en: Even the G20, which emerged when the G7 proved too narrow and exclusive to support effective economic-policy coordination, failed to change the game.

zh: 由于运转缺乏连续性，再加上各国之间存在分歧，G20的效果很快便打了折扣，特别是在全球衰退的威胁减退之后。
en: A lack of operational continuity, together with disagreements among countries, quickly undermined the G20’s effectiveness, especially after the threat of a global depression had passed.

zh: 考虑到所有这些因素，经济和金融全球化热情退潮根本不足为奇。
en: Given all this, it should come as no surprise that enthusiasm for economic and financial globalization has faltered.

zh: 事实上，发达和新兴经济体都早已提出了通过将更多国家权力委托给地区和国际机构来加强这些机构的概念。
en: Indeed, both advanced and emerging economies have long balked at the notion of strengthening regional and international institutions by delegating more national authority to them.

zh: 如今，一些国家采取了更加内向的方针，并/或将注意力转向了双边关系，亚洲则注重地区关系。
en: Now, some countries are adopting a more inward-looking approach and/or shifting their focus to bilateral and, in Asia, to regional linkages.

zh: 这样的转变让美国和中国等较大的经济体巨大的优势，而一些经济体和地区 — — 特别是非洲 — — 则被日益边缘化。
en: Such shifts give larger economies like the US and China a distinct advantage, while some economies and regions – particularly in Africa – face increasing marginalization.

zh: 围绕修改后的统一范式构建共识绝非易事。
en: Building consensus around a revised unifying paradigm will not be easy.

zh: 这是一个分析困难大、政治要求高、时间花费长的过程，在好主意生根之前，可能需要考察并拒绝不少坏主意。
en: It will be an analytically challenging, politically demanding, and time-consuming process that will probably entail the consideration and rejection of a few bad ideas before good ones take root.

zh: 与此前的共识构建过程相比，它也是一个跨越更多学科的智识包容的过程 — — 自下而上性胜于自上而下性。
en: It will also be a more multidisciplinary and intellectually inclusive process – more bottom-up than top-down – than the one that preceded it.

zh: 它需要进行明智的调整，以适应人工智能、大数据和移动性等创新。
en: It will need to adapt intelligently to innovations in artificial intelligence, Big Data, and mobility.

zh: 与此同时，经济学家和决策者在改善现状方面都起着重要作用。
en: In the meantime, both economists and policymakers have an important role to play in improving the existing situation.

zh: 在国际层面 ， “ 公平贸易”的概念 — — 更不用说社会取代（social displacement ） — —应该成为更大的政策讨论点。
en: At the international level, the concept of “fair trade” – not to mention social displacement – should be a bigger part of policy discussions.

zh: 经济体 — — 特别是欧洲 — — 需要积极致力于改革疲于奔命、日益丧失信誉的多边治理体系。
en: And economies – especially Europe – need to work actively to reform a tired system of multilateral governance that increasingly lacks credibility.

zh: 此外，需要更深度地考察实体经济和金融之间的反馈环。
en: Moreover, feedback loops between the real economy and finance need to be examined in greater depth.

zh: 分配问题，包括中产阶级的压力以及因为社会安全网过度伸张而极容易被遗漏的人群的窘境应该得到更好的理解和解决。
en: Distributional issues, including pressures on the middle class and the predicament of population segments vulnerable to slipping through stretched social safety nets, need to be better understood and addressed.

zh: 这就要求人们更加深入地理解技术驱动的结构变化，科技巨头要与政府同步理解并对其日益提升的系统重要性做出调整。
en: This demands deeper comprehension of technology-driven structural changes, with Big Tech recognizing and adjusting to its growing systemic importance in step with government.

zh: 上一个经济范式之所以失去信誉，关键原因在于自满。
en: Complacency was a central reason for the last economic paradigm’s loss of credibility.

zh: 我们切不可雪上加霜。
en: Let us not allow it to do any more damage than it already has.

zh: 乱套的宏观
en: Messed-Up Macro

zh: 伊萨卡—直到几年前，各种流派的经济学家还异口同声信心满满地宣布大萧条永远不会再次发生。
en: ITHACA – Until a few years ago, economists of all persuasions confidently proclaimed that the Great Depression would never recur.

zh: 从某种程度上说，他们是对的。
en: In a way, they were right.

zh: 2008年金融危机爆发后，我们迎来的是大衰退。
en: After the financial crisis of 2008 erupted, we got the Great Recession instead.

zh: 政府成功地通过向全球经济注入巨量货币、将利率大幅削减至零限制住了伤害。
en: Governments managed to limit the damage by pumping huge amounts of money into the global economy and slashing interest rates to near zero.

zh: 但是，在遏制了2008—2009年的崩溃后，他们的知识和政治弹药库也用尽了。
en: But, having cut off the downward slide of 2008-2009, they ran out of intellectual and political ammunition.

zh: 经济顾问们向他们的老板保证，复苏将很快发生。
en: Economic advisers assured their bosses that recovery would be rapid.

zh: 也确实出现了一些复苏；但2010年就陷入了停滞。
en: And there was some revival; but then it stalled in 2010.

zh: 与此同时，政府出现了巨额赤字 — — 这是经济衰退的后遗症 — — 这应该由复苏的增长来消化。
en: Meanwhile, governments were running large deficits – a legacy of the economic downturn – which renewed growth was supposed to shrink.

zh: 在欧元区，希腊等国家因为银行援助把私人债务转变为公共债务，而面临着主权债务危机。
en: In the eurozone, countries like Greece faced sovereign-debt crises as bank bailouts turned private debt into public debt.

zh: 注意力转向了财政赤字问题以及赤字与经济增长的关系问题。
en: Attention switched to the problem of fiscal deficits and the relationship between deficits and economic growth.

zh: 政府应该有意扩大赤字以抵消家庭和投资需求的下降吗？
en: Should governments deliberately expand their deficits to offset the fall in household and investment demand?

zh: 还是他们应该试图削减公共支出以解放私人支出资金？
en: Or should they try to cut public spending in order to free up money for private spending?

zh: 两种观点都可以以促增长的政策面目出现，这取决于你持有何种宏观经济理论。
en: Depending on which macroeconomic theory one held, both could be presented as pro-growth policies.

zh: 第一种观点可以促使经济扩张，因为政府增加了公共支出；第二种则是因为政府在削减公共支出。
en: The first might cause the economy to expand, because the government was increasing public spending; the second, because they were cutting it.

zh: 凯恩斯理论认为第一种对；而政府一边倒地相信第二种。
en: Keynesian theory suggests the first; governments unanimously put their faith in the second.

zh: 这一选择的后果是显而易见的。
en: The consequences of this choice are clear.

zh: 一个如今获得相当多一致赞同的结论是自2010年以来，财政紧缩导致发达经济体损失了5—10个百分点的GDP增长。
en: It is now pretty much agreed that fiscal tightening has cost developed economies 5-10 percentage points of GDP growth since 2010.

zh: 所有这些产出和收入都永久地损失了。
en: All of that output and income has been permanently lost.

zh: 此外，由于财政紧缩扼杀了经济增长，削减预算赤字和国民债务占GDP的比重的任务变得更加困难了。
en: Moreover, because fiscal austerity stifled economic growth, it made the task of reducing budget deficits and national debt as a share of GDP much more difficult.

zh: 削减公共支出似乎与削减赤字不一样，因为它同时把经济也给“削减”了。
en: Cutting public spending, it turned out, was not the same as cutting the deficit, because it cut the economy at the same time.

zh: 争论应该到这里就结束了。
en: That should have ended the argument.

zh: 但并非如此。
en: But it did not.

zh: 一些经济学家宣称2010年时政府面临着风险权衡：削减赤字也许放慢了增长，但不致力于削减赤字可能导致情况更加糟糕。
en: Some economists claim that governments faced a balance of risk in 2010: Cutting the deficit might have slowed growth; but not committing to cut it might have made things even worse.

zh: 这一观点认为，凯恩斯主义药方忽视了财政政策对预期的影响。
en: The Keynesian remedy, the argument went, ignored the effect of fiscal policy on expectations.

zh: 如果公共观点认为削减赤字是正确的事情，那么允许赤字增加将让一切希望发生的刺激效应泡汤。
en: If public opinion believed that cutting the deficit was the right thing to do, then allowing the deficit to grow would annul any of its hoped-for stimulatory effect.

zh: 预期税收必须增加才能“支付”额外的支出会让家庭和公司增加储蓄。
en: Expecting that taxes would have to rise to “pay for” the extra spending, households and companies would increase their saving.

zh: 担心主权违约会让债券市场要求政府为其借款支付极高利率。
en: Fearing sovereign defaults, bond markets would charge governments punitive interest rates on their borrowing.

zh: 还有一个紧箍咒：承诺财政紧缩让财政部长们给自己营造了一些财政放松的空间。
en: And here was the clincher: By committing themselves to fiscal tightening, finance ministers gave themselves scope for some fiscal loosening.

zh: 摆出一副财政美德的样子让他们得以行财政恶行之实。
en: Proclaiming fiscal virtue enabled them to practice fiscal vice.

zh: 他们可以通过比所承诺的少削减一些制造财政幻觉。
en: They could create a fiscal illusion by cutting less than they promised.

zh: 大部分财政部长做的就是这种事。
en: Most finance ministers did exactly that.

zh: 这就是宏观经济学给自己造成的混乱局面的一部分。
en: This is part of the mess into which macroeconomics has gotten itself.

zh: 信念和预期被引入经济学后（这看起来相当合理 ） ， 财政政策的结果就变得含糊不清了。
en: Once beliefs and expectations are introduced into economics, as is surely reasonable, the results of fiscal policy become indeterminate.

zh: 太多结论取决于人们认为政策结果会是如何。
en: Too much depends on what people think the results of the policy will be.

zh: 用经济学的行话说，政策结果是“模型依赖的 ” 。
en: In the economists’ lingo, policy results are “model-dependent.”

zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖获得者克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）对于他所谓的“信心仙女”嗤之以鼻。 “信心仙女”是指财政政策必须领导对债券市场的支持的观点。
en: The Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman has poured scorn on what he calls the “confidence fairy,” the claim that fiscal policy must command the support of the bond markets.

zh: 但证明实际政策让情况变得更糟并不意味着更好的���策是实际可行的。
en: But to show that actual policy made things worse does not mean that a better policy was actually available.

zh: 正确的政策的成功也许取决于公众对其效果的预期。
en: The right policy’s success may depend on the public’s expectations of its effects.

zh: 一个未知的问题是为何公众的预期是错的。
en: The unanswered question is why the public should have the wrong expectations.

zh: 如果说财政政策令人一头雾水的话，货币政策也不遑多让。
en: If fiscal policy is in a muddle, so is monetary policy.

zh: 中央银行试图通过开动印钞机 — — 技术上通过在二级市场上购买政府债券实现 — — 规避信心仙女。
en: Central banks have tried to avoid the confidence fairy by printing money – technically, by buying government bonds on the secondary market.

zh: 都出来的资金预期会在整个经济中渗透，加速经济活动。
en: The extra money is expected to percolate through the economy, quickening activity.

zh: 欧洲央行刚刚开始一项1.1万亿欧元的债券购买计划，以此绕开德国对财政扩张的否定。
en: The European Central Bank has just started a €1.1 trillion ($1.17 trillion) bond-purchase program to bypass the German veto on fiscal expansion.

zh: 但所谓的量化宽松的效果也取决于预期。
en: But the effects of so-called quantitative easing also depend on expectations.

zh: 如果给企业更多的钱能增强它们的信心，他们就会花得更多。
en: If giving businesses extra cash makes them more confident, they will spend more.

zh: 如果它们不相信这套政策，它们就会把现金囤积起来。
en: If they mistrust the policy, they will hoard the cash.

zh: 美国和英国的量化宽松结果是模棱两可的。
en: The results of quantitative easing in the United States and the United Kingdom have been equivocal.

zh: 诚然，政府因为收益率的下降而可以以更低成本获得资金。
en: Governments, it is true, could get their money cheaper as yields fell.

zh: 但银行并没有把可获得的资金用于贷款，部分是因为这些钱用来降低其自身的债务，部分则是因为贷款需求低迷。
en: But banks were not lending the money made available to them, partly because they used it to pay down their own debts, and partly because of low demand for loans.

zh: 量化宽松的主要积极效应体现在资产价格上 — — 主要是金融资产。
en: The main positive effect of quantitative easing was on asset prices – chiefly financial assets.

zh: 但富人更富并不一定会造成大量额外支出，倒确实增加了不平等性和资产泡沫的危险，而资产泡沫有可能带来新的金融动荡。
en: But greater wealth for the rich does not necessarily produce much extra spending. It does increase inequality and threaten asset bubbles, which could lead to a new financial crash.

zh: 因此，进入后危机时代的我们对于复苏和防止未来崩溃都没有一致意见。
en: So we enter the post-crisis era without any settled view on the right macro policy for either recovery or prevention of future meltdowns.

zh: 人们寄厚望于改善金融监管以阻止过度信用创造。
en: Great hopes are pinned on better financial regulation to stop excessive credit creation.

zh: 但什么是“过度 ” ？
en: But what is “excessive”?

zh: 央行会继续保持2%的通胀目标吗？
en: Will central banks continue to target 2% inflation?

zh: 还是它们应该依赖“名义收入”目标。
en: Or should they rely on a “nominal income” target?

zh: 新财政规则应该如何？ 对欧元区来说，又应该如何执行？
en: What should the new fiscal rules be, and how – in the eurozone – should they be enforced?

zh: 经济学家争论市场经济是否是天然稳定的。
en: Economists debate whether market economies are naturally stable.

zh: 作为凯恩斯主义者，我坚定认为市场经济需要通过政策来稳定。
en: As a Keynesian, I firmly believe that market economies need to be stabilized by policy.

zh: 但凯恩斯主义者必须直面一个令人不快的事实，即稳定政策的成功可能取决于企业界具有凯恩斯主义的预期。
en: But Keynesians have to face the uncomfortable truth that the success of stabilization policies may depend on the business community having Keynesian expectations.

zh: 他们需要信心仙女站在他们这一边。
en: They need the confidence fairy to be on their side.

zh: 经济民粹主义是如何运作的？
en: How Economic Populism Works

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 现在民粹主义者正在西方掌权，同时在酝酿的还有相关策略的知识产权冲突。
en: SANTIAGO – Now that populists are coming to power in the West, a conflict over the intellectual ownership of their approach is brewing.

zh: 像约翰·朱迪斯这样的作家称十九世纪美国人发明了政治民粹主义，其特点是反精英立场和煽动性言论。
en: Writers like John Judis claim that nineteenth-century Americans invented political populism, with its anti-elitist stance and inflammatory rhetoric.

zh: 诞生过超级民粹主义者胡安·多明戈·庇隆的阿根廷和热图利奥·瓦加斯的巴西或许对此不敢苟同。
en: Argentines, who gave the world über-populist Juan Domingo Perón, or Brazilians, who brought us Getúlio Vargas, might beg to differ.

zh: 但没人不赞成拉美人是经济民粹主义最出色、也最长期的奉行者。
en: Yet there can be no disagreement that Latin Americans have been the longest and best practitioners of economic populism.

zh: 20世纪，庇隆和瓦加斯，再加上秘鲁的阿兰·加西亚（至少在他的首个任期 ） 、 尼加拉瓜的丹尼尔·奥尔特加以及智利的萨尔瓦多·阿连德，还有其他很多人都奉行贸易保护主义，从而催生大量预算赤字，导致经济过热，容忍通胀上升并最终引发了目前的货币危机。
en: In the twentieth century, Perón and Vargas, plus Alan García in Perú (at least during his first term), Daniel Ortega in Nicaragua and Salvador Allende in Chile, and many others, engaged in trade protectionism, ran large budget deficits, overheated their economies, allowed inflation to rise, and eventually suffered currency crises.

zh: 近年来，委内瑞拉的乌戈·查韦斯和尼古拉斯·马杜罗将上述政策引向了新低。
en: In recent years, Hugo Chávez and Nicolás Maduro of Venezuela took these policies to new lows.

zh: 正在陷入国内经济民粹主义的富裕世界应当从拉美经历中吸取哪些教训？
en: What should the rich world, now undergoing its own bout of economic populism, learn from Latin America’s experience?

zh: 不要搞错：从体制专家的过往记录判断，富裕国家需要一些教训。
en: Make no mistake: judging by the track record of its establishment pundits, the rich world needs some lessons.

zh: 在英国，退欧反对者坚称如果选民决意要离开欧盟，那么即使不爆发全面经济危机，陷入到经济衰退也是不可避免的。
en: In Britain, Brexit opponents insisted that if voters decided to leave the European Union, a recession, if not a full-blown economic crisis, would be inevitable.

zh: 公投结束后，英镑有所贬值，但其他不利情况似乎没有怎么发生。
en: After the referendum, the pound depreciated some, but nothing much else happened.

zh: 今天，英国经济继续增长。
en: Today, the British economy continues to grow.

zh: 在美国，经济学者一再警告特朗普经济计划近乎愚蠢，在他令人震惊地赢得大选之后，有些人预言经济灾难近在咫尺。
en: In the United States, academic economists repeatedly warned that Trump’s economic plans were little short of lunacy, and in the aftermath of his shocking election victory, some prophesied immediate economic catastrophe.

zh: 从那以后，股票市场已经达到创记录的高位，商品价格已经复苏，对美国经济增长的预测持续上升。
en: Since then, the stock market has reached record heights, commodity prices have recovered, and forecasts of US economic growth keep rising.

zh: 专家们是否在胡言乱语？
en: Have the pundits been smoking something?

zh: 还是特朗普和英国退欧领导人物法拉奇废除了宏观经济学原则？
en: Or have Trump and pro-Brexit leader Nigel Farage abrogated the principles of introductory macroeconomics?

zh: 实际情况并非如此。
en: Nothing of the sort.

zh: 但人们必须先了解背后的逻辑，才能真正了解民粹主义政策。
en: But to understand the effects of populist policies, one must first understand their logic.

zh: 在一篇经典的论文中，加州大学洛杉矶分校的塞巴斯蒂安·爱德华兹和麻省理工大学已故学者鲁德格·多恩布施将经济民粹主义定义为“强调增长和收入再分配的经济学法则，但这种方法轻视通胀和赤字融资风险、外部制约因素以及经济因素对激进非市场政策的反应。
en: In a classic paper, Sebastian Edwards of UCLA and the late Rudiger Dornbusch of MIT define economic populism as “an approach to economics that emphasizes growth and income redistribution and deemphasizes the risks of inflation and deficit finance, external constraints, and the reaction of economic agents to aggressive nonmarket policies.”

zh: ”他们补充说民粹主义策略“最终会失败 ” ， 但这不是因为保守经济学更好，而是“民粹主义政策不可持续。 ”
en: They add that populist approaches “do ultimately fail,” not because conservative economics is better, but as “the result of unsustainable policies.”

zh: “最终”可能需要很长时间。
en: “Ultimately” can be a very long time.

zh: 恰恰因为具备民意基础才被称为民粹主义政策。
en: Populist policies are called that because they are popular.

zh: 这些政策受欢迎是因为它们能起作用 — — 至少在一段时间内。
en: And they are popular because they work – at least for a while.

zh: 在经济低迷期推行大规模财政刺激可以加速增长和创造就业机会。
en: A sizeable fiscal stimulus in a sluggish economy produces a pickup in growth and job creation.

zh: 如果金融市场逐渐看涨（金融市场常常上涨 ） ， 那么汇率升值，压制新生通胀压力并压低进口价格。
en: If financial markets turn bullish (as they often do), the exchange rate appreciates, quelling nascent inflationary pressures and making it cheaper to import.

zh: 而且，就像阿根廷经济学家兼哥伦比亚大学教授吉列尔莫·卡尔沃一直坚持的那样，恰恰因为民粹主义政策不可持续，才会导致人们将未来的消费转移到现在，在情况尚好的时候及时行乐。
en: And, as Argentine economist and Columbia University professor Guillermo Calvo has long argued, precisely because they are unsustainable, populist policies cause people to shift spending from the uncertain future to the present, when the going is good.

zh: 这进一步强化了刺激政策的影响，这种影响在固定汇率下尤其强劲。
en: This reinforces the expansionary impact of the stimulus, which is particularly strong under fixed exchange rates.

zh: 因此欧元区国家一定要提高警惕！
en: So, eurozone countries: beware!

zh: 在消费、信贷、就业蓬勃发展和资产价格高涨的情况下，温暖而朦胧的繁荣感渗透着社会。
en: With consumption, credit, and employment booming and asset prices sky-high, a warm and fuzzy feeling of prosperity permeates society.

zh: 民粹主义领袖被证明正确，而他们绝不会羞于领功。
en: Populist leaders feel vindicated, and they are not shy about claiming credit.

zh: 他们的支持率只会一路上升。
en: Their approval rating can only go up – and it does.

zh: 很快，禁酒主义者开始警告债务累积速度过快、信贷质量恶化、通胀压力上升、高估的汇率正在对出口企业造成长期影响。
en: Soon, teetotalers begin to warn that debt is accumulating too quickly, credit quality is deteriorating, inflationary pressures are incubating, and an overvalued exchange rate is doing lasting harm to exporters.

zh: 但音乐声太大、舞姿眼花缭乱，因此没有人听到这些警告。
en: But the music is too loud and the dancing too lively, so no one listens to the warnings.

zh: 派对能持续多久？
en: How long can the party go on?

zh: 拉美故事告诉我们要看具体情况，其中以初始条件最为重要。
en: One thing we know from the Latin American episodes is that the answer depends, first of all, on initial conditions.

zh: 多数工业经济体自金融危机以来几乎没有任何增长。
en: Most industrial economies have grown little since the financial crisis.

zh: 最常见的问题是通缩而非通胀。
en: Deflation, not inflation, has been the problem.

zh: 是的，美国失业率大幅下降。
en: Yes, the unemployment rate has dropped considerably in the US.

zh: 但在过去十年经历了这么多冲击和技术变革之后，人们很难确定尚未使用的力量究竟有多少，以及不加速通胀的就业率(NAIRU) 在什么地方。
en: But after so many shocks and so much technological change over the last decade, there is considerable uncertainty about how much unused capacity remains and where the non-accelerating inflation rate of unemployment (NAIRU) lies.

zh: 特朗普之流很可能发现他们可以在很长一段时间内刺激经济，直到出现明显的不平衡。
en: It could well be that the likes of Trump find that they can stimulate the economy for quite a while before obvious imbalances emerge.

zh: 另一个教训是无论公共或私人债务都会起到限制作用。
en: The other thing we have learned is that debt, both public and private, does become a constraint.

zh: 但这种作用何时、以何种方式体现却需要取决于债务类型。
en: But when and how depends crucially on what kind of debt it is.

zh: 今天，先进经济体以接近于零（甚至有时为负）的利率借贷本币债务。
en: Today, advanced economies borrow in their own currencies at near-zero (and sometimes negative) interest rates.

zh: 即使开始时债务占GDP比率已经很高，但仍有可能需要很长时间债务增长才能触发紧急状况。
en: Even if the starting point is a high debt-to-GDP ratio, it can be a long time before growing debt triggers an emergency.

zh: 类似的情况日本人曾经经历过。
en: Just ask the Japanese.

zh: 如果金融市场最终退缩并停止借贷将会发生什么情况？
en: What happens when financial markets finally get cold feet and stop lending?

zh: 其实，就像诺贝尔奖得主经济学家保罗·克鲁格曼在最近一篇论文中所描述的那样，面对国外去杠杆化冲击，一个汇率灵活、债务以本币计价的经济体非但不会收缩，反而会扩张。
en: Well, as the Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman was at pains to demonstrate in a recent paper, an economy with flexible exchange rates and debt denominated in domestic currency will expand, not contract, in response to a foreign deleveraging shock.

zh: （当然，克鲁格曼当时是在民主党总统治下争取财政扩张政策，但个中道理其实相同。
en: (Of course, Krugman was arguing for fiscal expansion under a Democratic president, but the point still stands.)

zh: ）即便如此，危机也不会即刻爆发。
en: Not even then do you get an immediate crisis.

zh: 1953年，庇隆送信给同为军队将领的智利总统卡洛斯·伊巴涅斯。
en: In 1953, Perón sent a message to Chilean president Carlos Ibáñez, a fellow army general.

zh: “我亲爱的朋友：给予民众、尤其是劳动者，一切可能的好处 ， ” 他写道。
en: “My dear friend: give the people, especially the workers, all that is possible,” he wrote.

zh: “没有什么比经济更富于弹性，人人都害怕经济是因为他们无知。
en: “There is nothing more elastic than the economy, which everyone fears so much because no one understands it.”

zh: ”如果特朗普有时间思考，他也可能得出同样的结论。
en: Trump, should he come to think about it, might stumble to the same conclusion.

zh: 美国、英国和其他国家的反民粹主义者必须接受这样一个现实：即不良政策在毒害经济前，或许会在很长时间内改善经济和政治情况。
en: Anti-populists in the US, the UK, and elsewhere must come to terms with the reality that bad policies pay off, both economically and politically, long before they become toxic.

zh: 是的，过度的私人和公共债务、出口能力丧失、体制削弱有损于经济（和政治 ） — —但只有经过很长时间才能体现损害结果。
en: Yes, the excessive private and public debt, the loss of export capacity, and the weakening of institutions harm the economy (and the polity) – but only in the long run.

zh: 如果批评者不理解这一点并采取相应行动，民粹主义者在富裕国家的机会就会像曾经在拉丁美洲一样漫长（且具有破坏性 ） 。
en: If critics do not understand that and act accordingly, populists will have as long (and destructive) a run in the rich countries as they once had in Latin America.

zh: 丰裕年代的经济学
en: Economics in the Age of Abundance

zh: 伯克利—直到最近，人类所面临的最大挑战之一是确保有足够多的吃的。
en: BERKELEY – Until very recently, one of the biggest challenges facing mankind was making sure there was enough to eat.

zh: 从农业雏形齐到工业时代，普通人的条件都处于营养学家和公共卫生专家认为严重和有害的营养生物医学压力状态。
en: From the dawn of agriculture until well into the Industrial Age, the common human condition was what nutritionists and public-health experts would describe as severe and damaging nutritional biomedical stress.

zh: 大约在250年前，乔治英格兰是有史以来最富裕的社会，但食品短缺仍然困扰着很大一部分人口。
en: Some 250 years ago, Georgian England was the richest society that had ever existed, and yet food shortages still afflicted large segments of the population.

zh: 被皇家海洋协会（Marine Society）派去船上为官员服务的青少年要比上流人士的孩子矮15厘米。
en: Adolescents sent to sea by the Marine Society to be officer’s servants were half a foot (15 centimeters) shorter than the sons of the gentry.

zh: 在经历了一百年的经济增长后，美国工作阶级仍要把40%的收入用于增加卡路里。
en: A century of economic growth later, the working class in the United States was still spending 40 cents of every extra dollar earned on more calories.

zh: 如今，食品短缺已不再是个问题，至少在高收入国家是如此。
en: Today, food scarcity is no longer a problem, at least in high-income countries.

zh: 在美国，大约1%的劳动力就能生产足够多的食品为全国人口提供足够的卡路里和必要营养素，而运输和分销这些食品则需要另外1%的劳动力即可。
en: In the US, roughly 1% of the labor force is able to grow enough food to supply the entire population with sufficient calories and essential nutrients, which are transported and distributed by another 1% of the labor force.

zh: 当然，这并不是食品行业的全部。
en: That does not account for the entire food industry, of course.

zh: 但其余致力于将食品送到我们口中的14%的劳动力的工作是让我们吃得更美味或更方便 — — 这与其说是必需品，不如说是娱乐或艺术。
en: But most of what is being done by the remaining 14% of the labor force dedicated to delivering food to our mouths involves making what we eat tastier or more convenient – jobs that are more about entertainment or art than about necessity.

zh: 如今，我们面临的挑战是丰裕。
en: The challenges we face are now those of abundance.

zh: 事实上，就致力于我们的饮食的工人而言，不妨加上另外4%的劳动力，他们是护士、药剂师和教育者，帮助我们解决因消费过多卡路里或错误的营养素所造成的问题。
en: Indeed, when it comes to workers dedicated to our diets, we can add some of the 4% of the labor force who, working as nurses, pharmacists, and educators, help us solve problems resulting from having consumed too many calories or the wrong kinds of nutrients.

zh: 20多年前，时任美联储主席格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）开始指出，美国GDP增长不再主要由试图获得更多东西的消费者驱动。
en: More than 20 years ago, Alan Greenspan, then-Chair of the US Federal Reserve, started pointing out that GDP growth in the US was becoming less driven by consumers trying to acquire more stuff.

zh: 繁荣的中产阶级对于沟通、寻找信息和试图获得正确的东西实现想要的生活的兴趣要大得多。
en: Those in the prosperous middle class were becoming much more interested in communicating, seeking out information, and trying to acquire the right stuff to allow them to live their lives as they wished.

zh: 当然，世界其他地区仍然面临稀缺问题；大约三分之一的世界人口难以获得足够的食物。
en: Of course, the rest of the world still faces problems of scarcity; roughly one-third of the world’s population struggles to get enough food.

zh: 也没人能够担保这些问题自我解决。
en: And there is no guarantee that those problems will solve themselves.

zh: 不能忘记，150多年前，马克思和穆勒（John Stuart Mill）都认为，印度和英国不出三代人就能实现经济趋同。
en: It is worth recalling that a little over 150 years ago, both Karl Marx and John Stuart Mill believed that India and Britain would converge economically in no more than three generations.

zh: 值得担忧的问题多得是：核武器的破坏力、愚蠢固执的政治、气候变化所带来的巨大的潜在社会破坏。
en: There is no shortage of problems to worry about: the destructive power of our nuclear weapons, the pig-headed nature of our politics, the potentially enormous social disruptions that will be caused by climate change.

zh: 但经济学家 — — 事实上，是人类 — — 的首要关注点是找到办法刺激平等的经济增长。
en: But the number one priority for economists – indeed, for humankind – is finding ways to spur equitable economic growth.

zh: 但第二重要的任务 — — 发展经济理论指导丰裕时代的社会 — — 也同样复杂。
en: But job number two– developing economic theories to guide societies in an age of abundance – is no less complicated.

zh: 一些可能出现的问题已经显而易见。
en: Some of the problems that are likely to emerge are already becoming obvious.

zh: 如今，许多人从工作中获得自尊。
en: Today, many people derive their self-esteem from their jobs.

zh: 随着劳动力在经济中的重要性的降低，特别是工作年龄人口在劳动力中比例的降低，与社会包容相关的问题必然会更加长期、更加尖锐。
en: As labor becomes a less important part of the economy, and working-age men, in particular, become a smaller proportion of the workforce, problems related to social inclusion are bound to become both more chronic and more acute.

zh: 这一趋势的后果可能远远不止于个人或心理，而是造就 — — 用诺贝尔经济学奖获得者乔治·阿克洛夫（George Akerlof）和罗伯特·希勒（Robert Shiller）的话说 — — 轻易就上钩的愚民。
en: Such a trend could have consequences extending far beyond the personal or the emotional, creating a population that is, to borrow a phrase from the Nobel-laureate economists George Akerlof and Robert Shiller, easily phished for phools.

zh: 换句话说，他们会沦为并不把他们的福祉作为第一目标的人的目标 — — 比如麦道夫（Bernie Madoff）这样的骗子、麦当劳或烟草公司这样的公司利益集团、占星大师、经营剥削式彩票（exploitative lotteries）的囊中羞涩的政府等。
en: In other words, they will be targeted by those who do not have their wellbeing as their primary goal – scammers like Bernie Madoff, corporate interests like McDonalds or tobacco companies, the guru of the month, or cash-strapped governments running exploitative lotteries.

zh: 这些问题需要与亚当·斯密所发轫的截然不同的经济学。
en: Problems like these will require a very different type of economics from the one championed by Adam Smith.

zh: 核心挑战不是在可能的情况下保护天赋自由和构建机构在其他地区仿照其效果，而是帮助人们保护自己不受操纵。
en: Instead of working to protect natural liberty where possible, and building institutions to approximate its effects elsewhere, the central challenge will be to help people protect themselves from manipulation.

zh: 诚然，经济学家是否具有解决这些问题的比较优势尚��清楚。
en: To be sure, it is not clear that economists will have a comparative advantage in addressing these problems.

zh: 但是，至少从现在看，阿克洛夫、希勒、理查德·赛勒（Richard Thaler）和马修·拉宾（Matthew Rabin）等行为经济学家正处于领先地位。
en: But, for now at least, behavioral economists like Akerlof, Shiller, Richard Thaler, and Matthew Rabin seem to be leading the field.

zh: 无论如何，只需要一瞥标题你就能理解，这一问题已经成为我们的经济时代的决定性特征。
en: In any case, one need only glance at the headlines to comprehend that the issue has become a defining feature of our economic epoch.

zh: 性别平等的商业理由
en: Making the Business Case for Gender Equality

zh: 纽约—放眼全球，性别偏见正在吸引更多注意力。
en: NEW YORK – Around the world, gender bias is attracting renewed attention.

zh: 世界各地的妇女通过示威游行和病毒社交媒体运动要求杜绝性骚扰、暴力 、 “ 直男癌”和不平等性。
en: Through protest marches and viral social-media campaigns, women everywhere are demanding an end to sexual harassment, abuse, femicide, and inequality.

zh: 但是，尽管“我也是 ” （ #MeToo）和“时间不多了 ” （ #TimesUp）等运动引起了公众的关注，平等斗争仍远未结束。
en: But, as successful as the #MeToo and #TimesUp movements have been in raising public awareness, the struggle for parity is far from over.

zh: 妇女和女童赋权是实现全部17个2030年联合国可持续发展目标的关键。
en: Empowering women and girls is key to achieving all 17 of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals by 2030.

zh: 但目前的情况是性别偏见仍然是全球进步的一大障碍，其中职场性别偏见尤其尖锐。
en: At the moment, however, gender bias remains a significant obstacle to global progress, and it is particularly acute in the workplace.

zh: 据非营利的CEO观察机构Catalyst的数据，如今，只有5%的标准普尔500公司由女性领导。
en: Today, only 5% of S&P 500 companies are led by women, according to Catalyst, a non-profit CEO watchdog.

zh: 令这一让人失望的数字更加触目惊心的是，据国际劳工组织（ILO）所做的调查，由73%的跨国企业声称制定了机会平等政策。
en: That dismal figure is all the more remarkable when one considers that 73% of global firms allegedly have equal-opportunity policies in place, according to a survey by the International Labour Organization (ILO).

zh: 此外，尽管研究表明一家公司的性别平衡程度与其财务健康程度密切相关，但在全球最大的企业中，女性占管理层的比例还不到20 % 。
en: Moreover, while research shows a clear link between a company’s gender balance and its financial health, women occupy fewer than 20% of governing board seats in the world’s largest companies.

zh: 克服这些缺陷既是经济要求，也是道德要求。
en: Addressing such deficiencies is both an economic and a moral imperative.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所（MGI）2015年的一份报告发现，如果女性和男性在“劳动力市场中扮演相同角色 ” ， 那么到2025年，全球经济能够增加28万亿美元规模。
en: A 2015 report by the McKinsey Global Institute found that if women and men played an “identical role in labor markets,” $28 trillion would be added to the global economy by 2025.

zh: 这些全球收益尚不包括个别公司的收益。
en: These global gains would be in addition to the benefits for individual companies.

zh: 性别更加平等的企业更有创新力，更慷慨，效益更好。
en: Firms with greater gender equality are more innovative, generous, and profitable.

zh: 但在当前女性赋权水平下，需要近220年才能填补性别差距。
en: But, at the current rate of female empowerment, it would take nearly 220 years to close the gender gap.

zh: 世界不能等这么久，我们需要新方法。
en: The world cannot afford to wait that long; we need a new approach.

zh: 为了帮企业勾勒雇用、留住和晋升女员工的路线图，我们和400多位全球商界领袖和政府代表一起参加了本周在智利圣地亚哥举行的第四届企业性别平等全球论坛。
en: To help chart a path for companies to hire, retain, and promote female employees, we are joining more than 400 global business leaders and government representatives in Santiago, Chile, this week for the Fourth Global Forum on Business for Gender Equality.

zh: 这次会议由智利政府和联合国开发规划署（UNDP）主办，ILO和联合国妇女组织（UN Women）协办，将强调性别平等在私营部门的重要性。
en: The gathering – organized by the Chilean government and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), in partnership with the ILO and UN Women – will highlight the importance of gender equality in the private sector.

zh: 一个将被会议列入议程的方案是UNDP支持的性别平等认证（Gender Equality Seal）项目，这是一个独一无二的计划，认证消灭了薪酬差距、增加了决策岗位的女性人数、致力于消除职场性骚扰的公司。
en: One solution that will be on the agenda is the UNDP-supported Gender Equality Seal program, a unique initiative that certifies companies that have eliminated pay gaps, increased the number of women in decision-making positions, and worked to end sexual harassment on the job.

zh: 如今，得到UNDP认证的公司正在领导全球构建更加平衡的劳动力大军。
en: Today, these UNDP-certified companies are leading the way in building a more balanced global workforce.

zh: 比如，智利国有企业国家铜业公司（Codelco）正在提高女性员工的级别 — — 并在此过程中提高了生产率。
en: For example, Chile’s state-owned copper mining company, Codelco, is increasing its ranks of female employees – and boosting productivity in the process.

zh: 类似地，哥斯达黎加国民银行（Banco Nacional）将几十名女性提拔到管理层；现在，该银行是女企业家金融的地区领先提供商。
en: Similarly, Costa Rica’s Banco Nacional has promoted dozens of women into managerial roles; the bank is now a leading regional provider of financing to female entrepreneurs.

zh: 而在加拿大，丰业银行（Scotiabank）依靠女性导师项目一举成为业内性别最平衡的公司之一。
en: And in Canada, Scotiabank has used a female mentorship program to become one of the industry’s most gender-balanced companies.

zh: 我们希望有更多的企业寻求获得性别平等认证，甚至可以在本周就表现出这样的意图。
en: Our hope is that many more firms will strive for gender equality certification, possibly even by signaling their intent this week.

zh: 另一项将被讨论的项目是妇女赋权原则（Women’s Empowerment Principles ） ， 这是由联合国妇女组织和联合国全球契约（Global Compact）共同制定的指引规程，从商业角度证明性别平等的重要性。
en: Another initiative to be discussed is the Women’s Empowerment Principles, a set of operating guidelines developed by UN Women and the UN Global Compact that embodies the business case for gender equality.

zh: 已有1,700多位CEO支持该原则，61个国家的近300家使用该项目的免费性别差距分析工具帮助管理者在职场实现性别平等。
en: More than 1,700 CEOs have endorsed the principles, while nearly 300 companies in 61 countries have used the initiative’s free gender gap analysis tool to help managers implement them in the workplace.

zh: 平心而论，全球会议、认证系统和免费软件都只是解决方案的一部分。
en: To be sure, global meetings, certification systems, and free software are only part of the solution.

zh: 女性仍然肩负着巨大的家庭负担，而来自社会和文化规范的压力常常剥夺她们上学、创业或参与公共生活的机会。
en: Women still bear disproportionate domestic burdens, and pressures stemming from social and cultural norms often rob them of the chance to attend school, start businesses, or participate in public life.

zh: 此外，哪怕女性真的获得了走出家门、走入职场的机会，她们也处在弱势一方，工资性别差距平均高达23 % ， 这表明平等性问题不仅只关乎机会。
en: Moreover, women who do have paying jobs outside the home are on the wrong side of a gender wage gap that averages 23%, suggesting that equality is not only about opportunity.

zh: 企业、社区和家庭必须携手打造公平的竞争平台。
en: Businesses, communities, and families must work together to level the playing field.

zh: 幸运的是，无动于衷的成本对任何企业 — — 以及作为整体的经济 — — 都是不可承受之重，因此，我们对消除职场性别偏见的可能性十分乐观。
en: Fortunately, the cost of doing nothing is too high for any business—and economies as a whole—to bear, which is why we are optimistic that eliminating gender bias at work is possible.

zh: 当公司将女性赋权作为其企业战略的核心时，增长和平等就能够互相强化，而不是互相压制。
en: When companies make female empowerment central to their business strategies, growth and equality can be mutually reinforcing to leave no one behind.

zh: 不断缩窄的中国政策回旋余地
en: China’s Narrowing Policy Horizons

zh: 发自北京 — — 回顾2011年最后一个季度，当时中国的投资增长加速下滑，加上官方不愿实施新经济扩张政策，使人们对经济硬着陆的担忧不断加剧。
en: BEIJING – Back in the last quarter of 2011, when the decline in China’s investment growth accelerated, concerns about a hard economic landing intensified, particularly given the authorities’ reluctance to pursue new expansionary policies.

zh: 然而从2012年5月开始政府转变了思维，国家发展改革委员会批准上马了总额达7万亿元人民币（折合1.3万亿美元）的新项目，再结合中国人民银行的连接两次降息，保证了经济放缓态势在2012年第三季度实现了扭转。
en: By May 2012, however, the government had changed its mind, with the National Development and Reform Commission approving ¥7 trillion ($1.3 trillion) in new projects. That, together with two ensuing interest-rate cuts by the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), guaranteed an end to the economic slowdown in the third quarter of 2012.

zh: 中国经济的表现因此保持了过去二十年来极为常见的循环模式:由经济扩张政策支撑的快速投资增长抬高了经济增长率。
en: The Chinese economy’s performance has thus maintained the cyclical pattern familiar from the past two decades: rapid investment growth, supported by expansionary policy, drives up the economic-growth rate.

zh: 由此引发了通货膨胀，于是政策紧缩，导致经济增长放缓。
en: Inflation follows, so policy is tightened and growth slows.

zh: 但通货膨胀率依然居高不下，甚至仍在上涨，所以需要强制实施更多的紧缩政策。
en: But inflation remains high or rising, so more tightening is imposed.

zh: 最终通货膨胀降了下来，但经济增长的减速程度超过了预期，这是经济周期早期的过度投资导致的产能过剩所引起的。
en: Inflation falls at last, but growth slows more than desired, owing to the overcapacity that resulted from excessive investment in the earlier phase of the cycle.

zh: 此时政策又变成了扩张性的，而周期又重新开始了：在投资增长的牵引之下，经济再度实现反弹。
en: At this point, policy becomes expansionary again, and the cycle begins anew: led by investment growth, the economy rebounds.

zh: 由此可见，2012第三季度以来的经济增长加速应属意料之内。
en: Thus, the acceleration of economic growth since the third quarter of 2012 should come as no surprise.

zh: 只要政府依然有使用扩张性货币和/或财政政策的空间，经济复苏就只不过是个时间问题。
en: With the government still having room to wield expansionary monetary and/or fiscal policy, the economic revival was only a matter of time.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国经济在2013年仍将遵循旧有的增长模式。
en: There is no reason to doubt that the Chinese economy in 2013 will follow the old growth pattern.

zh: 但中国的决策者们必须牢记两点：首先，在过去，短期的宏观经济稳定通常是以放弃结构性调整和资源合理配置为代价实现的。
en: But China’s decision-makers should bear two things in mind. First, in the past, short-term macroeconomic stability was often achieved at the expense of structural adjustment and rational allocation of resources.

zh: 要实现可持续发展，必须达成短期和长期目标的平衡。
en: To achieve sustained growth, a balance between short-term and long-term objectives must be struck.

zh: 而如何实现这一平衡则是中国当前所面临的最大挑战。
en: Striking that balance is the biggest challenge facing China.

zh: 第二，中国经济存在着一些金融缺陷。
en: Second, some financial vulnerabilities are embedded in the economy.

zh: 除非这些缺陷被及时处理，否则金融冲击有可能会使经济偏离正常的轨道。
en: Unless they are defused in time, financial shocks may derail the economy from its normal growth path.

zh: 根据初步报告，2012年的年投资增长率约为14 % — —比GDP增长率显著高了许多，由于房地产和基础设施投资的强劲反弹，这种情况在第四季度还进一步加速了。
en: According to preliminary reports, annual investment growth in 2012 reached roughly 14% – significantly higher than the GDP growth rate, which accelerated in the fourth quarter as a result of a strong rebound in investment in real estate and infrastructure.

zh: 2013年，可以预料得到的是，除非发生重大的破坏性事件，否则强劲的投资增长将在每一年度都推动中国GDP增长在8%以上。
en: In 2013, it can be expected that, barring major disruptions, strong investment growth will push China’s GDP more than 8% higher year on year.

zh: 不可避免的政策回转到紧缩的时机取决于总体的通货膨胀，尤其是房价。
en: The timing of the inevitable policy shift back to tightening depends on overall inflation, particularly house prices.

zh: 问题在于投资占中国GDP的比重已经达到了50 % ， 而2013年高达两位数的投资增长预计会使得这一比率更高。
en: The problem is that the investment share of China’s GDP is already about 50%, while double-digit investment growth in 2013 is expected to push that rate still higher.

zh: 这样的增长模式根本是不可持续的。
en: Such a growth path is simply not sustainable.

zh: 过去几十年来货币供给明显快过产出。
en: The money supply has grown significantly faster than output for decades.

zh: 2012年，M2的增长率约为14 % ， 相对历史标准来说比较低，但仍然显著高于正常GDP增长率。
en: In 2012, the growth rate of M2 was about 14%, relatively low by historical standards, but still significantly higher than the nominal GDP growth rate.

zh: 由于这种广义货币的长期快速增长，中国M2对GDP的比率已经超过了180 % ， 为全世界最高。
en: As a result of this chronically rapid growth in broad money, China’s M2/GDP ratio has surpassed 180%, the highest in the world.

zh: 尽管这种特有的高比率对宏观经济稳定的全面影响需要进一步的证实，它肯定意味着金融脆弱性和中国人民银行对经济中总体流动性控制力的削弱。
en: Though the full implications of this uniquely high ratio for macroeconomic stability need further investigation, it certainly implies financial fragility and a weakening of the PBOC’s ability to control overall liquidity in the economy.

zh: 此外，尽管中国国债对GDP比率官方宣称仍然在20%以下，由于2008的爆发的全球金融危机，其财政状况已经恶化，如果将政府的或有债务计算在内的话，中国的债务对GDP比率可能接近50 % 。
en: Third, though China’s public debt/GDP ratio is officially still under 20%, since the onset of the global financial crisis in 2008, its fiscal position has deteriorated. If the government’s contingent liabilities are included, China’s debt/GDP ratio may be closer to 50%.

zh: 另外一个令人担忧的情况是企业债务的快速上升，根据各种研究，现在已经超过了GDP的120 % — —这比主要发达国家非金融企业的杠杆率还要高得多。
en: A worrying development in this regard is the rapid rise in enterprise debt, which, according to various studies, now surpasses 120% of GDP – much higher than the leveraging rates of nonfinancial enterprises in major developed countries.

zh: 即便这不会引发危机，它也会急剧减少政府使用扩张性财政政策来刺激经济的运作余地。
en: Even if this does not trigger a crisis, it sharply narrows the government’s scope for using expansionary fiscal policy to stimulate the economy.

zh: 在2011年及2012年初有很多关于中国房地产市场崩盘及地下信贷网络和地方政府金融平台违约的连锁反应的言论。
en: In 2011 and early 2012, there was much talk of a crash in China’s housing market, and a chain-reaction of defaults in underground credit networks and local-government finance platforms.

zh: 2013年，这种言论转向了房地产泡沫重现和影子银行系统崩溃的危险，后者主要是那些财富管理企业和信托公司。
en: In 2013, the talk has changed to the danger of a resurgent housing bubble and the collapse of the shadow banking system, which consists mainly of wealth-management firms and trust companies.

zh: 根据市场消息指出，��影子银行系统管理的总资产自2009年起已经以指数方式增长，至2012年第三季度已达14万亿元，相当于GDP的三分之一。
en: According to market sources, total assets managed by the shadow banking system have risen exponentially since 2009, totaling ¥14 trillion, or one-third of GDP, in the third quarter of 2012.

zh: 由于增长相对缓慢，公司的利润率 — — 这是影子银行系统资产池的收益来源 — — 很低且一直在下降。
en: With relatively slow growth, corporate profitability, upon which the returns of the shadow banking system’s asset pools are based, is low and falling.

zh: 那么影子银行系统提供的金融产品的高回报又从何而来呢?
en: Where, then, will the high returns of the financial products provided by the shadow banking system come from?

zh: 如果影子银行系统崩溃，对金融系统的后果来说将会比地下信贷网络和地方政府金融平台所引起的问题更加严重，这些在2012年都有了很多的讨论。
en: If the shadow banking system collapses, the consequences for the financial system will be much graver than the problems caused by underground credit networks and local-government finance platforms, which were much discussed in 2012.

zh: 因此，难怪被视为中国人民银行行长潜在的继任者—周小川(他本人同时也是很有影响力的银行家)曾提出警告：有可能会出现中国式的次贷危机。
en: No wonder, then, that one influential banker regarded as a possible successor to PBOC Governor Zhou Xiaochuan has warned of the possibility of a “Chinese-style subprime crisis.”

zh: 目前，中国经济已经收到了其周期性刺激措施的成效，应该没什么大问题。
en: For now, the Chinese economy, having received its cyclical dose of stimulus, should be okay.

zh: 然而到今年年底，用来把中国经济从依靠投资需求转型到其他增长模式的结构性调整所付出的代价可能会进一步增加。
en: By the end of the year, however, the costs of the structural adjustment needed to shift China’s growth model away from investment demand could rise further.

zh: 经济复苏为什么不是民粹主义的对手？
en: Why Economic Recovery Won’t Defeat Populism

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 市场就像本周举行的达沃斯专家会议那样充满了希望：世界经济正在走向平衡而可持续的复苏。
en: SANTIAGO – Markets, like the pundits meeting in Davos this week, are hopeful: the world economy is well on its way toward a balanced and perhaps sustained recovery.

zh: 随着经济状况的好转，政治局势是否也会走上同样的道路？
en: With the economy on the mend, will politics follow suit?

zh: 对那些把全球民粹主义看作全球金融危机余震的人来说，答案的确如此。
en: For people who view the surge in populism around the world as an aftershock of the global financial crisis, the answer is yes.

zh: 随着失业率下降和中产阶级收入开始增加，民粹主义诱惑将会日渐萎缩，至少这是他们的希望。
en: As unemployment falls and middle-class incomes begin growing, the populist temptation will wither, or so they hope.

zh: 如果事情真像这么简单该有多好。
en: If only it were that simple.

zh: 碰巧正在台上的民粹主义政治家（比如唐纳德·特朗普或赞成英国脱欧的保守党）将把经济复苏的功劳据为己有，而这将增强他们的政治力量。
en: Populist politicians who happen to be in office (think Donald Trump or pro-Brexit Tories) will claim credit for the recovery, and that will strengthen their political hand.

zh: 但这不过是一种短期现象。
en: But that is only a short-term phenomenon.

zh: 过去几年来，宣扬民粹主义经济和政治/社会解读的人发生了激烈的争论。
en: During the last few years, a lively debate has taken place between advocates of economic and political/social explanations of populism.

zh: 经济方面的解释强调在经济不平等加剧和中产阶级收入停滞不前的世界里（这里美国被列为主要案例 ） ， 如果愤怒的中产和工人阶级选民转而相信那些承诺扭转这些趋势的政客，那么人们绝对不应当感到惊讶。
en: The economic explanation emphasizes that in a world of widening economic inequality and stagnating middle-class incomes (here the United States is cited as Exhibit A), no one should be surprised if angry middle- and working-class voters turn to politicians who promise to reverse these trends.

zh: 问题仍远未解决，但即使经济解释完全正确，也并不意味着当前的全球复苏能带来多大的政治变化。
en: The issue is far from settled, but even if the economic explanation is right, it does not follow that the current global recovery will make much of a political difference.

zh: 如果说最近的资产价格上涨预示着任何东西（请注意实际利率很可能在相当长的一段时间内仍然保持在低位 ） ， 经济增长的好处很有可能再次不成比例地惠及最有钱、收入最高的1 % 。
en: If recent asset-price inflation is any indication of things to come (and note that real interest rates are likely to remain low for a very long time), growth could be of the kind that again disproportionately increases the income and wealth of the top 1%.

zh: 即使在收入分配确实开始改善的最好情况下，所有派别的经济学家全都赞同的一个观点是可能会极为缓慢的发生变化。
en: Even in the best-case scenario, in which income distribution did begin to improve, one thing economists of all stripes agree on is that change would be glacially slow.

zh: 造成政治动荡的其他某些因素 — — 去工业化、制造业岗位减少、落后城市和地区居高不下的失业率 — — 即使能够发生改变也将是非常缓慢的。
en: Other factors that have plausibly stoked political upheaval – deindustrialization, loss of manufacturing jobs, stubborn pockets of unemployment in left-behind cities and regions – would also change very slowly, if at all.

zh: 即使高涨的复苏大潮的确能像保守派经济学家所说的那样让所有船只浮起来，但也不足以让众多船只摆脱民粹主义所掀起的风暴。
en: Even if the rising tide of recovery does lift all boats, as conservative economists like to say, it will not be enough to push many vessels clear of populist tempests.

zh: 这同样因为民粹主义背后的诸多因素是非经济性的。
en: That is also because many of the factors behind populism are non-economic.

zh: 首要证据是民粹党派在经济表现相对强劲的国家已经获得了民众的支持（如果他们仍未掌权的话 ） 。
en: The first piece of evidence is that populist parties have gained mass support (if not power) in countries with relatively strong economic performance.

zh: 在德国和瑞典这样的发达国家尤其如此，像菲律宾和土耳其等新兴经济体也处于同样的状况。
en: This is true of developed countries like Germany and Sweden, and of emerging economies like the Philippines and Turkey.

zh: 就像人们常常指出的那样，民粹主义是一种政治形式，它制造出一个名叫“他人”的群体可以承担社会弊病的罪责。
en: As is frequently pointed out, populism is a style of politics that creates an “other” on which society’s ills can be blamed.

zh: 在左翼民粹主义运动中，这个“他人”是精英 — — 无论经济、金融还是政治精英都一概囊括。
en: In the left-wing variety, the “other” is the elite – whether economic, financial, or political.

zh: 对右翼民粹主义分子而言，外国人、移民、少数民族和少数教派也能够发挥同样的作用。
en: For right-wing populists, foreigners, immigrants, or ethnic and religious minorities serve the same purpose.

zh: 这远不是什么新现象。
en: The phenomenon is far from new.

zh: 民粹主义在19世纪末的美国曾普遍存在；而20世纪欧洲的法西斯主义则是右翼民粹主义的某种花样；而左翼民粹主义当然一直作为拉美政治的重要特点，从几十年前的瓦加斯到胡安·多明戈·贝隆再到今天的克里斯蒂娜·费尔南德斯·德·基什内尔以及尼古拉斯·马杜罗。
en: Populism was widespread in the US in the late nineteenth century; twentieth-century European fascism was a variety of right-wing populism; and left-wing populism has of course been a feature of Latin American politics from Getúlio Vargas and Juan Domingo Perón decades ago to Cristina Fernández de Kirchner and Nicolás Maduro today.

zh: 两大因素最有可能促成了近期的民粹主义回归：文化和社会变革加速，以及外界眼中根深蒂固的政治精英的腐败现象。
en: Two factors have arguably facilitated the recent return of populism: accelerated cultural and social change, and the perceived corruption of established political elites.

zh: 让我们从文化和社会变革开始。
en: Start with cultural and social change.

zh: 像艾米尔·杜尔凯姆、费迪南德·托尼斯、格奥尔格·齐美尔等社会学巨擎很久以前就开始担忧从传统向现代社会的转型过程破坏了传统的支撑结构，导致社会中的个体感到被孤立和不快乐。
en: Giants of sociology, like Émile Durkheim, Ferdinand Tönnies, and Georg Simmel, worried long ago that the transition from traditional to modern society undermined traditional support structures and left individuals feeling isolated and unhappy.

zh: 疏远是现代化的结果，而不是现代化缺失的症状。
en: Alienation was a result of modernization, not a symptom of its absence.

zh: 相对早期的教训是民粹主义可以在阶级或国家等长期身份来源遭到弱化的环境中茁壮成长。
en: The lesson of earlier periods is that populism thrives in environments where longstanding sources of identity – for example, class or nation – have weakened.

zh: 在富裕国家，文化全球化和大规模移民导致了这样的弱化；而在新兴国家，传统的角色和价值观正在让位于快速城市化和产业或服务业中新中产阶级的崛起浪潮。
en: In rich countries, this weakening has happened as a result of cultural globalization and mass migration; in emerging countries, traditional roles and values are succumbing to rapid urbanization and the rise of a new middle class employed in industry or services.

zh: 在过去几十年已经经历过经济快速增长的拉美国家，民众告诉民调人员他们比自己的父母生活得更好，而他们希望自己的子女能过上比自己更好的生活。
en: In Latin American countries that have experienced fast economic growth over the last couple of decades, people tell pollsters that they live much better than their parents and that they expect their children to live even better still.

zh: 但同样这些人里有不少称自己感到孤独和受到虐待，他们认为自己所处的社会是不公平的。 他们越来越不相信自己的邻居，并声称对民主体制感到失望。
en: Yet many of the same people report feeling alone and abused, think their society is unfair, increasingly distrust their neighbors, and claim to be disillusioned with democracy.

zh: 这样的选民恰恰是民粹主义民众运动的基础。
en: It is upon such voters that populist mass movements are built.

zh: 这让我们意识到支撑民粹主义的另外一个关键要素：那就是政治精英合法性的下降。
en: This brings us to the other key factor underpinning support for populism: the declining legitimacy of political elites.

zh: 如果不理解民众认为众多美国政界人士都为贪婪的银行家服务的普遍看法（无论这种看法正确与否 ） ， 要想理解特朗普的崛起都是不可能的。
en: It is impossible to understand Trump’s rise without recourse to the popular perception (correct or not) that many American politicians are in the pocket of greedy bankers.

zh: 如果选民不认为传统政治阶层普遍将公共资金装进自己的腰包，那么五星运动要想在意大利取得如此之大的进展根本就无法想象。
en: Arguably, the Five Star movement would not have gained so much strength in Italy if voters there didn’t think the traditional political class had systematically enriched itself with public money.

zh: 当然，如果没有众多政治精英的腐败，拉美民粹主义浪潮取得如此长足的发展也是不可理解的。
en: Latin American populism, of course, is incomprehensible without the corruption of many in the political elite.

zh: 巴西建筑公司回扣的超级丑闻涉及拉美地区几乎所有的国家，而这只不过是一段长期而悲惨的历史中一段最新的篇章。
en: Brazil’s mega-scandal of payoffs by construction companies, reaching into almost every country in the region, is the latest chapter in a long and sad history.

zh: 所有这些都不会随全球经济复苏而改变。
en: None of this will change with the global economic recovery.

zh: 我们需要政治领导力 — — 来帮助人们理解身边发生的变化 — — 并在金钱和政治之间树立起难以逾越的可靠围墙，同时利用技术来加强民主问责制并推动公民参与。
en: What we need is political leadership – to help people make sense of the changes they are experiencing – and reforms that build credible Chinese walls between money and politics, and use technologies to increase democratic accountability and facilitate citizen participation.

zh: 央行管理者 — — 那些穿着灰色西装的当前经济好转的工程师 — — 已经完成了他们的工作。
en: Central bankers – the gray-suited engineers of the current economic upturn – have done their job.

zh: 现在应当轮到政治家上场。
en: Politicians now have to do theirs.

zh: 投资不足的世界
en: A World of Underinvestment

zh: 米兰—70年前，当二战结束时，世界大部 — — 包括工业化的欧洲、日本和其他占领国 — — 因为地缘政治而被割裂，并背上了沉重的主权债务，许多主要经济体满目疮痍。
en: MILAN – When World War II ended 70 years ago, much of the world – including industrialized Europe, Japan, and other countries that had been occupied – was left geopolitically riven and burdened by heavy sovereign debt, with many major economies in ruins.

zh: 你也许会认为，在相当一段长的时间里，国际合作将非常有限，增长将十分缓慢，失业率将保持高位，还会出现极端私有化啊，因为各国无力为巨大的投资需要提供融资。
en: One might have expected a long period of limited international cooperation, slow growth, high unemployment, and extreme privation, owing to countries’ limited capacity to finance their huge investment needs.

zh: 但事实并非如此。
en: But that is not what happened.

zh: 相反，世界领导人采取了长期的远见卓识。
en: Instead, world leaders adopted a long-term perspective.

zh: 他们认识到，他们的国家的债务减少取决于名义经济增长，而它们的经济增长前景 — — 更不用说持续和平了 — — 取决于世界的复苏。
en: They recognized that their countries’ debt-reduction prospects depended on nominal economic growth, and that their economic-growth prospects – not to mention continued peace – depended on a worldwide recovery.

zh: 因此，它们利用 — — 甚至扩大 — — 资产负债表进行投资，同时向国际贸易开放自己，从而帮助重塑需求。
en: So they used – and even stretched – their balance sheets for investment, while opening themselves up to international trade, thereby helping to restore demand.

zh: 美国 — — 它面临着巨大的公共债务，但实体资产基本安然无恙 — — 自然在这一过程中起到了领导作用。
en: The United States – which faced considerable public debt, but had lost little in the way of physical assets – naturally assumed a leadership role in this process.

zh: 战后经济复苏有两个显著特点。
en: Two features of the post-war economic recovery are striking.

zh: 首先，各国没有将主权债务视为硬约束（binding constraint ） ， 而是追求投资和潜在增长。
en: First, countries did not view their sovereign debt as a binding constraint, and instead pursued investment and potential growth.

zh: 其次，它们在诸多前沿彼此合作，资产负债表最强的国家帮助别的国家刺激投资，吸引私人投资。
en: Second, they cooperated with one another on multiple fronts, and the countries with the strongest balance sheets bolstered investment elsewhere, crowding in private investment.

zh: 冷战的爆发也许鼓励了这一方针。
en: The onset of the Cold War may have encouraged this approach.

zh: 如论如何，各国并没有各自为战。
en: In any case, it was not every country for itself.

zh: 今天的全球经济与二战刚刚结束时有诸多惊人的相似之处：高失业、不断增加的高债务水平，以及全球总需求短缺制约着增长、形成通缩压力。
en: Today’s global economy bears striking similarities to the immediate post-war period: high unemployment, high and rising debt levels, and a global shortage of aggregate demand are constraining growth and generating deflationary pressures.

zh: 与当时一样，今天的投资水平和质量也一直欠缺，对有形和无形资本 — — 长期增长的关键因素 — — 的公共支出持续大大低于最有水平。
en: And now, as then, the level and quality of investment have been consistently inadequate, with public spending on tangible and intangible capital – a critical factor in long-term growth – well below optimal levels for some time.

zh: 当然，现在也有新挑战。
en: Of course, there are also new challenges.

zh: 收入分配的动态在近几十年中发生了恶化，阻止了关于经济政策的共识。
en: The dynamics of income distribution have shifted adversely in recent decades, impeding consensus on economic policy.

zh: 而人口老化 — — 寿命延长和生育率下降的结果 — — 也在给公共财政制造压力。
en: And aging populations – a result of rising longevity and declining fertility – are putting pressure on public finances.

zh: 尽管如此，刺激经济增长和就业的有效战略要素是类似的：可动用的（主权和私人）资产负债表应该用于制造总需求、刺激公共投资，即使这会增加杠杆。
en: Nonetheless, the ingredients of an effective strategy to spur economic growth and employment are similar: available balance sheets (sovereign and private) should be used to generate additional demand and boost public investment, even if it results in greater leverage.

zh: 最新的IMF研究表明，给定过剩产能，政府有望从有利的短期乘数中获益。
en: Recent IMF research suggests that, given excess capacity, governments would probably benefit from substantial short-run multipliers.

zh: 更重要的是，着重投资将改善长期可持续增长前景，让政府和家庭能够追求负责任的去杠杆化。
en: More important, the focus on investment would improve prospects for long-term sustainable growth, which would enable governments and households to pursue responsible deleveraging.

zh: 类似地，国际合作对于今天的成功的重要性也不亚于70年前。
en: Likewise, international cooperation is just as critical to success today as it was 70 years ago.

zh: 有投资余力的（公共、准公共和私人）资产负债表在全球不是均匀分布的，我们需要制定全球性方针 — — 多边金融机构在其中要起到重要作用 — — 疏通阻塞的中介渠道。
en: Because the balance sheets (public, quasi-public, and private) with the capacity to invest are not uniformly distributed around the world, a determined global effort – which includes an important role for multilateral financial institutions – is needed to clear clogged intermediation channels.

zh: 国家有大量的激励进行合作，而不是采取贸易、金融、货币政策、公共部门采购、税收政策或其他方式互相破坏。
en: There is plenty of incentive for countries to collaborate, rather than using trade, finance, monetary policy, public-sector purchasing, tax policy, or other levers to undermine one another.

zh: 毕竟，当今全球化金融和经济系统的一大特征乃是连通性，如果没有几乎遍地开花的广泛复苏，任何一地都不可能获得充分复苏。
en: After all, given the connectedness that characterizes today’s globalized financial and economic systems, a full recovery anywhere is virtually impossible without a broad-based recovery nearly everywhere.

zh: 但是，近几年来，在绝大部分情况下，世界的合作相当有限，各国不但认为必须做好自我保护，还认为它们的债务水平构成了对刺激增长的投资的硬约束。
en: Yet, for the most part, limited cooperation has been the world’s chosen course in recent years, with countries believing not only that they must fend for themselves, but also that their debt levels impose a hard constraint on growth-generating investment.

zh: 由此导致的投资不足和全球经济资产基��的折旧正在遏制生产率增长，从而破坏可持续复苏。
en: The resulting underinvestment and depreciation of the global economy’s asset base are suppressing productivity growth and thus undermining sustainable recoveries.

zh: 在缺少强力国际再投资项目的情况下，各国使用货币政策刺激增长。
en: In the absence of a vigorous international re-investment program, monetary policy is being used to prop up growth.

zh: 但货币政策通常注重国内复苏。
en: But monetary policy typically focuses on domestic recovery.

zh: 此外，尽管非常规手段降低了金融不稳定性，但它们抵挡普遍的通缩压力或重塑增长的效果仍令人怀疑。
en: And, though unconventional measures have reduced financial instability, their effectiveness in countering widespread deflationary pressures or restoring growth remains dubious.

zh: 与此同时，储蓄者受到抑制，资产价格被扭曲，保持甚至增加杠杆的激励获得了增强。
en: Meanwhile, savers are being repressed, asset prices distorted, and incentives to maintain or even increase leverage enhanced.

zh: 竞争性贬值 — — 即使它们并非决策者公开承认的目标 — — 的吸引力正在日益增加，尽管它们更本无法解决总需求问题。
en: Competitive devaluations, even if they are not policymakers’ stated objectives, are becoming increasingly tempting – though they will not solve the aggregate-demand problem.

zh: 这并不是说突然的货币政策“正常化”是一个好主意。
en: This is not to say that sudden “normalization” of monetary policy is a good idea.

zh: 但是，如果大规模投资和改革计划作为非常规货币政策的补充手段实施，经济可能走上恢复力更强的增长路径。
en: But, if large-scale investment and reform programs were initiated as complements to unconventional monetary-policy measures, the economy could move onto a more resilient growth path.

zh: 尽管国际合作方针有着显而易见的好处，但仍鲜有实施。
en: Despite its obvious benefits, such a coordinated international approach remains elusive.

zh: 尽管不少贸易和投资协定正在谈判中，但大多是地区规模。
en: Though trade and investment agreements are being negotiated, they are increasingly regional in scope.

zh: 与此同时，多边贸易体系正在瓦解，创造这一体系的共识亦然。
en: Meanwhile, the multilateral trade system is fragmenting, along with the consensus that created it.

zh: 当今全球经济的显著特征是互连性和互相依存性，不愿合作是难以理解的。
en: Given the level of interconnectedness and interdependence that characterizes today’s global economy, the reluctance to cooperate is difficult to comprehend.

zh: 一个问题也许在于制约性（conditionality ） ， 各国不愿承诺采取补充性财政和结构改革。
en: One problem seems to be conditionality, with countries unwilling to commit to complementary fiscal and structural reforms.

zh: 这在欧洲尤其明显，人们指出 — — 有一定道理 — — 没有这些改革，增长将一直萎靡不振，维持甚至恶化财政约束。
en: This is especially evident in Europe, where it is argued, with some justification, that, without such reforms, growth will remain anemic, sustaining or even exacerbating fiscal constraints.

zh: 但如果制约性如此重要，为何它没有在70年前阻挡合作？
en: But if conditionality is so important, why didn’t it prevent cooperation 70 years ago?

zh: 受损严重的经济体能看见独立复苏的有限前景，它们会拒绝接受国际合作带来的机会，这一观点可能无法令人信服。
en: Perhaps the idea that severely damaged economies, with limited prospects for independent recoveries, would pass up the opportunity that international cooperation presented was implausible.

zh: 也许至今仍然如此。
en: Maybe it still is.

zh: 如果是这样，今天创造类似的机会可以改变激励，触发所需要的补充性改革，让全球经济走上更坚挺的长期复苏之路。
en: If so, creating a similar opportunity today could change the incentives, trigger the required complementary reforms, and put the global economy on course to a stronger long-term recovery.

zh: 美国增长契约
en: A Growth Pact for America

zh: 纽约—美国将再次迎来分裂的政府，民主党保有白宫，共和党控制国会两院。
en: NEW YORK – America, once again, will have a divided government, with the Democrats holding the White House, and the Republicans controlling both houses of Congress.

zh: 但这并不一定意味着奥巴马总统任期的最后两年一定会在僵局和互相指责中度过。
en: But that does not necessarily mean that the final two years of Barack Obama’s presidency need to be defined by stalemate and mutual recrimination.

zh: 选民渴望改变、害怕低增长持续，此乃共和党在本周国会中期选举中获胜的原因，也不可避免地激起了关于提高增长、就业和收入的政策选择的讨论。
en: The electorate’s desire for change and fear of continuing slow growth, which pushed the Republicans to their victory in this week’s mid-term congressional election, will invariably prompt discussion about new policy options designed to raise growth, employment, and incomes.

zh: 当然，美国过去的政府分裂经验或许让人对两党形成妥协的前景感到悲观，但是，墨西哥的三大政党最忌在市场导向的“墨西哥契约 ” （ Pact for Mexico）上形成了一致，这表明，即使是极端对立的两党也可以克服猜疑，共同实施需要的改革。
en: Of course, America’s experience with divided government can leave one pessimistic about the two parties’ ability to compromise; but, as Mexico recently demonstrated when its three big parties agreed on a market-oriented “Pact for Mexico,” even bitterly opposed political parties can overcome their suspicions to embrace needed reforms.

zh: 有利于美国的潜在政策行动很多，包括贸易自由化、全面监管改革、移民和教育改革等。
en: The list of potential policy actions that could benefit the United States – trade liberalization, comprehensive regulatory reform, and immigration and education reform, among others – is long.

zh: 但在“美国契约”中，只有两项政策最有希望：联邦基础设施支出和公司税改革。
en: But only two policies are particularly promising for such a “Pact for America”: federal infrastructure spending and corporate-tax reform.

zh: 实施这些改革将令每一方都受益，取得双赢效果。
en: Enactment of these reforms would generate a win for each side – and for both.

zh: 但这一跨党派共识需要克服左翼和右翼的意识形态障碍，至少暂时是如此。
en: But such a bipartisan consensus requires removing both the left and the right’s ideological blinders, at least temporarily.

zh: 左翼眼里只有凯恩斯主义刺激，这反映出对措施的可实施性（万事俱备的工程）和合意性（是否能对家庭和企业期望产生有意义的影响）的误解。
en: On the left, a preoccupation with Keynesian stimulus reflects a misunderstanding of both the availability of measures (shovel-ready projects) and their desirability (whether they will meaningfully change the expectations of households and businesses).

zh: 事实上，为了抵消源自最近金融危机的思维，要想提高未来增长预期从而刺激当前投资和就业，支出措施需要继续持续下去。
en: Indeed, to counteract the mindset forged in the recent financial crisis, spending measures will need to be longer-lasting if they are to raise expectations of future growth and thus stimulate current investment and hiring.

zh: 右翼必须反思其沉迷于临时性家庭和企业减税的做法。
en: The right, for its part, must rethink its obsession with temporary tax cuts for households or businesses.

zh: 这些减税措施对总需求的影响几乎总是聊胜于无，在后金融危机时期的衰退中，也无助于改变复苏和增长预期。
en: The impact of such cuts on aggregate demand is almost always modest, and they are poorly suited for shifting expectations for recovery and growth in the post-financial-crisis downturn.

zh: 政治将问题进一步复杂化了，因为完全短视地专注于支出和收入的财政影响与收益需要长时间才能逐渐显现的政策互相矛盾。
en: Politics complicates matters further, because the exclusively short-term focus on the fiscal impact of spending and revenues clashes with policies whose benefits accumulate over time.

zh: 尽管这些好处可能无法体现为“刺激 ” ， 但其累积效应能更好地起到提高未来需求和增长预期的效果。
en: While such benefits may not appear to be “stimulus,” their mounting effect better serves the objective of raising expectations of future demand and growth.

zh: 但不管是左翼还是右翼，严肃的人的担心并没有如此不同。
en: But the concerns of serious people, whether on the left or the right, are not so different.

zh: 经济增长是否能够足以提振就业和收入增长？
en: Will economic growth accelerate sufficiently to boost job and income growth?

zh: 将许多美国人排除在复苏和未来繁荣的壁垒能否消除？
en: Can the barriers that exclude many Americans from recovery and future prosperity be removed?

zh: 联邦基础设施支出和公司税改革应该成为吸引跨党派一致的最优先政策，因为它们有利于大幅提高长期生产率、收入和就业，同时也能支持短期增长。
en: Federal infrastructure spending and corporate-tax reform should top the list of policies capable of attracting bipartisan agreement, because they promise significant long-term productivity, income, and employment gains, while also supporting short-term growth.

zh: 比如，承诺多年期联邦基础设施支出计划能增加需求、私人投资和就业，即使这些工程可能眼下并不可行。
en: A commitment to a multi-year federal infrastructure-spending program, for example, could increase demand, private investment, and employment, even though projects may not be immediately available.

zh: 这样的计划常常由民主党提出，可以也应该加以修改以确保获得共和党的支持。
en: And such a program, normally proposed by Democrats, can and should be crafted to secure Republican support as well.

zh: 在这方面，基础设施计划应该让州和地方在选择为那些项目提供资金方面扮演关键角色，这些政府单元也应该承担部分成本，将自己的利益牵涉其中。
en: To that end, an infrastructure program should give states and localities a key role in selecting the projects to be funded, and these governmental units should have “skin in the game” by funding part of the costs.

zh: 决策者还应该认真考虑监管改革以降低新工程的支出、确保按时完工。
en: Policymakers should also give serious consideration to regulatory reforms that would reduce the expense of new projects and assure their timely completion.

zh: 以此为导向的基础设施项目 — — 而不是作为政策权宜之计的万事俱备工程 — — 应该能够激发保守派支持。
en: An infrastructure program oriented in this way – as opposed to a grab bag of politically expedient shovel-ready projects – should be able to muster conservative support.

zh: 如果实施得当，联邦出资的基础设施工程可以给低收入美国人带来巨大的好处。
en: And, done properly, federally funded infrastructure projects should provide substantial benefits to lower-income Americans.

zh: 比如，改善的交通基础设施不但可以创造就业，还能降低通勤成本。
en: Better transport infrastructure, for example, would not only create jobs, but would also reduce the costs of commuting to work.

zh: 公司税改革也有望获得跨党派一致，特别是考虑到奥巴马和两党国会领袖都表达出这方面的兴趣。
en: Corporate-tax reform also offers a good opportunity for bipartisan agreement, especially given that Obama and congressional leaders of both parties have expressed interest.

zh: 根本性税收改革 — — 比如以宽税基消费税取代当前税收体系 — — 好处巨大，在十年的时间里可以提振0.5—1个百分点的经济增长，而公司税改革也能够提振增长。
en: While gains from fundamental tax reform – say, replacing the current tax system with a broad-based consumption tax – are large, on the order of 0.5-1 percentage point per year of economic growth for a decade, corporate-tax reform would also boost growth.

zh: 大幅降低公司税率，同时取消定向企业税优惠并扩大公司税基将增加投资和工人工资。
en: Reducing the tax rate for companies substantially, while eliminating targeted business-tax preferences and broadening the corporate-tax base, would increase both investment and workers’ wages.

zh: 允许跨国公司汇回海外利润而不必多缴美国税也能够刺激美国国内的投资和就业创造。
en: Allowing multinational companies to repatriate overseas profits without paying additional US tax would also bolster investment and job creation at home.

zh: 最新研究表明，公司税有很大一部���是通过低工资形式由工人承担的，因此民主党应该能接受将税收改革作为支持收入增长的方式。
en: Given that recent research shows that much of the burden of corporate taxation is borne by workers in the form of lower wages, Democrats should embrace tax reform as a way to support income growth.

zh: 此外，还可以通过增加个体工人的劳动所得税抵扣（Earned Income Tax Credit）进一步支持低收入美国人。
en: One could add to such a reform further support for low-income Americans by increasing the Earned Income Tax Credit for single workers.

zh: 考虑到其政策目标，保守派应该支持精心规划的联邦基础设施项目，自由派应该支持公司税改革。
en: Given their policy objectives, conservatives should support a well-crafted federal infrastructure program, and liberals should support corporate-tax reform.

zh: 但政治过程的变化有助于推进进程。
en: But changes in the political process would help move matters ahead.

zh: 因为来自基础设施支出和税收改革的收益并不十分契合美国财政评估所使用的五年期和十年期预算窗口，因此要获得政治支持，更加全面地衡量这些政策的好处是至关重要的。
en: Because the payoffs from infrastructure spending and tax reform do not fit neatly within the five-year or ten-year budget window used by America’s fiscal scorekeepers, measuring more completely the benefits from such policies is vital to attracting political support.

zh: 此外，基础设施支出的任何增加或税收改革所导致的任何收入减少应该通过其他手段抵消。
en: Moreover, any increase in spending on infrastructure or any revenue loss from tax reform should be offset elsewhere.

zh: 比如，丰裕个人的社会保障金或住房按揭利息税收抵扣应该减少，美国保守派所提出的的累进指数化（progressive indexation）和英国在撒切尔夫人执政时期所实施的按揭利息税收抵扣调整证实了这一点。
en: For example, future growth in Social Security benefits or the home-mortgage-interest tax deduction could be scaled back for more affluent individuals, as progressive indexation, proposed by conservatives in the US, and the adjustment of mortgage-interest tax deductions in the United Kingdom, started during the Thatcher administration, attest.

zh: 显然，经济是美国人的首要关注点。
en: Clearly, the economy is Americans’ top concern.

zh: 其领导人必须采取专注于重振现在增长、持续未来增长的政策日程。
en: Its leaders must respond with a policy agenda focused on reviving growth now and sustaining it in the future.

zh: 但若要如此，必须有足够多的两党立法者以及总统破除思想和政治成见，达成创造就业和增加收入所必须的长期妥协。
en: But that can happen only if enough legislators in both parties, and the president, remove their intellectual and political blinders and reach the long-term compromises needed to create jobs and increase incomes.

zh: 美国契约（Pace for America）的时机已经成熟。
en: The time for a Pact for America has arrived.

zh: 难民路上的经济学家
en: Economists on the Refugee Path

zh: 纽黑文—今天的全球难民危机让人想起了第二次世界大战刚刚结束的时候。
en: NEW HAVEN – Today’s global refugee crisis recalls the period immediately after World War II.

zh: 据一项当代估算，光是在欧洲就有4,000万多难民。
en: By one contemporary estimate, there were more than 40 million refugees in Europe alone.

zh: 这些当时被称为“流民”的人因为暴力、强迫搬迁、迫害和房产和基础设施被毁而被迫逃离家园。
en: These “displaced persons,” as they were called at the time, were forced to flee their homes because of violence, forced relocation, persecution, and destruction of property and infrastructure.

zh: 战后的凄惨景象让联合国在1950年成立了难民署（High Commissioner for Refugees ） ， 该机构原本只是临时性的设置，目标是在三年的时间里保护流民。
en: The dire postwar situation led to the creation in 1950 of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, which was expected to serve only a temporary mandate, protecting displaced people for three years.

zh: 但这一问题从未消失。
en: But the problem never went away.

zh: 相反，联合国难民署不但仍然存在，还在敲响警钟。
en: On the contrary, the UNHCR is not only still with us; it is sounding an alarm.

zh: 在2015年年中报告中，联合国难民署认为2014年底全世界共有5,950万“被迫流离失所”者，其中包括1,950万国际流民（他们被定义为的真正的难民 ） 。
en: In its 2015 mid-year report, the agency put the number of “forcibly displaced” people worldwide at 59.5 million at the end of 2014, including 19.5 million internationally displaced, which they define as true refugees.

zh: 一些国家 — — 阿富汗、阿塞拜疆、哥伦比亚、中非共和国、民主刚果、伊拉克、缅甸、尼日利亚、巴基斯坦、索马里、南苏丹、苏丹、叙利亚和乌克兰 — — 各自都存在五十万以上被迫流离失所者。
en: Some countries – Afghanistan, Azerbaijan, Colombia, Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, Iraq, Myanmar, Nigeria, Pakistan, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, and Ukraine – each accounted for more than a half-million forcibly displaced people at the end of 2014.

zh: 报告指出，此后这一数字必定又有了极大的增长。
en: The report noted that the total number had certainly grown substantially since.

zh: 不幸的是，报告彰显出我们对难民为题理解的不足。
en: Unfortunately, the report underscores the incompleteness of our understanding of the refugee problem.

zh: 事实上，从历史上看，远赴另一地寻求庇护的难民的命运很少有人研究。
en: In fact, throughout history, the fate of refugees seeking asylum in another land has largely been unstudied.

zh: 历史学家记录战争，也会提一提侨民，但他们很少有兴趣研究难民危机如何产生或如何解决。
en: Historians record wars, and they mention diasporas, but they rarely show much interest in how refugee crises arose or were resolved.

zh: 历史总是由胜利者书写的，因此这也不奇怪。
en: To the extent that history is written by the victors, that is not surprising.

zh: 一国对某少数群体实施恐怖统治，以至于他们不得不逃往，或者某族人的祖先因为战败带着恐惧��到某地，这样的经历对于民族身份而言绝非令人振奋的源泉。
en: The knowledge that one’s country terrorized a minority to the point that its members had to flee, or that a substantial share of one’s forebears arrived in defeat and panic, is not exactly an inspiring source of national identity.

zh: 因此，这些故事不会口口相传。
en: So the stories, unheard and untold, are lost.

zh: 因此，我们需要更多地研究从长期看我们可以和应该为难民做些什么。
en: That is why we need more research on what can and should be done for refugees in the long term.

zh: 联合国难民署在保护难民方面起着重要作用，但它不可能满足难民的全部需要。
en: The UNHCR has been doing an important job in protecting refugees, but it cannot possibly address their needs alone.

zh: 2015年，联合国难民署预算为70亿美元，看起来很大，但摊到每个流离失所者头上每人只有100美元 — — 不足以覆盖食品和住所等最基本的需要。
en: Its budget of $7 billion in 2015 may seem large, but it amounts to only about $100 per displaced person – not enough to cover even essentials like food and shelter.

zh: 作为2016年美国经济协会主席，我感到一种道德责任，我们应该利用本月早些时候的美国经济协会年会关注严重经济问题。
en: As President of the American Economic Association for 2016, I felt a moral obligation to use our annual meeting earlier this month as a setting in which to bring attention to serious economic problems.

zh: 难民危机不论是什么，都属于经济问题。
en: And the refugee crisis, whatever else it may be, is an economic problem.

zh: 但提交美国经济协会年会的论文中很少有关注此问题的。
en: But a dearth of papers addressing it had been submitted to the meeting.

zh: 因此我决定组织一个名为“六千万难民”的分会，邀请经济学界最杰出的移民学者与会。
en: So I decided to create a session entitled Sixty Million Refugees, and invited some of our discipline’s most distinguished scholars on migration.

zh: 我请他们用经济学角度描述难民问题的各个维度，并且提出一些明智的政策建议解决这一问题。
en: I asked them to describe the dimensions of the refugee problem in economic terms, and to propose some sensible policies to address it.

zh: 埃塞克斯大学和澳大利亚国立大学的蒂莫西·哈顿（Timothy J. Hatton）的一篇文章考察了全球难民流以研究背后的驱动因素。
en: One of the papers, by Timothy J. Hatton of the University of Essex and Australian National University, examined refugee flows around the world, to see what drives them.

zh: 哈顿面对的是反对接纳难民的流行的理由：寻求庇护者并不是真正的绝望人群，只是利用危机作为借口进入更加富裕的国家。
en: Hatton confronts a popular argument against admitting refugees: that asylum-seekers are not really desperate, but are just using a crisis as a pretext for admission to a richer country.

zh: 他发现，与某些人的预期相反，难民流把主要由政治恐怖和侵犯人权行为驱动，而不是由经济力量驱动。
en: He finds that, contrary to some expectations, refugee flows are driven largely by political terror and human rights abuses, not economic forces.

zh: 担心生命安全的人会逃到最近而不是最富的安全地点。
en: People in fear for their lives run to the nearest safe place, not the richest.

zh: 帮助他们是无可逃避的道德责任。
en: There is no escape from the moral imperative to help them.

zh: 土耳其中央银行的塞米赫·图门（Semih Tumen）给出了关于220万叙利亚难民给边境地区劳动力市场造成何种影响的证据。
en: Semih Tumen of the Central Bank of Turkey presented evidence regarding the impact of the 2.2 million Syrian refugees on the labor market in the border region.

zh: 图门的文章也面对一个常常被用来反对接纳难民的理由：新来者会夺走本地人的饭碗并拉低工资。
en: Tumen’s paper, too, takes on an argument frequently used to oppose admitting refugees: that the newcomers will take locals’ jobs and drive down wages.

zh: 他发现，在正式部门，本地人工作岗位在难民涌入后事实上是增加的，这显然是拜难民流入对地区经济的刺激效应所赐。
en: He found that in the formal sector, jobs for locals actually increased after the influx of refugees, apparently because of the stimulative effect on the region’s economy.

zh: 如果更进一步的研究支持这一发现，那么各国也许就会欢迎劳动力的涌入了。
en: If further research backs up this finding, countries might actually welcome the inflow of labor.

zh: 乔治敦大学的苏珊·马丁（Susan F. Martin）的一篇文章描述了当前难民程序是如何“任性 ” ， 呼吁建立“基于保护需要而非引发难民的原因的法律框架 ” 。
en: Another paper, by Susan F. Martin of Georgetown University, described the arbitrariness of our current refugee procedures, calling for “legal frameworks based on the need for protection, rather than the triggering causes of the migration.”

zh: 但建立这样的规则需要进行一些仔细的经济考量。
en: But formulating such rules requires some careful economic thought.

zh: 难民制度的制定者需要考虑规则对移民本身以及母国政府的激励效应。
en: The framers of a refugee system need to consider the rules’ incentive effects on the migrants themselves and on the governments of their countries of origin.

zh: 比如，我们不希望让暴君能够轻而易举地将他不喜欢的少数群体赶出国家。
en: For example, we do not want to make it too easy for tyrants to drive unwanted minorities out of their country.

zh: 最后，哥伦比亚大学的杰弗里·萨克斯（Jeffrey D. Sachs）为管理难民提出了一套详细的新制度。
en: Finally, Jeffrey D. Sachs of Columbia University detailed a major new system for managing refugees.

zh: 萨克斯关注这一制度的规则如何在长期影响世界经济。
en: Sachs is concerned with how such a system’s rules will shape the world’s economies in the longer run.

zh: 他希望这一制度强制要求承诺不但要接受对东道国很有用的移民，也要接受低技能和绝望移民，以此防止刺激人才流失。
en: He wants such a system to prevent encouraging a brain drain by enforcing a commitment to admitting low-skilled and desperate immigrants, not just those who are highly useful to the host country.

zh: 此外，难民的流动速度必须得到监管，经济学家需要制定新方法确保各国公平分担负担。
en: Moreover, the rate of flow must be regulated, and economists need to develop a way to ensure equitable burden sharing among countries.

zh: 在当今无序又陈旧的避难规则下，难民必须冒很大的风险才能抵达安全之地，帮助难民的成本和收益的分配也十分不确定。
en: Under today’s haphazard and archaic asylum rules, refugees must take enormous risks to reach safety, and the costs and benefits of helping them are distributed capriciously.

zh: 这是完全可以改进的。
en: It does not have to be this way.

zh: 经济学家可以检验哪些国际规则和机构是改革无效并且常常不人道的制度所需要的，从而为解决难民问题做出贡献。
en: Economists can help by testing which international rules and institutions are needed to reform an inefficient and often inhumane system.

zh: 经济与美国国家安全
en: Economics and American National Security

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 白宫在本月早些时候发布的《国家安全战略》跟以前国会委任每四年制定一次的战略有所不同。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The National Security Strategy released by the White House earlier this month differs from the previous congressionally mandated strategies that have been prepared every four years.

zh: 而这份2017年版报告的差异之处在于强调了经济的作用，正如其内文所指出的那样 ： “ 经济安全就是国家安全 ” 。
en: The 2017 NSS is different because it emphasizes the role of the economy: “Economic security is national security,” the new NSS avers.

zh: 报告的大部分内容都是与传统国家安全事务有关：军事预算，联盟以及如何与俄罗斯和中国这类被新报告称之为“战略竞争者 ” （ 而非敌手）的国家打交道，同时国内经济的增长，国际贸易的作用以及美国的新优势能源地位也受到了极大关注。
en: Much of the report is of course devoted to traditional aspects of national security: military budgets, alliances, and dealing with countries like Russia and China, which the new NSS calls “strategic competitors” (rather than adversaries). But the growth of the domestic economy, the role of international trade, and America’s new positive energy position also receive substantial attention.

zh: 特朗普政府将其监管改革和最近制定的税收立法作为增加经济增长战略是正确的做法。
en: President Donald Trump’s administration rightly points to its regulatory reforms and its recently enacted tax legislation as strategies for increasing economic growth.

zh: 因为只有一个更庞大的经济体才能提供资源去建设更为强大的军事实力。
en: A bigger economy provides the resources to build stronger military capabilities.

zh: 但只有国会在未来增加国防预算，把目标锁定在那些最需要扩张的领域之时，经济增长才会转化为更有效的国防力量。
en: But that economic growth can translate into more effective national defense only if Congress enacts future increases in the defense budget, targeting those areas that are in greatest need of expansion.

zh: 在2011年《预算控制法》的暂时财政封存条款下，国防预算一直在全面削减，并计划在2021年将国防支出降至相当于GDP3％的水平，也是二战以来的最低比率。
en: Because of the sequestration provision of the Budget Control Act of 2011, the defense budget has been subject to across-the-board cuts that will reduce defense outlays to 3% of GDP in 2021, the lowest share of GDP since before World War II.

zh: 国会预算办公室预测以上比率会在2027年继续下降到2.7 ％ 。
en: The Congressional Budget Office projects that defense outlays, relative to GDP, will continue to decline to just 2.7% in 2027.

zh: 而如果想在2027年将此比率提高到5％的话，该年的政府总支出将增加6000多亿美元。
en: Bringing that up to 5% of GDP in 2027 would add more than $600 billion to total government spending that year.

zh: 《国家安全战略》中关于对外贸易的建议案则把一些有价值的动议与对美国贸易逆差原因的错误分析结合起来。
en: The NSS’s proposals for dealing with foreign trade combine some valuable initiatives with a false analysis of the causes of the United States’ trade deficit.

zh: 报告称“合作伙伴和国际机构可以发挥更大作用以解决贸易不平衡问题 ” ， 但这个说法是错误的。
en: “[T]rading partners and international institutions can do more to address trade imbalances,” the NSS asserts. That is wrong.

zh: 基础经济学告诉我们美国的贸易逆差其实反映了其国内储蓄和投资的总量。
en: Basic economics tells us that the US trade deficit reflects the aggregate levels of domestic saving and investment.

zh: 具体来说美国贸易逆差的规模（进口量减去出口量）等于美国投资超出美国国民储蓄的规模。
en: More specifically, the size of the US trade deficit – imports minus exports – equals excess of US investment over US national saving.

zh: 由于美国人的消费多于生产，因此进口必然多于出口。
en: Because Americans spend more than they produce, they must import more than they export.

zh: 如果要减少贸易赤字，家庭，企业和政府都必须增加储蓄 — — 这显然是首选解决方案 — — 或是减少投资。
en: So, to reduce the trade deficit, households, businesses, and governments must increase their saving – obviously the preferred solution – or invest less.

zh: 但在指出外国政府通过推动和纵容盗窃美国知识产权行为来伤害美国利益方面，报告是正确的。
en: But the NSS is certainly correct in noting that foreign governments hurt American interests by promoting and condoning the theft of US intellectual property.

zh: 奥巴马总统就曾在2013年加州桑尼兰德举行的首脑会议上向中国国家主席习近平出示过中国军方成员盗窃工业技术的证据。
en: At a summit meeting in 2013 at the Sunnylands retreat in California, President Barack Obama showed China’s President Xi Jinping the evidence that members of the Chinese military had been stealing industrial technology.

zh: 中方接受了这一证据，也同意盗窃工业技术与其他形式的间谍活动是不一样的并表示中国政府未来不会协助这类盗窃活动。
en: The Chinese accepted the evidence, agreed that stealing industrial technology was different from other forms of espionage, and said that the Chinese government would not assist in such theft in the future.

zh: 但这还不足以阻止其他中国人盗用美国的民用和军事技术，因此新《国家安全战略》也有正当理由去强调美国政府会采取进一步的措施加以制止。
en: Since that is not enough to stop other Chinese theft of US civilian and military technology, the new NSS rightly stresses that the US government will take further steps to stop it.

zh: 在谈到具体的贸易政策时 ， 《 国家安全战略》重点提出美国将设法“打破贸易壁垒并为美国人提供机会以增加出口 ” 。
en: When it turns to specific trade policies, the NSS emphasizes that the US will seek to “break down trade barriers and provide Americans with opportunities to increase their exports.”

zh: 这种强调增加出口而非减少进口的做法是值得欢迎的。
en: This emphasis on increasing exports, rather than reducing imports, is a welcome feature.

zh: 外国政府建立的贸易壁垒确实降低了美国企业从美国制出口产品中取得实际收益的能力。
en: Trade barriers erected by foreign governments reduce the ability of US firms to obtain the real income benefits from exporting products made in America.

zh: 报告还批评了中国及其他国家所采取的其他各类不公平政策，却并未对那些伤害美国利益的政策和那些虽然“不公平”但实际在帮助美国人的政策加以区分。
en: But the report also criticizes a variety of other unfair policies pursued by China and other countries, without distinguishing between those that hurt American interests and those that, though “unfair,” actually help Americans.

zh: 以下是报告拉出的清单 ： “ 其他国家利用倾销，歧视性非关税壁垒，强制技术转让，非经济势力，工业补贴以及其他来自政府和国有企业的支持来获取经济优势。 ”
