en: Here’s the list: “Other countries have used dumping, discriminatory non-tariff barriers, forced technology transfers, noneconomic capacity, industrial subsidies, and other support from governments and state-owned enterprises to gain economic advantages.”

zh: 针对美国出口产品的非关税壁垒显然伤害了美国企业，也对美国家庭无所裨益。
en: Non-tariff barriers to US exports clearly hurt US firms without doing anything to help US households.

zh: 强制性技术转让也是如此，但中国的立场其实是希望在中国经营的美国企业自愿同意转让技术以换取在中国生产和销售的权利。
en: The same is true of forced technology transfers, although the Chinese position is that American firms that want to operate in China voluntarily agree to transfer technology in exchange for the right to produce and sell in China.

zh: 倾销 — — 以低于生产成本的价格销售产品 — — 虽然伤害了美国企业，但对美国消费者有利。
en: Dumping – selling products at prices that are lower than the cost of production – clearly helps American consumers, even though it hurts American firms.

zh: 这其实与技术发展没什么不同，因为这使得一些美国公司能够以更低廉的成本进行生产，从而在有利于美国消费者的同时打击其他美国生产者。
en: But that is not different from a technological development that allows some US firms to produce more cheaply, thus helping American consumers and hurting other US producers.

zh: 虽然一些经济学教科书声称外国倾销行为会迫使国内生产者倒闭以便随后提价，但实际上并无证据表明这种行为确实有发生。
en: Although some economic textbooks claim that dumping by foreigners can force domestic producers to go out of business so that the foreign producer can then raise its price, there is no evidence of such behavior actually occurring in practice.

zh: 中国一些国有企业仍然处于产能过剩阶段，导致出口销售价格低于成本。
en: The Chinese are still maintaining excess capacity in some state-owned industries, leading to export sales at money-losing prices.

zh: 但就像倾销或者明目张胆的工业补贴一样，这是一种“不公平”但实际上却有利于美国消费者的政策。
en: Like dumping, that, together with explicit industrial subsidies, is an “unfair” policy that nonetheless actually helps American consumers.

zh: 展望未来，美国政府应该集中精力打击外国政府的某些贸易政策，比如技术盗窃，对美国出口的非关税壁垒以及强制技术转让等，这些政策伤害了美国企业，也没有转而为美国消费者带来任何利益。
en: Looking ahead, the US government should focus on combating foreign governments’ trade policies – such as technology theft, non-tariff barriers to US exports, and forced technology transfers – that hurt American firms without any offsetting benefits to American consumers.

zh: 作为一名经济学家，我很高兴新《国家安全战略》对美国国家安全的经济方面给予了很大的关注，也希望这种重视能够带来更好的国内和贸易政策。
en: As an economist, I am pleased that the NSS has given substantial attention to the economic aspects of US national security. I hope that this emphasis leads to better domestic and trade policies.

zh: 否定中的经济学
en: Economics in Denial

zh: 发自巴黎 — — 在离任欧洲中央银行总裁一职前，让-克劳德·特里谢（Jean-Claude Trichet）恼羞成怒地抱怨道 ： “ 作为一个危机时期的政策制定者，我发现现有的[经济和金融]模型作用很有限。
en: PARIS – In an exasperated outburst, just before he left the presidency of the European Central Bank, Jean-Claude Trichet complained that, “as a policymaker during the crisis, I found the available [economic and financial] models of limited help.

zh: 事实上我可以更进一步说：在危机面前，我们感觉被传统工具所抛弃了。 ”
en: In fact, I would go further: in the face of the crisis, we felt abandoned by conventional tools.”

zh: 特里谢不断寻求来自其他学科的灵感 — — 物理学，工程学，心理学，生物学 — — 来帮助解释他所经历的现象。
en: Trichet went on to appeal for inspiration from other disciplines – physics, engineering, psychology, and biology – to help explain the phenomena he had experienced.

zh: 这是一个不同寻常的呼救声，是对整个经济学界，尤其是从哈佛大学到海德拉巴印度商学院那帮拿着奢侈报酬的金融学教授们的严厉控诉。
en: It was a remarkable cry for help, and a serious indictment of the economics profession, not to mention all those extravagantly rewarded finance professors in business schools from Harvard to Hyderabad.

zh: 虽然到目前为止已经得到一些回应，但特里谢从他所信任的工程师和物理学家那里获得的帮助还相对较少。
en: So far, relatively little help has been forthcoming from the engineers and physicists in whom Trichet placed his faith, though there has been some response.

zh: 著名的气候变化专家罗伯特·梅（Robert May）认为他的学科技术可以帮助解释金融市场的发展。
en: Robert May, an eminent climate change expert, has argued that techniques from his discipline may help explain financial-market developments.

zh: 而流行病学家则认为对传染性疾病如何传播的研究可以用来阐述过去五年金融危机蔓延的模式。
en: Epidemiologists have suggested that the study of how infectious diseases are propagated may illuminate the unusual patterns of financial contagion that we have seen in the last five years.

zh: 这些建议都为未来的研究提供了肥沃的土壤，但什么才是经济学和金融学自身的核心准则？
en: These are fertile fields for future study, but what of the core disciplines of economics and finance themselves?

zh: 是否我们根本无法做点什么去让它们更有效地解释这个世界，只能假设它只是一个程式化的模型？
en: Can nothing be done to make them more useful in explaining the world as it is, rather than as it is assumed to be in their stylized models?

zh: 乔治·索罗斯（George Soros）为新经济思维研究所（Institute for New Economic Thinking )提供了慷慨的资助。
en: George Soros has put generous funding behind the Institute for New Economic Thinking (INET).

zh: 英格兰银行也试图鼓励新的想法。
en: The Bank of England has also tried to stimulate fresh ideas.

zh: 今年早些时候组织的一场会议也以“经济学的作用是什么？ ”这个启发性的标题来编辑会议纪要。
en: The proceedings of a conference that it organized earlier this year have now been edited under the provocative title What’s the Use of Economics?

zh: 会上提出了一些明确而切实的建议。
en: Some of the recommendations that emerged from that conference are straightforward and concrete.

zh: 例如应该增加更多的经济史教学。
en: For example, there should be more teaching of economic history.

zh: 我们完全应该庆幸美联储主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）是一位研究当年大萧条以及政府错误政策回应的专家，而不是拘泥于动态随机均衡理论某些细节方面的学者。
en: We all have good reason to be grateful that US Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke is an expert on the Great Depression and the authorities’ flawed policy responses then, rather than in the finer points of dynamic stochastic general equilibrium theory.

zh: 因此当危机爆发时他已经准备好采取非常规措施，并在影响同僚方面发挥了自身的说服力。
en: As a result, he was ready to adopt unconventional measures when the crisis erupted, and was persuasive in influencing his colleagues.

zh: 许多与会者都同意应该将经济学研究构建在更宏大的政治背景上，更着重于体制所扮演的角色，也应该教学生懂得谦卑。
en: Many conference participants agreed that the study of economics should be set in a broader political context, with greater emphasis on the role of institutions. Students should also be taught some humility.

zh: 他们所接触的模型存在一些说明性的价值，但只是在限定的参数内。
en: The models to which they are still exposed have some explanatory value, but within constrained parameters.

zh: 痛苦的经验也告诉我们，经济参与者可能不会按照模型所假设的方式去行动。
en: And painful experience tells us that economic agents may not behave as the models suppose they will.

zh: 但是这并不意味着大多数同行能接受这些已经非常��和的建议。
en: But it is not clear that a majority of the profession yet accepts even these modest proposals.

zh: 所谓的“芝加哥学派”对其以理性期望为基础的研究方法展开了坚定的辩护，认为反思不是必要的。
en: The so-called “Chicago School” has mounted a robust defense of its rational expectations-based approach, rejecting the notion that a rethink is required.

zh: 诺贝尔奖得主，经济学家罗伯特卢卡斯（Robert Lucas）则认为经济危机是不可预测的，因为经济学理论认为这样的事件是不可预测的。
en: The Nobel laureate economist Robert Lucas has argued that the crisis was not predicted because economic theory predicts that such events cannot be predicted.

zh: 所以一切都是合理的。
en: So all is well.

zh: 还有令人不安的证据表明，危机的消息还没有到达某些经济部门。
en: And there is disturbing evidence that news of the crisis has not yet reached some economics departments.

zh: 汇丰银行集团首席经济学家史提芬·金（Stephen King）指出，当他询问应届大学毕业生（许多刚刚加入汇丰银行）他们花多少时间在关于金融危机的讲座和研讨会上时 ， “ 大多数承认这个问题甚至没有被提起过。
en: Stephen King, Group Chief Economist of HSBC, notes that when he asks recent university graduates (and HSBC recruits a large number of them) how much time they spent in lectures and seminars on the financial crisis, “most admitted that the subject had not even been raised.”

zh: ”事实上正如史提芬·金所说 ， “ 年轻的经济学家进入金融领域时对金融系统如何运作知之甚少。 ”
en: Indeed, according to King, “Young economists arrive in the financial world with little or no knowledge of how the financial system operates.”

zh: 我相信他们在汇丰银行会很快上手。
en: I am sure they learn fast at HSBC.

zh: （有人假设说，他们将来也会很快了解与洗钱有关的监管条例。
en: (In the future, one assumes, they will learn quickly about money laundering regulations as well.)

zh: ）但是令人沮丧的是许多大学的经济学部仍在否认这个问题。
en: But it is depressing to hear that many university departments are still in denial.

zh: 这并非因为学生缺乏兴趣：我在巴黎政治学院教授一个关于危机对金融市场所产生后果的课程，而对这类课程的需求非常巨大。
en: That is not because students lack interest: I teach a course at Sciences Po in Paris on the consequences of the crisis for financial markets, and the demand is overwhelming.

zh: 但无论如何，我们不应该仅仅把注意力集中在经济学家身上。
en: We should not focus attention exclusively on economists, however.

zh: 理论上说常规知识工具箱中最缺乏的组件是资本资产定价模型和其近亲：有效市场假说。
en: Arguably the elements of the conventional intellectual toolkit found most wanting are the capital asset pricing model and its close cousin, the efficient-market hypothesis.

zh: 但这这些理论的倡议者们却没看到有什么问题需要解决。
en: Yet their protagonists see no problems to address.

zh: 与此相反，芝加哥大学尤金·法玛（Eugene Fama）阐述了一个理念，认为金融理论其实跟一个 “空想”那样谬误，并认为“金融市场和金融机构不是经济衰退的始作俑者，而是受害者。
en: On the contrary, the University of Chicago’s Eugene Fama has described the notion that finance theory was at fault as “a fantasy,” and argues that “financial markets and financial institutions were casualties rather than causes of the recession.”

zh: ”他认为自己捍卫的有效市场假说不应受到指责，因为“大部分投资都是由那些不相信市场有效性的激进型资金管理者所做出的。 ”
en: And the efficient-market hypothesis that he championed cannot be blamed, because “most investing is done by active managers who don’t believe that markets are efficient.”

zh: 这就是我们可能称之为“非相关性”的辩护：原来金融理论家们可以不负责任，是因为没有人在现实世界里关注他们！
en: This amounts to what we might call an “irrelevance” defense: Finance theorists cannot be held responsible, since no one in the real world pays attention to them!

zh: 所幸的是该领域的其他专家确实希望追寻其中的关联，也经历了五年的历练。 在这五年里，经济模型所预测的那些一百万年才发生一次的价格运动在一周内就能出现几次。
en: Fortunately, others in the profession do aspire to relevance, and they have been chastened by the events of the last five years, when price movements that the models predicted should occur once in a million years were observed several times a week.

zh: 他们正在努力追根溯源，并创造新的方法来测量和监控风险，这也是目前许多银行所关注的主要问题。
en: They are working hard to understand why, and to develop new approaches to measuring and monitoring risk, which is the main current concern of many banks.

zh: 这些努力无疑与我们更多听说到的那些具体详细的监管政策变化同样重要。
en: These efforts are arguably as important as the specific and detailed regulatory changes about which we hear much more.

zh: 我们过去对控制的理解依据的假设是，金融市场可以在最大程度上自行运作，而金融机构及其董事会就是控制风险和保护自己企业的最佳人选。
en: Our approach to regulation in the past was based on the assumption that financial markets could to a large extent be left to themselves, and that financial institutions and their boards were best placed to control risk and defend their firms.

zh: 这些假设在经济危机中遭受了致命打击，导致突然转向更具干预性的监管。
en: These assumptions took a hard hit in the crisis, causing an abrupt shift to far more intrusive regulation.

zh: 能否在金融机构和私营企业之间寻找一个崭新和稳定的关系，关键取决于我们的知识模型改造。
en: Finding a new and stable relationship between the financial authorities and private firms will depend crucially on a reworking of our intellectual models.

zh: 因此英格兰银行完全应该发出战斗的号令，而经济学家们也应该群起响应。
en: So the Bank of England is right to issue a call to arms. Economists would be right to heed it.

zh: 全球经济的犹豫蓝调
en: The Global Economy’s Hesitation Blues

zh: 纽黑文—经济减速常常伴随着犹豫时代（periods of hesitation ） 。
en: NEW HAVEN – Economic slowdowns can often be characterized as periods of hesitation.

zh: 消费者犹豫购买新房或新车，想着老房子和老车还能好好地用一段时间。
en: Consumers hesitate to buy a new house or car, thinking that the old house or car will do just fine for a while longer.

zh: 管理者犹豫扩大招聘、购买新办公楼或建造新工厂，等待能让他们不再担忧落实新概念的消息。
en: Managers hesitate to expand their workforce, buy a new office building, or build a new factory, waiting for news that will make them stop worrying about committing to new ideas.

zh: 从这个角度看，我们应该对今天的 犹豫的影响保持多大的担忧？
en: Viewed from this perspective, how worried should we be about the effects of hesitation today?

zh: 犹豫常常很像拖延。
en: Hesitation is often like procrastination.

zh: 你也许有一种说不清的怀疑，觉得需要再好好想想；与此同时，其他问题困扰着你的思考，让你做不出决定。
en: One may have vague doubts and feel a need to mull things over; meanwhile, other issues intrude on thought and no decision is taken.

zh: 如果你问人们为何拖延，很有可能得不到干脆的回答。
en: Ask people why they procrastinate, and you probably won’t get a crisp answer.

zh: 那么，这样的行为是如何普遍到足以让经济衰退的？
en: So how does such behavior become sufficiently widespread to bring about an economic slump?

zh: 事实上，暂停刺激经济活动的原因可能很难识别。
en: In fact, the reasons for postponing activities that would stimulate the economy may be difficult to discern.

zh: 首先想到的是来自其他人正在犹豫的反馈。
en: One thinks first of feedback from others who are hesitating.

zh: 收入效应和群体心理可能放大个体犹豫。
en: Income effects and crowd psychology may amplify individual vacillation.

zh: 但必须有某种初始因素启动反馈环 — — 某种犹豫的基本原因。
en: But there must have been some initial factor that started the feedback cycle – some underlying source of hesitation.

zh: 失去经济“信心”或是其中之一。
en: Loss of economic “confidence” is one possible cause.

zh: 20世纪50年代开始公开发布的信心指数以调查为基础，消费者和商界人士被询问关于商业活动和未来收入和就业预期的感觉。
en: Published confidence indices, available since the 1950s, are based on polls that ask consumers or businesspeople about their perceptions of business activity and expectations of future income and employment.

zh: 关于经济政策的“不确定性”是另一个可能的由于原因。
en: “Uncertainty” about economic policy is another possible source of hesitation.

zh: 如果商界人士不知道将面临何种规则、税收或更糟糕的国有化，他们就有可能出现犹豫。
en: If businesspeople don’t know what regulations, taxes, or worse, nationalizations, will be coming, they may dither.

zh: 这是一个很古老的概念，在20世纪30年代大萧条期间提出；但这一概念没有得到很好的度量，至少直到最近是如此。
en: The idea is an old one, expressed during the Great Depression of the 1930s; but it was not measured well, at least until recently.

zh: 在2015年的工作论文中，经济学家斯科特·贝克尔（Scott R. Baker ） 、 尼古拉斯·布鲁姆（Nicholas Bloom）和史蒂文·戴维斯（Steven J. Davis）利用数字新闻档案为几十个国家构建了经济政策不确定性（EPU）指数。
en: In a 2015 working paper, the economists Scott R. Baker, Nicholas Bloom, and Steven J. Davis constructed Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) indices for a dozen countries using digital news archives.

zh: 该指数覆盖加拿大、中国、法国、德国、印度、意大利、日本、俄罗斯、韩国、西班牙、英国和美国，构造方法为计算每个国家每个月包含“经济 ” （ E ） 、 “政策 ” （ P）和“不确定性 ” （ U）三词的报纸文章数量。
en: The indices (covering Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Russia, South Korea, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States) were created by counting the number of newspaper articles in each country and each month that had the trifecta of terms “economy” (E), policy” (P) and “uncertainty” (U).

zh: 该指数的月度读数为包含这三个词的文章总数，除以目标报纸每月文章总数。
en: The index each month was the total number of articles with those three words, divided by the total number of articles in the targeted newspapers each month.

zh: 请各国母语使用者对这三个词进行合适的翻译。
en: Native speakers in each country were consulted on the appropriate translations of the three words.

zh: 该指数覆盖数十年，美国和英国更是追溯到1900年。
en: The indices spanned decades, and in two countries, the US and the UK, went all the way back to 1900.

zh: 美国的指数与期权市场隐含股价波动率（VIX）相关。
en: The US index correlates with implied equity-price volatility in the options markets (VIX).

zh: 三名经济学家发现，他们的EPU指数先行于12个国家的经济收缩，在具备长期指数的两个国家中，EPU值在大萧条期间相当高。
en: They found that their EPU index foreshadows economic contractions in the 12 countries, and that for the two countries with long-term indices, the EPU values were high during the Great Depression.

zh: 但到底是收缩引起了不确定性，还是不确定性引起了收缩？
en: But do contractions cause uncertainty, they ask, or does uncertainty cause contractions?

zh: 考虑到我们知道人们彼此存在高度互动，其中的因果关系很有可能是双向的，形成了一个反馈环。
en: Given that we know that people are highly reactive to each other, the causality most likely runs both ways, in a feedback loop.

zh: 更深刻也更有趣的问题是什么启动了这一不确定性。
en: The deeper and more interesting question concerns what initiates this uncertainty.

zh: 要回答这个问题，需要可能影响公众对经济的思考 — — 或避免思考 — — 的现有叙事和观念的大致特征（impressionistic characterizations ） 。
en: To answer it requires impressionistic characterizations of the extant stories and ideas that might influence public thinking – or avoidance of thinking – about the economy.

zh: 对于大萧条，你也许会好奇高EPU值是否与20世纪20年代的过剩之后的社会趋势有关，它助长了对共产主义以及（在美国）对新政的担忧。
en: As for the Great Depression, one wonders if the high degree of EPU was linked to social trends after the excesses of the 1920s, fueling fear of Communism and, in the United States, of the New Deal.

zh: 你也许会好奇1933年希特勒掌权后对法西斯政权以及即将到来的战争的担忧是否延长了萧条。
en: One wonders if fear of fascist regimes, and of a coming war, prolonged the depression after Hitler came to power in 1933.

zh: 对预言了同名事件的约翰内斯·斯蒂尔（Johannes Steele）1934年的著作《第二次世界大战 》 （ The Second World War）的关注表明，对大战的担忧一定获得了大量的讨论，足以导致某些犹豫。
en: The attention devoted to Johannes Steele’s 1934 book The Second World War, which predicted that eponymous event, indicates that fear of war must have been talked about enough to underpin some hesitation.

zh: 对于活过第一次世界大战的人来说，再来一次大战的想法简直是一场噩梦。
en: To people who lived through World War I, the thought of a sequel must have seemed nightmarish.

zh: 当然，大萧条是否真的因为这些叙事或观念而延长是无法证明的。
en: Of course, whether the Great Depression was really prolonged by these stories or ideas cannot be proved.

zh: 我们如何知道哪些叙事影响了人们的思考？
en: How do we know which stories were affecting people’s thinking?

zh: 另一方面，我们相当确定这些叙事中的一些确实影响了人们对经济不确定性的感觉。
en: On the other hand, we can be fairly certain that some of these stories really do affect perceived economic uncertainty.

zh: 经济学家证明，人会表现出一种“情绪启发式 ” （ affect heuristic ） ， 即用情感给记忆贴标签并让这些情绪影响决策的倾向，即使决策与引起情绪的原因没有关系。
en: Psychologists have shown that people display an “affect heuristic,” or a tendency to tag memories with emotions and to let those emotions affect decision-making, even when the decision is unrelated to what caused the emotions.

zh: 情绪错配可能导致执行功能障碍（executive dysfunction ） 、 无法行动，即犹豫。
en: A mismatch of emotions can cause executive dysfunction, a failure to act, hesitation.

zh: 一些类型的叙事在流传在当下 — — 与日益兴盛的民族主义或担心移民对传统文化价值观带来的挑战有关 — — 它们可能造成更大的犹豫。
en: Some kinds of stories circulating today – related to growing nationalism or fear of challenges by immigrants to traditional cultural values – might underpin greater hesitation.

zh: 英国上个月的“脱欧”投票被全世界视为政治动荡的一个及其显著的警示信号。
en: The Brexit vote in the United Kingdom last month has been viewed worldwide with extraordinary alarm as a signal of political instability.

zh: 恐怖主义的日益频发又给这一趋势平添了生动的情绪面。
en: The rising incidence of terrorism has added a vivid emotional edge to such developments.

zh: 这些担忧会产生足够的经济犹豫导致世界再次陷入衰退吗？
en: Will these fears fuel enough economic hesitation to bring on another worldwide recession?

zh: 此次的任何答案都将是大致而不精确的。
en: Any answer at this time would be impressionistic and imprecise.

zh: 但是，由于后果极其重要，我们不能畏惧思考这些担忧怎样影响着经济决策。
en: Given the importance of the consequences, however, we should not shrink from considering how such fears are affecting economic decision-making.

zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖与社会民主
en: Nobel Economics Versus Social Democracy

zh: 牛津—在现代社会管理精英中，只有经济学家有诺贝尔奖可得，刚刚宣布的最新获奖者是奥利佛·哈特（Oliver Hart）和班特·霍尔斯特罗姆（Bengt Holmström ） 。
en: OXFORD – Of the elites who manage modern society, only economists have a Nobel Prize, whose latest recipients, Oliver Hart and Bengt Holmström, have just been announced.

zh: 不管经济学家获得如此独特地位的原因何在，诺贝尔奖光环可以也确实常常让有害于公共利益 — — 比如推动不平等和增加造成金融危机的可能性 — — 的政策获得信誉。
en: Whatever the reason for economists’ unique status, the halo conferred by the prize can – and often has – lend credibility to policies that harm the public interest, for example by driving inequality and making financial crises more likely.

zh: 但经济学并非一家独大。
en: But economics does not have the field entirely to itself.

zh: 一种不同的世界观将大约30%的GDP — — 用于就业、医疗、教育和退休金 — — 配置给了最发达国家。
en: A different view of the world guides the allocation of about 30% of GDP – for employment, health care, education, and pensions – in most developed countries.

zh: 这一关于应该如何管理社会的观点 — — 社会民主不但是一种政治方向，它也是一种治国之道。
en: This view about how society should be managed – social democracy – is not only a political orientation; it is also a method of government.

zh: 标准经济学假设社会由自利个体组成，他们在市场中交易，他们的选择通过“看不见的手”放大成一种效率状态（efficient state ） 。
en: Standard economics assumes that society is driven by self-seeking individuals trading in markets, whose choices scale up to an efficient state via the “invisible hand.”

zh: 但这一信条在理论和实践中都不太稳固：其前提条件并不现实，其所支持的模式自相矛盾，其产生的预测常常出错。
en: But this doctrine is not well founded in either theory or practice: its premises are unrealistic, the models it supports are inconsistent, and the predictions it produces are often wrong.

zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖由瑞典央行在1968年赞助成立。
en: The Nobel Prize in economics was endowed by Sweden’s central bank, the Riksbank, in 1968.

zh: 这一时间不是巧合。
en: The timing was not an accident.

zh: 这项新奖项产生于一个由来已久的冲突：一方是富裕阶层（better off）的利益，即物价稳定；另一方是其他所有人的利益，即通过税收、社会投资和转移支付等手段降低不安全感。
en: The new prize arose from a longstanding conflict between the interests of the better off in stable prices and the interests of everybody else in reducing insecurity by means of taxation, social investment, and transfers.

zh: 瑞典皇家学院（Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences）颁发该奖项，但瑞典同时也是发达的社会民主国家。
en: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the prize, but Sweden was also an advanced social democracy.

zh: 20世纪五六十年代，瑞典央行与瑞典政府就如何管理信用的问题出现了冲突。
en: During the 1950s and 1960s, the Riksbank clashed with Sweden’s government over the management of credit.

zh: 政府的重点是就业和住房；而坚定的佩尔·奥斯布林克（Per Åsbrink）领导的瑞典央行担心通货膨胀。
en: Governments gave priority to employment and housing; the Riksbank, led by an assertive governor, Per Åsbrink, worried about inflation.

zh: 作为权限受限所获得的补偿，最后瑞典央行在其成立三百周年之际获得了赞助一项诺贝尔奖的殊荣。
en: As recompense for restrictions on its authority, the Riksbank was eventually allowed to endow a Nobel Prize in economics as a vanity project for its tercentenary.

zh: 在皇家学院内部，一群中右翼经济学家把持着遴选获奖者的流程。
en: Within the Academy of Sciences, a group of center-right economists captured the process of selecting prizewinners.

zh: 获奖者均为顶尖经济学者。
en: The laureates comprised a high-quality sample of economics scholarship.

zh: 一项对他们的影响、倾向和偏见的分析表明，诺贝尔奖委员会通过左与右、形式和经验、芝加哥学派和凯恩斯主义之间的僵化平衡保持公平的表象。
en: An analysis of their influence, inclinations, and biases indicates that the Nobel committee kept up an appearance of fairness through a rigid balance between right and left, formalists and empiricists, Chicago School and Keynesian.

zh: 但我们的研究表明，职业经济学家总体而言广泛地左倾。
en: But our research indicates that professional economists, on the whole, are more broadly inclined toward the left.

zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖的最高决定者是斯托克霍姆大学经济学家阿萨尔·林德贝克（Assar Lindbeck ） ， 他以前是社会民主中人。
en: The prize kingmaker was Stockholm University economist Assar Lindbeck, who had turned away from social democracy.

zh: 20世纪七八十年代，林德贝克干预瑞典选举，援引微观经济学理论对抗社会民主，并警告说高税收和充分就业导致灾难。
en: During the 1970s and 1980s, Lindbeck intervened in Swedish elections, invoked microeconomic theory against social democracy, and warned that high taxation and full employment led to disaster.

zh: 他的干预将人们的注意力从当时所犯的巨大的政策错误上引开：信用去监管，它导致了20世纪90年代的深度金融危机，也是2008年爆发的全球危机的先声。
en: His interventions diverted attention from the grave policy error being made at the time: deregulation of credit, which led to a deep financial crisis in the 1990s and anticipated the global crisis that erupted in 2008.

zh: 林德贝克的关注点与国际货币基金组织（IMF ） 、 世界银行以及美国财政部类似。
en: Lindbeck’s concerns were similar to those of the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, and the US Treasury.

zh: 这些行动方坚持私有化、去监管化以及资本市场和贸易的自由化 — — 即所谓的华盛顿共识 — — 这套政策肥了商界和金融精英，导致了剧烈的危机，也破坏了新兴经济体增长。
en: These actors’ insistence on privatization, deregulation, and liberalization of capital markets and trade – the so-called Washington Consensus – enriched business and financial elites, led to acute crises, and undermined emerging economies’ growth.

zh: 在西方，根据作为华盛顿共识的基础的个人主义自利范式制定的重点为腐败、不平等以及对执政精英的不信任制造了温床 — — 这也是理性选择、自我第一假设的意料之外的后果。
en: In the West, the priority accorded to the individualist self-regarding norms underlying the Washington Consensus created a nurturing environment for growth in corruption, inequality, and mistrust in governing elites – the unintended consequences of rational-choice, me-first premises.

zh: 随着发达经济体爆发此前发展中国家专属的失序，瑞典政治学家波·罗斯坦因（Bo Rothstein）要求瑞典皇家学院（他也是院士之一）暂停诺贝尔��济学奖直至查清这些后果。
en: With the emergence in advanced economies of disorders previously associated with developing countries, Swedish political scientist Bo Rothstein has petitioned the Academy of Sciences (of which he is a member) to suspend the Nobel Prize in economics until such consequences are investigated.

zh: 社会民主的理论化不如经济学深刻。
en: Social democracy is not as deeply theorized as economics.

zh: 它由务实政策组合构成，在预防经济不安全方面取得了巨大的成功。
en: It constitutes a pragmatic set of policies that has been enormously successful in keeping economic insecurity at bay.

zh: 尽管几十年来饱受攻讦，社会民主仍然是提供市场无法高效、公平、充足地提供的公共品的不可或缺的关键。
en: Despite coming under relentless attack for decades, it remains indispensable for providing the public goods that markets cannot supply efficiently, equitably, or in sufficient quantity.

zh: 但缺乏正式的学界支持意味着即便名义上打着社会民主旗号的政党也无法完全理解社会民主运行得如何。
en: But the lack of formal intellectual support means that even nominally social-democratic parties do not entirely understand how well social democracy works.

zh: 市场奖励有钱人和成功者，与此不同，社会民主建立在公民平等（civic equality）的前提上。
en: Unlike markets, which reward the wealthy and successful, social democracy is premised on the principle of civic equality.

zh: 这造成了有利于“一刀切”权利的偏见；但对于这一约束条件早已有了应对之道。
en: This creates a bias for “one-size-fits-all” entitlements; but there have long been ways to manage this constraint.

zh: 由于经济学有着引人入胜的外表，而社会民主不可或缺，因此两种思想发生了演变以互相适应 — — 这并不是说他们的结合是和谐的。
en: Because economics appears to be compelling, and because social democracy is indispensable, the two doctrines have mutated to accommodate each other – which is not to say that their marriage is a happy one.

zh: 与许多不和谐的回音一样，离婚不是选项之一。
en: As with many unhappy marriages, divorce is not an option.

zh: 许多经济学家应对经济学核心假设的失灵的办法是撤退到实证调查领域。
en: Many economists have responded to the failure of their discipline’s core premises by retreating into empirical investigation.

zh: 但由此带来的合理性是有代价的，即丧失一般性：以地方实验为形式的随机化控制实验无法取代放之四海而皆准的社会公益观。
en: But the resulting validity comes at the cost of generality: randomized controlled trials in the form of local experiments cannot replace an overarching vision of the social good.

zh: 承认这一点的一个好的起点是据此遴选诺贝尔经济学奖得住。
en: A good way to begin acknowledging this would be to select Nobel Prize recipients accordingly.

zh: 气候危机的经济学
en: The Economics of the Climate Crisis

zh: 波哥大 — — 上周两项重大事件直接涉及有关气候变化的全球争论以及如何应对。
en: BOGOTÁ – Two major events last week bear directly on global debates about climate change and how to address it.

zh: 其一是联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）发布报告，该报告确切阐述了为实现2015年巴黎气候协议目标所应采取的措施。
en: The first was the release of a report from the United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), which sets out precisely what must be done to achieve the objectives of the 2015 Paris climate agreement.

zh: 其二是公开宣布耶鲁大学经济学家威廉·诺德豪斯将分享今年的诺贝尔经济学奖，理由是他的研究“将气候变化纳入到长期宏观经济分析。 ”
en: The second was the announcement that Yale University economist William Nordhaus will share this year’s Nobel Prize in economics for his work “integrating climate change into long-run macroeconomic analysis.”

zh: 其中第一件事理应为国际社会敲响警钟。
en: The first event should serve as a wake-up call for the international community.

zh: 联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会报告呼吁各国政府采取紧急措施，在未来十年内大幅降低温室气体排放。
en: The IPCC report appeals to governments to take urgent action to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions significantly within the next decade.

zh: 该报告警告，如果任由全球平均温度超过前工业化水平1.5℃ — — 或者在最差情况下，2℃，那么，极有可能带来灾难性的后果，而且这些后果最早在2040年就能被感受到。
en: It warns that if average global temperatures are allowed to exceed 1.5°C – or, at worst, 2°C – above pre-industrial levels, the consequences could be catastrophic, and they will be felt as soon as 2040.

zh: 更糟的是，报告显示，巴黎协议缔约国自愿设定的国家自主贡献标准严重不足。
en: Worse, the report shows that the Nationally Determined Contributions set voluntarily by signatories to the Paris accord are vastly insufficient.

zh: 即使各国都满足这些标准，截止2100年全球平均气温的升高仍将超过3℃，而且在其后仍将进一步上升。
en: Even if they are met, the increase in average global temperature will surpass 3°C by 2100, and will continue to rise still further after that.

zh: 显而易见，当决策者修改国家自主贡献目标时，他们必须将其大幅提高。
en: Clearly, when policymakers revise their countries’ NDCs, they must raise them significantly.

zh: 但实质性动作需要在2030年之前完成。
en: But substantive action needs to come well before 2030.

zh: 否则，世界环境将以海平面上升、生物多样性丧失和陆地及海洋生态系统恶化等形式遭受到不可逆转的破坏，包括可能造成全球珊瑚礁的灭绝。
en: Otherwise, the world will suffer irreversible damage in the form of rising sea levels, loss of biodiversity, and deterioration of both land and marine ecosystems, including the potential extinction of the world’s coral reefs.

zh: 上述发展对供水和全球民众健康及生活水平所产生的影响将是十分深远的。
en: These developments will have far-reaching implications for water supplies and the health and living standards of the global population.

zh: 而且，毋庸赘言，变暖幅度越大，所产生的后果就越严重。
en: And, needless to say, the greater the warming, the more severe these effects will be.

zh: 选择诺德豪斯授予诺贝尔奖的作法非常令人欢迎。
en: The selection of Nordhaus for the Nobel Prize is a more welcome development.

zh: 但值得注意的是，他应对气候变化的方法往往十分保守，也就是说，他崇尚渐进主义的原则。
en: Even so, it is worth noting that his approach to addressing climate change tends to be rather conservative, which is to say gradualist.

zh: 诺德豪斯依赖传统经济分析，通过资本回报或利率“折现”来确定未来消费的现值。
en: Nordhaus relies on traditional economic analysis, which “discounts” the present value of future consumption by the return on capital, or interest rates.

zh: 换句话讲，按照不同的假定利率，50年后的100美元今天只值15美元、10美元甚至更低。
en: In other words, $100 a half-century from now is worth $15, $10, or even less today, depending on the assumed interest rate.

zh: 但由于任何应对气候变化行动的成本都必须在当前承担，因此它们肯定拥有较高的现值。
en: But, because the costs of any initiative to combat climate change must be borne in the present, they are necessarily higher at present values.

zh: 上述结果意味着投入必须缓慢进行。
en: The implication is that they must be incurred slowly.

zh: 此方法的问题在于它对子孙后代有失公平，他们当然对我们今天所做的决定没有发言权。
en: The problem with this approach is that it is inequitable toward future generations, which, of course, have no say in decisions that we make today.

zh: 仅定义就决定他们的福利正在遭受损失。
en: By definition, their welfare is being discounted.

zh: 但如果我们要对代际公平问题进行严肃的思考，那么首先要考虑的因素就是子孙后代将拥有比我们今天更先进的技术。
en: Yet were we to take intergenerational equity seriously, the leading factor to consider is that future generations will have better technologies than what we have today.

zh: 因此，恰当的社会贴现率应等同于技术变化率，而这与市场利率相比要低得多。
en: Therefore, the appropriate social rate of discount should be equal to the rate of technological change, which is much lower than market interest rates.

zh: 除去对子孙后代外，人们还可以争辩传统经济分析对人类个体而言甚至更不公平。
en: One could also argue that the traditional economic analysis is even inequitable toward individuals, in addition to future generations.

zh: 这一点只需去问问那些领取不足额（或根本没有资格领取）养老金的老人，他现在的福利是否低于其过去消费的价值。
en: Just ask an older person with an inadequate (or nonexistent) pension whether his present welfare is worth less than his past consumption.

zh: 伦敦经济学院的尼古拉斯·斯特恩已经研究出一种更好的方法。
en: A much better approach has been developed by Nicholas Stern of the London School of Economics.

zh: 在其著名的“气候变化经济学评论”中，斯特恩早在2006年就呼吁加快应对气候变化的行动。
en: In his now-famous “Review on the Economics of Climate Change,” Stern was calling for accelerated action to combat climate change as early as 2006.

zh: 在斯特恩看来，全球变暖失控的代价将远超及早解决这个问题的成本。
en: In his view, the costs of dealing with runaway global warming would far exceed the expense of addressing it early.

zh: 哈佛大学的马丁·维茨曼已经研发出另外一种解决方案。
en: Another alternative has been developed by Martin Weitzman of Harvard University.

zh: 维茨曼依赖于类似诺德豪斯的分析工具，但他的研究也考虑了与气候变化有关的灾难性风险。
en: Weitzman relies on analytical tools similar to those used by Nordhaus, but his work also accounts for the catastrophic risks associated with climate change.

zh: 因此，他的方案与联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会和联合国环境规划署（UNEP）提出的方案类似，两者都认为全球变暖超过一定限度将会带来真正的灾难。
en: As such, his approach is also similar to that of the IPCC and the UN Environment Programme (UNEP), both of which have concluded that global warming above a certain level will have truly disastrous effects.

zh: 在我看来，诺贝尔委员会不仅应当承认诺德豪斯，还应当承认其他一些气候变化经济学家，尤其是斯特恩。
en: To my mind, the Nobel Committee should have recognized not just Nordhaus but also some of these other economists of climate change, particularly Stern.

zh: 事实是，人类无法在这个问题上逐步采取行动。
en: The fact is that humanity cannot afford to act gradually on this issue.

zh: 斯特恩报告 、联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会报告和联合国环境署均得出结论，目前的减排工作必须得到大幅增强。
en: The Stern Review, the latest IPCC report, and the UNEP have all concluded that current efforts to reduce emissions must be stepped up substantially.

zh: 这意味着加速全球朝向清洁能源技术（包括运输）的过渡，改善能源生产和消费效率、改善土地运用并推动技术创新来辅助这些进程。
en: That means accelerating the global transition to clean-energy technologies (including in transportation), improving the efficiency of energy production/consumption, reversing deforestation, improving land use, and promoting technological innovation to facilitate all of these processes.

zh: 联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会报告所传递的信息非常明确。
en: The message from the IPCC report is clear.

zh: 所有国家都必须提高减排目标并强化根据巴黎协议所作出的承诺。
en: All countries must raise their emissions-reduction targets and strengthen their commitments under the Paris agreement.

zh: 而历史上曾经为温室气体排放担负最大责任的国家美国必须返回巴黎协议并再次在这个问题上发挥领导作用。
en: And the country that is historically responsible for the largest share of greenhouse-gas emissions – the United States – must return to the agreement and show leadership on this issue once again.

zh: 经济学家的娼妓
en: The Economist’s Concubine

zh: 伦敦—近几十年来，经济学一直在入侵迄今为止被认为不能进行正式数学分析的人类活动研究。
en: LONDON – In recent decades, economics has been colonizing the study of human activities hitherto considered exempt from formal calculus.

zh: 批评者称之为“经济学帝国主义 ” ， 它产生了爱情经济学、艺术经济学、音乐经济学、语言经济学、文学经济学，还有其他各种各样的经济学。
en: What critics call “economics imperialism” has given rise to an economics of love, of art, of music, of language, of literature, and of much else.

zh: 经济学的如此扩张背后的统一的基本思想是不管人们做什么，是做爱还是做小东西，他们的目标都是以最小的代价获得最好的结果。
en: The unifying idea underlying this extension of economics is that whatever people do, whether it is making love or making widgets, they aim to achieve the best results at the least cost.

zh: 这些成本和收益可以简化为钱。
en: These benefits and costs can be reduced to money.

zh: 因此，人们总是追求交易的最佳财务回报。
en: So people are always looking for the best financial return on their transactions.

zh: 这与流行的行为区分相反。 流行的区分将行为分为算计成本是正确（也是理性）的行为和不（也不应该）算计成本的行为。
en: This is contrary to the popular separation of activities in which it is right (and rational) to count the cost, and those in which people do not (and should not) count the cost.

zh: 批评者认为，认为良心可以进行冰冷的算计没有抓住重点。
en: To say that affairs of the heart are subject to cold calculation is, say the critics, to miss the point.

zh: 但经济学家的回答是，冰冷的算计正是重点。
en: But cold-hearted calculation, reply the economists, is exactly the point.

zh: 将经济学方法应用于爱情的先锋是诺贝尔经济学奖加里·贝克尔（Gary Becker ） ， 他的大部分职业生涯都在芝加哥大学度过（还能在哪里呢？
en: The pioneer of the economic approach to love was the Nobel laureate Gary Becker, who spent most of his career at the University of Chicago (where else?).

zh: ） 。 在他1973年发表的讨论班论文《婚姻论 》 （ A Theory of Marriage）中，贝克尔指出，挑选伴侣本身是一类市场，婚姻仅当伴侣双方都获益时才发生。
en: In his seminal paper, “A Theory of Marriage,” published in 1973, Becker argued that selecting a partner is its own kind of market, and marriages occur only when both partners gain.

zh: 这是一个非常漂亮的理论，以男女互补的性质为基础，但只把爱情作为降低成本的机制对待。
en: It’s a very sophisticated theory, relying on the complementary nature of male and female work, but which tends to treat love as a cost-reducing mechanism.

zh: 接着，哥伦比亚大学的莱纳·埃德伦德（Lena Edlund）和马尔堡大学的伊芙琳·科恩（Evelyn Korn ） ， 以及雷丁大学的马琳娜·德拉·吉乌斯塔（Marina Della Giusta ） 、 都灵大学的玛利亚·劳拉·迪托马索（Maria Laura di Tommaso）和奥斯陆大学的斯坦纳·斯特罗姆（Steiner Strøm）等经济学家应用同样的方法研究卖淫。
en: More recently, economists such as Columbia University’s Lena Edlund and University of Marburg’s Evelyn Korn, as well as Marina Della Giusta of Reading University, Maria Laura di Tommaso of the University of Turin, and Steiner Strøm of the University of Oslo, have applied the same approach to prostitution.

zh: 在这里，经济学方法似乎效果更好，因为钱确实是唯一重要的因素。
en: Here, the economic approach might seem to work better, given that money is, admittedly, the only relevant currency.

zh: 埃德伦德和科恩将妻子和妓女处理为替代品。
en: Edlund and Korn treat wives and prostitutes as substitutes.

zh: 第三种方案，即定期性伴侣，被假设排除在外。
en: A third alternative, working in a regular job, is ruled out by assumption.

zh: 根据数据，妓女比从事普通工作的妇女收入高得多。
en: According to the data, prostitutes make a lot more money than women working in ordinary jobs.

zh: 那么问题来了：为何对于如此低级的技能会有如此高昂的溢价？
en: So the question is: why is there such a high premium for such low skills?

zh: 在需求端是登徒子，常常是旅行途中的登徒子，他们掂量与妓女共度春宵的收益和被抓包的成本。
en: On the demand side is the randy male, often in transit, who weighs the benefits of going with prostitutes against the costs of getting caught.

zh: 在供给端，妓女要求更高的收入以补偿更高的患病、遭遇暴力和难以获得理想婚姻的风险。
en: On the supply side the prostitute will require higher earnings to compensate for her higher risk of disease, violence, and blighted marriage prospects.

zh: “如果婚姻是女性的一个收入源 ， ” 埃德伦德和科恩写道 ， “ 那么妓女必须获得远离婚姻市场机会的补偿。
en: “If marriage is a source of income for women,” write Edlund and Korn “then the prostitute has to be compensated for foregone marriage market opportunities.”

zh: ”因此，妓女收入的高溢价体现了从事性工作的机会成本。
en: So the premium reflects the opportunity cost to the prostitute of performing sex work.

zh: 对于为何竞争没有拉低性工作者的奖励的问题，有一个现成的答案。
en: There is a ready answer to the question of why competition does not drive down sex workers’ rewards.

zh: 她们有一个“保留工资 ” ： 如果出价太低，她们就会换一个风险较低的工作。
en: They have a “reservation wage”: If they are offered less, they will choose a less risky line of work.

zh: 如果国家要干预这个由自愿买家和卖家组成的市场中的契约，依据何在？
en: What warrant does the state have to interfere with the contracts that are struck within this market of willing buyers and sellers?

zh: 为何不遂了许多性工作者的愿，让这个市场整体脱罪？
en: Why not decriminalize the market altogether, as many sex workers want?

zh: 和所有市场一样，性市场需要监管，特别是为了保护性工作者的健康和安全。
en: Like all markets, the sex market needs regulation, particularly to protect the health and safety of its workers.

zh: 此外，和所有市场一样，犯罪活动，包括暴力，也是非法的。
en: And, as in all markets, criminal activity, including violence, is already illegal.

zh: 但另一方面，一刀切禁止买春的呼声很高。
en: But on the other side, there is a strong movement to ban buying sex altogether.

zh: 所谓的买春法规定购买性服务为犯罪（但出卖性服务非罪 ） ， 瑞典、挪威、冰岛和北爱尔兰都已经实施了该法。
en: The so-called Sex Buyer Law, criminalizing the purchase, though not the sale, of sexual services has been implemented in Sweden, Norway, Iceland, and Northern Ireland.

zh: 人们预期强制减少需求能减少供给，而不必让供给者入罪。
en: The enforced reduction of demand is expected to reduce supply, without the need to criminalize the supplier.

zh: 一些证据表明，这确实起到了一些效果。
en: There is some evidence that it has had the intended effect.

zh: （尽管这一所谓的北欧制度的支持者忽视了买春入罪对性服务供给者或曾经的供给者的收入的影响。 ）
en: (Though supporters of the so-called Nordic System ignore the effect of criminalizing the purchase of sex on the earnings of those who supply it, or would have supplied it.)

zh: 禁止买春运动因为国际贩卖妇女（以及毒品）活动的日益猖獗而加强。
en: The movement to ban buying sex has been strengthened by the growth of international trafficking in women (as well as drugs).

zh: 这可以算作全球化的一个成本，特别是当许多妇女从对待女性的态度截然不同的国家涌入西方的时候。
en: This may be counted as a cost of globalization, especially when it involves an influx into the West from countries where attitudes toward women are very different.

zh: 但人们提出的解决办法太过极端。
en: But the proposed remedy is too extreme.

zh: 买春法假定妓女不可能是自愿的 — — 这是一种针对妇女和女孩的有机（organic）暴力形式。
en: The premise of the Sex Buyer Law is that prostitution is always involuntary for women – that it is an organic form of violence against women and girls.

zh: 但我认为没有理由这样认为。
en: But I see no reason to believe this.

zh: 关键在于“自愿”一词的定义。
en: The key question concerns the definition of the word “voluntary.”

zh: 诚然，一些妓女被奴役，使用她们的服务的男性应该被起诉。
en: True, some prostitutes are enslaved, and the men who use their services should be prosecuted.

zh: 但对于禁止使用奴工已经有了成文法。
en: But there are already laws on the books against the use of slave labor.

zh: 我猜大部分妓女是只是不情愿（reluctantly）地选择了她们的工作，迫于压力才这么做，但不是不自愿（involuntarily ） 。
en: I would guess that most prostitutes have chosen their work reluctantly, under pressure of need, not involuntarily.

zh: 如果使用她们的服务的男性被入罪，那么使用超市收银员、呼叫中心工人等服务的人也应该背入罪。
en: If men who use their services are criminalized, then so should people who use the services of supermarket checkout employees, call-center workers, and so on.

zh: 还有一些妓女（诚然，只是少数）声称享受自己的工作。
en: Then there are some prostitutes (a minority, to be sure) who claim to enjoy their work.

zh: 当然，也有男妓（不管是同性恋还是直男 ） ， 他们常常被妓女的女权主义批评者所忽略。
en: And, of course, there are male prostitutes, gay and straight, who are typically ignored by feminist critics of prostitution.

zh: 简言之，寻求禁止买春者的人性观和经济学家一样狭隘。
en: In short, the view of human nature of those who seek to ban the purchase of sex is as constricted as that of the economists.

zh: 圣奥古斯丁曾说 ： “ 远离娼妓，世界饱受淫欲折磨。 ”
en: As St. Augustine put it, “If you do away with harlots, the world will be convulsed with lust.”

zh: 最后，所有基于不平等和胁迫的概念而反对妓女的观点都是肤浅的。
en: Ultimately, all arguments against prostitution based on notions of inequality and coercion are superficial.

zh: 当然，反对妓女有强大的道德正确性。
en: There is, of course, a strong ethical argument against prostitution.

zh: 但除非我们准备好坦然接受它 — — 而我们的自由文明并没有做好准备 — — 否则我们能做的最佳办法就是监管性交易。
en: But unless we are prepared to engage with that – and our liberal civilization is not – the best we can do is to regulate the trade.

zh: 免费之下的长期性经济停滞
en: Secular Stagnation for Free

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 在资本主义世界肯定有些什么东西彻底出问题了。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Something is definitely rotten in the state of capitalism.

zh: 尽管采取了前所未有的低利率，大多数发达国家的投资水平依然远远低于2008年经济危机之前，而就业率则依旧一蹶不振。
en: Despite unprecedentedly low interest rates, investment in most advanced countries is significantly below where it was in the years prior to the 2008 crisis, while employment rates remain stubbornly low.

zh: 但即便是在危机之前，就算利率普遍低下，投资也不见起色。
en: And even investment in the pre-crisis period was unimpressive, given low prevailing interest rates.

zh: 不知什么原因，获取达致完全就业的投资水平似乎需要实际负利率（排除通胀）才能实现，以致出现某种说法，认为必须先发钱给人们然后能产生投资。
en: For some reason, achieving a level of investment that would generate full employment seems to require negative real (inflation-adjusted) interest rates, which is another way of saying that people have to be paid to invest.

zh: 但在一个低通胀和零名义利率的世界上，达到所需的负实际利率其实较为困难。
en: But in a world of low inflation and zero nominal interest rates, getting to the required negative real rate may be a challenge.

zh: 这也是拉里·萨莫斯（Larry Summers）引用埃尔文·汉森（Alvin Hansen）在1938年发表的一篇论文里提到的“长期性经济停滞”概念。 。
en: This is the ailment that Larry Summers, recalling a 1938 paper by Alvin Hansen, has dubbed “secular stagnation.”

zh: 这种事态的政策后果依然有待讨论 — — 所有相关问题在科恩·图林斯（Coen Teulings） 理查德·鲍德温（Richard Baldwin）编纂的一本电子图书上都有涵盖。
en: The policy consequences of this state of affairs remain open to debate (the issues are well summarized in an e-book edited by Coen Teulings and Richard Baldwin).

zh: 对凯恩斯主义者来说，解决方法就是实施非常规货币政策（比如量化宽松 ） ， 财政刺激，以及制定更高的通胀率目标。
en: For Keynesians, the answer is unconventional monetary policy (for example, quantitative easing), fiscal stimulus, and a higher target inflation rate.

zh: 但正如萨莫斯和其他人指出的那样，宽松货币政策或许会引发资产泡沫，而旷日持久的财政刺激则会导致一场债务危机。
en: But, as Summers and others point out, lax monetary policies may trigger asset bubbles, and prolonged fiscal stimulus may end in a debt crisis.

zh: 此外，凯恩斯主义者所偏爱的政策只能应对长期性经济停滞的后果，而非其成因 — — 而对后者的说法更是众说纷纭，莫衷一是。
en: Moreover, the Keynesians’ preferred policies address only the consequences of secular stagnation, not its causes – about which there is even less agreement.

zh: 某些人认为，问题出在于与人口增长放缓，预期寿命延长，以及一成不变的退休年龄界定相关的过度储蓄之上 — — 这迫使人们要为自己的老年准备更多的钱。
en: For some, the problem is a savings glut associated with slower demographic growth, rising life expectancy, and static retirement thresholds – a combination that forces people to save more for their old age.

zh: 但正如巴里·艾申格林（Barry Eichengreen）所指出的那样，当前储蓄额的增量太少，根本不足以解释这一点。
en: But, as Barry Eichengreen points out, the rise in savings appears to be too small to explain this.

zh: 在另一些人看来，问题的根本是更低的投资需求，在某种程度上是因为机器的价格更加便宜且科技进步自1970年以来逐步放缓。
en: For others, the problem is lower investment demand, caused partly by the fact that machines are now much cheaper and that technological progress has slowed since 1970.

zh: 罗伯特·戈登（Robert Gordon）和泰勒·柯文（Tyler Cowen）等经济学家因为过去的科技突破，包括管道自来水，空调和商业化航班，都都比当今许多科技进步拥有更大的社会影响力 — — 比如推动了汽车和大型购物广场等郊区生活方式的崛起。 。
en: Economists like Robert Gordon and Tyler Cowen argue that the technological breakthroughs of the past, including piped water, air conditioning, and commercial air travel, had a greater social impact – giving rise to the suburban lifestyle of cars and shopping malls, for example – than many of today’s advances.

zh: 这一论断让乔尔·莫基（Joel Mokyr） 或者埃里克· 比约诺夫森和安德烈·麦卡菲（Erik Bryjnolfsson & Andrew McAfee）这些乐观主义者感到不满，因为因为他们并不认为技术发展正在放缓，并认为就GDP这种衡量经济总量和发展的传统概念低估了发展的程度。
en: This assessment bothers optimists like Joel Mokyr or Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee, who do not believe that technological progress has slowed. Instead, they argue that the traditional concept used to measure economic output and growth, gross domestic product, understates that progress.

zh: 毕竟在谷歌、维基百科、Skype、推特、脸书、YouTube、位智（Waze ） 、 Yelp（点评网站 ） 、 Hipmunk（机票预订网站 ） 、 Pandora（定制电台）等其他许多公司的帮助下我们的生活效率和生产力比过去提高了许多。
en: After all, our lives have been made dramatically more productive thanks to Google, Wikipedia, Skype, Twitter, Facebook, YouTube, Waze, Yelp, Hipmunk, Pandora, and many other companies.

zh: 但这些公司都是免费提供服务的，也就意味着这些好处无法为计算在GDP里。
en: But all deliver their services for free, which means that the benefits they provide are not counted in GDP.

zh: 正如爱德华·格拉瑟（Edward Glaeser）所指出的那样，我们无法相信那些据说比1970年代境况更差的美国中等收入家庭会愿意放弃自己的手机，网络和崭新的健康科技以回到过去的时代。
en: As Edward Glaeser has argued, it is hard to believe that the median family in the United States, which supposedly is worse off than in 1970, would be willing to give up its cell phones, Internet access, and new health technologies in order to return to that halcyon era.

zh: 由此可见，GDP数字必须将这类进步包含在内。
en: Thus, the GDP numbers must be excluding much progress.

zh: 而如此多的创新都是免费提供的事实不仅仅为经济学家带来了测量方面的难题；同时也为那些尝试寻找投资机会的人造成了困扰。
en: The fact that so much innovation is given away for free does not only create a measurement problem for economists; it is also a real problem for those trying to find investment opportunities.

zh: 在二战后高速发展的那段好时光里，如果你想��一台空调，一辆汽车或一份报纸，你就必须付钱，而生产商就可以通过提供这些产品来获得利润。
en: In the good old days of the post-World War II boom, if you wanted an air conditioner, a car, or a newspaper, you had to buy one, making it possible for producers to earn money by providing them.

zh: 而那些信息密集型的产品 — — 当今这些科技发达经济体中非常常见 — — 则完全不同。
en: Information-intensive products – typical of today’s technologically advanced economies – are different.

zh: 因为多生产一份内容的成本基本为零，因此也很难对此收费。
en: Because the cost of providing an extra copy is almost nil, it is hard to charge for them.

zh: 其中电台广播和电视首当其冲，因为他们无法阻止那些拥有接收终端的人收到信号。
en: Broadcast radio and television were the first to confront this problem, because they could not prevent those with a receiver from getting the signal.

zh: 他们只能发展一个一广告为基础的模式，找其他人来为消费者所获得的好处买单。
en: They had to develop an advertising-based model, making it possible for others to pay for the benefits received by the consumer.

zh: 这大概也是谷歌能赚那么多钱的原因，虽然我一直难以相信作为身为一个勤奋而幸福的互联网用户自己所得到的巨大好处竟然是由本人相当稀少的互联网购买行为所支撑的。
en: This is supposedly what makes Google so profitable, though I have trouble believing that the enormous benefits I receive as an assiduous and happy user are paid for by my rather infrequent Internet purchases.

zh: 因此我们生活在这么一个世界上：新技术所承载的进步附着于一些免费的产品之上。
en: So we live in a world where much of the progress that new technology permits is embodied in products that must be given away for free.

zh: 一个潜在产品某种程度上任意的一部分，只要采取了正确的商业模式，就可以赚钱 — — 比如说出售从用户那里顺便收集的信息或是拿来做广告。 。
en: A somewhat haphazard sub-set of potential products can, with the right business model, be profitable – say, through advertising or by selling the information that they passively collect from users.

zh: 在许多其他产品，比如维基百科和公共电台，却难以实现收支平衡。
en: But many others, like Wikipedia and public radio, have trouble making ends meet.

zh: 因为免费的产品同时也压低了近似替代品的价值。
en: Free products also depress the value of close substitutes.

zh: 有些花掉100万制作费的舞台剧可能需要100块钱门票，但某些电影制片人可以通过出售10块钱门票给那些不愿等到电视播放才看的消费者来赚钱，虽然他们的电影成本是2个亿。
en: While it may require charging $100 per ticket to recover the costs of a $1 million theater play, some filmmakers can make money on a $200 million film by selling $10 tickets to consumers who are unwilling to wait a few weeks until their cable TV provider offers it.

zh: 上文中提到激发本文创作灵感的电子书也是免费的（正如这篇专栏文章 ） 。
en: The e-book mentioned above, which prompted this column, is available to you, the reader, for free (as is this column).

zh: 无怪乎那么多商家都难以做到收支平衡。
en: No wonder so many people have trouble making ends meet.

zh: 但发布这部电子书的智库机构经济政策研究中心（Center for Economic Policy Research ） ， 以及分发这一专栏文章的世界报业辛迪加机构（Project Syndicate）都是（至少在某种程度上）由捐款来维持运作的。
en: But the Center for Economic Policy Research, which published the e-book, and Project Syndicate, which distributes this column, are both (at least to some extent) donor-funded.

zh: 这可能不是一个巧合。
en: This may not be a coincidence.

zh: 为了驾驭新技术所带来的多种可能性，我们或许需要利用一些非市场形式的手段来支付那些有价值的贡献。
en: To harness the possibilities of new technology, we may need non-market forms of payment for valuable contributions.

zh: 传统的资本主义模式让比尔·盖茨成为了一个富人，但他创立的基金会正在资助那些非营利的重大技术突破。
en: The traditional capitalist model may have made Bill Gates rich, but his foundation now finances valuable technological breakthroughs in unprofitable ways.

zh: 在负实际利率的情况下，我们或许要付钱才能推动那些有价值的投资，但必须以一个更加精准而高效率的方式。
en: As with negative real interest rates, but in a more targeted and efficient manner, we may have to pay to make valuable investments happen.

zh: 2017年的三大惊奇
en: Three Surprises in 2017

zh: 伦敦—传统上，经济专家总是在1月伊始进行新年预测（传统上，这样的预测总是不正确的 ） 。
en: LONDON – Economic pundits traditionally offer their (traditionally inaccurate) New Year predictions at the beginning of January.

zh: 但今年的全球环境一点都不传统，因此，似乎应该等到美国总统特朗普入主白宫再来掂量在他任内可能震动世界经济和金融市场的主要冲击。
en: But global conditions this year are anything but traditional, so it seemed appropriate to wait until US President Donald Trump settled into the White House to weigh in on some of the main surprises that might shake up the world economy and financial markets on his watch.

zh: 从目前的市场波动和条件看，世界可能被三大潜在变革性发展趋势搞得猝不及防。
en: Judging by current market movements and conditions, the world could be caught off guard by three potentially transformative developments.

zh: 首先，特朗普的经济政策有可能大幅提高美国的利率和通胀，远高于金融市场的预期。
en: For starters, Trump’s economic policies are likely to produce much higher US interest rates and inflation than financial markets expect.

zh: 特朗普的当选几乎肯定结束了1981年以来35年的无通胀利率下行趋势，而这给全球经济条件和资产价格带来了重大影响。
en: Trump’s election has almost certainly ended the 35-year trend of disinflation and declining rates that began in 1981, and that has been the dominant influence on economic conditions and asset prices worldwide.

zh: 但投资者和决策者尚未信服。
en: But investors and policymakers don’t believe it yet.

zh: 美联储发布的预测显示今年的升息将以四分之三个百分点为节奏进行，期货市场价格则只体现了两次如此幅度的升息。
en: The US Federal Reserve Board’s published forecasts suggest only three quarter-point rate hikes this year, and futures markets have priced in just two such moves.

zh: 但是，随着特朗普政策的公布，美联储可能会比就职演说前所计划的幅度更大地收紧货币政策，而不是如市场仍然预期的那样幅度更小。
en: As Trump launches his policies, however, the Fed is likely to tighten its monetary policy more than it had planned before the inauguration, not less, as the markets still expect.

zh: 更重要的是，随着特朗普的政策刺激实体经济活动和通胀，长期利率 — — 比央行设定的隔夜利率更能影响世界经济 — — 有可能剧烈上升。
en: More important, as Trump’s policies boost both real economic activity and inflation, long-term interest rates, which influence the world economy more than the overnight rates set by central banks, are likely to rise steeply.

zh: 这一情景背后的逻辑很简单。
en: The rationale for this scenario is straightforward.

zh: 特朗普的税收和支出计划将强烈逆转国会强迫奥巴马政府采取的预算整合，而如果特朗普兑现其取消2008年金融危机后所实施的银行监管措施的承诺，家庭借贷将大幅扩张。
en: Trump’s tax and spending plans will sharply reverse the budget consolidation enforced by Congress on Barack Obama’s administration, and household borrowing will expand dramatically if Trump fulfills his promise to reverse the bank regulations imposed after the 2008 financial crisis.

zh: 随着这一额外的刺激助推已经接近充分就业的经济，通胀必然会加速，而保护主义贸易关税和可能的“边境税”将更进一步推高进口商品价格。
en: As all this extra stimulus fuels an economy already nearing full employment, inflation seems bound to accelerate, with protectionist trade tariffs and a possible “border tax” raising prices even more for imported goods.

zh: 唯一的不确定性是货币政策如何对这一“特朗普通胀”发生反应。
en: The only uncertainty is how monetary policy will respond to this “Trumpflation.”

zh: 但不论美联储是通过比其当前预测所暗示的更激进地提高利率，还是通过保持短期利率大大落后于物价增长的上升曲线来应对，债券投资者都将遭受损失。
en: But whether the Fed tries to counteract it by raising interest rates more aggressively than its current forecasts imply, or decides to move cautiously, keeping short-term interest rates well behind the rising curve of price growth, bond investors will suffer.

zh: 因此，未来一年十年期美国国债收益率可能从2.5%上升到3.5%或以上，并最终进一步大幅提高。
en: As a result, yields on ten-year US bonds could jump from 2.5% to 3.5% or more in the year ahead – and ultimately much higher.

zh: 相反，在欧洲和日本，货币条件将保持宽松，因为央行将继续用零利率和量化宽松（QE）支持经济增长。
en: In Europe and Japan, by contrast, monetary conditions will remain loose, as central banks continue to support economic growth with zero interest rates and quantitative easing (QE).

zh: 这一政策趋异暗示了金融市场似乎尚未做好准备的第二个潜在冲击。
en: And this policy divergence suggests a second potential shock for which financial markets seem unprepared.

zh: 尽管特朗普表示要提振美国出口，但美元可能继续大幅升值，特别是美元兑新兴市场货币汇率。
en: The US dollar could strengthen much further, especially against emerging-market currencies, despite Trump’s stated desire to boost US exports.

zh: 汇率升值的催化剂不但在于美国的利率，也在于新兴市场的美元挤兑。 2010年以来，新兴市场外部债务增加了3万亿美元。
en: The catalyst for exchange-rate appreciation would be not only higher US interest rates, but also a dollar squeeze in emerging markets, where foreign debts have increased by $3 trillion since 2010.

zh: 美元升值和过度对外借贷的综合作用在20世纪80年代和90年代引发了拉美和亚洲债务危机。
en: A confluence of dollar strength and excessive foreign borrowing caused the debt crises in Latin America and Asia in the 1980s and 1990s.

zh: 这一回，特朗普的保护主义将让情况更加糟糕，特别是对于墨西哥和土耳其等国家，它们的发展战略以出口迅速扩张为基础，并通过美元债务来为国内商业活动融资。
en: This time, Trump’s protectionism could make matters even worse, especially for countries such as Mexico and Turkey, which have based their development strategies on rapidly expanding exports and have financed domestic business activity with dollar debts.

zh: 坏消息到此为止。
en: So much for the bad news.

zh: 幸运的是，尚未体现在金融市场价格中的第三个重要发展趋势或许对全球经济条件较为有利：欧盟 — — 对于除墨西哥和加拿大几乎所有国家来说，欧盟是比美国还要重要的市场 — — 在2017年的表现可能会大大好于预期。
en: Fortunately, a third major development that is not priced into financial markets could be more favorable for global economic conditions: the European Union – an even more important market than the US for almost every trading country apart from Mexico and Canada – could do much better than expected in 2017.

zh: 2015年初，欧洲央行通过启动规模比美联储量化宽松还要大的债券购买计划来阻止欧元区解体，此后，大部分欧盟国家经济指标开始迅速改善。
en: Economic indicators began to improve rapidly in most EU countries from early 2015, when the European Central Bank stopped the fragmentation of the eurozone by launching a bond-buying program even bigger than the QE pioneered by the Fed.

zh: 但去年这一经济复苏被政治解体的担忧所压倒。
en: But this economic recovery was overwhelmed last year by fears of political disintegration.

zh: 荷兰、法国、德国和意大利都面临民粹主义反动 — — 前三个国家今年都要举行选举 — — 英国退欧和特朗普冲击当然也引发了焦虑：下一块多米诺骨牌很可能是这些欧盟创始成员国之一，甚至整个欧盟都要沦陷。
en: With the Netherlands, France, Germany, and Italy all facing populist insurgencies – and at least the first three holding elections this year – the Brexit and Trump shocks have naturally provoked anxiety that the next domino to fall will be one of these EU founding members, followed perhaps by the entire EU.

zh: 这一预期形成了2017年最大的惊奇：欧盟不会解体，反而会稳定化，推动经济反弹和强劲的金融表现，类似于2010年到2014年的美国“金发姑娘时期 ” ， 即经济复苏既不过热，也不过冷。
en: These expectations create the possibility of the biggest surprise of 2017: instead of disintegrating, the EU stabilizes, facilitating an economic rebound and a period of strong financial performance similar to the US “Goldilocks period” from 2010 to 2014, when the economy recovered at a pace that was neither too hot nor too cold.

zh: 关键事件将是法国总统大选，其结果几乎肯定要等到5月7日的第二轮选举才能落定。
en: The key event will be France’s presidential election, which will most likely be decided in a second-round runoff on May 7.

zh: 不管是弗朗索瓦·菲永（François Fillon）还是艾曼努尔·马克隆（Emmanuel Macron）胜出，法国都将采取可以与2003年的德国时任总理施罗德相提并论的经济改革。
en: If either François Fillon or Emmanuel Macron wins, France will embark on an economic reform process comparable to Germany’s in 2003, undertaken by then-Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder.

zh: 即使是对这些改革的温和期待，都将鼓励9月24日大选产生的德国新政府放松其紧缩要求。
en: Even a mild foretaste of such reforms would encourage a relaxation of the austerity terms demanded by the new German government that emerges from the general election there on September 24.

zh: 更加合作和建设性的法德关系反过来又将削弱民粹主义的五星运动（Five Star Movement）在意大利的支持率。
en: A more cooperative and constructive Franco-German relationship would, in turn, erode support for the populist Five Star Movement in Italy.

zh: 当然，这一良好前景的风险是马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）赢得法国大选。
en: The risk to this benign scenario is, of course, that Marine Le Pen wins in France.

zh: 若是如此，欧盟解体将成为非常现实的前景，引发欧洲金融市场和经济体的恐慌。
en: In that case, a breakup of the EU will become a realistic prospect, triggering panic in European financial markets and economies.

zh: 所有民调和对法国政治的严肃分析都表明勒庞成为总统只是不可能的幻想。
en: Every opinion poll and serious analysis of French politics indicates that President Le Pen is an impossible fantasy.

zh: 但在去年美国总统大选前，关于美国政治的所有民调和严肃分析不也是如此吗？
en: But isn’t that what every opinion poll and serious analysis of US politics indicated last year about President Trump?

zh: 披着人文外衣的经济学
en: Economics With a Humanities Face

zh: 芝加哥—在一份2006年的调查中，美国大学教授被问及，是从多种研究领域中汲取知识更好，还是专注于一个领域更好。
en: CHICAGO – In a 2006 survey, American university professors were asked whether it was better to possess knowledge from numerous fields of study, or from just one.

zh: 在心理学教授中间，79%的人热衷于跨学科学习，社会学教授的这一比例为73 % ， 历史学教授为68 % 。
en: Among professors of psychology, 79% were enthusiastic about interdisciplinary learning, as were 73% of sociologists and 68% of historians.

zh: 最不热衷的教授呢？
en: The least enthusiastic?

zh: 经济学。 只有42%的受访经济学教授同意应该通过跨学科视角看待世界。
en: Economists: only 42% surveyed said they agreed with the need to understand the world through a cross-disciplinary lens.

zh: 一位观察家尖锐地指出 ： “ 经济学家真的认为他们没有什么可以从别人身上学习的。 ”
en: As one observer put it bluntly: “Economists literally think they have nothing to learn from anyone else.”

zh: 事实上，如果经济学家能够拓宽视野，将大受其益。
en: In fact, economists would benefit greatly if they broadened their focus.

zh: 如果将经济学看成是真正的人类之学，那么经济学可以从人文学科中学到很多东西。
en: Dealing as it does with human beings, economics has much to learn from the humanities.

zh: 其模型将变得更加现实，其预测将变得更加准确，而经济政策也可以变得更加有效和公平。
en: Not only could its models be more realistic and its predictions more accurate, but economic policies could be more effective and more just.

zh: 不管是思考如何在多样化的文化中打造经济增长 — — 当大学通过牺牲学生来追求自身利益时，就产生了道德问题 — — 还是与医疗、婚姻和家庭有关的非常个人的问题，经济学洞见都是必要而不充分的。
en: Whether one considers how to foster economic growth in diverse cultures, the moral questions raised when universities pursue self-interest at the expense of their students, or deeply personal issues concerning health care, marriage, and families, economic insights are necessary but insufficient.

zh: 如果我们只考虑这些洞见，政策就会失之偏颇，人民也会蒙受损失。
en: If those insights are all we consider, policies flounder and people suffer.

zh: 经济学家热衷于基于数学的解释，至少有三个方面，他们是几乎束手无策：考虑文化因素、使用叙事型解释，以及无法单独简化为经济类型的伦理问题。
en: In their passion for mathematically-based explanations, economists have a hard time in at least three areas: accounting for culture, using narrative explanation, and addressing ethical issues that cannot be reduced to economic categories alone.

zh: 人可不是被造出来然后浸润到某种文化中的有机体，比如冥河的阿克琉斯。
en: People are not organisms that are first made and then dipped in some culture, like Achilles in the river Styx.

zh: 人从诞生之初就是文化生物。
en: They are cultural beings from the outset.

zh: 但是，由于文化无法用数学来描述，经济学家通常会采取前文化人性（pre-cultural humanness）的处理方式。
en: But, because culture cannot be rendered in mathematical terms, economists typically embrace the idea of a pre-cultural humanness.

zh: 要理解作为文化生物的人，你必须讲述关于人的故事。
en: To understand people as cultural beings, one must tell stories about them.

zh: 人的生活的展开不像火星绕着太阳旋转那么容易预测。
en: Human lives do not unfold in a predictable fashion the way Mars orbits the sun.

zh: 偶然性、习性和不可预见的选择起着不可分割的作用。
en: Contingency, idiosyncrasy, and unforeseeable choices play an irreducible role.

zh: 生活表现出一种可称之为“叙事性”的特质，这意味着需要通过讲故事来进行解释。
en: Life displays what might be called “narrativeness,” implying the need for explanation in terms of stories.

zh: 要更好地理解这一点，可以想想小说。 小说也许不仅是一种文学形式，也是理解社会世界一种方式。
en: And the best appreciation of this is to be found in novels, which may be considered not just a literary form, but also a distinct way of understanding the social world.

zh: 尽管小说所描述的事件是虚构的，但这些事件的形式、顺序和后果通常能够准确地描述我们的生活是如何展开的。
en: Although the events that novels describe are fictional, the shape, sequence, and ramifications of those events is often the most accurate account we have of how lives unfold.

zh: 最后，经济学免不了会包含一些无法简化为经济学本身 — — 乃至任何社会科学的伦理问题。
en: Finally, economics inevitably involves ethical questions that are not reducible to economics itself – or, for that matter, to any other social science.

zh: 经济学家常常将伦理问题夹带入他们的关于“公平”市场价格之类的概念的模型中。
en: Economists often smuggle ethical concerns into their models with concepts like “fair” market price.

zh: 但其实可以通过多种方法让这些问题公开，供大家讨论。
en: But there are many ways to make these issues overt and open them to argument.

zh: 论伦理洞见，没有比托尔斯泰、陀思妥耶夫斯基、乔治·艾略特、简·奥斯汀、亨利·詹姆斯和其他现实主义者的小说更好的源泉了。
en: There is no better source of ethical insight than the novels of Tolstoy, Dostoevsky, George Eliot, Jane Austen, Henry James, and the other great realists.

zh: 他们的作品能够提炼至关重要的伦理问题的复杂性，这些问题过于重要，不能通过高度概括的理论来阐述。 这些问题需要同理心和很好的判断力，这些素质需要通过经验来获得，无法形式化。
en: Their works distill the complexity of ethical questions that are too important to be safely entrusted to an overarching theory – questions that call for empathy and good judgment, which are developed through experience and cannot be formalized.

zh: 平心而论，某些伦理理论可能会让人产生同理心，但阅读文学作品、理解其中的角色能够很好地训练人与他人感同身受的能力。
en: To be sure, some theories of ethics may recommend empathy, but reading literature and identifying with characters involves extensive practice in placing oneself in others’ shoes.

zh: 如果你不能理解安娜·卡列尼娜，你就无法真正读懂《安娜·卡列尼娜 》 。
en: If one has not identified with Anna Karenina, one has not really read Anna Karenina.

zh: 当你阅读一部名著，并理解其中的角色时，你会花大量时间与他们神交 — — 由内而外地感受另一个人的感受。
en: When you read a great novel and identify with its characters, you spend countless hours engaging with them – feeling from within what it is like to be someone else.

zh: 你透过不同的阶级、性别、宗教、文化、性取向、道德观或其他决定和区分做人的体验的要素来看待世界。
en: You see the world from the perspective of a different social class, gender, religion, culture, sexual orientation, moral understanding, or other features that define and differentiate human experience.

zh: 你间接地通过角色的生活来生活，不但感受到角色的感受，也会深入地思考这些感受，考察角色的行为，并在实践中获得角色所处环境中的为人处世之道。
en: By living a character’s life vicariously, you not only feel what she feels, but also reflect on those feelings, consider the character of the actions to which they lead, and, with practice, acquire the wisdom to appreciate real people in all their complexity.

zh: 这里的要点不是要抛弃经济学的伟大成就于不顾，而是要创造我们所谓的“人文经济学 ” ， 即让每个学科都保持自身独特的品质。
en: The point is not to abandon the great achievements of economics, but to create what we call a “humanomics,” which allows each discipline to keep its own distinctive qualities.

zh: 人文经济学不是要让经济学和人文学融合在一起，而是要创造两者之间的对话。
en: Rather than fuse economics and the humanities, humanomics creates a dialogue between them.

zh: 这一对话实际上将让经济学回归亚当·斯密思想的辉煌的根基，他在《道德情操论》中明确否认了人的活动能够通过个人效用最大化的“理性选择”来充分描述。
en: Such a conversation would actually bring economics back to its illustrious roots in the thought of Adam Smith, who, in The Theory of Moral Sentiments, explicitly denied that human behavior could be adequately described in terms of people’s “rational choice” to maximize their individual utility.

zh: 毕竟，人们常常做蠢事。
en: After all, people often behave foolishly.

zh: 对斯密来说，更重要的是人们对他人的关注是一种“原始的激情 ” ， 无法简化为自私的考量。
en: More important for Smith, their care for others is an “original passion” that is not reducible to selfish concerns.

zh: 斯密关于经济学和伦理学的著作无不体现出对理性的边界的深刻认识。
en: Smith’s writings on economic and ethics share a deep sense of the limits of reason.

zh: 中央极化注定要失败，关于行为的代数模型亦然。
en: Central planning is bound to fail, but so are algebraic models of behavior.

zh: 我们需要对异常有微妙的理解，在斯密的道德名著问世半个世纪后，这种敏感性被简·奥斯汀和她的后来人发扬光大。
en: One needs a subtle appreciation of particulars, the sort of sensitivity that was dramatized, a half-century after Smith’s moral treatise, by Jane Austen and her successors.

zh: 作为一位伟大的心理学家，斯密知道我们即需要金钱，也需要情感。
en: A great psychologist, Smith knew that we need both cents and sensibility.

zh: 计量经济学方法和数学模型教会了我们很多，但也只是这样罢了。
en: Econometric methods and mathematical models teach us much, but only so much.

zh: 对于人的生活，它充满了偶然性和叙事性，因此故事是不可或缺的理解途径。
en: When it comes to human lives, characterized as they are by contingency and narrativeness, stories are an indispensable way of knowing.

zh: 正因如此，经济学的定量的严格性、政策重点和逻辑需要用同理性、判断和人类所拥有的最好的智慧来补充。
en: That is why the quantitative rigor, policy focus, and logic of economics must be supplemented with the empathy, judgment, and wisdom that defines the humanities at their best.

zh: 经济学家必须深入其他学科中 — — 同时也让其他学科深入到经济学中。
en: Economists must speak to other disciplines – and let them speak back.

zh: 忽视经济大局
en: Missing the Economic Big Picture

zh: 伯克利—我最近听世贸组织前总干事拉米（Pascal Lamy）转述了一则佛教传说，禅宗六世祖惠能对无尽藏比丘尼说 ： “ 智者指月，愚者见指不见月。
en: BERKELEY – I recently heard former World Trade Organization Director-General Pascal Lamy paraphrasing a classic Buddhist proverb, wherein China’s Sixth Buddhist Patriarch Huineng tells the nun Wu Jincang: “When the philosopher points at the moon, the fool looks at the finger.”

zh: ”拉米补充说 ： “ 市场资本主义就是月。
en: Lamy added that, “Market capitalism is the moon.

zh: 全球化就是指。 ”
en: Globalization is the finger.”

zh: 如今，反全球化情绪在西方全面崛起，今年也成为望指（finger-watching）的一年。
en: With anti-globalization sentiment now on the rise throughout the West, this has been quite a year for finger-watching.

zh: 在英国退欧公投中 ， “ 小英国人”投票脱离欧盟；在美国，唐纳德·特朗普赢得总统大选，因为他让足够多的关键州选民相信他将“让美国再次伟大 ” ， 而其手段就包括为美国重新谈判各不相同的贸易“协议 ” 。
en: In the United Kingdom’s Brexit referendum, “Little Englanders” voted to leave the European Union; and in the United States, Donald Trump won the presidency because he convinced enough voters in crucial states that he will “make America great again,” not least by negotiating very different trade “deals” for the country.

zh: 让我们这样引导我们自己：想一想经济政策之月现在是怎么一副模样，特别是从增长和不平等的角度看。
en: Let us orient ourselves by considering what the economic-policy moon looks like today, particularly with respect to growth and inequality.

zh: 首先，信息处理、机器人和生物技术等领域的技术创新仍然在以惊人的速度加速。
en: For starters, technological innovation in areas such as information processing, robotics, and biotechnology continues to accelerate at a remarkable pace.

zh: 但北大西洋国家的年生产率增长从1870年以来早已习以为常的2%的水平下降到如今的1%左右。
en: But annual productivity growth in North Atlantic countries has fallen from the 2% rate to which we have been accustomed since 1870 to about 1% now.

zh: 生产率增长是一个重要的经济指标，因为它衡量实现相同水平经济产出的资源和人力同比下降率。
en: Productivity growth is an important economic indicator, because it measures the year-on-year decline in resources or manpower needed to achieve the same level of economic output.

zh: 西北大学经济学家罗伯特·戈登（Robert J. Gordon）认为，在过去推动经济增长的所有真正的“改变大局”的创新 — — 电力、飞行、现代卫生设施等 — — 都已是明日黄花，我们不应该再期待增长永无止境地继续下去。
en: Northwestern University economist Robert J. Gordon maintains that all of the true “game-changing” innovations that have fueled past economic growth – electric power, flight, modern sanitation, and so forth – have already been exhausted, and that we should not expect growth to continue indefinitely.

zh: 但戈登几乎肯定是错的：改变大局的发明从根本上改变或重新定义生活体验，这意味着它们往往落在经济增长的常规衡量手段适用范围之外。
en: But Gordon is almost surely wrong: game-changing inventions fundamentally transform or redefine lived experience, which means that they often fall outside the scope of conventional measurements of economic growth.

zh: 如果说有什么期待的话，也应该期待当前的创新速度将带来更多的改变大局的创新。
en: If anything, we should expect to see only more game changers, given the current pace of innovation.

zh: 生产率增长或技术增加值的衡量指标只包括了基于市场的生产和消费。
en: Measures of productivity growth or technology’s added value include only market-based production and consumption.

zh: 但一个人的物质财富并不等同于一个人的真实财富 — — 即一个人过上充实生活的自由和能力。
en: But one’s material wealth is not synonymous with one’s true wealth, which is to say, one’s freedom and ability to lead a fulfilling life.

zh: 我们的真实财富大部分由家庭构成，在家庭中，我们可以将非市场的时间、信息和社会投入与市场产品和服务结合起来，实现我们的自我选择的各种结果。
en: Much of our true wealth is constituted within the household, where we can combine non-market temporal, informational, and social inputs with market goods and services to accomplish various ends of our own choosing.

zh: 标准衡量指标表明生产率增长有所下降，但所有其他指标显示真实生产率增长正在上升，原因在于市场产品和服务于新兴信息和通讯技术的协同效应。
en: While standard measures show productivity growth falling, all other indicators suggest that true productivity growth is leaping ahead, owing to synergies between market goods and services and emerging information and communication technologies.

zh: 但如果经济增长较低的国家不能为人民提供充分的教育，那么几乎所有不能进入收入顶层五分之一的人口都无法获得测得经济增长的收益，但仍能够得益于改善他们的生活和福利的新技术。
en: But when countries with low-growth economies do not sufficiently educate their populations, nearly everyone below the top income quintile misses out on the gains from measured economic growth, while still benefiting from new technologies that can improve their lives and wellbeing.

zh: 经济学家卡尔·波兰尼（Karl Polanyi）在20世纪三四十年代指出，如果经济制度承诺创造共同繁荣，但最终只服务于收入顶层的20 % ， 它就会令绝大多数经济参与者的期望落空。
en: As economist Karl Polanyi pointed out in the 1930s and 1940s, if an economic system promises to create shared prosperity but only seems to serve the top 20% of earners, it has disappointed the vast majority of economic participants’ expectations.

zh: 而在这方面，市场资本主义没能提供物廉价美的20世纪80年代生活方式，而当时有很多人期待能够得到这种生活方式。
en: And market capitalism, for its part, has not delivered the ever-more affordable 1980s lifestyle that so many back then expected it would.

zh: 相反，在过去30年，一个“卓越阶级 ” （ overclass）浮现，这一阶级比镀金时代的强盗大亨的相对经济实力还要强。
en: Instead, during the past 30 years, an “overclass” has emerged, one that exercises even more relative economic power than Gilded Age robber barons did.

zh: 但是，导致这一阶级崛起和拥有过度权力的的因素仍不清楚。
en: The factors contributing to its rise and undue power, however, remain unclear.

zh: 在其他地区，中国、印度和一些环太平洋国家已经或即将赶超北大西洋国家的生产率和繁荣。
en: Elsewhere, China, India, and some Pacific Rim countries have matched, or will soon match, North Atlantic countries’ productivity and prosperity.

zh: 其余地区也不再被北大西��越甩越后，但也没能缩小生产率和繁荣差距，这意味着这些国家将继续无穷无尽地落后。
en: The rest of the world is no longer falling further behind the North Atlantic, but nor is it closing the productivity and prosperity gap, implying that these countries will continue to lag behind indefinitely.

zh: 上述特点都是传说中市场资本主义之月的要素。
en: The aforementioned features are all constituent parts of our proverbial market capitalist moon.

zh: 随着它与社会、政治和技术力量互动，它将创造出欢乐和悲伤。
en: As it develops and interacts with social, political, and technological forces, it creates elation alongside distress.

zh: 全球化是更大的拼图中的一块：我们找到全球贸易体系的最佳管理之道固然重要，但这不能取代管理市场资本主义本身这一大得多的挑战。
en: Globalization is one piece in a larger puzzle: while it is important that we determine the best way to manage the global trade system, doing so cannot substitute for the much larger challenge of managing market capitalism itself.

zh: 我们只关注个别自由贸易协定 — — 不管是草案还是已经存在的协定 — — 或聚焦于对移民关闭国家边境，这就是见指不见月。
en: By focusing on individual free-trade agreements, whether proposed or already existing, or on closing national borders to immigrants, we are looking at the finger and missing the moon.

zh: 要想控制全球经济的运行轨迹，现在我们必须抬头看月。
en: If we are to get a grip on the global economy’s trajectory, is time to look up.

zh: 经济学及其批评
en: Economics and Its Critics

zh: 慕尼黑—如今，经济学的“吐槽点”可谓多矣。
en: MUNICH – There is much to criticize in economics nowadays.

zh: 比如，经济学关注政治问题实在太少，而用数学折磨学生又是在太甚。
en: For example, the profession focuses far too little on political issues and far too much on beating students to death with mathematics.

zh: 但当前大量对经济学的批评却是建立在误解和无知的基础上。
en: But much current criticism of the profession is based on misunderstanding and ignorance.

zh: 以亚当·斯密的“看不见的手”的概念为例。 这一概念认为市场均衡是有效的，如果竞争是完美的并且产权是明晰的话。
en: Consider Adam Smith’s concept of the “invisible hand,” which implies that a market equilibrium is efficient if perfect competition prevails and well-defined property rights exist.

zh: 与许多批评主张相反，主流经济学家并不假设这些理想条件总是成立。
en: Contrary to what many critics suppose, mainstream economists do not assume that these ideal conditions are always present.

zh: 相反，经济学家一般将这些条件作为分析市场失灵的基准。
en: On the contrary, economists tend to use these conditions as a benchmark for analyzing market failures.

zh: 他们就像是嗅探犬，寻找经济中的缺陷，并提出如何通过明智的政府干预纠正这些缺陷。
en: Like sniffer dogs, they search the economy for such defects and ponder how they can be corrected through intelligent state intervention.

zh: 从这个角度看，经济学家就好比是医生，在能够诊断病情、开出治疗方案之前，他们必须知道健康的体魄是怎样的。
en: In this respect, economists are like doctors, who have to know what a healthy body looks like before they can diagnose disease and prescribe treatment.

zh: 好医生不会肆意干预身体过程，而只有在有客观证据证明存在疾病并且可以开出有效治疗方案的情况下才会干预。
en: A good doctor does not intervene arbitrarily in the body’s processes, but only in cases where there is objective proof of a disease and an effective treatment can be prescribed.

zh: 环境监管解决了市场失灵的一个尤其显著的例子。
en: Environmental regulation addresses a particularly striking example of market failure.

zh: 市场是总体有效的，如果公司收入正确地反应了它们的产出给予第三方的一切好处、并且它们的成本反映了一切坏处的话。
en: Markets are generally efficient if companies’ revenues correctly reflect all the benefits that their output bestows on third parties, while their costs reflect all the harms.

zh: 在此情形中，利润最大化带来社会福利最大化。
en: In this case, maximizing profit leads to maximizing social welfare.

zh: 但如果生产造成公司不承担成本的环境破坏，激励就被扭曲了；公司或许会有利润，但从经济标准看，它们的运营是低效的。
en: But if production entails environmental damage for which companies do not pay, incentives are distorted; companies may turn a profit, but they function inefficiently in economic terms.

zh: 因此，国家通过课以罚款或实施禁令“纠正”企业的激励。
en: So the state “corrects” firms’ incentives by levying fines or issuing bans.

zh: 另一种经济学家有时诊断的病例或许可称之为“凯恩斯病 ” 。
en: Another malady that economists sometimes diagnose might be called “Keynes disease.”

zh: 如果需求太疲软，就有可能导致就业的急剧恶化（因为工资和价格在短期是刚性的 ） 。
en: If demand is too weak, it can lead to a sharp drop in employment (because wages and prices are rigid in the short term).

zh: 凯恩斯病课以通过注入债务融资的公共刺激来治疗 — — 就像给心脏病人吃硝化甘油以维持他的心脏跳动。
en: The disease can be cured with injections of public, debt-financed stimulus – like giving a cardiac patient doses of nitroglycerine to keep his heart going.

zh: 与许多人想象的相反，今天的主流经济学中并不存在针对这一药方的根本性偏见。
en: Contrary to what many think, there is no fundamental bias against this medicine in mainstream economics today.

zh: 但刺激不能视为万灵丹。
en: But stimulus cannot be seen as a universal remedy.

zh: 许多折磨经济的疾病是慢性而非急性的，因此需要其他治疗方法。
en: Many ailments that may afflict an economy are chronic, not acute, and thus call for other types of treatment.

zh: 用凯恩斯疗法解决（比如）目前正在影响南欧的结构性问题就好比是用心脏病药物治疗腿疾。
en: Trying Keynesian therapy to resolve, say, the structural problems currently affecting the countries of southern Europe would be like trying to cure a broken leg with heart medicine.

zh: 硝化甘油可以解决循环系统衰竭的风险。
en: Nitroglycerine addresses the risk of circulatory collapse.

zh: 放到经济学里讲，这就是2008年全球金融危机爆发后所需要的。
en: In economic terms, that is what was needed following the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 但长期使用这类药物可能是致命的。
en: But long-term use of such medication can be fatal.

zh: 意识形态总是导致概念混淆。
en: Here and elsewhere, ideology causes conceptual confusion.

zh: 比如，斯密认为竞争是看不见的手运行的基本条件，因为垄断和寡头会剥削消费者、限制生产。
en: For example, Smith viewed competition as a basic condition of the invisible hand’s operation, because monopolies and oligopolies exploit consumers and restrict production.

zh: 但只有相似产品提供商之间的竞争才是有益的。
en: But only competition among providers of similar products is beneficial.

zh: 互补商品或服务供应商之间的竞争是有害的，甚至可能比垄断更糟糕。
en: Competition among providers of complementary goods or services is harmful, and can be even worse than a monopoly.

zh: （正因如此 ， （ 比如）火车司机和飞行员应该强制加入代表所在公司其他所有员工的垄断工会。 ）
en: (That is why train drivers and pilots, for example, should be forced into monopoly unions that represent all of the other employees of their respective companies.)

zh: 最初导致公共部门干预的市场失灵往往会在国际上重现，这意味着国家间竞争也常常是低效的。
en: The market failures that initially give rise to public-sector intervention tend to recur internationally, which means that competition between states is usually not efficient, either.

zh: 这方面的例子包括福利国家之间阻止经济移民的竞争、税收方面的逐底竞争、银行和保险部门的监管竞争等。
en: Examples include competition between welfare states to deter economic migrants, the race to the bottom in taxation, and regulatory rivalry in the banking and insurance sectors.

zh: 与许多右翼人士所认为的相反，竞争并不总是好事。
en: Competition, contrary to what many on the right believe, is not always good.

zh: 当然，意识形态也常常蒙蔽左翼的双眼。
en: Of course, ideology often overwhelms terminology on the left as well.

zh: 以“新自由主义”为例，许多人对这个词嗤之以鼻，因为它被认为是去监管化和放任自由思想。
en: Consider “neoliberalism,” a term of derision for many because it has come to be viewed as a doctrine of deregulation and pure laissez-faire.

zh: 但至少在欧洲，新自由主义的含义与此大相径庭。
en: But in Europe, at least, neoliberalism has a very different meaning.

zh: 这个词由亚历山大·罗斯托（Alexander Rüstow）提出。 1932年，罗斯托宣称旧自由主义已经终结，呼吁采取以强国家角色为企业经营打造扎实法律基础为特征的新的自由主义。
en: It was coined by Alexander Rüstow, who in 1932 proclaimed the end of old liberalism and called for a new liberalism featuring a strong state that lays down a solid legal framework within which firms operate.

zh: 经济人，即经济学家的模型中的理性的利己者，最近也遭到了批评，因为他们常常并不代表现实中的个体行为。
en: Homo economicus, the rationally acting egoist who populates economists’ models, has recently attracted criticism as well, because all too often he does not represent the real behavior of individuals.

zh: 行为实验令人信服地表明这一人为构造的预测价值十分有限。
en: Behavioral experiments have shown conclusively the limited predictive value of this artificial construct.

zh: 但经济人的概念从来不是为了预测才发明的；它的真正目的是更容易地区分市场失灵和思想失灵。
en: But homo economicus was never intended to be used for forecasting; its real purpose is to make it easier to distinguish between market failures and mental failures.

zh: 经济学家试图寻找集体不理性，而假设个体理性的经济模型对此大有裨益。
en: Economists seek to detect collective irrationality, and economic models that assume individual rationality facilitate that.

zh: 通过保证政策响应游戏规则中的漏洞而不是个体错误或不理性，这一“方法论个体主义 ” （ methodological individualism）使我们免于独裁式家长作风。
en: By ensuring that policies respond to flaws in the rules of the game, not to individuals’ fallibility or irrationality, this “methodological individualism” saves us from dictatorial paternalism.

zh: 发放高风险贷款而股本不足的银行相当清楚地说明了“经济人”的分析价值。
en: Banks that grant risky loans on too little equity illustrate the analytical value of homo economicus particularly clearly.

zh: 它们的利润被私人化，而任何超出它们的股本的损失被推给了债权人或者 — — 更妙的是 — — 推给了纳税人。
en: Their profits are privatized, but any losses exceeding their equity are dumped on their creditors, or, even better for them, on the taxpayers.

zh: 这一不对称性让银行变成了赌场：庄家永远是赢家。
en: This asymmetry turns banking into a casino: The house always wins.

zh: 银行选择风险畸高的投资项目，这些项目或许有利可图，但在经济上弊大于利。
en: Banks choose particularly risky investment projects, which may be profitable but are economically damaging.

zh: 问题的原因不是人类不理性；相反，问题发生的原因正在与银行家的理性行为。
en: The problem is not caused by human irrationality; on the contrary, it arises precisely because bankers are acting rationally.

zh: 我们从环境监管中知道，向银行家宣讲常识和道德无济于事；但改变银行家的激励 — — 比如通过要求更高的股本-资产比率 — — 会收到奇效。
