zh: 在二十世纪六十年代后期和七十年代早期，菲尔普斯在斯坦福大学遇到了 Amartya Sen、John Rawls和 Kenneth Arrow，这使他对哲学又重新感起了兴趣。
en: In the late 1960’s and early 1970’s, Phelps’s encounters with Amartya Sen, John Rawls, and Kenneth Arrow at Stanford revived his philosophical streak.

zh: 他与Rawls进行过极其有价值的智慧讨论，这促使他写了几篇有关经济公正理论的论文以及在1974年出版了一本专著，这本书今天仍在被使用。
en: He had extremely valuable intellectual conversations with Rawls, prompting him to write several essays on the theory of economic justice and publish a book on the subject in 1974 – a book still used today.

zh: 菲尔普斯还参与了对宏观经济的修订。 据萨缪尔森讲，还有微观经济的修订。
en: Phelps was behind the modern reworking of the macro economy – and, according to Samuelson, the micro economy, too.

zh: 他的研究课题包括把信息和知识的不完整性引入经济理论，他对此又再次进行了系统论述，以及对于经纪人的预期给予高度重视。
en: His research programme consisted of introducing the imperfection of information and knowledge into economic theory, which he then reformulated, giving serious consideration to agents’ expectations.

zh: 在他出版的一本著名的以及包含有他的三个重要贡献的名为《关于就业和通货膨胀的微观经济基础的理论》的著作中，他阐述了在过去50年间成为经济学理论中最伟大革命的理论。
en: In Microeconomic Foundations of Employment and Inflation Theory , a famous work that he published and to which he made three major contributions, he set the scene for what would become the greatest revolution in economic theory of the last 50 years.

zh: 正是因为有了菲尔普斯，才给我们带来了自然失业理论，这是现代宏观经济理论和经济政策的基石，该理论被弗里德曼在一年后重新发现，尽管也许只是受到了启发。
en: It is to Phelps that we owe the theory of the natural unemployment rate – a cornerstone of modern macroeconomic theory and economic policy that Milton Friedman rediscovered a year later, albeit heuristically.

zh: 菲尔普斯提出“孤岛比喻 ” ， 该比喻帮助解释了为什么货币政策作为一种不确切的信息能产生暂时性的真正的效果。
en: Phelps was also responsible for the “island parable,” which helped explain why monetary policy can have temporary real effects as a result of imperfect information.

zh: 菲尔普斯大量的工作还包括结构学理论的重新修订，以显示利率和资产价格的变化怎样在一定的时间内影响了失业率的平衡。
en: The bulk of Phelps’s current work consists of a new reworking of structuralist theory, in an effort to show how changes in interest rates and asset prices affect the equilibrium unemployment rate over the medium term.

zh: 菲尔普斯的新理论提供了一个逻辑背景，凭借这一背景我们可以评估在新技术和创新的强有力的影响下股票价格、汇率以及更常见的有形资产和人力资本的价值波动所带来的后果。
en: Phelps’s new theory provides a logical backdrop against which we can assess the consequences of fluctuations in share prices, exchange rates, and, more generally, the value of physical assets and human capital under the powerful influence of new technologies and innovation.

zh: 这些当然正是今天的经济理论极力想要解释的东西。
en: These are, of course, the main phenomena that economic theory struggles to explain nowadays.

zh: 所以我们很容易理解为什么至今菲尔普斯还站在这一领域的前沿。
en: So it is easy to understand why Phelps still leads the way.

zh: 事实上，我们完全可以期待在今后的一二十年间他新的理论体系会成为一个基准点。
en: Indeed, we can expect his new theoretical framework to become a reference point in a decade or two.

zh: 在介绍一位印度数学家进入哈佛大学时，Ludwig Wittgenstein这样写道 ： “ 科学方面的天才通常在其一生中能有一个伟大的观点；他有两个。
en: When recommending an Indian mathematician to a Harvard colleague, Ludwig Wittgenstein wrote that: “scientific geniuses generally have one great idea in their life; he has had two.”

zh: ”那么我们该怎么去说菲尔普斯呢？
en: What could we say about Phelps?

zh: 让美国人去聆听穆斯林之声
en: Educating Americans about Muslim Voices

zh: 发自纽约 — — 在具有历史里程碑意义的开罗讲话中，美国总统奥巴马向穆斯林世界伸出了友谊之手 — — 他尝试与穆斯林达成一种相互尊重的共同承诺。
en: NEW YORK – President Barack Obama has extended an open hand of friendship in his landmark Cairo speech to the Muslim world – seeking to engage Muslims with a commitment of mutual respect. No one can doubt his sincerity.

zh: 没人会怀疑他的真诚，因为自就职以来总统就一直强调，要着手为美国与伊斯兰世界的关系揭开新的篇章。
en: From his first days in office, he has emphasized the importance of embarking on a new chapter in relations between the United States and the world’s Muslims.

zh: 但不幸的是，如果大多数美国人依然忽视关于伊斯兰教的某些基本事实，并对穆斯林文明广阔的地理分布差异和文化多样性视而不见，那么总统的热切渴望将依然只是泡影。
en: But this aspiration will remain elusive without acknowledging the sad fact that most Americans remain woefully ignorant about the basic facts of Islam, and about the broad geographic and cultural diversity of Muslim cultures.

zh: 近四年来的大多数民意调查显示，美国人对伊斯兰教的观感依然走不出“9·11”事件的阴影；比如在2006年由《华盛顿邮报》和ABC新闻网发起的民意调查就显示，近半数美国人认为伊斯兰教是“不利的 ” ， 而1/4的收访者则承认自己对穆斯林有偏见。
en: A majority of public opinion polls taken in the last four years show that the views of Americans about Islam continue to be a casualty of the attacks of September 11, 2001. Washington Post/ABC News polls from 2006, for example, found that nearly half of Americans regard Islam “unfavorably,” while one in four admits to prejudicial feelings against Muslims.

zh: 中东冲突、伊拉克战争和阿富汗战争严重误导了美国人对穆斯林世界的观感，以致美国普通民众甚至对大多数穆斯林其实居住在亚洲这样的事实都表现出集体性的无知，也忽视了印尼，巴基斯坦，印度和孟加拉这四个穆斯林人口最多的文明国家，都有着和其他宗教文化和平并存数千年的历史。
en: American views of the Muslim world are so colored by the conflict in the Middle East and the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan that US citizens have no collective appreciation of the fact that most Muslims live in Asia. Or that the four countries with the largest Muslim populations – Indonesia, Pakistan, India, and Bangladesh – are all cultures with millennia-old histories of coexisting with other religions and cultures.

zh: 对此，美国国务院下属的文化外交事务咨询委员会在2005年发布的一份报告中就呼吁必须给文化外交找到一个能“以微妙，广泛和可持续方式促进美国国家安全”的新视角。
en: A 2005 report by the US State Department’s Advisory Committee on Cultural Diplomacy called for a new vision of cultural diplomacy that “can enhance US national security in subtle, wide-ranging and sustainable ways.”

zh: 而在2008年，一个由共识寻求与构建研究所召集，民主共和两党领导人联合组成的“美国-穆斯林合作项目组”则发表报告，呼吁美国必须找到与穆斯林世界关系��展的新方针,而项目组的主要目标就是“促进美国人和全世界穆斯林之间的相互尊重和理解 ” 。
en: In 2008, a bipartisan group of American leaders—the US-Muslim Engagement Project— convened by Search for Common Ground and the Consensus Building Institute, issued a report calling for a new direction for US relations with the Muslim world. A primary goal of this effort would be “to improve of mutual respect and understanding between Americans and Muslims around the world.”

zh: 而如今就是美国民众与奥巴马政府携手翻开与穆斯林世界关系新一页的时候了。
en: It is time for US citizens to commit themselves to working alongside the Obama administration to turn a new leaf in relations with the Muslim world.

zh: 我们要采取的第一步则是必须采取切实措施，教育美国人并让他们明白：全世界10亿穆斯林其实是分布在各种多元化的社会当中的。
en: The first step is to make a concerted effort to become better educated about the multifaceted societies that comprise the one billion-strong Muslim population throughout the world.

zh: 因为文化拥有转变人们观感的力量。
en: The power of culture resides in its ability to transform perceptions.

zh: 因此在2009年6月5号到14号，纽约人经历了一场全市范围的穆斯林多元文化洗礼 — — 命名为“穆斯林之声：艺术与理念”的一连串节日和会议活动。
en: From June 5-14, New Yorkers are experiencing the rich diversity of Muslim cultures through a city-wide initiative, entitled “Muslim Voices: Arts and Ideas.”

zh: 包括美国在内的25个国家的300多名艺术家、作家、表演家和学者汇聚一堂，共同参与这场盛况空前的文化盛宴。
en: More than 300 artists, writers, performers, and scholars from more than 25 countries, including the US, are gathering for this unprecedented festival and conference.

zh: 本次活动呈现了一系列来自穆斯林世界的令人眼花缭乱的艺术形式 — — 涵盖从传统（阿拉伯文书法、穆斯林苏菲派祭典唱腔）到现代（视觉装置艺术、印尼先锋剧场艺术和阿拉伯说唱音乐）的各种表现形式。
en: Presentations include a dizzying variety of artistic forms from the Muslim world, ranging from the traditional (calligraphy, Sufi devotional voices) to the contemporary (video installations, avant-garde Indonesian theater, and Arabic hip-hop).

zh: 而同期举行的合作政策会议则聚集了全球的学者和艺术家，共同探讨文化习俗和公共政策的关系并提出文化外交的新方向。
en: A companion policy conference has attracted scholars and artists from around the world exploring the relationship between cultural practice and public policy and suggesting new directions for cultural diplomacy.

zh: 整个活动则旨在打破人们的旧观念，并让民众对穆斯林社会有更细微的了解。
en: A critical goal of this project is to help break stereotypes and create a more nuanced understanding of Muslim societies.

zh: 但尽管我们以无限的热忱寄望这次盛会能够增进人们互相之间的了解，但一场表演，一部电影或者一场艺术展显然并不能解决所有那些割裂美国与伊斯兰世界的难题。
en: Despite our enthusiasm for the possibilities of what this initiative can do to broaden understanding, a performance, a film, or an art exhibition cannot find solutions to all of the problems that divide Americans and the Muslim world.

zh: 因为目前在两种文明的对立问题上，距离感植根于与棘手政治问题同等严峻的文化无知之上，而其中许多问题已经超出了艺术与文化所能解决的范畴。
en: The current distance is rooted as much in ignorance as in hard political issues, many of which go beyond what arts and culture can realistically address.

zh: 然而，类似“穆斯林之声”这样的文化外交行动可以让世界更加了解穆斯林世界的现实 — — 她其实和其他文明一样，是一片孕育世界级艺术品的广阔天地。
en: However, cultural diplomacy and initiatives such as “Muslim Voices” can open the door to the reality of the Muslim world as a rich space for world-class artistic production.

zh: 这反过来可以鼓励人们用尊重和平等的意识去处理那些棘手的政治问题。
en: That, in turn, can encourage an interest in addressing the harder political issues with respect and a sense of equity.

zh: 长期以来，人们早已习惯于采用全球利益冲突的框架，而不是用文化差异的角度来理解美国和穆斯林世界的分别。
en: For too long, the differences between the US and the Muslim world have been framed not in terms of diversity, but as the foundations of a permanent global conflict.

zh: 因此当人们进入到这种体现并超越特定文化的审美体验中时，观念也必然发生变化。
en: But when people participate in an aesthetic experience that both addresses and transcends a particular culture, perceptions are bound to change.

zh: 通过重新寄望于文化间交流，对话和相互理解，美国已经步入了本国乃至全球历史的关键时刻。
en: America has reached a pivotal moment in its national and global history, with new hopes for intercultural exchange, dialogue, and mutual understanding.

zh: 总统奥巴马和国务卿希拉里·克林顿声称他们已经进入了“巧实力”的时代，这意味着他们将有效地采用一切外交手段去取得外交成果，文化外交当然也赫然在列。
en: President Obama and Secretary of State Hillary Clinton say that theirs will be an age of “smart power” that will effectively use all tools of diplomacy at their disposal, including cultural diplomacy.

zh: 因此美国必须再次将艺术视为一种能进一步加强文化交流的有力手段，并最终找到与穆斯林世界之间的沟通新渠道。
en: The US must focus once again on the arts as a meaningful way to promote stronger cultural engagement and, ultimately, to find new channels of communication with the Muslim world.

zh: 这样做的目则是为了表明：文明间的关系并不只是以政治冲突来界定，相反，美国和穆斯林世界有机会通过分享穆斯林丰富复杂的艺术表现形式来重新定义彼此的联系 — — 而这更是探索相互尊重共识所需的至关重要一步。
en: Doing so will show that relations need not be defined only through political conflict. Rather, there is now an opportunity to define connections between America and the Muslim world by sharing the richness and complexity of Muslim artistic expressions – as a vital step in finding grounds for mutual respect.

zh: 教育欧洲
en: Educating Europe

zh: 教育在结束欧洲分裂的过程中扮演着重要的角色。
en: Education has played a big part in healing Europe's divisions.

zh: 四十年前，查尔斯•戴•高乐和康拉德•阿登纳批准为两国的儿童分别编写新的课本。 使用新课本有助于结束法德之间一个世纪以来的对抗状态。
en: Four decades ago, Charles de Gaulle and Konrad Adenauer approved the creation of new textbooks that children in both countries would use to help heal the century-long Franco-German antagonism.

zh: 当今的挑战需要我们积极地采用这样的教育政策。
en: Today's challenges call for such a dynamic use of educational policy.

zh: 随着10个来自中、东、和南欧的国家在五月加入欧盟，欧盟在政治、经济和社会方面将会变得前所未有地多元化。
en: With the May accession of the ten central, eastern, and southern European candidate states, the European Union will be more politically, economically, and socially diverse than ever.

zh: 这无疑会带来新的机遇，但同时也会催生新的风险。
en: This entails new opportunities, no doubt, but also new risks.

zh: 因为一个扩大的欧盟在两个月内就会变成现实，所以我们必须树立文化谅解的观念从而帮助新成员国顺利地融入欧盟大家庭。
en: Because an enlarged Union will become a reality in just two months, it is imperative to develop concepts for cultural understanding that contribute to the successful integration of the new members.

zh: 一些欧盟长期奉行的价值观在传达给新成员国时应该相对容易。
en: Some values, long espoused by the Union, should be relatively easy to convey.

zh: 在十年前的《马斯特里赫特条约》中，欧盟的成员国们一致同意尊重所有成员民族的历史、文化和传统。
en: A decade ago, with the Maastricht Treaty, EU members agreed to respect the history, culture, and traditions of all of their constituent peoples.

zh: 在最近的第一轮谈判中未被接受的欧盟宪法草案不仅承诺尊重文化传统，还责成欧盟采取积极的措施保护、维持和发展欧洲的文化和语言多样性。
en: The draft constitution that recently failed to gain acceptance in the first round of negotiations not only promises to respect cultural heritage; it obliges the Union actively to protect, maintain, and develop the wealth of Europe's cultural and linguistic diversity.

zh: 然而只有在各成员文化都不闭关自守的情况下，欧洲才能完成这项任务。
en: But Europe can succeed in this task only if its various constituent cultures do not seal themselves off from one another.

zh: 在一个交融而开放的欧洲，就不会有对外来文化的抵制；接触是不可避免的。
en: Within a mobile and open Europe, there can be no fencing off of foreign cultures; contact cannot be avoided.

zh: 多样性必须是充满活力的，这就意味着在树立我们自己的文化独特性的同时还要学习与其它的地区和思维方式相融相处。
en: Diversity has to be lived, which means establishing one's own uniqueness and learning to cope in and with other regions and mindsets.

zh: 歌德在其戏剧《塔索》中已提到过这一点。 他大声疾呼 ： " 比较你自己！
en: Goethe already spoke of this in his play "Torquato Tasso," when he cried out: "Compare yourself!

zh: 了解你是谁！ "
en: Discover what you are!"

zh: 确实，欧洲人只有对外来事物持开放的态度才能够成功地建立一个更为广泛的欧洲。
en: Indeed, Europeans will only succeed in building the wider Europe if they are open to what is foreign to them.

zh: 恐外是教育失误的信号-是心胸狭隘和不能设身处地为他人着想的表现。
en: Xenophobia is a sign of education gone wrong - an expression of narrow-mindedness and the inability to put oneself in the position of others.

zh: 因此，与其寻求一种欧洲同一性，还不如达成共同的教育目标以加强欧洲人对于作为其兄弟姊妹的"他人"的意识。
en: So, rather than embarking on a search for a European identity, we should agree on mutual educational objectives to increase the awareness of all Europeans of the "others" who are their brethren in Europe.

zh: 对知识的渴望、与世界交流的欣喜和对不同民族文化的同理心是确保我们能异中求同，同中存异的基本素质。
en: A thirst for knowledge, a delight in engaging with the world, and empathy with people from different cultures are qualities that can ensure diversity in unity, and unity in diversity.

zh: 宽容和使用多种语言的素质同样不可或缺。
en: The same is true for the virtue of tolerance and for multilingualism.

zh: 只有那些熟悉欧洲历史并积极地与准成员国就欧洲的现实和未来进行探讨的人才能在不同的文化和宗教之间担当桥梁的作用。
en: Only those who are familiar with European history and who engage in discussion with the candidate countries about what Europe is and should be will be able to bridge the gap between different cultures and religions.

zh: 这还意味着批评和容忍批评的能力。
en: This implies critical faculties and the ability to tolerate criticism.

zh: 欧盟现有的成员国不但要能够容忍来自西方文明的中、东和南方的欧洲人的批评，还要在制定政策时考虑到这些批评。
en: Moreover, the current EU member states will not only have to be able to tolerate the criticism by central, eastern, and southern Europeans of western civilization, but also to take such criticism into consideration as they ponder policy.

zh: 成功的教育教会我们在对待他人时不论宗教、种族、出身和性别而一视同仁。
en: A successful education teaches us to treat others with dignity, regardless of religion, race, origin, or gender.

zh: 成功教育的一个重要元素就是宽以待人的意愿。
en: A significant element of a successful education is the willingness to be tolerant of others.

zh: 从心理学的角度讲，这种美德意味着设身处地为他人着想的能力。
en: Psychologically, this virtue implies the ability to put oneself in others' position.

zh: 不同文化的成员之间交流失败的原因通常是因为我们对彼此的文化知之甚少。
en: Communication between members of different cultures fails so often because we know too little about one another.

zh: 人们说旅行能开阔心胸，但要做到这一点仅凭地理位置的经常改变远远不够。
en: Travel broadens the mind, they say, but for that to happen, more is required than merely frequent changes of location.

zh: 要深入地了解来自不同文化的人们的世界观，就需要了解他们体验生活的方式。
en: To acquire an insight into how people from other cultures perceive the world, what is required is knowledge of how they live and experience life.

zh: 一种更新的洞察告诉我们：使用多种语言的能力能够开阔我们的心胸。
en: A newer insight would be: multilingualism broadens the mind.

zh: 语言不仅仅是交流的工具。
en: Language is not just a means of communication.

zh: 语言是文化。
en: Language is culture.

zh: 一种语言用以描绘某种思想状态、特征和环境的词汇就能向我们展示一些文化特性。
en: The very question of which states of mind, characteristics, and circumstances a language has words for tells us something about cultural peculiarities.

zh: 以德语为例，诸如 Weltschmerz , Weltgeist , Zeitgeist , Schadenfreude , Realpolitik , 和 Bildung 这些词在其它语言中都通常缺少与之等价的准确词汇。
en: For the German language, let me point here to Weltschmerz , Weltgeist , Zeitgeist , Schadenfreude , Realpolitik , or Bildung - all of them words for which other languages often lack precise equivalents.

zh: 另外，学习一门外语也能促进我们对自身的新的认识。
en: Moreover, by learning a foreign language, one acquires a new understanding of one's own.

zh: 但最重要的是语言是我们通往其它文化的门户。
en: Most importantly, though, language provides access to the other culture.

zh: 到国外留学的倡议-如果可能至少为期一年-作为未来欧洲课程的一部分应该得到大力宣传和认真考虑。
en: Calls for attendance in a foreign school - if possible for at least one year - as part of a future European curriculum should be heard and seriously considered.

zh: 当然，使用多种语言的能力，同理心，宽容和获取关于外来文化的知识不能像税收那样实施。
en: Of course, multilingualism, empathy, tolerance, and the acquisition of knowledge about foreign cultures cannot be decreed like taxes.

zh: 但国家可以也应该为年轻人提供良好的伦理和政治教育，从而让他们有机会与不同的文化互动并认识和接受文化的平等。
en: But the state can and should organize a good ethical and political education that affords young people the opportunity to interact with others and recognize and accept their equality.

zh: 在探求公民意识的过程中，自由民主所依靠的是用榜样、信念和世界观指明前进方向的人和制度。
en: Liberal democracy, in its search for civic-mindedness, depends on people and institutions that can guide the way by their example, beliefs, or worldview.

zh: 在一生中，我们需要无数次地让自己容忍与我们相左的观念和行为。
en: Time and again throughout the course of our lives, we must bring ourselves to tolerate opinions and behaviours that seem contrary to our own.

zh: 这种宽容只能通过教育来维持。
en: In this effort, we are sustained only by education.

zh: 演员兼作家彼得·乌斯蒂诺夫对此有一个形象的描述 ： " 教育是重要的，特别是在解除偏见方面。
en: The actor and writer Peter Ustinov found a graphic image for this: "Education is important, especially when it comes to dismantling prejudices.

zh: 即便我们会不可避免地成为自己思想的囚徒，但至少我们可以确保自己的牢房摆设得体。 "
en: You can't help being a prisoner within your own mind, but the least you can do is ensure that the cell is decently furnished."

zh: 教育神话
en: The Education Myth

zh: 地拉那 — — 在这样一个政治极化、政策瘫痪的时代，人们应当为能就经济战略达成广泛的一致而感到庆幸。
en: TIRANA – In an era characterized by political polarization and policy paralysis, we should celebrate broad agreement on economic strategy wherever we find it.

zh: 其中一个理念得到了人们的一致认同，正如时任英国首相托尼·布莱尔在2001年竞选连任时所说的那样 ， “ 教育、教育、还是教育”是共享式增长的核心内容。
en: One such area of agreement is the idea that the key to inclusive growth is, as then-British Prime Minister Tony Blair put in his 2001 reelection campaign, “education, education, education.”

zh: 降低入学门槛、改善教育质量不仅能实现经济快速增长，而且能收获经济增长中的公平。
en: If we broaden access to schools and improve their quality, economic growth will be both substantial and equitable.

zh: 意大利人说：magari fosse vero，多希望这是真的。
en: As the Italians would say: magari fosse vero. If only it were true.

zh: 完全可以理解人们对教育的热情。
en: Enthusiasm for education is perfectly understandable.

zh: 我们希望自己的孩子受到最好的教育，因为我们希望他们拥有全方位的生活选择，能够亲身体味生活的奇迹，迎接生活的挑战。
en: We want the best education possible for our children, because we want them to have a full range of options in life, to be able to appreciate its many marvels and participate in its challenges.

zh: 我们还知道受过良好教育的人往往能拿到高收入。
en: We also know that better educated people tend to earn more.

zh: 教育的重要性毋庸置疑 — — 教学是我的日常工作，因此我当然希望它有价值。
en: Education’s importance is incontrovertible – teaching is my day job, so I certainly hope it is of some value.

zh: 但它是否构成经济增长战略是另一回事。
en: But whether it constitutes a strategy for economic growth is another matter.

zh: 多数人眼中更好的教育是接受更多教育；而更高质量教育是指有效地学会技能（比方说像经合组织标准化PISA考试成绩 ） 。
en: What most people mean by better education is more schooling; and, by higher-quality education, they mean the effective acquisition of skills (as revealed, say, by the test scores in the OECD’s standardized PISA exam).

zh: 但这是否真是经济增长的推动力？
en: But does that really drive economic growth?

zh: 事实上，推动更好教育的试验已经在全球范围内进行。
en: In fact, the push for better education is an experiment that has already been carried out globally.

zh: 而且，就像我在哈佛的同事 兰特·普里切特已经指出的那样，这项试验出乎意料地取得了令人失望的长期效果。
en: And, as my Harvard colleague Lant Pritchett has pointed out, the long-term payoff has been surprisingly disappointing.

zh: 从1960到2010年这五十年里，全球劳动人口的平均在校时间从2.8年增长至8.3年，基本达到原来的三倍。
en: In the 50 years from 1960 to 2010, the global labor force’s average time in school essentially tripled, from 2.8 years to 8.3 years.

zh: 也就是说一个中等国家的普通工人从还差一点完不成一半的小学教育演变成今天的完成高中教育的一半以上。
en: This means that the average worker in a median country went from less than half a primary education to more than half a high school education.

zh: 那么这些国家现在应该有多富？
en: How much richer should these countries have expected to become?

zh: 1965年，法国劳动力所受平均教育不满五年，大致有14，000美元的人均收入（按2005年价格计算 ） 。
en: In 1965, France had a labor force that averaged less than five years of schooling and a per capita income of $14,000 (at 2005 prices).

zh: 而2010年，教育水准相似的国家却只有不到1，000美元的人均收入。
en: In 2010, countries with a similar level of education had a per capita income of less than $1,000.

zh: 1960年，学校教育达8.3年的国家比只有2.8年的国家富5.5倍。
en: In 1960, countries with an education level of 8.3 years of schooling were 5.5 times richer than those with 2.8 year of schooling.

zh: 相比之下，1960年只有2.8年而到2010年增加到8.3年的国家却只富167 % 。
en: By contrast, countries that had increased their education from 2.8 years of schooling in 1960 to 8.3 years of schooling in 2010 were only 167% richer.

zh: 此外，即便上述增长也在很大程度上并非归功于教育，因为2010年的工人拥有比1960年工人先进50年的技术优势。
en: Moreover, much of this increase cannot possibly be attributed to education, as workers in 2010 had the advantage of technologies that were 50 years more advanced than those in 1960.

zh: 显然，繁荣除了教育还需要别的东西。
en: Clearly, something other than education is needed to generate prosperity.

zh: 通常情况下，各个国家的经验比平均值更能说明问题。
en: As is often the case, the experience of individual countries is more revealing than the averages.

zh: 中国1960年开始时教育程度还不如突尼斯、墨西哥、肯尼亚或伊朗，到2010年所取得的进步也不如上述国家。
en: China started with less education than Tunisia, Mexico, Kenya, or Iran in 1960, and had made less progress than them by 2010.

zh: 但在经济增长方面，中国却完爆这些国家。
en: And yet, in terms of economic growth, China blew all of them out of the water.

zh: 同样的情况也出现在泰国、印度尼西亚与菲律宾、喀麦隆、加纳或巴拿马的比拼之中。
en: The same can be said of Thailand and Indonesia vis-à-vis the Philippines, Cameroon, Ghana, or Panama.

zh: 同样，增长较快的一方除教育外还做了其他工作。
en: Again, the fast growers must be doing something in addition to providing education.

zh: 各国的国内经验也同样发人深思。
en: The experience within countries is also revealing.

zh: 墨西哥25-30岁小学毕业男性的平均收入在穷市和富市相差3倍。
en: In Mexico, the average income of men aged 25-30 with a full primary education differs by more than a factor of three between poorer municipalities and richer ones.

zh: 造成上述差异的不可能是教育质量，因为那些从穷市迁移到富市的劳动力同样赚得更多。
en: The difference cannot possibly be related to educational quality, because those who moved from poor municipalities to richer ones also earned more.

zh: 对“教育、教育、教育”的鼓吹者而言还有进一步的坏消息：劳动者的绝大多数技能都是从工作中获得。
en: And there is more bad news for the “education, education, education” crowd: Most of the skills that a labor force possesses were acquired on the job.

zh: 这个社会知道做什么的主要是公司而不是学校。
en: What a society knows how to do is known mainly in its firms, not in its schools.

zh: 多数公司对入门级员工开放的岗位只有不到15 % ， 也就是说雇主所要求的东西教育系统不能 — — 也不会 — — 提供。
en: At most modern firms, fewer than 15% of the positions are open for entry-level workers, meaning that employers demand something that the education system cannot – and is not expected – to provide.

zh: 面对上述情况，教育爱好者们往往提出教育是增长的必要而非充分条件。
en: When presented with these facts, education enthusiasts often argue that education is a necessary but not a sufficient condition for growth.

zh: 但如果真的如此，在缺少其他条件的情况下教育投资不太可能取得多大效果。
en: But in that case, investment in education is unlikely to deliver much if the other conditions are missing.

zh: 毕竟，虽然满足10年学校教育的国家2010年一般人均收入为30,000美元，但达到同样教育水平的阿尔巴尼亚、亚美尼亚和斯里兰卡的人均收入还不到5，000美元。
en: After all, though the typical country with ten years of schooling had a per capita income of $30,000 in 2010, per capita income in Albania, Armenia, and Sri Lanka, which have achieved that level of schooling, was less than $5,000.

zh: 妨碍这些国家富裕起来不是教育而是其他因素。
en: Whatever is preventing these countries from becoming richer, it is not lack of education.

zh: 一个国家的收入是每位工人的产量总和。
en: A country’s income is the sum of the output produced by each worker.

zh: 增加收入需要工人生产率的提高。
en: To increase income, we need to increase worker productivity.

zh: 显然 ， “ 除教育以外的某些隐形因素”让某些地方的工人效率比其他地方更高。
en: Evidently, “something in the water,” other than education, makes people much more productive in some places than in others.

zh: 成功的发展战略需要弄清楚这究竟是什么。
en: A successful growth strategy needs to figure out what this is.

zh: 不要误会，教育确有提高生产率之功效。
en: Make no mistake: education presumably does raise productivity.

zh: 但说教育是本国的增长战略却意味着放弃了离开学校的全部劳动力 — — 18岁以上的人多数均已离校，而25岁以上的几乎全部离校。
en: But to say that education is your growth strategy means that you are giving up on everyone who has already gone through the school system – most people over 18, and almost all over 25.

zh: 如此的战略无视今天100%劳动力的潜力，明年98 % ， 以及今后半个世纪仍有劳动能力的数量巨大的民众。
en: It is a strategy that ignores the potential that is in 100% of today’s labor force, 98% of next year’s, and a huge number of people who will be around for the next half-century.

zh: 唯教育战略注定让所有人都遗憾自己出生太早。
en: An education-only strategy is bound to make all of them regret having been born too soon.

zh: 教育增长战略已经不能为现在这代人提供帮助。
en: This generation is too old for education to be its growth strategy.

zh: 这代人需要某种战略来提高他们的效率 — — 这样才能创造出更多资源投入到下一代的教育当中。
en: It needs a growth strategy that will make it more productive – and thus able to create the resources to invest more in the education of the next generation.

zh: 我们这代人即使为后辈着想也应该有自己的发展战略。
en: Our generation owes it to theirs to have a growth strategy for ourselves.

zh: 而这种战略并不一定要我们回归学校。
en: And that strategy will not be about us going back to school.

zh: 终结针对教育的战争
en: Ending the War on Education

zh: 火奴鲁鲁 — — 我三岁的侄女非常相信“好人”的力量。
en: HONOLULU – My three-year-old niece believes strongly in the power of “the good guys.”

zh: 每次我去拜访，她总会把我拉到她房间的书架旁，拿出一本接一本书，每一本书的结论都相同：无论战斗大小，最终总是好人获胜。
en: Whenever I visit, she drags me to the bookshelf in her room and pulls out book after book, each with the same conclusion: in battles big or small, the good guys always win.

zh: 我不忍心告诉她，在真实的世界里，干净的战斗和令人满意的结果仅仅是例外。
en: I don’t have the heart to tell her that, in the real world, clean fights and gratifying outcomes are the exception.

zh: 现代战争不遵守任何规则，而忠诚永远不是非黑即白。
en: Modern warfare follows no rules, and loyalties are never black and white.

zh: 在我看来，冲突地区针对学校和教育工作者的暴力行为激增最能说明这一点。
en: For me, nothing illustrates this truth more terribly than the surge in violence directed at schools and educators in conflict areas.

zh: 今年5月，全球保护教育免遭袭击联盟将发布一份遭受攻击的教育情况报告，该报告证实战争和军事行动对教育造成的严重伤害正在超过近代记忆中的任何时候。
en: In May of this year, the Global Coalition to Protect Education from Attack will publish its “Education Under Attack” report, which confirms that wars and military engagements are affecting education more severely than any time in recent memory.

zh: 教育遭受影响的数据的确令人震惊。
en: The numbers are truly shocking.

zh: 全球约有8，000万儿童因暴力而无法上学。
en: Around the world, some 80 million children are unable to attend school because of violence.

zh: 仅2017年上半年，20个国家就发生了超过500起学校袭击事件，这一数据显著超过往年的水平。
en: In the first half of 2017, there were more than 500 attacks on schools in 20 countries, a significant increase from previous years.

zh: 据联合国报告，在其中的15个国家，政府军或叛乱部队攻占学校用于军事用途。
en: According to the United Nations, in 15 of those countries, government soldiers or rebel forces seized schools for military use.

zh: 出于显而易见的原因，以任何形式支持针对学校和教育工作者发动袭击的政府都必须被追责。
en: For obvious reasons, governments that support the targeting of schools and educators in any capacity must be held to account.

zh: 被迫生活在冲突地区的儿童本已在遭受苦难；如果暴力阻止他们学习，那就意味着双重悲剧将在他们身上发生。
en: Children forced to live in conflict zones are already suffering; when violence prevents them from learning, they suffer a double tragedy.

zh: 我们必须思考战争如何摧毁儿童教育工作。
en: Consider how completely a child’s education is uprooted by war.

zh: 例如，在叙利亚爆发目前的冲突前，那里的小学入学率曾经达到90%以上。
en: Before the current conflict in Syria, for example, the enrollment rate for primary school was above 90%.

zh: 而今天，在受战斗影响最严重的地区，小学入学率已经降到30%以下。
en: Today, in areas most affected by the fighting, it has dropped to below 30%.

zh: 在也门，随着战争和饥荒的爆发，6-9岁的失学儿童人数超过200万。
en: In Yemen, with war and famine raging, more than two million children between the ages of six and nine are out of school.

zh: 而在近700所由联合国负责管理的叙利亚、加沙、西岸、黎巴嫩和约旦的学校中，近年来近半数都曾有过至少一次遇袭或关闭的经历。
en: And nearly half of the 700 UN-administered schools in Syria, Gaza, the West Bank, Lebanon, and Jordan have been attacked or shut down at least once in recent years.

zh: 人道主义危机往往会强化政治意愿；他人，尤其是儿童，遭受不必要的痛苦将促使国际社会将资金和精力投入到缓解痛苦当中。
en: Humanitarian crises often produce a surge in political will; the needless suffering of others, and especially of children, pushes the international community to dedicate money and energy to ameliorating the misery.

zh: 但不幸的是，那样的慷慨很少能够支持受战争蹂躏地区的教育工作。
en: Unfortunately, that generosity rarely extends to supporting education in war-torn areas.

zh: 在全世界数百万失学儿童中，有1/4都生活在受危机影响的国家。
en: Of the millions of children not attending school around the world, one in four lives in a crisis-affected country.

zh: 但教育仅占人道主义援助总额的2 % ， 而仅有38%的紧急教育援助申请得到满足。
en: Yet, education accounts for just 2% of total humanitarian aid, while only 38% of emergency aid requests for education are met.

zh: 2000年4月，在达卡行动框架协议签署时，各签署国认为实现“全民教育”的“主要障碍”是冲突，而全民教育则被列入联合国可持续发展目标。
en: In April 2000, when the Dakar Framework for Action was adopted, signatories identified conflict as a “major barrier” to attaining the goal of “education for all,” one of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

zh: 该报告还表达了政府和民间社会团体必须尽可能迅速行动“重建被摧毁或被破坏的教育系统”的共识。
en: The report also expressed the consensus view that governments and civil-society groups must move swiftly to “reconstruct destroyed or damaged education systems” whenever possible.

zh: 那么，为什么在框架协议签署近20年后，人们才决心重建这一一直被忽视的因素？
en: Why, then, nearly two decades after the framework was signed, is this commitment to rebuilding routinely ignored?

zh: 教育是遭受冲突影响的家庭和国家恢复的关键要素。
en: Education is the key to recovery for households and countries hit by conflict.

zh: 学校教育每增加一年， 就读者的收入平均增长10 % ， 进而改善他们长期的财务稳定性，并有助于降低回归暴力的风险。
en: Each year of additional schooling increases a learner’s earnings by 10%, on average, improving their long-term financial stability, and helping to lower the risk of a return to violence.

zh: 换句话说，攻击教育实际上是攻击我们共同的未来。
en: In other words, as I explained at a recent panel organized by the Education Above All Foundation at the World Innovation Summit for Education (WISE), attacks on education are quite literally attacks on our collective future.

zh: 在受冲突影响地区，女孩失学的可能性是男孩的2.5倍 。
en: Girls are are 2.5 times more likely than boys to be out of school in conflict-affected areas.

zh: 但投资女孩能带来长远的好处，可以改变社区并消除贫困。
en: Yet investing in girls has long-term benefits that can transform communities and eradicate poverty.

zh: 受过教育的女孩不太可能在年纪很小的时候结婚，而更有可能生育更少、但更健康的子女。
en: Educated girls are less likely to marry at a young age, and more likely to have fewer, healthier children.

zh: 此外，参与劳动的女性将 90%的收入重新投入她们所在的社区当中。
en: Moreover, women in the workforce reinvest 90% of their incomes to their communities.

zh: 受暴力困扰并试图摆脱的国家或许没有财力在重建的同时重修学校。
en: Countries enduring and emerging from violence may not have the financial capacity to rebuild schools while simultaneously funding reconstruction.

zh: 这也告诉我们国际支持为什么如此重要。
en: That is why international support is so crucial.

zh: 国际社会必须筹集23亿美元来改善冲突地区的教育状况。
en: The global community must find the $2.3 billion needed to improve access to education in conflict zones.

zh: 与此同时，捐助者必须资助能为因战争压力而造成心理创伤的儿童提供帮助的机构。
en: At the same time, donors must fund institutions that will help children traumatized by the psychological stress of war.

zh: 对冲突地区的许多儿童来说，社会心理与情感支持与教育机会同样重要。
en: For many children in conflict areas, psychosocial and emotional support is as important as educational opportunity.

zh: 我侄女的图画书世界 — — 用20页来概括每一场斗争，并且结局都是“今后永远开心地生活 ” — —永远不会成为现实。
en: The world of my niece’s picture books – where every struggle in summarized in 20 pages and ends with a “happily ever after” – will never be reality.

zh: 但在没有仙女教母和保护女巫的情况下，世界需要可行的方案来帮助好人（和女童）获胜。
en: But, in the absence of fairy godmothers and protective witches, the world needs workable solutions that can help the good guys (and girls) win.

zh: 通过教育每个孩子，哪怕是那些受到伤害的孩子，我们或许可以成功地让这个世界变得不那么邪恶。
en: By educating every child, even those in harm’s way, we may succeed in making the world just a little less wicked.

zh: 失去的一代又一代
en: The Lost Generations

zh: 纽约—一国的经济成功取决于其国民的教育、技能和健康程度。
en: NEW YORK – A country’s economic success depends on the education, skills, and health of its population.

zh: 当一国年轻人身体健康、受到良好教育时，他们就能找到高薪工作，赢得尊严并成功地调整渡过全球劳动力市场的波动期。
en: When its young people are healthy and well educated, they can find gainful employment, achieve dignity, and succeed in adjusting to the fluctuations of the global labor market.

zh: 企业会增加投资，因为它们知道员工生产率很高。
en: Businesses invest more, knowing that their workers will be productive.

zh: 但世界上有许多国家没能应对好保证每一代儿童获得基本健康和优秀教育的挑战。
en: Yet many societies around the world do not meet the challenge of ensuring basic health and a decent education for each generation of children.

zh: 为何如此之多的国家不能很好地应对教育挑战？
en: Why is the challenge of education unmet in so many countries?

zh: 一些国家太穷，无法提供优质教育。
en: Some are simply too poor to provide decent schools.

zh: 父母亲自己也许也没有受过充分的教育，这让他们在孩子入学一两年之后便无力供养，这导致了文盲和科学盲代代相传。
en: Parents themselves may lack adequate education, leaving them unable to help their own children beyond the first year or two of school, so that illiteracy and innumeracy are transmitted from one generation to the next.

zh: 多子女家庭（比如有六七个孩子的家庭）的这一困境尤为突出，因为父母亲在每个孩子身上的卫生、营养和教育投资极为有限。
en: The situation is most difficult in large families (say, six or seven children), because parents invest little in the health, nutrition, and education of each child.

zh: 但发达国家也做得不好。
en: Yet rich countries also fail.

zh: 比如，美国残忍地对最贫困儿童的惨状熟视无睹。
en: The United States, for example, cruelly allows its poorest children to suffer.

zh: 穷人生活在贫民区，上烂学校。
en: Poor people live in poor neighborhoods with poor schools.

zh: 他们的父母亲通常是失业者、疾病缠身、离婚甚至入狱。
en: Parents are often unemployed, ill, divorced, or even incarcerated.

zh: 尽管总体而言美国已经进入了丰裕社会，但儿童却陷入了永恒的代际贫困循环。
en: Children become trapped in a persistent generational cycle of poverty, despite the society’s general affluence.

zh: 穷孩子通常最后会变成穷大人。
en: Too often, children growing up in poverty end up as poor adults.

zh: 令人瞩目的新纪录片《我所居住的房子 》 （ The House I Live In）表明，美国的情况甚至刚才我所描述的更凄惨、更残酷。
en: A remarkable new documentary film, The House I Live In, shows that America’s story is even sadder and crueler than that, owing to disastrous policies.

zh: 这一切都是拜灾难性的政策所赐。 大约40年前，美国政客开始“像毒品宣战 ” ， 表面上摆出杜绝致瘾药物（如可卡因）的姿态。
en: Starting around 40 years ago, America’s politicians declared a “war on drugs,” ostensibly to fight the use of addictive drugs like cocaine.

zh: 但是，正如该片所清楚显示的，毒品战争演变成了一场穷人战争，特别是针对贫穷少数族裔的战争。
en: As the film clearly shows, however, the war on drugs became a war on the poor, especially on poor minority groups.

zh: 事实上，毒品战争造成大量贫穷少数��裔青年入狱。
en: In fact, the war on drugs led to mass incarceration of poor, minority young men.

zh: 如今，美国时时刻刻都有约230万年轻人在蹲班房，其中相当数量是因贩卖毒品以解决自己的药瘾而被捕的穷人。
en: The US now imprisons around 2.3 million people at any time, a substantial number of whom are poor people who are arrested for selling drugs to support their own addiction.

zh: 结果，美国的入狱率为世界之最，平均每10万人中有令人咋舌的743人坐牢！
en: As a result, the US has ended up with the world’s highest incarceration rate – a shocking 743 people per 100,000!

zh: 该片描绘了一个噩梦般的世界，贫穷从一代人传给下一代，残酷的、费时费力的、事倍功半的“毒品战争”贯穿着整个过程。
en: The film depicts a nightmarish world in which poverty in one generation is passed on to the next, with the cruel, costly, and inefficient “war on drugs” facilitating the process.

zh: 穷人 — — 通常是非洲裔美国人 — — 在从军队退役后由于无一技之长和雇用合同而无法找到工作。
en: Poor people, often African-Americans, cannot find jobs or have returned from military service without skills or employment contacts.

zh: 他们陷入了贫穷，并转向了毒品。
en: They fall into poverty and turn to drugs.

zh: 他们没有获得社会和医疗补助，而是被逮捕入狱，打为重犯。
en: Instead of receiving social and medical assistance, they are arrested and turned into felons.

zh: 从此，他们便成为班房的常客，几乎不可能找到可以让他们摆脱贫困的合法工作。
en: From that point on, they are in and out of the prison system, and have little chance of ever getting a legal job that enables them to escape poverty.

zh: 他们的孩子在父母不在家的环境中长大，感受不到希望和支持。
en: Their children grow up without a parent at home – and without hope and support.

zh: 瘾君子的孩子通常自己也会变成瘾君子；也会成为班房常客、遭受暴力甚至早夭。
en: The children of drug users often become drug users themselves; they, too, frequently end up in jail or suffer violence or early death.

zh: 这一问题的疯狂之处在于美国对显而易见的一点视而不见，而且这一视而不见维持了40年。
en: What is crazy about this is that the US has missed the obvious point – and has missed it for 40 years.

zh: 为了打破贫穷循环，一国需要投资于儿童的未来，而不是每年将230万人投入班房 — — 他们中有许多都不是暴力罪犯，而是贫穷的受害者。
en: To break the cycle of poverty, a country needs to invest in its children’s future, not in the imprisonment of 2.3 million people a year, many for non-violent crimes that are symptoms of poverty.

zh: 许多政客是这一不正常现象的共谋。
en: Many politicians are eager accomplices to this lunacy.

zh: 他们煽动中产阶级的恐慌，特别是针对少数族裔的恐慌，将这一社会行为和政府支出的错误方向永久化。
en: They play to the fears of the middle class, especially middle-class fear of minority groups, to perpetuate this misdirection of social efforts and government spending.

zh: 基本要点是这样的：政府在保证所有年轻人 — — 不论贫富 — — 都拥有机会方面扮演着独一无二的角色。
en: The general point is this: Governments have a unique role to play to ensure that all young members of a generation – poor children as well as rich ones – have a chance.

zh: 穷孩子不可能在没有强力而有效的支持高质量教育、卫生保健和全面营养的政府计划的情况下摆脱自身和父母的贫穷状态。
en: A poor kid is unlikely to break free of his or her parents’ poverty without strong and effective government programs that support high-quality education, health care, and decent nutrition.

zh: 这才是“社会民主”的实质。 社会民主由斯堪的纳维亚国家率先实施，哥斯达黎加等许多发展中国家也已经推行。
en: This is the genius of “social democracy,” the philosophy pioneered in Scandinavia, but also deployed in many developing countries, such as Costa Rica.

zh: 其中的思想简单而有力：所有人都应该得到机会，而社会应该帮助所有人得到这个机会。
en: The idea is simple and powerful: All people deserve a chance, and society needs to help everybody to secure that chance.

zh: 最重要的是，家庭必须帮助儿童健康成长、完善营养、接受教育。
en: Most important, families need help to raise healthy, well-nourished, and educated children.

zh: 社会投资是巨大的，钱来自高税收 — — 富人得缴税，而不是逃税。
en: Social investments are large, financed by high taxes, which rich people actually pay, rather than evade.

zh: 这是打破贫穷代际传递的基本方法。
en: This is the basic method to break the intergenerational transmission of poverty.

zh: 瑞典的穷孩子从出生就可以享受福利。
en: A poor child in Sweden has benefits from the start.

zh: 孩子的双亲可以获得母亲/父亲产假以便于照顾婴儿。
en: The child’s parents have guaranteed maternity/paternity leave to help them nurture the infant.

zh: 政府还提供高质量的日托服务，以便母亲安心回到工作中去，不必担心孩子呆在不安全的环境中。
en: The government then provides high-quality day care, enabling the mother – knowing that the child is in a safe environment – to return to work.

zh: 政府保证所有孩子都能接受学前教育，让他们做好从6岁开始的学校教育的准备。
en: The government ensures that all children have a place in preschool, so that they are ready for formal schooling by the age of six.

zh: 医保也是普遍适用的，因此每个孩子都能健康成长。
en: And health care is universal, so the child can grow up healthy.

zh: 因此，比较一下美国和瑞典就很能说明问题。
en: A comparison of the US and Sweden is therefore revealing.

zh: 看一下经合组织所提供的可比数据和定义，美国贫困率为17.3 % ， 是瑞典的数字（8.4 % ） 的两倍有余。
en: Using comparable data and definitions provided by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, the US has a poverty rate of 17.3%, roughly twice Sweden’s poverty rate of 8.4%.

zh: 美国人入狱率是瑞典（10万人中有70人）的十倍。
en: And America’s incarceration rate is 10 times Sweden’s rate of 70 people per 100,000.

zh: 平均而言，美国比瑞典更富，但美国最富和最穷之间的收入差远大于瑞典，且美国对待穷人的态度是惩罚，而不是支持。
en: The US is richer on average than Sweden, but the income gap between America’s richest and poorest is vastly wider than it is in Sweden, and the US treats its poor punitively, rather than supportively.

zh: 近几年来出现的一个令人震惊的现实是美国的社会流动率在高收入国家中几乎垫底。
en: One of the shocking realities in recent years is that America now has almost the lowest degree of social mobility of the high-income countries.

zh: 生而平穷的孩子很可能死也贫穷，生而富足的孩子很可能死也富足。
en: Children born poor are likely to remain poor; children born into affluence are likely to be affluent adults.

zh: 这一代际演化导致了人力资源的大浪费。
en: This inter-generational tracking amounts to a profound waste of human talents.

zh: 从长期看，除非有所改变，否者美国将为此付出代价。
en: America will pay the price in the long term unless it changes course.

zh: 投资于儿童和年轻人可以为社会带来最高的回报，不管从经济学上说还是从人类学上说。
en: Investing in its children and young people provides the very highest return that any society can earn, in both economic and human terms.

zh: 数字时代的教育
en: Education in the Digital Age

zh: 东京—第四次工业革命与前几次有一个关键不同：技术不是让人类更便利地利用周边事物更有效地为自身利益服务，而是取代职场中的人。
en: TOKYO – The Fourth Industrial Revolution stands out from its predecessors in a critical way: rather than making it easier for humans to use their surroundings more effectively for their own benefit, technology is displacing humans in the workplace.

zh: 问题在于现在谁会从中获益。
en: The question is who will benefit now.

zh: 自动化或基于科技的服务能够提高公司的利润边际，也为用户带来比完全依靠人工生产更加廉价、更加方便、更加可靠的选择。
en: Automated or otherwise technology-enabled services can increase profit margins for companies, while representing for users cheaper, more convenient, or more reliable options than those produced exclusively by humans.

zh: 但这当然也给此前作为生产者的人带来了高昂的代价。
en: But, of course, this comes at a high cost for the humans who previously filled those roles.

zh: 全世界都接受了优步等拼车服务，这令传统出租车司机深受其害。
en: People all over the world have embraced ridesharing and transportation services like Uber, to the detriment of traditional taxi drivers.

zh: 当人工智能主管的无人驾驶汽车具备了性价比和可靠性时，优步和出租车司机都将成为明日黄花。
en: When artificial intelligence-enabled driverless cars become cost-effective and reliable, Uber and taxi drivers alike will become obsolete.

zh: 在股票交易方面，据耶鲁大学管理学院的张小虎的数据，如今有79%的市场交易系由软件完成，这表明机器有望能够比人类更有效地识别走势 — — 这也许导致了最近的股市回调。
en: In stock trading, 79% of market transactions are now performed by software, according to Frank Zhang of the Yale School of Management, reflecting the hope that machines will be able to identify patterns more effectively than a human could – a hope that may have contributed to the recent stock-market correction.

zh: 无论如何，这对于人类交易员不是什么好消息。
en: In any case, this doesn’t bode well for human traders.

zh: 我自己则发现只要对谷歌翻译做一些修改，就能得到不错的结果，因此剩下了不少翻译成本，不过这对我请来做翻译的研究生来说意味着收入损失。
en: I myself have saved on translation costs since realizing that, with some edits by me, Google Translate can work just fine, though this means lost income for the graduate students whom I used to hire the task.

zh: 同声传译员 — — 这是个高薪行业 — — 也许会对机器很快就能威胁他们的饭碗的看法嗤之以鼻，但机器学习在围棋等高度复杂的策略博弈中所取得的成功表明，机器的学习能力不容小觑。
en: While simultaneous interpreters – who occupy a high-paid profession – may scoff at the notion that machines will threaten their positions any time soon, the success of machine learning in highly complex strategic games like Go suggests that machines’ ability to learn should not be underestimated.

zh: 简言之，人工智能驱动的革命将产生赢家和输家。
en: In short, the AI-driven revolution will have its winners and losers.

zh: 要想成为赢家，一个关键点是不但要不免被新技术取代，还要利用它们所带来的新机会。
en: To win, it is vital not just to avoid being displaced by new technologies, but also to capitalize on the new opportunities they present.

zh: 这意味着投资于优步等尖端企业，韩裔日本产业家孙正义便是这么做的。
en: This might mean investing in cutting-edge businesses like Uber, as the Japanese-Korean industrialist Masayoshi Son has done.

zh: 或者，这意味着学习必要的知识和技能，保证获得一个能借助新经济东风的岗位。
en: Or it might mean acquiring the knowledge and skills needed to secure a job that takes advantage of this new economy.

zh: 这些应对之道不但对个人有意义，对作为一个整体的经济也有意义。
en: Such responses are good not just for individuals, but also for economies as a whole.

zh: 比如，对日本来说，开发人力资源是在人口老龄化和不断减少的时代支持增长的关键。
en: In Japan, for example, human-capital development is crucial to support growth as the population ages and shrinks.

zh: 这一过程很早就开始了：诺贝尔经济学奖得主詹姆斯·赫克曼（James Heckman）证明，儿童教育对于生产率具有很大影响。
en: And that process begins early: as the Nobel laureate economist James Heckman has shown, education of young children has a significant impact on productivity.

zh: 因此，首相安倍晋三宣布，从2019年开始生效的提高消费税中所增加的收入，要拿出一半用于学前教育投资。
en: That is why Prime Minister Shinzo Abe has announced that half of the extra revenues raised from the consumption-tax hike that will go into effect in 2019 will be invested in pre-school education.

zh: 为了让年轻人获得在变化的数字经济中实现发展所需要的工具，这类投资必须集中于改善教育质量。
en: To give young people the tools they will need to thrive in the changing digital economy, such investment must focus on improving the quality of education.

zh: 这意味着修订课程，从注重机械学习和直观计算转向注重批判性思维、沟通和领导力等技能。
en: That may mean transforming curricula to focus less on rote learning or straightforward calculation and more on skills like critical thinking, communication, and leadership.

zh: 今天的日本教育 — — 可能还包括韩国教育 — — 类似于“危险边缘 ” （ Jeopardy）游戏：知道的最多的人成为赢家。
en: Education in Japan today – and perhaps also in South Korea – is something like the game “Jeopardy”: the one who knows the most facts is the winner.

zh: 日本学生排名最著名的办法是用“偏差值 ” — —直译为“标准差 ” ， 它反映你在某所学校的某项以记忆公式和事实为重点的考试中，和典型学生的统计平均值的差距。
en: The best-known means by which Japanese students are ranked is hensachi – literally translated as “standard deviation” – which reflects how far from the statistical mean a typical student admitted to a given institution scores on a test focused on memorized formulas and facts.

zh: 具有高正偏差值分数的学生，能够进入更加严格的高中和大学，他们常常被鼓励学医，原因只是入学考试很难，丝毫不管他们对医学到底感不感兴趣。
en: Students with higher positive hensachi scores are admitted to more rigorous high schools and colleges, where they are often encouraged to study medicine, simply because the entrance exam is difficult, even if they have no interest in a medical career.

zh: 否则，他们会竞争最有影响力的部门的官员敢为 — — 如财政、经济、外交等 — — 或者竞争丰田和索尼等经营企业的升职快车道。
en: Otherwise, they compete to become bureaucrats at the most influential ministries – for example, finance, economy, or foreign affairs – or they try to get on the fast track to the top of elite firms like Toyota or Sony.

zh: 因此，偏差值分数决定了一个人的全部职业轨迹。
en: Hensachi scores thus determine people’s entire career trajectories.

zh: 高分意味着直到退休的优渥的生活。
en: High scores mean a comfortable life, all the way through retirement.

zh: 因此，日本学生从很小就感受到记忆信息的压力。
en: Given this, Japanese students feel pressured to memorize information from a very young age.

zh: 家长甚至会因为幼儿园和名牌大学有关系而搬家。
en: Parents will go so far as to move to a district where the kindergarten is linked to a renowned university.

zh: 这套制度并非始于日本。
en: This system did not begin in Japan.

zh: 相反，它脱胎于一直实施到二十世纪初的中国官僚查举制度。 这是一种精英治国的安排，因此要优于裙带关系，但它没有考虑一个事实：机械学习能力未必意味着创造力和聪明才智。
en: On the contrary, it is an outgrowth of the system for assessing and promoting Chinese bureaucrats that prevailed until the early twentieth century.While it is a form of meritocracy, and thus superior to nepotism, it fails to take into account the reality that a capacity for rote learning does not necessarily imply an aptitude for creativity or ingenuity.

zh: 即使的确如此，我们也可能无法发现创造力和聪明才智，因为记忆足够多信息以确保考试高分让人没有时间用于学习思考 — — 发展技能或培养才能为社会和国家做出真正贡献。
en: Even if it did, we might not find out, because memorizing enough information to secure high scores on assessments leaves little time to learn to think – to develop skills or foster talents that could amount to a real contribution to one’s community and country.

zh: 事实上，基于偏差值的制度非常不鼓励真正具有宝贵才华的人将他们的才华发展成为有用的技能。
en: In fact, a system based on hensachi actively discourages those who do have valuable talents from developing them into useful skills.

zh: 但在人工智能时代，这些才华和技能变得无比宝贵。
en: Yet, in the age of AI, those talents and skills are more valuable than ever.

zh: 第四次工业革命将对注重记忆事实、进行公式计算的日本教育制度构成严重考验 — — 这些领域正是人类绝对无法与智能机器竞争的领域。
en: The Fourth Industrial Revolution will amount to a major test for a Japanese education system focused on reciting facts and performing formulaic calculations – precisely the areas where humans cannot compete with intelligent machines.

zh: 尽管科技发展日新月异，但人类才智和创造力仍然无与伦比。
en: With all of our technological developments, human ingenuity and creativity remain unmatched.

zh: 我们应该尽可能多地发掘这些人才，让我们的年轻一代获得尽可能有效地运用内在优势的机会。
en: We should make the most of that, and give our young people the opportunity to use their innate advantages as effectively as possible.

zh: 亚洲发明繁荣
en: Asia’s Invention Boom

zh: 贝尔维尤，华盛顿—一个多世纪以来，美国一直是全球创新的主导力量。
en: BELLEVUE, WASHINGTON – For more than a century, the United States has been the dominant global force for innovation.

zh: 但中国和其他亚洲国家正在挑战美国的主导地位，而西方应该欢迎这种挑战。
en: But China and other Asian countries are now testing that dominance, and the West should welcome the challenge.

zh: 中国从模仿向创新的转变是近几年来的一项国家政策。
en: China’s move from imitation to innovation has been a matter of national policy in recent years.

zh: 比如，2011年，政府设立了一系列关于专利数量的宏伟目标。
en: In 2011, for example, the government established a set of ambitious targets for the production of patents.

zh: 而中国几乎马上就成为世界顶尖的专利申请国。
en: Almost immediately, China became the world’s top patent filer.

zh: 很快，中国在其他重要方面也超过了美国。
en: China soon surpassed the US in other important measures.

zh: 每年，中国大学所授予的理科和工科博士数量比美国机构更多 — — 而本科生数量更是超过美国一倍有余。
en: Each year, Chinese universities award more PhD’s in science and engineering than US institutions do – and more than twice as many undergraduate degrees in these fields.

zh: 此外，中国即将在研发投资方面超越美国。
en: Moreover, China is set to outpace the US in investment in research and development.

zh: 自2001年以来，中国研发支出以每年18%以上的速度增加，占GDP的比重更是翻了一番多。
en: Since 2001, China’s R&D expenditure has been growing by 18% annually and has more than doubled as a share of GDP.

zh: 在美国，这一比例则相对稳定。
en: In the US, that ratio has remained relatively constant.

zh: 诚然，这些指标很容易被操纵 — — 批评者往往很快就能指出这一点。
en: To be sure, such metrics can easily be manipulated – a fact that critics are quick to point out.

zh: 但来自美国国家科学基金会（US National Science Foundation）的数据表明了亚洲大部的真正创新动力。 东亚、南亚和东南亚国家的研发支出之和已经超过了美国。
en: But statistics from the US National Science Foundation reveal a genuine drive to innovate across much of Asia, with East, South, and Southeast Asian countries together spending more on R&D than the US.

zh: 而该地区技术密集型活动正在快速接近北美和西欧。
en: And technology-intensive activity in the region is fast approaching that of North America and Western Europe.

zh: 事实上，亚洲国家正在助推彼此的创新成功。
en: In fact, Asian countries are helping to fuel one another’s innovative success.

zh: 中国的发明计划之所以能产生如此快速的结果，部分是因为政府积极地与亚洲竞争对手展开合作。
en: China’s invention initiative has produced such rapid results in part because the government actively cooperates with its Asian competitors.

zh: 事实上，尽管存在领土纠纷和其他不和，但日本、韩国、中国以及（在更小程度上）新加坡和中国台湾的专利官员经常开会定义和协调彼此的知识产权政策。
en: Indeed, despite territorial disputes and other divisive issues, the commissioners of the patent offices of Japan, South Korea, China, and, to a lesser extent, Singapore and Taiwan meet often to define and coordinate their intellectual-property (IP) policies.

zh: 中国领导人知道他们可以从日本和韩国身上学习经验，后两者实施鼓励创新和保护知识产权的政策远远早于中国。
en: China’s leaders know that they can learn from countries like Japan and South Korea, which implemented policies to encourage innovation and protect IP rights long before China did.

zh: 亚洲知识产权扩张的到底有多大影响难以预测。
en: The precise impact of Asia’s IP expansion is impossible to predict.

zh: 但其转型潜力是显而易见的。
en: But its transformative potential is obvious.

zh: 可以说亚洲国家为数以万计的顶级专家提供了机会和激励去解决当今最紧迫挑战 — — 如发展高性价比可持续能源解决方案、确保老龄化人口看得起病，以及改善过度拥挤的城市的生活质量等。
en: Asian countries are essentially giving tens of thousands of top minds the opportunities and incentives to tackle today’s most pressing challenges, such as developing cost-effective sustainable-energy solutions, ensuring affordable health care for aging populations, and improving the quality of life in overcrowded cities.

zh: 这些复杂问题需要大量创新型人才和长期国际合作 — — 不仅仅是找到解决办法，也要实施这些办法。
en: These complex problems demand a plurality of innovative talent and long-term international collaboration – not just to find solutions, but also to deploy them.

zh: 在日益依靠知识的全球经济中，伙伴关系与合作将是自然法则。
en: In an increasingly knowledge-based global economy, partnerships and cooperation will be the natural order.

zh: 在这样的背景下，西方阻挠亚洲知识产权崛起是相当愚蠢的。
en: In this context, the West would be foolish to resist Asia’s IP emergence.

zh: 相反，西方政府应该支持、学习并摘取东方发明繁荣的果实。
en: Instead, Western governments should support, learn from, and reap the rewards of the invention boom in the East.

zh: 比如，在将创新产品引入市场方面领先全球的美国应该为中国创新性大学和小公司提供商业化渠道。
en: For example, the US, which leads the world in bringing innovative products to the market, should offer commercialization channels to innovative Chinese universities and small companies.

zh: 中国和西方公司应该被鼓励投资彼此的知识产权。
en: And Chinese and Western companies should be encouraged to invest in one another’s IP.

zh: 这样的合作已经开始了。
en: Such cooperation has already begun.

zh: 比如，2008年，告高智发明公司（Intellectual Ventures，我也参与了创立）在中国和其他创新文化方兴未艾的国家展开经营活动，以便关注这些国家发明者的才华和能量。
en: For example, in 2008 Intellectual Ventures (which I helped found) established a presence in China and other countries with emerging innovation cultures in order to focus their inventors’ talent and energy.

zh: 由此产生了包括400多家机构和4,000多个活跃发明者在内的全球网络，它所申请的专利比许多研发密集型公司还要多。
en: The resulting global network of more than 400 institutions and over 4,000 active inventors has produced more patent applications than many R&D-intensive companies do.

zh: 在这一生态系统中，人人都是赢家。
en: In this ecosystem, everyone wins.

zh: 发明者能获得公司在知识产权开发方面的专家经验，加入由经验丰富的问题解决者组成的国际社区。
en: The inventors gain access to the company’s expertise in IP development and to an international community of experienced problem-solvers.

zh: 高智发明公司对有价值的方案做股权投资。
en: Intellectual Ventures gets a stake in valuable solutions.

zh: 世界都会因这些方案受益。
en: And the world benefits from those solutions.

zh: 试想一下，如果有更多的类似项目会怎样 — — 不仅由公司发起，也可以由政府发起。
en: Imagine if more such initiatives were launched, not only by companies, but also by governments.

zh: 合作方法有助于改善陷入麻烦的亚洲和西方的交易动态 — — 一个显著特征是西方对中国执行知识产权法律不力十分不满。
en: A cooperative approach could help to improve the troubled trade dynamics between Asia and the West, characterized by disagreement over China’s lax enforcement of IP laws.

zh: 西方不应该棒杀，而是可以提供激励鼓励中国成为现有知识产权机制中的负责任的行为人。
en: Instead of shaking its fist, the West could provide incentives that encourage China to become a responsible actor in the existing IP regime.

zh: 这些激励可以包括（比如）为数以万计靠盗版为生的中国公司组织可行的替代方案。
en: These could include, for example, efforts to organize viable alternatives to piracy for the tens of thousands of Chinese companies that currently earn a living from it.

zh: 一些西方企业家已经将这些所谓的“山寨”企业转变为 为它们的原型产品提供量产服务的企业，创造了一种跨境Kickstarter文化。
en: Some Western entrepreneurs already turn to these so-called Shan Zhai enterprises to manufacture their prototypes at scale, creating a kind of cross-border Kickstarter culture.

zh: 最终，许多山寨公司将携自己的知识产权演化为合法企业。
en: Eventually, many Shan Zhai companies will evolve into legitimate businesses with their own IP.

zh: 由于亚洲国家在更多自身利益牵涉其中时自然会更有力地支持和保护知识产权，因此西方应该找到加快这一转变的方法。
en: Given that Asian countries naturally will uphold and defend IP rights more vigorously when they have more at stake, the West should look for ways to hasten this transition.

zh: 西方也可以借鉴亚洲国家正在做的各种模式的提升国内创新的实验。
en: The West can also take some lessons from the various models Asian countries are experimenting with as they ramp up domestic innovation.

zh: 在韩国，LG公司最近提出了一项计划，从公众那里征求创新思想，承诺如若公司将发明项目商业化，则发明人能获得此过程中高达8%的权益。
en: In South Korea, LG recently launched a program to solicit invention ideas from the public, promising inventors a hefty 8% stake in the proceeds of any ideas the company commercializes.

zh: 这或许是许多美国公司从未想象过的办法。
en: That is probably not an approach that many American companies have considered.

zh: 但它们应该想到。
en: But maybe they should.

zh: 亚洲也在试验创新性创新融资办法，比如中国的知识产权交易所和马来西亚的知识产权贷款计划。
en: Asia is also experimenting with creative ways to finance innovation, such as China’s IP exchanges and Malaysia’s IP loan programs.

zh: 西方应该关注这些举措，因为它们可以为发现创新和创新融资提供传统方式（往往结果平平，如风险资本）之外的替代方案。
en: The West should pay attention to these efforts, because they could offer alternatives to traditional avenues for sourcing and financing invention, such as venture capital, that are producing lackluster results.

zh: 最后，西方公司应该乐于为出售创新产品的中国企业提供投入品。
en: Finally, Western companies should be willing to supply inputs to Chinese businesses selling innovative products.

zh: 这一建议可能有些激进，但这只是因为从西方向东方的单向创新流动的观念过于根深蒂固。
en: This recommendation may seem radical, but only because the view of a one-way flow of innovation from West to East has become so entrenched.

zh: 事实上，当亚洲频频出现神童企业家和高科技创业公司时，西方企业没有理由袖手旁观。
en: In fact, there is no good reason for Western businesses to stand on the sidelines as Asia produces whiz-kid entrepreneurs and high-tech start-ups.

zh: 这些先锋正在建立各个层面都有入口的生态系统，而西方不应该错过每一个入口。
en: These pioneers are building ecosystems with points of entry at every level, and the West should enter at all of them.

zh: 随着亚洲创新自主性的不断增强，美国和其他发达国家必须找到参与办法 — — 否则就有可能在徒劳地试图掌握已成过去的主导权的过程中措施世纪良机。
en: As Asian innovation comes into its own, the US and other developed countries must find ways to participate – or risk missing the opportunity of the century in a vain bid to recapture bygone supremacy.

zh: 误导性指标
en: Misleading Indicators

zh: 贝尔维尤，华盛顿州 — “ 如果你不能测量它，你就不能管理它。
en: BELLEVUE, WASHINGTON – “If you can’t measure it, you can’t manage it.”

zh: ”这就是国内生产总值和其他显示全球国家级经济体健康程度的总量指标背后的智慧。
en: That is the wisdom behind metrics like gross domestic product and other aggregate indicators that signal the health of national economies around the world.

zh: 几十年来，决策者和规划者用这些数字帮助他们理解如何指导国内经济增长。
en: Policymakers and planners have used these numbers for decades to help them understand how to guide domestic economic growth.

zh: 但依赖GDP和其他传统指标可能有害于一个急切追寻的目标：蒸蒸日上的创新经济的发展情况。
en: But reliance on GDP and other traditional indicators may be sabotaging a keenly sought goal: the development of thriving innovation economies.

zh: 如今，一些信息技术部门的关键部分很少出现在国民账户中。
en: Today, some vital parts of the information-technology sector barely register in the national accounts.

zh: 尽管GDP测量一国国内生产的所有商品和服务，但数字时代的许多明星企业（如维基百科、Facebook、Twitter、Mozilla、网景和其他）并不生产产品，并且提供的是免费服务。
en: While GDP measures the market value of all goods and services produced within a country, many stars of the digital age (think Wikipedia, Facebook, Twitter, Mozilla, Netscape, and so on) produce no goods and provide free services.

zh: 这些明星企业还总是削弱传统企业的生产率。
en: These same star players also tend to undercut the productivity of traditional businesses.

zh: 免费导航应用让曾经位列美国成长最快公司行列的GPS先锋Garmin公司销售额暴跌。
en: Free navigation apps have shrunk sales for Garmin, the GPS pioneer that was once one of the fastest-growing companies in the United States.

zh: Skype以“每次一分钟”的速度扼杀着越洋电话。
en: Skype is killing the international phone call “one minute at a time.”

zh: 这些发展趋势表莫名需要新能够识别新企业类型的新增长指标。
en: These developments point to the need for new growth metrics that recognize new kinds of enterprise.

zh: 而由于这些指标关注创新，因此还必须是前瞻性的。
en: And, because these metrics concern innovation, they should be forward-looking as well.

zh: 决策者需要理解如何建立、管理从而测量鼓励创新在某地区集结并促进该地区后续繁荣的条件。
en: Policymakers need to understand how to establish, manage, and thus measure the conditions that encourage innovators to flock to a region and forge a prosperous future there.

zh: 创新指标必须在新思想具有传统测量手段下的盈利能力前多年就识别出它们的价值。
en: Innovation metrics must capture the value of new ideas years before those ideas become profitable in traditionally measured ways.

zh: 发展中世界对这类指标的需求尤其迫切。
en: The need for such metrics is especially urgent in the developing world.

zh: 新兴经济体都使用外国直接投资（FDI）作为测量进步的基准。
en: Emerging economies commonly use foreign direct investment (FDI) as a yardstick to measure progress.

zh: 这一指标在发展的早期阶段很有意义：贫穷的经济体需要外国资本建设工厂、培训工人以及让普通公民兜里有钱。
en: That metric makes sense in the early stages of development: poor economies need foreign capital to build factories, train workers, and put money in the pockets of ordinary citizens.

zh: 但外国投资往往流向了低风险、地利润率的项目：钢铁厂、水泥厂等。
en: But foreign investment most often goes to low-risk, low-margin projects: iron foundries, cement plants, and so forth.

zh: 相反，创新是高风险、高回报的活动。
en: Innovation, by contrast, is a high-risk, high-reward effort.

zh: 即使是大型跨国公司也不会一开始就像新思想投入大笔资金。
en: Even big multinationals do not put a lot of money into a new idea at first.

zh: 明天最具破坏力的创新对今天的FDI或GDP可能毫无影响。
en: Tomorrow’s most disruptive innovation may have no effect on FDI or GDP today.

zh: 因此，对于中国、印度和巴西等正在寻求实现国内创新文化起跳的国家，FDI目标实际上妨碍了政府规划者接触最有可能以创造性思维看待问题人和公司。
en: Thus, for countries like China, India, and Brazil that are trying to jump-start their domestic innovation cultures, FDI targets actually prevent government planners from reaching out to the people and companies that are most likely to take creative approaches to problems.

zh: 那么，从宏观经济数据角度看，有价值的创新在其成长为下一个谷歌、拜耳、保时捷或阿里巴巴之前是怎样一副模样？
en: So what does valuable innovation look like, in terms of macroeconomic data, years before it gives rise to the next Google, Bayer, Porsche, or Alibaba?

zh: 什么数字能最好地刻画处于初期阶段的蓬勃发展的创新生态系统？
en: What numbers best characterize a thriving innovation ecosystem in its birth stages?

zh: 我们已经知道了一些关键要素。
en: We already know some of the essential ingredients.

zh: 它们包括顶级人才、历史记录卓越的连续创业家、得到名声显赫的资本支持的创业企业，以及受知识产权权利保护的突破性产品。
en: They include top-level talent, serial entrepreneurs with good track records, start-ups backed by reputable capital, and breakthrough products protected by intellectual-property rights.

zh: 我们公司的分析师最近研究了能否量化这些要素。
en: Analysts at my company recently investigated whether these ingredients could be quantified.

zh: 我们的初步结论是肯定的。
en: Our preliminary results suggest that they can.

zh: 比如，我们了解到，在当今最成功的五家信息技术部门创业企业中，在它们存在的第三年底表现出两大共同特征：它们都递交了不止一项专利，得到不止一家顶级风险资本的投资。
en: For example, we learned that five of today’s most successful start-ups in the information-technology sector had two attributes in common by the end of their third year in business: they had filed more than one patent and been funded by more than one top venture-capital firm.

zh: 在此后的年份中，这五家公司的累计收入比随机选择的创业企业高六倍。
en: In subsequent years, these five companies’ cumulative revenue was six times higher than that of start-ups chosen at random.

zh: 经济学家可以对这一分析进行扩展，开发出年轻创新经济体的关键绩效指标。
en: Economists could extend such analyses to develop a set of key performance indicators for young innovation economies.

zh: 政府可以使用这些创新指标遴选出未来成功潜力最大的创业企业、人才和产品。
en: Governments could then use these innovation metrics to identify start-ups, talent, and products with the strongest potential for future success.

zh: 这一方法可以应用于任何高科技孵化工程（不管在发展中世界还是在发达世界 ） 。 目前，这些孵化工程的唯一测量指标就是钱。
en: This approach could be applied to any high-tech incubator project – within or beyond the developing world – that currently measures success only in dollars.

zh: 当然，这些指标只能提高成功的概率，决不是灵丹妙药。
en: Of course, such metrics would merely improve the odds of succeeding, not point to a sure thing.

zh: 创新经济体永远需要对大量潜在对象进行投资以产生极少数大赢家最终构成成熟生态系统的基石。
en: Innovation economies will always require investments in a multitude of prospects to produce the few big winners that will ultimately anchor the mature ecosystem.

zh: 但成功概率哪怕只是微小增加，如果这意味着带来两家 — — 而不是一家或一家都没有 — — 苹果或三星，也已经是善莫大焉。
en: But even a modest improvement in odds will deliver outsize results if it means landing two Apples or Samsungs rather than one – or none.

zh: 改变我们对经济价值的看法并不容易。
en: Changing how we think about economic value will not be easy.

zh: 但GDP增长陷入停滞的国家 — — 越来越多的国家进入了这一范畴 — — 也许会欢迎能够显示真正的进站信号的指标。
en: Yet countries where GDP has been flagging – an ever-increasing cohort – might welcome new metrics that can show signs of real progress.

zh: 而决策者和规划者也日益认识到，创新人才和企业家技能等虚拟资产仍在一国财富中占据着越来越大的比重。
en: And there is a growing awareness among policymakers and planners that virtual assets like creative talent and entrepreneurial skill make up an increasing portion of a country’s wealth.

zh: 去年夏天，美国经济分析局（Bureau of Economic Analysis）修改了GDP的定义，以使其更好地反映知识产权和研发对生产率和经济活力的贡献。
en: The US Bureau of Economic Analysis acknowledged as much last summer when it changed the definition of GDP to represent better the contributions of intellectual property and research and development to productivity and economic vitality.

zh: 更广地改革GDP的努力 — — 包括经合组织和欧盟发起的计划 — — 试图将可持续性、生活标准和其他一国福利的重要方面也囊括进来。
en: Broader efforts to reform GDP, including initiatives sponsored by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development and the European Commission, seek to encompass sustainability, living standards, and other important aspects of a country’s wellbeing.

zh: 新经济思想研究所（ Institute for New Economic Thinking）等集团正在领衔研究创新经济学，从而为这方面的努力提供数据和分析。
en: Groups like the Institute for New Economic Thinking are championing the study of innovation economics to provide data and analyses for these efforts.

zh: 正如前美联储主席伯南克在2011年的一次讲话中所指出的 ， “ 如果我们能够更有效地测量创新行为、了解它们在经济增长中的作用，我们就更能促进这类行为。 ”
en: As former US Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke noted in a 2011 speech, “We will be more likely to promote innovative activity if we are able to measure it more effectively and document its role in economic growth.”

zh: 事实上，帮助各国推动创新的指标能够改变我们对经济增长的理解。 政府想要这些指标。
en: In fact, metrics that help countries drive innovation could change our very understanding of economic growth.

zh: 经济需要这些指标。 全球社会能从这些指标中获益。
en: Governments want them, economies need them, and the global community will benefit from them.

zh: 宏观经济学应该为如何测量二十一世纪创新家的雄心设计相应指标。
en: It is time for macroeconomics to measure up to the ambitions of twenty-first-century innovators.

zh: 天才将军
en: The Ingenious General

zh: 华盛顿 — — 如果沙龙从未进入政坛，他依然会是世界闻名的军事指挥官和战术家。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Had Ariel Sharon never entered politics, he would still be known around the world as a military commander and tactician.

zh: 在这两方面他都具有非凡的才能，因为他的方法即使在超乎常规的以色列军队也迥异于常规的军事行动。
en: In both roles, he was extraordinary, because his methods diverged from normal military practices, even in the unconventional Israeli army.

zh: 以赎罪日战争为例。
en: Consider the Yom Kippur War.

zh: 1973年10月16日，埃及军队跨越苏伊士运河、奇袭以色列十天后。 沙龙率部通过埃及前线一条狭窄的缝隙跨过运河，一举将失败变成了胜利。
en: On October 16, 1973, ten days after Egypt’s army surprised the Israelis by crossing the Suez Canal, Sharon turned defeat into victory by leading his own troops across the canal through a narrow gap in the Egyptian front.

zh: 以色列人迅速在埃军后方散开，占领防空炮台并阻断给养和增援线路。
en: The Israelis swiftly spread out behind the Egyptians, overrunning anti-aircraft batteries and blocking supply and reinforcement routes.

zh: 短短六天内，埃及总统萨达特被迫请求立即、无条件停火：太多的埃及部队被拦腰截断，无法躲避空袭和地面炮火，或者被完全包围，以致于没有大部队能阻止以色列人进攻 — — 甚至无法保卫通往开罗的道路。
en: Within six days, Egyptian President Anwar Sadat had to plead for an immediate, unconditional ceasefire: so many Egyptian units were cut off, wrecked by air strikes, under attack, or fully encircled that no major forces were left to stop the advancing Israelis – not even to guard the road to Cairo.

zh: 埃及最高统帅部相信沙龙的渡河不过是小股部队的连夜突袭行动。
en: The Egyptian high command was convinced that Sharon’s crossing was only an overnight raid by light forces.

zh: 他们的理由似乎也合情合理：以色列不可能组织起超过几百人、数辆坦克的首波突袭，因为他们甚至控制不了运河的己方一侧。
en: Their reasoning was sound: The Israelis did not control even their own side of the canal, so they could not possibly reinforce the first wave of a few hundred men with a handful of tanks.

zh: 埃及统帅部认为与其撤回运河对岸追击偷袭的以色列人，还不如让埃军互相靠拢、填补被沙龙所用的两英里缺口就能全数俘获以军。
en: Rather than pulling their units back across the canal to chase the raiding Israelis, the Egyptian commanders believed that their forces could capture all of them by converging toward one another, thus closing the two-mile gap that Sharon had exploited.

zh: 沙龙的上司也赞同埃及对手的看法。
en: Sharon’s superiors agreed with their Egyptian counterparts.

zh: 他们命令沙龙停止派军渡河，而是全力扩大运河以方一侧的缺口。
en: They ordered Sharon to stop sending forces across the canal, and instead to widen the gap on the Israeli side.

zh: 沙龙借口通讯困难没有服从，同时派尽可能多的部队渡河。
en: Sharon did not obey, pleading communications difficulties while sending as many of his forces as possible across the canal.

zh: 他料定从后方袭击埃及人 — — 摧毁他们阻碍以空军进攻的导弹阵地、伏击援军和物资、在前线制造大规模混乱 — — 可能导致埃及军队出现组织上的崩溃。
en: He calculated that attacking the Egyptians from their own rear – destroying the missile batteries that impeded the Israeli air force, ambushing reinforcements and supplies, and simply causing massive confusion across the entire front – would induce organizational collapse in the Egyptian army.

zh: 事实果然不出所料。
en: That is exactly what happened.

zh: 但这让沙龙的同胞将军们大为光火，这种情况以前也屡次出现过。
en: But Sharon’s fellow generals were furious at him, as was often the case.

zh: 1953年年方25岁的沙龙已经在1947-49年独立战争中因伤退伍，之后又被重新召回现役，组建以色列的首支突击队。
en: In 1953, at the age of 25 and already a wounded veteran of the 1947-49 War of Independence, Sharon was recalled to active duty to establish Israel’s first commando unit.

zh: 阿拉伯入侵者穿过以色列疏于防御的边界抢掠牲畜窃取农具，有时甚至袭击以色列平民。
en: Arab raiders were crossing Israel’s unfenced borders to rob cattle and steal farm implements, sometimes attacking civilians.

zh: 守卫以色列漫长的边境线的任务需要20倍的军力才能完成。
en: Guarding Israel’s elongated borders would have required 20 times more troops than Israel had.

zh: 因此以色列选择对埃及约旦军事哨所进行惩罚性袭击并扫荡窝藏掠夺者的村庄。
en: So Israel chose to mount punitive raids against Egyptian and Jordanian military outposts and villages that harbored marauders.

zh: 沙龙得到授权放手组织训练自己的部队。
en: Sharon was given a free hand to raise and train his unit.

zh: 沙龙并不强调纪律，他手下的战士爱穿什么就穿什么、不向任何人敬礼也从不出操。
en: Instead of insisting on discipline, his men wore whatever they liked, never saluted anybody, and never drilled.

zh: 但这支部队能对最精锐的阿拉伯军队约旦阿拉伯军团发动毁灭性夜袭而自己很少伤亡。
en: But they launched devastating night raids while suffering few casualties, even when going up against Jordan’s Arab Legion, by far the best Arab military force.

zh: 沙龙要的是天生的战士而不是忠诚的士卒。 他为每次夜袭都制定了详尽计划，每次都会派人深入到远远超过袭击目标的敌后去伏击增援部队。
en: Sharon sought natural fighters rather than dutiful soldiers, and he carefully planned each raid, always sending some men well beyond the target of the attack to ambush any reinforcements.

zh: 主力部队在黑暗掩护下无声无息地���着目标迫近，直到被敌人发现再全力冲锋，所有武器一齐开火。 而迫击炮和机枪阵地会留在部队身后，其火力恰好覆盖冲锋部队的前方。
en: The main assault force advanced toward the target in the darkness until detected, then rushed forward, firing every weapon, while mortar and machine-gun emplacements remained in the rear, firing just ahead of the advancing troops.

zh: 短短三年内沙龙就指挥一个旅参与了1956年的西奈战斗。 他率领全旅官兵快速穿越沙漠与空降到埃及腹地守卫森严的米特拉山口的伞兵营汇合。
en: Within three years, Sharon commanded an entire brigade in the 1956 Sinai campaign, which he led in a swift advance across the desert to link up with a paratroop battalion that had been dropped deep into Egyptian territory at the entrance to the strongly defended Mitla Pass.

zh: 按照命令沙龙本该在那里止步，但他却没有，而是浴血奋战夺取了米特拉山口。
en: There Sharon was to stop but did not, instead fighting a bloody battle to conquer the pass.

zh: 他的顶头上司想将他赶出部队，但最高领导层却提拔他担任师指挥官。
en: His immediate superiors wanted him out, but the top leadership instead promoted him to command a division.

zh: 沙龙因此在1967年6月战争中策划并指挥了乌姆卡提夫那次非同寻常的战斗。
en: That is how Sharon came to plan and fight the extraordinary battle of Umm Katef in the June 1967 war.

zh: 这次战斗只持续了一个晚上，但其复杂性却是独一无二的。
en: The battle lasted only one night, but it was unique in its complexity.

zh: 埃及守军用配备火炮的防御工事和一百多辆坦克封锁了穿越西奈半岛的中央公路，并在正面设置了三条平行战壕，并由依托沙丘掩体及两侧制高点的数千名步兵把守。
en: The Egyptian defenses blocked the central highway across the Sinai with a fortified box containing powerful artillery and more than a hundred tanks, fronted by three parallel trench-lines manned by thousands of infantrymen and anchored on sand dunes and high ground at each end.

zh: 沙龙让部队翻越沙丘进入战壕内部，从天而降袭击对手 — — 如果没有遭到密集的炮火牵制和以色列坦克的正面袭击，埃及人本来可以挫败这次简单的行动。
en: Sharon had his troops climb over the sand dunes to enter the trench lines at their top end and attack down their length – a simple maneuver that the Egyptians could have defeated had they not been pinned down by an artillery barrage and Israeli tanks firing directly at them.

zh: 以色列步兵将手电贴在自己的头盔上，这样坦克射手就能将炮火瞄准前面的埃及人。
en: The Israeli infantrymen had taped flashlights to their helmets so that the tank gunners could direct their fire at the Egyptians just ahead of them.

zh: 但埃及炮兵仍然颇具优势，而且至少应该可以压制向战壕开火的以色列坦克。
en: Still, the Egyptian artillery was superior, and should have at least silenced the tanks firing at the trench line.

zh: 但从直升机上跳下的以军伞兵却出其不意地袭击埃及炮手，这些炮手在贴身肉搏中根本没有机会胜出。
en: But paratroopers, flown in by helicopters, suddenly jumped the Egyptian gun crews, who never had a chance in hand-to-hand combat.

zh: 埃及坦克本来仍可以发起反攻，但他们被战壕后面冒出来的一个以色列坦克营缠住，这个坦克营不知怎样越过了被认为不可逾越的沙丘。
en: The Egyptians’ tanks could still have counter-attacked, but they were engaged by an Israeli tank battalion that appeared from well behind the trench lines, having crossed supposedly impassable sand dunes.

zh: 之后刚刚朝战壕开火的以军坦克从这几辆坦克的上面开进防御工事，彻底粉碎了埃军的抵抗行动。
en: Then the Israeli tanks that had been shooting up the trench lines crossed over them to enter the box, and finish off Egyptian resistance.

zh: 通过乌姆卡提夫的道路因此被打开了。
en: The road through Umm Katef was opened.

zh: 沙龙又一次打破了战争的基本法则，但依然大获全胜。
en: Sharon had once again broken the basic rules of warfare, yet won total victory.

zh: 但即使在超乎常规的以色列军队，沙龙也太标新立异了。
en: But, even for the unconventional Israeli army, Sharon was too unconventional.

zh: 当他在争夺陆军参谋长的角逐中落败并退出现役时（参加1973年史诗战争时他的身份是预备役 ） ， 一位明智的以色列将领就告诫同事他会回来担任国防部长，而如果他没能当上国防部长（就像1982年黎巴嫩战争中所出现的状况 ） ， 他就会担任以色列总理职务。
en: When he was passed over for promotion to Army Chief of Staff and retired from active duty (he fought his epic 1973 battle as a reservist), a wise Israeli general warned his colleagues that he would return as Defense Minister, and that if he lost that office – as he did after the 1982 Lebanon War – he would return as Prime Minister.

zh: 直到现在沙龙才遭遇了他无法智取的敌人。
en: Only now has Sharon met an enemy that he cannot outmaneuver.

zh: 斯诺登定时炸弹
en: The Snowden Time Bomb

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 全球金融危机发生后，各国领导人不断重复着宽慰民众的口头禅。
en: PRINCETON – In the aftermath of the global financial crisis, world leaders repeated a soothing mantra.

zh: 货币政策的明显改善（事实的确如此）以及国际合作制度化的长足进步确保了大萧条不会再次上演。
en: There could be no repeat of the Great Depression, not only because monetary policy was much better (it was), but also because international cooperation was better institutionalized.

zh: 但一位名叫爱德华·斯诺登的美国前情报部门承包商已经证实这种说法距离现实有多远。
en: And yet one man, the American former intelligence contractor Edward Snowden, has shown how far removed from reality that claim remains.

zh: 长时间的紧张局势会削弱机构合作。
en: Prolonged periods of strain tend to weaken the fabric of institutional cooperation.

zh: 2008-2009年最具活力和成效的两家机构是国际货币基金组织（IMF）和G-20，但两者的信誉在漫长的危机进程中均有所削弱。
en: The two institutions that seemed most dynamic and effective in 2008-2009 were the International Monetary Fund and the G-20; the credibility of both has been steadily eroded over the long course of the crisis.

zh: 由于主要工业经济体似有复苏之势（尽管势头非常微弱 ） ， 似乎没有人在意合作机制已经老化失效。
en: Because the major industrial economies seem to be on the path to recovery – albeit a feeble one – no one seems to care very much that the mechanisms of cooperation are worn out.

zh: 这当然不对。
en: They should.

zh: 世界各国可能发生更多金融火灾，因此需要消防队来完成灭火工作。
en: There are likely to be many more financial fires in various locations, and the world needs a fire brigade to put them out.

zh: 2009年国际货币基金组织的资源得到了拓展，该组织本应持续改革强化新兴市场发言权。
en: The IMF’s resources were extended in 2009, and the organization was supposed to be reformed in order to give emerging markets more voice.

zh: 但这方面的改革却一直没有多大进展。
en: But little progress has been made.

zh: IMF是后1945年全球经济体系的核心机构。
en: The Fund was the centerpiece of the post-1945 global economic system.

zh: 它在20世纪80年代的债务危机管理以及1989年开始的后共产主义经济转型中均发挥了核心作用。
en: It subsequently played a central role in the management of the 1980’s debt crisis and in the post-communist economic transition after 1989.

zh: 但其后的每一次重要国际金融危机都削弱了基金组织的权威性。
en: But every major international crisis since then has chipped away at its authority.

zh: 1997-1998年的亚洲金融危机动摇了其在亚洲的合法地位，因为很多亚洲政府认为危机受到了美国和美国金融机构的利用。
en: The 1997-1998 Asian financial crisis undermined its legitimacy in Asia, as many governments in the region believed that the crisis was being exploited by the United States and US financial institutions.

zh: 三个原因导致IMF的信誉在后2007年大萧条中进一步受损。
en: The post-2007 Great Recession discredited the IMF further for three reasons.

zh: 首先，危机的初始阶段看似只与美国相关。
en: First, the initial phase of the crisis looked like an American phenomenon.

zh: 其次，IMF频繁介入长期欧元危机似乎是对欧洲和欧洲人另眼相看。
en: Second, the IMF’s heavy involvement in the prolonged euro crisis looked like preferential treatment of Europe and Europeans.

zh: 特别是有人提出要求，称因为整个世界都在关注欧洲，因此另一名欧洲人（而且是另一名法国人）应当接替时任总裁多米尼克·斯特劳斯－卡恩在IMF的领导地位在新兴市场大国看来简直不可理喻。
en: In particular, the demand that, because the world was focused on Europe, another European (and another French national) should succeed the IMF’s then-managing director, Dominique Strauss-Kahn, was incomprehensible to the large emerging-market countries.

zh: 最终就像亚洲危机时一样，欧洲政府和欧盟委员会与IMF闹翻，开始责怪该组织的分析困扰并搅乱了市场。
en: Eventually, as in the Asian crisis, European governments and the European Commission fell out with the Fund and began to blame its analysis for having confused and unsettled markets.

zh: 在造成全球金融危机的经常账户失衡、决定哪些国家应该调整以及协调金融改革及增长议程等重大问题上，IMF的话语权与危机前相比并没有多少进步。
en: On the big issues underlying the global financial crisis – the problem of current-account imbalances and deciding which countries should adjust, and reconciling financial reform with a pro-growth agenda – the IMF cannot say much more, or say it more effectively, than it could before the crisis.

zh: G-20是金融危机的大赢家。
en: The G-20 was the great winner of the financial crisis.

zh: 原有的峰会（G-7或者加上俄罗斯的G-8 ） ， 还有G-7财长会议，都已经失去了合法地位。
en: The older summits (the G-7 or, with the addition of Russia, the G-8), as well as the G-7 finance ministers’ meetings, were no longer legitimate.

zh: 它们当中包含了实际造成问题的国家；无法摆脱美国的控制；中等欧洲国家得到过度代表的现象十分严重。
en: They consisted of countries that had actually caused the problems; they were dominated by the US; and they suffered from heavy over-representation of mid-sized European countries.

zh: 相反，G-20引入了新兴市场大国，并且在开始时承诺要控制和引导IMF。
en: The G-20, by contrast, brought in the big emerging markets, and its initial promise was to provide a way to control and direct the IMF.

zh: 2009年4月在伦敦召开的最成功的G-20峰会媒体报导所广泛采用的官方照片准确捕捉到了全球经济体制变化的崭新氛围。
en: The new mood of global economic regime change was captured in the official photograph that was widely used in coverage of the most successful of the G-20 summits, held in London in April 2009.

zh: 短期来看，伦敦峰会成功控制了南欧金融危机的蔓延；使世行拥有更多资源处理新兴市场出口贸易融资问题；看似赋予了IMF更丰富的资源及合法地位；并且似乎催生了恢复市场信心的统一的财政刺激措施。
en: In the short term, the London summit mitigated financial contagion emanating from southern Europe; gave the World Bank additional resources to deal with the problem of trade finance for emerging-market exports; appeared to give the IMF more firepower and legitimacy; and seemed to catalyze coordinated fiscal stimulus to restore confidence.

zh: 但这四项成就中只有技术性较强的前两项经受住了时间的考验。
en: But only the more technical of these four achievements – the first two – stood the test of time.

zh: 伦敦峰会的其他协议都出了问题。
en: Everything else that was agreed at the London summit turned sour.

zh: 后续的峰会根本不见成效。
en: The follow-up summits were lame.

zh: 当人们意识到许多欧洲国家政府无法在避免市场不安并将自身推向越来越贵因而难以为继的借贷周期的情况下承担更多的债务，统一财政刺激政策的理念就出现了问题。
en: The idea of coordinated fiscal stimulus became problematic when it became obvious that many European governments could not take on more debt without unsettling markets and pushing themselves into an unsustainable cycle of increasingly expensive borrowing.

zh: 但无论事实证明伦敦峰会所取得的成就多么有限，在斯诺登泄密事件之前峰会本身还没有彻底失信。
en: And yet, however limited the London summit’s achievements proved to be, the summit process itself was not fully discredited until Snowden’s intelligence revelations.

zh: 或许因为领导人及工作人员居然天真到相信他们的信息联络真正安全。
en: It may be that leaders and their staffs were naive in believing that their communications were really secure.

zh: 但斯诺登披露伦敦峰会英国主办方监控与会者的信息传递使人们相信早前峰会真正保密的状况很难再现。
