en: But Snowden’s revelations that the London summit’s British hosts allegedly monitored the participants’ communications make it difficult to imagine that the genuine intimacy of earlier summits can ever be recreated.

zh: 而且因为间谍活动显然更多地针对新兴经济体代表，发达国家和新兴国家之间的鸿沟也因此进一步加深。
en: And, with the espionage apparently directed mostly at representatives of emerging economies, the gulf between the advanced countries and those on the rise has widened further.

zh: 各国领导人在回应相关指控时显得既虚伪又无知。
en: World leaders appear partly ignorant and partly deceptive in responding to the allegations.

zh: 他们强调对监控行为一无所知也许是对的。
en: They are probably right to emphasize how little they really know about surveillance.

zh: 复杂的数搜集计划本来就没有任何监控措施。
en: It is in the nature of complex data-gathering programs that no one really has an overview.

zh: 但数据监视和采集计划缺乏透明度意味着一旦举报人泄漏信息，人人都可以由此推导出政策制定原因和方法的不同版本。
en: But the lack of transparency surrounding data surveillance and mining means that, when a whistleblower leaks information, everyone can subsequently use it to build their own version of how and why policy is made.

zh: 泄密因此催生了离奇的阴谋理论。
en: The revelations thus encourage wild conspiracy theories.

zh: 伦敦峰会的实质性后果已经使人们普遍对G-20峰会丧失了信心。
en: The substantive aftermath of the London summit has already caused widespread disenchantment with the G-20 process.

zh: 斯诺登事件摧毁了领导人相互信任的所有幻想，同样不复存在的还有对领导人能力的信心。
en: The Snowden affair has blown up any illusion about trust between leaders – and also about leaders’ competence.

zh: 因为承诺为斯诺登提供一年庇护，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举办今年的圣彼得堡峰会时就好像把一枚定时炸弹埋在了身边。
en: By granting Snowden asylum for one year, Russian President Vladimir Putin, will have the bomber in his midst when he hosts this year’s summit in Saint Petersburg.

zh: 斯诺登效应
en: The Snowden Effect

zh: 马德里—前美国国家安全局合同工斯诺登不断地泄漏保密情报，这激起了关于隐私和国际法的激烈争论，不幸的是，这一争论盖过了斯诺登行为的地缘政治影响。
en: MADRID – The continued leaking of classified information by the former US National Security Agency contractor Edward Snowden has provoked heated debate about privacy and international law, which, unfortunately, has overshadowed the geostrategic dimension of his actions.

zh: 事实上，斯诺登披露的美国监视计划及其本人为避免引渡而做的斗争反映了美国总统奥巴马对美国外交关系问题的首肯态度。
en: In fact, Snowden’s revelations about US surveillance programs, and his own ongoing struggle to avoid extradition, reveal much about President Barack Obama’s conception of US foreign relations.

zh: 与其他近期美国总统相比，奥巴马更高地提升了国际预期。
en: More than any other incoming American president in recent memory, Obama raised expectations worldwide.

zh: 但他的兴趣主要（如果不是全部的话）集中在国内事务上，这是由外交政策反应决定的。
en: Yet he has proved to be mainly, if not solely, interested in domestic issues, resulting in a foreign policy of reaction.

zh: 斯诺登事件反映了这一方针的三大要素：美俄关系、美国在南美的影响，以及美国与欧洲的关系。
en: The Snowden affair highlights three elements of this: US-Russia relations, US influence in South America, and US relations with Europe.

zh: 克里姆林宫处理斯诺登事件的手法彰显美俄关系的紧张状态。
en: The Kremlin’s handling of the affair is indicative of the tense state of US-Russia relations.

zh: 在美俄双边关系不幸的“重启”后，俄罗斯急切地欲维持其衬托美国的国际立场，这让美俄双方的众多人士重新回到了冷战思维。
en: In the aftermath of the bilateral relationship’s ill-fated “reset,” Russia has been eager to maintain its global position as a foil to the US, causing many people on both sides to revert to a Cold War mentality.

zh: 掉入这一陷阱的美国为俄罗斯总统普京提供了用不尽的素材赢得政治闪光点并巩固其国内地位。
en: By falling into this trap, the US has provided President Vladimir Putin with endless fodder to score political points and solidify his domestic position.

zh: 普京将反美作为遏制国内异见的有效工具。
en: Putin regards anti-Americanism as an effective tool for short-circuiting domestic discontent.

zh: 美国国会批准的马格尼茨基法案（Magnitsky Act）被俄罗斯描述为美国的挑衅，克里姆林宫采取了禁止外国人领养俄罗斯孤儿等报复措施赢得国内支持，有效地打击了国内反对者。
en: Developments like the US Congress’s enactment of the Magnitsky Act, portrayed in Russia as an American provocation, have allowed the Kremlin to rally support at home with retaliatory measures such as a ban on foreign adoptions, while providing cover for a crackdown on domestic opponents.

zh: 在2011年北约领导的干预利比亚行动后 — — 克里姆林宫将此视为西方越界的又一例证 — — 俄罗斯在追求国际影响力方面变得更加积极了，当然主要是反对美国。
en: Following the NATO-led intervention in Libya in 2011, which the Kremlin regarded as another example of Western overreach, Russia has been more aggressive in asserting itself internationally, mainly in opposition to the US.

zh: 最显然的是俄罗斯顽固地支持叙利亚的巴沙尔·阿萨德政权。
en: This is most obvious in Russia’s dogged support for Bashar al-Assad’s regime in Syria.

zh: 俄罗斯以依法为由拒绝交出斯诺登让普京再次与奥巴马争锋相对 — — 这一回，作为合法性和人权捍卫者的是俄罗斯。
en: And Russia’s refusal to hand over Snowden, under the pretext of strict adherence to the law, has allowed Putin to poke Obama in the eye once again – this time while posing as a defender of legality and human rights.

zh: 放大这条妙计的是普京愤怒的呼声 — — 俄罗斯不会允许斯诺登滞留国内，除非他停滞泄漏“旨在伤害我们的美国伙伴”的情报。
en: This coup de théȃtre was magnified by Putin’s cynical claim that Russia would allow Snowden to stay only if he stopped leaking information “aimed at inflicting damage on our American partners.”

zh: 我看在于俄罗斯安全部门的分析会上，普京不会反对幕后释放这些伤害。
en: Presumably, Putin would not object to the infliction of such damage behind closed doors, during a debriefing with the Russian security services.

zh: 此外，斯诺登事件增强了一种感觉：美国正在失去对南美的统治力。
en: Moreover, the Snowden affair reinforces the perception that the US is losing its sway in South America.

zh: 除了极少数显著的例外 — — 比如美国驻巴西大使香农（Tom Shannon ） — —美国外交缺少关于拉美的战略愿景。
en: With few notable exceptions, such as US Ambassador to Brazil Tom Shannon, US diplomacy has lacked a strategic vision for Latin America.

zh: 奥巴马在2008年的当选使人们对这一地区也期望颇高，但其政府对拉美的方针至多只能算有所保留，时不时出些昏招。
en: Barack Obama’s 2008 election created high expectations in this region, too; but his administration’s approach has been reserved, at best, and often obtuse.

zh: 中国对拉美的影响力大幅增加，但美国仍漠然视之。
en: While China’s influence in Latin America has soared, the US has remained aloof.

zh: 奥巴马5月的拉美之行表现出试图在亚太地区崛起的环境下振兴拉美关系的姿态。
en: Obama’s visit in May was presented as an effort to reinvigorate relations in the context of the rise of the Asia-Pacific region.

zh: 不幸的是，奥巴马必须收拾好第一个任期留下的烂摊子。
en: Unfortunately, the chickens of Obama’s first term have already come home to roost.

zh: 比如，美国毫无疑问是厄瓜多尔最大的贸易伙伴，占其对外贸易的三分之一强。
en: For example, the US is far and away Ecuador’s largest trading partner, accounting for more than a third of its foreign trade.

zh: 但是，在面临厄瓜多尔可能想斯诺登提供庇护的局面时，美国感到了马上采取行动的必要，副总统拜登以个人名义向厄瓜多尔总统科雷亚表达了美国的意思，尽��奥巴马宣布他不会“不择手段”地引渡斯诺登。
en: Yet, facing the possibility that Ecuador might grant Snowden asylum, the US felt the need to scramble, with Vice President Joe Biden personally pleading America’s case to Ecuadorian President Rafael Correa, even after Obama announced that he would not engage in “wheeling and dealing” over the extradition.

zh: 美国官员威胁削减对厄瓜多尔的援助 — — 2014年将只有区区1200万美元 — — 是更加拙劣的昏招。
en: The threat by US officials to cut off aid to Ecuador, which would amount to a measly $12 million in 2014, further evinces a clumsy approach.

zh: 美国影响力的传统源泉 — — 软实力、地区联盟和金融杠杆 — — 都在枯竭。
en: America’s traditional sources of influence – its soft power, regional alliances, and financial leverage – appear to be running dry.

zh: 世界得到的信号是明确的：美国不再是它所应该是的地区大国。
en: The message to the world is clear: the US is not the regional power that it should be.

zh: 最后，回到欧洲，奥巴马关于美国被控监视欧盟及其成员国问题的轻率态度表明美国的例外主义（exceptionalism）风头正劲。
en: Finally, turning to Europe, Obama’s flippant attitude concerning alleged US surveillance of the European Union and its member states shows that American exceptionalism is alive and well.

zh: 奥巴马非但没有承认欧洲担忧的合理性，反而认为这是无关紧要的小事 ： “ （我）向你们保证，在欧洲各国首都都有这样的人，他们即便不想知道我早餐吃了什么，至少也很有兴趣知道我在与他们的领导人会面后说了哪些要点。 ”
en: Instead of acknowledging the legitimacy of European concerns, he shrugged them off as a frivolity: “[I] guarantee you that in European capitals, there are people who are interested in, if not what I had for breakfast, at least what my talking points might be should I end up meeting with their leaders.”

zh: 显然，获得关于欧洲盟友决策的更深层次的分析洞见，而不是光靠给（比如）德国总理默克尔带电话获得消息，这符合美国的利益。
en: The US certainly has an interest in gaining deeper analytical insight into its European allies’ decision-making than can be gained by simply calling, say, German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

zh: 接受谍报是美国现实主义工具之一，我们欧洲人可以指望这一工具被合理使用。
en: Accepting that spying is realistically part of the US toolkit, we Europeans expect it to be conducted responsibly.

zh: 奥巴马对欧洲人关于监视如何进行的担忧不屑一顾，这表明了美国的一个最坏的习惯 — — 对欧洲居高临下。
en: By dismissing European concerns about how such surveillance is carried out, Obama has demonstrated one of America’s worst habits – that of patronizing Europe.

zh: 事实上，欧洲就美国情报行为提出过严重质疑，包括让合同工从事如此敏感的工作所体现的不专业性、对某些盟友（如英国和新西兰）采取不干涉方针而将其他盟友（包括大部分欧盟国家）降格为有必要监视的国家，等等。
en: In fact, Europeans have raised serious questions about US intelligence practices. These range from the lack of professionalism implied by allowing contractors to conduct such sensitive work to America’s hands-off approach toward certain allies, like the United Kingdom and New Zealand, while relegating many of its other allies – including most of the European Union – to surveillance-worthy status.

zh: 更讽刺的是，在这个突发的不详时刻，欧洲和美国正在打造自创立北约以来最重要的联合项目 — — 跨大西洋自由贸易协定。
en: The bitter irony is that, at this suddenly inauspicious moment, Europe and the US are launching their most significant joint project since the creation of NATO – a transatlantic free-trade agreement.

zh: 为了协定的成功，欧洲对美国要求 — — 应该在处理国际事务中多点技巧和专业性、尊重它的伙伴 — — 真的太过分了吗？
en: For the sake of its success, is it really too much to ask of the US that it play its part internationally with a bit more skill and professionalism, and that it treat its partners with respect?

zh: 间谍游戏
en: The Spying Game

zh: 墨尔本 — — 多亏了爱德华·斯诺登，我现在才知道美国国家安全局在对我进行暗中监视。
en: MELBOURNE – Thanks to Edward Snowden, I now know that the US National Security Agency is spying on me.

zh: 安全局利用谷歌、Facebook、Verizon和其他互联网及通信公司搜集海量的数字信息，其中无疑也包括我本人的电子邮件、手机通话数据和信用卡使用记录。
en: It uses Google, Facebook, Verizon, and other Internet and communications companies to collect vast amounts of digital information, no doubt including data about my emails, cellphone calls, and credit card usage.

zh: 我不是美国公民，因此这完全合法。
en: I am not a United States citizen, so it’s all perfectly legal.

zh: 而且就算我是美国公民，反正我的很多信息也会被一网打尽，但可能不会成为监控行动的直接目标。
en: And, even if I were a US citizen, it is possible that a lot of information about me would have been swept up anyway, though it may not have been the direct target of the surveillance operation.

zh: 我该不该为这种侵犯隐私的行为感到愤怒？
en: Should I be outraged at this intrusion on my privacy?

zh: 乔治·奥威尔著作《1984》中的世界是否晚了三十年终于来到？
en: Has the world of George Orwell’s 1984 finally arrived, three decades late?

zh: 老大哥是不是在监视我？
en: Is Big Brother watching me?

zh: 我并不感觉愤怒。
en: I don’t feel outraged.

zh: 按照目前所了解的情况，我其实并不在乎。
en: Based on what I know so far, I don’t really care.

zh: 可能不会有人阅读我的电子邮件或偷听我的Skype通话。
en: No one is likely to be reading my emails or listening in on my Skype calls.

zh: NSA的数据搜集量使这成为一项不可能完成的任务。
en: The volume of digital information that the NSA gathers would make that an impossible task.

zh: 相反，计算机程序挖掘可疑的活动模式数据，情报分析员希望能借此使恐怖分子落网。
en: Instead, computer programs mine the data for patterns of suspicious activity that intelligence analysts hope will lead them to terrorists.

zh: 整个过程与许多公司用来提高广告针对性或为我们提供最想要的在线搜索结果的数据搜集和分析并没有什么不同。
en: The process is not all that different from the data collection and analysis that many corporations use to target their ads at us more effectively, or that give us the online search results that we are most likely to want.

zh: 问题不在于政府或企业搜集什么样的信息，而在于他们用这些信息做什么。
en: The question is not what information a government, or business, gathers, but what they do with it.

zh: 比方说，假如有证据表明美国政府用搜集到的隐私信息要挟外国政要为美国的利益服务，或故意将这些信息泄露给媒体诽谤美国政策的批评者，那才是真正激怒我的丑闻。
en: I would be outraged if there were evidence that – for example – the US government was using the private information that it scoops up to blackmail foreign politicians into serving US interests, or if such information were leaked to newspapers in an effort to smear critics of US policies. That would be a real scandal.

zh: 可是如果没有发生这种事情，如果有有效的措施保证这种情况不会发生，那么剩下的问题就是这项庞大的数据收集工程是否真能保护我们远离恐怖主义，或者说项目的经费应用是否值得。
en: If, however, nothing of that sort has happened, and if there are effective safeguards in place to ensure that it does not happen, then the remaining question is whether this huge data-gathering effort really does protect us against terrorism, and whether we are getting value for money from it.

zh: NSA声称通讯监控自2001年以来已经阻止了50多起恐怖袭击。
en: The NSA claims that communications surveillance has prevented more than 50 terrorist attacks since 2001.

zh: 我不知道该怎么评价这种说法，或者我们是否有其他方式阻止这些袭击发生。
en: I don’t know how to evaluate that claim, or whether we could have prevented those attacks in other ways.

zh: 投资价值的问题更加难以评估。
en: The value-for-money question is even more difficult to assess.

zh: 2010年 ， 《 华盛顿邮报》制作了一份题为绝密美国的重要报告。
en: In 2010, the Washington Post produced a major report on “Top Secret America.”

zh: 在十几位记者整整两年的调查后 ， 《 邮报》得出的结论是没有人掌握美国情报行动的成本 — — 就连美国情报机构聘用多少人员都是未知数。
en: After a two-year investigation involving more than a dozen journalists, the Post concluded that no one knows how much US intelligence operations cost – or even how many people American intelligence agencies employ.

zh: 当时《邮报》报导通过“绝密”安全审核的共有854,000人。
en: At the time, the Post reported that 854,000 people held “top secret” security clearances.

zh: 现在该数字据称已膨胀到140万之多。
en: Now that figure is reported to be 1.4 million.

zh: （单是接触绝密材料的人数之多就已经让人怀疑将个人信息用于��诈勒索或其他私人目的是不可避免的。 ）
en: (The sheer number of people does make one wonder whether misuse of personal data for blackmail or other private purposes is inevitable.)

zh: 无论我们对NSA监控程序本身持何种看法，美国政府显然对相关信息泄露反应过度。
en: Whatever we think of the NSA surveillance program itself, the US government has clearly overreacted to the release of information about it.

zh: 美国政府撤销了斯诺登的护照，并写信要求别国政府拒绝他可能提出的避难请求。
en: It revoked Snowden’s passport, and wrote to governments asking them to reject any asylum request that he might make.

zh: 更非同寻常的是美国政府似乎指使法国、西班牙、意大利和葡萄牙等国以斯诺登可能搭乘专机为由拒绝许可玻利维亚总统埃沃·莫拉莱斯的飞机途经它们的领空从莫斯科回国。
en: Most extraordinary of all, it seems that the US was behind the apparent refusal of France, Spain, Italy, and Portugal to permit Bolivian President Evo Morales’s airplane to enter their airspace en route home from Moscow, on the grounds that Snowden might have been aboard.

zh: 莫拉莱斯不得不降落在维也纳，这激怒了认为尊严受辱的拉美国家领袖。
en: Morales had to land in Vienna, and Latin American leaders were furious at what they took to be an insult to their dignity.

zh: 民主支持者在控告朱利安·阿桑奇、布拉德利·曼宁和斯诺登等人之前应该认真进行反思。
en: Supporters of democracy ought to think long and hard before prosecuting people like Julian Assange, Bradley Manning, and Snowden.

zh: 如果我们认为民主是种善政，那么我们必须相信公众应该尽可能了解他们亲手选出的政府在做些什么。
en: If we think that democracy is a good thing, then we must believe that the public should know as much as possible about what the government it elects is doing.

zh: 斯诺登说他泄密是想让“公众来决定这些计划和政策是对是错 ” 。
en: Snowden has said that he made the disclosures because “the public needs to decide whether these programs and policies are right or wrong.”

zh: 他说得没错。
en: He’s right about that.

zh: 如果民主政体根本不知道这种计划是否存在，它又该怎么决定NSA该不该进行那样的政府监控？
en: How can a democracy determine whether there should be government surveillance of the kind that the NSA is conducting if it has no idea that such programs exist?

zh: 事实上，斯诺登的泄密内容还显示国家情报总监詹姆斯·克拉珀三月在参议院情报委员会所做的听证证词就NSA的监控行为对国会进行了误导。
en: Indeed, Snowden’s leaks also revealed that National Intelligence Director James Clapper misled the US Congress about the NSA’s surveillance practices in his testimony at a hearing held in March by the Senate Intelligence Committee.

zh: 当《华盛顿邮报》联同《卫报》刊发斯诺登所提供的信息时，它曾询问美国人对NSA的情报搜集程序持支持还是反对态度。
en: When the Washington Post published (along with The Guardian) the information that Snowden provided, it asked Americans whether they support or oppose the NSA’s intelligence-gathering program.

zh: 表态支持的受访者约占58 % 。
en: Some 58% of those surveyed supported it.

zh: 但同一调查显示支持起诉斯诺登泄密行为的人仅占43 % ， 而48%持反对态度。
en: Yet the same poll found that only 43% supported prosecuting Snowden for disclosing the program, while 48% were opposed.

zh: 调查还显示65%的人支持由美国国会对NSA监控程序举行听证。
en: The poll also indicated 65% support for public hearings by the US Congress on the NSA surveillance program.

zh: 如果真的出现这种情况，斯诺登的泄密行为将使我们更好地了解情况。
en: If that happens, we will all be much better informed because of Snowden’s disclosures.

zh: 对不平等现象的清算
en: Reckoning With Inequality

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 当涉及到自上世纪70年代在美国和其他一些发达经济体所出现的经济不平等扩大现象时，真正的问题并不在于我们选择哪种收入分配措施：因为这些措施都无法遏制不平等的扩大。
en: CAMBRIDGE – When it comes to the rise in economic inequality since the 1970s in the United States and some other advanced economies, it doesn’t really matter which measure of income distribution we choose: They all show the increase.

zh: 与此同时，虽然人们对此提出了许多这样那样的解释，我们也不是非得要在对事件成因的看法上达成一致，大家照样可以搁置争议，携手推行合理的政策来应对这一问题。
en: And, while many competing explanations have been proposed, we do not need to agree about causes to concur on sensible policies to address the problem.

zh: 有很多种方法去测量不平等状况，而每种方法都会告诉我们一些不同的东西。
en: There are many ways to measure inequality. Each can tell us something different.

zh: 许多亚洲国家近年取得的经济成就在某些测量方式（比如贫困率大幅下跌）上减少了不平等现象，但从其他方式上看则不然（高-低收入差距有所增加 ） 。
en: Many Asian countries’ recent economic success has reduced inequality by some measures (for example, a big fall in the poverty rate), but not by others (the high-low range has increased).

zh: 而在美国，一切测量不平等的方法自世纪之交以来都指向了同一方向，反映出经济增长所带来的好处了几乎全都归了位于社会顶层的那一小撮人。
en: In the US, however, all measures of inequality have pointed in the same direction since the turn of the century, reflecting the fact that the benefits of economic growth have gone almost exclusively to those at the top.

zh: 前0.5％的人收入占全社会总收入的份额已达14 ％ ， 上次出现这样的情况还是在1920年代。
en: The share of income received by the top 0.5% has reached 14%, where it was in the 1920s.

zh: 通常人们会觉得找到这类根本性转变的成因才是开出药方的必要步骤。
en: Normally, one would think that diagnosing the cause of such a fundamental shift would be a necessary step in prescribing a cure.

zh: 但在这种情况下，你会被一大堆看似合理的解释淹没，陷入选择困难，最终消磨掉了所有决心。
en: In that case, one might be discouraged by the over-abundance of plausible explanations that have been offered and the difficulty in choosing among them.

zh: 托马斯•皮克提（Thomas Piketty）在《二十一世纪的资本》一书中重点强调了由高资本回报率所催生的一个超长期趋势，使得财富传承的积累速度高于工资收入的增长。
en: Thomas Piketty’s Capital in the Twenty-First Century emphasizes what he sees as a very long-term trend arising from a high return to capital, which causes inherited wealth to accumulate at a faster rate than earned income grows.

zh: 这本出版于2013年的书影响巨大，令不平等状况重归美国经济学家的议程之中。
en: Piketty’s book, published in 2013, did much to put inequality back on the agenda of American economists.

zh: 但大多数研究人员认为，美国不断扩大的不平等状况主要来源于收入内部的不平等，而非来自劳动收入（工资和薪金）和非劳动收入（资本回报）之间的差异。
en: But most researchers believe that the sources of widening US inequality lie primarily within earned income, rather than arising from the difference between earned income (wages and salaries) and unearned income (return on capital).

zh: 针对劳动收入不平等的第一个解释是技术变革，这令对高技术工人的需求增长比供给要快。
en: The first explanation for earned-income inequality is technological change, which raises the demand for skilled workers faster than the supply.

zh: 不过虽然这可以解释高技术和“非技术”工人（以其是否受过大学教育来界定）之间不断扩大的工资或收入差距，却无法解释最富有的那1％和其他人之间的差距。
en: But, while this can explain a widening wage or income gap between skilled and “unskilled” workers (defined according to whether they are college-educated), this has little to do with the gap between the top 1% and the rest.

zh: 第二种解释是所谓的“选型交配 ” ： 那些成就卓越的成功男士不会再娶他们的秘书为妻，而是选择同样成绩斐然的职业女性。
en: The second explanation is what is called “assortative mating,” according to which highly accomplished professional men no longer marry their secretaries, but instead choose highly accomplished professional women.

zh: 第三种解释是许多行业（从牙医到大学教授再到电影明星）赢家通吃的特质。
en: The third is the winner-take-all character of many professions, from dentists to university professors to movie stars.

zh: 由于现代传媒会告诉我们谁是城里最好的牙医或是世上最好的演员，在能力上相对小的差异却能产生比过去大得多的收入差异。
en: Because modern media tell us who is the best dentist in town or the best movie actor in the world, relatively small differences in abilities win far bigger differences in income than they used to.

zh: 而第四种解释认为，企业高管获得的极高花红，尤其是在金融领域，并不是因其服务于有社会价值（比如毕业于医学院或拥有与生俱来的表演天赋）的需求所带来的回报。
en: According to the fourth explanation, the very high compensation of corporate executives, especially in the financial sector, is not a return to services that are in demand because they are socially valuable (like having gone to medical school or having been born with acting talent).

zh: 相反，这些高管们基本上都是自己收入条款的设定者，这其实反映出在公司治理，税法和金融工程等方面的失灵。
en: Rather, managers essentially get to set the terms of their own pay, through compensation packages that reflect failures of corporate governance, tax law, and financial engineering.

zh: 例如股票期权原本是为了将薪酬与绩效联系起来，如今却变了味。
en: Stock options, for example, have failed in their original goal of relating pay to performance.

zh: 最后一个特别流行的解释认为富人已攫取权力的杠杆。
en: Finally, an especially popular explanation is that the rich have captured the levers of power, through campaign donations.

zh: 通过竞选捐款，他们资助的政客们都纷纷制定有利于富人的政策。
en: The politicians they finance are only too eager to enact favorable policies.

zh: 而不管原因为何，许多改善不平等状况的政策药方其实都适用。
en: But many policy prescriptions to ameliorate inequality apply regardless of the cause.

zh: 大多数会采用更加先进的税收制度，例如为降低低收入劳动者的有效边际税率 — — 就是美国总统奥巴马所提出的 “让工作真正挣钱 ” 。
en: Most would make the tax system more progressive, by, for example, lowering the effective marginal tax rate for low-income workers – what US President Barack Obama has called “making work pay.”

zh: 强化劳动所得税抵免也是当前的一个热点选择，奥巴马在他2016年1月发表的国情咨文中提出扩大工资保险，该保险目前只能帮助那些因为一般工作原因而失业的人，未来可能延伸到那些遭遇科技变革影响的失业者。
en: Enhancing the earned-income tax credit is a live option today, and Obama proposed in his January 2016 State of the Union address expanding wage insurance, which currently helps workers who lose their jobs because of trade but could be extended to those who lose their jobs due to technological change.

zh: 同样，对于低收入工人的工资税也可能被取消。
en: Similarly, the payroll tax for low-income workers could be eliminated.

zh: 鉴于美国的社会保障和医疗保险计划可能出现赤字，这类税收准则上的变化理论上应该对财政收入影响不大。
en: In light of looming deficits for America’s Social Security and Medicare programs, such changes in the tax code should ideally be revenue-neutral.

zh: 今年共和党总统候选人像往常一样提出针对富人大规模减税，却拿不出个如何支付社保和医保的方案来。
en: The Republican candidates for president this year, as usual, propose massive tax cuts, focused on the rich, without a plan for how to pay for them.

zh: 美国可以用在财政上负责任的方式去增加额外收入以应对不平等状况。
en: The US can raise additional revenue with which to address inequality in fiscally responsible ways.

zh: 对于“附带权益”的税务豁免 — — 比如以较低的资本利得税率向对冲基金经理的收入征税 — — 应该取消（民主党总统候选人希拉里•克林顿正是如此主张 ） ， 同时对房地产税的豁免（最初由小布什提出）可以减少。
en: The tax break for “carried interest,” by which hedge-fund managers’ income is taxed at low capital-gains rates, should be abolished (as Democratic presidential candidate Hillary Clinton favors), and the exemption for the estate tax (originally expanded by George W. Bush) could be reduced.

zh: 与此同时，对高收入劳动者的工资税上限可能被提高，而针对高收入家庭的扭曲性税收减免（例如相关抵押贷款利率）则会收紧。
en: At the same time, the cap on payroll taxes for upper-income workers could be raised, and distorting tax deductions, like that for mortgage interest, could be tightened for upper-income households.

zh: 在支出侧也有许多事情可做。
en: A lot should be done on the spending side, too.

zh: 例子包括提供高品质普遍性学前教育，为所有人提供医疗保险，以及基础设施支出。
en: Examples include universal high-quality preschool, health insurance for all, and infrastructure spending.

zh: 许多对不平等状况感到沮丧的人被吸引到伯尼•桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）或唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）的旗帜下。
en: Many of those who are upset about inequality are attracted to the banner of Bernie Sanders (or that of Donald Trump).

zh: 许多人认为必须拆分银行才能彻底铲除问题的根源，因为正是这些富人“收买”了政治家们。
en: Many believe that one must break up banks in order to address the root cause of the problem, which is thought to be that the rich have “bought” politicians.

zh: 金钱确实是政治上的一大问题。
en: Money in politics is indeed a big problem.

zh: 但是政治家会怎么用这些钱呢？
en: But what do politicians use all that money for?

zh: 它不会进入他们的口袋（至少在美国不会 ） 。
en: It doesn’t go into their pockets (at least not in the US).

zh: 他们会花钱去竞选公职：发布竞选广告和动员支持者。
en: It goes to running for office: campaign advertisements and mobilizing supporters.

zh: 在我看来，投票支持的那些会推行正确政策去解决不平等状况 — — 以及其他各项事务 — — 的候选人才是更为直接的策略，而非把选票投给那些想分拆银行并最终减少可动用的资金数量，妄图以此阻碍选民选择合适人选的候选人。
en: In my view, voting for candidates who will enact the right policies is a far more direct strategy for addressing inequality – and much else – than voting for those who want to break up the banks to reduce the amount of money available to dissuade voters from supporting the right candidates.

zh: 一个对IMF的彻底疯狂建议
en: A Perfectly Crazy Idea for the IMF

zh: 发自日内瓦 — — 在电影《危险心灵》中，女演员米歇尔·普法伊费尔（Michelle Pfeiffer）饰演一位在内陆小城担任高中老师的前美国海军陆战队员。
en: GENEVA – In the movie Dangerous Minds, the actress Michelle Pfeiffer plays a former US Marine who becomes a teacher in an inner-city high school.

zh: 在面对一帮无心向学的叛逆少年时，这位女教师想出了一个路子有点野但相当有效的新点子：每个学生都以“A”等成绩开始自己的学年，随课堂表现而扣减。
en: In a difficult environment, where academic achievement is far from the top of the rebellious teens’ list of priorities, Pfeiffer’s character comes up with an unorthodox – and effective – new approach: each student will start the year with an “A” grade, which is theirs to lose.

zh: 而 当许多新兴市场经济体都像那些学生一样自暴自弃的时候，也许国际货币基金组织（IMF）也该和这位女教师一样将剧本翻到新的一页了。
en: At a time when many emerging-market economies are as discouraged as Pfeiffer’s students, perhaps the International Monetary Fund should take a page out of her playbook.

zh: 新兴经济体处于一个资本流动极不稳定的高风险世界中。
en: Emerging economies inhabit a risky world characterized by volatile capital flows.

zh: 对此它们通过积累大量国际储备来自我保障，而非等待IMF出手履行其保护各国免遭流动性危机的使命。
en: But, rather than rely on the IMF to fulfill its mandate of protecting them from liquidity crises, they self-insure by accumulating large stockpiles of international reserves.

zh: 迄今为止新兴和发展中经济体已经向美国财政部贷款达7.5万亿美元 — — 这些钱本可用来资助各国国内急需的基础设施建设项目。
en: Emerging and developing economies now lend nearly $7.5 trillion to the US Treasury – resources that could be used to fund badly needed infrastructure projects.

zh: 这种做法的奇怪之处就在于：虽然IMF在处理金融危机方面的记录不尽完美，但一般还是相当不错的。
en: What is curious about this approach is that the IMF’s record in handling financial crises, though far from perfect, is generally quite good.

zh: 那么为何各国都不愿向该组织求助？
en: So why the reluctance to count on the Fund?

zh: 其中最明显的理由或许是时机。
en: Perhaps the most obvious reason is timing.

zh: 由于各种历史原因，大多数基金设施更擅长管理而不是防止危机。
en: For historical reasons, most Fund facilities are better suited to managing crises than they are to preventing them.

zh: 在受灾国向IMF求助时，它们往往已经断绝了一切进入国际资本市场的渠道。
en: By the time countries turn to the IMF for support, they have already lost access to international capital markets.

zh: 同时它们还必须经历漫长的谈判，导致使局势在出现转机之前进一步恶化。
en: Yet they have to engage in protracted negotiations that allow the situation to deteriorate before it improves.

zh: 调用一个国家自身储备可能不是一个理想的选择，但至少足够迅速。
en: Tapping a country’s own reserves may not be an ideal option, but at least it is fast.

zh: 但IMF确实提供了一个快速选项。
en: But the IMF does offer a fast option.

zh: 灵活信用额度（Flexible Credit Line）机制允许各国在无需回答任何问题的情况下迅速获取基金资源。
en: The Flexible Credit Line (FCL) facility grants immediate access to Fund resources, no questions asked.

zh: 这相当于符合资格的国家可以根据其基本面状况以及政策记录随时获取一笔预先批准好的贷款,因此也是防止自我强化型流动性危机的完美工具。
en: It amounts to a pre-approved loan that eligible countries can obtain whenever they want, on the basis of the strength of their fundamentals and policy record. It is thus the perfect tool for preventing self-fulfilling liquidity crises.

zh: 然而各IMF成员国似乎对上述机制不太感冒。
en: Yet IMF members do not seem to be interested in the FCL.

zh: 该机制建立七年来只有三个国家（哥伦比亚，墨西哥和波兰）使用过。
en: Seven years after the facility was developed, only three countries (Colombia, Mexico, and Poland) have access to it.

zh: 虽然并非IMF的189个成员国都有使用资格，但实际数量远远不止3个。
en: While not all of the Fund’s 189 members could qualify for it, the number that do is a lot higher than three.

zh: 而与FCL类似的预防和流动性额度（Precautionary and Liquidity Line ） ， 虽然门槛更低，但也只得两个受援国。
en: The FCL-like Precautionary and Liquidity Line, which has an even lower bar for eligibility, has only two takers.

zh: 问题在于名声。
en: The problem is stigma.

zh: 虽然IMF声明预先批准的申请过程是保密的，但各国却对此将信将疑，害怕一旦走漏了风声就会被视为存在潜在经济问题。
en: Countries fear that by applying for pre-approval – a process that they are not confident will remain confidential, as promised – they will signal potential economic problems.

zh: 更糟糕的是，申请 — — 无论是首次申请还是1~2年一度的复审 — — 都可能被拒绝；如果这事传了出去，肯定也会削弱外界对本国经济体的信心。
en: Worse, they could be rejected, either the first time they apply or when their approval comes up for review (every 1-2 years); that would surely undermine confidence in their economies, if word of it were to get out.

zh: 这就是女教师的策略能奏效的地方。
en: This is where Pfeiffer’s strategy comes in.

zh: 与其迫使各国申请批准，IMF可以创建一个新的FCL类机制，除了那些因政策和基本面不符合某些标准的国家之外，所有成员国都能预先获得批准。
en: Instead of forcing countries to work for approval, the IMF could create a new FCL-like facility for which all of its members are pre-approved, with the exception of countries that do not meet certain criteria in terms of policies and fundamentals.

zh: 那些例外情况可以被定义为IMF与成员国之间所谓第四条（Article IV）磋商的一部分 — — 某种强化IMF对该国监控程度的手段。
en: Exceptions could be identified as part of the IMF’s so-called Article IV consultations with members – an approach that would strengthen IMF country surveillance.

zh: 至于其他方面，预先批准会大大减少引发囤积储备的自我保障动机。
en: As for the rest, pre-approval would substantially diminish the temptation to self-insure by accumulating reserves.

zh: 正如任何改变现状的企图一样，这种方法也会迎来挑战。
en: As with any attempt to change the status quo, this approach would raise challenges.

zh: 首先，基金组织工作人员可能遭遇那些不合资格国家所施加政治压力，特别那些在IMF中比较有影响力的成员国。
en: For starters, IMF staff could face political pressure from countries that did not qualify, particularly if those countries were among the IMF’s more influential members.

zh: 但正如廷托·卡德拉（Tito Cordella）和爱德华多·勒维·叶雅迪（Eduardo Levy Yeyati）在2006年所建议的那样，可以通过具体，可衡量和透明的标准来舒缓这类风险。
en: But, as Tito Cordella and Eduardo Levy Yeyati suggested in 2006, this risk could be mitigated by specific, measurable, and transparent criteria.

zh: 而这种方法的缺点在于将涉及更详细的针对每个国家特殊情况的分析，其中涉及众多定性评估。
en: The disadvantage of this approach is that it would preclude more nuanced country-specific analyses involving qualitative assessments.

zh: 此外，如果评价过程被公之于众，某些负面评估或会引发危机。
en: Moreover, if evaluations were made public, negative assessments could precipitate crises.

zh: 确保明确和具体的资格标准将有助于防止这种结果。
en: Ensuring that the eligibility criteria are clear and specific could help to prevent such an outcome.

zh: 一个防止较疲弱经济体爆发危机的更直接方法是创建一个类似于（对国家风险没有很大影响的）主权评级量表的连续型资格标准，不同国家在量表中的位置不同，从而获得的预防机制也不同。
en: A more direct approach to preventing crises in weaker economies would be to create a continuous eligibility scale, akin to the sovereign rating scale (which does not have a large effect on country risk), with countries at different points on the scale having access to different types of precautionary facilities.

zh: 最后的风险是，如果许多国家都能达到标准，IMF可能没有足够的资源来履行其在危机中的承诺。
en: The final risk is that, if many countries fulfill the criteria, the Fund might not have enough resources to meet its commitments in a crisis.

zh: 这个问题可以通过提高基金借款能力，同时减少其需要为类FCL机制预留的资源量来解决。
en: This problem could be solved by boosting the Fund’s capacity to borrow, while reducing the amount of resources that the Fund needs to set aside for FCL-like facilities.

zh: 毕竟一个从来不会（或很少）被使用的预防信用额度才是一个成功的机制。
en: After all, a successful precautionary credit line is one that is never (or very rarely) used.

zh: 金融全球化需要一个更强有力的全球金融安全网来支撑。
en: Financial globalization demands a stronger global financial safety net.

zh: 自1990年代中期以来，经济学家和政策制定者一直在修改国际金融架构，但却并未取得多少成功。
en: Economists and policymakers have been tinkering with the international financial architecture since the mid-1990s, without much success.

zh: 虽然重新定义现状的想法可能听起来很疯狂，但或许可以改写一下物理学家尼尔斯·玻尔（Niels Bohr）的名言，是否疯狂到一定程度，才有实现正确的可能。
en: While the idea of redefining the status quo may sound crazy, it may be, to paraphrase the physicist Niels Bohr, just crazy enough to be right.

zh: 穆尔西身后的埃及
en: Egypt after Morsi

zh: 柏林—埃及是阿拉伯革命的核心，尽管最初的星星之火点燃在突尼斯。
en: BERLIN – Egypt lies at the heart of the Arab revolution, even if the original spark occurred in Tunisia.

zh: 但埃及 — — 及其战略位置、稳定的边境线、庞大的人口和古老的历史 — — 几百年来一直是阿拉伯世界的主要力量，其决定阿拉伯历史走向的作用无人能及。
en: But Egypt – with its strategic location, stable borders, large population, and ancient history – has been the principal power of the Arab world for centuries, defining the movement of history there like no other.

zh: 这意味着埃及民选总统穆尔西的下台将引起更广泛的反响。
en: This implies that the overthrow of Egypt’s democratically elected president, Mohamed Morsi, will have much broader repercussions.

zh: 穆尔西的下台典型的披着军事政变的反革命吗？
en: Was Morsi’s ouster a classic counterrevolution in the guise of a military coup?

zh: 还是政变防止了穆斯林兄弟会的全面掌权，从而避免了埃及经济的崩溃和混乱地走向宗教独裁？
en: Or did the coup prevent a total takeover of power by the Muslim Brotherhood, and thus avert Egypt’s economic collapse and chaotic descent into religious dictatorship?

zh: 没人可以否认埃及所发生的事件属于军事政变，或者来自前总统穆巴拉克政权的势力重新掌握了权力。
en: No one should deny that what happened in Egypt was a military coup, or that forces from former President Hosni Mubarak’s regime have returned to power.

zh: 但是，与2011年不同的是，当时极少数亲西方自由派和数量庞大的城市中产阶级年轻人群起反对穆巴拉克，而如今同一个群体支持政变，使政变具有了一定程度的（民主的？
en: But, unlike in 2011, when the few pro-Western liberals and huge numbers of urban, middle-class youth rallied against Mubarak, now the same groups support the coup, lending it a certain (democratic?) legitimacy.

zh: ）合法性。 尽管如此，这无法为民选政府被军队推翻洗地。
en: Nonetheless, the overthrow of a democratically elected government by the military cannot be glossed over.

zh: 那么，如今埃及的观点如何？
en: So what options does Egypt now have?

zh: 它会重蹈阿尔及利亚悲剧的覆辙吗？ 阿尔及利亚军队曾取消了一次选举以防止伊斯兰教掌权，结果导致了八年内战，20万人因此丧命。
en: Will it repeat the Algerian tragedy, in which the military canceled an election to prevent Islamists from assuming power, leading to an eight-year civil war that claimed up to 200,000 lives?

zh: 埃及会回到军事独裁吗？
en: Will the country return to military dictatorship?

zh: 或者，埃及最终会迎来类似于长期存在于土耳其的基马尔主义（Kemalist）式“民主 ” ， 即由军队操纵的傀儡文职政府吗？
en: Or will Egypt end up with something like a Kemalist “democracy” of the type that long prevailed in Turkey, with a civilian government but the military pulling the strings?

zh: 所有这三条道路都有可能发生，但具体是哪一条还不可能预测。
en: All three alternatives are possible, though it is impossible to predict which one will come to pass.

zh: 但有一点可以说已经确定无疑，那就是埃及人内部的权力分配。
en: But one thing already can be said for certain: the basic distribution of power within Egyptian society has not changed.

zh: 西方导向的自由派没有任何真正的权力，正如我们所看到的，他们唯军队马首是瞻。
en: The military and the Muslim Brotherhood divide power between themselves. The Western-oriented liberals do not have any real power and stand, as we are seeing now, on the army’s shoulders.

zh: 我们不应该忘记，穆尔西在2012年总统选举中的对手是沙菲克，而沙菲克是前将军、穆巴拉克时代末代总理，且显然不是自由派。
en: We should not forget that Morsi’s opponent in the presidential election in 2012 was Ahmed Shafik, a former general and the last Mubarak-era prime minister – certainly no liberal.

zh: 不管是穆兄会还是军队获得胜利，都不是民主的胜利。
en: A victory by either the Brotherhood or the military would not be a victory for democracy.

zh: 2006年以来统治着加沙地带的哈马斯可以作为穆兄会意图的一个例子：完全的权力，包括军队。
en: Hamas, which has ruled Gaza since 2006, may serve as an example of what the Brotherhood wants: undivided power, including over the military.

zh: 类似地，自20世纪50年代开始把持权力的埃及军队也是数十年军事独裁史的结果。
en: Likewise, the Egyptian army’s hold on power, beginning in the 1950’s, resulted in a decades-long military dictatorship.

zh: 但现在有了第三个、也是新出现的因素的作用，它衡量权力的方式不同于军队和穆兄会。
en: But there is a third and new factor now in play, one that does not measure power in the same way as the military and the Brotherhood.

zh: 通过两年来对示威游行的领导，城市中产阶级年轻人赢得了他们自身的合法性，且他们拥有技术和语言能力，能主导关于埃及的全球争论。
en: Through their leadership of the protests for two years, urban middle-class youth have gained their own legitimacy, and, with their technological and linguistic capacities, are able to dominate global debate about Egypt.

zh: 这些年轻人希望进步，而不是权力；他们希望未来可以获得他们从互联网和西方所了解到的生活。
en: These young people want progress, not power; they want the future to resemble the life that they see on the Internet and in the West.

zh: 如果这一运动被引导到制度政治，将极大地影响埃及国内权力分配。
en: If this movement were channeled into institutional politics, it would significantly affect Egypt’s internal distribution of power.

zh: 埃及的闹剧将由这个三角矛盾以及这三个群体的要求决定。
en: Egypt’s unfolding drama will be framed by the triangle of contradictions and demands among these three groups.

zh: 我们也不应该忘记，年轻人感到在过去的民族主义军事独裁下他们没有未来，除此之外，大规模贫困是爆发2011年革命的第二因素。
en: And it should not be forgotten that, along with young people’s sense that they lacked a future under the nationalistic military dictatorships of the past, mass poverty was the second trigger of the 2011 revolution.

zh: 军队和穆斯林兄弟会冲突的原因不仅仅是宗教问题，而是充斥着整个阿拉伯社会的社会问题，其中就包括不平等性问题。
en: Underlying the contradiction between the military and the Muslim Brotherhood is not only the question of religion, but also all of the social problems, including inequality, that riddle Arab societies.

zh: 穆兄会有效地扮演了类似于19世纪欧洲左翼政党的角色。
en: The Brotherhood has effectively assumed a role similar to that of left-wing European political parties in the nineteenth century.

zh: 如果你想削弱穆兄会，就必须决绝解决它所带来并试图解决的紧迫社会问题。
en: Whoever wants to weaken the Brotherhood has to address the urgent social issues that it raises and try to solve them.

zh: 这意味着最终什么解决方案会胜出将通过该方案是否能解决经济危机（特别是年轻人就业机会不足的问题）和不断深化的大规模贫困问题来衡量。
en: This means that whatever solution ultimately prevails will be measured according to whether it can solve the economic crisis (particularly the lack of job opportunities for the young) and deepening mass poverty.

zh: 机会很小。
en: The chances of this are slim.

zh: 放眼阿拉伯世界，民族主义束缚着社会，阻碍着合作、取消关税和建立经济社会。
en: Throughout the Arab world, nationalism constricts societies and retards cooperation, the dismantling of tariffs, and the creation of an economic community.

zh: 危机中的阿拉伯国家太小，不可能单枪匹马获得成功；即使所有方面都进展良好，它们也无法给广大年轻人带来积极未来的希望。
en: And yet the economies of the Arab countries in crisis are too small to succeed on their own; even if everything goes well, they cannot offer their large and young populations hope of a positive future.

zh: 它们需要加强合作，共同的语言意味着阿拉伯世界的合作基础比欧洲更好。
en: They need enhanced cooperation, which, given a common language, would rest on a stronger foundation than it does in Europe.

zh: 在埃及，西方应该与所有三大领先政治实力合作，即军队、穆兄会和城市年轻人，因为从短期看不可能会出现单一观点的解决方案。
en: In Egypt, the West should work with all three leading political forces – the military, the Brotherhood, and the urban young – because no short-term solution will come in the form of one option.

zh: 最坏的情形是再一次边缘化甚至迫害穆斯林兄弟会甚至伊斯兰政治势力。
en: The worst approach would be to marginalize or even persecute the Muslim Brotherhood and political Islam again.

zh: 更广地说，叙利亚内战动摇着黎巴嫩，也威胁约旦，与此同时，伊拉克也在饱受类似的宗派暴力的摧残，因此埃及军事政变似乎是阿拉伯革命结束的先声，至少从目前看是如此。
en: More broadly, with Syria’s civil war destabilizing Lebanon and threatening to do the same in Jordan, and with Iraq plagued by similar sectarian violence, the military coup in Egypt appears to herald the end of the Arab revolutions, at least for the time being.

zh: 所有地方的信号都指向相反的方向。
en: Everywhere, the signs are pointing backwards.

zh: 但我们也别被欺骗了。
en: But we should not be deceived.

zh: 即使权力之争已经确定，但这并不意味着回到从前的状况。
en: Even if the struggle for power seems decided, this does not mean a return to the former status quo.

zh: 如今我们知道，当1848年欧洲革命在一年后卷土重来时，一切都已经不同。
en: When the revolutions of 1848 in Europe were rolled back the following year, everything was nonetheless different, as we now know.

zh: 君主制继续掌了几十年权力，但工业革命和民主的崛起已经势不可挡。
en: The monarchies remained in power for decades, but the Industrial Revolution and the advent of democracy had become unstoppable.

zh: 但是，我们也知道，这给欧洲带来的未来一点都不平静。
en: We also know, however, that this led Europe to a future that was anything but serene.

zh: 阿拉伯世界或许受影响不会那么深，但近期未来显然也不会和平稳定。
en: The Arab world might not be so deeply affected, but the near future there will certainly be neither peaceful nor stable.

zh: 阿拉伯宗教战争
en: The Arab Wars of Religion

zh: 马德里—纵观阿拉伯世界，两大历史势力之争 — — 宗教和世俗 — — 方兴未艾。
en: MADRID – Throughout the Arab world, a struggle between two major historical forces, religion and secularism, is now unfolding.

zh: 这场战争堪与折磨欧洲数百年之久的凯撒和上帝之战相媲。
en: It is the type of battle between Caesar and God that took Europe centuries to resolve.

zh: 阿拉伯中东的未来将取决于叙利亚的逊尼派叛军（他们有原教旨主义赞助人、沙特瓦哈比派在整个地区的支持）及其世俗的社会复兴党（Baath）政权之争、原教旨主义哈马斯和世俗的巴解组织之争、以及埃及形成于解放广场示威的青年世俗反对派与穆斯林兄弟会和极端沙拉菲派之争。
en: The future of the Arab Middle East will be decided in the fight between Syria’s Sunni insurgents, supported throughout the region by the Saudi Wahhabis – the patrons of religious fundamentalism – and its secular Baath regime; between the fundamentalist Hamas and the secular PLO in Palestine; and between Egypt’s young secular opposition, forged in the protests of Tahrir Square, and the Muslim Brotherhood and radical Salafists.

zh: 目前，阿拉伯革命已经证明了一个假设 — — 大多数阿拉伯社会的结构决定了推翻世俗独裁免不了意味着开启了伊斯兰民主的大门。
en: So far, the Arab revolts have vindicated the assumption that, given the structure of most Arab societies, toppling secular autocracies inevitably means opening the door to Islamic democracies.

zh: 我们多次看到了这一动态。 20世纪90年代初的阿尔及利亚是如此，伊斯兰救世阵线（Islamic Salvation Front）在议会选举第一轮中胜出（这导致第二轮选举被取消 ） ； 2006年哈马斯在巴勒斯坦选举中获胜也是如此；还有最近的穆斯林在埃及的民主崛起和掌权。
en: We saw that dynamic play out in Algeria in the early 1990’s, with the Islamic Salvation Front’s first-round victory in a parliamentary election (which prompted the cancellation of the second round); with Hamas’s electoral victory in Palestine in 2006; and, most recently, with the Muslim Brotherhood’s democratic rise to power in Egypt.

zh: 在阿尔及利亚和埃及，世俗力量无力阻止政治伊斯兰的崛起，只有通过军事接管才能遏制。
en: In both Algeria and Egypt, secular forces were incapable of stemming political Islam’s rise, which could be cut short only by a military takeover.

zh: 阿尔及利亚军事政变最终演变成血腥内战，据估计有超过20万人丧命。
en: The Algerian military coup eventually ushered in a bloody civil war that is estimated to have taken more than 200,000 lives.

zh: 埃及政变的后果可能尚有待发酵。
en: The consequences of the Egyptian coup have still to unfold.

zh: 世俗反对派在坦克的支持下问鼎权力，这可能导致未来多年中伊斯兰教徒的怒火。
en: The secular opposition’s accession to power on the back of a tank might feed the Islamists’ rage for years to come.

zh: 穆斯林兄弟会在民主进程中丧失了信誉，这对埃及来说是一个坏消息，而对相信权力只能来自鲜血和恐怖的基地组织和其他圣战主义者来说这是一针强心剂。
en: The Muslim Brotherhood’s loss of trust in the democratic process would be bad news for Egypt and a boost to Al Qaeda and other jihadists who believe that power can be obtained only through blood and terror.

zh: 让教堂和国家分离的思想与伊斯兰教不相容 — — 前伊朗最高领袖霍梅尼有一句名言 ， “ 伊斯兰教要么是政治，要么什么也不是 ” — —伊斯兰教徒仍然需要证明他们可以服从于民主治理。
en: The concept of separation of church and state is alien to Islam – former Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini once famously declared that “Islam is politics or it is nothing” – and Islamists have still to prove that they are amenable to democratic governance.

zh: 事实上，被推翻的埃及总统穆尔西丢掉政治前途只能怪罪自己。
en: Indeed, Mohamed Morsi, Egypt’s deposed president, has only himself to blame for his political demise.

zh: 他的宗派主义独裁行为导致了埃及的极化，以至于以同情伊斯兰教著称的军队首脑西西（Abdul Fattah al-Sisi）将军也不再支持任命了他的穆尔西。
en: His sectarian, authoritarian behavior polarized his country to such a degree that even the army’s chief, General Abdul Fattah al-Sisi, known for his Islamist sympathies, withdrew his support from the man who had appointed him.

zh: 类似地，伊拉克什叶派-逊尼派战争的死灰复燃在很大程度上是拜总理马利基的宗派统治所赐。
en: Likewise, the revival of the Shia-Sunni civil war in Iraq largely reflects the sectarian rule of Prime Minister Nouri al-Maliki.

zh: 哈马斯在加沙地带的崛起和掌权也没有带来包容性的民主治理。
en: Nor has Hamas’s rise to power in Gaza ushered in inclusive, democratic governance.

zh: 在试图以军事手段推翻哈马斯的选举胜利失败后，巴解组织与其伊斯兰教对手就国民和解问题达成了一致，但这份契约无异于废纸一张。
en: After having failed to reverse Hamas’s electoral victory by military means, the PLO agreed with its Islamist rivals on a plan for national reconciliation; but this pact remains a dead letter.

zh: 再看叙利亚，针对阿拉伯世界最世俗的独裁政权之一的革命退化为一场逊尼派和什叶派之间的殊死斗争，并且可能溢出到中东地区的其他国家。
en: As for Syria, the revolt against one of the most secular autocracies in the Arab world has degenerated into a fight to the death between Sunnis and Shia that is spilling over to other countries in the region.

zh: 如今，一场针对社会复兴党政权及其什叶派盟友伊朗和真主党的逊尼派圣战已经打响。
en: A Sunni jihad has now been launched against the Baath regime and its Shia allies, Iran and Hezbollah.

zh: 存在严重逊尼派-什叶派冲突的邻国黎巴嫩已经受到了直接影响。
en: Neighboring Lebanon, with its fierce Sunni-Shia divide, is already being directly affected.

zh: 马格里布（Maghreb）的宗教和国家之争没有那么暴力，但也具有爆发性潜力。
en: The struggle between religion and state in the Maghreb is less violent, but potentially explosive nonetheless.

zh: 阿拉伯之春的起源地突尼斯如今也有世俗派和原教旨主义者纠缠不清。
en: Tunisia, where the Arab Spring began, is now caught between secularists and religious fundamentalists.

zh: 伊斯兰复兴运动党（Islamist Ennahda）领导着突尼斯政府，但它面临来自极端保守的沙拉菲派伊斯兰解放党（Hizb Ut-Tahrir）的严重挑战。
en: The Islamist Ennahda party leads the government, but it faces a serious challenge from the ultra-conservative Salafists of Hizb Ut-Tahrir.

zh: 在摩洛哥，国王穆罕默德四世毫不隐瞒他对埃及政变的支持，但领导摩洛哥政府的伊斯兰正义和发展党（Islamist Justice and Development Party，JDP）意见相反。
en: In Morocco, King Mohammed VI did not conceal his support for the Egyptian coup, but the Islamist Justice and Development Party, which leads his government, denounced it.

zh: 事实上，世俗中右翼政党独立党（Istiqlal）在埃及政变前夕脱离了政府，并指责以首相本基兰（Abdelilah Benkirane）为首的JDP试图通过效仿穆尔西在埃及那样垄断权力使摩洛哥“埃及化 ” 。
en: Indeed, Istiqlal, a secular center-right party, left the government in the wake of the Egyptian coup, accusing the JDP, under Prime Minister Abdelilah Benkirane, of trying to “Egyptianize” Morocco by monopolizing power, as Morsi did in Egypt.

zh: 甚至在让伊斯兰教和民主相协调的愿望十分强烈的非阿拉伯的穆斯林国家土耳其，总理埃尔多安的伊斯兰教政府和城市中产阶级之间就限制官方对世俗生活方式指手画脚问题所达成的一致也在动摇之中。
en: Even in Turkey, a non-Arab Muslim country with strong aspirations to reconcile Islam with democracy, the agreement between Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s Islamist government and the urban middle class to limit official encroachment on secular lifestyles is unraveling.

zh: 如今埃尔多安誓要按他自己的独裁和宗教形象“重建土耳其 ” 。
en: Erdoğan now promises to “reconstruct Turkey” in his own authoritarian and religious image.

zh: 阿拉伯人迈向自由的长征之路注定是漫长而曲折的 — — 或许将是21世纪的主要地缘政治考验。
en: The Arabs’ march to freedom is bound to be a long and tortuous process – perhaps the main geopolitical test of the twenty-first century.

zh: 但阿拉伯世界的世俗和宗教之争并不需要像欧洲那样持续几百年，原因很简单：当代人可以从让西方通往现代民主的社会和科学进步的长期过程中获益。
en: Yet the battle between secularism and religion in the Arab world does not have to last centuries, as it did in Europe, if only because contemporary generations can benefit from the long process of social and scientific progress that enabled the West to pave the way to modern democracy.

zh: 但让当代阿拉伯世界接受这一西方遗产、同时复兴阿拉伯自身的宽容和擅长科学的中世纪传统将是十分困难的。
en: But adapting this Western legacy for the contemporary Arab world, while recovering Arabs’ own medieval heritage of tolerance and scientific excellence, will be difficult.

zh: 但愿在埃及受到打击的伊斯兰教能告别复仇的政治，走向反省，认识到民主不是赢家通吃的零和博弈。
en: One hopes that Egypt’s defeated Islamists will move from the politics of vengeance to a soul-searching process that leads to the recognition that democracy is not a zero-sum game in which the winner takes all.

zh: 穆尔西所采纳的列宁主义的“民主集中制”如果持续下去，将是对旧国家组织中的新一代人及其盟友的崛起的挑衅，这甚至会导致内战的代价。
en: The Leninist “democratic centralism” to which Morsi seemed to have subscribed, if maintained, will be a standing provocation to the new generations and their allies in the old state apparatus to rise up, even at the price of civil war.

zh: 出售中的埃及
en: Egypt for Sale

zh: 开罗 — — 沙特阿拉伯国王萨尔曼上周访问埃及签署了22项协议，包括一项220亿美元的石油协议撑起埃及垂死的经济。
en: CAIRO – Last week’s visit to Egypt by King Salman of Saudi Arabia resulted in 22 agreements, including a $22 billion oil deal to prop up Egypt’s moribund economy.

zh: 但这样大方的援助需要付出代价：埃及不得不放弃1950年沙特阿拉伯割让给它的两座红海岛屿。
en: But the lavish aid came at a price: Egypt had to relinquish two Red Sea islands ceded to it by Saudi Arabia in 1950.

zh: 此举拆穿了埃及领导人关于该国依然是地区大国的谎言。
en: The move exposed the Egyptian leadership’s narrative that the country remains a major regional power as a lie.

zh: 事实上，埃及甚至无法应对依赖超额补贴的迅速增长的人口所造成的国内难题 — — 圣战分子非常成功的利用了这一局势。
en: Indeed, Egypt cannot even handle domestic challenges posed by a rapidly growing population dependent on unaffordable subsidies – a situation that jihadists are exploiting with much success.

zh: 埃及究竟怎样陷入到如此境地？
en: How did the country reach this point?

zh: 默罕默德·阿里1807年击败英国人使埃及成为第一个赢得事实上独立的阿拉伯国家。
en: When Muhammad Ali defeated the British in 1807, Egypt became the first Arab country to gain de facto independence.

zh: 但阿里之孙伊斯梅尔的挥霍无度浪费了这种独立，造成了一直延续至今的依赖外部援助。
en: But Ali’s grandson, Ismail, squandered that independence with profligate spending, establishing a dependency on external assistance that persists to this day.

zh: 首先，伊斯梅尔被迫于1875年出售埃及在苏伊士运河的股权用于支付其财政赤字。
en: First, Ismail was forced to sell Egypt’s shares in the Suez Canal in 1875 to cover his budget deficits.

zh: 当事实证明这并不足以止住财政大出血时，欧洲债权人成立了一家保障债务支付的委员会。
en: When that proved insufficient to stop the fiscal hemorrhaging, European creditors established a committee to ensure payment.

zh: 到1877年，埃及超过60%的收入都用来还债。
en: By 1877, more than 60% of Egypt’s revenue was servicing this debt.

zh: 1882年，英国为了保护在埃及的投资而控制埃及。
en: In 1882, the British took control of the country to protect their investments.

zh: 埃及对英国的依赖一直到贾迈尔·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔1952年掌权才结束。
en: Egypt’s dependence on the British continued until Gamal Abdel-Nasser took power in 1952.

zh: 纳赛尔张开双臂欢迎苏联，后者为其提供先进的武器以换取曾为其前任带来厄运的同样类型的借据。
en: He welcomed the Soviets, who provided sophisticated weapons in exchange for the same kinds of IOUs that doomed his predecessor.

zh: 到1970年纳赛尔去世时，苏联海军已经将亚历山大港变成了以俄语为第二语言的事实上的苏联加盟共和国。
en: By the time Nasser died in 1970, the Soviet Navy had transformed the port of Alexandria into a virtual Soviet republic, with Russian spoken as a second language.

zh: 此外，纳赛尔还奉行代价昂贵的民粹主义经济政策。
en: Meanwhile, Nasser pursued costly populist economic policies.

zh: 他拓展了官僚机构，为每一位大学毕业生提供了一份政府闲职；今天，政府雇佣了该国24%的劳动力。
en: He expanded the bureaucracy by offering every college graduate a government sinecure; today, 24% of the workforce is employed by the state.

zh: 他为从面包到石油的所有商品提供补贴，2013-2014年占比高达 GDP的8.1 % 。
en: He introduced subsidies for commodities, from bread to oil, that amounted to 8.1% of GDP in 2013-2014.

zh: 2014-2015年，81%的预算都用来还债、支付补贴和工资，挤占了对长期增长至关重要的教育和其他投资。
en: In 2014-2015, 81% of the budget went to debt service, subsidies, and wages, crowding out education and other investments essential to long-term growth.

zh: 所有这些都加剧了埃及对国外援助的急需。
en: All of this intensified Egypt’s need for foreign aid.

zh: 而且事实上，尽管纳赛尔具有亲苏倾向，直到1967年与以色列的灾难性战争冻结埃美关系之前，埃及一直是美国对外援助的最大接受国。
en: And, in fact, despite Nasser’s pro-Soviet bent, Egypt was the largest recipient of American foreign aid until its disastrous war with Israel in 1967 froze relations.

zh: 因为无法在军事上挑战以色列，苏联飞行员在苏伊士运河上空与以色列对手展开了空中格斗。
en: Unable to challenge Israel militarily, Soviet pilots engaged Israeli adversaries in dogfights over the Suez Canal.

zh: 热衷于抨击帝国主义和经济从属性的纳赛尔亲手让自己的国家成为了附庸。
en: Nasser, who railed against imperialism and economic subservience, had delivered his country into vassalage.

zh: 纳赛尔的继任者安瓦尔·萨达特试图通过自由化重振埃及经济、与以色列握手言和，并放弃与苏联结盟而转向西欧和美国。
en: Nasser’s successor, Anwar Sadat, attempted to revive Egypt by liberalizing the economy, making peace with Israel, and abandoning the alliance with the Soviets in favor of the US and Western Europe.

zh: 他因此获得了每年超过20亿美元的援助奖励。
en: He was rewarded with an aid package that averaged more than $2 billion per year.

zh: 但因为埃及人口年增长2.2 % ， 就连这笔巨款也不足以应付支出。
en: But, with Egypt’s population growing at an annual rate of 2.2%, even this was not enough.

zh: 今天，埃及同样依赖于欧洲和波斯湾国家所提供的援助，援助渠道包括阿拉伯经济和社会发展基金、阿布扎比发展基金和沙特发展基金。
en: Today, Egypt also depends on aid from Europe and the Persian Gulf, delivered through, for example, the Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development, the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development, and the Saudi Fund for Development.

zh: 阿拉伯经济发展科威特基金会已经为埃及提供了25亿美元 — — 其中超过50%是无偿援助 — — 埃及也因此成为该机构最大的援助接收国。
en: The Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development has given Egypt $2.5 billion – more than 50% in the form of grants – making Egypt its largest aid recipient.

zh: 上述援助通过投资基础设施项目和提供预算救济对埃及经济起到了支撑���用。
en: Such aid props up Egypt’s economy by funding infrastructure projects and providing budgetary relief.

zh: 偶尔发生的债务勾销也提供了帮助。
en: The occasional debt write-off also helps.

zh: 埃及人很少听到自己国家的财政困境。
en: Egyptians rarely hear about their country’s dire financial straits.

zh: 相反，政府控制的媒体吹嘘新桥梁落成和工业生产增加，同时强调埃及在地区事务中的作用，比方说陷入休眠状态的以巴和平进程以及拼凑在一起的黎巴嫩政府。
en: Instead, the government-controlled press boasts about new bridges and increased industrial production, while highlighting Egypt’s role in regional affairs, such as the dormant Israeli-Palestinian peace process and the cobbling together of governments in Lebanon.

zh: 这样的宣传是为了继续维持埃及在中东具有强大和独特地位的神话。
en: Such propaganda aims to sustain the myth that Egypt holds a unique and powerful position in the Middle East.

zh: 可以肯定，和其他多数阿拉伯国家（尤其是黎巴嫩和也门）不同，埃及有着植根于古代法老帝国的民族认同感。
en: To be sure, unlike in most other Arab countries, particularly Lebanon and Yemen, Egypt has a sense of national identity, rooted in the Pharaonic empires of antiquity.

zh: 而该国在很大程度上同质化的人口 — — 逊尼派穆斯林占90%以上 — — 也令其避免陷入困扰伊拉克和叙利亚等国家的宗派冲突并且成立了强大的中央政府。
en: And its largely homogenous population – 90% Sunni Muslim – has allowed it to avoid the sectarian conflicts plaguing countries like Iraq and Syria, and to forge a strong central government.

zh: 但埃及领导人编造的地区领导故事听上去越来越空洞。
en: But the narrative of regional dominance that Egypt’s leaders have fashioned increasingly rings hollow.

zh: 每年大学毕业的750，000埃及人需要的不是基于过去辉煌的空洞承诺，他们需要工作。
en: The 750,000 Egyptians who graduate from college each year want jobs, not empty promises based on past glory.

zh: 在大幅下降的旅游业从业的非熟练劳动力渴望外国游客重新流入。
en: The unskilled laborers in the decimated tourist industry pine for foreigners to return.

zh: 而工厂工人所向往的生产水平也是当地无业消费者的购买力所无法维持的。
en: And factory workers yearn for production levels that local unemployed consumers’ purchasing power cannot sustain.

zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒 - 法塔赫·塞西不但满足不了这些迫切的需求，反而被迫将领土交还给沙特以换取国家支撑下去所需要的援助。
en: Instead of delivering on these imperatives, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has been forced to relinquish territory to the Saudis to secure the aid the country needs to stay afloat, facing considerable mockery in the process.

zh: 但在中东政治的零和游戏中，一方的损失就是另一方的收益。
en: In the zero-sum game that is Middle East politics, however, one party’s loss is another’s gain.

zh: 而在今天埃及的情况下，从大众对政府的希望幻灭中受益最大的是极端伊斯兰分子。
en: And in the case of Egypt today, it is radical Islamists who are reaping the rewards of popular disillusionment with the government.

zh: 伊斯兰分子有他们自己的解释：现代民主国家已经满足不了阿拉伯人和穆斯林的需求。
en: The Islamists are offering their own narrative: The modern nation-state has failed Arabs and Muslims.

zh: 这在每天都亲眼目睹国家失败的民众当中引发了强烈的共鸣。
en: This resonates with a population that is experiencing the state’s failure every day.

zh: 着眼于恢复过去伊斯兰教的辉煌正在变得比重建一个或许永远无法确保巴勒斯坦人权利的地区大国更具吸引力。
en: Focusing on restoring past Islamic glory is becoming more appealing than resurrecting a regional power that could never even secure rights for Palestinians.

zh: 埃及领导人仍然掌握着遏制这个危险故事的合法性和能力。
en: Egypt’s leaders retain the legitimacy and strength needed to curtail this dangerous narrative.

zh: 但如果想要取得成功，他们必须认清埃及的能力边界。
en: But, if they are to succeed, they will have to acknowledge what Egypt is – and what it is not.

zh: 在一个深深珍爱所有古文物的国家，地区大国神话应当是一个迅速消失的遗留物。
en: In a country where ancient artifacts are deeply cherished, the myth of regional greatness is one relic that should disappear soon.

zh: 埃及大决战
en: Showdown in Egypt

zh: 伦敦 — — 在选出首任平民总统一年后的6月30日，埃及国内爆发了大规模反政府抗议活动。 遍布各地的抗议活动多种多样，对穆罕默德·穆尔西总统继续执政构成了前所未有的挑战。
en: LONDON – With massive anti-government protests across Egypt on June 30 – a year to the day after Egyptians elected their first-ever civilian president – a diverse and decentralized movement has challenged President Mohammad Morsi’s hold on power as never before.

zh: 成千上万人走上街头，很多人强行攻占并烧毁了执政党穆斯林兄弟会在开罗的总部。
en: Hundreds of thousands were mobilized to take to the streets, with many storming and burning down the Cairo headquarters of the ruling Muslim Brotherhood.

zh: 当天傍晚，总统接到最后通牒。
en: At the end of the day, the president was given an ultimatum.

zh: 埃及基层新的反抗（Tamarod）运动首次发表“革命”声明要求穆尔西在两天内离开，否则就要到总统府门前举行示威活动。
en: The first “revolutionary” statement of Egypt’s new grassroots Tamarod (rebel) movement demanded that Morsi leave within two days or face a march on the presidential palace.

zh: “我们代表2200万群众宣布穆罕默德·穆尔西不再是埃及的合法总统。
en: “In the name of 22 million citizens, we declare that Mohammad Morsi is no longer the legitimate President of Egypt.”

zh: ”抗议者接下来呼吁“政府、军警和司法部门顺应民意的要求。 ”
en: The protesters then appealed to “the institutions of the state, the army, the police, and the judiciary to side with the popular will.”

zh: 军方以向穆尔西发出最后通牒的方式做出了表态：答应抗议者的要求，否则将武力解决冲突。
en: The army has spoken, issuing an ultimatum of its own to Morsi: Address the protesters’ demands or face a military solution to the crisis.

zh: 当天傍晚，穆尔西办公室宣布军方发布声明前并未征询他们的意见，成千上万的总统支持者午夜在数个城市同时举行示威活动。
en: As the day ended, Morsi’s office declared that it had not been consulted prior to the army’s statement, and tens of thousands of the president’s supporters demonstrated in several cities simultaneously at midnight.

zh: 局势将会如何发展？
en: So what will happen next?

zh: 反抗（Tamarod）运动和军事干预将如何影响埃及脆弱的民主化进程？
en: And what impact will the Tamarod movement and the army intervention have on Egypt’s precarious democratization process?

zh: 今天危机的爆发并不出人意料。
en: The path to today’s crisis was predictable.

zh: 穆尔西赢得总统大选的得票率仅有51.7 % ， 而其余48.3%则包括穆巴拉克政权及其支持者在内的强大力量。
en: Morsi won the presidential election with only 51.7% of the vote, while the other 48.3% included very powerful forces, including figures from the Mubarak regime and their supporters.

zh: 2012年11月为夺取绝对权力废除宪法宣言激化了政府与反对派的矛盾，穆尔西这么做据说是为了保护埃及新生的脆弱机构不受政治化司法体制的影响。
en: Opposition to Morsi hardened following the annulled November 2012 constitutional declaration, by which he had sought sweeping powers – allegedly to protect the country’s infant elected institutions against a politicized judiciary.

zh: 埃及百姓物质收益的欠缺也助长了公众的愤怒。
en: The lack of tangible material gains for ordinary Egyptians also fueled public anger.

zh: 所有总统候选人都做出了大胆的承诺。 但在承诺兑现方面（比方说解决该国长期以来的天然气及电力短缺）缺乏明显进展助长了大规模的反穆尔西运动。
en: All of the presidential candidates had made wild promises; but the absence of significant achievement, such as resolving the country’s chronic shortages of gas and electricity, helped to fuel the massive anti-Morsi mobilization.

zh: 政治转型期的无能往往需要付出高昂的代价。
en: Incompetence during a political transition has a high price.

zh: 但穆尔西也并非全无政绩或支持者。
en: But Morsi is not entirely without accomplishments or supporters.

zh: 去年8月，他剔除了武装部队最高委员会（SCAF）领袖。
en: Last August, he culled the leaders of the Supreme Council of the Armed Forces (SCAF).

zh: 而在经济领域，由于旅游收入增加及债务减免，埃及央行2012年7月至2013年3月期间的报告显示该国国际收支逆差出现了从112亿美元到21亿美元的明显下降。
en: On the economic front, the Egyptian Central Bank’s report for the period of July 2012 to March 2013 indicates that the balance-of-payments deficit fell from $11.2 billion to $2.1 billion, owing to rising tourism revenues and debt forgiveness.

zh: 上述经济改善并未惠及普通百姓，也没有通过有效的��体及沟通战略善加利用。
en: This improvement did not trickle down to ordinary citizens, and there was no effective media and communication strategy to capitalize on it.

zh: 但穆尔西的核心支持者却从未动摇过。
en: But Morsi’s core supporters remain committed.

zh: 尽管革命期间只有区区数百人现身支持靠欺诈当选的穆巴拉克，却有成千上万的埃及民众为声援穆尔西而在拉比雅·阿德维娅广场的总统府附近连续集会两周。
en: Whereas only a few hundred showed up to support the fraudulently elected Mubarak during the revolution, hundreds of thousands of Egyptians rallied for two consecutive weeks in Rab‘a al-‘Adawiyya square, near the presidential palace, to express their solidarity with Morsi.

zh: 只有依靠军队保障政府安全穆尔西才能继续执政。
en: If Morsi survives in office, he will have to rely on the army to guarantee his government’s safety.

zh: 他的支持者也必须展示强大的力量。
en: He will also need a massive show of strength from his supporters.

zh: 但这意味着军队将回归到政治核心 — — 进而牺牲掉强化民众控制这一穆尔西去年8月当选以来的最大进步。
en: But this would mean returning the army to the center of politics – and thus sacrificing the gains from Morsi’s imposition last August of greater civilian control.

zh: 而且最后通牒显示军方正准备发动政变。
en: And the army’s ultimatum indicates that the military is moving in the direction of a coup.

zh: 穆尔西领导的穆斯林兄弟会及其他伊斯兰支持者的参与也颇具冒险性。
en: Mobilization of Morsi’s Muslim Brotherhood and other Islamist supporters is also risky.

zh: 事实上，正在进行的权力斗争有可能逆转引导曾经全副武装的伊斯兰教徒走向选举及宪法政治的革命性步骤。
en: Indeed, the revolutionary step of steering once-armed Islamists toward electoral and constitutional politics could be reversed in ongoing power struggle.

zh: 如果穆尔西无法继续掌权，他将以何种方式下台将在很大程度上决定此后的形势。
en: If Morsi does not remain in power, much will depend on how he is removed.

zh: 依靠街头动员和军队干预迫使拥有基层支持的当选领袖下台不太可能带来好的结果。
en: Reliance on street mobilization and army intervention to bring down an elected leader who has support on the ground is unlikely to lead to a positive outcome.

zh: 相反，曾在1936年西班牙、1953年伊朗、1973年智利、1980年土耳其、1989年苏丹和1992年阿尔及利亚和塔吉克斯坦上演的戏码却往往导致军事独裁、内战或两者兼而有之。
en: On the contrary, that pattern – seen in Spain in 1936, Iran in 1953, Chile in 1973, Turkey in 1980, Sudan in 1989, and Algeria and Tajikistan in 1992 – usually leads to military dictatorships, civil wars, or both.

zh: 但历史上也曾有过当选总统戴高乐和平退出的先例。
en: But there is also Charles de Gaulle’s precedent of a peaceful exit by an elected president.

zh: 1968年法国出现的大规模抗议活动导致提前举行议会选举，而戴高乐的支持者在议会选举中赢得了决定性的胜利。
en: The massive protests in France in 1968 led to an early parliamentary election, which de Gaulle’s supporters won decisively.

zh: 但后来戴高乐却因为一个没那么重要的问题主动选择了辞职。
en: But de Gaulle later resigned of his own volition, over an issue of minor importance.

zh: 问题是穆尔西并不具备戴高乐的背景，而且2013年埃及混乱的政治转型与1968年法国的综合民主根本无法相比。
en: The problem with this precedent is that Morsi does not have de Gaulle’s background, and Egypt’s chaotic political transition of 2013 is far from France’s consolidated democracy of 1968.

zh: 法国的戴高乐主义者并未受到迫害，而一些埃及反对派人物已经发誓决不让穆尔西和穆斯林兄弟会的日子好过。
en: French Gaullists did not face persecution; several Egyptian opposition figures have already vowed that Morsi and the Muslim Brothers will.

zh: 宪法规范及行为缺乏可信的担保在很大程度上加大了政治生存的赌注。
en: That raises the stakes of political survival considerably, especially given the absence of any credible guarantor of constitutional norms and behavior.

zh: 此外，谁有可能代替穆尔西执政目前还不清楚。
en: Moreover, a possible replacement for Morsi is not very clear.

zh: 部分反对派曾经提到渡性“总统委员会 ” 。
en: Parts of the opposition speak of a transitional “presidential council.”

zh: 但部分因为缺少由公认人物出面的民众动员，且更大程度上因为相关政客的妄自尊大，同样的方案已经在武装部队最高委员会执政期间（2011年年2月 - 2012年6月）失败过一次。
en: But that idea failed once already, during the SCAF’s rule (February 2011-June 2012), owing partly to the lack of popular mobilization behind a uniting figure(s), but mostly because of the egos – indeed, megalomania – of the politicians involved.

zh: 没有军方及安全机构的参与几乎可以肯定穆尔西不会下台。
en: Morsi will almost certainly not be removed without the involvement of the army and the security establishment.

zh: 获胜者很可能会阻止伊斯兰势力卷土重来，这意味着新一轮无所不用其极的政治和武装斗争。 在此期间，各方势力会戴着民主的面具合法地排挤和迫害政治对手。
en: And the winners will probably try their best to block the Islamist forces from a comeback, implying another cycle of no-holds-barred political – and perhaps physical – combat, in which democracy serves as a mask to legitimize the exclusion, and possibly the destruction, of one’s political opponents.

zh: 埃及的活死人
en: Egypt’s Dead Men Walking

zh: 开罗—大面积死刑判决常常出现在希特勒的纳粹或波尔布特的红色高棉这样的政权统治下。
en: CAIRO – Mass death sentences are usually associated with regimes like those of Adolf Hitler’s Nazis or Pol Pot’s Khmer Rouge.

zh: 但埃及军事统治者如今也加入了这类政权的行列，进行着如同儿戏的结果早已预订的审判。
en: But Egypt’s military rulers have now joined the ranks of such regimes, staging circus-like trials in which the outcome is foreordained.

zh: 2014年3月进行的一次审判制造了529起死刑；另一次4月份进行的审判产生了683起死刑。
en: One such trial, in March 2014, produced 529 death sentences; another, in April, yielded 683 death sentences.

zh: 并且这一趋势毫无减缓迹象。
en: And the trend shows no signs of slowing.

zh: 上个月，107人 — — 包括埃及首位自由选举总统穆尔西在内 — — 因为被控在2011年1月反前总统穆巴拉克的暴动中集体“越狱”而判处死刑。
en: Last month, 107 people – including Mohamed Morsi, Egypt’s first freely elected president – were handed death sentences for their alleged role in a mass “prison break” during the January 2011 uprising against former President Hosni Mubarak.

zh: 穆尔西还被控“里通外敌 ” — —即真主党和哈马斯 — — 以释放埃及政治犯。
en: Morsi was also accused of “colluding with foreign militants” – that is, Hezbollah and Hamas – in order to free political prisoners in Egypt.

zh: 不久，六名所谓的“阿拉伯沙尔卡斯 ” （ Arab Sharkas）案的被告 — — 他们在2014年10月因被控袭击安全岗而被判处死刑 — — 被执行死刑，尽管地方和国际人士都强烈反对这一漏洞百出的审判。
en: Soon after, the six defendants in the so-called “Arab Sharkas” case – who were handed death sentences in October 2014 for allegedly attacking security posts – were executed, despite a local and international outcry against the flawed trial.

zh: 赫尔米（Ahmed Helmi）是六人中的四人的律师之一，他表示政府希望“在穆尔西的裁决后释放一个信号 ” — —他们会真的执行这些审判。
en: According to Ahmed Helmi, a lawyer for four of the six men, the government wanted to “send a message following Morsi’s verdict” that it would carry out such sentences.

zh: 他说，他的当事人和其他人只是“替罪羊 ” 。
en: His clients and the others, he concluded, were just “scapegoats.”

zh: 埃及军方2013年7月推翻穆尔西以来，民事法庭总共宣判了1,000多起死刑判决。
en: Overall, civilian courts have handed down more than 1,000 death sentences since Egypt’s military overthrew Morsi in July 2013.

zh: 被“定罪”者名单令人侧目：比如，沙欣（Emad Shahin）是世界著名学者、哈佛大学和开罗美利坚大学（American University）教授；阿塞姆（Sondos Asem）是前途无量的年轻学者和政治活动家。
en: The profiles of the “convicts” raise eyebrows: Emad Shahin, for example, is a world-renowned academic who has taught at Harvard and the American University in Cairo; Sondos Asem is a promising young scholar and political activist.

zh: 更糟糕的是，安全部门和军方所实施的法外处决现象猖獗。
en: Making matters worse, extra-judicial killings by the security services and elements in the military are rampant.

zh: 最显著的例子与2013年7月的政变有关，当时埃及警方和军方向开罗拉巴广场（Rab’a Square）反对推翻穆尔西的群众开火，在不到十小时时间内有超过1,000示威者被杀。
en: The most dramatic of these episodes accompanied the coup in July 2013, when Egyptian police and army opened fire on crowds protesting Morsi’s ouster in Cairo’s Rab’a Square, killing more than 1,000 protesters in less than ten hours.

zh: 更晚近一些，开罗夏姆斯大学（Ain Shams University）工科学生、支持被定性为非法的穆斯林兄弟会的阿提托（Islam Atito）被发现死于埃及郊外的沙漠中。
en: More recently, Islam Atito, an engineering student at Cairo’s Ain Shams University who supported the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood, was found dead in the desert on the outskirts of Cairo.

zh: 埃及内政部声称阿提托与“刺杀”某警官的案件有涉，死于安全部队在突袭其“藏身窝点”时的交火。
en: Egypt’s interior ministry claimed that Atito had been involved in the “assassination” of a police officer and was killed in a firefight with security forces during a raid on his “hideout.”

zh: 但根据夏姆斯大学工程学院学生会的说法 — — 全体成员在因为反对杀戮而集体退学 — — 阿提托是在学校参加期末考试时被捕的。
en: But according to the student union of the university’s engineering faculty – whose members collectively resigned in protest against the killing – Atito was arrested during a final exam on the university campus.

zh: 学生会表示，政府劫持并杀害阿提托是因为他是活跃分子。
en: The government, it is claimed, had Atito abducted and murdered in response to his activism.

zh: 一位关注此案的人权律师指出，这只是多起类似案件中的一起 — — 所有这些案件都没有进行严肃调查。
en: As a human-rights lawyer monitoring the case notes, this is just one of several such cases – none of which is being seriously investigated.

zh: 这些司法和法外杀戮反映出埃及当前危机之深刻。
en: These judicial and extra-judicial killings reflect the depth of Egypt’s current crisis.

zh: 控制安全部门和军方的“鹰派”决心要重塑穆巴拉克式的统治，但他们与穆巴拉克有一个关键不同：他们认为穆巴拉克在镇压反对者方面做得远远不够。
en: The “hawks” who control the security and military establishments seem intent on restoring a Mubarak-style regime, but with one key difference: they believe that Mubarak did too little to repress the opposition.

zh: 对于埃及的现任领导层来说，利比亚的卡扎菲和叙利亚的巴沙尔·阿萨德所采用的残暴策略在埃及的环境中起作用的可能性比上述两国都要大。
en: For Egypt’s current leadership, the brutal tactics employed by the likes of Libya’s Muammar el-Qaddafi and Syria’s Bashar al-Assad are more likely to work in the Egyptian context than in those countries.

zh: 毕竟，国际干预（如利比亚）的概率几乎为零，而全面武装起义（如叙利亚）的可能性也极其有限。
en: After all, the probability of international intervention (as in Libya) is nil, and the likelihood of a full-fledged armed revolution (as in Syria) is extremely limited.

zh: 但依赖武力在一个70%人口不到30岁的国家打击持异见者是一个重大挑战，极有可能血流成河。
en: But relying on force to subdue dissent in a country where 70% of the population is under the age of 30 will be a major challenge, if not resulting in a bloodbath.

zh: 埃及鹰派的残暴政策也让反对派发生了改变。
en: The brutal policies of Egypt’s hawks have also transformed the opposition.

zh: 在2013年反对穆尔西被推翻的静坐示威中，穆斯林兄弟会最高领袖巴迪（Mohamed Badie）宣布 — — 这句话���来成为穆斯林兄弟会的战斗口号 — — “我们的平和比他们的子弹更强大。
en: At a 2013 sit-in protesting Morsi’s ouster, the Muslim Brotherhood’s Supreme Guide, Mohamed Badie, declared, in what became a rallying cry for the movement, “Our peacefulness is stronger than their bullets.”

zh: ”但是，此后巴迪因多项指控（其中一项与南部明亚省袭击警署的案件有关）被判处死刑，这句话也成为对包括穆兄会成员在内的年轻政治活动家的苦涩嘲讽。
en: But, with Badie having since been sentenced to death in multiple cases (including one related to attacks on police stations in the southern province of Minya), the phrase has become the subject of bitter mockery among young political activists, including Brotherhood members.

zh: 穆斯林兄弟会所属新闻网站Rassd最近公开了一封由该组织前总书记戈兹兰（Mahmoud Ghozlan）所写的信，信中主张“革命”继续以非暴力的形式进行。
en: Rassd, a Brotherhood-affiliated news website, recently published a letter (link in Arabic) by the group’s former secretary-general, Mahmoud Ghozlan, asserting that the “revolution” will continue to be non-violent.

zh: 但该网站还公开了年轻的穆兄会活跃分子对戈兹兰的立场的批评 — — 对于极少公开内部异见的组织来说，这是一个引人注目的情况。
en: But it also published harsh criticism of Ghozlan’s position by young Brotherhood activists – a notable development for an organization in which dissent is rarely publicized.

zh: 事实上，年轻成员中的愤怒情绪已经十分尖锐，据埃及穆斯林兄弟会海外行政办公室（Administrative Office Abroad，组织数千名目前处于流亡状态的穆兄会成员的新机构）主管阿卜杜尔-拉曼（Ahmed Abdel-Rahman）透露，穆兄会因此换掉了65%的领导层。
en: In fact, anger among younger members has become so acute that the Brotherhood has allegedly changed some 65% of its leadership, according to Ahmed Abdel-Rahman, the head of the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood Administrative Office Abroad (a new body that organizes the thousands of Brotherhood members now in exile).

zh: 穆兄会还采取了强硬路线，公开宣称其政府在2011年和2012年议会和总统选举后采取的“改革主义”方针是“错误的 ” ， 将非伊斯兰革命青年组织排除在外更是“严重错误 ” 。
en: The organization has also adopted a harsher line, having publicly stated that the “reformist” approach that its government took after winning parliamentary and presidential elections in 2011 and 2012 was “wrong”, and that excluding non-Islamist revolutionary youth groups was a “major mistake.”

zh: 考虑到埃及的大面积死刑判决、法外暴力和鹰派主导安全部门和军方，再加上穆斯林兄弟会的言辞、行为和组织变化，妥协的可能性一天比一天小。
en: Given Egypt’s mass death sentences, extrajudicial violence, and the dominance of hawks in the security and the military establishments, together with the rhetorical, behavioral, and organizational changes within the Muslim Brotherhood, the chances of reconciliation are fading by the day.

zh: 在“妥协”被视为脏话的环境中，埃及的未来恐怕不妙。
en: In an environment in which “compromise” is regarded as a dirty word, Egypt’s future appears to be far from bright.

zh: 埃及要的是总统，不是法老
en: Egypt Needs a President, Not a Pharaoh

zh: 一场全国政治改革的热烈讨论正在埃及进行，核心事件是所有反对党和民间社团一致要求修改1971年宪法，取消1981年安瓦尔·萨达特遇刺后实行达23年之久的紧急状态。
en: Egypt is undergoing a heated nationwide debate over political reform. The central issue is a demand by all opposition parties and civil society groups to amend the 1971 constitution and abolish the 23-year-old State of Emergency that was imposed following Anwar Sadat's assassination in 1981.

zh: 这个要求早已不再新鲜，但从20世纪80年代中起就遭到胡斯尼·穆巴拉克总统和执政的民族民主党的重重阻挠。
en: Such demands are not new. But President Hosni Mubarak and the ruling National Democratic Party have been stonewalling since the mid-1980's.

zh: 使这次改革呼声更为迫切的是埃及目前的困难状态，以及在地区和国际事务中的险恶环境。
en: What makes the demands for reform more pressing this time are ominous developments in Egypt, the region, and in the wider world.

zh: 在国内，对穆巴拉克年龄（76岁）和健康状况恶化的忧虑日益增长。
en: At home, concern about Mubarak's age (76) and deteriorating health has grown.

zh: 近年来虽然一直谣传穆巴拉克的身体状况十分糟糕，但直到2003年11月再也无法隐瞒的时候官方才予以证实。
en: Mubarak's ill health, widely rumored for years, was never officially acknowledged until November 2003, when it could no longer be covered up.

zh: 在议会讲话时，穆巴拉克在成百上千万电视观众面前昏了过去。
en: While speaking to Parliament, Mubarak fainted before millions of TV viewers.

zh: 尽管他1小时后就恢复了知觉，并完成了那次讲话，埃及人还是开始要求对总统健康状况更多的知情权，其它国事领域也是如此。
en: Although he returned an hour later and delivered the rest of his speech, Egyptians began to demand greater transparency regarding the president's health as well as other state affairs.

zh: 与此同时，埃及日益下滑的经济、居高不下的失业率和肆意蔓延的腐败使很多青年人陷入绝望。
en: Meanwhile, Egypt's sagging economy, high unemployment rate, and rampant corruption have driven many Egyptian youngsters to despair.

zh: 埃及半数以上的现有人口都是穆巴拉克执政后出生的。
en: More than one half of living Egyptians were born since Mubarak assumed office.

zh: 援引联合国开发计划署不久前的一份报告，约半数15到30岁之间的埃及人梦想移民到欧洲、北美或澳大利亚。
en: According to a recent report by the UN Development Program, roughly half of those between 15 and 30 years old dream of emigrating to Europe, North America, or Australia.

zh: 每周都有所谓埃及非法移民命丧地中海的报道。
en: There are weekly reports of would-be illegal Egyptian immigrants drowning in the Mediterranean.

zh: 几个星期前，几个年轻人被装在超载的卡车里遣返回埃及，途中路过利比亚沙漠时甚至窒息而死。
en: A few weeks ago, several youngsters suffocated to death while being deported back to Egypt across the Libyan desert in overloaded trucks.

zh: 这一事件激起了民众的愤慨，迫使埃及当局逮捕、讯问并审判了负责押送的几名埃及警官。
en: The incident caused an uproar that compelled the authorities to arrest, interrogate, and try the Egyptian police officers in charge.

zh: 地区和国际事务也推动了埃及的反对浪潮，人们不仅要求改革，而且提出修改有关总统任命的宪法条款。
en: Regional and international events have also emboldened the Egyptian opposition, not only to press for reform, but to focus on amending the constitution's articles that pertain to the presidency.

zh: 穆巴拉克已经连续四次当选，传言还表明他会谋求第五次六年任期，或者建立"世袭"共和国，培养41岁的儿子贾迈勒·穆巴拉克接班，就像叙利亚总统哈菲兹·阿萨德和儿子巴沙尔·阿萨德一样。
en: Mubarak has been re-elected four times, and rumors have persisted that he will either seek a fifth six-year term or establish a "hereditary republic" and groom his 41-year old son, Gamal, to succeed him, like Syria's Hafez al-Assad and son, Bashar.

zh: 反对派的斗争口号是阻止穆巴拉克再次连任，并阻止他将大权传给贾迈勒。
en: The opposition battle cry is "No" to Mubarak's re-election and "No" to passing the presidency to Gamal.

zh: 很多埃及人也许对贾迈勒·穆巴拉克本人并无反感，但在父亲24年的漫长统治后，再由儿子继续统治24年甚至更长时间，却让他们感到苦不堪言。
en: Many Egyptians may not have major misgivings about Gamal Mubarak per se, but they find it mortifying that, after 24 years of the father, they might be stuck with another 24 or more years of the son.

zh: 现行宪法于1971年10月生效，共211条，其中30条与总统任命有关。
en: The current constitution was adopted in October 1971, and has 211 articles, 30 of which concern the presidency.

zh: 总统系由埃及人民议会三分之二的议员提名任命，再由公民投票进行简单的"是 " " 否"表决。
en: The president is nominated by two-thirds of the People's Assembly, and endorsed in a plebiscite that allows only for a simple "Yes" or "No."

zh: 赢得六年任期只需符合简单多数，且任期可以通过同样程序无限延长。
en: A simple majority of the ballots is required to win a six-year term, which is renewable indefinitely by the same process.

zh: 如此宽松的程序却与总统的权力形成了鲜明的对比。
en: These lax procedures contrast jarringly with the president's powers.

zh: 总统身为国家首脑和军队司令，全权管辖最高司法委员会、最高警察委员会和部长内阁，可以全权决定一个或多个副总统的任命或罢免。
en: The president is the head of state and commander-in-chief; officiates over the Supreme Judiciary Council, the Supreme Police Council, and the Cabinet of Ministers; and can appoint and recall one or more vice-presidents at his sole discretion.

zh: 总统也负责任命总理和高级部长，且必须批准所有的部长、大使和政府代表的任命。
en: He also appoints the prime minister and senior ministers, and must approve all other ministers, ambassadors, and state representatives.

zh: 他可以召集大选、宣布战争、执行紧急状态和颁布有法律效力的政令。
en: He can call general elections, declare war, impose a state of emergency, and issue decrees that have the force of law.

zh: 根本没有权力的制衡。
en: There are no checks and balances on these powers.

zh: 有条款规定 ， " 控告总统犯叛国罪或其它罪行须由人民议会三分之一以上的议员提出动议，并得到三分之二以上议员的批准。
en: A single article stipulates that, "Accusation of the President of committing grand treason or any other criminal act may be made upon a motion submitted by at least one-third of members of the People's Assembly and approved by two-thirds."

zh: "满足上述条件则暂停行使总统权力，由副总统暂时接任直至审判完成。
en: The president is then suspended from carrying out his duties, and the vice-president fills in until the accusation is resolved.

zh: 但穆巴拉克却从未颁布执行上述条款的必要法律，也从未任命过副总统，尽管人们要求的呼声此起彼伏。
en: But Mubarak has never enacted the law essential to implementing this article or appointed a vice-president, despite repeated popular demands to do so.

zh: 其结果导致了事实上的"帝王总统 " ， 甚至有人把他比作古埃及神圣的法老王。
en: The result has been a de facto "imperial presidency," with Mubarak likened to the god-king Pharaohs of ancient Egypt.

zh: 没有任何现代的国家领袖拥有这样的权力。
en: No other head of state in modern times enjoys as much power.

zh: 埃及流行将穆巴拉克比作勃列日涅夫，此君在苏联停滞和衰退时期统治长达20年以上。
en: A more apt analogy popular in Egypt compares Mubarak to Leonid Brezhnev, who for two decades presided over the Soviet Union's stagnation and decline.

zh: 在穆巴拉克的统治下，埃及作为地区大国的地位日渐削弱。
en: Egypt's status as a regional power under Mubarak has similarly weakened steadily.

zh: 经济领域内，年外资流入额从20世纪90年代中期的30亿美元直线下降到2003年的区区3亿美元。
en: On the economic front, annual foreign investment inflows have plummeted from $3 billion in the mid-1990's to a minuscule $300 million in 2003.

zh: 改革要求目前集中在由两个或更多的竞争者参与总统直选，并将总统任期限制在连任不超过两届。
en: Demands for reform are now focused on introducing direct presidential elections with two or more contenders, and limiting presidents to two consecutive terms in office.

zh: 除此之外，削弱总统的绝对权力和建立可行的公共官员责任机制也有着同样重要的意义。
en: It is no less important to reduce the presidency's sweeping powers and formulate viable mechanisms for enforcing the accountability of all public officials without exception.

zh: 如果穆巴拉克及其政府未能提出满足要求的宪法修正案，就会有更多的埃及人脱离现政权，为在其它国家寻求解脱而心甘情愿冒着生命的危险。
en: Should Mubarak and his government fail to recommend constitutional amendments that satisfy these demands, ever more Egyptians will desert the regime and risk their lives in search of salvation in other lands.

zh: 约旦眼中的埃及
en: Egypt on Jordan’s Mind

zh: 安曼—约旦皇家法院（Royal Court）在穆斯林兄弟会的穆尔西宣布取得埃及总统大选胜利后这几天的行为颇有点意思。
en: AMMAN – The behavior of Jordan’s Royal Court in the days following the official announcement of the victory of the Muslim Brotherhood’s Mohamed Morsi in Egypt’s presidential election tells an intriguing story.

zh: 一开始，约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世对于签署人们期待已久的选举法犹豫不决。
en: At first, Jordan’s King Abdullah II hesitated to sign a long-sought-after election law.

zh: 接着，选举法被批准，但又被要求进行修订，还出人意料地与哈马斯领导人进行了正式会晤。
en: This was followed by approval of the law, a request for its revision, and a surprise official meeting with the leader of Hamas.

zh: 过去一年来，阿卜杜拉国王十分坚定地认为约旦人民应该在2012年之前获得自由公平选举的权利。
en: During the past year, King Abdullah has been adamant that Jordanians should vote in free and fair elections no later than the end of 2012.

zh: 约旦宪法进行了修订。
en: Constitutional changes were adopted.

zh: 独立的选举委员会依法成立。
en: An independent election commission was created by law.

zh: 某广受尊敬的法学家、前联合国国际法院法官因阻挠选举法通过而受到了批评。 。
en: And a respected Jordanian jurist who had been a judge at the International Court of Justice was reprimanded for dragging his feet in getting the election law passed.

zh: 既然如此，为什么国王要等待四天才签署这项两院已经通过了的法律？ 为什么他要求立刻修改这项法律？
en: So why did the king wait four days after both houses of parliament passed the law to sign it, and why did he immediately ask for changes?
