zh: 该法建立了一项以单一成员选区为基础的绝对多数制度，在140个议员席位中，只有17个根据国家党派名单选出。 约旦参议院在埃及独立选举委员会宣布穆尔西胜出之前批准了这项法律。
en: The law, which establishes a largely majoritarian system based on single-member districts, with only 17 of the parliament’s 140 seats to be elected according to national party lists, was approved by Jordan’s Senate just hours before Egypt’s independent election commission declared Morsi the winner.

zh: 据约旦政府和王室成员告诉我，他们原本认为穆巴拉克时期的末代总理莎菲克会赢得大选。
en: People to whom I spoke in Jordan’s government and palace say that they were led to believe that the post would go to Mubarak’s last prime minister, Ahmed Shafiq.

zh: 穆尔西的胜利改变了一切。
en: Morsi’s victory changed everything.

zh: 2010年，约旦穆斯林兄弟会曾抵制约旦议会选举，声称政府“没有提供任何诚信保证 ” 。
en: Jordan’s Muslim Brotherhood boycotted the country’s parliamentary election in 2010, arguing that the government “did not provide any guarantees of its integrity.”

zh: 在2007年的选举中，穆斯林兄弟会指责政府“舞弊 ” ， 并反对多数获胜的选举规则。
en: In the 2007 election, the Brotherhood accused the government of “fraud,” and opposed the majoritarian electoral system.

zh: 阿拉伯之春爆发伊始，约旦曾承诺进行全面的政治改革，此后，埃及高级官员一直在慢慢地开倒车。
en: Senior officials in Jordan have been slowly walking back from the comprehensive political reforms that were promised in the initial euphoria of the Arab Spring.

zh: 包括前首相哈苏奈（Awn Khasawneh）在内的许多人认为这反映了约旦高官的想法：阿拉伯之春在约旦和该地区已是明日黄花。
en: Many, including former Prime Minister Awn Khasawneh, believe that this reflects a belief among senior Jordanian officials that the Arab Spring has run its course in Jordan and the region.

zh: 毕竟，群众示威运动并未形成气候；巴沙尔牢牢地控制着叙利亚；而既无宪法又无议会的埃及即使不能说陷入了一片混乱，显然也在和民主渐行渐远。
en: After all, popular protests have failed to gather steam; Bashar al-Assad’s regime has held firm in Syria; and Egypt, with neither a constitution nor a parliament, has apparently veered from democracy, if not descended into chaos.

zh: 哈苏奈曾鼓励伊斯兰主义者加入政治进程中，还促成了与巴勒斯坦伊斯兰运动组织哈马斯的和解。 但他也警告说，认为阿拉伯之春已经失败是错误的。
en: But Khasawneh, who had encouraged Islamists to join the political process, and forged a rapprochement with the Palestinian Islamic movement Hamas, warns that it is a mistake to write off the Arab Spring.

zh: 5月份次之后不久，他警告约旦领导人不要对改革进程感到自满。
en: In May, shortly after his resignation, he warned Jordanian leaders of complacency in the reform process.

zh: 在被保守派取代之后，哈苏奈最后说的话是提醒约旦领导人，阿拉伯之春随时随地会再次灿烂。
en: His last word after being replaced by a conservative was to remind Jordan’s leaders that spring is a season that always returns.

zh: 随着穆尔西在埃及宣布获胜，阿拉伯之春似乎以比哈苏奈所设想的速度更快地卷土重来了。
en: With the announcement of Morsi’s victory in Egypt, spring seems to have returned to Jordan more quickly than even Khasawneh had expected.

zh: 穆斯林兄弟会在约旦的政党伊斯兰行动阵线（Islamic Action Front）仍拒绝多数获胜的选举制度，因为该制度更有利于部落而不是政党和其他重要社会团体。
en: The Islamic Action Front, the Brotherhood’s political party in Jordan, continued to reject the majoritarian electoral system, which favors tribes over political parties and other important social groups.

zh: 特别是，由于全国党派名单影响力相对较小，占选民数量接近一半的巴勒斯坦裔约旦人只能选出很小一部分官员。
en: In particular, owing to the relative insignificance of national party lists, Jordanians of Palestinian origin, who comprise nearly half the electorate, receive only a small percentage of elected officials.

zh: 阿卜杜拉国王批准选举法意味着新成立的选举委员会工作的开始。
en: The King’s approval of the law will allow the newly established election commission to begin its work.

zh: 但现在他还希望议会能使选举法更具代表性。
en: But now he wants the parliament to make the law more representative as well.

zh: 事实上，阿卜杜拉国王在正式会晤中欢迎了哈马斯领导人马沙尔（Khaled Mashal ） ， 这次会晤包括了皇家午宴以及与首相塔拉瓦奈（Fayez Tarawneh）的会面，最重要的是，还包括了曾在1999年建议将马沙尔和其他四名哈马斯高级官员逐出约旦的约旦情报局首脑。
en: Indeed, he welcomed Hamas leader Khaled Mashal in an official meeting that included a royal lunch, meetings with Prime Minister Fayez Tarawneh, and, most important, talks with the head of Jordan’s intelligence service, which in 1999 had recommended the expulsion from Jordan of Mashal and four other senior Hamas officials.

zh: 改善选举法、接纳马沙尔的目的并不止于说服约旦国内的伊斯兰主义者加入到政治进程中来。
en: The decisions to improve the election law and receive Mashal are not aimed solely at persuading Jordan’s own Islamists to join the political process.

zh: 与其他阿拉伯国家一样，拥有700万人口的约旦密切关注着它人口最多、实力最强的阿拉伯邻邦埃及。
en: Like other Arab countries, Jordan, with seven million people, looks up to Egypt, its most populous and powerful Arab neighbor.

zh: 从经济上讲，约旦仍需依赖埃及获得天然气（所需费用已得到了削减 ） 。
en: And, economically, Jordan is still dependent on Egypt for natural gas, which is delivered at reduced rates.

zh: 约旦似乎已经算定了政治算盘，认为改善与埃及新领导人的关系而不是与他们相抗才是上策。
en: Jordan seems to have read the political tea leaves and concluded that it makes more sense to improve relations with Egypt’s rising leaders than it does to fight them.

zh: 而改善与埃及的关系需以与穆尔西和穆斯林兄弟会建立更加密切的关系为前提。
en: And better relations with Egypt presuppose closer ties with Morsi and the Muslim Brotherhood.

zh: 埃及的破败经济
en: Egypt’s Broken Economy

zh: 华盛顿—自从穆巴拉克去年倒台以来，政治渴望就主导着埃及人民的公共生活。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Egyptians’ political aspirations have dominated the country’s public life since the fall of President Hosni Mubarak last year.

zh: 不幸的是，在政治渴望被满足的同时，埃及经济却步入了深度衰退，这也使得革命目标之一即改善埃及人民的生活水平和福利落了空。
en: Unfortunately, as those aspirations are addressed, the economy has entered a steep decline, jeopardizing one of the revolution’s main goals, namely improvement in Egyptians’ living standards and welfare.

zh: 事实上，埃及政客的民粹主义论调已成为自穆巴拉克时代就开始的经济改革的威胁。
en: Indeed, the populist rhetoric of Egyptian politicians threatens to undo the economic reforms undertaken by the Mubarak regime.

zh: 2004年，前总理那齐夫（Ahmed Nazif）开始了一项重大改革计划。
en: In 2004, a major reform program was launched under former Prime Minister Ahmed Nazif.

zh: 该计划的目标通过金融部门改革、疏通商业法规、开放对外贸易以及减弱政府在经济中所扮演的作用来是消除增长中的官僚主义约束。
en: It was aimed at removing bureaucratic constraints to growth by restructuring the financial sector, streamlining business regulations, liberalizing foreign trade, and reducing the government’s role in the economy.

zh: 2004年的改革消除了外汇管制、降低了进口关税，逐渐地改善了商业和投资环境。
en: The 2004 reforms, with their elimination of restrictions on access to foreign exchange and reduction of import tariffs, gradually improved the business and investment climate.

zh: 在有利国际条件的助推下，埃及年GDP增长率从2004年的4.1%提高到2008年的7.2 % ， 2009—2010年全球衰退期间也维持在5 % 。
en: Coupled with favorable international conditions, Egypt’s annual GDP growth rate rose to 7.2% in 2008, from 4.1% in 2004, and remained at 5% in 2009-2010, despite the global recession.

zh: 这些新措施还有助于吸引大量资本流入和外国直接投资，从而使埃及外汇储备大幅增加，从2004年的148亿美元提高到2010年末的360亿美元。
en: The new measures also helped to attract large capital inflows and foreign direct investment, underpinning a dramatic rise in foreign-currency reserves, from $14.8 billion in 2004 to more than $36 billion by the end of 2010.

zh: 2011年，经济状况几乎全面倒退了。
en: In 2011, the situation worsened on virtually all fronts.

zh: 年GDP增长率下降为越0.5 % ， 而通胀率维持在两位数。
en: Annual growth fell to about 0.5%, and inflation remained in double digits.

zh: 失业率在第四季度达到了12.4 % ， 2010年同期水平为8.9 % 。
en: The unemployment rate reached 12.4% in the fourth quarter, up from 8.9% in the same period of 2010.

zh: 由于旅游业收入缩水40亿美元以及来自在外工作埃及人的海外侨汇急剧减少，经常项目收支迅速恶化。
en: The current-account balance deteriorated rapidly, owing to the loss of more than $4 billion in tourism revenues and a sharp fall in remittances by Egyptian workers abroad.

zh: 财政赤字增加为GDP的10 % ， 这导致前几年一直在下降的政府债务（包括外债）水平提高到GDP的76 % 。
en: The fiscal deficit widened to 10% of GDP, causing government debt (including external debt), which had been falling steadily, to rise to 76% of GDP.

zh: 但是，最令人担心的发展趋势是解放广场革命成功后一年来国际储备的减少。
en: The most striking development, however, was the loss of international reserves in the year following the Tahrir Square revolution.

zh: IMF估计，截至2011年12月，埃及外汇储备大约减少了一半，下降至180亿美元，部分原因是经常项目收支恶化，但更重要的原因在于国内外投资者从埃及收回投资。
en: The International Monetary Fund estimates that foreign-currency reserves fell by half, to $18 billion, by December 2011, owing partly to the worsening current-account balance, but, more importantly, to withdrawal from Egypt by foreign and domestic investors alike.

zh: 面临重大且不断恶化的外部失衡的埃及中央银行选择在去年的政治和经济动荡时捍卫埃及镑。
en: In the face of large and growing external imbalances, the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) chose to defend the Egyptian pound during last year’s political and economic turmoil.

zh: 埃及央行只让汇率 — — 按官方定义，埃及镑是“管理浮动”的 — — 贬值了3 % 。
en: The CBE allowed the exchange rate, which is formally defined as a “managed float,” to depreciate by only 3%.

zh: 保持汇率稳定被视为比防止外汇储备减少更重要的事情。
en: Keeping the currency relatively stable was considered a higher priority than preventing the loss of foreign reserves.

zh: 如今，埃及不仅面临着国内政治动荡，还面临着货币危机的风险 — — 这主要是拜国际储备不断消耗所赐，自去年10月以来，每个月大概都要减少20亿美元。
en: Today, Egypt not only remains vulnerable to unstable domestic politics; owing to the depletion of its international reserves – at a rate of roughly $2 billion a month since last October – the country now also faces the threat of a currency crisis.

zh: 更坏的是，这一数字几乎肯定低估了储备减少问题的严重性，因为其中并未剔除去年11月以来拍卖美元国债所获得的35亿美元流入。
en: Moreover, this almost certainly underestimates the extent of the losses, because it does not exclude inflows of $3.5 billion since November of last year from auctions of US-dollar-denominated treasury bills.

zh: 此外，埃及军方给了政府10亿美元贷款，沙特和卡塔尔也提供了10亿美元赞助，这表明自2010年12月以来的外汇储备损失达到了近22亿美元。
en: In addition, the Egyptian military gave a $1 billion loan to the government, and another $1 billion was received through grants from Saudi Arabia and Qatar, bringing the loss of reserves since December 2010 closer to $22 billion.

zh: 另一大国际储备来源旅游业大概只产生了80亿美元收入，较2010年的120亿美元显著下降。
en: The other source of international reserves, tourism, brought in only $8 billion, down sharply from $12 billion in 2010.

zh: 埃及的进口依然比其出口高出近一倍，导致其2011年底的贸易赤字超过了100亿美元。
en: Egypt continues to import almost double what it exports, resulting in a trade deficit of over $10 billion by the end of 2011.

zh: 因此，埃及的融资必须持续增加：该国目前需要借入140—150亿美元以填补其240亿美元的融资空白。
en: As a result, Egypt’s financing must continue to grow: the country now needs to borrow about $14-15 billion to plug its estimated financing gap of $24 billion.

zh: 这在很大程度上取决于外部援助何时或是否能落实，而后者又取决于埃及32亿美元IMF贷款谈判能否获得批准。
en: Much depends on when, or whether, external aid materializes, which is contingent on approval of Egypt’s renegotiated $3.2 billion IMF loan.

zh: 如果IMF谈判取得结果，则可以进一步引来世界银行和其他国际机构的援助项目。
en: If finalized, the IMF program could trigger further aid packages by the World Bank and other international donors.

zh: 有了援助，埃及就可以开始修正一些融资问题，但仍需要长期战略来刺激可持续增长。
en: If the aid arrives, Egypt could begin to address some of its financing problems, but it is still in need of a long-term strategy to spur sustainable growth.

zh: 埃及经济面临着持续的风险，这是由资本外逃、通胀高企、失业以及民粹主义政策决定的。
en: Egypt’s economy is facing continued risks, owing to capital flight, rising inflation, unemployment, and populist policies.

zh: 即使可以获得外部融资，埃及领导人仍须找出依靠私人部门来振兴国民经济的办法。
en: Even with the availability of external finance, Egyptian leaders must look for ways to engage the private sector in reviving the country’s economy.

zh: 不幸的是，最近的政治事件与促进民主活动的美国非政府组织有涉，这使得两国关系降了温，也威胁到了埃及每年从美国那里获得的13亿美元军事援助。
en: Unfortunately, the latest political incident involving the democracy-promoting activities of American NGOs has cooled bilateral relations and threatens the $1.3 billion in military assistance that Egypt receives annually from the United States.

zh: 这可能还会影响到其他援助者和国际金融机构，特别是IMF和世界银行。
en: This may have an impact on other donors, as well as the international financial institutions, particularly the IMF and the World Bank.

zh: 埃及从民粹主义经济政策到反美民粹主义的过渡说明，政治不稳定性可以对经济发展形成重大影响。
en: Egypt’s transition from populist economic policies to anti-American populism exemplifies the impact that political uncertainty can have on economic developments.

zh: 我们希望，即将于5月举行的总统大选以及国内民选政府的组成能够平息政治动荡，引导经济走向稳定和复兴。
en: The upcoming presidential election in May and the formation of a democratically elected government, one hopes, will calm the political turmoil and lead to economic stabilization and revival.

zh: 否则的话，埃及人民好不容易获得的政治胜利将有可能付诸东流。
en: Otherwise, Egyptians’ hard-won political gains may well be lost.

zh: 和平制造者埃及？
en: Egypt the Peacemaker?

zh: 特拉维夫—在以色列和加沙哈马斯战斗升级之前，必须进行停火谈判。
en: TEL AVIV – Before the current fighting between Israel and Hamas in Gaza escalates further, a ceasefire must be negotiated.

zh: 当然，与前几次停火一样，休战总是暂时的，免不了会受到让以色列和哈马斯武装冲突维持下去的势力的破坏。
en: Of course, like previous ceasefires, any truce is likely to be temporary, inevitably undermined by the forces that perpetuate Israel’s armed conflict with Hamas.

zh: 尽管如此，在叙利亚陷入内战、大中东仍不稳定的情况下，双方都需要停火拯救生命、维持眼下得之不易的地区和平。
en: Nonetheless, with Syria consumed in civil war and the wider Middle East already unsteady, a ceasefire is essential both for saving lives and preserving today’s uneasy regional peace.

zh: 这在很大程度上取决于埃及，该国是最佳的协议调停人选。
en: Much depends on Egypt, which is best placed to broker an agreement.

zh: 但评估外交努力的前景需要理解当事人的看法和安排。
en: But assessing the prospects of any diplomatic effort requires understanding the protagonists’ perspectives and agendas.

zh: 以色列并没有针对加沙的完整计划。
en: Israel does not have a comprehensive policy toward Gaza.

zh: 前总理沙龙采取了颇有魄力的措施：单方面从加沙撤军，并解散那里的以色列定居点。
en: Former Prime Minister Ariel Sharon took a courageous step by withdrawing unilaterally from Gaza and dismantling the Israeli settlements there.

zh: 但他在将这些措施纳入解决巴勒斯坦问题的更大一盘棋之前就病倒了。
en: But he fell ill before these measures could be fitted into a larger effort to address the Palestinian issue.

zh: 他的继任者奥尔默特开始与巴勒斯坦权力机构主席阿巴斯展开最终地位谈判。
en: His successor, Ehud Olmert, began negotiating a final-status agreement with the Palestinian Authority’s president, Mahmoud Abbas.

zh: 但这并没有结束源自加沙的暴力 — — 该地区事实上已经脱离了巴勒斯坦权力机构，成为哈马斯控制的原型国家。
en: But this did nothing to end the violence emanating from Gaza, which has effectively seceded from the Palestinian Authority and become a Hamas-controlled proto-state.

zh: 2008—2009年冬，以色列用铸铅行动（Operation Cast Lead）再次形成威慑并带来了一段时间的相对和平；但自2012年以来，显而易见各方又进入了冲突模式。
en: Israel’s Operation Cast Lead in the winter of 2008-2009 re-established deterrence and brought a period of relative calm; but it has been clear since the start of 2012 that the parties were once again on a collision course.

zh: 在其第一个以色列总理任期内，内塔尼亚胡继续奥尔默特与巴勒斯坦权力机构的谈判，也从未考虑过和哈马斯展开对话。
en: During his first term as Israel’s prime minister, Binyamin Netanyahu refused to continue to negotiate with the Palestinian Authority on Olmert’s terms, and never considered holding talks with Hamas.

zh: 他同意用巴勒斯坦囚犯交换被俘士兵吉拉德·沙利特（Gilad Shalit ） ； 但是，对内塔尼亚胡以及大部分以色列人来说，与公然反对闪米特人、拒绝承认以色列权利的组织谈判是徒劳的。
en: He agreed to swap Palestinian prisoners for an abducted soldier, Gilad Shalit; but, for Netanyahu, as for most Israelis, negotiating with an organization whose blatantly anti-Semitic charter rejects Israel’s right to exist is pointless.

zh: 在内塔尼亚胡看来，加沙问题不存在令人满意的解决方案。
en: From Netanyahu’s point of view, the Gaza problem has no satisfactory solution.

zh: 他的目标是获得并维持边境和平。
en: His aim is to obtain and maintain calm along the border.

zh: 以色列向加沙提供电力、水和通道，但也维持包围之势，组织更大型、更致命的武器进入。
en: Israel provides electricity, water, and passage to Gaza, but also maintains a siege intended to prevent imports of larger, more lethal weapons.

zh: 以色列领导人知道哈马斯有中程导弹（主要通过西奈地下渠道走私进入 ） ， 但他们仍然指出，不对加沙进行包围，伊朗和其他国家就会提供更多更先进的武器。
en: Israeli leaders were aware of Hamas’s buildup of medium-range missiles, mostly smuggled through Sinai in underground tunnels, but continue to argue that, absent the siege, Iran and others would supply more (and more sophisticated) weapons.

zh: 事实上，在过去几年中，以色列发现加沙拥有足以让其南部陷入瘫痪的火箭和导弹。
en: In fact, Israel discovered over the last few years that Gaza contained enough rockets and missiles to paralyze its south.

zh: 以色列各大城市已数度遭袭。
en: Major Israeli cities were hit several times.

zh: 在铸铅行动期间，火箭弹距离特拉维夫和本古里安机场只有一步之遥。
en: During Operation Cast Lead, rockets struck perilously close to Tel Aviv and Ben Gurion Airport.

zh: 对以色列领导人来说，特拉维夫进入火箭弹打击范围只是时间问题。
en: For Israeli leaders, it was only a matter of time before Tel Aviv could and would be hit.

zh: 在穆斯林兄弟会巴勒斯坦分支机构哈马斯则在寻求巩固其对加沙的控制，并将其用作控制约旦河西岸和巴勒斯坦民族运动的基地。
en: For its part, Hamas, the Muslim Brotherhood’s Palestinian branch, seeks to consolidate its control over Gaza and use it as a base from which to take control of the West Bank and the Palestinian national movement.

zh: 这一结果可以和穆斯林兄弟会在埃及掌权相比，能够进一步建立其地区支配地位。
en: This outcome would be comparable to the Brotherhood’s takeover in Egypt, further establishing its ascendancy in the region.

zh: 最近发生的一系列事件助长了哈马斯的气势。
en: Recent events appear to have emboldened Hamas.

zh: 尽管伊朗与其逊尼派对手的冲突以及叙利亚内战迫使它放松了与伊朗和叙利亚的关系，投入逊尼派阵营，但从诸多方面看，这都是令人满意的变化。
en: Although the conflict between Iran and its Sunni rivals and the Syrian civil war forced it to loosen ties with Iran and Syria and move into the Sunni fold, in many respects this has been a comfortable shift.

zh: 埃及落入了其母运动之手，这让哈马斯感到信心更足了。
en: Hamas feels more confident next to an Egypt dominated by its parent movement.

zh: 卡塔尔埃米尔也访问了加沙，以表彰哈马斯与伊朗的决裂，并留下了一大笔资金。
en: The Emir of Qatar paid a visit to Gaza as a reward for Hamas’s break with Iran and left a check.

zh: 但哈马斯在加沙并不是孤家寡人。
en: But Hamas is not alone in Gaza.

zh: 其霸权受到了更激进的伊斯兰圣战组织（Islamic Jihad，仍是伊朗的盟友）和其他一系列沙拉菲派和其他圣战组织的挑战，其中一些与西奈的激进分子有关联，这使得哈马斯与埃及的关系复杂化了。
en: Its hegemony is challenged by the more radical Islamic Jihad (which remains allied with Iran) and a host of Salafi and jihadi groups, some connected to radical elements in Sinai, which complicates Hamas’s relations with Egypt.

zh: 此外，这些组织频繁地策动从加沙或经过西奈对以色列发动攻击，制造让哈马斯尴尬不已的暴力循环。
en: Moreover, these groups have frequently initiated attacks on Israel from Gaza or through Sinai, generating cycles of violence that have embarrassed Hamas.

zh: 与此同时，来自这些更为激进的组织的压力可能已经迫使哈马斯自身在最近几个月变得更加激进，其底气大概来自手中的Fajr-5型火箭，如果以色列采取更大规模的报复，这批火箭可以打到特拉维夫地区。
en: At the same time, pressure from these more radical groups may have forced Hamas itself to become more aggressive in recent months, perhaps bolstered by the knowledge that its arsenal of dozens of Fajr-5 rockets could hit the Tel Aviv area should Israel retaliate on a larger scale.

zh: 埃及政治和政策的变化也具有相同效果：哈马斯断定以色列不会因为发动新一轮加沙地面攻势破坏其与埃及的脆弱关系。
en: The change in Egypt’s politics and policies had a similar effect: Hamas calculated that Israel would not jeopardize its fragile relationship with Egypt by launching another ground operation in Gaza.

zh: 当以色列发动进攻，除掉了其军事领袖艾哈迈德·贾巴里（Ahmed al-Jabari）并摧毁了其Fajr-5军火库时，哈马斯大为震惊。
en: Hamas was taken by surprise when Israel attacked, killing its military leader, Ahmed al-Jabari, and destroying most of its Fajr-5 arsenal.

zh: 其反应措施是对以色列南部进行大举炮轰，并设法向特拉维夫发射了几枚导弹，对耶路撒冷也发射了一枚导弹。
en: It responded with massive shelling of southern Israel, and managed to send several missiles toward Tel Aviv and one toward Jerusalem.

zh: 以色列最大两个城市上空终于响起了防空警报。
en: Air raid sirens were finally heard in Israel’s two largest cities.

zh: 以色列的回应是公开进行大规模地面军事调动。
en: In response, Israel is visibly preparing for a large-scale ground operation.

zh: 以色列无意发动第二次铸铅行动；但完全的稳定、长期停火是可接受的。
en: There is no appetite in Israel for a second Operation Cast Lead; but nothing less than a stable, long-lasting ceasefire is acceptable.

zh: 这样的停火是可能的。
en: Such a truce is possible.

zh: 以色列的袭击获得了开门红，而哈马斯也因成功地用导弹袭击了特拉维夫感到欢欣鼓舞，这一成就让真主党在2006年黎巴嫩战争中的成果相形见绌。
en: Israel’s assault scored impressive initial successes, while Hamas can take pride in having reached Tel Aviv with its missiles, an achievement that eluded Hezbollah in the 2006 Lebanon War.

zh: 此外，埃及 — — 哈马斯的赞助人和坚定盟友 — — 仍然维持着与以色列的关系和沟通渠道，并无意切断一切联系，因为这样做会与支持埃及军队的美国形成冲突。
en: Moreover, Egypt, Hamas’s patron and senior ally, maintains a relationship and channels of communication with Israel, and does not want to sever all ties – not least because to do so would provoke a confrontation with the United States, which underwrites the Egyptian army.

zh: 事实上，埃及总统穆尔西正在寻求从美国和IMF获得更多的财政援助，希望其对华盛顿的访问获得成功。
en: In fact, Egyptian President Mohamed Morsi is seeking more financial aid from the US and the International Monetary Fund, and wants his coming visit to Washington, DC, to be a success.

zh: 他还希望重塑埃及作为重要地区力量的地位。
en: He also wants to restore Egypt’s position as a major regional force.

zh: 成为和平制造者能够让他一举多得。
en: Playing the peacemaker would serve him well on all counts.

zh: 因此，穆尔西需要长袖善舞。
en: So Morsi is juggling.

zh: 他谴责并警告以色列，召回了埃及驻特拉维夫大使，并将总理派往加沙。
en: He has denounced and warned Israel, recalled Egypt’s ambassador to Tel Aviv, and sent his prime minister to Gaza.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，他一直没有跨越任何红线。
en: But, so far, he has not crossed a single red line.

zh: 采取行动的时间已经不多了。
en: There is little time to act.

zh: 更多的斗争会将更多的方面（包括土耳其）拖入战局。
en: More fighting will bring additional actors into the picture (including Turkey).

zh: 如果美国和欧洲选择静观其变，它们至少不得不鼓励埃及承担这一角色。
en: If the US and Europe choose to remain inactive, they must at least encourage Egypt to play its role.

zh: 埃及的主要障碍是哈马斯坚持要求以色列解除包围和定点清除，以此作为停火协议的一部分。
en: Egypt’s major obstacle is Hamas’s insistence on an end to the Israeli siege and targeted killings as part of a ceasefire agreement.

zh: 埃及领导人的挑战是说服哈马斯在掀起未来战斗的情况下降低条件。
en: The challenge for Egyptian leaders is to persuade Hamas to settle on lesser terms without further fighting.

zh: 埃及的逍遥杀人犯
en: Egypt’s Innocent Murderers

zh: 开罗 — “ 巴沙尔应该放下权力，到埃及来安全地退休。
en: CAIRO – “Bashar should abandon power and retire safely in Egypt.

zh: 埃及最高检察官对杀人犯可好了 ， ” 一位朋友在和我一起观看前埃及总统穆巴拉克在警察学院刑事法庭受审时这样向我评价叙利亚总统。
en: The general-prosecutor is murder-friendly,” a friend, referring to Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, told me as we watched former Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak’s trial in the Police Academy’s criminal court.

zh: 尽管穆巴拉克及其内政（安全）部长阿德利（Habib al-Adly）在定罪后被判终身监禁，但以内政部副部长之名操作埃及镇压机器的诸位将军被判无罪。
en: Although Mubarak and his interior (security) minister, Habib al-Adly, were handed life sentences at the conclusion of their trials, the generals who ran Egypt’s apparatus of repression as deputy interior ministers were acquitted.

zh: 拉赫曼（Hasan Abd al-Rahman ） ， 如斯塔西一般臭名昭著的国家安全调查局（SSI）局长、拉姆齐（Ahmad Ramzi ） ， 中央安全部队（CSF）司令、法伊德（Adly Fayyid ） ， 公共安全首脑、谢尔（Ismail al-Shaer ） ， 开罗安全理事会（CSD）会长、尤塞夫（Osama Youssef ） ， 吉萨（Gisa）安全理事会会长、还有法拉马维（Omar Faramawy）10·6安全理事会会长，这些人都逃脱了罪名。
en: Hasan Abd al-Rahman, head of the notorious, Stasi-like State Security Investigations (SSI); Ahmad Ramzi, head of the Central Security Forces (CSF); Adly Fayyid, the head of Public Security; Ismail al-Shaer, who led the Cairo Security Directorate (CSD); Osama Youssef, the head of the Giza Security Directorate; and Omar Faramawy, who oversaw of the 6th of October Security Directorate, were all cleared of any wrongdoing.

zh: 穆巴拉克和阿德利的律师会就终身监禁提起上诉，许多埃及人认为他们会得到减刑。
en: Lawyers for Mubarak and al-Adly will appeal their life-sentences, and many Egyptians believe that they will receive lighter sentences.

zh: 对穆巴拉克的裁决传递了一个明确的信号，将对埃及政治过渡形成重大影响。
en: The verdicts sent an unmistakable message, one with serious consequences for Egypt’s political transition.

zh: 当判决宣布时，受害者家庭及其律师们情不自禁地流下了眼泪 ： “ 人民恨不得清洗司法部。 ”
en: A spontaneous cry was heard from the lawyers and the families of victims when they were announced: “The people want to cleanse the judiciary.”

zh: 事实上，许多埃及人 — — 包括资深法官 — — 认为司法部并不是一个独立机构。 “这是一个重大专业错误。
en: Indeed, many Egyptians – including senior judges – do not view the judiciary as an independent institution.

zh: 那些将军应该和穆巴拉克一样被判终身监禁。
en: “This is a major professional mistake.

zh: ”前当选法官俱乐部（Judges Club）主席阿齐兹（Zakaria Abd al-Aziz）说 ， “ 杀戮维持了好几天，他们没有派任何人去阻止杀戮。
en: Those generals should have been handed life-sentences like Mubarak,” said Zakaria Abd al-Aziz, the former elected head of the Judges Club. “The killing went on for days, and they did not order anyone to stop it.

zh: 内政部（MOI）并不是唯一应该清洗的部门。
en: The Ministry of Interior (MOI) is not the only place that should be cleansed.

zh: 司法部也应该清洗一番。 ”
en: The judiciary needs that” as well.

zh: 毫无疑问，这样的裁决在增强了安全事务免于刑罚的文化。
en: The verdicts certainly reinforce a culture of impunity within the security services.

zh: 在穆巴拉克30年的统治时期里，SSI及其下属部门犯有诸多侵犯人权的罪行，包括酷刑和法外处决。
en: The SSI and its departments were responsible for many human-rights violations, including mass-torture and extra-judicial killings, throughout Mubarak’s 30-year rule.

zh: 当3月11日示威者横扫SSI总部和其他行政部门时，刑讯室和刑具随处可见。
en: When protestors stormed the SSI headquarters and other governorates in March 2011, torture rooms and equipment were found in every building.

zh: 非法监禁、绑架、失踪、虐待、强奸和非人道关押自从20世纪80年代以来便不绝于人权组织和少数埃及法庭记录中。
en: Unlawful detentions, kidnappings, disappearances, systematic torture, rape, and inhuman prison conditions have all been documented since the 1980’s by human-rights organizations and a few Egyptian courts.

zh: 在由警察暴行引发的革命后赦免SSI和CSF（拥有30万成员的穆巴拉克“爪牙”机构）首脑直接再次点燃了解放广场示威之火。
en: Acquitting the heads of the SSI and the CSF (the 300,000-strong institution that acted as the “muscle” of Mubarak’s regime), after a revolution sparked by police brutality, led directly to renewed protests in Tahrir Square.

zh: “要么为烈士争取权利，要么和烈士一样死去 ， ” 解放广场和其他埃及广场上成千上万的示威者喊道。
en: “We either get the rights of the martyrs, or die like them,” chanted hundreds of thousands in Tahrir and other Egyptian squares.

zh: 为纪念推翻穆巴拉克统治的2011年1—2月的18天而进行的静坐示威活动已经开始。
en: Sit-ins, reminiscent of the 18 days of January and February 2011 that ended Mubarak’s rule, have already started.

zh: 这些裁决的第三大后果是MOI内部的反改革集团获得了权力。
en: A third consequence of the verdicts concerns the empowerment of an anti-reform faction within the MOI.

zh: 从我对埃及安全部门改革一年来的研究看，该集团已然成为最有权势的群体。
en: Based on my year-long research on Egyptian security-sector reform, this faction is already the most powerful.

zh: 革命之后，MOI的内部斗争就公开花了。
en: Following the revolution, factional struggle within the MOI became public.

zh: “我们得保存颜面 ， ” 内政部副部长、被阿德利解职的巴迪尼（Abd al-Latif Badiny）将军说。
en: “We have to save face,” said General Abd al-Latif Badiny, a deputy interior minister who was fired under al-Adly.

zh: “许多军官和指挥官拒绝严刑拷问犯人、反对腐败，但我们需要具有革命精神的总统赋予我们全力清洗内政部。 ”
en: “[M]any officers and commanders refused to torture detainees and were against corruption, but we need a revolutionary president to empower us and clean the ministry.”

zh: 巴迪尼在革命之后重新获得了任命，但在2011年11月造成40名示威者死亡的游行者和警方的冲突后再次受到斥责。
en: Badiny was reappointed after the revolution, but then reprimanded in November 2011, following clashes between demonstrators and police that left more than 40 protesters dead.

zh: “他鼓吹应该和示威者展开对话，而阿德利的人认为应该严厉镇压。 最后，阿德利派获胜了。
en: “He was advocating dialogue with protesters, whereas al-Adly’s men wanted a harsh crackdown.

zh: ”支持改革的尽管大联盟（GCPO）发言人拉加比（Ahmad Ragab）少校说。 GCPO寻求成立正是的警察联合会，以非政治的职业方向改革安全系统。
en: They got their way in the end,” says Major Ahmad Ragab, the spokesperson of the reformist General Coalition of Police Officers (GCPO), which seeks to establish an official police syndicate and reform the security services along apolitical, professional lines.

zh: 这些裁决会对其他两大进程产生重要影响：革命军的动员能力以及基于这种动员能力的对执政的武装部队最高委员会（SCAF）的施压能力。
en: The verdicts will significantly affect two other processes: revolutionary forces’ capacity to mobilize, and thus to place pressure on the ruling Supreme Council of Armed Forces (SCAF), and the presidential elections.

zh: 解放广场和其他官场上反对此次裁决的示威者的目标则包括：清洗司法部；禁止穆巴拉克手下高级官员十年内担任政治要职；对阿德利手下的将军进行重新审判；以及换掉由穆巴拉克任命的最高检察官。
en: The objectives of those protesting the verdicts in Tahrir and other squares include: a judicial purge; a law that would ban Mubarak’s senior officials from holding political posts for ten years; new trials for al-Aldy’s generals; and removal of the general prosecutor (who was appointed by Mubarak).

zh: 也有人呼吁在6月16—17日总统大选决胜轮之前保持更大的团结，但尚未形成气候。
en: There are also calls, still undeveloped, for greater unity ahead of the presidential run-off election on June 16-17.

zh: 这类吁求包括要求立即将权力移交给革命派总统候选人联盟（尽管其中的机制非常模糊）以及组成联合总统阵线参选，由穆斯林兄弟会（MB）的摩西（Mohamed Morsi）担任总统，左倾的纳赛尔主义者萨巴希（Hamadin Sabahi）和自由派温和伊斯兰主义者福特乌（Abdel Moneim Aboul Fotouh）担任副总统。
en: Such appeals range from demanding an immediate transfer of power to a coalition of revolutionary presidential candidates (although the mechanism is vague) to the formation of a united presidential front in the runoff, with Mohamed Morsi of the Muslim Brothers (MB) as President and left-leaning Nasserist Hamadin Sabahi and liberal-leaning moderate-Islamist Abdel Moneim Aboul Fotouh as Vice-Presidents.

zh: MP已经号召三人进入议会商谈结盟问题。
en: MPs have already called on the three figures to come to the parliament and negotiate a coalition.

zh: 这些裁决或许有助于增加摩西的支持率，在首轮选举中，摩西和其他两位候选人分散了伊斯兰主义者的选票。
en: The verdicts are likely to boost support in the runoff for Morsi, who split the Islamist vote with two other candidates in the election’s first round.

zh: 此外，非伊斯兰革命派选票的大部也将投向摩西，因为除了他之外再无其他革命派候选人。
en: Moreover, a significant share of the non-Islamist revolutionary vote will go to Morsi, owing to the absence of other revolutionary alternatives.

zh: 解放广场的共声是“我们与摩西有分歧，但与沙非齐（Ahmed Shafiq）有血仇。 ”沙非齐是穆巴拉克时代最后一任总理，也是摩西在决胜轮的竞选对手。
en: The common saying in Tahrir is: “We’ve got differences with Morsi, but we’ve got blood with [Ahmed] Shafiq,” Mubarak’s last prime minister and Morsi’s opponent in the runoff.

zh: 革命派非伊斯兰非MB候选人在第一轮总统选举中赢得了970万张选票。
en: Pro-revolution, non-Islamist, and non-MB candidates received almost 9.7 million votes in the first round of the presidential election.

zh: 其中的绝大部分选民现在很有可能会支持摩西，而不是坐山观虎斗（裁决出台前的主流想法 ） 。
en: The majority of these voters will probably now support Morsi, as opposed to staying home (the general drift before the verdicts).

zh: 如果MB想让福特乌和萨巴希的支持者在选举中抛弃沙非齐，就需要更加包容。
en: The MB must still decide for inclusiveness if it wants to attract the support of Aboul Fotouh and Sabahi voters in the runoff against Shafiq.

zh: 但是，眼下，解放广场和其他广场再次形成了支持变革的团结力量（不管是不是伊斯兰主义的 ） 。
en: But, for now, Tahrir and other squares are once again uniting the pro-change forces, whether Islamist or not.

zh: 埃及革命派的主要挑战是保持团结之势，组成一个领导联盟，将赞歌转化为实在的要求，并在实施过程中持续施加压力。
en: The key challenge for Egyptian revolutionaries is to sustain that unity, establish a leadership coalition, translate their chants into concrete demands, and maintain the pressure during implementation.

zh: 埃及的革命还在继续。
en: Egypt’s revolution continues.

zh: 埃及新组建的旧政府
en: Egypt’s New Old Government

zh: 开罗 — — 埃及有史以来的首位自由选举总统，穆斯林兄弟会的穆罕默德·穆尔西已经完成了首届内阁任命，你猜怎么样？
en: CAIRO – Egypt’s first-ever freely elected president, the Muslim Brotherhood’s Mohamed Morsi, has appointed his first cabinet, and guess what?

zh: 旧的政府官员充斥着新内阁。
en: It is crammed with officials from the old regime.

zh: 穆尔西政府显然是总统和武装部队最高委员会（SCAF）权力平衡的产物，但也反映了穆斯林兄弟会寻找新平衡的战略。
en: Morsi’s government clearly reflects the balance of power between the president and the Supreme Council of the Armed Forces (SCAF). But it also reflects the strategy of the Muslim Brothers to shift that balance.

zh: 新任总理希沙姆·甘迪勒任命了35位部长，其中7位（包括甘迪勒本人）均曾在此前武装部队最高委员会任命的政府中担任过部长职务。
en: Thirty-five ministers were chosen by the new prime minister, Hisham Qandil, seven of whom (including Qandil) were ministers in the previous SCAF-appointed government.

zh: 信息、高等教育、青年、劳工和住房建设部等五部部长由穆斯林兄弟会自由与公正党（FJP）占据。
en: Five ministries – information, higher education, youth, labor, and housing – were given to the Muslim Brothers’ Freedom and Justice Party (FJP).

zh: 其他支持革命的人士也占据了内阁组合中教育、法律及议会事务、工业及外贸，以及最重要的司法部等若干部长职务。
en: Other pro-revolution figures secured several cabinet portfolios as well: education, legal and parliamentary affairs, industry and foreign trade, and most importantly, the justice ministry.

zh: 内政和国防部等“实权”部委仍由与前政权相关的人士掌控。
en: The “power” ministries – interior and defense – were kept under the control of figures associated with the former regime.

zh: 侯赛因·坦塔维元帅（兼武装部队最高委员会领袖）仍留任国防部长，而曾因暴行引发这场革命的阿尔丁将军则受命统帅内政部。
en: Field Marshal (and SCAF leader) Hussein Tantawy retained his post as Defense Minister, and General Ahmed Gamal al-Din was appointed to head the interior ministry, whose brutal behavior sparked the revolution.

zh: 阿尔丁的叔叔阿卜杜勒 - 阿哈德·贾迈勒·阿尔丁2000年间曾任执政民族民主党的议会多数党领袖。
en: Gamal al-Din’s uncle, Abd al-Ahad Gamal al-Din, was the ruling National Democratic Party’s parliamentary majority leader during the 2000’s.

zh: 其侄在释放政治犯谈判中充当强硬派，且在2011年11月结束街头冲突的谈判中也同样扮演强硬派的角色。
en: His nephew was a hardliner during negotiations to release political prisoners, as well as during talks to end the street clashes of November 2011.

zh: 他还在“吉萨警官案”的审判过程中出庭作证，此次审判中有17名警官被控于2011年1月打死打伤示威群众。
en: He was also a witness in the “Giza Officers Trial,” in which 17 policemen were accused of killing and injuring protesters in January 2011.

zh: 他为这些警官出庭辩护，声称警方出于“自卫”目的才杀死被害人。
en: He defended the policemen, claiming that the victims had been killed in “self-defense.”

zh: 尽管凡此种种，持改革态度的警务人员联盟（GCPO）创始人阿什拉夫·阿巴纳仍然抱有希望 ： “ 他出任内政部副[部长]时曾十分高效 … [ 因此]我们有理由期待某种改革。
en: Nonetheless, Ashraf al-Banna, a co-founder of the reformist General Coalition for Police Officers (GCPO), remains hopeful: “He was an effective deputy [minister of interior]...[so] we expect some reforms.

zh: 内政部目前的状况已经难以为继。
en: The situation in the ministry is unsustainable.”

zh: ” 。 但也有人，比如德高望重的革命官员联盟参与者指责阿尔丁是内政部强势反改革派系成员，并将其划归为追随前内政部长阿德利的“阿德利手下 ” 。
en: But others, like the members of the more revolutionary Officers but Honorable Coalition, accuse Gamal al-Din of being a member of a powerful anti-reform faction in the ministry, dubbed “al-Adly’s men” (after former Interior Minister Habib al-Adly).

zh: 支持改革的势力方面，穆斯林兄弟会的媒介部领军人物信息部长萨拉赫·阿卜杜勒·马苏德即便在穆尔西选举获胜后，仍将控制其所属部门继续攻击穆尔西及其组织。
en: As for the pro-change forces, Minister of Information Salah Abd al-Maqsud, a leading figure in the Muslim Brothers’ media wing, will control a sector that continues to attack the group and Morsi, even after his electoral victory.

zh: 另一位主要穆斯林兄弟会成员新任青年部长乌萨马·亚辛在推翻前总统胡斯尼·穆巴拉克的为期18天的塔里尔广场革命中实际担任了“保安队长”的角色。
en: The new youth minister, Osama Yassin, another leading Muslim Brother, was the de facto “security chief” in Tahrir Square during the 18 days that toppled former President Hosni Mubarak.

zh: 乌萨马·亚辛隶属于由兄弟会第一副主席（副总干事）沙特尔统帅的强势坚定派别“铁腕组织 ” 。
en: He belongs to the so-called “iron organization,” a strong, committed faction led by Khairat al-Shater, the Brotherhood’s first deputy chairman (deputy general guide).

zh: 同样，高等教育部部长职务归属在穆尔西竞选期间掌管教育事务的自由公正党党员穆斯塔法·摩萨德。
en: Likewise, higher education went to Mostafa Mossad, an FJP member who was in charge of the education portfolio during Morsi’s campaign.

zh: 劳工部部长职务则归属另一名兄弟会成员，此人既是阿萨利工会副会长也是警方暴行的受害者。
en: The labor ministry went to Khaled al-Azhary, a Brother who was deputy head of the Workers Union and a victim of police brutality in 2010.

zh: 当然，对兄弟会而言，如果政府在即将举行的议会选举后解散一切都会发生改变。
en: For the Brothers, of course, everything could change if the government is dissolved after the upcoming parliamentary election.

zh: 但即便这种情况真的出现，这次任职所积累起来的经验、数据和知识都将是一笔可观的财富。
en: But, even if that happens, the experience, data, and knowledge gained will be of immense value to the Brotherhood.

zh: 其他四部委的部长职务被革命派人士及伊斯兰人士收入囊中。
en: Four other ministries went to pro-revolution and Islamist figures.

zh: 在竞选中反对穆巴拉克时任官员回归政府的温和派伊斯兰瓦萨特党代表人物穆罕默德·马素布当选法律及议会事务部部长。
en: Mohamed Mahsoob, a leading figure in the moderate Islamist al-Wasat Party who campaigned against the return of Mubarak-era officials, became Minister of Legal and Parliamentary Affairs.

zh: 上次议会选举中曾加入穆斯林兄弟会选举联盟的文化党副主席哈特姆·萨利赫被任命为工业及外贸部部长。
en: Hatem Saleh, the deputy chairman of the Civilization Party, which joined the Muslim Brotherhood’s electoral coalition in the last parliamentary election, was named Minister of Industry and Foreign Trade.

zh: 影响埃及主要伊斯兰团体阿兹哈尔的宗教捐助部归属于伊斯兰权利及改革法律机构副所长塔拉特·阿菲菲（Talaat Afifi ） ， 阿菲菲也是一位兄弟会盟友，其统帅的机构由一百多名埃及著名的伊斯兰学者和活动家组成。
en: The religious endowment ministry, which influences the country’s main Islamic institution, al-Azhar, went to another of the Brothers’ allies, Talaat Afifi, the deputy head of the Islamic Legal Body for Rights and Reform, which comprises more than a hundred of Egypt’s leading Islamist scholars and activists.

zh: 最后，曾出任埃及最高上诉法院副院长的Ahmed Mekki将统领拯待改革的司法部。
en: Finally, Ahmed Mekki, the former deputy head of the Court of Cassation, Egypt’s highest appeals court, will lead the justice ministry, which is in need of real change.

zh: Mekki是司法独立的坚定支持者，被誉为甘迪勒政府中“革命人士的代表 ” 。
en: Mekki is a strong proponent of judicial independence, and was dubbed “the revolution’s representative” in Qandil’s government.

zh: 总体而言，35个部长席位中改革派力量仅占10个左右，余下的则是旧政权人物和并未公开宣布政治背景的技术专家的组合。
en: Overall, only ten of the 35 ministries went to pro-change forces, with the other ministers a combination of old-regime figures and technocrats without any publicly declared political affiliation.

zh: 但鉴于穆斯林兄弟会和武装部队最高委员会不可避免的斗争，这10位部长的选择在战略安排上是颇为明智的。
en: But the choice of the ten ministries was strategically clever, given the Muslim Brotherhood’s coming battles with SCAF.

zh: 所有部长都是低成本、软实力的代表性人物：这些人来自能加强革命派动员力量的官方机构、为革命派争取宗教合法性、并在革命派加强基层非官方网络的同时消除司法镇压的威胁。
en: All of these ministries represent low-cost, soft power: official institutions that can enhance pro-change forces’ capacity to mobilize, give them religious legitimacy, and remove the threat of judicial repression as they strengthen unofficial networks on the ground.

zh: 但武装部队最高委员会也运用了类似的策略：即加强对关键实权部委的控制力度。
en: But the SCAF side is applying a similar strategy: strengthening its hold over the key power ministries.

zh: 比如，在内政部上周进行的年度人员调整中，很多因腐败、参与镇压或两项指控兼有而预计将被免职的人却仍继续留任。
en: For example, in last week’s annual personnel changes at the interior ministry, many of those expected to be removed, owing to accusations of corruption, complicity in repression, or both, were not.

zh: 有几位甚至反而得到了重用。
en: A few were even promoted.

zh: 因此埃及的斗争还在进行中。
en: The struggle for Egypt thus continues.

zh: “第二共和国”依然没有诞生。
en: The “Second Republic” is yet to be born.

zh: 埃及和突尼斯不同的道路
en: Egypt and Tunisia’s Divergent Paths

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 埃及和突尼斯政权更迭后五年过去了，两国仍然遭受着经济增长低迷、财政赤字沉重、失业率高企和公共债务上升的威胁。
en: CAMBRIDGE – It has been five years since Egypt and Tunisia underwent regime change, and both countries are still suffering from low economic growth, large fiscal deficits, high unemployment, and rising public debts.

zh: 因为未能凭借自身力量实施改革，两国都不约而同求助于国际货币基金组织，该组织2013年与突尼斯达成协议，并刚刚批准了埃及价值120亿美元的贷款项目 — — 这是该国1991年后首个贷款项目，也创下了中东国家有史以来贷款项目的最大金额。
en: Having failed to institute reforms on their own, both have turned to the International Monetary Fund, which entered into an arrangement with Tunisia in 2013 and has just approved a $12 billion loan program for Egypt – the country’s first since 1991, and the largest ever for a Middle Eastern country.

zh: 从表面看，国家走向民主似乎与走向独裁在经济上经历了同样糟糕的表现，因为无论何种类型的政治动荡和不确定性都会自然而然地损害经济发展和投资。
en: On the face of it, countries moving toward democracy seem as likely to experience poor economic performance as countries moving toward renewed dictatorship, because political instability and uncertainty of any kind naturally hurt investment and growth.

zh: 但突尼斯已经接受了政治包容性理念，而且或许很快就会回到经济健康增长的轨道，而埃及与世隔绝的封闭社会则导致国内经济陷入下降螺旋。
en: But Tunisia has embraced political inclusion, and could soon find itself back on the path toward healthy economic growth, while Egypt’s closing society positions its economy for a downward spiral.

zh: 直到不久前，两国政府还表现得对经济改革惊人地缺乏兴趣。
en: Until recently, both countries’ governments showed a surprising lack of interest in economic reform.

zh: 相反，他们以反映各自政治道路的方式应对生存问题和安全挑战。
en: Instead, they engaged with identity issues and security challenges in ways that reflect their diverging political paths.

zh: 在突尼斯，伊斯兰安纳达党和代表世俗的突尼斯呼声党（ Nidaa Tounes Party）之间的选举竞争已经创造环境就宗教在政治和社会中的作用进行了卓有成效的辩论；而在埃及，情况却恰恰相反，阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西总统的专制政府对穆斯林兄弟会进行了猛烈的镇压。
en: In Tunisia, electoral contests between the Islamist Ennahda Party and the secular Nidaa Tounes Party have allowed for a productive debate about the role of religion in politics and society; in Egypt, by contrast, President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi’s autocratic government has violently repressed the Muslim Brotherhood.

zh: 此外，两国政府都无法抵制增加公共支出。
en: Meanwhile, governments in both countries could not resist increasing public spending.

zh: 在埃及，截止2016年中各项补贴仍占到GDP总量的10%以上，表明该国再次回到旧有的专制主义制度，即民众用放弃政治参与来换取政府的经济支持。
en: In Egypt, subsidies were still above 10% of GDP in mid-2016, suggesting a return to the old authoritarian bargain whereby citizens abstain from political participation in exchange for government economic support.

zh: 现在，为达到国际货币基金组织的援助条件，埃及已经承诺减少补贴并实行增值税。
en: Now, to qualify for the IMF’s assistance, Egypt has committed to reducing its subsidies and instituting a value-added tax.

zh: 在突尼斯，工会想方设法推高公务员工资至国际货币基金组织规定的目标之上 — — 已从2011年占国内GDP的10%增加到现在的15 % 。
en: In Tunisia, labor unions have managed to push civil-servant wages – which now equal 15% of GDP, up from 10% of GDP in 2011 – well above IMF targets.

zh: 而宏观经济动荡也已对两国经济增长起到了阻碍作用。
en: And macroeconomic instability has impeded growth in both countries.

zh: 埃及信用评级低迫使政府在国内借款，从而挤出其他借款人，导致私人投资仅占GDP的11 % 。
en: Egypt’s low credit rating has forced the government to borrow domestically, which has crowded out other borrowers to the point that private investment amounts to just 11% of GDP.

zh: 突尼斯的对外国家借款并没有挤出私人部门；但即便如此，私人投资也已降至GDP的18 % 。
en: Tunisia’s external state borrowing has not crowded out the private sector; nonetheless, private investment has fallen to 18% of GDP.

zh: 旅游收入下降和出口活动中断导致两国经常账户赤字均有所扩大，而且两国均未采取措施提高私营部门的竞争力。
en: Both countries’ current-account deficits have widened as a result of falling tourism revenues and disrupted export activities, and neither country has taken measures to improve private-sector competitiveness.

zh: 塞西和埃及前总统穆巴拉克一样，对私人部门参与者获得政治影响力持谨慎态度，而是反过来支持他可以信任的密友，如军队企业和曾与穆巴拉克政权有过联系的某些公司。
en: Sisi, like former Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, is wary of allowing private-sector players to gain political clout, and has instead propped up cronies whom he can trust, such as army corporations and some of the firms previously connected to the Mubarak regime.

zh: 在突尼斯，国家官僚制度拖累了私营部门活动，而且自从突尼斯呼声党政府2015年接管政权以来不断有报告显示政治关联企业的腐败状况恶化。
en: In Tunisia, the state bureaucracy has hindered private-sector activity, and there are reports of increased corruption by politically connected firms since the Nidaa Tounes government assumed power in 2015.

zh: 突尼斯允许国内货币随时间推移进行调整，2014年来第纳尔已经兑美元贬值了1/3。
en: Tunisia has allowed its currency to adjust over time, and the dinar has lost a third of its value against the US dollar since 2014.

zh: 而埃及方面则灾难性地错误管理了国内汇率。
en: Egypt, for its part, has disastrously mismanaged its exchange rate.

zh: 除2013年进行过一次不太重要的调整外，2011年后埃及一直实行固定汇率，即使在其国内货币大幅高估并开始造成进口商品短缺时也依然如此。
en: With the exception of one minor adjustment in 2013, it has stuck to a fixed rate since 2011, even after its currency became massively overvalued and started to create imported-goods shortages.

zh: 当埃及遵守国际货币基金组织条件并于11月1日实行浮动汇率时，汇率从8.5磅兑一美元贬值至15.5镑兑一美元；很快，进口商品成本将比现在增加40-60 % 。
en: When Egypt complied with IMF conditions and floated its currency on November 1st, the exchange rate weakened from 8.5 to 15.5 pounds to the dollar; soon, imported goods will likely cost 40-60% more than they do now.

zh: 埃及和突尼斯民众正在对各自国家的经济表现越来越不满意。
en: The Egyptian and Tunisian people are becoming increasingly dissatisfied with their respective countries’ economic performance.

zh: 但随着时间的推移，这样的不满情绪很可能帮助突尼斯经济而损害埃及。
en: But over time, this frustration will probably help Tunisia’s economy, while hurting Egypt’s.

zh: 首先，突尼斯的政治包容性促进有关潜在解决方案的健康对话。
en: For starters, political inclusiveness in Tunisia fosters healthy dialogue about potential solutions.

zh: 举例而言，8月成立新一届突尼斯内阁吸纳了前工会领袖，他们现在可以参与制定宏观经济政策，而不仅只是要求提高工资。
en: For example, the new Tunisian cabinet formed in August includes ex-union leaders, who can now shape broad economic policies, not just press for higher wages.

zh: 这已经导致政策辩论更有建设性，因为决策者正在关注劳工和企业如何公平分担经济调整的负担问题。
en: This has already made public-policy debates more constructive, because policymakers are focusing on how labor and business can fairly share the burden of economic adjustment.

zh: 相比之下，埃及封闭的政治体制让政府不断担心底层民众的反对。
en: Egypt’s closed political system, by contrast, has left the government constantly in fear of the street.

zh: 由于缺少建设性的政治辩论渠道，政府的最佳选择一直是推迟必要的经济调整，直到调整变得无可躲避。
en: With no channels for constructive political debate, the government’s best option has been to postpone necessary economic adjustments until they become unavoidable.

zh: 这种做法不仅在经济领域效率低下（具体体现在埃及近年来没有外国证券组合净投资 ） ； 而且还有政治危险性。
en: This is not only economically inefficient (reflected in the absence of net foreign portfolio investment in Egypt in recent years); it is also politically risky.

zh: 埃及政治家除祈祷底层民众不因最近的货币贬值而揭竿而起之外几乎没有其他事情可做。
en: Egyptian politicians can do little but cross their fingers and hope that the street does not rise up in response to the recent currency devaluation.

zh: 政治包容性创造出更明智 — — 或许也更宽容的 — — 公众氛围。
en: Political inclusiveness creates a more informed – and possibly more forgiving – public.

zh: 在突尼斯，民间团体成员和媒介可以自由审视政府及呼吁改革。
en: In Tunisia, members of civil society and the media may freely scrutinize the government and call for change.

zh: 虽然改革进展缓慢，但日益增长的公众批评令政府不可能永远忽视下去。
en: While reforms have been slow in coming, the government cannot ignore growing public criticism forever.

zh: 事实上，2017年预算法草案已经囊括了打击腐败、整顿官僚机构和减少逃税等紧急措施。
en: In fact, the 2017 draft budget law already includes urgent measures to fight corruption, trim the bureaucracy, and reduce tax evasion.

zh: 另一方面，埃及的货币贬值震惊了普通民众。
en: In Egypt, on the other hand, the currency devaluation has come as a shock to ordinary citizens.

zh: 公众对国家经济状况的了解少之又少，因为主流媒体已经成为政府喉舌，一直在向民众灌输埃及重返荣耀之巅的美好画面。
en: There was very little public understanding about the state of the economy, because the mainstream media, having become a regime mouthpiece, has been painting a rosy picture of Egypt’s return to glory.

zh: 与此同时，言论和结社自由受到严重限制；批评政府政策被认为和叛国是一回事。
en: At the same time, freedom of expression and association are severely limited; criticizing government policies is deemed tantamount to high treason.

zh: 突尼斯已通过巩固民主进程取得了政治进步，为所有利益相关者创造了制度空间，并允许自由表达和举行集会。
en: Tunisia has made political progress by shoring up its democratic processes, creating institutional space for all stakeholders, and allowing for free expression and assembly.

zh: 这对突尼斯经济的长期前景无疑是好兆头。
en: This bodes well for the Tunisian economy’s long-term prospects.

zh: 埃及方面可能因货币基金组织的一揽子援助计划而短期受益。
en: Egypt, for its part, may benefit from short-term gains as a result of the IMF package.

zh: 但其国内“凶狠但虚弱”的统治阶级不能指望通过专制主义变本加厉来取得长期进步。
en: Its “fierce but weak” rulers, however, cannot hope to make long-term progress by doubling down on despotism.

zh: 如果他们不选择漫长而曲折的政治包容转型之路，那么迟早他们必将面对那些遭到他们排斥的民众的怒火。
en: If they do not take the long and winding road toward political inclusion, sooner or later they will face the wrath of those they have excluded.

zh: 埃及世界杯之旅的四个教训
en: Four Lessons from Egypt’s World Cup Experience

zh: 发自拉古纳海滩 — — 在高涨的期望和球迷汹涌澎湃的热情支持下，埃及国家男子足球队在时隔28年后再次入围世界杯决赛圈。
en: LAGUNA BEACH – Egypt’s national soccer team rode to Russia for their first World Cup finals in 28 years on a wave of lofty expectations and potent fan enthusiasm.

zh: 不过连输三场后的他们如今只能灰溜溜卷铺盖回家 — — 这对一个极为看重足球和民族自豪感的国家来说堪称不小的打击。
en: They are now returning home having lost all of their games – no small disappointment for a country that takes both soccer and national pride very seriously.

zh: 于是乎，一场无人幸免的相互骂战就爆发了。
en: Now, a blame game has erupted from which no one seems to be spared.

zh: 出现这种状况可以理解，但却是毫无建设性的。
en: This may be understandable, but it is not constructive.

zh: 事实上，它可能会掩盖一些重要的经验教训，这些教训不仅可以帮助埃及，还可以协助其他新兴经济体发挥其巨大潜力 — — 而且不仅限于足球方面。
en: Indeed, it risks obscuring important lessons that can help not just Egypt, but also other emerging economies, to fulfill their considerable potential – and not just in soccer.

zh: 第一个教训是管理预期。
en: The first lesson is to manage expectations.

zh: 埃及队的世界杯之路首先要归功于该队的明星球员穆罕默德·萨拉赫，而这位在2017/2018年两度当选英超年度球员的选手并已成为数百万埃及人的偶像。
en: The run-up to the World Cup was dominated by well-deserved praise for the team’s star player, Mohamed Salah, who was English football’s 2017/2018 double player of the year and has become an idol for millions of Egyptians.

zh: 再加上埃及自1990年以来都未曾入围过世界杯决赛圈，导致人们的预期远远超出了球队在小组赛中实际可以实现的目标。
en: Add to that the fact that Egypt had not qualified for a World Cup final since 1990, and expectations ended up far exceeding what the team could realistically achieve in the tournament.

zh: 而令情况更遭的则是萨拉赫最近肩部脱臼受伤，导致他缺席了利物浦对阵皇家马德里的欧洲冠军联赛决赛以及埃及对阵乌拉圭的第一场关键比赛。
en: This was all the more true given that Salah recently suffered a dislocated shoulder, which forced him out of Liverpool’s Champions League final against Real Madrid and sidelined him in Egypt’s first pivotal game in Russia, against Uruguay.

zh: 可是埃及人仍然满怀希望 — — 实际上是过度满怀希望 — — 以致最终的失望也远远超过了他们本应实际承受的失望。
en: Yet Egyptians remained hopeful – indeed, too hopeful – and ended up far more disappointed than, realistically, they should have been.

zh: 这种失望会导致预期朝着在相反的方向过度修正。
en: Such disappointment can cause expectations to overcorrect in the opposite direction.

zh: 第二个教训是要想方设法令自身的优势多元化。
en: The second lesson is to take advantage of strengths to support diversification.

zh: 面对萨拉赫受伤的状况，埃及队兜里已经拿不出什么杀手锏，但埃及人却依然保持着对本队的热切期望。
en: Egyptians’ enduring hope for their soccer team after Salah’s injury was not rooted in the knowledge that there was some other secret weapon waiting to dazzle the crowd.

zh: 结果埃及的比赛策略依旧严重依赖于萨拉赫这位才华横溢却无法发挥全部潜力的队员。
en: On the contrary, Egypt’s game plan continued to rely substantially on Salah, whose talent was well known, but who was unable to play at full potential.

zh: 即使在对手派两人甚至三人盯防之时该队的战术也没多大变化。
en: The team’s tactics were also slow to evolve, even after opponents double- and triple-teamed Salah.

zh: 球队管理者没能将从原本一个点的优势中继续发展出多点优势，而是陷入了“积极的惯性 ” — —很想有所建树，但却依然死守既定的路径，即使该路径已经遇到了根本性的挑战。
en: Rather than diversify from a position of strength, managers became stuck in “active inertia” – trying to do more, but still locked into their established approach, even as it came up against fundamental challenges.

zh: 第三个教训则是要从一而终。
en: The third lesson is to finish the job.

zh: 在埃及的第三场世界杯比赛中 — — 2比1惨败给沙特导致其小组垫底 — — 对手的两个进球都是在上下半场的补时阶段取得的。
en: In Egypt’s final World Cup game – a crushing 2-1 loss to Saudi Arabia that put the team at the bottom of its group – both of the opponent’s goals were conceded in the stoppage time of each half.

zh: 随着终场逐渐临近，球队的注意力似乎开始涣散。
en: As the game clock ticked down, the team’s concentration seemed to wane.

zh: 德国也犯了类似的错误，在补时阶段给韩国队拿到了两个进球。
en: Germany made a similar mistake, giving up two goals to South Korea in stoppage time.

zh: 这种做法不适用于足球，也不适用于商业，政策制定或其他任何领域。
en: That does not work in soccer, nor does it work in business, policymaking, or just about any other field.

zh: 持续成功的关键就是永不放弃，直到终场哨声响起。
en: The key to sustained success is never to let up until the final whistle is blown.

zh: 埃及世界杯之旅的最后一个教训是国际参与可以在提升国内资本和资源方面发挥重要作用。
en: The last lesson of Egypt’s World Cup experience is that international engagement can play a vital role in enhancing domestic capital and resources.

zh: 像萨拉赫那样有机会出国踢高水平联赛中的球员可以强化和拓展自身的技能，同时更全面地理解这项运动的相关策略。
en: Players who, like Salah, have opportunities to play abroad in highly competitive leagues can deepen and expand their skill sets, while developing a broader strategic understanding of the game.

zh: 这使他们能够更好地改善国家队在区域和全球性大赛中的表现。
en: This puts them in a better position to improve the performance of the national team in regional and global competitions.

zh: 日益增加的球员跨国流动使得各国球技水平走向趋同，这一点从阿根廷、巴西、法国、德国，意大利和西班牙等传统足球强国的统治地位下降上可以看出。
en: The increased movement of players across borders has already contributed to a convergence among countries’ skill levels, reflected in the declining dominance of traditional powerhouses like Argentina, Brazil, France, Germany, Italy, and Spain.

zh: 事实上，意大利连本届世界杯决赛圈都没进，德国队在小组赛中出局，阿根廷队也只是涉险过关。
en: Indeed, Italy did not qualify for this World Cup, Germany lost in the group stage, and Argentina got a real scare.

zh: 埃及需要更加努力去抓住发展人力资本的国际机遇，让出国学习者将自己获取的见识和专业知识传回国内，并将所学到的知识传播给更多的同胞。
en: Greater efforts are needed to seize international opportunities for human-capital development, to repatriate the resulting knowledge and expertise, and to spread what is learned to more people at home.

zh: 这可不仅限于足球一项运动，也同样适用于包括商业流程到科技上的许多目标。
en: That is as true for soccer as it is for many other pursuits, from business processes to technology.

zh: 埃及入围世界杯决赛圈已经表明了该国有能力参与国际最高水平赛事。
en: Egypt’s qualification for the World Cup showed that the country is capable of competing at the highest international level.

zh: 为此埃及人不应将球队的败北视为失败，而应将其视为一种可以帮助指导该国在多个方面更充分发挥其巨大潜力的学习体验。
en: Rather than treating its loss as a failure, Egyptians should view it as a learning experience, one that can help guide the country as it seeks to achieve more fully its considerable potential on multiple fronts.

zh: 事实上，从这种失望中汲取的教训所蕴含的意义可以远远超出足球领域，也远远超出埃及一国。
en: In fact, the lessons learned from this disappointment can be applied well beyond soccer – and well beyond Egypt.

zh: 2014年的中东安全
en: Middle East Security in 2014

zh: 耶路撒冷—中东是一个让预测死无葬身之地的地方。
en: JERUSALEM – The Middle East is a region where predictions go to die.

zh: 而该地区当下的动荡局势让预测事态发展变得更加棘手了。
en: And the region’s recent turbulence has made forecasting the course of events there even more treacherous.

zh: 但是，2013年以来日益明确的是，中东危机的主要根源不是“文明的冲突 ” ， 而是以逊尼派-什叶派分歧为核心的伊斯兰教内部冲突。
en: But, as became increasingly clear in 2013, the main source of the Middle East’s crises is not a “clash of civilizations,” but a clash within Islam, centered on the Sunni-Shia divide.

zh: 这场斗争的平民伤亡数字令人震惊。
en: The civilian death toll from this struggle is staggering.

zh: 阿富汗、埃及、伊拉克、利比亚和叙利亚伤亡数字之和已经达到了好几十万 — — 也许是1948年以来的以色列-巴勒斯坦总伤亡数字的十倍 — — 另有数百万人过着悲惨的难民生活。
en: The combined figure for Afghanistan, Egypt, Iraq, Libya, and Syria is now approaching many hundreds of thousands – perhaps ten times the total death toll of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict since 1948 – while millions more are leading squalid lives as refugees.

zh: 如今，阿拉伯之春已经不再火热，中东的2014年前景看起来十分黯淡。
en: With the Arab Spring now frozen over, the regional outlook for 2014 appears gloomy.

zh: 我们仍能看到一些机会，2014年也必将有更多的机会涌现。
en: Some opportunities are still on the table, and more will surely emerge during the coming year.

zh: 但抓住这些机会需要全球领导和战略上的明确、详细和果断 — — 这些在2013年都无从寻找。
en: But seizing them will demand global leadership, strategic clarity, nuance, and decisiveness – almost all of which were absent in 2013.

zh: 事实上，世界领导人和公众、敌手和盟友中间有一种日益普遍的看法，即长期以来的全球领导者美国已经大大地衰落了。
en: Indeed, there is a spreading perception among world leaders and publics, adversaries and allies alike, that the longtime incumbent global leader, the United States, has been significantly weakened.

zh: 总统奥巴马在叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权去年夏天使用化学武器后无法坚守“红线 ” ； 埃及回归军政；伊朗在2009年大选后爆发示威游行；伊拉克、阿富汗、巴基斯坦局势动荡，这些都是美国衰落的写照。
en: Consider President Barack Obama’s failure to defend his “red line” after Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s regime used chemical weapons this past summer; Egypt’s return to military rule; Iran’s post-election protests in 2009; or the instability in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Pakistan.

zh: 由于美国带来的不确定性，伊朗、叙利亚和真主党轴心胆量大了起来，明年必将利用它们所取得的成果。
en: As a result of American uncertainty, the radical axis of Iran, Syria, and Hezbollah feels emboldened, and will certainly try to leverage its achievements in the year ahead.

zh: 巴沙尔最终把他使用化学武器攻击所造成的震惊变成了仍有待执行和核查的裁军协议的谈判筹码，极大地延缓（如果不是挫败的话）了推翻他的图谋。
en: Assad ended up using the shock caused by his chemical-weapons attack as a bargaining chip in a disarmament deal – still to be executed and verified – that bought him a valuable pause in the efforts to topple him, if not salvation.

zh: 2014年，巴沙尔将寻求推迟化学武器协议的实际实施，从而赢得时间进一步瓦解和削弱他的反对者。
en: Assad will seek in 2014 to delay the actual implementation of the chemical-weapons deal, in order to gain time to split and weaken his opponents further.

zh: 他还可以继续蒙混过关 — — 在11月美国中期选举之前，对他动武将是政治上不可能的任务。
en: He could then muddle through until the US mid-term elections in November, when attacking him would be politically impossible.

zh: 他极有可能可以侥幸逃脱。
en: There is a good chance that he will get away with it.

zh: 真主党将支持巴沙尔直到最后，因为后者的掌权关系到前者本身的存亡。
en: Hezbollah will support Assad to the end, because his continuing hold on power is critical to its own survival.

zh: 因内斗而遭到削弱的叙利亚叛军也是美国及其阿拉伯盟友日益不和的受害者。
en: The Syrian rebels, weakened by infighting, have also been victims of the growing rift between the US and its closest Arab allies.

zh: 叛军没有成功打击巴沙尔本人的机会，因此几无可能在地面上取得胜利。
en: Short of a successful attack on Assad himself, the chances of a rebel triumph on the ground are slim.

zh: 明年，和平谈判将在日内瓦重启，其唯一的成功机会是巴沙尔在被严重削弱后来到谈判桌前，而这不太可能发生。
en: Renewed peace negotiations in Geneva next year can succeed only if Assad comes to the table substantially weaker, which probably will not happen.

zh: 以色列将继续先发制人的打击以防止重型导弹和先进的防空系统从叙利亚流入黎巴嫩南部的真主党，而这当然将带来采取军事摊牌的风险。
en: Israel will continue to act proactively to prevent the transfer of heavy missiles or advanced air-defense systems from Syria to Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, which of course carries the risk of a military showdown.

zh: 但先发制人措施也可以阻止真主党获得对黎巴嫩的绝对主宰权，从而有利于黎巴嫩的生存。
en: But such pre-emptive measures could also promote Lebanon’s survival by preventing Hezbollah from gaining absolute dominance over the country.

zh: 尽管巴沙尔暂时无忧，但与伊拉克和利比亚一样，叙利亚面临逐渐进入同族部落交织缠斗的局面，这些部落可能完全独立，也可能松散地联系在一起，类似于后铁托时代的南斯拉夫 — — 铁腕人物身后留下政治空白由共同的愤怒来填补。
en: Though Assad may survive for now, Syria, like Iraq and Libya, faces creeping disintegration into more ethnically homogenous sub-entities, either completely separate or very loosely tied together, similar to post-Tito Yugoslavia, where communal rage filled the political void left by the dictator’s iron fist.

zh: 矛盾的是，阿拉伯世界的分裂之际，正是伊朗从数十年严重外交封闭中走出之时。
en: Paradoxically, disintegration in the Arab world is taking place just when Iran is emerging from its decades-long diplomatic deep freeze.

zh: 11月在日内瓦达成关于其核计划的为期六个月的过渡性协议后，伊朗的军用核计划可能会暂时停歇。
en: Following the six-month interim agreement on its nuclear program reached in Geneva in November, Iran’s military nuclear program may be stopped temporarily.

zh: 但伊朗以很低的代价换来了从令人窒息的国际制裁中解脱的机会；而由于过渡协议的两阶段结构推迟了协议成功与否的决定日，对伊朗 — — 以及全世界 — — 的真正考验还在后面。
en: But Iran got relief from crippling international sanctions at a low price; and, because the two-phase structure of the interim agreement delays verification of its success or failure, the true test for Iran – and the world – is still to come.

zh: 迫在眉睫的风险是伊朗仍有核浓缩能力，也有大量低纯度铀。
en: The immediate risk is that Iran still possesses the capability to enrich uranium, as well as a substantial amount of low-enriched uranium.

zh: 如何处理这些铀在于伊朗，而其执政者很可能简单地等待美国（不管出于何种原因）无法做出反应时向核能力迈进。
en: The decision about how to proceed is Iran’s, and its rulers will most likely simply wait for an opportunity to charge ahead toward nuclear capability when the US is unable, for whatever reasons, to respond.

zh: 这也许需要6—12个月的时间，在伊朗看来还伴随着一些风险；但一旦他们拥有了达到武器级别的材料，就没有什么能够阻止她们成为军事核力量了。
en: This might take 6-12 months, with some risks from the Iranians’ point of view; but once they have enough weapon-grade material, nothing could be done to stop Iran from becoming a military nuclear power.

zh: 巴基斯坦和朝鲜都走过这条路。
en: Both Pakistan and North Korea took that path.

zh: 而有了美国在叙利亚的反覆的先例，伊朗人相信，随着时间的推移，实体打击（至少是来自美国的实体打击）并不在选择范围中。
en: And, following America’s Syrian zigzag, the Iranians are convinced that, for the time being, a physical attack (at least by the US) is not on the table.

zh: 有核伊朗所带来的后果可能是让地区秩序和全球稳定毁于一旦。
en: The consequences of a nuclear-armed Iran could be devastating for regional order and global stability.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯可以在数周内拥有核武器，土耳其和埃及也将被迫跟进。
en: Saudi Arabia might have nuclear weapons within weeks, with Turkey and Egypt feeling compelled to follow.

zh: 国际核不扩散制度将崩溃。
en: The international non-proliferation regime would collapse.

zh: 霸权伊朗将震慑波斯湾邻国、赞助国外恐怖活动，并自认为不再需要顾忌国际干预。
en: Hegemonic Iran would intimidate its Gulf neighbors, sponsor terrorist activities abroad, and feel immune from international intervention.

zh: 当然，如果永久协议谈判崩溃，以色列甚至美国可能被迫考虑采取进一步行动。
en: Of course, if negotiations on a permanent agreement collapse, Israel and probably even the US might feel compelled to contemplate further action.

zh: 但是，对于现在来说，伊朗领导人显然相信他们已经为自己赢得了时间。
en: But, for now, Iran’s leaders clearly believe that they have bought themselves time.

zh: 此外，六个月后伊朗可以再提出略加修改的过渡性协议以换取进一步放松制裁，再一次利用选举年对美国决策所造成的瘫痪效应。
en: Moreover, in six months, Iran might propose another slightly modified interim agreement with a further loosening of sanctions, leveraging once again the paralysis imposed by election-year dynamics on American decision-making.

zh: 这套战略可能将永久协议拖延到2014年以后。
en: Such a strategy could drag the permanent phase of the agreement far beyond 2014.

zh: 伊朗人是象棋高手，他们明白如何布局。
en: Iranians are chess players; they know what a gambit is.

zh: 他们并没有放弃获胜的机会。
en: They have not given up on winning the game.

zh: 唯一的解决办法 — — 也还有时间 — — 是找到一个办法明白无误地向伊朗人传递信息 ： “ 我们尊重你们的需求。
en: The only solution – for which there is still time – is to find a way to tell the Iranians unequivocally: “We respect your needs.

zh: 我们也不会公开让你们难堪。
en: We will not embarrass you in public.

zh: 但你们应该明白我们不是在开玩笑。
en: But you should understand that we mean business.

zh: 你们必须在你未来几个月里裁掉军事核计划，否则后果自负。 ”
en: You will have to dismantle the military nuclear program in the coming few months, or face the consequences.”

zh: 伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊从未得到过如此明确的信号。
en: Such a message has never reached Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

zh: 既然从未听说，也不相信，他自然也不会屈服。
en: Without hearing and believing it, there is no way that he will yield.

zh: 相对论一百年
en: One Hundred Years of Relativity

zh: 斯托克霍姆—今年是爱因斯坦广义相对论诞生一百周年。 这个伟大理论把引力描述为空间和时间的弯曲。
en: STOCKHOLM – This year marks the centenary of Albert Einstein's general theory of relativity, his masterwork describing gravity as the curvature of space and time.

zh: 但是，科学界总是发现，爱因斯坦的洞见给物理学家带来的问题与答案一样多。
en: Yet, as is often true in science, Einstein's insights have provided physicists with as many questions as they have answered.

zh: 寻找符合爱因斯坦方程的解 — — 描述宇宙曲率的时空 — — 十分困难，因此他的理论进展缓慢。
en: Finding solutions that fulfill Einstein's equations – space-times that describe the curvature of our universe – is difficult, so his theory was slow to catch on.

zh: 进行早期研究和第一批决定性测试的科学家不得不使用逼近技术。
en: Scientists carrying out early studies and the first crucial tests were forced to use approximations.

zh: 科学界花了几十年时间才发展出归类和推导新解的技术。
en: It took decades to develop techniques to classify and derive new solutions.

zh: 但是，如今我们已经知道了许多解，其他棘手问题，如两颗碰撞恒星的引力场问题，可以用计算机求得数值解来探索。
en: Today, however, many solutions are known, and other thorny problems, such as the gravitational field of two colliding stars, can be explored using computers to carry out the numerical calculations.

zh: 爱因斯坦的理论不但描述了从我们的宇宙 — — 从大爆炸到黑洞；它也教会了物理学家几何与对称的重要性 — — 从粒子物理到晶体学都获益良多。
en: Einstein's theory not only describes our universe, from the Big Bang to black holes; it has also taught physicists the relevance of geometry and symmetry – lessons that spread from particle physics to crystallography.

zh: 但是，尽管爱因斯坦的理论与其他物理学理论有诸多相似之处，但它与解释原子和次原子级别物质的主要行为的量子力学格格不入。
en: But, despite the similarities that Einstein's theory has with other theories in physics, it stands apart by its refusal to fit together with quantum mechanics, the theory that explains the dominant behavior of matter at the atomic and subatomic scale.

zh: 根据爱因斯坦的理论，引力与其他为人类所知的物理力不同，它不是量子化的。
en: According to Einstein's theory, gravity, unlike all other physical forces known to man, is not quantized.

zh: 它不受海森堡著名的不确定性原理的约束。
en: It is not subject to Heisenberg's famed uncertainty principle.

zh: 穿越双缝的粒子的电磁场可以同时穿越两条缝。
en: The electromagnetic field of a particle that passes through a double slit can pass through both slits at once.

zh: 其引力等价物则不能。
en: Its gravitational equivalent cannot.

zh: 这一我们对引力的理解和物质的量子理论之间的不匹配给理论物理学家带来了极大的难题，因为这导致了数学上的矛盾。
en: This mismatch between our understanding of gravity and the quantum theories of matter poses a huge conundrum for theoretical physicists, because it leads to mathematical contradictions.

zh: 显然，某些能够将量子理论与引力联系起来的知识我们仍然不知道，并且我们队空间、时间和物质的理解取决于这一联系。
en: Clearly, there is something about the combination of quantum theory and gravity that remains unknown, and our understanding of space, time, and matter hinges on unraveling this connection.

zh: 寻找一种与我们对量子物理学的理解相容的引力的描述方法将带来宇宙学革命，形成关于宇宙最初时刻的新的洞见，并提供作为所有现代物理学基础的理论的更深层次的理解。
en: Finding a description of gravity that is compatible with our understanding of quantum physics would revolutionize cosmology, yield new insights into the first moments of our universe, and provide a deeper understanding of the theories on which all of modern physics is based.

zh: 但是，尽管这一突破潜在影响无穷，并且一代又一代物理学家为此殚精竭虑，我们仍然不知道那种理论才是正确的。
en: But, despite the enormous potential impact of such a breakthrough and the efforts of generations of physicists to achieve it, we still do not know which theory is the right one.

zh: 与你在早晨起床时的感觉相反，引力是我们目前所定义的所有基本力中最弱的一种。
en: Contrary to how it may feel when you try to get out of bed in the morning, gravity is by far the weakest fundamental force of all we have identified.

zh: 让你的头发竖起来只需要几个电子的静电斥力，这样就能克服整个地球向你的头发施加的地心引力。
en: It takes only the static repulsion of a few electrons to make your hair stand up, overcoming the gravitational pull of the entire planet.

zh: 在原子和次元子世界，引力与其他力比起来显得无关紧要。 其他力都可以用量子理论来描述。
en: In the atomic and subatomic world, gravity is irrelevant compared to what else is going on, all of which can be described by quantum theories.

zh: 引力的弱性质导致我们很难测量它的量子效应；因此，我们无法获得实验数据指导物理学家研究这一迷失的理论。
en: Gravity's weakness makes it very difficult to measure its quantum effects; as a result, we have no experimental data to guide theoretical physicists in the development of the missing theory.

zh: 检测“引力子 ” — —形成部分引力场的假象粒子 — — 需要银河系那么大的粒子对撞机或质量与木星相当的检测器。
en: Detecting a “graviton" – the hypothetical particle making up part of a gravitational field – would require a particle collider the size of the Milky Way or a detector with a mass of the planet Jupiter.

zh: 这些实验目前仍远远脱离我们的技术能力，因此物理学家不得不首先解决数学矛盾，发展出弦论、圈量子引力和渐进安全引力等方法。
en: These experiments are so detached from our technological capabilities that physicists have focused on trying to remove the mathematical contradictions first, developing approaches like string theory, loop quantum gravity, and asymptotically safe gravity.

zh: 但要想知道哪种理论描述了物理实际，最终要需要实验检验。
en: But to know which theory describes physical reality, experimental tests must eventually be developed.

zh: 就这样，在过去十年中，物理学家已开始寻找量子引力的间接证据。
en: That is why, over the last decade, physicists have begun to look for indirect evidence of quantum gravity.

zh: 研究者没有去试图检测引力场的量子，而是寻找其他表明引力被量子化的效应。
en: Rather than seeking to detect a quantum of the gravitational field, researchers are looking for other effects that would imply that gravity is quantized.

zh: 这些测试工作很像是利用原子的稳定性作为间接证据证明电磁力的量子化。
en: These tests work much like those that use the stability of atoms as indirect evidence for the quantization of the electromagnetic force.

zh: 比如，一些科学家在寻找能模糊遥远星系影像或导致系统性扭曲的时空的量子波动的证据。
en: For example, some scientists are searching for evidence of quantum fluctuations of space-time that could blur images of distant stars or lead to systematic distortions.

zh: 另一些科学家在寻找对违反某些对称性的现象，这一现象让正常情况下不会发生的粒子衰减能够发生。 其他科学家在寻找引力波检测器中的噪声或难以解释的量子相干性的丧失。
en: Others are looking for violations of certain symmetries that could enable normally forbidden particle decays, unexplained noise in gravitational wave detectors, or inexplicable loss of quantum coherence.

zh: 目前，这些尝试都没有发现想要的证据。
en: So far, these attempts have failed to detect the sought-after evidence.

zh: 尽管如此，它们还是带来了重要的发展，因为消极结果排除了一些似是而非的假说。
en: Nonetheless, they have led to important developments, because the negative results have ruled out some plausible hypotheses.

zh: 此外，尽管研究者尚未发现支持任何一种理论的结果，但他们通过更好地定义任何引力的量子理论都必须考虑的观察标准推动的科学进步。
en: And, though researchers may not have found results supporting any one theory, they have advanced the cause of science by better defining the observational criteria any quantum theory of gravity will have to take into account.

zh: 在我们纪念爱因斯坦的成就的同时，我们也应该抓住这一机会赞美奋勇向前、试图回答爱因斯坦理论留给我们的问题的人的不屈不挠的精神。
en: As we commemorate Einstein's achievement, we should also seize the opportunity to celebrate the unrelenting spirit of those who are pushing ahead and trying to answer the questions his theory left us.

zh: 这一追求过程产生了硕果累累的研究领域，如宇宙学、数值广义相对论和量子引力。
en: That quest has blossomed into astonishingly fruitful research areas like cosmology, numerical general relativity, and quantum gravity.

zh: 广义相对论给我们带来了虫洞、蒸发黑洞和大爆炸理论；它打下的基础让我们发现宇宙正��扩张并且所谓的系外行星远比所有人想象的都更常见；它彻底改写了我们对地球和宇宙的看法，甚至带来了宇宙到底是否唯一的问题。
en: General Relativity has brought us wormholes, evaporating black holes, and the Big Bang theory; it underlies the discovery that the universe is expanding and that so-called exoplanets are much more common than anybody thought; and it has utterly redefined the way we think of our own place in the universe, ultimately even calling into question whether this universe is the only one.

zh: 如果研究者一直根据当前学术界通行的三年计划进行研究，所有这些进步都不会发生。
en: None of these advances would have been possible had researchers been operating according to the three-year plans that characterize much of current academia.

zh: 因此，今年也许是一次感谢空想家的良机，他们知道，可持续进步取决于更好更新理论的发展，这些新理论的影响也许需要几十年才能了解 — — 事实上，有可能继续分叉发展100年才行。
en: So this year is perhaps a good moment to appreciate the visionaries who have understood that sustainable progress relies on the development of new and better theories whose impact may not be fully grasped for decades – indeed, that may continue to ramify 100 years later.

zh: 现实主义者爱因斯坦
en: Einstein the Realist

zh: 发自牛津 — — 最近有研究发现宇宙的膨胀速度并未减缓，而是如原先推导的那样逐渐加速。
en: OXFORD – It was recently discovered that the universe’s expansion is accelerating, not slowing, as was previously thought.

zh: 来自远方恒星爆炸所产生的光揭示出在宇宙学范畴内存在一种比引力更加强大的未知力量（人们称之为“暗能量 ” ） 。
en: Light from distant exploding stars revealed that an unknown force (dubbed “dark energy”) more than outweighs gravity on cosmological scales.

zh: 但出乎研究者意料的是，阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦在1915年修正自身引力理论时就已经预判了这一力量的存在。
en: Unexpected by researchers, such a force had nevertheless been predicted in 1915 by a modification that Albert Einstein proposed to his own theory of gravity, the general theory of relativity.

zh: 但他随后却放弃了这一名为“宇宙项”的修正，并将其称之为一生中“最严重的失误 ” 。
en: But he later dropped the modification, known as the “cosmological term,” calling it the “biggest blunder” of his life.

zh: 于是各大报章头条都惊呼 ： “ 爱因斯坦最后还是对的！ ”仿佛科学家们都是一帮拥有千里眼顺风耳，洞察不可知事物的特异人士 — — 而这些不可知事物包括一些尚未进行，甚至还未构想出来的实验所得出的结果。
en: So the headlines proclaim: “Einstein was right after all,” as though scientists should be compared as one would clairvoyants: Who is distinguished from the common herd by knowing the unknowable – such as the outcome of experiments that have yet to be conceived, let alone conducted?

zh: 试问这些擅长马后炮的人中又有谁曾经做出过准确预测？
en: Who, with hindsight, has prophesied correctly?

zh: 但科学并不是科学家之间的竞争；而是一场理念的竞技 — — 所谓理念，也就是解释现实存在的究竟是何种事物，而这种事物又是为何以及如何运动。
en: But science is not a competition between scientists; it is a contest of ideas – namely, explanations of what is out there in reality, how it behaves, and why.

zh: 这些解释最初往往都无法通过实验来验证，只能通过用以解开自然之迷的推理，逻辑，适用性以及独特性等条件来检测。
en: These explanations are initially tested not by experiment but by criteria of reason, logic, applicability, and uniqueness at solving the mysteries of nature that they address.

zh: 而预测只是用来验证能通过上述条件考验的很小一部分解释。
en: Predictions are used to test only the tiny minority of explanations that survive these criteria.

zh: 而爱因斯坦为何提出宇宙常数，随后又放弃，如今又被宇宙学家重新引入的经历恰好展示了这一过程。
en: The story of whyEinstein proposed the cosmological term, whyhe dropped it, and whycosmologists today have reintroduced it illustrates this process.

zh: 爱因斯坦尝试避免未修正前的广义相对论所引出的结论：宇宙不可能是静态的 — — 这意味着宇宙可以膨胀（在自身引力影响下逐渐放缓 ） ， 坍塌或者突然进入静止状态，但它不能在没有支撑的情况下存在。
en: Einstein sought to avoid the implication of unmodified general relativity that the universe cannot be static – that it can expand (slowing down, against its own gravity), collapse, or be instantaneously at rest, but that it cannot hang unsupported.

zh: 这一特定推测无法得到验证（即便宇宙真的陷入静止，也没有任何观测手段能确认这一点 ） ， 但同时又不可能随意改动广义相对论的相关方程，因为它们都受到爱因斯坦理论中某些基本解释的限制，比如引力来源于时空的弯曲，对于所有观测者来说光速都是相等的等解释。
en: This particular prediction cannot be tested (no observation could establish that the universe isat rest, even if it were), but it is impossible to change the equations of general relativity arbitrarily. They are tightly constrained by the explanatory substance of Einstein’s theory, which holds that gravity is due to the curvature of spacetime, that light has the same speed for all observers, and so on.

zh: 但爱因斯坦意识到有可能在不破坏其他解释的情况下添加一个特殊项 — — 即宇宙项 — — 并调整其数量来推测一个静态的宇宙。
en: But Einstein realized that it is possible to add one particular term – the cosmological term – and adjust its magnitude to predict a static universe, without spoiling any other explanation.

zh: 其他所有基于原有牛顿引力理论的预测当时都可以得到验证，而且都与未修正的广义相对论的推测极为相近，只有一个例外：牛顿的空间是一个相对于运动物体的不运动背景。
en: All other predictions based on the previous theory of gravity – that of Isaac Newton – that were testable at the time were good approximations to those of unmodified general relativity, with that single exception: Newton’s space was an unmoving background against which objects move.

zh: 当时没有任何证据能反对牛顿的观点 — — 也没有未知的膨胀需要解释。
en: There was no evidence yet, contradicting Newton’s view – no mystery of expansion to explain.

zh: 此外任何脱离这一传统空间概念的理论都需要实现相当大的观念跳跃，而宇宙项并未对其他预测造成可测量的差异。
en: Moreover, anything beyond that traditional conception of space required a considerable conceptual leap, while the cosmological term made no measurable difference to other predictions.

zh: 因此爱因斯坦把它添加了进来。
en: So Einstein added it.

zh: 随后在1929年，埃德温·哈勃发现宇宙正在不断膨胀，而且以当时的观测精度看来该发现与修正前的广义相对论相一致。
en: Then, in 1929, Edwin Hubble discovered that the universe is expanding, consistently (within the observational accuracy of the day) with unmodified general relativity.

zh: 于是爱因斯坦又舍弃了宇宙项。
en: So Einstein dropped the cosmological term.

zh: 他这样做并非因为哈勃以甚少犯错著称；也并非臣服于哈勃的超凡预测能力，只不过因为这一宇宙项所试图解决的问题已经不存在了。
en: His doing so had nothing to do with Hubble being less blunder-prone; nor was Einstein deferring to Hubble’s superior prophetic abilities. It was just that the problem that the term was intended to solve no longer existed.

zh: 当时那些新观测结果也并未否定宇宙项的存在，仅仅是说明该项是一个不太好的解释罢了。
en: The new observations did not refute the existence of a cosmological term. They merely made it a bad explanation.

zh: 结果1998年的更新观测结果发现宇宙正在加速膨胀。
en: Then, in 1998, came those new observations of a universe whose expansion is accelerating.

zh: 结果“重新引入”来解释这些新观测的宇宙项已经与爱因斯坦当年提出又撤销的那个有所不同了。
en: As a result, the cosmological term that has been “reinstated” to account for the new observations is not quite the one that Einstein proposed and retracted.

zh: 它变得更加宏大，因为不仅要解释为何宇宙没有坍塌，还要说明为何在加速膨胀。
en: It is larger, for it now has to explain not just why the universe isn’t collapsing, but why its expansion is accelerating.

zh: 而爱因斯坦所谓“犯了大错”的评论也跟如今“终于胜利”的说法一样具有误导性。
en: Einstein’s remark about having “blundered” is as misleading as the idea that he is “right after all.”

zh: 宇宙项不是一个永远不应被提出的东西。
en: The cosmological term is not something that should never have been proposed.

zh: 它的引入代表了人们在认识现实的过程中所取得的进步 — — 而它在哈勃观测结果公布后的被舍弃，以及在新发现后以一种修正后的新形式被重新引入都同样说明了这一点。
en: Its introduction represented progress in understanding reality – as did its abandonment in light of Hubble’s discovery and its reinstatement in revised form to account for the new observations.

zh: 同样，上世纪中叶的“波尔-爱因斯坦量子理论之辩”往往被误读为是一场天才人物之间的冲突。
en: Likewise, the mid-twentieth century “Bohr-Einstein debate” about quantum theory is often misinterpreted as a personal clash between wizards.

zh: 在该领域其中一个领军人物尼尔斯·波尔的带动下量子理论的推测是如此的违反直觉，以致人们认为根本没有任何基本现实能解释这些推测。
en: So counter-intuitive are quantum theory’s predictions that, under the leadership of one of its pioneers, Neils Bohr, a myth grew that there is no underlying reality that explains them.

zh: 从A点向B点运动的粒子不需要穿过中间的空间，在这个空间中粒子并没有足够的能量来维持其存在；它们只是暂时“借用”能量，因为我们“不确定”究竟它们的能量来自何处。
en: Particles get from A to B without passing through the intervening space, where they have insufficient energy to exist; they briefly “borrow” the energy, because we are “uncertain” about what their energy is.

zh: 信息从A点到B点无需穿过任何东西 — — 爱因斯坦称之为“幽靈般的超距作用 ” 。
en: Information gets from A to B without anything passing in between – what Einstein called “spooky action at a distance.”

zh: 相似的例子还有很多。
en: And so on.

zh: 而这类自相矛盾的解释的共同点就是都抛弃了现实主义，而现实主义这一基本信条认为存在于现实中的物理世界解释了我们的所有经验认识。
en: What these paradoxical interpretations have in common is that they abandon realism, the doctrine that a physical world, existing in reality, accounts for all of our experience.

zh: 当今量子理论中的反现实主义依然流行，并以各种面目跻身于教科书和流行解释之中。
en: Anti-realism remains popular and appears in various guises in textbooks and popular accounts of quantum theory.

zh: 但爱因斯坦坚持物理现象必须可以用他所谓的“实体要素”来解释。
en: But Einstein insisted that physical phenomena have explanations in terms of what he called “elements of reality.”

zh: 幸运的是，包括笔者在内的一小部分物理学家都采纳量子物理学家休·艾弗雷特的多世界诠释，并明确地站在了现实主义一边。
en: Fortunately, a minority of physicists, myself included, likewise side unequivocally with realism, by adopting Hugh Everett’s multiple-universes interpretation of quantum theory.

zh: 根据这一诠释，在没有足够能量的情况下粒子是不存在的；在某些宇宙中它们拥有比平均水平更多的能量，而在其他宇宙中则较少。
en: According to this view, no particles exist where they have insufficient energy to be; it is simply that in some universes they have more energy than average, and in others, less.

zh: 至此量子理论中的所有所谓“矛盾”都迎刃而解。
en: All alleged “paradoxes” of quantum theory are similarly resolved.

zh: 因此当大多数解释认为波尔赢得了论战之时，我的看法则是当爱因斯坦一如既往地寻找一个实体解释之时，他的对手却在鼓吹虚无。
en: So, while most accounts say that Bohr won the debate, my view is that Einstein, as usual, was seeking an explanation of reality, while his rivals were advocating nonsense.

zh: 而艾弗雷特的解释也并不是将爱因斯坦神化，只是再次证明了后者的正确而已。
en: Everett’s interpretation doesn’t make Einstein a demigod. But it does make him right.

zh: 诊断学和全球健康
en: Diagnostics for Global Health

zh: 科瓦利斯，俄勒冈州—在发达国家，大部分人认为得病时获得及时诊断和治疗乃是理所应当之事。
en: CORVALLIS, OREGON – In developed countries, most people take for granted that when they are sick, they will have access to timely diagnosis and treatment.

zh: 事实上，尽管诊断过程 — — 通常情况下包括递交血液、尿液或组织样本进行实验室分析 — — 可能繁琐而昂贵，医疗提供者和高精尖实验室往往门可罗雀。
en: Indeed, while the diagnostic process – which typically involves sending a sample of blood, urine, or tissue to a laboratory for analysis – may be cumbersome and expensive, health-care providers and sophisticated laboratories remain widely available.

zh: 因此，发达国家的疾病负担可以大大下降。
en: As a result, the disease burden in the developed world has declined substantially.

zh: 相反，在发展中世界，每年有数百万人死于疟疾等可治疾病，原因是缺乏先进实验室和其他诊断测试。
en: By contrast, in the developing world, millions of people die each year from treatable diseases like malaria, owing to the lack of sophisticated laboratories and alternative diagnostic tests.

zh: 但希望仍在：微流控领域的进步有望通过允许基于实验室的检测这一“金本位”变为“床旁检测 ” （ point of care，POC）改变医疗。
en: But there is reason for hope: Advances in the field of microfluidics have the potential to transform health care by allowing “gold standard” laboratory-based testing to be transferred to the point of care (POC).

zh: 提供及时准确结果的床旁检测可以为得不到充分服务的人群提供诊断，让他们更早得到治疗并避免误治（当成另一种症状相似的疾病来治 ） 。
en: A POC test that provides an accurate and timely result would provide diagnostic access to underserved populations, enabling earlier treatment and helping to avoid mistreatment (treating another disease with similar symptoms).

zh: 但是，为了实现这一潜力，床旁检测必须考虑影响医疗应用的诸多影响因素。
en: In order to meet their potential, however, POC tests must account for the wide range of factors affecting health-care applications.

zh: 首先，床旁检测必须面对特定的环境和操作约束。
en: First, a POC test must meet the particular environmental and operating constraints of where it will be used.

zh: 这些约束可能包括供电不稳、恶劣或不可预知的环境状况、医疗服务提供者和病患之间联系时间太少、用户缺少培训、服务价格约束和地方基础设施不足等，这些因素可能制约相关��器的维护和维修。
en: These may include an unreliable power supply, harsh or unpredictable environmental conditions, limited contact time between the health-care provider and patient, lack of user training, severe price constraints, and inadequate local infrastructure, which can impede the maintenance and repair of relevant instruments.

zh: 事实上，床旁测试的环境可能是略经训练的医疗服务提供者在有电和制冷设备的诊所中进行，也可能是未受过训练的个人在无温度和湿度控制装置的环境中进行。
en: Indeed, POC settings can vary from a semi-trained health-care provider working in a clinic with electricity and access to refrigeration to an untrained individual in an environment with no mechanism for controlling temperature or humidity.

zh: 为了确保尽可能广泛的覆盖，床旁测试应该被设计成在最简陋环境中进行。
