en: One should always be careful about attributing motives to other people’s views.

zh: 但是，库施奈尔本人经常说他的俄罗斯犹太裔祖父母在奥斯威辛集中营被害激发了他的人道干预主义。
en: But Kouchner himself has often said that the murder of his Russian-Jewish grandparents in Auschwitz inspired his humanitarian interventionism.

zh: 人们或许同意或许不同意库施奈尔的政策，但是他的动机却是无可指摘的。
en: One may or may not agree with Kouchner’s policies, but his motives are surely impeccable.

zh: 欧洲和美国的众多著名犹太裔知识分子都经常像库施奈尔一样有过左倾历史。 他们对使用美国武力在世界上促进人权和民主事业表示同情。
en: The fact that many prominent Jewish intellectuals in Europe and the United States – often, like Kouchner, with a leftist past – are sympathetic to the idea of using American armed force to further the cause of human rights and democracy in the world, may derive from the same wellspring.

zh: 他们的观点可能也来自同样的源泉。 他们认为，为了避免另一场犹太人浩劫，使用武力都是应该的，而那些逃避支持使用武力责任的人则被认为是邪恶的同犯。
en: Any force is justified to avoid another Shoah, and those who shirk their duty to support such force are regarded as no better than collaborators with evil.

zh: 如果我们不是那么被绥靖纳粹政权的记忆以及随后的种族屠杀所困扰，那么人们就可能不会如此关心人权问题了。
en: If we were less haunted by memories of appeasing the Nazi regime, and of the ensuing genocide, people might not be as concerned about human rights as they are.

zh: 而且，那些保护他人人权的人不用引用第三帝国的恐怖来给英美武装干预提供理由。
en: And by no means do all those who work to protect the rights of others invoke the horrors of the Third Reich to justify Anglo-American armed intervention.

zh: 但是“伊斯兰法西斯主义”这一词汇并非空穴来风。
en: But the term “Islamofascism” was not coined for nothing.

zh: 这会让我们将伊斯兰世界的一大部分视为纳粹主义的自然延伸。
en: It invites us to see a big part of the Islamic world as a natural extension of Nazism.

zh: 萨达姆根本就不是什么伊斯兰主义者，而伊朗总统内贾德则经常被描绘成为希特勒天然的继承人。
en: Saddam Hussein, who was hardly an Islamist, and Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, who is, are often described as natural successors to Adolf Hitler.

zh: 而欧洲的软弱，更不要说对其自由主义的“背叛 ” ， 进而造成伊斯兰对欧洲的征服（所谓“欧洲伊斯兰 ” ） 则被认为是对纳粹威胁采取绥靖主义的可怕回响。
en: And European weakness, not to mention the “treason” of its liberal scribes, paving the way to an Islamist conquest of Europe (“Eurabia”) is seen as a ghastly echo of the appeasement of the Nazi threat.

zh: 革命伊斯兰主义毫无疑问是危险和充满暴力流血的。
en: Revolutionary Islamism is undoubtedly dangerous and bloody.

zh: 但是，把它和第三帝国相比较尽管在谴责政见不同的人士上高度有效，却通常是错误的。
en: Yet analogies with the Third Reich, although highly effective as a way to denounce people with whose views one disagrees, are usually false.

zh: 没有什么伊斯兰军队会入侵欧洲。 实际上，大多数革命伊斯兰主义的受害者居住在中东，而非欧洲，而内贾德尽管其言辞可恶但是其实力不可与希特勒相提并论。
en: No Islamist armies are about to march into Europe – indeed, most victims of Revolutionary Islamism live in the Middle East, not in Europe – and Ahmadinejad, his nasty rhetoric notwithstanding, does not have a fraction of Hitler’s power.

zh: 许多穆斯林人拒绝融入西方社会、高失业率以及随处可见的革命性宣传会轻而易举地爆发为暴力事件。
en: The refusal of many Muslims to integrate into Western societies, as well as high levels of unemployment and ready access to revolutionary propaganda, can easily explode in acts of violence.

zh: 但是，将欧洲“伊斯兰化”也遥不可及。
en: But the prospect of an “Islamized” Europe is also remote.

zh: 我们并不生活在1938年的重演之中。
en: We are not living a replay of 1938.

zh: 那么，人们特别是新保守主义者为什么对欧洲的绥靖如此警觉呢？
en: So why the high alarm about European appeasement, especially among the neo-conservatives?

zh: 为什么轻易地把伊斯兰主义与纳粹主义相提并论呢？
en: Why the easy equation of Islamism with Nazism?

zh: 人们经常把以色列提为一个原因。
en: Israel is often mentioned as a reason.

zh: 但是，对于不同的人来说，以色列具有不同的含义。
en: But Israel can mean different things to different people.

zh: 对于某些福音基督徒来说，以色列是耶稣复生的地方。
en: To certain evangelical Christians, it is the holy site of the Second Coming of the Messiah.

zh: 对于许多犹太人来说，她是一个永远可以避难的地方。
en: To many Jews, it is the one state that will always offer refuge.

zh: 对于新保守主义意识形态者而言，她是在专制主义沙漠中的民主绿洲。
en: To neo-conservative ideologues, it is the democratic oasis in a desert of tyrannies.

zh: 保护以色列不受伊斯兰敌人的侵犯可能确实是当前“反恐战争”基础的存在主义危言耸听的一个因素。
en: Defending Israel against its Islamic enemies may indeed be a factor in the existential alarmism that underlies the present “war on terror.”

zh: 拥有核子武装的伊朗必定会让以色列感到更加脆弱。
en: A nuclear-armed Iran would certainly make Israel feel more vulnerable.

zh: 但是，人们可能把这一局面夸大成为了一个解释。
en: But it is probably overstated as an explanation.

zh: 库施奈尔并没有因为以色列而主张干预波斯尼亚或者科索沃。
en: Kouchner did not advocate Western intervention in Bosnia or Kosovo because of Israel.

zh: 如果对于以色列的忧虑在沃尔福威茨主张对伊拉克动武中发挥了部分作用，那可能也是很小的作用。
en: If concern for Israel played a part in Paul Wolfowitz’s advocacy of war in Iraq, it was probably a minor one.

zh: 对于人权和民主的共同担忧，也许还有地缘政治的考虑可能是这两个人的动机。
en: Both men were motivated by common concerns for human rights and democracy, as well as perhaps by geopolitical considerations.

zh: 内贾德和其他人所采纳的伊斯兰言论依旧是有意用来挑起犹太人大浩劫的回忆。
en: Still, Islamist rhetoric, adopted by Ahmedinejad among others, is deliberately designed to stir up memories of the Shoah.

zh: 所以，某些西方知识分子的存在主义担忧可能要比他们非常甚至是奉承地信任美国政府用武力来挽救世界较为容易解释。
en: So perhaps the existential fear of some Western intellectuals is easier to explain than their remarkable, sometimes fawning trust in the US government to save the world by force.

zh: 对于这一神秘信赖的解释可能在其他地方。 许多新保守主义者从左倾的过去演变出来。
en: The explanation of this mysterious trust may lie elsewhere.

zh: 左倾主义相信自上而下的革命是司空见惯的。 昨天是“人民的民主 ” ， 今天是“自由民主 ” 。
en: Many neo-cons emerged from a leftist past, in which a belief in revolution from above was commonplace: “people’s democracies” yesterday, “liberal democracies” today.

zh: 在犹太人和其他少数族裔中，另一个历史记忆可能也发挥了作用， 那就是帝国的保护。
en: Among Jews and other minorities, another historical memory may also play a part: the protection of the imperial state.

zh: 奥地利和匈牙利犹太人是奥匈国王最为忠诚的支持者，因为他让犹太人免受占人口多数���的暴力性收归国有。
en: Austrian and Hungarian Jews were among the most fiercely loyal subjects of the Austro-Hungarian Emperor, because he shielded them from the violent nationalism of the majority populations.

zh: 波兰和俄罗斯犹太人至少在共产主义初期经常使共产国家的忠诚臣民，因为共产国家担保（结果是虚假的）不让他们受到反犹太主义民族主义者的暴力攻击。
en: Polish and Russian Jews, at least at the beginning of the communist era, were often loyal subjects of the communist state, because it promised (falsely, as it turned out) to protect them against the violence of anti-Semitic nationalists.

zh: 如果民主西方世界的根本生存果真会被一场伊斯兰革命所摧毁，只有寻求美国非正式帝国的全力保护才会有道理。
en: If it were really true that the fundamental existence of our democratic Western world were about to be destroyed by an Islamist revolution, it would only make sense to seek protection in the full force of the US informal empire.

zh: 但是，如果人们并不使用这种大难临头的观点看待当前的问题的话，那么就会看到另一种教士的背叛，也就是说，某些时候愚蠢的军事强国进行不必要的战争，造成人的死亡要比战争想要挽救的人还要多，对此却不问原味地喝彩。
en: But if one sees our current problems in less apocalyptic terms, then another kind of trahison des clercs comes into view: the blind cheering on of a sometimes foolish military power embarked on unnecessary wars that cost more lives than they were intended to save.

zh: 经济趋同的未来
en: The Future of Economic Convergence

zh: 华盛顿—世界正面临观察家所谓的“同步”增长上扬。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The world is now facing what observers are calling a “synchronized” growth upswing.

zh: 这对于发达国家和发展中国家的经济“趋同”意味着什么？ 趋同的话题自十年前大衰退开始以来便鲜有人提及。
en: What does this mean for the economic “convergence” of developed and developing countries, a topic that lost salience after the Great Recession began a decade ago?

zh: 20世纪90年代，发展中国家增长开始总体快于发达国家（用人均标准衡量 ） ， 这让很多人乐观地认为这两类国家的产出和收入将会趋于一致。
en: In the 1990s, developing economies, taken as a whole, began to grow faster than their advanced counterparts (in per capita terms), inspiring optimism that the two groups’ output and income would converge.

zh: 从1990年到2007年，发展中经济体平均年人均增长比发达经济体高2.5个百分点。
en: From 1990 to 2007, the developing economies’ average annual per capita growth was 2.5 percentage points higher than in the advanced economies.

zh: 2000—2007年，这一差距进一步拉大，达到了3.5个百分点。
en: In 2000-2007, the gap widened, to 3.5 percentage points.

zh: 尽管不是所有国家都能取得进步 — — 许多小经济体表现不佳 — — 但从总量看，世界经济的结构一直在改变。
en: Though not all countries made progress – many small economies did not do well – on an aggregate basis, the structure of the world economy was being transformed.

zh: 在庞大而有活力的印度 — — 以及更有过之的中国，它经历了近三十年的两位数GDP增长 — — 的推动下，亚洲国家以极快的速度赶超发达经济体。
en: Asian countries were catching up at a particularly rapid clip, driven by the large, dynamic economies of India and, even more so, China (which experienced nearly three decades of double-digit GDP growth).

zh: 但2007年全球金融危机爆发后，这一动态发生了改变。
en: After the global financial crisis began in 2007, however, the dynamic changed.

zh: 一开始，趋同表现出加速之势。
en: At first, it seemed that convergence was accelerating.

zh: 发达经济体增长陷入停滞，发展中经济体的人均增长优势扩大到四个百分点。
en: With advanced-economy growth having ground to a halt, developing countries’ lead in per capita growth increased to four percentage points.

zh: 但在2013—2016年，许多新兴经济体增长慢了下来 — — 特别是拉丁美洲，其中巴西在2015年和2016年经历了衰退 — — 而美国则赶了上来。
en: By 2013-2016, however, growth slowed in many emerging economies – particularly in Latin America, with Brazil experiencing negative growth in 2015 and 2016 – while growth in the United States picked up.

zh: 我们是否如一些观察者所宣称的那样，正在迎来趋同的终局？
en: Are we, as some observers have claimed, witnessing the end of convergence?

zh: 答案取决于发展中经济体找到并利用新的、更高级的增长源泉的能力。
en: The answer will depend on developing economies’ ability to find and tap new, more advanced sources of growth.

zh: 在过去，趋同的主要引擎是制造业。
en: In the past, the key engine of convergence was manufacturing.

zh: 终于获得了必要的技能和制度的发展中国家开始在本地应用发达国家的技术，从而得益于充足的低成本劳动力。
en: Developing countries that had finally acquired the needed skills and institutions applied advanced-country technologies locally, benefiting from plentiful, low-cost labor.

zh: 但丹尼·罗德里克（Dani Rodrik）指出，轻松“山寨”赶超的源泉已经基本耗尽。
en: But, as Dani Rodrik has argued, that source of easy copycat catch-up has mostly been exhausted.

zh: 低垂的制造业果实已被摘尽。
en: The low-hanging fruit in manufacturing has already been picked.

zh: 如今占总增加值更大比例的服务业的技术赶超更加困难。
en: Technological catch-up is more difficult in the services sector, which now accounts for a larger share of total value-added.

zh: 此外，当今尖端科技 — — 比如机器人、人工智能和生物工程 — — 比工业机械更加复杂，可能更难复制。
en: Moreover, today’s cutting-edge technologies – such as robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), and bioengineering – are more complex than industrial machinery, and may be more difficult to copy.

zh: 而由于智能机器日益胜任低薪工作，发展中国家的成本优势也被大大削弱。
en: And, because intelligent machines can increasingly fill low-wage jobs, developing countries’ cost advantage may have been diminished significantly.

zh: 但是，达伦·阿西莫格鲁（Daron Acemoglu）和帕斯库埃尔·雷斯特雷普（Pascual Restrepo）指出，这些技术的冲击 — — 特别是自动化和人工智能 — — 远比这更加微妙。
en: Yet, as Daron Acemoglu and Pascual Restrepo show, the impact of such technologies – in particular, automation and AI – is more nuanced than that.

zh: 他们认为，总产出是传统劳动力、传统资本和可以完全不消耗劳动力完成的任务所涉及的资本的函数。
en: According to them, aggregate output is a function of traditional labor, traditional capital, and capital involved in tasks that can be performed entirely without labor.

zh: 传统劳动力和资本扩张型技术进步，或劳动力替代性进步的增长将提高产出，但后者的增长还会降低劳动力需求、抑制工资。
en: Growth in traditional labor- and capital-augmenting technological progress, or in labor-displacing progress, would increase output, but growth in the latter would also lead to reduced labor demand and lower wages.

zh: 相反，生产率增长，自动化的深入，以及全新任务的创造将增加劳动力需求、推高工资。
en: By contrast, productivity growth, the deepening of automation, or the creation of entirely new tasks would increase labor demand and push up wages.

zh: 当然，对于出现在发展中价值链中 — — 包括依靠前沿技术的服务 — — 的机器人和人工智能来说，仍然需要最低限度的特殊技能和基础设施。
en: Of course, for robotics and AI to appear in developing-country value chains, including services that rely on frontier technologies, a minimum set of specific skills and infrastructure will be needed.

zh: 但在新兴经济体实施某些新技术、部署某些新任务可能会比在发达国家更难、代价更加高昂。
en: But deploying some new technologies and tasks in the emerging economies may turn out to be no more difficult or costly than in advanced countries.

zh: 在这方面，很大程度上将取决于需要何种互补性劳动力。
en: Here, much will depend on what kind of complementary labor is required.

zh: 人们常说，拥有 超高技能劳动力储备对于部署人工智能至关重要。
en: It is often assumed that a pool of very highly skilled labor is crucial to deploy AI.

zh: 在一些例子中，这也许是对的，但在令一些例子中正好相反。
en: That may be true in some cases, but the opposite may be true in others.

zh: 比如，新劳动力取代性技术能够让熟练工不足的活动变得可行。
en: For example, the new labor-displacing technologies could make feasible activities for which there had been insufficient skilled labor.

zh: 因此，完全自动化将导致经济活动的更大份额落在发展中国家。
en: Thus, complete automation can lead to a greater share of an economic activity being located in a developing country.

zh: 另一个影响到发展中国家技术升级过程的因素是跨国公司的投资意愿。
en: Another factor that will shape the process of technological upgrading in developing countries is global firms’ willingness to invest.

zh: 全球市场结构和定价将在一定程度上决定收益的分布。
en: Global market structures and pricing will partly determine the distribution of benefits.

zh: 但各国汲取监管教训的效率亦然，包括如何制定吸引投资者、捕获价值链中的重要细分、确保从创新中获得充分大的收益份额等。
en: But so will countries’ efficiency at learning regulatory lessons, including how to design rules that attract investors, capture important segments of value chains, and secure a sufficiently large share of the gains from innovation.

zh: 学习迅速的国家可能会在现实中比发达经济体增长鞥快，即使是在高科技行业中。
en: Those countries that learn quickly may actually grow faster than advanced economies, even in high-tech sectors.

zh: 当然，对许多国家和部门而言，传统赶超仍然大有可为，这一过程也仍有可能继续推动增长。
en: Of course, for many countries and sectors, there remains considerable room for traditional catch-up – a process that will likely continue to fuel growth.

zh: 但它不足以推动趋同。
en: But it will not be enough to fuel true convergence.

zh: 对于趋同，发展中国家需要相对有效地部署新技术，考虑到劳动力市场技能和监管的作用。
en: For that, developing countries will need to deploy new technologies relatively efficiently, taking into account the role of labor-market skills and regulations.

zh: 这绝非易事，我们也有可能永远无法回归2007年前的趋同的“黄金时代 ” 。
en: This will not be easy, and we may never return to the “golden age” of convergence that preceded 2007.

zh: 但新技术想来也不会阻止趋同，即便它们（有可能）会减缓趋同的速度。
en: But new technologies should not be expected to stop convergence, even if, as is likely, they slow it down.

zh: 新兴经济体的人口挑战
en: Emerging Economies’ Demographic Challenge

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 人口老化常常被认为是发达国家所面对的一项重大经济挑战。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Population aging is often cited as a major economic challenge for the developed world.

zh: 而由麦肯锡国际研究中心所发布的一项最新报告则显示，不断转化的人口构成已经对许多新兴经济体的增长前景构成了更为重大的威胁。
en: But a new report from the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI) shows that shifting demographics pose an even greater threat to the growth prospects of many emerging economies.

zh: 在过去50年间，全球1.6%的年均人口增长率为许多新兴经济体带来了一大波劳动力大军以及迅速的GDP增长。
en: Over the last 50 years, the world's 1.6% annual population growth fueled a surging labor force and a rapid increase in GDP in many emerging economies.

zh: 中国和南非的就业数量翻了一番以上，而在巴西、印度、印尼，墨西哥和尼日利亚则增加了至少三倍。
en: Employment more than doubled in China and South Africa, and at least tripled in Brazil, India, Indonesia, Mexico, and Nigeria.

zh: 沙特的就业职位则增长了几乎九倍。
en: In Saudi Arabia, employment increased almost nine-fold.

zh: 但随着人口增长逐渐放缓，新兴经济体的年均就业增长率预计也将由1.9%下跌到0.4 % 。
en: But, with population growth slowing, average annual employment growth in emerging economies is expected to drop from 1.9% to 0.4%.

zh: 以绝对值计算，这一下跌幅度将远超发达国家，而后者在未来几年的下跌幅度为从0.9%跌至0.1 % 。
en: In absolute terms, the decline will exceed that of developed economies, where annual employment growth is expected to fall from 0.9% to 0.1% the coming years.

zh: 在大多数经济体中，就业职位预计在未来50年内到达顶峰；而在中国，劳动人口数量将在这一时期内减少20 % 。
en: In most economies, employment is expected to reach its peak within the next half-century; in China, the labor force could shrink by 20% over this period.

zh: 当然，有些国家也独立于这一趋势之外。
en: Of course, there are exceptions to this trend.

zh: 印尼和南非两国预计将持续出现就业增加的局面（尽管增长率有所降低 ） 。
en: Indonesia and South Africa are projected to continue to experience rising employment (albeit at slower rates).

zh: 尼日利亚的劳动人口有望在2014到2064年间达到目前的三倍，而其他许多撒哈拉以南非洲的经济体也将出现类似规模的增长。
en: Nigeria's labor force is expected to triple from 2014 to 2064, and many other economies in Sub-Saharan Africa will experience similar levels of growth.

zh: 但总体来说，各经济体的人口顺景将出现逆转，并带来影响GDP增长的严重后果。
en: But, overall, economies' demographic tailwinds will wane, with serious consequences for GDP growth.

zh: 如果这一趋势不发生改变的话，到2064年新兴经济体的GDP增长率将下降三分之一，从年均4.8%下跌到3.1 % 。
en: With no other change in current trends, emerging economies' rates of GDP growth would fall by one-third, from 4.8% to 3.1% annually, by 2064.

zh: 令问题更加恶化的是，适龄劳动人口比例的下跌也将导致某些国家的人均GDP产值下跌超过30 % — —其中最为显著的莫过于巴西，墨西哥和沙特。
en: More problematic, the declining share of the working-age population is set to cause per capita GDP to decline by more than 30% in some countries – most notably, Brazil, Mexico, and Saudi Arabia.

zh: 然而好消息是新兴经济体拥有一项强大的工具去抵消这些趋势：生产力提升。
en: The good news is that emerging economies have at their disposal a powerful means to offset these trends: productivity growth.

zh: 无可否认，新兴经济体的年均生产力增长需要提升57 % ， 也就是从2.8%上升到4.4 % ， 才能完全补偿由于人口构成变化所带来的负面效应。
en: To be sure, annual productivity growth in emerging economies would need to accelerate by 57%, from 2.8% to 4.4%, to compensate fully for the demographic shift.

zh: 但即便这一雄心勃勃的目标无法在所有各国都同时实现，新兴经济体依然拥有相当大的空间去实现生产力增长的赶超。
en: But, even if that ambitious goal is not achievable everywhere, emerging economies have considerable scope for catch-up productivity growth.

zh: 毕竟在过去50年中，新兴和发达经济体之间的生产力鸿沟并未得到有效弥合；按绝对值计算甚至翻了一番。
en: After all, over the last 50 years, the productivity gap between emerging and developed economies has barely narrowed; in absolute terms, it has more than doubled.

zh: 事实上，虽然新兴经济体的平均生产力增长自1970年代以来的每十年间都不断加速，但这在很大程度上仅仅是体现了一个国家的迅速生产力增长：中国 — — 该国自1964年以来实现了年均5.7%的增长率。
en: Indeed, though average productivity growth in emerging economies has accelerated in every decade since the 1970s, this largely reflects rapid productivity growth in just one country: China, where the annual average has been 5.7% since 1964.

zh: 而在其他地方，这一数字则显得差强人意。
en: Elsewhere, the record has been patchy.

zh: 在同一时期，墨西哥和沙特的年均生产力增长都不到1 % ； 阿根廷、巴西，俄罗斯和南非也只实现了年均1.2%到1.5%的增长。
en: Mexico and Saudi Arabia improved their productivity by less than 1% per year over this period; Argentina, Brazil, Russia, and South Africa managed productivity growth of 1.2-1.5%.

zh: 我们有理由相信这些经济体可以表现得更好。
en: There is reason to believe that these economies can do much better.

zh: 借助综合性的手段，11个新兴经济体（阿根廷、巴西、中国、印度、印尼、墨西哥、尼日利亚、俄罗斯、沙特，南非和土耳其）可以在2025年平均将各自的年均生产力增长率推高到6 % 。
en: With a comprehensive approach, 11 emerging economies (Argentina, Brazil, China, India, Indonesia, Mexico, Nigeria, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, and Turkey) could, on average, boost their annual productivity growth to as much as 6% by 2025.

zh: 而这一增长成果中的4/5可以通过借鉴已经在其他地方取得成功的手段来实现，再辅以科学技术，运营和商业模式上的革新。
en: Four-fifths of that growth would be achieved through the adoption of approaches that have already been successful elsewhere, with new technological, operational, and business innovations covering the rest.

zh: 赶超发达国家生产力水平的机遇在各个关键部门都极为充裕。
en: Opportunities to catch up to developed-country productivity levels abound across key sectors.

zh: 在零售领域，新兴经济体可以在很大程度上通过采用类似超级市场和超大型超市等现代商铺运营模式，在2025年令自身生产力翻一番，因为这两者的生产力是传统小商铺的至少三倍。
en: In retail, emerging economies could double their productivity by 2025, largely by adopting modern store formats, such as supermarkets and hypermarkets, which are at least three times more productive than traditional small shops.

zh: 在墨西哥，将现代零售商的市场份额提升10%将令该部门的整体生产力提升25 % 。
en: In Mexico, boosting the share of modern retailers by 10% would yield a 25% increase in the sector's total productivity.

zh: 同样，如果中国的庞大汽车产业可以被整合成为产能相当的几个更大型车厂，该部门原本远低于发达国家水平的生产力将有望提升50 % 。
en: Similarly, if China's huge automotive industry consolidated operations into a smaller number of larger plants operating close to capacity, the sector's productivity – which is well below the developed-country average – could rise by up to 50%.

zh: 许多国家也可以通过实施农业机械化等方式大幅提升食品价值链的效率。
en: And many countries can improve the efficiency of food value chains considerably, such as by mechanizing agriculture.

zh: 同时在提升生产力的创新方面也存在着极大的空间，尤其是在健康这一在大多数新兴国家都方兴未艾的产业上。
en: There is also enormous scope for productivity-enhancing innovation, particularly in health care, a sector that is just evolving in most emerging countries.

zh: 卫生病历信息的数码化令印度的布鲁格兰农村诊所（Bhorugram Rural Dispensary）得以在短短四年间将免疫接种的数量翻了近一番。
en: Digitization of health records enabled India's Bhorugram Rural Dispensary nearly to double the number of immunizations it provided in just four years.

zh: 同样，此举也令肯尼亚西部的莫索里奥农村卫生中心的行政人员互相之间减少了2/3的行政事务沟通时间，并将接诊病人数量提高了一倍。
en: Likewise, it allowed clerks at western Kenya's Mosoriot Rural Health Center to spend two-thirds less time interacting with other staff on administrative tasks, and almost twice as much time registering patients.

zh: 在运营创新方面的一个例子就是印度的阿拉凡眼科卫生系统（Aravind Eye Care System ） ， 通过将工业工程运作法则引入到自身工作流程中，该企业已经成长为了全球最大的眼科健康服务提供商，甚至可以仅用1/6的成本承担整个英国国民健康服务体系（National Health Service）2/3的手术 — — 而且感染率更低。
en: In terms of operational innovations, there is the example of India's Aravind Eye Care System, which, by applying principles of industrial engineering to its work flow, has become the world's largest eye-care provider. Aravind can carry out two-thirds the number of operations conducted by the United Kingdom's entire National Health Service at one-sixth the cost – and with a lower infection rate.

zh: 政府可以在推动这类创新方面扮演一个重要角色。
en: Governments can play an important role in promoting such innovation.

zh: 巴西的农业放松管治措施以及对研究的鼓励使巴西农业研究公司得以开发超过9000项技术项目，包括培育一种可以在巴西气候下茁壮成长的热带大豆品种。
en: Brazil's deregulation of agriculture and encouragement of R&D enabled the Brazilian Agriculture Research Corporation to pioneer more than 9,000 technology projects, including the design of a tropical soybean strain that can thrive in Brazil's climate.

zh: 随着效率提升，巴西的农作物产量得以与众发达国家并驾齐驱。
en: Efficiency soared, placing Brazil's crop yields on par with those of developed economies.

zh: 那个简单通过大量年轻劳动者来推动的“简单”GDP增长时代已经走向终结。
en: The era of “easy" GDP growth driven by a massive army of young workers is ending.

zh: 而新兴经济体必须借助推动对政策，法案和现有做法的颠覆性改革来直面因此而产生的增长挑战。
en: Emerging economies must face the resulting growth challenge head-on, by pursuing sweeping changes in policies, incentives, and established practices to boost productivity.

zh: 认识到这一点的紧迫性只是开端，而如今是时候挽起衣袖，迎难而上了。
en: Recognizing this imperative is the first step. Now the hard work must begin.

zh: 不断增加的新兴经济体脆弱度
en: Emerging Vulnerabilities in Emerging Economies

zh: 发自米兰 — — 就在美国雷曼兄弟投资银行破产触发一场席卷全球经济的金融危机之前，世界银行增长与发展委员会发布了一份对新兴经济体增长战略的评估报告，希望能从以往的研究和经验中总结教训。
en: MILAN – Just before the collapse of the US investment bank Lehman Brothers triggered a financial crisis that would engulf the world economy, the Commission on Growth and Development published an assessment of emerging-economy growth strategies, aimed at drawing lessons from previous research and experience.

zh: 一晃十年，许多 — — 甚至算不上大多数 — — 这些教训依然未曾受到重视。
en: Over a decade later, many – if not most – of those lessons remain unheeded.

zh: 在新兴经济体中，持续的中速或高速GDP增长是推动发展和提高收入的关键。
en: In emerging economies, sustained medium or high GDP growth is the key to advancing development and raising incomes.

zh: 当然，危机无可避免地会产生一些需要较长恢复期的重大挫折，大大减少了收入和财富的增长。
en: Of course, crises inevitably produce major setbacks with long recovery periods, drastically reducing growth in income and wealth.

zh: 但十年显然是太过漫长了，而经验表明新兴经济体应该做的与它们一直在做的事情之间的差距仍然巨大。
en: But ten years is a long time, and the gap between what experience dictates emerging economies should do and what they have been doing remains large.

zh: 其中一些国家实现了持续的中高速增长，但它们依赖于高水平的公共和私人投资，而且主要由国内储蓄来进行融资。
en: While some countries have achieved sustained medium or high growth, they have relied on high levels of public and private investment, financed mainly by domestic savings.

zh: 相比之下，持续存在大额经常账户赤字会导致经济变得脆弱，甚至往往会随着外部金融条件的变化而导致崩溃。
en: By contrast, running persistently large current-account deficits creates vulnerabilities and often leads to disruptions, as external financial conditions change.

zh: 借入外国硬通货币尤其危险，因为一旦本地货币贬值就可能引发负债激增。
en: Borrowing in foreign hard currencies is particularly risky, as depreciation of the local currency can cause liabilities to surge.

zh: 因此尽管对借债的需要程度取决于增长，因为GDP的强劲和弹性增长会降低杠杆率，但新兴经济体依然得努力限制债务水平。
en: Emerging economies thus should be working to constrain debt levels, though the extent to which this is needed depends on growth, as strong and resilient increases in GDP reduce leverage ratios.

zh: 同时货币的价值也有关系。
en: The value of the currency is also relevant.

zh: 通过积累外汇储备实现的持续汇率低估压抑了进行结构改革和实现生产率增长的动力。
en: Persistent undervaluation, achieved through the accumulation of foreign-exchange reserves, reduces the incentive to pursue structural reform and achieve productivity growth.

zh: 这是人们所熟知的中等收入陷阱的其中一个要素。
en: This is one element of the well-known middle-income trap.

zh: 此外，外汇储备资产的回报通常很低，因为经济一旦实现增长当地货币将会升值（即使其仍然被低估 ） — —这种模式可以持续很长一段时间。
en: Moreover, the return on foreign-reserve assets is usually quite low, because the local currency will appreciate (even if it remains undervalued) if the economy is growing – a pattern that can be sustained for an extended period.

zh: 而与高估值货币相关的风险则更为严重。
en: The risks associated with an overvalued currency are more severe.

zh: 首先贸易部门的增长和就业会受到负面影响，主要是由于贸易条件与经济的生产力水平不匹配。
en: For starters, growth and employment in the tradable sector is adversely affected, essentially because the terms of trade are mismatched with the economy’s productivity levels.

zh: 此外，货币高估通常会伴随着经常账户赤字和过度依赖外国资本来为投资提供资金。
en: Furthermore, an overvalued currency will usually be accompanied by a current-account deficit and excessive reliance on foreign capital to finance investment.

zh: 如果外部财务状况良好，这种模式可以持续一段时间。
en: If external financial conditions are favorable, this pattern can be sustained for some time.

zh: 但正如最近的经验所表明的那样，这种情况的变化可能迫使各国放开货币贬值，或者调用本国央行的外汇储备去大笔买入本国货币来推迟货币贬值。
en: But, as recent experience has shown, a change in such conditions can force countries either to allow currency depreciation or to delay it by purchasing large amounts of local currency using the central bank’s foreign-currency reserves.

zh: 无论如何，市场最终都会迫使货币大幅贬值。
en: In any case, markets eventually force an often-sharp depreciation of the currency.

zh: 于是信贷收紧，资产负债表恶化（特别是如果公司或银行都是借入外币的情况下 ） ， 投资萎缩，增长再次受到打击。
en: As a result, credit is tightened, balance sheets deteriorate (especially if companies or banks have borrowed in a foreign currency), investment contracts, and growth takes another hit.

zh: 这些不平衡都是在资本账户管理不干涉理论的基础上发展起来的，因为它们假设资本市场激励始终会与增长战略保持一致。
en: These imbalances develop as a result of a hands-off approach to capital-account management, based on the assumption that capital-market incentives and growth strategies are always aligned.

zh: 事实上很难找到一个通过这种方法实现持续增长的国家的例子。
en: In fact, it is hard to find any example of a country that has achieved sustained growth with such an approach.

zh: 诚然资本市场不是敌人，但外部投资者和国内政策制定者之间的利益无论如何也算不上一致。
en: To be sure, capital markets are not the enemy. But the alignment of interests between external investors and domestic policymakers is imperfect, at best.

zh: 成熟的投资者通常认为经济增长不是投资回报的决定因素。
en: Sophisticated investors routinely maintain that economic growth is not determinative of investment returns.

zh: 这个看法是可取的。
en: It is valid point.

zh: 投资回报取决于金融资产的估值以及其他因素。
en: Returns on an investment depend on the valuation of financial assets, among other factors.

zh: 只有在简化的理论模型中这些估值才能完全取决于预期基础现金流量下的增长。
en: Only in a simplified theoretical model would these valuations be determined solely by growth in the expected underlying cash flows.

zh: 有人可能会争辩说，虽然估值以及潜在的增长动力在中短期可能会出现分歧，但它们最终是趋同的。
en: One might argue that while valuations and the underlying growth dynamics can diverge in the short and medium run, they eventually converge.

zh: 无论这个说法是否属实 — — 很可能也是对的 — — 大多数金融投资者其实并不关心长期回报，他们的投资代理通常也不会因其长期业绩而获得奖励。
en: Whether or not that is true – and it may well be – most financial investors don’t care about the long run, and their agents usually do not get rewarded for long-run performance.

zh: 金融投资者都知道丰厚的回报可能会持续一段时间，但这种失衡以及风险可能随时会迫使你狼狈退出。
en: Financial investors understand that adequate returns may persist for a while, but that imbalances and risks may necessitate a hasty exit at any moment.

zh: 正如新兴市场经济学家罗伯特·苏巴拉曼（Robert Subbaraman）在最近的一份报告中所指出的那样 ： “ 尽情享受派对，但得留在靠近门口的地方。 ”
en: As the emerging-market economist Robert Subbaraman puts it in the title of a recent report: “Enjoy the Party, but Stay Close to the Door.”

zh: 虽然这对投资者来说是理性的，但它并不符合政策制定者在持续增长方面的利益。
en: While this is rational for investors, it does not support policymakers’ interest in sustained growth.

zh: 这就是为什么成功的资本账户管理必须注重促进稳定，控制风险，并使资本市场流动与经济增长和就业目标保持一致。
en: That is why successful capital-account management must focus on promoting stability, controlling risks, and aligning capital-market flows with economic-growth and employment objectives.

zh: 在后危机时期，发达经济体的超低利率刺激资本流入以当地货币计价的高收益新兴市场资产。
en: In the post crisis period, ultra-low interest rates in developed economies spurred capital flows into higher-yielding emerging-market assets denominated in the local currency.

zh: 与此同时，许多新兴市场企业以美元或欧元借款，却在某些情况下较为缺乏这些货币形式的收入以配合相应货币的还本付息。
en: At the same time, many emerging-market corporations borrowed in US dollars or euros, in some cases with little or no dollar revenues to match the dollar-denominated debt service.

zh: 经验证明这一手段相当冒险。
en: As experience shows, this is a risky approach.

zh: 只要利率仍然很低，它们（以及总体资产价格）所隐含的风险溢价仍然低于对系统中包含的实时演变风险的合理评估额。
en: As long as interest rates remain very low, the risk premia they (and asset prices generally) imply remain below reasonable assessments of the actual evolving risks embedded in the system.

zh: 对于着重短期的投资者而言，这是一个值得享受的派对 — — 只要能留在出口附近就行。
en: For investors looking at the short term, that is a party worth enjoying – from a position near the exit.

zh: 对于许多新兴经济体而言，必须重新平衡增长模式，更加注重风险抵御能力，更积极地管理债务和资本流动及其对资产价格、汇率和增长的影响。
en: For many emerging economies, it is imperative to pursue a rebalancing of growth patterns, with a greater focus on resilience, and a more active approach to managing debt and capital flows and their effects on asset prices, exchange rates, and growth.

zh: 否则的话不可持续增长模式的危险将使这一派对戛然而止并可能引发金融危机蔓延。
en: Otherwise, the dangers of unsustainable growth patterns will bring the party to an abrupt halt, potentially triggering financial contagion.

zh: 随着不断升级的贸易紧张局势加剧了不确定性，警觉的投资者都已经开始向大门的方向挪动了。
en: Already, as escalating trade tensions generate added uncertainty, nervous investors are edging toward the door.

zh: 重燃新兴经济体的增长之火
en: Reigniting Emerging-Economy Growth

zh: 发自香港 — — 毫无疑问，各新兴经济体都正面临着严峻的挑战，并在阻碍了它们过往那种爆发式增长的同时削弱了其发展前景。
en: HONG KONG – It is no secret that emerging economies are facing serious challenges, which have undermined their once-explosive growth and weakened their development prospects.

zh: 而它们是否能回归到不断缩小与发达经济体之间差距的路径则在很大程度上取决于它们将如何应对日益复杂的经济环境。
en: Whether they return to the path of convergence with the advanced economies will largely depend on how they approach an increasingly complex economic environment.

zh: 当然，这些经济体的发展之路从来就不是一帆风顺的。
en: Of course, these economies’ development path was never simple or smooth.

zh: 但在二战后的大多数时期一直到最近十年以前，形势还是比较明朗的。
en: But for most of the post-World War II period, until as recently as ten years ago, it was relatively clear-cut.

zh: 各国都以合理的步伐逐步开放其经济；借助全球的技术和需求；专注于贸易部门；追求大量的投资（占GDP的30％左右 ） ； 促进外国直接投资，并适当地吸收了转移过来的知识。
en: Countries needed to open their economies at a sensible pace; leverage global technology and demand; specialize in tradable sectors; pursue a lot of investment (some 30% of GDP); and promote foreign direct investment, with appropriate provisions for knowledge transfer.

zh: 在这一过程中，新兴经济体认识到了允许市场机制按照自身规律运作、保证财产权利，维护宏观经济和金融稳定等事务的重要性。
en: Throughout this process, the emerging economies recognized the importance of allowing market mechanisms to work, guaranteeing property rights, and safeguarding macroeconomic and financial stability.

zh: 也许最重要的是，它们知道必须把重点放在创造就业机会 — — 尤其是在城市地区以及现代化部门，以及更广泛的包容性发展方面。
en: Perhaps most important, they knew that they had to focus on generating employment, particularly in urban areas and modernizing sectors, and on inclusiveness more broadly.

zh: 在奉行这一议程的过程中，​​新兴经济体经历了艰难的开端和无数危机，还往往伴随着过度负债，货币陷阱和高通胀率。
en: As they pursued this agenda, emerging economies experienced stuttering starts and numerous crises, often associated with excessive debt, currency traps, and high inflation.

zh: 而达到中等收入水平的国家则遭遇到向高收入状态过渡过程中的政策和结构性缺陷。
en: And, upon reaching middle-income levels, countries confronted the policy and structural pitfalls that accompany the transition to high-income status.

zh: 即便如此，在以发达经济体的强劲增长（及强劲需求）为特征的日益开放的全球环境中，新兴经济体奋力实现了巨大且迅速的进步。
en: Nonetheless, in an increasingly open global environment, characterized by strong growth (and demand) in the advanced economies, the emerging economies managed to make huge and rapid progress.

zh: 但在2008年全球金融危机之后一切都改变了。
en: That all changed after the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 可以肯定的是发展议程的核心仍旧相同。
en: To be sure, the core of the development agenda remains the same.

zh: 但却变得更为复杂了。
en: But it is vastly more complicated.

zh: 其中一组复杂因素源于外部的全球经济失衡，扭曲以及不断加剧的资本流动，汇率和相对价格波动。
en: One set of complications arises from external global imbalances, distortions, and heightened volatility in capital flows, exchange rates, and relative prices.

zh: 由于这基本上是种全新的挑战，因此各国手中也没有成熟的方案去应对。
en: Given that such challenges are essentially new, there is no proven roadmap for overcoming them.

zh: 毕竟发达经济体以前并未实施过近年这种非常规货币政策 — — 这个时期是以超低利率和超迅速的跨境资本流动为特点的。
en: After all, the developed economies have not previously engaged in the kind of unconventional monetary policy seen in recent years – a period characterized by ultra-low interest rates and ultra-fast cross-border capital flows.

zh: 对于新兴经济体来说，由于其金融市场相对缺乏流动性，这种趋势促进了对低成本外部资本的过度依赖，而且这些资本可以瞬间撤走。
en: For the emerging economies, with their relatively illiquid financial markets, such trends encourage over-dependence on low-cost external capital, which can be withdrawn in a heartbeat.

zh: 超低的借贷成本也刺激了对杠杆的过度依赖，弱化了提振潜在增长所需的改革意愿 — — 从而进​​一步加剧了经济遭遇利率或投资者情绪转变时的脆弱性。
en: Rock-bottom borrowing costs also spur excessive reliance on leverage, weakening the will to undertake reforms needed to boost potential growth – and further exacerbating the economy’s vulnerability to a shift in interest rates or investor sentiment.

zh: 令那些资源型新兴经济体情况更糟的则是2014年以来大宗商品价格的暴跌。
en: Making matters worse for the resource-rich emerging economies, commodity prices have plummeted since 2014.

zh: 在经历了相当长时期的加速需求增长（特别是来自中国）之后，各国政府纷纷觉得商品价格会近乎永久性地维持高位 — — 这导致它们高估了自身的未来收入。
en: After a prolonged period of accelerating demand growth, notably from China, governments came to regard high commodity prices as semi-permanent – an assumption that caused them to overestimate their future revenues.

zh: 如今价格走低，这些国家都面临着巨大的经济失衡和财政压力。
en: Now that prices have dropped, these countries are facing huge imbalances and fiscal strain.

zh: 而且不仅仅是政府；私营部门也一样依据乐观的假设而贸然动用了高杠杆。
en: And governments are not alone; the private sector, too, relied on rosy assumptions to justify imprudently high levels of leverage.

zh: 发达经济体的增长放缓也削弱了贸易流动，进一步增大了经济发展的阻力。
en: Slower growth in the advanced economies has also weakened trade flows, adding to the headwinds.

zh: 正如穆罕默德·埃尔-埃利安观察到的那样，在全球经济中，你的邻国 — — 那些与你有经济或金融联系的经济体 — — 是相当重要的。
en: As Mohamed El-Erian has observed, in the global economy, your neighborhood – the economies to which you have economic or financial links – matters.

zh: 这对于��度依赖于自身邻国的新兴经济体来说更是如此。
en: That is all the more true for the emerging economies, which have become highly dependent on their neighbors.

zh: 总而言之，新兴经济体遭遇的是由外部产生的宏观经济转变，非常规货币政策，大范围的市场波动以及发达市场缓慢增长所带来的挑战。
en: In short, emerging economies have been challenged by externally generated macroeconomic shifts, unconventional monetary policies, widespread volatility, and slow growth in developed markets.

zh: 在缺乏明确指引的情况下，也难怪各国在应对这些挑战的能力方面存在极大差别。
en: Without much of a playbook to guide them, it is unsurprising that their ability to cope with these challenges has varied considerably.

zh: 总体来说，那些表现较好的新兴经济体（比如印度）已经将健康的增长基本面和改革与务实积极的措施结合起来对抗外部波动。
en: Generally, those that have fared better, such as India, have combined sound growth fundamentals and reforms with pragmatic and activist measures to counter the external sources of volatility.

zh: 当然印度同时也从油价下跌中受益。
en: India has also, of course, benefited from lower oil prices.

zh: 而巴西这类商品出口国则会经历更多挣扎，这可不仅仅是因为自然资源价格下跌。
en: Commodity exporters like Brazil have struggled more, but not just because of falling natural-resource prices.

zh: 事实上，价格的下降以及资本流向逆转同时作用，暴露了以前被有利条件所掩盖了的增长模式缺陷。
en: In fact, the decline in prices, together with the reversal of capital flows, exposed weaknesses in the underlying growth patterns that had previously been masked by favorable conditions.

zh: 如此还有另一种在今年不断加剧的挑战。
en: Now there is yet another challenge, which is becoming larger by the year.

zh: 新兴经济体应对这些挑战的路径选择还必须考虑到由数字资本密集型技术所驱动的根本性转变。
en: Whichever path emerging economies choose for addressing these challenges must also account for the fundamental shift driven by digital capital-intensive technologies.

zh: 虽然数字技术在高科技领域和分享经济交中创造了新的工作类型，却也减少和消灭了许多“常规的”白领和蓝领工作。
en: While digital technologies have created new kinds of jobs in high-tech sectors and the sharing economy, among others, they have been reducing and dis-intermediating “routine” white- and blue-collar jobs.

zh: 在这里，机器人技术的快速发展尤其重要，因为越来越精密的机器对各部门的廉价劳动力构成了威胁。
en: Here, rapid advances in robotics are particularly relevant, as increasingly sophisticated machines threaten to supplant low-cost labor in a variety of sectors.

zh: 这些技术的高固定/低可变成本意味着一旦机器人变得比人类劳动更具成本效益，这种趋势就不会扭转，尤其是自动化组装线可以被布局在更靠近市场的地方，而非被迫选择劳动最便宜的地方。
en: The high fixed and low variable costs of these technologies mean that once robots become more cost-effective than human labor, the trend will not reverse, especially given that automated assembly can be located close to markets, rather than where labor is cheapest.

zh: 在全球贸易中扮演重大角色并有助于推动许多新兴经济体经济 — — 特别是中国 — — 增长的电子产品装配业职位尤其脆弱。
en: Jobs in electronics assembly, which plays a huge role in global trade and has helped to drive growth in many emerging economies – notably, China – are particularly vulnerable.

zh: 虽然制衣行业 — — 纺织品，服装，鞋 — — 还未被自动化，但最终可能也只是一个时间问题。
en: While trades involving sewing – textiles, apparel, shoes – are not yet being automated much, it is probably only a matter of time before they are.

zh: 由于早期比较优势的经典来源出现萎缩，各国 — — 尤其处于较初级阶段的发展中国家 — — 将需要实施以服务业（包括交易类服务）为重点的政策；它们还需要调整自身对人力资本的投资。
en: As the classic sources of early comparative advantage dwindle, countries – particularly earlier-stage developing countries – will need to implement policies that feature services (including tradable services) more prominently; they will also need to adjust their investment in human capital.

zh: 但这是否相当于直接跳过最底层的发展阶段还有待观察。
en: Whether this amounts to removing the bottom rungs on the ladder of development remains to be seen.

zh: 印度相对非常规的增长模式，及其较早关注服务业的发展步骤，可以成为重要的经验。
en: The relatively unconventional growth pattern in India, with its early emphasis on services, may hold important lessons.

zh: 无论如何，发展中国家 — — 特别是新兴经济体 — — 显然都有很多需要考虑的地方。
en: In any case, the developing countries – and especially the emerging economies – clearly have a lot on their plates.

zh: 随着这些经济体不断在自身的核心增长议程中添加项目 — — 保护自身免遭波动性影响，应对不利的外部环境，并适应强大的技术趋势 — — 它们不可避免地会犯错误，甚至遭受重大挫折。
en: As these economies add items – protecting themselves from volatility, countering unfavorable external conditions, and adapting to powerful technological trends – to their core structural growth agendas, they will invariably make mistakes, and even stumble.

zh: 这将使各国的经济表现出现差异并降低追赶发达国家的平均速度。
en: This will produce high variance in performance across countries and probably reduce the average pace of convergence.

zh: 但在我看来，这一切都不会阻止它们追赶的步伐。
en: But it will not, in my estimation, derail convergence completely.

zh: 淹没市场的威胁
en: The Submerging-Market Threat

zh: 华盛顿—是时候正确地审视新兴经济体的崛起了。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – It is time to put the rise of the emerging economies in perspective.

zh: 自世纪之交以来，发展中世界大部分国家经济高速增长，其背后是大宗商品繁荣和信用扩张过度。
en: The rapid economic growth in much of the developing world since the beginning of the century was fueled by a commodity boom and an overextension of credit.

zh: 但是，由于新兴市场繁荣没有伴随充分的结构改革，因此是不可持续的。
en: But, because the emerging-market boom was not accompanied by sufficient structural reforms, it was not sustainable.

zh: 如今，大部分主要新兴经济体都经历了财富的严重逆转。
en: Today, most of the major emerging economies have experienced a severe reversal of fortune.

zh: 俄罗斯和巴西陷入严重危机，通胀达到两位数，同时去年GDP萎缩4 % 。
en: Russia and Brazil have plunged into severe crises, with double-digit inflation accompanying a 4% contraction in GDP last year.

zh: 南非几乎没有增长。
en: South Africa is barely growing.

zh: 中国的现象级扩张速度已经放缓至7%以下。
en: China’s phenomenal rate of expansion has slowed to below 7%.

zh: 毫不奇怪，高盛已经关闭了亏损的投资于巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国的金砖四国基金。
en: Unsurprisingly, Goldman Sachs has closed its money-losing BRIC fund for investment in Brazil, Russia, India, and China.

zh: 事实上，未来金砖国家（也包括南非 ） — —以及其他新兴市场 — — 前景堪忧。
en: Indeed, the future of the BRICS (including South Africa) – and that of other emerging markets – looks gloomy.

zh: 在亚洲之外，大部分发展中经济体大多为大宗商品出口国，因此极易受到价格冲击影响。
en: Outside of Asia, most developing economies are principally commodity exporters, and thus are highly exposed to price shocks.

zh: 暴跌的油价导致俄罗斯卢布兑美元贬值超过一半，未来有可能继续贬值 — — 特别是如果美联储继续提高利率的话。
en: Plunging oil prices have cut the value of the Russian ruble by more than half against the US dollar, and further declines appear likely – especially if the US Federal Reserve continues to hike interest rates.

zh: 大宗商品价格可能会维持低位一二十年，20世纪80和90年代便是如此。
en: Commodity prices are likely to stay low for one or two decades, as they did in the 1980s and 1990s.

zh: 比如，对石油来说，页岩气、致密油、液化天然气和竞争力日益增强的太阳能和风能正在刺激能源供给，即使十年来的高价刺激了储备，降低了需求。
en: When it comes to oil, for example, shale gas, tight oil, liquefied natural gas, and increasingly competitive solar and wind energy are boosting energy supply, even as a decade of high prices has spurred conservation and reduced demand.

zh: 大宗商品动荡可能给新兴市场的人民带来痛苦，他们常常用美元来计算收入。
en: The commodity crunch is likely to prove painful to people in emerging markets, who often measure their income in US dollars.

zh: 随着汇率下跌，他们将很快觉得自己变穷了。
en: As exchange rates fall, they will quickly feel much poorer.

zh: 政府也会遭遇损失，它们的外债 — — 因几乎没有刺激增长的财政和货币扩张而大幅增加 — — 负担越来越重，而降低汇率对贸易的刺激作用将十分有限，因为除了大宗商品部门之外它们没有新的能力。
en: Governments will suffer, too, as their foreign debt – boosted by fiscal and monetary expansion that yielded little growth – becomes much more burdensome, while the export stimulus from lower exchange rates will be small, owing to the absence of new capacity outside the commodity sectors.

zh: 随着各国日渐遭受偿付压力，可能出现多场新兴市场债务危机。
en: As countries come under pressure to make payments, multiple emerging-market debt crises are likely.

zh: 在短期，巴西的情况最令人担忧，其外债和预算赤字规模巨大。
en: In the short term, Brazil arouses the most worry, given its large public debt and its vast budget deficit.

zh: 但是，在中期，中国的情况更加可怕。
en: In the medium term, however, China appears even more frightening.

zh: 经验证据表明，新兴经济体的私人和公共部门债务总和不应超过GDP的100 % 。
en: As a rule of thumb, an emerging economy’s total private- and public-sector debt should not exceed 100% of GDP.

zh: 而中国的债务总量已经超过GDP的250 % 。
en: China’s total debt is now more than 250% of GDP.

zh: 金砖国家的关键短处是拙劣的治理。
en: The BRICS countries’ critical shortcoming is poor governance.

zh: 在透明国际的腐败印象指数上，南非名列第61名，巴西和印度第76名，中国第83名，俄罗斯第119名。
en: On its corruption perception index of 175 countries, Transparency International ranks South Africa 61st, Brazil and India 76th, China 83rd, and Russia 119th.

zh: 治理不善限制了一国建设创造持久财富和生产力的能力 — — 即使这些短处要到繁荣破灭时才会显现和形成伤害。
en: Poor governance limits a country’s ability to create lasting wealth and productive capacity – even if the shortcomings become evident and damaging only when booms turn to busts.

zh: 沃伦·巴菲特说 ： “ 只有在退潮后才能发现谁在裸泳。 ”
en: As Warren Buffet has put it, “You only find out who is swimming naked when the tide goes out.”

zh: 要有效地打击腐败，人们需要罢免腐败的领导人，而这正是民主的重要之处。
en: To combat corruption effectively, people need to oust corrupt leaders, which is why democracy is vital.

zh: 乌克兰和阿根廷的政权更迭，以及反对派最近在委内瑞拉议会选举中所取得的胜利，预示着未来走势。
en: The regime changes in Ukraine and Argentina, and the opposition’s victory in Venezuela’s recent parliamentary election, are harbingers of what is to come.

zh: 下一个可能是巴西。
en: Brazil may be next.

zh: 新兴市场可能再次崛起，如果实施治理改善和结构改革提振潜在增长的话。
en: The emerging markets may rise again, if and when improved governance and structural reforms are implemented to boost potential growth.

zh: 但这需���时间。
en: But that will take time.

zh: 全球低增长局面持续二十年不足为奇。
en: We should not be surprised to see two decades of slow global growth.

zh: 西方决不能自满。
en: The West cannot afford to be complacent.

zh: 欧洲过于关注需求管理，应该试图降低国家的财政和监管负担，以使经济能够再次启动增长。
en: After having focused too much on demand management, Europe should be trying to reduce the fiscal and regulatory burden of the state, so that its economies can start growing again.

zh: 欧洲还应该开放缺陷重重的劳动力、服务、资本和数字产品市场。
en: It should also open up stunted markets for labor, services, capital, and digital products.

zh: 西方需要齐心协力在仍有能力的时候制定全球标准。
en: The West needs to work together to set global standards while it still can.

zh: 民主、法治和市场经济都值得为之奋斗。
en: Democracy, the rule of law, and market-based economies are all worth fighting for.

zh: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰和北非和中东战事说明了为何北约应该得到加强，也说明了为何欧洲必须认真对待自卫问题 — — 而不是继续依赖美国。
en: Russia’s aggression in Ukraine and the wars in North Africa and the Middle East have demonstrated why NATO should be strengthened, and that Europe must become serious about defending itself – rather than simply continuing to depend on the United States.

zh: 在协调西方对俄制裁过程中，G7重新焕发的重要性。
en: In coordinating Western sanctions against Russia, the G7 has already achieved renewed significance.

zh: 接下来应该合力治理即将到来的停滞。
en: This should be followed by efforts to manage the coming stagnation.

zh: 跨太平洋合作伙伴关系和跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系都是这方面的重要举措。
en: The Trans-Pacific Partnership and the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership are both important initiatives in this regard.

zh: 随着国际组织难以保持重要性，西方领导的组织和机构安排将变得尤其重要。
en: Western-led organizations and institutional arrangements will become especially important as international organizations struggle to remain relevant.

zh: 特别是，联合国可能因为俄罗斯和中国在安理会行使否决权而大受掣肘。
en: The United Nations, in particular, will likely be crippled by Russian and Chinese vetoes in the Security Council.

zh: 只有国际货币基金组织（IMF）有望提升地位，因为主要新兴经济体 — — 最有可能的是委内瑞拉、阿根廷和巴西 — — 终将向其求助。
en: Only the International Monetary Fund can be expected to rise in prominence, as major emerging economies – most likely Venezuela, Argentina, and Brazil – end up as its wards.

zh: 除了经济问题，中国和俄罗斯可能陈伟最大的挑战。
en: Economics aside, China and Russia are likely to pose the biggest challenge.

zh: 这两个新兴大国仍由极权政府领导，主宰它们的执政精英之腐败 — — 从他们所聚敛的财富看 — — 堪称历史之最。
en: These two large emerging countries are still led by authoritarian governments, headed by ruling elites who – given how much wealth they have amassed – may be the most corrupt in history.

zh: 随着他们承受压力，转型不可能和平。
en: As they come under pressure, their transformations are unlikely to be peaceful.

zh: 克里姆林宫已经通过其在乌克兰和叙利亚的战争表明，它准备用对外侵略对抗国内问题。
en: The Kremlin has already shown, with its wars in Ukraine and Syria, that it is ready to counter domestic malaise with external aggression.

zh: 除非我们做些什么阻止这一点，否则情况不可能改变。
en: That is unlikely to change unless something is done to stop it.

zh: 新兴经济体的坠落可能带来比它们的崛起大得多的影响。
en: The fall of the emerging economies could have a far more lasting impact than their rise.

zh: 让新兴经济体发挥最大潜力
en: Making the Most of Emerging Economies

zh: 发自巴黎 — — 全球各新兴经济体又一次站在了一系列不确定性面前。
en: PARIS – Once again, the world’s emerging economies are facing a bout of uncertainty.

zh: 其中阿根廷，南非和土耳其受到了较多关注，因为在其值得商榷的货币政策以及本币兑美元贬值的共同作用下这些国家的债务偿付能力可能被削弱。
en: Argentina, South Africa, and Turkey are among those generating the most concern, owing to a combination of questionable monetary policies and currency depreciation vis-à-vis the US dollar that threatens to undermine these countries’ ability to service their debts.

zh: 但要指出的是，并非所有新兴经济体都是生而平等的。
en: But not all emerging economies are created equal.

zh: 上述状况无疑跟过去一样存在着明确的传导风险。
en: To be sure, as in the past, there is a distinct risk of contagion.

zh: 那些最为脆弱的新兴经济体都必须应对各自的挑战以避免沦为受害者。
en: The emerging economies that are most vulnerable each must address its own challenges to avoid falling victim.

zh: 而各国应对所面临挑战的手段也将对自身产生连锁反应。
en: And the approaches countries take to the challenges they face will have knock-on effects of their own.

zh: 有鉴于此，投资者可能会倾向于对整个新兴世界实施大范围的避险手段，尤其是在全球贸易紧张局势升级的背景下。
en: Given this, investors may find it tempting to pursue a broad risk-off approach to the entire emerging world, especially in the context of rising global trade tensions.

zh: 但因此而忽视一些新兴经济体所具备的高度有利条件也是不可取的。
en: But it would be a mistake to ignore the very favorable conditions that exist in some emerging economies.

zh: 例如许多国家在债务水平管理，生产力提升，基础设施改善以及实施所需改革方面都已经取得了重大进展。
en: For example, many have made significant progress in managing their debt levels, raising productivity, improving infrastructure, and implementing needed reforms.

zh: 上述这些都有助于强化这些经济体对外部冲击的抵御能力。
en: All of this has contributed to strengthening these economies’ resilience to external shocks.

zh: 事实上，尽管就各国究竟在多大程度上吸取了过往教训方面还一直存在着不确定性，更别提各国之间的不一致性，但许多新兴经济体已经在较长时期内构筑了更加健全的基本面。
en: Indeed, despite enduring uncertainties over the degree to which they have absorbed the lessons of the past, not to mention inconsistencies across countries, many emerging economies have developed much sounder fundamentals over an extended period.

zh: 感知/实际风险之间的差异以及把所有新兴经济体一耙子打倒的倾向都是一个长期存在的问题。
en: The disparity between perceived and actual risk and the tendency to paint all emerging economies with the same brush is a longstanding problem.

zh: 而投资者应避免因少数国家的高调问题而大规模撤出新兴经济体。
en: But investors should eschew a wholesale retreat from emerging economies in response to high-profile problems in a few.

zh: 相反他们应采取更为细致的做法，一方面着通过投资选定的地区和市场来改善自身风险回报，一方面与合适的机构开展合作。
en: Instead, they should adopt a more nuanced approach, one focused on improving the risk-return profile by investing in selected regions and markets, while working with the right institutions.

zh: 特别要指出的是，现在可不是忽视拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的时候，因为这些地区有着广泛的投资需求 — — 在最近于阿根廷召开G20会议期间已经有所展现 — — 并且还提供了广泛的增长机会。
en: In particular, now is not the time to ignore Latin America and the Caribbean, which have a wide range of investment needs – touched upon during the recent G20 meetings in Argentina – and also offer a broad range of growth opportunities.

zh: 该地区的国家已经进行了大量改革，不但促进了经济增长，也为长期的强劲财务回报奠定了基础。
en: Countries in this region have pursued substantial reforms that have boosted economic growth and laid the foundations for strong financial returns in the longer term.

zh: 更宏观地说，利益相关者们应该强化自己使用“从数十亿到数万亿”的方法去解决世界上诸多最棘手问题的承诺。
en: More broadly, stakeholders should strengthen their commitment to using the “billions to trillions” approach to resolving the world’s most vexing problems.

zh: 该方法通过将与财务，技能，能力和风险分配相关的措施结合在一起，利用相对稀缺的公共部门资本来调动更为强大的私营部门资源。
en: That approach uses a combination of measures related to finance, skills, capacity, and risk allocation to leverage relatively scarce public-sector capital to mobilize more robust private-sector resources.

zh: 多边开发银行在这里发挥着至关重要的作用，而其中许多在回应市场需求方面取得了很大进展。
en: The multilateral development banks have a critical role to play here, and many have made great strides in responding to market needs.

zh: 此外在联合国的主持下全世界已经商定了应对全球性挑战的补充路线图 ： 《 巴黎气候协定》和《可持续发展目标 》 。
en: Moreover, the world has agreed, under the auspices of the United Nations, on complementary road maps for addressing global challenges: the Paris Climate Agreement and the Sustainable Development Goals.

zh: 通过建立正确的机制去利用相关的投资机会，我们可以使用数十亿美元的公共资金来换取价值数万亿美元的进步。
en: By establishing the right mechanisms to take advantage of related investment opportunities, we can use billions of public dollars to make trillions of dollars’ worth of progress.

zh: 我们投资界的许多人致力于确保建立正确的财务和风险管理工具来连接公共和私营部门以提高自身的工作效率。
en: Many of us in the investment community are working to boost the effectiveness of our work by ensuring that the right financial and risk-management instruments are in place to connect the public and private sectors.

zh: 目前已有相应机制来促进资本流入新兴经济体，特别是目前已经涌现出一些诱人风险调整后收益机会的拉丁美洲和加勒比地区。
en: Already, mechanisms are in place to facilitate capital flows into emerging economies, particularly those in Latin America and the Caribbean, where opportunities for attractive risk-adjusted returns are now available.

zh: 在这种背景下，即使是大型机构投资者的适度投资分配也会对可持续成果的实现产生重大影响，同时也能提供诱人且具竞争力的财务回报。
en: In this context, even a very modest allocation by large institutional investors will have a major impact on the pursuit of sustainable outcomes, while also providing attractive, competitive financial returns.

zh: 这种动态 — — 也是“从数十亿到数万亿”方法的基本组成部分 — — 可以被嵌入其中，从而为一个赚钱与行善不相冲突的更宏大体系奠定基础。
en: This dynamic – a fundamental component of the billions-to-trillions approach – can become embedded, creating the basis for a broader system in which there is no trade-off between making money and doing good.

zh: 某些新兴经济体当前的动荡不应被用来抹杀过去它们过去取得的进展。
en: The current turmoil in some emerging economies must not be allowed to derail past progress.

zh: 相反，它应该促使各个利益相关者共同加倍努力去建立一个广泛受益的体系，这首先意味着要采取更为细致的风险评估方法去识别出许多新兴市场经济体所提供的诱人长期增长机会。
en: On the contrary, it should spur stakeholders to redouble their collective efforts to establish a broadly beneficial system. This means, first and foremost, taking a nuanced approach to risk assessment that recognizes the attractive long-term growth opportunities that many emerging-market economies offer.

zh: 新发传染性疾病
en: Emerging Infectious Diseases

zh: 如今的生物多样性危机已经不仅仅是栖息地消失和物种灭绝了，它还是新发传染性疾病（EID’s ） — —诸如艾滋病（人类 ） 、 埃博拉（人类和猩猩 ） 、 西尼罗河病毒和禽流感（人和鸟类 ） ， chytrid壶菌（两栖动物）以及瘟热（海狮）等所引发的危机。
en: Today’s bio-diversity crisis is not just one of lost habitats and extinct species. It is also a crisis of emerging infectious diseases (EID’s), such as HIV in humans, Ebola in humans and gorillas, West Nile virus and Avian Influenza in humans and birds, chytrid fungi in amphibians, and distemper in sea lions.

zh: 我们有足够理由来严肃对待这些事件，因为EID’s看来已经经历了很长时间的进化过程。
en: There is every reason to take these events seriously, because EID’s appear to have a long evolutionary history.

zh: 这是因为许多病原体能够传染诸多宿主，但是却只在某些宿主居住的地方才能进化。
en: This is because many pathogens are capable of infecting a range of hosts, but evolved in places where only some of those hosts live.

zh: 病菌通过独特的方式在宿主之间传播。
en: Pathogens also have specialized means of transmission from host to host.

zh: 举例来说，若某种病菌是通过某种居住在树顶的昆虫传播的，那么那些从不离开地面的宿主就不可能被传染。
en: If, for example, a pathogen is transmitted by an insect that lives in the tops of trees, susceptible hosts will not be infected if they never leave the ground.

zh: 对人类而言，艾滋病、埃博拉、西尼罗河病毒和禽流感只是无数EID’s中最新出现的几种。
en: For humans, HIV, Ebola, West Nile virus, and Avian flu are only the latest in a long line of EID’s.

zh: 一百万年前，当我们的祖先从非洲丛林搬迁至大草原时，他们很快就成为了战斗力极强的肉食动物。
en: When our ancestors moved out of the African forest onto the savannah more than a million years ago, they rapidly became effective predators.

zh: 由于和那些早就存在的肉食动物一起食用猎物，他们得上了原先只在狼狗、大型猫科动物和非洲猎狗身上才会寄居的绦虫。
en: Sharing prey with pre-existing carnivores, they acquired tapeworms that originally inhabited only hyenas, large cats, and African hunting dogs.

zh: 当人类开始迁徙出非洲的时候，他们把一部分病菌携带到了新地区，在那里他们把病菌传给了当地人，而当地的病菌也在新来人群身上定居下来。
en: When humans began to move out of Africa, they carried some of their pathogens to new areas, where they switched over to native hosts while native pathogens took up residence in the newly arrived humans.

zh: 农业和城市化使我们接触了更多的病菌。
en: Agriculture and urbanization subsequently exposed us to yet more pathogens.

zh: 如果那时候就有医生的话，他们会把所有这些都称为EID’s。
en: If doctors were around back then, they would have called all these occurrences EID’s.

zh: 地域限制和特殊的传播方式意味着在大多数情况下，大部分病菌只在一小部分宿主物种上出现，通常情况下是只在一种物种上出现，但却保持着感染更多物种的能力。
en: Geographical restriction and specialized transmission mean that in most time periods, most pathogens occur in a small number of host species, often only one, but retain the ability to infect more.

zh: 但是气候变化改变了一切。
en: But climate change alters everything.

zh: 物种离开了他们原本生存的地区，生态系统因此发生改变。
en: Species move out of their areas of origin and ecosystems change.

zh: 病菌开始接触那些它们以前从未碰到过、易受感染的、也从未有机会发展免疫力的宿主。
en: Pathogens come into contact with susceptible hosts that they have never before encountered, and that never had the opportunity to evolve resistance.

zh: 结果，EID’s不仅仅成为可能；而是成为一种必然。
en: As a result, EID’s are not just possible; they are inevitable.

zh: 事实上，气候变化的每一步都产生了EID’s。
en: Indeed, every episode of climate change has produced them.

zh: 从时间和成本角度来看，对问题先知先觉总比到时候再应对危机来得有效。
en: Anticipating a problem is always more effective in terms of time and cost than responding to a crisis, no matter how viable the response.

zh: 不幸的是，我们通常忙于与现存的疾病作战而未能将目光放远。
en: Unfortunately, we usually fight existing diseases but neglect looking forward.

zh: 举例来说，栖居在哥斯达黎加的白尾鹿身上有六种蜱，但是没有一种携带当地报道的莱姆病（Lyme Disease ） 。
en: For example, white-tailed deer living in northwestern Costa Rica host six species of tick. None of the ticks is known to carry Lyme Disease, which has never been reported in Costa Rica.

zh: 结果，那里就没有任何有关莱姆病的公共健康咨询。
en: As a result, there are no public health advisories about Lyme Disease there.

zh: 但是某些蜱与已知的莱姆病携带者极为相近，因此他们是潜在的携带者。
en: But some of the ticks are closely related to known carriers, and thus are potential carriers themselves.

zh: 这种古老的 — — 但却难以诊断的疾病就会在无意中由诸如一个无症状的生态旅行家这样简单的人或物带进哥斯达黎加。
en: This debilitating – and difficult to diagnose – illness could thus be introduced to Costa Rica inadvertently by something as simple as an asymptomatic eco-tourist.

zh: 有关哥斯达黎加鹿蜱的信息来源于北哥斯达黎加的脊椎动物寄生虫目录，但同类目录却只有这么一本。
en: The information about Costa Rican deer ticks comes from an inventory of parasites of vertebrates in northern Costa Rica, but it is the only inventory of its kind ever undertaken.

zh: 我们还得做得更好一点。
en: We must do better.

zh: 这个星球超过50%的物种是某种形态的寄生虫，包括影响人类的病菌，牲畜，庄稼和野生动物。
en: More than 50% of the species on this planet are parasites of some form, including pathogens affecting humans, livestock, crops, and wildlife.

zh: 但是，相对于我们对生物多样性的全部了解程度，我们只记录了全世界病菌的10%还不到。
en: But, relative to our overall knowledge of biodiversity, we have documented less than 10% of the world’s pathogens.

zh: 其余的90%就是潜在的EID’s。
en: The remaining 90% are potential EID’s.

zh: 因此，由于我们无法对未被证明存在性的病菌物种先发制“菌 ” ， 我们面临着一个潜在危机，而这个危机产生于我们对生物圈的根本性忽略。
en: We face a potential crisis, therefore, that stems from our fundamental ignorance about the biosphere, for it is impossible to be proactive about species of pathogens whose existence has not been documented.

zh: 这使很多病菌在我们重新找到新栖息地、把物种带到四处并改变现行生态系统的时候，成为等候我们的“进化中的地雷 ” 。
en: This makes many pathogens “evolutionary land mines” awaiting us as we relocate to novel habitats, move species around, and alter existing ecosystems.

zh: 但是，大部分资源仍然被用于应付已知的EID’s，而不是对潜在EID’s的风险进行评估 ， 。
en: Nevertheless, most resources are still being allocated for responses to known EID’s rather than to assessing the risk of potential EID’s.

zh: 简而言之，我们必须完善全球物种目录。
en: Simply put, we must complete the global inventory of species.

zh: 就从现在开始。
en: Now.

zh: 用更快更便宜的计算机来演绎的这五十万年以来的搜寻和收集经验，结合以价钱更低速度更快的分子分析，使得这个工作可行且经济。
en: Five hundred thousand years of experience in hunting and gathering, coupled with cheaper and faster molecular analysis, performed by faster and cheaper computers makes this task economically feasible.

zh: 使用基因“条形码”进行快速鉴定能够提高发现物种并确定潜在EID’s传播动力的效率。
en: Rapid identification using genetic “bar codes” can increase the rate of discovering species and determining the transmission dynamics of potential EID’s.

zh: 病菌拥有尤为特别的传播模式，而密切相关的物种群的传播模式可能颇为相像。
en: Pathogens have highly specialized transmission modes, and groups of closely related species tend to be very similar.

zh: 例如，所有类型的疟疾都是通过蚊子传播的。
en: All species of malaria, for example, are transmitted by mosquitos.

zh: 一旦能够将它们分类，我们就能够在对两者都知之甚少的基础上对两种密切相关的物种进行预测，既省时间又省钱。
en: Once classified, we will then be able to make predictions about two closely related species based on incomplete information about either, buying time and saving money.

zh: 最终，这些信息将被数字化并在国际互联网上免费向所有有关的研究者和党派公开。
en: Finally, this information should be digitized and made freely available over the Internet to all concerned researchers and parties.

zh: 如果EID’s寥寥无几，在应对危机过程中所采取的手段也许是划算的。
en: If EID’s were rare, management through crisis response might be cost-effective.

zh: 但是EID’s绝非寥若晨星。
en: But EID’s are not rare at all.

zh: 相反，它们是大规模环境变化下地理分布的自然产物。
en: Rather, they are a common outcome of geographic dispersal associated with large-scale environmental changes.

zh: 所以我们再也不能视而不见、消极行事，我们应该变得博学多闻并采取积极态度。
en: So we must cease being ignorant and reactive, and become informed and proactive.

zh: 正如常说的运动谚语那样：赢要保持，输要改变。
en: As a common sports adage puts it: never change a winning game, but always change a losing one.

zh: 即将到来的新兴市场债务踩踏
en: The Coming Emerging-Market Debt Squeeze

zh: 圣地亚哥—考虑以下情形。 这一情形在新兴市场国家一再上演过。
en: SANTIAGO – Consider the following scenario, one that has played out time and again in emerging-market countries.

zh: 本地银行和企业继续着借贷狂欢，积累了大量美元计价债务 — — 专家们认为这些债务可以完美维持，只要本币保持坚挺。
en: Local banks and firms go on a borrowing binge and pile up dollar-denominated debt – debt that pundits consider perfectly sustainable, as long as the local currency is strong.

zh: 突然间，一些事情（美国利率升高、大宗商品价格下跌、本国政治冲突等）导致本币兑美元贬值。
en: Suddenly, something (an increase in United States interest rates, a drop in commodity prices, a domestic political conflict) causes the local currency to drop in value against the dollar.

zh: 用本币衡量的债务负担大大增加。
en: The debt burden, measured in domestic currency, is now much higher.

zh: 一些借款人无法偿付利息；另一些借款人无法延期本金。
en: Some borrowers miss interest payments; others are unable to roll over principal.

zh: 金融损失随之而来。
en: Financial mayhem ensues.

zh: 这就是20世纪80年代拉丁美洲债务危机、1994年墨西哥龙舌兰危机、1997年亚洲债务危机 和1998年俄罗斯危机的发生方式。
en: This is how the Latin American debt crisis of the 1980s, the Mexican Tequila crisis of 1994, the Asian debt crisis of 1997, and the Russian crisis of 1998 unfolded.

zh: 这也是2008—2009年金融危机传染到新兴市场的方式。
en: It was also how the financial crisis of 2008-2009 transmitted itself to emerging markets.

zh: 每一次，借款人和贷款人都宣称汲取了教训。
en: Every time, borrowers and lenders claimed to have learned their lesson.

zh: 如今，这一情形不但可能再度发生，其规模也可能比以往大得多。
en: Not only could it happen again today; it could happen on a much larger scale than in the past.

zh: 利用发达国家极低利率的条件，新兴市场银行和政府以前所未有的规模借贷。
en: Taking advantage of ultra-low interest rates in advanced countries, emerging-market banks and firms have been borrowing like never before.

zh: 国际清算银行（BIS）的最新报告表明，自全球金融危机爆发以来，美国之外非银行借款人的未偿还美国信用增加了一半，从6万亿美元增至9万亿美元。
en: A recent paper by the Bank of International Settlements shows that since the global financial crisis, outstanding dollar credit to non-bank borrowers outside the US has risen by half, from $6 trillion to $9 trillion.

zh: 其中大部分债务在亚洲，光是中国就占了大约1万亿美元。
en: The bulk of that debt is in Asia, with China alone accounting for approximately $1 trillion.

zh: 其他主要美元借款人包括巴西（3,000亿美元以上）和印度（1,250亿美元 ） 。
en: Other big dollar borrowers include Brazil (over $300 billion) and India ($125 billion).

zh: 马来西亚、南非、土耳其以及金融较开放的拉美国家的外币债务也出现了大幅增加。
en: Countries such as Malaysia, South Africa, and Turkey, plus Latin America’s more financially open economies, also have rising foreign-currency debts.

zh: 是的，在美联储本月早些时候出人意料地释放出比预期更为“鸽派”的立场后，美元的强势有些减弱。
en: Yes, the almighty dollar is not as mighty as it was before the US Federal Reserve surprised markets with a more-dovish-than-expected communiqué earlier this month.

zh: 但是，考虑到美国和其他发达经济体（特别是欧元和日本）之间可能的利差，再加上美国经济复苏的日益稳健，美元升值的时代 — — 这几乎是新兴市场货币贬值的代名词 — — 也许还将持续。
en: But, given the likely interest-rate differential between the US and other advanced economies (particularly the eurozone and Japan), together with a more robust US economic recovery, an era of dollar strength – and, almost by definition, weak emerging-market currencies – is here to stay.

zh: 这也许意味着借入美元在圣保罗或吉隆坡建造购物城的企业将遇到麻烦，如今，它们得拿出比以往大得多比例的里亚尔或林吉特收入来维持美元债务。
en: This likely means trouble for the firm that borrowed in dollars to build a shopping mall in São Paulo or Kuala Lumpur, and now must devote a much larger share of its revenues in depreciated real or ringgit to service its debt.

zh: 我们是如何走到这一步的？
en: How did we get here?

zh: 曾经的传统智慧认为，遏制政府负债偏好就能结束过度负债，因为私人部门将知道要审慎，也会衡量增加美元债务的利弊。
en: Once upon a time, conventional wisdom maintained that curbing governments’ appetite for debt would put an end to over-borrowing, because private agents would know to act prudently and weigh the costs and benefits of one more dollar of debt.

zh: 如今，即使是顽固的芝加哥大学经济学家也不再相信这一点了。
en: Not even stern University of Chicago economists believe that anymore.

zh: 许多新兴经济体（即使不包括阿根廷、委内瑞拉和其他以管理不善闻名的国家）的财政和债务情况比以往好得多。
en: The fiscal and debt position of many emerging economies (though not of Argentina, Venezuela, and other poster children for mismanagement) is much stronger than it once was.

zh: 但私人部门财务主管们似乎决心证明他们可以像公共部门同道曾经所做的那样肆意借贷。
en: But private-sector CFOs seem determined to prove that they can borrow as lavishly as their public-sector colleagues once did.

zh: 传统智慧曾经还认为，美元借贷狂欢只发生在固定汇率国家，由中央银行为借款人提供货币风险的事实保险。
en: Conventional wisdom also once held that dollar borrowing binges occur only in countries with fixed exchange rates, with the central bank de facto insuring borrowers against currency risk.

zh: 如今，大部分新兴市场经济体已经（或至少看似已经）采取了浮动汇率，但本地人仍大量借入外币。
en: Today, most emerging-market economies have (or at least pretend to have) floating exchange rates, and yet locals continue to borrow heavily in foreign currency.

zh: 这部分反映了借贷成本差。
en: This partly reflects borrowing-cost differentials.

zh: 如果本币利率为每年17%而美元利率为2 % ， 那么借入美元仍然有利可图，只要本币不会贬值15%以上。
en: If the local interest rate is 17% per year and the dollar interest rate is 2%, it still makes sense to borrow in dollars as long as the domestic currency is expected to depreciate 15% or less.

zh: 另一种解释来自经济学家吉列莫·卡沃（Guillermo Calvo）和卡门·莱因哈特（Carmen Reinhart）所谓的“浮动恐惧 ” 。
en: The other part of the explanation follows from what the economists Guillermo Calvo and Carmen Reinhart call “fear of floating.”

zh: 许多市场参与者从过去的经验（比如2008—2009年）中知道，新兴经济体央行害怕急剧贬值，在面临压力时它们倾向于干预，至少是暂时干预，以支持汇率 ， “ 平滑”其下降趋势。
en: Many market participants know from past experience (recall 2008-2009, for example) that emerging economies’ central banks fear sharp depreciations, and that in moments of stress they tend to intervene, at least temporarily, to support the exchange rate, “smoothing” its decline.

zh: 因此动作迅速的投机客能够攫取不错的利润，在音乐还没有停止时逃之夭夭。
en: So a speculator who is quick on his feet can make a handsome profit and get out while the music is still playing.

zh: 新兴市场因为其美元债务而脆弱到何种程度？
en: How vulnerable are emerging economies because of all this dollar debt?

zh: 乐观者喜欢说，2010年以来，新兴市场积累了巨量国际储备，这使得它们可以在面临货币或外部债务挤兑时保护自己。
en: Optimists like to point out that emerging markets have accumulated a huge stock of international reserves since 2010, enabling them to self-insure against a run on their currencies or their foreign debt.

zh: 的确如此，但是有限度。
en: That is true, but only up to a point.

zh: 在中央银行的金库中存放数百上千亿美元看上去���当可靠，直到你认识到未来12个月中到期的美元债务并不比这个数字小多少。
en: Having tens or even hundreds of billions of dollars in the central bank’s vault sounds reassuring until you realize that dollar debt coming due in the next 12 months may not be that much smaller.

zh: 尽管数据并不完全可靠，国家之间也未必可比，但稍做计算即可发现，许多新兴市场的短期债务可达国际储备存量的50%甚至更多。
en: The data are not fully reliable or comparable across countries, but quick calculations reveal that there are many emerging markets where such short-term debt is 50% or more of the stock of international reserves.

zh: 而美元债务人也许并非唯一指望这笔储备的人。
en: And dollar debtors may not be alone in staking a claim on those reserves.

zh: 发生踩踏时，本币持有人也想把钱换成美元。
en: In a squeeze, holders of domestic currency will want to exchange it for greenbacks.

zh: 如果央行的浮动政策是严肃的，将提高本币利息以限制价格上涨，从而导致痛苦的衰退。
en: If the central bank is serious about floating, it will hike local interest rates to limit price increases, causing a painful recession.

zh: 或者，它可以干预并出售国际储备，导致可用于偿还美元债务的存量下降。
en: Alternatively, it may intervene and sell international reserves, reducing the stock available to repay dollar debt.

zh: 乐观者还指出，一些本地借款人天然对冲了风险。
en: Optimists also argue that some local borrowers are naturally hedged.

zh: 诚然，一些借入美元的出口公司也赚取美元。
en: Yes, some export companies that borrow dollars also earn dollars.

zh: 但它们是少数，而即使是它们也可能会有问题，以往内贬值降低了它们的本币资产的美元价值，导致违反贷款契约的情况，并有可能让它们无法获得信用。
en: But they are in the minority, and even they can have problems, because depreciation reduces the dollar value of their domestic assets, causing breaches in loan covenants and potentially impairing access to credit.

zh: 哪怕是那些试图用国内美元贷款与国外美元借款相匹配的银行也存在风险。
en: There are risks even for banks that make the effort to match their dollar borrowing from abroad with dollar loans extended at home.

zh: 也许这些银行并不存在显而易见的货币错配，但如果本地借款人的收入全部为本币，就有可能无法维持债务。
en: There may be no obvious currency mismatch for the bank, but if the local borrowers’ revenues are only in domestic currency, they may become unable to service their debt.

zh: 在一地通过监管消除的风险在另一地重新出现。
en: Risk eliminated by regulations in one place reappears somewhere else.

zh: 对许多借入美元产生本币收入的新兴市场企业来说，目前的贬值正在触发大量金融困难。
en: For the many emerging-market firms that borrowed in dollars to generate local-currency revenue, the recent depreciation is triggering plenty of financial trouble.

zh: 困难有多大最终取决于它们难以预测的因素，包括市场对美联储紧缩和影响投资者对本地政策和市场新型的政治冲击（比如与巴西石油公司有关的丑闻）如何反应。
en: How much trouble will ultimately depend on factors that are very hard to forecast, including markets’ responses to Fed tightening and political shocks (say, the scandal enveloping Petrobras in Brazil) that shake investors’ faith in local policies and markets.

zh: 只有一个结果是肯定的：剧烈波动。
en: One can predict only one outcome with confidence: a bumpy ride.

zh: 新兴经济体摆脱危机的秘诀
en: The Secret to Emerging-Economy Immunity

zh: 发自北京 — — 下个月，政策制定者和专家将齐聚印尼巴厘岛努沙杜瓦，参加国际货币基金组织和世界银行集团年会。
en: BEIJING – Next month, policymakers and experts will gather in Bali Nusa Dua, Indonesia, for the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank Group.

zh: 这个地点相当应景：印尼是20多年前那场亚洲金融危机的风暴中心。
en: The location is fitting: Indonesia was at the epicenter of the Asian financial crisis that erupted just over 20 years ago.

zh: 那场危机为阿根廷和土耳其等新兴市场当前的动荡留下了重要教训。
en: That crisis carries important lessons for the current turmoil in emerging markets like Argentina and Turkey.

zh: 至于预测今时今日的问题是否真会转化为一场类似1997~1998年那样的危机，这项工作我还是留给其他人好了。
en: Predicting whether today’s problems will actually bring about a crisis like that of 1997-1998 is an exercise that I will leave to others.

zh: 尽管如此，为了更好地分辨哪些新兴经济体最易受到影响，还是有必要将一代人遭遇的危机与当前这场危机进行比较。
en: Nonetheless, it is worth comparing the circumstances surrounding the crisis a generation ago to those prevailing today, in order to discern better which emerging economies are most vulnerable.

zh: 过去几年的状况与1997~1998年危机爆发之间那几年存在着极大的相似之处。
en: There are significant similarities between events of the last few years and the run-up to the 1997-1998 crisis.

zh: 在经历了1990年代初的经济衰退之后，美国一直维持着低利率和宽松货币政策，正如2008年全球经济危机之后一样。
en: Following the recession of the early 1990s, the United States maintained low interest rates and an accommodative monetary policy, just as it did after the 2008 global economic crisis.

zh: 在那十年的中段，鉴于联邦基金利率已于1995年达到顶峰，美联储开始逐步收紧政策 — — 也跟今天一样。
en: In the middle of that decade, the US Federal Reserve began gradually tightening its policy – much as it is doing today – with the federal funds rate peaking in 1995.

zh: 但是在同一时期，新兴市场国家，尤其是亚洲的新兴市场国家却大幅增加了外部借款，造成了随后引发危机的货币和资产负债表不匹配状况。
en: In the 1990s, however, emerging markets, especially in Asia, increased their external borrowing considerably, creating the currency and balance-sheet mismatches that later triggered the crisis.

zh: 对于许多新兴经济体来说当前的情况并非如此，因为它们大多都建立了充足的外汇储备并且保持着低外债水平。
en: That is not the case today for many emerging economies, which have built ample foreign reserves and kept external debt low.

zh: 但这并不意味着新兴经济体就没事了。
en: But this does not mean that emerging economies are in the clear.

zh: 毕竟在阿根廷比索近期大幅贬值以致该国只得向国际货币基金组织申请救助之前，该国的外债水平也被认为相对较低。
en: After all, Argentina’s external debt was also considered relatively low until the peso’s recent sharp depreciation, which spurred the government to request funds from the IMF.

zh: 事实在于对于危机的防范并没有万全之法。
en: The truth is that there is no foolproof approach to preventing a crisis.

zh: 当然，维持低债务水平，保持灵活汇率以及实施明智的宏观审慎政策等措施有助于避免灾难。
en: Of course, measures like keeping external debt low, maintaining flexible exchange rates, and implementing smart macroprudential policies can help to stave off disaster.

zh: 而那些虽然难以描述，但可以体现可信度并维护市场信心的一整套政策也可以召唤出保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）口中的“信心仙女 ” 。
en: So can the elusive set of policies that are supposed to show credibility and keep markets confident, summoning the “confidence fairy,” as Paul Krugman would say.

zh: 但是，正如病毒也会感染那些身体最好的人那样，危机也可以横扫一个早已做足准备的经济体。
en: But, just as a virus can afflict the healthiest of people, a crisis can sweep up even a well-prepared economy.

zh: 这就是为什么各国不能只着眼于预防措施而是要强化自身的迅速复原能力。
en: That is why countries must look beyond preventive measures and strengthen their ability to support a speedy recovery.

zh: 为了弄清楚这在实践中意味着什么，我们应考量各经济体在1997~1998年危机后的复原速度差异。
en: To figure out what that means in practice, we should consider the differences in how quickly economies recovered from the 1997-1998 crisis.

zh: 韩国的实际人均GDP在两年内就回到了危机前水平。
en: South Korea’s real per capita GDP was back to pre-crisis levels within two years.

zh: 但是马来西亚和泰国花了六年时间，土耳其花了八年，而印尼和阿根廷则等了十年时间才恢复到危机前状态。
en: But it took Malaysia and Thailand six years, Turkey eight years, and Indonesia and Argentina a decade to return to pre-crisis conditions.

zh: 这一差异与每个国家的富裕程度并不相关：阿根廷要比除韩国外的其他所有经济体都富裕得多。
en: The difference does not lie in how wealthy each country was: Argentina was much richer than all of the other economies mentioned, except for South Korea.

zh: 相反，它至少部分反映了生产和出口的结构构成和复杂性。
en: Instead, it reflects, at least partly, the structure and sophistication of production and exports.

zh: 1997年时韩国在出口成熟度方面排名第一，其次是马来西亚、泰国、土耳其，阿根廷和印尼 — — 这一顺序也与经济复苏的持续时间一致。
en: In 1997, South Korea would have ranked first in export sophistication, followed by Malaysia, Thailand, Turkey, Argentina, and Indonesia – a sequence that mirrors the duration of the recovery.

zh: 那么为何更成熟的出口基础可以支撑金融危机复苏？
en: Why would a more sophisticated export base support recovery from financial crisis?

zh: 正如2015年国际货币基金组织《世界经济展望》报告所显示的那样，尽管某些国家可能处于全球价值链上游，但汇率对出口增长仍然很重要。
en: As the 2015 IMF World Economic Outlook report shows, despite the rise of global value chains, the exchange rate still matters for export growth.

zh: 此外，更成熟且更具差异化的出口产品对汇率波动的反应往往更大。
en: In addition, more sophisticated and differentiated export products tend to respond more to exchange-rate fluctuations.

zh: 因此危机期间的货币贬值能为那些生产基础更为成熟的经济体的出口和增长给予更大推动。
en: Currency depreciation during a crisis thus provides a bigger boost to exports and growth in economies with a more sophisticated production base.

zh: 亚洲金融危机期间的经历证实了这一点。
en: The experience during the Asian financial crisis bears this out.

zh: 韩元贬值导致三星产品更具竞争力，使企业得以扩大其市场份额。
en: The depreciation of the South Korean won caused Samsung products to become more competitive, enabling the company to expand its market share.

zh: 而阿根廷和印尼的主要出口产品 — — 农产品 — — 对货币贬值的反应则小得多。
en: The main exports of Argentina and Indonesia – agricultural commodities – were far less responsive to currency depreciation.

zh: 国际货币基金组织的利达·谢里夫（Reda Cherif ） ， 弗阿德·哈桑诺夫（Fuad Hasanov）连同弗吉尼亚大学王丽晨（音译，Lichen Wang）的近期研究成果表明，出口成熟度是经济增长的最强大决定因素，同时也可能是经济复苏的强大来源。
en: The IMF’s Reda Cherif, Fuad Hasanov, and Lichen Wang recently showed that export sophistication is the most robust determinant of an economy’s growth. But it may also be a powerful source of economic resilience.

zh: 虽然新兴经济体 — — 特别是那些采取灵活汇率并限制其外债规模的经济体 — — 有条件去避免危机，但无法保证它们一定能实现这一点。
en: While emerging economies – particularly those economies that adopt flexible exchange rates and limit their external debt – may yet avoid a crisis, there is no guarantee that they will be able to do so.

zh: 但随着出口基础的日趋成熟，它们遭遇长期衰退的风险将大大减少。
en: With a more sophisticated export base, however, the risks of protracted recession will be significantly diminished.

zh: 新兴市场的未来
en: The Future for Emerging Markets

zh: 伯克利—过去几年来，全球经济环境发生了意料之外的巨大变化。
en: BERKELEY – Over the past year, the global economic environment changed markedly and in unexpected ways.

zh: 能源和大宗商品暴跌。
en: Energy and commodity prices plunged.

zh: 中国的增长（占全球增长的40%左右）下降到1996年以来的最低水平，尽管其股市暴涨至不可持续的高位。
en: Growth in China (which accounts for about 40% of global growth) fell to its lowest rate since 1996, even as its stock market soared to unsustainable heights.

zh: 美国和欧盟加码对俄制裁，以此作为俄罗斯军事入侵乌克兰的回应，这突显出与跨国投资相关的地缘政治风险。
en: The United States and the European Union ratcheted up economic sanctions on Russia in response to its military excursions in Ukraine, highlighting the geopolitical risks associated with cross-border investments.

zh: 而由于实际或预期的货币政策变化（如美联储 ） ， 汇率也出现了剧烈波动。
en: And there have been large swings in exchange rates, fueled by actual or, in the case of the Federal Reserve, anticipated changes in monetary policy.

zh: 来势迅猛的变化让全球金融市场措手不及，也吓坏了投资者，降低了他们的风险偏好 — — 在新兴市场已经表现出相当谨慎的态度。
en: These rapid changes have rattled global financial markets and spooked investors, reducing their appetite for risk – a cautious attitude that has been reflected in emerging markets.

zh: 投资者开始旁观，追踪新兴市场股市回报的MSCI指数陷入停滞。
en: Investors have sat on the sidelines, and the MSCI index that tracks returns on emerging-market equities has stagnated.

zh: 去年下半年，15个最大的新兴市场经济体经历了自2008年全球金融危机以来最大的资本外流。
en: During the second half of last year, the 15 largest emerging-market economies experienced the biggest capital outflows since the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 新兴国家外汇储备总量自1994年以来首次出现下降。 从1994年开始，新兴市场外汇储备大幅攀升，成为过去二十年来全球经济的一个显著特征。
en: And the aggregate foreign-exchange reserves held by emerging countries declined for the first time since 1994, when they began the steep upward climb that has been a defining feature of the global economy during the last two decades.

zh: 导致新兴市场投资不振的一个主要因素是人们预期美联储将在今年晚些时候提高利率和货币政策正常化。
en: One major factor driving the lackluster performance of investments in emerging markets is the expectation that the Fed will begin to raise interest rates and normalize monetary policy later this year.

zh: 在最近的讲话中，美联储主席耶伦确认，如果经济继续改善，这些措施将是“合适的 ” ， 并表示“推迟收紧货币政策，到就业和通胀回到我们的目标水平再采取行动将有可能导致经济过热。 ”
en: In a recent speech, Fed Chair Janet Yellen confirmed that such steps would be “appropriate” if the economy continues to improve, stating that “delaying action to tighten monetary policy until employment and inflation are already back to our objectives would risk overheating the economy.”

zh: 升息预期从2013年就开始限制流向新兴市场的资本流，当时，美联储宣布有可能缩减其债券购买计划，这引起了所谓的“削减恐慌 ” 。
en: Expectations of a rate hike have restricted flows to emerging markets ever since 2013, when the Fed triggered what came to be called the “taper tantrum” by announcing that it was likely to reduce its bond-buying program.

zh: 由此带来的警报引起了美国金融市场动荡和国际影响。
en: The resulting alarm roiled US financial markets and spilled over internationally.

zh: 新兴市场经济体承受了巨大的压力，投资资金流入剧减，资产价格下跌，许多货币兑美元汇率也纷纷贬值。
en: Emerging-market economies came under intense pressure, with inflows to investment funds falling sharply, asset prices declining, and many currencies losing value against the dollar.

zh: 幸运的是，削减恐慌的高潮是短暂的。
en: Fortunately, the worst of the taper tantrum proved temporary.

zh: 随后资本流入有所恢复，大部分新兴市场经济体都抵挡住了资本市场的这一金融波动。
en: Capital inflows recovered somewhat, and most emerging-market economies weathered the financial distress in their capital markets.

zh: 但这一经验让人们质疑美联储后续措施的效果。
en: But the experience raised questions about the effects of future moves by the Fed.

zh: 美联储副主席斯坦利·费舍尔（Stanley Fischer）最近表示，据他预计，美联储今年晚些时候的政策利率升息幅度对于新兴市场经济体来说将是“可管理的 ” 。
en: Stanley Fischer, the Fed’s vice chairman, said recently that he expects the anticipated increase in the Fed’s policy interest rate later this year to “prove manageable” for emerging-market economies.
