zh: 但美联储动作所导致的外资流入的骤降可能放大哪怕是表现最好的亚洲经济体所面临的挑战，出口市场需求的萎靡不振将导致它们增长放缓。
en: But sudden steep declines in foreign capital inflows triggered by the Fed’s action could exacerbate the challenges that even the best-performing Asian economies are facing, as anemic demand in their export markets causes growth to slow.

zh: 美联储试图将其政策意图、战略和时机表述得一清二楚，以确保投资者不会感到意外。
en: The Fed has tried hard to be very clear about its policy intentions, strategies, and timing to ensure that investors are not surprised.

zh: 近几年来，新兴市场经济体资产 — — 特别是货币 — — 相对美元编制了5—50 % ， 既反映了外部失衡，也反映了个体国家更广义的宏观情况。
en: In recent years, assets in emerging-market economies – especially currencies – have depreciated by 5-50% relative to the dollar, reflecting both external imbalances and the broader macro conditions of individual countries.

zh: 一个广泛存在的观点是大部分新兴金融市场价格已经体现了逐渐升高利率的影响。
en: There is a widespread view that most emerging financial markets have already priced in the effects of a gradual increase in interest rates.

zh: 但这并不意味着这一影响将对已被投资者认为是高风险的国家无关紧要。
en: But that does not mean that these effects will be insignificant for countries that investors already regard as risky.

zh: 随着投资者日渐谨慎，他们也变得越来越挑剔。
en: As investors have become more cautious, they have also become more discriminating.

zh: 新兴市场之间以及市场内部不同部门之间的回报差异已经扩大。
en: The difference in returns across emerging countries and among sectors within them has grown.

zh: 资本大量外流风险最大的国家包括那些依赖外部融资的国家、依赖大宗商品的经济体和那些政治环境不确定的国家。
en: The countries at greatest risk of large capital outflows include those that are dependent on external financing, those with commodity-heavy economies, and those with uncertain political conditions.

zh: 许多表现最佳的国家在亚洲 — — 唯一一个有多个经济体在至少四时年的时间里保持5%或以上增长速度的地区。
en: Many of the best performers are in Asia – the only region where several economies have grown by 5% or more for at least four decades.

zh: 去年MSCI亚洲指数上涨10 % ， 尽管新兴和前沿市场指数下跌14 % ， 拉丁美洲新兴市场下跌21 % 。
en: Over the last year, the MSCI index for Asia increased by 10%, even as it fell by roughly 14% for emerging and frontier markets and by 21% for emerging markets in Latin America.

zh: 而事实上，亚洲最大的两个新兴经济体让我们感到谨慎乐观。
en: And, indeed, Asia’s two largest emerging economies offer reasons for cautious optimism.

zh: 中国显然不是没有风险。
en: China is certainly not free from risk.

zh: 最近的股市暴涨与基本面完全脱离，是由投机性债务融资买入行为驱动的。
en: The recent equity-market rally is largely divorced from fundamentals and is driven by speculative, debt-financed purchases.

zh: 公司利润前景仍然萎靡；股票供给正在增加；估值高企。
en: The outlook for corporate profits remains weak; the country’s equity supply is growing; and valuations are stretched.

zh: 中国股市市值有高达10%为信用融资 — — 是发达经济体平均水平的五倍。
en: Up to 10% of China’s equity market cap is funded by credit – five times the average in developed economies.

zh: 但中国有大量货币和财政政策空间遏制债务累积、房地产繁荣和股市非理性繁荣所带来的不利后果，同时追求大胆的经济和资本市场结构改革。
en: But China also has substantial wriggle room in its monetary and fiscal policy to contain the adverse consequences of its debt buildup, real-estate boom, and irrationally exuberant stock market, while simultaneously pursuing bold structural reforms in its economy and capital markets.

zh: 中国增长率也许已经从三十年来的平均水平10%下降到25年来的最低值7 % ， 但这一减速基本上是降低固定投资、促使经济从制造业转向服务业的政策的结果。
en: China’s growth rate may have dropped from a three-decade average of 10% to a 25-year low of 7%, but that slowdown has been largely the result of policies to reduce fixed investment and move the economy from manufacturing to services.

zh: 就业依然强劲，中产阶级也在快速成长。
en: Employment remains strong, and the middle class is growing rapidly.

zh: 与此同时，在印度，总理莫迪的宏大改革日程的实施比预计的更加缓慢。
en: Meanwhile, in India, the implementation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s ambitious reform agenda has been slower than anticipated.

zh: 但通胀已经降了下来；财政状况也有所改善，而印度经济也因为石油和大宗商品价格下跌而受益。
en: But inflation is down; the fiscal situation has improved; and the economy has benefitted from the drop in oil and commodity prices.

zh: 6—7%的增长率似乎是可以实现的，而莫迪仍然是受民众支持的改革派领导人，他的政策吸引了国内投资者的支持。
en: Growth of 6-7% seems achievable, and Modi remains a popular reform-minded leader whose policies are attracting the support of domestic investors.

zh: 未来五年，全球投资者将面临新兴市场水深难测的局面，他们应该记住，对这些经济体来说，工业化和城市化浪潮以及随之而来的生产率提高还远未结束。
en: As global investors navigate the uncertain waters of emerging markets in the next few years, they should remember that, for these economies, the wave of industrialization and urbanization and the associated productivity gains are far from over.

zh: 它们拥有更快的人口和生产率增长速度，将在相当长一段时间内获得相对发达经济体的增长优势。
en: With their faster-growing populations and productivity, they will enjoy a growth advantage over developed economies for some time to come.

zh: 回归新兴市场基本面
en: Back to Fundamentals in Emerging Markets

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 经过15年的大肆炒作，新兴市场深陷困境这一新的传统智慧已经站稳了脚跟。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Following 15 years of hype, a new conventional wisdom has taken hold: emerging markets are in deep trouble.

zh: 许多分析人士曾预测巴西、俄罗斯、土耳其和印度等国未来将维持快速增长，并将其赞誉为世界经济的新引擎。
en: Many analysts had extrapolated rapid growth in countries such as Brazil, Russia, Turkey, and India into the indefinite future, calling them the new engines of the world economy.

zh: 现在几乎上述所有国家都出现了增速放缓，因为美联储今年9月预期加息，投资者正忙着撤出资金。
en: Now growth is down in almost all of them, and investors are pulling their money out – prompted in part by the expectation that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates in September.

zh: 上述国家货币持续下跌，而腐败丑闻和其他政治困难已经在巴西和土耳其等地压倒了经济诉求。
en: Their currencies have tumbled, while corruption scandals and other political difficulties have overwhelmed the economic narrative in places like Brazil and Turkey.

zh: 事后看来，多数新兴市场国家显然没有连贯的增长前景。
en: With hindsight, it has become clear that there was in fact no coherent growth story for most emerging markets.

zh: 究其原因，你会发现它们的高增速源于需求拉动而非生产率转变，反过来又受到不可持续的公私借贷所带来的暂时商品繁荣的驱动。
en: Scratch the surface, and you found high growth rates driven not by productive transformation but by domestic demand, in turn fueled by temporary commodity booms and unsustainable levels of public or, more often, private borrowing.

zh: 的确，新兴市场涌现出许多世界级公司，而且中产阶级的扩张也明白无误。
en: Yes, there are plenty of world-class firms in emerging markets, and the expansion of the middle-class is unmistakable.

zh: 但生产企业仅雇佣了很少一部分劳动力，而非正式的非生产企业则吸纳了大部分工人。
en: But only a tiny share of these economies’ labor is employed in productive enterprises, while informal, unproductive firms absorb the rest.

zh: 与成功跨入到发达国家行列的少数国家进行对比，你就能找到所缺少的要素。
en: Compare this with the experience of the few countries that did emerge successfully, “graduating” to advanced-country status, and you can see the missing ingredient.

zh: 快速工业化是韩国和台湾增长的背景。
en: South Korea and Taiwan grew on the back of rapid industrialization.

zh: 随着韩国和台湾农民变身为工厂工人，两国经济 — — 其后还有政治 — — 都经历了转型过程。
en: As South Korean and Taiwanese peasants became factory workers, the economies of both countries – and, with a lag, their politics – were transformed.

zh: 韩国和台湾最终成为富裕的民主国家。
en: South Korea and Taiwan eventually became rich democracies.

zh: 相比之下，今天的多数新兴市场都过早开始了去工业化进程。
en: By contrast, most of today’s emerging markets are deindustrializing prematurely.

zh: 服务的贸易性与工业产品不可同日而语，同等的技术活力也难以体现其中。
en: Services are not tradable to the same extent as manufactured goods, and for the most part do not exhibit the same technological dynamism.

zh: 因此迄今为止的事实已经证明服务并非出口导向型工业化的合格替代品。
en: As a result, services have proved to be a poor substitute to export-oriented industrialization so far.

zh: 新兴市场并非无法避免今天所遭受的厄运。
en: But emerging markets do not deserve the doom-and-gloom treatment they are getting these days.

zh: 新兴市场经济停滞的真正教训是必须更多关注增长的基本面，并清醒地认识到被强行划归一类的不同经济体具有各自局面的多样性。
en: The real lesson from the collapse of the emerging-market hype is the need to pay closer attention to growth fundamentals and to recognize the diversity of circumstances among a group of economies needlessly lumped together.

zh: 对发展中经济体而言，劳动力教育和技能培训、机构及治理改善和从低生产率到高生产率活动的结构转型（例如工业化）是三大关键增长基本面。
en: For developing economies, the three key growth fundamentals are acquisition of skills and education by the workforce; improvement of institutions and governance; and structural transformation from low-productivity to high-productivity activities (as typified by industrialization).

zh: 东亚式快速增长通常需要长达数十年的大规模结构转型，靠教育和体制的平稳进步为接轨发达经济提供长期支撑。
en: East Asian-style rapid growth has typically required a heavy dose of structural transformation for a number of decades, with steady progress on education and institutions providing the longer-term underpinnings of convergence with advanced economies.

zh: 与东亚经济体不同的是，今天的新兴市场不能继续依赖制造业出口盈余作为结构转型和增长的引擎。
en: Unlike East Asian economies, today’s emerging markets cannot rely on export surpluses in manufactures as their engine of structural transformation and growth.

zh: 因此，他们不得不更多地依赖于教育和制度等长期基本面因素。
en: So they are forced to rely more on the longer-term fundamentals of education and institutions.

zh: 这些确实会带来经济增长，并且实际上是增长不可或缺的要素。
en: These do generate growth – and indeed are ultimately indispensable to it.

zh: 但它们最多只能带来每年2-3%的增长，远远落后于东亚7-8%的增速。
en: But they generate 2-3% annual growth at best, not East Asia’s 7-8% rates.

zh: 我们来对比一下中国和印度。
en: Compare China and India.

zh: 中国增长依靠建设工厂并吸纳受教育程度不高的农民，借此为生产力带来立竿见影的好处。
en: China grew by building factories and filling them with peasants who had little education, which generated an instant boost in productivity.

zh: 印度的比较优势在于相对的技术密集型服务 — — 比如信息技术 — — 但只能吸纳该国极小比例的非技术劳动人口。
en: India’s comparative advantage lies in relatively skill-intensive services – such as information technology – which can absorb no more than a tiny slice of the country’s largely unskilled labor force.

zh: 印度的平均技术水平需要几十年才能提升到能显著提高经济整体生产率的程度。
en: It will take many decades for the average skill level in India to rise to the point that it can pull the economy’s overall productivity significantly higher.

zh: 因此印度的中期增长潜力远低于近几十年来的中国。
en: So India’s medium-term growth potential lies well below that of China in recent decades.

zh: 显著推动基础设施开支和政策改革可能会有所改变，但却不可能完全填补两国间的鸿沟。
en: A significant boost in infrastructure spending and policy reforms can make a difference, but it cannot close the gap.

zh: 另一方面，在发展竞赛中乌龟与兔子相比有着独到的优势。
en: On the other hand, being the tortoise rather than the hare in the growth race can be an advantage.

zh: 依赖稳定的技术积累和治理改善的国家可能不会发展得非常快，但却可能发展得更稳、不容易出现危机、更有可能最终跨入发达国家的行列。
en: Countries that rely on steady, economy-wide accumulation of skills and improved governance may not grow as fast, but they may be more stable, less prone to crises, and more likely to converge with advanced countries eventually.

zh: 中国取得的经济成就不可否认。
en: China’s economic achievements are undeniable.

zh: 但它依然是由共产党掌握政治垄断权的专制国家。
en: But it remains an authoritarian country where the Communist Party retains its political monopoly.

zh: 所以政治和体制转型的挑战远大于印度��中国的长期投资者面临的不确定性相对较高。
en: So the challenges of political and institutional transformation are immeasurably greater than in India. The uncertainty that confronts a long-term investor in China is correspondingly higher.

zh: 或者对比巴西与其他新兴市场。
en: Or compare Brazil with other emerging markets.

zh: 在这些国家中，可以说巴西近来遭受的打击最大。
en: Among these countries, Brazil has arguably taken the greatest hit recently.

zh: 围绕国有旗舰石油公司巴西石油（Petrobras）的腐败丑闻引发了一场经济危机，导致货币跳水，经济增长陷入停滞状态。
en: The corruption scandal surrounding the flagship state-owned oil company, Petrobras, has produced an economic crisis, with the currency tanking and growth grinding to a halt.

zh: 但巴西对政治危机的处理表明其国内民主日臻成熟，甚至可以说表现出一种力量而非软弱。
en: Yet Brazil’s political crisis demonstrates the country’s democratic maturity, and arguably is a sign of strength rather than weakness.

zh: 检察官有能力在不受政府政治干扰 — — 或确保不将调查过程演变为政治迫害的情况下深入巴西社会和政府的最高层级对支付违规行为展开调查。 巴西的这种能力甚至为许多发达国家树立了榜样。
en: The ability of prosecutors to investigate payment irregularities reaching into the highest ranks of Brazilian society and government without political interference – or the process turning into a witch hunt – would be exemplary in many advanced countries.

zh: 巴西与土耳其的对比极为引人注目。
en: The contrast with Turkey could not be more striking.

zh: 牵扯到总统埃尔多安及其家人的规模大得多的腐败都没有得到调查。
en: Corruption of a much greater magnitude there, implicating President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and his family, has gone untouched.

zh: 土耳其检察官2013年对埃尔多安的调查明显出于政治动机（背后的推动者是反对运动领导人法土拉·葛兰，埃尔多安自我流放的伊斯兰传教士对手 ） ， 而这给了政府所需的撤销调查的借口。
en: A probe by Turkish prosecutors against Erdoğan in 2013 was clearly politically motivated (and driven by Erdoğan’s foes in the movement headed by Fethullah Gülen, a self-exiled Islamic preacher), which gave the government the cover needed to quash the investigation.

zh: 土耳其经济并没有遭受像巴西那么大的损失，但腐败带来的长期破坏将更为显著。
en: Turkey’s economy has not suffered nearly as much as Brazil’s, but its rot will cause greater long-term damage.

zh: 廉价的外部融资、充足的资本流入和大宗商品繁荣掩盖了诸多这样的缺陷，推动新兴市场快速增长了15年。
en: Cheap external finance, plentiful capital inflows, and commodity booms helped hide many such shortcomings and fueled 15 years of emerging-market growth.

zh: 随着世界经济未来几年内所产生的较强阻力，真正强化经济政治基本面和依靠弄虚作假及浮躁的投资者情绪的国家将变得很容易区分。
en: As the world economy generates stronger headwinds in the years ahead, it will become easier to distinguish countries that have truly strengthened their economic and political fundamentals from those that have coasted on false narratives and the tenuous strength of fickle investor sentiment.

zh: 新兴市场货币暴动
en: The Emerging-Market Currency Rout

zh: 圣地亚哥—马来西亚、印度尼西亚、南非、土耳其、巴西、哥伦比亚、智利和墨西哥货币最近纷纷创出新低，全世界货币交易者都在问：新兴市场货币要跌到什么时候？
en: SANTIAGO – With the currencies of Malaysia, Indonesia, South Africa, Turkey, Brazil, Colombia, Chile, and Mexico hitting record lows recently, currency traders around the world are asking: How much further can emerging-market currencies weaken?

zh: 会的这一问题的标准方法是选取一个相对正常的基年，然后测量一国货币自该年以来贬值了多少。
en: The standard approach to answering this question takes a relatively normal base year and measures how much a country’s currency has depreciated since then.

zh: 然后将这个数字用该国及其贸易伙伴的通货膨胀差异进行调整。
en: That number is then adjusted for the inflation differential between the country and its trading partners.

zh: 如果由此得到的真实汇率与基年相去不远，那么就可以说市场位于均衡，不会产生多少后续贬值。
en: If the resulting real exchange rate is not too far from that of the base year, the market is said to be in equilibrium, and little or no further depreciation should be expected.

zh: 现在，考虑另一种方法。
en: Now consider an alternative method.

zh: 观察同一国的经常项目赤字，计算需要真实贬值多大幅度（需要做一些关于贸易弹性的假设）方能填补这一外部缺口。
en: Take the same country’s current-account deficit and ask how large a real depreciation is needed (making some assumptions about trade elasticities along the way) to close that external gap.

zh: 如果当前真实贬值已经达到这一阈值，那么就不会产生后续贬值。
en: If the recent real depreciation achieves that threshold, no further change in the exchange rate should be expected.

zh: 这些都是正确的答案，但问题错了。
en: These are the right answers, but to the wrong question.

zh: 从中期到长期，汇率实际上是由实体经济情况驱动的。
en: Over the medium to long term, exchange rates are indeed driven by what happens in the real economy.

zh: 或者，更准确地说，汇率反映了，要让经济同时实现外部平衡（小规模、可管理的经常项目赤字）和内部平衡（国内没有通胀压力 ） ， 真实汇率应该是多少。
en: Or, more precisely, they reflect the requirement that the real exchange rate be such that the economy attains both external balance (a small and manageable current-account deficit) and internal balance (no inflationary pressures at home).

zh: 但这要到冲击发生好几个月甚至多年后才会成为现实。
en: But that need not happen until many months – perhaps years – after a shock.

zh: 在短期，汇率完全由金融条件决定。
en: In the short run, exchange rates are driven by purely financial considerations.

zh: 因此，汇率很容易超调。
en: That is why they are prone to overshooting.

zh: 即使是微小的基本面变动也可能对汇率产生重大影响，导致远超长期调整需要的事先波动。
en: Even small changes in fundamentals can have large effects on exchange rates, with up-front movements that far exceed what long-run adjustment requires.

zh: 而如果国内企业存在大量外币债务，潜在波动将非常巨大，所有如今陷入压力的新兴经济体莫不如此。
en: And the potential for volatility is particularly great if domestic corporations have large foreign-currency debts, which is true in all of the emerging economies under stress today.

zh: 假象有一家拉丁美洲零售公司，它从海外借入美元在国内建造购物城。
en: Consider the case of a hypothetical Latin American retail company that borrowed abroad in dollars to build a shopping mall at home.

zh: 这笔借款需要抵押品 — — 在这个例子中是准备用于建造购物城的土地。
en: Such borrowing calls for collateral – in this case, the land on which construction will take place.

zh: 抵押品的价值越大（常常用本币衡量，或者，在智利Unidad de Fomento公司的案例中，用通胀指数单位衡量 ） ， 美元贷款的规模也越大。
en: The larger the value of the collateral, typically measured in domestic currency (or in an inflation-indexed unit, such as Chile’s Unidad de Fomento), the larger the size of the dollar loan.

zh: 再假设自然资源是该国最大出口项，其价格突然跳水（就像最近所发生的那样 ） 。
en: Next, suppose that the price of the natural resource that is the country’s largest export suddenly dips sharply (as has happened recently).

zh: 汇率（不管是名义值还是真实值）也将随之贬值，进入教科书上的标准调整过程。
en: The exchange rate (both nominal and real) will depreciate accordingly, thereby setting in motion the standard, textbook adjustment process.

zh: 但在这个例子中，还有一个非标准因素起作用。
en: But in this case, a second, non-standard factor comes into play.

zh: 贬值后，用美元衡量的抵押品价值下降了。
en: After the depreciation, the collateral, valued in dollars, is worth less.

zh: 贷款合同有可能无法维持，贷款人将开始要求借款人要么拿出新抵押品，要么去杠杆并偿还部分贷款。
en: Loan covenants have likely been broken, and lenders begin demanding that the borrower either put up new collateral or deleverage and repay part of the loan.

zh: 要偿还贷款，该企业必须买入美元。
en: To repay, the firm must purchase dollars.

zh: 如果存在大量美元债务，并且许多企业都陷入了这一状况，那么新增美元需求将推动汇率进一步贬值。
en: If there are large dollar debts outstanding, and many firms find themselves in the same position, the additional demand for dollars will cause the exchange rate to depreciate even further.

zh: 当然，抵押品的美元价值也会随之进一步下跌。
en: And that, of course, causes the dollar value of the collateral to fall yet again.

zh: 你可以看到这个故事的结局了。
en: You can see where this story is going.

zh: 这一过程会一直持续下去，直到本币失去相当大一部分价值。
en: The process plays out until the domestic currency has lost a good deal of its value.

zh: 不出几天或几周，汇率就有可能跌到比调整经常项目的需要更深的程度。
en: After a few days or weeks, the exchange rate is likely to be weaker than is warranted by the need to adjust the current account.

zh: 超调由大规模外币债务和金融（抵押品）约束的同时作用导致。
en: The overshooting is caused by the coexistence of sizeable foreign-currency debts and financial (collateral) constraints.

zh: 注意，如果在长期债务大幅减少，并且贸易条件冲击有所缓和，真实汇率就不需要贬值如此程度，最终甚至略有升值。
en: Notice that if in the long run the debt is reduced sufficiently, and the terms-of-trade shock abates somewhat, the real exchange rate need not depreciate that much, and may even end up appreciating a bit.

zh: 超调就好像打了类固醇：一开始本币急剧大幅贬值，然后反弹，最后，以经通胀调整的标准衡量的汇率可能比一开始更强。
en: This is overshooting on steroids: a very sharp initial loss of value for the domestic currency, followed by a gain that may leave the exchange rate, measured in inflation-adjusted terms, stronger than it was at the start.

zh: 唉，对许多新兴市场经济体来说，这是一个痛苦的现实情景。
en: For many emerging-market economies, this is, alas, a painfully realistic scenario.

zh: 自次贷危机以来，发达世界的极低利率导致新兴市场企业的借贷行为与以往发生了很大变化。
en: Since the subprime crisis, ultra-low interest rates in the rich world have caused emerging-market firms to borrow like never before.

zh: 一些债务甚至根本不出现在借款国的官方统计数字中，因为它们由本国企业通过离岸分支借入。
en: Some of the debt does not even appear in the official statistics of borrowing countries, because it was often taken on not by domestically-based firms, but by their offshore subsidiaries.

zh: 国际清算银行测算，美国之外的非银行借款人未偿还美元信用高达9万亿美元。
en: The Bank for International Settlements estimates outstanding dollar credit to non-bank borrowers outside the United States at $9 trillion.

zh: 大债务人包括一些最近货币承受贬值压力的国家：中国（1万亿美元 ） 、 巴西（超过3,000亿美元 ） 、 印度（1,250亿美元 ） ， 以及马来西亚、南非、土耳其和哥伦比亚、智利、秘鲁、墨西哥等拉美金融开放经济体。
en: Big debtors include some of those countries whose currencies have come under downward pressure recently: China ($1 trillion), Brazil (more than $300 billion), India ($125 billion), plus Malaysia, South Africa, Turkey, and Latin America’s financially open economies: Colombia, Chile, Peru, and Mexico.

zh: 中央银行可以干预货币市场，出售外汇储备，从而抵消外国贷款人融资撤出��影响。
en: Central banks can intervene in the currency markets and sell reserves, thereby offsetting the withdrawal of financing by foreign lenders.

zh: 但干预首先要求当局拥有储备，并愿意放弃（至少暂时放弃）它们不干涉浮动汇率的承诺。
en: But intervention requires that the authorities first have both the reserves and the will to abandon (at least temporarily) their hands-off commitment to a floating exchange rate.

zh: 并非所有新兴市场中央银行都符合这两个要求。
en: Not all emerging-market central banks are in a position to fulfill both of these requirements.

zh: 增长急剧放缓是这一超调模式的另一个因素。
en: A sharp growth slowdown is the other component of this overshooting adjustment pattern.

zh: 最初的出口冲击可能影响增长。
en: The initial export shock was likely to reduce growth.

zh: 外国债权人所要求的突然的去杠杆使经常项目平衡需要更深更快地调整。
en: The sudden deleveraging imposed by foreign creditors requires the current-account balance to adjust further and faster.

zh: 货币贬值带来的出口增加有所帮助，但常常姗姗来迟。
en: The additional exports triggered by the depreciated currency can help, but they are often slow in coming.

zh: 更快的调整方式是通过降低需求和进口，这也是几乎每一次都最终发生的事。
en: The fastest way to adjust is via reduced demand and imports, and that is what almost always ends up happening.

zh: 增长和就业创造遭受打击，这就是现在我们在全球新兴市场经济体所看到的。
en: Growth and job creation take the hit, as we are seeing today in emerging market economies around the world.

zh: 在这样的环境下，货币交易者遭遇打击。
en: In these circumstances, currency traders suffer.

zh: 但中等收入债务国公民可能遭遇更大的打击。
en: But citizens of indebted middle-income countries are likely to suffer far more.

zh: 如今，新兴市场动荡已是既成事实，而他们是真正的受害者。
en: Today’s emerging-market turmoil is here to stay, and they are the true victims.

zh: 新兴市场的欧洲问题
en: Emerging Markets’ Europe Problem

zh: 巴黎 — — 从香港到圣保罗，以及中间的所有地区，所有大投资商都在谈论一个词：希腊。
en: PARIS – From Hong Kong to São Paulo, and all points between, one word dominates all others among big investors: Greece.

zh: 希腊人会不会留在欧元区？
en: Will the Greeks remain in the eurozone?

zh: 如果他们选择退出，欧盟和全球经济将向何处去？
en: What will happen to the European Union and the global economy if they do not?

zh: 直到不久前，欧洲还是主要新兴经济体证实自身骄人成就的一面镜子。
en: Until recently, Europe was a sort of mirror that confirmed for the major emerging economies the spectacular nature of their own success.

zh: 他们可以用自身的高增长与欧洲的高债务尽情的对比。
en: They could contrast their high growth rates with Europe’s high levels of debt.

zh: 他们可以对比自身的“积极活力”和主宰欧洲人思想的悲观情绪。
en: They could oppose their “positive energy” with the pessimism dominating European minds.

zh: 他们洋洋得意地建议欧洲努力工作、节约开支，因为合情合理的骄傲中掺杂着可以理解的清算历史欠账、借以减轻他们曾经接受殖民的痛苦和屈辱的情绪。
en: They were only too willing to advise Europe to work harder and spend less, as legitimate pride mingled with an understandable desire to settle historical scores and attenuate their legacies of colonial submission and humiliation.

zh: 但今天，新兴国家越来越忧虑欧洲过度疲软对其各自经济的严重威胁，他们的这种担忧不无道理，因为欧洲仍然领导着世界贸易。
en: But, today, emerging countries are growing very concerned with what they rightly perceive as the serious risks to their own economies implied by excessive weakness in Europe, which remains the world’s trade leader.

zh: 此外，鉴于现有制度的合法性和延续快速经济增长之间的紧密关系，欧洲经济的萎靡不振甚至威胁到上述很多国家、特别是中国的政治稳定。
en: Moreover, Europe’s malaise threatens many of these countries’ political stability as well, given the close connection – especially in China – between the legitimacy of existing arrangements and the continuation of rapid economic growth.

zh: 如果欧洲危机导致中国的全年GDP增长低于7 ％ 、 印度低于5 % 、 巴西低于3 % ， 这些新兴国家最弱势的民众将会受到最沉重的打击。
en: If the crisis in Europe were to cause annual GDP growth to fall below 7% in China, 5% in India, and 3% in Brazil, these countries’ most vulnerable citizens would be hardest hit.

zh: 在这些国家的成功中曾经发挥重要作用的“希望文化”在很大程度上以物质成功为基础 ， “ 希望文化”从来未曾真正属于这些弱势民众。
en: They were never part of the “culture of hope,” based largely on material success, that played a key role in these countries’ success. If social inequalities were to reach new heights, their frustration and resentment could manifest itself fully.

zh: 鉴于这种情况，欧洲可能突然成为新兴国家一面完全不同的镜子，暴露出他们自身存在的结构性缺陷，甚至导致这些缺陷进一步加剧。
en: In that case, Europe could suddenly become a very different mirror for emerging countries, revealing, if not accentuating, their own structural weaknesses.

zh: 正如欧洲必须不惜一切代价挽救希腊经济或西班牙银行系统，新兴国家也出于同样原因必须尽一切可能为挽救欧洲经济出力。
en: And that is why, just as Europe must save the Greek economy or Spain’s banks at all costs, emerging countries must do whatever they can to contribute to the rescue of the European economy.

zh: 欧洲的教训告诉我们，等待时间越长，成本越高 — — 而成功的机会越低。
en: As Europe has learned, the longer one waits, the higher the cost – and the lower the chance of success.

zh: 然而不幸的是，由同样拒绝全球责任的国家联合组成的团体不太可能这样思考问题。
en: Unfortunately, a group of countries that are united above all by a common denial of their global responsibilities is unlikely to reach such a conclusion.

zh: 事实上，多数新兴市场国家面对为欧洲提供金融援助的提议望而生畏有以下几种原因。
en: Indeed, most emerging countries would balk at the idea of coming to Europe’s financial rescue for several reasons.

zh: 首先，目前还不存在新兴国家集团这样的组织。
en: First, there is no such thing as a bloc of emerging countries.

zh: 即没有共同的愿景或共同的政治理想（类似于西方的民主制度）将他们团结在一起。
en: They are not united by a common vision of their future, or by a common political ideal, such as democracy in the Western world.

zh: 无论共同价值观有多少矛盾或局限性，忽视其重要性都将犯下幼稚的错误。
en: Whatever the limits or contradictions of shared values, it would be naive to dismiss their importance.

zh: 即使奥巴马像法国的尼古拉斯·萨科齐那样只担任一届总统，欧洲和美国仍将继续是盟友。
en: Europe and the United States will remain allies even if Barack Obama, like Nicolas Sarkozy in France, turns out to be a one-term president.

zh: 其次，新兴国家与其说是欧洲的伙伴还不如说是对手。
en: Second, emerging countries are more Europe’s rivals than its partners.

zh: 对中国的怀疑是他们唯一的共同之处。
en: They are united only by their shared suspicion of China.

zh: 鉴于这种情况，极难想象他们能制定统一的长期战略。
en: In such a context, a common long-term strategy is extremely difficult to conceive.

zh: 正如一位著名的中国国际关系专家所说，中国人可能认为他们思考问题比美国更“长远 ” ， 而美国思考问题更“广泛 ” ， 欧洲则更“深入 ” 。
en: The Chinese may proclaim that they tend to think over a “longer” term than Americans, who think more “broadly,” and Europeans, who think more “deeply,” as a well-known Chinese international relations expert has put it.

zh: 但是当面对欧洲的金融危机时，即使中国2011年对欧洲的投资达到之前的三倍，但短期的战术考量似乎是决定中国所作所为的唯一因素。
en: But, when it comes to the European financial crisis, China’s behavior seems to be determined by purely short-term tactical considerations, even as Chinese investments in Europe tripled in 2011.

zh: 以低廉的价格购买一半的比雷埃夫斯港与其说是从长远角度投资希腊的经济和金融，还不如说是趁火打劫占取便宜。 但实际情况是否真的如此？
en: To buy half of the Piraeus harbor at a knockdown price may seem more advantageous than investing in the long-term consolidation of the Greek economy and its finances, but is that really the case?

zh: 其三，新兴国家的短期机会主义是基于所谓的双重不信任：其中当然有不信任欧洲，但荒谬的是同样有不信任他们自己。
en: Third, emerging countries’ short-term opportunism is based on a double distrust: towards Europe, of course, but also, paradoxically, towards themselves.

zh: 也就是说，他们不相信自己能完成拯救欧洲这个全球经济病夫的任务。
en: That is, they lack confidence in their ability to do their part to save the sick man of the global economy that Europe has become.

zh: 可以肯定，这与亚洲散发的必胜信念尤其背道而驰。
en: To be sure, this runs counter to the triumphalism emanating from Asia, in particular.

zh: 新加坡权威外交政策思想家马凯硕不久前刚在我院在维也纳组织的一次会议上宣布下世纪将是属于亚洲的世纪。
en: Kishore Mahbubani, a leading foreign-policy thinker from Singapore, recently proclaimed in Vienna, at a conference organized by my institute, that the next millennium would be Asian.

zh: 但可以感觉到新兴国家精英阶层内心隐藏着挥之不去的疑问，而这些在欧洲危机中只能是进一步加剧而已。
en: And yet one senses among elites from emerging countries something akin to existential doubt, which the European crisis has served to reinforce.

zh: 这种不安全感表现在诸多方面：当很多人，甚至是大多数人会选择让子女到国外接受教育的情况下，他们却忙于积累流动性财富来对抗国内外不确定局势。
en: This insecurity manifests itself in many ways: from the accumulation of liquid wealth as insurance against foreign and domestic uncertainties to the choice of many, if not most, to educate their children abroad.

zh: 无可否认，欧洲甚至是西方病夫可能有着很强的恢复能力，而这来源于其民主和法治的天然防御力量。
en: In fact, the sick man – undeniably European, if not Western – could reveal himself to be more resilient, owing to the strength of his own natural defenses: democracy and the rule of law.

zh: 这也是为什么当前的欧洲危机可能被证明是对新兴国家的一次关键的考验，他们在经济活力上胜于欧洲，但在政治上却远比欧洲更加脆弱。
en: That is why the current European crisis may well prove to be a crucial test for emerging countries that are more dynamic than Europe economically, but ultimately more fragile politically.

zh: 新兴市场大泡沫
en: The Great Emerging-Market Bubble

zh: 伦敦—人们认为将会影响甚至主导世界未来的新兴经济体发生了非常严重的问题。
en: LONDON – Something has gone badly wrong in the emerging economies that were supposed to be shaping, even dominating, the future of the world.

zh: 目前正在寻找罪魁：大宗商品价格、液压致裂法、美国利率、厄尔尼诺、中国都是热门。
en: The search for culprits is under way: commodity prices, fracking, US interest rates, El Nino, China, these and others lead the field.

zh: 但答案其实更加简单，也更加传统，那就是政治。
en: But the answer is simpler and more traditional. It is politics.

zh: 以巴西为例。
en: Look at Brazil.

zh: 这个曾经似乎已经走上永续繁荣的经济体两年多来现有增长，目前更是陷入了衰退。
en: There an economy once tipped for ever-lasting boom has barely grown for more than two years, and is currently shrinking.

zh: 大宗商品出口价格的下跌绝非福音，但巴西经济应该绝不仅限于收成和炼制产业。
en: Falling prices for its commodity exports haven’t helped, but Brazil’s economy was supposed to be about far more than just harvests and extractive industries.

zh: 再看看印度尼西亚。
en: Or look at Indonesia.

zh: 印尼经济仍在扩张，但增长率 — — 上季度年化增长率4.7 % — —与此前的预期和人口增长率相比相当令人失望。
en: That economy is still expanding, but at a rate – 4.7% annually in the latest quarter – that is disappointing in terms both of previous expectations and of population growth.

zh: 土耳其也是如此，上季度增长率下降至2.3 % — —总算胜过了人口增长率，但与2010年和2011年的突飞猛进（增长率高达9 % ） 相比显得相当疲软。
en: The same can be said of Turkey, where growth has sagged to 2.3% in the latest quarter – which at least beats population growth but is meager compared with the country’s go-go years of 2010 and 2011, when it expanded by 9%.

zh: 南非亦然，其经济进步一直过于缓慢，不管是在黄金和其他资源的繁荣期还是萧条期，减贫方面也几无进展。
en: Or South Africa, where economic progress has constantly been too slow, whether in boom years for gold and other resources or busts, to make any real dent in poverty levels.

zh: 还有中国本身，它的减速是其他所有人用来解释自身迟滞的最佳借口。
en: Then there is China itself, whose slowdown is everybody else’s favorite explanation for their own sluggishness.

zh: 中国的私人经济学家又回到了过去他们最喜欢的经济压力期，也就是推算自己的GDP增长指标而不信任官方统计数字的时期。
en: There, private economists are back enjoying their favorite pastime during periods of economic stress, namely trying to construct their own indices for GDP growth as at such times they do not believe the official statistics.

zh: 从官方数据看，中国增长仍保持在稳健的7 % ， 也就是政府宣布的增长目标，但私人经济学家的测算大多在4—6 % 。
en: Officially, Chinese growth is rock-steady at 7% per year, which happens to be the government’s declared target, but private economists’ estimates mostly range between 4% and 6%.

zh: 近几年来有个魔咒，即，不管全球经济增、大宗商品或金融市场长发生什么扭曲或转折 ， “ 新兴市场的故事总能岿然不动。
en: One mantra of recent years has been that, whatever the twists and turns of global economic growth, of commodities or of financial markets, “the emerging-economy story remains intact.”

zh: ”公司董事会和投资策略师这样说的意思是他们仍然相信新兴经济体必然比发达世界增长快得多，在进口科技和管理的同时出口商品和服务，从而获得低工资和生产率提高的胜利组合。
en: By this, corporate boards and investment strategists mean that they still believe that emerging economies are destined to grow a lot faster than the developed world, importing technology and management techniques while exporting goods and services, thereby exploiting a winning combination of low wages and rising productivity.

zh: 但是，这个魔咒有个问题。 一个简单的事实是，顾名思义，这一魔咒定义太一般，难以覆盖全部亚洲、拉美、非洲和东欧的各种类型的经济体。
en: There is, however, a problem with this mantra, beyond the simple fact that it must by definition be too general to cover such a wide range of economies in Asia, Latin America, Africa, and Eastern Europe.

zh: 如果如“新兴市场故事”观点所隐含的那样，趋同和赶超只是一个逻辑和宿命的问题，那么这一逻辑应该也适用于发展中国家增长开始吸引人们眼球之前的几十年。
en: It is that if convergence and outperformance were merely a matter of logic and destiny, as the idea of an “emerging-economy story” implies, then that logic ought also to have applied during the decades before developing-country growth started to catch the eye.

zh: 但并非如此。
en: But it didn’t.

zh: 之所以并非如此，其原因与如此多的新兴经济体现在陷入了麻烦的原因相同。
en: The reason why it didn’t is the same reason why so many emerging economies are having trouble now. It is that the main determinants of an emerging-economy’s ability actually to emerge, sustainably, are politics, policy and all that is meant by the institutions of governance.

zh: 这一原因是，新兴经济体的实际持续兴起的主要决定因素是政治、政策和由治理制度决定的一切。
en: More precisely, although countries can ride waves of growth and exploit commodity cycles despite having dysfunctional political institutions, the real test comes when times turn less favorable and a country needs to change course.

zh: 这就是巴西在令人失望的四年中所存在的难点。
en: That is what Brazil has been finding so difficult for the past four disappointing years.

zh: 巴西无法在不引起衰退的情况下控制通货膨胀，其自2010年以来的颓势并不是因为运气不好或私人部门企业家精神流失，而是因为政治失败。
en: Unable to keep inflation under control without causing a recession, the country has, since 2010, got stuck not because of bad luck, or any loss of entrepreneurial spirit in its private sector, but because of political failings.

zh: 巴西政府一直不愿或无法裁减臃肿的公共部门、深陷各种腐败丑闻，而其总统罗塞夫一直表现出对导致这些问题出现的国家领导资本主义情有独钟。
en: Brazil’s government has been unwilling or unable to cut back its bloated public sector, has been mired in vast corruption scandals, and yet its president Dilma Rousseff continues to evince a fondness for just the sort of state-led capitalism that leads to exactly these problems.

zh: 巴西、印尼、土耳其和南非等民主国家都没有能做好任何政治制度的基本任务：平稳协调互相竞争的利益集团和权力派系以使更最广泛的公共利益最终胜出。
en: The democracies of Brazil, Indonesia, Turkey, and South Africa are all currently failing to perform what is a basic task for any political system: to mediate smoothly between competing interest groups and power blocs in order to permit a broader public interest to prevail.

zh: 这本质上意味着公共利益：让经济灵活演化，从而让资源从无法盈利的用途流向潜力更大的用途。
en: By that is meant essentially a public interest in allowing the economy to evolve flexibly, so that resources move from uses that have become unprofitable to ones that have a higher potential.

zh: 一个拥塞的经济，一个无法发生创造性破坏和适应新环境的经济是无法持续低增长的。
en: A clogged up economy, one that does not permit such creative destruction and adaptation to new circumstances, is one that will not grow sustainably.

zh: 这是民主国家，特别是法治制度和言论自由脆弱的不成熟民主国家与极权体制相比的天然劣势吗？
en: Is this something that democracies, especially immature ones with fragile institutions of the rule of law and freedom of speech, are simply bad at, when compared with authoritarian regimes?

zh: 显然，这些步履蹒跚的经济体所犯的一个错误是没有向新加坡学习。 新加坡采取有管理的民主制度，今年迎来建国50周年，它成功地避免了掣肘（比如）巴西的利益集团硬化症和腐败。
en: Certainly, what these stumbling economies are guilty of is a failure to learn from Singapore, a system whose managed democracy is celebrating its 50th anniversary this year, and which has successfully avoided the sort of interest-group sclerosis and corruption that is holding back Brazil, for example.

zh: 也许对民主派来说，一个福音是最近中国也没有学习新加坡的经验。
en: One comfort, perhaps, for the democrats is that right now China is failing to learn the Singaporean lesson, too.

zh: 中国经济最近的减速似乎是因为中共没能解决国有企业权力垄断、向民营企业自由开放新部门的问题。
en: Its current slowdown appears to arise from a failure by the Communist Party to challenge the monopoly powers of state-owned enterprises and to free up new sectors for private enterprise.

zh: 这些都不重要。
en: No matter.

zh: 这不是一个民主和极权谁更好的问题。
en: It is not a question of whether democracy or authoritarianism is best.

zh: 其本质是，除非新兴经济体能保证灵活性和适应力，否则它们无法继续“新兴 ” 。
en: The bottom line is that unless emerging economies can ensure that they remain flexible and adaptable, they will not continue to “emerge.”

zh: 而这一灵活性和适应力的决定因素在于政治制度以及它们挑战利益集团、协调社会冲突、维护法治的意愿。
en: And the determinant of that flexibility and ability to adapt lies in political institutions and their willingness to challenge interest groups, mediate social conflicts, and maintain the rule of law.

zh: 重要的是政治，笨蛋。
en: It’s the politics, stupid.

zh: 马克龙能否重绘政治版图？
en: Can Macron Redraw the Political Map?

zh: 华盛顿 — — 许多评论家将伊曼纽尔·马克龙在法国总统大选中的获胜描述成中右翼势力的获胜，因为如果没有他，这些选票将会投给丑闻缠身的主流保守派候选人弗朗索瓦·菲永。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Many commentators have described Emmanuel Macron’s victory in the French presidential election as a triumph for the center right, because he received votes that otherwise would have gone to the scandal-plagued mainstream conservative candidate, François Fillon.

zh: 但这样的选举平衡并没有抓住马克龙胜利的真意。
en: But this electoral dynamic does not capture the meaning of Macron’s victory.

zh: 更准确的说，马克龙击碎了传统的党派划分，他所代表的选民相信通过恰当的管理和全新的技术，欧洲一体化和全球化可以带来能被人们广泛共享的利益。
en: It would be more accurate to say that Macron cut through traditional party divides and stood as a candidate for those who believe that, with proper management and new technologies, European integration and the forces of globalization can deliver widely shared benefits.

zh: 相比之下，绝大多数马克龙的竞争对手只是挑起人们对当今经济现实的恐惧。
en: By contrast, most of Macron’s opponents simply stoked fears about today’s economic realities.

zh: 让我们来看看首轮法国总统大选的以下统计数据：42%的马克龙支持者过去曾同情社会党，还有36%的支持者倾向于支持中间势力。
en: Consider the following statistics from the French presidential election’s first round: 42% of Macron’s supporters have in the past sympathized with the Socialist Party; and another 36% have tended to support centrists.

zh: 这些数据表明左翼和中间派选民构成了马克龙支持基础的绝大部分，而且他们将马克龙视为中左翼、而非中右翼候选者。
en: These data indicate that voters on the left and in the center constitute the bulk of Macron’s support base, and that they regarded him as a center-left, rather than a center-right, candidate.

zh: 事实上，马克龙出身于现代、赞成全球化的中左翼。
en: Indeed, Macron hails from the modern, pro-globalization center left.

zh: 他不久前曾担任法国总统弗朗索瓦·奥朗德的政府成员；而且在其职业生涯早期，前社会党总理米歇尔·罗卡德曾是他的指导者。
en: He was most recently a member of former French President François Hollande’s government; and, earlier in his career, his mentor was former Socialist Prime Minister Michel Rocard.

zh: 但即便马克龙没有与自己的政治历史切割得干干净净，但他通过向不同政治阶层的选民伸出援手而成功打破了传统党派和政治身份的障碍，唯一例外的只有极左翼和极右翼选民。
en: But even if Macron did not make a clean break with his political past, he broke through traditional party and political-identity barriers, by reaching out to voters across the political spectrum, except for those on the extreme left and extreme right.

zh: 如果说有什么不同，将马克龙强行挤进传统法国政治样板的诸多尝试表明人们迫切需要对欧洲和全球政治进行重塑，以便能够解释新的论据、说法和裂痕。
en: If anything, the many attempts to squeeze Macron into a traditional French political archetype show that European and global politics desperately need to be reframed to account for new arguments, narratives, and fault lines.

zh: 选举刚刚结束，马克龙成立的过渡政府在性别和政治经历及党派隶属方面都显示出巨大的多样性。
en: The transitional government that Macron formed just after the election reflects great diversity, not only in terms of gender, but also with respect to political experience and affiliation.

zh: 马克龙的内阁吸收了中间派、左翼和右翼党派分子，社会党和绿党分子均被涵盖其中。
en: Macron’s cabinet draws from centrist, leftist, and right-leaning parties, including the Socialists and Greens.

zh: 但他对布鲁诺·勒耶尔和格拉尔德·达尔马宁等中右翼共和党人的任命尤其重要，因为投票数据显示马克龙的观点在右倾选民间引起了最少的共鸣。
en: But his appointment of center-right Republicans such as Bruno Le Maire and Gérald Darmanin is of particular importance, because polling data indicate that Macron’s message resonated the least with right-leaning voters.

zh: 此外，通过任命同是共和党人的艾杜瓦·菲利普担任总理，马克龙将改革法国政治的承诺付诸实行。
en: Moreover, by appointing Édouard Philippe, also of the Republicans, as his prime minister, Macron firmed up his commitment to transforming French politics.

zh: 他的政府从第一天起就将覆盖所有政治范畴。
en: His government will span the political spectrum from day one.

zh: 凭借这样多样化的政治代表性，马克龙可以强化其所在政党共和国前进党！ 在本月举行的国民议会选举中的获胜前景。
en: And with such diverse political representation, Macron could bolster the prospects of his own party, La République En Marche !, in the National Assembly election this month.

zh: 强势表现将大大提高其兑现关键竞选承诺的可能性。
en: A strong showing would significantly improve his chances of fulfilling key campaign promises.

zh: 作为一名深刻了解全球经济运行规律的社会自由决策者，马克龙可能成为各地进步人士苦苦寻找的领导人。
en: As a social-liberal policymaker with a good understanding of how the global economy works, Macron could become what progressives everywhere have been looking for.

zh: 要想做到这一点，他必须制定新的社会契约，面对灵活开放的21世纪经济不可避免的快速变化和突然破坏为最弱势群体提供保护。
en: To do that, he will have to forge a new social contract that protects the most vulnerable from the rapid shifts and abrupt disruptions inherent in a flexible, open twenty-first-century economy.

zh: 这无疑是一项巨大的挑战。
en: This is undoubtedly a huge challenge.

zh: 但如果马克龙取得成功，改革派长期坚持的“现代”观将在他手上得以实现。
en: But if Macron succeeds, he will have delivered on reformists’ long-held idea of “modernity.”

zh: 21世纪新法国社会契约必须以三大支柱为基础，首先是强有力的社会保障政策，上述政策将使经济更有活力，劳动力市场更加灵活。
en: A new French social contract for the twenty-first century must rest on three pillars, starting with strong social-security policies, which will allow for improved labor-market flexibility and greater economic dynamism.

zh: 举例而言，如果考虑到今天流动工人不断增加，法国的现行体制效率必须得到大幅提升。
en: For example, France’s current system would be much more efficient if it accounted for today’s increasingly mobile workers.

zh: 法国民众均将受益于追随其一生的更多便携版社会保障措施，无论他们是在寻找新的工作、接受教育还是接受再培训。
en: French citizens would all benefit from more portable social-protection measures that follow them throughout their lives, whether they are pursuing new jobs or education and retraining opportunities.

zh: 第二根支柱是促进技术推广和创新及鼓励企业家精神的工业体系，从而使新加入者能够与各行各业的现有公司竞争。
en: The second pillar is an industrial system that fosters technological diffusion and innovation, and encourages entrepreneurship, so that new entrants can compete with incumbent firms across all sectors.

zh: 而且，最终，任何新社会契约都必须坚定不移地致力于经济开放、欧洲一体化和全球化进程。
en: And, finally, any new social contract must maintain a firm commitment to economic openness, European integration, and globalization.

zh: 大选首轮马克龙的投票者 — — 当时法国大选还有其他许多候选人 — — 相信这三根支柱不仅可以同时存在，而且可以相互支撑。
en: Those who voted for Macron in the first round of the election – when the field was still crowded with other candidates – believe that these three pillars are not just compatible, but mutually reinforcing.

zh: 尽管左翼候选人传统上只关注社会团结 — — 有时甚至因此而拒绝欧洲一体化 — — 马克龙已经承诺同时坚持社会公平、增长和开放的原则。
en: Whereas candidates on the left have traditionally focused only on social solidarity – sometimes to the point of rejecting European integration – Macron has promised to stand simultaneously for social justice, growth, and openness.

zh: 而且他对中右翼人士承诺随着社会政策的改革，法国也将拥有更多创新和市场灵活性。
en: And for those on the center right, he has promised that, with reformed social policies, France can also have more market flexibility and innovation.

zh: 通过制定新的社会契约，马克龙可以重绘法国政治版图。
en: By developing a new social contract, Macron could redraw the French political map.

zh: 当前，法国实际上已经陷入“双重保守主义 ” ， 右翼保守分子宣扬削弱社会政策提高竞争力，而左翼“保守分子”则坚持现行制度根本无法改革。
en: Right now, France is essentially stuck with “double conservatism,” whereby conservatives on the right argue for weaker social policies as a means to improve competitiveness, while “conservatives” on the left argue that that the existing system simply cannot be reformed.

zh: 在马克龙领导下，将逐步建立起一套以社会政策和自由为基础的全新进步政治制度。
en: Under Macron, a new progressive political system that is based on a synthesis of social policies and liberalization could gradually emerge.

zh: 不仅如此，马克龙不会在欧洲问题上单纯防守。
en: Moreover, Macron will not be playing defense with respect to Europe.

zh: 他已经对欧洲计划作出了全面的承诺，而且法国民众中的很大部分似乎支持他。
en: He has made his full commitment to the European project well known, and an important section of the French population seems to be standing with him.

zh: 与竞选中众多对手不同，马克龙并未将欧洲视为问题的来源，而是将其视为解决之道。
en: Unlike many of his opponents in the election, Macron sees Europe as a source of solutions, not problems.

zh: 马克龙总统任期的成功代表在利用欧盟吸引力规模、集合风险及其在全球事务中的影响力将欧洲打造成人类进步引擎方面迈出了重要的一步。
en: A successful Macron presidency would represent a step forward in using the EU’s attractive scale, pooled risk, and greater influence in global affairs to turn Europe into an engine of human progress.

zh: 由法国及其总统来扮演这样的角色非常适合。
en: That is a fitting role for France and its president.

zh: 零工经济中的劳动者保护
en: Worker Protection in the Gig Economy

zh: 伯克利 — — 随着数字平台改变劳动力市场运作并彻底改变工作性质，如今的劳动力市场正在发生根本性的转变。
en: BERKELEY – Today’s labor markets are undergoing radical change, as digital platforms transform how they operate and revolutionize the nature of work.

zh: 在很多方面这都堪称一种积极的变化，具备比以往任何时候都更有效、更透明地匹配岗位和劳动者的潜能。
en: In many ways, this is a positive development, one that has the potential to match workers with jobs more efficiently and transparently than ever before.

zh: 但劳动力市场的日益数字化至少也有一个令人担忧的缺点：它破坏了一直作为员工福利和保护主要提供渠道的传统的雇主和雇员关系。
en: But the increasing digitization of the labor market also has at least one very worrying drawback: it is undermining the traditional employer-employee relationships that have been the primary channel through which worker benefits and protections have been provided.

zh: 数字劳动力平台生态系统仍处于起步阶段，但其发展非常迅速。
en: The ecosystem of digital labor platforms is still in its infancy, but it is developing rapidly.

zh: 广受欢迎的大型平台，比方说LinkedIn，迄今为止主要被用于高技能劳动者和高端岗位的匹配工作。
en: Large popular platforms like LinkedIn have so far mainly been used to match high-skill workers with high-end jobs.

zh: 但上述平台已经开始扩展到中等技术劳动者和工作。
en: But these platforms are already expanding to accommodate middle-skill workers and jobs.

zh: 近4亿人已经在LinkedIn上发布了自己的简历，2014年该网站在世界各地促成了一百多万次新的雇佣。
en: Nearly 400 million people have posted their resumes on LinkedIn, and in 2014 the site facilitated more than one million new hires worldwide.

zh: 同时，其他类型的数字平台不断涌现，联系着劳动者与客户或企业的特定任务或服务。
en: Meanwhile, other types of digital platforms are emerging, linking workers with customers or companies for specific tasks or services.

zh: 上述平台在“临时”或“按需”劳动力市场发挥的作用越来越大，上述市场被广泛定义为临时工市场或未与雇主签订标准兼职或全职合同的工作岗位。
en: Such platforms play a growing role in the market for “contingent” or “on-demand” workers, broadly defined as workers whose jobs are temporary and who do not have standard part-time or full-time contracts with employers.

zh: 直接在临时工与客户间建立联系的知名数码平台包括Lyft、TaskRabbit、Uber和Angie’s List。
en: Well-known digital platforms that link contingent workers directly to customers include Lyft, TaskRabbit, Uber, and Angie’s List.

zh: Freelancer.com和Upwork是帮助企业寻找聘用一系列专项任务临时工的平台，比方说软件或网站开发。
en: Freelancer.com and Upwork are examples of platforms that help companies find and hire contingent workers for a range of specialized tasks such as software or website development.

zh: Freelancer.com在全球拥有超过1，700万用户。
en: Freelancer.com has more than 17 million users worldwide.

zh: 麻烦的是这些网站在为劳动者和企业提供新机会的同时，绕过了美国和许多国家为劳动者提供福利和保护的传统渠道。
en: The trouble is that even as these sites provide new opportunities for workers and companies, they are bypassing the traditional channels through which the US and many countries deliver benefits and protections to their workforce.

zh: 尤其是美国 ， “ 社会合同”长期依赖雇主按《公平劳动标准法》的规定提供失业险、残疾险、养老金和退休计划、与工作相关的工伤赔偿、带薪休假和其他各项保护。
en: In the US, in particular, the “social contract” has long relied on employers to deliver unemployment insurance, disability insurance, pensions and retirement plans, worker’s compensation for job-related injuries, paid time off, and protections under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

zh: 虽然《平价医疗法》使劳动者更容易凭自身力量获得医疗保险，但多数劳动者的健康险仍然通过雇主获得。
en: Although the Affordable Care Act has made it easier for workers to acquire health insurance on their own, most workers continue to receive health insurance through their employers.

zh: 随着数字化工作平台的影响力不断扩大，美国劳动力本已摇摇欲坠的社会安全网对越来越多的劳动力而言正在四分五裂。
en: With the proliferation of digital job platforms, the social safety net for workers in the US – threadbare to begin with – is at risk of unraveling for a growing share of the workforce.

zh: 原因在于通过数字就业平台找工作的多数个人是以独立承包商的身份，致使他们享受不到全职和兼职员工标准雇佣合同规定的福利和保护。
en: This is because most individuals who find work through digital job platforms operate as independent contractors, leaving them without the benefits and protections provided in standard employment contracts for full-time and part-time workers.

zh: 一名享受福利的全职员工和独立承包商的成本差距可以达到30%或以上，因此只要能吸引到他们所需的人才，企业具有强烈的动机用独立承包商取代通过标准全职合同聘用的劳动者。
en: The difference between the cost of a full-time employee with benefits and an independent contractor can be 30% or more, so there is a strong incentive for companies to replace workers on standard full-time employment contracts with independent contractors as long as companies can attract the talent they need.

zh: 数字就业平台也方便了企业通过临时意外合同雇佣和解雇劳动者。
en: Digital job platforms also make it easier for businesses to hire and fire workers on temporary contingent contracts.

zh: 这营造了一种竞相杀价的氛围，导致雇主通过监管套利等方式在劳动力成本方面展开竞争。
en: This creates the potential for a race to the bottom, with employers competing on labor costs through regulatory arbitrage.

zh: 除非决策者采取行动，否则美国将继续滑向劳动力市场的两极。
en: Unless policymakers act, the US will continue to drift toward a two-tier labor market.

zh: 其中一极是享受雇主慷慨福利（并拥有税收优惠）的高技术全职员工和以独立承包商或自雇形式赚取高收入负担个人福利的高技术群体，而另一极则是大量临时雇佣、对强大而有活力的中产阶级所依赖的福利、收入及安全可望而不可及的中低技术劳动者。
en: One tier will be populated by fully employed high-skill workers with generous employer-provided (and tax-advantaged) benefits, as well as high-skill individuals who finance their own benefits from high incomes earned as independent contractors or from self-employment. The other tier will include a large pool of contingent middle- and low-skill workers without the benefits, income, or security on which a robust and resilient middle class depends.

zh: 需要制定新政策为临时受雇者发放福利，并需要建立新制度来落实上述政策。
en: New policies are needed to provide workers in contingent employment relationships access to benefits, and new institutions are needed to deliver them.

zh: 越来越多人支持福利应满足三个条件：即可以随身携带、归属于职工个人而非雇主及具有普遍性，适用于所有劳动者和一切形式的雇佣。
en: There is growing support for the view that benefits should satisfy at least three conditions. They should be portable, attached to individual workers rather than to their employers.

zh: 福利应当按比例分配，将雇主所应负担的福利与劳动时间、工作量或赚取的收入挂钩。
en: They should be universal, applying to all workers and all forms of employment. And they should be pro-rated, linking employer benefit contributions to time worked, jobs completed, or income earned.

zh: 包含上述条件的两份近期提案呼吁设立与美国社会安全账户类似的 “个人安全账户”  ，包括适用于所有劳动力且与就业状况无关的便携式福利，并通过按比例自动工资拨付的形式累积到个人账户。
en: Two recent proposals incorporating these conditions call for the creation of “individual security accounts” analogous to US Social Security accounts, but encompassing portable benefits that would be available to all workers, regardless of employment status, and would accrue via pro-rated automatic payroll contributions.

zh: 一个奇怪的同盟者群体 — — “零工”雇主、劳动组织、风险投资家和两党智库 — — 不久前发表了一封信，呼吁要在上述条件下建立稳定灵活的安全网络。
en: A group of strange bedfellows – “gig” employers, labor organizations, venture capitalists, and bipartisan think tanks – recently issued a letter calling for a stable and flexible safety net based on these conditions.

zh: 此外在美国国会，弗吉尼亚州参议员马克·沃纳等具有前瞻性眼光的决策者正在寻找问题的解决办法，为两党合作创造良好的势头。
en: Meanwhile, in Congress, forward-looking policymakers like Senator Mark Warner of Virginia are seeking ways to get ahead of the issues and create momentum for bipartisan solutions.

zh: 为所有劳动者建成新型安全网络之前还有很多工作要做：确定涵盖哪些福利和保护、如何支付以及如何发放到劳动者手中。
en: Much remains to be done before a new safety net for all workers is in place: determining which benefits and protections to include, how to pay for them, and how to deliver them to workers.

zh: 工会或像Coworker.org及自由职业者联盟这样的新型劳工机构可以填补空白，像建筑业工会和娱乐业公会那样为从业者提供福利和保护。
en: Labor groups, including unions or new types of labor organizations like Coworker.org and the Freelancers Union, could fill the gap, providing benefits as unions have done in the construction industry and guilds have done in the entertainment industry.

zh: 在每周雇佣数以千计承包商和自由职业者的美国硅谷，MBO Partners等新型私有企业的崛起为服务于众多雇主的临时工队伍处理福利相关事务。
en: In Silicon Valley, where thousands of contractors and freelancers are hired every week, new private companies like MBO Partners are emerging to handle the benefits of contingent workers who work for many employers.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所估计截止2025年，数字劳动力平台可将美国GDP提升2.3 % ， 美国全职就业率提升2.7 % 。
en: The McKinsey Global Institute estimates that digital labor platforms could increase US GDP by 2.3% and US full-time equivalent employment by 2.7% by 2025.

zh: 但在实现经济收益的同时为所有劳动者提供安全便捷的安全网需要企业和决策者适应新的思维方式。
en: But realizing these economy-wide gains while providing a secure and portable safety net for all workers will require new ways of thinking by companies and policymakers.

zh: 授予非洲妇女权力
en: Empowering Africa’s Women

zh: 约翰内斯堡 — — 非洲再次成为全球焦点，但这次是出于正当的理由。 随着南非世界杯开幕式的临近，人们不仅将南非、也将整个非洲大陆视为此次全球盛大庆典活动中平等的伙伴。
en: JOHANNESBURG – Africa is again high on the global agenda, and this time for all the right reasons. As the kickoff to the World Cup in South Africa approaches, people are seeing not just South Africa but our entire continent as equal partners in this extraordinary global celebration.

zh: 因此，随着世界对非洲关注度的提升，我们应当抓住这次机会向世界展示非洲女性在非洲大陆成功中所发挥的关键作用。
en: So, as the world’s eyes turn to Africa, we should take the opportunity to showcase the key role that Africa’s women are increasingly playing in the continent’s success.

zh: 埃伦·约翰逊·瑟利夫当选利比里亚总统标志着女性在非洲大陆所取得的进步，埃伦是受到推举管理非洲国家的首位女性。
en: Ellen Johnson-Sirleaf’s election as President of Liberia, the first women elected to run an African country, was symbolic of the progress of women across the continent.

zh: 女性占卢旺达议会50%以上的席位也让我们感到骄傲，卢旺达女性议员的比例居世界之首。
en: We are proud as well that women make up more than 50% of MPs in Rwanda – the highest proportion in the world.

zh: 在两性平等排名表中名列前茅的还有南非和莱索托。
en: South Africa and Lesotho are just two other African countries that sit near the top of the gender-equality league table.

zh: 女性也在为缓解紧张局势、治疗冲突和暴力给非洲留下的后遗症贡献自己的力量。
en: It is women as well who are helping to calm tensions and heal Africa’s terrible wounds of conflict and violence.

zh: 妇女在冲突解决、纠纷和解、以及起草法律和宪法框架实现和平及防止虐待方面都发挥了领导作用。
en: Women are in the lead in conflict resolution, in reconciliation, and in drafting the legal and constitutional framework to secure peace and prevent abuses.

zh: 在遍布非洲大陆的媒体、民间团体和社团中，女性大都承担着重要的责任。
en: In the media, civil society, and in communities up and down the African continent, women are taking on major responsibilities.

zh: 虽然前途仍任重道远，但女性在获得话语权，协助制定解决方案和确定政策重点方面已经取得了长足的进步。
en: There is a huge amount more to do, but women are winning the fight to have their voices heard and help shape solutions and map priorities.

zh: 教育方面的性别差异仍然令人担忧。
en: The gender gap in schooling remains a concern.

zh: 在从小学到大学的女童教育层面，非洲仍然落后于世界许多国家。
en: Africa still lags behind many parts of the world in educating its girls from primary school through to university.

zh: 但现在参与并完成学业的女孩已经比十年前多得多。
en: But many more girls are attending and completing school now than a decade ago.

zh: 教育是进步的基石，受过教育的女性会给非洲带来力量，因此目前的当务之急是督促未能缩小差异的国家改变现状。
en: Education is the bedrock for progress and educated women will empower Africa, so the focus now must be on those countries that are failing to close the gap.

zh: 政府需要推行正确的方略，找到获得成功所需的政治意愿和资源。
en: Governments need to implement the right strategies and find the political will and resources to succeed.

zh: 非洲发展小组刚刚公布的非洲发展报告牵涉到的一个重要问题就是计划内容和实际变化之间所存在的不同。
en: One of the major problems highlighted in the just-published Africa Progress Report, prepared by the African Progress Panel, is the gap between plans and change on the ground.

zh: 这些年进展甚微的另外一个领域就是在正规经济中开发利用女性的全部才干和潜能。
en: Another area where we have seen little progress is in harnessing women’s full talents and potential in the formal economy.

zh: 当然，女性对经济的贡献在全球许多地方都被人们低估。
en: Women’s economic contribution is, of course, under-valued in many places around the world.

zh: 无论生活在哪里，女性都比自己的男性同胞面对着更多的障碍和挫折。
en: Wherever they live, women face greater obstacles and frustrations than their male counterparts.

zh: 但情况在非洲尤其严重 — — 即使是最漫不经心的来访者也不会看不见女性在经济中所扮演的关键角色。
en: But this is particularly true in Africa – a continent where the crucial role that women play in the economy cannot be missed by even the most casual visitor.

zh: 看看我们的田野。
en: Look in our fields.

zh: 你会看到是女性在种植和收割作物。
en: It is women who you will see planting and harvesting the crops.

zh: 看看我们的市场。
en: Look in our markets.

zh: 你会看到是女性在买卖各种货物。
en: It is women who you will see buying and selling the goods on offer.

zh: 女性也创办许多小企业，在创造就业机会的同时传播繁荣。
en: Women, too, are setting up the small businesses that are creating jobs and spreading prosperity.

zh: 女性的确是非洲经济的引擎。
en: Women are truly the motors of Africa’s economies.

zh: 但她们的贡献却每每遭到轻视，她们的梦想每每遭到阻挠。 女性发现自己无法得到培训和支持。
en: Yet at every turn, their contribution is downplayed and their ambitions are obstructed. Women find themselves cut off from training and support.

zh: 还可能面临着来自政府和供应商的歧视。
en: And they can face discrimination from the authorities and suppliers.

zh: 无论有意还是无意，金融行业对待女性的态度造成了最为严重的损伤。
en: But it is in women’s treatment, deliberately and accidentally, by the financial sector that the most damage is done.

zh: 比方说，女性只得到小农场信贷总额的10 % ， 以及农业信贷总额的1%不到。
en: Women receive, for example, only 10% of the credit given to small farmers and less than 1% of total loans to agriculture.

zh: 但她们却承担着非洲大陆上80%的粮食产出。
en: Yet they are responsible for growing 80% of the food on our continent.

zh: 土地及相关收益只能传给男性家庭成员的强制性继承规定导致女性所处的地位极其被动。
en: Inheritance rules dictating that land – and its proceeds – can be passed down only through the men of the family have put women at a terrible disadvantage.

zh: 非洲在养活自身人口之外向世界各国出口粮食的潜力越来越受到人们广泛的认可。
en: Africa’s potential not only to feed its own people but to export food around the world is increasingly and rightly acknowledged.

zh: 但只有承认女性在农业生产中的核心地位，允许她们在非洲大陆推动一场绿色革命，这样一个梦想才可能变成现实。
en: But this ambition will be met only through policies that recognize the central role of women in agriculture and enable them to drive a green revolution on the continent.

zh: 妇女财产的缺乏以及陈旧过时的社会规范，在很大程度上阻碍了她们获取创办和发展小企业所需的资金。
en: Women’s lack of assets, together with out-dated social norms, is also a major barrier blocking their access to the capital they need to set up and expand small businesses.

zh: 由女性开办的新创企业发展为成熟企业的可能性更大。
en: Women-run start-ups are most likely to become established enterprises.

zh: 但她们在新企业投资中却只能得到不超过10%的资金份额。
en: Yet they command less than 10% of the capital available for investment in new enterprises.

zh: 歧视仍在继续，尽管有大量证据显示女性明智运用商业贷款、并遵守还款计划的可能性更大。
en: The discrimination continues, despite overwhelming evidence showing that women are more likely to invest business loans wisely and to meet repayment schedules.

zh: 就连小额信贷计划似乎都常常在同等条件下借给男性贷款人比女性更多的金额。
en: Even micro-credit schemes often seem to lend less to women than to men in the same circumstances.

zh: 这样的问题也不仅局限在小企业内部。
en: Nor are these problems limited to small businesses.

zh: 在我不久前参与的内罗毕非洲妇女经济首脑会议上，一名在喀麦隆创办建筑公司的妇女的故事就引起了轩然大波。
en: The African Women’s Economic Summit, which I attended recently in Nairobi, was electrified by the story of a woman who had set up her own construction firm in Cameroon.

zh: 她有着数十万美元的资金需求。
en: Her capital needs run into hundreds of thousands of dollars.

zh: 但在与金融机构打交道的时候，她却面临着和非洲大陆女性小企业主同样的障碍和过时的态度。
en: Yet, when dealing with financial institutions, she faced the same obstacles and out-dated attitudes familiar to the smallest businesswomen across the continent.

zh: 金融机构必须消除这些障碍，让女性能够公平便利地享受到资金和金融服务。
en: Financial institutions must remove such barriers to fair and easy access to capital and financial services.

zh: 非洲要想完成联合国千年发展计划所制定的增长目标，女性就必须全面参与正规经济，全面享受金融��务。
en: For Africa to reach the growth rates needed to meet the United Nation’s Millennium Development Goals, women must be brought fully into the formal economy and the financial sector.

zh: 因此金融服务和产品必须进行创新，而这反过来又要求当地、区域和国际范围内的女性参与制定解决方案。
en: This requires innovation in the financial services and products on offer, which in turn requires that women – locally, regionally, and internationally – are helping to formulate the solutions.

zh: 如果政府和关键利益方能够消除阻碍女性在经济和社会生活中充分发挥作用的障碍，那么无论对于女性还是整个非洲大陆来讲，前途都是光明的。
en: If governments and key stakeholders can lift the barriers that prevent women from playing their full role in our economy and societies, the future is bright – not just for women but our entire continent.

zh: 赋权女孩
en: Empowering Girls

zh: 华盛顿—在生命彩票中，生在穷国的女性需要面对双重劣势。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – In the lottery of life, being born female in a poor country places one at a double disadvantage.

zh: 贫穷国家的妇女，贫困发生率比任何人口群体都要高，健康状况也最糟糕，教育普及程度也最低，遭受暴力的危险也最大。
en: Women in poor countries have the highest global incidence of poverty of any demographic group, along with the worst health conditions, the least access to education, and the highest likelihood of being victims of violence.

zh: 性别不平等 — — 通过职场排斥和低薪酬 — — 给给世界造成的损失高达GDP的15.5 % 。
en: Gender inequality – through workplace exclusion and lower pay – costs the world a staggering 15.5% of GDP.

zh: 阻挠妇女获得发展潜力的机会意味着社会放弃了她们的贡献。
en: Denying women opportunities to develop their potential means that societies forego their contribution.

zh: 但令人沮丧的现实是，解决性别不平等问题的有效方案可能很难找到。
en: Yet the frustrating reality is that effective solutions to address gender inequality can be difficult to identify.

zh: 妇女失权规模之巨的最极端例子是有3,000万女孩在未来十年面临接受割礼的危险。
en: At the most extreme end of the scale of disempowerment are the 30 million girls deemed at risk of female genital mutilation (FGM) over the next decade.

zh: 割礼在索马里、几内亚、吉布提、埃及、厄立特里亚、马里、塞拉利昂和苏丹几乎是所有女性都无法避免的。
en: The procedure is almost universal in Somalia, Guinea, Djibouti, Egypt, Eritrea, Mali, Sierra Leone, and Sudan.

zh: 世界卫生组织警告，受影响妇女将因此发生长期健康问题，分娩死亡率也更高。
en: The World Health Organization warns that affected women suffer long-term health problems and higher rates of perinatal death.

zh: 但找到问题容易，解决问题难。
en: But the problem is easier to identify than it is to solve.

zh: 法律改革影响甚微。
en: Legal reforms have had little impact.

zh: 即使在英国，割礼在30年前已经非法，但从未有人因此被成功起诉。
en: Even in the United Kingdom, where FGM was outlawed 30 years ago, not a single person has been successfully prosecuted.

zh: 7月份第一批被记录的数字表明，在2015年4月到2016年3月期间，英格兰发生了5,702起新的割礼案件。
en: The first-ever recorded figures, reported in July, showed that there were 5,702 new cases in England between April 2015 and March 2016.

zh: 英国至少有18名年轻妇女和女孩将不得不接受割礼，而在非洲，割礼是绝大多数女性的都要经历的。
en: At least 18 young women and girls were subjected to FGM in the UK, while most underwent the procedure in Africa.

zh: 过去三十年中，割礼的普及度总体而言是下降的。
en: There has been an overall decline in the prevalence of FGM over the last three decades.

zh: 但并非所有国家都有进步。
en: But not all countries have made progress.

zh: 事实上，按照当前趋势，接受割礼的女孩和妇女数量将在未来15年显著增加。
en: In fact, on current trends, the number of girls and women undergoing FGM will rise significantly over the next 15 years.

zh: 这并不是说致力于该领域的慈善机构和政府工作不够出色。
en: This is not to say that charities and governments working in this area are not doing some excellent work.

zh: 但我们需要关于如何遴选和推广有效计划的高质量的研究。
en: But we need more high-quality studies of how to identify and scale up effective programs.

zh: 童婚是剥夺女孩机会的另一个不可接受的风俗。
en: Child marriage is another unacceptable custom that robs girls of opportunity.

zh: 2011年到2020年间，全世界将有超过1.4亿女孩沦为童婚新娘 — — 按照联合国18岁以前结婚算童婚的定义的话。
en: From 2011 to 2020, more than 140 million girls worldwide will become child brides – defined by the United Nations as marriage before age 18.

zh: 联合国儿童基金会估计，在九个国家 — — 尼日尔、中非共和国、乍得、孟加拉国、马里、几内亚、南苏丹、布基纳法索和马拉维 — — 童婚率高于50 % 。
en: In nine countries – Niger, Central African Republic, Chad, Bangladesh, Mali, Guinea, South Sudan, Burkina Faso, and Malawi – UNICEF estimates that child marriage rates are higher than 50%.

zh: 对年轻的新娘们来说，童婚的影响是巨大的：受教育程度和终身收入因此更低，家庭暴力比率因此更高，妊娠和分娩死亡风险因此更大，孩子的死亡率也因此增加。
en: For young brides, the effects are far-reaching: lower education levels and lifetime earnings, higher rates of domestic violence, greater risk of dying during pregnancy or childbirth, and increased mortality rates for their children.

zh: 和割礼问题一样，光靠法律不足以解决问题。
en: As with FGM, laws alone are not enough to address the problem.

zh: 以孟加拉国为例，该国有52%的女孩在18岁时已经结婚。
en: Consider Bangladesh, where 52% of girls are married by the time they reach the legal age of 18.

zh: 大量法律禁止童婚和陪嫁，但收效甚微，18%的女孩 — — 比例为世界最高 — — 在15岁前就已经结婚。
en: Numerous laws prohibiting child marriage and dowries have had scant effect, with 18% of girls – the world’s highest rate – married before they turn 15.

zh: 社会团体所发起的向少女传授生活技能和训练的项目影响有限。
en: Programs by community groups to give adolescent girls life skills and training have had limited impact.

zh: 杜克大学和麻省理工大学的阿卜杜勒·拉提夫·贾米尔贫困行动实验室（Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab）的经济学家在孟加拉国的分析表明，提供财务激励推迟结婚是最有效的策略。
en: Analysis in Bangladesh by economists from Duke University and MIT’s Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab suggests that providing financial incentives to delay marriage could be the most effective strategy.

zh: 全球人口中最穷的20%中的女孩，比最富裕的20%的人口中的女孩发生童婚的可能性高一倍。
en: Girls in the poorest 20% of the global population are more than twice as likely as those in the wealthiest 20% to be married young.

zh: 在孟加拉国南部所实施的一项很有希望的项目向未婚女孩的父母发放食用油。
en: A promising program in southern Bangladesh gave cooking oil to parents of unmarried girls.

zh: 参与者每四个月可以获得四升油，条件是监督员确认他们的女孩没有结婚。
en: Every four months, participants received four liters of oil, conditional upon a monitor confirming that the girls were still unmarried.

zh: 这一微小的激励起了作用：收到食用油的家长的女儿，在16岁前结婚的可能性要低30 % ， 所产生的收益四倍于成本。
en: This modest incentive worked: daughters of recipients were up to 30% less likely to marry before 16, yielding benefits four times higher than the costs.

zh: 令人激动的是，该计划还改善了女孩的教育水平：参与者的女儿不辍学的可能性要高22 % 。
en: Promisingly, the program also improved girls’ education levels: daughters of recipients were up to 22% more likely to remain in school.

zh: 这很重要，因为千年发展目标（Millennium Development Goals，结束于2015年）的关键目标之一是消除中小学教育的性别不平等。
en: This matters, because one of the key targets of the Millennium Development Goals, which concluded in 2015, was to eliminate gender disparity in primary and secondary education.

zh: 小学教育取得了非常好的进展，但中学和大学教育的普及率仍然高度不平等。
en: Good progress was made in the primary sector, but access to secondary and university-level education still remains highly unequal.

zh: 小学入学率差异在所有地区都出现了下降，但撒哈拉以南非洲、中东和北非处于落后地位。
en: Differences in enrollment in primary education have decreased in all regions, but Sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East, and North Africa lag behind.

zh: 减小就学方面的性别差距的收益能惠及下一代。
en: Reducing the gender gap in schooling would have benefits that reach the next generation as well.

zh: 加强女孩教育意味着她们的孩子能拥有更好的健康和营养结果。
en: More education for girls means better health and nutrition outcomes for their children.

zh: 我们如何实现这一目标要视情况而定。
en: How we achieve this will vary.

zh: 比如，提供免费校服在一些地区能起到帮助作用，在另一些地区不能。
en: Providing free school uniforms, for example, helps in some places, but not everywhere.

zh: 在孟加拉国，干预童婚对普及中学教育起到了辅助作用。
en: In Bangladesh, the intervention for child marriage reduction had auxiliary benefits in furthering secondary education.

zh: 新的研究表明，全球而言，用于降低教育方面性别差异的资金，其收益是成本的五倍左右。
en: New research shows that, globally, money spent to reduce gender disparity in education yields benefits around five times higher than the costs.

zh: 许多降低性别不平等的思想初衷良好，甚至无可挑剔，但分析和量化比较困难。
en: Many well-meaning and even unquestionably good ideas to reduce gender inequality are harder to analyze and quantify.

zh: 确保妇女妇女拥有平等的财产继承权、契约签署权、企业注册权或开立银行账户权都不需要什么成本，而能带来巨大的收益。
en: Ensuring that women have equal rights to inherit property, sign a contract, register a business, or open a bank account would all cost little and could have far-reaching benefits.

zh: 尽管面临数据问题，一个由哥本哈根共识（Copenhagen Consensus）召集的诺贝尔奖得主组成的小组仍将这些措施列为最值得追求的19项发展目标之一每一美元投入能够产生价值超过15美元的收益。
en: Despite data problems, a panel of Nobel laureates convened by Copenhagen Consensus identified such measures as one of the 19 best development targets to pursue, with every dollar spent producing benefits worth more than $15.

zh: 我们确实知道如何解决一个问题 — — 我们也拥有足够的成本-收益数据。
en: We do know how to tackle one problem – and we have ample data on costs and benefits.

zh: 全世界大约有2.25亿妇女，她们想避孕，但没有安全有效的计划生育手段可用。
en: Some 225 million women who want to avoid pregnancy are not using safe and effective family-planning methods.

zh: 原因包括无法获得信息和服务、缺少来自伴侣或社区的支持等。
en: The reasons range from a lack of access to information or services to lack of support from their partners or communities.

zh: 确保避孕手段的全民普及每年需要花费36亿美元，但也意味着150,000位母亲免于死亡，600,000儿童免于沦为孤儿。
en: Ensuring universal access to contraception would cost $3.6 billion annually, but would mean 150,000 fewer maternal deaths and 600,000 fewer orphans.

zh: 此外，赡养人口下降、工作人口增加的人口红利将加速经济增长。
en: Moreover, the demographic dividend from fewer dependents and more people in the workforce would accelerate economic growth.

zh: 总收益将比成本高120倍。
en: The total benefits are an astounding 120 times higher than the costs.

zh: 对于性别不平等问题没有速效药，但有一点是显然的：不是所有措施都同样优秀或有可靠数据支撑。
en: There are no quick fixes for gender inequality, but one thing is clear: not all efforts are equally good or supported by sound data.

zh: 在道德和经济领域，决策者应该采取最能为女孩和妇女赋权的措施。
en: On moral and economic grounds, policymakers should adopt those measures that do the most to empower girls and women.

zh: 非洲学界如何降低非洲失业
en: How African Scholarship Can Reduce African Unemployment

zh: 布莱顿—三分之二的非洲人口还不到25岁，年轻人也许是非洲最大的竞争优势。
en: BRIGHTON – With two thirds of Africa’s population under 25 years of age, the continent’s youth may be its biggest competitive advantage.

zh: 毕竟，国家的长期经济前景通常取决于是否能获得年轻的流动劳动力。
en: After all, countries’ long-term economic prospects are typically linked to the availability of a young, mobile labor force.

zh: 易卜拉欣基金会（Mo Ibrahim Foundation）的一份最新报告指出，2004—2014年间全世界25个增长最快的经济体中有十个在非洲。
en: A recent report by the Mo Ibrahim Foundation concluded that ten of the world’s 25 fastest-growing economies between 2004 and 2014 were in Africa.

zh: 但是，2015年非洲数以百万计的年轻人处于失业状态，更多年轻人处于半失业状态，这个大洲并没有充分利用这一潜力。
en: And yet, with many millions of young people unemployed in 2015, and many more underemployed, Africa has so far failed to reach its full potential.

zh: 非洲年轻人就业挑战之所以持续存在，原因有很多。
en: The continent’s youth-employment challenge persists for many reasons.

zh: 首先，关注年轻人的政策和干预在整个地区都十分有限。
en: For starters, youth-focused policies and interventions are limited across the region.

zh: 即使存在的计划，也缺乏足够的协调，并且常常难以吸取教训和反馈。
en: Programs that do exist lack adequate coordination, and often fail to incorporate lessons and feedback.

zh: 就业战略也常常以理论为主，尽管初衷是良好的，但无法在实践中产生效果。
en: Employment strategies have also tended to be largely theory-based; while well meaning, they can fail to deliver results when put into practice.

zh: 但在我们看来，除此之外还有一个常常被忽视的弱点：学术环境导致非洲年轻学者 — — 刚刚完成博士学业的学生 — — 难以施展抱负，而他们掌握着让非洲发展起来的钥匙。
en: But in our view, an additional, often overlooked weakness is an academic environment that limits contributions from Africa’s youngest scholars – students just finishing their PhDs – who may in fact hold the keys to putting the continent to work.

zh: 经验表明，年轻的非洲博士生们所做的研究对于解决非洲的发展挑战至关重要。
en: Experience shows that young African doctoral students produce research that is crucial to addressing the continent’s development challenges.

zh: 但是，这些年轻的头脑常常缺少将概念从江湖运用到庙堂所需要的训练、途径和支持。
en: And yet, far too often, these young minds lack the training, access, and support they need to bring their ideas from the field to the policymaking arena.

zh: 因此，我们加入了一项全球计划，通过研究合作和发表的机会，为年轻的非洲学者提供参与政策导向方案的机会。
en: That is why we have joined a global initiative to provide young African researchers an opportunity to engage in policy-oriented solutions, through research collaboration and publishing opportunities.

zh: 2016年由万事达卡基金会和英国发展研究所（Institute of Development Studies，IDS）发起的玛塔沙研究员网络（Matasa Fellows Network）旨在聚合非洲年轻学者的才华，帮助解决非洲的年轻人就业挑战。
en: Launched in 2016 by The MasterCard Foundation and the Institute of Development Studies (IDS) in the United Kingdom, the Matasa Fellows Network aims to bring together the continent’s young academic talent to help solve Africa’s youth employment challenge.

zh: 这一挑战和其他问题紧密相关 — — 如移民、冲突、农村发展和性别等 — — 因此决策者在考虑解决方案时必须面面俱到。
en: Because that challenge is closely connected to other issues – like migration, conflict, rural development, and gender – policymakers must cast a wide net when considering solutions.

zh: 我们的研究员通过对这些问题的研究，向政府和发展基金提出了关于如何以确保问责的方式制定和实施方案的关键性问题。
en: Our fellows’ research on these issues poses vital questions to governments and development funders about how to design solutions and implement them in ways that ensure accountability.

zh: 第一批研究员最近在《IDS公告板 》 （ IDS Bulletin）上发布了他们的新发现。 他们是十位社会科学领域的非洲博士生。
en: The first cohort of fellows, who recently published their findings in the IDS Bulletin, included ten African doctoral students working in the social sciences.

zh: 在IDS工作人员的训练和指导下，这些研究员通过面对面的指导仔细审视自己的思想，通过与政府官员和非政府组织专业人士的互动形成政策观点。
en: With coaching and mentorship from IDS staff, the fellows fine-tuned their ideas through peer mentorship and worked to generate policy ideas through interactions with government officials and NGOs professionals.

zh: 到目前为止，研究员的成果令人印象深刻：他们提出了主题各异的政策简报，包括加纳年轻人就业问题、肯尼亚畜牧生产问题、改善年轻人领导的企业家精神的地区战略问题等。
en: The fellows’ output so far has been remarkable: policy briefs on a diverse range of topics, including youth unemployment in Ghana, livestock production in Kenya, and regional strategies for improving youth-led entrepreneurship.

zh: 第一批玛塔沙研究员还研究了埃塞俄比亚年轻人就业和政策流程中的政治问题、影响非洲就业选择的社会和文化问题、导师指导如何影响企业家精神的问题、非洲年轻人如何看待赌博和色情等非法行业的问题等。
en: The inaugural Matasa fellows also studied the political dimensions of youth employment and policy processes in Ethiopia; the social and cultural concerns underpinning employment choices across the continent; how mentorship affects entrepreneurship; and how young Africans view illicit industries, like gambling and sex work.

zh: 其中一些研究员的研究产生了引人注目的成果 — — 并且与直觉形成了鲜明的对比。
en: Some of the fellows’ research has generated remarkable results –all the more so for being counterintuitive.

zh: 比如，在坎帕拉工作的研究员尼古拉斯·基利马尼（Nicholas Kilimani）对就业战略的调查发现，与通常认为的相反，年轻人失业率实际上随教育程度相应地增加。
en: For example, Kampala-based researcher Nicholas Kilimani’s survey of employment strategies found that, contrary to commonly held assumptions, youth unemployment rates actually rise proportional to educational attainment.

zh: 因此，基利马尼认为，解决就业危机需要创造性思维。
en: Solving the employment crisis will therefore require creative thinking, Kilimani argues.

zh: “年轻人就业挑战要求基础教育和劳动力市场等领域之外的政策动作 ， ” 他写道 ， “ 如信用市场、基础设施、企业监管和农村发展等。 ”
en: “The youth employment challenge requires policy action beyond basic education and labor markets,” he writes, “into areas such as credit markets, infrastructure, business regulation, and rural development.”

zh: 研究肯尼亚青年事业发展基金（Youth Enterprise Development Fund，一个政府经营的微金融项目）的毛里斯·西肯尼（Maurice Sikenyi）的工作也很有创新性。
en: The work of Maurice Sikenyi, who studied Kenya’s Youth Enterprise Development Fund, a government-run microfinancing initiative, is equally innovative.

zh: 这位明尼苏达大学的学者通过一手访问和二手数据，认为该基金的触及面和影响力因为腐败、模糊的资质标准、漫长的贷款流程以及低估年轻人开办自己的企业所承担的风险而受到了削弱。
en: Using primary interviews and secondary data, the University of Minnesota scholar concluded that the fund’s reach and impact was being weakened by corruption, vague eligibility criteria, long wait times for loan processing, and an underappreciation of the risks young people take when starting their own business.

zh: 他的文章探索了发展项目如何通过更加注重问责手段和关注指导得到强化。
en: His paper explores how the development program could be strengthened through greater attention to accountability measures and a renewed focus on mentorship.

zh: 非洲可以扭转年轻人就业形式。
en: Africa can turn the corner on youth employment.

zh: 但要实现这一目标，非洲决策者需要更加深度地与非洲最优秀的年研究者合作 — — 他们常常拥有独特的视角，可以提供关键性的洞见 — — 并在非洲研究、政策和实践之间建立新的学术联系节点。
en: To do so, however, African decision-makers need to engage more deeply with the continent’s youngest, brightest researchers – who often are uniquely positioned to lend key insights – and build new nodes of academic connectivity between the continent’s research, policy, and practice.

zh: 出口商品的进口
en: The Import of Exports

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 一个国家的发展战略是否应特别关注出口？
en: CAMBRIDGE – Should a country’s development strategy pay special attention to exports?

zh: 毕竟，出口无关于满足当地民众的教育、医疗、住房、电力、供水、电信、安全、法治和娱乐等基本需求。
en: After all, exports have nothing to do with satisfying their people’s basic needs, such as education, health care, housing, power, water, telecoms, security, the rule of law, and recreation.

zh: 那么，为什么要优先满足相距甚远的异国消费者的需求？
en: So why give precedence to satisfying the needs of distant foreign consumers?

zh: 简言之，这个问题就是自由贸易和经济全球化的众多反对者 — — 以及众多坚信对所有行业应当一视同仁的右翼人士 — — 想要知道的。
en: That, in a nutshell, is what many opponents of free trade and economic globalization – as well as many on the right who believe that all industries should be treated equally – want to know.

zh: 但如果问题本身就是伪命题，那么答案就可想而知了。
en: But there are no right answers to wrong questions.

zh: 恰恰因为政府关心本国民众，他们才更要关注出口。
en: It is precisely because governments care about their own people that they should focus on exports.

zh: 要想弄懂这一点，必须明白什么才是市场经济的根本。
en: To see this, consider what a market economy is all about.

zh: 某些人，包括佛朗西斯教皇在内，认为市场经济的根本是贪婪 — — 在市场经济体系中，人们只关心自己的利益。
en: Some, including Pope Francis, would say that it is about greed – a system in which everybody cares only about herself.

zh: 但市场经济的实质应该理解为通过为其他人服务赚取生活费；我们赚钱的多少反映了我们的服务在他人眼中的价值。
en: But a market economy should be understood as a system in which we are supposed to earn our keep by doing things for other people; how much we earn depends on how others value what we do for them.

zh: 市场经济迫使我们要关注他人的需要，因为正是他们的需要构成了我们的生活来源。
en: The market economy forces us to be concerned about the needs of others, because it is their need that constitutes the source of our livelihood.

zh: 从某种意义上说，市场经济是一个礼物交换系统；钱仅仅跟踪了我们给予彼此礼物的价值。
en: In some sense, a market economy is a gift-exchange system; money merely tracks the value of the gifts we give one another.

zh: 这样一来，市场经济鼓励专业化：我们熟练掌握狭窄范围内的某种技能或产品，并以此来换取数以百万计我们不知道怎么制作的其他物品。
en: As a result, a market economy encourages specialization: We become very good in a narrow set of skills or products, and exchange them for millions of other things we have no clue how to do or make.

zh: 因此，我们最终能做的事情少之又少，除此之外的其他东西都从别人那里进口。
en: As a consequence, we end up doing remarkably few things and buying everything else from others.

zh: 这项原则既适用于人也适用于特定地域，无论该地域是社区、城镇、州、省、还是国家。
en: This observation is as true about an individual as it is about a place, whether the place is a neighborhood, a town, a state or province, or a country.

zh: 每座城镇都有服务于当地民众的杂货铺、美容院、加油站和电影院。
en: Every town has grocery stores, beauty parlors, gas stations, and movie theaters that serve the local community.

zh: 经济学家称这些为“非贸易活动 ” ， 因为它们不以服务远程客户为目的。
en: Economists call these “non-tradable activities,” because they are not undertaken with distant customers in mind.

zh: 但镇上的人也想要镇上甚至没人会做的东西。
en: But the town’s people would also want access to things that nobody in the city even knows how to make.

zh: 举例来讲，大多数城镇和城市不生产粮食、汽车、汽油、药品、电视机或影片。
en: For example, most towns and cities do not produce food, cars, gasoline, medicines, TVs, or films.

zh: 因此他们需要从别处“进口”这些产品。
en: So they need to “import” these goods from elsewhere.

zh: 为了向外人支付他们想要东西的对价，他们必须将自己能够制作的某种东西卖给他们。
en: To pay for what they want from out-of-towners, they must sell them some of the things that they do know how to make.

zh: 当然，外地人有权从别处进口。
en: Of course, the out-of-towners have the option of buying from somewhere else.

zh: 这解释了为什么卖给非居民的商品和服务能对生活质量产生重大影响，甚至影响到生活的可持续程度。
en: This is why the goods and services that a place can sell to non-residents have a disproportionate impact on its quality of life – and even its viability.

zh: 矿山关闭会导致一座采矿小镇变为鬼城，因为杂货铺、药店和电影院不再具有购买“进口”食品、药品和电影的能力。
en: A mining town becomes a ghost town when the mine closes, because the grocery store, the pharmacy, and the movie theater no longer have the capacity to buy the “imported” food, medicine, and films they need.

zh: 与非贸易活动相比，某地的出口活动需要颇具竞争力才能说服有众多其他选择的外地客户购买当地制造商的产品。
en: In contrast to non-tradable activities, a place’s export activities need to be pretty good to convince out-of-town customers – who have ample other options – to buy from local producers.

zh: 这意味着出口必须具备有吸引力的性价比。
en: That means that exports must have an attractive quality/cost ratio.

zh: 出口活动的质量和效率越高，就能在保持竞争力的情况下支付更高工资。
en: One way to increase this ratio is to improve quality and productivity. Another is to lower wages.

zh: 如果出口行业就业占比较大，就像不依赖石油收入的多数地域那样，出口行业能够支付的工资将影响生活在城里的几乎所有人。
