zh: 在欧盟、中国、日本、美国、亚洲基础设施投资银行和其他国际发展主体的参与下，海湾合作委员会可以轻松资助并领导这样的金融机构 — — 同样的理念我在别的场合也探讨过。
en: This financial institution – an idea I have discussed elsewhere – could easily be funded and led by the Gulf Cooperation Council with participation from the European Union, China, Japan, the United States, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, and other international development actors.

zh: 通过这种三管齐下的方法，或许可以管理数十年来世界经历的最严重的难民危机。
en: With this three-pronged approach, it is possible to manage the worst refugee crisis the world has experienced in decades.

zh: 通过创造工作机会、加强沟通和数字连接以及为战后重建奠定基础，一个破碎地区的民众可以开始规划更加繁荣的未来。
en: By ensuring access to work, strengthening communication and digital access, and laying the groundwork for post-war reconstruction, the people of a shattered region can begin planning for a more prosperous future.

zh: 与此相对应的另外一种选项 — — 那就是没有任何有意义战略指导的短期援助流入 — — 只会进一步加剧人们的失望情绪。
en: The alternative – short-term aid that trickles in with no meaningful strategy – will produce only further disappointment.

zh: 结束中东的宗教暴力
en: Ending Religious Violence in the Middle East

zh: 费斯—自2010年所谓的阿拉伯之春暴动开始以来，中东激进主义、暴力和内战的升级已经造成了巨大的人员伤亡和财产损失。
en: FEZ – The escalation of radicalism, violence, and civil wars in the Middle East since the so-called Arab Spring revolts began in 2010 has exacted a massive toll in human lives and welfare.

zh: 建设支持和平、提供更大的机会和繁荣、保护人道权利的高效国家的需要已是万分紧迫。
en: The need to build effective states that support peace, provide greater opportunity and prosperity, and protect human rights could not be more urgent.

zh: 目前，过去几年中所出现的暴力已经导致180,000伊拉克人和470,000叙利亚人丧生。
en: Already, the violence that has surged in the last few years has left more than 180,000 Iraqis and 470,000 Syrians dead.

zh: 此外，650万叙利亚人在国内流离失所，另有480万人被迫逃离。
en: Moreover, 6.5 million Syrians have been internally displaced, and another 4.8 million driven from the country altogether.

zh: 他们在监狱中遭受酷刑，在难民营中遭受屈辱。
en: They have often been tortured in prisons and humiliated in refugee camps.

zh: 据估计，70-80%的受害者为平民，其中大部分是妇女和儿童。
en: An estimated 70-80% of the victims are civilians, most of them women and children.

zh: 事实上，据叙利亚政策研究中心（Syrian Center for Policy Research）的数据，在叙利亚国内流离失所的人中有一半年龄不到18岁。
en: In fact, according to the Syrian Center for Policy Research, half of the refugees and internally displaced people are under the age of 18.

zh: 他们的未来前景已经遭到巨大的影响。
en: This has a major impact on their future prospects.

zh: 联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）报道，210万叙利亚儿童和700,000叙利亚难民儿童辍学。
en: UNICEF reports that 2.1 million children in Syria and 700,000 Syrian refugee children are out of school.

zh: 共有80,000身处约旦的儿童难民无法接受教育。
en: A total of 80,000 child refugees in Jordan lack access to an education.

zh: 但所有这些人道损失只不过是更深层次的问题的症候 — — 与流行的信念相反，这个问题并非伊斯兰教。
en: But all of these human costs are symptoms of a deeper problem – and, contrary to popular belief, that problem is not Islam.

zh: 激进伊斯兰或圣战主义者是穆斯林，这一事实并不意味着他们的宗教、更不意味着他们的种族和文化天生就是暴力的。
en: The fact that radical Islamists or jihadists are Muslim does not mean that their religion, not to mention their ethnicity or culture, is inherently violent.

zh: 看着西方新闻，你很容易看出为何如此多人谴责伊斯兰教。
en: Watching Western news, it is easy to see why so many blame Islam.

zh: 从伊斯兰国在叙利亚和伊拉克的暴行，到基地组织发动的恐怖袭击，再到阿富汗根据伊斯兰教法对私通妇女所采取的石刑，中东暴力几乎总是可以归因于伊斯兰教。
en: From the brutality of the Islamic State (ISIS) in Syria and Iraq to the terrorist attacks carried out by al-Qaeda to the stoning of adulterous women under Sharia law in Afghanistan, Middle East violence is almost always attributed to the religion.

zh: 于是，伊斯兰教常常主要被视为是一种威胁。
en: As a result, Islam is often viewed primarily as a threat.

zh: 但是，加拿大哲学家查尔斯·泰勒（Charles Taylor）解释道，真正的威胁不是伊斯兰教本身，而是“块思维 ” （ block thinking ） 。
en: But, as the Canadian philosopher Charles Taylor explains, the real threat is not Islam itself, but “block thinking.”

zh: 伊斯兰极端分子只占全球穆斯林人口的不到0.5 % ， 但他们的世界观主宰者媒体报道 — — 不光是对伊斯兰教的报道，也包括对中东政治发展的报道。
en: Islamic extremists comprise less than 0.5% of the global Muslim population, yet their worldview dominates media coverage not just of Islam, but also of political developments in the Middle East.

zh: 这些报道抹杀穆斯林之间的巨大差异，强化了一种单一的、简化的对伊斯兰教的认识。
en: By erasing the huge differences among Muslims, such coverage reinforces a single, simplistic perception of Islam.

zh: 这就是块思维。
en: That is block thinking.

zh: 此外，迈克尔·格里芬（Michael Griffin）在他的著作《伊斯兰国：重写历史 》 （ Islamic State: Rewriting History）指出，这样的思维正在美国和欧洲得势。
en: And, as Michael Griffin documents in his book Islamic State: Rewriting History, such thinking is gaining ground in the United States and Europe.

zh: 结果，许多人接受了塞缪尔·亨廷顿（Samuel Huntongton）的“文明的冲突”理论，该理论认为伊斯兰教与现代性相悖。
en: As a result, many have embraced Samuel Huntington’s theory of a “clash of civilizations,” which assumes that Islam is at odds with modernity.

zh: 但这样的观点忽视了伊斯兰教的早期改革家 — — 如穆罕默德·阿卜杜（Muhammad Abduh）和贾马勒丁·阿富汗尼（Jamaleddin al-Afghani ） — —的影响，他们一直在影响世界各地的穆斯林。
en: But that assumption ignores the ideas and impact of Islam’s early reformers – figures like Muhammad Abduh and Jamaleddin al-Afghani – who continue to influence Muslims everywhere.

zh: 第一波改革浪潮延续最久的影响是成立了沙拉菲（salafi，保守传统主义）运动，它认为现代国家是改善大部分穆斯林境况的一种方法。
en: The most lasting impact of the first reformist wave was the establishment of a salafi (conservative traditionalist) movement, which came to regard the modern state as a means to improve the lot of Muslims.

zh: 如今，穆斯林思想家 — — 如伊朗的阿卜杜尔卡里姆·索罗什（Abdolkarim Soroush ） 、 突尼斯的塔哈尔·哈达德（Tahar Haddad ） 、 巴基斯坦的法兹鲁尔·拉曼（Fazlur Rahman ） 、 摩洛哥的费特马·梅尔尼西（Fatema Mernisssi ） 、 埃及的卡西姆·阿明（Qasim Amin ） 、 苏丹的马哈茂德·穆罕默德·塔哈（Mahmud Muhammad Taha）等 — — 仍在探索伊斯兰思想与现代价值观之间的联系。
en: Today, Muslim thinkers – such as Iran’s Abdolkarim Soroush, Tunisia’s Tahar Haddad, Pakistan’s Fazlur Rahman, Morocco’s Fatema Mernissi, Egypt’s Qasim Amin, and Sudan’s Mahmud Muhammad Taha – continue to explore the connections between Islamic thought and modern values.

zh: 尽管激进伊斯兰主义者强烈反对他们的工作，但这些思想家对全世界一代又一代穆斯林知识分子产生了巨大影响。
en: While radical Islamists strongly oppose their work, these thinkers have had a huge influence on generations of Muslim intellectuals worldwide.

zh: 所有这些都不是说宗教在中东暴力中没有起作用。
en: None of this is to say that religion does not play a role in Middle East violence.

zh: 相反，这些暴力 — — 包括性侵害和任意剥夺个人和公共自由 — — 无处不在、形式多样，它们是宗教信仰、文化传统、种族和民族、战争以及政治综合影响的产物。
en: On the contrary, such violence – including sexual assault and arbitrary deprivation of individual and public freedoms – is widespread and multifaceted, owing to the combination of religious beliefs, cultural tradition, race and ethnicity, war, and politics that influences it.

zh: 甚至招募圣战战士也可以视为一种基于宗教的暴力形式，与童婚和荣誉杀戮一样。
en: Even the recruitment of jihadist fighters can be viewed as a form of religion-based violence, much like child marriage and honor killings.

zh: 但所有这些都不意味着伊斯兰教天生暴力。
en: But none of that means that Islam is inherently violent.

zh: 诉诸模糊 — — 并且常常偏隘 — — 的文化、宗教或种族解释是有失明智的举动，或者说不如不动。
en: Resorting to fuzzy – and often bigoted – cultural, religious, or ethnic explanations is a recipe for ill-advised action, or no action at all.

zh: 中东需要的是有效的社会和经济战略和政策，以解决暴力背后的复杂的非宗教因素 — — 及其绝非宗教性的影响。
en: What the Middle East needs are effective social and economic strategies and policies that tackle the complex non-religious reasons behind the violence – and its decidedly non-religious effects.

zh: 文化、种族和宗教因素也应该被考虑，但它们不是失业和边缘化的主要原因。
en: While cultural, ethnic, and religious factors may need to be considered, they are not the main causes of unemployment and marginalization.

zh: 中东政府必须致力于采取果断的创新政策，解决教育不足、事业高企和普遍腐败的问题，这些问题助长了该地区的暴力和动乱。
en: Middle Eastern governments must commit to pursuing bold and creative policies that address the inadequate education, high unemployment, and pervasive corruption that are helping to fuel violence and unrest in the region.

zh: 这些措施应该着眼于推进民主化、经济发展和培养强大的公民社会和进步媒体。
en: Such efforts should aim to advance democratization, economic development, and the emergence of a strong civil society and progressive media.

zh: 关键是不要事事“伊斯兰化 ” ， 而是制定符合人民需要的真正的政策方案。
en: The key is not to “Islamize” every issue, but rather to develop real policy solutions that meet people’s needs.

zh: 教育当然是成功的关键：学校课程必须更加包容，扩大学生的宗教和文化知识。
en: Education is of course critical to success: school curricula must become more inclusive, to broaden students’ knowledge of religions and cultures.

zh: 更广泛地讲，学校还应该采取教育和国家分离的政策 — — 并大力保护宗教自由 — — 这是结束中东基于宗教的暴力的必要条件。
en: More broadly, schools should also embody the separation of church and state – and well-protected religious freedom – that will be needed to end religion-based violence in the Middle East.

zh: 发生在中东的大规模暴力带来了巨大的个人伤害，破坏了资本基础，阻碍了生产力发展，也破坏了经济增长。
en: Large-scale violence like that occurring in the Middle East causes devastating harm to individuals, erodes the capital base, hampers productivity, and undermines economic growth.

zh: 其对政治、社会和经济结构的影响应该予以修复，而国家修复影响的能力不应该被低估和忽视。
en: Its impact on political, social, and economic structures needs to be addressed, and the capacity of the state to do so should not be underestimated or overlooked.

zh: 但只要国家框定于或寻求在宗教条例中实现政策合法化，暴力就不会停止。
en: But so long as the state frames or seeks to legitimize its policies in religious terms, the violence will not stop.

zh: 预防是最好的移民疗法
en: Prevention Is the Best Migration Cure

zh: 巴黎—报纸上充斥着关于移民家庭面临挑战的报道，你很容易会认为，流离失所的原因也在得到解决。
en: PARIS – With newspapers full of stories about the challenges migrant families face, it might be tempting to assume that the causes of displacement are also being addressed.

zh: 但在大部分情形中，这一假设是错误的。
en: In most cases, however, such an assumption would be wrong.

zh: 如今，被迫移民问题的解决方案几乎完全集中在帮助逃离后的难民，而没有把目标对准他们逃离的原因。
en: Today, solutions to forced migration focus almost exclusively on aiding refugees after they flee, rather than targeting the reasons for their flight.

zh: 要解决世界的难民危机，就需要向关注结果那样关注原因。
en: To resolve the world’s refugee crises, the causes require as much attention as the effects.

zh: 为什么家长们要冒着自己或孩子的生命危险，离开家园前往未知之地？
en: Why would parents risk their lives, or the lives of their children, to leave home and journey into the unknown?

zh: 可以做些什么阻止家庭被迫离开故土？
en: And what can be done to keep families from being forced to migrate in the first place?

zh: 我和我的同事们所主持的一项经合组织新研究《2018年的脆弱之国 》 （ States of Fragility 2018）试图回答这些关键问题。
en: These are among the key questions that colleagues and I have attempted to answer in a new OECD study, States of Fragility 2018.

zh: 我们的发现很有启发意义，也令人担心
en: The findings are as illuminating as they are troubling.

zh: 到2030年，全世界超过80%的穷人将生活在可定义为“脆弱”的地区 — — 脆弱是一种可能因为政治、社会、安全、经济、环境等原因所造成的状态。
en: By 2030, more than 80% of the world’s poor will live in an area defined as “fragile” – a status that may reflect any number of political, social, security, economic, or environmental causes.

zh: 不幸的是，如果当前趋势持续下去的话，解决造成脆弱性的因素的发展援助是远远不够的。
en: Unfortunately, if current trends hold, far too little development aid will be allocated to address the factors contributing to fragility.

zh: 比如，2016年，流向受脆弱性影响地区的官方发展援助（ODA）总量为682亿美元，其中只有2%被用于冲突预防活动，只有10%被用于缔造和平的计划。
en: In 2016, for example, just 2% of the $68.2 billion in official development assistance (ODA) that went to places affected by fragility was used for conflict-prevention activities, and only 10% went to peace-building initiatives.

zh: 结论只有一个：我们必须改变ODA的配置方式。
en: There is no other conclusion to draw: we must change how ODA is allocated.

zh: 据联合国难民署数据，2017年被迫流离失所人数达到了创纪录的6,850万人。
en: According to the United Nations Refugee Agency, a record 68.5 million people were forcibly displaced in 2017.

zh: 其中许多来自五个国家 — — 阿富汗、缅甸、索马里、南苏丹和叙利亚。
en: Many of these people hailed from just five countries – Afghanistan, Myanmar, Somalia, South Sudan, and Syria.

zh: 但尽管收容难民的国家急需资金支持长期安置措施，大部分ODA仍被用在了短期方案上。
en: But, while countries hosting refugees have an urgent need for money to support long-term relocation efforts, most ODA is still channeled to short-term solutions.

zh: 人道主义措施 — — 如粮食和居所 — — 消耗了去年ODA总量的约三分之一，近十年来，这一比例一直在上升。
en: Humanitarian initiatives – like food and shelter – accounted for roughly a third of all ODA last year, and that share has been climbing for nearly a decade.

zh: 相反，用于建设学校、医院和其他基础设施的拨款一直滞后。
en: By contrast, funding for construction of schools, hospitals, and other infrastructure continues to lag.

zh: 不难理解，出资者会倾向于立即能够帮到流离失所者的方案，但忽略难民的长期需要实乃短视。
en: While it’s understandable that donors would gravitate toward solutions that offer immediate assistance to the displaced, neglecting refugees’ long-term needs is shortsighted.

zh: 简言之，国际社会的援助目标决不能只着眼于让人活下去，还要给移民提供一个未来。
en: Simply put, the international community’s ambition for aid must evolve beyond keeping people alive; it must also offer migrants a future.

zh: 如果能够得到合理配置，ODA能够成为预防冲突、扭转造成脆弱性的趋势的强大工具。
en: If allocated properly, ODA can be a powerful tool in preventing conflict and reversing the trends that contribute to fragility.

zh: 此外，这类支出往往是移民的希望之源，因为在许多受危机影响地区，ODA是最可靠的资金源之一。
en: Moreover, this type of spending is often a source of hope for migrants, given that in many crisis-affected areas, ODA is among the most reliable funding sources.

zh: 紧急状态保持较长时间之后尤其如此，因为拨款水平往往会随着来自其他源头的捐助的耗竭而下降。
en: That is particularly true as emergencies age, because funding levels typically drop as donations from other sources dry up.

zh: 平心而论，扭转当前ODA支出趋势绝非易事。
en: To be sure, reversing current ODA spending trends will not be easy.

zh: 脆弱性仍在以各种方式恶化，解决多样化的挑战，如暴力极端主义、气候变化、有组织犯罪和性别歧视等，需要新的发展之处指南。
en: Fragility manifests in myriad ways, and addressing challenges as diverse as violent extremism, climate change, organized crime, and gender discrimination will require a new playbook for development spending.

zh: 尽管如此，我们急需马上采取行动。
en: Still, the need for actions has become urgent.

zh: 如果放任不管，冲突、暴力和其他形式的脆弱性将让发展收益倒退几十年，进一步助长一开始导致动荡的因素。
en: If unaddressed, conflict, violence, and other forms of fragility will set development gains back decades, further fueling the very dynamics that lead to instability in the first place.

zh: 除非国际社会改变在脆弱地区的投资方针，否则世界将一直无法实现联合国可持续目标的关键目标之一：一个都不能少。
en: Unless the international community changes its approach to investing in fragile regions, the world will fail to achieve a key objective of the UN Sustainable Development Goals: to leave no one behind.

zh: 将支出花在长期方案上还能带来财务回报。
en: Spending on long-term solutions also makes financial sense.

zh: 据联合国和世界银行数据，如果配置更多资金给冲突预防计划，每年可节最多700亿美元约难民安置成本。
en: According to the UN and World Bank, if more money were allocated to conflict-prevention programs, up to $70 billion could be saved annually in refugee-relocation costs.

zh: 世界已经接受了高性价比的医疗预防（比如通过推动定期筛查实现 ） ， 但同样的方法尚未用于移民决策。
en: While the world has accepted the premise of cost-effective prevention in health care (by promoting regular screenings and checkups, for example), this philosophy has yet to be applied to policymaking on migration.

zh: 这可以也应该有所改变。
en: This can and should change.

zh: 全球移民危机 — — 第二次世界大战以来最严重的危机 — — 吞噬了为数巨大的金融和政治资本。
en: The global migration crisis – the worst since the end of World War II – has consumed huge sums of financial and political capital.

zh: 要有效解决这一危机，必须将重点转向增进移民来源地的稳定与安全以及对未来的希望上。
en: To address it effectively, the focus must shift to improving stability and security, and hope for better futures, in the places where migrants originate.

zh: 而这意味着发展界，特别是官方捐助，必须反思重点和政策。
en: And that means the development community, and especially official donors, must rethink their priorities and policies.

zh: 结束核罪恶
en: Ending Nuclear Evil

zh: 开普敦 — — 消灭核武器是世界人民的民主愿望。
en: CAPE TOWN – Eliminating nuclear weapons is the democratic wish of the world’s people.

zh: 但目前所有核国家似乎都尚未准备好在未来消除这些可怕的装置。
en: Yet no nuclear-armed country currently appears to be preparing for a future without these terrifying devices.

zh: 事实上，所有核国家都为实现核力量现代化豪掷数十亿美元，从而导致联合国裁军承诺成为嘲笑的对象。
en: In fact, all are squandering billions of dollars on modernization of their nuclear forces, making a mockery of United Nations disarmament pledges.

zh: 如果我们容忍这样的疯狂继续下去，这些恐怖武器的最终应用似乎是不可避免的。
en: If we allow this madness to continue, the eventual use of these instruments of terror seems all but inevitable.

zh: 日本福岛电厂的核能危机以残酷的方式提醒人们，被认为不太可能的事情也是会发生的。
en: The nuclear power crisis at Japan’s Fukushima power plant has served as a dreadful reminder that events thought unlikely can and do happen.

zh: 这次大规模的悲剧之后，某些领导人已经采取行动，避免世界其他地方的核反应堆发生类似灾难。
en: It has taken a tragedy of great proportions to prompt some leaders to act to avoid similar calamities at nuclear reactors elsewhere in the world.

zh: 但他们不应等到又一次广岛或长崎（甚至更大的灾难）发生后才最终警醒，意识到核裁军的迫切需要。
en: But it must not take another Hiroshima or Nagasaki – or an even greater disaster – before they finally wake up and recognize the urgent necessity of nuclear disarmament.

zh: 本周，美、俄、英、法、中等五大有核国家外长将齐聚巴黎，就去年在《核不扩散条约》审议大会上所做核裁军承诺的执行状况进行探讨。
en: This week, the foreign ministers of five nuclear-armed countries – the United States, Russia, Britain, France, and China – will meet in Paris to discuss progress in implementing the nuclear-disarmament commitments that they made at last year’s Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) review conference.

zh: 这次会议将考验他们实现未来无核愿景的坚定程度。
en: It will be a test of their resolve to transform the vision of a future free of nuclear arms into reality.

zh: 如果真心希望防止这些可怕武器扩散，避免它们的使用，五大有核国家就会为迅速彻底消灭核武器而精诚合作。
en: If they are serious about preventing the spread of these monstrous weapons – and averting their use – they will work energetically and expeditiously to eliminate them completely.

zh: 核武器零标准必须适用于所有国家。
en: One standard must apply to all countries: zero.

zh: 核武器是邪恶的化身，无论它们由谁掌控。
en: Nuclear arms are wicked, regardless of who possesses them.

zh: 无论印有哪国国旗，它们所带来的无以言表的人类痛苦都不会发生变化。
en: The unspeakable human suffering that they inflict is the same whatever flag they may bear.

zh: 只要这些武器存在，那么它们因为偶然或纯粹疯狂而被使用的可能性就不会消除。
en: So long as these weapons exist, the threat of their use – either by accident or through an act of sheer madness – will remain.

zh: 我们不应容忍核种族隔离制度，上述制度允许某些国家拥有核武器，但显然不接受其他国家获取核武器的意图。
en: We must not tolerate a system of nuclear apartheid, in which it is considered legitimate for some states to possess nuclear arms but patently unacceptable for others to seek to acquire them.

zh: 如此双重标准显然不是世界和平与安全的基础。
en: Such a double standard is no basis for peace and security in the world.

zh: 《核不扩散条约》并非五大原有核国家无限期持有核武器的执照。
en: The NPT is not a license for the five original nuclear powers to cling to these weapons indefinitely.

zh: 国际法庭已经确认它们必须履行善意谈判、彻底消除核武器的法律义务。
en: The International Court of Justice has affirmed that they are legally obliged to negotiate in good faith for the complete elimination of their nuclear forces.

zh: 尽管新订立的美俄《削减战略核武器条约 》 （ START）向正确的方向迈出了重要步骤，但较之前冷战对手满满当当的核武库（占全球核武器总量的95 % ） 而言也只是九牛一毛。
en: The New START agreement between the US and Russia, while a step in the right direction, will only skim the surface off the former Cold War foes’ bloated nuclear arsenals – which account for 95% of the global total.

zh: 此外，上述及其他国家核现代化行为与它们自称支持无核世界的许诺并不相符。
en: Furthermore, these and other countries’ modernization activities cannot be reconciled with their professed support for a world free of nuclear weapons.

zh: 美国在年度常规的500亿美元核武预算之外追加1850亿美元扩充核武库存的做法非常令人担忧。
en: It is deeply troubling that the US has allocated $185 billion to augment its nuclear stockpile over the next decade, on top of the ordinary annual nuclear-weapons budget of more than $50 billion.

zh: 同样令人不安的是五角大楼力促研发装配核武器的无人驾驶飞机 — — 此类飞机可以通过远程控制投掷氢弹。
en: Just as unsettling is the Pentagon’s push for the development of nuclear-armed drones – H-bombs deliverable by remote control.

zh: 俄国也宣布了一项大规模核武器现代化计划，其中包括部署若干新型运载系统。
en: Russia, too, has unveiled a massive nuclear-weapons modernization plan, which includes the deployment of various new delivery systems.

zh: 与此同时，英国政界人士也在寻求更新海军老化的三叉戟潜艇编队，该项目的预计开支高达760亿英镑（合1210亿美元 ） 。
en: British politicians, meanwhile, are seeking to renew their navy’s aging fleet of Trident submarines – at an estimated cost of £76 billion ($121 billion).

zh: 在采取上述行动的同时，他们放弃了领导核裁军的历史性机会。
en: In doing so, they are passing up an historic opportunity to take the lead on nuclear disarmament.

zh: 投资于国家核武库的每一块美元都在分流学校、医院和其他社会服务本应分得的资源，偷走全球成百上千万人的温饱和基本医疗服务。
en: Every dollar invested in bolstering a country’s nuclear arsenal is a diversion of resources from its schools, hospitals, and other social services, and a theft from the millions around the globe who go hungry or are denied access to basic medicines.

zh: 政府不应把资金投向制造血光之灾的武器，而应把资源投向满足人类的需求。
en: Instead of investing in weapons of mass annihilation, governments must allocate resources towards meeting human needs.

zh: 消除核武器领域的唯一障碍是缺乏政治意愿，上述问题我们能够、而且应当克服。
en: The only obstacle we face in abolishing nuclear weapons is a lack of political will, which can – and must – be overcome.

zh: 三分之二的联合国成员呼吁签订与现有条约相似的核武条约，特别取缔包括生物、化学、人员杀伤地雷和集束炸弹在内的其他类型的非人道和肆意杀伤性武器。
en: Two-thirds of UN member states have called for a nuclear-weapons convention similar to existing treaties banning other categories of particularly inhumane and indiscriminate weapons, from biological and chemical arms to anti-personnel land mines and cluster munitions.

zh: 这样的协定不仅可行，而且已经非常紧迫。
en: Such a treaty is feasible and must be urgently pursued.

zh: 核武器的确已经存在，但这并不意味着核裁军只是个不可能实现的梦想。
en: It is true that nuclear weapons cannot be uninvented, but that does not mean that nuclear disarmament is an impossible dream.

zh: 我自己的国家南非就在20世纪90年代放弃了核武器，我们意识到没有这些武器可以过得更好。
en: My own country, South Africa, gave up its nuclear arsenal in the 1990’s, realizing it was better off without these weapons.

zh: 大约在同一时期，白俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦和乌克兰等新独立国家也自愿放弃了掌握的核武器，加入到《核不扩散条约》当中。
en: Around the same time, the newly independent states of Belarus, Kazakhstan, and Ukraine voluntarily relinquished their nuclear arms, and then joined the NPT.

zh: 还有其他国家也已放弃核武器计划，认识到核武计划不可能产生积极作用。
en: Other countries have abandoned nuclear-weapons programs, recognizing that nothing good could possibly come from them.

zh: 全球核武器库存已经从冷战高峰��的68,000枚核弹头下降到了今天的20,000枚左右。
en: Global stockpiles have dropped from 68,000 warheads at the height of the Cold War to 20,000 today.

zh: 最终，所有政府都会意识到用核武器威胁毁灭整座城市在根本上具有非人道主义的特征。
en: In time, every government will come to accept the basic inhumanity of threatening to obliterate entire cities with nuclear weapons.

zh: 他们会齐心协力创造一个没有核武器的世界，在上述世界中法治而非暴力才是至高无上的准则，合作才是实现国际和平最好的担保。
en: They will work to achieve a world in which such weapons are no more – where the rule of law, not the rule of force, reigns supreme, and cooperation is seen as the best guarantor of international peace.

zh: 但只有全世界民众敢于挑战核疯狂行径，这样的世界才能最终变成现实。
en: But such a world will be possible only if people everywhere rise up and challenge the nuclear madness.

zh: 直面新闻业的直男癌
en: Confronting Journalism’s Misogynistic Trolls

zh: 伦敦—在互联网掀起新闻采集和分享的革命之前，记者很少需要担心虚拟暴力的威胁。
en: LONDON – Before the Internet revolutionized how news was gathered and shared, journalists rarely had to worry about the threat of virtual violence.

zh: 他们面临的风险都在现实生活中：报道灾难和冲突所带来的身体和心理安全顾虑。
en: The main risks they faced were in the field: the physical and psychological safety concerns of reporting on disaster and conflict.

zh: 但今天的媒体战场日益搬到了线上，而比过去更甚的是，妇女遭到了猛烈攻击。
en: But today’s media battlefields are increasingly online, and more than ever, it is women who are coming under fire.

zh: 据英国智库德莫斯（Demos）的数据，女记者在推特上遭到攻击性评论的可能性是男同事的三倍，攻击者经常用不雅用语（如“荡妇”和“婊子 ” ） 攻击他们的目标。
en: According to Demos, a UK-based think tank, female journalists are three times more likely than their male counterparts to be targeted by abusive comments on Twitter, with perpetrators frequently using sexualized language (such as “slut” and “whore”) against their targets.

zh: 2016年，欧洲安全与合作组织发布的研究表明，女媒体从业者是国际性别威胁的主要目标，并指出攻击“对她们的安全和未来在线活动造成直接影响。 ”
en: In 2016, the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe published research showing that women working in the media were internationally and disproportionately targeted by gendered threats, noting that the abuse had “a direct impact on their safety and future online activities.”

zh: 针对女媒体工作者的暴力威胁常常会波及家人，而攻击的私密性 — — 常常发到她们新闻职场之外的个人设备上 — — 加剧了这一影响。
en: The threats of violence against women working in the media often extend to family members, and the intimate nature of the attacks, received as they are on personal devices outside the professional parameters of the newsroom, also heightens the impact.

zh: 在这里，我们看到虚拟、身体和心理的安全前线已经浑然一体。
en: Here we see the blurring of virtual, physical, and psychological frontlines of safety.

zh: 这种“数字硫酸”并非新鲜事，但“直男癌”的调门显然在提高。
en: While this digital vitriol is not new, the misogynistic tenor is clearly deepening.

zh: 除非媒体高管们开始严肃对待这些趋势，否者女记者很有可能被噤声。
en: Unless media executives begin to take these trends seriously, the voices of women journalists could be silenced.

zh: 女记者经常在线上被盯上的另一条路径是破坏她们的工作或败坏她们的名声。
en: Another way in which women journalists are frequently targeted online is through the undermining of their work or reputation.

zh: 已经有证据表明，女记者开始自我审查，不再撰写某些问题的报道，特别是基于权利的问题和影响到边缘群体的问题。
en: Already there is evidence that women are self-censoring and drawing back from writing about certain issues, specifically rights-based issues and those affecting marginalized communities.

zh: 但这样一来，弱势群体的声音也就听不到了。
en: But, by doing this, the voices of the vulnerable are also silenced.

zh: 诚然，有一些女性对暴力进行回击，拒绝向直男癌低头。
en: To be sure, some women are fighting back against the violence and refusing to let the trolls win.

zh: 瑞典裔希腊记者亚力桑德拉·帕斯卡利都（Alexandra Pascalidou）因为其对人权问题的报道而受到线上线下威胁，她公开谈论自己的经验，甚至公开原谅了一位煽动对她采取暴力的新纳粹分子。
en: Alexandra Pascalidou, a Swedish-Greek journalist who has experienced threats online and offline for her work covering human-rights issues, has spoken openly about her experiences and has even publicly forgiven one of the neo-Nazis who ran a campaign of abuse against her.

zh: 帕斯卡利都在去年年底举行的News Xchange媒体会议上发言，说任期人们对她和其他女记者经常会遇到的暴力的关注是她的“责任 ” 。
en: Speaking at the News Xchange media conference late last year, Pascalidou described it as her “duty” to bring attention to the abuse she and other female journalists regularly endure.

zh: “我们需要跟多人像我们一样 ， ” 她说 ， “ 只要我们人数不够多，他们就更容易吓到我们。
en: “What we need is more people like us,” she said. “As soon as we are few, it is easier for them to scare us.”

zh: 前CNN战地记者玛利亚·雷萨（Maria Ressa）同样心直口快。
en: Maria Ressa, a former CNN war correspondent, is equally outspoken.

zh: 作为菲律宾在线新闻组织Rappler.com创始人兼首席执行官，自2016年 以来她成为语言性骚扰活动的目标。
en: The founder and CEO of Rappler.com, an online news organization in the Philippines, she has been the target of a campaign of sexualized harassment since 2016.

zh: 雷萨已经记不清受到过多少次威胁，她说，她报道真刀真枪的冲突的经验都让她对针对她的她的Rappler同事的暴力规模之大措手不及。
en: Ressa has lost count of the number of death threats she has received and says none of her previous experiences covering physical conflict could have prepared her for the scale of the violence directed toward her and her Rappler colleagues.

zh: 但她的反击策略可以作为认识到在线羞辱的严重性的媒体领导者的蓝图。
en: But she is fighting back with a strategy that could well serve as a blueprint for media leaders who recognize the severity of online harassment.

zh: 她的策略之一通过新闻调查认识攻击者，并公开要求社交媒体平台加大力度制止攻击行为并承认攻击对受害者造成的心理影响。
en: Among the tactics she has used are investigative journalism to identify her abusers, and she has publicly called on social media platforms to do more to counter abuse and acknowledge the psychological impact it has on victims.

zh: 不幸的是，大部分在线上遭到威胁的女记者不愿意对施暴者奋起反击。
en: Unfortunately, most female journalists bullied online are less willing to challenge their accusers.

zh: 对许多人来说，出于名誉甚至身体安全的考虑，让她们形成了一种羞耻文化，不敢采取强烈的、有尊严的回应方式。
en: For many, fear of reputational or even physical harm has created a culture of shame that discourages a strong, dignified response.

zh: 沉默是可以理解的；毕竟，与魔鬼共舞只能助长在线仇恨，这样的看法有一些道理。
en: This reticence is understandable; after all, there is some truth to the argument that engaging trolls only feeds the fires of online hate.

zh: 但沉默意味着目标和她们的支持者实际上被伤害了两次 — — 第一次是被攻击者的言行伤害，第二次是被无力反击伤害。
en: But by staying silent, targets and their supporters are essentially victimized twice – first by their attacker’s words and actions, and second by the powerlessness to respond.

zh: 这是旧性别权力动态在数字时代的新形式。
en: It’s an old-fashioned form of gendered power dynamics updated for the digital age.

zh: 我认识的女记者大多都承认会在网上进行自我审查。
en: Most female journalists I know admit to self-censoring their online engagement.

zh: 更有许多人干脆放弃了推特、脸谱和Instagram等社交媒体平台，尽管她们的上司要求她们与受众“保持联系 ” 。
en: Many more have abandoned social-media platforms like Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram altogether, despite pressure from bosses to remain “connected” to audiences.

zh: 对已经功成名就的女记者来说，保持数字世界的距离也许不是什么大事。
en: For already-established female journalists, this digital distancing may not be such a big deal.

zh: 但对职业生涯刚刚起步的女记者，切断社交媒体的决定会带来职业和声誉风险。
en: But for female journalists at the start of their careers, the decision to renounce social media carries professional and reputational risks.

zh: 简言之，在线攻击者正在迫使女媒体从业者做出不可能的选择。
en: Simply put, online abusers are forcing women in the media to make impossible choices.

zh: 尽管有证据表明一些媒体高管正在努力改善性别平等 ， ， 但许多人并没有给予在线攻击应有的关注。
en: Despite evidence that some media executives are moving toward improving gender equality, many are not giving online harassment the attention it deserves.

zh: 我就这一问题与数名媒体业高管进行过交谈 — — 主要是男性媒体领导人 — — 大部分人听说自己的女同事们在数字世界面临着如此大的威胁后都惊呆了。
en: When I discussed this issue with several senior, predominantly male industry leaders, most were shocked to hear that their female colleagues felt so threatened in the digital space.

zh: 更糟糕的是，媒体高管对于如何解决这个问题束手无策。
en: Worse, the executives lacked adequate answers about how to address the problem.

zh: 认识不足部分原因在于女性将在线经历大事化小、小事化了的方式；许多人担心说出经历多少回对职业地位造成负面影响。
en: The lack of awareness is partly due to the way women minimize their online experiences; many worry that speaking out will somehow negatively affect their job status.

zh: 比如，一位女同事告诉我，她不想就一个她收到的人身攻击帖子大题小做，因为这“只是”威胁要强奸 — — 而不是一位朋友所收到的死亡威胁。
en: For example, one female colleague told me that she didn’t want to make a fuss about a harassing post she had received, because it was “only” a threat of rape – not a death threat like the one a friend had received.

zh: 另一位同事认为她的数字暴力经历不会得到严肃对待，因为它并没有在“真实世界”中发生。
en: Another colleague did not think her experience of digital violence would be taken seriously, because it had not happened in the “real world.”

zh: 我们不能责怪女性有这样的想法，但我们可以要求高管对记者的安全负更大的责任。
en: We cannot blame women for feeling this way, but we can demand more from the executives responsible for their journalists’ safety and security.

zh: 目前，大部分媒体组织都没有解决这个问题，如果其结果是更多女性离开这个行业，那么新闻业就会比现在更加偏向男性视角。
en: At the moment, most media organizations are failing to tackle the problem, and if that results in more women leaving the industry altogether, journalism will become more skewed toward male perspectives than it already is.

zh: 出于显而易见的原因，传统的不利新闻环境 — — 比如战争区 — — 受到了公众和媒体高管的大部分同理心；但敲响在线攻击的警钟并不是要淡化这些环境中的记者所面临的危险。
en: Traditionally hostile news environments – like war zones – have, for obvious reasons, drawn the bulk of sympathies from the public and media executives; raising the alarm about online harassment is not meant to diminish the dangers that journalists in these circumstances face.

zh: 但是，女记者都知道，数字攻击也会留下伤疤。
en: And yet, as any female journalist knows, digital combat leaves scars, too.

zh: 如果女性要能安然无恙地在媒体业的虚拟前沿游刃有余，就不能让她们单独战斗。
en: If women are to navigate the industry’s virtual frontlines without injury, they must not be expected to go into battle alone.

zh: 结束叙利亚战争
en: Ending the Syrian War

zh: 纽约—叙利亚目前是全世界最大的人道主义灾难和最危险的地缘政治热点。
en: NEW YORK – Syria is currently the world’s greatest humanitarian catastrophe and most dangerous geopolitical hotspot.

zh: 叙利亚人民遭遇了一场血腥屠杀，400,000多人丧生，一千万人流离失所。
en: The Syrian people are caught in a bloodbath, with more than 400,000 dead and ten million displaced.

zh: 由外部势力支持的暴力圣战组织无情地蹂躏着这个国家，鱼肉这个国家的人民。
en: Violent jihadist groups backed by outside patrons mercilessly ravage the country and prey on the population.

zh: 所有冲突各方 — — 总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权、美国及其盟友所支持的反阿萨德力量，以及伊斯兰国 — — 都犯有并且继续犯着严重的战争罪行。
en: All parties to the conflict – President Bashar al-Assad’s regime, the anti-Assad forces supported by the United States and its allies, and the Islamic State – have committed, and continue to commit, serious war crimes.

zh: 应该寻求解决之道。
en: It is time for a solution.

zh: 但解决方案必须建立在首先透明务实地找出战争根源的基础上。
en: But such a solution must be based on a transparent and realistic account of what caused the war in the first place.

zh: 按时间记录，事情是这样的。
en: The chronology is as follows.

zh: 2011年2月，叙利亚主要城市爆发和平示威，这是遍及整个地区、被称为“阿拉伯之春”的现象的一部分。
en: In February 2011, peaceful protests were staged in Syria’s major cities, amid the region-wide phenomenon dubbed the “Arab Spring.”

zh: 阿萨德政权对此的反应是暴力镇压（向示威者开枪）和改革双管齐下。
en: The Assad regime reacted with a shifting mix of violent repression (shooting at demonstrators) and offers of reform.

zh: 很快，暴力升级。
en: Soon, the violence escalated.

zh: 阿萨德的反对者指责当局不知克制地对平民使用武力，而政府宣称士兵和警察丧生证明了示威者中间有暴力圣战分子。
en: Assad’s opponents accused the regime of using force against civilians without restraint, while the government pointed to the deaths of soldiers and policeman as evidence of violent jihadists among the protestors.

zh: 可能早至2011年3月或4月，逊尼派反政府武装开始从邻国进入叙利亚。
en: It seems likely that as early as March or April 2011, Sunni anti-regime fighters and arms started to enter Syria from neighboring countries.

zh: 许多目击者报告称有外国圣战者参与针对警察的暴力袭击。
en: Many eyewitness accounts tell of foreign jihadists engaging in violent attacks on policemen.

zh: （但是，这些报告难以核实，特别是在过去近五年后的今天 ） 。
en: (Such accounts are, however, hard to confirm, especially after almost five years.)

zh: 2011年春，美国及其地区盟友试图将阿萨德赶下权力宝座，认为他将像埃及的穆巴拉克和突尼斯的本·阿里一样迅速下台。
en: The US and its regional allies tried to nudge Assad from power in the spring of 2011, thinking that he would fall quickly like Egypt’s Hosni Mubarak and Tunisia’s Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.

zh: 许多观察者认为卡塔尔资助了叙利亚反政府活动，并利用位于多哈的半岛电视台煽动全世界反阿萨德情绪，尽管这些主张难以确认。
en: Many observers assert that Qatar funded an increase in anti-regime activity within Syria and used the Doha-based broadcaster Al Jazeera to boost anti-Assad sentiment worldwide, though such claims are hard to pin down definitively.

zh: 美国加紧了对阿萨德政权的贸易和金融制裁。
en: The US imposed a tightening noose of trade and financial sanctions on the regime.

zh: 美国外交政策的指标 — — 布鲁金斯研究所呼吁罢免阿萨德，美国媒体大肆宣传反阿萨德的内容。
en: The Brookings Institution, a bellwether of US official policy, called for Assad’s ouster, and anti-Assad propaganda in the US media soared.

zh: （此前，阿萨德在美国媒体的形象一直是相对温和的极权统治者，时任国务卿希拉里·克林顿在2011年3月时仍说，许多美国国会议员认为阿萨德是改革者。 ）
en: (Until then, Assad was considered in the US media to be a relatively benign, albeit authoritarian, ruler, and then-Secretary of State Hillary Clinton noted as late as March 2011 that many in the US Congress regarded Assad as a reformer.)

zh: 开战可以追溯到2011年8月18日，美国总统奥巴马和克林顿宣布“阿萨德必须下台 ” 。
en: The launch of the war can be dated to August 18, 2011, when President Barack Obama and Clinton declared that “Assad must go.”

zh: 那时，暴力仍是可控的。
en: Up to that point, the violence was still containable.

zh: 总死亡人数（包括平民和战斗人员）也许在2,900左右（根据一项反对派的统计 ） 。
en: Total deaths, including both civilians and combatants, ran perhaps to around 2,900 (according to one tally by regime opponents).

zh: 8月份之后，死亡人数开始飙升。
en: After August, the death rate soared.

zh: 时不时有人说，当时美国并未采取强力行动。
en: It is sometimes claimed that the US did not act vigorously at this point.

zh: 总体而言，奥巴马的政敌抨击他没有采取什么行动，而不是采取了过多的行动。
en: Obama’s political foes generally attack him for having taken too little action, not too much.

zh: 但美国确实行动起来推翻阿萨德，尽管大部分行动为秘密进行并且通过盟友完成，特别是沙特阿拉伯和土耳其（尽管两国不需要刺激就会干预叙利亚 ） 。
en: But the US did in fact act to topple Assad, albeit mostly covertly and through allies, especially Saudi Arabia and Turkey (though neither country needed much prodding to intervene).

zh: 中央情报局和沙特阿拉伯秘密地协调着它们的行动。
en: The CIA and Saudi Arabia covertly coordinated their actions.

zh: 当然，理顺叙利亚战争发展顺序不等于解释了这场战争。
en: Of course, the chronology of the war does not explain it.

zh: 要想提供解释，我们需要考察关键行动方的动机。
en: For that, we need to examine the motivations of the key actors.

zh: 首先，叙利亚战争是一场代理战争，牵涉到的各方主要是美国、俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和伊朗。
en: First and foremost, the war in Syria is a proxy war, involving mainly the United States, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Iran.

zh: 美国及其盟友沙特阿拉伯和土耳其2011年发动这场战争是为了颠覆阿萨德政权。
en: The US and its allies, Saudi Arabia and Turkey, started the war in 2011 in order to overthrow Assad’s regime.

zh: 美国阵营受到了俄罗斯和伊朗的日渐加强的反制，后两者的黎巴嫩代理军真主党与阿萨德政府并肩作战。
en: The US alliance was met with escalating counterforce by Russia and Iran, whose Lebanese proxy army Hezbollah is fighting alongside Assad’s government.

zh: 美国之所以对推翻阿萨德政权感兴趣，正是因为后者仰仗伊朗和俄罗斯的支持。
en: The US interest in overthrowing Assad’s regime was precisely its reliance on Iranian and Russian backing.

zh: 解决掉阿萨德，美国安全官员相信，能够削弱伊朗，打击真主党，遏制俄罗斯的地缘政治势力范围。
en: Removing Assad, US security officials believed, would weaken Iran, undermine Hezbollah, and roll back Russia’s geopolitical reach.

zh: 美国的盟友，包括土耳其、沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔，则意在用逊尼派领导的政权取代阿萨德的阿拉维派政权（阿拉维派是什叶派的分支 ） 。
en: America’s allies, including Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar, were interested in replacing Assad’s Alawite regime in Syria with a Sunni-led regime (Alawites are a branch of Shia Islam).

zh: 它们相信，这也将削弱它们的地区竞争对手伊朗，并在总体上进一步遏制什叶派在中东的影响。
en: This, they believed, would also weaken their regional competitor, Iran, and curtail Shia influence in the Middle East more generally.

zh: 认定阿萨德很容易推翻，美国 — — 这不是第一次 — — 依赖其自身的宣传。
en: In believing that Assad would be easily overthrown, the US – not for the first time – was relying on its own propaganda.

zh: 阿萨德政权面临的深深的反对，但也拥有大量内部支持。
en: The regime faced deep opposition, but also had considerable internal support.

zh: 更重要的是，阿萨德政权拥有强大的盟友，主要是伊朗和俄罗斯。
en: More important, the regime had powerful allies, notably Iran and Russia.

zh: 认为伊朗和俄罗斯不会有所反应是幼稚的。
en: It was naive to believe that neither would respond.

zh: 公众应该认识到中央情报局领导的战斗的肮脏性质。
en: The public should appreciate the dirty nature of the CIA-led fight.

zh: 美国及其盟友向叙利亚派出大量逊尼派圣战分子，正如20世纪80年代美国向阿富汗派出大量圣战分子（圣战游击队）并在日后演变为基地组织。
en: The US and its allies flooded Syria with Sunni jihadists, just as the US had flooded Afghanistan in the 1980s with Sunni jihadists (the Mujahideen) that later became Al Qaeda.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯、土耳其、卡塔尔以及美国时不时支持某些最暴力的圣战组织，犬儒主义地错误地计划让这些代理人替它们干脏活，然后再把他们踢出局。
en: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Qatar, and the US have regularly backed some of the most violent jihadist groups in a cynical miscalculation that these proxies would do their dirty work and then somehow be pushed aside.

zh: 据美国和欧洲主流媒体的说法，俄罗斯军事干预叙利亚是狡诈的扩张主义。
en: According to the US and European mainstream media, Russia’s military intervention in Syria is treacherous and expansionist.

zh: 事实并非如此。
en: The truth is different.

zh: 根据联合国宪章，美国无权组织联盟，招募雇佣兵和走私重武器以推翻另一个国家的政府。
en: The US is not allowed under the UN Charter to organize an alliance, fund mercenaries, and smuggle heavy weapons to overthrow another country’s government.

zh: 从这个角度讲，俄罗斯是在应对（react ） ， 而非行动（act ） 。
en: Russia in this case is reacting, not acting.

zh: 它是在应对美国对其盟友的挑衅。
en: It is responding to US provocations against its ally.

zh: 结束战争需要坚守六个原则。
en: Ending the war requires adherence to six principles.

zh: 首先，美国应该结束公开和隐蔽的颠覆阿萨德政府的活动。
en: First, the US should cease both overt and covert operations to overthrow Syria’s government.

zh: 其次，联合国安理会应该实施目前正在谈判中的停火，呼吁所有国家，包括美国、俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯、土耳其、卡塔尔和伊朗在内，停止武装和资金支持叙利亚境内的军事力量。
en: Second, the UN Security Council should implement the ceasefire now under negotiation, calling on all countries, including the US, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Qatar, and Iran, to stop arming and funding military forces within Syria.

zh: 第四，所有准军事活动都应该停止，包括所谓的受美国支持的“温和派”的活动。
en: Third, all paramilitary activities should cease, including those of so-called “moderates” backed by the US.

zh: 第四，美国和俄罗斯 — — 事实上，还有联合国安理会 — — 应该要求叙利亚政府严格停止针对政权反对者的惩罚行为。
en: Fourth, the US and Russia – and, indeed, the UN Security Council – should hold Syria’s government strictly responsible to desist from punitive actions against regime opponents.

zh: 第五，政治转型应该逐渐进行，并辅之以各方信心建设，而不是通过武断匆忙地进行的“自由选举 ” 。
en: Fifth, the political transition should take place gradually and with confidence building on all sides, rather than through an arbitrary, destabilizing rush to “free elections.”

zh: 最后，应该向海湾国家、土耳其和伊朗施压，让它们面对面地就能够确保持续和平的地区框架展开谈判。
en: Finally, the Gulf States, Turkey, and Iran should be pressed to negotiate face to face on a regional framework that can ensure lasting peace.

zh: 阿拉伯人、土耳其人和伊朗人已经共同生活几千年。
en: Arabs, Turks, and Iranians have all lived with each other for millennia.

zh: 它们，而不是外部势力，才应该是引领该地区走向稳定的力量。
en: They, not the outside powers, should lead the way to a stable order in the region.

zh: 结束金融军备竞赛
en: Ending the Financial Arms Race

zh: 美国剑桥— 人们经常问，监管者和立法者有没有修复几乎将世界打入第二场大萧条的金融系统漏洞。
en: CAMBRIDGE – People often ask if regulators and legislators have fixed the flaws in the financial system that took the world to the brink of a second Great Depression.

zh: 简短的回答是没有。
en: The short answer is no.

zh: 是的，大部分投资者、监管者、消费者甚至政客将在相当长的时间内铭记金融濒死的体验，因此像2008年剧烈崩盘这样的事件在短期内不会重演。
en: Yes, the chances of an immediate repeat of the acute financial meltdown of 2008 are much reduced by the fact that most investors, regulators, consumers, and even politicians will remember their financial near-death experience for quite some time.

zh: 完全重启鲁莽模式还得等一段时间。
en: As a result, it could take a while for recklessness to hit full throttle again.

zh: 但是，另一方面，并没有发生多少根本性改变。
en: But, otherwise, little has fundamentally changed.

zh: 危机产生的立法和监管大体上都是为了维持现状。
en: Legislation and regulation produced in the wake of the crisis have mostly served as a patch to preserve the status quo.

zh: 政客和监管者既没有政治勇气，也没有明智观点，而这些都是重返更清晰、更简单系统的必要条件。
en: Politicians and regulators have neither the political courage nor the intellectual conviction needed to return to a much clearer and more straightforward system.

zh: 在怀俄明州杰克森霍尔举行的精英央行年会演讲中，英格兰银行的安迪·霍尔丹（Andy Haldane）大声疾呼要求回归简单银行监管。
en: In his recent speech to the annual, elite central-banking conference in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, the Bank of England’s Andy Haldane made a forceful plea for a return to simplicity in banking regulation.

zh: 霍尔丹正确地指出，银行监管已从为数较少的极为具体的指导方针转变为计算风险和资本充足性的复杂得令人头晕的统计算术了。
en: Haldane rightly complained that banking regulation has evolved from a small number of very specific guidelines to mind-numbingly complicated statistical algorithms for measuring risk and capital adequacy.

zh: 立法复杂性也在显著增加。
en: Legislative complexity is growing exponentially in parallel.

zh: 在美国，1933年的格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案只有37页，而该法在70年的时间里保证了更大范围的金融稳定。
en: In the United States, the Glass-Steagall Act of 1933 was just 37 pages and helped to produce financial stability for the greater part of seven decades.

zh: 而当前的多德-弗兰克华尔街改革和消费者保护法案有848页，监管机构还得��此基础上增加几百份文档以规定更为详细的规则。
en: The recent Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act is 848 pages, and requires regulatory agencies to produce several hundred additional documents giving even more detailed rules.

zh: 把所有相关规定都加起来，该法案总规模将接近30000页。
en: Combined, the legislation appears on track to run 30,000 pages.

zh: 正如霍尔丹所指出的，即使是著名的“沃克尔规则 ” — —在较平稳的商业银行业务和风险较大的自营银行交易业务间建立一堵墙 — — 也因立法过程的消磨而大打折扣。
en: As Haldane notes, even the celebrated “Volcker rule,” intended to build a better wall between more mundane commercial banking and riskier proprietary bank trading, has been hugely watered down as it grinds through the legislative process.

zh: 这一由前美联储主席提出的简单方案被分解和稀释到了几百页厚的法律文档中。
en: The former Federal Reserve chairman’s simple idea has been co-opted and diluted through hundreds of pages of legalese.

zh: 至少问题是简单的：随着金融越变越复杂，监管者的对策是出台更复杂的规则。
en: The problem, at least, is simple: As finance has become more complicated, regulators have tried to keep up by adopting ever more complicated rules.

zh: 这是一场军备竞赛，资金不足的政府部门绝无获胜机会。
en: It is an arms race that underfunded government agencies have no chance to win.

zh: 在20世纪90年代，监管者已在私底下抱怨很难找到能够理解快速演变的衍生品市场的工作人员了。
en: Even back in the 1990’s, regulators would privately complain of the difficulty of retaining any staff capable of understanding the rapidly evolving derivatives market.

zh: 拥有一年衍生品研究经验的研究助理会被私人部门以五倍于政府可以开出的工资挖走。
en: Research assistants with one year of experience working on derivatives issues would get bid away by the private sector at salaries five times what the government could pay.

zh: 大约与此同时，即20世纪90年代中期，学术界开始发表认为现代银行业唯一有效的监管方式是某种形式的自我监管的论文。
en: Around the same time, in the mid-1990’s, academics began to publish papers suggesting that the only effective way to regulate modern banks was a form of self-regulation.

zh: 让银行自己设计自己的风险管理体系并予以有限程度的审计，然后损失超过议定参数时予以严厉惩罚。
en: Let banks design their own risk management systems, audit them to the limited extent possible, and then severely punish them if they produce a loss outside agreed parameters.

zh: 许多经济学家认为这些聪明的模型是有漏洞的，因为惩罚威胁并不可信，特别是在系统性崩溃威胁到金融系统大部的时候。
en: Many economists argued that these clever models were flawed, because the punishment threat was not credible, particularly in the case of a systemic meltdown affecting a large part of the financial system.

zh: 但论文还是大量地发表了，论文中的观点也被实行了。
en: But the papers were published anyway, and the ideas were implemented.

zh: 产生了什么结果就不用我说了。
en: It is not necessary to recount the consequences.

zh: 斯坦福大学的阿德马蒂（Anat Admati，合作者摆阔德玛佐（Peter DeMarzo ） 、 赫尔维格（Martin Hellwig）和普费勒德勒（Paul Pfleiderer ） ） 的一系列重要论文进一步阐释了最清晰、最有效的简化监管方法。
en: The clearest and most effective way to simplify regulation has been advanced in a series of important papers by Anat Admati of Stanford (with co-authors including Peter DeMarzo, Martin Hellwig, and Paul Pfleiderer).

zh: 基本要点是金融企业应该被强制以更平衡的方式为自身筹集资金，不能过度依赖债务融资。
en: Their basic point is that financial firms should be forced to fund themselves in a more balanced fashion, and not to rely so heavily on debt finance.

zh: 阿德马蒂及其同事建议采取强制金融企业通过利润留存或（若为上市公司）发行股票的方式进行股权融资的要求。
en: Admati and her colleagues recommend requirements that force financial firms to generate equity funding either through retained earnings or, in the case of publicly traded firms, through stock issuance.

zh: 目前的监管规则允许银行只持有极薄的股本缓冲，充分利用纳税人的资助，金融企业的负债率远高于典型的大型非金融企业。
en: The status quo allows banks instead to leverage taxpayer assistance by holding razor-thin equity margins, relying on debt to a far greater extent than typical large non-financial firms do.

zh: 苹果等大公司几乎一分钱债务都没有。
en: Some large firms, such as Apple, hold virtually no debt at all.

zh: 更多地依靠股本能够为银行提供强大得多的损失吸收缓冲。
en: Greater reliance on equity would give banks a much larger cushion to absorb losses.

zh: 金融业抱怨说强制进行股权融资的动作会妨碍放贷，但在一般均衡条件下这纯属无稽之谈。
en: The financial industry complains that efforts to force greater equity funding would curtail lending, but this is just nonsense in a general equilibrium setting.

zh: 尽管如此，政府在这条战线上显得颇为畏首畏尾，新的巴塞尔III规则充其量只是迈向真正变化的微小一步。
en: Nevertheless, governments have been very timid in advancing on this front, with the new Basel III rules taking only a baby step toward real change.

zh: 当然，在全球经济停滞的背景下进行金融改革立法绝非易事，因为这有可能妨碍信用扩张，将步履蹒跚的复苏打回可怕的衰退。
en: Of course, it is not easy to legislate financial reform in a stagnant global economy, for fear of impeding credit and turning a sluggish recovery into a full-blown recession.

zh: 当然，学者也会受到不作为的职责，他们当中仍然不乏认定看似精美但具有深层漏洞的完美市场模型，这类模型创造了一种安全假象，原本极易受风险侵袭的系统看起来安全无比。
en: And, surely, academics are also to blame for the inertia, with many of them still defending elegant but deeply flawed models of perfect markets that create an illusion of safety for a system that is in fact highly risk-prone.

zh: 流行的意见是允许银行发行“或有资本 ” （ 在发生系统性危机是转变为股权的债务 ） ， 该意见比承诺发生危机时严惩银行的方案可信得多。
en: The fashionable idea of allowing banks to issue “contingent capital” (debt that becomes equity in a systemic crisis) is no more credible than the idea of committing to punish banks severely in the event of a crisis.

zh: 更简单、更透明的系统最终将增加贷款、增强稳定性，而不是相反。
en: A simpler and more transparent system would ultimately lead to more lending and greater stability, not less.

zh: 让金融市场监管回归明智刻不容缓。
en: It is high time to restore sanity to financial-market regulation.

zh: 结束民族国家的神话
en: Ending the Nation-State Myth

zh: 纽约－今年秋天，大学会将一个神话作为事实教给几万名大学生。
en: NEW YORK – This fall, thousands of college students will be taught a myth presented as fact.

zh: 这个神话在过去已经对战争起到助燃作用，并可能在现在阻碍找到世界面临的最大的问题的解决方法。
en: It is a myth that has helped fuel wars and may hinder finding solutions to the world’s biggest problems.

zh: 虽然这个神话的起源扑朔迷离，但是科学已经证明了它是错误的，而且，一个全球化的世界已经认为这个神话与时代格格不入。
en: Though the origin of this myth is cloudy, science has proven its falsity, and a globalized world has rendered it anachronistic.

zh: 我在这里谈论的是民族国家的神话。
en: I am talking about the nation-state.

zh: 民族国家合并了两个观点，一个是具体的国家，另一个是模糊的民族。
en: The nation-state myth conflates two ideas, one that is concrete, the state, and one that is fuzzy, the nation.

zh: 国家的作用是很清楚的，它是使人们能够为了共同利益汇集他们的资源并动员起来抵御共同的威胁 — — 不管这些威胁是洪水还是外国军队的入侵 — — 的必要的组织原则。
en: The utility of the state is clear. It is a necessary organizing principle that allows people to pool their resources for the common good and mobilize against common threats, whether they are floods or invading armies.

zh: 国家也是法律最终的裁判者。
en: The state is also the final arbiter of law.

zh: 一部分原因是要对全球化作出回应，以及作为能源市场不断增加的财富效应的结果，国家的权力甚至还在增强 ， 。
en: State power is even on the rise, partly as a backlash to globalization and as a result of growing wealth from energy markets.

zh: 但是，将民族国家作为治理国家的基础模糊了人类最大威胁的性质。
en: But the nation-state as a basis for statecraft obscures the nature of humanity’s greatest threats.

zh: 污染、恐怖主义、流行疾病以及气候变化都是全球性的现象。
en: Pollution, terrorism, pandemics, and climate change are global phenomena.

zh: 这些现象并不尊重国家主权，因而，它们需要全球合作来加以应对。
en: They do not respect national sovereignty, and, therefore, they necessitate global cooperation.

zh: 人们对民族国家的起源并不是很清楚。
en: The origin of the nation-state idea is unclear.

zh: 大多数人认为它为巩固和合法化一个国家对一群人的统治 — — 不管这群人是由共同的语言、文化还是种族所确定 — — 提供了一个途径。
en: Most agree that it offered a way to consolidate and legitimize a state’s rule over a group of people, whether defined by a common language, culture, or ethnicity.

zh: 问题是，一个文化群体的范围很少会和一个政治实体的范围一致。
en: The problem is that the contours of a cultural community rarely coincide with a political entity.

zh: 民族统一的理想也不能解决民族内部的差异和冲突。
en: Nor does the ideal of national unity account for internal diversity and conflict.

zh: 人们在民族内部的身份是不固定的，甚至每一分钟都不同。
en: Identities within nations are fluid, even from minute to minute.

zh: 大约在15年前，我在法国的卢瓦尔河谷地区呆了一个夏天。
en: About 15 years ago, I spent a summer in France’s Loire Valley.

zh: 像许多到法国的旅行者证实的那样，法国乡下的人们认为是他们，而不是巴黎人，组成了“真正的”法国。
en: As many travelers to France will attest, people in the French countryside believe that they, not Parisians, constitute the “true” France.

zh: 在许多国家，对核心和外围的区分是很普遍的。
en: This division of core and periphery is common in many countries.

zh: 但是，我也注意到，一个人的身份在谈话的过程中都会发生改变。
en: But I also noticed that a person’s identity would change during the course of a conversation.

zh: “我们法国人”会根据话题而让位于“我们高卢人 ” ， “我们拉丁人 ” ， “我们布里多离人 ” ， “我们弗兰克斯家族”或者是“我们欧洲人 ” 。
en: “We French” would give way to “We Gauls,” “We Latins,” “We Bretons,” “We Franks,” or “We Europeans” depending on the topic.

zh: 这种不断改变的身份令人吃惊，但是，再仔细想想，这是有意义的：毕竟，夏尔·戴高乐的一个著名言论是，统治一个有246种奶酪的国家是很困难的。
en: This ever-changing identity was startling, but, on second thought, it made sense: after all, Charles de Gaulle famously said that it is difficult to govern a country with 246 types of cheese.

zh: 中国经常被认为是由汉族统治的。
en: China is often thought to be governed by the Han majority.

zh: 但是，汉族在语言、文化甚至起源上都有很多不同。
en: But this group is linguistically, culturally, and even genetically diverse.

zh: 就像作家伊恩·布鲁马（Ian Buruma）最近深入思考的那样，人们说“中国”时的意思并不明确。
en: As the author Ian Buruma recently mused, it is not clear what people mean by “China.”

zh: 台湾是一个独立的国家，但是却正式是中国的一部分。
en: Taiwan is an independent state but is officially part of China.

zh: 中国的文化和语言已经传播到了全世界。
en: Chinese culture and language has spread all over the world.

zh: 布鲁马作出结论认为 ， “ 中国”不仅仅是一个民族国家。
en: “China” is much more than just a nation-state, Buruma concludes.

zh: 台湾学者李筱峰最近论证 ， “ 中国人”这一概念是一个毫无意义的词语，它被编造用来证明统治少数民族的正当性。
en: Taiwanese scholar Lee Hsiao-feng has recently argued that the concept “Chinese” is a meaningless word that was fabricated to justify rule over minorities.

zh: 很难想象一个民族只局限于一个国家或一个国家只有一个民族。
en: It is difficult to imagine a nation that is confined to one state or a state that contains one nation.

zh: 有人认为日本就是一个民族国家的例子。
en: Some argue that Japan is an example of a nation-state.

zh: 在无数激烈的讨论中，我已经提醒过许多日本人，日本民族实际上包含了阿伊怒人、朝鲜人、中国人、菲律宾人以及琉球人。
en: In countless heated discussions, I have reminded many Japanese that the Japanese people actually comprise Ainu, Koreans, Chinese, Filipinos, and Ryuku.

zh: 这些日本人的反应总是是这样的 ： “ 是的，但是我们应该认为有一个日本民族。 ”他们甚至有一个专门考察成为日本人意味着什么的研究领域。
en: Their response is always: “Yes, but we want to believe that there is a Japanese people.”  They even have a field of study devoted to examining what it means to be Japanese.

zh: 像宗教一样，民族国家神话需要进行观念上的巨变。
en: Like religion, the nation-state myth requires a leap of faith.

zh: 日本学者萩原义久（Yoshihisa Hagiwara）认为，既然民族国家不是建立在事实基础上的，那么，民族国家神话就一定会消散，让位于我们只是作为全球共同体的一部分的个人这样一种认识。
en: Japanese scholar Yoshihisa Hagiwara argues that since it is not grounded in fact, the nation-state myth is bound to dissolve, giving way to an understanding that we are merely individuals who are part of a global community.

zh: 他悲叹日本人特别喜欢“日本的”的观点，使日本可能成为一个垂死的社会思潮的“最后的英雄 ” 。
en: He laments that the Japanese are especially fond of the idea of “Japaneseness,” making it possible that Japan may become the “last hero” of a dying ethos.

zh: 对这个观点的表达经常出现在流行文化中。
en: Expressions of this notion appear frequently in popular culture.

zh: 一个最近的信用卡��告描述了一对父子旅行到挪威去探寻他们家族的起源的故事。
en: A recent credit card commercial depicts a father and son traveling to Norway to trace their family’s origins.

zh: 在感受了当地的啤酒、食物、毛衣以及泳池后，他们发现他们的家族实际上来自瑞典。
en: After bonding over local beer, food, sweaters, and swimming, they discover their family is actually from Sweden.

zh: 如果我进行这样一个旅行，我可能会到爱尔兰，然后发现我的爱尔兰祖先最初来自苏格兰。
en: If I were to take that trip, I might have gone to Ireland to discover that my Irish ancestors were originally from Scotland.

zh: 但是，这些苏格兰人来自哪里呢？
en: But where were the Scots from?

zh: 或许横跨另一个海洋。
en: Just across another sea, perhaps.

zh: 这种起源神话会无限继续下去，直到我们找到人类的共同祖先，或者一个真正的神话 — — 在中国的一个黑蛋，在日本海的一个长矛，或者是在法国火与冰的交互作用。
en: The origin myth continues ad infinitum until we reach humanity’s common ancestor, or an actual myth – a black egg in China, a spear in the ocean in Japan, or the interaction of fire and ice in France.

zh: 如果政策制定者们打算解决现在的问题，他们的思维必须更开阔。
en: If policymakers are to address today’s problems, they must think more broadly.

zh: 或许重新检视民族国家的定义 — — 这一定义被作为国际关系的基本单位教授给全世界的学生 — — 是一个开端。
en: One place to start may be to reexamine the concept of the nation-state, which students around the world are taught is the basic unit of international relations.

zh: 在核心的现实主义力量均衡理论之外，在国际事务中引入伦理学 — — 道德哲学、人权以及非国家主体的作用 — — 应该成为国际关系课程的主流观点。
en: Beyond the core Realist theories of balance of power, an introduction to ethics in international affairs – moral philosophy, human rights, and the role of non-state actors – should be mainstreamed in international relations curricula.

zh: 像哲学家彼得·辛格（Peter Singer）在其著作《一个世界》中展现的那样，应对世界面临的最大的问题的统一战线要求进行观念上的根本转变 — — 远离狭隘，面向对利己主义的重新定义。
en: As the philosopher Peter Singer showed in his book One World, a united front against the biggest problems facing the world will require a fundamental shift in attitude – away from parochialism and toward a redefinition of self-interest.

zh: 进步的利己主义可以建立在国家的基础上，但是，利益应该被重新定义，以包含诸如《世界人权宣言》这样的公理。
en: Enlightened self-interest can be state-based, but interests would be re-defined to encompass universal principles such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

zh: 如果这些利益要获得普遍的认可，我们要永远抛弃民族国家的神话。
en: If these interests are to gain universal recognition, we will need to shed the nation-state myth once and for all.

zh: 为无尽的毒品战争画上句号
en: Ending the Never-Ending War on Drugs

zh: 发自圣保罗 — — 毒品战争已经迷失了自己的方向，而2011年也是时候抛弃这个折磨人的做法，转而推动一系列与公共卫生，人权和常识有关的新政策。
en: SAO PAULO – The war on drugs is a lost war, and 2011 is the time to move away from a punitive approach in order to pursue a new set of policies based on public health, human rights, and common sense.

zh: 这也是由我本人，墨西哥前总统欧内斯托·扎迪罗和哥伦比亚前总统塞萨尔·加维里亚共同召集成立的拉丁美洲毒品与民主委员会所取得的核心研究成果。
en: These were the core findings of the Latin American Commission on Drugs and Democracy that I convened, together with former presidents Ernesto Zedillo of Mexico and César Gaviria of Colombia.

zh: 我们对毒品事务的介入是基于一个显而易见的原因：与毒品走私有关的暴力和腐败都是拉美民主的重要威胁。
en: We became involved with this issue for a compelling reason: the violence and corruption associated with drug trafficking represents a major threat to democracy in our region.

zh: 而那种紧迫感则要求我们去评估当前政策并寻找切实可行的替代方案。
en: This sense of urgency led us to evaluate current policies and look for viable alternatives. The evidence is overwhelming.

zh: 无数的证据表明，那种着眼于打击毒品生产和吸毒罪行的封堵策略已经彻底失败了。
en: The prohibitionist approach, based on repression of production and criminalization of consumption, has clearly failed.

zh: 在奋战了30年之后，所有封堵策略最终取得的成果只不过是将毒品种植区和贩毒集团从一国赶到了另一国（所谓气球效应 ） 。
en: After 30 years of massive effort, all prohibitionism has achieved is to shift areas of cultivation and drug cartels from one country to another (the so-called balloon effect).

zh: 拉丁美洲依旧是全世界最大的可卡因和大麻出口源。
en: Latin America remains the world’s largest exporter of cocaine and marijuana.

zh: 成百上千的年轻人依然在帮派火拼中丧命。
en: Thousands of young people continue to lose their lives in gang wars.

zh: 毒品大亨还是用恐惧和暴力手段统治着所有社区。
en: Drug lords rule by fear over entire communities.

zh: 在报告的结尾我们呼唤一场模式的转换。
en: We ended our report with a call for a paradigm shift.

zh: 既然毒品消费存在一天，毒品走私就不会终结，那么与其坚持那些无法消除毒品暴利（及其影响力）的错误政策，不如将焦点转向毒品对人和社会的危害方面，最终减少毒品消费。
en: The illicit drug trade will continue as long as there is demand for drugs. Instead of sticking to failed policies that do not reduce the profitability of the drug trade – and thus its power – we must redirect our efforts to the harm caused by drugs to people and societies, and to reducing consumption.

zh: 在大多数文化的历史中都存在着某些形式的毒品消费。
en: Some kind of drug consumption has existed throughout history in the most diverse cultures.

zh: 而当今毒品已经渗透到了社会各个层面。
en: Today, drug use occurs throughout society.

zh: 形形色色的人出于五花八门的理由服食毒品：为了缓解痛楚或是获取快感，为了逃避现实或是增加对现实的感知。
en: All kinds of people use drugs for all kinds of reasons: to relieve pain or experience pleasure, to escape reality or enhance their perception of it.

zh: 但委员会在报告中所推荐的方式也不是无懈可击的。
en: But the approach recommended in the Commission’s statement does not imply complacency.

zh: 毒品损害健康，影响吸毒者的决策能力。
en: Drugs are harmful to health. They undermine users’ decision-making capacity.

zh: 分享注射器传播艾滋病及其他疾病。
en: Needle-sharing spreads HIV/AIDS and other diseases.

zh: 吸毒上瘾则导致财政困境和家庭暴力（尤其是针对儿童 ） 。
en: Addiction can lead to financial ruin and domestic abuse, especially of children.

zh: 因此尽可能地减少毒品消费将是主要目标。
en: Cutting consumption as much as possible must, therefore, be the main goal.

zh: 但这要求不能将吸毒者视为必须打击的罪犯，而是需要照顾的病人。
en: But this requires treating drug users not as criminals to be incarcerated, but as patients to be cared for.

zh: 有几个国家已经开始推行强调预防和治疗而非打击的政策 — — 并将重点放到真正的敌人身上，那就是有组织犯罪。
en: Several countries are pursuing policies that emphasize prevention and treatment rather than repression – and refocusing their repressive measures on fighting the real enemy: organized crime.

zh: 全球各国对于封堵策略的共识也在逐步分裂。
en: The crack in the global consensus around the prohibitionist approach is widening.

zh: 越来越多的欧洲和拉美国家都不再采用单一的封堵模式。
en: A growing number of countries in Europe and Latin America are moving away from a purely repressive model.

zh: 葡萄牙和瑞士在以预防，治疗和减低危害为中心的政策方面都取得了积极的成果。
en: Portugal and Switzerland are compelling examples of the positive impact of policies centered on prevention, treatment, and harm reduction.

zh: 两国都不再将个人服食毒品视为犯罪。
en: Both countries have decriminalized drug possession for personal use.

zh: 许多人都害怕这会导致毒品消费量激增，但结果却是寻求治疗者的数量不断增加，但总体毒品消费量却发生了下滑。
en: Instead of leading to an explosion of drug consumption, as many feared, the number of people seeking treatment increased and overall drug use fell.

zh: 当政策手段从打击毒品犯罪转向公共健康，吸毒者也更乐于寻求治疗。
en: When the policy approach shifts from criminal repression to public health, drug users are more open to seeking treatment.

zh: 吸毒无罪化同时也削弱了毒品贩子影响和控制吸毒者行为的能力。
en: Decriminalization of consumption also reduces dealers’ power to influence and control consumers’ behavior.

zh: 在报告中，我们建议从公共卫生的角度 — — 并以当前最尖端的医学研究为基础 — — 来评估将个人服食大麻行为无罪化的优点。
en: In our report, we recommend evaluating from a public-health standpoint – and on the basis of the most advanced medical science – the merits of decriminalizing possession of cannabis for personal use.

zh: 大麻是目前使用最为广泛的毒品，越来越多的证据显示它所造成的危害其实是与酒精与烟草的危害类似的。
en: Marijuana is by far the most widely used drug. There is a growing body of evidence suggesting that the harm it causes is at worst similar to the harm caused by alcohol or tobacco.

zh: 此外，大多数与大麻有关的危害 — — 从对吸毒者不加辨别的打击到与毒品贸易相关的暴利和腐败 — — 其实都是当前封堵政策所造成的后果。
en: Moreover, most of the damage associated with marijuana use – from the indiscriminate incarceration of consumers to the violence and corruption associated with the drug trade – is the result of current prohibitionist policies.

zh: 因此大麻无罪化则是将吸食毒品作为一种健康问题（而不是犯罪）来对待方面所迈出的重要一步。
en: Decriminalization of cannabis would thus be an important step forward in approaching drug use as a health problem and not as a matter for the criminal justice system.

zh: 为确保能取得可靠而有效的效果，大麻无罪化必须与健全的预防运动相结合。
en: To be credible and effective, decriminalization must be combined with robust prevention campaigns.

zh: 近几十年烟草消费量的持续暴跌表明公共信息发布和预防吸烟运动是有效的，只要能使目标受众所接受的信息和自身的体验相一致就行。
en: The steep and sustained drop in tobacco consumption in recent decades shows that public information and prevention campaigns can work when based on messages that are consistent with the experience of those whom they target.

zh: 烟草并未被禁止，而是贬低了形象，施加了税款并受到了管制。
en: Tobacco was de-glamorized, taxed, and regulated; it has not been banned.

zh: 至今还没有任何国家针对毒品问题制定了综合性方案。
en: No country has devised a comprehensive solution to the drug problem.

zh: 但这样一个方案并不意味着必须在禁止和合法化之间二选其一。
en: But a solution need not require a stark choice between prohibition and legalization. The worst prohibition is the prohibition to think.

zh: 毕竟这已不再是一个不可讨论的禁区。
en: Now, at last, the taboo that prevented debate has been broken.

zh: 也有一系列替代方案正在接受测试并认真检视。
en: Alternative approaches are being tested and must be carefully reviewed.

zh: 最终，人们衡量风险和在充分掌握信息的情况下做出选择的能力对于规管毒品的使用方面非常重要，也有助于体现更为人性化和高效的法律和政策。
en: At the end of the day, the capacity of people to evaluate risks and make informed choices will be as important to regulating the use of drugs as more humane and efficient laws and policies.

zh: 没错，毒品腐蚀人们的自由。
en: Yes, drugs erode people’s freedom.

zh: 但也是时候意识到那些对吸毒者的封堵政策，将偏见，恐惧和意识形态施加于他们身上，其实也是与自由的一种威胁。
en: But it is time to recognize that repressive policies towards drug users, rooted as they are in prejudice, fear, and ideology, may be no less a threat to liberty.

zh: 结束达尔福尔的悲剧
en: Ending the Tragedy of Darfur

zh: 达尔福尔持续的恶劣局势正在使其人民深受其害。
en: The critical conditions that continue to prevail in Darfur are causing immense suffering to its people.

zh: 争端双方 ― ― 苏丹政府及其联军以及达尔福尔的各反对派都必须懂得平民不能再成为他们政治分歧的受害者。
en: Both sides of the conflict – the government of Sudan and its allied forces, as well as all the opposition groups in Darfur – must understand that civilians should no longer fall victim to their political disputes.

zh: 苏丹政府同意联合国/非洲联盟派军在该地区维护和平，这是受人欢迎的进展。
en: The Sudanese government’s consent to the deployment of the hybrid United Nations/African Union mission, which aims to keep peace in the region, is of course a welcome development.

zh: 但这次行动必须享有足够强大的权力，足以给平民提供充分的保护。
en: But the mandate of this mission must be strong enough to allow for full protection of the civilian population.

zh: 而且，该部队必须有足够的人员、能力和资金，从而有效地实现这一重要目标。
en: Moreover, the force must have sufficient manpower, capacity, and funding to put this vital objective into practice efficiently.

zh: 所有为保证此次任务顺利进行而捐助资金援助的国家和组织 ― ― 特别是法国、西班牙和欧盟都应受到赞许。
en: The countries and institutions that have committed additional funds in order to help secure the success of this mission – notably France, Spain, and the European Commission – should all be applauded.

zh: 重要的是国际各方须向苏丹政府保证，联合国/非洲联盟这次行动无意使达尔福尔发生政权变更或者作出超出其维和职权范围的行动。
en: It is important for international actors to assure Sudan’s government that the UN/AU mission will not strive for regime change in the country or otherwise exceed its peacekeeping mandate.

zh: 同时，苏丹政府也必须充分认识到，只有坚持以前的承诺，并帮助联合国/非洲联盟准备、部署并维护这一行动才能得到国际社会的继续支持。
en: At the same time, the Sudanese government must be fully aware that only by adhering to past commitments and by cooperating in helping to prepare, deploy, and maintain the mission will the international community be encouraged to continue its support.

zh: 而对于达尔福尔的反对派来说，最近几位领导人跨越分歧，努力采取一致行动是一个好的动向。
en: As for the Darfur opposition, the recent efforts by some of its leaders to overcome fragmentation and re-unify their movement are a welcome development.

zh: 各主要反对派能够就其目标和谈判立场达成一致是很重要的。
en: It is essential that all major opposition groups achieve agreement about their aims and negotiating positions.

zh: 只有这样，他们才能成为国际社会以及苏丹政府的可靠伙伴。
en: Only then can they act as credible partners of the international community and the Sudanese government.

zh: 分歧各方都应认识到，解决分歧的最终途径只能是在各方同意的基础上达成的公正而长期的和平协定。
en: All parties to the conflict must realize that, ultimately, there is no way to end their dispute other than through an equitable and sustainable peace agreement endorsed by all stakeholders.

zh: 帮助那些国内移民重返家园以及对他们提供应有的关心是这些协定的一个中心环节。
en: The return of internally displaced persons and due care for them must be a core component of any such arrangement.

zh: 全世界能起作用的人们，特别是政治家和记者们，应该保持对达尔福尔的关注，那里上百万受害者以及难民每日经受的苦难依然令人恐怖。
en: Responsible people around the globe, particularly politicians and journalists, must remain focused on Darfur. For the grievances and harm suffered daily by millions of victims and refugees remain as gruesome as ever, notwithstanding the fatigue from the prolonged conflict that some may perceive.

zh: 此外，他们还经受着有些人所想见的由于长期纷争所带来的疲惫。 现在有了几个月后可能出现的稳定苗头，现在正是时候准备增加为重建和发展所提供的国际援助以及人道主义援助。
en: Now that there are signs of possible stabilization in the months to come, it is time to start preparing for increased volumes of international reconstruction and development assistance, in addition to humanitarian aid.

zh: 经济发达国家特别需要担负起国际责任，帮助达尔福尔走向复兴和发展。
en: Economically advanced countries in particular should meet their global responsibility and help Darfur move toward renewal and prosperity.

zh: 这种援助应该是国家发展合作项目的扩展或重新定位。
en: This increased assistance should emerge from an extension or re-focusing of national development cooperation programs.

zh: 另外，国际上应该仔细研究如何有效地利用协同合作这一手段。
en: Additionally, international arrangements aiming at effective use of synergies should be carefully explored.

zh: 为了加强国际社会与达尔福尔当地各派间的复杂关系，联合国积极发挥着无可替代的作用并应得到积极支持。
en: In facilitating the complex relations between the international community and the local actors in Darfur, the UN currently plays an indispensable role and must be actively supported.

zh: 中国特别应该利用其在苏丹的影响力促成该国的决策者们达成和平解决争端的确切方案。
en: China in particular should use its considerable influence in Sudan to bring the country’s decision-makers to a definitive peaceful settlement of the dispute.

zh: 另外，由于达尔福尔代表着更为广泛的难题，国际社会的眼光不应该局限于目前的争端，而应加大力度解决灾难中的危险隐患，比如气候变化以及环境恶化。
en: Moreover, because Darfur is emblematic of wider difficulties in the world, the international community must look beyond the immediate circumstances of the conflict and increase efforts to deal with the threats that have played a role in the disaster, such as climate change and environmental degradation.

zh: 确实，沙漠的加速扩大将导致附近的农业减产、水资源严重恶化，造成了更多争端以及人们的迁移。
en: Indeed, the accelerating expansion of deserts will likely lead to a decrease of agricultural yields from the surrounding areas, acute deterioration of the availability of water, and possibly to further conflicts and displacement of people.

zh: 全世界各个地区还存在着相同的情况 ― ― 也许刚刚开始存在。
en: Similar conditions exist – or may begin to exist – in several locations worldwide.

zh: 因此，在那些环境恶化已经使人们生活严重恶化的地区，这一问题的全球性应该被认识到并被重视起来。
en: So the global nature of this problem must be recognized and addressed in places where environmental degradation is already bringing about a dangerous deterioration in peoples’ lives.

zh: 一旦这些危害构成了危险，提早预防是很有必要的。
en: Where such damage looms as a threat, early prevention is required.

zh: 弥补结核病的资金缺口
en: Closing the TB Funding Gap

zh: 纽约 — — 在肺结核（TB）被宣布为全球紧急卫生事件的25年中，决策者和医疗专业人士花费了相当长的时间来讨论消除结核病的办法。
en: NEW YORK – In the 25 years since tuberculosis (TB) was declared a global-health emergency, policymakers and health-care professionals have devoted considerable time discussing ways to eliminate it.

zh: 仅过去两年中，他们就在莫斯科、布鲁塞尔、新德里以及最近纽约召开的联合国大会上进行了讨论，他们在那里召开了有史以来探讨结核病控制问题的首次高级别会议。
en: Over the last two years alone, they have held talks in Moscow, Brussels, New Delhi, and, most recently, in September at the United Nations General Assembly in New York, where they convened for the first-ever high-level meeting on TB containment.

zh: 尽管领导人普遍赞同投资解决方案的必要性，但令人意想不到的是，在人类长达1/4个世纪抗击结核病的斗争中，我们鲜有治疗结核病的药物可供展示。
en: But while leaders generally agree on the need to invest in solutions, we have surprisingly few TB medicines to show for our quarter-century of effort.

zh: 自1993年来感染结核病的2.5亿人 — — 以及数百万因此失去宝贵生命的患者 — — 本应该得到更好的待遇。
en: The 250 million people who have been infected since 1993 – and the millions who have died – deserved better.

zh: 结核病是全世界最致命的传染病，人类有着与结核病抗争的漫长历史。
en: TB is the world’s deadliest infection, and it has been with us for a very long time.

zh: 研究人员推测大约5，000年前，人类首次在非洲感染结核病，而后这种疾病迅速沿着贸易路线传播到全球几乎每一个角落。
en: Researchers theorize that humans first acquired TB in Africa about 5,000 years ago, and that the disease then swiftly spread along trade routes to nearly every corner of the globe.

zh: 今天，结核病是全世界最主要的致死原因，仅2017年就造成约160万人死亡，仅略低于前一年的死亡人数。
en: Today, TB is among the world’s leading causes of death, killing approximately 1.6 million people in 2017, which was only slightly fewer than the year before.

zh: 但结核病治疗的有效性正在下降，从而引起了人们对耐药菌株正在变得更具毒性的担忧。
en: But the effectiveness of TB treatments is declining, raising concerns that drug-resistant strains are becoming more virulent.

zh: 鉴于这个问题的普遍性和严重性，结核病已不仅仅限于医学问题的范畴。
en: Given its prevalence and seriousness, TB is not purely a medical problem.

zh: 这种疾病导致发展中国家贫困长期存在，因为患者及其家人必须常规性地将高达半数的收入用于购买药品和获取医疗服务。
en: The disease perpetuates poverty in developing countries, because patients and their families must routinely spend up to half of their income buying medicines and managing care.

zh: 但随着耐药型结核病的不断蔓延，上述开支并不总能取得效果。
en: And yet, with drug-resistant forms of TB spreading, these expenditures do not always yield results.

zh: 截止2050年，耐药型结核病可能导致全球经济被迫承担16.7万亿美元的医疗开支和工资损失 — — 大致相当于整个欧盟的经济产出。
en: By 2050, drug‐resistant TB could cost the global economy as much as $16.7 trillion in medical expenses and lost wages – roughly the equivalent of the European Union’s entire economic output.

zh: 可以肯定，世界各国仍有可能赢得这场针对结核病的战争。
en: To be sure, the world can still win the war on TB.

zh: 研究人员正在锁定更加有效的药物治疗方案，更先进的诊断工具和可行的疫苗。
en: Researchers are closing in on more effective drug regimens, better diagnostics tools, and viable vaccines.

zh: 但如果没有研发支出的大幅增加，我们仍然无法真正越过终点线。
en: Still, we cannot get over the finish line without a significant increase in research and development spending.

zh: 据世界卫生组织统计，结核病研发的年度资金缺口超过13亿美元。 而制药行业缺乏市场激励机制则导致这种短缺进一步加剧。
en: According to the World Health Organization, the annual funding deficit for TB research and development is more than $1.3 billion, a shortfall that is exacerbated by a lack of market incentives within the pharmaceutical industry.

zh: 尽管结核病覆盖全球各地，但三分之二的2017年新发病例仅仅出现在八个国家 — — 印度、中国、印度尼西亚、菲律宾、巴基斯坦、尼日利亚、孟加拉和南非。
en: Despite TB’s global reach, two-thirds of new cases in 2017 occurred in just eight countries – India, China, Indonesia, the Philippines, Pakistan, Nigeria, Bangladesh, and South Africa.

zh: 由于制药企业显然不愿或无法单方面承担研发成本，富国和穷国必须合作来填补这一空白。
en: With drug makers apparently unwilling or unable to fund development costs unilaterally, rich and poor countries must collaborate to fill the gap.

zh: 研发负担必须由公共和私营部门共同承担，而作为研发成果的治疗方法必须得到普遍的采用。
en: The R&D burden must be shared among the public and private sectors, and resulting treatments must be universally adopted and available.

zh: 我们的目标应当是确保所有需要药物的人都能够以低廉的价格拿到它；其中包括高危人群，如医疗卫生工作者、艾滋病毒/艾滋病感染者，结核病是导致后者死亡的主要原因。
en: The goal should be to ensure that medicines are accessible and affordable for anyone who needs them; this includes high-risk populations such as health-care workers, as well as people living with HIV/AIDS, for whom TB is a leading cause of death.

zh: 9月举行的高级别会议旨在激发世界根除结核病的热情。
en: The high-level meeting in September was meant to galvanize the world’s TB-eradication efforts.

zh: 但不幸的是，关于制药企业知识产权的争论使得会议召开前罕见的政治团结蒙上了一层阴影。
en: Unfortunately, the rare political unity in the lead-up to the discussion was overshadowed by a debate about drug makers’ intellectual-property rights.

zh: 虽然在联合国会议结束时通过的一项声明的确达成了某种妥协，但结核病治疗工作实际并没有摆脱困境：如何在保障制药企业研发资金流的同时，确保患者 — — 尤其是最贫困的患者 — — 能够获得药品。
en: While the declaration endorsed at the end of the UN meeting did offer a compromise, the quandary remains: how can we guarantee access to medications – especially for the poorest patients – while maintaining funding streams for pharmaceutical R&D?

zh: 我们必须始终强调患者的需求。
en: Patients’ needs must always be emphasized.

zh: 但我们也无法简单地忽视知识产权在创造新疗法中所发挥的作用。
en: But we cannot simply ignore the role that intellectual property plays in the creation of new treatments.

zh: 为在结核病领域实现恰当的平衡，国际社会必须通过向外界展示9月所达成的 财务领导协议来重新致力于研发活动。
en: To strike the right balance with TB, the international community must recommit to R&D initiatives by showing the financial leadership agreed upon in September.

zh: 在最佳状态下，该协议将补充所谓的产品研发伙伴关系，而上述关系已经协助解决了包括结核病在内的许多被忽视的疾病。
en: In the best-case scenario, that agreement will supplement the so-called product development partnerships that have already helped tackle many neglected diseases, including TB.

zh: 去年， 据估计有360万结核病感染者无法获得治疗，这一惊人的覆盖差距必须迅速得到纠正。
en: Last year, an estimated 3.6 million people infected with TB were unable to access treatment, a staggering gap in coverage that must be quickly closed.

zh: 我们在追加研发资金和强化治疗合作的过程中等待的时间越长，就会导致结核病死亡人数不断攀升。
en: The longer we wait to increase R&D funding and strengthen collaboration on treatment, the higher TB’s death toll will climb.

zh: 因为如此众多的生命正受到威胁，坐而论道的时间已经结束。
en: With so many lives at stake, the time for talking is over.

zh: 如何结束委内瑞拉的噩梦
en: How to End Venezuela’s Nightmare

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 坐等问题自己消失很少是一种有效的策略。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Wishing a problem away is seldom an effective strategy.

zh: 在国际社会关注其他问题的同时，委内瑞拉的灾难已进一步加剧。
en: While the international community has had its attention focused on other issues, the Venezuelan catastrophe has deepened.

zh: 如果任由目前趋势持续下去，只会迎来更糟糕的结果。
en: If current trends continue, it will only get worse.

zh: 一天工资的中位数现在只能购买1.7个鸡蛋或一公斤木薯等最廉价的卡路里。
en: A day’s work at the median wage now buys 1.7 eggs or a kilogram of yuca, the cheapest available calorie.

zh: 一公斤当地产的奶酪需要18天的中位数工资；而一公斤肉取决于打折多少，则需要将近一个月。
en: A kilogram of local cheese costs 18 days of median-wage work; a kilo of meat costs almost a month, depending on the cut.

zh: 十三个月来，物价一直以恶性通胀的速度直线上升，而本月则有望超过标志性的1，000，000 % 。
en: Prices have been rising at hyperinflationary rates for 13 straight months and inflation is on track to surpass the 1,000,000% mark this month.

zh: 产出继续直线下降：2018年10月的石油输出国组织报告显示产量同比下降37 % ， 也就是每天近70万桶。
en: Output continues to fall like a stone: OPEC reports that in October 2018, production was down 37% year on year, or almost 700,000 barrels a day.

zh: 据非政府机构联盟 Alianza Salud统计，2018年的新增疟疾病例自2012年以来猛增高达12倍，总患病人数超过60万，占美洲全部病例的54 % 。
en: According to Alianza Salud, a coalition of NGOs, new malaria cases in 2018 have shot up by a factor of 12 since 2012, bringing the total to more than 600,000, which is 54% of all cases in the Americas.

zh: 大片的委内瑞拉领土已经被犯罪组织所占据，其中包括哥伦比亚的哥伦比亚革命武装力量（FARC）以及哥伦比亚民族解放军（ELN ） ， 这些组织勾结国民卫队生产黄金和钶钽铁矿，以及从事毒品贩运。
en: Large swaths of Venezuela’s territory have been ceded to criminal organizations, including terrorist groups such as Colombia’s FARC and ELN, which collude with the National Guard in the production of gold and coltan, as well as in drug trafficking.

zh: 结果导致委内瑞拉民众成群结队地离开，由此造成的难民危机刷新了美洲有史以来的规模纪录，甚至可以媲美叙利亚。
en: As a result, Venezuelans have been leaving in droves, creating a refugee crisis of Syrian proportions, the biggest ever in the Americas.

zh: 鉴于Facebook报告国外有330万委内瑞拉用户，我在哈佛大学国际发展中心的研究团队估计委内瑞拉难民的总量至少在550万以上。
en: Given that Facebook reports having 3.3 million Venezuelan users abroad, my research team at the Center for International Development at Harvard University estimates that there must be at least 5.5 million overall.

zh: 在那些2017年11月仍仅从委内瑞拉国内发布推文的人中， 超过10%已经逃到了国外。
en: Of those tweeting only from Venezuela in 2017 by November over 10% had left the country.

zh: 哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁尽管进行了英勇的尝试，但在应对难民潮方面所面临的难度却在不断加大。
en: Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru, despite their valiant efforts, are facing increasing difficulties in coping with the refugee flow.

zh: 显而易见，委内瑞拉的问题无法得到解决，除非政权发生变化。
en: It is patently obvious that Venezuela’s problems will not be solved unless and until there is regime change.

zh: 归根结底，现政权和经济崩溃都是消灭基本人权的产物。
en: After all, both the regime and the economic collapse are the consequence of the elimination of basic rights.

zh: 委内瑞拉民众无法投资和生产以满足其自身的需求，因为他们的经济权力已经被剥夺了；而他们也无法改变错误的政策，因为他们的政治权利也已经被剥夺了。
en: Venezuelans cannot invest and produce to satisfy their needs, because economic rights have been taken away; and they cannot change wrongheaded policies, because their political rights have been taken away.

zh: 扭转局面将需要重新授权给委内瑞拉民众。
en: A turnaround will require the re-empowerment of Venezuelans.

zh: 幸运的是，这场噩梦即将结束，但还需要委内瑞拉民主力量与国际社会之间的协调合作。
en: Fortunately, an end is in sight to this nightmare, but it will require coordination between the Venezuelan democratic forces and the international community.

zh: 1月10日标志着尼古拉斯·马杜罗总统的任期结束，马杜罗的任期始于2013年的选举结果。
en: January 10 marks the end of President Nicolás Maduro’s term, which started with his election in 2013.

zh: 他在今年5月第二次当选是一个骗局：主要反对党及其候选人均被阻止参加竞选，而美国、加拿大、欧盟、日本和主要拉美国家，以及其他许多国家均拒绝承认选举结果。
en: His election to a second term in May of this year was a sham: the major opposition parties and their candidates were prevented from running, and the United States, Canada, the European Union, Japan, and the major Latin American countries, among many others, refused to recognize the outcome.

zh: 那也就是说，他们对马杜罗1月10日以后继续担任总统的合法性并不认可。
en: That means they do not recognize the legitimacy of Maduro’s presidency after January 10.

zh: 合乎逻辑的解决办法是由2015年12月当选的反对派占2/3多数的国民议会通过指定一届新的临时政府和一名能够组织回归民主并结束危机的新的最高军事指挥官来打破宪法僵局。
en: The logical solution is for the National Assembly, elected in December 2015 with a two-thirds opposition majority, to resolve the constitutional impasse by designating a new interim government and a new military high command that can organize the return to democracy and end the crisis.

zh: 但他们对这样做抱有极为谨慎的态度，因为他们担忧这样做的最好情况是被熟视无睹，而最坏情况则是被监禁、流放或者磨至死，或者被扔出十楼的窗户。 今年10月这样的惨剧就发生在加拉加斯市议员费尔南多·奥尔本的身上。
en: However, they are wary of doing so, because they fear that they will be ignored at best, or, at worst, jailed, exiled, or tortured to death and thrown out of a tenth-floor window, as happened in October to Fernando Albán, a Caracas city councilor.

zh: 除非武装部队尊重国民议会的决定，否则执行上述决定将是极为困难的。
en: Unless the Armed Forces respect the National Assembly’s decisions, they will be hard to enforce.

zh: 这解释了为什么该方案需要国际社会和委内瑞拉民主力量进行合作。
en: That is why this solution requires coordination between the international community and Venezuela’s democratic forces.

zh: 那些力量无法确定它们能得到多大力度的国际支持，而国际社会则并不清楚民主力量的凝聚力和计划。
en: Those forces are unsure of how much international support they will receive, and the international community is unsure of the democratic forces’ plans and cohesion.

zh: 就像任何协调问题一样，都有可能出现好坏两种自我实现的结果。
en: As with any coordination problem, there are good and bad self-fulfilling outcomes.
