zh: 目前由于国际社会尚未明确谁将在1月10日后被承认为委内瑞拉的合法政府，以及将以何种力度对其提供支持，因此委内瑞拉内部的民主力量仍然未能围绕解决方案开展合作。
en: For now, because the international community has not made clear who will be recognized as Venezuela’s legitimate government after January 10, and what level of support will be provided, Venezuela’s democratic forces have been unable to coalesce around a solution.

zh: 但委内瑞拉民众一直在为奠定变革的组织基础而不断做功课。
en: But the Venezuelans have been doing their homework and laying the organizational groundwork for change.

zh: 政党、工会、大学、非政府组织和天主教会齐聚一堂，汇聚到一个名为委内瑞拉自由行动的旗帜下。
en: Political parties, trade unions, universities, NGOs, and the Catholic Church have come together in an initiative called Venezuela Libre.

zh: 他们在委内瑞拉24个州中的每一个组织代表大会，并邀请了超过12，000名代表参加。 而且，在11月26日，他们召集了一次全国性活动，发表了一份宣言具体描绘了重回民主的路线图。
en: They have organized congresses in each of Venezuela’s 24 states, attended by over 12,000 delegates, and, on November 26, they held a national event to issue a manifesto delineating a path back to democracy.

zh: 此外，他们一直在制定详细的经济计划，该计划经过与国际社会进行充分的探讨，旨在渡过危机并实现经济恢复。
en: In addition, they have been working on a detailed economic plan, amply discussed with the international community, to overcome the crisis and restore growth.

zh: 这是国际社会迈向协调解决方案的绝佳机会：明确拒绝在1月10日后承认马杜罗政权，并同时认可国民议会关于过渡政府的决策，并协助执行它。
en: This is an excellent opportunity for the international community to move toward a coordinated solution: an explicit refusal to recognize Maduro after January 10, coupled with recognition of the National Assembly’s decisions regarding the transition government and help implementing them.

zh: 同时应当向委内瑞拉武装部队发出明确的信号：即国民议会的决定必须得到尊重。
en: And a clear message should be sent to the Venezuelan Armed Forces that the National Assembly’s decisions must be respected.

zh: 解决委内瑞拉灾难不仅符合人们的愿望，同时也是有可能的。
en: A solution to the Venezuelan catastrophe is not only desirable, but also possible.

zh: 世界绝不能眼看着这次机会白白错过。
en: The world cannot afford to let this opportunity slip.

zh: 1月10日可能成为一个新的开始。
en: January 10 can become a new beginning.

zh: 艾滋病的末日
en: The End of AIDS

zh: 纽约—从1981年到2016年，艾滋病夺走了大约3,600万人的生命，目前还有同样数量的人携带艾滋病毒。
en: NEW YORK – The AIDS pandemic claimed around 36 million lives between 1981 and 2016, and a similar number around the world currently live with the HIV virus.

zh: 去年约有120万人死于艾滋病，另有180万人被传染。
en: Some 1.2 million people died of AIDS last year, and another 1.8 million were infected.

zh: 这些数字触目惊心，但令人惊喜的消息是“没有艾滋病的一代”这一目标已经具备现实可能性。
en: Those statistics are daunting, but the startling news is that the goal of an “AIDS-Free Generation” is realistically within reach.

zh: 美国当选总统特朗普应该尽早在任期内批准所需要的措施。
en: The required policy steps should be agreed in the early days of US President-elect Donald Trump’s administration.

zh: 艾滋病能够被消灭的关键原因是一项2011年的科学发现，这项发现表明，接受抗逆转录酶（ARV）疗法的艾滋病毒阳性个体血液中的艾滋病毒数量下降非常快，通过性或共用针头途径几乎不可能将病毒传染给其他人。
en: The key reason that the epidemic can be ended is a scientific finding back in 2011 that showed that HIV-positive individuals receiving antiretroviral (ARV) treatment suppress the HIV virus in their bloodstreams so dramatically that they are very unlikely to transmit the virus to others through sex or shared needles.

zh: 这一发现确认了“以治为防”概念的正确性。
en: This finding confirmed the concept of “treatment as prevention.”

zh: 只要足够大比例的艾滋病毒阳性个体接受ARV疗法，就不但可以拯救他们的生命，还能打破病毒本身的传播链，从而消灭这一传染病。
en: If a high enough proportion of HIV-positive individuals receive ARV treatment, it is possible not only to save their lives, but also to break the transmission of the virus itself, thereby ending the epidemic.

zh: 基于这一思想，艾滋病专家发展出两大关键思想 ： “ 90-90-90”和“阶梯式艾滋病治疗 ” 。
en: Building on this idea, AIDS specialists developed two crucial ideas: “90-90-90” and the “cascade of AIDS care.”

zh: 90-90-90计划的目标是到2029年90%的艾滋病感染个体知道自己被感染（第一个90 ） ； 90%的知道自己被感染的患者接受ARV疗法（第二个90 ） ； 90%的接受ARV疗法的患者成功遏制血液中的艾滋病毒。
en: The 90-90-90 program aims to ensure that by the year 2020, 90% of all HIV-infected individuals know that they are infected (the first 90); 90% of all those who know they are infected are receiving ARV treatment (the second 90); and 90% of all those receiving ARV treatment successfully suppress the HIV virus in the blood.

zh: 阶梯思想是，如果这三个“90”的每一步都成功实现，那么所有艾滋病毒感染个体中病毒得到遏制的比例将是90%×90%×90 % ， 等于72 % 。
en: The idea of the cascade is that if each of the three “90s” is achieved, the proportion of all HIV-infected individuals with viral suppression would be 90% x 90% x 90%, which is equal to 72%.

zh: 如果72%的今天的感染者不再传染其他人，艾滋病的传染将得到阻断。
en: If 72% of those infected today can no longer infect others, the HIV/AIDS epidemic will be curtailed.

zh: 事实上，如果2020年的90-90-90到2030年成为95-95-95，则艾滋病毒阳性个体无法传染给其他人的比例将上升至86 % 。
en: Indeed, if 90-90-90 in 2020 becomes 95-95-95 by the year 2030, the proportion of HIV-positive individuals that cannot infect others would rise to 86%.

zh: 艾滋病的传染将戛然而止，正如大都市地区麻疹在儿童中的传染情况在80%的儿童获得免疫时就会结束，即使另外20%儿童没有接种。
en: The ongoing epidemic would grind to a halt, just as a measles epidemic among children in a metropolitan area ends when 80% percent of the children are vaccinated, even if the other 20% percent of children remain unvaccinated.

zh: 仍会有一些病例，但艾滋病不再是一场灾难。
en: Some cases would remain, but the AIDS catastrophe would be over.

zh: 2020年达到90-90-90和2030年达到95-95-95的目标是现实的，如果各国为之努力的话。
en: The goal of reaching 90-90-90 by the year 2020 and 95-95-95 by 2030 is realistic, if countries strive for success.

zh: 最近，瑞典宣布其已经达到90-90-90目标。
en: Sweden recently announced that it has reached the 90-90-90 targets.

zh: 许多高收入国家也已接近这一目标。
en: Many other high-income countries are close.

zh: 在国际援助和国家措施的帮助下，不仅高收入国家，发展中国家也可以达到90-90-90目标。
en: With international help and national efforts, 90-90-90 could be achieved not only in high-income countries but in developing countries as well.

zh: 对全世界大部分国家来说，最大的挑战是确保2020年至少有90%的艾滋病毒阳性个体得到检测并了解自己被感染 — — 即第一个90。
en: For most of the world, the biggest challenge is ensuring that by 2020 at least 90% of HIV-positive individuals are tested and learn that they are infected – the first of the three 90s.

zh: 要实现这一目标，有艾滋病症状者和高风险者必须联系卫生系统接受检测。
en: To reach this goal, people who are symptomatic or at high risk need to be connected to the health system for testing.

zh: 如果艾滋病毒感染者检测呈阳性，实现第二个90 % （ AVR疗法）主要取决于资金和人手；如果有充足的卫生预算，所有受感染个体都能获得药物。
en: Once an HIV-infected individual tests positive, achieving the second 90% (AVR treatment) depends mainly on funding and staffing; with a sufficient health budget, medicines can be made available for all infected individuals.

zh: 实现第三个90 % （ 遏制病毒量）主要取决于接受AVR疗法的个体是否按时治疗。
en: Achieving the third 90% (suppression of the viral load) depends mainly on whether AVR-treated individuals take the medications on schedule.

zh: 这需要社会支持以鼓励患者在觉得恢复健康后仍然坚持治疗，以及确保医药的及时且平价的供应。
en: That may require social support to encourage the patients to continue the medications even when they feel healthy, and to help ensure the timely and affordable supply of medications.

zh: 即使对于贫困和偏远人群，90-90-90目标也是可实现的，因为我们有了强大的新公共卫生解决方案：有智能手机支持的社区卫生工作者（CHW ） 。
en: The 90-90-90 targets can be reached even among impoverished and hard-to-reach populations, thanks to a new and powerful public-health solution: community health workers (CHWs) supported by smartphones.

zh: CHW是本地社区居民，至少具备高中学历，接受为期数月的具体医疗状况管理培训（如识别潜在艾滋病毒感染个体、将他们带到医院接受检测，并帮助他们遵守医疗协议 ） 。
en: CHWs are local community residents with at least a high-school education, who are trained for a few months in the management of specific health challenges, such as identifying potentially HIV-infected individuals, bringing them to the clinic for testing, and helping them to adhere to their medical protocols.

zh: 新智能手机应用能帮助他们完成工作。
en: New smartphone apps help them to do their job.

zh: 在医生往往短缺、艾滋病流行程度往往剧烈的非洲农村地区，CHW在拯救生命方面的潜力得到了很好的表现和记录。
en: In rural Africa, where doctors are typically very scarce and AIDS prevalence is often high, the high life-saving potential of CHWs has been very well demonstrated and documented.

zh: 此外，成为CHW为年轻人提供了很好的职业生涯起点。
en: Moreover, being a CHW offers a good way for young people to start their careers.

zh: 尽管一开始的薪酬很低（也许每个月只有100美元 ） ， 但经验和培训能让这些年轻工作者获得持续教育（如护理 ） 、 提升技能和更高的收入。
en: Though initial compensation is very modest (perhaps $100 per month), the experience and training can put these young workers on a path toward further education (such as nursing), rising skills, and higher incomes.

zh: 但是，尽管我们有望消灭艾滋病，但目前的情况仍是寸步难行。
en: Yet, despite the potential to bring the AIDS epidemic to an end, the world is currently stuck in limbo.

zh: 悲哀的是，我们的政府不是基于大胆的目标和实现手段运行，而是“一切照旧 ” 。
en: Sadly, our governments operate not on the basis of bold goals and the means to achieve them, but on “business as usual.”

zh: 十六年前，一切照旧意味着对贫穷的艾滋病人几乎不予治疗，因为没钱。
en: Sixteen years ago, business as usual meant almost no treatment of poor people with AIDS, because financing was not available.

zh: 当时，我建议成立一个新的“全球基金”为治疗艾滋病提供资金，这一想法被接受，并帮助开启了非洲控制艾滋病的时代。
en: At that time, I recommended a new “Global Fund” to finance AIDS treatment, an idea that was adopted and then helped to start an era of AIDS control in Africa.

zh: 美国总统小布什政府为艾滋病提供了巨大的融资支持，全球基金和美国计划合起来让数百万人获得了治疗。
en: US President George W. Bush’s administration made a major US financial commitment to AIDS, and the Global Fund and US programs together helped millions of people gain access to treatment.

zh: 但是，2008年金融危机爆发后，总统奥巴马减少了美国的融资支持，全球艾滋病控制措施也陷入了“半途 ” 。
en: Yet, after the 2008 financial crisis erupted, President Barack Obama leveled off the US financing, and the global AIDS control effort got caught in a “half-way” mode.

zh: 到2016年，大约一半的艾滋病毒阳性个体正在接受ARV疗法，远低于90%的目标。
en: As of 2016, roughly half of all HIV-positive individuals are on ARV treatment, far short of the 90% target.

zh: 即将履新的特朗普征服应该抓住这一历史机遇，通过政府和其他出资者的温和融资承诺帮助消灭艾滋病。
en: The incoming Trump administration should grasp the historic opportunity to help bring AIDS to an end through a modest financial commitment by governments and other funders.

zh: 从各种渠道每年增加100亿美元资金便可能足以完成任务，其中美国每年只需要出30—40亿美元。
en: An extra $10 billion per year from all sources would likely be sufficient to get the job done, with just $3-4 billion annually from the US.

zh: 怀疑派会嘲笑说，特朗普不可能支持这样的措施；但是，坦白讲，15年前谁又能猜到布什会成为加大对抗艾滋病力度的主要资金推手呢？
en: Skeptics will scoff that Trump is an unlikely champion of such an effort; but, frankly, who would have guessed 15 years ago that Bush would be the key mover of the financial scale-up of the fight against AIDS?

zh: 历史往往充满了惊喜和“惊吓 ” ； 消灭艾滋病将是我们这一代人的历史性成就，如果我们实现的话。
en: History is full of positive as well as negative surprises; the end of AIDS can be a historic achievement of our generation, if we reach for it.

zh: 欧洲超国家的终结？
en: The End of the European Supernation?

zh: 发自马德里 — — 从政治的角度看，自2008年欧元区危机爆发以来，欧盟一直是在一个超国家机构的外衣下按照跨政府机构的模式运作着。
en: MADRID – Since the eurozone crisis began in 2008, the European Union has, from a political perspective, led an intergovernmental life in supranational clothing.

zh: 但随着欧盟准备就英国的退出举行谈判，很显然该机构正日渐撕下这层外衣。
en: But as the EU prepares to negotiate Britain’s exit, it is becoming increasingly apparent that the Union no longer has any clothes at all.

zh: 如今的问题是欧盟作为一个由其成员国主导的集合体的状态是否是永久性的。
en: The question now is whether the EU’s status as an enterprise dominated by its member states is permanent.

zh: 某些会员国在欧盟决策过程中享有的霸主地位 — — 尤其是德国 — — 早就不是什么新鲜事了。
en: The supremacy of member states – especially Germany – in EU decision-making is far from new.

zh: 很显然在整个欧元区危机期间，德国总理安吉拉·默克尔和她的财政部长沃尔夫冈·朔伊布勒（Wolfgang Schäuble）以及时任欧洲理事会主席的比利时人赫尔曼·范龙佩（Herman Van Rompuy）就占据了主导地位。
en: It was evident throughout the euro crisis, when German Chancellor Angela Merkel and her finance minister, Wolfgang Schäuble, along with the European Council’s then-president, Belgium’s Herman Van Rompuy, took center stage.

zh: 但欧洲超国家主义的神话依然存在。
en: But the myth of European supranationalism persisted.

zh: 尤其是在让-保罗·容克（Jean-Claude Juncker）在2014年接任欧盟委员会主席后，欧盟的执行机构开始将自身认定为一个总部位于布鲁塞尔且有能力带领各国向着容克在2015年欧盟国情咨文讲话中所谓“更联合的联盟”迈进的机构。
en: In particular, after Jean-Claude Juncker took over as President of the European Commission in 2014, the EU’s executive branch began to bill itself as a Brussels-based institution capable of leading the way toward what Juncker called in his 2015 State of the Union speech “more Union in our Union.”

zh: 而今年容克的讲话就没那么乐观了。
en: This year, Juncker delivered a far more sober speech.

zh: 事实上六月的英国脱欧公投似乎不仅打击了他，还给欧盟委员会中的所有亲欧派都泼了盆冷水，以致他们在随后关于欧洲应该呈现何种面目的争论中都被边缘化了 — — 其中一个值得留意的例外是欧盟竞争事务专员玛格丽特·维斯塔格（Margrethe Vestager）在税收方面持有的受欢迎程度极高的立场，但其最终结果仍有待定夺。
en: Indeed, it seems that the June Brexit vote has chastened not only Juncker, but all of the Commission’s Europhiles, who have largely been sidelined in the ensuing battle over what Europe will look like. (The notable exception is Competition Commissioner Margrethe Vestager’s very public stand on taxation, the outcome of which is still to be determined.)

zh: 相反，这场争论很大程度上是在欧洲理事会内展开的，而默克尔则在其中承担了核心作用。
en: Instead, that battle has been playing out largely within the European Council, with Merkel assuming a central role.

zh: 虽然无法具体描述未来即将呈现的欧盟是个什么样子，但似乎可以明确的一点是，它肯定不会是一个许多委员会成员孜孜以求的那个布鲁塞尔为中心的，高度大一统的世外桃源。
en: While it is impossible to say exactly what the EU that emerges will look like, it seems clear that it will look nothing like the Brussels-centric, deeply integrated Shangri-La long sought by many at the Commission.

zh: 欧盟理事会主席唐纳德·图斯克（Donald Tusk）在这一点上尤其坚决，批评那些人脑子里都是一副“天真的大欧洲愿景 ” ， 并呼吁一个更温和的少说话多办事的欧洲。
en: Council President Donald Tusk has been especially adamant on this point, criticizing “naive Euro-enthusiastic visions” and calling for a more modest Europe that promises less and delivers more.

zh: 图斯克还在最近一次于布拉迪斯拉发召开的非正式欧洲理事会峰会上重申了这一立场 — — 此次峰会也是首次不包括英国的一届 — — 指出“赋予欧盟机构新的权力并不是合理的药方 ” 。
en: Tusk reiterated this position just before the recent informal European Council summit in Bratislava – the first not to include the United Kingdom – declaring that “giving new powers to European institutions is not the desired recipe.”

zh: 而默克尔则花了整个夏天去准备以一个成员国主导的方式来展开英国脱欧谈判并决定欧洲的未来走向。
en: Merkel, for her part, spent the summer preparing a member-state-led approach to the Brexit negotiations and Europe’s future.

zh: 在布拉迪斯拉发峰会上的议题和结论正是体现了这些努力。
en: The discussion and outcome of the Bratislava summit underscored these efforts.

zh: 委员会在最近几个月的唯一实际行动就是在七月任命米歇尔·巴尼耶（Michel Barnier）为英国脱欧谈判首席代表。
en: As for the Commission, its only real action in recent months was to appoint Michel Barnier in July as its chief representative in the Brexit negotiations.

zh: 但因为主导这一进程的是理事会，也就很难判断巴尼耶究竟会怎么做。
en: With the Council taking command of that process, it is far from clear what Barnier will actually do.

zh: 事实上，随着成员国的国内政治在驾驭欧盟现行政策动向方面扮演了比欧洲理事会更重要的角色，即便实现一个跨政府形式的欧盟都比较渺茫。
en: In fact, with member states’ domestic politics playing a more important role than the European Council in driving whatever EU policy momentum exists, even an intergovernmental EU may be too much to hope for.

zh: 以德国为例，随着默克尔的基督教民主党在地方选举 — — 包括在其老家梅克伦堡 - 西波莫尼亚 — — 大败，许多人开始质疑该国的走向。
en: Consider Germany, where the dreadful performance of Merkel’s Christian Democrats in a string of regional elections, including in her home state of Mecklenberg-West Pomerania, has caused many to question the country’s trajectory.

zh: 目前大家都在等待明年的联邦大选，因为可能会将这个国家 — — 及其领导欧盟的方式 — — 导向一个截然不同的方向。
en: Now, the wait is on for next year’s federal election, which may send the country – and its approach to EU leadership – in a very different direction.

zh: 不确定性还来自其他方向：意大利将在今年年底举行宪法公投，而法国和荷兰都将在明年举行选举。
en: Uncertainty is also coming from other directions: Italy will hold a constitutional referendum by the end of this year, and France and the Netherlands will hold elections next year.

zh: 这一切并不是说超国家主义已经过时了。
en: None of this is to say that supranationalism is a thing of the past.

zh: 但这很可能意味着至少在各主要国家选举完成之前，各方的狭隘利益将会是主导。
en: But it is likely that parochial interests will become even more dominant, at least until major elections are complete.

zh: 一个欧洲策略的新篇章可能会随之开启，但前提是当前的僵持状态不会导致机构的萎缩。
en: An opening for a European approach may follow, but only if the current torpor does not lead to institutional atrophy.

zh: 赢得公众的信任也相当关键。
en: Earning the public’s trust is crucial.

zh: 过去欧盟一路高歌猛进，似乎已经得到了公众的认可，但事实上却并非如此。
en: In the past, the EU has forged ahead, as if the public approved. It does not.

zh: 法国前外长于贝尔·韦德里纳（Hubert Vedrine）最近估算说只有15~20％的欧洲人是亲欧派，还有15~20％的人一贯反对欧盟，剩下的60％是“欧元过敏症患者 ” — —这一描述虽然粗略，但还算公允。
en: As Hubert Vedrine, a former French foreign minister, recently estimated that only 15-20% of Europeans are Europhiles, another 15-20% oppose the EU outright, and the remaining 60% are “euro-allergic.” It is a rough but fair portrait.

zh: 简而言之，对大部分民众来说欧盟机构缺乏合法性。
en: Put simply, for much of the public, EU institutions lack legitimacy.

zh: 其原因是众所周知的：沟通不畅，缺乏民主，成员国和委员会之间互相扯皮，制度架构有缺陷。
en: The reasons are well known: poor communication, a democratic deficit, finger pointing between member states and the Commission, a flawed institutional architecture.

zh: 容克和欧洲议会主席马丁·舒尔茨（Martin Schulz）可以大谈共同体方略（méthode communautaire ） ； 只是在可预见的将来这都不可能发生罢了。
en: Juncker and Martin Schulz, the president of the European Parliament, can speak about méthode communautaire until they are blue in the face; it is not happening in the foreseeable future.

zh: 其结果是显而易见的：在关于欧洲将如何发展的斗争中，欧盟机构缺乏足够的权威或支持去投身大多数争论 — — 甚至无法完全介入讨论。
en: The result is clear: in the struggle over how Europe will develop, the EU institutions lack the authority or support to put up much of a fight – or even fully enter the ring.

zh: 不过趁各成员国都盯着本国利益不放的时候，或许欧盟机构也能得到一个弥合合法性差距​的宝贵机会。
en: But this moment of national navel-gazing among the member states may actually present an important opportunity for EU institutions to work on closing the legitimacy gap.

zh: 这意味着遏制住一些冲动：试图美化那些用于不会真正兑现的未来行为，或推出一些令人印象深刻但缺乏现实效果的前瞻性计划。
en: This means resisting the urge to wax poetic about future actions that never actually materialize, or to roll out impressive-looking programs with few real-world effects.

zh: 要成功完成一系列关键举措 — — 最迫切的莫过于建立银行联盟；改进问责制；并确保公众理解欧盟机构在做什么。
en: It means, instead, completing key initiatives, most urgently the banking union; improving accountability; and ensuring that the public understands what the EU institutions are doing.

zh: 这也意味着避免涉入政治冲突，因为无论欧盟委员会还是欧洲议会都不会有任何取胜的资本。
en: And it means staying out of political conflicts, which neither the European Commission nor the European Parliament are in any position to win.

zh: 如果这种做法似乎过度谨慎，那是因为它本应如此。
en: If this approach seems cautious, that is because it is.

zh: 如今不是进行高风险弯道超车的时候，而是要用一丝不苟精心策划的渐进性措施去逐渐和持续获取公众的信任。
en: Now is the time not for risky shortcuts, but for meticulous, well-planned, incremental measures that gradually and consistently earn the public’s trust.

zh: 而由容克和欧盟委员会第一副主席弗兰斯·蒂摩曼斯（Frans Timmermans）制定的那份相对温和的具体优先事项列表则是一个良好的开端。
en: The relatively modest list of concrete priorities issued by Juncker and Commission First Vice-President Frans Timmermans is a good start.

zh: 大多数人都不傻。
en: Most people are not stupid.

zh: 他们能大体知道何时遭到了愚弄，也厌倦了空话和半桶水的提案。
en: They can generally tell when they are being strung along, and they are tired of empty rhetoric and half-baked initiatives.

zh: 只有当欧盟机构以可信和透明的方式做出真正的行动之后，它们才能保证当前跨政府主义只是阶段性的做法，而欧洲的未来将是统一的欧洲。
en: Only if the EU institutions deliver genuine action, in a credible and transparent manner, can they ensure that the current inter-governmentalism is just a phase and that the future of Europe is Europe.

zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命的结束
en: The End of Iran’s Islamic Revolution

zh: 石溪—7月，伊朗与其国际谈判对手达成了核协议，该协议标志着伊斯兰共和国与外部世界（尤其是美国）关系的一个显而易见的转折点。
en: STONY BROOK – The nuclear deal reached in July by Iran and its international interlocutors marks an obvious turning point in the Islamic Republic’s relations with the outside world, particularly with the United States.

zh: 但美国为何花了如此之长的时间才与霍梅尼的伊朗革命达成和解，而不像毛泽东的中国革命那样迅速达成和解？
en: But why has it taken so much longer for the US to come to terms with Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini’s revolution in Iran than it did with Mao Zedong’s revolution in China?

zh: 当然，美伊双边关系长期冻结的一个解释是小布什愚蠢地提出了“全球反恐战争 ” ， 在这场战争中，伊朗与伊拉克和朝鲜一样被列入国际“邪恶轴心 ” 。
en: Of course, one explanation for the prolonged bilateral freeze is the warped discourse of what George W. Bush foolishly called the “global war on terror,” in which Iran, along with Iraq and North Korea, was cast as part of an international “axis of evil.”

zh: 结果，美国官员将任何外交正常化的举动都视为不可接受的“绥靖 ” 。
en: As a result, US officials viewed any move toward diplomatic normalization as unacceptable “appeasement.”

zh: 但小布什政府的道学式外交政策只是强化了美国自1979年伊朗伊斯兰革命以来的立场。
en: But the Bush administration’s moralistic foreign policy merely reinforced America’s stance since Iran’s 1979 Islamic Revolution.

zh: 而对最近的进展的更全面也更令人信服的解释要从历史和革命进程中去寻找。
en: And it is in the history and course of that revolution that a fuller and more compelling explanation of recent events is to be found.

zh: 忘却作为榜样的法国革命吧：在谓的热月政变中，温和派结束了罗伯斯庇尔的恐怖统治，但这只是现代革命模式的一个例外。
en: Forget the French Revolution as a model: the so-called Thermidorian Reaction, when moderates ended Robespierre’s Reign of Terror, was an exception to the pattern of modern revolutions.

zh: 在我们的鲜活记忆中，典型的革命模式是，强硬派紧跟温和派而来。
en: The typical pattern during our living memory is that the hardliners come after the moderates.

zh: 比如，在苏联，二战后强硬派大力输出马克思列宁主义革命，将世界拖入了为期几十年的冷战。
en: In the Soviet Union, for example, it was hardliners after World War II who strove to export Marxist-Leninist revolution, condemning the world to decades of cold war.

zh: 伊朗亦然。
en: So, too, with Iran.

zh: 1989年霍梅尼死后，务实派拉夫桑贾尼（Ali Akbar Hashemi-Rafsanjani）成为总统，然后是改革派哈塔米（Mohammad Khatami ） 。
en: After Khomeini’s death in 1989, the pragmatic Ali Akbar Hashemi-Rafsanjani became President, followed by the reform-minded Mohammad Khatami.

zh: 但强硬派发动了逆袭。
en: But the hardliners struck back.

zh: 哈塔米的改革计划没有收到成效，默默无名的巴斯杰（Basij）军官内贾德（Mahmoud Ahmadinejad）趁机在2003年当选德黑兰市长（只有12%的德黑兰市民参与了投票 ） ， 接着在2005年击败拉夫桑贾尼成为伊朗总统。
en: When Khatami’s reform program was ineffective, Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, an obscure officer of the Basij militia, was elected Mayor of Tehran in 2003 (after just 12% of the city’s voters turned out), and then defeated Rafsanjani in 2005 to become President.

zh: 内贾德是伊斯兰革命第一位伊玛目 — — 霍梅尼的狂热信徒，他标志着伊斯兰革命的民粹主义开端。
en: Ahmadinejad, a fanatical devotee of Khomeini, the revolution’s first imam, was a reminder of the revolution’s populist inception.

zh: 推行激进的核计划便是证明霍梅尼抵抗“大恶魔”美国的斗争的正确性。
en: To promote an aggressive nuclear policy was to vindicate Khomeini’s battle against America, “the Great Satan.”

zh: 直到伊朗选民不堪忍受内贾德的无能并在2013年支持鲁哈尼成为总统，伊斯兰革命才可以说告一段落。
en: Only when Iran’s voters lost patience with Ahmadinejad’s incompetence and elected Hassan Rouhani in 2013 could the Islamic Revolution be said to be over.

zh: 美国可以避免浪费内贾德执政的这几年吗？
en: Could America have avoided the waste of the Ahmadinejad years?

zh: 他的前任做出了巨大的努力改善与美国的关系。
en: His predecessors had made serious efforts to improve relations with the US.

zh: 受美国领导的1991年海湾战争胜利（盟军的对手伊拉克正是伊斯兰共和国的死敌）的鼓舞，1995年拉夫桑贾尼向美国释放出明确信号，愿意重建外交关系。
en: Encouraged by the victory of the US-led coalition in the 1991 Gulf War against Iraq (the Islamic Republic’s arch-enemy), in 1995 Rafsanjani sent very clear signals to the US of a willingness to restore diplomatic ties.

zh: 克林顿政府忽视了拉夫桑贾尼的信号，第二年，美国国会一致通过了伊朗和利比亚制裁法。
en: The Clinton administration ignored Rafsanjani’s effort, and the following year the US Congress unanimously passed the Iran and Libya Sanctions Act.

zh: 平心而论，克林顿及其顾问有充分的理由持怀疑态度。
en: Admittedly, Bill Clinton and his advisers had plenty of reasons for skepticism.

zh: 拉夫桑贾尼至少从某种程度上说是热衷于破坏其外交政策方针强硬派反对者的人质，后者不失时机地在法国、德国和阿根廷从事恐怖活动。
en: Rafsanjani was at least partly hostage to hardline opponents keen to sabotage his foreign-policy initiatives with precisely timed acts of terror in France, Germany, and Argentina.

zh: 但克林顿及其国务卿奥尔布赖特（Madeleine Albright）对于拉夫桑贾尼的继任者哈塔米的提议是认真的，在2000年的联合国大会上，他们提出了通过“文明的对话”在克林顿所谓的伊朗和美国之间的“不信任之墙上凿出一条缝 ” 。
en: But Clinton and his secretary of state, Madeleine Albright, took seriously the proposal by Khatami, Rafsanjani’s successor, at the UN General Assembly in 2000 for a “dialogue of civilizations” to open what he called “a crack in the wall of mistrust” between Iran and the US.

zh: 悲哀的是，伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊强迫伊朗总统和外交部长回避计划中的与美国总统和国务卿的握手。
en: Sadly, Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, forced his president and foreign minister to avoid the planned handshakes with their American counterparts.

zh: 对希望美伊关系改善的人来说，更坏的消息还在后面。
en: Worse was to follow for those hoping for better US-Iran relations.

zh: 首先是2002年小布什发表“邪恶轴心”演讲。
en: First, there was Bush’s “axis of evil” speech in 2002.

zh: 接着，2005年2月，也就是强硬派内贾德即将开始第一个总统任期前夕，小布什正式拒绝了鲁哈尼（时任哈塔米在伊朗最高国家安全委会中的代表）费尽千辛万苦谈判成功并在2004年底与法国、德国和英国签署的核协议。
en: Then, in February 2005, just as the hardline Ahmadinejad was about to begin his first term as president, Bush formally rejected a nuclear deal that had been painstakingly negotiated by Rouhani (then Khamenei’s representative in Iran’s Supreme National Security Council) and signed in late 2004 by France, Germany, and Britain.

zh: 当伊朗进行战略盘算时，美国入侵伊拉克显然是因为萨达姆没有任何大规模杀伤性武器。
en: As Iran scanned the strategic horizon, it seemed obvious that the US had invaded Iraq because Saddam did not have any weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 这让内贾德坚持伊朗的核“权利”的做法得到了伊朗群众和中产阶级的支持。
en: This made Ahmadinejad’s insistence on Iran’s nuclear “rights” popular with the Iranian masses and the middle class alike.

zh: 尽管伊朗人民已经从内贾德时代中警醒，但这一情绪在伊朗仍然十分普遍。
en: Despite popular disenchantment with the Ahmadinejad era, that sentiment still prevails in Iran.

zh: 但上个月所达成的核协议是不同的政治环境的产物：奥巴马总统急切地想与伊朗达成协议，并将此作为自己的政治遗产，同时，身为伊朗总统的鲁哈尼也得以在哈梅内伊的全力支持下参与谈判。 与哈塔米不同，鲁哈尼与哈梅内伊进行了紧密合作。
en: But the nuclear accord reached last month is the product of a different political context: President Barack Obama was eager to make a deal with Iran part of his legacy, and this time, Rouhani, as President, was able to negotiate with the full backing of Khamenei, with whom (unlike Khatami) he has worked closely.

zh: 但核谈判的成功还有一个更深层次的原因：1979年的霍梅尼伊斯兰革命终于结束了 — — 并且哈梅内伊知道这一点。
en: But there is a deeper reason for the success of the nuclear negotiations: Khomeini’s Islamic revolution of 1979 has finally ended – and Khamenei knows it.

zh: 他还必须明白，什叶派伊朗所输出伊斯兰革命已经失去了吸引力，在逊尼派世界中，它首先被基地组织的全球圣战所取代，现在又被所谓的伊斯兰国和巴格达迪的哈里发所取代。
en: He must also know that the export of Islamic revolution from Shia Iran has lost its allure, replaced in the Sunni world first by the global jihad of al-Qaeda and now by the so-called Islamic State and caliphate of Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi.

zh: 对伊朗来说，现在重要的不再是意识形态，而是国家利益和现实政治。
en: For Iran, what counts now is no longer ideology but national interest and realpolitik.

zh: 因此，如今它支持革命伊斯兰的反对者：在叙利亚与伊斯兰教徒对抗的巴沙尔·阿萨德以及在也门与基地组织对抗的胡塞叛军。
en: That is why it finds itself currently backing the opponents of revolutionary Islam: Bashar al-Assad against the Islamists in Syria and the Houthis against al-Qaeda in Yemen.

zh: 也是因此，它不但与大恶魔签订了核协议，还心照不宣地与它合作对抗共同的敌人伊斯兰国。
en: And it is why it finds itself not only signing a nuclear accord with the Great Satan but also tacitly cooperating with it against the Islamic State, their common enemy.

zh: 既然伊斯兰革命已经结束，其他领域的合作也许就会变得同样有吸引力。
en: Now that the revolution is over, cooperation in other areas is likely to become equally appealing.

zh: 安息吧，自由世界秩序
en: Liberal World Order, R.I.P.

zh: 新德里—法国哲学家、作家伏尔泰揶揄道，在运转了近一千后，衰颓的神圣罗马帝国既不神圣，也不罗马，更不是帝国。
en: NEW DELHI – After a run of nearly one thousand years, quipped the French philosopher and writer Voltaire, the fading Holy Roman Empire was neither holy nor Roman nor an empire.

zh: 如今，两个半世纪过去了，用伏尔泰的话说，问题变成了：衰颓的自由世界秩序既不自由，也不具有世界性，更谈不上秩序。
en: Today, some two and a half centuries later, the problem, to paraphrase Voltaire, is that the fading liberal world order is neither liberal nor worldwide nor orderly.

zh: 二战爆发后，美国在英国和其他国家的紧密合作下，建立了自由世界秩序。
en: The United States, working closely with the United Kingdom and others, established the liberal world order in the wake of World War II.

zh: 其目标是绝不容许30年内导致两场世界大战的条件再度发生。
en: The goal was to ensure that the conditions that had led to two world wars in 30 years would never again arise.

zh: 在这方面，民主国家致力于建立一套自由的国际体系，其中的自由是指它以法治和尊重各国主权和领土完整为基础。
en: To that end, the democratic countries set out to create an international system that was liberal in the sense that it was to be based on the rule of law and respect for countries’ sovereignty and territorial integrity.

zh: 人权受到保护。
en: Human rights were to be protected.

zh: 所有这些都适用于全世界；与此同时，所有自愿的参与者都可以参与其中，促进和平（联合国 ） 、 经济发展（世界银行）以及贸易和投资（国际货币基金组织以及日后的世界贸易组织）的机构纷纷建立起来。
en: All this was to be applied to the entire planet; at the same time, participation was open to all and voluntary. Institutions were built to promote peace (the United Nations), economic development (the World Bank) and trade and investment (the International Monetary Fund and what years later became the World Trade Organization).

zh: 所有这些背后的支撑是美国的经济和军事实力、遍布欧洲和亚洲的盟国网络，以及能够威慑侵略的核武器。
en: All this and more was backed by the economic and military might of the US, a network of alliances across Europe and Asia, and nuclear weapons, which served to deter aggression.

zh: 因此，自由世界秩序的基础不仅仅是民主国家的理想，也包括硬实力。
en: The liberal world order was thus based not just on ideals embraced by democracies, but also on hard power.

zh: 所有这些都是绝不自由的苏联所不具备的，它所持有的概念在根本上有别于构成欧洲和世界秩序的概念。
en: None of this was lost on the decidedly illiberal Soviet Union, which had a fundamentally different notion of what constituted order in Europe and around the world.

zh: 随着冷战的结束和苏联解体，自由世界秩序看上去牢不可破。
en: The liberal world order appeared to be more robust than ever with the end of the Cold War and the collapse of the Soviet Union.

zh: 但在四分之一个世纪后的今天，它的未来疑问重重。
en: But today, a quarter-century later, its future is in doubt.

zh: 事实上，它的三个要素 — — 自由主义。 普世性以及保护秩序本身 — — 都正在受到其70年历史上前所未见的挑战。
en: Indeed, its three components – liberalism, universality, and the preservation of order itself – are being challenged as never before in its 70-year history.

zh: 自由主义节节退缩。
en: Liberalism is in retreat.

zh: 民主国家感受到日益兴盛的民粹主义的影响。
en: Democracies are feeling the effects of growing populism.

zh: 政治极端党派在欧洲突飞猛进。
en: Parties of the political extremes have gained ground in Europe.

zh: 英国退出欧盟的投票结果表明精英影响力的消退。
en: The vote in the United Kingdom in favor of leaving the EU attested to the loss of elite influence.

zh: 甚至美国也发生了前所未有的总统攻击本国媒体、法院和执法机构的现象。
en: Even the US is experiencing unprecedented attacks from its own president on the country’s media, courts, and law-enforcement institutions.

zh: 极权主义制度，包括中国、俄罗斯和土耳其等蠢蠢欲动。
en: Authoritarian systems, including China, Russia, and Turkey, have become even more top-heavy.

zh: 匈牙利和波兰等国家变得不再关注年轻的民主体制的命运。
en: Countries such as Hungary and Poland seem uninterested in the fate of their young democracies.

zh: 用整个世界的角度看待问题变得日益困难。
en: It is increasingly difficult to speak of the world as if it were whole.

zh: 特点各不相同的地区秩序 — — 或者说失序，中东就是最好的例子 — — 正在崛起。
en: We are seeing the emergence of regional orders – or, most pronounced in the Middle East, disorders – each with its own characteristics.

zh: 构建全球框架的尝试节节败退。
en: Attempts to build global frameworks are failing.

zh: 保护主义日益兴盛；最新一轮全球贸易谈判没有形成任何结果。
en: Protectionism is on the rise; the latest round of global trade talks never came to fruition.

zh: 网络空间治理规则莫衷一是。
en: There are few rules governing the use of cyberspace.

zh: 与此同时，大国对峙卷土重来。
en: At the same time, great power rivalry is returning.

zh: 俄罗斯用武力改变欧洲边境，违反了国际关系最基本的准则；它还视图影响2016年美国总统大选，这侵犯了美国的主权。
en: Russia violated the most basic norm of international relations when it used armed force to change borders in Europe, and it violated US sovereignty through its efforts to influence the 2016 election.

zh: 朝鲜对反对核武器扩散的国际共识不屑一顾。
en: North Korea has flouted the strong international consensus against the proliferation of nuclear weapons.

zh: 面对叙利亚和也门的人道主义灾难，世界袖手旁观，面对使用化学武器的叙利亚政府，联合国和其他国家无动于衷。
en: The world has stood by as humanitarian nightmares play out in Syria and Yemen, doing little at the UN or elsewhere in response to the Syrian government’s use of chemical weapons.

zh: 委内瑞拉正在成为一个失败之国。
en: Venezuela is a failing state.

zh: 如今，每一百个世界人口中就有一人沦为难民或在国内流民。
en: One in every hundred people in the world today is either a refugee or internally displaced.

zh: 这一切之所以发生、为什么在现在发生，原因有很多。
en: There are several reasons why all this is happening, and why now.

zh: 从一定程度上讲，民粹主义的兴起是对收入停滞和就业流失的反应，而造成收入停滞和就业流失的主要是新技术，但人们却归咎于进口和移民。
en: The rise of populism is in part a response to stagnating incomes and job loss, owing mostly to new technologies but widely attributed to imports and immigrants.

zh: 民族主义被越来越多的领导人用来树立权威，特别是在面临困难的经济和政治局面时。
en: Nationalism is a tool increasingly used by leaders to bolster their authority, especially amid difficult economic and political conditions.

zh: 全球机构也没有对新的实力平衡和技术做出调整。
en: And global institutions have failed to adapt to new power balances and technologies.

zh: 但自由世界的弱势最重要的原因还是美国态度的改变。
en: But the weakening of the liberal world order is due, more than anything else, to the changed attitude of the US.

zh: 特朗普上台后，美国决定不再加入跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP ） ， 并退出巴黎气候协定。
en: Under President Donald Trump, the US decided against joining the Trans-Pacific Partnership and to withdraw from the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 它威胁要退出北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）和伊朗核协议。
en: It has threatened to leave the North American Free Trade Agreement and the Iran nuclear deal.

zh: 它以其他国家也可以使用的理由（国际安全）为借口，单方面引入钢铁和铝关税，将世界推向贸易战。
en: It has unilaterally introduced steel and aluminum tariffs, relying on a justification (national security) that others could use, in the process placing the world at risk of a trade war.

zh: 它质疑自己对北约和其他盟友关系的承诺。
en: It has raised questions about its commitment to NATO and other alliance relationships.

zh: 它很少谈及民主或人权。
en: And it rarely speaks about democracy or human rights.

zh: “美国优先”和自由世界秩序似乎互不相容。
en: “America First” and the liberal world order seem incompatible.

zh: 我并不是想把单单美国拎出来加以鞭挞。
en: My point is not to single out the US for criticism.

zh: 今天的其他主要力量，包括欧盟、俄罗斯、中国和日本等，它们的某些所为和所不为也可以批评。
en: Today’s other major powers, including the EU, Russia, China, India, and Japan, could be criticized for what they are doing, not doing, or both.

zh: 但美国不仅仅是另一个国家。
en: But the US is not just another country.

zh: 它是自由世界秩序的主要缔造者和主要支撑力量，同时也是主要受益者。
en: It was the principal architect of the liberal world order and its principal backer. It was also a principal beneficiary.

zh: 因此，美国决定放弃它扮演了七十多年的角色这是一个转折点。
en: America’s decision to abandon the role it has played for more than seven decades thus marks a turning point.

zh: 自由世界秩序无法光靠自己存活，因为其他国家或者缺乏利益，或者缺乏手段来维持自由世界秩序。
en: The liberal world order cannot survive on its own, because others lack either the interest or the means to sustain it.

zh: 结果是世界将变得更不自由、更不繁荣、更不和平，对美国人和其他国家的人都是如此。
en: The result will be a world that is less free, less prosperous, and less peaceful, for Americans and others alike.

zh: 批准核试禁令
en: Endorse the Nuclear Test Ban

zh: 发自斯德哥尔摩/墨西哥城 — — 印尼国会刚刚迈出了历史性的一步，也是令我们这个星球更加远离核武器威胁的一步。
en: STOCKHOLM/MEXICO CITY – Indonesia’s parliament has just taken a historic step, one that makes the planet safer from the threat of nuclear weapons.

zh: 印尼批准《全面禁止核试验条约》的意义如何形容都不过分，而这也是余下八个国家批准该条约并使之具备法律效力的黄金机会。
en: The importance of Indonesia’s decision to ratify the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty cannot be overstated. This is a golden opportunity for the remaining eight countries to endorse the CTBT, enabling it to come into legal effect.

zh: 二战结束后这50年来平均每9天就有一次核试验震撼并辐射地球。
en: For the five decades following World War II, a nuclear test shook and irradiated the planet on average every nine days.

zh: 而这个时代终于在1996年联合国大会通过《全面禁止核试验条约》后走到了尽头。
en: This era was ended in 1996, when the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly.

zh: 但条约必须在附件中所列44个核技术持有国签署通过后才能生效，否则的话核试验的幽灵将依然萦绕在我们身边。
en: But, for the CTBT to enter into force, all 44 states specified as holders of nuclear technology must ratify it. Until they do, the specter of nuclear testing will continue to haunt us.

zh: 该条约尽快在全球范围内全面生效的紧迫性无需赘述。
en: It is urgent that the CTBT take full legal effect around the world as soon as possible.

zh: 一条全面禁止核爆的禁令将阻碍现有核武器库的升级以及新武器的研究开发，消灭现有以及潜在核武国家的核能力。
en: A complete ban on all nuclear explosions would hamper the upgrading of existing nuclear arsenals and the development of new weapons, diminishing the capabilities of both current and potential nuclear-armed states.

zh: 条约还将推动核不扩散以及核裁军，并成为实现全球，地区和国家安全的必要因素。
en: The CTBT reinforces both nuclear non-proliferation and nuclear disarmament, and is essential for global, regional, and national security.

zh: 对欧洲、拉丁美洲全体国家以及其他地区部分国家批准条约的行动我们表示欢迎。
en: We applaud the fact that all of the nuclear-capable countries in Europe and Latin America and many in other regions in the world have ratified the CTBT.

zh: 随着印尼批准条约，余下未批准国家只剩下8个：中国、埃及、印度、伊朗、以色列、巴基斯坦，朝鲜和美国。
en: With Indonesia’s ratification, the number of countries that have yet to do so has decreased to eight: China, Egypt, India, Iran, Israel, Pakistan, North Korea, and the United States.

zh: 这些国家有责任把这个法定禁令变成现实。
en: These countries have a responsibility to make the legal ban on nuclear testing a reality.

zh: 我们强烈敦促这些国家重新考虑该条约；这是一个实现和平和安全的重要工具，能使我们向一个没有核武器威胁的世界进一步靠拢。
en: We strongly urge them to reconsider the CTBT; this important instrument for peace and security will bring us a step closer to a world without the threat of nuclear weapons.

zh: 虽然尚未生效，但《全面禁止核试验条约》已经产生了令人瞩目的影响。
en: The CTBT has already had a dramatic impact, despite not yet being in force.

zh: 在联合国大会通过条约后核试验实际上已经销声匿迹，所有182个签约国也停止了核爆实验。
en: Since its adoption, nuclear testing has virtually stopped, and all 182 signatory states have abstained from testing nuclear explosives.

zh: 而那3个未签署该条约并实施了核试验的国家 — — 印度，巴基斯坦和朝鲜 — — 则遭到了来自联合国安理会的国际谴责以及相关制裁。
en: The three countries that have failed to ratify the CTBT and have tested such devices – India, Pakistan, and North Korea – have faced universal condemnation from the UN Security Council, and UN sanctions.

zh: 测试所有武器控制条约可行性的一个关键方法就是测试其核查效率。
en: A key measure of the viability of any arms-control treaty is how effectively it can be verified.

zh: 而在这方面国际社会已经拥有了一个强大的工具。
en: In this respect, the international community has a formidable instrument at its disposal.

zh: 全面禁止核试验条约组织筹备委员会正在建立一个监察体系，而该体系已经一再证明即便是小型地下核试验也无法逃过其耳目。
en: The Preparatory Commission for the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization (CTBTO) is creating a verification regime that has repeatedly proven its reliability in detecting even small underground nuclear tests.

zh: 除了其核查授权之外 ， 《 全面禁止核试验条约》的监察系统还能用来减轻核灾难的影响。
en: In addition to its verification mandate, the CTBT monitoring system also helps to mitigate disasters.

zh: 在今年3月日本发生的悲剧性灾难当中，条约筹备委员提供的数据帮助地方当局及时发布警告，同时也继续通过检测福岛核电站核辐射全球扩散范围的方式予以协助。
en: During the tragic catastrophe in Japan last March, CTBTO data helped local authorities to issue timely alerts. The CTBTO continued to help by monitoring the global dispersion of radioactivity from the damaged Fukushima nuclear power plant.

zh: 墨西哥和瑞典一直以来都是条约的支持者。
en: Mexico and Sweden are longstanding supporters of the CTBT.

zh: 在未来两年内，两国将携手监督实现条约生效的全过程。
en: Over the coming two years, our countries will jointly oversee the process of bringing the CTBT into force.

zh: 我们宣誓将不遗余力地推进这一目标，我们郑重宣告：
en: We pledge to spare no effort to advance this aim. We vow to:

zh: ·         拜访并号召未批准国领导人尽快采取切实行动实现这一目标���
en: ·         Call upon political leaders in the states that have not yet ratified the CTBT to act without delay and take concrete steps to this end;

zh: ·         鼓励这些国家的公民社会团体 — — 非政府组织、媒体，大学以及青年组织 — — 去敦促其决策者批准条约。
en: ·         Encourage civil-society groups – NGOs, media, universities, and youth organizations – in these countries to urge their decision-makers to ratify the CTBT;

zh: ·         借助各决策层次的国家，地区以及国际性会晤和会议来推动条约；
en: ·         Use national, regional, and international meetings and conferences to promote the CTBT at every level of decision-making;

zh: ·         完善全面禁止核试验条约组织筹备委员会的监察体系，并争取所有国家的支持，使之成为一个阻止潜在核试验行为的有力手段。
en: ·         Complete the CTBTO’s verification regime, which all states should support as a powerful deterrent to any would-be nuclear testers.

zh: 结束这一破坏性试验并永远关闭核试验之门的时候已经来到。
en: It is time to end this destructive experiment and close the door on nuclear testing once and for all.

zh: 我们呼吁8个未批准国的决策者能向前迈进。
en: We appeal to decision-makers in the eight states that have not yet ratified the CTBT to move forward.

zh: 印尼已经树立了榜样；如今焦点则聚集到了你们身上。
en: Indonesia has set an example; now the spotlight is on you.

zh: 垒实金砖
en: Building Up the BRICS

zh: 发自曼彻斯特— 在15年前，我创设了“金砖四国（BRICs ） ” 一词来指代几个主要新兴经济体：巴西，俄罗斯，印度和中国（后于2010年增添了南非 ） 。
en: MANCHESTER – This year’s meeting of the BRICS in India is taking place just a fortnight after the 15th anniversary of the creation of the term “BRICs,” which I coined to refer to the major emerging economies: Brazil, Russia, India, and China (South Africa was added in 2010).

zh: 在主持的针对抗菌素耐药性（Antimicrobial Resistance）的独立审查工作于近期完成之后，我在英国政府的短暂任期也结束了。
en: Recently, my brief tenure in the British government came to an end, following the completion of an independent review on antimicrobial resistance (AMR) that I had been chairing.

zh: 而在思考下一步该投身哪些事业的时候，我不禁回想到了这个迄今15周年的主题。
en: As I ponder what to do next, and as the BRICS leaders meet, I can’t help but wonder about the term’s meaning today.

zh: 这些庞大且让人寄予厚望的新兴经济体到底有没有辜负人们的期望？
en: Have these large and promising emerging economies fulfilled expectations?

zh: 也许回答这个问题的最简单方法与我的抗菌素耐药性审查工作有关，这是由前英国首相戴维·卡梅伦于2014年启动的项目。
en: Perhaps the simplest way to answer this question relates to my work on the AMR review, which was launched by former British Prime Minister David Cameron in 2014.

zh: 同年9月21日我们就取得了一项重大进展：联合国针对该议题签署了一份高级别协议。
en: On September 21, we achieved a major victory: a high-level agreement by the United Nations on the topic.

zh: 在协议达成后，一个在我的团队和我本人在各界广泛树立耐药性意识期间不时跟踪拍摄的德国电视摄制组曾经在直播中问我，这个项目的结果是否比金砖四国的概念更重要。
en: After the agreement was reached, a German television crew that had occasionally followed my team and me as we worked to spread awareness of AMR asked me, on air, whether the outcome was more important than the BRIC concept.

zh: 而我甚至都没来及回答，他们就抢先给出了肯定的答案。
en: Without even waiting for me to answer, they declared that it obviously was.

zh: 他们是对的：不管是新兴还是其他什么经济体，如果持续处于抗菌素耐药性这类严重且无法控制的卫生威胁之下的话，都是不可能实现繁荣的。
en: And they were right: no economy, emerging or otherwise, can hope to be successful if it is plagued by a health threat as serious and uncontrollable as AMR.

zh: 但是金砖五国的故事可不仅限于此：金砖五国在应对抗菌素耐药性议题上的重要性跟应对耐药性对于这五国的重要性是等同的。
en: But there is more to the story: the BRICS are just as important to tackling AMR as tackling AMR is to the BRICS.

zh: 其中南非就是英国在近期在杭州G20峰会上耐药性议题的主要支持者，如果缺少了该国的支持，该议题甚至可能没机会出现在会议的公报上。
en: South Africa, for one, was a key supporter of the United Kingdom in discussions about AMR at the recent G20 summit in Hangzhou, China, and the issue might not have ended up in the meeting’s communiqué without its support.

zh: 而这就是问题所在。
en: And that is the point.

zh: 当今的金砖五国跟2001年时一样，在解决那些最为紧迫的国际性挑战方面发挥着至关重要的作用。
en: The BRICS today, like in 2001, have a vital role to play in tackling the most pressing international challenges.

zh: 事实上我之所以想出BRICS这个缩写，不仅是因为各国名称首字母的巧合，也是因为这个词的真实含义：在我2001年发表的文章中，这些新兴经济体应该是构筑新全球金融和治理体系的基石。
en: In fact, I came up with the acronym not just because the letters fit together, but also because of the word’s actual meaning: these emerging economies, I argued in my 2001 paper, should be the building blocks of freshly overhauled global financial and governance systems.

zh: 然而在即将召开的国际货币基金组织和世界银行的秋季会议上，金砖国家在这些关键机构中的代表性依旧不足。
en: Yet, as we approach this year’s autumn meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank, the BRICS remain severely underrepresented by these critical institutions.

zh: 如果这一情况无法扭转的话，随着各项改革远远超出当前的范围，我们很快就会发现所谓的“全球治理”已经跟全球性不沾边了。
en: If this does not change, with reforms going much further than they have so far, we will soon find that “global governance” is no longer global at all.

zh: 诚然金砖国家近年的日子也不太好过。
en: To be sure, the BRICS have lately been going through a rough time.

zh: 巴西和俄罗斯近十年间的经济表现尤其是令人失望，以致许多人如今都觉得应该把这两个国家从缩写中剔除。
en: The economic performance of Brazil and Russia, in particular, has been very disappointing so far this decade, to the point that many now perceive those countries as unworthy of the status the acronym afforded them.

zh: 但这种认为金砖国家重要性被夸大了的想法其实是相当幼稚的。
en: But the suggestion that the BRICS’ importance was overstated is simply naïve.

zh: 四个金砖起始国如今的经济总量其实与我多年前作出的预测保持了一致。
en: The size of the original four BRICs economies, taken together, is roughly consistent with the projections I made all those years ago.

zh: 俄罗斯和巴西两国占全球GDP的比重和2001年基本一致。 虽然根据我的简单计算，俄罗斯可能已经跌出了世界十大经济体之外。
en: Both Russia and Brazil now account for a similar share of global GDP as they did in 2001, though Russia, according to my simple calculation, might currently be outside the world’s ten largest economies.

zh: 而巴西即便有着相当多的问题，但全球排名甚至比我当初的设想要高。
en: Brazil, for all of its considerable problems, is higher in the world ranking today than even I had envisaged back then.

zh: 印度依然沿着与15年前大致相同的路径不断前进。
en: India continues along roughly the same path it was on 15 years ago.

zh: 有了合理的结构性改革，它甚至可以在一段时期内持续实现中国式的两位数经济增长。
en: With the right structural reforms, it may even be able to achieve a sustained period of Chinese-style double-digit economic growth.

zh: 而最大的金砖国家成功故事仍然是中国。 尽管近期经济有所放缓，但中国的发展远远超过了预期。
en: But the biggest BRICS success story remains China, which, despite its recent slowdown, has far exceeded expectations.

zh: 如果中国经济能在2020年前保持6％左右的年增长率，那么我的20年预测就将应验。
en: If the economy grows at an annual rate of around 6% for the remainder of the decade, it will fulfill my 20-year projection.

zh: 这可不是在回避中国所面临的挑战。
en: This is not to diminish the challenges confronting China.

zh: 但如果它能设法解决其中最为紧迫的问题 — — 下行通货紧缩风险 — — 其备受争议的债务挑战就将变得更加易于管理。
en: But if it manages to address the most urgent among them – downside deflationary risks – its much-discussed debt challenge will become far more manageable.

zh: 但中国的幸运之处在于其他国家希望 — — 或者应该希望 — — 它走向成功。
en: Fortunately for China, other countries want – or should want – it to succeed.

zh: 毕竟一个充满活力的中国经济符合其他许多国家的利益，特别是那些可以输出一个更现代化且消费拉动型的中国所需的商品和服务的国家。
en: After all, a dynamic Chinese economy is in the interest of many other countries, especially those that can export the goods and services that a more modern, consumer-driven China needs.

zh: 事实上，中国消费者的崛起可能是当前最重要的单一全球经济变化因素 — — 甚至比困扰欧洲和日本的经济问题或者对印度经济与全球的长期关联性的质疑这类问题更加重要。
en: In fact, the rise of the Chinese consumer may well be the most important single global economic variable today – even more important than, say, the economic problems afflicting Europe and Japan or questions about India’s enduring global relevance.

zh: 金砖国家的成长和发展的潜在障碍是多方面的，包括抗菌素耐药性这类健康威胁，教育方面的挑战，在全球治理机构中代表性不足以及一些短期的周期性问题。
en: The potential barriers to the BRICS’ growth and development are many, including health threats like AMR, educational challenges, inadequate representation in global governance bodies, and a number of short-term cyclical problems.

zh: 而全球政策制定者必须致力于拆除这些壁垒，以令金砖国家最终能发挥出其真正的潜力。
en: Policymakers worldwide must commit themselves to dismantling these barriers, and enabling the BRICS to fulfill, finally, their true potential.

zh: 给欧洲注入活力
en: Energizing Europe

zh: 在法国总统选举前的竞选之中，欧洲事务被提及或被讨论过，但是几乎从来没有辩论过。
en: In France’s pre-presidential electoral campaign, European affairs are mentioned or whispered, but almost never debated.

zh: 法国大体上只是关心自己的问题，特别是被认为的其政治阶层的运转不良以及法国公众明显的懒惰。 人们指责后者是脆弱的经济增长的根源，特别是与美国相比。
en: France is mostly concerned with its own problems, particularly the supposed malfunctioning of its political class and the apparent laziness of the French public, which is blamed for weak economic growth, especially when compared to the United States.

zh: 法国需要有关欧洲事务的辩论，但条件是这一辩论不要沦为自我鞭挞。 而这正是欧洲常有的事情。
en: France needs a debate on European Union affairs, but only as long as it does not degenerate – as is common in Europe – into self-flagellation.

zh: 但是这一辩论的潜质依旧存在，而且，它与两年前主导法国有关欧盟宪法全民公决的竞选大相径庭。
en: But the germ of such a debate exists, and it sounds very different from that which dominated the failed constitutional referendum campaign in France two years ago.

zh: 欧盟机制的运作，包括欧洲央行、欧盟委员会以及稳定和增长公约等面临严重的批评，但是这些批评并非是以对于国家主权的怀旧的名义进行的。
en: The operation of European institutions – the European Central Bank, the European Commission, and the Stability Pact – is facing severe criticism, but not in the name of a nostalgia for national sovereignty.

zh: 人们并未拒绝欧洲；实际上，人们只是以共同利益的名义、以改善欧盟机制的精神提出批评。
en: Europe is not being rejected; instead, the criticism has been in the spirit of improving European institutions in the name of the common good.

zh: 法国总统大选的两个主要候选人罗雅尔女士和萨尔科奇都呼吁建立欧元区的主管经济的政府。
en: Both of the major candidates for the French presidency, Ségolène Royal and Nicholas Sarkozy, have called for the creation of an economic government for the euro zone.

zh: 当然，这样的一个“政府”已经以欧洲央行的形式存在了。
en: Of course, such a “government” already exists in the form of the European Central Bank.

zh: 但是，人们需要的是一个机制框架，这一框架将会为欧洲所应追求的主要经济目标，即全面就业和增长确立更大的政治责任，并且至少部分地解决由于欧洲央行从欧元区国家中接管货币政策而造成的民主赤字。
en: But what is needed is an institutional framework that would establish greater political responsibility concerning the primary economic objectives that Europe should pursue – full employment and growth – and that would at least partly close the democratic deficit implied by the ECB’s takeover of monetary policy from euro-zone states.

zh: 当前存在着表面上的政治不团结，因此现在可能并不是开始这一工程的正确时机。
en: A moment of seeming political disunity, such as exists today, may not seem the right one to initiate such a project.

zh: 但是从历史上看，欧洲曾经在危险的时候排除任何其他考虑，而成功地开创了不可逆转的进程。
en: But, historically, Europe has succeeded when, at moments of danger, it has initiated irreversible processes that outweigh any other consideration.

zh: 欧盟的创始人们在提出创立欧洲煤钢共同体时正是这样做的，那就是以促进经济利益的借口鼓励昔日的仇人把一些战争中最强有力的用品来联合经营真是一个绝妙的战略。
en: Europe’s founding fathers understood this when they hatched the idea of creating the European Coal and Steel Community: encouraging old enemies to pool some of the most powerful tools of war under the pretext of advancing their economic interests was a strategy of rare intelligence.

zh: 现在我们面临着类似的不确定性和危险，而同样地，这一次有一个既在经济上同时又在政治上把整个联盟联合起来的计划，那就是国家主权的一个重要因素即能源独立自主。
en: We now live in a similar moment of uncertainty and danger, and this time, too, there is a project, both economic and political, that can unite the Union: energy independence, a key factor in national sovereignty.

zh: 今天，我们并不拥有一个泛欧洲的计划能保证每个成员国能确保其未来能源供应的安全的责任。
en: Today, there is nothing on a pan-European scale that guarantees the responsibility of each member state to ensure the security of its future supplies.

zh: 欧盟委员会对于建立一个单一的能源市场的企图表现得很谨慎，因为它需要劝说各国政府拆解它们业已存在的垄断经营者，而这是竞争的前提。
en: The European Commission is weary of trying to build a single energy market, which has required it to persuade governments that they must dismantle their existing monopoly operators – a prerequisite to competition.

zh: 尽管各个成员国似乎对此表示了认可，但是它们却坚决抵制其他欧洲公司控制它们的国有霸主公司。
en: Although member states appear to have resigned themselves to this, they fervently resist other European firms taking control of their “national champion” companies.

zh: 实际上，各国政府无法回避它们对其公民的责任，而只有最天真的专家治国论者才会相信仅仅依靠市场就能保证能源的独立。
en: To be sure, governments cannot escape their responsibilities to their citizens, and only the most naïve technocrat believes that the market alone can ensure energy independence.

zh: 与此同时，各个欧盟成员国分别与石油和天然气的生产国之间进行的双边谈判降低了成员国讨价还价的能力，同时也削弱了欧洲在世界事务中的地缘政治力量。
en: At the same time, however, purely bilateral negotiations between individual EU members and oil- and gas-producing countries weakens the member states’ bargaining power, as well as undermining Europe’s geopolitical weight in world affairs.

zh: 然而，幸运的是，我们并不需要听天由命。
en: Yet, fortunately, there is no need for resignation.

zh: 存在一个与我们的创始人们建立煤铁共同体同样明显的解决方案，即一个欧洲能源、环境和研究共同体（E3RC ） 。
en: There is an obvious solution, similar to the Coal and Steel Community implemented by our founding fathers: a European energy, environment, and research community (E3RC).

zh: 那种认为关注生态环境只会导致经济负增长的看法是完全错误的。
en: It is a mistake to believe that ecological concerns can be addressed only through negative growth.

zh: 事实上，情况恰恰相反。
en: In fact, the opposite is true.

zh: 新的能源和环境技术未来无疑会推动经济的增长。
en: New energy and environmental technologies will undoubtedly drive growth in the future.

zh: 但是我们只有下大力气加大研究力度以创造新的能效技术，我们最终才能做到消耗的能源总量大大减少，并且能源消耗更多地是以不影响环境的方式来进行的。
en: But only if research is doubled to create new energy-efficient technologies will we eventually consume less energy overall and more energy in an environmentally friendly way.

zh: 今天的经济活动所已经制造出的生态灾难以及可能将会带来的灾难性后果最终使人们认识到能源政策和环境保护必须被放在一起进行考虑。
en: The ecological disasters that today’s economic activity has already produced and the catastrophic potential of those to come have at last brought home the fact that energy policy and environmental protection cannot be separated.

zh: 目前来看，欧洲能源、环境和研究共同体有两个直接相关的目标可以追求，即欧洲能源的独立自主。 这依赖于新的能源和环境技术，和加强欧洲在全球市场上讨价还价的能力。
en: As it is, the E3RC would pursue two directly related objectives: European energy independence, which would be helped by new energy and environmental technologies, and Europe’s increased bargaining power in global markets.

zh: 它的建立同时也可以向欧洲民众传递一个新的信息，即欧洲的大地上所存在的并不仅仅竞争。
en: Its creation would also send out a new message to the European public: competition alone is not the only thing on Europe’s horizon.

zh: 最为主要的是，欧洲需要合作。
en: Above all, the EU requires cooperation.

zh: 互助世界中的能源独立
en: Energy Independence in an Interdependent World

zh: 美国剑桥—20世纪70年代初，在尼克松总统表示希望能够保证国家能源独立的时候，美国有四分之一的原油需要进口。
en: CAMBRIDGE – When President Richard Nixon proclaimed in the early 1970’s that he wanted to secure national energy independence, the United States imported a quarter of its oil.

zh: 20世纪70年代末，在经历了阿拉伯石油禁运和伊朗革命以及国内石油产量的下跌后，美国原油进口比例上升到了50 % ， 而油价上涨了15倍。 当是时，人们相信美国的天然气很快就要开采殆尽了。
en: By the decade’s end, after an Arab oil embargo and the Iranian Revolution, domestic production was in decline, Americans were importing half their petroleum needs at 15 times the price, and it was widely believed that the country was running out of natural gas.

zh: 能源冲击助长了经济增长停滞和通货膨胀的致命组合，自尼克松以来，每一任美国总统都会把能源独立作为目标。
en: Energy shocks contributed to a lethal combination of stagnant economic growth and inflation, and every US president since Nixon likewise has proclaimed energy independence as a goal.

zh: 但没人把这个目标当回事。
en: But few people took those promises seriously.

zh: 如今，能源专家再也笑不出来了。
en: Today, energy experts no longer scoff.

zh: 根据美国能源信息局（US Energy Information Administration）的说法，到2020年，美国所消费的原油中将有近一半产自国内，其中又有82%来自大西洋沿岸。
en: By the end of this decade, according to the US Energy Information Administration, nearly half of the crude oil that America consumes will be produced at home, while 82% will come from the US side of the Atlantic.

zh: 著名能源分析师维尔莱格（Philip Verleger）指出，到2023年，即尼克松提出“独立计划”50周年之际，美国将实现能源独立 — — 其能源出口将超过进口。
en: Philip Verleger, a respected energy analyst, argues that, by 2023, the 50th anniversary of Nixon’s “Project Independence,” the US will be energy independent in the sense that it will export more energy than it imports.

zh: 维尔莱格认为，能源独立“可能将世界带入新美国世纪（New American Century ） ， 形成一个美国能够以比世界其他地方低得多的成本获得能源的经济环境 ” 。
en: Verleger argues that energy independence “could make this the New American Century by creating an economic environment where the United States enjoys access to energy supplies at much lower cost than other parts of the world.”

zh: 如今，欧洲和亚洲的天然气价格已经比美国高出了4—6倍。
en: Already, Europeans and Asians pay 4-6 times more for their natural gas than Americans do.

zh: 到底发生了什么？
en: What happened?

zh: 水平钻井和水压致裂技术 — — 对页岩和其他深层低渗透岩石施以水轰和化学物质轰击 — — 释放了大量新的天然气和原油供给。
en: The technology of horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing, by which shale and other tight rock formations at great depths are bombarded with water and chemicals, has released major new supplies of both natural gas and oil.

zh: 2005—2010年间，美国页岩气产业年增长率高达45 % ， 页岩气占美国天然气总产量的比重从4%上升到了24 % 。
en: America’s shale-gas industry grew by 45% annually from 2005 to 2010, and the share of shale gas in America’s overall gas production grew from 4% to 24%.

zh: 据估计，美国的天然气足够以当前产量开采一百年。
en: The US is estimated to have enough gas to sustain its current rate of production for more than a century.

zh: 其他国家也拥有相当可观的页岩气储量，但问题重重，比如中国存在水资源短缺问题，阿根廷存在投资安全性问题，欧洲国家存在环境约束问题，等等。
en: While many other countries also have considerable shale-gas potential, problems abound, including water scarcity in China, investment security in Argentina, and environmental restrictions in several European countries.

zh: 美国经济将因能源供给的变化而获得数不尽的好处。
en: The American economy will benefit in myriad ways from its change in energy supply.

zh: 现在已经形成了数十万个工作岗位，其中一些是在原本萧条的边远地区。
en: Hundreds of thousands of jobs are already being created, some in remote, previously stagnating regions.

zh: 由此产生的经济活动的增加将提振总体GDP增长，产生大量新财政收入。
en: This additional economic activity will boost overall GDP growth, yielding significant new fiscal revenues.

zh: 此外，能源进口支出下降将使美国贸易赤字减少，国际收支平衡状况改善。
en: In addition, the lower energy-import bill will cause America’s trade deficit to narrow and its balance-of-payments position to improve.

zh: 一些行业（如化工和塑料行业）将在生产成本方面获得巨大的比较优势。
en: Some US industries, such as chemicals and plastics, will gain a significant comparative advantage in production costs.

zh: 事实上，据国际能源署估计，确保页岩气井的环境安全性所需要的附加预防措施 — — 包括密切关注地震条件、合适的密封通风井以及合理的废水管理等 — — 只会带来7%的额外成本。
en: Indeed, the International Energy Agency estimates that the additional precautions needed to ensure shale-gas wells’ environmental safety – including careful attention to seismic conditions, properly sealed shafts, and appropriate waste-water management – add only about 7% to the cost.

zh: 不过，从气候变化角度看，更依赖页岩气的结果很不好说。
en: With respect to climate change, however, the effects of greater reliance on shale gas are mixed.

zh: 天然气燃烧所产生的温室气体要小于煤和石油等化石燃料，因此页岩气称得上通往减少碳密集程度的捷径。
en: Because natural-gas combustion produces fewer greenhouse gases than other hydrocarbons, such as coal or oil, it can be a bridge to a less carbon-intensive future.

zh: 但是低气价会妨碍新能源资源的开发，除非后者能得到补贴或碳税的支持。
en: But the low price of gas will impede the development of renewable energy sources unless accompanied by subsidies or carbon taxes.

zh: 现阶段，我们只能预测地缘政治影响。
en: At this stage, one can only speculate about the geopolitical effects.

zh: 显然，美国经济的坚挺将强化美国的经济实力 — — 这与当前流行的美国衰落论背道而驰。
en: Clearly, the strengthening of the US economy would enhance American economic power – a scenario that runs counter to the current fashion of portraying the US as being in decline.

zh: 但下结论不能操之过急。
en: But one should not jump to conclusions.

zh: 能源进出口的平衡只是通往能源独立的第一步。
en: A balance of energy imports and exports is only a first approximation of independence.

zh: 我在近著《实力的未来 》 （ The Future of Power）中指出，全球互助性既具有敏感性，也具有脆弱性。
en: As I argue in my book The Future of Power, global interdependence involves both sensitivity and vulnerability.

zh: 如果美国能源进口量有所减少，那么从长期看它的脆弱性将会减小，但石油是一种可替代商品，而美国经济仍然对世界油价的突然变化所带来的冲击非常敏感。
en: The US may be less vulnerable in the long run if it imports less energy, but oil is a fungible commodity, and the US economy will remain sensitive to shocks from sudden changes in world prices.

zh: 换句话说，沙特革命或是封锁霍尔木兹海峡之类的事件仍旧可能对美国及其盟友造成严重伤害。
en: In other words, a revolution in Saudi Arabia or a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz could still inflict damage on the US and its allies.

zh: 因此，即使美国在中东没有其他利益（比如以色列或核不扩散 ） ， 能源进出口平衡也不会让美国从保护该地区石油运输线的军费开支（一些专家估计高达每年500亿美元）中解脱出来。
en: So, even if America had no other interests in the Middle East, such as Israel or nuclear non-proliferation, a balance of energy imports and exports would be unlikely to free the US from military expenditures – which some experts estimate run to $50 billion per year – to protect oil routes in the region.

zh: 与此同时，美国在国际政治上的讨价还价地位应能得到优化。
en: At the same time, America’s bargaining position in world politics should be enhanced.

zh: 实力来自不对称的互助性。
en: Power arises from asymmetries in interdependence.

zh: 你我可以相互依赖，但如果你需要我甚于我需要你，那么我的讨价还价实力就会见涨。
en: You and I may depend on each other, but if I depend on you less than you do on me, my bargaining power is increased.

zh: 几十年来，美国和沙特存在一种不对称的平衡，我们依赖他们作为见机行事的石油生产者，而他们依赖我们作为最终军事安全力量。
en: For decades, the US and Saudi Arabia have had a balance of asymmetries in which we depended on them as the swing producer of oil, and they depended on us for ultimate military security. Now the bargains will be struck on somewhat better terms from America’s point of view.

zh: 类似地，俄罗斯控制着天然气供给和管线，从而扼住了欧洲及其小国邻邦的咽喉。
en: Likewise, Russia has enjoyed leverage over Europe and its small neighbors through its control of natural gas supplies and pipelines.

zh: 随着北美在天然气上成为自给自足地区，其他众多地区将能腾出手来为欧洲提供替代资源，从而削弱俄罗斯的优势。
en: As North America becomes self-sufficient in gas, more from various other regions will be freed up to provide alternative sources for Europe, thereby diminishing Russia’s leverage.

zh: 在东亚 — — 美国外交政策的新焦点 — — 中国将日渐依赖中东的石油。
en: In East Asia, which has become the focus of US foreign policy, China will find itself increasingly dependent on Middle Eastern oil.

zh: 美国说服中国逐渐参与地区安全安排的努力将会更受重视，而中国将意识到其能源供给线在发生冲突的不可能事件时将受到美国海军的干扰，这两个方面将对双方讨价还价实力形成微妙影响。
en: American efforts to persuade China to play a greater role in regional security arrangements may be strengthened, and China’s awareness of the vulnerability of its supply routes to US naval disruption in the unlikely event of conflict could also have a subtle effect on each side’s bargaining power.

zh: 能源进出口平衡并不会产生纯粹的依赖性，但确实会改变能源互助所带来的实力对比。
en: A balance of energy imports and exports does not produce pure independence, but it does alter the power relations involved in energy interdependence.

zh: 在这一点上，尼克松是对的。
en: Nixon got that right.

zh: 能源市场还是能源治理？
en: Energy Markets or Energy Governance?

zh: 马德里 — — 本月，国际能源署将发布年度报告，即权威的《世界能源展望 》 ， 这份报告将显示，我们并没有走在缓解全球变暖的正途上。
en: MADRID – This month, the International Energy Agency will publish its annual report, the internationally definitive World Energy Outlook, which will confirm that we are not on the right track to reduce global warming.

zh: 如果能源生产的当前趋势继续下去，那么，到2100年，地球平均温度将比1900年提高2℃，对地球和人类生存环境造成不可逆的伤害。
en: If the current trend in energy production continues, the earth’s average temperature will be more than 2ºC higher in 2100 than it was in 1990, irreversibly harming the planet and conditions for human life.

zh: 眼下，其他更为紧迫的危机正在让世界疲于奔命，政府和人民的注意力并不在仍然困扰着我们的能源挑战上。
en: Other, more immediate crises are occupying the world’s attention almost completely, distracting governments and citizens alike from the energy challenges that are still before us.

zh: 在美国，联邦级别的讨论中不见能源问题踪影已经有很长一段时间了；欧盟正在金融飓风中苦苦挣扎；而新兴国家希望保持快速经济增长从而将数百万人带出贫困状态。
en: In the United States, there has been no energy debate at the federal level for a long time; the European Union is in the eye of a financial hurricane; and the emerging countries want to maintain rapid economic growth in order to lift millions out of poverty.

zh: 在这样的环境下，将于11月在南非德班举行的新一届联合国气候变化框架会议（UNFCCC）几乎没有受到任何关注。
en: In this context, the next meeting of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), set for the end of November in Durban, South Africa, is passing totally unnoticed.

zh: 但能源乃是人类生存的基本问题，这不仅是因为它具有潜在的负外部性，也因为它具有经济上的关联性：西方国家的GDP中有8—10%花在了能源上，而发展中国家的这一比重是发达国家的两倍甚至三倍。
en: But energy is fundamental for humanity, not only because of its potentially negative externalities, but also given its economic relevance: Western countries spend 8-10% of their GDP on energy, and developing countries spend double or triple that amount.

zh: 因此，我们需要一个能源治理体系。
en: For this reason, we need a system to govern energy.

zh: 不受管制的能源市场绝非有用的治理机制，这主要是因为能源具有环境负外部性，而不受管制的能源市场无法将环境成本内部化。
en: Owing mainly to its environmentally negative externalities, an unregulated energy market is not a useful governing mechanism, because it is unable to internalize the environmental costs.

zh: 据测算，污染性最大的能源应该被课以70%的税收，以反映其负外部性。
en: It has been calculated that the most contaminating energy sources would have to pay a 70% tax to reflect their negative externalities.

zh: 这方面信息的严重不足是自由市场起不了作用的另一个原因。
en: A substantial lack of information in this field is another reason why the free market doesn’t work.

zh: 通常而言，像天然气储量这样的信息在技术上是很难获得的。
en: Often, as with the properties of a gas reserve, for example, information is technically difficult to obtain.

zh: 此外，政府会认为自然资源具有战略重要性，因此不会披露这方面的信息。
en: In addition, governments consider natural resources to be strategic and don’t release information about them.

zh: 最后，与能源有关的时间框架通常非常长：环境效应需要几个世纪才能显现，投资需要好几十年才能收回。
en: Finally, time frames related to energy are usually long: centuries for environmental effects or decades for investments to pay off.

zh: 因此，能源必须通过一个合作和监管体系才能得到治理。
en: Thus, energy must be governed through a system of cooperation and regulation.

zh: 当然，这是非常复杂的事情。
en: That will be complicated, of course.

zh: 管理能源同时要求考虑��术、政治、经济等诸多方面的问题。
en: Managing energy requires taking into account technical, political, and economic dimensions simultaneously.

zh: 能源勘探和生产要求众多学科和技术基础，比如风力、光伏、核能、煤炭等。
en: Energy exploration and production requires many different disciplines and technologies – eolic (wind), photovoltaic, nuclear, coal, etc.

zh: 政治问题也是如此，产业和经济部门虽然有组织，但却是各自为政。
en: Something similar exists in the political sphere, where industrial and economic sectors are organized but divided.

zh: 而国际合作的需要则让这个问题难上加难。
en: And the need for international coordination poses an additional difficulty.

zh: 能源问题是我们缺少多边机构的明证。
en: The energy sector exemplifies the inadequacy of our multilateral institutions.

zh: 能源政策在国家层面制定，但能源部门的外部性却由全球共同承担。
en: Energy policy is national, but the sector’s externalities are global.

zh: 核泄漏、海底油井泄露以及（最重要的）二氧化碳排放所威胁到的绝非一个国家。
en: A radioactive leak, the rupture of an undersea oil well and, above all, CO2 emissions do not threaten just one country.

zh: 另一方面，能源带来的好处却是定向的，获得者只有能源消费者、生产者和出售者。
en: On the other hand, energy’s benefits adhere to specific agents, be they consumers, producers, or sellers.

zh: 这一失衡造成了显而易见的免费搭车激励：他们获得好处，而我们其他人承担成本。
en: This imbalance creates a clear incentive for free riders: they benefit, while the rest of us pay.

zh: 此外，全球治理之所以有必要，是因为世界能源供求并不连贯。
en: Moreover, global governance is necessary because energy supply and demand around the world are disconnected.

zh: 鲜有国家存在中性的能源平衡。
en: Few countries have a neutral energy balance.

zh: 这一点可以用世界主要能源 — — 石油来说明。
en: Oil, the world’s main source of energy, is indicative in this regard.

zh: 中东在石油上有着266%的商业盈余，而美国则有65%的赤字。
en: The Middle East has a 266% commercial surplus of oil, and the US a 65% deficit.

zh: 这一地缘性的失衡要求一个有序的交易体系、明晰的监管以及结构合理的全球市场。
en: This geographical imbalance requires an ordered system of trade, clear regulations, and a well-structured global market.

zh: 但是，当今世界充斥着不透明的双边协定，截然不同的环境要求和相互矛盾的补贴同时存在。
en: Today, however, opaque bilateral agreements abound, and very different environmental requirements and contradictory subsidies coexist.

zh: 结果，我们严重缺乏全球能源机构。
en: As a result, our global energy institutions are woefully inadequate.

zh: 国际能源署只承认经合组织国家（其中不包括中国）为主要能源消费国。
en: The International Energy Agency admits only OECD countries, which excludes China, the largest energy consumer.

zh: 政府间的能源宪章条约（Energy Charter Treaty）规定，签署国必须实施无差异的能源产品和服务市场规则，但世界第二大能源消费国美国和第一大能源生产国俄罗斯都没有加入。
en: The intergovernmental Energy Charter Treaty, which obliges signatories to apply impartial market rules to energy products and services, has not been signed by the US, the world’s second-largest energy consumer, or ratified by Russia, the world’s largest oil producer.

zh: 国际贸易组织协定对能源问题只是略有提及，因为能源被视为可耗竭自然资源，因此很多时候被免于世贸组织规则的束缚。
en: World Trade Organization agreements apply to energy only tangentially, because energy is considered an exhaustible natural resource, and in many cases is thus exempt from the rules.

zh: 此外，非西方国家 — — 其中包括中国和印度等大型消费国以及海湾国家和俄罗斯等大型生产国 — — 不信任主要由西方国家设置的国际体系。
en: Moreover, non-Western countries – which include big consumers like China and India, and the largest producers (the Gulf states and Russia) – don’t trust the institutional system created mainly by the West.

zh: 新兴国家正确地指出，西方才是当今气候变化问题的始作俑者。
en: The emerging countries rightly argue that the West is responsible for today’s climate-change problem.

zh: 从工业革命到现在，西方的发展一直没有受到任何环境方面的约束，因此新兴国家认为，调整成本不应该由它们来承担。
en: From the Industrial Revolution until very recently, the West’s development was free of any environmental restrictions, and the emerging countries believe that they should not have to bear the adjustment cost.

zh: 类似地，能源生产国也反对放弃手中仅有的权力。
en: Likewise, producing countries oppose giving up one of the few bases of power they have.

zh: 解决方案必须包括成立一个新的机构。
en: The solution must include a new institution.

zh: 也许先让主要排放国通过G20之类的场合进行能源协商是个好主意。
en: Perhaps, for a start, it would be a good idea for the world’s largest emitters to negotiate through the G-20, or something like it, for energy.

zh: 接着，协商应该对所有国家开放 ， （ 比如）以UNFCCC的名义让它们坐下来谈。
en: Later, negotiations could be opened up to all states, placing them under the ambit of the UNFCCC, for example.

zh: 协商的关注点必须面面俱到，产生关于排放限制以及对环境破坏性较小的能源予以财务和技术支持方面的结果。
en: The focus of the negotiations must be comprehensive, resulting in emission limits and financial and technological support for energy sources that are less harmful to the environment.

zh: 限制排放将给技术不太成熟的过度依赖能源出口的国家以及新兴国家消费者带来压力。
en: Limiting emissions would impose costs disproportionately on oil-exporting countries, and on consumers in emerging countries, where technology is less sophisticated.

zh: 在UNFCCC德班会议中，所有国家 — — 不管是发达国家还是新兴国家，不管是自然资源富裕国还是匮乏国 — — 必须群策群力，确保当前困扰世界的危机被解决后，我们不会对全人类所面临的最大危机放松警惕。
en: At the UNFCCC’s meeting in Durban, all countries – developed, emerging, with or without natural resources – must join together to ensure that when the other crises currently roiling the world are finally resolved, the biggest crisis of all does not catch us off guard.

zh: 什么能源短缺？
en: What Energy Shortage?

zh: 瑞士马蒂尼 — — 如果我们能够捕获并利用短短两分钟内照射到地球上的太阳能量，就足以为我们的汽车加油、为我们的建筑提供照明、采暖以及满足整整一年其他所有的用电需求。
en: MARTIGNY, SWITZERLAND – If we were able to capture and use the energy from just two minutes of sunlight falling on the earth, it would be enough to fuel our cars, light and heat our buildings, and provide for all of our other electricity needs for an entire year.

zh: 简单地说，我们人类并没有面临能源短缺。
en: Simply put, we humans are not facing a shortage of energy.

zh: 我们所面临的是捕获能量并将其提供给消费者的技术难题；投资于更好的储存方法是解决这一难题最有效的方式之一。
en: We are facing a technical challenge in capturing it and delivering it to consumers; and one of the most efficient ways to meet that challenge is to invest in better ways to store it.

zh: 当今世界的许多问题都可以追溯到能源应用领域，从石油供应引发的冲突、温室气体排放引发的担忧到因电力短缺或停电造成的生产率和产量损失。
en: Many of the world’s problems today can be traced to energy use, from conflicts over oil supplies and concerns about greenhouse-gas emissions to lost productivity and output stemming from shortages and blackouts.

zh: 在世界许多最贫困地区，能源的缺乏仍在扼杀经济发展。
en: In many of the poorest parts of the world, the lack of energy stifles economic development.

zh: 全球范围内超过13亿人还没用上电；大约26亿人还没用上现代烹饪设施。
en: Globally, more than 1.3 billion people have no access to electricity; and some 2.6 billion have no access to modern cooking facilities.

zh: 上述人口中超过95%居住在撒哈拉以南非洲或亚洲发展中国家，并且84%生活在农村地区。
en: More than 95% of these people are in Sub-Saharan Africa or developing Asia, and 84% live in rural areas.

zh: 比方说，在尼日利亚最近一次总统选举前夕，一位妇女被问及她想要候选人为她做什么。
en: During the run-up to the recent presidential election in Nigeria, for example, a woman was asked what she wanted the candidates to deliver.

zh: 她只回答了一个词 ： “ 灯 ” 。
en: She replied with a one-word answer: “Light.”

zh: 电力这种最基本的商品能够让她继续工作、让她的孩子继续学习。
en: Electricity, a basic commodity, would allow her to continue to work and her children to study.

zh: 非洲及印度次大陆大部分地区、以及亚洲部分地区的问题是无法确保能源供应。
en: Unreliable or unavailable energy is a problem in much of Africa and the Indian sub-continent, as well as some other parts of Asia.

zh: 据国际能源机构一份报告显示，改进能源部门在世界某些最贫困地区可以带来相当于十年的增长成绩。
en: According to a report by the International Energy Agency, improvements to the energy sector could provide the equivalent of a decade of growth in some of the poorest parts of the world.

zh: 创新的缺乏加剧了全球能源危机。
en: Our global energy crisis has been aggravated by a lack of innovation.

zh: 美国政府劳伦斯 - 利弗莫尔国家实验室的一项研究表明，我们的能源从产出到被消费期间的损耗高达超过60 % 。
en: According to a study by the United States government’s Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, more than 60% of the energy we use is lost between the time it is generated and the time it is consumed.

zh: 其中包括将化石能源转化为电能过程中的低效率、传输损失、消费者的浪费行为以及有必要储备一部分电能预防停电事故。
en: This includes the inefficiency in converting fossil fuels to electricity, losses during transmission, wasteful consumer behavior, and the need to maintain a reserve to prevent blackouts.

zh: 必须掀起一波新的创新浪潮，目的是杜绝浪费、减少污染并拓宽世界各地能源的获取。
en: A new wave of innovation is required, one that can eliminate waste, reduce pollution, and broaden access to energy around the world.

zh: 这意味着注重效率提升技术，如无线通信、机器通信、智能电表和更好的生产管理。
en: That means focusing on efficiency-boosting technologies such as wireless communication, machine-to-machine communication, smart metering, and better production management.

zh: 可再生能源，包括太阳能和风能，能够很好地满足成熟和新兴经济体的能源需求。
en: Renewable energy sources, including solar and wind power, are well positioned to contribute to energy needs in both mature and emerging economies.

zh: 但因为太阳并不总是照耀，风也并不总是吹拂，来源于上述渠道的能量具有间歇性和不稳定性。
en: But, because the sun does not always shine, and the wind does not always blow, energy from these sources is unstable and intermittent.

zh: 除非我们能有效储存可再生能量，否则这将继续成为一道难题。
en: And this will continue to be a problem unless, and until, we are able to store power from renewable sources efficiently.

zh: 美国西部电力协调委员会的研究已经发现寻找更好的方式来储存能量可以削减总浪费量的约18 % ， 并提高11%的电能使用效率。
en: Studies by the US Western Electricity Coordinating Council have found that finding better ways to store energy could cut total waste by about 18% and boost the efficiency of electricity use by up to 11%.

zh: 更好的储能方法也会使电力更容易输送到目前电力紧张的边远地区，有助于最大限度地利用往往稀缺的资源。
en: Better energy-storage methods would also make it easier to deliver electricity to hard-to-reach areas that are currently underserved, as well as help make the best use of often-scarce sources of power.

zh: 一种久经考验的储能办法是利用超额能力将水泵入水库，以便在需求高峰时可以用它来驱动涡轮机。
en: One well-tested method for storing energy is to use excess capacity to pump water into reservoirs, so that it can be used later to power turbines when demand is high.

zh: 但这种方法只在山区可行，因此作为大规模市场解决方案有些不合适。
en: But this approach is practical only in mountainous areas, making it unsuitable as a mass-market solution.

zh: 有希望的研究领域包括充放电次数可达数万次的电网级别电池，以及靠数据分析来优化电池使用，从而尽可能提高电网效率。
en: Promising areas of research include grid-scale batteries with the ability to charge and discharge tens of thousands of times and data analytics to optimize the use of the batteries and make the grid as efficient as possible.

zh: 仅仅会生产能量是不够的。
en: It is not enough to generate energy.

zh: 我们还必须有效利用、广泛采用先进的存储技术。
en: We must also use it efficiently, and the wide-scale adoption of state-of-the-art storage technology will be an essential part of the solution.

zh: 确保全球能源稳定、高效、方便和廉价供应需要时间。
en: Ensuring that the world’s energy supplies are stable, efficient, accessible, and affordable will take time.

zh: 但我们很快就会实现突破。
en: But breakthroughs are on the horizon.

zh: 我们的任务是继续关注这一问题。
en: Our task is to keep our sights there.

zh: 接触伊斯兰主义者
en: Engaging the Islamists

zh: 哈马斯在巴勒斯坦议会选举中大获全胜令全世界为之震惊。 然而这一结果本不应该让人如此意外。
en: The massive victory of Hamas in the Palestinian parliamentary elections stunned much of the world, but the outcome should not have been so surprising.

zh: 的确，哈马斯的胜利时刻是该地区日益明朗的趋势的一部分。
en: Indeed, Hamas’s moment of triumph is part of a growing regional pattern.

zh: 四年前，土耳其的伊斯兰党派“公正和发展党”赢得了议会选举的多数席位并组阁。
en: Four years ago, Turkey’s Islamic-oriented Justice and Development Party won a plurality in parliamentary elections and formed a government.

zh: 一个月之后，摩洛哥一个名称相似的伊斯兰党派PJD在立法选举中位居第三。
en: A month later, a similarly named Islamic party in Morocco, Parti de la Justice et du Development (PJD), finished third in legislative elections.

zh: 去年12月，埃及的穆斯林兄弟会（自1954年起就被定为非法组织）同样战绩辉煌，赢得了20%地普选选票和88个议会席位，从而成为穆巴拉克的执政党“国家民主党 ” ( NDP)的主要反对派阵营。
en: Last December, the Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt (legally banned since 1954) scored equally impressive results, garnering 20% of the popular vote and 88 seats in the Parliament, making it the main opposition bloc to Mubarak’s ruling National Democratic Party (NDP).

zh: 黎巴嫩真主党和伊拉克的什叶派政党也在选举中取得了不俗的成绩。
en: Hezbollah in Lebanon and Shiite parties in Iraq have also performed well in elections.

zh: 尽管有民主的前提，但大多数西方国家政府在与这些党派接触方面还是颇为勉强，在接受伊斯兰主义者通过选举掌权的事实上也是如此。
en: Despite this democratic endorsement, most Western governments have been reluctant to engage with these parties or to prepare for Islamists coming to power through the ballot box.

zh: 它的讽刺意味在于：似乎一向把民主怀疑为西方阴谋的伊斯兰主义者，比美国那些实行独裁的盟友们更严肃地对待布什总统在穆斯林世界推行民主的行动—甚至比布什本人还严肃。
en: The irony is obvious: Islamists, who seem suspicious of democracy as a Western plot, took President George W. Bush’s promotion of democracy in the Muslim world more seriously than America’s autocratic friends – and possibly more seriously than Bush himself.

zh: 在哈马斯获胜以后白宫举行的第一次新闻发布会上，布什在回应这一“出乎意料的形势发展”时明显语塞。
en: In his first press conference after Hamas’s victory, Bush was visibly at a loss for words in responding to this “unexpected development.”

zh: 事实上在过去的三年里，包括我在内的一些地区性“局内人士”和布什在国家安全委员会和国务院的顾问们进行了几次长时间的讨论。
en: The truth is that over the last three years, some regional insiders, including me, had several lengthy discussions with Bush’s advisors on the National Security Council (NSC) and in the State Department.

zh: 我们敦促布什政府制定连续性的政策，与本地区愿意接受民主治理原则的伊斯兰主义者接触。
en: We urged the Bush administration to formulate a consistent policy that engages the region’s Islamists who are willing to rule by democratic principles.

zh: 其中有些辩论的内容已经广为人知了。
en: Some of this debate was widely publicized.

zh: 美国在和伊斯兰主义者接触方面的迟疑在一定程度上反映了它对那些独裁政权的反应有所顾虑。 它们中的一些国家是美国的长期盟友。
en: Part of America’s reluctance to deal with Islamists reflected concern over the reaction of autocratic regimes, some of which are long-time allies.

zh: 事实证明这种担心不仅是毫无必要的，也是适得其反的，因为它并未能阻止伊斯兰主义者在阿拉伯中东地区的征程。
en: This fear proved not only unwarranted, but also counterproductive, for it has not stopped the march of the Islamists in the Arab Middle East.

zh: 现在是时候以一种全新而大胆的策略来应对穆斯林世界所有介入性政治力量了。
en: Now it is time for a fresh and bold approach toward all contending political forces in the Muslim world.

zh: 首先，美国和西方必须停止以援助、贸易和武器的方式支持独裁政权。
en: First, America and the West must stop supporting autocrats with aid, trade, and arms.

zh: 其次，还必须努力为穆斯林世界的民主人士扩大公共空间，因此就需要推动自由媒体和独立司法以保护新闻自由。
en: Second, there must be a push to expand the public space for the Muslim world’s democrats, so free media and independent judiciaries to protect press freedom need to be boosted.

zh: 再者，不论有多困难，一场和伊斯兰主义者的积极对话必须开启动并持续下去。
en: Third, an active dialogue that engages the Islamists, no matter how difficult, must begin and continue.

zh: 西方必须建立明晰和持续的接触规则。
en: The West needs to establish clear and consistent rules of engagement.

zh: 有条件地恢复对巴勒斯坦的援助是合法的也是必需的。 为此，哈马斯必须承认以色列的存在权并恪守此前由巴解组织和巴勒斯坦当局所签署的各种协议。
en: It is legitimate and imperative to make resumption of aid to Palestinians contingent on Hamas’s recognition of Israel’s right to exist and on its commitment to all international agreements previously signed by the PLO and the Palestinian Authority.

zh: 作为赢得国际社会承认的第一步，巴解组织必须修改《巴勒斯坦盟约 》 ， 该盟约呼吁摧毁以色列。
en: In an earlier step toward recognition by the world community, the PLO had to revamp the Palestinian Covenant, which called for the destruction of Israel.

zh: 如果以强硬的姿态提出这样的要求，那么哈马斯没有理由不步前人后尘。
en: There is no reason why Hamas would not follow that precedent, if the demand to do so were made relentlessly.

zh: 事实上，从爱尔兰共和军到桑地诺民族解放阵线（Sandinistas ） ， 再到非洲国民议会（African National Congress ） ， 所有的武装解放运动都在适当的时候都 放弃了暴力。
en: In fact, all militant liberation movements have renounced violence in due time, from the IRA to the Sandinistas to the African National Congress.

zh: 同样，不论在心理上多么难以接受，以色列也必须积极回应来自哈马斯的每一个友好姿态。
en: Likewise, Israel must reciprocate every gesture of good will from Hamas, however psychologically difficult this may be.
