zh: 毕竟，1947年和他们类似的犹太“自由战士”炸毁了大卫王酒店，杀死数十名英国军官。
en: After all, in 1947 similar Jewish “freedom fighters” blew up the King David Hotel, killing tens of British officers.

zh: 直到1970年代，这些犹太复国主义游队员还被英国政府作为恐怖分子通缉。
en: Until the 1970’s, these Zionist guerillas were wanted as terrorists by British authorities.

zh: 而接着，他们中的一员，梅纳赫姆·贝京当选为以色列总理，并成为埃及总统萨达特的和平伙伴。
en: Then one of them, Menachem Begin, was elected Prime Minister of Israel and became a partner in peace with Egypt’s President Anwar Sadat.

zh: 据埃及当局称，萨达特本人由于策划和参与实施了对一位政治要员的刺杀，因而也有恐怖分子的嫌疑。
en: Sadat himself was a suspected terrorist, according to Egyptian authorities, for having plotted and taken part in assassinating a prominent political figure.

zh: 但萨达特和贝京同样由于敢为和平承担风险而受到全世界的尊敬，并共同获得诺贝尔和平奖。
en: But both Sadat and Begin became respected worldwide for taking risks for peace and won a joint Nobel Peace prize.

zh: 因此，对于哈马斯以及美国、西方和以色列而言，带着愤怒和挫伤抱着过去不放是于事无补的。
en: So, for Hamas as well as for America, the West, and Israel, it is futile to look back in anger and frustration.

zh: 他们都应该以前瞻的心态开创比萨达特、贝京、拉宾甚至沙龙的遗策更为新颖和积极的政策。
en: Instead, they all should look forward to creating anew the more positive legacies of Sadat, Begin, Rabin, and even Ariel Sharon.

zh: 如果这些领导人们都能够和他们暴力的过去决裂，并采取切实步骤达成地区和平，哈马斯又怎么会不行呢？
en: If those leaders could disavow their own violent pasts and take practical steps toward peace in the region, why can’t Hamas?

zh: 新世纪的新技术
en: A New Century’s New Technologies

zh: 达沃斯—今年的瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛要确定地缘政治和人类安全问题，并寻找加快制定更有效的政治、经济和技术工具以解决它们的办法。
en: DAVOS – This year’s World Economic Forum meeting in Davos, Switzerland, addresses threats to geopolitical stability and human life, and seeks ways to accelerate the design of more effective political, economic, and technological tools to address them.

zh: 我们这一代人的最紧迫挑战包括食品、水和能源短缺；气候变化和海平面上升；以及新的耐药性疾病的蔓延。
en: Among this generation’s most daunting challenges are food, water, and energy shortages; climate change and rising sea levels; and the spread of new, drug-resistant diseases.

zh: 此前，人类便已面临着生存威胁和地球健康威胁，但我们通过巧思和发明成功避免了启示录的发生，或者至少推迟了它。
en: Humanity has faced threats to its existence and the health of the planet before, yet we have managed to avoid the apocalypse, or at least postpone it, through ingenuity and invention.

zh: 今年的达沃斯会议将让我们略微了解下一波拯救生命、地球和经济的发现和产品将会产生于何处，以及我们应该将天才和资金用于何处以刺激下一代变革性技术。
en: This year’s Davos meeting will offer a glimpse of where the next life-, planet- and economy-saving discoveries and products will come from, and where we should invest our talents and treasure to fuel the next generation of transformative technologies.

zh: 生物学、物理学和工程学的加速趋同给我们带来了层出不穷的新技术方案。
en: An accelerating convergence of the biological, physical, and engineering sciences promises a stunning array of new technological solutions.

zh: 想象一下，一座火电厂只排放水和新鲜空气。
en: Imagine a coal-fueled power plant that emits only water and clean air.

zh: 再地球内部，设计师酵母细胞将燃煤过程所产生的二氧化碳转化为地板砖和其他建筑材料的原料。
en: Inside the plant, designer yeast cells transform the carbon dioxide released during the coal’s combustion into raw materials for floor tiles and other construction supplies.

zh: 或者想象一下用简单又廉价的尿检诊断癌症，彻底避免手术活体切片。
en: Or imagine a simple and inexpensive urine test that can diagnose cancer, eliminating the need for a surgical biopsy.

zh: 此外，当需要治疗癌症时，疗法的毒性只针对癌细胞，大大降低伤害性副作用。
en: And, when cancer treatment is needed, its toxic punch hits cancer cells selectively, with far fewer damaging side effects.

zh: 或者想象一下食物和燃料作物充足的未来。
en: Or imagine a future with plentiful food and fuel crops.

zh: 通过改良种子储备和更有效的水管理，我们可以获得水需求更低的作物，以更高密度种植，并且能适应更大的温度范围。
en: Through improved seed stocks and more efficient water management, we can have crops that require less water, grow at higher density, and thrive in wider temperature ranges.

zh: 而数据驱动型农业供应链将把作物更有效地推向市场。
en: And data-driven agriculture supply chains will move them more effectively to the market.

zh: 这些进步将让我们能够养活2050年的预计人口 — — 九十亿人，并为他们提供电力 — — 以更小的经济和环境成本实现。
en: These advances will enable us to feed and provide power – at a lower economic and environmental cost – to the anticipated 2050 population of nine billion people.

zh: 这些和其他创新正在通过方兴未艾的生物学和工程学的趋同涌现。
en: These and other innovations are emerging from the convergence of biology and engineering that is now upon us.

zh: 新一代科学家、工程师和临床医生，他们受到的教育比前辈范围更广，能够互相听懂语言，并以前所未有的方式共事。
en: A new generation of scientists, engineers, and clinicians, educated more broadly than their predecessors, speak the languages of both and are working together in unprecedented ways.

zh: 他们进行着跨学科对话 — — 不仅是工程学和生物学，也包括化学、物理学、数学和计算机 — — 并寻找新的创新之路，让初始发现转变为市场中的成熟应用。
en: They are conversing across disciplines – not only engineering and biology, but also chemistry, physics, mathematics, and computation – and setting new paths for innovation, from initial discovery to the launch of advanced applications in the marketplace.

zh: 今天我们许多人所依赖的技术来自二十世纪初物理学和工程学发现的并行收敛。
en: The technologies on which many of us depend today arose from a parallel convergence of discoveries in physics and engineering in the early twentieth century.

zh: 1900年，世界还没有没有普及电力、汽车和飞机，也没有通信设备。
en: In 1900, the world did not have ready access to electricity, automobiles and aviation, or telecommunications.

zh: 而在当今世界大部，这些东西已是理所当然；事实上，我们已经把它们当成了必需品。
en: In much of the world, we now take these conveniences for granted; indeed, we regard them as necessities.

zh: 一开始，它们只是对物理世界运转方式的深奥探险 — — 电磁学的性质和物质的原子结构等 — — 如今，再发明家和创新者手中，它们变成了通信、新药物、医学造影和设备、核电、计算机芯片和互联网。
en: What began as esoteric explorations of the workings of the physical world – the nature of electromagnetism and the atomic structure of matter, for example – became, in the hands of inventors and innovators, telecommunications, new drugs, medical imaging and devices, nuclear power, the computer chip, and the Internet.

zh: 如今，连上互联网的移动设备数量比地球人口还要多。
en: There are now more connected mobile devices than there are people on the planet.

zh: 电子和数字行业的产品将继续扩大它们的影响力 ， “ 大数据 ” 、 “物联网”和“工业互联网”日益普及。
en: The products of electronic and digital industries will continue to expand their impact, with “big data,” the “Internet of things,” and the “industrial Internet” becoming increasingly prevalent.

zh: 除了这些二十世纪技术的扩展，我们还可以预言新一批变革性行业 — — 尽管我们还不知道它们的名字 — — 将在新千年挺进。
en: Beyond the extension of these twentieth-century technologies, we can also anticipate a new set of transformational industries – as yet nameless – as we advance into the new millennium.

zh: 与此同时，正如二十世纪物理学和工程学改变了我们的生活，生物学和工程学的加速趋同正在驱动前所未有的发现，为创新、新行业的崛起和经济增长创造新的平台。
en: At the same time, just as the twentieth century’s convergence of physics and engineering transformed our lives, the accelerating convergence of biology and engineering is driving unprecedented discoveries that promise to create another platform for innovation, the rise of new industries, and economic growth.

zh: 燃料制造和制药业已经开始依赖按需开发的微生物以创造成熟的生物产品。
en: The manufacture of fuels and pharmaceuticals already relies on purpose-developed microbes that create sophisticated biological products.

zh: 新制造过程将结合特别设计的微生物和计算机特征的化合物，形成各种产品。
en: New manufacturing processes will incorporate specially designed microbes and computer-characterized compounds into an array of products.

zh: 类似地，基因测序成本的显著降低 — — 从每人2003年的4 000万美元左右下降到今天的5 000美元左右 — — 以及计算能力的快速增加正在提高医学诊断测试的速度、准确性和鲁棒性。
en: Likewise, the dramatic reduction in the cost of gene sequencing, from roughly $40 million per human genome in 2003 to about $5,000 today, together with a rapid increase in computational power, is boosting the speed, accuracy, and robustness of medical diagnostic tests.

zh: 这不但能带来更及时、更有效的癌症疗法，也能给其他目前的疑难杂症的医治带来类似的进步。
en: That promises not only more timely and effective therapies for cancer, but also similar advances against other currently intractable diseases.

zh: 二十一世纪的产业和经济驱动力将来自日益结合的生物学和工程学努力。
en: The industries and economic drivers of the twenty-first century will arise from the increasingly combined efforts of biology and engineering.

zh: 这一趋同有助于产生提供足够清洁能源、食物、和水所需要的技术方案，也能提供更加健康的未来，让2050年的九十亿人口能够存活下去。
en: It is this convergence that will help deliver the technological solutions needed to supply enough clean energy, food, and water, as well as better health, to sustain the world’s nine billion people in 2050.

zh: 银行界的胜利大逃亡
en: The Great Bank Escape

zh: 发自斯坦福 — — 事实证明，今年试图将世界经济从银行和银行家们过分强势的掌控中解救出来的努力又是徒劳的。
en: STANFORD – This year has proven to be yet another replete with futile efforts to manage the outsize grip that banks and bankers have on the world economy.

zh: 全球金融系统仍然扭曲并处于危险之中。
en: The global financial system remains distorted and dangerous.

zh: 自1980年代以来 ， “ 股东价值”日益成为公司治理的重点。
en: Since the 1980’s, “shareholder value” has increasingly become the focus of corporate governance.

zh: 管理层和董事会成员常常获得股权补偿，这不但使他们获得了权益，反过来又创造了一个使公司股票市场价值最大化的强大诱因。
en: Managers and board members often receive stock-based compensation, which gives them equity ownership rights and, in turn, creates a powerful incentive to maximize the market value of their companies’ shares.

zh: 然而以股东价值为名实施的经营活动通常只有利于那些自身财富与公司利润关系密切的人，而且很可能实际上会损害许多股东的利益。
en: But actions taken in the name of shareholder value often benefit only those whose wealth is closely tied to the company’s profits, and may actually be harmful to many shareholders.

zh: 尽管管理层宣称他们在追求股东价值，但它们的所作所为通常只体现了自身 — — 尤其是高层管理人员 — — 的利益，对那些持有绝大部分股份的股东并无好处。
en: Despite their claims that they are pursuing shareholder value, the actions of top managers, in particular, often reflect only their own interests, rather than those of shareholders who often hold the great majority of the shares.

zh: 这种矛盾在银行业尤为明显。
en: This discrepancy can be seen clearly in the banking sector.

zh: 2007年以前银行享受着高回报以及不断飙升的股价。
en: Before 2007, banks enjoyed high returns and soaring stock prices.

zh: 然而之前银行在风险投资中的过度负债和损失引发了全球金融危机，并导致了许多主要金融机构濒临或完全破产。
en: But excessive indebtedness and losses on the risky investments that had been made triggered the global financial crisis and led to the failure, or near-failure, of many major financial institutions.

zh: 积累了大量未偿还债务的银行随之缩小贷款规模，而尽管各国政府及中央银行大肆出手干预，此次危机还是把全球经济拖下了水。
en: Banks with substantial overhanging debt reduced lending, and, despite the massive intervention of governments and central banks, the crisis dragged down the global economy.

zh: 结果自2008年以来，股民在银行上的投资损失惨重。
en: As a result, since 2008, shareholders have lost substantially on their investments in banks.

zh: 这次危机 — — 加上随之而来的长期经济低迷 — — 也导致了那些进行多样化投资的股东们在其他投资项目上遭受了损失。
en: The crisis – together with the prolonged economic downturn that followed – caused diversified shareholders to lose on their other investments, too.

zh: 此外，许多银行股东都直接或是间接地通过所在企业或是雇主受到了贷款中断的影响。
en: Furthermore, many bank shareholders have suffered from the disruption in lending, either directly or via their businesses or employers.

zh: 有些人甚至因此失业。
en: Some have even lost their jobs.

zh: 但与其他纳税人一起，他们还承担了救助银行的费用。
en: And, along with other taxpayers, they incurred some of the cost of the bailouts.

zh: 然而，尽管顶级银行家们所持的股份在2007年与2008年之间蒙受了巨大的损失，但却依然比其他大部分股东要好过得多。
en: And yet, despite large losses on their holdings in 2007-2008, top bankers fared significantly better than most of their shareholders did in 2000-2008.

zh: 即使是破了产的贝尔斯登和雷曼兄弟投资银行的主管们也能获得数亿美元的补偿，而这些公司的股东们 — — 虽然也跟着获得了一些分红 — — 只得到了极为糟糕的保守，更别说其他跟危机相关的损失了。
en: Even executives of the failed investment banks Bear Stearns and Lehman Brothers walked away with hundreds of millions of dollars in compensation, while the companies’ shareholders, who received some dividends along the way, fared much worse – not even considering their other crisis-related losses.

zh: 为了捍卫他们的利益，银行家们一直不断游说反对一些法规 — — 这些法规要求他们较少依赖借款，转向依靠留存收益或者新股基金来资助贷款及投资。
en: To safeguard their interests, bankers have lobbied relentlessly against regulations that would require them to rely less on borrowing and more on retained earnings or new equity to fund their lending and investments.

zh: 他们声称需要为股东带来更高的回报，暗示更严格的法规会损害股东利益。
en: They cite the need to deliver high returns for shareholders, implying that tighter regulations undermine shareholders’ interests.

zh: 但更安全、负债更少的银行才能更好地继续放贷而不致陷入困境或寻求支持。
en: But safer, less indebted banks are better able to continue lending without becoming distressed or needing support.

zh: 这些银行因此也不大可能破坏全球金融系统稳定或损害大部分股东和公众的利益。
en: As a result, they are less likely to destabilize the global financial system or impose harm on most shareholders and the public.

zh: 银行家们还宣称更高的资本要求会限制信贷及阻碍经济增长。
en: Bankers also claim that higher equity requirements would restrict credit and hinder economic growth.

zh: 但他们的论据是有缺陷且具有误导性的。
en: But their arguments are flawed and misleading.

zh: 比如，他们主要用股权收益来衡量盈利能力，却忽略了股本回报率与股东价值之间的区别。
en: For example, they use return on equity as their primary measure of profitability, but neglect to distinguish between ROE and shareholder value.

zh: 事实上如果一心追求高回报率的话，银行家们就会将股东们暴露在过度风险之下，却无法提供给他们足够的相应补偿。
en: In fact, in the single-minded quest for higher returns, bankers might expose shareholders to excessive risk, without compensating them adequately.

zh: 银行家们也故意忽略政府担保和的津贴在导致借贷过于容易发放且如此吸引方面所扮演的角色。
en: And bankers neglect to acknowledge the role of government guarantees and subsidies in making so much borrowing possible and attractive.

zh: 与银行家们的主张相反，显著增加股本要求，从而保护金融系统的稳定才符合公众利益 — — 这包括了大部分股东的利益。
en: Contrary to bankers’ claims, increasing equity requirements significantly, and thus safeguarding the financial system’s stability, is in the public interest – including the interest of most shareholders.

zh: 相比之下，如果只是维持现状或者监管不足的话，银行家们将会继续以他人的损失为代价谋取私利。
en: By contrast, preserving the status quo, or implementing inadequate regulation, would allow bankers to continue to profit at the expense of others.

zh: 小股东无法轻易影响银行的决定，尤其是在与复杂风险相关的事情上。
en: Small shareholders cannot easily influence banks’ decisions, especially on complex risk-related issues.

zh: 银行的董事会拥有最终控制权，然而没有法律规定它要考虑其决策行为可能对他人造成的更大范围影响。
en: And banks’ boards of directors, which wield ultimate control, are not legally required to consider the broader impact of their actions on others.

zh: 反而，他们狭隘的视角 — — 通常与主管们的偏好相符并伤害到小股东 — — 却主导了它们的决策。
en: Instead, their narrow perspective – which tends to coincide with executives’ preferences even at the expense of other shareholders – dictates their decision-making.

zh: 即使从银行狭隘的立场出发，更高的股本要求所产生的成本也低于其他法规方案。
en: Even from banks’ narrow standpoint, higher equity requirements would cost less than other proposed regulations.

zh: 而且这种要求还会降低强势银行被要求承担破产机构解决方案经费的可能性。
en: And such requirements would reduce the likelihood that strong banks would be called upon to finance the resolution of failed institutions.

zh: （当然，如果银行家们预计能成功阻止所有旨在减少过度冒险行为的法规，或者预料到能得到救援，这些考虑因素就不太相关了。 ）
en: (Of course, these considerations are less relevant if bankers expect to succeed in blocking all regulation aimed at reducing excessive risk-taking, and to be bailed out in a crisis.)

zh: 照目前的情况，银行家们继续从其投资的有利一面中独享全部收益，同时却要债权人和纳税人 — — 有时是与股东 — — 共同分担投资的亏损。
en: As matters stand, bankers continue to benefit fully from the upside of their investments, while sharing the downside with creditors and taxpayers – and sometimes with shareholders.

zh: 尽管在改善监管与执法上取得了一些进步，行业游说还是在很大程度上成功拖延了用以保证全球金融稳定的必要改革。
en: Although some progress has been made in improving regulation and enforcement, industry lobbies have largely succeeded in delaying essential reforms needed to ensure global financial stability.

zh: 据报道摩根大通的总裁杰米·戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）告诉自己的女儿说金融危机“每5到7年就会发生一次 ” 。
en: JPMorgan Chase’s CEO Jamie Dimon reportedly told his daughter that a financial crisis “happens every five to seven years.”

zh: 上个月，摩根银行支付了11亿美元的股息，使其吸收未来投资损失的能力遭到了削弱。
en: Last month, the bank paid $1.1 billion in dividends, reducing its ability to absorb future losses on its investments.

zh: 如果政策制定者和监管者们不加强他们的改革力度，纳税人和股东 — — 当然不是戴蒙这种大银行家 — — 将依然是下一次危机的受害者。
en: If policymakers and regulators do not strengthen their reform efforts, taxpayers and shareholders – not bankers like Dimon – will be the ones who suffer the consequences of the next crisis as well.

zh: 启蒙主义经受考验
en: Enlightenment on Trial

zh: 有关宗教和科学的丑陋辩论通常看似局限在美国。 但是，最近几个月来，这场辩论开始蔓延，首先到欧洲，然后遍布全球。
en: Ugly debates about religion and science usually seem to be confined to the United States.  In recent months, however, such debates have begun to spread – first to Europe and then around the world.

zh: 科学似乎正在飘向自启蒙运动之前以来所从未遇到的政治危险之中。
en: Science, it seems, is drifting into political dangers it has not faced since before the Enlightenment.

zh: 当维也纳的红衣主教克里斯托弗·施波恩对那些自认为是罗马天主教信徒的人们质疑达尔文主义和进化论理论是否可以接受时，欧洲开始了其美国式的有关生命起源的辩论。
en: Europe began its own American-style debate on the origins of life when Cardinal Christoph Schönborn of Vienna cast doubt on the acceptability of Darwinism and evolutionary theory to people who see themselves as faithful Roman Catholics.

zh: 这个红衣主教主张进化是上帝之作，应该根据这一观点，而非其他观点来解释进化论理论。
en: The Cardinal argued that evolution is the work of God and that evolutionary theory should be interpreted in that light and no other.

zh: 从启蒙运动、至少是自十九世纪末和二十世纪初的经过艰苦努力而赢得的政教分离以来，以来老欧洲一直维系的科学和宗教之间和平相处。 在红衣主教施波恩的干预下，这一局面突然之间被打破了。
en: With Cardinal Schönborn’s intervention, the peace between science and religion that in Old Europe had held almost since the Enlightenment – and at least since the historically hard-won eviction of the Church from politics in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries – seemed suddenly to have been broken.

zh: 这位红衣主教似乎说，上帝启示的真理应当被置于科学通过理性揭示的真理之上。
en: Revealed truth, the Cardinal seemed to say, must be accorded primacy over the truths science reveals through reason.

zh: 这并非说明宗教情感，或者就德国而言，从纳粹时期发展而来的苦难的历史经历并没有就干细胞研究的伦理问题向其他欧洲国家表明。
en: This is not to say that religious sentiment or, in the case of Germany, bitter historical experience stemming from the Nazi era, had not informed other European debates, say, on the ethics of stem-cell research.

zh: 实际上，欧洲国家的宗教背景清楚地反映在有关这种研究的不同的欧洲国家的法律之中。 英国和瑞典最为开明，而意大利、奥地利和波兰最为限制。
en: Indeed, the religious background of Europe’s nations clearly manifested itself in various European laws on such research, with the United Kingdom and Sweden being the most liberal and Italy, Austria, and Poland the most restrictive.

zh: 但是，没有任何辩论挑战科学在社会中的作用，或者像红衣主教施波恩一般表明宗教和科学可能互不相容。
en: But none of these debates directly challenged the role of science in society or posed, as Cardinal Schönborn did, the idea that religion and science are potentially incompatible.

zh: 根据红衣主教的宣称，许多人指向美国，认为那里是通过宗教把科学政治化所固有的危险的迹象。
en: Following the Cardinal’s declaration, many pointed to the US as a warning sign of the dangers inherent in politicizing science through religion.

zh: 他们指出，有些人想让进化学理论成为学校科学课程的选修科目，而布什总统已经公开地站在他们一边。
en: They noted that President Bush had sided openly with those who want to make evolutionary theory optional in schools’ science curricula.

zh: 这种伪科学在众多的美国学校中张扬，其原因与美国极为松散的学校体系直接有关。 这一体系允许宗教观念坚定的地方组织修改学校的课程。
en: The reason that such pseudo-science has prevailed in so many American schools is directly related to America’s tremendously decentralized school system, which allows committed local groups of the religious-minded to reshape the curriculum.

zh: 在美国，此类基于信仰的运动的力量不可否认，并且其在科学和政治融合的领域影响力与日俱增，这包括供应某些药品，如所谓的“女用口服避孕丸”即是一例。
en: The power of faith-based movements in the US is undeniable, and their influence in other areas where science and politics meet, including the availability of certain drugs – the so-called “morning after” pill being one example – is growing.

zh: 欧洲的学校由于其结构不太可能受到“特创论”的侵袭。
en: It is unlikely that European schools, because of their structure, can be invaded by “creationism.”

zh: 然而欧洲也不应该认为可以免受此问题影响。
en: Yet Europe should not think itself immune to this problem.

zh: 当教义信仰进入政治领域，遇到争论议题时就难以达成妥协，而这一点对民主政治而言不可或缺。
en: When dogmatic faith enters politics, compromises on controversial issues, which are indispensable in a democracy, become difficult to achieve.

zh: 这是因为基本价值观念与分配物质资源相比被认为是没有商议余地的。
en: This is because fundamental values – as opposed to, say, the distribution of material resources – are seen as being non-negotiable.

zh: 危险在于，这样会导致包含科技因素的科学决策不再服从于研究或者理性的争论，而变成了各种利益团体争斗的目标。 这些团体总是宣称他们交纳的税收应该只用来赞助与他们的价值观一致的研究项目。
en: The danger is that scientific decisions with a scientific-technical component are no longer subject to study or rational argument, but instead are fought over by various interest groups, with some invariably claiming that their taxes should be used to fund only research that is compatible with their values.

zh: 关于科学的性质与利益之争并不是仅限于美国和欧洲。
en: Debates about the nature and benefits of science are not confined to the US and Europe.

zh: 当韩国国立大学宣布首次克隆成功狗之后，这条新闻在亚洲各地引发了关于科学和社会的争论。
en: When South Korea’s National University announced the first-ever successful cloning of a dog, the news triggered arguments about science and society throughout Asia.

zh: 虽然没有明显使用宗教的语言，但是亚洲的争论却反映了同样一种担心，即科学不知何故正“失去控制 ” ， 并且力量之大令人恐惧。
en: Although the language of religion was not used overtly, the debate in Asia reflected the same fears that science is somehow “out of control” and far too powerful.

zh: 导致这个的一个主要原因是中国正在把大量的资源投入到研发领域。
en: One key reason for this is the fact that China is pouring vast resources into research and development.

zh: 1995 年到2002年期间，中国研发领域的投入在其快速增长的国民生产总值中所占的百分比翻了一番，生物科技和其他高科技领域是重中之重。
en: Between 1995 and 2002, it doubled the percentage of its rapidly growing GDP that it invests in R&D, with biotechnology and other high-tech fields enjoying the highest priority.

zh: 科学似乎正在成为这个新的全球超级大国发展的合伙人，这种发展令全世界感到紧张。
en: Science, it seems, is becoming a partner in the unnerving development of a new global superpower.

zh: 今天，科学属于快速全球化的世界。
en: Today, science belongs to a rapidly globalizing world.

zh: 它既被看作经济增长的发动机，但也被看作给我们的安全和信仰带来威胁。
en: It is perceived as a motor of economic growth, but also as a threat to our security and beliefs.

zh: 文化世界观和宗教当然将会继续塑造文化和价值观形势，科学和技术则会在这一形势中互相影响。
en: Cultural worldviews and religion, of course, will continue to shape the overall cultural and value context within which science and technology interact.

zh: 但是价值观常常会因为过去的经验及对未来的恐惧而改变。
en: But values are subject to change, often in response to past experience and fears about the future.

zh: 经过数个世纪，科学才从政治和宗教中独立出来，虽然还有千丝万缕的联系。
en: It took centuries for science to carve out its sphere of autonomy, always a relative one, from politics and religion alike.

zh: 这种独立状态有利于科学，独立并负责的科学对社会和经济做出了巨大贡献。
en: This autonomy has served science well, and independent and accountable science has served society and the economy well.

zh: 如果要想维持这种有益的关系，那么就一定要保护科学的独立，免受摆脱宗教教义和政治干涉。
en: If this beneficial relationship is to be maintained, scientific independence – from both religious dogmatism and governmental intervention – must be defended.

zh: 谁曾想到��在二十一世纪初，旧的启蒙运动的辩论仍然会如此激烈？
en: Who would have thought that, at the dawn of the twenty-first century, the old Enlightenment debates would still be so potent?

zh: 为欧洲谋未来
en: A Future Made in Europe

zh: 罗马—在过去三年中，面临平息动荡的市场和为可靠复苏打下基础的欧盟的动作主要集中在金融稳定和减少财政赤字和债务上。
en: ROME – Over the last three years, the European Union, faced with the imperative of calming roiled markets and laying the foundations for a sound recovery, has concentrated largely on financial stability and reducing fiscal deficits and debt.

zh: 如今，金融紧张局面正在缓解，信心正在恢复，2014年欧洲领导人应该把注意力收回到实体经济和产业基础上来。
en: Now, with financial tensions easing and confidence returning, Europe’s leaders should shift their focus in 2014 back to the real economy and the industrial base.

zh: 2月的欧盟理事会部长会议将是一个很好的起点。
en: February’s meeting of the European Council of Ministers will be a good place to start.

zh: 为了决定最佳的前进道路，欧盟领导人需要回顾以往。
en: To decide the best way forward, Europe’s leaders should look to the past.

zh: 从历史上看，制造业投资是欧洲增长的一大主要引擎，如今也是为欧洲经济重新注入活力的关键。
en: Investment in manufacturing – historically one of the main drivers of growth in Europe – holds the key to revitalizing the European economy.

zh: 在过去十年中，产业政策大大地向金融和服务部门倾斜。
en: Over the last decade, industrial policy has been sidelined in favor of the financial and service sectors.

zh: 制造业被认为是明日黄花，而欧洲也不再被视为竞争性工业的合适地点。
en: Manufacturing was deemed a pursuit of the past, and Europe was no longer considered a suitable location for competitive industry.

zh: 此后，许多欧洲国家经历了去工业化。
en: Many European countries have since undergone deindustrialization.

zh: 比如，意大利工业产出自2007年以来下降了约20 % 。
en: Industrial production in Italy, for example, has declined by about 20% since 2007.

zh: 尽管如此，工业部门仍在欧盟经济中扮演着关键角色，雇用了3 400多万工人，贡献了80%的出口，也提供了很大一部分私人研发投资。
en: Nonetheless, the industrial sector continues to play a key role in the EU economy, employing more than 34 million people and accounting for 80% of exports, while providing a substantial share of private investment in research and development.

zh: 因此，工业制造业影响着欧洲经济的其他各个部门，包括服务部门。
en: Industrial manufacturing thus affects every other sector of Europe’s economy, including the service sector.

zh: 事实上，尽管决策者的注意力发生了变化，来自新兴经济体的竞争也日趋激烈，但欧洲国家的制造业表现仍位居世界前列，这是因为许多企业成功地实现了适应和创新。
en: In fact, despite policymakers’ shift in focus and emerging-economy competition, European countries remain among the world’s top performers in manufacturing, owing to the many firms that have managed to adapt and innovate.

zh: 这些企业让意大利走出“三F ” — —食品（food ） 、 时尚（fashion）和家具（furniture ） — —计入到生物制药、机电一体化和航天等领域。
en: Such firms have enabled Italy to move beyond the “three Fs” – food, fashion, and furniture – to cutting-edge sectors like biopharma, mechatronics, and aerospace.

zh: 类似的向更高附加值制造业活动转移的现象在整个欧盟随处可见。
en: A similar shift toward higher-value-added manufacturing activities is occurring across the EU.

zh: 这些发展趋势表明欧洲未来的成功将取决于其将传统经济优势与强大的创新相结合的能力。
en: These developments suggest that Europe’s future success will depend on its ability to combine its traditional economic strengths with strong innovation.

zh: 欧洲国家应该致力于创造工业部门繁荣的必要环境。
en: EU countries should be working to create the conditions that a thriving industrial sector needs.

zh: 比如，意大利最近实施了“目标意大利 ” （ Destinazione Italia）计划，通过建立更加可预测的税收制度、减少官僚繁文缛节、强化民法制度以确保有效的合同执行帮助意大利公司蝴蝶成功。
en: For example, Italy’s recently launched Destinazione Italia program will help Italian companies succeed by establishing a more predictable tax system, reducing bureaucratic red tape, and ensuring more effective contract enforcement by strengthening the civil-justice system.

zh: 这样的环境有利于企业成长，同时还能吸引外国和国内私人投资。
en: Such an environment would enable firms to grow, while attracting foreign and domestic private investment.

zh: 但光有国家层面的努力是不够的。
en: But national efforts alone are not enough.

zh: 欧洲企业早已融入了地区和全球价值链。
en: European firms are integrated into regional and global value chains.

zh: 布雷西亚所生产的元件可能会用于斯图加特所生产的设备上，而后者又在马拉加装配成为最终产品。
en: A component produced by a company in Brescia might go into equipment produced in Stuttgart, which might then be assembled as a final product in Malaga.

zh: 在这样的环境下，必然会出现一国荣则俱荣，一国损则俱损的局面。
en: In this context, no single country can reach its full potential unless all are successful.

zh: 重塑欧洲竞争力的最有效方式是把欧盟各成员国的个体优势结合起来，从而形���生产率日益提高的欧洲供应链 — — 或在全球供应链中脱颖而出。
en: The most effective approach to restoring European competitiveness would be to combine EU member countries’ individual strengths, thereby forming increasingly productive European supply chains – or capturing the top positions in global supply chains.

zh: 这要求深化各国经济的联系，塑造整合不同国家相对优势的真正的无国界单一市场。
en: This would require deepening the connections among national economies and fostering a genuine, unbounded single market that integrates different countries’ relative strengths.

zh: 在这方面，欧盟层面的更具针对性的政策至关重要。
en: To this end, more targeted policies at the EU level are essential.

zh: 保持全球竞争力需要对未来工业产品的关键决定因素 — — 能源效率和技术创新进行投资。
en: Remaining globally competitive will require investment in the key determinants of future industrial production: energy efficiency and technological innovation.

zh: 因此，欧盟应该追求支持能源密集型产业竞争力的措施，特别是要降低与欧洲工业竞争对手 — — 如美国和新兴经济体 — — 之间的能源价格差。
en: Given this, the EU should pursue measures that support the competitiveness of energy-intensive industry, with a particular focus on reducing the energy-price gap with Europe’s industrial competitors, such as the United States and the emerging economies.

zh: 有效的内部能源市场对于提供平价能源至关重要。
en: An efficient internal energy market is vital to the delivery of affordable energy.

zh: 另一个重要项目 — — 欧洲研究区（European Research Area）已经开始操作，应能在2014年进入实施阶段。
en: Another important initiative – a European Research Area – is already underway, and should be implemented by 2014.

zh: 通过成立共同的国家研究计划日程和促进技能和科学知识传播 — — 比如允许意大利顶尖机械科学研究中心从芬兰和葡萄牙招募研究员 — — 研究区能够形成最优的创新环境。
en: By creating a shared agenda for national research programs and facilitating the circulation of skills and scientific knowledge – allowing, say, a top-notch center for mechanical sciences in Italy to attract researchers from Finland or Portugal – the research area promises to create an optimal environment for innovation.

zh: 在研发领域之外，基于创新的工业经济需要拥有高水平专门技能的工人。
en: Beyond research and development, an innovation-driven industrial economy demands workers with specific, high-level skills.

zh: 要满足这一要求，欧盟必须出台促进中学、高中和高等教育的政策。
en: Meeting this demand requires EU policies that promote secondary, upper secondary, and higher education.

zh: 为了建立更深、更一体化、更多维的市场，欧盟应该把自由贸易协定作为当务之急，特别是目前正在与美国谈判的跨大西洋贸易和投资合作伙伴关系协定。
en: In order to create deeper, more integrated, and more multi-dimensional markets, the EU should place a high priority on free-trade agreements, especially the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership currently being negotiated with the US.

zh: 贸易一体化 — — 以及最终形成的跨大西洋共同市场 — — 可以成为未来数十年欧洲最有效的增长机制，特别是对中小规模制造业企业来说。
en: Such trade integration – and, eventually, a Transatlantic Common Market – could prove to be one of Europe’s most effective growth mechanisms, especially for small and medium-size manufacturing firms, in the coming decades.

zh: 欧洲制造业公司还需要更好的融资渠道。
en: European manufacturing companies also need much better access to finance.

zh: 金融危机的一个危害最大的后果是持久的信用限量。
en: One of the most damaging legacies of the financial crisis has been persistent credit rationing.

zh: 在一些国家，一半的贷款申请遭到拒绝，融资成本也高得令人咋舌。
en: In some countries, half of all loan applications are rejected and financing costs have reached prohibitively high levels.

zh: 博岑（波尔扎诺）的贷款成本是临近的因斯布鲁克的两倍，这是完全不合理的；事实上，如此武断的差异只能破坏竞争，导致经济停滞。
en: There is no reason why loans in Bozen (Bolzano) should cost twice as much as those in nearby Innsbruck; in fact, such arbitrary divergences merely undermine competition and cause economic stagnation.

zh: 如果欧盟领导人不解决这个问题（包括通过建立完善的银行联盟 ） ， 改革措施的积极效应将很快因为缺少新投资而消失殆尽。
en: If EU leaders do not resolve this issue, including by pursuing a full-fledged banking union, the positive effects of reform efforts will quickly be nullified by the lack of new investment.

zh: 再工业化 — — 加上战胜年轻人失业 — — 应该成为2014年欧洲日程的最紧要任务，欧洲应该制定2020年工业部门GDP贡献比例达到20%的目标。
en: Reindustrialization – together with the fight against youth unemployment – should top Europe’s agenda in 2014, with the goal of establishing an industrial sector that accounts for 20% of GDP by 2020.

zh: 而要让这成为可能，唯有通过进一步欧盟一体化。
en: This will be possible only through deeper EU integration.

zh: 事实上，不断紧密的联盟是欧洲构建繁荣的现代创新经济的唯一出路。
en: Indeed, ever-closer union represents Europe’s only hope of building a modern, innovative, and prosperous economy.

zh: 墨西哥转向
en: Mexico Turns a Corner

zh: 墨西哥城—多年的政治争论和政府分裂削弱了墨西哥的国家机构，严重妨碍了它们履行对墨西哥人民基本义务的能力：促进经济增长、创造高薪就业岗位、提供高品质教育和社会服务，以及保障公共安全。
en: MEXICO CITY – Years of political squabbling and divided governments weakened state institutions in Mexico, greatly hampering their ability to meet their basic obligations to the country’s citizens: to foster economic growth, to create well-paying jobs, to provide quality education and social services, and to guarantee public safety.

zh: 但这种状况已经开始改变，这要归因于政治创新让墨西哥政治领导人们团结在共同的改革日程周围。
en: But that has begun to change, thanks to a political innovation that has united Mexico’s political leaders around a shared reform agenda.

zh: 2012年，我在总统选战中承诺要把墨西哥变为更现代、更有活力、更具竞争力的国家，一个可以在二十一世纪的竞争中胜出的国家。
en: In 2012, I campaigned for the presidency on a promise to transform Mexico into a more modern, dynamic, and competitive country, one that could compete and succeed in the twenty-first century.

zh: 为了实现这一承诺，我采取了重大结构性改革。
en: In order to achieve this, I proposed major structural reforms.

zh: 大部分墨西哥选民通过投票箱帮助我赢得了大选，获胜后不久，我的图案丢就与墨西哥三大主要政治力量领导人举行了会晤，制定了共同改革日程和实现这一日程的合作框架。
en: Soon after a majority of Mexico’s voters backed my candidacy at the ballot box, my team met with the leaders of the country’s three main political forces to define a common reform agenda and a collaborative framework to realize it.

zh: 结果，我们达成了一个政治协定，提出了包括95点、现在被称为“墨西哥契约”的明确而全面的行动计划。
en: The result was a political agreement on a clear and comprehensive action plan consisting of 95 points, now known as the “Pact for Mexico.”

zh: 契约条款包括了本届政府执政伊始就获得所有政党投同意的重大结构性改革。
en: Among the Pact’s provisions are major structural reforms that all parties agreed to support at the outset of the current administration.

zh: 一揽子教育改革（已获得国会批准）将改善全国教学质量和人力资本形成。
en: A package of education reforms, which Congress has already approved, will improve the quality of teaching and the formation of human capital throughout the country.

zh: 教师将被评估，学校将获得更大的自主管理权，学术标准将成为公立教育系统的基石。
en: Teachers will be assessed, schools will be managed with greater autonomy, and a commitment to academic excellence will become the backbone of the public education system.

zh: 同样重要的还有通信改革。 通信改革的目标是扩大覆盖面、降低通信费用、改善服务质量。
en: Equally important, telecommunications reforms will expand coverage, lower consumer prices, and improve the quality of services.

zh: 通信改革将进一步开放市场、打造公平竞争环境，以此寻求提高生产率以及确保在墨经营的公司能得到战略投入品。
en: By allowing more open markets and leveling the playing field, we seek to increase productivity and ensure that companies operating in Mexico have access to strategic inputs.

zh: 在金融改革方面，众议院已经批准了承诺促进经济增长和强化金融包容性的立法（并且很快将提交参议院 ） 。
en: As for financial reform, the Chamber of Deputies has already approved legislation (soon to be taken up by the Senate) that promises to foster economic growth and enhance financial inclusion.

zh: 通过让金融机构以更有利的利率发放更多的贷款，中小企业将获得成长和繁荣的空间。
en: By enabling financial institutions to grant more loans at more favorable rates, small and medium-sized businesses will have the means to grow and prosper.

zh: 最后，国会刚刚批准的税收改革将保证可靠的公用财政并通过增加基础设施、教育、研发和社会福利（包括全民退休金和失业保障）方面的投资促进增长。
en: Finally, the tax reform that Congress recently approved will guarantee sound public finances and promote growth by increasing public investment in infrastructure, education, research and development, and welfare services (including universal pension and unemployment insurance).

zh: 但是，尽管墨西哥契约已经带来了重要的立法进展，但改革日程的一些关键项仍有待突破。
en: And yet, while the Pact for Mexico has led to important legislative developments, some key items on the agenda are still pending.

zh: 最重要的便是能源和政治改革，目前正在国会讨论中。
en: The most important of these items – energy and political reforms – are currently under consideration in Congress.

zh: 我们认识到，许多人正急切地盼望能源改革。
en: We recognize that many people are eagerly awaiting energy-sector reform in particular to begin.

zh: 事实上，该经济部门的改革是合理也是必要的。
en: Indeed, reform in this sector of the economy is both desirable and necessary.

zh: 如今，墨西哥在技术上和经济上都无法在没有立法变化的情况下充分利用其能源资源。
en: Today, it is neither technically nor economically feasible for Mexico to take full advantage of its energy resources without legislative changes.

zh: 如果我们想要强化能源安全、增加墨西哥经济的生产率，能源部门改革十分关键。
en: Energy-sector reform is crucial if we want to strengthen energy security and increase our economy’s productivity.

zh: 我们的方案将允许更多的私人能源投资，同时保证墨西哥保持对其丰富自然资源的所有权。
en: Our new legislation, recently passed, allows for more private investment in the energy sector, while guaranteeing that Mexico maintains the property rights over its vast natural resources.

zh: 我坚定地相信，随着这些结构性改革的实施，墨西哥人将能够战胜墨西哥最紧迫的问题，创造一个更繁荣、更包容、生产率更高的国家。
en: I firmly believe that with the implementation of these structural reforms, Mexicans will be able to resolve the country’s most pressing problems and build a more prosperous, inclusive, and productive country.

zh: 墨西哥契约教会了我们一个重要教训：国家优先事项和党派忠诚并不一定相互冲突。
en: The Pact for Mexico has already taught us the important lesson that national priorities and partisan loyalties are not mutually exclusive.

zh: 关于大胆改革方案达成广泛一致完全是可能的。
en: Broad agreement on a bold reform package is possible.

zh: 平心而论，与其他民主国家一样，选举将依然是竞争激烈的；但是，尽管我们有着各种不同，但绝大部分墨西哥人 — — 不管他忠于哪个党派 — — 都有一个共同的最强烈的的渴望 — — 为墨西哥建设更美好的未来。
en: To be sure, as is true in any other democracy, elections will continue to be highly competitive; but, despite our differences, the vast majority of Mexicans – regardless of their partisan loyalties – share an overriding desire to build a better future for Mexico.

zh: 我希望其他反复陷入政治瘫痪的国家也可以找到类似的改革之路。
en: I hope other countries that struggle regularly with political paralysis can find similar roads to reform.

zh: 萎缩的氦产业
en: The Deflated Helium Industry

zh: 牛津—氦对于以技术为基础的当今世界来说至关重要。
en: OXFORD – Helium is vital in today’s technology-based world.

zh: 它能精确冷却磁共振（MRI）机的超导线圈和用于制造智能电话芯片和制光纤玻璃的硅。
en: It cools, with precision, the superconducting coils of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) machines, as well as the silicon used to make chips for devices like smart phones or the glass that is drawn into optic fibers.

zh: 对压馈火箭、大物理甚至派对气球，都没有氦的现实替代物。
en: For pressure-fed rockets, Big Physics, or even party balloons, there is no realistic alternative to helium.

zh: 到目前为止，地球上看似取之不尽的氦供应完全来自24个富藏氦资源的天然气田，它们是天然气生产的副产品。
en: Until recently, the world’s seemingly abundant supply of helium was extracted solely as a by-product of natural-gas production in just two dozen helium-rich fields.

zh: 但全球氦产量短缺让氦价格以两位数的增长率上涨，也让科学界的焦虑日益增加。
en: But global helium production shortfalls have driven double-digit inflation of helium prices and fueled rising anxiety in the scientific community.

zh: 如今，美国（世界最大氦出口国）勘探者正在勘察专门生产氦的矿藏。
en: Now, prospectors in the United States – the world’s largest helium exporter – are exploring fields in search of helium exclusively.

zh: 氦短缺难免会刺激关于生产和保护的争论。
en: Helium shortages inevitably spur debate about production and preservation practices.

zh: 自1996年美国氦私有化法案（HPA）实施以来，已经发生了三次类似的短缺。 HPA要求政府以呆板的价格公式出售其还储备，以偿还20世纪60年代大规模购氦所累积的债务。
en: Since the 1996 US Helium Privatization Act (HPA) – which required the government to sell off its helium reserves using a rigid price formula in order to repay the debt accrued from a large helium buy-up in the 1960’s – there have been three such shortfalls.

zh: HPA要求售氦行为在债务偿还（即今年10月）后即行终止，因此科学界、医学界和技术界越来越担心会出现氦的大规模短缺和成本飙升。
en: Given that the HPA calls for helium sales to cease once the debt is paid – that is, this October – the scientific, medical, and technology communities have become increasingly concerned about a massive helium shortage and ballooning costs.

zh: 这与氦支持着美国大量就业的事实一起，已导致最近美国国会采取措施试图保证全球氦储备的三分之一流动起来，但价格会有所上涨。
en: This, together with the fact that helium underpins much US employment, may have contributed to the US Congress’s recent efforts to keep one-third of the world’s helium supply flowing, but at higher prices.

zh: 这是个及时的行动，因为过去15年中，强制处理美国联邦氦储备系统的巨量氦储备让美国中西部的大量氦生产商倒闭，也让其他地方的工程推迟（见图 ） 。
en: The move is timely, because the mandated disposal of such a large volume of helium from the US Federal Helium Reserve over the last 15 years has displaced many helium producers in the American Midwest and deferred projects elsewhere (see graph).

zh: 事实上，通过人为约束氦价格，HPA削弱了公司对从天然气中分离氦的投资的激励。
en: Indeed, by artificially constraining helium prices, the HPA weakened companies’ incentive to invest in separating helium from natural gas.

zh: 结果，数千吨氦在生产地或随天然气的燃烧而排入了大气。
en: As a result, many thousands of tonnes of helium have simply been vented into the atmosphere at source or when the natural gas has been burned.

zh: 结束这一对氦的可悲浪费要求天然气行业思维的根本性转变。
en: Ending this lamentable squandering of helium requires a fundamental shift in thinking in the natural-gas industry.

zh: 氦是其高能配对物质的副产品，可以说，未被使用的氦是不可保留的。
en: As helium is a by-product of its much larger energy counterpart, it is fair to say that helium that is not used will not be preserved.

zh: 如今，上游氦市场具有结构性弱点。
en: Today, the upstream helium market is structurally weak.

zh: 生产氦的美国最大天然气田雨果顿（Hugoton）正在走下坡路。
en: Helium-bearing Hugoton, America’s largest natural-gas field, is in decline.

zh: 而维持美国联邦氦储备提供的高产能并用于减轻全球氦供应破坏的影响在地质学角度上也是不可能的。
en: And sustaining the US Federal Helium Reserve’s high production capacity, which used to enable it to offset global helium-supply disruptions, is no longer geologically viable.

zh: 此外，美国页岩气行业的迅速扩张（页岩气不含能廉价回收的氦）挤出了传统天然气的边际供应。
en: Moreover, the rapid expansion in the US of shale gas, which contains no economically recoverable helium, has squeezed marginal conventional-gas supplies.

zh: 比如，俄克拉荷马的凯斯（Keyes）天然气田如今已处于休眠状态，而在美国政府自星际竞争期间开始从私人生产者手中收购氦气以来，凯斯气田缓解了巨大的氦短缺状况。
en: For example, Oklahoma’s Keyes natural-gas field – which relieved a major helium shortage just as the US government started purchasing the gas from private producers during the space race – now lies dormant.

zh: 而如果不生产天然气，氦提炼在经济上也不可行。
en: And helium extraction is not economical without natural-gas production.

zh: 天然气公司也没有什么激励改变经营方式提炼氦气。
en: As it stands, natural-gas companies have little incentive to adapt their operations to enable helium extraction.

zh: 阿尔及利亚的富氦气田Hassi R’Mel同时也是撒哈拉地区的天然气中心。
en: In Algeria, a giant gas field, the helium-rich Hassi R’Mel, is also a gas hub for the Sahara region.

zh: 富氦气流和贫氦气流在这里汇集。
en: Rich and lean streams are blended there.

zh: 这减少了氦集中度，也让提炼氦气变得十分困难。
en: This reduces the helium concentration and makes extraction difficult.

zh: 显然，问题不在于氦不足，而在于对氦资源的经济、法律和物理限制。
en: Clearly, the problem is not insufficient helium, but the economic, legal, and physical constraints on helium resources.

zh: 事实上，光是亚利桑那州便蕴藏着足够供应美国十年的氦储量。
en: In fact, Arizona alone has enough helium to supply the US for a decade.

zh: 但圣约翰的多姆（Dome）天然气田中大部分是二氧化碳李奇微亚利桑那石油公司（Ridgeway Arizona Oil Corporation）意在利用这些二氧化碳增强该地区的石油回收工程。
en: But the St. John’s Dome natural-gas field is dominated by CO2, which the Ridgeway Arizona Oil Corporation aims to use to enhance oil-recovery projects in the area.

zh: 二氧化碳并不是产品之一，也不会被排放，因此该气田中的氦仍然无法提炼。
en: Given that the CO2 is not yet being produced and will not be vented, the field’s helium remains inaccessible.

zh: 尽管存在这些挑战，工业天然气公司正在获得低等级天然气中的氦。
en: Despite these challenges, the industrial gas companies are gaining access to helium in low-grade gas sources.

zh: 尽管一些生产者 — — 包括位于怀俄明州拉巴奇（La Barge）的埃克森美孚公司纬纱溪（Shute Creek）制氦厂（到2013年为止为世界最大的氦提炼商 ） — —曾向大气中排放二氧化碳废气，但如今它们已经建立了碳捕捉装置减少或消灭碳排放。
en: Although some producers – including Exxon Mobil’s Shute Creek plant near La Barge, Wyoming (until 2013, home to the world’s largest helium refinery) – once vented waste CO2 into the atmosphere, they are now installing carbon-capture facilities to reduce or eliminate emissions.

zh: 此外，氮气 — — 可以排放到大气中而不会产生后果的气体 — — 也是氦气的伴生物。
en: Moreover, nitrogen – a gas that can be vented without consequences – always coexists with helium.

zh: 巧的是，1903年美国首次发现大量氦气是在堪萨斯州德克斯特（Dexter）的一座废气气井中，该气井中的气体中70%多是氮气，1.84%是氦气。
en: Coincidentally, the initial discovery of abundant helium in the US in 1903 occurred at a dud gas well in Dexter, Kansas, which contained a gas mixture comprising more than 70% nitrogen and 1.84% helium.

zh: 随着氦价格的上涨，富氮资源将变得有利可图。
en: As helium prices rise, nitrogen-rich sources are becoming economical.

zh: 但这些小打小闹无法满足亚洲爆发式增长的氦需求。
en: But such small-scale schemes will be inadequate to meet escalating demand for helium in Asia.

zh: 对此，应该着眼于液化天然气 — — 页岩气的先导 — — 这种技术可以从氦气成分只占0.04%的天然气中生产氦。
en: For that, firms should look to liquefied natural gas (LNG) – the precursor to shale gas – which enables the production of helium from natural gas containing just 0.04% helium.

zh: ���一个产氦的液化天然气厂于1994年在阿尔及利亚完工。
en: The first helium-producing LNG plant was commissioned in 1994 in Algeria.

zh: 卡塔尔也有一座运转中的氦提炼厂，另有一家工厂最近刚刚上马。
en: Qatar has one operating helium refinery, and another recently started up.

zh: 加在一起，它们将在2014年产出世界氦气总产量的25 % 。
en: Together, they should produce 25% of the world’s helium during 2014.

zh: 在未来十年中，氦产业将经历根本性转变。
en: Over the next ten years, the helium industry will undergo a fundamental transformation.

zh: 在中东供应商 — — 以及来自俄罗斯的新晋大型供应商 — — 主宰全球市场的情况下，美国或许将开始进口氦。
en: With such Middle Eastern supplies – as well as major new supplies from Russia – dominating the global market, the US may begin to import helium.

zh: 大部分氦供应输往亚洲，因此欧盟 — — 它消费了世界商业氦资源的20%多 — — 必须马上行动起来出台氦政策确保这一战略商品的未来供应。
en: Given that much of the helium supply will be channeled toward Asia, the European Union – which consumes more than 20% of the world’s commercially available helium – must act now to develop a helium policy that secures its future supply of this strategic commodity.

zh: 尽管欧洲高科技产业依赖于稳定的氦供应，但氦气并没有在欧洲引起足够的关注。
en: Although high-tech industries in Europe depend on a steady supply of helium, the gas has received scant attention there.

zh: 2011年MRI生产中心英国将氦排除在战略重要性元素的听证之外，因为它“没有进入调查范围 ” 。
en: In 2011, the United Kingdom, a center of MRI manufacturing, excluded helium from a parliamentary hearing on strategically important elements, because it was “outside of the scope of [the] inquiry.”

zh: 与此同时，一大半阿尔及利亚氦气在没有被分离的情况下向北通过输气管道输往西班牙和意大利。
en: Meanwhile, more than half of Algeria’s helium molecules head north, unrecovered, in gas pipelines via Spain and Italy.

zh: 阿尔及利亚是欧洲除俄罗斯以外的重要天然气供应者，因此欧盟必须据此制定其氦政策。
en: Given the importance of Algeria to Europe as an alternative to Russian gas supplies, the EU should be focusing on developing its helium policy accordingly.

zh: 全球发展的“赢”目标
en: Global Development’s Winning Goals

zh: 纽约—世界各国政府将在9月25日的联大特别会议上碰面讨论如何提速千年发展目标（MDG）以及就新的可持续发展目标（SDG）形成一致。
en: NEW YORK – The world’s governments meet at a special session of the United Nations General Assembly on September 25 to discuss how to accelerate progress on the Millennium Development Goals, and also to agree on a timetable for a new set of Sustainable Development Goals.

zh: MDG始自2000年，将于2015年到期，随之开始SDG，后者的最可能期限是2-15—2030年。
en: The MDGs, adopted in 2000, will conclude in 2015, to be followed by the SDGs, most likely for the 2015-2030 period.

zh: MDG专注于结束极端贫困、饥饿和可预防疾病。
en: The MDGs focus on ending extreme poverty, hunger, and preventable disease.

zh: 它们是联合国历史上最重要的全球发展目标。
en: They have been the most important global development goals in the UN’s history.

zh: SDG将继续与极端贫困作斗争，但还加上了确保经济增长更平等、有更高的环境可持续性等挑战，特别是加入了遏制人为造成的气候变化的危险这一关键目标。
en: The SDGs will continue the fight against extreme poverty, but also add the challenges of ensuring more equitable economic growth and environmental sustainability, especially the key goal of curbing the dangers of human-induced climate change.

zh: 设定国际发展目标给人们的生活到来了巨大不同，特别是地球最贫困地区的人们。
en: Setting international development goals has made a huge difference in people’s lives, particularly in the poorest places on the planet.

zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲从MDG中获得了巨大的好处，我们可以在设计SDG时吸取成功经验。
en: Sub-Saharan Africa has benefited enormously from the MDGs, and we can learn from that success in designing the SDGs.

zh: MDG对撒哈拉以南非洲有多大影响？ 比较实施前后十年的情况即可一窥端倪。
en: To see the MDGs’ importance for Sub-Saharan Africa, one need only compare the decade before their adoption with the decade after.

zh: 在MDG实施之前的十年中，该地区经济增长缓慢，贫困率居高不下（而且一直在上升 ） ， 疾病（包括HIV/艾滋病和疟疾）负担日益沉重。
en: In the ten years before the MDGs, economic growth in the region was slow, the poverty rate was high (and rising), and there was an increasingly heavy disease burden, including HIV/AIDS and malaria.

zh: MDG的实施击中了非洲各国政府和非政府组织、联合国机构、国际赞助人、基金会和活动家对抵抗贫困、饥饿和疾病的紧迫性的注意力。
en: The adoption of the MDGs focused increased attention by African governments, non-governmental organizations, UN agencies, international donors, foundations, and activists on the urgency of combating poverty, hunger, and disease.

zh: MDG还使全世界开始关注许多非洲最贫困国家所面临的的沉重债务负担，促使IMF和世界银行采取了一系列手段予以债务豁免。
en: The MDGs also cast a global spotlight on the crippling debt burdens faced by many of Africa’s poorest countries, leading to a process of debt cancelation led by the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.

zh: 从2000到2010年，撒哈拉以南非洲贫困率（以每日生活费不到1.25美元的人口比例衡量）降至48.5 % ， 而在1990—1999年期间，贫困率从56.5%增加到58 % ， ��此同时，总体经济增长率从1990—2000年期间的年均2.3%的基础上翻了一番，在2000—2010年期间增至5.7 % 。
en: From 2000 to 2010, Sub-Saharan Africa’s poverty rate (as measured by the share of those living on less than $1.25/day) fell to 48.5%, after having risen from 56.5% to 58% in the 1990-1999 period, while overall annual economic growth, which averaged 2.3% from 1990 to 2000, more than doubled, to 5.7% during the 2000-2010 period.

zh: 疾病控制方面也取得了重大进展。
en: There were significant improvements in disease control as well.

zh: 从1990年到情况最严重的2004年前后，每年因疟疾致死人数从约80万增加到160万。
en: From 1990 to the peak year, around 2004, annual malaria deaths rose from roughly 800,000 to 1.6 million.

zh: 此后，随着MDG启动了大量分发抗疟疾蚊帐行动，疟疾致死人数开始下降，到2010年降至每年110万人，现在可能进一步降低了。
en: After that point, upon the MDGs-inspired mass distribution of anti-malaria bed nets, malaria deaths began to decline, to around 1.1 million per year in 2010, and perhaps lower now.

zh: 类似地，在2000年时，还没有正式捐赠项目让贫困非洲人获得艾滋病抗逆转录病毒疗法。
en: Likewise, as of 2000, there were still no official donor-supported programs to enable poor Africans to receive antiretroviral treatment for AIDS.

zh: 在MDG日程设置力量的大力推动下，抗击艾滋病的捐赠项目得到了实施，超过600万非洲人现在能够通过正式捐赠项目获得抗逆转录病毒治疗。
en: Thanks in large part to the agenda-setting power of the MDGs, donor programs to fight AIDS began to be implemented, and more than six million Africans now receive antiretroviral treatment supported by official donor programs.

zh: 2001年以来，作为联合国秘书长MDG事务特别顾问（2001—2007年协助科菲·安南，2007年及以后协助潘基文 ） ， 我亲眼目睹了许多非洲政府如何认真地设置目标，利用MDG安排优先事项、促使相关利益者行动，提高公众意识和积极性，并保证相关部门的可问责性。
en: As Special Adviser to the UN Secretary-General on the MDGs since 2001 (to Kofi Annan until 2006, and to Ban Ki-moon since 2007), I have seen how seriously many African governments take the targets, using them to set priorities, catalyze stakeholders, increase public awareness and motivation, and hold ministries accountable.

zh: 随着时间的推移，联合国和高收入国家的赞助机构也开始越来越多地使用MDG协助组织他们本身在非洲的工作。
en: Over time, the UN and the high-income countries’ donor agencies increasingly used the MDGs to help organize their own work in Africa as well.

zh: 尽管MDG并不是促使2000年以来发生重大改善的唯一因素，但毫无疑问起了极重要的作用。
en: While the MDGs are not the only factor underpinning the improvements since 2000, they have played a huge role.

zh: 当然，要取得最大进步、实现MDG设定的目标，还有很长的路要走。
en: Of course, much remains to be done to maximize progress on achieving the targets set by the MDGs.

zh: 最重要的是，健康方面的重大进展可以说归功于充分的金融资源。
en: Most important, significant gains in health could be attained with adequate financial resources.

zh: 赞助国应该在今年晚些时候向全球抗击艾滋病、结核病和疟疾基金提供充足的补充资金，以确保这一关键机构继续获得成功。
en: Donor countries should provide ample replenishment funding later this year to the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria, which would ensure this vital agency’s continued success.

zh: 当联合国成员国转向下一阶段的全球发展目标时，它们应该从MDG中汲取教训。
en: When UN member states turn to the next set of global development goals, they should learn from the MDGs.

zh: 首先，保证SDG清单相对较短 — — 不超过十项 — — 能使它们更易被记住，从有助于动员群众。
en: First, keeping the list of SDGs relatively short – no more than ten – will make them easy to remember, which will help in mobilizing the public.

zh: 其次，各国政府不论贫富都应该成为SDG目标实施国并接受问责。
en: Second, all governments, rich and poor, should be accountable for meeting the SDGs as implementers.

zh: 在MDG中，穷国大多是实施国，富国大多是赞助国。
en: The MDGs applied mainly to poor countries as implementers and to rich countries as donors.

zh: SDG应该将全部国家视为实施国（富国同时也被视为赞助国 ） 。
en: The SDGs should apply to all countries as implementers (and also to rich countries as donors).

zh: 事实上，在气候变化等问题上 — — 这类问题将是新SDG的核心 — — 富国应该承担更多工作，走在穷国前面。
en: Indeed, when it comes to problems like climate change, which will be at the core of the new SDGs, rich countries have more work ahead of them than poor countries do.

zh: 第三，SDG应该建立在MDG的基础上。
en: Third, the SDGs should build on the MDGs.

zh: MDG帮助我们将全球极端贫困减少了一大半。
en: The MDGs helped to cut global extreme poverty by more than half.

zh: SDG应该接受结束极端贫困的挑战。
en: The SDGs should take on the challenge of ending extreme poverty for good.

zh: 在这方面，我嫩值得称颂世界银行，它已经出台了2030年结束极端贫困的目标。
en: The World Bank, to its credit, has already adopted the goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.

zh: 联合国成员国也应该这样做。
en: UN member states should do the same.

zh: 最后，SDG应该在可持续发展的诸项关键挑战上动员专家团。
en: Finally, the SDGs should mobilize expert groups around the key challenges of sustainable development.

zh: MDG刚刚出台时，相关专家开始自我组织起来提出实现目标的意见。
en: When the MDGs first appeared, the relevant specialists began to organize themselves to give advice on achieving them.

zh: 联合国千年计划综合了大约250名全球专家在关键性发展问题上的建议。
en: The UN Millennium Project synthesized the counsel of roughly 250 global experts on crucial development issues.

zh: 目前，在低碳能源、可持续农业、弹性城市、全面卫生覆盖等问题上同样的专家建议和解决问题流程，而这些问题都有可能进入SDG。
en: The same process of expert advice and problem solving is urgently needed on issues such as low-carbon energy, sustainable agriculture, resilient cities, and universal health coverage, all of which are likely to feature in the SDGs.

zh: 五十年前，美国总统肯尼迪说 ： “ 给予我们的目标更加明确的定义，让这些目标更加易于管理、离我们更近，我们就可以让所有人都看到它，从它身上得到希望，并且坚定地向它前进。
en: Fifty years ago, US President John F. Kennedy declared that, “By defining our goal more clearly, by making it seem more manageable and less remote, we can help all people to see it, to draw hope from it, and to move irresistibly towards it.”

zh: ”MDG在抵抗贫困方面就起到了这一作用。
en: The MDGs have helped to play that role in the fight against poverty.

zh: SDG可以在实现可持续发展的复杂挑战中起到同样的作用。
en: The SDGs can do the same for the complex challenge of achieving sustainable development.

zh: 硅谷之外
en: Beyond Silicon Valley

zh: 伯克利—加州硅谷正在再次确认其高科技企业家精神和财富创造圣地的地位。
en: BERKELY – Once again, California’s Silicon Valley is confirming its status as a mecca of high-tech entrepreneurship and wealth creation.

zh: 但这不是一个其他地方的决策者和企业家可以模仿的创造就业和包容性增长的模式 — — 至少在做出一些根本性调整之前是如此。
en: But it is not a model for job creation and inclusive growth that policymakers and entrepreneurs elsewhere can emulate – at least not without making some fundamental adjustments.

zh: 平心而论，目前在硅谷所发生的事情可谓令人眼花缭乱。
en: To be sure, what is happening in Silicon Valley today is nothing short of dazzling.

zh: 风险资本（VC）投资正处于接近历史记录的高峰。
en: Venture capital (VC) investment has reached near-record highs.

zh: 一夜暴富 — — 成为百万乃至亿万富翁 — — 层出不穷。
en: Overnight millionaires – even billionaires – are proliferating.

zh: 二十来岁的软件代码编写员要求六位数的薪水。
en: Twenty-something software coders are commanding six-figure salaries.

zh: 这一繁荣推动了加州的经济复苏。
en: The boom has driven California’s economic recovery.

zh: 并且，它与勇气十足的政治领导力一起，让加州摆脱了令人绝望的财政危机。
en: And, along with courageous political leadership, it has enabled the state to escape from a seemingly hopeless fiscal crisis.

zh: 但硅谷的超级明星科技公司和顶尖VC是繁荣孤岛上的居民。
en: But the Silicon Valley superstar tech companies and their VC champions populate an isolated island of prosperity.

zh: 事实上，距离硅谷不过100英里的加州中央山谷（Central Valley）失业率一直保持两位数（Fresno市为11.2 % ， Modesto市为10.4 % ） ，平均家庭收入还不到位于硅谷中心的帕洛阿尔托（Palo Alto）的一半。
en: Indeed, just 100 miles inland, in California’s Central Valley, unemployment rates remain in the double digits (11.2% in Fresno and 10.4% in Modesto), with average family income amounting to less than half of that in Palo Alto, the heart of Silicon Valley.

zh: 如果风险资本家蒂姆·德拉珀（Tim Draper）将加利福尼亚分成六个州的错误计划成功，硅谷将是美国最富有的州，而中央山谷将是最贫穷的州。
en: If the venture capitalist Tim Draper had succeeded in his misguided initiative to divide California into six states, Silicon Valley would have become the richest state in the US, and the Central Valley the poorest.

zh: 因此，关键问题是引导硅谷的企业家和创新动力服务于美国中心地带的包容性经济增长。
en: The key question, then, is how to harness Silicon Valley’s entrepreneurial and innovative prowess to the goal of inclusive economic growth in America’s heartland.

zh: 从某种程度上说，这已经开始发生，纳什维尔、辛辛那提、新奥尔良、威奇托（Wichita）和盐湖城等城市中的有远见的企业家调整硅谷的成功秘诀以适应本地环境和机会 — — 并在此过程中创造出急需的中产阶级工作岗位。
en: To some extent, this is already happening, with visionary entrepreneurs in cities like Nashville, Cincinnati, New Orleans, Wichita, and Salt Lake City adapting Silicon Valley’s recipe for success to local conditions and opportunities – and creating much-needed middle-class jobs in the process.

zh: 但我们可以也应该做更多事情支持这一趋势。
en: But more can and should be done to support this trend.

zh: 弗吉尼亚大学米勒中心（Miller Center）最近成立了一个委员会（作者之一的伦尼也是成员之一）研究支持通过企业家精神创造中产阶级工作岗位的战略。
en: The University of Virginia’s Miller Center recently created a commission (of which one of us, Lenny, was a member) to identify strategies to support the creation of middle-class jobs through entrepreneurship.

zh: 委员会报告中提出的观点包括为潜在企业家和创业企业 提供培训和导师、营造支持基础设施的“生态系统 ” 、 减少监管壁垒等。
en: The ideas proposed in the commission’s report include providing training and mentors for prospective entrepreneurs and startups, creating “ecosystems” of supporting infrastructure, and reducing regulatory barriers.

zh: 报告还强调了解放资本服务“主街”企业家的重要性。 “主街”资本家很难找到启动、维持和扩大经营所需要的融资，特别是最近的衰退导致大量社区银行破产，而社区银行是他们的传统信用来源。
en: The report also highlights the importance of unlocking capital for “Main Street” entrepreneurs, who struggle to find the funding they need to launch, sustain, or scale up their operations, particularly as the recent recession drove out many of the community banks on which they had traditionally relied for credit.

zh: 相反，硅谷创业企业享受着来自VC的慷慨资金支持，自20世纪80年代以来，美国风险投资总量的30—35%流向了硅谷。
en: Silicon Valley startups, by contrast, enjoy the generous support of VC funds, having received 30-35% of all venture investment deployed in the US since the 1980s.

zh: VC投资不但只集中于美国的一小部分地区；它们的最新趋势是支持后续阶段投资扩张而不是发起创业企业。
en: Not only is VC investment concentrated in a small part of the country; it has recently tended to support the expansion of later-stage investments, rather than the launch of startups.

zh: 换句话说，VC资金并不十分热衷支持可能带来大量本地就业岗位、刺激本地繁荣的新企业，而是热衷支持接近于启动数十亿美元IPO的企业。
en: In other words, VC funds are not well suited to support new businesses that may generate a large number of jobs and boost prosperity locally, but that are not close to launching a billion-dollar IPO.

zh: 全球经济危机爆发前，企业家常常依靠个人储蓄、信用卡、住房净值抵押和亲朋好友投资作为启动资本。
en: Before the global economic crisis, entrepreneurs often relied on personal savings, credit cards, home equity loans, and investments by friends and family for start-up capital.

zh: 但是，2008年以来，很少有雄心勃勃的企业家能够从银行借到大笔资金。
en: Since 2008, however, few aspiring entrepreneurs have been able to borrow significant amounts of money from banks.

zh: 而大部分人都没有有钱的亲戚或同班同学。
en: And most people do not have wealthy relatives or classmates.

zh: 但是 ， “ 主街”企业家有两个（利用不足的）融资选择。
en: Main Street entrepreneurs do, however, have two major – and underused – financing options.

zh: 第一个选择存在于公共部门。
en: The first lies in the public sector.

zh: 在美国，社区再投资法（Community Reinvestment Act，CRA，其订立是为了确保吸收中低收入社区存款的银行将一部分利润再投资于这些社区）提供了600多亿美元社区融资，而去年VC资金投资规模为480亿美元。
en: In the US, the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) – created to ensure that banks that gather deposits in low- or middle-income communities reinvest some of their earnings in those communities – supports more than $60 billion in community finance, compared to the $48 billion of VC funding that was deployed last year.

zh: 尽管传统上再投资中有很大一部分流入了住房领域，但越来越多的投资者和银行 — — 包括Bay Area Equity Fund、Village Capital和Roberts Enterprise Development Fund — — 正在将CRA资金投向企业家。
en: Though much of that reinvestment has traditionally been channeled toward housing, a growing number of investors and banks – including the Bay Area Equity Fund, Village Capital, and the Roberts Enterprise Development Fund – are investing CRA funds in entrepreneurs.

zh: 其他机构 — — 如Bridges Ventures和Pacific Community Ventures — — 正在利用社区发展金融研究所（Community Development Financial Institutions）和保险公司的资产负债表扩大欠发达社区创业企业的可用融资池。
en: Others – such as Bridges Ventures and Pacific Community Ventures – are using Community Development Financial Institutions and insurance-company balance sheets to expand the financing pool available to start-ups in disadvantaged communities.

zh: 第二个关键资本来源是私人和社区慈善基金会，根据美国法律，这些机构每年至少要将5%的资产用于慈善目的。
en: A second key source of capital lies with private and community philanthropic foundations, which are required by US law to donate at least 5% of their assets to charitable causes annually.

zh: 2012年，这些基金会大约提供了520亿美元用于慈善项目。
en: In 2012, such foundations distributed about $52 billion to support their philanthropic missions.

zh: 它们的总资产规模为7,150亿美元，剩下的大部分都流入了传统投资项目，以创造回报扩大资本基础。
en: They channeled most of the rest of their $715 billion in assets into traditional investments, in order to generate returns that would expand their capital base.

zh: 但越来越多的基金会 — — 如比尔和梅琳达•盖茨基金会、洛克菲勒基金会, 和 克雷斯基基金会（Kresge Foundation ） — —正在提高用于扩大慈善的投资的比例。
en: But a growing number of foundations – such as the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, the Rockefeller Foundation, and the Kresge Foundation – are increasing the share of assets they direct toward investments that further their philanthropy.

zh: 这些投资有助于加速影响投资 — — 影响投资的目的是同时产生社会和财务回报。
en: Such investments can help to accelerate impact investing, which aims to yield both a social and a financial return.

zh: 不幸的是，与项目有关的支出仍只占基金会资本配置的1 % ， 流向股权投资的部分更是只有0.05 % 。
en: Unfortunately, program-related spending still represents only 1% of capital deployed by foundations, with just 0.05% of that going toward equity investments.

zh: 对地方创业企业的公共和慈善投资已开始取得回报，不管是从创造就业岗位角度还是从创造财务回报角度都是如此。
en: Public and philanthropic investments in local startup businesses are already paying off, both in terms of creating jobs and generating financial returns.

zh: 早期领导者Bay Area Equity Fund从银行、退休基金和个人手中筹集到7,500万美元，创造了大约15,000个工作岗位，其中2,218个岗位位于低收入或中低收入社区，还给投资者带来24.4%的年回报。
en: An early leader, the Bay Area Equity Fund, raised $75 million from banks, insurance companies, pension funds, and individuals; created about 15,000 jobs, 2,218 of which were in low- and moderate-income neighborhoods; and generated a 24.4% annual return for its investors.

zh: 政府能够做很多事情促进这类投资。
en: The government can do much to promote such investment.

zh: 首先，政府硬干优化决定哪些投资符合RCA标准的规则。
en: For starters, it should refine the rules governing which investments meet CRA requirements.

zh: 类似地，美国影响力投资专家小组建议当局应该明确规定哪些属于免税基金会允许进行的投资活动。
en: Likewise, as the US taskforce on impact investing recommended, the authorities should clarify the permissible investment activity of tax-exempt foundations.

zh: 正如硅谷的活力不应该削弱，美国其他地区的企业家潜力也不应该低估。
en: Just as Silicon Valley’s dynamism should not be diminished, the rest of the country’s entrepreneurial potential should not be underestimated.

zh: 如果有正确的激励和来自慈善资源的资金，创造就业岗位的企业就可以成为全美国各社区更具包容性的增长的引擎。
en: With the right incentives and funding from philanthropic sources, job-creating entrepreneurs could serve as engines of more inclusive growth in communities across the US.

zh: 作为外交利器的创业精神
en: Entrepreneurship as a Diplomatic Tool

zh: 华盛顿 — — 亚美尼亚和土耳其长期以来关系一直不睦。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Armenia and Turkey have long been at odds.

zh: 由于悲剧性往事所造成的分歧，这两个相邻国家并未建立外交关系，它们的边界仍然关闭着。
en: Divided over a tragic past, the neighboring countries do not have diplomatic ties, and their border remains closed.

zh: 尽管如此，在2014年11月一群土耳其人到亚美尼亚参与创业周末活动，雄心勃勃的企业家在这里交流意见，并把他们的想法推介给投资者和专家。
en: Despite this, in November 2014, a group of Turks traveled to Armenia for Startup Weekend, an event where aspiring entrepreneurs hone and pitch their ideas to investors and experts.

zh: 在这里，年轻的亚美尼亚人和土耳其人共同合作创建新的合资企业。
en: In mixed teams, young Armenians and Turks worked together to build new ventures.

zh: “我们不会在意是亚美尼亚人还是土耳其人 — — 只会在意是不是最好的 ， ” 一位土耳其与会者这样说。
en: “We weren’t focused on being Armenian or Turkish – just on being the best,” a Turkish participant noted.

zh: 支持这次活动的美国及欧盟外交官恰恰希望达到这样的效果。
en: That sentiment is exactly what the people who backed the trip – diplomats from the United States and the European Union – had hoped to achieve.

zh: 几十年来，他们一直在努力寻找亚美尼亚人和土耳其人的共同点，以便让他们能够开始对话。
en: For decades they have struggled to find common ground for Armenians and Turks to begin a dialogue.

zh: 创业者共同的人格类型、价值观和对事务一心一意的专注创造了很好的切入点。
en: The common personality types, values, and single-minded focus of entrepreneurs created an opening.

zh: 创业精神能够催化全世界处于同样棘手境地的国家取得进步。
en: Entrepreneurship has become a catalyst for progress in similarly thorny situations worldwide.

zh: 关注就业和财富创造已成为几乎所有政府都能一致同意的“谈话焦点 ” — —至少也不存在多少能造成分歧的地方。
en: The focus on job and wealth creation has become a “talking point” upon which nearly all governments can agree – or at least find little with which to disagree.

zh: 它也因此成为一种得心应手的新形式外交工具。
en: That has made it a handy tool for a new form of diplomacy.

zh: 无论在非洲、亚洲、拉丁美洲还是中东，创业都提升了个人能力、资质及交流。
en: Whether in Africa, Asia, Latin America, or the Middle East, entrepreneurship has improved individual capability, capacity, and connectivity.

zh: 创业不仅刺激了经济活动，而且实现了社会流动。
en: It has stimulated not only economic activity but also social mobility.

zh: 强调创业精神颠覆了传统的外交援助模式，因为它假设有能力创新并推进成果商品化的当地人才（即均匀分布在世界各地的特定阶层民众）才是真正的发展引擎。
en: An emphasis on entrepreneurship stands the traditional foreign-aid paradigm on its head, because it is based on the assumption that the engine of development is local talent, a class of people – equally distributed throughout the world – with the capacity to innovate and commercialize their innovations.

zh: 在非��，像肯尼亚的M-Pesa和尼日利亚的Paga 这样的移动支付平台已经解决了其本国和横跨若干大陆的成百上千万人所面临的关键问题：那就是缺少金融服务。
en: In Africa, mobile money platforms such as M-Pesa in Kenya and Paga in Nigeria have solved a key problem for millions in their respective countries and across several continents: the lack of financial services.

zh: 通过一条简单的短信，任何有便携式手机的人都可以发送和接收资金。
en: Through a simple text message, anyone with a cellular handset is able to send and receive money.

zh: 这在极大程度上强化了资金的流动。
en: That has helped move money.

zh: 更重要的是，成百上千万人因此有机会开创属于自己的事业。
en: More importantly, it has given millions of individuals an opportunity to start their own businesses.

zh: 释放人类创造力及聪明才智正在帮助成百上千万人摆脱贫困，并协助改善国家的基础设施。
en: Unlocking human creativity and ingenuity is lifting millions out of poverty and helping improve national infrastructure.

zh: 由于化石燃料导致全球变暖，亚洲、拉美和欧洲的创业者正积极开拓一系列替代能源方案。
en: As fossil fuels contribute to global warming, entrepreneurs in Asia, Latin America, and Europe are pioneering a variety of alternative energy solutions.

zh: 像墨西哥Optima Energia这样的创业企业正在利用风能、太阳能和生物燃料来提供可持续及可扩展的能源解决方案。
en: Startups such as Optima Energia in Mexico are harnessing wind, sun, and biofuels to offer sustainable and scalable energy options.

zh: “有眼光看到新产品或新工艺并有能力将其变为现实的人才能称之为创业者 ， ” 斯蒂芬·科尔泰在他即将出版的新著《通过创业精神实现和平》中如是说。
en: “An entrepreneur is a person with the vision to see a new product or process and the ability to make it happen,” writes Steven Koltai in his forthcoming book, Peace Through Entrepreneurship.

zh: 曾担任美国国务院官员并于2009年创建全球创业计划（GEP）的科尔泰将创业描绘成“创造就业的机器 ” 。
en: A former US State Department official who set up the Global Entrepreneurship Program (GEP) in 2009, Koltai describes entrepreneurship as a “job-creating machine.”

zh: 或许开餐馆和重新定义美食体验能够揭示创业和就业之间的不同。
en: It is the difference between opening a restaurant and reimagining what the experience of eating could be like.

zh: 创业者创造全新的事物，而这些新事物反过来又能创造消费者对它们的需求。
en: Entrepreneurs create new things that in turn create consumer demand for those things.

zh: 就在上周，全球创业计划（GEP ） 、 考夫曼基金会、巴西非政府组织ANDI会同麦德林市政府在哥伦比亚麦德林市协力召开了全球创业大会。
en: Last week, GEP, along with the Ewing Marion Kauffman Foundation, the Brazilian NGO ANDI, and the city of Medellín co-hosted the Global Entrepreneurship Congress in Medellín, Colombia.

zh: 会议聚集了来自160多个国家的创业者、投资人、研究人员和决策者，共同分享最佳经验、支持初创企业的发展并建设有利于其运营的生态系统。
en: The gathering brought together entrepreneurs, investors, researchers, and policymakers from more than 160 countries to share best practices and work to bolster startup growth and build the ecosystems in which they operate.

zh: 麦德林这个城市本身就在忙于从可卡因之都到创业中心的转型工作。
en: Medellin itself is busy transforming itself from a cocaine capital into a startup hub.

zh: 前段时间，硅谷利用了这种现象，在印尼总统佐科威、印度总理莫迪和中国主席习近平面前展开了红毯。
en: Silicon Valley seized on this phenomenon some time ago, rolling out the red carpet for world leaders such as Indonesia’s President Joko Widodo, India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and China’s President Xi Jinping.

zh: 这些世界领袖正在探寻硅谷的奥秘：是哪些神奇的配方能在他们自己的国家创建同样生机勃勃的创新生态系统。
en: These world leaders are looking for the Silicon Valley secret: the magic ingredients that will create an equally vibrant innovation ecosystem in their countries.

zh: 但创业者自身并不依赖于创新或技术。
en: Entrepreneurs themselves, however, do not depend on innovation or technology.

zh: 正如科尔泰所指出的那样，星巴克围绕咖啡这种有100多年历史的古老饮料建立起了庞大的企业帝国。
en: As Koltai points out, Starbucks built an enormous enterprise around serving a cup of coffee, a centuries old beverage.

zh: 今天的星巴克全球员工约 182,000人 — — 比Facebook、Google和Apple合起来还多50，000人。
en: Today Starbucks employs roughly 182,000 people worldwide – 50,000 more than Facebook, Google, and Apple combined.

zh: 能够想象某种产品或服务，并为其创造旺盛全球需求的阿根廷人、约旦人、马来西亚人或西班牙人 — — 就像西班牙的阿曼西奥·奥尔特加扎拉创建Zara一样 — — 将成为不亚于下一个比尔·盖茨的企业家。
en: An Argentine, Jordanian, Malaysian, or Spaniard who can visualize and create thriving global demand for a product or service – just as Spain’s Amancio Ortega did with Zara – is just as much an entrepreneur as the next Bill Gates is.

zh: 从拉合尔到拉各斯、从墨西哥城到孟买，各国政府正在将其民众视为亟待开发的人才库。
en: From Lahore to Lagos, Mexico City to Mumbai, governments are looking at their own populations as pools of talent waiting to be tapped.

zh: 外交官们也是时候这样做。
en: It is time for diplomats to do the same.

zh: 他们应当支持和鼓励就业创造和问题解决，并将发展援助转化为投资。
en: They should support and encourage job creators and problem solvers, and turn development assistance into investments.

zh: 他们应当将创业精神融入经济政策和贸易协议当中。
en: They should include entrepreneurship in economic policies and trade agreements.

zh: 他们应敦促政府允许创业者开发自己的创新成果来推动人类繁荣，并作为疾病、气候变化、移民和战争等棘手问题长期解决方案的重要来源。
en: They should press governments to allow entrepreneurs to develop their innovations as a component of human flourishing and as an essential source of sustainable solutions for often-intractable problems such as disease, climate change, migration, and war.

zh: 事实上，创业精神作为青年男女自我表达的渠道是打击恐怖主义和暴力极端主义的有力武器。
en: Indeed, entrepreneurship, as a channel for young men and women to express themselves, is a compelling weapon in the fight against terrorism and violent extremism.

zh: 这条渠道可以实现建设和增值，而不是毁灭。
en: It is an outlet to build and add value rather than destroy it.

zh: 这对于中东来讲尤为重要，因为布鲁金斯学会指出，中东正在经历一场“前所未有的”大规模青年潮。
en: This is especially important in the Middle East, which is, as the Brookings Institution has noted, experiencing “an unprecedented ‘youth bulge.’”

zh: 该地区人口的30%以上 — — 也就是超过1亿人 — — 都正处于15到29岁，而且有大量年轻人找不到工作。
en: More than 30% of the region’s population – over 100 million people – is aged 15-29, and a significant number of these young people are unemployed.

zh: 对他们而言，创业精神和掌握自身命运的能力绝非可有可无；而是必须掌握的。
en: For them, entrepreneurship and the ability to gain control over their own destinies isn’t an option; it is an imperative.

zh: 同样，创业精神绝不仅仅是外交官和决策者的商业和经济选择。
en: Similarly, entrepreneurship is not just a commercial or economic option for diplomats and policymakers.

zh: 在一个正在面临急迫挑战的世界 — — 从流行病到贫困、从资源枯竭到宗教极端分子 — — 创业正在成为外交政策一种重要手段。
en: In a world with ever more pressing challenges – from pandemics to poverty and resource depletion to religious extremists – it is becoming a vital tool of foreign policy.

zh: 环境变化的健康代价
en: The Health Costs of Environmental Change

zh: 牛津 — — 近年来，世界各国越来越关注全球变暖及其他人为因素所造成环境变化的潜在灾难性后果，而且人们完全有理由这样做。
en: OXFORD – In recent years, the world has become increasingly preoccupied with the catastrophic potential of global warming and other human-induced environmental changes, and rightly so.

zh: 但最严重的危险因素之一却一直被忽视：那就是对人类健康的威胁。
en: But one of the most serious risks has been all but ignored: the threat to human health.

zh: 可以肯定，担心全球气温超过前工业化水平对地球可能意味着什么是完全合理的。
en: To be sure, concerns about what a rise in global temperatures above pre-industrial levels could mean for the planet are entirely justified.

zh: 同时，不难想见许多人对世界最贫困人口受影响最大深感忧虑，而全球第二大二氧化碳排放国美国似乎正在推卸责任。
en: And many are understandably perturbed that the world’s poorest suffer disproportionately, while the United States, the planet’s second-largest emitter of carbon dioxide, seems to be shirking its responsibilities.

zh: 但人们在很大程度上忽视了人为因素所致环境变化带来的健康影响，同时有些人为了经济利益而以我们子孙后代的生活质量为抵押。
en: But the health implications of human-induced environmental change are largely being overlooked, while future generations’ quality of life is being mortgaged for economic gain.

zh: 这样的影响在非洲、亚洲、美洲和欧洲等新兴市场国家表现得最为明显了。
en: Nowhere are these implications more visible than in the emerging markets of Africa, Asia, the Americas, and Europe.

zh: 经济快速增长和收入增加已经带来了营养、教育和社会流动性等方面前所未有的改善。
en: Rapid growth and rising incomes have led to unprecedented improvements in nutrition, education, and social mobility.

zh: 过去35年来，巴西、中国、印度、印尼、墨西哥、俄罗斯、南非和土耳其等国都在人类发展领域得了非凡的成就。
en: Over the last 35 years, countries such as Brazil, China, India, Indonesia, Mexico, Russia, South Africa, and Turkey have all made extraordinary gains in human development.

zh: 但上述进步往往是在忽视自然系统稳定的前提下取得的。
en: But this progress has often been pursued with little regard for the stability of natural systems.

zh: 全球约半数淡水水源遭到污染、2000年后超过140万平方英里（合230万平方公里）的森林消失、固体废弃物管理不善以及遍布全球的物种损失、栖息地破坏和过度捕捞等现象正在摧毁人类生存所需要的资源。
en: The contamination of roughly half of the world’s fresh water supply, the disappearance of more than 1.4 million square miles (2.3 million square kilometers) of forests since 2000, solid waste mismanagement, and widespread species loss, habitat destruction, and overfishing are destroying the very resources we need to survive.

zh: 人类正在造成自然环境的急剧恶化，乃至科学家们认为我们已经进入了“人类世”这一新的地质时期。 人类世始于1950年左右，以前所未有的行星污染为标志。
en: Humans are changing the natural environment so dramatically, and to our own detriment, that scientists believe we have entered a new geologic epoch – the “Anthropocene” – which began around 1950 and is characterized by unprecedented planetary pollution.

zh: 牛津大学格林坦普顿学院的新兴市场论坛最近得出结论，尤其是在发展中国家，上述变化已经严重影响到人类健康。
en: The Emerging Markets Symposium at the University of Oxford’s Green Templeton College recently concluded that these changes have serious implications for human health, especially in developing economies.

zh: 新兴市场论坛发现，世界现有疾病的近四分之一都是与人为环境因素相关的。
en: Up to a quarter of the world’s disease burden is associated with human-caused environmental factors, the symposium found.

zh: 五岁以下儿童罹患因环境保护不力所造成疾病的风险最大。
en: Children under five years old are at the greatest risk of suffering a disease caused by poor environmental stewardship.

zh: 修复地球自然系统并恢复地球最脆弱群体健康的目标是可以实现的。
en: Repairing the Earth’s natural systems, and restoring the health of the planet’s most vulnerable populations, is possible.

zh: 但成功实现这一目标需要环境、经济和社会政策发生根本性的变化。
en: But success will require radical changes in environmental, economic, and social policies.

zh: 在现代环境科学诞生前发展的国家可以理直气壮的说他们不知道会有这些害处。
en: Countries that developed early, before the advent of modern environmental science, can rightly claim they knew no better.

zh: 比如，在科学家们指出石棉的致癌作用、或用铅管输水造成的神经影响之前，我们并没有制定相应的法律和法规来解决这些问题。
en: It wasn’t until scientists pointed out the carcinogenic impact of asbestos, for example, or the neurological effects of pumping water through lead pipes, that laws and regulations were enacted to address these problems.

zh: 但今天，各国不能再借口对科学的无知而什么都不做。
en: But today, countries cannot hide behind scientific ignorance.

zh: 即使是发展中国家，也必须将经济抱负与对增长环境后果的全面（或至少是部分）认识相结合。
en: Even developing countries must reconcile economic ambitions with full (or at least, partial) knowledge of the environmental consequences of growth.

zh: 世界各国领袖必须做好准备倡导态度、生活方式和发展战略等领域的变化。
en: Leaders everywhere must be prepared to advocate changes in attitudes, lifestyles, and development strategies.

zh: 他们必须更重视能保护环境和公众健康的发展目标。
en: And they must place a greater emphasis on development goals that protect the environment and public health.

zh: 上述政策调整在结构管理和政治推销方面的难度都非常大。
en: These adjustments will be hard to manage structurally, and even harder to sell politically.

zh: 在某些情况下，它们需要将地球的福祉置于国家利益之上。
en: In certain cases, they will put the planet’s welfare above national interests.

zh: 但和其他国家领导人一样，新兴市场领导人必须认识到他们别无选择。
en: But leaders in emerging markets, as elsewhere, need to recognize that there is no other option.

zh: 多年无拘无束的经济增长以及无论我们如何开发、自然系统都将继续给予的错误认识已经导致我们被迫面对目前的状况。
en: Years of unbridled growth, and the misguided assumption that natural systems would continue giving, no matter how extensively they were exploited, has brought us to this point.

zh: 但也有好消息，那就是严格的环境保护可以适应经济增长、社会进步和政治稳定的要求。
en: There is good news, however. Rigorous environmental stewardship is compatible with economic growth, social progress, and political stability.

zh: 最贫困的国家也同样如此，只要他们严格执行促进健康、非破坏性发展模式的合理的环境政策。
en: This is true for even the poorest countries that pursue environmentally sound policies that promote healthy, non-destructive models of development.

zh: 特朗普内阁所做的让美国退出巴黎气候协定的短视决策有可能将世界推向另一个方向。
en: Shortsighted decisions, like that taken by the Trump administration to withdraw the US from the Paris climate agreement, have the potential to move the world in the other direction.

zh: 我们决不能容忍这样的情况。
en: We must not let that happen.

zh: 巴黎协定其余缔约国必须共同努力解决世界所面临的环境挑战，并密切关注不作为所造成的健康代价。
en: The agreement’s remaining signatories must work collectively to solve the world’s environmental challenges, paying close attention to the health costs of inaction.

zh: 现有的发展轨迹无法得到纠正，除非所有国家都认可我们可以同时实现经济增长和环境保护的目标。
en: The current trajectory cannot be corrected unless all countries accept that economic growth and environmental stewardship can coexist.

zh: G20和联合国等全球论坛可以成为促进可持续发展的重要管道。
en: Global forums, like the G20 and the United Nations, can serve as key conduits for the promotion of sustainable development.

zh: 尤其是促进健康和福祉的策略必须能更好地融入到地方、国家和国际环境决策。
en: In particular, strategies to promote health and wellbeing must be better integrated into local, state, and international environmental policymaking.

zh: 毫无疑问：一意孤行的反对者会质疑科学并抨击那些认为忽视环境可能危害人类健康的倡导者。
en: Make no mistake: determined opponents will question the science and criticize those who claim that human health is being jeopardized by environmental disregard.

zh: 但我想对这些批评者提一个问题 ： “ 你们愿意承担错误的风险吗？ ”
en: But to these critics I pose a question of my own: “Are you willing to risk being wrong?”

zh: 地球极限和人类繁荣
en: Planetary Boundaries and Human Prosperity

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 人类的未来取决于能否把握住平衡。
en: STOCKHOLM – The future of humanity will depend on mastering a balancing act.

zh: 难度在于养活一百多亿人的同时保护地球的生命支持系统。
en: The challenge will be to provide for the needs of more than ten billion people while safeguarding our planetary life-support systems.

zh: 最近的科研发现让我们能更好地把握这种平衡。
en: Recent scientific insights have made us better equipped than ever to strike that balance.

zh: 完成这项任务将是我们这代人肩负的伟大使命。
en: Doing so will be our generation’s great task.

zh: 人类历史上首次能够实实在在地结束贫困。
en: Ending poverty has become a realistic goal for the first time in human history.

zh: 我们有能力确保地球上每个人都拥有过上有尊严、有机遇生活所需的食物、水、住房、教育、医疗和能源。
en: We have the ability to ensure that every person on the planet has the food, water, shelter, education, health care, and energy needed to lead a life of dignity and opportunity.

zh: 但要想实现这一目标只有同时保护地球关键系统：包括气候、臭氧层、土壤、生物多样性、淡水、海洋、森林和空气。
en: But we will be able to do so only if we simultaneously protect the earth’s critical systems: its climate, ozone layer, soils, biodiversity, fresh water, oceans, forests, and air.

zh: 而上述系统正承受着前所未有的压力。
en: And those systems are under unprecedented pressure.

zh: 过去一万年中，地球的气候一直相当稳定。
en: For the last 10,000 years, the earth’s climate has been remarkably stable.

zh: 全球气温升降不超过一摄氏度（上个冰河期全球气温有超过八摄氏度的波动 ） ， 生态系统也有着满足人类需求的足够弹性。
en: Global temperatures rose and fell by no more than one degree Celsius (compared with swings of more than eight degrees Celsius during the last ice age), and resilient ecosystems met humanity’s needs.

zh: 这个被称为全新世的时期提供了人类文明崛起和繁荣所需的稳定。
en: This period – known as the Holocene – provided the stability that enabled human civilization to rise and thrive.

zh: 据我们所知只有这种状态才能确保上百亿民众生活得富裕繁荣。
en: It is the only state of the planet of which we know that can sustain prosperous lives for ten billion people.

zh: 但人类已经成为改变地球生态系统的唯一最大力量，标志着世界进入到一个全新的地质时代，有人将其称之为人类世。
en: But humans have now become the single largest driver of ecosystem change on earth, marking the start of a new geological age that some call the Anthropocene.
