zh: 科学家们尚未确定这个时代的确切起点，但可以追溯到大约1945年，当时现代工农业开始快速发展。
en: Scientists argue over the exact starting point of this epoch, but it can be dated to somewhere around 1945, when modern industry and agriculture began to expand briskly.

zh: 从那以后，地质学家能看到核爆炸碎片释放的放射性碳原子等警示性标志，以及塑料废弃物嵌入岩石并散落在地球表面。
en: In the future, geologists will see telltale markers like radioactive carbon – debris from nuclear blasts – and plastic waste scattered across the planet’s surface and embedded in rock.

zh: 最近，人类活动已经进入被称为剧烈加速的阶段：资源消耗和生态退化速度大幅加快。
en: More recently, human activity has undergone what is being called the Great Acceleration: the rapid intensification of resource consumption and ecological degradation.

zh: 我们有可能破坏地球的关键系统，并威胁现代文明本身的安全。
en: We risk disrupting the earth’s critical systems, and with them modern civilization itself.

zh: 地球对人类压力做出的反应很可能难以预测。
en: The planet’s response to our pressures is likely to be unpredictable.

zh: 事实上，意想不到的情况已经开始上演。
en: Indeed, the surprises have already begun.

zh: 随着我们透支地球资源，地球已经开始以极端天气事件、冰盖加速融化、生物多样性快速丧失和珊瑚礁大面积脱色等形式惩罚全球经济。
en: As we overdraw on our planet’s accounts, it is starting to levy penalties on the global economy, in the form of extreme weather events, accelerated melting of ice sheets, rapid biodiversity loss, and the vast bleaching of coral reefs.

zh: 我们迫切需要建立安全区，防止人类将地球推出异常温和的全新世。
en: We face an urgent need to define a safety zone that prevents us from pushing our planet out of the unusually benevolent Holocene state.

zh: 2009年几位科学家（包括我们的约翰在内）最先发布的地球极限框架就是要完成这项任务。
en: The Planetary Boundaries framework, which a group of scientists, including one of us (Johan), first published in 2009, does just that.

zh: 框架借鉴了尖端科学，以确定能让地球保持全新世状态的关键行星变化。
en: It draws on the best science to identify the key planetary processes regulating the earth’s ability to sustain Holocene-like conditions.

zh: 该框架为每项变化制定了边界 — — 即量化极限 — — 超出上述极限就有可能带来导致地球不适于人类生存的突发性变化。
en: For each of those processes, it proposes a boundary – a quantitative ceiling – beyond which we risk inducing abrupt changes that could push our planet into a state that is more hostile to humanity.

zh: 这九大边界包括气候变化、臭氧层破坏、海洋酸化、干扰全球氮磷循环、土地利用变化、全球淡水应用、生物圈完���性、空气污染和一些全新因素（如有机污染物，放射性物质、纳米材料以及微塑料 ） 。
en: These nine boundaries include climate change, ozone depletion, ocean acidification, interference in the global nitrogen and phosphorus cycles, land-use change, global freshwater use, biosphere integrity, air pollution, and novel entities (such as organic pollutants, radioactive materials, nanomaterials, and micro-plastics).

zh: 令人担忧的是，我们在一月做出的确认这九大边界并对其进一步量化的最近一次更新表明人类已经越过了这九大边界中的四个：包括气候变化、氮和磷的使用、生物多样性的丧失和土地利用变化。
en: Worryingly, our most recent update in January, which confirms the nine boundaries and improves their quantifications further, indicates that humanity has already transgressed four: climate change, nitrogen and phosphorus use, biodiversity loss, and land-use change.

zh: 我们所面临的挑战是在把地球系统带回安全区的同时确保每个人拥有足够资源能够快乐充实的生活。
en: Our challenge is to bring the earth’s systems back within the safety zone, while simultaneously ensuring that every person has the resources he or she needs to lead a happy and fulfilling life.

zh: 地球和社会边界之内才是人类安全公正的行动空间：要想建设摆脱贫困、具有生态弹性的世界我们必须尊重上述界限。
en: Between these planetary and social boundaries lies humanity’s safe and just operating space: the limits we must respect if we are to create a world that is ecologically resilient and free of poverty.

zh: 实现上述目标需要更公平地分配地球资源并提高使用效率。
en: Meeting these goals will require a far more equitable distribution of the planet’s resources and far greater efficiency in how we use them.

zh: 要保证地球上所有人都能茁壮成长，我们就必须建立实现繁荣的新典范。
en: If we are to ensure that our planet remains one on which all of humanity can thrive, we will have to pursue a new paradigm of prosperity.

zh: 环境挑战的地缘政治
en: The Geopolitics of Environmental Challenges

zh: 伦敦 — — 世界许多国家似乎都陷入到紧张局势。
en: LONDON – Much of the world seems to be on edge.

zh: 西方与俄罗斯的关系、北约的未来、叙利亚内战和难民问题、日益崛起的右翼民粹主义、自动化的影响和英国即将脱欧带来的冲击：所有这些话题 — — 和其他问题交织在一起 — — 已经牢牢占据了世界各国公众辩论的主题。
en: The West’s relationship with Russia, the future of NATO, the Syrian civil war and refugees, rising right-wing populism, the impact of automation, and the United Kingdom’s impending departure from the European Union: all of these topics – and more – have roiled public debate worldwide.

zh: 但有一个问题 — — 有人可能会说这个问题是最重要的 — — 正在遭到忽视或者搁置：那就是环境问题。
en: But one issue – one might say the most significant of them all – is being ignored or pushed aside: the environment.

zh: 今年在瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛年会上的情况就是如此。
en: That was the case at this year’s annual meeting of the World Economic Forum at Davos, Switzerland.

zh: 除中国主席习近平提到巴黎气候协定外，像气候变化和可持续发展这样的话题甚至被从主要舞台上挤了出去。
en: Beyond a mention of the Paris climate agreement by Chinese President Xi Jinping, topics like climate change and sustainable development didn’t even make it to the main stage.

zh: 相反，他们被降格到附属会议上讨论，附属会议的议题似乎与当前政治和经济事件鲜有交集。
en: Instead, they were relegated to side meetings that rarely seemed to intersect with current political and economic events.

zh: 允许环境问题在当前这一地缘政治和社会动荡期半途而废是一个错误，这不仅是因为目前恰恰是管理气候变化之战的关键时期。
en: Allowing environmental issues to fall by the wayside at this time of geopolitical and social instability is a mistake, and not just because this happens to be a critical moment in the fight to manage climate change.

zh: 环境退化和自然资源不安全正在削弱我们应对某些全球最严重问题的能力。
en: Environmental degradation and natural-resource insecurity are undermining our ability to tackle some of the biggest global issues we face.

zh: 尽管经常遭到低估，但环境不安全是导致全球动荡的一个主要因素。
en: Environmental insecurity is a major, though often underestimated, contributor to global instability.

zh: 联合国难民事务高级专员报告自2008年以来，自然灾害造成每年超过2600万人流离失所 — — 几乎占到这一时期被迫流离失所者总人数的1/3。
en: The UN High Commission on Refugees reports that natural disasters have displaced more than 26 million people per year since 2008 – almost a third of the total number of forcibly displaced people in this time period.

zh: 就连当前的难民危机也不乏环境因素。
en: Even the current refugee crisis has an environmental element.

zh: 战争爆发前几年，叙利亚经历了该国有史以来最极端的干旱天气。
en: In the years leading up to the war, Syria experienced its most extreme drought in recorded history.

zh: 那次旱灾，加之不可持续的农业耕作和糟糕的资源管理，导致150万叙利亚人在国内流离失所，并催化了2011年起义爆发前的政治动荡局势。
en: That drought, together with unsustainable agricultural practices and poor resource management, contributed to the internal displacement of 1.5 million Syrians and catalyzed political unrest ahead of the 2011 uprising.

zh: 环境和农业压力之间的联系绝不仅仅是叙利亚的问题。
en: The link between environmental and agricultural pressures extends far beyond Syria.

zh: 过度依赖特定的农业地域耕作意味着粮食生产可能加剧、甚至创造出新的环境问题。
en: Over-reliance on specific geographies for agriculture means that food production can exacerbate environmental problems, or even create new ones.

zh: 就像密西西比河流域一样，这可能导致全球消费者利益与当地民众利益之间产生对立，这个世界著名粮仓之一的化肥残留正在加深人们对水资源质量的忧虑。
en: This can pit global consumer interests against local citizen interests, as it has along the Mississippi River, where fertilizer runoff from one of the world’s breadbaskets is contributing to concerns about water quality.

zh: 这种联系是双向的，一方面环境条件影响农业生产 — — 而且反过来又决定了占世界贸易商品约10%的农产品价格。
en: The connection goes both ways, with environmental conditions also shaping agricultural production – and, in turn, the prices of agricultural commodities, which represent about 10% of traded goods worldwide.

zh: 举例而言，温度上升和降水模式改变已经推高了咖啡定价。
en: For example, rising temperatures and altered precipitation patterns are already driving up the price of coffee.

zh: 随着全球适合种植咖啡的土地注定要在2050年前减少近一半 ，价格压力只会进一步加剧。
en: With the global land area suitable for growing coffee set to contract by up to half by 2050, price pressures will only intensify.

zh: 突然转向贸易保护主义可能进一步推高农产品价格。
en: A sudden shift toward trade protectionism could drive up agricultural commodity prices further.

zh: 如此涨价将影响家庭农场收入，在给某些农民带来好处的同时伤害其他人。
en: Such an increase would affect farm-level household income, favoring some farmers while harming others.

zh: 最终消费者，尤其是穷人和弱势群体，也将因此而陷入困境。
en: End consumers, particularly the poor and vulnerable, would also suffer.

zh: 环境理应成为经济辩论核心的另一个原因是农业一直是全球唯一的最大雇主。
en: Another reason why the environment should be at the center of economic debates is its role as the world’s single largest employer.

zh: 其中近十亿人，即刚刚不到全球劳动力总数的20 % ， 在农业领域实现正式就业。
en: Almost a billion people, just under 20% of the world’s labor force, are formally employed in agriculture.

zh: 还有十亿人左右从事自给自足的农业，因此并未被记入正式的工资统计数据。
en: Another billion or so are engaged in subsistence farming, and therefore don’t register in formal wage statistics.

zh: 支持经济发展的任何计划都必须支持这部分民众向更高生产率的活动转移。
en: Any initiatives to support economic development must support this population’s transition toward higher-productivity activities.

zh: 在越来越复杂和综合的技术工艺威胁跨跃某些国家的整代工人时，上述转移的重要性尤其不容忽视。
en: This is particularly important at a time when increasingly sophisticated and integrated technology threatens to leapfrog an entire generation of workers in some countries.

zh: 惠及数量巨大的这部分民众的工作不仅要关注培训和教育，而且还要注重允许各国充分利用自然资本的全新模式 — — 其中包括地形地貌、流域和海域 — — 但同时要避免谋求发展采取耗尽资源的方式。
en: Efforts to benefit this huge population must focus not only on training and education, but also on new models that allow countries to capitalize on their natural capital – the landscapes, watersheds, and seascapes – without depleting it.

zh: 就像自然资源不安全可能导致脆弱和流离失所一样，有效的自然资源管理可以支持可持续经济发展和冲突的解决。
en: Just as natural-resource insecurity can cause displacement and vulnerability, effective natural-resource management can support conflict resolution and sustainable economic development.

zh: 在这方面，实现环境补救、提高农业群体抵御灾害的能力以及推动可持续农业生产和支持以社区为基础的环境管理工作都已经取得了显著的效果。
en: On this front, efforts to achieve environmental remediation, to boost the resilience of rural communities, to advance sustainable agricultural production, and to support community-based environmental stewardship have all shown promising results.

zh: 以北方牧场信托组织为例，该机构为实现肯尼亚可持续和公平的土地利用，致力于创建地域群体保护区。
en: Consider the Northern Rangelands Trust, an organization focused on creating community conservancies to enable sustainable and equitable land use in Kenya.

zh: 北方牧场信托组织帮助牧民群体建立其赖以生存的有效环境治理机制，减少因为放牧权所引发的冲突，尤其是在干旱时期。
en: NRT has helped pastoralist communities establish effective governance mechanisms for the environment on which they depend, reducing conflict over grazing rights, especially in times of drought.

zh: 对众多群体而言，群体成员与他们所生活的陆地环境之间的关系与他们的身份形成有机的统一。
en: For many communities, members’ relationship with the landscape in which they live is an integral part of their identity.

zh: 通过有效的治理和规划、公开对话、资源共享框架和对包括技能培训在内的充分投资，这些群体可以将这种关系转化为有效的环境管理 — — 并建设更健康和更安全的社会。
en: With effective governance and planning, open dialogue, resource-sharing frameworks, and sufficient investment, including in skills training, these communities can translate this relationship into effective environmental stewardship – and build healthier and more secure societies.

zh: 吞噬现代社会的危机极为复杂。
en: The crises engulfing the modern world are complex.

zh: 但有一点十分清楚：环境与所有危机都有着不可分割的关系。
en: But one thing is clear: the environment is connected to all of them.

zh: 如果没有能够执行方案的健康世界，单纯制定解决方案将几乎没有任何意义。
en: Solutions will mean little without a healthy world in which to implement them.

zh: 好不平等性与坏不平等性
en: Good and Bad Inequality

zh: 普林斯顿—在经济理论中，平等与效率的权衡占据着崇高地位。
en: PRINCETON – In the pantheon of economic theories, the tradeoff between equality and efficiency used to occupy an exalted position.

zh: 美国经济学家亚瑟·奥肯（Arthur Okun）著有经典名著《平等与效率：大权衡 》 （ Equality and Efficiency: The Big Tradeoff ） ， 他认为公共政策就是围绕管理这两种价值的冲突而生的。
en: The American economist Arthur Okun, whose classic work on the topic is called Equality and Efficiency: The Big Tradeoff, believed that public policies revolved around managing the tension between those two values.

zh: 2007年，纽约大学经济学家托马斯·萨金特（Thomas Sargent）在为加州大学伯克利分校学生发表毕业演说时总结了12条简短的经济学原理智慧，权衡也在其中。
en: As recently as 2007, when New York University economist Thomas Sargent, addressing the graduating class at the University of California, Berkeley, summarized the wisdom of economics in 12 short principles, the tradeoff was among them.

zh: 增进平等需要牺牲经济效率的观念建立在经济学最重要思想之一上：激励（incentives ） 。
en: The belief that boosting equality requires sacrificing economic efficiency is grounded in one of the most cherished ideas in economics: incentives.

zh: 企业和个人需要有更高的收入前景才会储蓄、投资、努力工作和创新。
en: Firms and individuals need the prospect of higher incomes to save, invest, work hard, and innovate.

zh: 如果盈利企业和富裕家庭的税收影响到这一前景，结果就是偷懒和经济增长下降。
en: If taxation of profitable firms and rich households blunts those prospects, the result is reduced effort and lower economic growth.

zh: 共产主义国家的平等主义实验往往导致经济灾难，一直是反再分配政策的“呈堂证供 ” 。
en: Communist countries, where egalitarian experiments led to economic disaster, long served as “Exhibit A” in the case against redistributive policies.

zh: 但是，最近几年来，经济学理论和实证经验都倾向于这一假定的权衡。
en: In recent years, however, neither economic theory nor empirical evidence has been kind to the presumed tradeoff.

zh: 经济学家提出了新论据证明为何经济表现不仅相容于分配公平，甚至还有求于它。
en: Economists have produced new arguments showing why good economic performance is not only compatible with distributive fairness, but may even demand it.

zh: 比如，在高度不平等的社会，穷人家庭被剥夺经济和教育机会，经济增长也受到抑制。
en: For example, in high-inequality societies, where poor households are deprived of economic and educational opportunities, economic growth is depressed.

zh: 另一面是斯堪的纳维亚国家，那里的公平主义政策显然没有妨碍经济繁荣。
en: Then there are the Scandinavian countries, where egalitarian policies evidently have not stood in the way of economic prosperity.

zh: 今年早些时候，国际货币基金组织（IMF）的经济学家得出了一个似乎足以颠覆这一旧共识的实证结果。
en: Early this year, economists at the International Monetary Fund produced empirical results that seemed to upend the old consensus.

zh: 他们发现，更大的不平等性伴随着随后更快的中期增长，不管在国家内部还是在国家间都是如此。
en: They found that greater equality is associated with faster subsequent medium-term growth, both across and within countries.

zh: 此外，分配政策并未表现出任何对经济表现的危害。
en: Moreover, redistributive policies did not appear to have any detrimental effects on economic performance.

zh: 看起来我们可以鱼与熊掌兼得。
en: We can have our cake, it seems, and eat it, too.

zh: 这是一个令人惊讶的结果 — — 考虑到这一结果来自极少出现异端或极端思想的IMF就更加值得惊讶了。
en: That is a striking result – all the more so because it comes from the IMF, an institution hardly known for heterodox or radical ideas.

zh: 作为一门科学，经济学可以说没有揭示过任何普遍真理。
en: Economics is a science that can claim to have uncovered few, if any, universal truths.

zh: 与社会生活中的几乎所有其他方面一样，平等和经济表现之间的关系可能是偶然的而不是固定的，取决于不平等的更深层次原因和诸多中介因素。
en: Like almost everything else in social life, the relationship between equality and economic performance is likely to be contingent rather than fixed, depending on the deeper causes of inequality and many mediating factors.

zh: 因此，关于不平等的有害影响的新共识可能与旧共识一样具有误导性。
en: So the emerging new consensus on the harmful effects of inequality is as likely to mislead as the old one was.

zh: 比如，考虑工业化与不平等之间的关系。
en: Consider, for example, the relationship between industrialization and inequality.

zh: 在大部分劳动力受雇于传统农业的穷国，城市工业机会的出现也许能拉低不平等，至少在工业化的早期阶段是如此。
en: In a poor country where the bulk of the workforce is employed in traditional agriculture, the rise of urban industrial opportunities is likely to produce inequality, at least during the early stages of industrialization.

zh: 随着农民走向城市、获得更高收入，收入差距也被打开。
en: As farmers move to cities and earn higher pay, income gaps open up.

zh: 但同一过程产生了经济增长；所有成功的发展中国家都有这一经历。
en: And yet this is the same process that produces economic growth; all successful developing countries have gone through it.

zh: 比如，在中国，20世纪70年代末以后的快速经济增长伴随着不平等程度的显著增加。
en: In China, for example, rapid economic growth after the late 1970s was associated with a significant rise in inequality.

zh: 不平等程度增加的大约一半来自城乡收入差距，而这也是经济增长的引擎。
en: Roughly half of the increase was the result of urban-rural earnings gaps, which also acted as the engine of growth.

zh: 或者，考虑对富人和中产阶级征税以提高穷人家庭收入的转移支付政策。
en: Or consider transfer policies that tax the rich and the middle classes in order to increase the income of poor households.

zh: 许多拉丁美洲国家（如墨西哥和玻利维亚）以财政审慎的方式采取了这类政策，以确保政府赤字不会导致债务高企和宏观经济动荡。
en: Many countries in Latin America, such as Mexico and Bolivia, undertook such policies in a fiscally prudent manner, ensuring that government deficits would not lead to high debt and macroeconomic instability.

zh: 另一方面，查韦斯及其后继者马杜罗在委内瑞拉所采取的激进再分配转移支付由暂时性石油收入作为资金源，转移支付和公关经济稳定性都受到了威胁。
en: On the other hand, Venezuela’s aggressive redistributive transfers under Hugo Chávez and his successor, Nicolás Maduro, were financed by temporary oil revenues, placing both the transfers and macroeconomic stability at risk.

zh: 尽管委内瑞拉（目前的）不平等程度被抑制，但其经济增长前景也被严重削弱。
en: Even though inequality has been reduced in Venezuela (for the time being), the economy’s growth prospects have been severely weakened.

zh: 20世纪90年代初以来，拉丁美洲是世界上唯一一个不平等程度下降的地区。
en: Latin America is the only world region where inequality has declined since the early 1990s.

zh: 社会政策的改善和教育投资的增加都是重要因素。
en: Improved social policies and increased investment in education have been substantial factors.

zh: 但高技能和低技能工人薪酬差距 — — 经济学家称之为“技能溢价 ” — —的下降也起到了重要作用。
en: But the decline in the pay differential between skilled and unskilled workers – what economists call the “skill premium” – has also played an important role.

zh: 对经济增长来说，这是好消息还是坏消息？ 答案取决于技能溢价下降的原因。
en: Whether this is good news or bad for economic growth depends on why the skill premium has fallen.

zh: 如果薪酬差异是因为高技能工人相对供给增加而收窄，那么我们可以寄希望于拉丁美洲不平等程度的下降不会干扰增长加速（甚至可能是增长加速的早期信号 ） 。
en: If pay differentials have narrowed because of an increase in the relative supply of skilled workers, we can be hopeful that declining inequality in Latin America will not stand in the way of faster growth (and may even be an early indicator of it).

zh: 但如果基础原因是高技能工人需求下降，那么薪酬差异缩小意味着作为未来增长基石的现代技能密集型产业扩张不足。
en: But if the underlying cause is the decline in demand for skilled workers, smaller differentials would suggest that the modern, skill-intensive industries on which future growth depends are not expanding sufficiently.

zh: 在发达国家，不平等程度增加的原因仍在争论中。
en: In the advanced countries, the causes of rising inequality are still being debated.

zh: 自动化和其他技术变革、全球化、工会式微、最低工资的侵蚀、金融化和企业内部可接受薪酬差距范式的变化都起到了作用，只不过在美国的权重与在欧洲不同。
en: Automation and other technological changes, globalization, weaker trade unions, erosion of minimum wages, financialization, and changing norms about acceptable pay gaps within enterprises have all played a role, with different weights in the United States relative to Europe.

zh: 所有这些驱动因素对增长都有不同的效应。
en: Each one of these drivers has a different effect on growth.

zh: 技术进步显然有利于促进增长，但20世纪90年代以来的金融崛起可能具有消极效应 — — 通过金融危机和债务积累突显。
en: While technological progress clearly fosters growth, the rise of finance since the 1990s has probably had an adverse effect, via financial crises and the accumulation of debt.

zh: 经济学家不再把平等-效率权衡看做铁律，这是一件好事。
en: It is good that economists no longer regard the equality-efficiency tradeoff as an iron law.

zh: 我们不应该颠倒错误，认为更大的不平等和更好的经济表现永远会同时出现。
en: We should not invert the error and conclude that greater equality and better economic performance always go together.

zh: 毕竟，经济学只有一个普遍真理：视情况而定。
en: After all, there really is only one universal truth in economics: It depends.

zh: 股债脱节
en: The Stock-Bond Disconnect

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 人们应当如何看待全球股指迭创新高和实际利率屡创新低间的脱节关系？
en: CAMBRIDGE – How should one understand the disconnect between the new highs reached by global equity indices and the new depths plumbed by real interest rates worldwide?

zh: 几种截然不同的解释试图理顺上述趋势关系，而且只有把握原因才能精确调整货币和财政政策。
en: Several competing explanations attempt to reconcile these trends, and getting it right is essential for calibrating monetary and fiscal policy appropriately.

zh: 最流行的淡化风险因素的解释在某种程度上危险地误导了人们的思维。
en: The most popular explanations downplay risk factors in a way that can be dangerously misleading.

zh: 比方说 ， “ 长期停滞”理论认为低利率才是事情的本质。
en: For example, the “secular stagnation" theory claims that low interest rates tell the true story.

zh: 全球经济正受困于长期需求不足，可以通过持续增加政府支出来弥补事态。
en: The global economy is suffering from a chronic demand shortfall, which can be remedied through sustained growth in government spending.

zh: 按照这种观点，股票市场飙升仅仅反映未来利润折扣降低。
en: According to this view, soaring stock markets merely reflect low discounting of future profits.

zh: 此外，除英国外，纵观全世界八大经济体，劳动力收入占利润份额似乎在 近数十年呈明显下降态势。
en: Moreover, labor's share of profits seems to have fallen markedly in recent decades across the world's eight largest economies, with the possible exception of the United Kingdom.

zh: 反之，资本利润份额持续上行当然引发股价上涨（但股价在英美等劳动力收入占比至少开始周期性复苏且加息渐行渐近的国家依然保持了上升态势 ） 。
en: Conversely, capital's share of profits has been rising, which of course raises the value of equities (though, stock prices have continued to rise in countries like the US and the UK where labor shares have begun at least a cyclical recovery, and where interest-rate hikes may soon be on the horizon).

zh: 长期停滞理论的支持者认为政府支出占GDP份额虽然从20世纪60年代起在最发达经济体增长已超过两倍，但仍将延续上涨态势。
en: Proponents of secular stagnation argue that government spending as a share of GDP, which has more than doubled in most advanced economies since the 1950s, should continue to rise.

zh: 虽然人们很容易认可教育和基础设施领域高效益的政府投资在今天看来尤其必要，但由此推定需求将永远限制供给的看法却在很大程度上值得怀疑。
en: Although one can readily agree that high-yielding government investments in education and infrastructure are especially justified today, the idea that demand permanently constrains supply in a significant way is dubious.

zh: 针对近期衰退更深入的研究表明失业领域所谓的持续“滞后”效应已经相对有限，至少在美国的情况如此。
en: More refined studies of the recent recession suggest that the lasting so-called “hysteresis" effects on unemployment have been limited, at least in the US.

zh: 低利率另一种可能的解释是金融抑制。
en: Another possible explanation of low interest rates is financial repression.

zh: 欧洲央行、日本央行像之前的美联储一样，正进行大规模债券买入。
en: The European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan, like the Federal Reserve before them, are gluttonously buying bonds.

zh: 与此同时，一系列促进金融稳定的新法规正迫使银行、养老基金和保险公司对政府债券进行买入。
en: At the same time, a host of new regulations to promote financial stability are forcing banks, pension funds, and insurance companies to stock up on government securities.

zh: 因此，与其说今天的低利率反应了低增长预期，还不如说是金融市场扭曲所造成的结果。
en: Thus, today's low interest rates are more a reflection of distortions in financial markets than of low growth expectations.

zh: 金融抑制解释的支持者基本将低利率视为对债券持有者的隐形税收，压制了他们原本应得的利益。
en: Proponents of the financial repression explanation essentially view low interest rates as a hidden tax on bondholders, who receive a lower interest rate than they would otherwise.

zh: 这倒不一定是件坏事，鉴于所有税收都具有扭曲性，而且也没有更好的办法在缓解今天巨额债务负担的同时能不在某种程度上影响经济。
en: This is not necessarily a bad thing, given that all taxes are distorting, and that there really is no way to deal with today's outsize debt burdens that does not impinge on growth in some way.

zh: 但金融抑制税在累进性方面远不如普遍财产税，因为低收入家庭通常所持股权资产占比很低。
en: But the financial repression tax is not nearly as progressive as a more general wealth tax would be, because lower-income households typically have a smaller share of their assets in equities.

zh: 无论如何，目前尚无法确定金融抑制是否是全部因素。
en: In any event, it is unclear how financial repression can be the whole story.

zh: 除政府债券外更大范围的债券资产收益都明显下跌。
en: The fall in bond yields has extended to a far broader range of debt than just government paper.

zh: 还有其他因素共同促成了今天的超低利率环境。
en: Other factors are contributing to today's ultra-low interest-rate environment as well.

zh: 人口结构恶化和劳动力供给增速下滑在多数发达经济体的重要作用都无可否认。
en: Adverse demographics and declining labor-supply growth in most advanced economies are undeniably important.

zh: 但问题在于上述趋势兼具渐进性和可预测性，但利率下滑速度更快，也更超乎预期（从央行层面当然如此 ） 。
en: The puzzle, though, is that this trend has played out in a very gradual and predictable way, whereas the decline in interest rates has been more rapid and somewhat unexpected (certainly by central banks).

zh: 而且虽然有人做过这方面的努力，但很难认定弱势人口结构就是强势股价的主要推动力。
en: And it is difficult to argue that weak demographics is the main driver of strong stock prices, though some have tried.

zh: 奇怪的是， 虽然提出过这种想法，但高风险和进一步衰退引发的担忧 — — 不止针对再次发生金融危机，而且也包括地缘政治动荡和流行病肆虐 — — 似乎并未在目前的政策讨论中占据多大比例。
en: Curiously, heightened risk and fears of further disruptions – not just another financial crisis, but also geopolitical instability and pandemics – do not seem to carry much weight in current policy discussions, though the idea has been around.

zh: 虽然债券很难对这种风险进行完美对冲，但它们的作用通常要好于股票（除非发生波及全球的灾难，两者的回报率都出现问题 ） 。
en: Though bonds are hardly a perfect hedge against such risks, they typically beat stocks (except, perhaps, in cases of global conflagration, when both fare badly).

zh: 在与卡门和文森特·莱因哈特的近期合作中，我们成功证明即使灾害风险发生相对微小的变化 — — 比方说从正常的2-3%攀升至3-4 % — —也可能导致全球实际利率大幅下降，甚至将全球带入负利率领域。
en: In recent work with Carmen and Vincent Reinhart, we show that even relatively minor shifts in disaster risk – say, a rise from a normal 2-3% to 3-4% – can lead to a massive decline in global real interest rates, even taking them well into negative territory.

zh: 就算预期增长强劲这样的可能性也无法排除。
en: This can be the case even if expected growth is strong.

zh: 但上述政策影响并不简单纯粹。
en: But the policy implications of this are not straightforward.

zh: 如果政府掌握信息及分析优势，并正确判断出公众的担忧没有道理，那么当然应该利用上述信息 — — 比如发行更多债券。
en: If the government has superior information and analysis, and correctly assesses that public fear is not justified, then of course it makes sense to take advantage of the information – by issuing more debt, for example.

zh: 但如果公众对灾难风险上升的认知基本正确，那么政策问题就远没有如此简单。
en: If, on the other hand, the public is basically right about heightened disaster risks, the policy issues become much more complex.

zh: 问题在于一旦灾难来袭政府很可能面对高额成本，也就是说政府要在最必要的时刻为保持财政地位付出更高的期权价值。
en: The problem is that the government likely faces high costs if a disaster strikes, which implies a high option value to preserving fiscal space for when it is most needed.

zh: 将超低利率仅仅归结于需求不足和金融抑制的认识简单得有些草率。
en: The idea that hyper-low interest rates are merely symptoms of deficient demand or financial repression is dangerously simplistic.

zh: 公众对金融危机后未来经济灾难的担忧仍起到很大作用，欧元区持续脆弱和新兴市场动荡增强都证明了这一点。
en: Surely heightened public concern about the risk of future economic catastrophe in the wake of the financial crisis is still playing an important role, reinforced by lingering fragility in the eurozone and rising instability in emerging markets.

zh: 因此公众的态度谨慎不难理解。
en: This makes the public understandably more cautious.

zh: 但如果能解释股债走势的风险因素切实存在，那么决策者也不应该过于乐观。
en: But if the risks that might help explain the price trends for stocks and bonds are real, policymakers, too, should be careful not to throw caution to the wind.

zh: 巴基斯坦的小儿麻痹症转折点
en: Pakistan’s Polio Tipping Point

zh: 伊斯兰堡—本月上旬，巴基斯坦消灭小儿麻痹症的事业再次遭受沉重打击，两名疫苗接种工作人员和一名随行警察被杀。
en: ISLAMABAD – Early this month, tragedy struck Pakistan’s polio eradication campaign once again with the killing of two more polio workers and a policeman on patrol with the vaccination teams.

zh: 在巴基斯坦谋杀事件之前，12月和元旦分别有9名巴基斯坦卫生工作者和多名卫生事业发展工作人员被杀。 而在巴基斯坦最新谋杀事件之后，又有9名尼日利亚小儿麻痹症工作人员被杀。
en: The latest murders in Pakistan preceded the killing of nine polio workers in Nigeria, and follow the slaying of another nine Pakistani health workers in December and the New Year’s Day murders of development workers affiliated with public-health efforts.

zh: 针对这些勇敢工作人员的持续伤害给这些国家的公共卫生事业以及让所有孩子都获得救命疫苗的集体目标造成了严峻挑战。
en: The continued targeting of such brave workers is posing a severe challenge to these countries’ public-health communities and their collective ambition to reach every child with lifesaving vaccines.

zh: 对巴基斯坦来说，讽刺之处是该国一直是消灭小儿麻痹症的成功样板，病患数量从2011年的197例下降到2012年的58例。
en: For Pakistan, the irony is that the country has been a success story for polio eradication, with the number of cases falling from 197 in 2011 to 58 in 2012.

zh: 尽管最近遇到了挑战，但巴基斯坦28个区的接种工作人员仍坚守岗位 — — 在这些地区，有1200万儿童需要接种。
en: Despite recent challenges, Pakistan put vaccinators back on the job in 28 districts, where 12 million children needed to be reached.

zh: 公众对消灭小儿麻痹症的事业非常支持，这从议会表决就能一窥端倪。
en: Widespread public support for polio eradication efforts has been reflected in a parliamentary resolution.

zh: 由知名牧师组成的伊斯兰学者理事会（Ulema Council）也对这项事业给予了支持。
en: The Ulema Council, a group of influential clerics, has given its backing as well.

zh: 全球消灭小儿麻痹症计划独立监督委员会（ndependent Monitoring Board of the Global Polio Eradication Initiative）2012年11月发布的最新报告承认了巴基斯坦的最新进展，这与该机构此前报告中的消极看法形成了鲜明对比。
en: The most recent report by the Independent Monitoring Board of the Global Polio Eradication Initiative, released in November 2012, acknowledged Pakistan’s recent progress – in stark contrast to the bleak outlook of its previous report.

zh: 但关键在于即将进行的巴基斯坦选举不要影响最新获得的进展，特别是在目前的低传播率季节（即阻止其传播的最佳机会的节骨眼上 ） 。
en: But it is critical that the country’s upcoming election does not jeopardize recent gains, particularly during the current low-transmission season, which is the best opportunity to stop the disease in its tracks.

zh: 所有政治派系都必须承诺当选后致力于消灭小儿麻痹症。
en: All political factions must remain committed to the eradication drive if it is to succeed.

zh: 事实上，尽管2012年取得了一定的进展，但我们尚不能完全打断小儿麻痹症病毒在巴基斯坦的传播，其主要原因是计划的实施和管理遇到了各种障碍。
en: Indeed, despite progress in 2012, we have not been able fully to interrupt the spread of the poliovirus in Pakistan, owing primarily to obstacles affecting program implementation and management.

zh: 这些障碍必须通过在各个层面上加强治理解决，特别是在约四分之一的邦级政府权威受到严重侵蚀的情况下 — — 复杂的因素导致种族、政见、信仰间的各种不信任，使法律和秩序大规模瘫痪。
en: These challenges must be addressed through stronger governance at all levels, particularly given that state authority has been badly eroded in roughly a quarter of the country, where complex factors have created distrust in the name of ethnicity, politics, and religion, resulting in a massive breakdown in law and order.

zh: 此外，在去年，巴基斯坦还以导致取消国家卫生部的宪法修订震惊了全球公共卫生界。
en: Moreover, Pakistan shocked the global public-health community last year by adopting a constitutional amendment that led to the abolition of the national health ministry.

zh: 不幸的是，突然将卫生责任下放给邦级政府的做法并没有充分的准备和监督支持。
en: Unfortunately, the sudden devolution of health responsibilities to the country’s provinces occurred without adequate preparation or oversight.

zh: 缩减地方政府系统和巴基斯坦脆弱的民主制度的联合政府的政治分裂的同时发生继续阻碍着消灭小儿麻痹症项目的实施。
en: The simultaneous scaling back of the local-government system, along with the divisive politics of coalition governments in Pakistan’s fragile democracy, continues to undermine implementation of the polio eradication program.

zh: 由此导致的巴基斯坦邦级卫生体系的缺陷暴露无遗 — — 不但体现在无法消灭小儿麻痹症上，也体现在夺走300多名儿童生命的最新的麻疹大爆发上。
en: The resulting shortcomings in the country’s provincial health systems have manifested themselves not just in the inability to eradicate polio, but also in a recent measles outbreak, which has killed more than 300 children.

zh: 与此同时，地方政府的困难正在对提供清洁水和良好卫生环境的努力造成消极影响，而后两者对消灭小儿麻痹症、促进公共卫生起着关键作用。
en: At the same time, local governments’ difficulties are having an adverse effect on provision of clean water and proper sanitation, which are vitally important for polio eradication and public health more broadly.

zh: 还有不少父母拒绝为子女接种疫苗，特别是由神职人员以命令语气要求的疫苗接种，因为他们认为这种公共卫生手段实际上是一种隐蔽的避孕项目。
en: There have also been cases of refusal by parents to vaccinate their children, typically at the behest of clergy members, owing to the belief that such public-health efforts are in fact a covert sterilization program.

zh: 事实上，拒绝接种要占为接种儿童总数的2 % 。
en: Indeed, refusal to vaccinate accounts for 2% of the children who are missed.

zh: 最近又爆发了一起针对小儿麻痹症疫苗的抹黑事件，数名国会议员公开参与其中，这让问题更加复杂化了。
en: A recent smear campaign aimed at discrediting polio vaccination, in which several MPs publicly took part, has complicated matters further.

zh: 道路是曲折的，但我们不能让接种工作停下。
en: Daunting as all of this may be, stalling vaccination is not an option.

zh: 众所周知，一旦接种工作停止，患病数量会激增，2003年的尼日利亚就是明证 — — 10个月的拖延导致了当地数千人感染，而且影响到周边20多个国家。
en: It is well established that when vaccination is impeded, the number of cases rises drastically, as was shown in Nigeria in 2003, where a ten-month delay led to the infection of thousands of people domestically, and to reinfection in more than 20 other countries.

zh: 同样的局面也出现在巴基斯坦的史瓦特河谷（Swat Valley ） 。 2009年，史瓦特河谷被军事接管，在几个月的时间里，这一地区都无法进入。
en: A similar outcome was observed in Pakistan’s Swat Valley after the militant takeover of 2009 rendered the region inaccessible for months.

zh: 由此看来，本月因卫生工作人员受到威胁而取消卡拉奇接种工作的决定虽然可以理解，但会造成严重后果。
en: This month’s decision to hold back vaccination in Karachi after health workers there were threatened, though understandable, is nonetheless a cause for serious concern in this respect.

zh: 与尼日利亚情形一样，接种工作的中止会对邻国造成极大的负面影响。
en: As in Nigeria, vaccination delays will be highly detrimental for neighboring countries.

zh: 在阿富汗-巴基斯坦交界的广大山区，游牧民族自由地迁移着。
en: Nomadic populations move freely back and forth across the vast and porous Afghanistan-Pakistan border.

zh: 2011年，中国出现了小儿麻痹症爆发，其源头可以追溯到巴基斯坦。
en: In 2011, a polio outbreak in China was traced back to Pakistan.

zh: 过去两年中已经杜绝了小儿麻痹症的印度也如临大敌，充分认识到要在国内继续获得成功，取决于国外的小儿麻痹症消灭情况。
en: India, polio-free for the last two years, is well aware that lasting domestic success depends on eradication efforts elsewhere.

zh: 潜在的国际风险并不只局限于邻国。
en: Potential international risks go beyond the immediate neighborhood.

zh: 最近在埃及出现的脊灰野病毒也来自巴基斯坦。
en: Already, Pakistan is responsible for the recent appearance of wild poliovirus in Egypt.

zh: 幸运的是，没有迹象表明这一病毒在蔓延，但未来是否如此幸运还不好说。
en: Fortunately, there is no evidence of transmission, but we may not be so lucky in the future.

zh: 事实上，在2013年，巴基斯坦朝圣者可能把这一问题带向麦加朝圣 — — 穆斯林世界最隆重的年度机会，这已不仅仅是理论上的危险。
en: Indeed, the risk that Pakistani pilgrims could carry the problem with them on the 2013 Hajj, the largest annual congregation of Muslims, is not just a theoretical threat.

zh: 若发生最坏情形，可能将数十年来的小儿麻痹症斗争成果毁于一旦。
en: A worst-case outcome there could set back the fight against polio by decades.

zh: 挑战的规模，以及所需要的多层面应对，必须得到正确理解。
en: The scale of the challenge, and hence the multifaceted response that is needed, must not be underestimated.

zh: 如今，小儿麻痹症已成为动摇巴基斯坦国基和社会的复杂问题之一。
en: Polio today has become an example of the complex problems plaguing Pakistan’s state and its society.

zh: 巴基斯坦必须增强在消灭小儿麻痹症方面的努力，这不仅仅是兑现全球卫生承诺的需要（光是这条理由便已足够 ） 。
en: Pakistan must increase its efforts on polio eradication for reasons that go beyond fulfilling a global health promise (which is reason enough in its own right).

zh: 取得成功能够证明巴基斯坦拥有应对复杂挑战的能力，也为后续发展干预提供了蓝图。
en: Success would be a sign of Pakistan’s ability to conquer complex challenges, and it would provide a blueprint for further development interventions.

zh: 通过消灭小儿麻痹症，巴基斯坦不仅可以在全世界范围内战胜这一疾病作出贡献，也能证明其在其他全球事务中的声望和实力。
en: In eradicating polio, Pakistan would not just play its part in eliminating the disease worldwide. It would also reclaim its own global prestige and potential for progress in other areas.

zh: 打赢针对肺结核的战争
en: Winning the War on Tuberculosis

zh: 约翰内斯堡 — — 世界各国终于意识到我们这个时代最被忽视的疾病之一所带来的威胁。
en: JOHANNESBURG – The world is finally waking up to the threat posed by one of the most overlooked diseases of our time.

zh: 上个月，联合国大会（UNGA）举办了有史以来首次肺结核高级会议，目的是探讨国际根除肺结核工作的各种选择。
en: Last month, the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) hosted the first-ever high-level meeting on tuberculosis (TB) to explore options for international eradication efforts.

zh: 但虽然这种新的全球关注非常令人欣慰，但事实依然是打败肺结核的道路始于非洲。
en: But, as welcome as this new global focus is, the fact remains that the road to beating TB begins in Africa.

zh: 简言之，肺结核仍然是当前非洲最致命的流行病，全球所有的肺结核死亡病例有1/4都发生在非洲。
en: Simply put, TB remains one of the deadliest epidemics in Africa today, and one-quarter of all TB deaths worldwide occur there.

zh: 仅2016年，非洲大陆就约有417，000人死于肺结核。
en: In 2016, some 417,000 people on the continent succumbed to the disease.

zh: 近期在南非、莫桑比克和加纳爆发的多重耐药性及广泛耐药性结核病可能导致年度死亡率进一步上升。
en: Recent outbreaks of multidrug-resistant TB and extensively drug-resistant TB in South Africa, Mozambique, and Ghana could push the annual death toll even higher.

zh: 这些菌种现在完全不受抗菌治疗的影响，这进一步加大了全球根除肺结核工作的难度。
en: These pockets of the bacterium, now completely immune to antimicrobial treatment, mean that the challenge of global eradication has become even more daunting.

zh: 肺结核如此难以根治其部分原因在于它往往感染那些脆弱的人群。
en: Part of the reason for TB’s persistence is the vulnerability of the populations it infects.

zh: 首先，肺结核是艾滋病毒感染者最主要的一种死因，占到因感染艾滋病毒致死群体的40 % 。
en: For starters, TB is among the leading killers of HIV-positive people, claiming some 40% of those who die from HIV.

zh: 肺结核也威胁到非艾滋病毒感染者，尤其是那些婴儿、幼童和免疫系统受到压制的人群。
en: This poses dangers for non-HIV patients as well, especially those with suppressed immune systems, young children, and infants.

zh: 根除工作十分困难，因为结核病毒是一种经由空气传播的高度传染性细菌；矿工、囚犯、移民和难民等在密闭环境中工作和生活的群体遭受感染的可能性最高。
en: Eradication is also difficult because TB is a highly contagious airborne bacterium; people living and working in close quarters – such as miners, prisoners, migrants, and refugees – suffer the highest rates of infection.

zh: 最后，因为肺结核流行与贫困和社会边缘化之间存在密切的联系，为那些最需要的人提供帮助往往并不轻松。
en: Finally, because TB prevalence is closely linked to poverty and social marginalization, reaching those most at risk is not always easy.

zh: 传染性疾病不存在国界，随着非洲国家间贸易联系的深化以及非洲内部移民的增长，区域流行性疾病的威胁只会与日俱增。
en: Infectious diseases have no borders, and as African countries deepen their trade ties and intra-Africa migration grows, the threat of regional pandemics will only increase.

zh: 这使得非洲国家着手制定遏止、控制并最终根除像肺结核这样的公共卫生挑战的多部门综合性策略变得更加至关重要。
en: This makes it all the more critical that Africa begin developing a multi-sector, integrated approach to containing, controlling, and eventually eradicating public-health challenges like TB.

zh: 为此，非洲各国政府可以效法非洲大陆采矿业所实行的肺结核管理策略，这是南部非洲发展共同体在2014年制定的一项机构间计划。
en: To this end, one approach that African governments could emulate is the TB management strategy in place for the continent’s mining sector, an inter-agency plan devised in 2014 by the Southern African Development Community.

zh: 尽管这种所谓的“协调”策略适用于商业领域，但因其专注于与区域经济共同体（RECs ） — —也就是为实现经济一体化目的而相互合作的非盟国家 — — 进行合作，因此可以被视为为遏制肺结核采取更有效集体行动的典型榜样。
en: Although this so-called “harmonized” approach applies to a commercial industry, its focus on coordinating with the Regional Economic Communities (RECs) – African Union states grouped for economic integration – could serve as a model for more effective collective action on TB containment.

zh: 但在协商确定具体的框架之前，有三个问题迫切需要引起人们的关注。
en: But before a specific framework can be agreed upon, three issues require urgent attention.

zh: 首先，非洲医疗规划人员和传染病专家必须制定国家、地区和地方具体的遏制目标。
en: First, African health-care planners and disease specialists must set country, regional, and local containment targets.

zh: 例如，制定目标减少新增肺结核感染病例可以使卫生官员更准确地评估其战略的影响。
en: For example, setting goals for reductions in new TB infections would enable health officials to measure more accurately the impact of their strategies.

zh: 此外，为彻底根除结核病，非洲国家需要公共和私人部门作出新的长期金融承诺。
en: Moreover, to end TB completely, Africa will need new and sustained financial commitments from the public and private sectors.

zh: 最后，必须设计一套新的疾病控制战略，以保证支持区域经济共同体在经济和医疗等领域的重点目标。
en: And, finally, disease-control strategies must be designed to support the economic and health-care priorities of the RECs.

zh: 目前，绝大多数国家和地区的医疗保健体系均被迫面对资金和人力资源的匮乏。
en: At the moment, most state and regional health-care systems lack funding and human resources.

zh: 因此，非洲决策者必须建立完整的预防、诊断和护理体系，以协助政府分担疾病重担并确保统一的治疗方案能够在各地执行。
en: African policymakers must therefore develop systems for prevention, diagnosis, and care that help governments share the disease burden and ensure that treatment protocols are consistent across regions.

zh: 可以肯定，在抗击结核病的过程中出现了某些积极的趋势。
en: To be sure, there are some positive trends in the fight against TB.

zh: 全球感染率每年下降约两个百分点，就连遭结核病袭击的非洲国家仍在2013至2017年成功将感染率降低了4 % 。
en: Global infection rates are falling by about 2% annually, and even African countries hit by TB still managed a 4% decline in infections from 2013 to 2017.

zh: 而且，随着世卫组织和非洲联盟等机构开始制定根除肺结核的路线图 ，显而易见，根除肺结核的动力正在稳步上升。
en: And, with organizations like the World Health Organization and the African Union beginning to produce roadmaps for TB eradication, it is clear that momentum is steadily building.

zh: 尽管如此，在非洲保持这样的进展不仅需要重大的地区协调，而且还需要获取更多资金。
en: Still, sustaining this progress in Africa will require significant regional coordination, not to mention a lot more money.

zh: 多数非洲民众都无力承担多数疫苗和药物的费用。
en: Most vaccines and medications are currently too expensive for the majority of Africans.

zh: 但就连那些能够得到治疗的幸运儿 — — 治疗过程往往需要在6到8个月期间内使用强力抗生素 — — 仍然面临着20%的复发可能。
en: But even those lucky enough to obtain treatment – usually a six- to eight-month course of powerful antibiotics – still face a 20% chance of relapse.

zh: 彻底消灭肺结核的目标可以实现；最近在联合国大会上召开的会议标志着世界对这种疾病战争的关键转折。
en: The goal of eradicating TB is within reach; the recent gathering at the UNGA marked a critical turning point in the world’s war on the disease.

zh: 但即使人们作出承诺并签署声明，我们也不能忘记，非洲根除结核病的战斗还远未结束。
en: But even as commitments are made and declarations signed, we must remember that in Africa, the battle is far from over.

zh: 打赢这场反对结核病的战争
en: Winning the War Against TB

zh: 西雅图 — — 人类自从石器时代起就开始与结核病进行战斗。
en: SEATTLE – Humans have been battling tuberculosis since the Stone Age.

zh: 但真正取得对这种疾病的进步还仅仅是上个世纪的事情。
en: But only in the last century has real progress been made against the disease.

zh: 一种于1921年首先用于人体的疫苗今天仍然在世界各地广泛使用。
en: A vaccine, first used in humans in 1921, is still in use around the world today.

zh: 而从20世纪40年代链霉素开始的系列抗生素已经被证明能对感染起到有效的治疗作用。
en: And a series of antibiotics, beginning with streptomycin in the 1940s, has proven effective in treating infections.

zh: 20世纪90年代开始，肺结核的年死亡人数已减少近半数。
en: Since 1990, TB’s annual death toll has been cut nearly in half.

zh: 从2000到2014年，更有效的诊断和治疗技术挽救了约4300万人的生命。
en: From 2000 to 2014, better diagnosis and treatment saved some 43 million lives.

zh: 尽管如此，进展依然非常缓慢，说明这场战争还远远没有结束。
en: Nonetheless, progress has slowed to a crawl, suggesting that the battle is far from over.

zh: 过去10年来肺结核发病数的年下降率仅有1.65 % ； 而2014年一年，肺结核就夺去了150万人的生命。
en: The annual decline in cases over the past decade has been a mere 1.65%; in 2014, TB killed 1.5 million people.

zh: 此外，某些结核病菌株正在对治疗产生耐药性。
en: Meanwhile, strains of the disease are developing resistance against treatment.

zh: 对于抗生素的滥用和管理不善已经导致耐多药结核病的产生。
en: The misuse and mismanagement of antibiotics has resulted in multidrug-resistant TB.

zh: 这些菌株必须动用二线药物治疗，而二线药物不仅昂贵而且往往带来更多副作用。
en: These strains must be treated with second-line medications, which are more expensive and often cause worse side effects.

zh: 而对二线药物同样产生耐药性的菌株（也就是所谓的广泛耐药性结核病（XDR-TB）也已经产生。
en: Strains that are resistant to second-line drugs, known as extensively drug-resistant TB (XDR-TB), have also appeared.

zh: 鉴于结核病造成的巨大的经济负担和大面积人类痛苦，急需开展全面工作应对结核病。
en: Given the enormous economic burden and widespread human suffering caused by TB, a comprehensive effort to tackle the disease is urgently needed.

zh: 哈佛医学院全球健康及社会医学教授Salmaan Keshavjee在英国医学杂志《柳叶刀》上发表系列文章，明确指出了战胜结核病的对策。
en: In a series of articles in the British medical journal The Lancet, Salmaan Keshavjee, a professor of global health and social medicine at Harvard Medical School, outlined a strategy for defeating it.

zh: Keshavjee和一群研究结核病的科学家、医生及来自政府和非政府组织、医院和大学的倡导者为自己制定的目标是将结核病死亡率降为零 — — 并明确提出了实现这一目标需要采取哪些举措。
en: Keshavjee and a group of TB scientists, clinicians, and advocates from governmental and nongovernmental organizations, hospitals, and universities set themselves the goal of bringing TB’s death toll to zero – and outlined the measures needed to achieve it.

zh: 首先是要强化数据收集工作。
en: The first step is to ramp up data-collection efforts.

zh: 像其他传染病一样，结核病疫情根据地理位置的不同而变化；因此，需要根据当地条件来开展根除结核病的工作。
en: TB epidemics, like those of other infectious diseases, vary by geography; as result, eradication efforts need to be customized to local conditions.

zh: 当地结核病项目需要更好地利用现有数据、扩大数据的日常收集、现代化数据存储系统并发展衡量地方干预效果所需的分析基础设施。
en: Local TB programs need to make better use of existing data, expand routine collection, modernize data-storage systems, and develop the analytical infrastructure needed to measure the effects of local interventions.

zh: 上述研究成果需要在数据来源国公布，而从中所吸取的教训则必须与邻近国家和地区共享。
en: These findings need to be made available within the country where data were collected, and the lessons learned must be shared with neighboring countries and regions.

zh: 此外，医疗工作者必须扩大预防新增感染病例的工作并迅速处理新发病例。
en: Moreover, health-care workers must expand efforts to prevent new infections and quickly treat fresh cases.

zh: 通过积极寻找受害者并迅速对其进行治疗，能使结核病患者不再具有传染性，并借此打破结核病的传播链条。
en: By actively seeking out victims and treating them quickly, so that they are no longer infectious, the chain of TB transmission can be broken.

zh: 实证评价和数学模型已经证实这种方法十分有效。
en: This strategy has been proven effective by empirical evaluation and mathematical modeling.

zh: 同时，必须努力控制结核病的温床，也就是作为几乎所有新增活动型结核病感染源头的潜伏期感染病例。
en: At the same time, efforts must be made to control the seedbeds of the disease, the latent infections that are the source of virtually all new cases of active TB.

zh: 使人感染结核病的结核病杆菌可以在很长时间内处于休眠状态，而在此期间内受害者并未表现出任何感染症状。
en: Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the bacteria that causes the disease, can lay dormant for long periods, during which the victim shows no symptoms of having been infected.

zh: 在此阶段治疗结核病可以阻止细菌的传播并减轻结核病的全球负担。
en: Targeting TB at this stage would stop the bacteria’s spread and reduce the disease’s global burden.

zh: 针对高危人群推出预防性治疗和研发更有效的诊断测试来确诊那些无症状感染将有助于彻底消灭细菌库。
en: Rolling out preventive therapies in at-risk populations and developing better diagnostic tests to identify those with asymptomatic infections would help drain reservoirs of the bacteria.

zh: 研发更有效的疫苗可能对疫情影响最大。
en: Developing a more effective vaccine would have the biggest impact on the epidemic.

zh: 卡介苗广泛应用于世界众多国家的新生儿，但其抗结核病的功效变化幅度很大。
en: The Bacillus Calmette–Guérin vaccine is given to infants in many parts of the world, but its efficacy against pulmonary TB is highly variable.

zh: 为了在全球范围内消灭结核病，研发更有效的疫苗至关重要。
en: To eliminate the disease globally, a better vaccine would be crucial.

zh: 最后，任何根除结核病的工作都必须承认结核病的根源是贫困和社会排斥。
en: Finally, any effort to eradicate TB must acknowledge that the disease is rooted in poverty and social exclusion.

zh: 自20世纪中叶以来，世界各地应对结核病的工作一直强调运用生物医学方法并注重治疗疫情的爆发。
en: Since the middle of the twentieth century, worldwide efforts to address TB have emphasized biomedical solutions and focused on treating outbreaks.

zh: 但在抗生素发明之前，生活水平的提高就已经有助于缓解结核病的影响。
en: But, before the development of antibiotics, improvements in living standards had helped reduce the impact of TB.

zh: 只有将生物医学方法与注重良好营养、舒适居所和人类福祉相结合才能实现战胜结核病的目标。
en: Integrating a biomedical approach with an emphasis on the importance of good nutrition, decent housing, and human welfare will be necessary if the disease is to be brought to heel.

zh: 国际社会必须共同努力将现有的知识和对策转化为对受结核病困扰最严重群体有效的项目干预举措。
en: The global community must work together and translate existing knowledge and strategies into effective programmatic interventions in communities most afflicted by TB.

zh: 通过研发新工具 — — 包括快速诊断、更安全迅速的治疗结核感染和结核病，以及有效的结核病疫苗 — — 强化卫生系统并改善高危人群的生活条件，我们才能最终战胜这个人类最古老的杀手。
en: By developing new tools – including rapid diagnostics, safe and shorter treatment of TB infection and disease, and an efficacious TB vaccine – strengthening health systems, and improving the living conditions of at-risk populations, we can neutralize one of humankind’s oldest killers.

zh: 只有到那时，我们才能最终将结核病写进历史书。
en: Only then will we be able to consign TB, at long last, to the history books.

zh: 埃尔多安是和平缔造者吗？
en: Erdoğan the Peacemaker?

zh: 伊斯坦布尔 — — 土耳其总理雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安已经开始了一项艰巨的挑战。
en: ISTANBUL – Turkey’s Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has taken on a daunting challenge.

zh: 在三月底参加了韩国核安全首脑会议后，他便前往德黑兰，敦促伊朗领导人在与联合国安理会五大常任理事国（英国、中国、法国、俄罗斯和美国）及德国进行的下一轮核谈判中达成协议。
en: After participating in the nuclear-security summit in South Korea at the end of March, he went to Tehran to urge Iran’s leaders to make a deal during the next round of nuclear talks between Iran and the United Nations Security Council’s five permanent members (Britain, China, France, Russia, and the United States) plus Germany.

zh: 四月中旬，埃尔多安将在伊斯坦布尔主持这些会谈。
en: And Erdoğan will host those talks in Istanbul in mid-April.

zh: 埃尔多安上次前往德黑兰是在2010年5月，目的是与伊朗最终达成某项协议，该协议规定伊朗向土耳其提供大量低浓缩铀，而土耳其为伊朗研究核反应堆提供核燃料。
en: Erdoğan last traveled to Tehran in May 2010 to finalize an agreement that he had negotiated under which Iran was to send large quantities of its low-enriched uranium to Turkey in exchange for nuclear fuel for Iran’s research reactor.

zh: 该协议是在土耳其和巴西的调解下达成的，作为一项突破性的信心建设倡议呈现在世界面前。
en: The deal, mediated by Turkey and Brazil, was presented to the rest of the world as a groundbreaking confidence-building initiative.

zh: 但美国及其盟国很快就拒绝了这项协议，因为它们认为伊朗是在采取伎俩减弱国际社会对其实施额外制裁的增长势头。
en: But the US and its allies quickly rejected the agreement as an Iranian ploy designed to halt the growing momentum for additional sanctions.

zh: 土耳其坚持推行该项协议，结果造成本国与美国关系紧张，引发国内外人士的指责 — — 埃尔多安政府正在脱离与西方国家结成的长期联盟。
en: Turkey’s insistence on pressing ahead with the deal caused tension with the US and fueled criticism at home and abroad that Erdoğan’s government was shifting away from its long-standing alliance with the West.

zh: 这场与美国相持的短暂危机在土耳其政界仍然闻所未闻。
en: The memory of this short-lived crisis with the US is still fresh in Turkish government circles.

zh: 两年前埃尔多安就曾提出该问题，结果是自讨苦吃，那么为什么现在又将该问题重提呢？
en: So why, despite having burned his fingers two years ago, is Erdoğan taking up the issue again?

zh: 他希望在德黑兰达到什么目的呢？
en: What did he hope to accomplish in Tehran?

zh: 在过去两年中中东发生了很大变化，但这一状况对土耳其非常不利。
en: Much has changed in the Middle East during the past two years, and not to Turkey’s advantage.

zh: 因此，土耳其正努力遏制地区安全形势迅速恶化的形势。
en: As a result, Turkey is now seeking to contain a rapidly deteriorating regional security situation.

zh: 叙利亚事件迫使土耳其当局接受这一严酷的现实 — — 阿萨德政权具有很大柔韧性，而且对土耳其充满敌意。
en: Events in Syria are forcing Turkish authorities to accept the harsh reality of the Assad regime’s resilience – and now its hostility towards Turkey.

zh: 土耳其的另一邻国伊拉克在美军撤离之后，面临着一场旷日持久的教派权力斗争。
en: Iraq, another of Turkey’s neighbors, faces the risk of a protracted sectarian power struggle following withdrawal of US troops.

zh: 鉴于此，现在土耳其的主要目的是为了防止对伊朗进行军事干预。
en: Given this, Turkey’s main objective now is to prevent a military intervention against Iran.

zh: 从土耳其的角度来看，以色列或美国打击伊朗核设施，将进一步破坏该地区稳定，伊朗无疑将通过加剧教派斗争的紧张局势、破坏叙利亚和伊拉克的和解前景进行报复。
en: From Turkey’s perspective, an Israeli or American strike against Iran’s nuclear facilities would destabilize the region further, as Iran would undoubtedly retaliate by fueling sectarian tensions and undermining the prospects of a settlement in both Syria and Iraq.

zh: 鉴于此，土耳其希望不惜一切代价延长外交时间。
en: As a result, Turkey wants to prolong, at all costs, the time available for diplomacy.

zh: 但埃尔多安这次的具体目标与2010年相比较为温和，因为土耳其不希望发挥调解的作用，也不会就该协议的具体细节进行谈判。
en: But Erdoğan’s specific objective was more modest this time than it was in 2010, because Turkey does not want to play the role of mediator and will not seek to negotiate the details of an agreement.

zh: 相反，埃尔多安向伊朗领导人强调国际社会使伊朗的核计划透明的决心及下一轮核问题会谈具体进展的重要性。
en: Instead, Erdoğan emphasized to his Iranian counterparts the international community’s resolve to bring transparency to Iran’s nuclear program, and insisted on the importance of concrete progress in the next round of the nuclear talks.

zh: 他警告说，如果伊朗不妥协，那么会谈将难逃失败的厄运，中东地区将很可能面临新一轮军事对抗。
en: He warned that Iranian intransigence would doom the talks to failure, raising the prospects of yet another military confrontation in the Middle East.

zh: 埃尔多安特别强调，伊朗必须对其核计划表现出善意姿态。
en: In particular, Erdoğan stressed the need for Iran to offer a gesture of goodwill about its nuclear program.

zh: 伊朗政权至少应承诺浓缩铀生产减少20％左右 — — 小于武器生产所需的阈值。
en: The Iranian regime should, at the very least, commit itself to halt uranium enrichment at 20%, a figure short of the threshold needed to produce weapons.

zh: 同时，埃尔多安同伊朗总统内贾德和最高领袖哈梅内伊曾经直接会晤，作为一个北约国家的总理，他的地位非常独特 — — 他需要将这些重要消息传递给一个顶层决策过程同以往西方一样不透明的政权。
en: Having had direct meetings with both Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad and Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Erdoğan was in a unique position, as a prime minister of a NATO country, to convey these critical messages to a regime whose top-level decision-making processes remain as opaque as ever to the West.

zh: 然而，奇怪的是，埃尔多安的任务虽然比2010年更温和了，但同时也更困难了，因为伊朗可能会面临新的制裁措施，包括七月份生效的石油出口禁令。
en: Paradoxically, however, Erdoğan’s task, while more modest than in 2010, is also more difficult, owing to the prospect of new sanctions on Iran, including a ban on oil exports, that are to enter into force in July.

zh: 支持对伊朗实施制裁的人认为，这些措施会对伊朗的经济可能陷入瘫痪。
en: Advocates of sanctions argue that they are having a crippling effect on the Iranian economy.

zh: 自年初以来，伊朗里亚尔（伊朗货币单位）对美元的汇价下跌了50 ％ ， 外汇短缺严重。
en: The value of the Iranian rial has fallen by 50% against the US dollar since the beginning of the year, and the country is suffering from a severe shortage of foreign exchange. So now is not the time to pull back.

zh: 此外，美国总统奥巴马面临着11月的选举，不希望被指责对伊朗采取姑息态度，因此西方国家很难对伊朗伸出援手。
en: Moreover, US President Barack Obama, facing an election in November, does not wish to be accused of being soft on Iran, making it difficult for the West to reciprocate potential Iranian overtures.

zh: 然而，埃尔多安在冒险开局中最好的盟友可能是美国消费者。
en: Yet Erdoğan’s best ally in his risky gambit may be the US consumer.

zh: 由于伊朗危机持续，面对汽油价格上涨，美国人对驾驶成本特别关注，这也导致了奥巴马的民意支持摇摇欲坠。
en: Faced with rising gasoline prices as a result of the ongoing crisis with Iran, Americans’ concerns about the cost of driving have contributed to Obama’s shaky popularity ratings.

zh: 因此，奥巴马政府可能会认为，设法与伊朗达成协议是政治上的权宜之计。
en: Thus, the Obama administration may find it more politically expedient to seek a deal with Iran.

zh: 如果伊朗真正愿意妥协，西方应该推迟实施新​​的制裁。
en: If Iran displays a real willingness to compromise, the West should hold off on the new sanctions.

zh: 埃尔多安的访问是否成功，很快就会��得清晰。
en: It will soon become clear whether Erdoğan’s visit succeeds.

zh: 如果伊朗决定在下一轮多边谈判中参与国际社会，制定具体的信心建立措施，埃尔多安将会因为给外交创造机会 — — 很可能会因为避免一场中东的灾难性军事对抗而获得好评。
en: If Iran decides to engage the international community with concrete confidence-building measures at the next round of multilateral talks, Erdoğan will take much of the credit for giving diplomacy a last chance – and quite possibly for averting a disastrous military confrontation in the Middle East.

zh: 土耳其的关键选举
en: Turkey’s Critical Election

zh: 伊斯坦布尔 — — 极少有民主国家像6月7日大选时的土耳其那样因为很小的选票变化而改变最终选局。
en: ISTANBUL – In very few democracies could such a small shift in votes lead to outcomes as different as the ones that could result from Turkey’s general election on June 7.

zh: 不到1%的国内选票变化就有可能决定执政的正义与发展党（AKP）是否要在土耳其13年的一党执政后被迫组建联合政府 — — 从而使雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安总统无法达成强化总统权力的愿望。
en: A swing of less than 1% of the national vote could decide whether the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) is forced to form a coalition government – Turkey’s first after 13 years of single-party rule – leaving it unable to fulfill President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s longstanding desire to strengthen the presidency.

zh: 自2002年正义与发展党上台后土耳其大选一直非常沉闷。
en: Turkish elections have been boring affairs since the AKP came to power in 2002.

zh: 该党取得压倒性胜利和组建多数政府的选举结果几乎是预先注定的。
en: The party’s results have been all but preordained: landslide victories and majority governments.

zh: 但今年的情况却有所不同：选举结果根本无法确定，而其中所牵扯的利益则高得不能再高。
en: This year, however, the outlook is different: the results are far from certain, and the stakes could hardly be higher.

zh: 选举结果不仅将决定埃尔多安的政治命运，还将决定能否与库尔德人达成长期和解以及土耳其民主制度的长期前途。
en: Riding on the outcome is not only Erdoğan’s political future, but also the potential for a long-term settlement with the country’s Kurds and the long-term soundness of Turkish democracy itself.

zh: 此次的不确定性是由以库尔德人为主的人民民主党（HDP）造成的。
en: The uncertainty this time around is attributable to the predominantly Kurdish Peoples’ Democratic Party (HDP).

zh: 库尔德政党过去一直回避参选，因为他们害怕凑不够进入议会所需的10%的公众选票。
en: Kurdish political parties shied away from contesting past elections, owing to their fear of failing to clear the 10% popular-vote threshold needed to enter the parliament.

zh: 相反，库尔德政治家会以不受10%门槛限制的独立候选人身份参选。
en: Instead, Kurdish politicians would run as independent candidates, who are not subject to the threshold.

zh: 一旦成功当选，他们再重新集结在库尔德政党的旗帜下。
en: Once safely in office, they would reunite under the banner of a party.

zh: 但今年，库尔德政治运动已经决定将库尔德候选人以一党参选的身份推出。
en: This year, however, the Kurdish political movement has decided to field its candidates as members of a single party.

zh: 这样的选举策略虽有风险，但却可能带来巨大的回报，其结果不仅将对该党的当前命运产生巨大影响，也将影响到土耳其的长期前途。
en: This electoral strategy, though risky, could yield large rewards, with the outcome holding significant implications for the party’s immediate fortune – as well as for Turkey’s long-term prospects.

zh: 人民民主党达不到10%的议会门槛将启动全面的国内政治体制改革。
en: The HDP’s failure to clear the 10% threshold would open the way for an overhaul of the country’s political system.

zh: 如果库尔德人及其候选人被排除在议会之外，正义与发展党只需表现略好于民调就能继续主导国内的政治生活。
en: With the Kurds and their candidates excluded from the parliament, the AKP would have to do only slightly better than polls are predicting to maintain its political dominance.

zh: 如果该党能获得45%以上的国内选票，那么依据土耳其选举法的奇怪规定，就能在550个议会席位中拥有代表超过330个。
en: If the party is able to secure more than 45% of the national vote, the quirks in Turkey’s electoral law will give it more than 330 representatives in the country’s 550-seat legislature.

zh: 这样的结果将使埃尔多安有权施行他一直期待的总统执政制度。
en: Such a result would give Erdoğan the power to put in place the presidential system of governance that he has long sought.

zh: 正义与发展党的议会多数将允许其单方面起草新宪法，并在一年内将其付诸公投。
en: The AKP’s parliamentary majority would allow the party to draft a new constitution unilaterally and put it to a referendum within a year.

zh: 与此同时，土耳其东南部地区可能会爆发内乱，因为在制度转轨期完全失去政治话语权的库尔德运动会鼓吹地方自治权的扩大。
en: At the same time, the country’s southeastern regions could become vulnerable to civil unrest, as the Kurdish movement – faced with a total lack of national political representation during a time of institutional transition – agitates for greater local autonomy.

zh: 另一方面，如果人民民主党能够达到10%的门槛，那么它的命运 — — 连同埃尔多安的命运 — — 都将走向另一个方向。
en: If, on the other hand the HDP can reach the 10% threshold, its fortunes – and Erdoğan’s – will swing in the other direction.

zh: 该党候选人将会掌控可观的议会少数代表权，而正义与发展党则有可能成为联合政府的高级合伙方。
en: The party’s candidates would command a sizable minority delegation in parliament, and the AKP would likely become the senior partner of a coalition government.

zh: 总理达武特奥卢不仅不能取得主导地位，还将被迫在联合人民民主党抑或保守的民族主义运动党（MHP）之间做出选择。
en: Far from securing a dominant position, Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu would be forced to choose between aligning his party with the HDP or the conservative Nationalist Movement Party (MHP).

zh: 虽然理论上与中左翼共和人民党（CHP）结成大联盟的可能性存在，但这样的假设却与土耳其的政治文化不符。
en: A grand coalition with the main opposition party, the center-left Republican People’s Party (CHP), though theoretically possible, is not congruous with Turkey’s political culture.

zh: 这样的结果将授权以达武特奥卢为首的执政官员削弱总统地位。
en: Such a result would empower the executive, headed by Davutoğlu, to the detriment of the presidency.

zh: 因为已经不可能成为执行主席，埃尔多安的权力将很快开始削弱。
en: With the possibility that Erdoğan could become an executive president no longer realistic, his power would quickly begin to wane.

zh: 即使假设正义与发展党依然是全国最大的政党，但土耳其政治的权力平衡也将开始不利于他。
en: Even assuming that the AKP remained the country’s largest party, the balance of power in Turkish politics would start to turn against him.

zh: 在自由民主国家，全国选举旨在授权获胜方在下一次选举前执政及确定优先政策。
en: In liberal democracies, national elections are intended to provide the winning side with a popular mandate to govern and to set policy priorities until the next election.

zh: 选举的意义很少延伸到单一选举周期以上。
en: Only rarely do they hold implications that will last longer than a single electoral cycle.

zh: 但当今土耳其的现实却是即将举行的投票结果可能决定土耳其之后多年的政治生活规则。
en: But that is the case today in Turkey, where the outcome of the upcoming popular vote is likely to determine the rules of political life for years to come.

zh: 人民民主党现在的民调得票率在10%左右。
en: The HDP is currently polling at around 10%.

zh: 向任何方向的微调带来的改变都可能意义重大。
en: A little nudge in either direction could make all the difference in the world.

zh: 土耳其世俗主义的离奇死亡
en: The Strange Death of Turkish Secularism

zh: 耶路撒冷 — — 土耳其失败的军事政变提出了一个根本性的问题：雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安总统是会为了复仇的目的继续奉行独裁主义道路，还是会向反对派伸出手去，试图弥合土耳其社会存在的深层次的鸿沟。
en: JERUSALEM – The aftermath of Turkey’s failed military coup raises a fundamental question: will President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan continue to pursue his authoritarian path, perhaps with a vengeance, or will he reach out to his opponents and attempt to bridge the deep fissures in Turkish society?

zh: 审判结果尚无定论，但是从历史先例看，对独裁或半独裁领导人发起严峻挑战往往会导致政权更加强硬，而不是让执政者更加温和。
en: The jury is still out, but judging from previous historical examples, serious challenges to authoritarian or semi-authoritarian leaders usually lead to a hardening of the regime, not greater moderation.

zh: 而政变崩溃后埃尔多安的动作 — — 几乎立即发布对数千名士兵、法官、警察和教师的大规模逮捕令 — — 似乎证实了相对悲观的预想。
en: And Erdoğan’s moves since the coup’s collapse – mass arrests and purges of thousands of soldiers, judges, police, and teachers were announced almost immediately – seem to confirm the more pessimistic scenario.

zh: 但完全通过埃尔多安个性及独裁倾向的棱镜来观察土耳其现在的局势将是一种错误。
en: Yet it would be a mistake to view what is now happening in Turkey exclusively through the prism of Erdoğan’s personality and his authoritarian inclinations.

zh: 埃尔多安和他的正义与发展党（AKP）代表着土耳其政治的结构性转变，同样的转变在中东其他穆斯林多数国家中也可以观察到。
en: He and his Justice and Development Party (AKP) represent a tectonic shift in Turkish politics, one with parallels in other Muslim-majority countries in the Middle East.

zh: 在试图让土耳其脱离该国现代创始人凯末尔·阿塔图尔克激进世俗主义道路的历史斗争中，正义与发展党最初似乎改变了凯末尔主义者的专制政策。
en: In trying to move the path of Turkish history away from the radical secularism of modern Turkey’s founder, Kemal Atatürk, the AKP initially appeared to veer from the Kemalist authoritarian mold.

zh: 因为西方观察家支持凯末尔主义的世俗属性，很多人都忽略了凯末尔政权更像20世纪30年代的欧洲法西斯主义 — — 即以对阿塔图尔克的个人崇拜为最高原则的民族主义一党制国家 — — 而不是自由民主。
en: Because Western observers were supportive of the secular nature of Kemalism, many overlooked that the regime was more similar to 1930s European fascism – a nationalistic one-party state with Atatürk himself at the apex of a personality cult – than to liberal democracy.

zh: 一直到20世纪60年代土耳其内部体制才有所放松。
en: Only in the 1950s was the system slowly loosened.

zh: 凯末尔式的世俗主义并不是底层民众广泛、普遍的民意表达；它是由一小撮城市精英 — — 包括军队和知识分子 — — 对传统和乡村社会的强加。
en: Kemalist secularism was not the expression of a wide, popular movement from below; it was imposed by a small urban elite – military and intellectual – on a traditional and mostly rural society.

zh: 凯末尔主义不但引入了一种变形的拉丁字母，并借此切断了土耳其人与自身历史文化的任何联系；而且还禁止传统的着装形式（毯帽、男士灯笼裤和女士头巾）并强制全体民众采用欧洲的着装标准。
en: Kemalism not only introduced a variant of the Latin alphabet, which totally cut off Turks from any link to their history and culture; it also banned traditional forms of attire (fez, baggy trousers for men, headscarves for women) and forced a European dress code on the entire population.

zh: 所有阿拉伯或穆斯林姓氏都必须改成突厥姓氏。
en: All Arabic- or Muslim-sounding surnames had to be changed to Turkic ones.

zh: 如此痛苦的自上而下的文化革命所有欧洲社会都未曾经历过。
en: No European society has experienced so wrenching a process of top-down cultural revolution.

zh: 在西方，世俗化进程与民主化和自由化的启蒙运动齐头并进。
en: In the West, secularization went hand in hand with the Enlightenment project of democratization and liberalization.

zh: 但在土耳其 — — 在伊朗国王和埃及、突尼斯、叙利亚和伊拉克等国军事独裁者相对不那么激进的统治下 — — 民众从未有权选择。
en: In Turkey – and in a less radical form under the Shah in Iran and under military dictators in countries like Egypt, Tunisia, Syria, and Iraq – the population never had a choice.

zh: 正义与发展党2002年后的选举胜利（以及其他穆斯林国家的类似进展）在某种程度上代表被压迫者的反抗。
en: The AKP’s electoral victories since 2002 (as well as comparable developments in other Muslim countries) were, in a way, the return of the repressed.

zh: 因为凯末尔体制最终实现了政治自由化（虽然并不是文化自由化 ） ， 但多党制的兴起最终也完成了对传统保守主义者的授权，这些人的喜好曾长期不被社会接受。
en: Because the Kemalist system eventually liberalized politically (though not culturally), the emergence of a multiparty system eventually also empowered the traditional conservatives whose preferences had long been denied.

zh: 与此同时，经济现代化为保守主义者带来社会流动性，从而导致固守传统宗教价值观并将隐藏在军队、官僚体系、司法体系和大学之中的凯末尔主义精英视为压迫势力的新兴中产阶级力量逐步壮大。
en: At the same time, economic modernization brought social mobility to the conservatives, which led to the emergence of a new bourgeoisie that clung to its traditional religious values and viewed the Kemalist elite – ensconced in the army, the bureaucracy, the judiciary, and the universities – as oppressors.

zh: 这些选民构成了正义与发展党选举胜利和民主合法性的根基。
en: These voters formed the basis of the AKP’s electoral victories and democratic legitimacy.

zh: 刚刚发生的军队分子（凯末尔世俗主义的盾牌）推翻人民意愿的政变（过去半个世纪以来曾3次发生这样的政变）再次凸显了土耳其世俗主义和民主之间的持续冲突。
en: The recent effort by elements of the army – the shield of Kemalist secularism – to overturn the will of the people (as it has done three times in the last half-century) confirms the continuing clash between secularism and democracy in Turkey.

zh: 同时，埃尔多安近年实施的外交政策根本不成功。
en: At the same time, Erdoğan’s foreign policy in recent years has been anything but successful.

zh: 他起初实施的“与邻国零冲突”政策反而导致了与亚美尼亚、俄罗斯、以色列和埃及关系日趋恶化 — — 更不要说对国内可观的反作用力，包括因卷入叙利亚内战而造成的一波恐怖袭击浪潮。
en: His initial commitment to “zero conflicts with neighbors” has led, instead, to deteriorating relations with Armenia, Russia, Israel, and Egypt – not to mention significant domestic blowback, including a wave of terrorist attacks, from involvement in Syria’s civil war.

zh: 所有这些都没有对埃尔多安的国内支持率造成影响，美国和欧盟虽然咬紧牙关，但仍然在最近爆发的政变企图中对埃尔多安表达了支持的态度。
en: None of this has eroded Erdoğan’s support at home, while the United States and the European Union found themselves supporting him, albeit through clenched teeth, against the latest coup attempt.

zh: 这证明稳定土耳其符合西方列强的根本利益，欧盟需要土耳其来阻止主要来自叙利亚的进一步的移民浪潮，而美国也需要土耳其的帮助才能打赢针对伊斯兰国的有限战争。
en: This attests to Western powers’ fundamental interest in a stable Turkey, which the EU needs in order to stop further waves of immigrants, mainly from Syria, and which the US needs for its war, limited as it is, against the Islamic State.

zh: 埃尔多安追捕国内反对派（无论确实存在还是异想天开）都不太可能阻止美国或欧盟寻求土耳其的合作。
en: It is doubtful that Erdoğan’s pursuit of internal enemies – real and imagined – will prevent either the US or the EU from courting Turkish cooperation.

zh: 但埃尔多安对政变企图的残酷回应 — — 其中可能包括公开审判以及对世俗主义制度及其前葛兰运动盟友残余公共机构的“清洗”行为 — — 只会导致土耳其社会的分歧进一步深化。
en: But Erdoğan’s brutal response to the coup attempt – which may include show trials, in addition to the “cleansing” of public institutions of both remnants of the secularist establishment and his former allies in the Gülen movement – will only deepen the chasms within Turkish society.

zh: 事实上，发动恐怖袭击的不仅包括伊斯兰国，还包括库尔德武装，后者要求自治挑战了土耳其民族不可分割的理念，而这也是凯末尔政府的一项基本原则。
en: Indeed, terrorist attacks have been launched not only by the Islamic State, but also by Kurdish militants, whose demands for autonomy challenge the concept of an indivisible Turkish nation – a cornerstone of the Kemalist state.

zh: 在爆发此次叛乱前，埃尔多安采取重要措施缓解与俄罗斯和以色列的紧张局势，而相关工作似乎不太可能受到埃尔多安后政变期镇压活动的影响。
en: Prior to the attempted putsch, Erdoğan made significant moves to reduce tension with Russia and Israel, and both efforts seem unlikely to be derailed by his post-coup crackdown.

zh: 但叙利亚内战似乎没有平静下来的趋势，而叙利亚作为统一国家事实上的内爆将继续挑战土耳其政治及社会凝聚力，造成试图涌入土耳其的难民越来越多。
en: Yet Syria’s civil war does not appear to be winding down, and the de facto implosion of Syria as a coherent state will continue to challenge Turkish politics and social cohesion, with more and more refugees trying to cross into Turkey.

zh: 最终，凯末尔式的军事世俗主义被证明是不可持续的：他在正义与发展党治下被消灭享有广泛的群众基础。
en: Ultimately, Kemalist military-based secularism proved to be unsustainable: its demolition under the AKP enjoys broad support.

zh: 但这次未遂政变很可能会强化埃尔多安治下民主的非自由层面，导致民众意愿和多数统治压制多元主义、人权和言论自由。
en: But the failed coup is likely to reinforce the illiberal aspects of the democracy emerging under Erdoğan, in which the will of the people and majoritarian rule runs counter to pluralism, human rights, and freedom of speech.

zh: 尽管绝大多数人反对政变，但民众对埃尔多安的敌意也依然很强，因此上述体系在土耳其的稳定性尚有待观察。
en: The stability of such a system in Turkey – where, despite popular opposition to the coup, hostility to Erdoğan is strong – remains to be seen.

zh: 埃尔多安的第二次机会
en: Erdoğan’s Second Chance

zh: 伊斯坦布尔—在最近的土耳其大选中，选民在五个月的时间里两次前往投票站，其结果揭示了土耳其民主以及土耳其人民偏好的一些重要特点。
en: ISTANBUL – The outcome of Turkey’s latest general election – voters have gone to the polls twice in the last five months – reveals important insights into the nature of the country’s democracy and the preferences of its citizens.

zh: 今年，土耳其进行了两次议会选举，第一次是在6月，被广泛认为是总统埃尔多安加强其班子权力的全民公决。
en: The first of Turkey’s two parliamentary elections this year, in June, was widely viewed as a referendum on President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s efforts to strengthen the powers of his office.

zh: 结果是明确的。
en: The result was clear.

zh: 埃尔多安的正义和发展党（AKP）只获得了41%的选票，失去了自2002年掌权以来的多数支持率。
en: Erdoğan’s Justice and Development Party (AKP) received just 41% of the vote, costing it the majority it had enjoyed since coming to power in 2002.

zh: 但是，6月选举后的谈判导致了无多数议会，11月1日，土耳其再次举行投票，结果截然不同。
en: On November 1, however, after negotiations following the June elections resulted in a hung parliament, Turks voted again, and the outcome could not have been more different.

zh: 这一回，选举主要被视为关于继续一党执政的全民公决，AKP赢得49%的选票，获得了令人心安的多数。
en: This time, the election was predominantly perceived as a referendum on the continuation of single-party rule, and the AKP won 49% of the vote, providing it with a comfortable majority.

zh: 在最近的选举之前的一段时间，埃尔多安和AKP强调该党占议会多数对于土耳其政治稳定的重要性。
en: In the run-up to the latest election, Erdoğan and the AKP emphasized the importance of the party’s parliamentary majority for Turkey’s political stability.

zh: 反对派反驳说，联合政府能够遏制土耳其政治深度两极分化的问题，同时也有助于建立更强的制衡。
en: The opposition countered with the argument that a coalition government would counter the country’s deep political polarization, while helping to establish stronger checks and balances.

zh: 看起来，稳定承诺更能引起共鸣。
en: The promise of stability proved to be the more resonant message.

zh: 6月的无果选举所带来的政治动荡因为国内和地区安全局势的急剧恶化而恶化。
en: The political instability following June’s inconclusive election had been compounded by a sharp decline in domestic and regional security.

zh: 分裂派库尔德工人党（PKK）的暴力行动卷土重来，伊斯兰国的袭击也层出不穷 — — 包括100余人被杀的安卡拉自杀式炸弹袭击 — — 这让AKP的口号更有号召力。
en: A renewed campaign of violence by the separatist Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK) and attacks by the Islamic State, including suicide bombings in Ankara that killed more than 100 people, created a backdrop that reinforced the AKP’s message.

zh: 选举结果印证了土耳其议会反对派的低能，他们再一次没能影响AKP的支持率，好像他们是为了证明选民肯定讨厌长期执政的政府这一理论不正确似的。
en: The outcome of the vote attests to the ineffectiveness of Turkey’s parliamentary opposition, which once again failed to make a dent in the AKP’s popularity, almost as if they had set out to disprove the theory that electorates simply tire of long-serving governments.

zh: 相反，AKP获得了压倒性胜利 — — 在不间断地执政13年后，这是一个了不起的成就 — — 靠的是从竞争对手手中争夺选民。
en: Instead the AKP obtained its landslide victory – a major achievement after 13 years of uninterrupted rule – by siphoning voters from its competitors.

zh: AKP比6月多获得了近五百万张选票，相当于支持率升高20 % 。
en: The party received nearly five million more votes than it did in June, corresponding to a 20% increase in its popularity.

zh: 两大反对党 — — 保守派的民族主运动党（MHP）和主要反对党库尔德人民民主党（HDP ） — —加起来共损失三百万选民，中左翼的共和人民党（CHP）守住了阵地，以25%的支持率名列第二。
en: Two opposition parties, the conservative Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) and the predominantly Kurdish Peoples’ Democratic Party (HDP), together lost three million votes, while the center-left Republican People’s Party (CHP) held its ground, finishing second with 25% of the vote.

zh: 6月选举后，MHP拒绝一切加入联合政府的条件，这一从中作梗的行为受到了选民的严惩。
en: Voters punished the nationalist MHP severely for its obstructionism following the June election, when it refused all offers to join a coalition government.

zh: HMP只获得12%的支持率，而6月为16 % ， 因此丧失了近一半的议会席位。
en: With 12% of the popular vote, compared to 16% in June, the MHP lost almost half of its parliamentary seats.

zh: HDP的败因在于无法与PKK保持距离，很大一部分选民认为，PKK要为国内暴力升级负责。
en: The HDP was handicapped by its inability to distance itself from the PKK, which a large section of the electorate regards as being responsible for the upsurge in domestic violence.

zh: 事实上，HDP可能无法获得进入议会所需要的10%的支持率，这一结果将让AKP赢得足够大的多数，靠自己修订宪法。
en: Indeed, the HDP seemed at risk of failing to obtain the 10% of the vote it would need to enter parliament, an outcome that would have provided the AKP with a majority large enough to amend the constitution on its own.

zh: 最终，HDP获得10.75%的选票，而6月选举时为13 % ， 阻止了埃尔多安获得建立执行总统制所需要的听话的议会。
en: In the end, HDP ended with 10.75% of the vote, down from 13% in the June elections, preventing Erdoğan from securing the compliant parliament he would need to establish an executive presidency.

zh: 尽管如此，土耳其新政府拥有了足够广泛的权力解决土耳其最困难、最紧迫的政策挑战 — — 其中最引人注目的便是与库尔德人的和平进程。
en: Nonetheless, Turkey’s new government has been provided with a broad enough mandate to address some of the country’s most difficult and imminent policy challenges – most notably the peace process with the Kurds.

zh: 此前的和平进程在选举前被中止，因为PKK回归暴力，而AKP领导层的口风日益民族主义和强硬。
en: A previous effort had been suspended ahead of the election, as the PKK returned to violence and the AKP’s leadership adopted increasingly nationalist and hawkish rhetoric.

zh: 但是，选举结束后，新政府有望重启谈判。
en: With the election over, however, there is hope that the new government will restart the negotiations.

zh: 如果成功，谈判不但将产生巨大的国内影响，也将有利于继续打击伊斯兰国。
en: If successful, the talks would have a major impact not only domestically, but also on the ongoing fight against the Islamic State.

zh: AKP的多数地位还让它能够继续改变土耳其外交政策。
en: The AKP’s majority will also enable it to continue to recalibrate the country’s foreign policy.

zh: 阿拉伯之春后，土耳其的政策导致它失去了影响力和盟友；但最近土耳其开始调整方针适应现实。
en: Turkey’s policies following the Arab Spring had led to a loss of influence and friends in the region; but recently the country has begun to adapt its approach to the realities on the ground.

zh: 比如，土耳其不再反对叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德参加结束叙利亚内战的谈判。
en: For example, Turkey has lifted its objections to a role for Syrian President Bashar al-Assad in negotiations to end the civil war in Syria.

zh: 类似地，打击伊斯兰国的新承诺打消了土耳其西方盟友的一个核心摩擦点。
en: Similarly, a new commitment to the struggle against the Islamic State has eliminated a core point of friction with Turkey’s Western partners.

zh: 新政府必须避免的主要陷阱是回归家长式治国。
en: The main trap the new government must avoid is a return to a heavily paternalistic style of governance.

zh: AKP应该对其所获得的大多数感到欣慰，并开始更温和地对待少数派观点甚至和平异见者，以利于土耳其和欧盟的入盟谈判。
en: The AKP should take comfort in its large majority and start to view minority views and even peaceful dissent more benignly, in a way that befits a country negotiating accession to the European Union.

zh: 两次选举的教训是显而易见的：土耳其选民希望看到一个强大、稳定的政府，但也不能冷酷无情的践踏反对派。
en: The lesson of the two elections is clear: Turkey’s voters want a strong, stable government, but not one that runs roughshod over its opponents.

zh: 雄主埃尔多安
en: Erdoğan the Magnificent

zh: 伊斯坦布尔—现在，土耳其总统埃尔多安已经实现了他的终极政治目标 — — 成为土耳其历史上第一位民选的实职总统，他在星期天的选举中赢得了近53%的全国选票。
en: ISTANBUL – Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has now fulfilled his ultimate political objective of being the country’s first ever popularly elected executive president, receiving almost 53% of the national vote in Sunday’s election.

zh: 一年前，埃尔多安推动修宪将土耳其的议会制民主改为高度集中的总统制。
en: A year ago, Erdoğan pushed through constitutional amendments to transform Turkey’s parliamentary democracy into a highly centralized presidential system.

zh: 现在，修正案将完全生效。
en: Now those amendments will come fully into force.

zh: 修宪给了埃尔多安任命副总统、部长和高级官员的新权力。
en: The constitutional changes give Erdoğan new powers to appoint vice presidents, ministers, and senior officials.

zh: 修改后的宪法还允许埃尔多安解散议会、成为政党党员、对任命最高法院法官拥有话语权、发布有法律效力的敕令，以及宣布紧急状态。
en: They also allow him to dissolve parliament, be a member of a political party, have a greater say in appointing judges to the highest courts, issue decrees with the force of law, and impose a state of emergency.

zh: 去年4月以微弱多数批准的宪法修正案还废除了总理班子。
en: Narrowly approved by voters last April, the constitutional amendments also abolished the office of the prime minister.

zh: 未来五年，埃尔多安将是土耳其国家元首、执政党正义与发展党（AKP）党首和政府首脑。
en: For the next five years, Erdoğan will be Turkey’s head of state, head of its ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP), and head of government.

zh: 埃尔多安的位置非常稳固，因为提前总统选举需要三分之二议会多数批准 — — AKP占领了议会接近多数，因此不太可能发生这一情况。
en: Erdoğan is secure in his position because an early presidential election requires a two-thirds parliamentary vote – an unlikely scenario given the AKP’s near-majority.

zh: 因此，他已经成为二战刚结束土耳其开启竞争选举以来权力最大的领导人。
en: He has thus become Turkey’s most powerful leader since the country began to hold contested elections in the years immediately following World War II.

zh: 现在，土耳其内政和外交政策最终集中到了一个人手上。
en: Turkey’s domestic and foreign policies will now be shaped, ultimately, by one man.

zh: 这显然与自由民主南辕北辙。 自由民主是为了限制行政权威而设计的强大的制度性制衡的核心。
en: This is of course the opposite of liberal democracy, a core feature of which is a robust set of institutional checks and balances designed to limit executive authority.

zh: 土耳其新宪法将无与伦比的广泛权力授予代表行政权的总统，这反映了民粹主义政府观，根据这一观点，当选领导人作为国家代表，在追求国家利益的过程中不应该受到掣肘。
en: The assignment of exceptionally broad powers to the executive president under the new constitution reflects a populist vision of government according to which the elected leader, as the true representative of the nation, should not be hindered in pursuing the nation’s interests.

zh: 国家只能每五年一次评判总统的表现。
en: The nation can judge the president’s performance only every five years.

zh: 在全民公决批准修宪的过程中，微弱多数土耳其选民支持民粹主义的民主政治概念。
en: By adopting the constitutional text in a referendum, a slim majority of Turkish voters seem to have given their blessing to this populist conception of democratic politics.

zh: 但两个关键问题制约着埃尔多安炙手可热的权力。
en: But two key considerations will constrain how Erdoğan uses his impressive set of new prerogatives.

zh: 首先，尽管赢得了总统选举，但AKP在议会失去了绝对多数。
en: First, despite winning the presidency, the AKP lost its outright majority in Parliament.

zh: 他们共赢得42%的选票，较2015年11月的选举下降7个百分点，能够确保议会600个议席中的293个。
en: With a tally of 42%, down seven points compared to the November 2015 election, the AKP was able to secure 293 of the parliament’s 600 seats.

zh: 因此，埃尔多安必须寻求同盟才能实施立法。
en: As a result, Erdoğan will be forced to seek alliances to enact legislation.

zh: 尽管根据新宪法，议会的角色被削弱，但控制立法机关对于有效治理国家来说仍然非常重要。
en: Even with the parliament’s diminished role under the new constitution, control of the legislature remains important for the effective functioning of the state.

zh: 极右翼的民族主义运动党（MHP）是埃尔多安在议会中的天然盟友。
en: Erdoğan’s natural ally in parliament is the far-right Nationalist Movement Party (MHP).

zh: 两党在选举前就已经结盟，埃尔多安的11%的选票是由这个政治伙伴赢得的。
en: The two parties were in a pre-electoral alliance, and Erdoğan owes his election to the 11% of the vote won by his political partner.

zh: 但与MHP缔结更深层的长期联盟关系将给土耳其国内政治和国际地位造成严重影响，还会制约埃尔多安的政策腾挪空间。
en: But a deeper, long-term alliance with the MHP will have significant implications for Turkey’s domestic politics and international standing. It will also constrain Erdoğan’s room for policy maneuver.

zh: 在国内，MHP代表秩序和安全。
en: At home, the MHP stands for order and security.

zh: 因此，与MHP结盟意味着切断了一切与土耳其库尔德人和解的可能 — — 如2015年AKP政府所推出的和平动议。
en: The alliance with MHP will therefore preclude any opening – akin to the peace initiative launched by the AKP government in 2015 – toward Turkey’s Kurds.

zh: 出于同样的原因，MHP也不可能成为任何旨在增强基本自由的大规模民主改革的天然伙伴。
en: By the same token, the MHP is not likely to be a natural partner for any large-scale democratic reforms aimed at strengthening fundamental freedoms.

zh: 在外交政策方面，MHP与生俱来的疑欧立场将进一步限制土耳其与西方合作伙伴重塑关系的外交空间。
en: On the foreign-policy front, the MHP’s inherently Euroskeptic stance will further restrict Turkey’s diplomatic space to rebuild its relations with its partners in the West.

zh: 选战期间，MHP领导层甚至要求土耳其收回其聊胜于无的欧盟入盟条件。
en: During the campaign, the MHP leadership even called for Turkey to withdraw its moribund bid for accession to the European Union.

zh: 土耳其的经济弱势是埃尔多安权威的第二大制约因素，但其重要性不亚于第一个因素。
