en: Turkey’s economic vulnerabilities pose a second and equally important constraint on Erdoğan’s authority.

zh: 与存在经常项目盈余的基于大宗商品的经济（如俄罗斯和巴西）不同，土耳其需要依赖外国储蓄。
en: Unlike commodity-based economies with current-account surpluses, like Russia and Brazil, Turkey is reliant on foreign savings.

zh: 土耳其通过利用国际资本市场为其每年约2,500亿美元的外部借贷需要提供融资，进而助推增长。
en: Turkey fuels its growth by tapping international capital markets to finance its annual external borrowing requirement of around $250 billion.

zh: 如此巨大的赤字源自长期存在的投资与储蓄之间的缺口，以及过去的AKP政府没有采取结构性改革提高总体增长率、增强土耳其的国际竞争力。
en: This substantial deficit is the consequence of a chronic gap between investment and saving, and past AKP governments’ failure to enact structural reforms to raise total productivity and enhance Turkey’s international competitiveness.

zh: 近几年来过于强调增长加剧了这些困难。
en: An overemphasis on growth in recent years has exacerbated these difficulties.

zh: 去年，土耳其经济增长率为7 % ， 位居经合组织最高行列。
en: Last year, Turkey growth rate of 7% was among the highest in the OECD.

zh: 但埃尔多安的扩张性政策加剧了土耳其的结构性失衡，通胀上升到两位数，名义利率达到了16 % ， 经常项目赤字超过国民收入的16 % 。
en: But Erdoğan’s expansionary policies have compounded the country’s structural imbalances, with inflation rising to double digits, nominal interest rates reaching 16%, and the current-account deficit surpassing 6% of national income.

zh: 因此，埃尔多安作为土耳其执政总统的表现将取决于他是否能够既满足MHP的主要重点考虑事项，又能解决经济过热的消极后果。
en: Erdoğan’s performance as Turkey’s executive president will therefore depend on his ability to chart a trajectory that satisfies the MHP’s main priorities and addresses the adverse consequences of economic overheating.

zh: 这两大约束都有可能随着时间而越来越紧，MHP自恃其在议会中的作用，变得日益桀骜难驯，而经济也越来越需要紧缩性调整。
en: Both constraints are likely to become stronger over time, with the MHP increasingly emboldened by its parliamentary leverage, and the economy in growing need of a potentially contractionary adjustment.

zh: 在埃尔多安即将到来的任期中，问题还将保持：这些实际的 — — 因此也是暂时的 — — 约束是否能成为巩固民主制度的强有力的保证的曙光？
en: Throughout Erdoğan’s coming term, the question will nonetheless remain: Can these practical – and thus ephemeral – constraints serve as even a minimal proxy for the robust guarantees of a consolidated democratic system?

zh: 埃尔多安的悲剧性选择
en: Erdoğan’s Tragic Choice

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 自从土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（Recep Tayyip Erdoğan）于2002年赢得了第一次大选以来，被政变夺权的梦魇就时时困扰着他。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Ever since Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan won his first general election in late 2002, he has been obsessed with the idea that power would be wrested from him through a coup.

zh: 他的担忧可不是空穴来风。
en: He had good reason to worry even then.

zh: 当年扎根于土耳其司法和军队高层的极端世俗体制一直都毫不掩饰其对埃尔多安本人及其政治盟友的反感。
en: Turkey’s ultra-secularist establishment, ensconced in the upper echelons of the judiciary and the military at the time, made no secret of its antipathy toward Erdoğan and his political allies.

zh: 埃尔多安本人也曾因当众背诵宗教诗歌而入狱，这令他无法在其领导的土耳其正义与发展党2002年11月赢得议会选举时立刻就职。
en: Erdoğan himself had been jailed for reciting religion-laced poetry, which prevented him from taking office immediately when his Justice and Development Party (AKP) assumed office in November 2002.

zh: 2007年时土耳其军方公开发表声明反对正义与发展党推举的总统候选人选 — — 其实那人基本上就是一个傀儡。
en: In 2007, the military issued a statement opposing the AKP’s candidate for president – then largely a figurehead.

zh: 而在2008年，该党险些被土耳其最高法院以“反世俗活动”罪名解散。
en: And in 2008, the party narrowly escaped being shut down by the country’s top court for “anti-secular activities.”

zh: 但这帮老看门人的努力在很大程度上都事与愿违，反而增强了埃尔多安的人气。
en: The old guard’s efforts largely backfired and served only to augment Erdoğan’s popularity.

zh: 对手中权力的日渐紧握让埃尔多安不急于反抗并衍生出较少对抗性的政治行事风格。
en: His strengthening grip on power might have mollified him and led to a less confrontational political style.

zh: 相反在随后几年中，他当时的盟友葛兰主义者 — — 土耳其流亡宗教学者法图拉·葛兰的追随者们 — — 则一手将人们对埃尔多安的崇拜变成了偏执。
en: Instead, in the ensuing years, his then-allies the Gülenists – followers of the cleric-in-exile Fethullah Gülen – managed to whip Erdoğan’s obsession into paranoia.

zh: 从2008年到2013年，在警界，司法和媒体的葛兰主义者们炮制了一系列据称针对埃尔多安的虚构阴谋事件，而且描绘得一个比一个更绘声绘色。
en: From 2008 to 2013, Gülenists in the police, judiciary, and media concocted a series of fictitious conspiracies and plots against Erdoğan, each more gory than the last.

zh: 他们针对一众军官，记者，非政府组织，教授学者和库尔德政治家举行了大张旗鼓的公审。
en: They ran sensational show trials targeting military officers, journalists, NGOs, professors, and Kurdish politicians.

zh: 或许连埃尔多安都无法相信所有的指控 — — 某位曾与他密切共事的高级军官也被投入了监狱 — — 但这些起诉达到了这帮人的目的。
en: Erdoğan may not have believed all of the charges – a military chief with whom he had worked closely was among those jailed – but the prosecutions served their purpose.

zh: 它们缓解了埃尔多安遭遇推翻的忧虑，并在军事和民用机构中铲除了世俗政权的残余遗迹。
en: They fed Erdoğan’s fear of being toppled, and eliminated the remaining vestiges of the secularist regime from the military and civilian bureaucracy.

zh: 而这群葛兰主义者还有另外一个小算盘。
en: The Gülenists had another motive as well.

zh: 他们可以通过虚假审判清理一批高级军官，并用自己的同情者取而代之。
en: They were able to place their own sympathizers in the senior ranks vacated by the military officers targeted by their sham trials.

zh: 葛兰主义者们已经花了几十年的时间去渗透军队；但一直无法染指最高指挥层。
en: The Gülenists had spent decades infiltrating the military; but the commanding heights had remained out of reach.

zh: 他们急需把握这个机会。
en: This was their opportunity.

zh: 而今年七月的未遂政变中最讽刺的一点莫过于它不是由土耳其的世俗主义者策划的，而是出自埃尔多安指派来取代前者的葛兰主义者之手。
en: The ultimate irony of July’s failed coup is that it was engineered not by Turkey’s secularists, but by the Gülenist officers Erdoğan had allowed to be promoted in their stead.

zh: 到了2013年底，埃尔多安与葛兰主义者公开决裂。
en: By the end of 2013, Erdoğan’s alliance with the Gülenists had turned into open warfare.

zh: 随着共同的敌人 — — 世俗主义者 — — 被消灭殆尽，自然也没什么理由继续结盟了。
en: With the common enemy – the secularist old guard – defeated, there was little to hold the alliance together.

zh: 埃尔多安已经着手关闭葛兰主义学校和企业，并将其党羽清除出国家机构。
en: Erdoğan had begun closing Gülenist schools and businesses and purging them from the state bureaucracy.

zh: 针对军队的大清洗也在酝酿之中，显然这促使葛兰主义军人只得选择先发制人。
en: A major purge of the military was on the way, which apparently prompted Gülenist officers to move pre-emptively.

zh: 无论如何，这场未遂政变已经完全证实了埃尔多安的被夺权妄想症状，也有助于解释为何针对葛兰主义者和其他政府反对派的打击力度会如此无情和广泛。
en: In any case, the coup attempt has fully validated Erdoğan’s paranoia, which helps explain why the crackdown on Gülenists and other government opponents has been so ruthless and extensive.

zh: 近4000名军官被逐出军队，8.5万名公职人员自7月15日起被革职查办，1.7万人被判入狱。
en: In addition to the discharge of nearly 4,000 officers, 85,000 public officials have been dismissed from their jobs since July 15, and 17,000 have been jailed.

zh: 数十名记者遭到拘留，其中包括许多跟葛兰运动无关的人。
en: Scores of journalists have been detained, including many with no links to the Gülen movement.

zh: 法治和正当程序规则的任何遮羞布都不复存在了。
en: Any semblance of the rule of law and due process has disappeared.

zh: 而一个伟大的领导者则会做出截然不同的应对。
en: A great leader would have responded differently.

zh: 这场未遂政变创造了一个实现民族团结的难得机会。
en: The failed putsch created a rare opportunity for national unity.

zh: 所有政党 — — 包括库尔德人民民主党 — — 都跟绝大多数政治倾向各异的普通民众一道谴责这场政变。
en: All political parties, including the Kurdish People’s Democratic Party (HDP), condemned the coup attempt, as did the vast majority of ordinary people, regardless of their political orientation.

zh: 埃尔多安本可利用这个机会去超越伊斯兰，自由主义，世俗主义和库尔德人的身份认知，围绕民主规范构建一个新的政治共识，有机会成为实现一个民主团结的领袖。
en: Erdoğan could have used the opportunity to rise beyond Islamist, liberal, secularist, and Kurdish identities to establish a new political consensus around democratic norms. He had a chance to become a democratic unifier.

zh: 但埃尔多安却选择了深化土耳其内部的分裂并进一步腐蚀法治。
en: Instead, he has chosen to deepen Turkey’s divisions and erode the rule of law even more.

zh: 对政敌的解雇和监禁已经远远超出了政变者的范围。
en: The dismissal and jailing of opponents has gone far beyond those who may have had a role in the putsch.

zh: 马克思主义学者，库尔德记者，和自由派评论家都与葛兰主义者一起遭到了清洗。
en: Marxist academics, Kurdish journalists, and liberal commentators have been swept up alongside Gülenists.

zh: 埃尔多安继续将库尔德人民民主党视为贱民，而且根本不去考虑与库尔德反政府武装之间达成和平，甚至热衷于重新开战。
en: Erdoğan continues to treat the HDP as a pariah. And, far from contemplating peace with the Kurdish rebels, he seems to relish the resumption of war with them.

zh: 不幸的是，这是一个成功的策略。
en: Unfortunately, this is a winning strategy.

zh: 让国民对假想敌保持高度警惕并煽动民族宗教情绪可以令埃尔多安的选民基础保持活跃。
en: Keeping the country on high alert against perceived enemies and inflaming nationalist-religious passions serves to keep Erdoğan’s base mobilized.

zh: 此举还能拉拢两个主要反对党；这两党都是高度民族主义，并因此构建了针对库尔德反对派战争的可靠联盟。
en: And it neutralizes the two main opposition parties; both are highly nationalistic and therefore constitute reliable allies in the war against the Kurdish rebels.

zh: 同样，埃尔多安针对葛兰本人及其运动的打击更像是政治投机而非要将政变组织者绳之于法。
en: Similarly, Erdoğan’s offensive against Gülen and his movement seems driven more by political opportunism than by a desire to bring the coup’s organizers to justice.

zh: 埃尔多安和他的部长们一直都抱怨美国不愿意将葛兰引渡回土耳其。
en: Erdoğan and his ministers have endlessly griped about the United States’ reluctance to extradite Gülen to Turkey.

zh: 然而政变至今已近两月，土耳其依然没有正式将葛兰的犯罪证据提交给美国。
en: Yet, nearly two months after the coup, Turkey has not formally submitted to the US any evidence of Gülen’s culpability.

zh: 反美言论在土耳其一直都是很吃香的东西，而埃尔多安在这方面自然也不落人后。
en: Anti-American rhetoric plays well in Turkey, and Erdoğan is not beneath exploiting it.

zh: 在一份回答政变调查检察官质询的证词中，土耳其陆军司令兼总参谋长胡卢西·阿卡尔（Hulusi Akar）表示劫持他的政变者在事件发生当晚要求他与葛兰通话。
en: In his testimony to the prosecutors investigating the coup, the army’s top general has said that the putschists who took him hostage offered to put him in contact that night with Gülen.

zh: 目前来说这是葛兰本人直接参与政变的最有力证据。
en: This remains the strongest evidence that Gülen himself was directly involved.

zh: 一位试图向全世界证明葛兰意图谋反的领导人肯定会让自己的军界同僚在媒体面前讲述当晚详情。
en: A leader intent on convincing the world of Gülen’s culpability would have paraded his military chief in front of the media to elaborate on what happened that night.

zh: 然而这位司令至今未被要求 — — 或者允许 — — 公开讲话，令外界不禁揣测他本人在这场未遂政变中究竟扮演何种角色。
en: Yet the general has not been asked – or allowed – to speak in public, fueling speculation about his own role in the attempted coup.

zh: 至此土耳其永无止境受害者螺旋 — — 囊括了伊斯兰主义者、共产主义者、世俗主义者，库尔德人，如今又增添了葛兰主义者 — — 又进一步加速运转。
en: And so Turkey’s never-ending cycle of victimization – of Islamists, communists, secularists, Kurds perennially, and now the Gülenists – has gained velocity.

zh: 埃尔多安犯下了跟2009~2010年同样的悲剧性错误：利用自身的民望破坏而非重振民主和法治 — — 从而令温和主义和政治和解在未来变得更加难以实现。
en: Erdoğan is making the same tragic mistake he made in 2009-2010: using his vast popularity to undermine democracy and the rule of law rather than restoring them – and thus rendering moderation and political reconciliation all the more difficult in the future.

zh: 埃尔多安曾有两次成为一个伟大的领袖的机会，却两次都将其抛诸脑后 — — 这不仅将令他的政治遗产大打折扣， 也会让土耳其付出更为沉重的代价
en: Erdoğan has twice had the chance to be a great leader. At considerable cost to his legacy – and even greater cost to Turkey – he spurned it both times.

zh: 普京的土耳其软糖
en: Putin’s Turkish Delight

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 小心带着礼品的沙皇。
en: BRUSSELS – Beware of czars bearing gifts.

zh: 这是对土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安中肯的建议，埃尔多安正试图在与西方关系中利用土耳其与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的友好关系。
en: It is sound advice for Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, as he tries to leverage his rapprochement with Russian President Vladimir Putin in his relations with the West.

zh: 埃尔多安与普京本月在圣彼得堡的会晤表面重点是去年在土叙边境击落俄罗斯战机后与俄冰释前嫌。
en: Erdoğan’s meeting with Putin in St. Petersburg this month was ostensibly focused on burying the hatchet after Turkey shot down a Russian warplane near its border with Syria last year.

zh: 但普京似乎将此次会面视作说服埃尔多安“向东转”并加入俄罗斯、中国及中亚各国独裁兄弟联盟的一次良机。
en: But the Kremlin seems to view the visit as an opportunity to convince Erdoğan to “turn east” and join Russia, as well as China and the countries of Central Asia, in a kind of brotherhood of autocracies.

zh: 问题在于埃尔多安是否打算接受他的建议。
en: The question is whether Erdoğan actually plans to take up the offer.

zh: 埃尔多安显然正与普京打得火热，承诺建立友谊与合作联盟。
en: Erdoğan certainly put on a show with Putin, promising friendship and cooperation.

zh: 他借此在上个月军事政变失败后向批评他逮捕数千名包括众多新闻记者在内的所谓反对派的西方盟友传递了一条有力的消息 ： “ 我并不需要你们。
en: In doing so, he sent his Western allies – which have criticized the arrests of thousands of perceived opponents, including many journalists, following last month’s failed military coup – a powerful message: “I don’t need you.”

zh: ”相反，普京是政变后首位呼吁支持埃尔多安政府的世界领袖，这或许能够解释埃尔多安为什么在尘埃落定后第一站就拜访俄罗斯。
en: Putin, by contrast, was the first world leader to call for support for Erdoğan’s government after the coup, which perhaps explains why Russia was Erdoğan’s first destination after the dust had settled.

zh: 可以肯定，埃尔多安可能只是抓住了一个巩固土耳其自身及地区安全的理想机会。
en: To be sure, Erdoğan may simply have been seizing an ideal opportunity to boost Turkey’s own security and that of the region.

zh: 归根结底，土耳其与俄罗斯闹得不可开交不符合任何人 — — 包括北约的利益。
en: After all, it is in nobody’s interest – least of all NATO’s – to have Turkey and Russia at each other’s throats.

zh: 但如果说埃尔多安不想让其北约盟国紧张恐怕没有人相信。
en: But it would be surprising if Erdoğan had no desire to make his NATO allies nervous.

zh: 而且他成功进行了这方面的努力。
en: And, in that endeavor, he succeeded.

zh: 从最低限度上讲，欧盟需要土耳其继续按照今年3月所达成协议的规定遏制难民流向土欧边界；因此埃尔多安可能对欧洲不利的任何迹象都应当引起严重的关注。
en: At the very least, the EU needs Turkey to continue, according to the deal struck in March, to stem the flow of refugees to its borders; any indication that Erdoğan may be turning against Europe is thus a cause for serious concern.

zh: 但埃尔多安与普京的和解或许还有更深层次的内容。
en: There may, however, be more to Erdoğan’s rapprochement with Putin.

zh: 如果他真像某些人所警告的那样试图牺牲与欧盟和美国的关系来深化对俄关系，就很可能会引发根本性的地缘政治重组。
en: If he is genuinely seeking to deepen Turkey’s relationship with Russia, at the expense of its ties with the EU and the US, as some warn, this would amount to a fundamental geopolitical realignment.

zh: 但这种情况似乎不太可能发生。
en: But this seems unlikely.

zh: 克里姆林宫对土耳其与西方伙伴关系恶化乐见其成。
en: The Kremlin has a strong interest in the deterioration of Turkey’s relations with its Western partners.

zh: 普京一直对北约政策（特别是北约的俄罗斯邻国政策）直言不讳地表示反对。
en: Putin has been vocal about his opposition to NATO policies – particularly its role in countries bordering Russia.

zh: 鉴于普京对人权、法治或民主关注甚少，坐视欧盟与美国领导人与埃尔多安在后政变镇压问题上硬碰硬无疑似乎是一个削弱北约的黄金机会。
en: Given that Putin cares little for human rights, the rule of law, or democracy, watching EU and US leaders butt heads with Erdoğan over his post-coup crackdown must have looked like a golden opportunity to weaken NATO.

zh: 俄罗斯急于向土耳其伸出友谊之手的另一个原因是叙利亚持续不断的冲突，克里姆林宫已经加入军事干预以保护叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政府。
en: Another reason why Russia is keen to extend the hand of friendship to Turkey is the ongoing conflict in Syria, in which the Kremlin has intervened militarily to safeguard Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s regime.

zh: 普京需要在叙利亚获胜 — — 而且还需要安全撤出。
en: Putin needs a win in Syria – and an escape route.

zh: 要想达到目的，他需要吸引一直在向俄罗斯空军全力打击的逊尼派反政府武装提供武器和支持的埃尔多安倒戈加入。
en: To that end, he needs to move Erdoğan, who has been supplying arms and support to the Sunni rebels whom the Russian air force has been hunting, into his camp.

zh: 但土耳其缺��设立东部支点的理由。
en: But the case for an eastern pivot by Turkey is far weaker.

zh: 的确，土耳其需要俄国游客提振其乏力的经济。
en: True, Turkey needs Russian tourists to bolster its distressed economy.

zh: 但俄国所能提供的经济利益在欧盟这个推动土耳其现代化进程中不可或缺的关键贸易和商业伙伴面前无疑都相形见绌。
en: But whatever economic benefits Russia can offer are dwarfed by those provided by the EU – a critical trade and business partner that has been indispensable in driving Turkey’s modernization.

zh: 再加上普京作为合作伙伴的过往记录并不值得信赖，不难得出结论尽管改善土俄关系可以惠及土耳其，但埃尔多安放弃与西方国家关系基本是不可能的。
en: Add to that Putin’s track record as an untrustworthy partner, and it is clear that, while a better relationship with Russia can benefit Turkey, Erdoğan cannot afford to abandon his country’s ties with the West.

zh: 尽管埃尔多安进入普京的轨道是个错误，但之前犯下战略错误的领袖绝不在少数。
en: But while it would be a strategic error for Erdoğan to enter Putin’s orbit, plenty of leaders have made strategic errors before.

zh: 土耳其和欧盟敲定争议问题的未来几个月也因此起着非常关键的作用。
en: That is why the next few months, when Turkey and the EU hash out contentious issues, are so critical.

zh: 土耳其和西方、尤其是欧盟紧张局势的唯一来源远非埃尔多安的后政变期镇压。
en: Erdoğan’s post-coup crackdown is far from the only source of tension between Turkey and the West, particularly the EU.

zh: 土耳其坚持要求欧盟政府兑现今年1月承诺的土耳其公民免签证访问欧盟的承诺。
en: Turkey insists that visa-free travel for Turkish citizens visiting the EU, promised by EU governments in January, should be delivered this year.

zh: 但因为土耳其迄今为止未能满足约定条件 — — 包括大规模修改其反恐立法 — — 欧盟不太可能兑现这一承诺，而且政变发生后似乎更不可能。
en: But, with Turkey having so far failed to meet the agreed conditions, including overhauling its anti-terrorism legislation, that may not happen – an outcome made even more likely by the coup attempt.

zh: 结果导致今年3月签署的移民协议目前危在旦夕。
en: As a result, the migration deal concluded in March now hangs by a thread.

zh: 要想继续向前推进，欧盟和土耳其之间迫切需要展开持续性的对话。
en: To chart a way forward, a sustained dialogue between the EU and Turkey is urgently needed.

zh: 西方国家，尤其是欧盟必须比以往更加明确地谴责埃尔多安朝着专制方向的转变，而不应坐视埃尔多安利用与普京的关系来操纵其北约盟友。
en: Rather than allow Erdoğan to use his relationship with Putin to manipulate his NATO allies, the West – and the EU, in particular – must condemn, more clearly than ever, his accelerating shift toward autocracy.

zh: 欧盟必须让埃尔多安明白他现在所走的道路离欧盟成员资格越来越远，而且可能让土耳其付出损失重要经济联系的惨重代价。
en: They must make him understand that his current path leads away from EU membership and could cost Turkey some of the economic ties on which it depends.

zh: 是该埃尔多安做出决策的时候了。
en: It is decision time for Erdoğan.

zh: 或者他重续与欧盟的亲密关系，并享受由此带来的全部繁荣，或者他继续推动土耳其走向独裁和孤立，在这样的境况下偶尔接到克里姆林宫打来的安慰电话 — — 但没有实质性的帮助。
en: Either he renews his country’s commitment to a close partnership with the EU, with all of the prosperity that this would entail, or he continues to push Turkey toward a future of despotism and isolation, in which he would receive the occasional comforting phone call from the Kremlin – but little else.

zh: 对土耳其民众而言这根本不是选择，希望埃尔多安能认清这一点。
en: It’s not much of a choice. For the sake of Turkey’s citizens, one hopes that Erdoğan sees that.

zh: 裕仁的幽灵
en: The Ghost of Hirohito

zh: 纽约—日本宫内厅完成了61卷本裕仁天皇实录，这在日本引起了广泛的兴趣和关注。
en: NEW YORK – The completion by Japan’s Imperial Household Agency of the 61-volume record of the life of Emperor Hirohito (1901-1989) has generated much interest and attention in Japan.

zh: 这份卷帙浩繁的实录目前对公众有限开放阅览，计划在未来五年中陆续出版。
en: The entire formidable work was recently opened to limited public viewing, with a plan to publish it over the next five years.

zh: 但很显然，这份新实录在不经意间反映了日本仍然没能解决其历史中的一些基本问题。
en: But it is already clear that the new record inadvertently reflects Japan’s continuing inability to address some fundamental questions about its past.

zh: 裕仁实录的编纂经历了四分之一世纪，其材料包括40多项新资料，其中最令人瞩目的是1936—1944年担任天皇侍从长的百武三郎的日记和笔记。
en: Having taken a quarter-century to compile, the project relied on some 40 new sources, most notably the diary and notes of Saburo Hyakutake, an admiral who served as Court Chamberlain from 1936 to 1944.

zh: 但是，专家们尽管认可裕仁实录规模之浩大，但似乎也一致认为这份新实录并没有提出震撼性发现，或对裕仁在日本现代史最喧嚣时期中的众多变化的角色提出创新性解读。
en: But, while acknowledging the enormous scale of the undertaking, specialists seem to agree that the new account offers no earth-shattering findings or innovative interpretations concerning Hirohito’s many and changing roles in the most tumultuous period of Japan’s modern history.

zh: 也许这并不令人奇怪，因为宫内厅的官方编辑团队相当保守。
en: Perhaps this is not surprising, coming from a conservative imperial institution’s official team of editors.

zh: 裕仁实录发扬了利奥波德·冯·兰克（Leopold von Ranke）十九世纪所提出的历史学家的任务 — — 记录“实际发生了什么 ” 。
en: The record takes to new lengths the idea that the historian’s task, as Leopold von Ranke put it in the nineteenth century, is to show “what actually happened.”

zh: 据说该实录堪称天皇起居注之典范，比如，它披露裕仁小时候欢庆圣诞节，年轻时鼻子动过手术等等，还记录了他与某人多么频繁地见面。
en: It is said to be an excellent chronicle of the court’s day-to-day goings-on, revealing, for example, that the emperor celebrated Christmas as a boy, that he had nose surgery in his youth, and how often he met with whom.

zh: 平心而论，这些花边新闻很有趣也很有用。
en: To be fair, such tidbits can be interesting and useful.

zh: 但新实录没有解释或分析裕仁在位期间的关键事件。
en: But the new account fails to explain or analyze crucial events of Hirohito’s reign.

zh: 希望更深入地了解日本发动太平洋战争、战败、盟军占领（特别是裕仁与麦克阿瑟将军的关系）以及裕仁随后不愿访问供奉包括甲级战犯在内的日本战死者的靖国神社的历史的读者会感到失望。
en: Readers will be disappointed if they want to learn more about Japan’s entry into the Pacific War, its defeat, the Allied occupation (especially Hirohito’s relationship with General Douglas MacArthur), or Hirohito’s later reluctance to visit the Yasukuni Shrine, where Imperial Japan’s war dead, including Class-A war criminals, are honored.

zh: 关于裕仁天皇的已知历史十分简略。
en: What is already known about Hirohito is sketchy.

zh: 他是个悲剧的矛盾人物，这是众所周知的。
en: That he was a tragically conflicted man is not news.

zh: 作为年轻的君主（20岁摄政，25岁即位天皇 ） ， 他必须扮演互相矛盾的角色：日本国的神主兼正在殖民亚洲邻国的帝国皇军总司令。
en: As a young sovereign (imperial regent at age 20; emperor at 25), he had to assume contradictory roles: divine pater familias of the Japanese state and Supreme Commander of the imperial armed forces that were colonizing Japan’s Asian neighbors.

zh: 他不可能是最勇敢、最果断的人，因为他无法抵挡军国主义的崛起。
en: He could not have been the bravest or most decisive man, given that he was unable to resist rising militarism.

zh: 但说他大权旁落（因此没有责任）或没有做出任何反抗也是不正确的。
en: But to say that he was powerless (and thus blameless) or did nothing to oppose it would also be wrong.

zh: 裕仁神权和世俗角色之间的冲突在1941年秋天最为尖锐。 当时日本领导人就是否要和美国及其盟国开战的问题展开争论。
en: The conflict between Hirohito’s divine and secular roles became most acute in the autumn of 1941, when Japan’s leaders debated whether to go to war with the United States and its allies.

zh: 9月6日召开了帝国会议，批准了美日外交谈判失败情况下的战争动员时间表。
en: On September 6, an imperial conference was convened to approve a timetable for war mobilization in the event of a breakdown in US-Japanese diplomatic talks.

zh: 与所有帝国会议一样，裕仁被认为会保持沉默，批准形成决定的政策。
en: As was true of all imperial conferences, Hirohito was expected to remain silent and approve a policy that already had been decided.

zh: 但裕仁打破了默契，提出放弃外交努力操之过急，并引用了其祖父明治天皇在日俄战争开始时所写的诗句 ： “ 四海之内皆兄弟，何以无事起风波？
en: Breaking with protocol, however, Hirohito cautioned against giving up on diplomacy too soon, and then recited his grandfather Emperor Meiji’s poem from the beginning of the Russo-Japanese War, in 1904: “Beyond all four seas, all are brothers and sisters/Then why oh why these rough winds and waves?”

zh: ”因此，也许裕仁一直在寻求表达自己的观点：日本应该避免与美国开战，特别是已经与中国进行了四年多残酷又不成功的征服战的情况下。
en: Thus, Hirohito might have been seeking to express his view that Japan should avoid a war with the US, especially given that the country had been fighting a savage and unsuccessful war of conquest in China for more than four years.

zh: 但是，不管裕仁的真实意图为何（我们也无从确切知道 ） ， 更大的事实依然是他遵从了战争动员。
en: But, whatever Hirohito’s true intentions (which we cannot know for certain), the larger fact remains that he went along with the war mobilization.

zh: 而尽管新官方实录披露了这一众所周知的事实的一些细节，但并未就裕仁如何理解其自身的行动这一问题提供新的信息。
en: And, while the new official record depicts this well-known episode in some detail, it sheds no new light on how Hirohito understood his own action.

zh: 正如他在与美国开战问题上犹豫不决，裕仁在如何休战的问题上也陷入了绝望的矛盾。
en: Just as he dithered over going to war with the US, Hirohito was hopelessly ambivalent about how to end it.

zh: 新实录披露，1944年9月26日，裕仁对最紧密的亲信、掌玺官木户幸一说 ： “ 如果可以实现和平并且不必背负裁军和战争责任，我才不在乎我们所征服的领土（被收回 ） 。
en: The new record reports that Hirohito told his closest adviser, Privy Seal Kōichi Kido, on September 26, 1944: “If one could come to a peace without the question of disarmament or war responsibility, I don’t care [if] our conquered territories [are taken away].”

zh: ”据说这是新实录中第一个裕仁渴望结束战争的迹象。
en: This is reportedly the first indication in the new account about Hirohito’s desire to end the war.

zh: 但是，不管他真正渴望什么，他接下来的行动 — — 再一次地 — — 并非一个积极地试图寻找和平之路的人所应该做的。
en: But, whatever his true desire, his subsequent actions were – once again – not those of a man actively trying to find a path to peace.

zh: 在几个月的时间里，他告诉自己和其他人，首先“日本必须再次取得对美国的军事大胜 ” ， 这样就能在战后和解谈判中获得些许外交优势。
en: For months, he told himself and others that first “Japan must have another brilliant military gain” over the US, so that it would have a modicum of diplomatic clout in negotiating a postwar settlement.

zh: 不消说，无数日本人和非日本人在这几个月的优柔寡断中失去了生命。
en: Needless to say, many Japanese and non-Japanese lives were lost during those months of indecision.

zh: 事实上，日本国的生存都收到了威胁，许多城市遭遇轰炸，冲绳被占领，广岛和长崎遭到原子弹打击。
en: Indeed, the very existence of the Japanese nation was endangered, as most cities were bombed, Okinawa was invaded, and atomic bombs were dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

zh: 最终，日本被解除了武装，战后法庭也成立了，许多日本政府的领土被返回。
en: In the end, Japan was disarmed, postwar trials were held, and most of the country’s imperial conquests were reversed.

zh: 但裕仁仍成功地回避了他在战中的责任问题 — — 而很显然，这场战争是以他的名义发动的。
en: And yet Hirohito still managed to sidestep the question of his own responsibility in a war that was so obviously fought in his name.

zh: 在战后的废墟中间，他成了和平的象征。
en: Amid the postwar devastation, he became a symbol of peace.

zh: 因此，新裕仁实录的最重要教训也许与编纂者的初衷相去甚远。
en: The most important lesson of the new imperial record, then, might be quite different from what its compilers had intended.

zh: 日本在面对历史方面的集体无能早已臭名昭著，这其实与其在理解本国天皇上的无能息息相关。
en: Japan’s notorious collective inability to come to terms with its past is deeply entwined with its inability to understand this emperor.

zh: 诚然，新实录只是有选择地使用了原始资料，其中有一些资料尚未完全解密。
en: Admittedly, the new account makes only selective use of primary sources, quite a few of which have not been declassified in their entirety.

zh: 未来有可能会有更多的细节披露。
en: It is possible that more revelations will emerge in the future.

zh: 但是，就目前而言，裕仁仍是一个非常不透明、非常孤立的角色，不同于我们对他的常规理解 — — 呜呼，更好地理解“实际发生了什么”由从何谈起呢。
en: But, for now, Hirohito remains a singularly unfathomable and isolated character who defies common understandings – alas, to the detriment of a better understanding of “what actually happened.”

zh: 欧洲的危险新常态
en: Europe’s Precarious New Normal

zh: 伦敦—十年前，十个国家加入了欧盟。
en: LONDON – A decade ago, ten countries joined the European Union.

zh: 如今，塞浦路斯、捷克、爱沙尼亚、匈牙利、拉脱维亚、马耳他、波兰、斯洛伐克和斯洛文尼亚都被普遍认为充分融入了欧洲国家。
en: Today, Cyprus, the Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Poland, Slovakia, and Slovenia are universally recognized as fully integrated European countries.

zh: 1989年柏林墙倒塌所带来的巨大的政治变局，以及随后冗长的欧盟入盟过程造就了这一新常态，一个摆脱了冷战政治和经济扭曲的常态。
en: The extraordinary political transitions set in motion by the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989, together with the mundane and drawn-out EU accession process that followed, produced this new normal – one essentially free from the political and economic distortions of the Cold War.

zh: 如今，乌克兰正在这条路上冒险前行 — — 并且没有获得被欧盟完全接受的承诺。
en: Ukraine is now venturing down this path – without the promise of full accession.

zh: 在这个周年纪念，在一个地缘政治紧张局面在欧洲大陆重现的时刻，我们大有必要提醒自己这一新常态对十年前加入欧盟的国家意味着什么，对乌克兰又可能意味着什么。
en: On this anniversary, with an era of geopolitical tension again descending on the European continent, it is worth reminding ourselves what the new normal has meant for the countries that joined the EU ten years ago – and what it could mean for Ukraine.

zh: 被“铁幕 ” （ Iron Curtain）遮掩起来的欧洲“失踪的中部”已经得到重建。
en: Europe’s “missing middle,” gouged out by the Iron Curtain, has been restored.

zh: 中欧地区贸易出现了繁荣，并自然而然地被世界第一大市场 — — 欧盟所吸引。
en: Trade in the region has flourished, naturally gravitating toward the EU, the world’s largest market.

zh: 投资则呈现出反方向流动，如经济学理论所能推断的那样从资本富裕国流向资本匮乏国。
en: Investment has flowed in the opposite direction, from capital-rich to capital-poor countries, as economic theory would predict.

zh: 比较波兰和乌克兰的情况可以一窥欧盟成员资格所造成的区别。
en: Comparing Poland and Ukraine underscores the difference that EU membership has made.

zh: 1989年，波兰和乌克兰的生活水平大致相当；如今，波兰比乌克兰富裕三倍。
en: In 1989, Poland and Ukraine had approximately the same standard of living; today, Poles are three times richer.

zh: 如今，波兰与西欧的收入差距是1500年以来最低的。
en: Poland’s income gap with Western Europe today is smaller than it has been at any point since the year 1500.

zh: 欧盟GDP总量比俄罗斯大八倍，因此，我们可以预计，乌克兰的新常态化意味着欧盟将主导它的对外贸易。
en: Given that the EU’s combined GDP is eight times larger than that of Russia, we should expect a path toward normality for Ukraine to mean that the EU would dominate the country’s foreign trade.

zh: 但这并不意味着完全与俄罗斯决裂。 自2004年以来，俄罗斯占波兰出口权重翻了三倍。
en: But this does not imply a complete break with Russia, whose weight in Polish exports has tripled since 2004.

zh: 从地理位置关系和产业网络看，俄乌贸易的潜力要大得多。
en: Given their geographic proximity and industrial networks, the potential for trade between Russia and Ukraine is much greater.

zh: 但新常态还与民主和尊严有关。
en: But the new normal is about democracy and dignity as well.

zh: 很难想象现在在东乌克兰发生的社会动荡会在波兰发生。
en: It is hard to imagine that what is currently happening to the social fabric in eastern Ukraine could happen in Poland.

zh: 毫无疑问，被接受加入欧盟对波兰卓越的制度变迁起到了推动作用。
en: EU accession has undoubtedly contributed to Poland’s exceptional institutional transformation.

zh: 和乌克兰一样，波兰在共产主义崩溃后的几年中立刻出现了腐败横行。
en: Like Ukraine, Poland suffered from widespread corruption in the years immediately following the collapse of communism.

zh: 但如今，波兰的腐败指标比许多欧盟旧成员国都要好。
en: But today it ranks better than many old EU members on corruption indicators.

zh: 向欧盟规则和监管的靠拢过程是痛苦的，但帮助波兰在20世纪90年代成为正常欧洲国家，如今也可以帮助乌克兰治理其贿赂、任人唯亲和裙带关系等问题。
en: The painstaking approximation of EU rules and regulation that helped Poland become a normal European country by the late 1990’s would offer Ukraine the prospect of taming its own demons of bribery, cronyism, and nepotism.

zh: 此外，波兰从获得大量欧盟资金上获益良多，在过去十年中，超过920亿欧元涌入了波兰经济。
en: Moreover, Poland has benefited from access to massive EU funding, with more than €92 billion ($128 billion) pouring into the economy over the last ten years.

zh: 中欧和东欧的私人部门资金流也有了很大增加，因为那里拥有吸引外国直接投资的诱人条件 — — 其中许多投资都是��期项目，并伴随着知识转移和国际先进实践经验的引入。
en: Private-sector flows have been much larger throughout Central and Eastern Europe as well, owing to attractive conditions for foreign direct investment – much of it comprising long-term projects with associated benefits like knowledge transfer and the introduction of international best practices.

zh: 在乌克兰建立这一新常态能释放巨大的转变力。
en: Establishing this kind of normality in Ukraine could unleash massive transformational forces.

zh: 但我们都知道，这样的愿望今天是十分危险的。
en: But this aspiration, as we all know, is now in serious jeopardy.

zh: 而灭亡的成本可能极其高昂，不仅仅对乌克兰是如此，对中欧和东欧国家也是如此。
en: And the price of its extinction could be high, not only for Ukraine, but also for the countries of Central and Eastern Europe.

zh: 首先，考虑到针对自身难保的俄罗斯经济的制裁，与俄罗斯贸易关系的复兴成了这些国家的弱点。
en: For starters, with sanctions targeting Russia’s floundering economy, revived trade ties are becoming a source of vulnerability for these countries.

zh: 活跃于俄罗斯市场的公司已经开始报告融资困难，跨境投资也纷纷中止。
en: Already, companies active in the Russian market are reporting problems finding funding, and cross-border investments are being postponed.

zh: 影响不止于短期贸易和投资。
en: The impact goes beyond short-term trade and investment.

zh: 增加能源安全需要大手笔的快速动作，这正在挤压中欧和东欧国家的高等教育和研究长期投资等其他当务之急以及急需的医疗体系改善。
en: Expensive quick fixes to increase energy security are crowding out other important priorities in Central and Eastern Europe, such as long-term investment in tertiary education and research, and much-needed improvements in dilapidated health-care systems.

zh: 而1989年后出现的、帮助中欧和东欧国家创造财政空间的“和平红利”正在蒸发，因为该地区内外的各国认为需要增加防务开支。
en: And the post-1989 “peace dividend,” which has helped create fiscal space, is evaporating, as countries in the region and beyond perceive a need to increase defense expenditures.

zh: 欧洲领导人正在仔细考虑下一阶段步骤和应对措施，而乌克兰人需要认真考虑他们可以从通往欧洲常态的经济和制度改革之路上获得什么。
en: As Europe’s leaders mull over their next steps and consider how to respond, Ukrainians should consider carefully how much they would gain by moving down the path of economic and institutional reform toward European normality.

zh: 与此同时，中欧和东欧国家应该得到欧盟的支持，减少它们的脆弱性。
en: At the same time, the countries of Central and Eastern Europe deserve the EU’s support in their efforts to reduce their vulnerabilities.

zh: 土耳其的失败官僚政变
en: Turkey’s Failed Bureaucratic Coup

zh: 安卡拉—上周，土耳其总理埃尔多安加强了政府对反腐调查的反应。 自12月以来，反腐调查席卷全国，重构了司法和警察部门领导层。
en: ANKARA – Last week, Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan intensified his government’s response to the corruption investigations that have been roiling the country since December, restructuring the leadership of the judiciary and police.

zh: 但这并不是行政部门和司法部门之争，也不是为了掩盖导致三名部长辞职的指控。
en: But it would be a mistake to view this as a fight between the executive and the judiciary, or as an attempt to cover up charges that have led to the resignation of three ministers.

zh: 问题的重点是执法当局的独立性和公正性。
en: What is at issue is the law-enforcement authorities’ independence and impartiality.

zh: 事实上，由于编造证据之嫌，埃尔多安现已不再反对重审被判颠覆政府罪的高级军官。
en: Indeed, amid charges of fabricated evidence, Erdoğan now says that he is not opposed to retrials for senior military officers convicted of plotting to overthrow his government.

zh: 最近的发展态势反映了埃尔多安政府和葛兰运动之间的日益扩大的分歧。
en: The recent developments reflect the widening rift between Erdoğan’s government and the Gülen movement, led by Fethullah Gülen, a self-exiled Islamic preacher currently residing near Philadelphia.

zh: 葛兰运动由目前定居费城附近的自我放逐的伊斯兰传教士法法土拉·葛兰（Fethullah Gülen）领导，它是执政的正义和发展党（AKP）及其在执政的前两个任期中实现文官控制军队的努力的重要支持者。
en: The Gülen movement was an important backer of the governing Justice and Development Party (AKP) and its efforts to establish civilian control over the military during the AKP’s first two terms in office.

zh: 但是，如今，葛兰运动似乎在酝酿自己的政变。
en: Now, however, the movement appears to have been plotting a coup of its own.

zh: 与针对政府官员、商人和政客家人的腐败指控有染的许多司法和警察部门官员与葛兰运动都有关系。
en: Many members of the judiciary and the police force associated with the wave of corruption charges brought against government officials, businessmen, and politicians’ family members are connected with the Gülen movement.

zh: 以贪污调查开场的反腐运动很快就演变为支持-反对的诋毁运动。
en: What started out as an investigation into alleged graft soon became an opposition-supported smear campaign.

zh: 土耳其的当前斗争引出了关于多元主义民主中官僚和当选官员的合理关系的问题。
en: Turkey’s current struggles raise important questions about the appropriate relationship between bureaucrats and elected officials in a pluralist democracy.

zh: 回答这些问题需要超越权力分割和司法独立、澄清政治和宗教合理关系的讨论。
en: Answering them will require a debate that transcends issues like the separation of powers and judicial independence and elucidates the appropriate relationship between politics and religion.

zh: 对这个问题，理解当前危机的历史背景十分关键。
en: For that, understanding the historical context of the current crisis is crucial.

zh: 1950年，土耳其成为民主国家，之前政权的世俗基马尔主义精英试图利用军队和官僚的力量控制当选政府。
en: When Turkey became a democracy in 1950, the previous system’s secular Kemalist elites attempted to harness the power of the military and the bureaucracy to control the elected government.

zh: 事实上，1960年、1971年、1980年和1997年，土耳其军方在司法部门的支持下赤裸裸地干预了文职政府的运作，每一次都打着捍卫世俗主义的名号。
en: In fact, the Turkish military, with the judiciary’s support, explicitly intervened in the civilian government’s functioning in 1960, 1971, 1980, and 1997, each time in the name of protecting secularism.

zh: 结果，包括葛兰运动在内的许多宗教集团鼓动追随者在官僚和军队中任职。
en: In response, various religious groups, including the Gülen movement, encouraged their followers to take positions in the bureaucracy and the military.

zh: 20世纪90年代，军方支持的世俗主义政府发动逆袭，试图清洗宗教官僚和军队领导人：不饮酒的人、家庭成员佩戴头纱的人马上受到了怀疑。
en: In the 1990’s, military-backed secularist governments struck back, attempting to purge religious bureaucrats and military leaders: those who did not consume alcohol, or whose family members wore headscarves, were immediately suspected.

zh: 2002年AKP在大选中获胜后，土耳其民主实现了正常化，高级官僚序列不再限制对宗教公民的招募、就业和升职 — — 拥有广大的教育、媒体和商业网络的葛兰运动的成员在这一过程中受益最大。
en: With the normalization of Turkish democracy following the AKP’s victory in 2002, restrictions on the recruitment, employment, and promotion of religious citizens in the upper echelons of the bureaucracy were eliminated – a process that especially benefited members of the Gülen movement, with its extensive education, media, and business networks.

zh: 葛兰的追随者 — — 声称支持AKP追求的自由民主和容忍、现代的伊斯兰教 — — 似乎是埃尔多安政府的天然盟友。
en: Gülen followers – who claimed to support liberal democracy and the tolerant, modern form of Islam embraced by the AKP – seemed like natural allies of Erdoğan’s government.

zh: 在十年的时间里，与葛兰有关的公司对土耳其的经济增长和发展做出了广为人知 — — 和支持 — — 的作用，而葛兰运动学校毕业的学生纷纷追求公务职位。
en: For a decade, Gülen-connected companies played a widely acknowledged – and appreciated – role in Turkey’s economic growth and development, while Gülen-movement schools trained students to pursue public-service jobs.

zh: 只要官僚系统根据才能来招聘和升职，AKP就不会无法接受葛兰运动追随者在一些政府机构中人数过多。
en: As long as bureaucrats were recruited and promoted based on merit, the AKP had no problem accepting the over-representation of Gülen followers in certain branches of government.

zh: 之所以能够接受，是因为AKP认为葛兰运动成员能够坚守多元主义民主的根本要求 — — 官僚不会让宗教信仰压倒对公共服务和法治精神的承诺，土耳其的穆斯林、美国的摩门教徒和日本的和尚都是如此。
en: This acceptance was rooted in the belief that Gülen members would adhere to the fundamental requirement in a pluralist democracy that bureaucrats – whether Muslims in Turkey, Mormons in the United States, or Buddhists in Japan – do not allow their religious convictions to trump their commitment to public service and the rule of law.

zh: 政府没有想到的是会出现一种新形式的官僚对文职政府的控制。
en: What the government did not imagine was that a new vision of bureaucratic tutelage over the civilian government would emerge.

zh: 尽管葛兰运动追随者不同意政府的某些政策，但他们在过去三次选举中仍大多支持AKP。
en: Although Gülen followers have disagreed with several of the government’s policies, they largely backed the AKP in the last three elections.

zh: 让他们与AKP决裂的是重组“补习班”的政策争论。 “补习班”是一种昂贵的私人机构，为高中高年级学生提供大学入学考试备战指导。
en: What drove them to reject the party completely was a policy debate on restructuring “cram schools” – expensive private institutions that prepare high-school seniors for their university entrance examinations.

zh: 这些学校至少有四分之一是葛兰运动开的，它们也构成了葛兰运动数十亿美元教育网络的关键部分并为之输送新成员。
en: The Gülen movement operates at least one-quarter of these schools, which form a key component of the movement’s multi-billion-dollar education network and help it recruit new members.

zh: 葛兰运动成员因此认为关于补习班的争论是对其影响力的直接挑战。
en: The movement’s members thus viewed the debate over cram schools as a direct challenge to their influence.

zh: 但他们的反应有些过火 — — 特别是考虑到政府的计划并未定案。
en: But their reaction was disproportionate – not least because the government’s plans were not finalized.

zh: 此外，这项计划与葛兰运动毫无关系；政府是为了应对人民对不得不花费额外的大量费用帮孩子备考免费的公立大学的不满。
en: Moreover, the proposal had nothing to do with the Gülen movement; the government was responding to citizens’ complaints about having to pay extravagant fees to prepare their children for free public universities.

zh: 葛兰运动也并没有完全失势，补习班代表也参与了与教育部官员的对话。
en: And the Gülen movement was not exactly caught off-guard; cram-school representatives had been engaged in a dialogue with education-ministry officials for some time.

zh: 和任何民主国家一样，对土耳其政府政策公共批评是正常的健康现象。
en: As in any democracy, public criticism of Turkey’s government policies is normal and healthy.

zh: 但司法和警察部门中的葛兰运动盟军坚决抵制、威胁和非法要挟政府是不可接受的。
en: But attempts by Gülen-aligned members of the judiciary and the police force to blackmail, threaten, and illegally bargain with the government are unacceptable.

zh: 现在，应该由法院来澄清土耳其所谓“公务员”腐败的真相。
en: Now, it is up to the courts to discern the truth about corruption among Turkey’s so-called “public servants.”

zh: 但所有信号都表明，包括最近卷入腐败案的总检察部门高官和坚决捍卫检察官公正形象（尽管他们的许多非法行为 — — 如大量未授权的监听行为 — — 已经遭到了曝光）的亲葛兰运动媒体在内的葛兰运动追随者在组织一场政变。
en: But all of the signs point to a coordinated political crusade by Gülen followers, including the chief prosecutors involved in the recent corruption cases and the pro-Gülen media that have steadfastly defended the prosecutors’ impartiality (despite the many irregularities – such as extensive unauthorized wiretaps – that have come to light).

zh: 此外，司法部门内部的一个有组织团体被质疑编造证据 — — 这项指控导致人们要求军方相关人员辞职。
en: Moreover, a coordinated group within the judiciary is suspected of planting evidence – allegations that have led to the calls for military personnel to be retried.

zh: 当然，这并不意味着军方人员在过去并没有尝试过政变，也不意味着政客和官僚没有腐败。
en: To be sure, this does not mean that there were no coup attempts by members of the military in the past or cases of corruption by politicians and bureaucrats.

zh: 要点是土耳其需要司法改革扫除有组织派系操纵宪法权力追求自身狭隘利益的可能。
en: The point is that Turkey needs judicial reforms that eliminate the possibility of organized cliques manipulating their constitutional powers to advance their own narrow goals.

zh: 这是多元主义民主的一条红线。
en: This is a red line for any pluralist democracy.

zh: 个体公民应该拥有信仰自由；不能允许不受约束的神学观点决定他们作为公务员和官僚的行为。
en: Individual citizens should be free to live according to their beliefs; but an unaccountable theological vision must not be allowed to shape their behavior as civil servants and bureaucrats.

zh: 更一般地说，关于葛兰运动的争论应该成为一个澄清宗教和政治关系的机会，提醒土耳其公众 — — 以及整个地区的穆斯林多数国家 — — 什么才是让土耳其得以发展和繁荣的核心民主价值。
en: More generally, the debate about the Gülen movement should serve as an opportunity to clarify the relationship between religion and politics, while reminding the Turkish public – and Muslim-majority countries throughout the region – of the core democratic values that have enabled Turkey to develop and thrive.

zh: 逃离难民危机
en: Escaping the Refugee Crisis

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 7月，抵达欧盟边界的移民数量超过100，000人 — — 已经是连续第三个月刷新移民人数记录。
en: PRINCETON – In July, the number of migrants reaching the borders of the European Union passed 100,000 – the third consecutive month in which a new record was set.

zh: 仅8月的1个星期，就有21，000名移民抵达希腊。
en: In one week in August, 21,000 migrants arrived in Greece.

zh: 游客抱怨置身难民营中取代了他们计划中的希腊夏日之旅。
en: Tourists complained that the summer holiday they had planned on a Greek island was now in the midst of a refugee camp.

zh: 当然，难民危机的影响远不止于此。
en: Of course, the refugee crisis has far more serious implications.

zh: 上周，奥地利当局在维也纳附近一辆被遗弃的匈牙利卡车里发现71具腐烂的移民尸体。
en: Last week, Austrian authorities found the decomposing bodies of 71 migrants in a Hungarian truck abandoned near Vienna.

zh: 2,500多名潜在移民今年葬身地中海，其中大部分试图从北非穿越至意大利。
en: And more than 2,500 would-be migrants have drowned in the Mediterranean this year, most of them attempting to cross from North Africa to Italy.

zh: 成功抵达法国的移民都住在加来附近的帐篷里，等待机会搭乘货运列车穿过海峡隧道到英国去。
en: Migrants who have made it as far as France are living in tents near Calais, waiting for a chance to get to England by scrambling aboard a freight train passing through the Channel Tunnel.

zh: 其中有一部分人也会丧命，从火车上摔下来或者被碾死。
en: Some of them die, too, falling off trains or getting run over.

zh: 不过，相比其他一些国家欧洲难民人数仍不算多。
en: Nevertheless, the number of refugees in Europe is still small compared to some other countries.

zh: 德国收到的庇护请求超过其他任何欧洲国家，但其每千名居民不到6名难民的比例还不到土耳其每千名居民21人的三分之一，而黎巴嫩每千名居民232名难民的比例又远非土耳其能比。
en: Germany has received more applications for asylum than any other European country, but its six refugees per thousand inhabitants is less than a third of Turkey’s 21 per thousand, which in turn is dwarfed by Lebanon’s 232 per thousand.

zh: 2014年底，联合国难民机构联合国难民署估计全球有5950万人被迫流离失所，达到有史以来的最高记录。
en: At the end of 2014, UNHCR, the United Nations agency for refugees, estimated that there were 59.5 million forcibly displaced people worldwide, the highest level ever recorded.

zh: 当然，180万人正在等待庇护申请结果，难民有1950万人，而其他人则是在自己国内流离失所。
en: Of these, 1.8 million are awaiting a decision on their asylum applications, 19.5 million are refugees, and the rest are displaced inside their own countries.

zh: 叙利亚、阿富汗和索马里是难民的最大来源，但更多难民来自利比亚、厄立特里亚、中非共和国、南苏丹、尼日利亚和刚果民主共和国。
en: Syria, Afghanistan, and Somalia are the largest sources of refugees, but many more come from Libya, Eritrea, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, Nigeria, and the Democratic Republic of Congo.

zh: 在亚洲，缅甸对穆斯林罗兴亚少数族裔的迫害也导致了近期难民数量的增加。
en: In Asia, the persecution of the Muslim Rohingya minority in Myanmar has contributed to a recent increase in the number of refugees.

zh: 我们不能责怪人们希望离开冲突缠身的贫困国家并在别处找到更好的生活。
en: We cannot blame people for wishing to leave conflict-ridden, impoverished countries and find a better life elsewhere.

zh: 如果我们身临其境会做出同样的选择。
en: In their situation, we would do the same.

zh: 但一定有更好的方式满足他们的需求。
en: But there must be a better way of responding to their needs.

zh: 少数大胆的思想家倡导世界开放边界，认为这将极大促进全球GDP和平均幸福指数。
en: A few bold thinkers advocate a world with open borders, arguing that this would greatly boost both global GDP and average global happiness.

zh: （参见如http : / /openborders.info。
en: (See, for example, http://openborders.info.)

zh: ）上述观点忽略了我们人类可悲的排外倾向，欧洲极右翼极端主义政党飙升的人气就是证据。
en: Such arguments ignore our species’ lamentable xenophobic tendencies, evidenced all too clearly by the surge in popularity of far-right extremist political parties in Europe.

zh: 在可以预见的未来，没有哪国政府会对希望入境者开放边界。
en: For the foreseeable future, no government will open its borders to all who want to enter.

zh: 事实上，反而存在反向趋势：塞尔维亚和匈牙利正在修建围墙阻挡移民，目前确保26个欧洲国家间人员自由流动的申根地区已经有人开始谈论恢复边境管制。
en: Indeed, there is only movement in the opposite direction: Serbia and Hungary are building fences to keep migrants out, and there has been talk of reinstating border controls within the Schengen Area, which currently guarantees freedom of movement among 26 European countries.

zh: 与其简单地封闭边境，富裕国家应该为那些支撑大量难民的不那么富裕的国家提供更多支持：黎巴嫩、约旦、埃塞俄比亚和巴基斯坦都是明显的例子。
en: Instead of simply sealing themselves off, affluent countries should be giving much more support to less affluent countries that are supporting large numbers of refugees: Lebanon, Jordan, Ethiopia, and Pakistan are obvious examples.

zh: 安全生活在邻国的难民尝试踏上到遥远地区的危险旅行的可能性较小，一旦冲突解决也更有可能回到国内。
en: Refugees living securely in countries that border their own are less likely to attempt hazardous journeys to remote regions and more likely to return home once a conflict is resolved.

zh: 为承受最大难民负担的国家提供国际支持也有其经济意义：约旦为一名难民提供一年支持要花3，000欧元（合3，350美元 ） ， 而德国则要耗费12，000欧元以上。
en: International support for countries bearing the greatest refugee burden also makes economic sense: it costs Jordan about €3,000 ($3,350) to support one refugee for a year; in Germany, the cost is at least €12,000.

zh: 但归根结底，需要重新思考在许多人看来神圣、不可改变的文字：联合国 有关难民地位的公约和协议。
en: Ultimately, however, we need to reconsider what for many is a sacred and immutable text: the UN Convention and Protocol Relating to the Status of Refugees.

zh: 这项1951年签署的公约原本仅对欧洲范围内于该日期前出逃者适用。
en: The Convention, concluded in 1951, was originally limited to persons within Europe fleeing events before that date.

zh: 它要求缔约国允许抵达其领土的难民留��那里，不加以歧视或因违反移民法而施行惩罚措施。
en: It required the signatory countries to allow refugees who reached their territory to stay there, without discrimination or penalty for breaching immigration laws.

zh: 难民指那些有充分理由担心因“种族、宗教、国籍、加入特定社会团体或政治观点”而遭受迫害而不能或不愿回国的人。
en: Refugees were defined as those unable or unwilling to return to their country because of a well-founded fear of persecution on the grounds of “race, religion, nationality, membership of a particular social group, or political opinion.”

zh: 1967年，时间和地域限制的消除使得上述公约具有了普遍意义。
en: In 1967, the restrictions of time and geography were removed, making the Convention universal.

zh: 这无疑当属高尚之举，但人们却从未对关键问题提出过质疑：为什么有能力前往他国的人较之生活在难民营、无力旅行的人却掌握优先权利？
en: That was a noble thing to do, but a key question was never asked: Why should someone who is able to travel to another country have priority over others who are in refugee camps and unable to travel?

zh: 富裕国家有责任收容难民，其中不少可以而且应该接受更多。
en: Affluent countries have a responsibility to take refugees, and many of them can and should accept more than they do.

zh: 但随着寻求庇护人数的增加，法庭和法院已经越来越难以界定谁是公约规定的难民，谁又是对规则烂熟于胸的移民试图在富裕国家寻求更好的生活。
en: But as the number of people seeking asylum has grown, it has become difficult for tribunals and courts to determine who is a refugee, as defined by the Convention, and who is a well-coached migrant seeking a better life in a more affluent country.

zh: 该公约还开创了通常不择手段、有时甚至是致命的人口走私行业。
en: The Convention has also given rise to the new, often unscrupulous, and sometimes lethal industry of people smuggling.

zh: 如果那些在邻国申请庇护者被送往难民营，在免遭迫害的同时享受来自富裕国家的财政支持，就可以消灭人口走私 — — 和运输途中的人员死亡。
en: If those who claim asylum in a nearby country were sent to a refugee camp, safe from persecution, and supported financially by aid from affluent countries, people smuggling – and deaths in transit – would be eliminated.

zh: 此外，经济移民寻求庇护的动机将会减少，而富裕国家也可以在保持边界控制的同时，履行从难民营接收更多难民的职责 。
en: Moreover, the incentive for economic migrants to seek asylum would be reduced, and affluent countries could fulfill their responsibility to accept more refugees from the camps, while maintaining control of their borders.

zh: 这或许不是最好的解决办法，但其可行性可能最高。
en: That may not be the best solution, but it may be the most workable.

zh: 而且较之许多难民目前面临的混乱和悲剧要好得多。
en: And it looks a lot better than the chaos and tragedy that many refugees are facing now.

zh: 拒绝抵达边境的人入境在感情上非常困难，即使他们被送往一个安全的避风港。
en: Turning away people who manage to reach one’s country is emotionally difficult, even if they are being sent to a safe haven.

zh: 但我们也应该同情在难民营中等待的成百上千万难民。
en: But we should also have compassion for the millions of people who are waiting in refugee camps.

zh: 我们需要给予他们希望。
en: We need to give them hope, too.

zh: 逃离乔治·布什的未来
en: Escaping George Bush’s Future

zh: 一切都是石油惹的祸。
en: It always comes back to oil.

zh: 美英对中东不断进行的错误干预，其根源在于阿拉伯的土壤深处。
en: The continuing misguided interventions in the Middle East by the United States and the United Kingdom have their roots deep in the Arabian sand.

zh: 自从上世纪初温斯顿·丘吉尔领导了英国海军从煤到油的能源转换，西方大国就不断地插手中东国家的事务，为了保持石油流通，颠覆政府，在战争中推波助澜，展开了一场所谓的能源“大竞赛 ” 。
en: Ever since Winston Churchill led the conversion of Britain’s navy from coal to oil at the start of the last century, the Western powers have meddled incessantly in the affairs of Middle Eastern countries to keep the oil flowing, toppling governments and taking sides in wars in the supposed “great game” of energy resources.

zh: 不过这场竞赛已接近尾声，因为旧的手段显然已力有不逮。
en: But the game is almost over, because the old approaches are obviously failing.

zh: 就在人们开始相信美英在伊拉克的行动还有石油以外的原因时，现实将我们拉了回来。
en: Just when one is lulled into thinking that something other than oil is at the root of current US and UK action in Iraq, reality pulls us back.

zh: 布什总统最近邀请记者想象今后50年的世界。
en: Indeed, President Bush recently invited journalists to imagine the world 50 years from now.

zh: 他的心中并没有未来的科技，也不在意高达九十亿的全球人口，或者气候变化及生物多样性的挑战。
en: He did not have in mind the future of science and technology, or a global population of nine billion, or the challenges of climate change and biodiversity.

zh: 相反，他想知道的是伊斯兰激进分子是否会控制全球的石油。
en: Instead, he wanted to know whether Islamic radicals would control the world’s oil.

zh: 不论50年后有什么问题值得我们担心，这肯定是最次要的问题之一。
en: Whatever we are worrying about in 50 years, this will surely be near the bottom of the list.

zh: 即便这个问题很重要，为了保证50年内的石油供应而把萨达姆·侯赛因拉下台也是最无理取闹的战略。
en: Even if it were closer to the top, overthrowing Saddam Hussein to ensure oil supplies in 50 years ranks as the least plausible of strategies.

zh: 然而各种各样的证据告诉我们，当布什政府将重点从通缉本·拉登转为向伊拉克开战时，他心里所想的正是这个。
en: Yet we know from a range of evidence that this is what was on Bush’s mind when his government shifted its focus from the search for Osama bin Laden to fighting a war in Iraq.

zh: 推翻萨达姆是新保守主义的新美国世纪计划长久以来的执念，早在上世纪90年代他们就坚持认为萨达姆很可能会压制“全球很大一部分石油供应 ” 。
en: The overthrow of Saddam was the longstanding pet idea of the neoconservative Project for a New American Century, which was already arguing in the 1990’s that Saddam was likely to achieve a stranglehold over “a significant proportion of the world’s oil supplies.”

zh: 副总统迪克·切尼在酝酿伊拉克战争时多次表示这样的担心，宣称萨达姆·侯赛因为了“控制全球很大一部分能源供应 ” ， 在制造大量大规模杀伤性武器。
en: Vice President Dick Cheney reiterated these fears in the run-up to the Iraq War, claiming that Saddam Hussein was building a massive arsenal of weapons of mass destruction to “take control of a great portion of the world’s energy supplies.”

zh: 切尼所谓的事实显然是错误的，而且他的逻辑也不对。
en: Cheney’s facts were obviously wrong, but so was his logic.

zh: 像萨达姆这样的独裁者要靠出售石油生存，而不会任其埋在地底。
en: Dictators like Saddam make their living by selling their oil, not by holding it in the ground.

zh: 不过，或许萨达姆太急于将石油开采权卖给法国、俄罗斯和意大利的公司，而不是英美的公司。
en: Perhaps, though, Saddam was too eager to sell oil concessions to French, Russian, and Italian companies rather than British and US companies.

zh: 不管怎样，伊拉克战争都不会保障未来50年全球的能源供应。
en: In any event, the war in Iraq will not protect the world’s energy supplies in 50 years.

zh: 这场战争如果有任何作用，那就是给其声称要打击的激进主义火上浇油，从而对能源供应造成威胁。
en: If anything, the war will threaten those supplies by stoking the very radicalism it claims to be fighting.

zh: 真正的能源安全不会通过侵略和占领中东实现，也不会通过在该地区扶植恭顺的政府得到，它需要我们认清某些更深层的全球能源问题。
en: Genuine energy security will come not by invading and occupying the Middle East, or by attempting to impose pliant governments in the region, but by recognizing certain deeper truths about global energy.

zh: 首先，能源战略必须满足三个目标：低成本、多供应源、以及二氧化碳排放的极大减少。
en: First, energy strategy must satisfy three objectives: low cost, diverse supply, and drastically reduced carbon dioxide emissions.

zh: 这需要对新技术和资源进行大规模的投资，而不是为了中东的石油“一战到底 ” 。
en: This will require massive investments in new technologies and resources, not a “fight to the finish” over Middle East oil.

zh: 重要的能源技术将包括煤的液化（如汽油 ） 、 油砂和油页岩的利用、以及非化石燃料能源的发展。
en: Important energy technologies will include conversion of coal to liquids (such as gasoline), use of tar sands and oil shale, and growth in non-fossil-fuel energy sources.

zh: 低成本的太阳能、零排放的煤基技术、以及安全可靠的核能具有极大的潜力。
en: Indeed, there is excellent potential for low-cost solar power, zero-emitting coal-based technologies, and safe and reliable nuclear power.

zh: 太阳辐射约等于人类当前能源利用的1万倍。
en: Solar radiation equals roughly 10,000 times our current energy use.

zh: 我们目前对太阳能的利用非常基础 — — 食品生产、风能、水电、太阳能加热、太阳热能发电、太阳能电池板 — — 但是太阳能便宜、随处可见且无环境污染，大幅度提高对太阳能的利用的前景十分巨大。
en: We tap that solar power in many fundamental ways – food production, wind power, hydroelectric power, solar heating, solar-thermal electricity, solar panels – but the possibilities for greatly increased use of inexpensive, widely available, and environmentally friendly solar power are huge.

zh: 煤和太阳能一样，也是到处都有。
en: Coal, like solar energy, is widely available.

zh: 煤价已经很低，不过煤是固体而非液体，污染严重，是温室效应气体的排放源。
en: It is already inexpensive, but it is a solid rather than a liquid, a major pollutant, and a source of greenhouse gas emissions.

zh: 然而所有这些问题都可以解决，只要在研究和开发上投入必要的投资。
en: Yet all of these problems can be solved, especially if we make the needed investments in research and development.

zh: 气化煤可以消除危险的污染物，而且煤已经可以通过低成本的方式转化成汽油；一家南非公司已开始将这项技术大规模地引入中国。
en: Gasification of coal allows for the removal of dangerous pollutants, and coal can already be converted to gasoline at low cost; a South African company is beginning to bring that technology to China on a large scale.

zh: 聚变和裂变产生的核能是另一种大量、可靠、安全且无环境污染的初级能源。
en: Nuclear power, both fission-based and fusion-based, is yet another possibility for vast, reliable, secure, and environmentally safe primary energy.

zh: 这里同样存在技术障碍，不过看起来可以克服。
en: Here, too, there are technological obstacles, but they seem surmountable.

zh: 当然，此外还有重大的政治、制度以及安全方面的因素，所有这些问题都需要适当处理。
en: Of course, there are also major political, regulatory, and security considerations, all of which need to be addressed properly.

zh: 一个一门心思想要降低中东石油风险的政府选择了耗费数千亿 — — 甚至可能达到数万亿 — — 美元，推行并不成功的军事行动来解决问题，而这些问题本来可以并且应该通过相对低廉的成本、研发、管理和市场激励解决。
en: It is ironic that an administration fixated on the risks of Middle East oil has chosen to spend hundreds of billions—potentially trillions—of dollars to pursue unsuccessful military approaches to problems that can and should be solved at vastly lower cost, through R&D, regulation, and market incentives.

zh: 这真是极大的讽刺！ 看来，最严重的能源危机在于美国外交政策错误地将精力放在战争上，而不是放在科学发现和技术进步上。
en: The biggest energy crisis of all, it seems, involves the misdirected energy of a US foreign policy built on war rather than scientific discovery and technological progress.

zh: 摆脱石油“魔咒”
en: Escaping the Oil Curse

zh: 麻省剑桥 — — 利比亚人重获生机，在经历这么多事之后，终于感到自己成为命运的主人。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Libyans have a new lease on life, a feeling that, at long last, they are the masters of their own fate.

zh: 也许伊拉克人，在经历十年战争之后，也有同感。
en: Perhaps Iraqis, after a decade of warfare, feel the same way.

zh: 这两国都是产油国，其民众普遍期待这一天赐之宝能在社会重建过程中成为一个巨大优势。
en: Both countries are oil producers, and there is widespread expectation among their citizens that that wealth will be a big advantage in rebuilding their societies.

zh: 与此同时，非洲的加纳采出了该国有史以来的第一桶石油，乌干达也决心效法。
en: Meanwhile, in Africa, Ghana has begun pumping oil for the first time, and Uganda is about to do so as well.

zh: 说真的，从西非到蒙古，好多国家都财自天降，发现了石油和矿产。
en: Indeed, from West Africa to Mongolia, countries are experiencing windfalls from new discoveries of oil and mineral wealth.

zh: 石油和矿产价格在世界市场上达到了四年以来的历史高位，可谓喜上加喜。
en: Heightening the euphoria are the historic levels that oil and mineral prices have reached on world markets over the last four years.

zh: 很多国家都有过类似的经历，因为发现自然资源而喜出望外，最终却落得失望的下场，天赐良机白白浪费，国民的生活质量却没有大的改善。
en: Many countries have been in this position before, exhilarated by natural-resource bonanzas, only to see the boom end in disappointment and the opportunity squandered, with little payoff in terms of a better quality of life for their people.

zh: 但是，不论是利比亚还是加纳，今天的政治领袖们有一个优势，他们大都记得前车之鉴，都想知道如何才能避免臭名昭著的自然资源“魔咒 ” 。
en: But, whether in Libya or Ghana, political leaders today have an advantage: most are well aware of history, and want to know how to avoid the infamous natural-resource “curse.”

zh: 要开药房，就先得诊病。
en: To prescribe a cure, one must first diagnose the illness.

zh: 为什么盛产石油往往是魔咒而不是祝福？
en: Why do oil riches turn out to be a curse as often as they are a blessing?

zh: 经济学家辨识出自然资源出口国常常陷入的六个陷阱：商品价格波动、制造业挤出 、 “ 荷兰病 ” （ 某一出口行业的繁荣导致货币迅速升值，瓦解了其他出口行业的竞争力 ） 、 制度发展滞后、内战以及资源的过早耗竭（因为不够节约 ） 。
en: Economists have identified six pitfalls that can afflict natural-resource exporters: commodity-price volatility, crowding out of manufacturing, “Dutch disease” (a booming export industry causes rapid currency appreciation, which undermines other exporters’ competitiveness), inhibited institutional development, civil war, and excessively rapid resource depletion (with insufficient saving).

zh: 油价波动特别厉害，最近五年的过山车走势是一个很好的提醒。
en: Oil prices are especially volatile, as the large swings over the last five years remind us.

zh: 近期的石油大牛市很容易逆转成熊市，尤其是当全球经济活动减速。
en: The recent oil boom could easily turn to bust, especially if global economic activity slows.

zh: 波动性本身也是有成本的，它会导致经济无法有效地对价格信号做出反应。
en: Volatility itself is costly, leaving economies unable to respond effectively to price signals.

zh: 短期的商品牛市往往会从稚嫩的制造业和其他国际贸易品生产行业那里吸走工人、资本和土地。
en: Temporary commodity booms typically pull workers, capital, and land away from fledgling manufacturing sectors and production of other internationally traded goods.

zh: 这种资源再分配可能伤及长期的经济发展，因为那些受损的行业，往往蕴含着边做边学的机会，本来可以促进生产力的广泛提高。
en: This reallocation can damage long-term economic development if those sectors nurture learning by doing and fuel broader productivity gains.

zh: 问题不仅在于工人、资本和土地被吸进商品部门的畸形繁荣。
en: The problem is not just that workers, capital, and land are sucked into the booming commodity sector.

zh: 制造业失去的血液往往也会流向地产开发和其他非贸易品和服务部门。
en: They also are frequently lured away from manufacturing by booms in construction and other non-tradable goods and services.

zh: 这种模式还包括政府开支的过度扩张，导致公务员薪资膨胀，基础设施建设大干快上，一旦油价下跌，两者都将不可持续。
en: The pattern also includes an exuberant expansion of government spending, which can result in bloated public payrolls and large infrastructure projects, both of which are found to be unsustainable when oil prices fall.

zh: 如果制造业已被“空心化 ” ， 结果会更惨。
en: If the manufacturing sector has been “hollowed out” in the meantime, so much the worse.

zh: 就算油价上涨真能持久，还是有不少陷阱等着它们。
en: Even if an increase in oil prices turns out to be permanent, pitfalls abound.

zh: 可以轻易靠石油矿产资源供养自己的政府，往往难以发展出有利于经济增长的长期制度。
en: Governments that can finance themselves simply by retaining physical control over oil or mineral deposits often fail in the long run to develop institutions that are conducive to economic development.

zh: 此类国家往往演化出一个金字塔形的威权社会，人们唯一的动力就是争夺商品寻租的特权。
en: Such countries evolve a hierarchical authoritarian society in which the only incentive is to compete for privileged access to commodity rents.

zh: 在极端情况下，这种争夺演变为内战。
en: In the extreme case, this competition can take the form of civil war.

zh: 在没有丰富资源的国家，精英们反而没有什么办法，只能让经济分散发展，以便让人们有动力去工作和储蓄。
en: In a country without resource wealth, by contrast, elites have little alternative but to nurture a decentralized economy in which individuals have incentives to work and save.

zh: 那样的国家才会走上工业化道路。
en: These are the economies that industrialize.

zh: 最后一个陷阱是石油矿产资源过早的耗尽，违反节约原则，更说不上保护环境了。
en: The final pitfall is excessively rapid depletion of oil or mineral deposits, in violation of optimal rates of saving, let alone environmental preservation.

zh: 有关国家怎么做才能确保自然资源发挥好的作用而不是把自己毁掉呢？
en: What can countries do to ensure that natural resources are a blessing rather than a curse?

zh: 有一些政策和制度，经过实验证明失败。
en: Some policies and institutions have been tried and failed.

zh: 特别是试图人为抑制国际市场波动，搞价格控制、出口控制、市场联盟和卡特尔垄断等等。
en: These include, in particular, attempts to suppress artificially the fluctuations of the global marketplace by imposing price controls, export controls, marketing boards, and cartels.

zh: 但也有一些国家成功了，它们的成功经验可以作为利比亚、伊拉克、加纳、蒙古和其他国家效仿的有用模式。
en: But some countries have succeeded, and their strategies could be useful models for Libya, Iraq, Ghana, Mongolia, and others to emulate.

zh: 这些经验包括，像墨西哥那样利用石油期权市场对冲出口价格风险；像智利那样利用结构性财政管理维持财政政策的反周期性；像博茨瓦纳那样雇用专业经历运作主权财富基金等等。
en: These include: hedging export earnings – for example, via the oil options market, as Mexico does; ensuring counter-cyclical fiscal policy – for example, via a variant of Chile’s structural budget rule; and delegating sovereign wealth funds to professional managers, as Botswana’s Pula Fund does.

zh: 最后，还有一些很有前途的思路，还从未有人尝试过：发行以石油价格而非美元计价的债券，以预防价格风险；在货币政策上，以商品价格目标制代替通胀目标制或汇率目标制；对全体国民均分石油收入，确保其不会流入精英们的瑞士银行账户。
en: Finally, some promising ideas have virtually never been tried at all: denominating bonds in oil prices instead of dollars, to protect against the risk of a price decline; choosing commodity-price targeting as an alternative to inflation targeting or exchange-rate targeting for anchoring monetary policy; and distributing oil revenues on a nationwide per capita basis, to ensure that they do not wind up in elites’ Swiss bank accounts.

zh: 那些国家的领袖们有选择的自由。
en: Leaders have free will.

zh: 产油国不是注定要成为那��“魔咒”的牺牲品。
en: Oil exporters need not be prisoners of a curse that has befallen others.

zh: 那些国家可以利用其自然资源为其国民谋求长期的经济改善，而不是仅仅为了领袖个人或者家族。
en: Countries can choose to use their resource bonanzas for the long-term economic advancement of their people, not just that of their leaders.

zh: 从CIA到GFE
en: From the CIA to the GFE

zh: 纽约—美国需要把支出从战争转移到教育上，从中央情报局（CIA）支持的颠覆政权活动转移到新的全球教育基金（GFE）上。
en: NEW YORK – The United States needs to shift its spending from war to education, from CIA-backed regime change to a new Global Fund for Education (GFE).

zh: 全世界有数亿儿童无学可上，或在教师质量低下、缺少计算机、班级规模庞大和没有电的学校上学，全世界许多地方因此正在走向大规模动荡、失业和贫困。
en: With hundreds of millions of children around the world not in school, or in schools with under-qualified teachers, a lack of computers, large class sizes, and no electricity, many parts of the world are headed for massive instability, joblessness, and poverty.

zh: 二十一世纪属于能让年轻人获得合理教育从而能够参与全球经济生产的国家。
en: The twenty-first century will belong to countries that properly educate their young people to participate productively in the global economy.

zh: 目前，美国在全球教育和军事相关项目上的开支非常不平衡：前者每年要花10亿美元，后者则高达9,000亿美元。
en: The current imbalance in US spending on global education and military-related programs is staggering: $1 billion per year on the former, and roughly $900 billion on the latter.

zh: 军事相关项目包括国防部（大约6,000亿美元 ） 、 CIA及相关机构（大约600亿美元 ） 、 国土安全部（大约500亿美元 ） 、 不由国防部负责的核武器系统（大约300亿美元）以及老兵项目（大约1,600亿美元 ） 。
en: Military-related programs include the Pentagon (around $600 billion), the CIA and related agencies (around $60 billion), Homeland Security (around $50 billion), nuclear weapons systems outside of the Pentagon (around $30 billion), and veterans’ programs (around $160 billion).

zh: 美国政客和决策者的思维一定不正常，否则他们绝不会认为900比1的军事-全球教育支出比有利于美国国家安全。
en: What US politicians and policymakers in their right minds could believe that US national security is properly pursued through a 900-to-1 ratio of military spending to global education spending?

zh: 当然，美国在这方面不是“孤家寡人 ” 。
en: Of course, the US is not alone.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯、伊朗和以色列都在耗费巨资加速中东军备竞赛，而美国是主要金主和军备供应者。
en: Saudi Arabia, Iran, and Israel are all squandering vast sums in an accelerating Middle East arms race, in which the US is the major financier and arms supplier.

zh: 中国和俄罗斯也在迅速增加军事支出，尽管它们还面临紧迫的国内要务。
en: China and Russia are also sharply boosting military spending, despite their pressing domestic priorities.

zh: 看上去列强之间正在进行一场新的军备竞赛，而此时此刻真正需要的是教育和可持续发展的和平竞赛。
en: We are, it seems, courting a new arms race among major powers, at a time when what is really needed is a peaceful race to education and sustainable development.

zh: 一些最新国际报告，包括本月两份由英国前首相戈登·布朗主持的联合国教科文组织和全球教育融资国际委员会的报告，表明每年用于小学和中学教育的全球发展援助必须从大约40亿美元增加到大约400亿美元。
en: Several recent international reports, including two this month by UNESCO and the International Commission on Financing Global Education, headed by former UK Prime Minister Gordon Brown, show that annual global development assistance for primary and secondary education needs to rise from around $4 billion to around $40 billion.

zh: 惟其如此，穷国才能实现全民小学和中学教育（这也是新的可持续发展目标中的第四个目标 ） 。
en: Only this ten-fold increase can enable poor countries to achieve universal primary and secondary education (as called for by Goal Four of the new Sustainable Development Goals).

zh: 作为回应，美国和其他发达国家应该将今年的剩余时光用于成立GFE，将今天用于军事支出的钱拿来为GFE提供资金。
en: In response, the US and other rich countries should move this year to create the GFE, with the needed funds shifted from today’s military spending.

zh: 如果有望成为下任美国总统的希拉里·克林顿真的相信和平和可持续发展，那么她应该宣布准备支持成立GFE，正如2001年小布什总统成为第一个支持新提出的遏制艾滋病、结核病和疟疾全球基金的国家元首。
en: If Hillary Clinton, the likely next US president, genuinely believes in peace and sustainable development, she should announce her intention to back the GFE’s creation, just as President George W. Bush in 2001 was the first head of state to endorse the newly proposed Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria.

zh: 她应该呼吁中国和其他国家加入这一多边行动。
en: She should call on China and others to join this multilateral effort.

zh: 否则 — — 继续花费巨资用于防务而不是全球教育 — — 美国将沦为悲剧地沉迷于数百个海外军事基地、数十亿美元年度军备销售以及永久性战争的衰落的帝国。
en: The alternative – to continue spending massively on defense rather than on global education – would condemn the US to the status of a declining imperial state tragically addicted to hundreds of overseas military bases, tens of billions of dollars in annual arms sales, and perpetual wars.

zh: 没有GFE，穷国就无法得到足够资源教育它们的孩子，一如如果遏制艾滋病、结核病和疟疾全球基金没有成立，它们也无法拿出钱来治理这些疾病。
en: Without a GFE, poor countries will lack the resources to educate their kids, just as they were unable to finance the fight against AIDS, TB, and malaria until the Global Fund was established.

zh: 这里存在一个基本预算挑战：穷国为一名儿童提供一年教育至少需要250美元，但低收入国家平均只能负担每人每年90美元左右。
en: Here’s the basic budgetary challenge: it costs at least $250 in a poor country to educate a child for a year, but low-income countries can afford, on average, only around $90 per child per year.

zh: 2.4亿名学龄儿童每人每年存在160美元缺口，总数高达400亿美元左右。
en: There is a gap of $160 per child for around 240 million school-aged kids in need, or about $40 billion per year.

zh: 基础教育资金不足的后果是悲剧性的。
en: The consequences of underfunded education are tragic.

zh: 儿童过早离开学校，常常还没有掌握基本读写技能。
en: Kids leave school early, often without being able to read or write at a basic level.

zh: 这些辍学者常常成为黑社会、毒贩甚至圣战者。
en: These dropouts often sign up with gangs, drug traffickers, even jihadists.

zh: 女孩很早就结婚生子。
en: Girls marry and begin to have children very young.

zh: 生育率居高不下，教育程度很低的贫穷母亲（和父亲）的孩子很难摆脱贫穷。
en: Fertility rates stay high and the children of these poor, under-educated mothers (and fathers) have few realistic prospects of escaping poverty.

zh: 不能通过优质学校教育创造体面工作岗位的代价是政治动荡、大量移民美国（从中美和加勒比地区）和欧洲（从中东和非洲）以及与贫穷、毒品、人贩和种族冲突有关的暴力。
en: The cost of failing to create decent jobs through decent schooling is political instability, mass migration to the US (from Central America and the Caribbean) and Europe (from the Middle East and Africa), and violence related to poverty, drugs, human trafficking, and ethnic conflict.

zh: 很快，美国无人机就将到来，加剧动荡。
en: Soon enough, the US drones arrive to exacerbate the underlying instability.

zh: 简言之，我们需要从CIA转向GFE，从代价高昂的美国领导的政权颠覆行动（包括以阿富汗塔利班、伊拉克的萨达姆·侯赛因、利比亚的卡扎菲和叙利亚的巴沙尔·阿萨德为目标的行动）转向健康、教育和体面工作岗位投资。
en: In short, we need to shift from the CIA to the GFE, from the expensive failures of US-led regime change (including those targeting Afghanistan’s Taliban, Iraq’s Saddam Hussein, Libya’s Muammar el-Qaddafi, and Syria’s Bashar al-Assad) to investments in health, education, and decent jobs.

zh: 一些援助批评者认为，为教育而投入的资金根本就是浪费。
en: Some critics of aid argue that funds for education will simply be wasted.

zh: 但2000年我提出加大公共卫生资金投入时批评者也是这么说疾病控制的。
en: Yet the critics said exactly the same about disease control in 2000 when I proposed a scale-up of funding for public health.

zh: 十六年后，情况是这样的：疾病负担显著下降，全球基金证明是巨大的成功（出资人现在也同意这一点，并在最近追加了投入 ） 。
en: Sixteen years later, the results are in: disease burdens have fallen sharply, and the Global Fund proved to be a great success (the donors now think so, too, and have recently replenished its accounts).

zh: 要在教育方面也成立一个全球基金，首先美国和其他国家要将各自的援助组成一个新的基金。
en: To establish a successful counterpart for education, first the US and other countries would pool their assistance into a single new fund.

zh: 接着，该基金邀请低收入国家递交支持方案。
en: The fund would then invite low-income countries to submit proposals for support.

zh: 方案由一个非政治的技术评估小组进行评估，并建议哪些方案应该得到资金支持。
en: A technical and non-political review panel would assess the proposals and recommend those that should be funded.

zh: 被批准的方案将获得支持，并由GFE实施监督和评估，以使表现出色的政府获得可靠治理的记录和名声。
en: Approved proposals would then receive support, with the GFE monitoring and evaluating implementation, enabling well-performing governments to build track records and reputations for sound management.

zh: 2000年以来，美国和其他国家在战争和军购上豪掷数万亿美元。
en: Since 2000, the US and other countries have squandered trillions of dollars on wars and arms purchases.

zh: 现在，它们应该采取明智、人道、专业的新方针，扩大教育投资，同时缩减战争、政变和军备支出。
en: The time has come for a sensible, humane, and professional new approach that would scale up investment in education while scaling back expenditures on wars, coups, and weaponry.

zh: 教育全世界年轻人是全球可持续发展最可靠的道路 — — 事实上，也是唯一的道路。
en: The education of the world’s youth offers the surest path – indeed, the only path – to global sustainable development.

zh: 健康的抗脆弱性
en: The Anti-Fragility of Health

zh: 纽约 — — 因写作《黑天鹅》而广为人知的纳西姆·尼古拉斯·塔勒布又写了一本精彩的新书，书名叫抗脆弱性：从混乱中受益。
en: NEW YORK – Nassim Nicholas Taleb, perhaps best known as the author of The Black Swan, has written a wonderful new book called Antifragile: Things That Gain from Disorder.

zh: 按照塔勒布的说法，多数生命体都具有抗脆弱性 — — 它们不仅不会被彻底打垮，反而在压力下愈加繁荣。
en: According to Taleb, things that are anti-fragile – mostly living things – not only resist being broken; they actually grow stronger under stress.

zh: 过度宠爱反而会变得脆弱。
en: When coddled too much, they grow weaker.

zh: 进化就是一种抗脆弱的进程。
en: Evolution is an anti-fragile process.

zh: 在真实的大千世界里，偶发的小型森林火灾烧毁灌木丛，从而降低重大大火灾的可能性。
en: In the broader physical world, occasional minor forest fires eliminate underbrush, reducing the risk of major conflagrations.

zh: 轻微地震可以释放地壳压力，防止大地震发生。
en: Small ground tremors can ease seismic tension and forestall big earthquakes.

zh: 同样，健康经济体具有抗脆弱性，其所要求的不仅是消灭贫穷。
en: Likewise, a healthy economy is anti-fragile, and requires more than just the absence of poverty.

zh: 强势经济中压力提高生产能力：短暂的经济衰退或小规模打击淘汰弱势参与者，以便人员和资金流向更有前途的企业和部门。
en: In a strong economy, stress improves productive capacity: a short recession or a minor shock gets rid of weaker players, so that employees and capital can shift to more promising companies and sectors.

zh: 同样的逻辑也适用于有组织暴力。
en: The same logic applies to organized violence.

zh: 用剧作家乔纳森·拉尔森的话说 ， “ 创造是战争的对立面。
en: To quote the playwright Jonathan Larson, “The opposite of war is creation.”

zh: ”非营利组织和平直通车的目标不仅是促进和平，而且还要进行包括积极合作和冲突解决在内的“和平建设 ” 。
en: The non-profit organization Peace Direct seeks to foster not just a state of peace, but an activity that it calls “peace-building” – active collaboration, conflict resolution, and the like.

zh: 健康的等价项是什么？
en: What are the equivalent terms for health?

zh: 多数字典把健康定义为“没有疾病。
en: Most dictionaries define health as the “absence of disease.”

zh: ”但如果这么说 ， “ 投资健康”的主张就没有那么令人信服。
en: But, in those terms, it is not a compelling proposition for people to “invest in health.”

zh: 你怎么能够投资虚无？
en: How can you invest in a vacuum?

zh: 当然，我们也投资医疗保健。
en: Of course, we do invest in health care.

zh: 但那有点类似投资维修汽车 — — 调配资源用来修复损伤，而不是提升安全技术或提升红绿灯亮度。
en: But that is like investing in auto repair – allocating resources to repairing damage, rather than to improving safety technology or brightening traffic lights.

zh: 只有当消极“健康”出现问题时我们才求助于医疗保健：比方说免疫系统被病原体攻克、暴饮暴食（垃圾食品 ） 、 酗酒、吸烟、消遣性毒品或者压力过大 — — 也许再加上睡眠不足和缺乏运动 — — 损害了身体的正常机能。
en: Health care is what we wield when inactive “health” has failed to keep us healthy: the immune system has been overcome by a pathogen, or too much (bad) food, alcohol, smoking, recreational drugs, or stress – perhaps compounded by too little sleep and exercise – have compromised the body’s normal operation.

zh: 即便我们运气太差患有无可避免的遗传疾病，这种疾病发生在原本健康的人身上也更容易治疗。
en: Even if we are unlucky and suffer from a genetic condition that cannot be prevented, it often will still be easier to address in an otherwise healthy person.

zh: 健康本身其实是承受压力并积极响应的能力 — — 也就是抗脆弱性表现在特定环境当中。
en: Health itself is the capacity to undergo stress and react positively to it – anti-fragility in a specific context.

zh: 比方说，如果不接触传染性病原体，人类免疫系统也许永远学不会如何抵御入侵者，甚至可能像自体免疫疾病那样损害自身健康。
en: For example, without exposure to infectious agents, the human immune system will never learn how to ward off invaders and may even turn inward, as in auto-immune diseases.

zh: 肌肉需要锻炼（和承受压力）才能变得强健。
en: Muscles need to work (and be stressed) to grow strong.

zh: 饥饿带来的不适感促使我们摄入食物。
en: The discomfort of hunger impels us to eat.

zh: 起初就像将“构思方案”或“合法干预 ” （ 被警方开枪射杀）列为死亡原因一样，制造健康的理念听上去显得有些浮夸。
en: At first, the notion of producing health sounds a bit pompous, like “ideating solutions” or listing “legal intervention” (by a policeman’s bullet) as a cause of death.

zh: 但这一理念确实值得我们宣传和探讨。
en: But it is a concept worth exploring and promoting.

zh: 首先，制造健康指的是某种活动，而不是某种状态。
en: First of all, producing health connotes an activity, not a state.

zh: 你无法简单地避免生病；你必须采取行动促进必要能力的创造。
en: You cannot simply avoid disease; you have to do something to promote creation of the desired capacity.

zh: 像教育一样，我们最终需要相关个体积极参与健康。
en: Like education, health ultimately demands the active participation of the individuals involved.

zh: 制造健康需要投资 — — 投资于有营养的食物、愉快而无害的环境和激励人们付出努力并获得成就感的事业。
en: Producing health requires investment – in good food, in a pleasant and non-toxic environment, and in jobs that motivate people to work and feel productive.

zh: （而且也许还需要投资于让垃圾食品失去吸引力，提高营养食品便利性并降低其价格 — — 甚至为其提供补助。 ）
en: (And perhaps it requires investment in, say, making bad food unappealing, if only by making good food cheaper – or even subsidized – and more convenient.)

zh: 但制造健康还需要相关人等开展“投资合作”��—也就是让他们努力提升自己的“健康生产率 ” ， 就像企业需要激励员工提高生产率一样。
en: But producing health also requires “co-investment” by the people involved – that is, getting them to exert themselves to increase their “health productivity,” just as a company needs to motivate its workers to increase productivity.

zh: 而且，就像在企业中一样，内部报酬、挑战和比赛等往往比金钱的诱惑更为有效。
en: And, as in companies, intrinsic rewards, challenges, competitions, and the like are often more effective inducements than money.

zh: 总之，在神通广大的消费者可以在线订座的世界里，我们也需要被赋予权力的“健康制造者 ” 。
en: In short, in a world of empowered consumers who book their own seats online, we need empowered “health producers” as well.

zh: 当然，网上预订的好处相当直接，而健康制造的好处可能相对遥远（也不那么容易察觉 ） 。
en: Of course, the benefits of booking online are fairly immediate, while the benefits of health production may be more distant (and less tangible).

zh: 但至少我们正在研发更好的测量工具 — — 不仅包括移动端自我监测和游戏，而且很快就会实现无创式血液检查 — — 以降低健康管理的难度。
en: But at least we are developing better measurement tools – not just mobile self-monitors and games, but soon also non-invasive blood tests – to make that easier.

zh: 健康制造业的参与者不仅包括企业和雇主，而且还包括国家及地方政府、卫生系统、学校和建筑。
en: Players in the health-production business include not just companies and employers, but also national and local governments, health systems, schools, and buildings.

zh: 保持服务对象健康并逐步强化其抗脆弱能力与所有参与方的长远利益相符。
en: All of them have a long-term interest in the health of the people they serve and in building up their anti-fragile capacity.

zh: 但我承认仍然存在疑虑。
en: Yet I confess to doubt.

zh: 实际兑现承诺比凭空说说难度更大。
en: Getting the language right is easy compared to actually delivering on the promise.

zh: 将这种类比推而广之，过去几年来，雇主已经认识到好的环境有多重要 — — 包括舒适的座椅、简单易用的软件，以及更好的指导和更多有用的反馈。
en: To extend the analogies a little further, over the past few years, employers have discovered the importance of a good environment – everything from comfortable chairs and easier-to-use software to better coaching and more useful feedback.

zh: 好公司对待员工像对待志愿者，激励而不是操纵他们积极参与制造。
en: In good companies, employees are treated like volunteers and motivated, not manipulated, to produce heroically.

zh: 员工则喜爱自己的工作，加倍努力让经理满意，而且效率更高。
en: People enjoy their jobs, work harder to please their managers, and are more productive.

zh: 但我们知道还有很多地方没有运用这样的规则。
en: But there are lots of places – we all know them – where that knowledge just is not applied.

zh: 我想象不出健康制造业会有多大的不同。
en: I cannot imagine that it will be all that different with health production.

zh: 当事关健康制造时，几乎每个人都是志愿者。
en: When it comes to producing health, virtually everyone is a volunteer.

zh: （只有患病的人不属于志愿者。
en: (The sick people are the non-volunteers.)

zh: ）就像我们以某些企业为榜样一样，我们也会树立健康制造领域的榜样。
en: And, just as some companies are role models, so we will have health-production role models.

zh: 只要能确切理解他们的成功方法，我们就更有可能效仿他们的成功。
en: With the right language to understand what they are doing, we are more likely to be able to emulate them.

zh: 透明度挑战
en: The Transparency Challenge

zh: 纽约—现在我们美国人知道了。
en: NEW YORK – So now we Americans know.

zh: 我们知道了我们的政府不但监控外国人，也在监控我们。
en: We know that our government is spying not just on foreigners; it is also spying on us.

zh: 当然，关于政府“知道”你什么，大部分只有在某些人想了解你的更多东西时能接触这些信息时 — — 或者在你的数据与他们正在调查的某个模式相匹配时 — — 才会被“知道 ” 。
en: Of course, most of what the government “knows” about you is “known” only in the sense that someone could get at it if they wanted to find out more about you – or if your data matched some pattern that they were investigating.

zh: 因此，从某种程度说，政府所收集的数据是无害的 — — 我的意思是，在这些信息被用于真实世界目的（如将你列入禁飞名单或强迫网上所发帖子“惹麻烦”的你进局子）之前是无害的。
en: So, in a sense, the data that the government collects are harmless – that is, until such information is used for a real-world purpose, such as putting people on a no-fly list or forcing into an institution someone whose online posts are “troubling.”

zh: 而这只是开始。
en: And that is only the beginning.

zh: 就个人而言，我难以接受美国政府监控人民（特别是外国人）的说法，因为政府受公开的有强制力的规则约束。
en: Personally, I am reluctantly willing to accept the US government spying on people, especially foreigners, as long as it is constrained by rules that are public and enforced.

zh: “别人也这么做”的借口是蹩脚的，但也是事实。
en: The argument that “the other guys do it” is lame, but it is also true.

zh: 缺少世界政府阻止了权力滥用 — — 不管如何不完美，这迫使政府互相竞争（尽管它们往往勾搭成奸 ） 。
en: The absence of a world government deters abusive power – however imperfectly, it forces governments to compete (even though they often collude).

zh: 此外，在一个不完美的世界中，任何政府都有保护公民免受敌人伤害的责任。
en: And, in an imperfect world, part of each government’s job is to protect its citizens from enemies.
