zh: 言论自由和不受管制的媒体支撑这一信心的方式不是通过为体制歌功颂德，而是曝光其不足，然后用反应灵敏并以规则为基础的机制来纠正这些错误。
en: Freedom of expression and unfettered media bolster this confidence, not by highlighting the system’s strengths, but by exposing its weaknesses, which can subsequently be corrected through responsive, rule-based mechanisms.

zh: 由于美国政府必须要回应公民的呼声，它也不太可能寻求通胀借债融资的手段。
en: With the US government forced to answer to its citizens, it is unlikely to resort to inflationary debt financing.

zh: 事实上，大约4.5万亿的美国联邦债务都由本地投资者持有，包括退休人士、养老基金，金融机构和保险公司 — — 这些团体较大的政治影响力确保没有政府冒让通胀失控的风险。
en: In fact, about $4.5 trillion of US federal debt is held by domestic investors, including retirees, pension funds, financial institutions, and insurance companies – groups whose considerable political clout ensures that no administration would risk allowing inflation to spin out of control.

zh: 独立于行政和立法部门的美国司法系统进一步支撑着美元的国际角色。
en: The US legal system – independent from the executive and legislative branches of government – further supports the dollar’s global role.

zh: 虽然某些人会指摘美国法律规章的复杂性，但也无法否认它们是相对一致地得到了执行。
en: While one might quibble about the complexity of US laws and regulations, it cannot be said that they are not applied relatively consistently.

zh: 这就与中国的一党制体制形成了鲜明对比，后者的政府可信度也更为低下。
en: This contrasts sharply with China’s single-party system, in which the level of government accountability is much lower.

zh: 官员腐败现象是如此根深蒂固，以致习近平主席必须将反腐败运动当成核心目标来抓。
en: Official corruption, for example, has become so entrenched that President Xi Jinping has made an anti-graft campaign a central objective.

zh: 现实的情况是尽管中国经济体量巨大而且中央政府公共负债较低，外国投资者也不会把大笔钱放在中国。
en: The reality is that, despite China’s economic heft and low central-government public debt, foreign investors are unlikely to trust China with large sums of money.

zh: 资本流动 — — 虽然在近年来毫无疑问地不断增大 — — 主要是由投资者对分散投资和高回报所驱动，而非因为中国是一个其他问题市场的避风港，尤其考虑到中国金融市场的发展相对低下而且存在相当大的风险。
en: Capital inflows – which will undoubtedly increase in the coming years – are driven largely by investors’ interest in diversification and high yield, rather than the country’s image as a refuge from troubled financial markets elsewhere, especially given that China’s financial markets are relatively underdeveloped and beset by considerable risks.

zh: 当然，一些外国央行已经与中国签订了货币互换协议并在自身的储备项目表中持有少量的人民币。
en: Of course, some foreign central banks have signed currency-swap agreements with China and even hold small amounts of its currency in their reserve portfolios.

zh: 但这些行动与其说是代表了人民币向国际统治地位不可避免地推进，不如说是对其崛起成为一个广泛接受的国际货币可能性的低成本赌注。
en: But these actions may be less a sign of the renminbi’s inevitable march toward global dominance than a low-cost bet on its likely emergence as a widely accepted international currency.

zh: 而那些国家出于中国不断崛起的经济实力而与其维持良好关系的意愿也必须考虑在内。
en: And countries’ desire to maintain good relations with China, owing to its rising economic power, cannot be discounted.

zh: 人民币会在不远的未来成为一个重要的储备货币，但这取决于中国开放其资本账户和发展金融市场的进度。
en: Depending on how soon China opens up its capital account and develops its financial markets, the renminbi could become a significant reserve currency in the near future.

zh: 但除非中国领导人能将该国的政治和法律体系与其经济改革同时进行，否则人民币将无法挑战美元的统治地位。
en: But it will not contest the dollar’s supremacy unless China’s leaders align the country’s political and legal institutions with its economic reforms.

zh: 永远的香港
en: Eternal Hong Kong

zh: 我在香港做公务员已有30余年。
en: I have been a part of Hong Kong’s civil service for more than three decades.

zh: 在整个职业生涯中，与我共过事的人中，以服务香港为动力的大有人在。
en: Throughout my entire career I have worked with many people whose driving impulse has been to serve Hong Kong.

zh: 四十年前我初入政界时是如此，四十年后的今天也是如此。
en: That remains as true today as it did almost 40 years ago, when I first entered government.

zh: 过去几周是自1997年香港回归中国以来最重大的时刻之一。
en: The past couple of weeks have been among the most momentous periods since our reunification with China in 1997, and it has left me in the hot seat as Hong Kong’s Acting Chief Executive.

zh: 也就在这一期间，我坐上了香港代理特别行政长官这一让人坐立不安的位置，感受到的巨大责任难以用语言来描述。
en: It is not easy to describe the enormous level of responsibility I feel.

zh: 香港之所以与众不同，是因为我们有能力维护社会稳定，保证经济增长。
en: What sets Hong Kong apart is our ability to sustain social stability and economic growth.

zh: 我们能成功，关键之一就在于我们有种种制度来为发展提供支持与保障。
en: One key element of our success is the institutions that buttress our development.

zh: 其中包括我们立法、司法、行政分开的法律制度。
en: These include our legal system, which is underpinned by an independent judiciary, our legislature, and our civil service.

zh: 此三权独立运作，但又同为一体。
en: Each operates independently but is an integral part of the whole.

zh: 总之，我们的政府制度与大多数政府制度类似。
en: In short, ours is a system of government like many others.

zh: 但是，香港还有一些与众不同的特色。 如在“全球化”成为流行语之前很久，我们就已经紧密融入了世界市场，因此我们的政府非常善于放眼全球，具有很强的国际化思维。
en: However, Hong Kong has some distinguishing features, including a very internationally minded and outward-looking government, owing to our close integration into world markets long before globalization became a catchphrase.

zh: 我们的行政人员和司法人员里有不少来自不同国家的外籍人士，如英国、澳大利亚、美国、加拿大和印度。
en: Within the ranks of our civil service and judiciary are nationals from Britain, Australia, the United States, Canada, and India.

zh: 此外，我们的终审法庭也汇聚了一些来自奉行普通法的国家的精英人士。
en: Moreover, our Court of Final Appeal calls on some of the most esteemed minds of the common-law world.

zh: 我们有大量的外籍人口，并拥有全球最大的领事使团。
en: We have a large foreign population and one of the world’s largest consular corps.

zh: 国际工商会在政府咨询方面发挥着重要的积极作用。
en: International chambers of commerce play a very active and vital role in government consultations.

zh: 我们的基本法甚至允许外籍人士通过选举，占有五分之一的议会席位。
en: Our Basic Law even allows for foreign nationals to be elected to one-fifth of the seats in our legislature.

zh: 香港的世界主义早就在我们执政方法里播下了宽容、尊重的种子。
en: Hong Kong’s cosmopolitanism long ago planted the seeds of tolerance and respect in our approach to government.

zh: 其结果是，我们一直致力于以对话和妥协来平衡公共事务里比比皆是的不同要求和观点，并视之为唯一途径。
en: As a result, we are committed to dialogue and compromise as the only way to balance the many competing demands and opinions that pervade public affairs.

zh: 善政并非竞争，与输赢无关，也与谁的观点、意志取胜无关。
en: Good government is not a competition. It’s not about winning or losing, or whose view or will prevails.

zh: 善政就是为整个社会做出最佳决定。
en: It is about making the best decisions for the community as a whole.

zh: 如此一来，在很多时候，妥协便不可避免。
en: Inevitably, this will often involve compromise.

zh: 事实上，随着香港社会的日益成熟，香港也变得更为复杂，社会更为多元，也更具多样性。
en: Indeed, as Hong Kong’s society has grown more sophisticated, it has also become more complex, multi-faceted, and pluralistic.

zh: 这就意味着政府不能再孤立地看待问题。 政府运作需要精简增效、扫平障碍，并消除分工太过琐细的情况。
en: This means that government can no longer afford to view issues in isolation; its operations need to be de-compartmentalized and flattened, as well as streamlined.

zh: 这一任务相当艰巨，因为我们的一些制度已经存在了多年，且多有法律保证。
en: This is a difficult task, given that some of our systems have been in place for many years, often entrenched in law.

zh: 当然，实用主义也有其局限性，因为善政也意味着坚持核心价值。
en: Of course, pragmatism has its limits, because good government is also about upholding core values.

zh: 我经常提到我称之为香港成功的四大支柱：法制、为商业活动提供的公平竞争环境，行政部门廉洁高效，信息流动畅通无阻。
en: I have often referred to what I call the four pillars of Hong Kong’s success: the rule of law, a level playing field for business, a clean and efficient civil service, and the free flow of information.

zh: 对于这些价值，我们决不会妥协。
en: These are values that we simply will not compromise.

zh: 这种妥协将标志着香港灭亡的开始。
en: To do so would mark the beginning of the end for Hong Kong.

zh: 回归祖国后，我们又多了基本法的保障。 基本法赋予了“一国两制”原则和“香港高度自治”原则法律效力。
en: Since reunification with our motherland, we have the added safeguard of the Basic Law, which gives effect to the principles of “one country, two systems” and “Hong Kong’s people running Hong Kong with a high degree of autonomy.”

zh: 善政还要求与公众分享政府对未来的展望，这是公共政策背后的目的和思路。
en: Good government also requires sharing a vision of the future – the purposes and thinking behind public policies – with the community.

zh: 我们对未来的展望是使香港发展成为亚洲的国际都会。
en: Our vision is to develop Hong Kong as Asia’s world city.

zh: 亚洲国际都会这一简短提法无所不包，涵盖了我们从事的各种公众事务和经济活动，包括了从国际贸易到艺术、文化、旅游业等的各个领域。
en: This is an all-encompassing brief, covering everything we do as a community and an economy in areas ranging from international trade to art, culture, and tourism.

zh: 基本法体现了我们对未来的这一展望，为香港未来50年的发展奠定了基础，并赋予了我们自由与力量，使我们能够自力更生地将香港建设成为亚洲的国际都会。
en: The Basic Law embodies this vision, laying the foundations for our development over a 50-year period and providing the freedom and the power for us to position ourselves as Asia’s world city – and to do it on our own.

zh: 同时，基本法还体现了中央政府对香港的大力支持。
en: At the same time, it also embodies the depth of the central government’s support for Hong Kong.

zh: 因此，基本法对管理好香港特别行政区至关重要。
en: It is thus crucial to the good governance of the Hong Kong Special Administration Region.

zh: 应该说，在很多领域，如金融服务、基础设施、通信技术、旅游业方面，我们香港都已经达到了自己的目标。
en: In many areas – financial services, infrastructure, communications technology, and tourism – I would say we have reached our goals for Hong Kong.

zh: 几乎每天我们都可以在地方报纸上读到有关香港作为亚洲国际都会方面的报道。
en: Hardly a day goes by when we don’t read something in the local press that refers to our status as Asia’s world city.

zh: 即使别人觉得我们还没有达到国际都会应具备的标准，我们也应该为人们对我们的高标准要求感到高兴，因为这样可以让我们一直保持高度警觉。
en: Even when people feel we have not lived up to the standards expected of a world city, we are glad to be held to a high benchmark, because it keeps us on our toes.

zh: 也许有人觉得这番话听起来不够真诚，但香港的官员们都肩负着一个同样的任务：维护香港的繁荣与稳定。
en: That may sound disingenuous to some, but Hong Kong’s officials share a common mission to maintain the stability and prosperity of our city.

zh: 我们的职责是为了我们大家，把香港建设得更加美好。 在这里，没有隐秘动机，没有钱权交易。
en: Our duty is to make Hong Kong a better place for us all, without hidden agendas or quid pro quos.

zh: 这是一个繁重而庄严的任务，可能今天令你振奋激动，明天又让你灰心丧气。
en: It is an onerous and solemn undertaking, uplifting one day and extremely frustrating the next.

zh: 但是，最重要的是，能够在社会里扮演这样一个角色是我们的荣幸。 我知道绝大多数曾与我共事的政府官员、议员、法官和公务员都会同意这一看法。
en: But, above all, it is an honor and a privilege to play such a role in our society, and I know that the vast majority of officials, legislators, judges, and civil servants with whom I’ve worked would agree.

zh: 改掉STEM课程大纲
en: Hacking the STEM Syllabus

zh: 旧金山—在经过漫长的数字经济蜜月后，近几年来，互联网、社交媒体和“科技巨头”的黑暗面逐渐暴露。
en: SAN FRANCISCO – After a prolonged honeymoon for the digital economy, the dark side of the Internet, social media, and “Big Tech” has become increasingly apparent in recent years.

zh: 在线对商业有利，而对个人或社会则未必。
en: Online, what is good for business is not necessarily good for individuals or societies.

zh: 科技巨头平台让操纵民意、散播仇恨和煽动暴力变得容易。
en: Big Tech platforms make it easy to manipulate opinion, spew hate, and incite violence.

zh: 我们曾经天真地以为，全民上网将势不可挡地带来信息民主化；如今，我们担心危害全民的“上瘾经济 ” 。
en: We once naively believed that mass access to the World Wide Web would inevitably democratize information; today, we worry about the emergence of an “addiction economy” that is bad for everyone.

zh: 怎样才能支持更加人道、道德和有效的技术？
en: What can be done to support more humane, ethical, and effective technology?

zh: 系统性地解决这个问题的一个重要办法是改革所谓的STEM学科的教育，即科学、技术、工程和数学。
en: One important way to address this problem in a systemic way is by reforming education in the so-called STEM disciplines: science, technology, engineering, and math.

zh: 全世界的决策者已在关注如何增加STEM毕业生数量和STEM学生的多样性。
en: Policymakers worldwide are already focusing on increasing the number of STEM graduates and the diversity of STEM students.

zh: 但我们还应该扩大STEM教育的范围，以确保学生学会评估和应对他们的工作所带来的社会、经济和政治后果。
en: But we should also expand the scope of STEM education, to ensure that students learn to evaluate and respond to the social, economic, and political consequences of their work.

zh: 这并不意味着在STEM课程表中加入已有的人文或社会科学课程。
en: This does not mean adding existing humanities or social sciences courses to a STEM curriculum.

zh: 相反，这要求制定全新的课程表，让下一代技术人员、工程师、科学家和数学家打下形式基础 — — 包括共同的用语和知识框架 — — 来考虑他们的行为对社会所产生的宏观影响。
en: Rather, it will require the development of an entirely new curriculum that gives the next generation of technologists, engineers, scientists, and mathematicians the formal foundations – including shared vocabulary and intellectual frameworks – for considering the macro effects of their actions on society.

zh: 如果没有这样一套框架，创新的憧憬和人类体验的现实之间的差距将越来越大。
en: Without such a framework, the gap between the promise of innovation and the reality of human experience will only grow.

zh: 幸运的是，这场教育革命的种子已经开始发芽。
en: Fortunately, the seeds of this educational revolution are already sprouting.

zh: 一些大学在STEM课程表中加入了伦理内容。
en: Some universities are adding ethics classes to the STEM curriculum.

zh: 以工科著称的斯坦福大学最近增加了《伦理、公共政策和科技变迁》和《计算机、伦理学和公共政策》等主题课程。
en: Stanford University, with its deep links to the tech industry, has recently added courses with topics like “Ethics, Public Policy, and Technological Change” and “Computers, Ethics, and Public Policy.”

zh: 斯坦福最近还启动了新的以人为本的人工智能计划（Human-Centered AI Initiative ） ， 该计划认为“人工智能的发展应该与不间断的对其对人类社会的研究并行前进，并接受后者的指导。
en: Stanford has also recently launched a new Human-Centered AI Initiative, which recognizes that “the development of AI should be paired with an ongoing study of its impact on human society, and guided accordingly.”

zh: ”去年，康奈尔大学启动了米尔斯坦科技和人文计划（Milstein Program in Technology and Humanity ） 。
en: Last year, Cornell launched the Milstein Program in Technology and Humanity.

zh: 这些初步计划可以为新课程表和方法提供重要的试验场。
en: These early initiatives can serve as important testing grounds for new curricula and methods.

zh: 但只有等到STEM计划能够向学生提供对自己的工作的人文影响进行可信评估所需要的工具时，才可能产生真正的变化。
en: But the real change will come only when all STEM programs provide students with the tools they need to carry out a credible assessment of their work’s effects on humanity.

zh: 当然，如果我们不知道最有效的工具到底是什么，这些变化就毫无意义。
en: Of course, such changes will mean little if we do not know what the most effective tools actually are.

zh: 因此，不断地进行试验也非常重要。
en: That is why continued experimentation is also essential.

zh: 科罗拉多大学波尔德分校（University of Colorado, Boulder）的凯西·费斯勒（Casey Fiesler）正在探索这一试验方法，他将以科技伦理为主题的课程大纲进行众包。
en: Casey Fiesler of the University of Colorado, Boulder, is pursuing just such experimentation by crowd-sourcing syllabi focused on tech ethics.

zh: 不断扩大的在线数据库已经包含了世界各地大学的200多项不同课程大纲。
en: The growing online database already contains more than 200 different syllabi from universities around the world.

zh: 但这些课程中只有四分之一是由计算机科学教员讲授。
en: Yet only one-quarter of these courses are taught by computer science faculty.

zh: 剩余部分为法律、哲学、通讯等院系的课程，这意味着它们并非为STEM相关院校量身定制。
en: The rest are taught in departments such as law, philosophy, and communications, which means that they are not being tailored to STEM-related challenges.

zh: 更为根本性的是，这些单独设置的课程并不理想。
en: More fundamentally, such standalone courses are not ideal.

zh: 费斯勒本人也同意的更好的方针应该集中关注将伦理学与STEM领域的“日常实践”相整合。
en: A better approach, as Fiesler herself agrees, would focus on integrating ethics into “everyday practice” in the STEM fields.

zh: （费斯勒希望她的数据库能够帮助教员在各自的大学中实现这一点。 ）
en: (Fiesler hopes that her database will help faculty make this case to their universities.)

zh: 这也是负责任的计算机科学任务（Responsible CS Challenge）项目的目标。
en: This is the goal of the Responsible CS Challenge, launched last month by Omidyar Network, Schmidt Futures, Craig Newmark Philanthropies, and Mozilla.

zh: 该项目在上个月由Omidyar Network公司、Schmidt Futures公司、Craig Newmark慈善基金会和Mozilla公司发起。 这项为期两年的任务将鼓励美国计算机科学教授在本科课程中加入伦理学内容，以便STEM学生更加深刻地理解技术如何影响人文。
en: The two-year challenge should encourage computer science professors in the United States to integrate ethics into their undergraduate curriculum, so that STEM students can gain a deeper understanding of how technology affects humanity.

zh: 这是一个良好的开端，但还远远不够。
en: This is a good first step, but much more must be done.

zh: 首先，开始关注伦理学固然很有意义但经济学、心理学和其他众多所谓的人文科学也需要进行类似的探索。
en: For one thing, while the initial focus on ethics makes sense, similar explorations will be needed in a wide variety of disciplines such as economics, psychology, and many more of the so-called humanities.

zh: 扩大STEM教育，将这些更加宽泛的考量也纳入进来，这应该成为更加全面的长期战略的基础，保证技术以基本积极的性质服务于社会。
en: Expanding STEM education to include such broader considerations would serve as a cornerstone of a more comprehensive long-term strategy to ensure that technology serves society in overwhelmingly positive ways.

zh: 这套战略还必须包括（比如）商业模式、激励、创新战略和监管机制方面的变化 — — 而实现这些变化的，应该是那些受过的教育让他们做好了纠正他们的工作给我们所有人所带来的影响的准备人。
en: That strategy must also include changes, say, to business models, incentives, innovation strategies, and regulatory regimes – changes that should be pursued by people whose education has prepared them to address the effects of their work on the rest of us.

zh: 奥巴马和伦理
en: Ethics and Obama

zh: 蒂宾根－许多人说世界金融危机是不可能预知的。
en: TUBINGEN – Many say that the world financial crisis could not have been foreseen.

zh: 或许金融家和经济学家不能预知这次金融危机，但是，其他那些关注市场发展的人 — — 通常带着惊慌 — — 就不仅仅只是担忧了。
en: Perhaps not by financiers and economists, but others who were watching how markets were developing – often with dismay – were more than worried.

zh: 早在1997年，我就在我的作品《全球政治和经济的全球伦理》中，发出了对1929－1933年式的经济秩序崩溃再现的警告 ： “ 例如，美联储主席阿兰·格林斯潘在1996年12月月初的 ‘非理性繁荣’已经导致金融市场高估这样最轻微的评论，就足以使亚洲、欧洲和美国处于高位的股票市场高度紧张的投资者陷入恐慌性抛售。
en: As early as 1997, I warned about a repeat of the collapsed economic order of 1929-1933 in my book A Global Ethic for Global Politics and Global Economics : “The slightest remark, for example by the President of the American Federal Bank, Alan Greenspan, at the beginning of December 1996, that an “irrational exuberance” had led to an overvaluation of the financial markets was enough to drive the nervous investors on the high-flying stock markets of Asia, Europe and America into a spin, and panic selling.

zh: 这也显示了全球化危机不是一个先验平衡，而是或许变得日益糟糕了。 ”
en: This also shows that crises in globalization do not a priori balance out, but perhaps get progressively worse.”

zh: 那时，我已经大胆提出对经济学家来说是一个异端的假定：混沌理论应该被应用到经济学上；最小的原因都可能导致毁灭性的结果。
en: Back then, I was already venturing what is, for economists, a heretical presumption: that chaos theory should be applied to the economy; that devastating effects can follow from the smallest causes.

zh: 人们绝对不能排除“世界经济危机以及1929－1933年式的世界经济秩序崩溃的重演 ” 。
en: One could by no means rule out “a return of the world economic crisis and the collapse of the world economic order of 1929-1933.”

zh: 所以，我对最近几个月事件发展的速度和程度一点也不吃惊。 事实上，只有几个经济学家 — — 例如2001年诺贝尔经济学奖获得者约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz）和2008年诺贝尔经济学奖获得者保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman ） — —对现在在全球化的经济中上升的致命发展状况发出了警告。
en: So I was not at all surprised by the speed and dimension of events in recent months.  Indeed, only a few economists – such as the 2001 Nobel economics laureate Joseph Stiglitz and the 2008 laureate Paul Krugman – warned against fatal developments that were mounting in the now globalized economy.

zh: 和经济专家的许多预测相反，危机并不仅仅限于金融部门。 相反，它对实体经济产生了巨大的冲击 — — 对汽车业和化工行业的打击尤其大。
en: Contrary to many predictions by economic experts, the crisis has not been limited to the financial sector.  Instead, it is generating a massive impact on the real economy – hitting the automobile and chemical industries especially hard.

zh: 和1929年形成对比的是，信贷现在还没有被停滞；相反，公共资金正在被注入银行和经济。
en: In contrast to 1929, credits are not now being throttled; on the contrary, public money is being pumped into banks and the economy.

zh: 但是，只有不是用孤立和民粹化的方式来采取这些措施，它们才能成功。
en: But these measures will be successful only if they are not taken in an isolated and populist way.

zh: 而且，这些措施需要成为一个结合了包括减轻个人金融负担内容的负责任的国家干预和节约公共预算的有说服力的全面方案的一部分。
en: Instead, they need to be part of a convincing overall plan that combines responsible state intervention with relief of the financial burdens of individual citizens, as well as savings in public budgets.

zh: 无法预见的国家债务 — — 是以后代为代价的 — — 是一个既不可行也不道德的解决办法。
en: Unforeseeable state debt – at the cost of coming generations – is neither a viable nor an ethical solution.

zh: 幸运的是，促使危机产生的一般思想状态有正在发生改变的迹象。
en: Fortunately, there are signs that the general state of mind that helped spawn the crisis is changing.

zh: 在富裕的工业化国家，在一个愤世嫉俗和短视的行为利润最大化时代之后，我们可能正处在一个谦逊和可持续的新时代的破晓之时。 公司都面临着行为要符合伦理的日益增大的压力，不道德的商业行为最终都要受到处罚。
en: In the rich industrialized countries, after an era of cynical and short-sighted profit-maximizing behavior, we may be at the dawn of a new age of modesty and sustainability.  Companies are facing growing pressure to behave ethically, and unethical business behavior is at last being punished.

zh: 2008年11月在美国的一个巡回演讲中，我能看出现在许多人都在抱怨商业上获得利润的巨大欲望以及政治上的狂妄自大。
en: On a lecture tour in the United States in November 2008, I could see that many people are now complaining about the overwhelming desire for profit in business and megalomania in politics.

zh: 当市场失灵时，对追求利润进行道德监管的呼吁，不仅在原则上是正当的，在事实上也是正当的。
en: As markets failed, calls for ethical regulation of the quest for profit has become justified not only in principle, but also in fact.

zh: 但是，伦理不是蛋糕上的糖衣；它不仅仅只是全球市场经济的一个偶然附加。
en: But ethics is not the icing on the cake; it is not merely an incidental addition to the global market economy.

zh: 相反，许多人呼吁并且急需的新金融结构，必须以道德架构作为支持。
en: Rather, the new financial architecture that many are calling for, and which is urgently needed, must be supported by an ethical framework.

zh: 人类致命的贪婪和狂妄本能只有一些基本的伦理准则才能驾驭。
en: The fatal human instincts of greed and hubris can be tamed only with some elementary ethical norms.

zh: 那么，这一道德架构应该包含什么呢？ 1993年在芝加哥举行的世界宗教会议上提出的《世界伦理宣言》中，有一段话的内容如下：
en: So what should this ethical framework entail?  A paragraph of the Declaration toward a Global Ethic of the Parliament of the World’s Religions in Chicago in 1993 reads as follows:

zh: “在人类伟大的古老宗教和伦理传统中，我们发现了如下的谕示： 人不应该偷窃！
en: “In the great ancient religious and ethical traditions of humankind we find the directive: You shall not steal!

zh: 或者用肯定语气表达的： 诚实公正地交易！
en: Or in positive terms: Deal honestly and fairly!

zh: 让我们重新反思这个古老谕示所得到的推论：任何人都无权用任何方式抢夺或霸占其它任何人的财产或公益。
en: Let us reflect anew on the consequences of this ancient directive: No one has the right to rob or dispossess in any way whatsoever any other person or the commonweal.

zh: 而且，任何人都无权在不考虑社会和地球的需要的情况下使用她或他的财产。
en: Further, no one has the right to use her or his possessions without concern for the needs of society and Earth.

zh: 要成为我们伟大宗教和伦理传统精神中真正的人，意味着如下的内容
en: To be authentically human in the spirit of our great religious and ethical traditions means the following:

zh: •  我们必须将经济和政治权力用于 服务人类 而不是将它们滥用在为争夺统治而进行的无情战争上。
en: • We must utilize economic and political power for service to humanity instead of misusing it in ruthless battles for domination.

zh: 我们必须发扬对那些遭受不幸的人的同情精神，对儿童、老人、穷人、残疾人、难民以及孤独的人进行特别的关怀；
en: We must develop a spirit of compassion with those who suffer, with special care for the children, the aged, the poor, the disabled, the refugees, and the lonely;

zh: •我们必须培养 互相尊重 和体谅，以达到一个合理的利益平衡，而不是仅仅考虑无约束的权力和无法避免的竞争；
en: • We must cultivate mutual respect and consideration, so as to reach a reasonable balance of interests, instead of thinking only of unlimited power and unavoidable competitive struggles;

zh: •我们必须珍视 温和和谦逊意识 而不是对金钱、声望和消费难以抑制的贪欲。
en: • We must value a sense of moderation and modesty instead of an unquenchable greed for money, prestige, and consumption.

zh: 在贪欲中，人们失去了他们的‘灵魂 ’ ， 他们的自由，他们的镇静，他们内心的平和并因而失去了那些使他们成为人的东西。 ”
en: In greed humans lose their ‘souls’, their freedom, their composure, their inner peace, and thus that which makes them human.”

zh: 全世界许多希望现在都指向了以对一个政治家来说非常高的道德主张开始总统任期的巴拉克·奥巴马总统，当然，奥巴马不是救世主；他不能创造奇迹。
en: Many hopes throughout the world are now directed toward President Barack Obama, who enters his presidency with a moral claim that is extraordinarily high for a politician. Of course, Obama is not the Messiah; he cannot work miracles.

zh: 但是，他处在为重建全球经济确定道德架构的重要地位之上。
en: But he is in a position to define an ethical framework for the rebuilding global economy.

zh: 考虑到奥巴马在国内和国际上面临沉重 — — 以及空前 — — 多的问题，他当然不可能实现所有的期望。
en: In view of the oppressive – and unprecedented – abundance of problems with which Obama is confronted at home and abroad, he will certainly not be able to fulfill all expectations.

zh: 我不应该对迄今为止所报道的奥巴马的世界经济计划进行评价。
en: I shall not pass judgment on his plans for the world economy as reported so far.

zh: 但是，他肯定已经认识到当前经济危机中的道德问题 ： “ 它实际上是我们的一个价值：我们只对财富赋予价值还是对创造财富的工作赋予价值？ ”
en: But it is certain that he has recognized the ethical dimension of the current economic crisis: “It amounts to one of values: do we assign a value only to wealth or the work which creates it?”

zh: 许多人正在忍受的不幸引起了变革的压力，奥巴马敏锐地将这些压力转变成为一种政治力量。
en: The suffering that so many people are enduring leads to pressure for reform, and Obama has shrewdly transformed these pressures into a political force.

zh: 所有这些都表明，现在比以前任何时候都急需对一个全球性的共同伦理价值进行反思了。
en: All this shows that reflection on common ethical values, a global ethic, is needed more urgently now than ever before.

zh: 有伦理的机器能给我们带来什么
en: The Promise of Ethical Machines

zh: 斯托尔斯，康涅狄格州—长期以来，人工智能（AI）的前景一直是伦理难题的来源。
en: STORRS, CONNECTICUT – The prospect of artificial intelligence (AI) has long been a source of knotty ethical questions.

zh: 但人们的关注焦点一直在我们创造者可以和应该如何使用先进的机器人。
en: But the focus has often been on how we, the creators, can and should use advanced robots.

zh: 而为机器本身制订一套伦理的需要一直没有得到讨论，同样被遗漏的还有在出现伦理两难时机器如何解决的问题。
en: What is missing from the discussion is the need to develop a set of ethics for the machines themselves, together with a means for machines to resolve ethical dilemmas as they arise.

zh: 只有这两点得到了充分考虑，智能机器才能自主运行，在完成任务的同时做出伦理选择而不需要人类干预。
en: Only then can intelligent machines function autonomously, making ethical choices as they fulfill their tasks, without human intervention.

zh: 有很多活动我们都乐于完全转交给自动运行的机器。
en: There are many activities that we would like to be able to turn over entirely to autonomously functioning machines.

zh: 机器人可以从事非常危险或令人非常不快的工作。
en: Robots can do jobs that are highly dangerous or exceedingly unpleasant.

zh: 它们可以填补劳动力市场空缺。
en: They can fill gaps in the labor market.

zh: 它们也可以完成冗长乏味或细节导向性任务 — — 比起人类，这些任务更适合机器人。
en: And they can perform extremely repetitive or detail-oriented tasks – which are better suited to robots than humans.

zh: 但没人能完全放心让机器在没有伦理框架指导的情况下独立行动。
en: But no one would be comfortable with machines acting independently, with no ethical framework to guide them.

zh: （多年来，好莱坞在强调这些风险方面做出了非常漂亮的工作。
en: (Hollywood has done a pretty good job of highlighting those risks over the years.)

zh: ）正因如此，我们需要训练机器人识别和权衡给定状况的伦理相关的方面（比如表明潜在收益或对人的伤害的方面 ） 。
en: That is why we need to train robots to identify and weigh a given situation’s ethically relevant features (for example, those that indicate potential benefits or harm to a person).

zh: 我们需要向它们灌输合理行动（从而实现收益最大化和伤害最小化）的责任。
en: And we need to instill in them the duty to act appropriately (to maximize benefits and minimize harm).

zh: 当然，在现实生活中，可能会出现多重伦理相关方面和相应的责任 — — 并且彼此之间可能互相冲突。
en: Of course, in a real-life situation, there may be several ethically relevant features and corresponding duties – and they may conflict with one another.

zh: 因此，对机器人而言，每项责任都必须放在周边环境中比较和考虑：重要，但不绝对。
en: So, for the robot, each duty would have to be relativized and considered in context: important, but not absolute.

zh: 表面上至关重要的责任可能 — — 特别是在特定的环境中 — — 被另一项责任所否定。
en: A duty that prima facie was vital could, in particular circumstances, be superseded by another duty.

zh: 做出这些判断的关键是在机器开始工作前就向它们灌输的至高无上的伦理原则。
en: The key to making these judgment calls would be overriding ethical principles that had been instilled in the machine before it went to work.

zh: 有了这一批判性视角，机器可以正确地处理意料之外的情况，甚至能够论证它们的决定。
en: Armed with that critical perspective, machines could handle unanticipated situations correctly, and even be able to justify their decision.

zh: 机器需要什么原则在某程度上取决于它被如何部署。
en: Which principles a machine requires would depend, to some extent, on how it is deployed.

zh: 比如，搜救机器人的责任是拯救尽可能多的生命，在完成这一责任时，它们需要明白如何根据有多少受害者可能位于某个区域或有多少存货可能等问题排定优先顺序。
en: For example, a search and rescue robot, in fulfilling its duty of saving the most lives possible, would need to understand how to prioritize, based on questions like how many victims might be located in a particular area or how likely they are to survive.

zh: 这些考虑不适用于看护老人机器人。
en: These concerns don’t apply to an eldercare robot with one person to look after.

zh: 看护老人机器人必须设定必须尊重主人的自主权。
en: Such a machine would instead have to be equipped to respect the autonomy of its charge, among other things.

zh: 只有在伦理学家就什么是可接受的行为形成了一致的领域，我们才能允许机器自主运行。
en: We should permit machines to function autonomously only in areas where there is agreement among ethicists about what constitutes acceptable behavior.

zh: 否则，允许任何机器自主运行都有可能让我们反受其害。
en: Otherwise, we risk a backlash against allowing any machine to function autonomously.

zh: 但伦理学家不应该是“独行侠 ” 。
en: But ethicists would not be working alone.

zh: 相反，制定及其伦理需要基于伦理学家和AI专家对话的多学科交叉研究。
en: On the contrary, developing machine ethics will require research that is interdisciplinary in nature, based on a dialogue between ethicists and AI specialists.

zh: 要想获得成功，双方都必须尊重对方的专业性 — — 以及需求。
en: To be successful, both sides must appreciate the expertise – and the needs – of the other.

zh: AI研究者必须认识到伦理是哲学的一个研究历史悠久的分支；伦理学之所涉远远超乎外部人士的直觉。
en: AI researchers must recognize that ethics is a long-studied field within philosophy; it goes far beyond laypersons’ intuitions.

zh: 伦理行为不但包括克制不去做某些事情，也包括做某些事情从而让事物进入理想状态。
en: Ethical behavior involves not only refraining from doing certain things, but also doing certain things to bring about ideal states of affairs.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，关于机器行为的伦理顾虑的确定和缓解主要强调“克制”部分，即防止机器做出伦理上不可接受的行为，这常常造成不必要地约束它们的可能行为和部署领域。
en: So far, however, the determination and mitigation of ethical concerns regarding machine behavior has largely emphasized the “refraining” part, preventing machines from engaging in ethically unacceptable behavior, which often comes at the cost of unnecessarily constraining their possible behaviors and domains of deployment.

zh: 至于伦理学家，他们必须承认为一个机器编程需要最大限度的精确性，而这又需要让他们的伦理讨论观点更加犀利，甚至达到罕见的程度。
en: For their part, ethicists must recognize that programming a machine requires the utmost precision, which will require them to sharpen their approach to ethical discussions, perhaps to an unfamiliar extent.

zh: 他们还必须更多地参与他们的理论工作的真实世界应用，这能够给推进伦理学领域带来额外的好处。
en: They must also engage more with the real-world applications of their theoretical work, which may have the added benefit of advancing the field of ethics.

zh: 更广泛地说，尝试为机器制定一套伦理能够给我们一个全新的开始，制定用于解决伦理难题的原则。
en: More broadly, attempting to formulate an ethics for machines would give us a fresh start at determining the principles we should use to resolve ethical dilemmas.

zh: 由于我们关注的是机器行为，可以比讨论人类行为的情况更加客观地考察伦理，即使我们所讨论的对象应该也适用于人类。
en: Because we are concerned with machine behavior, we can be more objective in examining ethics than we would be in discussing human behavior, even though what we come up with should be applicable to humans as well.

zh: 一方面，我们不会倾向于向机器嵌入一些人类演化而来的行为，如支持本人和某个集体。
en: For one thing, we will not be inclined to incorporate into machines some evolutionarily evolved behaviors of human beings, such as favoring oneself and one’s group.

zh: 相反，我们会要求它们尊重全体人类。
en: Rather, we will require that they treat all people with respect.

zh: 因此，有可能机器行为会比大部分人类更符合伦理，并成为我们所有人的积极角色榜样。
en: As a result, it is likely that the machines will behave more ethically than most human beings, and serve as positive role models for us all.

zh: 有伦理的机器不会造成人道威胁。
en: Ethical machines would pose no threat to humanity.

zh: 相反，它们将在很大程度上帮助我们，不但为我们工作，还向我们展示，要作为一个物种生存下去，我们人类应该如何行为。
en: On the contrary, they would help us considerably, not just by working for us, but also by showing us how we need to behave if we are to survive as a species.

zh: 非洲政治的女性化
en: The Feminization of African Politics

zh: 巴马科/多伦多 — — 上个月，埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德任命了新一届内阁；由女性担任20个职位中的十个。
en: BAMAKO/TORONTO – Last month, Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed appointed a new cabinet; ten of the 20 positions went to women.

zh: 短短一周后，该国议会一致推选祖德成为埃塞俄比亚的首位女总统，而一周后，立法机构又任命阿什纳菲担任该国首位女性最高法院院长。
en: One week later, the country’s parliament unanimously elected Sahle-Work Zewde to become Ethiopia’s first female president, and a week after that, lawmakers appointed Meaza Ashenafi to serve as the first female Supreme Court president.

zh: 埃塞俄比亚并不是唯一的。
en: Ethiopia is not alone.

zh: 卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅上个月任命了一届性别平衡的新内阁 。
en: Rwandan President Paul Kagame installed a new gender-balanced cabinet last month.

zh: 卢旺达已经有着全世界国民议会中最高的女性比例；而现在，这个国家将会涌现出更多的女性领导者。
en: Rwanda already had the world’s highest percentage of women in a national parliament; now, the country will have even more female leaders.

zh: 尽管埃塞俄比亚和卢旺达均处在非洲推动政治性别平等运动的第一线，但其他非洲国家也不甘落后。
en: While Ethiopia and Rwanda are at the forefront of Africa’s push for gender parity in politics, other African countries are not far behind.

zh: 在由女性担任立法席位比例的问题上，非洲以南撒哈拉地区在全世界20个排名靠前的国家中占据了六个。 而在全球排名垫底的两个非洲国家 — — 尼日利亚和马里 — — 政界人士正在积极探讨增加女性代表的方法。
en: Six of the world’s 20 top countries in terms of the share of legislative seats held by women are in Sub-Saharan Africa, and in two African countries toward the bottom of the global list – Nigeria and Mali – politicians are currently discussing ways to increase female representation.

zh: 这样的转变既令人鼓舞又是历史性的。
en: This shift is as inspiring as it is historic.

zh: 通过任命这么多年轻、有活力的女性领袖 — — 向卢旺达信息和通信技术及创新部长因加比莱和马里外交部长卡马拉，此外还有博茨瓦纳贸易部长凯内文多 — — 非洲国家正在向所有人证明，年轻女性可以憧憬并实现颇具影响力的目标。
en: By appointing so many young, energetic female leaders – like Paula Ingabire, Rwanda’s minister of information and communications technology and innovation, Kamissa Camara, Mali’s foreign affairs minister, or Bogolo Kenewendo, Botswana’s trade minister – African countries are demonstrating that young women can aspire to, and achieve, impactful goals.

zh: 上述改变不仅仅是为了公平，对非洲的长期繁荣也至关重要。
en: These changes are essential not only for the sake of fairness, but also for Africa’s long-term prosperity.

zh: 在这块总统平均年龄为62岁的大陆上，非洲需要更多年轻女性当权来反映其年轻人口的才能和愿望。
en: On a continent where the average age of presidents is 62, Africa needs more young women in power to reflect the talent and desires of its youthful population.

zh: 为维持非洲的社会经济进步，由年轻女性担任领导职务非常有必要。
en: To sustain Africa’s socioeconomic progress, young women must be in leadership positions.

zh: 女性以与男性不同的方式感受这个世界。
en: Women experience the world differently than men.

zh: 我们在培养文化规范和期待的过程中逐渐成长，这些规范无疑会在限制我们行为的同时，让我们了解到它们对包容性政策的制定至关重要。
en: We grow up navigating cultural norms and expectations that, while certainly constraining, give us insights that are essential for inclusive policymaking.

zh: 越来越多的证据表明，女性参与政治领导能强化治理能力，改善跨党派和与盟友的合作，并切实推进像育儿假、托幼服务、养老金领取和消灭性别暴力等领域的进步。
en: A growing body of evidence shows that women’s political leadership strengthens governance capacity, improves cooperation with allies and across parties, and advances issues like parental leave and childcare, access to pensions, and the elimination of gender-based violence.

zh: 虽然期待女性就所有问题达成一致或在政治生涯中对性别问题同等敏感既不合理也不现实，但认为女性领导人独特的经历会影响其思想却不失为一种公平的假设。
en: While it is unreasonable – and indeed undesirable – to expect that women will agree on all issues or be equally gender-sensitive in their politics, it is fair to assume that a female leader’s ideas will be informed by her unique experiences.

zh: 随着各国领导人竭尽全力建设更加公平的社会，赋予不同性别的专业人士政治发言权的重要性绝不能被低估。
en: As leaders everywhere strive to build more equitable societies, they must not underestimate the importance of giving political voice to gendered expertise.

zh: 在世界许多地方，包括非洲许多国家，人们普遍认为女性的位置应当在家中；公共空间被视为男性的领地。
en: In much of the world, and in many African countries, a woman’s place is widely believed to be in the home; public space is regarded as a male domain.

zh: 当非洲政府大胆而有意地让女性进入决策机构并赋予她们政治权力时，他们正在直接挑战这些过时的假设。
en: When governments in Africa boldly and intentionally crowd women into decision-making bodies, and entrust them with power, they are directly challenging these outdated assumptions.

zh: 随着更多女性榜样的出现，年轻女性和女孩将能够憧憬全新的职业可能性；父母将为他们的女儿开辟新的成功之路；教师将以不同的方式为女生授课；社会和文化壁垒将被打破。
en: With more female role models, young women and girls will be able to imagine new career possibilities; parents will chart new paths of success for their daughters; teachers will teach girls differently; and social and cultural barriers will fall.

zh: 某些批评人士认为，政府性别配额带有屈尊俯就的意味，因此是不必要的。
en: Some critics argue that gender quotas in government are condescending and unnecessary.

zh: 但在世界许多地方，它们所能起到的作用至关重要。
en: But in many parts of the world, they are essential.

zh: 例如，在某些社会中，女性无法轻易投票，这也就意味着即使女性候选人参与选举， 她们获得选举支持也是非常困难的。
en: In some societies, for example, women cannot easily vote, meaning that even when female candidates are on the ballot, it can be difficult for them to garner electoral support.

zh: 埃塞俄比亚和卢旺达已经充分认识到这一挑战，并已开始着手解决它。
en: Ethiopia and Rwanda have recognized this challenge and have moved to address it.

zh: 此外，通过任命性别平衡的内阁，领导者正在有意识地面对女性在政治领域的某种共同经历：那就是，女性在数量上远低于她们的男性同僚。
en: Moreover, by appointing gender-balanced cabinets, leaders are intentionally addressing a common experience for women in politics: being vastly outnumbered by male counterparts.

zh: 上述两国政府现在有机会在解决各自所面临的难题时运用女性的视角。
en: These two governments now have the opportunity to bring women’s perspective to bear on the challenges their countries face.

zh: 组建性别平等的内阁强化了这样一种理念，那就是，进步不仅仅关乎个人的能力建设。
en: The creation of gender-equal cabinets reinforces the message that progress is about more than building individual capacity.

zh: 相反，它还需要对管理社会的结构和制度进行改革。
en: Rather, it also requires transforming the structures and institutions that govern society.

zh: 对年轻的非洲女性而言，过去几周来的政治改变实际在持续推动性别平等的过程中起到了里程碑式的作用，它标志着非洲大陆进入到一个进步的新时代。
en: For young African women, the last few weeks of political change represents a milestone in the continuing push for gender equality, marking the beginning of a new era of progress for the continent.

zh: 埃塞俄比亚新的恐怖气氛
en: Ethiopia’s New Climate of Fear

zh: 维也纳 — — 今年，埃塞俄比亚将收到来自欧盟，美国和其他主要捐助国家25亿美元的捐款。 对于这个世界上最贫困的国家来说，以上的捐款还不包括来自非盈利组织提供的有关医疗保健，饥饿救助以及其他难以计数的服务等。
en: Vienna – The European Union, the United States, and other major donors will pump about $2.5 billion into Ethiopia this year, a sum that does not even begin to include the cost of medicines, famine relief, and countless other services provided by non-profit groups in one of the world’s most impoverished countries.

zh: 这种援助是必要的，因为长期以来，埃塞俄比亚一直受到贫困，疾病和自然灾害的袭扰。
en: That help is needed, because Ethiopians are prone to malnutrition, disease, and natural calamity.

zh: 国家现有的资源难以应对急剧膨胀的人口数量。
en: Its burgeoning population far outstrips the country’s ability to feed itself.

zh: 这也是众多明星 — — 从鲍勃·吉尔道夫为埃塞俄比亚饥民举办的ive Aid音乐会到安吉丽娜·朱莉和布拉德·皮特收养孤儿 — — 救助埃塞俄比亚的原因，这些都是对国家和机构救援者不可能提供帮助的补充。
en: So desperate is Ethiopia that celebrity causes – from Bob Geldoff’s Live Aid famine-relief concerts to Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt’s adoption of orphaned babies – supplement what donors cannot possibly provide.

zh: 尽管有这么多的救助，埃塞俄比亚政府的威权统治依然不可动摇。
en: But for all this generosity, an authoritarian government rules Ethiopia with virtual impunity.

zh: 总理梅莱斯·泽纳维消灭了反对者，在位已经高达18年。
en: Prime Minister Meles Zenawi, in power for 18 years, has crushed the opposition.

zh: 他领导的政党占据着政府要位。
en: His ruling party dominates public institutions.

zh: 更为糟糕的是，在领土面积广大的农村地区，他的手下控制了国家宣传机器，压制其他媒体的声音。
en: Worse still, in a vast and predominantly rural country, the prime minister’s underlings control broadcasting and maintain a choke-hold on other media.

zh: 4年前的这个月，泽纳维领导的埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线在选举中受到重创。 这是这位前游击老手自从1991年推翻了前苏联支持的残酷政权以来遭受的最大一次打击。
en: Four years ago this month, Zenawi’s Ethiopian People’s Revolutionary Democratic Party (EPRDF) suffered its worst loss at the polls since the former guerrilla overthrew a ruthless, Soviet-backed regime in 1991.

zh: 泽纳维不但不接受失败，反而指责反对派试图实行暴乱 ，宣称自己获得了压倒性的胜利，
en: Rather than accept its losses, the EPRDF-run government responded with a brutal crackdown, claiming outright victory and accusing the opposition of trying to stage an insurrection.

zh: 安全部队袭击了和平的示威者，关押了反对派领袖，将数以千计的反对派投入可怕的集中营，诬陷独立的新闻记者犯有叛国罪 — — 此项罪名最高可以判处死刑。
en: Security forces attacked peaceful protesters, jailed opposition leaders, sent thousands of their supporters to gruesome detention camps, and accused independent journalists of treason – a crime punishable by death.

zh: 一些记者和政治人物不得不流亡他国寻求政治避难。
en: Some journalists and politicians sought asylum in other countries.

zh: 在近期的几次骚乱中，大约有200人被杀戮。
en: During several months of unrest, roughly 200 people were killed.

zh: 这对于那些为了埃塞俄比亚民主转型而耗费大量时间和资金的捐助国家来说，无疑是一个响亮的耳光。
en: It was a disgraceful snub for donor nations that had invested time and capital in supporting Ethiopia’s democratic transition.

zh: 虽然随后，许多记者和反对派人物都被仁慈地释放，但我们不能因此而对暴政有所宽恕。
en: Many of the journalists and opposition figures were eventually released or granted clemency, but there has been no letup to the torment.

zh: 2009年4月底，安全部队以颠覆政府的名义，又逮捕了40名反对派人物。
en: In late April 2009, security forces arrested 40 opposition figures, accusing them of trying to topple the government.

zh: 与此同时，独裁政府通过善变的政策，对异议人士的审讯以及时不时地取消国际独立媒体，例如美国之音的采访权等措施，继续对独立的媒体进行打压。
en: Meanwhile, the authorities continue their assault on independent media through capricious licensing rules, interrogations, and, on occasion, revoking the permits of reporters for international broadcasters like the Voice of America.

zh: 知名媒体工作者被袭击，被起诉后不明不白地消失。
en: Leading journalists have been assaulted, the culprits never found.

zh: “在埃塞俄比亚，只有恐惧，没有自由。 ”一位知名记者如是说。
en: “There is only fear, not freedom, of expression in Ethiopia,” says one leading journalist.

zh: 埃塞俄比亚的记者也不是完全无辜的。
en: Ethiopia’s journalists are not entirely innocent.

zh: 一些报纸挑拨种族和地区的相互仇恨，进行歪曲事实的报道。
en: Some newspapers have stoked the country’s ethnic and regional animosities, and can be wildly inaccurate in their reporting.

zh: 即便如此，对记者的骚扰甚至监禁也不利于事情的解决，正确的方法应该是通过志愿媒体委员会或是独立的人权组织来解决问题。
en: Yet badgering or jailing journalists is no way to resolve what could be handled through a voluntary media council or independent ombudsman.

zh: 进一步说，政府对独立媒体的抹黑也伤害了本国许多职业操守良好的记者和编辑的声誉。
en: Furthermore, the government effort to portray independent journalists as vicious enemies unfairly condemns the many Ethiopian reporters and editors who take their responsibilities seriously.

zh: 泽纳维之所以没有受到西方盟友的制裁，部分原因是这位博学的前马克思主义者和英国前首相托尼·布莱尔私交良好，而且在对非洲之角的反恐行动中，他和布什政府有着密切的合作。
en: Zenawi has largely escaped sanction from his Western allies, in part because the erudite ex-Marxist had a friendly relationship with former British Prime Minister Tony Blair and cooperated closely with the Bush administration in counter-terrorism efforts in the Horn of Africa.

zh: 当然，西方也不是完全保持沉默。
en: There has not been total silence.

zh: 美国众议院外交事务委员会的领军人物多那德·佩恩和来自葡萄牙的欧洲议会议员，2005年选举的欧盟观察员安娜·戈麦斯一直致力于将非人道主义援助和埃塞俄比亚的新闻自由和人权联系起来。
en: Donald Payne, a leading member of the US House Foreign Affairs Committee, and Ana Gomes, a member of the European Parliament from Portugal and head of the EU’s observation team in the 2005 elections, have sought to tie non-humanitarian aid more closely to Ethiopia’s conduct on press freedom and other human rights.

zh: 对于埃塞俄比亚选举后的镇压行径，英国和一些欧洲国家也暂停了对其经济援助。
en: Britain and some other European governments responded to the post-election crackdown by temporarily withholding aid.

zh: 对那些关心埃塞俄比亚的人权和民主问题的人士来说，他们一直处在一个两难的境地。
en: But Ethiopia poses a dilemma for anyone who cares about human rights and democracy.

zh: 终止救援就会影响到8000万人民的生活，造成该国地区的不稳定，引发埃塞俄比亚和邻国索马里和厄立特里亚新一轮的冲突。
en: Cutting off aid could have calamitous humanitarian consequences for the nation’s 80 million people. It could also destabilize a fragile region, sparking fresh wars with neighboring Somalia and Eritrea.

zh: 不管怎么样，我们可以有以下办法来对泽纳维施加压力
en: Nevertheless, there are ways to pressure Zenawi:

zh: ·        阻止埃塞俄比亚部长们参加国际事务的权利，例如阻止泽纳维作为非洲发展新伙伴关系（New Partnership for Africa's Development）的首脑参加20国峰会的权利。 这也是他一直想谋求参加的会议；
en: ·        Donors should deny Ethiopian ministers a seat at diplomatic tables, such as the coveted spot Zenawi got at the G-20 summit in London as head of the New Partnership for Africa’s Development;

zh: ·        在欧盟和其他主要捐助国家的主导下，成立发展帮助集团（Development Assistance Group ） ， 监督和指导捐款利用的效率，防止国际援助的资金运用到那些违反人权的政策上去；
en: ·        While the Development Assistance Group, created by the EU and other principal donors to coordinate aid projects in Ethiopia, has improved the efficiency of donor contributions, a vigorous monitoring component is needed to ensure that international resources do not support policies that are anathema to human rights values;

zh: ·        对于作为主要援助者的欧盟来说，应该对埃塞俄比亚发挥更大的影响力。
en: ·        As a leading donor, the EU wields considerable power in Ethiopia and should be more willing to use it.

zh: 欧盟应该逐渐推行实施《科托努协定 》 ， 就是将经济援助和人权民主和法律联系起来 ， 《 科托努协定》将在2010年被修订，所以现在就应该建立惩处机制，对那些没有尊重人权和新闻自由的国家实施明确的处罚措施。
en: The EU should aggressively enforce the Cotonou Agreement, which requires Ethiopia and other nations that receive European assistance to respect “human rights, democratic principles, and the rule of law.” Cotonou is due for revision in 2010, so now is the time to develop enforcement mechanisms that establish clear penalties for failing to uphold human rights and freedom of the press.

zh: ·        欧盟和美国应该利用例如世界银行等国际组织的影响力，将新闻自由和人权的状况和他们所提供的服务联系起来。
en: ·        The EU and the US should wield more of their clout at the World Bank and other international organizations to link development grants to progress on press freedom and human rights.

zh: 对于埃塞俄比亚这个非洲第二大国来说，接受的援助可能有点微不足道，不能让其摆脱混乱局面的困扰。
en: The aid that Ethiopia receives from its friends may be a small price to pay to keep Africa’s second largest country from descending into chaos.

zh: 但对于埃塞俄比亚人民来说，政府应该有所进步，开放新闻的自由就是一个基本前提，因为它不仅仅是人权的一个基石，更重要的是，繁荣的媒体可以预警在埃塞俄比亚即将到来和已经发生的各种危机。
en: But Ethiopia’s people deserve more from their government. Press freedom is a start, not just because it is a fundamental human right, but also because vigorous media are essential to keeping societies alert to the kinds of crises that are all too common in Ethiopia.

zh: 堕落的非洲解放者
en: Africa’s Fallen Liberators

zh: 牛津—上周，在不到24小时内，两个重要非洲国家领导人先后辞职。
en: OXFORD – The leaders of two key African countries resigned their posts within 24 hours of each other last week.

zh: 南非的祖玛最终迫于本党的压力，辞去了总统职务。
en: South Africa’s Jacob Zuma finally buckled under pressure from his own party to resign the presidency.

zh: 第二天，埃塞俄比亚总理德萨莱尼在持续的群众示威和政治动荡面前宣布决定下台。
en: The following day, Ethiopian Prime Minister Hailemariam Desalegn announced his decision to step down in the face of sustained mass protests and political turmoil.

zh: 在这两个例子中，非洲最老牌的两个解放运动政党，在引起了群众的极度不满之后，被迫抛弃了各自的领导人。 它们上台执政都可以追溯到二十五年前。
en: In both cases, two of the oldest liberation parties in Africa, which have remained in office since first coming to power a quarter-century ago, were forced by deep popular discontent to push their leaders aside.

zh: 两党的历史轨迹高度相似。
en: The historical trajectories of both parties are largely similar.

zh: 尽管如此，它们的领导人下台的影响却将大相径庭。
en: Nevertheless, the effects of their leaders’ exit could not be more different.

zh: 是的，南非非国大党和埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主前线党（EPRDF）在过去十分之一个世纪中都变得故步自封且腐化堕落，遭到了政治衰败。
en: Yes, both the African National Congress (ANC) in South Africa and the Ethiopian People’s Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF) grew complacent and corrupt, and suffered political decay, over the past quarter-century.

zh: 但南非在脱离种族隔离的时候建立了强大的制度性保障，而埃塞俄比亚在推翻了门格斯图的独裁统治后从未建立起足够强大的制度挽救国家于执政党之手。
en: But whereas South Africa had put in place a robust set of institutional safeguards in the wake of its transition from apartheid, Ethiopia, after the overthrow of Mengistu Haile Mariam’s dictatorship, never managed to build national institutions strong enough to save the country from the ruling party.

zh: 两国历史和经济条件大相径庭，但主导性政党的经营方式，以及它们声称采取的经济模式惊人地相似。
en: Despite obvious differences in the two countries’ histories and economic conditions, the way their dominant parties conduct business, and the economic model they claim to have adopted, are strikingly similar.

zh: 非国大党和EPRDF都支持列宁主义民主集中制，根据这一制度，党员要遵守党中央所制定的政策。
en: Both the ANC and the EPRDF espouse the Leninist principle of democratic centralism, according to which party members are expected to abide by the policies established by the central party leadership.

zh: 两党都部署了大量干部确保公务员体系执行政治和决定。
en: Both parties deploy cadres widely to ensure that the civil service carries out political decisions.

zh: 后来，两国党内精英都实施了非正统的经济政策。
en: More recently, party elites in both countries have moved to embrace heterodox economic policies.

zh: 非国大党受到的指责是脱离了作为全世界最不平等国家之一的南非的贫困选民。
en: The ANC has been accused of losing touch with its impoverished voters in one of the most unequal countries on earth.

zh: 更糟糕的是，2012年34名矿工在马利坎（Marikan）惨遭警察屠杀，让人下班过去可种族隔离政权如何对待黑人。
en: Making matters worse, the massacre in 2012 of 34 miners by police in Marikana revived memories of the apartheid regime’s contempt for blacks.

zh: 尽管如此，早已习惯于65%以上支持率非国大党（主要凭借其解放者的威名实现）继续支持千夫所指、指控内容包括受贿和强奸等罪名的祖玛。
en: Regardless, the ANC, accustomed to winning well above 65% of the vote (mainly owing to its liberation credentials), continued to back the embattled Zuma, who faces accusations ranging from bribery to rape.

zh: 随着经济停滞而腐败和国家捕获“蓬勃发展 ” ， 治理大幅恶化。
en: Governance deteriorated as the economy stagnated and corruption and state capture proceeded apace.

zh: 曼德拉的政党有可能被内部腐化所吞噬 — — 并且拉着南非陪葬。
en: The party of Nelson Mandela risked succumbing to internal rot – and taking the country down with it.

zh: 与此同时，在埃塞俄比亚，EPRDF向公众滔滔不绝地宣传几十年前它如何把国家从残暴的军事独裁手中拯救出来，尽管在该党统治下出生和成长起来的数百万年轻人饱受畸高的失业率的折磨。
en: Meanwhile, in Ethiopia, the EPRDF harangued the public about how it freed the country decades ago from a brutal military dictatorship, even as millions of young people born and raised under the party’s rule face crippling unemployment.

zh: EPRDF不断暗示，其领导层的失败不影响其治理国家的权利，而反对派的政治挑战被打为谋逆。
en: The EPRDF continues to imply that any failure by its leadership does not undermine its right to govern the country, while political challenges by opposition groups are portrayed as treasonous.

zh: 和非国大党一样，EPRDF掌权时间越长，就越难想象埃塞俄比亚没了它的领导会变成什么样子。
en: Like the ANC, the longer the EPRDF remained in power, the less it could imagine Ethiopia without it at the helm.

zh: 祖玛宣布辞职后，南非兰特跳涨至三年来最高点。
en: When Zuma announced his resignation, the South African Rand jumped to a three-year high.

zh: 但当德萨莱尼宣布下台后，埃塞俄比亚美元债券下跌至六个月最低点。
en: But after Desalegn announced his decision to step down, Ethiopia’s dollar bond fell to a six-month low.

zh: 但这些指标只是两人辞职给各自国家政治和经济造成不同影响的开端。
en: These indicators, however, are just the start of the divergent implications the two resignations have had for their respective countries’ politics and economics.

zh: 和20世纪60年代非洲众多解放运动一样，非国大党和EPRDF不再响应不断变化的政治和经济要求，与此同时，掠夺性政客及其党羽集结在党的大旗背后。
en: The ANC and EPRDF, like many of Africa’s liberation movements in the 1960s, stopped responding to evolving political and economic demands, while predatory politicians and their cronies hid behind the party’s banner.

zh: 但祖玛的继任者拉马福萨在祖玛辞职后几天的议会演讲中承诺要带给南非“新的黎明 ” ， 而在差不多同时，埃塞尔比亚宣布进入紧急状态，人们广泛担心国家是否能够在争夺德萨莱尼继任者的种族挂帅的权力斗争中生存下来。
en: But while Zuma’s successor, Cyril Ramaphosa, promised a “new dawn” for South Africa when he addressed Parliament within days of Zuma’s resignation, Ethiopia declared a state of emergency around the same time, amid widespread concern about whether the state would survive the ethnically charged power struggle to succeed Desalegn.

zh: 关键性的区别在于，南非领导人具有远见卓识，明白失控的主导政党可能会带来怎样的危险。
en: The crucial difference is that South Africa had visionary leaders who were aware of the danger that an out-of-touch dominant party could pose.

zh: 据说曼德拉曾敦促获得公民权的南非黑人 ， “ 如果非国大党像种族隔离政府一样对待你们，那你们也必须向对待种族隔离政府一样对待非国大党。
en: Mandela reportedly urged newly enfranchised black South Africans, “If the ANC does to you what the apartheid government did to you, then you must do to the ANC what you did to the apartheid government.”

zh: ”这一情绪体现在南非后种族隔离时代宪法的民主制衡条款中。
en: This sentiment was reflected in the democratic checks and balances enshrined by South Africa’s post-apartheid constitution.

zh: 但埃塞尔比亚没有那么幸运，这尤其是因为现任政权将执政的第一个十年用在了巩固其危在旦夕的权力基础和与邻国厄立特里亚打仗上面。
en: Ethiopia, however, has not been so fortunate, particularly because the current regime spent its first decade in office shoring up its precarious power base and fighting a war with neighboring Eritrea.

zh: 但EPRDF破坏它自己参与制定的宪法；同时，除了理所应当的整顿民族不平等的政策之外，也没有拿出任何国家建设计划（尽管它成功地刺激了经济，增长速度创出了进入现代史后的记录 ） ， 这令情况雪上加霜。
en: But the EPRDF made matters worse by undermining the constitution that it helped promulgate, and appearing to have no plan for nation building beyond supposedly rectifying historical inequalities between ethnic communities (though it succeeded in stimulating faster economic growth than the country had ever recorded in modern times).

zh: 对两国民主制度在应对主导政党的衰败方面的不同，最能说明问题的指标是最新选举结果。
en: The most telling indicator of how differently the two countries’ democratic institutions responded to the perceived decay of their dominant parties is the recent election results.

zh: 因为领导层没能管理好南非各个层面的问题，非国大党面对反对党在选举中节节败退。
en: The ANC kept losing electoral ground to rival parties as its leadership failed to manage South Africa’s multifaceted problems.

zh: 非国大党之所以决定抛弃祖玛，正是为了阻止进一步的选举失败。
en: It was to stem further electoral losses that the party decided to push Zuma aside.

zh: 相反，EPRDF将埃塞俄比亚变成事实上的一党国家。
en: The EPRDF, by contrast, turned Ethiopia into a de facto single-party state.

zh: 在2015年的选举中，EPRDF宣布和其执政联盟一起赢得了所有议会席位，此后不出几个月，埃塞俄比亚便陷入了政治动荡。
en: The country began its descent into political turmoil a few months after the party claimed to have won, together with its allies, all parliamentary seats in the 2015 elections.

zh: 上周，南非民主制度将非国大党救出了自己之手。
en: Last week, South Africa’s democratic institutions appeared to have saved the ANC from itself.

zh: 埃塞俄比亚不可能有这样的幸运。
en: Ethiopia is unlikely to be so fortunate.

zh: 制度性保障不足让EPRDF所造成的消极或积极的破坏能够维持下去。
en: Too few institutional guardrails have survived the neglect or active dismantling that the EPRDF brought about.

zh: 印度会不会发生种族清洗？
en: Is Ethnic Cleansing Coming to India?

zh: 新德里 — — 分裂印度71年后，且于东巴基斯坦成为孟加拉国47年后，次大陆混乱分裂的传统再次困扰着这个国家。
en: NEW DELHI – Seventy-one years after the partition of India, and 47 years after the former East Pakistan became Bangladesh, one of the legacies of the messy division of the subcontinent has returned to haunt the country.

zh: 目前印度阿萨姆邦公布全国公民登记册 （NRC）所引发的危机已经对约400万人的公民身份 — — 和未来前景 — — 提出了质疑，并有可能破坏该地区的和平现状。
en: The current crisis over the publication of a National Register of Citizens (NRC) in the Indian state of Assam has cast doubt on the citizenship – and the future – of some four million people, and threatens to undermine peace in the region.

zh: 1947年英国人撤离时以宗教为基础划分了印度：他们成立了一个穆斯林国家巴基斯坦，该国源于印度东西部省份以穆斯林为主体的民众。
en: The departing British partitioned India in 1947 on the basis of religion: they created a Muslim state, Pakistan, out of Muslim-majority provinces in the west and east of India.

zh: 1971年，在巴基斯坦军队开展残酷的种族灭绝运动迫使约1，000万难民逃往印度后，东巴基斯坦独立出来成立了孟加拉。
en: In 1971, after a brutal and genocidal campaign by the Pakistani army drove some ten million refugees to India, East Pakistan seceded to form Bangladesh.

zh: 印度一旦在那次战争中打败巴基斯坦，绝大多数难民都返回了新独立的孟加拉，但仍然有些人选择留在印度，留在那里的人与当地民众实现了无缝同化。
en: Once India had defeated Pakistan in that war, most of the refugees returned to the newly independent Bangladesh, though some remained in India, where they assimilated seamlessly.

zh: 接下来的几年里，他们目睹了来自孟加拉国数百万其他移民的涌入，这些人因为经济困难和土地稀缺而逃离拥挤不堪的孟加拉。
en: Over the next few years, they were joined by millions of other migrants from Bangladesh, who were fleeing economic hardship and land scarcity in an overcrowded country.

zh: 尽管前往印度西孟加拉邦的移民在他们的孟加拉同胞身边很容易就实现了同化，但因为与多数新邻居存在语言、文化和宗教差异，那些定居在东北部阿萨姆邦的移民所面临的挑战更大。
en: While migrants to the Indian state of West Bengal assimilated easily among their fellow Bengalis, those who settled in the northeastern state of Assam faced greater challenges, owing to linguistic, cultural, and religious differences with the majority of their new neighbors.

zh: 到20世纪80年代，阿萨姆邦学生仍因为对失去土地和工作机会的前景感到怒不可遏而举行大规模抗议活动，抗议活动偶尔会导致暴力冲突的爆发。
en: By the 1980s, Assamese students – angry at the prospect of losing land and job opportunities – were staging mass protests, which occasionally erupted into violence.

zh: 阿萨姆邦因此近乎失控。
en: Assam became all but ungovernable.

zh: 一对针对孟加拉穆斯林移民群体的野蛮大屠杀 — — 其中一次于1983年杀害了阿萨姆邦内利村和其他村的约3，000名穆斯林民众，暴露了这次危机已经造成了多么严重的后果。
en: A pair of savage massacres of Bengali Muslim migrant groups – one of which killed some 3,000 in the Assamese village of Nellie and other villages in 1983 – exposed the depth of the crisis.

zh: 最后，在1985年，时任印度总理拉吉夫·甘地达成了一项“阿萨姆协议 ” ， 该协议通过承诺将1971年后所有非法移民至该地的孟加拉人驱逐出境而结束了这场“阿萨姆风潮 ” 。
en: Finally, in 1985, then-Indian Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi concluded an “Assam Accord,” which brought an end to the “Assam Agitation” by pledging to deport all those who had migrated illegally to the region from Bangladesh after 1971.

zh: 但说来容易做来难。
en: This was easier said than done.

zh: 多年来，法庭评估仅仅确定了预计的2，000万非法移民中的几千人都不到。
en: Over the years, an assortment of tribunals failed to identify more than a few thousand of the estimated 20 million illegal migrants.

zh: 即便如此，也没有采取具体措施来履行阿萨姆协议的承诺。
en: Yet no concrete action was taken to fulfill the guarantees of the Assam Accord.

zh: 相反，在长达数十年的时间里该问题一直被搁置着。
en: Instead, the problem was left on the back burner for decades.

zh: 之后，在2014年，由总理纳伦德拉·莫迪及其印度人民党（BJP）领导的强硬派印度教民族主义（Hindutva)政府当选，之后这一进程又重新启动。
en: Then, in 2014, the hardline Hindutva (Hindu nationalist) government led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) was elected, and the process was revived.

zh: 由法院指导和政府支持行动的主要阶段结束后，全国公民登记册的第二稿 — — 一份能证明其祖先在1971年前就生活在阿萨姆邦的人员名单 — — 最终于7月下旬被发表。
en: When the main phase of the court-directed and government-supported exercise was concluded, the second draft of the NRC – a list of people who could prove that they had antecedents in Assam before 1971 – was published in late July.

zh: 印度人民党假装这是一次中立行动，哪怕在因甄别“外国人”而额首相庆的同时，仍然强调整个过程都接受最高法院的监督。
en: The BJP pretends that this is a neutral exercise, emphasizing that the Supreme Court supervised the process, even as it celebrates the identification of “foreigners.”

zh: 但因为能够决定谁能在印度人民党执政的阿萨姆邦拥有土地、工作机会和投票权，此举绝不是不带偏见的。
en: But the move is anything but unbiased, as it will determine who can own land, hold jobs, and vote in BJP-ruled Assam.

zh: 且无论全国公民登记册终稿的规模如何 — — 仍有时间对其结果提出上诉并纠正某些错误 — — 显而易见，如果最终被排除在外的不完全是孟加拉的穆斯林，这些人也将占据绝大多数。
en: And whatever the size of the final NRC – there is still time to appeal its findings and correct some errors – it is already clear that those ultimately excluded will be overwhelmingly, if not entirely, Bengali Muslims.

zh: 事实上，有人提出重启全国公民登记册进程的主要目的是在下一次大选投票前尽一切可能阻止孟加拉穆斯林参与投票。
en: In fact, it has been suggested that a principal purpose of reviving the NRC process has been to strip as many Bengali Muslims as possible of the right to vote ahead of the next general election.

zh: 因为很少能够得到印度穆斯林的支持，在拥有约3，000万人口的阿萨姆邦，剥夺400万人的投票权可能对印度人民党的选举运势产生重大影响。
en: In a state of some 30 million, disenfranchising four million people could have a major impact on the BJP’s electoral fortunes, as it has scant support among India’s Muslims.

zh: 但完全区分孟加拉穆斯林和印度孟加拉穆斯林几乎不可能。
en: But it is almost impossible to tell a Bangladeshi Muslim and an Indian Bengali Muslim apart.

zh: 另外，剥夺如此多居民投票权的法律影响仍然有待评估，而法庭很可能会挑战这项决策。
en: Also, the legal implications of the move to strip so many inhabitants of their voting rights have yet to be assessed, and court challenges await.

zh: 无论如何，被全国公民登记册排除在外的孟加拉穆斯林失去的不仅是投票权。
en: In any case, the Bengali Muslims excluded from the NRC stand to lose more than their voting rights.

zh: 有人高调鼓吹要将他们驱赶到孟加拉国。
en: Some speak glibly of deporting them to Bangladesh.

zh: 但印度和孟加拉并未签署双边驱逐协议，而孟加拉国已经明确表示不对其境外的任何人负责。
en: But there is no bilateral deportation agreement in place, and Bangladesh has made clear that it assumes no responsibility for people who are not on its territory.

zh: 最不符合印度需要的就是制造一次移民危机，或者更糟的是，试图针对孟加拉国展开强制驱逐行动 — — 而孟加拉则是与印度人民党维持良好关系的少数几个邻国。
en: The last thing India needs is to create a migration crisis or, worse, try to force deportations to Bangladesh – one of the few neighbors with which the BJP government has managed to maintain good relations.

zh: 那些被全国公民登记册排除在外的人还有可能被赶出在阿萨姆邦的住所而无家可归 — — 他们已经在那里居住了40年以上。
en: Still, it seems possible that those who are excluded from the NRC will be driven from their homes in Assam – which they may have inhabited for more than four decades – with no place to go.

zh: 有人建议印度在这些人返回孟加拉之前为其设立难民营，因为无法保证那一天将会到来，这样的前景令人权团体倍感恐怖。
en: Some have suggested that India establish camps to house these people until they can return to Bangladesh – a prospect that horrifies human-rights groups, not least because there is no guarantee that that day will ever come.

zh: 从本质上讲，在民主印度剥夺人们已经享有了大半生的权利究竟是不是合理的？
en: More fundamentally, is it really justifiable to strip people of the rights they have exercised in democratic India for most of their lives?

zh: 到目前为止，全国公民登记册所造成的危机仍未涉及暴力。
en: So far, the crisis created by the NRC has been nonviolent.

zh: 但随着局势日趋紧张，暴力活动爆发的危险正在不断累积中。
en: But as tensions mount, the risk of an eruption is growing.

zh: 现在，政府必须面对棘手的问题。
en: Now, the government must confront difficult questions.

zh: 1985年达成的一项解决自1971年以来所采取行动的协议是否真的是2018年解决问题的最佳框架？
en: Is an accord reached in 1985 to address actions taken since 1971 really the best framework to resolve the issue in 2018?

zh: 印度民主能否对已在其领土上生活了数十年的民众人权持彻底的忽视态度？
en: Can India’s democracy afford to disregard the human rights of people who have been living on its territory for decades?

zh: 尽管保护印度主权和公民身份完整性的理由值得称赞，但以此为由将数百万人扔进地狱究竟是不是合理的？
en: As laudable as it is to protect India’s sovereignty and the integrity of its citizenship, does it justify throwing millions of lives into limbo?

zh: 尽管处在舆论两端的狂热分子都试图说服民众，但这些问题其实是没有明确答案的。
en: There are no clear answers to these questions, despite what passionate voices on both sides of the argument would have one believe.

zh: 显而易见的是，在人民党高调宣扬多数权利已引起人们强烈关注的时刻，无论结局是好是坏，政府就全国公民登记册所作出的决策将决定印度动荡民主的未来走向。
en: What is clear is that, at a time when the BJP’s majoritarian assertiveness is already raising serious concerns, the decisions the government makes regarding the NRC will shape the future of India’s turbulent democracy – for better or for worse.

zh: 对堡垒化欧洲的反思
en: Rethinking Fortress Europe

zh: 伦敦 — — 欧盟关于移民问题的辩论散发着某种陈腐气息。
en: LONDON – There is something rotten about the European Union’s debate on migration.

zh: 欧洲大陆的政治领袖在反移民民粹主义的裹挟下，正在抛弃逃离战争、人权践踏和经济崩溃的绝望的弱势群体。
en: The continent’s political leaders, paralyzed by the rise of anti-immigrant populism, are turning their backs on desperately vulnerable people fleeing war, human-rights abuses, and economic collapse.

zh: 为欧洲政策付出最大代价的莫过于地中海。
en: Nowhere is the human cost of European policies more visible than in the Mediterranean Sea.

zh: 欧洲和非洲之间的海域是全世界最致命的移民线路。
en: The waters between Europe and Africa are the world’s deadliest migration route.

zh: 估计约30万人 — — 超过2013年人数的两倍 — — 已经在2014年跨过这片海域。
en: Roughly 300,000 people are estimated to have made the crossing in 2014 – more than twice as many as in 2013.

zh: 约3，000人死于溺水、饥饿、暴晒或者窒息。
en: Some 3,000 died from drowning, hunger, exposure, or asphyxiation.

zh: 绝大多数移民来自利比亚，那里已成为产值数百万美元的人口贩卖中心。
en: Most migrants set out from Libya, which has emerged as the center of a multi-million-dollar human-trafficking industry.

zh: 直到不久前，前往意大利的多数移民还乘坐小船越境。
en: Until recently, most migrants setting out for Italy made the crossing on small vessels.

zh: 但意大利当局刚刚在年初从一艘老旧钢制货轮上救起了包括孕妇和数十名儿童在内的数百名移民。
en: But, in a new twist, Italian authorities at the beginning of this year rescued hundreds of migrants, including pregnant women and dozens of children, aboard an aging steel-hulled freighter.

zh: 船员早已跳海逃生。
en: The crew had jumped ship.

zh: 因为靠近发生致命冲突的叙利亚，靠近以极端贫困、人权践踏和政府及经济衰落崩溃闻名的战乱国家，欧盟必然像磁铁一样吸引着寻求庇护者和移民。
en: Given its close proximity to a deadly conflict in Syria and countries marked by extreme poverty, human-rights abuses, and weak or collapsed states and economies, the EU is inevitably a magnet for migrants and asylum-seekers.

zh: 欧盟因此需要制定能反映其价值观的移民政策。
en: That is why it needs a migration policy that reflects the values on which it was founded.

zh: 不幸的是，卑劣的政治算计压倒了对生命的尊重。
en: Unfortunately, respect for human life has taken a back seat to baser political calculations.

zh: 让我们看看欧洲对搜索救援行动的态度。
en: Consider Europe’s approach to search and rescue operations.

zh: 去年11月，因为其他欧盟成员国拒绝分担每月900万欧元左右（合1060美元）的成本，意大利暂停了地中海救援行动（2013年300多名移民在靠近意大利兰佩杜萨岛海岸溺水身亡后，意大利启动了这项救援行动 ） 。
en: Last November, Italy suspended its Mare Nostrum rescue operation (which it launched in 2013, after more than 300 migrants drowned off the coast of the Italian island of Lampedusa), because other EU member states refused to share the costs – some €9 million ($10.6 million) a month.

zh: 欧盟边境管理局、欧盟边防局（Frontex）已经启动名为海卫行动的有限海岸救援计划，以部分弥补地中海救援行动停止后的空缺。
en: In its place, the EU border agency, Frontex, has begun conducting a limited coastal mission called Operation Triton.

zh: 欧盟国家为什么不愿分担人道主义救援行动的费用？
en: Why the reluctance to share the cost of humanitarian rescue operations?

zh: 英国和其他北欧国家的高级部长以扶手椅行为经济学为借口，提出地中海救援行动鼓励更多移民尝试危险的海洋偷渡。
en: Senior ministers in the United Kingdom and other northern European countries, relying on little more than armchair behavioral economics, argued that Mare Nostrum encouraged more migrants to attempt the dangerous sea crossing.

zh: 换言之，任由儿童溺水而坐视不理是合法的威慑因素。
en: In other words, allowing children to drown is a legitimate deterrent.

zh: 回到现实世界，驱动民众逃离的绝望和期望压倒了渡海所带来的危险 — — 也就是说停止地中海救援行动不会减少向欧洲偷渡的人数。
en: Back in the real world, the desperation and aspiration driving people to flee outweigh the risks posed by the crossing – meaning that the closure of Mare Nostrum will do nothing to reduce the number of people attempting the journey to Europe.

zh: 但欧洲有毒的移民辩论却极少探讨致使民众偷渡的因素。
en: But Europe’s debate on migration is so toxic that the forces actually causing people to move are seldom discussed.

zh: 据欧盟边防局统计，2014年偷渡地中海的移民约有四分之一是为逃避叙利亚内战。
en: According to Frontex, roughly a quarter of the migrants who crossed the Mediterranean in 2014 were Syrian families escaping the civil war there.

zh: 还有四分之一是厄立特里亚青年，试图逃离该国对持不同政见者实行的无限兵役制。
en: Young Eritreans – fleeing a country that imposes indefinite military conscription on dissidents – made up another quarter.

zh: 还有很多人来自巴勒斯坦、索马里、苏丹、马里和尼日利亚等贫困和暴力频发的国家。
en: Many others came from poor, violence-prone countries: Palestine, Somalia, Sudan, Mali, and Nigeria.

zh: 面对地中海人道主义危机，欧盟却以建设堡垒作为主要对策。
en: Faced with a humanitarian crisis in the Mediterranean, the EU has responded by trying to build a fortress.

zh: 欧盟已经为在土耳其和希腊边境修建围栏投入巨资。
en: It has invested heavily in a fenced border between Turkey and Greece.

zh: 国际大赦组织记录了阻挡移民和难民越境进入希腊和保加利亚的普遍做法 — — 这种做法违反了国际法的原则。
en: Amnesty International has documented the widespread practice of pushing back migrants and refugees attempting to cross into Greece and Bulgaria – a practice that contravenes international law.

zh: 但欧洲构筑的堡垒并未阻止、只是改变了人流，迫使移民和难民在缩减搜索救援行动的情况下尝试危险的海上偷渡。
en: But the fortress has merely rechanneled, rather than stemmed, the flow of people, forcing migrants and refugees to attempt dangerous sea crossings – even as search and rescue operations are being scaled back.

zh: 人贩子成了唯一的受益者，他们为危险偷渡船只上的弹丸之地而向叙利亚难民收取6，000欧元的高价。
en: The only beneficiaries are the human traffickers that charge Syrian refugees some €6,000 for space in a dangerous boat or freighter.

zh: 欧盟寻找明确危机解决办法的努力已几乎成为闹剧。
en: The EU’s efforts to develop a coherent approach to the crisis have bordered on farce.

zh: 驱使人们奔赴欧洲的包括从冲突到政治迫害、从贫困到经济压力等一系列的复杂因素。
en: What drives people to Europe is a complex set of forces, ranging from conflict and political persecution to poverty and economic pressures.

zh: 欧洲机构的对策是将所有移民问题视为边境管理问题。
en: Europe’s institutional response is to view all migration as a border-management issue.

zh: 欧盟委员会各个部门 — — 尤其是那些侧重发展的部门 — — 的意见却很少有人听取。
en: The EU Commission’s various departments – notably, those that focus on development – are barely consulted.

zh: 此外，东拼西凑的国家庇护和移民政策难以建立起连贯的框架结构。
en: Meanwhile, the patchwork of national asylum and migration policies makes a cohesive framework impossible to devise.

zh: 欧盟外长前不久发表的移民宣言就很好体现出问题所在，其中用词含混到很难做出实际的解释。
en: This challenge was reflected in the EU foreign ministers’ recent declaration on migration, which was so vague that it defied practical interpretation.

zh: 民粹主义政治势力的崛起更加大了纠正政治错误的难度。
en: Correcting these policy failures is made more difficult by the rise of populist political forces.

zh: 法国国民阵线、英国独立党和瑞典、丹麦及意大利的极右翼反移民政党获得的选票不断攀升，并且取消了就��个没有简单答案的艰难政治问题在全面理解基础上的公众辩论。
en: The National Front in France, the United Kingdom Independence Party, and far-right anti-immigration parties in Sweden, Denmark, and Italy are picking up votes and shutting down informed public debate on a tough policy question that has no easy answers.

zh: 欧洲迫切需要就移民问题进行以事实为基础的成熟对话。
en: Europe desperately needs to have a mature, fact-based conversation about migration.

zh: 加强边境控制永远无法解决欧盟移民所面临的全部问题。
en: Strict border controls can never be more than one part of the solution to the EU’s migration challenge.

zh: 叙利亚、伊拉克和撒哈拉以南非洲危机可能导致更多的人流离失所。
en: The crises in Syria, Iraq, and parts of Sub-Saharan Africa are likely to lead to yet more dislocation.

zh: 加高围栏、强化监控及增强警力肯定不足以化解由此导致的移民人数增加。
en: Higher fences, more vigilant surveillance, and increased policing will not be enough to address the increase in migration that is almost certain to result.

zh: 相反，各成员国秉承欧盟最基本的价值观，理应共同承担地中海行动的搜索和救援开支；加强对难民权利的保护；并共同承担起庇护之责。
en: Instead, acting on the EU’s founding values, member states should co-finance a search and rescue operation along the lines of Mare Nostrum; strengthen their efforts to protect the rights of refugees; and share the burden of granting asylum.

zh: 德国、法国、英国和瑞典去年收容了全部欧盟难民的70 % 。
en: Germany, France, the United Kingdom, and Sweden took in 70% of those granted refugee status in the EU last year.

zh: 其他国家 — — 尤其是西班牙 — — 需要强化这方面的努力。
en: Others – notably Spain – need to do more.

zh: 此外还要采取更广泛的对策。
en: Wider responses are also needed.

zh: 比方说，长期慷慨地提供临时工作签证对移民和欧洲民众同样有利。
en: For example, more coherent and generous approaches to the provision of temporary work visas would benefit both migrants and Europeans.

zh: 欧盟成员国可以运用国内援助预算，为邻国生活在水深火热中的叙利亚难民提供更多支持。
en: And EU member states could use their aid budgets to provide greater support for the Syrian refugees living in dire circumstances in neighboring countries.

zh: 地中海移民危机的教训显而易见：堡垒化的欧洲没有办法持续下去。
en: The lesson of the migration crisis in the Mediterranean is clear: Fortress Europe is not working.

zh: 欧洲必须谋划新的解决办法。
en: The EU must map out a new approach.

zh: 在此过程中，欧洲自身的价值观将提供最好的指引。
en: When it does, its own values will be the best guide.

zh: 英国的最后一根欧盟稻草？
en: Britain’s Last EU Straw?

zh: 伦敦—17亿英镑对英国政府来说是一大笔钱，因此拿出来需要仔细考虑吗？
en: LONDON – Is £1.7 billion ($2.7 billion) a lot of money for the British government to fork out?

zh: 当它以欧盟预算要求的形式突然出现时是的。
en: It is when it is a European Union budget demand that comes out of the blue.

zh: 但欧盟出人意料的账单不仅仅是金融上的，因为它的到来正逢反欧盟的英国独立党（United Kingdom Independence Party）在民调中狂飙突进之时。
en: But the impact of the EU’s unexpected budget invoice is not just financial, for it has arrived at a time when the anti-EU, United Kingdom Independence Party (UKIP) is riding high in opinion polls.

zh: 这一事件彰显出欧盟预算规定有多么任性（arbitrary ） ， 这将陷欧盟自身于极其不利的境地，也很可能成为英国退出欧盟的最后一根稻草。
en: The episode reveals the arbitrary nature of EU budget setting, which puts the EU itself in a bad light – and could be the last straw for Britain’s EU membership.

zh: 这张账单源于欧盟统计局（Eurostat）对英国过去20年经济表现的重新统计结果。
en: The bill originates from a statistical recalculation by Eurostat, the EU statistical office, of the UK’s economic performance over the past 20 years.

zh: 但是，其长期代价也许比其相对较小的数字（相当于GDP的0.1 % ） 大得多。
en: The longer-terms costs, however, could be much greater than the relatively small amount (0.1% of GDP) involved.

zh: 政治危机 — — 源自欧盟预算对国家预算附加费和退税的计算 — — 来自于制度任性（institutional arbitrariness ） ， 这种任性是不公平的，并且产生了极大的不满。
en: The political crisis – which originated with the calculation of national budget surcharges and rebates from the EU budget – stems from an institutional arbitrariness that seems unjust and fosters immense resentment.

zh: 就像是看似因为琐事而破裂的友谊和婚姻，其背后其实存在根本性问题，这场预算危机彰显出英国-欧盟关系中的严重缺陷。
en: Like friendships or marriages that break down over seemingly trivial issues that in fact signify fundamental problems, this budget crisis has highlighted a serious flaw in the UK-EU relationship.

zh: 这一新金融要求震惊了英国首相卡梅伦，他称之为“完全不可接受 ” 。
en: The new financial demand surprised UK Prime Minister David Cameron, who called it “completely unacceptable.”

zh: 对许多欧洲怀疑派来说，这只不过是欧盟委员会针对英国的又一阴谋信号。
en: For many Euroskeptics, this was yet another sign of a conspiracy by the European Commission against Britain.

zh: 卡梅伦用儿童凶杀案侦探桌游作比方说 ： “ 你不需要超级线索（Cluedo）就能知道，有人聚集在图书馆下水道旁边密谋。
en: Referring to a children’s murder-detective board game, Cameron declared: “You don’t need a Cluedo set to know that someone has been clubbed with the lead piping in the library.”

zh: ”更好的比方也许是凸显资本主义随机不公正性的大萧条时代桌游强手棋中的“机会”卡。
en: A better comparison might have been with the “Chance” cards in Monopoly, the Great Depression-era board game that highlighted the random injustice of capitalism.

zh: 争议对英国的欧盟反对派来说可谓来得正逢其时。
en: The timing of the spat could not be better for Britain’s EU opponents.

zh: 英国独立党名正言顺地在明年5月的大选后维持权力平衡，迫使政府履行其所承诺的欧盟“留还是走”公投。
en: UKIP could conceivably hold the balance of power following next May’s general election, and force the government to hold its promised “in-out” referendum on EU membership.

zh: 面临选举压力的英国两大政党保守党和工党已开始宣传限制移民，而这与欧盟法律和欧洲一体化核心原则相悖。
en: Under electoral pressure, Britain’s two main parties – Conservatives and Labour – are already advocating limits on immigration that are incompatible with EU law and the core principles of European integration.

zh: 这一心理冲突的扩大可能导致许多英吉利海峡两岸的人认为英国和欧盟还是各走一边为好。
en: The emotional escalation may lead many people, on both sides of the English Channel, to conclude that the UK and the EU would each be better off without the other.

zh: 先前所存在的紧张难免在当前的交火中扮演着重要角色。
en: Pre-existing tensions have inevitably played a large part in the current flare-up.

zh: 但欧盟的预算计算方式是否也有问题？
en: But is the EU’s budget calculation method also at fault?

zh: 一国对欧盟预算的贡献反映其实际经济活动是自然而然的。
en: It is rational for a country’s EU budget contribution to reflect its real level of economic activity.

zh: 无论如何，占欧盟产出1%左右的欧盟预算相对较低，并且30多年来没有什么变化。
en: In any case, the total EU budget, at around 1% of EU output, is relatively small, and has not changed for more than 30 years.

zh: 重新计算只不过是为了更准确地勾勒欧盟经济图景，纠正官方国民账户没有计算的活动，如慈善、毒品、卖淫等。
en: The recalculation simply attempts to achieve a more accurate picture of the EU economy, correcting for activity not officially measured in national accounts, such as charity, drugs, and prostitution.

zh: 此外，英国也不是唯一一个在重新计算中“中镖”的欧盟成员国。
en: Moreover, Britain was not the only EU member to fall foul of the recalculation.

zh: 意大利经济表现比此前所认为的更好，因此也需要增加欧盟预算贡献额。
en: Italy’s economic performance also looked better than previously assumed, necessitating an additional payment.

zh: 意大利总理伦齐听闻后也动了怒，称欧盟预算重新计算是“致命凶器 ” 。
en: Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi duly joined the chorus of outrage, calling the recalculation a “lethal weapon.”

zh: 平心而论，政府尽可能对更多国内经济活动进行监控和课税从根本上说是明智的。
en: To be sure, it is fundamentally sensible for governments to monitor and tax as much domestic economic activity as possible.

zh: 试图计算整个经济 — — 并以此为基础计算预算贡献 — — 的外部评估应该可以增加税收效率。
en: An external assessment that attempts to account for the whole of the economy – and calculates the budget contribution on this basis – should increase tax efficiency.

zh: 毕竟，拙劣的税收能力是包括意大利在内的南欧的顽疾之一（希腊尤其严重 ） ， 而收获大笔退款的法国和德国的收税能力要强得多。
en: Poor taxation capacity has, after all, been an endemic problem in southern Europe, including in Italy (and especially in Greece), while France and Germany, which both received large rebates, are better tax collectors.

zh: 和希腊类似，意大利也在试图扩大税基。
en: Italy, like Greece, has been trying to broaden its tax base.

zh: 空中勘测用于检查家庭游泳池；税收评估师正在调查停在港口中的游艇；1,000欧元以上的交易不可用现金进行。
en: Aerial surveys now detect garden swimming pools; tax assessors investigate yachts moored in harbors; and no transactions above €1,000 ($1,268) may be made in cash.

zh: 但欧盟预算计算为何如此强调国民账户，从而让人们感到它显得十分任性？
en: Yet why should the EU’s budget calculations place such importance on national accounts, which constitute a set of arbitrary conventions?

zh: 如果（比如）家务活也要付工资，那么GDP就可以在不增加任何活动的情况下增长。
en: If, for example, wages were paid for housework, GDP would increase without any more activity taking place.

zh: 在理性世界中，欧盟预算贡献不会如此任性地确定，而是根据（比如）增值税税收额的固定比例自动决定。
en: In a rational world, EU budget contributions would not be arbitrarily set, but would be automatically determined, say, as a fixed proportion of value-added tax (VAT) receipts.

zh: 只需要相对较小的比例，不需要定期重新计算。
en: Only a relatively small share would be needed, requiring no periodic recalculations.

zh: 以当前方式对一国的义务进行评估和在评估会伤害欧盟。
en: Assessing, and then reassessing, members’ dues in the current way damages the EU.

zh: 将这一逻辑极端化，成员国将要求重新计算反映它们测量收入和财富的不同方法，从而让潜在受益国和贡献国针锋相对。
en: Taken to its logical extreme, member countries would demand recalculations to reflect the different ways they measure income and wealth, thereby pitting potential beneficiary countries against contributors.

zh: 这一财政设计已经导致了成员国分裂的威胁 — — 比如苏格兰和加泰罗尼亚。
en: Such a fiscal set-up has already threatened to break up member states – consider Scotland or Catalonia.

zh: 如果欧盟仅仅被视为一个向成员国配置财政资源的财库，那么它必然会失败。
en: If the EU is seen as being little more than a treasure chest that allots fiscal resources to its members, it is bound to fail.

zh: 随着地缘政治挑战的增加，以及欧盟面临其冷战结束后的第一次系统性安全威胁，兹事不可谓不体大。
en: As geopolitical challenges mount, and Europe faces its first systemic security threat since the end of the Cold War, the stakes could not be higher.

zh: 欧洲决不能陷入一个本应是简单的官僚程序而无法自拔。
en: Europe cannot get bogged down in what should be a simple bureaucratic process.

zh: 相反，欧盟必须能够解释重新计算的真正含义，并且其理想算盘必须反映在明确、可预测、不任性的行为中。
en: Rather, the EU must be able to explain what it truly represents, and these ideals must be reflected in actions that are clear, predictable, and non-arbitrary.

zh: 欧盟的真正威胁
en: The Real Threats to the EU

zh: 伦敦—在英国，退欧是一件大事，从政府部长到花边小报，人人都在为英国将与欧盟达成什么协议、会产生什么影响而争辩不休。
en: LONDON – In the United Kingdom, Brexit looms large, with everyone from government ministers to tabloid newspapers frothing daily about the deal that will be struck with the European Union and the effects that it will have.

zh: 但欧盟面临着太多的紧迫挑战，不能深陷英国问题。
en: But the EU faces too many pressing challenges to be obsessing about Britain.

zh: 英国的顾虑不难理解：越来越多的证据表明，脱离单一市场和关税同盟不利于英国经济。
en: The UK’s concern is understandable: evidence is mounting of the likely damage a departure from the single market and customs union will do to the UK economy.

zh: 据欧洲改革中心（Centre for European Reform）的新研究，如果英国选民当初选择留在欧盟的话，英国经济会比现在规模大2.1 % 。
en: According to new research from the Centre for European Reform, the UK economy is already 2.1% smaller than it would have been had voters chosen to remain.

zh: 对公共财政的总冲击高达每周4.40亿英镑。
en: The hit to public finances totals £440 million ($579 million) per week.

zh: 由于无法预测英国退欧将如何展开，商界十分担忧。
en: The lack of information about how Brexit will play out has businesses worried.

zh: 西门子英国公司首席执行官尤尔根·迈尔（Jürgen Maier）最近敦促英国领导人明确将如何与欧盟展开贸易，要求他们确保英国留在关税联盟中。
en: The CEO of Siemens UK, Jürgen Maier, recently urged British leaders to clarify how trade with the EU will work, urging them to ensure that the country remains in the customs union.

zh: 空中客车警告说 ， “ 无协议”的结果将迫使他们重新评估在英国的长期策略，数千个英国就业岗位将面临危险。
en: Airbus has warned that a “no deal” outcome would force it to reassess its long-term position in the country, putting thousands of British jobs at risk.

zh: 宝马公司重申了留在英国的承诺，但警告成本可能会上升。
en: BMW has affirmed its commitment to remaining in the UK, but warned that costs could rise.

zh: 这些警告并没有受到退欧派的认真对待。
en: Such warnings have not been received kindly by the Brexiteers.

zh: 英国卫生大臣杰里米·亨特（Jeremy Hunt）说这些警告“完全没有根据 ” ， 它们在给首相梅“挖坑 ” 。
en: Britain’s health secretary, Jeremy Hunt, has called them “completely inappropriate,” insisting that they “undermine” Prime Minister Theresa May.

zh: 但梅倒是很擅长给自己挖坑：她宣称 ， “ 退欧红利”将为增加英国国家医保（National Health Service）支出提供一部分资金。 人们广泛认为提高医保是一个骗局。
