en: But May is doing a fine job of undermining herself: her claim that a “Brexit dividend” will partly fund increases in spending on the National Health Service has been widely condemned as a lie.

zh: 但欧盟如何看待所有这些？
en: But what does the EU think of all of this?

zh: 欧盟领导人似乎认为我们英国人已经失去了理智，而他们对此无能为力。
en: It seems that EU leaders have accepted that we British have taken leave of our senses, and there is not much they can do about it.

zh: 他们显然不会去破坏自己成功的、基于法律的经济模式来帮我们的忙。
en: They certainly are not going to undermine their own successful, law-based economic model to do us a favor.

zh: 英国退欧对我们的伤害将远甚于对欧盟的伤害。
en: Brexit will hurt us a lot more than it will hurt the EU.

zh: 可能伤及欧盟 — — 事实上，是威胁到它的基本组织 — — 的是一系列其他挑战，首先是美国总统特朗普对跨大西洋联盟所构成的健康乃至生命威胁，而这一联盟关系是二战后全球秩序的关键支柱。
en: What could hurt the EU – indeed, threaten its very fabric – is a slew of other challenges, beginning with US President Donald Trump’s threats to the health and even survival of the transatlantic alliance, a key pillar of the post-World War II global order.

zh: 特朗普显然更喜欢独裁者而非民主派，也丝毫不尊重他的盟友。
en: Trump plainly prefers dictators to democrats, and lacks any respect for his allies.

zh: 他在新加坡举行的峰会上赞美朝鲜领导人金正恩，这与他在魁北克G7峰会后抨击加拿大总理特鲁多形成了鲜明对比。
en: His praise for North Korean leader Kim Jong-un at their summit in Singapore stood in jarring contrast to his criticism of Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau after the G7 summit in Quebec.

zh: 特朗普问题最大的立场之一是贸易。
en: One of Trump’s most problematic stances relates to trade.

zh: 他基于对贸易的意义的惊人的误解，认定它意味着美国在对抗全世界。
en: He has determined, based on a profound misunderstanding of how trade works, that it pits the United States against the world.

zh: 他不去和欧洲和日本合作并强化世贸组织以遏制中国的重商主义，而是决定单打独斗，大肆攻击最亲密的盟友，威胁要发动全方位贸易战，让包括美国工业和消费者在内的所有人都蒙受损失。
en: Rather than collaborating with Europe and Japan and strengthening the World Trade Organization to counter China’s mercantilism, he has decided to go it alone, attacking even his closest allies in what threatens to escalate into a full-blown trade war that will hurt everyone, not least American industry and consumers.

zh: 欧盟所面临的另一个紧迫挑战是移民。
en: Another pressing challenge facing Europe is immigration.

zh: 今年早些时候，特朗普批准了“零容忍”移民政策，不仅将起诉非法穿越边境的所有成年人 — — 哪怕是寻求庇护者 — — 还要把他们的孩子夺走单独关押（尽管后来他又发布行政令取消了家庭隔离 ） 。
en: Earlier this year, Trump approved a “zero-tolerance” immigration policy that would not only prosecute all adults – even asylum-seekers – illegally crossing the border, but also take their children away to be detained separately (although he has since issued an executive order to reverse the separation of families).

zh: 这绝不是文明国家应该效仿的例子。
en: It is an example that no civilized country should so much as consider copying.

zh: 但一些欧洲人似乎相信，沿着边境树立铁丝网（匈牙利）或将载满移民的船只拒之国门之外（意大利和马耳他）是合情合理的。
en: Yet some in Europe seem to believe that erecting barbed-wire fences along borders (Hungary) or closing ports to ships full of refugees (Italy and Malta) is justified.

zh: 这些行为显然得到了特朗普的首肯。
en: Such behavior certainly gets a Trumpian nod of approval.

zh: 事实上，欧洲的右翼民粹主义者事实上得到特朗普前首席战略顾问史蒂夫·班农（Stephen Bannon）乃至一些美国大使的默许和鼓励。
en: Indeed, right-wing populists in Europe are virtually guaranteed a pat on the back and a few words of encouragement from Trump’s former chief strategist, Stephen Bannon, and even some US ambassadors.

zh: 与此同时，持有文明治理观的欧洲民主派受到了打压。
en: European democrats with a civilized view of governance, meanwhile, are punished.

zh: 德国做了什么导致了他们必须接受理查德·格里内尔（Richard Grenell，他直言渴望“赋权其他保守派 ” ） 来当美国驻德国大使？
en: What did Germany do to deserve Richard Grenell – who has asserted his desire to “empower other conservatives” – as its ambassador from the US?

zh: 答案也许是其中间派总理默克尔“怼”了特朗普。
en: The answer, it seems, is that its centrist chancellor, Angela Merkel, has pushed back against Trump.

zh: 但要让欧洲免受荼毒，谴责美国、祈祷特朗普早日下台是远远不够的。
en: Yet draining the poison from Europe will require a lot more than scolding the US and praying for Trump’s early departure.

zh: 事实上，一些欧盟领导人对于移民等问题所采取的方针有可能创造系统性问题，哪怕特朗普回归他的充斥着高尔夫和破产事务生活，也会长久存在下去。
en: In fact, some EU leaders’ approaches to issues like immigration are threatening to create systemic problems that will endure long after Trump has returned to a life of golf courses and bankruptcy courts.

zh: 明智的欧洲领导人应该恭送英国上路，以便可以将注意力集中到对欧盟长期凝聚力和基本价值观的威胁。
en: Sensible European leaders can be forgiven for politely sending the UK on its way, so that they can focus their attention on threats to their long-term cohesion and fundamental values.

zh: 欧洲人向来因为生活在一个重视保护少数派的社会而自豪，他们向来欢迎穷人和被压迫者。
en: The EU has always prided itself on being a community of values that protects minorities and has welcomed the poor and downtrodden.

zh: 毕竟，欧盟由少数派组成，他们知道贫困和艰苦的分量。
en: The EU is, after all, composed of minorities, and it has known its share of poverty and hardship.

zh: 但默克尔、法国的马克龙和荷兰的吕特这样的民主派，如何与匈牙利、波兰、意大利甚至奥地利的右翼政治领导人拥有共同价值观？
en: But what values could moderate democrats like Merkel, France’s Emmanuel Macron, and the Netherlands’ Mark Rutte possibly share with the right-wing political bosses in Hungary, Poland, Italy, and even Austria?

zh: 令人讨厌的年轻的奥地利总理库尔兹正积极寻求动员人们反对默克尔，即使她对难民的态度让奥地利免于面临大量寻求庇护者涌入。
en: Sebastian Kurz, Austria’s tiresome young chancellor, is actively seeking to mobilize opposition to Merkel, even though her attitude toward refugees saved Austria from a deluge of asylum seekers.

zh: 良好的判断力和经验应该让我们知道，自私的口号、对法治的践踏，以及对国际承诺的无视绝不是好政策。
en: Good sense and experience should tell us that selfish sloganeering, violating the rule of law, and dismissing international commitments is not a recipe for good policy.

zh: 马克龙正确地指出，不能再放任欧尔班的匈牙利和卡钦斯基的波兰从更富裕的欧洲伙伴手中拿钱，却视欧盟价值观为无物。
en: Macron is right to argue that Viktor Orbán’s Hungary and Jarosław Kaczynski’s Poland should no longer be allowed to pick the pockets of their richer European partners, while trampling over EU values.

zh: 欧盟必须拿出团结合作的政策，将效率和基本人道体面相结合，来解决眼前的挑战。
en: The EU must confront the challenges ahead with cohesive, collaborative policies that combine effectiveness with basic human decency.

zh: 比如，在移民问题上，它必须向一个人那样行动起来加强自身边境，同时通过发展援助和安全合作帮助难民的祖国。
en: On migration, for example, it must work as one to strengthen its own borders, while helping, through development assistance and security cooperation, the countries from which people are fleeing.

zh: 有了更多的稳定和开放的市场，这些国家就能够出口产品而不是公民。
en: With more stability and open markets, they will be able to export their products, rather than their citizens.

zh: 至于英国，自己要上床，就得忍受在床上做的噩梦。
en: As for Britain, we made our bed; now we must endure our nightmares in it.

zh: 欧洲无意义的赤字目标？
en: Europe’s Pointless Deficit Targets?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—欧盟的财政规则在近几年中进行了一些急需的改进，但还需要更多的改进。
en: BRUSSELS – The fiscal rules of the European Union have undergone some much-needed improvements in recent years, but much more needs to be done.

zh: 除了在关键问题上缺少明确性，欧盟财政政策依然过于关注短期目标，比如毫无必要地强调年预算周期内的名义赤字目标。
en: In addition to suffering from a lack of clarity on key issues, EU fiscal policy remains overly focused on short-term goals, reflected in its needless emphasis on nominal deficit targets within annual budget cycles.

zh: 诚然，其他成员国的财政可持续性是所有欧盟国家的切身利益。
en: To be sure, all EU countries have a real interest in the fiscal sustainability of their fellow members.

zh: 但年度赤字是衡量一国是否必须为另一国偿还债务的糟糕指标。
en: But annual deficits are poor approximations of the likelihood that one member may have to repay another’s debt.

zh: 如今，可以以存在特殊情况为由将任何必须的调整负担分配到一年以上的时间短 ，这一事实是大有裨益的。
en: The fact that the existence of exceptional circumstances can now be invoked to distribute the burden of any needed adjustments over more than one year is helpful.

zh: 但这并没有消除欧盟财政规则中的短期倾向。
en: But it does not eliminate the short-term bias embedded in the EU’s fiscal rules.

zh: 在充分一体化的市场中，政府赤字的年度融资不应该成为问题，如果债务存量可持续的话。
en: In a fully integrated market, the annual financing of government deficits should not be an issue, provided the stock of debt is sustainable.

zh: 因此，欧盟应该致力于建立一个财政框架，其唯一目标是确保成员国债务可持续。
en: That is why the EU should strive to create a fiscal framework that has the sole objective of ensuring that its members’ debts are sustainable.

zh: 顾名思义，这一目标应该具体到国家。
en: By definition, this target would be country-specific.

zh: 它不要求每一年每一国标题赤字（headline deficit）都低于GDP的3 % 。
en: It would not require a headline deficit of below 3% of GDP in each and every year, in each and every country.

zh: 但它要求比现在更成熟的分析框架，只根据是否符合公债不超过GDP的60%的欧盟标准区分各国。
en: But it would require a more sophisticated analytical framework than the current one, which merely distinguishes between countries on the basis of whether they meet the EU’s 60%-of-GDP ceiling on public debt.

zh: 与以往相比，目前的欧元区处于一个好得多的管理财政压力的位置。
en: The eurozone is much better positioned to manage fiscal pressures than it once was.

zh: 欧洲央行“直接货币交易”机制为债务可持续性提供了重要支撑。
en: The European Central Bank’s “outright monetary transactions” scheme provides an important backstop for debt sustainability.

zh: 而银行联盟一旦完成，也可以遏制金融危机和传染的风险。
en: And a banking union, once completed, should contain the risk of financial crisis and contagion.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲央行的量化宽松降低了对政府现金耗尽的担忧，至少在目前是如此。
en: Meanwhile, quantitative easing by the ECB has reduced fears that governments will run out of cash, at least for the time being.

zh: 让规则更加灵活的措施值得欢迎，但缺陷仍在，特别是考虑到实施风险让规则变化的宏观经济效果难以量化。
en: Efforts to make the rules more flexible are a welcome development, but shortcomings remain, particularly given that implementation risks make the macroeconomic effects of rule changes difficult to quantify.

zh: 比如，如何应对大国的决定比小国具有更大（积极和消极）外部性的事实，为本应平等的货币联盟中的区别对待找到依据，目前尚不清楚。
en: For example, it is not obvious how to deal with the fact that decisions by large countries have larger externalities, both positive and negative, than those made by their smaller peers, setting the ground for different treatment in a monetary union of supposed equals.

zh: 同样不清楚的还有欧盟委员会被授予多大的自由裁量权纠正这类结果。
en: Nor is it clear what room for discretion has been provided to the European Commission to address such outcomes.

zh: 首先，长期财政前景必须充分纳入欧盟及其成员国。
en: Above all, long-term fiscal outlooks must be fully embedded in the EU and its member states.

zh: 机构必须重新设计以适应这一方针，并解决当前框架的某些含糊之处，同时避免歧视或政治化。
en: Institutions will have to be redesigned to accommodate this approach and resolve some of the ambiguities in the current framework, while avoiding discrimination or politicization.

zh: 实现这一目标的一个可能方法是建立独立的委员会，这使欧盟所谓的财政契约现在对欧元区的所有国家都有约束力。
en: One possible vehicle for accomplishing this is the independent councils that the EU’s so-called fiscal compact has now made mandatory for every country in the eurozone.

zh: 这些委员会的任务是评估宏观经济预测的准确性、监督是否符合目标，以及确保长期财政可持续性。
en: These councils are tasked with assessing the accuracy of macroeconomic forecasts, overseeing compliance with targets, and ensuring long-term fiscal sustainability.

zh: 但它们如何契合总体财政框架仍不清楚；事实上，欧盟规则的复杂性可能制约委员会实现其功能的能力。
en: But it remains unclear exactly how they fit into the overall fiscal framework; indeed, the complexity of EU rules may limit the councils’ capacity to fulfill their function.

zh: 财政委员会不能用来解读财政契约的内容。
en: Fiscal councils should not be put in the position of trying to interpret the letter of the fiscal compact.

zh: 更好的做法是让只让它们负责一项任务：评估债务可持续性并向政府提供这方面的建议。
en: It would be far better to provide them with the sole task of assessing debt sustainability and advising governments in this regard.

zh: 它们的建议应该具有约束力，但应该专注于中期而非年度财政结果。
en: Their recommendations should be binding, but they should also be focused on the medium term, rather than on annual fiscal outcomes.

zh: 在一些例子中，财政委员会可以提出比当前的欧盟规则更加严苛的条件，但只限于强制实施每一个财政契约签署国都写入宪法或约束力等同的立法的结构性平衡。
en: In a few cases, fiscal councils might impose conditions that are even more stringent than current EU rules stipulate, but they would be limited to enforcing the structural balance that each signatory of the fiscal compact has enshrined in its constitution or in equally binding legislation.

zh: 在其他例子中，委员会的建议可以比当前欧盟规则的以年为基础的做法更加宽松 — — 特别当委员会需要受到国家议会问责的话。
en: In other cases, the councils’ recommendations are likely to be more relaxed on an annual basis than current EU rules. Either way, the recommendations would have the advantage of being better adapted to local needs – especially if the councils are accountable to national parliaments.

zh: 保持委员会长期独立性的最佳办法是通过欧元区层面的自上而下的监督和控制，比如通过成立一个欧洲财政委员会（European Fiscal Council）负责确保所有国家的委员会都完成使命。
en: The best way to preserve the councils’ independence over time would be through top-down monitoring and control at the eurozone level, for example through the establishment of a European Fiscal Council, which would be responsible for ensuring that every national council fulfills its mandate.

zh: 欧洲财政委员会将得到授权要求对一国的财政历史和要求作出修正评估。
en: The EFC would be authorized to request an amended assessment of a country’s fiscal trajectory and requirements.

zh: 在权限如此有限的情况下，没有必要在欧洲层面上问责欧洲财政委员会或要求其具有民主合法性。
en: With such limited authority, there would be no need for the EFC to be accountable or democratically legitimated at the European level.

zh: 除了有利的长期前景，这一治理结构还能解决一些随灵活性的增加而出现的问题。
en: In addition to favoring a long-term perspective, this governance structure would also answer some of the questions that arise with increased flexibility.

zh: 独立的国家当局不但能更好地评估实施风险，还有利于结构改革。
en: Independent national authorities would be better placed not only to assess implementation risks, but also to advocate for structural reforms.

zh: 此外，这一体系意味着小国受到自上而下的歧视的风险极小。
en: Moreover, such a system would imply little risk of top-down discrimination against smaller countries.

zh: 由于由国家政府负责欧洲的财政可持续性目标，欧盟要求的年度财政预算将不合时宜，应该彻底抛弃。
en: As national governments took responsibility for the European objective of fiscal sustainability, annual budget targets imposed by the EU would become obsolete, at which point that should be abandoned altogether.

zh: 欧元区治理静在沉默中死亡
en: The Silent Death of Eurozone Governance

zh: 布鲁塞尔—有时候，发生的最重要的事是什么没有发生 — — 或者，用夏洛克·福尔摩斯的话说，就是那条在夜里没有叫的狗。
en: BRUSSELS – Sometimes the most important thing that happens is what doesn’t happen – or, to paraphrase Sherlock Holmes, it’s the dog that doesn’t bark in the night.

zh: 欧盟委员会的稳定与增长公约（SGP）在西班牙和葡萄牙没有得到执行也没有引起反应，就属于此列。
en: The lack of response to the European Commission’s non-enforcement in Spain and Portugal of the terms of the Stability and Growth Pact (SGP) is one of those times.

zh: 据SGP，欧盟委员会应该提出就西班牙和葡萄牙大幅度超出财政赤字目标进行罚款。
en: According to SGP rules, the Commission should have proposed a fine to be levied on Spain and Portugal for overshooting their fiscal deficit targets by a wide margin.

zh: 罚款原本也是象征性的，但欧盟委员会似乎认定象征性不值得它出手。
en: The fine would have been largely symbolic, but the Commission seems to have decided that the symbolism wasn’t worth it.

zh: 不但欧盟委员会选择了不叫，欧洲其他国家也保持了沉默。
en: And it was not only the Commission that chose not to bark; the rest of Europe remained silent as well.

zh: 就连欧盟第一紧缩监督官德国也打不起精神。
en: Not even Germany, the European Union’s leading austerity watchdog, perked up.

zh: 事实上，有报道说德国财长朔伊布勒游说多名欧盟委员不要对西班牙和葡萄牙罚款。
en: In fact, there have been reports that German Finance Minister Wolfgang Schäuble lobbied several commissioners not to impose fines on Spain or Portugal.

zh: 德国财经媒体经常批评欧盟委员会管得太松，对这个决定却几乎视而不见。
en: The German financial press, which often criticizes the European Commission for being too lax, barely registered the decision.

zh: 如此沉默原因何在？
en: What explains the silence?

zh: 欧盟的财政宽大有先例可循。
en: There is precedent for fiscal leniency in the EU.

zh: 2003年，欧元区三个大国（法国、德国和意大利）的赤字都超过了SGP所规定的上限、GDP的3 % 。
en: In 2003, all three large eurozone countries (France, Germany, and Italy) were running deficits in excess of 3% of GDP, the upper limit established by the SGP.

zh: 到当年年底，法国和德国（当时失业率处于创纪录水平）都显然不能兑现减赤承诺。
en: Toward the end of that year, it was clear that France and Germany (then with record-high unemployment) were not fulfilling their deficit-reduction commitments.

zh: 但是，与今天不同的是，欧盟委员会倒是叫了（即便它其实不可能真的咬人 ） 。
en: But, unlike today, the Commission did bark (even if it could not really bite).

zh: 它建议扩大SGP的所谓过度赤字程序。
en: It proposed ratcheting up the SGP’s so-called excessive deficit procedure.

zh: 该建议不包括任何罚款；相反，它的重点是考虑罚款之前的阶段。
en: The proposal did not entail any fines; rather, it focused on the stage before fines would be considered.

zh: 尽管如此，欧盟各财政部长强烈反对，原因主要是政治上的。
en: Nonetheless, EU finance ministers strenuously opposed it, largely for political reasons.

zh: 这场冲突占据了整个欧洲的报纸头条，特别是德国，其媒体就像是政治反对派，热衷于批评总理施罗德政府不能坚持财政正确。
en: The clash occupied the front pages of newspapers all over Europe, especially in Germany, where the press, like the political opposition, was eager to chastise Chancellor Gerhard Schröder’s government for its failure to uphold fiscal rectitude.

zh: 就财政规则以及欧盟委员会执行规则的角色问题上出现了热烈的争论。
en: There were heated debates on the fiscal rules, and the Commission’s role in enforcing them.

zh: 简言之，所有人都在嚎叫。
en: In short, everyone was howling.

zh: 尽管遭遇了阻力，欧盟委员会仍然决定行动并公开谴责德国和法国。
en: Despite the resistance, the Commission decided to plow ahead and censure Germany and France.

zh: 它以这一行动清楚地表明，它对于执行欧盟条约的责任是认真的 — — 事实上，其认真程度达到了即使它并不同意的规则也要执行。
en: With that decision, it sent a clear message that it took seriously its responsibility to administer the EU treaties – so seriously, in fact, that it would enforce rules with which it did not necessarily agree.

zh: 事实上，时任欧盟委员会主席普罗迪严厉批评了SGP的僵化。
en: Indeed, the Commission’s then-president, Romano Prodi, had already harshly criticized the SGP’s rigidity.

zh: 但是，最终，政治利益获得了胜利，欧盟财政部长们推翻了这一建议。
en: Ultimately, however, political interests won the day, and the EU finance ministers voted down the proposal.

zh: 财政部长们随后开始了改革SGP，将重点从标题赤字转向考虑经济状态的财政状况指标。
en: The ministers subsequently moved to reform the SGP, shifting the focus from headline deficits to a measure of the fiscal position that takes into account the state of the economy.

zh: 欧盟委员会接受了改革，此后又进行了几次变革，每一次都骄傲地宣布SGP比以往更加“灵活”和“智能 ” 。
en: The Commission accepted the reform, and has since made several additional changes, each time proudly declaring that the SGP is more “flexible” and “intelligent” than ever.

zh: 如今，西班牙和葡萄牙连新的灵活规则都不遵守。
en: Today, Spain and Portugal are not adhering even to the new flexible rules.

zh: 但以主席容克为首的现任委员会就是否要执行规则产生了分歧，一些委员支持宽大处理。
en: Yet the current Commission, led by President Jean-Claude Juncker, was divided on whether to enforce them, with some commissioners favoring leniency.

zh: 似乎朔伊布勒的干预左右了最后的决定。
en: Schäuble’s intervention, it seems, settled the matter.

zh: 显然，在允许政治考虑影响规则的执行方面，情况并没有发生太大变化。
en: Clearly, when it comes to allowing political considerations to affect enforcement of the rules, not much has changed.

zh: 此外，事实上这一回欧盟委员会有更大的力量克服财政部长们的反对。
en: And, in fact, this time around, the Commission had more power to override resistance from finance ministers.

zh: 2008年经济危机后，欧洲引入了“扭转多数规则 ” ， 根据这一规则，欧盟委员会的任何罚款建议都是最终建议，除非欧盟财政部长们以三分之二多数反对。
en: After the 2008 economic crisis, Europe introduced a “reverse majority rule,” under which any Commission proposal to impose a fine is final, unless EU finance ministers can muster a two-thirds majority against it.

zh: 在这里，今天的情况与2003年存在一个关键区别：欧盟��员会对执行SGP的决心减弱了。
en: And herein lies a key difference between today and 2003: the Commission’s commitment to enforcing SGP rules has waned.

zh: 公众和媒体的相对沉默最能说明问题。
en: The relative silence of the public and the media drive the point home.

zh: 对财政规则的支持看不到了。
en: Support for the fiscal rules has faded.

zh: 也许，随着恐怖袭击的激增（特别是在德国和法国 ） ， 人民和领导人被安全问题吸引了注意力。
en: Perhaps, with a surge in terrorist attacks, particularly in Germany and France, citizens and leaders are too preoccupied with security issues.

zh: 英国即将“脱欧”也消耗了大量关注。
en: The United Kingdom’s impending “Brexit” from the EU is also consuming much attention.

zh: 而许多国家持续高企的失业率也许是比减赤更加紧迫的经济问题。
en: And continuing high unemployment in many countries may seem to be a more urgent economic issue than reducing deficits.

zh: 但对欧洲财政规则的支持减弱带来了严重的风险。
en: But the decline in support for European fiscal rules carries serious risks.

zh: 如果欧元区治理框架的大部分实质要素不能严格应用，还拿什么迫使成员国实施改革和稳定债务水平？
en: If the most concrete elements of the eurozone’s governance framework are not applied rigorously, what will compel member states to undertake reforms and stabilize their debt levels?

zh: 含糊不清的告诫是没用的。
en: Vague exhortations will not work.

zh: 危机及其后重债国政府超高的风险溢价似乎已经被忘记了。
en: It seems that the crisis, and the untenably large risk premia for highly indebted governments that followed, has already been forgotten.

zh: 官方而言，欧盟委员会仍在努力实现“真正的”经济和货币联盟的蓝图。
en: Officially, the Commission is still working to realize the blueprint for a “genuine” Economic and Monetary Union.

zh: 但随着欧盟委员会决定不执行SGP，这一努力已经毫无意义。
en: But in the wake of the Commission’s decision not to enforce the SGP, this effort has become meaningless.

zh: 现在比以往任何时候都更加清楚，欧盟成员国认为政治紧迫性比共同规则 — — 以及欧洲的共同好处 — — 更加重要。
en: It is now clearer than ever that EU member states prioritize domestic political imperatives over common rules – and Europe’s common good.

zh: 高估欧盟经济
en: Overestimating the EU Economy

zh: 阿布扎比—欧盟委员会、国际货币基金组织（IMF）和经合组织预测，明年欧盟平均经济增长率将为1.9 % ， 总体与今年的预期水平平均2%保持一致。
en: ABU DHABI – The European Commission, the International Monetary Fund, and the OECD predict that, on average, the European Union’s economy will grow by 1.9% next year, a rate that is broadly consistent with the average of 2% expected for this year.

zh: 但这一预测局面有可能过于乐观，因为增长率本身可能令人失望，也因为欧盟2019年后的增长潜力承受着巨大的下行压力 — — 而目前欧洲领导人似乎还没有准备好营销应对这些压力。
en: But the picture this paints may prove to be overly optimistic, not only because the growth rate itself is likely to disappoint, but also because there is significant downward pressure on the EU’s growth potential beyond 2019 – pressure that, at present, European leaders seem unprepared to counter effectively.

zh: 如果把欧盟比作一支足球队，它不会因为缺少比赛计划或因为实力不济而输掉比赛。
en: If the EU were a soccer team, it would not lose games for lack of a game plan or due to inadequate capacity.

zh: 欧盟经济目前价值近19万亿美元，仍然是世界第二，贡献了大约五分之一的全球产出。
en: Worth nearly $19 trillion, the EU’s economy remains the world’s second largest, constituting about one-fifth of the global output.

zh: 问题在于这支队伍作为一个整体，无法团结比赛，各位顶级球星因为家里情况一团糟而各自为政。
en: The problem is that the team as a whole is not playing cohesively, and all of the top players are struggling individually, owing to messy problems at home.

zh: 在过去的一年中，欧盟采取了一些小措施 — — 如加强共同金融安全网 — — 来增强抵御一路颠簸的总体实力。
en: Over the last year, small steps – such as strengthening the collective financial safety net – have been taken to enhance the EU’s overall capacity to handle bumps in the road.

zh: 但欧盟经济整体构架仍不完善。
en: But the economy’s overall architecture remains incomplete.

zh: 欧元区问题尤其令人关注，银行联盟进展缓慢，财政政策协调哦不力，政治也陷入分裂。
en: The problems are particularly notable in the eurozone, which is challenged by slow progress on banking union, inadequate fiscal-policy coordination, and political divisions.

zh: 而分裂的力量还会进一步加强。
en: And the forces of fragmentation will only strengthen.

zh: 首先，民粹主义政党和领导人影响力越来越大，他们利用广泛存在的身份和移民焦虑，以及对主流精英的失望，在许多国家赢得支持甚至权力。
en: For starters, populist political parties and leaders are increasingly influential, having capitalized on widespread anxieties about identity and migration, together with frustration with mainstream elites, to win support, and even power, in many countries.

zh: 但从选战到决策的转型 — — 不管是在议会中还是（如意大利）在联合政府中 — — 对于一些反建制政党来说十分困难，因为它们缺少全面的政策平台。
en: But the transition from campaigning to decision-making – whether within parliament or, as in Italy, within the governing coalition – has proved to be difficult for several of the anti-establishment parties, given their lack of comprehensive policy platforms.

zh: 这一新增的不确定因素，以及明年举行的欧洲议会选举，让地区协调和决策变得复杂化，而与此同时，许多决策者又被悬而未决的英国退欧问题分散了精力。
en: Together with the election for the European Parliament scheduled for next year, this added layer of uncertainty complicates region-wide coordination and decision-making, at a time when many policymakers are already preoccupied with the as-yet-unresolved issue of Brexit.

zh: 结果，他们可用来消除生产率增长障碍、构建结构更合理的经济以应对迅速的科技进步和全球经济环境变化的能力雪上加霜。
en: As a result, they have even less capacity to dedicate to removing impediments to productivity growth and building a more agile economy capable of responding to rapid technological advances and changes in the global economic environment.

zh: 欧洲流动性环境也不再那么有支持力度，这也是一个担忧点。
en: It doesn’t help that Europe’s liquidity environment is also becoming less supportive.

zh: 欧洲央行已经减缓了资产购买节奏，到今年年底，它还将缩减大规模刺激计划。
en: Having already slowed its asset purchases, the European Central Bank is set to wind down its massive stimulus program at the end of this year.

zh: 欧洲央行行长德拉吉表示，到他任期届满时（2019年10月 ） ， 有可能采取升息。
en: ECB President Mario Draghi has signaled that an interest-rate hike is likely to follow by the end of his term, in October 2019.

zh: 但尽管这些因素都有可能加剧欧盟经济所面临的分裂问题，如果明星球员表现足够强力，军心涣散的球队仍然能够确保胜利。
en: But while these factors threaten to exacerbate the challenge of fragmentation confronting the EU economy, even a disjointed team can secure a victory if its star players manage to perform strongly enough.

zh: 不幸的是，扼杀简单方案、掣肘国家和欧洲决策的国内问题，正在众多欧盟最大经济体肆虐，包括法国、德国、意大利、波兰、西班牙和英国。
en: Unfortunately, domestic issues that defy simple solutions and constrain both national and European policymaking are roiling many of the EU’s biggest economies – France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Spain, and the United Kingdom.

zh: 法国正在被“黄马甲”示威所动摇。 黄马甲运动反对总统马克龙的改革日程。
en: France is being shaken by the “Yellow Vest” protests against President Emmanuel Macron’s reform agenda.

zh: 德国面临深刻的政治变局，总理默克尔准备在这个任期末退休。
en: Germany is facing a deep political transition, as Chancellor Angela Merkel prepares to retire at the end of her current term.

zh: 意大利民粹主义政府正在与欧盟委员会“死磕”其2019年预算方案 — — 该方案也是基于对GDP的乐观假设所指定。
en: And Italy’s populist government is at loggerheads with the European Commission over its proposed 2019 budget, which is also based on optimistic assumptions for GDP growth.

zh: 在波兰，政府采取了所谓的反自由民主，其所追求的政策，在很多人看来与欧盟的价值观和愿景相悖。
en: As for Poland, its government has embraced so-called illiberal democracy, and is pursuing policies that many view as inconsistent with the EU’s values and vision.

zh: 西班牙政府则依然孱弱。
en: Spain’s government, for its part, remains weak.

zh: 而在英国，执政党保守党内部的分裂阻挠了有序的英国退欧程序，让有意义的促增长和促生产率政策计划无从落实。
en: And in the UK, divisions within the ruling Conservative Party are hampering progress toward an orderly Brexit process, precluding meaningful pro-growth and pro-productivity policy initiatives.

zh: 这些挑战都无法在短期内得到解决，欧洲的重要增长引擎看上去将在2019年失去动力。
en: With these challenges unlikely to be resolved soon, Europe’s key growth engines seem set to lose steam throughout 2019.

zh: 与此同时，促进欧盟长期增长潜力的政策有可能仍然只是例外而非规则。
en: Meanwhile, policy efforts to promote the EU’s longer-term growth potential will probably remain the exception, rather than the rule.

zh: 所有这些都将发生在外部支持缺乏（不管是经济还是金融）的环境中。
en: All of this will happen within an external environment that is less supportive, both economically and financially.

zh: 目前，欧盟出口引擎已不足以抵消国内增长动力的疲软。
en: Already, the EU’s export engine is not powerful enough to offset weakening domestic drivers of growth.

zh: 而由于中国放缓导致外部需求下降，增长也将进一步受到削弱。
en: And yet exports are set to suffer further, as a slowing China undermines external demand.

zh: 与此同时，在全球增长放缓、技术弱点和抑制波动的货币扩张过程（包括央行可预测地注入大量流动性）转向等因素的作用下，金融市场波动有可能继续高企。
en: Meanwhile, financial-market volatility is likely to continue, amid slowing global growth, technical vulnerabilities, and the reversal of volatility-repressing monetary expansion, which included ample and predictable liquidity injections by central banks.

zh: 因此，欧盟“队”在国内比赛和国外竞争中都将面临严峻挑战。
en: So the EU “team” is set to face serious challenges both in domestic play and international competition.

zh: 但并非所有消息都是坏消息：技术上，欧盟有比赛计划，也具备按计划行事的内在优势。
en: But the news is not all bad: technically, the EU has both the game plan and the inherent strengths it needs to perform.

zh: 经济已经从金融危机最严重的阶段恢复。
en: The economy has recovered from the worst of the global financial crisis.

zh: 在厘清需要哪些政策步骤实现强力而包容的增长、减少金融脆弱性、阻止长期繁荣的基石受到侵蚀方面，欧盟已经做了大量工作。
en: A lot of work has been done to identify the policy steps required to achieve strong and inclusive growth, reduce financial vulnerability, and stop the erosion of the pillars of longer-term prosperity.

zh: 并且欧盟拥有巨大的未利用或利用不足的内在实力。
en: And the EU has considerable untapped or underused internal capabilities.

zh: 在协作战略的环境下释放这些实力能够大幅改善欧盟的经济表现和前景。
en: Unleashing them in the context of a coordinated strategy could improve the EU’s economic performance and prospects considerably.

zh: 成功需要有能力激发公众又有意愿采取一致的促增长政策计划的政治领袖。
en: Success will require political leaders who are capable of inspiring the public and willing to pursue consistent pro-growth policy initiatives.

zh: 这些领袖崭露头角所花费的时间越长，欧盟避免保级战的困难就越大。
en: The longer it takes for such leaders to emerge, the more difficult it will be for the EU to avoid a relegation battle.

zh: 意大利会拖垮欧洲吗？
en: Will Italy Sink Europe?

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 尽管经历了政治动荡以及全球层面上浮现的诸多风险，欧元区在过去两年间依然实现了强劲经济增长 — — 至少是按照其堪称历史新低的标准做参照 — — 甚至英国都正在步履蹒跚地退出欧盟。
en: LONDON – Despite political turmoil and emerging risks at the global level, the eurozone has had two years of strong economic growth, at least by its own historically disappointing standards – and even with the United Kingdom lurching toward withdrawal from the European Union.

zh: 但随着今年意大利民粹主义政府的出现，只能说欧元区最糟糕的日子还在后头。
en: But with the emergence of a populist government in Italy this year, it is no longer safe to assume that the eurozone’s worst days are behind it.

zh: 在我1982年加入金融这行时，意大利是我研究的第一个国家，因此也对它有着特殊的感情。
en: Italy was the first country that I studied when I entered the financial world back in 1982, so I have a special affection for it.

zh: 我当时为一家大型美国银行工作，对当时频繁参加跨大西洋电话会议讨论意大利的债务与GDP比率的情景依然记忆犹新。
en: I was working for a very large American bank at the time, and I can still remember joining frequent transatlantic conference calls to discuss Italy’s debt-to-GDP ratio.

zh: 当时每个人都在思考该国何时违约；但这一情况却从未出现。
en: The question on everyone’s mind was when the country would default; but it never did.

zh: 相反意大利得以蒙混过关，并从那时起屡试不爽。
en: Instead, Italy muddled through, and has continued to do so ever since.

zh: 即便如此，由于本届意大利政府似乎准备与欧盟对着干，因此违约的忧虑重新出现也就不足为奇了。
en: Still, now that the Italian government seems poised for a standoff with the EU, it would not be surprising if worries about a default were to re-emerge.

zh: 正如我30多年前的经历所表明的那样，意大利的经济问题远在其采用欧元之前就存在了。
en: As my experience more than 30 years ago shows, Italy’s economic problems far predate its adoption of the euro.

zh: 长期以来该国相对欧洲标准的生产率一直低迷，并转化为加入欧元区前相对较低的增长趋势。
en: It has long had poor productivity by European standards, and that translated into relatively low trend growth in the pre-euro decades.

zh: 与此同时不时出现的快速增长刺激措施总会播下各种危机的种子，导致意大利里拉贬值。
en: At the same time, occasional spurts of faster growth regularly sowed the seeds for various crises, often resulting in devaluations of the Italian currency, the lira.

zh: 当然，如今也有些人渴望能回到当年削弱里拉以恢复增长的日子。
en: Of course, there are some who now yearn for the days when the lira could be weakened to restore growth.

zh: 但在单一货币下已经不存在这一选项。
en: That is no longer an option under the single currency.

zh: 然而欧元前浪漫主义者所忽视的一点在于欧元成员国资格赋予了意大利低通胀以及因此产生的低利率。
en: But what the pre-euro romanticists overlook is that euro membership has given Italy low inflation, and thus lower interest rates.

zh: 此外也有理由认为里拉贬值弊大于利。
en: Moreover, there is reason to think that lira devaluations did more harm than good.

zh: 即使这些举措偶尔能刺激一下竞争力，却阻碍了更艰难的、可以在长期内提高生产力的结构性改革。
en: Even if they offered an occasional competitive boost, they stood in for tougher structural reforms that would have increased productivity over the long term.

zh: 还有一些人认为是欧元区的财政和货币框架锁死了意大利，使其名义GDP增长疲软，通胀或许过低且债台高筑。
en: There are also some who believe that the eurozone’s fiscal and monetary framework locks Italy into weak nominal GDP growth, possibly too-low inflation, and high debt.

zh: 然而在新政府上任之前，意大利排除周期性因素后的财政赤字水平相当于欧元区其他国家以及G7的其他成员（加拿大，法国，德国，日本，英国和美国）来说都算是相当的收敛了 — — 这与其基本债务状况相反。
en: Yet before the new government took office, Italy’s cyclically adjusted fiscal deficit – as opposed to its underlying debt position – was often rather restrained compared to the rest of the eurozone, as well as the other members of the G7 (Canada, France, Germany, Japan, the United Kingdom, and the United States).

zh: 无奈一直统领着意大利直到今年的主流政党未能实现该国所需的名义GDP增长。
en: Still, the mainstream political parties that governed Italy until this year did not deliver the nominal GDP growth that the country needs.

zh: 于是意大利人选出了一个非常规执政联盟，其纲领将民粹主义左右两翼的政策拧在了一起。
en: As a result, Italians elected an unconventional coalition whose program combines the policies of the populist left with those of the populist right.

zh: 一边是联盟党承诺减税，另一边五星运动却在寻求某种形式的基本收入。
en: While the League party promises to cut taxes, the Five Star Movement (M5S) is pursuing a form of basic income.

zh: 但意大利需要的其实是一项旨在提高生产力的大范围结构改革计划。
en: But what Italy needs is a broad structural reform program to improve productivity.

zh: 这也是该国目前人口构成状况下实现更高长期增长率的唯一途径。
en: That is the only way to achieve a higher long-term growth rate, given the country’s demographics.

zh: 除了制定提高妇女劳动力参与率的政策外，意大利还必须为其年轻人提供更具吸引力的机会。
en: In addition to enacting policies to boost the labor-force participation rate among women, Italy must provide more attractive opportunities for its young people.

zh: 而欧盟方面则应采取更多措施帮助意大利采取所需的艰难步骤。
en: For its part, the EU should do more to help Italy take the tough steps it needs.

zh: 欧盟委员会，欧洲中央银行和德国政府都错误地执着于《欧盟稳定与增长公约 》 ， 特别是其中财政赤字与GDP比率不得超出3％的条款。
en: The European Commission, the European Central Bank, and the German government have erred in insisting on rigid enforcement of the EU Stability and Growth Pact, particularly the 3%-of-GDP cap on fiscal deficits.

zh: 虽然一些国家在困难时期被允许违反该上限，但由于债务水平较高，意大利几乎从未获得多少扶助。
en: Although some countries have been allowed to breach the deficit cap during challenging times, Italy is almost never afforded much accommodation, owing to its high debt levels.

zh: 但正如比利时和日本的经验所表明的那样，只有通过持续的经济增长才能减少居高不下的政府负债。
en: Yet as the experience of Belgium and Japan shows, high government debt can be reduced only through sustained economic growth.

zh: 使事情进一步复杂化的是一些促进长期生产力的改革实际上会在短期内减少增长。
en: Complicating matters further, some reforms to boost long-term productivity can actually reduce growth in the short term.

zh: 因此任何实施此类措施的政府都需要保留一个采取反周期刺激措施的选项。
en: Thus, any government enacting such measures will need to have the option of pursuing counter-cyclical stimulus.

zh: 另一个问题则涉及到货币政策。
en: Another problem concerns monetary policy.

zh: 欧洲央行应当在如何达致不到2％通胀目标这个问题上表现得更加宽容。
en: The ECB could stand to be more broad-minded in how it pursues its inflation target of just under 2%.

zh: 因为这一目标以及德国自己的2％目标已经使意大利陷入低通胀状态，即使是在它可以从更多货币政策刺激措施中受益之时。
en: That target, along with Germany’s own 2% target, leaves Italy locked into a state of low inflation, even when it could benefit from more monetary-policy stimulus.

zh: 在这种情况下，欧盟当局最好不要过于激烈地反对意大利现政府的计划。
en: Under these conditions, the EU authorities would do well not to oppose the current Italian government’s plans too aggressively.

zh: 如果主流自由主义者担心民选民粹主义政府的影响，那么他们应该更加担心如果经济环境继续恶化下去可能会出现些什么。
en: If mainstream liberals are worried about the implications of a democratically elected populist government, then they should worry even more about what could come next if economic circumstances worsen.

zh: 一言以蔽之，在这个阶段意大利需要的是更强劲的名义GDP增长。
en: At this stage, Italy needs stronger nominal GDP growth – plain and simple.

zh: 有些人会说当年就不应该意大利加入欧元区，而且这一理想货币区的成员资格门槛应该加高。
en: Some will say that it was a mistake to have allowed Italy into the eurozone in the first place, and that an optimal currency zone should have been more discriminating in its membership.

zh: 但德国和法国的商业界坚持认为货币联盟必须包含一些意大利更具竞争力的企业。
en: But the German and French business communities insisted that the monetary union must include some of Italy’s more competitive companies.

zh: 如果意大利被认为是合格的，那么许多其他国家也该如是。
en: And once Italy was considered eligible, so, too, were many other countries.

zh: 最后，那些有权制定和执行欧盟财政和货币规则的人都完全明白如果意大利爆发一次希腊式危机，那么欧元区也会跟着完蛋。
en: At the end of the day, those with the power to set and enforce EU fiscal and monetary rules know full well that the eurozone could not survive a Greek-style crisis in Italy.

zh: 而他们也有责任去确保这种情况在未来几个月不会发生。
en: It is their responsibility in the months ahead to make sure it doesn’t come to that.

zh: 欧洲需要工作岗位
en: European Jobs Wanted

zh: 柏林—1997年，当欧盟首次举行增长和就业峰会时，泛欧盟失业率为11 % 。
en: BERLIN – When the European Union held its first summit on growth and jobs in 1997, EU-wide unemployment stood at 11%.

zh: 去年秋天，当欧盟再次举行增长和就业峰会时，情况没有太大变化。
en: Last autumn, when it held another, not much seemed to have changed.

zh: 欧元区失业率为11.5 % — —2008年一季度曾达到过6.8%的低点。
en: Unemployment in the eurozone was 11.5% – up from a low of 6.8% in the first quarter of 2008.

zh: 欧盟要想兑现其和平与繁荣的承诺，就需要找到办法为更多欧洲公民创造机会。
en: If the EU is to fulfill its promise of peace and prosperity, it will need to find ways to create opportunities for more of its citizens.

zh: 年轻人失业率尤其令人担心，即使是在就业数字相当积极的国家；在劳动力市场情况较差的国家，这意味着潜在社会和政治动荡。
en: Youth unemployment is a particularly serious concern, even in countries with otherwise positive employment statistics; in countries with worse labor-market conditions, it represents a potential source of social and political instability.

zh: 劳动力参与度不但与收入水平相联系，也与自尊、社会包容和社会地位相联系。
en: Participation in the workforce is linked not only to income levels, but also to self-esteem, social inclusion, and social status.

zh: 游离于劳动力市场外增加了贫困和健康恶化的风险，失业状态维持越久，伤害就越大。
en: Being left out of the labor market increases the risk of poverty and poor health, and the longer unemployment lasts, the more damaging the effects.

zh: 没有工作的年轻人在日后的生活中的机会也更少 — — 这是对教育和技能的浪费，对国民经济造成消极影响。
en: Young people who are unemployed have fewer opportunities later in life – representing a waste of education and skills that has a detrimental effect on national economies.

zh: 平心而论，一些欧盟国家在抵挡危机方面做得相当出色。
en: To be sure, some EU countries have managed to weather the crisis reasonably well.

zh: 根据博斯曼基金会（Bertelsmann Stiftung）可持续治理指数（Sustainable Governance Indicators ，SGI）项目的新社会公正排名，奥地利、丹麦和德国在劳动力市场易入性方面名列三甲，随后是瑞典和芬兰。
en: According to a new Social Justice ranking by the Bertelsmann Stiftung’s Sustainable Governance Indicators (SGI) project, Austria, Denmark, and Germany top the list in terms of labor-market access, followed by Sweden and Finland.

zh: 但即使在这些国家，也存在改善空间。
en: But even in these countries, there is room for improvement.

zh: 比如，丹麦曾经被视为劳动力市场改革典范。
en: Denmark, for example, once served as a model for labor-market reform.

zh: 但是，自欧元危机爆发以来，丹麦失业率也有所上升 — — 从2008年的3.5%增加到2014年11月的6.4 % 。
en: Since the start of the euro crisis, however, unemployment has risen – from 3.5% in 2008 to 6.4% in November 2014.

zh: 德国在过去十年中大幅降低了失业率，即使在经济危机时期也是如此。
en: Germany has radically reduced its unemployment rate in the last decade, even during the economic crisis.

zh: 在经历了多年的长期高结构性失业后，从2003年开始，德国实施了一系列劳动力市场和其他改革，其经济也成为欧盟表现最好的经济之一。
en: After years of high and long-term structural unemployment, the country implemented a series of labor-market and other reforms beginning in 2003, turning its economy into one of the top performers in the EU.

zh: 德国的职业培训体系将该国劳动力技能与企业需求相匹配，有助于降低年轻人失业率。
en: The German system of vocational training has matched the skills of the country’s workforce to the needs of its firms, contributing to low youth unemployment.

zh: 但一个麻烦的因素仍然存在：双面劳动力市场的出现，低薪临时工人难以跳出不充分的工作条件，进入主流劳动力市场。
en: But one troubling factor remains: the emergence of a dual labor market, in which low-wage and temporary workers find it hard to transfer out of inadequate working conditions into the mainstream labor market.

zh: 双面劳动力市场问题在整个欧盟都存在。
en: Dual labor markets are a problem throughout the EU.

zh: 根据SGI研究，在处理这一问题上表现最佳的是奥地利：只有8.1%的受访问临时工是因为无法找到固定工作才做临时工的。
en: Austria has dealt with the issue best, according to the SGI study: only 8.1% of temporary employees surveyed had taken temporary work because they could not find permanent positions.

zh: 德国位于列第二，但与奥地利差距明显：21%的受访问临时工说更愿意找固定工作。
en: Germany ranks a distant second, with 21% of those surveyed saying they would prefer a permanent position.

zh: 在受危机冲击的南欧，这一问题更加严重。
en: In crisis-stricken southern Europe, the problem is even worse.

zh: 在西班牙和塞浦路斯，90%的临时工无法找到固定工作。
en: In Spain and Cyprus, more than 90% of people in temporary positions cannot find permanent employment.

zh: 名列前茅的德国和奥地利的另一个问题是特定人群的教育机会的缺失，这造成劳动力市场缺少机会和流动性。
en: Another problem in top-ranked Germany and Austria is the lack of educational opportunities for certain groups, which contributes to a lack of opportunity and mobility in the labor market.

zh: 在奥地利，孩子们从四年级开始进入不同的教育序列。
en: In Austria, children are divided from fourth grade into separate education streams.

zh: 结果，他们的后续教育发展在年幼时就已经决定。
en: As a result, their later educational development is set in stone from an early age.

zh: 父母的社会地位通常决定了孩子是否能获得更高程度的教育。
en: The social status of parents often determines their children’s ability to access higher education.

zh: 高收入父母的孩子和拥有高等教育学历的父母的孩子大学毕业的概率要高得多。
en: Children of higher-income parents and of parents who attended tertiary institutions are far more likely to graduate from university.

zh: 在德国，移民和低收入家庭孩子的教育机会比其他许多经济发达国家都要少。
en: In Germany, educational opportunities for children from immigrant and low-income families are fewer than in many other economically advanced countries.

zh: 在斯堪的纳维亚国家，移民所面临的劳动力市场条件也是个麻烦问题，尽管它们在普及就业方面表现出色。
en: Labor-market conditions for immigrants are also a troublesome issue in Scandinavian countries, which otherwise perform well in enabling access to employment.

zh: 在丹麦，非西方移民的失业率更高，教育成就更低。
en: In Denmark, non-Western immigrants experience higher unemployment rates and lower educational achievement than others.

zh: 类似地，尽管瑞典总体无歧视记录十分出色，但移民仍难以融入瑞典社会，相对土生土长的瑞典人仍要面临劳动力市场劣势。
en: Similarly, despite Sweden’s excellent record on non-discrimination in general, immigrants find it difficult to integrate into Swedish society and face disadvantages in the labor market relative to native Swedes.

zh: 此外，尽管瑞典的就业率名列欧盟前茅，但它也没能处理好长期存在的年轻人失业问题，目前年轻人失业率高达23 % 。
en: Moreover, though Sweden has one of the EU’s highest employment rates, it has failed to tackle its longstanding problem of youth unemployment, which currently stands at 23%.

zh: 在西班牙和希腊，年轻人失业率超过50 % ， 受危机冲击的塞浦路斯、葡萄牙、意大利和克罗地亚情况也很糟糕。
en: In Spain and Greece, youth unemployment is above 50%, and the situation is not much better in crisis-hit Cyprus, Portugal, Italy, and Croatia.

zh: 从欧盟总体看，11月年轻失业率是令人沮丧的21.9 % 。
en: In the EU as a whole, youth unemployment stood at a dispiriting 21.9% in November.

zh: 一份研究显示，这会造成每年1,500亿欧元的工资和支出损失，除此之外，大量无法找到工作的年轻人还将饱受生活之苦。
en: According to one study, this costs the EU €150 billion ($183 billion) per year in lost wages and spending, in addition to the hardship suffered by the many young people who are unable to find work.

zh: 2013年2月，欧盟领导人推出了年轻人就业计划（Youth Employment Initiative ） ， 该计划预算60亿欧元，旨在解决年轻人就业问题。
en: In February 2013, EU leaders launched a Youth Employment Initiative, with a budget of €6 billion, to help alleviate the problem.

zh: 但2014年6月，德国总理默克尔承认，到目前为止，该计划是一场失败。
en: But German Chancellor Angela Merkel admitted in June 2014 that the initiative has so far been a failure.

zh: 欧盟最近的就业峰会也没有提出多少新办法。
en: The EU’s most recent jobs summit did not provide much in the way of new ideas.

zh: 欧盟说，年轻人不应该被排除在就业和教育之外超过四个月；但在实现这一目标方面我们看不到进展。
en: The EU has said that young people should not be out of employment or education for more than four months; but no progress has been made toward making this a reality.

zh: 除非马上采取新观念，否则欧洲的大量失业青年有可能沦为失去的一代。
en: Unless new thinking is adopted soon, Europe’s many unemployed young people risk becoming a lost generation.

zh: 欧洲的主权幻觉
en: Europe’s Sovereignty Illusion

zh: 马德里 — — 欧盟由成员自由意志、而非军事力量推动的民主整合已经站在了制度创新的最前沿，并且达到了前所未有的高度。
en: MADRID ‒ The European Union has taken democratic integration – driven by the free will of its members, rather than military force – to unprecedented levels, securing its place at the forefront of institutional innovation.

zh: 但今天，欧盟的情绪与其说倾向于“合作 ” ， 还不如说更倾向于“冲突 ” 。
en: But today, sentiment in the EU seems to lean toward “conflict," rather than “cooperation."

zh: 某些成员国在伸手索要资金援助的同时仍在鼓吹自己单方面行动的主权权利，还有些则像是纯粹的债主，无视当前债务危机已经造成的社会痛苦。
en: Some member states are touting their sovereign right to embrace unilateral action, even as they request financial assistance, while others are acting as mere creditors, ignoring the social suffering that the current debt crisis has caused.

zh: 要想回到创新一体化的道路上来，欧洲需要建立能支持合作伙伴和友国间有效合作的全新公众讨论框架，而不是任其助长对手间看似不可调和的冲突。
en: To return to the path of innovative integration, the EU needs a new framework for public debate that underpins effective cooperation among partners and friends, instead of fueling conflict among seemingly irreconcilable rivals.

zh: 总体而言，欧洲一体化进程可以算得上和谐、有序和公正。
en: Overall, European integration has been a harmonious, ordered, and just process.

zh: 不太富裕的成员国受益于诸如结构基金和团结基金，利用基金所提供的丰富资源提高本国的人均收入。
en: Less wealthy member countries benefited from tools like the Structural Funds and the Cohesion Fund, which provided considerable resources to enable them to boost their per capita income.

zh: 但长期难以缓解的经济危机已经改变了上述国家民众的看法，有越来越多的人认为欧盟成员国资格起到了更多的负面作用。
en: But protracted economic crisis has changed their citizens' perspective, with a rising proportion viewing EU membership as more costly than beneficial.

zh: 不出所料，上述变化激起了强化“民族主权”的要求，而民粹主义政党，如希腊新当选的激进左翼联盟，已经利用这样的变化取得了选举的成功。
en: Not surprisingly, that change has fueled demands for more “national sovereignty," which populist parties, such as Greece's newly elected Syriza, have translated into electoral success.

zh: 无论右翼还是左翼党派都把国家主权与所谓的“外部势力”尖锐对立，并试图扭转欧盟的政治核心轴。
en: All of these parties, whether on the right or the left, place national sovereignty at odds with the so-called “external powers," and seek to tilt the EU's political axis accordingly.

zh: 正是这种极度简化的观点成为凝聚希腊执政联盟的唯一力量。
en: This reductionist view is the only glue holding the Greek ruling coalition together.

zh: 在上文提到的时髦言论中，主权和“权力”是一回事，而欧盟制度则等同于“不民主 ” 。
en: In this trendy discourse, sovereignty means “empowerment," and EU institutions are “undemocratic."

zh: 主权因此成为对南欧成员国民众极具诱惑力的概念，这些人越来越相信他们被迫成为欧盟“僵化”结构的受害者。
en: Sovereignty has thus become a particularly seductive concept for citizens of the southern member countries, who have increasingly come to believe that the EU's “rigid" structure has been imposed upon them.

zh: 此外，北欧国家也无法抵挡他们自己的简化言论：那就是南欧盟国都是不负责任的败家子，他们留下的烂摊子应该让他们自己收。
en: Meanwhile, the northern EU countries are falling prey to a simplistic message of their own: that their southern counterparts are irresponsible spendthrifts who should be left to solve their own problems.

zh: 全球化造成的恐惧和不确定性是这两种看法的根源所在，民众们担心自己的安全，无法确定自己在当今世界的位置。
en: At the root of both beliefs is the fear and uncertainty generated by globalization, with citizens concerned for their security and unsure of their place in the world.

zh: 但就算人们无法从今天占主导地位的民粹主义言论中意识到，回到以孤立民族国家为特点的全球秩序已经不可能了。
en: But there is no going back to a global order defined by isolated nation-states – even if one would not know it from the populist rhetoric dominating today's discussions.

zh: 当然，欧盟成员国都是主权国家，各自有着独立的谈判地位。
en: Of course, EU members are sovereign states, and they negotiate among themselves as such.

zh: 但他们同时也相互依存，每个成员国的所作所为都受制于外部因素。
en: But they are also interdependent, with each member's actions shaped by external factors.

zh: 这样的相互依存不仅来自于拥有共同货币：更来自于无休无止的社会经济互动使欧盟成员国铸就的动态网络。
en: This interdependence stems not only from a shared currency: it is the fruit of endless socioeconomic interactions that weave the EU member states into a dynamic web.

zh: 因此只公开讨论强制一体化或绝对国家主权这两种极端状况既危险又极具误导性。
en: That is why a public debate that considers only two extreme scenarios – imposed integration or absolute national sovereignty – is misleading and dangerous.

zh: 它把参与者驱赶到对立的角落，导致他们不可避免地发生冲突 — — 我们应该不惜一切代价避免这样的后果。
en: It drives participants into opposite corners, setting them up for conflict – an outcome that should be avoided at all costs.

zh: 其实还存在一条中间道路。
en: There is a middle ground.

zh: 欧盟应继续推进制度民主化，就像允许民主选举产生的欧洲议会在选择在欧盟委员会主席时有发言权一样。
en: The EU should commit to continue democratizing its institutions, as it did when it gave the democratically elected European Parliament a voice in the selection of the European Commission president.

zh: 而作为对手方的欧盟成员国则应当意识到，因为主权集中的收益大过成本，它们作为主权国家自愿选择了整合。
en: For their part, EU member countries should recognize that they, as sovereign actors, chose integration, because the benefits of pooling their sovereignty outweighed the costs.

zh: 欧洲的各项制度都体现了这种的趋向。
en: European institutions reflect this dynamic.

zh: 比方说欧洲稳定机制集体计划就是为了维护欧元区的金融稳定，而不是为了搞统治或搞对抗。
en: The European Stability Mechanism, for example, is a collective project aimed at safeguarding the eurozone's financial stability, not an instrument of domination or confrontation.

zh: 欧洲稳定机制的资源属于所有人，就像国家破产每个人都要遭殃。
en: The ESM's resources belong to everyone, just as one country's bankruptcy affects everyone.

zh: 如果经济稳定的国家无视那些在困难中挣扎的盟国，他们自身的利益也同样会受到影响。
en: When financially stable countries disregard the challenges facing their struggling counterparts, they are acting against their own interests.

zh: 同样，结构基金和团结基金进行经济转移的主体是主权、民主国家。
en: Likewise, the economic transfers conducted through the Structural Funds and the Cohesion Fund involved sovereign, democratic countries.

zh: 向欧洲伙伴国申请救助的是希腊、葡萄牙、塞浦路斯和爱尔兰等国的主权政府。
en: And it was the sovereign governments of Greece, Portugal, Cyprus, and Ireland that requested bailouts from their European partners.

zh: 希腊已经拿到了占本国GDP 117%的援助；塞浦路斯占GDP的55.9 % ， 紧接着是爱尔兰和葡萄牙，分别占各自GDP的 45.1%和46.6 % 。
en: Greece has already received aid worth 117% of its GDP; in Cyprus, the figure is 55.9%, followed by Ireland and Portugal, at 45.1% and 46.6%, respectively.

zh: 显然，既然相互依存无法避免；那么就必须承担相应的责任。
en: Clearly, interdependency cannot be avoided; nor can the responsibility than it entails.

zh: 只要碰到困难就退而幻想纯国家主权能解决欧盟各国所有问题其实不过是一种认识谬误和政治幻想，因此会在社会上带来相当大的负面影响。
en: The idea that, when the going gets tough, an EU country can solve all of its problems by reverting to pure national sovereignty is an intellectual fallacy, a political chimera, and thus a source of considerable social frustration.

zh: 主权和相互依存并不是排他选项。
en: Sovereignty does not negate interdependence.

zh: 各国应彻底放弃某种神乎其神的主权形式能使其既不用承担高昂成本又可以逃脱身为欧盟成员国责任的幻想。
en: It is time for countries to abandon the notion that there is some magical form of sovereignty that will allow them to escape their responsibilities as EU members without incurring serious costs.

zh: 在当今欧洲的现实世界中，债务国不能撕毁为求得援助所签署的协议，而债权国也必须认识到有必要继续为救助基金提供资金援助。
en: In the real world of Europe today, debtors cannot break agreements that they have made in exchange for aid, and creditors must recognize the need to continue contributing resources to the bailout fund.

zh: 此外债权国还应当明白就像他们数十年来对团结基金的出资，类似的援助资金不会把他们的口袋掏光（比如将国内的公共养老金花光 ） 。
en: It would also help if creditors understood that their contributions, like their decades of support to cohesion funds, will not impoverish them (by, say, depleting their public pensions).

zh: 相反，更加稳定、偿付能力更强的出口伙伴也能够惠及债权国。
en: On the contrary, creditor countries will benefit from more stable, solvent commercial partners for their exports.

zh: 主权神话在欧盟已太过根深蒂固，助长了危险的民族主义情绪和对“他人”的惧怕。
en: The myth of sovereignty has been perpetuated for far too long in the EU, fueling dangerous nationalist sentiment and fear of the “other."

zh: 会员国，首先从希腊开始，必须承认相互依赖不可避免 — — 事实上如果管理得当，甚至可以取得很好的效果。
en: Member countries, beginning with Greece, must acknowledge that interdependency is unavoidable – and, indeed, desirable, if managed properly.

zh: 希腊总理亚历克西斯·齐普拉斯最近承认 ， “ 欧洲是个注重协商和互惠妥协的地方。
en: As Greece's prime minister, Alexis Tsipras, admitted recently, “Europe is a space for negotiation and mutually beneficial compromises."

zh: ”融合是共同选择 — — 而且充满了积极意义。
en: Integration was a choice – and a positive one.

zh: 欧洲在强化多重身份，避免冲突方面还有许多工作要做。
en: Europe has much work to do to strengthen the multiple identities needed to avoid conflict.

zh: 无论来自北部还是南部，德国还是希腊，我们都是欧洲的民众。
en: Whether we are from the north or the south, from Germany or Greece, we are all European.

zh: 而且欧洲给了我们更加多彩和富足的生活。
en: And we are richer for it.

zh: 欧洲的决策时刻
en: Decision Time for Europe

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 无论你对欧盟有何抱怨，但它绝不缺乏雄心壮志或实现它们的蓝图。
en: STOCKHOLM – Say what you will against the European Union, but it does not lack ambitions or plans for realizing them.

zh: 几乎紧随2016年6月英国脱欧公投后，欧盟的其他27个成员国一致通过了“伯拉第斯拉瓦路线图 ， ” 制定一个没有英国的未来发展规划。
en: Almost immediately after the June 2016 Brexit referendum, the EU’s 27 other member states agreed to the “Bratislava Roadmap,” charting the course for a future without the United Kingdom.

zh: 一年后，欧盟领导人再次汇聚塔林，并通过了一项截止“2019年5月欧洲议会选举前指导欧盟行动”的“领导人计划 ” 。
en: One year later, EU leaders reconvened in Tallinn and adopted a “Leaders’ Agenda” to “guide EU action up until the European Parliament elections in May 2019.”

zh: 而目前，我们正在筹备罗马尼亚锡比乌峰会，就在锡比乌峰会召开的同一个月，将会最终确定这些蓝图的模样。
en: And now, the EU is preparing for a summit in Sibiu, Romania, that same month, where these blueprints will be finalized.

zh: 尽管如此，最终评判欧盟的不是解决方案而是结果。
en: Still, the EU ultimately will be judged on results, not resolutions.

zh: 过去十年中，集团曾面临两次重大的挑战，现在仍在面对第三次挑战的过程中。
en: Over the past decade, the bloc has faced two profound challenges, and it is now in the process of confronting a third.

zh: 最开始是可能导致共同货币消亡的欧元危机。
en: The first was the euro crisis, which could have ended with the demise of the common currency.

zh: 相反，当时欧洲国家召开了一系列峰会，而欧洲成功度过了这次危机。
en: Instead, a series of summits were held, and Europe managed to muddle through.

zh: 随着时间的推移，成员国经济开始复苏，与此同时，还采用了协调欧元区经济政策的新工具。
en: With time, member states’ economies started to recover, and new instruments for coordinating economic policy within the eurozone were adopted.

zh: 但就在欧盟开始重新赢得公众信任时，又突然遭到2015年难民危机的打击，此次危机对某些国家的影响远远超过其他国家，由此暴露出在适用有关人员流动共同准则方面明显的不一致。
en: But just when the EU was starting to regain the public’s trust, it was hit by the 2015 refugee crisis, which affected some countries far more than others, exposing glaring inconsistencies in the application of common rules concerning the movement of people.

zh: 从那以后，前往欧洲的庇护寻求者人数已经大幅下降，但对2015年情景重现的担忧继续困扰着选民。
en: The number of asylum seekers traveling to Europe has since fallen substantially, but fears of a return to 2015 continue to haunt voters.

zh: 而且从更广义的角度讲，人们越来越意识到中东冲突和非洲人口趋势如何有可能威胁到欧洲的稳定。
en: And, more broadly, there is a growing awareness of how conflicts in the Middle East and demographic trends in Africa could threaten European stability.

zh: 现在又爆发了第三次挑战：那就是英国即将到来的从欧盟的退出。
en: Now comes the third challenge: the UK’s impending withdrawal from the EU.

zh: 由于首相特雷莎·梅迄今为止未能获取议会对其所谈判达成的退出协议的支持，英国正处在一场全面爆发的政治危机当中，欧盟领导人则别无选择只能在一旁观望这场闹剧。
en: With Prime Minister Theresa May having so far failed to secure parliamentary support for her negotiated exit deal, Britain is in the midst of a full-scale political crisis, and EU leaders have no choice but to watch from the sidelines as the drama unfolds.

zh: 这个曾经领导世界的国家现在甚至领导不了自己。
en: A country that once led the world now cannot even lead itself.

zh: 随着欧洲议会选举快速临近，现在根本没有时间去沾沾自喜。
en: With the European Parliament election fast approaching, this is no time for complacency.

zh: 在经历了英国脱欧公投和2016年唐纳德·特朗普当选所造成的恐慌后，法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙在2017年的当选又重新点燃了人们的希望。
en: After the horrors of the Brexit referendum and Donald Trump’s election in 2016 came a renewal of hope with French President Emmanuel Macron’s election in 2017.

zh: 但在2018年，欧洲前景重又陷入到一种深刻的不确定状态 — — 不确定性最强的莫过于法国。
en: But in 2018, Europe’s prospects reverted to a state of deep uncertainty – nowhere more so than in France itself.

zh: 没有人知道2019年将会带来什么。
en: There can be no telling what 2019 will bring.

zh: 我们所知道的是，随着民众支持从大规模主流政党转向新贵政党和左右翼运动，整个欧盟的治理正变得越来越具有挑战性。
en: What we do know is that governance across the EU is becoming more challenging as large mainstream political parties lose support to upstart parties and movements of both the left and the right.

zh: 在这个日益分散和两极化的政治格局中，组建国家政府的过程已经变得漫长而又艰巨；就连瑞典也在追随这种不幸的新模式。
en: In this increasingly fragmented and polarized political landscape, the process of forming national governments has become long and arduous; even Sweden is following this unfortunate new pattern.

zh: 更糟的是，欧洲各国的经济增长似乎正在放缓 — — 这种状况甚至在法国爆发大规模游行 、以及意大利就其预算案问题与欧盟展开对抗之前就出现了。
en: Making matters worse, economic growth across the EU appears to be slowing – and that was even before the eruption of mass protests in France and Italy’s confrontation with the EU over its proposed budget.

zh: 虽然意大利民粹主义政府试图将该国的问题归咎于布鲁塞尔的欧盟官僚机构，但马克龙却通过呼吁建立更强大的欧盟体系来回应公众的担忧。
en: Whereas Italy’s populist government has sought to blame the country’s problems on the EU bureaucracy in Brussels, Macron has responded to public concerns by calling for even stronger EU institutions.

zh: 但以上两种观点都忽略了这样一个事实，那就是变化只能取决于在政治上带来痛苦的国内改革。
en: But both perspectives elide the fact that change will depend on politically painful domestic reforms.

zh: 此外，无论安格拉·默克尔总理已经任职多长时间，事实已经证明对成立对“拨款联盟”的支持绝不在德国的考虑范围中。
en: And besides, regardless of how long Chancellor Angela Merkel remains in office, it is already clear that German backing for a “transfer union” is not in the cards.

zh: 现实的危险是德国、法国、意大利和英国政治局势的不确定性将推动民粹主义者和像匈牙利总理维克多·奥尔班那样自称为“非自由”民主人士的力量修砌起更多围墙（这个词既包含实际意义也包含比喻意义）和调动民族主义幽灵的努力更加有机可乘。
en: The danger now is that political uncertainty in Germany, France, Italy, and the UK will create an opening for populists and self-declared “illiberal” democrats such as Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán to build more walls (physically as well as metaphorically) and mobilize the ghosts of nationalism.

zh: 此外，欧洲的外部环境已经变得更具危险性。
en: Moreover, Europe’s external environment has become more dangerous.

zh: 尽管世界各国的注意力现在集中在中美贸易战升级上，但具有同等破坏性的跨大西洋冲突威胁也是不容忽视的。
en: Though the world’s attention is currently fixed on the risks of an escalating Sino-American trade war, the threat of an equally destructive transatlantic conflict cannot be ignored.

zh: 特朗普似乎真心相信纽约街头的德国汽车会对美国国家安全构成威胁。
en: Trump seems genuinely to believe that German cars on the streets of New York pose a threat to US national security.

zh: 如果他哪天早晨醒来决定对欧洲汽车征收高额进口关税，那么局势很有可能在很短的时间内就变得一团糟。
en: Should he wake up one morning and decide to impose heavy import tariffs on European cars, things could get very ugly, very fast.

zh: 许多欧洲决策者已经认定总部设在美国的科技巨头对欧洲安全构成了威胁，他们会很高兴有机会针对这些高科技企业采取强硬行动。
en: Many European policymakers, already convinced that the US-based tech giants are a threat to European security, would welcome the opportunity to pursue stronger actions against them.

zh: 如果美国也作出类似回应，那么受害人数将会迅速增加。
en: If the US responded in kind, the casualties would pile up quickly.

zh: 人们也不能忘记欧盟外围地区不断升级的地缘政治和人道主义挑战。
en: One also cannot forget the mounting geopolitical and humanitarian challenges on the EU’s periphery.

zh: 特朗普在对伊朗痴迷情绪的推动下，似乎有意加剧中东地区冲突。
en: Trump, driven by an obsession with Iran, seems intent on aggravating ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.

zh: 而且，认为俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将不会干涉乌克兰即将进行的总统和议会选举的想法将会十分荒谬。
en: And it would be absurd to think that Russian President Vladimir Putin will refrain from interfering in Ukraine’s upcoming presidential and parliamentary elections.

zh: 俄罗斯对刻赤海峡的封锁 — — 该海峡是具有重要战略意义的亚速海进入点 — — 以及在克里米亚的军事集结都表明欧洲绝不能放松警惕。
en: Russia’s blockade of the Kerch Strait – the entry point to the strategically important Sea of Azov – and military buildup on Crimea indicate that Europe cannot let down its guard.

zh: 为应对现在和未来的挑战，欧盟必须从2019年开始对自己进行重新定义。
en: To manage these and future challenges, the EU will have to redefine itself, starting in 2019.

zh: 在如今越来越危险的地缘政治环境中，欧盟绝不能再仅仅依靠软实力。
en: In an increasingly dangerous geopolitical environment, the EU can no longer rely solely on soft power.

zh: 而且，就像所有政府一样，欧盟必须开始筹备数字革命，要么就有可能在近期和远期付出惩罚性的代价。
en: And, as is the case for all governments, it must start preparing for the digital revolution, or risk punishing costs over the near and long term.

zh: 伯拉第斯拉瓦路线图、领导人议程和即将举行的锡比乌峰会都值得欢迎 — — 甚至十分必要。
en: The Bratislava Roadmap, the Leaders’ Agenda, and the upcoming Sibiu summit are all well and good – even necessary.

zh: 但就像2018年是混乱之年一样，2019年将是决策之年。
en: But whereas 2018 was a year of confusion, 2019 will be year for decision-making.

zh: 欧洲领导人必须直面世界不断变化的残酷现实。
en: European leaders must face up to the brutal realities of a changing world.

zh: 只有这样，选民才会相信他们能够开拓一条通往未来和平与繁荣的崭新道路。
en: Only then will voters trust them to forge a new path toward a future of peace and prosperity.

zh: 超越危机状态的移民
en: Migration Beyond Crisis Mode

zh: 马德里 — — 过去七年来，欧洲一直处在危机状态，几乎就没有间断过。
en: MADRID – Over the past seven years, Europe has been in crisis mode almost without interruption.

zh: 从乌克兰到希腊的一系列事件让欧洲大陆从受尽煎熬到面对熊熊战火，期间伴随着连绵不断的首脑会议、正式宣言和边缘政策。
en: From Ukraine to Greece, events have led the continent from the frying pan to the fire and back again, with all of the attendant summitry, declarations, and brinkmanship.

zh: 现在需要欧盟关注的移民危机已经爆发 — — 上述危机不太可能在可以预见的未来顺利解决。
en: Now, it is a migration crisis – one that is unlikely to be resolved in the foreseeable future – that is commanding the European Union’s attention.

zh: 但如果欧洲想要采取有效对策，就必须超越危机状态理解自身的目标和现实局势。
en: But, if Europe is to respond effectively, it must move beyond crisis mode to understand both what it is facing and what it wants to achieve.

zh: 移民应该引起欧盟的关注已经是不争的事实。
en: It is indisputable that migration deserves the EU’s focus.

zh: 欧洲移民人数不仅月月打破记录；移民的主要进入点也在不断变化之中。
en: Not only are migrant flows into Europe shattering records from one month to the next; migrants’ primary entry points are changing as well.

zh: 此外，寻求庇护者、难民、流离失所者和单纯经济移民之间本已模糊的界限变得愈加难以区分。
en: Meanwhile, the already-hazy lines between asylum-seekers, refugees, displaced persons, and purely economic migrants are becoming increasingly difficult to distinguish at all.

zh: 移民之路的危险状况构成了严重的人道主义危机。
en: The dangerous conditions of the migrants’ journey constitute a serious humanitarian crisis.

zh: 今年年初以来，约有2，500人死于试图穿越地中海，更不用说最近像奥地利一辆废弃卡车中发现71具腐烂尸体那样的可怕场景。
en: Since the beginning of this year, roughly 2,500 people have died attempting to cross the Mediterranean, to say nothing of gruesome scenes like the recent discovery of 71 decomposing bodies in an abandoned truck in Austria.

zh: 成千上万人滞留在临时搭建的帐篷中几乎得不到任何支持。
en: Thousands more languish in makeshift camps with little or no support.

zh: 更糟的是，从德国有人策划纵火袭击难民收容所到马其顿和匈牙利警方针对移民的暴力事件，欧洲一直就存在着针对移民的暴力行为。
en: To make matters worse, there has been a steady stream of migration-related violence across Europe, from an arson attack on a planned refugee shelter in Germany to police brutality against migrants in Macedonia and Hungary.

zh: 加来港已经成为危机的瓶颈，移民在那里拼命试图强行登上开往英国的卡车和火车。
en: The port of Calais has become a chokepoint of the crisis, with migrants desperately trying to force their way onto trucks and trains bound for the United Kingdom.

zh: 目前局势时时处处昭示着“紧急 ” — —欧盟也因此采取了措施。
en: The situation screams “emergency” – and has triggered a response by the EU.

zh: 最引人注目的是，欧盟已将海卫行动的预算增加了三倍，目的是加强边境安全；在地中海启动了欧洲范围内针对 走私贩运人口的海军行动（EUNAVFOR Med ） ； 并为不堪重负的一线会员国划拨了额外的资金。
en: Most notably, the EU has tripled the budget of Operation Triton, designed to strengthen border security; launched an EU-wide naval operation against human smugglers and traffickers in the Mediterranean (EUNAVFOR Med); and allocated additional funds to overwhelmed frontline member countries.

zh: 某些成员国也采取了行动。
en: Some individual member countries have also acted.

zh: 其中以德国最为显著，该国在今年面临 800,000名庇护寻求者入境的情况下已暂停执行可能导致数千名叙利亚难民被驱逐的欧盟都柏林公约。
en: Most notably, Germany, despite facing the arrival of a predicted 800,000 asylum-seekers this year, has suspended implementation of the EU’s Dublin Regulation, which would have led to the deportation of thousands of Syrian refugees.

zh: 但上述措施虽然不无帮助，但却远远解决不了问题。
en: But these measures, though helpful, are far from adequate.

zh: 事实上，它们是危机模式决策活生生的例子，相比于真正的解决办法，更倾向于采取看似令人印象深刻的权宜性措施（更不用说称得上空洞或夸张的豪言壮语 ） 。
en: In fact, they are examples of crisis-mode policymaking, which tends to favor impressive-seeming stopgap measures (not to mention lofty declarations that can verge on hollowness or hyperbole), instead of real solutions.

zh: 这种方法允许欧盟领导人避免承认移民挑战的长期性，并因此削弱了他们采取集体行动的动机。
en: By allowing EU leaders to avoid acknowledging the long-term nature of the migrant challenge, this approach weakens their motivation to take collective action.

zh: 事实上，上月召开的欧盟司法和内政事务委员会已经表现出不愿合作的姿态，会议代表未能就如何分配欧洲理事会在6月协议安排的区区40，000名难民达成一致。
en: And, indeed, a reluctance to cooperate was on display at last month’s meeting of the EU’s Justice and Home Affairs Council, where representatives failed to produce an arrangement on how to distribute the paltry 40,000 refugees that the European Council agreed to accept in June.

zh: 事实上，移民压力仍将持续下去。
en: The fact is that the pressure of migration is here to stay.

zh: 毕竟，驱动成千上万人甘冒一切风险奔赴欧洲的因素根本没有消除。
en: After all, the factors driving hundreds of thousands of people to risk everything to get to Europe are nowhere near being resolved.

zh: 伊拉克和叙利亚依然陷于暴力和混乱；厄立特里亚处于专制政权的掌控之中；利比亚则成了崩溃国家的典型。
en: Iraq and Syria remain mired in violence and chaos; Eritrea is in the grip of a repressive regime; and Libya has become a collapsed state.

zh: 再加上非洲大部分地区脆弱或几乎感觉不到的治理（以及由此造成的安全威胁和黯淡的经济前景 ） ， 很难想象移民潮能够得到遏制。
en: Add to that weak or non-existent governance in much of Africa (and the concomitant security threats and bleak economic prospects), and it is difficult to imagine how the tide of migrants will be slowed.

zh: 美好生活的机会 — — 或者任何生的机会 — — 在这些地区的民众看来都无法抗拒。
en: The chance of a better life – or any life at all – is all but irresistible to the people trapped in these areas.

zh: 无论欧盟的对外边界多么强大 — — 尽管改善监管和巡逻措施确有必要 — — 移民人数仍将继续超过他们的防御能力，从而对自申根协议始的开放这一欧洲统一的基础构成威胁，申根协议确保欧盟26个成员国民众在没有边界控制的情况下能够自由迁徙。
en: No matter how strong the EU’s external borders are – though, of course, better monitoring and patrolling measures are needed – the flow of migrants will continue to overwhelm their capacity, endangering the openness that is so fundamental to European unification, beginning with the Schengen acquis, which guarantees freedom of movement, without border controls, among 26 European countries.

zh: 欧盟要想应对移民挑战，设计出欧盟委员会主席让-克劳德·容克称之为“集体勇气”的现实有效的解决办法，就必须对当前移民潮的根源和促成因素发起攻击。
en: If Europe is to adapt to the migrant challenge, and design realistic and productive solutions that heed European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker’s call for “collective courage,” it must target the root causes and enablers of the current migration wave.

zh: 具体而言，欧盟必须支持治理改革和经济发展，并在移民逃离的国家保障最基本的人权。
en: Specifically, the EU must support governance reform, economic development, and the establishment of basic human security in the countries that migrants are fleeing.

zh: 同时，需要通过与主要来源国和过境国建立伙伴关系，强化前往欧盟边境途中和靠近欧盟边境的威慑力。
en: At the same time, efforts are needed to strengthen deterrence near and en route to Europe’s borders, through partnerships with major source and transit countries.

zh: 应当为那些按国际法规定理应得到保护或掌握可能有利于欧洲社��技能的人开辟合法的移民途径。
en: Legal channels of migration should be opened for those who either deserve protection under international law or possess skills that could benefit European societies.

zh: 必须为没有资格享受国际法保护、也不具备上述重要技能的移民设立遣返机制。
en: For migrants who reach EU territory, are not entitled to international legal protection, and lack such vital skills, repatriation regimes must be established.

zh: 所有这一切都需要更新移民的法律分类并实现欧盟内部责任共担，这在现在看来都是极其缺乏的机制。
en: All of this will require an update of the legal categorizations of migrants, as well as burden-sharing within the EU, which is glaringly absent at the moment.

zh: 欧盟不能简单通过零零星星地实施恐慌性措施，等待当前的移民危机自己过去。
en: The EU cannot simply wait out the current migration crisis by implementing piecemeal and panicked measures in the hope that the problem will eventually resolve itself.

zh: 现在需要认真思考如何平衡人道主义原则与安全问题、国际法律义务与国内社会福利、各成员国间的相互义务以及对国内民众的责任问题。
en: What is needed is careful consideration of how best to balance humanitarian imperatives with security concerns, domestic social welfare with international legal obligations, and member countries’ duties to one another with their responsibilities to their own citizens.

zh: 只有这样，领导人才能设计出深思熟虑、全面的前瞻性战略，解决移民危机和欧盟自身的生存问题。
en: Only then can leaders design the kind of thoughtful, comprehensive, and forward-looking strategy that the migrant crisis – and, indeed, the EU’s own survival – demands.

zh: 构建以人为本的欧洲
en: Putting People First in Europe

zh: 发自巴黎 — — 推动了英国脱欧的那股民粹主义不满情绪正弥漫在整个欧洲上空，让人们意识到政策制定者们早已偏离了欧洲计划的核心宗旨：为全体欧洲人造福。
en: PARIS – The same type of populist discontent that fueled Brexit in the United Kingdom is on the rise throughout Europe, suggesting that policymakers have lost sight of the European project’s central objective: to ensure the wellbeing of all Europeans.

zh: 正如在1990年发布的第一份《联合国人类发展报告》所指出的那样 ： “ 人民才是一个国家真正的财富。 ”
en: As the first United Nations Human Development Report put it in 1990: “People are the real wealth of a nation.”

zh: 让一个国家或地区的人们充分发挥自身能力的最好方法莫过于实现社会公平。
en: The best way to capitalize on the people of a country or region is through social equity.

zh: 而阿马蒂亚·森（Amartya Sen）在其名作《正义的理念》中指出，真正的社会公平不是要求平等对待所有人，而是要给予穷人和那些遭遇逆境者更好的待遇。
en: Amartya Sen, in his magisterial The Idea of Justice, concluded that true social equity requires not equal treatment for all, but rather unequal treatment in favor of the poor and most disadvantaged.

zh: 仅仅在公共财政或法律面前平等是不够的，还得考虑个人和社会群体在竞争起点上的不同。
en: Mere equity in public finance or in the eyes of the law is not enough if we don’t also consider the different starting points for individuals and groups in society.

zh: 有见及此，自1990年以来的每一份联合国发展报告都表明如果某地的公共政策能把民生放在首位，则其经济和政治都会变得更加强大。
en: Recognizing this, successive UN development reports since 1990 have made the case that both economies and societies are stronger when public policy puts people’s wellbeing first.

zh: 但这种理念却尚未在欧盟的精英决策圈里扎根，那些心怀善意的经济学家和政治家的人相信自己正在通过平衡预算和控制支出（通常由削减在医疗、 教育和基础设施预算）等手段做着正确的事。
en: However, this outlook hasn’t yet taken root in the EU’s elite policymaking circles, where well-meaning economists and politicians often believe they are doing the right thing by balancing budgets and reining in spending, usually by cutting health, education, and infrastructure budgets.

zh: 这些政策制定者在缺乏实证证据的情况下都认为今天的财政削减将带来明天的经济繁荣。
en: These policymakers, with little empirical evidence, believe that fiscal prudence today will lead to a stronger economy tomorrow.

zh: 这是隐藏在当前欧洲政策组合背后的理念，将财政紧缩与“结构性改革”相结合，减少构建社会安全网的支出，放宽那些保障劳动者权益的规定。
en: This is the thinking behind the current policy mix in Europe, where fiscal austerity is combined with “structural reform,” meaning less spending on the social safety net and less regulation to protect workers.

zh: 而这些政策的成本显然主要由穷人和中产阶层来承担。
en: Obviously, the costs of these policies are mostly borne by the poor and the middle class.

zh: 但这种手段会引发其他几个问题。
en: But there are several other problems with this approach as well.

zh: 首先，它对大多数人的收入状况不利。
en: First, it isn’t good for most people’s incomes.

zh: 牛津大学经济学家托尼 · 阿特金森（Tony Atkinson）就通过不平等状况来观察英国的经济表现，人们一般认为经济增长强劲的1980年代，不平等状况却不断恶化；而这一点在增长低迷的1990年代却有所改善。
en: When the Oxford University economist Tony Atkinson looked at the UK’s economic performance through the lens of inequality, the 1980s, generally considered a strong decade in terms of growth, appeared much worse; and the 1990s, regarded as a low-growth decade, appeared much better.

zh: 阿特金森的调查结果指向一个中心问题︰ 谁从增长中受益 — — 多数人还是少数人？
en: Atkinson’s findings point to a central question: Who benefits from growth – the many or the few?

zh: 如果所谓的经济增长是少数人囊括大部分收益，而其他人只能维持原状甚至减少，经济增长的概念就没有意义了。
en: If an economy can be said to be growing when a small minority receives most of the gains while everyone else’s lot stays the same or decreases, the concept of economic growth loses much of its meaning.

zh: 这又引出了现行范式下的第二个问题，就是把抽象的经济指标放在真实的民众之上。
en: This leads to a second problem with the prevailing paradigm, which is that it puts abstract economic indicators before actual people.

zh: 因为国内生产总值是衡量任何经济价值的首选项，许多为民众福祉作出贡献的很多因素被忽视���，而那些如卫生和教育类的基本需求开支则来被视为成本，而不是一项至关重要的投资。
en: Because gross domestic product is the preferred gauge of any economy’s value, many factors that contribute to human wellbeing are ignored, and spending on fundamental needs, such as health and education, comes to be seen as an expense rather than an essential investment.

zh: 如果政策制定者认为这种支出视为一种投资，他们就会开始考虑如何将回报最大化。
en: If policymakers viewed such spending as an investment, they could start thinking about how to maximize returns.

zh: 像所有对人力资源或固定资本的投资那样，越高的投资水平可能伴随着收益的递减。
en: Like all investments in human or fixed capital, there may be diminishing returns at high levels.

zh: 因此政策制定者与其将经济利益都导向富人并假设这些好处能“漏点下去 ” ， 应评估是否投资为穷人创造机会能更多地促进经济增长。
en: So, rather than funneling economic benefits to the rich and assuming it will “trickle down,” policymakers should assess whether investing in opportunities for the poor actually does more for economic growth.

zh: 美国1944年的《军人转业安置法案》之所以成功，因为它为那些最需要培训的人提供了支持，让归国二战老兵顺利融入生产性经济。
en: In the US, the 1944 Servicemen’s Readjustment Act (better known as the GI Bill) was a success because it provided training for those most in need of it, enabling returning World War II veterans to re-enter the productive economy.

zh: 该法案创建了一支受过良好教育的劳动力队伍，为大多数美国人迎来了一个收入增长的年代。
en: The bill created a more educated workforce and ushered in a period of rising incomes for most Americans.

zh: 目前手段的第三个问题是其核心目的不是实现充分就业。
en: A third problem with the current approach is that its central objective is not full employment.

zh: 如今是时候回归 1950~60 年代的宏观经济政策，认识到充分就业对促进社会稳定和可持续增长的好处。
en: It is time to return to the macroeconomic policies of the 1950s and 1960s, which recognized the benefits of full employment in fostering social stability and sustainable growth.

zh: 正如北欧模式所展现的那样，高就业率是有益于经济的，因为它能创造足够的税收来资助高水平的社会投资，最终创建一个良性的循环。
en: As the Nordic model shows, high employment is good for the economy because it ensures adequate tax revenues to finance high levels of social investment, which creates a virtuous cycle.

zh: 许多欧洲国家如今却反而陷入了一种恶性循环，由于财政紧缩政策而导致青年失业问题进一步恶化。
en: Many European countries are now in a vicious cycle instead, with austerity policies worsening the problem of youth unemployment.

zh: 这不仅毫无必要，还是一种浪费，因为它很可能产生整整一代人因为没有足够的技能储备而无力推动未来的经济增长。
en: This is not only unnecessary, but also wasteful, because it risks creating a generation that will be ill equipped to drive future growth.

zh: 正如约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯（John Maynard Keynes）在1937年指出的那样 ： “ 繁荣，而不是衰退时期，才是财政部实施紧缩政策的正确时间。
en: As John Maynard Keynes pointed out in 1937, “The boom, not the slump, is the right time for austerity at the Treasury.”

zh: ”在当前的经济衰退情况下，欧洲各国更应投资于人力资本来刺激经济的潜在增长。
en: In the current slump, European countries should be investing in their human capital to spur their economies’ potential growth.

zh: 第四个问题是欧洲国家的财政政策并不强调创意和创新，而这两者不仅从受益于有利的监管环境，还来自于高质量的教育和基础设施。
en: The fourth problem is that European countries’ fiscal policies do not emphasize creativity and innovation, which benefits not only from a conducive regulatory environment, but also from high-quality education and infrastructure.

zh: 各国政府需要减少官僚作风好让企业家可以承担更多风险。
en: Governments need to reduce bureaucratic red tape so that entrepreneurs can take more risks.

zh: 但如苹果，脸书和推特这些突破性技术公司也取决于企业与高水平教育体系的交流，而这类体系是需要充足资金去构建的。
en: But breakthrough technology companies such as Apple, Facebook, and Twitter also depend on people who had access to well-funded education systems.

zh: 虽然欧洲有越来越多的“高品质科技”部门，但它们需要在最新型基础设施的支撑下才能成功，这一般就要依仗公共支出。
en: And while there is a growing “tech for good” sector in Europe, it will succeed only if it is supported by up-to-date infrastructure, which generally requires public outlays.

zh: 欧洲 （和其他地方） 的政策制定者需要调整自身思维 — — 尤其是在财政方面 — — 并转向以人为本。
en: Policymakers in Europe (and elsewhere) need to adjust their thinking – especially their fiscal thinking – to put people first.

zh: 那些将实现民众幸福最大化的政府最终不仅会获得更高的经济增长，同时也会孕育更健康的政治氛围。
en: Governments that make it their central objective to maximize human wellbeing end up not only encouraging higher economic growth, but also nurturing healthier politics.

zh: 英国的转折之年
en: Britain’s Watershed Year

zh: 伦敦 — — 在2016年初伦敦灰暗、雨雾蒙蒙的日子里，找到乐观的理由恐怕很难。
en: LONDON – On a grey and rain-sodden London day at the beginning of 2016, it can be tough to find reason for optimism.

zh: 白天太阳照样升起。
en: The sun still comes up in the morning.

zh: 淅淅沥沥地阴雨大概也总会停歇。
en: At some point, it will presumably stop raining.

zh: 我的孙儿们就像一缕阳光般温暖；他们全都是星战迷，他们大概能让我相信，像莉亚公主领导的持不同政见者部队一样，好人最终能够战胜坏人。
en: My grandchildren offer a ray of sunshine; all Star Wars fans, they can just about convince me that, like Princess Leia’s dissident forces, the good guys will eventually win.

zh: 但读新闻头条的感觉却和这样的乐观情绪恰恰相反。
en: Newspaper headlines, however, are pretty good at tempering such sentiments.

zh: 中国和巴西的经济前景明显低落，世界经济正处于一蹶不振 — — 甚至全面崩溃的边缘。
en: With economic prospects in China and Brazil looking distinctly gloomy, the world economy is at risk of flat-lining – or worse.

zh: 西亚地区一片混乱，没有任何迹象表明沙特和伊朗准备合作缓解逊尼和什叶派的敌对行动。
en: Western Asia is in turmoil, and Saudi Arabia and Iran have shown no sign that they are prepared to work together to ease Sunni-Shia hostilities.

zh: 成千上万的移民继续涌向欧洲脆弱不堪的边境。
en: Migrants continue to arrive by the thousand at Europe’s fragile borders.

zh: 朝鲜声称一种更大更好的核武器正在制造之中。
en: North Korea claims that it is building a bigger and better nuclear weapon.

zh: 上月联合国气候变化会议的利好消息已经被淹没在地缘政治黑暗的雪崩之中。
en: The good news from last month’s United Nations climate change conference in Paris has been buried in an avalanche of geopolitical gloom.

zh: 而且年底局势可能会进一步失控。
en: And things could get even worse by the end of this year.

zh: 因为英国很可能年底前要就是否留在欧盟举行全民公决，局势可能变得更加棘手。
en: In the United Kingdom, where a referendum on whether to remain in the European Union is likely to take place before the end of the year, things could get a lot worse.

zh: 如果英国在谎言和伪装的欺骗下投票退出欧盟，此次公投 — — 其目的是平息保守党内部越来越高涨的反欧盟声浪 — — 将彻底击溃首相戴维·卡梅伦的内阁并为英国带来无法弥补的损失。
en: If, deluded by mendacity and make-believe, Britain votes to quit the EU, the referendum – introduced as a way to placate the growing number of anti-EU voices in the Conservative Party – will have blown up Prime Minister David Cameron’s cabinet and done irreparable harm to Britain.

zh: 我不认为这种情况将会发生。
en: I don’t think it will happen.

zh: 不过，话说回来，我也不会相信几年、甚或几个月前，美国共和党会在唐纳德·特朗普和特德·克鲁兹之间选择总统候选人。
en: But, then again, I wouldn’t have believed a few years ago, or even a few months ago, that the Republican Party in the United States would be choosing between Donald Trump and Ted Cruz as its presidential nominee.

zh: 显而易见，民粹主义的愚蠢可以将理性和常识抹杀得干干净净。
en: Clearly, populist folly can eviscerate reason and common sense.

zh: 投票反对欧盟成员资格，特别是在如此危险的国际环境下，真的会是失去理性。
en: A vote against EU membership, especially in such a dangerous international environment, truly would be irrational.

zh: 首先，英国可以谈判以优惠条件在欧盟内部出售其商品的提法就没有什么意义，因为欧洲统一市场对英国出口企业的意义远大于英国市场之于欧洲。
en: For starters, the argument that the UK could negotiate favorable terms for selling its goods in the EU makes little sense, as Europe’s single market matters far more to British exporters than the UK market matters to European businesses.

zh: 称离开欧盟让能英国像挪威或瑞士一样追求自身商业利益的说法根本没有认识到上述国家进入欧盟统一市场先要接受他们自己根本无权制定的欧盟规则。
en: Claims that leaving the EU would enable the UK to pursue its own commercial interests, like Norway or Switzerland, fail to acknowledge that these countries have to accept the rules of Europe’s single market in order to access it – rules that they have no part in making.

zh: 一开始挪威人将其称之为“传真民主 ” ： 从布鲁塞尔发来的指令只会出现在奥斯陆政府办公室，并在未经讨论的情况下予以实行。
en: At the beginning, the Norwegians called it “fax democracy”: Instructions from Brussels would simply appear in Oslo government offices, to be implemented without debate.

zh: 值得注意的是，这就是英国欧洲怀疑论者所谓的“主权 ” 。
en: This, remarkably, is what British Euroskeptics call “sovereignty.”

zh: 但主权始终是个难以把握的概念。
en: But sovereignty is always a slippery concept.

zh: 民族主义者往往声称主权和童贞类似 — — 这一秒还在，下一秒就已荡然无存。
en: Nationalists often argue as though it was akin to virginity – there one moment, gone the next.

zh: 但主权远远不是一种绝对条件。
en: But sovereignty is far from an absolute condition.

zh: 作为未来能源供应仰仗法中两国所掌握核电站的能源净进口国，英国究竟能够享受多少主权？
en: How much sovereignty does the UK enjoy as a net energy importer, with much of its future supply set to be provided by nuclear power stations in French and Chinese hands?

zh: 一旦被对冲基金和债券交易员盯上，一个国家又能有多少主权？
en: How sovereign is a country once the hedge funds and bond traders mark it down?

zh: 而且在面对只能靠国际合作才能应对的环境威胁时，主权又有多大作用？
en: And what good is sovereignty when we face environmental threats that can be countered only through international cooperation?

zh: 单方面决定所有问题或许听上去不错，但在当今这个一体化的世界其实根本就不可能。
