en: The idea of making all decisions unilaterally may sound nice, but it simply isn’t plausible in today’s integrated world.

zh: 即使身为世界第五大经济体，英国想与美国、日本和中国等巨头谈判有利的贸易协议恐怕也是难上加难。
en: Even as the world’s fifth-largest economy, the UK probably would not find it easy to negotiate favorable trade deals with giants like America, Japan, and China.

zh: 事实上，如果英国决定自己单干，大型投资者可能很快就会急于退出。
en: In fact, if the UK decides to go it alone, big investors could soon rush to the exit.

zh: 到年底，生产企业可能就会开始计算要把多少工厂转移到欧洲。
en: By the end of this year, manufacturers could be trying to calculate how much of their plant they should move to the continent.

zh: 而到明年一月，刚刚给过欧盟当头一棒的英国可能就要在新首相及其内阁的领导下开始谈判，试图与欧盟其他27个成员国建立新的政治和经济关系。
en: And by January, Britain, having just kicked the EU in the teeth, could find itself attempting to negotiate, under a new prime minister and cabinet, a new political and economic relationship with the EU’s 27 other members.

zh: 我觉得这简直是乱成一锅粥。
en: It looks like mayhem to me.

zh: 当然，可能这一切都还可以避免。
en: Of course, it is possible that none of this will happen.

zh: 英国选民可以接受美日等我们最亲密的朋友和盟国的建议，选择留在现实世界当中。
en: British voters could – as our closest friends and allies, from the US to Japan, have advised – choose to remain citizens of the real world.

zh: 投票留在欧盟后，英国就可以开始修复其在欧盟声誉的进程 — — 我们长久以来吹毛求疵、三心二意的俱乐部会员形象严重损害了英国的声誉。
en: Following such a vote, the UK could begin to repair its reputation in the EU – a reputation that has been severely undermined by our prolonged status as the carping, semi-detached member of the club.

zh: 现在，即使其他欧盟成员国赞同英国的观点，它们可能也不会公开表态，因为害怕受到英国有毒品牌的玷污。
en: Nowadays, even if another EU member agrees with the UK, it might not say so, in order to avoid being tainted by our toxic brand.

zh: 改变负面看法并不意味着要放弃我们的利益。
en: Changing negative perceptions does not mean that we must act against our interests.

zh: 这意味着我们必须公开表态要制定既有利于别人也有利于我们自己的议程。
en: It means that we must make clear our desire to pursue an agenda that suits others as well as us.

zh: 这意味着要扮演建设性的角色，而不是站在一边简单地加以批评。
en: It means being constructive, instead of simply criticizing everything from the sidelines.

zh: 本着这样的精神，英国应该在建设统一市场的过程中发挥领导作用。
en: In this spirit, Britain should be leading the effort to complete the single market.

zh: 我们应该成为与美国建设跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系的先锋。
en: We should be at the forefront of the campaign to complete the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership with the US.

zh: 我们应该施压制定能够强化自身安全的欧盟能源政策。
en: We should be pressing for an EU energy policy that reinforces our security.

zh: 我们应该带头制定欧洲战略，解决邻国、以及西亚和北非诸国所面临的严重问题。
en: We should be spearheading a European strategy to address the serious challenges facing our neighbors, as well as the countries of Western Asia and North Africa.

zh: 如果我们在2016年底完成所有任务，那么在这充斥着坏消息的一年可能会有些好事发生。
en: If we are doing all of this by the end of 2016, some good will have emerged in a year that seems likely to provide a lot of bad news.

zh: 千古罪人卡梅伦？
en: Neville Cameron?

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 欧洲问题堪称英国政坛的死穴 — — 但凡触及此议题，则政党分裂，政府失势，许多人的政治生涯毁于一旦。
en: LONDON – The European question is the grim reaper of British politics – dividing parties, debilitating governments, and destroying careers.

zh: 然而这个问题所涉及的利害关系却从未如今天般严峻。
en: But never before have the stakes surrounding the question been so high.

zh: 因为首相戴维·卡梅伦就英国是否继续保持欧盟成员国资格问题举行公投的决定 — — 最快会在6月启动 — — 将可能推翻他的政府，毁灭他的政党，并撕裂其国家。
en: Prime Minister David Cameron’s decision to hold a referendum – perhaps as early as June – on the United Kingdom’s continued membership in the European Union could bring down his government, destroy his political party, and literally tear his country apart.

zh: 卡梅隆正在尽一切努力对成员国资格条款进行重新谈判，以说服选民选择留在欧盟。
en: Cameron is doing all he can to renegotiate the terms of membership in order to persuade voters to choose to remain in the EU.

zh: 但公投这东西的结果是谁也说不准的。
en: But referendums are notoriously unpredictable.

zh: 至于席卷整个欧洲大陆的民粹主义风暴会不会登陆英国，也不好说。
en: And there is no reason to believe that the storms of populism blowing across the continent will not make landfall in the UK.

zh: 脱离欧盟的决定会严重撼动英国经济并大大削弱其国际地位。
en: A decision to leave the EU would fall like a sledgehammer on the British economy and greatly diminish its international stature.

zh: 更严重的是这可能导致英国陷入分裂。
en: Far worse, it could lead to the dissolution of the UK.

zh: 苏格兰民族党就曾威胁要在英国选民决定离开欧盟后举行第二次公投。
en: The Scottish National Party has threatened to hold a second independence referendum if British voters decide to leave the EU.

zh: 其领导人认为就算英格兰，威尔士和北爱尔兰扬长而去，这还能让独立的苏格兰留在欧洲。
en: This, the SNP’s leaders argue, would allow an independent Scotland to remain part of Europe, even as England, Wales, and Northern Ireland set out on their own.

zh: 一旦这样的事情发生，英国的分裂就将使卡梅伦成为英国史上最糟糕的首相。
en: Were this to happen, the dismemberment of the UK would make Cameron’s legacy the worst of any prime minister in British history.

zh: 这个门槛似乎有点高，因为这么一个称号通常被授予试图以绥靖政策安抚希特勒的英国前首相内维尔·张伯伦（Neville Chamberlain ） 。
en: That might seem like a high bar, given that the title is usually associated with Neville Chamberlain, who famously tried to appease Adolf Hitler.

zh: 虽然张伯伦所犯下的错误更加严重，但至少他的政策还可以在自己的国家被摧毁前被扭转过来（正如温斯顿·丘吉尔所为 ） 。
en: But while the stakes were certainly higher in Chamberlain’s case, at least his polices could be reversed before they destroyed the country (and Winston Churchill did just that).

zh: 而一旦卡梅隆在欧盟和苏格兰公投上失算，他的继任者将无力把欧盟或英国重新联合在一起。
en: If Cameron loses both the EU and Scottish referendums, his successors will not be able to put the EU or the UK back together again.

zh: 在卡梅隆奋力拯救其政党和国家的时候，我脑中不禁浮现出王尔德的一句名言 ： “ 每一个男人都会杀死他所热爱的东西 ” 。
en: As Cameron fights to save his party and his country, a line from Oscar Wilde resonates: “For each man kills the thing he loves.”

zh: 首相所面临的困境是，他的政治实力取决于他在保守党的大旗下团结狂热民族主义者和自由市场原教旨主义者的能力；但欧洲问题却令后面两者纷争不断。
en: The prime minister’s predicament is that his political strength depends on his ability to stretch the Conservative Party’s blanket over its uneasy bedfellows of flag-waving nationalists and free-market fundamentalists; but the European question pits one side against the other.

zh: 对于资本和大企业来说，欧盟成员国资格是经济上的必需品，直接通向5亿消费者以及合资格的廉价劳动力储备。
en: For capital and big business, EU membership is an economic imperative, offering access to 500 million consumers and reserves of cheap, qualified labor.

zh: 而在民族主义者眼中这东西是一个威胁，破坏了英国的主权以及对边界的控制力。
en: For nationalists, it is a threat, undermining British sovereignty and control over the country’s borders.

zh: 当年卡梅伦第一次呼吁公投时还是在野，这样做只是为了安抚双方势力，既让他们得以各自保留自身的原则，同时还能把包袱甩给选民。
en: Cameron’s call for a referendum, first issued when he was in opposition, was an attempt to appease both sides, allowing each to stick to their principles while promising to give voters the final say.

zh: 谁知这却是麻烦的开始，因为一旦他成为首相，就得被迫站队。
en: The trouble began when he became Prime Minister and was forced to pick a side.

zh: 幸运的是，很多事情对卡梅隆还算有利。
en: Fortunately for Cameron, he has a lot going in his favor.

zh: 事实相当清楚：英国的经济，安全和国际地位都因为其欧盟成员国身份而受益。
en: The facts are clear: the UK’s economy, security, and international stature all benefit from EU membership.

zh: 同时大部分商界、工会、议会、媒体，甚至大多数英国公众都倾向于留在欧盟。
en: And broadly, the business community, trade unions, parliament, the media, and even a plurality of the British public all favor remaining in the EU.

zh: 与此同时，反对保留欧盟成员国的一方还未拿出一个可靠的替代方案。
en: Meanwhile, opponents of EU membership have yet to make the case for a credible alternative.

zh: 此外，卡梅伦总能超出人们对他的预期。
en: Moreover, Cameron has an impressive track record of exceeding expectations.

zh: 当他在2005年竞逐保守党党魁时，根本没多少人认为他能控制住自己的政党。
en: Few predicted he would take control of his party when he launched his leadership campaign in 2005.

zh: 2010年保守党上台时，许多人怀疑他没法呆够一个完整的总理任期。
en: When the Conservatives came to power in 2010, many doubted that he would serve a full term as Prime Minister.

zh: 即便卡梅隆自己都也没想到能在去年的大选中赢得绝对多数。
en: And even Cameron himself did not expect to win an outright majority in last year’s general election.

zh: 不过这也没法保证他的连胜纪录将延续下去。
en: But there is no guarantee that his winning streak will continue.

zh: 欧洲传来的消息都相当负面，并可能最终左右公投的结果。
en: The news from Europe has been unrelentingly grim, and it could ultimately sway the result of the referendum.

zh: 难民危机，恐怖袭击，以及全球经济危机的持续影响都在不断撩拨着本土主义情绪。
en: The refugee crisis, terrorist attacks, and the lingering effects of the global economic crisis are all providing fuel for simmering nativist sentiment.

zh: 对难民问题的忧虑和分裂失能的欧洲现状都对遍布这个大陆的排外和极端分子有利。
en: Worries over migration and the spectacle of a divided, dysfunctional Europe have benefited xenophobes and extremists across the continent.

zh: 而恐怖袭击，就其本质来说，就是为了挑起非理性的对抗性反应（比如在最近丹麦的全民公决中选民就出人意料地否决了旨在让本国与欧盟就内部事务展开合作的修改提案 ） 。
en: And terrorist attacks, by their very nature, are intended to provoke irrational backlashes (as evidenced by a recent referendum in Denmark, in which voters unexpectedly rejected a proposal to modify the country’s opt-outs from certain EU home-affairs regulations).

zh: 卡梅伦的盟友说他只有两种行为模式：自满和恐慌。
en: Cameron’s allies say he has only two modes of operation: complacency and panic.

zh: 到目前为止，他还在平静地面对公投的挑战。
en: So far, he has faced his referendum challenge calmly.

zh: 但是这很可能会随着公投临近而改变，而风险在于，卡梅隆有可能成为，照丘吉尔的话说，那个在自己的政党和国家之间选择了前者，却最终同时失去了一切的领导人。
en: But that is likely to change as the vote approaches and the risk grows that he will be remembered as the leader who, to paraphrase Churchill, was given a choice between his party and his country, chose his party, and ended up losing both.

zh: 欧洲团结的生命线
en: A Lifeline for European Solidarity

zh: 马德里 — — 一场人类悲剧正在地中海上演，数十万难民冒着生命危险 — — 而且在很多情况下真的失去了生命 — — 只为到欧洲避难。
en: MADRID – A human tragedy is unfolding in the Mediterranean, with hundreds of thousands of refugees risking – and, in many cases, losing – their lives for the chance to find refuge in Europe.

zh: 欧盟如何应对这一危机不仅关乎人道主义；同时预示着欧盟自身的未来。
en: How the European Union responds to this crisis matters not just for humanitarian reasons; it will also be a bellwether of the future of the Union itself.

zh: 欧盟必须做好这件事。
en: The EU must get it right.

zh: 欧洲从来都不乏挑战。
en: Europe faces no shortage of challenges.

zh: 过去五年来，欧盟面临着一系列看似无穷无尽的考验，包括波及整个欧元区的金融危机、俄罗斯入侵乌克兰、希腊重现违约担忧以及英国退出欧盟的隐患。
en: Over the last five years, it has confronted a seemingly endless series of tests, including a eurozone-wide financial crisis, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, renewed fears of a Greek default, and the prospect of a British exit.

zh: 但都没有像现在的移民讨论那样对欧盟的存在意义提出如此根本性的挑战。
en: But none has raised such fundamental questions about the meaning of the EU as the current debate about migration.

zh: 遗憾的是，迄今为止救援工作并不连贯。
en: Unfortunately, efforts so far have been inconsistent.

zh: 欧盟在四月1，000多名移民溺水的恐怖事件发生后迅速行动，将其饱受指责的海上监视行动预算扩大3倍，恢复了意大利已经中止的地中海行动的救援范围。
en: The EU acted quickly in the aftermath of the drowning of more than 1,000 migrants in a particularly horrific episode in April, tripling the budget of its much-maligned naval surveillance operations and expanding their operational area to match Italy’s discontinued Mare Nostrum operation.

zh: 此举已经取得成果，上月底的救援数字刷新了记录。
en: This move has already borne fruit, with record numbers of rescues late last month.

zh: 另一项举措 — — 即欧盟委员会所提的“移民议程 ” — —就没有那么简单。
en: Another initiative – the European Commission’s proposed “Agenda on Migration” – is less straightforward.

zh: 议程提出各式各样的举措，只是详尽程度有所差别。
en: The agenda presents a hodgepodge of measures in varying degrees of detail.

zh: 议程既重要又充满争议的一项是反移民走私行动计划，可能包括使用武力对走私船进行拦截。
en: An important and controversial offshoot of the agenda is the action plan against migrant smuggling, which may include the use of military force to stop the smugglers’ boats.

zh: 批评者质疑该计划的合法性和由此带来的损失风险，而且，最重要的是，武装干预能否有效遏制人口贩运行动。
en: Critics have questioned the plan’s legality, the risk of collateral damage, and, most important, the effectiveness of armed intervention in stemming human-trafficking operations.

zh: 此外令人不安的是如此华而不实的举措将给人留下欧盟正在行动的印象，从而使欧盟及其成员国逃避有效应对危机所需的长期承诺和政治上不受欢迎的措施。
en: There is also the troubling prospect that such a showy initiative would, by creating the impression that the EU is taking action, enable the EU and its members to avoid the long-term commitment and politically unpopular measures that an effective crisis response would demand.

zh: 事实上，欧盟到目前为止一直专注于采取象征性举措：即为庇护寻求者提供拟议中的欧盟全境定居安置。
en: And, indeed, the EU has so far been focusing on a largely symbolic measure: the proposed EU-wide relocation and resettlement system for asylum seekers.

zh: 乍一看，拟将40，000名庇护寻求者从意大利和希腊按GDP、人口和失业率等因素安置到欧盟其他国家的迁移制度或许看似迈出了实质性的一步。
en: At first glance, the relocation system – which would move 40,000 asylum-seekers from Italy and Greece to other EU members countries, with the allocation determined according to factors such as GDP, population, and the unemployment rate – may seem like a substantial step.

zh: 但考虑到去年一年仅意大利一国就收到63，000多份庇护申请并安置 170,000多名非正规移民，该计划的实际影响是微乎其微的。
en: But, with Italy alone having received more than 63,000 asylum applications and 170,000 irregular migrants last year, the program’s impact would be minimal.

zh: 欧盟委员会的建议旨在强调欧洲团结和分担责任 — — 两者都是欧盟的核心原则。
en: The European Commission’s proposal is intended to underscore European solidarity and burden-sharing – both core EU principles.

zh: 但计划的有限性不足以形成这样的印象。
en: But the plan’s limited scope undermines this impression.

zh: 更糟的是，上述计划所引起的反应 — — 某些成员国选择退出计划；还有些反对配额的衡量标准；还有些根本不同意欧盟提出的配额理念 — — 似乎证明欧盟国家都只在乎自己的利益。
en: Worse, the response to the plan – with some member states opting out of the program; others objecting to how the quotas are to be measured; and still others bristling at the idea that the EU should propose a quota at all – seems to suggest that it is every country for itself.

zh: 这些讨论模糊了庇护寻求者和不受国际人道主义公约保护的经济移民之间的界限。
en: Throughout these discussions, the line between asylum seekers and economic migrants, who are not protected by binding international humanitarian conventions, has been blurred.

zh: 面对着无可否认的大规模人类苦难的这些争论改变了欧盟的核心价值，包括它坚持奉行以规则为基础的国际秩序的承诺。
en: These squabbles in the face of undeniable, large-scale human suffering controvert the EU’s core values, including its commitment to adhere to a rules-based international order.

zh: 争论还反映出影响欧盟机构的令人不安的趋势：个别国家的利益越来越多地战胜了团结与合作。
en: They also reflect a disturbing trend affecting EU institutions: individual countries’ interests are increasingly trumping unity and cooperation.

zh: 问题是许多欧洲人将欧盟视为提款机、魔鬼或绊脚石 — — 无论如何他们对欧盟不承担任何义务。
en: The problem is that many Europeans regard the EU as either a dispenser of benefits, a bogeyman, or an albatross – not something to which they are obliged in any way.

zh: 随着金融危机持续发酵，成员国间的相互指责削弱了欧盟赖以生存的集体意识，难民问题更是加剧了危险的分裂。
en: As the financial crisis has dragged on, and recriminations among member countries have weakened the sense of community that forms the EU’s foundations, the refugee challenge has exacerbated a dangerous divisiveness.

zh: 欧盟不但未能巩固团结和同情的基础，反而因此产生了分裂。
en: Instead of reinforcing its foundations with solidarity and compassion, the Union has fractured.

zh: 事实上，欧洲有效应对危机的利益超乎价值观之外。
en: In fact, Europe’s interest in mounting an effective response to the crisis extends beyond values.

zh: 由于人口快速老龄化带来显著的财政压力，欧盟成员国拥有接收更多移民的强烈的经济动机。
en: As rapid population aging generates significant fiscal pressures, EU members have a strong economic incentive to accept more immigrants.

zh: 但是这样做所造成的短期挑战似乎掩盖了这一事实。
en: The short-term challenges that doing so would pose, however, seem to be obscuring this fact.

zh: 但难民挑战并非短期问题。
en: But the refugee challenge is not a short-term issue.

zh: 相反，因为中东及非洲国家面临持续暴力、贫困和政府崩溃，危机只会进一步加剧。
en: On the contrary, with countries throughout the Middle East and Africa facing continued violence, poverty, and governmental breakdown, the crisis will only deepen.

zh: 仅利比亚一地，估计就还有五十到一百万难民等待前往欧洲。
en: In Libya alone, an estimated 500,000 to one million additional migrants are awaiting passage to Europe.

zh: 现在是时候把原则放在政策之前考虑。
en: It is time to place principle back at the forefront of policy.

zh: 欧盟领导人必须明确承诺不惜一切代价解决难民危机 — — 即使这意味着通过既不便利也不受欢迎的扩大合法移民方案的措施。
en: EU leaders must make a clear commitment to do what it takes to address the refugee crisis – even if that means pushing through measures, such as expanded options for legal migration, that are neither expedient nor popular.

zh: 为便于实施，欧盟及其成员国可以发起民众教育运动，让民众了解更灵活敏感的移民体系有哪些优势。
en: To facilitate implementation, the EU and its member states could initiate a campaign to educate the public about the benefits of a more supple and responsive immigration system.

zh: 必须强调缺少解决持续大规模移民动力持续承诺的任何应对之策都不完整 — — 而这意味着全面改革欧盟的睦邻政策。
en: No response, it must be stressed, would be complete without a sustained commitment to addressing the drivers of mass immigration – and that means a complete overhaul of the EU’s Neighborhood Policy.

zh: 新政策应着眼于扩大青年大规模失业国家的经济机会，这样年轻人就不会觉得冒着生命危险前往欧洲是他们未来的唯一机会。
en: The new policy should focus on contributing to the creation of economic opportunities in countries with large unemployed youth populations, so that young people no longer feel that risking their lives to reach Europe is their only chance at a future.

zh: 所有这些都需要有强烈共同目标感支撑的某种长期承诺。
en: All of this will require a sustained commitment, underpinned by a strong sense of common purpose.

zh: 如果欧洲人不携手合作解决移民问题，无数人还会淹死在地中海，而欧盟也将继续走上瓦解的道路。
en: If Europeans do not stand together in addressing migration, countless more people will drown in the Mediterranean and the EU will continue to unravel.

zh: 事实就是如此简单。
en: It is as simple as that.

zh: 坚守欧洲东线
en: Staying the Course in Europe’s East

zh: 斯托克霍姆—欧盟领导人在里加与欧盟的六个“东方合作伙伴 ” （ Eastern Partnership）成员举行峰会，这让很多人想起了引人注目的2013年11月维尔纽斯会议。
en: STOCKHOLM – As the European Union’s leaders gather in Riga for a summit with the six members of the EU’s “Eastern Partnership,” many recall the dramatic meeting in Vilnius of November 2013.

zh: 在维尔纽斯会议上，时任乌克兰总统亚努科维奇经不起俄罗斯的强大压力，拒绝签署欧盟-乌克兰结盟协议（EU-Ukraine Association Agreement ） 。 该协议的谈判从2007年一直持续到2012年。
en: It was there that Ukraine’s then-president, Viktor Yanukovych, under heavy Russian pressure, refused to sign the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement that had been negotiated from 2007 to 2012.

zh: 当然，当亚努科维奇回国时，他不得不面对基辅独立广场的成千上万示威者。
en: Of course, when Yanukovych returned home, he had to face thousands of protesters in Kyiv’s Maidan (Independence Square).

zh: 示威者动员了整个国家，他们决心要让亚努科维奇信守签署欧盟协议、不让乌克兰加入与俄罗斯的关税联盟的承诺。
en: Determined to hold him to his promise to sign the EU agreement and not take Ukraine into a customs union with Russia, the protesters mobilized the country.

zh: 亚努科维奇用安全部队镇压示威，但以失败告终，于是便一走了之。
en: Yanukovych, failing to crush them with his security forces, simply fled.

zh: 此后，俄罗斯在乌克兰的所作所为让东方合作伙伴变得比以往任何时候都更加重要。
en: Russia’s behavior in Ukraine since then has made the Eastern Partnership more important than ever.

zh: 东方合作伙伴始于2009年，由波兰和瑞典发起，当时我是瑞典外交部长。
en: The Eastern Partnership was launched in 2009 on the initiative of Poland and Sweden, where I was the foreign minister at the time.

zh: 东方合作伙伴的目标是响应亚美尼亚、阿塞拜疆、白俄罗斯、格鲁吉亚、摩尔多瓦和乌克兰对某些一体化工具（instruments of integration）的渴望。 这些一体化工具让中欧和巴尔干国家成为今天的民主国家和欧盟成员国。
en: The aim was to respond to the desire of Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, and Ukraine for some of the instruments of integration that had helped transform the Central European and Baltic countries into the democracies – and now EU members – that they are today.

zh: 东方合作伙伴也被视为平衡欧盟的“俄罗斯第一”方针的办法。
en: The Eastern Partnership was also seen as a way to balance the EU’s “Russia first” approach.

zh: 欧盟花了巨大的投入构建对俄关系，但其中用于帮助欧盟和俄罗斯的共同邻国 — — 包括最重要的邻国乌克兰 — — 的少之又少。
en: Enormous resources had been invested in the relationship with Russia, but very little had gone into helping the countries in the neighborhood that the EU and Russia share – including the most important of these neighbors, Ukraine.

zh: 2013年前，欧盟的东方合作伙伴似乎没有引起克里姆林宫的担忧。
en: Until 2013, the EU’s Eastern Partnership seemed to raise no concerns in the Kremlin.

zh: 在俄罗斯与欧盟的众多高规格双边会议中，东方合作伙伴从未被提及，我所参加的所有会议也是如此。
en: It was never brought up at any of the numerous high-level bilateral meetings, nor at any meeting in which I participated.

zh: 兴许克里姆林宫认为它并不重要。
en: The Kremlin probably regarded it as irrelevant.

zh: 2012年普京重新当上俄罗斯总统后，局面发生了变化。
en: That changed after Vladimir Putin returned to Russia’s presidency in 2012.

zh: 如今，他的主要地缘政治工程是建立欧亚联盟（Eurasian Union ） ， 他知道，如果不迫使乌克兰放弃欧盟道路倒向他，欧亚联盟就不可能取得成功。
en: His main geopolitical project was now the creation of the Eurasian Union, which he knew could not succeed without forcing Ukraine off of its EU path and into his embrace.

zh: 欧盟“更广大的欧洲”的愿景依赖于软实力、经济一体化和长期制度建设，而普京的“更广大的俄罗斯”政策依赖于威吓和暴力。
en: While the EU’s vision of “wider Europe” relies on soft power, economic integration, and long-term institution building, Putin’s “wider Russia” policy depends on intimidation and violence.

zh: 欧盟从长期地缘经济学着眼，而克里姆林宫玩的是短期强硬地缘政治。
en: The EU pursues long-term geo-economics, whereas the Kremlin plays short-term hardball geopolitics.

zh: 因此，亚努科维奇决定逃往俄罗斯后，普京的“小绿人”马上开始在克里米亚公开露面，而俄罗斯Buk防空导弹和俄罗斯营级战斗编队不久后也出现在乌克兰东部的顿巴斯地区。
en: That is why, soon after Yanukovych decided to flee to Russia, Putin’s “little green men” began to appear openly in Crimea, while Russian Buk anti-aircraft missiles and Russian battalion battle groups appeared in Ukraine’s eastern Donbas region not long after.

zh: 克里姆林宫吞并克里米亚，煽动顿巴斯的分裂主义暴力，其目标显然是动摇乌克兰使之屈服于俄罗斯。
en: In annexing Crimea and stoking separatist violence in Donbas, the Kremlin’s aim has clearly been to destabilize Ukraine in order to bring it under Russia’s thumb.

zh: 事实上，包括普京在内的俄罗斯领导人公开质疑乌克兰的国家独立性。
en: Indeed, the very notion of an independent Ukrainian state is openly questioned by Russia’s leaders, Putin included.

zh: 在里加，欧盟领导人将确认与乌克兰、摩尔多瓦和格鲁吉亚所谓的深度全面自由贸易协定。
en: In Riga, the EU’s leaders will reaffirm the so-called deep and comprehensive free-trade agreements concluded with Ukraine, Moldova, and Georgia.

zh: 最重要的信号将是欧盟承诺这些协定将生效。
en: The most important signal will be the EU’s pledge that these agreements will take effect.

zh: 尽管面临大面积宣传战、紧张的经济压力和公然军事侵略，但欧盟能够也将会坚守其东方合作伙伴及其对其邻国的承诺。
en: Despite massive propaganda, intense economic pressure, and overt military aggression, the EU can and will stay the course in its Eastern Partnership and its offers to its neighbors.

zh: 显然，欧洲人决不可低估未来的挑战。
en: Clearly, no one in Europe should underestimate the challenges ahead.

zh: 2013年11月，当我离开维尔纽斯会议时，我确定乌云已开始聚集，但我不知道普京准备实施如此大规模的侵略和动乱。
en: When I left the Vilnius meeting in 2013, I could certainly see storm clouds gathering, but I did not know that Putin was prepared to unleash so much aggression and turmoil.

zh: 现在，我们欧洲人绝对有必要做好长期行动准备，在必要时帮助我们的邻国走自己选择的道路。
en: Now we in Europe have every reason to prepare for the long-term effort needed to help our neighbors along their chosen paths.

zh: 但这需要更大的欧洲承诺，不管是政治上还是经济上，这个承诺比我们现在所做的还要大。
en: But this will require a greater European commitment, both politically and economically, than we have seen thus far.

zh: 乌克兰治理不善已经有几十年的历史，它必须战胜改革带来的痛苦，然后才有可能获得与欧盟结盟和一体化带来的好处。
en: Ukraine has been misgoverned for decades, and it will have to pass through a valley of reform-induced tears before it starts to reap the benefits of association and integration with the EU.

zh: 不幸的是，俄罗斯煽动短期动荡比欧洲帮助建设长期稳定容易得多。
en: Unfortunately, it is far easier for Russia to fuel short-term volatility than it is for Europe to help build long-term stability.

zh: 但任由克里姆林宫及其代理人取得成功不但将削弱东方合作伙伴诸国；还有可能破坏欧洲本身的和平。
en: But to allow the Kremlin and its proxies to succeed would not only undermine the Eastern Partnership countries; it might jeopardize peace in Europe itself.

zh: 毕竟，吃得越多胃口越大，克里姆林宫的“更广大的俄罗斯”战略正是如此。
en: After all, the appetite grows with eating, which might well apply to the Kremlin’s “wider Russia” strategy.

zh: 到达一定程度时，北约与俄罗斯公开对抗的风险会增加。
en: At some point, the risk of an open confrontation between NATO and Russia could grow.

zh: 即使是作为俄罗斯朋友和主顾的中国，也应该为自己考虑这一风险。
en: Even China, as it poses as Russia’s friend and patron, should consider the consequences for itself of such a risk.

zh: 必须阻止这一冲突。
en: Such a clash must be prevented.

zh: 欧盟领导人可以通过确认东方合作伙伴协定证明他们不准备默认新的雅尔塔式欧洲大陆分割，让这些国家丧失选择自己的道路的权利。
en: By confirming the Eastern Partnership agreements, the EU’s leaders will demonstrate that they are not prepared to acquiesce in a new Yalta-style division of the continent that would deprive these countries of their right to choose their own destiny.

zh: 里加会议不太可能产生吸引眼球的新方案。
en: The Riga meeting is unlikely to produce any headline-grabbing new initiatives.

zh: 但我们不需要新方案。
en: But none is needed.

zh: 自2013年以来，东方合作伙伴受到过各种威胁，从大量虚假情报到坦克和士兵，因此，坚守现状已是强有力的成功信号。
en: With everything from massive disinformation to tanks and soldiers thrown against the Eastern Partnership since 2013, just staying the course is a powerful sign of success.

zh: 此外，从全欧洲长期稳定的利益出发，这应该受到欢迎 — — 即使是对普京的民族主义兴盛的俄罗斯来说。
en: And, in the interest of long-term stability across Europe, that should be welcomed – even in Putin’s nationalistically aroused Russia.

zh: 英国脱欧和克努特王
en: Brexit and King Canute

zh: 伦敦—克努特王的传说讲述了盎格鲁-萨克逊先王如何向臣民展现皇家权力的极限。
en: LONDON – The legend of King Canute describes how an early Anglo-Saxon King showed his subjects the limits of royal power.

zh: 克努特将王座设在海边，命令上涨的海潮退去。
en: Canute set his throne by the sea and commanded the rising tide to turn back.

zh: 海水和往常一样上涨并浸透了克努特，这时他对朝臣们说 ： “ 现在，让所有人知道国王的权力是多么空虚。 ”
en: When the sea rose as usual and soaked Canute, he told his courtiers: “Now let all men know how empty is the power of kings.”

zh: 以“英国退欧就意味着英国退欧”为口号的首相梅似乎认为克努特给人们的教训是关于民主而不是天文的：他应该举行公投。
en: British Prime Minister Theresa May, whose motto is “Brexit means Brexit,” seems to believe that Canute’s message was about democracy, not astronomy: he should have held a referendum.

zh: 尽管梅反对英国从欧盟退出，但现在她有了新的口号 ： “ 我们将让英国脱欧成为一场成功，因为英国人民投票选择了它。 ”
en: Though May opposed the United Kingdom’s withdrawal from the European Union, she now has a new mantra: “We will make Brexit a success because people voted for it.”

zh: 这毫无意义。
en: This is nonsense.

zh: 如果英国成为除俄罗斯之外仅有的自绝于欧盟单一市场的欧洲国家，其就不可能获得经济成功，不管人民怎么投票。
en: If Britain becomes the only European country apart from Russia to exclude itself from the EU single market, it will not succeed economically, regardless of how people vote.

zh: 如果克努特坐在王座上不懂，民主无法阻止重力推动的潮汐吞没克努特，而公投也无法让受全球化推动的经济潮流退却。
en: Democracy would not have prevented the ocean tides, driven by gravity, from drowning Canute if he had stayed on his throne, and a referendum will not turn back the economic tides driven by globalization.

zh: 企业对此心知肚明。
en: Businesses understand this.

zh: 因此，英国现在面临着经济学家所谓的“极端不确定性 ” ， 即风险无法合理量化，导致利率、税收和货币价值的变动基本无效。
en: That is why Britain now faces what economists call “radical uncertainty,” a situation where risks cannot be rationally quantified, making changes in interest rates, taxes, and currency values largely ineffective.

zh: 英格兰银行指出，许多投资和招聘决定会被推迟，直到英国贸易条件形势明朗。
en: As the Bank of England has noted, many investment and hiring decisions will now be delayed until Britain’s trading terms are clarified.

zh: 如果英国进入脱欧程序，这将耗时多年。
en: If Brexit goes ahead, this will take many years.

zh: 随着英国经济陷入衰退，以及政府的快速“成功脱欧”承诺被证伪，公共观点将很快发生变化。
en: As Britain’s economy sinks into recession, and the government’s promises of a quick “successful Brexit” prove unrealistic, public opinion will shift.

zh: 梅的议会微弱多数将承受压力，包括来自因为她迫使所有前首相卡梅伦的盟友去职而树的诸多对头的压力。
en: May’s small parliamentary majority will come under pressure, not least from the many enemies she made by purging all of former Prime Minister David Cameron’s allies from office.

zh: 因此，英国脱欧事宜的主要决定不会在伦敦做出，而是在布鲁塞尔和柏林做出。
en: The main decisions on Brexit will therefore be made not in London but in Brussels and Berlin.

zh: 在做出这些决定时，欧洲领导人必须回答两个问题：如果英国拒绝欧盟规则和机构，它是否应该继续获得欧盟成员国的主要好处？
en: In making these decisions, European leaders must answer two questions: Should Britain keep the main benefits of EU membership if it rejects EU rules and institutions?

zh: 是否应该改革一些规则和机构，以使欧盟对选民更具吸引力（不仅是英国，而是整个欧洲 ） ？
en: And should some of these rules and institutions be reformed to make the EU more attractive to voters, not just in Britain but throughout Europe.

zh: 两个问题的答案显而易见。 第一个是“否 ” 。
en: The answers to both questions are obvious: “No” to the first; “Yes” to the second.

zh: 欧盟领导人应该给出明确的选择：要么英国在进行了一些满足公共意见的附加改革谈判后保留欧盟成员资格；要么完全脱离欧盟，以与“从阿富汗到津巴布韦在内的所有世界贸易组织成员”一样的标准与欧盟谈判。 这是英国财政研究所（Institute for Fiscal Studies）所描述的除了完全成员地位之外最可靠的替代方案。
en: EU leaders should present a clear choice: either Britain remains an EU member after negotiating some additional reforms to satisfy public opinion; or it disengages completely and deals with the EU on the same basis as “any country in the World Trade Organization, from Afghanistan to Zimbabwe,” which is how Britain’s Institute for Fiscal Studies describes the most plausible alternative to full membership.

zh: 表明脱欧条件不可谈判，同时为保留成员资格条件提供操作空间，这样一来欧洲可以把注意力引向第二个建设性问题：能否说服选民，让他们对欧盟持积极态度？
en: By making exit conditions non-negotiable, while offering room for maneuver on the terms of continuing membership, Europe could shift attention to the second, constructive question: Can voters be persuaded to feel positive again about the EU?

zh: 严肃地回答这个问题要把注意力集中在欧盟成员地位的除了对单一市场的技术官僚抽象（technocratic abstractions）之外的诸多有形好处上：环境改善、农业补贴、科研资金、基础设施、高等教育以及在全欧洲生活和工作的自由。
en: Addressing this question seriously would focus attention on the many tangible benefits of EU membership beyond technocratic abstractions about the single market: environmental improvements, rural subsidies, financing for science, infrastructure, and higher education, and the freedom to live and work throughout Europe.

zh: 欧盟应该排除“挪威”或“瑞士”模式等虚幻的中间道路选项 — — 而梅耶拒绝了这些选项，因为它们隐含人的自由迁徙 — — 从而让英国脱欧的经济影响明确化。
en: By excluding spurious intermediate options such as the “Norwegian” or “Swiss” models – which May has, in any case, rejected, because they imply free movement of people – the EU could make Brexit’s economic implications unequivocally clear.

zh: 伦敦将不再是欧洲金融首都，因为监管将有意识地做出改变，让商业活动转移到欧盟司法辖区。
en: London would cease to be Europe’s financial capital because regulations would be deliberately changed to shift business activities into EU jurisdictions.

zh: 出于同样的理由，许多位于英国的出口产业也将无法维持。
en: For the same reason, many UK-based export industries would become non-viable.

zh: 面临这一前景，英吉利海峡两岸的企业将有动力公开支持英国保留完全欧盟成员地位，而不是静悄悄地游说自身所在部门的特殊协议。
en: Facing this prospect, businesses on both sides of the English Channel would be impelled to campaign openly for Britain to keep full EU membership, instead of quietly lobbying for special deals for their own sectors.

zh: 媒体甚至会指出代议制民主将狭义公投多数视为议会决定的永久性约束，这样的宪政安排是荒谬的。
en: The media might even point out the constitutional absurdity of a representative democracy treating a narrow referendum majority as permanently binding on parliamentary decisions.

zh: 强硬派民族主义者也许不会关注，但足够多的边缘疑欧派可能会重新思考他们的立场，从而扭转52 % - 48%的脱欧公投多数。
en: Hard-core nationalists might pay no attention, but enough marginal Euroskeptics would probably reconsider their positions to flip the 52%-48% Brexit majority the other way.

zh: 如果欧洲领导人不是为英国脱欧提供便利，��是认识到脱欧公投是欧盟改革的“集结号 ” ， 以此真正重视英国选民释放的信号，那么公共观点的逆转几乎是肯定的。
en: The reversal of public opinion would become near-certain if European leaders genuinely heeded UK voters’ message, not by facilitating Brexit, but by recognizing the referendum as a wake-up call for EU reform.

zh: 假设欧盟领导人邀请英国政府就主导公投并且仍在继续助长其他欧洲国家怨念的政策进行谈判。 这些政策包括本国失去对移民的控制；权力从国家议会转移到布鲁塞尔；依赖公民权与慷慨的福利国家之间的强联系的社会模式的破坏等。
en: Suppose EU leaders invited the British government to negotiate on the policies that dominated the referendum and are also fueling resentment in other European countries: loss of local control over immigration; the transfer of power from national parliaments to Brussels; and erosion of social models that depend on strong bonds of citizenship and generous welfare states.

zh: 比如，想象一下欧盟领导人认可丹麦的最新方案，允许国家政府区别对待本国公民和新近移民的福利支付，或者，想象一下将瑞士“紧急叫停”移民激增的计划推广到全欧洲。
en: Imagine, for example, that EU leaders endorsed Denmark’s recent proposal to allow national governments to differentiate between welfare payments to citizens and recent immigrants, or that it extended to all of Europe the Swiss plan for an “emergency brake” against sudden immigration surges.

zh: 想象它们放松扼杀南欧的反生产性预算和银行规则。
en: Imagine them easing the counterproductive budget and banking rules that have suffocated southern Europe.

zh: 最后，在想象一下欧盟承认权力的集中有些过度，并正式停止推动“更加紧密的联盟 ” 。
en: Imagine, finally, that the EU acknowledged that centralization of power has gone too far and formally ended the drive for “ever closer union.”

zh: 这些改革在布鲁塞尔是不可想象的，因为它们需要更该条约，并且可能被选民拒绝。
en: Such reforms are considered unthinkable in Brussels, because they would require treaty changes and could be rejected by voters.

zh: 但反对此前集中权力的欧盟条约的选民几乎肯定会援引让国家议会重获权威的改革。
en: But voters who opposed previous EU treaties for centralizing power would almost certainly welcome reforms that restored authority to national parliaments.

zh: 改革的真正障碍不在于更该条约的困难性，而在于官僚对让渡权力的抵制。
en: The real obstacle to reform is not the difficulty of treaty change; it is the bureaucracy’s resistance to ceding power.

zh: 欧盟委员会仍沉迷于捍卫欧盟既有成果，即联盟所“收集”的权力。 欧盟的原则禁止将这些权力还给民族国家。
en: The European Commission remains obsessed with defending the acquis communautaire, the collection of powers “acquired” by the Union, which EU doctrine dictates must never be returned to nation-states.

zh: 欧盟委员会主席容克及其幕僚长马丁·塞梅尔（Martin Selmayr）甚至欢迎英国脱欧，视之为通过进一步集中权力“强化既有成果”的机会。
en: Jean-Claude Juncker, the Commission President, and his chief of staff, Martin Selmayr, have even welcomed Brexit as a chance to “strengthen the acquis” by centralizing power even more.

zh: 和梅一样，容克也应该想一想克努特王。
en: Juncker, like May, should recall King Canute.

zh: 国家民主的潮流正在整个欧洲兴起 ， “ 更加紧密的联盟”的口号无法逆转这一潮流。
en: The tide of national democracy is rising across Europe, and slogans about “ever closer union” will not reverse it.

zh: 欧洲领导人必须认识现实，否则将目睹欧洲沉没。
en: European leaders must acknowledge reality – or watch Europe drown.

zh: 欧元债还是分裂？
en: Eurobonds or Bust

zh: 伦敦 — — 欧元区的制度缺陷已经暴露无遗。
en: LONDON – The eurozone’s institutional weaknesses have been laid bare.

zh: 试图在缺乏统一财政的情况下实现统一货币政策的努力宣告失败。
en: The attempt to run a common monetary policy without a common treasury has failed.

zh: 投资者在购买意大利债券是根本搞不懂自己买入的究竟是什么 — — 德国会为这玩意儿兜底吗？
en: Investors do not know what they are buying when they purchase an Italian bond – is it backstopped by Germany or not?

zh: 我们现在知道的是，剩下的国家的信誉不能再受损了，否则的话，恐慌性挤兑 — — 也就是已将希腊、爱尔兰和葡萄牙拖入万劫不复，如今又在将意大利和西班牙逼上绝路的挤兑 — — 将是不可避免的。
en: We now know that the best credit must stand behind the rest, or else bear runs, such as those that have derailed Greece, Ireland, and Portugal – and that now threaten to do the same to Italy and Spain – are inevitable.

zh: 光靠债务共同化无法拯救欧元，但如果没有债务共同化，欧元区就不可能完好无损。
en: Debt mutualization alone will not save the euro, but, without it, the eurozone is unlikely to survive intact.

zh: 7月21日的欧元区峰会朝债务算是迈出了一小步。
en: The eurozone’s July 21 summit was a small step forward.

zh: 欧元区领导人同意调低欧洲金融稳定基金（EFSF）贷款利率，并认定希腊债务负担为不可持续。
en: Leaders agreed to lower interest rates on loans made by the European Financial Stability Fund (EFSF) and they recognized that Greece’s debt burden is unsustainable.

zh: 但这与解决欧元货币联盟危机深化问题之所需尚相去甚远。
en: But this falls far short of what is needed to arrest the currency union’s deepening crisis.

zh: 许多欧元区经济体 — — 不光是外围国家 — — 的借贷成本仍然维持在不可持续的高水平。
en: Borrowing costs remain unsustainably high for many eurozone economies – and not just those in the periphery.

zh: 比如，西班牙和意大利的经济增长潜力如今在1%徘徊，而其借贷成本已经超过了6 % 。
en: The economic growth potential of Spain and Italy, for example, now hovers around 1%, but their borrowing costs exceed 6%.

zh: 与此相反，德国主权债务收益率出现了暴跌，拉低了公共和私人部门借贷成本。
en: By contrast, German sovereign yields have fallen sharply, lowering public and private-sector borrowing costs.

zh: 这将进一步拉大欧元区经济两极分化和经济破产的情况。
en: This is a recipe for further economic divergence and insolvency in the eurozone.

zh: 为了阻止这一状况，欧元区需要一个“无风险”利率。
en: To prevent this, the eurozone needs a “risk-free” interest rate.

zh: 陷入困境的经济体需要更低的借贷成本，否则它们的经济就难以为继（欧元区成员国地位的政治基础也将因此失去 ） 。
en: The struggling economies need lower borrowing costs, or they will suffocate economically (and political support for eurozone membership will evaporate).

zh: 只有债务发行的共同化能够产生这一低（无风险）利率 — — 让这些国家公共财政站稳脚跟、给经济恢复增长打下基础的利率。
en: Only mutualization of debt issuance can generate the low (risk-free) interest rate needed to enable these countries to put their public finances on a sound footing and lay the basis for a return to economic growth.

zh: 因此，所有欧元区国家都应该通过发行由所有成员国共同担保的债券来为财政债务融资。
en: All eurozone countries should, therefore, finance debt by issuing bonds that would be jointly guaranteed by all member states.

zh: 欧元债有一个显而易见的问题，那便是道德风险：怎样避免财政不负责任的国家搭其他成员国信誉之东风？
en: The obvious problem with eurobonds is moral hazard: how to prevent fiscally irresponsible countries from free-riding on the credit-worthiness of other member states.

zh: 毫不奇怪，德国和荷兰对这一问题颇为担忧。
en: This is the understandable fear of countries such as Germany and the Netherlands.

zh: 一种可能的解决办法是允许成员国最多发行相当于GDP的60%的欧元债，如果债务超限，就要追究个体国家的责任。
en: One possible solution would be to permit member states to issue debt as eurobonds up to, say, 60% of GDP, and to require them to be individually responsible for any debt exceeding that level.

zh: 这将给公共债务水平较高的国家整固其公共财政的激励。
en: This would give countries with high levels of public debt an incentive to consolidate their public finances.

zh: 如果欧元区一开始就引入这一体系，说不定早就能见到成效了。
en: Had the eurozone introduced such a system from the outset, it might well have worked.

zh: 但现在亡羊补牢也为时未晚。
en: But it is too late for that now.

zh: 对不少欧元区经济体来说，要提高借债数量将变得极其昂贵。
en: For several eurozone economies, the additional borrowing would simply be too expensive.

zh: 一种更佳解决办法是成立一个新的独立财政机构，为个体成员国设置借贷目标，然后与一个欧洲债务机构共同代表它们发行（不超过某个限额的）欧元债。
en: A better solution would be to create a new, independent fiscal body to establish borrowing targets for individual member states, together with a European debt agency to issue eurobonds (up to a certain level) on their behalf.

zh: 新的财政规则应该如何设计？
en: How would the new fiscal rules be designed?

zh: 武断地为各国设置预算平衡的四年大限而不考虑各国在经济周期中所处的阶段是无济于事的：无法实施的目标没有任何意义。
en: A dogmatic target of budgetary balance four years hence, irrespective of a country’s position in the economic cycle, would achieve little: targets are meaningless if they are impossible to implement.

zh: 因此，新规则必须参考每个成员国经周期调整的财政状况（OECD已经为此进行了估算 ） 。
en: So the rules would have to be set with reference to each member state’s cyclically adjusted fiscal position (for which the OECD already produces estimates).

zh: 新财政机构的组成必须慎之又慎。
en: Careful thought would need to be given to the composition of the new fiscal body.

zh: 每个成员国派出一人组成一个17人的委员会既冗余，又不可能获得欧元区主要债权国的支持。
en: A board of 17 people, one from each eurozone economy, would be unwieldy, and unlikely to win the support of the eurozone’s principal creditor countries.

zh: 与此同时，由债权国经济体主导的委员会也不可能获得债务国的支持。
en: At the same time, a board dominated by the creditor economies would be unlikely to win the backing of the debtor countries.

zh: 一个由来自大型成员国、欧洲委员会、欧洲央行和OECD的9名经济学家组成的委员会或许是更好的选择。
en: A board of nine economists, from the big eurozone members, the European Commission, the European Central Bank, and the OECD might form a good basis.

zh: 当然，欧元区在强化财政规则方面的历史记录非常差，这意味着需要对不遵守规则的情况施以严惩。
en: The eurozone, of course, has a poor record of enforcing fiscal rules, implying the need for strong penalties for non-compliance.

zh: 如果一国没能按其财政目标行事，就应该剥夺其享受无风险利率继续借钱的权利。
en: If a country deviated from its fiscal targets, it would be barred from borrowing additional funds at the risk-free interest rate.

zh: 该国将按其信用评级在市场上借钱 — — 对于财政状况疲软的国家来说，利率会高到无法承受。
en: It would have to borrow under its own rating, which would be prohibitively expensive for fiscally weaker countries.

zh: 为了进一步增加遵守规则的激励，欧洲央行可以拒绝接受按国家信用评级发行的债券作为抵押品。
en: To provide additional incentives to abide by the rules, the ECB could refuse to accept debt issued under national ratings as collateral.

zh: 也可以成立新的欧盟金融监管当局，通过要求银行为按国家信用评级发行的债券计提更多的资本来阻止各国发行此类债券。
en: Alternatively, a new EU financial regulator could handicap own-country bonds by requiring banks holding them to set aside more capital.

zh: 上面设想的财政规则（以及新的强化这些规则的机构）不需要改变欧盟条约。
en: Fiscal rules of the type envisaged (and a new body to enforce them) would not necessarily require a treaty change.

zh: 许多债权国担心欧元债会推高它们的借贷成本并形成一个转移联盟（这种担心完全正确 ） ， 但反对者最终将发现，欧元债是最不坏的选择。
en: And, while various creditor countries rightly fear that eurobonds would push up their borrowing costs and constitute a transfer union, opponents might eventually come around to seeing eurobonds as the least bad option.

zh: 迟早人们会发现，最大的风险在于未能及时采取行动导致无法挽回欧元的局部分裂：马上采取行动要比等待半年再动手有效得多。
en: The risk is that, by then, it could be too late to save the euro from a partial break-up: what might work if adopted promptly could be ineffective if adopted in six months.

zh: 对核心国家来说，欧元债肯定会比为受困成员国销债成本更低，后者实际上是拿优质资金往劣等资金池中扔，将给EFSF贷款造成重大损失，而如果借款人最终脱离欧元区并违约的话（这很有可能 ） ， 损失还会进一步加大。
en: For core countries, eurobonds would certainly be a cheaper option than underwriting loans to struggling member-states, which essentially means throwing good money after bad. They will book large losses on EFSF loans, and those losses will be even larger if, as seems possible, some of the borrowers end up leaving the eurozone and defaulting on their debt.

zh: 用欧元债券平息恐慌
en: Eurobonds without Fear

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 欧元债券的诞生很可能已经不远了。
en: SANTIAGO – The day of the Eurobond may be near.

zh: 这个用来解决欧洲金融危机的办法曾经被嗤之以鼻，现在摇身一变，成了挽救欧元唯一可靠的方法。
en: What was once a quack’s idea for resolving Europe’s financial crisis is now the only reliable way to save the euro.

zh: 欧洲央行的国债买入计划并未使希腊、爱尔兰和葡萄牙免于救援。
en: Having their bonds purchased by the European Central Bank did not keep Greece, Ireland, and Portugal from needing a bailout.

zh: 西班牙和意大利也一样。
en: It will not save Spain and Italy, either.

zh: 但西班牙和意大利太大了，没人救得了。
en: But Spain and Italy are too large to be bailed out.

zh: 新的欧洲金融稳定基金（EFSF）无法胜任这一职责。
en: The new European Financial Stability Facility (EFSF) is not up to the task.

zh: 而且将EFSF扩大到足够规模将大大增加法国的贷款，这将不利于法国，将其置于投机冲击的风险之下。
en: And enlarging the EFSF to an appropriate size would require massive additional French borrowing, which could well place France itself at the receiving end of a speculative attack.

zh: 此时就需要欧洲债券出马了。
en: This is where Eurobonds come in.

zh: 五个受困国家需要发行数百亿欧元新债务，并对更大数额的就债务实行展期。
en: The five countries in trouble will need to place tens of billions of euros in new debt and roll over even larger amounts of old debt.

zh: 市场上在很久以前就已难觅希腊、爱尔兰和葡萄牙发行的债务的买家了，很快，意大利和西班牙债也将无人问津（或者要求极高的利率 ） 。
en: Markets long ago stopped buying bonds issued by Greece, Ireland, and Portugal, and might soon stop buying paper issued by Italy and Spain – or do so only at prohibitive interest rates.

zh: 但市场对于由整个欧元区的信誉作支撑的债券是不会失去兴趣的。
en: But markets would happily gorge on bonds backed by the full faith and credit of the eurozone.

zh: 欧元债券可以降低欧盟两个受困大国的借贷成本，也可以让德国和欧盟状况良好的北欧国家的纳税人免于为南欧成员国再次掏钱施救。
en: Eurobonds would cut borrowing costs for the European Union’s two large troubled members. And it would spare German and other taxpayers from the EU’s solvent northern countries from having to fund yet another bailout of a southern member state.

zh: 关于是否以及如何引入欧元债券的争论集中在如何设定合理的发行限额上。
en: The debate about whether and how to introduce Eurobonds has focused on the appropriate limits on issuance.

zh: 如果不设限，不知收敛的国家就会毫无节制地花钱，而成本则由节俭国家来承担。
en: With no limit, profligate countries could go on a spending spree at the expense of thriftier ones.

zh: 欧元推出后，借德国低利率之东风，欧元区地中海国家出现了贷款繁荣。
en: After the advent of the euro, the eurozone’s Mediterranean members enjoyed a lending boom while piggybacking on Germany’s low interest rates.

zh: 不难理解，人们很不愿意让这一幕再次发生。
en: There is understandable reluctance to allow that to happen again.

zh: 但在限额是否应该设在GDP的60%的问题上斤斤计较也没有抓住重点。
en: But arguments about whether the limit should be 60% of GDP or more miss a larger point.

zh: 诞生了欧元和欧盟的马斯特里赫特条约生效至今已过去了十九年，这十九年的经验令人信服地表明，这样的限额是不具有强制性的。
en: Nineteen years of experience with the Maastricht Treaty, which created both the EU and the euro, has shown convincingly that such limits are unenforceable.

zh: 有恃无恐的国家一俟政治环境合适就会无视这一限制。
en: Countries with the clout to flaunt the limits will do so whenever it is politically convenient.

zh: 此外，当债务危机逼近的时候，各种各样的免责条款就会应运而生，弃权声明会纷纷冒出，新债买家会排成长队。
en: And, if a debt crisis is near, exceptions will be found, waivers will be issued, and buyers for the additional debt will be lined up.

zh: 因此，问题并不在于当债务接近限额时怎么办，不管这个限额是高还是低。
en: So the question is not what to do when debt gets near its limit, however high or low.

zh: 问题在于怎样在一开始防止债务接近这个限额（当然发生了极端或反常事件时另当别论 ） 。
en: It is how to prevent debt from getting near that limit in the first place, except in very extreme and unusual circumstances.

zh: 而要解决这一问题，你需要的是财政规则。
en: And for that, you need fiscal rules.

zh: 财政规则是事先确定的机制，用于约束支出或赤字。
en: A fiscal rule is any pre-specified mechanism that constrains spending or the deficit.

zh: 根据IMF的研究，全世界有80个国家采用了某种类型的财政规则。
en: According to a study by the International Monetary Fund, 80 countries around the world use some kind of fiscal rule.

zh: 但并非所有的财政规则都是一样的。
en: But not all fiscal rules are created equal.

zh: 如果规则太松，则会沦为皇帝的外衣。
en: If too loose, a rule is merely ornamental.

zh: 如果太紧（比如用宪法修正案的形式规定预算必须平衡 ） ， 则财政规则就会带来问题，而不是解决问题：想想看，如果失业率高达21%的西班牙被迫在一夜之间消除其巨大的财政赤字，会造成怎样的经济和政治混乱。
en: If too tight – a constitutional amendment requiring a balanced budget, for example – the rule could create rather than solve problems: think of the economic and political chaos that would ensue if Spain, with unemployment at 21%, were forced to eliminate its huge fiscal deficit overnight.

zh: 从地缘政治上说，瑞典和智利称得上是两个极端，但两国均非常成功地运用了成熟的财政规则。
en: Sweden and Chile are almost poles apart geographically, but both have used sophisticated fiscal rules successfully.

zh: 智利设立了一个按周期调整的财政平衡目标，即，在考虑了商品价格和国内产出与趋势水平的离差之��，必须实现财政平衡。
en: Chile sets a target for its cyclically-adjusted fiscal balance – that is, the balance that emerges after accounting for the deviations in commodity prices and domestic output from their trends.

zh: 2005年左右，商品价格出现了大繁荣，根据规则，智利应该保持巨大的预算盈余。 智利也的确做到了，偿还了几乎所有公共债务，还攒下了一大笔备用资金。
en: When commodity prices boomed in the middle of the last decade, the rule called for huge budget surpluses – which Chile achieved, repaying almost all of its public debt and accumulating a sizable rainy-day fund.

zh: 当金融危机爆发后，智利还有钱实施激进的财政刺激，抵抗金融市场的不利局面。
en: When the financial crisis came, Chile was able to mount an aggressive fiscal stimulus without so much as a hiccup from financial markets.

zh: 当然，没有哪个财政规则可以应付所有意外事件。
en: Of course, no fiscal rule can account for all contingencies.

zh: 这就是为什么需要一个独立的财政委员会来管理财政规则的原因，正如需要一个独立的央行来实施以通胀为目标的货币政策。
en: That is why you need an independent fiscal council to administer it, just as you need an independent central bank to pursue an inflation-targeting monetary rule.

zh: 欧洲很难在如何组成这样一个委员会的问题上达成一致，但要在欧洲央行委员会的组成上达成一致更难。
en: Agreeing on the composition of such a council for Europe would be hard, but no harder than it was to agree on the makeup of the ECB’s board.

zh: 欧元债券加财政规则：这就是解决欧元危机的最佳之道。
en: Eurobonds plus fiscal rules: this formula is the euro’s best hope for salvation.

zh: 不幸的是，欧洲领导人是不会认真考虑这一点的，要让他们学乖，还得再来两三次危机。
en: Unfortunately, another crisis or two might be necessary before European leaders consider it seriously.

zh: 欧洲的货币宽松终局
en: Europe’s Easy-Money Endgame

zh: 慕尼黑—欧元给欧洲带来了一场收支平衡危机，一如20世纪20年代的金本位。
en: MUNICH – The euro has brought a balance-of-payments crisis to Europe, just as the gold standard did in the 1920s.

zh: 事实上，这两场危机只有一个区别：在今天的危机中，你可以获得大量国际援助。
en: In fact, there is only one difference between the two episodes: During today’s crisis, huge international rescue packages have been available.

zh: 这些援助计划减轻了欧元区的金融压力，但代价是高昂的。
en: These rescue packages have relieved the eurozone’s financial distress, but at a high cost.

zh: 不但投资者避免了为糟糕决策买单，定价过高的南欧国家也获得了推迟实际贬值（通过降低商品的相对价格实现）的机会。
en: Not only have they enabled investors to avoid paying for their poor decisions; they have also given overpriced southern European countries the opportunity to defer real depreciation in the form of a reduction of relative prices of goods.

zh: 这对于重建在欧元最初几年中因为使用欧元导致过度通胀而失去的竞争力来说是必不可少的。
en: This is necessary to restore the competitiveness that was destroyed in the euro’s initial years, when it caused excessive inflation.

zh: 事实上，对希腊、葡萄牙和西班牙等国来说，重获竞争力需要降低本国产品相对于欧元区其他国家的价格，降幅（较危机开始时）应达到30%左右。
en: Indeed, for countries like Greece, Portugal, or Spain, regaining competitiveness would require them to lower the prices of their own products relative to the rest of the eurozone by about 30%, compared to the beginning of the crisis.

zh: 意大利可能需要让相对价格降低10—15 % 。
en: Italy probably needs to reduce its relative prices by 10-15%.

zh: 但葡萄牙和意大利目前都没有发生任何“实际贬值 ” ， 而希腊和西班牙的相对价格分别只下降了8%和6 % 。
en: But Portugal and Italy have so far failed to deliver any such “real depreciation,” while relative prices in Greece and Spain have fallen by only 8% and 6%, respectively.

zh: 有启迪意义的是，在所有危机国中，只有爱尔兰扭转了局面。
en: Revealingly, of all the crisis countries, only Ireland managed to turn the corner.

zh: 原因显而易见：爱尔兰的泡沫在2006年底还无法获得援助资金时就已经结束了。
en: The reason is obvious: its bubble already burst at the end of 2006, before any rescue funds were available.

zh: 爱尔兰需要自力更生，因此它别无选择，只能实施大规模紧缩措施，降低其产品相对其他欧元区国家的价格，从最高降幅高达13 % 。
en: Ireland was on its own, so it had no option but to implement massive austerity measures, reducing its product prices relative to other eurozone countries by 13% from peak to trough.

zh: 如今，爱尔兰失业率正在大幅下降，其制造部门正在繁荣。
en: Today, Ireland’s unemployment rate is falling dramatically, and its manufacturing sector is booming.

zh: 相对而言，希腊获得了大部分欧洲援助资金，失业率的攀升也最严重。
en: In relative terms, Greece received most of Europe’s bailout money and showed the largest increase in unemployment.

zh: 欧洲央行和国际社会提供给希腊的官方贷款在过去五年中增长了五倍多，从2010年2月的530亿欧元增加到如今的3,240亿欧元或GDP的181 % 。
en: The official loans granted to the country by the European Central Bank and the international community have increased more than sixfold during the past five years, from €53 billion ($58 billion) in February 2010 to €324 billion, or 181% of GDP, now.

zh: 尽管如此，希腊失业率仍翻了一番多，从11%增加到26 % 。
en: Nevertheless, the unemployment rate has more than doubled, from 11% to 26%.

zh: 对于这一局面，有四种可能的经济和政策应对方式。
en: There are four possible economic and policy responses to this state of affairs.

zh: 首先，欧洲可能成为一个转移联盟，北方给予南方越来越多的信用，然后予以豁免。
en: First, Europe could become a transfer union, with the north giving more and more credit to the south and later waiving it.

zh: 其次，南方可能通缩。
en: Second, the south can deflate.

zh: 第三，北方可能通胀。
en: Third, the north can inflate.

zh: 第四，不再具有竞争力的国家可能退出欧洲货币联盟，然后让新货币贬值。
en: And, fourth, countries that are no longer competitive can exit Europe’s monetary union and depreciate their new currency.

zh: 每一种可能都会带来严重的副作用。
en: Each path is associated with serious complications.

zh: 第一种可能将导致永久性转移依赖症，通过维持相对价格阻止经济重获竞争力。
en: The first creates a permanent dependence on transfers, which, by sustaining relative prices, prevents the economy from regaining competitiveness.

zh: 第二种可能会导致许多危机国债务人走向破产。
en: The second path drives many debtors in crisis countries into bankruptcy.

zh: 第三种可能不啻掠夺北方债权国。
en: The third expropriates the creditor countries of the north.

zh: 第四中国可能会通过资本市场形成传染效应，也许将迫使决策者像2013年的塞浦路斯那样引入资本管制。
en: And the fourth may cause contagion effects via capital markets, possibly forcing policymakers to introduce capital controls, as in Cyprus in 2013.

zh: 目前，欧洲政治的焦点是以近零利率向危机国提供公共信用，这笔信用最终可能变为转移。
en: European politics has focused so far on providing public credit to the crisis countries at near-zero interest rates, which eventually may morph into transfers.

zh: 但如今欧洲央行正在尝试通过量化宽松打破僵局。
en: But now the ECB is attempting to break the impasse through quantitative easing (QE).

zh: 欧洲央行所宣称的目标是通过购买超过1.1万亿欧元的资产让欧元区实现再通胀，从而���低欧元的对外价值。
en: The ECB’s stated goal is to reflate the eurozone, thereby reducing the euro’s external value, by purchasing more than €1.1 trillion worth of assets.

zh: 根据欧洲央行行长德拉吉的说法，通胀率（目前略低于0 % ） 将提升到略低于2%的平均水平。
en: According to ECB President Mario Draghi, the inflation rate, which currently stands at just below 0%, is to be raised to an average of just below 2%.

zh: 这将给南欧国家一条走出竞争力陷阱的道路，因为如果南方价格维持不变而北方国家出现通胀，那么南方国家可以在不必感受太多痛苦的情况下逐步降低商品的相对价格。
en: This would offer southern European countries a way out of their competitiveness trap, because if prices remained unchanged in the south, while the northern countries inflated, the southern countries could gradually reduce their goods’ relative prices without feeling too much pain.

zh: 当然，在这种情况下，北方的通胀必须高于2 % 。
en: Of course, in that case the north needs to inflate faster than by just 2%.

zh: 如果（比如）南欧将通胀率保持在0%而法国通胀为1 % ， 那么德国必须通胀4 % ， 欧元区其他地区通胀2 % （ 均为年率 ） ， 以使欧元区平均通胀水平略低于2 % 。
en: If, say, southern Europe kept its inflation rate at 0% and France inflated at a rate of 1%, Germany would have to inflate by a good 4%, and the rest of the eurozone at 2% annually, to reach a eurozone average of slightly less than 2%.

zh: 这一模式需要维持十年才能让欧元区回归平衡。
en: This pattern would have to continue for about ten years to bring the eurozone back into balance.

zh: 到那时，德国价格水平将比今天高出50%左右。
en: At that point, Germany’s price level would be about 50% higher than it is today.

zh: 我确实预期量化宽松会带来一定的通胀。
en: I do expect QE to bring about some inflation.

zh: 由于汇率即货币的相对价格，随着更多的欧元进入流通，它们的价值将大幅下降，以使货币市场形成新均衡。
en: Given that an exchange rate is the relative price of a currency, as more euros come into circulation, their value has to fall substantially to establish a new equilibrium in the currency market.

zh: 美国、英国和日本的类似经验表明量化宽松会释放出巨大的贬值压力。
en: Experience with similar programs in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Japan has shown that QE unleashes powerful forces of depreciation.

zh: 因此，欧元区量化宽松将通过提高进口和出口价格带来德拉吉想要的通胀。
en: QE in the eurozone will thus bring about the inflation that Draghi wants via higher import and export prices.

zh: 这一效应是否足以重振南欧则有待观察。
en: Whether this effect will be sufficient to revitalize southern Europe remains to be seen.

zh: 有一个风险是日本、中国和美国不会坐视欧元贬值，世界甚至有可能滑向货币战争。
en: There is a risk that Japan, China, and the US will not sit on their hands while the euro loses value, with the world possibly even sliding into a currency war.

zh: 此外，欧盟南方国家可能不让价格维持不变，而是放弃紧缩，发行更大量的新债券刺激经济。
en: Moreover, the southern EU countries, instead of leaving prices unchanged, could abandon austerity and issue an ever greater volume of new bonds to stimulate the economy.

zh: 竞争力的提高和再平衡将无法实现，欧元区在经历最初的回光返照后将回归持久危机模式。
en: Competitiveness gains and rebalancing would fail to materialize, and, after an initial flash in the pan, the eurozone would return to permanent crisis.

zh: 最终，完全失去信誉的欧元将在一片狼藉中寿终正寝。
en: The euro, finally and fully discredited, would then meet a very messy end.

zh: 但愿这一情景不会发生，但愿南欧国家能坚持紧缩。
en: One can only hope that this scenario does not come to pass, and that the southern countries stay the course of austerity.

zh: 这是它们最后的机会。
en: This is their last chance.

zh: 欧元的独木桥
en: The Euro’s Narrow Path

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 随着法国总统选举以埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的胜利告终，以及默克尔所属的基督教民主联盟在9月24日德国大选前的民调中遥遥领先，一个欧元区改革的窗口随之开启。
en: BERKELEY – With Emmanuel Macron’s victory in the French presidential election, and Angela Merkel’s Christian Democratic Union enjoying a comfortable lead in opinion polls ahead of Germany’s general election on September 24, a window has opened for eurozone reform.

zh: 欧元一直是由法德主导的项目。
en: The euro has always been a Franco-German project.

zh: 如今法国拥有了一位充满活力的新领导人，对应的德国首脑又一次得到了民众的授权，也就为两国共同去纠正这个作品的最严重缺陷创造了机会。
en: With a dynamic new leader in one country and a fresh popular mandate in the other, there is now an opportunity for France and Germany to correct their creation’s worst flaws.

zh: 但双方之间依然存在巨大分歧。
en: But the two sides remain deeply divided.

zh: 马克龙秉承法国一直以来的传统，坚持认为货币联盟的问题在于中央集权程度太低。
en: Macron, in long-standing French tradition, insists that the monetary union suffers from too little centralization.

zh: 在他看来欧元区需要设立自有的财政部长和议会，还需要获拨数千亿欧元的预算以承担投资项目以及增加在高失业率国家身上的支出。
en: The eurozone, he argues, needs its own finance minister and its own parliament. It needs a budget in the hundreds of billions of euros to underwrite investment projects and augment spending in countries with high unemployment.

zh: 另一方面，默克尔却认为货币联盟的问题是集权过度而各国分担责任过少。
en: Merkel, on the other hand, views the monetary union’s problem as one of too much centralization and too little national responsibility.

zh: 她担心巨额的欧元区预算不会被负责任地使用。
en: She worries that a large eurozone budget wouldn’t be spent responsibly.

zh: 虽然不反对欧元区设立财政部长，但她并不寄望该官员能拥有广泛的权力。
en: While not opposed to a eurozone finance minister, she does not envision that official possessing expansive powers.

zh: 但其实存在一座双方都应该能接受的前进独木桥。
en: But there is a narrow path forward that should be acceptable to both sides.

zh: 这将从完善银行联盟开始。
en: It starts with completing the banking union.

zh: 欧洲如今已经在欧洲中央银行任命有一位单一监管人，但它缺乏一个共同的存款保险方案，而德国官员反对该方案的理由是欧洲银行系统的风险还未降到合理水平。
en: Europe now has a single supervisor in the European Central Bank, but it lacks a common deposit insurance scheme, which German officials oppose on the grounds that there has been inadequate risk reduction in the European banking system.

zh: 换言之，他们担心从德国银行处收取的费用将被用于偿付其他国家的储户。
en: In other words, they worry that the fees levied on German banks will be used to pay off depositors in other countries.

zh: 解决办法是通过严格执行《巴塞尔协议 III》 的较高资本金标准并限制政府债券的集中持有来保障这些银行。
en: The solution lies in bulletproofing the banks by strictly applying the demanding capital standards of Basel III and limiting concentrated holdings of government bonds.

zh: 这里的自相矛盾之处在于，欧洲监管机构（包括德国监管机构）实际上一直在与美国的谈判中要求放宽这些监管规定的应用。
en: The paradox here is that European regulators, including German regulators, have in fact been arguing for looser application of those regulations in negotiations with the United States.

zh: 而在这样做的时候，他们其实在和自己的最佳利益对着干。
en: In doing so, they have been arguing against their own best interests.

zh: 其次，欧洲需要将欧洲稳定机制这个救助基金雏形转变为真正的欧洲货币基金 (European Monetary Fund ) 。
en: Next, Europe needs to transform the European Stability Mechanism, its proto-rescue fund, into a true European Monetary Fund (EMF).

zh: 它的资源可以通过增加政府的资本认购和扩大其借贷能力来扩充。
en: Its resources could be augmented by increasing governments’ capital subscriptions and expanding its ability to borrow.

zh: 决策可以通过从将目前的全体一致规则转化为合格的多数票来进行简化。
en: Decision-making could be streamlined by moving from the current unanimity rule to qualified majority voting.

zh: 然后，欧洲货币基金就可以取代欧洲央行和欧盟委员会去与各国政府商讨融资计划条款。
en: The EMF could then take the place of the ECB and the European Commission in negotiating the terms of financing programs with governments.

zh: 是否延长紧急贷款的最终决定也因此无需由各国家元首在通宵会谈中达成；相反它将由一个经欧洲理事会提名并由欧洲议会确认 — — 这为这一进程补足了当前所缺乏的合法性 — — 的欧元区代表（包括公民社会代表）组成的委员会来承担。
en: The final decision of whether to extend an emergency loan would no longer fall to heads of state in all-night talks. Rather, it would be taken by a board made up of eurozone representatives, including from civil society, nominated by the European Council and confirmed by the European Parliament, giving the process a legitimacy it currently lacks.

zh: 但德国只有在看到那些有助于限制大手笔干预措施可能性的步骤时才会点头同意。
en: But Germany will agree only if it sees steps limiting the likelihood of expensive intervention.

zh: 这就给我们引来了财政政策的棘手问题。
en: This brings us to the vexed question of fiscal policy.

zh: 我们早该放弃那种认定财政纪律的最终来源是一套严格执行的欧盟规则的幻想。
en: It is past time to abandon the fiction that the ultimate source of fiscal discipline is a set of strictly enforced EU rules.

zh: 税收和公共支出仍然是敏感的国家特权，令到外部监督束手无策。
en: Taxation and public spending remain sensitive national prerogatives, rendering outside oversight ineffectual.

zh: 将监督权授予布鲁塞尔的欧盟委员会带来的 — — 不可避免地 — — 不是纪律，而是一场危险的民粹主义回潮。
en: Assigning oversight to the European Commission in Brussels promises, inevitably, not discipline but a dangerous populist backlash.

zh: 另一种选择是将财政政策的控制权交还给各国政府，撕掉欧盟规则可以约束该政策的幌子。
en: The alternative is to return control of fiscal policy to national governments, abandoning the pretense that policy can be regimented by EU rules.

zh: 然后政府可以作出自己的决定；一旦它们决策错误，就必须进行债务重组。
en: Governments could then make their own decisions; if they make bad decisions, they will have to restructure their debts.

zh: 采用一套欧洲债务重组机制将有助于避免最坏的后果。
en: Adopting a European debt-restructuring mechanism would help to avoid the worst fallout.

zh: 任何不利的后果将不再蔓延到其他国家，因为它们的银行将不再集中持有大量政府债券。
en: Any adverse consequences would no longer spread to other countries, because their banks would no longer hold concentrations of government bonds.

zh: 它们也不会令欧洲货币基金破产，因为后者只会在流动性受阻的情况下借贷，不会去救助破产国。
en: They would not bankrupt the EMF, which would be able to lend only in cases of illiquidity, not insolvency.

zh: 这些想法会令那些一心致力于实现欧元联邦化的人震惊不已。
en: These ideas will horrify dedicated euro-federalists.

zh: 可以安抚他们一个方法是建立试点性失业保险基金，其规模相当于欧元区 GDP 的1 % 。
en: One bone they can be thrown is a pilot unemployment insurance fund amounting to, say, 1% of eurozone GDP.

zh: 这类似于美国联邦政府为各州管理的失业保险提供部分资金的安排，也让欧元区财政部长有点事情好做。
en: This would be analogous to US arrangements under which the federal government provides partial funding for state-administered unemployment insurance.

zh: 如果最初的适度计划能证明有效，那么就可以相应扩大规模。
en: And it would give the eurozone finance minister something to do. If the initial modest program was shown to work, it could be scaled up.

zh: 但德国政界人士意识到法国的失业率要比本国高出2.5 倍，也因此增加了转移支付只会单向流动的风险。
en: But German politicians are aware that unemployment is 2.5 times higher in France than at home, raising the danger that transfers would all go one way.

zh: 这就是为何这样的提议都取决于以减少高失业率以及增加劳动力和产品市场灵活性的结构性改革。
en: That’s why such proposals are contingent on structural reforms that reduce unemployment where it is high and increase the flexibility of labor and product markets.

zh: 这基本上就是马克龙提供给默克尔的交换条件。
en: This is essentially the bargain Macron has offered Merkel.

zh: 换句话说 ， “ 如果你（德国）同意在财政联邦制的方向上采取适度的步骤，完善银行联盟，建立一个欧洲货币基金组织，我（法国）将进行深层次的结构改革 ” 。
en: To paraphrase, “I’ll undertake deep structural reforms if you agree to modest steps in the direction of fiscal federalism, completing the banking union, and creating a European Monetary Fund.”

zh: 莱茵河两岸的人都不会认为这是完美的交易。
en: No one on either side of the Rhine will regard this bargain as perfect.

zh: 但鉴于欧元的命运悬而未决 ， “ 完美”不应该被允许成为“好”的对立面。
en: But with the euro in the balance, the perfect should not be allowed to become the enemy of the good.

zh: 欧洲、美国及对伊朗的战鼓声
en: Europe, America, and the Drumbeat of War with Iran

zh: 战争的流言又一次在美国的首都甚嚣尘上，这不光是针对在伊拉克的最新“制胜战略 ” ， 同时也包括对伊朗的军事行动。
en: America’s capital is once again abuzz with talk of war, not only of the latest “strategy for victory” in Iraq, but now also of military action against Iran.

zh: 对布什政府行动背后的理性越难理解，流言机器也就越是开得功率十足。
en: The harder it becomes to discern any rationality in the Bush administration’s actions, the louder the rumor mill grinds.

zh: 布什会下令空军和特种兵对伊朗进行打击吗？
en: Will Bush order an air and Special Forces attack on Iran?

zh: 自从布什在一月底的国情咨文演讲以来，与伊朗相关的形势就一直在变化发展之中，而布什政府的措辞也日渐强硬。
en: Ever since Bush’s State of the Union address at the end of January, hardly a day has passed without something happening in connection with Iran or without the Bush administration’s ratcheting up its rhetoric.

zh: 显然，美国也在加紧进行空袭的准备。
en: Clearly, the US is also pressing ahead with preparations for an air strike.

zh: （鉴于美国地面部队的战线已经拉得过长，实施更广泛的军事打击的可能性很小。 ）
en: (A more extensive military commitment is scarcely possible, given how overstretched US ground forces already are.)

zh: 的确，与在伊拉克的伊朗人的对峙已如箭在弦上，而其它的一些因素还可能会加强这种压力。
en: Indeed, the confrontation with the Iranians in Iraq is visibly intensifying, and it may be gathering strength elsewhere as well.

zh: 最近，一枚针对伊朗革命卫队的炸弹在伊朗与阿富汗的边界爆炸。
en: A bomb directed at the Iranian Revolutionary Guard recently exploded on Iran’s border with Afghanistan.

zh: 当然，美国还会有新的企图来鼓吹伊朗威胁的“证据”从而为其打击找到借口。
en: And there are, of course, new attempts by the United States to drum up “evidence” of an Iranian threat that may justify an attack.

zh: 这一切是虚张声势么？
en: Is this all a bluff?

zh: 如果不是伊朗核计划的进展和布什总统的任期即将结束都可能使事态突然失控，国际社会大可以静观其变。
en: The world could perhaps calmly wait for an answer, but for the fact that the progress of Iran’s nuclear program and the approaching end of President Bush’s term might create an incalculable dynamic of its own.

zh: 正如对伊拉克那样，美国的实力可能足够发动一场战争，但却不能赢得它。
en: As with Iraq, America’s strength may be enough to start a war, but not to win it.

zh: 但在伊朗进行军事冒险的后果会远比伊拉克战争来的严重。
en: But the consequences of a military adventure in Iran would far surpass those of the war in Iraq.

zh: 又一次在中东做虎头蛇尾的事情是下下策—对于该地区及其邻居都没好处。
en: Doing things by halves yet again in the Middle East would be the worst of all possible options – bad for the region and bad for its neighbors.

zh: 首当其冲受影响的就是欧洲。
en: The first among the neighbors affected would be Europe.

zh: 那么，到目前欧洲是如何在这个与自身利益攸关的安全问题上做出反应的呢？
en: So how has Europe, with its vital security interests at stake, responded to these developments?

zh: 英国首相托尼•布莱尔已经附和了美国政府的新对峙言辞。
en: British Prime Minister Tony Blair has already adapted to the US administration’s new confrontational rhetoric.

zh: 法国总统雅克•希拉克毫无防备地推测说由于存在核报复的可能性，所以拥有一两颗核弹的伊朗不会成为一个严重的威胁—他的观点令法国官员们大为震惊，并很快地纠正了总统的评论。
en: French President Jacques Chirac unguardedly speculated that an Iran with one or two nuclear bombs might not pose a serious a threat, given the possibility of nuclear retaliation -- his musings so startled French officials that they quickly jumped in to correct the President’s comments.

zh: 德国总理安吉拉•默克尔在几次安全会议上发表了有利于美国的演说，但除此之外德国更希望待在幕后。
en: German Chancellor Angela Merkel gives speeches at security conferences that find favor in America, but otherwise Germany prefers to stay in the background.

zh: 在整个欧洲，规避风险似乎是当今主流，即使是以牺牲共同利益和北约团结为代价。
en: Across Europe, risk avoidance seems to be the order of the day, even at the expense of the common interest and NATO solidarity.

zh: 德国海军正保卫着黎巴嫩沿海不受真主党侵扰，而其它的欧洲国家则负责维护黎巴嫩的地面秩序。
en: The German navy is defending the Lebanese coast against Hezbollah, while other European nations bear the brunt of policing Lebanon on the ground.

zh: 在阿富汗，重兵把守北方的德国对在南方与死灰复燃的塔利班战斗的加拿大盟友的求助置若罔闻。
en: In Afghanistan, Germany, with its strong military presence in the north, has been turning a deaf ear to calls for help from the Canadian allies fighting a revived Taliban in the south.

zh: 德国现在想派出几架“狂风”战斗机去执行侦察任务—聊胜于无，但又于事无补。
en: Germany now wants to send some Tornado jets for reconnaissance purposes – better than nothing, but not by much.

zh: 就安全政策而言，在团结成为当务之急的时刻，欧洲即使没在倒退，也是停滞不前。
en: In terms of security policy, Europe is stagnating, if not regressing, at the very moment when unity is needed more then ever.

zh: 欧洲三大国—以及作为欧盟现任主席国的德国—必须找到在战略安全事务上统一行动的办法。
en: The Big Three of Europe – and Germany, as the current EU president in particular – must find a way to act together in strategic security matters.

zh: 如果做不到，那么当事态恶化时，欧洲就没有了发言权。
en: If they don’t, Europe will largely cease to matter when the going gets rough.

zh: 而现在伊朗和海湾地区的事态已经非常严重了。
en: And the going is now getting quite rough in Iran and the Persian Gulf.

zh: 如果伊朗在今年受到攻击，其后果会首先直接由该地区承担，但欧洲作为中东最近的西方邻居也会受到影响—这些后果会长期存在。
en: Should Iran be attacked this year, the consequences will be borne first and foremost by the region, but also by Europe as the Middle East’s immediate western neighbor – and they will be felt for a long time to come.

zh: 的确，如果伊朗成功地成为一个核国家，那么欧洲就不得不分担代价。
en: Indeed, Europe will have to share the costs if Iran prevails and becomes a nuclear power.

zh: 所以现在对于古老的欧陆而言，正是利益攸关的时刻。
en: So there is much at stake for the old continent.

zh: 确切地说，现在危及最深的是欧盟的两大首要安全利益：避免与伊朗发生战争并防止伊朗成为核国家。
en: To be precise, two overriding EU security interests are at stake: avoiding a war with Iran and preventing Iran from becoming a nuclear power.

zh: 这两项看似相悖的利益可以被和解并转化为一项共同战略。 具体做法是采取一种基于有效孤立、充分遏制和直接谈判的三头并进的策略。
en: These two apparently contradictory interests can be reconciled and translated into a common strategy by adopting a three-pronged approach based on efficient isolation, effective containment, and direct negotiations.

zh: 欧洲人—在默克尔、布莱尔和希拉克的领导下—应该一致向美国确保欧洲准备付出高昂的、甚至是极为高昂的经济代价，采取决定性的行动加强对伊朗的制裁。
en: The Europeans – led by Merkel, Blair, and Chirac – should agree to assure the US that Europe is ready to pay a high, perhaps very high, economic price by taking decisive action to intensify the sanctions against Iran.

zh: 但他们的这项承诺只能在两个严格的前提条件下做出：军事干预不予考虑，各方—包括美国—都必须参加与伊朗的直接谈判。
en: But they should offer this only on two strict preconditions: that the military option be taken off the table, and that all parties involved – including the US – enter into direct negotiations with Iran.

zh: 孤立与直接谈判相结合的政策还可以进一步由一项针对叙利亚的共同战略来强化。 这项战略的目的不是“政体改革”而是“联盟改革 ” — 即让叙利亚逐渐脱离与伊朗的紧密联盟。
en: The policy of isolation coupled with direct negotiations would be strengthened further by a common strategy toward Syria, aimed not at “regime change,” but at “coalition change” – that is, drawing Syria away from its close alliance with Iran.

zh: 欧盟外交部长理事会在对伊朗实施制裁的问题上达成一致是正确和重要的。
en: It was both right and important that the EU Council of Foreign Ministers agreed on sanctions against Iran.

zh: 面对金融制裁的威胁，伊朗的政治精英阶层会更加认识到其为对峙所付出的代价。
en: Faced with the threat of financial sanctions, Iran’s political elite is increasingly realizing the price of its confrontational course.

zh: 在继续坚决推进这项进程的同时拒绝军事冒险主义是势在必行的。
en: It is imperative to further this process in a resolute manner, while at the same time rejecting military adventurism.

zh: 现在就要看欧洲如何下定决心、共同行动来防止两种最坏的情况发生—战争与核武器。
en: It is up to Europe to prevent the two worst developments in Iran – war and nuclear armament – by acting jointly and with determination.

zh: 欧洲和跨大西洋的重大利益正受到威胁。
en: Vital European and transatlantic interests are at stake.

zh: 因此马上行动是欧洲的责任—更是欧盟现任主席国德国的责任。
en: It is thus Europe’s responsibility – and especially Germany’s, as the current EU president – to act now.

zh: 谁会是欧洲的亚历山大·汉密尔顿？
en: Who Will Be Europe’s Alexander Hamilton?

zh: 蒂尔堡—不久前，欧洲央行的行动还屡屡赢得人们的欢呼。
en: TILBURG – Not too long ago, the European Central Bank’s actions were usually met with cheers.

zh: 但最近，欧洲央行不但遭到了银行家和经济学家的批评，公民和政客也对它颇有微词。
en: But more recently, the ECB has drawn criticism from not just bankers and economists, but also citizens and politicians.

zh: 随着固定收益投资回报的下降，投资者被迫进军股市，拜金融和经济稳定的不确定性日益增加，股市变得越来越危险、越来越昂贵。
en: With returns on fixed-income investments decreasing, investors are being forced into equity investments, which have become riskier and more expensive, owing to increased uncertainty about financial and economic stability.

zh: 这一不确定性反映了一个事实：欧洲央行的极低利率导致欧元区重赤字和债务国急需的结构性改革没有落实。
en: That uncertainty reflects the fact that the ECB’s extremely low interest rates are serving to prevent desperately needed structural reforms in eurozone countries with high deficits and debt.

zh: 现在的大问题是欧洲央行当前的货币政策利弊孰大。
en: The big question now is whether the ECB’s current monetary policies are doing more harm than good.

zh: 欧洲央行的官方目标是实现接近2%的通货膨胀。
en: The ECB’s official aim is to reach an inflation target of close to 2%.

zh: 但尽管注入了大量流动性，欧元区通货膨胀仍然有所下降，这表明实体经济需求不足。
en: But despite massive liquidity injections, the eurozone’s inflation rate has fallen, indicating that there is insufficient demand in the real economy.

zh: 事实上，需求之所以停滞，是因为许多公司必须先减少债务，然后才能进行投资。
en: Indeed, demand is stagnating because many companies cannot make investments until they have reduced their debts.

zh: 此外，欧元区国家正在受到石油价格下降和中国增长放缓的影响 — — 而欧洲央行的低利率对这两个因素没有什么效果。
en: Moreover, eurozone countries are feeling the effects of falling oil prices and slower Chinese growth – two factors on which the ECB’s low interest rates have little bearing.

zh: 央行可以通过提高利率、制造流动性挤出来打破通胀循环；但它们无法光靠低利率制造通胀。
en: Central banks can break an inflationary cycle by raising interest rates and creating a liquidity squeeze; but they cannot generate inflation through low interest rates alone.

zh: 换句话说，欧洲央行可以猛踩有门，但如果离合器不工作的话，汽车也不会前进；而只会制造巨大的噪音。
en: In other words, the ECB can step on the gas pedal, but if the clutch does not work, the car will not move; it will just create a lot of noise.

zh: 因此，确保欧洲经济复苏的责任在于国家政府。
en: Accordingly, responsibility for ensuring Europe’s economic recovery rests with national governments.

zh: 欧洲央行已经将欧元区谚语中的栗子取出了金融之火。
en: The ECB has pulled the eurozone’s proverbial chestnuts out of the financial fire.

zh: 但这样做让欧洲央行成为金融机构的众火之的，此前，它们一直避免（至少在公开场合如此）反驳欧洲央行行长德拉吉的政策
en: But in doing so, it has felt the hot breath of financial institutions, which had previously abstained from contradicting ECB President Mario Draghi’s policies, at least in public.

zh: 当然，欧洲央行应该维持支持性货币政策。
en: The ECB should, of course, maintain supportive monetary policies.

zh: 但欧元区坚挺国，如德国、芬兰和荷兰，现在必须起到先锋作用。
en: But stronger eurozone countries such as Germany, Finland, and the Netherlands must now play the role of pioneer.

zh: 在这方面，由欧元区财政部长们组成的欧元集团在荷兰人迪塞尔布鲁姆（Jeroen Dijsselbloem）的主持下，应该制定一个日程。
en: To this end, the Eurogroup of eurozone finance ministers, headed by Jeroen Dijsselbloem of the Netherlands, should set the agenda.

zh: 欧盟委员会应该通过所谓的“六部立法权力 ” （ Six-Pack powers ） ， 给予欧元区集团一切需要的支持。
en: The European Commission should provide it with whatever help it needs through the so-called Six-Pack powers.

zh: 而欧元区坚挺国应该在监督增长与稳定公约的基础上更进一步，实施可靠的刺激计划和税收改革。
en: And stronger eurozone countries should go beyond monitoring the Stability and Growth Pact to also enact sound stimulus packages and tax reforms.

zh: 欧盟委员会的提振投资的“容克计划 ” （ Juncker Plan）应该包括一个法国和德国之间的交换，其中，法国采取结构性改革，德国采取刺激计划，而欧洲投资银行负责补充性投资。
en: The European Commission’s “Juncker Plan” for boosting investment should have involved a trade-off between France and Germany, whereby the former would pursue structural reforms and the latter stimulus, with supplementary investments by the European Investment Bank.

zh: 但容克计划尚未起步，而欧元区却形成了一个僵局，在法国和意大利等国家感受到更大的压力从而实施国内改革之前难有进展。
en: But the Juncker Plan has not gotten off the ground, and the eurozone has reached a stalemate, which is where it will remain until countries such as France and Italy feel more pressure to implement domestic reforms.

zh: 如果阻碍这些改革，德国和荷兰将无法实现温和的预算赤字或鼓励更多基础设施和研发方面的国内投资。
en: Barring such reforms, Germany and the Netherlands will be unable to run modest budget deficits or encourage more domestic investment in infrastructure and research and development.

zh: 欧元集团内部需要一个新范式。 欧元集团成员应该包括法国和德国财政部长、德拉吉、欧洲央行副行长维特尔·康斯坦西奥（Vítor Constâncio ） ， 以及来自欧盟委员会代表，包括其主席容克。
en: What is needed is a new presidium within the Eurogroup, comprising the French and German finance ministers, Draghi, ECB Vice President Vítor Constâncio, and representatives from the European Commission, including its president, Jean-Claude Juncker.

zh: 这一人事组合将大大改进欧元集团、欧洲央行和欧盟委员会在刺激和结构改革措施以及未来升息方面的协作。
en: Such a presidium would vastly improve coordination among the Eurogroup, the ECB, and the European Commission on stimulus and structural-reform measures and future interest-rate hikes.

zh: 说到底，一个非正式的管理团队还能为建立欧洲财政部和财政联盟打下基础，如果人民和政客对这一可能性持开放态度的话。
en: Ultimately, an informal presidium could also lay the groundwork for establishing a European finance ministry and fiscal union, if citizens and politicians prove open to that possibility.

zh: 前欧洲央行行长特里谢（Jean-Claude Trichet）早就指出，欧元区无法在没有财政联盟的情况下正常运转。
en: As former ECB President Jean-Claude Trichet has long argued, the eurozone cannot function without a fiscal union.

zh: 但要实现这一跳跃，欧洲需要一位亚历山大·汉密尔顿 — — 强势的第一位美国财政部长。
en: But to make that leap, Europe will need its own Alexander Hamilton – the United States’ powerful first Secretary of the Treasury.

zh: 毕竟，财政联盟不但是一个分担已有和新增债务的机制。
en: After all, a fiscal union is not just a mechanism for sharing existing and new debt.

zh: 它还通过平衡预算规则和其他手段，为国家层面创造财政决策条件。
en: It must also establish the conditions for fiscal policymaking at the national level, through balanced-budget rules and other measures.

zh: 正如汉密尔顿的改革将权力从美国各州转移到美国联邦政府，欧元区各国也必须让渡一定程度的国家主权。
en: Just as Hamilton’s reforms shifted power from American states to the US federal government, eurozone countries would have to cede some degree of national sovereignty.

zh: 诚然，这一权力的转移需要付出巨大的努力。
en: To be sure, such a shift in power would be momentous.

zh: 但说到底，财政联盟是欧元区结构性问题唯一的可行解决办法。
en: But, at the end of the day, a fiscal union is the only viable solution to the eurozone’s structural problems.

zh: 增长与稳定公约则是次优选择，而欧洲将在一个又一个危机之间颠簸前行。
en: The Stability and Growth Pact is a second-best solution that will leave Europe stumbling from crisis to crisis.

zh: 历史表明，为了打造欧元，欧洲决策者们首先需要精诚合作理顺欧洲货币体系内部的国家政策和激励。
en: History has shown that, to establish the euro, European policymakers first had to work together to align national policies and incentives within the European Monetary System.

zh: 今天，新的欧元集团内部管理层可以为财政联盟做同样的工作。
en: A new presidium within the Eurogroup could do the same for a fiscal union today.

zh: 但谁会成为欧洲的汉密尔顿。
en: But who will be Europe’s Hamilton?

zh: 眼下，所有人的眼光都集中在目前呼吁建立财政联盟、任命欧元区财政部长最力的领导人身上：法国总统马克龙。
en: Right now, all eyes are on the most prominent leader currently calling for the establishment of a fiscal union and a eurozone finance minister: French President Emmanuel Macron.

zh: 欧盟军队是否在路上？
en: Are EU Troops on the Way?

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 突然间，关于成立欧洲联合军队的辩论获得了真正的能量。
en: STOCKHOLM – Suddenly, the debate about creating a joint European Union army has gained real momentum.

zh: 在法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙最近提出这个想法后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对此加以诋毁（当然是在一条推文中 ） ， 但德国总理安格拉·默克尔却（在敦促保持谨慎的同时）表示赞同。
en: After French President Emmanuel Macron recently proposed the idea, US President Donald Trump disparaged it (in a tweet, of course), but German Chancellor Angela Merkel endorsed it (while urging caution).

zh: 这个问题凸显是在本月纪念一战结束100周年之际，这自然而然将欧洲人的视线集中在战争与和平。
en: The issue came to the fore this month with the centennial of the end of World War I, which naturally focused Europeans’ attention on matters of war and peace.

zh: 在参观一战战场时，马克龙观察到 “欧洲的和平非常脆弱 ” ， 并且“除非决定组建一支真正的欧洲军队，否则我们无法保护欧洲人。 ”
en: While touring WWI battlefields, Macron observed that “peace in Europe is precarious,” and that “we will not protect Europeans unless we decide to have a true European army.”

zh: 组建欧洲军队的目标可以追溯到二战结束后欧洲一体化的最初阶段。
en: The goal of establishing a European army dates back to the earliest stages of European integration after World War II.

zh: 1954年，法国议会拒绝批准一项条约，如果该条约得到批准，将组建由西德、法国、意大利、比利时、荷兰和卢森堡共同组成的欧洲防务共同体及联合军队。
en: In 1954, the French parliament refused to ratify a treaty that would have established a European Defense Community and joint military force comprising West Germany, France, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.

zh: 在此之后，最终支撑今天欧盟一体化的构架往往更加注重经济，并任由北约和美国安全保护伞来负责欧洲的领土防御。
en: After that, the structures of integration that would eventually underpin today’s EU tended to be more economically oriented, and territorial defense was left to NATO and the US security umbrella.

zh: 但过去几十年，在制定共同的欧盟外交和安全政策方面已经取得了更多进展，并且在这一目标的指导下组建了新的构架和体系。
en: But over the last few decades, there has been more movement toward establishing a common EU foreign and security policy, and new structures and institutions have been developed with that goal in mind.

zh: 尽管如此，今天有关欧洲防务问题的探讨的确是新鲜事。
en: Still, today’s discussion of European defense is truly novel.

zh: 到目前为止，欧洲主要促进研究和开发领域的合作，而各个国家集团则一直致力于建设不同的防御和安全能力。
en: Until now, the EU has primarily fostered cooperation in the area of research and development, while various country groupings have worked to establish different defense and security capabilities.

zh: 在下一个七年预算中，可能会有大量资金用于资助这些项目。
en: In the next seven-year budget, there will likely be substantial funding for such projects.

zh: 马克龙指出，欧盟战略环境变得越来越脆弱是正确的认识。
en: Macron is right to think that the EU’s strategic environment has become increasingly fragile.

zh: 复仇主义的俄国、高调自信的中国和颇具破坏性的美国今天的欧洲人都不得不面对。
en: Europeans today are confronted with a revanchist Russia, an assertive China, and a disruptive US.

zh: 尽管近年来美国一直在扩大其在欧洲的军事能力，但它此前主要将欧洲大陆视为在其他战区的行动平台。
en: Although the US has expanded its military capabilities in Europe in recent years, it has previously regarded the continent primarily as a platform for operations in other theaters.

zh: 而现在特朗普让人对美国保护欧洲的承诺产生了怀疑，因此重新提议组建欧洲军队应当不足为奇。
en: And now that Trump has cast doubt on America’s commitment to defend Europe, renewed proposals for a European army should come as no surprise.

zh: 尽管如此，欧洲仅仅拥有包括法国、英国和俄罗斯在内的三大战略文化强国。
en: Still, Europe is home to only three countries with a robust strategic culture: France, the United Kingdom, and Russia.

zh: 三者都对地缘政治权力驱动和军事力量的运用有着深刻的制度性认识。
en: All three have a deep-seated institutional understanding of geopolitical power dynamics and the use of military force.

zh: 事实上，俄罗斯自身的军事现代化计划表明，该国寻求自身利益越来越依赖于建设硬实力。
