en: Indeed, Russia’s own program of military modernization suggests that it is becoming increasingly reliant on hard power to pursue its interests.

zh: 不仅如此，法国已经启动了欧洲干预计划，这一新框架以联合拥有真正防御能力和意愿的国家为目的。
en: Meanwhile, France has launched the European Intervention Initiative, a new framework uniting countries with real defense capabilities and a willingness to use them.

zh: 最重要的是，这一新团体哪怕在英国脱离欧盟后也将需要英国的参与。
en: Most important, this new grouping will include the UK even after it leaves the EU.

zh: 也就是说，在可以预见的未来，马克龙在欧盟级别中央指挥下组建欧洲军队的设想仍然仅仅是一种雄心壮志，而原因非常简单，那就是各国极少会自愿放弃军队。
en: That said, Macron’s vision of a European army under a central EU-level command will remain aspirational for the foreseeable future, for the simple reason that countries seldom give up their armies voluntarily.

zh: 尽管如此，马克龙更广泛的目标值得引起我们的深思，这一目标并不局限在特朗普和英国脱欧等眼前问题。
en: Nonetheless, it is worth considering Macron’s broader goal, which extends well beyond immediate concerns such as Trump and Brexit.

zh: 简言之，马克龙呼吁欧洲制定更加连贯和自主的战略，以实现21世纪欧洲的安全和防务利益。
en: In short, Macron is calling on Europe to develop a more coherent and autonomous strategy for pursuing its security and defense interests in the twenty-first century.

zh: 毋庸置疑，该项目将面临诸多障碍。
en: Needless to say, this project will encounter many hurdles.

zh: 只有美国人才能阻止俄国使用核武器。
en: Russia’s use of nuclear forces can be deterred only by those of the US.

zh: 法国和英国不愿承认，但他们的核武库数量根本不够，尤其现在俄国正在升级自身的核武库。
en: The French and the British don’t like to admit it, but their nuclear arsenals are simply insufficient, especially now that Russia is upgrading its own.

zh: 除核威慑之外，如果涉及跨欧洲大陆的军事行动，那么很有可能依然是美国处于指挥、控制和情报的核心位置。
en: Beyond nuclear deterrence, the US will also likely remain at the center of command, control, and intelligence when it comes to continent-wide operations.

zh: 此外，欧洲人还需要首先解决其内部的紧张局势。
en: Moreover, Europeans will also have to resolve a number of internal tensions.

zh: 德国将坚持所有新计划均需纳入欧盟构架，同时要求议会批准所有的军事行动。
en: Germany will insist that all new programs be housed within EU structures, while demanding parliamentary approval for all operations.

zh: 但英国将不再属于欧盟，并将对法国有关战略自治的言论持怀疑态度，而这可能反过来削弱北约。
en: But the British will no longer belong to the EU, and will remain skeptical of French talk of strategic autonomy, which could imply a weaker NATO.

zh: 欧盟东部成员国也同样如此，它们更不愿意支持与北约或美国脱钩的战略。
en: The same goes for eastern EU member states, which are even less willing to countenance a delinking from NATO or the US.

zh: 尽管存在这些困难，但人们正在就重组欧洲防务的必要性达成共识。
en: Despite these difficulties, there is an emerging consensus on the need to restructure European defense.

zh: 表面的推动力量是俄罗斯、中国和大中东地区不断增长的威胁。
en: The ostensible impetus is the growing threat from Russia, China, and the broader Middle East.

zh: 但令人不安的现实是，对军事一体化的重新关注也反映了由于英国脱欧和特朗普执政而在某些方面对欧洲战略地位所造成的侵蚀。
en: But the uncomfortable reality is that renewed interest in military integration also reflects the erosion of Europe’s strategic position as a result of Brexit and, in some respects, Trump.

zh: 我期待一支法国军队 — — 而非欧洲军队 — — 将在未来几十年的巴士底日进入香榭丽舍大街。
en: I expect that a French army – not a European one – will be marching down the Champs Elysée on Bastille Day for decades to come.

zh: 但我同样希望，欧洲国家在维护自身主权方面变得更加自信，并在涉及安全的问题上集体采取行动。
en: But I also expect European countries to become more assertive in defense of their sovereignty, and to act collectively when it comes to security.

zh: 欧洲终于在军力上扣动了扳机
en: Europe Finally Pulls the Trigger on a Military Force

zh: 慕尼黑 — — 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在欧洲的表现令人无法容忍。
en: MUNICH – US President Donald Trump is making an intolerable show of himself in Europe.

zh: 它不仅令人对美国承诺的北约共同防御产生怀疑；他还单方面宣布退出了伊朗和联合国安理会五大常任理事国，再加上德国和欧盟于2015年签署的核协议。
en: Not only has he cast doubt on America’s commitment to mutual defense under NATO; he has also unilaterally withdrawn from the 2015 nuclear agreement between Iran and the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, plus Germany and the European Union.

zh: 从那以后，特朗普政府单方面对从任何第三国（其中包括其他协议缔约国）向伊朗交付的货物实施禁运。
en: Since then, the Trump administration has unilaterally imposed an embargo on goods deliveries to Iran from any third country, including the other signatories of the agreement.

zh: 继续在伊朗开展业务的外国公司现在面临制裁威胁，而处理交易的银行则很可能会失去进入美国金融系统的机会。
en: Foreign firms that continue to conduct business in Iran now face the threat of sanctions, and banks that process transactions risk losing access to the US financial system.

zh: 此外，美国一直威胁对从俄罗斯到德国的新北溪2号天然气管线采取类似的行动。
en: Meanwhile, the US has been threatening similar action with respect to the new Nord Stream 2 gas pipeline that will run from Russia to Germany.

zh: 美国国会正在考虑，允许特朗普政府对参与该项目的欧洲公司实施制裁的立法，即使这些公司按照规定有责任履行合同义务。
en: The US Congress is considering legislation that allows the Trump administration to impose sanctions on European firms taking part in the project, even though these companies are contractually obliged to see the work through.

zh: 而且据现在主持管道项目的前德国总理格哈德·施罗德透露，美国驻德国大使的所作所为更像是一名“占领官 ” ， 而不是外交官的行径。
en: And, according to Gerhard Schröder, a former German chancellor who now chairs the pipeline project, the US ambassador to Germany has been acting more like an “occupation officer” than like a diplomat.

zh: 总而言之，朗普政府的破坏性行动令法国和德国政府感到愤怒。
en: All told, the Trump administration’s disruptive behavior has left the French and German governments furious.

zh: 但除愤怒以外，特朗普攻击他国主权的行为正在为欧洲政治统一创造新的机会。
en: But, beyond fueling anger, Trump’s attacks on other countries’ sovereignty are adding momentum to a new push for European political unification.

zh: 众所周知，欧洲正处在内部经济危机之中 — — 这是南部欧元区国家在2008年金融危机爆发前背负高通胀的结果，并因此严重削弱了它们在欧元体系内部的竞争力。
en: It is no secret that Europe is in the midst of an internal economic crisis – a result of the euro saddling southern eurozone countries with high inflation prior to the 2008 financial crash, which severely reduced their competitiveness within the euro system.

zh: 这些经济问题导致了整个欧洲大陆欧洲怀疑论民族主义政党和运动的出现。
en: These economic problems have led to the emergence of Euroskeptic nationalist parties and movements across the continent.

zh: 而不久前，英国退出欧盟的决定则进一步削弱了欧洲统一项目。
en: More recently, the European project has been weakened further by the United Kingdom’s decision to withdraw from the EU.

zh: 在这样的背景下，特朗普的所作所为实际是天赐的机会，因为它们迫使欧洲人接受一个现实，那就是欧洲人必须站在一起捍卫自身的主权和繁荣。
en: Against this backdrop, Trump’s actions are actually something of a godsend, because they have forced Europeans to accept that they must stand together in defense of their sovereignty and prosperity.

zh: （英国脱欧后）一个拥有近4.5亿人口的联盟无法容忍一个体量仅有其2/3的国家对它的态度就像对待附庸。
en: A union of almost 450 million people (after Brexit) cannot allow a country two-thirds its size to treat it like a group of vassal states.

zh: 因此，法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙和德国总理安格拉·默克尔本月宣布他们支持组建欧洲联合军队的必要性。
en: Accordingly, both French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Angela Merkel declared this month that they support the need to create a joint European army.

zh: 德国防长冯德莱恩表示理解这项工作的最佳方式是对特朗普政府要求欧洲投入更多防务资金的回应。
en: The best way to understand this effort, said German Minister of Defense Ursula von der Leyen, is as an answer to Trump’s demand that Europeans spend more on defense.

zh: 当然，冯德莱恩知道成立独立的欧洲部队并不真是美国总统想要的结果。
en: Of course, von der Leyen knows that the formation of an independent European force isn’t really what the US president had in mind.

zh: 但德国机构仍坚持认为，欧洲军队是对北约的强化和补充。
en: But the German establishment credibly maintains that a European army is meant to supplement and strengthen NATO.

zh: 跨大西洋联盟的必要性将不亚于从前，欧洲民众在看待美国民众时也不会缺少任何友谊和同情。
en: The transatlantic alliance will be no less necessary than it was before, nor will European citizens regard their American counterparts with any less sympathy and fellow feeling.

zh: 美欧之间深厚的历史渊源保持不变；人人都知道特朗普之后美国仍将是美国。
en: The deep historical ties between the US and Europe remain unchanged; everybody knows there will be an America after Trump.

zh: 更乐观的是，欧洲再次以充满活力和集体目标的方式寻求政治统一，而这恰恰是它原本应有的样子。
en: Better yet, Europe is once again pursuing political unification with vigor and a sense of collective purpose, and that is how it should be.

zh: 欧洲计划长期以来一直受困于以经济一体化为傲却将政治统一推向搁置。
en: The European project has long suffered from giving economic integration pride of place while pushing political unification to the backburner.

zh: 事实上，法国、意大利、比荷卢经济联盟（包括比利时、荷兰和卢森堡）以及德国早在1952年就已经同意在欧洲防务共同体框架下组建欧洲军队。
en: Indeed, France, Italy, the Benelux countries (Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg), and Germany had agreed to form a European army as early as 1952 under the Framework of the European Defense Community.

zh: 但法国国民议会从未批准该项条约，因此该条约也从未发挥过效力。
en: But the French National Assembly never ratified that treaty, so it never entered into force.

zh: 而后又诞生了马斯特里赫特条约，该条约再次为政治联盟提供了机会。
en: Then came the Maastricht Treaty, which offered a second chance for a political union.

zh: 但法国又一次构成了障碍。
en: Yet France stood in the way once again.

zh: 法国支持欧元成员资格，因为他们希望包括自己在内的地中海国家能够在资本市场上以与德国相同的低利率实现借贷。
en: The French supported euro membership, because they wanted the Mediterranean countries, including themselves, to be able to borrow at the same low rates as Germany on the capital markets.

zh: 但他们成功抵制了政治联盟的建立，因为政治联盟建立的前提是拥有联合军队并垄断武力使用的中央集权。
en: But they successfully resisted the creation of a political union, which is predicated on a central state with a joint army and monopoly on the use of military force.

zh: 如果法国现在认真考虑将本国军队并入欧洲中央指挥下的联合防御力量 — — 而不仅仅限于针对其前非洲殖民地的干预部队 — — 马克龙很有可能确保自己在史书中占据一席之位。
en: If France is now serious about merging national armies into a joint defense force under a central EU command – rather than just an intervention force for its former African colonies – Macron could well secure his place in the history books.

zh: 尽管还有很长的路要走。
en: There is much work to be done.

zh: 但如果目标真的实现，那么特朗普将是他的恩人。
en: But if it happens, he will have Trump to thank.

zh: 欧洲被包围？
en: Europe Under Siege?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—因为大量移民穿越国境，许多欧洲人觉得他们的国家正在遭受袭击。
en: BRUSSELS – Many Europeans feel like their countries are under assault, as huge numbers of migrants flow across their borders.

zh: 不论他们拥有第一手与难民打交道的经验，还只是通过报纸上的照片了解难民，欧洲人都很清楚，为数巨大的绝望人群正在试图通过各种可能方式进入欧盟领土。
en: Whether they are being exposed to refugees firsthand, or just seeing images of them splashed across newspaper pages, Europeans are well aware of the vast numbers of desperate people trying to enter European Union territory by any means possible.

zh: 但了解这一情况尚未转化为统一反应行动。
en: But this awareness has yet to translate into a unified response.

zh: 成员国之间的紧张似乎正在增加，也许是因为各国所面临的问题大相径庭。
en: Tensions among member states seem to be rising, perhaps because the problem differs so greatly across countries.

zh: 从人均角度衡量，瑞士接受的避难申请是英国的15倍。 英国的难民外交政策仍然是欧盟中最不友好的。
en: On a per capita basis, Sweden receives 15 times more asylum applications than the United Kingdom, where official policy toward refugees remains the most hostile.

zh: 德国已经成为第一大目的地，接受的难民占欧盟总量的近40 % ； 即使用人均衡量，也比欧盟平均水平高出数倍。
en: Germany has now become the main destination overall, receiving nearly 40% of the EU total; even on a per capita basis, this is several times more than the EU average.

zh: 当然，对于如何划分对难民的责任，有明确的规则：根据所谓的都柏林规则（Dublin Regulation ） ， 难民所进入的第一个欧盟成员国必须对该难民的避难申请负责。
en: Of course, there are clear rules about how responsibility for refugees is delineated: according to the so-called Dublin Regulation, the first EU member state into which a refugee crosses is responsible for that person’s asylum application.

zh: 但这显然是有问题的，因为它将所有负担都推给了欧盟边界国家。
en: But this is clearly problematic, as it puts the entire burden of refugees on the EU’s frontier countries.

zh: 尽管这一问题在20世纪90年代尚不严重 — — 欧盟国家每年总共只需要接受300,000避难申请 — — 但如今避难申请总数增长了两倍，这一规则已不再合适。
en: Though this may not have been a huge problem in the 1990s, when EU countries received, in all, only 300,000 asylum applications annually, it cannot work in a year when the total is expected to be triple that number.

zh: 较小的边界国家，如匈牙利和希腊，根本没有能力登记和为数十万计的寻求庇护者提供住宿。
en: Smaller border countries like Hungary and Greece simply do not have the capacity to register and house hundreds of thousands of asylum-seekers.

zh: 意大利等较大的国家有激励忽视在本国海岸登陆的大量难民，因为它们知道，如果什么都不做，这些难民有可能会去往别的地方（主要是北欧 ） 。
en: And larger countries like Italy have an incentive to overlook the large numbers of refugees landing on their shores, knowing that, if nothing is done, those refugees will likely head elsewhere (mainly to northern Europe).

zh: 德国知道都柏林规则不可靠，现已决定处理所有来自叙利亚人的避难申请，不管他们在何地进入欧盟。
en: Germany, recognizing that the Dublin system is untenable, has now decided to process all asylum applications from Syrians, regardless of where they crossed into the EU.

zh: 这一决定背后的动机也许是 — — 至少部分是 — — 欧盟内部边界错综复杂，难以确定难民最初从哪里入境。
en: The decision was likely driven, at least partly, by how difficult it is, given the EU’s porous internal borders, to determine where a refugee first entered.

zh: 欧洲法院（European Court of Justice）2013 裁定德国不能将伊朗难民遣返希腊（申请者被发现可能在那里“面临实实在在的受到非人道和不体面对待的风险 ” ） ，这也许突显出德国在这一问题上的责任感。
en: A 2013 ruling by the European Court of Justice that Germany could not return an Iranian refugee to Greece (where the applicant was found “to face a real risk of being subjected to inhuman or degrading treatment”) probably heightened Germany’s sense of responsibility on this issue.

zh: 从人口和GDP衡量，德国是欧盟最大的成员国；因此，从某种程度上，确实应该由它担任领导。
en: Germany is the largest EU member country in terms of population and GDP; so, to some extent, it does make sense for it to take the lead.

zh: 但德国的人口还不到欧盟的五分之一，经济规模也不到欧盟的四分之一。
en: But Germany still accounts for less than one-fifth of the EU’s population, and less than one-quarter of its economy.

zh: 换句话说，即使是德国也无法处置当今全部欧洲难民。
en: In other words, not even Germany can handle all of Europe’s refugees today.

zh: 几个月前，欧盟委员会试图解决这一问题。 它提出了一个大胆的方案，根据一个考虑了人口和GDP的简单的公式在各成员国之间分配难民。
en: A few months ago, the European Commission tried its hand at resolving this problem with a courageous proposal to distribute refugees across member states according to a simple equation that accounts for population and GDP.

zh: 但这一计划被拒绝，有成员国 — — 特别是难民最少的成员国 — — 声称这是对内政的过度干涉。
en: But the plan was rejected, with member states – particularly those with the fewest refugees – claiming that it represented an undue interference in domestic affairs.

zh: 这就引出了欧盟的常见困境：所有人都知道有问题，但达成解决方案需要一致同意，而一致同意不可能达成，因为每个国家只捍卫其自身利益。
en: This has put the EU in its usual quandary: everybody recognizes that there is a problem, but a solution requires unanimity, which cannot be achieved, because each country defends only its own interests.

zh: 唯一的前进之道是剔除（至少暂时剔除）最不愿意接受移民的国家，在愿意共同承担责任的国家之间形成一个解决方案。
en: The only way forward is to leave out the countries that are most averse to accepting immigrants, at least temporarily, and create a solution involving just those that are willing to share the burden.

zh: 这也许不“公平 ” ， 但是，每天都有更多的难民来到欧洲边界，欧盟领导人不能再坐视不理了。
en: This may not seem “fair,” but, with more refugees landing on Europe’s borders every day, EU leaders cannot afford to delay action.

zh: 但这场危机还有另一面，让解决它变得非常复杂。
en: But there is another dimension to the crisis that makes addressing it all the more complicated.

zh: 移民并非全部来自冲突地区，如叙利亚，因此，根据国际法，他们不具有“避难权 ” 。
en: The migrants are not all from conflict areas like Syria, and thus do not, according to international law, have a “right to asylum.”

zh: 有很多移民是来自（比如）巴尔干较穷地区的经济移民，他们的愿望是摆脱家乡的贫�� — — 并准备在移民过程中滥用避难制度。
en: There are also plenty of economic migrants from, say, the poorer parts of the Balkans, hoping to escape poverty at home – and willing to misuse the asylum system in the process.

zh: 提出避难申请，即使根本没有可能被接受，也颇具吸引力，因为在申请被拒绝前，申请者可以获得基本住宿、社会服务（包括医疗）和远超祖国工资水平的零花钱。
en: Lodging an application, even one without any chance of being accepted, is appealing, because until it is rejected, the applicant receives basic housing, social services (including health care), and pocket money in an amount that may well exceed wages in his or her home country.

zh: 在北欧呆上几个月等待避难申请处理远比回家做一份难以糊口的工作（甚至失业）更有吸引力。
en: Spending a few months in northern Europe while an asylum application is processed is far more attractive than going home to a job that pays a barely livable wage, or to no job at all.

zh: 随着避难申请者数量的增加，处理申请的时间也随之延长，避难制度对经济移民的诱惑力也更大了。
en: As the number of asylum-seekers increases, so does the time it takes to process their applications, making the system all the more tempting for economic migrants.

zh: 事实上，如今在德国的避难申请者中有近一半来自安全的国家，如塞尔维亚、阿尔巴尼亚和马其顿。
en: And, indeed, close to half of all asylum-seekers in Germany now come from safe countries, like Serbia, Albania, or Macedonia.

zh: 欧洲民粹主义者用这些“福利旅游”的例子煽动欧洲公众的恐慌和愤怒，在这样的情况下，达成协议收留真正的难民变得越来越困难。
en: As Europe’s populists use such cases of “welfare tourism” to sow fear and anger among the European public, reaching an agreement to accommodate actual refugees becomes increasingly difficult.

zh: 在这一背景下，欧盟需要双管齐下。
en: Against this background, the EU needs to take action on two fronts.

zh: 首先，各成员国必须立刻增加处理避难申请的能力，以便迅速识别应该获得保护的申请者。
en: First, member countries must urgently boost their capacity to deal with asylum applications, so that they can quickly identify those who deserve protection.

zh: 其次，欧盟需要改进负担共担机制 — — 在理想情况下应由所有国家一起承担，但首先也许只能在较少数国家实现 — — 为获得避难权的人提供住所。
en: Second, the EU needs to improve burden sharing – ideally among all countries, but perhaps among a smaller group at first – in providing shelter for those who gain asylum.

zh: 这也是国际法 — — 以及基本道德 — — 的最低要求。
en: International law – and basic morality – demands nothing less.

zh: 关上红利的龙头
en: Turning Off the Dividend Spigot

zh: 纽约—欧洲银行高昂的诉讼和重组成本给它们的账表造成了严重损失，也让股价一蹶不振。
en: NEW YORK – European banks’ high litigation and restructuring costs have resulted in major losses on their books and abysmal stock-market performance.

zh: 欧洲银行业和监管者目前正在反思这一窘况、寻找解决之道，它们应该考虑银行的收入（revenue）分配 — — 包括员工奖金和股东红利 — — 也是问题的一部分。
en: As the industry and European regulators now reflect on this dismal state of affairs and search for solutions, they should consider banks’ revenue distribution – including employee bonuses and shareholder dividends – as part of the problem.

zh: 收入分配是欧洲银行资本短缺的一个主要原因。
en: Revenue distribution is one primary reason for European banks’ capital shortfalls.

zh: 要理解个中原因，可以回顾2014年10月欧洲银行局（European Banking Authority，EBA）对欧元区123家大银行所做的资产负债表压力测试，该测试发现所有银行存在250亿欧元的资本短缺。
en: To understand why, we should look back to October 2014, when the European Banking Authority began balance-sheet stress tests for the eurozone’s largest 123 banks and found a capital shortfall of €25 billion ($28 billion) in all of them.

zh: 当时，EBA要求银行在6—9个月内制定出解决各自资本短缺问题的计划。
en: At the time, the EBA required the banks to devise plans to address their respective shortfalls within 6-9 months.

zh: 一些银行采取了行动，通过权益工具发行筹集股本，有时政府也提供了大量帮助。
en: Some banks took action and raised equity through rights issues, sometimes with substantial help from governments.

zh: 但大部分银行只是降低了高风险资产改善资本比率，以此蒙混过关。
en: But most banks mollified regulators by simply shedding riskier assets to improve their capital ratios.

zh: 不消说，这些措施毫无效果，欧洲银行自2014年首次评估以来平均下跌了50 % 。
en: Needless to say, these efforts were ineffective, and European banks’ share prices have declined by 50%, on average, since the initial 2014 assessment.

zh: 没有通过压力测试，也没有认真对待结果的银行固然需要谴责，但没有充分监督银行改善资产负债表，以及把压力测试难度定得太低以至于无法找出财务弱点的监管者也难辞其咎。
en: Banks that failed the stress test and didn’t take the result seriously are partly to blame, but so, too, are regulators who did not sufficiently hold the banks’ feet to the fire to improve their balance sheets, and who may have applied stress tests that were too weak to detect financial frailty.

zh: 7月底，EBA组织了新一轮压力测试并公布了结果。
en: The EBA conducted another series of stress tests and reported the results in late July.

zh: 该轮测试包括51家银行，与此前的测试不同，它们的目标并不是发现资本短缺，而是提供“通用的分析框架对欧盟大银行面临不利经济发展形势时的恢复力进行持续的比较和评估。 ”
en: This latest round looked at 51 banks and, contrary to previous tests, was not designed to identify capital shortfalls, but rather to provide “a common analytical framework to consistently compare and assess the resilience of large EU banks to adverse economic developments.”

zh: 现在，监管者认为欧洲银行业面对不利冲击具备足够的恢复力。
en: Regulators now suppose that the European banking sector is resilient to adverse shocks.

zh: 在EBA结果公布的当天，测试表现最差的意大利锡耶纳牧山银行（Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena）根据其56亿欧元资本要求宣布进行50亿欧元的新筹资。
en: On the same day as the EBA’s announcement, the worst performer, Italy’s Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena, announced €5 billion ($5.6 billion) in new funding, pursuant to its €5.6 billion capital requirement.

zh: 但是，市场对该公告的反应是消极的（EuroStoxx银行指数两天下跌了7.5 % ） ，最可能的原因是EBA没有公告欧洲银行资本短缺情况的具体估算值或列出再融资计划。
en: Still, market reaction to the announcement was negative (the EuroStoxx Banks index fell 7.5% in two days), most likely because the EBA did not include specific estimates of European banks’ capital shortfalls or outline a recapitalization plan.

zh: 我们在一份研究这一市场反应的新文章中，根据美国资本要求规则算出所有51家参与测试的银行的总资本短缺为1,230亿欧元。
en: In a new paper investigating this market reaction, using United States capital-requirement rules, we calculate the total capital shortfall in all 51 participating banks to be €123 billion.

zh: 尽管这一资本缺口十分巨大，但压力测试中34家上市银行中的28家在2015年发放了400亿欧元左右的红利，这意味着它们平均将60%的利润分配给了股东。
en: Despite this large capital shortfall, 28 of the 34 publicly listed banks in the stress test paid out about €40 billion in dividends for 2015, meaning that they distributed, on average, over 60% of their earnings to shareholders.

zh: 资本不足银行所支付的红利等于是财富从次级债权���转移到股东，因为在危机中蒙受损失的是债权人。
en: Dividend payments made by under-capitalized banks amount to a substantial wealth transfer from subordinated bondholders to shareholders, because it is bondholders who will suffer the losses in a crisis.

zh: 此外，本质上这也是财富从纳税人转移到私人股东，因为根据新的银行规则，可以在债权人（自救，bail-in）了银行股本和负债的8%后进行政府援助。
en: Moreover, it is potentially a wealth transfer from taxpayers to private shareholders, because under new banking rules government bailouts are possible after bondholders have covered (bailed in) 8% of a bank’s equity and liabilities.

zh: 相反，在美国，资本不足银行如果不能通过压力测试，将强制停止一切形式的资本分配。
en: By contrast, undercapitalized banks in the US are forced to halt all forms of capital distribution if they fail a stress test.

zh: 幸运的是，2016年压力测试后，EBA 现在也开始考虑此类监管制裁。
en: Fortunately, following the 2016 round of stress tests, the EBA is now also considering this type of regulatory sanction.

zh: 因此 ， “ 胜任的当局也许还将考虑要求改变机构的资本计划 ” ， 资本计划“可以采取多种形式，比如，可以要求银行如想分红就必须在不利情景下保持议定资本计划。 ”
en: Thus, “competent authorities may also consider requesting changes to the institutions’ capital plan,” which “may take a number of forms such as potential restrictions on dividends required for a bank to maintain the agreed trajectory of its capital planning in the adverse scenario.”

zh: 我们估算，如果欧洲监管者早些采取这一方针，强制银行在2010年 — — 即欧洲主权债务爆发之年 — — 停止发放红利，留存股本将足以支付2016年资本短缺的50%以上。
en: We estimate that if European regulators had adopted this approach and forced banks to stop paying dividends in 2010 – the start of the sovereign debt crisis in Europe – the retained equity could have paid for more than 50% of the 2016 capital shortfalls.

zh: 下图说明了我们所计算的资本短缺情况，使用了EBA压力测试的“不利情景”损失以及这些银行自2010年以来发放的累计红利。
en: The figure above shows our calculated capital shortfalls, using the EBA stress test’s “adverse scenario” losses and the cumulative dividends these banks have distributed since 2010.

zh: 一些银行，如巴黎银行和巴克莱银行，所发放的红利其实已经超过当前资本短缺，也有一些 — — 如德意志银行、德国商业银行和法国兴业银行 — — 的资本短缺远超所能留存的红利。
en: Dividends paid out by some banks, such as BNP Paribas and Barclays, actually exceed the current capital shortfalls, while at others – such as Deutsche Bank, Commerzbank, and Société Générale – capital shortfalls far exceed dividends that would have been retained.

zh: 除了红利限制，后面这些银行仍需要大量发行资本以弥补缺额。
en: The latter banks would still require substantial capital issuances on top of dividend restrictions to make up the difference.

zh: 尽管如此，我们的发现给出了迈向防止银行资本流失的简单的第一步：禁止存在资本短缺的银行发放红利（包括员工奖金等内部红利 ） 。
en: Nonetheless, our findings suggest a simple first step toward preventing bank capital erosion: stop banks with capital shortfalls from paying dividends (including internal dividends such as employee bonuses).

zh: 这一政策甚至不需要监管者讨论资本发行、援助或自救等问题，并且一些银行甚至已经开始停止发放红利。
en: Such a policy would not even require regulators to broach topics like capital issuance, bailouts, or bail-ins, and some banks have even already begun to suspend dividend payments.

zh: 现在，所欠缺的只是欧洲央行在整个欧元区执行这一方针。
en: All that’s left now is for the European Central Bank to enforce this practice across the eurozone.

zh: 银行联盟的新年
en: A New Year’s Banking Union

zh: 布鲁塞尔—金融危机爆发五年后，欧洲经济和政治状况依然脆弱。
en: BRUSSELS – Five years after the outbreak of the financial crisis, Europe’s economic and political situation remains fragile.

zh: 预计今年欧洲将经历轻微衰退，失业率也早升高。
en: A mild recession is expected in Europe this year, and unemployment is on the rise.

zh: 除了削减赤字，我们还需要实施1200亿欧元的欧洲投资计划，并深化欧洲单一市场以释放其增长潜力。
en: Beyond deficit reduction, we need to implement a €120 billion ($155 billion) European investment plan, and deepen the European Single Market to unleash its growth potential.

zh: 但我们还需要其他结构性措施。
en: But we also need other structural measures.

zh: 欧盟必须切断个体成员国与其国内银行系统之间的负反馈环。
en: The European Union must put an end to the negative feedback loop between individual member states and their national banking systems.

zh: 2008—2011年间，欧盟纳税人给了银行4.5万亿欧元贷款和担保。
en: Between 2008 and 2011, EU taxpayers granted banks €4.5 trillion in loans and guarantees.

zh: 在一些国家，用公共资金重组银行资本的威胁已导致市场信心的大跌和利率的大增。
en: In some countries, the threat of bank recapitalization with public funds has resulted in a drop in market confidence and a huge rise in interest rates.

zh: 欧洲央行已采取决定性手段切断这一恶性循环。
en: The European Central Bank (ECB) has taken decisive action to break this vicious circle.

zh: 此外，17个欧元区成员国也已经达成一致，必须以银行联盟补充共同货币。
en: Moreover, there is now a consensus that the 17 eurozone countries need a banking union to accompany their common currency.

zh: 欧盟委员会发布了单一银行资本要求规则、对各国存款保险机制的共同支持方案，以及泛欧洲清算倒闭银行规则（主要损失将由银行股东和债权人而不是纳税人承担 ） 。
en: The European Commission has proposed a single rulebook for banks’ capital requirements; mutual support between national deposit guarantee schemes; and Europe-wide rules for resolving failing banks that place the main burden on bank shareholders and creditors, not on taxpayers.

zh: 6月29日，欧洲各国和政府首脑承诺成立单一的欧元区银行监督机构。
en: On June 29, European heads of state and government committed themselves to the creation of a single European supervisor for banks in the eurozone.

zh: 这对于金融稳定性和公共财政来说都是好消息：一旦单一监督机构成立，监督就将更加可信和公正，这对于处理受困银行让它们重获活力非常重要。
en: This is good news for both financial stability and public finances: once the single supervisor is in place, supervision will be more credible and impartial, which is important for dealing with ailing banks and managing their return to viability.

zh: 欧盟委员会还更进一步，提出了一系列立法方案，欲成立单一监督机制并将主要监督职责授予欧洲央行。
en: The European Commission also put forward a set of legislative proposals to establish the single supervisory mechanism and confer key supervisory tasks on the ECB.

zh: 欧洲议会和部长会议必须尽快修订和批准这一方案，如果我们想抓住机会激活欧洲稳定性机制（ESM）并打下其他银行联盟必要基础的话。
en: This proposal must now be amended and approved as soon as possible by the European Parliament and the Council of Ministers if we are to have a chance of activating the European Stability Mechanism (ESM) and proceeding with the other essential pillars of a banking union.

zh: 不过，在诸多领域，仍需要更多的动作：
en: Further work, however, is still needed in several areas:

zh: 从2013年就开始实施新方案将先让欧洲央行监督获得或要求公共资金的银行。
en: Entry into force in January 2013 would bring about supervision by the ECB of banks that have received or requested public funding.

zh: 直到2013年6月，所有具系统重要性的银行才会纳入欧洲央行的监督之下。
en: Only in July 2013 would all banks of major systemic importance be subject to ECB supervision.

zh: 剩余银行将在2014年初进入新机制的管辖范围。
en: The remaining banks would be subject to the new mechanism at the start of 2014.

zh: 对于如此兹事体大的工程，激烈争论再正常不过了。
en: Intense discussions are normal for such a high-stakes project.

zh: 德国、芬兰和荷兰等国家有权利争辩说快速推进不能以牺牲新监督结构的质量为代价。
en: Countries like Germany, Finland, and the Netherlands are right to argue that rapid progress cannot come at the expense of the new supervisory structure’s quality.

zh: 但欧盟国家必须兑现6月份所做出的承诺，争取按时启动2013年开始逐步实施的方案。
en: But EU countries have to stick to the commitment that they made in June and strike a deal in time for a gradual entry into force in January 2013.

zh: 欧洲资本市场能在英国脱欧后幸存下来吗？
en: Can a European Capital Market Survive Brexit?

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 2015年9月30日，在英国还拥有欧盟正式成员国资格的那些遥远日子里，时任欧盟专员的乔纳森·希尔（Jonathan Hill）宣布启动一项名为“资本市场联盟”的新动议。
en: LONDON – On September 30, 2015, in those far-off days when the United Kingdom was a fully-fledged member of the European Union, then-European Commissioner Jonathan Hill announced the launch of a new initiative called the “capital markets union.”

zh: 欧洲建构已近60年，却仍然未能创造出任何近似单一投资市场的体系，同时许多欧盟国家的资本市场依然处于贫弱不发达状态。
en: Almost 60 years of European construction had still not created anything approaching a single market for investment, and in many EU countries capital markets remained weak and underdeveloped.

zh: 希尔写道，这一动议的价值在于“找出那些阻碍跨境投资流动的障碍”并“研究如何一步步克服它们 ” 。
en: The worthy aim, Hill wrote, was “to identify the barriers to the cross-border flow of investment,” and “work out how to overcome them step by step.”

zh: 自那以后大量流动性资金在各国之间进进出出，而希尔也已经退休，领取自己的欧元养老金了。
en: Much liquidity has flowed under the bridge since then, and Hill is now drawing his euro-pension.

zh: 但我们却尚未在这方面看到很大的进展。
en: But it is hard to see that a great deal of progress has been made.

zh: 事实上该项目甚至有可能被逆转，因为英国脱欧的举措可能会破坏和分裂欧洲现在拥有的一个运作良好的资本市场 — — 伦敦，欧洲公司从市场中筹集的大部分资金都是由该地经手的。
en: Indeed, the project may even have gone into reverse, as Brexit threatens to disrupt and divide the one well-functioning capital market Europe now possesses: London, which accounts for the majority of the market finance raised for European companies.

zh: 这种可能发生分裂是极为负面的，因为它会加剧欧盟委员会所定义的实际问题。
en: That likely split is highly unfortunate, to the extent that it worsens the real problem the European Commission identified.

zh: 与美国相比，欧洲在很大程度上依赖于银行融资。
en: By comparison with the US, Europe relies heavily on bank finance.

zh: 在美国，企业债券市场占到了企业融资来源的近3/4，剩下那1/4由银行贷款填补。
en: In the US, the corporate bond market is the source of almost three-quarters of finance for companies, with bank lending supplying the remaining quarter.

zh: 在除英国外的那27个欧盟国家，这一比例几乎完全倒转了过来。
en: In the 27 remaining EU countries, the proportions are almost exactly reversed.

zh: 在英国，这个数字大约是50：50 — — 正如经常出现的情况那样，英国常常会位于大西洋两岸的某个中间位置。
en: In the UK, it is about half and half: as is often the case, Britain is positioned somewhere in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.

zh: 欧盟银行之所以会发挥不同作用是有结构和历史原因的，我们也不应指望欧洲资本市场能完全遵循其北美同行的运作模式。
en: There are structural and historical reasons for the different role played by EU banks, and one should not expect European capital markets precisely to follow the pattern of their North American counterparts.

zh: 在所谓的莱茵兰（Rhineland）模式中，银行与其企业客户的关系非常密切，有时甚至持有它们的股份。
en: In the so-called Rhineland model, banks are often very close to their corporate clients, and sometimes own stakes in them.

zh: 但对金融危机的反思则显示了企业资金来源多元化的重要性。
en: But the aftermath of the financial crisis showed the importance of diversified funding sources for companies.

zh: 由于银行贷款急剧减少（按实际价值计减少了1/5 ） ， 欧盟企业的总融资额相对GDP的比率已经从2006年时的112％下降到2016年的106 ％ 。
en: Total funding of EU companies fell from 112% of GDP in 2006 to 106% in 2016, owing to a sharp reduction in bank lending, which dropped by a fifth in real terms.

zh: 由于银行试图修复自身资产负债表并重建资本实力，美国的银行贷款额也略有下降。
en: Bank lending fell a little in the US, too, as banks sought to restore their balance sheets and rebuild their capital strength.

zh: 这是更严格银行监管的必然后果，并且相当比例的危机后资本金比率改善也是由于贷款减少所致。
en: Tighter bank regulation made that inevitable, and a considerable proportion of the post-crisis improvement in capital ratios was driven by a reduction in lending.

zh: 但在美国，资本市场有能力弥补这一缺口，企业融资总额也有所上升，推动了更为强劲的经济复苏。
en: But in the US, the capital markets were able to take up the slack, and total funding available to companies has risen, powering a more robust economic recovery.

zh: 但在欧洲，资本市场并未发挥吸纳银行信贷收缩配额冲击的重要作用。
en: In Europe, capital markets have not played that vital role of absorbing the shock of credit rationing by banks.

zh: 欧洲央行在这方面已经尽了全力，特别制定了相关计划去为银行提供资金以贷款给中小企业。
en: The European Central Bank has done its best to help, with special schemes that fund banks to lend to small and medium-size enterprises.

zh: 这些举措都取得了成功 — — 但只是在一定程度上。
en: These have been successful, up to a point.

zh: 各银行在最新的计划中领取了740亿欧元（折合888亿美元 ） — —这些资金将在未来三年内偿还。
en: The latest scheme had a take-up of €740 billion ($888 billion) – money that is to be repaid within the next three years.

zh: 但这样的计划给欧洲央行带来了负担，限制了其撤回非常规融资并实现货币政策正常化的能力。
en: But such programs impose a burden on the ECB and constrain its ability to withdraw unconventional funding and normalize monetary policy.

zh: 如果欧洲资本市场能更加灵活并向更广大的企业开放，情况就会好得多。
en: It would be far better if European capital markets were more flexible and open to a wider range of companies.

zh: 现在有一些不太显眼的迹象表明企业正在向以市场为基础的融资方式转换。
en: There are now some modest signs that a shift to market-based financing is under way.

zh: 银行自身也已经能够筹集到新的股权资本，也有利于事态的好转。
en: The banks themselves have been able to raise new equity capital, which helps.

zh: 欧洲也已经开始磕磕绊绊地推动更高程度的市场行为标准化。
en: And Europe has taken baby steps toward promoting greater standardization of market practices.

zh: 欧盟委员会正在鼓励欧洲证券化市场的重生，欧洲证券和市场管理局的权力也得到了加强。
en: The European Commission is encouraging the rebirth of a European securitization market, for example, and the powers of the European Securities and Markets Authority are being strengthened.

zh: 那些迄今仍然不愿将本国市场控制权让渡给泛欧洲权力机构的欧盟成员国也逐渐意识到，大家需要一个更接近于欧洲证券交易委员会的来确保共同标准的执行。
en: Member states that hitherto were reluctant to cede control over their markets to a pan-European authority are coming to understand that something closer to a European Securities and Exchange Commission is needed to ensure common standards.

zh: 但进展依旧缓慢，而英国脱欧则是另一大阻碍。
en: But progress is slow, and Brexit is a further obstacle.

zh: 欧洲最大的流动性和资本池仍然位于泰晤士河畔，目前还没有人知道英国脱欧会对它们造成何种影响。
en: The largest pools of European liquidity and capital remain located on the banks of the Thames, and no one yet knows how UK withdrawal from the EU will affect them.

zh: 投资者和银行家警告说，通过对英国和欧盟之间的跨境活动实施控制来割裂这些资金池将会阻碍资本市场联盟的发展进程并推高欧盟企业的融资成本。
en: Investors and bankers warn that dividing these pools by imposing controls on cross-border activity between the UK and the EU will set back the cause of capital markets union and make financing more costly for EU companies.

zh: 但就目前而言，有关英国脱欧的政策 — — 无论是在英吉利海峡的哪一边 — — 都是市场友好型解决方案的绊脚石。
en: But, for now, the politics of Brexit – on both sides of the English Channel – are standing in the way of a market-friendly solution.

zh: 不出意外，英国正努力为伦敦金融企业保留尽可能多的市场准入权。
en: The UK, understandably, is trying to maintain as much market access as possible for London-based firms.

zh: 但欧洲脱欧谈判代表米歇尔·巴尼埃（Michel Barnier）坚称，随着英国向“第三方国家”状态转型，只可能为其保留有限的监管等同待遇，意味着跨海峡金融交易将受到限制。
en: Michel Barnier, Europe’s Brexit negotiator, is insisting that, as the UK makes its transition to “third country” status, only limited regulatory equivalence is possible. And that, says Barnier, will restrict cross-channel financial transactions.

zh: 随着欧洲经济的初期性放缓迹象开始扩大 — — 多个同期指标显示2018年工业产量大幅下跌 — — 同意英国脱欧达成协议并重新关注资本市场联盟的必要性也变得日益重大和迫切。
en: As signs of an incipient slowdown in the European economy begin to multiply – coincident indicators suggest that industrial production has slowed sharply in 2018 – the case for agreeing on a Brexit deal and refocusing attention on capital markets union is becoming more powerful and more urgent.

zh: 现任欧盟专员瓦尔季斯·东布罗夫斯基斯（Valdis Dombrovskis）于4月下旬在伦敦表示那些“构建模块”将于明年年初到位，以“帮助我们的企业更好地应对欧洲最大金融中心脱离单一市场的情况 ” 。
en: The commissioner now responsible, Valdis Dombrovskis, said in London in late April that the “building blocks” will be in place early next year, to “help our companies to better cope with the departure of Europe’s largest financial center from the single market.”

zh: 这是一个值得赞扬的目标，但它或许太渺小，也太迟了。
en: That is a laudable goal, but it could well be too little, too late.

zh: 日渐膨胀的欧洲泡沫
en: Europe’s Emerging Bubbles

zh: 慕尼黑 — — 欧洲央行的最新政策举动令许多观察家大跌眼镜。
en: MUNICH – The European Central Bank’s latest policy moves have shocked many observers.

zh: 虽然目标 — — 防通缩促增长 — — 相当明确，但这些政策本却成为了严重不稳定态势的根源。
en: While the goal – to prevent deflation and spur growth – is clear, the policies themselves are setting the stage for severe instability.

zh: 有问题的政策包括将欧洲央行主要再融资操作的利率设置为零；将每月的资产购买总额从200亿欧元（折合223亿美元）提高到800亿欧元；把银行在欧洲央行的存款利率进一步推入负值区域 （ - 0.40 ％ ） 。
en: The policies in question include setting the interest rate on the ECB’s main refinancing operations to zero; raising monthly asset purchases by €20 billion ($22.3 billion) to €80 billion; and pushing the interest rate on money that banks deposit with the ECB further into negative territory – to -0.40%.

zh: 此外，欧洲央行还推出了四个一连串的新定向长期再融资操作，同时也包含了负利率。
en: Moreover, the ECB has launched a new series of four targeted longer-term refinancing operations, which also carry negative interest rates.

zh: 银行只有贷款给私人企业的时候才能从欧洲央行处拿到不到0.4％的利息。
en: Banks receive up to 0.4% interest on ECB credit that they take themselves, provided they lend it out to private businesses.

zh: 欧洲央行一直都尝试收拾南欧地区在推行欧元的最初一段时期形成的大量泡沫崩溃的残局，而这些政策只是这一系列尝试中的最新一项。
en: These policies are, in essence, the latest in a string of attempts by the ECB to address the fallout of the collapse of the massive bubble that formed in southern Europe in the early years of the euro.

zh: 这一切都始于1995年马德里欧洲峰会上宣布引入欧元从而导致利率暴跌的公告。
en: It all began with the announcement of the euro’s introduction at the 1995 EU Summit in Madrid, which caused interest rates to tumble.

zh: 由持续低利率所引发的南欧国家通胀信贷泡沫削弱了这些国家的竞争力，并将资产和房产价格推高到了不可持续的高水平。
en: The inflationary credit bubble spurred in southern European countries by the persistence of lower interest rates undermined their competitiveness and drove asset and property prices to unsustainably high levels.

zh: 当泡沫破灭后，欧洲央行试图通过使用印钞机并向投资者承诺无限保底来防止过高的价格回到均衡水平，而上述新措施也只是上述策略的翻版而已。
en: When the bubble burst, the ECB tried to prevent the excessive prices from returning to their equilibrium levels by using its printing press and promising unlimited coverage to investors. The latest ECB measures are just more of the same.

zh: 当然，在金融危机在2008年美国投行雷曼兄弟倒闭后全面爆发之时，欧洲央行的干预是合理的。
en: Of course, when the financial crisis erupted in full force in 2008, following the collapse of the US investment bank Lehman Brothers, the ECB’s interventions were justified.

zh: 但当全球经济在随后一年的后半段开始复苏，欧洲央行的举措就变得越来越有问题，因为它们令各国能够逃避实施结构性​​改革以及南部欧元区国家必要的通货紧缩 — — 甚至将其完全停止，正如在葡萄牙和意大利所发生的那样。
en: But after the global economy started to recover during the latter part of the following year, the ECB’s moves became increasingly problematic, because they enabled countries to evade structural reform and hindered the necessary disinflation in the southern eurozone countries – or even halted it altogether, as in Portugal and Italy.

zh: 南欧染上了廉价信贷的毒瘾。
en: Southern Europe had succumbed to the drug of cheap credit.

zh: 而当私人信贷停滞，戒毒症状开始出现时，欧洲央行又奉上了替代药物。
en: But when private credit stalled and the symptoms of withdrawal began to appear, the ECB provided replacement drugs.

zh: 但相对于戒断毒瘾，它却创造了一堆无法自我修复的瘾君子经济体。
en: Instead of treating the addiction, it created junkie economies that were unable to function without a fix.

zh: 日本也在1990年房地产泡沫破灭时犯了同样的错误。
en: Japan made a similar mistake when its property bubble burst in 1990.

zh: 在过去的二十年中，日本央行以近零利率让整个经济体充斥着钞票。
en: For over two decades, the Bank of Japan flooded the economy with money at near-zero interest rates.

zh: 日本政府一直固守赤字开支政策，令公共债务由相当于GDP的67％暴涨到246 ％ ， 最近又被首相安倍晋三政府所推行的令人摸不着头脑的“安倍经济学”经济战略所再次推高。
en: The Japanese government, for its part, has followed such a relentless policy of deficit spending that public debt jumped from 67% of GDP to 246% of GDP today, with the latest upward push provided by the dubious “Abenomics” economic strategy being pursued by Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s government.

zh: 所有这些策略都无济于事，因为无论是货币还是财政政策都无法替代结构性改革。
en: None of this has helped, because neither monetary nor fiscal policy can substitute for structural reform.

zh: 相反，随着服用越来越多的凯恩斯主义和货币主义药物，市场的自愈能力也不断减弱，政策制定者对经济和民众实施痛苦戒毒治疗的意愿也就越弱。
en: On the contrary, the more Keynesian and monetarist drugs are administered, the feebler the self-healing power of the markets and the weaker the willingness of policymakers to impose painful detoxification treatments on the economy and populace.

zh: 但欧洲央行政策的最坏影响可能还尚未到来，除非那些仍然健全的欧元区经济体也成为信贷瘾君子。
en: But the worst effects of the ECB policy may be yet to come, if the eurozone’s still-sound economies also become credit junkies.

zh: 目前在这方面也出现了一些令人担忧的迹象。
en: There are already some worrying signs of this.

zh: 奥地利，德国和卢森堡的房地产市场实际上已经在危机期间大涨，因为银行在以近零利率四处贷款，却无视贷款者的信用状态。
en: Property markets in Austria, Germany, and Luxembourg have practically exploded throughout the crisis, as a result of banks chasing borrowers with offers of loans at near-zero interest rates, regardless of their creditworthiness.

zh: 在奥地利，房产价格自雷曼兄弟破产以来已经上涨了1/2；而卢森��的房价也上升了近1/3。
en: In Austria, property prices have risen by nearly half since the Lehman collapse; in Luxembourg, they have risen by almost one-third.

zh: 即使是欧洲最大的经济体德国也经历了2010年以来最大规模的房地产热潮，城市住宅平均价格上升了超过1/3 — — 大城市则升了将近一半。
en: Even Germany, Europe’s largest economy, has been experiencing a massive property boom since 2010, with average urban property prices having risen by more than one-third – and by nearly half in large cities.

zh: 该国正经历自两德统一以来前所未有的建设热潮。
en: The country is undergoing a construction boom not seen since reunification.

zh: 房产中介手里只有一些尾货在售卖，其他都被抢光了。
en: Real estate agents have only leftovers on offer.

zh: 德国的房地产热潮本可以用适当的利率跳升来进行遏制​。
en: The German property boom could be reined in with an appropriate jump in interest rates.

zh: 但鉴于欧洲央行显然决心在相反的方向前进，泡沫只会越来越大。
en: But, given the ECB’s apparent determination to head in the opposite direction, the bubble will only grow.

zh: 一旦泡沫爆裂，对欧元的影响将是灾难性的；而最近在德国州议会选举中狂飙突进的新欧洲怀疑论政党正等待着这一天的到来。
en: If it bursts, the effects could be dire for the euro; the new Euro-skeptic Alternative for Germany party, which made astonishing headway in the country’s recent state elections, would make sure of that.

zh: 欧元区的明斯基困局
en: The Eurozone’s Minsky Conundrum

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 挥之不去的低通胀一直困扰着欧洲央行。
en: BRUSSELS – Stubbornly low inflation has the European Central Bank worried.

zh: 但它对此的应对手段 — — 本质上只是更多的量化宽松 — — 可能只会适得其反，不但加剧了失衡状况，还将导致严重的金融动荡。
en: But its response – essentially just more quantitative easing – could backfire, exacerbating imbalances and generating serious financial instability.

zh: 目前欧元区的整体消费物价指数一直徘徊在0附近，而核心通胀率甚至仍然低于1 ％ — —距离欧洲央行2％左右的目标依然太远。
en: As it stands, the headline consumer price index in the eurozone hovers around zero, and even core inflation remains below 1% – too far for comfort from the ECB’s target of around 2%.

zh: 虽然这些数字都可归因于今年早些时候的新一轮全球大宗商品价格下跌，但却无法解释较长期的通胀预期的疲软问题 — — 即便在今年三月欧洲央行启动了每月600亿欧元（约合663亿美元）的大规模债券购买计划后出现了些许改善。
en: While a new round of weakness in global commodity prices earlier this year contributed to these figures, it does not explain the weakness in longer-term inflation expectations, which have improved little since March, when the ECB started its massive €60 billion ($66.3 billion) per month bond-buying program.

zh: 但欧洲央行并未因此重新思考其战略，而是开始考虑双倍下注：购买更多债券，并进一步将其基准利率降为负值，而这将酿成大错。
en: But instead of rethinking its strategy, the ECB is considering doubling down: buying even more bonds and lowering its benchmark interest rate even further into negative territory. This would be a serious mistake.

zh: 更简易的信贷条款以及更低的利率本可通过刺激投资和消费需求以提振经济增长。
en: Easier credit conditions and lower interest rates are supposed to boost growth by stimulating investment and consumption demand.

zh: 但欧元区的核心 — — 如德国荷兰等国 — — 信贷已然充足，而利率已经相当一段时间接近于0，因此购买债券也不太可能产生显著的影响。
en: But in the core of the eurozone – countries like Germany and the Netherlands – credit has been plentiful, and interest rates have been close to zero for some time, so there was never much chance that bond purchases would have a significant impact there.

zh: 而实际上欧盟委员会最新发表的经济预测报告就显示，核心国家的支出并未因欧洲央行的政策而增加；德国的外部顺差还在进一步增大。
en: And, indeed, the European Commission’s most recent economic forecast shows that spending in the core countries has not increased as a result of the ECB’s policies; Germany’s external surplus is actually increasing.

zh: 当然，那些债台高筑的外围国家是有足够的空间去下调利率和增加信贷供应 — — 而它们已经在引导政府和家庭增加支出。
en: Of course, in the highly indebted peripheral countries, there was room for interest rates to fall and for credit supply to grow – and they have, leading governments and households to increase their spending.

zh: 但虽然欧洲央行政策的不对称影响在原则上是合理的（因为外围国家的失业率要高得多 ） ， 无奈现实告诉我们，仅靠那些个麻烦最大的国家是无法可持续支撑经济复苏的。
en: While the asymmetrical impact of the ECB’s policy is appropriate in principle (because unemployment is much higher in the periphery), the reality is that a recovery supported by the least solvent economies is not sustainable.

zh: 早在1986年，美国经济学家海曼·明斯基（Hyman Minsky）就警告说如果“庞氏骗局式”的借款人 — — 那些用新债偿旧债者 — — 成为经济主要支柱的话就会对金融稳定造成长期危害。
en: Back in 1986, Hyman Minsky warned about the longer-term dangers to financial stability if “Ponzi” borrowers – those who can service their debt only with new debt – become the main pillar of the economy.

zh: 零利率的环境当然非常适合这类借款人，因为没有什么可以证明偿债能力的指示物；借款人只需不断滚动他们的债务即可。
en: A zero-interest-rate environment is of course ideal for such borrowers, because there is nothing to provide an indication of solvency; borrowers can just roll over their debt.

zh: 但受害的是那些资产状况较好的人；一方面降低了他们的消费能力，另一方面又刺激他们去储蓄更多的钱。
en: But it is bad for those with a strong asset position; by reducing their spending power, it spurs them to save even more.

zh: 针对明斯基提出的问题 — — 支出者无力偿付而储蓄者不花钱 — — 的标准回应是，货币政策应将重点放在确保物价稳定上，而宏观审慎政策则旨在限制向高负债机构借贷来维护金融体系稳定。
en: The standard response to Minsky’s concern – that the spenders can’t afford it and the savers aren’t spending – is that monetary policy should focus on ensuring price stability, while macroprudential policy aims to safeguard financial stability by limiting borrowing by highly indebted agents.

zh: 但这种方法是行不通的。
en: But this approach does not work.

zh: 如果宏观审慎政策能有效限制向边缘借款者发放额外信贷，货币政策就将无法对需求产生影响（只要最有偿付能力的机构拒绝支出更多就行 ） 。
en: If macroprudential policy limited additional credit to marginal borrowers effectively, monetary policy would have no impact on demand (as long as the most solvent agents refuse to spend more).

zh: 这一问题在2001年经济衰退后开始在美国浮现。
en: This problem arose in the United States after the 2001 recession.

zh: 虽然美联储宣布较长时间维持低利率，但企业部门并未增加投资。
en: Although the Federal Reserve kept interest rates low for a protracted period, the corporate sector did not increase its investment.

zh: 复苏最终是由所谓“次级贷”贷款所推动：也就是向信用评级较低的借款人发放住宅贷款。
en: The recovery was ultimately fueled by so-called “subprime” mortgages: home-purchase loans extended to borrowers with lower credit ratings.

zh: 其结果，如我们所见，正是这一巨型泡沫引发了2008年的金融危机。
en: The result, as we know, was a mega-bubble that triggered the 2008 financial crisis.

zh: 在欧元区，风险因其主要的宏观审慎工​​具 — — 稳定与增长公约 — — 在限制各国支出上的无能而加剧，因为更低的利率给了债务国增加支出的空间。
en: In the eurozone’s case, the risk is compounded by the ineffectiveness of its key macroprudential instrument, the Stability and Growth Pact, in limiting countries’ spending, as lower interest rates give debtor countries leeway to spend more.

zh: 即便意大利和西班牙两国及其欧元区伙伴国都承诺要降低负债率，但其公共债务占GDP的比重却一路上升。
en: Public debt as a share of GDP is on the rise in Italy and Spain, even though both countries, with their eurozone partners, have committed to reducing the debt ratio.

zh: 事实上，即使没有更低的利率，该条约规定的赤字限制也已被证明是不具约束力的，法国自2009年以来对此限制的无视就是明证。
en: In fact, even without lower interest rates, the deficit limits that the Pact imposes have proved to be non-binding, exemplified by France’s flouting of them since 2009.

zh: 简而言之，货币政策延续了欧元区债权国和债务国经济体之间的不平衡，而宏观审慎政策也对此束手无策。
en: In short, monetary policy is perpetuating the disequilibrium between creditor and debtor economies in the eurozone, and macroprudential policy is doing nothing to stop it.

zh: 一旦利率恢复正常化就可能产生严重的金融动荡。
en: When interest rates normalize, this could generate serious financial instability.

zh: 但 — — 这是难题所在 — — 欧洲央行缺乏足够的选项去刺激欧元区偿付能力较强机构的需求，也因此难以支撑经济的可持续复苏。
en: But – and this is the conundrum – the ECB has few options for stimulating demand among the eurozone’s more solvent agents, and thus supporting a sustainable recovery.

zh: 在决定下一步行动前 — — 是否发起更多的债券购买计划，进一步降低利率，或者双管齐下 — — 欧洲央行必须认识到，任何对需求的积极影响都可能仅限于欧元区较弱的经济体 — — 也就是至少有能力偿付的经济体。
en: In deciding its next move – whether to initiate more bond purchases, lower interest rates even further, or do both – the ECB must recognize that any positive impact on demand probably will be limited to the eurozone’s weaker economies – that is, the economies that can least afford it.

zh: 这是一个高风险的举动，可能会与使价格向着欧洲央行的目标增加几十个基点的努力背道而驰。
en: This is a high-risk move, one that is probably not justified by the effort to bring price increases a few dozen basis points closer to the ECB’s target.

zh: 欧元区已经出现了复苏的苗头，也应该让复苏在自己的轨道上运行。
en: A recovery has already begun in the eurozone. It should be left to run its course.

zh: 一个更具扩张性的货币政策立场或许能大幅强化这场复苏，但对此付出的成本，则是加剧了欧元区本已危险的失衡状况。
en: An even more expansionary monetary-policy stance might strengthen the recovery marginally, but at the cost of increasing the eurozone’s already-dangerous imbalances.

zh: 欧洲的空想资本市场联盟
en: Europe’s Chimerical Capital-Markets Union

zh: 伦敦—欧元区的生存再次面临威胁，希腊要求债务豁免并停止紧缩，否则 … … 。
en: LONDON – The eurozone's survival is in doubt again, as Greece demands debt forgiveness and an end to austerity – or else.

zh: 但是，尽管欧洲货币联盟告急，银行联盟也仍处于初级阶段，但创造力无穷的欧盟委员会正在进行另一场冒险，所谓的“资本市场联盟 ” 。
en: But, though Europe's currency union is at risk, and its banking union remains at an early stage of development, the endlessly creative European Commission is embarking on another adventure: a so-called “capital-markets union."

zh: “所谓”这个定于名副其实，因为这个工程在现阶段定义含糊，其意图绝不可能是打造单一的欧洲资本市场。
en: That “so-called" is appropriate, because the project, despite being only vaguely defined at this point, is most certainly not intended to create a single European capital market.

zh: 事实上，如今欧盟领导人还不至于蠢到宣布如此野心 — — 这需要新条约额，而没人准备打开这个魔盒。
en: Indeed, European Union leaders know better than to announce such an ambition, which would require a new treaty – no one is prepared to open up that can of worms.

zh: 毕竟，欧洲选民无意给予布鲁塞尔更多的权力。
en: After all, European voters are in no mood to transfer more powers to Brussels.

zh: 资本市场联盟起初其实是一个口号，由欧盟委员会主席容克的一位助手提出。
en: The capital-markets union actually began as a slogan, coined by one of EU Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker's acolytes.

zh: 如今，新任金融市场委员、英国的希尔勋爵（Lord Jonathan Hill）不可避免地承担了给出这一计划细节的任务。
en: Now, the new financial markets commissioner, the United Kingdom's Lord Jonathan Hill, has been assigned the unenviable task of putting flesh on bare bones.

zh: 欧盟委员会关于该问题的“绿皮书”咨询轮所提出的问题多于找到的答案。
en: The Commission's “Green Paper" consultation round on the subject produced more questions than answers.

zh: 智库、游说集团和国家监管者立刻行动起来试图影响希尔，阻止任何可能伤害它们利益的计划。
en: Think tanks, lobby groups, and national regulators have wasted no time in trying to influence Hill's efforts, and to head off any initiatives that might damage their interests.

zh: 英格兰银行指出，绝不应该能像银行联盟那样授予欧洲央行新的权力而削弱国家央行。
en: The Bank of England has argued that there should be no replication of the banking union grant of new powers to the European Central Bank at the expense of national central banks.

zh: 英格兰银行说，资本市场联盟“不需要机构变革 ， ” 因此没有必要成立超级监管者。
en: The capital-markets union, the BOE argues, “does not require institutional change," so no super-regulator should be created.

zh: 现在，欧盟委员会接受了这一论断，尽管希尔的一位助手表示“总有一天 … … 监督问题会浮出水面。
en: The Commission has accepted that conclusion for now, though one of Hill's aides has suggested that, “at some point…supervisory issues will pop up."

zh: ”事实上，建立欧洲版本的美国证券和交易委员会一直是布鲁塞尔欧洲共同市场行政体系的长期目标 — — 这一目标也许会实现，但不可能是现在。
en: In fact, establishing a European version of the US Securities and Exchange Commission is a longstanding aim of the Brussels Eurocracy – one that may be achieved one day, but not just yet.

zh: 但在深入研究机构问题 — — 欧盟老手们最喜欢的话题 — — 之前，我们应该想想资本市场联盟是为了解决什么问题。
en: But before delving into institutional issues – a favorite topic of EU veterans – one should consider what problem the capital-markets union is supposed to solve.

zh: 在这方面，我们已经有了相当大的一致。
en: And here, there is considerable agreement.

zh: 大部分监管者和市场参与者都同意，欧洲金融市场功能不全。
en: Most regulators and market participants agree that Europe's financial markets are dysfunctional.

zh: 银行资产接近欧盟GDP的300 % ， 而美国只有70 % ， 大量储蓄资金没有派上用场。
en: With banking assets amounting to roughly 300% of EU-wide GDP, compared to some 70% in the United States, large pools of savings are being left unused.

zh: 此外，欧洲公司融资有80%多来自银行，只有不到20%来自资本市场（美国的比例与此相反 ） 。
en: Moreover, European companies receive an excessive 80% of their finance from banks and less than 20% from capital markets (the proportions are roughly reversed in the US).

zh: 最近的金融危机爆发以来，修正这一失衡的必要性日益凸显，银行重建资本基础（以及满足更严格的监管要求）导致了信用配给现象。
en: The need to redress that imbalance has become increasingly evident since the recent financial crisis, as banks' efforts to rebuild their capital bases (and meet stricter regulatory requirements) has led to credit rationing.

zh: 放松这一产出增长约束能够改善欧洲经济的恢复力、鼓励风险承担、增加活力。
en: Loosening that constraint on output growth would improve the European economy's resilience, encourage risk-taking, and promote dynamism.

zh: 因此，资本市场联盟的总体目标相对而言相当直观。
en: The overall aim of the capital-markets union is thus relatively straightforward.

zh: 但实现目标则并非如此 — — 在很大程度上是因为欧洲对银行融资的严重依赖来源于结构和文化因素。
en: But achieving it is not – in no small part because Europe's heavy reliance on bank finance stems from structural and cultural factors.

zh: 欧盟委员会目前所提出的解决之道 — — 比如鼓励众筹和证券化条件标准化 — — 似乎无助于刺激非银行融资的快速增长。
en: And the remedies that the Commission has suggested so far – for example, encouraging crowdfunding and standardizing the terms of securitization – appear unlikely to promote rapid growth in non-bank finance.

zh: 促进泛欧洲私人配置市场也许有所助益，理顺担保债券标准亦然。
en: Promoting a pan-European private placement market might help, as would aligning standards for covered bonds.

zh: 但这两大战略都面临严重的法律障碍。
en: But both strategies would face serious legal obstacles.

zh: 事实上，尽管希尔的初始日程相当温和，绝不会造成任何伤害（并且应该尽快实施 ） ， 但任何此后的重大措施将面临严重挑战。
en: Indeed, though Hill's modest initial agenda certainly would do no harm (and should be pursued as quickly as possible), any substantial measures beyond it would confront major roadblocks.

zh: 比如，协调整个欧洲大陆的清算机制并降低有利于债务而不利于股权的税收融资尽管十分符合逻辑，但也影响到成员国剩余主权的核心，因此极难推行。
en: For example, harmonizing insolvency regimes across the continent and reducing tax incentives that favor debt over equity, while entirely logical, strike at the heart of member states' remaining sovereignty, and thus will be extremely difficult to push forward.

zh: 希尔提出的其他一些想法，比如放松长期投资的资本要求，与将在明年实施的欧盟保险商和养老基金偿债能力要求相违背。
en: Some of the other ideas that Hill has floated, such as relaxing the capital standards for long-term investments, run counter to the EU solvency standards for insurers and pension funds that will be implemented next year.

zh: 一些老生常谈已被剔除出下一轮讨论之外。
en: Some old nags have also been dragged out of the stables for another run around the course.

zh: “改进”招股书以及豁免小公司的某些会计标准等手段此前已在个别国家做了尝试，并以失败告终。
en: “Streamlined" prospectuses and exemptions from some accounting standards for small companies have been tried before in individual countries – and have failed.

zh: 放松的发行人标准会削弱投资者保护，并且有迹象表明对新股发行监管的放松会降低投资者对新股需求，增加融资成本。
en: Looser standards for issuers weaken protection for investors, and there is evidence that lax regulation of new issues may reduce investor demand for them, raising the cost of finance.

zh: 除非欧洲的政治情绪发生快速变化 — — 不太可能 — — 否则期望资本市场联盟拥有可与银行联盟相比的转化力是不现实的。
en: Unless the political mood changes radically in Europe – an unlikely development – it would be unrealistic to expect the capital-markets union to be anywhere near as transformational as the banking union has been.

zh: 它充其量只是一次微小的扰动，几乎不会牺牲神圣不可侵犯的国家主权。
en: It will be, at best, a small disturbance, in which few national sacred cows are slaughtered.

zh: 起先作为口号的东西可能最终会有所助益。
en: What began as a slogan may turn out to be helpful.

zh: 但资本市场联盟绝不可能结束欧洲与银行的紧密关系。
en: But a capital-markets union is highly unlikely to end Europe's love affair with its banks.

zh: 对市场结构最大的影响将继续来自不断提高的资本要求，而这将让银行信用更加昂贵，促使借款人将目光投向别处。
en: The biggest impact on market structure will continue to come from ever-rising capital requirements, which will make bank credit more expensive and encourage borrowers to look elsewhere.

zh: 欧洲的午夜之犬
en: Europe’s Dog in the Nighttime

zh: 布鲁塞尔—以让-克劳德·容克为首的新欧盟委员会开局不利。
en: BRUSSELS – The new European Commission headed by Jean-Claude Juncker is off to a rocky start.

zh: 但从新闻中你看不到这一点。
en: But one would not know it from reading the news headlines.

zh: 福尔摩斯知道，不在午夜乱吠的狗往往不会引起注意。
en: As Sherlock Holmes understood, a dog that does not bark in the nighttime usually goes unnoticed.

zh: 在欧洲，欧盟的财政规则是问题所在，而欧盟委员会 — — 原则上它是欧盟的看门狗 — — 应该在问题没有得到重视时大声吠叫。
en: In Europe’s case, the European Union’s fiscal rules are at issue, and the Commission – in principle the EU’s watchdog – should bark loudly when they are flouted.

zh: 上个月，在两个欧盟大国意大利和法国上交其2015年预算计划，其政府违背继续紧缩的承诺已成定局后，谴责之声不可避免。
en: Last month, howls seemed inevitable after two large EU countries, Italy and France, submitted budget plans for 2015 that clearly violated their governments’ vows of continued austerity.

zh: 首先，欧盟委员会忠实地拒绝了两国预算计划，因为其不符合欧盟稳定与增长公约（Stability and Growth Pact，SGP）规则。
en: At first, the Commission dutifully rejected the two budgets as incompatible with the rules of the EU’s Stability and Growth Pact (SGP).

zh: 但接着发生了福尔摩斯故事中的“有趣”的事情。
en: But then something happened that was as “curious” as in Arthur Conan Doyle’s story.

zh: 几天后，两国对预算做了相当于GDP的0.2%的微调，并由财政部长致书欧盟委员会表示预算现在应予通过。
en: Within days, both countries offered mini-adjustments to their budgets, worth about 0.2% of GDP, and their finance ministers wrote to the Commission that their budgets should now be approved.

zh: 委员会没有对此做出反应，这使得法国和意大利领导人声称，是他们而不是布鲁塞尔官僚拥有最终决定权。
en: The Commission did not react, leaving French and Italian leaders to claim that they, not Brussels bureaucrats, had the last word.

zh: 事实上，最新预测表明法国和意大利今年的表现要比最初承诺的还要糟糕，法国赤字预计将在2015年略有增加，意大利的经周期调整的赤字还将进一步恶化。
en: In fact, the latest forecast reflects an even worse outcome for France and Italy this year than originally promised, with France’s deficit set to increase slightly for 2015 and Italy’s cyclically adjusted deficit expected to deteriorate.

zh: 增长和稳定公约规定每年的改善幅度至少要达到GDP的0.5 % 。
en: The Stability and Growth Pact prescribes an annual improvement of at least 0.5 % of GDP.

zh: 因此，新欧盟委员会有可能从上任的第一天就失去其权威性。
en: The new Commission thus risks losing its authority from the very start of its mandate.

zh: 是否会如此是一个关键问题，因为维持高信誉对于欧元区经济决策而言至关重要。
en: Whether it does is a crucial question, because maintaining a high degree of credibility is essential to economic policymaking in the eurozone.

zh: 要想明白原因，不妨回忆一下，SGP的最初规则被一位前主席（罗曼诺·普罗迪（Romano Prodi ） ） 称为“愚蠢 ” ， 因为一根筋地追求赤字低于GDP的3%可能在衰退时期并不合适。
en: To see why, it is worth recalling that the SGP’s original rules were judged “stupid” by one former Commission president (Romano Prodi), because the single-minded pursuit of a deficit below 3 % of GDP could be inappropriate during recessions.

zh: 这一批评被接受，SGP大概也因为（比如）允许预算赤字根据经济周期调整、添加支出的中期目标以及引入豁免条款而被认为变得更“聪明”了。
en: That argument was accepted, and the SGP was supposedly rendered more “intelligent” by, for example, permitting budget deficits to be adjusted for the economic cycle, adding medium-term objectives for expenditure, and introducing escape clauses.

zh: 但显然，新规则需要强大、决定可以被所有人接受的机构来解释。
en: But the new rules obviously require a strong institution to interpret them, and whose judgment is accepted by everybody.

zh: 检查预算是否低于SGP的上限 — — GDP的3%也许是个简单的任务，但对于商业周期调整应该算作GDP的0.5%还是0.8%的问题，或者一国是否遵循其中期支出目标的问题，仍会引起合理的分歧。
en: Though checking whether a budget is below the SGP’s ceiling of 3% of GDP may be a straightforward matter, there can be reasonable disagreement about whether the business-cycle adjustment should be estimated at 0.5% or 0.8% of GDP, or whether a country is adhering to its medium-term expenditure objective.

zh: 欧盟委员会应该拥有最后决定权，从而保证规则的信誉和持续性 — — 而它似乎在第一回合就败下阵来。
en: The Commission is supposed to have the last word, thereby ensuring the rules’ credibility and consistency – and it seems to have lost this fight in the first round.

zh: 当然，你可能会说，SGP应该废弃，因为紧缩在欧元区面临通缩风险时毫无意义。
en: One could, of course, argue that the SGP should be scrapped, because austerity makes no sense when the eurozone faces the risk of deflation.

zh: 但这应该由欧盟委员会而不是财政一片狼藉的成员国来决定。
en: But the Commission, not fiscally louche member countries, should be the one to decide that.

zh: 欧洲的另一个问题是狗没有原因而吠。
en: The other problem for Europe is a dog that does bark, but for no reason.

zh: 英国就是如此，它被要求支付约20亿欧元（大约相当于英国自身预算的四舍五入规模）的欧盟预算追加金。
en: This is the case of the United Kingdom, which has been asked to pay an additional contribution to the EU budget of about €2 billion ($2.5 billion, which amounts to a rounding error of the UK’s own budget).

zh: 这笔追加金的原因是，几周前英国国家统计局自豪地宣布，英国国民总收入（GNI）比此前估计的高出很多，不但2013年是如此，此前多年都是如此。
en: The reason for this additional levy is that a few weeks ago the UK’s Office for National Statistics announced, proudly, that it had discovered that the country’s gross national income (GNI) had been much higher than previously assumed, not only in 2013, but also in all previous years.

zh: 在包括了2002—2012年的修正额后，这一差额大概在3,500亿英镑。
en: Including the revisions for the 2002-2012 period, the difference comes to about £350 billion ($560 billion).

zh: 由于每个欧盟成员国都有义务贡献其1%的GNI作为欧盟预算，因此英国的数据修正导致它需要多缴纳数十亿欧元。
en: Because every EU member state is obliged to contribute about 1% of its GNI to the Union’s budget, the UK’s data revision had to lead to a back payment of billions of euros.

zh: 但英国首相卡梅伦政府宣布不会支付“不在欧盟委员会意料之中，也不在其需要之中”的钱。
en: But British Prime Minister David Cameron’s government has declared that it does not intend to pay money that “the European Commission was not expecting and does not need.”

zh: 这两个例子 — — 该吠的狗不吠，吠的狗不该吠 — — 威胁到了欧盟的基本运转，后者的基础是有一套明确的规则并由强大的欧盟委员会得力执行。
en: These two cases – the dog that should have barked but did not, and the dog that barked for no reason – threaten the EU’s fundamental workings, which are based on a clear rulebook enforced vigorously by a strong Commission.

zh: 如果规则可以更改甚至打破以迁就大成员国的国内政治需要，容克的委员会有可能从一开始就失去权威。
en: Juncker’s Commission risks losing its authority from the start if the rules can be bent or broken to accommodate the larger member states’ domestic political priorities.

zh: 欧盟委员会必须夺回政治和思想领导地位并作出选择：要么阐明为何SGP即使在面临通缩的现在也必须遵守，要么与认为当前环境需要财政刺激的国家形成一致。
en: The Commission must regain political and intellectual leadership and make its choice: either explain why the SGP rules must be followed even now, in the face of deflation, or agree with those who argue that the current environment calls for a fiscal stimulus.

zh: 欧盟委员会无法通过公开坚持紧缩规则而又默许成员国打破这一规则避免站队。
en: It cannot avoid taking sides by insisting publicly on austerity rules but then acquiescing when member states break them.

zh: 成员国领导人也必须做好三分三。
en: Leaders in member states have to play their part as well.

zh: 迎合民粹主义也许具有短期选举利益的吸引力，但需要付出信誉的长期代价，这一带价不管是对他们本身还是对欧盟都是十分高昂的。
en: Pandering to populists may be attractive in terms of short-term electoral gains, but the long-term cost in terms of credibility, both their own and that of the EU, will be very high.

zh: 即将到来的大西洋世纪
en: The Coming Atlantic Century

zh: 普林斯顿—美国正在崛起；欧洲正在稳定；两边日益密切。
en: PRINCETON – The United States is rising; Europe is stabilizing; and both are moving closer together.

zh: 这是本月举行的一年一度的慕尼黑安全会议（MSC）放出的主要信息。 MSC是各国国防部长、外交部长、高级军官、议员、记者和各领域国家安全顾问参与的高规格会议。
en: That was the principal message earlier this month at the annual Munich Security Conference (MSC), a high-powered gathering of defense ministers, foreign ministers, senior military officials, parliamentarians, journalists, and national-security experts of every variety.

zh: 与会者主要来自欧洲和美国；事实上，这一始于1963年的会议一开始完全是北约成员国的内部会议。
en: The participants come primarily from Europe and the US; indeed, when the conference began in 1963, it was focused entirely on NATO members.

zh: 不过，今年巴西、中国、印度、尼日利亚、新加坡、卡塔尔和沙特的高级政府官员也参与其中，这是一个重要的时代信号。
en: This year, however, senior government officials from Brazil, China, India, Nigeria, Singapore, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia also joined, an important sign of the times.

zh: 美国参议员、2008年总统候选人麦凯恩（John McCain）一直是慕尼黑会议国会代表团领袖。
en: John McCain, the US senator and 2008 presidential candidate, always leads a large congressional delegation to Munich.

zh: 通常美国政府还会派出国防部长或国务卿前去发表礼节式演讲，对欧洲人强调跨大西洋同盟的重要性。
en: The US administration also typically sends the Secretary of Defense or the Secretary of State to deliver a ritual speech reassuring the Europeans of the strength of the transatlantic alliance.

zh: 今年，副总统拜登亲自出马，使美国的阵容又升了一格。
en: This year, Vice President Joe Biden did the honors, bumping the US representation up a notch.

zh: 此次MSC的另一特征是出现了一个非常规问题专家讨论会。 这一问题便是“美国石油和天然气好运：变化中的能源地缘政治 ” 。
en: The conference also featured a panel on an unusual subject – “The American Oil and Gas Bonanza: The Changing Geopolitics of Energy.”

zh: 美国国籍能源事务特使兼协调员帕斯奎尔（Carlos Pascual）描述了“美国内部的能源革命 ” ： 天然气产量增加25 % （ 这将拉低美国气价 ） ， 石油产量足以将进口量-消费量比从60%降至40 % ， 此外还将有10%的预计增量。
en: US Special Envoy and Coordinator for International Energy Affairs Carlos Pascual described “the US internal energy revolution”: a 25% increase in natural-gas production, which should push down US gas prices, and enough oil output to reduce oil imports from 60% to 40% of consumption, with an additional 10% increase projected.

zh: 帕斯奎尔预测，到2030年，美国的所有能源需求都将在美洲内部解决。
en: Pascual projected that the US will be able to import all of its energy needs from within the Americas by 2030.

zh: 德国情报局（German Intelligence Agency）的一份最新机密研究认为，事实上，到2020年，美国便可能成为石油和天然气出口国，而目前它仍是世界第一大能源进口国。
en: A recent confidential study by the German Intelligence Agency raises the possibility that the US could actually become an oil and gas exporter by 2020, in contrast to its present position as the world’s largest energy importer.

zh: 第一进口国的头衔可能会落到中国头上，后者将日益依赖中东。
en: That honor would likely fall to China, which would become increasingly dependent on the Middle East.

zh: 这还有一个额外的好处：美国天然气使用比重的增加将让美国碳排放量降至1992年水平。
en: As an extra bonus, the higher US proportion of gas use has reduced US carbon emissions to 1992 levels.

zh: 专家组大谈美国制造业能源价格的下降如何会对美国经济的竞争力产生全面的积极影响，对美国前景如此看好，这在近来实属罕见。
en: The sense of US good fortune, a phrase that is not often heard around the world these days, increased with the panelists’ description of how lower energy prices for US manufacturing has a broad positive impact on the American economy’s competitiveness.

zh: 于是，美国的能源储备也变成了一块投资磁石。
en: As a result, the country’s energy reserves have also become an investment magnet.

zh: 德国经济和技术部长罗斯勒说，许多德国公司已经转向美国，原因就是能源价格的下降。
en: German Minister of Economics and Technology Philipp Rösler said that many German firms are already relocating to the US because of lower energy prices.

zh: 同样重要的是，专家组还报告说，液化天然气将相对管道天然气变得更加重要，这将带来巨大的地缘政治效应。
en: Equally important, the panelists reported on the rising importance of liquid natural gas relative to pipeline gas, which has enormous geopolitical implications.

zh: 简单讲，如果天然气以液态方式出口，则将成为可替代的。
en: In a nutshell, if gas is exported in liquid form, it is fungible.

zh: 换句话说，如果俄罗斯出于政治原因限制流向乌克兰的天然气量，但欧洲其他国家可以从别处获得天然气，那么它们就可以把自己的天然气通过波罗的海出口给乌克兰。
en: In other words, if Russia restricts the flow of gas to Ukraine for political reasons, but the rest of Europe has gas from other sources, they can simply resell their gas to Ukraine and export it via the Baltic Sea.

zh: 皇家壳牌公司主席奥利拉（Jorma Ollila）描述了页岩油气的全球储量分布图。
en: Jorma Ollila, Chairman of Royal Dutch Shell, described the global map of major shale oil and gas deposits.

zh: 乌克兰本身拥有欧洲第三大储量；其他拥有庞大储量的国家包括波兰、法国、中国、印尼、澳大利亚、南非、阿根廷和墨西哥。
en: Ukraine itself has the third-largest reserves in Europe; other countries with large deposits include Poland, France, China, Indonesia, Australia, South Africa, Argentina, and Mexico.

zh: 而美国已经超过俄罗斯，成为世界第一大天然气生产国。
en: And the US has already taken over from Russia as the world’s largest gas producer.

zh: 所有这些数据引起了巴西外交部长帕特利奥塔（Antonio de Aguiar Patriota）的注意。
en: All of this data got Brazilian Foreign Minister Antonio de Aguiar Patriota’s attention.

zh: 在“崛起势力和全球治理”专家讨论组中，帕特利奥塔提到了这场能源讨论，并评论说崛起势力应该记住 ， “ 老牌势力并不是衰落势力 ” 。
en: On a panel entitled “The Rising Powers and Global Governance,” Patriota referred to the energy discussion and noted that the rising powers should remember that “the established powers are not sinking powers.”

zh: 简言之，西方崛起的流行观念一夜之间自我反转了。
en: In short, the pervasive narrative of Western decline suddenly reversed itself.

zh: 欧洲一侧的前景似乎也更加光明了。
en: The horizon seemed brighter on the European side as well.

zh: 在开场专家讨论组“欧元危机和欧盟未来”中，谨慎乐观随处可见。
en: In the opening panel on “The Euro Crisis and the Future of the EU,” cautious optimism prevailed.

zh: 没有人认为欧元的麻烦已经得到了解决，但也没有人认为欧元区正在分裂。
en: No one thought that the European Union’s troubles were resolved, but no one thought that the eurozone was coming apart, either.

zh: 相反，德国财政部长朔伊布勒（Wolfgang Schäuble）明确表示，德国帮助欧元区走出困境的决心是坚定地。
en: On the contrary, German Finance Minister Wolfgang Schäuble made clear that German resolve to see the eurozone through its troubles was firm.

zh: 听众席上的一位经常预测欧元区解体的著名经济学家也很快更改了口风。
en: And a prominent economist in the audience who has often predicted the eurozone’s demise was backtracking rapidly.

zh: 除了美国崛起（尽管财政乱象未除）和欧洲稳定（尽管共同货币危机尚在 ） ， 此次MSC的另一特色是拜登的演讲。 拜登所说的内容远远超过了美国决策者向欧洲各国做口头承诺的程度。
en: Aside from reports of a rising US (fiscal woes notwithstanding) and a stabilizing Europe (despite the common currency’s troubles), the conference featured a speech by Biden that went far beyond the reassuring rhetoric that US policymakers typically offer in European capitals.

zh: 拜登告诉听众，他和美国总统奥巴马认为“欧洲是我们参与世界其他事物的基石 ” ， 也是“我们全球合作的催化剂 ” 。
en: Biden told the audience that he and US President Barack Obama believe that “Europe is the cornerstone of our engagement with the rest of the world” and “the catalyst for our global cooperation.”

zh: 拜登指出 ， “ 欧洲是美国最大的经济伙伴 ” ， 他提及专注于亚洲的奥巴马政府经常忘记的数字 ： “ 年贸易额6000亿美元，创造并维持了欧洲大陆和美国数百万个工作岗位；商业关系的总价值更是高达5万亿美元。
en: Biden pointed out that “Europe is America’s largest economic partner,” recalling figures that the Asia-focused Obama administration has often seemed to forget: “over $600 billion in annual trade that creates and sustains millions of jobs on the continent and at home, and a $5 trillion overall commercial relationship.”

zh: ”拜登继续指出，一周后，在国情咨文中，奥巴马将宣布开始“全面的跨大西洋贸易和投资协定”的谈判。
en: Biden went on to suggest a “comprehensive transatlantic trade and investment agreement”; a week later, in his State of the Union Address, Obama announced the launch of negotiations for precisely such an agreement.

zh: 拜登的结论非常吸引眼球。
en: Biden concluded with a flourish.

zh: “欧洲仍是美国不可分割的第一伙伴 ， ” 他说 ， “ 如果你们不介意我有些专横的话，我相信我们也仍是你们不可分割的伙伴。
en: “Europe remains America’s indispensable partner of first resort,” he declared. “And, if you forgive some presumptuousness, I believe we remain your indispensable partner.”

zh: ”如此强音反映了华盛顿的新态度。
en: Those strong words reflect a new sensibility in Washington.

zh: 正如前国务卿希拉里·克林顿在其最后一系列外交政策演讲之一中所指出的，美国并未准备把重点从欧洲移向亚洲，而是联合欧洲面向亚洲。
en: As former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton declared in one of her last foreign-policy speeches, the US is not planning to pivot away from Europe to Asia, but rather with Europe to Asia.

zh: 西方前景正在转好，虽慢但是事实。
en: Western fortunes are rising, slowly but surely.

zh: 欧洲和美国合起来占据世界GDP的一大半，拥有令其他势力望尘莫及的世界上最庞大的军队，还控制着不断上升的全球能源储备比重。
en: Together, Europe and the US account for more than 50% of global GDP, have the largest military force in the world by many multiples, and control a growing proportion of global energy reserves.

zh: 它们还拥有可怕的外交和发展援助能力，代表着在权利、命运和全人类潜力方面存在共同目标的和平民主国家。
en: They also have a formidable diplomatic and development-assistance capacity, representing a peaceful community of democracies that share a common commitment to the rights, dignity, and potential of all human beings.

zh: 想象一下这一和平民主国家集团在拉丁美洲东海岸和非洲西海岸的扩张。
en: Imagine that community spreading down the east coast of Latin America and the west coast of Africa.

zh: 说到底，这将是一个大西洋世纪。
en: It might be an Atlantic century after all.

zh: 欧洲和亚洲的军备竞赛
en: Europe and Asia’s Arms Race

zh: 当欧洲统一开始实现时，人们认为“异常紧密的联盟”能够建立一个使欧洲人免受政治讹诈的共同体。
en: When European unification was launched, it was thought that “ever closer union” would establish a community that would protect Europeans from political blackmail.

zh: 现在我们发现—虽然由于美国的压力和中国的激进，欧盟解除武器禁运的时间可能会推迟—当法国和中国制定联合行动计划时，欧盟就沦落为腐败的工具而已。
en: Now we see – though the lifting of the Union’s arms embargo may now be delayed thanks to US pressure and Chinese aggressiveness – that the European Union has become merely a tool for corruption when France and China draw up joint action plans.

zh: 这一战略是简单而无情的。
en: The strategy is simple and ruthless.

zh: 世界上最大的独裁国家正准备击溃并占领历史上的第一个华人民主国家—台湾。
en: The world’s largest dictatorship is preparing to crush and occupy the first Chinese democracy in history – Taiwan.

zh: 为了实施这一战略，中华人民共和国需要比其现有的更为尖端的武器。
en: In order to do so, the People’s Republic needs much more sophisticated arms than those it possesses today.

zh: 美国自然不会将这样的武器出口到中国。
en: The United States naturally does not export such arms to China.

zh: 相反，美国正尽力阻止中国的统治者向台湾的民主人士发动这样的军事进攻。
en: Instead, the US is trying to deter China’s rulers from launching a military attack on the democrats in Taiwan.

zh: 但如果欧盟一旦开始向中国全面出口强大的进攻性武器系统，人民解放军就会具备击败台湾防御力量的能力。
en: But if the EU ever begins to offer China extensive exports of powerful and offensive weapons systems, the military power of the People’s Liberation Army would be able to defeat Taiwan’s defense forces.

zh: 大陆已经部署了超过600枚的导弹，瞄准着该岛的城市和军事基地。
en: Over 600 missiles, already deployed on the mainland, are aimed at cities and military bases on the island.

zh: 这种威胁暂时还有些虚张声势。
en: The threat is more apparent than real – for now.

zh: 俄罗斯目前向中国销售某些武器，但却避免向其出口最尖端的系统。 因为克里姆林宫将中国看作未来潜在的威胁。
en: Russia currently sells certain arms to China, but avoids exporting its most sophisticated systems, since the Kremlin views China as a potential future threat.

zh: 但如果欧盟国家开始竞争中国的市场份额，那么俄罗斯可能很快就会不敌诱惑而向北京的共产党政权出售他们最好的武器。
en: However, if EU countries start competing for a share of the Chinese market, the Russians could soon be tempted to sell their best arms to the communist regime in Beijing.

zh: 中国的新军备加上北朝鲜危机可能会迫使该地区的一些国家重新武装其军队。
en: China’s new armaments, together with the North Korean crisis, will probably force half a dozen countries in the region to renew their armed forces.

zh: 因此，欧盟在任何时候决定解除对中国的武器禁运都可能为东亚的军备竞赛火上浇油。
en: Thus, by whenever the Union should decide to lift its ban on weapons exports to China, the EU could help fuel an arms race in East Asia.

zh: 中国和法国是如何愚弄了欧盟，使其决定要介入其中的呢？
en: How did China and France manage to fool the EU into thinking that it should ever take part in this?

zh: 当希拉克政府决定要解释与中国的经济合作时，武器成为该战略中的重要一环。
en: When Jacques Chirac’s government decided to expound its economic co-operation with China, arms became an important component in the strategy.

zh: 正如那位冷酷无情的希拉克总理在1970年代将核反应堆出售给萨达姆那样，当今的希拉克总统正被诱使着和另一个侵略性的独裁政权进行巨额交易。
en: Just as a ruthless Prime Minister Chirac sold a nuclear reactor to Saddam Hussein in the 1970’s, so the President Chirac of today is being lured into doing big business with another aggressive dictatorship.

zh: 剩下的就是一个经济讹诈的问题。
en: The rest is a question of economic blackmail.

zh: 法国的外交官们当然向中国通报了其他欧洲国家在解除武器禁运方面的尴尬。 这一禁运是在1989年天安门大屠杀以后实施的。
en: French diplomats have of course informed China about the reluctance of other European countries about lifting the arms embargo, which was imposed after the massacre in Tiananmen Square in 1989.

zh: 中国那时就威胁要撤销或停止与这些欧盟国家的贸易。
en: China then simply threatened to abandon or never to conclude trade deals with these EU members.

zh: 对德国人，中国人可能悄声提到了西门子和大众；对荷兰人，耳语中很可能有飞利浦的名字。
en: To the Germans, the Chinese probably murmur something about Siemens and Volkswagen. To the Dutch their whispers are most likely about Philips.

zh: 中国通过其法国朋友关注着欧盟内部的权力游戏，因而掌握了相关政府的软肋。
en: China follows the power game within the EU through its French friends, and therefore knows which governments need to be whipped into line.

zh: 在瑞典，可能只需轻声一句“爱立信”和“沃尔沃”就足以使Göran Persson首相明白该国与中国在商业上的利害关系。
en: In Sweden, it has probably been enough to whisper “Ericsson” and “Volvo” to make Primer Minister Göran Persson understand what is at stake for his country commercially.

zh: 的确，哪一个欧洲国家敢对数十亿欧元的中国定单等闲视之呢？
en: What European nation, indeed, dares to put at risk a Chinese order for several billion euros?

zh: 从没有一个欧盟国家将台湾作为不能恢复武器出口的理由就可见一斑了。
en: Typically enough, no EU-country has mentioned Taiwan as a reason not to resume arms exports.

zh: 欧盟代之以“行为规范 ” （ 意义不大，但却顺耳）和“自由贸易 ” （ 向独裁政权出口武器的另一个委婉说法）的字眼。
en: Instead, the EU talks of a “code of conduct” (which probably does not mean very much, but sounds nice) and “free trade” (another charming euphemism for arms exports to dictatorships.

zh: 这种沉默是个可怕的信号。
en: This silence gives a hideous signal.

zh: 因为欧盟实际上向中国表明 ： “ 台湾与我们无关。
en: For what the EU in practice says to China is this: “Taiwan’s cause in not our own.”

zh: ”如果（当）欧盟有朝一日解除武器禁运，欧洲就会拒绝为可能降临的灾难负责。
en: If and when the Union lifts the embargo, Europe will be refusing to take responsibility for the catastrophe that may be approaching.

zh: 按惯例，应该由美国出面来保护可能陷入危难的自由国家。
en: As usual, it is up to America to protect a free nation that may otherwise be destroyed.

zh: 将这样的情形与60年前的重大事件做一番比较。
en: Compare this situation to the drama 60 years ago.

zh: 那时是美国的军队和武器将西欧从纳粹的铁蹄下解放出来。
en: Then it was American troops and arms that liberated Western Europe from Nazism.

zh: 现在欧洲的武器可能落在中国人手里，并瞄准着保卫一个2300万人口的民主国家（换句话说，这相当于北欧国家的人口之和）的美国军队。
en: Now it may be European arms in the hands of the Chinese that will be aimed at American troops protecting a democracy with 23 million inhabitants (in other words, as many people as in all the Nordic countries combined).

zh: 正如一位来自加利福尼亚州的美国民主党国会议员，Tom Lantos所言，解除对中国的武器禁运的意图清楚地表明欧盟已经“丧失了它的道德指南 ” 。
en: As Tom Lantos, a Democratic US Congressman from California, put it, the move to lift the ban on arms exports to China clearly shows that the EU has “lost its moral compass.”

zh: Lantos对此深有体会：年幼的他正是在Raoul Wallenberg的援救之下才摆脱了被布达佩斯的纳粹送入奥斯威辛集中营的厄运。
en: Lantos knows about moral compasses: as a boy, he was rescued by Raoul Wallenberg from being deported to Auschwitz by the Nazis in Budapest.

zh: Wallenberg是瑞典人。
en: Wallenberg was a Swede.

zh: 但现今的瑞典也显得缺乏政治道德。
en: But now Sweden is revealing that it, too, lacks political morality.

zh: 我在议会保守党阵营的几位朋友长期以来就致力于支持自由台湾的事业。
en: Several friends of mine in the Conservative party’s parliamentary group have long been engaged in supporting a free Taiwan.

zh: 在过去十年里，我们在哥本哈根、奥斯陆和斯德哥尔摩的议会都召开过关于台湾问题的斯堪的纳维亚会议。
en: Over the past ten years, we have held Scandinavian conferences on Taiwan in the parliaments in Copenhagen, Oslo, and Stockholm.

zh: 然而，来自首相Persson的呼吁就足以使保守党领袖Fredrik Reinfeldt改变初衷。
en: But a call from Prime Minister Persson was enough to render the Conservative party leader Fredrik Reinfeldt docile.

zh: Persson发现自己在瑞典议会中缺少取消对华军售的多数票支持。
en: Persson had discovered that he lacked a majority in the Swedish parliament to lift the arms embargo on China.

zh: 而在Reinfeldt耳边轻声一句“爱立信”似乎就使Persson 达到目的。
en: By whispering “Ericsson” into Reinfeldt’s ear, it seems, Persson achieved the desired result.

zh: Reinfeldt 成为瑞典历史上第一位主张向共产党独裁政权出口武器的保守党领袖。
en: Reinfeldt became the first Conservative party leader in Swedish history to encourage arms exports to a Communist dictatorship.

zh: 然而和希拉克一样，Reinfeldt忘了些什么。
en: But Reinfeldt, like Jacques Chirac, has forgotten something.

zh: 具有自由思想的人民在下一次大选中可能不仅仅想以一位愤世嫉俗的首相来代替另一位。
en: Liberal-minded people may very well prefer not just to exchange one cynical prime minister for another at the next election.

zh: 他们还可能更需要一种明确的选择。
en: They may prefer a clear choice.

zh: 当前的欧洲防务一体化
en: European Defense Integration Now

zh: 马德里 — — 最近召开的首次没有英国参与的欧盟伯拉第斯拉瓦峰会提出了几项改善欧盟安全的提案。
en: MADRID – During the European Union’s recent Bratislava summit, the first to take place without a British presence, several proposals to improve European security were made.

zh: 尽管有人可能提出不同意见，但探讨改善欧洲安全问题依然既必要又明智：在经历了欧洲计划的瘫痪和自我怀疑期后，欧盟必须直面自身安全问题并提出统一的行动计划。
