en: Though some may argue otherwise, discussions on improved European security are both wise and necessary: after a period of paralysis and self-doubt for the European project, the EU must face its security problems and propose unifying initiatives.

zh: 欧洲民众日益将安全视为优先问题，并希望欧盟发挥进一步的领导作用。
en: Europe’s citizens increasingly regard security as a high-priority issue and want the EU to show greater leadership.

zh: 欧盟的朋友和盟国也希望欧洲安全问题得到改善。
en: The EU’s friends and allies expect improvement in European security as well.

zh: 确保欧盟民众在联盟边境内的安全首先要确保国外局势稳定。
en: Offering EU citizens security within the Union’s borders requires more stability abroad.

zh: 近来的事件清楚地表明了这一点：例如如果叙利亚局势发生变化，处理困扰欧盟的难民危机就会容易得多。
en: Recent events have shown this clearly: the refugee crisis bedeviling the EU, for example, would be much easier to manage if the situation in Syria was different.

zh: 因为国内外安全问题联系如此紧密，欧盟不应再按区域划分其政策 — — 这一理念在近期由联盟高级代表费代丽卡·莫盖里尼提出的欧盟拟议新型“全球战略”中进行了详尽的阐述。
en: Because security at home and abroad are so interrelated, the EU should not compartmentalize its policies – an idea that is well developed in the proposed new “Global Strategy” for the Union, presented recently by High Representative Federica Mogherini.

zh: 传统上，民族国家通过军事手段保护自身免受外来威胁，同时按保护公民权利的一系列标准管理其内部事务。
en: Traditionally, nation-states have defended themselves against foreign threats through military means, while running their internal affairs according to a set of norms designed to protect their citizens’ rights.

zh: 今天，军事准备在抵御外部威胁时依然十分必要，但却已经不是唯一的因素。
en: Today, military preparedness is still necessary to defend against external threats, but it is no longer sufficient.

zh: 今天处理这问题同样需要顾及“民众”的角度。
en: A “civilian” angle is needed as well.

zh: 实现安全所需的一切资产都必须适应当今威胁和冲突的现实局面。
en: All assets needed to achieve security must adapt to the reality of today’s threats and conflicts.

zh: 这意味着欧盟的军事力量不能孤立构造，而必须与民事力量（警察机构、情报部门、法院甚至非政府机构）共同发挥作用。
en: This means that the EU’s military capacities cannot be structured in isolation, but must work side by side with its civil capabilities (police agencies, intelligence units, the courts, and even non-governmental organizations).

zh: 融合军民危机响应能力必须是欧盟政策及其成员国所不可或缺的。
en: The capacity for a fused civil-military response to crisis must become integral to EU policy and that of its member states.

zh: 欧盟已经进行了军民力量相融合的部署。
en: The EU has already undertaken deployments that combine military and civilian capabilities.

zh: 但很明显需要采取进一步措施来改进上述行动的效果。
en: But it has always been clear that much more is needed to improve the efficacy of such actions.

zh: 事实上，欧盟里斯本协议包括这方面的许多措施，但多数仍处于待落实状态。
en: Indeed, the EU’s Treaty of Lisbon includes many measures along these lines, but most have not yet been implemented.

zh: 原因之一是2008年来欧盟经济问题所造成的注意力分散。
en: One reason for this is the distraction caused by the EU’s economic problems since 2008.

zh: 但当前难民问题的严重性要求人道主义和安全问题必须在泛欧洲的前景构架内构建。
en: But now the gravity of the refugee problem requires that humanitarian and security issues be framed within a pan-European outlook.

zh: 欧盟成员国国内外力量的割裂完全不可持续。
en: The division between the domestic and external capacities of EU member states simply is no longer sustainable.

zh: 幸运的是，欧盟成员国国内政策的诸多力量在防御部署中同样可以发挥效果。
en: Fortunately, many of the capacities available to member states in their internal policies are also useful for their defense deployments.

zh: 例如，加强情报合作的必要性越来越明确。
en: For example, it is increasingly clear that enhancing intelligence cooperation is essential.

zh: 欧盟扩大其安全政策覆盖范围需要更多资源；但最重要的是，需要加强合作更好地运用现有力量。
en: If the EU wants to extend the reach of its security policies, it will need more resources; but, above all, existing capacities need to be used better and more cooperatively.

zh: 但这样的合作需要改变当前临时搭设行动中心的模式，建立管辖一切欧洲安全行动的战略总部。
en: But such cooperation requires a strategic headquarters for all EU security-related operations, rather than maintaining the current model whereby operational centers are established on an ad hoc basis.

zh: 不仅如此，确保欧盟实现战略自主性需要有竞争力的欧洲国防工业，并需要各国共同确保大幅追加国防科技研发投资。
en: Moreover, in order for the EU to achieve strategic autonomy, it needs a competitive European defense industry, with investment in research and development of defense technologies rising substantially as part of a common effort.

zh: 这些要求恰恰是欧洲防务局能力发展计划设计时所考虑的。
en: The European Defense Agency’s Capabilities Development Plan was designed precisely with these requirements in mind.

zh: 推进这项计划可以优化现有成员国的资源运用 — — 从而产生有利的经济协同效应 — — 并准确找到实现我们目标所需的额外资源。
en: Advancing this plan will enable optimized use of existing member-state resources – thereby securing advantageous economic synergies – as well as precise identification of the additional resources required to achieve our goals.

zh: 结构性永久安全合作机制的法律基础已经存在，并记载在里斯本条约中。
en: The legal basis for a mechanism for permanent, structured cooperation on security already exists, enshrined in the Treaty of Lisbon.

zh: 条约规定允许具备相关意愿的欧盟成员国能够加强军事合作并快速部署完成国外的共同使命。
en: Treaty provisions enable willing EU states to reinforce their military cooperation and deploy quickly for shared missions abroad.

zh: 激活这一机制一直是与欧洲理事会近期谈判的组成部分，并且似乎是深化防务一体化最可行的方式。
en: Activating this mechanism has been part of recent discussions within the European Council and seems to be the most viable way to deepen defense integration.

zh: 同时以安全和防务为支柱的欧盟可以加重欧洲的全球砝码。
en: And an EU with security and defense as one of its pillars would boost Europe’s global weight.

zh: 仍然有人认为深化防务一体化可能削弱欧盟成员国所属的北约等其他机构。
en: Some still think that deeper defense integration may weaken other institutions, such as NATO, to which EU members belong.

zh: 但现实是欧洲在危机时采取有效集体对策的能力其实是（可以掌握更多资源的）北约和联合国所欢迎的。
en: But the truth is that Europe’s ability to provide an effective collective response in a crisis would be welcomed by NATO (which would have more resources at its disposal) and the United Nations.

zh: 此外，整合欧盟防务可以促进北约行动，从而使参与永久结构性合作的欧盟国家团体能够以单一身份参与北大西洋理事会这一北约管理机构。
en: Integrating EU defense, moreover, would facilitate NATO operations, so that groups of EU countries engaged in permanent structured cooperation could, for example, participate in the North Atlantic Council, NATO’s governing authority, as a single entity.

zh: 欧盟的定义不仅取决于如何���护自己的公民，还取决于在境外采取何种举措。
en: The EU is defined not only by how it protects its own citizens, but also by what actions it takes outside its borders.

zh: 除了确保在国际法的指导下采取行动外，欧盟应当在面对当前新的冲突时就特定国际规范的缺陷发起全球性探讨。
en: Beyond ensuring that these actions are guided by international law, the EU should foster a global debate on the deficiencies of certain international norms in the face of today’s new conflicts.

zh: 即使在这个欧洲怀疑主义甚嚣尘上的年代，欧洲民众仍然希望欧盟在外交和安全政策方面采取必要、有益且符合我们责任的更加果断的举措。
en: Even in this era of pervasive Euroskepticism, Europe’s citizens want a more decisive EU approach to foreign and security policy, which is necessary, beneficial, and part of our duty.

zh: 毕竟欧盟定义将取决于其自身的行动，而欧盟境内外的和平与安全属于其必须提供的公共产品范畴。
en: The EU, after all, will be defined by its actions, and peace and security are among the public goods that it must provide, both within and beyond its borders.

zh: 欧洲存款保险的弊端
en: The Perils of European Deposit Insurance

zh: 慕尼黑—目前正在讨论为欧元区银行建立一个联合存款保险系统。
en: MUNICH – Discussions are now underway to establish a system of joint deposit insurance for eurozone banks.

zh: 以欧盟委员会和欧洲央行为首的支持阵营指出，存款保险能预防危机时期的银行挤兑。
en: Proponents of the scheme, with the European Commission and the European Central Bank (ECB) taking the lead, point out that deposit insurance would avert the danger of a run on banks in times of crisis.

zh: 这一观点固然正确，但批评者也强调了风险不对等，因为银行资产负债表上的不良贷款大量集中在几个国家。
en: While this argument is true, critics emphasize the disparity in risks, owing to the high share of bad loans on the balance sheets of banks in some countries.

zh: 要解决这一风险不对等、推进计划，就必须在考虑下一步行动之前先清理资产负债表。
en: To address this risk disparity and move ahead with the plan, balance sheets will need to be cleaned up before considering the next step.

zh: 最新发布的国际货币基金组织（IMF）数据表明，去年4月以来欧元区稳定国家银行不良贷款率只有2 % ， 而爱尔兰有11 % ， 意大利有16 % ， 塞浦路斯有40 % ， 希腊有46 % 。
en: While the share of bad loans for banks in the stable eurozone countries is just 2%, the most recently published International Monetary Fund statistics, from last April, show a share of 11% for Ireland, 16% for Italy, 40% for Cyprus, and 46% for Greece.

zh: 但这一失衡甚至不是主要问题。
en: But this asymmetry is not even the main problem with the proposal.

zh: 最重要的是，存款保险将导致银行部分责任地承担风险。
en: First and foremost, deposit insurance would induce irresponsible risk-taking on the part of banks.

zh: 它将让欧元区僵尸银行随心所欲地获得存款，用于给全世界垃圾项目发放贷款。
en: It would enable even the eurozone’s zombie banks to obtain savings deposits at will and use them to finance trash ventures worldwide.

zh: 2013年塞浦路斯银行倒闭前，必须给予存款4%或以上的利息已补偿储户的破产担忧。
en: Prior to their collapse in 2013, banks in Cyprus had to pay interest of 4% or more on deposits to compensate for savers’ fears of insolvency.

zh: 现在，想象一下因为欧洲存款保险的存在，储户把钱存到塞浦路斯而不必担心失去它们。
en: Now just imagine savers bringing their savings to Cyprus and not having to worry about losing them, thanks to a European deposit insurance.

zh: 塞浦路斯银行只需要提供微不足道的风险溢价，就能够在欧洲任何地方筹集任何数量的客户资金，转动比过去更大的财富之轮。
en: Banks in Cyprus would be able to collect any amount of customer funds from anywhere in Europe by offering minimal risk premiums, allowing them to spin an even bigger wheel of fortune than they did in the past.

zh: 有人说，这一危险已不复存在，因为现在由欧洲央行负责监督欧洲银行。
en: Some argue that this danger no longer exists, because the ECB is now supervising European banks.

zh: 这只是一厢情愿：一旦存款保险建立起来，银行监管当局将无法阻止过度冒险。
en: That is wishful thinking: no banking regulator will be able to prevent excessive risk-taking once a deposit insurance has been established.

zh: 欧洲央行通过所谓的直接货币交易降低息差后，各国便不再遵守债务上限，银行的行为也不会有多大不同。
en: The banks won’t behave much differently from the states that failed to adhere to their debt limits after the ECB reduced interest-rate spreads by means of its program of so-called outright monetary transactions.

zh: 至少有两个最近的例子可以说明保护储户的集体机制如何导致灾难性后果，哪怕存在联合银行监管当局。
en: At least two recent examples illustrate the potentially devastating effects of collective mechanisms for protecting savers despite a joint banking regulator.

zh: 一是20世纪80年代的美国储贷银行危机。
en: One is the US savings and loan crisis of the 1980s.

zh: 在存款保险机制的保护下，美国储贷银行得以以低利率吸引到巨量客户存款，并投资于高风险（尽管看上起有利可图的）资产。
en: Protected by deposit insurance, US savings and loan institutions were able to attract, at low interest rates, huge amounts of customer deposits, which they invested in risky, though seemingly profitable, assets.

zh: 这些钱被用来购买高息垃圾债券，还有令人倒吸一口凉气的期限转换：短期储蓄转换为长期高息贷款。
en: The money was put in high-interest junk bonds, and there was a breathtaking maturity transformation: short-term maturity savings were transformed into long-term high-interest loans.

zh: 当这些赌注失败时，联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）就会介入。
en: When these bets failed, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation stepped in.

zh: 远超1,000家、也许接近于2,000家储贷银行破产 — — 约占所有储蓄银行的一半 — — 总损失高达1,500亿美元，其中FDIC需要收拾1,250亿美元。
en: Well over 1,000, and probably closer to 2,000, S&Ls went bankrupt – about half of all savings banks – at a combined cost of $150 billion, of which the FDIC had to pick up $125 billion.

zh: 1993年公布的国会调查委员会的正式报告发现，事实上正是联合存款保险机制促使银行变身为赌徒。
en: The official report of a congressional commission of inquiry, released in 1993, found that it was in fact the joint deposit insurance that had prompted the banks to take these gambles.

zh: 第二个例子是德国国有地区银行（Landesbanken ） ， 在官方担保的保护下，它们可以以低成本举债，将所获资金用于全世界的高风险投资机会。
en: The second example involves Germany’s state-owned Landesbanken (regional banks), which, protected by official guarantees, were able to take on debt cheaply and plowed the money into high-risk investment opportunities worldwide.

zh: 1997年亚洲危机爆发，1998年俄罗斯破产，德国地区银行损失了数十亿美元，最后由德国纳税人收拾烂摊子。
en: When the Asian crisis peaked in 1997 and Russia declared bankruptcy the following year, Germany’s Landesbanken lost billions, and German taxpayers ultimately picked up the tab.

zh: 国家担保撤销后，地区银行又遇到了一段好日子，它们的财富之轮再次转动起来 — — 然后又再次倒闭 — — 在这里只值得略作提及。
en: The fact that the Landesbanken later spun the wheel again – and failed again – when they were granted a grace period after the state guarantee was withdrawn, deserves only a brief mention here.

zh: 毕竟，拜国家担保所给予的储户和投资者保护所赐，地区银行在此之前便已沦为常规意义上的僵尸银行了。
en: After all, the Landesbanken had already become zombie banks before that, in the normal course of business, because of the depositor and investor protection afforded by the state’s guarantee.

zh: 所有这些都不意味着不应该实施某种形式的存款保险，而只意味着扩大的欧洲存款保险机制哪怕在银行账目上的不良贷款清理完毕后也不应该建立。
en: None of this means that there should not be some form of deposit insurance. It only means that an expansive European deposit-insurance scheme should not be established even after the bad loans now on banks’ books are cleaned up.

zh: 为什么不让银行自己形成互助组织？
en: Why not leave it up to the banks to form mutually supportive groups?

zh: 比如，在德国就有四种不同的存款保险系统。
en: In Germany, for example, there are now four different deposit insurance systems.

zh: 这能够避免过度强调风险共担、低估国家提供的方案所固有的行为风险。
en: This would avoid the over-emphasis on risk-sharing and the underestimation of behavioral risks inherent in state-provided solutions.

zh: 简单的一刀切方案 — — 如欧盟委员会和欧洲央行提出的方案 — — 无异于给目前处于焖燃状态的欧洲银行之火浇上汽油。
en: A single, one-size-fits-all solution, such as what the EU Commission and the ECB are pursuing, amounts to an attempt to fight Europe’s smoldering bank fires with gasoline.

zh: 欧洲歧视受到审判
en: European Discrimination on Trial

zh: 在整个种族面临系统性歧视的时侯，欧洲旨在确保所有公民法律平等的公约有何作用呢？
en: What good are Europe’s treaties aimed at ensuring the legal equality of all citizens when entire groups face systematic discrimination?

zh: 这就是欧洲人权法院（ECHR）本周所面临的问题。 由17人组成的大法庭开始考虑对一项最初裁决的上诉，该裁决拒绝了就捷克共和国教育部门对罗姆人所作歧视提出的指控。
en: That is the question that the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) faces this week as its Grand Chamber, consisting of 17 judges, begins considering an appeal of an initial ruling that rejected claims of discrimination against the Roma by the Czech Republic’s education authorities.

zh: 所有的欧洲国家都是欧洲理事会的成员，所有成员国都已经签署了欧洲人权公约，46个成员国中的39个已经采纳了关于保护少数民族的框架协议，14个成员国已经批准了关于禁止歧视的第12款议定书。
en: All European states are members of the Council of Europe, all have signed the European Convention on Human Rights, 39 of the 46 member states have adopted the Framework Convention for the Protection of National Minorities, and 14 have ratified Protocol 12 on the prohibition against discrimination.

zh: 然而，许多罗姆人的生存状况仍然是令人震惊的。
en: Nevertheless, the living conditions of many Roma remain appalling.

zh: 近期由欧盟种族主义及仇外主义少监控中心以及欧洲人权委员理事会在2006年发布的报告显示了一些改进，但这些报告表明罗姆人的生存状况就算不恶化也停滞不前。
en: Although recent reports published in 2006 by the European Union’s Monitoring Center on Racism and Xenophobia and the Council of Europe’s Human Rights Commissioner note some improvements, they indicate Roma living conditions have stagnated, if not deteriorated.

zh: 虽然在欧洲理事会的敦促及支持下当地作出了很大工作，罗姆人仍是住房、就业、保健和教育歧视领域的受害者。
en: Roma are still victims of discrimination in access to housing, employment, healthcare, and education, despite significant local efforts at the Council of Europe’s instigation and with its support.

zh: 对获得教育的歧视是特别重要的，因为教育对受害者的生活前景具有深刻影响。
en: Discrimination in educational access is particularly important, given its profound effect on its victims’ life prospects.

zh: 在大多数极端案例中，教育系统本身就实行了种族隔离政策，也就是说，偏僻地区孤立的学校、主流学校罗姆孩子特殊班级以及为具有学习困难孩子所设的班级中罗姆儿童过多。
en: In the most extreme cases, the education system itself is segregated: isolated schools in remote camps; special classes for Roma children in mainstream schools; and an over-representation of Roma children in classes for children with learning difficulties.

zh: 欧洲人权法院要审理D.H. 及他人诉捷克共和国一案中涉及到的第三项问题。
en: The EHCR was confronted with the third issue in the case D.H. and others vs. Czech Republic .

zh: 向法庭提起了18个案例，其中的男孩和女孩们在1996至1999年之间被直接或在小学就读一段时间后被排在学习困难特殊学校。
en: The Court was referred to 18 cases of girls and boys who, between 1996 and 1999, were placed in special schools for children with learning difficulties, either directly or after a period of time in primary schools.

zh: 涉案问题是，孩子们是否是因为他们的少数民族身份而成为歧视的受害者。
en: The question was whether the children were victims of discrimination owing to their national minority status.

zh: 捷克政府承认，在某些特殊学校的学生中，80%到90%是罗姆孩子。
en: The Czech government admitted that some of the special schools’ student bodies comprised 80% to 90% Roma children.

zh: 然而，就算存在歧视，那也不是直接的，因为按照捷克的法律，这种调动只能根据在教育心理咨询中心作的智力测试的结果由校长决定并且需得到孩子的家长或监护人的同意。
en: However, if there was discrimination, it was not direct, because under Czech law, such a move could be decided only by a school headmaster based on the results of an intelligence test at an educational psychology counseling centre, and subject to the approval of the child’s parents or legal guardian.

zh: 待遇的不同本身并不是歧视。
en: A difference in treatment is not discriminatory in itself.

zh: 根据各国最高法院及欧洲人权法院的判例法，只有在处于类似情况中的人被区别对待的时侯方才存在歧视。
en: According to the case law of national supreme courts and the ECHR, discrimination exists only when people in a similar situation are treated differently.

zh: 然而各国及国际判例法也确认，理论上的非歧视措施可能成为实践中的歧视。
en: Yet national and international case law recognizes that a non-discriminatory measure in theory can be discriminatory in practice.

zh: 因此，在当前案例中，所指控的歧视并非根源于法律本身，而是根源于其影响，原告主要根据数据表明特殊学校中罗姆人过多。
en: So, in the current case, the alleged discrimination does not stem from the law itself, but from its effects, with the plaintiffs relying mainly on statistics showing the over-representation of Roma in special schools.

zh: 现在有关于捷克共和国罗姆人情况的许多其它报告，包括欧洲理事会作出的报告。
en: Many other reports on the situation of Roma in the Czech Republic, including by the Council of Europe, are available.

zh: 但是，法庭公正地提示，它仅会对所提交的案例进行裁决，不会表达其对捷克教育系统合理性的观点，因为关于教育机会的选择属于各国的管辖范围，因而可能会有所不同。
en: But, as the Court rightly noted, it should rule only on the cases to which it is referred, and should not make known its opinion on the Czech education system’s legitimacy, as choices concerning educational opportunities fall under the jurisdiction of states and therefore can vary accordingly.

zh: 由七名法官组成的欧洲人权法院审议庭根据这一假设并考虑到所要解决的案件于2006年2月作出了原告败诉的裁决，并且判定，有关特殊学校的法律并不是特别针对罗姆人的，并且不是仅仅适用于他们的。
en: Working on this assumption and given the case it had to solve, an EHCR panel of seven judges ruled against the plaintiffs in February 2006, concluding that the law on special schools is not aimed specifically at Roma and does not apply only to them.

zh: 法庭认为，该法律合理的目的是为具有特殊困难的学生作出教学调节，并且，心理测试看上去是足够客观，并未牵涉到种族偏见。
en: According to the Court, the law’s legitimate purpose is to adapt teaching to the difficulties of a specific category of pupils, and psychological tests seem to be objective enough not to be suspected of racial bias.

zh: 除此以外，将孩子安排到特殊学校需得到父母同意的要求依旧有效，而最初被排到这些学校的罗姆孩子稍后可以回到主流学校，因此重新融合到了正常教育之中。
en: Moreover, the requirement of parents’ approval for placing children in special schools remains valid, while Roma children who were initially placed in those schools could have returned to mainstream schools later, and thus reintegrated into normal schooling.

zh: 尽管法庭的推理是有根据的，但不安感仍然继续存在。
en: As well-founded as the Court’s reasoning may be, a feeling of unease persists.

zh: 显示这些学校存在大量比例的罗姆孩子的数据不容忽视，难以避免歧视嫌疑。
en: The statistics showing the enormous proportion of Roma children in those schools are hard to ignore, and the suspicion of discrimination is difficult to avoid.

zh: 虽然法律改变了，但是心态并不总是同步改变，并且从直觉上我们知道利用心理学来安排很多事情是很容易办到的。
en: While laws have changed, mentalities do not always follow at the same pace, and we intuitively know that it is easy to get psychology to mean a lot of things.

zh: 确实，在决定宣布以前，法院认为有必要指出，虽然未断定人权公约被违反，但数据仍然显示出“令人担忧的数字，并且捷克共和国罗姆孩子教育问题的总体情况堪待改进 ” 。
en: Indeed, before announcing its decision, the Court felt it necessary to state that while it did not conclude that the Convention had been violated, statistics still revealed “worrying figures, and the situation in general in the Czech Republic regarding Roma children’s education needs to be improved.”

zh: 虽然法官巴罗托提出了书面异议，法庭庭长科斯塔在未置疑其决定的合法性的情况下也表明了类似的观点。
en: The Court’s president, Jean-Paul Costa, expressed a similar view, without questioning the legitimacy of the decision, although Judge Cabral Barreto wrote a dissenting opinion.

zh: 而且，在当事人的要求之下，法庭同意将该案例向大法庭提请上诉，这一举动意义重大。
en: Moreover, it is significant that the Court agreed, at the request of the parties, to refer the case on appeal to its Grand Chamber.

zh: 根据科斯塔的观点，否决2006年2月的判决将与以前的判例法相抵触。
en: According to Costa, rejecting the ruling in February 2006 would contradict previous case law.

zh: 那么，法庭会不会针对捷克教育系统的运作本身有所判决？
en: Will the Court, then, decide on the workings of the Czech education system itself?

zh: 或者是否会听从法官巴罗托的要求，承认有义务旨在为罗姆人利益而���取积极行动政策？
en: Or will it follow Judge Barreto, who calls for recognition of an obligation to adopt affirmative action policies aimed at benefiting Romanies?

zh: 不管采取何种方案，罗姆儿童需得到与其它儿童同等的机会，这一点是毋庸置疑的。
en: Whatever formula is adopted, it is certain that Roma children should be afforded the same opportunities as other children.

zh: 正是这一需要决定了即将作出的裁决的重要性，因为它为法院提供了一个时机来重申确定我们民主社会的非歧视的基本原则。
en: It is this imperative that underlies the importance of the coming decision, for it provides an occasion for the Court to reassert the fundamental principle of non-discrimination that defines our democratic societies.

zh: 财政联盟的诞生
en: The Birth of Fiscal Unions

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 财政联盟往往是提升信誉的有效方式，还可以在广袤地理区域的不同民族间创造出新的团结意识。
en: PRINCETON – Fiscal unification is often an effective way to enhance creditworthiness, and it may also create a new sense of solidarity among diverse peoples living within a large geographic area.

zh: 欧洲人因此常常向往美国模式。
en: For this reason, Europeans have often looked toward the model of the United States.

zh: 但他们从来没有仿效成功，因为他们具有形形色色的结盟动机。
en: But they have never been able to emulate it, because their motivations for union have been so varied.

zh: 身处绝境的国家往往将财政联盟视为应对紧急状况的唯一方式。
en: Desperate countries often consider such unions to be the best way out of an emergency.

zh: 1940年，面对纳粹的挑战，丘吉尔接受了由戴高乐提出的英法财政联盟，当时的法国在纳粹的铁蹄下已经沦陷。
en: In 1940, Charles de Gaulle proposed, and Winston Churchill accepted, the idea of a Franco-British union in the face of the Nazi challenge, which had already overwhelmed France.

zh: 战争结束5年后的1950年，德国战后首任总理康拉德·阿登纳同样提议成立财政联盟（这次是法德财政联盟 ） — —借以摆脱战败国的生存危机。
en: In 1950, five years after the war, Germany’s first postwar chancellor, Konrad Adenauer, also proposed a union – this time between France and Germany – as a way out of his defeated country’s existential crisis.

zh: 政治联盟的提议最终遭到拒绝；但经济联盟的辉煌却持续了六十多年 — — 直到今天依然在延续。
en: Political unification was rejected; but economic association has had a brilliant career for more than six decades – until now.

zh: 财政联盟背后的基本思想是资信较差的贫困国家可以受益于与富裕国家的联合债务。
en: The fundamental idea behind a fiscal union is that poorer, less creditworthy countries can gain from joint debt liability with richer countries.

zh: 实际上，这方面最有趣的建议来自一战初期，当时俄罗斯帝国在国际资本市场有限的借贷能力和短缺的外汇储备导致其无法创建有效的军力。
en: Indeed, one of the most fascinating proposals to this effect came at the beginning of World War I, when the Russian Empire found that its limited capacity to borrow on international capital markets and its low foreign-currency reserves left it unable to create an effective military force.

zh: 于是俄国政府提出与英法两国建立全面的战时财政联盟。
en: So the Russian government proposed what would have amounted to a full fiscal union with Britain and France for war-related finances.

zh: 这项提议得到了法国的支持，因为法国的借债能力要弱于英国。
en: France latched onto the idea, because its borrowing capacity was also weaker than Britain’s.

zh: 英国当然希望打赢战争，但却并没有到愿意承担俄法两国政府无限债务责任的程度。
en: The British wanted to win the war – but not so much that they were prepared to accept unlimited liability for debt incurred by the French and Russian governments.

zh: 现实生活中，在政治体制差异如此之大的国家间建立财政联盟其实是行不通的。
en: In reality, a fiscal union between such diverse political systems would have been unworkable.

zh: 独裁或腐败政府具有为精英阶层谋利的强烈动机。
en: An autocratic or corrupt regime has a strong incentive to spend in a way that benefits the elite.

zh: 上述动机随着对民主国家资源的控制力而增强，民主国家的民众愿意纳税（并清偿未来债务）是因为他们同样能掌控政府。
en: That incentive increases if it can command the resources of a more democratically governed state, where citizens agree to pay taxes (and pay off future debt) because they also control the government.

zh: 民主国家接受协议的唯一可能性是明确关系到安全利益。
en: The only circumstance in which democracies sign up to such a deal is when a clear security interest is at stake.

zh: 这样的困境让1914年前的俄国进入到法国的金融市场。
en: It was that predicament that gave pre-1914 Russia unique access to the French financial market.

zh: 但在1915年，英国即便在战时也不愿承担俄国的债务。
en: Yet, in 1915, the British, even in the face of an ongoing war, were unwilling to assume Russia’s liabilities.

zh: 也许纯粹是战前欧洲的不确定性、或者威胁性质的不确定性，让安全顾虑在与金融风险的博弈中占据了上风 。
en: Perhaps the sheer degree of uncertainty in pre-war Europe, or the more amorphous nature of the threat, made security concerns trump financial risk.

zh: 俄国一战信贷方案预示了欧洲二十世纪末有关负债及其与安全关系的政治操纵。
en: Russia’s World War I credit arrangements anticipated some of the political maneuvering about debt and its relation to security that occurred in late-twentieth-century Europe.

zh: 因为处在冷战的分界线上，后1945年的西德在很长一段时期内非常脆弱。
en: Post-1945 West Germany was vulnerable for a long time, because it sat on the Cold War’s fault line.

zh: 西德政府因此为邻国提供财政援助以换取安全和政治团结，特别是在他们无法确定美国支持是否可靠、以及能否继续的时候。
en: As a result, West German governments offered neighboring countries financial help in exchange for security and political solidarity, especially at moments when they were uncertain about the reliability and continuity of US support.

zh: 但这种财政援助并非没有限度。
en: But there were limits.

zh: 1979年，当西德实行带有合作伙伴（欧洲货币体系）保障机制的固定汇率制度时，德国央行成功地确保自己不受无限制的货币干预，并能在德国马克的稳定性受到威胁时终止固定汇率制度。
en: In 1979, when West Germany adopted a fixed exchange-rate regime with a support mechanism for its partners (the European Monetary System), the Bundesbank ensured that it was not committed to unlimited currency interventions and that it might stop when the stability of the Deutsche Mark was endangered.

zh: 相同的逻辑于20世纪90年代初再次在更大范围内上演，不过这次不存在任何预先确定的限制因素。
en: The logic was repeated on an even larger scale at the beginning of the 1990’s, but this time without any pre-determined limits.

zh: 欧盟做出的货币联盟承诺显著改善了欧元区地中海国家的公共财政和债务状况。
en: The European Union’s commitment to monetary union enabled the eurozone’s Mediterranean countries to improve their debt dynamics and public finances dramatically.

zh: 实现本币与联盟国家（特别是德国）货币挂钩后上述国家的借贷成本大幅下降，因为德国具有极强的稳定声誉。
en: Their borrowing costs fell as they locked their currencies into a union with countries – Germany, in particular – with a stronger reputation for stability.

zh: 出现危机时最终偿债责任如何划分的问题当时并没有解决，而过度负债问题则通过制定欧元趋同标准（反正该标准也没有全面实施）只当不存在。
en: At that point, the problem of how to divide the eventual bill when things became costly was not addressed, and the problem of excessive debt was wished away by the establishment of convergence criteria (which were not fully implemented anyway).

zh: 但自从2009年欧元区外围国家的财务困境将上述问题推上了前台，欧洲人面临的���题简直和一战盟国一模一样。
en: But, since 2009, when financial distress in the eurozone’s periphery brought such problems to the fore, Europeans have faced the same question as the WWI Allies.

zh: 安全和政治利益是否真的重要到值得冒险承担无法控制的政治体制所产生的无限巨额债务？
en: Are security and political interests so overwhelming that they justify assuming large and unlimited liabilities incurred by political systems over which they have no control?

zh: 因为欧洲持续和平、不存在单一压倒性的安全威胁，因此当议价程度变得清晰时，富裕债权国的选民和政治家将会选择拒绝。
en: Because Europe is at peace, with no singular, overriding security threat, it is likely that when the extent of the bargain becomes clear, voters and politicians in the rich creditor countries will reject it.

zh: 但欧洲更加无法确定的安全挑战可能恰恰需要1914年前法俄两国和1950年德法两国曾经乐于建立的那种牢固的财政连接。
en: But the more uncertain security challenges that Europe faces may just demand the kind of strong fiscal link that the French and Russians were willing to forge before 1914, and that the Germans and French embraced in 1950.

zh: 现实影响是非常重要的：只有通过解散腐败寡头、削弱财政冒险动机的政治改革进程，债务和安全之间的必要平衡才有可能达到。
en: The implications for the present are important: the only palatable way in which the necessary balance between liability and security can be achieved is through a process of political reform that dissolves corrupt oligarchies and weakens incentives for fiscal imprudence.

zh: 方法之一或许是询问欧洲国家民众是否愿意接受涉及硬性债务限制的某种形式的财政契约。
en: One approach might be to ask citizens in all European countries whether they are prepared to accept some sort of fiscal compact involving a hard limit on debt.

zh: 德国人把这一方案称为Schuldenbremse（债务制动 ） 。
en: Germans refer to this solution as a Schuldenbremse (debt brake).

zh: 方案预先设定了制度及其基础性假设逐渐被广泛接受的意义深远的过程。
en: It presupposes a profound process through which institutions and the assumptions underlying them come to be widely shared.

zh: 但实现这一过程需要时间，世界从危机中脱颖而出的最成功的联盟美国充分证明了这一点。
en: But that takes time, as the history of the US – the world’s most successful union born of emergency – amply demonstrates.

zh: 欧洲和全球食品危机
en: Europe and the Global Food Crisis

zh: 巴黎 - - 食品价格前所未有地暴涨震撼了世界。 因饥饿引发的骚乱以及社会紧张关系表明食品供应再次成为动荡因素，而全球气候变暖以及日益下降的自然资源则给这一空前的紧急局势火上加油。
en: PARIS – The world has been shaken by unprecedented spikes in food prices, by hunger riots, and by social tensions that demonstrate that food supplies have returned as a source of insecurity – to which global warming and declining natural resources are adding unprecedented urgency.

zh: 人们估计，到2050年全世界将会有九十亿人口，因此食品需求可能翻番，而这些需求主要来自世界最贫困国家的城市人口。
en: By 2050, it is estimated that there will be nine billion people on earth, so the need for food may double – primarily among urban populations in the world’s poorest countries.

zh: 但是为了寻找解决途经，仅仅确定那些有能力给世界提供粮食的国家是不够的。
en: But there is more to finding a solution than simply identifying those nations that are capable of feeding the rest of the world.

zh: 目前，每个国家在粮食上自给自足越发紧迫。
en: It is increasingly urgent that every nation gain the means of feeding itself.

zh: 这就意味着农业应该成为国际优先重点问题，帮助最贫困国家维护其食品供应安全和独立。
en: This means that agriculture should become an international priority, with the poorest countries helped to safeguard the security and independence of their food supplies.

zh: 各国和国际组织已经行动起来。
en: Countries and organizations are already mobilizing.

zh: 联合国粮农组织认为，食品价格上扬导致全球冲突增加。
en: The United Nations’ Food and Agriculture Organization argues that rising food prices could lead to increasing global conflicts.

zh: 达沃斯世界经济论坛把食品供应脆弱列为对人类的主要威胁。
en: The Davos World Economic Forum ranks food insecurity as a major risk to humanity.

zh: 世界银行已经大力强调农业在促使经济增长以及打破贫困循环上的重要性。
en: The World Bank has forcefully emphasized the importance of agriculture to jump-starting economic expansion and breaking the cycle of poverty.

zh: 联合国秘书长潘基文成立了工作组来制定行动规划，而法国总统萨尔科奇建议创立全球食品伙伴关系。
en: UN Secretary Ban Ki-moon has created a working group to define a common plan of action, and France’s President Nicolas Sarkozy has proposed a global partnership for food.

zh: 萨尔科奇的建议包括三大支柱。
en: Sarkozy’s proposed partnership has three pillars.

zh: 首先，一个国际小组应该拟定全球食品安全战略。
en: First, an international group should draft a worldwide strategy for food security.

zh: 其次，应该指派一个国际科学平台评估世界农业形势，对即将到来的危机发出警报并且在可能的情况下协助各国政府采纳政治和其他方面的战略工具以应对食品危机。
en: Second, an international scientific platform should be charged with evaluating the world’s agricultural situation, sending out warnings of upcoming crises, and possibly facilitating governments’ adoption of political and other strategic tools to deal with food crises.

zh: 最后，国际金融界尽管自身问题重重，也必须动员起来。
en: Finally, the international finance community, despite its current problems, must be mobilized.

zh: 欧盟农业产量稳定而又巨大，这就意味着它能够而且应该在全球市场上发挥监管者的作用。
en: The reliability and size of the European Union’s farm output means that it can and should play the role of regulator in global markets.

zh: 如果欧洲削减其农业生产，那么，其自身粮食进口增加将会大幅度提高全球食品价格。
en: If Europe cut back on its agricultural production, the increase in its own food imports would contribute significantly to a worldwide increase in food prices.

zh: 因此，保持欧盟粮食生产水平稳定至关重要，这对于欧洲人和世界最贫困国家人们而言都是如此。
en: This makes it imperative that EU food production levels be held steady – for the sake of Europeans and of people in the world’s poorest countries.

zh: 但是欧洲不能在危害贫困国家的基础上壮大自身的农业。
en: But Europe cannot build up its own agriculture to the detriment of the less fortunate.

zh: 所以，欧盟必须与穷国协调其政策。
en: So the EU must harmonize its policies with poorer countries.

zh: 目前，出口补贴以及援助款项只占欧洲农业预算的1%不到，而且欧盟已经开始在得到其他主要食品出口国家对等许诺的时候消除它们。
en: At present, export subsidies and support payments represent less than 1% of the European agricultural budget, and the EU has undertaken to eliminate them once it receives reciprocal undertakings from major food-exporting countries.

zh: 从2001年以来，根据“排除军火”倡议，来自贫困国家的武器弹药以外的所有产品均可以免税进入欧盟单一市场。
en: Since 2001, with the “Everything but Arms” initiative, all products from poor countries – with the exception of weapons and munitions – can enter the EU single market on a duty-free basis.

zh: 这就让欧盟成为了最贫困国家产品的主要市场。
en: This has led to the EU becoming the primary market for the poorest countries’ products.

zh: 欧盟还在制定措施，通过改变其共同农业政策来应对新的全球挑战。
en: The EU is also developing ways to respond to new global challenges through changes to its Common Agricultural Policy.

zh: 这反映在其停止“闲置”规则决定之上。 这一规则要求一定比例的农田休耕。
en: This was reflected in the decision to suspend the “set aside” rule that requires a proportion of agricultural land to lie fallow.

zh: 现在，欧盟准备逐步提高奶制品配额并且正在评估其有关生物燃料的决定对世界市场的影响。
en: Now the EU is preparing to increase dairy quotas progressively, and evaluating the impact on world markets of its decisions regarding bio-fuels.

zh: 但是欧盟必须关注于鼓励发展地区农业。
en: But Europe’s focus must be on encouraging the development of local agriculture.

zh: 这是取得更大全球安全以及减少贫困的唯一途经。
en: Doing so is the only way to achieve greater global food security and reduce poverty.

zh: 这也将会让确保今天的农产品高价转化为贫困农民的机遇。
en: It will also make it possible to ensure that today’s high prices for agricultural products are transformed into opportunity for poor farmers.

zh: 这非常关键，因为根据世界银行的报告，农业增长消除贫困要比其他任何经济部门的增长都要大两倍。
en: This is vital because, according to the World Bank, growth in farming eliminates poverty twice as much as growth in any other economic sector.

zh: 确实，世界最贫困国家中农业依旧是主要的生产部门，65%的人口以农业就业，而且平均而言对GDP的贡献超过25 % 。
en: Indeed, agriculture remains the primary productive sector in the world’s poorest countries, employing 65% of the working population and, on average, contributing more than 25% to GDP.

zh: 但是在过去的二十年中，农业发展支持一直在下降。
en: But over the past 20 years, support for agricultural development has been declining.

zh: 现在只有4%的公共发展援助用于农业。
en: Only 4% of public development assistance is now earmarked for agriculture.

zh: 欧盟委员会和欧盟成员国因此规划通过欧洲发展基金以及发展新的财政支持来源来提高援助。
en: The European Commission and EU member states are therefore planning to increase their assistance, both through the European Development Fund and by developing new sources of financial support.

zh: 进一步开放农业贸易并不确保食品安全。
en: Further liberalization of farm trade will not ensure food security.

zh: 农业市场起伏不定，因此就需要法规来减缓动荡的食品价格对贫困国家的影响。
en: Faced with the erratic nature of agricultural markets, regulation is needed to soften the impact on poorer countries of volatile food prices.

zh: 这并不意味着应该采取保护主义，而是有必要不时地考虑到影响国际农业贸易的具体问题，例如天气、价格波动或者健康风险等等。
en: This does not mean that protectionism is the way forward, only that taking account of specific issues that affect international farm trade – weather, price volatility, or health risks – may be necessary from time to time.

zh: 但是，当今世界的生产效率差异可以相差一千倍，仅仅依靠市场来让最贫困国家扩大其经济是不明智的。
en: But, in a world where productivity differentials can be as great as one to 1,000, it would be unwise to rely on markets alone to enable the poorest countries to expand their economies.

zh: 跨国食品分销商和爆发饥荒国家的生产者之间的竞争并不大可能带来经济扩大。
en: Nor is it likely that much economic expansion will result from competition between multinational food distributors and producers in countries where famine still stalks the land.

zh: 相反，汇集外部专业知识以及地理、环境和经济限制的当地知识以便分散风险，共担资源和项目管理更有可能帮助贫穷国家实现食品独立。
en: Instead, bringing together outside expertise and local knowledge of the geography and environmental and economic constraints in order to spread risks and share the management of resources and projects is far more likely to help poor countries achieve food independence.

zh: 在不到二十年的时间内，这一措施就帮助战后欧洲实现了粮食自主。
en: It was such an approach that, in less than 20 years, helped postwar Europe achieve food sovereignty.

zh: 像印度和越南那些将其农业发展排除于国际竞争构成威胁之外的国家也大幅度削减了农村贫困。
en: Countries that have protected their agricultural development from the threats posed by international markets – such as India or Vietnam – have achieved substantial reductions in agricultural poverty.

zh: 现在应该优先发展农业以便确保更加符合人道的发展。
en: The time has also come to prioritize agriculture in order to ensure growth with a more human face.

zh: 法国位居欧盟核心地位，愿意在迅速成为全世界共同主要问题的集体行动上发挥作用。
en: At the heart of the EU, France wants to play its part in a collective effort that is fast becoming a major issue for us all.

zh: 危机与转型
en: Crisis and Transformation

zh: 安卡拉 — — 以多种快速转型并举来形容我们这个时代并不新鲜。
en: ANKARA – It has become a cliché to characterize our era as one of multiple rapid transformations.

zh: 但2012年尤其算得上多事之秋，经济危机、政治军事冲突、社会动荡、文化冲突、世界某个角落的环境问题无时无刻不在吸引着公众的注意力。
en: But 2012 was particularly eventful. Not a single day passed without requiring continuous and concerted attention to economic crises, political and military conflicts, social upheavals, cultural clashes, or environmental problems in some corner of the world.

zh: 土耳其的近邻占据了2012年全球政策议程的头把交椅，2013年仍将延续这种格局。
en: Turkey’s immediate neighborhood occupied the top spot on the global policy agenda in 2012, and will continue to so in 2013.

zh: 我们北面的欧洲正处在创造性毁灭的十字路口，由此产生的深远后果将远远超出欧盟本身的范畴。
en: To our north, Europe is at a crossroads, undergoing a process of creative destruction, with potentially far-reaching ramifications well beyond the confines of the European Union.

zh: 而在我们南面，对尊严、自由、民主与和平不可逆转的追求正在改变着地区的政治格局。
en: To our south, an irreversible quest for dignity, freedom, democracy, and peace is altering the region’s political landscape.

zh: 毋庸置疑，仅靠经济措施无法结束欧盟目前的危机。
en: Needless to say, economic measures alone cannot end the EU’s ongoing crisis.

zh: 若要保住地缘政治话语权，欧洲必须对自身及所要完成的使命进行重新定义。
en: Europe must redefine itself and identify its mission anew if it wishes to retain its geopolitical weight.

zh: 欧盟必须确定自身究竟代表价值观群体还是狭隘的地理实体，是否任由上述实体的排外冲动最终削弱欧盟整体的全球话语权。
en: The EU must decide whether it represents a community of values or a narrowly defined geographic entity whose exclusionary impulses will eventually erode its global relevance.

zh: 土耳其不是一个冷漠的旁观者，我们是欧洲的组成部分并以加入欧盟为战略目标。 相反，我们尽力参与目前的讨论，说出自己的想法和意见。
en: As an integral part of Europe with EU membership as a strategic objective, Turkey is not an indifferent bystander; on the contrary, we strive to participate in the current debate by offering our own views and ideas.

zh: 比方说我们认为欧盟一体化进程必须更为广泛深入，并以此保持对周边地区积极的改革影响。
en: We believe, for example, that EU integration needs to be wider as well as deeper, thereby maintaining its positive transformative influence in neighboring regions.

zh: 既然如此，中东和北非当然是首要考虑的目标。
en: Here, of course, the Middle East and North Africa should be of paramount concern.

zh: 历史上地中海一侧发生的状况会对另一侧造成直接的影响；鉴于当前全球高度的相互依赖性，我们完全有理由相信这一规律仍将发挥作用。
en: Historically, whatever happens on one side of the Mediterranean has had a direct impact on the other; given today’s high level of global interdependence, there is every reason to believe that this will remain true.

zh: 阿拉伯民众争取欧洲已有权利的真实愿望驳斥了西方人长期以来形成的东方观。
en: The Arab peoples’ genuine aspiration to secure for themselves the universal rights that Europeans enjoy refutes the West’s long-held orientalist perspective.

zh: 当然，现在预测阿拉伯觉醒运动的结果还为时尚早，但转型中的国家面临严峻挑战却是不争的事实。
en: Of course, it is still too early to predict the outcome of the Arab Awakening, and the countries in transition still face daunting challenges.

zh: 但人们想象中的噩梦并没有在现实中出现，这预示着未来仍有希望。
en: But none of the various nightmare scenarios materialized, which augurs hope for the future.

zh: 此外，2012年突尼斯、利比亚和埃及举行了自由公正的选举，这在上述国家历史上当属首次。
en: Moreover, in Tunisia, Libya, and Egypt, free and fair elections – the first in these countries’ history – were held in 2012.

zh: 但选举绝不是民主的全部，建立基本民主制度（法治、问责、性别平等、言论和信仰自由）的任务仍有待这些国家去完成。
en: But democracy is not only about elections. The task of creating essential democratic institutions – the rule of law, habits of accountability, gender equality, and freedom of expression and faith – still awaits these countries.

zh: 但阿拉伯人民终于体验到真正的天赋权利，成功跨过了恐惧的门槛。
en: Yet the Arab peoples have finally experienced genuine empowerment, and have crossed the threshold of fear.

zh: 我相信他们会朝着民主继续大踏步迈进。
en: I believe that they will continue to advance toward democracy.

zh: 说完这些，叙利亚局势和以色列不久前对加沙的入侵行动仍然是无法回避的事实。
en: That said, the situation in Syria and recent Israeli aggression in Gaza remain open wounds.

zh: 叙利亚的血腥内战正蹂躏着世界上最壮观的古代城市。
en: In Syria, a bloody civil war is laying waste to some of the world’s most magnificent ancient cities.

zh: 叙利亚民众像突尼斯、利比亚和埃及民众一样要求尊严民主的生活。
en: The Syrian people’s demands are the same as those heard in Tunisia, Libya, and Egypt: a dignified, democratic life.

zh: 但他们却面临巴沙尔·阿萨德政权发动的惨无人道的暴力活动，包括战斗机、直升机和坦克的进攻。
en: Instead, they have gotten an inhuman campaign of violence – including attacks by warplanes, helicopters, and tanks – by President Bashar al-Assad’s regime.

zh: 阿萨德政权将垂死挣扎转化为种族和宗派冲突的行径将对整个地区造成严重的破坏，而首当其冲受到影响的就是巴嫩和伊拉克等邻国。
en: The regime’s effort to turn its struggle for survival into an ethnic and sectarian conflict could wreak havoc across the region, starting with neighbors like Lebanon and Iraq.

zh: 自阿拉伯觉醒运动伊始，土耳其就坚定地支持民众的民主合法诉求。
en: From the very outset of the Arab Awakening, Turkey has taken a principled stand on the side of legitimate and democratic aspirations.

zh: 意识到身为历史性合作伙伴甚至权利自由追求者力量源泉的特殊作用，我们越发感到有义务这样做。
en: Aware of our special role as a historical partner and, more so, as a source of inspiration to those demanding their rights and freedom, we felt particularly compelled to do so.

zh: 对土耳其而言，叙利亚内战带来又一次人道主义危机挑战。
en: For Turkey, the civil war in Syria has created an additional challenge in the form of a humanitarian crisis.

zh: 我们目前收容了约20万因暴力活动升级而背井离乡的叙利亚难民，用于支持难民生活的开支超过4亿美元 — — 世界其他国家几乎没有提供任何援助。
en: We are now hosting approximately 200,000 Syrians who fled their country’s growing violence, and have already spent more than $400 million to accommodate these desperate people – with almost no assistance from the rest of the world.

zh: 但鉴于几个世纪共同历史所形成的特殊纽带，我们永远不会在邻国叙利亚最艰难的时刻对他们弃之不顾。
en: But we will never be dissuaded from helping our Syrian neighbors in their most difficult hour, given the special bonds emanating from centuries of shared history.

zh: 阿以冲突和大规模杀伤性武器（WMDs）扩散风险日益增强这两大相互关联的地区性根本安全挑战必须得到解决，才能确保中东历史性转型带来稳定、繁荣和安全。
en: Two other fundamental and inter-related security challenges in the region – the Arab-Israeli conflict and the growing danger of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction (WMDs) – also must be resolved in order to ensure that the Middle East’s historic transformation leads to security, stability, and prosperity.

zh: 不久前发生的暴力事件再次证明加沙存在爆发全面地区性冲突的危险。
en: Here, the recent violence in Gaza has once again demonstrated the risk of an all-out regional conflict.

zh: 从战略战术两方面而言，以色列最近的加沙行动没有取得任何收获。
en: Israel’s latest operation in Gaza brought it no benefit, either tactical or strategic.

zh: 相反，此次出于国内政治目的而采取的行动明显有损于以色列的长期安全。
en: On the contrary, this aggression, clearly staged for domestic political consumption, will harm Israel’s long-term security.

zh: 哈马斯首次成功干扰到特拉维夫，迫使以色列在传统的盟友（包括美国）面前为自己的行为和声誉进行辩护。
en: For the first time, Hamas proved capable of causing disruptions as far away as Tel Aviv, while Israel was forced to defend its behavior and reputation even with its traditional allies, including the United States.

zh: 但在阿拉伯觉醒运动后更好理解新的战略环境是以色列应该吸取的最大教训。
en: But the biggest lesson for Israel is that it needs to comprehend better the new strategic environment following the Arab Awakening.

zh: 上述问题有必要采取全面措施加以解决。
en: It is imperative to adopt a more holistic approach to both of these problems.

zh: 执行2002年阿拉伯和平计划解决以色列安全问题并根据1991年通过的联合国安理会687号决议实现销毁地区大规模杀伤性武器理应作为上述措施的基础。
en: The reference point for such an effort should be parallel implementation of the 2002 Arab Peace Plan, which addresses Israel’s security concerns, and a regional disarmament mechanism based on United Nations Security Council Resolution 687, adopted in 1991 to enable the elimination of WMDs from the entire region.

zh: 我非常支持美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马在2010年核不扩散条约审议大会上的讲话，奥���马在会上支持了上述想法，并要求其他主要国家就裁军问题采取行动。
en: I deeply appreciate US President Barack Obama’s remarks at the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty Review Conference in 2010, at which he supported this idea and invited other major actors to take the initiative on disarmament.

zh: 上述方法可以在消除伊朗和其他国家威胁意识所带来的紧张局势，公正持久地解决严重违背人们正义感、并导致动荡和极端主义的巴勒斯坦问题。
en: This approach would enable a fair and lasting resolution of the Palestinian issue, which profoundly offends people’s sense of justice and causes instability and extremism, while eliminating tensions arising from the threat perceptions of Iran and other countries in the region.

zh: 此外，发达国家和国际金融机构应效仿二战结束后的马歇尔计划，在尚处于转型阶段的阿拉伯国家实施全面的经济复苏计划。
en: Beyond this, advanced countries and international financial institutions should implement a comprehensive economic recovery program for the Arab countries in transition, similar to the Marshall Plan implemented after World War II.

zh: 欧洲和国际社会有机会协助地中海地区恢复其曾经拥有的繁荣和伟大，在中东地区实现和平、民主和稳定。
en: Europe and the international community have an opportunity to help the Mediterranean region to regain the prosperity and grandeur that it once had, and to turn the Middle East into a zone of peace, democracy, and stability.

zh: 土耳其愿意为实现上述愿景而竭尽全力。
en: Turkey will play whatever part it can in order to realize this vision.

zh: 欧洲和世界新秩序
en: Europe and the New World Order

zh: 柏林 - 2008年11月15日是一个值得纪念的日子，因为这一天，历史被创造了。
en: BERLIN – November 15, 2008, is a date to remember, because on that day history was made.

zh: 第一次，G - 20 这个世界上20个主要的经济体，为了找到全球金融和经济危机的解决方案，在华盛顿特区聚到了一起。
en: For the first time, the G-20, the world’s 20 leading economies, came together in Washington, D.C., to find an answer to the global financial and economic crisis.

zh: 虽然这第一次会议的结果只是发表了意向声明，但它仍然是一个历史性的转折点。
en: While this first meeting resulted in nothing more than declarations of intent, it still marks a historic turning point.

zh: 面对20世纪30年代以来全球最严重的金融和经济危机，以前主导世界经济的西方工业国家（包括俄罗斯 ） ， 已不再能够拿出有效的对策。
en: Faced with the gravest financial and economic crisis worldwide since the 1930’s, the Western industrial nations (including Russia) that previously dominated the world economy are no longer capable of coming up with an effective response.

zh: 此外，减轻，或者更确切地说，走出全球经济危机的希望就全部落在新兴的经济强国肩上，首先而且主要是中国。
en: Moreover, hopes for mitigating or, indeed, overcoming the global economic crisis rest exclusively with the emerging economic powers, first and foremost China.

zh: 因此，把最重要的新兴市场国家排斥在外的八国集团，已经永远地失去了其重要性。
en: As a result, the G-8, which excludes the most important emerging-market countries, has lost its significance for good.

zh: 全球化导致了权力和机会之分配的长久性改变，并奠定了二十一世纪世界新秩序的基础。
en: Globalization has resulted in a lasting change in the distribution of power and opportunities, laying the groundwork for a new world order for the twenty-first century.

zh: 一旦当前全球经济危机结束，一切都会不同。
en: Once the current global crisis is over, nothing will ever be the same again.

zh: 西方国家-美国和欧洲-正在相对走弱，而新兴的亚洲和拉美国家将是赢家。
en: The West – the United States and Europe – are in relative decline, while the emerging Asian and Latin American powers will be among the winners.

zh: 美国已经对其全球实力的下降作出了反应，选出了第一位非洲裔总统巴拉克·奥巴马，这令人印象深刻。
en: The US has responded to the decline of its global strength in an impressive manner, with the election of its first African-American president, Barack Obama.

zh: 在其历史上最严重的危机时刻，美国向自己和全世界证明了其自我改造的能力。
en: Amidst one of the gravest crises in its history, America has proven to itself and the world its ability to reinvent itself.

zh: 即使是现在马上来看，美国人民的这一选择将无疑带来三个长期影响。
en: And it is clear even now that this decision will have three long-term consequences.

zh: 首先，选出一位黑人总统将结束悲惨的奴隶制和美国内战的遗留问题。
en: First, the election of a black president will put to rest the tragic legacy of slavery and the American Civil War.

zh: 从现在开始，皮肤的颜色、眼睛的形状或性别的问题在一个候选人竞争高职位甚至是最高职位时，将不再起决定性作用。
en: From now on, the issues of skin color, eye shape, or gender will no longer play a deciding role for a candidate for high, or even the highest, office.

zh: 美国现在的政治制度体现了这个国家的人口结构的变化，因为非白人人口增长最为迅速。
en: The US political system now reflects the country’s demographic changes, as non-white sections of the population grow the fastest.

zh: 其次，奥巴马的当选将导致美国中期外交政策的重新调整。
en: Second, Obama’s election will lead to a reorientation of US foreign policy in the medium term.

zh: 特别是以前被认为是美国外交政策中的理所当然的跨大西洋/欧洲的重点，将越来越成为明日黄花。
en: In particular, the transatlantic/European focus of American foreign policy, which was previously a matter of course, will increasingly become a thing of the past.

zh: 第三，随着全球财富和权力不断从西方向东方转移，美国的政治文化视角的内部调整也将得到加强。
en: Third, the internal realignment of America’s political-cultural perspective will be reinforced by the ongoing global shift of wealth and power from the West to the East.

zh: 东北太平洋地区的强国-中国、日本和韩国-已经成为美国最重要的债权国，金融危机的出现使这些国家的重要性进一步加强。
en: The Northeastern Pacific powers – China, Japan, and South Korea – are already America’s most significant creditors by far, and their importance will increase further as a result of the financial crisis.

zh: 在可预见的未来，最大的增长机会将出现在这一地区，而出于经济和地缘政治的考虑，美国将越来越多地转向亚太地区，从而降低其跨大西洋定位的重要性。
en: For the foreseeable future, the greatest opportunities for growth lie in this region, and for both economic and geopolitical reasons America will increasingly turn toward the Pacific region, thus downgrading its transatlantic orientation.

zh: 所有这一切对欧洲来说无疑都是坏消息，因为一旦全球危机结束，欧洲的重要性肯定会下降。
en: All of this is bad news for Europe, because once this global crisis is over, Europeans will simply have become less important.

zh: 不幸的是，欧洲不仅在努力阻止或扭转这种局面方面无所事事，且其自身的所作所为却在加快这种下行的过程。
en: And, unfortunately, Europe is not only doing nothing to hold off or reverse its decline – it is accelerating the process through its own behavior.

zh: 随着奥巴马的当选，美国已经在全球化和多极化的世界框架中面对未来；而另一方面，欧洲却在当今的危机中重新挖掘其采取国家行动的效果，因此还在吃老本。
en: With the election of Obama, America has turned toward the future within a globalized, multipolar world; Europe, on the other hand, is rediscovering national action in this time of crisis, and thus banking on the past!

zh: 欧洲宪法已经失败，里斯本改革条约被爱尔兰拒绝后已无人问津，而加强欧洲经济治理受到了德法不团结的阻扰。
en: The European constitution has failed, the Lisbon reform treaty is in limbo after the Irish rejected it, and stronger European economic governance is blocked by German-French disunity.

zh: 欧盟成员国对这种旷日持久的自作自受所造成的僵局作出了毫不含糊的反应：各成员国主要靠自己的努力以填补出现的真空，而不是试图对政治和经济的进一步一体化进程重新注入活力。
en: The reaction of EU member states to this ongoing self-inflicted impasse is unambiguous: rather than trying to reenergize the process of further political and economic integration, they are primarily acting on their own to try to fill the vacuum that has emerged.

zh: 当然，成员国之间的协调是存在的，有时甚至是成功的，但没有强大的欧洲机构，单个的成功将不会持续太久。
en: Certainly, coordination between the member states exists, and is even successful at times, but without strong European institutions, such singular successes will not last.

zh: 有一个非常真实的危险，那就是欧洲将完全错失历史性的战略转机以转入多极化的世界，并且要为此付出高昂的代价。
en: There is a very real danger that Europe will simply miss out on an historic strategic turn towards a multipolar world – and at a high price.

zh: 在华盛顿首脑会议之后，各地的欧洲人甚至是英国的那些对欧盟持怀疑态度的人，也应该意识到这一战略调整此刻就在发生着！
en: After the summit in Washington, it should have sunk in among Europeans everywhere – even the Euroskeptics of the British Isles – that this strategic realignment is taking place right now!

zh: 如果欧洲人不能承认十九世纪他们的时代已经结束，那么全球列车没有他们也照样能朝二十一世纪继续迈进。
en: If Europeans cannot get their heads around the fact that the nineteenth century is over, the global caravan will continue to move forward into the twenty-first century without them.

zh: 欧洲能源联盟的能量
en: The Power of a European Energy Union

zh: 发自都柏林 — — 在去年夏天当选之前，欧盟委员会主席让-克劳德·容克（Jean-Claude Juncker）提出的其中一个核心议题就是创立一个欧洲能源联盟。
en: DUBLIN – One of the top priorities established by European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker ahead of his election last summer was the creation of a European energy union.

zh: 这一举措是正确的。
en: He was right to do so.

zh: 如果能正确实现的话，一个更具凝结力的能源政策将自动实现三大战略目标。
en: Done properly, a more cohesive energy policy could achieve three strategic objectives simultaneously.

zh: 通过将研究和投资相结合，鼓励节约能源，并将能源市场进行整合，一个能源将有助于对抗气候变化，为欧洲提供一项急需的经济刺激政策，并让整个大陆免受能源供应波动 — — 例如北非和乌克兰危机 — — 的冲击。
en: By coordinating research and investment, encouraging conservation, and integrating energy markets, an energy union would help fight climate change, provide Europe with a much needed economic stimulus, and protect the continent from supply shocks, such as those caused by the crises in North Africa and Ukraine.

zh: 当然，欧盟采取行动的能力取决于其成员国的意愿，虽然其中一些领头国家不断推进这一动议，但其他国家却对此不甚热心。
en: Of course, the European Union's ability to act is dependent on the willingness of its member states; and, though some of the continent's leaders have championed the initiative, others have proved less enthusiastic.

zh: 而对各国集体决心的一个关键测试指标就是是否愿意支持建设那些促成上述三大目标的核心基础设施。
en: A crucial test of their collective resolve will be whether they are willing to support key infrastructure projects that deliver on all three objectives.

zh: 这一项目的其中一个模范样板就是北海沿岸诸国所提出的离岸电网动议，旨在将所有的风力发电站连接成一个新的区域电网，让各国可以跨境对各自的电力供应进行平衡。
en: One good example of such a project is the North Sea Countries' Offshore Grid Initiative, a proposal that would link offshore wind farms to a new regional grid, and allow countries to balance variable power supplies across borders.

zh: 这一在2009年由欧盟九国及挪威签署的合作备忘录中首先提出的理念拥有巨大的潜力；到2030年，北海的风力发电站提供的电力将占到全欧的10 % — —而且零碳排放。
en: The idea – first advanced in a 2009 memorandum of understanding signed by nine EU member states and Norway – has enormous potential; by 2030, North Sea winds could provide Europe with 10% of its electricity – carbon-free.

zh: 但如果要继续推进这一项目，就急需得到政治上的委任授权。
en: But if the project is to go forward, it urgently needs a political mandate.

zh: 我们可以把整合电网想象成一个巨大的环，从英国连接到挪威，然后穿越英吉利海峡与法国，比利时和荷兰对接，再接上德国并回到斯堪的纳维亚半岛。
en: The integrated grid can be imagined as a large ring, connecting Norway with the United Kingdom, and then linking across the channel to France, Belgium, and Holland, before moving on to Germany and returning to Scandinavia.

zh: 它的实施将使欧洲得以建立一个可再生能源的自由贸易区，并因此减少为支撑其他各类能源供应所需的储存空间和过剩产能。
en: Its implementation would allow Europe to introduce a free-trade zone for renewable energy, reducing the need for storage and excess capacity to back up variable power supplies.

zh: 电网不但能维持自身的运营，而且可以通过提供与能源市场的已有连接通道，使新风力发电站的成本下降30 % 。
en: Not only would the grid pay for itself; once in place, it would reduce the cost of new wind farms by some 30%, by providing them with an existing connection to energy markets.

zh: 一个互联的能源系统对英国和德国尤其有用，因为两国可以利用互相之间的一小时时差去抹平本国能源需求的高峰和低谷。
en: An interconnected energy system would make particular sense for the UK and Germany, which could use the one-hour time difference between them to smooth out the peaks and troughs in demand.

zh: 可再生能源的生产本身是有间歇性的，而德国不同能源来源供应量的大起大落已经将其现有电网逼到了极限。
en: Renewable energy production is by nature intermittent, and the sheer number of fluctuating power sources in Germany is already pushing its existing grid to the limit.

zh: 互联也将有助于减少该国所需的内陆输电网数量。
en: Interconnection would also reduce the number of new onshore transmission lines the country needs.

zh: 为此德国政府也制定了一份政策文件以描述一个进一步整合的区域能源市场应当如何运作。
en: The German government has produced a policy paper outlining how a more integrated regional market might work.

zh: 去年，英国在太阳能和风力发电站等洁净能源方面的投资达152亿美元，与德国相仿。
en: Last year, the UK matched Germany's investments in clean energy, spending some $15.2 billion on solar panels and wind farms.

zh: 但要达到其制定的气候目标的话英国还有很长的路要走。
en: But Britain will need to do a lot more if it is to meet its climate targets.

zh: 据一份议会报告指出 ， “ 建设这样一个超级电网的成本将极为高昂 … … 但将带来大量经济利益 — — 包括在离岸可再生能源行业的数万新工作职位。
en: According to a parliamentary report, “the cost of developing such a supergrid could be very high...but it may bring a host of economic benefits – including tens of thousands of new jobs in the offshore renewable industry."

zh: ”一个区域性动议也将让首相戴维·卡梅伦得以安抚本党内那些反对建设内陆可再生能源发电站的声音。
en: A regional initiative would also allow Prime Minister David Cameron to accommodate opposition within his party to onshore renewable energy plants.

zh: 每一个牵涉这一项目的国家都将从项目的建设中受益。
en: Each of the individual countries involved in the project would benefit from its construction.

zh: 荷兰和比利时需要一个更具性价比的方法来发展自身的离岸能源资源。
en: Holland and Belgium need a cost-effective way to develop their own offshore resources.

zh: 丹麦已经从互联的电力市场中得到了好处；而从中得到的经验就是再进一步整合都是合理的。
en: Denmark already benefits from an interconnected electricity market; and the lesson it has learned is that it makes sense to integrate even further.

zh: 挪威将得以出售自身的水电资源，就算气候变化导致该资源减少，也可以确保后备能源供应。
en: Norway would be able to sell its hydropower and secure a backup supply should climate change leave it running dry.

zh: 电缆传输技术的进步令爱尔兰和法国连接起来，那么即便英国议会投票选择置身于电网之外，也可以让前者有另一条连结欧洲能源市场的通路。
en: Advances in cable technology would allow Ireland to link to France, providing an alternative route to European markets if the UK elects to remain outside the network.

zh: 容克在12月提出的3150亿欧元（折合3600亿美元）投资计划中包含了对各项互联项目的870亿欧元投资。
en: Juncker's €315 billion ($360 billion) investment plan, proposed in December, includes some €87 billion in interconnection projects.

zh: 而这些项目更应该��整合进一个单一动议之中，制定出技术，规划和监管方式的共同标准。
en: It would make sense to combine these into a single initiative, with common standards for technology, planning, and regulations.

zh: 这一举动将降低从欧洲投资银行贷款的资金成本并刺激欧洲能源企业的发展。
en: Doing so would lower the cost of capital on loans from the European Investment Bank and give a boost to European technology companies.

zh: 波罗的海诸国也在规划自身的离岸电网。
en: The Baltic states are also planning their own offshore grid.

zh: 但受益的可不仅仅是北欧地区。
en: But it is not just Northern Europe that could gain from such an approach.

zh: 东南欧和地中海沿岸诸国也会从能源分享中得益。
en: Europe's southeastern and Mediterranean countries could also benefit from sharing power.

zh: 发展这类项目所需的大部分法律和监管框架都已经就位，无需修改条约或者纷繁复杂的新立法。
en: Most of the necessary legal and regulatory framework is already in place. There is no need for treaty changes or complex new legislation.

zh: 唯一需要的就是政治指向，好让欧盟委员会可以建立一个必要的治理架构。
en: All that is needed is political direction, so that the European Commission can establish the necessary governance structures.

zh: 欧洲承诺建立一个真正能源联盟方面的决心将3月19日的欧洲议会会议上展现出来。
en: The strength of Europe's commitment to a true energy union will be revealed when the European Council meets on March 19.

zh: 会上的众多决策之一就是是否建立这些区域电网。
en: Among the decisions it will make will be whether to build these regional grids.

zh: 如果能欧盟及其成员国可以达成协议的话，它们就能在促进自身经济发展的同时改善自身能源安全形势。
en: If the EU and its member states reach an agreement, they could simultaneously boost their economies and improve their energy security.

zh: 否则的话就只能从中国或者美国购买相关科技，并在未来投资于各国自身的电网建设。
en: If not, they could end up buying the technology from China or the United States, which will be investing in their own grids in the coming years.

zh: 欧洲的能源要务
en: Europe’s Energy Essentials

zh: 马德里—在上个月的欧洲理事会布鲁塞尔会议上，能源问题主宰了会议日程 — — 这已是今年的第三次。
en: MADRID – At last month’s European Council meeting in Brussels, energy issues dominated the agenda – for the third time this year.

zh: 欧洲领导人把能源作为关注焦点是明智的，因为它是欧盟所面临的三大生存威胁的交汇点：修正主义俄罗斯、欧洲企业竞争力下降以及气候变化。
en: Energy’s emergence as a focal point for European leaders makes sense, given that it lies at the confluence of the three existential threats facing the European Union: a revisionist Russia, the declining competitiveness of European businesses, and climate change.

zh: 这些发展趋势挑战了欧洲的价值、社会模式的可行性以及世界的长期安全，因此欧洲领导人必须专注于构建新的能源体系以确保可靠供给、合理定价和生态可持续性。
en: As these developments challenge Europe’s values, its social model’s viability, and the world’s long-term security, EU leaders must focus on building a new energy system that ensures a reliable supply, sensible pricing, and ecological sustainability.

zh: 好消息是已经有了能促进这一方向的框架。
en: The good news is that a framework is already emerging that could facilitate this initiative.

zh: 事实上，除了被广泛讨论2030年能源产量目标 — — 该目标考虑了温室气体排放、能源效率和可再生资源等因素 — — 欧洲理事会的决议包括了务实有效的能源方针的关键要素。
en: Indeed, beyond widely discussed targets for energy production for 2030 – covering greenhouse-gas emissions, energy efficiency, and renewable resources – the European Council’s conclusions embrace key elements of a practical and effective approach to energy.

zh: 但是，要想从构想走向实施，欧洲必须塑造同一目标，而这在欧盟能源政策中一直难觅踪迹。
en: But, in order to move from aspiration to implementation, Europeans must muster the unity of purpose that so far has been conspicuously absent in EU energy policy.

zh: 欧盟新能源政策框架中最看得见摸得着的要素是内部能源市场，如能完善这一市场，能源和相关投资就可以在欧盟内部畅通无阻地流动。
en: The most tangible element of the EU’s emerging energy-policy framework is the internal energy market, which, once completed, will allow for the unimpeded flow of energy and related investments throughout the EU.

zh: 这一一体化能源市场将带来巨大的节约 — — 到2030年估计可达每年400亿欧元 — — 从而带来急需的竞争力提振。
en: Such an integrated energy market would lead to significant savings – estimates go as high as €40 billion ($51 billion) annually by 2030 – thereby providing a much-needed competitiveness boost.

zh: 内部能源市场还将增强欧洲的能源安全。
en: The internal energy market would enhance Europe’s energy security as well.

zh: 尽管欧洲总体保持着平衡的能源组成，供给在天然气、煤炭、石油、可再生能源和核能之间的配比相对均匀，但个体国家通常过分依赖于某种能源，甚至（更加危险地）依靠单一供给国：俄罗斯。
en: Though the EU as a whole maintains a balanced energy mix, with supply divided relatively evenly among gas, coal, oil, renewables, and nuclear generation, individual countries are often excessively dependent on a single source and, more dangerously, a single supplier: Russia.

zh: 不受限制的欧盟内部能源流将坚强供给干扰或冲击的风险。
en: Unrestricted energy flows within the EU would mitigate the risks of supply disruptions or shocks.

zh: 当然，建立内部能源市场并不只是政策问题。
en: Of course, establishing an internal energy market is not just a matter of policy.

zh: 欧盟需要正确的基础设施支持能源在国家和地区间的流动。
en: The EU needs the right infrastructure to facilitate the movement of energy among states and regions.

zh: 在这方面，欧洲有很多需要做的地方。
en: On this front, there is much to be done.

zh: 比如，西班牙目前只能将其发电产能的1.5%输送给欧洲其他地区，其原因是比力牛斯山区基础设施不足和法国不愿开放能源市场接受来自伊比利亚半岛的竞争。
en: Spain, for example, can currently transmit only 1.5% of its electricity-generating capacity to the rest of Europe, owing to a lack of transmission infrastructure in the Pyrenees and France’s reluctance to open its energy market to competition from the Iberian Peninsula.

zh: 欧洲理事会意识到这一问题的紧迫性，呼吁加强电力互联性，目标在2020年和2030年分别达到产能的10%和15 % ， 各国每发100百万瓦电力可以出口15百万瓦。
en: The European Council, recognizing the urgency of this issue, has called for greater electricity interconnection, targeting 10% of generating capacity by 2020 and 15% by 2030, with countries exporting 15 megawatts of power for every 100 megawatts they produce.

zh: 实现这些基准目标需要大规模资本投资和欧盟成员国思维的转变，以使类似于法国的担忧不再阻碍进展。
en: Achieving these benchmarks will require both significant capital investment and a shift in EU member states’ mentalities, so that fears like France’s do not continue to impede progress.

zh: 各国需要理解它们的公司不会因为短缺期间电力外流其他欧盟国家而受损，也不会因为价格升高而受损（因为目前正在日益着重于可再生能源 ） 。
en: Countries need to know that their companies will not suffer either from outflows of electricity to other EU countries during shortages, or from price increases, owing to the rising emphasis on renewables.

zh: 新兴的欧洲“能源联盟 ” （ 欧洲理事会支持这一联盟）能够成为这一转变的理想推动因素。
en: The emerging European “energy union,” which the Council has endorsed, could be the ideal vehicle to facilitate this shift.

zh: 问题在于欧盟领导人尚没有找到如何构建这一转变的令人信服又有效的战略。
en: The problem is that EU leaders have yet to define a compelling and effective strategy for building it.

zh: 事实上，尽管欧盟委员会主席容克已经设立了负责能源联盟的副主席职位 — — 目前的人选是舍甫科维奇（Maroš Šefčovič ） — —但没人知道该职位的具体职责。
en: Indeed, though European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker has established a vice-presidential post responsible for energy union – now held by Maroš Šefčovič – no one seems to know what exactly the position will entail.

zh: 目前舍甫科维奇只是为能源联盟提出了五个笼统的基本要点，这让许多人认为当前的政策方向有名无实。
en: So far, Šefčovič has merely presented five vague pillars for the energy union, leading many to consider the current policy approach to an energy union hollow.

zh: 欧盟需要明确的能源战略以助克服妨碍有效方案的信任赤字。
en: The EU needs a well-defined energy strategy that helps to overcome the trust deficit that is hampering effective solutions.

zh: 这首先意味着为能源联盟建立明确且可预测的共同规则和成本敏感型政策。
en: This means, first and foremost, establishing clear and predictable community rules and cost-sensitive policies for the energy union.

zh: 如此将有助于欧盟实现另一个关键目标：向世界其他地方展示一条更加团结的阵线。
en: Doing so would help the EU to achieve another critical goal: presenting a more united front to the rest of the world.

zh: 欧洲理事会的最新决议认识到了这一当务之急，新欧盟委员会结构也有利于政策凝聚性。
en: The Council’s recent conclusions recognize this imperative, and the new Commission structure is conducive to policy coherence.

zh: 成员国必须顺着这条线行动。
en: Member states must now fall into line.

zh: 明年的巴黎联合国气候变化会议（COP21）将是一场重要考验。
en: A major test will be next year’s United Nations climate change conference (COP21) in Paris.

zh: 2009年的哥本哈根会议是一场彻头彻尾的灾难，欧洲的“用榜样引导”方针没有吸引到追随者。
en: The 2009 conference in Copenhagen was an unmitigated disaster, as Europe’s “lead by example” approach failed to attract followers.

zh: 欧盟不能把再次自己孤立起来，也决不能再次误解起作用的地缘政治力量。
en: The EU cannot afford to isolate itself, or misunderstand the geopolitical forces at play, yet again.

zh: 幸运的是，欧洲理事会似乎已经消化了这一教训，打开了在COP21后重新考虑其承诺的可能性。
en: Fortunately, the Council seems to have internalized this lesson, leaving open the possibility of reconsidering its commitments after COP21.

zh: 但在此之前欧洲理事会已经做了很多，不但建立了统一的方针，还将在COP21上将该方针转化为强大的策略和明确的信号。
en: But it has a lot to do before then, not only to establish a unified approach, but also to translate that approach into strong tactics and a clear message at COP21.

zh: 成功将成为更广泛的欧盟能源日程的一个稳固基础。
en: Success would provide a strong foundation for the broader EU energy agenda.

zh: 如果欧盟想要解决能源安全、竞争性定价和可持续性等方面的关键挑战，就需要统一、全面和令人信服的政策方针。
en: If the EU is to address the key challenges of energy security, competitive pricing, and sustainability, it will need a unified, comprehensive, and compelling policy approach.

zh: 这一方针的基础 — — 内部能源市场、能源联盟框架和外部声音配合 — — 正在形成。
en: The foundations of such an approach – an internal energy market, the framework of an energy union, and a cohesive external voice – are emerging.

zh: 如今，欧洲需要再接再厉，落实这一方针。
en: Now Europe needs to follow through and make it work.

zh: 欧洲是和平的引擎
en: Europe, An Engine of Peace

zh: 欧洲货币一体化的评论家们通常指出，在缺乏政治一体化的条件下，货币一体化注定要失败。
en: Critics of European monetary integration often point out that, in the absence of political union, monetary union is doomed to fail.

zh: 我同意评论家们的结论，但却不能苟同他们的假定前提，因为目前为止，与单一货币的成功休戚相关的正是欧盟成员国的政治义务。
en: I agree with the critics’ conclusion, but not with their premise, for the success of the single currency so far has been due precisely to the political commitments of the Union’s member countries.

zh: 换而言之，欧盟确实组成了一个政治联盟。
en: In other words, it is not true that the European Union does not constitute a political union.

zh: 欧洲的经济一体化 — — 从所有方面来看 — — 都反映了将欧洲政治一体化的意愿，在我看来这至少暗示着欧洲的经济和货币一体化是不可扭转的。
en: European economic integration – in all its aspects – reflects the desire to integrate Europe politically, which, at least in my view, implies that European economic and monetary integration is irreversible.

zh: 自从1952年六国设立欧洲煤炭钢铁联合体(European Coal and Steel Community，简称ECSC)启动了欧洲一体化进程以来，这种不可扭转的趋势就一直保持着。
en: This has been true from the outset of the European integration process in 1952, when six countries established the European Coal and Steel Community (ECSC).

zh: ECSC的目的明显是具有政治性的：消除重型武器生产中所需的两种重要原材料的控制权，该控制权来自曾在史上最为血腥残忍的战争中相互斗争的国家。
en: The aim of the ECSC was explicitly political: to remove control of the two most important raw materials for the production of heavy weaponry from states that had just fought the bloodiest war in history.

zh: 这种无声无息的对和平的推动一直是欧洲经济进一步一体化的主要动力，而欧洲经济一体化被看作是达到政治一体化的一种手段。
en: This drive for peace remained, quietly, the key motivation behind further steps toward Europe’s economic integration, which was regarded as the vehicle for achieving political integration.

zh: 1951年，法国总理Rene Pléven提议设立一个与ECSC相近的欧洲防卫共同体（European Defense Community，简称EDC ） 。
en: In 1951, French Prime Minister Rene Pléven proposed establishing a European Defense Community (EDC) alongside the ECSC.

zh: 他没有成功，但是这个观点却保留了下来。
en: He failed, but the idea did not vanish.

zh: 同年末，罗布特·舒曼（Robert Schumann ） — —当时的法国外交部长兼欧洲一体化的奠基之父 — — 明确地用推动和平确定了ECSC。
en: Later that year, Robert Schumann – the French foreign minister at the time and a founding father of European integration – explicitly identified the ECSC with the drive for peace.

zh: 他将ECSC描述为“各种利益的融合 … … 它将成为一块酵母，在那些由于流血冲突长期彼此敌对的国家之间培养出一个更为广泛更为深入的共同体。 ”
en: He described it as a means for creating a “fusion of interests…that will be the leavening from which may grow a wider and deeper community between countries long opposed to one another by bloody conflicts.”

zh: 这些话在引进单一货币的当晚就获得了响应。
en: These words were echoed on the eve of the introduction of the single currency.

zh: 特别是在赫尔穆特·科尔（Helmut Kohl）总理带领下的德国通常将货币一体化与政治联盟的目的联系在一起。
en: In particular, Germany under Chancellor Helmut Kohl often linked monetary integration with the objective of political union.

zh: 科尔曾经将单一货币的成功看作一件和“战争与和平”同等重要的事情。
en: Kohl once referred to the single currency’s success as a matter of “war and peace.”

zh: 正是由于这个原因，我不同意那些认为德国对欧洲货币一体化的支持是他们为欧洲接受德国重新统一所付出的回报。
en: For this reason, I do not agree with those who argue that Germany’s support for European monetary integration was the price it paid for Europe’s acceptance of German reunification.

zh: 相反，历史记录表明，在铁幕落下之前，德国无论对货币一体化还是政治一体化都同样地致力于推动。
en: On the contrary, the historical record shows that Germany made the case for a parallel drive to monetary and political integration well before the fall of the Iron Curtain.

zh: 当然，在支持经济一体化的背后还有其他动力。
en: Of course, there are other motives behind support for economic integration.

zh: 欧盟领导人确信，达到所谓的四大自由 — — 即货物、服务、资金和人员流动自由 — — 将最优化欧洲人民的生活水平。
en: The EU’s leaders are convinced that achieving the so-called four freedoms – i.e., freedom of movement of goods, services, capital, and people – will optimize the well-being of Europe’s population.

zh: 他们也渴望着提高欧洲大陆的战略力量。
en: They also aspire to increase the Continent’s strategic power.

zh: 但是正如赫尔穆特·施密特（Helmut Schmidt）和德斯坦（Valérie Giscard d’Estaing）为单一货币和今天的欧洲中央银行打下基础时候一样，在欧洲一体化进程刚开始的时候，和平是舒曼（Schumann）和让·莫奈（Jean Monnet）这些人心中的主要动力。
en: But peace was the principal driving force in the minds of people like Schumann and Jean Monnet at the beginning of the European integration process, as it was for Helmut Schmidt and Valéry Giscard d’Estaing when they laid the foundations of the single currency and today’s European Central Bank.

zh: 半个世纪以来，欧洲一体化进程一直在进行之中 — — 有时候有挫折，有时候又向前一大步 — — 通过建立非常密切的贸易关系把以前四分五裂的市场联合起来。
en: For half a century, the process of European integration proceeded – sometimes with setbacks, sometimes with giant steps forward – joining formerly separate markets by creating very close trade relations.

zh: 随着时间的流逝，这刺激了前所未有的经济集中。
en: Over time, this stimulated ever-greater economic convergence.

zh: 当然，欧洲的各种经济体制还没有变成“相似者 ” ， 他们的人均GDP也没有完全平等。
en: Of course, Europe’s economies have not become “look-alikes,” nor has GDP per capita been fully equalized.

zh: 但是，欧洲各经济体制之间的差异还没有这么剧烈以至于对启动所有计划中最为艰巨的一项 — — 采取共同货币制 — — 形成一个难以逾越的障碍。
en: But the differences between Europe’s economies were never so dramatic as to form an insurmountable barrier to embarking upon the most ambitious project of all: adopting a common currency.

zh: 理解这段历史十分关键，因为欧盟再一次站在了一个新开端上：是否应该遵守诺言开始与土耳其进行成员国谈话？
en: Understanding this history is vital, because Europe’s Union once again stands at a threshold: should it keep its promise to start membership talks with Turkey?

zh: 随着欧盟宪法条约今年春天在法国和荷兰遭遇否决，许多人都说欧洲十年前的承诺不能够也不应该再去遵守了。
en: In the wake of the defeat of the EU’s Constitutional Treaty in France and the Netherlands this spring, many say that Europe’s decade-old promise cannot and should not be kept.

zh: 让我深感危险的是，和平问题 — — 这个从一开始就推动欧洲一体化的引擎 — — 在这些事件发生后的辩论中几乎不再出现了。
en: What strikes me as dangerous is that the issue of peace – the motor that has driven European integration from the start – rarely comes up in the debate about what to do in the wake of these events.

zh: 相反，恪尽职守的政治家和党派领导人已经公开对土耳其获得成员国资格表示反对。
en: On the contrary, responsible statesmen and party leaders have come out openly against Turkish membership.

zh: 我真希望这些人已经从舒曼和莫奈那里学会什么才是对欧洲和欧洲未来真正重要的，可惜，事情看来并非如此。
en: I would have hoped that these people had learned from Schumann and Monnet what really matters for Europe and its future; sadly, this does not seem to be the case.

zh: 当然，我不担心土耳其和欧盟之间会��生某些形式的军事冲突。
en: Of course, I do not fear some sort of military clash between Turkey and the EU.

zh: 毕竟，土耳其已经并一直是北约的忠实成员。
en: After all, Turkey has been and remains a loyal member of NATO.

zh: 但是一种越来越充满敌意的、伊斯兰教和人道主义、基督教和犹太教传统之间的文化冲突正在欧洲出现 — — 尤其在法国、德国、西班牙和荷兰。
en: But an increasingly virulent and violent clash of cultures is emerging in Europe – particularly in France, Germany, Spain, and the Netherlands – between Islam and the humanitarian, Christian, and Jewish traditions.

zh: 对我而言，欧洲将穆斯林土耳其一体化进它的政治联盟是舒曼和莫奈曾经成功克服的同一类和平问题。
en: For me, Europe’s integration of Muslim Turkey into its political union is the same sort of question of peace that Schumann and Monnet successfully confronted.

zh: 今天，欧洲需要文化之间的和平共处，正如它曾经需要国家之间的和平一样，并且正是由于这个原因我们必须欢迎土耳其加入到我们中来。
en: Today, Europe needs peace between cultures as much as it once needed peace between nations, and it is for this reason that we must welcome Turkey into our midst.

zh: 欧盟大胆的新战略
en: The EU’s Bold New Strategy

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 当各种问题像在欧洲一样累积时（英国退欧决策后接踵而来的是土耳其的政变失败 ） — —吸引人们注意力的往往是最近发生的问题。
en: BRUSSELS – When problems accumulate, as in Europe – where the failed coup in Turkey comes hard on the heels of the United Kingdom’s decision to leave the European Union – attention is often focused on the most recent issue to arise.

zh: 稍早发生的问题现在显得不那么紧迫，因此容易被人忽视。
en: Earlier problems, now seeming less urgent, are neglected.

zh: 多年以来，我们欧洲人对此早已见怪不怪：说到底，没有任何问题最终得到了解决。
en: For many years, we Europeans have seen how this plays out: in the end, none of the problems ever seems to be resolved.

zh: 土耳其政变现在看似正在自我解决，尽管对那个重要国家会产生什么样的长期影响还没有人能够确定。
en: The Turkish coup appears now to be resolving itself, though no one yet knows what long-term implications it will have for that vital country.

zh: 英国退欧毫无疑问切实打击了欧洲项目。
en: Brexit is, without doubt, a veritable blow to the European project.

zh: 一个成员国令人遗憾地选择独自前行，但这并不一定会令欧洲陷入到破坏性最强的瘫痪境地。
en: A member state has regrettably chosen to move ahead alone. But this mustn’t lead the EU into the most damaging situation of all: paralysis.

zh: 欧盟必须解决的诸多问题不会只随时间的流逝而消失。
en: The many issues that the Union must still resolve won’t disappear merely with the passage of time.

zh: 欧洲安全是最紧迫的问题之一：没有采取联合行动的每一天都将失去一次机会，并且意味着更大的风险来临。
en: And one of the most urgent is Europe’s security: each day that passes without taking joint action is an opportunity lost and leads to greater risk.

zh: 有效解决上述问题，而不是落入眼前的陷阱，需要对既定策略的坚持。
en: Addressing such issues effectively, rather than falling into the trap of the immediate, requires adhering to accepted strategies.

zh: 既定策略能够找出问题、确定长期目标并设计实现这些目标的集体行动，以及提供必要的方案框架以连贯和更有远见的方式来解决问题。
en: By identifying challenges, establishing long-term objectives, and designing collective action to achieve those objectives, strategies provide a framework for initiatives to address problems in a more far-sighted, coherent way.

zh: 本着这样的理念，欧盟外交事务高级代表费代丽卡·莫盖里尼及其团队已经设计并提出了一套欧洲安全全球战略，战略明确指出了适合欧盟内外形势的目的。
en: With this in mind, Federica Mogherini, the EU’s high representative for foreign affairs, and her team have designed and presented a Global Strategy for European security that has clearly defined aims befitting conditions both within and beyond our borders.

zh: 许多观察家均已提出现在并不是拟定一项假设所有欧洲人都团结在共同利益周围愿景的最好时机。
en: Many observers have indicated that now is not the best time to elaborate a vision that assumes that all Europeans are united by common interests.

zh: 但就像战略所明确宣布的那样，合作已经从原则性问题上升到生存的必须。
en: But, as the strategy clearly declares, cooperation is no longer a question of principle; it is an existential imperative.

zh: 因此那些说全球战略生不逢时、甚至毫无用处的见解恕我不能同意。
en: That is why I disagree with those who call the Global Strategy ill-timed and even useless.

zh: 虽然全球战略在英国退欧公投后一周才提交给欧洲理事会，但其目标是要在《里斯本条约》生效7年后真正落实条约所设定的规则。
en: Even though it was presented to the European Council a week after the Brexit referendum, its aim is to implement the provisions foreseen in the Treaty of Lisbon, seven years after the treaty entered into effect.

zh: 全球战略也是2015年6月欧洲理事会本身命令的结果。
en: It is also the result of a June 2015 mandate from the European Council itself.

zh: 其目的是像很多民众所希望的那样制定一项强化欧盟的政策。
en: And it aims to develop a policy to strengthen the EU, which many citizens want.

zh: 坐失良机会犯下严重的错误。
en: To remain immobile would have been a grave error.

zh: 全球战略制定了明确目标、吸取了过去错误的教训并深深植根于欧盟当今的现实。
en: The Global Strategy defines clear objectives, considers the mistakes of the past, and is deeply anchored in the EU’s present-day reality.

zh: 它呼吁建立更负责任、更团结可靠的欧盟 — — 只有采取这样的对策才能克服欧洲怀疑主义。
en: It calls for a more responsible, united, and credible EU – the only response capable of overcoming Euroskepticism.

zh: 全球战略明确了欧盟必须采取的行动，以及巩固国防及安全必须具备的能力。
en: It defines the actions Europe must take and the capacities it must have for its own defense and security.

zh: 全球战略认真思考了其行动的长期影响，并认识到欧盟成员国的发展是预防冲突的关键问题。
en: It takes into account the long-term effects of its actions and understands that the development of the EU’s member states is essential to conflict prevention.

zh: 全球战略认识到要想应对恐怖主义、移民和气候变化的挑战，欧洲只有加强团结。
en: And it recognizes that only greater unity will enable Europe to confront the challenges of terrorism, migration, and climate change.

zh: 评估全球战略有效性的时候必须牢记一个基本的事实：并不是因为某些协议或政府间共识的规定才有了共同的欧洲安全威胁。
en: A fundamental fact should be borne in mind when assessing the Global Strategy’s usefulness: The threats to Europe’s security are not common because some treaty or intergovernmental consensus has said so.

zh: 我们面临着共同的威胁是因为我们是邻国，而且不管愿意与否，我们都生活在一个无可救药的全球化的世界。
en: They are common because we are neighbors, and because, like it or not, the world around us is irremediably global.

zh: 全球战略文件的结果之一是创造一种共同的话题。
en: One consequence of a document like the Global Strategy is the creation of a common discourse.

zh: 2003年，欧洲人同样需要共同的外交政策，以克服伊拉克干预行动所造成的分歧。
en: In 2003, Europeans also needed to unite behind a common foreign policy, following the differences created by the intervention in Iraq.

zh: 但今天的问题处在一个完全不同的层面：欧洲项目本身正在遭到质疑。
en: But the problem today is on a very different level: the European project itself is being questioned.

zh: 显示出欧洲具备采取有效行动的能力将有助于肯定其存在的必要性。
en: Revealing the EU’s capacity to act effectively would help to confirm the necessity of its existence.

zh: 全球战略的作用恰恰在这里。
en: The Global Strategy can be useful here.

zh: 欧洲民众认为恐怖主义和难民悲剧等问题至关重要，因此希望欧盟能发挥更大作用解决恐怖、移民和其他全球问题。
en: European citizens perceive terrorism and the refugee tragedy as questions of vital importance and want the EU to play a greater role in addressing them and other global issues.

zh: 在欧洲十国（包括像英国、波兰和匈牙利等所谓欧洲怀疑论的堡垒）所进行的皮尤研究中心调查发现，74%的受调查者支持欧盟在海外采取更加果断的行动。
en: A Pew Research Center study in ten European countries (including supposed bastions of Euroskepticism like the UK, Poland, and Hungary) found that an average of 74% of those polled supported more decisive action by the EU abroad.

zh: 近年来，我们亲眼目睹了国内外局势的密切联系。
en: In recent years, we have seen how internal and external security conditions are closely linked.

zh: 正因如此，全球战略强调有必要采取更多更好的外部行动以维护内部安全利益。
en: That is why, in the interest of safeguarding internal security, the Global Strategy emphasizes the need for more and improved external action.

zh: 欧盟也因此需要充分利用所有工具和政策的整体方案来应对冲突和危机。
