en: It is also why the EU requires an integral approach to conflicts and crises that uses every available instrument and policy.

zh: 不仅如此，我们身为欧洲人的形象取决于我们采取外部行动的方式。
en: Moreover, the manner in which we conduct external action characterizes us as Europeans.

zh: 在人类安全��域，鲜有机构能像欧盟一样整合警察或法官等军民元素完整地部署行动和任务。
en: In the field of human security, few organizations can deploy missions and operations as complete as the EU’s, combining military and civilian elements, such as police or judges.

zh: 2003年欧洲安全战略出台后形势发生了很大变化：欧洲现在必须在大国竞争中找到自己的位置并谈判东南侧翼的冲突和动荡问题。
en: Much has changed since the European Security Strategy of 2003: Europe must now find its place amid the competition of great powers and negotiate the conflicts and instability on its eastern and southern flanks.

zh: 欧洲内部也发生了重要变化，英国退欧公投和维谢格拉德集团（捷克共和国、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克）最近的立场表明，越来越多人反对欧盟加强自身实力。
en: There have been important changes within Europe as well, and opposition to strengthening the EU seems to be on the rise, as evidenced by the Brexit vote and the position recently expressed by the Visegrad Group (the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, and Slovakia).

zh: 借提出全球战略之机，那些赞成推进欧洲项目的人公开提出了自己的建议。
en: With the presentation of the Global Strategy, those in favor of moving the European project forward have placed an initiative on the table.

zh: 如果没有全球战略，人们只能听见反对欧洲扩张的声音。
en: Without it, only proposals for less Europe would have been heard.

zh: 未来几个月，我们必须推进外交和安全政策以落实战略目的。
en: Over the coming months, we must move our foreign and security policy forward, in order to implement the strategy’s objectives.

zh: 我们这些希望欧洲继续前进的人不能沉默不语。
en: Those of us who are in favor of continuing to advance cannot remain silent.

zh: 欧元区的三个前途
en: Three Ways Ahead for the Eurozone

zh: 华盛顿—在经历了动荡的一年后，欧洲政坛似乎开始稳定下来。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – After a tumultuous year, politics seem to be stabilizing across Europe.

zh: 尽管极右翼的德国另类选择党（AfD）在最近的德国联邦选举中赢得近13%的选票，但并未给总理默克尔的领导权造成严重威胁。
en: Though the far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) gained almost 13% of the vote in Germany’s recent federal election, it does not pose a serious threat to Chancellor Angela Merkel’s leadership.

zh: 在欧洲工程的另一个支柱法国，总统马克龙能够倚赖坚强的议会多数。
en: In France – the other pillar of the European project – President Emmanuel Macron can count on a solid parliamentary majority.

zh: 而尽管围绕英国退欧的细节还存在很多不确定性，但几乎没有人怀疑，不论欧盟采取什么计划，英国都不再是其中一分子。
en: And, despite the uncertainty surrounding the details of Brexit, there is little doubt that, whatever plans the European Union makes, it will be doing so without the United Kingdom as a member.

zh: 因此，现在的问题是，欧盟，尤其是欧元区，会如何前进。
en: So now the question is how the EU and, in particular, the eurozone, will move forward.

zh: 有三种可能。
en: There are three possibilities.

zh: 第一个选择是欧盟委员会主席容克在上个月的盟情咨文中所描述的“更加统一的联盟 ” 。
en: The first option is a “more united union,” as described by European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker in his state of the union address last month.

zh: 容克的愿景拒绝了多速的欧洲，支持欧盟所有成员齐头并进。
en: Juncker’s vision rejects a multi-speed Europe, in favor of uniform steps by all EU members.

zh: 这首先意味着扩大跨境自由的申根区，将保加利亚和罗马尼亚也包括进来。
en: This would mean, for starters, expanding the Schengen Area of border-free travel to include Bulgaria and Romania.

zh: 容克还呼吁建立一个欧洲社会标准联盟（European Social Standards Union ） ， 就单一市场的福利权益形成统一的认识。
en: Juncker also called for progress toward a European Social Standards Union embodying a shared understanding of welfare entitlement in the single market.

zh: 对于欧元，容克强调它要成为整个欧盟的货币，而不仅仅是一部分国家的货币。
en: As for the euro, Juncker stressed that it is meant to be the currency of the entire EU, not just select countries.

zh: 据此，欧盟应该追求建立一个全面的银行联盟，其中，各成员国的银行规则和监督要统一起来。
en: With that in mind, the EU should pursue the creation of a full banking union, in which banking rules and supervision are consistent across all member states.

zh: 经济和金融事务委员应该成为欧洲财政部长，而欧洲稳定机制（European Stabilization Mechanism）应该成为欧洲货币基金（European Monetary Fund ） 。
en: The commissioner for economic and financial affairs should become a European finance minister, and the European Stabilization Mechanism should become the European Monetary Fund.

zh: 一年前，如此“强硬”的一体化根本毫无可信度可言；毕竟，英国绝不会支持它。
en: A year ago, such “hardline” integrationism would have lacked credibility; after all, the UK would never stand for it.

zh: 但如今，英国退欧已是板上钉钉，容克的愿景也有了一些可信度。
en: But, with Brexit apparently a sure thing, Juncker’s vision has gained some credibility.

zh: 尽管如此，容克的“单速”一体化方针仍然饱受争议。
en: Nonetheless, Juncker’s “one-speed” approach to integration remains highly controversial.

zh: 因此，马克龙也抛出了他自己的宏大愿景，其中不少与容克的方案遥相呼应，但马克龙的方案允许欧盟内部存在差异，至少在中期是如此。
en: So Macron has set out his own ambitious vision for Europe, which echoes many of Juncker’s proposals, but seems to allow for more differentiation within the EU, at least in the medium term.

zh: 比如，如果波兰不想采用欧元，就不应该强迫它这样做，并且这一决定也不应该妨碍其他欧元区国家继续迈向一体化。
en: For example, if Poland does not want to adopt the euro, it should not be forced to do so, and that decision should not prevent other eurozone countries from moving ahead with integration.

zh: 因此，马克龙希望建立一个单独的欧元区议会，由它来决定不适用于欧洲议会全体成员的事务。
en: That is why Macron wants a separate eurozone parliament, which would decide on matters that do not pertain to all members of the European Parliament.

zh: 各国所追求的一体化程度的不同不应该妨碍任何国家 — — 或每一个国家 — — 最终加入欧盟深度一体化的“核心 ” 。
en: Differences in the level of integration countries pursued today would not prevent anyone – or everyone – from eventually joining the EU’s deeply integrated “core.”

zh: 欧元区的第三种 — — 似乎也是最有可能的一种 — — 前途是一切照旧。
en: The third – and, it seems, most likely – way forward for the eurozone is business as usual.

zh: 引起加强一体化 — — 有时是更加分裂 — — 的呼声的经济危机已经过去了，目前欧元区GDP增长率超过2 % ， 失业也大幅减少。
en: The economic crisis that long powered calls for more integration – and, in some cases, for more fragmentation – has subsided, with eurozone GDP growth now exceeding 2% and unemployment having declined significantly.

zh: 甚至是希腊 — — 从某种程度讲，它是唯一一个仍陷在危机模式中的国家 — — 也一直能够勉强维持。
en: Even Greece – the one country that remains, to some extent, in crisis mode – continues to muddle through.

zh: 在这样的环境下，决策者很可能会如同此前多次发生过的那样，将宏大的欧元区改革计划往后推，认为危机期间所采取的改革已经足够。
en: In this context, policymakers may well decide, as they have so many times before, to put ambitious eurozone reforms on the back burner, deciding that the reforms pursued during the crisis are sufficient.

zh: 这让他们有更大的空间关注其他领域 — — 如能源、数字监管和移民等 — — 从当前的情况看，这些领域更加需要紧急关注。
en: This would leave them more space to focus on other areas – such as energy, digital regulation, and migration – that in the current context may appear to require more urgent attention.

zh: 如果决策者真的按照这条路走，将带来严重的风险。
en: If policymakers do go this route, there are serious risks.

zh: 承让，目前欧元区运转良好，而其他领域的关键性改革也确实很重要。
en: Yes, the eurozone is now functioning, and key reforms in other areas are important.

zh: 但货币联盟仍然有一个根本性缺陷：其成员国失去了用汇率进行调整的能力，同时又没有一个能够阻止国家间成本分化的机制。
en: But the monetary union retains a fundamental flaw: the absence of mechanisms capable of forestalling cost divergences across countries that have lost the ability to engage in exchange-rate adjustment.

zh: 一种机制是加强服务业劳动力流动性。
en: One such mechanism would be more labor mobility in services.

zh: 但即使欧元区国家统一进一步实施劳动力市场自由化，工人们也将面临很高的文化和语言壁垒。
en: But even if eurozone countries agreed to further labor-market liberalization, workers would face high cultural and linguistic barriers.

zh: 无论如何，如果不存在任何这样的机制，最终导致上一次经济危机的趋势，很有可能还会导致新的危机。
en: In any case, without any such mechanism, the trends that culminated in the last economic crisis could well lead to another.

zh: 在经历了危机之后，如果未来出现成本分化加剧的信号，欧元区国家间的利率差异将比上一次危机中更快地扩大，这将是一个早期警告信号。
en: After the experience of the crisis, if signs of growing cost divergences begin to emerge in the future, interest-rate differentials among eurozone countries will rise much faster than they did before the last crisis, providing an earlier warning signal.

zh: 尽管如此，由于仍然累积着大量债务并且大量救援资金已经消耗掉，新的冲击可能带来灾难性后果。
en: Yet, given that much of the debt overhang remains and much of the rescue ammunition has been spent, another shock could be devastating.

zh: 据马丁·沃尔夫（Martin Wolf）报道，经济学家亚当·雷里克（Adam Lerrick）提出了一种机制，让利息差异突然变化的受益人将所得收益转入一个“融资成本稳定账户 ” ， 当利率冲击消退后返回。
en: As Martin Wolf reports, the economist Adam Lerrick proposes a scheme whereby the beneficiaries of sudden changes in interest-rate differentials would transfer half their gains into a “financing cost stabilization account,” to be paid back when the interest-rate shock subsides.

zh: 但是，和其他欧元区改革一样，这一机制需要欧元区成员国之间达成一致。
en: But, like other eurozone reforms, such a scheme would have to be agreed among eurozone members.

zh: 默克尔仍然在组建新的联合政府，因此，现在无法确认欧洲会在未来几年采取怎样的一体化方针。
en: With Merkel still forming her new coalition government, it is impossible to say for certain what approach to integration Europe will take in the coming years.

zh: 但她的执政联盟将包括疑欧派的自由民主党和支持一体化的绿党，而她本人的基督教民主党介于两者之间，因此，大踏步追求宏大的全欧盟一体化的目标可能性很低。
en: But, given the likelihood that her coalition will include the Euroskeptic Free Democrats and the pro-integration Greens, with her own Christian Democrats in between, rapid pursuit of ambitious integration objectives for the entire EU seems unlikely.

zh: 一个更加现实的选择是多速方案，欧元区国家能够继续前进，其他国家可以等一等。
en: A more realistic option is a multi-speed effort whereby the eurozone countries can move ahead, while others are allowed to wait.

zh: 结果不会完美，但要比现状更好 — — 好得多。
en: The outcome would not be perfect, but it would be better – much better – than the status quo.

zh: 欧洲化欧洲
en: Europeanizing Europe

zh: 柏林 — — 欧元区已成为全球金融危机的中心，因为在欧元区 — — 仅次于美元的第二大货币使用区 — — 危机击中的是软弱的“结构”而不是拥有真实力量的国家。
en: BERLIN – The eurozone is at the center of the global financial crisis, because only there, in the realm of the second most important currency after the dollar, does the crisis hit a weak “structure” rather than a state with real power.

zh: 这一结构挥霍公民和市场对其解决冲突的能力的信任，还把国际金融体系推向了灾难边缘。
en: It is a structure that is squandering the trust of citizens and markets in its ability to resolve conflicts – while pushing the international financial system to the brink of disaster.

zh: 换句话说，眼下，金融危机反映了欧元区的政治危机，一场让人质疑欧洲计划存在的合理性的危机。
en: In other words, the financial crisis now reflects a political crisis of the eurozone – one that calls into question the very existence of the European project as a whole.

zh: 如果欧洲货币联盟崩溃，那么所谓的共同市场以及欧洲机构和条约都不会得到保留。
en: If Europe’s monetary union fails, not much of the common market, or of European institutions and treaties, will be left.

zh: 欧洲一体化进程60年的成就将一笔勾销，留给人们的将是充满不确定的未来。
en: We would have to write off six decades of successful European integration, with unknown consequences.

zh: 这样的失败将伴随世界新秩序的出现，两个世纪以来的西方主导模式将寿终正寝。
en: This failure would coincide with the emergence of a new world order, as two centuries of Western predominance come to an end.

zh: 权力和财富正在向东亚和其他新兴市场国家转移，美国将忙于处置自己的问题，并将重心从大西洋转向太平洋。
en: Power and wealth are shifting towards East Asian and other emerging countries, while America will be preoccupied with its own problems and turning from the Atlantic towards the Pacific.

zh: 如果欧洲人现在不能维护好自己的利益，那么没有人会帮他们完成这一任务。
en: If Europeans don’t address their interests now, no one will do it for them.

zh: 如果欧洲现在不能成为自身命运的代言人，那么它将沦为新势力的目标。
en: If Europe today does not become the agent of its own destiny, it will become the object of new world powers.

zh: 造成欧洲危机的原因并非30年来的新自由主义，也不是投机活动越吹越大的资产泡沫的崩溃、对马斯特里赫特条约的违反、日渐膨胀的债务或是贪婪的银行。
en: The cause of the European crisis is not three decades of neo-liberalism. Nor is it the result of the collapse of a speculation-fueled asset bubble, the violation of the Maastricht criteria, ballooning debt, or greedy banks.

zh: 与这些因素同样重要的是，欧洲的问题并不在已发生的事情，而在于未曾发生的事情 — — 成立共同的欧洲政府。
en: As important as all of these factors are, Europe’s problem is not what happened, but what did not happen: the creation of a common European government.

zh: 20世纪90年代初，欧盟多数成员国决定成立一个货币联盟，使用共同货币，由一家央行管理，但成立中央政府的思想并没有得到支持。
en: At the beginning of the 1990’s, when the majority of the European Union’s member states decided to form a monetary union with a common currency and a central bank, the idea of a central government lacked support.

zh: 结果，货币联盟建设的这一阶段被中止了，虽然建成了一幢耀眼的大厦，其根基却并不牢固，不足以在危机爆发时保证稳定性。
en: As a result, that phase of the monetary union’s construction was postponed, leaving an impressive edifice that lacked a strong foundation to ensure stability in times of crisis.

zh: 货币主权成为了欧洲的共同事业，但执行它所需要的权力依然掌握在各国手中。
en: Monetary sovereignty was made a common cause; but the power needed to exercise it remained in national capitals.

zh: 当时，人们相信，形式化的规则 — — 设置关于赤字、债务和通胀的强制性限制 — — 已经足够了。
en: It was believed at the time that formalized rules – imposing mandatory limits on deficits, debt, and inflation – would be enough.

zh: 但这一规则的基础本身被证明只是一场幻觉：原则从来都需要权力的支持，否则无法经受现实的考验。
en: But this foundation of rules turned out to be an illusion: principles always need the support of power; otherwise they cannot stand the test of reality.

zh: 而如今，欧元区作为一个采用共同货币和共同原则及机制的主权国家联合体在现实的考验中失败了。
en: The eurozone, a confederation of sovereign states with a common currency and common principles and mechanisms, is now failing that test.

zh: 欧元区没能对危机作出决定性的反应，因此失去了比黄金还要宝贵的信心。
en: Unable to respond decisively to a crisis, the eurozone is losing the confidence that is any currency’s most important asset.

zh: 除非欧洲的政治权力也得到欧洲化，让现在的联合体进化为联邦，否则欧元区 — — 以及整个欧盟 — — 将分崩离析。
en: Unless political power in Europe is Europeanized, with the current confederation evolving into a federation, the eurozone – and the EU as a whole – will disintegrate.

zh: 再度国家化将导致巨大的政治、经济和财政成本；欧盟的瓦解足以让全世界产生恐慌。
en: The political, economic, and financial costs of renationalization would be enormous; an EU collapse is feared around the world for good reason.

zh: 相反，如果货币联盟的政治赤字能够现在就解决掉 — — 第一步是成立财政联盟（共同预算和共同债务 ） — —那么建立真正的政治联邦仍有可能。
en: By contrast, if the currency union’s political deficit is addressed now, first by establishing a fiscal union (a common budget and common liabilities), a real political federation will be possible.

zh: 我们要认清形势：唯有欧罗巴合众国才有防止迫在眉睫的灾难的力量。
en: And let us be clear: anything less than a United States of Europe will not be powerful enough to prevent the looming disaster.

zh: 不管你愿不愿意承认，欧元区是欧盟的前哨，因为拥有27个成员国的欧盟既没有意愿，也没有能力加快政治统一日程。
en: Like it or not, the eurozone will have to act as the EU’s avant-garde, because the EU as a whole, with its 27 member states, will be neither willing nor able to accelerate political unification.

zh: 不幸的是，没有人可以保证对欧盟条约进行必要修改的建议能获得一致通过。
en: Unfortunately, unanimous support for the necessary EU treaty changes simply could not be secured.

zh: 那么，我们应该做些什么？
en: So, what should be done?

zh: 欧洲曾签署过所谓的申根协议（如今是欧盟条约的一部分 ） ， 开放边境，这是在欧盟条约之外（但仍带有鲜明的欧洲精神烙印）迈出的具决定性意义的统一步骤。
en: Europeans made decisive progress on integration outside the scope of the EU treaties (but very much in the European spirit) when they agreed to open their borders with the so-called Schengen Agreement (today a part of the EU treaties).

zh: 从这一成功先例看，欧元区应该避免欧盟建立缺乏民主合法化基础的超国家结构的原罪。
en: Drawing on that successful experience, the eurozone should avoid the EU’s original sin of creating a supra-national structure that lacked democratic legitimization.

zh: 欧元区需要一个政府，从目前的情况看，这个政府可以仅由各国政府首脑组成 — — 此步骤已经开始了。
en: The eurozone needs a government, which, as things stand at the moment, can consist only of the respective heads of state and government – a development that has already started.

zh: 此外，由于财政联盟不可能在没有共同预算政策的情况下产生，因此不通过各国议会，什么事情都决定不了。
en: And, because there can be no fiscal union without a common budget policy, nothing can be decided without the national parliaments.

zh: 这意味着由各国议会首脑组成的“欧洲议事厅 ” （ European Chamber）也是必不可少的。
en: This means that a “European Chamber,” comprising national parliaments’ leaders, is indispensable.

zh: 欧洲议事厅可以先以咨询机构的形式存在，各国议会依然保有各自职能。 然后，在共同政府条约的基础上，欧洲议事厅必须成为名副其实的议会控制和决策机构，由各国议会代表成员组成。
en: Initially, such a chamber could be an advisory body, with the national parliaments maintaining their competencies; later, on the basis of an intergovernmental treaty, it must become a real parliamentary control and decision-making body, made up of national parliaments’ delegated members.

zh: 当然，由于此类条约意味着主权向欧洲共同政府机构的大规模转移，因此需要通过所有成员国（特别是德国）公投实现直接的、广受人民支持的合法化。
en: Of course, because a treaty of this kind would mean extensive transfer of sovereignty to European intergovernmental institutions, it would need direct popular legitimization through referendums in all member states, including (and especially) Germany.

zh: 所有这些都无法解决重要问题，比如确保经济稳定和刺激增长的共同政策。
en: None of this addresses important questions, such as common policies to ensure economic stability and promote growth.

zh: 但是，如果说我们能够从当前危机汲取什么教训的话，那就是，除非欧元区拥有一个以实际政府、有效议会控制和真正民主合法化为基础的可靠的制度性框架，否则这些问题甚至连如何界定都无法实现。
en: But, if we have learned anything from the current crisis, it is that such issues cannot even be framed unless and until the eurozone has a reliable institutional framework, with a sturdy foundation consisting of a real government, effective parliamentary control, and genuine democratic legitimization.

zh: 战争中的欧洲
en: Europe at War

zh: 纽约—2014年入侵乌克兰意味着俄罗斯总统普京对作为欧盟成立基础的价值和原则以及对自1945年以来保持欧洲和平的基于规则的体系进行了根本挑战。
en: NEW YORK – By invading Ukraine in 2014, President Vladimir Putin’s Russia has posed a fundamental challenge to the values and principles on which the European Union was founded, and to the rules-based system that has kept the peace in Europe since 1945.

zh: 欧洲领导人和欧洲人民都没有充分认识到这一挑战的规模，更不用说如何应对这一挑战了。
en: Neither Europe’s leaders nor its citizens are fully aware of the scope of this challenge, much less how to deal with it.

zh: 普京政权基于武力统治，这一点可以从其国内镇压和国外侵略中看出。
en: Putin’s regime is based on rule by force, manifested in repression at home and aggression abroad.

zh: 但它至少在短期成功地赢得了相对欧盟和美国的战术性优势，后两者决意避免直接军事冲突。
en: But it has been able to gain a tactical advantage, at least in the short term, over the EU and the United States, which are determined to avoid direct military confrontation.

zh: 俄罗斯违反条约义务，吞并了克里米亚并在东乌克兰的顿巴斯地区建立分裂主义飞地。
en: Violating its treaty obligations, Russia annexed Crimea and established separatist enclaves in eastern Ukraine’s Donbas region.

zh: 去年夏天，在乌克兰政府似乎可以赢得顿巴斯战争时，普京下令俄罗斯正规武装力量入侵。
en: When it appeared last summer that the Ukrainian government might win the war in Donbas, Putin ordered an invasion by regular Russian armed forces.

zh: 第二轮军事活动在11月开始准备，此时，普京还为分裂主义者提供新的装甲装装备和人手。
en: Preparations for a second wave of military action began in November, when Putin provided separatists with a new influx of armored columns and personnel.

zh: 不幸的是，西方给予饱受战乱的乌克兰的只有象征性的支持。
en: The West, sadly, has provided embattled Ukraine with only a façade of support.

zh: 同样令人不安的是国际领导人一直不愿给予乌克兰新的金融承诺，尽管其外汇储备压力日增，大有爆发全面金融崩溃之势。
en: Equally disturbing has been the continuing reluctance of international leaders to provide new financial commitments to Ukraine, despite growing pressure on its foreign-currency reserves and the specter of a full-blown financial meltdown.

zh: 结果，仅仅是军事行动的威胁就有可能足以让乌克兰经济崩溃。
en: As a result, the mere threat of military action may be sufficient to bring about Ukraine’s economic collapse.

zh: 普京似乎假装抛出大妥协的前景，俄罗斯帮助打击伊斯兰国 — — 比如不向叙利亚提供S300导弹（从而保证美国的制空权 ） — —以换取美国让俄罗斯控制其所谓的“近邻 ” 。
en: Putin seems to be holding out the prospect of a grand bargain, with Russia helping in the fight against the Islamic State – for example, by not supplying S300 missiles to Syria (thus preserving US air domination) – in exchange for the US giving Russia control over its so-called “near abroad.”

zh: 美国总统奥巴马接受这一交易的话，整个国际关系结构就将大大偏向于使用武力。
en: Should US President Barack Obama accept such a deal, the entire structure of international relations would be dangerously altered in favor of the use of force.

zh: 这将是一个悲惨的错误，带来深远的地缘政治后果。
en: That would be a tragic mistake, with far-reaching geopolitical consequences.

zh: 乌克兰的崩溃将是北约的惨重损失，并且间接剧烈影响到欧盟和美国。
en: The collapse of Ukraine would be a tremendous loss for NATO and indirectly for the EU and the US.

zh: 胜利的俄罗斯将给存在大量俄罗斯族人口的巴尔干国家形成严重威胁。
en: A victorious Russia would pose a potent threat to the Baltic states, with their large ethnic Russian populations.

zh: 北约不再能够支持乌克兰，反而必须在自己的土壤上自卫，使欧盟和美国都暴露在你它们急切地想要避免的风险之下：与俄罗斯发生直接军事冲突。
en: Instead of supporting Ukraine, NATO would have to defend itself on its own soil, exposing both the EU and the US to the danger they have been so eager to avoid: direct military confrontation with Russia.

zh: 欧盟政治凝聚力风险甚至比军事风险还要大。
en: The threat to the EU’s political cohesion is even greater than the military risk.

zh: 欧元危机已将一个由平等主权国家自愿牺牲一定独立性以追求共同利益而形成的无比紧密的联盟转变为一个由债权国和债务国组成的联合体，债务国为了满足债权国的条件而焦头烂额。
en: The euro crisis has transformed an ever-closer union of equal sovereign states, willingly sacrificing a share of their independence for the common good, into an association of creditor and debtor countries, with the debtors struggling to meet the creditors’ terms.

zh: 这一新欧盟既不平等，亦非自愿。
en: This new EU is neither equal nor voluntary.

zh: 事实上，对许多债务国年轻人来说，欧盟就像是一个外国压迫者。
en: In fact, for many young people in the debtor countries, the EU seems like a foreign oppressor.

zh: 大约30%的新当选欧洲议会由反欧盟政党占多数。
en: And about 30% of the recently elected European Parliament ran on anti-European platforms.

zh: 这一内在软弱性导致普京的俄罗斯 — — 其本身吸引力也相当弱 — — 成为欧盟的劲敌。
en: It is this internal weakness that has allowed Putin’s Russia – which, on its own, is far from attractive – to emerge as a potent rival to the EU.

zh: 匈牙利总理奥班居然将普京引为榜样 — — 并且这样做算不上异类。
en: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has gone so far as to cite Putin as his role model – and he is no anomaly.

zh: 欧洲的领导人和公民都没有认识到俄罗斯袭击乌克兰是对欧盟及其治理原则的间接打击。
en: Neither Europe’s leaders nor its citizens seem to recognize that Russia’s attack on Ukraine is indirectly an assault on the EU and its principles of governance.

zh: 必须明确，对于一国或一个国家联盟，在战时还追求财政紧缩是不合适的，而欧盟一直在这样做。
en: It should be clear that it is inappropriate for a country, or association of countries, at war to pursue fiscal austerity, as the EU continues to do.

zh: 所有的可用资源都应该用于战争用途，即使这需要增加预算赤字。
en: All available resources should be put to work in the war effort, even if that requires running up budget deficits.

zh: 欧洲是幸运的，德国总理默克尔在面对俄罗斯的威胁时表现得像一个真正的欧洲人。
en: Europe is fortunate that German Chancellor Angela Merkel has behaved as a true European with regard to the threat posed by Russia.

zh: 她是最坚定的制裁支持者，比其他领导人都更愿意在这个问题上否定德国的公众意见和商业利益。
en: The foremost advocate of sanctions, she has been more willing to defy German public opinion and business interests on the issue than on any other.

zh: 但德国也是财政紧缩的主要支持者，默克尔需要明白这些立场中的矛盾。
en: But Germany has also been the main advocate of fiscal austerity, and Merkel needs to understand the contradiction between these positions.

zh: 针对俄罗斯的制裁是必不可少的，但也不是没有副作用。
en: Sanctions against Russia are necessary, but they are not without repercussions.

zh: 欧洲经济体（包括德国）正在蒙受损失，因为制裁的抑制效应放大了已经起作用的衰退和通缩力量。
en: European economies, including Germany, are suffering, as the sanctions’ depressive impact aggravates the recessionary and deflationary forces that are already at work.

zh: 相反，帮助面临俄罗斯入侵的乌克兰自卫能给乌克兰和欧洲带来刺激效应。
en: By contrast, helping Ukraine to defend itself against Russian aggression would have a stimulative effect on Ukraine and Europe.

zh: 欧盟成员国陷入了战争 — — 它们必须开始这样行动。
en: The EU’s members are at war – and they need to start acting like it.

zh: 这意味着丢掉财政紧缩承诺、认识到帮助乌克兰自卫比希望他们不必捍卫欧盟本身更好。
en: That means modifying their commitment to fiscal austerity and recognizing that they are better off helping Ukraine to defend itself than hoping that they will not have to defend the EU themselves.

zh: 乌克兰需要立刻注入现金，比如200亿美元，并许以需要时还能追加的承诺，以避免金融崩溃。
en: Ukraine needs an immediate cash injection of, say, $20 billion, with a promise of more when needed, in order to stave off a financial collapse.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）可以像往常那样提供这笔资金，并由欧盟承诺匹配IMF的贡献。
en: The International Monetary Fund could provide these funds, as it did previously, with the EU promising to match the IMF’s contribution.

zh: 实际支出仍有IMF控制，并根据意义深远的结构性改革的实施情况进行。
en: Actual expenditures would remain under the IMF’s control and subject to the implementation of far-reaching structural reforms.

zh: 在乌克兰，还有一个因素有利于欧盟：该国新领导层决心纠正前任政府的腐败、管理不善和滥用职权。
en: In Ukraine, there is one more factor working in the EU’s favor: the country’s new leadership is determined to correct previous governments’ corruption, mismanagement, and abuses.

zh: 事实上，它已经制定了一个详细战略将家庭天然气消费降低一大半，计划拆分腐败的天然气垄断商国家天然气公司并摆脱对俄罗斯的能源依赖。
en: Indeed, it has already created a detailed strategy to cut household gas consumption by more than half, with the goal of dispersing the corrupt gas monopoly of Naftogaz and ending Ukraine’s energy dependence on Russia.

zh: “新乌克兰”将坚决站在欧洲一方，并准备通过自卫保卫欧洲。
en: The “new Ukraine” is resolutely pro-European, and ready to defend Europe by defending itself.

zh: 但它的敌人 — — 不仅有普京的俄罗斯，还包括其自身的官僚和金融寡头 — — 十分强大，它无法自力更生战胜它们。
en: But its enemies – not only Putin’s Russia, but also its own bureaucracy and financial oligarchy – are formidable, and it cannot defeat them alone.

zh: 在2015年及其后支持新乌克兰是欧盟所能做的最有性价比的投资。
en: Supporting the new Ukraine in 2015 and beyond is the most cost-effective investment the EU could make.

zh: 这甚至能够帮助欧盟重新获得让欧盟得以诞生的统一精神和共同繁荣。
en: It could even help the EU recapture the spirit of unity and shared prosperity that led to its creation.

zh: 简言之，通过拯救乌克兰，欧盟也可以拯救自己。
en: In short, by saving Ukraine, the EU could also save itself.

zh: 欧洲不作为的代价
en: The Price of European Indifference

zh: 巴格达—欧洲的移民争论正在发生令人不安的转折。
en: BAGHDAD – Europe’s migration debate has taken a disturbing turn.

zh: 它开始于一刀切的“移民”概念（一种法律异形）的建立，这一概念模糊了作为法律核心的区别，即经济和政治移民的区别，或者逃离贫困的人和因为战争而被迫离开家园的人的区别。
en: It began with the creation of the catch-all concept (a legal freak) of a “migrant,” which obscures the difference, central to the law, between economic and political migration, between people escaping poverty and those driven from their homes by war.

zh: 与经济移民不同，逃离压迫、恐怖和大屠杀的人有不可侵犯的避难权，这意味着国际社会有无条件为他们提供收容所的义务。
en: Unlike economic migrants, those fleeing oppression, terror, and massacre have an inalienable right to asylum, which entails an unconditional obligation by the international community to provide shelter.

zh: 即使承认了这一区别，也常常沦为另一套花招的一部分，即试图让轻信之士相信，花数千美元登上破船颠簸前往蓝佩杜萨群岛（Lampedusa）或科斯岛（Kos）男性、女性和儿童都是经济移民。
en: Even when the distinction is acknowledged, it is often as part of another sleight of hand, an attempt to convince credulous minds that the men, women, and children who paid thousands of dollars to travel on one of the rickety boats washing up on the islands of Lampedusa or Kos are economic migrants.

zh: 然而，现实是，这些人中有80%是难民，他们是为了逃脱叙利亚、厄立特里亚和阿富汗等国家的独裁、恐怖和宗教极端主义。
en: The reality, however, is that 80% of these people are refugees, attempting to escape despotism, terror, and religious extremism in countries like Syria, Eritrea, and Afghanistan.

zh: 因此，国际法要求寻求庇护者必须逐一审查而非集体审查。
en: That is why international law requires that the cases of asylum-seekers are examined not in bulk, but one by one.

zh: 而即使这一点被接受，当大量人群蜂拥来到欧洲海岸，不容你否认促使他们逃离的粗暴行为时，也会产生第三种烟幕。
en: And even when that is accepted, when the sheer number of people clamoring to get to Europe’s shores makes it all but impossible to deny the barbarity driving them to flee, a third smokescreen goes up.

zh: 一些人，包括俄罗斯外交部长拉夫罗夫在内，宣称产生了这些难民的冲突全部都在受西方轰炸的阿拉伯国家。
en: Some, including Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, claim that the conflicts generating these refugees rage only in Arab countries that are being bombed by the West.

zh: 在这方面，数据依然不会撒谎。
en: Here again, the figures do not lie.

zh: 难民的最大来源地是叙利亚，国际社会拒绝组织“保护责任”所要求的军事行动 — — 即使国际法要求当疯狂的独裁者杀戮了240,000本国人民、几乎掏空全国时必须采取行动。
en: The top source of refugees is Syria, where the international community has refused to conduct the kinds of military operations required by the “responsibility to protect” – even though international law demands intervention when a mad despot, having killed 240,000 of his people, undertakes to empty his country.

zh: 西方也没有轰炸难民的另一个主要来源地 — — 厄立特里亚。
en: The West also is not bombing Eritrea, another major source of refugees.

zh: 但另一个有害的传说是“欧洲堡垒”正在遭受一波又一波野蛮人的冲击。 这一传说通过令人震惊的影像传播 — — 大量难民蜂拥通过边境隔离带，或者试图攀上加莱（Calais）的火车 — — 它存在两个层面的错误。
en: Yet another damaging myth, perpetuated by shocking images of refugees swarming through border fences or attempting to climb onto trains in Calais, is that “Fortress Europe” is under assault by waves of barbarians.

zh: 首先，欧洲绝非移民的主要目的地。
en: First, Europe is far from being the migrants’ primary destination.

zh: 来自叙利亚一地的近两百万难民进入了土耳其，一百万逃往黎巴嫩 — — 后者本身的人口只有350万。
en: Nearly two million refugees from Syria alone have headed to Turkey, and one million have fled to Lebanon, whose population amounts to just 3.5 million.

zh: 人口650万的约旦接受了近700,000人。
en: Jordan, with a population of 6.5 million, has taken in nearly 700,000.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲表现出团结的自私，扼杀了一个在意大利和希腊为区区40,000寻求庇护者提供收容的计划。
en: Meanwhile, Europe, in a display of united selfishness, has scuttled a plan to relocate a mere 40,000 asylum-seekers from their cities of refuge in Italy and Greece.

zh: 其次，确实选择了德国、法国、斯堪的纳维亚英国或匈牙利为目的地的少数人也不是为了摧毁我们，甚至不是为了寄食于欧洲纳税人。
en: Second, the minority who do choose Germany, France, Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, or Hungary are not enemies who have come to destroy us or even to sponge off of European taxpayers.

zh: 他们自由的追求者，热爱我们这片乐土，我们的社会模式，和我们的价值。
en: They are applicants for freedom, lovers of our promised land, our social model, and our values.

zh: 他们高喊“欧洲！ 欧洲！
en: They are people who cry out “Europe!

zh: ” ， 就好像一个世纪前登上埃利斯岛（Ellis Island ） 、 学会高唱“美丽美国”的数百万欧洲人。
en: Europe!” the way millions of Europeans, arriving a century ago on Ellis Island, learned to sing “America the Beautiful.”

zh: 还有一个恶劣的谣言：这一想象中的攻击是“大替代 ” （ great replacement）战略家秘密策划的，目的是用外国人取代土著欧洲人，或更恶劣地，用国际圣战代理人取代欧洲土著人，今天的移民将是明天子弹头列车上的恐怖分子。
en: Then there is the ugly rumor that this imaginary assault has been clandestinely orchestrated by the strategists of a “great replacement,” with foreigners supplanting native Europeans, or, worse, by agents of an international jihad, in which today’s migrants are tomorrow’s terrorists on bullet trains.

zh: 毫无疑问，这纯属无稽之谈。
en: It should go without saying that this is nonsense.

zh: 这些扭曲和幻想已经形成了严重后果。
en: Taken together, these distortions and delusions have had serious consequences.

zh: 首先，地中海已经成为蛇头的乐园。
en: For starters, the Mediterranean Sea has been all but abandoned to human smugglers.

zh: “我们的海”正在逐渐变成远古诗歌中的一望无际的水葬墓场。
en: The Mare Nostrum is gradually becoming the kind of vast and watery mass grave described by a faraway poet.

zh: 今年便已有大约2,350人葬身地中海。
en: Some 2,350 people have drowned already this year.

zh: 但是，对大部分欧洲人来说，这些人只不过是统计数字，正如那些在旅途中活下来的男女仍然没有身份，无法辨别，成为危险的匿名群众。
en: But, for most Europeans, these people are little more than statistics, just as the women and men who have survived the journey remain unidentified and indistinguishable, a threatening anonymous mass.

zh: 我们的外表社会（society of spectacle）常常很快就能为当下危机（不管是猪流感还是卡车司机罢工）制造一张“脸 ” ， 却没有兴趣关心“移民”中的一员的命运。
en: Our society of the spectacle, normally so quick to manufacture an instant celebrity to serve as the “face” of the crisis du jour (anything from swine flu to a truckers’ strike), has not taken an interest in the fate of a single one of the “migrants.”

zh: 这些个体 — — 他们来到欧洲的旅程就像几千年前来自宙斯背上的泰尔（Tyre）的腓尼基公主欧罗巴（Phoenician Princess Europa ） — —被全部拒之门外；事实上，欧洲正在建设将他们隔离在外的藩篱。
en: These individuals – whose course to Europe resembles that of the Phoenician Princess Europa, who arrived from Tyre on Zeus’s back several millennia ago – are being wholly rejected; indeed, walls are being constructed to keep them out.

zh: 结果是有一群人无法得到基本权利。
en: The result is another group of people being denied basic rights.

zh: 这些人 — — 正如汉娜·阿伦特（Hannah Arendt）曾经观察到的 — — 最终将把犯罪作为他们进入法律世界、融入那些享有法律授予的权利的人的唯一途径。
en: Such people, as Hannah Arendt once observed, will ultimately come to see in the commission of a crime their only path into the world of law and of those who enjoy the rights the law confers.

zh: 受仇外情绪困扰、充满自我怀疑的欧洲已经背离了它的价值。
en: Europe, harassed by its xenophobes and consumed by self-doubt, has turned its back on its values.

zh: 事实上，它已经忘了它是什么。
en: Indeed, it has forgotten what it is.

zh: 丧钟不仅为移民而鸣，也为人文遗产在我们眼前崩塌的欧洲而鸣。
en: The bell tolls not only for the migrants, but also for a Europe whose humanistic patrimony is crumbling before our very eyes.

zh: 欧洲的圣战一代
en: Europe’s Jihadi Generation

zh: 马德里 — — 他来自阿尔及利亚，想要过上更好的生活，憧憬着从贫困、压迫和绝望中摆脱。
en: MADRID ‒ He came from Algeria seeking a better life, anticipating an escape from poverty, oppression, and hopelessness.

zh: 他在巴黎找到了一份技术要求不高的工作，之后生育子孙。
en: In Paris, he found a low-skill job and had children and grandchildren.

zh: 身为法国公民，他们拥有接受教育和医疗的权利。
en: As French citizens, they had the right to an education and health care.

zh: 但却在环绕法国各大城市的贫民窟中长大，可以说身处社会边缘，周围都是和他们境况类似的家庭。
en: But they grew up in the ghettos that ring France’s major cities, surrounded by families like theirs, literally on the margins of society.

zh: 因为始终无法完全融入，他们鲜有机会取得经济上的成功。
en: Unable to integrate fully, they had few opportunities for economic advancement.

zh: 他们从未得到想象中的天堂。
en: Paradise was never gained.

zh: 同样的故事在西欧国家已经重复了数百万次，那里的移民及家庭过着被排斥的贫困生活。
en: This story has been repeated millions of times in the countries of Western Europe, with immigrants and their families ending up poor and excluded.

zh: 最坏情况下，他们被看似为其提供所缺元素的极端组织招募，因为极端组织为他们提供了无法获得的归属感、认同感和目的感。
en: In the worst-case scenario, they are recruited by extremist groups that seem to offer what they are missing: a sense of belonging, identity, and purpose.

zh: 在终其一生无法融入主流社会后，参与更宏伟的事业似乎值得付出谎言、自我毁灭乃至死亡的代价。
en: After a lifetime of marginalization, participation in a larger cause can seem worth the lies, self-destruction, and even death that inclusion demands.

zh: 在挫败针对巴黎讽刺杂志查理周刊和比利时的另一次恐怖袭击后，欧洲需要认真地审视自身。
en: In the wake of the attack on the French satirical magazine Charlie Hebdo in Paris and the thwarting of another attack in Belgium, Europe needs to take a good look at itself.

zh: 我们必须认识到第二和第三代移民很容易受到恐怖组织花言巧语的蛊惑，因为成为欧洲公民并没有为他们带来社会和经济领域的包容。
en: It must recognize that second- and third-generation immigrants are susceptible to the blandishments of terrorist organizations because European citizenship has not translated into social and economic inclusion.

zh: 如果一定要说有什么，那么因多年危机而不断加剧的不平等正在使问题变得更加糟糕。
en: If anything, growing inequality – exacerbated by years of crisis – is making the problem worse.

zh: 所有人都需要希望。
en: People need hope.

zh: 他们需要相信某种愿景，相信承诺为他们及所在群体缔造更美好未来的计划。
en: They need to believe in a vision, a project that promises a better future for them and their communities.

zh: 欧洲国家曾给过人这样的希望。
en: European countries once offered that sense of hope.

zh: 但危机及其后采取的官方对策让这种希望变成了沮丧和失望。
en: But the crisis, and the official response to it, has replaced hope with frustration and disillusionment.

zh: 这为反移民的民粹主义者和伊斯兰恐怖分子创造了肥沃的土壤。
en: This has created fertile ground for anti-immigrant populists and Islamist terrorists alike.

zh: 估计已有超过1200名法国公民加入了叙利亚圣战组织，600名英国人、550名德国人和400名比利时人也是一样。
en: More than 1,200 French citizens are estimated to have joined the jihadi cause in Syria, along with 600 from the United Kingdom, 550 from Germany, and 400 from Belgium.

zh: 其他欧洲国家，包括西班牙，同样出现了类似的现象。
en: Other European countries, including Spain, are experiencing a similar phenomenon.

zh: 某些欧洲公民，比方说袭击查理周刊的刺客，已经在国内采取了行动。
en: And some European citizens, like the Charlie Hebdo assassins, have acted at home.

zh: 虽然情报部门和警察部队必须出力防止袭击，但制定有效策略对抗极端主义首先要理解背后的驱动力量。
en: While intelligence services and police forces must be engaged to prevent attacks, devising an effective strategy to counteract extremist movements requires, first and foremost, understanding what drives them.

zh: 西方国家必须在捍卫言论自由及加强警方协调以外制定长期方案化解恐怖追随者的经济和社会边缘化，同时避免文化冲突和单纯依靠镇压。
en: Western countries must go beyond defending freedom of speech and improving police coordination to develop lasting solutions that address adherents’ economic and social marginalization, while avoiding cultural confrontation and reliance on repression alone.

zh: 更根本的是，上述方案必须放弃将自由和安全一分为二的错误观点。
en: More fundamentally, such solutions require abandoning the false dichotomy of liberty and security.

zh: 如果安全问题压制了基本权利和自由，那么宗教狂热就已经打了胜仗；如果伊斯兰恐惧症和仇外心理的表达不断蔓延，带来的结果也将一模一样。
en: If security concerns trump basic rights and freedoms, fanaticism will have scored a victory; and the same thing will happen if expressions of Islamophobia and xenophobia increase.

zh: 巴黎袭击发生一个星期后，德国总理默克尔重申了2010年前总统克里斯蒂安·武尔夫所表达的立场：默克尔与土耳其总理达武特奥卢并肩站在一起，宣布伊斯兰教和犹太教、基督教同样是德国社会的组成部分。
en: A week after the Paris attacks, German Chancellor Angela Merkel reiterated the sentiment expressed by former President Christian Wulff in 2010: standing beside Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu, Merkel declared that Islam is as much a part of Germany as Judaism and Christianity.

zh: 这一声明代表了正确的前进方向。
en: This statement represents the right way forward.

zh: 穆斯林移民，无论是第一，第二还是第三代，都必须能完全融入欧洲社会，享有欧洲其他居民和公民得到的同样机会。
en: Muslim immigrants, whether first-, second-, or third-generation, must be able to integrate fully into European society, gaining the same opportunities as Europe’s other residents and citizens.

zh: 通过建立一套促进发展的包容性框架并鼓励伊斯兰世界拒绝狂热情绪，这项原则也应当适用于世界各国。
en: That principle should be applied at the global level as well, through the establishment of an inclusive framework that fosters development – and encourages the rejection of fanaticism – in the Islamic world.

zh: 数百年来压制基督教社会的激进原教旨主义和内讧已经过去，我们绝不能允许它再度复活。
en: The aggressive fundamentalism and infighting that held down Christian societies for centuries has been relegated to the past, and that is where it must remain.

zh: 宗教不仅是一种信仰体系；也是一种制度、一种语言，甚至是一种市场主体，竭尽全力争夺支持者。
en: A religion is not only a belief system; it is also an institution, a language, and even a kind of market actor, competing for supporters.

zh: 激进恐怖组织试图巩固其歪曲版本“真正”伊斯兰教独一无二的地位，强制推行他们的语言去赢得整个穆斯林市场
en: Radical terrorist groups attempt to consolidate their distorted version of “true” Islam as the only institution, imposing their language to win the entire Muslim market.

zh: 如今，像伊斯兰国和尼日利亚博科圣地这样的组织已经加入了基地组织的队伍，诱惑世界各地的穆斯林民众，从而确保对全球圣战运动的领导。
en: Today, groups like the Islamic State and Nigeria’s Boko Haram have joined Al Qaeda in a struggle to attract Muslims from all over the world, thereby securing their leadership in global jihad.

zh: 这些组织利用无法无天的环境、脆弱或濒临崩溃的制度来争取在区域内实现立足。
en: These groups take advantage of unruly environments and weak or collapsing institutions to gain a territorial foothold.

zh: 事实上，伊斯兰国的崛起要归结于叙利亚、利比亚、也门阿拉伯之春起义后转型失败的推动。
en: Indeed, it was the failed transitions in Syria, Libya, and Yemen after the Arab Spring revolts that fueled the Islamic State’s emergence.

zh: 数以百万计的年轻人，虽然对数十年社会瘫痪、失业和残酷独裁政权倍感失望，但却敢于怀揣更美好的梦想。
en: Millions of young people, though disillusioned by decades of social paralysis, unemployment, and brutal dictatorships, had dared to expect better.

zh: 虽然突尼斯已经取得进展，但其他受影响的群体，比如欧洲许多穆斯林移民，却怀揣着已经破灭的梦想。
en: Though Tunisians have made progress, the other affected populations, like many Muslim immigrants in Europe, have had their hopes shattered.

zh: 圣战像其他简化的政治纲领一样，能对各种各样的人产生诱惑。
en: Jihad, like any other reductionist political program, is capable of seducing a wide variety of people.

zh: 他们的共同点是无助感和漫无目标。
en: The attribute they almost always share is a sense of futility or a lack of purpose.

zh: 西方人必须认识到，就像阿富汗和伊拉克事态已经证明的那样，外国军事干预无法解决阿拉伯世界的冲突。
en: The West must recognize that, as Afghanistan and Iraq have shown, conflict in the Arab world cannot be resolved through foreign military intervention.

zh: 恢复地区秩序和推动进步的唯一途径是授权温和的穆斯林民众，使他们能战胜激进主义和暴力力量。
en: The only way to restore order and spur progress in the region is by empowering moderate Muslims, so that they can triumph over the forces of radicalism and violence.

zh: 西方要做的是找到并接受他们，并为他们提供帮助。
en: The West’s role is to identify them and offer them acceptance and support.

zh: 这一教训理应在国内国外全部适用。
en: This lesson should be applied both abroad and at home.

zh: 重塑欧洲，和欧洲人
en: Redefining Europe, and Europeans

zh: 莱比锡—在德国即将迎来9月24日的联邦选举之际周游这个国家，你一定会被2015年难民危机所造成的挥之不去的深切伤痕所震撼。
en: LEIPZIG – Traveling through Germany in the run-up to its federal election on September 24, one cannot help but be struck by the lingering signs of profound trauma from the 2015 refugee crisis.

zh: 突然间，在几乎没有任何预警的情况下，近一百万绝望的人群 — — 大部分是逃离祖国大屠杀的叙利亚人 — — 涌入了德国。
en: Suddenly and virtually without warning, nearly a million desperate people – mostly Syrians fleeing the carnage in their homeland – flocked to Germany.

zh: 尽管德国也许是欧洲官僚管理最完善的国家，也没有能够抵挡得住。
en: And while Germany may be Europe’s most bureaucratically well-managed country, even it was overwhelmed.

zh: 德国总理默克尔对这场两年前的危机的反应是打破常规，打开国门。
en: German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s response to the crisis two years ago was to throw out the rulebook and open her country’s borders.

zh: 她告诉德国人民 ， “ 我们可以做到。 ”
en: She famously told the German people, “Wir schaffen das” (We can do it).

zh: 但当下的德国公众态度表明，这个国家对如此激进的姿态变得更加谨慎了。
en: But German public opinion today suggests that the country has become warier of such bold gestures.

zh: 是的，德国做到了，因为没有第二条路可以走；许多德国人对自己的祖国能够面对这样的情况挺身而出感到自豪。
en: Yes, Germany did it, because there was no alternative; and many Germans are proud of their country for rising to the occasion.

zh: 但大部分人希望这样的危机再也不要发生。
en: But most hope that such a crisis never happens again.

zh: 尽管许多德国人接受了两年前所发生的事情，但仍有一小部分人觉得自己被背叛了。
en: Although many Germans have come to terms with what happened two years ago, a small minority still feels betrayed.

zh: 他们因此产生了愤怒和仇外民族主义，这些情绪毫无疑问要反映在选票中。
en: They have responded with anger and xenophobic nationalism, and these sentiments will undoubtedly be reflected in how they vote.

zh: 但德国因为难民危机而蒙受的伤害应该全面地去看待。
en: But Germany’s trauma from the refugee crisis should be put in perspective.

zh: 在黎巴嫩和土耳其等国家寻求并得到保护的难民数量远多于德国。
en: Far more refugees have sought and found protection in countries such as Lebanon and Turkey than in Germany.

zh: 相对而言，2015年德国需要接受2,000万难民，才能与黎巴嫩相提并论。
en: In relative terms, Germany would have had to take in 20 million refugees to match Lebanon in 2015.

zh: 在土耳其，光是伊斯坦布尔现在所收容的难民就比整个德国都要多。
en: In Turkey, Istanbul alone is now hosting more refugees than all of Germany.

zh: 当然，德国不是唯一一个因为难民危机而变得不安的欧洲国家。
en: Of course, Germany is not the only European country that remains unsettled from the refugee crisis.

zh: 在我的祖国瑞典，一个希望让我们与世界其他部分隔离开来的政党，很有可能在明年的大选中收获颇丰。
en: In my own country, Sweden, a political party that wants to shut us off from the rest of the world will most likely make strong gains in next year’s general election.

zh: 在许多知道最近才重新拥有了主权感的中欧国家，难民被广泛视为构成了对民族身份的威胁。
en: And in many Central European countries that only recently regained their sense of sovereignty, refugees are widely viewed as posing a threat to national identity.

zh: 这些问题将以各种各样的方式主导未来多年的欧洲政治。
en: One way or another, these issues will dominate European politics in the years ahead.

zh: 欧洲正在缓缓试图构建恢复力，弥合2015年所经历的创伤。
en: Europe is slowly trying to build up resilience to the kind of trauma it experienced in 2015.

zh: 欧洲曾经输出了战争和动乱，但如今，它要保护自己不受周边邻居的问题的影响。
en: It is a continent that once exported war and turmoil, but that now wants to protect itself from its neighbors’ problems.

zh: 2015年的一个教训是欧盟必须制定一套更加强大的共同外交和安全政策。
en: One of the lessons from 2015 is that the European Union will need to develop a far stronger common foreign and security policy.

zh: 欧盟必须用务实的行动取代豪言壮语，同时也要接受其地区和全球责任。
en: The EU must replace lofty rhetoric with concrete action, while also accepting its regional and global responsibilities.

zh: 在匈牙利和塞尔维亚之间修建铁丝网无法让欧洲隔绝乌克兰战争、安纳托利亚（Anatolia）叛乱和恐怖主义，以及黎凡特和美索不达米亚暴力冲突的影响。
en: Barbed wire fencing between Hungary and Serbia will not shield Europe from the effects of war in Ukraine, putsches and terrorism in Anatolia, or violent conflagrations in the Levant and Mesopotamia.

zh: 它也无助于欧洲管理非洲正在发生的剧变。 几十年后，世界40%的工作年龄人口都将来自非洲。
en: And it will not help Europe manage the dramatic shift now underway in Africa, which will be home to 40% of the world’s working-age population in a few decades.

zh: 2015年的另一个教训是欧洲国家必须学会重塑民族身份。
en: Another lesson from 2015 is that European countries must learn to redefine their national identities.

zh: 美国、澳大利亚和加拿大都是移民建立的国家，而我们中的大部分人祖先也不是本地土著。
en: The United States, Australia, and Canada have all been built on immigration, and most of us are the progeny of people from somewhere else.

zh: 事实上，在这些国家，已经没有多少“原住民”剩下了。
en: Indeed, there is not much left of the “first nations” in these countries.

zh: 芝加哥的瑞典人后裔比斯德哥尔摩多，这完全是可能的。
en: It is now entirely possible for there to be more people of Swedish descent in Chicago than in Stockholm.

zh: 诚然，欧洲和其他西方国家不同。
en: To be sure, Europe is different from its Western counterparts.

zh: 它的部落战火燃烧了千年之久。
en: Its tribes have been fighting one another for millennia.

zh: 但在过去两个世纪中，欧洲人一直在漫长复杂的历史经验的基础上，构建日益强大的民族国家和民族身份。
en: And for the past two centuries, Europeans have been building ever-stronger nation-states and national identities on the basis of long, complicated historical experiences.

zh: 当然，欧盟本身就是民族国家建立的。
en: The EU itself was of course built by nation-states.

zh: 但这些国家的公民，希望克服部落主义（tribalism）和战争的遗产。
en: But their citizens wanted to overcome their long legacy of tribalism and war.

zh: 从这个目标判断，欧盟的第一个五十年堪称巨大的成功。
en: Judged by that objective, the EU’s first half-century has been a tremendous success.

zh: 但后继乏力也是显而易见的。
en: And yet the strains are there for anyone to see.

zh: 不管有没有充分的理由，当人们感到民族身份受到威胁时，他们的部落本能就会蜂拥而出。
en: Whether justified or not, when people perceive a threat to their national identity, their tribal instincts kick in.

zh: 而对于真正被吓到的一小撮人，布鲁塞尔和麦加都被视为致命威胁。
en: And for a truly frightened few, Brussels and Mecca have both come to be seen as mortal threats.

zh: 欧洲要想在快速变化的世界中找到一席之地，其公民就需要学会利用多重身份。
en: For Europe to find its place in a rapidly changing world, its citizens will have to learn to tap multiple identities.

zh: 你可以同时是一个骄傲的瑞典人，又是一个骄傲的欧洲人；你可以既是德国人，也是土耳其人，并从这种双重性中获取优势。
en: One can be a proud Swede and a proud European at the same time; one can also be both German and Turkish, and derive strength from that duality.

zh: 自视为世界公民不是不忠。
en: It is not disloyal to see oneself as a citizen of the world.

zh: 相反，这是一件光荣的事。
en: On the contrary, it is honorable.

zh: 这种态度的转变将带来一个截然不同的欧洲。
en: Such a shift in attitudes would make for a very different Europe.

zh: 我们终将摆脱古老的部落冲突和恐惧，拥抱网络化的数字未来。
en: We would have finally moved on from ancient tribal conflicts and fears, and embraced a networked, digital future.

zh: 有望在9月24日赢得又一个四年总理任期的默克尔告诉德国人，他们“可以做到。
en: Merkel, who will likely be elected to another four-year term as chancellor on September 24, told Germans that they “can do it.”

zh: ”但德国和欧洲其他国家会不会做仍有待观察。
en: But whether Germany and the rest of Europe will do it remains to be seen.

zh: 我们面临的任务十分艰巨。
en: We have our work cut out for us.

zh: 欧洲的新政治战线
en: Europe’s New Political Battle Lines

zh: 巴黎 — — 法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙将预定于2019年5月举行的欧洲议会选举认定为不光是传统右翼和左翼党派之间的斗争，还包括民粹主义者和像他自己一样的亲欧洲进步人士。
en: PARIS – French President Emmanuel Macron has framed the European Parliament election in May 2019 as a battle not between the traditional right and left, but between populists and pro-European progressives like himself.

zh: 希腊总理亚历克西斯·齐普拉斯不久前也采纳了类似的论调，宣称“所有进步、民主和亲欧洲的力量都有义务携手并肩站在同一条历史战线上。
en: Greek Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras recently adopted similar rhetoric, declaring that “all progressive, democratic, and pro-European forces have a duty to stand side by side on the same side of history.”

zh: ”这样一种全欧洲范围内根本性的政治转变 — — 像极了去年在法国爆发并导致马克龙掌权的那次运动 — — 能否实际取得成功？
en: Would such a fundamental Europe-wide political shift – much like the one in France that brought Macron to power last year – actually come to pass?

zh: 右翼欧洲人民党（EPP）和左翼社会主义和民主（S&D）进步联盟长期以来一直共同控制着欧洲议会，它们的执政纲领一直是相互妥协的产物。
en: The European People’s Party (EPP) on the right and the Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats (S&D) on the left have long shared control of the European Parliament, where they have governed by compromise.

zh: 但随着时间的推移，这已经在欧洲产生了某种形式的政治同质化，从而导致大规模弃权运动的诞生。
en: But, over time, this has produced a kind of political homogenization in Europe, leading to mass abstentionism.

zh: 而那些亲身参与投票的人也越来越倾向于选择经常表达极端观点的反建制派力量。
en: Those who do vote increasingly choose anti-establishment parties that often espouse extreme views.

zh: 结果，尽管欧洲人民党及社会主义和民主进步联盟2009年还控制着欧洲议会61%的席位，但在2014年却仅仅赢得了54%的选票。 这也意味着欧洲议会已经非常接近被极端主义政党所主导。
en: As a result, whereas the EPP and S&D controlled 61% of the European Parliament in 2009, they won only 54% of the vote in 2014, meaning that the body was very nearly dominated by extremist parties.

zh: 2019年选举可能为建制派带来进一步损失， 预计仅有45%的席位将归属建制派所有。
en: The 2019 election is likely to produce even more losses for the establishment parties, which are expected to win only 45% of seats.

zh: 现阶段，我怀疑会不会有人愿意考虑以左右翼分歧为基础来参与竞选 — — 尤其因为深层次分歧同样存在于党派内部。
en: At this stage, it is doubtful that anyone would consider running a campaign on the basis of left-right divisions – not least because of deep rifts within the parties themselves.

zh: 从右翼角度讲，欧洲人民党被分为亲欧洲自由派和保守的欧洲怀疑派，尽管两派共同认定来自德国基督教社会联盟的韦博作为人民党首席候选人。
en: On the right, the EPP is divided between pro-European liberals and conservative Euroskeptics, despite endorsing Manfred Weber of Germany’s Christian Social Union as the EPP Spitzenkandidat.

zh: 最近，在赫尔辛基举行的欧洲人民党代表大会上，欧洲理事会主席唐纳德·图斯克明确表示：违反法治与归属基督教民主党大家庭从根本上不相容 — — 这条信息显然是针对匈牙利总理维克多·奥尔班所传递的。
en: At the recent EPP Congress in Helsinki, European Council President Donald Tusk was explicit: breaching the rule of law is incompatible with belonging to the Christian Democrat family – a message obviously aimed at Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán.

zh: 在欧洲议会内部，欧洲人民党甚至投票赞成援引里斯本协议中的第七条反对匈牙利，此举将制裁奥尔班政府系统性破坏司法独立、言论自由和少数群体及移民权利的活动。
en: In the European Parliament, the EPP even voted in favor of invoking Article 7 of the Treaty of Lisbon against Hungary, a move that would impose sanctions in response to the Orbán government’s systematic violations of judicial independence, freedom of speech, and the rights of minorities and migrants.

zh: 但欧洲人民党投票的主要原因是其希望保住作为规模最大的欧盟政党的机会，同时确保韦博成为下一任欧盟委员会领导者。
en: But the EPP’s vote was largely motivated by its desire to preserve its chances of remaining the largest EU party and ensuring that Weber becomes the next European Commission leader.

zh: 从更广义的角度讲，强大的政治压力迫使欧洲人民党别无选择；如果换成不同的状况，该党很可能会为了保住自己在欧洲议会的霸权地位，而乐见其成地坐视奥尔班继续随心所欲地违反民主规则。
en: More broadly, strong political pressure forced the EPP’s hand; under different circumstances, the party probably would have been happy to allow Orbán to continue breaching democratic norms unchecked, in order to preserve its own hegemony in the EU Parliament.

zh: 但因为拒绝澄清对奥尔班的立场或驱逐奥尔班，欧洲人民党正在承担巨大的风险。
en: But in refusing to clarify its position on Orbán or expel him, the EPP is taking an enormous risk.

zh: 如果欧洲理事会选择韦博担任下一届欧盟委员会主席，那么欧洲议会中的社会民主党和自由派都有可能拒绝为来自继续收留奥尔班的政党的候选人投票。
en: If the European Council chooses Weber as the next European Commission president, both social democrats and liberals in the European Parliament could refuse to vote for a candidate from a party that keeps Orbán in its ranks.

zh: 这也解释了为什么有兴趣分裂欧洲人民党并引诱其自由派人士加入的马克龙会反对首席候选人系统。
en: That is why Macron, who has an interest in dividing the EPP and luring its liberal wing to join him, opposes the Spitzenkandidat system.

zh: 目前其实存在三种选择。
en: There are three alternatives.

zh: 首先，欧洲理事会可以选择一位对匈牙利态度不那么暧昧的欧洲人民党候选人。
en: First, the European Council could choose an EPP candidate who is less ambiguous on Hungary.

zh: 英国脱欧首席谈判代表米歇尔·巴尼尔可能成为韦博重要的替代者 — — 也可能是欧洲人民党内部唯一的选择。
en: Brexit chief negotiator Michel Barnier could be a serious substitute for Weber – probably the only one within the EPP.

zh: 第二种选择是支持荷兰工党的弗兰斯·蒂默曼斯，他在反对奥尔班的问题上立场强硬，同时德国总理安格拉·默克尔和欧洲人民党自由派也能够接受他。
en: The second alternative would be to endorse the Dutch Labour Party’s Frans Timmermans, who took a very strong position against Orbán and is acceptable to German Chancellor Angela Merkel and EPP liberals.

zh: 可以肯定，默克尔可能更偏爱韦博。
en: To be sure, Merkel might prefer Weber.

zh: 但如果欧洲理事会陷入僵局，而她的选择遭到欧洲议会的反对，那么她转而支持另一名候选人也是有可能的。
en: But if the European Council is deadlocked, and the European Parliament opposes her choice, she could endorse another candidate.

zh: 社会主义和民主进步联盟的衰落也使韦博得到他们的支持变得不太可能。
en: The decline of the S&D also makes it implausible that Weber could get their support.

zh: 得到欧洲自由和民主联盟（ALDE）认可的候选人，例如欧洲竞争事务专员马格丽特·维斯塔格可能成为第三种选择。
en: The third option could be a candidate endorsed by the Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe (ALDE), such as Margrethe Vestager, the EU competition commissioner.

zh: 某些观察家认为丹麦政府永远不会提议将维斯塔格作为本国的候选者。
en: Some observers argue that the Danish government will never propose Vestager as their candidate.

zh: 但强烈支持维斯塔格的马克龙却有可能批准她作为法国的候选人参选 — — 而这一前所未有的举措将加速大陆政治的欧洲化进程。
en: But Macron, who strongly supports Vestager, could endorse her as the French candidate – an unprecedented move that would accelerate the Europeanization of continental politics.

zh: 总体而言，民粹主义势力保住欧洲议会多数可能并非难事，但他们将无法在统一的政治旗帜下作为一股统一的力量进行运作。
en: Overall, populist forces could well secure a majority in the European Parliament, though they will not operate as a unified force under a single political banner.

zh: 在这样的情况下，马克龙需要与欧洲人民党或社会主义和民主进步联盟建立政治合作关系，上述两党的观点大体上与他对欧盟的愿景相同 — — 而且，更加重要的是欧元区改革。
en: In such a scenario, Macron would need to build political coalitions with either the EPP or the S&D, whose views largely align with his vision for EU – and, more important, eurozone – reform.

zh: 事实上，就像法治一样，欧元区改革是未来赖以建立政治联盟的最关键的断层。
en: In fact, like the rule of law, eurozone reform is a key fault line along which political alliances will be established.

zh: 马克龙已经在争取西班牙及荷兰中右翼领袖的支持，他们更加同情他对欧洲统一的愿景。
en: Macron is already marshaling support among center-right leaders in Spain and the Netherlands, who are more sympathetic to his vision for European integration.

zh: 他已经与荷兰首相马克·鲁特建立了良好的关系 ，即使鲁特反对马克龙所倡议的欧元区改革。
en: He has established a good rapport with Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte, even though Rutte opposes the eurozone reforms Macron advocates.

zh: 其他两个问题可能将会影响欧洲议会的选举结果。
en: Two other issues will likely shape the outcome of the European Parliament election.

zh: 首先，欧洲领导人必须强化欧盟外部边境，特别是通过部署早就应当部署的欧洲边境巡逻队来完成这项任务。
en: First, Europe’s leaders will have to address the need to reinforce the EU’s external frontiers, especially through the long-overdue deployment of a European border patrol.

zh: 这样的提议无疑将激怒民族民粹主义分子，他们将在反对移民的同时反对欧洲军队的部署。
en: Such a proposal will undoubtedly rile nationalist populists, who will oppose the deployment of a European force, even as they rail against migration.

zh: 其次，欧洲领导人有必要致力于打击大型企业，尤其是大型科技企业的逃税和避税活动。
en: Second, Europe’s leaders will need to commit to combating tax evasion and avoidance by major companies, especially the big tech firms.

zh: 这个问题事关重大，因为它将成为日益数字化的经济生活中各国能否保障其财政偿付能力的决定性因素。
en: This is a high-stakes issue, as it will determine the capacity of states to remain fiscally solvent in increasingly digital economies.

zh: 这方面已经取得了一些进展，而这主要归功于维斯塔格。
en: Some progress has already been made on this front, thanks largely to Vestager.

zh: 但仍需采取更强硬的行动，尤其因为欧洲国家继续给予大企业税收减免资格。
en: But stronger action is needed, not least because EU countries continue to grant corporate tax abatements.

zh: 而随着德国重新思考其是否支持由法国提出的在欧盟层面向大型科技企业收入征税的计划，能不能取得进一步的进展其实还很难说。
en: And with Germany reconsidering its support for a French-backed plan to tax the revenue of large technology companies at the EU level, further progress is far from guaranteed.

zh: 也许欧洲正在进行的政治调整将有助于实现马克龙让欧洲更强大、也更统一的愿景。
en: Perhaps Europe’s ongoing political realignment will enable the realization of Macron’s vision of a stronger, more integrated Europe.

zh: 尽管近期的挑战 — — 尤其是意大利与欧盟委员会的预算争夺战 — — 显示这样的结果距离得到保障还相去甚远，但它仍然是抵制民粹主义崛起的最为可靠的平衡力量。
en: While recent challenges – not least Italy’s budget battle with the European Commission – indicate that such an outcome is far from assured, it remains the most credible counterweight to the rise of populism.

zh: 向更民主的欧洲迈进？
en: Toward a More Democratic Europe?

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 一年前，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在法国总统大选中所取得的大胜及其所属政党随后在议会选举中的佳绩让许多人都松了一口气，似乎西方极端主义民粹主义的上升趋势似乎终于得到了逆转。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – A year ago, Emmanuel Macron’s decisive victory in the French presidential election, and his party’s subsequent success in legislative elections, caused many to breathe a sigh of relief. The rising tide of extremist populism in the West, it seemed, had finally turned.

zh: 然而事实证明情况并非如此。
en: That has turned out not to be the case.

zh: 意大利这个欧盟创始成员国崛起了一个民粹主义多数派政府的事实确实令人震惊，但却并不一定意味着灾难降临。
en: But the stunning emergence of a populist majority government in Italy, a founding member of the European Union, does not necessarily spell disaster.

zh: 诚然，民粹主义者实力的日益膨胀正在威胁着传统的中右翼政党，使得当前形式下的欧洲层面治理难以发挥作用。
en: True, populists’ growing strength is threatening traditional center-right and center-left parties and making it very difficult for EU-level governance, in its current form, to function.

zh: 但如果民粹主义运动的持续选举成功有助于推动更广泛的政治体制改革，最终令欧洲民主得以强化了呢？
en: But what if populist movements’ continued electoral success helps to drive forward a broader political restructuring that ultimately strengthens European democracy?

zh: 而马克龙本人的经历也强化了这种认识。
en: This reading is reinforced by the experience of Macron himself.

zh: 过往从未担任过任何民选职务的他创建了一个以自己为核心的新党派，并得到了中左翼和中右翼选民的支持。
en: Having never held elected office, Macron created a new party centered on himself, with support from both center-left and center-right voters.

zh: 在这一过程中他似乎已经重构了法国政治。
en: He seems to have restructured French politics in the process.

zh: 明年的欧洲议会选举可能会更多地揭示这类政治体制改革的潜力。
en: Next year’s European Parliament election is likely to reveal more about the potential for such political restructuring.

zh: 欧洲议会从来没有像欧盟委员会，欧盟理事会甚至欧洲法院等欧洲其他机构那样吸引那么多的关注。
en: The European Parliament has never generated the same level of interest as other European institutions, such as the Commission, the Council, or even the Court of Justice.

zh: 欧洲议会的辩论很少传到过布鲁塞尔或斯特拉斯堡之外，选民投票率通常也很低。
en: European parliamentary debates rarely make it far outside Brussels or Strasbourg, and voter turnout to fill the body’s seats has typically been low.

zh: 长期以来这样的事实被认为是欧盟缺乏民主的证据，公民并未适当参与过欧洲层面的治理。
en: Such facts have long been cited as evidence that the EU suffers from a democratic deficit, with citizens inadequately engaged with European-level governance.

zh: 但随着一系列危机不断侵袭欧盟 — — 其中受灾最深的是希腊、爱尔兰、葡萄牙、西班牙和意大利 — — 这些动态一直在变化。
en: But as a series of crises have hit the EU – affecting most acutely Greece, Ireland, Portugal, Spain, and Italy – these dynamics have been changing.

zh: 尽管有些抱怨，但欧洲人悄然接受欧盟的日子已经一去不复返了。
en: Gone are the days when Europeans quietly accepted the EU, despite some complaints.

zh: 如今欧盟正处于各国国内政治辩论的中心，而这些辩论越来越多地涵盖事关欧元区和整个欧洲计划存续的存在性问题。
en: Now, the EU is at the center of domestic political debates, which increasingly include existential questions about the survival of the eurozone and the entire European project.

zh: 这意味着参与明年欧洲议会选举的候选人很可能不会只关注其国内问题。
en: This means that candidates in next year’s election are unlikely just to focus on domestic issues.

zh: 虽然还会涉及一些国内事务，但也可能首次就欧洲的未来和政策进行广泛的讨论，特别是在移民、国防和安全、能源和气候以及与美俄等主要大国的关系方面。
en: While there will be some of that, there is likely also to be, for the first time, extensive discussion about Europe’s future and policies, especially in areas like migration, defense and security, energy and climate, and relations with major powers like the United States and Russia.

zh: 毕竟欧洲各国虽然存在差异，但几乎每个国家都在努力解决自身要在多大程度上融入欧洲，应该对新形式的技术驱动型全球化秉承多大程度的开放和乐观态度，以及何种水平的社会团结才算适当等诸多问题。
en: After all, despite their differences, virtually every country in Europe is currently grappling with the question of how much Europe it wants, how open and optimistic it should be about new forms of technology-enabled globalization, and how much social solidarity is appropriate.

zh: 这些讨论 — — 以及明年就此选出的欧洲议会 — — 不太可能遵守标准的党派路线。
en: These discussions – and thus the European Parliament that emerges next year – are unlikely to adhere to standard party lines.

zh: 毕竟如今要坚守传统的政治派系分类已是非常困难，比如马克龙自己的党派 — — 前进运动（La République En Marche！ ） — —就不符合传统的意识形态类别。
en: After all, sticking to traditional political groupings is highly difficult nowadays, as exemplified by Macron’s party – La République En Marche ! – which does not fit neatly into traditional ideological categories.

zh: 马克龙此举相当于对一个泛欧政党的成立做出试探。
en: Macron has put out feelers for a pan-European party.

zh: 虽然在欧洲真正的超国家政治仍然是个未知领域，但一个高度亲欧盟的政治家成为其先驱之一也不出所料。
en: Though truly supranational politics in Europe remains uncharted terrain, it makes sense that a strongly pro-EU politician should be one of its pioneers.

zh: 而那些宣扬民族主义以及反欧洲的右翼民粹主义者看似独来独往，但似乎也很希望在欧洲层面相互扶持，利用互相之间在大多数问题（特别是移民，文化认同和贸易）上的共同立场来获利。
en: Right-wing populists, as nationalist and anti-European as they may be, also seem eager to support one another at the European level, taking advantage of their common platforms on most issues, particularly immigration, cultural identity, and trade.

zh: 对于极左翼来说则更加困难，至少在法国是如此，因为他们得将对移民的传统自由主义观点与贸易保护主义经济政策结合在一起，而第二项政策看起来跟民粹主义右派所拥护的并无二致。
en: This will be more difficult for the far left, at least in France, which combines traditionally liberal views on immigration with protectionist economic policies that look at lot like those espoused by the populist right.

zh: 当然，过去五年中在西班牙，意大利，法国以及（在较小程度上）德国失去了大批选民的传统中右翼和中左翼党派将重新重试站稳脚跟。
en: Of course, the traditional center-right and center-left parties – which have lost a large share of the electorate over the last five years, particularly in Spain, Italy, France, and, to a lesser extent, Germany – will try to regain their own footing.

zh: 问题在于，无论领导人的年龄大小，这些政党对许多年轻选民来说都显得过时了。
en: The problem is that these parties seem outdated to many younger voters, regardless of their leaders’ age.

zh: 如果它们还想赢得选举，就需要构筑一个鼓舞人心的新平台去令人信服地应对当前的问题 — — 同时还要与新的政治力量进行抗衡。
en: If they are to succeed, they will need to provide an inspiring new platform that convincingly addresses the issues of the today – all while contending with new political forces.

zh: 然而，新的政治势力有时也会吸收传统的中右派和中左派。
en: It is possible, however, that new political forces will in some cases absorb traditional center-right and center-left parties.

zh: 例如，在法国，马克龙的政党可以吸收中右翼的法国共和党（Les Republicains ） ， 或者进一步向左翼移动，借助一个社会团结计划来配合其已经采取的自由市场措施。
en: In France, for example, Macron’s party could absorb the center-right Les Republicains, or it could shift further to the left, with a social solidarity program to accompany the liberal market measures it has already taken.

zh: 问题在于该党的领导人是否认为他们可以同时取得对共和党和中左派社会主义者的胜利。
en: The question is whether the party’s leaders think they can secure a simultaneous victory against Les Republicains and the center-left Socialists.

zh: 虽然细节仍未明朗，但一场对欧洲政治现状的彻底重组 — — 这在很大程度上是由人们对欧洲的态度所决定的 — — 似乎是板上钉钉的事情。
en: Although the details remain unclear, a thorough restructuring of the European political scene – shaped largely by attitudes toward Europe – seems certain.

zh: 如果明年的欧洲议会选举有助于推动这一重组，这可能最终成为向欧洲民主迈出的一大步。
en: If the European Parliament election next year helps to advance this restructuring, this may end up constituting a large step forward for democracy in Europe.

zh: 欧洲的代际冲突
en: Europe’s Clash of Generations

zh: 伦敦—随着欧洲金融危机由急性转为慢性，关于谁来承担解决危机的成本的争论正在让新一代政治运动浮出水面。
en: LONDON – As Europe’s financial crisis goes from acute to chronic, the dispute over who will bear the costs of resolving it is fueling the emergence of a new generation of political movements.

zh: 在所谓的外围，政治新贵向人民承诺采取紧缩的替代方案。
en: In the so-called periphery, political upstarts promise citizens an alternative to austerity.

zh: 在欧元区的“核心”国家，他们宣称要保护纳税人免受拯救债务国的无理要求的折磨。
en: In the eurozone’s “core” countries, they purport to protect taxpayers from relentless demands for debtor-country relief.

zh: 欧洲领导人如何应对这些新的政治挑战将决定货币联盟是走向稳定还是分裂。
en: How Europe’s leaders respond to these new political challengers will determine whether the monetary union stabilizes or fractures.

zh: 在过去的大部分时间里，欧洲政治精英极力主张融合。
en: Europe’s political elite have, for the most part, been strongly integrationist.

zh: 他们大多是二战后一代，十分清楚和平的欧洲的好处。
en: Given that they are largely of the post-World War II generation, they are acutely aware of the benefits of a peaceful Europe.

zh: 20世纪90年代，关于欧洲一体化的不同愿景催生了有问题的妥协。
en: In the 1990’s, differing visions of European integration led to a problematic compromise.

zh: 为了确保法国支持德国的重新统一，德国同意建立货币联盟 — — 而不是财政联盟。
en: In order to secure France’s backing for German reunification, Germany agreed to create a monetary union – but not a fiscal union.

zh: 如今，欧洲正在经受这一浮士德式讨价还价的后果。
en: Now, Europe is suffering the consequences of that Faustian bargain.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲领导人面临新一代选民的压力，他们成长于柏林墙倒塌的影响下。
en: At the same time, Europe’s leaders are under pressure from a new generation of voters, who grew up in the shadow of the Berlin Wall’s collapse.

zh: 铁幕的升起让西方得到了来自东欧的充足的廉价劳动力供应。
en: The lifting of the Iron Curtain gave the West access to a vast supply of cheap labor in Eastern Europe.

zh: 随后，中国的崛起让廉价劳动力供应进一步扩大了，并在2001年中国加入世贸组织时达到高峰。
en: China’s subsequent emergence expanded that supply further, culminating with China’s entry into the World Trade Organization in 2001.

zh: 结果，许多欧洲经济体开始落后。
en: As a result, many of Europe’s economies began to fall behind.

zh: 欧洲领导人希望货币联盟能帮助欧洲缺少竞争力的经济体赶超北欧的富裕国家。
en: European leaders hoped that a monetary union would help Europe’s less competitive economies catch up to the richer countries of the north.

zh: 在第一个十年里，欧元表面上达到了这一目的。
en: And, during its first decade, the euro ostensibly delivered.

zh: 正如廉价按揭融资糊住了美国不断增长的收入不平等裂缝，来自北欧的廉价资本加速了欧洲表面上的经济趋同。
en: Just as cheap mortgage financing papered over the cracks of growing income inequality in the United States, cheap capital from the north accelerated Europe’s apparent economic convergence.

zh: 柏林墙后一代似乎获得了命运的垂青 — — 至少是暂时性地。
en: The post-Wall generation seemed to have all the luck – at least for a while.

zh: 但收入不平等在所有成员国都在稳步恶化，教育层次高的公民受益于服务业繁荣，而教育层次低的公民遭难于制造业向低成本地区的转移。
en: But income inequality was worsening steadily in all member countries, with more highly educated citizens benefiting from the booming services industry, while the less educated suffered as manufacturing moved to cheaper locations.

zh: 接着，全球金融危机爆发，收入不平等大幅上升，南欧的柏林墙后一代遭遇了二战后最严重的生活水平下降。
en: Then, the global financial crisis struck, income inequality rose sharply, and the post-Wall generation in southern Europe suffered the largest drop in living standards since WWII.

zh: 与美国不同 — — 美国建立在反对英国殖民主义的政治目标基础上，这铸造了共同的国民身份 — — 加入欧盟的诸国只是为了寻求进一步躲避大陆战乱。
en: Unlike the US, which was founded on a political cause – opposition to British colonialism – that forged a common national identity, countries joining the European Union sought simply to avoid further warfare on the continent.

zh: 这当然值得赞赏，但如此目标不足以铸造共同的欧洲身份。
en: While laudable, this cause was inadequate to foster a shared European identity.

zh: 相反，它让民族身份坐大了。
en: On the contrary, it allowed national identity to flourish.

zh: 柏林墙后一代 — — 他们年龄不到40，没有经历过二战 — — 对这一目标毫无共鸣。
en: The post-Wall generation, whose members are less than 40 years old and thus far removed from WWII, has little appreciation for this cause.

zh: 对他们来说，债务国和债权国日渐分歧的经济目标才更有意义得多。
en: For them, debtor and creditor countries’ increasingly divergent economic objectives are much more meaningful.

zh: 债务国公民 — — 他们成长于对经济趋同的得意中 — — 失去了储蓄，很多人还失去了希望。
en: Citizens of debtor economies, who grew up complacent about economic convergence, have lost their savings and, in many cases, have run out of hope.

zh: 与此同时，债权国公民着眼于保护他们在危机前所赚得的好处；毕竟，是他们的储蓄替邻国不知节制的花钱提供了融资。
en: Meanwhile, citizens of creditor countries are focused on protecting the gains made before the crisis; after all, it was their savings that financed their neighbors’ reckless spending.

zh: 在整个欧元区，上升的收入不平等已经造成了一个下等阶级，他们越来越质疑货币联盟。
en: Throughout the eurozone, rising income inequality has created an underclass that is increasingly suspicious of the monetary union.

zh: 随着战后一代老去 — — 他们大部分人至少已经60岁，其领袖要么身居高位，要么是资深政客 — — 对一体化的支持正在消失。
en: As the post-war generation ages – with most of its members now at least 60 years old and its leaders either in senior leadership positions or acting as senior statesmen – the remaining support for integration is waning.

zh: 许多柏林墙后一代选民或者是老牌政党的边缘人，或者在建立他们自己的新政党，与此同时，更务实的群体被旧秩序和新运动争相争取。
en: Many post-Wall voters stand on the margins of established parties or are forming parties of their own, while a more pragmatic group is being pulled between the old order and new movements.

zh: 对欧元危机的模糊而被动的反应反映了一种妥协，传统政党为了在代际差异日益极端时保有权力而做出了这一妥协。
en: The muddled, reactive response to the euro crisis reflects the compromises that traditional political parties have made in order to remain in power as generational differences have become increasingly extreme.

zh: 政治革命很少会产生于为时短暂的急性危机。
en: Political revolutions rarely arise out of brief periods of acute crisis.

zh: 它们往往产生于一代甚至几代人的缓慢衰落之后，那时，经济损失产生了愤怒目标、美妙承诺开始出现并编织应对措施。
en: Rather, they follow one or more generations of chronic decline, when fear of economic loss gives way to targeted anger, and charismatic voices surface to orchestrate the response.

zh: 这一模式在历史上屡试不爽，从法国大革命到柏林墙倒塌无一不是如此。
en: This pattern has recurred throughout history, from the French Revolution all the way to the fall of the Berlin Wall.

zh: 尽管市场现在已经被迫从命，但欧元区政治基础的裂缝正在开始显露。
en: Although markets may have been cowed into submission for now, the cracks in the eurozone’s political foundations are beginning to show.

zh: 现在，柏林墙后一代缺少明确的愤怒对象。
en: For now, the post-Wall generation lacks a clear focus for its anger.

zh: 意大利、希腊和德国的新民粹主义政党反映了政治的发展方向，而不是终点。
en: New populist parties in Italy, Greece, and Germany reflect the direction in which politics is moving, not the final destination.

zh: 他们能赢得左右两派的能力表明，重建战后一代所拆掉的保护性国家壁垒已是共识。
en: Their ability to win support from both the left and the right suggests a shared aspiration to rebuild the protective national barriers that the post-War generation demolished.

zh: 针对这一背景，大部分欧洲领导人担心他们的选民会拒绝任何暗示进一步一体化的方案。
en: Against this background, most European leaders are afraid that their electorates will reject anything that seems to imply more integration.

zh: 这是个典型的囚徒困境：如果所有国家都为共同目标努力，则所有国家都会受益，但国家选举的压力阻碍了政客推行这一目标的能力。
en: It is a classic prisoner’s dilemma: all countries are better off if they contribute to a common cause, but the pressure of national elections impedes politicians’ ability to champion that cause.

zh: 对领导人的终极考验将是欧盟条约改革承诺及其所包含的一切棘手谈判和公投。
en: The ultimate test of leadership will be a commitment to EU treaty reform, with all the thorny negotiations and referenda that this entails.

zh: 战后一代的政治领袖必须在新崛起的政治运动尚处于萌芽之势时对它们构成的挑战做出迅速而有效的反应。
en: The post-war generation’s political leaders must respond promptly and effectively to the challenge posed by emerging political movements while they are still immature.

zh: 如果等得太久，就墙会重新竖起，欧元卫士将万劫不复。
en: If they wait too long, the old walls will be restored and the euro’s guardians will be left out in the cold.

zh: 伊斯兰面目的欧洲政治？
en: European Politics With an Islamic Face?

zh: 伦敦—唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）扬言要禁止穆斯林进入美国，这引起了我的两位青年朋友的对话 ： “ 如果要在穆斯林移民和捍卫自由道德观之间作虎选择 ， ” 我问 ， “ 你会选哪个？
en: LONDON – Donald Trump’s call to bar Muslims from the United States provoked the following exchange with two young friends of mine: “If the choice was between Muslim immigration and preserving liberal moral values,” I asked, “which would you choose?”

zh: ”他们均否认了问题的前提。
en: They both denied the question’s premise.

zh: 移民本身，他们认为，也许存在反动道德，但他们的孩子们生长在今天的英国、美国或欧洲大陆，会与父辈大不相同。
en: The immigrants themselves, they suggested, might have reactionary moral codes, but their children, growing up in today’s Britain, America, or Continental Europe, would be quite different.

zh: 但果真如此吗？
en: But is that true?

zh: 我的问题的重点不是伊斯兰恐怖主义，即特朗普爆发的表面目标，而是大规模穆斯林移民给我的青年朋友（以及大部分受过教育的欧洲人）视为理所当然的道德观所造成的威胁。
en: My question focused not on Islamist terrorism – the ostensible ground of Trump’s outburst – but on the threat posed by large-scale Muslim immigration to the code of morals that my young friends, like most educated Europeans, now accept without question.

zh: 暂且把恐怖主义放在一边，如果伊斯兰教日益对英国法律和政治形成越来越大的影响，他们难道不会担忧吗？
en: Terrorism aside, wouldn’t they worry if Islam came to have a growing influence on British law and politics?

zh: 这可不是假设的可能性。
en: This is not just a hypothetical possibility.

zh: 2010年欧洲穆斯林人口，为4,410万，或总人口的6 % 。
en: The Muslim population in Europe was 44.1 million in 2010, or 6% of the total.

zh: 2011年英国穆斯林人口为270万（总人口的4.8 % ） ，而2001年只有160万。
en: There were 2.7 million Muslims in the United Kingdom in 2011 (4.8% of the population), up from 1.6 million in 2001.

zh: 从当前移民趋势以及更重要的穆斯林高于平均值的生育率（每户人家有三个孩子，英国平均水平为1.8个 ） ， 穆斯林占英国人口比重在未来几十年中必然会不断增加。
en: Given recent immigration trends and, more important, Muslims’ above-average fertility rate (three children per family versus the British average of 1.8), the Muslim share of the UK population is bound to grow for decades to come.

zh: 大量欧洲地区都面临着同样的人口趋势。
en: Much of Europe is on the same demographic trajectory.

zh: 当然，人口学不属于精确科学：很大程度上要取决于关于年龄结构、生活水平、不平等性等因素的假设，而穆斯林生育率迟早会向全国平均水平靠拢。
en: Of course, demographics is not an exact science: Much depends on assumptions about age profiles, standards of living, inequality, and so on, and sooner or later the Muslim fertility rate will converge with the national average.

zh: 但那时穆斯林人口已有快速增长 — — 可能占英国总人口的10—20 % 。
en: But by then the Muslim population will have expanded rapidly – to 10-20% of the total in the UK.

zh: 这一变化有什么后果是一个有趣的问题。
en: The interesting question concerns the consequences of this.

zh: 自由派不担心民族人口，因为他们认为个体最终会认同东道国社会的规范。
en: Liberals have not worried about ethnic demographics, because they assume that individuals eventually identify with the host society’s norms.

zh: 通常的观点是移民能充实东道国社会，他们与东道国社会不相容的特征都会留在母国。
en: The standard argument is that immigrants enrich the host, while leaving any incompatible characteristics at home.

zh: 特别是，他们的政治行为将与大多数人一致。
en: In particular, their political behavior will fall into line with that of the general population.

zh: 果真如此的话，人口民族构成的社会政治影响应该是中立甚至积极的。
en: If this is right, the sociopolitical impact of a change in the ethnic composition of a population is neutral, or even beneficial.

zh: 来自阿尔及利亚、孟加拉国、巴基斯坦或土耳其的移民将在一两代人的时间里实现人生观和政治观的欧洲化。
en: Immigrants from Algeria, Bangladesh, Pakistan, or Turkey will, in the course of a generation or two, become European in outlook and politics.

zh: 他们的宗教信仰将只是隐私问题，就像如今的大部分欧洲人那样，他们将在所有重要方面实现融合。
en: Their religion will become for them a private matter, as it now is for most Europeans, and they will become integrated in all important respects.

zh: 但在我看来，这一历史模式有一个关键前提，即移民规模小，并且在文化上与母国人口切断联系。
en: But that historical pattern, in my view, depended crucially on the small size of the immigrant population and its cultural closeness to the home population.

zh: （即使如此，同化的过程也绝非一帆风顺。
en: (Even so, the process of assimilation was far from frictionless.)

zh: ）历史经验没有告诉我们，数量上大得多的移民会带来怎样的社会和政治后果，也没有告诉我们，战后来到欧洲的移民（特别是穆斯林移民）的更加显著的文化差异会带来怎样的社会和政治后果。
en: Historical experience offers little guide to the social and political consequences of the much greater numbers and more pronounced cultural differences at stake in the postwar migrations to Europe, especially from the Muslim world.

zh: 他们的不相容性要大得多。
en: The incompatibilities are much greater.

zh: 问题的核心是当代欧洲文明是世俗文明，而穆斯林文明是宗教文明。
en: The nub of the problem is that contemporary European civilization is secular, whereas Muslim civilization is religious.

zh: 在欧洲，宗教已经失去了凌驾于法律、立法、教育、道德和商业之上的权威。
en: In Europe, religion has lost its authority over law, legislation, education, morals, and business life.

zh: 伊斯兰世界则尚未经历类似的过程。
en: The Islamic world has undergone no comparable process.

zh: 在伊斯兰世界，信仰和国家之间没有系统区分；家庭而非个人仍然是基本社会单元。
en: There is no systematic separation of faith and state; the family, not the individual, remains the basic social unit.

zh: 现代欧洲政治生活的基本要素 — — 个人权利和责任，以及人民对政府的问责权 — — 在伊斯兰世界特别是阿拉伯中东是不存在的。
en: The essential elements of modern European political life – individual rights and duties, and the accountability of government to the governed – are lacking, particularly in the Arab Middle East.

zh: 尽管存在一些世俗化努力，但穆斯林和西方世界观之间的距离在近几年越拉越大，在大部分穆斯林国家，宗教重新取得了支配地位。
en: Despite efforts at secularization, the gap between Muslim and Western outlooks has, if anything, grown in recent years, as religion has regained ascendancy in most Muslim countries.

zh: 伊斯兰教法 — — 其中最极端者坚持认定在西方早已不是犯罪的行为 — — 比如通奸和同性恋 — — 应该处以死刑 — — 影响着地方规范。
en: Sharia religious law – extreme versions of which hold that conduct decriminalized in the West, such as adultery and homosexuality, is punishable by death – influences their legal codes.

zh: 此外，在许多国家，绝大多数穆斯林认为伊斯兰教法应该成为官方法律。
en: Moreover, in many countries, large majorities of Muslims say Sharia should be the official law.

zh: 在欧洲，伊斯兰教是一个发展势头迅猛的宗教，而伊斯兰教法也渗透到了欧洲法律体系中。
en: In Europe, Islam is the fastest-growing religion, and Sharia has penetrated European legal systems.

zh: 在英国，有一百家伊斯兰法庭裁决着离婚和其他家庭案件，促使内政大臣特蕾莎·梅（Theresa May）承诺要审查伊斯兰法庭“已决定它们是否与英国价值观一致 ” 。
en: In the UK, a hundred Sharia courts adjudicate on divorce and other family cases, prompting Home Secretary Theresa May to promise a review of Sharia courts “to determine whether they are consistent with British values.”

zh: 世俗化不是不可避免的。
en: Secularization is not inevitable.

zh: 政治哲学家拉里·西登托普（Larry Siedentop）曾说 ， “ 世俗化是基督教给世界的礼物。
en: As the political philosopher Larry Siedentop has argued, “secularization is Christianity’s gift to the world.”

zh: ”在西登托普看来，基督教所特有的特征带来了自由个人主义，这是世界其他大宗教所没有的。
en: According to Siedentop, features specific to Christianity led to liberal individualism, and they are absent from the other great world religions.

zh: 反过来，世俗化带来的大礼物是宽容。
en: The great gift of secularism, in turn, has been tolerance.

zh: 尽管二十世纪的欧洲发生了可怕的倒退，但世俗化仍有助于钝化偏执，因为世俗理性不同于神启，不具有一锤定音的效力。
en: Despite horrific twentieth-century backsliding in Europe, secularism has served to blunt the edge of bigotry, because secular reasoning, unlike divine revelation, is never conclusive.

zh: 经济学家将移民视为个体追寻更好的生活的运动，支持用更多的移民来抵消人口老化或提供干“脏活”的工人。
en: Economists regard migration as a movement of individuals in search of a better life and call for more immigration to offset population aging, or to provide workers to do the “dirty jobs.”

zh: 但这一对“经济人”的召唤没有考虑到移民的一个关键特征：人们在穿越政治边境时也带来了他们的文化。
en: But such evocations of “economic man” miss a key dimension of migration: People carry their culture with them across political frontiers.

zh: 我们不能认为经济成功会自动带来文化趋同。
en: We should not assume that economic success automatically leads to cultural convergence.

zh: 这让我们回到了特朗普。
en: This brings us back to Trump.

zh: 不管美国发生了什么，未来几年进入欧洲的穆斯林移民仍将继续并有可能增加。
en: Whatever happens in the US, Muslim immigration into Europe will continue and even expand in the next few years.

zh: 光是叙利亚灾难就足以形成这一结果。
en: The Syrian catastrophe alone ensures this.

zh: 对话和教育能够弥合移民和东道国社会之间的差异，应该不遗余力地去做。
en: Everything that dialogue and education can do to close the gap between immigrant and host communities should be done.

zh: 但有可能无法阻止宗教政治的回归 — — 以及宗教偏执所带来的冲突。
en: But it may not be possible to prevent a return to religious politics – and the conflict which religious bigotry brings.

zh: 如果我们想要避免梦游着进入无比动荡的未来的情况，就必须认识到，融合失败，而不是恐怖主义，才是我们所面临的主要危险。
en: If we are to avoid sleepwalking into a highly troublesome future, we must recognize that failed integration, not terrorism, is the main danger we face.

zh: 欧洲的双重机会
en: Europe’s Double Opportunity

zh: 华盛顿—欧洲需要做一个决定。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Europe has a decision to make.

zh: 它可以在极权主义席卷美国（特朗普的“美国优先”方针）和中国（正从一党制向单一领袖政权转变）袖手旁观。
en: It can stand by as nationalism and authoritarianism flourish from the United States (with Donald Trump’s “America First” approach) to China (which is moving from a single-party system to a single-leader regime).

zh: 它也可以在科技驱动的日新月异的而变化需要政治、经济和社会等领域的重大改革时，领导民主价值观和国际合作复兴。
en: Or it can lead a reinvigoration of democratic values and international cooperation, at a time when rapid technology-driven change demands major political, economic, and social reforms.

zh: 一些人认为民粹主义 — — 主要来自右翼 — — 在欧盟的崛起是一个信号，表明欧盟远远没有做好起领导作用的准备，倒有可能解体。
en: Some view the rise of populism – mostly of the right-wing variety – in the European Union as a sign that, far from being ready to play a leadership role, the EU may be disintegrating.

zh: 但欧盟的情况比悲观派所提出的更加复杂 — — 也没有那么令人绝望。
en: But the EU’s situation is much more complicated than the pessimists make it out to be – and not nearly as bleak.

zh: 去年秋天，特别欧洲晴雨表647（Special Eurobarometer 467）调查显示，75%的受访者对欧盟持积极态度。
en: Last autumn, the Special Eurobarometer 467 survey showed that 75% of respondents viewed the EU positively.

zh: 尽管大部分受访者认为他们的孩子会比自己生活更加艰难，但三分之二的人相信欧盟给欧洲年轻人提供了希望 — — 较2016年上升了六个百分点。
