en: Though a majority of respondents think their children’s lives will be more difficult than theirs own, two-thirds believe that the EU offers hope for Europe’s youth – an increase of six percentage points from 2016.

zh: 年轻人似乎也同意。
en: Young people seem to agree.

zh: 较年轻的受访者（15—39岁）对欧盟持积极态度的比例尤其高。
en: The share of younger respondents (ages 15-39) who view the EU positively is particularly high.

zh: 尽管有人担忧欧盟的“民主赤字 ” ， 但这群人似乎认可政治参与的潜力。
en: And, despite concerns about the EU’s “democratic deficit,” this cohort seems to appreciate the potential for political participation.

zh: 去年5月，马克龙当选法国总统，这给了人们对欧盟的未来的信念注入了一针强心剂。
en: Faith in the EU’s future was buoyed last May by the election of French President Emmanuel Macron.

zh: 如果马克龙能确保德国与法国在欧洲改革计划上携手，欧盟的前景就会大大改善。
en: If Macron can secure Germany’s cooperation for his European reform program, the EU’s prospects will be strengthened further.

zh: 去年9月的德国联邦选举并未形成类似的强烈亲欧盟的结果 — — 极右翼德国选择党（Alternative for Germany）现为最大反对党，获得了近13%的选票 — — 主要温和政党仍然赢得了选举，赢得60%以上的选票。
en: While last September’s German federal election didn’t produce such a strongly pro-EU result – the far-right Alternative for Germany is now the largest opposition party, having secured nearly 13% of the vote – the main moderate parties still won the day, gaining more than 60% of the vote.

zh: 德国新联合政府至少与前任一项亲欧，而更强大的欧洲也是总理默克尔的合适的遗产。
en: Germany’s new coalition government is at least as pro-European as the one that preceded it, and a stronger Europe could be a fitting legacy for Chancellor Angela Merkel.

zh: 意大利的最新选举 — — 反移民的联盟党（League，票仓在北方）和左倾民粹主义五星运动（Five Star Movement，支持集中在南方）加起来赢得超过50%的选票 — — 这更加令人担忧。
en: Italy’s recent election – in which the anti-immigrant League party (with its electoral base in the north) and the left-leaning populist Five Star Movement (whose support is concentrated in the south) together won more than 50% of the vote – is more worrying.

zh: 但由于这两个党派互相对立，能维持下去的执政联盟将包括亲欧洲的民主党，说到底，妨碍意大利及其负债累累的经济给欧盟进一步一体化造成的阻碍不可能无法克服，只要法国和德国表现出果断的领导力。
en: Yet, given the antagonism between the two parties, it is likely that a governing coalition that can last will include the pro-European Democratic Party. Ultimately, whatever barriers Italy, with its debt-laden economy, poses to greater EU integration are unlikely to be insurmountable, if France and Germany exercise decisive leadership.

zh: 当然，英国退欧让欧洲难以承受。
en: Of course, Brexit will not be easy on Europe.

zh: 但总体而言，欧洲已不再是危机之洲。
en: But, overall, Europe no longer appears to be a continent in crisis.

zh: 即使在希腊，也实现了GDP增长恢复，大部分受访者目前都支持欧盟。
en: Even in Greece, which has restored GDP growth, a majority of respondents now supports the EU.

zh: 在这样的背景下，欧盟可能面临两个相关的机会。
en: In this context, the EU may be facing two related opportunities.

zh: 对内，它可以采取改革提高机构效率、推动一体化。
en: Internally, it can adopt reforms that boost institutional efficiency and advance integration.

zh: 对外，它可以坚决支持国际合作、人权和开放社会。
en: Externally, it can stand strongly for international cooperation, human rights, and open society.

zh: 要想抓住第二个机会，欧洲就必须在第一个机会方面取得进展，而这意味着强化欧元区。
en: Europe must make progress on the first opportunity if it is to seize the second, and that means strengthening the eurozone.

zh: 在这方面，马克龙提出了雄心勃勃的方案：一个独立的欧元区预算、一个负责这个预算的欧洲财政部长，以及一个问责上述财政部长的欧元区议会（由欧洲议会和国家议会成员组成 ） 。
en: On this front, Macron has already offered ambitious proposals: a separate eurozone budget, a eurozone finance minister responsible for it, and a eurozone parliament (composed of members of the European Parliament and national parliamentarians) to hold the finance minister accountable.

zh: 在德国新联合政府组建前，就成立了一个法国-德国工作组考察马克龙的方案。
en: Before Germany’s new coalition government was formed, a Franco-German working group was established to consider Macron’s proposals.

zh: 如今，默克尔的新政府已经就位，我们将看到德国支持欧元区拥有更强凝聚力的意愿有多强烈。
en: Now that Merkel’s new administration is in place, we will find out how far Germany is willing to go in supporting greater eurozone cohesion.

zh: 从短期看，德国新政府不太可能支持当前版本的马克龙方案。
en: In the short run, it seems unlikely that the new government will support Macron’s proposals in their current form.

zh: 但它可能支持完善银行联盟和一些促进欧元区经济政策协调的机制。
en: But it may back the completion of the banking union and some mechanism for greater coordination of eurozone economic policies.

zh: 从长期看，马克龙的一些改革应该是可行的，特别是如果允许欧元区国家在没有获得所有27个欧盟成员国一致同意的情况下就采取行动的话。
en: In the longer run, some of Macron’s reforms should be possible, especially if the eurozone countries are allowed to move forward without unanimous approval from all 27 EU member countries.

zh: 这样的变化 — — 以及更多的军事和情报合作 — — 将向欧洲工程注入新的活力、刺激新的热情，以及欧洲公民更大的安全感。
en: Such changes – along with more military and intelligence cooperation – will imbue the European project with a new dynamism, spurring more enthusiasm, not to mention a greater sense of security, among Europe’s citizens.

zh: 更加一体化和安全的欧盟很有利于在国际舞台上更有效地发出声音。
en: A more integrated and secure EU would be well positioned to assert itself more effectively on the international stage.

zh: 欧洲单一市场的GDP仍然比中国或美国更大，欧盟可以成为新世界秩序的第三“极 ” 。
en: With the European Single Market still boasting a larger GDP than China or the US, the EU can act as the third “pole” in a new world order.

zh: 它的经济开放、社会凝聚和机构强大的模式能够取代威胁到全球合作的孤立主义和民族主义趋势。
en: Its model of economic openness, social cohesion, and strong institutions can provide an alternative to the isolationist and nationalist tendencies that are threatening global cooperation.

zh: 不要搞错了：在贸易、气候变化、金融业监管、竞争政策和网络安全等领域，国际合作仍然至关重要。
en: And make no mistake: in areas such as trade, climate change, financial-sector regulation, competition policy, and cyber security, international cooperation remains critical.

zh: 而随着人工智能和生物科技带来了棘手的伦理问题，只有在国际层面上才能得到有效解决，国际合作更加变得不可或缺。
en: And it will become indispensable as advances in artificial intelligence and biotechnology raise thorny ethical issues that can be addressed effectively only at the international level.

zh: 从二战废墟中诞生、为防止未来灾难而制定的自由世界秩序正面临其诞生以来最严峻的考验。
en: The liberal world order that arose from the ruins of World War II to help prevent future catastrophes is facing its most difficult test yet.

zh: 我们必须在这个新的数字时代中重申国际主义、开放和民主的重要性，同时让我们的政策和规则适应新现实。
en: We must reaffirm the importance of internationalism, openness, and democracy in this new digital age, while adapting our policies and rules to new realities.

zh: 欧洲，以及其独一无二的建立超国家治理的民主模式的经验，应该在其中起到领导作用。
en: Europe, with its unique experience of creating a democratic model of supranational governance, should lead the way.

zh: 世界 — — 特别是年轻人 — — 对此翘首以盼。
en: The world – especially its young people – is counting on it.

zh: 特朗普时代的欧洲安全
en: European Security in the Trump Era

zh: 慕尼黑—在去年的慕尼黑安全会议上，欧洲安全官员的恐慌和担忧情绪都写在脸上。
en: MUNICH – At last year’s Munich Security Conference, the mood of fear and apprehension among European security officials was palpable.

zh: 三年前，俄罗斯吞并克里米亚并入侵东乌克兰。
en: Three years earlier, Russia had annexed Crimea and launched incursions into Eastern Ukraine.

zh: 去年，英国选民以微弱多数决定要求国家脱离欧盟，美国人则选了一位批评北约、公开仰慕俄罗斯总统普京的总统。
en: And in the previous year, a narrow majority of British voters had decided to take their country out of the European Union, and Americans had elected a president who was critical of NATO and openly admired Russian President Vladimir Putin.

zh: 尽管如此，西方仍然在特朗普时代生存了下来。
en: Still, the West has so far survived the age of Donald Trump.

zh: 而尽管混乱依然存在 — — 如英国退欧和德国领导人难以组成新政府 — — 欧盟似乎已经恢复。
en: And, despite the ongoing confusion over Brexit and German leaders’ difficulty in forming a new government, the EU seems to have bounced back.

zh: 大部分成员国经济表现良好，法国总统马克龙政府则为欧洲概念注入了新生命。
en: Most member states’ economies are doing well, and French President Emmanuel Macron’s administration is breathing new life into the European idea.

zh: 尽管特朗普政府在兑现其对美国人民的承诺方面继续表现模棱两可，但美国仍然兑现了前总统奥巴马加强北约在巴尔干半岛和波兰的军事部署的承诺。
en: Although the Trump administration has continued to send mixed signals about its willingness to uphold American commitments, the US has nonetheless delivered on former President Barack Obama’s pledge to strengthen NATO’s military posture in the Baltics and Poland.

zh: 而随着今年晚些时候的北约峰会的临近，美国表示它会做更多事确保巴尔干和斯堪的纳维亚成员国的领土完整。
en: And in the run-up to a NATO summit later this year, the US has indicated that it will do even more to ensure the territorial integrity of Baltic and Scandinavian member states.

zh: 此外，关于特朗普可能会与克里姆林宫形成新雅尔塔协议 — — 放弃东欧国家，让它们自寻活路 — — 的担忧已经烟消云散。
en: Moreover, fears that Trump might try to forge a new Yalta-style agreement with the Kremlin – in which Eastern European countries would be abandoned to their fate – have all but disappeared.

zh: 要说现在有什么担忧的话，主要是美俄关系日益恶化，甚至显得有些过度恶化。
en: If anything, the greater concern now is that US-Russian relations are becoming increasingly acrimonious, even irrationally so.

zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯渴望将其军队撤出局面棘手的俄叙利亚。 到目前为止，俄罗斯在叙利亚的军事牌打得相当出色。
en: Russia, meanwhile, seems eager to disengage its military from an intractable situation in Syria, where it has so far played its cards right.

zh: 乌克兰则并非如此，克里姆林宫认识到入侵绝非交朋友之道。
en: The same cannot be said for Ukraine, where the Kremlin has learned that invasions are not a good way to make friends.

zh: 俄罗斯的入侵将未来几代乌克兰人都推向了对立面，结果是让自己受到了堪称史上最严重的地缘政治反噬。
en: By alienating that country for generations to come, Russia has suffered a geopolitical setback of historic proportions.

zh: 迟早，俄罗斯也将止损并退出东乌克兰。
en: Sooner or later, Russia will want to cut its losses and disengage from Eastern Ukraine, too.

zh: 它已经提出了一个概念，即让联合国向东乌克兰派遣有限的维和部队。
en: It has already floated the idea of a limited United Nations peacekeeping operation there.

zh: 尽管俄罗斯尚未表示愿意放弃对乌俄边境的控制，对美谈判也没有取得什么进展，但普京显然知道现状是不可持续的。
en: And while Russia has not yet expressed a willingness to cede control of the Ukraine-Russia border, nor made progress in talks with the US, Putin surely knows that the status quo is unsustainable.

zh: 所有这些是否意味着一年前的担忧已经烟消云散？
en: Does all of this mean that the fears of a year ago have dissipated?

zh: 绝非如此。
en: Far from it.

zh: 近几年来的战略冲击留下了深刻而持续的裂痕，也将欧洲推向了崭新的未知领域。
en: The strategic shocks of recent years have left deep and lasting wounds, and pushed Europe into new and uncharted waters.

zh: 十年前，欧盟领导人信心满满地谈论如何在海外构建稳定。
en: A decade ago, EU leaders talked confidently about projecting stability abroad.

zh: 如今，他们的要务是防止动荡从外部溢入欧洲。
en: Today, their priority is to prevent instability from spilling over into Europe.

zh: 与此同时，越来越多的人认识到，尽管美国仍然是欧洲安全的保障，但这一保障不会永远存在。
en: At the same time, there is a growing awareness that while the US is still the main guarantor of European security, it might not be forever.

zh: 尽管一些伴随欧盟防务联盟呼声出现的说辞显然失之夸张，但与以往相比，欧盟领导人将更多注意力放在防务和安全问题上是正确的。
en: Even if some of the rhetoric accompanying proposals for an EU defense union has been vastly overblown, the bloc’s leaders are right to focus more on defense and security issues than they have in the past.

zh: 不管是通过“防务产业政策”还是其他方式实现，欧盟都需要发展通过联合响应措施应对未来硬实力威胁的能力。
en: Whether it is through “defense industrial policies” or something else, the EU needs to develop its capacity to marshal joint responses to future hard-power threats.

zh: 即便克里姆林宫已开始后悔其在2014年的所作所为，也仍然如此。 2014年的举动令西方大军压境。
en: This is true even if the Kremlin has come to regret its actions in 2014, which led to Western military forces being deployed on its borders.

zh: 毕竟，俄罗斯仍然占领着克里米亚，在那里长期保留着重要的军事基地。
en: After all, Russia is still holding on to Crimea, where it has long maintained key military bases.

zh: 此外，除了俄罗斯，欧洲还被其他冲突所包围。
en: And, apart from Russia, Europe is surrounded by ongoing conflicts.

zh: 不断升级的冲突从印度河延续到尼罗河并贯穿整个北非，任何动荡都会给欧洲安全造成直接影响。
en: Tensions are increasing from the Indus to the Nile and across North Africa, where any turmoil will have an immediate impact on European security.

zh: 欧洲人十分明白，不可能在地中海建造一堵墙。
en: As Europeans well know, there is no way to build a wall in the Mediterranean.

zh: 此外，特朗普政府几乎从来没有谈及如何维持战后自由国际秩序，这一点令人担忧。
en: Moreover, it is worrying that the Trump administration hardly ever talks about upholding the post-war liberal international order.

zh: 相反，特朗普政府将世界视为一场零和战略竞争，美国应该以只顾自身利益。
en: Instead, it views the world as a zero-sum strategic competition in which the US should look out only for itself.

zh: 不幸的是，这个世界不存在共同机构阻止主权国家之间冲突的升级，因此爆发全面战争的风险将持续上升。
en: Unfortunately, in a world without common institutions to restrain sovereign states from escalating conflicts with one another, the risks of all-out war will increase substantially.

zh: 诚然，美国说要加强其对欧洲安全的重视。
en: To be sure, the US says that it is stepping up its commitment to European security.

zh: 但是，考虑到中国日益强大的军事实力和在亚太地区的战略重要性，美国将别无选择，只能转向东方。
en: But, given China’s growing military might and the strategic importance of the Asia-Pacific region, the US will have no choice but to pivot to the East.

zh: 事实上，尽管特朗普对美国过度重视北约怨声载道，但美国已经将其主要军事支出用于亚太地区。
en: In fact, despite all of Trump’s complaints about America’s oversized contribution to NATO, the US already directs the bulk of its military spending to the Asia-Pacific region.

zh: 因此，尽管2017年的担忧已经平息，也恢复了一些正常化的感觉，但欧洲已不再能够回避为自身防务承担责任。
en: So, while the immediate fears of 2017 have subsided, and some sense of normality has returned, Europeans can no longer avoid taking responsibility for their own defense.

zh: 即使在特朗普身后，在硬实力冲突的世界中，拥有软实力也是不够的。
en: Even after Trump is long gone, soft power will not suffice in a world of hard-power conflicts.

zh: 欠缺理性的欧洲
en: Europe’s Lapse of Reason

zh: 纽约—终于，美国显现出从小布什执政末期爆发的危机中复苏的信号，这场几乎让美国金融系统崩溃的危机波及了全世界。
en: NEW YORK – At long last, the United States is showing signs of recovery from the crisis that erupted at the end of President George W. Bush’s administration, when the near-implosion of its financial system sent shock waves around the world.

zh: 但现在的复苏并不坚挺；充其量只是经济理应取得的成就和经济今天所处的位置之间的差距没有扩大。
en: But it is not a strong recovery; at best, the gap between where the economy would have been and where it is today is not widening.

zh: 如果这一差距正在缩小，那么速度也十分缓慢；危机所造成的伤害似乎是长期的。
en: If it is closing, it is doing so very slowly; the damage wrought by the crisis appears to be long term.

zh: 其实事情可能更加糟糕。
en: Then again, it could be worse.

zh: 放眼大西洋两岸，你甚至连平庸的美国式复苏也难以找到：欧洲经济目前所处的位置与其在不发生危机情况下所应该取得的成就之间的差距在继续扩大。
en: Across the Atlantic, there are few signs of even a modest US-style recovery: The gap between where Europe is and where it would have been in the absence of the crisis continues to grow.

zh: 在大部分欧盟国家，人均GDP还不如危机前。
en: In most European Union countries, per capita GDP is less than it was before the crisis.

zh: 失去的五年很快就会变成失去的十年。
en: A lost half-decade is quickly turning into a whole one.

zh: 在冰冷的数据背后，生活每况愈下，梦想遭遇打击，家庭因为年复一年的经济停滞 — — 有的地方则是经济萧条 — — 而被迫拆散（或无法组建 ） 。
en: Behind the cold statistics, lives are being ruined, dreams are being dashed, and families are falling apart (or not being formed) as stagnation – depression in some places – runs on year after year.

zh: 欧盟拥有才华横溢、受过良好教育的人民。
en: The EU has highly talented, highly educated people.

zh: 欧盟成员国拥有强大的法律框架和运转良好的社会。
en: Its member countries have strong legal frameworks and well-functioning societies.

zh: 危机前，大部分欧盟成员国的经济也在良好地运转。
en: Before the crisis, most even had well-functioning economies.

zh: 在一些地方，小时生产率 — — 或其增长率 — — 位列世界最高行列。
en: In some places, productivity per hour – or the rate of its growth – was among the highest in the world.

zh: 但欧洲并不是受害者。
en: But Europe is not a victim.

zh: 诚然，美国经济治理有问题；但是，美国并没有设法让危机的全球震波涌向欧洲，没有。
en: Yes, America mismanaged its economy; but, no, the US did not somehow manage to impose the brunt of the global fallout on Europe.

zh: 欧盟的问题是自己造成的，来自前所未有的持续经济决策失当，而首先就是欧元的创立。
en: The EU’s malaise is self-inflicted, owing to an unprecedented succession of bad economic decisions, beginning with the creation of the euro.

zh: 尽管创立欧元的初衷是统一欧洲，但最终欧元却在分裂欧洲；而在缺乏建立单一货币运转所需要的机构的意愿的情况下，欧元所造成的伤害也无从消除。
en: Though intended to unite Europe, in the end the euro has divided it; and, in the absence of the political will to create the institutions that would enable a single currency to work, the damage is not being undone.

zh: 从某种程度上讲，当前的乱象来自欧洲对一个早已破产的信念的坚持 — — 市场能够在信息和竞争不完美的情况下完美运转。
en: The current mess stems partly from adherence to a long-discredited belief in well-functioning markets without imperfections of information and competition.

zh: 自大也起到了一些作用。
en: Hubris has also played a role.

zh: 若非如此，如何解释这样的事实 — — 年复一���，欧洲官员对其政策后果的预测无不以错误告终？
en: How else to explain the fact that, year after year, European officials’ forecasts of their policies’ consequences have been consistently wrong?

zh: 这些预测错误的原因不在于欧盟国家没有实施规定的政策，而是在于作为这些政策基础的模型缺陷太大。
en: These forecasts have been wrong not because EU countries failed to implement the prescribed policies, but because the models upon which those policies relied were so badly flawed.

zh: 比如，在希腊，旨在降低债务负担的措施实际上导致了该国背上了比2010年还要沉重的债务负担：债务-GDP比率因为财政紧缩对产出所造成的消极影响而增加。
en: In Greece, for example, measures intended to lower the debt burden have in fact left the country more burdened than it was in 2010: the debt-to-GDP ratio has increased, owing to the bruising impact of fiscal austerity on output.

zh: 至少国际货币基金组织（IMF）承认了这些理论和政策失误。
en: At least the International Monetary Fund has owned up to these intellectual and policy failures.

zh: 欧洲领导人依然认为，必须以结构改革为重中之重。
en: Europe’s leaders remain convinced that structural reform must be their top priority.

zh: 但他们所指向的问题在危机前多年就已经显露无疑，并且此后从未停止扩大。
en: But the problems they point to were apparent in the years before the crisis, and they were not stopping growth then.

zh: 与成员国国内的结构改革相比，欧洲更加需要欧元区本身的结构改革以及扭转紧缩政策 — — 紧缩政策在提振经济增长方面一而再、再而三地失败。
en: What Europe needs more than structural reform within member countries is reform of the structure of the eurozone itself, and a reversal of austerity policies, which have failed time and again to reignite economic growth.

zh: 认为欧元无法生存下去的观点被一再证明是错误的。
en: Those who thought that the euro could not survive have been repeatedly proven wrong.

zh: 但是批评者有一点是正确的：除非改革欧元区的结构并扭转紧缩政策，否则欧洲不会复苏。
en: But the critics have been right about one thing: unless the structure of the eurozone is reformed, and austerity reversed, Europe will not recover.

zh: 欧洲的闹剧远未结束。
en: The drama in Europe is far from over.

zh: 欧盟的一大优势是其生机勃勃的民主。
en: One of the EU’s strengths is the vitality of its democracies.

zh: 但欧元让欧洲人民 — — 特别是危机国的国民 — — 无法决定他们的经济命运。
en: But the euro took away from citizens – especially in the crisis countries – any say over their economic destiny.

zh: 选民们反复选出新内阁，他们对经济的方向十分不满 — — 而新政府总是继续听命于布鲁塞尔、法兰克福和柏林所规定的方向。
en: Repeatedly, voters have thrown out incumbents, dissatisfied with the direction of the economy – only to have the new government continue on the same course dictated from Brussels, Frankfurt, and Berlin.

zh: 但是，这一切可以持续多久？
en: But for how long can this continue?

zh: 选民又将如何反应？
en: And how will voters react?

zh: 放眼欧洲，我们已经令人警觉地看到，极端民族主义政党正在崛起，站到了让欧洲取得如此大成功的启蒙价值的对立面。
en: Throughout Europe, we have seen the alarming growth of extreme nationalist parties, running counter to the Enlightenment values that have made Europe so successful.

zh: 在一些地区，大规模分裂主义运动正在兴起。
en: In some places, large separatist movements are rising.

zh: 如今，希腊正在给欧洲又一考验。
en: Now Greece is posing yet another test for Europe.

zh: 2010年以来，希腊GDP的下降程度远比美国在20世纪30年代大萧条期间更严重。
en: The decline in the Greek economy since the start of the crisis is in many ways worse than that which confronted America during the Great Depression of the 1930s.

zh: 年轻人失业率高达50%以上。
en: Youth unemployment is over 50%.

zh: 总理萨马拉斯政府已经倒闭，如今，由于议会无法选出新的希腊总统，可能将于1月25日举行提前大选。
en: Prime Minister Antonis Samaras’s government has failed, and now, owing to the parliament’s inability to choose a new Greek president, an early general election will be held on January 25.

zh: 反对党左翼同盟（Syriza party）在民意调查中领先。 该党承诺重新谈判希腊的欧元援助条款。
en: The left opposition Syriza party, which is committed to renegotiating the terms of Greece’s EU bailout, is ahead in opinion polls.

zh: 如果该党获胜但无法获得权力，那么一个主要原因将是恐惧欧盟的应对方式。
en: If Syriza wins but does not take power, a principal reason will be fear of how the EU will respond.

zh: 恐惧不是好情绪，也无法产生希腊向前进步所需要的国民统一意志。
en: Fear is not the noblest of emotions, and it will not give rise to the kind of national consensus that Greece needs in order to move forward.

zh: 问题不在希腊。
en: The issue is not Greece.

zh: 在欧洲。
en: It is Europe.

zh: 如果欧洲不改变它的道路 — — 如果它不改革欧元区并撤销紧缩 — — 就难免会遭遇群众抵制。
en: If Europe does not change its ways – if it does not reform the eurozone and repeal austerity – a popular backlash will become inevitable. Greece may stay the course this time.

zh: 今天，希腊也许能抵挡住此次冲击。
en: But this economic madness cannot continue forever. Democracy will not permit it.

zh: 但在恢复理性之前，欧洲还要承受多少痛苦？
en: But how much more pain will Europe have to endure before reason is restored?

zh: 欧洲合众为一？
en: E Pluribus Europe?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—过去五年的欧盟经济危机导致北部债权国和南部债务国裂痕日深。
en: BRUSSELS – The European Union’s economic crises of the last half-decade have fueled the emergence of a deep divide between the northern creditor countries and the southern debtors.

zh: 如今，欧洲移民危机则正在制造东西分裂，一边欢迎持续流入的难民，另一边什么忙都不想帮。
en: Now Europe’s migrant crisis is creating an east-west divide between the countries that are welcoming toward the ongoing influx of refugees, and those who want to do little, or nothing, to help.

zh: 除此之外还有成员国内部日益增加的政治分歧。 你一定会问：欧盟快要崩溃了吗？
en: Add to that growing political divisions within member countries, and one must ask: Is the EU coming unglued?

zh: 今年夏天，在希腊第三轮援助协议谈判期间，债权国/债务国分裂大为缓和。
en: The creditor/debtor split was thrown into sharp relief this summer, during the negotiations over Greece’s third bailout agreement.

zh: 紧缩派领导者、影响力最大的债权国德国被控灵活性和团结精神不足；希腊则被猛烈批评没能实施在前两次援助中承诺实施的改革。
en: Germany, the leading proponent of austerity and the most influential creditor, was accused of insufficient flexibility and solidarity; Greece, for its part, was lambasted for failing to implement the reforms that it promised the first two times it was bailed out.

zh: （是既不完全“北”也不完全“南”的法国最终成为促成协议的“关键先生 ” 。 ）
en: (It was France, neither entirely “north” nor entirely “south,” that ended up playing a vital role in facilitating the deal.)

zh: 如今，德国在移民危机中也试图充当领头羊，但这一回凭借的是慷慨。
en: Germany is now trying to lead the way in the migrant crisis as well, but this time by its generosity.

zh: 总理默克尔承诺，仅在今年德国就准备接收800,000以上的难民。
en: Chancellor Angela Merkel has pledged to take in more than 800,000 refugees just this year.

zh: 欢迎群众纷纷走上德国各大城市街头和火车站，为精疲力竭的难民提供饮水、食品和衣物。 许多难民走了数百英里、冒着生命危险，终于来到了安全的地方。
en: Welcoming crowds have lined streets and filled train stations in German cities, offering drinks, food, and clothing to the exhausted refugees, many of whom have walked hundreds of miles and risked their lives to get to safety.

zh: 默克尔有力地宣布伊斯兰教也是德国的宗教，但一些东欧人宣称他们只欢迎少数难民 — — 并且必须是基督教徒。
en: Whereas Merkel declared forcefully that Islam was also a religion of Germany, some in Eastern Europe have declared that they will welcome only a small number of refugees – and only if they are Christian.

zh: 如此顽固的态度正中全球伊斯兰极端分子下怀。
en: Such bigotry plays directly into the hands of Islamist extremists worldwide.

zh: 从欧盟成员国内部的政治分裂问题看，难民危机极具挑战性。
en: The refugee crisis is all the more challenging in view of EU member countries’ internal political fragmentation.

zh: 左翼支持谨慎接受难民，而越是右倾的人，对待难民的态度就越强硬。
en: While those on the left support cautious acceptance of refugees, the further one moves to the right, the more negative the attitude becomes.

zh: 就连默克尔所在的基督教民主联盟（Christian Democratic Union）的姊妹政党、巴伐利亚基督社会联盟（Christian Social Union）在难民问题上也是态度冷淡。
en: Even the Christian Social Union, the Bavarian sister party to Merkel’s Christian Democratic Union, has proved a reluctant partner in this area.

zh: 但还有另一个分裂，存在于英国和欧盟剩余部分之间。
en: Yet another divide lies between the United Kingdom and the rest of the EU.

zh: 英国与法国一起构成了欧洲防务的主力和全球事务重要权威（特别是气候和发展相关问题 ） ， 因此这一分裂趋势理应成为欧盟严重关注的问题。
en: Given the UK’s role, alongside France, as the key force in European defense and a significant authority in world affairs, particularly with regard to climate- and development-related issues, the prospect of a genuine split should be a source of serious concern for the EU.

zh: 这些分裂给以促进更有效决策的共同治理体系为基础的日益紧密的欧洲联盟这一梦想蒙上了阴沉的疑云。
en: These divisions have created deep doubts about the dream of ever-closer union in Europe, underpinned by a shared system of governance that allows for more effective decision-making.

zh: 类似地，这些分裂也不利于刺激经济增长所需要的改革的实施。
en: Likewise, they are not conducive to implementation of the reforms that are needed to spur economic growth.

zh: 但抹杀欧洲进一步一体化的进展还为时过早。
en: Yet it is still too early to write off progress toward increased European integration.

zh: 事实上，在欧盟凝聚力这一问题上，多重分裂可能好于一重分裂。
en: In fact, when it comes to EU cohesion, more cleavages are probably better than a single divide.

zh: 当经济问题独大、主宰争论时，北欧的顽固紧缩派无视任何凯恩斯主义考虑，而努力挣扎的南欧急切地需要财政空间来让刺激需求、创造就业岗位的结构性改革具有政治可行性。 北欧和南欧就这样陷入了拉锯。
en: When economic considerations alone were dominating the debate, austerity-obsessed northern Europe, oblivious to any Keynesian considerations, and struggling southern Europe, desperately in need of fiscal room to make demand-boosting, job-creating structural reforms politically feasible, were at loggerheads.

zh: 争论如此激烈，以至于一些德高望重的观察者甚至提出为德国及其周边地区创造“北欧元 ” ， 为地中海地区创造“南欧元 ” （ 法国应该归属哪个地区尚无定论 ） 。
en: The situation became so heated that some respected observers even proposed creating a “northern euro” for the region around Germany, and a “southern euro” in the Mediterranean (where France would fit was unclear).

zh: 在这样一个欧元区中，欧洲央行也必须分裂，北欧元将会升值。
en: In such a eurozone, the European Central Bank would have to split, and the northern euro would appreciate.

zh: 汇率不确定性将重新出现，不仅存在于两种欧元之间，不久也将存在于“北”和“南”区域之间，因为人们对货币联盟这一思想的信心已经崩塌。
en: Exchange-rate uncertainty would reappear, not only between the two euros, but also, before long, within the “northern” and “southern” zones, owing to the collapse of confidence in the very idea of a currency union.

zh: 在北欧元区，德国将扮演比现在还要重要的角色，这一局面可能制造新的紧张。
en: Within the northern bloc, Germany would play an even more outsize role than it does now, a situation that would likely generate new tensions.

zh: 类似地，对难民友好的西部和封闭的东部之间明确分裂将在事实上终结申根协定，因为政治分歧将深化为实体屏障，阻碍人们在欧盟内部的自由迁徙。
en: Similarly, a clear division between a refugee-friendly west and a closed east would effectively end the Schengen Agreement, because the political disagreement would harden into a physical barrier blocking the free movement of people within the EU.

zh: 这一分裂对欧洲凝聚力的伤害不亚于分裂的欧元区。
en: Such a split would be as damaging to Europe’s cohesion as a divided eurozone.

zh: 但在一个分裂中对立的国家，在另一个分裂中站在同一边，事情会怎么样？
en: But what if countries that are on opposite sides of one cleavage are on the same side of another?

zh: 德国、意大利、西班牙和瑞典在移民问题上一致，而希腊、法国、意大利和葡萄牙在欧元区宏观经济政策上站在同一阵营。
en: Germany, Italy, Spain, and Sweden may agree on the immigration issue, while Greece, France, Italy, and Portugal agree on eurozone macroeconomic policies.

zh: 法国、波��和英国可能愿意将更多支出用在防务上，而德国仍然是和平主义者。
en: France, Poland, and the UK may be willing to spend more on defense, while Germany remains more pacifist.

zh: 而德国、斯堪的纳维亚国家和英国又都是治理气候变化的先锋。
en: And Germany, the Scandinavian countries, and the UK may be at the forefront of the fight against climate change.

zh: 此外，基督教民主党（Christian Democrats ） 、 社会民主党（Social Democrats）等泛欧洲政治“家族”也可能在某些政策上互为盟友，而在另一些政策上争锋相对，超越国家和地区边界，触及泛欧洲政治，而欧洲议会的民主争论和监督功能日益增加。
en: Moreover, the Europe-wide political “families” of Christian Democrats, Social Democrats, and so on could be allies on some policies and opponents on others, transcending national or regional borders, and moving toward pan-European politics, with the European Parliament increasing its democratic debate and oversight functions.

zh: 一个各国无法明确归类为这一类或那一类的欧洲，一个在各种问题上组成灵活的统一战线的欧洲也许是比仅仅南北分裂或东西分裂的欧洲更好的进步机会。
en: A Europe where countries do not fit neatly into one category or another, and where flexible coalitions emerge on various issues, probably has a greater chance of progressing than one divided simply between north and south or east and west.

zh: 当然，强化欧盟机构、使其能够管理这一多样性并拿出政治效率协调这一多样性仍是一项挑战。
en: Of course, there remains the challenge of strengthening institutions so that they can manage this diversity and reconcile it with political effectiveness.

zh: 在这方面，扩大加权和双倍多数投票范围至关重要。
en: Here, greater scope for weighted and double-majority voting is crucial.

zh: 但是，对真正的民主社会来说，协调多样化利益的挑战永远不会消失。
en: But, for truly democratic societies, the challenge of reconciling divergent interests never goes away.

zh: 欧洲的联邦主义威胁
en: The Federalist Threat to Europe

zh: 发自斯德哥尔摩 — — 这个世界是在英国“脱欧”公投之后发生了根本性的变化。
en: STOCKHOLM – The world is fundamentally different after the “Brexit” referendum in the United Kingdom.

zh: 而只有再等几十年，我们才能真正认识到英国选民脱欧决定的全面影响。
en: It will be decades before we know the full effect of British voters’ decision to leave the European Union.

zh: 但有一件事是确定无疑的，就是虽然英国选民单方面作出了自己的决定，但保持与英国的紧密联系依然符合欧盟的最佳利益。
en: One thing we can know for sure, however, is that it is in the EU’s best interest to maintain strong ties with the UK, despite the fact that British voters made their decision unilaterally.

zh: 如果放任这一进程被可能掩盖或损害共同利益的细小权力博弈所左右，就必将影响到大局，正如欧洲政治中经常出现的那样。
en: Too much is at stake to allow the process to be dominated by petty power games that overshadow or undermine common interests, as happens so often in European politics.

zh: 在经济上，欧盟的增长无疑将从一个开放的对英贸易关系中受益。
en: Economically, growth in the EU will undoubtedly benefit from an open trading relationship with Britain.

zh: 包括金融服务在内的自由贸易协议将最大限度地减少脱欧对各方的伤害，因为欧洲企业仍然得依赖伦敦作为该地区唯一的全球金融中心。
en: A free-trade agreement that includes financial services will minimize the damage from Brexit for all parties involved, because European firms will still rely on London as the region’s only global financial center.

zh: 即使银行服务在欧元区其他地区迁移，沃尔沃，西门子和道达尔这样的企业如果还想与丰田，通用电气，埃克森公司竞争的话，就没法绕开伦敦。
en: Even if banking services migrate elsewhere in the eurozone, companies like Volvo, Siemens, and Total will still need London if they are to compete with companies like Toyota, GE, and Exxon.

zh: 在政治上，欧盟和英国都将从紧密合作中受益，因为任何一方都无法摆脱困扰本地区的众多问题。
en: Politically, the EU and the UK will benefit from maintaining close cooperation because neither side is spared from the problems afflicting the region today.

zh: 这些措施包括俄罗斯及其总统普京日益增加的侵略行径；ISIS兴起和本土恐怖主义威胁；以及从中东和北非涌入欧洲的难民。
en: These include increasing aggression from Russia and its president, Vladimir Putin; the rise of ISIS and the threat of homegrown terrorism; and refugees fleeing to Europe from the Middle East and North Africa.

zh: 此外，脱欧公投不会改变北约的战略重要性，维持合作非常必要，而且欧盟需要英国的程度并不亚于英国需要欧盟。
en: Moreover, the Brexit vote does not change the strategic importance of NATO, where continued cooperation is necessary and where the EU needs the UK as much as the UK needs the EU.

zh: 那么欧盟究竟该如何行动呢？
en: So, what should the EU do?

zh: 欧盟委员会主席让-克劳德·容克（Jean-Claude Juncker）呼吁建立更强化的联邦制 — — 将更多的权力委托给欧盟管理机构。
en: European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker has called for more federalism – for more power to be delegated to the EU’s governing institutions.

zh: 虽然我和容克私交不错，但我坚决不同意他这个想法。
en: I consider Juncker a close friend, but I strongly disagree with him about this idea.

zh: 向更深层次的一体化和中央控制体制推进将是一个危险的路径，因为这会增加其他成员国选择脱离欧盟的风险。
en: Moving toward deeper integration or centralized control would be a dangerous path to take, for it would increase the risk of other members choosing to leave the EU.

zh: 而在这一危机之外，还有其他原因要求不我们不要走上联邦制的道路。
en: And, beyond that hazard, there are other reasons to avoid federalist measures.

zh: 联邦主义者所提出的主要经济依据是欧元区需要一个共同的财政政策来协调税收等政策决策。
en: Consider the main economic argument offered by federalists: the eurozone needs a common fiscal policy to harmonize policy decisions, such as taxation.

zh: 但这是错误的，原因有二：
en: This is wrong for two reasons.

zh: 首先，欧盟的根本经济问题是结构性的。
en: First, the EU’s fundamental economic problems are structural.

zh: 只要欧洲人一天没有看到自身生活水平的改善，他们就将继续倾向于民粹主义，而这生活水平改善只能靠更高生产率增长来实现。
en: Europeans will continue to gravitate toward populism if they do not see improvements in their standard of living, which will happen only with higher productivity growth.

zh: 一个单一财政政策无法解决该问题 — — 并且可能使问题变得更糟。
en: A single fiscal policy would not bring this about – and could make the problem worse.

zh: 相反欧洲需要的是一个改革战略以提高竞争力并减少竞争壁垒。
en: What Europe needs, instead, is a reform strategy that increases competitiveness and reduces barriers to competition.

zh: 欧盟政策制定者尤其应当实施令劳动力市场更加灵活的政策。
en: In particular, EU policymakers should pursue policies that make labor markets more flexible.

zh: 这将包括降低边际税率，确定更严格的福利分配标准，为找工作设立更严格的要求，投入更多资源进行技能培训，同时减少限制性的就业保护法规。
en: These would include lower marginal tax rates, tighter criteria for determining benefits eligibility, stricter requirements for job searches, more resources for skills training, and less restrictive employment-protection regulation.

zh: 第二个原因是政治上的。
en: The second reason is political.

zh: 说白了，统一财政政策所需的加税和削减开支举措是不存在政治基础的。
en: Put plainly, there is no political support for the higher taxes and spending cuts that would be necessary with a common fiscal policy.

zh: 人们会指责布鲁塞尔浪费纳税人的金钱，而任何在无视民意的情况下强加给欧盟成员国的财政一体化只会适得其反，助长了令英国脱欧最终实现的民粹主义浪潮。
en: Brussels would be accused of wasting taxpayers’ money, and any effort to disregard public opinion and impose fiscal integration on EU members would only backfire and fuel the wave of populist rage that carried the Brexiteers to victory.

zh: 如今欧盟的支持者必须面对这样的事实：一个不断紧密联合的联盟并非欧洲人民的意志，即使是那些绝不会选择离开的成员国中也是如此。
en: Today, supporters of the EU must face the facts: an ever-closer union is not the European people’s will, even in the member states that would never choose to leave it.

zh: 如果欧洲委员会非得要在这个方向上描绘后脱欧时期的图景，其结果必将大相径庭。
en: If the European Commission forces the post-Brexit narrative in this direction, the result will be the opposite of what was intended.

zh: 事实上，联邦制可能是对欧盟未来的最大一个威胁。
en: In fact, federalism is probably the single greatest threat to the future of the EU.

zh: 谁想要欧盟的存续下去的人应当抵制夺取更多控制权的诱惑。
en: Those who want the EU to survive should resist the temptation to assert more control.

zh: 我们不需要一个在缺乏民意支持的新超级政治体制强压之下构筑的欧洲一体化，而是一个符合欧洲本身意愿的一体欧洲。
en: We need a Europe that stands united because it wants to, not because it is forced to by new political super-structures that lack any underpinning of popular support.

zh: 欧洲大门里的野蛮人
en: Europe’s Barbarians Inside the Gate

zh: 柏林—我正在欧洲作为期两周的旅行，眼下，我对欧洲的前景既不特别悲观，也不建设性地乐观。
en: BERLIN – I am on a two-week European tour at a time that could make one either very pessimistic or constructively optimistic about Europe’s prospects.

zh: 首先是坏消息：在经历了本月早些时候骇人听闻的恐怖袭击后，巴黎显得十分低落，甚至可以说是抑郁。
en: First the bad news: Paris is somber, if not depressed, after the appalling terrorist attacks earlier this month.

zh: 法国经济增长依然萎靡，失业者和许多穆斯林心怀怨念，马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）的极右翼政党国民阵线有望在即将举行的地区选举中表现出色。
en: France’s economic growth remains anemic, the unemployed and many Muslims are disaffected, and Marine Le Pen’s far-right National Front is likely to do well in the upcoming regional elections.

zh: 布鲁塞尔因为恐怖袭击风险已经沦为半座死城，管制严格。 但欧盟机构仍没有制定出统一的战略管理移民和难民的涌入，更不用说解决欧盟近邻的动荡和暴力了。
en: In Brussels, which was semi-deserted and in lockdown, owing to the risk of terrorist attacks, the European Union institutions have yet to devise a unified strategy to manage the influx of migrants and refugees, much less address the instability and violence in the EU’s immediate neighborhood.

zh: 在欧元区之外，伦敦担心来自货币联盟的消极金融和经济溢出效应。
en: Outside the eurozone, in London, there is concern about negative financial and economic spillover effects from the monetary union.

zh: 移民危机和最近的恐怖袭击意味着关于是否保留欧盟成员资格的全民公决 — — 有望在明年举行 — — 可能导致英国退出欧盟。
en: And the migration crisis and recent terrorist attacks mean that a referendum on continued EU membership – likely to be held next year – could lead the United Kingdom to withdraw.

zh: 接下来，英国本身也有可能分裂 ， “ 英国退出”可能导致苏格兰人宣布独立。
en: This would probably be followed by the breakup of the UK itself, as “Brexit” would lead the Scots to declare independence.

zh: 与此同时，在柏林，德国首相默克尔的领导地位受到日益严重的压力。
en: In Berlin, meanwhile, German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s leadership is coming under growing pressure.

zh: 她决定让希腊留在欧元区，勇敢但不受欢迎地选择了允许一百万难民进入德国，再加上大众公司丑闻和经济增长减速（拜中国和新兴市场减速所赐 ） ， 就连她本身的政党内也出现了批评她的声音。
en: Her decision to keep Greece in the eurozone, her courageous but unpopular choice to allow in a million refugees, the Volkswagen scandal, and flagging economic growth (owing to the slowdown of China and emerging markets) have exposed her to criticism even from her own party.

zh: 法兰克福是一座分裂的决策之城：德国央行反对量化宽松和负利率，而欧洲央行准备加码这些政策。
en: Frankfurt is a divided city, policy-wise: the Bundesbank opposes quantitative easing and negative policy rates, while the European Central Bank is ready to do more.

zh: 但节俭的德国储户 — — 家庭、银行和保险公司 — — 对欧洲央行从他们（以及其他欧元区核心国）身上征税补贴欧元区外围饱受诘难的不知节制的花钱大户和借款人十分愤怒。
en: But Germany’s thrifty savers – households, banks, and insurance companies – are furious about ECB policies that tax them (and others in the eurozone core) to subsidize the eurozone periphery’s alleged reckless spenders and debtors.

zh: 在这样的环境下，根本无法形成一个稳定的货币联盟最终必须具备的完整的经济、银行、财政和货币联盟：欧元区核心国反对进一步风险共担、凝聚和加快一体化。
en: In this environment, the full economic, banking, fiscal, and political union that a stable monetary union eventually requires is not viable: The eurozone core opposes more risk sharing, solidarity, and faster integration.

zh: 左翼和右翼民粹主义政党 — — 它们反欧盟、反欧元、反移民、反贸易、反市场 — — 正在全欧洲风生水起。
en: And populist parties of the right and left – anti-EU, anti-euro, anti-migrant, anti-trade, and anti-market – are becoming stronger throughout Europe.

zh: 但在欧洲所面临的所有问题中，只有移民危机可能演变为生存危机。
en: But of all the problems Europe faces, it is the migration crisis that could become existential.

zh: 在中东、北非以及从萨赫勒到非洲之角的广袤地区，大约存在2,000万流民；内战、无处不在的暴力以及国家失败已经成为常态。
en: In the Middle East, North Africa, and the region stretching from the Sahel to the Horn of Africa, there are about 20 million displaced people; civil wars, widespread violence, and failed states are becoming the norm.

zh: 如果欧洲无法吸收一百万难民，还如何最终解决2,000万？
en: If Europe has trouble absorbing a million refugees, how will it eventually handle 20 million?

zh: 除非欧洲能够防卫其对外边界，否则申根协定将崩溃，其内部边界将重新出现，欧盟内部大部分地区自由迁徙 — — 欧洲一体化的核心原则 — — 将是明日黄花。
en: Unless Europe can defend its external borders, the Schengen agreement will collapse and internal borders will return, ending freedom of movement – a key principle of European integration – within most of the EU.

zh: 但一些人所反对的解决方案 — — 关闭难民进入欧洲的大门 — — 只会让问题更加恶化，动摇土耳其、黎巴嫩和约旦等已经吸收了数百万难民的国家。
en: But the solution proposed by some – close the gates to refugees – would merely worsen the problem, by destabilizing countries like Turkey, Lebanon, and Jordan, which have already absorbed millions.

zh: 而补偿土耳其和其他国家继续收留难民代价巨大并且不可持续。
en: And paying off Turkey and others to keep the refugees would be both costly and unsustainable.

zh: 而大中东（包括阿富汗和巴基斯坦）和非洲的问题无法光靠军事和外交手段解决。
en: And the problems of the greater Middle East (including Afghanistan and Pakistan) and Africa cannot be resolved by military and diplomatic means alone.

zh: 这些（和其他）冲突背后的经济因素将恶化：全球气候变化正在加速沙漠化和水资源的耗竭，对农业和其他经���活动带来灾难，引发种族、宗教、社会和其他形式的暴力。
en: The economic factors driving these (and other) conflicts will worsen: global climate change is accelerating desertification and depleting water resources, with disastrous effects on agriculture and other economic activity that then trigger violence across ethnic, religious, social, and other cleavages.

zh: 至少必须有规模相当于马歇尔计划的金融资源援助 — — 特别是以重建中东为目标的援助 — — 才能确保长期稳定。
en: Nothing short of a massive, Marshall Plan-style outlay of financial resources, especially to rebuild the Middle East, will ensure long-term stability.

zh: 欧洲能够并且愿意承担它应该承担的部分吗？
en: Will Europe be able and willing to pay its share of it?

zh: 如果找不到经济解决方案，那么这些地区的冲突最终将动摇欧洲，数百万绝望无助的人最终将走向极端，指责西方必须为他们的苦难负责。
en: If economic solutions aren’t found, eventually these regions’ conflicts will destabilize Europe, as millions more desperate, hopeless people eventually become radicalized and blame the West for their misery.

zh: 即使建立一道环绕欧洲的墙 — — 根本不可能 — — 许多人仍会设法进入欧洲，其中一些人将在未来几十年中在欧洲从事恐怖活动。
en: Even with an unlikely wall around Europe, many would find a way in – and some would terrorize Europe for decades to come.

zh: 因此，一些评论家煽动紧张，大谈“门口的野蛮人 ” ， 并将欧洲的现状与罗马帝国衰亡开始时相比较。
en: That’s why some commentators, inflaming the tensions, speak of barbarians at the gates and compare Europe’s situation to the beginning of the end of the Roman Empire.

zh: 但欧洲绝非注定会崩溃。
en: But Europe is not doomed to collapse.

zh: 它目前所面临的冲突可能带来更大的凝聚力、更多的风险共担和进一步机构一体化。
en: The crises that it now confronts could lead to greater solidarity, more risk sharing, and further institutional integration.

zh: 德国可能吸收更多的难民（尽管达不到每年一百万的速度 ） 。
en: Germany could absorb more refugees (though not at the rate of a million per year).

zh: 法国和德国可能提供和出资针对伊斯兰国的军事干预。
en: France and Germany could provide and pay for military intervention against the Islamic State.

zh: 整个欧洲以及世界其他地区 — — 美国、波斯湾富裕国家 — — 可能提供大量资金用于支持难民并最终出资筹建失败国家，为数以亿计的穆斯林和非洲人民提供经济机会。
en: All of Europe and the rest of the world – the US, the rich Gulf States – could provide massive amounts of money for refugee support and eventually funds to rebuild failed states and provide economic opportunity to hundreds of millions of Muslims and Africans.

zh: 这对欧洲和世界来说是一个沉重的财政负担 — — 当前欧元区和全球财政目标必须做出适当调整。
en: This would be expensive fiscally for Europe and the world – and current fiscal targets would have to be bent appropriately in the eurozone and globally.

zh: 但另一边是全球混乱，乃至教皇方济各所警告的第三次世界大战的爆发。
en: But the alternative is global chaos, if not, as Pope Francis has warned, the beginning of World War III.

zh: 欧元区的黑暗中也有一丝曙光。
en: And there is light at the end of the tunnel for the eurozone.

zh: 受未来多年货币宽松和日益灵活的财政规则支持，周期性复苏已经开始。
en: A cyclical recovery is underway, supported by monetary easing for years to come and increasingly flexible fiscal rules.

zh: 银行部门将开始更多的风险共担（下一步是泛欧盟存款保险机制 ） ， 最终，宏大的财政联盟方案会被采纳。
en: More risk sharing will start in the banking sector (with EU-wide deposit insurance up next), and eventually more ambitious proposals for a fiscal union will be adopted.

zh: 结构性改革 — — 不管多么缓慢 — — 将继续逐渐提振潜在和实际增长。
en: Structural reforms – however slowly – will continue and gradually increase potential and actual growth.

zh: 欧洲的模式一直是危机带来 — — 不管多么缓慢 — — 更多的一体化和风险共担。
en: The pattern in Europe has been that crises lead – however slowly – to more integration and risk sharing.

zh: 如今，欧元区（从希腊开始）和欧盟本身（从英国退出开始）都面临着生存威胁，开明欧洲领导人必须站出来维持朝向加深统一的趋势。
en: Today, with risks to the survival of both the eurozone (starting with Greece) and the EU itself (starting with Brexit), it will take enlightened European leaders to sustain the trend toward deeper unification.

zh: 当今世界，既有老牌和新兴力量（美国、中国和印度 ） ， 也有衰落的修正主义力量（如俄罗斯和伊朗 ） ， 一个分裂的欧洲将沦为地缘政治侏儒。
en: In a world of existing and rising great powers (the US, China, and India) and weaker revisionist powers (such as Russia and Iran), a divided Europe is a geopolitical dwarf.

zh: 幸运的是，柏林的开明领导人 — — 其实为数绝不少，尽管人们的感觉与此相反 — — 明白德国的未来系于更加强大、更加一体化的欧洲。
en: Fortunately, enlightened leaders in Berlin – and there are more than a few of them, despite perceptions to the contrary – know that Germany’s future depends on a strong and more integrated Europe.

zh: 他们，以及欧洲各地的明智领导人都知道，这需要合适的凝聚力形式，包括能够解决欧洲周边问题的统一的外交政策。
en: They, together with wiser European leaders elsewhere, understand that this will require the appropriate forms of solidarity, including a unified foreign policy that can address the problems in Europe’s neighborhood.

zh: 但凝聚力从自身内部开始。
en: But solidarity begins at home.

zh: 而这意味着支持总需求和促增长改革以确保就业和收入复苏更加坚挺，从而消灭大门里的民粹主义和民族主义野蛮人。
en: And that means beating back the populists and nationalist barbarians within by supporting aggregate demand and pro-growth reforms that ensure a more resilient recovery of jobs and incomes.

zh: 欧洲的领导危机
en: Europe’s Leadership Crisis

zh: 布鲁塞尔—欧盟的危机名单还在加长。
en: BRUSSELS – The European Union’s list of crises keeps growing.

zh: 但是，除了英国“退欧”公投、波兰宪法法院乱象、俄罗斯扩张主义、移民和难民问题以及民族主义复兴，欧盟最大的威胁来自内部：政治领导层正在让欧盟机构陷入瘫痪。
en: But, beyond the United Kingdom’s “Brexit” vote to leave the bloc, Poland’s constitutional-court imbroglio, Russian expansionism, migrants and refugees, and resurgent nationalism, the greatest threat to the EU comes from within: a crisis of political leadership is paralyzing its institutions.

zh: 好像是为了证明这一点似的，欧盟成员国领导人（英国首相梅除外）最近齐聚斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发试图证明欧洲的团结，并启动英国退出后的改革进程。
en: As if to prove the point, EU member states’ leaders (with the exception of UK Prime Minister Theresa May) met recently in Bratislava, Slovakia, in an attempt to demonstrate solidarity, and to kick-start the post-Brexit reform process.

zh: 与会者在构建欧洲防御联盟方面取得了一些进展 — — 这令人欣喜，并且朝着承认欧盟当前组织框架不可持续迈进了一步；但对有意义的机构和经济改革几乎只字未提。
en: The attendees made some progress toward creating a European Defense Union, which should be welcomed, and toward admitting that the EU’s current organizational framework is unsustainable; but there was scant talk of meaningful institutional or economic reform.

zh: 与此同时，意大利总理伦齐在峰会闭幕时拒绝与法国总统奥朗德和德国首相默克尔同台，这确认了人们对领导层失去方向正在加剧机构功能失调的担忧。
en: Meanwhile, Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi’s refusal, at the close of the summit, to appear onstage with French President François Hollande and German Chancellor Angela Merkel all but confirmed fears that rudderless leadership is fueling institutional dysfunction.

zh: 本应为团结正名的峰会反而揭露了更深层的分歧。
en: A summit that was supposed to be a display of unity revealed only further division.

zh: 欧盟领导人必须为最近的失败负责。
en: EU leaders must take responsibility for this latest failure.

zh: 首先，他们必须停止许诺空头支票。
en: For starters, they must stop issuing empty declarations.

zh: 欧盟机构能力欠缺是显而易见的，特别是在面临其敌人时。
en: The EU’s institutional impotence is apparent, especially to its enemies.

zh: 因此现在欧盟面临严峻选择：向统一跃进，或陷入不可避免的解体。
en: So now it faces a stark choice: a leap forward toward unification or inevitable disintegration.

zh: 新欧洲人想做出选择。
en: Few Europeans want to make that choice.

zh: 许多政客担心推动欧盟改革议程会导致他们付出高昂的国内政治代价。
en: Many politicians are afraid of paying a high domestic political price for pursuing an agenda of EU reform.

zh: 他们指出，在当前政治环境下追求进一步一体化是鲁莽的，欧盟应该专注于少做、做好。
en: They argue that pushing for further integration in the current political climate is reckless, and that the EU should focus on doing less, better.

zh: 但这是错误的权衡。
en: But that is a false trade-off.

zh: 欧盟可以构建一个更加一体化的经济治理模式以增加投资、创造就业，与此同时理顺它的操作流程以解决对繁文缛节和机能失调的抱怨。
en: The EU could build a more integrated economic-governance model to increase investment and create jobs, while at the same time streamlining its operations to address common complaints about red tape and dysfunction.

zh: 极少有欧洲领导人理解欧盟 — — 及其自身的政治未来 — — 的真正风险是现状。
en: Few European leaders seem to understand that the real risk to the EU – and to their own political futures – is the status quo.

zh: 放眼欧洲，民粹主义运动正在投票箱中横扫传统政党，带来真正变化的窗口正在快速关闭。
en: And with populist movements across Europe pummeling traditional parties in the polls, the window for delivering real change is quickly closing.

zh: 这并不是宿命。
en: It does not have to be this way.

zh: 太多领导人对国内民族主义者和民粹主义者只是动动嘴皮子，错误地认为这样就能捍卫他们的国内支持率，而他们实际上应该表现出真正的领导力以及为人民利益而斗争。
en: Too many leaders are paying lip service to domestic nationalists and populists, mistakenly thinking that this will preserve their domestic poll ratings, when they should be showing genuine leadership and fighting for the common good.

zh: 即将到来的法国和德国大选将是欧洲领导层未来的风向标。
en: Upcoming national elections in France and Germany will be bellwethers for the future of European leadership.

zh: 在最新的德国地方选举中，默克尔的基督教民主联盟及其执政伙伴社会民主党遭遇惨败，这可能意味着德国执政联盟明年大选告急。
en: In recent German state elections, Merkel’s Christian Democratic Union and its government partner, the Social Democratic Party, experienced notable losses, which could mean that Germany’s grand coalition is at risk ahead of next year’s election.

zh: 与此同时，对极右翼的德国另类党（AfD）的支持率持续攀升。
en: Meanwhile, support for the far-rightAlternative for Germany (AfD) continues to grow.

zh: 默克尔有两个选择：她可以右倾，如法国前总统萨科齐为法国总统大选所做的最后一搏那样；她也可以硬碰AfD的简单化立场，坚持中间道路。
en: Merkel has two choices: She can move to the right, as former French President Nicolas Sarkozy has done in his latest bid for the French presidency, or she can fight to hold the center by addressing the AfD’s simplistic arguments head on.

zh: 选择是显而易见的：默克尔应该坚持战斗，同时拿出欧盟现代化的替代愿景。
en: The choice is clear: Merkel should stand and fight, while also advancing an alternative vision for modernizing the EU.

zh: 打败民粹主义需要领导人承认因全球化而落后的人群，同时也需要打破存在速效药或全球化可以迅速逆转的神话。
en: Defeating populism will require leaders to acknowledge the people left behind as a result of globalization, but also to dispel the myth that there is a quick fix, or that globalization can simply be reversed.

zh: 与民粹主义观点相反，保护主义无法降低年轻人失业率或收入不平等。
en: Contrary to populist arguments, protectionism will not reduce youth unemployment or income inequality.

zh: 如果欧盟国家拒绝目前正在讨论中的贸易协定，包括跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系以及全面经济和贸易协定，那么欧盟占世界贸易的比重将继续下降，欧洲经济也将因此蒙受损失。
en: If EU countries reject trade deals currently under discussion, including the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership and the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement, the EU’s share of world trade will decrease, and the European economy will suffer for it.

zh: 类似地，如果欧元区无法通过强化其经济治理结构实现进一步融合，那么欧洲的金融危机还将继续，破坏社会流动性和社会正义。
en: Likewise, if the eurozone fails to integrate further by strengthening its economic-governance structures, Europe’s ongoing financial crisis will only continue, impeding social mobility and undermining social justice.

zh: 欧盟领导人应该更高效地提出这些观点。
en: It is time for EU leaders to make these arguments more effectively.

zh: 放眼西方，2008年金融危机所引发的政治斗争仍然没有结束。
en: Across the West, the 2008 financial crisis triggered a political fight that is still in progress.

zh: 它已经从问责和改革战争演变为开放和封闭社会愿景之间的冲突、全球共识与仍在国家、地方甚至部落层次运行的政策之间的冲突。
en: It has changed from a battle for accountability and reform to a clash between visions of open and closed societies, between a global consensus and policies still operating at the national, local, or even tribal level.

zh: 如果欧盟平复对全球化、自由贸易和开放社会的反动，就需要更多的领导人、更少的管理者。
en: If the EU is going to quell the revolt against globalization, free trade, and open societies, it will need more leaders and fewer managers.

zh: 坦率地说，欧洲领导人应该不至于愚蠢到通过指责欧盟机构、假定的贸易协定和难民为他们自身在解决失业和降低不平等性方面的失败开脱。
en: European leaders, frankly, should know better than to blame EU institutions, hypothetical trade deals, and refugees for their own failures to tackle unemployment and reduce inequality.

zh: 欧盟的当前危机管理策略已经穷途末路。
en: The EU’s current crisis-management playbook is running out of pages.

zh: 我们欧洲人可以当鸵鸟，放任欧洲工程缓缓死去，也可以利用这次机会开启新的复兴和改革工程。
en: We in Europe can either put our heads in the sand while the European project slowly dies, or we can use this crisis to start a new project of renewal and reform.

zh: 在这里，正确的选择同样显而易见：欧洲领导人应该为欧洲人民提供新的社会契约，它基于这样的认识：人民对全球化的合理担忧应该用进步的欧洲集体应对措施来解决。
en: Here, too, the right choice is clear: EU leaders should offer Europeans a new social contract, based on the understanding that people’s legitimate fears about globalization should be met with a collective, progressive European response.

zh: 欧洲曾经是全球化的主要推动力，也只有欧盟有力量改变结果。
en: The EU has been a major force behind globalization, and only the EU has the power to help manage the consequences.

zh: 欧洲领导人必须向选民解释民族主义为什么行不通。
en: European leaders must explain to their voters why nationalism cannot.

zh: 欧洲究竟是民主还是崩溃？
en: Democracy or Bust in Europe

zh: 柏林 — — “欧洲将实现民主或土崩瓦解！
en: BERLIN – “Europe will be democratized or it will disintegrate!”

zh: ”这句格言不仅是我刚在柏林创立的欧洲民主运动 — — DiEM25宣言中多次出现的流行语。
en: That maxim is more than a catchphrase from the manifesto of the Democracy in Europe Movement – DiEM25, the group I just helped to launch in Berlin.

zh: 这是一个很多人还没有意识到的简单事实。
en: It is a simple, if under-acknowledged fact.

zh: 欧洲目前的解体太过真实。
en: Europe’s current disintegration is all too real.

zh: 放眼望去新的隔阂似乎无所不在：沿着边境线的两侧、存在于经济社会内部和隐藏在欧洲民众的心里。
en: New divisions are appearing seemingly everywhere one looks: along borders, within our societies and economies, and in the minds of Europe’s citizens.

zh: 难民危机的最新转折显示出欧洲统一性的丧失。
en: Europe’s loss of integrity became painfully evident in the latest turn in the refugee crisis.

zh: 欧洲领导人呼吁土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安面向饱受战争蹂躏的叙利亚城市阿勒颇难民开放其边界；同时，他们却严厉批评希腊让同样的难民涌入“欧洲”领土，甚至威胁要在希腊和欧洲其他国家的边境上设立围栏。
en: European leaders called upon Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan to open his country’s borders to refugees from the war-torn Syrian city of Aleppo; in the same breath, they chastised Greece for letting the same refugees into “European” territory, and even threatened to erect fences along Greece’s borders with the rest of Europe.

zh: 金融领域同样可以看出类似的解体。
en: Similar disintegration can be seen in the realm of finance.

zh: 如果是美国公民赢得了彩票头奖，她不会在意自己的奖金是存入内华达州还是纽约州的银行。
en: If an American citizen won some lottery jackpot, she would not care whether her prize dollars were deposited in a bank domiciled in Nevada or New York.

zh: 但在欧元区却并非如此。
en: This is not so in the eurozone.

zh: 同样数额的欧元在葡萄牙、意大利、希腊、荷兰或德国的银行账户里有着截然不同的“预期”价值，因为较弱的成员国银行需要依赖本已财政困难的政府提供救助。
en: The same sum of euros has very different “expected” value in a Portuguese, Italian, Greek, Dutch, or German bank account, because banks in the weaker member states are reliant on bailouts from fiscally stressed governments.

zh: 这一迹象明确显示出单一货币的解体。
en: That is a sure sign of the single currency’s disintegration.

zh: 此外，欧盟中心地带的政治裂痕正在产生并迅速繁殖。
en: Meanwhile, political rifts are dividing and multiplying in the European Union’s heartland.

zh: 英国纠结于是否退出欧盟 — — 这反映其政治体制本身一直不愿捍卫欧盟和直面其独裁主义。
en: The United Kingdom is torn on whether to exit or not – a reflection of its political establishment’s own chronic unwillingness both to defend the EU and to confront its authoritarianism.

zh: 结果是只要出错选民就指责欧盟，但却对加强欧洲民主或离开欧盟单一市场不感兴趣。
en: The result is an electorate prone to blaming the EU for everything that goes wrong, but with no interest either in campaigning for more European democracy or in leaving the EU’s single market.

zh: 更为严重的是，为欧洲一体化提供动力的法德联盟已经破裂。
en: More ominously, the Franco-German axis powering European integration has fractured.

zh: 没有什么比法国经济部长马克隆所谓两国正在走向现代版天主教新教三十年战争的说法更令人寒心了。
en: Emmanuel Macron, France’s Economy Minister, could not have put it more chillingly when he said that the two countries are edging toward a modern version of the Catholic-versus-Protestant Thirty Years’ War.

zh: 此外南部国家因为陷入永久衰退状态而指责欧洲北部。
en: Meanwhile, southern countries languish in a state of permanent recession that they blame on Europe’s north.

zh: 而且，似乎这还不够，沿着之前的铁幕再次出现了另一条断裂线，前共产主义国家政府公开反对曾象征（至少在理论上）欧洲计划的团结精神。
en: And, as if this were not enough, another menacing fault line has appeared along the former Iron Curtain, with governments of formerly communist countries openly defying the spirit of solidarity that used to characterize (at least in theory) the European project.

zh: 欧洲为什么正在解体？
en: Why is Europe disintegrating?

zh: 我们应该采取什么措施？
en: And what can be done about it?

zh: 应当从欧洲的起源中寻找答案。
en: The answer lies in the EU’s origins.

zh: 欧盟的生命起始于决意通过设在布鲁塞尔的官僚机构操纵价格并实现利润再分配的重工业卡特尔。
en: The EU began life as a cartel of heavy industries determined to manipulate prices and redistribute monopoly profits through a bureaucracy located in Brussels.

zh: 要想确定欧洲各国的价格，就有必要先确定汇率。
en: To fix prices across European borders, there was a need to fix exchange rates as well.

zh: 而在布雷顿森林体系时代，由美国负责提供这种“服务 ” 。
en: During the Bretton Woods era, the Unites States provided this “service.”

zh: 但随着美国于1971年夏天放弃布雷顿森林体系，位于布鲁塞尔的卡特尔管理员们开始设计一套欧洲的固定汇率体系。
en: But as soon as the US ditched Bretton Woods in the summer of 1971, the Brussels-based cartel’s administrators began to design a European fixed exchange-rate system.

zh: 在一系列（往往令人叹为观止的）失败后，作为强力汇率粘合剂的欧元终于问世。
en: After a series of (often spectacular) failures, the euro was born to superglue exchange rates together.

zh: 但像所有卡特尔管理者一样，欧盟技术官僚将真正的泛欧洲民主视为一种威胁。
en: As with all cartel managers, the EU technocrats treated genuine pan-European democracy as a threat.

zh: 他们有条不紊地耐心推进非政治化的决策体系。
en: Patiently, methodically, a process of de-politicizing decision-making was put in place.

zh: 国家政客因为保持沉默而收到丰厚的回报，而反对卡特尔技术官僚做法的任何人都被贴上“反欧洲”标签，并且遭受到局外人的待遇。
en: National politicians were rewarded handsomely for their acquiescence, while anyone opposed to the cartel’s technocratic approach was labeled “un-European” and treated as an outsider.

zh: 因此，尽管欧洲国家仍实行民主制度，但拿到关键决策主权的欧盟机构却一直保持其不民主的本质。
en: Thus, although European countries remained democratic, the EU institutions, where sovereignty over crucial decisions was transferred, have remained democracy-free.

zh: 正如玛格丽特·撒切尔在其英国首相任内最后一次议会会议上所指出的那样，谁控制了货币和利率政策，谁就能控制欧洲政治。
en: As Margaret Thatcher explained during her last Parliamentary appearance as British Prime Minister, who controls money and interest rates controls the politics of Europe.

zh: 将欧洲货币和政治交给一家卡特尔政府不仅标志着欧洲民主的结束；还催生了独裁主义和糟糕经济表现的恶性循环。
en: Handing Europe’s money and politics to a cartel administration did not only spell the end of European democracy; it has also fueled a vicious cycle of authoritarianism and poor economic results.

zh: 欧洲机构越压制民主，其政治当局就越缺乏合法性。
en: The more Europe’s establishment chokes off democracy, the less legitimate its political authority becomes.

zh: 这导致欧洲领导人加倍奉行独裁主义，以便顶着越来越强的经济衰退压力继续执行其失败政策。
en: That leads European leaders to double down on authoritarianism in order to stick to their failed policies when recessionary economic forces strengthen.

zh: 这也解释了为什么欧洲2008年后会成为世界唯一一个没有复苏的经济体。
en: This is why Europe is the world’s only economy that has failed to recover since 2008.

zh: 欧洲危机正是通过这样的恶性循环使得民众日趋内向并相互敌视，放大了潜在的侵略主义和排外主义。
en: It is through this vicious cycle that Europe’s crisis is turning its peoples inward and against one another other, amplifying latent jingoism and xenophobia.

zh: 事实上，正是这种循环导致欧洲无法化解像去年夏天难民流入那样的外部冲击。
en: Indeed, it is what has rendered Europe incapable of absorbing external shocks – like last summer’s refugee influx.

zh: 我们现在必须完成民主人士本该在1930年完成的任务，才有可能防止再次遭受灾难袭击。
en: What we should do now is what democrats should have done in 1930 to prevent a catastrophe that is now becoming imaginable once again.

zh: 我们应当反对将人民力量视为对其权威威胁的欧盟机构，建立由激进、社会、绿色和自由派民主人士共同组成的泛欧洲联盟，让“民众”再次回到民主制度中去。
en: We should establish a pan-European coalition of radical, social, green, and liberal democrats to put the “demos” back into democracy, countering an EU establishment that sees people power as a threat to its authority.

zh: 这就是DiEM25的宗旨，而且也解释了为什么必须成立这一组织。
en: This is what DiEM25 is about and why it is necessary.

zh: 我们是乌托邦？
en: Are we utopian?

zh: 也许。
en: Maybe.

zh: 但这比欧盟机构抓住业已四分五裂、反民主、类卡特尔式的联盟更为现实。
en: But it is more realistic than the EU establishment’s attempt to hang on to our disintegrating, anti-democratic, cartel-like union.

zh: 如果我们的计划是乌托邦，它也是防止陷入“反乌托邦”状态的唯一机会。
en: If our project is utopian, it is also the only alternative to a dystopia in the making.

zh: 真正的危险并非我们好高骛远、无法达成目的。
en: The real danger is not that we shall aim too high and miss.

zh: 真正的危险是欧洲人眼睛盯住深渊，并最终掉下去。
en: The real danger is that Europeans train their eyes on the abyss and end up there.

zh: 欧盟能从民粹主义的虎口中逃生吗?
en: Can the EU Survive Populism?

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 新的一年，对欧盟的生存来说又是个新威胁。
en: BRUSSELS – Another year, another threat to the European Union’s survival.

zh: 好消息是，2016年最大的事件 — — 英国公投脱欧 — — 似乎还是可控的。
en: The good news is that the greatest disruption of 2016, Britain’s vote to exit the EU, appears manageable.

zh: 坏消息是，法国和意大利今年都面临着民粹主义政治夺权的前景，而任何一场夺权都可能会导致欧盟的终结。
en: The bad news is that both France and Italy face the prospect of a populist political takeover this year. Either outcome could well spell the end of the EU.

zh: 欧盟近来成为了民粹主义者的主要目标。
en: The EU has lately become a prime target for populists.

zh: 这种现象首先在希腊冒头，以激进左翼联盟党（Syriza）在2015年1月上台为标志。
en: The phenomenon first took hold in Greece, when the left-wing Syriza party came to power in January 2015.

zh: 但该党并不想让希腊脱离欧盟；相反，它希望与希腊的债权人 — — 这些国家和机构迫使希腊公民承受了严厉的紧缩措施 — — 达成更好的交易。
en: But Syriza was not trying to pull Greece out of the EU; rather, it wanted a better deal with the country’s creditors, who had imposed devastating austerity measures on Greek citizens.

zh: 激进左翼联盟党的做法在很大程度上反映了人民的意志。
en: Syriza’s approach largely reflected the will of the people.

zh: 在2015年6月的公投中，选民近乎一面倒地否绝了希腊债权人提出的一项将进一步加剧紧缩的交易。
en: In a June 2015 referendum, voters overwhelmingly rejected a deal proposed by Greece’s creditors that would have meant even more austerity.

zh: 然而政府在仅仅几天后接受的一项变化不大的交易却获得了广泛的支持。
en: Yet the government’s acceptance of a largely unchanged deal just a few days later received broad support.

zh: 在希腊选民看来，就算条件再好，也不值得为此放弃欧元区成员国资格。
en: Greek voters understood that better terms were not worth losing eurozone membership.

zh: 可以肯定的是，并不是每个人都认为值得为欧盟成员国资格作出如此牺牲。
en: To be sure, not everyone considered EU membership to be worth the sacrifice.

zh: 但在民众对欧盟的批评中有一种实用主义倾向，主要集中在欧盟做了什么，尤其是在经济领域。
en: But there was an air of practicality in popular criticism of the EU, which largely focused on what the EU did, especially in the economic sphere.

zh: 这就是为何这些批评在那些受欧元危机影响最严重，或面临紧缩政策，或感觉被贸易协议抛弃的国家中声浪最大的原因。
en: That is why such criticism has been loudest in the countries that were hit the hardest by the euro crisis, or that faced austerity, or, more recently, that felt left behind by trade agreements.

zh: 但如今情况发生了改变。
en: That is no longer the case.

zh: 右翼民粹主义在某些强大经济体（如奥地利）和通过欧盟成员国资格获益甚多的国家（如匈牙利和波兰）都获得了动力。
en: Right-wing populism has gained traction in strong economies (Austria) and in countries where the benefits of EU membership are palpable (Hungary and Poland).

zh: 比如法国从来没有遭遇过任何欧盟强加的紧缩政策；甚至欧盟委员会主席让-克劳德·容克（Jean-Claude Juncker）都承认，法国实际上不受欧盟的预算规则控制 — — “因为法国就是老大啊。 ”
en: In France, there was never any EU-imposed austerity; even European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker admitted that the EU’s budget rules cannot actually be imposed on France, “because it is France.”

zh: 但如今民粹主义者关注的不是欧盟的所作所为，而是它所代表的东西。
en: Now, populists are focused not on what the EU does, but what it represents.

zh: 民粹主义者不去质问欧盟究竟是让人们变得更富有还是更贫穷，却关注一个更根本和强有力的问题 ： “ 我们是谁？
en: Instead of asking whether the EU is making people richer or poorer, populists are focused on a more fundamental and powerful question: “Who are we?”

zh: 这一转变在这个大规模移民迁徙的时代并不奇怪。
en: At a time of large-scale immigration, this shift is not surprising.

zh: 那些一直以来都根据共同的背景和文化来长定义自身的社会现在必须与多元文化主义的影响做斗争。
en: Societies that have long defined themselves according to shared background and culture now must struggle with the implications of multiculturalism.

zh: 这就是为何大多数关注民粹主义政党的（特别是右翼政党）的观察者都关注其对外国人和少数派群体的态度。
en: That is why most observers of populist parties, especially of right-wing parties, have focused on attitudes toward foreigners and minorities.

zh: 随着这种向身份政治 — — 这是一个不是特别容易实现妥协的领域 — — 的转变，人们对民主体制的态度也发生了转变。
en: With the shift toward identity politics – a terrain that is not particularly amenable to compromise – has come a shift in attitudes toward democratic institutions.

zh: 民粹主义者领导人假设“民众 ” （ 如民粹主义者所定义）的意志不应受到体制的限制并以此为行动准则，这就与自由民主制度的基本前提起了冲突：后者认为多数人的权力必须受到限制，特别是保护少数派群体，选举权和其他权利。
en: Populist leaders operate on the assumption that the will of the “people” – as defined by the populist – should not be institutionally constrained. This controverts the fundamental premise of liberal democracy: that the power of the majority must be limited, not least to protect minorities, electoral and otherwise.

zh: 大多数时候对权力的限制通常是通过美国人所称的“制衡”来实现的，例如包括独立的司法机构以及需要实现超级多数才能改变的政治制度基本要素。
en: Limits on the power of the majority of the moment are typically achieved through what Americans call “checks and balances,” which include, for example, an independent judiciary and super-majority requirements to alter fundamental elements of the political system.

zh: 这种限制至少在大部分情况下是行得通的。
en: And such limits usually work, at least for the most part.

zh: 例如在英国，三名高等法院法官裁决只有议会 — — 而非政府 — — 才能触发《里斯本条约》第50条的程序正式脱离欧盟。
en: In the United Kingdom, for example, three High Court judges ruled that only Parliament – not the government – can trigger Article 50 of the Treaty of Lisbon, the formal process for leaving the EU.

zh: 但是民粹主义政治家则在这种限制下躁动不已。
en: But populist politicians chafe under such constraints.

zh: 匈牙利总理维克多·奥尔班（Viktor Orbán）不仅公开宣称自己倾向于实现“非自由”民主制度；还努力破除对他政府权力的制衡。
en: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has not only openly stated his preference for an “illiberal” democracy; he has worked to dismantle checks on his government’s power.

zh: 波兰的民粹主义政府也是如此，其实际领导人雅罗斯瓦夫·卡辛斯基（Jarosław Kaczyński）甚至没有在政府中担任任何正式职位。
en: The same goes for Poland’s populist government, whose de facto leader, Jarosław Kaczyński, doesn’t even hold a formal position in the administration.

zh: 鉴于上述人士对独立机构的藐视，也就不难看出为何民粹主义者会反对欧盟，因为欧盟在某种意义上就是一种典型的自由民主体制：由非人格的规则来管辖，而不是依赖某一个时刻的大多数，而大多数决策都要求实现超级多数或完全一致同意。
en: Given their contempt for independent institutions, it is not hard to see why populists oppose the EU, which is, in a sense, the quintessential liberal democracy: governed by impersonal rules, rather than by the majority of the moment, with most decisions requiring either a super-majority or unanimity.

zh: 对于民粹主义者来说，欧盟代表了极大的附加约束，甚至比国内制衡更难超越。
en: For populists, the EU represents significant added constraints that are even harder to push past than domestic checks.

zh: 这也使欧盟成为了他们的眼中钉。
en: That makes it a problem.

zh: 然而在另一个意义上，欧盟也存在着民主不足的问题：正如民粹主义者领导人经常指出的那样，欧盟在布鲁塞尔总部的领导人并非通过选举产生（他们也使用类似的论据来否定国家法院这类机构的合法性 ） 。
en: In another sense, however, the EU suffers from insufficient democracy: as populist leaders routinely point out, its leaders in Brussels are unelected. (Populists use similar arguments to deny the legitimacy of, say, national courts.)

zh: 当然，现实是民主选举的政府和议会之所以设置欧盟领导人和官僚（以及独立法官 ） ， 正是为了限制某一时刻的大多数以及未来的政府。
en: The reality, of course, is that democratically elected governments and parliaments install EU leaders and bureaucrats (and independent judges) precisely to place limits on the majority of the moment and future governments.

zh: 但民粹主义者则宣称这些官员不过是“精英”小圈子推举出来镇压人民意志的人且本身就是精英集团的一分子，以图重塑他们的追随者们对这一制度的理解。
en: But populists reframe their followers’ understanding of this system, by declaring that such officials are part of the “elite,” selected by their fellow elites to frustrate the will of the people.

zh: 主流政治家对这种叙述无从下手，而欧盟官员更是束手无策。
en: There is little that mainstream politicians, much less EU officials, can do to counter this narrative.

zh: 一些国家政治家屈服于民众的压力，采纳了其民粹主义对手的说辞 — — 甚至是议案。
en: Some national politicians succumb to popular pressure, adopting the rhetoric – and even the program – of their populist adversaries.

zh: 但欧盟不能做出这样的事情，因为这将切切实实地加速自身的灭亡。
en: But the EU can do no such thing, without effectively hastening its own demise.

zh: 而当问题在于欧盟做过了什么的时候，就可能会有一个解决方案：欧盟可以在经济问题上改变方针。
en: When the problem was what the EU did, there was a possible solution: the EU could change tack on economic issues.

zh: 欧盟委员会实际上已经放弃了紧缩方案。
en: And, indeed, the Commission has de facto abandoned austerity.

zh: 同样，欧盟与加拿大的新贸易协议也是在达成了详尽复杂的妥协后才于去年十月签署的。
en: Likewise, the EU’s new trade deal with Canada, signed in October, was concluded only after working out elaborate compromises.

zh: 但欧盟不能改变其代表性。
en: But the EU cannot change what it represents.

zh: 它不能接受，更不可能推动所谓“制衡是进步的障碍”或“外国人威胁了欧洲的生活方式”这样的观点。
en: It cannot accept, much less advance, the notion that checks and balances are obstacles to progress, or that foreigners threaten the European way of life.

zh: 它不能提出民粹主义者借以赢取支持的那种激进，不可行或不自由的解决方案。
en: It cannot offer the kinds of radical, impossible, or illiberal solutions that populists use to win support.

zh: 欧盟必须继续成为自由民主制度的堡垒，维持所有的枯燥但必要的规则和程序。
en: The EU must remain a bulwark of liberal democracy, with all of its unsexy yet necessary rules and procedures.

zh: 在目前的环境下，实施多层次民主和开放经济的笨拙实体确实无法与民粹主义者的高调承诺竞争。
en: In the current environment, this lumbering embodiment of a multi-level democracy and open economy cannot compete with populists’ lofty promises.

zh: 然而当民粹主义者不能兑现其承诺时，民众将回归欧盟。
en: When populists fail to deliver, however, it is back to the EU that the public will run.

zh: 唯望那时还有欧盟存在就是了。
en: One only hopes that there will still be an EU waiting for them.

zh: 公民组成的欧洲
en: A Europe of Citizens

zh: 马德里 — — 上个月对欧洲来讲又是残酷之月，在3月22日对布鲁塞尔的恐怖袭击事件中达到高潮。
en: MADRID – Last month was another cruel one for Europe, culminating in the horrific terrorist attacks in Brussels on March 22.

zh: 结果引发了欧洲人新一轮自我反省，他们认真思索欧盟的制度缺陷和能力不足，更不用说它目前正在面临的生存挑战。
en: The aftermath has seen a new round of soul searching, with Europeans mulling over the European Union’s institutional failures and sheer incompetence, not to mention the existential challenge it currently faces.

zh: 随着欧洲遭遇从希腊危机到难民涌入等看似无穷无尽的一系列突发事件，今天这样的思考似乎成了家常便饭。
en: Such considerations seem to arise frequently these days, as Europe encounters a seemingly endless series of emergencies, from the Greek crisis to the influx of refugees.

zh: 但自满仍然是现在的常态，欧盟领导人应对危机的心态是被动多于主动，因此无法打破动荡循环。
en: Yet complacency remains the order of the day, with EU leaders adopting to a crisis-response mentality that privileges reaction over action and perpetuates the cycle of destabilization.

zh: 危机已成为欧盟新常态的现实强化了这一其实已经在亲欧人士和欧盟官员当中无所不在的观念。 这种观念认为我们只能继续蒙混过关。
en: The fact that crises have become the EU’s new normal has reinforced the notion, already ubiquitous among Europhiles and Eurocrats, that we will simply continue to muddle through.

zh: 这样的方法既错误又非常危险。
en: This approach is both misguided and dangerous.

zh: 现实情况是欧洲一体化正在迅速瓦解。
en: As it stands, European unity is disintegrating rapidly.

zh: 在荷兰刚刚结束的全民公决中，荷兰选民以压倒多数否决了乌克兰加入欧盟的协议仅仅是最新的例证。
en: The just-concluded referendum in the Netherlands, in which Dutch voters overwhelmingly rejected an association agreement between the EU and Ukraine, is merely the latest example.

zh: 如果欧盟想要从这次慢动作版的火车失事中逃生，更不用说在未来实现繁荣兴旺，那么迫切需要的不仅是豪言壮语，还有大胆的行动。
en: If the EU is to survive this slow-motion train wreck, let alone thrive in the long run, bold action – not just valiant rhetoric – is urgently needed.

zh: 现在必须决定欧盟是真正的跨国机构还仅仅是政府间安排的承载者。
en: It is time to decide whether the EU is a truly transnational undertaking or merely a vessel for inter-governmental arrangements.

zh: 如果只是后者，我们必须实话实说。
en: If it is the latter, we should call a spade a spade.

zh: 但如果出现那种情况，我们必须明白我们 — — 包括欧盟及各成员国在内 — — 实际接受了自己越来越无关紧要的现实。
en: But, in that case, we should understand that we – both the EU and individual countries – are effectively resigning ourselves to increasing irrelevance.

zh: 面对关键领域的共同问题口惠而实不至导致问题无法得到解决，机遇也无法真正实现。
en: Paying little more than lip service to a common approach in critical areas leaves problems unaddressed and opportunities unexplored.

zh: 简言之，在“人人为己”的原则指导下，我们将会一起完蛋。
en: Simply put, with an “every man for himself” approach, everyone will sink.

zh: 建立跨国机构是更好的方案。
en: A transnational undertaking is the superior option.

zh: 但这样做难度更大，因为需要深入根本地改革实现欧洲一体化的方式。
en: But it is also the more difficult one, because it demands deep and fundamental changes in how the question of European integration is approached.

zh: 欧盟计划的原罪是尽管存在布鲁塞尔，但却没有欧洲选民。
en: The original sin of the European project is that, Brussels notwithstanding, there is no European constituency.

zh: 事件、政策和问题全都通过国家的视角观看。
en: Events, policies, and challenges are all viewed through a national lens.

zh: 难民危机让这个问题变得非常明显；但欧洲体系所承受的一切压力最终都导致民族主义观点。
en: The refugee crisis has brought this into sharp relief; but every stress on the European system brings to the fore nationalist perspectives.

zh: 这种情况为什么不应该出现？
en: And why shouldn’t this be the case?

zh: 毕竟，政治责任 — — 更不用说税金 — — 在公民和国家首都间流动。
en: After all, political accountability – not to mention tax money – flows from citizens to the national capitals.

zh: 但割裂欧盟和国家政府是错误的做法。
en: But the split between the EU and national governments is a false one.

zh: 正确执行并理解称之为各级政府决策权的辅助性原则一直且今后必须仍然指导欧洲的行动。
en: Subsidiarity, properly applied and understood as decision-making power at the appropriate level of government, is and must remain a guiding principle of European action.

zh: 但有时需要集体采取行动。
en: There are, however, times when collective action is needed.

zh: 这样的行动要想实现高效，欧盟层面就不能仅仅用来充当替罪羊或夸夸其谈。
en: For such action to be effective, the EU level cannot be a place for scapegoating and bloviating.

zh: 国家政要不能继续宣称布鲁塞尔或欧盟委员会是所有问题的根源，同时实行以自我为中心的短视政策并最终导致危机进一步加剧。
en: National political figures cannot continue to claim that Brussels or the European Commission is the source of all their problems, and pursue self-centered and shortsighted measures that ultimately exacerbate crises.

zh: 欧盟官员也不能继续耸耸肩膀并指责国内政要未能实施拟议中的欧盟举措。
en: Nor can EU officials continue to shrug their shoulders and blame national politicians for failing to implement proposed EU-wide measures.

zh: 相反，欧盟需要真正的权威来执行政策。
en: Instead, the EU needs real authority to execute policy.

zh: 一位布鲁塞尔知情人士最近对我指出欧盟在危机的推动下已经进入了新的授权阶段，也就是说由欧盟而非其成员国掌握真正的执行权。
en: One Brussels insider recently noted to me that the EU, propelled by its crises, is already entering a new phase of empowerment, where it, not its member states, has real implementing authority.

zh: 事实上，有各种各样的实例显示某种程度的执行权由欧盟掌握；值得注意的是，人们希望欧盟在执行最近与土耳其签署的难民危机协议中能够发挥领导作用。
en: And, indeed, there are assorted examples of the EU assuming something of an executive position; notably, the EU is expected to play a leading role in implementing its recent deal with Turkey to resolve the refugee crisis.

zh: 但欧盟执行权真实合法的转移需要加强民众及其代表之间的联系。
en: But a genuine and legitimate shift to an effective EU executive requires a stronger connection between the people and those acting on their behalf.

zh: 换句话说，我们必须建设一个跨国选区。
en: In other words, we must create a transnational constituency.

zh: 这早已不是新的想法。
en: This is not a new idea.

zh: 长期以来一直存在对欧洲公民构想的支持，欧盟条约也已经包含可以为此奠定基础的条款。
en: There has long been support for the idea of European citizenry, and the EU treaties include provisions that could serve as stepping stones to this end.

zh: 但这方面的有限进展反映了民众的情绪。
en: But limited progress on this front reflects popular sentiment.

zh: 在调查机构“欧洲晴雨表”开始对欧盟公民民意测验的5年内，积极响应者的比例只增长了2 % （ 从2010年的62%增长到2015年的64 % ） 。
en: In the five years since Eurobarometer began asking survey participants whether they feel like citizens of the EU, the number responding positively has increased by only 2% (from 62% in 2010 to 64% in 2015).

zh: 加深欧洲民众的政治联系需要基于集体行动、意识及所有权的制度改革。
en: Deepening the political links among Europeans requires institutional reform based on collective action, awareness, and ownership.

zh: 上述努力的种子 — — 从以直选欧盟委员会主席取代优雅但却毫无血性的种子候选人制度到思考某种有限但直接的欧盟税以划定明确的责任限度 — — 已经存在。
en: The seeds of such an endeavor – from replacing the elegant but bloodless Spitzenkandidaten system with direct EU-wide elections for European Commission President to considering a limited but direct EU tax to establish a clear line of accountability – are already available.

zh: 这项工作肯定会遭遇严重的政治阻力；毕竟，目前的体系对很多人而言非常方便。
en: Such efforts would certainly face serious political headwinds; the current system is, after all, quite comfortable for many.

zh: 但解构的过程已经开始。
en: But the process of unraveling is already underway.

zh: 只有拥有自觉意识的欧洲公民能够削弱每次危机中出现的离心力，因为只有这样的公民能够确保在欧盟层面建立问责制度，迫使官员制定并执行有效的政策，从而打破欧盟决策层面根深蒂固的相互指责的恶性循环。
en: Only a conscious European citizenry can weaken the centrifugal forces that emerge in every crisis, because only such a citizenry can ensure accountability at the EU level, compel officials to formulate and execute effective policy, and thereby break the cycle of blame that has become entrenched in European decision-making.

zh: 建立这种意识将是一种长期的过程，但所起的作用却非常关键。
en: Creating this awareness would be a long-term process, but it is essential.

zh: 在如此困难的情况下，加强跨国主义可能看似极端和难以实现。
en: At a time of such difficult challenges, strengthening transnationalism might seem extreme and unachievable.

zh: 但除非我们认识到连续遭遇危机重创的真正原因，我们将注定继续得过且过，直到欧盟不复存在。
en: But unless we recognize the real reasons that we continue to be battered by crises, we will be doomed to continue muddling through until there is no EU left.

zh: 押注乌克兰
en: Betting on Ukraine

zh: 基辅—一年前，乌克兰青年冒着生命危险走上基辅独立广场，捍卫让他们的祖国与欧盟走得更近的协议。
en: KYIV – A year ago, young Ukrainians were risking their lives on Kyiv’s Independence Square to defend an agreement that would bring their country closer to the European Union.

zh: 这场起义结束了一个腐败的政权，把权力 — — 在自由公正的选举之后 — — 交给了乌克兰有史以来最有改革思维的政府。
en: That uprising ended a corrupt regime and brought to power – after a free and fair election – what appears to be Ukraine’s most reform-minded government ever.

zh: 你也许认为乌克兰人对欧洲式民主理想的英勇决心会给他们带来大量西方支持，帮助他们抵抗俄罗斯的入侵和经济动荡。
en: One might have expected the heroic commitment of Ukrainians to Europe’s democratic ideals to trigger a rush of Western support for the country in its battle against Russian aggression and economic instability.

zh: 但并非如此。
en: But that has not been the case.

zh: 事实上，尽管上一次2014年欧盟领导人峰会做出了“坚持”对俄罗斯实施制裁的勇敢决定，但并没有采取行动援助乌克兰。
en: Indeed, though the last EU leadership summit of 2014 brought the courageous decision to “stay the course” on Russian sanctions, it produced little movement on aid to Ukraine.

zh: 当时，第一次以欧盟理事会主席身份主持峰会的前波兰总理塔斯克（Donald Tusk）支持增加对乌克兰的融资支持。
en: Donald Tusk, the former Polish prime minister who was chairing his first summit as President of the European Council, supports additional financing for Ukraine.

zh: 但是，据《金融时报 》 （ Financial Times）报道，一些欧盟国家对于出资仍“相当冷淡 ” 。
en: But, as the Financial Times reports, several EU countries’ willingness to come up with the money remains “lukewarm at best.”

zh: 在面临欧元区债务危机时，欧洲领导人一再采取权宜之计。
en: When confronted with a debt crisis in the eurozone, European leaders repeatedly kicked the can down the road.

zh: 结果是造成了不必要的长期深度衰退。
en: The result was an unnecessarily deep and protracted recession.

zh: 如今，他们在乌克兰又要重蹈覆辙，而潜在后果可能更加严重。
en: Now, they are about to make the same mistake in Ukraine, with even more devastating potential consequences.

zh: 乌克兰的银行存款正在稳步告竭，财政和经常项目赤字巨大，未来几年还要偿还大量外债。
en: Ukraine is facing a steady drain on bank deposits, large fiscal and current-account deficits, and sizeable external debt payments in the next few years.

zh: 随着国际储备的减少，乌克兰无法用其自身的美元资源填补资金缺口。
en: With its international reserves dwindling, the country cannot finance these gaps with its own dollar resources.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）估计2015年乌克兰将需要150亿美元外援，而在去年乌克兰已经获得了170亿美元援助金。
en: The International Monetary Fund has estimated that Ukraine will need $15 billion in outside help in 2015, in addition to the $17 billion bailout that it received last year.

zh: 融资缺口将在2016年及其后继续存在。
en: The funding gap extends into 2016 and beyond.

zh: 当然，稳定乌克兰经济需要深刻的国内改革。
en: Stabilizing Ukraine’s economy will, of course, require deep domestic reforms.

zh: 乌克兰政府必须削减能源补贴以减少国有石油天然气公司乌克兰石油公司（Naftogaz）的巨大赤字。
en: The government will have to cut energy subsidies to reduce the yawning deficit of Naftogaz, the state-owned oil and gas company.

zh: 与此同时，乌克兰央行必须继续清理和关闭破产银行并确保可靠金融机构的资本重组。
en: At the same time, the central bank must continue to clean up and close insolvent banks and ensure the recapitalization of viable financial institutions.

zh: 此外，在透明国际（Transparency International）的腐败感指数上，乌克兰位于175个国家的第142位，采取果断措施改善治理、实现治理专业化也是当务之急。
en: And, with Transparency International’s corruption perceptions index ranking Ukraine 142nd out of 175 countries, drastic measures to improve and professionalize governance are imperative.

zh: 但这些改革只有在金融稳定的条件下才能成功。
en: But these reforms can succeed only in an environment of financial stability.

zh: 乌克兰财政赤字需要通过货币创造融资，通货膨胀高企、其货币格里夫纳大幅贬值（尽管跌幅比俄罗斯卢布小得多 ） 。
en: With the fiscal deficit being financed through money creation, inflation is high and the hryvnia, Ukraine’s currency, has depreciated (though nowhere near as much as the Russian ruble).

zh: 大到足以重振信心、打消融资疑虑的外部援助计划是成功的结构改革的先决条件。
en: An external aid package that is large enough to restore confidence and assuage financing doubts is a precondition for successful structural reform.

zh: 另一个先决条件是政治合法性。
en: The other prerequisite is political legitimacy.

zh: 毕竟，改革需要公民做出巨大牺牲。
en: After all, reform demands tremendous sacrifices from citizens.

zh: 在中欧和东欧的其他地区，公民已经接受了这一牺牲，因为来自西方的慷慨金融援助和欧盟成员地位前景给了民主和未来繁荣的承诺以信誉。
en: Elsewhere in Central and Eastern Europe, citizens readily accepted such sacrifices, because generous financial assistance from the West and the prospect of EU membership lent credibility to the promise of democracy and future prosperity.

zh: 乌克兰人必须觉得调整的痛苦被公平地分担，而这意味着至少该国的寡头最终需要接受法律的约束。
en: Ukrainians must perceive that the pain of adjustment is being shared fairly, which means that the country’s oligarchs must become subject, at long last, to the rule of law.

zh: 但是，由于自由、稳定、繁荣的乌克兰十分符合欧洲的战略利益，因此欧盟成员国政府也应该分担金融改革的负担。
en: But, given that a free, stable, and prosperous Ukraine is very much in Europe’s strategic interest, the EU’s member governments should also share the burden of financing reform.

zh: 乌克兰在未来四年中稳定经济所需要的资金与用于援助希腊（高达3,000亿美元以上，来自不同来源）的资金相比只是九牛一毛，而希腊的战略意义远远及不上乌克兰。
