en: The funding that Ukraine will need to stabilize its economy over the next four years looks paltry when compared to the more than $300 billion, from different sources, devoted to bailing out Greece – a country where there is far less at stake strategically.

zh: 在此前的金融危机期间，不论是1994年的墨西哥还是最近的欧洲，国际社会都证明它在寻找紧急资金渠道机制方面具有巨大的创新力。
en: During previous financial crises, from Mexico in 1994 to southern Europe recently, the international community has proved that it can be very creative when it comes to finding mechanisms to channel emergency funds.

zh: 这表明，今天的问题不在于资金不足或制度约束，而在于缺少政治意愿。
en: This suggests that the problem today is not insufficient money or institutional constraints, but a lack of political will.

zh: 欧盟和德国政府中的怀疑派承认乌克兰困境的紧迫性，但他们担心，如果没有全面改革，援助资金会打水漂。
en: Skeptics in the EU and the German government acknowledge the urgency of Ukraine’s plight; but they fear that the money will go to waste in the absence of comprehensive reforms.

zh: 犬儒主义者还夹带私货，指出恶性通胀也许并不那么糟糕，因为它将迫使地方政客实施改革。
en: Cynics privately add that hyperinflation may not be such a bad thing after all, because it would force local politicians to reform.

zh: 但这是对历史的无视：20世纪90年代乌克兰层经历过恶性通胀，结果是以总统库奇马（Leonid Kuchma）和亚努科维奇（Viktor Yanukovych）为首的政府的当选。 库奇马的暴政导致了2004年的橙色革命，亚努科维奇则在2014年2月被推翻。
en: But that ignores history: Ukraine suffered hyperinflation in the 1990s, only to elect governments headed by President Leonid Kuchma, whose misrule incited the Orange Revolution in 2004, and President Viktor Yanukovych, who was overthrown in February 2014.

zh: 显然，这些自以为是的观点可谓执迷不悟，并且具有可怕的危险性。
en: Clearly, such complacent views are both wrongheaded and terribly dangerous.

zh: 改革措施的成功永远无法事先保证。
en: The success of reform efforts can never be assured in advance.

zh: 但金融动荡倒是可以保证改革的失败 — — 以及政治和经济混乱。
en: But one factor that can guarantee failure – and lead to political and economic dislocation – is financial instability.

zh: 本届乌克兰政府拥有前所未有的变革的选举授权。
en: The current government in Ukraine has an unprecedented electoral mandate for change.

zh: 乌克兰政府也将该国的一些最好最聪明的人才（包括乌克兰犹太人）纳入了公职部门以实现打仗和避开经济崩溃两不误。
en: It has also drawn into public service some of the country’s best and brightest (including from the Ukrainian diaspora) to fight a war and stave off an economic meltdown simultaneously.

zh: 人们总是不愿考虑失败时会发生什么。
en: One hesitates to consider what might happen if they fail.

zh: 乌克兰的B计划显然不是更多改革，而是更少改革 — — 甚至可能是近几年来拉丁美洲所出现的鲁莽的经济民粹主义，比如查韦斯的委内瑞拉和基什内尔夫妇（Néstor and Cristina Kirchner）的新庇隆主义阿根廷。
en: Plan B in Ukraine is surely not more reform, but less of it – and probably the kind of reckless economic populism that Latin America has witnessed in recent years, from Hugo Chávez’s Venezuela to Néstor and Cristina Kirchner’s neo-Peronist Argentina.

zh: 光是这一点也许就足以让IMF、美国以及（最重要的）欧盟采取行动。
en: That possibility alone should be sufficient to spur the IMF, the United States, and, above all, the EU to act.

zh: 在苏联日薄西山时，独立民主的乌克兰似乎是不可想象的。
en: In the grey and depressing days of the Soviet Union, an independent and democratic Ukraine seemed unimaginable.

zh: 但它发生了。
en: Yet it happened.

zh: 如今，经济和政治改革也似乎毫无生气；但改革仍然是可能发生的。
en: Today, economic and political reform seems similarly daunting; but it remains just as attainable.

zh: 对西方政府来说，援助乌克兰是一场赌博，但显然是值得冒险的赌博。
en: For Western governments, coming to the aid of Ukraine is a gamble, but one that is surely worth taking.

zh: 欧洲谷歌罚款越线
en: Europe’s Google Fines Cross the Line

zh: 巴黎—欧盟监管机构似乎对谷歌特别敌视。
en: PARIS – The European Union’s regulatory bodies seem to be particularly hostile to Google.

zh: 2017年6月，欧盟委员会以违反欧盟反垄断规则为由，对谷歌公司罚款 24.2亿欧元，说“谷歌滥用其搜索引擎市场主导地位，为其另一项谷歌产品购物服务比较提供非法优势。 ”
en: In June 2017, the European Commission fined the company €2.42 billion ($2.75 billion) for breaching EU antitrust rules, after concluding that, “Google has abused its market dominance as a search engine by giving an illegal advantage to another Google product, its comparison shopping service.”

zh: 接着，上个月欧盟委员会又对谷歌“找茬 ” ， 以“安卓移动设备方面的非法活动”为由罚款 43.4亿欧元。
en: Then, last month, the Commission went after Google again, fining it €4.34 billion ($4.94 billion) for “illegal practices regarding Android mobile devices.”

zh: 谷歌与移动设备制造商和网络运营商达成一致“预装谷歌搜索应用和浏览器应用（Chrome ） ” 。
en: Google had made agreements with mobile-device manufacturers and network operators “to pre-install the Google Search app and browser app (Chrome).”

zh: 此外，欧洲议会和一些欧盟成员国也想分解谷歌，将搜索引擎与其他可能的营收源分离。
en: Moreover, it seems that the European Parliament and several EU member states would like to dismantle Google by separating its search engine from other possible revenue sources.

zh: 毫无疑问，谷歌在互联网上拥有独一无二的地位。
en: There is no doubt that Google holds a unique position on the Internet.

zh: 在搜索活动方面，十年来它支配了大约90%的市场，让一些所谓的竞争捍卫者谴责它“滥用”它的“主导地位 ” 。
en: In terms of search activity, it has commanded around 90% of the market for over a decade, leading many soi-disant defenders of competition to denounce it for “abusing” its “dominant position.”

zh: 但这些攻讦背后往往是误解和谷歌竞争对手放出的可疑的有害论。
en: But most of these attacks are driven by a mix of misconceptions and questionable claims of harm by Google’s competitors.

zh: 谷歌的批评者定义垄断为一家企业拥有100%的市场份额，或足以让可信竞争变得不可能的份额。
en: Google’s critics would define a monopoly as any firm that has a 100% market share, or at least a share large enough to make credible competition seem impossible.

zh: 传统经济理论认为，垄断可疑得到比在“纯粹、完美的竞争”条件下更高的价格，从而剥削了消费者。
en: Traditional economic theory holds that a monopoly can take advantage of consumers by imposing higher prices than would otherwise be possible under conditions of “pure and perfect competition.”

zh: 根据这一简单的逻辑，立法者和法官必须遏制垄断“掠夺者 ” ， 对它们课以巨额罚款或分拆它们，历史上多次发生过这样的情况。
en: By this simple reasoning, legislators and judges must rein in monopolistic “despoilers” by imposing heavy fines, or by breaking them up, as has happened many times throughout history.

zh: 但要接受这一思路，你必须忽视一个两种垄断之间的根本性差别。 一种垄断源于市场的自由运行，另一种垄断来自国家强制。
en: But to follow to this line of thinking, one must ignore a fundamental distinction between two kinds of monopolies: those that emerge from the free operation of the market; and those that are a result of state coercion.

zh: 传统上 ， “ 纯粹、完美的竞争”的意思是许多企业生产以同样的技术生产同种商品。
en: Traditionally, “pure and perfect competition” is taken to mean that many firms are producing the same good with the same techniques.

zh: 但这一定义是一种静态视角，将市场结果衡量为简单的离散点，尽管经济本身是动态的。
en: But this definition takes a static approach, measuring market outcomes at a single point in time, even though the economy itself is dynamic.

zh: 想象一家企业发布了一项创新产品。
en: Consider the case of a firm that is launching an innovative product.

zh: 根据定义，其市场份额为100 % ， 至少可以维持一段时间。
en: By definition, its market share will be 100%, at least for a while.

zh: 该企业获得“主导地位”是因为其优秀，以及消费者欣赏其产品这一事实。
en: The firm owes its “dominant position” to merit, and to the fact that consumers appreciate its product.

zh: 该情形表明，竞争不应该用武断的生产者数字决定，而应该根据其他企业是否可以自由进入市场决定。
en: As this scenario demonstrates, competition should not be defined by some arbitrary number of producers, but by whether other firms are free to enter the market.

zh: 说到底，进入市场是创新的关键先决条件。
en: Ultimately, market entry is the key prerequisite of innovation.

zh: 如果国家对这一自由加以限制，以致于让某个私营或公营生产者获得或保持市场主导地位，那么它就造成了有害的垄断，严重限制了创新的机会。
en: If the state imposes constraints on that freedom in such a way as to establish or maintain a single private or public producer’s market dominance, then it has created a harmful monopoly, by severely limiting opportunities for innovation.

zh: 在谷歌的例子中，没有人阻止其他人进入互联网搜索市场。
en: In the case of Google, no one has prevented others from entering the Internet-search market.

zh: 因此，谷歌在该领域的名声来自人才和诚信。
en: Google thus owes its reputation in this area to talent and ingenuity.

zh: 它进入市场时，并不是第一家搜索引擎，全世界任何一家企业都可以自由追求同样的机会。
en: When it entered the market, it was not the first search engine, and any firm around the world had the freedom to pursue the same opportunity.

zh: 谷歌胜出是因为它提供了比其他人都更好的服务，并且很早就建立了优势。
en: Google prevailed because it provided a better service than anyone else, and it did so early.

zh: 谷歌不应该因为它的成功而被惩罚。
en: Google should not be punished for this success.

zh: 在没有国家压制的情况下 ， “ 主导”是无稽之谈，谷歌潜在竞争对手的抱怨也不具有合理性。
en: In the absence of state coercion, the word “dominant” has no purchase, and the complaints of Google’s potential competitors have no legitimacy.

zh: 它们应该抓住机会行动。
en: They should have acted when they had the chance.

zh: 如今，谷歌提供电子邮件、翻译、视频分享等重要的现成服务。
en: Today, Google makes freely available important services such as email, translation, video hosting, and more.

zh: 它之所以能提供这些服务，是因为它在其他活动上赚取了利润，即链接到它的搜索服务上的在线广告。
en: It is able to do this because it makes profits on other activities, namely online advertising connected to its search service.

zh: 拆分谷歌有可能破坏其生存手段，给消费者带来沉重的成本。
en: By dismantling Google, one risks undercutting its means of survival, and imposing high costs on consumers.

zh: 让我们回到欧盟最近的举措。
en: Let us return to the EU’s recent actions.

zh: 欧盟委员会在2017年6月对谷歌罚款是因为谷歌将自身“购物比较服务”置于其他竞争对手的服务之前。
en: The Commission levied its June 2017 fine because Google prioritized its own “comparative shopping service” over those of its competitors.

zh: 但是，任何谷歌和他的各种服务的用户都是自由选择这么做的，而不是因为谷歌设法迫使他们这么做。
en: And yet, anyone who uses Google and its various services does so freely, not because Google is somehow forcing them.

zh: 他们完全可以使用其他服务，因此他们使用谷歌的决定必然意味着谷歌提供了对他们最有用的服务。
en: They could just as well use other services, so their decision to use Google must mean that Google provides the service most useful to them.

zh: 类似地，在2018年7月的罚款中，谷歌也没有强制行为。
en: Likewise, Google did not use coercion in the case for which it was fined in July 2018.

zh: 它与设备制造商签订自愿合同，后者同意在自己的设备中预装谷歌服务。
en: It entered into voluntary contracts with device manufacturers, who agreed to pre-install some of its services.

zh: 这里不存在“滥用”它的“强大市场地位 ” ， 只有自由合同和自由市场环境下的创新。
en: There was no “abuse” of its “powerful market position.” There was only innovation in the context of free contracts and free markets.

zh: 事实上，如果说有人“滥用”其“主导地位”的话，也是欧盟。
en: In fact, if there has been any “abuse” of one’s “dominant position,” it has been committed by the EU.

zh: 通过强制，国家限制个人和企业做出自己的市场决定，创新企业也因此而受罚。
en: Through coercion, the state is constraining individuals and firms from making their own decisions in the market, and innovative firms are being punished as a result.

zh: 欧盟的都柏林难题
en: The European Union’s Dublin Conundrum

zh: 布鲁塞尔—关于移民问题的紧张态势仍在主导欧洲政坛。
en: BRUSSELS – Tensions over immigration continue to dominate European politics.

zh: 意大利内政部长、民粹主义急先锋马特奥·萨尔维尼（Matteo Salvini）独占公众关注焦点，几乎每天都在发声“怼”移民。
en: In Italy, Interior Minister Matteo Salvini, a populist firebrand, is monopolizing the public’s attention with almost daily outbursts against immigrants.

zh: 类似地，萨尔瓦尼的德国同仁霍斯特·希霍夫（Horst Seehofer）为了保证针对试图从奥地利入境德国的寻求庇护者采取新措施，不惜在联合政府内部制造 一场危机。
en: Likewise, Salvini’s German counterpart, Horst Seehofer, created a crisis in the governing coalition in order to secure new measures against asylum seekers trying to enter Germany from Austria.

zh: 萨尔瓦尼和希霍夫宣称，由于本国需要解决自身非法移民问题，因此必须以国家而非欧洲方案为重。
en: With their countries having been left to fight illegal immigration on their own, Salvini and Seehofer claim, they must focus on national, not European, solutions.

zh: 他们都错了。
en: They are wrong.

zh: 真相是欧盟对于减少不规律人员流入起着重要作用，自2015年大量叙利亚难民经由希腊和匈牙利涌入以来，难民人数大幅下降。
en: The truth is that the European Union has been instrumental in reducing the flows of irregular arrivals, which have declined considerably since the massive influx of Syrian refugees, via Greece and Hungary, in 2015.

zh: 2016年3月，欧盟与土耳其达成协议，此后便很少有人能够入境希腊。
en: Thanks to the agreement that the EU reached with Turkey in March 2016, very few people are now crossing into Greece.

zh: 类似地，到达意大利的人数也下降到了去年总数的几分之一。
en: Likewise, the number of arrivals in Italy is a mere fraction of the total just last year.

zh: 总体而言，非法越境欧盟人数已经下降到了约每年100,000人，而2015年涌入人数据估计超过了一百万。
en: Overall, illegal crossings into the EU have been reduced to about 100,000 annually, compared to the estimated more than one million who arrived in 2015.

zh: 欧盟人口有五亿多，这个数字完全是可以管理的。
en: Given the EU’s population of over 500 million, that number is eminently manageable.

zh: 尽管如此，政客一直在利用移民问题，一些惹人注目的新来者 — — 特别是大量在利比亚沿岸被就起来的移民 — — 一直占据着新闻标题。
en: Nonetheless, politicians continue to exploit the migration issue, with some highly visible arrivals – in particular, the large number of migrants who have been rescued off the coast of Libya – keeping the issue in the news.

zh: 但真正需要解决的问题是已经到达欧盟领土的难民应该由哪个国家负责。
en: The real issue that needs to be resolved, however, is which country should be responsible for those who have already entered EU territory.

zh: 欧盟对这个问题的答案无法令各方满意，目前，这一局面已经威胁到申根自由跨国移动地区的生存。
en: The EU’s failure to answer this question in a way that satisfies all sides is now threatening the survival of the Schengen Area of border-free travel.

zh: 理论上，欧盟对于这个问题制定了明确的规则：根据所谓的都柏林规则，寻求庇护者所抵达的第一个欧盟国家负责审查他们的申请。
en: On paper, the EU has clear rules on the matter: under the so-called Dublin Regulation, the first EU country that asylum seekers enter is responsible for examining their applications.

zh: 但欧盟边境国家，如希腊和意大利等，自然会抱怨这让它们背上了不公平的负担。
en: But countries with external borders, such as Greece and Italy, naturally complain that this puts an unfair burden on them.

zh: 寻求庇护者本身也抵制这一规则。
en: Asylum seekers themselves also resist this rule.

zh: 一些南部边境国家的劳动力市场条件不太好，许多人径直前往北欧申请庇护。
en: Given unfavorable labor-market conditions in southern border countries, many make a beeline for northern Europe to apply for asylum.

zh: 因此，并没有外部边境的德国所收到的庇护申请比意大利更多。
en: That is why Germany, which has no external border, receives more asylum applications than Italy.

zh: 大量这类案件已经在欧盟庇护数据库EURODAC注册在案。
en: Many such cases have already been registered on the EU asylum database EURODAC.

zh: 根据都柏林规则，德国有权要求其他成员国“接管 ” （ 法律术语）这些案件。
en: According to the Dublin Regulation, Germany has the right to ask other member states to “take charge” (the legal term) of these cases.

zh: 但首抵国（first-country-of-arrival）规则有很多例外。
en: But there are many exceptions to the first-country-of-arrival rule.

zh: 比如，如果一位寻求庇护者已经在不同国家（在这个例子中，德国）有了家室，那么这个国家也可以负责处理申请。
en: For example, if an asylum seeker already has family in a different country (in this case, Germany), that country may be responsible for processing the application.

zh: 或者，如果一位寻求庇护者设法离开抵达国三个月，最初的申请可以收回，转而向不同的欧盟成员国递交申请。
en: Or if an asylum seeker manages to leave the country of arrival for three months, the initial application can be withdrawn and a new one submitted in a different EU member state.

zh: 这些例外给了寻求庇护者充分的空间在法庭力争都柏林转移。
en: These exceptions give asylum seekers ample room to contest Dublin transfers in court.

zh: 此外，国家当局有强烈的激励反对可能的形式或实质的转移要求，同时又尽可能多地发出这样的要求。
en: Moreover, national authorities have a strong incentive to object to incoming transfer requests on formal or substantive grounds, while trying to send abroad as many as possible.

zh: 2017年共发生了大约160,000例“接管”要求，但只有大约20,000 被实际执行。
en: About 160,000 “take charge” requests were lodged in 2017, though only about 20,000 were actually implemented.

zh: 这些因素，再加上欧盟成员国司法体系和行政程序方面的差异，使得都柏林规则形同虚设。
en: These factors, together with discrepancies among EU member states’ legal systems and administrative procedures, have largely nullified the Dublin Regulation.

zh: 这一现实就是德国执政联盟内部紧张局面的根源。
en: It was this reality that lay at the root of recent tensions within Germany’s coalition government.

zh: 2017年，德国当局根据都柏林规则发出了60,000次接管要求，只有不到15%被实际执行，只有7,100个难民被转移到其他成员国。
en: Of more than 60,000 take-charge requests lodged by German authorities in 2017 under the Dublin Regulation, fewer than 15% were actually implemented, resulting in just 7,100 transfers to other member states.

zh: 但在2016年，德国执行了它收到的27,000例转移要求中的近30 % ， 也就是说，它接管了大约8,700人。
en: Yet in 2016, Germany implemented close to 30% of the 27,000 incoming requests it received, meaning that it took charge of about 8,700 people.

zh: 德国也因此成为都柏林转移的净接收国，尽管它并没有外部边境。
en: Germany has thus become a net recipient of Dublin transfers, despite lacking an external border.

zh: 基于此，希霍夫希望阻止已在其他国家注册EURODAC的寻求庇护者进入德国。
en: Given this, Seehofer wants to prevent asylum seekers who have been registered elsewhere on EURODAC from ever entering Germany.

zh: 但他绝不是唯一感到失望的人：司法原则和现实之间的鸿沟所造成的后果是没有一个成员国对当前的体系感到满意。
en: But he is far from alone in his frustration: the upshot of the gulf between legal principles and reality is that no member state is satisfied with the current system.

zh: 边境国一直坚持认为都柏林规则对它们不公平，而北欧国家抱怨都柏林规则没有得到合理的执行。
en: While border countries continue to insist that the Dublin Regulation is unfair to them, northern countries complain that it is not being implemented properly.

zh: 在欧盟庇护体系下，十多个国家当局对待入境申请犹如烫手山芋，这样的体系是无法运转的。
en: An asylum system in which more than a dozen national bureaucracies try to pass applicants around like hot potatoes cannot work.

zh: 欧洲庇护支持办公室（EASO）应该负责解释难民分配规则 — — 比如决定当成员国对于某个案例发生分歧时，由哪个国家负责。
en: The European Asylum Support Office (EASO) should be made responsible for interpreting the rules for assigning refugees – deciding, for example, which country is responsible when member states disagree in individual cases.

zh: 提供接受难民的金融激励 — — 如每接受一位难民获得一笔一次性资金 — — 也会有裨益。
en: Providing financial incentives for accepting refugees – say, a lump sum for each one – would also help.

zh: 这两项措施无法满足民粹主义者。
en: These two measures will not satisfy the populists.

zh: 反对难民和移民 — — 甚至将他们和他们的支持者妖魔化 — — 是他们的政治面包和黄油。
en: Opposition to refugees and migrants – and even demonization of them and their supporters – is their political bread and butter.

zh: 但加强EASO并提高金融支持应该有助于缓解目前的紧张局面，至少能够让欧洲庇护体系制定彻底的改革计划。
en: But strengthening EASO and boosting financial support should go some way toward alleviating today’s tensions, at least until a radical reform of Europe’s asylum system can be contemplated.

zh: 欧洲任务
en: Europe as a Task

zh: 对于现任捷克共和国总理的我来说，欧洲的意义远远超过其地理范畴。
en: For me as Prime Minister of the Czech Republic, Europe has a meaning that goes far beyond geography.

zh: 它是新开端、新希望和在我们每个人身上都存在着的"更好的自我"的同义词。
en: It is a synonym for a new beginning, new hope, the rule of the "better me" that exists in all of us.

zh: 它表达了繁荣、进步和公正。
en: It's an expression of prosperity, progress, and justice.

zh: 对于愤世嫉俗的人，这些话听起来或许有些夸张。
en: Perhaps these words sound exaggerated to cynical ears.

zh: 但它们清楚地表达了欧洲在过去的50多年里所见证的变化。 在长期不被允许分享欧洲和平与繁荣的成果之后，捷克人现在要为自己争取这种美好的变化。
en: But they clearly express the changes that Europe has witnessed over the past half-century, changes for the good that all Czechs now want to secure for themselves, having been denied the fruits of European peace and prosperity for so long.

zh: 在历史上，欧洲发生过无数血腥的战争；当民族之间和国家之间发生冲突的时候，捷克往往成为这些血腥战役的十字路口。
en: Throughout its history, Europe saw countless bloody conflicts; peoples and states clashed, with the Czech lands often the bloody crossroads of these battles.

zh: 两次世界大战和半个世纪的冷战所造成的灾难促使欧洲接受合作与一体化从而避免另一场自杀性战争的发生。
en: The disasters of two world wars, and the half-century of Cold War, pushed Europe to embrace cooperation and integration in order to avoid another suicidal battle.

zh: 那些通过统一将欧洲引领到和平之路上来的具有远见卓识的欧洲人值得我们由衷的敬仰。
en: Those far-sighted Europeans who set Europe on its road to peace through unification deserve our heartfelt appreciation.

zh: 简单地说，欧洲一体化的理念改变了欧洲大陆。
en: Simply put, the idea of European integration transformed our continent.

zh: 开放的经济空间和团结的原则确保了那些加入欧共体，而后再加入欧盟的经济较不发达的欧洲国家飞速发展，不断提高其人民的生活水平。
en: The open economic space and the principle of solidarity helped ensure that economically less developed countries that joined the European Economic Community and, later, the European Union, progressed at an astonishing pace, enhancing the living standards of their peoples.

zh: 确实，在现今的欧洲，随着各国人民生活质量的全面提高，生活水平的差距日渐缩小。 不断扩大的生活水平差距作为曾经一度的历史模式已不复存在。
en: Nowadays, indeed, instead of deepening disparities in standards of living in Europe, which was the historic norm, differences are actually blurring as the quality of life everywhere in Europe rises.

zh: 然而这个繁荣与和平的欧洲并不是田园牧歌；正如过去十年里狂乱的巴尔干战争和痛苦的后共产主义转型所昭示的，欧洲有时也不是个能让人安居乐业的地方。
en: Yet this prosperous and peaceful Europe is not idyllic; sometimes Europe is not at all an easy place for its citizens to live, as the tumultuous Balkan Wars and painful postcommunist transitions of the past decade demonstrated.

zh: 但就是在艰难时世下，每个欧洲人的内心都明了：欧洲一体化以其不断扩大欧洲和平与稳定的区域的清晰前景已经为我们带来了和平。
en: But even in hard times, every European knows deep down that European integration has delivered peace with clear prospects for broadening Europe's zone of peace and stability.

zh: 然而，要兑现和平与稳定的承诺，欧洲人必须意识到欧盟并不是也不能被当作是一纸空文。
en: On the other hand, to secure that promise of peace and stability, Europeans must recognize that the Union is not and cannot be perceived as a work set in stone.

zh: 由一体化带来的半个世纪的和平也在不断演进着。
en: The half-century of peace that integration has delivered involved constant changes.

zh: 今天，我们必须继续塑造和修正欧盟以使其能够最大限度的反映其居民在不断变化的世界形势下的需求。
en: Today, we must also continue forming and correcting the EU to maximize its ability to reflect the needs of its inhabitants in an ever-changing world.

zh: 但是这些变革必须和欧洲的核心价值观一致。
en: These changes, however, must always be undertaken in the light of core European virtues.

zh: 在这个价值体系中最重要的大约就是欧盟开放性的特点。
en: Foremost among these, perhaps, is the Union's open character.

zh: 欧盟既不是封闭的也不是静态的；它是一个充满生命力的有机体。
en: The European Union is neither closed nor static; it is a living organism.

zh: 按照我的理解，欧盟首先是一个不断向上的进程；这个进程的唯一目标就是-持续发展欧洲的繁荣与和平。
en: The European Union, as I grasp it, is primarily a process, leading from worse to better; a process with only one end - the continuous development of European prosperity and peace.

zh: 确实，明白欧洲一体化进程不是机械的而是有机的这一点至关重要。
en: Indeed, it is vital to understand that Europe's integration process is not mechanical but organic.

zh: 它不是一台自行其是的机器，而是一个所有欧洲人都必须为之生活和工作的理念。
en: It is not a machine that goes on of its own accord, but is instead something that must be lived and worked for by Europeans.

zh: 因为所有人都应该明白：欧洲一体化的方式还有其它的选择-但都是糟糕的、不受欢迎的和危险的。
en: For no one should be mistaken: there are alternatives to European integration - all of them bad, unwanted, and dangerous.

zh: 除非所有的欧洲人都致力于一体化和塑造一个开放的欧洲的进程，否则这片大陆黑暗的过去就会在未来重演。
en: Unless all Europeans remain devoted to integration and the creation of an open Europe, the Continent's dark past may once again become its future.

zh: 如果一体化要继续建设一个更加开放的欧洲，那么有些品质是我们必须了解的。
en: There are a number of qualities that must be understood if integration is to continue to build an ever more open Europe.

zh: 最重要的一种品质就是主动的自我约束-一种自发与更广泛的集体分享权利和待遇的品质。
en: Voluntary self-restraint, a voluntary sharing of our own rights and privileges with a wider collective, is paramount here.

zh: 一些国家曾经以牺牲他国的权利为代价来贯彻自己的权利，而它们现在却以有利于他国的方式转让自己的权利。
en: While states once enforced their rights at the expense of others, they now transfer their rights in favor of others.

zh: 这种奇迹发生的动因是它让所有人获益-欧洲的公民、国家、整个欧洲大陆以至全世界。
en: The heart of this miracle is that it benefits all - Europe's citizens, its states, the whole continent, and the world.

zh: 国家主动限制自身的行为在人类历史上是绝无仅有的。
en: For states to voluntarily limit themselves is unique in human history.

zh: 欧洲国家能够实现这种约束首先因为它们都是民主国家。
en: Europe's states have been able to achieve this discipline primarily because they are democracies.

zh: 欧洲的人民同意限制政府的权力以使全欧洲的和平得以实现。
en: Europe's peoples have sanctioned limiting their own governments powers so as to achieve peace across Europe.

zh: 如果没有民主的原则作为基础，就不会有欧盟，更不会有欧洲的一体化。
en: There would be no Union and no integration, were it not built on the principles of democracy.

zh: 这就是为什么中欧和东欧的国家在重建民主政体之后都不约而同地选择加入洲大陆一体化的进程。
en: This is why, having regained their democratic regimes, Central and Eastern European countries unequivocally voted to join the continent's integration process.

zh: 这也就是为什么这些国家将它们民主的未来和与其他欧洲国家更紧密的合作联系起来。
en: This is why these countries associate the future of their democracies with ever-closer and more integrated cooperation with other European states.

zh: 诚然，民主并不自动地意味着一体化。
en: Of course, democracy does not automatically mean integration.

zh: 但没有民主也就不可能有真正的、公平的和让所有人获益的一体化进程。
en: But without democracy, no genuine, fair, and universally beneficial integration would be possible.

zh: 捷克共和国的人民和大多数欧洲人一样，希望在欧洲的国家、地区、城市及其居民之间共同建立一种不可撤销的相互关系。
en: The people of the Czech Republic, like most Europeans, wish to jointly build an irreversible system of mutual relationships among states, regions, municipalities, and their inhabitants.

zh: 他们的愿望是清除暴力同时为所有欧洲人创造一个适于经济和社会发展的稳定环境。
en: Their desire is to eliminate violence and, at the same time, generate stable conditions for economic and social progress for everyone in Europe.

zh: 欧洲的历史将会如何发展也许现在还不明了，但欧洲黑暗历史的终点却近在眼前-只要欧洲人继续在一体化的道路上前行。
en: The end of history may not be at hand in Europe, but the end of Europe's dark history is clearly in sight - so long as Europeans continue on the path of integration.

zh: 欧洲的四大战役
en: Europe’s Battle on Four Fronts

zh: 伦敦 — — 随着德国大选结束，欧洲已经走到了持续政治动荡期的尽头。
en: LONDON – With Germany’s election over, Europe has reached the end of a season of continuous political upsets.

zh: 现在已经到了采取行动应对所有这些投票所造成混乱的时候。
en: It is now time for actions that adequately respond to the upheavals created by all these votes.

zh: 欧洲委员会第一副总裁弗兰克·蒂姆曼去年曾用 “多重危机”这个词来形容欧洲的状态：英国脱欧、难民问题、匈牙利和波兰的“非自由民主 ” 、 仍然悬而未决的欧元危机以及应当归咎于唐纳德·特朗普和弗拉基米尔·普京的地缘政治危险因素。
en: Frans Timmermans, the European Commission’s first vice president, last year described the state of Europe as “multi-crisis”: Brexit, refugees, “illiberal democracy” in Hungary and Poland, the still-unresolved euro crisis, and the geopolitical risks attributable to Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin.

zh: 所有这些都对60年前始于《罗马条约》的“欧洲计划”构成了挑战。
en: All are challenging the “European project” that began 60 years ago with the Treaty of Rome.

zh: 但危机总是伴随着机遇。
en: But crises invariably create opportunities.

zh: 而去年的多重危机已经为欧洲带来了不止一个机遇。
en: And last year’s multi-crisis has produced a convergence of opportunities.

zh: 欧洲领导人不再有不作为的借口，因为他们继续等下去，只会等来选民下一次打击。
en: European leaders no longer have an excuse for inaction while they wait for voters’ next rebuff.

zh: 法国的经济改革、德国对难民问题和欧元问题的担忧、布鲁塞尔对欧洲一体化的新态度以及英国脱欧将被无限延期甚或完全颠覆的迹象：所有这一切都为驯服去年民粹主义暴动所释放的危险力量创造了新的机遇。
en: Economic reforms in France, German unease about refugees and the euro, new attitudes toward European integration in Brussels, and signs that Brexit will be delayed indefinitely or even completely averted: all have created new possibilities for taming the dangerous forces unleashed by last year’s populist revolts.

zh: 但抓住这些机遇需要在欧洲各国同时实现四大政治和经济突破。
en: But realizing these opportunities will require four simultaneous political and economic breakthroughs across Europe.

zh: 法国必须采取行动，纠正过度监管和过度公共开支。
en: France must act on over-regulation and excessive public spending.

zh: 德国则必须重新思考财政紧缩和死板的货币政策。
en: Germany must rethink fiscal austerity and monetary dogma.

zh: 英国需要转变在民族主义和移民问题上的立场。
en: Britain needs a turnabout on nationalism and immigration.

zh: 而欧盟官员则必须放弃他们对促使所有成员国实现许多民众并不接受的“越来越紧密联盟”的痴迷。
en: And European Union officials must abandon their obsession with driving all member countries toward an “ever-closer union” that many of their citizens do not want.

zh: 如果没有这四方面的同时突破，很难想象任何进展能够在多重危机的某个领域单独取得。
en: Without simultaneous breakthroughs on all four fronts, it is hard to imagine progress on any of the separate aspects of the multi-crisis.

zh: 例如，德国推动的任何紧缩政策的放松都需要证明法国正在采取经济改革；而只有在德国同意更宽松的财政规则并支持惠及欧元区弱势成员的货币政策的前提下法国的改革才能取得成功。
en: For example, any easing of German-inspired austerity will require evidence of economic reform in France; but French reforms will succeed only if Germany agrees to more generous fiscal rules and supports monetary policies that benefit the eurozone’s weaker members.

zh: 同样，如果欧盟同意将谈判期限延长到2019年3月以后并在移民和福利支付问题上做出某些微小的让步，才有可能避免或无限期推迟英国的脱欧进程。
en: Similarly, Brexit could be averted or indefinitely delayed if the EU offered an extension of the negotiating period beyond March 2019 and suggested some modest concessions on immigration and welfare payments.

zh: 但欧洲领导人只有看到明确的证据，证明英国选民正在改变其离开欧盟初衷的情况下才会考虑作出这样的让步。
en: But European leaders would consider offering such concessions only if they saw clear evidence that British voters were changing their minds about leaving the EU.

zh: 现在来看看反对安格拉·默克尔总理及其领导的社会民主党伙伴联盟的那些德国选民，他们持反对态度主要因为他们痛恨所看到的不受控制的移民以及针对希腊的不合理的转移支付。
en: Now consider the German voters who have turned against Chancellor Angela Merkel and her SPD coalition partners, mainly because they resent what they see as uncontrolled immigration and unjustified transfer payments to Greece.

zh: 如果这些选民认为政府用他们的钱来补贴那些拒绝在难民问题上合作并拒绝遵守欧盟法律的欧洲周边贫困国家，他们就会反对稳定欧元区所必须的财政和货币一体化政策。
en: These voters will oppose the fiscal and monetary integration required to stabilize the eurozone if they think their money will be spent on subsidizing poor countries on Europe’s periphery that refuse to cooperate on refugees and fail to abide by EU laws.

zh: 说服德国选民他们的钱并未被乱用的唯一方法是建立欧元区独立的政治机构和预算计划。
en: The only way to convince German voters that their money will not be misdirected would be to create separate political institutions and a separate budget for the eurozone.

zh: 这项提案由法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙提出并原则上获得了默克尔的赞同。
en: This is the proposal advanced by French President Emmanuel Macron and supported in principle by Merkel.

zh: 但这样一项欧洲双轨制计划实行的前提是默克尔能够压制想要打破单一货币的德国民族主义者，同时还要求马克龙能够压制布鲁塞尔的一体化狂热分子，这些人希望迫使所有欧盟国家加入欧元区。
en: But plans for such a two-track Europe can advance only if Merkel can overcome German nationalists who want to break up the single currency, and only if Macron can silence integrationist zealots in Brussels who want to force all EU countries to join the eurozone.

zh: 乍看上去，同时在诸多方面取得进展的可能性是微乎其微的。
en: At first sight, simultaneous progress on many fronts seems too much to hope for.

zh: 毕竟，如果法国、德国、英国和布鲁塞尔取得必要突破的概率都是掷硬币式的50%对50 % ， 那么所有四个硬币都正面朝上的概率应当仅有6.25 % 。
en: After all, if the necessary breakthroughs in France, Germany, Britain, and Brussels were each a 50-50 coin-toss, the probability of all four coins landing “heads” would be only 6.25%.

zh: 幸运的是，至少有两个理由可以推翻如此明显的逻辑怀疑。
en: Fortunately, there are at least two reasons for dismissing such apparently logical scepticism.

zh: 首先，欧洲各国领导人现在所面临的政治和经济决策都具有相关性。
en: First, the political and economic decisions that leaders across Europe now face are anything but independent.

zh: 巴黎、伦敦和布鲁塞尔所发生的一切将完全取决于默克尔与其柏林最终联盟伙伴就政府计划的谈判结果。
en: What happens in Paris, London, and Brussels will depend crucially on the government program that Merkel negotiates with her eventual coalition partners in Berlin.

zh: 而德国的联盟协议又反过来取决于马克龙的外交技巧，取决于他如何宣传欧元区显著的政治经济特征。
en: And Germany’s coalition agreement will, in turn, depend on Macron’s diplomatic skills in advocating a distinct politico-economic identity for the eurozone.

zh: 同样重要的是，欧盟官僚机构必须热情拥抱双轨制欧洲的概念。
en: Equally important, the EU bureaucracy will have to embrace – enthusiastically – the concept of a two-track Europe.

zh: 这意味着放弃所有欧盟成员国都在向同一目标努力的假设及改变将非欧元区国家视为落后的二等公民的态度（欧盟官僚机构之前曾屈尊俯就地将这些国家称之为“预备加入国 ” ） 。
en: This means abandoning the assumption that all EU members are heading for the same destination, and an end to treating non-euro countries as second-class laggards (described condescendingly as “pre-ins”).

zh: 现在，假设欧盟领导人认识到保持欧洲稳定和进步的唯一可行方法是实行双轨制或采用“同心圆”模式，靠近核心部位的是政治更为一体化的欧元区，而外围则是由非欧元区国家构成的松散的经济联盟。
en: Now, suppose that EU leaders recognized that the only feasible way to maintain European stability and progress would be by adopting the two-track or “concentric circles” model, with a more politically integrated eurozone surrounded by a looser economic confederation of non-euro countries.

zh: 在这样的条件下，英国将很可能改变其退出欧盟的初衷。
en: Under these circumstances, Britain would be likely to change its mind about Brexit.

zh: 若非如此，英国将会花费几年时间陷入 困难的过渡状态，之后几乎肯定会重新加入瑞典、丹麦、波兰、匈牙利和捷克共和国等欧盟外围国家，反对欧元所要求的主权集中。
en: Failing that, Britain would spend several years in a transition limbo and would then almost certainly re-join Sweden, Denmark, Poland, Hungary, and the Czech Republic in the outer ring of EU countries that object to the pooling of sovereignty required by the euro.

zh: 这条外层轨道还将借助几乎不可抗拒的经济吸引力吸引挪威和瑞士的加入。
en: This outer orbit would also attract Norway and Switzerland through the irresistible pull of economic gravity.

zh: 由此推导出相信欧盟领导人能够在欧洲各国同时取得政治和经济突破的第二个理由。
en: This points to the second reason to believe that EU leaders could achieve simultaneous political and economic breakthroughs across Europe.

zh: 巴黎、柏林、伦敦和布鲁塞尔的必要决策绝不仅仅是随机的抛掷硬币。
en: The necessary decisions in Paris, Berlin, London, and Brussels are not just a random coin toss.

zh: 而是只要事实证明所有其他备选方案都将对经济造成损害或带来政治风险，那么所有民主国家的选民和政治领袖都将强烈希望作出支持经济繁荣和政治稳定的决策。
en: There are strong incentives for voters and political leaders in all democratic countries to take decisions that support economic prosperity and political stability, once it becomes obvious that all the alternatives are economically damaging or politically dangerous.

zh: 法国选民4月选出马克龙的时候可能已经达成了这项共识，同时随着英国脱欧的风险和矛盾变得越来越明显，英国类似的转折点可能正在加速到来之中。
en: This is the point that French voters arguably reached in April when they elected Macron, and a similar turning point is rapidly approaching in Britain, as the risks and contradictions of Brexit become ever clearer.

zh: 余下的就是德国必须认识到它的繁荣和安全取决于进一步欧元区一体化，以及处在欧元区外围的更加灵活的欧盟。
en: All that remains is for Germany to recognize that its prosperity and security depends on a more integrated eurozone inside a more flexible EU.

zh: 夹在特朗普和习近平之间的欧洲
en: Europe Between Trump and Xi

zh: 巴黎 — — 今年12月在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯召开的最新一届世贸组织部长级会议失败得非常之惨。
en: PARIS – The most recent World Trade Organization ministerial conference, held in December in Buenos Aires, Argentina, was a fiasco.

zh: 尽管议程有限，但与会者仍未能达成联合声明。
en: Despite a limited agenda, the participants were unable to produce a joint statement.

zh: 但并非各方都对这一结果感到失望：中国在外交方面保持沉默，而美国似乎庆幸这次会议的失败。
en: But not everyone was disappointed by that outcome: China maintained a diplomatic silence, while the United States seemed to celebrate the meeting’s failure.

zh: 这对欧洲而言是个坏消息，事实上只有欧洲在表达不满。
en: This is bad news for Europe, which was virtually alone in expressing its discontent.

zh: 外界常常指出，在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普推行狭隘保护主义的情况下，欧盟有机会发挥更大的国际领导作用，同时强化其自身在全球贸易领域的国际地位。
en: It is often pointed out that, in the face of US President Donald Trump’s blinkered protectionism, the European Union has an opportunity to assume a larger international leadership role, while strengthening its own position in global trade.

zh: 最近与日本签署的自贸协定将导致欧盟在农业领域对美国取得明显的优势，而随着美国重新谈判北美自由贸易协定，加强与墨西哥的贸易关系也有可能产生类似的影响。
en: The free-trade agreement recently signed with Japan will give the EU a clear advantage over the US in agriculture, and strengthening trade ties with Mexico could have a similar impact, as the US renegotiates the North American Free Trade Agreement.

zh: 有人提出为进一步巩固自身地位，欧洲应当与中国合作，中国虽然在世贸组织会议上保持沉默，但最近却试图将自身定位为多边主义的领导者。
en: Some suggest that, to strengthen its position further, Europe should team up with China, which, despite its reticence at the WTO conference, has lately attempted to position itself as a champion of multilateralism.

zh: 中欧伙伴关系完全有可能成为抵消美国对国际贸易及合作所造成负面影响的强大力量。
en: A Sino-European partnership could be a powerful force offsetting America’s negative impact on international trade and cooperation.

zh: 但这样一种伙伴关系距离确定还相去甚远。
en: Yet such a partnership is far from certain.

zh: 是的，欧洲和中国对全球化和多边主义同样抱有积极的总体看法。
en: Yes, Europe and China converge on a positive overall view of globalization and multilateralism.

zh: 虽然欧洲支持一种旨在加强现有机构规则和执法机制的“进攻性多边主义 ” ， 但中国却拒绝改变现有标准，尤其如果这种改变有可能强化执行限制发挥其自身能力优势的规则。
en: But whereas Europe supports a kind of “offensive multilateralism” that seeks to beef up existing institutions’ rules and enforcement mechanisms, China resists changes to existing standards, especially if they strengthen enforcement of rules that might constrain its ability to maximize its own advantages.

zh: 欧洲迫使中国遵守共同规则的愿望导致其利益与美国更紧密地联系在一起，欧美拥有诸多共同的不满，从中国持续实行私营企业补贴到市场准入屏障。
en: Europe’s desire to force China to adhere to common rules aligns its interests more closely with the US, with which it shares many of the same grievances, from China’s continued subsidization of private enterprises to the persistence of barriers to market access.

zh: 最近的一项研究显示，中国的市场准入壁垒已经对欧洲出口增长造成了很大的影响。
en: According to one recent study, market access barriers erected by China have taken a high toll on the growth of EU exports.

zh: 但美国和欧盟在如何解决这些不满方面看法并不一致。
en: But the US and the EU do not have the same vision for how to address these grievances.

zh: 为限制中国滥用世贸规则，欧洲领导人希望能够通过双边投资协议框架或多边公共采购协议来谈判新的、更明确的规则。
en: In order to limit abuse of WTO rules by China, Europe’s leaders want to be able to negotiate new, clearer rules, either through the framework of a bilateral investment agreement or through a plurilateral agreement on public procurement.

zh: 特朗普并不想改革现有制度；他想要废弃它。
en: Trump does not want to reform the system; he wants to sink it.

zh: 事实上，因为特朗普试图利用双边协定来减少美国贸易赤字，美国未来彻底退出世贸组织的可能性将无法排除 — — 这对欧盟而言不啻于一场噩梦，后者一直主张不使用武力而使用共同规则。
en: In fact, with Trump seeking to use bilateral deals to secure reductions in America’s trade deficit, the possibility that the US will leave the WTO altogether – a nightmare scenario for the EU, which advocates shared norms over force – cannot be excluded.

zh: 特朗普的前任奥巴马提出了自己的解决方案。
en: Trump’s predecessor, Barack Obama, had his own solution.

zh: 新一代多边框架协定 — — 与亚洲的跨太平洋伙伴关系（TPP）和与欧盟的跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系（TTIP ） — —将会限制中国的回旋空间。
en: New multilateral frameworks – the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP) with Asia and the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) with the EU – would circumscribe China’s room for maneuver.

zh: 因为这样的框架协定会带来监管趋同效应，美国和欧盟将能借此定义新兴全球经济标准，从而迫使中国要么接受要么被甩开。
en: As such frameworks brought about regulatory convergence, the US and the EU would be able to define the standards of the emerging new global economy, forcing China either to accept those standards or be left behind.

zh: 但该计划已经遭到了致命的破坏。
en: But this project has now been fatally undermined.

zh: 奥巴马试图在任期结束前最终敲定这两份协定的努力虽然可以理解，但却引发了对匆忙决策的严重关切。
en: Obama’s effort to finalize both agreements before the end of his presidency, though understandable, bred serious concerns about hastiness.

zh: 欧洲人认识到美国和欧洲间实现全面监管趋同实际上至少需要十年时间。
en: Europeans recognized that full regulatory convergence between the US and the EU would, in reality, take at least a decade.

zh: 因此在国内民众的压力下，欧洲领导人开始对环境和卫生法规及透明度的缺乏表达关注。
en: So, under pressure from their citizens, European leaders began to express concern about what the TTIP was lacking in terms of, say, environmental and sanitary regulations and transparency.

zh: 因为在监管趋同，尤其是强化对中国立场方面拥有共同的利益，美国和欧盟最终将不得不恢复合作。
en: Given their shared interest in regulatory convergence, particularly to strengthen their position vis-à-vis China, the US, and the EU will eventually have to resume cooperation toward that end.

zh: 但只要特朗普掌权，积极宣扬双边互惠并压制多边主义，这样的努力也许根本就不可能。
en: But, as long as Trump is in power, advocating bilateral reciprocity over multilateralism, such an effort will probably be impossible.

zh: 相反，特朗普的美国极有可能继续利用其深远的商业影响力来获取战略或政治好处。
en: Instead, Trump’s America will most likely continue to take advantage of its far-reaching commercial influence to secure strategic or political gains.

zh: 在这方面，欧洲的劣势相当严重。
en: On this front, Europe is at a significant disadvantage.

zh: 欧盟毕竟不是一个国家，因此无法用一个声音在国际事务中表达自己的诉求。
en: The EU is, after all, not a state, and it does not speak on international matters with one voice.

zh: 那些熟练运用现实政治语言的中国人不是不可能宁愿满足美国人也不愿满足欧洲人对多边条件的特别要求。
en: It is not out of the question that the Chinese, who speak the language of realpolitik fluently, would prefer to meet the ad hoc demands of the Americans over the multilateral conditions of the Europeans.

zh: 在这样的大背景下，欧盟的首要任务应当是统一成员国立场，以克服美国所设的壁垒和建立共同制约中国的制度。
en: In this context, the EU’s top priority should be to unify the positions of its member states, with the goal of overcoming the barriers erected by the US and creating shared systems for constraining China.

zh: 但说来容易做来难。
en: But that is easier said than done.

zh: 目前，许多欧盟国家反对引入任何贸易限制，无论出于对自由经济理想的过度痴迷亦或是害怕欧盟管理国外投资共同机制的建立会有损于它们自身在中国的利益。
en: As it stands, many EU countries resist the introduction of any trade restrictions, whether owing to an excessive commitment to liberal economic ideals or fear of jeopardizing their own interests in China by, say, establishing an EU mechanism for managing foreign investment.

zh: 中东欧地区“非自由”政府的兴起导致欧盟所面临的局面更加复杂。
en: The emergence of “illiberal” governments in Central and Eastern Europe complicates matters further for the EU.

zh: 上述政府对任何形式的多边主义都不感兴趣，因为他们只在乎自身的狭隘利益。
en: These governments have no interest in any form of multilateralism, as they have embraced a narrow view of their interests.

zh: 它们看似时常沉迷于特朗普、中国主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京所推崇的现实政治逻辑。
en: They often seem fascinated by the logic of realpolitik espoused by Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

zh: 不仅如此，这些国家可能以损害欧盟采购规则为代价来追求其自身的商业利益。
en: Moreover, these countries’ pursuit of their commercial interests could come at the expense of EU procurement rules.

zh: 而且这种做法在欧盟内部并不稀奇。
en: And they are not alone within the EU.

zh: 例如希腊已经接受了大笔的中国投资。
en: Greece, for example, has accepted large amounts of Chinese investment.

zh: 欧盟而后又在涉及南海冲突的一项决议中明确拒绝提到中国的名字。
en: The EU then refused to mention China explicitly in a resolution on the conflict in the South China Sea.

zh: 可以肯定，欧洲国家欢迎中国投资并没有错。
en: To be sure, European countries are not wrong to welcome Chinese investment.

zh: 但中国应当互惠互利，更积极地欢迎欧洲在中国的投资。
en: But China should be reciprocating, offering European investment in China a warmer welcome.

zh: 欧盟和中国应当努力完成双方已经谈判数年但却进展有限的双边投资条约。
en: That is why the EU and China should work to complete the bilateral investment treaty that they have been negotiating for years, with limited progress.

zh: 这样的条约应当以互惠原则为基础，包括拆除中国市场存在的投资壁垒。
en: Such a treaty should rely on reciprocal rules, including the dismantling of barriers to China’s market.

zh: 法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙正竭力推进进攻型多边主义。
en: French President Emmanuel Macron is trying to advance offensive multilateralism.

zh: 但除非欧盟作为一个整体拥护这项事业，否则夹在信奉非常保守但又过时的多边主义解读的中国和想要彻底废除多边主义的特朗普之间的欧盟就很有可能成为牺牲品。
en: But unless the EU as a whole embraces the cause, Europe – caught between China, which has a very conservative but outdated interpretation of multilateralism, and Trump, who wants to get rid of it – risks becoming a casualty.

zh: 欧洲的英国脱欧宿醉
en: Europe’s Brexit Hangover

zh: 纽约—市场对英国脱欧冲击的反应和其他两次最近的全球金融动荡 — — 2015年夏天（担心中国硬着陆）和今年前两个月（中国担忧卷土重来，以及其他全球尾部风险 ） — —相比显得相当温和。
en: NEW YORK – The market reaction to the Brexit shock has been mild compared to two other recent episodes of global financial volatility: the summer of 2015 (following fears of a Chinese hard landing) and the first two months of this year (following renewed worries about China, along with other global tail risks).

zh: 这场冲击只是地区性而非全球性，市场影响集中在英国和欧洲；而波动仅仅维持了一周，前两次严重的避险潮持续了大约两个月并导致美国和全球股市剧烈修正。
en: The shock was regional rather than global, with the market impact concentrated in the United Kingdom and Europe; and the volatility lasted only about a week, compared to the previous two severe risk-off episodes, which lasted about two months and led to a sharp correction in US and global equity prices.

zh: 为什么此次冲击如此温和和短暂？
en: Why such a mild, temporary shock?

zh: 首先，英国只占全球GDP的3 % 。
en: For starters, the UK accounts for just 3% of global GDP.

zh: 相反，中国（世界第二大经济体）占世界产出的15%和全球增长的一大半。
en: By contrast, China (the world’s second-largest economy) accounts for 15% of world output and more than half of global growth.

zh: 此外，欧盟在英国脱欧后表现出的团结，以及西班牙选举的结果安抚了欧盟或欧元区很快就会解体的担忧。
en: Moreover, the European Union’s post-Brexit show of unity, together with the result of the Spanish election, calmed fears that the EU or the eurozone would fall apart in short order.

zh: 而英国政府的迅速换届也让人们对英国和欧盟的“离婚”谈判有了希望，也许不管过程多么崎岖，结果将是一个通过大限度欧盟单一市场准入资格和有限的移民控制相结合保留大部分贸易联系的方案。
en: And the rapid government changeover in the UK has boosted hopes that the divorce negotiations with the EU, however bumpy, will lead to a settlement that maintains most trade links by combining substantial access to the single market with modest limits on migration.

zh: 更重要的是，市场很快就将英国脱欧冲击将导致世界主要央行采取更加鸽派的立场体现在了价格中。
en: Most important, markets quickly priced in the conclusion that the Brexit shock would lead to greater dovishness among the world’s major central banks.

zh: 事实上，在前两次避险事件中，正是央行流动性支撑了市场和经济。
en: Indeed, as in the two previous risk-off episodes, central-bank liquidity backstopped markets and economies.

zh: 但欧洲和全球波动的风险可能只是短暂地中止了。
en: But the risk of European and global volatility may have been only briefly postponed.

zh: 抛去其他全球风险不谈（包括已然相当平庸的美国增长的减速、中国硬着陆担忧增加、石油和大宗商品价格颓势以及重要新兴市场的脆弱性等 ） ， 有充分地里有担心欧洲和欧元区。
en: Leaving aside other global risks (including a slowdown in already-mediocre US growth, more fear of a Chinese hard landing, weakness in oil and commodity prices, and fragilities in key emerging markets), there is plenty of reason to worry about Europe and the eurozone.

zh: 首先，英国-欧盟离婚过程可能持久而激烈，增长和市场将因此蒙受损失。
en: First, if the UK-EU divorce proceedings become protracted and acrimonious, growth and markets will suffer.

zh: 而丑陋的离婚可能还将导致苏格兰和北爱尔兰脱离英国。
en: And an ugly divorce may also lead Scotland and Northern Ireland to leave the UK.

zh: 果真如此的话，加泰罗尼亚可能也会推进脱离西班牙独立。
en: In that scenario, Catalonia may also push for independence from Spain.

zh: 而没有了英国，不准备加入欧元区的丹麦和瑞典可能担心自己沦为欧盟二等成员，因此导致它们也考虑脱欧。
en: And without the UK, Denmark and Sweden, which aren’t planning to join the eurozone, may fear that they will become second-class members of the EU, thus leading them to consider leaving as well.

zh: 其次，即将到来的选举是一个政治雷区。
en: Second, upcoming elections promise to be a political minefield.

zh: 奥地利将在9月重新举行总统选举，上一次的结果基本上是平手，这意味着极右翼自由党（Freedom Party）的诺伯特·霍福尔（Norbert Hofer）又有了机会。
en: Austria will repeat its presidential election in September, the previous one having ended in a virtual tie, giving another chance to the far-right Freedom Party’s Norbert Hofer.

zh: 接下来的一个月，匈牙利将举行由总理欧尔班发起的推翻欧盟收容移民配额指令的公投。
en: The following month, Hungary will hold a referendum, initiated by Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, on overturning EU-mandated quotas on the resettlement of migrants.

zh: 最重要的是，意大利将进行修宪公投，如果不通过，可能在很大程度上影响到意大利的欧元区成员资格。
en: And, most important, Italy will hold a referendum on constitutional changes that, if rejected, could effectively jeopardize the country’s membership in the eurozone.

zh: 目前，意大利是欧元区最脆弱的一环。
en: Italy currently is the eurozone’s weakest link.

zh: 总理伦齐政府政局不稳，经济增长萎靡不振，银行急需资本，而若要实现欧盟财政目标，难免将引发又一场衰退。
en: Prime Minister Matteo Renzi’s government has become politically shakier, economic growth is anemic, the banks are in need of capital, and EU fiscal targets will be hard to achieve without triggering another recession.

zh: 如果伦齐失败 — — 目前这种可能性越来越大 — — 反欧元的五星运动（Five Star Movement，在最近的市政选举中表现出色）可能早在明年上台掌权。
en: If Renzi fails – as is increasingly possible – the anti-euro Five Star Movement (which recently did well in municipal elections) could come to power as early as next year.

zh: 果真如此的话，2015年的希腊脱欧担忧简直是小巫见大巫了。
en: Should that happen, the Grexit fears of 2015 would pale in comparison.

zh: 意大利是欧元区第三大成员国，太大而不能倒。
en: Italy, the eurozone’s third-largest member, is too big to fail.

zh: 但是，其公债水平十倍于希腊，因此也太大而不能救。
en: But, with a public debt ten times larger than Greece’s, it is also too big to be saved.

zh: 欧盟无法拿出能够支持意大利2万亿欧元（GDP的135 % ） 公共债务的计划。
en: No EU program can backstop Italy’s €2 trillion ($2.2 trillion) of public debt (135% of GDP).

zh: 此外，法国、德国和荷兰将在2017年进行选举，由于欧洲大部增长萎靡和失业高企导致了反欧元、反移民、反穆斯林和��全球化的民粹主义右翼（欧元区核心）和左翼（欧元区外围）政党的崛起，这些选举将进一步增加不确定性。
en: Moreover, elections in France, Germany, and the Netherlands in 2017 create additional uncertainties as weak growth and high unemployment in most of Europe boost support for anti-euro, anti-immigrant, anti-Muslim, and anti-globalization populist parties of the right (in the eurozone core) and of the left (on the eurozone periphery).

zh: 与此同时，欧洲周边情况糟糕并且每况愈下。
en: At the same time, Europe’s neighborhood is bad and getting worse.

zh: 修正主义俄罗斯日益独断专行，不仅在乌克兰如此，在波罗的海和巴尔干地区亦然。
en: A revisionist Russia has become more assertive not just in Ukraine, but also in the Baltics and the Balkans.

zh: 而中东继续动荡的后果至少要从两方面看：法国、比利时和德国恐怖主义事件抬头，假以时日可能危及企业和消费者信心；而移民危机需要加强与土耳其的合作，但土耳其本身因为未遂军事政变而变得不稳定。
en: And the consequences of the continuing turmoil in the Middle East are at least twofold: renewed episodes of terrorism in France, Belgium, and Germany, which may over time dent business and consumer confidence; and a migration crisis that requires closer cooperation with Turkey, which itself has become unstable since the botched military coup.

zh: 在这轮选举结束结束前，欧盟不可能采取任何措施通过引入更多的风险共担和加快结构改革鼓励更快的经济趋同来完成未竟的货币联盟。
en: Until the coming round of elections is over, the EU is unlikely to take any steps to complete its unfinished monetary union by introducing more risk-sharing and accelerating structural reforms to encourage faster economic convergence.

zh: 考虑到当前改革节奏缓慢（以及人口老化）的状况，潜在增长将保持低迷，而实际增长正处于一个非常平庸的周期性复苏，现在这一复苏又受到英国脱欧后风险和不确定性的威胁。
en: Given the current slow pace of reforms (and population aging), potential growth remains low, while actual growth is on a very moderate cyclical recovery that is now threatened by post-Brexit risks and uncertainties.

zh: 与此同时，沉重的赤字和债务，再加上欧元区规则，限制了通过使用财政政策刺激增长，而欧洲央行的非常规货币政策对维持复苏的支持力可能也在达到极限。
en: At the same time, high deficits and debts, together with eurozone rules, constrain the use of fiscal policy to boost growth, while the European Central Bank may be reaching the limits of what even unconventional monetary policy can do to sustain the recovery.

zh: 欧元区和欧盟不会突然间分崩离析。
en: The eurozone and the EU are unlikely to disintegrate suddenly.

zh: 它们所面临的许多风险累积的十分缓慢。
en: Many of the risks they face are on a slow fuse.

zh: 当然，可以通过平衡进一步一体化的需求和对一系列问题上的一定程度的国家自主和主权的渴望的政治愿景来避免解体。
en: And disintegration can of course be avoided by a political vision that balances the need for greater integration with the desire for some degree of national autonomy and sovereignty over a range of issues.

zh: 但找到民主和政治上可接受的一体化办法是当务之急。
en: But finding ways to integrate that are democratic and politically acceptable is imperative.

zh: 得过且过已经造成了一个不稳定的均衡，让欧盟和欧元区的解体变得不可避免。
en: Muddling through has resulted in an unstable equilibrium that will make disintegration of the EU and the eurozone inevitable.

zh: 考虑到欧洲所面临的众多风险，现在需要一个新愿景。
en: Given the many risks Europe faces, a new vision is needed now.

zh: 逐步一体化的欧洲
en: Europe by Degrees

zh: 罗马 — — 一年前，当欧盟宪法在2005年被否的伤痛尚未平复的时候，几乎没有人敢断定欧盟会以如此平稳的姿态批准去年12月在里斯本通过的新《改革条约 》 。
en: ROME -- A year ago, few people would have bet that the European Union, still reeling from the trauma of the Constitutional Treaty’s rejection in 2005, would be poised to ratify the new Reform Treaty, adopted in Lisbon last December.

zh: 在一些人看来，英国甚至先于意大利这样有 “亲欧洲”传统的国家签署这项条约，只能进一步说明这项条约在加速欧洲的统一步伐方面缺乏新鲜而大胆的创意。
en: For some, the fact that the United Kingdom might ratify it even earlier than traditionally “pro-European” countries like Italy merely underscores the Treaty’s lack of new and bold initiatives to accelerate European unification.

zh: 但是他们看错了。
en: But they are wrong.

zh: 勿庸置疑，从欧盟成立初期起，对于现状的急切不满就是推进欧洲一体化的一种驱动力量。
en: To be sure, impatient dissatisfaction has been a driving force behind European integration since its initial years.

zh: 但是，正像罗伯特·舒曼在他1950年发表的宣言中所写到的那样，大欧洲的建成不可能一蹙而就。
en: But, as Robert Schuman wrote in his Declaration in 1950, Europe could not be built all at once.

zh: 另外一位欧盟之父阿尔蒂诺·斯皮内利在晚年同样写道，如果没有充满幻想的欧洲人就不会有大欧洲，但是如果没有脚踏实地的政治家，这些幻想也将无果而终。
en: Likewise, Altiero Spinelli, another of the EU’s founding fathers, wrote late in life that without visionary Europeans there would be no Europe, but without pragmatic statesmen, the visionaries would have gotten nowhere.

zh: 《改革条约》的缺陷显而易见。
en: The Reform Treaty’s shortcomings are obvious.

zh: 放弃“宪法”之名可能是将所有欧盟成员国招至麾下的必要做法。
en: Abandoning the name “Constitution” was probably necessary to bring all member states on board.

zh: 但是，欧洲外交政策的口径需要有共同的政纲，而在这个问题上一直举棋不定就不是那么有必要了。
en: But not equally necessary is the enduring uncertainty about the common political platform upon which Europe’s voice in foreign policy will have to rely.

zh: 除此以外，在公民自由，国家安全和司法等领域也需要达成一致，从而为打击犯罪和恐怖主义确定基本决策，但这些方面缓慢的进展却让人难以忍受。
en: Moreover, the Area of Freedom, Security, and Justice still requires unanimity for essential decisions in the fight against crime and terrorism and therefore, implying excruciating slowness.

zh: 条约在加强欧洲各国经济和预算合作领域的力度也明显不够。
en: Nor does the Treaty do enough to strengthen coordination of Europe’s economic and budgetary policies.

zh: 然而，同样显而易见的是，正像《欧洲议会2月20号决议》所说的那样 ： “ 《里斯本条约》在已有条约的基础上迈进了一大步，这将强化欧盟的民主问责制度，同时也改善了欧盟的决策能力。
en: But it is equally obvious that, as the European Parliament’s Resolution of February 20 puts it, “the Treaty of Lisbon is a substantial improvement on the existing Treaties, which will bring more democratic accountability to the Union and enhance its decision making.”

zh: ”欧盟立法的通过将受到一定程度的议会审查（审查单位包括欧洲议会以及各国议会 ） ， 这在其他超国家或国家间组织中是根本不存在的。
en: The adoption of EU legislation will be subject to a level of parliamentary scrutiny (both at the European and national levels) that exists in no other supranational or international structure.

zh: 此外，欧洲刑警组织以及欧洲司法组织等机构也同样要更多地接受议会的监督，而且预算制定的程序将会更加简洁，同时也更加民主。
en: Moreover, agencies such as Europol and Eurojust will be similarly subject to greater parliamentary scrutiny, and the budgetary procedure will be simpler and more democratic.

zh: 《欧洲联盟基本权利宪章》将具有法律效力，对公民的司法保护也将通过降低欧洲法院的门槛以及扩大该法院的司法裁决权而得到加强。
en: The EU Charter of Fundamental Rights will become legally binding and the judicial protection of citizens will be enhanced by facilitating their access to the European Court of Justice and by extending the Court’s jurisdiction.

zh: 将欧盟理事会的高级代表与对外关系委员会合二为一，并建立单一的外交机构将有利于加强欧盟发挥全球作用的能力。
en: The Union’s capacity as a global actor will be enhanced by merging the High Representative with the Commissioner for External Relations and establishing a single diplomatic service.

zh: 变化还有很多，然而我们已经有足够的理由认定对欧盟及其成员国来讲，最应该做的就是从新《改革条约》中获取最大的利益。
en: The list could continue, but we already have reason enough to conclude that getting the best out of the new Treaty will be the best that the EU and its member states can do.

zh: 欧洲共同身份的第一剂要素已经注入到了扩大之后的欧盟实体，展现出了迥然各异的立场见解，敏感事务和期待解决的不同问题。
en: The first ingredients of a common collective identity have been injected into the EU’s enlarged membership, which is still marked by diverse positions, sensitivities, and expectations.

zh: 各成员国一致通过了新条约，在此时如果对每个成员国再提出更多的要求，将会损害欧洲原本就很脆弱的和谐关系。
en: Asking everyone to do more than what everyone is unanimously ratifying would undermine Europe’s fragile harmony.

zh: 但是，如果成员国相互之间的信任以及相似性促使他们在较小范围内通过独立的协议实现更大胆的目标，这应该是完全可以实现的。
en: Nothing, however, prevents smaller groups of member states from aiming at bolder goals through separate agreements, if their mutual trust and similarities encourage them to do it.

zh: 毕竟，后来构成了《欧盟现行法 》 ( 欧盟法律主体)一部分的《申根条约》就是这样达成的。
en: After all, this was how the Schengen Treaty – which later became part of the acquis communitaire (the body of EU law) – came into being.

zh: 近期通过的《普朗协议 》 （ Prun Agreement）已经将参与国之间的警务合作提升到了警务一体化的高度。
en: More recently, the Prun agreement has elevated police cooperation to police integration among the participating states.

zh: 因此，完全有理由展望一些欧盟成员国在打击犯罪，反恐，国防或财政以及预算协调等领域将朝着这一方向迈进。
en: There is reason to hope that some of the EU’s member states will embark on this venture in fighting crime and terrorism, defense matters, or in financial and budgetary harmonization.

zh: 无论在什么领域，一些相互更紧密融合的成员国将给欧盟带来核心凝聚力，从而有益于加强欧盟整体的统一。
en: In whatever area, a group of more deeply integrated member states would give the Union a noyau dur (a hard core) , which might be very helpful in strengthening the EU as a whole.

zh: 就让这些国家单独行动起来吧，同时欧盟通过已经实现的改进得到了更多的活力。
en: But let them do it separately, and in the meantime let the Union be energized by the improvements that it has already adopted.

zh: 这是舒曼宣言发表五十年后给我们的一个启示。
en: Fifty years later, this is the lesson for us of the Schuman’s declaration.

zh: 欧洲左派在移民问题上向右派看齐
en: Europe’s Left Turns Right on Immigration

zh: 柏林 — — 欧洲的建制左派正濒临灭绝。
en: BERLIN – Europe’s established left is facing the threat of extinction.

zh: 在不到两年里，欧洲大陆的社会民主党在法国、荷兰、德国和意大利都遭受了历史性的损失。
en: In less than two years, the continent’s social-democratic parties have suffered historic losses in France, the Netherlands, Germany, and Italy.

zh: 在欧洲这块长期以中左及中右翼党派竞争为特色的大陆，即使不考虑党派利益，左派崩溃所产生的影响可能也是非常深远的。
en: On a continent long defined by democratic competition between center-right and center-left parties, the collapse of the left could have far-reaching consequences, beyond particular party interests.

zh: 许多因素都能造成左派的衰落，其中包括传统工人阶级的解体。
en: Many factors underlie the left’s decline, including the dissolution of the traditional working class.

zh: 但其中最重要的原因既严峻又简单：欧洲选民越来越反对移民，而且不相信左派能对其加以限制。
en: But one of the most important reasons is as grim as it is simple: European voters are increasingly opposed to immigration, and do not trust the left to limit it.

zh: 面对主要来自中东和非洲地区的持续移民和难民涌入，欧洲选民已经将近期一系列选举转化成了有关移民问题的公投行动。
en: Faced with a sustained influx of refugees and migrants, primarily from the Middle East and Africa, European voters have transformed a series of recent elections into popular referenda on immigration.

zh: 右翼民粹主义运动巧妙地利用了蓝领选民的恐惧，让他们相信传统劳动党会允许移民流入而不设任何限制。
en: Right-wing populist movements have skillfully played on blue-collar voters’ fears by convincing them that traditional labor parties will allow immigrants to flow in virtually unchecked.

zh: 4月，匈牙利总理维克托·奥尔班在将竞选活动的重点放在所谓由穆斯林移民造成的对“基督教价值观”的“威胁”后，成功赢得了压倒性的胜利。
en: In April, Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán won a landslide election victory after running a campaign that focused on the “threat” to “Christian values” supposedly posed by Muslim immigrants.

zh: 意大利新的反建制联盟政府最近掌权，究其原因是马泰奥·萨尔维尼领导的坚定反移民的联盟党在国内广受欢迎，而萨尔维尼本人现在也担任内政部长兼副总理。
en: Italy’s new anti-establishment coalition government was propelled to power by the popularity of the staunchly anti-immigrant League party, led by Matteo Salvini, who is now interior minister and deputy prime minister.

zh: 在斯洛文尼亚，前总理亚内兹·扬沙领导的右翼反对党在本月举行的议会选举中赢得了略低于25%的选票，这意味着扬沙将组建该国下一届政府。
en: In Slovenia, former Prime Minister Janez Janša’s right-wing opposition party secured just under 25% of the vote in this month’s parliamentary election, meaning that Janša will form the country’s next government.

zh: 与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普相呼应，杨莎在反移民的“斯洛文尼亚优先”平台上开展其竞选活动。
en: Echoing US President Donald Trump, Janša campaigned on an anti-immigrant “Slovenia first” platform.

zh: 当右翼民粹主义最初开始获得政治支持时，欧洲中左翼政党希望传统优势能帮他们解决这一难题。
en: When right-wing populists first started gaining political traction, Europe’s center-left parties hoped that their traditional strengths would enable them to weather the challenge.

zh: 为避免在无意识的情况下强化右派观点，中左翼竞选人试图引导公众辩论向原有的意识形态舒适区倾斜：包括失业、不平等和社会正义。
en: To avoid unwittingly strengthening right-wing narratives, center-left campaigners attempted to shift public debate toward their ideological comfort zone: unemployment, inequality, and social justice.

zh: 德国的社会民主党（SPD）2017年全年竞选活动都围绕着一句口号 ， “ 现在是时候强化正义 ” 。
en: Germany’s Social Democratic Party (SPD) based its entire 2017 election campaign on the slogan, “It’s time for more justice.”

zh: 但一次又一次痛苦的失败终于促使中左翼党派形成了一种鲜明的认识：主要关心移民问题的选民不可能被平等的呼声所吸引 — — 无论这样的呼声多么饱含正义。
en: Yet defeat after painful defeat has driven center-left parties to a stark realization: voters who are concerned primarily with immigration are not going to be won over with calls – however justified – for equality.

zh: 因此，欧洲所有国家的中左翼政党已经开始修改路线，其中几个重要国家的社会民主党改变了长期坚持的移民问题态度。
en: As a result, center-left parties across Europe have begun to change course, with social democrats in several key countries changing long-held positions on migration.

zh: 在德国，联合政府（由社会民主党、基督教民主联盟和基民盟的巴伐利亚姐妹党基督教社会联盟组成）陷入了一场威胁联盟生存的激烈的移民斗争。
en: In Germany, the coalition government (comprising the SPD, the Christian Democratic Union, and the CDU’s Bavarian sister party, the Christian Social Union) is embroiled in a bitter fight over immigration that threatens the survival of the coalition.

zh: 尽管社会民主党希望在欧洲范围内寻找解决方案并拒绝封锁德国边境，但党派领导人安德里亚·纳勒斯呼吁加速审议庇护程序，从而能使当局在一个星期内在安全的第三国完成对庇护申请的处理。
en: While the SPD aims for a European solution and rejects sealing Germany’s borders, party leader Andrea Nahles called for accelerated asylum procedures that would enable authorities to conclude asylum applications from safe third countries within one week.

zh: 上个月，纳勒斯在社会民主党内部发起了一场辩论，她宣称德国“不能接收所有人 ” ， 这似乎是对右翼言论的一种呼应。
en: Last month, Nahles launched the debate within the SPD when, seemingly echoing right-wing rhetoric, she declared that Germany “cannot accept all.”

zh: 社民党及其青年联盟的某些领导人已经准备斗争。
en: Some in the SPD’s leadership and its youth wing were up in arms.

zh: 但纳勒斯加倍押注于现有立场，公开赞成由独立观察员委员会提交的对去年选举失败的批评性分析。
en: Yet Nahles has doubled down on her stance, publicly endorsing a critical analysis, compiled by a board of independent observers, of last year’s election defeat.

zh: 该报告认为在移民问题上“缺乏始终如一的社会民主立场”是该党的结构性弱点之一。
en: That report identified “the lack of a consistent social-democratic position” on migration issues as one of the party’s structural weaknesses.

zh: 奥地利的社会民主党进一步改变了移民问题立场。
en: Austria’s Social Democratic Party has taken its shift on immigration further.

zh: 该党领导层已经建立了新平台，并将在今年晚些时候正式通过，此举正式将该党立场界定为“赞成一体化 ” ， 而不是赞成移民。
en: The party leadership has presented a new platform, to be officially endorsed later this year, that formally redefines the party’s position as “pro-integration,” as opposed to pro-migration.

zh: 尽管上述平台确实提到过该国的“人道主义责任 ” ， 但同时也要求“有效地保护”欧盟的外部边境。
en: While the platform does refer to the country’s “humanitarian responsibilities,” it also demands “functioning protection” of the EU’s external borders.

zh: 丹麦的社会民主党比奥地利伙伴更进一步：在准备明年大选时，他们已经通过了一份新的移民立场文件，题为“公正和务实 ” 。
en: Denmark’s social democrats are a step ahead of their Austrian counterparts: in preparation for next year’s elections, they have adopted a new position paper on immigration titled “Just and Realistic.”

zh: 通过在欧洲以外设立“接待中心”审核庇护申请，该文件宣称，可以降低流入丹麦的移民人数。
en: By establishing “reception centers” outside Europe to decide on asylum claims, the paper asserts, the flow of migrants into Denmark can be reduced.

zh: 该文件还呼吁加强与联合国的合作并制定非洲“马歇尔计划 ” ， 这样做可以说服更多移民留在家中。
en: The paper also calls for stronger cooperation with the United Nations and a “Marshall Plan” for Africa that would presumably convince more migrants to stay home.

zh: 瑞典的社会民主党也基本持同样立场，因为他们试图抵御公众对极右翼反移民瑞典民主党的强力支持。
en: This stance is largely mirrored by Sweden’s social democrats, as they attempt to cope with strong public support for the far-right, anti-immigrant Sweden Democrats.

zh: 正在为9月连任展开竞选的总理斯特凡·勒芬最近称该国传统的开放移民政策“不可持续 ” 。
en: Prime Minister Stefan Löfven, who is campaigning for reelection in September, recently called his country’s traditionally open immigration policy “not sustainable.”

zh: 他拟议中名为“新时代安全移民政策”的政策提案可以将合法进入瑞典的难民人数减少一半，并防止被拒绝的庇护寻求者获得社会支持 — — 该立场遭到了亲移民团体的严厉批评。
en: His proposed policy, entitled “A Safe Migration Policy for a New Time,” would halve the number of refugees allowed into Sweden and prevent rejected asylum seekers from receiving social support – a position that pro-migration groups harshly criticize.

zh: 上述批评凸显了一项关键挑战。
en: The criticism highlights a key challenge.

zh: 在某一层面，社会民主人士移民立场的转变是对选民需求的必要反应。
en: On one level, social democrats’ immigration shift is a necessary response to voter demand.

zh: 限制或管理移民的工作并不一定基于种族主义或仇外心理。
en: Efforts to limit or manage migration are not necessarily based on racism or xenophobia.

zh: 关键是要确保做出合乎道德要求的政策反应。
en: The key is to ensure that policy responses remain morally acceptable.

zh: 与此同时，过于激进的变化可能会使挣扎的中左翼党派弄巧成拙。
en: At the same time, too drastic a change could be self-defeating for struggling center-left parties.

zh: 他们显然不能复制激进右翼势力的原始本土主义方法，这种方法不仅将在经济上起反作用，而且可能悍然挑战进步价值观，从而导致世界主义支持者的疏离。
en: They clearly cannot copy the crude nativist recipes of the radical right, which would not only be economically counterproductive, but would also fly in the face of progressive values, alienating cosmopolitan supporters.

zh: 相反，欧洲中左翼政党应当通过三管齐下的策略试图平衡国内和国际团结，上述三管齐下的策略包括有效限制移民、重点推进融合以及竭力缓和大规模人道主义痛苦。
en: Instead, Europe’s center-left parties should strike a balance between national and international solidarity with a three-pronged strategy comprising effective limits on immigration, a focus on integration, and humanitarian efforts to ease large-scale human suffering.

zh: 这样一种方法可以远离煽动性言论，提供真实、具有前瞻性和在道德上可持续的解决方案，虽然这样的方案与民粹主义无关，但肯定会受到欢迎。
en: Such an approach would eschew incendiary rhetoric, and instead offer real, forward-thinking, and morally sustainable solutions that are not populist, but certainly can be popular.

zh: 加拿大总理贾斯汀·特鲁多也已经采用了这种策略，采取同样措施的还有法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙。
en: Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau has embraced this approach, as has French President Emmanuel Macron.

zh: 欧洲各国奋力挣扎的中左翼党派都应当加以仿效，因为他们必须充分认识到这样的重新定位很可能关系到政治上能否生存。
en: Struggling center-left parties across Europe should follow suit, recognizing that such a repositioning may well be the key to political survival.

zh: 申根大地的报应时刻
en: Payback Time in Schengen Land

zh: 法兰克福—无国界欧洲之梦由来已久，在20世纪90年代中期曾经成为现实，现在正在快速消亡。
en: FRANKFURT – The long-held dream of a borderless Europe, which became reality in the mid-1990s, is fading fast.

zh: 意大利正在阻挠欧盟收买土耳其让难民不要进入希腊进而进入德国、瑞典或其他北欧国家的决定。
en: Italy is blocking a European Union decision to bribe Turkey to keep refugees from crossing over into Greece on their way to Germany, Sweden, or other northern European countries.

zh: 而德国财政部长朔伊布勒（Wolfgang Schäuble）为此呼吁团结，警告说否则的话边境守卫很快就会恢复，首先是在德国-奥地利边境。
en: In response, German Finance Minister Wolfgang Schäuble has called for solidarity, warning that otherwise the border guards might soon be back at their posts, beginning with the German-Austrian frontier.

zh: 诚然，申根协议的解体未必标志着欧洲工程的末日，至少在理论上如此。 申根协议始于1995年，规定大部分欧盟国家间可以免签旅行。
en: To be sure, the dissolution of the Schengen Agreement, which instituted passport-free travel within most of the EU starting in 1995, need not mark the end of the European project, at least not in principle.

zh: 从经济上讲，边境控制和税收差不多；它们增加交易成本，减少跨境商品和服务流，从而扭曲经济活动。
en: Economically, border controls act just like taxes; they distort activity, by increasing transaction costs and reducing cross-border flows of goods and services.

zh: 没有边境控制 — — 并且更重要地，引入共同货币 — — 将让市场更加有效。
en: Without them – and, more important, with a single currency – a market is more effective.

zh: 当然，这并不意味着单一市场不能在存在边境控制或多货币的情况下运转。
en: That does not mean, of course, that the single market cannot work with border controls or multiple currencies.

zh: 这只是意味着这类“再国家化”会带来巨大的成本，包括生产率下降和产能大幅降低等。
en: It simply means that such “renationalization” would carry enormous costs, in the form of substantially reduced productivity and significantly lower output.

zh: 考虑到这些成本，欧盟委员会主席容克强调“杀死”申根协议将破坏欧盟“比以往更紧密的联盟”的创始目标是正确的。 实事求是地讲，一些欧盟成员国在签署这一目标时并不是心甘情愿的。
en: Given these costs, European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker has rightly stressed that “killing” Schengen would undermine the EU’s foundational goal of “ever closer union” – an objective to which, admittedly, several EU members have signed up only reluctantly.

zh: 英国的怀疑声音最大，但波兰、匈牙利、斯洛伐克和其他许多东欧国家也从未放松关注国家特权。
en: The United Kingdom is the most vocal skeptic, but Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and pretty much the rest of Eastern Europe have never been enthusiastic about shifting their focus from national prerogatives.

zh: 难民危机让这一分歧突显。
en: The refugee crisis has thrown this discord into sharp relief.

zh: 因此，欧洲细密的互相依存网络开始解体。
en: As a result, Europe’s densely knit network of interdependencies is beginning to unravel.

zh: 曾经由法国-德国联盟构成的仁慈霸权正在消亡。
en: The benevolent hegemon, which used to be the French-German couple, is missing.

zh: 对国家（也包括一些地区，如加泰罗尼亚和苏格兰）问题的关注正在增加，决策者的激励也是如此，因为选民是有祖国（或地区出身）的。
en: A focus on national (and in some places, like Catalonia and Scotland, regional) issues is gaining ground, in line with the incentives of policymakers, whose constituencies are national (or regional).

zh: 从这一点看，意大利总理伦齐呼吁要交换 — — 放松欧盟财政规则换取接受土耳其协议 — — 完全是可以理解的。
en: Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi’s call for a quid pro quo – a loosening of the eurozone’s fiscal rules in exchange for accepting the deal with Turkey – is entirely understandable in this light.

zh: 但可能给欧盟带来危险。
en: But it puts the EU on a slippery slope.

zh: 所有这些的讽刺之处是德国现在在呼吁团结。 而在欧洲主权（和私人）债务危机期间，德国被广泛认为毫无情面。
en: The irony in all of this is that Germany, which was perceived as ruthless during the European sovereign (and private) debt crises, is now calling for solidarity.

zh: 在其他北欧债权国的支持下，德国无情地强制实行其财政原则，尽管这样做的系统性后果是造成压力（比如，希腊和西班牙的政府都已经改变 ） 。
en: Supported by other northern European creditors, Germany enforced its fiscal principles relentlessly, despite the systemic consequences for those it was pressuring (Greece and Spain, for example, now have different governments).

zh: 调整政策是否成功仍是个热议话题；毫无疑问的是这些政策制造了很多输家 — — 尤其是那些最脆弱的国家，现在它们基本上都把欧盟-德国共识视为威胁。
en: Whether the adjustment policies have been successful remains a subject of heated debate; what is not in doubt is that they produced many losers – most notably among the most vulnerable, who now largely perceive the EU-Germany consensus as threatening.

zh: 在此背景下，全欧洲的反现状政党都反对体现这一德国喜欢的方针的政策。
en: Against this background, anti-establishment parties across Europe oppose policies that reflect this German-inspired approach.

zh: 这解释了（比如）为何法国极左翼和极右翼提出的经济平台差不多。
en: This explains, for example, the similarity of the economic platforms offered by the far left and far right in France.

zh: 就连主流政党也在承压迎合这一反抗情绪；为欧盟政策方案做辩护是输掉选举的不二法门。
en: Even mainstream parties are under pressure to cater to this insurgent sentiment; defending EU policy proposals is a surefire way to lose an election.

zh: 因此，当德国疲于处置150万难民时，朔伊布勒的团结呼声根本无人响应。
en: That is why, as Germany struggles to cope with some 1.5 million refugees, Schäuble’s call for solidarity is falling on barren ground.

zh: 从法国开始，所有人都躲了起来。
en: Everybody, beginning with France, is hiding.

zh: 这是报应时刻。
en: It’s payback time.

zh: 负担共担 — — 即“公平”地在整个欧盟（政治上分散地）分配难民 — — 看上去只是痴人说梦。
en: Burden-sharing – that is, a “fair” allocation of refugees throughout the EU (to be hashed out politically) – appears to be a pipe dream.

zh: 从经济上讲，安置难民在相当长的时间内都是一项挑战。
en: Economically, accommodating refugees will be a challenge for quite some time.

zh: 但如果着眼于长期，吸收新来者应该是一个机会 — — 如果处置得当的话。
en: But if one takes a longer view, absorbing the newcomers should be an opportunity – if it is appropriately handled.

zh: 但是，与此同时，不但德国，瑞典、荷兰、奥地利和其他国家都在反对被认定为政治可行的事。
en: In the meantime, however, not only Germany, but also Sweden, the Netherlands, Austria, and others, are running up against what is deemed to be politically feasible.

zh: 这意味着无法指望形成泛欧盟的应对措施，因此，申根协议可能寿终正寝。
en: This implies that no EU-wide response can be expected, and thus that Schengen is probably doomed.

zh: 对欧洲公民而言，这不仅仅是象征性损失。
en: This would be more than a symbolic loss for European citizens.

zh: 当然，重新建立国家边境无助于解决根本问题。
en: And, of course, re-erecting national borders does nothing to address the underlying issue.

zh: 难民将会退回整个链条最脆弱的一环 — — 希腊。
en: Refugees would just be pushed back to Greece, the most fragile and vulnerable link in the chain.

zh: 听起来也许令人沮丧，但现在我们必须考虑我们所熟悉的欧洲货币联盟和欧盟的末日。
en: As uninspiring as this might sound, we must now consider the prospect of the end of the European Monetary Union and the EU as we have known it.

zh: 这样做的目标不仅仅是强调与这一结果有关的机会损失；这些损失显然是巨大儿，特别是如果货币联盟不得不解体的话。
en: The goal is not simply to highlight the lost opportunities associated with such an outcome; those would clearly be sizable, especially if the currency union had to be untied.

zh: 重点还在于证明，当前形式下的欧盟和欧元区缺乏起作用的最低条件。
en: The point is also to show that the minimal conditions for the EU and the eurozone to work in their current form are lacking.

zh: 这些条件中最重要的是对欧盟问题和共同哲学的一致诊断。
en: Foremost among these conditions is a shared diagnosis of the EU’s problems and a common philosophy.

zh: 比如，伦齐和朔伊布勒对于从财政政策到银行业的诸多关键问题有着截然矛盾的观点。
en: Renzi and Schäuble, for example, have strikingly contradictory views on crucial issues, from fiscal policy to the banking sector.

zh: 伦齐批评欧盟，同时将新的债权人自救（bail-in）监管措施的后果的责任全部推给德国。
en: Renzi criticizes the EU, while laying the blame for the consequences of new creditor bail-in regulations squarely at Germany’s door.

zh: 出于同样的原因，法国总统奥朗德将内部安全摆在第一位（也许这和他的选民的偏好一致 ） ， 对财政规则的支持前后不一。
en: For the same reasons, French President François Hollande puts internal security first (possibly in line with the preferences of his electorate), and honors fiscal rules inconsistently.

zh: 这无济于事，应用德国或欧盟的难民政策方案根本不会增加他2017年连任的机会。
en: It doesn’t help that applying German or EU proposals on refugee policy would not exactly strengthen his re-election chances in 2017.

zh: 如果欧盟成员国追求开明自利，就会支持更加紧密的联盟，让北欧和南欧（在财政和其他领域）更加团结。
en: If EU member states were to pursue their enlightened self-interest, they would nurture ever closer union, with solidarity – fiscal and otherwise – between North and South.

zh: 相反，它们日益拿欧洲当替罪羊，强调国家立场。
en: Instead, they are increasingly scapegoating Europe and embracing a national discourse.

zh: 欧洲似乎正在再一次梦游着走向危机。
en: Once again, Europe seems to be sleepwalking into crisis.

zh: 我们希望它能够在比上一次更安全的地方醒过来。
en: One hopes that it wakes up in a safer place than it has in the past.

zh: 欧洲的两个未来
en: Europe’s Two Futures

zh: 巴黎—欧洲似乎又一次站在了岔路口。
en: PARIS – Once again, Europe seems to have reached a fork in the road.

zh: 一个方向上是悲观派所描述的未来，他们说，兴盛的民粹主义运动和欧元贬值是欧洲大陆滑向地缘政治和经济灾难的明证。
en: In one direction lies the future as described by pessimists, who argue that rising populist movements and the plunge of the euro are evidence of the continent’s coming slide into geopolitical and economic oblivion.

zh: 另一个方向上是迈向欧洲一体化和重新崛起为全球力量的康庄大道 — — 乐观派说，随着欧洲大陆的觉醒和认识到它必须能够抵御最恶劣的风暴，它一定会走上这条路。
en: In the other direction lies a steep upward path to Europe’s integration and reemergence as a global power – the course, optimists say, that the continent will take as it wakes up and recognizes that it must have the capacity to weather the harshest storms.

zh: 不知道未来会向哪条路发展。
en: There is no telling which future will be realized.

zh: 欧洲是“一个老太婆，已经不再丰润，活力尽失”P教皇方济各在去年11月的欧洲议会演讲上如是说）吗？
en: Is Europe “a grandmother, no longer fertile and vibrant,” as Pope Francis put it when he addressed the European Parliament last November?

zh: 还是一只即将（再次）涅槃的凤凰？
en: Or is it a phoenix, about to rise (yet again) from its ashes?

zh: 当然，结果取决于欧洲人对当前的艰难如何反应。
en: The outcome depends, of course, on how Europeans respond to their current travails.

zh: 而在他们思索选择时，最好考虑一下外部是如何看待欧洲大陆的？
en: And as they contemplate their choices, they would be wise to consider how the continent is perceived from the outside.

zh: 首先，很重要的一点是承认前景并不美妙。
en: For starters, it is important to acknowledge that the outlook looks bleak.

zh: 奥斯维辛集中营解放已经过去了七十年，但犹太人仍然在各大欧洲城市被袭击和谋杀。
en: Seventy years after the liberation of Auschwitz, Jews are still being attacked and murdered in European cities.

zh: 阿尔及利亚战争结束已经过去了50多年，欧洲穆斯林面临的其歧视比以往任何时候都要多。
en: More than 50 years after the end of the Algerian War, European Muslims face more discrimination than ever.

zh: 俄罗斯支持的分裂主义者 — — 甚至还有俄罗斯军队 — — 正在乌克兰与政府军打仗，战争幽灵再一次飘荡在欧洲大陆上空。
en: With Russian-backed separatists – and maybe even Russian troops – battling government forces in Ukraine, the specter of war is once again stalking the continent.

zh: 而希腊极左翼政府的当选也引起了欧元到底是不是个好主意的质疑。
en: And the election of a leftist government in Greece has raised the question of whether introducing the euro was a good idea.

zh: 另一方面，欧洲曾经面临过更糟糕的情况 — — 比现在糟糕得多 — — 并且也变得比以往更强大。
en: On the other hand, Europe has faced worse – much worse – and emerged stronger than ever.

zh: 二十世纪上半叶过去后 — — 这是人类历史上最血腥的时期 — — 欧洲大陆领导人从战场归来，为维持欧洲和平打下基础。
en: After the first half of the twentieth century – the bloodiest period of human history – the continent’s leaders returned from the battlefield to lay the foundations of lasting European peace.

zh: 欧洲也许永远都不能回到世界舞台的中央，但它可以继续成为重要行动方和有吸引力的榜样。
en: Europe may never regain its standing as the center of the world, but it can continue to be both an important actor and an attractive model for others.

zh: 事实上，着眼于远处，我们可以看到一幅更广阔的图景。
en: Indeed, with the benefit of distance, a broader picture emerges.

zh: 从中国看来，欧洲是首先是一个极具吸引力的机会；欧元的大幅贬值让它尤其诱人。
en: Seen from China, Europe is first and foremost an attractive investment opportunity; and the euro’s spectacular fall now makes it a particularly tempting one.

zh: 欧洲大陆也许已不是昔日的稳定之岛 — — 这就是俄罗斯总统普京和几千欧洲圣战者的目的。
en: The continent may not be the island of stability it once was – Russian President Vladimir Putin and a few thousand European jihadists have seen to that.

zh: 但与世界其他地区的长期动荡和尖锐威胁相比，欧洲所面临的风险并不大。
en: But the risks it faces are mild when compared with the chronic instability and acute threats facing much of the rest of the world.

zh: 欧洲血染的历史也给中国和亚洲其他地区提供了有用的警告，也可以作为克服地区长期恩怨的榜样。
en: Europe’s bloodstained history also provides a useful warning for China and the rest of Asia, and can serve as an example for overcoming the region’s long-standing animosities.

zh: 尽管中国及其邻国关于东海和南海的领土主张纠纷在近几个月中有所缓和，但（特别是）中日关系恶化的前景仍然令人十分忧虑。
en: Though tensions between China and its neighbors over territorial claims in the East and South China Seas have receded somewhat in recent months, the prospect of worsening Sino-Japanese relations, in particular, remains worrisome.

zh: 遵循法德模式和解也许还不现实，但对亚洲两大强国来说，学习欧洲的经验不失为好建议。
en: Reconciliation along the Franco-German model may not yet be in the cards, but the two Asian powers would be well advised to learn from Europe’s experience.

zh: 从美国看来则一切都不相同。
en: The view from the United States is completely different.

zh: 从美国的角度看，欧洲与其说是榜样，不如说是古迹。
en: From the American perspective, Europe is less a model than a historical relic.

zh: 欧洲大陆的国家特征已经成为关注焦点：德国经济强，法国遍地恐怖主义，希腊的极左翼政党，等等。
en: The continent’s national characteristics have returned to the fore: Germany with its economic power, France with its terrorists, Greece with its leftists, and so forth.

zh: 从世界最穷地区的角度看，欧洲是对抗极端伊斯兰教联盟中最弱的一环。 这场战争的代价主要由中东、南亚和非洲承担 — — 尽管西方媒体报道造成的印象并非如此。
en: From the perspective of the poorest parts of the world, Europe represents the weakest link in the coalition fighting radical Islam, a battle that is taking its highest toll – despite the impression created by Western media coverage – primarily in the Middle East, South Asia, and Africa.

zh: 对许多因为冲突而逃离这些地区的人来说，欧洲也是迦南乐土 — — 对冒着生命危险来到繁荣的地中海这一边的人来说，这里也是希望和梦想的目标。
en: For many of those fleeing the conflicts in these regions, Europe is also the Promised Land – the object of the hopes and dreams of those risking their lives to reach the prosperous side of the Mediterranean Sea.

zh: 最后，欧洲人如何看待自己将决定他们的集体命运。
en: In the end, how Europeans view themselves will determine their collective fate.

zh: 如果他们不抓住定义自己的决定性时刻 — — 比如，可以从实施国家所急需的改革开始 — — 他们就有可能走上永远不想走的道路。
en: If they do not seize this decisive moment to define themselves – by beginning to institute the difficult reforms their countries so desperately need, for example – they risk ending up on a path they never intended to take.

zh: 欧洲的重大决策
en: Europe Crosses the Rubicon

zh: 截至目前，所谓的“欧洲邻居政策”稀奇古怪。
en: The so-called “European Neighborhood Policy” has, so far, been a curious thing.

zh: 欧盟内部对此议论纷纷，但是却没有什么实效。
en: There is much talk about it in the European Union, but little practical effect.

zh: 这一政策的目的在于成为不断扩大的入盟谈判的替代品。 这些谈判涉及到南高加索各国。
en: It was meant as an alternative to the ever-increasing number of accession rounds, say, involving the countries in the southern Caucasus.

zh: 但是，黎巴嫩战争及其后果对这一政策不紧不慢的实行产生了突如其来而又根本性的变化。
en: But the war in Lebanon and its consequences have caused a sudden and fundamental change in the leisurely pursuit of this policy.

zh: 黎巴嫩战争严厉地提醒欧盟，它具有“战略利益 ” ， 首先而且最重要的是安全利益，而且，如果它有意回避这些利益，代价将是巨大的。
en: The Lebanon War has served as a harsh reminder to the European Union that it has “strategic interests” – security interests first and foremost – and that, should it choose to ignore them, the price will be high.

zh: 而且，美国和欧洲之间的分工在久经考验的方式下并不奏效。 伊拉克目前的战争正在侵蚀美国的军事能力，造成美国的道义和政治合法性在整个阿拉伯伊斯兰地区的危机。
en: Moreover, the division of labor between the US and Europe isn’t functioning in the time-tested manner of old: the ongoing war in Iraq is gnawing at America’s military capabilities and resulted in a crisis of moral and political legitimacy of the US across the Arabic/Islamic world.

zh: 欧盟各成员国决定向黎巴嫩派遣数千名士兵来执行联合国有关停火的1701号决议，由此，欧盟在其邻居政策范围内做出了最为重大的决定。
en: With the decision of its member states to send several thousand soldiers to Lebanon to implement the UN cease-fire resolution 1701, the European Union has taken the most significant decision yet within its Neighborhood Policy.
