zh: 欧盟能否真的在紧靠欧洲的地缘政治邻居中最为危险的冲突地带成为一支稳定性的政治力量呢？
en: Can the EU in fact be able to emerge as a stabilizing political force in the most dangerous area of conflict within Europe’s immediate geopolitical neighborhood?

zh: 二十世纪九十年代的巴尔干战争后，近东和中东地区立即成为当今欧盟最为危险、并且鉴于安全考虑，也是最为重要的近邻。
en: After the Balkan Wars of the 1990’s, the Near and Middle East is at once the most dangerous and also – given security considerations – the most important neighboring region for the EU today.

zh: 为何如此？
en: Why?

zh: 因为二十一世纪初叶欧洲安全的主要威胁来自那一地区。
en: Because the main threats to European security at the beginning of the 21st century stem from that region.

zh: 集中于中东的威胁五花八门，包括地区冲突、极权宗教意识形态、恐怖主义、核武计划、阻碍现代化进程、不稳定的政权以及霸权主义野心。
en: The threats concentrated in the Middle East are diverse: regional conflicts, totalitarian religious ideologies, terrorism, nuclear armament programs, blockades to modernization, unstable regimes and hegemonic ambitions.

zh: 如果有人问，在这一危机四伏地地区中欧盟及其成员国的利益何在，答案就是，这显然忧关欧洲的能源和经济利益以及欧洲的伙伴和盟国(特别是以色列)的重大利益。
en: If one asks what interests the EU and its member states have in this crisis-riddled region, the answer is, that certainly European energy and economic interests are at stake, as well as the vital interests of Europe’s partners and allies (Israel in particular).

zh: 但是，欧洲自身利益占据首位。
en: But first and foremost on the list are Europe’s.

zh: 中东局势如何发展将决定欧洲安全的风险程度，甚至对其安全构成可能的挑战。
en: How the Middle East develops will determine the extent of the risks for, or even probable challenges to, Europe’s security.

zh: 成功地遏制或者解决那里的冲突将对欧洲安全产生极为积极的影响。
en: Success in containing, or indeed resolving, the conflict there will have overwhelmingly positive consequences for Europe’s security.

zh: 当今，三场中心冲突缠绕着中东。 它们是以色列和阿拉伯世界的冲突、伊拉克以及伊朗。
en: The Middle East today is defined by three central conflicts: the Israeli-Arab conflict, Iraq, and Iran.

zh: 伊朗核子计划及其霸权野心，连同伊拉克局势以及黎巴嫩的真主党将会导向“新的中东”局势。 这一局势很有可能挑起大规模对抗。
en: The fusion of Iran’s nuclear program (and Iran’s hegemonic ambitions) with the situation in Iraq and with Hezbollah in Lebanon will lead to a “New Middle East” which, in all likelihood, will provoke a major confrontation.

zh: 涉及范围远远超出该地区通常的势力和冲突。
en: This will involve far more than just the usual regional actors and conflicts.

zh: 黎巴嫩战争让这一危险的进程的进展程度一目了然。
en: The war in Lebanon has made it abundantly clear how far this dangerous process has already progressed.

zh: 对于联合国、特别是欧洲而言，黎巴嫩的使命充满风险。
en: The mission in Lebanon is a high-risk one for the UN force, and for Europe in particular.

zh: 这一战争并未带来实质性的决定。
en: The war did not bring forth a real decision.

zh: 无论是真主党还是叙利亚，抑或是伊朗都不乐见联合国使命的成功。
en: Neither Hezbollah nor Syria, let alone Iran, have any interest in the UN mission’s success.

zh: 联合国安理会决议除了分隔战斗各方外，还假定切实执行黎巴嫩民选政府的对内对外主权，但是并未说明如何在真主党在政治上得到加强、军事上强于黎巴嫩军队的情况下实现这一目标。
en: The Security Council resolution presupposes – in addition to separating the combatants – the enforcement of the internal and external sovereignty of Lebanon’s elected government of Lebanon, without saying how this is to be accomplished with a politically strengthened Hezbollah, militarily superior to the Lebanese forces.

zh: 任何由联合国部队解除真主党武装的企图都将意味着同真主党(以及背后的叙利亚和伊朗)的战争。 联合国部队无法完成这一任务。
en: Any attempt at disarming Hezbollah by the UN force would mean a war with Hezbollah (and with Syria and Iran in the background) -- a task the UN force cannot accomplish.

zh: 但是，如果联合国部队甘于在黎巴嫩仅仅成为观察员，那么，联合国和欧洲都将会失去可信度。
en: But were it to resign itself to mere observer status in Lebanon, the UN and Europe would lose all credibility.

zh: 况且，联合国士兵有可能在几个月的时间内再一次处于冲突各方的交叉火力之中。
en: Moreover, it is likely that, within a few months, UN soldiers would once again find themselves between the firing lines of the conflicting parties.

zh: 联合国使命因此就将会在履行其稳定黎巴嫩国家的严峻使命中如履薄冰。
en: The mission therefore will have to walk the thin and risky line in pursuit of its robust mandate to stabilize the country.

zh: 一旦失败就会危险四伏，充满军事风险。
en: Failure will be a constant danger and the military risk will be high.

zh: 但是，鉴于局势，没有什么其他更好的办法。
en: Yet, in light of the situation there is no better alternative.

zh: 鉴于欧洲士兵的风险，欧洲将不得不影响整个中东地区的政治环境，并且主动出击予以战略性的改变。
en: In view of the risk to its troops, Europe will be compelled to influence and even proactively bring about strategic changes to the political environment in the entire Middle East.

zh: 欧盟决定支持黎巴嫩的使命，因而也就做出了重大军事决策。
en: With its decision in favor of the mission in Lebanon, the EU crossed a military Rubicon.

zh: 现在， 欧盟必须用政治行动来支撑其在中东日益增长的份量。
en: It must now back up its growing weight in the Middle East with political initiative.

zh: 这必须包括三大关键因素。 它们是：谈判解决叙利亚问题，巴以之间重开谈判以及同美国就西方在该地区的政治战略达成共同的战略谅解(它也解决伊朗问题，也是该地区最危险的冲突 ) 。
en: This must include three key elements: a negotiated solution for Syria; a resumption of negotiations between Israel and the Palestinians; and a common strategic understanding with the US of the political strategy of the West for the region (which addresses the region’s most dangerous conflict, Iran).

zh: 这一共同谅解将会是跨大西洋关系未来的重大挑战。
en: This common understanding will be the pivotal challenge for the future of the transatlantic relationship.

zh: 对于欧洲及其部队而言，黎巴嫩充满风险。
en: For Europe and its troops, the stakes in Lebanon are very high.

zh: 但是，这事关欧��的重大利益。
en: But this is about vital European interests.

zh: 中东的战争和混乱，或者仅仅是道义和政治真空都将会直接影响和破坏欧盟及其所有成员国的安全。
en: War and chaos in the Middle East or just a moral or political vacuum will directly affect and upset the security of the EU and all its member states.

zh: 因此，尽管做出决定明显是困难的，但是欧洲必须采取行动。
en: Europe therefore had to act, though that decision was obviously difficult.

zh: 近期的主要问题是，欧洲是否果真具有军事和政治能力、政治持久力量以及共同意愿来根据其在中东的核心利益采取行动。
en: The key question in the near future will be whether Europe actually has the military and political capabilities, the political staying power, and the common will to act in accordance with its core interests in the Middle East.

zh: 我们拭目以待。
en: We will see.

zh: 无论如何，有一件事已经明白，那就是，崭新的世界来临了。
en: In any case, one thing can already be said: Welcome to the real world.

zh: 关于伊斯兰教辩论的探讨
en: The Debate About Debating Islam

zh: 巴黎 — — 这场辩论是从阿尔及利亚小说家兼记者卡迈勒·达乌德为意大利《共和国报》撰写的一篇关于发生在2015年新年前夜德国科隆的一系列性侵事件的文章开始的。
en: PARIS – The argument began when the Algerian novelist and journalist Kamel Daoud wrote an article for the Italian newspaper La Repubblica about a spate of sexual assaults in Cologne, Germany, on New Year’s Eve, 2015.

zh: 据外界报道来自北非和中东的移民群体制造了这些性侵事件，而达乌德对此的解释是该地区众多穆斯林正遭受极端性剥夺，而在他笔下，这样的状况造成了“与女性及其身体和欲望的关系并不健康。 ”
en: The attacks were widely reported to have been carried out by groups of immigrants from North Africa and the Middle East, which Daoud explained by saying that many Muslims from the region suffer from extreme sexual deprivation, which, he wrote, generates an “unhealthy relationship with women, their body, and desire.”

zh: 达乌德似乎并未预料到他这篇文章所造成的反应，特别是在其文章被《世界报》转载的法国。
en: Daoud seems not to have expected the reaction his article received, especially in France, where it was republished by Le Monde.

zh: 在遭到仇视伊斯兰教的令人难堪的指责后，达乌德宣布他将停止其新闻工作并专注于创作小说。
en: After withering criticism accusing him of Islamophobia, Daoud announced that he would cease his journalistic work and focus on writing novels.

zh: 但限制对伊斯兰教的批评不仅剥夺了像达乌德这样的作者讲话的权利；还以敷衍的态度彻底扼杀了一场迫切需要的探讨。
en: But putting Islam off limits to criticism not only deprives a voice to authors like Daoud; it perfunctorily halts a much-needed discussion.

zh: 毋庸置疑，达乌德决定写这篇文章需要非凡的勇气。
en: There can be no doubt that Daoud’s decision to write the article took extraordinary courage.

zh: 2014年，在达乌德发表从被谋害阿拉伯兄弟的视角重新演绎阿尔贝·加缪作品《局外人》的首部小说《默尔索调查》后不久，一位萨拉菲派伊玛目就宣布了一道伊斯兰教令，呼吁以叛教和发表异端邪说的罪名判处达乌德死刑。
en: In 2014, shortly after the publication of his first novel, The Meursault Investigation, which retells Albert Camus’ The Stranger from the perspective of the murdered Arab’s brother, a Salafist imam declared a fatwa calling for Daoud’s death for apostasy and heresy.

zh: 但这并未阻止他对争议问题的探讨。
en: But that didn’t stop him from tackling a controversial subject.

zh: 在穆斯林世界，达乌德写道 ， “ 女性遭遇否定、拒绝、杀害、蒙面、幽禁或拥有 ， ” 她们身体的快乐权利被剥夺。
en: In the Muslim world, Daoud wrote, “Women are negated, rejected, killed, veiled, locked in, or owned,” their bodies denied the right to pleasure.

zh: 他指出在招募伊斯兰教徒的布道中 ， “ 对天堂的描绘不像是对虔诚者的奖励而更像是一所妓院，自杀式炸弹袭击者对于处女的幻想、道德警察追捕肌肤裸露过多的妇女以及专政、蒙面和掀开面纱的清教徒习俗。 ”
en: In the preaching of Islamists seeking recruits, he notes, are “descriptions of a paradise more similar to a bordello than the reward for pious individuals, fantasies of virgins for suicide bombers, morality police chasing down women showing too much skin, the puritanism of dictatorship, veils, and burqas.”

zh: 在伊斯兰教徒看来，西方的妇女解放并非是一种自由的表现，而是代表西方的道德沦丧。
en: In the Islamist view, the liberation of Western women is not an expression of freedom, but a sign of the West’s moral decay.

zh: 达乌德总结道 ， “ 对欲望的愤怒构成了伊斯兰教。
en: Daoud concludes, “Islam is an outrage against desire.

zh: 上述欲望注定会在西方领土上不时爆发，因为这里的自由是如此的赤裸。 ”
en: And that desire is bound to explode from time to time in Western territory, where freedom is so naked.”

zh: 这篇文章所引发的反应是迅速而凶狠的。
en: The response was quick and vicious.

zh: 2月12日，一群人类学家、社会学家和历史学家联合在《世界报》上发表恶毒的攻击文章。
en: On February 12, a “collective” of anthropologists, sociologists, and historians published a virulent attack in Le Monde.

zh: 这篇题为《卡迈勒·达乌德的幻想》的文章指责他“重新翻出早已过时的东方主义陈词滥调”并“以此来迎合欧洲大众不断滋生的仇视伊斯兰教的幻想。 ”
en: Entitled “Kamel Daoud’s Fantasies,” it accused him of “recycling much worn-out Orientalist clichés” and “feeding the Islamophobic fantasies of a growing segment of the European public.”

zh: 可以肯定，学者们质疑达乌德的方法是可以理解的；他的观点基于一系列“本质论 ” ， 即仅仅通过文化和宗教因素来解释个人行为，而不考虑社会、政治和经济条件发挥的影响。
en: To be sure, it is understandable that academics might question Daoud’s approach; his argument was based on a strain of “essentialism,” in which individual actions are reduced to cultural and religious forces, with no attention to the social, political, and economic conditions that might be at work.

zh: 而且批评家们指出达乌德并未提及欧洲、亚洲和北美与伊斯兰教无关的针对妇女的许多暴力行为也是正确的。
en: And the critics were right to point out that Daoud omitted mentioning the many acts of violence with no connection to Islam that are carried out against women in Europe, Asia, and North America.

zh: 但达乌德的批评者超越了合法思想探讨的界限，他们指责他“轻视”种族主义批评并将其装扮成“人本主义思想 ” 。
en: But Daoud’s critics overstepped the boundaries of legitimate discussion of ideas, accusing him of “trivializing” racist criticism and dressing it up in “humanistic thought.”

zh: 事实上，他们质疑他是否有权希望穆斯林世界在对待女性的方式和重新审视性禁忌方面进行迫切需要的变革。
en: Indeed, they questioned his right to wish for a much-needed change in the way the Muslim world treats women and a reexamination of its sexual taboos.

zh: “我还是觉得这样做很不道德 ， ” 达乌德回应道 ， “ 我被当做祭祀的羔羊呈送到当地仇恨的祭坛上，并被今天的宗教法庭谴责为伊斯兰教的仇视者。 ”
en: “I still find it quite unethical,” Daoud responded, “that I was pushed into the role of sacrificial lamb to be brought on the altar of local hate, condemned for Islamophobia by today’s Inquisition.”

zh: 这一事件在几位法国作家（及很多法国-阿尔及利亚博客写手）中造成了不小的轰动，他们站出来保护达乌德，对萨拉菲派和旨在迫使他陷入沉默的学者对他的攻击行为持批评态度。
en: The episode created such a commotion in France that several authors – as well as many Franco-Algerian bloggers – came to Daoud’s defense, criticizing the attacks against him by Salafists and academics intent on bullying him into silence.

zh: 就连法国总理曼纽尔·瓦尔斯也参与进来，表达对达乌德“原创性勤奋思考”的致敬并谴责他的批评者。
en: Even French Prime Minister Manuel Valls weighed in, saluting Daoud’s “original hard thinking” and denouncing his critics.

zh: 瓦尔斯利用法国的国家格言辩护道“自由是写作和思想的自由、是男女两性的平等、是友爱和世俗主义，以此为基础才能建立我们的社会团结。
en: Referring to France’s national motto, Valls defended “liberty, that is, freedom to write and to think, equality among men and women, and fraternity and secularism, from which is derived our social unity.”

zh: ”正如他所说的那样 ， “ 让这位作者孤军奋战就好比放弃自我。 ”
en: As he put it, “Leaving this writer to fend for himself would be like giving up on who we are.”

zh: 可悲的是，达乌德的艰苦努力仅仅是合法的知识探索沦落为能否批评伊斯兰教的政治争吵的一个实例而已。
en: Sadly, Daoud’s travails are just one example of legitimate intellectual inquiry degenerating into political bickering over whether it is acceptable to criticize Islam.

zh: 这对自由思想和伊斯兰教自身的未来已经产生了危险的影响。
en: This has dangerous implications for free thought, as well as for the future of Islam itself.

zh: 今天常常可以见到政治分析家扭曲自己的观点以避免被指责为仇视伊斯兰教。
en: It is not uncommon today for political analysts to contort their arguments in order to avoid being denounced as Islamophobic.

zh: 结果是人们并未研究伊斯兰教在激进行为中所发挥的系统性作用，比方说，他们将激进分子形容为莫名其妙地盲目陷入伊斯兰教。
en: As a result, rather than examining the systemic role that Islam plays in radicalization, for example, they describe radicals as having somehow fallen haphazardly into Islam.

zh: 哪怕仅仅为实现思想自由的缘故，现在停止为所有敢于对宗教进行批判性探讨的人贴上偏执的标签也正是时候。
en: For the sake of free thought alone, it is time to stop branding as a bigot anyone who dares discuss the religion critically.

zh: 在实现这一目标之前，在欧洲展开对伊斯兰教的诚实探讨是不可能的。
en: Until we do, an honest debate about Islam in Europe will be impossible.

zh: 欧盟第一
en: The European Union First

zh: 慕尼黑—世界比以往任何时候都更加需要欧盟。
en: MUNICH – The world needs the European Union now more than ever.

zh: 尽管遭到最近的危机和英国退欧投票的重创，欧盟仍然是当今最严重威胁的最可靠的防线，包括孤立主义、保护主义、民族主义和各种形式的恐怖主义，所有这些都在重新在欧洲和其他地区崛起。
en: Despite recent crises and the hard blow dealt by the Brexit vote, the EU may well be the world’s best line of defense against today’s most serious threats: isolationism, protectionism, nationalism, and extremism in all forms, all of which are once again growing in Europe and beyond.

zh: 让欧盟实现其潜能、挽救自身和世界于将倾的关键是成员国尽快打出“欧盟第一”口号。
en: The key to enabling the EU to meet this potential – to save itself and the world from catastrophe – is for member states urgently to adopt a “European Union first” mantra.

zh: 与美国总统特朗普的“美国第一”的信条不同，欧洲第一的口号不会成为危险的单边主义。
en: Unlike the “America first” credo embraced by US President Donald Trump, such a mantra would not be an exercise in damaging unilateralism.

zh: 相反，它将促使成员国政府超越狭隘的国家利益，捍卫开放性和多边主义，直面最近方兴未艾的排斥性政治势力。
en: On the contrary, it would compel member states’ governments to look beyond narrow national interest, defend openness and multilateralism, and confront head-on the exclusionary political forces that have lately been gaining ground.

zh: 它将推动成员国巩固欧盟，从而让欧盟能够克服它所面临的挑战、帮助捍卫国际秩序。
en: It would drive member states to consolidate the EU, thereby enabling it to overcome the challenges it faces and help preserve the international order.

zh: 这一秩序既非无关紧要的装饰，也不是战后遗留。
en: That order is neither an inessential accessory nor a post-war relic.

zh: 它支持了全球繁荣与稳定70年。
en: It has supported global prosperity and stability for 70 years.

zh: 我们需要它 — — 以及建立在此基础上的、无法在国家层面上解决的多边主义 — — 以面对我们所面临的诸多经济、环境和战略挑战，这些挑战无法在国家层面解决。
en: We need it – together with the multilateralism on which it is built – to confront many of the economic, environmental, and strategic challenges we now face, challenges that cannot be addressed at the national level.

zh: 现有国际秩序的基石之一是承认保持和平与人类福祉需要理解和尊重他人的需求和利益 — — 这些需求和利益与我们自己的需求和利益一样合法。
en: A cornerstone of the existing international order is the recognition that maintaining peace and human welfare requires an understanding of and respect for the needs and interests of others – needs and interests that are no less legitimate than our own.

zh: 多边主义不是有些人所说的那样，是不可持续的团结的产物；它是对一个人自身利益的开明解释的产物。
en: Multilateralism is not a product of unsustainable solidarity, as some like to claim; it is the result of an enlightened interpretation of one’s own interests.

zh: 有了建设性的态度，即使是众多截然不同的行动方也可以形成每个人都略作牺牲以换取共赢的协议；没有建设性的态度，持续和平和广泛分享的繁荣的前景就会十分渺茫。
en: With a constructive attitude, even a large number of disparate actors can reach agreements in which everyone wins by yielding a little; without it, prospects for sustained peace and widely shared prosperity become far bleaker.

zh: 如果所有国家都把自身利益放在第一位，而不去关注其他人，竞争就会马上压倒共同利益。
en: If all countries put their own interests first, paying no heed to others, competition will quickly overwhelm common interests.

zh: 如果没人愿意做出让步，所有人都会输。
en: If nobody is ever willing to yield, we will all lose.

zh: 如果我们只依赖双边协议，推动在困难的关键问题上达成共识的共同空间和协同将越来越窄直至消失，从气候变化到安全问题都是如此。
en: If we depend solely on bilateral deals, the shared spaces and synergies that facilitate agreement on difficult but vital topics – from climate change to security – will narrow until they disappear.

zh: 因此，特朗普的美国第一立场非常令人担忧。
en: This is why Trump’s embrace of an America first mantra is so worrying.

zh: 作为世界的领导力量，美国制定了合作的基调，并往往要为其他国家提供参与的激励。
en: As the world’s leading power, the US sets the tone of cooperation and often provides the incentives for other countries to participate.

zh: 如果美国保持单边和孤立主义立场，其他国家几乎肯定也会效仿，这将威胁到所有人 — — 包括美国。
en: If the US maintains a unilateral and isolationist stance, other countries are almost certain to follow suit, endangering everyone – including the US.

zh: 最近，特朗普政府已经开始软化一些外交政策立场。
en: Recently, the Trump administration has begun to moderate some of its foreign-policy positions.

zh: 特别是，特朗普终于同意尊重“一个中国”政策。
en: In particular, Trump has finally agreed to honor the “One China” policy.

zh: 在人们对其履行美国安全承诺的诚意表示质疑后，他还改变了对日方针。
en: He also seems to have rectified his approach to Japan, after having raised doubts about his willingness to follow through on America’s security commitments.

zh: 这些发展态势表明，特朗普政府正在重新认识采取更具建设性的方针的必要性。
en: These developments imply that the administration is beginning to recognize the need for a more constructive approach.

zh: 这一认识可能部分源自对历史的理解。
en: That recognition may arise partly out of an understanding of history.

zh: 经验表明，防止冲突的最有效的办法是通过包容与合作。
en: Experience has shown that the most effective way to prevent conflicts is through inclusion and cooperation.

zh: 排斥性言论正中那些将身份降格为本土论定义的人的下怀。
en: Exclusionary rhetoric plays into the hands of those who reduce identity to nativist definitions.

zh: 这些人物 — — 民族主义者和民粹主义者 — — 过去曾经指导过政策制定，结果是大规模冲突。
en: When such figures – nationalists and populists – have been left to guide policy in the past, the result has been large-scale conflict.

zh: 如今，全球力量动态正财发生变化，发生这一结果的风险更加巨大。
en: At a time when global power dynamics are in flux, as is true today, the risk of such an outcome is even greater.

zh: 如今，我们正在试图接纳新兴力量 — — 特别是中国 — — 更加深度地参与到现有全球治理结构中。
en: Today, an effort is being made to incorporate emerging powers – particularly China – more deeply into the existing structures of global governance.

zh: 质疑这些结构 — — 它们在过去七十年里维持了世界稳定 — — 只能助长民族主义和竞争，为波动和冲突打开大门。
en: Casting doubt on these structures, which have sustained stability over the last seven decades, would merely fuel more nationalism and competition, opening the way for volatility and conflict.

zh: 如果不能指望美国支持全球稳定，欧盟模式和经验就将变得更加重要。
en: If the US cannot be counted on to support global stability, the EU’s model and experience will become even more important.

zh: 欧盟是包容、合作和民主价值观的化身。
en: The EU is the embodiment of inclusion, cooperation, and democratic values.

zh: 尽管存在一些缺陷，但欧盟已经经历过多次考验，证明了差异可以和平和建设性地得到解决。
en: Despite its flaws, the EU has proved time and again how differences can be resolved peacefully and constructively.

zh: 其成员国都致力于多边主义；事实上，我们每天都在贯彻多边主义。
en: Its member states are uniquely committed to multilateralism; indeed, we practice it daily.

zh: 结果不言自明。
en: The results speak for themselves.

zh: 没人可以质疑欧盟是所有成员国和平、民主、现代性和进步的保护神。
en: No one can doubt that the EU has been a guarantor of peace, democracy, modernity, and progress for all of its members.

zh: 其社会模式 — — 该模式要求通过合作、协商和妥协达成任何有结果的决定 — — 能够有效制约极端主义，因为任何成员国，只要推行激进政策，都会遭到其他成员国的反弹。
en: Its community model – which requires cooperation, negotiation, and compromise to reach any consequential decision – amounts to a check on extremism, because no member country can push radical policies forward without other members pushing back.

zh: 这并不是说欧盟国家不在面临沦为简单化的民粹主义论调的受害者的风险。
en: This is not to say that EU countries face no risk of falling victim to simplistic populist rhetoric.

zh: 相反，重要的是强调为何欧盟成员国必须致力于不断建设更强大、更深刻的联盟。
en: On the contrary, the point is to highlight why EU member states must dedicate themselves to the continued construction of a stronger and deeper union.

zh: 为了欧洲和世界的利益，应该喊出欧洲第一的口号。
en: For the sake of Europe and the world, it is time to put the EU first.

zh: 没有人比欧洲更清楚极端主义和民族主义的后果 — — 以及如何克服他们。
en: No one knows better than Europe the consequences of extremism and nationalism – or how to overcome them.

zh: 凭借开明和超国家的精神，欧盟已经实现了一百年前看似不可能的持续和平。
en: With an enlightened and supranational spirit, the EU has achieved a sustained peace that would have seemed impossible a century ago.

zh: 欧盟不可忘却这一成就。
en: It must not lose sight of that achievement.

zh: 相反，它必须继续致力于推进联盟，向世界证明多边主义可以做到什么。
en: Instead, it must continue to advance the union, and show the world what multilateralism can do.

zh: 为何通缩对欧洲来说是好事?
en: Why Deflation is Good News for Europe

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 在当今的全球经济中，没有什么价格要比原油价格更重要。
en: BRUSSELS – In today's global economy, there is no price as important as that of crude oil.

zh: 每天有超过8000万桶原油被生产和消费掉，而且其中很大一部分都进入了国际贸易环节。
en: More than 80 million barrels are produced (and consumed) daily, and a large part of that output is traded internationally.

zh: 因此，油价的大幅下跌 — — 从去年的110美元到近日的60美元/桶 — — 为石油进口国节省了数千亿美元的资金。
en: Thus, the sharp fall in the crude-oil price – from about $110 last year to around $60 today – is yielding hundreds of billions of dollars in savings for oil importers.

zh: 对于欧盟和美国来说，从油价下跌中所取得收益相当于各自GDP的2~3 % 。
en: For the European Union and the United States, the gain from that decline is worth about 2-3% of GDP.

zh: 在欧洲方面，低油价的好处或会随着时间推移不断增加，因为长期天然气供应合同在很大程度上与油价挂钩。
en: For Europe, the benefits of cheap oil might grow over time, because long-term gas-supply contracts are to a significant degree indexed to the oil price.

zh: 同时这也意味着另一优势，欧洲当前的天然气价目前来说还是数倍于美国，因为后者受惠于低价的页岩油。
en: This represents another advantage for Europe, where prices for natural gas were, until recently, several times higher than in the US, which had been benefiting from lower-cost shale energy.

zh: 但许多观察家也指出低油价也有其不利之处，因为这会令发达国家的通缩趋势进一步恶化，令到本以似乎陷入低增长陷阱的状况雪上加霜。
en: But many observers have argued that cheap oil also has a downside, because it exacerbates deflationary tendencies in the advanced countries, which already seem to be mired in a low-growth trap.

zh: 根据这一观点，油价的迅速下跌会令那些国家的央行更难实现为维持价格稳定任务而设立的每年2%通胀目标
en: The sharp fall in oil prices, according to this view, will make it even harder for these countries' central banks to achieve the 2% annual inflation rate that most have targeted in fulfilling their price-stability mandate.

zh: 欧元区则显得尤为危险，因为物价自2009年以来首度下跌。
en: The eurozone, in particular, seems to be in danger, as prices are now falling for the first time since 2009.

zh: 据说通缩不是一件好事，因为它令那些负债国，尤其是欧元区外围的问题经济体（希腊、爱尔兰、意大利，葡萄牙和西班牙 ） ， 更难以去偿还自身债务。
en: This deflation is bad, it is argued, because it makes it harder for debtors, especially in the troubled economies of the eurozone's periphery (Greece, Ireland, Italy, Portugal, and Spain), to pay what they owe.

zh: 但这种担忧是毫无根据的，因为这其实构建于某种误解之上。
en: But this fear is unfounded, because it is based on a misunderstanding.

zh: 影响债务偿还能力的其实应该是负债者的收入状况，而非总体价格水平。
en: What matters for debt-service capacity is the debtors' income, not the general price level.

zh: 随着油价下跌，家庭的实际（排除通胀因素）收入应当有所上升，因为油费和供暖费用减少了。
en: As oil prices fall, households' real (inflation-adjusted) income should rise, because they do not have to spend as much on fuel and heating.

zh: 对于美国和欧元区外围国家的高负债家庭来说，油价下跌缓解（而非增加）了一定的生活压力。
en: Lower oil prices make life easier, not harder, for highly indebted households in the US or the eurozone periphery.

zh: 消费者价格的下降也应当被视为一个好的迹象。
en: Falling consumer prices should thus be viewed as a good sign.

zh: 大多数制造企业将从更低的油价中受益，并随之改善其债务偿还能力。
en: Most manufacturing enterprises will also benefit from lower energy costs, improving their ability to service their debts.

zh: 而这也与欧元区外围国家尤其相关，因为这些国家的金融部门在2008年全球金融危机前累积了过多负债。
en: This, too, is particularly relevant in the eurozone periphery, where the non-financial sector accumulated too much debt during the credit boom that preceded the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 此外，虽然由低能源价格产生的节余或许首先会体现为更高的利润，但随着时间推移，竞争会迫使企业将这些飞来横财的一部分以更低价格或者更高工资的形式转移出来。
en: Moreover, though most of the savings implied by lower energy costs might initially show up in higher profits, over time, competition will force companies to pass on some of these windfall gains in the form of lower prices or higher wages.

zh: 低油价还有另一个重要后果：更低的价格使人更难以判定究竟工资压力将在哪个点位形成通胀压力。
en: This is another important consequence of cheap oil: lower prices make it more difficult to judge the point at which wage pressure becomes inflationary.

zh: 因为工资可以在不推高通胀的情况下出现一定程度的攀升，所以美联储委员会或许倾向于推迟提高利率，而外界本来预期它将在今年夏天推行这一措施的。
en: Because wages can increase to a greater extent without fueling inflation, the US Federal Reserve Board might be inclined to delay hiking interest rates, which it is now widely expected to do this summer.

zh: 公共财政也会在低油价引发的通缩中受益。
en: Public finances should also benefit from the deflation engendered by lower oil prices.

zh: 政府的收入不仅依靠消费，还依赖于国内产值。
en: Government revenues depend on the value of domestic output, not only consumption.

zh: 虽然低油价压制了消费者物价，也将刺激生产和整体GDP。
en: Though lower oil prices depress consumer prices, they should boost production and overall GDP.

zh: 如果原材料价格不出现大波动的话，消费者物价指数将随GDP紧缩指数（整体经济的价格紧缩指数）的变化而变化。
en: Absent large price changes for raw materials, the consumer price index evolves along with the GDP deflator (the price deflator for the entire economy).

zh: 但这种情况在今年度将不会发生，因为消费者物价正在下跌，而GDP紧缩指数（以及名义GDP）依然正在上升。
en: But that will not be true this year, because consumer prices are falling, whereas the GDP deflator (and nominal GDP) is still increasing.

zh: 这将为政府带来可靠的收入，不仅对那些债台高筑的发达工业国政府，尤其对欧元区外围国家有所裨益。
en: This should lead to solid government revenues, which is good news for highly indebted governments throughout the industrialized world, but particularly for the eurozone periphery.

zh: 欧元区目前经历的（消费者）物价下跌也可以因此被视为对所有能源进口国的积极进展。
en: The fall in (consumer) prices that the eurozone currently is experiencing should thus be seen as a positive development for all energy importers.

zh: 尤其是欧元区外围国家可以寄望于出现一个低利率，合理欧元汇率以及低油价带来的实际收入上升三者相结合。
en: The eurozone periphery, in particular, can look forward to an ideal combination of low interest rates, a favorable euro exchange rate, and a boost in real incomes as a result of cheap oil.

zh: 在一个通缩环境中，低油价似乎令欧洲央行更难以实现其近2%的通胀目标。
en: In a deflationary environment, lower oil prices appear to make it more difficult for the European Central Bank to achieve its target of an inflation rate close to 2%.

zh: 事实上，更低的油价堪称对欧洲的恩惠 — — 尤其是那些面临着内忧外困局面的国家。
en: In reality, lower oil prices represent a boon for Europe – especially for its most beleaguered nations.

zh: 克服欧洲的双重增长挑战
en: Overcoming Europe’s Twin Growth Challenges

zh: 发自慕尼黑 — — 随着经济复苏终于开始在欧洲占据上风，决策者的当务之急是确保增长可以持续到久远的将来。
en: MUNICH – As economic recovery finally begins to take hold in Europe, the imperative for policymakers is to ensure that growth can be sustained far into the future.

zh: 财政和货币刺激政策在危机高峰期可能是恰当之举，但却无助于应对欧洲大陆的长期发展前景的最大威胁：祸不单行的弱势人口结构和低投资额。
en: Fiscal and monetary stimulus may have been appropriate at the peak of the crisis, but they will do little to address the biggest threat to the continent’s long-term prospects: a toxic twosome of weak demographics and low investment.

zh: 根据经合组织和欧盟委员会的计算，即使能实现移民的稳定流入，28个欧盟国家的总劳动人口仍会在未来15年中减少1200~1600万。
en: Even assuming a steady inflow of immigrants, the combined workforces of the 28 European Union countries are projected to shrink by 12-16 million people over the next 15 years, according to the OECD and the European Commission.

zh: 新输入人口数量的更快速上升可以帮助改善这种情况；但更多的移民在根本上也不是对欧盟经济长期问题的适当解决方案。
en: A sharper rise in the number of newcomers could help ameliorate the situation; but higher immigration is not, on its own, an adequate solution to the EU economy’s long-term problems.

zh: 实现欧洲可持续增长的唯一希望是推动生产力，并以此在不断萎缩的劳动力中获得更多的价值。
en: Europe’s only hope for sustained growth is to boost productivity, so that it can derive more value from its shrinking workforce.

zh: 但问题是欧洲大陆距离上一次生产率的显著提高已经很多年了。
en: The trouble is that it has been many years since the continent last saw significant productivity gains.

zh: 在西欧，劳动生产率（每工作小时的产出）的增长已经停滞了几十年。
en: In Western Europe, growth in labor productivity (output per hour worked) has been decelerating for decades.

zh: 在1960年代，劳动生产率实现了强劲的年均4％增长，然后放缓至1980年代的2％并在世纪之交之际跌破1 ％ 。
en: In the 1960s, labor productivity grew at a robust 4% annual rate, before slowing to 2% in the 1980s and dropping below 1% around the turn of the century.

zh: 如今则以0.5％的速度匍匐前进。
en: Today it crawls forward at about 0.5% a year.

zh: 与此同时，包含技术创新在内的全要素生产率则一直停滞不前。
en: Meanwhile, total factor productivity, which takes into account technological innovation, has been stagnant.

zh: 欧盟迫切需要经济增长，好让成员国在不断老龄化的同时以维持自身的社会保障和福利制度 — — 其他国家和地区也都面临着类似的挑战。
en: The EU desperately needs economic growth to enable its member states to sustain their social security and welfare systems as their societies get older – a challenge that other regions and countries are facing as well.

zh: 但没几个国家会面临欧洲的生产率增长停滞和人口下降的双重阻碍。
en: But few confront Europe’s twin obstacles of anemic productivity growth and demographic decline.

zh: 以中国为例，虽然该国也遭遇了劳动力减少和退休人员数量急剧上升的挑战，但中国的劳动生产率在过去十年实现了年均9％的增长。
en: China, for example, is facing a similar demographic challenge, as its labor force shrinks and the number of retirees rises rapidly. But China’s labor productivity has been growing by 9% a year, on average, over the last decade.

zh: 在数字化技术 — — 常被描述为21世纪的工业革命 — — 迅速推广的前提下，欧盟生产率增长下降的情况其实相当出人意料。
en: The decline in productivity growth in the EU is surprising, given the rapid onset of digitalization – often described as the industrial revolution of the twenty-first century.

zh: 事实上，增速放缓的其中一部分原因可以归结为测量方法的问题：在欧洲还有美国，智能手机和互联网所引发的科技变革根本没有体现在生产率数据上。
en: In fact, part of the perceived slowdown can be attributed to measurement issues: In Europe, as well as the United States, the technological changes being wrought by smartphones and the Internet simply are not showing up in the productivity data.

zh: 比如说，统计人员也在绞尽脑汁地思考如何统计消费者因数字化而实现的质量提升和传递速度加快所带来的益处。
en: Statisticians struggle, for example, to account for how consumers are benefiting from the increased quality and speed of delivery that often results from digitalization.

zh: 此外在数字时代许多服务都是免费提供的，这意味着它们并未被计算机在消费内。
en: Furthermore, in the digital age, many services are being provided free of charge, which means they are not being counted as consumption at all.

zh: 可能导致生产率增长数据波澜不惊的另一个因素是，许多企业的传统实体性经营与新的数字商业模式并不兼容。
en: Another factor that may be contributing to flat productivity is that many corporations run traditional physical business models parallel to new digital ones.

zh: 在传统操作程序上增加高科技系统会在短时间内提高成本，从而抑制生产率，尤其是在新老模式无法良好衔接的情况下。
en: Adding high-tech systems to traditional processes can temporarily increase costs and thus depress productivity, especially if the new and old businesses are not well connected.

zh: 这些问题应该会随着时间的推移而减少；随着情况的不断好转，一部份生产力抑制因素也会消失。
en: These issues should diminish with time; as that happens, part of the productivity lull should disappear.

zh: 但并不是所有的生产率增长放缓都可以归因于向新技术时代的艰难过渡。
en: But not all of the slowdown in productivity growth can be attributed to the cumbersome transition to a new technological era.

zh: 即便经济已开始复苏，对欧洲的投资额仍远低于2008年的水平。
en: Even as the economy has started to recover, investment in Europe remains well below its level in 2008.

zh: 而长期的经济改善将在很大程度上取决于投资是否复苏以及规模大小。
en: Long-term economic health will depend, in large part, on whether investment recovers and by how much.

zh: 同时我们也有理由感到悲观。
en: And there are reasons for pessimism.

zh: 疲软的投资活动在一定程度上反映了欧洲市场的悲观看法。
en: Weak investment activity partly reflects a gloomy view of the European market.

zh: 如果劳动力停滞不前或继续萎缩，同时增长疲弱，那为何要花钱提高产量？
en: If workforces are stagnating or shrinking and growth is subdued, why spend on boosting output?

zh: 简而言之，欧洲的问题盘根错节：一方面需要投资提高���产力以弥补其劳动力萎缩；另一方面其人口结构缺陷又导致企业踌躇不前。
en: Simply put, Europe’s problems have become intertwined. The continent needs productivity-enhancing investment in order to compensate for its shrinking workforce; but its demographic weakness is causing companies to hold back.

zh: 但幸运的是还存在很多施展的空间。
en: Fortunately, there is much that can be done.

zh: 新一轮的欧洲市场针对服务，数字商品，资本市场和能源的一体化将消除企业所面临的障碍并催生新的投资积极性。
en: A renewed push to integrate European markets for services, digital goods, capital markets, and energy would remove barriers to business and bring new incentives to invest.

zh: 欧盟目前正在与美国进行谈判的《跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系协定》也将创造一个监管更少且竞争更大的更庞大市场。
en: The Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership that the EU is currently negotiating with the US would also create a larger market, with less burdensome regulation and more competition.

zh: 在国家层面上，像在爱尔兰，葡萄牙和西班牙出现的改革动力可以改善整个欧洲大陆的企业经营状况和竞争力。
en: On a national level, reform drives like those carried out in Ireland, Portugal, and Spain could improve business conditions and competitiveness across the continent.

zh: 最后，所有欧洲国家都可以加倍努力去教育和训练自己的国民去拥抱数字化时代。
en: Finally, all European countries could redouble their efforts to educate and train their residents for the digital era.

zh: 政策制定者不能仅仅乐观地假设欧洲的经济将靠自身来实现复苏。
en: Policymakers must not rest on the optimistic assumption that Europe’s economy will recover on its own.

zh: 相反，他们应该推动各项政策来支持投资，鼓励创新以及提升劳动者技能。
en: Rather, they should pursue policies that support investment, encourage innovation, and promote the development of skills.

zh: 随着工人和公司都要奋力在一个快速变化的 — — 而且越来越赢家通吃 — — 全球经济中进行竞争，推行确保长期增长的政策也变得刻不容缓。
en: As workers and companies struggle to compete in a rapidly changing – and increasingly winner-take-all – global economy, the need for policies that will ensure long-term growth could not be more urgent.

zh: 2016的欧洲难题
en: The Europe Question in 2016

zh: 发自纽约 — — 新年伊始，我们却面对着一个地缘政治和地缘经济风险都成倍增加的世界。
en: NEW YORK – At the cusp of the new year, we face a world in which geopolitical and geo-economic risks are multiplying.

zh: 中东大多数地区战火纷飞，让人不禁怀疑逊尼派和什叶派之间的长期战争（正如欧洲天主教徒和新教徒之间的三十年战争）可能就在眼前。
en: Most of the Middle East is ablaze, stoking speculation that a long Sunni-Shia war (like Europe’s Thirty Years’ War between Catholics and Protestants) could be at hand.

zh: 中国的崛起正催生大范围的亚洲领土争端，并挑战美国在该地区的战略领导地位。
en: China’s rise is fueling a wide range of territorial disputes in Asia and challenging America’s strategic leadership in the region.

zh: 而俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵显然已经进入半冻结状态，并可能在任何时候重燃。
en: And Russia’s invasion of Ukraine has apparently become a semi-frozen conflict, but one that could reignite at any time.

zh: 此外还可能爆发其他流行病，正如近几年非典，中东呼吸综合症，埃博拉病毒和其他传染病所展现的那样。
en: There is also the chance of another epidemic, as outbreaks of SARS, MERS, Ebola, and other infectious diseases have shown in recent years.

zh: 网络战也是一个迫在眉睫的威胁，同时非特定国籍的破坏分子和团体正在中东及撒哈拉南北的非洲地区制造冲突和混乱。
en: Cyber-warfare is a looming threat as well, and non-state actors and groups are creating conflict and chaos from the Middle East to North and Sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 最后（但显然并非最不重要的）气候变化已经造成了明显的破坏，极端天气事件已经变得越来越频繁和致命。
en: Last, but certainly not least, climate change is already causing significant damage, with extreme weather events becoming more frequent and lethal.

zh: 然而欧洲可能会在2016年变成地缘政治的爆点。
en: Yet it is Europe that may turn out to be the ground zero of geopolitics in 2016.

zh: 首先希腊退出欧元区的进程可能只是被推迟，而非阻止，因为养老金和其他结构性改革使得该国与其欧洲债权人爆发了极大冲突。
en: For starters, a Greek exit from the eurozone may have been only postponed, not prevented, as pension and other structural reforms put the country on a collision course with its European creditors.

zh: 对此“希退”可能是货币联盟走向尽头的开端，因为投资者会怀疑其他成员 — — 甚至可能是核心国家（如芬兰 ） — —是否会是下一个退出者。
en: “Grexit,” in turn, could be the beginning of the end of the monetary union, as investors would wonder which member – possibly even a core country (for example, Finland) – will be the next to leave.

zh: 如果“希退”确实发生，英国退出欧盟可能会变得更加容易。
en: If Grexit does occur, the United Kingdom’s exit from the EU may become more likely.

zh: “英退”的概率相较于一年前有所增加，原因如下：最近在欧洲的恐怖袭击以及移民危机令英国的孤立主义更加明显。
en: Compared to a year ago, the probability of “Brexit” has increased, for several reasons. The recent terrorist attacks in Europe have made the UK even more isolationist, as has the migration crisis.

zh: 在杰里米·科尔宾（Jeremy Corbyn）的领导下，工党对欧洲的疑虑倾向大增。
en: Under Jeremy Corbyn’s leadership, Labour is more Euroskeptic.

zh: 而首相戴维·卡梅伦（David Cameron）则将自己逼到了角落，因为他对欧盟改革的要求即便是向来同情英国的德国人也无法接受。
en: And Prime Minister David Cameron has painted himself into a corner by demanding EU reforms that even the Germans – who are sympathetic to the UK – cannot accept.

zh: 对许多英国人来说，欧盟就像一艘下沉中的邮轮。
en: To many in Britain, the EU looks like a sinking ship.

zh: 如果“英退”发生，其他的骨牌会随之倒下。
en: If Brexit were to occur, other dominos would fall.

zh: 苏格兰可能会决定脱离英国，导致联合王国解体。
en: Scotland might decide to leave the UK, leading to the breakup of Britain.

zh: 这还可能刺激其他分离主义运动 — — 或许从加泰罗尼亚开始 — — 更强烈地要求独立。
en: This could inspire other separatist movements – perhaps starting in Catalonia – to push even more forcefully for independence.

zh: 而欧盟的北欧成员国会觉得既然英国都走了，自己最好也随之离开。
en: And the EU’s Nordic members may decide that with the UK gone, they, too, would be better off leaving.

zh: 至于恐怖主义，相当数量的土生圣战者意味着欧洲的问题不是下一次袭击是否会发生，而是何时何地会再次发生。
en: As for terrorism, the sheer number of homegrown jihadists means that the question for Europe is not whether another attack will occur, but when and where.

zh: 而且反复爆发的袭击将严重打击企业和消费者的信心，令欧洲脆弱的经济复苏陷入停滞。
en: And repeated attacks could sharply reduce business and consumer confidence and stall Europe’s fragile economic recovery.

zh: 这些认为移民危机会威胁到欧洲存续的人是正确的。
en: Those who argue that the migration crisis also poses an existential threat to Europe are right.

zh: 但问题不在于2015年进入欧洲的一百万新面孔，而是2000万以上在中东和非洲大部分地区流离失所，深陷绝望，并试图逃离暴力，内战，国家失败，荒漠化和经济崩溃的人。
en: But the issue is not the million newcomers entering Europe in 2015. It is the 20 million more who are displaced, desperate, and seeking to escape violence, civil war, state failure, desertification, and economic collapse in large parts of the Middle East and Africa.

zh: 如果欧洲不能为这一问题找到一个协调性的解决方案，并强化共同的外部边界，申根协定将因此崩溃，欧盟成��国之间的内部边界也将重新树立起来。
en: If Europe is unable to find a coordinated solution to this problem and enforce a common external border, the Schengen Agreement will collapse and internal borders between the EU member states will reappear.

zh: 与此同时，对紧缩及改革上疲于奔命的欧元区外围国家 — — 与非欧元区的欧盟成员国（例如匈牙利和波兰）之间 — — 与厌倦救助的核心国家冲突不断。
en: Meanwhile, austerity and reform fatigue on the eurozone periphery – and among non-eurozone EU members such as Hungary and Poland – is clashing with bailout fatigue in the core.

zh: 左右两翼的民粹主义政党 — — 两者一样敌视自由贸易，移民，穆斯林和全球化 — — 在整个欧洲都更受欢迎。
en: Populist parties of the left and right – with their shared hostility to free trade, migration, Muslims, and globalization – are becoming more popular throughout Europe.

zh: 激进左翼联盟已经在希腊掌权；葡萄牙组建了左翼联合政府；西班牙大选可能会导致显著的政治和政策不确定性。
en: Syriza is in power in Greece; a leftist coalition is in office in Portugal; and the Spanish election could lead to significant political and policy uncertainty.

zh: 恶毒反移民反穆斯林的政党在欧洲核心国家 — — 包括荷兰，丹麦，芬兰和瑞典 — — 越来越受欢迎。
en: Virulent anti-migrant, anti-Muslim parties are becoming more popular in Europe’s core, including the Netherlands, Denmark, Finland, and Sweden.

zh: 在法国，极右的国民阵线在本月初差点夺得了一些地区的政权，其领导人，马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen ） ， 可能会在2017年总统大选中表现抢眼。
en: In France, the far-right National Front came close to winning power in several regions earlier this month, and its leader, Marine Le Pen, may do well in the 2017 presidential election.

zh: 此外在意大利，总理马泰奥·伦齐（Matteo Renzi）正处于由两个民调支持率上涨的反欧元民粹主义政党的夹击之下。
en: In Italy, moreover, Prime Minister Matteo Renzi is under attack by two anti-euro populist parties that have risen in opinion polls.

zh: 目前默克尔对德国的领导也受到了威胁，因为正是她的勇敢但极富争议的决定使近百万寻求庇护者进入了该国。
en: And Chancellor Angela Merkel’s leadership is now under threat in Germany, following her courageous but controversial decision to allow almost a million asylum-seekers to enter the country.

zh: 简而言之，欧洲的需求和欧洲人的需求之间的距离正不断加大，这种差距可能会在2016年引发深层次危机。
en: In short, the distance between what Europe needs and what Europeans want is growing, and that gap could spell deep trouble in 2016.

zh: 欧元区和欧盟都面临着多种威胁，而所有这一切都要求它们做出集体回应。
en: The eurozone and the EU are facing multiple threats, all of which call for a collective response.

zh: 但我们看到的是其成员国越来越多地通过本国的视角来考虑问题，从而破坏了寻求全欧洲级别的解决方案的可能性（难民危机就是一个悲剧性的经典范例 ） 。
en: But what we are seeing is its member states increasingly adopting a national approach, thus undermining the possibility of Europe-wide solutions (the migration crisis is a tragic case in point).

zh: 欧洲需要更多的合作，整合，风险共担，以及团结。
en: Europe needs more cooperation, integration, risk sharing, and solidarity.

zh: 相反，欧洲人似乎更欢迎民族主义，巴尔干化，分歧和分裂。
en: Instead, Europeans appear to be embracing nationalism, balkanization, divergence, and disintegration.

zh: 挺欧洲还是反欧洲?
en: Europe or Anti-Europe?

zh: 发自米兰 — — 有位知识渊博的米兰朋友最近问了我一个问题 ： “ 如果一个外部投资者，比方说一个美国人，想向意大利投资大笔资金，你有什么建议？
en: MILAN – A knowledgeable friend in Milan recently asked me the following question: “If an outside investor, say, from the United States, wanted to invest a substantial sum in the Italian economy, what would you advise?”

zh: ”我回答说，虽然存在很多投资企业和部门的机会，但是整体投资环境复杂。
en: I replied that, although there are many opportunities to invest in companies and sectors, the overall investment environment is complicated.

zh: 我会建议找一个见多识广的国内合作伙伴合作投资，因为此人既能在体系内游刃有余，又能点出那些不易识别的风险。
en: I would recommend investing alongside a knowledgeable domestic partner, who can navigate the system, and spot partly hidden risks.

zh: 当然，类似的建议也适用于许多其他国家，比如中国，印度和巴西。
en: Of course, the same advice applies to many other countries as well, such as China, India, and Brazil.

zh: 欧元区则正逐渐变为一个内部发展不同步的经济集团，而这一趋势的潜在政治后果也引发了投资者们越来越多的关注。
en: But the eurozone is increasingly turning into a two-speed economic bloc, and the potential political ramifications of this trend are amplifying investors’ concerns.

zh: 在最近举行的一次高级别投资顾问会议上，其中一个组织者问大家是否认为欧元将在未来五年内继续存在。
en: At a recent meeting of high-level investment advisers, one of the organizers asked everyone if they thought the euro would still exist in five years.

zh: 与会的200人中只有一位给出了否定答案 — — 在欧洲目前的经济形势下，这一对趋势性风险的集体评估结论委实让人感到意外。
en: Only one person out of 200 thought that it would not – a rather surprising collective assessment of the trending risks, given Europe’s current economic situation.

zh: 现在，意大利的实际（计入通货膨胀因素后）GDP大致处于2001年的水平。
en: Right now, Italy’s real (inflation-adjusted) GDP is roughly at its 2001 level.

zh: 西班牙表现较佳，但其实际GDP仍然在2008年金融危机爆发之前的水平徘徊。
en: Spain is doing better, but its real GDP is still around where it was in 2008, just prior to the financial crisis.

zh: 包括法国在内的南欧国家则经历了极其微弱的复苏和挥之不去的高失业率 — — 超过10 ％ ， 其中30岁以下居民的失业率则更高。
en: And Southern European countries, including France, have experienced extremely weak recoveries and stubbornly high unemployment – in excess of 10%, and much higher for people younger than 30.

zh: 与此同时，主权债务水平已接近或超过GDP（意大利现为135 ％ ） ，而通胀水平和实际增长 — — 以及名义增长 — — 仍然很低。
en: Sovereign debt levels, meanwhile, have approached or exceeded 100% of GDP (Italy’s is now at 135%), while both inflation and real growth – and thus nominal growth – remain low.

zh: 这种持续的债务负担过重状况限制了使用财政手段来帮助恢复强劲增长的能力。
en: This lingering debt overhang is limiting the ability to use fiscal measures to help restore robust growth.

zh: 欧元区各经济体中可交易部门的竞争力差异巨大，原因来自首次启用共同货币后出现的分化状况。
en: The competitiveness of eurozone economies’ tradable sectors varies widely, owing to divergences that emerged after the common currency was first launched.

zh: 虽然欧元最近的疲软会抵消其中一些分化的影响，但却无法根除。
en: While the euro’s recent weakening will blunt the impact of some of these divergences, it will not eliminate them entirely.

zh: 德国将继续积累大量顺差；而那些单位劳动力成本/生产率的比率较高的国家依然无力通过贸易创造足够增长。
en: Germany will continue to run large surpluses; and countries where the ratio of unit labor costs to productivity is high will continue to generate insufficient growth from trade.

zh: 自2008年金融危机以来，人们的普遍推论是欧元区经济体的长期艰难复苏将最终带来强劲增长。
en: Since the 2008 financial crisis, the conventional wisdom has been that a long, difficult recovery for eurozone economies will eventually lead to strong growth.

zh: 但这种说法正逐渐被抛弃。
en: But this narrative is losing credibility.

zh: 与其说是缓慢复苏，还不如说欧洲似乎被困在了一个半永久性的低增长均衡之中。
en: Rather than slowly recovering, Europe seems to be trapped in a semi-permanent low-growth equilibrium.

zh: 欧元区国家的社会政策减弱了因全球化，自动化和数字技术引发的就业和收入分化的分配性影响。
en: Eurozone countries’ social policies have blunted the distributional impact of job and income polarization fueled by globalization, automation, and digital technologies.

zh: 但这些国家（平心而论，也包括其他许多国家）仍然必须认真应对自2000年左右以来影响全球经济的三个先后产生的变化。
en: But these countries (and, to be fair, many others) still must reckon with three consequential changes affecting the global economy since around the year 2000.

zh: 第一个，也最与欧洲自身息息相关的是，欧元是在缺乏补充性的财政和监管一体化政策的状况下启动的。
en: First, and closest to home, the euro was introduced without complementary fiscal and regulatory unification.

zh: 第二，中国加入世界贸易组织并更彻底地融入全球市场。
en: Second, China joined the World Trade Organization, and became more thoroughly integrated into global markets.

zh: 第三，数字技术开始对经济结构，就业和全球供应链产生越来越大的影响，这大大改变了全球就业模式，加速了常规工作的流失速度。
en: And, third, digital technologies began to have an ever-larger impact on economic structures, jobs, and global supply chains, which significantly altered global employment patterns, and accelerated the pace of routine-job loss.

zh: 没过了多久，大概在2003年至2006年间德国进行了影响深远的改革以提高体制的灵活性和竞争力。
en: Shortly thereafter, between 2003 and 2006, Germany implemented far-reaching reforms to improve structural flexibility and competitiveness.

zh: 随后在2005年，自1974年以来负责分配纺织品和服装出口配额的《多种纤维协定》过期作废，全球纺织品制造业大量向中国和孟加拉国聚集（后者让人有点意外 ） 。
en: And, in 2005, the Multi-Fiber Arrangement lapsed. Without the MFA, which had underpinned quotas for textile and apparel exports since 1974, global textile manufacturing became heavily concentrated in China and, surprisingly, Bangladesh.

zh: 仅在2005年，中国就将其向西方的纺织品和服装出口增加了一倍。
en: In 2005 alone, China doubled its textile and apparel exports to the West.

zh: 这种发展对较贫困的欧洲地区和世界其他竞争力较弱的发展中国家都产生了特别不利的影响。
en: This development had a particularly adverse effect on Europe’s poorer regions and less competitive developing countries around the world.

zh: 这些变化造成了跨越多国的增长模式失衡现象。
en: These changes created a growth-pattern imbalance across a wide range of countries.

zh: 由于许多国家都采取措施来应对总需求缺口，主权债务增加，由负债驱动的楼市泡沫也不断膨胀。
en: As many countries took measures to address shortfalls in aggregate demand, sovereign debt increased, and debt-fueled housing bubbles expanded.

zh: 这些增长模式是不可持续的，当它们最终崩盘时，潜在的结构性弱点就会显露无疑。
en: These growth patterns were unsustainable, and when they eventually broke down, underlying structural weaknesses were laid bare.

zh: 如今对当前体制的抵制也在增加。
en: Resistance to the current system is now growing.

zh: 英国脱欧公投和唐纳德·特朗普当选美国总统反映出公众对最近增长模式在分配方面的不满。
en: The United Kingdom’s Brexit referendum and Donald Trump’s election as US president both reflected public discontent with the distributional aspects of recent growth patterns.

zh: 民众对民粹主义，民族主义和反欧洲政党的日益支持可能对欧洲构成严重威胁，对法国和意大利这样的欧元区大国的影响尤深。
en: And rising support for populist, nationalist, and anti-euro parties could pose a serious threat to Europe as well, not least in large eurozone countries such as France and Italy.

zh: 无论这些政党是否会在不久的将来在选举中取得成功，它们的出现应该使人对欧元长期的过度乐观的看法产生怀疑。
en: Whether or not these parties succeed at the ballot box in the immediate future, their emergence should cast doubt on overly sanguine views about the euro’s longevity.

zh: 反欧元的政治力量显然正在选举中逐渐得势，只要增长仍然贫乏，失业率仍然居高，它们就将继续获得力量。
en: Anti-euro political forces are clearly making electoral inroads, and they will continue to gain ground as long as growth remains anemic and unemployment remains high.

zh: 与此同时，由于担心这样做会对今年在荷兰，法国和德国（或许还有意大利）进行的选举产生不利影响，欧盟很可能不会在短期内进行实质性政策或体制改革。
en: In the meantime, the EU will most likely not pursue substantial policy or institutional reforms in the near term, for fear that doing so could adversely affect the outcome of consequential elections this year in the Netherlands, France, Germany, and possibly Italy.

zh: 当然，另一种观点认为英国脱欧，特朗普当选，民粹主义和民族主义政党的兴起将成为一个警钟，并推动欧洲走向更广泛的一体化和增长型政策。
en: Of course, an alternative view holds that Brexit, Trump’s election, and the rise of populist and nationalist parties will serve as a wake-up call, and spur Europe toward broader integration and growth-oriented policies.

zh: 这将要求欧盟决策者放弃各国自扫门前雪的观点，以维持欧盟在财政，金融和监管方面的承诺。
en: This would require EU policymakers to abandon the view that each country is solely responsible for getting its own house in order, while upholding EU fiscal, financial, and regulatory commitments.

zh: 维护欧盟规则不再是切实可行的做法，因为当前体制施加了过多限制的同时却包含了太少的有效调整机制。
en: Upholding EU rules is no longer practical, because the current system imposes too many constraints and contains too few effective adjustment mechanisms.

zh: 可以肯定的是，虽然财政，结构和政治改革都时不我待；但它们不足以解决欧洲的增长问题。
en: To be sure, fiscal, structural, and political reforms are sorely needed; but they will not be sufficient to solve Europe’s growth problem.

zh: 而令人沮丧的矛盾则是欧元区各国其实在各个领域都拥有巨大的增长潜力。
en: The bitter irony in all of this is that eurozone countries have enormous growth potential across a wide variety of sectors.

zh: 它们还远远不至于无可救药，只是需要放松系统对它们的约束。
en: Far from being basket cases, they simply need the system’s constraints to be loosened.

zh: 欧洲的未来是否会沦为一个缓慢前进的火车残体，还是新一代的年轻领导者会转向寻求更深层次的整合和包容性增长？
en: Will Europe’s future resemble a slow-motion train wreck, or will a new generation of younger leaders pivot toward deeper integration and inclusive growth?

zh: 这是很难说，但我本人无法否定这两种可能性。
en: It is hard to say, and I, for one, would not dismiss either possibility.

zh: 有一件事似乎很清楚：当前的现状不稳定也不能无限期持续下去。
en: One thing seems clear: the status quo is unstable and cannot be sustained indefinitely.

zh: 没有政策和经济轨迹的明显转变，政治上的断路器就会在某个时点跳闸，就跟在美国和英国一样。
en: Absent a marked shift in policies and economic trajectory, the political circuit breakers will be tripped at some point, just as they have been in the US and the UK.

zh: 民主高于主权的欧洲
en: Democracy Over Sovereignty in Europe

zh: 发自米兰 — — 欧盟的未来不一定会由近期荷兰、法国、德国和意大利选举的投票所决定，但这些选举的结果将对欧洲的命运造成深远的影响。
en: MILAN – The future of the European Union may not officially be on the ballot in the upcoming elections in the Netherlands, France, Germany, and Italy, but the results will go a long way towards determining Europe’s fate.

zh: 正如荷兰的格特·维尔德斯（Geert Wilders）和法国的玛琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）等右翼民粹主义反体制分子近乎狂热的竞选运动所展现的那样，民众的反欧盟情绪比以往任何时候都更为广泛。
en: Anti-EU sentiment is more widespread than ever, as demonstrated by the feverish campaigns of right-wing populist insurgents like Geert Wilders in the Netherlands and Marine Le Pen in France.

zh: 但也存在着支持改革和重塑欧盟的迹象 — — 这一信息也得到了法国的伊曼纽尔·马克隆（Emmanuel Macron）和德国的马丁·舒尔茨（Martin Schulz）这类候选人的拥护。
en: But there are also signs of support for revamping and reinventing the EU – a message being espoused by the likes of France’s Emmanuel Macron and Germany’s Martin Schulz.

zh: 任何有说服力的亲欧盟竞选活动都必须解决欧元引起的一系列问题。
en: Any pro-EU campaign, to be convincing, must address the problems stemming from the euro.

zh: 已经在欧盟28个成员国（英国脱欧后为27个）中的19个国家通行的共同货币已经成为欧洲一体化远景的主要阻碍因素。
en: Adopted by 19 of the EU’s 28 member countries (27, after Brexit), the common currency has become a major source of disillusionment with European integration.

zh: 虽然欧元危机最凶险的时期已经过去，但欧元区的架构仍然脆弱。
en: Though the euro crisis, in its most acute form, is over, the eurozone remains a fragile construct.

zh: 一旦出现新的波动，对其存续能力的怀疑极易卷土重来。
en: In the event of renewed volatility, doubt about its survival could easily return.

zh: 而共同货币脆弱性的根源则来自于《马斯特里赫特条约》框架的缺陷，该框架规定欧元区成员国在维持共同货币政策的同时可以制定符合共同财政规则的单一财政政策。
en: At the root of the common currency’s fragility are flaws in the Maastricht Treaty framework, which dictates that eurozone members maintain a common monetary policy and individual fiscal policies that conform to shared fiscal rules.

zh: 但仅仅存在财政规则并不足以确保各国一定会遵守，在欧盟一级也缺乏强制机制以确保财政纪律的充分执行。
en: But the mere existence of fiscal rules has proved insufficient to guarantee compliance, and there is no enforcement mechanism at the EU level to ensure adequate fiscal discipline.

zh: 除非这一规定得到变革，否则就永远存在较弱势成员国堆积不可持续债务的风险，使得强势成员国只能在提供政治上不可持续的转移支付和允许成员退出之间二选一，从而产生可能导致整个项目失败的不稳定性。
en: Unless this changes, there will always be the risk that weaker members will accumulate unsustainable debts, forcing stronger members to choose between providing politically untenable transfers and allowing members to exit, creating instability that could bring down the entire project.

zh: 倘若亲欧洲势力能在即将举行的选举中胜出的话，就可能提供一个 — — 也许是最后的 — — 机会去实现对《马斯特里赫特条约》的必要修订。
en: A victory for pro-European forces in the coming elections could provide the opportunity – perhaps the last opportunity – to pursue the changes to the Maastricht Treaty that are needed.

zh: 推动这些修订绝非易事。
en: Those changes will not be easy to carry out.

zh: 欧洲人将需要接受一个在欧元区合法性基础上的根本性转变，超越对基于规则的经济治理的简单承诺，转而接受具有民主合法性的权威机构所采取的那种自由裁量手段。
en: Europeans will need to accept a fundamental shift in the basis of the eurozone’s legitimacy, moving beyond a simple commitment to rules-based economic governance to accept the kind of discretionary approach taken by an authority with democratic legitimacy.

zh: 在缺乏政治联盟的情况下，采用基于规则的治理手段是可以理解的。
en: Without political union, the adoption of a rules-based approach to governance is understandable.

zh: 这与中央银行独立性的逻辑相一致：非选举产生的决策者致力于制定一套直接明了的规则，例如一定要实现特定的通胀率，而他们也会对此负责。
en: It aligns with the logic of central-bank independence: unelected policymakers are committed to a straightforward set of rules, such as targeting a particular inflation rate, against which they can be held accountable.

zh: 但这种逻辑对欧元区不起作用，因为具体的规则已被证明不足以遏制选民对转移支付的反对压力。
en: But that logic hasn’t worked for the eurozone, where concrete rules have proved inadequate to prevent pressure for redistribution that voters do not support.

zh: 现在这一状况已是显而易见，有人主张让市场在执行纪律方面发挥更大的作用。
en: Now that this has become apparent, some advocate a greater role for the market in enforcing discipline.

zh: 要求允许有序重组的新主权借贷框架提案就反映了这一逻辑理念。
en: Proposals for a new sovereign-lending framework that allows for orderly restructuring reflect this reasoning.

zh: 一项建议要求欧洲稳定机制采用类似国际货币基金组织的体制，以防止向破产国家提供贷款，并在负债总额超过一定阈值后进行强制重整或重组。
en: One proposal calls for the European Stability Mechanism to adopt a system similar to that of the International Monetary Fund, in order to prevent lending to insolvent countries and force reprofiling or restructuring after a certain debt threshold is crossed.

zh: 这种方法将使欧盟的“不救助”规则变得更加可信，也能避免对货币政策造成过度负担。
en: Such an approach would make the EU’s “no bailout” rule more credible and avoid placing an excessive burden on monetary policy.

zh: 但寄望于靠这么个计划来解决问题就有点天真了。
en: But it would be naive to believe that such a scheme would solve the problem.

zh: 对于一个货币联盟来说，对危机蔓延的恐惧合情合理，因为某一国债务危机的外部性总有可能殃及联盟的其余部分。
en: Fear of contagion would always be justified in a monetary union, where the externalities of a debt crisis in one country always risks infecting the rest of the union.

zh: 有鉴于此，完全基于市场机制的框架将易于产生不稳定状况。
en: Given this, a framework based exclusively on market mechanisms would be prone to instability.

zh: 但这并不是说由市场驱动的债务重组框架在欧元区改革中行不通。
en: This is not to say that a market-driven debt-restructuring framework has no place in eurozone reform.

zh: 它有一定作用，而一套简单的通用规则也是如此。
en: It does, and so does a set of simple common rules.

zh: 但是为了支持共同的财政立场并实现货币和财政政策的更好结合，我们需要第三个组成部分：一个独立的，专注于创建风险共担机制的联邦财政机构。
en: But, to support a shared fiscal stance and achieve a better mix of monetary and fiscal policy, a third component is needed: an independent federal fiscal authority focused on creating risk-sharing mechanisms.

zh: 这样一个机构需要拥有少量预算制定权和一些自由裁量权，以便能够根据不同事件调整其方法。
en: Such an authority would need a small budget and some discretionary power, in order to be able to adjust its approach in response to events.

zh: 当然，这种体制会被认为是损害成员国主权因而在政治上不可行。
en: Of course, if such a system were perceived to be undermining member states’ sovereignty it would not be politically feasible.

zh: 因此需要说服其批评者相信该机构的民主合法性。
en: Its critics would need to be convinced of its democratic legitimacy.

zh: 在不具备完整政治联盟的情况下，可以通过强调透明度，独立性，并让欧洲议会发挥更大的作用 — — 可能会在与各国议会的协调下实现。
en: Without full political union, that could be achieved with an emphasis on transparency, independence, and a much larger role for the European Parliament, possibly in coordination with national parliaments.

zh: 毕竟正如右翼民粹主义者所说，欧洲面临的核心问题并非主权，而是民主。
en: After all, the central issue facing Europe is not sovereignty, as the right-wing populists claim, but democracy.

zh: （在一体化市场中要求实现充分国家主权是一种错觉。
en: (With integrated markets, full national sovereignty is an illusion.)

zh: ）欧洲今天需要的是一项能在欧盟一级扩大民主合法性的条约。
en: What Europe needs today is a treaty that expands democratic legitimacy at the EU level.

zh: 如果还是靠为19世纪远未整合的欧洲经济而设计的体制来维护国家主权，就会注定走向失败。
en: Preserving national sovereignty based on institutions designed for the far less integrated European economy of the nineteenth century is a recipe for failure.

zh: 加大欧洲能源效率力度
en: Doubling Down on European Energy Efficiency

zh: 布鲁塞尔—在去年12月的巴黎COP21会议上，世界领导人做出了制定包括能源效率基准在内的减少温室气体排放的国家目标的有约束力的承诺。
en: BRUSSELS – At the COP21 conference in Paris last December, world leaders made a binding pledge to set national targets, including energy-efficiency benchmarks, for reducing greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 如今，欧盟委员会正在接近真相时刻它会制订一套宏大但可实现的能源效率目标、迫使个人和产业做出真正的改变吗？
en: Now, the European Commission is nearing a moment of truth: Will it set ambitious but attainable energy efficiency targets that will force individuals and industry to make real changes?

zh: 或者，它是否会屈从于政治压力，制定总能实现但不会有任何新措施的毫无意义的目标》
en: Or will it bend to political pressure and set meaningless targets that will be reached anyway, with no any additional effort?

zh: 2014年就出现过后一种情况，当时，欧洲领导人同意在2030年前将能源效率提高27 % 。
en: The latter approach was taken in 2014, when European leaders agreed to improve energy efficiency by 27% before 2030.

zh: 当时，欧洲理事会还因为在此事上的领导作用而大受赞扬。
en: The European Council was applauded at the time for its leadership.

zh: 大家都懒得一提全球能源效率目标本身到2030年有望提高35 % 。
en: Nobody bothered to mention that global energy efficiency was already likely to increase by around 35% on its own by 2030.

zh: COP21协定给了欧洲第二次机会成为榜样和能源效率的全球标准制造者。
en: The COP21 agreement has given Europe a second chance to set an example and become the global standard-bearer for energy efficiency.

zh: 环保主义者、商界领袖和学界正在等待欧盟委员会的新目标。 新目标有望在今年10月制定，写入欧盟委员会的新版能源效率指引。
en: Environmentalists, business leaders, and academics are awaiting new targets from the European Commission, which will most likely be established in October, in a forthcoming revision to the Commission’s Energy Efficiency Directive.

zh: 那么，什么才是有意义的目标？
en: So, what would be a meaningful target?

zh: 如果欧洲领导人认真对待COP21承诺，就应该在2030年在2010年消费水平的基础上减少70 % ， 这一目标比欧洲理事会2014年的目标宏大一倍。
en: If European leaders are serious about their COP21 commitment, they should embrace a 70% reduction on 2010 consumption levels by 2030 – more than double the European Council’s 2014 target.

zh: 70%的减少量相当大，但并非不可能。
en: A 70% reduction is ambitious, but not impossible.

zh: 兑现这一目标既符合经济利益，也符合环境利益。
en: There is both an economic and an environmental case to be made for it.

zh: 经济上，减少能源消费的国家也提高了生产率，原因很简单，能源用得越少，钱花得也越少。
en: Economically, countries that reduce energy consumption also increase productivity, simply because using less energy costs less money.

zh: 尽管实施能源效率措施需要大量初始投资，但这些支出可以由未来生产率增加弥补，这也是发达国家可持续地改善生活水平的唯一办法。
en: While implementing energy-efficiency measures may require heavy initial investments, these outlays will be offset by future productivity growth, which is the only way developed countries can sustainably improve living standards over time.

zh: 宏大目标的环境论据不是我们需要“拯救地球 ” 。
en: The environmental argument for an ambitious target is not that we need to “save the Earth.”

zh: 但我们确实需要拯救人类在其中演化和繁荣的气候。
en: But we do need to save the climate in which humans have evolved and prospered.

zh: 全球而言，能源效率以每年1.5%左右的速度增长，这是一个值得欢迎的趋势，表明30年来的进步环境政策起到了一些效果。
en: Energy efficiency around the world is increasing at roughly 1.5% per year, which is a welcome development and a sign that 30 years of forward-leaning environmental policies have had some effect.

zh: 但是，全球能源消费量以每年3%左右的速度增长，这意味着我们仍在继续给自己挖坑，而不是填坑。
en: Global energy consumption, however, is rising at around 3% per year, implying that we’re still digging our hole deeper, rather than filling it in.

zh: 世界六大经济体 — — 中国、美国、俄罗斯、印度、日本和欧盟 — — 仍是最大的污染者。
en: Six of the world’s largest economies – China, the United States, Russia, India, Japan, and the European Union – remain the biggest polluters.

zh: 但今天的大部分增长来自目前参与到全球经济中的发展中国家。
en: But most growth today comes from developing countries that now participate in the global economy.

zh: 即便这些国家在减排方面取得长足的进步，它们仍将是未来污染者，特别是在近期。
en: Even if these countries make significant strides in reducing emissions, they will be the polluters of the future, at least in the near term.

zh: 全球化增加了许多贫穷国家的寿命预期，也改善了那里的生活水平。
en: Globalization has increased life expectancy and improved living standards in many poor countries.

zh: 但全球化也造成了新的环境问题，需要宏大的解决方案。
en: But it also poses new environmental problems that will require ambitious solutions.

zh: 从这个角度讲，能源效率增进70%是欧洲 — — 以及全世界 — — 在当前全球增长水平上实现真正的可持续性的最低要求。
en: Seen in this light, a 70% improvement in energy efficiency is the minimum Europe – and the world – can aim for to reach real sustainability at current levels of global growth.

zh: 幸运的是，这一切完全可以做到。
en: Fortunately, this is all within our grasp.

zh: Ecofys、Quintel Intelligence��里斯本委员会（Lisbon Council）发表的一份2015年研究认为，欧洲已经拥有了可用的技术，在不牺牲经济增长的情况下将当前能源效率水平提高一倍。
en: A 2015 study published by Ecofys, Quintel Intelligence, and the Lisbon Council concluded that Europe already has the technologies available to double current energy-efficiency levels without sacrificing economic growth. These include heat pumps, smart grids, LED lighting, and energy-efficient household equipment.

zh: 那么，这些技术为什么还没有实施？
en: So why aren’t these technologies being implemented already?

zh: 原因不是产业界拖了欧洲的后腿；相反，欧洲产业界的环境足迹近几年来大为改观。
en: The reason isn’t that industry is holding Europe back; on the contrary, European industry’s environmental footprint has improved considerably in recent years.

zh: 但是，欧洲的首要能源消费者是个体家庭，如果有正确的政治领导、足够的投资和欧洲人自身的长期承诺，未来几年家庭能源效率可以提高两倍。
en: Rather, the principal energy consumer in Europe is individual households, where energy efficiency can be tripled in the coming years with the right political leadership, sufficient investment, and long-term commitment from Europeans themselves.

zh: 这让我们回到了能源效率指引，这应该成为这项工作的起点。
en: This takes us back to the Energy Efficiency Directive, where this work should begin.

zh: 欧盟委员会应该制定“登月 ” （ moon-shot）式标准，鞭策我们取得曾经不敢想象的高成就。
en: The European Commission should set “moon-shot” standards that push us to higher achievements than we once thought possible.

zh: 如果欧洲能够在2030年将能源效率提高一倍，欧洲人回首往事的时候会非常惊讶于过去的生活竟然如此不同。
en: If Europe can double its energy efficiency by 2030, Europeans will look back and wonder how they ever lived differently.

zh: 欧洲的三条断层线
en: Europe’s Three Fault Lines

zh: 巴黎—十年或二十年前，欧盟所面临的生存问题是，在一个全球化的世界里，它是否仍有意义。
en: PARIS – Ten or 20 years ago, the existential question facing the European Union was whether it still had a purpose in a globalized world.

zh: 如今，这个问题是，对于重大外部冲击，欧盟是否能够有效应对。
en: The question today is whether the EU can respond effectively to major external shocks.

zh: 欧洲周边地区既贫穷又危险。
en: Europe’s neighborhood is poor and dangerous.

zh: 从直布罗陀往南，人均收入要下降五倍多。
en: South of Gibraltar, income per capita drops more than fivefold.

zh: 乌克兰已被战争席卷。
en: War has recently raged in Ukraine.

zh: 以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突持续了50多年。
en: The Israel-Palestine conflict has continued for more than 50 years.

zh: 而伊拉克战争还未结束，叙利亚骚乱便已兴起。
en: And the war in Iraq barely ended before the mayhem in Syria commenced.

zh: 二战结束后的几十年里，欧洲能够忽视其边界外的发展趋势：安全归美国管。
en: For several decades after World War II, Europe could afford to overlook what went on beyond its borders: security was the business of the United States.

zh: 但形势已有所不同。
en: But things have changed.

zh: 美国从伊拉克撤军表明了它的参与限度，而欧盟近邻 — — 不仅包括叙利亚，也包括东部和南部周边地区 — — 的问题已经影响到欧盟自身。
en: The US retreat from Iraq signaled the limits of its engagement, and the problems in the EU’s immediate neighborhood – not just in Syria, but also to the east and the south – are now knocking on its door.

zh: 因此，看起来欧盟最重要的重点应该是保护自身和帮助稳定其环境。
en: So it would seem that the EU’s top priority should be to protect itself and help stabilize its environment.

zh: 但三条内部的断层线让欧盟难以实现这些目标。
en: Yet three internal fault lines are making it difficult for the EU to achieve these ends.

zh: 英国正在 犹豫是否应该退出欧盟。
en: Britain is wondering whether it should exit.

zh: 西欧和东欧在难民问题上针锋相对。
en: Western and Eastern Europe are at odds over the refugee crisis.

zh: 法国和德国的重点也有所不同。
en: And France and Germany differ on priorities.

zh: 英国因为欧盟成员资格而痛苦不堪，这尤其历史根源：1946年，丘吉尔提出了著名的欧罗巴合众国，但不包括英国在内。
en: Britain’s torment over EU membership is rooted in history: In 1946, Winston Churchill famously advocated a United States of Europe – but without Britain.

zh: 但英国的仇欧心理没有什么实质内容：并无根本性的原因将英国和欧洲其余部分割离开来。
en: Yet there is little substance to British Europhobia: nothing fundamental separates the United Kingdom from the rest of the continent.

zh: 颇能说明问题的是，英国外交部关于欧盟如何运行的详细评估并未给出遣返能力（repatriation of competence）的日程。
en: Tellingly, the British Foreign Office’s rigorous review of how the EU operates did not deliver an agenda for the repatriation of competences.

zh: 英国首相卡梅伦最近致信欧盟，其中所提出的唯一一个重大要求是关于欧盟内部移民的。
en: The only significant demand expressed by Prime Minister David Cameron in his recent letter to the EU concerns internal migration.

zh: 曾经的劳动力可移动性先锋英国如今对待外国工人的态度十分谨慎，希望限制外来工人获得社会福利。
en: Britain, the erstwhile champion of labor mobility, has now become wary of foreign workers and wants to limit their access to social benefits.

zh: 这是英国-欧盟关系的一个潜在分歧点；但绝不是结束四十年伙伴关系的理由。
en: This is a potential sticking point in the UK-EU relationship; but it is hardly a reason to end a four-decade-old partnership.

zh: 民调显示，卡梅伦承诺于2017年年底前举行的欧盟成员资格全民公决目前差距很小。
en: Polls suggest that Britain’s referendum on continued EU membership, which Cameron has promised to hold by the end of 2017, will be a close call.

zh: 但如果英国人投票支持“英国退出 ” ， 将此作为保护英国免受欧洲大陆骚乱的形式，那将是一个愚蠢的错误和悲剧。
en: But it would be both a blunder and a tragedy were Britons to vote for “Brexit” as a form of protection against tumult on the continent.

zh: 第二条断层线与难民危机有关。
en: The second fault line appeared alongside the refugee crisis.

zh: 直到2014年，欧盟在2004年所进行的“大爆炸”式扩张可谓成功，在中欧和东欧的经济和政治平稳快速转型中起到了重要作用。
en: By 2014, the EU’s “big bang” enlargement in 2004 could be hailed as a success story, having contributed significantly to swift and peaceful economic and political transition in Central and Eastern Europe.

zh: 真正的欧洲统一似乎正在向我们走来。
en: True European unification seemed to be in the making.

zh: 然而难民危机揭示出，欧盟的西部和东部成员对国家（nation）的概念并不相同。
en: Yet the refugee crisis has revealed that the EU’s western and eastern members do not share the same concept of a nation.

zh: 大部分西欧国家均 — — 至少在���实上 — — 趋向于非种族、非宗教的国家定义。
en: Most Western European countries have converged, at least de facto, on a non-ethnic, non-religious definition.

zh: 大部分西欧国家是大量种族和宗教少数群体的家园。
en: Most are home to significant ethnic and religious minorities.

zh: 这不是一个容易的转变，各国对于吸收更多移民的感觉也不尽相同；但这一变化是不可逆转的。
en: This has not been an easy transformation, and there are differences in countries’ perceived ability to absorb more immigrants; but the change is irreversible.

zh: 但是，大部分中欧和东欧国家反对这一点。
en: Most Central and Eastern European countries, however, object.

zh: 匈牙利总理欧尔班在言辞中表现出强烈的反穆斯林立场。
en: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has developed a fierce anti-Muslim rhetoric.

zh: 斯洛伐克总理费科在7月份宣布，他的国家只接受基督徒难民。
en: His Slovak counterpart, Robert Fico, announced in July that his country would accept only Christian refugees.

zh: 本月早些时候，捷克总统泽曼向一个叫作“阻止伊斯兰 ” （ Bloc Against Islam）的团体发表讲话，对支持者说，他们不是“极端分子 ” 。
en: Earlier this month, Czech President Miloš Zeman addressed a group called the Bloc Against Islam, telling its supporters that they were “not extremists.”

zh: 而波兰新任欧洲事务部长西曼斯基（Konrad Szymanski）在巴黎袭击发生不到24小时就用该事件指责欧洲的缺陷。
en: And Poland’s new European affairs minister, Konrad Szymanski, did not wait 24 hours after the Paris attacks before using them to denounce Europe’s flaws.

zh: 这不是政策上的不一致，而是原则上的分歧 — — 欧盟条约和《基本权利宪章》中的原则。
en: This is not a disagreement over policies. It is a divide over principles – the very principles of the EU’s treaties and Charter of Fundamental Rights.

zh: 特别是在德国，任何以政治原因被迫害的人都有宪法赋予的避难权。
en: In Germany, especially, any person persecuted on political grounds has a constitutional right to asylum.

zh: 与常见的误解不同，德国总理默克尔今年之所以让一百万左右的难民进入德国，不是基于人口因素上的自利行为，而是基于道德价值。
en: Contrary to common misperceptions, German Chancellor Angela Merkel acted on the basis of moral values, not demographic self-interest, in letting in about one million refugees this year.

zh: 德国几乎不抱希望能获得其欧洲伙伴国的团结。
en: Germany rarely expects solidarity from its European partners.

zh: 在难民危机最严重的时候，它一度希望获得一些团结。
en: At the height of the migrant crisis, it hoped, for once, to receive some.

zh: 一直从欧洲的团结中获得巨大好处的国家公开断然拒绝了德国无声的恳求，这绝不会轻易遗忘。
en: The public, categorical rejection of Germany’s silent plea by countries that continue to benefit massively from European solidarity will not be easily forgotten.

zh: 第三条断层线存在于法国和德国之间。
en: The third fault line lies between France and Germany.

zh: 11月13日巴黎袭击发生以来，安全成为法国压倒一切的目标。
en: Since the November 13 attacks in Paris, security has become the overriding French objective.

zh: 与此同时，德国专注于组织接待和安置大规模涌入的难民。
en: Meanwhile, Germany is focused on organizing the reception and settlement of a massive influx of refugees.

zh: 这一分歧更多地属于偶发分歧，而不是根本分歧。
en: This divide is more circumstantial than essential.

zh: 恐怖主义可能蔓延到德国，难民也可以越国边境。
en: Terrorism may spread to Germany, and refugees may move across borders.

zh: 但是，至少在目前，两国的公共关注点和政府重点是不同的。
en: Yet, at least for the time being, public concerns and government priorities differ.

zh: 默克尔和法国总统奥朗德都承诺要互相支持。
en: Both Merkel and French President François Hollande have expressed a commitment to mutual support.

zh: 法国将欢迎一些移民，而德国将派遣一些军队到马里。
en: France will welcome some refugees, and Germany will dispatch some troops to Mali.

zh: 但象征性姿态是不够的。
en: But symbolic gestures are not enough.

zh: 风险仍在于法国和德国都觉得自己在关键时刻被孤立了。
en: The risk remains that each country feels that it has been left alone at a critical juncture.

zh: 德国和法国也提出了一些更有雄心的计划。
en: More ambitious initiatives have been proposed.

zh: 两国经济部长加布里埃尔（Sigmar Gabriel）和马克伦（Emmanuel Macron）最近呼吁成立一个共同基金解决欧洲的难民和安全挑战，并未共同政策提供融资。
en: Sigmar Gabriel and Emmanuel Macron, the German and French economy ministers, recently called for a common fund to address Europe’s refugee and security challenges and to finance joint policies.

zh: 该基金将作为具体的风险共担机制存在，并且，如一些学者所言，这将是克服欧盟计划的障碍 — — 乃至通往共同化防卫和安全 — — 的有意义的一小步。
en: The fund would serve as a concrete risk-sharing mechanism and would be a modest, yet meaningful step toward overcoming the deadlock over EU initiatives, if not toward mutualizing defense and security, as some scholars recommend.

zh: 不管采取什么形式，显然需要更加果断。
en: Whatever form it takes, greater boldness is clearly needed.

zh: 否则，无法解决共同风险和挑战极有可能导致公民转向排斥性的民族国家信念，拒绝团结，要求永久性恢复国家边界。
en: Otherwise, the failure to address common risks and challenges may well result in citizens placing exclusive faith in the nation-state, rejecting solidarity, and calling for the permanent restoration of national borders.

zh: 欧盟的三条断层线正好出现在其面临前所未有的挑战的时刻，这不是巧合。
en: It is no accident that the EU’s three fault lines have appeared at the very moment when it is confronted with unprecedented challenges.

zh: 外部压力暴露出内部弱点。
en: External pressures reveal internal weaknesses.

zh: 欧盟要么克服这些弱点，要么屈服于这些弱点。
en: Europe can either overcome them or succumb to them.

zh: 欧盟的难民和安全双生危机构成了它的关键时刻。
en: The EU’s twin refugee and security crises constitute its moment of truth.

zh: 欧洲的反乌托邦政治
en: Europe’s Politics of Dystopia

zh: 东京—最近，保守派的劳动和正义党（Law and Justice，PiS）在波兰选举中取得胜利，这确认了欧洲的一个最新趋势：不自由的国家资本主义在民粹主义右翼集权派的领导下崛起。
en: TOKYO – The recent victory of the conservative Law and Justice (PiS) party in Poland confirms a recent trend in Europe: the rise of illiberal state capitalism, led by populist right-wing authoritarians.

zh: 在俄罗斯，这是普京经济学，匈牙利是奥班经济学，土耳其是厄尔多安经济学，还有意大利迄今还未爬出大坑的为期十年的贝卢斯科尼经济学。
en: Call it Putinomics in Russia, Órbanomics in Hungary, Erdoğanomics in Turkey, or a decade of Berlusconomics from which Italy is still recovering.

zh: 毫无疑问，用不了多久我们就将看到波兰的卡钦斯基经济学。
en: Soon we will no doubt be seeing Kaczyńskinomics in Poland.

zh: 所有这些都是同一个不变主题的变体：一位民族主义领导人，在经济不振演变为慢性的长期停滞时上台掌权。
en: All are variations on the same discordant theme: a nationalist leader comes to power when economic malaise gives way to chronic and secular stagnation.

zh: 接着，当选的极权派开始通过铁腕控制媒体特别是电视缩减政治自由。
en: This elected authoritarian then starts to reduce political freedoms through tight-fisted control of the media, especially television.

zh: 接着，他（到目前为止，这些人都是男性，尽管法国的马琳·勒庞如果能够掌权的话也符合这一模式）开始追求反对欧盟（如果他的国家是欧盟成员的话）或其他超国家治理机构的日程。
en: Then, he (so far, it has always been a man, though France’s Marine Le Pen would fit the pattern should she ever come to power) pursues an agenda opposing the European Union (when the country is a member) or other institutions of supra-national governance.

zh: 他还会反对自由贸易、全球化、移民和外国直接投资，同时偏袒国内工人和企业，特别是国有企业和与掌权派关系密切的私营企业和金融集团。
en: He will also oppose free trade, globalization, immigration, and foreign direct investment, while favoring domestic workers and firms, particularly state-owned enterprises and private business and financial groups with ties to those in power.

zh: 在一些例子中，彻底的先天论种族主义政党支持这样的政府或表现出根深的极权主义和反民主倾向。
en: In some cases, outright nativist, racist parties support such government or provide an even deeper authoritarian and anti-democratic streak.

zh: 诚然，这些力量在大部分欧洲国家尚未取得权力。
en: To be sure, such forces are not yet in power in most of Europe.

zh: 但它们在几乎所有国家都日益受到选民支持：勒庞的法国国民阵线、马迪奥·萨尔维尼（Matteo Salvini）的意大利北方联盟、尼格尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）的英国独立党（UKIP）都将俄罗斯的不自由国家资本主义及其总统普京视为值得敬仰和模仿的领袖。
en: But they are becoming more popular nearly everywhere: Le Pen’s National Front in France, Matteo Salvini’s Lega Nord in Italy, and Nigel Farage’s United Kingdom Independence Party (UKIP) all view Russia’s illiberal state capitalism as a model and its president, Vladimir Putin, as a leader deserving of admiration and emulation.

zh: 在德国、荷兰、芬兰、丹麦、奥地利和瑞典，民粹主义、反欧盟、反移民的右翼政党也在获得越来越多的支持。
en: In Germany, the Netherlands, Finland, Denmark, Austria, and Sweden, too, the popularity of populist, anti-EU, anti-migrant right-wing parties is on the rise.

zh: 在社会政策上，这些政党大部分都倾向于保守。
en: Most of these parties tend to be socially conservative.

zh: 但它们的经济政策 — — 反市场、担心自由资本主义和全球化会破坏国家身份和主权 — — 与左翼民粹主义政党有诸多共同之处，如希腊左翼联盟（在其向债权人屈服之前 ） 、 西班牙社会民主党以及意大利五星运动（Five Star Movement ） 。
en: But their economic policies – anti-market and fearful that liberal capitalism and globalization will erode national identity and sovereignty – have many elements in common with populist parties of the left, such as Syriza in Greece (before its capitulation to its creditors), Podemos in Spain, and Italy’s Five Star Movement.

zh: 事实上，正如20世纪30年代大量支持极左政党的选民态度做出一百八十度大转弯、最终转而支持右翼极权主义政党，今天的民粹主义政党的经济思想看上去也在从多个角度殊途同归。
en: Indeed, just as many supporters of radical leftist parties in the 1930s made a U-turn and ended up supporting authoritarian parties of the right, the economic ideologies of today’s populist parties seem to converge in many ways.

zh: 20世纪30年代，经济停滞和萧条导致了希特勒在德国、墨索里尼在意大利、弗朗哥在西班牙崛起（还有其他极权主义者 ） 。
en: In the 1930s, economic stagnation and depression led to the rise of Hitler in Germany, Mussolini in Italy, and Franco in Spain (among other authoritarians).

zh: 今天，不自由领导人的烙印也许不如他们20世纪30年代前辈那样政治恶劣。
en: Today’s brand of illiberal leaders may not yet be as politically virulent as their 1930s predecessors.

zh: 但他们的经济社团主义和专制风格是相似的。
en: But their economic corporatism and autocratic style are similar.

zh: 民族主义、先天论民粹主义的死灰复燃并不令人奇怪：经济停滞、高失业、不平等性和贫困增加、缺少机会、担心移民和少数群体“偷走”就业和收入，这些因素给了上述力量极大的提振。
en: The reemergence of nationalist, nativist populism is not surprising: economic stagnation, high unemployment, rising inequality and poverty, lack of opportunity, and fears about migrants and minorities “stealing” jobs and incomes have given such forces a big boost.

zh: 针对全球化 — — 以及随之而来的更自由的商品、服务、资本、劳动力和技术的移动 — — 的抵制如今在许多国家大行其道���对于不自由煽动家来说，这也是有利条件。
en: The backlash against globalization – and the freer movement of goods, services, capital, labor, and technology that comes with it – that has now emerged in many countries is also a boon to illiberal demagogues.

zh: 如果经济失衡变成长期，就业和工资无法迅速增长，民粹主义政党将在更多欧洲国家更接近掌权。
en: If economic malaise becomes chronic, and employment and wages do not rise soon, populist parties may come closer to power in more European countries.

zh: 更糟糕的是，欧元区可能再次面临风险，希腊退出将引发多米诺效应，最终导致欧元区崩溃。
en: Worse, the eurozone may again be at risk, with a Greek exit eventually causing a domino effect that eventually leads to the eurozone’s breakup.

zh: 或者英国退出欧元区将触发欧洲解体，此外，一些国家（英国、西班牙和比利时）国内也存在分裂的可能，这进一步增加了风险。
en: Or a British exit from the EU may trigger European dis-integration, with the additional risks posed by the fact that some countries (the UK, Spain, and Belgium) are at risk of breaking up themselves.

zh: 20世纪30年代，大萧条让极权主义者政权在欧洲甚至亚洲上台掌权，最终导致第二次世界大战。
en: In the 1930’s, the Great Depression brought to power authoritarian regimes in Europe and even Asia, eventually leading to World War II.

zh: 今天，不自由国家资本主义政权和领袖的卷土重来距离引起战争还十分遥远，因为中右翼和中左翼政府仍致力于捍卫自由民主，开明经济政策和坚固的福利制度仍是大部分欧洲国家的做法。
en: Today’s resurgence of illiberal state capitalist regimes and leaders is nowhere close to inciting a war, because center-right and center-left governments still committed to liberal democracy, enlightened economic policies, and solid welfare systems still rule most of Europe.

zh: 但民粹主义之毒正在获得优势，它可能开启一个潘多拉魔盒，释放出不可预测的后果。
en: But the toxic brew of populism now gaining strength may yet open a Pandora’s box, unleashing unpredictable consequences.

zh: 不自由主义的崛起浪潮让避免欧元区或欧盟解体变得更加重要。
en: This rising tide of illiberalism makes avoiding a break-up of the eurozone or the EU ever more vital.

zh: 但是，要确保这一点，需要提振总需求、增加就业创造和增长、减少收入和财富不平等性、为年轻人提供经济机会，以及融合而不是拒绝难民和经济移民的宏观和结构性经济政策。
en: But, to ensure this, macro and structural economic policies that boost aggregate demand, job creation and growth, reduce income and wealth inequality, provide economic opportunity to the young, and integrate rather than reject refugees and economic migrants will be needed.

zh: 唯有果断的政策能够阻止欧洲滑向长期停滞和民族主义民粹主义。
en: Only bold policies can halt Europe’s slide toward secular stagnation and nationalist populism.

zh: 过去五年所变现出来的谨小慎微只能让风险愈演愈烈。
en: Timidity of the type witnessed in the past five years will only increase the risks.

zh: 不能果断采取行动将导致和平、统一、全球化、超国家的欧盟的最终失败，以及反乌托邦民族主义政权的崛起。
en: Failure to act decisively now will lead to the eventual failure of the peaceful, integrated, globalized, supra-national state that is the EU, and the rise of dystopian nationalist regimes.

zh: 这些政权的样子，我们可以通过乔治·奥威尔的《1984 》 、 奥尔德斯·赫胥黎的《美丽新世界》以及米歇尔·维勒贝克（Michel Houellebecq）的最新小说《屈服 》 （ Submission）等文学作品一窥端倪。
en: The contours of such places have been reflected in literary work such as George Orwell’s 1984, Aldous Huxley’s Brave New World, and Michel Houellebecq’s latest novel Submission.

zh: 我们希望它们永远只存在于印刷品中。
en: Let us hope that they remain confined to the printed page.

zh: 夭折的欧洲安全战略
en: Europe’s Stillborn Security Strategy

zh: 马德里—宣布战略而没有人听，这样的战略有用吗？
en: MADRID – If a strategy is announced and nobody is listening, does it make a sound?

zh: 欧盟将在6月份知道答案。 欧盟外交事务和安全政策高级代表费德里卡·蒙赫伊尼（Federica Mogherini）为欧洲提出了久违的外交安全战略 — — 而此时所有人的注意力都集中在英国欧盟成员资格全民公决上。
en: The European Union will find out the answer this June, when Federica Mogherini, its High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, presents a long overdue foreign and security strategy for Europe – just when all eyes will be on the United Kingdom’s referendum on EU membership.

zh: 欧洲已经失去了方向，急需刺激以重燃使命感和活力。
en: The EU is adrift and desperately in need of a catalyst to renew its sense of purpose and dynamism.

zh: 全球战略有利于这一目标，但在注意力完全集中在另一项挑战，特别是这项挑战可能给欧盟带来根本性变化时绝非如此。
en: The global strategy could serve that purpose, but not if it is issued at a time when attention is squarely focused on another challenge, especially one that could bring about fundamental change for the EU.

zh: 基于此，该战略的宣布应该推迟到全民公决之后。
en: Given this, the strategy’s launch should be put on hold until after the referendum.

zh: 美国法律规定总统每年都要发布国家安全战略。
