en: In the United States, the president is legally required to issue a national security strategy annually.

zh: 尽管这一要求遵守并不严格 — — 奥巴马总统在过去七年中只发布过两次 — — 但其意图是明确的：确根据政府和国家所处的变化环境而确定的具体的国家安全重点。
en: Though the requirement is adhered to only loosely – President Barack Obama has released just two strategies in the last seven years – the intent is clear: to establish a set of concrete national security priorities informed by the administration in office and the country’s changing circumstances.

zh: 在欧洲，这一方针要宽泛得多。
en: In Europe, the approach is broader.

zh: 2003年，欧洲第一次也是唯一一次发布战略。 根据计划，这是一项长期指引，将跨越诸多欧洲委员会。
en: When the first – and only – strategy was launched in 2003, it was meant as a long-term guide, to endure through multiple European Commissions.

zh: 但它持续时间太久，现在早已过时 — — 这一点在其开头便已显而易见 ： “ 欧洲从未如此繁荣，如此安全，如此自由。 ”
en: But it has lasted for too long, and is now well out of date – a reality that is apparent from its opening line: “Europe has never been so prosperous, so secure, nor so free.”

zh: 去年6月，欧洲理事会承认需要更新战略，并要求蒙赫伊尼准备新的外交和安全政策并在一年内提交。
en: Last June, the European Council recognized the need for an updated strategy, and called on Mogherini to prepare a new foreign and security policy, to be submitted within a year.

zh: 为了尽量提高成功机会，蒙赫伊尼和欧洲对外行动局谨慎地推进着这一专家主导的制定流程，刻意避免公共争论。
en: To maximize their chances of success, Mogherini and the European External Action Service have kept the expert-led development process discreet, intentionally avoiding broad public debate.

zh: 与此同时，诸多艰巨挑战 — — 最主要是持续难民危机 — — 摧残着欧洲。
en: Meanwhile, numerous difficult challenges – most notably, the ongoing refugee crisis – have buffeted Europe.

zh: 这不仅导致公众对外交和安全战略制定流程缺乏了解，也改变了战略的实施环境。
en: This has not only sustained the lack of public awareness of the foreign and security strategy development process, but has also altered the environment in which the strategy is to be introduced.

zh: 本意是让欧洲能够更好响应外部变化的流程现在必须进行反思，以体现欧洲人认识到如今需要经历根本性转型的是欧盟本身。
en: A process that was intended to enable Europe to respond better to external changes now must be rethought to reflect the recognition that it is the EU which is now set to undergo a fundamental transformation.

zh: 不管英国选民是否选择离开欧盟，这一变化都会发生。
en: Such change will occur regardless of whether British voters choose to exit the EU.

zh: 如果英国带着外交、军事、经济和文化力量离开欧盟，那么欧盟影响外部环境的能力显然将大打折扣。
en: If the UK leaves – taking its diplomatic, military, economic, and cultural prowess with it – the hit to the EU, in terms of its capacity to influence its external environment, is obvious.

zh: 如果英国留在欧盟，它将要求松散的欧盟概念正式化 — — 而这将对欧盟一体化的未来产生核心问题。
en: If the UK stays, it will require the formalization of a looser conception of the EU – one that will raise core questions about the future of European integration.

zh: 从这个角度看，即将到来的英国全民公决要比2005年失败的欧盟宪法公投意义更加重大。
en: Seen in this light, the UK’s upcoming referendum is more momentous even than the failed referenda on an EU constitution in 2005.

zh: 同时公布新的外交和安全战略不但将让该计划变得无关紧要；还会强化一种感觉，即欧盟机构已经不合于现实世界，从而加剧欧盟已然尖锐的生存危机。
en: Releasing a new foreign and security strategy at the same moment will not just doom the plan to irrelevance; it will reinforce the perception that the EU institutions are out of touch with the real world, exacerbating the Union’s already-acute existential crisis.

zh: 延长该计划的制定流程将适得其反，刺激大量受人关注的关于新欧洲（不论是否包括英国）应该是一副什么样子的讨论。
en: Prolonging the plan’s development process would have the opposite effect, by helping to spur a broad – and attentive – discussion on what the new Europe, with or without the UK, should look like.

zh: 这场讨论除了产生一个重要且有用的外交和安全战略，还将产生一个全新的欧盟叙事（narrative ） ， 从而重振公众对欧洲工程的支持。
en: Beyond producing a relevant and useful foreign and security strategy, such a discussion can give the EU a new narrative, thereby invigorating public support for the European project.

zh: 要理解这一叙事的必要性，只需要看看英国关于其欧盟成员资格的争论即可。 这场争论的焦点几乎完全集中在现实的考虑和成本/收益分析上。
en: To understand the need for such a narrative, one need look no further than the debate in the UK over its EU membership, which is focused almost exclusively on practical considerations and cost/benefit analyses.

zh: 原则、团结和愿景都是细枝末节。
en: Principles, solidarity, and vision are nowhere to be found.

zh: 对政治来说，实际就是一切。
en: Timing is everything in politics.

zh: 去年6月，欧洲领导人发出了正确的要求。
en: Last June, Europe’s leaders made the right call.

zh: 如果该战略在当时就准备好发布，就有可能成为一个中心，让关于欧洲在世界中的使命的讨论围绕它展开。
en: If the strategy had been ready for release at that time, it might have served as a pole around which a discussion on Europe’s purpose in the world could have coalesced.

zh: 但内部和外部事件影响着这一流程。
en: But events, both internal and external, have overtaken the process.

zh: 应该作出调整。
en: It is time to adjust.

zh: 如果发布的新战略并未反映欧洲的新现实，就会带来巨大的机会成本 — — 事实上，考虑到欧洲对方向的渴望，这将是一场悲剧。
en: Releasing a new strategy that does not reflect Europe’s new reality would amount to an enormous missed opportunity – a tragedy, in fact, given how desperately the EU needs direction.

zh: 随着2016年截止期的临近，欧洲理事会和欧盟委员会应该时刻牢记职业点。
en: The European Council and Commission should bear this in mind as the June 2016 deadline to submit the strategy approaches.

zh: 有时耐心确实是智慧的良伴。
en: Sometimes patience truly is the companion of wisdom.

zh: 欧洲破网而出
en: Europe Against the Ropes

zh: 马德里 — — 11月18日，当唐纳德·特朗普在美国总统竞选中奠定令人震惊的胜势之际，布鲁塞尔正在举行纪念已故捷克斯洛伐克（后更名为捷克共和国）首任后共产主义总统瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔政治遗产的会议。
en: MADRID – On November 8, as Donald Trump was sealing his shocking victory in the United States presidential election, a conference in Brussels commemorated the legacy of the late Václav Havel, the first post-communist president of Czechoslovakia (and later the Czech Republic).

zh: 随着世界进入到特朗普时代，尤其是在欧洲，这种遗产的重要性可谓无与伦比。
en: As the world enters the Trump era, that legacy could not be more important, especially for Europe.

zh: 很难想象两个人的不同能超过哈维尔和特朗普。
en: It is hard to imagine two figures more different than Havel and Trump.

zh: 前者是一生为真理而奋斗的艺术家和知识分子，不知疲倦地希望发掘民众和社会最好的潜质。
en: The former was an artist and intellectual who fought his entire life for truth, working tirelessly to bring out the best in people and societies.

zh: 而后者则是自恋的骗子，通过利用人们最原始的情绪来获得权力。
en: The latter is a self-obsessed huckster who rose to power by playing on people’s basest emotions.

zh: 哈维尔的价值观与二战后带来前所未有和平及繁荣的推动自由世界秩序的发明创造非常相似。
en: Havel’s values have much in common with those that drove, after World War II, the creation of the liberal world order, which has brought unprecedented peace and prosperity.

zh: 但特朗普的当选表明美国可能不再奉行这些价值观，更不要说继续履行其在二战后维持国际秩序的义务。
en: Trump’s election, however, suggests that the US may no longer uphold those values, much less continue to fulfill its post-WWII role in maintaining international order.

zh: 由此带来的战略空白创造出由其他某种全球势力接过领导责任的机遇 — — 事实上也是一种不顾一切的必需。
en: The resulting strategic lacuna creates an opportunity – indeed, a desperate need – for some other global actor to take up the mantle of leadership.

zh: 欧盟能比其他任何全球势力更准确地把握和践行支撑自由世界秩序的理想和原则，因此应当成为接过自由世界衣钵的继任者。
en: The European Union – which, more than any other global actor, has internalized and operationalized the ideals and principles that undergird the liberal world order – should be the one to do it.

zh: 问题在于，至少从现在的情况看，欧盟似乎无法完成这样的任务。
en: The problem is that, for now at least, the EU does not look like it can.

zh: 欧盟曾为自由世界秩序做出过宝贵贡献，从树立气候变化榜样到合作推进遏制伊朗核计划的可行协议。
en: The EU has made valuable contributions to the liberal world order, from setting an example on climate change to helping push forward a workable deal to contain Iran’s nuclear program.

zh: 但到目前为止，它还没有表现出真正的全球领导力。
en: But, so far, it has not shown a capacity for real global leadership.

zh: 想想灾难性的2009年哥本哈根气候变化会议、拙劣的利比亚干预行动或者更痛苦的是，其对持续移民危机严重不足的反应能力。
en: Consider the disastrous 2009 Copenhagen climate-change conference, the bungled Libya intervention, or, most painful, its inadequate response to the ongoing migration crisis.

zh: 总之，虽然欧洲是位可靠的球员，但却从未出色地担任过队长职务。
en: In short, while Europe has been a solid team player, it has not been a very good team captain.

zh: 究其原因，并不是因为缺少希望。
en: This is not for lack of hoping.

zh: 举例来讲，确立欧盟全球权力的核心地位曾经是备受争议的2003欧盟安全战略目标。
en: Establishing the EU as a pole of global power was the goal of the much-maligned 2003 EU security strategy, to cite one example.

zh: 特朗普获胜后，外交和安全政策高级代表费德里卡·莫盖里尼宣布欧盟正在成为“不可或缺的力量 ” 。
en: Following Trump’s victory, EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Federica Mogherini declared that the EU is becoming an “indispensable power.”

zh: 但言论和现实之间差异巨大，这就是欧洲的实际情况。
en: But, as so often happens in Europe, there is a huge gap between rhetoric and reality.

zh: 美国大选后参与积极性不高的欧洲外长紧急会议明确地提醒人们，欧洲需要付出多少努力才能填补特郎普放弃美国全球责任所造成的真空。
en: The poorly attended emergency meeting of European foreign ministers following the US election is a stark reminder of just how far Europe has to go to fill the gaping hole that Trump’s abdication of America’s global responsibilities would create.

zh: 现实是欧盟缺乏远见和影响力。
en: The truth is that the EU lacks both perspective and clout.

zh: 成为世界核心需要以硬实力或软实力为基础的磁性支撑。
en: To be a pole requires magnetism, produced by either hard or soft power.

zh: 在21世纪初欧洲扩张的鼎盛时期，欧洲曾经拥有过这样的影响。
en: During the early 2000s, the heyday of EU enlargement, Europe had this pull.

zh: 就在2013年新欧盟示威期间欧盟或许仍拥有这样的影响力，当时年轻的乌克兰人为争取本国与欧盟的联系而勇敢地奉献生命。
en: And it may have had this pull as recently as the 2013 Euromaidan protests, when young Ukrainians died in the name of their country’s potential links with the EU.

zh: 今天，随着欧盟及其成员国将注意力转向国内，这种吸引力逐渐消失了。
en: Today, as the EU and its member states look inward, that attraction is gone.

zh: 现在，随着英国脱欧展开和跨大西洋伙伴关系解体，欧盟很有可能陷入解体之中。
en: Now, as Brexit plays out and the transatlantic partnership becomes unmoored, the EU could well unravel.

zh: 就算没有，欧盟也最有可能成为其霸主国德国践行领导力的平台。
en: If not, the most likely alternative is that it becomes a platform on which its hegemon, Germany, can stand and lead.

zh: 从某些方面讲，欧盟已经走上了这条道路。
en: In some ways, the EU is already well down this road.

zh: 现在一个不争的事实是如果没有德国政府的默许布鲁塞尔什么也做不成。
en: It is a truism that nothing gets done in Brussels these days without the German government’s acquiescence.

zh: 安格拉·默克尔总理单方面承诺欢迎难民和由德国主导与土耳其签署遏制难民协定就凸显了这样的现实。
en: Chancellor Angela Merkel’s unilateral pledge to welcome refugees and the German-led EU deal with Turkey to stem refugee flows underscore this reality.

zh: 这样的结果问题重重 — — 甚至具有悲剧性。
en: This outcome would be highly problematic – even tragic.

zh: 欧盟本应是一次超国家尝试，主导它的是哈维尔所倡导的弘扬共同利益的集体行动精神。
en: The EU was supposed to be a supranational endeavor, shaped by the spirit of collective action for the common good that Havel championed.

zh: 尽管德国肯定是个温和的霸主，但一国主导欧洲违反了创建欧盟的基本精神。
en: Though Germany is surely a benign hegemon, mono-national domination of Europe controverts the very basis for the EU’s creation.

zh: 从更实际的角度，德国也无法成为符合欧洲需要的足够强大的世界领袖。
en: On a more practical level, Germany will not be a strong enough international champion for Europe.

zh: 在我们这个日益信奉霍布斯哲学的世界里，必须向世界展示常规力量。
en: In our increasingly Hobbesian world, demonstrations of conventional strength are needed.

zh: 德国传统上对硬实力的厌恶将阻碍该国和欧洲在全球范围内投射影响力。
en: Germany’s traditional aversion to hard power will hamper its ability to project its influence – and Europe’s – globally.

zh: 可以肯定，欧洲其他国家能以某种形式贡献自己的力量。
en: There are, to be sure, ways the rest of Europe can help.

zh: 最值得注意的是，可以重振协调和精简欧洲防务这项长期工作。
en: Most notable, the long-stalled effort to coordinate and streamline European defense could be reinvigorated.

zh: 幸运的是，近几周在这方面出现了积极的迹象，欧洲外长和防长同意推动合作。
en: Fortunately, there have been signs of life on that front in recent weeks, with European foreign and defense ministers agreeing to move forward on cooperation.

zh: 将上述努力置于事实上的德国领导之下并不是最佳选择，但考虑到现实情况，它或许已经是最好的结果。
en: Placing those efforts under de facto German leadership is not optimal, but it may be the best possible outcome, given the circumstances.

zh: 期望欧洲取得理想成果是不现实的。
en: Ideal outcomes in Europe are not realistic.

zh: 而且，如哈维尔所说，坚持乐观主义 — — 相信事情会取得很好的结果 — — 是毫无意义的。
en: And, as Havel pointed out, clinging to optimism – the belief that things will end well – is pointless.

zh: 相反，我们必须找到希望的理由 — — 相信事情终将取得合理的结果。
en: Instead, we must find grounds for hope – the belief that things will eventually make sense.

zh: 达到目的唯一的方法是诚实地对待自己、清醒地看待我们可以和必须做些什么，以确保取得最好的结果。
en: The only way to do that is to be honest with ourselves and take a sober look at what we can and must do to ensure the most that can be achieved.

zh: 欧洲有能力在全球发挥领导作用，但缺乏实现目标所需的自信和专注。
en: Europe has the potential to play a leading role in the world, but lacks the self-confidence and dedication to make it happen.

zh: 现在是时候认清这一点，认清自由世界秩序所面临的真正威胁。
en: It is time to recognize that, and to acknowledge the real threat that the liberal world order faces.

zh: 只有这样，我们才能在充满挑战的现实生活中捍卫我们的利益和理想。
en: Only then can we figure out how, realistically, to safeguard our interests and ideals in a challenging world.

zh: 我相信，这才是哈维尔今天要说的。
en: This, I believe, would be Havel’s message today.

zh: 捍卫英国退出后的欧洲
en: Securing Post-Brexit Europe

zh: 马德里—据说好事总是降临到耐心等待的人头上。
en: MADRID – It is said that good things come to those who wait.

zh: 果真如此的话，那么姗姗来迟十年的欧盟新全球外交和安全政策战略（Global Strategy on Foreign and Security Policy）就是一件大好事。
en: If so, then the European Union’s new Global Strategy on Foreign and Security Policy, more than a decade overdue, must be a very good thing.

zh: 实际上，它正是欧洲所需要的。
en: Actually, it is exactly what Europe needs.

zh: 但其发布时机 — — 英国投票脱离欧盟之后立即发布 — — 可能导致它变成鸡肋。
en: But the timing of its release – in the immediate aftermath of the United Kingdom’s vote to leave the EU – could relegate it to irrelevance.

zh: 欧盟如何推进该战略将是欧洲工程未来的决定性因素。
en: How the EU moves forward with the strategy will be a bellwether for the future of the European project.

zh: 该战略由欧盟外交和安全政策高级代表费德里卡·墨赫里尼（Federica Mogherini）制定，可谓切中要害：它提供了一个一致的指导性愿景和一个采纳具体政策的灵活框架。
en: The strategy, developed by Federica Mogherini, High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, does precisely what it should: it provides a coherent guiding vision and a flexible framework for adopting concrete policies.

zh: 它实现了务实和进取的完美平衡，承认欧盟的局限性，并精确指明了需要的改进之处。
en: It strikes the ideal balance between realism and ambition, recognizing the EU’s limitations and pinpointing the improvements that are needed.

zh: 该战略“接地气”的视角可谓开宗明义 ： “ 我们需要一个更强大的欧洲。
en: The strategy’s grounded perspective is apparent from the first sentence: “We need a stronger Europe.”

zh: ”这表明它与发布于2003年的上一版过时战略有了重大改变。 上一版的第一句话显得相当别有用心 ： “ 欧洲从未如此繁荣，如此安全，如此自由。
en: This signals a major shift from the previous, outdated strategy, issued in 2003, whose much-maligned opening sentence declared, “Europe has never been so prosperous, so secure, nor so free.”

zh: 具体而言，该战略强调欧洲保持软实力的重要性，其中潜在的扩张在这方面起着重要作用；同时也承认光有软实力不足以确保安全。
en: Specifically, the strategy emphasizes the importance of the EU’s enduring soft power, in which prospective enlargement plays an important role, while acknowledging that soft power alone is not enough to ensure security.

zh: 此外，它所给出的解决地区挑战的愿景要比解决全球挑战的愿景具体得多，这间接地给出了欧盟全球方针制定的正确顺序。
en: Moreover, it implicitly establishes the right sequence for the development of the EU’s approach to the world, by offering a far more specific vision for addressing regional challenges than it does for global challenges.

zh: 个中含义是明确的：欧盟需要先在周边团结一致，然后才能争取更大的角色。
en: The message is clear: the EU needs to get its act together within its neighborhood before it can grasp a broader role.

zh: 所有这些都很好，但如果欧盟领导人不像墨赫里尼所说的那样“联合”起来以确保该战略的潜力得到充分实现，一切都是空谈。
en: All of this is well and good, but it will amount to nothing if EU leaders do not “join up,” as Mogherini puts it, to ensure that the strategy fulfills its potential.

zh: 而到目前为止，前景并不十分乐观。
en: And, so far, the outlook does not look particularly promising.

zh: “英国退出”已经让全球市场陷入混乱，也提出了关于欧盟未来的严肃问题，它让新安全战略的发布黯然失色，在最近的欧洲理事会峰会决议中对后者几乎没有提及。
en: “Brexit,” which has thrown global markets into turmoil and raised serious questions about the Union’s future, has eclipsed the release of the security strategy, which barely got a mention in the conclusions of the latest European Council summit.

zh: 更糟糕的是，英国公投并没有启发欧盟领导人进行急需的扪心自问，反而似乎刺激了许多人让国家政治利益 — — 更不用说个人野心了 — — 来指导思维。
en: Making matters worse, instead of inspiring much-needed soul-searching among EU leaders, the British referendum seems to have spurred many to allow national political interests, not to mention personal ambitions, to guide their thinking.

zh: 这一自利冲动可以从欧洲议会主席马丁·舒尔茨激烈的评论中一窥端倪。 舒尔茨要求英国立刻启动第50条（退欧程序 ） — —这显然是为了警告他的政治对手、呼吁谨慎考虑和给英国时间的德国总理默克尔。
en: This self-serving impulse was on display in European Parliament President Martin Schulz’s fiery comments calling for the UK to invoke Article 50 (the withdrawal procedure) immediately – a move surely intended as a shot across the bow of his political rival, German Chancellor Angela Merkel, who had called for deliberation and time.

zh: 这一自利冲动也可以从法国总统奥朗德的强硬姿态中一窥端倪。 奥朗德如此反应似乎受到极右翼政党国民阵线的马琳·勒庞可能在明年的总统大选中与他进行一番恶斗的刺激。
en: It can also be seen in French President François Hollande’s tough posturing, which seems motivated by the expectation of a battle with the far-right National Front’s Marine Le Pen in next year’s presidential election.

zh: 另一个可以清楚地表明这一自利冲动的现象是欧洲理事会和欧盟委员会为了控制即将到来的英国退欧谈判而斗得不可开交，欧洲理事会担心的主要是鼓励成员国的自治权。
en: And it is abundantly clear in the struggle between the European Council and the European Commission for control over the forthcoming Brexit negotiations, in which the Council is concerned primarily about upholding the autonomy of the member states.

zh: 长期以来，正是这种短视损害了欧盟在世界和成员国（通过强化无能和愚蠢的印象）的形象。
en: This is precisely the kind of short-sightedness that has long undermined the EU’s image in the world and, by reinforcing the impression of fecklessness and ineptitude, in the member states as well.

zh: 如果这一局面继续下去，如末日论者所警告的，英国退出可能标志着欧盟解体。
en: If it continues, Brexit could, as the doomsayers warn, be the EU’s downfall.

zh: 相反，如果欧盟领导人站出来直面英国退出所带来的挑战，团结一致地实现新全球战略中所提出的愿景，那么欧盟能够从这一混乱时期中走出并变得比以往更加强大。
en: If, instead, EU leaders rise to the challenge that Brexit poses and come together to realize the vision set out in the new global strategy, the EU could emerge from this tumultuous period stronger than ever.

zh: 在不确定的时代，欧洲必须决定如何应对它所面临的生存挑战。
en: In uncertain times, Europe must decide how it will address the existential challenges it faces.

zh: 明智的前进之道是通过尽量扩大集体优势来尽量缩小劣势。
en: The sensible way forward is to minimize weaknesses by maximizing collective strengths.

zh: 否则 — — 像英国所选择的那样，各国各走各路 — — 就将失之鲁莽。
en: The alternative – for each country to go its own way, as the British have chosen to do – would be reckless.

zh: 但最危险的方针 — — 将带来最严重的冲突和不安全的方针 — — 是继续假装统一，同时各自为政。
en: But the most dangerous approach – the one that would bring the most strife and insecurity – would be to continue pretending to be united, while acting independently.

zh: 欧盟领导人已经失去了一个重要机会。
en: Already, EU leaders have missed an important opportunity.

zh: 他们本可以主导制定欧洲的愿望和起草反映这些愿望的安全战略的过程，将它转换为关于欧盟应该怎样的大讨论，在包括最近的欧盟理事会等场合进行。
en: They could have woven the process of defining Europe’s aspirations, and of drafting a security strategy that reflected them, into broader discussions of what the EU should be, including at the most recent European Council summit.

zh: 他们不应该再次失去已经出台的新战略所带来的机会。
en: They should not also miss the opportunity presented by the strategy that has been produced.

zh: 这些机会不会每天都有。
en: Such opportunities do not come along every day.

zh: 新欧盟战略标志着欧洲新篇章的开始，还是标志着欧洲工程的死亡，取决于欧洲领导人是否可以克服狭隘，致力于合作。
en: Whether the new EU strategy symbolizes the start of a new chapter for Europe or a dead letter about a defunct project will depend on whether European leaders can overcome their parochialism and commit to cooperation.

zh: 早期的转变不容乐观。
en: The early returns are not promising.

zh: 饮鸠止渴的欧洲复苏
en: Europe’s Poisoned Chalice of Growth

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 在经历了一场双底型衰退以及比预想中更长的停滞之后，欧元终于看见了复苏的曙光。
en: CAMBRIDGE – After a double-dip recession and an extended period of stagnation, the eurozone is finally seeing green shoots of recovery.

zh: 消费者信心正在回升，零售额和新车注册量也掉头向上。
en: Consumer confidence is rising. Retail sales and new car registrations are up.

zh: 欧盟委员会今年会有1.3%的增长，这在欧洲标准看来不坏，但对欧洲改革来说，这是一个非常糟糕的消息。
en: The European Commission foresees 1.3% growth this year, which is not bad by European standards. But it could be very bad for European reform.

zh: 我们其实不难发现这种增长是如何实现的。
en: It is not hard to see why growth has picked up.

zh: 其中最明显的是，欧洲央行在一月底宣布实施了一项极为激进的资产购买计划 — — 也就是量化宽松。
en: Most obviously, the European Central Bank announced an ambitious program of asset purchases – quantitative easing – in late January.

zh: 这一手段所产生的预期当即压低了欧元汇率，令欧洲产品的国际竞争力有所提升。
en: That prospect rapidly drove down the euro’s exchange rate, enhancing the international competitiveness of European goods.

zh: 但讨论欧元贬值所产生的巨大影响还为时过早。
en: But the euro’s depreciation is too recent to have made much difference yet.

zh: 历史证据 — — 更别提当年日元贬值的经验教训 — — 表明在人们感知到货币贬值的积极影响之前往往要经历数个季度，甚至数年。
en: Historical evidence, not to mention Japan’s experience with a falling yen, suggests that it takes several quarters, or even years, before the positive impact of currency depreciation on net exports is felt.

zh: 因此肯定还有其他因素在起作用。
en: So other factors must be at work.

zh: 其中一个就是如今财政巩固政策对支出和增长的压力有所减少。
en: One is that spending and growth are now under less pressure from fiscal consolidation.

zh: 在2010~2012年间，国际货币基金组织所偏爱的“财政突击”手段 — — 结构性基础预算平衡 — — 令每年的GDP额外收缩了1%到1.5 % ， 直到其效果在很大程度上不再明显。
en: The structural primary budget balance, the International Monetary Fund’s preferred measure of “fiscal thrust,” tightened by an additional 1-1.5% of GDP each year from 2010 to 2012, after which it remained broadly stable.

zh: 随后两年财政政策则回归中性，为经济表现带来了改观。
en: The subsequent two years of neutral fiscal policy has made a positive difference for economic performance.

zh: 而与此同时，虽然本人对欧盟的财政管治无法一碗水端平表示遗憾，但欧盟委员会最近给予法国更多时间去将本国预算赤字降到相当于GDP3%的决定还是值得肯定的，因为该国的经济确实处于弱势。
en: And, however regrettable the uneven application of the EU’s fiscal rules, the European Commission’s recent decision to give France more time to reduce its budget deficit to 3% of GDP is welcome, coming as it did against the backdrop of a weak economy.

zh: 另外一个增长背后的因素，则是以西班牙为首的欧盟国家在结构性改革方面取得的切实进展。
en: Another factor behind the upturn is the meaningful progress that a number of European countries, such as Spain, have made on structural reform.

zh: 劳动力市场管制得到了放松，单位劳动力成本也有所下降。
en: Labor-market regulation has been loosened, and unit labor costs have come down.

zh: 这同时也令欧洲的竞争力进一步改善。
en: This, too, is showing up as further improvement in Europe’s competitiveness.

zh: 复苏的第三个驱动力就是银行和金融市场如今都更好地隔绝于希腊危机之外。
en: A third driver of recovery is the fact that banks and financial markets are now better insulated from the turmoil in Greece.

zh: 法国和德国的银行都得以出售自身持有的希腊政府债券，其中大部分卖给了欧洲央行这个最终债券采购者。
en: French and German banks have been able to sell their holdings of Greek government bonds, largely to the ECB, which has acted as bond purchaser of last resort.

zh: 欧洲央行同时也承诺：如果其他国家债券市场出现希腊这样的状况也会给予同样的支持。
en: The ECB has also promised to support other countries’ bond markets in the event of a Greek accident.

zh: 因此欧洲的复苏也不太可能被雅典的危机所影响。
en: Hence Europe’s recovery is less at risk of being derailed by instability in Athens.

zh: 第四个也是最后一个因素，就算是只死鸡也会蹬蹬脚啊！
en: Fourth and finally, even dead cats bounce.

zh: 经济增长会有许多好处：通过减少呆坏账的规模改善银行的资产负债表；通过增加税收收入并缩减福利支出来收紧政府预算赤字；通过增加债务/GDP比率的分母来提升债务稳定性。
en: It strengthens banks’ balance sheets by reducing the volume of non-performing loans. It narrows government budget deficits by increasing tax revenues and limiting welfare spending.

zh: 所有这些好处都是自动到来的，根本不需要官员们去做什么。
en: By raising the denominator of the debt/GDP ratio, it enhances confidence in debt sustainability. And it produces these benefits automatically, without officials having to do anything more.

zh: 但不幸的是，对欧洲来说，在这个急需实施行动的时候（比如对希腊）增长却减少了人们实施行动的紧迫感。
en: Unfortunately for Europe, growth also reduces the perceived urgency of action where action is urgently needed – for example, Greece.

zh: 在欧洲其他国家都出现增长的情况下，各国政府都似乎对自身经济情况多了点底气，因此也越来越不愿和希腊有所妥协。
en: With the rest of Europe growing, other governments, believing themselves to be in a stronger economic position, are less inclined to compromise with Greece.

zh: 每个人都知道相对于谈判破裂，不可控违约，以及希腊被迫退出欧元区来说妥协是更好的选项，可随着欧洲对自身的可持续复苏越有信心，就越可能走强硬路线 — — 也就越可能导向一个戏剧性的悲剧结局。
en: Everyone understands that compromise is preferable to the collapse of negotiations, disorderly default, and Greece’s forced exit from the eurozone. But the more confident the rest of Europe becomes of the sustainability of its recovery, the more it adopts a hard line – and the more likely a disorderly denouement becomes.

zh: 同理，复苏和持续增长越令各大银行的资产负债表得到改善，政策制定者就越缺少处理结构性的紧迫感 — — 比如德国各州银行和城市储蓄银行从政府处享有的明确偿付保障，或者葡萄牙圣灵银行（Banco Espirito Santo）这种家族式银行的危机。
en: Similarly, the more that recovery and sustained growth strengthen banks’ balance sheets, the less urgency policymakers feel to address structural shortcomings, such as the implicit guarantees enjoyed by state banks and municipal savings banks in Germany, and the problems of family-controlled banks like Banco Espirito Santo in Portugal.

zh: 而即便是2%的增长也无法让欧洲的双位数债务/GDP比率得以持续。
en: And even 2% growth will not render Europe’s triple-digit debt/GDP ratios sustainable.

zh: 尽管领导人们都不愿承认，但欧洲依然需要债务重组。
en: Europe still needs debt restructuring, though the continent’s leaders refuse to acknowledge this.

zh: 经济复苏只是推迟了末日审判的到来而已。
en: Economic recovery merely enables them to delay the inevitable day of reckoning.

zh: 最后，如果要避免欧洲再次爆发一场类似的危机，就必须以更具雄心壮志的改革 — — 财政和政治联盟 — — 来为货币联盟做补充。
en: Finally, there are the more ambitious reforms – fiscal union and political union – that must complement monetary union if Europe is to avoid a similar crisis in the future.

zh: 如果说能在欧洲最近的苦痛挣扎中得到了一点教训的话，那就是财政和政治联盟的货币联盟是行不通的。
en: If there is one lesson to be learned from Europe’s recent travails, it is that monetary union without fiscal and political union will not work.

zh: 但就算面对着对进一步财政和政治整合的强��反对，如果要实现进展的话就一定会有艰难且导致不和的谈判。
en: Yet, given intense opposition to further fiscal and political integration, progress, if it is to occur, will entail difficult and divisive negotiations.

zh: 因此任何在缺乏这类手段情况下出现的欧洲增长都将最终被其自身所阻碍。
en: So any European growth that occurs without these measures will create an incentive to put them off.

zh: 简而言之，根本原因就是许多导致欧洲危机的潜在因素都尚未得到解决。
en: The problem, quite simply, is that many of the underlying conditions that produced the eurozone crisis remain unaddressed.

zh: 如果欧洲在没下狠心解决这些问题之前实现了增长，那么就因此更难以作出这些艰难的决定。
en: If Europe now grows without making the hard decisions needed to address them, those decisions become correspondingly less likely to be made.

zh: 在发展中国家，有种说法叫经济改革往往在年景好的时候最为艰难。
en: In developing countries, it is said that good times are bad times for economic reform.

zh: 好吧，欢迎大家来到发展中的欧洲。
en: Welcome to developing Europe.

zh: 以自由的名义噤声
en: Muzzled in the Name of Freedom

zh: 纽约—恐怖行动可以造成可怕的伤害。
en: NEW YORK – Acts of terror can inflict terrible damage.

zh: 但它们无法摧毁开放社会。
en: But they cannot destroy an open society.

zh: 只有治理我们的民主国家的人可以，那就是以自由的名义打击我们的自由。
en: Only those who govern our democracies can do that, by shrinking our freedoms in freedom's name.

zh: 日本右翼民族主义者首相安倍晋三不需要有人鼓舞就收紧了隐私法，授予警察更大的权力，或让使用武力更加容易。
en: Shinzo Abe, Japan's right-wing nationalist prime minister, does not need much encouragement to tighten up secrecy laws, give more powers to the police, or make it easier to use military force.

zh: 两名被伊斯兰国恐怖分子绑架的日本公民在叙利亚被残忍处决，这给了安倍正需要的采取这些措施的鼓励。
en: The grisly executions of two Japanese citizens caught by Islamic State terrorists in Syria have provided precisely the encouragement that Abe needs to pursue such measures.

zh: 但日本从未成为言论自由的堡垒，也没有如此自称过。
en: But Japan has never been seen as a bastion of free speech, nor did it ever make great claims to be.

zh: 法国有过。
en: France does.

zh: 这显然是上个月恐怖分子袭击巴黎后所举行的彰显团结的示威的意义。
en: That is what the demonstration of solidarity in the face of last month's terrorist attacks in Paris was surely all about.

zh: 在世界各国中，法国可以避免其他自称世界自由灯塔的西方伟大共和国深陷其中的陷阱。
en: France, of all countries, would avoid the trap that snared the other great Western republic claiming to be a beacon of freedom in the world.

zh: 9/11袭击后所产生的对恐怖主义暴力的恐惧对美国的自由所造成的伤害比9/11自杀式袭击所导致的几千条美国人民的生命更大。
en: Fear of terrorist violence after the 9/11 attacks did more damage to freedom in the United States than the suicidal murder of thousands of its citizens.

zh: 因为这一恐惧，美国人让自己遭到本国政府的一律监视，也让恐怖主义嫌犯不经审判就被无限期关押和虐待。
en: Because of that fear, Americans allow themselves to be spied on indiscriminately by their own government, and permit terrorism suspects to be tortured and locked up indefinitely without trial.

zh: 与其他大部分欧盟国家一样，法国也有禁止仇恨言论的法律。
en: France, like most other countries in the European Union, already has laws that ban hate speech.

zh: 基于种族、信仰和性取向攻击他人是违法的。
en: You cannot legally insult people on the grounds of their race, beliefs, or sexual orientation.

zh: 在法国 — — 以及其他一些国家 — — 你可能因为否认犹太人大屠杀和其他历史种族灭绝事件而被起诉。
en: And in France, as well as in some other countries, one can be prosecuted for denying the Holocaust and other historical genocides.

zh: 法国总统奥朗德 — — 与安倍不同，他不是右翼民族主义者 — — 现在希望收紧这些禁令。
en: President François Hollande, who is not a right-wing nationalist like Abe, now wants to strengthen those bans.

zh: 他提出了新的法律，要求Google和Facebook等在线实体为其用户在线发布的任何“仇恨言论”负责。
en: He has proposed new laws that would make online entities like Google and Facebook responsible for any "hate speech" posted online by their users.

zh: 前欧盟国家首脑也支持来自欧洲犹太人领袖的建议 — — 所有欧盟国家不仅反犹太主义和否认种族灭绝将被定罪，总体的“仇外”也是犯罪行为。
en: Former EU heads of state have also backed a proposal from European Jewish leaders to criminalize in every EU country not just anti-Semitism and genocide-denial, but also "xenophobia" in general.

zh: 几乎没有人会为仇外或反犹太言论辩护。
en: Few people would wish to defend expressions of xenophobia or anti-Semitism.

zh: 但用法律来禁止观点真的明智吗？
en: But is it really wise to use the law to ban opinions?

zh: 首先，这些法律即便实施，也不可能降低恐怖行动的风险。
en: First of all, such laws, if enacted, are unlikely to reduce the risk of terrorist acts.

zh: 禁止观点表达并不能扼杀观点。
en: Banning the expression of opinions will not make them go away.

zh: 它们还是会被表达，也许以更秘密的方式，因此也有可能变得更加恶毒。
en: They will continue to be expressed, more secretively perhaps, and as a result become even more toxic.

zh: 中东和其他地区的恐怖主义的社会和政治基础不会仅仅因为公开禁止仇外言论而消失。
en: And the social and political basis for terrorism, in the Middle East and elsewhere, will not vanish just because of a public ban on xenophobic speech.

zh: 但监督人们想什么的法律还有一个更大的危险。
en: But there is a larger danger in using the law to police what people think.

zh: 它可能扼杀公共争论。
en: It can stifle public debate.

zh: 这一危险导致了至今在美国仍有市场的看法，即观点不管多么令人讨厌，都应该可以自由表达，因此可以被反对观点驳斥。
en: That danger underlies the view, still operative in the US, that opinions, however obnoxious, should be freely expressible, so that they can be opposed by counter-arguments.

zh: 当然，认为宗教或政治极端主义者有兴趣交换观点实属天真。
en: It would be naive, of course, to believe that religious or political extremists are interested in an exchange of views.

zh: 但煽动暴力在美国也是被禁止的。
en: But inciting violence is banned in the US as well.

zh: 美国宪法第一修正案不保护可证明马上会带来暴力风险的言论的表达。
en: The First Amendment of the Constitution does not protect freedom of expression when it can be shown to create a risk of imminent violence.

zh: 仇外观点，或否认种族灭绝，是令人厌恶的，但未必会引起这种威胁。
en: Xenophobic views, or the denial of genocide, are repellent, but do not necessarily result in such a threat.

zh: 在大部分社会 — — 包括美国社会 — — 公开表达这类观点受到什么可以被社会尊重这一粗略共识的限制。
en: In most societies, including the US, the public expression of such opinions is limited by a rough consensus on what is socially respectable.

zh: 这一共识随时间变化而变化。
en: This consensus changes with time.

zh: 它受到编辑、作家、政客和其他公开发表言论的人的左右。
en: It is up to editors, writers, politicians, and others who speak in public to shape it.

zh: 漫画家、艺术家、博客写手、活动家和喜剧演员有时喜欢挑战关于可尊重性的共识。
en: Cartoonists, artists, bloggers, activists, and comedians sometimes like to challenge the consensus of respectability.

zh: 一些挑战可能引起愤慨（毕竟，这才是重点 ） 。
en: Some of these challenges might cause outrage (that, after all, often is the point).

zh: 但只要它们不宣扬或威胁使用暴力，用法律禁止它们就弊大于利。
en: But as long as they do not promote or threaten violence, it would do more harm than good to ban them by law.

zh: 允许政府决定什么观点可以发表是危险的，这不仅扼杀争论，还导致政府独断专行和自私自利。
en: Allowing the government to decide which opinions are permissible is dangerous not just because it smothers debate, but also because governments can be arbitrary or self-serving.

zh: 在当前的恐慌环境中，回忆一下美国的��个著名仇恨言论案件大有裨益。
en: It would be useful in the current climate of fear to recall a famous hate-speech case in the US.

zh: 1977年，美国纳粹党计划犹太人口数量庞大的芝加哥卫星城斯科基（Skokie）举行示威。
en: In 1977, the American Nazi Party planned to stage a demonstration in Skokie, a suburb of Chicago with a large Jewish population.

zh: 受震惊而恐慌的公共观点的驱使，地方法院裁定，展示纳粹十字、发布传单和身穿纳粹制服应该禁止。
en: A local court, prompted by shocked and fearful public opinion, decided that the display of swastikas, distribution of leaflets, and the wearing of Nazi uniforms should be banned.

zh: 这样的示威将是对包括大屠杀幸存者在内的社区的侮辱 — — 很有道理。
en: Such a demonstration, it was quite plausibly argued, would be an insult to a community that included Holocaust survivors.

zh: 但这一禁令受到美国民权同盟（American Civil Liberties Union，ACLU）的挑战，认为这违反了宪法第一修正案。
en: But the ban was contested by the American Civil Liberties Union as an infringement of the First Amendment.

zh: ACLU律师（大部分是自由派犹太人）的论据不是以同情纳粹符号或观点为基础。
en: The argument of the ACLU lawyers, most of whom were liberal Jews, was not based on any sympathy for Nazi symbols or views.

zh: 他们的论据是，如果你允许政府禁止你所讨厌或鄙视的观点，你就削弱了你自己挑战针对你所同意的观点的类似禁令的权利。
en: Their argument was that if you allow the government to ban opinions you hate or despise, you weaken your right to contest a similar ban on views with which you might agree.

zh: 大部分欧洲政府对公开侮辱的砍伐比美国宪法更严格。
en: Most European governments already take a stricter view of public insults than the US Constitution does.

zh: 进一步增加限制将是一个大错。
en: It would be a great mistake to add even more restrictions.

zh: 恐怖袭击已经造成了足够多的生命和财产伤害。
en: Terrorist attacks are doing enough damage, in lives and property.

zh: 政府没有理由通过干预公民自由来雪上加霜。
en: There is no reason for governments to make things worse by tampering with their citizens' liberties.

zh: 不平等、移民和伪善
en: Inequality, Immigration, and Hypocrisy

zh: 美国剑桥—欧洲移民危机暴露出正在进行的关于经济不平等性的争论的一个根本性缺陷 — — 或者令人瞩目的伪善。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Europe’s migration crisis exposes a fundamental flaw, if not towering hypocrisy, in the ongoing debate about economic inequality.

zh: 真正的进步分子难道不应该支持全世界所有人机会平等，而不是幸运地生长于富裕国家的人才有机会平等？
en: Wouldn’t a true progressive support equal opportunity for all people on the planet, rather than just for those of us lucky enough to have been born and raised in rich countries?

zh: 许多发达国家的思想领袖鼓吹一种应得权利（entitlement）思想。
en: Many thought leaders in advanced economies advocate an entitlement mentality.

zh: 但应得权利止于国界：他们认为在个体国家内进行更大规模再分配是绝对必要的，但新兴市场或发展中国家的人不在此列。
en: But the entitlement stops at the border: though they regard greater redistribution within individual countries as an absolute imperative, people who live in emerging markets or developing countries are left out.

zh: 如果说当下关于不平等性的担忧完全属于政治范畴，那么这一内向视角是可以理解的；毕竟，穷国公民无法在富国投票。
en: If current concerns about inequality were cast entirely in political terms, this inward-looking focus would be understandable; after all, citizens of poor countries cannot vote in rich ones.

zh: 但富国不平等争论的论调有悖于一个道德标准，它心安理得地忽视境况差得多的数十亿其他地区的人。
en: But the rhetoric of the inequality debate in rich countries betrays a moral certitude that conveniently ignores the billions of people elsewhere who are far worse off.

zh: 我们决不能忘记，哪怕经历了一段时间的停滞，富裕国家的中产阶级在全球范围内仍属于上层阶级。
en: One must not forget that even after a period of stagnation, the middle class in rich countries remains an upper class from a global perspective.

zh: 全球只有15%的人口生活在发达国家。
en: Only about 15% of the world’s population lives in developed economies.

zh: 但发达国家占据了全球消费和资源消耗的40%强。
en: Yet advanced countries still account for more than 40% of global consumption and resource depletion.

zh: 诚然，增加富人税收有助于减轻一国内部的不平等性，但这无法解决发展中国家深度贫困的问题。
en: Yes, higher taxes on the wealthy make sense as a way to alleviate inequality within a country. But that will not solve the problem of deep poverty in the developing world.

zh: 道德优越感吁求 — — 以证明出生在西方就能享受如此多优势是合理的 — — 也无助于解决问题。
en: Nor will it do to appeal to moral superiority to justify why someone born in the West enjoys so many advantages.

zh: 诚然，可靠的政治和社会制度和机构是持续经济增长的基石；事实上，它们是一切成功发展的必要条件。
en: Yes, sound political and social institutions are the bedrock of sustained economic growth; indeed, they are the sine qua non of all cases of successful development.

zh: 但欧洲的长期掠夺性殖民主义史让人们很难猜测，如果欧洲人带来的只是贸易而没有征服，亚洲和非洲的制度和机构会发展成怎样。
en: But Europe’s long history of exploitative colonialism makes it hard to guess how Asian and African institutions would have evolved in a parallel universe where Europeans came only to trade, not to conquer.

zh: 当我们仅仅从只关注国内不平等而忽视全球不平等的视角看待问题时，许多广义政策问题就会扭曲。
en: Many broad policy issues are distorted when viewed through a lens that focuses only on domestic inequality and ignores global inequality.

zh: 托马斯·皮凯蒂（Thomas Piketty）的马克思主义论断 — — 资本主义正在失败，因为不平等性正在增加 — — 背景正在于此。
en: Thomas Piketty’s Marxian claim that capitalism is failing because domestic inequality is rising has it exactly backwards.

zh: 当你赋予全球公民完全一致的权重时，将看到一个完全不同的情景。
en: When one weights all of the world’s citizens equally, things look very different.

zh: 特别是，同样是让富裕国家中产阶级工资陷入停顿的全球化力量，让其他国家的数亿人走出了贫困。
en: In particular, the same forces of globalization that have contributed to stagnant middle-class wages in rich countries have lifted hundreds of millions of people out of poverty elsewhere.

zh: 从很多角度讲，全球不平等性在过去三十年得到了巨大的降低，这是资本主义的伟���胜利。
en: By many measures, global inequality has been reduced significantly over the past three decades, implying that capitalism has succeeded spectacularly.

zh: 资本主义也许减少了发达国家工人因为出生而享受到的租（rent ） 。
en: Capitalism has perhaps eroded rents that workers in advanced countries enjoy by virtue of where they were born.

zh: 但它对亚洲和新兴市场的全球真正的中等收入工人的帮助更大。
en: But it has done even more to help the world’s true middle-income workers in Asia and emerging markets.

zh: 实现更加自由的人口跨境流动将比贸易更加迅速地实现机会平等，但对此的抵制是强烈的。
en: Allowing freer flows of people across borders would equalize opportunities even faster than trade, but resistance is fierce.

zh: 反移民政党在法国和英国等国家正在取得节节胜利，在其他国家也成为重要力量。
en: Anti-immigration political parties have made large inroads in countries like France and the United Kingdom, and are a major force in many other countries as well.

zh: 当然，生活在战区和失败国家的数百万绝望的人民别无选择，只能寻求富裕国家的庇护，不管这意味着多大的风险。
en: Of course, millions of desperate people who live in war zones and failed states have little choice but to seek asylum in rich countries, whatever the risk.

zh: 叙利亚、厄立特里亚、利比亚和马里的战争是最近试图进入欧洲的难民潮的重要原因。
en: Wars in Syria, Eritrea, Libya, and Mali have been a huge factor in driving the current surge of refugees seeking to reach Europe.

zh: 即使这些国家稳定下来，其他地区的动荡也极有可能会取而代之。
en: Even if these countries were to stabilize, instability in other regions would most likely take their place.

zh: 经济压力是另一个强大的移民原因。
en: Economic pressures are another potent force for migration.

zh: 来自穷国的工人欢迎发达国家的工作机会，哪怕他们的工资处于社会底层。
en: Workers from poor countries welcome the opportunity to work in advanced countries, even at what seem like rock-bottom wages.

zh: 不幸的是，如今，富裕国家的大部分争论 — — 不论是左翼还是右翼 — — 核心都是如何将其他人拒之门外。
en: Unfortunately, most of the debate in rich countries today, on both the left and the right, centers on how to keep other people out.

zh: 这也许是务实的，但显然在道德上站不住脚。
en: That may be practical, but it certainly is not morally defensible.

zh: 而如果全球变暖根据气候学家的基线预测那样展开，移民压力还将进一步增加。
en: And migration pressure will increase markedly if global warming unfolds according to climatologists’ baseline predictions.

zh: 随着赤道地区变得过于炎热和干旱以至于无法开展农业，北方气温的升高将增加农业生产率。
en: As equatorial regions become too hot and arid to sustain agriculture, rising temperatures in the north will make agriculture more productive.

zh: 因此，气候模式的变化将助长流向富裕国家的移民潮，让眼下的移民危机相形见绌，特别是考虑到穷国和新兴市场通常较接近赤道、气候条件更脆弱的情况下。
en: Shifting weather patterns could then fuel migration to richer countries at levels that make today’s immigration crisis seem trivial, particularly given that poor countries and emerging markets typically are closer to the equator and in more vulnerable climates.

zh: 大部分国家的能力和对移民的忍受力已经达到了极限，很难说全球人口分布的新均衡将以和平方式达到。
en: With most rich countries’ capacity and tolerance for immigration already limited, it is hard to see how a new equilibrium for global population distribution will be reached peacefully.

zh: 对发达经济体的怨恨 — — 发达经济体对于全球污染和商品消费负有最主要的责任 — — 随时可能爆发。
en: Resentment against the advanced economies, which account for a vastly disproportionate share of global pollution and commodity consumption, could boil over.

zh: 随着世界越来越富有，不平等性难免将成为比贫困更加严重的问题，我在十多年前就首次提出了这一问题。
en: As the world becomes richer, inequality inevitably will loom as a much larger issue relative to poverty, a point I first argued more than a decade ago.

zh: 但是，遗憾的是，不平等性争论一直聚焦于国内不平等，而严重性远远过之的全球不平等性问题一直没有得到关注。
en: Regrettably, however, the inequality debate has focused so intensely on domestic inequality that the far larger issue of global inequality has been overshadowed.

zh: 这是一个糟糕的局面，因为富裕国家有很多办法可以让情况有所不同。
en: That is a pity, because there are many ways rich countries can make a difference.

zh: 它们可以提供免费的在线医疗和教育支持、增加发展援助、债务减记、市场准入、更多地位全球安全做出贡献。
en: They can provide free online medical and education support, more development aid, debt write-downs, market access, and greater contributions to global security.

zh: 绝望地乘船向欧洲海岸靠近的移民乃是发达国家失败的写照。
en: The arrival of desperate boat people on Europe’s shores is a symptom of their failure to do so.

zh: 欧洲否认剖面图
en: Profiles in European Denial

zh: 雅典—欧洲建制派踌躇满志。 最近他们宣布了两件事，即使只是部分正确，意义和十分重大：希腊债务危机结束，以及法德重新设计欧元区的协议。
en: ATHENS – Europe’s establishment is luxuriating in two recent announcements that would have been momentous even if they were only partly accurate: The end of Greece’s debt crisis, and a Franco-German accord to redesign the eurozone.

zh: 不幸的是，这两件事只是欧盟建制派绝不放过放过机会的机会的过人天赋的最新证明。
en: Unfortunately, both reports offer fresh proof of the European Union establishment’s remarkable talent for never missing an opportunity to miss an opportunity.

zh: 两件事在同一周宣布，这不是巧合。
en: The two announcements did not come in the same week by accident.

zh: 发生于2010年的希腊危机爆发是欧元区设计缺陷的急诊，因此，它在整个欧洲引发了多米诺效应。
en: The Greek debt implosion, back in 2010, was the ugly symptom of the eurozone’s design flaws, which is why it triggered a domino effect across the continent.

zh: 希腊一直无力偿债说明法德轴心内部对于欧元区的重新设计问题存在深刻分歧。
en: Greece’s continuing insolvency reflects the deep disagreements within the Franco-German axis concerning eurozone redesign.

zh: 三位法国总统和同一位德国总理没能就能给欧元区带来可持续性的制度变化达成一致，希腊也被放任不断流血。
en: While three French presidents and the same German chancellor were failing to agree on the institutional changes that would render the eurozone sustainable, Greece was asked to bleed quietly.

zh: 2015年，希腊人奋起反抗，被欧洲建制派无情镇压。
en: In 2015, the Greeks staged a rebellion, which Europe’s establishment ruthlessly crushed.

zh: 英国退欧和欧盟在欧洲选民眼前逐渐失去合法性都没有让建制派改变方针。
en: Neither Brexit nor the EU’s steady de-legitimation in the eyes of European voters managed to convince the establishment to change its ways.

zh: 法国总统马克龙的当选是柏林和巴黎能够达成协议，阻止意大利引发另一场 — — 这一回会要命 — — 多米诺效应的最后希望。
en: French President Emmanuel Macron’s election seemed the last hope for the new Berlin-Paris accord needed to prevent a suffocating Italy from triggering the next – this time lethal – domino effect.

zh: 马克龙提出了令人满怀希望的新方案：欧元区共同预算、新的安全债务工具和准联邦制的征税制度、共同失业保险基金、共同银行保险和倒闭银行重组机制（从而提供真正的银行联盟所需要的基础 ） 。
en: Under Macron, new, hopeful ideas were proposed: a common budget for the eurozone; a new safe debt instrument and quasi-federal tax-raising capacities; a common unemployment insurance fund; common bank deposit insurance and a common pot from which to recapitalize failing banks (thus providing the missing foundation of a real banking union).

zh: 此外，新投资基金将动员欧洲闲置储蓄而不会给成员国增加财政压力。
en: Moreover, a new investment fund would mobilize idle savings across Europe, without adding to the fiscal stress of member-states.

zh: 马克龙政府似乎还接受了我在2015年希腊财政部长任上所提出的的建议，通过GDP指数化重组公共债务。
en: And Macron’s government also seemed to adopt a proposal I made in 2015, when I was Greece’s finance minister, for restructuring public debt via GDP-indexing.

zh: 如此，希腊公共债务总规模（及其偿还速度）将与希腊名义收入规模和增长率挂钩。
en: That way, the size of Greece’s total public debt (and the speed of its repayment) would be linked to the size and growth rate of Greece’s nominal income.

zh: 一年后，随着意大利与欧盟冲突显现，德国总理默克尔与马克龙的梅瑟堡（Meseberg）峰会达成了关于欧元区改革的协议。
en: A year later, with Italy on a collision course with the EU, the Meseberg Summit between German Chancellor Angela Merkel and Macron delivered an agreement on eurozone reform.

zh: 几天后，欧元区财政部长组成的欧元集团抛出了其本身的希腊债务危机“解决方案 ” 。
en: A few days later, the Eurogroup of eurozone finance ministers delivered its own “solution” to the Greek debt crisis.

zh: 在理想环境下，这两件事一昂该预示着欧洲失去的十年的结束和重建的新时代的开始，在新时代中，欧洲人需要团结面对美国总统特朗普和下一次经济衰退所带来的挑战。
en: In a decent universe, these two announcements would herald the end of a lost decade for Europe and the beginning of an era of rebuilding so that Europeans may face, together, the challenges posed by US President Donald Trump and the next economic downturn.

zh: 可惜，这不是我们所在的环境。
en: Alas, that is not the universe we inhabit.

zh: 在梅瑟堡峰会之前，马克龙的方案便已经弱化到了形同缴械的地步。
en: Even before the Meseberg Summit, Macron had diluted his proposals to the point of surrender.

zh: 共同存款保险机制和重组基金的未来意义变得无足轻重：欧元区外围国银行需要在合适的银行联盟形成之前处理好不良贷款。
en: The common bank deposit insurance scheme and the recapitalization fund were pushed into an implausible future in which the eurozone periphery’s banks have to shed their bad loans before a proper banking union is forged.

zh: 共同失业保险机制甚至没有纳入讨论。
en: The common unemployment insurance scheme was not even discussed.

zh: 最后，作为欧元区共同预算（规模相当于欧元区总收入的2—3 % ） 基础的共同债务工具 — — 具有宏观重要性的财政联盟的主要前提 — — 被随意地丢进了垃圾桶。
en: Last but not least, a common debt instrument to underpin a eurozone budget amounting to 2-3% of eurozone aggregate income – the main prerequisite for a macroeconomically significant fiscal union – was unceremoniously consigned to the dustbin.

zh: 自然，默克尔恰到好处地同意了一些马克龙的建议，这让马克龙的受辱看起来像是取得了个人胜利。
en: Naturally, Merkel offered just enough to allow Macron to disguise his humiliation as a personal triumph.

zh: 在欣喜若狂的媒体面前，他们为建立了名义上的欧元区预算而振奋，但实际上，这无非是从欧洲稳定性机制（ESM，2015年给希腊贷款的救助基金）划拨的一笔信用额度。
en: In front of an ecstatic press corps, they hailed the decision to create a eurozone budget in name, when in reality it is nothing more than a credit line from the European Stability Mechanism (ESM, the bailout fund that gave Greece its loans in 2015).

zh: 他们还同意成立根本不现实的“雨天”基金，由成员国和堪称海外奇谈的金融交易和数字经济税融资 — — 这样的“妥协”不费默克尔一分一毫，因为荷兰和爱尔兰等国家很可能不会同意。
en: They also agreed to an insubstantial “rainy day” fund, to be financed by member states and a fictional financial transactions and digital economy tax – a “compromise” that costs Merkel nothing, given that countries like the Netherlands and Ireland are likely to torpedo it.

zh: 对于银行重组，马克龙和默克尔也在鼓吹由ESM拨款的机制。
en: As for bank recapitalization, Macron and Merkel touted an ESM-funded scheme.

zh: 但ESM的所有决定都需要德国议会批准，德国联邦议院将拥有（比如）意大利银行重组方案的否决权。
en: But with all ESM decisions subject to German parliamentary approval, the German Bundestag would have veto power over the recapitalization of, say, an Italian bank.

zh: 意大利新政府不可能接受这一情况。
en: Italy’s new government is unlikely to buy into this.

zh: 银行家在填补账上的不良贷款时，会扩大新贷款让没有偿债能力的借款人装作能够维持原来的贷款。
en: When bankers try to cover up bad loans on their books, they extend new loans to enable their insolvent borrowers to pretend to be servicing the original loan.

zh: 当新贷款用尽时，客户会被允许暂停偿付几年，利息照常累计。
en: When the new loan is exhausted, the client is allowed to suspend repayment for a few years, with interest accumulating.

zh: 这使得它们的资产（贷款）的净现值保持恒定，而推后了清算日（当它们不得不向监管者承认贷款无力填补之时 ） 。
en: This keeps the net present value of their asset (the loan) constant while postponing the day of reckoning (when they have to confess to their regulator that the loan is unrecoverable).

zh: 2010年以来，希腊债权人一直在“练习”这一扩展-假装策略，仿佛要在奥运会上参加这场比赛。
en: Since 2010, Greece’s creditors have been practicing this extend-and-pretend strategy as though they were training for an Olympic event.

zh: 欧元集团并没有采取勇敢有效的“剃头 ” （ haircut ） ， 或者温和的GDP指数化方案，其最近的决定 — — 号称“希腊危机的结束 ” — —实则是对这一犬儒做法的崇拜。
en: Instead of a courageous and therapeutic haircut, or the moderate GDP-indexing solution, the Eurogroup’s recent decision, proclaimed as the “end of the Greek debt crisis” boiled down to the apotheosis of this cynical practice.

zh: 从技术上讲，新债务协议的核心支柱是总额966亿欧元将从2023年开始到期的债务暂停偿付长达十年。
en: Technically speaking, the central pillar of the new debt agreement is a decade-long postponement of payments totaling €96.6 billion ($112.5 billion) that were due to begin in 2023.

zh: 因此，希腊获得的条件是在2033年都不必承担偿付压力，换取其继续无限期实施严厉的紧缩（2022年前实现初级预算盈余达到国民收入的3.5 % ， 2023—2060年达到2.2 % ） 、在2033—2060年间进行根本不可能实现的偿付（大约相当于希腊税收收入的60 % ） ，以及到2060年高达230%以上的债务-国民收入比（如果下一场全球衰退导致该计划过于宏达的增长目标无法实现的话。 这几乎是必然 ） 。
en: The Greek state has thus been offered easy repayments until 2033 in exchange for continuing harsh austerity ad infinitum (a primary budget surplus target of 3.5% of national income until 2022, and 2.2% during 2023-2060); impossible annual debt repayments from 2033 to 2060 (around 60% of the state’s tax revenues); and a debt-to-national income ratio above 230% by 2060 if the next global recession puts the plan’s over-ambitious growth targets out of reach, as it surely will.

zh: 只要你对欧元集团最近达成的希腊公共债务协议进行可观评估，就会发现它将让希腊永远呢沦为债奴。
en: Any objective assessment of the Eurogroup’s recent deal on Greek public debt would conclude that it condemns Greece to permanent debt bondage.

zh: 如果你以公正的态度审视默克尔-马克龙的梅瑟堡峰会，就会发现欧元区仍和五年前一样具有宏观经济不可持续性。
en: And an impartial observer of the Merkel-Macron Meseberg Summit would conclude that the eurozone remains as macroeconomically unsustainable as it was five years ago.

zh: 但欧洲建制派早已忘了民族主义国际（Nationalist International）准备要吞噬欧盟，反而在撑大它的胃口。
en: And yet Europe’s establishment, oblivious to the Nationalist International preparing to devour the EU, is serving it appetizers.

zh: 产业战略的回归
en: The Return of Industrial Strategy

zh: 伦敦—产业政策正在许多发达经济体卷土重来。
en: LONDON – Industrial policy is making a comeback in many advanced economies.

zh: 产业政策在奔腾的20世纪80年代被视为此前十年停滞的罪魁，因而惨遭抛弃，如今，它被日益视为阻止工作阶级选民倒向右翼民粹主义政党的方法。
en: Dismissed out of hand in the go-go 1980s as a contributor to the previous decade’s stagnation, it is increasingly viewed as a means to stem working-class voters’ defection to right-wing populist parties.

zh: 但制定现代而与有效的产业政策绝非易事。
en: But developing a modern and effective industrial strategy will be no easy feat.

zh: 欧盟从2014年以来一直在试图为解决这个问题制定一个一致框架。 当时它发布了一份关于产业政策利弊的分析。
en: The European Union has been trying to define a consistent framework for addressing the topic since 2014, when it published an analysis of industrial policy’s advantages and disadvantages.

zh: 英国更进一步，在1月发布了关于制定产业战略的绿皮书。
en: The United Kingdom is further along, having released in January a green paper on building an industrial strategy.

zh: 美国总统特朗普也专注于产业政策，尽管他的产业政策包括了大量国家干预和保护主义措施。
en: US President Donald Trump has also focused on industrial policy, though his version would presumably entail substantial state intervention and protectionist measures.

zh: 特朗普的退步版产业政策仍然只是提纲挈领，但缺点已经暴露无遗。
en: Trump’s regressive vision, despite remaining short on details, already seems defective.

zh: 欧洲的产业战略方针倒是令人有些憧憬，原因之一是其中可能避开了过去强调“遴选赢家”的广泛干预。
en: But Europe’s approaches to industrial strategy show some promise, not least because they are likely to eschew the broad interventions of the past that emphasized “picking winners.”

zh: 比如，在英国，预计政府将把注意力集中在“定向干预 ” ， 旨在创造积极的激励、纠正市场失灵，以及解决社会、地区和部门失衡。
en: In the United Kingdom, for example, the government expects to focus instead on “targeted interventions” designed to create positive incentives, correct market failures, and address social, geographical, and sectoral imbalances.

zh: 显然，政治领导人已经从历史中汲取了一些重要教训。
en: Clearly, political leaders have learned some important lessons from history.

zh: 但仍然存在一些严重的问题。
en: But serious problems remain.

zh: 欧洲各国政府似乎认为它们可以实施权宜政策强化当下的“看不见的手 ” ， 并且这些政策最终能够完美契合于一套一致的框架。
en: Europe’s governments seem to think that they can implement ad hoc policies that strengthen their “invisible hand” today, and that those policies will somehow end up fitting neatly into a coherent framework.

zh: 这过于乐观了。
en: That seems optimistic, at best.

zh: 英国的新计划甚至没有规定战略的主要目标。
en: The UK’s new plan does not even pinpoint the strategy’s main objective.

zh: 它是为了在英国不再是欧洲单一市场和关税联盟的一部分时支撑其GDP增长吗？
en: Is it to buttress GDP growth when the UK is no longer part of the European single market and customs union?

zh: 还是为了提振英国经济的潜在产出（即长期趋势增长 ） ？
en: Or is it to boost the British economy’s potential output (that is, to increase long-term trend growth)?

zh: 政府的计划中这两个目标都有提及，但并没有论述它们之间如何平衡。
en: The government’s plan mentions both objectives, but says little about how they will be balanced.

zh: 英国领导人必须认识到，当产业战略是为了提振退欧后的增长，那么也许需要在欧盟关税提高的前提下制定。 欧盟将仍然是英国的主要市场。
en: UK leaders must recognize that, where the strategy is aimed at strengthening post-Brexit growth, it will probably have to be set in the context of higher tariffs vis-à-vis the EU, which would remain Britain’s main market.

zh: 这一战略还必须考虑英国工业的全球竞争力，并对英国的新的独立贸易政策形成补充。
en: Such a strategy would also have to take into account the global competitiveness of British industry, and complement the country’s new independent trade policy.

zh: 与此同时，英国政府决不可过度沉溺于在英国退欧后捍卫短期增长和就业，而忽视了提振长期增长潜力的需要。
en: At the same time, the British government must not get so caught up in preserving short-term growth and employment amid Brexit that it loses sight of the need to boost long-term growth potential.

zh: 但是，令人担心的是，英国的战略方案可能过于强调约束政府自身参与经济。
en: Worryingly, however, the proposed strategy may over-emphasize ring-fencing the government’s own involvement in the economy.

zh: 政府回避遴选赢家是正确的，但它们必须在其他方面保持活跃。
en: While governments are right to shy away from picking winners, they must remain active in other ways.

zh: 具体而言，它们必须分析哪些部门和产业最有可能有利于长期增长，并帮助它们取得成功 — — 甚至可以不惜承担真正的金融风险。
en: Specifically, they must analyze which sectors and industries are more likely to contribute to long-term growth, and help to enable their success – potentially even in ways that imply real financial risks.

zh: 比如，政府应该考虑提供正外部性 — — 如缩短通讯时间，这将带来经济和社会收益 — — 以及对私人部门来说规模过大、风险过高的大规模基础设施投资。
en: For example, governments should consider large infrastructure investments that have positive externalities – say, shorter commuting times, with their economic and social benefits – and that may be too large or too risky for the private sector.

zh: 当政府能够比私人部门获得更广泛的信息，从而增强优化投资的能力时，这一点尤其重要。
en: This is particularly relevant where the government has access to a wider range of information than the private sector, strengthening its ability to optimize its investments.

zh: 当前的欧洲产业政策讨论中的另一个被忽略的要素是明确的时间线。
en: Another component that is missing from current discussion of industrial policy in Europe is a clear timeline.

zh: 现实是，今天制定的战略可能需要一代人时间才能收获效果（如教育改革 ） 。
en: The reality is that a strategy developed today could take a generation to deliver results (think education reform).

zh: 因此，有效的产业战略不但要有总体时间框架，还要制定重要的里程碑。
en: So an effective industrial strategy must establish not only an overall timeframe, but also important milestones along the way.

zh: 在英国的例子中，这些里成本应该包括与英国退欧过程有关的较为短期的目标和结果。
en: In the UK’s case, those milestones should include shorter-term goals and outcomes associated with the Brexit process.

zh: 毕竟，有效的现代产业战略需要仔细考虑经济在未来几年中所需要的资产和资源，包括人力资本。
en: After all, an effective modern industrial strategy requires a careful accounting of the assets and resources, including human capital, that the economy will need in the coming years.

zh: 对英国来说，这样的考量必须放在英国退欧的大环境中进行。
en: For the UK, such an accounting cannot be decoupled from Brexit.

zh: 特别是，英国领导人必须认识到哪些资源与欧洲单一市场有关，如何替代它们，以及这一过程要持续多久。
en: In particular, UK leaders must identify which resources are tied to Europe’s single market, how they can be replaced, and how long that process will take.

zh: 有效的产业战略的最后一个关键要素是其所依赖的制度框架。
en: The final critical element of an effective industrial strategy is the institutional framework on which it depends.

zh: 英国政府认识到，建立正确的制度来解决地区差异非常重要。
en: The UK government acknowledges the importance of creating the right institutions to address regional disparities.

zh: 但制度必须更进一步，将产业和地区串联起来以确保透明度和问责，特别是在私人和公共部门合作方面。
en: But institutions must go beyond linking up sectors and regions to ensure transparency and accountability, especially in the relationship between the private and public sectors.

zh: 英国领导人应该时刻铭记这一点，在此基础上判断哪些必要的制度已经建立，那些制度需要更新。
en: With that in mind, British leaders should reflect on which of the necessary institutions are already in place and which need upgrading.

zh: 一个要点是必须遏制冲动，不能对弱势或低效的制度一关了之，而应该考虑如何改革和强化它们。
en: It is important to resist the urge simply to shut down weak or inefficient institutions, and to consider, instead, how they can be reformed and strengthened.

zh: 英国和欧洲经济体将迎来巨大的变化。
en: Major changes are coming to the British and European economies.

zh: 领导人必须从现在开始行动，制定全面的战略愿景以应对未来挑战。
en: Leaders must act now to define a comprehensive strategic vision that will enable them to cope with the challenges ahead.

zh: 这一愿景必须果断且宏大。
en: That vision must be bold and ambitious.

zh: 最重要的是，这一愿景应该得到共享。
en: Above all, it must be shared.

zh: 在极化日益严重的时期，这很有可能才是最困难的部分。
en: At a time of intensifying polarization, that may well be the hardest part.

zh: 欧洲的倒退
en: Europe in Reverse

zh: 柏林-美国富有传奇色彩的投资家沃伦·巴菲特曾经说过 ， “ 只有当潮水退去的时候，你才知道谁一直在裸泳。
en: BERLIN – The legendary American investor Warren Buffet once said, “It’s when the tide goes out that you find out who has been swimming naked.”

zh: ”这一睿智的说法指的是公司在发生经济危机时的情况,但它同样也适用于指国家和经济体。
en: That particular piece of wisdom referred to the situation of companies in an economic crisis. But it can also be applied to countries and economies.

zh: 在欧洲，情况越来越令人担心，因为全球经济危机正在把欧盟的缺点和局限性无情地暴露出来。
en: In Europe, the situation is cause for growing concern, because the global economic crisis is relentlessly laying bare the European Union’s flaws and limitations.

zh: 事实上，随着对宪法规定的条约的蔑视，欧洲丧失的最重要的东西现在是显而易见的：它丧失了它对自身和对自己的共同的前途的信念。
en: Indeed, what Europe lost, first and foremost, with the rejection of the constitutional treaty is now obvious: its faith in itself and its common future.

zh: 在这个自1929年以来发生的最严重的危机的时刻，通过巴拉克·奥巴马的当选，美国现在选择了一个真正的重新起步，已进入了重塑自身的进程。
en: Amid this worst crisis since 1929, America has opted for a truly new beginning with the election of Barack Obama, and is now in the process of reinventing itself.

zh: 而相反，欧盟成员国之间的分裂却日益加深。
en: By contrast, each passing day seems to drive EU members further apart.

zh: 欧盟不但不进行自我重塑，反而在危机和其自身内部矛盾的压力下，有回到国家利己主义和保护主义的老路上去的危险。
en: Rather than reinventing itself, Europe, under the pressure of the crisis and its own internal contradictions, threatens to revert to the national egoism and protectionism of the past.

zh: 当今的欧洲有着统一的货币和欧洲央行（ ECB ） ， 这已被证明是金融危机期间维护货币稳定的利器。
en: Europe today has a common currency and the European Central Bank (ECB), which have proven to be bulwarks in defending monetary stability during the financial crisis.

zh: 任何对这两个机构的作用的削弱，都会对欧洲的共同利益造成严重损害。
en: Any weakening of these two institutions would cause severe damage to common European interests.

zh: 但是，过去几个月里欧盟各成员国政府的行为令人非常怀疑他们是否也这么认为。
en: But EU member governments’ behavior during the past few months raises grave doubts about whether they see things this way.

zh: 这场危机持续的时间越长，越变得明显的是，仅靠统一的货币和欧洲央行是不足以维护共同市场和欧洲一体化的。
en: The longer the crisis continues, the more obvious it becomes that the common currency and the ECB alone are not enough to defend the Common Market and European integration.

zh: 没有至少在欧元区成员国之间协调的共同的经济和金融政策，那么共同货币和欧盟的凝聚力-事实上，这两者本身的存在-也会陷入前所未有的危险境地。
en: Without common economic and financial policies, coordinated at least between the members of the euro zone, the cohesion of the common currency and the EU – indeed, their very existence – are in unprecedented danger.

zh: 可以肯定的是，这场危机已捆住了世界各国的手脚。
en: To be sure, the crisis has placed a stranglehold on countries worldwide.

zh: 但在欧盟和欧元区内有明显的差异和经济上的不平衡，例如，这反映在越来越多的利率冲突上。
en: But there are significant differences and economic imbalances within the EU and the euro zone, reflected, for example, by increasingly divergent interest rates.

zh: 人们对意大利、西班牙、爱尔兰、葡萄牙和希腊的信心正在迅速蒸发，而北欧比较强大的经济体尽管日子也不好过，但情况相对要好一些。
en: Confidence in Italy, Spain, Ireland, Portugal, and Greece is rapidly evaporating, while the stronger economies in northern Europe are doing better, although they are struggling, too.

zh: 如果这种情况继续下去，也许马城条约标准将走到事实上的尽头，并且以国家保护主义的形式出现的工业补贴将不断抬头，欧元也将受到严重损害。
en: Should this continue, perhaps bringing a de facto end to the Maastricht criteria and rising national protectionism in the form of industrial subsidies, the euro will be seriously jeopardized.

zh: 不难想象欧元的失败将对欧盟作为一个整体意味着什么：那将是一场历史性的灾难。
en: It is easy to imagine what the euro’s failure would mean for the EU as a whole: a disaster of historic proportions.

zh: 此外，欧盟的东欧新成员国既没有经济实力也没有长期成员国那样的政治上的稳定，它们现在的情况开始急剧恶化。
en: Moreover, the new EU member states in Eastern Europe, which have neither the economic strength nor the political stability of long-term members, are now beginning to take a nosedive.

zh: 鉴于一些欧元区国家如奥地利也不能幸免，这场危机也将直接影响到欧元区。
en: Given the exposure of some euro-zone states such as Austria, this crisis will also affect the euro area directly.

zh: 因此，等待和观望是个错误的战略。
en: To wait and see is, therefore, the wrong strategy.

zh: 我们没有理由认为目前的全球经济危机已经走出谷底。
en: There is no reason to believe that the current global economic crisis has bottomed out.

zh: 因此，假设它进一步恶化，那么欧洲将很快面临严峻选择：要么是较富裕和稳定的经济体-首先是欧洲最大的经济体德国-利用其更丰富的财政资源来帮助较弱的欧元区中的其它经济体;要么是欧元将受到威胁，从而威胁到整个欧洲一体化。
en: So, assuming that it intensifies further, Europe will rapidly face a grim alternative: either the richer and more stable economies in the North – first and foremost Europe’s largest economy, Germany – will use their greater financial resources to help the weaker euro-zone economies, or the euro will be endangered, and with it the whole project of European integration.

zh: 那么为什么不迅速推出新的证券形式，如欧元债券，或建立一个类似于国际货币基金组织的欧盟机制呢？
en: Why not, then, quickly introduce new instruments such as Eurobonds, or create an EU mechanism comparable to the IMF?

zh: 它们肯定都要花昂贵的代价的-尤其是对德国-也因此根本不会受选民的支持，但其它的选项会更昂贵，实际上，这些不会成为被认真加以考虑的政治选项。
en: Each would certainly be costly – particularly for Germany – and therefore would be anything but popular, but the alternatives are much costlier; indeed, they are not serious political options.

zh: 在体制上，没有办法绕过“欧洲经济政府”或“强化了的经济协调 ” （ 或随你怎么称呼都可以）之路 ，非正式地这会成为可能，也因此不会带来任何条约上的变化。
en: Institutionally, there is no way around a “European economic government” or “enhanced economic coordination” (or whatever you want to call it), which in fact would be possible informally and thus without any treaty change.

zh: 不幸的是，现在已经很清楚，法德这个对欧盟行动一致起至关重要作用的引擎，暂时熄火了。
en: Unfortunately, it has become clear that the Franco-German engine, which is crucial to the EU acting in unison, is momentarily blocked.

zh: 他们在公开言论中认为法国和德国有许多共通之处，但事实上却完全不是这样。
en: Their rhetoric suggests that France and Germany have a great deal in common, but the facts speak a completely different language.

zh: 在几乎所有的管理欧盟危机的战略层面，德国和法国��在互相阻碍对方-虽然具有讽刺意味的是它们几乎都在做同样的事情。
en: In nearly all strategic aspects of EU crisis management, Germany and France are blocking each other – although ironically, both are doing virtually the same thing.

zh: 他们首先想到的是自己而不是欧洲，因此，这里毫无领袖作风可言。
en: They are thinking first and foremost of themselves, not of Europe, which is thus effectively without leadership.

zh: 欧盟是和制度化的妥协，过去是，现在也是，而且处在全球经济危机的时刻，将来也必须继续这样。
en: The EU was and is institutionalized compromise, and must remain so now, in the midst of a global economic crisis.

zh: 如果德国和法国不迅速地解决他们的分歧并找到针对危机的共同战略，他们将损害到自身和整个欧洲。
en: If Germany and France don’t quickly resolve their differences and find a joint strategic answer to the crisis, they will damage themselves and Europe as a whole.

zh: 绝不能忘记的是，欧盟是一个旨在为促进相互间的经济进步而设计的。
en: It must never be forgotten that the EU is a project designed for mutual economic progress.

zh: 如果这个经济上的纽带消失了，国家利益将重新迅猛抬头并撕裂整个欧盟。
en: If this economic bond disappears, national interests will reassert themselves and rip the project apart.

zh: 今天的欧洲并不缺乏经济实力，缺乏的是采取一致行动的政治意愿。
en: Europe today does not lack economic strength, but rather the political will to act in unison.

zh: 这是德国和法国必须带头的方面。
en: Here is where Germany and France must lead the way.

zh: 欧洲迷途
en: Europe Has Lost its Way

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 欧洲针对其战略挑战的应对 — — 俄罗斯对乌克兰的侵略，逃离暴力冲突的中东难民，失控的北非局势 — — 都让人觉得它的领导人像个无头苍蝇。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Europe’s response to the strategic challenges it is facing – Russian aggression in Ukraine, refugees fleeing violence in the Middle East, disorder in North Africa – leaves the impression that its leaders have no idea what to do.

zh: 实际上这些人可能并非如此 — — 这是一个需要开诚布公而非刻意掩盖的事实。
en: And indeed, they may not – a reality that needs to be acknowledged, not papered over.

zh: 简单地说，欧盟的经济停滞限制了其对外部压力的回应，内部危机又使欧盟领导人缺乏腾挪的空间。
en: Simply put, the European Union’s stagnant economy is conditioning its response to the external pressures it confronts; internal crisis has left EU leaders little room for maneuver.

zh: 幸运的是，如果能唤起足够的智慧和政治意愿，欧洲其实有办法去解决这一危机。
en: Fortunately, Europe has the means to address this crisis, if it can summon the wisdom and the political will.

zh: 欧盟问题的根源在于其对2008年全球金融危机的应对：两年的大规模财政刺激计划。
en: The origins of the EU’s problems lie in its response to the 2008 global financial crisis: two years of large-scale fiscal stimulus.

zh: 这不仅没有带来多大的增长，还导致了严重的公共债务。
en: While this did little for growth, it resulted in crippling public debt.

zh: 七年后，欧盟的人均产出甚至还低于危机爆发时的水平。
en: Seven years later, EU output per person is no higher than it was at the start of the crisis.

zh: 同时公共债务规模飙升，相当于GDP总量的87 % ， 导致留给政策调整和创新的空间极为有限。
en: Meanwhile, average public debt has soared to 87% of GDP, leaving little space for policy flexibility or innovation.

zh: 事后看来，很显然应该采取另一种正确的策略的。
en: In hindsight, it is all too obvious what should have been done.

zh: 希腊，作为财政刺激方案力度最大的国家，受到经济伤害也最大。
en: Greece, which carried out the biggest fiscal stimulus, is the country whose economy has suffered the most damage.

zh: 希腊继续萧条，而像拉脱维亚、立陶宛、爱沙尼亚等几个早期大张旗鼓地推动财政调整为经济松绑的国家，则正在享受强劲增长。
en: Its depression continues, whereas countries like Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia, which carried out early, radical fiscal adjustments and liberalized their economies, are enjoying strong growth.

zh: 此外，欧洲缓慢的决策过程也加深了希腊的麻烦。
en: Furthermore, the slow pace of European decision-making has compounded Greece’s troubles.

zh: 当谈到经济政策时，一个快速的、错误的决定通常是比无所作为要好。
en: When it comes to economic policy, a fast, faulty decision is often better than inaction.

zh: 与其迅速地解决希腊金融危机，欧盟领导人却坐视它在其他议题之间拖拉了五年之久。
en: Instead of resolving the Greek financial crisis quickly, EU leaders allowed it to crowd out discussion of other issues for five long years.

zh: 期间希腊只得蹒跚前行，从未采取过任何有助于恢复信心的决定性措施。
en: Meanwhile, Greece limped along, never taking the decisive measures that might have restored confidence.

zh: 由于聚焦于宏观经济，欧盟无暇采取那些让经济回到正轨的措施：开放市场，削减开支(而非增税 ) ， 而且最重要的是，进一步发展最大的资产：欧洲单一市场。
en: With its attention focused on macroeconomics, the EU neglected to take the measures that would have put economic growth back on track: freeing up markets, cutting spending (rather than raising taxes), and, above all, further developing its greatest asset, the single European market.

zh: 意大利经济学家阿尔伯托·阿里斯纳（Alberto Alesina）和弗兰塞斯科·吉雅瓦兹（Francesco Giavazz）在差不多十年前就指出 ， “ 没有严肃、深入、全面的改革，欧洲将不可避免地衰退，无论在经济上还是政治上都一样。 ” ， 但一切至今都没什么改变。
en: Little has changed since Italian economists Alberto Alesina and Francesco Giavazzi noted, nearly a decade ago, that, “Without serious, deep, and comprehensive reforms, Europe will inexorably decline, both economically and politically.”

zh: 他们警告说“如果缺乏深刻的变革，欧洲在20到30年后占全球产出的比例将明显低于现今，而或许更重要的，是其政治影响力将大大削弱。 ”
en: They warned that, “Absent profound change, in 20 or 30 years the share of Europe [in world output] will be significantly lower than it is today, and, perhaps more important, its political influence will be much trimmed.”

zh: 事实上，世界银行的一份报告对欧洲2012年的增长情况总结如下 ： “ 日益老迈的欧洲人正受到创新美国人和高效亚洲人的挤压。 ”
en: Indeed, a World Bank report on European growth in 2012 summed up the situation as follows: “Aging Europeans are being squeezed between innovative Americans and efficient Asians.”

zh: 欧洲表现不佳的罪魁祸首路人皆知：高税收，过多且负面的监管，缺乏关键市场以及高昂的公共支出。
en: The chief culprits for Europe’s underperformance are well known: high taxes, too many and bad regulations, the absence of key markets, and high public expenditures.

zh: 欧洲政府花那么多钱的原因只有一个：过度的社会保障。
en: And there is only one reason why European governments spend so much: excessive social protection.

zh: 世界银行指出 ， “ 西欧政府支出与GDP的比率要比美国、加拿大和日本都高出10 % ， 在社会保障支出上的差距相当于GDP的9 % 。
en: As the World Bank observed, “Western European governments spend about 10% of GDP more than the United States, Canada, and Japan. The difference in social protection spending is 9% of GDP.”

zh: 为了支撑这笔费用，就必须增加政府收入。
en: In order to fund this spending, revenues must be raised.

zh: 同时，因为难以有效计算资本所得税，欧洲转而对劳动征收极高税率。
en: And, because it is difficult to tax capital efficiently, Europe has imposed exorbitant levies on labor.

zh: 整个欧洲大陆，尤其南欧，税收和严苛的劳动力市场使得失业率居高不下，占劳动力总量的11 % ， 也因此阻碍了欧洲人对教育的投资。
en: Across the continent, but especially in southern Europe, taxes and strict labor-market regulations keep unemployment high, at 11% of the labor force, and dissuade Europeans from investing in their education.

zh: 自然后果是就业过低，高等教育投资过低，创新过少，伴随着生产力的极低增长。
en: The natural consequences are too little employment, too little investment in sophisticated education, too little innovation, and minimal increases in productivity.

zh: 最引人注目的是欧洲在高科技发展和创新背景下的衰落。
en: Most striking is European backwardness in high-tech development and innovation.

zh: 从各个方面来讲，欧洲大部分地区看起来可怜的。
en: By almost any measure, most of Europe looks pitiable.

zh: 根据上海名单和《泰晤士报高等教育增刊》的排名, 全球最好的50所大学中，约有30所在美国，6~7所在英国，只有少数是位于欧洲大陆。
en: Of the 50 best universities in the world, according to the Shanghai list and the Times Higher Education Supplement list, some 30 are American, six or seven are British, and only a handful are to be found in continental Europe.

zh: 北欧六个国家可在研发支出和专利授予方面与美国比肩，而欧洲南部和东部则远远落后。
en: A half-dozen northern European countries can compete with the US when it comes to research and development spending and patents granted, but the south and east of Europe lag far behind.

zh: 与此同时，尽管服务业约占在大多数欧盟国家GDP的70 % ， 但欧盟尚未开放商务服务和数字贸易市场 — — 这两者正是美国经济繁荣的动力。
en: Meanwhile, the EU has yet to open its markets for business services and digital trade, on which the American economy thrives, even though services account for about 70% of GDP in most EU countries.

zh: 2006年，欧盟委员会发布一项关于服务贸易自由化的指令，但主要国家 — — 尤其是德国 — — 拒绝执行。
en: In 2006, the European Commission issued a directive on the liberalization of trade in services, but major countries – particularly Germany – have refused to implement it.

zh: 缺乏服务和数字市场在损害了欧洲现代经济的发展，可见美国巨头苹果、亚马逊和谷歌在高科技行业的统治地位并非偶然。
en: The absence of services and digital markets harms the development of a modern economy in Europe. It is not by chance that American giants like Apple, Amazon, and Google rule the world of high-tech.

zh: 欧洲的问题是完全可以避免的，正如过度的社会转移支付并不应该是欧洲特色那样。
en: There is nothing inevitable about Europe’s malaise, just as there is nothing quintessentially European about having excessive social transfers.

zh: 一些认真执政的欧洲国家政府 — — 从爱尔兰到波兰 — — 都已成功地解决了这个问题。
en: Serious European governments – from Ireland to Poland – have successfully addressed the problem.

zh: 欧盟其它地区不仅应该效仿；也应该减少收入和工资税并开放劳动力市场。
en: The rest of the EU should not only follow suit; they should also cut income and payroll taxes and liberalize their labor markets.

zh: 根本性地经济改革通常只在严重的危机后施行，就像在1970年代末的英国，1990年代早期的瑞典和芬兰，1989年共产主义崩溃后的东欧。
en: Fundamental economic reforms are usually implemented only after a severe crisis, as was the case in Britain in the late 1970s, in Sweden and Finland in the early 1990s, and in Eastern Europe after the collapse of communism in 1989.

zh: 欧盟已经浪费了2008年全球金融危机和随后的欧元危机所带来的机会。
en: The EU has wasted the opportunities afforded by the 2008 global financial crisis and the subsequent euro crisis.

zh: 相比通过艰难的改变来实现强劲复苏，欧洲的政策制定者却因为增加支出和债务而拖累了经济。
en: Rather than making the difficult changes that would enable strong recovery, Europe’s policymakers have weighed down the economy with more spending and debt.

zh: 除非意识到自身的错误，开始实施经济所需的改革，否则欧洲只能继续徘徊不进。
en: The EU will continue to flounder until it recognizes its mistakes and begins to carry out the reforms its economy needs.

zh: 也只有让欧洲大陆回归增长之路，才能让欧洲领导人腾出手来，应对当前所面对的外部挑战。
en: Only by putting the continent firmly back on the path of growth will Europe’s leaders be able to address the external challenges they now confront.

zh: 切勿把欧洲当成美国
en: Europe is Not the United States

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 在一个国情千差万别的国家集团中推行单一货币必将引发某些负面后果，而欧洲目前正为此焦头烂额。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Europe is now struggling with the inevitable adverse consequences of imposing a single currency on a very heterogeneous collection of countries.

zh: 但希腊的预算危机以及意大利、西班牙两国的破产风险只不过是单一货币所导致的其中一部分问题而已。
en: But the budget crisis in Greece and the risk of insolvency in Italy and Spain are just part of the problem caused by the single currency.

zh: 欧洲各大银行的脆弱性，高失业率以及欧洲各国之间的巨额贸易不平衡（德国拥有2000亿欧元经常账户盈余，相反其他欧元区国家合共存在3000亿欧元的经常账户亏损）也是因为欧元的推行而导致的。
en: The fragility of the major European banks, high unemployment rates, and the large intra-European trade imbalance (Germany’s $200 billion current-account surplus versus the combined $300 billion current-account deficit in the rest of the eurozone) also reflect the use of the euro.

zh: 经济学家曾经警告一个全欧洲通用的单一货币将造成严重问题，但那些坚持在1999年启动欧元的欧洲政治家却忽略了这一点。
en: European politicians who insisted on introducing the euro in 1999 ignored the warnings of economists who predicted that a single currency for all of Europe would create serious problems.

zh: 欧元的鼓吹者们把注意力放在了欧洲政治整合的目标之上，并将单一货币视为培养政治认同感的其中一环。
en: The euro’s advocates were focused on the goal of European political integration, and saw the single currency as part of the process of creating a sense of political community in Europe.

zh: 他们用“一个市场，一种货币”这样的口号来发动群众，声称只有依靠一个单一货币才能最终建成欧盟自由贸易区。
en: They rallied popular support with the slogan “One Market, One Money,” arguing that the free-trade area created by the European Union would succeed only with a single currency.

zh: 然而历史和经济学逻辑都无法支撑上述观点。
en: Neither history nor economic logic supported that view.

zh: 事实上，尽管27个欧盟成员国中只有17个使用欧元，但欧盟贸易依旧运作良好。
en: Indeed, EU trade functions well, despite the fact that only 17 of the Union’s 27 members use the euro.

zh: 但对欧洲官员和其他为欧元辩护者来说，他们的核心论据是既然一个单一货币能在美国通行无阻，那么在欧洲也应该行的通。
en: But the key argument made by European officials and other defenders of the euro has been that, because a single currency works well in the United States, it should also work well in Europe.

zh: 毕竟欧美双方都是大型洲际经济体，内部也参次不齐。
en: After all, both are large, continental, and diverse economies.

zh: 但这个论据却忽视了美欧之间的三个重要差别。
en: But that argument overlooks three important differences between the US and Europe.

zh: 首先，美国基本上是一个单一劳动力市场，劳动者可以从失业率不断上升的区域向职位想对充裕的地区流动。
en: First, the US is effectively a single labor market, with workers moving from areas of high and rising unemployment to places where jobs are more plentiful.

zh: 而在欧洲，各国劳动力市场实际上被语言，文化，宗教，欧盟成员国资格和社保系统等各类障碍割裂开来。
en: In Europe, national labor markets are effectively separated by barriers of language, culture, religion, union membership, and social-insurance systems.

zh: 虽然某些欧洲劳动者确实能在各国间迁徙，但由于缺乏美国劳动者所拥有的高度流动性，欧洲的总体失业率只有在高失业率国家实行宽松货币政策之后才能有所下降，但这条路已经被单一货币堵死了。
en: To be sure, some workers in Europe do migrate. In the absence of the high degree of mobility seen in the US, however, overall unemployment can be lowered only if high-unemployment countries can ease monetary policy, an option precluded by the single currency.

zh: 第二个重要差别则是美国拥有一个中央财政系统。
en: A second important difference is that the US has a centralized fiscal system.

zh: 个人和组织把大部分税款交给了位于华盛顿的联邦政府，而非所在地（州）当局。
en: Individuals and businesses pay the majority of their taxes to the federal government in Washington, rather than to their state (or local) authorities.

zh: 因此当一个州的经济活动落后于其他州的时候，该州的个人和组织向联邦政府缴交的税款也会相应减少，同时来自联邦政府的资助额（失业津贴以及其他转移支付项目）也会相应增加。
en: When a US state’s economic activity slows relative to the rest of the country, the taxes that its individuals and businesses pay to the federal government decline, and the funds that it receives from the federal government (for unemployment benefits and other transfer programs) increase.

zh: 大体上看，马萨诸塞州或者俄亥俄州每出现1美元的GDP下降，所引发的税率变更和转移支付就将冲抵其中40美分，也因此起到有效的财政刺激作用。
en: Roughly speaking, each dollar of GDP decline in a state like Massachusetts or Ohio triggers changes in taxes and transfers that offset about 40 cents of that drop, providing a substantial fiscal stimulus.

zh: 而欧洲则不存在类似的抵消行为，因为纳税人上缴的税款（以及接受的转移支付）基本上全部针对各国政府。
en: There is no comparable offset in Europe, where taxes are almost exclusively paid to, and transfers received from, national governments.

zh: 欧盟《马斯特里赫特条约》特别保留了成员国收税以及进行转移支付的权力，而这也反映出欧洲各国并不愿像美国各州那样互相进行转移支付。
en: The EU’s Maastricht Treaty specifically reserves this tax-and-transfer authority to the member states, a reflection of Europeans’ unwillingness to transfer funds to other countries’ people in the way that Americans are willing to do among people in different states.

zh: 第三个重要区别是美国各州的宪法都规定要平衡每年的预算。
en: The third important difference is that all US states are required by their constitutions to balance their annual operating budgets.

zh: 在年景好的时候设立“纾困基金”以备衰退的同时，各州的“一般责任（general obligation ） ” 借贷仅限于修建公路或者学校项目。
en: While “rainy day” funds that accumulate in boom years are used to deal with temporary revenue shortfalls, the states’ “general obligation” borrowing is limited to capital projects like roads and schools.

zh: 即便是加利福尼亚这样看似挥霍无度的州，其当前年度预算赤字只是GDP的1 % ， 一般责任债务也仅相当于GDP的4 % 。
en: Even a state like California, seen by many as a poster child for fiscal profligacy, now has an annual budget deficit of just 1% of its GDP and a general obligation debt of just 4% of GDP.

zh: 这些在州层面的预算赤字限制政策正是美国各州无法印钱来填补赤字空缺的逻辑结果。
en: These limits on state-level budget deficits are a logical implication of the fact that US states cannot create money to fill fiscal gaps.

zh: 这些宪法规定防止了各州出现欧元区那样的赤字和借贷问题，而资本市场也忽略了各单一欧洲国家缺乏货币独立性的事实。
en: These constitutional rules prevent the kind of deficit and debt problems that have beset the eurozone, where capital markets ignored individual countries’ lack of monetary independence.

zh: 即使欧元区能进化成为一个更加明确的政治联盟，也无法发展出美国经济的上述特质。
en: None of these features of the US economy would develop in Europe even if the eurozone evolved into a more explicitly political union.

zh: 尽管德国以及其他各方依然大力鼓吹政治联盟的形式，它也无法实现一个美国式的中央税收系统，因为这会令德国纳税人承担更多资助其他国家政府项目的压力。
en: Although the form of political union advocated by Germany and others remains vague, it would not involve centralized revenue collection, as in the US, because that would place a greater burden on German taxpayers to finance government programs in other countries.

zh: 而这种政治联盟也无法提高欧元区内的劳动者流动性，更无法解决共同货币政策对经济循环状况各不相同的国家所带来的问题，同时也不能改善竞争力的国家的贸易状况，因为它们无法降低自身的货币汇率。
en: Nor would political union enhance labor mobility within the eurozone, overcome the problems caused by imposing a common monetary policy on countries with different cyclical conditions, or improve the trade performance of countries that cannot devalue their exchange rates to regain competitiveness.

zh: 或许加强欧元区政治联盟的最有效方法就是授予德国控制其他国家预算并修订相关征税和支出政策的权力。
en: The most likely effect of strengthening political union in the eurozone would be to give Germany the power to control the other members’ budgets and prescribe changes in their taxes and spending.

zh: 但这种主权的正式让渡只能增加德国和其他欧盟国家之间业已存在的紧张和冲突。
en: This formal transfer of sovereignty would only increase the tensions and conflicts that already exist between Germany and other EU countries.

zh: 巴勒斯坦的欧洲角色？
en: A European Role in Palestine?

zh: 伦敦—如今，国际社会对中东的关注难免集中于伊斯兰国在叙利亚和伊拉克的军事扩张、也门和利比亚的国家失败、伊斯兰极端分子在各地的活动，以及完成遏制伊朗核野心的协议的努力。
