en: LONDON – The international community’s attention in the Middle East nowadays is inevitably focused on the Islamic State’s military advances in Syria and Iraq, the failed states of Yemen and Libya, the activities of Islamic extremists everywhere, and the continuing efforts to complete a deal to contain Iran’s nuclear ambitions.

zh: 与此同时，该地区最古老的纠纷 — — 一个进行了几十年仍不知所踪的和平进程 — — 依旧在巴勒斯坦和以色列不断恶化。
en: Meanwhile, the oldest dispute in the region – the subject of a decades-long peace process that moves nowhere – continues to fester and worsen in Palestine and Israel.

zh: 本月早些时候，非政府组织巴勒斯坦国际儿童保护组织（Defense for Children International – Palestine，DCIP）向联合国秘书长潘基文递交了一份报告，总结了2014年巴以冲突所造成的儿童伤亡情况。 该报告凸显出这场冲突伤害最大的后果。
en: A report submitted earlier this month by the NGO Defense for Children International – Palestine (DCIP) to UN Secretary General Ban Ki-moon on the Palestine-Israel conflict’s toll on children in 2014 underscores some of the most damaging consequences of this state of affairs.

zh: 它的发布也提醒我们为何没能在这一和平进程上取得进展。
en: Its reception also serves as a reminder of why we have made no progress toward peace.

zh: 根据DCIP报告，去年有561名儿童被杀 — — 其中557人是巴勒斯坦人，大部分死于去年夏天以色列在加沙进行的护刃行动（Operation Protective Edge ） 。
en: Last year, according to the DCIP report, 561 children were killed – 557 of them Palestinian, most as a result of Israel’s Operation Protective Edge in Gaza during the summer.

zh: 此外还有近3,000名巴勒斯坦儿童在这场为期50天的冲突中受伤，大约1,000名儿童永久致残。
en: In addition, almost 3,000 Palestinian children were injured during that 50-day conflict, with about 1,000 permanently disabled.

zh: 报告还相信列出了学校的毁坏情况、冲突后年轻人所面临的精神健康问题，以及儿童被囚禁的情况。
en: The report also details the destruction of schools, the post-conflict mental health problems faced by the young, and the imprisonment of children.

zh: 潘基文指出，2014年被杀的巴勒斯坦儿童数量比叙利亚和达尔富尔儿童死亡人数还要多，仅次于阿富汗和伊拉克儿童死亡人数。
en: According to Ban, the number of Palestinian children killed in 2014 was higher than the numbers of child deaths in Syria and Darfur, and was exceeded only in Afghanistan and Iraq.

zh: 巴勒斯坦地区被摧毁学校数量则比其他任何地方都要多。
en: The number of schools destroyed in Palestinian areas was the highest recorded anywhere.

zh: 毫不奇怪，联合国儿童和武装冲突特别代表莱拉·泽罗圭（Leila Zerrougui）建议以色列及其加沙的对手哈马斯（也是双手沾满了鲜血）应该被记上联合国严重损害儿童权利年度名单。
en: Not surprisingly, the UN’s special representative for children and armed conflict, Leila Zerrougui, recommended that Israel and its adversary in Gaza, Hamas (which has a grim record, too), should be placed on the UN’s annual list of states and groups that gravely violate children’s rights.

zh: 但美国向秘书长施压，要求将以色列剔除出该名单；潘基文同意了，并决定把哈马斯也剔除出该名单。
en: But the United States put pressure on the Secretary-General to leave Israel off the list; Ban acceded, and decided to leave Hamas off the list as well.

zh: 以色列常常在美国国会叫嚣自己是美国在中东地区最可靠的盟友，它也是联合国儿童权利公约签署国。
en: Israel, frequently lauded in the US Congress as America’s most dependable ally in the region, is a signatory to the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child.

zh: 很难想象美国驻联合国大使萨曼莎·鲍尔（Samantha Power，她在人权保护方面记录优异）一心游说为以色列洗白。
en: It is difficult to imagine that US Ambassador to the UN Samantha Power, who has a fine record on human-rights protection, had her heart in lobbying to whitewash Israel.

zh: 许多欧洲人会认为，这进一步表明（如果有任何需要的话）美国将永远 — — 也是灾难性地 — — 保护以色列免于面对其行为的国际和名誉后果。
en: Many Europeans will conclude that this is further evidence (if any was needed) that the US will always – and disastrously – protect Israel from the international and reputational consequences of its actions.

zh: 但这还不够。
en: But this is not enough.

zh: 以色列和巴勒斯坦走进了血腥的死胡同，这对巴勒斯坦人来说是一场灾难，对以色列的前景来说也日益危险。
en: Israel and Palestine are trapped in a bloody cul-de-sac, which is catastrophic for Palestinians and increasingly dangerous for Israel’s prospects.

zh: 一个由欧洲政治要人组成的小组最近指出，两国和平协议可能丧失，以色列将因此面临二选一：成为非犹太民主国家，或者成为犹太非民主国家。
en: As a group of eminent European politicians recently noted, a two-state peace deal could be lost, leaving Israel to face a stark choice: become a non-Jewish democracy or a Jewish non-democracy.

zh: 5月，这个包括了多位前总统、首相、外交部长、欧盟委员和高级外交官的小组向欧盟领导人提出了一系列建议。
en: This group, which included former presidents, prime ministers, foreign ministers, European Union commissioners and senior diplomats, sent a set of proposals to EU leaders in May.

zh: 该小组指出，欧洲应该弥补美国从外交进程中的撤退（这一点已经显而易见 ） ， 承担起重振和平前景的主要作用。
en: Europe, according to the group, should offset America’s evident withdrawal from the diplomatic process and play a serious role in reviving prospects for peace.

zh: 这些建议的核心是欧盟支持这样的联合国安理会协议 ： “ 要么（1）呼吁进行新磋商并为两国方案协议设定强制性的完成期限，要么（2）在以色列和巴勒斯坦各方之间建立更大的平等关系，包括通过承认巴勒斯坦国和大力支持巴勒斯坦加入国际条约和组织。 ”
en: At the heart of the proposals is EU support in the UN Security Council for a resolution that “either (1) calls for new negotiations and sets a mandatory deadline for the completion of an agreement to establish a two-state solution, or (2) creates a greater equivalence between the Israeli and Palestinian parties, including through recognition of a Palestinian state and strong support for Palestine accession to international treaties and organizations.”

zh: 呼吁这样一个决议反映出以色列总理内塔尼亚胡行为可憎，而他的几位部长观点极端，以至于欧洲国家开始同情巴勒斯坦的国家地位。
en: The call for such a resolution reflects the impact of Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu’s obnoxious behavior and the extremist views of several of his ministers, which have increased European countries’ sympathy for Palestinian statehood.

zh: 此外，欧盟中有越来越多的人要求强制性纠正产自以色列约旦河西岸定居点的产品的标签。
en: There is also a growing clamor in the EU to enforce the correct labeling of products made in Israel’s West Bank settlements.

zh: 这些产品根据欧盟和以色列的双边贸易协定出口到欧洲。
en: These products are exported to Europe under bilateral trade agreements between the EU and Israel.

zh: 但根据国际法，约旦河西岸定居点并不是以色列的一部分。
en: But the settlements are not part of Israel under international law.

zh: 迟早会有人就此将欧盟国家告上法庭。
en: Sooner or later, someone will take EU countries to court over this.

zh: 以色列政府对这些提议的反应不难预测，令人压抑。
en: The response to these sorts of proposals from Israel’s government has been depressingly predictable.

zh: 首先，以色列发言人指责欧洲人反犹 — — 这是欧洲历史上的一个可恨污点。
en: First, Israeli spokesmen accuse Europeans of anti-Semitism – that hateful blot on Europe’s history.

zh: 但将对以色列的“任性”行为和极端主义的批评与反犹相提并论真的很危险。
en: But there is a real danger in conflating criticism of Israeli intransigence and extremism with anti-Semitism.

zh: 说谴责杀害和致残加沙儿童的行为是反犹，这是对每个文明人都应该谴责的真正的反犹行为的嘲弄。
en: To say that it is anti-Semitic to condemn the killing and maiming of children in Gaza is to make a mockery of acts that really are anti-Semitic and that deserve to be condemned by every civilized person.

zh: 其次，以色列反复声明，它没有潜在的和平伙伴。
en: Second, Israel repeats its claim that it has no potential partner for peace.

zh: 事实上，以色列已陷入了深刻的否认，内塔尼亚胡在其获得成功的竞选中轻蔑地拒绝两国方案就是明证。
en: In fact, Israel is in deep denial, which was reflected in Netanyahu’s contemptuous rejection of a two-state solution in his successful re-election campaign.

zh: 事实是，凡是主宰力量与被它谴责为恐怖分子存在冲突局面，迟早都要以磋商解决问题。
en: The fact is that every situation in which a dominant power confronts those it condemns as terrorists sooner or later ends in negotiations.

zh: 在阿尔及利亚、南非和北爱尔兰，掌权者无一例外地宣布它们没有和平伙伴 — — 直到它们与它们中伤了���十年的“恐怖分子”缔结和平。
en: In Algeria, South Africa, and Northern Ireland, those in power invariably claimed that they had no partner for peace – until they made peace with the very “terrorists” they had spent decades vilifying.

zh: 阻挠谈判让暴力越来越难以结束，这意味着暴力所引起的情绪越来越难以改变。
en: To put off talking makes violence increasingly difficult to end, which means that the sentiments that violence breeds become increasingly difficult to change.

zh: 为了确保和平，以色列总有一天不得不与哈马斯以及法塔赫和PLO进行严肃对话。
en: To secure peace, Israel will one day have to talk seriously to Hamas as well as Fatah and the PLO.

zh: 没有第二条路可走。
en: There is no alternative.

zh: 在这一幕发生前，儿童 — — 其中绝大部分是巴勒斯坦儿童 — — 将继续遭受苦难。
en: Until that happens, the children – the overwhelming majority of them Palestinian –will continue to suffer.

zh: 世界其他国家还要袖手旁观多久？
en: How long will the rest of the world look the other way?

zh: 欧洲：工作得更长点
en: Europe is Working Longer

zh: 法国允许雇主增加工作时间及薪酬、废除它每周35小时工作制的决定标志着数十年的趋势出现了逆转。
en: France’s decision effectively abolishing its 35-hour workweek by allowing employers to increase working hours – and pay – marks a reversal of a decades-old trend.

zh: 在上世纪80及90年代，大部分欧洲国家削减了工作时间：德国将每周工作时间从40降为38小时，英国从40降为37小时，丹麦从39减少到37小时，法国从40减少到35小时。
en: In the 1980’s and 1990’s, most European countries reduced working hours: Germany went from more than 40 to 38 per week, the UK from 40 to 37, Denmark from 39 to 37, and France from 40 to 35.

zh: 然而今天，当欧洲人在高失业率和停滞不前的生活水平中苦苦挣扎时，他们不得不工作得更长一点以适应全球化。
en: Today, however, as Europeans struggle with high unemployment and stagnating living standards, they may have to work longer to cope with globalization.

zh: 德国最新的工资协议导致更长的工作时间，法国的行动就在德国政策变化之后。
en: The French actions follow changes in Germany, where some recent wage settlements resulted in longer working times.

zh: 两国的不同之处在于，德国的工作时间虽然增长了，但是补贴报酬却毫无增长迹象。
en: The difference between the two countries is that, in Germany, working times were increased without compensating pay increases.

zh: 西门子首当其冲，将每周工作时间从35小时提高至40小时。
en: Siemens was the forerunner, going from 35 to 40 hours per week.

zh: 巴伐利亚市政府将老年雇员的工作时间从38.5小时提高至40小时，年轻雇员的工作时间则增至42小时。
en: Bavaria’s government increased the workweek from 38.5 to 40 hours for older employees and to 42 hours for younger employees.

zh: 戴姆勒-克莱斯勒将其研究和发展中心的工作时间从35小时提高至40小时，此先河一开，其他的谈判协议纷至沓来。
en: When Daimler-Chrysler increased work hours from 35 to 40 hours in its research and development center, the dam broke and other bargaining agreements fell into line.

zh: 德国原本是出于对来自前社会主义国家的低工资竞争做出回应。
en: Germany primarily reacted to low-wage competition from ex-communist countries.

zh: 目前，2004年五月加入欧盟的十国平均工资大约是西德工资水平的七分之一，中国工资是其二十五分之一。
en: Currently, the average wage of the ten countries that joined the EU in May 2004 is about one-seventh of the West German wage level, and the Chinese wage is one twenty-fifth.

zh: 这些差距如此之大以至于某些人认为参与竞争的努力无济于事。
en: Those differences are so huge that some people consider efforts to compete futile.

zh: 但是，由于德国生产效率要高得多，增加工作时间以有效削减人力成本的做法看起来值得一试。
en: But, as productivity is much higher in Germany, an effective reduction of hourly labor costs by uncompensated increases in working hours seems worth trying.

zh: 这对欧洲其他国家而言树立了一个榜样。
en: This could be an example for other European countries.

zh: 法国的下一步可能是无薪延长工作时间。
en: The next step for France could be unpaid increases in working times.

zh: 工会反对延长工作时间的抗议建立在“劳动合成谬误”的理论之上。
en: Trade union opposition to extending working hours is based on the “lump-of-labor” theory.

zh: 根据这一观点，这样的政策毫无经济利益，因为经济学中的劳力总和是固定的。
en: According to this view, there are no economic advantages of such a policy, because the total amount of labor in the economy is fixed.

zh: 因此，工作时间延长10%只会导致就业率降低10 % 。
en: As a result, a 10% increase in working time will merely reduce employment by 10% percent.

zh: 这个观点尽管看上去颇有道理，但它是错误的。
en: Despite its seeming plausibility, this view is wrong.

zh: 同酬条件下的延长工时是使欧洲更具竞争力的有效方法，与削减工资相比，它对工人和雇主的负担都较轻。
en: Working longer for the same pay is a useful way of making Europe more competitive, and, when compared to reducing wages, it imposes a much lighter burden on workers and employees.

zh: 更长的工作时间将促进经济增长，因为如果人们工作时间更长，资本也就积累越多。
en: Working longer will boost economic growth, for if people work longer, then so does capital.

zh: 除了全天24小时轮班的地方，延长人们白天的工作时间能提高资本利用率。
en: Except for where all 24 hours of the day are filled with shift work, increasing the daily working time of people extends daily capital utilization.

zh: 因而，工作时间加长10%就像经济生产资本储备增加了10%一样。
en: Thus, a 10% increase in working time is the same as if the economy’s stock of productive capital were increased by 10%.

zh: 社会财富将有跳跃式增长，生产力将会即刻提高。
en: There is a jump in wealth and an immediate production boom.

zh: “劳动合成谬误”理论假定加长工作时间与雇佣更多的人是一回事情。
en: The lump-of-labor theory assumes that working longer and employing more people is the same thing.

zh: 但事实上，它们是不同的。
en: But they are very different.

zh: 延长工作时间可以立马做到，然而因为雇佣更多员工尤其要求新的实物投资，时间长、花费大，所以，延长工时是达到增长并获得竞争力的最理想方法。
en: Longer working time can be achieved nearly instantaneously, whereas employing more people is time consuming and expensive, as it typically requires new physical investment. Working longer is thus the ideal way to achieve growth and competitiveness.

zh: 事实上，用媒体的术语来说，延长白天的工时将造就更高的就业率，因为它能在保持劳动力成本不变的情况下提高生产效率。
en: In fact, extending daily working times will, in the medium term, also result in higher employment, because it will increase productivity while labor costs remain constant.

zh: 那些生产效率过于低下以至于与劳力成本不相称的工人现在将被解雇，因为公司将会发现，将产量水平提高到通过投入更多资本、雇佣更多工人这种方式增加工时所达到的产量水平之上，那是值得的。
en: Some workers whose productivity was too low to cover their cost will now be hired, as firms will find it worthwhile to expand output above the level resulting from the increased working time itself by investing more capital and hiring more workers.

zh: 一些人担心工作日增加所导致的资本对劳动比例降低将无法提供更多的工作岗位。
en: Some fear that extending the workday will not produce more jobs because the resulting expansion of hours worked will reduce the capital-labor ratio.

zh: 它将会降低高效工作的每小时边际生产力，抵消掉增加每小时工人人数所带来的积极影响。
en: This would lower the marginal productivity of hours worked sufficiently to offset the positive effects of increasing the number of hours per worker.

zh: 但是，再说一次，资本将会运营地更久一点。
en: But, again, capital would also work longer.

zh: 事实上，根据“资本利用率效益”资本对劳力比例不会降低，因此也不会对工作时间的边际生产力产生重要影响。
en: Because of the “capital utilization effect,” the capital-labor ratio would not, in fact, decline, and hence there would be no significant effect on the marginal productivity of hours worked.

zh: 从理论上来说，如果边缘劳工工作得更长的话，他们的生产效率更高，这无疑还会对就业率产生积极作用。
en: The theoretical effect on employment is unambiguously positive, because marginal workers will be more productive as they work longer.

zh: 会有足够的需求来吸收工作日延长所带来的附加产量吗？
en: Would there be enough demand to absorb the additional output resulting from increasing the workday?

zh: “劳动合成谬误”观点的支持者们说，不会。
en: Advocates of the lump-of-labor view say no.

zh: 但是当每个工资固���的工人生产出更多货物，利润与产量的价值增长量是相同的。
en: But as more goods are produced while the wage per worker is fixed, profits increase by exactly the same amount as the value of output does.

zh: 所以，原则上说，会出现针对附加产量的购买力量。
en: Thus, in principle, the purchasing power for the extra output would be available.

zh: 企业主也许要为他的妻子买一件皮毛大衣或为他的工人建造一座新生产车间。
en: The entrepreneur might buy his wife a new fur coat or his workers a new production plant.

zh: 如果所有的公司都工作长一点，大部分将会面临更多的需求，并且一般公司会遇到与其额外供给相同的额外需求。
en: If all firms work longer, most will experience more demand, and the average firm will face as much extra demand as it provides extra supply.

zh: 的确，一部分额外需求将会流入国外，但是这种情况也会发生在额外供给上。
en: True, some extra demand will go abroad, but so will some of the extra supply.

zh: 轻微的货币贬值将能解决出口需求的任何遗留问题。
en: A slight devaluation would solve any remaining problem with export demand.

zh: 这可能是直接贬值也可能是由于价格下降而引起的隐性贬值，这两种情况都有可能是因为工资不变条件下额外的工作时间所引发的单元生产成本降低所造成的。
en: This could be an explicit devaluation or an implicit one due to a price reduction, made possible by the reduction in unit production costs resulting from the extra working time at constant pay.

zh: “工作更长久将会损害就业”和“我们需要技术进步以使我们变得更具竞争力并保持就业率”的观点本身就是矛盾的，因为工作时间加长与能使资本和劳力都更具价值的技术进步几乎是一样的。
en: The argument that working longer destroys jobs and that we need technological progress in order to become more competitive and maintain employment is inherently inconsistent, because working longer is nearly the same as technological progress that makes capital and labor more productive.

zh: 尽管两者都有可能正确，但是它们不可能同时正确。
en: Either one or the other view is correct, but both cannot be true simultaneously.

zh: 担心加长工作时间将会对就业率造成损害是毫无道理的。
en: In any case, only the second interpretation is correct.

zh: 这是一条费力但却是真正的通往经济增长、竞争力加强、就业率提高的道路。
en: The fear that extending the workday will damage employment is unfounded. It is a tried and true path towards growth, competitiveness and employment.

zh: 在意大利解决欧洲银行危机
en: Resolving Europe’s Banking Crisis in Italy

zh: 伦敦—欧洲银行业步路蹒跚并且高度分散。
en: LONDON – The European banking sector is crippled and highly fragmented.

zh: 它的问题在某些国家和金融机构中尤其尖锐，但这一行业的盈利水平平均而言要低于其股权成本，并且其手中的不良贷款和难以估值的资产的存量之大足以威胁到未来多年的市值。
en: Though its problems are more acute for some countries and financial institutions, the sector runs on a level of profitability that is, on average, lower than its cost of equity and maintains a stock of non-performing loans and hard-to-value assets large enough to undermine its capitalization for years to come.

zh: 意大利正是如此。
en: Italy is a case in point.

zh: 其银行业萎靡不振不但威胁到经济复苏、阻碍了投资，并且其银行业的麻烦尖锐地反映了一个影响到整个欧元区的问题。
en: Not only is its dysfunctional banking sector undermining economic recovery and inhibiting investment; the sector’s troubles are the sharp end of a problem that affects the entire eurozone.

zh: 到2012年春，显然欧洲银行系统已成为欧元大厦的一个关键弱点。
en: By the spring of 2012, it had become clear that the European banking system was a critical weak point in the euro’s architecture.

zh: 人们已经认识到，共同银行监督、中央化清算框架以及共同化存款担保机制是欧元区必不可少的支柱。
en: Common banking supervision, a centralized resolution framework, and a mutualized deposit-guarantee scheme were understood to be necessary pillars of the eurozone.

zh: 人们认为，这些措施短期有助于加快银行恢复，并最终结束金融分散问题，形成一个公平的经营环境，降低未来银行危机风险，最终遏制并共担银行倒闭的成本。
en: It was thought that these measures would help in the short term to accelerate bank repair, and that they would end financial fragmentation, establish a level playing field, reduce the risk of future banking crises, and ultimately contain and share the costs of banking failures.

zh: 但好心办了坏事。
en: But the road to hell is paved with good intentions.

zh: 欧洲银行联盟的现状不但远远算不上完善，其设计缺陷更是令它成为不作为和不稳定的根源，这可能比它原本想要解决的问题还要糟糕。
en: The European banking union, in its current state, is not only incomplete; its design flaws have made it a source of inaction and instability potentially worse than the ills it was intended to cure.

zh: 比如，存款担保机制完全看不到进展迹象，而关于单一清算基金，以及因为它无法获得公共支持，故而不能解决大规模银行灾难的争论也是众说纷纭。
en: The deposit-guarantee scheme, for example, shows no sign of progress, and the debates on the single resolution fund and its lack of a public backstop to deal with large-scale banking distress are going nowhere.

zh: 最后，自救（bail-in）规则引入过早，银行还无法发行足够的足以自救（bail-in-able）的债务。
en: Finally, the bail-in rules were introduced before banks could issue enough bail-in-able debt.

zh: 这些顺次发生的问题可以也应该用时间来解决。
en: These sequencing issues can and should be addressed over time.

zh: 但银行联盟本身的概念基础存在更加麻烦的问题，特别是其清算框架。
en: But there are far more troubling problems with the conceptual foundation of the banking union itself, in particular with its resolution framework.

zh: 2007年以来，欧盟国家向陷入困境的金融机构提供了超过6,750亿欧元资本金和应偿还贷款以及1.3万亿欧元担保，因此不难理解它们希望限制援助（bail-out ） 。
en: Since 2007, EU countries have provided in excess of €675 billion ($757 billion) in capital and repayable loans, along with €1.3 trillion in guarantees, to financial institutions in distress, so the desire to limit bailouts is understandable.

zh: 再考虑到援助常常会为了保护现有银行利益和行为而妨碍重组、清算和整合，从而延迟必要的资产负债表修复、导致欧洲银行系统僵尸化，这一顾虑就更加合情合理了。
en: This concern is all the more legitimate, given that bailouts have often hampered restructuring, resolution, and consolidation to preserve existing banking interests and practices, thereby delaying the necessary repair of balance sheets and zombifying the European banking system.

zh: 诚然，国际经验表明必须使用公共资源才能实现成本最小化和加快整合。
en: To be sure, international experience shows that public resources are sometimes necessary to minimize costs and hasten consolidation.

zh: 但孤立干预的逻辑忽视了系统的互通性，一家大机构陷入困难常常形成溢出效应，带来破坏性的全系统挤兑。
en: But the logic of isolated intervention ignores the interconnectedness of the system, whereby distress in one large institution often creates spillover effects that feed destabilizing system-wide runs.

zh: 正因如此，西班牙和爱尔兰的成功干预都是全面干预，需要大量国家和欧洲资源成立“坏银行 ” ， 保证随后进行一次全系统的资产大检查、资本重组和整合。
en: That is why successful interventions in Spain and Ireland were comprehensive and required large amounts of national and European resources to establish a “bad bank” and ensure a system-wide subsequent triage of assets, recapitalization, and consolidation.

zh: 尽管这些计划的全面性特点是其成功的因素，但不论是银行复苏和清算指令（Banking Recovery and Resolution Directive）还是单一清算委员会（SRB ） ， 都不是为了落实这些系统性因对措施而设。
en: Although these programs’ comprehensive nature explains their success, neither the Banking Recovery and Resolution Directive nor the Single Resolution Board (SRB) are designed to put in place such systemic responses.

zh: 事实上，SRB甚至没有行政权限实施它的决定，而由国家当局实施。
en: In fact, the SRB even lacks the executive authority to implement its decisions, which are carried out by national authorities.

zh: 它也没有能力确保银行清算时银行系统的其余部分采取必要的预防性措施。
en: It also lacks the ability to ensure that bank resolutions are accompanied by the necessary preventive steps in the rest of the banking system.

zh: 简言之，欧洲银行清算框架将干预工具从国家当局（它们知道应该怎样做）手中收走，但并没有在欧洲层面恢复这些工具。
en: In short, the European banking resolution framework has confiscated the tools for intervention from national authorities (which was the right thing to do), without recreating them at the European level.

zh: 结果，不论是国家政府还是欧洲当局，都没有行动的权力。
en: As a result, neither national governments nor European authorities are empowered to act.

zh: 这就导致意大利当局面临的选项十分有限。
en: This leaves the Italian authorities with a limited set of options.

zh: 单方面一刀切援助将导致银行联盟承压，公共财政吃紧，而意大利银行系统结构性弱点依旧。
en: A unilateral blanket bailout would stress the banking union, stretch public finances, and leave the Italian banking system with its structural weakness.

zh: 或者，他们也可以保持当前的渐进方针，该方针本质上即投入少量公共资源，强迫情况较好的银行支持情况较差的银行。
en: Alternatively, they could also maintain the current piecemeal approach, which has essentially committed small amounts of public resources and forced the stronger banks to support the weaker ones.

zh: 但这一策略对大机构束手无策。
en: But this strategy cannot work for large institutions.

zh: 第三个选项是通过制定全面的债务重组、资本重组和整合意大利银行系统的计划来应对欧洲银行联盟的缺陷，从而结束几十年来的治理和监管不力。
en: A third option would be to confront the European banking union’s shortcomings by setting out a comprehensive plan to restructure, recapitalize, and consolidate the Italian banking system, thereby ending decades of poor governance and bad supervisory practices.

zh: 这一新方针首先要求大幅扩大阿迪兰特基金（Atlante，其成立的目的是对情况较差的意大利银行进行资本重组）的规模，让它对银行业的“坏银行”资产进行梳理鉴别。
en: This new approach would require, first, a substantial increase in the size of Atlante, the fund set up to recapitalize some of the weaker Italian banks, to enable it to play the standard role of asset triage of a “bad bank” for the entire banking sector.

zh: 如果欧盟委员会竞争管理当局能承担治理阿迪兰特基金的责任，那么增加投入意大利公共资源的要求也可以接受。
en: The need for further Italian public resources could be acceptable if the European Commission’s competition authority were to play a role in the governance of Atlante.

zh: 其次，一旦从不良贷款中解放出来，银行需要进行预防性资本重组，包括次级债券持有人的自救以及立刻补偿散户投资者。
en: Second, once freed of their non-performing loans, banks would need to undertake precautionary recapitalizations, including the bail-in of subordinated bondholders and the immediate compensation of retail investors.

zh: 接着，所有银行都应该被要求在短期内根据单一监督者的指示筹集私有资本，直到能够建立足够确保生存的缓冲；不能按时完成这一任务的银行应该被清算。
en: Then, all banks should be given a tight schedule to raise capital privately, in accordance with the single supervisor’s instructions, to levels that create a sufficient buffer to ensure their viability; banks that fail to meet this schedule should be resolved.

zh: 最后也是最重要的，应该采取深度改革促使银行业务模式的真正变化，重塑银行盈利能力。
en: Finally, and most important, deep reforms should be undertaken to facilitate a real shift in banks’ business models in order to restore their profitability.

zh: 这些改革应该包括专门针对银行员工的冗余机制（以便利整合 ） ， 修订偿债能力法和法庭程序（以纠正拖延补偿 ） ， 大幅变革公司治理、特别是合作性银行系统的公司治理等。
en: Such reforms should include dedicated redundancy schemes for bank employees (to facilitate consolidation), an overhaul of solvency law and court procedures (to redress repossession delays), and profound changes in corporate governance, particularly in the cooperative banking system.

zh: 由于银行联盟的分散和能力不足，欧洲当局无法指定这样的计划。
en: European authorities are unable to design such a plan, owing to the banking union’s fragmented and incomplete competencies.

zh: 必须由意大利来打破不作为的恶性循环，采取必要的果断措施修复意大利银行（并避免真正的危机 ） ， 这也将为解决欧洲清算机制缺位的问题提供一个蓝图。
en: It is up to Italy to break the vicious cycle of inaction and take the bold steps needed to repair Italian banks (and avert a real crisis), which would also provide a blueprint for redressing the inadequacies of the European resolution framework.

zh: 意大利需要表明它既能当消防员，也能当建筑工人。
en: Italy needs to show that one can be both a firefighter and a builder.

zh: 欧洲央行的独立假象
en: The ECB’s Illusory Independence

zh: 发自雅典 — — 对中央银行独立性的坚守是人们希望“靠谱”政策制定者所能秉承信条的重要组成部分（还有私有化，劳动力市场的“灵活性”等等 ） 。
en: ATHENS – A commitment to the independence of central banks is a vital part of the creed that “serious” policymakers are expected to uphold (privatization, labor-market “flexibility,” and so on).

zh: 但央行应该独立于什么而存在？
en: But what are central banks meant to be independent of?

zh: 答案似乎显而易见：政府。
en: The answer seems obvious: governments.

zh: 在这个意义上说，欧洲央行就是个典型的独立中央银行：没有任何一个单一政府为它作后盾，同时也被明确禁止为以它作为央行的任何国家政府作后盾。
en: In this sense, the European Central Bank is the quintessentially independent central bank: No single government stands behind it, and it is expressly prohibited from standing behind any of the national governments whose central bank it is.

zh: 然而欧洲央行却是发达经济体中独立性最低的中央银行。
en: And yet the ECB is the least independent central bank in the developed world.

zh: 核心的难题来自于欧洲央行的“不救助”条款 — — 禁止其援助任何破产的成员国政府。
en: The key difficulty is the ECB’s “no bailout” clause – the ban on aiding an insolvent member-state government.

zh: 由于商业银行是各成员国政府筹集资金的一个重要来源，而欧洲央行被迫拒绝为那些位于破产国的银行提供流动性。
en: Because commercial banks are an essential source of funding for member governments, the ECB is forced to refuse liquidity to banks domiciled in insolvent members.

zh: 因此欧洲央行是建立在阻止其作为最后贷款人的规则之上的。
en: Thus, the ECB is founded on rules that prevent it from serving as lender of last resort.

zh: 这一安排的致命弱点是缺乏针对欧元区成员国的破产程序。
en: The Achilles heel of this arrangement is the lack of insolvency procedures for euro members.

zh: 于是当希腊在2010年宣布破产后，德法两国政府拒绝承认希腊政府拥有抹去两国银行所持债务的权利，结果希腊的第一个“救市”就是用来让德法两国银行全身而退的，但这样做只是进一步加深了希腊的债务困境。
en: When, for example, Greece became insolvent in 2010, the German and French governments denied its government the right to default on debt held by German and French banks. Greece’s first “bailout” was used to make French and German banks whole.

zh: 也正是这一点充分暴露了欧洲央行独立性的缺失。
en: It was at this point that the ECB’s lack of independence was fully exposed.

zh: 2010年以来，希腊政府一直依赖一系列永远无法偿还的贷款来维持自身拥有偿付能力的表象。
en: Since 2010, the Greek government has been relying on a sequence of loans that it can never repay to maintain a façade of solvency.

zh: 一个真正独立的欧洲央行，根据自身的规则，应拒绝接受所有由希腊政府担保的债务负债抵押品 — — 政府债券，国库券以及希腊银行为维持周转而发行的500亿欧元（折合560亿美元）白条。
en: A truly independent ECB, adhering to its own rules, should have refused to accept as collateral all debt liabilities guaranteed by the Greek state – government bonds, treasury bills, and the more than €50 billion ($56 billion) of IOUs that Greece’s banks have issued to remain afloat.

zh: 当然，这种拒绝将导致希腊各银行纷纷倒闭，并立即引发希腊退出欧元区，因为政府被迫得去发行属于自己的流动性。
en: Of course, such a refusal would close down Greek banks and lead immediately to Greece’s exit from the eurozone, because the government would be forced to issue its own liquidity.

zh: 唯一的选择将是借助一个有意义的债务重组来结束希腊的破产。
en: The only alternative would be a meaningful debt restructuring to end Greece’s insolvency.

zh: 无奈欧洲的政治机构不愿采用上述任何一个选项，而是选择去敷衍拖延希腊的破产状况 — — 并假装已经通过新一批的贷款解决了这一问题。
en: Alas, Europe’s political establishment, unwilling to adopt either option, has chosen to extend Greece’s insolvency – which it pretends has been resolved through new loan tranches.

zh: 欧洲央行一直都对希腊债权人要求下的拖延掩饰行为持默许态度，也因此撕下了其自称独立的伪装。
en: The ECB’s ongoing acquiescence in the extend-and-pretend charade demanded by Greece’s creditors has demolished its claim to be independent.

zh: 如果要保证希腊各银行继续营业，并接受它们提供的政府担保抵押品，欧洲央行有义务给予希腊债务一个不救助规则之外的豁免。
en: To keep Greece’s banks open, and accept their government-guaranteed collateral, the ECB is obliged to grant Greek debt an exemption from its no-insolvency rule.

zh: 但为了继续钳制住希腊，德国坚持这项豁免条件必须得到它的批准 — — 或者在欧洲的语境中，就是要让欧元区各国财政部长一致认定“希腊的财政整顿和改革计划正处于合理的轨道上。 ”
en: And, to keep the noose firmly around Greece’s neck, Germany insists that this exemption is conditional on its approval – or, in euro-speak, that the Eurogroup of eurozone finance ministers confirms that “Greece’s fiscal consolidation and reform program are on track.”

zh: 因此实际上是政治家在指挥欧洲央行何时该切断整个银行系统的流动性。
en: So, in effect, it is politicians that tell the ECB when to cut off liquidity to an entire banking system.

zh: 可见欧洲央行一方面在面对破产的欧盟外围国家政府时号称独立​​，一方面又听任欧洲债权国政府的摆布。
en: While the ECB can claim independence vis-à-vis insolvent, peripheral governments, it is entirely at the mercy of the governments of Europe’s creditor countries.

zh: 我们可以重新审视债权国是如何对待2015年一月选举产生的希腊政府，并借此说明欧洲央行的困局。
en: To illustrate the ECB’s conundrum, it is worthwhile revisiting the creditors’ treatment of the Greek government elected in January 2015.

zh: 2014年12月时形势已经相当明朗，前任政府濒临倒台，左翼激进左翼联盟即将上台。
en: By December 2014, it had become clear that the previous government was on its last legs and that the leftist Syriza party was on its way to power.

zh: 希腊央行行长这个欧洲央行的爪牙竟���“预测”市场面临流动性紧张，暗示激进左翼联盟的胜选将会导致银行系统不稳定 — — 但凡认真考量过的人都会意识到这份声明很可能会导致挤兑。
en: The governor of Greece’s central bank, an arm of the ECB, “predicted” that markets were facing a liquidity squeeze, implying that a Syriza victory would render the banking system unsafe – a statement that would be inane were it not calculated to start a bank run.

zh: 激进左翼联盟在选举中获胜后，我也随即在二月就任财政部长，那时银行挤兑得一塌糊涂，股票一落千丈。
en: By the time I became Finance Minister that February, after Syriza’s electoral victory, the bank run was in full swing and stocks were in free fall.

zh: 究其原因，显然是因为大家都知道德国强烈反对我们这届政府，即将禁止欧洲央行继续维持接受希腊抵押品的豁免要求。
en: The reason, of course, was the common knowledge that Germany, vehemently opposed to our government, was about to switch off the green light required by the ECB to maintain the exemptions allowing it to accept Greek collateral.

zh: 为了稳定局势，我飞赴伦敦去游说一众金融家，阐述关于改革和债务重组的一系列温和合理政策。
en: To stabilize the situation, I flew to London to address financiers with a message of moderation and sensible policies regarding both reforms and debt restructuring.

zh: 第二天早上，股市反弹了13 ％ ， 银行股上涨幅度超过20 ％ ， 挤兑停止了。
en: The following morning, the stock exchange rebounded 13%, bank shares rose by more than 20%, and the bank run ceased.

zh: 当天，欧洲央行在德国压力下撤销了其豁免的一个重要组成部分，从而切断了希腊银行向欧洲央行的直接融资渠道，并将它们导向希腊央行的高价融资渠道（所谓的紧急流动性援助 ） 。
en: On that day, the ECB, pressured by Germany, rescinded an important part of its exemption, thereby cutting off Greek banks’ direct access to the ECB and diverting them to pricier financing from Greece’s central bank (so-called emergency liquidity assistance).

zh: 不出所料，股价暴跌和银行挤兑卷土重来，希腊银行系统在接下来的几个月内流失450亿欧元存款。
en: Unsurprisingly, stock prices plummeted and the bank run returned with a vengeance, bleeding €45 billion of deposits out of the system over the next few months.

zh: 与此同时，德国和其他债权国开始逼迫希腊接受新的财政紧缩措施，作为反抗“欧洲央行的”决定的代价。
en: Meanwhile, Germany and other creditors began to push Greece to accept new austerity measures as the price of reversing the “ECB’s” decision.

zh: 这并不是欧洲央行的唯一一次基于政治动机的出手。
en: This was not the ECB’s only politically driven intervention.

zh: 同样积极的还有其限制希腊银行政府国债购买的决定，指示它们拒绝债务展期。
en: Equally aggressive was its decision to curtail Greek banks’ spending on government treasuries, by instructing them to refuse debt rollovers.

zh: 这削弱了我治下的希腊财政部偿还国际货币基金组织贷款的能力，而正是该组织坚持要求大幅削减养老金和取消对希腊工人最后的保护屏障。
en: This diminished my ministry’s capacity to repay the International Monetary Fund, which was insisting on drastic pension cuts and on the removal of the last protections for Greek workers.

zh: 在欧洲央行的步步紧逼之下，我们抵制德国和国际货币基金组织执行进一步紧缩政策的要求并坚持了五个月。
en: For five months, as the ECB’s noose tightened, we resisted German and IMF demands for further austerity.

zh: 最后在2015年6月，所有希腊银行的流动性供应都被关闭，只能关门大吉。
en: Finally, the complete cessation of all liquidity to Greece’s banks in June 2015 forced their closure.

zh: 随后各方再次尝试分裂我们的政府并迫使我们的总理屈服 — — 他也弹尽粮绝，只得接受850亿欧元的最新一笔的拖延掩饰贷款。
en: This was followed by the final push to divide our government and force the prime minister to capitulate – as he did, accepting the latest extend-and-pretend loan of €85 billion.

zh: 差不多一年后，这帮债权国又来推动更严厉的紧缩政策以换取更多的贷款。
en: Almost a year later, Greece’s creditors were pushing for even greater austerity in exchange for more loan tranches.

zh: 这时候希腊央行行长（那位曾引发了2014年12月第一轮挤兑的人）又跳出来公开声称是我们这届政府在2015年6月之前所持的立场导致了450亿欧元的存款流失，随之而​​来的银行倒闭以及新一轮的拖延掩饰贷款。
en: At this point, Greece’s central-bank governor (who had triggered the original bank run in December 2014) publicly alleged that our government’s stance until June 2015 caused the loss of €45 billion worth of deposits, the ensuing bank closures, and the new extend-and-pretend loans.

zh: 施暴者竟然指责受害者，欧洲央行也公开自身作为其幕后政治大佬 — — 债权国 — — 鹰犬的角色 ： 。
en: The bully was blaming the victim, and the ECB was openly embracing its role as enforcer for its political masters: the creditors.

zh: 欧元区目前的设计使得欧洲央行不可能维持其独立性。
en: The eurozone’s current design makes ECB independence impossible.

zh: 更糟的是，独立性的幌子已经成为了一块遮羞布，不仅粉饰了那些政治动机，更与自由民主的原则背道而驰。
en: Worse, the pretense of independence serves as a fig leaf for interventions that are not only politically driven, but that are also utterly inconsistent with the principles of liberal democracy.

zh: 欧洲长期投资障碍
en: Europe’s Roadblocks to Long-Term Investment

zh: 阿姆斯特丹—欧洲经济所面临的重大挑战之一是其资本市场缺乏流动性。
en: AMSTERDAM – One of the major challenges facing the European economy is the lack of liquidity in its capital markets.

zh: 自2008年全球金融危机以来，欧洲已经实施了大量新规则。
en: Since the 2008 global financial crisis, an enormous number of new rules have been put in place.

zh: 为了促进欧洲所急需的长期投资，明智的做法是重新评估过去六年中所浮现的监管大环境。
en: In order to facilitate the long-term investment that Europe desperately needs, it would be wise to reassess the broader regulatory environment that has emerged over the past six years.

zh: 由于银行不愿发放新贷款，退休基金等机构就成了解资本之渴的近水。
en: With banks reluctant to make new loans, institutions such as pension funds are well placed to meet the desperate demand for capital.

zh: 事实上，几十年后才会退休的工人的储蓄特别适合长期投资。
en: Indeed, the savings of workers who may not be retiring for several decades are particularly well suited for long-term investments.

zh: 麻烦之处在于，在许多情形中，规则和监管总是倾向于确保金融市场的稳定性，而牺牲了退休基金和其他资金平滑有效地配置储蓄的能力。
en: The trouble is that in many cases, rules and regulations intended to ensure financial markets’ stability impede the ability of pension funds and others to allocate savings smoothly and efficiently.

zh: 合理监管的重要性怎么强调都不过分。
en: The importance of proper regulations cannot be understated.

zh: 内容和应用合理的监管能确保金融稳定，维持（并且在必要时重塑）市场信心，也有利于长期投资，有助于公民满足未来金融需要。
en: When properly drafted and applied, they ensure financial stability, maintain (and, if necessary, restore) confidence in the markets, and facilitate long-term investment, helping citizens meet their future financial needs.

zh: 但如果监管措施与各种类型的市场参与者不匹配，与市场实际运转情况不匹配，那么它们可能扼杀本可以有利于投资者和经济的机会。
en: But if regulations are not well tailored to the various types of market participants and to how markets actually work, they can choke off opportunities that would otherwise benefit investors and the economy.

zh: 新衍生品保证金要求便是扼杀机会的例子。 它的初衷是降低系统风险。
en: The new margin requirements for derivatives, introduced in order to reduce systemic risk, are one example of such a chokepoint.

zh: 对于银行和对冲基金来说，实施这一要求是合适的，但退休基金是信誉卓著的机构，不会或极少给金融市场带来系统风险。
en: It might make sense to apply them to banks or hedge funds, but pension funds are highly creditworthy institutions that pose little or no systemic risk to financial markets.

zh: 强迫它们将部分资产用于抵押目的只能减少可用于长期投资的资本。
en: Forcing them to set aside assets for collateral purposes only drains capital that could be used for long-term-investment.

zh: 这类投资包括各种产品、市场参与者和司法辖区，结果是监管的效果难觅踪影，更无法定量评估。
en: Such investment involves a variety of products, market players, and jurisdictions, and, as a result, the effect of regulations can be difficult to see, much less quantify.

zh: 首先，规则和监管的影响可以是直接的，也可以是间接的。
en: For starters, the impact of rules and regulations can be direct or indirect.

zh: 专门适用于长期投资产品或策略的规则可以归为直接影响型。
en: Rules that apply specifically to long-term-investment products or strategies can be classified as having a direct impact.

zh: 适用于投资者及其对手方、竞争性产品或市场的补充方的规则可以归为间接影响型。
en: Rules that apply to investors or their counterparts, competitive products, or complementary parts of the market can be described as having an indirect effect.

zh: 设计合理的规则框架能最小化长期投资的不利后果，同时最大化积极效应。
en: A well-crafted regulatory framework minimizes the adverse consequences for long-term investment, while maximizing the positive effects.

zh: 欧洲一直在引入新监管措施。
en: New regulations are constantly being introduced.

zh: 仔细分析新监管措施是否真的需要，以及在需要的情况下预估并用规则填补监管空白以确保储蓄平稳流向新建和已有项目很重要。
en: It is important to analyze carefully whether the new regulations are actually needed and, if yes, to foresee and fill regulatory gaps with rules that ensure the smooth flow of savings to new and existing projects.

zh: 比如，与备兑债券（covered bond ） 、 绿色债券和通过不动产信托进行的跨境投资有关的标准化监管措施能鼓励更多的长期投资。
en: For example, standardizing regulations relating to covered bonds, green bonds, and cross-border investment through real-estate trusts could encourage more long-term investment.

zh: 增加适合长期投资、调和地方破产机制的总体监管推进手段可以以更加间接的方式产生积极效应。
en: In a more indirect way, a general regulatory push that increased the availability of projects suitable for long-term-investment and harmonized local insolvency regimes could also have a positive effect.

zh: 存在直接消极影响的监管显例包括现有证券化规则和关于基于资产的资本费用的建议规则。
en: Prominent examples of regulations with a direct negative impact include existing rules on securitization and proposed rules on asset-based capital charges.

zh: 这些监管措施对长期投资的间接消极影响自然更加难以识别，但其伤害性不亚于直接影响 — — 特别是当它们导致投资者可用于长期投资的资金减少的情况下。
en: The indirect negative effects of such regulations on long-term investment are, by nature, more difficult to discern, but they can be just as harmful as the direct effects – especially if they leave investors with fewer funds available for long-term investment.

zh: 衍生品交易保证金要求就有这类影响，提高银行成本的监管措施亦然。
en: Margin requirements for derivatives transactions have this effect, as do regulations that increase banking costs.

zh: 这些类型的间接消极影响从未成为关注如何提振长期投资的政策讨论的核心。
en: These types of indirect negative effects have not been central to policy discussions concerning how to boost long-term investment.

zh: 但我们应该仔细考虑这个问题。
en: But they deserve careful consideration.

zh: 关键点是我们需要厘清它们对资本配置的影响的全部范围和规模。
en: It is crucial that we identify the full scope and scale of their impact on the allocation of capital.

zh: 否则，它们就有可能抵消投资刺激改革的积极影响。
en: Otherwise, they risk offsetting the positive impact of investment-enhancing reforms.

zh: 在立法者和监管者继续调整投资环境时，他们不仅要监督和评估每一项新增监管政策的影响，也必须明白规则彼此之间 — — 以及与所引入的新规则之间 — — 的互动方式，这一点很重要。
en: As legislators and regulators continue to shape the investment environment, it is important not only to monitor and evaluate the impact of each piece of additional regulation; the way rules interact with one another – and with new rules as they are introduced – must also be understood.

zh: 不必要的宽监管应该避免，以利于为不同的市场参与者量身定制的规则。
en: Unnecessarily broad regulations should be avoided in favor of rules that are specifically tailored to the various participants in the market.

zh: 让退休基金等长期投资者为欧洲经济提供急需的资本有望给未来退休者和整体经济带来巨大好处。
en: Allowing long-term investors such as pension funds to provide the European economy with much-needed capital has the potential to provide huge benefits to future retirees, as well as to the broader economy.

zh: 但这只有在建立了正确的监管环境的基础上才有可能。
en: But that will not be possible unless, and until, the right regulatory environment is created.

zh: 欧洲想要公平竞争
en: Europe Means Fair Play

zh: 随着乌克兰的民主进程继续痛苦地进行，欧洲人不知道原则政治能否有一天超越权力政治。
en: As Ukraine’s agonizing struggle for democracy continues, Europeans wonder if the politics of principle can ever eclipse the politics of power.

zh: 相信世界不仅仅是零和思维是否太天真？
en: Is it naive to believe that the world amounts to more than zero-sum thinking?

zh: 欧洲能否在国际事务中促进公平竞争？ 还是不得不承认新的大国竞争游戏不可避免，然后也投身到这场喧嚣之中？
en: Can Europe promote fair play in international affairs, or must it accept a new game of great power rivalry as inevitable and throw itself into the fray?

zh: 许多欧洲人都把自己看作是全球公平竞争的典范，但是欧洲自以为正直的想法并不总是得到别人的同意。
en: Many Europeans see themselves as champions of global fair play. But Europe’s opinion of its integrity is not always shared.

zh: 俄罗斯就是一个例子。 俄罗斯对欧盟的意图感到怀疑，特别是最近对乌克兰的意图。
en: One example is Russia, which is skeptical about the EU’s intentions, most recently over Ukraine.

zh: 我们并不感到惊讶。
en: That should not surprise us.

zh: 欧盟的成员已经从六国增加到25国，而且保加利亚、罗马尼亚、克罗地亚和土耳其还在等候加入。
en: The EU has expanded from six members to 25, with Bulgaria, Romania, Croatia, and Turkey waiting in the wings.

zh: 俄罗斯想知道欧盟的边界会扩展到哪里。
en: Russia wants to know where the Union will stop.

zh: 它是否还计划吞并乌克兰、白俄罗斯和高加索地区？
en: Does it plan to swallow Ukraine, Belarus, and the Caucasus?

zh: 大多数欧盟成员国认为这是悬而未决的问题，近期内不大可能解决。
en: Most EU members view these as open questions, unlikely to be resolved soon.

zh: 然而克里姆林宫似乎隐隐约约地看到了一道烟幕，掩盖了欧盟的真实意图，尽管欧盟和俄罗斯最近的高峰会议提供了澄清事实的机会。
en: The Kremlin, however, seems to see in such vagueness a smokescreen hiding the Union’s true intentions, though the recent EU-Russia summit provided an opportunity to clear the air.

zh: 从某种意义上讲，对欧盟持批评态度的人是对的：欧盟可能正在寻求按自己的形象改造世界。
en: In a sense, critics of the EU are right: the Union may be on a quest to reshape the world in its image.

zh: 如今，如果欧盟与非欧盟国家签署协议，它必定要包括人权、核不扩散、重新接纳移民、以及恐怖主义等领域的各种硬性要求。
en: Nowadays, when the EU concludes agreements with non-EU countries, it includes all sorts of stiff requirements in areas like human rights, non-proliferation, readmission of migrants, and terrorism.

zh: 对于处在接受方的国家而言，这些条件可以被看作一种微妙的权力政治，是欧洲把自己的价值观强加给世界。
en: To countries on the receiving end, these conditions can seem like a subtle form of power politics, with Europe trying to impose its values on the world.

zh: 的确，对欧盟来说，某些问题是没有商量的，因为它们是我们寻求与世界分享的欧洲模式的支柱。
en: Indeed, for the EU some issues are non-negotiable, because they are pillars of the European model that we seek to share with the world.

zh: 这些问题包括民主和法制、尊重人权和环境、不扩散大规模杀伤性武器、以及反对恐怖主义的运动。
en: These issues include democracy and the rule of law, respect for human rights and the environment, non-proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, and the campaign against terrorism.

zh: 其他国家如果不达到欧盟的政治标准，就不要想从欧盟得到经济的以及其他的利益。
en: Countries cannot expect economic and other benefits from the Union unless they meet its political standards.

zh: 但这些标准真的是强加的吗？
en: But are those standards really an imposition?

zh: 在欧洲以外，公平竞争的原则似乎正在被越来越多的人所拥护。
en: It looks as if the principles of fair play are increasingly embraced outside of Europe.

zh: 想想非洲，非洲联盟在解决大陆上的争端中正发挥着领导作用，并且越来越坚定地介入和制止侵略，确保对非洲少数民族公平。
en: Consider Africa, where the African Union is taking a leading role in resolving conflicts on the continent and is increasingly determined to intervene to halt aggression and assure fair play for African minorities.

zh: 尽管在外人看来，非洲大地上的现实还谈不上引人注目，但态度上的变化是真实的。
en: Even if the results on the ground in Africa don’t yet look spectacular to outsiders, the change in attitude is real.

zh: 欧盟可以支持非洲人自己的努力，让他们从欧盟的经验中获益，而不是在非洲玩“大国游戏 ” 。
en: Instead of playing the “Great Power Game” in Africa, the EU can support Africans’ own efforts and allow them to benefit from the Union’s experience.

zh: 欧洲对所有人公平竞争的信仰反映了它自身的利益，至少在某些方面如此，因为世界上的势力平衡正在发生变化。
en: Europe’s belief in fair play for all reflects its self-interest, at least in some ways, because the world’s balance of power is changing.

zh: 想想中国和印度的崛起。
en: Consider the rise of China and India.

zh: 投资银行高盛公司预测，到2007年，中国经济的美元价值将超过英国和德国。
en: The investment bank Goldman Sachs predicts that the dollar size of the Chinese economy will overtake that of Britain and Germany by 2007.

zh: 到2020年，印度将超过法国，到2023年超过德国。
en: India will pull ahead of France by 2020 and surpass Germany by 2023.

zh: 随着亚洲经济体向前飞速发展，它们的政治抱负也同样高涨。
en: As Asia’s economies race forward, so do its political ambitions.

zh: 亚洲人想在世界上承担更多的责任，而只要他们也尊重公平竞争的规则，那么他们的如愿就符合欧洲的利益。
en: Asians want to assume greater responsibility in the world, and it is in Europe’s interest that they do, as long as they, too, respect the rules of fair play.

zh: 在欧盟内部，公平竞争的意识也是非常重要的。
en: A sense of fair play also matters within the Union.

zh: 欧盟变得越大，对协调一致的政策的需要就越强烈，而要让所有成员国都站在统一的立场上就越困难。
en: The larger the EU gets, the greater its need for coordinated and coherent policies, and the harder it becomes to rally all members around a common position.

zh: 这可以被称作“扩张的矛盾 ” 。
en: Call this the “paradox of enlargement.”

zh: 最大的三个成员国 — — 英国、法国和德国 — — 面对这个矛盾，倾向于追求更紧密地三边合作。
en: The three largest member states – Britain, France, and Germany – have tended to respond to this paradox by pursuing closer trilateral cooperation.

zh: 当然，先锋成员国先行一步没有什么不对 — — 最近在伊拉克核计划问题上的外交倡议就刚好说明了这一点。
en: Of course, there’s nothing wrong with vanguard groups of members forging ahead – the recent diplomatic initiative concerning Iran’s nuclear program is a case in point.

zh: 的确，在可预见的未来，每个成员国都可能坚持自己追求独立外交政策的权利。
en: Indeed, every member state can be expected to cling to its right to pursue an independent foreign policy for the foreseeable future.

zh: 但是，要保证欧洲的整体要大于各个部分之和，保证所有欧盟成员国之间的公平，所有欧盟国家都必须在欧盟政策的范围内活动，正如它们在乌克兰的问题上所做的一样。
en: However, to ensure that the European whole is greater than the sum of its parts, and to guarantee fairness to all Union members, all EU states must work within the parameters of EU policy, as they have in the case of Ukraine.

zh: 当它们这样做了，它们的努力就会巩固各成员国和欧盟的合法性和权威性。
en: When they do, their efforts strengthen the legitimacy and authority of both the member states and the Union.

zh: 在一个公平竞争的世界里，制定规则的另一面就是遵守规则，而遵守规则可能会需要通过经济制裁和其他非军事化的措施强制执行。
en: In a world of fair play, the flip side of rule making is compliance, and compliance may require enforcement, through economic sanctions and other non-military measures.

zh: ���为最后的手段，欧盟甚至必须准备好通过军事措施捍卫它认为值得保护的价值和原则。
en: As a last resort, the EU must even be prepared to rise to the military defense of the values and principles it believes are worth protecting.

zh: 如果欧洲不准备在必要的时候拿起武器，那么在世界其他国家看来，它对公平竞争的呼吁就仅仅是故作姿态。
en: If Europe is not prepared to take up arms when it must, then its appeals for fair play will sound to the rest of the world like mere posturing.

zh: 但是如果要在全球范围内推广公平竞争，欧洲人的倡议就应该是更大范围的国际努力的一部分，其中还有美国等意趣相投的伙伴和多边机构的参与。
en: But if fair play is to be made global, European initiatives should be part of broader international efforts, involving both like-minded partners such as the United States and multilateral institutions.

zh: 分裂性的跨大西洋竞争不会给开明的欧洲模式带来民族的或政治的基础。
en: A divisive transatlantic rivalry offers no ethical or political basis for an enlightened European approach.

zh: 相反，公平竞争需要美国的力量作为支持。
en: On the contrary, fair play requires American power to back it up.

zh: 欧洲的移民机会
en: The Migration Opportunity

zh: 伦敦—去年，有4,000多男性、女性和儿童在试图经地中海从非洲前往欧洲的过程中丧命。
en: LONDON – In the last year, more than 4,000 men, women, and children have lost their lives attempting to cross the Mediterranean Sea from Africa to Europe.

zh: 他们的悲剧并没有延缓迁徙人潮 — — 蛇头变得越来越无耻而残忍，偷渡人数每周都在增长。
en: Their tragic deaths have done nothing to slow the human tide, which is swelling by the week, as smugglers on the coast become increasingly brazen and cruel.

zh: 光是今年以来，就有数钱移民在冰冷的海水中获救。
en: Thousands of migrants have been rescued from the frigid waters since the beginning of this year alone.

zh: 在这一背景下 — — 以及在巴黎和哥本哈根恐怖袭击造成的恐慌的影响下 — — 欧盟即将制定新的关键性移民议程。
en: Against this backdrop – and that of the fear sown by the terrorist attacks in Paris and Copenhagen – the European Union is set to develop a new – and critically important – agenda on migration.

zh: 欧盟委员们在开会讨论如何处理移民问题时，他们必须克服短期下意识解决方案的诱惑，而要制定出真正的创新、全面的国内和国外行动计划。
en: When EU commissioners gather to debate how to proceed, they must overcome the temptation to grasp at short-term, knee-jerk solutions, and instead develop a truly creative, comprehensive plan of action both at home and abroad.

zh: 欧洲上一次面临类似的移民政策转折点是在2011年。 当时，阿拉伯之春导致大量逃脱北非暴力和混乱的移民来到欧洲。
en: The last time Europe faced such a turning point on migration was in 2011, when the Arab Spring triggered a flood of new arrivals fleeing violence and chaos in North Africa.

zh: 但采取果断行动 — — 建立地中海马歇尔计划，把投资引向移民融合项目 — — 的时机被白白浪费了。
en: But the moment for bold actions – the creation of a Mediterranean Marshall Plan, for instance, or massive investments into immigrant integration – passed without being seized.

zh: 2014年，欧盟移民和庇护紧急资金总额只有250亿欧元 — — 对于一项集体行动来说，这个数字低得可怜，尽管有来自成员国的资金补充。
en: In 2014, the EU's emergency funding for migration and asylum totaled a mere €25 million ($28 million) – a pathetic exercise in collective action, albeit one supplemented by funds from member states.

zh: 让问题更加严重的是欧盟本身内部承诺与同情的不平衡。
en: Adding to the problem is an imbalance of commitment and compassion within the EU itself.

zh: 瑞典和德国接纳了大部分来自叙利亚和其他地方的寻求庇护者，而其他大部分欧盟成员国只接纳了极少数或一个人都没有接纳。
en: Sweden and Germany have taken in the majority of asylum seekers from Syria and elsewhere, while most other EU member states have admitted few or none.

zh: 比如，英国去年只为叙利亚难民提供了90个安置点。
en: The UK, for example, offered just 90 resettlement spots for Syrian refugees last year.

zh: 因此，仍在上演的地中海悲剧正在严重影响欧盟的凝聚力。
en: As a result, the ongoing tragedy in the Mediterranean is placing EU solidarity under serious strain.

zh: 持续不作为不会让问题自动消失，也不会让欧洲领导人在下一轮国内选举中获益。
en: Continued inaction will not make the problem go away, nor will it benefit European leaders in their next domestic elections.

zh: 考虑到许多北非政府的动荡 ， “ 打击蛇头 ” — —对许多欧盟人来说，这是首选方案 — — 需要许多年才会收到效果。
en: “Cracking down on smugglers," the go-to solution for many in the EU, will take many years to have an impact, given the instability of many North African governments.

zh: 与此同时，中东动荡的加剧 — — 十分现实的前景 — — 可能让数千万根据国际法拥有请求庇护的合法权利的人无法获得安全。
en: Meanwhile, further destabilization of the Middle East – a very real prospect – could compromise the security of tens of millions of people who, under international law, would have a legitimate right to claim asylum.

zh: 我们需要更佳、更积极的方针。
en: A better, more active approach is needed.

zh: 紧迫的必要措施需要大量资源，但在操作上可行：拥有明确救助权力的强大的欧盟联合海上行动。
en: The immediate necessary response is resource-intensive but operationally viable: a robust joint EU sea operation with an explicit rescue mandate.

zh: 当寻求庇护者抵达欧洲海岸时，欧盟应该集体承担处置和收容的金融和管理责任，不管他们在何处上岸。
en: When asylum seekers reach European shores, the EU should take collective financial and administrative responsibility for processing and accommodating them, regardless of where they disembark.

zh: 欧盟还应该更加团结地应对叙利亚难民，在所有成员国之间平等地分担接纳他们的责任。
en: And it should take solidarity a step further when it comes to Syrians, equitably distributing the responsibility to host them across all member states.

zh: 与此同时，要减少蛇头船只上的人数，欧盟所承诺的安置人数应该远远多于目前所承诺的30,000叙利亚难民。
en: Meanwhile, in order to lighten smugglers' boats, the EU should commit to resettling many more than the 30,000 Syrian refugees it has pledged to accept thus far.

zh: 至少要达到近250,000才是公平的数字 — — 考虑到黎巴嫩、土耳其和约旦已经安置了数百万人。
en: A number closer to 250,000, at least, would seem fair – given the millions being sheltered by Lebanon, Turkey, and Jordan.

zh: 与此同时，欧盟外交部长们应该加紧与非洲国家的谈判，为那些遭受危险、想穿越地中海的人建立新的合法安全的途径。
en: Meanwhile, EU foreign ministers should intensify talks with African countries in order to establish new, legal, and safe means for those at risk who want to cross the Mediterranean.

zh: 这可以包括扩大人道主义、务工和家庭团聚签证并在海外办理申请。
en: This could entail extending humanitarian, labor, and family-reunification visas, with applications processed overseas.

zh: 欧盟应该考虑从长期目标，如建立地中海共同市场促进北非经济体增长，最终将该地区转变为移民目的地而不是转运区。
en: The EU should consider longer-term goals, like creating a common Mediterranean market to allow North African economies to grow, eventually transforming the region into a destination for migrants rather than a transit zone.

zh: 最重要的是，欧洲需要从内而外强化自己。
en: Most important, Europe needs to strengthen itself from the inside out.

zh: 欧洲大陆迫切需要焕然一新的多元化方针。
en: The continent is in desperate need of a dramatically different approach to diversity.

zh: 欧盟国家有两个选择：它们可以徒劳地试图恢复过时的单一民族国家；也可以带着民族文化不但能存活下来、还能繁荣昌盛的认识接受多元化。
en: The countries of the EU have two options: They can either make a vain attempt to revert to outdated, mono-ethnic models of statehood, or they can accept diversity with the realization that their national cultures will not only survive, but flourish.

zh: 这样做并不会牺牲任何欧洲核心价值。
en: Doing so would in no way entail compromising any core European values.

zh: 但这需要承诺尊重所有接受这些价值的人，不管他们来自什么种族，信仰什么宗教。
en: But it would require a commitment to respect all who adopt those values, regardless of their race or religion.

zh: 一些人认为地中海是欧洲的软肋。
en: Some see the Mediterranean as Europe's soft underbelly.

zh: 但欧洲大陆真正的阿克琉斯之踵乃是其无法建立稳定多元的社会。
en: But it is the failure to build stable, diverse societies that is the continent's true Achilles heel.

zh: 从源头解决移民问题
en: Tackling Migration at the Source

zh: 华盛顿 — — 对贫困国家的公民来说，移民的选项往往非常具有吸引力。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – For citizens of poor countries, migration often is a highly appealing option.

zh: 前往新国家的旅程往往伴随着危险，但却很可能带来重大的经济机遇：发达经济体的人均收入均值（以购买力平价计算）可以比发展中世界高出50倍乃至更多。
en: The journey to a new country is often perilous, but it promises far greater economic opportunity: average per capita incomes in advanced economies can be more than 50 times higher (in terms of purchasing power parity) than those in the developing world.

zh: 在许多情况下，也会显著改善移民的人身安全状况。
en: In many cases, migrants’ physical security improves as well.

zh: 但对接收国来说，移民仍然是一个颇具争议的话题，接收国政府竭尽全力制定政策从而使本国经济能在避免付出过高的成本的同时获得收益。
en: Yet, for recipient countries, immigration remains a contentious topic, with governments struggling to settle on policies that will enable their economies to reap the benefits and avoid incurring excessive costs.

zh: 移民是欧美国家特别突出的一项政治争议话题。
en: Immigration is a particularly salient topic of political debate in Europe and the United States.

zh: 即使在基本对移民关闭边境的日本，寻找方法应对人口快速老龄化的必要性最近也引发了对这一问题的讨论。
en: Even in Japan, which has largely closed its borders to migrants, the need to find ways to cope with rapid population aging has lately been stimulating discussion of the issue.

zh: 在所有这些国家，讨论往往归结于三个基本立场。
en: In all of these countries, the debate tends to boil down to three basic positions.

zh: 第一种观点 — — 其支持者往往是少数族裔，并且缺乏主要势力的政治支持 — — 即移民主要为发达国家带来好处，因为新移民可以缓解人口压力并加固经济的技术根基。
en: The first – espoused by a small minority, and lacking significant political support – is that immigration is fundamentally beneficial to an advanced country, as newcomers can mitigate demographic challenges and contribute to the economy’s skills base.

zh: 第二种立场则恰恰相反：即发达经济体应当竭尽全力防止移民流入。
en: The second position is precisely the opposite: immigration should be prevented by all available means.

zh: 这种观点的支持者往往认为移民压低工资，特别是在收入分配的低层阶段，从而导致当地人的生活水平下降。
en: Proponents of this view often argue that migrants drive down wages, particularly at the lower end of the income distribution, undermining natives’ living standards.

zh: 他们还认为移民会淡化接收国的文化和传统 — — 经济学家往往会低估这种说法在情绪方面的吸引力。
en: They also argue that migrants dilute the recipient country’s culture and traditions – a claim with an emotional pull that economists often underestimate.

zh: 第三种立场处于这两种极端之间。
en: The third position falls somewhere between these extremes.

zh: 它承认某些移民潜在的好处，但呼吁严格执行能力测试，以确保只有填补接收国某项技能空白的移民才会被接受。
en: It recognizes the potential benefits of some immigration, but calls for strict proficiency tests, to ensure that only migrants who can fill a skills gap in the recipient country are accepted.

zh: 这样，移民就能在不造成文化压力的情况下，提高劳动力市场的供给质量并提升企业竞争力。
en: That way, immigration will improve the quality of supply in the labor market and boost firms’ competitiveness, without generating cultural pressures.

zh: 当然，从移民来源国的角度看，这种方法的效果是截然不同的，它们不仅损失了有价值的熟练劳动者，还损失了投资在这名劳动者身上的一切资源（比方说通过教育体系 ） 。
en: Of course, this approach looks quite different from the perspective of migrants’ home countries, which lose not only valuable skilled labor, but also any resources invested in that labor, say, through the education system.

zh: 虽然一个国家可以从海外人员的汇款中得到好处，但只有移民本人能享受国外生活的总体便利。
en: While a country may benefit from its expatriates’ remittances, it is the migrants alone who secure the overall benefits of relocating.

zh: 无论如何，当发达国家只接收少量技术移民时，他们其实未采取任何措施来减轻促使移民流动的压力，而多数流动的移民并不掌握新国家所需的技术。
en: In any case, when advanced countries accept only a small number of skilled migrants, they do nothing to diminish the pressure that drives migration flows, which overwhelmingly comprise people who lack the new country’s required skills.

zh: 就像地中海悲惨局势所表明的那样，这样的压力非常强势，仅今年前四个月就有超过一千名难民在从非洲到欧洲的危险旅途中丧生。
en: And those pressures are powerful, as demonstrated by the tragic situation in the Mediterranean Sea, where more than a thousand refugees on the treacherous route from Africa to Europe died in the first four months of this year.

zh: 如果坐视这样的压力继续下去，许多移民最终将以这样或那样的方式来到发达世界。
en: If these pressures are allowed to persist, many migrants will ultimately make it to the developed world, one way or another.

zh: 尽管移民自由主义者认为移民有助于缓解接收国的人口压力确有道理，但反对者认为新移民将对新社区（尤其是欧洲）造成巨大文化压力的论调也不无道理。
en: And while immigration liberals are right that migrants will help to ease demographic pressures in recipient countries, the prohibitionists are right that the newcomers will place considerable cultural stress on their new communities, particularly in Europe.

zh: 这也解释了为什么针对移民问题的任何解决方案都必须着眼于促进移民本国的发展。
en: This is why any solution to the migration challenge must focus on spurring development in migrants’ home countries.

zh: 对欧洲来说，需要重点关注非洲问题，因为非洲是欧洲移民流动的主要来源地。
en: For Europe, the focus should be on Africa, the main source of migration flows.

zh: 促进非洲经济快速增长将随着时间的推移大大降低欧洲所面临的压力。
en: More rapid economic growth in Africa would, over time, greatly reduce the pressure that Europe faces.

zh: 非洲的长期发展当然需要加强和平与政治稳定；但与此同时，欧洲可以采取某些措施来协助刺激经济。
en: Africa’s long-term development will of course require greater political stability and peace; in the meantime, however, there are steps that Europe can take to help spur growth.

zh: 尽管非洲拥有大量的自然资源，但却缺乏支持经济显著加速的资本和专业知识。
en: While Africa has plenty of natural resources, it lacks the capital and knowhow needed to support a significant growth acceleration.

zh: 公共资源根本不足以提供所需开发资金的主体。
en: Public resources are simply inadequate to supply the bulk of that capital.

zh: 因此，人们最近开始认可投资必须来源于私营部门，私营部门还必须提供关键技术和发达国家市场准入能力。
en: So, as has lately been recognized, investment must come from the private sector, as must critical skills and access to more developed markets.

zh: 但利用私人投资需要公共部门采取特定的扶持措施，吸引慈善行业加盟，上述行业手中掌握的大量资源也可以协助达到这样的目的。
en: But tapping private investment requires the public sector to take some enabling steps, joined by the philanthropic sector, which also has significant resources to contribute.

zh: 这并不是说公共投资和慈善事业应当补贴从本质上无利可图的项目。
en: This is not to say that public investment and philanthropy should subsidize inherently unprofitable projects.

zh: 恰恰相反，从长远看，这不符合所有相关方的利益。
en: On the contrary, that would leave everyone worse off in the long run.

zh: 因此目标应当是找到尽管在经济上有利可图，但却因为制度和其他障碍而无法吸引私人投资者的项目，然后，竭尽全力保证这些障碍的消除。
en: The goal should be to identify projects that, despite being economically profitable, are unattractive to private investors, owing to institutional and other barriers, and then work to remove those obstacles.

zh: 对非洲私人投资的一个主要障碍是风险。
en: One key barrier to private investment in Africa is risk.

zh: 就像多数发展中国家那样，当投资环境被认为不确定时，投资者会对几乎任何项目要求风险溢价，就连潜在回报率很高的项目也无法幸免。
en: When the investment environment is considered uncertain, as is the case in most developing countries, investors demand a risk premium on virtually any project, even those with potentially high rates of return.

zh: 毕竟，在这样的环境下衡量单个项目的风险有着很大的难度。
en: Individual project risk is, after all, very difficult to measure in such a context.

zh: 公共部门可以通过采取承担一定风险或提供保险的风险汇总措施为私人资本提供帮助。
en: The public sector can help with risk-pooling measures such as carrying certain tranches of risk or providing insurance.

zh: 这样的风险汇总辅之以横跨所有行业的制度建设（不仅限于医疗和教育 ） ， 可能会对促进经济增长和非洲及其他地区的发展起到很强的推动作用。
en: Such risk pooling, accompanied by institution-building across all sectors (not just health and education), could go a long way toward boosting economic growth and development in Africa and elsewhere.

zh: 这种做法将产生深远的积极影响 — — 首先就是减轻移民压力。
en: The positive impact of this approach would be far-reaching – beginning with a reduction in migration pressure.

zh: 如果像新成立的“被迫流离失所者委员会”所建议的那样，针对流离失所和潜在移民人数最多的目标区域新增投资，将会产生更大的影响。
en: The impact would be even greater if new investment targeted areas with the largest number of displaced persons and migrants-in-waiting, as proposed by a new “Commission on Forced Displacement”.

zh: 投资驱动的经济发展不能取代冲突化解和政治稳定；恰恰相反，如果后者迟迟不能向前推进前者所取得的进展很可能也无法维系。
en: Investment-driven growth is no substitute for conflict resolution and political stabilization; on the contrary, the former cannot be sustained without progress on the latter.

zh: 但经济增长可以作为迫切需要的希望的重要来源 — — 也是建立和平与繁荣良性循环的开始。
en: But an economic boost could serve as an important source of much-needed hope – and the start of a virtuous circle of peace and prosperity.

zh: 阿勒颇审判
en: The Judgment of Aleppo

zh: 巴黎—我们必须阻止阿勒颇大屠杀。
en: PARIS – We must halt the massacre in Aleppo.

zh: 不惜一切代价，我们必须停止大规模随机无差别轰炸 — — 以及最糟糕的，主要以平民、人道主义车队和医院为目标的有差别轰炸 — — 巴沙尔·阿萨德的部队和俄军在这座叙利亚昔日人口最多的城市进行着这样的报复。
en: Whatever the cost, we must stop the massive, random, indiscriminate bombings – and, worst of all, the discriminate ones aimed chiefly at civilians, humanitarian convoys, and hospitals – that the forces of Bashar al-Assad and Russia have resumed with a vengeance in and around what was once Syria’s most populous city.

zh: 我们必须阻止它们，否则要不了几天（甚至几小时 ） ， 丛集炸弹、磷弹和氯气弹就将从低空盘旋在温和叛军控制的阿勒颇残部的政府军直升飞机上倾泻而下。
en: We must call a halt in the days (if not hours) ahead to the rain of steel, the cluster and phosphorus bombs, and the barrels of chlorine dropped from low-flying government helicopters on the last parts of Aleppo held by moderate rebels.

zh: 以民主国家为首的全世界不可以对这些由仍留在阿勒颇的极少数目击者所提供的骇人听闻的影像无动于衷。
en: The world, with the democracies out front, cannot fail to respond to the horrifying images, relayed by the few witnesses still there.

zh: 这些影像包括儿童枯萎的玻璃化的尸体；肢体因为缺医少药而被绝望的医生从身体上切除的伤员 — — 医生自己也很快遭到屠杀；在排队购买酸奶或面包时被火箭弹杀死的女人 — — 一如24年前的萨拉热窝；在废墟中挖掘幸存者时遭遇扫射身亡的志愿者；苟延残喘在污秽和垃圾中、早已失去生命光泽的人类。
en: Those images are of children’s shriveled, vitrified bodies; of the wounded whose limbs, for lack of drugs, have been amputated by desperate doctors who are soon massacred themselves; of women mown down by rocket fire, as in Sarajevo 24 years ago, while waiting in line to buy yogurt or bread; of volunteers struck down while digging through the rubble in search of survivors; of human beings drained of strength, surviving in filth and waste, saying goodbye to life.

zh: 我们必须制止硝烟和战火。
en: We must smother the columns of fire and smoke.

zh: 我们必须驱散从杀人犯的前所未有的先进武器中吐出的火舌。
en: We must dispel the clouds of flaming gas streaming from the murderers’ unprecedentedly sophisticated weapons.

zh: 我们必须行动，因为我们可以行动。
en: We must act because we can act.

zh: 而我们可以行动，是因为需要对这场大屠杀，对这些战争罪行，对这个城市的毁灭的人并没有藏匿起来。 他们不但犯有反人类罪，更摧毁了这座世界最重要遗产之一的城市的记忆和文化。
en: And we can act because those who are responsible for this carnage, for these war crimes, for an urbicide in which probable crimes against humanity are compounded by the destruction of sites of memory and culture that counted among the world’s vital heritage, are not hiding.

zh: 他们公然摧毁叙利亚最国际化的生机勃勃的城市，从不掩饰自己的行为。
en: They are standing in plain sight as they destroy Syria’s most cosmopolitan, wondrously alive city, doing nothing to hide their acts.

zh: 我们知道他们是谁。
en: We know who they are.

zh: 当然，我指的是大马士革政权，多年前我们就应该像对待卡扎菲政权那样处理它。
en: I mean, of course, the regime in Damascus, which years ago we should have begun to deal with as we dealt with Muammar el-Qaddafi’s regime.

zh: 我也指该政权的伊朗以及 — — 最重要的 — — 俄罗斯支持者。
en: I mean, too, the regime’s Iranian and, above all, Russian sponsors.

zh: 五年来，他们系统性地阻挠联合国所提出的每一项解决方案。
en: For five years, they have systematically blocked every attempt at a resolution emanating from the United Nations.

zh: 在多起记录详尽的例子中，俄罗斯飞机公开参与阿萨德针对平民的大规模行动。
en: Russian planes have, in several well-documented instances, openly participated in Assad’s massive campaign against civilians.

zh: 事实上，克里姆林宫日益铁心要在叙利亚实施在车臣实施过的政策，即将那些俄外交部长拉夫罗夫故技重施贴上“恐怖分子”标签的人“踢进马桶 ” 。
en: Indeed, the Kremlin appears increasingly determined to apply to Syria the policy practiced in Chechnya, namely to “kick into the crapper” those whom Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov is again mendaciously labeling “terrorists.”

zh: 基于这些事实，是否必须采取行动是显而易见的。
en: Given these facts, there is no dilemma about whether it is necessary to act.

zh: 但是，因为美国采取了与三年前一样的立场 — — 总统奥巴马选择不因为使用化学武器（这是奥巴马本人划定的红线）而惩罚阿萨德 — — 我恐怕这一责任将主要甚至全部落在欧洲头上。
en: But, because the United States adopted the position it did three years ago, after President Barack Obama chose not to punish Assad for using chemical weapons (a red line that Obama himself had drawn), I fear that the responsibility falls chiefly, if not exclusively, on Europe.

zh: 这是我们的选择。
en: It’s our choice.

zh: 我们欧洲人可以划定我们自己的红线，警告俄罗斯，如果越线，我们将收紧对俄制裁，因为从此以后它将为其叙利亚附庸的罪行负责。
en: We in Europe can draw our own red line, warning Russia that, if the line is crossed, we will increase sanctions against it as a state henceforth held to be responsible for the crimes of its Syrian vassal.

zh: 我们也可以立即采取行动成立一个磋商论坛施压，类似于两年前法国总统奥朗德和德国总理默克尔所成立的、成功遏制了乌克兰战争的“诺班底计划 ” （ Normandy format ） 。
en: We can also immediately take the initiative to establish a forum for negotiation and pressure akin to the “Normandy format” that President François Hollande and Chancellor Angela Merkel successfully conceived two years ago to contain the war in Ukraine.

zh: 这样做，我们可以迫使侵略者妥协。
en: In so acting, we can force the aggressor to come to terms.

zh: 我们也可以什么都不做，如法国驻联合国大使德拉特（François Delattre）所言那样默默接受又一个萨拉热窝；我们可以去冒出现阿拉伯格尔尼卡（Guernica）的风险，让俄罗斯战机扮演德国秃鹰军团（Condor Legion）在1936年西班牙共和国领空中的角色。
en: Or we can do nothing and acquiesce in another Sarajevo, as François Delattre, France’s ambassador to the United Nations, put it; we can run the risk of an Arab Guernica, with Russian aircraft in the role of the German Condor Legion over the skies of Republican Spain in 1936.

zh: 在这一情形中，我们不但将颜面扫地，借用丘吉尔的话说，我们还将让所有我们所面临的危险上升到极端水平，首先就是移民数量激增，其中大部分人是直接因为国际不干预而被迫逃离叙利亚。
en: In that case, we would not only reap dishonor, but also, to paraphrase Winston Churchill, raise to extreme levels all of our present dangers, starting with a dramatic increase in the tide of refugees, most of whom have fled Syria as a direct consequence of the world’s nonintervention.

zh: 我们就站在这里：已经成为废墟的深陷重围的阿勒颇，它已经精疲力竭并被全世界抛弃，但它的反抗 — — 它的死于抗争 — — 是我们的耻辱，我们的玩忽职守罪，我们的自取其辱，我们的面对野蛮暴力的投降主义，我们对惨无人道的接受。
en: This is where we stand: Aleppo, besieged and in ruins, exhausted and abandoned by the world, yet defiant – dying with its boots on – is our shame, our crime of omission, our self-abasement, our capitulation in the face of brute force, our acceptance of the worst in humanity.

zh: 阿勒颇已经不再哭喊，它已濒临死亡并在诅咒西方。
en: Aleppo, which no longer cries out, is dying and cursing the West.

zh: 而站在最前沿的欧洲的未来和一部分身份也将受到威胁 — — 它所无力保护的人们正站在欧洲边境，要求进入。
en: And Europe, on the front line, risks its future and a part of its identity as the people it could not protect press at its borders, asking to be let in.

zh: 欧洲会在阿勒颇放弃我们仅存的灵魂吗？ 还是会团结一心，昂首挺胸，完成必须完成的任务？
en: Will Europe surrender, in Aleppo, what remains of its soul, or will it pull itself together, hold up its head, and do what it must?

zh: 如果欧洲不能或不愿回答这个问题，它所面临的所有其他问题和危机都将变得不重要。
en: If Europe can’t or won’t answer that question, all of the other questions and crises it is facing may well become irrelevant.

zh: 新欧洲的老幽灵
en: New Europe’s Old Ghosts

zh: 纽约—2014年，历史纠缠着欧洲。
en: NEW YORK – The past stalked Europe in 2014.

zh: 年初，一战爆发百年吸引了无数纪念热情。
en: When the year started, the centennial of the Great War’s outbreak attracted much commemorative energy.

zh: 但是，随着2014年的深入，出现了令人担忧的比较 — — 不是和1914年，而是一些两次大战之间的更凶险的特点。
en: But, as it progressed, disturbing parallels appeared – not to 1914, but to some of the nastier features of the interwar years.

zh: 从苏格兰和加泰罗尼亚到乌克兰边境，国籍政治（politics of nationality）闹得不可开交，与此同时，欧洲经济陷入了停滞 — — 这是可追溯到1923年的德国通胀恐惧症的副作用。
en: From Scotland and Catalonia to the borders of Ukraine, the politics of nationality flared, while Europe’s economy stagnated – hostage to a German inflation phobia that dates back to 1923.

zh: 此外，随着2014年的展开，欧洲大陆两大20世纪初的巨人 — — 德国和俄罗斯之间的新的地缘政治战争角力变得日益明显，而欧洲健忘的政治精英们在各个阵线上手忙脚乱。
en: And, as the year unfolded, a new geopolitical tug of war between the continent’s two early-twentieth-century giants, Germany and Russia, became apparent, while Europe’s amnesiac political elite seemed to be fumbling on one front after another.

zh: 任何还记得但泽和苏台德的人都会觉得2014年俄罗斯总统普京在东乌克兰顿巴斯地区的复仇主义令人不安地似成相识 — — 没完没了的国籍归属主张和反主张在东欧边境引发了第二次世界大战。
en: To anyone who recalls Danzig and the Sudetenland – the endless nationality claims and counter-claims that triggered World War II in the borderlands of Eastern Europe – Russian President Vladimir Putin’s revanchism in eastern Ukraine’s Donbas region in 2014 has a disturbingly familiar ring to it.

zh: 普京的羞辱和包围论、关于少数群体权利的策略性谈话、克里姆林宫对当地代理人的利用，以及伴随依靠这些行动者而产生的诸多不确定性 — — 所有这些都让人想起两次大战期间德国自身的恢复国土政策。
en: His rhetoric of humiliation and encirclement, the instrumental talk of minority rights, and the Kremlin’s use of local proxies, with all of the uncertainties that accompany reliance on such actors – all of this was reminiscent of nothing so much as interwar Germany’s own irredentist policies.

zh: 国籍政治并不局限于东欧。
en: The politics of nationality is not confined to Eastern Europe.

zh: 9月的苏格兰独立公投大有分裂英国之势。
en: Scotland’s independence referendum in September threatened to split the United Kingdom.

zh: 同一个月，多达两百万支持独立的加泰罗尼亚人在巴塞罗那举行了游行，也许是欧洲有史以来规模最大的游行示威。
en: The same month, up to two million pro-independence Catalans marched through Barcelona, in what may have been the largest demonstration ever seen in Europe.

zh: 如果你问大部分加泰罗尼亚人，除了摆脱西班牙独立还能带来什么，你不会听到多少答案：对历史错误的仇恨压倒了任何对未来的认真算计。
en: Ask most Catalans what independence will bring, aside from freedom from Spain, and you won’t get much of an answer: resentment at past wrongs overshadows any serious calculations about the future.

zh: 但也许最纯粹的大战之间民族主义意识形态回归发生在欧洲边界之外 — — 以色列各地。
en: But perhaps the purest reversion to interwar nationalist ideology is occurring just beyond Europe’s borders – in Israel, of all places.

zh: 在以色列，总理内塔尼亚胡政府提出了一项法律，要将以色列犹太人的集体主体地位写入其中 — — 这一立法从精神和形式上摧毁了目前已经所剩无几的以色列建国承诺 — — 法律面前人人平等。
en: There, Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu’s government has proposed a law enshrining the collective primacy of the country’s Jews – legislation that destroys in spirit and form what little is left of Israel’s founding commitment to equality under the law.

zh: 关于历史狡猾的最悲哀写照莫过于此。
en: Could there be any sadder demonstration of the cunning of history?

zh: 欧洲的历史同样体现在2014年的经济中。
en: Europe’s past was equally present in the realm of economics in 2014.

zh: 拜欧盟的紧缩政策所赐，欧元区面临着日本式的停滞时代，南欧更是出现了持久居高不下的失业。
en: Thanks to the European Union’s austerity policies, the eurozone faces the prospect of a Japan-style era of stagnation, and chronic high unemployment on its southern fringe.

zh: 讽刺的是，德国对价格稳定的焦虑 — — 这也是欧盟采取紧缩的原因 — — 完全是无的放矢：德国通胀低得不能再低了。
en: The irony is that Germany’s anxieties about price stability, which underlie the EU’s embrace of austerity, are entirely misplaced: German inflation could scarcely be lower.

zh: 德国的失业率也处于历史最低水平，而意大利失业率处于历史最高水平，希腊和西班牙的失业率也高得可怕，这造就了一个两级欧洲，德国总理默克尔的政府掌握生杀大权。
en: With German unemployment, too, hitting record lows, while joblessness hits record highs in Italy and remains at obscene levels in Greece and Spain, what has emerged is a two-tier Europe, with German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s government calling the shots.

zh: 如今，外围国还认为留在欧元区内的最终好处高于紧缩带来的当下的痛苦。
en: For now, the periphery countries calculate that the eventual benefits to be gained from remaining within the eurozone will outweigh the current pain of austerity.

zh: 至于德国，它把紧缩当作它参与单一货币的交换。
en: For its part, Germany exacts austerity as the price of its participation in the single currency.

zh: 在这一并不容易的基础上，德国建立了欧洲霸权。
en: It is on this uneasy basis that its hegemony in Europe rests.

zh: 尽管去政治化和漠不关心阻止了对德国主宰地位的严重的挑战，但这类挑战正在浮现。
en: Though depoliticization and apathy have held back serious challenges to German dominance, such challenges are emerging.

zh: 德国决策者认为匈牙利和希腊等相对小国中的极端主义崛起并不重要。
en: German policymakers have discounted the rise of extremism in relatively small countries such as Hungary and Greece.

zh: 但你也许好奇他们会如何应对马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）的国民阵线（National Front）在明年法国地区选举或2017年总统选举中大获全胜的情景。
en: But one wonders how they might respond to spectacular results for Marine Le Pen’s National Front in next year’s French regional elections or in the presidential election in 2017.

zh: 当然，德国本身也是一个大谜，它似乎因为经济繁荣而迷失了历史。
en: And of course the big mystery is Germany itself, seemingly lifted from history by its own economic buoyancy.

zh: 德国政客能够在被魏玛式政治崩溃反噬之前抛弃魏玛式经济学吗？
en: Can German politicians abandon Weimar-style economics before they are hit by Weimar-style political disintegration?

zh: 即使他们最终治理好了经济，德国会与此同时丧失大部分欧洲吗？
en: And even if they manage this eventually, will Germany have lost much of Europe in the meantime?

zh: 这就引出了俄罗斯-德国对峙的一个仍在萌芽状态但已清晰可辨的信号。
en: This brings us to the nascent but unmistakable signs of a Russo-German rift.

zh: 如果说法德对峙决定了1870—1920年，那么与俄罗斯的冲突就决定了此后的70年。
en: If Franco-German rivalry shaped the era between 1870 and 1920, it was the conflict with Russia that defined the next 70 years.

zh: 冷战结束后，这一冲突被忘记了二十年，因为俄罗斯出现了内部问题，而德国渴望证明它重新统一后不会构成威胁，这让两大列强有所收敛。
en: That conflict was forgotten for two decades after the end of the Cold War, because Russia’s internal travails and Germany’s desire to demonstrate its post-unification harmlessness kept both powers from flexing their muscles.

zh: 如今，普京把耀武扬威作为其主要外交手段 — — 不仅是在乌克兰和波罗的海国家，也包括巴尔干和北海 — — 德国必须站出来领导欧洲的反应。
en: Now that Putin has made muscle-flexing his main form of diplomacy – not merely in Ukraine and the Baltic states, but also in the Balkans and the North Sea – it has fallen to Germany to shape Europe’s response.

zh: 今天的动机不是捍卫海外日耳曼人 — — 数百万日耳曼人在20世纪40年代遭到驱逐，这一担忧如今已不复存在 — — 而是更有理有利的目的 — — 面对来自东方的新集权主义，捍��民主欧盟的价值。
en: The motive today is not to defend ethnic Germans abroad – their expulsion in the millions in the 1940s ended that particular concern – so much as the more laudable desire to preserve the values of a democratic EU against the new authoritarianism from the East.

zh: 但是，德国是否能够继续担任这一角色将取决于未来几年欧盟会变成怎样。
en: Whether Germany can continue to perform this role, however, will depend on what kind of EU emerges over the next few years.

zh: 特别是，如果欧洲想要实现以德国为首的成功，德国人和其他人就必须远比现在更加果断地与历史决裂。
en: In particular, if Europe is to succeed with Germany at the helm, Germans and everyone else will have to break more decisively with the past than they have managed to do so far.

zh: 欧洲需要B计划
en: Europe Needs a Plan B

zh: 纽约 — — 欧盟是在卡尔·波普尔所谓的“零碎社会工程 ” （ piecemeal social engineering）的思想下产生的。
en: NEW YORK – The European Union was brought into existence by what Karl Popper called piecemeal social engineering.

zh: 一群具有远见卓识的政治家在“欧洲合众国”思想的启发下认定，通过设定有限目标、动员达到这些目标所需的政治意愿并最终缔结要求各国牺牲在政治上能够容忍的最大限度的主权的条约，这一目的可以逐步达到。
en: A group of farsighted statesmen, inspired by the vision of a United States of Europe, recognized that this ideal could be approached only gradually, by setting limited objectives, mobilizing the political will needed to achieve them, and concluding treaties that required states to surrender only as much sovereignty as they could bear politically.

zh: 战后的煤钢共同体就是这样最终转型为欧盟的 — — 每次都踏进一步，并且知道每一步都是不完善的、需要在适当的时候再向前迈进下一步。
en: That is how the post-war Coal and Steel Community was transformed into the EU – one step at a time, understanding that each step was incomplete and would require further steps in due course.

zh: 二战殷鉴、苏联的威胁、以及深度一体化的经济利益给了欧盟缔造者必须的政治意愿。
en: The EU’s architects generated the necessary political will by drawing on the memory of World War II, the threat posed by the Soviet Union, and the economic benefits of greater integration.

zh: 这一过程为其自身的成功奠定了基础，而苏联的解体和德国的重新统一让这一过程看上去有了非常美好的前景。
en: The process fed on its own success, and, as the Soviet Union crumbled, it received a powerful boost from the prospect of German reunification.

zh: 德国人认为，更加深入的欧洲一体化是德国重新统一的必要条件，德国愿意为此付出代价。
en: Germany recognized that it could be reunified only in the context of greater European unification, and it was willing to pay the price.

zh: 德国人通过把蛋糕做大来调解国家间利益冲突，在德国的帮助下，欧洲一体化在马斯特里赫特条约的签署和欧元的诞生中达到了高峰。
en: With the Germans helping to reconcile conflicting national interests by putting a little extra on the table, the process of European integration reached its apogee with the Maastricht Treaty and the introduction of the euro.

zh: 但欧元是一种不完全货币：只有中央银行，没有中央财政。
en: But the euro was an incomplete currency: it had a central bank but no central treasury.

zh: 欧元缔造者对这一缺陷心知肚明，但他们认为，随着需求的出现，更进一步所需要的政治意愿自然而然就会产生。
en: Its architects were fully aware of this deficiency, but believed that when the need arose, the political will could be summoned to take the next step forward.

zh: 但事实并非如此，因为欧元还具有其缔造者所未察觉的缺陷。
en: That is not what happened, because the euro had other deficiencies of which its architects were unaware.

zh: 他们是在一个错误的观念下徒劳地工作着 — — 金融市场能够纠正其自身的过剩，因此只需设计解决公共部门过剩问题的规则就行了。
en: They labored under the misconception that financial markets can correct their own excesses, so the rules were designed to rein in only public-sector excesses.

zh: 而即使在公共部门问题上，他们也过度地依赖于主权国家的自主决策。
en: And, even there, they relied too heavily on self-policing by sovereign states.

zh: 但过剩主要出现在私人部门，因为利率趋同造成了经济趋异：低利率在疲软国家吹起了房地产泡沫，而最强劲的国家德国却不得不勒紧裤腰带，以应对重新统一带来的负担。
en: But the excesses were mainly in the private sector, as interest-rate convergence generated economic divergence: lower interest rates in the weaker countries fueled housing bubbles, while the strongest country, Germany, had to tighten its belt in order to cope with the burden of reunification.

zh: 与此同时，普遍使用的不健全金融工具和欠审慎的贷款行为严重拖累了金融部门。
en: Meanwhile, the financial sector was thoroughly compromised by the spread of unsound financial instruments and poor lending practices.

zh: 随着德国的重新统一，欧洲一体化进程的主要推动力已经不复存在，金融危机则拉开了欧洲分裂的序幕。
en: With Germany’s reunification, the main impetus behind the integration process was removed, the financial crisis unleashed a process of disintegration.

zh: 决定性的时刻发生在雷曼兄弟公司倒闭后，各国必须保证不会再有具系统重要性的金融机构破产。
en: The decisive moment came after Lehman Brothers collapsed, and authorities had to guarantee that no other systemically important financial institution would be allowed to fail.

zh: 德国总理默克尔坚持认为不应该实行欧盟联合担保，各国必须自己打扫自己的后院。
en: German Chancellor Angela Merkel insisted that there should be no joint EU guarantee; each country would have to take care of its own institutions.

zh: 这就是今日欧元危机的根源。
en: That was the root cause of today’s euro crisis.

zh: 金融危机迫使主权国家用其自身信用来取代破产信用，欧洲也不例外，每个国家必须各扫门前雪，这就使人们对欧洲政府债券的可信度产生了怀疑。
en: The financial crisis forced sovereign states to substitute their own credit for the credit that had collapsed, and in Europe each state had to do so on its own, calling into question the creditworthiness of European government bonds.

zh: 风险溢价扩大了，欧元区被分解为债权国和债务国。
en: Risk premiums widened, and the eurozone was divided into creditor and debtor countries.

zh: 德国的角色出现了180度大转弯：从欧洲一体化的主要推动者变成了“转移联盟”的主要反对者。
en: Germany had changed course 180 degrees from the main driver of integration was to the main opponent of a “transfer union.”

zh: 这就造成了速度不一的两个欧洲，债务国在债务重压逐渐沉没，而盈余国则在大步向前。
en: This created a two-speed Europe, with debtor countries sinking under the weight of their liabilities, and surplus countries forging ahead.

zh: 最大债权国德国可以对援助计划指手画脚 — — 这一计划带有惩罚性质，可能使债务国走向破产。
en: As the largest creditor, Germany could dictate the terms of assistance, which were punitive and pushed debtor countries towards insolvency.

zh: 与此同时，德国是欧元危机的受益者，因为这压低了汇率，进一步提振了德国的竞争力。
en: Meanwhile, Germany benefited from the euro crisis, which depressed the exchange rate and boosted its competitiveness further.

zh: 随着一体化转变为分裂，欧盟上层建筑的作用也发生了逆转，从走向统一的先锋队变为了捍卫现状的保守派。
