en: As integration has turned into disintegration, the role of the European political establishment has also reversed, from spearheading further unification to defending the status quo.

zh: 结果，任何人只要认为现状不合意、不可接受、不可持续，他就必须加入反欧洲立场联盟。
en: As a result, anyone who considers the status quo undesirable, unacceptable, or unsustainable has had to take an anti-European stance.

zh: 而随着债务国逐渐走向破产，民族主义政党（比如芬兰的真正芬兰人党及其他同类欧洲政党）开始逐渐强势。
en: And, as heavily indebted countries are pushed towards insolvency, nationalist political parties – for example, Finland’s True Finns – have grown stronger, alongside more established counterparts elsewhere in Europe.

zh: 但欧洲上层建筑仍在辩解称，现状不可替代。
en: Yet Europe’s political establishment continues to argue that there is no alternative to the status quo.

zh: 金融当局为了赢得时间不惜饮鸩止渴。
en: Financial authorities resort to increasingly desperate measures in order to buy time.

zh: 但时间并不与他们站在同一条战壕里：两种速度的欧洲正在使成员之间的距离国越拉越大。
en: But time is working against them: two-speed Europe is driving member countries further apart.

zh: 希腊正在迈向无序违约和/或货币贬值，其后果难以预料。
en: Greece is heading towards disorderly default and/or devaluation with incalculable consequences.

zh: 要遏制甚至逆转这一不可避免的进程，希腊和欧元区均必须采取B计划。 希腊违约已成无可不免之势，但可以以有序的方式发生。
en: If this seemingly inexorable process is to be arrested and reversed, both Greece and the eurozone must urgently adopt a Plan B. A Greek default may be inevitable, but it need not be disorderly.

zh: 希腊违约必然会造成某种程度的传染 — — 希腊发生的一切都可能在葡萄牙再度出现，和爱尔兰的财政状况也可能变得不可持续 — — 因此其他欧元区国家必须筑起高墙。
en: And, while some contagion will be unavoidable – whatever happens to Greece is likely to spread to Portugal, and Ireland’s financial position, too, could become unsustainable – the rest of the eurozone needs to be ring-fenced.

zh: 这意味着欧元走强，而后者又可能要求欧元债券的更广泛的使用以及某种意义上的泛欧元区存款保险机制。
en: That means strengthening the eurozone, which would probably require wider use of Eurobonds and a eurozone-wide deposit-insurance scheme of some kind.

zh: 要产生政治意愿要求欧盟本身也采取B计划。
en: Generating the political will would require a Plan B for the EU itself.

zh: 欧洲精英必须还原欧盟创立的指导原则，认识到我们对现实的理解具有先天性的不完美，而观念注定是有偏颇的，机构注定是有缺陷的。
en: The European elite needs to revert to the principles that guided the Union’s creation, recognizing that our understanding of reality is inherently imperfect, and that perceptions are bound to be biased and institutions flawed.

zh: 开放社会从不将现行安排视为神圣不可侵犯，当先行安排失灵的时候，开放社会并不排斥替代方案。
en: An open society does not treat prevailing arrangements as sacrosanct; it allows for alternatives when those arrangements fail.

zh: 用“当现状已不再能够持续时，我们应该寻求欧洲解决方案，而不是各国各自为政”这一思想将亲欧洲的沉默的大多数动员起来并非不可能。
en: It should be possible to mobilize a pro-European silent majority behind the idea that when the status quo becomes untenable, we should look for a European solution rather than national ones.

zh: “欧洲人”的数量肯定要多于真正的芬兰人和德国和其他地方的反欧人士。
en: “True Europeans” ought to outnumber true Finns and other anti-Europeans in Germany and elsewhere.

zh: 必要的移民
en: Necessary Migrants

zh: 柏林 — — 球迷高举横幅欢迎饱受战争蹂躏的中东难民，踏上德国的土地是如此感人至深。
en: BERLIN – How heartwarming it is to land in Germany, where football fans hold up banners welcoming refugees from the war-ravaged Middle East.

zh: 德国是绝望及受压迫者、战争和掠夺幸存者崭新的乐土。
en: Germany is the new Promised Land for the desperate and downtrodden, the survivors of war and pillage.

zh: 就连德国不常做好事的流行小报都表示愿意帮助难民。
en: Even the popular German tabloids, not normally of a do-gooding disposition, are promoting a willingness to help.

zh: 当英国和其他国家的政客撮着手解释为什么就连数量相对较少的叙利亚、利比亚和伊拉克或厄立特里亚难民都对其社会结构构成致命威胁的时候 ， “ 默克尔妈妈”却承诺德国不会拒绝任何真正的难民。
en: While politicians in the United Kingdom and other countries wring their hands and explain why even a relatively minor influx of Syrians, Libyans, Iraqis, or Eritreans constitutes a lethal danger to the social fabric of their societies, “Mama Merkel” promised that Germany would not reject any genuine refugee.

zh: 预计今年将有约800,000名难民进入到德国境内，而英国首相戴维·卡梅伦却为不到 30,000份庇护申请大惊小怪，不怀好意地警告穿越北海的“大批人群 ” 。
en: Some 800,000 refugees are expected to enter Germany this year, whereas British Prime Minister David Cameron is making a fuss about fewer than 30,000 asylum applications and warning darkly about “swarms of people” crossing the North Sea.

zh: 而且和默克尔不同的是，卡梅伦要为煽动利比亚战争，导致数百人民众生活无法忍受承担一定的责任。
en: And, unlike Merkel, Cameron was partly responsible for stoking one of the wars (Libya) that made life intolerable for millions.

zh: 难怪默克尔希望其他欧洲国家在强制配额制度下接收更多的难民。
en: No wonder Merkel wants other European countries to take in more refugees under a mandatory quota system.

zh: 事实上，尽管政客们说得吓人，但与德国相比英国多民族杂居度更高，某些方面开放度也更大。
en: In fact, despite its politicians’ anxious rhetoric, the United Kingdom is a more ethnically mixed, and in some ways more open, society than Germany.

zh: 伦敦的国际化程度远超柏林或法兰克福。
en: London is incomparably more cosmopolitan than Berlin or Frankfurt.

zh: 而且从总体上看，英国已大大受益于移民潮。
en: And, on the whole, Britain has greatly benefited from immigration.

zh: 事实上，国家卫生局已经警告减少移民接收人数将导致英国医院严重人手不足，并将带来灾难性的后果。
en: Indeed, the National Health Service has warned that accepting fewer immigrants would be catastrophic, leaving British hospitals seriously understaffed.

zh: 当今德国的心态可能绝无仅有。
en: The mood in contemporary Germany may be exceptional.

zh: 接收难民或任何移民从来就不是轻而易举的政治推销。
en: Taking in refugees, or any immigrants, has never been an easy political sell.

zh: 20世纪30年代末，当德国和奥地利犹太人遭受致命威胁时，没有几个国家（包括富裕的美国在内）愿意接收超过少量的难民。
en: In the late 1930s, when Jews in Germany and Austria were in mortal danger, few countries, including the wealthy United States, were prepared to take in more than a handful of refugees.

zh: 1939年最后时刻英国允许约10，000名犹太儿童前来英国，但前提是他们在当地要有人抚养，并且离开自己的父母。
en: Britain allowed about 10,000 Jewish children to come in 1939, at the very last minute, but only if they had local sponsors and left their parents behind.

zh: 将德国今天的慷慨姿态与过去的残暴行为相联系无助于理解这一问题。
en: To say that the generous mood in Germany today has much to do with the murderous behavior of Germans in the past is not to make light of it.

zh: 日本人也背负着历史罪行，但他们对外国人的态度却远没有那么友好。
en: The Japanese, too, carry a burden of historical crimes, but their attitude to foreigners in distress is far less welcoming.

zh: 尽管鲜有德国人留有对第三帝国的亲身记忆，但很多人仍然感到有必要证明他们已经从国家历史中吸取了教训。
en: Even though few Germans have any personal memories of the Third Reich, many still feel the need to prove that they have learned from their country’s history.

zh: 但政治家和媒体对当前难民危机全心全意的关注掩盖了更广泛的移民问题。
en: But the almost exclusive focus by politicians and the media on the current refugee crisis conceals wider immigration issues.

zh: 可怜的难民家庭在贪婪的走私者和歹徒支配下在海上漂流的图片很容易激发怜悯和同情（而且不只是在德国 ） 。
en: Images of miserable refugee families drifting in the sea, at the mercy of rapacious smugglers and gangsters, can easily inspire feelings of pity and compassion (and not just in Germany).

zh: 但跨越欧洲边境找工作和建立新生活的多数都不是难民。
en: Even Cameron has had to soften his tone, promising to accept a few thousand refugees, because he was moved “as a father” by the picture of a drowned Syrian boy.

zh: 当英国官员说2014年抵达和离开英国者相差300，000人“显然令人失望 ” ， 他们所指的主要不是寻求庇护的难民。
en: But most people crossing European borders to find work and build new lives are not refugees. When British officials said that it was “clearly disappointing” that about 300,000 more people came to Britain than left in 2014, they were not mainly talking about asylum-seekers.

zh: 新入境者大多来自波兰、罗马尼亚和保加利亚等其他欧盟成员国。
en: The majority of these newcomers are from other European Union countries, such as Poland, Romania, and Bulgaria.

zh: 有人前来求学，也有人来找工作。
en: Some enter as students, and some come to find jobs.

zh: 他们来不是为了活命，而是为了改善生活。
en: They do not come to save their lives, but to improve them.

zh: 将庇护寻求者和经济移民混为一谈损害了难民的信誉，仿佛他们为了挤进边界而蒙混过关。
en: By lumping asylum-seekers together with economic migrants, the latter are discredited, as though they were trying to squeeze in under false pretenses.

zh: 人们普遍认为来自欧盟内外的经济移民主要靠相对富裕阶层的税收生活。
en: It is widely assumed that economic migrants, from inside or outside the EU, are mainly poor people out to live off the tax money of the relatively rich.

zh: 其实他们多数人不是寄生虫。
en: In fact, most of them are not spongers.

zh: 他们想要工作。
en: They want to work.

zh: 对宗主国的好处很容易看得到：经济移民往往工作更卖力，挣的钱还更少。
en: The benefits to the host countries are easy to see: Economic migrants often work harder for less money than locals.

zh: 这肯定不符合所有人的利益：指出廉价劳动力的好处不会说服那些工资受影响者。
en: This is not in everyone’s interest, to be sure: Pointing out the benefits of cheap labor will not persuade people whose wages might be undercut.

zh: 无论如何，即使在德国，接受经济移民总比争取对难民的同情难度要大。
en: It is, in any case, easier to appeal to compassion for refugees than to the acceptance of economic migrants. Even in Germany.

zh: 2000年，德国总理施罗德想为约2，000名外国高科技专家颁发工作签证，其中有不少人来自印度。
en: In 2000, German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder wanted to issue work visas to about 20,000 foreign high-tech experts, many of them from India.

zh: 德国非常需要他们，但施罗德迅速激起了抵制力量。
en: Germany needed them badly, but Schröder met swift opposition.

zh: 一位政客专门发明了标语 “Kinder statt Inder ” （ 要孩子不要印度佬 ） 。
en: One politician coined the slogan “Kinder statt Inder” (children instead of Indians).

zh: 但德国人像其他富国民众一样，并未生育足够的儿童。
en: But Germans, like many other rich countries’ citizens, are not producing enough children.

zh: 上述国家需要有活力有技能的年轻移民，填补当地人无论出于何种原因不能或不愿接受的工作。
en: These countries need immigrants with youthful energy and skills to fill jobs that locals, for whatever reason, are unable or unwilling to take.

zh: 这并不意味着必须向所有人开放边界。
en: This does not mean that all borders must be opened to everyone.

zh: 默克尔的难民配额理念对经济移民也应该适用。
en: Merkel’s idea of quotas on refugees should be applied to economic migrants, too.

zh: 但迄今为止，欧盟还没有制定出统一的移民政策。
en: So far, however, the EU has not come up with a coherent policy on migration.

zh: 欧盟民众在欧盟内部可以自由迁徙（英国也想阻止这一点，但却不太可能成功 ） 。
en: Citizens of the EU can move freely within the Union (Britain wants to stop this, too, though it is unlikely to succeed).

zh: 但在审慎监管下从非欧盟国家引进经济移民既合理合法也十分必要。
en: But economic migration from non-EU countries, under carefully managed conditions, is both legitimate and imperative.

zh: 这绝非因为移民应该得到欧洲人的同情，而是因为欧洲自身的需要。
en: This is not because the migrants deserve Europeans’ sympathy, but because Europe needs them.

zh: 这绝非轻而易举的过程。
en: It will not be easy.

zh: 多数民众较之冷静的利益考量似乎更容易受情绪支配 — — 这在特定条件下会导致大规模屠杀或温暖的同情。
en: Most people appear to be more easily swayed by emotions – which can lead them to mass murder or warm compassion, depending on the circumstances – than by the cool calculus of rational self-interest.

zh: 欧洲的愿景赤字
en: Europe needs to make up its mind

zh: 本月罗马条约50周年的庆祝来得正是时候。
en: The celebrations to mark the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Rome this month come at an opportune moment.

zh: 因为，现在是欧盟结束其在法国和荷兰拒绝欧盟宪法后自我实行的“反思阶段 ” ， 并且重新开始50年前在罗马开始的联合进程的时候了。
en: For now is the time for the European Union to call an end to its self-imposed “reflection period” following the rejection of the European Constitution by the French and the Dutch, and make up its mind about the future.

zh: 这一反思阶段毫无实际反思，而欧洲领导人并未向欧洲公民提出任何新的根本性愿景。
en: The reflection period has been mostly devoid of actual reflection, and Europe’s leaders have failed to offer Europe’s citizens any new, fundamental vision.

zh: 那么，德国总理默克尔在其有关欧洲政策的首次议会声明中所称的欧洲“重建”又如何实现呢？
en: So how should a “refounding” (Neubegründung) of Europe – as called for by German Chancellor Angela Merkel in her first parliamentary statement on European policy – be accomplished?

zh: 在理论上，在欧盟的未来上存在三种相互竞争、根本不同的愿景。
en: In theory, there are three competing, fundamentally different visions of the EU’s future.

zh: 有些依旧采取“民族国家的国家”形式。
en: Some still take the form of a “state of nation states.”

zh: 这些思想家经常被错误地称为“联邦主义者 ” 。 他们把欧盟宪法称为朝向欧洲联邦的必要一步。
en: These thinkers – often imprecisely called “Federalists” – refer to the Constitution as a necessary step towards a European federation.

zh: 人们宣称民族国家的道义实质被过往的敌对所大幅削弱而给这样一种联邦提供理由，或者联邦可以作为限制潜在的新冲突的切实的预防性措施。
en: Such a federal state can be justified by claiming that the moral substance of traditional nation states has been deeply compromised by past belligerence, or as a practical preventive measure to keep the potential of new nationalist passions in check.

zh: 而且，英国政治学家摩根曾经说，一个强有力的泛欧身份认同概念同样要求泛欧国家，欧洲的精英们如果维持对美国的永久性战略依赖立场是不负责任的。
en: Moreover, the British political scientist Glyn Morgan has argued that a robust concept of pan-European security also requires a pan-European state, and that it is irresponsible on the part of Europe’s elites to maintain a permanent position of strategic dependency on the United States.

zh: 与这一观念有关的是，只有一个强大的欧洲才能够挽救“欧洲社会模式 ” 。
en: Related to this is the idea that only a strong EU can save the “European social model.”

zh: 但是，过去几年已经表明，组成欧洲的国家大多数并不支持联邦，有关被否决的欧盟宪法的辩论强调了这一点。
en: But the last few years have made clear the absence of majority support for a European federation by the states that make up Europe, a point underscored by the debate surrounding the failed Constitutional Treaty.

zh: 实际上，许多“联邦主义者”的论点看起来是可疑的。 特别是，不存在单一的欧洲社会模式。
en: In fact, many of the “federalist” arguments look dubious: in particular, there is no single European social model.

zh: 举例来说，斯堪的那维亚国家、地中海国家以及像爱尔兰和英国那样的“自由的大西洋国家”之间的差别在某些时候要比欧洲整体和美国之间的差别还要大。
en: The differences for instance between the Scandinavian countries, the Mediterranean countries, and the “liberal Atlantic countries” like Ireland and the UK are sometimes more pronounced than those between Europe as a whole and the US.

zh: 近年来，有关欧盟的另一个观点已经植根，那就是所谓的“超国家多元文化主义 ” 。
en: In recent years, an alternative view of the EU that can be described as “supra-national multiculturalism” has taken root.

zh: 这一观点要求欧盟的主要功用是允许并维护多样性和差别。
en: This view entails a Union whose main function is to allow – and to maintain – diversity and difference.

zh: 这一欧洲并不是寻求成为传统单一同质国家，而是“多元化的社区 ” 。 借用法学家维勒的词语来说就是一种“你中有我，我中有你 ” 。
en: Instead of traditional homogeneous states, this Europe seeks to be a “Community of Difference,” a kind of “People of Others,” to borrow a phrase from the jurist Joseph Weiler.

zh: 在这一愿景中，宽容成为基本的欧洲美德，而欧盟的特性作为具有联邦法律而无联邦国体的实体被认为是一种优势，而非弱点。
en: Tolerance becomes the cardinal European virtue in this vision, and the EU’s character as an entity with federal law but without federal statehood is viewed as a strength, not a weakness.

zh: 因此，超国家多元文化主义也就拒绝联邦民主。
en: The prophets of supra-national multiculturalism thus reject a federal democracy.

zh: 他们相信，可行的情况最多是所谓的“多民民主 ” ， 也就是，不是单个民族的统治，而是多个民族的统治。 这些多个民族有意确保并寻求维持他们的多样性。
en: What is feasible is, they believe, at best a so-called “demoi-cracy” -- that is, the rule not of one people or “demos,” but of many peoples or “demoi” who deliberately assure and seek to maintain their diversity.

zh: 这一愿景的要素看似引人入胜。
en: Elements of this vision sound attractive.

zh: 但是，欧洲各国领导人促进这种泛欧多元文化主义，同时又极力谴责国内被指称的“多元文化主义者”幻觉。 这已经在几乎所有国家成为标准的政治说教。
en: It is questionable, though, how credible European heads of government are who promote such pan-European multiculturalism and at the same time emphatically denounce alleged “multiculturalist” illusions at home – as has by now become standard political rhetoric in almost all countries.

zh: 第三个愿景基本上是根本没有愿景，而是为如今存在的欧盟官僚体制辩解。
en: The third vision is essentially no vision at all, but a justification of the Brussels bureaucracy as it currently exists.

zh: 从这一技术官僚观点来看，今天的布鲁塞尔维持了某些功能，而即使在某些民族国家内部，这些功能都经常被分派到不是民主选举产生的机构中。
en: From this technocratic perspective, Brussels today maintains functions that even within nation states are often delegated to institutions that are not democratically elected.

zh: 中央银行是一个经典的例子。
en: Central banks are the classic example.

zh: 公民们认为最为重要的政策领域，特别是社会政策和教育，依旧在欧盟成员国的指导之下。
en: Those policy areas that citizens consider the most significant – in particular welfare and education – remain under the direction of member states.

zh: 结果，布鲁塞尔不再是一个政府，而是一个管理当局，而这经常对欧洲消费者有利。
en: Consequently Brussels is no government to be, but a regulatory authority – and this often to the benefit of European consumers.

zh: 技术官僚们宣称，这一当局反过来是国家内部和超国家制衡制度的一部分。 这一制度尽管并不像国内民主，但可以可靠地防止专制主义在布鲁塞尔生根。
en: This authority, the technocrats claim, in turn is part of a system of national and supra-national checks and balances which, while not resembling a national democracy, would reliably prevent despotism from taking root in Brussels.

zh: 这三个愿景并不完全偏离欧盟的现实或者其未来可能。
en: None of these three visions entirely misses the EU’s current reality or its future possibilities.

zh: 联邦已经遥不可及，但依旧在政客们的讲话中获得敬意，好像不同的结局是不可思议的那样。
en: The federation has become a distant prospect, but still receives homage in politicians’ speeches, as if a different end result was inconceivable.

zh: 多民民主派赢得支持，是因为他们的愿景趋向于强化现实状况并且让几乎所有的选择都有可能。
en: The demoi-crats win support because their vision tends to reinforce the status quo and leaves nearly all options open.

zh: 技术官僚们反过来认为他们的立场随着时间的推移得到确定，以至于被指称的合法性危机没有显现。
en: The technocrats in turn see their position confirmed with every passing day that the alleged crisis of legitimacy fails to appear.

zh: 但是是否存在一个泛欧洲的政治理解，可以就此达成共识，或者实现多数呢？
en: But is there any kind of pan-European consensus on where Europe should go next, whether federal state, demoi-cracy or status quo?

zh: 如果答案是否定的话，那么，坚持以现实主义的做法处理欧盟，将其作为“联邦体”则可以替代高瞻远瞩的愿景。 经典的论点是，欧盟就像是一辆自行车，必须总是向前以避免倒下。
en: If the answer is no, adhering to a pragmatic approach to the Union as a kind of continuously expanding “Commonwealth” is the most honest alternative to any high-minded visions.

zh: 这一论点根本是不正确的。 反思阶段对于联邦主义者而言可能是沮丧的，但是它同时也证明，欧盟即使在停滞阶段依旧继续。
en: The classic argument that the EU, like a bicycle, must always keep moving forward to avoid falling over, is simply not true: the reflection period may be frustrating for federalists, but it also proves that, even at a standstill, the EU continues.

zh: 布鲁塞尔的精英们不大可能不再骚扰就承认这一事实。 他们的高谈阔论依旧在极度悲观主义和某种亲欧洲的公共关系之间摇摆不定。
en: The Brussels elites are not likely to admit this fact without further ado: their rhetoric still oscillates between doom-and-gloom pessimism and a kind of pro-European PR that is concerned only with how best to “sell” the Union to Europe’s citizens.

zh: 这一亲欧洲的公关只是关心如何最好地向欧洲公民“兜售”欧盟。 但是，如果没有能够兜售自己的愿景，那时不可能的。
en: But PR won’t work unless there is a vision that ultimately sells itself.

zh: 欧洲近邻的新增长模式
en: A New Growth Model for Europe’s Neighborhood

zh: 伦敦—全球金融危机已经过去了十年多，世界经济终于迎来了广泛复苏。
en: LONDON – More than ten years after the global financial crisis, the world economy is finally enjoying a broad-based recovery.

zh: 欧洲及其广大近邻也不例外：在中东欧、中亚、中东、北非以及俄罗斯和土耳其，几乎所有国家经济增长去年增长都有所提高，预计未来也将保持强劲增长。
en: Europe and its broader neighborhood are no exception: economic growth in almost every country in Central and Eastern Europe, Central Asia, the Middle East, and North Africa, as well as in Russia and Turkey, has accelerated in the last year, and is projected to remain robust.

zh: 但新挑战呼之欲出。
en: Yet new challenges loom.

zh: 如果不加以解决，这些地区前途堪忧。
en: If not addressed, these regions’ prospects will dim.

zh: 欧洲复兴开发银行的新《转型报告 》 （ Transition Report）显示，大衰退前欧洲及其广大近邻诸国表现要好于其他地区的可比新兴经济体。
en: As the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development’s new Transition Report shows, before the Great Recession, the countries of Europe and its broader neighborhood were outperforming comparable emerging economies elsewhere.

zh: 但在最近几年中，情况发生了逆转，并且差距不断扩大。
en: In recent years, however, the tables have turned – and the gap is growing.

zh: 原因很简单。
en: The explanation is straightforward.

zh: 此前，欧洲及其广大近邻享受了较高的全要素生产率增长。
en: Previously, Europe and its broader neighborhood enjoyed high total factor productivity (TFP) growth.

zh: 这些国家取摆脱了源自社会主义或其他国家干预主义历史所造成的低效率，将资本和劳动力用于更加合适的用途。
en: By eliminating many of the inefficiencies inherited from their socialist or otherwise dirigiste pasts, these countries were putting their capital and labor to increasingly good use.

zh: 但到了2009年，容易的果实已经摘尽，固定资本投资下降到其他新兴经济体水平之下。
en: Yet, by 2009, the low-hanging fruit had been picked, and investment in fixed capital had fallen below the levels in emerging economies elsewhere.

zh: 面临大量危机所产生的不良贷款的这些国家的注意力转到了去杠杆化上，投资和全要素生产率增长陷入停滞。
en: Faced with the large amounts of non-performing loans inherited from the crisis, countries shifted their attention to deleveraging, leaving investment and TFP growth to stall.

zh: 欧洲及其广大近邻诸国 — — 即使是其中的较不发达经济体 — — 无法依靠低工资比较优势实现长期增长。
en: Countries in Europe and its broader neighborhood – even those whose economies are less developed – cannot base long-term growth on a low-wage comparative advantage.

zh: 相反，它们必须为未来导向的增长模式打好基础，而其根本在于加强人力资本和创新。
en: Instead, they must lay the foundations of future-oriented growth models, underpinned by stronger human capital and innovation.

zh: 这首先要求更加深入地融入全球经济。
en: This demands, first and foremost, deeper integration into the global economy.

zh: 如今，能够进入更大的市场是产生创新红色生产率增长激励的关键。
en: Nowadays, access to larger markets is vital to generating incentives for innovation and productivity growth.

zh: 欧盟国家显然因为单一市场而获益良多。
en: European Union countries obviously benefit from the single market.

zh: 但对新兴欧洲和中东和北非（MENA）国家来说，利用规模经济需要降低贸易壁垒、加强联动性。
en: For emerging Europe and the countries of the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), however, taking advantage of economies of scale will require reduced trade barriers and better connectivity.

zh: 具体而言，这意味着新兴欧洲和MENA地区需要加强基础设施投资。
en: In concrete terms, this means that emerging Europe and the MENA region need to invest more in infrastructure.

zh: 而事实上，据《转型报告》的估算，这些地区的基础设施投资要求高达约2.2万亿欧元。
en: And, in fact, according to the Transition Report’s estimates, these regions’ infrastructure investment requirements amount to about €2.2 trillion ($2.6 trillion).

zh: 要满足这一需求，财政吃紧的国家必须通过公私合作来动员私人资源。
en: To meet this need, fiscally constrained countries will have to mobilize private resources, via private-public partnerships.

zh: 发达国家行动方常常担忧新兴经济体的基础设施投资会导致“断头路 ” ， 资金被用在了没什么人居住或现有居民急切地想要利用这些新造好的公路逃之大吉的偏远地区。
en: Developed-country actors often worry that infrastructure investments in emerging economies may result in “roads to nowhere,” with money being channeled toward remote regions where nobody lives or from which existing residents are eager to leave, using those shiny new roads.

zh: 但并不总是如此。
en: But this does not have to be the case.

zh: 土耳其是一个很好的例子。
en: Turkey is a case in point.

zh: 2002年，土耳其实施了一项浩大工程，在十年时间里将25%的公路网络拓宽为双车道。
en: In 2002, the country launched a major effort to turn 25% of its road network into dual carriageways over the course of about ten years.

zh: 欧洲复兴开发银行的《转型报告》分析表明，这项投资对国内贸易和此前不发达的东部地区的就业创造都产生了重要影响。
en: The EBRD’s Transition Report’s analysis shows that this investment has had a major impact on domestic trade and created jobs in the country’s previously underdeveloped eastern regions.

zh: 各国在为自身基础设施项目招商引资时，应该从这样的成功案例中汲取经验，并向潜在出资者进行宣传。
en: As countries attempt to attract financing for their own infrastructure projects, they should learn from – and highlight for potential donors – such successes.

zh: 制定有效的长期基础设施投资战略需要关注的另一项关键领域是环境。
en: Designing effective strategies for long-term infrastructure investment requires attention to another key area: the environment.

zh: 各国必须预备面对为了（比如）兑现巴黎气候协定承诺而必须做出的监管变化。
en: Countries must anticipate the regulatory changes that will arise, as they attempt, say, to meet their commitments under the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 这一方针与市场共识一致。
en: This approach is in line with the market consensus.

zh: 欧洲复兴开发银行用据富时罗素低碳经济（FTSE Russell Low Carbon Economy）数据库的数据发现，尽管绿色企业的盈利能力较之可持续性较差的同行仍显不足 — — 毕竟绿色企业大多比较年轻，规模也较小 — — 但增长很快。
en: Using the FTSE Russell Low Carbon Economy database, the ERBD found that while greener firms remain less profitable than their less sustainable counterparts – they are, after all, largely younger and smaller – they are growing faster.

zh: 也许更重要的是，我们发现绿色收入较高的企业，股市估值（市盈率）也较高，即使它们当前权益回报率要低于它们的非绿色同行。
en: Perhaps more important, we found that firms with a higher share of green revenues have higher stock-market valuations (price-to-earnings ratios), even if their current return on equity is lower than that of their non-green peers.

zh: 这表明，投资者预期绿色市场细分能产生更强的增长，或至少愿意赋予更高估值来支持绿色企业。
en: This suggests that investors expect stronger growth in greener market segments, or at least attach more value to supporting greener firms.

zh: 在化石燃料价格较高的地区，企业本身也认识到更加绿色、能源效率更高的技术的好处。
en: In places where fossil fuels are adequately priced, firms themselves also recognize the benefits of greener, more energy-efficient technologies.

zh: 不幸的是，许多国家仍然实施巨额能源补贴，要想推动绿色经济转型，这一补贴必须取消。
en: Unfortunately, many countries still have in place substantial energy subsidies, which must be phased out to propel the shift toward a green economy.

zh: 为了确保最有需要的家庭不会蒙受损失，取消补贴必须辅之以定向补助，最近的白俄罗斯、埃及和乌克兰都采取了这样的做法。
en: To ensure that the neediest households do not suffer, the removal of subsidies can be offset by targeted assistance, as has been done recently in Belarus, Egypt, and Ukraine.

zh: 欧洲近邻的新增长模式还必须包括金融系统的再平衡。
en: A new growth model for Europe’s neighborhood must also involve a rebalancing of the financial system.

zh: 考虑到大萧条带来的不良贷款的遗留问题，新投资项目的融资更可能来自股本而非债务。
en: Given the Great Recession’s legacy of non-performing loans, financing for new investment is more likely to come from equity than from debt.

zh: 幸运的是，权益投资者也开始转向长期视角，越来越愿意购买绿色资产。
en: Fortunately, equity investors are also oriented toward the long term, and are increasingly willing to buy greener assets.

zh: 但更多依靠权益融资要求更好的国家和公司治理，而这又需要以法治为基础。
en: Yet greater reliance on equity finance will require better state and corporate governance, underpinned by the rule of law.

zh: 实现这一点绝非易事，但欧洲复兴开发银行的研究表明，至少在欧洲近邻，这方面的进步不但能够令经济 — — 包括通过促进投资和创新实现 — — 受益，也将惠及整体环境和社会。
en: Achieving that will be no easy feat. But EBRD research implies that, at least in the European neighborhood, progress would benefit not just the economy – including by promoting investment and innovation – but also the environment and society as a whole.

zh: 这样的投资是非常值得的。
en: That is an investment worth making.

zh: 为何欧洲需要纸币
en: Why Europe Still Needs Cash

zh: 发自法兰克福 — — 欧洲的支付体系如今正是风气云涌之际。
en: FRANKFURT – Payment systems in Europe are facing upheaval.

zh: 数字革命为交易结算提供了比以往更快捷，更方便的手段，以至于现金看似已经穷途末路。
en: With the digital revolution offering ever-faster and more convenient means for settling transactions, cash seems to some to have no future.

zh: 然而抹杀钞票和硬币在经济中所扮演的角色可是要犯错误的。
en: But to write off the role of banknotes and coins in the economy would be a mistake.

zh: 近年以来非现金支付方式不断增加。
en: Non-cash payment options have been proliferating in recent years.

zh: 信用卡，在线转帐和直接付款技术都已极为成熟。
en: Credit cards, online transfers, and direct-debit payments are already well established.

zh: 支持智能手机的数字支付解决方案和手机钱包也在攻城拔寨。
en: Now, smartphone-enabled digital-payment solutions and mobile wallets are also gaining ground.

zh: 而一些潜在的破坏性创新（如分布式分类账技术）的出现也表明，进一步的根本性变革可能为时不远了。
en: The emergence of potentially disruptive innovations like distributed ledger technologies indicate that further and possibly fundamental change may be on the horizon.

zh: 在这些新生的选项之外，还有一些研究正在为消灭现金寻找依据。
en: Independent of these new and incipient options, there are a number of studies making the case to abolish cash.

zh: 而无现金社会的倡导者一般会分为三个不同的阵营。
en: Advocates of a cashless society tend to fall into three distinct camps.

zh: 第一阵营是一帮炼金术士，他们想要突破零利率下限对货币政策所施加的限制。
en: The first camp, the alchemists, wants to overcome the restrictions that the zero lower bound (ZLB) imposes on monetary policy.

zh: 第二阵营是想要取缔现金这种非法活动主要支付方式的法律与秩序派。
en: The second, the law and order camp, wants to cancel the primary means of payment for illicit activities.

zh: 而位处第三个阵营的金融技术联盟则在筹划一旦免除了金融业当前现金存储，发行和营运等高额成本之后所产生的巨大商机。
en: And the third camp, the fintech (financial technology) alliance, anticipates major business opportunities arising from the elimination of the high storage, issuance, and handling costs of cash that the financial industry currently faces.

zh: 但这些要求取消现金的论据其实都经不起推敲。
en: But the arguments for going cashless do not withstand scrutiny.

zh: 让我们先从炼金术士说起：无可否认，在极低利率环境下，货币政策的执行确实困难重重。
en: Start with the alchemists’ case. It is true that, in an environment of very low interest rates, the conduct of monetary policy becomes difficult.

zh: 但经验表明，更低下限与零利率下限其实是不同的。
en: Yet experience has shown that the effective lower bound is different from the ZLB.

zh: 事实上负利率已经奏效，特别是在与直接资产购买，长期信贷操作（包括“固定利率全额分配”和设定“针对性”变量）以及前瞻指导相结合之时，也并未导致人们一窝蜂地兑换现金。
en: Indeed, negative interest rates have worked, without triggering a flight to cash, especially when combined with outright asset purchases, long-term credit operations (including “fixed-rate full allotment” and “targeted” variants), and forward guidance.

zh: 因此，负利率应被理解为一个与低利率不同的特定非标准货币政策工具。
en: As such, negative interest rates should be understood as a specific non-standard monetary-policy instrument different from low interest rates.

zh: 法律与秩序派的现金取缔说也站不住脚。
en: The law-and-order camp’s case for banning cash also wilts under scrutiny.

zh: 作为一种价值储藏物和支付方式的现金为许多守法公民实现了重要的社会功能。
en: By acting as a store of value and a means of payment, cash fulfills an important social function for many law-abiding citizens.

zh: 试问有没有人会呼吁禁止私人拥有豪华车或宝石，只因为犯罪分子也喜欢这些东西？
en: Would anyone suggest forbidding private ownership of luxury cars or gems because criminals like them?

zh: 为了惩罚少数的害群之马而妨害守法生活的多数人，就如把孩子和洗澡水一起倒掉一样荒谬。
en: Harming the decent majority in order to punish a misbehaving minority would be like cracking a nut with a sledgehammer – and breaking the table it is on in the process.

zh: 最后，金融技术联盟承诺说，创新的数字支付解决方案可以让金融交易操作变得更轻松。
en: Finally, the fintech alliance promises that, with its innovative digital-payment solutions, it can ease the conduct of financial transactions.

zh: 客户不再需要携带现金或者四处寻找取款机。
en: Customers would no longer need to carry wads of cash or search for ATMs.

zh: 但有一个悬而未决的问题则是当前仍然高度碎片化的数字支付部门为消费者带来的好处是否会大于那些提供支付解决方案的企业。
en: But it is an open question whether the still highly fragmented digital-payment sector will help customers more than the companies offering the payment solutions.

zh: 无现金社会的论点还存在一个主要障碍：大多数人 — — 至少在欧元区 — — 无意实现这一点。
en: There is one more major problem with the arguments for a cashless society: most people, at least in the eurozone, don’t want it.

zh: 根据一份尚未公布的欧洲央行对6.5万名欧元区居民的调查，所有的销售点交易中有约80%是以现金进行；而在交易总额方面，超过一半的数额都是以现金支付的。
en: According to an as-yet-unpublished European Central Bank survey of 65,000 eurozone residents, almost 80% of all point-of-sale transactions are conducted in cash; and, in terms of value, more than half of payments are made in cash.

zh: 正如欧洲经常出现的情况那样，成员国之间的差异相当显著：现金交易所占的份额在芬兰为42 ％ ， 而马耳他则高达92 ％ 。
en: As is often the case in Europe, the differences among member states are pronounced: the share of cash transactions ranges from 42% in Finland to 92% in Malta.

zh: 但总的来说，公众对现金的信任度仍然很强，而且有变得越来越强的趋势。
en: But, overall, the public’s commitment to cash remains strong – and is becoming stronger.

zh: 事实上，对总体现金需求的增长正在超过名义GDP增长。
en: In fact, growth in overall demand for cash is outpacing nominal GDP growth.

zh: 近五年来，欧元纸币总面额和总数量的年均增长率分别为4.9％和6.2 ％ 。
en: In the last five years, the average annual growth rate of euro banknotes was 4.9% by value and 6.2% by piece.

zh: 这种上涨包括主要用于交易的面额，而不只是储蓄。
en: This rise includes denominations that are predominantly used for transactions, rather than for savings.

zh: 这些调查结果都印证了欧洲央行对支付方式所持的中立立场 — — 同时允许现金和非现金支付 — — 的适当性。
en: These findings confirm the appropriateness of the ECB’s neutral stance on payments, which allows for both cash and cashless payments.

zh: 这种方法基于四大原则：技术安全性，效率，技术中立性以及用户对各种支付方式的选择自由。
en: This approach is based on four principles: technological safety, efficiency, technological neutrality, and freedom of choice for users of the respective means of payment.

zh: 欧洲央行的最终目标是确保价格稳定。
en: The ECB’s supreme objective is to ensure price stability.

zh: 为了实现这一目标，它以供银行持有的央行储备和欧元钞票两种形式来提供安全的央行流动性（而后者是欧元区享有法定货币地位的唯一纸币 ） 。
en: To support that objective, it supplies safe central-bank liquidity, in the form of both bank-held central-bank reserves and banknotes (the latter being the sole notes with the status of legal tender in the eurozone).

zh: 如果欧洲要取消现金，就会切断民众与中央银行货币的唯一联系。
en: If Europe were to abolish cash, it would cut off people’s only direct link to central-bank money.

zh: 在民主政体中，这种联系可以通过强化民众对有效货币政策制定过程的信任和支持，进而提升公众对央行独立性的认可度。
en: In a democracy, such a link helps to foster public acceptance of central-bank independence, by reinforcing the trust and support of the people in the conduct of effective monetary policymaking.

zh: 而欧洲央行将继续提供纸币，同时也将促进一个综合，创新和竞争性的欧元区零售支付解决方案市场的进一步发展。
en: The ECB will continue to provide banknotes. We will also facilitate the further development of an integrated, innovative, and competitive market for retail payment solutions in the eurozone.

zh: 如果真有一天现金被电子付款取而代之，那这个决定也应源自人民的意愿，而非游说团体的势力。
en: If, one day, cash is replaced by electronic means of payment, that decision should reflect the will of the people, not the force of lobby groups.

zh: 欧洲的难民健忘症
en: Europe’s Refugee Amnesia

zh: 巴塞罗那—第一次世界大战后，数百万欧洲公民沦为难民，因为敌军的占领或驱逐而流离失所，为此，一套国际机制发展起来以协调有效应对和改善流离失所者的境况。
en: BARCELONA – After World War I, when millions of European civilians were made refugees, forced out of their homelands by enemy occupation or deportation, an international regime was developed to coordinate effective responses and ease the suffering of those who had been uprooted.

zh: 一个世纪后，另一场移民危机正在上演，而这一回，欧洲有能力为绝望的人们提供安全港。
en: A century later, another refugee crisis is underway, and this time, it is Europe that has the power to provide safe haven to desperate people.

zh: 但它没有响应起来，它的许多应对措施与情况的紧迫性不匹配。
en: Yet it has not risen to the occasion, with many of its responses failing to match the urgency of the situation.

zh: 2015年才过去几个月，但已有38,000多人试图供北非渡过地中海来到欧洲。
en: In just the first few months of 2015, more than 38,000 people have attempted to reach Europe by crossing the Mediterranean from North Africa.

zh: 大约1,800人在途中丧生 — — 是2013年全年因此死亡的人数的两倍多。
en: Some 1,800 people have died as a result – more than twice the number of such deaths in all of 2013.

zh: 令人失望的是，许多欧洲人对于这场与一个世纪前欧洲所遭遇的情况十分相似的人道危机的反应是反对国家接受更多难民。
en: Disappointingly, many Europeans have responded to this humanitarian crisis, which closely resembles the one that Europe endured a century ago, by opposing their countries’ acceptance of any more refugees.

zh: 他们忘记过去的速度真是迅速。
en: How quickly we forget our past.

zh: 更糟糕的是，一些欧洲人希望我们忘记。
en: Worse, some Europeans want us to forget.

zh: 今天的情绪受自我定位为民族身份捍卫者的民粹主义政党的煽动。
en: Today’s sentiment has been fueled by populist parties positioning themselves as guardians of national identity.

zh: 他们认为，欧洲面临巨大的人口流入，这会给其经济、劳动力市场和文化带来更大的制约。
en: Europe, they argue, faces a mass influx that threatens to place even greater strain on its economies, labor markets, and cultures.

zh: 只要稍稍回顾一个世纪前的情况，你就能发现这一论调的后果有多严重。
en: One does not have to look back a century to see how dangerous the consequences of such rhetoric can be.

zh: 但民粹主义论调不但具有煽动性；它根本是无中生有。
en: But the populists’ narrative is not just inflammatory; it is false.

zh: 尽管有时难以区分流离失所的原因，但联合国难民署的数据的数据表明，至少一半试图从北非来到欧洲的人是为了逃避战火和迫害。
en: Although it is sometimes difficult to distinguish the drivers of displacement, data from the United Nations refugee agency show that at least half of those trying to reach Europe from North Africa are fleeing from war and persecution.

zh: 国际移民组织（International Organization for Migration）与意大利海军的合作研究表明，今年的移民主要来自厄立特里亚、冈比亚、尼日利亚、索马里和叙利亚 — — 这些国家的状况足以让其公民获得庇护身份。
en: The International Organization for Migration, together with Italy’s navy, has determined that this year’s migrants hail mainly from Eritrea, Gambia, Nigeria, Somalia, and Syria ‒ countries where conditions entitle their citizens to request asylum.

zh: 简言之，这不是一场移民危机，而是一场难民危机 — — 并且尚未表现出缓解的迹象。
en: In short, this is a crisis not of immigrants, but of refugees – and it is showing no sign of slowing.

zh: 事实上，北非和中东大部饱受动荡和暴力困扰，这或许意味着二战以来武装冲突趋缓之势已经开始式微 — — 甚至开始反转。
en: Indeed, with instability and violence plaguing much of North Africa and the Middle East, the decline in armed conflict since World War II seems to have slowed – and could even reverse.

zh: 国际社会有法律义务保护因为冲突和迫害而被迫离开家园的人。
en: The international community is legally bound to protect those who are being forced to flee their homes by conflict and persecution.

zh: 从欧洲的历史和价值观看 — — 更不用说其毗邻受困人口的地理位置了 — — 它有着为此做出贡献的特殊责任。
en: Given Europe’s history and values – not to mention its proximity to some of the beleaguered populations – it has a special obligation to contribute to this effort.

zh: 但欧洲并非唯一一个需要承担当今移民流的地区 — — 甚至不是受影响最大的地区。
en: But Europe is not the only region that has been burdened by today’s migration flows – or even the most affected.

zh: 十分之九的难民没有离开地区，只是从本国逃往紧邻或接壤的国家。
en: Nine out of ten refugees do not leave their region, fleeing to countries very close to or bordering their own.

zh: 约旦难民营Zaatari一处就收容了82,000多人；如果这是一个正式城市，则可以位列约旦人口最多的城市之一。
en: The Jordanian refugee camp Zaatari alone shelters more than 82,000 people; if it were an official city, it would be among the country’s most populous.

zh: 黎巴嫩全国人口只有450万，却收容了大约1,116,000名难民 — — 与布鲁塞尔人口相当。
en: Lebanon, a country of just 4.5 million people, has taken in an estimated 1,116,000 refugees – roughly equivalent to the population of Brussels.

zh: 考虑到这一点，很难为欧洲辩护 — — 欧洲拒绝在今年为总共（比如）20,000难民提供安置和收容，根据28个国家的配额进行分配。
en: Given this, it is difficult to justify Europe’s failure to agree on a system of relocation and resettlement for a total of, say, 20,000 refugees this year, distributed among 28 countries according to individual quotas.

zh: 事实上，到目前为止许多欧洲国家接受的难民数量极少，这让人们更加难以理解它们为何不作为。
en: Indeed, many European countries have accepted very few refugees so far, making their inaction even more difficult to comprehend.

zh: 比如，西班牙和希腊各自只接受了4,000人左右 ） — —和约旦和黎巴嫩相比实在不值一提。
en: Spain and Greece, for example, have each accepted only about 4,000 – a meager amount, when compared to Jordan or Lebanon.

zh: 基于配额的协议也有助于在欧洲国家间分散负担。
en: A quota-based agreement could help to disperse the burden across European countries.

zh: 目前，各国庇护政策的巨大不同意味着在难民数量上的巨大分歧。
en: As it stands, major differences among countries’ asylum policies have meant major disparities in refugee numbers.

zh: 事实上，四个国家 — — 法国、德国、意大利和瑞典 — — 占了欧洲去年接受难民总数的三分之二。
en: Indeed, just four countries – France, Germany, Italy, and Sweden – accounted for two-thirds of all refugees accepted in Europe last year.

zh: 当蛇头网络让地中海沦为坟场时，欧洲决不能束手旁观。
en: When a network of human traffickers turns the Mediterranean into a mass grave, Europe cannot simply turn away.

zh: 欧洲领导人不应该受制于破坏性民粹主义和无耻的孤立主义，而必须致力于兑现他们帮助难民的法律和道德义务 — — 当然，也必须向公民解释这样做的重要性。
en: Instead of succumbing to destructive populism and dishonorable isolationism, Europe’s leaders must commit to fulfilling their legal and moral responsibility to help the refugees – and, of course, to explain to their citizens why this is so important.

zh: 这一努力要求所有欧洲国家 — — 而不仅是地中海沿岸国家 — — 提供资源支持大规模搜救行动。
en: Such an effort would require every European country – not just those situated on the Mediterranean – to contribute resources to support large-scale search-and-rescue operations.

zh: 边境控制不可作为唯一目标 — — 甚至不可作为主要目标。
en: Border control cannot be the only – or even the primary – objective.

zh: 除了帮助遏制当前危机，欧洲还必须致力于帮助脆弱的冲突影响国克服它们所面临的挑战，改善公民福祉，建设繁荣经济。
en: Beyond helping to manage the crisis today, Europe must commit to helping fragile and conflict-affected countries overcome the challenges they face, improve their citizens’ wellbeing, and build thriving economies.

zh: 要维持其道德和政治权威，欧盟 — — 其本身也许正是合作如何支持和平与繁荣的最佳案例 — — 必须带着诚意和决心超越边界，与其南部邻邦达成共同受益的协议。
en: To retain its moral and political authority, the European Union – perhaps the most compelling example of how cooperation can support peace and prosperity – must implicate itself beyond its frontiers in a sincere and determined way, reaching mutually beneficial agreements with its southern neighbors.

zh: 在欧盟国家收到的每一分庇护申请背后都有一出人间悲剧 — — 一出暴力、恐惧和损失的微历史。
en: Behind almost every request for asylum that an EU country receives is a human tragedy – a micro-history of violence, fear, and loss.

zh: 寻求庇护者的目标不是到达欧洲；而只是逃脱冲突和迫害。
en: The goal of the asylum-seekers is not to reach Europe; it is simply to escape conflict and persecution.

zh: 他们应该获得这一权利。
en: And they should be able to.

zh: 上个世纪 — — 在两次世界大战中 — — 欧洲人都曾逃离迫害。
en: Last century – in both world wars – Europeans were the ones fleeing from persecution.

zh: 如今，流离失所的人数之众为二战以来所未见，欧洲有责任回忆自己的历史。
en: With the number of displaced people now at levels unseen since World War II, Europe has a responsibility to recall its history.

zh: 它应该承担责任，像希望世界如何应对它的苦难那样应对今天的难民危机 — — 并证明欧盟价值观远远不局限于它的边界之内。
en: And it should take the opportunity to respond to today’s refugee crisis as it would have liked the world to respond to its suffering – and to prove that the EU’s value extends far beyond its borders.

zh: 为何欧洲在伊朗问题上支持奥巴马
en: Why Europe Backs Obama on Iran

zh: 帕尔马—以色列总理内塔尼亚胡眼看着快要下令以军总动员了，而美国的共和党也在准备与总统奥巴马的政府决一死战，只待与伊朗达成架性核协议。
en: PARMA – Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu seems close to ordering a general mobilization of his country’s military, and Republicans in the United States are preparing for a ferocious battle with President Barack Obama’s administration, in the wake of the framework nuclear agreement with Iran.

zh: 然而这一框架性协议在欧洲受到了几乎一致的欢迎。
en: And yet the framework deal has been almost universally welcomed in Europe.

zh: 是什么导致了西方内部对一个至关重要的地区和全球威胁态度如此不同？
en: What accounts for this disconnect within the West over a key regional and global threat?

zh: 许多因素都在起作用。
en: Several factors are at work.

zh: 当然，其中之一是欧洲 — — 或者准确地说是英国、德国和法国 — — 与伊朗谈判已逾十年。
en: One, certainly, is that Europe – or, more precisely, the United Kingdom, Germany, and France – has been engaged in the talks with Iran for more than a decade.

zh: 在小布什总统将伊朗列为“邪恶轴心”之前，欧洲关键成员国便已认定外交是比战争更好的办法。
en: Even as former President George W. Bush branded Iran a part of an “axis of evil,” the key European Union members insisted that diplomacy was better than war.

zh: 欧洲的方针一步一步地得到了证实。
en: And, step by step, the European approach has been vindicated.

zh: 当然，形成如此结果的关键是美国情报部门报告说所有证据表明伊朗很久以前 — — 2003年 — — 就放弃了发展核武器的实质计划。
en: Critical to that outcome, of course, was the US intelligence community’s reports that all the evidence pointed to Iran having long ago – in 2003 – abandoned concrete plans to develop a nuclear weapon.

zh: 伊朗这样做不难理解。
en: It is easy to see why the Iranians would have done so.

zh: 只要在20世纪80年代悍然发动持续了八年的对伊朗战争、西方影响力人士公开指责寻求拥有核武器的萨达姆仍在掌权，伊朗政府发展核武器的计划就有一定的现实逻辑。
en: So long as Saddam Hussein, who had launched a brutal eight-year war against Iran in the 1980s, and whom influential Westerners openly accused of seeking to acquire nuclear weapons, remained in power, the Iranian government’s plan to develop nuclear weapons followed a certain realist logic.

zh: 而在2003年美军推翻萨达姆政权后，伊朗最紧迫的安全威胁已经解除。
en: Once the US military ousted Saddam’s regime in 2003, Iran’s most acute security threat vanished.

zh: 此外，美国和欧洲的对伊朗核计划政策一直有一个战术性区别。
en: Moreover, there has long been a tactical difference between US and European policies toward Iran’s nuclear program.

zh: 美国多次想要根除它深度怀疑的国家的一切核技术知识，而欧洲的方针是寻求伊朗不会发展核武器的可靠保证。
en: At times, the US seemingly sought to eradicate any knowledge of nuclear technology from a country of which it is deeply suspicious, whereas the European approach was to seek reliable assurances that Iran would never develop a nuclear weapon.

zh: 最终，美国认识到任何现实政策都需要欧洲的支持，而欧洲将阻止美国货以色列发动战争作为关键政策目标。
en: At the end of the day, the US recognized that any realistic policy needed European support, while Europeans saw preventing a rush to war by the US or Israel as a central policy objective.

zh: 还应该指出，欧洲从未过度沉迷于美国针对邪恶轴心的另一个关键成员 — — 朝鲜及其核野心的强硬方针。
en: It should also be said that Europeans have never been overly impressed with America’s hardline approach toward that other charter member of the axis of evil, North Korea, and its nuclear ambitions.

zh: 拒绝与朝鲜政权谈判并对其实施最严厉制裁并没有阻止朝鲜获得核武器，也没有阻止它加速核技术和弹道技术的发展。
en: Refusing to negotiate with the North Korean regime, and imposing the most stringent sanctions on it, has not stopped it from either acquiring nuclear weapons or accelerating its development of both nuclear and missile technologies.

zh: 在6月底与伊朗达成最终协议的截止期前，有一些重要问题需要解决，其中之一是就逐渐停止并最终取消对伊朗的经济和外交制裁的细节形成一致。
en: Among the significant issues that need to be sorted out before the end-of-June deadline for reaching a final deal with Iran is to agree on the details of the gradual suspension, and eventual repeal, of economic and diplomatic sanctions against the country.

zh: 这将是美国激烈政治斗争的主题，而欧盟很可能远比美国更愿意在这方面取得进展。
en: While this will be the subject of a fierce political battle in the US, it is likely that the European Union will be far more willing to move ahead.

zh: 事实上，欧洲有充分的理由解除对伊朗的石油出口限制。
en: Indeed, Europe has sound reasons to lift the restrictions on Iranian oil exports.

zh: 增加全球石油市场供给将进一步压低价格。
en: Additional supplies of oil to global markets will keep prices down or depress them further.

zh: 除了欧洲经济所能获得的经济利益外，低油价还能产生重要的战略利益 — — 特别是遏制俄罗斯总统普京对乌克兰和其他地区的修正主义野心。
en: Apart from the economic gain for Europe’s economies, low oil prices yield important strategic benefits – particularly with respect to constraining Russian President Vladimir Putin’s revisionist ambitions in Ukraine and elsewhere.

zh: 不消说，美国和欧洲应该在制裁问题上坚持共同方针。
en: Needless to say, the US and Europe should stick to a common approach on the sanctions issue.

zh: 但如果共和党控制的美国国会的更加军事化的政策方针胜出，美国极有可能会丧失对制裁成功至关重要的盟友。
en: But were a more militant policy approach by the Republican-controlled US Congress to prevail, America might well find that it loses the ally that makes the key difference for the sanctions’ success.

zh: 事实上，在这个问题上，美国也许很快就会发现自己已经被其他国际行动方所孤立。
en: Indeed, on this issue, the US might rapidly find itself isolated from all other global actors.

zh: 显然，欧洲在伊朗政权的性质问题上并不天真。
en: Europe is certainly not naive about the nature of the Iranian regime.

zh: 历史上，法国在核扩散问题上信念坚定，在谈判期间的立场特别坚定。
en: France, with its historically strong convictions on issues concerning nuclear proliferation, has taken a particularly firm stance during the talks.

zh: 但欧洲也清醒地认识到暴力冲突的迅速升级及其近邻苦难迅速增加的后果；事实上，欧洲人每天都能看到这些后果 — — 试图抵达欧洲海岸的难民如潮水般汹涌。
en: But Europe is also acutely aware of the consequences of the rapid increase in violent conflict and suffering in its immediate neighborhood; indeed, Europeans see those consequences daily in the flood of refugees trying to reach its shores. Another war in the Middle East is clearly not in its interest.

zh: 最后，以色列是美国和欧洲在伊朗问题上方针不同的主要因素。
en: Finally, Israel is a key factor underlying the differences between the US and Europe when it comes to Iran.

zh: 尽管内塔尼亚胡刺耳声音在美国很有些拥趸，但大部分欧洲人认为他的立场荒谬可笑。
en: Though Netanyahu’s shrill words still have an attentive audience in the US, most of Europe regards his position as being only a little short of ridiculous.

zh: 因此，几乎肯定地说，假设6月与伊朗达成最终协议，欧洲对该协议的支持将是一边倒的，并且欧洲很希望支持奥巴马在国内就该协议与反对者所展开的斗争。
en: Thus, it is nearly certain that, assuming a final agreement with Iran is reached in June, Europe’s backing for it will be unanimous – or close to it – and that it will be eager to support Obama in his battle with opponents of the deal at home.

zh: 该框架协议证明了欧洲解决和纠纷的方针是正确的。
en: The framework agreement has vindicated Europe’s approach to resolving the nuclear dispute.

zh: 西方有充分的理由在未来几个月中保持这一方针。
en: The West has every reason to maintain that approach in the months ahead.

zh: 假日中的欧洲
en: Europe on Holiday

zh: 目前，法德两国15到25岁年龄段员工的平均工作时间与美国相比约低50 % 。
en: Currently, the average number of hours worked per person aged 15 to 25 each year in France and Germany is about 50% lower than in the United States.

zh: 其它欧洲国家（如意大利和西班牙）则处于两者之间。
en: Other European countries (for example, Italy and Spain) fall somewhere between these poles.

zh: 尽管有些美国人总喜欢吹嘘自己工作理念如何出众，美欧之间工作时数的差异并非向来如此。
en: Although some Americans always like to boast about their superior work ethic, this disparity in working hours between the US and Europe has not always existed.

zh: 实际上，20世纪70年代为止，大西洋两岸劳工的工作时数还大体相同。
en: Indeed, until the mid-1970's, the number of hours worked on either side of the Atlantic was roughly the same.

zh: 但从20世纪70年代开始，美国人的工作时数基本不变，而西欧人却开始逐年减少。
en: From the mid-1970's on, however, Americans continued working more or less the same number of hours, while Western Europeans began working less and less each year.

zh: 如果西欧想解释为什么经济增长率赶不上美国，根本不需要另找其它原因。
en: If Western Europe needs an explanation as to why its rate of economic growth is lagging behind the US, it need look no further.

zh: 人均工作时数的多少取决于很多因素：
en: The average number of working hours per person depends on a variety of factors:

zh: •就业参与程度的高低；
en: • the level of participation in the labor force;

zh: •工人们享受的假期天数；
en: • the number of vacation days workers have;

zh: •不受假期干扰的"正常"周工作时数。
en: • the number of hours worked in a "normal" week, i.e., with no vacation.

zh: 实际上美国和法德两国的差别主要源自前两个因素，这两者几乎同等重要。
en: Virtually all the difference between the US on one side and France and Germany on the other are due to the first two factors, each with roughly equal weight.

zh: 因此，就业参与程度低解释了其中的一半原因，而实际就业者享受长假则解释了原因的另外一半。
en: So, lower participation in the labor force explains half of the difference, and longer vacations for those who do work accounts for the other half.

zh: 这样的解释对亲身经历过8月欧洲倾城出动、4月欧洲和5月法意三周长假，德国城市周五午后2点"堵车高峰"和学校2月寒假期间滑雪圣地拥挤不堪的人们来说，一点也不会感到意外。
en: The importance of vacation time should come as no surprise to anyone who has experienced Europe's deserted cities in August, the three-week vacation "bridges" in April and May in France and Italy, the "rush hours" that take place every Friday at 2 PM in German cities, and crowded ski slopes in February due to winter school vacations.

zh: 但了解欧洲人如何工作得少是一方面 ， " 为什么"工作得少是另一方面。
en: But knowing "how" Europeans work less is one thing; knowing "why" Europeans work less than Americans is another.

zh: 观点之一是美国人被视作（他们自己也喜欢这样）加尔文主义工作狂，而欧洲人则认为自己了解如何享受生活。
en: One view is that Americans are perceived (and like to see themselves) as Calvinist workaholics, whereas Europeans like to think that they know how to enjoy life's pleasures.

zh: 作为在美国工作的欧洲人，我承认我比美国同事们休假更多。
en: As a European working in the US, I admit that I do take many more vacations than my American colleagues.

zh: 因此这种"文化"解释也许包含了部分原因。
en: So there may be something in this "cultural" explanation.

zh: 但为什么始于1973年呢？
en: But why did this start around 1973?

zh: 另一种观点把差别归咎于所得税。 实际上，20世纪70年代起欧洲所得税就快速增长，而美国的所得税却从20世纪80年代开始下降。
en: A second argument attributes the difference to income taxes, which, in fact, have increased significantly in Europe since the 1970's, while in the US income taxes fell from the early 1980's onward.

zh: 所得税当然会影响到工作的积极性。
en: Income taxes certainly must affect willingness to work.

zh: 它对家庭中主要的经济来源（通常是男主人）或许影响有限，但却能影响女性参与到就业中来。
en: They may not change by much the number of hours worked by the main breadwinner in a family (typically a man), but they do influence the participation of women in the labor force.

zh: 毕竟，如果税后收入只够看孩子和雇保姆的花销，人们为什么要出去工作？
en: After all, why work, when your after-tax salary barely pays for childcare and household help?

zh: 但即便如此理由也不够充分，因为对劳动力供应与税收变化关系的研究表明：美国和欧洲，特别是英法两国之间的巨大差距一定另有原因。
en: But even this is not a sufficient explanation, because studies of how the supply of labor responds to tax changes suggest that something else must explain the enormous gap between US and Europe, especially France and Germany.

zh: 很明显，对50岁以上的人群来说，养老金体系结构是非常重要的因素。
en: For the age group over 50, the structure of pension systems is clearly a major factor.

zh: 无论过去或者现在，在欧洲提前退休都比在美国来得划算。
en: It was and remains much more profitable to retire earlier in Europe than in the US.

zh: 如果法国或意大利人20世纪90年代50多岁时就可以退休，享受最终薪水的80%甚至更多，那他们又为什么要在60多岁时继续工作？
en: Why should a Frenchman or Italian in his early sixties work today, when in the 1990's he could have retired in his mid-fifties with 80% or more of his last working-age salary?

zh: 对女性来讲，20世纪90年代中的退休年龄更趋于年轻化。
en: For women, the retirement age in the mid-1990's was even lower.

zh: 公共部门的员工好处更多。
en: Public sector employees had even more advantages.

zh: 这也还不是全部。
en: Nor is that all.

zh: 20世纪的八九十年代，很多欧洲劳工组织面对日益上升的失业率，采取了"全体工作，减少时数"的应对方法。
en: In the 1980's and 1990's, many European labor unions, in response to rising unemployment, adopted the policy of "work less, work all."

zh: 换句话讲，他们争取减少工作时间（也就是更多休假 ） ， 目的在于维持较高的就业率。
en: In other words, they obtained shorter hours (i.e., more vacations) in order to keep employment up.

zh: 问题在于相对于缩短的工作时数，工资并没有按比例减少，导致单位时间的劳动报酬提高。
en: The problem is that total compensation did not go down in proportion to the shorter hours, thus leading to an increase in pay per hour.

zh: 下降的生产率和升高的单位劳动成本损害了公司的用人积极性，使欧洲的失业率长期高于美国。
en: Lower productivity and higher unit labor costs eroded firms' willingness to hire, leaving Europe with chronically higher unemployment than in the US.

zh: 今天有关欧洲增长的辩论充满了"知识社会 " " 技术进步"和"投资教育"这样的华丽字眼。
en: Today's debates about growth in Europe are full of buzz words like "knowledge-based society," "technological progress," and "investment in education."

zh: 欧洲人当然要为充满假期的短暂职业生涯付出代价。
en: Europeans certainly need something to compensate for a short working life with many vacations.

zh: 但这样的争论大都只停留在"政治上正确与否"的简单层面，毕竟，让欧洲人认为增长缓慢的原因是社会知识不够丰富比直接指出假期和增长的反比例关系更令人安心 ， " 感觉也更好 " 。
en: But much of this discussion is merely a form of "political correctness." It is more reassuring - and "feels better" - to tell Europeans that growth is sluggish because society is not sufficiently knowledge-based, rather than pointing to the trade-off between vacations and growth.

zh: 与增长相比，欧洲人更喜欢休假。
en: Europeans tend to prefer vacations over growth.

zh: 就个人而言，我喜欢休假的时间越来越长，但却不能（也不会）抱怨工资增长越来越慢。
en: Personally, I love taking more and more vacations. But I cannot (and do not) then complain if my income does not grow faster and faster.

zh: 欧洲的雄心是如何吓跑英国的
en: How EU Overreach Pushed Britain Out

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 就在英国举行“脱欧”公投的前几天，我的一位极为睿智的英国朋友说他将投票支持留欧，因为他担心英国脱离欧盟会带来经济上的不确定性。
en: CAMBRIDGE – A thoughtful British friend of mine said to me a few days before the United Kingdom’s “Brexit” referendum that he would vote for Remain because of his concern about the economic uncertainty that would follow if the UK left the European Union.

zh: 但他又补了一句，说如果他早知道欧盟会演变成今天这个样子，就不会赞成英国于1973年加入欧盟。
en: But he added that he would not have favored Britain’s decision to join the EU back in 1973 had he known then how the EU would evolve.

zh: 虽然投票脱欧者的原因各异，但许多人都注意到欧盟领导人们已经僭越了他们最初的领受的任务，创造了一个更庞大且更具侵入性的组织。
en: While voters chose Leave for a variety of reasons, many were concerned with the extent to which EU leaders have exceeded their original mandate, creating an ever larger and more invasive organization.

zh: 欧盟缔造者让·莫内（Jean Monnet）建立欧洲合众国的梦想可不是英国人在40年前加入欧盟时想得到的东西，他们也不想如德国战后第一任总理康拉德·阿登纳（Konrad Adenauer）曾一度鼓吹的那样借欧洲抗衡美国。
en: Jean Monnet’s dream of a United States of Europe was not what the British wanted when they joined the EU 40 years ago. Nor were they seeking a European counterweight to the United States, as Konrad Adenauer, Germany’s first post-war chancellor, had once advocated.

zh: 英国只是想通过促进与英吉利海峡对面的国家的贸易，并从劳动力市场一体化中得益。
en: Britain simply wanted the advantages of increased trade and labor-market integration with countries across the English Channel.

zh: 欧盟始于六国之间为实现商品和资本的自由贸易并消除劳动力流动障碍的一份协议。
en: The EU began as an agreement among six countries to achieve free trade in goods and capital and to eliminate barriers to labor mobility.

zh: 当欧盟领导人试图通过建立一个货币联盟以加强欧洲团结感的时候，英国很幸运地选择了退出并继续使用英磅 — — 并得以继续掌控控制自身货币政策。
en: When EU leaders sought to reinforce a sense of European solidarity by establishing a monetary union, Britain was fortunately able to opt out and keep the pound – and control over its monetary policy.

zh: 但是退出这一步已经让英国成为了欧盟中的相对局外人。
en: But the opt-out has left Britain a relative outsider within the EU.

zh: 随着欧盟从6国扩展到28国，英国无法长期限制来自新成员国的劳动者进入本国劳动力市场。
en: As the EU expanded from six countries to 28, Britain could not permanently limit entry to its labor market by workers from the new member states.

zh: 结果英国本土的外国劳工数量自1993年以来翻了一番，达到600余万，相当于总劳动力的10 ％ ， 如今大部分都来自非欧盟其他原始成员国的低工资国家。
en: As a result, the number of foreign-born workers in Britain has doubled since 1993, to more than six million, or 10% of the labor force, with most now coming from low-wage countries that were not among the EU’s other original members.

zh: 虽然脱欧派选民担心这会导致英国工资压力上升，但他们一般不会反对增加贸易和资本流动的最初目标，因为那就是全球化的本质。
en: Although pro-Brexit voters worry about the resulting pressure on UK wages, they generally do not reject the original goals of increased trade and capital flows that are the essence of globalization.

zh: 有些脱欧捍卫者可能会引用加拿大和墨西哥两国与美国达成自由贸易协议的正面例子，其中并未限制劳动力流动。
en: Some Brexit defenders could point to the example of the successful US free-trade agreement with Canada and Mexico, which contains no provision for labor mobility.

zh: 但与英国不同的是，以法德为首的其他欧盟国家的野心比自由贸易和扩大劳动力市场更大。
en: Unlike Britain, the other EU countries, led by France and Germany, wanted more than free trade and an enlarged labor market.

zh: 从一开始，欧洲领导人就决定扩大“欧洲计划”来构建一个《罗马条约》称之为“不断紧固的联盟 ” 。
en: From the start, European leaders were determined to expand the “European project” to achieve what the Treaty of Rome called an “ever closer union.”

zh: 那些向欧盟机构移交主权的拥护者用“共享主权”这个理念来论证这一举动的正当性，照此执行的话，英国的主权就会欧盟决策的侵蚀，完全无需征得英国政府或人民的正式同意。
en: Advocates of shifting authority to EU institutions have justified this with the notion of “shared sovereignty,” according to which British sovereignty could be eroded by EU decisions, without any formal agreement from the UK’s government or people.

zh: 1998年签署的《稳定与增长公约》向各成员国强加了年度赤字限制，要求各国债务与GDP的比例不得超过60 ％ 。
en: The “Stability and Growth Pact” of 1998 imposed a limit on member countries’ annual deficits and required that debt-to-GDP ratios shrink toward a maximum of 60%.

zh: 当全球金融危机于2008年爆发后，德国总理默克尔看到了进一步加强欧盟的机会，通过实施新的“财政紧固”政策授权欧盟委员会去监督成员的年度预算，并对违反预算和债务目标的成员课以罚款（虽然并未以此收到任何款项 ） 。
en: When the global financial crisis began in 2008, German Chancellor Angela Merkel saw an opportunity to strengthen the EU even further, by enforcing a new “fiscal compact” authorizing the European Commission to oversee members’ annual budgets and impose fines for violating budget and debt targets (though no fines have been levied).

zh: 德国还带头着手建立一个欧洲“银行业联盟 ” ， 设立一个单一监管框架以及对陷入困境的金融机构具有约束力的解决方案机制。
en: Germany also led the move to establish a European “banking union” with a single regulatory framework and a binding resolution mechanism for troubled financial institutions.

zh: 虽然不是所有这些政策都对英国产生了直接影响；但它们扩大了英国和欧盟欧元区成员之间的理念和政治差距。
en: Not all of these policies directly affected the UK; nonetheless, they widened the intellectual and political gap between Britain and the EU’s eurozone members.

zh: 这强化了英国政府以及许多欧盟国家之间的根本性区别：前者以市场为导向，后者则有着社会主义，政府规划和严格监管的传统。
en: That reinforced the fundamental difference between market-oriented British governments and those of many EU countries, with their traditions of socialism, government planning, and heavy regulation.

zh: 欧盟官僚机构和成员国之间权力的划分原则也是极为模糊 — — 这是从天主教社会教学经验中借鉴而来 — — 的“权力下放 ” ： 决策本应在的“最低”或集权程度最小层面上的 “主管当局”中作出。
en: The division of powers between the EU bureaucracy and member states is governed by the ambiguous principle – borrowed from Catholic social teaching – of “subsidiarity”: decisions should be made at the “lowest” or least centralized level of “competent authority.”

zh: 在实践中这却并未限制布鲁塞尔和斯特拉斯堡欧盟机构的规则制定权。
en: In practice, that did not limit the rulemaking in Brussels and Strasbourg.

zh: 权力下放原则对欧盟各成员国政府的保障远远低于美国宪法第十修正案对联邦各州的保障，因为后者认定联邦政府不能拥有任何未获宪法授予的权力。
en: Subsidiarity provides much less protection for EU member governments than the Tenth Amendment of the US Constitution – which denies to the federal government any powers not delegated to it by the Constitution – does for US states.

zh: 对欧盟感到不满的当然不仅仅是英国民众。
en: The British public is of course not alone in its discomfort with the EU. A recent poll conducted in EU countries by the Pew Foundation found that a majority of voters in three of the largest countries – Britain, France, and Spain – view the EU unfavorably.

zh: 皮尤基金会最近在欧盟国家进行的一项民调显示，三个最大欧盟国家 — — 英国，法国和西班牙 — — 的多数选民都对欧盟持负面态度；在德国正负双方各半；在意大利，虽然大多数人都表示他们从欧盟中受益；然而民粹主义的五星运��党（Five Star Movement）最近却在其参选的20个城市赢下了19场市长选举（包括夺得首都罗马市长选举的70％选票 ） ， 并承诺如果能赢得今年晚些时候的议会选举，就举行公投决定是否离开欧元区。
en: In Germany, the public was split 50-50. In Italy, a clear majority say that they have benefited from EU membership; and yet the populist Five Star Movement, which recently won mayoral elections in 19 of the 20 cities it contested (including 70% of the vote in Rome), has promised a referendum on leaving the eurozone if it wins the parliamentary election later this year.

zh: 尽管许多官员和专家都预测英国脱欧将带来可怕的经济后果，当然这也不是不可避免的，其中很大程度取决于欧盟和英国之间构建未来关系的条款。
en: Although many officials and experts predict that Brexit will have dire economic consequences, this certainly is not inevitable. Much now depends on the terms of the future relationship between the EU and Britain.

zh: 英国现在也处于更有利的地位，可以与美国展开更优惠的贸易和投资协定谈判。
en: The UK is also now in a better position to negotiate a more favorable trade and investment treaty with the US.

zh: 尽管目前构建美欧跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系的提案停滞不前，位处欧盟之外的英国政府与美国达成交易的容易程度大大提升。
en: Although the proposed US-EU Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) is bogged down, a British government outside the EU could negotiate a deal with the US far more easily.

zh: 美国将与一国而非28国进行谈判，况且其中很多国家不同意英国的市场导向政策。
en: The US would be negotiating with one country, not 28 — many of which do not share Britain’s pro-market policies.

zh: 英国欧盟成员资格的问题已经尘埃落定。
en: The question of Britain’s EU membership has been decided.

zh: 现在，该国经济的未来则取决于它将如何运用自己的新独立地位。
en: Now its economic future depends on what it does with its new independence.

zh: 应对欧洲的政治极化
en: Responding to Europe’s Political Polarization

zh: 巴黎—欧洲的2015年始于极左翼的左翼联盟党（Syriza）赢得希腊选举，终于另外三场证明了政治极化日益兴盛的选举。
en: PARIS – In Europe, 2015 began with the far-left Syriza party’s election victory in Greece. It ended with another three elections that attested to increasing political polarization.

zh: 在葡萄牙，社会党（Socialist Party）与此前的死对头共产党结成同盟。
en: In Portugal, the Socialist Party formed an alliance with its former archenemy, the Communists.

zh: 在波兰，民主主义的劳动与正义党（PiS）赢得了足够的支持，能够独立组阁。
en: In Poland, the nationalist Law and Justice (PiS) party won enough support to govern on its own.

zh: 而在西班牙，另一个极左翼政党社会民主党（Podemos）的崛起终结了中左翼的西班牙社会工人党（Socialist Workers’ Party）和中右翼的人民党（Partido Popular）的传统霸权。
en: And in Spain, the emergence of Podemos, another new left-wing party, has ended the traditional hegemony of the Spanish Socialist Workers’ Party on the center left and the Partido Popular on the center right.

zh: （此外，在法国，由马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）领导的极右翼政党国民阵线（National Front）也在今年12月的第一轮选举中尽显强势，尽管最后没有赢得胜利。 ）
en: (In France, moreover, the far-right National Front, led by Marine Le Pen, showed its strength in the first round of December’s regional elections, though it eventually failed to win any).

zh: 个中意义显而易见：选民日益对主流政党深感失望，并愿意给主张激进替代方案的政党一个机会。
en: The message is impossible to miss: Increasingly, voters are deeply dissatisfied with mainstream parties and are willing to give a chance to those proposing radical alternatives.

zh: 他们给予支持的政党尽管彼此之间十分不同，但都指责欧盟应该为本国经济和劳动力市场的糟糕状况负责。
en: They are lending support to parties that, though very different from one another, all blame the European Union for the sorry state of their countries’ economies and labor markets.

zh: 诚然，如今激进化并不是欧洲的特有现象。
en: To be sure, radicalization is not limited to Europe nowadays.

zh: 我在其他文章中指出，美国总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）之所以能崛起，背后的许多因素与勒庞越来越受到欢迎是一样的。
en: As I have argued elsewhere, American presidential candidate Donald Trump owes his rise to many of the same factors that are driving Le Pen’s growing popularity.

zh: 欧洲问题的严重之处在于激进政治与主流治理之间的碰撞。
en: What is particularly problematic in the EU is the clash between radical politics and mainstream governance.

zh: 30年来，在大部分欧盟国家执政的中右翼或中左翼政党都持有广泛取得共识的欧洲观。
en: For 30 years, center-right or center-left parties with a broadly shared vision of Europe have governed most EU countries.

zh: 尽管政策上存在分歧，但在思想上是一致的，思想上的一致造就了单一市场、欧元和扩大的欧盟 — — 并形成了政治联盟。
en: Despite their policy disagreements, they jointly embodied the ideological consensus – and formed the political coalition – that built the single market, the euro, and the enlarged EU.

zh: 但如今，许多选民感到主流政策是失败的。
en: But many voters now feel that mainstream policies have failed.

zh: 政府证明了它无法保护无技能和低技能员工不受全球化和技术变革冲击。
en: Governments have proved unable to protect unskilled and semi-skilled employees from the consequences of globalization and technological change.

zh: 大众教育、累进税制和社会福利没能阻止不平等性加剧。
en: Mass education, progressive taxation, and social-welfare benefits have not prevented increasing inequality.

zh: 欧元也没有带来繁荣与稳定。
en: And the euro has failed to engineer prosperity and stability.

zh: 认为具体的政策错误和制度缺陷，而非欧洲一体化才是罪魁的人（包括我）的声音根本没人去听。
en: Those (like me) who think that specific policy errors and institutional flaws are more to blame than European integration itself are being drowned out.

zh: 在民主国家，政治调整是件常事；事实上，民主制度就是为了让这种调整成为可能。
en: Political realignments are to be expected in democracies; indeed, democratic institutions are designed to make them possible.

zh: 一般而言，宪法不会改变，或改变缓慢，而新的政党或政党联盟会重新制定政策日程、改革立法。
en: Generally, the constitution does not change, or changes only slowly, whereas a new party or coalition redefines the policy agenda and reforms the legislation.

zh: 这一刚性和弹性的组合让民主制度能够适应公民偏好的变迁。
en: This combination of rigidity and plasticity enables democratic regimes to adapt to shifts in citizens’ preferences.

zh: 但欧洲已不再如此。
en: The same does not apply to Europe, however.

zh: 首先，政治变化并不同步。
en: First, political change is not synchronized.

zh: 在任一给定时刻，一些国家可能投票给激进政党，而其他国家则否（或根本没有举行选举 ） 。
en: At any given moment, some countries may have voted for radical parties, while others have not (or simply have not held elections).

zh: 去年春天，当希腊政府寻求放松紧缩措施时，它一开始没能理解这一合法性的冲突：左翼联盟获得了希腊选民授予的变革使命，但其他国家的代表并没有收到这一使命。
en: This clash of legitimacy is what the Greek government initially failed to understand last spring when it sought to ease austerity measures: Syriza had received a mandate for change from Greek voters, but other countries’ representatives had not received such a mandate.

zh: 其次，与国家民主不同，欧盟的合法性不是来自决定政治选择的程序，而是主要来自它的输出。
en: Second, unlike national democracies, the EU does not derive its legitimacy from the process through which political choices are made, but mainly from the output it can deliver.

zh: 这并不是说没有民主程序：选举产生的欧洲议会是一个严肃的立法机构，其对欧盟委员的审批常常比国家层面的人事遴选更加严格。
en: This is not to say that there is no democratic process: the elected European Parliament is a serious legislative body, and its vetting of European commissioners is often more thorough than personnel selection at the national level.

zh: 但你看不到这一点，因为重大决定都由国家政府间的谈���确定。
en: But it has no visibility, because major decisions are negotiated between national governments.

zh: 第三，欧盟的宪法和立法问题的界线十分古怪。
en: Third, the boundary between constitutional and legislative matters is peculiar in the EU.

zh: 所有条约条款都具有宪法地位；事实上，只有全体一致同意才能修改。
en: All treaty provisions have constitutional status; indeed, they can be changed only by unanimous agreement.

zh: 此外，由于政府之间彼此不信任，因此它们坚持在条约中包括正常情况下属于一般立法的内容。
en: Furthermore, because governments did not trust one another, they insisted on including in treaties what would normally belong in ordinary legislation.

zh: 因此，在欧盟，许多经济规则远比类似的本国规则更加难以修改。
en: The many rules that govern economic life in the EU are therefore much more difficult to amend than are similar domestic provisions.

zh: 换句话说，修订规则的空间过于狭窄，即便它们所体现的政策一致早已不复存在。
en: In other words, the scope for redefining the rules is exceedingly narrow, even though they reflect a policy consensus that is no longer widely shared.

zh: 这意味着欧盟还有哪些选择可以应对政治极化以及随之而来的增加国家层面政策自由度的要求？
en: What options does this leave the EU for responding to political polarization and the concomitant demands for more policy leeway at the national level?

zh: 当然，欧盟可以一概忽视这些变化，寄希望于极端化在其始作俑者面临治理责任后烟消云散。
en: Of course, the EU could simply ignore these changes, and hope that radicalism will wane once its bearers are confronted with the responsibility of governing.

zh: 但这样的希望是愚蠢的。
en: But that would be foolish.

zh: 左翼联盟被迫接受了艰难的选择，因为希腊需要仰仗外部金融支持。
en: Syriza was forced to accept tough choices because Greece depends on external financial assistance.

zh: 其他国家的情况都与此不同。
en: No other country is in the same situation.

zh: 忽视变革要求最终将深化对欧盟的群众敌对情绪。
en: Ignoring demands for change would ultimately deepen popular hostility toward the EU.

zh: 另一个可能性是临时利用现有欧盟条约条款的灵活性。
en: Another possibility would be to exploit, on an ad hoc basis, the existing flexibility in EU treaty provisions.

zh: 务实主义确实能够有所助益，而以容克为首的欧盟委员会也愿意务实。
en: Pragmatism can indeed be helpful, and the European Commission headed by Jean-Claude Juncker is willing to embrace it.

zh: 但让欧盟框架沦为各国各自为政的政治讨价还价场所是危险的。
en: But it would be dangerous to turn the EU framework into a thicket of country-specific political bargains.

zh: 对于将法治和基本原则的执行看作大事的国家 — — 不仅仅是德国 — — 很快就会反对。
en: Those for whom the rule of law and the enforcement of fundamental principles are serious matters – not just Germany – would soon object.

zh: 最后的方案是让欧盟变得更加便于政治变化。
en: The last solution would be to make the EU more amenable to political change.

zh: 这需要明确改变宪法和立法之间的平衡。 从而在保护原则的同时让政策能够响应政治。
en: This would require explicitly changing the balance between constitutional and legislative matters, so that principles are preserved, but policies can be responsive to politics.

zh: 此外，欧盟应该获得更广泛的政策立法权，比如税收。
en: Moreover, the EU should be able to legislate on a wider array of policies, including, for example, taxation.

zh: 这将让欧盟不再对不平等性问题束手无策 — — 也显然漠不关心。
en: This would end its awkward impotence on – and apparent indifference to – inequality.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲议会应该获得更高的规格（如同真正的联邦制度那样 ） ， 从而让国家和欧洲层面的政府拥有平等的合法性。
en: At the same time, the European Parliament should be given a higher profile, as in a truly federal system, so that governments at the national and European level are perceived as equally legitimate.

zh: 如果欧盟 — — 或更小的规模的欧元区（可能性更大，因为一体化程度更高 ） — —能够联邦化，政策冲突将不会让民选的国家政府面对一个不透明的制度，而是面对一个政治上合法的联邦制度。
en: With such federalization in the EU or, more likely, the smaller eurozone (within which the degree of integration is higher), policy conflicts would place elected national governments in opposition not to an opaque system, but to a politically legitimate federal institution.

zh: 这一方针面临着巨大的障碍。
en: This approach confronts formidable obstacles.

zh: 起草欧盟宪法的尝试在21世纪初就已开始。
en: An attempt to write an EU constitution was made in the early 2000s.

zh: 结果失败了。
en: It failed.

zh: 主流政策仍然广受支持的德国和其他国家将强烈反对任何被认为是软化共同规则和原则的改变。
en: Germany and other countries where mainstream policies still command wide support would vehemently oppose any perceived softening of the common rules and principles.

zh: 如今，从激进派开始，大量欧洲人认为欧盟是本国当前乱象的罪魁祸首，再这样的情况下，同意加强能力、强化欧洲议会是非常困难的。
en: It will be hard, to say the least, to agree on additional competences and a stronger European Parliament at a time when so many in Europe, starting with the radicals, consider the EU the main culprit for their current woes.

zh: 但最终，构建一个跨国民主政体是应对欧洲政治极化的最可行的办法。
en: Yet ultimately, the construction of a transnational democracy is the most viable response to political polarization in Europe.

zh: 欧洲的贫穷定时炸弹
en: Europe’s Poverty Time Bomb

zh: 发自马德里 — — 穷人通常无力左右发达国家的选举，但他们如今却是意大利大选中各方争相讨好的对象。
en: MADRID – The poor don’t often decide elections in the advanced world, and yet they are being wooed heavily in Italy’s current electoral campaign.

zh: 意大利力量党（Forza Italia）领袖，前总理西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼提议发放“尊严性收入 ” （ dignity income ） ， 而五星运动党影子领袖，喜剧演员毕普·格里罗（Beppe Grillo）则同样要求发放“公民收入 ” 。
en: Former Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi, the leader of Forza Italia, has proposed a “dignity income,” while Beppe Grillo, the comedian and shadow leader of the Five Star Movement, has likewise called for a “citizenship income.”

zh: 这两项建议 — — 都需要每月向弱势人群慷慨地发放一笔钱 — — 在其制度设计上都有点站不住脚，但它们至少揭示了欧洲地区急剧恶化的普遍贫困问题。
en: Both of these proposals – which would entail generous monthly payments to the disadvantaged – are questionable in terms of their design. But they do at least shed light on the rapidly worsening problem of widespread poverty across Europe.

zh: 贫穷是收入两极化现象的一种极端形式，但并不等同于不平等。
en: Poverty represents an extreme form of income polarization, but it is not the same thing as inequality.

zh: 即使在一个严重不平等的社会中，那些收入少一些的人也不一定会缺乏体面而充实的谋生手段。
en: Even in a deeply unequal society, those who have less do not necessarily lack the means to live a decent and fulfilling life.

zh: 但那些生活在贫困中的人却并非如此，因为它们遭受了彻底的社会排斥，甚至完全无家可归。
en: But those who live in poverty do, because they suffer from complete social exclusion, if not outright homelessness.

zh: 即使在发达经济体中，穷人也往往无法获得金融体系的帮助，拿不出钱支付食品或水电租金，并且过早地死亡。
en: Even in advanced economies, the poor often lack access to the financial system, struggle to pay for food or utilities, and die prematurely.

zh: 当然，并不是所有的穷人都生活得如此悲惨。
en: Of course, not all of the poor live so miserably.

zh: 但很多人确实如此，而在意大利这些人的选举权重已经大到无可忽视。
en: But many do, and in Italy their electoral weight has become undeniable.

zh: 大约有500万意大利人（占全国人口总量约8 ％ ） 都在购买基本商品和服务支出上捉襟见肘。
en: Almost five million Italians, or roughly 8% of the population, struggle to afford basic goods and services.

zh: 而在短短的十年间这个群体的规模几乎增加了三倍，尤其集中在该国南部地区。
en: And in just a decade, this cohort has almost tripled in size, becoming particularly concentrated in the country’s south.

zh: 与此同时另有6％的人生活在相对贫困中，这意味着他们缺乏足够的可支配收入来从该国的平均生活水平中受益。
en: At the same time, another 6% live in relative poverty, meaning they do not have enough disposable income to benefit from the country’s average standard of living.

zh: 整个欧洲大陆层面的情况也同样令人担忧。
en: The situation is equally worrisome at a continental level.

zh: 在2016年的欧盟统计中，有1.175亿欧洲人（约占总人口的1/4）面临着陷入贫困或社会排斥状态的风险。
en: In the European Union in 2016, 117.5 million people, or roughly one-fourth of the population, were at risk of falling into poverty or a state of social exclusion.

zh: 自2008年以来，意大利，西班牙和希腊三国的贫困人口增加了近600万，而法国和德国的贫困人口比例保持稳定，大约为20 ％ 。
en: Since 2008, Italy, Spain, and Greece have added almost six million people to that total, while in France and Germany the proportion of the population that is poor has remained stable, at around 20%.

zh: 在2008年金融危机之后，由于非养老金类社会福利的削减以及欧洲劳动力市场保留内部人员就业的趋势，陷入贫困的可能性出现了整体上升，而对年轻人尤其如此。
en: In the aftermath of the 2008 financial crisis, the probability of falling into poverty increased overall, but particularly for the young, owing to cuts in non-pension social benefits and a tendency in European labor markets to preserve insiders’ jobs.

zh: 从2007年到2015年，有可能陷入贫困的18~29年龄段欧洲人比例从19％上升到了24 ％ ； 而在65岁及以上年龄段的比例则从19％下降到14 ％ 。
en: From 2007 to 2015, the proportion of Europeans aged 18-29 at risk of falling into poverty increased from 19% to 24%; for those 65 and older, it fell from 19% to 14%.

zh: 现在物质严重匮乏的年轻人所占比例已经达到了总人口的12 ％ ， 几乎是老年人的两倍。
en: The share of young people now experiencing severe material deprivation, at 12% of the total population, is almost twice that of the elderly.

zh: 正如国际货币基金组织总裁克里斯蒂娜·拉加德今年在达沃斯世界经济论坛会议上所指出的那样，年轻的欧洲人“正在搁置自己的梦想。 ”
en: As Christine Lagarde, the International Monetary Fund’s managing director, noted at the World Economic Forum’s meeting in Davos this year, young Europeans “are putting their dreams on hold.”

zh: 虽然当下的经济增长可以部分扭转这一青年贫困趋势，但问题背后的结构性因素依然存在。
en: Although the current economic upswing could partly reverse the trend in youth poverty, the structural factors underlying the problem will remain.

zh: 在长期失业的状态下，工人自身的技能可能会逐渐荒废，或者由于科技的迅猛发展而突然遭到淘汰。
en: Workers’ skills can deteriorate irreparably during stints of long-term unemployment, or can suddenly be rendered obsolete by rapid advances in technology.

zh: 对于许多贫困人口来说，重新加入劳动力队伍要么是不可能的，要么只能争取到一些临时性的低薪工作岗位，让他们只能在下一轮经济低潮中继续受灾。
en: For many poor people, re-joining the workforce will either be impossible, or it will require them to settle for precarious, low-paid jobs that leave them vulnerable to the next downturn.

zh: 根据经合组织的数据，近年来西班牙和希腊的适龄劳动人口中就有14％虽然找到了工作，但仍处于贫困状态。
en: According to the OECD, 14% of the working-age population in Spain and Greece in recent years was employed but still in poverty.

zh: 在不平等的社会中，资源可以通过累进税收，货币转移支付和工资上限从富人那里重新分配到其他人手里。
en: In unequal societies, resources can be redistributed from the very rich to the rest through progressive taxation, monetary transfers, and salary caps.

zh: 但消除贫困可不只是重新划分经济大饼。
en: But eliminating poverty requires more than merely reapportioning the economic pie.

zh: 穷人也必须重新掌握权力并重新融入那个将他们边缘化的社会。
en: The poor also must be re-empowered and reintegrated into societies that have pushed them to the margins.

zh: 毕竟这不仅仅是政治稳定和经济公平问题，而是人类的尊严问题。
en: Ultimately, it is not just a matter of political stability and economic fairness, but of human dignity.

zh: 展望未来，欧洲的福利国家需要改革来解决当前的现实问题。
en: Looking ahead, Europe’s welfare states will need to be reformed to address current realities.

zh: 老年人不再是欧洲社会经济中最脆弱的成员，但他们仍然占据了最大的福利份额。
en: The elderly are no longer the most economically vulnerable members of European society, but they still receive the largest slice of the pie.

zh: 各国政府应减少养老金并将其转化为针对穷人，失业者和年轻人的福利。
en: Governments should reduce pension benefits in favor of the poor, the unemployed, and the young.

zh: 这三个群体经常互相重叠，而且迫切需要财政援助，技能培训和家庭扶助政策。
en: These three groups, which often overlap, are in desperate need of financial assistance, skills training, and family-friendly policies.

zh: 欧洲各国政府还应改革其税收制度，让那些有长期稳定工作的劳动者缴纳更多，为雇佣弱势劳动者的公司提供财政激励，并推动建立全欧盟层面的贫困保险计划。
en: European governments should also overhaul their tax systems to make older workers contribute more, offer fiscal incentives to companies that hire disadvantaged workers, and move toward establishing an EU-wide poverty-insurance scheme.

zh: 而企业家和私营企业应该增加他们所在社区的社会项目投入。
en: And entrepreneurs and private firms should invest more in social programs in the communities where they are active.

zh: 虽然贝卢斯科尼（已被禁止参选）和格里罗都已经选择直面贫穷问题，但他们提出的解决方案只不过是短期修复。
en: While Berlusconi (who is barred from running for office) and Grillo have homed in on the problem of poverty, their proposed solutions are nothing more than short-term fixes.

zh: 一项基础收入方案可能会为穷人提供一些眼前的财政救助，但它无法破解贫困的结构性成因。
en: A basic-income scheme might provide some immediate financial relief to the poor, but it would not address the structural causes of poverty.

zh: 更大的问题在于由于该两项提案都没有认真鼓励失业者去找工作或接受培训，穷人最终可能只能永远依赖国家援助。
en: Even worse, because neither proposal seriously encourages the unemployed to seek work or training programs, the poor could end up reliant on state assistance forever.

zh: 而且这种政策显然不可能实现预算中立，相反还必须依赖政治不受欢迎的加税或开支削减措施来资助。
en: And it is not as if such policies would be budget-neutral. Rather, they would have to be funded by politically unpopular tax increases or spending cuts.

zh: 尽管如此，正如贝卢斯科尼和格里罗明确表示的那样，欧洲领导人再也无法忽视贫困问题。
en: Still, as Berlusconi and Grillo have made clear, Europe’s leaders can no longer afford to ignore the poverty problem.

zh: 他们必须提供真正的解决方案，而不是一些把问题过度简单化的方案。
en: They will have to offer real solutions, not simplistic schemes.

zh: 由于那些健忘的精英们总是不撞南墙不回头，也该是穷人奋起反抗的时候了。
en: As oblivious elites often learn the hard way, the poor will endure their lot only for so long.

zh: 欧洲繁荣的五步计划
en: A Five-Step Plan for European Prosperity

zh: 华盛顿—尽管希腊危机大有停止迹象，但欧洲经济局面依然不容乐观。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Though the Greek crisis has been placed on pause, the economic situation in Europe remains bleak.

zh: 欧元区增长较几个月前接近衰退的水平略有提高，但IMF的2015年和2016年预测都没有超过1 % 。
en: Eurozone growth is up slightly from its near-recession levels of a few months ago, but projections by the International Monetary Fund for 2015 and 2016 barely exceed 1%.

zh: 失业率仍高达11%以上 — — 年轻人失业率比这个数字还要高一倍（希腊和西班牙则需要再翻一番 ） 。
en: Unemployment remains above 11% – and twice that among the young (and doubled again in countries like Greece and Spain).

zh: 如今，希腊退出欧元区的破坏性也许么有几年前那么大了。
en: Greece's exit from the eurozone would likely be less disruptive now than it would have been a few years ago.

zh: 在市场眼中，传染风险最大的国家 — — 葡萄牙、西班牙和意大利 — — 现在不再那么脆弱了；欧盟也成立了援助基金；欧洲央行更是启动了大规模债券购买计划。
en: The countries most at risk of contagion – Portugal, Spain, and Italy – are less vulnerable now in the eyes of the markets; the European Union has established a bailout fund; and the European Central Bank has launched a large bond-buying program.

zh: 欧洲的真正挑战是继续停止和公共部门财政压力继续因为福利国家人口不断老龄化而上升。
en: The real challenge in Europe is continued stagnation and rising public-sector fiscal pressures in bloated welfare states with rapidly aging populations.

zh: 重塑增长、机会、繁荣和金融稳定需要在五个相互关联的问题上采取果断动作。
en: Restoring growth, opportunity, prosperity, and financial stability will require bold solutions to five inter-related problems.

zh: 第一个问题是财政。
