en: The first problem is fiscal.

zh: 算术很简单。
en: The math is simple.

zh: 覆盖社会支出所需要的税率必须等于接受福利的人数与纳税人人数之比（供养比）乘以相对于应税收入的平均福利水平（替代率 ） 。
en: The tax rate necessary to fund social spending must equal the ratio of the number of people receiving benefits to the number of taxpayers (the dependency ratio), multiplied by the average benefit relative to the income being taxed (the replacement rate).

zh: 欧洲央行行长德拉吉正是基于这一算术宣布“欧洲社会模式已是明日黄花。
en: It was this math that led Mario Draghi, the president of the European Central Bank, to declare that, “The European social model has already gone."

zh: ”太多欧洲人吃掉了太多福利；但目前政府大多在回避问题，大量举债以延长清算日。
en: Too many Europeans are collecting too many benefits, but so far governments have mostly ducked the issue, taking on massive debt in order to postpone the reckoning.

zh: 真正需要的以社会支出为目标的改革长期缺位。
en: Reform that targets social spending at true need is long overdue.

zh: 第二个问题是经济：十年复十年，欧洲的增长已经远远落后于美国。
en: The second problem is economic: growth in Europe has fallen far short of that in the United States, decade after decade.

zh: 尽管经济学理论认为生活水平会趋同，但欧洲已经落后美国30%有余。
en: Though economic theory predicts convergence in standards of living, Europe lags behind the US by 30% or more.

zh: 高税收和过度监管阻碍了劳动力市场和潜在的新企业。
en: High taxes and burdensome regulations stifle the labor market and potential new businesses.

zh: 过于慷慨的社会福利不利于人们参与工作、雇用、投资和增长的意愿。
en: Overgenerous social-welfare payments create disincentives to work, hire, invest, and grow.

zh: 长期缓慢的增长不足以为欧洲大陆的大量失业和半失业年轻人创造机会。
en: Chronic sluggish growth is insufficient to create opportunities for the continent's masses of unemployed and underemployed young people.

zh: 第三个问题是银行危机。
en: The third problem is the banking crisis.

zh: 在欧洲，银行提供了欧洲经济70%左右的信用，而美国只有30 % 。
en: In Europe, banks supply roughly 70% of the credit to European economies, compared to 30% in the US.

zh: 但许多欧洲银行都是过度负债的僵尸银行，依靠紧急公共流动性注入维持生命。
en: But many European banks are over-leveraged zombies, kept alive by emergency public infusions of liquidity.

zh: 第四是货币危机。
en: Fourth, there is the currency crisis.

zh: 欧元的诸多好处 — — 跨境定价透明性、更低的交易成本和通胀信誉 — — 需要牺牲独立货币政策和浮动汇率来换取。
en: The euro's many benefits – cross-border pricing transparency, lower transaction costs, and inflation credibility – required surrendering independent monetary policies and flexible exchange rates.

zh: 但是，由于跨地区转移和劳动力流动性有限，这意味着欧洲大陆远远不能通过所谓的自动稳定器吸收不相关的冲击。
en: But, given limited interregional transfers and labor mobility, this means that the continent has far less ability to absorb disparate shocks through the operation of so-called automatic stabilizers.

zh: 相反，在美国，高失业的密歇根州居民可以迁往（比如）就业岗位充裕的德克萨斯州，即使联邦税收和转移系统自动向反方向引导资金，缓冲地方衰退。
en: In the US, by contrast, people in high-unemployment Michigan move to, say, Texas, where jobs are plentiful, even as the federal tax and transfer system automatically shifts money in the opposite direction, cushioning the local downturn.

zh: 最后，欧洲面临严重的治理赤字。
en: Finally, Europe faces a severe governance deficit.

zh: 公民对欧洲精英和超国家机构（如欧盟委员会）越来越不信任，因为它们所实施的规则和监管与其国家的经济利益和主权相冲突。
en: Citizens are becoming increasingly disenchanted with European elites and supra-national institutions such as the European Commission, which impose rules and regulations that conflict with their countries' economic interests and sovereignty.

zh: 选民焦躁不安，希腊选举结果就是明证。
en: Voters are restless, as the Greek election result demonstrated.

zh: 民族主义情绪在日益高涨，极右翼和极左翼煽动性政党在选举中纷纷得势。
en: Nationalist sentiment is rising, and demagogic parties of the far right and left are gaining in every poll.

zh: 解决这些问题是困难的，但并非不可能。
en: Addressing these problems will be difficult, but not impossible.

zh: 核心挑战是财政；欧洲必须缩小僵化的福利国家的规模。
en: The core challenge is fiscal; Europe cannot escape the need to scale back its sclerotic welfare states.

zh: 认识到这一点并实施下列互相强化的政策可以让欧洲大陆走出当前的困局。
en: By recognizing that, and implementing the following series of mutually reinforcing policies, the continent can move beyond its current torpor.

zh: 逐步财政整合 — — 降低未来政府支出规模预期，从而降低税率 — — 必须成为核心措施。
en: Gradual fiscal consolidation – reducing the projected future size of government spending, and hence future tax rates – will have to be at the center of the effort.

zh: 除此之外，应该辅之以高负债国家 — — 可��义为债务-GDP之比高于（比如）60%或70%的国家 — — 一定比例负债的共同化和温和减记，替之以长期零息债券。
en: This should be combined with the mutualization of some portion of the liabilities of highly indebted countries – defined as a debt-to-GDP ratio above, say, 60% or 70% – and modest write-downs in exchange for long-term zero-coupon bonds.

zh: 20世纪90年代美国用来帮助解决拉丁美洲解决债务危机的“布雷迪债券”可以作为模板。
en: The “Brady bonds" that the US used to help resolve the Latin American debt crisis in the 1990s could serve as a model.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲的僵尸银行必须通过兼并或暂时接管、清算和资产甩卖予以快速消化，如重组信托公司（Resolution Trust Corporation）在20世纪80年代美国储贷危机中做的那样。
en: Meanwhile, Europe's zombie banks will have to be rapidly resolved by acquisition or temporary takeover, cleanup, and asset sale, as was done by the Resolution Trust Corporation during the US savings and loan crisis in the 1980s.

zh: 此外还必须实施增加劳动力市场灵活性、减少官样文章和新企业成立的相关障碍的结构改革。
en: Structural reforms that increase labor-market flexibility and reduce red tape and related obstacles to new business formation must also be implemented.

zh: 最后，欧元区应该采取汇率浮动的“双轨欧元 ” 。 这一思想由美国经济学家艾伦·梅尔策（Allan Meltzer）提出。
en: Finally, the eurozone should adopt a two-track euro with a fluctuating exchange rate – an idea championed by the American economist Allan Meltzer.

zh: 必须制定系统新规则决定哪些欧元区成员国降级使用“B级欧元”或可升级为“A级欧元 ” 。
en: Systematic rules would have to be developed to determine when members of the eurozone are demoted to “euro B" or promoted to “euro A."

zh: 这一过渡制度 — — 可称之为“不脱离的贬值 ” — —可以避免一国完全退出欧元区所带来的一些（但非全部）问题。
en: Such a halfway house – call it “depreciation without departure" – would avoid some (but not all) of the problems of a country's complete withdrawal from the eurozone.

zh: 这一制度可以造成一系列激励，从整体上向个体国家施压使其避免降级，一如顶级联赛的足球俱乐部寻求避免降至低级别联赛。
en: It would create its own set of incentives, which, on balance, would pressure individual countries to avoid demotion, just as top-tier football (soccer) teams seek to avoid relegation to the minor leagues.

zh: 综合起来，这些措施能减少主权债务、降低利率、减小税收压力、让各国能够以较小的生活水平损失实现竞争力的提升、为欧洲提供繁荣路线图。
en: Together, these policies would reduce sovereign debt, lower interest rates, ameliorate tax pressures, enable countries to increase competitiveness with fewer sacrifices to living standards, and provide Europe with a road map to prosperity.

zh: 到目前为止，欧盟领导人一直在走最容易但生产率最低的道路，在问题爆发时进行一些局部的临时性修补。
en: Until now, the EU's leaders have followed the easiest, but least productive path, patching temporary, partial fixes on problems as they erupt.

zh: 更光明的经济未来前景应该足以刺激欧洲产生让其在二战废墟中重新崛起的领导力。
en: The possibility of a brighter economic future should be a prize large enough to evoke the same type of leadership through which Europe rose from the ashes of World War II.

zh: 安全的庇护之路
en: A Safer Path to Asylum

zh: 伦敦—2014年，190,000多人冒着生命危险从北非渡过地中海前往欧洲。
en: LONDON – In 2014, more than 190,000 people risked their lives crossing the Mediterranean Sea from North Africa to Europe.

zh: 大约3,500人输掉了这场豪赌，在穿越已成为世界最致命的前线时失去了生命。
en: Some 3,500 lost the gamble, dying as they tried to traverse what has become the world's deadliest frontier.

zh: 毫无疑问，一些人之所以走上如此危险的旅程，只是为了寻找收入更好的工作。
en: There can be no doubting that some who undertook the perilous journey did so simply to search for better-paying jobs.

zh: 但这些人的偷渡原因表明其中许多人是政治难民而非经济移民。
en: But the origins of those attempting the trip indicate that many are political refugees, not economic migrants.

zh: 去年，偷渡地中海的大部分人来自厄立特里亚和叙利亚。
en: The majority of those who crossed the Mediterranean last year come from Eritrea and Syria.

zh: 许多人在逃出国已获得联合国难民署（UNHCR）的正式难民身份。
en: Many have been formally recognized as refugees by the United Nations Refugee Agency (UNHCR) in the countries to which they initially fled.

zh: 90%的欧洲庇护申请者获得了某种程度的保护 — — 这进一步表明他们拥有真正的难民身份。
en: Some 90% of those who apply for asylum in Europe are granted some sort of protection – a further testament to their status as bona fide refugees.

zh: 欧盟应该将地中海危机的讨论与广义的移民争论区分开来。
en: It is time for the European Union to separate the discussion of the crisis in the Mediterranean from its broader immigration debate.

zh: 对于欧盟以南邻近地区的事件的政策、用语和反应必须与对于为了找工作而自愿从一个安全国家迁往另一个安全国家的事件有所区别。
en: The policies, language, and response to the events unfolding on the EU's southern border must be different from those concerning the voluntary movement of job seekers from one safe country to another.

zh: 事实上，合适的讨论背景应该是欧洲国家根据国际难民法的义务。
en: Indeed, the proper context of the discussion is European countries' obligations under international refugee law.

zh: 欧盟及其成员国所实施的政策与在穿越地中海时所发生的死亡直接相关。
en: The policies put in place by the EU and its member states are directly responsible for the plight of those who die attempting to cross the Mediterranean.

zh: 阻止难民到达的措施并没有减少获得欧洲庇护的人的数量；只是让授予难民身份的过程变得更加随机、更加危险。
en: Efforts to discourage refugees from arriving have not diminished the number of people who are granted asylum in Europe; they have merely made the process of being granted refugee status more random and dangerous.

zh: 每个欧洲国家都加入了承认难民有寻求庇护、不可强迫他们回到已不再安全的国家的国际条约。
en: Every country in Europe is party to international treaties that recognize the rights of refugees to seek asylum and not be forcibly returned to countries where they will be unsafe.

zh: 此外，尽管有人呼吁地中海沿岸国家建立制度以改善危机处理、共同承担难民负担，但让难民更加安全、在接受国中更加易于管理的措施极少。
en: And yet, despite calls by frontline Mediterranean states to establish systems to improve the handling of the crisis and share the burden, little is being done to make things safer for refugees or more manageable for the countries in which they arrive.

zh: 叙利亚和伊拉克周边国家面临着逃离上述两国暴力的最大量的难民涌入，UNHCR 呼吁协助安置有限数量的最需要群体。
en: The countries neighboring Syria and Iraq are facing the largest inflows of refugees fleeing the violence there, and the UNHCR has appealed for assistance in resettling a limited number of the neediest.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，最有能力接收难民的国家反应冷淡。
en: So far, however, the response from the countries that can most easily afford to take in refugees has been pathetic.

zh: 更糟糕的是，近几年来，许多此前可以轻松获得赴欧学习、工作和探亲许可的人如今仅仅因为难民身份而无法获得签证。
en: Even worse, many people who, as recently as a few years ago, would have easily obtained permission to study, work, or visit relatives in Europe are being denied visas simply because of their refugee status.

zh: 没有理由要求寻求庇护的人穿越整个沙漠，饱受蛇头虐待，遭遇殴打、勒索、强奸和剥削 — — 或要求他们在路上体验目睹亲朋好友的死亡带来的创伤。
en: There is no reason to require people seeking an asylum hearing to run a gamut of desert crossings, abuse by smugglers, beatings, extortion, rape, and exploitation – or to have them experience the trauma of watching their friends and family die along the way.

zh: 这样做是残忍的、不合人道的，并且违反了所有难民、人权和移民法的精神。
en: Doing so is cruel and inhumane, and it violates the spirit of all refugee, human rights, and immigration laws.

zh: 在过去，非洲、亚洲和中东的安置措施会审查相关人员以确定他们的难民身份；评估他们的教育、技能和家庭关系以确定他们在哪里最有可能实现融入；并且与欧洲、北美和澳大利亚政府合作为他们寻找新家。
en: In the past, resettlement programs in Africa, Asia, and the Middle East screened people to establish their status as refugees; assessed their education, skills, and family relations to determine where they might be integrated most easily; and worked with European, North American, and Australian governments to find them new homes.

zh: 20世纪80年代，这些措施帮助了成千上万埃塞俄比亚人、越南人和阿根廷人。 看看那些安置受益者的社区就能发现，绝大多数已成为自食其力的纳税人。
en: In the 1980s, such programs helped thousands of Ethiopians, Vietnamese, and Argentines, and a look at the communities in which the beneficiaries were resettled reveals that the vast majority have become self-reliant taxpayers.

zh: 没有理由认为今天逃离暴力和迫害的人不能获得同样的待遇。
en: There is no reason that something similar cannot be done for those fleeing violence and persecution today.

zh: 寻求庇护者如果可以有机会再当地获得表达诉求的机会，他们就不会被迫冒着生命危险渡海前往意大利或希腊。
en: If asylum seekers were provided with opportunities to present their claims in the countries where they currently find themselves, they would not be forced to risk their lives at sea to reach Italy or Greece.

zh: 厄立特里亚人将会在喀土穆申请瑞典、德国或英国庇护。
en: Eritreans could file applications in Khartoum for asylum in Sweden, Germany, or the United Kingdom.

zh: 开罗或贝鲁特的叙利亚人也可以这样做。
en: Syrians in Cairo or Beirut could do the same.

zh: 这些诉求可以按照规定方式予以优先处理，这样难民就可以健康地到达欧洲并随时开始工作或学习。
en: The claims could be prioritized and processed in a regular manner, and the refugees could arrive in Europe healthy and ready to work or study.

zh: 地中海危机无法通过零敲碎打的措施管理。
en: The crisis in the Mediterranean cannot be managed in a piecemeal manner.

zh: 搜寻水域、拯救漂流者的财务成本非常高。
en: The financial costs of patrolling its waters and rescuing those adrift are exorbitant.

zh: 生命的损失是不可挽回的。
en: The loss of lives is inexcusable.

zh: 但我们不必坐等流离失所的根源 — — 国家失败和内战 — — 得到纠正。
en: But we do not have to wait until the root causes of displacement – state failure and civil war – are addressed.

zh: 我们只需要找到勇气建立一套制度，让绝望的人不再需要拿生命冒险以求庇护和安置。
en: We need only to find the courage to create a system in which desperate people do not have to risk their lives to apply for asylum and resettlement.

zh: 欧洲难民政策的不人道之处
en: The Inhumanity of Europe’s Refugee Policy

zh: 马斯特里赫特—对于在希腊莱斯博斯（Lesbos）莫里亚（Moria）难民营的寻求庇护者而言 ， “ 几乎”一词成了灾难之源。
en: MAASTRICHT – For the asylum seekers in the Moria refugee camp in Lesbos, Greece, the word “almost” has become a source of devastation.

zh: 他们几乎就要成功了。
en: They almost made it.

zh: 他们几乎就要走到残酷旅程的终点。
en: They are almost at the end of their brutal journey.

zh: 27岁的幼女之父、来自阿富汗喀布尔的MBA毕业生阿拉什（Aarash）说 ， “ 说尽做尽，我们几乎成为人。
en: As Aarash, a 27-year-old father of a young daughter and an MBA graduate from Kabul, Afghanistan, put it, “When all is said and done, we are only almost human.”

zh: ”而欧洲也只是几乎欢迎他们。
en: And Europe only almost welcomes them.

zh: “几乎”给困在莱斯博斯和萨默斯（Samos）的寻求庇护者造成了不可承受的绝望，他们历尽旅程和难民营生活的创伤。
en: “Almost” causes unbearable despair to the asylum-seekers trapped on Lesbos and Samos, who have already endured the trauma of their journey and camp life.

zh: 据无国界医生组织（Doctors without Borders）10月份发布的报告，萨默斯近50%的难民在国境土耳其时经历了暴力，近25%在到达希腊后经历了暴力。
en: According to a report released in October by Doctors without Borders, nearly 50% of refugees on Samos experienced violence while passing through Turkey, and close to 25% had experienced violence since arriving in Greece.

zh: 负责莫里亚难民营脆弱性评估的官员已经不再问人们是否被强暴，而是问受到了多残忍的强暴，受到了多么频繁的强暴。
en: Officials undertaking vulnerability assessments at Moria are left asking not whether someone has been raped, but how brutally and how often.

zh: 在这一背景下，毫不奇怪居民饱受心理打击。
en: Against this background, it is unsurprising that residents suffer psychologically.

zh: 但等待接受心理治疗的名单有500多人那么长，这意味着最后几乎没有人能得到任何支持。
en: Yet the waiting list for psychological treatment is over 500 names long, meaning that few will end up receiving any support at all.

zh: 与此同时，由希腊非盈利组织莫里亚国际紧急响应中心（Emergency Response Center International in Moria）天天都会遇到自残的情况，自杀也屡见不鲜。
en: In the meantime, a small clinic run by the Greek nonprofit Emergency Response Center International in Moria confronts cases of self-harm daily, and suicide is not uncommon.

zh: 创伤专家保罗·史蒂文森（Paul Stevenson）描述了一种沮丧症候，这是他在位于澳大利亚海域的瑙鲁难民羁押营所观察到的。
en: The trauma specialist Paul Stevenson described a demoralization syndrome that he observed during his work at migrant detention centers on Nauru, off the Australian coast.

zh: 他说，发生自然灾害后的创伤后应激障碍的发病率大约有3 % 。
en: Following a natural disaster, he says, the incidence of post-traumatic stress disorder is about 3%.

zh: 发生恐怖袭击的话，这个数字会上升到25%左右。
en: After a terrorist attack, that figure rises to about 25%.

zh: 对于虐待和囚禁，这个数字会增加到50 % ， 因为这是一个人所能经历的“最令人沮丧的情况。 ”
en: In the case of torture and incarceration, it jumps to 50%, because that “is considered to be the most demoralizing situation” a person can experience.

zh: 心理虐待和囚禁便是莫里亚难民营中的寻求庇护者的“日常 ” 。
en: Psychological torture and incarceration are effectively what asylum-seekers in the Moria camp now face.

zh: 尽管他们被允许随意进出，但除了食品分配点，他们找不到别的生存之所。
en: Although they are permitted to come and go as they please, there are no alternative living spaces or food-distribution points.

zh: 而难民营的条件非常拥挤，设施严重不足 — — 据估计，目前有6,600名寻求庇护者挤在为3,000人建造的难民营中 — — 更不用说始终存在的虐待威胁了。
en: And conditions in the camp are characterized by cramped and inadequate facilities – an estimated 6,600 asylum-seekers are currently residing in a camp built for 3,000 – not to mention the constant threat of abuse.

zh: 这一状况与欧盟的说法形成了鲜明对比。
en: This situation contrasts sharply with the European Union’s narrative.

zh: 欧洲难民危机 — — 或者更准确地说，是难民管理危机 — — 在2015年夏天达到顶峰，一年后，欧盟宣布情况已经得到控制。
en: A year after the European refugee crisis – or, more accurately, refugee-management crisis – peaked in the summer of 2015, the EU declared that the situation was under control.

zh: 但是，尽管到达欧洲海岸的难民数量确实是减少了，但只要你最近到莱斯博斯看一看就会明白，危机远未结束。
en: But, while it is true that fewer refugees were arriving on Europe’s shores, anyone who has been to Lesbos lately knows that the crisis is far from over.

zh: 分析家门将2015年以来欧盟的地中海庇护和安全政策与“欧洲堡垒 ” （ fortress Europe）的建立有关。
en: Analysts have likened the EU’s asylum and security policies in the Mediterranean since 2015 to the construction of a “fortress Europe.”

zh: 如果欧盟是一个堡垒，那么莫里亚难民营就是刑讯室，其噩梦般的条件早已曝光于天下。
en: If the EU is a fortress, Moria camp is its torture chamber, with nightmarish conditions that have been well documented.

zh: 这已不再是一个“难民危机 ” ， 甚至也不是“难民管理危机 ” 。
en: This is no longer a “refugee crisis” or even a “refugee-management crisis.”

zh: 现在，这是一场刻意的人道主义危机。
en: It is now a humanitarian crisis by design.

zh: 考虑到欧盟所拥有的数据和资源，这一结果只能被认为是有意为之。
en: Given the EU’s data and resources, this outcome can be viewed only as intentional.

zh: 事实上，可怕的条件被允许出现在难民营中，因为当局希望借此恐吓其他寻求庇护者 — — 包括一些确实无权获得国际保护的人 — — 不要前来，甚至将一些已经到达的寻求庇护者吓回去。
en: In fact, appalling conditions are being allowed to prevail in refugee camps, because authorities want to deter other asylum seekers – including some who arguably have no right to international protection – from trying to get in, and potentially even to impel some who have arrived to return home.

zh: 这一逻辑认为，较好的难民营条件以及允许难民登陆希腊大陆将导致新一波难民潮。
en: Better camp conditions and allowing refugees to reach the Greek mainland, the logic goes, would contribute to another surge in crossings.

zh: 希腊最高行政法院已在质疑这一遏制政策的合法性 — — 该政策脱胎于有争议的欧盟-土耳其协定。
en: Greece’s highest administrative court has called into question the legality of this containment policy, a result of the controversial EU-Turkey agreement.

zh: 但希腊政府对法院裁决视而不见。
en: The Greek government, however, has defied the court’s ruling.

zh: 这是对人道尊严的毫无良心、犬儒注意的残忍漠视，其理由偏见而狭隘。
en: It is a heartless, cynical strategy of reckless disregard for human dignity, justified by bigoted discourse and biased narratives.

zh: 欧洲公民和领导人真的准备抛弃团结和同情等基本价值观，只为获得由利比亚雇佣兵保护的屏障、与土耳其达成的理应非法的协议，并让寻求逃离欧洲参与制造的贫困和冲突的人陷入悲惨的条件？
en: Are Europe’s citizens and leaders really prepared to abandon basic values like solidarity and empathy for a future of walls guarded by Libyan mercenaries, an arguably unlawful deal with Turkey, and unconscionable conditions for people seeking refuge from poverty and conflicts that Europe helped to create?

zh: 无论如何，面对“几乎”复“几乎 ” ， 莫里亚难民营的居民们仍然寄希望于欧洲很快就会想起并信守它保护人权的承诺。
en: Against all logic, and despite “almost” after “almost,” Moria camp residents remain hopeful that Europe will soon remember and abide by its commitments to upholding human rights.

zh: 与此同时，他们也证明了往往在不人道的条件下，人性会闪耀出最耀眼的光芒。
en: In the meantime, they demonstrate that it is often in inhumane conditions that humanity shines the brightest.

zh: 新到来者能够获得社区支持，包括如何在难民营的令人沮丧的环境中生存下来的教训。
en: New arrivals receive support from their communities, including lessons on survival in the camp’s demoralizing environment.

zh: 难民营不同种族的社区常常合作行动，确保（比如）精神状况不稳的同胞真的能够获得治疗。
en: The camp’s different ethnic communities often act together to ensure that compatriots who develop psychosis, for example, are among those who actually receive treatment.

zh: 瓦齐（Waqi）在到达希腊前后经历了难以置信的人生苦难，但现在她照顾着两家的孩子，因为他们的父母亲因为抑郁而无法胜任。
en: Waqi, despite incredible personal trauma experienced before and after her arrival in Greece, cares for the children of two families because their depressive parents cannot.

zh: 本不必如此。
en: It does not have to be this way.

zh: 许多承诺政策都有潜力形成被提出来的安全人道的庇护流程。
en: Many promising policies with the potential to create a safe and humane asylum process have been proposed.

zh: 这些流程包括人道主义签证、接收国和寻求庇护者之间的志愿匹配、再安置和加强对前沿国家的支持等。
en: These include humanitarian visas, preference matching between host countries and asylum seekers, resettlement, and much stronger support for frontline countries.

zh: 支持这些方案可能令人不快，或者在政治上不受欢迎。
en: Advocating for such solutions may not be comfortable or politically popular.

zh: 制定和实施尊重寻求庇护者的权利和人道的新庇护政策需要果断的领导力。
en: Developing and implementing new asylum policies that respect the rights and humanity of asylum-seekers will demand bold leadership.

zh: 但现状显然是不可接受的。
en: But the status quo is clearly unacceptable.

zh: 厘清欧洲的难民危机
en: Clarifying Europe’s Refugee Problem

zh: 马德里—即使从欧盟标准看，对所谓的难民危机的响应也堪称一团糟。
en: MADRID – Even by European Union standards, the response to the so-called refugee crisis is a mess.

zh: 这似乎不合逻辑：尽管这场危机毫无疑问是一个挑战，但人权 — — 事实上，也包括难民保护 — — 深深地印在欧洲的DNA上。
en: This seems to defy logic: While the crisis is certainly a challenge, human rights – and, indeed, refugee protection – are embedded in Europe’s DNA.

zh: 此外，日益老龄化、人口挑战日益严峻的欧盟成员国也需要移民。
en: Moreover, the EU’s aging and demographically challenged member states need immigrants.

zh: 但是，目前的危机并没有刺激解决方案的出现，反而暴露了欧洲工程丑陋、恶劣、失调的一面。
en: Yet, instead of spurring solutions, the current crisis has been bringing out all that is ugly, feckless, and dysfunctional about the European project.

zh: 到底发生了什么？
en: What happened?

zh: 和欧盟通常的情况一样，问题在于缺乏明确性。
en: As is so often the case with the EU, the problem is a lack of clarity.

zh: 难民和移民之间界限模糊，这导致几乎不可能出现令人信服的支持合理难民保护或更有效的移民政策的观点。
en: The blurring of the lines between refugee and immigrant has made it virtually impossible to make compelling arguments in favor of proper refugee protection or more effective immigration policy.

zh: 这困扰着诚心诚意的建设性对话，让宣扬恐惧和本土论者占了上风。
en: This has thwarted honest and constructive discussion, allowing those who peddle fear and nativism to gain ground.

zh: 移民和难民混为一谈也许并非恶意为之。
en: The conflation of immigrants and refugees was probably not the result of malicious intent.

zh: 去年9月，德国总理对难民采取了打开大门的政策，此后出现了大量报告，为她的决定提供经济和人口支持。
en: Following the introduction of German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s open-door policy toward refugees last September, a raft of reports emerged offering economic and demographic arguments within which her decision could be framed.

zh: 但这些支持实际上有损于难民保护的概念：着重于难民的潜在经济作用在不经意间强化了他们其实是经济移民的观点。
en: But such arguments actually poisoned the idea of refugee protection: The focus on the potential economic role of refugees inadvertently reinforced the view that they were, in fact, economic migrants.

zh: 民粹主义政党紧紧抓住了这一概念。 它们通过利用人民的恐惧和对全球化的不满，已经站稳了脚跟。
en: Populist parties, which had already gained a foothold by playing on people’s fears of and frustrations with globalization, seized on this notion.

zh: 在长期失业高企、公共债务负担沉重的背景下，它们宣称难民将从欧洲人手中夺走工作岗位，甚至更糟糕地，将耗尽欧洲纳税人供养的社会福利。
en: At a time of high long-term unemployment and heavy public-debt burdens, they declared that the refugees would take jobs from Europeans or, worse, drain European taxpayer-funded social benefits.

zh: 一些欧洲人对欧盟处理过去的危机的表现十分不满，沦为民族主义情绪的附庸；因此，民粹主义者不难将数十万涌入欧洲各国的难民描述为对民族身份的新威胁。
en: Some European populations, frustrated with the EU’s handling of past crises, had already begun to fall prey to nationalist sentiment; so it was not difficult for populists to portray the hundreds of thousands of refugees streaming into European countries as a new threat to national identity.

zh: 加莱、马其顿和科斯（Kos）边境的乱象加剧了失序的印象。
en: Chaotic border scenes from Calais, Macedonia, and Kos reinforced the image of disorder.

zh: 最后，骇人听闻的巴黎和布鲁塞尔恐怖袭击为这一讨论注入了影响深远的不安全感，尽管这两次袭击是欧洲人实施的。
en: Finally, the horrific terror attacks in Paris and Brussels, though carried out by European nationals, infused a profound sense of insecurity into the discussion.

zh: 当所有这些挑战汇聚在一起时，问题就变得十分棘手，产生了一种孤立主义应对措施是欧盟各国保护自己的唯一希望的印象。
en: When all of these challenges are lumped together, the problem seems intractable, creating the impression that an isolationist response is EU countries’ only hope for protecting themselves.

zh: 但欧洲实际上面临的是三个不同的挑战：保护难民，这是欧洲和国际法律的要求；制定有效、可持续的移民政策以惠及欧盟；以及响应第二代和第三代欧洲移民的不满情绪。
en: But what Europe actually faces is three distinct challenges: protecting refugees, as required by European and international law; developing an effective and sustainable immigration policy that will benefit the EU; and responding to the discontent of second- and third-generation immigrant communities in Europe.

zh: 只要分开考虑，有效解决方案就会浮现出来。
en: When considered separately, effective solutions begin to emerge.

zh: 对于已经在欧洲生活的移民的激进化问题，已经有了大量讨论，特别是在3月布鲁塞尔袭击之后。
en: In terms of radicalization among communities already living in Europe, much has been said, particularly following the attacks in March in Brussels.

zh: 很少被提到的是这些人是欧洲人。
en: What too few have pointed out is that these are Europeans.

zh: 以移民标准处理他们的不安定和不满只能进一步疏离他们。
en: Dealing with their restlessness and frustration within the context of immigration will only alienate them further.

zh: 至于难民挑战，解决方案必须从厘清欧洲的实际责任开始。
en: As for the refugee challenge, the solution must begin with clarity about Europe’s actual responsibilities.

zh: 为有“理由充分的受迫害恐惧”的人提供保护被写入了联合国公约中有关难民地位的内容，并由里斯本条约执行。
en: The duty to provide protection to those with a “well-founded fear of being persecuted” is contained in the United Nations Convention relating to the Status of Refugees, and reinforced by the Treaty of Lisbon.

zh: 换句话说，欧盟必须保护那些一旦回国就将立刻遭遇危险的人，而不是所有抵达欧洲边境的人。
en: In other words, the EU must protect those who face imminent danger if returned to their home country, not everyone arriving at its borders.

zh: 此外，这一保护并非永久性。
en: Moreover, that protection is not supposed to be permanent.

zh: 如果回国已经安全，那些尚未获得永久居留权或公民权的人就应该回国。
en: When it is safe to return home, those who have not obtained permanent residency or citizenship should do so.

zh: 所有人都必须明白，保护逃离迫害的人的义务是有边界的。
en: Everyone must understand that the obligation to protect people fleeing persecution has its limits.

zh: 平心而论，不应该让欧洲独自承担这一负担。
en: To be sure, Europe should not be shouldering this burden alone.

zh: 全体国际社会也应该贡献力量。
en: The entire international community should be doing its part.

zh: 1979年举行了一次国际会议讨论应对越南战争结束和柬埔寨红色高棉种族灭绝所产生的难民危机问题；在接下来的两年中，620,000 多难民被20个国家收容。
en: In 1979, an international conference was held to respond to the refugee crisis that arose from the end of the Vietnam War and the mayhem of the Khmer Rouge genocide in Cambodia; over the next two years, more than 620,000 refugees were resettled in 20 countries.

zh: 今天也急需这样的合作行动。
en: Such cooperative action is badly needed today.

zh: 只要国际社会不兑现其对难民的责任，就无法说服狐疑的欧洲公众这样���。
en: As long as the rest of the international community fails to fulfill its responsibilities toward the refugees, it will remain difficult to convince a skeptical European public to do so.

zh: 明确性在解决移民问题上也同样重要。
en: Clarity is similarly vital in addressing immigration.

zh: 欢迎移民符合欧洲的利益。
en: Welcoming immigrants is in Europe’s interest.

zh: 但欢迎什么样的移民应该由欧洲决定。
en: But precisely which immigrants should be up to Europe.

zh: 但无论是欧盟还是任何一个成员国，移民政策都与这一思维不符。
en: Yet neither the EU nor any of its member states has a coherent immigration policy with this end in mind.

zh: 这必须做出改变，欧盟要拿出吸引确保经济增长和竞争力所需要的人才和劳动力的能力证明。
en: This must change, with the EU demonstrating its capacity to attract the talent and labor needed to ensure economic growth and competitiveness.

zh: 除了合适的难民和移民政策，欧洲还需要合适的实施工具。
en: Beyond appropriate refugee and immigration policy, Europe needs proper tools for implementation.

zh: 如果边境不安全，或移民规则得不到有效应用，那么信号和激励就不会起作用。
en: No amount of messaging and incentives will work if the borders are not secure or immigration rules are not being applied effectively.

zh: 有人说，区分难民和移民等于排斥所有人。
en: It has been said that differentiating between refugees and immigrants is code for excluding everyone.

zh: 绝非如此。
en: That is not the case.

zh: 更准确地理解欧洲所面临的不同问题对于解决这些问题至关重要。
en: A more precise understanding of the distinct problems facing Europe is vital to resolving them.

zh: 如果我们要解决欧洲内部边缘化群体的不满，就需要理解他们的不满背后的因素。
en: If we are to address the discontent of marginalized communities within Europe, we need to understand the factors underlying it.

zh: 如果我们要履行我们的国际难民义务，就需要明白我们的责任在哪里。
en: If we are to meet our international obligations toward refugees, we need to know what those responsibilities are.

zh: 如果我们要确保移民能够让新来者和东道主都受益，就需要明白我们在寻求哪些好处。
en: If we are to ensure that immigration benefits both the newcomers and their host communities, we need to identify what benefits we are seeking.

zh: 缺少这样的明确性，试图通过简单的仇外宣传分裂我们的民粹主义者就会得逞。
en: Without such clarity, populists seeking to tear us apart with their simplistic xenophobic propaganda will thrive.

zh: 欧洲的难民问题：过去和现在
en: Europe’s Refugee Problem, Then and Now

zh: 纽约—今年春天早些时候，我驾车来到日内瓦湖南岸的一处美丽风景。
en: NEW YORK – Earlier this spring, I drove to a beautiful spot on the southern bank of Lake Geneva.

zh: 我的目的地是埃维昂莱班（Évian-les-Bains）的皇家酒店（Hotel Royale ） 。
en: My destination was the Hotel Royale in Évian-les-Bains.

zh: 1938年，就是在这里，32个国家进行了可耻的讨论，这段历史已经基本上从我们的记忆中抹去了。
en: It was there, in July 1938, that 32 nations met for a shameful discussion that has been virtually airbrushed from our memory.

zh: 埃维昂会议由美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福召集，目的是为了应对希特勒残暴的反犹主义所造成的大规模难民危机。 这次会议是一场灾难。
en: Convened by US President Franklin D. Roosevelt in response to the massive refugee crisis triggered by Hitler’s virulent anti-Semitism, the Évian conference was a catastrophe.

zh: 在今天的欧洲移民危机的衬托下，我们应该再次铭记起它的可怕后果。
en: And its disastrous outcome needs to be recalled in the light of Europe’s current migration crisis.

zh: 埃维昂会议原本是为了解决急于逃难的数十万德国和奥地利犹太人的困境。
en: The Évian conference was supposed to address the plight of hundreds of thousands of German and Austrian Jews who were desperate for refuge.

zh: 罗斯福认为唯有集体方案能够应对这一挑战。
en: Roosevelt believed that only a collective solution could meet the challenge.

zh: 希特勒也希望其他国家可以接受他们。
en: Hitler, too, hoped that other countries would accept them.

zh: 在那年3月的柯尼斯堡（Königsberg）讲话中，他揶揄道 ： “ 我只能希望和期待另一个世界对这些罪犯怀有深刻的同情，能够慷慨地将它们的怜悯之情转化为实际援助。
en: In a speech in Königsberg that March, he jeered, “I can only hope and expect that the other world which has felt such deep sympathy for these criminals will be generous enough to transform this pity into practical aid.

zh: 就我个人而言，我准备随时将我们的豪华船只提供给这些国家调遣，用于运送这些罪犯。
en: As far as I am concerned we are ready to place our luxury ships at the disposal of these countries for the transportation of these criminals.”

zh: ”他已经开始驱逐犹太人，手段包括强行把他们驱赶上船，运往地中海和大西洋的各个目的地。
en: He had already begun to expel Jews, including by placing them forcibly on ships and sending them to various destinations in the Mediterranean and across the Atlantic.

zh: 但是，难民在整个欧洲都面临被拒绝的局面。
en: But, throughout Europe, the refugees faced rejection.

zh: 1938年6月6日，埃维昂会议筹备期间，美国国务院收到了一封信，上面说，51名奥地利犹太难民被困在了多瑙河国际水域中的一条小船上。
en: On June 6, 1938, as preparations for the conference were underway, the US State Department received a letter concerning 51 Austrian Jewish refugees stranded on a small boat in the international waters of the Danube.

zh: 写信者回忆他看到的情景 ： “ 51个人在边界上被推来推去，令人揪心。
en: The writer recalled seeing: “the heartrending fate of 51 human beings driven from one frontier to the other.

zh: 我们感受到了无辜降临在100,000奥地利居民头上的莫可名状的痛苦。 ”
en: We have gained personal knowledge of the unspeakable misery that has innocently befallen 100,000 inhabitants of Austria.”

zh: 但接下来，在埃维昂的那个月中，尽管许多欧洲代表团对于德国和奥地利犹太人所经受的折磨表示诚挚的哀悼，但并不准备采取实质行动。
en: And yet in Évian the following month, although many European delegations voiced eloquent dismay over the torment experienced by the Jews of Germany and Austria, they were unprepared to take concrete action.

zh: 会议的结果是清楚的：欧洲、北美和澳大利亚不会接受大量这样的难民。
en: The outcome of the meeting was clear: Europe, North America, and Australia would not accept significant numbers of these refugees.

zh: 在会议报告的用语中，有两个词频繁出现 ： “ 密度 ” （ density）和“饱和 ” （ saturation ） 。
en: In the verbatim record, two words were uttered repeatedly: “density” and “saturation.”

zh: 欧洲国家已经饱受人口“密度”困扰，达到了“饱和”点 — — 换句话说，欧洲已经没有更多的空间。
en: The European countries were already beset with population “density” and had reached a point of “saturation” – in other words, there was simply no more room at the European inn.

zh: 当然，从当今欧洲人口规模看，1938年说出这样的话简直可笑。
en: It was an absurd thing to say, of course, in 1938, given the size of Europe’s populations today.

zh: 而现在说这样的话也同样荒谬。
en: And it would be an equally ridiculous thing to say now, too.

zh: 平心而论，埃维昂会议的参与者不可能预见到大屠杀或欧洲将发生又一场灾难性大战；尽管如此，他们的缺少良知仍然令人心碎。
en: To be sure, the participants in Évian could not have foreseen the Holocaust, or that Europe was being drawn into another devastating war; nonetheless, their lack of moral conscience was breathtaking.

zh: 许多拒绝接受蒙难难民的国家后来纷纷被纳粹占领和蹂躏 — — 急切地需要它们在1938年拒绝了犹太人的同情心。
en: Many of the countries that refused to take in suffering refugees were themselves, in due course, occupied and brutalized by the Nazis – and desperate for the compassion that they denied the Jews in July 1938.

zh: 残暴的反犹主义在欧洲其他地区取得了回音 — — 有时还相当有力 — — 这一定让纳粹欣喜不已。
en: The Nazis must have reveled in the knowledge that their virulent anti-Semitism found an echo – sometimes not so faint – in the rest of Europe.

zh: 它们还开始意识到，如果驱逐无从实现，最终就必须进行种族灭绝。
en: They also came to realize that if expulsion was not possible, extermination eventually would be.

zh: 如今，反犹主义、伊斯兰恐惧症、种族主义、仇外主义和反移民情绪再次在欧洲横行，如今，我们必须停下来准确地评估一下我们身在何处。
en: Today, anti-Semitism, Islamophobia, racism, xenophobia, and anti-migrant sentiment are again rising across Europe, and we must stop now and reassess precisely where we are.

zh: 一家著名英国小报最近认为，让其专栏作家将移民称为“蟑螂”也是可以接受的。
en: A major British tabloid newspaper recently felt it acceptable to allow one of its columnists to call immigrants “cockroaches.”

zh: 1994年种族灭绝前夕，卢旺达米勒·柯林斯自由广播电视台（Radio Télévision Libre des Mille Collines）用同样的词汇描述图西族人��一如当年朱利乌斯·施特赖歇尔（Julius Streicher）的纳粹报纸《先锋报 》 （ Der Stürmer）描述犹太人。
en: Rwanda’s Radio Télévision Libre des Mille Collines used the same word to describe Tutsis in the run-up to the 1994 genocide, as did Julius Streicher’s Nazi newspaper Der Stürmer to describe Jews.

zh: 全欧洲的政治领袖时不时可耻地指责移民需要为国家乱象负责。
en: Political leaders across Europe regularly – and shamefully – blame migrants for their national woes.

zh: 攻击移民或少数群体 — — 不管是通过言语赤裸裸地攻击还是通过政策更加巧妙地攻击 — — 在无论什么地方都是不可接受的。
en: Attacking migrants or minorities – whether crudely, through language, or more subtly, through policy – is unacceptable everywhere, full stop.

zh: 当人们带着明确的目的性使用导致民族、种族和宗教伤害和暴力的词汇时，言论自由就成了仇恨的催化剂，而这是法律不允许的。
en: When words are formulated with the clear intention of causing harm and violence on national, racial or religious grounds, freedom of expression becomes incitement to hatred, which is prohibited by law.

zh: 签署了国际公民权利和政治权利公约（International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights）的国家（包括所有欧盟成员国）都有法律义务捍卫它。
en: Countries that have ratified the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, which includes all European Union members, are bound to uphold it.

zh: 但目前的欧洲移民提案大有改进必要。
en: And yet Europe’s current proposals on migration leave much to be desired.

zh: 欧洲大陆需要更加细致地回顾它的过去，更佳慷慨地对待穿越地中海的绝望的人民。
en: The continent needs to recall its past more sensitively, and be more generous to the desperate people crossing the Mediterranean.

zh: 移民人权特别调查员弗朗西斯·克雷皮欧（François Crépeau）在最新的采访中观察道，欧洲、澳大利亚和加拿大可以轻松地在未来五年中收容一百万叙利亚难民，并且可以将厄立特里亚人也包括进来并把该政策延长到七年。
en: François Crépeau, the United Nations special rapporteur on the human rights of migrants, observed in a recent interview that Europe, Australia, and Canada could easily resettle one million Syrian refugees over the next five years, and they could add Eritreans to that list and extend this policy to seven years.

zh: 既然如此，为何欧洲仅仅提出每年收容20,000—40,000人？
en: So why is Europe proposing to accept a paltry 20,000-40,000 people annually for resettlement?

zh: 对于强烈反对移民的欧洲政客，我建议下一次当你们需要医院治疗时，看一看周围的人：许多照看你的人都是移民。
en: To the European politician strongly opposed to migration, I suggest that the next time you need hospital treatment, take a look around you: many of the people caring for you have a migrant’s tale.

zh: 而当你们打开来自埃维昂莱班的依云矿泉水解渴时，你们应该想一想，这里曾经举行过一次可耻地失败的会议，这个会议原本可以拯救无数人的生命，它能给今天的我们带来什么教训？
en: And should you quench your thirst with the famous water drawn from Évian-les-Bains, you may wish to reflect on the craven failure of a conference that could have saved so many lives – and on what it can still teach us today.

zh: 欧洲的难民机会
en: Europe's Refugee Opportunity

zh: 罗马—欧洲的所谓难民危机原本绝不应该成为一种紧急状况。
en: ROME – Europe’s so-called refugee crisis should never have become an emergency.

zh: 安置一百万寻求庇护者不应该成为欧盟的艰巨挑战 — — 欧盟拥有5亿公民，每年都要迎来三百多万移民。
en: Accommodating one million asylum-seekers should not be a huge challenge for the European Union – an area with 500 million citizens that welcomes more than three million immigrants every year.

zh: 不幸的是，缺乏协作应对措施正在将这个可管理的问题变为一场尖锐的政治危机 — — 如德国总理默克尔所正确地警告的，这场危机可能毁掉欧盟。
en: Unfortunately, the lack of a coordinated response is transforming a manageable problem into an acute political crisis – one that, as German Chancellor Angela Merkel has rightly warned, could destroy the EU.

zh: 大部分欧盟成员国都自私地只关注自身利益。
en: Most EU member states are selfishly focusing on their own interests.

zh: 这让它们彼此对立，也制造了恐慌，让难民的境况更加危险。
en: This pits them against one another and has precipitated panic, putting refugees in even greater peril.

zh: 明智的全面计划可以平息恐慌。
en: A smart, comprehensive plan would calm the fears.

zh: 相反，欧盟却偏好于寻找替罪羊 — — 而希腊则是最新的指责对象。
en: Instead, Europe has preferred to search for scapegoats – and Greece is the latest to be targeted for blame.

zh: 希腊被指责在处理和安置移民方面做得不够。
en: Greece has been accused of not doing enough to process and house refugees.

zh: 然而，即使希腊没有受到经济危机影响，要求像它这样的小国独自承担这一负担也是不合理的 — — 特别是面临一年800,000多难民过境的情况。
en: And yet, even if the country were not crippled by economic crisis, it would be unreasonable to expect a single small country to bear the burden alone – especially in a year when more than 800,000 refugees are expected to pass through its territory.

zh: 这是一个欧洲和全球问题，而不仅仅是希腊的问题。
en: This is a European and global problem, not solely a Greek problem.

zh: 应该负责的对象有很多。
en: There is plenty of blame to go around.

zh: 在希腊，乔治·索罗斯（George Soros）的开放社会基金会（Open Society Foundations）与欧洲经济区（European Economic Area）和挪威捐赠基金（Norway Grants）合作行动，预见到欧洲高层避难政策缺位可能带来的问题。
en: In Greece, George Soros’s Open Society Foundations, acting in partnership with European Economic Area and Norway Grants, anticipated the problems that the lack of a serious European asylum policy would create.

zh: 2013年，它们合作成立了一个叫作“立刻团结 ” （ Solidarity Now）的组织，由希腊公民社会精英运营。
en: In 2013, the partnership established an organization, Solidarity Now, run by the cream of Greek civil society.

zh: 立刻团结组织只需要6,200万欧元就可以为明年需要住在希腊的50,000难民中的15,000人提供照顾。
en: Solidarity Now needs just €62 million ($67 million) to care for 15,000 of the 50,000 refugees who need to be housed in Greece next year.

zh: 但是，尽管欧洲承诺拿出5亿欧元帮助希腊管理这场危机，但一些成员国并没有拿出应当的份额。
en: And yet, though the EU has promised to spend €500 million to help Greece manage the crisis, some member states have failed to pay their share.

zh: 除了支持希腊，欧盟还需要一个全面的计划让寻求庇护者以安全有序的方式到来。
en: In addition to supporting Greece, the EU needs a comprehensive plan for managing the arrival of asylum-seekers in a safe, orderly way.

zh: 这意味着在欧洲边界之外展开工作，从出资者的角度看，让寻求庇护者保持在现在所处的位置附近要安全得多，成本也低得多。
en: That means operating beyond Europe’s borders, as, from the donors’ perspective, it is much less disruptive and expensive to maintain asylum-seekers close to their present locations.

zh: 首先，欧盟应该承诺每年至少吸收500,000寻求庇护者，同时努力说服世界其他地区也接收相同数量的难民。
en: For starters, the EU should commit to absorbing at least 500,000 asylum-seekers a year, while working to convince the rest of the world to accept an equal number.

zh: 公开承诺接收那么多难民有助于平息无序蜂拥进入欧洲的状况。
en: A public commitment of this magnitude should help calm the disorderly scramble for Europe.

zh: 获得明确的地位和安全承诺的寻求庇护者可以引导到土耳其和其他前沿国家等待，而不必冒险穿越危险的地中海。
en: Asylum-seekers provided with a clear status and promises of safety could be induced to wait in Turkey and other frontline countries, rather than risk a dangerous Mediterranean crossing.

zh: 其次，应该建立正式的“边关 ” ， 首先是土耳其，然后是黎巴嫩、约旦、突尼斯和摩洛哥。
en: Second, formal gateways should be established, first in Turkey, and then in Lebanon, Jordan, Tunisia, and Morocco.

zh: 边关国家应该与联合国难民署和欧盟紧密合作，成立寻求庇护者注册处理中心并评估他们的庇护申请。
en: Gateway countries would establish, in close cooperation with the United Nations Refugee Agency and the EU, processing centers to register asylum-seekers and assess their applications.

zh: 获得接受的寻求庇护者可以排队在边关国家等候欧盟国家接受他们。
en: Accepted asylum-seekers would then be placed in a queue and required to remain in the gateway country until an EU country accepts them.

zh: 安全成熟的难民检查程序能够平息巴黎恐怖袭击所带来的安全担忧。
en: A safe, deliberate process of vetting refugees would quell security concerns in the aftermath of the Paris attacks.

zh: 边关国家必须改进接待、庇护和融合标准。
en: Gateway countries would have to improve reception, asylum, and integration standards.

zh: 作为交换，这些国家应该获得金融支持和其他激励 — — 如公民更容易进入欧盟。
en: In exchange, these countries should be helped financially and provided with other incentives – for example, easier access to the EU for their citizens.

zh: 事实上，欧盟应该成立或扩大允许非寻求庇护者进入的计划。
en: Indeed, the EU should establish or expand programs that allow entry to non-asylum-seekers.

zh: 第三，必须为前沿国家提供政治、金融和技术支持。
en: Third, political, financial, and technical support must be provided to frontline countries.

zh: 土耳其、黎巴嫩和约旦目前承担着大部分危机负担，接受了四百多万叙利亚难民。
en: Turkey, Lebanon, and Jordan, which have borne most of the burden of the crisis, host more than four million Syrian refugees.

zh: 土耳其说，它已经花费了78亿美元用于照顾两百多万难民；而到目前为止，土耳其只获得了4.15亿美元来自其他国家的资金（尽管欧盟已承诺再支持30亿欧元 ） 。
en: Turkey says it has spent $7.8 billion to care for more than two million refugees; thus far, it has received only $415 million from others (though the EU has promised another €3 billion).

zh: 充分支持前沿国家的难民估计每年至少要花费200亿欧元。
en: Full support for refugees in frontline countries is estimated to cost at least €20 billion per year.

zh: 欧盟至少应该承担其中的一半，其余部分由国际社会承担。
en: The EU should commit at least half of this, with the balance coming from the rest of the international community.

zh: 应该建立获得欧盟和美国最惠贸易待遇的特别经济区，为难民和本地居民形成投资、经济机会和就业岗位。
en: Special economic zones that benefit from preferred trade status with the EU and the United States should be created, in order to generate investment, economic opportunities, and jobs for refugees and locals alike.

zh: 特别经济区应该在前沿国家和过境国家建立。
en: These zones should be established in both frontline and transit countries.

zh: 第四，欧盟需要真正的共同庇护和边防体系。
en: Fourth, the EU needs a truly common asylum and border-guard system.

zh: 目前欧盟存在28套各自为政的庇护体系，可谓事倍功半，在接受新来者、地位确认和融合等方面产生了严重的不平等结果。
en: The patchwork of 28 separate asylum systems is expensive and inefficient, and it produces wildly uneven results in terms of the reception, status determination, and integration of new arrivals.

zh: 欧盟应该建立单一的欧洲边防局（European Border Guard）和单一的庇护和移民署（Asylum and Migration Agency）
en: The EU should establish a single European Border Guard and a single Asylum and Migration Agency.

zh: 第五，必须有联合国协调的全球危机响应方案配合欧盟的计划。
en: Fifth, a global response to the crisis, coordinated by the UN, must accompany the EU’s plan.

zh: 这将把解决难民危机的责任分散给更多国家，同时也有助于建立处理被迫移民挑战的全球标准。
en: This would distribute the responsibility for addressing the refugee crisis over a larger number of states, while helping establish global standards for dealing with the challenge of forced migration.

zh: 最后，为了筹集计划资金，欧盟应该利用其AAA级借贷能力发行长期债券。
en: Finally, to finance the plan, the EU could use its AAA borrowing capacity to issue long-term bonds.

zh: 维持债券的负担应该按与接受寻求庇护者数量的反比关系分配给各成员国。
en: The burden of servicing the bonds would be assigned to member states in inverse proportion to the number of asylum-seekers they accept.

zh: 成功融合难民的国家将获得经济优势；德国经济之所以增长速度显著更快，便是因为它愿意接受叙利亚难民。
en: Those countries that can successfully integrate refugees would reap an economic advantage; already, the German economy is growing significantly faster as a result of its willingness to accept Syrian refugees.

zh: 逃脱叙利亚和其他饱受战争摧残国家的难民潮酝酿时间漫长，很容易预见，也绝对是可以管理的。
en: The ongoing exodus from Syria and other war-torn countries was long in the making, easy to foresee, and eminently manageable.

zh: 炮制恐慌的本土论者利用协作应对方案缺失的机会鼓吹有悖于作为欧盟立盟价值观的愿景。
en: Fear-mongering nativists are taking advantage of the lack of a coordinated response to peddle a vision that runs counter to the values upon which the EU was built.

zh: 它们的愿景如果实现，将违反欧洲法；如今，这一愿景眼看就要令欧盟分裂和毁灭。
en: Their vision, if realized, would violate European law; already, it threatens to divide and destroy the EU.

zh: 因此，欧盟支持全面战略结束恐慌、停止不必要的人道灾难迫在眉睫。
en: For this reason, it is all the more urgent that the EU backs a comprehensive strategy to end the panic and stop the unnecessary human suffering.

zh: 大萧条的支持者
en: Depression’s Advocates

zh: 伯克利—在至今仍未结束的此次经济危机爆发早期，我曾经说过一些话，它们赢得过喝彩，常常招来笑声，并且永远给人们乐观的理由。
en: BERKELEY – Back in the early days of the ongoing economic crisis, I had a line in my talks that sometimes got applause, usually got a laugh, and always gave people a reason for optimism.

zh: 我说，从欧洲和美国在20世纪30年代的经验看，决策者不会重蹈他们的前辈在大萧条期间的覆辙。
en: Given the experience of Europe and the United States in the 1930s, I would say, policymakers would not make the same mistakes as their predecessors did during the Great Depression.

zh: 这一回，他们会犯下新的、不同的、但愿程度更小的错误。
en: This time, we would make new, different, and, one hoped, lesser mistakes.

zh: 不幸的是，这一预言看来是错误的。
en: Unfortunately, that prediction turned out to be wrong.

zh: 欧元区的决策者不但铁心重蹈20世纪30年代覆辙，还要以更残酷、更激烈、规模更大地重蹈覆辙。
en: Not only have policymakers in the eurozone insisted on repeating the blunders of the 1930s; they are poised to repeat them in a more brutal, more exaggerated, and more extended fashion.

zh: 我没有料到会这样。
en: I did not see that coming.

zh: 2010年希腊债务危机爆发时，我认为历史教训是如此显而易见，解决方案应该非常直观。
en: When the Greek debt crisis erupted in 2010, it seemed to me that the lessons of history were so obvious that the path to a resolution would be straightforward.

zh: 逻辑十分清楚。
en: The logic was clear.

zh: 如果希腊不是欧元区成员，其最好的选择将是违约、重组债务和货币贬值。
en: Had Greece not been a member of the eurozone, its best option would have been to default, restructure its debt, and depreciate its currency.

zh: 但是，由于欧盟不希望希腊退出欧元区（这将是作为政治工程的欧盟的一次重大挫折 ） ， 希腊本应该获得足够的援助、支持、债务豁免和偿付协助，以抵消任何它可能从退出货币联盟中获得的好处。
en: But, because the European Union did not want Greece to exit the eurozone (which would have been a major setback for Europe as a political project), Greece would be offered enough aid, support, debt forgiveness, and assistance with payments to offset any advantages it might gain by exiting the monetary union.

zh: 相反，希腊债权人选择收紧束缚。
en: Instead, Greece’s creditors chose to tighten the screws.

zh: 结果，要是它在2010年就放弃欧元，今天的状况或许会好得多。
en: As a result, Greece is likely much worse off today than it would have been had it abandoned the euro in 2010.

zh: 2008年，爱尔兰也受到了金融危机冲击，它提供了一个反例。
en: Iceland, which was hit by a financial crisis in 2008, provides the counterfactual.

zh: 希腊在萧条中泥足深陷，而爱尔兰 — — 它不在欧元区中 — — 已经基本实现复苏。
en: Whereas Greece remains mired in depression, Iceland – which is not in the eurozone – has essentially recovered.

zh: 诚然，正如美国经济学家巴里·艾肯格林（Barry Eichengreen）在2007年所指出的，技术考虑让退出欧元区变得十分艰难、昂贵和危险。
en: To be sure, as the American economist Barry Eichengreen argued in 2007, technical considerations make exiting the eurozone difficult, expensive, and dangerous.

zh: 但这只是硬币的一面。
en: But that is just one side of the ledger.

zh: 如果用爱尔兰作为衡量标杆，那么希腊不退出欧元区的代价是一年GDP的75 % 。
en: Using Iceland as our measuring stick, the cost to Greece of not exiting the eurozone is equivalent to 75% of a year’s GDP – and counting.

zh: 我很难相信，如果希腊在2010年就放弃欧元，经济损失回达到这个数字的四分之一。
en: It is hard for me to believe that if Greece had abandoned the euro in 2010, the economic fallout would have amounted to even a quarter of that.

zh: 此外，考虑到希腊债权人坚持紧缩要求，现在退出欧元区的即时影响也不太可能大过留在欧元区的长期成本。
en: Furthermore, it seems equally improbable that the immediate impact of exiting the eurozone today would be larger than the long-run costs of remaining, given the insistence of Greece’s creditors on austerity.

zh: 债权人的坚持表明，欧元区决策者 — — 特别是德国人 — — 死守着一个概念框架，这个框架导致他们一直低估了情况的严重性、要求采取让情况雪上加霜的政策。
en: That insistence reflects the attachment of policymakers in the EU – especially in Germany – to a conceptual framework that has led them consistently to underestimate the gravity of the situation and recommend policies that make matters worse.

zh: 2010年5月，希腊GDP同比下降4 % 。
en: In May 2010, Greece’s GDP had fallen by 4% year on year.

zh: 欧盟和欧洲央行预测，首个援助计划将让希腊GDP继续下滑2010年水平的3 % ， 然后在2012年开始经济复苏。
en: The EU and the European Central Bank predicted that the first bailout program would drive Greek GDP down by another 3% below 2010 levels, before the economy began to recover in 2012.

zh: 但是，到2012年3月，现实是残酷的。
en: By March 2012, however, reality had set in.

zh: GDP比2010年水平低了12 % ， 第二个援助计划开始实施。
en: With GDP headed to 12% below 2010 levels, a second program was put in place.

zh: 到当年年底，GDP比2010年水平下降17 % 。
en: By the end of the year, GDP had fallen to 17% below 2010 levels.

zh: 如今，希腊GDP比2009年水平低25 % 。
en: Greece’s GDP is now 25% below its 2009 level.

zh: 尽管有人预测2016年会开始复苏，但我无法看到任何需求流分析能够证实这一预测。
en: And while some predict a recovery in 2016, I fail to see how any analysis of demand flows can justify that forecast.

zh: 预测错得如此离谱，主要原因是一直在做预测的人低估了政府支出对经济的影响 — — 特别是在利率接近于零的时候。
en: The main reason the forecasts were so wrong is that those making them chronically underestimated the impact of government spending on the economy – especially when interest rates are near zero.

zh: 而紧缩政策显然无法重新启动希腊和欧元区其他国家的经济，但这并没有促使决策者反思他们的方针。
en: And yet the clear failure of austerity to restart the economy in Greece or the rest of the eurozone has not caused policymakers to rethink their approach.

zh: 相反，他们似乎准备加码原有政策，他们的理论是，危机越是深入，结构改革措施就会越成功。
en: Instead, they seem to be doubling down, on the theory that the deeper the crisis, the more successful the push for structural reforms will be.

zh: 这一思维认为，这些改革是提振长期增长的必要条件，而如果增长没有马上出现，那是因为对这些改革的需要比一开始预想的还要大。
en: Such reforms are needed to boost long-term growth, the thinking goes, and if that growth does not rapidly emerge, it is because the need for them was even greater than originally thought.

zh: 悲哀的是，这正是20世纪30年代发生过的事。
en: This, sadly, is the story of the 1930s as well.

zh: 美国评论家马修·伊���莱西亚斯（Matthew Yglesias）指出，当时欧洲主要中左翼政党意识到采取的政策根本无效，但也没有拿出替代方案。
en: As the American commentator Matthew Yglesias points out, Europe's major center-left parties at that time recognized that what was being done was not working, but nonetheless failed to offer an alternative.

zh: “这让拿下总体日程价值更低的政党 — — 比如希特勒 — — 站出来说，既然游戏规则导致长期大面积失业，那么就应该改变游戏规则。 ”
en: “It was left to other parties with less worthy overall agendas – Hitler, for example – to step in and say that if the rules of the game led to prolonged spells of mass unemployment, then the rules of the game had to be changed.”

zh: 如今，伊格莱西亚斯又说，欧洲中左翼政党同样“没有改变规则的战略，也没有勇气抛弃规则。
en: Today, Yglesias adds, Europe’s center-left politicians similarly “don’t have a strategy for changing the rules, and they don’t have the guts to tear up the rulebook.”

zh: ”结果，紧缩横行，只有法国的马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）和意大利的毕普·格里洛（Beppe Grillo）等民粹主义者提出异议，而他们的经济方案更加不可能见效。
en: As a result, austerity reigns, and dissent is left to populists like France’s Marine Le Pen or Italy’s Beppe Grillo – whose economic proposals seem even less likely to be effective.

zh: 你也许认为，我们有能力从历史中汲取教训，并且大萧条对于欧洲历史足够重要，欧洲决策者绝不会重蹈覆辙。
en: One would have thought we were capable of learning from the past, and that the Great Depression was important enough in European history that policymakers there would not be repeating its mistakes.

zh: 但是，眼下，正在发生的恰恰是重蹈覆辙。
en: And yet, at the moment, that is precisely what seems to be happening.

zh: 欧洲必须直面美国的域外制裁
en: Europe Must Confront America’s Extraterritorial Sanctions

zh: 纽约 — — 唐纳德·特朗普拒绝承认与伊朗签署的联合全面行动计划并重新启动美国对伊制裁是对全球和平的威胁。
en: NEW YORK – Donald Trump’s renunciation of the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA) with Iran and the reimposition of US sanctions on that country threaten global peace.

zh: 欧洲安全有赖于在美国退出协议的情况下捍卫联合全面行动计划（JCPOA ） 。
en: Europe’s security depends on defending the agreement with Iran despite the US withdrawal.

zh: 而这反过来又要求欧洲与俄罗斯、中国和其他联合国成员国一道确保与伊朗的经济关系可以得到发展。
en: That, in turn, requires Europe, along with Russia, China, and other United Nations member states, to ensure that economic relations with Iran can develop.

zh: 实现这样的目标仅有一种可能性，那就是欧洲能够直面、并最终颠覆美国的域外制裁，而上述制裁的目的就是阻止非美主体与伊朗展开贸易和金融活动。
en: And that can happen only if Europe confronts, and ultimately overturns, America’s extraterritorial sanctions, which aim to deter trade and financial activities with Iran by non-US actors.

zh: 特朗普此举的目的明显并且毫不含糊：那就是推翻伊朗政府。
en: The purpose of Trump’s move is clear and indeed explicit: to topple the Iranian regime.

zh: 因为这种愚蠢的做法，欧洲民众明确感觉到欧洲的安全利益已经不再与美国的安全利益密切挂钩。
en: Given this folly, European citizens accurately sense that Europe’s security interests are no longer closely aligned with those of the United States.

zh: 美国针对伊朗这种恃强凌弱的做法受到了美国两个中东地区盟友以色列和沙特阿拉伯的支持和拥护。
en: America’s bullying approach to Iran has been seconded – indeed championed – by two Middle Eastern allies of the United States, Israel and Saudi Arabia.

zh: 以色列借助美国的力量来避免与巴勒斯坦民众达成任何妥协。
en: Israel invokes US power to avoid having to make any compromises with the Palestinians.

zh: 而沙特阿拉伯则利用美国的军事力量遏制伊朗这一地区竞争对手。
en: Saudi Arabia invokes US military power to contain its regional rival, Iran.

zh: 两国都希望美国与伊朗之间爆发直接战争。
en: Both are hoping for a direct US war with Iran.

zh: 美国以往在中东政权更迭方面的努力在美国和欧洲都产生了可怕的后果（在美国挑起的大动荡中陷入灾难的那些国家还并不包括 ） 。
en: America’s previous efforts at regime change in the Middle East yielded horrendous results for the US and Europe (to say nothing of the disasters that befell the countries caught up in the US-provoked mayhem).

zh: 这样的“选择性战争”一直是造成中东和北非移民欧洲人数激增的主要因素。
en: Such “wars of choice” have been the major factor in the surge of migration to Europe from the Middle East and North Africa.

zh: 即使像阿富汗、伊拉克和利比亚那样的政权更迭最终取得成功，暴力和持续动荡也是不可避免的后果。
en: Even when regime change has “succeeded,” as in Afghanistan, Iraq, and Libya, the aftermath has been violence and instability.

zh: 而一旦像叙利亚那样政权更迭失败，其后果就是持续不断的战争。
en: And when regime change has failed, as in Syria, the result has been ongoing war.

zh: 法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙、英国首相特雷莎·梅和德国总理安格拉·默克尔在说服特朗普承认联合全面行动计划方面的可耻失败是可以预见的。
en: The humiliating failure of French President Emmanuel Macron, UK Prime Minister Theresa May, and German Chancellor Angela Merkel to convince Trump to remain in the JCPOA was predictable.

zh: 美国这一决定反映了两股趋同的力量：一是近期所有美国政府全部表现出在中东寻求霸权的深层次外交政策取向，二是特朗普所特有的心理变态。
en: The US decision reflects two converging forces: a deep-seated foreign-policy tendency – manifested by all recent US administrations – to seek hegemony in the Middle East, and Trump’s peculiar brand of psychopathy.

zh: 特朗普喜欢让欧洲领导人难堪，他们的局促不安让他大喜过望。
en: Trump delights in embarrassing European leaders; their squirming is his triumph.

zh: 但欧洲领导人绝不是任人宰割的弱者。
en: Yet they are not powerless.

zh: 恰恰因为伊核协议是一份经联合国安理会批准的多边协议（联合国第2231号决议 ） ， 而并非仅仅是美国和伊朗之间的协议，因此伊核协议仍然可以得到挽救。
en: The agreement with Iran can still be salvaged, precisely because it is a multilateral agreement, endorsed by the UN Security Council (Resolution 2231), not an agreement solely between the US and Iran.

zh: 事实上按照联合国宪章第25条的规定，所有联合国成员国，包括美国在内，都有义务履行联合全面行动计划。
en: Indeed, under Article 25 of the UN Charter, all UN member states, including the US, are obligated to fulfill the JCPOA.

zh: 特朗普要求美国退出联合全面行动计划的行为本身就违反国际法。
en: Trump’s withdrawal of the US from the JCPOA is itself a violation of international law.

zh: 联合全面行动计划和第2231号决议的核心内容是伊朗停止可能导致核武器研发的相关活动。
en: The essence of the JCPOA and Resolution 2231 is Iran’s cessation of activities that could lead to the development of nuclear weapons.

zh: 伊朗严格遵守伊核协议可以带来国际经济关系正常化，其中包括解除联合国已经达成一致的制裁举措。
en: Strict compliance by Iran is linked to the normalization of international economic relations, including the lifting of UN-agreed sanctions.

zh: 即使美国现在缺席联合全面行动计划，要想阻止协议在伊朗和世界其他国家之间的执行它也只有两种方法。
en: Even if the US now absents itself from the JCPOA, it has only two means to block the implementation of the agreement between Iran and the rest of the world.

zh: 其一是挑起战争。
en: The first would be to foment war.

zh: 这显然已经在美国的议程上，尤其现在老牌新保守主义分子约翰·博尔顿重返白宫担任国家安全顾问。
en: This clearly is on the US agenda, especially with the neoconservative doyen John Bolton back in the White House as National Security Adviser.

zh: 世界各国必须坚定地抵制另一场毁灭性的美国军事冒险活动。
en: The world must steadfastly resist another ruinous US military adventure.

zh: 域外制裁是美国可以扼杀联合全面行动计划的第二种方法。
en: Extraterritorial sanctions are the second way the US could kill the JCPOA.

zh: 美国决定不与伊朗进行贸易是一回事。
en: It is one thing for the US to decide that it will not trade with Iran.

zh: 而美国政府试图阻止伊朗与非美国家之间的贸易则完全是另外一回事了。
en: It is quite another for the US government to attempt to block trade with Iran by non-US parties.

zh: 美国打算这么做；为了维护全球和平，也为了捍卫其自身的直接经济利益，欧洲和中国必须挫败美国的企图。
en: This is America’s intention; it is up to Europe and China to defeat it, in the interest of global peace, as well as in their own direct economic interest.

zh: 从实际层面看，美国将会对在其国内市场运营的企业实行反伊制裁，而其中很可能也包括美国企业在国外运营的分支机构。
en: In practical terms, the US will be able to enforce anti-Iran sanctions on companies operating in its domestic market, and most likely on subsidiaries of US firms operating abroad.

zh: 但美国肯定试图走得更远，具体的方法是通过阻止非美企业与伊朗打交道。
en: Yet the US will try to go much further, by trying to block non-US companies from dealing with Iran.

zh: 美国很有可能成功抑制以美元为基础的交易，因为这些交易的结算一般需要通过美国银行系统。
en: The US will probably succeed in clamping down on dollar-based transactions, as these are generally cleared through the US banking system.

zh: 真正的问题在于在美国域外经营的非美企业，他们通过欧元和人民币等非美货币与伊朗展开经济互动。
en: The real issue will come with non-US companies operating outside of the US and interacting with Iran via non-dollar currencies such as the euro and renminbi.

zh: 美国肯定会试图制裁上述企业，通过针对他们在当地的分支机构，或者将他们拖入美国法院，再或者禁止他们进入美国市场。
en: The US will certainly try to punish such companies, whether by targeting their local subsidiaries, by trying to haul them into US courts, or by denying them access to the US market.

zh: 欧盟在这方面的立场必须坚定，不要再次乞求特朗普对某些欧洲商业交易给予“豁免 ” ， 因为这一进程只会导致欧洲国家更屈从于特朗普的突发奇想。
en: Here is where the European Union must take a strong stand and move beyond begging Trump for “waivers” for specific European business deals, a process that would make European countries even more subservient to Trump’s whims.

zh: 欧洲应当坚持对美国域外制裁坚定而明确的说“不 ” ， 尤其是那些以非美货币经营的企业就更是这样。
en: Europe should defend a firm and unequivocal “No” to US extraterritorial sanctions, notably on companies operating in non-dollar currencies.

zh: 欧盟应当坚持域外制裁违反国际法（包括联合国第2231号决议和联合国宪章）和世贸组织规则。
en: The EU should insist that extraterritorial sanctions violate international law (including the Resolution 2231 and therefore the UN Charter) and the rules of the World Trade Organization.

zh: 他们必须认识到默许相当于交给美国一张在联合国安理会决议以外制定战争与和平规则并在世贸组织以外制定全球贸易规则的空白支票。
en: They should recognize that acquiescence would be tantamount to handing the US a blank check to set the rules of war and peace beyond the UN Security Council, and the rules of global trade beyond the World Trade Organization.

zh: 欧盟应当做好准备针对美国启动世贸组织争端解决程序，并在联合国安理会和联大陈述自己的理由。
en: The EU should be prepared to use the WTO dispute resolution process against the US, and to bring its case to the UN Security Council and General Assembly.

zh: 如果欧洲不敢走这一步，那么伊朗国内的商机肯定会趁势被中国利用。
en: Where Europe is afraid to tread, China will surely swoop in to capitalize on business opportunities in Iran.

zh: 而中国这么做完全有理由。
en: And China would be right to do so.

zh: 法律甚至是地缘政治都不是欧洲最大的难题，欧洲最大的障碍在心理上。
en: Europe’s biggest challenge is not legal or even geopolitical. It is psychological.

zh: 欧洲领导人的所作所为就好像美国仍然关注跨大西洋联盟的共同利益、价值观和处事方法。
en: European leaders act as if the US still cares about a trans-Atlantic alliance of shared interests, values, and approaches.

zh: 但可悲的是，实际情况早已不再是这样。
en: Sadly, this is no longer the case.

zh: 美国和欧洲的确仍然有许多共同利益，但尤其如果美国违反国际法，他们的利益也存在很多不同。
en: The US and Europe do still have many shared interests; but they have many divergent ones as well, especially when the US violates international law.

zh: 欧洲需要根据其自身状况制定安全政策，就像它需要根据其自身状况制定贸易和环境政策一样。
en: Europe needs its own security policy, just as it needs its own trade and environmental policies.

zh: 因此，围绕联合全面行动计划的摊牌其实是在揭示真相。
en: The showdown over the JCPOA is therefore a moment of truth.

zh: 世界和平取决于欧洲捍卫联合国宪章和国际贸易规则。
en: World peace depends on Europe’s defense of the UN Charter and the rules of international trade.

zh: 欧洲的4%方案
en: Europe’s 4% Solution

zh: 华盛顿—对欧洲来说，这是一个重要的夏天，因为尽管6月的欧元区领导人会议朝着银行联盟和对西班牙银行直接进行资本重组迈出了重要的步骤，欧元区和欧盟仍面临着分崩离析的危险。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – This is a momentous summer for Europe, because both the eurozone and the European Union could be in danger of unraveling, despite the important steps toward a banking union and direct recapitalization of Spanish banks taken at the June meeting of eurozone leaders.

zh: 改革计划实施缓慢；欧洲稳定性机制（ESM）在德国可能遇到法律挑战；荷兰和芬兰似乎在协定的某些方面打起了退堂鼓。
en: Implementation of the proposed reforms is lagging; there may be legal challenges to the European Stability Mechanism in Germany; and the Netherlands and Finland seem to be backtracking on some parts of the agreement.

zh: 即使在最坏情形中，一定程度的欧洲内部合作也必定可以存活。
en: Even in a worst-case scenario, some degree of intra-European cooperation will surely survive.

zh: 但很难说我们所知道的欧洲能够���免于哪怕是欧元区的部分解体。
en: But it is hard to see how the EU as we know it could survive even a partial disintegration of the eurozone.

zh: 如果你认为一个和数个欧元区外围国家应该脱离欧元“休个假 ” ， 那你必定低估了这一事件的经济和政治后果。
en: Those who argue that one or more countries on the eurozone’s periphery should take a “holiday” from the euro underestimate both the economic and political repercussions of such a move.

zh: 如果两个或三个国家不得不离开，那么许多国家都会感到挫败感、信任的缺失以及深深的伤害，这将振动整个欧盟。
en: The sense of failure, loss of trust, and the damage inflicted on so many if two or three countries had to leave would shake the entire Union.

zh: 一个关键挑战是大量银行的疲软以及外围国主权债务疑云之间的负反馈环。
en: One of the key challenges is the negative feedback loop between the weaknesses of many banks and the doubts about the peripheral countries’ sovereign debt.

zh: 由于银行买入了大量的母国主权债务，主权债务和银行危机之间的关系越来越紧密而错综复杂。
en: The sovereign-debt and banking crises have become even more closely interlinked as banks bought greater amounts of their home countries’ sovereign debt.

zh: 因此 ， “ 问题”国家巨量经常项目赤字中所反映的欧洲生产成本和竞争力的两极分化可能将成为更难解决的问题。
en: That said, Europe’s disparities in production costs and competitiveness, reflected in the “problem” countries’ substantial current-account deficits, may prove to be an even more difficult problem to resolve.

zh: 在欧元历史的第一个十年中，希腊、葡萄牙、西班牙和意大利的单位劳动成本上涨速度比德国快20—30 % ， 比北欧整体单位劳动成本上升速度也要快。
en: Unit labor costs in Greece, Portugal, Spain, and Italy grew 20-30% faster than in Germany in the euro’s first decade, and somewhat faster than unit labor costs in northern Europe as a whole.

zh: 这一分化一定程度上体现了生产率增长差异，但更多体现的是工资增长差异。
en: This disparity reflected some differences in productivity growth but even more so differences in wage growth.

zh: 总整体上说，资本流入导致了南欧国家真实升值和更低的储蓄/投资比率，从而引发了结构性经常项目赤字。
en: Broadly speaking, capital inflows led to real revaluation and a lower domestic savings rate relative to investment in the southern countries, resulting in structural current-account deficits.

zh: 在希腊，大规模财政赤字伴随并恶化了这一趋势。
en: In Greece, large fiscal deficits accompanied and exacerbated this trend.

zh: 在西班牙，与经常项目赤字相伴而生的是私人部门借贷。
en: In Spain, the counterpart to the current-account deficit was private-sector borrowing.

zh: 只要这一内部失衡不降低至可持续水平，欧元区危机就不可能解决，而要实现前者，不仅要求受困外围国实行财政调整，亚要求整个欧元区实现收支平衡调整。
en: The eurozone crisis will not be resolved until this internal imbalance is reduced to a sustainable level, which requires not only fiscal adjustment in the troubled peripheral economies, but also balance-of-payments adjustments across the eurozone as a whole.

zh: 而这反过来又意味着需要出现欧元区内部的真实汇率调整，让外围国生产成本相对核心国有所下降。
en: That, in turn, implies the need for a real exchange-rate adjustment inside the eurozone, with peripheral countries’ production costs falling relative to those in the core.

zh: 货币联盟内部或固定汇率国家间的真实汇率调整可以通过通胀水平差异发生。
en: Real exchange-rate adjustments inside a monetary union, or among countries with fixed exchange rates, can take place through inflation differentials.

zh: 比如，人民币真实价值较美元有了明显的升值，尽管名义上汇率变化十分有限。 这是因为中国国内价格上涨快于美国。
en: The real value of the Chinese renminbi, for example, has appreciated considerably relative to the US dollar, despite limited nominal exchange-rate changes, because China’s domestic prices have risen faster than have prices in the United States.

zh: 假定欧元生产率表现类似，则类似的欧元区内部调整要求受困外围国工资增长慢于德国，且这一情形需维持多年，从而重塑外围国的竞争力。
en: A similar adjustment within the eurozone, assuming similar productivity performance, would require wages in the troubled peripheral countries to rise more slowly than in Germany for a number of years, thus restoring their competitiveness.

zh: 但是，因为德国和其他北欧盈余国对物价稳定采取强硬态度，因此欧元区内部的真实汇率调整要求受困南欧国家发生真实工资和物价通货紧缩。
en: But, because Germany and the other northern surplus countries remain hawkish on price stability, real exchange-rate adjustment within the eurozone requires actual wage and price deflation in the distressed southern economies.

zh: 外围国的这一压力 — — 在经济已然停滞时实行通货紧缩 — — 正在成为欧元区最严峻的挑战。
en: This pressure on the peripheral countries to deflate their already stagnant economies is turning into the eurozone’s greatest challenge.

zh: 欧洲央行提供流动性的举措可以赢得时间，但真实调整才能解决基本问题。
en: The ECB’s provision of liquidity can buy time, but only real adjustment can cure the underlying problem.

zh: 如果外围国生产率能以比核心国快得多的速度提高，从而让价格在工资不必下降的情况下就能有所降低，那么工资削减和真实收入损失就不必那么严重。
en: That could be achieved with less wage contraction and loss of real income if productivity in the peripheral economies were to start growing significantly faster than in the core, thereby allowing prices to fall without the need for lower wages.

zh: 但是，尽管结构性改革毫无疑问能随着时间的推移提高生产率增速，却不可能在信贷严重受限、投资大幅下滑、大量高技能年轻人移居国外的环境下发生。
en: But, while structural reforms could undoubtedly lead over time to faster productivity growth, this is unlikely to happen in an environment in which credit is severely constrained, investment is plummeting, and many skilled young people emigrate.

zh: 价格通缩不利于形成能够加速受压国资源再配置、提高整体生产率的相对价格变化。
en: Price deflation is not conducive to bringing about the sort of relative price changes that could accelerate reallocation of resources within the countries under stress and increase overall productivity.

zh: 相对价格在通胀温和时更容易变化，而不是在名义价格被迫减低的时候。
en: Relative prices are much easier to change when there is modest inflation than when nominal price reductions are required.

zh: 受困国需要提高生产率，这一点是毫无疑问的，但在当前极端的紧缩和通缩气候下，要达到这一目标是不可能的任务，因为潜在或公开社会冲突相当激烈。
en: The need for higher productivity in the troubled countries is undeniable; but achieving it in the current climate of extreme austerity and deflation is unlikely, given an atmosphere of latent, or open, social conflict.

zh: 这些经济调整可以以平稳得多的方式发生，如果欧元区整体追求更加扩张性的政策的话。
en: These economic adjustments could occur much more smoothly if the eurozone as a whole were to pursue a more expansionary policy.

zh: 如果欧元区目标通胀率被临时定在（比如）3.5 % ， 且经常项目盈余国鼓励国内通胀高于欧元区目标一定程度，那么欧元区内部就可以在受困国不发生价格通缩的情况下实现真实价格调整。
en: If the target inflation rate for the eurozone were to be set temporarily at, say 3.5%, and if the countries with current-account surpluses encouraged domestic inflation rates somewhat above the eurozone’s target, there could be real price adjustment within the eurozone without price deflation in the troubled countries.

zh: 如今终于有了些许信号，表明德国将会欢迎较快的国内工资增长和一定程度的高通胀。
en: There are finally some signs that Germany will welcome more rapid domestic wage growth and somewhat higher inflation.

zh: 这可以，也应该辅之以欧元贬值，尽管这并非万灵丹。
en: This could and should be accompanied by an overall depreciation of the euro, though that would be no panacea.

zh: 高公债水平仍必须有所削减，以创造财政空间并保持利率水平足够低从而重塑长期信心。
en: High public-debt levels would still have to be reduced to create fiscal space and keep interest rates low enough to restore long-term confidence.

zh: 这意味着外围国（事实上，是整个欧洲）仍必须实行大胆的结构性改革。
en: That means that courageous structural reforms must still be pursued in the peripheral countries – indeed, throughout Europe.

zh: 类似地，欧元区仍然需要强化其防火墙和合作机制。
en: Similarly, the eurozone would still need to strengthen its firewalls, as well as its mechanisms for cooperation.

zh: 但暂时而温和的较高通胀率有助于调整过程和为改革提供起效的机会。
en: But a temporary and modestly higher inflation rate would facilitate the adjustment process and give reforms a chance to work.

zh: 通缩会抑制未来的乐观。
en: Deflation discourages optimism about the future.

zh: 把整个调整负担推给存在经常项目赤字的外围国，而核心国继续保持盈余会对调整形成阻碍。
en: Shifting the entire adjustment burden onto peripheral countries with current-account deficits, while core countries continue to run surpluses, obstructs adjustment.

zh: 欧元区通胀目标并不是神奇数字，用它来决定整体宏观经济框架也是不理性的。
en: The eurozone’s inflation target is not a magic number, and it is irrational to let it determine the overall macroeconomic framework.

zh: 如果越低总是越好的话，那为什么不把目标定在1%甚至零呢？
en: If lower is always better, why not set the target at 1%, or even zero?

zh: 事实上，在不少时期，通胀目标为3—4%要好于2 % 。
en: In fact, there are times when 3-4% is better than 2%.

zh: 欧洲就处于这样一种时期中。
en: Europe is at such a moment.

zh: 欧洲稳定的定针
en: Europe's Anchor of Stability

zh: 法兰克福 – 对于诞生不到十年的欧元来说，无论从何种角度来看，它都是一个年轻的币种。
en: FRANKFURT – At less than ten years old, the euro is by all measures a young currency.

zh: 但是，它已经成了15个欧洲国家的近三亿二千万人们日常生活中实实在在的一部分。
en: Yet it has become a reality of daily life for almost 320 million people in 15 European countries.

zh: 对于欧元在今年全球金融危机中的表现，即使是其最强烈的批评者也不能否认欧元获得了令人吃惊的成功。
en: In the wake of the euro’s performance during this year’s global financial crisis, even its strongest critics cannot deny that the euro is an astounding success.

zh: 刚刚过去的这个夏天，数以百万计的旅行者避免了的兑换本国货币的高昂的收费。
en: This past summer, millions of travelers avoided paying cumbersome and expensive charges to change their currency.

zh: 但是，由于少了外汇兑换的风险而给贸易和投资带来的好处，在经济上的意义远比这更为重要。
en: But the advantage for trade and investment implied by the absence of foreign-exchange risks within the euro area is of greater economic importance.

zh: 统一的货币促成了欧元成员国的单一市场。
en: The common currency completes the single market for the euro area’s member states.

zh: 自从1999年以来，欧洲货币联盟（EMU）的成员国经历了一系列的外部打击：油价从每桶10美元左右上升到150美元；互联网泡沫破裂后股票市场的崩盘；2001年911事件后不断扩大的恐怖主义威胁以及两场战争。
en: Since 1999, members of the European Monetary Union (EMU) have experienced a number of severe exogenous shocks: the rise in the price of a barrel of oil from around $10 to $150; the collapse of equity markets after the dot-com bubble imploded; the spreading risk of terrorism after the September 11, 2001, and two wars.

zh: 从去年夏天以来，美国次贷危机的市场的问题引起了金融市场的震荡，至今仍不见底部。
en: Starting last summer, the breakdown of the market for US sub-prime mortgages triggered turbulence in financial markets, with no end in sight.

zh: 以过去各国本币的经验，上述任何一项冲击都会让欧洲人预期外汇市场将引发严重的危机。
en: From past experience with national currencies, Europeans could have expected that any of these shocks would trigger a severe crisis in foreign-exchange markets.

zh: 如果欧元区的国家仍然各自使用本国货币的话，是不难想象在近来的金融市场危机中会发生什么样的情况的：对一些币种的巨大的投机，央行重大的干预，以及平衡机制最后垮台。
en: It is not difficult to imagine what would have happened during the recent financial-market crisis if the euro-area countries still had all their national currencies: immense speculation against some currencies, heavy interventions by central banks, and finally a collapse of the parity system.

zh: 1992和1993年见证了欧洲汇率机制的巨大危机。
en: The years 1992-1993 witnessed a dramatic crisis in the European Exchange Rate System.

zh: 自从那个时期以来，虎视眈眈准备利用外汇市场机会的资本量成倍地增加，如果今天出现当时类似的危机，这些资金会让情况更加危急。
en: Since that period the amount of capital ready to exploit any opportunity in foreign exchange markets has multiplied, which would make any comparable situation today much more dangerous.

zh: 1990年代初的危机确实把欧盟共同市场的现状推到了危险的境地。
en: Indeed, the crisis of the early 1990’s put the status quo within the EU common market at risk.

zh: 很难相信，以目前的巨大的流动资本量，这一单边市场还能度过一系列的巨大并突发的汇率变化。
en: It is hard to believe that, with today’s vast capital flows, the single market would have survived a series of sharp and abrupt exchange-rate changes.

zh: 1991-1992年出现的那样的汇率变化，对在不同国家间进行贸易的货物的相对价格，产生了重要影响。
en: Changes in exchange rates of the type seen in 1991-1992 have a strong impact on relative prices for goods traded between different countries.

zh: 在那些货币升值强劲的国家中，公司（也包括工会，也为了同样的原因）遭遇了突现的严重的竞争力的丧失。
en: In countries that experienced strong currency appreciation, companies (and unions, for that matter) are exposed to a sudden and severe loss in competitiveness.

zh: 这样的公司当然要开始叫嚷针要针对所谓的“不公平”环境采取保护措施。
en: Such firms undoubtedly start to clamor for protection against supposedly “unfair” conditions.

zh: 诚然，欧元没有避免欧洲金融机构作出高风险的投资决定，或避免这些决定给金融市场带来的后果。
en: True, the euro did not prevent risky investment decisions by European financial institutions or the consequences for financial markets of these decisions.

zh: 但是，欧元本来就没有想要那么做。
en: But it was never intended to do that.

zh: 相反，欧元取得了它原先想要取得的成果：危机被抑制了，因为欧元不能在欧元区内对外汇汇率造成破坏。
en: Instead, the euro achieved what it was meant to achieve: the crisis was contained, because it could not inflict damage on foreign-exchange markets within the euro area.

zh: 在去年金融市场的动荡开始后，欧洲中央银行立刻提供了充裕的资金来平息事态，至今仍在这样做。
en: After the outbreak of turbulence in financial markets last year, the European Central Bank immediately provided ample liquidity to calm the situation, and has continued to do so ever since.

zh: 同时，欧洲中央银行从未忘记其主要的目标 – 维持物价稳定。
en: At the same time, the ECB never lost sight of its main goal – maintaining price stability.

zh: 事实上，欧洲中央银行已经从一开始就按照其对物价稳定的定义水准，成功地稳定了对通货膨胀的预期。
en: Indeed, the ECB has successfully anchored inflation expectations right from the start at a level consistent with its definition of price stability.

zh: 这个成就与所有的曾经批评过欧洲货币联盟的声音，形成了鲜明的对照。 这种声音曾警告欧洲货币联盟所做的实验，甚至预期其早期就夭折。
en: This achievement contrasts starkly with all the critical voices that warned against the experiment of European Monetary Union and even predicted its early failure.

zh: 在1998年6月欧洲央行成立的最初几周内，我收到了诺贝尔奖获得者Milton Friedman的信，他祝贺我被任命为行政理事会成员，这一他称之为“不可能完成的工作 ” 。
en: It was in the first weeks after the establishment of the ECB in June 1998 that I received a letter by the late Nobel Prize laureate Milton Friedman, who congratulated me on my appointment as member of the Executive Board – which he called “an impossible job.”

zh: 他坚信欧洲的货币联盟注定要失败。
en: He was convinced that monetary union in Europe was doomed to fail.

zh: 可是今天，很难再找到不承认欧元是个巨大成功的人。 欧洲央行一直走得很稳，以至于人们认为它的成功理所当然地来之毫不费力。
en: Today, however, it is hard to find anybody who does not consider the euro a great success, and the ECB has been so sure-footed that people now take that success for granted.

zh: 但这确实并非运气所致。
en: But this was not a matter of good luck.

zh: 欧元的成功的基石是辛勤的努力和对共同货币独特历史使命的孜孜以求，而且，很重要的一点，是选择了恰当的货币政策策略。
en: The fundamentals of the euro’s success are hard work, dedicated commitment to the common currency’s unique historical mission, and, not least, a well chosen monetary policy strategy.

zh: 但是这个成功不能成为我们自满的理由。
en: But this success is no reason for complacency.

zh: 巨大的挑战还在前头。
en: Major challenges lie ahead.

zh: 在愈加疲弱的经济增长的大背景下，稳定和发展协议将面临新的严峻考验。
en: In the context of weakening growth, the Stability and Growth Pact will face a severe new test.

zh: 同样重要的是，旨在保证更大的市场弹性的改革仍然滞后于对于充分利用单一货币政策的优势的需求。
en: And, just as important, reforms aimed at ensuring greater flexibility of markets still lag behind what is needed to exploit fully the advantages of the single monetary policy.

zh: 欧洲的反意识形态大选
en: Europe’s Anti-Ideological Election

zh: 发自巴黎-刚刚落下帷幕的欧洲议会竞选活动在欧盟的27个成员国当中都有着相似的氛围，那就是选民、候选人和媒体都把主要焦点放在了各国的国内议题之上。
en: PARIS – In each of the 27 states of the European Union, the campaign for the just concluded elections for the European Parliament occurred in an atmosphere of indifference, with voters, candidates, and the media focusing mostly on domestic issues.

zh: 而或许恰恰因为这样，本次选举的弃权率平均高达57 % ， 创下了自1979年首次选举以来的新高，与此同时，整个议会被右派阵营把持的现状，也没多大变化。
en: Perhaps for precisely this reason, the abstention rate (an average of  57%), was the highest since the first vote in 1979, while the composition of the Parliament, with its right-wing majority, underwent no significant changes.

zh: 在2004年的选举中，重新整合了诸多右派和中右派小党的欧洲人民党团（EPP）拿下了全部785个议员席位中的288个。
en: Following the 2004 elections, the European People’s Party (EPP), which regroups right and center right parties, held 288 MPs of the Parliament’s 785 seats.

zh: 虽然今年英国保守党和捷克右翼党派相约脱离EPP另组右翼色彩更浓厚的新党团参选，令EPP会员数目有所减少，不过它仍然是最强大的力量，把736个席位中的267个收入囊中，而这也为何塞·曼努埃尔·巴罗佐再次当选欧盟委员会主席铺平了道路。
en: In 2009, it is still the first force in the new parliament, with 267 deputies out of a total of 736: the decrease in its membership is also due to the stated commitment of the British Conservatives and the Czech right party to defect from the EPP to create their own party, with a stronger right-wing line. That opens the way to the possible return for a second term of José Manuel Barroso as president of the Commission.

zh: 这个选举结果显得相当荒谬，因为欧洲正经历着有史以来其中一次最严峻的经济危机，就业岗位流失、生活水平下降，人们对未来生活的担忧也不断增加。
en: This situation is paradoxical, as Europe is experiencing one of the worst economic crises in its history, with falling employment and living standards and rising worries about the future.

zh: 照理说这种情况下选民们应该用选票去惩罚在本国执政的右翼党派，然而这种威胁非但未能实现，反而在法国、意大利、波兰、丹麦以及在2004年选举中由基督教民主联盟赢得大多数议会席位的德国都显示了相反的结果。
en: One should have expected the right-wing to be punished in countries where they govern. But that threat did not materialize.  The latest returns, indeed, show quite the opposite – in France, Italy, Poland, Denmark, and even Germany, where the CDU had won a large number of representatives in the 2004 elections.

zh: 甚至在西班牙和葡萄牙这些右翼党派沦为在野党的国家，右翼的地位也有所提升。
en: Where the right is in opposition, such as in Spain and Portugal, it has improved its position.

zh: 另一方面，左翼的社会党几乎在任何一个国家，尤其是在其执政的西班牙、葡萄牙、匈牙利和荷兰都丧失了支持，以致曾在上届议会中拥有215席的欧洲社会党团（ESP）在本次选举中也只保住了160个席位。
en: On the other hand, the Socialist Party lost support almost everywhere, especially in countries – Spain, Portugal, Hungary, and the Netherlands – where it is in power.

zh: 而在社会党只是在野党的法国和丹麦这些国家，情况也未好转，只有希腊是个例外。
en: The European socialist party (ESP), which held 215 deputies in the old parliament, secured only 160 seats.  In France and Denmark, where the Socialist Party is in opposition, it did no better.

zh: 在法国，社会党的得票率甚至几乎被由魅力超凡的丹尼尔·科恩-本迪特所领导的绿党联盟 — — 欧洲生态党 — — 所赶超。
en: The only exception is Greece. In France, the Socialist Party is almost outnumbered by Europe Ecologie, a green coalition gathered by the charismatic Daniel Cohn-Bendit.

zh: 此外，先前拥有100个席位，现有大约80席的自由民主党仍是欧洲议会排名第三的势力。
en: The liberals remain the third force of the European parliament, with around 80 deputies, less than its previous 100 members.

zh: 而比上届多获得10个席位，目前占据55席的绿党似乎成为本次选举的主要受益者，并升级为第四股势力。
en: The Greens appear to be the main beneficiaries of the elections and become the forth force: they will get around 55 seats, a gain of more than 10 seats.

zh: 而与此同时，极端党派以及一些“欧洲怀疑派”党团也在本次选举中出尽了风头。
en: Extreme parties also benefited from the elections, as well as some “eurosceptic” parties.

zh: 虽然让-马里·勒庞的极右翼政党在法国选战中被极度削弱，但由吉耶特·威尔德茨所率领，宣扬反伊斯兰教的荷兰自由党得票率则高达17 % 。 不仅如此，极右党派在奥地利，丹麦，匈牙利，斯洛伐克，甚至在英国都表现得比预想的要好 — — 极右的英国国家党甚至赢得了建党以来的第一个席位。
en: In France, Jean-Marie Le Pen’s party has been substantially weakened, but in the Netherlands, the anti–Islam party led by Geert Wilders won 17% of the votes, and in Austria, Denmark, Hungary, Slovakia, and even in the UK the far right did better than expected.

zh: 虽然有人为极端主义在欧洲的崛起而忧虑，但这些极端党派的政纲其实千差万别，并非铁板一块，大可不必担心。
en: Indeed, the far-right British National Party won its first ever seat. But those worried about the rise of extremism in Europe should take some heart from the fact that there are many differences of views between these parties.

zh: 那么右翼党派凭什么能在未来欧洲议会中占有如此优势？
en: The predominance of the right in the future European Parliament calls for some explanation.
