zh: 加入欧盟的准备极大地推动了8个前共产主义中欧国家巩固或重建其民主体制和市场经济。
en: Preparations for EU entry strongly motivated the eight former communist Central European states to entrench or restore democratic institutions and market economies.

zh: 如果欧洲进一步地输出其法律和价值体系，就会进一步扩大一个致力于和平、民主和繁荣的和平共处的区域。
en: The further Europe export its laws and values, the more it expands a zone committed to peaceful, democratic, and prosperous co-existence.

zh: 如果一个国家决意做好准备加入欧盟，也就做好了准备和平地融入世界。
en: A country equipped to join the EU is a country equipped to make its way in the world peacefully, if it chooses to do so.

zh: 欧洲需要与这样的国家为邻。
en: Europe needs such countries on its border.

zh: 但目前为止，欧盟的行动却适得其反。
en: So far, the Union's actions have achieved the opposite.

zh: 例如，3年前乌克兰人穿越波兰边界六百万次。
en: For example, three years ago Ukrainians crossed the border with Poland six million times.

zh: 这些人多数是小商贩，从波兰买回商品到国内销售。 这就促进了波兰最贫穷的东部地区的经济发展。
en: Most were small traders buying goods for resale at home, boosting the economy of eastern Poland, the poorest part of that country.

zh: 其他克兰人在波兰从事清洁工和建筑工一类的廉价工作。
en: Others worked cheaply in Poland as cleaners and building workers.

zh: 为进一步加强欧盟的边界控制和签证规定，波兰开始要求其邻国公民申请入境签证。
en: As a step towards imposing EU border controls and visa rules, Poland began demanding visas from its neighbors.

zh: 于是跨越波兰边境的人流量骤减，减幅超过2/3。
en: Crossings at Polish border stations quickly fell by over two thirds.

zh: 于是欧盟与乌克兰的新边界让人以能相像得到的最消极的方式感受到了-通过损害乌波双方的贸易往来。
en: Thus the new EU border with Ukraine is making its presence felt in the most negative way imaginable - by hurting business on both sides of the border.

zh: 在欧盟，似乎只有波兰希望与一个繁荣、稳定和易进入的乌克兰为邻，而不愿其是一个贫穷、动荡，有着不稳定的民主和更不稳定的核电站的邻国。
en: In the EU, only Poland seems to want Ukraine as a prosperous, stable, and accessible neighbor, not as a poor and rickety one with a dodgy democracy and even dodgier nuclear power stations.

zh: 波兰担心越是将乌克兰排除在欧盟之外，该国在政治和经济上就越会落后。
en: Poland worries that the more Ukraine is shut off from the Union, the more it will fall behind, economically and politically.

zh: 但现今其他的欧盟成员国由于某些原因却带着宿命和恐惧来看待一个不断扩张的欧盟将乌克兰纳入麾下的前景。
en: But today's other EU members view the prospect of an ever-expanding Union to include Ukraine with fatalism and dread, for several reasons.

zh: 第一个原因不可避免的是金钱。
en: The first, inevitably, is money.

zh: 欧盟将数以亿万计的欧元从富有的成员国再分配到贫穷的成员国：这意味着越穷的国家就需要越多的份额。
en: The EU redistributes billions of euros from rich to poor members: more poor members mean more claimants on that purse.

zh: 第二个原因是移民。
en: A second is immigration.

zh: 欧盟的根本原则之一就是其公民可以在各成员国间自由流动。
en: One of the Union's fundamental principles is that there should be freedom to move from one member country to another.

zh: 但反对移民的政党在整个西欧正日渐强势；它们可能将乌克兰潜在的成员资格作为巨大的政治资本。
en: But anti-immigration parties are gaining ground across western Europe; they could make huge political capital out of potential Ukrainian membership.

zh: 有一种观点还认为更扩大的欧盟只会大而无当。
en: There is also a feeling that a larger EU might simply be unable to function.

zh: 要炮制似是而非的障碍阻挠乌克兰的加盟很容易。
en: Manufacturing plausible-sounding objections to Ukrainian membership is easy.

zh: 如我们并不是真正意义上的欧洲国家，我们太贫穷，也太不同了。
en: We are not really European, we are too poor, we are too different.

zh: 但欧盟一直拒绝为成员国设立最低收入标准的提议。
en: But the Union has consistently rejected the idea of insisting on a minimum income level for members.

zh: 它唯一严肃的经济要求-颇为正当的要求-是成员国必须有"健全的市场经济。
en: Its only serious economic demand - rightly so - is that members should have a "functioning market economy."

zh: "至于我们是否是欧洲国家，我想指出的是在巴尔扎克生活在乌克兰的岁月里，他绝不会提出这样一个问题。
en: As for whether we are European, I submit that Balzac would never have asked that question during the years he lived here.

zh: 欧洲、俄罗斯、乌克兰、摩尔多瓦和白俄罗斯唇齿相依的地方正在形成一个经济断层。
en: Where Europe, Russia, Ukraine, Moldova, and Belarus rub up against one another, an economic fault line is forming.

zh: 欧盟现在如何作为以弥合断层将会决定这些国家究竟是西方化还是停滞不前。
en: What the EU does now to bridge this fault line will determine whether these countries westernize or stagnate.

zh: 一个从大西洋到乌拉尔山的自由完整的欧洲的梦想仍有待实现。
en: The dream of a Europe free and whole, from the Atlantic to the Urals, remains to be completed.

zh: 过犹不及的欧洲统一性
en: Europe’s Harmony Overdose

zh: 发自布拉格 — — 承载着欧盟单一市场的其中一块基石就是统一性。
en: PRAGUE – One pillar of the European Union’s single market is harmonization.

zh: 这上看去非常合理，因为一个统一的规则之下，资本和劳动力都能自由流动并实现最优配置。
en: At first sight, that makes a lot of sense. Harmonized systems of rules make it easier for capital and labor to move around in search of their best use.

zh: 但遗憾的是，许多欧盟鼓吹者对这种一致性的狂热常常会超越经济理性，甚至违背常识。
en: Alas, some Europhiles’ unifying zeal has all too often spilled beyond the bounds of economic reason, even common sense.

zh: 事实上更多的“一致”或者“统一”并不意味着就能提供有效 — — 甚至合理的 — — 欧盟问题应对方案。
en: More unification and harmonization does not necessarily lead to effective – or even reasonable – solutions to the EU’s troubles.

zh: 目前正研究制定的新欧洲监管措施（除所谓的《巴塞尔协议III》以外）的重点就是要令金融系统更加稳定。
en: The main point of the new European regulatory measures under consideration (apart from the so-called new Basel III rules) is to bring more stability to the financial system.

zh: 而其间接的效应则是削减了金融部门的规模 — — 按绝对价值计算，并与经济总量相比 — — 并阻碍了其未来的发展。
en: The indirect effect will be to reduce the financial sector’s size – in absolute terms and relative to the economy – and to hinder its growth in the future.

zh: 但这些措施同时也将波及到那些在危机中保持高度稳定的欧盟国家及其金融部门。
en: But these effects will also occur in EU countries whose financial sectors have maintained a high degree of stability in the current crisis.

zh: 即便其中一些欧盟国家的银行是由稳定长期存款（而不是短期银行同业拆借）来维持经营，仅仅沾染少量有毒资产却拥有以巨额本地存款做后盾的本地贷款，却无法独善其身，最终整个欧盟地区的金融服务都将因这些措施而变得更加烦琐和昂贵。
en: Delivery of financial services will be made more difficult and expensive everywhere, even though some countries’ banks are financed by stable long-term deposits rather than short-term interbank loans, with few toxic assets and local loans that are more than comfortably covered by local deposits.

zh: 这也是为什么许多人反对征收一项统一的欧盟银行税的原因。
en: This is why one can hear many voices opposing the idea of a harmonized EU-wide bank levy or tax.

zh: 虽然那些金融部门在危机中惨遭重创的国家极力推崇该税项，但对那些根本无需援助本国银行的欧盟成员国来说，却是难以接受的。
en: This levy, strongly backed by those countries whose financial sectors are in tatters after the crisis, is hard to swallow for EU states that did not intervene to bail out their banks.

zh: 这个银行税是一种将危机的政治和金融成本摊派到所有欧盟成员头上的简单方法。
en: The levy is an easy way to spread the political and financial costs of the crisis from some to all EU members.

zh: 如果开征的话，银行资本就将缩水，信贷流动速度减慢，即便是那些金融部门相对稳定的国家，银行费率也将水涨船高，但原因却是其他一些国家在援助本国金融系统上花费了巨资 — — 另外也因为欧盟委员会从来都不会错过任何一个在全欧推行某种一致性政策的机会。
en: If applied, bank capital will be scarcer, the flow of credit slower, and bank fees higher in countries with pretty stable financial sectors, simply because others have spent a fortune to support their financial systems – and because the European Commission never misses an opportunity to unify rules across the EU.

zh: 同样的情况也将发生在金融衍生品交易系统上。
en: The same is true, for instance, for the derivatives trading system.

zh: 在如今这个后危机时代，弥漫在该领域的一致性狂热意味着各国要花费更大的成本来防止货币币值蒸发或者利率突变。
en: The post-crisis harmonization fervor in this area means that it will now be more costly everywhere in the EU to insure against currency volatility or unexpected changes in interest.

zh: 但在所有欧洲国家统一推行这种措施的做法既没必要，也不合理。
en: But such harmonization is neither necessary nor justified in every EU country.

zh: 此外，我们估计很快会碰到另一个统一，一致并且由上至下推动执行的国内或国家间欧元支付系统。
en: We are also soon likely to have a unified, harmonized, and enforced-from-above system for euro payments, be they intrastate or interstate.

zh: 欧盟委员的考虑是各国没必要各自使用一套独立的系统，更何况这些系统比一致的单一欧元支付区系统拥有更多顾客，交易量也更大。
en: The Commission reckons that it is rather suspicious that every country currently has its own system, and that these national systems are used by more customers and for more transactions than the harmonized Single Euro Payment Area (SEPA) system of payments.

zh: 但讽刺的是，在支付区刚开始建立的时候，许多私有银行自愿将自己的系统整合进支付区，但许多国有银行系统却是苦心经营了多年。
en: The irony here is that, at its beginning, participation by private banks in SEPA was strictly voluntary. But many of the national systems have been evolving for many years.

zh: 数百万消费者依然依靠这些系统来进行借记卡或信用开支付，同时也没有什么好的理由能说服他们转向这个代码不同，缩写不同，连标记也不同的支付区系统。
en: Millions of customers have willingly relied on them for their debit and credit payments, and simply have not found reason to switch to the SEPA system, with its different codes, abbreviations, and symbols.

zh: 而这就是欧盟委员会要在全欧洲推广的系统 — — 为此他们禁止了一切与支付区系统相冲突的金融产品。
en: This is the system that the Commission wants to prescribe for the whole Union, while banning all SEPA-incompatible products.

zh: 消费者必须改变自己的付款委托方式以及使用习惯，仅仅是为了在全欧盟达到一致。
en: Customers will have to change their payment orders and habits just because harmonization has become an end in itself for many in the EU.

zh: 而与这一敏感领域类似的其他领域其实都适用一个简单的法则：人家用得好好的，你又何苦要改变之？
en: One simple rule should be applied as rigorously in this sensitive area as anywhere else: if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it.

zh: 与此同时，某个风险极大的协调一致性措施也正在另一个领域酝酿：宏观经济表现。
en: Dubious harmonization and unification is in the pipeline in another area as well: macroeconomic performance.

zh: 在过去十年，我们已经见证了《稳定与增长公约 》 （ 在公约中欧盟各国宣誓保持较低的公共债务和财政赤字水平）在过度宽松的财政政策下名存实亡。
en: Over the last decade, we have watched as the Stability and Growth Pact (in which EU countries pledge to keep their public debts and deficits low) has dissipated in a mist of permissiveness.

zh: 而就在最近，似乎欧盟也最终意识到（因为他们似乎无意推动）没有任何一个公约 — — 无论其出发点是多么值得称赞 — — 都不能保证能各国一定会出台良好的财政政策。
en: Recently, it almost looked as if the EU had finally come to understand that, given a lack of will, no pact – however commendable its purpose – can ensure sound fiscal policies.

zh: 但欧盟机构如今不仅尝试修补这个公约，还想方设法去扩大其影响范围，使之可以惩罚那些“宏观经济不平衡的”欧盟国家。
en: But European institutions are now not only trying to repair the Pact, but are looking for ways to broaden its scope, making it possible to punish EU countries for “macroeconomic imbalances.”

zh: 比如说，如果一个比较贫穷的成员国正经历一个人民收入差距缩小的实质趋同时期，同时却遭遇临时性的经常账户赤字 — — 这种情况屡见不鲜 — — 该国就将因为“不够一致”而受到惩罚。
en: Just look at some of the proposals of EU President Herman Van Rompuy’s task force on economic governance. For example, if a poorer member country undergoes a period of real convergence and has a temporary current-account deficit – as is usual in such cases – it may be punished for not being sufficiently “harmonized.”

zh: 同样，如果一个国家通过对革新劳动市场或者保持较低的实质工资水平而实现��产力强劲增长，估计也会面临惩罚。
en: The same is true of a country that undergoes a period of strong productivity growth because it has reformed its labor market or kept real wages low and has a current-account surplus.

zh: 太过创新，太有竞争力，太快增长，太多出口都会在这个不正当的一致性理论下成为一大“罪状 ” 。
en: Being too innovative, too competitive, too flexible, growing too much, and exporting too much might become “a problem” in this perverted logic of harmonization.

zh: 那么对于在这方面尤为突出的德国人或其他人来说，难道不应感到汗颜吗？
en: So, Germans and others, are you listening carefully to these voices? Aren’t you afraid?

zh: 虽然协调一致确实能在欧盟的许多经济领域发挥作用，但不应将所有的金融管制和宏观经济表现都归于这一门类。
en: There are many areas of economic life in the EU where harmonization does help. But not every aspect of financial regulation and macroeconomic performance necessarily belongs in this category.

zh: 在经济生活中我们鼓励竞争，反对垄断，而各国政府之间的制度竞争或许能为我们带来更多好处。
en: We praise competition, not monopolies, in economic life. Competition in the rules that govern it might serve us better as well.

zh: 欧洲高等法院面临种族歧视
en: Europe’s High Court Confronts Racism

zh: 欧洲人权法院有史以来最重要的两起案件正在进行口头辩论。
en: The European Court of Human Rights is hearing oral arguments in two of the most important cases in its history.

zh: 和半个世纪前最终压垮美国种族隔离制度的布朗诉教育局案一样，民众要求欧洲法庭界定平等的根本原则。
en: As in Brown v. Board of Education , the case that ultimately broke the back of racial segregation in America half a century ago, the European Court is being asked to give meaning to the fundamental principle of equality.

zh: 其结果可能会诞生明确的章程，指导针对欧洲日益增多的种族和宗教少数族裔的未来政策。
en: The resulting decisions could establish clear ground rules to guide future policy toward Europe’s increasingly numerous ethnic and religious minorities.

zh: 原告是欧洲最大、也最贫困的少数族裔成员－罗马人、或吉普赛人，据传他们的祖先是几个世纪前的印度移民。
en: The plaintiffs are members of Europe’s poorest and largest minority group – the Roma, or Gypsies, whose ancestors are believed to have migrated from India centuries ago.

zh: 案件之一涉及到捷克共和国东北部城市俄斯特拉发的18名罗马族儿童，他们被指派到接收智障儿童的一所“特种”学校，在那里接受明显低劣的教育。
en: One case concerns 18 Roma children from the northeastern city of Ostrava in the Czech Republic who were placed in “special” schools for those deemed mentally deficient, where they receive a markedly inferior education.

zh: 孩子们说这种学校是他们在社会和经济领域进步的障碍。
en: The children argue that such schools are a barrier to social and economic progress.

zh: 很多罗马人即便在智力上没有障碍，也被送进了这样的特种学校。
en: Many Roma are sent to special schools even though they show no sign of mental disability.

zh: 能够完成高中学业或者上大学的人可谓凤毛麟角。
en: Few go on to finish high school or attend university.

zh: 因此，捷克共和国罗马族人的失业率和欧洲很多国家一样，远远超过了其它所有族裔。
en: As a result, Roma unemployment rates in the Czech Republic, as in much of Europe, far exceed those for the rest of the population.

zh: 呈送法院的证据表明：在某些捷克社区里，罗马族儿童被送往特种学校的几率比非罗马儿童高27倍。
en: Evidence before the Court indicates that, in some Czech communities, Roma children are 27 times more likely to be sent to special schools than non-Roma children.

zh: 原告方认为这构成了种族歧视，但遭到了政府的强烈否认。
en: The plaintiffs suggest that this amounts to racial segregation. The government vigorously denies this.

zh: 法庭定于3月1日进行听证。
en: The Court’s hearing is set for March 1.

zh: 第二起案件来自保加利亚。
en: The second case comes from Bulgaria.

zh: 1996年，军队警察射杀了两名罗马族应召士兵。
en: In 1996, military police shot and killed two Roma conscripts.

zh: 被害者不久前曾从军队施工建制中私自脱逃，据了解他们没有携带武器，也不会构成危险。
en: The victims, who had recently absconded from a military construction crew, were known to be unarmed and not dangerous.

zh: 射击所用的是自动武器，行凶地点就在光天化日之下的罗马族聚居区，其中一名受害者的祖母就住在这里。
en: The shooting, by automatic weapon fire, took place in broad daylight in a largely Roma neighborhood, where the grandmother of one of the victims lived.

zh: 凶杀发生后，一名军队警察被控用枪指着一位社区居民并向他大喊 ， “ 你们这些该死的吉普赛人！ ”
en: Immediately after the killing, a military police officer allegedly yelled at one of the town residents, “You damned Gypsies!” while pointing a gun at him.

zh: 去年，一位法庭陪审员发现这起枪杀事件和后来的证明其合法性的调查都搀杂了种族敌视的因素。
en: Last year, one panel of the Court found that both the shootings and a subsequent investigation that upheld their lawfulness were tainted by racial animus.

zh: 应保加利亚政府的要求，法庭的高级理事会同意在2月底以前重审这个案件。
en: At the request of the Bulgarian government, the Court’s Grand Chamber agreed to review the matter before the end of February.

zh: 尽管这两起案件的事实都令人心痛，但它们的意义却超越了庭审的范畴。
en: Though the facts of both cases are heart wrenching, their importance extends beyond the courtroom.

zh: 当移民问题、宗教极端主义和种族暴力引起人们越来越深忧虑的时候，政府必须做些什么才能兑现所有人机会平等的承诺？
en: At a time of rising concern about immigration, religious extremism, and ethnic violence, what must government do to secure the promise of equal opportunity for all?

zh: 过去10年来，欧盟内部种族越来越丰富。
en: Over the past decade, the European Union has grown more ethnically diverse.

zh: 西班牙、意大利和希腊等国的移民数量激增，使北欧地区长久存在的移民和奥地利、德国和卢森堡所谓“交流工人”大大增加。
en: Immigration to Spain, Italy, and Greece has surged, adding to longstanding immigrant populations in northern Europe and to the number of so-called “guest workers” in Austria, Germany, and Luxembourg.

zh: 去年5月最新一次的欧盟东扩纳入了中东欧新成员国内成百上千万的罗马族劳工。
en: The most recent stage of EU enlargement last May added millions of Roma from the new member states of Central and Eastern Europe.

zh: 随着欧洲的种族构成悄然发生变化，这里的法律也做出了相应的调整。
en: Just as Europe’s ethnic makeup has been changing, so have its laws.

zh: 2000年，欧盟的执行部门为了对日益抬头的反移民和新纳粹党势力做出反应，颁布了全世界意义最为深远的反歧视法案。
en: In 2000, the EU’s executive arm – responding in part to the growing popularity of anti-immigrant and neo-Nazi political parties – enacted the most far-reaching anti-discrimination legislation in the world.

zh: 但迄今为止，这项法案还处在休眠状态。
en: To date, however, this legislation has lain dormant.

zh: 在很多国家，律师和法官都不熟悉歧视的法律定义。
en: In many countries, lawyers and judges lack familiarity with legal concepts of discrimination.

zh: 因此排外、隔离和种族暴力行为时常逍遥法外也许并不奇怪。
en: Perhaps not surprisingly, acts of exclusion, segregation, and violence often go unpunished.

zh: 即将在斯特拉斯堡举行听证的这两起案件提供了改变现状的机会。
en: The two cases soon to be heard in Strasbourg provide an opportunity to change this.

zh: 种族歧视的判决会开创里程碑式的法律先例，在欧洲政治家考虑如何才能最好地吸纳成百上千万新移民和少数族裔的时候，使反对歧视和平等公正的核心价值观深入人心。
en: A finding of discrimination would establish a landmark legal precedent, putting core values of non-discrimination and equal justice beyond dispute at a time when Europe’s politicians consider how best to absorb millions of new immigrants and minority members.

zh: 同样重要的是，这样的裁决能发出强有力的信号：种族歧视和排外主义在新欧洲没有容身之地。
en: Just as importantly, such a ruling would send a powerful signal that racism and xenophobia have no place in the new Europe.

zh: 但这两起案件能够在欧洲最高权利法院进行审理，这本身就是它们最深刻的意义所在。
en: But perhaps the greatest significance of these cases lies in their very presence on the docket of Europe’s highest rights tribunal.

zh: 10年前，很少有人会同情少数族裔的受害者，他们也很少能为自己受到的歧视寻求法律上的赔偿。
en: A decade ago, few minority victims would have been inclined or able to seek legal remedies for discrimination.

zh: 某些受害者的呼声能引起人们的关注，���表明日益扩大的法律权力已经在欧洲成了积极变革的力量。
en: The success of some in having their claims heard is testimony to the growing power of law as a force for positive change in Europe.

zh: 欧洲的高危赌博
en: Europe’s High-Risk Gamble

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 希腊政府需要摆脱的是一个完全没有其他活路可走的困境。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The Greek government needs to escape from an otherwise impossible situation.

zh: 它拥有一个棘手的政府负债（相当于GDP的150 % ， 今年内已经递增了10 % ） ，一个陷入崩溃的经济（随着GDP下跌了7 % ， 失业率上升到16 % ） ，一个长期存在的政府收支赤字（目前相当于GDP的8 % ） ，以及一批资不抵债且在迅速流失存款的银行。
en: It has an unmanageable level of government debt (150% of GDP, rising this year by ten percentage points), a collapsing economy (with GDP down by more than 7% this year, pushing the unemployment rate up to 16%), a chronic balance-of-payments deficit (now at 8% of GDP), and insolvent banks that are rapidly losing deposits.

zh: 而希腊唯一的活路就是实施主权债务违约。
en: The only way out is for Greece to default on its sovereign debt.

zh: 一旦采取该行动，它必须将全部债务的本金削减至少50 % 。
en: When it does, it must write down the principal value of that debt by at least 50%.

zh: 而目前试图将私人持有债券现值削减20%的计划只是为实现这一目标而首先迈出的一小步而已。
en: The current plan to reduce the present value of privately held bonds by 20% is just a first small step toward this outcome.

zh: 如果希腊在违约之后脱离了欧元区，它就可以把自己的新货币贬值，从而刺激需求并最终转变为贸易顺差。
en: If Greece leaves the euro after it defaults, it can devalue its new currency, thereby stimulating demand and shifting eventually to a trade surplus.

zh: 这么一个“违约并贬值”的策略对于世界其他国家来说已经是标准动作了，一旦遭遇无法偿还的巨额政府债务以及长期经常账户逆差，他们就会照此办理。
en: Such a strategy of “default and devalue” has been standard fare for countries in other parts of the world when they were faced with unmanageably large government debt and a chronic current-account deficit.

zh: 而这个情况之所以没有在希腊身上发生就是因为希腊被单一货币捆住了手脚。
en: It hasn’t happened in Greece only because Greece is trapped in the single currency.

zh: 市场已经清楚地意识到失去偿还能力的希腊将最终违约。
en: The markets are fully aware that Greece, being insolvent, will eventually default.

zh: 这也是三年期希腊政府债券利率最近攀升超过100%而十年期债券收益率高达22%的原因，意味着一张十年后面值为100欧元的债券还不值当今的14欧元。
en: That’s why the interest rate on Greek three-year government debt recently soared past 100% and the yield on ten-year bonds is 22%, implying that a €100 principal payable in ten years is worth less than €14 today.

zh: 那么，法国和德国的领导人们又为何如此奋力去阻止 — — 或者更精确地说，拖延 — — 这件必将发生的事件？
en: Why, then, are political leaders in France and Germany trying so hard to prevent – or, more accurately, to postpone – the inevitable?

zh: 在此有两个原因可供解答。
en: There are two reasons.

zh: 首先，德法两国的银行以及其他金融机构都持有大量希腊政府债务，或者是直接持有，或者是通过自身在希腊以及其他欧元区银行的信贷持有。
en: First, the banks and other financial institutions in Germany and France have large exposures to Greek government debt, both directly and through the credit that they have extended to Greek and other eurozone banks.

zh: 推迟违约意味着为两国金融机构赢得时间去注入资本，使之能在贷款到期后不再继续借贷从而减少与希腊各银行的关联，并将希腊债券出售给欧洲央行。
en: Postponing a default gives the French and German financial institutions time to build up their capital, reduce their exposure to Greek banks by not renewing credit when loans come due, and sell Greek bonds to the European Central Bank.

zh: 而法德两国奋力推迟违约的第二个（也是更重要的）原因就是希腊违约将引发其他国家（尤其是西班牙和意大利）的主权债务违约以及银行系统危机。
en: The second, and more important, reason for the Franco-German struggle to postpone a Greek default is the risk that a Greek default would induce sovereign defaults in other countries and runs on other banking systems, particularly in Spain and Italy.

zh: 而这一风险在标准普尔最近调低意大利主权评级一事中可见一斑。
en: This risk was highlighted by the recent downgrade of Italy’s credit rating by Standard & Poor’s.

zh: 如果西班牙和意大利这两个大国发生违约，法德两国的银行以及金融机构都将承受灾难性后果。
en: A default by either of those large countries would have disastrous implications for the banks and other financial institutions in France and Germany.

zh: 欧洲金融稳定基金有足够能力去满足希腊的融资需求，而一旦西班牙和意大利无法从私人市场融资的话就爱莫能助了。
en: The European Financial Stability Fund is large enough to cover Greece’s financing needs but not large enough to finance Italy and Spain if they lose access to private markets.

zh: 因此欧洲政治家们希望通过向外界展示即使希腊也能免于违约，使私人市场对意西两国的生存能力重拾信心，并因此继续以合理的利率贷款给两国政府并向各银行注资。
en: So European politicians hope that by showing that even Greece can avoid default, private markets will gain enough confidence in the viability of Italy and Spain to continue lending to their governments at reasonable rates and financing their banks.

zh: 如果放任希腊在未来几个星期内发生违约，那么金融市场实质上将认定西班牙和意大利也将很快违约。
en: If Greece is allowed to default in the coming weeks, financial markets will indeed regard defaults by Spain and Italy as much more likely.

zh: 这将导致市场向两国贷款的利率飙升，国家债务总额迅速上涨，因此实质上剥夺其还债能力。
en: That could cause their interest rates to spike upward and their national debts to rise rapidly, thus making them effectively insolvent.

zh: 反过来欧洲政治家们认为如能将希腊违约推后两年时间的话，或许西意两国能证明自己在金融上还是有偿还能力的。
en: By postponing a Greek default for two years, Europe’s politicians hope to give Spain and Italy time to prove that they are financially viable.

zh: 两年时间能使市场看清西班牙银行是否有能力应对地产价格下滑的问题，或者抵押贷款违约是否会导致银行大规模破产，迫使西班牙政府注入巨额存款保证金。
en: Two years could allow markets to see whether Spain’s banks can handle the decline of local real-estate prices, or whether mortgage defaults will lead to widespread bank failures, requiring the Spanish government to finance large deposit guarantees.

zh: 同时这两年也将暴露出西班牙地方政府的财政状况，而这些政府无法偿还的债务最终也要由中央政府来担保。
en: The next two years would also disclose the financial conditions of Spain’s regional governments, which have incurred debts that are ultimately guaranteed by the central government.

zh: 同样，两年时间能让意大利政府表明其是否能实现财政收支平衡。
en: Likewise, two years could provide time for Italy to demonstrate whether it can achieve a balanced budget.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼政府最近通过了一项旨在增加税收并在2013年达到收支平衡的预算法案。
en: The Berlusconi government recently passed a budget bill designed to raise tax revenue and to bring the economy to a balanced budget by 2013.

zh: 这目标将很难实现， 因为财政紧缩将减少意大利目前仅在缓慢增长的GDP，并导致税收减少。
en: That will be hard to achieve, because fiscal tightening will reduce Italian GDP, which is now barely growing, in turn shrinking tax revenue.

zh: 因此在两年时间内，我们将看到一场关于预算平衡是否在循环调整的基础上最终实现的辩论。
en: So, in two years, we can expect a debate about whether budget balance has then been achieved on a cyclically adjusted basis.

zh: 这两年也将展现出意大利的银行是否比外界想象的要强健。
en: Those two years would also indicate whether Italian banks are in better shape than many now fear.

zh: 如果西班牙和意大利在两年后表现良好的话，欧洲的政治家们就能在没有危机传导之忧的情况下放任希腊违约。
en: If Spain and Italy do look sound enough at the end of two years, European political leaders can allow Greece to default without fear of dangerous contagion.

zh: 葡萄牙或许会步希腊的后尘并退出欧元区。
en: Portugal might follow Greece in a sovereign default and in leaving the eurozone.

zh: 但那些较大的国家将能以合理的利率借到资金，而目前的欧元区系统也将继续运作下去。
en: But the larger countries would be able to fund themselves at reasonable interest rates, and the current eurozone system could continue.

zh: 但如果西班牙和意大利无法在未来两年内用自己的财务���况说服市场的话，向其政府和银行的贷款利率将显著上升，并使两国陷入明确无误的破产境地。
en: If, however, Spain or Italy does not persuade markets over the next two years that they are financially sound, interest rates for their governments and banks will rise sharply, and it will be clear that they are insolvent.

zh: 而在这一点上他们已经违约了。
en: At that point, they will default.

zh: 结果它们至少在短期内无法在市场上融资，并强烈要求退出单一货币体系。
en: They would also be at least temporarily unable to borrow and would be strongly tempted to leave the single currency.

zh: 但这里还有一个更巨大也更迫在眉睫的危险。 即便西班牙和意大利在根本上都是可靠的，但已经没有两年时间给它们证明自己了。
en: But there is a greater and more immediate danger: Even if Spain and Italy are fundamentally sound, there may not be two years to find out.

zh: 目前的希腊利率水平显示市场相信该国会很快发生违约。
en: The level of Greek interest rates shows that markets believe that Greece will default very soon.

zh: 而即便是在违约发生之前，市场向西班牙和意大利贷款的利率都可能大幅上升，使两国走上一条金融上的不归路。
en: And even before that default occurs, interest rates on Spanish or Italian debt could rise sharply, putting these countries on a financially impossible path.

zh: 而欧元区的政治家们会得到一个痛彻心扉的教训：愚弄市场，可是一个危险的策略。
en: The eurozone’s politicians may learn the hard way that trying to fool markets is a dangerous strategy.

zh: 欧洲：下注无悔
en: Europe’s Historic Gamble

zh: 伯克利 — — 最近几周是欧元问世11年来最刺激也最重要的一段日子。
en: BERKELEY – The last few weeks have been the most amazing – and important – period of the euro’s 11-year existence.

zh: 先是希腊危机和救助。
en: First came the Greek crisis, followed by the Greek bailout.

zh: 当危机蔓延到葡萄牙与西班牙，又出台了1万亿美元的救助计划。
en: When the crisis spread to Portugal and Spain, there was the $1 trillion rescue.

zh: 最后，欧洲央行史无前例地购买西班牙、葡萄牙、希腊和爱尔兰的债券。
en: Finally, there were unprecedented purchases of Spanish, Portuguese, Greek, and Irish bonds by the European Central Bank.

zh: 在1个月以前还显得不可思议的事情，居然全都发生了。
en: All of this was unimaginable a month ago.

zh: 种种惊人然而错误的预言也令这两周更加波诡云谲。
en: Europe’s fortnight mirabilis was also marked by amazing – and erroneous – predictions. Greece would be booted out of the monetary union.

zh: 什么希腊会被踢出欧元同盟咯；什么欧元区会分裂成一南一北两个同盟咯；更有甚者，说如果德国不支持救助方案，欧元乃至欧盟都会解体云云。
en: The eurozone would be divided into a Northern European union and a Southern European union. Or the euro – and even the European Union – would disintegrate as Germany turned its back on the project.

zh: 然而，欧盟各国领导人没有选择亮牌，而是加倍下注。
en: But, rather than folding their cards, European leaders doubled down.

zh: 他们明白，如果押错了宝，这个赌局的代价会十分巨大。
en: They understand that their gamble will be immensely costly if it proves wrong.

zh: 他们明白，各自的政治生命都押在这上头了。
en: They understand that their political careers now ride on their massive bet.

zh: 他们也明白，既然已经下了注，也就不能反悔了。
en: But they also understand that they already have too many chips in the pot to fold.

zh: 那些预言欧元崩溃的人之所以会错，是因为不懂政治。
en: Those forecasting the demise of the euro were wrong because they misunderstood the politics.

zh: 欧元是欧洲一体化的象征。
en: The euro is the symbol of the European project.

zh: 欧元的缔造者之一，欧盟委员会前主席雅克·德洛尔（Jacques Delors）曾把单一货币誉为“欧洲王冠上的宝石 ” 。
en: Jacques Delors, one of its architects, once called the single currency “the jewel in Europe’s crown.”

zh: 放弃欧元就等于宣布，整个欧洲一体化方案以失败告终。
en: Abandoning it would be tantamount to declaring the entire European integration project a failure.

zh: 救助希腊的政治博弈固然惹恼了德国人。
en: It is true that Germans are incensed about bailing out Greece.

zh: 安格拉·默克尔固然是二战后第一位战后出生的德国总理。
en: It is true that Angela Merkel is the first postwar German chancellor not to have lived through World War II.

zh: 但她的见解和行为方式受制于她所处的那个社会，而那个社会的心态又受制于二战那段历史。
en: But her views and actions are shaped by the society in which she lives, which in turn is shaped by that history.

zh: 对默克尔适用的情况仍然对整个欧洲适用。
en: And what is true of Merkel is still true of Europe.

zh: 这就是为什么，欧盟各国领导人会咬着牙迈出史无前例的一步。
en: This is why European leaders swallowed hard and took their unprecedented steps.

zh: 可是，既然已经加倍下注，欧洲人就必须让他们的货币同盟正常运作。
en: But, having doubled their bet, Europeans now must make their monetary union work. Europe has excellent bank notes.

zh: 欧洲有很棒的钞票，也有很棒的央行，但它缺少一个货币同盟所需要的其他一些要素。
en: It has an excellent central bank. But it lacks the other elements of a proper monetary union.

zh: 它需要创造那些要素，而且得快，这就必须触动那些向来视为禁忌的话题。
en: It needs to establish them – and fast – which requires finally addressing matters that have been off-limits in the past.

zh: 首先，欧洲需要一个有实际约束力的《稳定与增长公约 》 。
en: First, Europe needs a Stability Pact with teeth.

zh: 这一点有望实现，因为德国会坚持到底。
en: This will now happen, because Germany will insist on it.

zh: 正如欧洲委员会所提议的，加强后的《公约》将为高负债国家设定更严格的赤字上限，而且取消一切例外和豁免。
en: As the European Commission has proposed, the strengthened pact will have tighter deficit limits for heavily indebted countries. Exceptions and exemptions will be removed.

zh: 各成员国政府得让欧盟委员会事先监督它们的预算编制过程。
en: Governments will be required to let the Commission vet their budgetary plans in advance.

zh: 其次，欧洲的劳动力市场得变得更加灵活。
en: Second, Europe needs more flexible labor markets.

zh: 当年美国之所以能统一到美元旗下，一部分原因是劳动力的灵活流动。
en: Adjustment in the United States’ monetary union occurs partly through labor mobility.

zh: 鉴于欧洲的文化和语言壁垒，欧洲的劳动力市场流动性不太可能达到像美国这样的程度。
en: This will never apply to Europe to a similar degree, given cultural and linguistic barriers.

zh: 那么，欧洲就应该转而依赖工资的灵活性，以增进其落后地区的竞争力。
en: Instead, Europe will have to rely on wage flexibility to enhance the competitiveness of its depressed regions.

zh: 在这方面它做得也不够。
en: This is not something that it possesses in abundance.

zh: 然而近来西班牙和希腊削减公共部门工资的做法证明，欧洲实际上是可以提高工资灵活性的。
en: But recent cuts in public-sector pay in Spain and Greece are a reminder that Europe is, in fact, capable of wage flexibility.

zh: 如果哪个国家的工资议价集团从中作梗，欧盟委员会就应该发出明确的告诫，要求该国推动改革。
en: Where national wage-bargaining systems are the obstacle, the European Commission should say so, and countries should be required to change them.

zh: 第三，欧元区需要财政互保。
en: Third, the euro area needs fiscal co-insurance.

zh: 对于那些已经完成财政整顿的国家，一旦它们受到副作用的冲击，应该有一个临时提供财政转移支付的机制。
en: It needs a mechanism for temporary transfers to countries that have put their public finances in order but are hit by adverse shocks.

zh: 需要澄清的是，这并不是说要建立一个“转移支付同盟 ” ， 像希腊那样的国家持续转移支付 — — 德国人就怕这个。
en: To be clear, this is not an argument for Germany’s dreaded “transfer union” – ongoing transfers to countries like Greece.

zh: 而是说，向那些在危机前预算平衡，却受到房地产崩盘和经济衰退冲击的国家，比如西班牙，提供临时转移支付。
en: It is an argument for temporary transfers to countries like Spain, which balanced its budgets prior to the crisis but then was hit by the housing slump and recession.

zh: 而且，这种财政互保是双向的。
en: It is an argument for fiscal insurance running in both directions.

zh: 第四，欧元区需要建立一个紧急融资机制。
en: Fourth, the eurozone needs a proper emergency financing mechanism.

zh: 紧急事态不应由现行的27国财长月度例会来处理，那个例会为了在亚洲市场开盘前达成决议，总是搞得神经兮兮。
en: Emergencies should not be dealt with on an ad hoc basis by 27 finance ministers frantic to reach a solution before the Asian markets open.

zh: 而欧盟各国领导人，也不应在陷入绝望的时候才强拉欧洲央行来帮忙。
en: And European leaders, in their desperation, should not coerce the European Central Bank into helping.

zh: 应该有一个规定明确的出资机制，谁负责，提供多少钱等等都应明确下来。
en: There should be clear rules governing disbursement, who is in charge, and how much money is available.

zh: 每次需要行动的时候，也不必获得27国议会的一一批准。
en: It should not be necessary to obtain the agreement of 27 national parliaments each time action is needed.

zh: 最后，欧洲需要协调一致的银行监管。
en: Finally, Europe needs coherent bank regulation.

zh: 希腊危机之所以如此难以处理，原因之一就是，欧洲的许多银行都处于资本金不足、杠杆过高的状态，大把希腊债券烂在手里，所以债务重组的可能性就被排除了，因而加剧了希腊的债务压力。
en: One reason the Greek crisis is so difficult is that European banks are undercapitalized, overleveraged, and stuffed full of Greek bonds, thereby ruling out the possibility of restructuring – and thus lightening – Greece’s debt load.

zh: 而这种局面的根源在于，欧洲的银行监管还是处于一场“放松监管竞赛”的状态中。
en: That happened because European bank regulation is still characterized by a race to the bottom.

zh: 作为一种可能解决方案的监管者委员会仍付阙如。
en: “Colleges” of regulators, the supposed solution, are inadequate.

zh: 既然欧洲有一个单一市场和一个单一货币，它同业也需要一个单一的银行监管者。
en: If Europe has a single market and a single currency, it needs a single bank regulator.

zh: 这个行动纲领令人望而生畏 — — 有人会说根本不现实。
en: This is a formidable – some would say unrealistically ambitious – agenda.

zh: 但这恰恰是欧洲需要的纲领 — — 如果它想让它的货币同盟正常运行的话。
en: But it is the agenda Europe needs to complete to make its monetary union work.

zh: 欧洲应该抛弃反倾销
en: Europe Should Dump Anti-Dumping

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 保护欧洲的经济不受不公平的国际贸易行为的损害长久以来已经成为欧盟外部政策的一个重要组成部分。
en: Stockholm – Defending Europe’s economy against unfair international trade practices has long been a key element of the European Union’s external policies.

zh: 在一些政治家和商业领袖中，如果竞争被认为是不公平的，那么欧盟委员会就应该召集使用新的保护贸易的措施，这几乎成为他们的一种本能反应。
en: It is almost an instinct among some politicians and business leaders that if competition is deemed unfair, the European Commission should marshal new trade defenses.

zh: 但是，欧洲人防卫的是什么，并且究竟什么是“不公平的”贸易行为呢？
en: But what are Europeans defending against, and what are “unfair” trade practices anyway?

zh: 在缺乏防止掠夺性价格和其他反竞争行为的国际竞争规则的情况下，保护贸易的措施是次优的选择。
en: In the absence of international competition regulations to prevent predatory pricing and other anti-competitive activities, trade defenses are a second-best option.

zh: 迄今为止，使用最广泛的工具是反倾销税，其目的是向以反竞争方式行为的公司施加一些限制措施。
en: By far the most widely used instrument are anti-dumping duties aimed at imposing some restraint on companies that behave in an anti-competitive way.

zh: 但是，关税提高了，商品价格就会上涨，这通常意味着社会总体福利的一个损失。
en: But, by increasing tariffs, prices also rise, which often means a welfare loss for society as a whole.

zh: 这个事实长久以来被寻求保护贸易的措施的公司所忽略。
en: This fact has long been ignored by firms seeking trade defence.

zh: 但是，新情况是，这些公司 本身 可能不能从保护贸易的措施中获得好处。
en: What is new, however, is that the firms themselves might not gain from trade defense.

zh: 正是“防卫”这个词给一个国家创造了这样一个形象：这个国家和世界上其他国家的商业联系仅仅是通过传统贸易进行的。
en: The very word “defense” creates an image of a nation state that is commercially connected to the rest of the world only via traditional trade.

zh: 对于这样一个国家，所有的进口货物都真正的是外国货物，因而它的保护贸易的措施仅仅针对的是外国的利益。
en: For such a state, all imports would truly be foreign goods, and its trade defenses would consequently be directed only against foreign interests.

zh: 但是在当今的全球化世界里，这并不正确。
en: But this is not true in today’s globalized world.

zh: 虽然我们仍然有传统贸易，但是也有外国直接投资，境外生产和业务外包。
en: Although we still have traditional trade, we also have foreign direct investment, offshoring, and outsourcing.

zh: 我们拥有全球供应链，在这个链条中，商品在一个国家研发，在另一个国家生产，在第三个国家组装。
en: We have global supply lines in which goods are developed in one country, manufactured in another, and assembled in a third.

zh: 资本和技术秘密在不同的国家之间流动，因此传统的双边贸易流动已经被一个复杂的国际商业关系网络所取代。
en: Capital and know-how flows across borders, so traditional bilateral trade flows have been replaced by a complex web of international commercial relations.

zh: 这对保护贸易的措施影响很大。
en: This has major implications for trade defense.

zh: 如果你的移动电话是在印度组装的，但是是在芬兰研发和设计的，那么它是一个印度产品还是是一个芬兰产品呢？
en: If your mobile phone was assembled in India, but developed and designed in Finland, is it an Indian or a Finnish product?

zh: 当欧洲的公司将劳动密集型的制造业务外包到成本低的国家，但是将其他的生产过程留在欧洲的时候，对任何试图评价贸易保护措施的经济学的人来说，情况就变得非常复杂了。
en: When European corporations outsource labor-intensive manufacturing to low-cost countries but keep the rest of the production process in Europe, they greatly complicate matters for anyone trying to evaluate the economics of trade defense.

zh: 针对一个亚洲制造商的反倾销措施所造成的损失，可能绝大部分由一个欧洲生产商来承担。
en: To aim an anti-dumping measure against an Asian manufacturer may inflict most of the damage on a European producer.

zh: 在2006年，当欧盟决定对在中国和越南生产的皮鞋征收反倾销税时，就发生了这样的事情。
en: That happened in the October 2006 anti-dumping action against leather shoes, when the EU decided to impose anti-dumping tariffs against China and Vietnam.

zh: 瑞典国家贸易协会对在不同国家和不同细分市场的五个欧洲制鞋厂商进行了一个案例研究，以确定在它们的生产过程中附加值是在哪里创造出来的。
en: Sweden’s National Board of Trade conducted a case study of five European shoe producers in different countries and market segments to establish where the value added in their production processes was created.

zh: 虽然是在中国和越南制造的，但是这些鞋子是在欧洲设计，开发和销售的。
en: Although manufactured in China and Vietnam, shoes were designed, developed, and marketed in Europe.

zh: 有时候，在真正制造以前和以后的大量无形的生产过程构成了附加值的80 % 。
en: These largely intangible production processes before and after the physical manufacturing sometimes constituted 80% of the value added.

zh: 也就是说，来自中国的鞋子有80%是欧洲的！
en: In other words, shoes from China were 80% European!

zh: 对于不是那么贵的鞋子，由于投入到生产过程中无形的部分的资金比较少，这个数字不是那么高，但是仍然超过了50 % 。
en: For less expensive shoes, with lower sums invested in the intangible parts of the production process, this figure was not as high, but still more than 50%.

zh: 因此，欧盟实行的反倾销措施在无意之中打击了欧洲公司。
en: The anti-dumping measures imposed by the EU therefore hit European companies in an unintentional way.

zh: 人力成本较高的产业 — — 例如电子消费产品 — — 比制鞋业拥有更高的研发成本，因此，与研发和其他无形的成本相比，将这些产品在一个低成本国家的装配线上生产可能不是非常昂贵。
en: Sectors with a higher human capital content – electronic consumer goods, for example – have much higher R&D costs than the shoe sector, so manufacturing these goods on an assembly line in a low-cost country is probably not very costly in comparison to R&D and other intangible costs.

zh: 对于更先进的产品，欧盟附加值（如果生产过程中的无形部分是在欧洲）非常高。
en: For more advanced goods, the EU value added (if the intangible part of the production process is in Europe) is quite high.

zh: 实行贸易保护措施抵制这样的产品，即使是合法的，也有可能给全球化的欧洲公司带来问题。
en: Imposing trade defense against such goods, even if legally warranted, is likely to create problems for globalized European companies.

zh: 许多人说这些问题都是为了确保公司不从事反竞争行为或者接受扭曲贸易的补贴付出的代价。
en: Many say that these problems are the price to be paid for ensuring that companies do not engage in anti-competitive behavior, or receive trade-distorting subsidies.

zh: 但是，即使这些措施像预想的那样有效，大部分保护贸易的措施也有可能不是用来针对反竞争的商业行为的。
en: But, even if the measures worked as supposed, the majority of trade defense measures are probably not directed against anti-competitive business practices.

zh: 更多的时候，在保护贸易的措施的背后，保护主义的政治学是至关重要的因素。
en: More often it is the politics of protectionism that are the crucial factor behind trade defenses.

zh: 反倾销措施经常用来针对这样的商品，它们非常便宜，因此对欧洲的生产商构成了威胁，即使这只是公平竞争。
en: Anti-dumping measures are frequently used against products that are simply so cheap that they pose a threat to European producers, even though that is no more than fair competition.

zh: 这引发了对欧洲贸易保护机制的一个根本性的批评。
en: This raises a fundamental criticism Europe’s trade defense mechanisms.

zh: 根据定义，国际贸易是不同的公司在一个不平坦的运动场上的竞争。
en: International trade is by definition a competition between companies on an uneven playing field.

zh: 有些公司比较容易取得资金，然而它们的竞争对手却不能以合理的利率取得资金。
en: Some companies have easier access to capital, whereas their competitors cannot get access to finance at reasonable interest rates.

zh: 有些公司拥有任其使用的良好的基础设施，然而它们的国际竞争对���却可能不得不对付经常性的断电。
en: Some have excellent infrastructure at their disposal, while their international competitors may have to contend with constant power cuts.

zh: 有些公司支付超额税费，然而有些却在避税天堂里经营。
en: Some must pay excessive taxes, while others operate out of tax havens.

zh: 有些公司发现很容易招聘到顶尖的工程师，然而有些却只有丰富的廉价劳动力。
en: Some find it easy to recruit top-notch engineers, whereas for others enjoy an abundance of cheap labor.

zh: 在贸易中，创造一个完全平坦的运动场是不可能的。
en: To create a completely level playing field in trade is impossible.

zh: 然而，许多政治家和商业领袖热切地关注着他们不喜欢的不同，并且想要看到不同的“消除 ” 。
en: Yet many politicians and business leaders are keen to focus on the differences they don’t like and would like to see “leveled.”

zh: 事实上，他们不喜欢的是竞争本身，并且他们通过设置一个可能给他们造成更大损失的工具来和它作斗争。
en: In reality, what they don’t like is competition itself, and they fight it by deploying an instrument that can inflict even greater damage on themselves.

zh: 欧洲应该以退为进
en: Europe Should Step Up By Standing Down

zh: 伦敦—十年以来，欧元是一个巨大的成功。
en: LONDON – Ten years on, the euro is a resounding success.

zh: 作为金融市场上的一支重量级货币，它的表现超过了美元、日元，直到最近也一直在强大的人民币之上，同时以欧元计数的债券交易与美国市场相当。
en: A financial-market heavyweight, it now outperforms the dollar, the yen, and, until recently, the mighty Chinese yuan, while euro-denominated bond trading rivals the US market in size.

zh: 但欧洲应该做得更好。
en: But Europe should be doing better.

zh: 它应该采取更富想象力的举措，以释放更多真正的经济自由度和竞争，停止扶持国家企业，并开始给予欧洲央行更多的支持。
en: It should act with greater imagination to unleash more genuine economic freedom and competition, stop championing national enterprises, and start giving the European Central Bank more support.

zh: 欧元区的政策制定者们也应该在世界关键性的经济俱乐部中发挥更大的作用。
en: Euro-zone policymakers should also seize the initiative in the world’s key economic clubs.

zh: 特别是欧洲经济与货币联盟的成员国更应该放弃它们在G-7和国际货币基金组织的席位。
en: In particular, members of Europe’s economic and monetary union should give up their seats in the G-7 and the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 欧洲货币联盟的每一个成员国都在G-8现身或许还讲得通，但在主要的经济组织中却不然。
en: There may be some justification for each EMU state to be represented in the G-8, but not in the main economic organizations.

zh: 如果它们自愿在这些论坛中统一行动，那么欧洲就能在最高级别的国际经济讨论中为其他重要的国家腾出必要的空间，而此举将会赢得全球政策制定者们的更多尊敬。
en: If they volunteered to act collectively at these forums, Europe would free up much-needed space for other important countries at the top table of world economic discussions, which would foster greater respect for global policymakers.

zh: 从内部而言，衡量欧元区的“成功”的最佳指标是经济增长。
en: Internally, euro-zone “success” can best be measured by the yardstick of economic growth.

zh: 许多评论家援引欧元区各成员国之间经济增长率参差不齐的现象作为失败的佐证。
en: Many commentators cite the wide disparities between euro-zone members’ growth rates as a sign of failure.

zh: 但在许多包括美国在内的其它的单一货币区，也显现出同样的分野现象。
en: But many other single-currency areas, including the US, display similar divergence.

zh: 同样明显的是在没有货币市场作为宣泄经济和金融压力的“阀门”的情况下，经济的不稳定性可能增加。
en: It should also be obvious that, in the absence of currency markets to act as a “valve” for economic and financial pressures, economic volatility may increase.

zh: 实际上，欧元区的领导人们不应该过分关注内部增长的差异而应该更重视整体经济表现欠佳的明显信号。
en: In fact, euro-zone leaders should be less worried about variations in internal growth than about clear evidence of overall economic underperformance.

zh: 尽管自欧洲货币联盟启动以来经济增长较为平稳，但人均GDP—可能是衡量经济成功的最佳指标—却显示欧洲落于其他地区，即便是统计数据由于劳动力规模的原因进行了调整之后依然如此。
en: While growth has been reasonably stable since EMU started, per capita GDP – probably the best measure of economic success available – shows that Europe has lagged other regions, even when the figures are adjusted for workforce size.

zh: 欧洲生产力正在掉队也是众所周知，可能正是同样的原因造成了欧洲在和其它对手相比之下的沉闷、谨慎和缺乏雄心。
en: It is also well known that European productivity is falling behind, too, probably due to the same factors that make Europe seem dull, cautious, and lacking in ambition when compared with many of its competitors.

zh: 在内部竞争的问题上，大多数欧洲国家仍然保持着国家“条框”内的思维方式。
en: When it comes to internal competition policies, most European countries still think within the national “box.”

zh: 为了能让欧元在提升欧洲经济增长和生产力方面发挥应有作用，各国政府必须允许—甚而鼓励—整个欧洲货币联盟区域内更为积极的竞争。
en: For the euro to help lift European growth and productivity in any significant way, governments must allow – indeed, encourage – stronger competitive forces across the EMU area.

zh: 在对外经济政策方面，欧洲的政策制定者们在应对世界经济中正在发生的全局性变化上几乎无所作为—除了抱怨中国的进口商品和俄罗斯进攻性的使用其商品以及最近令人难堪地沉迷于所谓主权财富基金。
en: In terms of external economic policy, European policymakers have done very little in response to the wholesale changes now underway in the world economy – beyond complaining about Chinese imports and Russia’s aggressive use of its commodities, and, most recently, becoming embarrassingly obsessed with so-called Sovereign Wealth Funds.

zh: 作为成功应对了创立欧盟和货币联盟的挑战的各国而言，这样的表现实在差劲。
en: This is a poor showing for countries that successfully confronted the challenges of creating the EU and monetary union.

zh: 在这些划时代的事件所必需的外交斡旋及努力之后，欧洲的政策制定者们应该能够应对IMF、世界银行、G-7和G-8的改革。
en: After all the diplomacy and effort that these epoch-making events required, European policymakers should be able to tackle reform of the IMF, the World Bank, the G-7, and the G-8.

zh: 然而所有这些机构都仍然反映着二战以后的情况，这对当今的世界几乎没有多大意义。
en: Yet all of these institutions still reflect the post-World War II status quo, which serves little purpose in today’s world.

zh: 例如，为什么要有一个像G-7这样的，不包括中国在内的国际经济组织呢？ 中国在2000年就摆出了架势要取代德国成为世界第三大经济体，而它对全球经济活动的贡献几乎与欧元区相当。
en: For example, why is there an international economic organization such as the G-7 without China, which is poised to overtake Germany as the world’s third largest economy and since 2000 has contributed almost as much to global economic activity as the entire euro zone?

zh: 没有中国的切实政策步骤，当今大多数的全球经济问题都几乎无法解决。
en: Most global economic issues today cannot be solved without policy steps in China.

zh: 的确，G-7怎么能够大言不惭地对其体系外的一个国家的货币一次次妄加评论并期望得到积极的回应呢？
en: Indeed, how can the G-7 have the audacity to make repeated public comments about the currency of an outside country and hope for a positive response?

zh: 这几乎就是一场闹剧。
en: It is almost farcical.

zh: 同时，法国、德国和意大利尽管有着共同的货币政策和货币，也都是G-7的成员。
en: Meanwhile, France, Germany, and Italy are all in the G-7, even though they share the same monetary policy and currency.

zh: 如果欧洲央行和欧盟的财政部长们能够在G-7会议之前达成一个共同的立场，并允许由一个共同的会议代表和欧洲央行总裁来阐述他们的统一观点，那么情况会好得多。
en: It would be better if the ECB and the EU finance ministers adopted a common position ahead of G-7 meetings, then allowed their joint view to be represented by a single Council representative and the ECB’s president.

zh: 由于部长们在每次G-7会议前都要碰头，所以这项程序应该很容易引入。
en: Because ministers meet before each G-7 meeting, this would be an easy procedure to introduce.

zh: 的确，今天一个“金融G-6”可能比现在的G-7更有意义，但这种情形可能明天就不复存在。
en: Indeed, a “financial G-6” may today make more sense than the current G-7, but that may no longer hold true tomorrow.

zh: 再过十年，印度可能进���第一层次的经济强国之列。
en: In another 10 years, India may be in the top echelon of economic powers.

zh: 抑或英国也可能加入了欧元区，从而使其独立的角色变成多余。
en: Or Britain might have joined the euro, making its independent role redundant.

zh: 在俄罗斯和巴西仍被排除在外的情况下，加拿大还保得住自己的位置么？
en: Can Canada keep its place while Russia and Brazil are excluded?

zh: 还有哪些蓄势待发的经济强国？
en: And what other economic giants are waiting in the wings?

zh: 诚然，我们需要为重要的国际组织建立一种成员制度从而确保它们的架构是合适的，并确保有足够的灵活性允许成员更替。
en: Clearly, therefore, we need to devise a system of membership for key international organizations that ensures that their structures are relevant but that is also flexible enough to allow members to come and go.

zh: 改革的方式应该是建立一种量化的指南—在马斯特利赫特条约的框架内—来授予G-7的成员资格。
en: One way forward would be to establish numerical guidelines – along the lines of the Maastricht Treaty – for conferring G-7 membership.

zh: 欧洲应该显示出模范的领导力—让世界从其在金融外交方面的深厚经验中获益，并愿意迈出前进的第一步。
en: Europe should lead by example – offering the world the benefit of its deep experience of financial diplomacy and volunteering to take the first steps forward.

zh: 鉴于欧洲已经成功地缔造了欧洲货币联盟 、 《 马斯特利赫特条约》和《稳定与增长协定 》 ， 建立一个确定G-7式成员资格的体系对于欧元区的专家们来说应该相对容易。
en: Given that Europe managed to construct EMU, the Maastricht Treaty, and the stability and growth pact that underlines the euro, it should be relatively easy for euro-zone experts to help devise a system for judging G-7 type membership.

zh: 除非欧洲国家在全球金融制度改革方面发挥积极作用，这项改革将不会成功。
en: Unless European countries take the initiative on global financial institutional reform, it will remain a lost cause.

zh: 欧洲的移民挑战
en: Europe’s Immigration Challenge

zh: 伦敦—欧洲面临着移民困境。
en: LONDON – Europe faces an immigration predicament.

zh: 主流政客囿于“恐外症”党派的要挟，不得不用反移民口号来取悦忧心忡忡的公众，而外国出生的公民则在学校、城市和工作单位日益受到边缘化。
en: Mainstream politicians, held hostage by xenophobic parties, adopt anti-immigrant rhetoric to win over fearful publics, while the foreign-born are increasingly marginalized in schools, cities, and at the workplace.

zh: 然而，尽管欧洲大陆很多国家面临着高失业，大量雇主却找不到他们所需要的员工。
en: Yet, despite high unemployment across much of the continent, too many employers lack the workers they need.

zh: 工程师、医生和护士均存在供给不足，农场工人和健康护理师也是如此。
en: Engineers, doctors, and nurses are in short supply; so, too, are farmhands and health aides.

zh: 欧洲的企业家也总是处于不足的状态，而他们的新思想正是驱动经济和创造就业的动力。
en: And Europe can never have enough entrepreneurs, whose ideas drive economies and create jobs.

zh: 流行的质疑移民的观点并不是一无是处。
en: The prevailing skepticism about immigration is not wholly unfounded.

zh: 许多社区确实被极化了，无怪乎欧洲人会对此忧心不已。
en: Many communities are genuinely polarized, which makes Europeans understandably anxious.

zh: 但把这一现象归咎于移民并不正确，只能让问题扩大化。
en: But to place the blame for this on immigrants is wrong, and exacerbates the problem.

zh: 我们所有人都有责任。
en: We are all at fault.

zh: 我们没有承担起责任来，这使得移民成了一系列与他们不相关问题的替罪羊。
en: By not taking responsibility, we allowed immigration to become the scapegoat for a host of other, unrelated problems.

zh: 全球经济危机、关乎欧洲存亡的政治争论以及新兴势力的崛起所造成的持久的不安全感总是被说成是移民的结果。
en: The enduring insecurity caused by the global economic crisis, Europe’s existential political debates, and the rise of emerging powers is too often expressed in reactions against migrants.

zh: 这样说不仅不公正，还会分散我们的注意力 — — 我们原本应该专注于构想解决真正问题的办法的。
en: Not only is this unjust, but it distracts us from crafting solutions to the real problems.

zh: 欧洲各国最终必须如实承认，与美国、加拿大和澳大利亚一样，它们也是移民国家。
en: European countries must finally and honestly acknowledge that, like the United States, Canada, and Australia, they are lands of immigrants.

zh: 在不少欧洲国家（包括西班牙、英国、德国、荷兰和希腊 ） ， 外国出生居民比重与美国不相上下。
en: The percentage of foreign-born residents in several European countries – including Spain, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, and Greece – is similar to that in the US.

zh: 但尽管如此，我们仍然没有投入足够的投资让新来者融入到我们的学校和工作单位中去。
en: Yet, despite this, we do not make the necessary investments to integrate newcomers into our schools and workplaces.

zh: 我们也没有改革我们的公共机构，让它们变得更包容、更能响应多元化社会。
en: Nor have we done enough to reshape our public institutions to be inclusive and responsive to our diverse societies.

zh: 问题不在于多少新移民被欧盟接受，而在于承认我们生活在其中的社会的性质和组成。
en: The issue is not how many new immigrants are accepted into the European Union, but acknowledging the nature and composition of the societies in which we already live.

zh: 这既讽刺，又危险 — — 欧洲的反移民情绪在全球结构性变迁为移民流带来基础性变化的当口达到了最高峰。
en: It is ironic – and dangerous – that Europe’s anti-immigrant sentiment is peaking just when global structural changes are fundamentally shifting migration flows.

zh: 最重要的转变是新吸引力极（poles of attraction）的出现。
en: The most important transformation is the emergence of new poles of attraction.

zh: 企业家、拥有博士学位的移民以及纯粹为了改善生活的移民正在涌向巴西、南非、印尼、墨西哥、中国和印度。
en: Entrepreneurs, migrants with Ph.Ds, and those simply with a desire to improve their lives are flocking to places like Brazil, South Africa, Indonesia, Mexico, China, and India.

zh: 在未来十年中，移民增长的大头将出现在南方。
en: In the coming decade, most of the growth in migration will take place in the global south.

zh: 西方不再是迦南乐土，欧洲的全球竞争力也将因此蒙上一层阴影。
en: The West is no longer the Promised Land, placing at risk Europe’s ability to compete globally.

zh: 欧洲人口老龄化是历史上从来不曾出现过的现象。
en: The aging of Europe’s population is historically unprecedented.

zh: 工作人口数量将出现大幅下降，到本世纪中叶将减少近三分之一，这将对欧洲的社会模式、城市的存亡、创新和竞争力以及（随着老人越来越依赖年轻人）代际关系产生巨大的影响。
en: The number of workers will decline precipitously, and could shrink by almost one-third by mid-century, with immense consequences for Europe’s social model, the vitality of its cities, its ability to innovate and compete, and for relations among generations as the old become heavily reliant on the young.

zh: 历史表明，欢迎新公民能量和活力的国家最能获得最强的国际竞争力，但欧洲却在反其道而行之 — — 收紧边境线。
en: And, while history suggests that countries that welcome newcomers’ energy and vibrancy compete best internationally, Europe is taking the opposite tack by tightening its borders.

zh: 但欧洲并不是不可救药。
en: But all is not lost.

zh: 欧洲之所以落得如此田地，是拜不作为和短视决策的综合作用所赐。
en: Europe got itself into this situation through a combination of inaction and short-sighted policymaking.

zh: 这意味着欧洲有很大的改善空间。
en: This leaves considerable room for improvement.

zh: 事实上，某些欧洲国家已经出现了希望之光。
en: In fact, there are rays of hope in certain corners of Europe.

zh: 比如瑞典。 瑞典已经修改了移民政策，允许雇主为所需要的移民员工争取身份（该政策包括一项保护措施，优先对待瑞典人和欧盟公民 ） 。
en: Consider Sweden, which has transformed its immigration policy by allowing employers to identify the immigrant workers whom they need (the policy has built-in safeguards to give preference to Swedish and EU citizens).

zh: 在理性时期，这类改革会让欧洲钦羡不已，特别是考虑到瑞典经济在欧洲本来就属于韧性较强的。
en: In more rational times, these reforms would be the envy of Europe, especially given the relative resilience of Sweden’s economy.

zh: 这些政策显然已经引起了澳大利亚和加拿大的注意，它们准备模仿瑞典的做法。
en: They certainly have caught the attention of Australia and Canada, which aim to emulate them.

zh: 在融合移民方面也有不少创新。
en: There have also been innovations in integrating immigrants.

zh: 不少方案（尽管力度不大）鼓励有移民背景者申请警察、消防队、媒体和其他公共部门的职位。
en: Some initiatives, albeit modest, encourage those with immigrant backgrounds to apply for public-sector jobs in police forces, fire departments, media, and elsewhere.

zh: 这些措施也对公共机构的迫切需要有所响应，这些机构与它们所服务的人群看上去颇为相似。
en: Such measures also respond to the urgent need for public institutions that look like the populations they serve.

zh: 还有很多工具可以用来增进融合。
en: There are many other tools to advance integration.

zh: 我们都清楚早期儿童教育的重要性，知道什么样的教育计划可以填补移民儿童和土著儿童之间的差异。
en: We understand well the importance of early childhood education, and what kinds of programs can bridge the gap between immigrant and native children. We know as well the importance of finding a job in the integration process.

zh: 我们也明白融合过程中找到工作的重要性，知道怎样更好地识别移民的技能，知道怎样为他们提供正确的语言培训，知道怎样克服招聘中的歧视。
en: We know how to recognize immigrants’ skills better, and how to provide the right kind of vocational training. We know how to ward off discrimination in hiring.

zh: 但是，尽管我们知道如何做，但如今还需要更多的政治意愿来实行。
en: But, while we know what to do, we now need to muster the political will to do it.

zh: 好消息是，如果我们可以处理好融合问题，就有很大机会���动公众支持更加开放的移民政策。
en: The good news is that, if we get integration right, we will be far more likely to bring publics along on more open immigration policies.

zh: 同样重要的是移民的国际合作问题。
en: Equally important is international cooperation on migration.

zh: 去年阿拉伯革命期间，欧盟坐失一次团结地中海两岸的良机。
en: Last year, during the Arab revolutions, the EU missed a historic opportunity to begin weaving together the two sides of the Mediterranean.

zh: 欧洲没有向年轻学生、企业家和其他北非人敞开大门。
en: It failed to open its doors to young students, entrepreneurs, and other North Africans.

zh: 如今，欧盟正在付出更大的努力包容南面的邻居。
en: Today, the EU is making a more serious effort to engage its southern neighborhood.

zh: 潜在机会包括自由贸易协定、放松大学留学生的签证要求、临时性务工项目以及吸引企业家的激励。
en: Among the potential opportunities are free-trade agreements, an easing of visa requirements for university students, temporary work programs, and incentives to attract entrepreneurs.

zh: 在移民问题上，没有哪个国家可以独善其身，也没有哪个国家可以单枪匹马解决问题。
en: No country is an island when it comes to migration, and none can address it alone.

zh: 我们还有很长的路要走，国际环境也可能在未来多年内不利于移民。
en: We have a long way to go, probably in a climate that will not turn favorable to immigration for many years.

zh: 我们能够取得多少进步取决于我们是否有能够打破关于移民的流言。
en: How much progress we can make will hinge on our ability to break through the myths about migration.

zh: 移民正在发生根本性转变，我们必须鞭策自己设计出适应新现实的制度和方法。
en: Migration is changing in fundamental ways, and we must continue to push ourselves to devise systems and approaches that respond to new realities.

zh: 如果能够成功，人力流动将成为21世纪的优良资产。
en: If we succeed, human mobility can become one of the great assets of the twenty-first century.

zh: 欧洲债务减记不可避免
en: Europe’s Inevitable Haircut

zh: 伯克利 — — “那只不过是希腊危机 ” ， “那只不过是希腊和爱尔兰的危机 ” ， 人们曾经那样以为，可是现在不行了，因为那显然已经是一场欧元区的危机。
en: BERKELEY – What once could be dismissed as simply a Greek crisis, or simply a Greek and Irish crisis, is now clearly a eurozone crisis.

zh: 要对付它，比通常料想的既更容易，又更困难。
en: Resolving that crisis is both easier and more difficult than is commonly supposed.

zh: 这场危机的经济学道理相当简单。
en: The economics is really quite simple.

zh: 希腊的财政有问题。
en: Greece has a budget problem.

zh: 爱尔兰的银行业有问题。
en: Ireland has a banking problem.

zh: 葡萄牙的私债市场有问题。
en: Portugal has a private-debt problem.

zh: 西班牙在上述三方面都有问题。
en: Spain has a combination of all three.

zh: 尽管细节各异，结论是一样的：这几个国家都得经受痛苦的削减开支的过程。
en: But, while the specifics differ, the implications are the same: all must now endure excruciatingly painful spending cuts.

zh: 要抵消紧缩政策的副作用，通常的办法是把国内减支和本币贬值结合起来。
en: The standard way to buffer the effects of austerity is to marry domestic cuts to devaluation of the currency.

zh: 贬值会增强出口竞争力，也就是拿外需来补内需。
en: Devaluation renders exports more competitive, thus substituting external demand for the domestic demand that is being compressed.

zh: 但是，这几个国家都是欧元区国家，它们没有独立的本币可以贬值，所以它们只能用内部贬值来代替外部贬值。
en: But, since none of these countries has a national currency to devalue, they must substitute internal devaluation for external devaluation.

zh: 它们必须削减工资、退休金和其他成本，以增加出口竞争力，达到扩大外需的效果。
en: They have to cut wages, pensions, and other costs in order to achieve the same gain in competitiveness needed to substitute external demand for internal demand.

zh: 其实，这几个危机国家勒紧裤腰带的决心是不小的。
en: The crisis countries have, in fact, shown remarkable resolve in implementing painful cuts.

zh: 但是有一个经济变量并没有随着其他变量的调整而改变，那就是公私部门的债务。
en: But one economic variable has not adjusted with the others: public and private debt.

zh: 政府累积债务的账面价值并未改变，银行债务 — — 除了欠普通债权人（junior creditors）的一些债务以外，也基本没变。
en: The value of inherited government debts remains intact, and, aside from a handful of obligations to so-called junior creditors, bank debts also remain untouched.

zh: 就是这个简单的事实使内部贬值策略陷入自相矛盾的境地：越是削减工资和其他成本，累积债务的负担就相对越重。
en: This simple fact creates a fundamental contradiction for the internal devaluation strategy: the more that countries reduce wages and costs, the heavier their inherited debt loads become.

zh: 债务负担越重，就越是得削减公共开支、增加税收，才能应付政府及其拱卫者（譬如银行）的债务。
en: And, as debt burdens become heavier, public spending must be cut further and taxes increased to service the government’s debt and that of its wards, like the banks.

zh: 这反过来要求更多的内部贬值，进一步推高债务负担，如此恶性循环，把经济拖入萧条的泥潭。
en: This, in turn, creates the need for more internal devaluation, further heightening the debt burden, and so on, in a vicious spiral downward into depression.

zh: 所以，要令内部贬值策略见效，必须想办法降低债务面值。
en: So, if internal devaluation is to work, the value of debts, where they already represent a heavy burden, must be reduced.

zh: 政府债必须进行重组。
en: Government debt must be restructured.

zh: 银行债必须搞债转股，银行资不抵债时则应注销。
en: Bank debts have to be converted into equity and, where banks are insolvent, written off.

zh: 按揭债也必须减记。
en: Mortgage debts, too, must be written down.

zh: 政策制定者不愿意走这条路，这是可以理解的。
en: Policymakers are understandably reluctant to go down this road.

zh: 契约神圣。
en: Contracts are sacrosanct.

zh: 政府担心失信于金融市场。
en: Governments fear that they will lose credibility with financial markets.

zh: 如果债权人主要来自国外，尤其是外国银行，减记只会连累其他国家。
en: Where their obligations are held by foreigners, and by foreign banks in particular, writing them down may only destabilize other countries.

zh: 这些顾虑不能说没有道理，但是不应由此得出不合理的结论。
en: These are reasonable objections, but they should not be allowed to lead to unreasonable conclusions.

zh: 出路只有两条：内部贬值或外部贬值。
en: The alternatives on offer are internal and external devaluation.

zh: 欧洲国家的首脑们必须二选其一。
en: European leaders must choose which one it will be.

zh: 他们一致排除了外部贬值的路子。
en: They are united in ruling out external devaluation.

zh: 但内部贬值必然要求债务重组。
en: But internal devaluation requires debt restructuring.

zh: 否认这一点，既没道理，也不合逻辑。
en: To deny this is both unreasonable and illogical.

zh: 债务重组的操作简单明了。
en: The mechanics of debt restructuring are straightforward.

zh: 政府可以发行一批债权，其面值在现有债务面值上按一定比例打折。
en: Governments can offer a menu of new bonds worth some fraction of the value of their existing obligations.

zh: 债券持有人可以选择，要么坚持按面值兑换手中债券，但到期时间较晚，利率较低；要么接受面值低于现有债券的打折债券，但到期时间较早，利率也高。
en: Bondholders can be given a choice between par bonds with a face value equal to their existing bonds but a longer maturity and lower interest rate, and discount bonds with a shorter maturity and higher interest rate but a face value that is a fraction of existing bonds’ face value.

zh: 这不是什么尖端科技，以前就有人搞过。
en: This is not rocket science. It has been done before.

zh: 但要搞成功，有三个前提。
en: But there are three prerequisites for success.

zh: 第一，要向债券持有人保证新债券的安全。
en: First, bondholders will need to be reassured that their new bonds are secure.

zh: 得有人出来为这批债券担保。
en: Someone has to guarantee that they are adequately collateralized.

zh: 20世纪80年代，根据布雷迪计划实施拉美债务重组时，扮演“担保大哥”的是美国财政部。
en: When Latin American debt was restructured in the 1980’s under the Brady Plan, these “sweeteners” were provided by the United States Treasury.

zh: 如今，国际货币基金和德国政府可以担起这个责任来。
en: This time around, the International Monetary Fund and the German government should fill that role.

zh: 第二，各国必须一致行动。
en: Second, countries must move together.

zh: 否则，一个国家的重组会提高对其他国家的预期，引起传导现象。
en: Otherwise, one country’s restructuring will heighten expectations that others will follow, giving rise to contagion.

zh: 最后，由债务重组而遭受亏损的银行，其资产负债表必须得到巩固。
en: Finally, banks that take losses as a result of these restructurings will need to have their balance sheets reinforced.

zh: 这些银行需要经受真正的压力测试，而不是今年早些时候搞的那种官样文章。
en: The banks need real stress tests, not the official confidence game carried out earlier this year.

zh: 如果债务重组预示着资本金不足，就得对有关银行���务进行全盘的债转股。
en: Where realistic debt-restructuring scenarios indicate capital shortfalls, across-the-board conversion of bank debt into equity will be necessary.

zh: 如果这还不够，就必须由政府出面对有关银行注入资本。
en: And where this does not suffice, banks will need immediate capital injections by their governments.

zh: 这一条同样需要各国一致行动。
en: Again, making this work requires European countries to move together.

zh: 一旦银行的资产负债表巩固了，就有可能重组按揭债、银行债和其他私人部门债务而不至于动摇整个金融系统。
en: And, with banks’ balance sheets having been strengthened, it will be possible to restructure mortgage debts, bank debts, and other private-sector debts without destabilizing financial systems.

zh: 现在来说说最大的难点。
en: Now we get to the hard part.

zh: 所有这一切都需要坚决的领导。
en: All of this requires leadership.

zh: 德国的领导人们必须承认，该国银行在欧元区边缘国家债务上的风险敞口很大，情况危急。
en: German leaders must acknowledge that their country’s banks are dangerously exposed to the debts of the eurozone periphery.

zh: 他们必须让后台老板和选民们相信，动用公共资金为债务重组和银行再注资提供担保是内部贬值策略的必要条件；既然德国敦促其他欧盟国家采取这种策略，它就应该义不容辞地肩负担保的责任。
en: They must convince their constituents that using public money to provide sweeteners for debt restructuring and to recapitalize the banks is essential to the internal devaluation strategy that they insist their neighbors follow.

zh: 一句话，欧洲的领导人，尤其是德国的领导人得把后果说得更严重一点 — — 不这样做就会大难临头。
en: In short, Europe’s leaders – and German leaders above all – must make the case that the alternative is too dire to contemplate.

zh: 因为事实就是如此。
en: Because it is.

zh: 关闭关塔那摩监狱背后的欧洲利益
en: Europe’s Interest in Closing Guantánamo

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 多年以来，欧盟一直高调呼吁要关闭关塔那摩监狱，而今美国总统奥巴马也已下定决心照此办理，对此欧盟则准备好了向美国提供政治和现实上的支持，以确保美方能顺利达到这项目标。
en: BRUSSELS – For years, the European Union has called loudly for the closure of the Guantánamo Bay detention center. Now that US President Barack Obama has taken the decision to do so, the EU stands ready to provide political and practical support to the United States to help achieve that goal.

zh: 对于奥巴马对关塔那摩监狱的评估结论，我们也深有同感，奥巴马指出“关塔那摩监狱已经变成了基地组织借以招募恐怖分子的一个象征。
en: We share President Obama’s assessment that “Guantánamo became a symbol that helped Al Qaeda recruit terrorists to its cause.

zh: 而事实上，关塔那摩监狱的存在似乎制造了比关押在内的囚犯数目更多的恐怖分子。
en: Indeed, the existence of Guantánamo likely created more terrorists around the world than it ever detained.”

zh: ”欧盟对此也相信，我们在防止宗教极端主义和打击恐怖分子招募活动方面的利益，和美国是一致的。
en: We in the EU believe that it is our common interest with the US to prevent radicalization and recruitment to terrorism throughout the world.

zh: 虽然关闭关塔那摩监狱并重新安置其囚犯的首要责任在美国人身上，但欧洲人也希望能从旁给予协助。
en: The primary responsibility for closing Guantánamo and re-settling detainees lies with the US. But Europeans want to help the US turn the page.

zh: 这也解释了下面一些行为：几个欧盟成员国重新接收了那些关押在关塔那摩监狱的本国公民和居留者；法国最近接收一个曾经入狱的阿尔及利亚籍囚犯；而另外几个欧盟成员国正考虑接收那些被排除了恐怖嫌疑，却因为某些不可抗因素而难以回到其所属国的囚犯。
en: That is why EU member states have already received their own nationals and former residents from Guantánamo. That is why France recently received an Algerian ex-detainee.

zh: 至此欧盟人希望美国也能采取同样的行动：如果在欧洲释放这些囚犯是安全的，那么在美国应该也一样。
en: And that is why several other EU countries are now considering receiving ex-detainees cleared for release, but who, for compelling reasons, cannot return to their countries of origin. We in the EU expect the US to do likewise; if it is safe to release these people in Europe, it is safe to do so in the US.

zh: 在更大意义上，我们赞同奥巴马关于“在长远来说我们将 … … 难以维护 … … 自己的安全，除非我们能从自身最基本的价值观上汲取力量 ， ” 而“我们秉承这些最珍视的价值观的原因，并不仅仅是因为这样做是对的，而是由于它能令我们更强大，并维护我们的安全。
en: More generally, we agree with Obama that “in the long run we...cannot keep...safe unless we enlist the power of our most fundamental values,” and that “we uphold our most cherished values not only because doing so is right, but because it strengthens [us] and keeps us safe.”

zh: ”在这方面，欧洲民主国家与恐怖主义威胁长期斗争的经验告诉我们，人权和法治这两项价值观是我们最有力的武器，同时也是恐怖分子殚精竭虑要破坏的东西。
en: The experience of European democracies confronted with a long-term terrorist threat shows that human rights and the rule of law are our strongest assets. That is why terrorists want to destroy them.

zh: 而关闭关塔那摩监狱的行动则要跟彻底的调查相结合，来检讨当年监狱借以设立的相关基本政策。
en: The closure of Guantánamo must be accompanied by a fundamental review of the underlying policies that gave rise to its existence.

zh: 对此奥巴马禁止“刑讯逼供”和秘密关押行为的决定则是在正确方向上迈出的重要一步。
en: Obama’s decisions to ban “enhanced interrogation” and end secret detention are important steps in the right direction.

zh: 但我们依然需要取得更多的改进。
en: But more steps are needed.

zh: 尤其是在缺乏法庭审讯的情况下就胡乱拘留的问题需要得到解决，以防其死灰复燃。
en: In particular, indefinite detention without trial needs to be addressed to avoid the recurrence of problems.

zh: 因此对拘留、审判、押解和审讯等一系列政策的检讨也是异常重要的。
en: Therefore, the review of detention, trial, transfer, and interrogation policies is of utmost importance.

zh: 因为只要有法律的地方，对个人权利的保护就不应该有空白。
en: There must be no gaps in protection, whatever law is applicable.

zh: 而欧盟将与奥巴马政府共同携手，与总统成立的拘留政策专责小组在与反恐相关的国际法原则上进一步交换意见。
en: The EU will take up the Obama administration’s invitation to share its views with his Detention Policy Task Force on international law principles relevant to the fight against terrorism.

zh: 我们希望美国能改变那些所谓“反恐战争”的武断论调并重新思考其在全球范围内与基地组织发生冲突的行为理念。
en: We hope the US will change its “war on terror” paradigm and re-think its conception of a global armed conflict against Al Qaeda.

zh: 但至今没有一个欧盟成员国采取相关的措施。
en: No EU member has taken such an approach.

zh: 与此同时，对于那些在阿富汗或者伊拉克作战中被捕的人员和在战斗之外被捕的恐怖分子，两者是应该区别对待的。
en: There is an obvious difference between persons engaged in an armed conflict, as in Afghanistan and Iraq, and terrorist suspects arrested outside of armed conflict.

zh: 因此一个针对不同个案分别处理的运作方式也是必需的。
en: A case-by-case approach is therefore necessary.

zh: 对于首次有前关塔那摩监狱囚犯在纽约受审的事实我们也表示欢迎。
en: We welcome the fact that the first former Guantánamo detainee is facing criminal charges in New York.

zh: 涉嫌发动马德里和伦敦爆炸案的嫌疑人在纽约普通刑事法庭上被起诉。
en: The perpetrators of the Madrid and London bombings were prosecuted in ordinary criminal trials.

zh: 还有一个策划“9·11”事件的嫌疑人则被送上德国普通法庭的被告席。
en: One plotter in the attack of September 11, 2001, appeared before ordinary courts in Germany.

zh: 许多欧盟成员国的刑法被加强并用以防止恐怖袭击。
en: In many EU member states, criminal law has been strengthened and is being used to prevent attacks.

zh: 而那些恐怖组织成员，包括在别国境内活动，招募��怖分子或者推动恐怖主义行动的人都会被判有罪。
en: Membership of a terrorist organization, including those operating on foreign soil, training and recruiting people for terrorism, and promotion of terrorism have been made criminal offenses.

zh: 而与国际恐怖主义的斗争也催生了一系列重要的法律问题。
en: The fight against international terrorism raises important legal questions.

zh: 我们希望能和美国国务院的法律顾问继续展开建设性的谈话和交流。
en: We are looking forward to continuing our productive dialogue with the US State Department Legal Adviser.

zh: 基地组织的威胁是全球性的，而欧盟和美国将共同致力于维护欧洲和美国的安全。
en: The threat from Al Qaeda is global. The EU and US must work together to make Europe and America safe.

zh: 通过关闭关塔那摩监狱和处理某些基本政策事务，美国正在为美欧双方在反恐以及打击跨国犯罪方面的更紧密合作建立一个建立在人权和法治之上的，更加强大的基础。
en: By closing Guantánamo and addressing the underlying policy issues, the US is creating a much stronger foundation for close EU-US cooperation in counter-terrorism and the fight against international crime, one based on the rule of law and human rights.

zh: 而美欧双方也将联合在全球推广正义、人权和自由方面夺取更有利的形势。
en: Together, the EU and the US will be in a better position jointly to promote justice, human rights and freedom around the world.

zh: 这才是防止极端主义和打击恐怖分子招募活动的行之有效并可持续采用的方法。
en: This has been and remains the most sustainable way of preventing radicalization and recruitment to terrorism.

zh: 由此可见，关闭关塔那摩监狱并不是为赢得欧洲人赞誉而故意做出的一种姿态，而是为了维护美国、欧洲和全世界安全所必需的政策修正。
en: Closing Guantánamo is not a gesture to win applause from Europeans. It is a necessary revision of policy that will make the US, Europe, and the world safer.

zh: 欧洲的最后良机
en: Europe’s Last Best Chance

zh: 发自斯坦福 — — 希腊总理帕潘德里欧和意大利总理贝卢斯科尼的双双辞职凸显出希腊，意大利以及其他许多国家所面临的问题：面对其臃肿公共部门中长期存在的不可持续社会福利补贴，他们是如何久拖不决，乃至酿成苦果的。
en: STANFORD – The resignations of Greek Prime Minister George Papandreou and Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi have highlighted how Greece, Italy, and many other countries obscured for too long their bloated public sectors’ long-standing problems with unsustainable social-welfare benefits.

zh: 事实上对许多这样的国家来说，重大改革已经无从逃避了。
en: Indeed, for many of these countries, meaningful reform has now become unavoidable.

zh: 跟美国，日本以及其他国家一样，欧洲的社会保险体系是依据与当今形势截然不同的经济和人口状况（更快的经济增长，不断增加的人口和更低的期望寿命）设计的。
en: The social-insurance systems in Europe, as in the United States, Japan, and elsewhere, were designed under vastly different economic and demographic circumstances – more rapid economic growth, rising populations, and lower life expectancy – from those prevailing today.

zh: 各国政府（虽然目前焦点都集中在希腊和意大利身上，但它们并不是孤例）对过多的人许下了过多也过久的承诺。
en: Governments (the focus is on Greece and Italy at the moment, but they are not alone) have promised too much, to too many, for too long.

zh: 对此笔者在1986年出版的《过多承诺》一书也指出了美国社会福利系统存在的类似问题。
en: My 1986 book Too Many Promises pointed to the same problem with America’s social-welfare system.

zh: 这些根本性问题如今在这些国家无以为继的债务循环上暴露无疑。
en: This fundamental problem has now manifested itself in these countries’ unsustainable debt dynamics.

zh: 欧元区成员的身份虽然在短期内允许其大量低息借债，但其实是加速了这一问题的恶化。
en: Euro membership, which temporarily enabled massive borrowing at low interest rates, merely aggravated it.

zh: 因此改革整个社会福利系统才是解决欧洲危机的唯一长期对策。
en: Reforming social-welfare benefits is the only permanent solution to Europe’s crisis.

zh: 有人希望在别国政府、欧洲央行，国际货币基金组织和欧洲金融稳定基金的帮助下，主权债务融资的漏洞能够暂时被堵住，而欧洲的银行也能进行资产重组。
en: One hopes that, with the help of national governments, the European Central Bank, the International Monetary Fund, and the European Financial Stability Facility, the holes in the sovereign-debt-funding dike will be temporarily plugged, and that European banks will be recapitalized.

zh: 但这些工作只有在这些经济体实施改革并变得更有竞争力之后才可以进行。
en: But this will work only if structural reforms make these economies far more competitive.

zh: 它们必须同时减轻税负并削减数量庞大的转移支付。
en: They must both lower the tax burden and reduce bloated transfer payments.

zh: 因为相对于那些工作并缴税的人来说，有太多人在领取补贴了。
en: Too many people are collecting benefits relative to those working and paying taxes.

zh: 与此同时，债券市场对财政赤字和债务循环的关注也使得这些国家的借债成本不断上升。
en: Meanwhile, the bond market’s concern over fiscal deficits and debt dynamics is driving these countries’ borrowing costs higher.

zh: 短期和长期的政策也因此紧密地联系了起来；除非临时应急措施能与根本性的长期结构改革相结合，另一个与目前类似（甚至更加恶劣的）灾难将在劫难逃。
en: Short-term and long-term policies are therefore closely related; unless temporary stopgaps are combined with fundamental long-term structural reform, another disaster like the current one – or worse – will become inevitable.

zh: 有三个根本性问题因素将决定一国主权债务的发展状况：经济发展速率；借债成本；以及该国的基本预算状况（除利息支付之外的预算平衡状况 ） 。
en: There are three fundamental factors that determine the evolution of a country’s sovereign debt: its rate of economic growth; its borrowing costs; and its primary budget position (the budget balance net of interest payments).

zh: 一个基本预算平衡的国家将有足够的收入去支付其现有支出（其未偿还的债务支付利息除外 ） 。
en: A country with a balanced primary budget collects enough revenue to pay its current expenses but not the interest on its outstanding debt.

zh: 更高的利率，更低速的增长和更脆弱的基本预算状况都会使得债务比率的曲线不断上升。
en: Higher interest rates, slower growth, and a weaker primary budget position all raise the debt-ratio trajectory.

zh: 例如意大利目前的经济年增长率只有1 % ， 却必须为其主权债务支付7%的年利息。
en: Italy is now paying 7% interest annually on its sovereign debt, while its economy is growing at only 1%.

zh: 于是意大利必须拥有可持续的，巨额的基本预算盈余，更加快速的增长，以及/或者远低于目前水平的借款利率来避免出现债务重组。
en: Thus, Italy needs sustained, large primary surpluses, much faster growth, and/or far lower interest rates to avoid a debt restructuring.

zh: 一个实现基本预算盈余的可靠路径将会降低利率。
en: A credible path to sufficient primary surpluses would lower interest rates.

zh: 长远来说，如果基本预算盈余能通过控制政府支出来实现的话，那么国家储蓄的增加将推动投资和增长，而高税率则会使事情向相反方向发展。
en: In the long run, if primary surpluses are achieved by controlling spending, the increase in national saving will promote investment and growth, whereas higher tax rates would work in the opposite direction.

zh: 二战后在经济合作与发展组织国家中成功实施的财政巩固政策表明：每1美元的税务上升所带来的效应平均需要5~6美元的支出削减来抵消。
en: Successful post-World War II fiscal consolidation in OECD countries averaged $5-$6 in spending cuts per $1 of tax hikes.

zh: 一些专家（比如欧洲央行前主席让-克劳德·特里谢）则认为财政巩固政策可能是扩张性的。
en: Some experts, such as former ECB President Jean-Claude Trichet, argue that fiscal consolidation would be expansionary.

zh: 简而言之，这种手段可以刺激信心，从而降低利率并抵消对需求造成的任何直接影响，正如爱尔兰和丹麦在1980年代的情况那样。
en: Specifically, it would boost confidence, which would lower interest rates and offset any direct effect on demand, as occurred in Ireland and Denmark in the 1980’s.

zh: 但如今这种情况不太可能发生，因为许多国家都同时在推行财政巩固政策，利率也已经很低，而货币联盟则不允许那些问题最严重的欧元区国家 — — 葡萄牙、意大利、爱尔兰，希腊和爱尔兰 — — 用货币贬值的方式来增强竞争力。
en: But that is less likely now, as many countries are undertaking fiscal consolidation simultaneously, non-sovereign interest rates are already low, and monetary union prevents the most troubled countries in the eurozone – Portugal, Italy, Ireland, Greece, and Spain – from devaluing their way to competitiveness.

zh: 为了稳定债务比率并将其逐渐降低到低于GDP60%的安全区域内（意希两国都超过100 % ） ，基本预算大量盈余的状况必须持续许多年。
en: Substantial primary surpluses will be needed for many years in order to stabilize the debt ratio and gradually reduce it to the economic safety zone of less than 60% of GDP (Italy and Greece are over 100%).

zh: 在由欧洲金融稳定基金，国际货币基金组织和欧洲央行所提供的临时紧急措施带来喘息空间的同时，一个可靠的长期改革计划也必须同时启动。
en: A credible long-term program of reforms must be implemented now, while temporary emergency measures – bond purchases by the EFSF, IMF, and the ECB – provide breathing room.

zh: 因为如果基本预算盈余不足的话，临时措施就只不过是推出了必将到来的债务崩溃而已。
en: If the primary surpluses are insufficient, temporary measures will only postpone the inevitable debt debacle.

zh: 在债务困境的核心还有更多的基础演算要做。
en: Even more fundamental arithmetic lies at the core of the debt quandary.

zh: 用以支付社会福利补贴的税率取决于三个因素：依赖比率（补贴享受者与纳税人之比 ） ； 替代率（补贴与平均工资之比 ） ； 经济发展率（大体上是生产力加上人口增长）
en: The tax rate required to fund social-welfare benefits depends on three factors: the dependency ratio (the ratio of recipients to taxpayers); the replacement rate (the ratio of benefits to average wages); and the economic-growth rate (roughly, productivity plus population growth).

zh: 换句话说，政府的补贴越慷慨，覆盖范围越大，所需要的税率就越高。
en: In other words, the more generous and widespread the government benefits, the higher the required tax rate.

zh: 这个核心问题甚至将逐渐影响到目前看似经济强劲且财政稳固的北欧国家。
en: This core problem will increasingly affect even the Northern European countries, notwithstanding their current appearance of economic strength and fiscal soundness.

zh: 在欧洲的高税负经济体中，更自觉的纳税行为或者选择性财政增收手段只能在不削弱增长的情况下获取少量的额外税收收入。
en: In Europe’s highly taxed economies, better tax compliance or selective revenue measures can produce only a small amount of additional tax revenue without undermining growth.

zh: 而支出削减则是大幅改善预算状况的唯一方法。
en: Spending cuts are the only way to improve the budget position significantly.

zh: 但这个过程将较为艰难。
en: But that course will be difficult.

zh: 在许多欧洲国家，领取政府补贴的人数竟占到了总人口的大部分。
en: In many European countries, the government pays benefits to a majority of the population.

zh: 一个关键问题就是即将就任希腊总理的卢卡斯·帕帕季莫斯和他的意大利同行马里奥·蒙蒂 — — 两人都是知名经济学家 — — 是否拥有纵横这些危险海域所需的领导技巧。
en: A key question is whether incoming Greek Prime Minister Lucas Papademos and his new Italian counterpart, Mario Monti, both highly regarded economists, have the leadership skills to navigate these treacherous waters.

zh: 他们的例子将检验其他高补贴欧洲国家是否能遏制住福利国家的过度支付行为。
en: Their examples will test whether other European democracies with heavily benefit-dependent populations can rein in the welfare state’s excesses.

zh: 这并不是一个不可能完成的任务。
en: It is not an impossible challenge.

zh: 例如加拿大就大幅减少了堪称福利国家中最恶劣的过度支付，因为无论是中左翼还是中右翼政府都努力在近年间将政府支出占GDP的比例减少了8 % 。
en: Canada has staged a substantial retreat from the welfare state’s worst excesses, as center-left and center-right governments alike reduced the share of government spending as a proportion of GDP by eight percentage points in recent years.

zh: 已经有数个欧洲在考虑升高其过低的退休年限，其中一些已经付诸实行。
en: Several European countries are considering raising their remarkably low retirement ages, or have already done so.

zh: 考虑到人口发展的趋势，这将是欧洲为其未来繁荣打下坚实基础的最后机会。
en: Given demographic trends, this may well be Europe’s last chance to build a firmer foundation for future prosperity.

zh: 丘吉尔有句关于美国的名言：只有在所有其他方案都被证明无效之后，你才可以确定美国人在做正确的事。
en: Winston Churchill once famously said of America that you can count on it to do the right thing once it has exhausted all other alternatives.

zh: 希望他的名言也可以在欧洲身上应验吧。
en: Let us hope that his dictum proves correct for Europe as well.

zh: 欧洲的休闲陷阱
en: Europe’s Leisure Trap

zh: 在传统上，美国的黑色星期五是感恩节的第二天。 这一天标志着节日季节大减价的开始。
en: Black Friday in the United States traditionally is the day after Thanksgiving that signals the start of the holiday season sale.

zh: 天亮的时候，人们在百货公司前排起长队来抢购“先来先得”降价商品。
en: At daybreak, people line up before department stores to get the special “early bird” bargains.

zh: 在欧洲，黑色星期六是七月份的最后一个周末。 那时，法国和其他欧洲各国的人们成群结队地前往地中海假日目的地，高速公路上都在堵车。
en: In Europe, black Saturday falls in the last weekend of July, when the French and other Europeans set off in droves for their Mediterranean holiday destinations, and highways get jammed with traffic.

zh: 这一比较可以作为大西洋两岸生活方式区别的象征。
en: This contrast could serve as a metaphor for the difference in lifestyles on either side of the Atlantic.

zh: 美国人每周工作时间更长，休假时间更短，但是他们有更多的钱可以花。
en: Americans work more hours per week and have less vacation time, but they have more money to spend.

zh: 不仅美国成年人工作的比例更高，而且他们也每周工作更长，每年工作更多的星期。
en: Not only does a higher percentage of American adults work, but they also work more hours per week and more weeks per year.

zh: 2004年，法国人比美国人人均工作时间少28 ％ ， 德国人和荷兰人少25 ％ ， 而他们挣的钱也就相应比美国人少。 他们的人均收入几乎要比美国人低30 ％ 。
en: In 2004, the French worked 28% fewer hours per person than Americans, and the Germans and Dutch each put in 25% fewer hours, and the money they earned was correspondingly lower—almost 30% less income per person than Americans received.

zh: 麻省理工大学经济学家布兰查德认为，欧洲人比美国人更为享受休闲时光，即使这意味着他们收入更少。
en: According to the MIT economist Olivier Blanchard, Europeans simply enjoy leisure more than Americans do, even if it means that they have less money.

zh: 根据他的观点，这一态度上的差异解释了欧洲和美国之间的收入差距。
en: In his view, this difference in attitude explains the income gap between Europe and the US.

zh: 但是并非所有人都同意布兰查德的观点。
en: But not everybody agrees with Blanchard.

zh: 有些经济学家指出，欧洲的高税率使得工作报酬降低而休闲则更为吸引人。
en: Some economists point out that high tax rates in Europe make work less rewarding – and thus leisure more attractive.

zh: 其他经济学家认为，欧洲强大的工会势力是欧洲人对待工作态度的一项重要决定因素。
en: Other economists see Europe’s powerful labor unions as an important determinant in European attitudes towards work.

zh: 毕竟，雇员们并不单个地谈判工作周的长度。
