en: After all, employees do not negotiate individually the length of the workweek.

zh: 在以往的经济衰退中，欧洲的工会谈判达成了缩短工作时间或者在不减薪的情况下更多的休假时间。
en: During past economic downturns, labor unions in Europe negotiated a reduced workweek or more vacation time with no reduction in wages.

zh: 而且，布兰查德没有注意到喜爱休闲有性别差异。
en: Moreover, Blanchard fails to note that the preference for leisure is not gender-neutral.

zh: 大洋两岸工作时间的差异有一部分可以通过比较欧洲妇女和美国妇女的工作量来解释。
en: The transatlantic difference in hours worked can be explained in part by comparing the labor input of European women to the input of American women.

zh: 美国妇女平均工作36个小时，荷兰是24个小时，而德国则为30小时。
en: While American women work 36 hours per week on average, Dutch women put in only 24 hours per week, while German women work 30 hours.

zh: 法国有工作的妇女每周平均工作34个小时，但是，法国离家工作的妇女的比例比美国要低几乎20 ％ 。
en: French women with a job work on average 34 hours per week, but the percentage of women who work outside the home in France is almost 20% lower than in the US.

zh: 是否欧洲妇女比美国要懒惰呢？
en: Are European females that much lazier than American females?

zh: 答案取决于人们是否考虑欧洲妇女花在家务上的时间。
en: The answer depends on whether one considers the time women in Europe spend on domestic work.

zh: 经济学家切卡特和弗里曼估计，美国妇女花在烧饭、清洁和照看儿童上的时间要比欧洲妇女每周少10小时。
en: The economists Ronald Schettkat and Richard Freeman have calculated that American women spend ten hours per week less on cooking, cleaning, and childcare than European women do.

zh: 美国人并不自己做这些家务，而是花钱让别人来做。
en: Instead of performing these household jobs themselves, Americans pay other people to do them.

zh: 美国更多地在餐馆就餐，大量使用洗衣房、干洗以及购物服务，并且雇佣奶妈来照看婴儿。
en: Americans eat more often in restaurants, make ample use of laundry, dry-cleaning, and shopping services, and hire nannies to take care of young infants.

zh: 确实，美国有各种各样的个人服务，欧洲就没有这样的规模。
en: Indeed, in the US, one finds all kinds of personal services that do not exist on a similar scale in Europe.

zh: 修指甲、洗车或者按摩等服务经常近在咫尺。
en: A manicure, carwash, or a massage is often only a stone’s throw from one’s home.

zh: 有门童的大厦为住户提供全天候的服务，溜狗员在平日照看宠物。
en: Doorman buildings provide round-the-clock service to residents and dog-walkers look after pets during the workday.

zh: 在纽约，人们可以在周末得到帮助来准备下一周的饭菜，烹饪专家给你提供食谱的建议、购买食品杂货，还做一点饭。
en: In New York City, one can get help during the weekends to prepare meals for the coming week, with a culinary expert to advise you on the recipes, buy the groceries, and do part of the cooking.

zh: 换句话说，美国妇女工作时间更长，因为她们上班，她们就用挣来的钱来雇人做那些她们做不了的事情。
en: In other words, American women work more hours and use the money they make to hire people to do the tasks that they can’t do because they’re working.

zh: 相比较而言，欧洲妇女工作时间短，也就没有更多的钱用在服务上。
en: By contrast, European women work less and have less money to spend on services.

zh: 在她们的“自由时间”里，欧洲妇女忙于清扫房屋、照看孩子。
en: In their “free time,” European women are busy cleaning the house and looking after the children.

zh: 因此平均而言，欧洲和美国妇女工作时间大体相当。
en: On balance, therefore, European and American women work about the same amount of hours.

zh: 目前，美国创造的财富比欧洲多。
en: Meanwhile, more wealth is created in the US than in Europe.

zh: 毕竟，女性专业人士并非必需在事业和孩子们之间作出选择，而是可以兼顾。
en: After all, women professionals do not have to choose between a career and children, but can enjoy both.

zh: 美国妇女把额外收入花在家务和个人服务上，美国妇女限制工作量，同时创造了服务性工作的需求，而这些工作在其他情形下就不会存在。
en: By spending part of their extra income on household jobs and personal services, American women limit their workload while creating demand for service jobs that wouldn’t exist otherwise.

zh: 直截了当地说，那就是一箭双雕。
en: To put it inelegantly, two birds are killed with one stone.

zh: 但是在欧洲，根本就没有雕可以射。
en: In Europe, no birds get killed at all.

zh: 受过高等教育、有孩子的欧洲妇女要么留在家里，要么做兼职工作、陷于低水平的工作。
en: Highly educated European women who have children either stay at home or work part-time and get stuck in low-end jobs.

zh: 她们自己料理家务和照看儿童。
en: They take care of the household and children themselves.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲没有足够的服务性工作可以让每个人都就业。
en: Meanwhile, there are not enough service jobs in Europe to put everybody to work.

zh: 失业的社会补助增加了劳动力收入的税负，反过来又阻碍了妇女从事全职工作。
en: The social benefits paid to the out-of-work increase the tax burden on labor income, which in turn discourages women from full-time work.

zh: 因此，这一休闲陷阱让教育程度最高的最低的人都失去了工作。
en: The leisure trap thus keeps both the best educated and the least educated out of the workplace.

zh: 欧洲的经济消耗战
en: Europe’s Economic War of Attrition

zh: 纽波特海滩—我九岁的时候，埃及和以色列打了一场现在被称为“消耗战”的战争。
en: NEWPORT BEACH – I was nine years old when Egypt entered what became known as its “war of attrition” with Israel.

zh: 在这段“非战非和”时期，基本冲突在不断恶化，脆弱的平静不断地被小规模武装冲突打断。
en: During this period of “no war and no peace,” underlying tensions festered, and a fragile tranquility was periodically interrupted by armed skirmishes.

zh: 这场消耗战在1967年6月的战争后开始，埃及显然是战败的一方 — — 乍一看，埃及人民和外部世界一定会对这一结果感到诧异。
en: The war of attrition followed the June 1967 war, in which Egypt – to the immense surprise of most of its citizens and the outside world – was soundly defeated.

zh: 其空军打残，其陆军也保守蹂躏，而以色列占领了整个西奈半岛。
en: Its air force was crippled and its army was virtually overrun, with Israel capturing the entire Sinai Peninsula.

zh: 部署在苏伊士运河东岸的以色列军队距离开罗只有100公里。
en: Positioned on the eastern bank of the Suez Canal, Israel’s army was just over 100 kilometers from Cairo.

zh: 以色列战斗机控制着空域，埃及首都及其大部分人民暴露在以色列轰炸机下。
en: And, with Israeli jet fighters still controlling the airspace, Egypt’s capital and its major population centers were greatly exposed.

zh: 官方说法对此几乎一字不提。
en: The official narrative reflected little of this.

zh: 不管在国家电视台还是在政府控制的报纸上 — — 那时候还没有言论自由、互联网和有线电视新闻 — — 埃及人民看到的是埃及已夺回命运主动权的豪言壮语。
en: Whether on state television or in government-controlled newspapers – at the time, there was no free press, Internet, or cable news – citizens were reassured that Egypt had regained control of its destiny.

zh: 但他们知道的远不止这些。
en: But they knew better.

zh: 我至今仍能清晰地记得埃及人民中间广泛弥漫这的忧虑，人们对未来会如何忧心忡忡。
en: To this day, I remember vividly the sense of general anxiety that prevailed among citizens, accentuated by deep concern about what the future might hold.

zh: 人们不敢投资，很多人在考虑要不要为了更美好的未来而移民。
en: People were afraid to invest, and many wondered whether they should emigrate in search of a better future.

zh: 基本问题还没有解决，消耗战便演变为1973年的全面战争 — — 这场战争再一次震惊了埃及内外的大部分人。
en: With the underlying issues left unaddressed, the war of attrition was followed by another full-scale war in 1973 – one that again surprised most people inside and outside Egypt.

zh: 这一回，埃及陆军赢得了早期一系列战役，并在停火时夺回了西奈半岛的部分领土，为1979年与以色列的和平协议创造了条件。
en: This time, the Egyptian armed forces won a number of early battles and secured a cease-fire that regained part of the Sinai, setting the stage for the 1979 peace agreement with Israel.

zh: 我叙述这些往事不是为了描绘今日巴以冲突图景 — — 几周前，巴以冲突导致众多平民（绝大部分是加沙居民）丧生。
en: I recount this history not to draw a parallel with today’s Israeli-Palestinian conflict, which, just a couple of weeks ago, resulted in many civilian deaths, overwhelmingly in Gaza.

zh: 我叙事这些往事是因为我认为它与欧洲债务危机的发展态势有着太多的相似之处。
en: Rather, it is because I see too many parallels with what is happening in the European debt crisis.

zh: 欧洲人民 — — 特别是希腊、葡萄牙和西班牙等外围经济体的人民 — — 十分焦虑。
en: European citizens – particularly in peripheral economies such as Greece, Portugal, and Spain – are anxious.

zh: 失业率保持在不可接受的高水平，并在继续上升。
en: Unemployment is unacceptably high, and is still rising.

zh: 经济继续萎靡，累积衰退已经创造了悲剧新纪录。
en: Their economies continue to implode, leading to cumulative contractions that are setting tragic new records.

zh: 贫困在抬头。
en: Poverty is on the rise.

zh: 毫不奇怪，向坚挺欧元区国家（比如德国）的移民在增加，并伴随着金融资本的加速外流。
en: Not surprisingly, increased emigration to the stronger eurozone countries (such as Germany) has been accompanied by higher outflows of financial capital.

zh: 不可否认的幸事是，这只是相似，绝不是相同。
en: Admittedly, and fortunately, the parallels are far from perfect.

zh: 欧洲并不存在武装冲突。
en: Europe does not have armed conflicts.

zh: 深深的不安全感与炸弹和防空警报无关。
en: Feelings of intense insecurity are not related to bombs and sirens.

zh: 欧洲的威胁是经济上的，而不是军事上的。
en: The threat is economic rather than military.

zh: 但欧洲确实存在“非战非和”的感觉。
en: Yet there is a real sense of “no peace and no war.”

zh: 欧洲的经济和平仍然晦暗不明，原因很简单：政府仍未找到增长、就业和金融稳定三管齐下的办法。
en: Europe’s economic peace remains elusive for a simple reason: governments have still not found a way to generate the trifecta of growth, employment, and financial stability.

zh: 这一状况维持得越久，相对健康的部门失血就会越多，原因有三。
en: The longer this prevails, the more oxygen is sucked out of sectors that remain relatively healthy – and for three distinct reasons.

zh: 首先，欧元区经济互相之间紧密相连。
en: First, the eurozone economy is extremely interconnected.

zh: 如此，疲软从其中一部分蔓延到其他部分只是时间问题。
en: As such, it is only a matter of time until weakness in one part migrates to other parts.

zh: 以德国为例，该国治理良好，一度自认为不会受周边麻烦的影响。
en: Witness what is happening in Germany, a well-managed country once thought itself immune from the troubles around it.

zh: 在经历了一段时间创纪录的低失业率之后，德国经济增长显著放缓，7—9月季度增长率只有0.2 % 。
en: After a period of record low unemployment, economic growth has slowed markedly, reaching just 0.2% in quarterly terms in July-September.

zh: 若按现有趋势发展，第四季度增长率将为负数。
en: On current trends, the fourth quarter’s growth rate will turn negative.

zh: 其次，欧元区援助规模在继续上升。
en: Second, the eurozone’s bailout bill continues to rise.

zh: 预计塞浦路斯也将加入“计划国 ” （ 希腊、爱尔兰和葡萄牙）行列，要求大规模正式融资；而在上述三国中，只有爱尔兰接近于重新正常进入资本市场。
en: Cyprus is expected to join the other three “program countries” (Greece, Ireland, and Portugal) in requiring considerable official financing; and, of the other three, only Ireland is getting close to regaining normal access to capital markets.

zh: 西班牙也在要求数十亿的新援助以重组其银行，核心国纳税人的或有债券在继续增加。
en: With Spain also requiring billions more to recapitalize its banks, the contingent claims on taxpayers in the core countries continue to mount.

zh: 事实上，这正是穆迪（步标准普尔之后）剥夺法国AAA信用评级的一大因素。
en: Indeed, this is one of the factors that contributed to Moody’s decision – following Standard & Poor’s – to strip France of its AAA credit rating.

zh: 最后，传染病正在冲出欧元区17国范围之外。
en: Finally, adverse contagion is extending beyond the 17 countries in the eurozone.

zh: 欧元区债务危机正在破坏规模更大、拥有27个成员国的欧盟的合作，造成最近峰会上关于欧盟预算方案的大失败。
en: The region’s debt crisis is undermining cooperation within the larger 27-member European Union, resulting in the spectacular failure of the recent summit on the EU budget.

zh: 中国的经济放缓也受此影响，人们开始担心（我认为这有瞎操心之嫌）中国新领导人难以让这个习惯了两位数（或较大一位数）增长的国家实现软着陆。
en: It has also contributed to the economic slowdown in China, raising concerns (which I believe are exaggerated) that the country’s new leadership may have problems engineering a soft landing for an economy accustomed to double-digit (or high single-digit) growth.

zh: 要不是欧洲央行所扮演的关键而分量日重的角色的话，和平的缺乏早已引发全面经济和金融战争了。
en: This lack of peace would have resulted in outright economic and financial war if not for the critical – and growing – role played by the European Central Bank.

zh: 在德拉吉的强力领导下，欧洲央行尽量提供时间让大部分政府能够共同行动。
en: Under the bold leadership of Mario Draghi, the ECB has committed to provide as much time as possible for most governments to get their acts together.

zh: 欧洲央行之所以能如此，靠的是以其弹性资产负债表替代过度扩张的政府、风声鹤唳的私人投资者以及仓皇出逃的银行存款人的创新手段。
en: And it has done so by relying on innovative measures that substitute its elastic balance sheet for those of over-extended governments, gun-shy private investors, and fleeing bank depositors.

zh: 但认为欧洲央行能够带来持续经济和平将是严重的错误。
en: Yet it would be a grave mistake to assume that the ECB can deliver lasting economic peace.

zh: 它无法完成这一点。
en: It cannot.

zh: 如果政府继续萎靡和争吵，欧洲央行行动充其量也只能延长些许时间。
en: If governments continue to dither and bicker, the most that it can do is delay the war for a while.

zh: 与埃及的消耗战一样，欧元区的基本经济、即溶和社会问题在不断发酵。
en: Like Egypt’s war of attrition, the eurozone’s underlying economic, financial, and social ferment continues.

zh: 如果政府继续在一个又一个修补方案之间换来换去 — — 这样的可能性相当高 — — 全面解决方案的迟迟得不到实施将压倒欧洲央行所尽力争取的效果。
en: If governments continue to stumble from one patchwork remedy to another – a probability that remains uncomfortably high – the delay in implementing a comprehensive solution will eventually overwhelm the defenses that the ECB has so courageously put in place.

zh: 有人说，正如埃及消耗战最终演变为全面战争和和平条约，欧洲也需要一场大危机来推动其前进。
en: Some say that, just as Egypt’s war of attrition eventually gave way to a full-scale war and then a peace treaty, Europe needs a major crisis to move forward.

zh: 但这是危险的想法，不仅包含巨大的风险，还隐含着不可接受的高昂过渡性人力成本。
en: But this is a dangerous notion, one that entails not just massive risks, but also unacceptably high interim human costs.

zh: 欧洲各国政府都得到了很好的意见：利用欧洲央行所愿意为他们买来的金融停火。
en: European governments are well advised to use the financial cease-fire that the ECB is willing to buy for them.

zh: 坐视金融停火结束而无法向永久稳定方向取得进展将让欧洲面临灾难，极大地挫伤其长期经济稳定、增长和就业创造前景。
en: Allowing it to expire without progress toward permanent stability would expose Europe to disruptions that would diminish significantly its prospects for long-term economic stability, growth and job creation.

zh: 由市场推动的欧洲一体化
en: Europe’s Market-Led Integration

zh: 发自柏林 — — 两年多以来欧洲已经接连召开了多个峰会，而且每一场在闭幕时都向外界保证遏制欧元区主权债务危机的必要手段“终于”得以推行。
en: BERLIN – For two years now, one European summit after another has ended with assurances that – at long last – the necessary measures for containing the eurozone’s sovereign-debt crisis have been taken.

zh: 大多数峰会都向外界自称为突破性进展，最终却名不副实。
en: Most were publicly portrayed as breakthroughs, though they were nothing of the sort.

zh: 最后竟形成了一个定势：市场一般会在峰会闭幕后的三天后意识到这个骗局，而危机也会随之进入下一个循环。
en: As a rule, it took about three days before markets caught on and the crisis entered another round.

zh: 由于欧洲的政策制定者们无法有效应对这场危机，终结危机的花费也逐渐水涨船高。
en: Because Europe’s political leaders have failed to manage the crisis effectively, the cost of ending it has risen.

zh: 事实上，一场本可以轻易处理的希腊财政危机竟然演化成影响欧盟南部各国生死的紧急事件 — — 甚至动摇了整个欧洲一体化计划。
en: Indeed, an easily manageable financial crisis in Greece was allowed to grow into a life-threatening emergency for the states on the southern periphery of the European Union – and for the European project as a whole.

zh: 其中体现了极为糟糕的治国方略，而大部分的责难都会指向德国总理默克尔。
en: This was statecraft at its worst, for which most of the blame can be laid at German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s door.

zh: 其实在12月布鲁塞尔欧洲峰会之前，欧洲理事会的公信力已经沦落到了极为低下的地步，以至于根本没人会把他们的决策当回事。
en: Indeed, prior to the European summit in Brussels in December, the stock of trust in the European Council had become so depleted that no one seemed to take its decisions seriously.

zh: 当然，或许英国否决峰会里斯本条约修订案的行为压倒了对其他议题的关注，而在欧洲内部意见不合的情况下，公众舆论和金融市场中的不信任也逐渐增加。
en: Of course, it could be that the United Kingdom’s veto of the summit’s proposed changes to the EU’s Lisbon Treaty drowned out all else, while further increasing distrust on the part of the public and financial markets of a divided Europe.

zh: 但讨论欧盟的分裂是愚蠢的。
en: But talk about an EU split is nonsense.

zh: 没有一个英国首相能在不经过国内公投的情况下批准一项旨在建立财政联盟的条约修订 — — 因为这场公投的后果甚至可能导致英国退出欧盟，同时也没有一个头脑清醒的欧洲领导人会有兴趣去干这件事。
en: No British prime minister could consent to a treaty change to create a fiscal union without having to call a referendum at home, the outcome of which would force the UK to withdraw from the EU. And no EU leader in his or her right mind could have any interest in that.

zh: 英国能从终结危机和维护欧元监听方面获取大量好处，反过来欧洲大陆也需要英国留在联盟内部。
en: The UK has every interest in ending the crisis and preserving a strong euro, just as Europeans on the continent need the British inside the EU.

zh: 但这几个月来所发生的事件也逐渐证明，虽然我们必须建立一个为最终实现欧洲财政联盟服务的具有法律效力的基础，但这一切必须以政府间联盟以及（刚刚出现的）欧盟-17国或者17+的名义在里斯本条约的框架之外进行。
en: So it has been clear for months that a legally binding basis for moving toward a European fiscal union, while indispensible, could only take place outside the framework of the Lisbon Treaty, namely on an intergovernmental basis and as an EU-17 or EU-17+, as has just happened.

zh: 此外，那些发出“分裂”警告的人都忽视了一个事实：欧盟以及货币联盟的构建一直以来都是以不同的速度在推进。
en: Moreover, alarmist talk of a “split” overlooks the reality that the EU and the monetary union have long been moving at different speeds.

zh: 在这一情况下，欧盟完全可以不理会英国人投的否决票以及因此而引发的噪声，而卡梅伦很快也会后悔自己成为了所属党派中那些欧洲怀疑论者的人质，更可况这类势力的壮大将极大削弱英国对欧盟的影响力。
en: The British veto, and the hullabaloo that it caused, is thus something that Europe could have done without, and Cameron will soon be sorry that he offered himself up as a hostage to his Euroskeptic backbenchers. Strengthening them will drastically weaken the UK’s influence in the EU.

zh: 而这一切也逐渐成为现实，因为布鲁塞尔峰会已经为在欧盟17+基础上建立财政联盟的打开了缺口。
en: That is all the more true because the Brussels summit flung open the door to a fiscal union for the EU-17+.

zh: 如果一个新协议能在2012年3月订下并在随后几个月得到各国政府批准，那么欧盟就将实现重大跃进 — — 事实上距离真正的政治联盟只有一步之遥，而如果欧盟想要一劳永逸地结束当前这场危机的话，就必定要走出后面那一步。
en: If a new treaty is negotiated by March 2012 and ratified in the following months, the EU will have taken a remarkable step forward – indeed, only one step away from a real political union, which will have to follow if Europe is to end the crisis for good.

zh: 但最近在布鲁塞尔峰会上做出的决策依然信心不足，这不仅源自于缺乏信任或者在英国否决票上的小题大做，还包括对本次危机明显缺乏干涉手段的状况。
en: And yet confidence in the recent decisions taken in Brussels remains low, owing not only to dissipated trust and the fuss about the British veto, but also to the apparent absence of measures to intervene in the current crisis.

zh: 但这其实也是一个错误的理解。
en: But this, too, is a misconception.

zh: 如果浏览一下在布鲁塞尔峰会上所作出的决定，你会立刻发现德国以及其他欧盟富国都得到了他们原先要求的所有稳定机制和保证，也使它们没有理由再拒绝包括恰当的金融保证在内的危机干涉方案。
en: If one reads through the decisions taken in Brussels, one immediately notices that Germany and the EU’s other rich countries received all the stability mechanisms and guarantees that they had previously requested, leaving them no reason to continue to refuse crisis-intervention measures, including appropriate financial guarantees.

zh: 最近召开的布鲁塞尔峰会开启了通往财政联盟之门，其中既包括一个稳定协议还有一个 — — 极端重要的 — — 责任分配协议。
en: The recent summit in Brussels opened the way to a fiscal union, including both a stability pact and – critically important – a liability pact.

zh: 但在德国，这两项协议都未获承认。
en: In Germany, none of this has yet registered at all.

zh: 在短期上，责任分配协议应该由欧洲中央银行来实施，而其独立性也会在柏林再一次被视为神圣不可侵犯，使其变成德国国内政策利益的一块欧洲遮羞布。
en: In the short term, the liability union is to be implemented by the European Central Bank, whose independence will once again be held up as sacred in Berlin, providing a European fig leaf for Germany’s domestic-policy priorities.

zh: 有见及此，默克尔应该感谢卡梅伦在布鲁塞尔的行为分散了大家的注意。
en: From this point of view, Merkel should be grateful to Cameron for the distraction that he created in Brussels.

zh: 那么我们是不是应该感谢某些人帮助欧洲取得了这些进步？
en: And whom do we have to thank for all this European progress?

zh: 我们是否应该感激那些欧洲领导人所表现出来的高超政治智慧，尤其是德国总理默克尔和法国总统萨科齐的“Merkozy”组合？
en: Do we owe it to the wisdom of Europe’s political leaders, particular that of the “Merkozy” odd couple of Merkel and French President Nicolas Sarkozy?

zh: 不幸的是：我们所取得的进步基本上都来自于那个遭万人唾骂的市场所产生的压力。
en: Unfortunately not: progress resulted almost exclusively from the pressure of the much-maligned financial markets.

zh: 正如把意大利前总理贝卢斯科尼赶下台的不是政敌，而是神经过敏的投资者，也正是市场而非欧洲领导人开启了构建欧洲财政和政治联盟的大门。
en: Just as former Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi was brought down not by political opponents, but by jittery investors, it was the markets, not European leaders, that opened the door to European fiscal and political union.

zh: 这并不值得庆祝，相反，它反映了欧洲政治家们在应对欧元区危机（以及监管市场）时缺乏战略眼光和勇气的事实。
en: That is no cause for celebration. On the contrary, it reflects European politicians’ lack of sufficient strategic vision and courage in dealing with the eurozone crisis – and also in regulating the markets.

zh: 欧洲的军事不公
en: Europe’s Military Injustice

zh: 伦敦－对由在必要的时候向需要安全保障的地区派出军队和提供武器装备的费用所引起的财政问题，欧洲各国都觉得非常头痛。
en: LONDON – The cost of sending troops and military hardware around the world to provide security when and where it is needed is causing major financial headaches across Europe.

zh: 事实上，欧洲各国的财政部都面临着将捉襟见肘的国家预算中多大一部分投入到军事上的两难问题；而且，欧洲各国的国防官员还必须在一定程度上保证宝贵的资金被以最有效的方式加以使用。
en: Indeed, Europe’s finance ministries face a dilemma over how much of their stretched national budgets to allocate to the military; and European defense officials must somehow ensure that precious funding is spent in the most efficient manner.

zh: 在英国，这个问题很尖锐，不仅是因为英国当前在阿富汗和伊拉克有驻军，而且还因为欧洲各国为在欧洲安全防卫政策（ESDP）下由北约领导的任务和军事行动提供资金的制度，是不公平的。
en: The problem is acute in Britain, not only because of our current troop deployments in Afghanistan and Iraq, but also because of the unfair systems by which NATO-led missions and military operations under the European Security and Defense Policy (ESDP) are financed.

zh: 在这两种制度下，那些担负采取军事行动责任的国家，也承担了军事行动大部分的经济负担。
en: Under both systems, those who accept responsibility to take military action also take on the lion’s share of the financial burden.

zh: 我们的集体安全联盟对这些不公平的提供资金的方法进行审视，并确保所有的成员国为全球安全提供适当的资金，现在正当其时。
en: It is time our collective security alliances overhauled these inequitable funding methods and made sure that all member states pay a proportionate price for global security.

zh: 英国国防部现在面临着资金危机已经不是什么秘密了。
en: It is no secret that Britain’s Ministry for Defense is facing a funding crisis.

zh: 尽管英国军队自2003年以来参加了两次重大的军事行动，但是，英国的国防开支只占GDP的2.3 % — —这一比例是20世纪30年代以来最低的。
en: Despite British forces having been engaged in two major military operations since 2003, defense spending represents only 2.3% of GDP – the lowest since the 1930’s.

zh: 英国国防开支作为政府全部开支的一部分，已经从1998年占全部政府开支的7.8%下降到2006年的6.1 % 。
en: As a share of total government spending, defense expenditure has fallen from 7.8% in 1998 to 6.1% in 2006.

zh: 由于在伊拉克和阿富汗持续的军事行动，现在的英国政府会给将来的英国政府留下一支资金困难、人员不足并且装备陈旧的军队。
en: Owing to the ongoing operations in Iraq and Afghanistan, any future British government will inherit a military that is overstretched, undermanned, and working with worn-out equipment.

zh: 与此有关的资金缺口共达几十亿英镑。
en: The unfunded liability associated with this will total billions of pounds.

zh: 在北约和欧洲安全防卫政策（ESDP）内进行更好的军事和经济负担分担，不仅会使英国受益，而且有助于减轻欧洲其他国家国防预算上的某些压力。
en: Better military and financial burden-sharing within both NATO and the ESDP would not only benefit the United Kingdom, but would also help to alleviate some of the pressure on other national defense budgets in Europe.

zh: 我们必须充分利用我们的有组织安全结构，确保全球安全责任被以公平和适当的方式加以分担。
en: We must take full advantage of our organized security structures to ensure that the global security burden is shared in a fair and proportionate manner.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，用公平和适当的方式分担全球安全责任的事情还没有发生过。
en: To date, this has not happened.

zh: 为了使北约能够顺利工作，北约成员国不仅要为北约领导的军事行动做好提供军队和装备的准备，还必须为这些行动提供资金和支持，直到行动结束。
en: For NATO to work properly, its members must be prepared not only to supply troops and equipment for NATO-led military operations, but also to fund and sustain these operations until missions are completed.

zh: 然而，现在有些北约成员国却在参加战斗、提供资金和做出牺牲方面，承担了数量非常不均衡的责任。
en: Instead, certain members now do a disproportionate amount of the fighting, funding, and dying.

zh: 这是不可持续的。
en: This is not sustainable.

zh: 所有的北约成员国都必须明白，北约成员资格带来了确保其军队具有在现代战场上战斗并取胜的能力的明示和默示的义务。
en: All NATO countries must understand that membership brings implicit and explicit responsibilities to ensure that their military forces have the capability to fight and win on the modern-day battlefield.

zh: 各北约成员国还必须认识到为联盟行动建立更坚实的财务制度的必要性。
en: They must recognize the need to create a sounder financial system for alliance operations.

zh: 当前，北约各成员国对某些共同开支，例如指挥部的开支，按照其GDP一定的比例共同提供资金。
en: There is currently common funding for certain shared costs, such as headquarters, with contributions linked to the member states’ GDPs.

zh: 但是，北约成员国共同提供资金的数量只是一次军事行动总开支的一小部分。
en: But the amounts covered by common funding are only a small part of an operation’s total cost.

zh: 所有其他的费用都是“自行承担 ” ： 一个国家为军事行动派出的军队和提供的装备越多，它最后的支出就越多。
en: All other expenses “lie where they fall”: the more troops and equipment a country contributes to a mission, the more it ends up paying.

zh: 例如，英国为北约在阿富汗的行动派出人员和提供装备的支出达到31亿英镑 — — 这对英国纳税人来说是一个沉重的负担。
en: The cost to the UK for its contribution to the NATO operation in Afghanistan, for example, totals £3.1 billion – a heavy burden on British taxpayers.

zh: 由于现代军事行动的远征性质，这样的责任分担制度是一个时代错误。
en: Because of the expeditionary nature of today’s military operations, that system is an anachronism.

zh: 然而，修正这个问题说起来容易做起来难。
en: Yet fixing the problem is easier said than done.

zh: 北约几年来一直在努力使其成员国将要求的GDP的2%作为国防开支，但是没有成功。
en: NATO has been trying for years – without success – to get its member states to spend the required 2% of GDP on defense.

zh: 如果所有的北约成员国都遵守这一要求，就意味着联盟内的国防开支会增加大约670亿美元，这约等于增加一个英国或法国的国防预算 — — 这样做不是万能的，但是，仍然十分有用。
en: Compliance would mean an estimated $67 billion increase in Alliance-wide defense spending, or roughly the equivalent of adding another British or French defense budget – no panacea, but very helpful nonetheless.

zh: 去年四月份，英国反对党保守党领袖大卫·卡梅隆（David Cameron）说明了为什么我们应该为北约的远征任务建立一个真正的行动基金，并且所有的成员都要为这个基金提供资金。
en: Last April, the leader of the UK’s opposition Conservative Party, David Cameron, explained why we should establish a real operational fund for NATO expeditionary missions, with every member state required to contribute.

zh: 这样做可以减轻那些当前承担过多责任的国家的一些负担。
en: Doing so would provide some reimbursement to countries that currently carry an unduly large part of the burden.

zh: 这也可以为那些可能部署军队，但是在军事行动所需开支上面临短期财政困难的国家提供潜在的资金。
en: It would also offer potential funding to countries that might deploy forces but face short-term financial difficulties in meeting the cost.

zh: 这一新北约行动基金显然比现在的制度更加公平，现在的制度对积极承担军事责任的成员国不利，却鼓励了那些宁愿什么也不做的成员国。
en: The new NATO operational fund would clearly be more equitable than today’s system, which penalizes proactive member states and rewards members that prefer to do nothing.

zh: 为什么少数几个国家应该承担这么多的责任？
en: Why should the few carry the many?

zh: 共同安全意味着共同承担责任。
en: Common security implies common commitment.

zh: 而且，仅仅解决北约的负担分担问题还不够。
en: Moreover, solving NATO’s burden-sharing problem is not enough.

zh: 欧盟的危机管理任务在涉及军队时面临着同样的问题。
en: The European Union’s crisis management missions face similar issues when military forces are involved.

zh: 欧盟的民事危机管理直接由共同外交和安全政策预算提供资金。
en: EU civilian crisis management is funded directly from the Common Foreign and Security Policy budget.

zh: 但是，除了军事行动的共同开支（通常不到总费用的8 % ） 之外，欧洲安全防卫政策（ESDP）使用和北约同样的筹资方法，这意味着欧洲安全防卫政策（ESDP）和北约领导的军事行动的大部分资金，都���自成员国的国防资金。
en: But, apart from the common costs of an operation (usually less than 8% of the total), the ESDP uses the same funding method as NATO, which means that the bulk of the money for both ESDP and NATO-led military operations comes out of the same defense pot in each member state.

zh: 所以，在修正一个筹资机制的时候不修正另一个筹资提供机制，是没有道理的。
en: So there is no point in fixing one funding mechanism without simultaneously fixing the other.

zh: 有趣的是，法国总统对改革所谓的雅典娜机制 — — 这一机制是用来确定每个欧盟成员国对军事任务共同开支的应付份额的方法，有一些讨论。
en: Interestingly, there was some discussion under the French presidency about reforming the so-called Athena Mechanism, which is the means used to determine the amount that each EU member state contributes to the common costs of a mission.

zh: 和北约共同基金一样，欧盟成员国提供资金的份额主要是根据GDP确定的。
en: Like the NATO common fund, EU contributions are largely based on GDP.

zh: 法国也呼吁“费用自行承担”的观念应该在财政共同责任的名义下加以抛弃。
en: The French also called for the “costs lie where they fall” concept to be abandoned in the name of financial solidarity.

zh: 对雅典娜机制进行的任何改变都必须包含对其规则和程序进行的改革。
en: Any change made to the Athena Mechanism must include reforms to its rules and procedures.

zh: 当前，在雅典娜特别委员会确定行动预算时，北约成员国中为军事行动派出军队的非欧盟成员国，不能进行投票 — — 甚至不能出现在投票现场 — — 即使它们的军队要参加战斗，并且可能会有人员伤亡。
en: Currently, non-EU members of NATO that contribute troops to an operation cannot vote – or even be present at votes – when the Athena Special Committee sets the mission budget, even though their troops will fight and possibly die.

zh: 这样做是歧视性的、不民主的，而且对像挪威和土耳其这样重要的盟友是行不通的。
en: This is discriminatory, undemocratic, and no way to treat important allies like Norway and Turkey.

zh: 集体安全联盟是 — — 集体的。
en: Collective security alliances are just that – collective.

zh: 现在是每个人都要为共同利益承担公平责任的时候了。
en: It is time that everyone contributed their fair share to the common good.

zh: 欧洲误入歧途的“增长悲观主义者”
en: Europe’s Misguided “Growth Pessimists”

zh: 欧洲对于经济深度悲观主义就是今天经济形势越好，那么人们就会认为它明天就会变得越糟糕。
en: Such is the deep pessimism in Europe about the economy that the better the economy does today, the worse people think it will do tomorrow.

zh: 今年欧洲的经济增长良好。
en: This year has been an excellent one for Europe’s economic growth.

zh: 但是欧洲悲观的经济学家们不是认为2006年所建立起来的这种势头将会延续下去而2007年经济形势会更好，反而预言经济将会出现明显的下滑。
en: Yet instead of thinking that the momentum building in 2006 will carry forward and make 2007 an even better year, Europe’s gloomy experts are predicting a significant slowdown.

zh: 对于他们来说，欧洲根本不可能有连续两个好的年景。
en: For them, it seems out of the question that Europe can have two good years in a row.

zh: 当然，每一年要取得增长都会面临很多的挑战，2007年也不例外。
en: Of course, every year has its growth challenges, and 2007 will be no exception.

zh: 而尤其让增长悲观主义者产生这种论调，或者让他们感到恐惧的是（1）欧洲更高的利率 ， （ 2）增长放缓的美国经济，以及（3）德国的增值税从明年开始将从16%调高到19 % 。
en: What motivates – or frightens – the growth pessimists, in particular, are (1) higher European interest rates, (2) the slowing US economy, and (3) the increase in the German value-added tax (VAT) from 16% to 19% set for the beginning of the year.

zh: 但是他们根本不应该对这些因素所吓倒。
en: But they are wrong to be frightened by these factors.

zh: 对于欧洲央行2006年度加息的担忧出自对于实际利率和名义利率的混淆。
en: Fear over the growth effects of the European Central Bank’s 2006 rate increases is based on confusion between real and nominal interest rates.

zh: 到今年年底，欧洲的利率将会提高150个基点（从一月份的2%提高到3.5 % ） 。
en: By the end of the year, European interest rates will have been raised 150 basis points (to 3.5%, from 2% in January).

zh: 但是欧洲的通货膨胀率也以大约同样的比率在增长着。
en: But European inflation is growing at approximately the same rate.

zh: 这就是说实际的利率，也就是依照货物和服务来衡量的利率并没有变化。
en: This means that real interest rates – interest rates measured in terms of goods and services – have stayed the same.

zh: 而影响经济增长的是实际的利率而不是货币的利率。
en: And it is the real interest rate – not the money rate – that counts for economic growth.

zh: 欧洲必须自问：尽管2006年经济良好并没有导致实际利率产生变化，那么利率又怎么会导致2007年的衰退呢？
en: Europe must ask itself: how can interest rates induce a slowdown in 2007 when real interest rates have hardly budged despite an economically healthy 2006?

zh: 还有，因为欧洲的收益很高，那么为了保证物价稳定而有可能会在将来提高的实际利率只会带来更大的收益而不会引起经济的震荡。
en: Moreover, because profits are high in Europe, likely future increases in real interest rates needed to ensure price stability easily can be financed out of profits without economic disruption.

zh: 真实的情况是欧洲的利率，无论是名义上的还是实际上的都是太 低 了，而不是太高了。
en: The truth of the matter is that interest rates – both nominal and real – are too low in Europe, not too high.

zh: 至于美国，油价暴跌，在大约一个月的时间里跌去了惊人的25 % ， 在消费者本来被预计会因为房地产市场的回落而使他们的信心和支出都全面下降的时候却反而增加了他们的信心和支出。
en: As for the United States, plummeting gas prices – an extraordinary 25% decline in roughly one month – have increased consumer confidence and spending at a time when consumers were supposed to be in full retreat because of the housing market decline.

zh: 此外，美联储前主席格林斯潘认为房地产市场的回落已经基本上结束了。
en: Moreover, former Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan says the housing market correction is already almost over.

zh: 悲观的欧洲人已经严重落后于形势了。
en: Pessimistic Europeans are behind the curve.

zh: 他们坚持认为美国经济在2007年增速会放缓，但是其实这种增速放缓已经发生了而它对美国经济和欧洲经济都影响甚微。
en: They are bracing for a 2007 US growth slowdown that already has taken place with little consequence for both the US and European economies.

zh: 当然，欧洲的油价同样也下跌了，而这会帮助减轻因为德国总理默克尔所推动的颇受争议的增加增值税所带来的刺痛。
en: Of course, falling gas prices are occurring in Europe as well, and this will help take the sting out of the controversial VAT increase engineered by German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

zh: 德国总理是很幸运的。
en: The German Chancellor has been lucky.

zh: 油价下跌和德国的高收益会推动税收的增长，从而使得这一政策的调整最终只是成为德国经济一个小小的障碍，至少如果低廉的油价能持续到明年的话。
en: The falling gas price and Germany’s high profits will “finance” the tax increase, which should prove little more than a speed bump for the German economy, at least if lower gas prices hold into the coming year.

zh: 事实上，德国政府慢慢地也认识到它对经济的悲观是不正确的，这表现在他们对2006年经济增长的预期不断的“往上调整 ” 。
en: Indeed, the German government is slowly coming to realize that its pessimism about the economy has been misplaced, which is reflected in continuous “upward revisions” of growth forecasts throughout 2006.

zh: 最近，政府把它对今年和明年的经济增长预期分别从1.6%调到了2.3 % ， 以及从1%调到了1.4 % 。
en: Recently, the government raised its growth forecasts for this year and next, from 1.6% to 2.3% for 2006, and from 1% to 1.4% for 2007.

zh: 我想随着政府面对经济强劲的上升势头，他们还会对经济增长预期继续往上调整。
en: Expect further upward revisions as the government continues to be surprised by the economy’s ongoing strength.

zh: 欧洲良好的增长势头所带来的一个重要的副产品就是使得对于结构改革的要求变得越来越急迫起来。
en: An important by-product of Europe’s good growth is that it is making the need for structural reform an urgent matter.

zh: 欧洲劳工市场、竞争规则以及其他方面因为没有进行结构改革而使得欧洲潜在的经济增长，即它的增长顶点将会比应有的水平要低。
en: The lack of structural reform of Europe’s labor markets, competitive practices, and so on means that European potential economic growth – its growth ceiling – is lower than it should be.

zh: 如果经济增长的顶点不高的话，那么强劲的经济表现会在增长过程中的一个相对较早的时期就带来通货膨胀的压力。
en: With a low growth ceiling, strong economic performance generates inflationary pressures at a relatively early stage in the growth process.

zh: 这将会使欧洲很难享受到一段很长的没有通货膨胀的高增长时期。
en: This makes it hard for Europe to enjoy an extended period of high growth without inflation.

zh: 过早的通货膨胀压力正是欧洲央行的前任主席伊森贝赫和现任主席特里谢在他们的记者招待会和演讲中不断敦促进行结构改革的主要原因。
en: Premature inflationary pressures are a prime reason that both ECB presidents, the late Wim Duisenberg and now Jean-Claude Trichet, have consistently pressed for structural reform in their press conferences and speeches.

zh: 无论如何，需要与由于欧洲没有进行结构改革而导致的通货膨胀作斗争的是欧洲央行。
en: It is the ECB, after all, that must fight the inflation caused by Europe’s lack of structural reform.

zh: 增长悲观主义者如果对于欧洲进行结构改革以提高经济增长的最终幅度的前景表示担忧，则是不无道理德。
en: Growth pessimists have a point if they are wary about Europe’s prospects for structural reform to raise the growth ceiling.

zh: 欧洲的政治家们总是拒绝带头来进行这件十分重要的事情。
en: Europe’s politicians simply refuse to take the lead on this all-important issue.

zh: 然而，他们对于欧洲将达到它被限制了的增长潜力的预期是错误的。
en: They are wrong, however, about Europe’s prospects for achieving its restricted growth potential.

zh: 欧洲实际的经济增长是非常出色的，这归功于低廉的油价、很低的实际利率、坚实的收益和强劲的增长势头，并且在增长顶点到来以及通货膨胀压力显现之前还会一直很好地保持下去。
en: Europe’s actual economic growth has been quite good and – thanks to low gas prices, low real interest rates, solid profits, and strong growth momentum – promises to get better before the ceiling is hit and inflationary pressures set in.

zh: 就把我称作一个“增加乐观主义者”吧，但是欧洲看上去真的很可能在2007年迎来又一个良好增长的年份。
en: Call me a “growth optimist”, but Europe looks poised for another good growth year in 2007.

zh: 地方主义的欧洲
en: Provincial Europe

zh: 柏林—多任务并不是欧洲当前一代领导人的优势所在。
en: BERLIN – Multitasking is not exactly the strong point of Europe’s current generation of leaders.

zh: 他们正确地给予了欧元区危机 — — 欧元区未来最核心的问题 — — 最高的优先级。
en: They have rightly given the eurozone crisis – the central question bearing on the European Union’s future – top priority.

zh: 但所有其他重要问题 — — 其中又以共同外交和安全政策为最 — — 几乎被完全忽视了。
en: But all other important issues – above all, a common foreign and security policy – have been almost completely ignored.

zh: 而在这一问题上 — — 欧洲的对外关系，对所有欧盟公民的未来来说，这绝对是关键性的问题 — — 重新国家化的阴影再次抬头了。
en: And it is here – Europe’s external relations, an issue absolutely vital to the future of all EU citizens – that renationalization is rearing its ugly head again.

zh: 如今，我们可以勾勒出后美国时代国际秩序的大致轮廓 — — 不仅包括新的结构，也包括其中的风险、威胁和冲突，没有一项容易解决。
en: Today, we can recognize the outlines of a post-American international (dis)order – not only its emerging structures, but also its risks, threats, and conflicts, all of which are intensifying.

zh: 对欧洲 — — 以及对世界其他地区 — — 来说，金融危机只不过是深远变革的加速器而已。
en: For Europe – and for the rest of the world – the financial crisis has proven to be an accelerant of far-reaching changes.

zh: 在东亚，世界最有活力、也是未来全球经济发展的主导地区，主要势力 — — 中国、日本、韩国和中国台湾 — — 关于边界问题、领土主张、声望和未解决历史遗留问题的冲突已呈爆发之势。
en: In East Asia, the world’s most dynamic and dominant region in terms of future global economic development, confrontation is escalating between the key powers – China, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan – over border issues, territorial claims, prestige, and unfinished historical business.

zh: 在此之上还有维持了多年的朝鲜半岛和台湾冲突，随时随地都可能再度爆发。
en: Add to this the perennial crisis on the Korean peninsula and the Taiwan conflict, which could flare up again anytime.

zh: 东亚的地区势力之间几乎无多边框架可言，其状态就像是19世纪末的欧洲。
en: East Asia’s regional powers operate almost without any multilateral framework, a state of affairs comparable to that of Europe toward the end of the nineteenth century.

zh: 幸好有美国的军事和政治部署保证着地区稳定。
en: Only the United States’s military and political presence ensures regional stability.

zh: 但是，至少是在中期，这样的部署隐含着引发中美之间全球冲突的大风险。
en: Yet, at least in the medium term, that presence implies a significant risk of inciting a global confrontation between China and the US.

zh: 此外，俄罗斯 — — 它正在向东亚扩大影响，但囿于其经济和政治弱势，一直只是二流东亚势力 — — 肯定也会寻求在如此发展态势中获利。
en: Moreover, Russia – which extends to East Asia, but, owing to its economic and political weakness, has been a background player there – would certainly seek to benefit from this development.

zh: 但欧洲不会在东亚有任何动静，因为任何这方面的努力都会对其影响范围和资源形成重大约束力。
en: Europe, however, will play no part in the region, simply because any attempt to do so would place too much strain on its reach and resources.

zh: 但是，由于欧洲对东亚的经济依赖意见严重，其在东亚的利益也极其巨大，从中期看，这一不匹配状况可能引起欧盟严重的不安。
en: Yet, given Europe’s growing economic dependence on East Asia, its interests are massively engaged – a mismatch that could cause the EU considerable discomfort in the medium term.

zh: 从各种角度看，欧洲于南亚的关系也是类似的；但在南亚，印度-巴基斯坦冲突、从2014年开始的“后美国”时代阿富汗以及伊朗和波斯湾局势的不确定性将对欧盟安全形成直接威胁。
en: The same is true, to varying degrees, of Europe’s relationship with South Asia; but here the India-Pakistan conflict, a looming “post-American” Afghanistan in 2014, and uncertainty concerning Iran and the Persian Gulf have a direct security impact on the EU.

zh: 在南亚，不安与危险交织在一起。
en: This is where discomfort meets danger.

zh: 在第三度出任总统的普京的领导下，俄罗斯���经做出了选择。
en: Russia, under Vladimir Putin’s third presidency, has made its choice.

zh: 由于“欧亚联盟”的阻挠，以及将原油和天然气的重新国有化同时作为胡萝卜和大棒，克里姆林宫希望尽可能团结更多的前苏联加盟国。
en: Under the banner of a “Eurasian Union,” and relying on the renationalized oil and gas sectors as both a carrot and a stick, the Kremlin wants to tie as many of the former Soviet territories as possible to the Motherland.

zh: 这一政策的核心目标是乌克兰，它也是后苏联欧洲秩序的关键所在。
en: At the center of this policy is Ukraine, the linchpin of Europe’s post-Soviet order.

zh: 但普京陷入了根本性冲突之中。
en: Yet Putin is caught in a fundamental contradiction.

zh: 他的大俄罗斯政策需要经济强势，从而要求国家成功地实现现代化。
en: His Great Russia policy requires economic strength, and therefore successful modernization of the country.

zh: 但是，为了达到这一目标，他必须鼓励能产生强大中产阶级的改革，而正如俄罗斯大城市所显示的，中产阶级反对普京的侍从主义“有指导的民主”以及与之相伴而生的大规模腐败。
en: But, to achieve this, he must encourage reforms that would lead to a strong middle class, which, as can already be seen in Russia’s big cities, opposes Putin’s clientilist “guided democracy” and the massive corruption that comes with it.

zh: 普京的困局代表了欧盟和美国的真正挑战，但也是机会，如果它们选择长期大规模介入的话。
en: Putin’s dilemma poses a real challenge for the EU and the US – but also an opportunity, if they choose significant long-term engagement.

zh: 不过，大西洋两岸似乎都犯了忽略这一问题的错误。
en: On both sides of the Atlantic, however, ignoring the issue seems to have been mistaken for a policy.

zh: 这是一个后果严重的疏漏，因为，显然，俄罗斯外交政策已经做出了挑衅性、冲突性的转变。
en: That is a grave oversight, for it is clear that Russian foreign policy has again taken a provocative and confrontational turn.

zh: 俄罗斯依然是叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德的坚定支持者，并且不惜与土耳其产生冲突，或在事实上和伊朗结盟，以捍卫巴沙尔政权。
en: Russia remains a steadfast supporter of Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, and is not shying away from conflict with Turkey, or from forging a de facto alliance with Iran, in order to defend the Assad regime.

zh: 与伊朗核计划头上的战争阴云、失败的以色列-巴勒斯坦和平京城以及大中东彻底的政治变革一道，叙利亚冲突表明，东南方向将依然是欧洲的主要安全挑战。 但是，尽管俄罗斯野心勃勃意欲改造其邻邦，而美国在中东地区的介入越来越小，欧洲却并没有做好行动准备。
en: Together with the war clouds hovering over the Iranian nuclear program, the failed Israeli-Palestinian peace process, and radical political change throughout the wider Middle East, the conflict in Syria shows that Europe’s southeast will continue to be a major security challenge.  Yet, despite Russia’s ambitions for reshaping its neighborhood – and despite decreasing US involvement in the Middle East – Europe is hardly prepared to act.

zh: 显然，土耳其和欧盟的关系需要自我“重置 ” 。
en: Clearly, the relationship between Turkey and the EU needs its own “reset.”

zh: 否则的话，双方会发现自己都是输家。
en: Otherwise, both sides will find themselves among the losers.

zh: 土耳其正在挑战其能力极限，而欧盟发现，对它来说，在这一地区土耳其是不可缺少的。
en: Turkey is currently confronting the limits of its possibilities, while the EU finds that it can do very little in this region without Turkey.

zh: 此外，在欧洲的南方近邻，即地中海地区，新风险正在北非和撒哈拉地区迅猛崛起，包括基地组织对马里北部的威胁。
en: And, to Europe’s immediate south, across the Mediterranean, new risks are emerging in the vastness of North Africa and the Sahara, including the threat of an Al Qaeda state in northern Mali.

zh: 如果你在这幅全球发展态势图上在加上一个事实，即不论美国大选结果如何，美国都会将其战略焦点移向东亚（或换句话说，移向看好自己 ） ， 则几乎所有事务都要求稳健的欧盟外交和安全政策。
en: If one adds to this European sketch of global development the fact that, whatever the outcome of the US election, America will shift its strategic focus to East Asia (and otherwise mainly look after itself), nearly everything cries out for a robust EU foreign and security policy.

zh: 不幸的是，目前的方向与此南辕北辙：在欧洲各族人民和决策者中间，重新国家话才是压倒性的优势观点。
en: Unfortunately, exactly the opposite is happening: here, too, renationalization is uppermost in the minds of Europe’s peoples and decision-makers.

zh: 在柏林，越来越多的人提出这样一个问题 ： “ 这对德国来说意味着什么？ ”而不问“这对欧洲来说意味着什么？
en: In Berlin, the question asked more and more often is, “What does this mean for Germany?” rather than, “What does this mean for Europe?”

zh: ”其他欧洲国家也是如此。
en: The same is true in other European capitals.

zh: 但错误的问题导致错误的答案，因为欧洲安全利益只有在欧洲和西方环境下才能解决，在国家层面上是解决不了的。
en: But the wrong question leads to wrong answers, because Europe’s security interests can be defended only within a European and Western context, not at the national level.

zh: 这就是为什么现在欧洲必须抛弃其地方主义，实施名副其实的共同外交政策，并最终合理地为其未来安全投资。
en: That is why it is high time for Europeans to abandon their provincialism, launch a common foreign policy worthy of the name, and finally start to invest properly in their future security.

zh: 欧洲必须成熟起来，开发捍卫自身利益的能力，因为形势变化太快，其他人早已不像从前那样愿意替我们完成这个任务了。
en: Europe must grow up and develop the capacity to defend its own interests, because the day is fast approaching when others will be less able and willing to do this for us than they once were.

zh: 欧洲作决定的时刻
en: Europe’s Moment of Decision

zh: 遗忘症是政治不可分割的一部分吗？
en: BRUSSELS -- Is amnesia an integral part of politics?

zh: 在有关将于11月份最终签订的改革欧盟机构的条约的问题上，最近的事态表明遗忘症确实扮演了一个中心的角色。
en: When it comes to the treaty to reform the Union’s institutions, which will be finalized in November, recent events suggest that amnesia does play a central role.

zh: 让我们来看一下使某些怀有可疑的顾虑的欧盟领导人忘记甚至是最近发生的事情的那种“病症”吧。
en: Let’s examine the “illness” that leads certain EU leaders with questionable scruples to forget even the recent past.

zh: 忙于处理国内事务的他们在把欧洲作为避免向他们的国民透露糟糕消息的替罪羊上是从来都毫不迟疑的。
en: Busy with domestic political affairs, they do not hesitate to use Europe as a scapegoat to avoid breaking bad news to their fellow citizens.

zh: 一些人表现出分离主义者的倾向，而使他们的选民感到担心和沮丧。
en: Some display separatist tendencies that worry, and frustrate, their electorates.

zh: 因此我们就不应该对许多欧盟公民拒绝，或者至少是对拥抱欧洲事业感到犹豫不决表示惊讶了。
en: No surprise, then, that many EU citizens refuse, or at least hesitate, to embrace the European cause.

zh: 这种政治欺骗也许能赢得选举，但是它严重破坏了任何能体验或是观察政治作为一个能对全球发展作出贡献的进程的机会。
en: This form of political racketeering may win elections, but it sabotages any opportunity to experience, or to perceive, politics as a process that can contribute to global development.

zh: 让我们来看一下英国的新首相布朗，根据他的看法全球化使欧洲计划失去了任何意义，这种政治上的自我中心论事实上将阻止欧盟适应任何变化并且无法找到应对全球化挑战的方案。
en: Consider Gordon Brown, Britain’s new prime minister, according to whom globalization strips the European project of any meaning, a form of political autism that in fact will prevent the EU from adapting to change and from being able to find solutions to globalization’s challenges.

zh: 幸运的是，公开反对欧洲政治的计划还没有形成潮流，至少现在还没有。
en: Fortunately, openly anti-European political programs are not the norm, at least not yet.

zh: 事实上，如果在2009年欧洲议会选举前，新的改革条约能够生效，到时各个成员国都将被迫澄清并证明其立场的正当性。
en: In fact, if, on the eve of the 2009 European Parliament elections, the new Reform Treaty enters into force, each member country will be forced to clarify and justify its position.

zh: 这份条约不仅对欧洲机构法规正常功能是至关重要的，同时对这些机构的进一步“深化 ” ， 这是某些人呼吁但并非真的想要达成的事情，也是至关重要的。
en: The Treaty will be essential not only to the proper functioning of Europe’s institutions, but also to their further “deepening” – something that many call for without necessarily really wanting to achieve.

zh: 得益于“强化合作 ” ， 那些不顺从的国家将不会再阻碍那些寻求取得进展的国家甚至可以寻求进入一个从欧盟“选择退出”的过程并且把它们从欧盟中“解放”出来，也许通过全民复议公决的方式。
en: Thanks to “reinforced cooperation,” recalcitrant states will no longer hinder those seeking to make progress, and could even resort to an “opt-out” process and “liberate” themselves from the EU, perhaps by means of a referendum.

zh: 还有那些认为欧盟的扩大阻止了进一步的“深化”的人以及那些对过去或未来都很少关心、辩解说寻求未来就必须抛弃过去的人。
en: Then there are those who believe that EU enlargement has prevented greater “deepening,” and who, with scant regard for the past or the future, argue that pursuing the latter requires abandoning the former.

zh: 但是谁可以有理由地主张说造就欧盟的那些元素需要被用来迎接未来50年或100年的挑战呢？
en: But who can reasonably claim to know what shape the EU will need to take to meet the challenges of the next 50 or 100 years?

zh: 像气候变化和能源供应这样的问题已经反映出单个国家行动徒劳无益以及深化 和 扩大欧盟的至关重要性。
en: Already, issues like climate change and energy supply demonstrate the futility of isolated national action and the critical importance of both deepening and enlarging the EU.

zh: 在因为俄罗斯与乌克兰以及后来的白俄罗斯之间的争执而导致石油和天然气供应出现中断后，欧盟的成员国最终明白了它们的生存依赖于它们将能源来源多元化的能力。
en: Having suffered from disruptions in oil and gas supplies following disputes between Russia and Ukraine and then Belarus, the EU’s members have finally understood that their survival depends on their capacity to diversify their energy sources.

zh: 欧盟的进一步扩大无疑既符合土耳其的利益，也符合欧洲的利益。
en: Further EU enlargement is undoubtedly in Turkey’s interest, and in Europe’s, too.

zh: 除开土耳其能够扮演的建设性角色，尤其是在中东，它成为成员国在能源问题上也是至关重要的。
en: In addition to the constructive role that Turkey could play, especially in the Middle East, its membership is vitally important in terms of energy.

zh: 此外，吸收土耳其也能够表现欧盟在政治上的一致性，同时也是朝欧洲计划迈出的质的一步。
en: Moreover, admitting Turkey would demonstrate the EU’s political consistency, while representing a qualitative step forward in the European project.

zh: 对于像法国总统萨科奇这样的政治家来说，这种考虑也许是毫无意义的。
en: For politicians like French President Nicolas Sarkozy, such considerations may be meaningless.

zh: 但是如果土耳其放弃其加入欧洲的梦想，而在战略上与俄罗斯甚至伊朗站在一起将会带来怎样的后果呢？
en: But what if Turkey were to abandon its European ambitions and align itself strategically with Russia or even Iran?

zh: 那将给欧洲的安全带来严重的后果。
en: The consequences for European security would be severe.

zh: 然后还有英国政治领导层的问题，对于他们来说扩大是一种阻止机构深化改革，以及实际上化解将欧洲政治化的一个途径。
en: Then there is Britain’s political leadership, for whom enlargement is a way to avoid deepening, and, indeed, to dissolve political Europe.

zh: 尽管这种想法并不为每个人所接受，某些大陆国家私下里还是很支持英国将欧洲肢解的想法，有一些政府的首脑甚至考虑对他们国家的承诺作出180º的改变。
en: While such ideas are not for everyone, certain Continental countries secretly prefer Britain’s disjointed scenarios, with some heads of governments even considering their countries’ commitments reversible.

zh: 那么，比如说，我们应该怎样对待波兰执政的卡钦斯基兄弟呢？
en: What, for example, should we make of Poland’s governing Kaczynski brothers?

zh: 这对性情急躁的双胞胎对改革条约拟议的部长会议的投票表决制度持有异议，然后用他们自己公开表明对同性恋的憎恨来把人们的目光从教皇统治制度中吸引过来，这种声明似乎排除了把欧盟基本权利宪章与波兰国内法律相结合的任何可能性。
en: The quick-tempered twins took issue with the reform treaty’s proposed voting system for the Council of Ministers, and then stole the limelight from papacy with their own homophobic declarations, proclamations that seem to exclude any possibility of integrating the EU’s Charter of Rights into Poland’s domestic law.

zh: 俄罗斯总统普京也许是唯一一个对这种抛弃欧洲社会价值观的行为表示欢迎的人。
en: Russian President Vladimir Putin may be the only one who welcomes this desertion from Europe’s community of values.

zh: 在这种情况下，荷兰总理巴尔克内德依然因为他的国家在2005年全民公决“反对”欧盟宪法条约草案而无法前进，他一直在寻求英国、捷克和波兰的支持以便可以采取措施缩减欧盟的责任范围。
en: In this climate, Dutch Prime Minister Peter Balkenende, still bogged down in his country’s “no” vote on the EU’s draft constitutional treaty in 2005, has been seeking to win British, Czech, and Polish support for measures to make it possible to diminish the EU’s areas of responsibility.

zh: 事实上，他也许甚至不会反对通过授予国家议会否决权来破坏欧盟的整个立法机制。
en: Indeed, he may not even object to ruining the EU’s entire legislative engine by granting national parliaments a veto.

zh: 现在我们欧洲人最最需要的就是走上一条相反的道路。
en: What we Europeans now need most of all is to embark on precisely the opposite course.

zh: 只有扩大由享有平等责任的伙伴所支持的欧盟的决策范围，欧洲才能应对对于我们共同未来的共同挑战。
en: Only by enlarging the scope of EU decision-making, backed by the commitment of equally responsible partners, can Europe meet the shared challenges of a common future.

zh: 目光短浅的欧洲防务削减
en: Europe’s Myopic Defense Cuts

zh: 发自哥本哈根 — — 在整个欧洲大陆，新预算紧缩时代的来临使得各国政府都开始削减预算，而国防经费则是他们最容易下手的目标，连戴维·卡梅伦领导下的英国保守党政府都投身到了这股压缩国防支出的热潮之中。
en: COPENHAGEN – All over Europe, budgets are being pared as a new age of austerity takes hold. Defense expenditures are proving to be the easiest of targets.

zh: 而这类削减行为恰恰又发生在一个特殊的时期：人们对欧洲承担西方防务责任的行动提出了质疑 — — 尤其是在阿富汗，许多欧洲国家都想方设法制定一大堆“附加条款 ” ， 好让本国部队得以远离那些最危险的区域，最终也减少了各国对整场战争的参与度。
en: These cuts are coming at a time when European efforts to shoulder a fair share of the Western defense burden have been cast in doubt – not least in Afghanistan, where most European countries have limited their participation by insisting on a myriad of “caveats” that usually serve to keep their troops far from the most dangerous zones.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲的国防支出总额自近代以来首次被亚洲超越。
en: Defense cuts are also happening at a time when Europe, for the first time in modern history, has been overtaken by Asia in terms of total defense spending.

zh: 西欧长期以来作为除美俄之外第三大军事力量聚集区的地位也荡然无存了。
en: Western Europe’s long-held position as the world’s most important concentration of military power after the United States and Russia appears to be over.

zh: 美国作为世界军事霸主的地位至今尚未受到任何严重威胁，毕竟它在军事上挥洒的金钱比全世界其他国家的总和还多。
en: The US faces no serious challenge (not yet, at least) as the world’s dominant military power. After all, the US spends almost as much on its armed forced as the rest of the world combined.

zh: 但情况也随着中国军费的不断增长而发生了变化。
en: But the picture is changing with the rapid growth of China’s military expenditures.

zh: 中国官方公布的军费增长 — — 过去十年每年提升15 % — —是一个相当惊人的数目，更何况还有一些秘密费用尚未计算在内。
en: The official growth rate of China’s military expenditure – 15% per year over the last decade – has increased substantially, and there is much hidden military spending as well.

zh: 而其周边邻国（尤其是印度）不断增加的紧张情绪则导致了其他亚洲国家军费的大幅增长。
en: Growing anxiety among China’s neighbors, particularly India, has led to remarkable increases in defense spending by other Asian powers as well.

zh: 此外，欧洲国防经费的削减也引发了大西洋联盟内部的紧张关系。
en: Cuts in European defense spending, moreover, are starting to cause serious tensions within the Atlantic Alliance.

zh: 北约组织从来被认为是“两根支柱（美欧 ） ， 一条横梁（共同的价值观 ） ” ，但即便是冷战时期，美国也经常指责欧洲那根“支柱”形同虚设，而美国人想要的则是更大程度上的“责任分担 ” 。
en: NATO is often described as a construction with two pillars and an architrave symbolizing the common values that form the basis of the alliance. But even during the Cold War, Americans often pointed out that the European pillar was lacking.

zh: 估计上述争吵很快又会死灰复燃，尤其是当前美国预算问题的严重程度比欧洲有过之而无不及的时候。
en: This debate may soon heat up again, now that the US, no less than Europe, is faced with grave budgetary problems.

zh: 事实上，在这个一个预算紧缩时代，美国政治家可能很难理解欧洲人为何还要削减国防支出，尤其是在费用水平早已远低于GDP2%的北约标准之时。
en: Indeed, in a time of austerity, US politicians might find it difficult to understand Europe’s willingness to cut defense budgets that already total far less than NATO’s official 2%-of-GDP target.

zh: 欧洲的问题不仅仅是缺乏军费，还有使用军费去实现其目的时的效率低下问题 — — 究竟应该在何时何地使用军事力量。
en: Europe’s problem is not only a lack of military spending, but also poor effectiveness when it comes to the purpose of that spending: the use of force when and where necessary.

zh: 相对其武装部队总人数来说，欧洲部署战斗部队的能力太弱了，以致有人半开玩笑地指出欧洲某些国家（在此姑隐其名）的将军人数相对其战斗部队数量来说显然有点夸张了。
en: Europe’s capability of deploying combat forces is simply too small relative to the number of men and women in uniform. It is often half-jokingly pointed out that the number of generals and admirals in some European countries (none mentioned, none forgotten) is glaringly disproportionate to the number of fighting troops.

zh: 欧洲军队的效率问题同时也与不同的采购政策有关，因为那些生产的军用设备的国家都喜欢把订单留给本国。
en: European military effectiveness is also curbed by different procurement policies, as those countries that produce military hardware prefer to keep orders at home.

zh: 武器配置和物流方面都存在着这个问题，尽管近年来在各国都努力用更少的预算做更多的事，但在整合和标准化中还是有巨大的潜力可挖。
en: This is true of weaponry as well as logistical capabilities, where, despite immense efforts over the years to get more out of the shrinking funds, there is still great potential for integration and standardization.

zh: 英法两国最近签订的防御条约显然是一个体现更大程度合作整合优势的绝佳范例 — — 尽管该条约跟北约和欧洲无关。
en: The defense treaties concluded recently by France and the United Kingdom appear to be a good example of what can be obtained through greater cooperation and integration – even though it is a strictly bilateral affair with no direct links to either NATO or the European Union.

zh: 但如果两国都大幅削减国防支出，以至于就算整合在一起都充其量只能维持原有水平的话，那么这个新“巴黎-伦敦协约”的价值也就有限了。 英国计划建造一艘新航空母舰，却拿不出钱来采购配套的舰载机，这意味着投入新协约的资源也是极为有限的。
en: But the value of the new “Paris-London Entente” will be limited if both countries cut their defense expenditures so much that their combined strength remains at best unchanged.  That Britain plans to fund construction of a new aircraft carrier, but not the planes to fly off of it, suggests that resources for the new entente will be sorely lacking.

zh: 但即便法英合作最终未能落到实处（须知实施条约所要客服的挑战不可胜数 ） ， 对其他国家也能起到激励作用。
en: Still, French-British cooperation if it does take on real substance could be an inspiration to others, though the challenges to making the agreement viable are formidable.

zh: 英国大兵必须学讲法语，而法国军团则要练习英文 — — 而种种缺乏协作精神的行为无疑会不断上演（比如军队食堂大门该谁先走 ） 。
en: British “Tommies” have to learn to speak French, and French legionnaires will have to learn English – and the limits on the spirit of cooperation will no doubt be found at the entrance to every army, navy, and air force canteen.

zh: 毕竟，谁能想象法国水兵大嚼“葡萄干布丁”这类皇家海军的特色食品呢。
en: After all, can anyone imagine French sailors eating “spotted dick” or any other culinary peculiarity of the Royal Navy?

zh: 某些更有发展前景的做法是把印度邀请进来，与法、德、英三国一道进行新Euro-fighter战斗机的研发。
en: Somewhat more promising is the possible invitation to India to participate in developing, alongside France, Germany, and Britain, the new joint Euro-fighter.

zh: 印度增加防务费用的决心以及获取新型军工生产线的意愿正是欧洲所国家缺少的。
en: India’s commitment to defense spending, and its desire to acquire advanced military production processes, may provide the kind of energy that Europe has been lacking.

zh: 但随着德国空军大幅减少Euro-fighter战斗机的采购量，印度参与研发的意愿就大打折扣了。
en: But with Germany’s Luftwaffe planning heavy cuts to its procurement of Euro-fighters, India may have second thoughts about taking part in the project.

zh: 印度这种增加国防支出的激情和决心必须被引入欧洲，因为欧洲正全力推动自身成为全球战略参与者。
en: The kind of energy and commitment to defense spending that India represents needs to be injected into Europe, because European rhetoric about playing a strategic global role remains in high gear.

zh: 但自从一位比利时外交部长（时任欧盟理��会主席）在1993年东盟会议上宣布“世界上只剩下两个超级强权，那就是美国和欧洲”之后，许多年都没有什么动静。
en: But it seems ages since a Belgian foreign minister (as chairman of the EU Council of Ministers) declared at an ASEAN meeting in Singapore in 1993: There are now only two superpowers left, the US and Europe!

zh: 如果欧洲认真想实现这一野心的话，他们就必须为不断下滑的军事力量找到解决方案政治领袖必须告诉选民军费是不能无限度削减的，因为冷战结束所节省出来的那部分军费早就花光了。
en: If Europeans want their ambitions to be taken seriously, they must find ways to deal with the decline in Europe’s military power. Political leaders will have to tell their constituents that there are limits to how much military budgets can be cut, as the “peace dividend” from the Cold War’s end was digested long ago.

zh: 欧洲国家之间必须采取新形式的军事合作以维持其效率。
en: Europeans may have to embrace new modes of cooperation among their national armed forces in order to put them to effective use.

zh: 不然的话，不但欧洲的全球政治野心化为泡影，连大西洋那边的盟友也最终将对欧洲人拒绝承担安全责任的行为失去耐性。
en: Otherwise, not only will Europe’s global political ambitions become untenable, but its allies on the other side of the Atlantic will lose patience with Europeans’ refusal to shoulder their share of the security burden.

zh: 欧洲的必要联盟
en: Europe’s Necessary Union

zh: 布鲁塞尔—欧洲债务危机的后果在欧盟大部显露无疑，而与此同时，受困经济体纷纷试图站稳脚跟、重振增长。
en: BRUSSELS – The consequences of Europe’s debt crisis are all too present throughout much of the European Union, as distressed economies attempt to stabilize and grow at the same time.

zh: 在过去几年中，欧盟做出过多项重要决定，但现实表明我们需要做更多的事情来应对欧元区所面临的挑战。
en: Notwithstanding the important decisions taken over the last couple of years, the reality is that we need to do more to tackle the challenges facing the eurozone.

zh: 欧盟各国各部无不正在实行改革和整合措施。
en: Reform and consolidation measures are being implemented across the EU.

zh: 联合金融防线已经打造成型。
en: Joint financial backstops have been put in place.

zh: 欧洲央行也不断地表明它将力挺欧元。
en: And the European Central Bank has consistently shown that it will stand by the euro.

zh: 但专家和伙伴常常低估了我们的决心。
en: Yet experts and partners often underestimate our determination.

zh: 到目前为止，我们所采取的措施增加而不是减少了欧洲的一体化。
en: All of the steps taken so far have resulted in more European integration, not less.

zh: 诚然，有时候我们的民主制度决策需要较长时间。
en: It is true that sometimes decision-making in our democratic system takes time.

zh: 但不能因此把我们一竿子打死：谈判是关于怎样做安排的，而不是关于最后结果的。
en: But do not misjudge us: the negotiations are about the arrangements, not about the final outcome.

zh: 欧盟内部具有足够的政治意愿采取一切必要手段捍卫欧元，因为单一货币的未来决定了欧洲的一体化。
en: There is sufficient political will in the EU to do whatever is necessary to protect the euro, because the future of the single currency will determine that of European integration.

zh: 欧洲所需要的后续措施必须深深地植根于深入一体化的承诺中。
en: The additional measures that Europe needs must be firmly rooted in a commitment to deeper integration.

zh: 主权债务水平高企，加上金融部门中某些部分的不当行为，放大了欧元区危机，也造成了重要的信心问题，如今需要系统性方案才能解决。
en: High levels of sovereign debt, together with the behavior of parts of the financial sector, have amplified the crisis in the eurozone and raised important issues of confidence that now require a systemic answer.

zh: 这就是为什么我们必须完成未竟的经济和货币联盟事业，也是为什么欧洲委员会长期以来认为建立银行联盟是迈向这一目标的不可或缺的步骤。
en: That is why we must complete the unfinished business of economic and monetary union – and why the European Commission has long argued for the creation of a banking union as an indispensable step toward that goal.

zh: 欧洲委员会即将给出的新方案将是范围更广的方案组合的一部分，而这一方案组合将引导欧洲形成重写欧洲一体化边界的经济、财政和政治联盟。
en: The Commission’s upcoming proposals are part of a broader package leading to economic, fiscal, and political union that will redefine the boundaries of European integration.

zh: 危机无情地揭露了现有银行监督体系的不充分性。
en: The crisis has starkly revealed the insufficiencies of existing banking supervision.

zh: 我们必须在合作的基础上更进一步，成立泛欧盟（特别是欧元区）的监督当局。
en: We must go beyond cooperation and establish an EU-wide supervisory authority, particularly in the eurozone.

zh: 主权债务和银行债务之间的联系必须一次性地予以彻底切断。
en: The link between sovereign debt and bank debt has to be broken once and for all.

zh: 我们必须终结一个恶性循环 — — 用纳税人的钱（目前超过4.5万亿欧元）拯救银行会威胁政府预算，而对风险越来越厌恶的银行不再为企业提供必须的贷款资金，从而进一步破坏经济。
en: We must end the vicious circle whereby the use of taxpayers’ funds – more than €4.5 trillion ($5.7 trillion) so far – to rescue banks weakens governments’ budgets, while increasingly risk-averse banks stop lending to businesses that need funds, undermining the economy further.

zh: 欧洲可以从现在开始采取果断行动切断这一负向动态。
en: Europe can stop this negative dynamic now with bold action.

zh: 目前，正在推出面向单一市场的单一金融服务规则。
en: A single rulebook for financial services is being put in place for the single market.

zh: 在此基础上，一个单一欧洲银行监督当局将扫清通过欧洲稳定性机制、共同存款保险以及单一破产框架对银行进行直接资本重组的障碍。
en: Building on this, a single European banking-supervision authority would open the way to direct recapitalization of banks through the European Stability Mechanism, as well as to common deposit insurance and a single resolution framework.

zh: 9月12日，欧洲委员会将提交关于单一银行监督机制（Single Banking Supervisory Mechanism）的方案。 该机制将基于三大关键原则：
en: On September 12, the Commission will present its proposals for a Single Banking Supervisory Mechanism based on three key principles:

zh: 单一监督者：在欧元区内部，光有国家级监督机构的合作是不够的。
en: Single supervision: Within the eurozone, coordination between national supervisory bodies is no longer enough.

zh: 产生于某一国的风险可能影响整个货币区。
en: Risks that emerge in one country can affect the entire currency area.

zh: 欧元区需要共同银行监督者增强使用共同金融防线的国家的信心。
en: Common banking supervision is needed for strengthening confidence among countries using common financial backstops.

zh: 信誉：欧元区的新银行监督机制将以欧洲央行为核心。
en: Credibility: The eurozone’s new banking-supervision mechanism will have the ECB at its heart.

zh: 委托欧洲央行的任务将确保对欧元区银行的严格、高质量且平等的审慎监督，从而在维持银行间信心 — — 从而增加整个欧元区的金融未定型方面起到关键性作用。
en: The choice of tasks to be entrusted to the ECB will ensure rigorous, high-quality, and equal prudential supervision of eurozone banks, thereby contributing decisively to maintaining confidence between the banks – and thus increasing financial stability throughout the eurozone.

zh: 国家级监督者的密切合作也将纳入这一框架。
en: Close cooperation with national supervisors will be built into the framework.

zh: 欧洲央行的监督职责将完全与其货币政策责任分离。
en: The ECB’s supervisory role will be fully separated from its monetary-policy responsibilities.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲银行局（European Banking Authority）将继续完成现有任务，即为整个单一市场制定单一规则并确保整个欧盟的监督行动的一致性。
en: In parallel, the European Banking Authority will continue to perform its existing tasks, namely developing the single rulebook for the entire single market and ensuring convergent supervisory practice throughout the EU.

zh: 广泛一致：所有欧元区银行都将被纳入欧洲监督系统。
en: Broad coverage: All banks in the eurozone will be covered by the new European supervisory system.

zh: 我们需要解决欧元区成员国和不使用欧元的欧盟成员国之间的差异问题，后者中不少也愿意加入新的监督机制。
en: And we will need to bridge the gap between eurozone members and EU members that remain outside the monetary union, some of which may want to participate in the new supervisory mechanisms.

zh: 我们决定采取的道路将允许我们迅速行动起来。
en: The road that we have decided to follow will allow for swift action.

zh: 单一银行监督机制并不要求改动欧盟条约，可以在2013年1月就开始实施。
en: The Single Banking Supervisory Mechanism does not require a treaty change and should be in place by January 2013.

zh: 共同和更佳一体化的监督是通向银行联盟的第一步。
en: Common and more integrated supervision is the first step towards a banking union.

zh: 接着，欧洲委员会将继续发展我们的当前方案，纳入存款担保机制和银行破产机制，向单一破产基金和单一破产管理当局的方向迈进。
en: Next, the Commission will build on our current proposals for deposit-guarantee schemes and bank resolution mechanisms to move toward a single resolution fund and a single resolution authority.

zh: 一旦这些方案被实施，银行联盟也就完整了。
en: Once these proposals are implemented, the banking union will be complete.

zh: 2013年成立银行联盟并不能赋予欧洲魔法，一下子就清除经济危机；但这是重建欧洲人民、国际合作伙伴和投资者信心的重要而关键的一步。
en: Establishing a banking union by 2013 will not give Europe a magic wand with which to wave away the economic crisis overnight; but it is a major and crucial step to restoring the confidence of Europe’s citizens, international partners, and investors.

zh: 这将确保金融稳定性、增加透明度、让银行部门可问责、并保护纳税人的钱。
en: It will ensure financial stability, increase transparency, make the banking sector accountable, and protect taxpayers’ money.

zh: 此外，这还是更大的棋的起手式。
en: Moreover, it is the start of something much bigger.

zh: 我想再次强调，欧元区正在从历史中吸取教训，并着眼于一体化的未来而不是过去。
en: Once again, I would like to stress that the eurozone is drawing lessons from the past and defining a way forward, not backwards, in terms of integration.

zh: 这是一个好消息，不仅对欧元是如此，对全球经济亦然。
en: That is good news not only for the euro, but also for the global economy.

zh: 欧洲的新自由主义挑战
en: Europe’s Neo-Liberal Challenge

zh: 在过去的20年里，我一直认为西欧的高失业率是不可持续的。
en: For over 20 years I have argued that Western Europe’s high unemployment rates are unsustainable.

zh: 在1970年代末期，货币主义者断言只有通过失业率短暂而温和的上升才能控制在西方工业化国家逐渐蔓延并正在加速的通货膨胀。 他们还认为当我们将来回顾历史时，会认为为回归有效的价格稳定性所付出的成本都是值得的。
en: At the end of the 1970’s, monetarists bet that only a transitory and modest increase in unemployment could rein in the creeping – and trotting – inflation of the industrial west, and that in retrospect the cost of returning to effective price stability would be judged worthwhile.

zh: 在英国和美国这样的论断得到的印证。
en: In Britain and the United States, this monetarist bet turned out well.

zh: 但在西欧却并非如此。
en: In Western Europe, it did not.

zh: 在过去的25年里，随着货币政策的收紧和为应对通胀而提高利率，失业率也上升了。
en: Over the past 25 years in Europe, unemployment rose as monetary policy was tightened and interest rates were raised to fight inflation.

zh: 但在通胀得到控制之后，失业率却并没有下降—或者说下降得不多。
en: But after inflation succumbed, unemployment did not fall – or not by much.

zh: 如果说失业率并没有维持在“大萧条”时期的水平，但也高得足以使长期失业或对长期失业的恐惧成为一种刻骨铭心的经历。
en: If unemployment was not stuck quite at Great Depression levels, it remained high enough to make long-term joblessness or the fear of long-term joblessness a defining experience.

zh: 连续好几代人的官方失业率都维持在10%或更高的社会是政府的经济管理失败的社会。
en: Societies in which the official unemployment rate stands at 10% or more for generations are societies in which government economic management has failed.

zh: 因此，似乎西欧20年以来根本的政治平衡—一边是社团主义者的讨价还价和充足的社会保障，另一边使紧缩的货币政策—必然破裂。
en: So, for 20 years it has seemed to me that Western Europe’s underlying political equilibrium – corporatist bargaining and ample social insurance, on the one hand, and tight monetary policies, on the other – must crack.

zh: 这双重的恐惧似乎让欧洲的决策者们束手无策了。
en: Twin fears appear to be paralyzing European policymakers.

zh: 欧洲央行的官员们担心他们的政治主人会勒令他们放松货币政策；担心释放总合供给所必需的结构性改革不会出现；还担心最后的结果就是又回到1970年代的通胀状态。
en: Europe’s central bankers fear that their political masters will order them to loosen monetary policy, that the structural reforms needed to free up aggregate supply will not be forthcoming, and that the result will be a return to the inflation of the 1970’s.

zh: 简言之，他们担心为价格稳定性所做出的一切牺牲都会付诸东流。
en: In short, they fear that all of the sacrifices made for price stability will have been in vain.

zh: 而西欧的政治家们担心的却是相反的结果。
en: West European politicians, for their part, fear the opposite outcome.

zh: 他们担忧的是即便在实施了结构性改革，降低失业受益的吸引力，提高工人获得工作和公司录用工人的能力之后，中央银行的官员们会依然坚持通货紧缩。
en: They worry that even after undertaking structural reforms to reduce the attractiveness of unemployment benefits and increase the ability of workers to move to jobs and of firms to move to workers, central bankers will continue to insist on tight money.

zh: 总之，他们担心没有产出或就业的扩张，实际结果就只会是贫穷的增加。
en: In short, they fear that, with no expansion of output or employment, the net effect will simply be an increase in poverty.

zh: 当然，这些担心也伴随着对结构性改革和货币扩张协调实施的希望。 这样做可以促进就业和产出而又不至于大幅提高通胀率。
en: Of course, these fears are accompanied by the hope that structural reforms and monetary expansion work in harmony, boosting employment and output without raising inflation by much.

zh: 但现实表明实现宽松的货币政策的方式是不存在的—特别是在羽翼未丰的欧洲央行急于建立自己应对通胀的公信力的情况下—且实现结构性改革的手段也仅是半心半意，缩手缩脚和小打小闹而已。
en: But the reality is that steps toward looser monetary policies are non-existent – especially with the fledgling European Central Bank anxious to establish its inflation-fighting credibility – and that steps toward structural reforms are half-hearted, hesitant, and small.

zh: 20年来，我一直是错的：尽管有高比例的公民被排除在相当部分的重要经济生活之外，西欧的政治仍然保持了稳定。
en: For 20 years, I have been wrong: West European polities have remained stable despite the exclusion of a large proportion of citizens from meaningful participation in much of economic life.

zh: 西欧的经济体们仍然继续成长—虽然本应更快一些—尽管他们仍然背负着失业劳动人口比例达10%甚至更高的沉重负担。
en: West European economies have continued to grow – albeit not as rapidly as they might have – despite bearing the heavy burden of the unemployed 10% or more of the labor force.

zh: 但现在我的观点似乎最终得到了印证—或者说如果不至于惊慌的话，至少我有理由担忧。
en: Now, though, it looks like I may finally be right – or at least right to worry, if not to panic.

zh: 法国拒绝欧盟宪法，首先—或说表面上看来—是因为它担心欧洲的进一步一体化必然会带来巨大的成本并危害新自由主义。
en: The French rejected the European Union constitution, primarily – or so it appears – because further European integration, it is feared, must bring in its wake the huge costs and disruptions of neo-liberalism.

zh: 当法国认为与德国结成紧密的伙伴就不会再有人为阿尔萨斯-洛林地区应该使用何种语言而大动干戈时，它支持了“欧洲计划 ” 。
en: It is one thing to back the “European project” when the idea is to bind Germany so tightly to France that never again will anybody think it worthwhile to wage a war over what language is spoken in Alsace-Lorraine.

zh: 可当欧洲计划意味着法国工人面临来自波兰的水管工、罗马尼亚的农民和土耳其的店员的竞争时就完全是另一码事了。
en: It is another when the European project means that French workers face competition from Polish plumbers, Romanian farmers, and Turkish shop clerks.

zh: 在德国，选民们似乎由于不满施罗德总理对新自由主义项目不温不火的忠诚而准备让他走人。
en: In Germany, the electorate seems poised to eject Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder out of discontent with his tepid allegiance to the neo-liberal project.

zh: 问题是，他们一旦这样做了又会迎来新总理安吉拉·默克尔（Angela Merkel）四年的任期。 而她对新自由主义项目的承诺几乎和我一样坚定。
en: The problem is that the electorate will then get four years of rule by a chancellor, Angela Merkel, whose commitment to the neo-liberal project is almost as strong as mine.

zh: 我认为德国在未来10年里还是实行更为新自由主义的政策比较好。
en: I think that Germany would be better off in a decade under more neo-liberal policies.

zh: 但这似乎不是德国选民们的想法，所以也使得德国未来四年的政治局面充满了不确定因素。
en: But this does not seem to be what the German electorate wants, and this makes the complexion of German politics four years from now incalculable.

zh: 北欧对央行官员，特别是对欧洲央行和欧元的不满使形势更为严峻。
en: Coupled with all this is northern European discontent with the central bankers, specifically with the ECB and the euro.

zh: 这并不是因为终结欧洲货币联盟已经提上了议事日程，而仅仅是因为人们开始考虑欧洲货币联盟的终结可能会催生低概率的期货。
en: It is not that the end of European Monetary Union is on the agenda; it is merely that people have begun thinking about possible low-probability futures in which the end of EMU might be placed on the agenda.

zh: 就这一点就足以动摇全世界的资产价格。
en: That is enough to shake asset prices worldwide.

zh: 西欧在第二次世界大战之后所取得的成就演绎了世界史上最令人振奋的成功故事���重要篇章。
en: Western Europe’s accomplishments since World War II are among the most heartening and impressive success stories in world history.

zh: 所有人都希望今天统一的欧洲在这样的成就之上继续发展而不愿让持续数代人的高失业率使我们前功尽弃。
en: Everyone should want today’s undivided Europe to build on these accomplishments, rather than for generations of high unemployment to jeopardize them.

zh: 但这就需要欧洲央行转变态度。
en: But this will require a shift in the ECB’s attitude.

zh: 欧洲需要一种重视帮助北欧提高就业率更多于实现价格稳定性的货币政策。
en: Europe needs a monetary policy that views aiding employment growth in northern Europe as more important than continental price stability.

zh: 毕竟在南欧和东欧还是会出现通胀—这是必然的。 因为随着各地区的发展和工业化，它们的贸易条件必须得到改善，而在货币联盟当中，地区性通胀是实现这一目的的手段。
en: There will, after all be inflation in southern and eastern Europe – there must be, for as regions develop and industrialize their terms of trade must improve, and under a monetary union regional inflation is how this can happen.

zh: 欧洲央行不应该为了实现人为的欧洲大陆范围内的目标，就以北欧的通货紧缩来平衡南欧和东欧的通货膨胀。
en: The ECB should not try to balance inflation in the south and east with deflation in the north in order to hit artificial continent-wide targets.

zh: 永不休止的欧洲宪法
en: Europe's Never-Ending Constitution

zh: 10月29号，欧盟的首脑们将聚集在罗马，签署一部新的欧州宪法条约。
en: On October 29, leaders of the European Union will gather in Rome to sign the Union's new Constitutional Treaty.

zh: 毫无疑问，到时会有很多对文件独特性的赞美。 这倒不是吹牛，因为欧洲宪法的确不同于任何其它宪法。
en: Praise for the document's uniqueness will undoubtedly be heard, and in this they won't be boasting, because the EU Constitution is unlike any other constitution ever written.

zh: 大多数宪法，包括美国宪法，都渴望"凝固历史 " ， 或建立一个最终的能抵抗变化的法律文本。
en: Most constitutions - including the American one - aspire to "freeze history," or to set up a lasting institutional order that will resist the winds of change.

zh: 事实上，宪法的本义就是试图"控制"历史，让历史跟随人类制定的法律而不是它自己的逻辑，包括不受欢迎的偶然性以及命里的一时冲动。
en: Indeed, a constitution is by its nature an attempt to "tame" history, to make it follow the laws of man rather than its own logic, including unwelcome contingencies and the whims of fate.

zh: 但与之相反，欧洲宪法却被大家心照不宣地认定为是一部暂时性的宪法。 它远远称不上完美，如果允许的话，它现在就需要作改动。
en: By contrast, the EU Constitution is written with the unspoken understanding that the institutions it is setting up are transitory, that they are far from optimal, and that it would be desirable to change them right now if political realities allowed it.

zh: 但是今天欧洲的政治现状不允许签约国真正想要的宪法存在，所以他们起草的宪法被定位为是一部反映进化过程、促进未来发展的法律。 社会的进步将 - - 希望如此 - - 在某一天忘掉目前这部行将签署的欧洲宪法。
en: But the realities of politics in today's Europe do not allow for the sort of document the signatories really wanted to draft, so the constitution that they did write is designed to establish a process of evolutionary change that will motivate further improvements along the way - improvement that will, it is hoped, one day obliterate the very arrangements today's EU Constitution is setting up.

zh: 事实上，欧州宪法条约的设计者从一开始就没有真的期望他们的草案会保留下去，相反，他们把自己看作是欧洲长期形成的"一步一步综合"模式的追随者。
en: Indeed, from the start, the architects of the Union's Constitutional Treaty never seriously expected that their draft would endure in the form in which they wrote it. Instead, they saw themselves as following Europe's long established pattern of step-by-step integration.

zh: 这个模式最早开始于半个世纪前的"欧洲计划 " 。
en: This pattern began at the start of the 'European project' over half a century ago.

zh: 50年代来自煤和钢社团的外溢效应导致了欧洲经济共同体的产生，接着又出现了欧洲共同体，最后成立了欧盟。
en: Spillover effects from the original Coal and Steel Community of the 1950's led to the creation of the European Economic Community, then to the European Community, and finally to the creation of the Union.

zh: 每一步都是更大的结合。
en: Each step led to progressively greater integration.

zh: 即使是里程碑似的文件如单一欧洲法、马斯垂克条约、阿姆斯特丹条约、尼斯条约等，也从来没有想过要追求永恒。
en: Even milestone documents such as the Single European Act and the Treaties of Maastricht, Amsterdam, and Nice, were never envisaged as achieving the kind of permanence (or even semi-permanence) that we normally associate with a constitution. The same is true of developments like the Union's common foreign and security policy or Monetary Union, with its Euro and European Central Bank.

zh: 欧盟的外交和安全政策、以及欧洲货币同盟也是如此。
en: No sooner did one intergovernmental conference produce a "settlement" than the wheels started turning to prepare for a successor conference and a successor settlement. This mechanism for the deliberately progressive construction of a unified polity out of nominally sovereign states is unprecedented in human history.

zh: 当国家着手一个整和计划时，最后的结果往往是：如果它们被放在一边，它们看上去就象没完成一样，而实际上还在进行中。
en: When nations embark on a program of ever closer integration, the end result is always likely to look unfinished if they put aside - on an ongoing basis - any resolution of the ultimate destination.

zh: 任何终极目标的决议都是这样。 事实上，在欧洲统一进程中，只有一件事似乎是从一开始就很明了的，那就是所有参与的国家，不管它们可能会选择什么样的合作伙伴，都会继续建造它们那个更加综合的政体。
en: Indeed, the only thing that seemed clear from the start of the European integration process was that the states involved - along with whatever new partner states they might pick up along the way - would continue wheeling and dealing to construct their ever more integrated polity.

zh: 结果是，每一个条约的修订都是混乱的政治争论的产物。
en: As a result, every set of treaty amendments was the product of the type of untidy political haggling typical of intergovernmental decision-making.

zh: 事实上，即使是在宪法条约下，所有国家都知道，他们的伙伴拥有明确的撤退的权力，只要他们足够地清醒或把建立欧盟看作是一个坏主意。
en: Indeed, even under the Constitutional Treaty, all states know that their partners have the express right to withdraw if they should ever become sufficiently disenchanted or come to look upon the EU as a bad bargain.

zh: 但是，这部欧州宪法条约会结束这种进化模式吗？ 可能在某种程度上会，但不会全部。
en: But will the Union's new Constitutional Treaty put an end to this pattern of evolutionary constitution building?

zh: 因为条约的设计者们已经将宪法中的不同内容分门别类，如基本权利宪章，欧盟机构和成员国的职责等。 从每日政治内容，如农业和渔业政策到民事刑事诉讼中司法合作的学术性等。
en: It may do so to some degree, but not nearly as much as if the treaty's architects had done more to separate constitutional matters, such as the Charter of Fundamental Rights and the competences of Union bodies and member states, from the stuff of everyday politics, like agricultural and fisheries policies or the technicalities of judicial cooperation in civil and criminal matters.

zh: 欧盟中那些永恒和持久的东西与欧盟中那些不太永恒和持久的东西分开来的机会被错过了。
en: A great opportunity to segregate what is permanent and durable (i.e., "constitutional") about the Union from what is impermanent and changeable (i.e., "political") was missed.

zh: 由于没有什么实在的东西，欧洲的制宪过程没有依赖于任何至高无上的文件，而是平衡政治关系和计算数据，这样整个欧盟才不会分裂。
en: With nothing set in concrete, Europe's constitutional process continue to rely not on any transcendent document, but on balancing political relations and calculations so that the whole thing does not fall apart.

zh: 但这个过程很可能会延长一个单一欧洲政治体的出现。
en: This process will probably carry the cost of prolonging the emergence of a single European political loyalty (if one ever does emerge).

zh: 只有那些把建立一个稳定的欧洲联盟看作是欧洲的命运的人才会把这当成是悲剧。
en: This will be considered tragic only for those who see a stable European federation as Europe's manifest destiny.

zh: 对余下的我们这些人来说，虽然欧盟向东扩展、在伊拉克问题上又爆发分歧、还存在其它的从欧洲灵活的进化论到宪法的制定等问题上的摩擦，但我们对这场为自我定义而进行的奋斗仍然抱有很多希望。
en: For the rest of us, notwithstanding the Union's unprecedented eastward enlargement, the schisms that erupted over the Iraq war, and the other frictions that are bound to result from Europe's flexible, evolutionary approach to constitution-making, there is also a lot of hope in this extended struggle for self-definition.

zh: 最近在欧洲形成的在紧急关头必须同心通力一起应付外部事务的共识，也许正是我们事业不败的保证。
en: The recent collective sense across Europe of the urgency of being able to speak with one voice in external affairs may provide the next breeze, and enough glue, to keep the enterprise afloat.

zh: 欧洲新的黎明
en: Europe's New Dawn

zh: 今天在罗马，欧盟25个成员国的首脑们将签署一部欧洲宪法条约。
en: Today in Rome, the heads of state and government of the EU's 25 member states will sign the Treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe.

zh: 从1957年，也是在罗马，6国成立欧洲经济合作体以来，我们走过了一条漫长的道路。
en: We have come a long way since the six founding members formed the European Economic Community back in March 1957 - also in Rome.

zh: 条约签署以后，它将领先于各国议会批准文件，所以理解为什么它值得被认可就至关重要。
en: After the Treaty is signed, it will go before the national parliaments for approval. So it is crucially important to understand why the Treaty deserves to be ratified.

zh: 简单地说，它将从4个方面，使欧洲人民的利益在欧盟的中心工作中占据更重要的地位。
en: Simply put, it places the interests of Europe's citizens more than ever at the heart of the European Union's activities. It does so in four ways.

zh: 首先，欧洲宪法条约将确保欧盟的机构尊重欧盟内每一个人的基本权利。
en: First, the Constitutional Treaty guarantees that the Union's institutions will respect the fundamental rights of everyone within the EU.

zh: 纳入宪法中的"基本权利目录"内容广泛，以尊重人的尊严、自由、平等为中心，同时还阐明了民主原则以及法律规则。
en: The "catalogue of fundamental rights" included in the Constitution is extensive, centering on respect for human dignity, freedom, and equality, and also on the principles of democracy and the rule of law.

zh: 通过归入宪法，这些基本权利和原则就有了法律依据，人们可以有更多机会向法院提请诉求。
en: By enshrining them in the Constitution, these fundamental rights and principles become legally binding, and citizens will have greater scope for bringing appeals to the Court of Justice.

zh: 从这一点来说，欧盟在保护基本权利方面领导了世界。
en: In this respect, the EU leads the world in the protection of fundamental rights.

zh: 其次，条约使欧盟更加民主，使政府离老百姓更近。
