en: Second, the Treaty makes the EU more democratic and brings government closer to Europe's citizens.

zh: 欧盟不会参与那些在地方、地区或国内可以成功解决的事务。
en: The Union has no business interfering in matters that can be dealt with successfully at the local, regional, or national level.

zh: 欧盟的目标很明确，那就是解决那些各国不能自行解决的问题，如发展更强大的经济、建立更安全的体制。
en: The EU's objectives are precisely those that countries are unable to achieve on their own, for example, a stronger economy and greater security.

zh: 宪法条约包含了确保欧盟严格执行这一原则的条款。
en: The Constitutional Treaty includes guarantees to ensure that the EU adheres to this principle strictly.

zh: 如果布鲁塞尔制定任何不必要的参与计划，国家议会有权提出抗议。
en: National parliaments will be able to call a time-out if Brussels makes proposals that seem to interfere unnecessarily.

zh: 如果三分之一的国家议会这么做，欧盟委员会就会被要求重新考虑计划。
en: Should one-third of national parliaments so wish, the European Commission will be required to reconsider a proposal.

zh: 此外，宪法条约还给予公民要求欧盟委员会就某一特殊事件采取行动的权力。
en: In addition, the Constitutional Treaty gives citizens the right to ask the European Commission to take action on a specific point.

zh: 但公民的这种自发行动需要有来自不同国家的100万个签名。
en: A citizens' initiative of this kind will require one million signatures, obtained in different countries.

zh: 同时，欧洲议会的权力将更大。
en: At the same time, the European Parliament will have far greater powers.

zh: 它将在更多领域参与当局的决定，包括预算。
en: It will have joint decision-making authority in many more areas, including the budget.

zh: 因此，欧洲人民选出的代表们将更好地审查委员会的工作。
en: As a result, European citizens' elected representatives will be better able to scrutinize the work of the Commission.

zh: 第三，条约使欧盟更加开放和透明。
en: Third, the Treaty makes the EU more open and more transparent.

zh: 公民要求以一种他们可以明白的方式来明确权力，公开作决定的过程。
en: Citizens want powers to be clearly defined and decisions to be taken openly in a way that they can understand.

zh: 很多人对目前欧盟混乱的条约以及它们无数的修正文件感到失望。
en: Many people despair of finding their way through the maze of current EU treaties and their numerous amendments.

zh: 布鲁塞尔以外的人，很少可以解释"立柱"结构以及欧盟和欧洲合作会之间的区别。
en: Outside Brussels, few people can explain the "pillar" structure and the distinction between the Union and the Community.

zh: 宪法交代了这些复杂的历史过程。
en: The Constitution consigns these complexities to history.

zh: 它还给公民提供了更多获取官方信息的渠道，扩大了他们了解所有机构、组织文件的权利。
en: It also gives people far greater access to official information, extending their right of access to documents from all institutions, organs, and bodies.

zh: 最后，条约将使欧州更加有效。
en: Finally, the Treaty will make Europe more effective.

zh: 这很重要，如果影响到人们生活的问题可以被成功地处理的话。
en: This is essential if the issues that affect people's lives are to be tackled successfully.

zh: 人们认为很重要的两个问题是更强大的经济（更多工作机会，更高的经济发展率）和更安全的社会（减少跨国犯罪 ） 。
en: Two themes that people consider crucial are a stronger European economy (more jobs and more growth) and greater security (reducing cross-border crime).

zh: 欧洲国家在这些问题上是紧密相连的。
en: European countries are heavily reliant on each other in addressing these issues.

zh: 人们指望欧洲行动起来。
en: People are counting on Europe to take action.

zh: 但是，由于欧盟经常必须一致通过才能作决定，因此要采取行动很困难。
en: But, because EU decisions often have to be taken unanimously, this can be difficult.

zh: 而且，也缺乏有效合作的方法。
en: Moreover, the means to work together effectively are often lacking.

zh: 宪法条约在这方面取得了很重要的进步，可以使我们更有效地工作在一起以达到我们的目标。
en: The Treaty introduces major improvements here, enabling us to work together more effectively to achieve our aims.

zh: 概括说来，宪法条约把基本权利纳入了法律中，同时使欧盟更加民主，更加透明，更加有效。
en: In sum, the Constitutional Treaty firmly enshrines fundamental rights in law, and also makes the EU more democratic, more transparent, and more effective.

zh: 它让每一个人满意 - - 不仅让那些希望欧盟有更多合作并取得更多实在的结果的人满意，也使那些原来担心欧盟会过多参与成员国内部事务的人满意。
en: This makes it a good deal for everyone - for people who expect more cooperation and more concrete results from the Union, but also for those concerned about excessive interference by Europe in questions that can be better dealt with by the member states themselves.

zh: 明年，我们将庆祝欧洲大部分地区和平60周年。
en: Next year, we will celebrate 60 years of peace across a large part of Europe.

zh: 此前在我们的历史中，我们从来没有享受过这么长时间的和睦，我们也没有见过如此巨大的繁荣。
en: Never before in our history have we enjoyed such a long period of concord, a period that has seen an enormous growth in prosperity.

zh: 民主已经几乎遍布欧洲的每一个角落，欧洲人现在有了多得多的自由，他们可以任意选择在哪里生活、工作和学习。
en: Democracy has taken root in almost every corner of Europe, and Europeans now have far greater freedom to live, work, and study where and how they wish.

zh: 这些成就的取得主要归功于欧洲各国间的合作。
en: These achievements are largely due to European cooperation.

zh: 宪法条约反映了我们渴望继续合作的意愿。
en: The Constitutional Treaty is a reflection of our wish to continue in the same vein, to carry on working together.

zh: 我们要重申，我们承担着一个急迫的义务，那就是建设一个没有战争、没有不公、自由的生活。
en: We want to reaffirm our commitment to a life without war and injustice, and to the freedom that we hold so dear.

zh: 宪法条约为我们的将来创造了一个坚实的基础。
en: The Constitutional Treaty provides solid foundations for our shared future.

zh: 和平、安全和繁荣很可贵，但也很脆弱。
en: Peace, security, and prosperity are as vulnerable as they are valuable.

zh: 这个条约将使它们更加坚强，也将使我们更加坚强。
en: This Treaty makes them stronger. And that makes us stronger.

zh: 因此，签署典礼代表着希望。
en: The signing ceremony is therefore a message of hope.

zh: 这是一个新的开始。
en: It is a new beginning.

zh: 欧洲的新拉姆斯菲尔德
en: Europe’s New Donald Rumsfeld

zh: 今年十二月，俄国杜马选举几乎肯定会巩固忠于普京的力量的势力。
en: Russia’s Duma elections this December are almost certain to cement the power of forces loyal to Vladimir Putin.

zh: 自从拉姆斯菲尔德把欧洲大陆划分为“新”欧洲和“老”欧洲以来，这一结果有可能会确认俄国成为最为引起欧盟分化的事务。
en: That outcome is likely to confirm Russia’s emergence as the most divisive issue in the European Union since Donald Rumsfeld split the continent into “old” and “new” Europe.

zh: 在二十世纪九十年代，欧盟成员国们很容易就形成对俄共同政策。
en: In the 1990’s, EU members found it easy to agree on a common approach to Russia.

zh: 这些国家联合在一个意在将软弱和负债累累的俄国民主化和西方化的战略之下。
en: They coalesced around a strategy of democratizing and westernizing a weak and indebted Russia.

zh: 这一政策现在已经瓦解。
en: That policy is now in tatters.

zh: 窜升的石油和天然气价格已经让俄国更为强大，不再如此合作，也不再对加入西方如此感兴趣。
en: Soaring oil and gas prices have made Russia more powerful, less co-operative, and less interested in joining the West.

zh: 如今，欧洲人甚至无法对俄国政权的性质取得共识，更不要说对其采取何种政策了。
en: Today, Europeans cannot even agree on the nature of the Russian regime, let alone what policy to adopt towards it.

zh: 这一混乱局面部分是由于普京高超的政治技巧造成的。
en: Part of the confusion lies in Putin’s skillful political positioning.

zh: 在一方面，普京需要最大程度地控制经济和社会以便提高工资和养老金并且压制反对派，与此同时培育让他稳坐江山的那些恩宠。
en: On the one hand, he needs to maximize his control of the economy and society in order to raise wages and pensions and to keep opponents down, while nourishing the long-tail of patronage that keeps him in power.

zh: 在另一方面，莫斯科的精英阶层担心未来的政府会将他们的资产收归国有，想要避免成为国际贱民，这般就可以在需要的时候在西方安度晚年。
en: On the other hand, Moscow’s elite – who fear that their assets may be expropriated by a future government – wants to avoid international pariah status so that they can see out their sun-set years in the safety of the West if the need arises.

zh: 一群联系紧密的政治顾问们帮助普京解决了这一难题。
en: A tightly knit group of political consultants has helped Putin resolve his conundrum.

zh: 他们并不是建立起一个独裁制度，而是帮助普京利用自由民主制度的微妙之处来巩固权力。
en: Rather than establish a dictatorship, they helped Putin use the trappings of liberal democracy to consolidate power.

zh: 普京通过建立克里姆林宫控制下的虚假的反对派政党和像“纳西”这样虚假的施加压力团体和组织并且重新确定法治作为政治权力工具，从而比许多独裁政权更为有效和微妙地加紧了其控制。
en: By establishing fake opposition political parties that are under the Kremlin’s thumb, creating pseudo pressure groups and organizations such as Nashi (“Ours”), and recasting the rule of law as an instrument of political power, Putin has tightened his control in a more effective and subtle way than many autocratic regimes.

zh: 在他的总统任期结束之计，他有可能竞选总理从而延长其统治，这是这一做法符合逻辑的延续。
en: The possibility that he may run for prime minister in order to prolong his rule when his presidential mandate expires is a logical continuation of this approach.

zh: 尽管欧盟未能在普京时代改变俄国，但是俄国却对欧盟出生了巨大的影响。
en: Though the EU has failed to change Russia during the Putin era, Russia has had a big impact on the EU.

zh: 在能源方面，俄国对欧盟各成员国们各个击破，分别签订破坏欧盟共同战略核心原则的长期协议。
en: On energy, it is picking off individual EU member states and signing long-term deals that undermine the core principles of the EU’s common strategy.

zh: 在科索沃问题上，俄国阻挠在联合国取得的进展。
en: On Kosovo, Russia is blocking progress at the United Nations.

zh: 在高加索和中亚，克里姆林宫有效地将欧盟排除除去，而欧盟则在这些地区具有促进政治改革、解决冲突以及建立能源合作夥伴的利益。
en: In the Caucasus and Central Asia, the Kremlin has effectively shut the EU out of regions where it has an interest in promoting political reform, resolving conflicts, and forging energy partnerships.

zh: 在乌克兰和摩尔多瓦，克里姆林宫努力破解欧洲的吸引力，并且取得了一定的成功。
en: In Ukraine and Moldova, the Kremlin has worked hard, with some success, to blunt the appeal of Europe.

zh: 在某些邻国眼中，俄国正在重新崛起，对主权、实力以及世界秩序采取不同的策略，从而成为欧盟在意识形态上的替换品。
en: In the eyes of some neighboring countries, Russia is emerging as an ideological alternative to the EU that offers a different approach to sovereignty, power, and world order.

zh: 欧洲建设建立在法治的基础之上，俄国则相信当实力平衡改变之际，法律也应当改变以反映这一变化。
en: Whereas the European project is founded on the rule of law, Russia believes that when the balance of power changes, the laws should be changed to reflect it.

zh: 而且，俄国正在试图与欧盟建立“不平衡的相互依存”关系。
en: Moreover, Russia is trying to build a relationship of “asymmetric interdependence” with the EU.

zh: 欧盟领导人们相信，和平和稳定是通过相互依存而建立的，俄国领导人却愿意形成这样一种局面，也就是欧盟需要俄国要大于俄国需要欧盟，特别是在能源领域。
en: While EU leaders believe that peace and stability is built through interdependence, Russia’s leaders are intent on creating a situation in which the EU needs Russia more than Russia needs the EU, particularly in the energy sector.

zh: 尽管俄国的GDP并不大于比利时和荷兰相加之和，其军费开支也只是欧盟的一小部分，但是克里姆林宫却一贯占据欧盟的上风。
en: Although Russia’s GDP is no bigger than that of Belgium and the Netherlands combined, and its military spending is a fraction of the EU’s, the Kremlin has consistently managed to get the better of the Union.

zh: 中心问题是，欧洲人荒废了其最为强大的实力源泉，也就是团结一致。
en: The central problem is that Europeans have squandered their most powerful source of leverage: unity.

zh: 一派把俄国视为潜在的���伴，可以通过“缓慢融入”的进程将其带入欧盟的范围。 另一派把俄国视为一个威胁，其扩张主义和蔑视民主必须通过“柔性遏制”政策来加以逆转。
en: Member states are divided between those that view Russia as a potential partner which can be drawn into the EU’s orbit through a process of “creeping integration,” and those that view Russia as a threat whose expansionism and contempt for democracy must be rolled back through a policy of “soft containment.”

zh: 最近几年的历史表明这两个策略都不成功。
en: The last few years demonstrate that neither approach will work.

zh: 第一个策略有在不坚持让俄国遵守稳定的规则而让其轻易获得与欧盟合作的所有利益的风险。
en: The first approach risks giving Russia easy access to all the benefits of cooperation with the EU, without insisting that Russia abide by stable rules.

zh: 但是，公开敌视俄国将会让欧盟难以取得俄国在一堆共同问题上的帮助，这些问题包括环境污染、非法移民、核子扩散以及科索沃的最终地位问题。
en: Open hostility toward Russia, however, will make it hard for the EU to draw on Russia’s help to tackle a host of common problems - from environmental pollution and illegal migration, to nuclear proliferation and Kosovo’s final status.

zh: 欧盟现在急需一个新的策略。
en: The EU urgently needs a new approach.

zh: 它不应该试图将俄国民主化或者遏制俄国，而是应该确定更为有限的、将俄国转变为可靠的、受到法治制约的夥伴的目标。
en: Rather than attempt to democratize or contain Russia, the Union should settle on the more limited goal of turning Russia into a reliable partner, bound by the rule of law.

zh: 共同策略将会给欧盟多种手段来确保俄国遵守条约和共同协议。
en: A common approach will give the EU many powerful levers to ensure that Russia honors treaties and mutual agreements.

zh: 在外交层面上，欧洲可以威胁剥夺俄国参加工业八强和俄欧高峰会议所带来的威望。
en: At the diplomatic level, Europeans could threaten to deprive Russia of the prestige it draws from participating in G8 and EU-Russia Summits.

zh: 它们还应该力图通过加强与诸如格鲁吉亚和乌克兰的关系而在欧洲近邻强化民主和法治。
en: They should also aim to strengthen democracy and the rule of law in the European neighborhood by tightening relations with countries such as Georgia and Ukraine.

zh: 还应该使用经济杠杆。
en: Economic leverage should be applied as well.

zh: 欧洲应该加强审查俄国在欧盟市场上的投资并且使用竞争法规来对垄断做法和现有投资活动的洗钱进行调查。
en: Europeans should subject Russian investments in EU markets to greater scrutiny and use competition law to launch investigations into monopolistic practices and money laundering for existing investments.

zh: 与此同时，欧盟成员国可以通过审查克里姆林宫精英人物购买西方资产而瞄准其利益，甚至可以禁止违犯人权者前往欧盟旅行。
en: At the same time, EU members could target the interests of the individuals in the Kremlin elite by scrutinizing their purchases of Western assets, and even ban travel to the EU for human rights abusers.

zh: 只要欧盟继续在融入和遏制之间摇摆不定，它就会继续在克里姆林宫面前显得软弱和举棋不定。
en: So long as the EU continues to sway between integration and containment, it will continue to appear to the Kremlin as weak and directionless.

zh: 这反过来将会鼓励俄国变得更为嚣张。
en: That, in turn, will merely encourage Russia to become even more assertive.

zh: 欧洲的下一个单一市场
en: Europe’s Next Single Market

zh: 当前的欧盟委员会已经明确承诺改正其官僚文牍作风。 具体作法是采用一种可以将我们法律提案的数量控制在最少限度的规则制定方式。
en: The current European Commission has made clear its commitment to reducing bureaucratic red tape by adopting an approach to regulation that keeps the number of laws we propose to an absolute minimum.

zh: 我们对此事态度严肃。
en: We are serious about this.

zh: 但我们为立法减负的承诺必须和使我们现有的法律有效的同等承诺相适应。
en: But our commitment to reducing the amount of legislation must be matched by an equal commitment to making what we have really count.

zh: 这是一项共同的责任，成员国都应该各尽其责。
en: This is a shared responsibility, and member states have to play their part.

zh: 直到布鲁塞尔通过的法律在国内法中生效并得到有效实施之前，它们完全就是没牙的纸老虎。
en: Until laws adopted in Brussels are enacted in national law and properly enforced, they remain paper tigers, entirely without teeth.

zh: 在布鲁塞尔通过的大多数法律都允许一个宽限期—通常是两年—让成员国采取行动。
en: Most laws adopted in Brussels allow a grace period – generally about two years – for member states to act.

zh: 各成员国自定最后期限，所以时间应该不成问题。
en: Member states set this deadline themselves, so it should be more than enough time.

zh: 在宽限期之后， 就不应该再有任何借口了。
en: After that, there should be no excuses.

zh: 十年前，布鲁塞尔通过的单一市场法律数量与在各成员国生效的法律数量之间的差距—被称为“转换赤字 ” — 是6 % 。
en: Ten years ago, the gap between the number of single-market laws adopted in Brussels and those in force in the member states – known as the “transposition deficit” – stood at 6%.

zh: 面对这样一个不良纪录，欧洲理事会在2001年承诺实现使该赤字在任何时候都不高于1.5%的目标。
en: Faced with this poor record, in 2001 the European Council committed itself to achieving a target of no more than 1.5% at any given time.

zh: 自那段时期以来，我们经历了一些波折，但大多数成员国都在理顺相关内务方面付出了巨大的努力。
en: In the period since, we have had our ups and downs, but most member states have made a considerable effort to get their house in order.

zh: 平均转换赤字有史以来第一次降到了1.5%以下，达到1.2 % 。
en: For the very first time, the average deficit has fallen below 1.5%, standing at 1.2%.

zh: 另外，所有的成员国都取得了进步，尤以丹麦和拉脱维亚—都只差5个指令就实现完美达标—为最佳。
en: What is more, all member states have made progress, with Denmark and Latvia – both five directives away from a perfect record – sharing first place.

zh: 这是一项重要的成就，但它不应该成为我们松懈的信号。
en: This is an important achievement, but it should not be taken as a signal to relax.

zh: 相反，我们应该自问是否到了设立更严格的目标的时候了。
en: On the contrary, we should ask whether the time has not come to set even more stringent targets.

zh: 同时还应该借此机会审视我们在哪些方面还继续存在不足。
en: And it is also time to take a more detailed look at where we continue to fall short.

zh: 当各成员国在布鲁塞尔签署通过法律时，它们就接受了实施这些法律的绝对义务。
en: When member states sign up to laws in Brussels, they accept an absolute obligation to be bound by them.

zh: 当它们未能实现承诺时，就辜负了本应从中受益的消费者和公司。
en: When they fail to live up to their commitments, they fail in their duty to the consumers and businesses that stand to benefit.

zh: 也不能用总体的良好结果来遮掩某些方面的问题—比如，占欧洲GDP15%至20%的公共采购。
en: Nor should good overall results be permitted to mask problems in particular areas – public procurement, for example, which accounts for between 15% and 20% of Europe’s GDP.

zh: 开放市场并实施欧洲的法规可以有效地为各成员国政府节省开支并使纳税人的税金实现更好的价值。
en: Opening up markets and applying European rules properly produces savings for governments and delivers better value for taxpayers’ money.

zh: 因此，我在这里对2004年在这一领域通过的一揽子方案深表失望。 有几个成员国未能在既定的期限内转换这套旨在使流程简单化和现代化的方案。
en: I am, therefore, deeply disappointed that a package of measures adopted in this area in 2004 – aimed at simplifying and modernizing procedures – has not been transposed within the agreed deadline by several member states.

zh: 我警告那些还没有行动的成员国，我将会采用一切必要的手段来迫使他们采取行动。
en: I warn those that have not yet acted that I will take whatever steps are necessary to make them act.

zh: 我们不能够在继续自我承诺建设一个更具竞争力的欧洲但同时却拒绝实现这一目标的手段。
en: We cannot continue to commit ourselves to delivering a more competitive Europe while denying ourselves the means to achieve it.

zh: 但降低转换赤字固然重要，却不是这场博弈的结束。
en: But reducing the transposition deficit, while important, is not the end of the game.

zh: 使法律写入国内法典是一回事，确保它们得到有效实施和执行则是另外一回事了。
en: Getting laws onto national statute books is one thing, ensuring they are properly applied and enforced is another.

zh: 法律转换成效卓越，但在实际操作上情况就不那么漂亮了。
en: And while the story is good on transposition, it is less rosy when it comes to how things are working on the ground.

zh: 虽然有8个成员国成功地减少了欧盟委员会提起的违反欧盟法律的个案数量，但仍有17个成员国今年在这方面与去年持平以至更甚。
en: Eight member states have managed to reduce the number of infringement cases taken against them by the Commission, but 17 have as many or more than they did this time last year.

zh: 我赞赏各成员国之间建立紧密的合作和伙伴关系，我也准备尽我所能与它们合作从而帮助它们正确地转换和实施欧盟法律。
en: I appreciate that close cooperation and partnership with member states are required, and I am ready to work with them in whatever way I can to help them to transpose and apply EU law correctly.

zh: 我倾向于避免陷入成本高昂而旷日持久的违法案件诉讼。
en: I prefer to avoid infringement cases, which are costly and time consuming.

zh: 但各成员国现在应该已经了解到我不是个手软的人。
en: But member states should know by now that I am not a soft touch.

zh: 我的责任是确保法律得到不偏不倚的执行，这也是我会继续从事的工作。
en: My job is to ensure that the law is enforced without fear or favor, and that is what I will continue to do.

zh: 单一市场是欧盟最伟大的成就之一。
en: The single market is one of the European Union’s greatest achievements.

zh: 为人员、商品、服务和资本的自由流动扫清障碍给整个欧洲大陆上的人们带来了伟大的繁荣，锤炼了我们内部的实力，增加了我们在国际上的份量。
en: Removing barriers to the free movement of people, goods, services, and capital has brought greater prosperity to people across the Continent, hones our skills internally, and gives us weight internationally.

zh: 当我们在20年前大力推动单一市场时，只有12个成员国。
en: When we made the big push for the single market 20 years ago, there were just 12 member states.

zh: 现在我们有了27个。
en: Now there are 27.

zh: 欧洲发生了巨变。
en: Europe is a very different place.

zh: 我们还经历了一场影响到生活方方面面的通信与技术革命。
en: We have also undergone a communications and technological revolution that has touched every aspect of our lives.

zh: 在众多的新机遇为欧洲公民和公司开启的同时，在贸易和投资方面的全球竞争也更为严酷。
en: While immense new opportunities have opened up for Europe's citizens and businesses, global competition for trade and investment has never been tougher.

zh: 今年晚些时候，欧盟委员会将开展一次单一市场评估以确保欧洲有足够的准备面对未来。
en: Later this year, the Commission will bring forward a review of the single market to ensure that Europe is ready for what lies ahead.

zh: 这是一次改革和更新的重要机遇。
en: This is an important opportunity for reform and renewal.

zh: 一个现代的单一市场应该反映现代的需求，我们应该将努力投入到最有成效的领域。
en: A modern single market should reflect modern needs, and we should concentrate our efforts where they can have most effect.

zh: 我们需要一套优先战略以应对人们的需求和期望—工作、成长和安全。
en: We need a set of priorities that responds to what people want and expect – jobs, growth, and security.

zh: 为了适应快速的变化，我们需要在监管方面保持灵活。
en: To cope with rapid change, we need to be flexible when it comes to regulation.

zh: 我们必须接受并不是所有事物都可以集中管理的事实，这就意味着更多的信任和伙伴关系，但还要有更强的担当未来责任的意愿。
en: We need to accept that not everything can be run from the center, which means more trust and more partnership, but also more willingness to shoulder responsibility further down the line.

zh: 的确，如果我们要成功地建立一个向世界开放，能不断提升内部实力，并在国际环境形成方面举足轻重的单一市场，那么我们在欧盟层面上的努力就必须要有各成员国层面上的努力来配合。
en: Indeed, if we are to succeed in creating a single market that is open to the world, builds on its internal strengths, and is at the cutting edge when it comes to shaping the international environment, our efforts at the EU level have to be matched by efforts at the national level.

zh: 我赞扬个成员国已经付出的努力，但我们还能做得更好。
en: I commend the member states for the efforts they have made, but we can all do better.

zh: 欧洲的下一步
en: Europe’s Next Steps

zh: 发生在伦敦的恐怖主义事件以及法、荷两国否决欧盟宪法条约使欧洲悲观论再次盛行。
en: Terrorism in London and the French and Dutch rejections of the European Union’s Constitutional Treaty have brought Euro-pessimism back into fashion.

zh: 六月欧盟峰会的失败及托尼·布莱尔和雅克·希拉克之间的龃龉加深甚至促使某些人宣称欧洲末日已经开始。
en: The failure of the June EU summit and the bitter clashes between Tony Blair and Jacques Chirac have even inspired some to proclaim the beginning of the end for Europe.

zh: 他们错了。
en: They are wrong.

zh: 欧洲没有消亡，也不会消亡。
en: Europe is neither dead nor dying.

zh: 但是最近的一些事件却宣告了欧洲一体化 — — 即建立一个会成为超级强权的全新联邦国家的“前所未有的紧密联盟”的说法的终结。
en: But recent events do spell the end of one version of European integration – the vision of an “ever closer union” producing a federal country that would become a new superpower.

zh: 然而，即使没有最近的一系列挫折，这个说法也难以实现。
en: That vision, however, was not in the cards even before the recent setbacks.

zh: 一旦欧盟六个中心创始国开始扩张欧盟以吸纳北欧、南欧以及最近加入的东欧国家，联邦国家的陈旧说法就注定失败。
en: Once the original six core countries began to expand to include northern, southern, and, most recently, eastern European countries, the old federal vision was doomed.

zh: 宪法是为了使一个拥有25个成员国的欧盟变得更有效率，而不是产生一个强大的联邦制国家。
en: The constitution was designed to make a Europe of 25 members more efficient, not produce a strong federal state.

zh: 希拉克的言辞中经常提到一个美国不再是唯一超级霸权的“多极世界 ” 。
en: Chirac’s rhetoric often includes references to a “multi-polar world” in which the United States is no longer the only superpower.

zh: 最近的佩尤民意调查发现，许多欧洲人已经失去了对美国的兴趣并且希望欧洲在世界政治中扮演更重要的角色。
en: A recent Pew poll found that many Europeans have lost their attraction to the US and would like Europe to play a larger role in world politics.

zh: 但是即使美国已经失去其一部分有魅力的“软力量 ” ， 处于后工业社会的欧洲公民们也不愿意为用于平衡欧洲硬力量的军事力量所需的投资付钱，这笔款项将占国内生产总值（GDP）内国防经费的两倍或三倍。
en: But even if America has lost some of its attractive “soft power,” Europe’s post-industrial publics are not willing to pay the price – a doubling or tripling of defense spending as a share of GDP – to invest in the military power that would be required to balance its hard power.

zh: 即使是这样，欧洲的前景也不像悲观主义者所设想的那样黯淡。
en: Even so, the picture for Europe is not as bleak as pessimists assume.

zh: 当今世界政治的力量分布就宛若一个三维国际象棋，阡陌纵横。
en: Power in world politics today is distributed like a three-dimensional chess game that is played vertically as well as horizontally.

zh: 在军事力量的顶层棋盘上，美国是世界唯一具备影响全球能力的超级霸权。
en: On the top board of military relations among states, the US is the world’s only superpower with global reach.

zh: 欧洲和中国难以在今后二十年内赶超美国。
en: Europe or China are unlikely to overtake the Americans in the next two decades.

zh: 在这里，世界还是单极的。
en: Here the world is uni-polar.

zh: 在经济关系的中层棋盘上，全球已经化为多极局面。
en: On the middle board of economic relations, the world is already multi-polar.

zh: 在这个棋盘上，欧洲以一个联盟身份行动，其他诸如日本和中国等国也发挥着举足轻重的作用。
en: This is the board where Europe acts as a union, and other countries like Japan and China play significant roles.

zh: 美国无法在欧盟委员会（EU Commission）不赞成的情形下达成某个贸易协议或解决某个反垄断案例。
en: The US cannot reach a trade agreement or settle anti-trust cases without the approval of the EU Commission.

zh: 就在最近，在世贸组织赞同欧洲的诉讼后，美国国会不得不以几十亿美元的代价修改税法。
en: Just recently, after the World Trade Organization ruled in favor of a European complaint, the US Congress had to rewrite billions of dollars of tax legislation.

zh: 这完全不符合单极世界的特性。
en: This hardly fits the description of a uni-polar world.

zh: 棋盘的底层包括政府控制之外、超越边疆的跨国关系 — — 从毒品到传染病到气候变化到跨国恐怖主义等每件事情。
en: The bottom board includes transnational relations that cross borders outside the control of governments – everything from drugs to infectious diseases to climate change to transnational terrorism.

zh: 在这个棋盘上，各种力量无序地分布于各个非国家行动组织中。
en: On this board, power is distributed chaotically among non-state actors.

zh: 没有政府能够在不与其他政府合作的情况下控制结果。
en: No government can control outcomes without the cooperation of others.

zh: 在这里，美国需要欧洲人的帮助，把这个世界称为单极世界也同样毫无道理。
en: Here the US needs the help of Europeans, and it makes no sense to call this world uni-polar, either.

zh: 在这个底层棋盘中，同样至关重要的还有民间合作的紧密程度，它受到国家吸引力或软力量的直接影响。
en: On this bottom board, the degree of close civilian cooperation is also important, which is affected by a country’s attractiveness or soft power.

zh: 在这里欧洲国家表现良好，他们克服了几个世纪以来彼此之间的仇恨并发展了一个巨大且成功的市场。
en: Here European countries are well endowed, having overcome centuries of animosity and developing a large successful market.

zh: 最近的挫折所带来的一个危险就是欧盟扩张停滞不前。
en: One danger of the recent setbacks is a halt to EU enlargement.

zh: 冷战末期，东欧国家并没有像他们在1920年代所做的那样试图形成一个当地联盟，而是把欧共体总部看作吸引他们未来的磁场。
en: At the Cold War’s end, East European countries did not try to form local alliances, as they did in the 1920’s, but looked toward Brussels as the magnet for their futures.

zh: 同样地，诸如土耳其、乌克兰等国也调整了他们的政策，因为他们也被欧洲所吸引。
en: Similarly, countries like Turkey and Ukraine have adjusted their policies because they are attracted to Europe.

zh: 对进一步扩张的反对之声所暗示的软力量缺失对欧洲、巴尔干半岛地区和国际稳定而言，都是一个大挫。
en: The loss of soft power implied by rejection of further enlargement would be a setback for Europe, the Balkans, and international stability.

zh: 欧盟下一步该如何走呢？
en: What will the EU do next?

zh: 一些人建议，应该重回以六个创始国作为内部中心、在更大联盟内建立一个联邦制的状态。
en: Some counsel retreating to the original six countries as an inner core that creates a federation within the larger union.

zh: 这个方法吸引了一部分人，这些人认为法国和荷兰的公民投票是对英国自由经济模式的反对。
en: This approach appeals to those who think that the French and Dutch referendums were a rejection of the British liberal economic model.

zh: 但是这个分析颇有可疑之处，因为民意测验表明，那些许多投反对票的人反对希拉克并/或对居高不下的失业率心存不满。
en: But that diagnosis is suspect, because polls show that many who voted “non” were objecting to Chirac and/or to high rates of unemployment.

zh: 退回到欧盟创始六国的状态不可能解决这些顾虑，对欧洲经济需要再接再厉的劳力市场自由化进程也无甚好处。
en: Turning backward and inward to the original six EU members is unlikely to meet such concerns, and augurs poorly for the liberalization of labor markets that Europe’s economies need to get moving.

zh: 对欧盟而言，更好的办法是表现出欧洲依然有用。
en: A better path for the EU is to show that Europe still works.

zh: 这意味着对新预算进行妥协，该预算将削减一部分共同农业政策的支出并将资金用于对去年新加入的成员国的一体化进程上。
en: This means a compromise on a new budget that curtails some of the expenditure on the common agricultural policy and devotes funds to integrating the new members who joined last year.

zh: 这也意味着继续欧洲在外交政策中所扮演的重要角色，诸如说服塞尔维亚在科索沃的未来地���上达成一致，或者继续劝说伊朗放弃其浓缩铀计划。
en: It also means carrying on with the important role that Europe plays in foreign policy such as attracting Serbia to reach agreement on the future status of Kosovo, or continuing efforts to persuade Iran to give up its plans for the enrichment of uranium.

zh: 同样重要的还有加紧世贸组织多哈回合的谈判，并把过去对非洲实行援助的承诺坚持到底。
en: Equally important will be to press ahead with the Doha round of WTO trade talks, and to follow through with past commitments regarding aid to Africa.

zh: 最终，在尘埃落定之后，才有可能在各政府之间达成协议以共同理清某些在新宪法条约通过之前应该解决的制度管理问题。
en: Eventually, after the dust has settled, it may be possible to reach inter-governmental agreements to tidy up some of the institutional arrangements that would have been settled if the new constitution had been approved.

zh: 这样一个实际高效的欧盟也许不会达到政治家们惯用的华藻辞令中所称的雄伟期望，但是它却不会被淘汰。
en: Such a practical, effective EU may not reach the lofty rhetorical aspirations beloved by politicians, but it will not be moribund.

zh: 相反，这样一个欧洲不仅能为世界其他国家作出贡献，也能为自己赢得很多。
en: On the contrary, such a Europe has a lot to gain for itself as well as to contribute to the rest of the world.

zh: 奥巴马带给欧洲的挑战
en: Europe's Obama Challenge

zh: 巴黎—2009年和巴拉克·奥巴马开始担任总统会标志着跨大西洋关系开始进入一个新时代吗？ 或者经济危机的纵深度和严重性会让过去的分裂徘徊不去？
en: PARIS – Will the year 2009 and the beginning of Barack Obama’s presidency mark the beginning of a new era in transatlantic relations, or will the old divisions linger, nurtured by the depth and gravity of the economic crisis?

zh: 这一危机将会使大西洋两岸出现民族主义的和只顾自己的态度，阻碍期待已久的关系好转吗？ 如果不是完全恢复这种关系的话？
en: Will the crisis lead to nationalistic and selfish attitudes on both sides of the Atlantic, stymieing the long-awaited rapprochement, if not a full reconciliation?

zh: 当然，要下定论还为时过早。
en: It is, of course, too early to tell.

zh: 即使欧洲左派中的左翼—相当于美国民主党中最自由的派别—表示担心奥巴马已经选定了一个过于温和的内阁，反美国主义的传统形式也必然在欧洲暂停。
en: Even if the left wing of the European left – like the most liberal of America’s Democrats – voices concerns that Obama has selected a far too centrist cabinet, a classical form of anti-Americanism is bound to recede in Europe.

zh: 欧洲人几乎不可能走上街头去谴责美国的“本质 ” （ 即美国是什么和美国在干什么 ） ， 而在布什时代甚至克林顿时代他们就这样做了。
en: It is very unlikely that Europeans will take to the streets to denounce the “essence” of the United States – what America is as much as what America does – as they did during the Bush era and even during the Clinton years.

zh: 自从11月4日以来，美国在欧洲的形象已经大变，而一旦奥巴马接任总统，他的外交风格可能还会巩固这种变化。
en: America’s image in Europe has changed profoundly since November 4, and the style of Obama’s diplomacy once he becomes president will probably confirm that change.

zh: 但在大西洋两岸的关系领域过多地指望一个人，无论他有多少独特之处，都是不明智的。 这也同样适用于全球关系。
en: Yet in the realm of transatlantic relations, as is true globally, it is unwise to expect too much from a single man, whatever his exceptional qualities.

zh: 根本性的问题依然还在，新的问题也可能发生。
en: Fundamental problems remain, and new ones are likely to emerge.

zh: 首先，无论在弗拉基米尔·普金和德米特里·梅德维杰夫治下的新俄罗斯行事多么蛮横，苏联已经不复存在，也不再构成对欧美的共同威胁，这种威胁直到1989年都把欧美黏在一起。
en: First, whatever the brutal style of the new Russia under Vladimir Putin and Dmitri Medvedev, the Soviet Union no longer exists and no longer constitutes the common threat that was the “glue” of the Alliance until 1989.

zh: 除非发生了相当离谱的事，新的冷战不会开始。
en: Unless something very wrong happens, a new cold war is not about to start.

zh: 第二，欧洲和美国看待彼此的方式之间存在一种持续的结构失衡：欧洲带着热情关注美国，而美国对欧洲兴趣一般，而且越来越不关心。
en: Second, there is a continuing structural imbalance between the way Europe looks at America, i.e., with passion and concern, and the way America looks at Europe, i.e., with mild interest giving way to growing indifference.

zh: 冷战时期，欧洲曾是美国的第一道防线。
en: During the Cold War, Europe was America’s first line of defense.

zh: 而在当下的全球时代，美国将优先考虑亚洲，中东，甚至可能是非洲。
en: In the current global age, Asia, the Middle East, and even maybe Africa will constitute greater priorities for the US.

zh: 第三，即使奥巴马治下的美国提出，甚至施行多边主义，美国人也远远没有准备好接受一个多极的世界。
en: Third, even if America under Obama praises and even practices multilateralism, Americans are far from ready to accept the reality of a multi-polar world.

zh: 他们可能会就它的概念写些东西，但是它的含义—在这个世界中他们的国家仅仅是“资格最老的那个 ” — 并没有真正深入这个国家的精神。
en: They may write about it conceptually, but its meaning – a world in which their country is only “primus inter pares” – has not really penetrated the national psyche.

zh: 美国的国际主义建立在“美国例外论”的观念上，事关一种独特的角色和使命感。
en: America’s internationalism remains grounded in the idea of American “exceptionalism” – a unique role and sense of mission.

zh: 这种处理世界问题的方法很难让欧洲人妥协接受。
en: It is an approach to the world with which Europeans have great difficulty coming to terms.

zh: 即使由奥巴马担任总统，他们也可能很快就交织在一起的傲慢和伪善发起谴责，这在他们看来是和美国“特殊又独特的使命”联系在一起的。
en: Even with Obama as president, they may be quick to denounce the combination of arrogance and hypocrisy that they see as linked to America’s view of her “special and unique mission.”

zh: 第四，如果美国的外交在形式和内容上发生变化，在美国要求帮助的时候，欧洲准备好应对挑战了吗？
en: Fourth, if US diplomacy changes in style and content, will Europe be ready to face the challenge when America calls for help?

zh: 先期考验可能事关阿富汗：奥巴马微笑而坚决地直接表示 ： “ 你们已经很支持我了。
en: One early test is likely to be Afghanistan, when a smiling but firm Obama turns to Europe and says directly: “You have backed me in immense numbers.

zh: 我谢谢你们。
en: I thank you for it.

zh: 但是现在我不需要你们象征性的投票，我需要你们具体的援助。
en: But now I do not need your symbolic votes; I need your concrete support.

zh: 我需要你们的部队更多地介入阿富汗。 ”
en: I need the further engagement of your troops in Afghanistan!”

zh: 我怀疑欧洲领袖不会做出激烈反应。
en: I suspect that European leaders will not respond eagerly.

zh: 大多数人都被说服接受阿富汗的问题不能用军事解决，他们也知道公众没有兴趣开展这样的行动，尤其是在经济极其困难的时期。
en: Most are convinced that there is no military solution in Afghanistan and they know that public opinion, especially in time of great economic hardship, has no appetite for such operations.

zh: 欧洲人有倾向于既谴责美国的军事冒险主义又依赖美国保护的传统。
en: Europeans have a traditional tendency to denounce American military adventurism while relying on the US as their protector.

zh: 第五 ， “ 老”问题之外我们必须加上一个新问题： 好几十年来最严重的金融危机可能对大西洋两岸关系造成的影响。
en: Fifth, to these “old” problems one must add a new one: the likely impact on transatlantic relations of the worst financial crisis in decades.

zh: 不可能是传统意义上的保护主义，因为我们已经汲取了1929年的教训。
en: Protectionism in the classical sense of the term is unlikely. We have learned the lessons of 1929.

zh: 但是向“龙头产业”提供公众援助可能被证实会对国际合作氛围造成破坏，就像关税壁垒过去所做的那样。
en: But public subsidies to “national champions” may prove to be as destabilizing for the climate of international cooperation as tariff barriers were in the past.

zh: 随着危机深入，使用民粹主义的利己措施来“安抚”受苦民众的诱惑可能会加剧。
en: The temptation to “appease” suffering populations with populist, selfish measures may grow as the crisis deepens.

zh: 自相矛盾之处还在于，一个“变绿”的美国—一个虽然晚了些才发现自己在地球幸存中的责任，却满怀热情的美国—可能会使得大西洋两岸竞相争取在生态保护中力拔头筹。
en: Paradoxically, too, the “greening” of America – an America that discovers late but with passion its responsibility for the planet’s survival – may lead to a competitive transatlantic race for first prize in ecological good behavior.

zh: 有可能发生的冲突还可以成倍增加，从核裁军—法国裁得太多，其他国家太少���到和伊朗，俄罗斯和中国打交道的最佳方法。
en: And one could multiply the subjects of possible tensions, from nuclear disarmament – too much for the French, too little for many others – to the best ways to deal with Iran, Russia, and China.

zh: 还有其他很重要的事情。
en: The essential issue lies elsewhere.

zh: 对于欧洲而言，巴拉克·奥巴马当选是一场至关重要的考验。
en: For Europe, the election of Barack Obama is a crucial test.

zh: 欧洲能否相时而动，抓住机会（这是由美国做出勇敢热情的选择而创造出来的 ） ， 从而向它自己和世界证明，老欧洲依然能够作为一种政治力量和一个统一的整体存在呢？
en: Will Europe rise to the occasion and seize the opportunity created by America’s daring and exhilarating choice to prove to itself and to the world that the old continent can exist as a power and a united actor?

zh: 财政紧缩与欧洲社会
en: Fiscal Austerity Versus European Society

zh: 华盛顿—在过去五年中，在没有明确的群众支持的情况下，欧元区的政策焦点严格地集中于财政紧缩和结构改革上 — — 尽管这掀起了巨大的社会反弹，不仅在地中海周边和爱尔兰是如此，甚至在法国等欧盟“核心”国家也是如此。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Over the last five years, the eurozone has, without explicit popular consent, maintained a strict policy focus on fiscal austerity and structural reforms – despite serious social repercussions, not only in the Mediterranean periphery and Ireland, but even in a “core" European Union country like France.

zh: 除非欧元区领导人反思这一方针，否则极端政党左翼联盟（Syriza）在最近的希腊大选中获胜将只是欧洲滑向社会分裂和政治动荡过程中的一小步。
en: Unless eurozone leaders rethink their approach, the radical Syriza party's success in Greece's recent general election could turn out to be just one more step toward a future of social fragmentation and political instability in Europe.

zh: 或者它也可以标志着务实而有益的欧洲经济战略再转向的开端。
en: Or it could mark the beginning of a realistic and beneficial re-orientation of Europe's economic strategy.

zh: 当然，财政稳定是防止破坏性债务重组、激发投资者和消费者信心的关键。
en: Of course, fiscal sustainability is vital to prevent a disruptive debt refinancing and inspire confidence among investors and consumers.

zh: 但不可否认，当你足够富裕因此不必依赖公共政策或者面临长期失业的巨大风险时，支持财政紧缩会容易得多。
en: But there is no denying that it is much easier to support fiscal austerity when one is wealthy enough not to rely on public services or be at serious risk of becoming mired in long-term unemployment.

zh: （富人还掌握着媒体、公共话语权和跨国资本流。 ）
en: (The wealthy also remain largely in control of the media, the public discourse, and cross-border capital flows.)

zh: 对数百万工人来说 — — 特别是年轻人 — — 没有工作前景，财政可持续性就不可能成为仅有的优先考虑项。
en: For the millions of workers – and especially young people – with no job prospects, fiscal sustainability simply cannot be the only priority.

zh: 当失业救济大幅减少时，他们就会沦为受害者。
en: When unemployment benefits are slashed, they are the ones who suffer.

zh: 而当预算削减影响到教育时，他们的孩子就无法获得实现未来潜力所需要的技能。
en: And when budget cuts extend to education, it is their children who are unable to gain the skills they need to reach their future potential.

zh: 紧缩导致的痛苦在希腊尤为极端。
en: Austerity-induced suffering is particularly extreme in Greece.

zh: 大量养老金削减让老年人无法有尊严地安享晚年。
en: Severe pension cuts are preventing the elderly from living out their lives with dignity.

zh: 大量负担落到了实际缴税的人身上，而许多人 — — 通常是最富有人群，他们早就开始将钱移往国外 — — 继续逃避着义务。
en: A large burden has been placed on those who actually pay their taxes, while many – often the wealthiest, who long ago stashed their money abroad – continue to evade their obligations.

zh: 医疗崩溃，许多癌症患者无法获得救命治疗。
en: Health care has lapsed, with many cancer patients losing access to life-saving treatment.

zh: 自杀率也在攀升。
en: Suicides are on the rise.

zh: 但希腊债权人继续忽视这些趋势。
en: Yet Greece's creditors have continued to ignore these developments.

zh: 社会可持续性对长期经济成功来说至关重要。
en: Social sustainability is essential for long-term economic success.

zh: 如果教育体系缺少资源和能力让儿童做好在数字经济中实现繁荣的准备，一国就不可能繁荣。
en: A country cannot prosper if its educational system lacks the resources and capacity to prepare its children to thrive in the digital economy.

zh: 类似地，如果不平等性、贫困和社会不满强化了极端主义政党 — — 如公然宣扬法西斯主义的希腊金色黎明党（Golden Dawn）和极右翼的反欧洲政党法国国民阵线（National Front，目前已获得25%的选举支持率 ） — —改革方案就无法实施。
en: Likewise, a reform program cannot be implemented if inequality, poverty, and social frustration strengthen extremist political parties, such as Greece's overtly fascist Golden Dawn party or France's far-right, anti-Europe National Front, which now boasts 25% electoral support.

zh: 世道艰难时，移民和少数群体很容易成为目标。
en: When times are tough, immigrants and minorities become easy targets.

zh: 大城市周边的贫民区的一些人 — — 不管他们人数多么少 — — 被暴力所引诱加入恐怖组织也绝不可能是是件好事。
en: It does not help when some of those trapped in the poor ghettos surrounding major cities – however small a minority – become tempted by violence and fall prey to terrorist recruiters.

zh: 不管今天公司利润报告和股市指数表现多好，如果这些基本社会问题得不到正确的解决，一国就无法实现包容性可持续成功 — — 不管在经济上还是在人道角度上。
en: Regardless of what today's corporate profit reports and stock indices may show, a country cannot achieve inclusive, sustainable success – in economic or human terms – if these fundamental social issues are not adequately addressed.

zh: 当然，也不能放弃财政谨慎；毕竟，如果政府或私人部门可以自由使用借来或新印出来的钱，结果肯定是更多的危机，而受危机冲击最大的正是穷人。
en: Of course, fiscal caution cannot be abandoned; after all, if governments or the private sector were to spend borrowed or newly minted money freely, the result would simply be more crises, which would hurt the poor most.

zh: 但社会可持续性必须成为一国经济计划的一部分，而不是事后再去考虑的东西。
en: But social sustainability must be an integral part of a country's economic program, not an afterthought.

zh: 在社会可持续性问题上一直打嘴炮，而真正实施的经济计划对紧缩毫不放松，这就是欧洲政治动荡的主要因素。
en: The persistent tendency to pay lip service to social sustainability, while implementing economic programs focused on unrelenting austerity, is a leading cause of political instability in Europe.

zh: 尽管旨在构建可行宏观经济框架的改革计划仍然至关重要，但它们必须包括强大的反周期政策内容以抵消“节俭悖论 ” （ 在衰退期储蓄更多、破坏经济增长的倾向 ） 。
en: Though reform programs aimed at building viable macroeconomic frameworks remain essential, they must include strong provisions for countercyclical policies to offset the “paradox of thrift" (the tendency to save more during a recession, undermining economic growth).

zh: 当总需求落后于总供给时，政府应该增加公共支出。
en: When aggregate demand falls short of aggregate supply, governments must increase public spending.

zh: 此外，现在狭隘地专注于微观经济问题的政府需要以同样程度的注意力和精力用于制定和实施明确专注于确保人口中最脆弱群体的民生、卫生、教育和住房问题的社会政策。
en: Moreover, governments that are now focused narrowly on microeconomic issues need to devote the same level of attention and commitment to designing and implementing social policies that focus explicitly on ensuring the livelihoods, health, education, and housing of the most vulnerable segments of the population.

zh: 此外，通过使用新技术分析大数据，它们还可以增加社会计划的效果，同时鼓励相关公民的积极参与。
en: And, using new technology to analyze large amounts of data, they should boost the efficiency of social programs, while encouraging the active participation of concerned citizens.

zh: 欧盟委员会和IMF已经承认了错误 — — 不但包括作为希腊计划依据的不准确的宏观经济预测，也包括不考虑社会可持续性的决定 — — 并且承认了它们的计划没有产生预期效果。
en: The European Commission and the IMF have admitted their errors – not only the inaccurate macroeconomic forecasts on which the Greek program was based, but also the decision not to account for social sustainability – and have acknowledged that the program has not produced the expected results.

zh: 但是，出于某些原因，希腊债权人拒绝与（国内支持率极高的）新政府谈判制定包括债务纾困、降低财政盈余和支持增长和促进社会凝聚力的结构改革在内的新计划。
en: Yet, for some reason, Greece's creditors refuse to negotiate with the new government (which enjoys strong domestic support) to develop a new program that incorporates debt relief, a lower fiscal surplus, and structural reforms that support growth and promote social cohesion.

zh: 决不能放任这一状况继续下去。
en: This must not continue.

zh: 过去五年彰显出实现金融稳定的挑战。
en: The last five years have underscored the challenge of achieving financial stability.

zh: 但政治和社会稳定更加难以获得。
en: But political and social stability have proved to be even more elusive.

zh: 欧洲的未来繁荣 — — 及其全球角色 — — 取决于此。
en: Europe's future prosperity – and its global role – depends on it.

zh: 奥朗德给欧洲带来的机会
en: Europe’s Opportunity in Hollande

zh: 布鲁塞尔—很少有哪次选举如同此次法国总统竞选那样在整个欧盟引起如此深刻的共振。
en: BRUSSELS – Rarely has an election resonated so widely across the European Union as the French presidential ballot has done.

zh: 很少有哪次欧盟成员国领导人变化如此次引起人们对实际政策变迁的猜想。
en: Rarely has a leadership change in one EU member state created expectations of a real policy shift.

zh: 全新的欧洲样板和公共氛围正在经济危机中形成，这一点颇为引人注目。
en: Remarkably, a new European demos and public sphere are emerging from the economic crisis.

zh: 欧洲人正在认识到他们有多么互相依赖。
en: Europeans are recognizing how interdependent they are.

zh: 一个国家的失败可以威胁到整个欧洲经济，可以引起人们对欧洲60年一体化成果的质疑。
en: One country’s failures can threaten the entire European economy, and can call into question the fruits of 60 years of integration.

zh: 和平、团结和繁荣不再是不可逆转的成就；只有27个国家同心共力才能保证这些成就。
en: Peace, solidarity, and prosperity are not irreversible achievements; only 27 countries working together can guarantee them.

zh: 奥朗德的获胜对欧洲来说是一次全新的机会。
en: François Hollande’s victory is a fresh chance for Europe.

zh: 它可以称为一根筋紧缩政策的终结，正是这一政策阻碍了我们的经济、让欧盟陷于分裂。 法国新总统承诺采取欧洲增长措施给公民带来了希望，应该也不会让任何人感到紧张 — — 至少金融市场肯定不会。
en: It should spell the end of a policy oriented exclusively towards austerity, which has paralyzed our economies and divided the EU. The new French president’s commitment to a European growth policy has brought hope to citizens, and should not alarm anyone – certainly not the financial markets.

zh: 奥朗德的增长计划拥有雄厚的支持基础，特别是在再三呼吁如此行动的欧洲议会中。
en: Hollande’s plans for a growth initiative fall on fertile ground, especially in the European Parliament, which has repeatedly called for such measures.

zh: 我很高兴地看到，这一信号正在得到越来越多的政治主流的响应，包括欧洲央行行长德拉吉。
en: I am delighted that this message is increasingly echoed by the political mainstream, including most recently by European Central Bank President Mario Draghi.

zh: 类似地，欧洲委员会正在制定“增长公约 ” ， 将于6月提交欧盟领导人讨论。
en: Likewise, the European Commission is working on a “growth pact” to be discussed by EU leaders in June.

zh: 事实上，欧洲需要一个整体计划以免蹈衰退深化、失业增加和银行系统进一步疲软之辙。
en: Indeed, Europe needs a master plan to avoid a tailspin of recession, growing unemployment, and weakening banking systems.

zh: 新的增长整体计划将不再是开动印钞机。
en: A new master plan for growth would not be about printing money.

zh: 财政纪律依然重要，深度结构性改革亦然。
en: Fiscal discipline remains essential, as are deep structural reforms.

zh: 新增长公约可以通过新的收入源得到合适的融资，比如金融交易税和基础设施投资合作项目债权，或者减少偷税漏税和税收欺诈并取消避税港，还可以考虑更高效、更巧妙地使用结构性资金。
en: The growth pact can be properly financed by new sources of revenue, such as a financial-transaction tax and joint project bonds for infrastructure investment, or by curbing tax evasion and tax fraud and eliminating tax havens, as well as by more efficient and intelligent use of structural funds.

zh: 那么，需要怎么做？
en: What is to be done?

zh: 首先，定向投资应该作为优先事项。
en: First, targeted investment should be given priority.

zh: 欧洲投资银行是很好的平台，可以（辅之以新的项目债券）刺激重大基础设施项目的支出（比如能源部门 ） 。
en: The European Investment Bank would be a good vehicle – in addition to new project bonds – to boost spending on major infrastructure projects (for example, in the energy sector).

zh: 可以大幅增强欧洲央行的资金源，以提振其贷款项目。
en: The EIB could be given significantly more resources to boost its loan programs.

zh: 从长期看，我们应该重新考虑联合欧元债券的方案。
en: In the longer-term, we should revisit the idea of joint Eurobonds.

zh: 将欧盟结构性资金导向创新领域是很重要的，因为与我们的全球伙伴比起来，我们在研发方面的支出之少足以引起警惕。
en: Channeling EU structural funds towards innovation is essential, given that spending on research and development is alarmingly low compared to our global partners.

zh: 共同农业政策（Common Agricultural Policy）的基本改革不应该是禁区。
en: Fundamental reform of the Common Agricultural Policy should not remain a taboo.

zh: 事实上，基本农业政策既不能保证可持续农业，也不能给全体农民带来体面的收入。
en: Indeed, the CAP is ensuring neither sustainable agriculture nor decent incomes for all farmers.

zh: 毫无疑问，在这一领域需要进行艰难的谈判过程，奥朗德便是一块难啃的骨头
en: Undoubtedly, tough negotiations lie ahead on this front, including with Hollande.

zh: 其次，必须优先考虑年轻人。
en: Second, young people must be a top priority.

zh: 在这个问题上，我们的责任是双重的：让增长重回轨道，同时对冲击我们的年轻人的人道危机做出迅速反应。
en: Our responsibility here is twofold: to put growth back on track, but also to respond immediately to the human tragedy that has hit our youth.

zh: 目前欧元区失业率为10.9 % ， 为采用欧元以来的最高值，而各国年轻人更是首当危机之冲，承受着不成比例的压力。
en: The eurozone’s unemployment rate, at 10.9%, is at its highest level since the euro was introduced, and young people everywhere, as the first to suffer the consequences of the crisis, are paying a disproportionally high price.

zh: 比如，西班牙的青年失业率已经超过了50 % 。
en: Youth unemployment in Spain, for example, is above 50%.

zh: 我们不能牺牲一代人，或者说，我们不能冒制造可能摧毁欧洲社会结构和稳定的失落的一代的风险。
en: We cannot afford to sacrifice a generation, or, rather, risk creating a lost generation that could destroy Europe’s social fabric and stability.

zh: 我们需要立刻启动应急预案：投资职业培训，改善教育机会，以及（最重要的）创造雇主雇用年轻人的激励。
en: We need an immediate contingency plan: invest to finance job training, improve educational opportunities, and, crucially, create incentives for employers to hire young people.

zh: 欧洲央行一直在以优惠利率向银行提供长期贷款。
en: The ECB has been offering long-term loans to banks at a favorable rate.

zh: 这笔钱应该贷给中小企业，它们才是欧洲经济的生命线。
en: This money should be loaned out to small and medium-size enterprises, which are the lifeblood of Europe’s economy.

zh: 欧盟还应该用共同行动代替零敲碎打的双边税收优惠和避税港协议，这些协议不利于公平社会的目标。
en: The EU also needs common initiatives to replace piece-meal bilateral agreements on tax evasion and tax havens, which undermine the goal of a fair society.

zh: 第三，在欧盟2014—2020长期支出计划谈判中，成员国不应该不问青红皂白地削减欧���预算。
en: Third, member states should not cut the EU budget indiscriminately during negotiations on the Union's long-term spending plan for 2014-2020.

zh: 如果我们认真考虑整体增长计划，就需要拿出必要的手段。
en: If we are serious about a master plan for growth, we need to provide the necessary means.

zh: 欧盟预算是一个投资平台，可以提振经济增长、创造就业岗位。
en: The EU budget is an investment vehicle that boosts economic growth and creates jobs.

zh: 欧盟预算为至关重要的泛欧盟运输和能源供应线提供融资，也有助于促进创新、刺激研发。
en: It finances crucial pan-EU transport and energy links. It helps to foster innovation and boost research and development.

zh: 欧盟预算为投资提供杠杆，有助于形成规模经济，而且不能有赤字。
en: The EU budget leverages investment, allows for economies of scale, and cannot run a deficit.

zh: 近几年来，欧盟一直缺少团结、想象力、勇气、统一和远见，以至于不少人（如果不是很多人的话）将欧洲视为分裂的典型。
en: The EU’s lack of solidarity, imagination, courage, unity, and vision in recent years has made Europe a symbol of division for some, if not many.

zh: 我们不能再坐视这一幕发展下去了。
en: We cannot let this continue.

zh: 奥朗德的当选对我们来说是一次良机，可以抓住它来应对欧盟所面临的挑战。
en: Hollande’s election offers us a valuable opportunity to meet the challenges that the EU faces.

zh: 要不然的话，我们就将放任贫困、恐惧和愤怒的滋生，培养出排外主义和种族主义，从而让欧盟最伟大的成就陷入危机。
en: Alternatively, we can allow growing poverty, fear, and anger to give rise to xenophobia and racism, and thus place at risk the EU’s greatest accomplishments.

zh: 但我们不妨乐观一点。
en: But let us be optimistic.

zh: 现在行动为时未晚。
en: It is not too late.

zh: 欧洲仍可以从当前的经济乱象中站起来变得更强。 欧盟终于开始改变方向，而欧中领导人可以在欧洲议会找到强有力的合作伙伴。
en: Europe can still emerge stronger from its current economic woes. The EU is changing direction at last, and Europe’s leaders will find an energetic partner in the European Parliament.

zh: 欧洲的矛盾议会
en: Europe’s Paradoxical Parliament

zh: 欧洲议会议员们（MEP）实际上都在做些什么？
en: What do members of the European Parliament (MEPs) actually do?

zh: 将在6月4号至7号举行的欧洲议会选举中有资格投票的三亿七千五百万选民中，大多数人可能只有一个朦胧的 概念，甚至根本没有任何概念。 这就解释了为什么整个欧盟的投票率有可能低至灾难性的程度。
en: Most of the 375 million or so people eligible to vote in the European elections on June 4-7 probably have only a hazy idea, or none at all, which explains why voter turnout throughout the European Union is likely to be disastrously low.

zh: 而30年前，当第一次议会举行选举时，有将近三分之二的选民参加了投票，但这些年来，投票率却节节下降。
en: Thirty years ago, when the first elections to the parliament were held, almost two-thirds of the electorate voted, but over the years, participation has dropped steadily.

zh: 今年可能只有30 ％ 。
en: This year it may be 30%.

zh: 欧洲的政治家们对欧盟及其扩展和深化的方式基本上是感到自豪的。
en: Europe’s politicians are by and large proud of the EU and the way it has both grown and deepened.

zh: 但是，正是欧盟变得日益复杂的情况成了选民热情减弱的根源，所以他们的冷漠应该引起严重的关注。
en: But it is also the EU’s growing complexity that is at the root of voters’ waning enthusiasm, so their indifference is a matter for serious concern.

zh: 欧洲选举本身就古怪并不能令人满意，也没有明显的欧盟范围的问题让人们可以投票赞成或反对，而每个欧洲议会议员的平均选民人数远远超过50万人，投票也不是对个人声望的测试。
en: The European elections are themselves curious and unsatisfactory; there are no obvious EU-wide issues that people can vote for or against, and, with the average MEP’s constituency numbering well over half a million people, the vote is not a test of personal popularity, either.

zh: 在欧洲大部分地区，选举将是一个对国家问题投抗议票的机会。
en: In most parts of Europe, the elections will be an opportunity for protest votes on national issues.

zh: 奇怪的是，选举结果却会产生重要的作用。
en: Paradoxically, though, great deal hangs on the elections’ outcome.

zh: 社会党和中间偏右政党赢得的席位数可能会影响下届欧洲联盟委员会 的组成-因此，也会影响2014年前的欧盟政治议程。
en: The number of seats won by the socialists and centre-right parties is likely to influence the make-up of the next European Commission – and thus the EU’s political agenda until 2014.

zh: 但仅从媒体对此的聊无兴趣上，你是不会知道这一点的。
en: But you wouldn’t know this from the low level of media interest.

zh: 和国内选民一样，大多数新闻工作者根本不知道在过去的20年中欧洲的政治决策发生了重大改变。
en: Most journalists, like national electorates, have little understanding of the significant shift in Europe’s political decision-making over the last 20 years.

zh: 他们还相信过时的观念，即本国议会作出所有重要决定。 但现实中决定欧洲未来的五分之四的决策是在布鲁塞尔作出的，然后由橡皮图章形式经各国家的议员通过。
en: They hang on to the outdated notion that their national parliaments make all key decisions, when in reality some four-fifths of the policies that determine Europe’s future are taken in Brussels and then rubber-stamped by national parliamentarians.

zh: 只要看一看任何欧盟成员 国的议会日程，就知道它们的立法主要限于国内的问题。
en: A glance at any EU member state’s parliamentary calendar shows that lawmaking there is largely confined to domestic issues.

zh: 而另一方面，作为专家的欧洲议会议员们，利用他们的专业知识和不断增加的权力对欧盟施加影响。
en: The specialist MEPs, on the other hand, use their expertise and their steadily increasing powers to exert a good deal of influence on EU legislation.

zh: 但是，这并不意味着，欧洲议会是一个“真正的”议会。
en: But this does not mean that the European Parliament is a “real” parliament.

zh: 它既不能征税，也不能对外宣战或解散政府（即使在理论上它可以集体解散欧盟委员会的所有成员，即所谓的“核选择 ” ， 而这是不太可能被采用的 ） 。
en: It can’t raise taxes, declare war, or sack a government (even though in theory it can dismiss all the members of the European Commission en masse, the so-called “nuclear option” that is unlikely ever to be used).

zh: 也许，更重要的是，欧洲议会并不象各国议会一样真正在左派-右派政治的基础上运作;与其说它涉及意识形态方面还不如说它涉及的是实际的方面。
en: More to the point, perhaps, the European Parliament doesn’t really work on the same basis of left-right politics as national parliaments do; it deals in practicalities more than ideologies.

zh: 尽管如此，欧洲议会的重要性远远超出其成员国的表面上对复杂问题的透彻理解，或作为欧盟决策过程中的民主遮羞布，这种过程主要被政府间的讨价还价所主宰。
en: For all that, the European Parliament’s importance goes far beyond its members’ technical expertise on complex issues, or its usefulness as a democratic fig leaf for an EU decision-making process that is dominated by inter-governmental horse-trading.

zh: 议会已经能够掌握更大的权力，因为它是欧洲唯一的能对欧盟的政策建议提出质疑和挑战的机制，也能熨平布鲁塞尔官场上有时出现的笨拙的高压式命令。
en: The parliament has been able to claw greater power for itself because it is the only mechanism Europe has for questioning and challenging EU policy proposals, and ironing out the sometimes clumsy and high-handed diktats of Brussels’ officialdom.

zh: 但不幸的是，欧洲议会在向舆论推销自己方面是相当无能的。
en: Unfortunately, however, the European Parliament is fairly inept at selling itself to public opinion.

zh: 最近的一项盖洛普民意测验表明， 在所有27个欧盟国家中被访人中，有36 ％表示不再信任议会；而唯一值得安慰的是，更大比例的被访者，即37 ％ 的人，现在也不信任欧盟委员会了。
en: A recent Gallup poll showed that 36% of people questioned in all 27 EU countries no longer trust the parliament, with the only consolation being that even more, 37%, now mistrust the European Commission.

zh: 在那些表示不会在今年的欧洲议会选举中投票的人中，有64 ％的人认为 ， “ 缺少信息”是他们做出此决定的原因，而有62 ％抱怨说他们的投票“不会促成任何改变 ” 。
en: Of those who said they wouldn’t be voting in this year’s European elections, 64% cited “lack of information” as the reason, with 62% complaining that their vote “wouldn’t change anything.”

zh: 这种无知加无力的感觉并不完全是欧洲议会的错。
en: This feeling of ignorance coupled with powerlessness is not entirely the European Parliament’s fault.

zh: 高层政治和折磨人的技术细节使欧盟决策远远不如各成员国本国政治景象有趣，当然还加上另一个问 题，即如此多的议员都是不为人知的外国人。
en: The combination of high politics and grinding technical detail makes EU policymaking a much less interesting spectacle than national politics, and of course there’s the added problem that so many of the players are unknown foreigners.

zh: 但是，即使议会努力和选民保持联系，议会的常任官员们所形成的冗长的官僚文化往往会把事情搞砸。
en: But, even when the parliament does make an effort to connect with voters, the ponderous bureaucratic culture of its permanent officials tends to spoil things.

zh: 去年，议会开始着手一种可悲的缺少专业精神的网络电视服 务，其庞大的预算支出没有放在好好做节目上，而是以欧盟官方语言办了一切事情。
en: Last year, the parliament launched a lamentably amateurish Web-TV broadcasting service whose large budget was spent not on good programming but on doing everything in all the EU’s official languages.

zh: 那么，该怎么办呢？
en: So what is to be done?

zh: 736名欧盟议员中的许多人越来越被视为是问题而不是解决欧盟弊病的无名英雄。
en: Many of the 736 EU parliamentarians are unsung heroes who risk being seen more and more as a problem rather than a solution to the EU’s ills.

zh: 也许欧盟应该 大胆地创造一个美国式的两院制议会，把欧洲议会变成众议院，并选举出一个参议院以取代部长会议，并由各会员国派两位参议员。
en: Rather than tinkering, perhaps the EU should boldly create an American-style bicameral system by turning the parliament into a House of Representatives and electing a Senate to replace the Council of Ministers, with two senators per member state.

zh: 但是，对于欧盟这个用了50年时间才形成今天这样的不能令人满意的杂交式的决策结构来说，这可能是过于革命性了。
en: But that is probably far too revolutionary for an EU that took 50 years to fashion today’s unsatisfactorily hybrid decision-making structures.

zh: 欧洲的领导实力
en: Europe’s Power to Lead

zh: 剑桥 - - 在今年的达沃斯世界经济论坛上，众人热议的话题是亚洲不断增长的实力。
en: CAMBRIDGE -- At this year’s World Economic Forum in Davos, the buzz was about Asia’s growing power.

zh: 一位亚洲问题分析家指出，到2050年，世界将会有三大强权，也就是美国、中国和印度。
en: One Asian analyst argued that by 2050, there will be three world powers: the United States, China, and India.

zh: 他没有提到欧洲，但是低估欧洲的实力是一个错误。
en: He did not mention Europe, but underestimating Europe’s power is a mistake.

zh: 是的，欧洲目前确实是虎落平川。
en: Yes, Europe currently punches below its weight.

zh: 它现在各自为政，和平无事，并且在一个硬性实力的世界里确定标准，但是，世界还有一部分并非完全由军事实力左右。
en: It is fragmented, peaceful, and normative in a world of hard power, but part of the world is not about military power.

zh: 在先进工业化民主国家中使用武力几乎是难以想见的。
en: The use of force among advanced industrial democracies is virtually unthinkable.

zh: 借用罗伯特卡根的话来说，在彼此关系中，这些国家都来自金星，所以在这里欧洲集中于法律和机制是有利之处。
en: In their relations with each other , such countries are all from Venus, to paraphrase Robert Kagan, and here Europe’s focus on law and institutions is an asset.

zh: 对于世界其他地方而言，最近的一项皮尤调查显示，许多欧洲人想要让欧洲发挥更大的作用，但是，平衡美国的军事实力将会要求军费翻两番或者三番，而欧洲人很少对于这样的增加军费感兴趣。
en: As for other parts of the world, a recent Pew poll found that many Europeans would like Europe to play a larger role, but to balance American military power would require a doubling or tripling of defense spending, and few Europeans are interested in such an increase.

zh: 但是，欧洲的灵巧战略要求在硬性实力上更大的投资。
en: Nevertheless, a smart strategy for Europe will require greater investments in hard power.

zh: 但是，对于欧洲而言，形势并非如悲观派估计的那样暗淡。
en: The picture for Europe, however, is not as bleak as pessimists assume.

zh: 所谓实力，就是达到想要达到的结果的能力，而产生这样行为的资源取决于环境。
en: Power is the ability to get the outcomes one wants, and the resources that produce such behavior depend upon the context.

zh: 在功能意义上，实力就像是一个三维象棋游戏棋盘一样分配。
en: In functional terms, power is distributed like a three-dimensional chess game.

zh: 在最高层是国家间的军事关系，而美国则是唯一拥有全球打击实力的超级大国。
en: On the top board are military relations among states, with the US the world’s only superpower with global reach.

zh: 在这一层面上世界是单级的。
en: Here the world is uni-polar.

zh: 中间一层是经济关系，世界在这一层面已经是多极的了。
en: On the middle board are economic relations, where the world is already multi-polar.

zh: 在这一层面，欧洲以一个联盟行事，而像中国、日本等国发挥重要作用。
en: Here, Europe acts as a union, and other countries like Japan and China play big roles.

zh: 没有欧盟的同意，美国无法达成贸易协议或者和解托拉斯案件。
en: The US cannot reach a trade agreement or settle anti-trust cases without the approval of the EU.

zh: 或者举另外一个例子，欧洲能够带领把沃尔弗维茨从世界银行总裁的位置上赶走。
en: Or, to take another example, Europe was able to lead the drive to remove Paul Wolfowitz from the World Bank.

zh: 象棋棋盘最底层包括政府控制以外的跨国关系，这包括毒品、传染病、气候变化乃至恐怖主义等等。
en: The bottom chessboard includes transnational relations outside the control of governments – everything from drugs to infectious diseases to climate change to terrorism.

zh: 在这一层面，实力混乱地分配于非国家参与者之间，把这一世界称为单级或者多极都是毫无意义的。
en: On this board, power is chaotically distributed among non-state actors, and it makes no sense to call this world either uni-polar or multipolar.

zh: 在这里，紧密的民间合作十分重要，欧洲在这一点上极有实力。
en: Here, close civilian cooperation is important, for which Europe is well endowed.

zh: 欧洲国家在克服几百年来敌对上的成功以及确立巨大的内部市场给了它们巨大的软实力。
en: European countries’ success in overcoming centuries of animosity, and the development of a large internal market, has given them a great deal of soft power.

zh: 冷战结束时，东欧国家并不企图像二十年代那样组成地区联盟，而是放眼布鲁塞尔来寻求安定其前途。
en: At the Cold War’s end, East European countries did not try to form local alliances, as they did in the 1920’s, but looked toward Brussels to secure their future.

zh: 同样，像土耳其和乌克兰那样的国家已经针对欧洲对它们的吸引力调整了政策。
en: Similarly, countries like Turkey and Ukraine have adjusted their policies in response to their attraction to Europe.

zh: 最近，美国国家情报委员会发布了世界在2020年四个迥然不同的可能局面。 第一是达沃斯世界，也就是经济全球化继续，但是亚洲份量更多。
en: Recently, the US National Intelligence Council published four widely different scenarios for the world in 2020: Davos World, in which economic globalization continues, but with a more Asian face; Pax Americana, where the US continues to dominate the global order; New Caliphate, where Islamic religious identity challenges the dominance of western norms; and Cycle of Fear, in which non-state forces create shocks to security that produce Orwellian societies.

zh: 第四是恐惧循环，也就是非国家势力制造对安全的冲击而产生专制社会。 就像是未来学中的任何演习一样，这些推演存在局限，但是它们帮助我们探究哪三个或者四个政治因素将会帮助产生这样的结果。
en: Like any exercises in futurology, such scenarios have their limits, but they help us ask which three or four major political factors will help shape the outcome.

zh: 首先是亚洲的崛起。
en: The first is the rise of Asia.

zh: 中国及其内部演进将会是大问题。
en: The big question will be China and its internal evolution.

zh: 从1990年以来，中国已经让四亿人口脱贫，但是还有四亿人口每天用不到两美元过活。
en: China has lifted 400 million people out of poverty since 1990, but another 400 million still live on less than $2 per day.

zh: 和印度不同，中国还没有解决政治参与的问题。
en: Unlike India, China has not solved the problem of political participation.

zh: 如果中国用民族主义取代遭到侵蚀的共产主义或者确保社会凝聚，结果将会是更为侵犯性的外交政策并且不愿意处理类似气候变化那样的问题。
en: If China replaces its eroded communism with nationalism or ensure social cohesion, the result could be a more aggressive foreign policy and unwillingness to deal with issues like climate change.

zh: 或者，它会处理其问题并且成为世界政治中一个“负责任的利益相关者 ” 。
en: Or it may deal with its problems and become a “responsible stakeholder” in world politics.

zh: 欧洲可以为中国融入全球体制和机制做出重大贡献。
en: Europe can contribute significantly to China’s integration into global norms and institutions.

zh: 通常而言，欧洲和美国对疲弱的中国的担心要胜过对富有���中国的担心。
en: In general, Europe and the US have more to fear from a weak China than they do from a wealthy China.

zh: 政治伊斯兰及其如何发展将会是第二个因素。
en: Political Islam and how it develops will be the second factor.

zh: 反对极端伊斯兰恐怖主义的斗争并非是“文明的冲突 ” ， 而是伊斯兰内部的内战。
en: The struggle against extreme Islamist terrorism is not a “clash of civilizations,” but a civil war within Islam.

zh: 一个极端少数派正在利用暴力来把简化和意识形态化的版本强加给具有更大多样性观点的主流人群头上。
en: A radical minority is using violence to impose a simplified and ideological version on a mainstream with more diverse views.

zh: 绝大多数穆斯林生活在亚洲，他们受到发生在中东的这一斗争本质的影响。 中东地区在全球化、开放性、机制以及民主化上落后于世界其他地方。
en: While the largest number of Muslims live in Asia, they are influenced by the heart of this struggle in the Middle East, an area that has lagged behind the rest of the world in globalization, openness, institutions, and democratization.

zh: 在这里，欧洲的经济实力和软实力可以做出很大贡献。
en: Here Europe’s economic might and soft power have a lot to contribute.

zh: 更为开放的贸易、经济增长、教育、发展公民社会机制以及逐步提高政治参与或许会长久以往帮助强化主流社会，正如穆斯林在欧洲和美国所受待遇一样。
en: More open trade, economic growth, education, development of civil society institutions, and gradual increases in political participation might help strengthen the mainstream over time, as could the way Muslims are treated in Europe and the US.

zh: 同样重要的是，西方对中东的政策是否能够满足主流穆斯林或者强化极端份子有关针对伊斯兰战争的讲述。
en: Equally important will be whether Western policies toward the Middle East satisfy mainstream Muslims or reinforce the radicals’ narrative of a war against Islam.

zh: 决定哪一种局面占据主导地位的主要决定因素将是美国的实力以及如何使用这一实力。
en: The third major determinant of which scenario prevails will be American power and how it is used.

zh: 美国在2020年依旧是最强大的国家，但是，自相矛盾的是，罗马时代以来最为强大的国家将无法独自保护其公民。
en: The US will remain the most powerful country in 2020, but, paradoxically, the strongest state since the days of Rome will be unable to protect its citizens acting alone.

zh: 美国的军事实力并不足以处理像全球传染病、气候变化、恐怖主义以及国际犯罪等威胁。
en: American military might is not adequate to deal with threats such as global pandemics, climate change, terrorism, and international crime.

zh: 这些问题要求吸引支持的软实力以及在提供全球公共利益的时候进行合作。
en: These issues require cooperation in the provision of global public goods and the soft power of attracting support.

zh: 除了欧洲，世界上没有其他任何地方与美国具有共同的价值观或者具有更大的能力影响美国的态度和实力。
en: No part of the world shares more values or has a greater capacity to influence American attitudes and power than does Europe.

zh: 这就意味着，未来的第四个政治决定因素将是欧洲政策和实力的演化。
en: That suggests that the fourth political determinant of the future will be the evolution of European policies and power.

zh: 欧洲的种族学校
en: Europe’s Racist Schools

zh: 我是很多人所说的“吉普赛人 ” ， 而我更喜欢“罗姆人”一词。
en: I am what many people call a “Gypsy.” I prefer the term “Roma.”

zh: 我们在欧洲大概有1000万人。
en: There are more than 10 million of us across Europe.

zh: 我们中绝大多数人过着第三世界的生活 — — 不能住上大房子，也不能享受到医疗和教育。
en: The vast majority of us live in Third World conditions – denied access to adequate housing, health care, and education.

zh: 我于20世纪60年代末出生在保加利亚的一个省辖市里。 那时候，和其他东欧国家一样，保加利亚还在共产党的统治下。
en: I was born in a provincial town in Bulgaria in the late 1960’s, when, like the rest of Eastern Europe, the country was under Communist rule.

zh: 共产党不承认有少数民族的存在 — — 我们所有人在形式上都是平等的。
en: The Party recognized no ethnic minorities – we were all, formally, equal.

zh: 确实如此，我们很平等，以致于政府给我们很多人一个新的保加利亚人名字。
en: Indeed, we were so equal that the government gave many of us new, Bulgarian names.

zh: 一天，我这个叫做胡斯尼（Husni）的十几岁孩子就变成了伊凡（Ivan ） 。
en: One day, when I was a teenager named Husni, my name became Ivan.

zh: 但我们并不平等。
en: But we were not equal.

zh: 罗姆人住在与其他人分开的贫民窟里。
en: Roma lived in segregated ghettos.

zh: 我们是二等公民。
en: We were second-class citizens.

zh: 我儿时最清晰的一个记忆就是我父亲对我和妹妹说 ： “ 教育是走向成功的钥匙。
en: One of my clearest early childhood memories is of my father telling my younger sister and me, “Education is the key to success.”

zh: ”他说 ： “ 如果希望那些非罗姆人把你当做平等的人，你必须接受比他们更好的教育。
en: He said, “If you want to be accepted as equals by Gadje [non-Roma], you must be better educated than they are.

zh: 这并不容易。
en: This is not easy.

zh: 但如果你成功了，这不只会改变你个人，而且能够改变你这个民族很多人的生活。 ”
en: But if you succeed, this will change not only your life but also the lives of many of your people.”

zh: 对很多罗姆人来说，教育是离开贫民窟的唯一途径。
en: Education is the only way out of the ghetto for many Roma.

zh: 但在像保加利亚这样种族歧视严重的社会里，罗姆人要为平等教育权而斗争。
en: But in societies like Bulgaria, where racism is rampant, Roma have to fight for equal schooling.

zh: 和我一起长大的多数孩子接受的教育都不高，无法使他们进入大学或者获得职业技能。
en: Most of the children I grew up with received an inferior education that did not train them for university or skilled jobs.

zh: 他们要不失业，要不就在保加利亚或者国外的黑市里做不需要技术的劳工。
en: They are either unemployed or working as unskilled laborers in Bulgaria or in the black market abroad.

zh: 和他们相反，很大程度上多亏有我的父亲，我完成了高中学习，而后进入医学院，而后成为了一名全科大夫。
en: By contrast, in large part because of my father, I managed to complete high school, then medical school, and become a general practitioner.

zh: 到了20世纪90年代初，保加利亚发生了巨变。
en: By the early 1990’s, Bulgaria had changed.

zh: 向民主的过渡保证所有在共产主义控制下的受苦人能够有自由和富裕的权力。
en: The transition to democracy promised freedom and prosperity to all who had suffered in communism’s stranglehold.

zh: 但罗姆人发现自己是这次民主转型的输家。
en: Yet the Roma found themselves losers of the democratic transformation.

zh: 他们一直很糟糕的境况更是大幅度地下降了。
en: Their situation, always tenuous, dramatically worsened.

zh: 他们不佳的教育情况，使他们无力面对新型的经济。
en: Their poor schooling left them ill equipped for the new economy.

zh: 共产党的教条不行了，我们在同一社会里人人平等的主张也不行了。
en: The communist dogma was shattered, but so was the pretense that we were all equals in a homogenous society.

zh: 政府允许就业歧视的存在，这样就使大多数罗姆人没有工作，这一群体进一步陷入了贫困。
en: The government allowed employment discrimination to go unchecked, leaving the majority of Roma without jobs, and communities were plunged deeper into poverty.

zh: 我获得了法律学位，因此我能够为我的群体说话。
en: I obtained a law degree to help advocate for members of my community.

zh: 今天，我生活并工作在布鲁塞尔。 在这里，我领导着一个向欧盟以及国家政府就罗姆问题政策提供咨询的组织。
en: Today, I live and work in Brussels, where I lead an organization that advises the European Union and national governments on Roma-related policies.

zh: 我能够养家并在事业上取得了成就。
en: I support my family and have achieved fulfillment in my career.

zh: 但我是一个特例。
en: But I am an exception.

zh: 教育的重要性使我成为了一个特例，这也使我正在为欧洲人权法庭最近做出的一个决定而深感忧虑。
en: It is because of the importance of education in making me an exception that I am so deeply troubled by a recent decision of the European Court of Human Rights.

zh: 这起诉讼是由捷克共和国俄斯特拉法市18个罗姆孩子提起的。 这些孩子因为“智力缺陷”而被分配去特殊的补习学校。
en: The case was brought by 18 Roma children from the city of Ostrava in the Czech Republic who had been assigned to special remedial schools for the “mentally deficient.”

zh: 在中欧和东欧，罗姆人被不公平地分配入特殊的学校里，那里为罗姆人提供极低的教育，只能让他们干体力活并过着贫困的生活。
en: In Central and Eastern Europe, Roma are often unfairly placed in these special schools, which provide sub-par education that all but guarantees a life of poverty and manual labor.

zh: 我成为这些孩子的律师之一。
en: I served as one of the lawyers for the children.

zh: 证据显示，俄斯特拉法有超过一半的罗姆孩子被分配到特殊学校就读，而这些特殊学校里超过一半的学生是罗姆人。
en: The evidence showed that more than half of the Roma children in Ostrava were placed in special schools, and that more than half of the population of special schools was Roma.

zh: 据说，俄斯特拉法的罗姆孩子比非罗姆孩子有高出27倍的可能性被分配到这样的学校。
en: All told, Roma children in Ostrava are more than 27 times more likely than non-Roma to be placed in such schools.

zh: 这不是一个特例。
en: This is not a unique situation.

zh: 远远不是。
en: Far from it.

zh: 这样不成比例的学校分配在大多数中欧和东欧国家里存在着。
en: The same disproportionate patterns of school assignment exist throughout much of Central and Eastern Europe.

zh: 正如一个联合国专家机构宣称的，这就是明显的种族隔离。
en: As a United Nations expert body has declared, this is racial segregation, plain and simple.

zh: 但法庭却并不为之所动。
en: But the Court was unmoved.

zh: 法庭承认原告提出了“一些重要的论据 ， ” 俄斯特拉法的教育制度维护了种族隔离。
en: Its judgment recognized that the claimants raised “a number of serious arguments,” and that the education system in Ostrava perpetuated racial segregation.

zh: 但法庭判决说，由于未能确实证明试验者以及行政长官头脑里存在着种族偏见 — — 事实上无法证实 — — 这种普遍存在的种族劣势不属于非法。
en: But the Court ruled that, absent a showing of actual racial bias in the minds of testers and administrators – virtually impossible to prove – the pervasive reality of racial disadvantage was not unlawful.

zh: 这本是一场可能为欧洲罗姆人打开机会之门的历史性胜利，斯特拉斯堡的法庭却选择将罗姆人接受良好教育的大门锁上了。
en: In what could have been a landmark victory that would open the doors of opportunity for Europe’s Roma, the Strasbourg Court instead chose to keep Roma locked out of a decent education.

zh: 法庭的决定在欧洲大陆引起了反响 — — 不只罗姆人，还有所有在民主欧洲里倡导宽容、平等价值观的人们。
en: Its decision reverberates across the Continent – not just for the Roma, but for all who have a stake in promoting the values of tolerance and equality in a democratic Europe.

zh: 任何相信所有孩子都有权接受高质量教育的人都会为这种短视的决定而不安。
en: Anyone who believes in the rights of all children to quality education should be troubled by a decision so myopic.

zh: 几十年来，欧洲学校���种族隔离使多少代罗姆孩子打上了愚蠢无能的烙印。
en: For decades, racial segregation in European schools has stigmatized generations of Roma children as stupid and disabled.

zh: 法庭的决定致使这一残酷的、制度化侵犯基本人权的情况得以继续。
en: The Court’s decision allows this brutal and systematic violation of fundamental rights to continue.

zh: 罗姆人以及全欧洲都遭受到一次惨重的失败。
en: The Roma, and Europe, have suffered a great defeat.

zh: 欧洲的俄国问题
en: Europe’s Russia Problem

zh: 纽约amp#45;amp#45;对于充满敌意的俄国在欧洲东边崛起，欧洲应该如何应对呢？
en: NEW YORK – How should Europe react to the rise of a hostile Russia on its eastern flank?

zh: 不同的国家受到各自历史经历以及经济利益的影响而做出了不同的反应。
en: Different countries have reacted differently, influenced by their historical experience and their economic interests.

zh: 但是欧盟制定一项统一的政策，协调不同的国家利益和态度十分关键。
en: Yet it is essential for the European Union to develop a unified policy, reconciling these divergent national interests and attitudes.

zh: 欧洲无法不阻止俄国的地缘政治侵略，而且为了有成功的希望它就必须联合一致。
en: Europe cannot afford not to resist Russia’s geopolitical aggression, and it needs to be unified to have any chance of success.

zh: 但是，统一的欧洲政策不能仅仅局限于地缘政治方面，因为如果是这样的话，共同利益就不足以强大到推翻国家利益的程度。
en: Yet, the unified European policy must not be purely geopolitical, because if it were, the common interest would not be strong enough to override national interests.

zh: 俄国可以像现在一样分而治之。
en: Russia could divide and conquer as it is doing already.

zh: 在纯粹的地缘政治方面，俄国占据优势。
en: In purely geopolitical terms, Russia holds the stronger hand.

zh: 欧洲的优越在于其作为开放、民主、和平、繁荣以及守法社会的价值观以及原则。
en: Europe’s superiority lies in its values and principles as an open, democratic, peaceful, prosperous, and law-abiding society.

zh: 尽管西方在过去的行为中并没有支撑其价值观和原则，但是这些价值观对前苏联人民而言具有强大的吸引力，不仅包括领导人，也包括广大民众。
en: These values hold great attraction for the people in the former Soviet Union—and that includes the leaders as well as the masses, in spite of the fact that the West did not back up its values and principles with deeds in the past.

zh: 结果，对于欧洲价值观的崇拜和向往同失望和仇视搀杂在一起。 普京政权通过引诱西方并且在地缘政治游戏中得分而获得了民众热情的支持。
en: As a result, admiration of and aspiration to European values is mixed with disillusionment and resentment, and the Putin regime has been able to gather enthusiastic support by baiting the West and scoring well in the geopolitical game.

zh: 但是，俄国还是受到欧洲吸引力的影响。
en: Nevertheless, Russia remains susceptible to Europe’s allure.

zh: 在历史上，俄国总是想成为欧洲的一部分，而且普京政权认识到，如果它寻求回到苏联孤立状态就会付出巨大代价。
en: Historically, Russia always aspired to be part of Europe, and the Putin regime recognizes that it would pay a big price if it sought to return to the Soviet Union’s isolation.

zh: 但是俄国相对于欧洲强化的地缘政治地位掩盖了在其他领域上的巨大弱点。
en: But Russia’s strengthened geopolitical position vis-à-vis Europe obscures grave weaknesses in other areas.

zh: 其专制政治制度压抑了私有企业和创新。
en: Its authoritarian political system stifles private enterprise and innovation.

zh: 那里没有法治，而且人们在敲诈勒索和收租上花的精力要远远超过生产。
en: The rule of law is absent, and much more effort is spent on extortion and rent collection than production.

zh: 结果，经济进展没有与石油收入的积累同步。
en: Consequently, economic progress has not kept pace with the accumulation of oil revenues.

zh: 这些缺点随着石油价格的下跌而越发严重。
en: These deficiencies became accentuated by the decline in the price of oil.

zh: 另一个巨大的弱点是人口方面的。
en: Another great weakness is demography.

zh: 俄国幅员辽阔，但是只有一亿四千万人口。
en: Russia has immense territory but only 140 million people.

zh: 人口中越来越多的部分是穆斯林少数民族，其出生率超过俄罗斯人。
en: A growing portion of the population consists of Muslim minorities with higher birthrates than ethnic Russians.

zh: 人口总数预计在十年内下降一千万人。
en: Overall population is expected to drop by 10 million in a decade.

zh: 西伯利亚资源丰富但是人口稀少，它与资源短缺但是蓬勃发展的中国交界。
en: Resource rich but sparsely populated Siberia is bordered by resource-deficient but teeming and rising China.

zh: 如果各中亚共和国与西方断绝，那么它们就可能转向中国以避免完全依赖于俄国。
en: If the Central Asian republics are cut off from the West, they are liable to turn to China in order to avoid becoming totally dependent on Russia.

zh: 从长期而言，普京引诱西方有可能像萨卡什维利引诱俄国一样弄巧成拙。
en: In the long run, Putin’s baiting of the West may turn out to be as self-defeating as Saakashvili’s baiting of Russia.

zh: 但是在短期而言确实存在危险，也就是俄国将会通过力求成为统领国家实体而追寻其成为欧洲一部分的百年渴望。
en: But in the short run there is a real danger that Russia will pursue its age-old aspiration of becoming part of Europe by seeking to become the dominant entity.

zh: 在这样的情况下，欧洲需要追寻双刃战略。
en: In these circumstances, Europe needs to pursue a two-pronged strategy.

zh: 一方面，它必须保护自己免受新近张狂而又冒险的俄国构成的地缘政治威胁。
en: On the one hand, it must protect itself against the geopolitical threat posed by a newly assertive and adventurous Russia.

zh: 另一方面，欧洲必须寻求用法治取代武治，用民主、开放社会以及国际合作取代地缘政治。
en: On the other, it must seek to replace the rule of force with the rule of law, and geopolitics with the pursuit of democracy, open society, and international cooperation.

zh: 欧盟无法在不运用这一双刃战略的情况下制定共同政策。
en: The European Union could not possibly forge a common policy without such a two-pronged approach.

zh: 在纯粹的地缘政治游戏中将会有太多的贪图便宜和叛逃者，但是采用了双刃战略每个成员国就会找到自身恰当的位置。
en: There would be too many freeloaders and defectors in a purely geopolitical game, but in a two-pronged approach each member state could find its proper place.

zh: 抵销俄国享有的地缘政治优势的关键就是建立统一的能源政策。 在这一政策中，跨欧管理机关优先于各国的管理当局，同时建立跨欧的能源分配网络。
en: The key to neutralizing the geopolitical advantage that Russia enjoys is to establish a unified energy policy with a Europe-wide regulatory authority which has precedence over national regulators and a Europe-wide distribution network.

zh: 这就会剥夺俄国各个击破的能力，因为给予某个国家分配商减让将会马上也提供给所有其他国家的客户。
en: This would deprive Russia of its ability to play one country against another, because a concession granted to one national distributor would immediately become available to customers in all the other countries.

zh: 能源公司开始意识到这一点并且不再抵制欧洲共同能源政策。
en: Energy companies are beginning to realize this and becoming less resistant to a common European energy policy.

zh: 这也会有利于另一个共同的目标，也就是帮助控制气候变化。
en: That would also serve another shared objective, namely helping to bring climate change under control.

zh: 另一个刀刃，也就是促进民主、国际合作以及开放社会的原则应当通过改革国际金融体系以及特别关注俄国近邻而间接地予以追寻。
en: The other prong, promoting the rule of law, international cooperation, and the principles of open society has to be pursued indirectly, by reforming the international financial system and by paying special attention to Russia’s near-abroad.

zh: 特别是乌克兰处于危险境地。 但是给公共基建项目提供资金从而在钢铁产业不景气的乌克兰东部创造就业可以在政治上和经济上产生巨大的效益。
en: Ukraine, in particular, is in a perilous state, but financing public works that would create jobs in eastern Ukraine, where the steel industry is in distress, could make a major difference both politically and economically.

zh: 我们必须帮助格鲁吉亚从俄国入侵造成的损失中复原过来。 但是援助必须取决于萨卡什维利政府遵守开放社会的原则。
en: Georgia must also be helped to recover from the damage inflicted by the Russian invasion, but help should be contingent on the Saakashvili regime observing the principles of open society.

zh: 俄国由于其对国家强制力的过度依赖而不能得到直接援助，但是当俄国看到特别是与中国的国际合作取得进展的时候，它就不想被抛在后面。
en: Russia cannot be helped directly because of its excessive reliance on arbitrary state power, but when Russia sees progress in international cooperation, particularly with China, it will not want to be left out in the cold.

zh: 加强和支持前苏联加盟共和国将会有利于欧盟对俄统一的双刃政策。
en: Strengthening and supporting the former Soviet republics would serve both prongs of a unified EU policy towards Russia.

zh: 如果允许俄国仅仅因为它拥有超级军力而把这些国家变成卫星国就会违反开放社会的价值观。
en: It would be against open society values if Russia were allowed to turn these countries into satellites just because it has superior military force.

zh: 而且，让这些国家作为能���供应国家保持开放也符合欧洲的地缘政治利益。
en: And Europe has a geopolitical interest in keeping them open as sources of energy supply.

zh: 欧洲的俄国问题
en: Europe’s Russia Question

zh: 布鲁塞尔 - - 是朋友还是敌人，还是尴尬地介于两者之间的东西？
en: BRUSSELS – Friend or foe, or something uneasily in-between?

zh: 这就是欧洲正在探寻的关于俄国的问题，而这也是俄国探寻有关近来咄咄逼人的欧洲的问题。
en: That’s the question Europe is asking about Russia, and Russia about a newly aggressive Europe.

zh: 俄罗斯石油天然气公司在欧洲的能源供应日益重要。 普京总统选择其董事长梅德韦捷夫作为总统继任人更把这一问题突出了。
en: President Vladimir Putin’s choice of Dmitri Medvedev, Chairman of Gazprom, the gas company with an emerging stranglehold on European energy supplies, only throws this question into an even starker light.

zh: 欧洲和俄国之间的关系几年来每况愈下，但是原先尚且可以控制的包括能源在内的经济问题现在正在由于更为起伏不定的政治分歧而恶化。
en: Relations between Europe and Russia have been deteriorating for several years, but once manageable economic issues, including energy, are now being aggravated by much more volatile political differences.

zh: 现在存在毫不掩饰的敌对状态环境的风险，而潜在的代价要大于冷战时期最严峻的阶段。
en: The risk is a climate of undisguised hostility, with potentially greater costs than during the nadir of the Cold War.

zh: 其中最为明显而又急迫的问题就是科索沃了。
en: The most obvious and imminent flashpoint is Kosovo.

zh: 现在的可能性就是，明年早些时候欧盟大多数成员国将会承认位于塞尔维亚南部边界的这一阿尔巴尼亚人占人口多数的飞地为一个独立国家。
en: The likelihood is that early next year most of the European Union’s member nations will recognize the Albanian-majority enclave on Serbia’s southern edge as an independent state.

zh: 这不仅肯定会让塞尔维亚，也会让克里姆林宫怒火中烧。
en: This is certain to enflame not just Serbia, but also the Kremlin.

zh: 还有，美国打算在波兰和捷克共和国建立导弹防御系统，以及北约进一步东扩越来越可能包括格鲁吉亚，因此造成紧张局势日益升高。 日益显现繁荣的格鲁吉亚与邻国俄国的关系充满摩擦。
en: Then there are rising tensions over plans by the United States to based a missile defense system in Poland and the Czech Republic, as well as the growing likelihood that further NATO enlargement will include Georgia, the increasingly prosperous neighbor with which Russia has fractious relations.

zh: 俄国继续在那里通过鼓励阿布哈兹和南奥塞梯独立而煽动分裂主义。
en: Russia continues to fan secessionist flames there by encouraging the independence of Abkhazia and South Ossetia.

zh: 俄国和欧洲的火气都在上升，但是奇怪的是，在它们所面临的主要挑战上其利益又大体相同。
en: Tempers are rising in both Russia and Europe, yet, paradoxically, when it comes to the major challenges they face, their interests are largely identical.

zh: 双方都受到伊斯兰极端主义和日益上升的动乱的威胁。
