zh: 在这部扣人心弦的著作中，最核心的是关于大萧条的一章，这一章的主线是美国联邦储备委员会对货币危机的应对不力。
en: At the center of their gripping narrative is a chapter on the Great Depression, anchored by an indictment of the US Federal Reserve Board for responding inadequately to the mounting crisis.

zh: 大体上，弗里德曼和施瓦茨被视为在指责美联储没能迅速地对接二连三的银行倒闭潮 — — 第一波在1930年末，接着在1931和1933年两度再次发生 — — 做出反应。
en: Friedman and Schwartz are generally seen as reproving the Fed for failing to react swiftly to successive waves of bank failures, first in late 1930 and then again in 1931 and 1933.

zh: 但通过更仔细的解读可以发现，两位作者保留了对美联储的最严厉的批评 — — 没能在1930年上半年实施购买证券的联合计划以防止银行倒闭。
en: But a close reading reveals that the authors reserve their most scathing criticism for the Fed’s failure to initiate a concerted program of security purchases in the first half of 1930 in order to prevent those bank failures.

zh: 这个教训应该被欧洲央行委员会成员们小心地铭记在心，8月2日，他们宣布已准备好应对事态的进一步发展，但在当下还没采取任何措施。
en: That is a message that the European Central Bank’s board members could usefully take to heart, given their announcement on August 2 that they were ready to respond to events as they unfolded but were taking no action for now.

zh: 读一读弗里德曼和施瓦茨的书可以提醒他们，阻止危机要比依靠一个人的力量终结它好。
en: Reading Friedman and Schwartz will remind them that it is better to head off a crisis than it is to rely on one’s ability to end it.

zh: 第二要推荐的书是关于20世纪30年代危机的：查尔斯·金德尔伯格（Charles Kindleberger）的《萧条中的世界，1929—1939 》 （ The World in Depression, 1929-1939，如果休假中的官员们在暑期阅读中能领会到一种模式，那么再好不过了 ） 。
en: A second recommendation is another account of the crisis of the 1930’s, Charles Kindleberger’s The World in Depression, 1929-1939. (If vacationing officials detect a pattern in their summer reading, all the better.)

zh: 金德尔伯格指出，避免危机 — — 以及在没能避免危机时成功地走出危机 — — 需要领导力。
en: Kindleberger’s point is that avoiding a crisis – and when failing to avoid one, successfully exiting from it – requires leadership.

zh: 具体而言，需要一个既有财力，又准备好动用财力的国家来充当领导者。
en: Specifically, it requires leadership by a country with the power of the purse and the willingness to use it.

zh: 问题在于，金德尔伯格发现，在两次大战之间，领先大国美国不愿意担起领导之责、提供财政资源来解决危机。
en: The problem in the interwar period, as Kindleberger recounts it, was the reluctance of the leading power, the US, to provide the leadership and financial wherewithal to resolve the crisis.

zh: 如今，在欧洲，重新统一走向复兴的德国是唯一有能力担起领导责任的国家。
en: In Europe today, reunified and reinvigorated Germany is the only country capable of assuming this role.

zh: 它应该赞成快速银行资本重组、为欧洲稳定性机制颁发银行执照并加大欧洲央行货币政策的扩张程度。
en: It could agree to swift bank recapitalization, a banking license for the European Stability Mechanism, and a more expansionary ECB policy.

zh: 如果德国能够提供此类领导力，其他国家就会马上跟进。
en: If Germany provided this kind of leadership, other countries would be quick to follow.

zh: 欧洲危机就能走上解决之路。
en: Europe’s crisis would then be well along the path to resolution.

zh: 我希望德国可以从金德尔伯格的书中受到启发，给希腊送去阳光。
en: Germans sunning themselves on Greek islands, one hopes, would be inspired by such reading.

zh: 但形势让人很难有信心。
en: But it is hard to be confident.

zh: 当然，经济学家关于大萧条的著作不是一个短短的暑期读得完的。
en: Of course, books by economics professors about the Great Depression hardly a summer holiday make.

zh: 欧洲领导人也可以换换脑子，读一读罗恩·切恩诺（Ron Chernow）的亚历山大·汉密尔顿传。
en: For variety, European leaders could take along Ron Chernow’s biography of Alexander Hamilton.

zh: 汉密尔顿是个多彩的人物，私生子出身，张于西印度群岛，在美国独立战争期间担任炮兵连长。
en: Hamilton was a colorful character, born out of wedlock, raised in the West Indies, and captain of an artillery company in America’s revolutionary war.

zh: 更重要的是，他是华盛顿的财政部长，正是他精心安排的讨价还价成功地化解了美国州债务问题。
en: More to the point, as George Washington’s Treasury secretary, he crafted the bargain that successfully rationalized the US states’ debts.

zh: 美国各州在组成新联盟时各有各的债务负担，各有各的偿债能力。
en: US states entered their new union with different debt loads and different capacities to service them.

zh: 汉密尔顿认为，联邦政府应该将各州因战争融资成本产生的债务揽下。
en: Hamilton made the case that the federal government should assume responsibility for their liabilities stemming from the costs of financing the war.

zh: 他还找到了收入源 — — 关税 — — 来作为偿债资金源，并明确表示如果州政府积累了更多的债务，从而再一次陷入麻烦，将不会获得第二次援助，从而将讨价还价过程包装得十分具有政治诱惑力
en: He identified a source of revenue – the tariff – that could be devoted to this end, and he rendered the bargain politically palatable by making clear that if state governments accumulated additional debts, and again got into trouble, they would not be bailed out a second time.

zh: 欧洲官员会争辩说，他们的问题更加困难。
en: European officials will argue that their problem is more difficult.

zh: 欧洲不但缺少联邦政府，而且也没有创造一个的意愿。
en: Not only does Europe lack a federal government, but there is no desire to create one.

zh: 但是，仔细阅读汉密尔顿的成就，欧洲读者就能发现，在美国建国之初，同样存在根深蒂固的厌联邦情绪。
en: A close reading of Hamilton’s accomplishments, however, will remind European readers that there was an equally deep aversion to federalism in the early US.

zh: 政治家用远见和外交手段在独立后建成了合众国这一政治实体。
en: It took politicians with vision and diplomatic skills to craft the political entity that emerged after independence.

zh: 最后，欧洲领导人还可以一读芭芭拉·塔克曼（Barbara Tuchman）的《八月之抢 》 （ The Guns of August，注意标题中的月份 ） 。
en: Finally, European leaders should consider adding to their book bag Barbara Tuchman’s The Guns of August (again, notice the month).

zh: 塔克曼描述了一系列单独决策 — — 每个决策在单独考虑时都无比合理 — — 是如何在无意中将欧洲拖入一战的。
en: Tuchman describes how a series of individual decisions, all of which seemed sound when considered in isolation, had the unintended consequence of leading Europe into World War I.

zh: 如今，没人会认为欧洲将爆发大战。
en: No one is predicting war in Europe today.

zh: 但国际外交的历史对于国际金融来说同样是正确的 — — 一系列看似合理的决策可能产生灾难性后果，如果没人愿意挑明结局的话。
en: But what is true of international diplomacy – that a series of seemingly reasonable decisions can have cataclysmic consequences if no one bothers to figure out the endgame – is equally true of international finance.

zh: 欧洲正在危险地靠近金融萨拉热窝。
en: Europe is dangerously close to its financial Sarajevo.

zh: 正在南欧危机国海滩度假的欧洲大陆领导人应该好好领会一下塔克曼的著述。
en: The continent’s leaders, while relaxing on southern Europe’s crisis-ridden shores, should take Tuchman’s message to heart.

zh: 欧洲令人惊喜的技术成功
en: Europe’s Surprising Tech Success

zh: 布鲁塞尔—欧洲常常被视为数字时代的落后地区，只能望不断拓展前沿的美国和亚洲之项背。
en: BRUSSELS – Europe is often viewed as a digital laggard, running far behind the frontier-pushing United States and Asia.

zh: 但外表有时会骗人。
en: But appearances are deceiving.

zh: 事实上，据伦敦风险投资公司Atomico的一份新报告，如今欧洲初创企业正在领先人工智能领域、形成新的技术枢纽，并吸引着来自传统行业的投资。
en: In fact, according to a new report by the London venture capital firm Atomico, European startups are now taking the lead in artificial intelligence, building new tech hubs, and drawing investment from traditional industrial stalwarts.

zh: 去年，投资于欧洲技术行业的资金达到了创纪录的136亿美元，而2011年只有28亿美元。
en: Last year, a record-setting $13.6 billion was invested in Europe’s tech sector, compared with $2.8 billion in 2011.

zh: 欧洲“技术”部门主要由消费者导向的电子商务企业 — — 通常只是成功的美国公司的高仿“山寨”版 — — 组成的日子一去不返了。
en: Gone are the days when Europe’s “tech” sector largely comprised consumer-oriented e-commerce businesses – often blatant knockoffs of successful US companies.

zh: 如今，欧洲已成为真正的先锋技术的大本营，首屈一指的便是Atomico所谓的“深度技术 ” — —类似于谷歌所开发的DeepMind人工智能。
en: Today, Europe is the home of real pioneering innovation, led by what Atomico calls “deep tech” – the kind of artificial intelligence developed by Google’s DeepMind.

zh: 深度技术在2015年获得13亿欧元欧洲风险投资，完成82个投资轮次，而2011年只有2.89亿美元、55个投资伦次。
en: Deep tech accounted for $1.3 billion of European venture investments in 2015, delivered in 82 rounds, up from $289 million, delivered in 55 rounds, in 2011.

zh: 欧洲的新技术枢纽崛起于出人意料之处，与伦敦、柏林和斯德哥尔摩等早期热点相去甚远。
en: Europe’s new tech hubs are emerging in unexpected places, far beyond the early hotspots of London, Berlin, and Stockholm.

zh: Atomico列举了巴黎、慕尼黑、苏黎世和哥本哈根为未来几年的希望之星。
en: Atomico pinpoints Paris, Munich, Zurich, and Copenhagen as the cities to watch over the coming years.

zh: Atomico指出，法国首都在风险资本融资交易数量和总规模方面已经开始挑战伦敦和柏林。
en: The French capital, Atomico points out, is already starting to challenge London and Berlin in terms of the number and volume of venture-capital-financed deals.

zh: 如今，欧洲传统行业已经开始有了技术意识。
en: Europe’s traditional industries are now awakening to tech.

zh: 在欧洲市值最大的企业中，有三分之二直接投资于科技公司。
en: Two-thirds of Europe’s largest corporates by market capitalization have made a direct investment in a tech company.

zh: 而自2015年以来，这些公司中又有三分之一并购了科技公司。
en: One-third of those companies have acquired a tech company since the beginning of 2015.

zh: 外国企业也纷纷涌入，利用欧洲的技术人才。
en: Foreign firms are also rushing to take advantage of Europe’s tech talent.

zh: 谷歌、Facebook和亚马逊都宣布将大举扩张它们的欧洲技术枢纽。
en: Google, Facebook, and Amazon have all announced major expansions of their European tech hubs.

zh: 去年共发生降至880亿美元以上的交易 — — 2014年只有33亿美元 — — 包括软银收购英国半导体设计企业ARM以及高通以470亿美元收购NXP半导体公司。
en: Transactions worth more than $88 billion took place last year – compared to just $3.3 billion in 2014 – including SoftBank’s purchase of the British semiconductor-design firm ARM and Qualcomm’s $47 billion purchase of NXP Semiconductors.

zh: 波士顿咨询集团（Boston Consulting Group）的另一份研究指出，许多出口导向型欧盟小成员国 — — 即比荷卢、巴尔干和北欧国家 — — 在所谓的“电子密集程度 ” （ 覆盖IT基础设施、互联网接入以及企业、消费者和政府参与互联网相关活动的情况）排行榜上都大大高于美国。
en: Another study, by the Boston Consulting Group, points out that many small export-oriented European Union member countries – namely, the Benelux, Baltic, and Nordic countries – rank well above the US in so-called “e-intensity,” which covers IT infrastructure, Internet access, as well as businesses, consumer, and government engagement in Internet-related activities.

zh: 这些“数字领先选手”的GDP有大约80%来自互联网，而欧洲五大国（德国、法国、意大利、西班牙和英国）只有5 % 。
en: These “digital frontrunners” generate about 8% of their GDP from the Internet, compared to 5% in Europe’s Big Five (Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom).

zh: 据预计，在2015—2020年间，数字化在这些国家所创造的就业岗位要比它们所消灭的就业岗位多出160—230万个。
en: Digitization is expected to generate between 1.6 million and 2.3 million more jobs than it eliminates in these countries between 2015 and 2020.

zh: 当然，欧洲的科技行业仍然存在弱点，一个明证是迄今为止还没有产生能与硅谷巨无霸抗衡的科技巨头。
en: Of course, Europe’s tech sector still has its weaknesses, reflected in its failure so far to produce a tech giant to rival the behemoths of Silicon Valley.

zh: 欧洲科技创业家在初创融资方面与他们的美国同侪一样容易，但美国企业所获得的后续阶段资本要比欧洲高出14倍。
en: While European tech entrepreneurs find it as easy as their American counterparts to raise startup funds, US firms enjoy 14 times more later-stage capital.

zh: 这一融资差距是可以消除的，只需要欧洲退休基金额外拿出0.6%的管理资本投入风险投资。
en: That funding gap would disappear, if European pension funds allocated just 0.6% more of their capital under management to venture investments.

zh: 一个相关的弱点是欧洲缺少真正的单一数字市场。
en: A related weakness is the lack of a true European single digital market.

zh: 在美国和中国，科技创业家能够立刻进入巨大的市场。
en: In the US or China, tech entrepreneurs gain immediate access to a massive market.

zh: 在欧洲，他们仍然需要面对28个不同的消费市场和监管机制。
en: In Europe, they still must navigate 28 different consumer markets and regulatory regimes.

zh: 诚然，欧盟委员会两年前就已承诺要建立一个单一数字市场，并估计这每年能给欧盟经济带来4,150亿欧元的提振。
en: To be sure, the European Commission promised to create a single digital market two years ago, estimating that it could boost the EU economy by €415 billion ($448.5 billion) annually.

zh: 但开放政治经济网络（Open Political Economy Network）的李-牧山浩石（Hosuk Lee-Makiyama）和菲利普·勒格雷因（Philippe Legrain）最近对其成果进行了严厉的批评。
en: But Hosuk Lee-Makiyama and Philippe Legrain of the Open Political Economy Network recently delivered a scathing assessment of the results.

zh: 他们指出，欧洲的“单一数字市场”最近的情况是充斥着“一大堆过时的、社团主义的、不事生产的产业政策，它们偏袒生产者甚于消费者，偏袒大公司甚于小公司，偏袒传统老牌企业甚于数字初创企业，偏袒欧蒙企业甚于外国企业。 ”
en: Europe’s “single digital market,” they argue, currently amounts “to a jumble of outdated, corporatist, counterproductive industrial policies that favor producers over consumers, big companies over small, traditional incumbents over digital startups, and EU firms over foreign ones.”

zh: 欧盟想要的不是自由化，而是监管。
en: Instead of liberalizing, the EU wants to regulate.

zh: 比如，欧盟正致力于禁止公司拒绝在线销售（除非出于版权原因）或根据客户母国情况制定不同的价格。
en: For example, it is working to ban companies from refusing online sales (except for copyright reasons) or setting different prices on the basis of a customer’s home country.

zh: 其他的危险动作 — — 比如监管数据所有权、接入和使用 — — 也呼之欲出。
en: Other dangerous possibilities – such as an effort to regulate data ownership, access, and usability – lie on the horizon.

zh: 尽管存在这些风险，但欧洲科技行业的总体趋势是积极的。
en: Despite these risks, the overall trend in Europe’s tech sector is a positive one.

zh: 新的风险偏好似乎正在席卷整个欧洲；Atomico的报告指出，85%以上的创始人认为开办自己的公司“在文化上可以接受 ” 。
en: A new appetite for risk seems to be sweeping the continent; Atomico reports that more than 85% of founders say it is “culturally acceptable” to start one’s own company.

zh: 此外欧洲还有很深的研究人才储备 — — 全球最顶尖的十家计算机科学研究所中有五家位于欧盟 — — 欧洲的创业繁荣看上去可以维持。
en: Add to that deep research talent – five of the top ten global computer science faculties are within the EU – and Europe’s start-up boom looks sustainable.

zh: 政治上也有理由保持乐观。
en: Politically, too, there is reason for optimism.

zh: 欧洲的数字领先者正在开始形成一股强大的力量，丹麦、爱尔兰和爱沙尼亚等16个欧盟小国已经组成了一个支持互联网的集团。
en: Europe’s digital frontrunners are beginning to organize into a potent force, with 16 small EU countries, from Denmark to Ireland and Estonia, having formed a pro-Internet group.

zh: 它们联合在一起，敦促欧盟禁止数据本地化的要求。
en: Together, these countries have urged the EU to ban data-localization requirements.

zh: 眼下，美国正在追求保护主义、孤立主义和倒退主义的政策，而欧洲正在崛起成为创新、前瞻的经济力量。
en: At a time when the US is pursuing protectionist, insular, and backward-looking policies, Europe is stepping up as an innovative and forward-looking economic force.

zh: 如果 — — 现在看上去相当可能 — — 所谓的落后的欧洲最终在释放互联网的真正经济潜力方面成为领导者，这难道不令人感到讽刺吗？
en: Wouldn’t it be ironic if, as now seems likely, it is the supposedly backward EU that ended up leading the way in unlocking the Internet’s true economic potential?

zh: 北非带给欧洲的考验
en: Europe’s Test in North Africa

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 欧洲对北非这场历史性变革的反应非常矛盾，自始至终都在兴奋与恐惧之间踌躇。
en: LONDON – Europe’s reaction to the historic revolutions in North Africa has vacillated between exhilaration and fear.

zh: 一方面各国都本能地欢庆并支持民主在地中海沿岸推行的局面，但另一方面又被危机可能蔓延到欧洲的恐惧所困扰。
en: The natural instinct to celebrate and support democratization across the Mediterranean has been tempered by concerns that the crisis will spill onto European shores.

zh: 少数几位欧洲国家领导人希望能向北非提供类似二战后马歇尔计划那样的欧洲发展援助，以确保该地区民主转型过程中的稳定并为欧洲带来长期的政治和经济效益。
en: A few leaders have invoked the post-World War II Marshall Plan as a model for large-scale European development assistance for the region, the aim being to ensure the sustainability of a democratic transformation and generate long-term political and economic benefits for Europe.

zh: 但大多数人的反应则更偏向恐惧：欧盟各国的媒体和政治家们都忧心将会有大批难民源源不断地涌入自己的国家。
en: But the mainstream reaction has been much more fearful: media and politicians throughout the European Union are obsessing about the threat of waves of migrants reaching their borders.

zh: 这种危胁是无法被忽略的。
en: Such a threat should not be taken lightly.

zh: 事实上，对意大利境内突尼斯难民问题的争议已经动摇了允许在申根条约区域内自由流动的政治基础。
en: Already, the controversy over Tunisian migrants in Italy has started to fray the political underpinnings that allow free movement in the Schengen area.

zh: 而与此同时，利比亚战争也产生了数以万计逃离暴力冲突并急需国际保护的难民。
en: The war in Libya, meanwhile, could lead to many more thousands of civilians fleeing the violence and needing international protection.

zh: 截至目前为止，突尼斯和埃及境内的难民营已收容了40万难民，同时估计有2万名难民已经抵达意大利沿岸。
en: So far, nearly 400,000 people have filled refugee camps in Tunisia and Egypt, and an estimated 20,000 have reached Italy’s shores.

zh: 对大批避难者的应对要求欧盟加强其提供短期保护的能力 — — 或者需要对整个避难系统的运作进行重新检讨。
en: Dealing with any surge of asylum seekers will require the EU to strengthen its capacity to offer temporary protection – and possibly to reconsider how its overall asylum system works.

zh: 鉴于目前欧盟在边境管制方面逐渐走向统一，Frontex边境管理局的规模也不断扩大，预计将对这一事务有所帮助。
en: That the Union has been moving towards a common approach to border security, most visibly with the expansion of the Frontex border agency, will be of help here.

zh: 但如果欧洲仅仅埋头应付这一短期危机，那么就可能挥霍掉一个绝佳的长期机遇。
en: But if Europe allows itself to be consumed by the short-term crisis, it risks squandering an extraordinary long-term opportunity.

zh: 通过有策略且明智地利用这一时刻，欧盟有机会重新建构自身与重组中的地中海南岸地区的关系，并推动符合欧洲利益的总体发展和增长。
en: By using this moment strategically and wisely, the EU would have a chance to reframe its relationship with the southern Mediterranean (as it is being redubbed) to promote generational development and growth in ways that can address Europe’s interests, too.

zh: 减轻欧洲的恐惧并防止难民潮失控的最佳办法就是创造积极的激励因素以及实施切实可行的运作方式，使得那些潜在的难民能留在原居地 — — 最有效的方法莫过于在地中海南岸地区创造更多职位，毕竟大部分难民都是极端不情愿的情况下离家出走的。
en: The best way to allay European fears and prevent uncontrolled migration is to establish positive incentives, and the practical means,for potential migrants to stay home – most significantly by creating jobs in the southern Mediterranean. After all, the vast majority of migrants leave home reluctantly.

zh: 而与此同时，随着战后婴儿潮一代在未来十年内逐渐步入退休年龄，欧洲需要补充各个层次的劳动者。
en: Yet, at the same time, as its baby boomers retire en masse in the coming decade, Europe will need workers at all skill levels.

zh: 而拥有大批年轻人口的地中海南部地区则有望成为这些劳动者的来源地。
en: The southern Mediterranean can be the source of this labor, given its huge youth bulge.

zh: 实现这一目的的窍门就在于确保这些移民有机会学习欧洲企业所需要的技能，并能以一种安全，合法和有秩的方式来流动。
en: The trick will be to ensure that migrants are given the chance to acquire the skills that European employers need, and that they have the chance to move in a safe, legal, and orderly fashion.

zh: 相对于目前接纳非法移民却无法满足欧洲的劳动力需求的政策手段，帮助训练下一代北非人并允许他们更加自由地在本国和欧洲之间流动的政策显然更为明智。 该理念并非宣扬要接纳更多移民，而是深思熟虑且计划周详的手段来接纳更优质的移民。
en: Policies that help train the next generation of North Africans, and allow them to circulate more freely between Europe and their home countries, are a much smarter solution than the current approach, which sustains illegal migration without meeting Europe's labor needs. This is an argument not for more migration, but for better migration – well thought out and planned.

zh: 当然，遏制非法移民的最佳长期手段莫过于使北非在欧洲的协助下建立持续而繁荣的民主制度。
en: Of course, if Europe helps North Africa build sustainable, prosperous democracies, this would be the greatest long-term deterrent to illegal migration of all.

zh: 回想50年前，北欧地区最大的移民群体都来自于意大利、希腊，葡萄牙和西班牙。
en: It is worth recalling that 50 years ago, the largest immigrant populations in northern Europe hailed from Italy, Greece, Portugal, and Spain.

zh: 随着上述国家逐渐走向繁荣，这些移民纷纷回国：他们的国家也最终成为了欧洲的增长引擎以及德国，法国和其他欧盟成员国的出口市场。
en: As those countries prospered, the émigrés returned home: their countries eventually became engines of European growth, and major export markets for Germany, France, and other EU member states.

zh: 同理，这样的发展弧线也可以并应当在地中海南岸勾勒出来。
en: The same arc of development can and should be limned for the southern Mediterranean.

zh: 幸运的是，近年来对移民与发展的研究创造了一系列欧洲应当考虑使���的政策工具。 专家和政策制定者们设计了许多创新性项目，包括减低移民向其来源国的汇款费用，加强海外流散者与祖国的联系，以及帮助有技能的移民寻找合适工作的创新性政策，确保不令合资格的外科医生沦为出租车司机。
en: Fortunately, research on migration and development in recent years has helped foster a range of policy tools that Europe should be considering. Experts and policymakers have been devising many innovative programs, including low-cost remittances from migrants to their home countries, efforts to strengthen ties between diasporas and their homelands, and initiatives that help skilled migrants find proper employment, so that qualified surgeons are not driving taxis.

zh: 在考虑如何重新构建欧盟与地中海南部地区关系的时候，我们应当在尽可能大的范围内推广这些理念。
en: In thinking about how to reframe the EU’s relationship with the southern Mediterranean, we should draw on these ideas as expansively as possible.

zh: 为了用积极的方式将各自的社会对接起来，我们必须认真考虑放宽贸易管制，为合法移民开辟新的通道，并大规模增加那些前来欧洲接受教育和专业培训的学生数量。
en: In order to connect our societies in positive ways, we should seriously consider liberalizing trade regimes, opening new avenues for legal migration, and vastly expanding the number of students from the region who come to Europe for education and professional training.

zh: 毕竟正是国内外的北非年轻人对自由的渴望将埃及和突尼斯的独裁者赶了下台，而他们的才干和活力也应当被培养和引导去帮助重建本国社会。
en: After all, it was the youth of North Africa, both at home and abroad, whose notions of freedom helped bring down dictators in Egypt and Tunisia. Their talents and energy should now be cultivated and harnessed to help rebuild their societies.

zh: 对这些挑战和机遇的回应要求在各个国家，国际机构和非政府组织之间建立强大的伙伴关系。
en: Responding to the challenges and opportunities of this moment demands the creation of strong partnerships among states, international institutions, and non-governmental actors.

zh: 自2006年创立以来，全球移民和发展论坛（Global Forum on Migration and Development）为各国以及其他利益攸关者之间关于移民和发展事务的对话提供了急需的平台。
en: Since its inception in 2006, the Global Forum on Migration and Development (GFMD) has provided a much-needed platform for dialogue among states and other stakeholders on issues related to migration and development.

zh: 论坛的年会也为相关经验交流和超越传统“南北”冲突的有益实践提供了便利。
en: Its annual plenary sessions facilitate the exchange of experiences and good practices in a way that transcends traditional “North-South” conflicts.

zh: 在其推动的各项变革之中，论坛说服政府更全面地理解移民问题，并发展出一套“政府整体应对”方案去处理这一事务所带来的机遇和挑战。
en: Among other changes that it has spurred, the GFMD has compelled governments to understand migration more holistically, and to develop a “whole of government” approach to addressing the opportunities and challenges that it poses.

zh: 它同时也强调维护移民权益和打击非法移民的重要性。
en: It also has highlighted the importance to development of protecting migrant rights and of fighting illegal migration.

zh: 全球论坛致力于创造和培育能使移民对来源国和目的地国家发展都有所裨益的理念。
en: The Global Forum has done its job by generating and fostering ideas that can make migration benefit the development of countries of origin and destination.

zh: 而目前也正是推行这些理念的最佳时刻。
en: It is high time that these ideas are implemented.

zh: 没有比在这个在欧洲和地中海南岸地区历史上至关重要的战略窗口执行这一理念的更佳机会了。
en: There could be no greater opportunity for doing so than this strategically crucial window in the history of Europe and the southern Mediterranean.

zh: 如果我们能把握住这一时刻，历史将以优厚的成果回报我们。
en: If we do not seize this moment for action, history could well pass us by.

zh: 欧洲的三大东部问题
en: Europe’s Three Eastern Questions

zh: 华盛顿 — — 今天，整个欧洲项目发生了动摇。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Today, the European project is shaking.

zh: 当然，我相信欧元区终将战胜持续的主权债务危机，并因此而诞生出一个一体化程度及效率更高的欧洲。
en: Of course, I am confident that the eurozone’s ongoing sovereign-debt crisis will be overcome, and that a more integrated and effective Europe will emerge.

zh: 但要改善欧洲的现状，不仅必需解决主权债务危机；与土耳其、俄罗斯和乌克兰等欧洲东部三国的关系也需要进一步稳固。
en: But, to get to that improved Europe, not only must the sovereign debt crisis be resolved; relations with three major countries to Europe’s east – Turkey, Russia, and Ukraine – will need to be put on more secure footing.

zh: 40年前，我们这代人亲身经历了从专制到民主的过渡。
en: I was of the generation in my country that lived through the transition from dictatorship to democracy four decades ago.

zh: 我们的梦想就是欧盟。
en: For us, the European Union was a dream.

zh: 实际上，我们曾经引用奥尔特加·伊·加塞特的名言 ： “ 如果西班牙有了问题，欧洲可以解决。 ”
en: Indeed, we used to quote Ortega y Gasset: “If Spain is the problem, Europe is the solution.”

zh: 尤其是对需要深化乃至建立民主传统的社会，我仍然深信欧洲就是解决方案。
en: I continue to believe, very deeply, that Europe is the solution, particularly for societies that need to deepen – if not establish – a democratic tradition.

zh: 密切欧洲与土耳其、俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的关系可以为他们带来我们在西班牙总是与欧洲联系在一起的收益。
en: Closer relations between Europe and Turkey, Russia, and Ukraine can deliver for them many of the same benefits that we in Spain always associated with Europe.

zh: 当然，土耳其已经是欧盟成员的候选国，但入盟谈判进展的非常缓慢，这在战略上是不明智的，因为土耳其在中东广大地区所树立的权威对欧洲来讲至关重要（可能比欧洲自身的权威还要重要 ） 。
en: Turkey is, of course, already a candidate for EU membership, but accession negotiations are moving very slowly, which is strategically unwise, because Turkey’s great authority in the wider Middle East is vitally important to Europe (and probably greater than its own).

zh: 从叙利亚到阿拉伯春天各国，土耳其的影响力非常显著，事实会证明深化与欧盟的合作只能带来好处。
en: From Syria to all of the Arab Spring countries, Turkey’s influence is highly significant, and further cooperation with the EU can only prove beneficial.

zh: 欧盟已经与土耳其建立了政治问题的沟通渠道。
en: The EU has created a channel of communication with Turkey on political matters.

zh: 但还没有解决最后阶段的关系问题。
en: But it has not resolved the relationship’s endgame.

zh: 我热切地希望耳其成为欧盟成员国，因为这样一个年轻人占绝大多数的民主的穆斯林国家可以在很多关键领域强化欧盟的力量。
en: My passionate hope is that Turkey becomes an EU member, because a country that is Muslim, democratic, and overwhelmingly young could strengthen the Union in vital ways.

zh: 围绕土耳其成员国资格的辩论注定要在今年下半年塞浦路斯担任欧盟轮值主席国时更加引人注目。
en: The debate around Turkish membership is set to become hotter in the second half of this year, when Cyprus assumes the EU’s rotating presidency.

zh: 坦率地讲，土耳其不会承认今天四分五裂的塞浦路斯作为该岛的唯一代表。
en: Turkey, to be blunt, will not recognize today’s divided Cyprus as the sole representative of that island.

zh: 塞浦路斯海岸附近发现石油导致问题进一步复杂化。
en: Further complicating matters is the discovery of oil close to the Cypriot coast.

zh: 任何计划在那里钻探的人都将卷入一场严重的海事纠纷，塞浦路斯自称石油储备位于自己的领海范围内，而土耳其则反驳说塞浦路斯根本没有领海，因为塞浦路斯至少在土耳其人看来是根本不存在的。
en: Anyone planning to drill there will become embroiled in a major maritime dispute, with Cyprus claiming that the reserves lie within its territorial waters, and Turkey countering that Cyprus has no territorial waters, because Cyprus, at least for the Turks, does not exist.

zh: 俄罗斯已经成为欧洲另外一个复杂因素。
en: Russia has become a different type of complicating factor for Europe.

zh: 重新担任总统职务的弗拉基米尔·普京或许和以前一样，但俄罗斯已经发生了变化。
en: Vladimir Putin, who has now returned to the presidency, may be the same person as before, but Russia has changed.

zh: 最近在莫斯科和全国各地的抗议浪潮已经暴露出他的权力是有限度的。
en: The recent wave of protests in Moscow and throughout the country has exposed the limits of his power.

zh: 我相信普京明白这一点，这也是未来外交的一个重要事实。
en: I believe that Putin understands this, which is an important fact for future diplomacy.

zh: 接下来的几天中，俄罗斯新政府的构成将会揭密保守派和自由派之间更多的权力关系。
en: In the next few days, the formation of Russia’s new government will reveal much about power relations between conservatives and liberals.

zh: 值得注意的是，因为前总统迪米特里·梅德韦杰夫设计的私有化计划，数十亿美元的公共财产正受到威胁。
en: Notably, billions of dollars of public property are at stake, owing to a privatization plan designed by former President Dimitri Medvedev.

zh: 在此问题上欧洲有一个和梅德韦杰夫谈判达成的现代伙伴关系框架，如果运用得当可能会产生非常积极的作用。
en: Here, the EU has a framework – the Partnership for Modernization, negotiated with Medvedev – that could potentially be very positive.

zh: 俄罗斯在2011年加入世贸组织也有助于确保它遵守国际规则，就像中国加入世贸组织的时候一样。
en: Russia’s accession to the World Trade Organization in 2011 should also help to ensure that it plays by international rules, as occurred with China when it joined the WTO.

zh: 俄罗斯遵守世贸组织的法律框架应该开始令它的经济关系变得更加稳定和可控。
en: Russia’s adherence to the WTO’s legal framework should begin to make economic relations with it much more stable and predictable.

zh: 此前，俄罗斯加入世贸组织曾遭到格鲁吉亚的阻挠，在去年优雅的外交举措既没有承认南奥塞梯和阿布哈兹分离地区是格鲁吉亚的组成部分，也没有承认其独立国家地位的前提下确立了边境管制机制，格鲁吉亚才取消了其否决投票。
en: Previously, Russia’s admission to the WTO had been blocked by Georgia, which lifted its veto last year after a feat of elegant diplomacy that established a border-control mechanism without recognizing the breakaway regions of South Ossetia and Abkhazia either as part of Georgia or as independent countries.

zh: 这样的解决方案虽然复杂，但却是上述地区一种很好的结果。
en: That solution, while complicated, is a good outcome for the region.

zh: 鉴于乌克兰当前问题及障碍的规模，优雅的解决方案可能既不存在也远远不够。
en: Given the scale of Ukraine’s current problems and dysfunction, an elegant solution may neither be available nor sufficient.

zh: 自从独立以来一直与我结下不解之缘的乌克兰一直让我感到非常沮丧。
en: Ukraine, with which I have been engaged since its independence, has been a great frustration to me.

zh: 我参与了促成2004-2005年橙色革命和平解决的谈判。
en: I was involved in the negotiations that helped to bring about a peaceful resolution of the Orange Revolution of 2004-2005.

zh: 但之后革命领导人季莫申科和尤先科之间的内讧极具破坏性，以致于企图操纵2004年总统大选并因此引发革命的亚努科维奇现在成了总统，而季莫申科则被关进了牢房。
en: But subsequent infighting between the revolution’s leaders, Yulia Tymoshenko and Viktor Yushchenko, was so destructive that Viktor Yanukovych, whose efforts to manipulate the 2004 presidential election incited the revolution, is now President and Tymoshenko is in jail.

zh: 乌克兰对欧盟而言仍然是一个严重问题。
en: For the EU, Ukraine continues to be a serious problem.

zh: 由于季莫申科和其他人遭到监禁，全面的自由贸易和入盟协定至今仍未能签署。
en: A comprehensive free-trade and association agreement with the Union remains unsigned, owing to the incarceration of Tymoshenko and others.

zh: 幸运的是，鉴于欧盟对多数普通乌克兰民众的吸引力，纯粹的现实主义仍有希望说服亚努科维奇和乌克兰的执政精英回心转意并允许签署入盟协议。
en: Fortunately, given the Union’s attraction for most ordinary Ukrainians, there is still hope that simple realism will persuade Yanukovych and Ukraine’s ruling elite to return to a path that would allow for the association agreement to be signed.

zh: 过去二十年来，欧洲的软实力已经改变了很多国家的很多东西，并带动领导人和公民进行经济改革，采纳或者强化民主价值观和制度。
en: Europe’s soft power has changed many things in many countries over the past two decades, spurring leaders and citizens to reform their economies and embrace or strengthen democratic values and institutions.

zh: 欧盟可以在土耳其，俄罗斯和乌克兰继续完成这样的使命，但也有可能因为漫不经心和无所作为而丧失公信力、影响力和经济机遇。
en: It can continue to do so in Turkey, Russia, and Ukraine, or, through inattention and inaction, Europe could lose credibility, influence, and economic opportunities.

zh: 欧洲参加主权债务危机补习班
en: Europe’s Time to Learn

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 一次危机就是一次学习的机会。
en: PRINCETON – Crises are a chance to learn.

zh: 过去的200年里，除了大萧条这个例外，历次大的金融危机都是在穷国和不稳定的国家爆发的，促使它们进行大规模的政策调整。
en: For the past 200 years, with the exception of the Great Depression, major financial crises originated in poor and unstable countries, which then needed major policy adjustments.

zh: 如今，危机却是从富国开始的 — — 不仅源自美国的次贷，而且还源自欧洲失控的银行和公债管理。
en: Today’s crisis started in rich industrial countries – not only with sub-prime mortgages in the United States, but also with mismanagement of banks and public debt in Europe.

zh: 那么，欧洲该吸取什么教训？ 这些教训对世界其他地方又有什么警示呢？
en: So what will Europe learn, and what relevance will those lessons have for the rest of the world?

zh: 欧洲当前的问题同此前困扰世界经济边缘地带的问题惊人地类似。
en: Europe’s contemporary problems offer striking parallels with previous problems on the periphery of the world economy.

zh: 20世纪80年代的拉美、1997年的东亚，从一波又一波危机的沉痛教训中，有关国家提升了经济政策的水平，并且摸索出一套管理公共债务的行之有效的办法。
en: In successive waves of painful crisis – in Latin America in the 1980’s, and in East Asia after 1997 – countries learned a better approach to economic policy and developed a more sustainable framework for managing public-sector debt.

zh: 如今，轮到欧洲来上这一课了。
en: Today it is Europe’s turn.

zh: 欧洲的危机差不多走完了一个循环。
en: The European crisis is coming full circle.

zh: 最初的一场金融危机，随着政府介入，为银行负债担保，演变为一场经典意义上的公债危机。
en: Initially a financial crisis, it morphed into a classic public-debt crisis after governments stepped in to guarantee banks obligations.

zh: 公债危机反过来又引起新的担忧 — — 银行持有的所谓安全的政府债，头寸是不是太大了？
en: That, in turn, has created a new set of worries for banks that are over-exposed to supposedly secure government debt.

zh: 国债似乎不再稳妥了。
en: Sovereign debt no longer looks stable.

zh: 最重要的前车之鉴是差不多30年前的拉美债务危机。
en: One of the most important precedents is the debacle of Latin American debt almost 30 years ago.

zh: 1982年8月，墨西哥宣布失去偿债能力，震惊世界。
en: In August 1982, Mexico shocked the world by declaring that it was unable to service its debt.

zh: 当年夏天，尽管墨西哥的财政赤字估计在GDP的11%上下，它仍然在国际金融市场上举债，只是溢价更高了。
en: For most of that summer, Mexico, with a projected fiscal deficit of around 11% of GDP, was still borrowing on international financial markets, though at an increasing premium.

zh: 放贷给它的银行自我安慰地想：反正国家是不会破产的。
en: Banks had reassured themselves with the belief that countries could not become insolvent.

zh: 但殊不知当时的情形很严峻，一大批性质各异的国家纷纷进入高负债行列，就像一副码好的多米诺骨牌。
en: But then a wide range of inherently different countries seemed to line up like a row of dominos.

zh: 趁着20世纪70年代的第二次石油价格冲击，墨西哥渡过了一段石油经济繁荣期；在军事独裁下饱受经济弊政之苦的阿根廷，正在为发动马岛战争作准备；巴西则在预演它今日的经济奇迹，凭借资本输入支撑惊人的高速增长。
en: While Mexico had a petroleum-based boom in the wake of the second oil-price shock of the 1970’s, Argentina suffered from economic mismanagement under a military dictatorship that then staged its disastrous invasion of the Falkland Islands/Malvinas. Brazil had experienced an earlier version of its current economic miracle, with stunning growth rates financed by capital imports.

zh: 到头来，它们殊途同归，陷入了同一个泥潭：过度负债。
en: But in the end, these very different circumstances produced a common and inherently simple problem: over-indebtedness.

zh: 当时，如果拉美国家普遍违约，将把各大工业国的银行体系全都拖垮，引爆又一次大萧条。
en: A Latin American default would have brought down the banking systems of all the major industrial countries, causing something like a replay of the Great Depression.

zh: 美国各大银行近九成的资本都押在了墨西哥国债上。
en: Exposure to Mexican debt alone represented some 90% of the capitalization of major US banks.

zh: 最后所采取的办法，当时被认为是卓有成效的，因为拉美各大债务国没有一个出现正式违约的情况（只是巴西于5年后，也就是1987年，曾短暂出现过违约 ） 。
en: The solution that was eventually adopted was considered brilliant at the time, because it avoided formal default by any of the big Latin American borrowers (though Brazil briefly defaulted five years later, in 1987).

zh: 这一套办法由三部分构成：国际货币基金组织（IMF）迅速提供国际援助；根据IMF的贷款条件，顶住民意压力，对内厉行节约，削减开支；各债权银行额外提供融资。
en: It involved a combination of three elements: immediate international assistance, through the International Monetary Fund; severe domestic retrenchment, enforced by the highly unpopular conditionality of IMF programs; and additional financing provided by the banks.

zh: 直到五年之后，各金融机构才开始就拉美债进行资产减记，此时对银行自身的稳定性已不再构成威胁。
en: There was no institutionalized write-down of Latin American debt until five years after the crisis, when a haircut no longer threatened banks’ stability.

zh: 也是从此时开始，新的放贷项目才得以真正启动。
en: It was only at this moment that real lending for new projects could really begin.

zh: 而在这若干年里，拉美各国一直苦苦挣扎，乃至有了后来广受议论的“失去的十年 ” 。
en: In the meantime, Latin America remained mired in what became widely known as “the lost decade.”

zh: 欧洲眼下所采取的办法，同20世纪80年代所谓“失去的十年”中，那些发展中国家所采取的拖延战术，似乎如出一辙。
en: The contemporary European solution seems to be repeating the same time-buying tactics of the lost decade of the 1980’s in the developing world.

zh: 也是同样的组合：对外寻求国际支援，对内强推削减措施（必然引发抗议示威 ） ， 并公然免除银行业的责任，尽管它们制造了危机。
en: There is the same combination of international support, highly unpopular domestic austerity measures (which are bound to set off major protests), and the apparent absolution of banks from financial responsibility for problems that they produced.

zh: 欧洲各大银行，不论是英国的、德国的还是法国的，就像20世纪80年代它们的前辈一样，错把国债当成安全债权，累积了巨大的头寸。
en: Major European banks – in the United Kingdom, Germany, and France – have, like their 1980’s predecessors, built up a gigantic exposure to what they erroneously thought was safe debt.

zh: 如果立即对脆弱的欧元区国家的主权债进行大规模减记，可能引发新一轮银行业大恐慌，其后果不堪设想。
en: A substantial immediate haircut on the sovereign debt of the vulnerable eurozone countries would be so destructive that it would set off a new round of bank panics.

zh: 恰恰是看准了这一点，那些银行便可以向它们的政府勒索赎金。
en: Recognizing this problem, banks can hold their host governments to ransom.

zh: 这才是此次危机给英国、德国和法国提出来的棘手问题。
en: That is why the crisis has become a challenge for the UK, Germany, and France.

zh: 法德首脑11月中旬在法国多维尔提出倡议修订《里斯本条约 》 ， 把出台强制债务重组机制的时间定在2013年以后，也是为了避免短期内爆发减记潮所可能造成的冲击。
en: The Franco-German initiative unveiled at Deauville in early November, which would require some possible measure of restructuring for debt issued after 2013, tried to avoid the immediate shock of a haircut.

zh: 尽管如此，对可能减记的预披露仍会引发市场对欧洲银行业的担忧。
en: But the pre-announcement of possible write-downs still led to a major wave of uncertainty about banks.

zh: 从长期来看，还有一种办法，就是当银行所持有的国债过多时，允许做一定数额的减记。
en: A long-term alternative requires some capacity to write down debt where it has reached excessive levels.

zh: 但是也必须对未到期债务中的一部分作出百分之一百的保证，预防全额减记引发恐慌。
en: But it is also necessary to establish an iron-clad guarantee of some part of the outstanding debt, in order to remove fear of a complete write-down.

zh: 如能建立一套有序处理国家破产的机制，将是对全球治理领域的一大贡献，同是也可以解决主权债市场的一大顽疾。
en: A mechanism for dealing in an orderly way with sovereign bankruptcy would be a major contribution to global governance, and to solving a longstanding problem of sovereign-debt markets.

zh: 在20世纪90年代和21世纪头十年里，此类方案引发过广泛讨论，而且IMF的常务董事安妮·克吕格尔（Anne Krueger）还推动过一个主权债务重组机制（Sovereign Debt Restructuring Mechanism ） ， 试图为债权人实施大规模减记提供一条法律通道，从而消除集体行动的困境，为有效解决国家破产扫除障碍。
en: Such proposals were widely discussed in the 1990’s and early 2000’s, and IMF Deputy Managing Director Anne Krueger pushed a Sovereign Debt Restructuring Mechanism that would have offered a legal path to imposing general haircuts on creditors, thereby ending the collective-action problems that impede the efficient resolution of sovereign bankruptcy.

zh: 欧洲正面临着史上最严峻的主权违约危机，如果它能证明，它的一套办法行之有效且具有可操作性，就能减轻疑虑，重振市场信心。
en: If Europe could show – in the worst possible scenario of sovereign default – how such a process might operate, uncertainty would be reduced and markets would be reassured.

zh: 从长期来讲，也能为处理棘手的主权债务问题树立一个可靠的榜样。
en: And, in the longer term, we would have a viable international model of how to tackle severe sovereign-debt problems.

zh: 欧洲的三重威胁
en: Europe’s Triple Threat

zh: 发自帕罗奥图 — — 欧洲正同时遭受着主权债务，银行以及货币危机的侵袭。
en: PALO ALTO – Europe is suffering from simultaneous sovereign-debt, banking, and currency crises.

zh: 严重的经济困局和政治压力正考验着公民，主权国家和类似欧洲央行这类超国家机构之间的关系。
en: Severe economic distress and political pressure are buffeting relationships among citizens, sovereign states, and supranational institutions such as the European Central Bank.

zh: 更有各种声音甚嚣尘上，既有要求放弃国家财政主权的，又有号召大幅重组在财务上极端脆弱的银行系统，同时/或许还有人要求希腊或者其他可能陷入困境的欧元区国家退出欧元（或者临时建立一个双重货币联盟 ） 。
en: Calls are rampant for surrendering fiscal sovereignty; for dramatic recapitalization of the financially vulnerable banking system; and/or for Greece and possibly other distressed eurozone members to quit the euro (or for establishing an interim two-tier monetary union).

zh: 在这个岌岌可危的境地，政策制定者们正不顾一切地运用各类手段 — — 包括欧洲央行，国际货币基金组织以及欧洲金融稳定基金 — — 来试图遏制金融恐慌，扩散以及陷入衰退的风险。
en: In this combustible environment, policymakers are desperately using various vehicles – including the ECB, the International Monetary Fund, and the European Financial Stability Facility – in an attempt to stem the financial panic, contagion, and risk of recession.

zh: 但这些官员们选择的道路又是否正确呢？
en: But are officials going about it in the right way?

zh: 主权债务，银行以及欧元危机这三者其实是紧密相连的。
en: The sovereign debt, banking, and euro crises are closely connected.

zh: 由于欧洲许多资本薄弱的银行都忍痛持有大量欧元区边缘国家的主权债务，一旦其资产被推向市场的话就将面临破产。
en: Given their large, battered holdings of peripheral eurozone countries’ sovereign debt, many of Europe’s thinly capitalized banks would be insolvent if their assets were marked to market.

zh: 同时这些银行的去杠杆化过程还阻碍了经济复苏。
en: Their deleveraging inhibits economic recovery.

zh: 而希腊，爱尔兰和葡萄牙等国（如果意大利和西班牙不包括在内的话）的大规模财政重整在经济和政治上都同样具有杀伤力。
en: And the large fiscal adjustment necessary for Greece, Ireland, and Portugal, if not Italy and Spain, will be economically and socially disruptive.

zh: 可能出现的违约将伴随着严重的经济规模收缩 — — 2002年阿根廷发生违约时其GDP规模就随之下降了15 % 。
en: Default likely would be accompanied by severe economic contraction – Argentina’s GDP fell 15% after it defaulted in 2002.

zh: 尽管进行了压力测试，设立援助基金同时连续开会商讨，欧洲的政策制定者们依旧未能找到一个长期可行的解决方案。
en: Despite stress tests, bailout funds, and continual meetings, a permanent workable fix has so far eluded European policymakers.

zh: 如果遭到失败的话欧洲未来的经济发展必将面临重大障碍，同时可能威胁到欧元的生存。
en: Failure will erect a huge obstacle to European economic growth for years to come, and could threaten the survival of the euro itself.

zh: 而各国首脑内部及其与欧洲央行之间在购买危机受灾国主权债券方面的意见不一致只是增加了整个事件的不确定性而已。
en: Disagreement among and between heads of state and the ECB over the Bank’s purchases of distressed sovereign debt have only added to the uncertainty.

zh: 一个体面的泛欧洲经济复苏以及成功的财政逐步巩固将使危机受灾国主权债券的价值随时间不断升高。
en: A decent pan-European economic recovery, and successful gradual fiscal consolidation, would allow the distressed sovereign bonds to rise in value over time.

zh: 到那时候，这些进程的执行者们将继续决定应该由谁在什么时候以何种方式承担损失：是希腊的公民们，还是法德两国的纳税人？
en: Until then, the jockeying will continue over who will bear the losses, when, and how. Will it be Greek citizens?

zh: 是债券持有者，金融机构，还是股东？
en: German, French, and Dutch taxpayers? Bondholders?

zh: 而基本的问题则是缓解危机的方式将如何影响到损失的数量。
en: Financial institutions’ shareholders? And the fundamental problem is that how the battle is resolved will affect the amount of the losses.

zh: 银行股的价格以及欧洲银行同业拆放款利率和隔夜指数掉期的利差（Euribor-OIS spread）都显示市场对受灾国主权债券的高度不信任，如今希腊十年期国债的收益率已经高达25 % 。
en: Prices of bank shares and the Euribor-OIS spread (a measure of financial stress) signal a profound lack of confidence in the sovereign debt of distressed countries, with yields on ten-year Greek bonds recently hitting 25%.

zh: 而这场危机同时也危及到非欧洲国家，人们对美国银行和货币市场基金与受灾欧洲银行之间的牵涉情况感到忧虑，进而危害到了美国金融市场。
en: The crisis affects non-Europeans too; for example, concern over the exposure of American banks and money-market funds to troubled European banks is harming US financial markets.

zh: 在此总共有三种基本方式去解决银行危机（而这意味着同时解决财政调整，主权债物和欧元问题 ） 。
en: There are three basic approaches to resolving the banking crisis (which means resolving the fiscal adjustment, sovereign debt, and euro issues simultaneously).

zh: 第一种方式依靠时间，收益率和最终的银行健康状况。
en: The first approach relies on time, profitability, and eventual workout.

zh: 有一项数据估计如果欧洲边缘国家的主权债券价值下跌50%的话（这对希腊来说很合理，对其他国家则较过分）就将带来3万亿美元的损失，比全欧洲银行资本的总和还高。
en: One estimate suggests that a 50% reduction in the value of peripheral countries’ sovereign debt (reasonable for Greece, but high for the others) would cause about $3 trillion in losses, overwhelming the capital of European banks.

zh: 但在目前的低利率环境下银行其实是盈利部门，因为它们一般利用杠杆进行短期借款，再以更高的利率放出长期贷款。
en: But the banks are profitable ongoing enterprises in the current low-interest-rate environment, because they typically engage in short-term borrowing and longer-term lending at higher rates, with leverage.

zh: 因此只要时间足够，银行就能逐渐通过保持盈利或者吸引外���资本的方式实现自我资产重组。
en: Playing for time thus might enable them gradually to recapitalize themselves by retaining profits or attracting outside capital.

zh: 一个强劲且持续的经济复苏将使这一方式变得可行。
en: A strong, durable economic recovery would make such an approach workable.

zh: 大多数欧洲官员也希望能在与足量公共资金相结合支持危机国主权债券的情况下实现这一点。
en: Most European officials hope that, when combined with substantial public money to support troubled sovereign debt, it will.

zh: 奥巴马政府在实施了不受欢迎的问题资产救助计划（就是将数千亿美元公共资金注入银行系统，其中许多资金都得到了偿还）之后也采用了这一选项。
en: The Obama administration adopted this option, following the unpopular Troubled Asset Relief Program, which injected hundreds of billions of public dollars into the banking system (most of which has been repaid).

zh: 但包括美洲银行和花旗银行在内的某些美国银行依然脆弱不堪，其资产负债表上依然存在大量有毒资产（主要涉及到房屋抵押债券 ） 。
en: But some US banks, including Bank of America and Citi, are still vulnerable, with considerable toxic assets (mainly related to home mortgages) on their balance sheets.

zh: 第二种方式则是迅速解决。
en: The second approach is rapid resolution.

zh: 因为如果损失规模过大或者复苏太过脆弱的话，任由有问题的银行逐渐自我资产重组并随后解决问题债券 — — 或许是通过欧洲版的布雷迪债券（于1990年代创设，使美国各大银行能部分减免拉美各国债务的零息债券，以时任美国财政部长布雷迪得名 ） — —的方式将无法生效。
en: But letting questionable banks gradually recapitalize themselves and resolving the bad debt later – perhaps with European Brady Bonds (zero-coupon bonds which in the 1990’s enabled US banks and Latin American countries to agree to partial write-downs) – won’t work if the losses are too large or the recovery is too fragile.

zh: 因此有必要采取更加迅速的解决方案以防止有毒银行进一步感染整个财政系统。
en: More rapid resolution may be necessary to prevent zombie banks from infecting the financial system.

zh: 美国清债信托公司曾在1989至1995年间迅速关闭了1000家破产银行和储蓄贷款公司，以防止其损害其他健康金融机构。
en: The US Resolution Trust Corporation rapidly shut down 1,000 insolvent banks and Savings and Loans from 1989 to 1995 so that they would not damage healthy institutions.

zh: 如果换算成当今经济规模的话，就有总值1.25万亿美元的资产被出售并追回了80%的总价值。
en: Scaled to today’s economy, assets worth $1.25 trillion were sold off, with 80% of the value recovered.

zh: 金融系统也得以迅速恢复健康。
en: The financial system rapidly returned to health.

zh: 而这个方法需要具备判断和分析能力，以便将无还债能力和有还债能力的机构区分开来。
en: This approach requires judgment and resolve in separating insolvent institutions from solvent ones.

zh: 最后还有一条公共资本的路径。
en: Finally, there is the path of public capital.

zh: 如果由市场推动的资本重组进程过于缓慢，同时又无法关闭无还债能力的金融机构，一个更加极端的备选方案就是将公共资本直接注入银行（而不是像现在这样通过力挺银行所持主权债券的间接方式 ） 。
en: If market-driven recapitalization is too slow, and closing failing institutions is impossible, a more extreme alternative is to inject public capital directly into the banks (rather than indirectly, as now, by propping up the value of the sovereign debt that they hold).

zh: 这种手段能防止银行遭遇挤兑，因为拥有更多资本的银行显然会变得更加安全。
en: This approach prevents bank runs, because banks with more capital are safer.

zh: 但究竟该动用多少公共资本，在什么条件下动用？
en: But how much public capital should be used, and on what terms?

zh: 而私人资本虽然更加适用，但考虑到这些金融机构可能在未来的公共干涉中遭到撤销，投资者自然会有所保留。
en: Private capital, of course, is preferable, but, given the risk that it will be wiped out by future public intervention, investors will be wary.

zh: 与此同时，监管者也在增加银行的资本充足率。
en: In the meantime, regulators are increasing banks’ capital ratios.

zh: 同时拥有借贷者和放贷者双重身份的欧洲人必须干脆利落地解决银行问题，并同时应对欧元，主权债务和财政重整事务。
en: Europeans, both debtors and creditors, must address the banking problem forthrightly, and simultaneously with the euro, sovereign-debt, and fiscal-adjustment issues.

zh: 而假装认为那些已经通过温和压力测试的银行能在造成少量间接破坏的情况下无限期地经营下去的想法显然是一厢情愿 — — 而且危险的。
en: Pretending that banks that passed modest stress tests can be kept open indefinitely with little collateral damage is wishful – and dangerous – thinking.

zh: 欧洲的麻烦邻居
en: Europe’s Troublesome Neighbors

zh: 发自巴黎 — — 对于欧洲来说，自己所处的地理位置堪称是一把双刃剑。
en: PARIS – Geography has dealt Europe a mixed hand.

zh: 欧洲人庆幸自己离那些正在崛起的世界强权 — — 比如印度，巴西，尤其是中国 — — 足够远，因此也免予遭受这些大国崛起过程中所伴生的种种冲突。
en: Europeans can congratulate themselves on being a relatively safe distance away from whatever tensions may accompany the rise of powers like India, Brazil, and, especially, China.

zh: 但与此同时，欧洲也与两个备受世界瞩目的区域为邻。
en: But Europe is bordered to its south and east by two great regions that give cause for significant concern.

zh: 时至今日，无论是俄罗斯还是伊斯兰世界，都依然还是那副与全球化格格不入的样子。
en: Neither Russia nor the Islamic world is, thus far, adapting well to globalization.

zh: 两者的经济都严重依赖石油和天然气出口。
en: The economies of both remain over-dependent on oil and gas exports.

zh: 在中东地区，这催生了为庞大的年轻人口创造工作的难题。
en: In the Middle East, this exacerbates the problem of creating jobs for ballooning populations of young adults.

zh: 而对于俄罗斯来说，人口也是个令人头痛的问题，只不过恰巧与中东相反罢了，因为预计在未来 15 到 20 年内，俄罗斯人口总量将下降整整 10 % 。
en: Russia, too, faces real demographic difficulties, though in the other direction as Russia’s population is projected to shrink by as much as 10% over the next 15 or 20 years.

zh: 尽管芬兰，波兰以及其他中东欧国家的担心不无道理，但欧洲与俄罗斯的关系相对于欧洲 - 穆斯林关系还算是比较好处理的。
en: Despite the understandable concerns of Finns, Poles, and others in Central and Eastern Europe, the relationship with Russia should be the easier of the two to manage.

zh: 自从冷战结束以后，欧俄之间的关系就像地球上两块挨在一起的大陆板块，不时你挤压一下我我挤压一下你。
en: The West’s relations with Russia since the end of the Cold War have resembled the meeting of two tectonic plates, with one progressively forced beneath the other.

zh: 比如 2008 年的格鲁吉亚冲突就凸显出“俄罗斯板块”对“欧洲板块”东进运动的巨大反作用力。
en: The Georgia conflict of 2008 was the tremor that signaled substantial resistance to the western plate’s eastward movement.

zh: 但所发生的一系列转变使得俄罗斯无论在国际影响范围还是军事力量方面都被大大削弱。
en: But the shifts that have taken place left Russia much diminished in terms of its sphere of influence and military might.

zh: 无可否认，普京治下的俄罗斯满脑子民族主义，笨拙不堪而且经常惹一些大麻烦。
en: To be sure, Vladimir Putin’s Russia is nationalistic, awkward, and disposed to dangerous trouble-making.

zh: 但这个国家其实也正面对着一些严峻的社会和公众健康问题，还有 13 亿中国人在东边虎视眈眈，此外俄罗斯人其实也和欧洲有着共同的利益，比如天然气和石油贸易，还有迫在眉睫的伊斯兰极端主义威胁。
en: But it also faces acute social and public-health problems and has 1.3 billion Chinese on its eastern border, and it has important common interests with Europe, including trade in gas and oil and a shared preoccupation with Islamic extremism.

zh: 只要用克制而坚定的手腕来处理，欧洲的对俄关系即使如何复杂，也不至于无法管理。
en: Handled with forbearance and firmness, relations with Russia should remain difficult but manageable.

zh: 有北约作后盾，欧盟携自己的“东部伙伴关系计划 ” （ Eastern Partnership initiative ）逐渐将在前苏联区域的持续敌我斗争关系转变成一些敌意没那么浓厚的进入行动，而美国总统奥巴马也表现出安抚俄罗斯被剥夺的尊严的迹象，因此在这个区域，大型的冲突将得以避免。
en: With NATO backing off, the European Union stepping in with its Eastern Partnership initiative to shift continuing competition in the post-Soviet space onto a less antagonistic footing, and President Barack Obama demonstrating his willingness to assuage Russia’s damaged pride, major confrontation should be avoidable.

zh: 而欧洲与伊斯兰世界的关系则更为棘手。
en: Europe ’s relations with the Islamic world are a lot trickier.

zh: 首先，虽然俄罗斯对欧洲的怨恨可能还只是近一个时期的事，但穆斯林世界的怨恨则更深，并且因更加深远的互动而催生，既有旧恨，又有新仇。
en: First, although Russia’s resentments may be fresher, those of the Muslim world run deeper, and are born of more profound interactions, past and present.

zh: 其二，不管你对基地组织的恐怖或者西方军队在伊拉克和阿富汗的行动作何感想，欧洲和伊斯兰世界似乎都更愿意用暴力的手段跟对方打交道。
en: Second, whether one thinks of Al Qaeda’s terrorism or the presence of Western armies in Iraq and Afghanistan, Europe and the Islamic world have demonstrated a continuing willingness to deal violently with each other.

zh: 第三，即便欧洲人可以被区分为数个彼此不同的群体，而伊斯兰世界的情况只能更为复杂。
en: Third, even if Europeans are a disparate group, the Islamic world is infinitely more so.

zh: 伊斯兰教是贴在这个群体身上一个共同的标签 — — 但其中的国家，比如印尼和也门，究竟有什么相似之处？
en: Islam is its identifying glue – but how much else do Indonesia and Yemen, for example, have in common?

zh: 伊斯兰世界内部同样存在着阿拉伯人和非阿拉伯人，逊尼派和什叶派，原教旨主义分子和神学温和派人士之间的冲突。
en: The Islamic world is riven by disputes between Arab and non-Arab, Sunni and Shia, and Salafi extremists and theological moderates.

zh: 即便是基地组织，也不忘在向西方发动圣战的同时将建立一个新伊斯兰教法统的目标写入自己的议程当中。
en: Al Qaeda’s agenda is as much about the creation of a new Islamic caliphate as it is about waging jihad against the West.

zh: 第四，欧洲人发现很难将传统伊斯兰教理念应用到妇女或者同性恋者身上。
en: Fourth, Europeans find it hard to stomach traditional Islamic attitudes towards, say, women or homosexuals.

zh: 反过来穆斯林也不明白一个满大街充斥着色情和酗酒的西方社会究竟有何文明可言。
en: Muslims find it hard to understand how we can believe our society is civilized when pornography and drunkenness are openly displayed.

zh: 在某种程度上欧洲人都是基督教徒，因为人们将宗教看作么每个人自身与心目中的“神”的关系；而穆斯林则将其视为某种组织性的社会准则。
en: To the extent that Europeans are Christian at all, we see religion as a matter of an individual’s relationship with his or her God; Muslims see it as an organizing social principle.

zh: 欧洲文化是罪感文化，而穆斯林文明却是耻感文化。
en: Ours is a guilt culture; theirs a shame culture.

zh: 而以色列这个国家则理所当然地成为伊斯兰世界愤怒的发泄目标。
en: Israel is, of course, the single issue on which the Islamic sense of resentment focuses.

zh: 因为它是西方人伪善的证明 — — 无论是在核不扩散，拒绝与民选的哈马斯政府合作，或者是在指责俄罗斯在格鲁吉亚“不当”使用武力的同时却对加沙地区冲突的 1300 条亡魂���持沉默的行为。
en: It exemplifies Western hypocrisy – whether over nuclear non-proliferation, the refusal to deal with the elected Hamas, or readiness to criticize Russia for “disproportionate” use of force in Georgia while remaining quiet over 1,300 deaths in Gaza.

zh: 此外，与其两位前任不同，奥巴马有勇气在自己就任初期就着手处理以巴这个异常棘手的问题。
en: Unlike his two predecessors, Obama has had the courage to target the Israel-Palestine problem, the intractable seat of the infection, from the beginning of his presidency.

zh: 他亲赴开罗对阿拉伯世界发表演讲，满口谦虚和恭敬，一点也没提到人权和个人自由这些东西。
en: And he went to Cairo to address the Arab world with humility and respect, without shirking issues of human rights and individual freedom.

zh: 对于欧洲人来说，美国如此活跃的坏处就是给了欧洲袖手旁观的理由。
en: The risk in this American activism is that it will provide the excuse for Europeans to sit back and cheer while someone else does the heavy lifting.

zh: 但这种消极的行为将会犯下一场历史性的错误。
en: But passivity would be a historic mistake.

zh: 须知美国在中东的利益跟欧洲可是截然不同的。
en: America’s Middle East interests are not identical with those of Europe.

zh: 既有大洋的阻隔，再加上足以实现能源自给的强大技术实力，美国将最终得以远离中东地区的种种混乱。
en: Protected behind its oceans, and applying its vast technological capacity to the goal of energy self-sufficiency, the United States is ultimately able to distance itself from the travails of the Middle East.

zh: 一旦撤出了伊拉克和阿富汗，美国人就会发现自己将越来越乐于和中东划清界限。
en: Once out of Iraq and Afghanistan, the US may find itself increasingly tempted to do just that.

zh: 但对欧洲来说，这种隔离根本不可能实现。
en: For Europe, such distancing is impossible.

zh: 欧洲的安全毫无疑问将和穆斯林世界寻求并维持一种妥协的做法捆绑在一起。
en: European security is inextricably bound up with the need to find and maintain a modus vivendi with the Muslim world.

zh: 当然，欧洲也并不是没有力量。
en: Europe is not without leverage.

zh: 目前欧洲正与以色列发展更深入的经贸关系：这样一旦以色列政府拒绝停止其在西岸地区的殖民行为，欧洲就应该清楚地意识到，作为以色列最重要的出口市场，欧洲是有权使用一点强硬手腕的。
en: It has currently put on hold a deepened economic relationship with Israel: if Israel’s government continues to refuse to stop its colonization of the West Bank, Europeans should make clear that, as Israel’s most important export market, they have tougher options at hand.

zh: 再考虑到伊朗和以色列双方都决心利用对方的强硬态度作为自己行事的理由，欧洲也必须准备好将自己的经济力量施加到伊朗身上，特别是当那群宗教统治者们拒绝了奥巴马伸出的双手的时候。
en: And, given the determination of both the Israeli and Iranian governments to use each other’s intransigence as an excuse for their own, Europe must also be prepared to use its economic muscle on Iran if and when the mullahs reject Obama’s extended hand.

zh: 最后，欧洲的军事力量也必须在制订和保证一个以巴两国方案方面扮演一个重要的角色。
en: European military forces will also be required to play a crucial role in policing and guaranteeing a two-state settlement.

zh: 这很重要，因为这将令欧洲真正醒悟到自己的安全利益究竟在哪里，并且承担起维护它的重任。
en: This makes it all the more important for Europe to wake up to where its real security interests lie, and to take responsibility for asserting them.

zh: 欧洲的信任赤字
en: Europe’s Trust Deficit

zh: 伯克利—如今，关于欧洲的赤字问题以及纠正这一问题的需要已是老生常谈了。
en: BERKELEY – There is no shortage of talk nowadays about Europe’s deficits and the need to correct them.

zh: 批评家们纷纷将矛头指向巨大的政府预算赤字。
en: Critics point to governments’ gaping budget deficits.

zh: 他们指责南欧国家长期背负着外部赤字。
en: They cite the southern European countries’ chronic external deficits.

zh: 他们强调欧元区的制度性赤字 — — 使用单一货币和单一央行，却没有其他货币联盟正常运转所必须的元素。
en: They highlight the eurozone’s institutional deficits – a single currency and a central bank but none of the other elements of a well-functioning monetary union.

zh: 当然，所有这些批评都有自己的道理。
en: Of course, in all of these areas, the critics have a point.

zh: 但这些赤字都不是真正的问题所在。
en: But none of these is the deficit that really matters.

zh: 导致欧洲迟迟不能给这场危机画上休止符的是信任赤字。
en: The deficit that prevents Europe from drawing a line under its crisis is a deficit of trust.

zh: 首先，欧洲存在各国领导人与各国公众之间的信任不足。
en: First, there is deficient trust between national leaders and their publics.

zh: 这方面最显而易见的便是前意大利总理贝卢斯科尼，幸运的是，他早已被踢出了政界。
en: We saw this most visibly in the person of former Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi, who fortunately has been kicked to the sidelines of the political scene.

zh: 但即使是最坚强的欧洲领导人，也无不因为朝令夕改而丧失了追随者的信任。
en: But even the most stalwart European leaders have lost their followers’ trust by baldly saying one thing today and the opposite tomorrow.

zh: 比如，2月底，德国总理默克尔做出了令人惊讶的坚持：欧洲不需要加固其金融防火墙来保护其他欧元区国家免受希腊的无序违约。
en: At the end of February, for example, German Chancellor Angela Merkel made a spectacle insisting that no bigger financial firewall was needed to protect other eurozone countries from a disorderly Greek default.

zh: 她坚定地宣称，德国纳税人不会再为此多花一个子儿。
en: Not one more euro of German taxpayer money, she vowed, would be contributed for this purpose.

zh: 但所有人都知道，一旦德国众议院投票赞成最近的希腊援助计划并经过足够长的时间来让她体面地承认现实，那么默克尔将会自食其言，指出欧元区毕竟还是需要更大的防火墙的。
en: Yet everyone knew that once the Bundestag voted for the latest Greek rescue and enough time passed to acknowledge reality gracefully, Merkel would reverse course and argue that the eurozone needed a bigger firewall after all.

zh: 事实上，对政客来说，体面是渴望不可及的。
en: In fact, there is nothing at all graceful about this.

zh: 他们今天说要如此如此，但公众们知道，过不了几天，他们便会提出完全相反的观点。 这已足以让欧洲领导人的信任度受到极大伤害。
en: For politicians to say one thing now when everyone knows they will soon say the opposite is guaranteed to erode trust in Europe’s leaders.

zh: 其次，欧盟成员国之间也缺少互信。
en: Second, there is a lack of trust among European Union member states.

zh: 北欧之所以不愿意提供“大炮 ” — —即为南欧国家提供更多的金融支援 — — 原因在于它们不相信受助国能明智地使用援助资金。
en: The real reason why the northern Europeans have been unwilling to provide a “big bazooka” – that is, extend more financial assistance to Southern Europe – is that they don’t trust the beneficiaries to use it wisely.

zh: 比如，它们担心，欧洲央行增加证券购买量 — — 初衷是为了压低西班牙的借贷成本 — — 的唯一效果是让西班牙政府放松其改革措施。
en: They fear, for example, that additional securities purchases by the European Central Bank, aimed at bringing down Spain’s borrowing costs, would only lead the Spanish government to relax its reform effort.

zh: 结果，德国及其盟国只准备提供使船不至于下沉的援助，而不会保证它能够平稳航行。
en: As a result, Germany and its allies are prepared to provide just enough assistance to keep the ship from capsizing, but not enough to set it on an even keel.

zh: 第三，被要求做出牺牲的社会团体之间也缺乏互信。
en: Third, there is lack of trust among the social groups called on to make sacrifices.

zh: 意大利出租车司机原因增加竞争，只要他们能确信意大利药店也这样做。
en: Italian taxi drivers would be prepared to allow more competition if they were sure that Italian pharmacy owners were willing to do likewise.

zh: 但如果颁发更多的出租车执照减少了司机的收入，而药店成功地抵制了意在降低其服务成本的鼓励竞争措施，那么出租车司机就会遭受损失，而药店将会获益，这显然是不公平的。
en: But if issuing more taxi medallions reduces cab drivers’ earnings, while pharmacists succeed in vetoing pro-competition measures to lower the cost of their services, the taxi drivers will end up worse off and the pharmacists will be enriched, which hardly seems fair.

zh: 换句话说，社会信任的缺乏阻挡了结构性改革。
en: In other words, lack of social trust blocks structural reform.

zh: 在希腊，这一矛盾 — — 其他人不缴更多的税，那么我也不愿因缴更多的税 — — 尤其突出。
en: The Greek version of this dilemma, in which no one pays taxes because no one else pays taxes, is particularly stark.

zh: 调查研究表明，不同社会的信任水平大相径庭。
en: Survey research has revealed that societies vary greatly in their levels of trust.

zh: 经济学家已经证明，这种观念上的差异具有深刻的历史根源。
en: Economists, for their part, have shown that these different attitudes have deep historical roots.

zh: 在欧洲，迫害少数民族的历史至少长达500年，但民族和宗教冲突在最近一段时间更加普遍了。
en: In European regions where minority groups were persecuted 500 years ago, ethnic and religious conflicts have been more pervasive in recent times.

zh: 在长期受到奥斯曼帝国统治的巴尔干地区，对政府的信任度要低于碰巧由效率更高的哈布斯堡王朝统治的邻近地区。
en: In parts of the Balkans long ruled by the Ottoman Empire, trust in government is lower than in nearby regions that just happened to have been ruled by the more efficient Habsburgs.

zh: 在早期居民从事农耕而不是放牧的地区，先民被迫进行了更广泛的合作，其后代在今天也更易建立起互信。
en: In regions where earlier inhabitants engaged in farming rather than herding, forcing them to cooperate more extensively, their descendants are more likely to form bonds of trust today.

zh: 有证据表明，观念会随代际的推移而减弱。
en: Evidently, attitudes are passed down through the generations.

zh: 观念会以文化的形式深入社会的血液。
en: They are embedded in societies in the form of culture.

zh: 简言之，对于信任这个问题，历史起到了极大的作用。
en: Simply put, when it comes to trust, history casts a long shadow.

zh: 历史学家很早就开始强调这种“路径依赖”的重要性，即很久以前发生的事件会影响现在的结果。
en: Historians have long emphasized the importance of such “path dependence” – that events in the distant past continue to shape outcomes in the present.

zh: 但他们也指出，时间具有神奇之窗，能让社会偏离已有路径。
en: Yet they also point to exceptional windows in time when it is possible for societies to shift away from their established paths.

zh: 危机，即已有安排的活力出现问题之时，便是一种时间窗口。
en: A crisis, when the viability of established arrangements is called into question, is just such a window.

zh: 因此，欧元区��机便为欧洲提供了建立信任的机会。
en: The euro crisis thus offers Europe an opportunity to reestablish trust.

zh: 欧洲各国领导人需要与选民直接对话，已建立信任。
en: Its national leaders need to reestablish the trust of their constituents by offering them straight talk.

zh: 欧盟成员国需要重建彼此的互信。
en: EU member states need to rebuild their trust in one another.

zh: 而面临痛苦的结构性改革的欧洲国家需要重建国内的社会信任。
en: And European countries facing the need for wrenching structural reforms need to restore social trust at home.

zh: 如果这一重塑信任的良机被浪费了，那么欧洲修正其财政、经济和制度赤字的可能性即使存在，也将非常渺茫。
en: If this opportunity to rebuild trust is squandered, it will be difficult, if not impossible, for Europe to address its fiscal, economic, and institutional deficits.

zh: 乌克兰：欧洲的战略枢纽
en: Europe’s Ukrainian Linchpin

zh: 柏林 — — 有人说，革命到头来总会吞噬自己的儿女。 就“颜色革命”而言，这显然不假。
en: BERLIN – Revolutions, it is said, almost always devour their children.

zh: 先是格鲁吉亚，如今轮到了乌克兰。 2004 年“橙色革命”的英雄，乌克兰总统尤先科，在几周以前的首轮总统选举中落败，只拿到了 6% 的选票。
en: Obviously, this is also true for the “color revolutions” – first in Georgia, and now in Ukraine, where President Viktor Yushchenko, the hero of the “Orange Revolution” in 2004, was voted out in the first round of presidential elections a few weeks ago, having received less than 6% of the vote.

zh: 此前的形势是，乌克兰的自由之春已经退化成一种明显的发展停滞，政府的无能和腐败引发了变革的呼声。
en: By that point, Ukraine’s springtime of freedom had already deteriorated into a very visible development standstill, owing to a mixture of incompetence and corruption that cried out for change.

zh: 无论其余的候选人谁最终当选，是现任总理季莫申科抑或亚努科维奇，橙色革命的历史一页肯定会就此翻过。
en: Regardless of which of the remaining candidates will be elected in the upcoming runoff – the incumbent Prime Minister Yuliya Tymoshenko or Viktor Yanukovych – the Orange Revolution will have come to an end.

zh: 所以，现在值得回顾一下，想当年，基辅市中心的独立广场那些激动人心的日日夜夜、尤先科的最终当选，牵出了多少 憧憬 和希望。
en: So it is worth looking back to the hopes that were linked to those wonderfully expectant days and nights on Maidan Square in the center of Kiev, and to Yushchenko’s electoral victory.

zh: 那是民主和独立对舞弊和强权的胜利。
en: It was a victory of democracy and independence over electoral fraud and naked power.

zh: 然而，发生在 2004~2005 年那个冬天的故事，不仅仅是乌克兰人民行使民主权利争取自治和独立的故事，也牵涉到冷战后欧洲秩序的未来。
en: But what happened in the winter of 2004/2005 was not only about the Ukrainian people’s democratic right to self-determination and their national independence, but also about the future of the European order as it had emerged from the Cold War’s end.

zh: 当时，欧洲马上理解了这一挑战，并作出了有效的回应。
en: At the time, Europe immediately understood the challenge and reacted effectively.

zh: 竞选必须重来，民主最终获胜。
en: The elections had to be repeated, and democracy won.

zh: 这一切，如今全是徒劳吗？
en: Was this, in hindsight, all in vain?

zh: 绝不！
en: By no means!

zh: 虽然乌克兰的经济社会问题重重，人们仍然不应忘记，那场革命拯救了乌克兰，使它摆脱了俄罗斯式的“听指挥”的民主，直到今天。
en: Although Ukraine is in big economic and social trouble, it should not be forgotten that it has, until today, been saved from the fate of becoming a “guided” democracy in the Russian mold.

zh: 乌克兰不再限制独立的媒体和言论自由，国际观察家和各党派也公认 2004 年以来的历次选举是自由和公平的。
en: Independent media and freedom of speech have not been restricted in Ukraine, and elections since 2004 have been judged free and fair by both international observers and the parties themselves.

zh: 这一切成就，在东欧的历史背景下看来，都是来之不易的。
en: All this cannot be taken for granted in Eastern Europe.

zh: 此外，不论谁赢得总统大选，乌克兰都不会有丧失独立性之虞，这跟 2004~2005 年那时很不一样。
en: Moreover, regardless of who wins the presidential runoff, fears about Ukraine’s independence will not, in contrast to 2004/2005, be an issue.

zh: 那也是不容低估的成就。
en: This too, is a step forward that should not be underestimated.

zh: 乌克兰的顽固不化和贪污腐败令欧洲灰心，欧洲遗弃了这个国家 — — 这将被证明是一个重大的战略错误。
en: Frustrated by Ukraine’s immobilism and corruption, Europe has turned away from the country – a stance that could turn out to be a significant strategic mistake.

zh: 乌克兰是后冷战欧洲秩序的一块基石。
en: Ukraine is one of the cornerstones on which the European order rests after the Cold War.

zh: 欧洲和俄罗斯在乌克兰遭遇，乌克兰的命运不仅是欧洲安全形势的关键，也是未来欧 — 俄关系的关键。
en: Europe and Russia meet in Ukraine, and its fate will not only be a crucial factor in defining European security, but will also play a substantial role in future European-Russian relations.

zh: 乌克兰是否能保持独立和民主，对整个欧 — 俄关系影响重大。 如果它保不住，历史就会倒退；如果能保住，情况就大不一样，对欧洲大为有利。
en: With an independent, democratic Ukraine, European-Russian relations will have a completely different, and much more positive, character than if its role were to fundamentally change and history be reversed.

zh: 所以，这个大国的未来对欧洲十分重要，哪怕只考虑自身利益，欧洲也不能放任自己的情绪，眼看着它沉沦下去。
en: So the future of this big country is of great importance to Europe; in view of its own interests, therefore, Europe cannot afford an emotionally frustrated reaction.

zh: 不仅如此，欧洲还应该积极行动起来，增大对乌克兰的经济政治投入力度，加强同它的合作。
en: Rather, the opposite is needed: massive economic and political investment, and closer cooperation.

zh: 同乌克兰打交道，需要耐心和恒心，但它实在是太重要，没有别的路可选。
en: Dealing with Ukraine will take patience and perseverance, but there is too much at stake to choose any other path.

zh: 这就意味着，欧盟在考虑一种“新东方政策”之时，必须首先考虑乌克兰。
en: This means that, when considering a “new eastern policy,” the European Union must focus first and foremost on Ukraine.

zh: 尤其是，来自东欧的欧盟成员国一定不能对乌克兰的未来失去信心，否则的话，欧盟迟早也会对它失去信心的。
en: The EU’s eastern member states, in particular, must not lose their interest in Ukraine's future, otherwise the Union as a whole may soon do the same.

zh: 在这一点上，德国和波兰的角色十分关键，这两个国家都属于欧盟六大国，并且对乌克兰的战略意义有清楚的认识。
en: Here, Germany and Poland will play a central role, for both belong to the EU’s six big member states and have the necessary strategic awareness of Ukraine’s importance for Europe.

zh: 法国、英国、意大利和西班牙的利益未必能使它们认识到这一点。
en: By contrast, the interests of France, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Spain don’t point in this direction.

zh: 2004 年的教训还有一条值得总结。
en: This was another lesson learned in 2004.

zh: 只有当德国和波兰，会同其他较小的东欧成员国一起，主张对乌克兰实行“东方”睦邻政策，欧盟的整体策略才能表现出必要的力度和耐心。
en: Only if Germany and Poland, together with the smaller eastern member states, jointly advocate such an “eastern” and neighborhood policy towards Ukraine, will EU policy as a whole receive the necessary power and perseverance.

zh: 因此，欧洲是不是会在东欧坚决地贯彻自己的利益诉求，关键看柏林和华沙的政府是否能精诚合作，看它们同布鲁塞尔的欧盟政府和其他成员国是否能存异求同。
en: Thus, whether Europe effectively pursues its own interests in Eastern Europe will depend on coordination between the governments in Berlin and Warsaw, and between them and the EU in Brussels and the other member states.

zh: 德国和波兰还应该共同努力，确保欧洲的利益诉求 — — 一个独立和民主的乌克兰 — — 不会引起任何方面的不满，不仅是基辅方面，也包括莫斯科方面。
en: Germany and Poland should also jointly make sure that Europe’s interest in an independent and democratic Ukraine is not directed against anyone — not just in Kiev, but also in Moscow.

zh: 德国的新外长曾说，要致力于重建当年的“魏玛三角 ” — — 法国、德国和波兰。
en: Germany ’s new foreign minister has spoken of trying to recreate the old “Weimar Triangle” of France, Germany, and Poland.

zh: 那条路行不通。 首先是因为，法国对此不感兴趣。
en: That will not work, primarily because France shows little interest, and it is an idea whose time is past.

zh: 但是另一条路却是可以走走的，就是德国加强同乌克兰的合作，最终建立一个德国、波兰、俄罗斯大三角，这个三角的意义更深远，可以给欧洲的东方政策带来新的动力。
en: But cooperation on Ukraine might eventually lead to the creation of a far more meaningful Germany-Poland-Russia triangle that could give a new stimulus to Europe’s eastern policy.

zh: 欧洲不均衡发展的挑战
en: Europe’s Uneven Growth Challenge

zh: 一年前，经济发展疲软是欧元区所面临的最重要的挑战。
en: A year ago, the euro zone’s most important challenge was anemic economic growth.

zh: 但2006年是欧洲发展较快的一年，出口的迅猛增长出人意料地拉动了国内的需求。
en: But 2006 turned out to be a good year for growth in Europe, as surprising strength in exports sparked unexpected increases in domestic demand.

zh: 欧元区最发达的国家德国经历了戏剧性的转折，2006年的国内生产总值增长了2.7 % ， 为2000年以后增长率之冠。
en: Germany, the euro zone’s biggest economy, had a particularly dramatic turnaround, with annual GDP up by 2.7% in 2006, the highest rate since 2000.

zh: 德国的复苏不仅促进了整个欧洲的经济增长，还打破了欧元区的增长均衡。
en: Not only has German resurgence raised overall growth in Europe, but it has also made growth less evenly balanced throughout the euro zone.

zh: 这是因为德国比法国和意大利等其他经济大国增长更为迅速。
en: This is because Germany is growing faster than the other large economies, France and Italy.

zh: 通过大规模改组企业部门，德国创造了这个奇迹。
en: Germany accomplished this feat by dramatically re-structuring its corporate sector.

zh: 从2001到2005年，德国悄然发生着革命。
en: From 2001 to 2005, there was a “silent revolution” in Germany.

zh: 就在观察家和评论家们喋喋不休地讨论经济发展迟缓的时候，重要但却不为人所知的变革正在幕后发生。
en: While observers and commentators focused on the economy’s slow overall growth, behind the scenes, largely unnoticed, important changes were taking place.

zh: 德国工人默默接受了在不增加工资的条件下延长劳动时间。
en: Without fanfare, German workers accepted longer hours without increases in pay.

zh: 这使德国与其他欧元区大国相比在国际市场上的竞争力有所提高，后者一直默不作声，既没有改革生产率，也没有采取其他相应措施。
en: This allowed Germany to improve its competitive position in world markets vis-à-vis the other large euro-zone economies, where there were no productivity revolutions, silent or otherwise.

zh: 一段时间以后，默默无闻的改革取得了具体成果。
en: It took some time for the silent revolution to show concrete results.

zh: 但截止到2006年，德国的出口和国内生产总值都比法国和意大利增长迅速。
en: But by 2006, both German exports and GDP were growing faster than in France and Italy.

zh: 引入欧元之前，德国和邻国之间的改革差距并不是什么了不起的问题。
en: Before the introduction of the euro, the reform gap between Germany and its larger neighbors would have been no problem for Europe.

zh: 如果哪个国家改革落后，那么其货币相对于德国马克的比价将会下跌，有可能还会引发辅助性的利率下降。
en: The currencies of the reform laggards would have depreciated against that of Germany, and there might have been a supportive cut in interest rates as well.

zh: 但这样的时代一去不复返了。
en: This is no longer possible.

zh: 德国经济的高速发展推动了欧元的升值，提升后的欧洲利率使德国游刃有余，却使欧元区的改革落后国感受到了压力。
en: Superior German economic performance has bid up the euro and European interest rates to levels that, while comfortable for the Germans, put pressure on the euro zone’s laggards.

zh: 如果德国感到比价合适，法国和意大利就会感到难以承受。
en: The appropriate level of the euro for the Germans is too high for the French and Italians.

zh: 而如果法国和意大利感觉合适，德国就会感到利率太低。
en: The right interest rate for the French and Italians is too low for the Germans.

zh: 对于法国、意大利和葡萄牙这样的改革落后国来说，与竞争力日益增强的德国结成货币联盟迫使他们做出这样的艰难选择：要么加速国内的改革不乏，要么坐视经济永远停滞下去。
en: For reform laggards like France, Italy, and Portugal, currency union with an increasingly competitive Germany is forcing an unwelcome choice between revving up their own reforms and permanent stagnation.

zh: 这样的选择非常艰难。
en: This is no easy choice.

zh: 即便在政治上下定决心，加速改革进程也是一项艰苦卓绝的任务，需要足够的时间。
en: Even with political will, revving up the reform process is a difficult task and takes time.

zh: 实际上，即便以德国这样意志坚定，改革也耗费了4到5年才初见结果。
en: Indeed, it took a motivated Germany four to five years to do it.

zh: 但法、意、葡等国永久停滞的前景是难以接受的。
en: But the prospect of permanent stagnation for countries like France, Italy, and Portugal is unacceptable.

zh: 长期经济停滞是接纳欧元所付出的太过惨重的代价。
en: Chronic stagnation is too high a price to pay for adopting the euro.

zh: 自然，政治家们不愿在不可接受（永久性停滞 ） 、 不可想象（退出欧元计划）和难以实施（改革）间做出选择。
en: Naturally, politicians are reluctant to face up to choices between the unacceptable (permanent stagnation), the unthinkable (leaving the euro), and the hard-to-do (reform).

zh: 因此他们用空想来自我安慰。
en: So they are taking refuge in fantasy.

zh: 比如在法国，所有总统候选人都提出了一个不太现实的方案，那就是留在货币联盟之内，但是要降低欧洲央行的独立性及其稳定价格的权限，并加强政府和欧洲央行之间的磋商，操纵欧元走势向对法国有利的方向发展。
en: In France, for example, all current presidential candidates hold out the unrealistic prospect of staying in the currency union but watering down the independence of the European Central Bank and its price stability mandate, increasing “consultation” between governments and the ECB, and manipulating the euro to France’s advantage.

zh: 这纯粹是在逃避现实。
en: This is pure escapism.

zh: 货币联盟内的根本性变化必须得到所有成员国的批准，因此是远水解不了近渴。
en: Approval of fundamental changes in the currency union must be agreed by all members, and so will not be forthcoming.

zh: 欧洲央行行长简·克劳德·特里谢（Jean-Claude Trichet）也不会屈服于法国的压力，实行更为柔和的货币政策。
en: Nor will ECB President Jean-Claude Trichet be intimidated by French pressure to pursue a softer monetary policy.

zh: 特里谢一直以强硬著称，面对法国领袖毫不示弱。
en: Trichet is a tough guy with a long history of standing up to the French politicians.

zh: 在当法国央行行长时，他没有屈服于法国政府的压力，捍卫了银行的独立地位，同样，现在的法国领导人不能使他屈服。
en: They couldn’t make him bend when, as Governor, he successfully defended the independence of the Bank of France, and they won’t make him bend now.

zh: 比如在欧洲央行管理委员会的1月会议上，实际就在四月举行的法国大选前，特里谢提前宣布将于三月提高欧洲利率。
en: At the January meeting of the ECB’s Governing Council, for example, Trichet virtually pre-announced that European interest rates would be increased in March just before the April French elections.

zh: 欧洲央行行长明确表示：无论面临什么样的政治压力，他都决心完成自己的任务。
en: The ECB President made it clear he will do his duty whatever the political pressure.

zh: 决定特里谢责任感的因素是《马斯特里赫特条约 》 ， 条约明确规定：欧洲央行的主要目标是维护价格稳定。
en: The defining factor in Trichet’s sense of duty is the Maastricht Treaty, which clearly states the prime objective of Europe’s central bank to be the promotion of price stability.

zh: 法国有些势力¾不仅限于左派¾希望加以改变。
en: Some in France – and not just the left – want to change this.

zh: 其中一种提法是由欧洲议会来决定欧洲央行的目标，理由是欧洲议会由民主选举¾就像签订《马斯特里赫特条约》不是一项民主进程。
en: One idea making the rounds is for the European Parliament to define the ECB’s objectives, on the basis that it is democratically elected – as if the Maastricht Treaty did not result from a democratic process.

zh: 这种劫持欧洲央行，将其变成欧洲议会附庸的蛮横企图会使欧洲利率持续低迷，还会造成欧元贬值。
en: This high-handed attempt to highjack the ECB and make it a servant of the European Parliament would mean chronically low European interest rates and a depreciated euro.

zh: 法国当然可以逃脱改革的枷锁，但代价是牺牲德国的利益，使德国不得不面对通货膨胀的压力。
en: France would be off the reform hook, of course, but at the expense of Germany, which would face unwanted inflationary pressures.

zh: 这项提案说明改革差距和随之而来的发展不均衡能够如何削弱欧洲的团结，造成欧洲国家的内部争斗。
en: This proposal illustrates how the reform gap, and the unbalanced growth that results from it, can debilitate the European fabric by setting one partner against the other.

zh: 为保护欧洲凝聚力 、改善各国的经济发展局面，法国和意大利必须以比德国更快的步伐推进改革，而不是等待德国慢下来。
en: To protect European cohesion as well as improve their own economic situation, France and Italy must reform at a faster pace than Germany rather than just waiting for Germany to slow down.

zh: 困难重重总好过无法接受或无法想象。
en: The hard-to-do is preferable to the unacceptable and the unthinkable.

zh: 但现在却没有迹象表明这两个改革落后国家正在接受挑战。
en: Still, there is little indication so far that the two reform laggards are up to the challenge.

zh: 欧洲价值观中的欧洲统一
en: Europe's Unity in European Values

zh: 伴随着关于欧盟宪法的争论而来的是一场关于欧洲价值观的论战。
en: Alongside the debate about the European Union constitution, a debate about European values has also developed.

zh: 这场辩论的重要之处在于它不仅能够赋予欧盟宪法以实质的意义，还会决定欧盟本身的活力和精神。
en: This debate is important not only for implanting meaning in the constitution, but will also determine the vitality and energy of the EU itself.

zh: 欧盟作为诸多伟大的宗教和哲学传统的产物，是一个价值观的共同体。
en: The EU, being the product of several great religious and philosophical traditions, is a community of values.

zh: 古希腊人和罗马人的理念、基督教、犹太教、人道主义和启蒙运动造就了今天的欧洲。
en: The ideas of the Greeks and Romans, Christianity, Judaism, humanism, and the Enlightenment have made us who we are.

zh: 与伊斯兰和阿拉伯文化的对话也在我们 同一性 的塑造中发挥了作用。
en: Dialogue with Islamic and Arabic cultures also helped form our identity.

zh: 我们价值观的模式在几百年来一直演进着。
en: The pattern of our values has been woven over hundreds of years.

zh: 欧洲是米开朗基罗和孟德斯鸠的大陆，但同时也是断头台和毒气室的大陆。
en: Europe is the continent of Michelangelo and Montesquieu, but also of the guillotine and the gas chamber.

zh: 的确，第二次世界大战的痛苦经历让欧洲人认识到共同价值观的根本重要性。
en: Indeed, the bitter experience WWII taught Europeans how fundamental is the importance of shared values.

zh: 在饱受战争蹂躏，百废待兴的欧洲，人们渴望和平、自由、稳定和实现繁荣的新机会。
en: In an impoverished, war-ravaged Europe, people yearned for peace, freedom, stability, and a new chance to prosper.

zh: 欧洲统一的建筑师们-莫内、舒曼、阿登纳、德加斯佩利及其他人-深知只有将欧洲各国的实际利益紧密结合才能实现这些理想。
en: The architects of European integration - Monnet, Schuman, Adenauer, De Gasperi, and others - understood that these ideals could be achieved only by combining and interweaving the practical interests of Europe's countries.

zh: 他们将脆弱的和平之屋建造在煤炭和钢铁之上。
en: They built their fragile house of peace on a foundation of coal and steel.

zh: 缔造者们将火炬传到了Jacques Delors, Helmut Kohl, François Mitterrand, Václav Havel, Valéry Giscard d'Estaing等一代人手中。
en: The founders passed the torch on to the generation of Jacques Delors, Helmut Kohl, François Mitterrand, Václav Havel, Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, and others. They broadened and deepened European cooperation.

zh: 在他们的领导下欧洲才可能大踏步地实现其战后的理想-和平、稳定和繁荣。
en: Their leadership made it possible for Europe to make great strides towards its post-war ideals - peace, stability, and prosperity.

zh: 现在我们正站在新一阶段欧洲合作的门槛上。
en: We now stand at the threshold of a new phase of European cooperation.

zh: 在10月的晚些时候，欧盟的《宪法条约》将会得以签署。
en: In late October, the EU's Constitutional Treaty will be signed.

zh: 新一代的政治家们已准备好接过火炬继续前行。
en: A new generation of politicians is ready to carry the torch onwards.

zh: 但这火焰还燃烧得那么明亮吗？
en: But is the torch still burning bright?

zh: 让·莫内在20世纪五十年代早期曾写道 ： " 我们并不是要组建一个国家联盟。
en: In the early 1950s, Jean Monnet wrote: "We are not forming a coalition of states.

zh: 我们是在把人民团结起来。
en: We are uniting people."

zh: "而现实显然并非如此。
en: Apparently not.

zh: 在欧盟大踏步前进的过程中，它似乎已将欧洲的公民们抛在了身后。
en: As the Union races ahead, it seems that it has lost Europe's citizens along the way.

zh: 有许多人正在抛弃这项事业。
en: Many are turning their backs on the whole project.

zh: 他们看不出欧洲有什么共同之处。
en: They have trouble seeing what is common to Europe.

zh: 他们不觉得自己是一个巨大整体的一部分。
en: They do not feel part of the great whole.

zh: 甚至在新的成员国，对欧洲民主国家大家庭的热度也正在降温。
en: Even in the new member states, enthusiasm for the European family of democracies is cooling.

zh: 我们是在没有将欧洲人团结起来的情况下建立了一个统一的欧洲。
en: We have achieved a united Europe without uniting Europeans.

zh: 当今战后的几代人由于缺少对第二次世界大战的直接记忆，便将欧洲的伟大成就-自由、和平和繁荣-看作是理所当然的。
en: Today's post-war generations, lacking direct memory of WWII, view Europe's great achievements - liberty, peace, and prosperity - as a given.

zh: 将欧洲作为遗产和使命的理念（对他们来说）并没有多大的意义。
en: The idea of Europe as a heritage and a mission does not mean much.

zh: 但，如果没有理想，欧洲的基础就会被侵蚀。
en: But, without ideals, Europe's foundations will erode.

zh: 强调纯粹的自我利益会增加这种威胁。
en: The emphasis on pure self-interest increases this threat.

zh: 在我们这代人成长的印象中，欧洲是一种经济合作的形式。
en: My generation grew up with the image of Europe as an economic form of cooperation.

zh: 这一经济事业掩盖了欧洲一体化背后的政治动因。
en: Political motives behind European integration were overshadowed by the economic project.

zh: 其结果是使欧洲给人以一个市场的印象。
en: The result is an impression of Europe as a marketplace.

zh: 市场和货币的欧洲而不是人和道德的欧洲主导着这项事业。
en: A Europe of markets and money, not of man and morals, dominated the project.

zh: 但如果没有坚实的道德基础也就不会有自由市场经济。
en: But without a moral foundation, there can be no free-market economy.

zh: 今天，我们正在为忽略欧洲共有的价值观和共同的使命而付出代价。
en: Today, we are paying the price for not attending to Europe's shared values and common mission.

zh: 直到欧洲人准确地了解了欧洲所代表的含义及启迪和激励我们的动力，欧盟才能在世界上采取协调一致的行动。
en: Until Europeans know precisely what Europe stands for, what inspires and motivates us, the Union will not be able to take joint action in the world.

zh: 《欧盟宪法》将会使欧洲变得更加民主和透明。
en: The EU Constitution will make Europe more democratic and more transparent.

zh: 它进一步确保决策者将会是与公民们最接近的人。 它承认欧盟所赖以生存的一系列价值观的重要意义：尊重人的权利和尊严、自由、民主、平等和法制。
en: It provides further guarantees that decisions will be taken by those closest to citizens, and it acknowledges the significance the values on which the Union rests: respect for human rights and dignity, liberty, democracy, equality, and the rule of law.

zh: 这些共有的价值观是将各国政府团结起来的粘合剂。 在此情况下，各国政府都承认当共同的关注需要我们采取共同战略时，敝帚自珍就不合时宜了。
en: These shared values are the glue that binds governments together in the recognition that clinging to pure self-interest is no longer reasonable when common concerns call for a common strategy.

zh: 如果欧洲各国的公民之间仍有隔阂，那么取消欧洲（各国间）的物理界限又有什么意义呢？
en: For what is the point of doing away with Europe's physical borders if borders between its citizens remain?

zh: 如果在铁幕消失之后欧盟的公民个人和集团仍将自己关在自设的铁幕后面，那么欧洲人又怎能快乐呢？
en: How can Europeans be happy that the Iron Curtain is gone if individuals and groups across the Union barricade themselves behind private iron curtains?

zh: 事实上恐惧、不安全感和民族主义又在抬头。
en: Indeed, fear, insecurity, and nationalism are again raising their heads.

zh: 在欧洲人准备欧盟的进一步扩大和考虑开始与土耳其进行入盟谈判时，他们在一点上的反思尤为重要。
