en: This is the so-called “spread”: the difference between the yield of, say, French, Italian, or Spanish bonds relative to those issued by Germany.

zh: 利差在最近几个月中急剧扩大。
en: And the spread has increased sharply in recent months.

zh: 但这一指标也与人们的关注点不一致：人们关注今年春天的法国总统竞选，或意大利大选（想必在民年初举行）作为在一定意义上决定欧元命运的事件。
en: But this indicator is also not consistent with the focus on France’s presidential election this spring, or on Italy’s general election (which must be held by early next year) as somehow determining the fate of the euro.

zh: 毕竟，广泛使用的利差是十年期债券收益率之差。
en: After all, the widely quoted spread refers to the difference in yields on ten-year bonds.

zh: 比如，意大利的利差是180个基点，意思是意大利政府要比德国政府多付出1.8 % ， 但只是在十年期债券上是如此。
en: A spread of 180 basis points for Italy, for example, means that the Italian government is paying 1.8% more than the German government, but only for ten-year bonds.

zh: 如果你认为即将到来的选举是合适的时间点，那么就应该关注1—2年的期限。
en: If one were to take the forthcoming elections as the proper time horizon, one should look at 1-2-year maturities.

zh: 但对于这些较短的投资期，利差要小得多：法国接近于零，意大利和西班牙也只有几十个基点。
en: But for these shorter-term investment horizons, the spreads are much lower: close to zero for France and a few dozen basis points for Italy and Spain.

zh: 因此，似乎没有理由担心欧元在短期内的生存。
en: Thus, there seems to be little reason to fear for the euro’s survival in the near term.

zh: 很小的短期利差有违于人们对即将到来的法国（以及意大利）的选举的关注，看上去选举结果隐含着切实的短期解体危险。
en: Small short-term spreads belie the focus on the forthcoming elections in France (and those in Italy), which supposedly imply a concrete short-run danger of a breakup.

zh: 类似地，尽管累计TARGET2失衡程度确实是一个问题，如果欧元解体的话；但它并不构成独立的资本外逃指标。
en: Likewise, while the accumulated TARGET2 imbalances would indeed create a problem in case of a euro breakup, they do not constitute an independent indicator of capital flight.

zh: 但也不是一切正常。
en: But all is not well, either.

zh: 持久的收益率差表明市场参与者怀疑欧元的长期生存。
en: Persistent longer-term yield differentials suggest that market participants have some doubts about the euro’s long-term survival.

zh: 对马上就要进行的选举的结果进行猜测要比讨论欧元区改革更加“带劲 ” 。
en: Speculation about election outcomes in the immediate future is more fascinating than discussions about eurozone reforms.

zh: 但是，投票结果出炉后，决策者将不再有任何借口不去解决根本性的长期问题 — — 如何经营一个成员如此多样化的共同货币区。
en: After the votes are counted, however, policymakers will no longer have any excuse not to address the fundamental longer-term issues of how to run a common currency with such diverse members.

zh: 欧元区应有的政府
en: The Government the Eurozone Deserves

zh: 雅典—希腊问题会摧毁欧洲货币联盟吗？ 还是揭示了应该如何拯救欧元区？
en: ATHENS – Will Greece’s troubles destroy Europe’s currency union, or reveal how it should be saved?

zh: 争议重重的最新协议 — — 有些类似于1919年的《凡尔赛和约 》 ， 今天的希腊相当于当时的德国 — — 可谓欧元区存在神话的新转折。
en: The recent controversial bailout deal – likened by some to the 1919 Versailles Treaty, with Greece in the role of Germany – offers the latest twist in the eurozone’s existential saga.

zh: 该协议导致了希腊左翼执政党左翼联盟（Syriza）的分裂，也让德国总理默克尔和她的坚决不妥协的财政部长朔伊布勒之间的分歧，还促使法国重新评估其在一直充当着欧洲一体化“引擎”的法德轴心中的作用。
en: The deal has caused a split in Syriza, Greece’s leftist governing party; opened a rift between Germany’s Chancellor Angela Merkel and her uncompromisingly tough finance minister, Wolfgang Schäuble; and spurred an effort by France to reassert itself within the Franco-German axis that has always been the “motor” of European integration.

zh: 与此同时，许多美国凯恩斯主义经济学家，如诺贝尔经济学奖获得者保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）和约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz ） ， 表示同情希腊的反紧缩立场。
en: Meanwhile, many of North America’s Keynesian economists, such as Nobel laureates Paul Krugman and Joseph Stiglitz, sympathize with Greece’s anti-austerity stance.

zh: 其他经济学家（主要是欧洲经济学家）认为希腊必须扮演与其经济重要性相当的政治角色，必须接受主权分享（和债务共担）安排以确保货币联盟的凝聚力和可持续性。
en: Other economists, mainly in Europe, argue that Germany must assume a political role befitting its economic preeminence and must accept sovereignty-sharing (and burden-sharing) arrangements to ensure the monetary union’s cohesion and sustainability.

zh: 羞辱一个小国、使其沦为被保护国不符合欧洲的长期利益。
en: Humiliating a small country and rendering it a virtual protectorate does not serve Europe’s long-term interest.

zh: 但这一局面近在眼前。
en: Yet this is what is at stake.

zh: 在朔伊布勒明确要求希腊退出欧元区 — — 据说是临时退出 — — 采用新货币后，希腊在协议上签了字。
en: Greece signed the deal after facing an explicit invitation from Schäuble to leave the eurozone – supposedly temporarily – and adopt a new currency.

zh: 德国的立场标志着欧洲领导力量首次公开挑战货币联盟不可动摇的概念。
en: Germany’s stance marked the first open challenge by a leading European power to the notion that the monetary union is irrevocable.

zh: 本质上同情反紧缩立场、意识到自己在法德合作中日益沦为配角的法国很快注意到，德国的立场也标志着从“欧洲德国”向“德国欧洲”的潜在变化。
en: As the French, instinctively sympathetic to the anti-austerity argument and conscious of their increasingly junior role in the Franco-German partnership, were quick to notice, the German stance also signaled a potential shift from a “European Germany” to a “German Europe.”

zh: 希腊及其债权人的谈判让人们日益怀疑左翼联盟的能力和动机，这无助于解决问题。
en: It hardly helped that the negotiations between Greece and its creditors produced a growing mistrust in the competence and intentions of Syriza.

zh: 诡异多变的谈判策略，加上秘密准备退出欧元区的计划 — — “B计划”的一部分 — — 损害了左翼联盟政府的信誉，就连保罗·克鲁格曼也承认 ： “ 我也许高估了希腊政府的胜任能力。 ”
en: Devious and erratic negotiating tactics, coupled with secret schemes to prepare – as part of a “Plan B” – for an exit from the euro, undermined the government’s trustworthiness, leading even Paul Krugman to admit: “I may have overestimated the competence of the Greek government.”

zh: 但是，不管指责游戏多么复杂，仍有一些教训可以汲取并作为未来政策的指引。
en: Yet, however complicated the blame game, some lessons can be drawn to guide future policy.

zh: 当只占欧元区GDP的2%的希腊政府的不当行为对货币联盟的生存造成严重威胁时，很显然一定是哪里出了问题。
en: When fiscal misbehavior by Greece, a country representing no more than 2% of the eurozone’s GDP, poses serious dangers for the survival of the currency union, something is clearly amiss.

zh: 但解决办法是采取更严厉的措施 — — 如加大惩罚甚至逐出联盟 — — 以执行欧元区规则，还是需要更改规则以协调成员国之间不同的环境？
en: But does the remedy lie in tougher measures – such as heavier penalties or even eviction – to enforce the eurozone’s rules, or do the rules need to be adjusted to accommodate members’ varying circumstances?

zh: 目前，执行规则的方针已经失败，原因在于欧元区基础的漏洞。
en: So far, enforcement has failed, owing to flaws in the eurozone’s foundations.

zh: 首先，财政和外部账户平衡必须受到检查以保证金融稳定和维持共同货币。
en: First, fiscal and external-account balances are to be kept in check in order to ensure financial stability and sustain the common currency.

zh: 其次，消除失衡是国家政府的责任，而国家政府之上又有一个超国家当局 — — 欧盟委��会和欧洲央行 — — 与欧洲理事会（反过来又代表国家政府）合作安排的救援机制。
en: Second, removing imbalances is the responsibility of national governments within the context of a rescue regime arranged by supranational authorities – the European Commission and the European Central Bank – in cooperation with the European Council, which in turn represents national governments.

zh: 希腊神话表明，这一体系无法迅速地控制破坏性失衡从而避免大危机。
en: The Greek saga shows that this system cannot control destabilizing imbalances quickly enough to ward off major crises.

zh: 失衡不仅仅是不负责任的政策的结果。
en: Imbalances are not solely the result of irresponsible policies.

zh: 它们反映了经济结构更深层次的弱点，如缺乏竞争力或制度缺陷。
en: They may reflect deeper weaknesses in economic structures, such as a lack of competitiveness or institutional shortcomings.

zh: 如果德国坚持国家责任，也许将发现执行规则必须无比严厉，最终导致巨大的社会和政治剧变让整个欧元大厦崩塌。
en: If Germany insists on national responsibility, it may find that enforcing the rules will have to be ever harsher, eventually leading to such social and political upheaval that the entire euro-edifice collapses.

zh: 替代方案是采取“转移支付联盟 ” ， 以更好地平衡团结和责任。
en: The alternative is to embrace a “transfer union” that ensures a better balance between solidarity and responsibility.

zh: 美国就采取了这一方案，确保了整个国家可以以统一的发展路径前进。
en: The United States embodies such a solution, ensuring an integrated pattern of development throughout the country.

zh: 欧元区必须强化其财政结构，使之能够对总体经济情况做出反应，同时又能考虑到各成员国不同的环境。
en: The eurozone must strengthen its fiscal structures enough to respond to overall economic conditions while taking into account the differing circumstances of each member country.

zh: 这一更强大的结构应该允许欧元区国家之间进行有限的资源转移，可以是反周期政策，也可以是补充性投资支出，特别是经济和社会基础设施方面的投资。
en: These stronger structures should permit limited resource transfers among eurozone countries, either to carry out countercyclical policy or to supplement investment spending, particularly in economic and social infrastructure.

zh: 但这必然需要建立单独的欧元区预算，将能力从国家机构转移给超国家机构。
en: But this must inevitably involve the creation of a separate eurozone budget, transferring competences from national to supranational authorities.

zh: 共同税收和欧元债券应该成为这一新财政结构的一部分，而欧洲稳定性机制（European Stability Mechanism）应该包括一个足够大的债务赎回基金以解决主权债务危机。
en: Common taxation and Eurobonds should form part of the new fiscal structure, and the European Stability Mechanism should include a debt redemption fund large enough to resolve sovereign-debt crises.

zh: 与此同时，银行联盟 — — 已由欧盟在2007—2008年全球金融危机爆发后建立 — — 应该得到强化，扩大单一清算基金（Single Resolution Fund）的资本基础并建立一个共同存款担保机制。
en: At the same time, the banking union, established by the EU in the wake of the 2007-2008 global financial crisis, should be strengthened by enlarging the capital base of the Single Resolution Fund and establishing a common deposit guarantee scheme.

zh: 所有这些设想都有一个前提，即欧盟的超国家机构 — — 欧洲议会和欧盟委员会的权力应该大幅扩大。
en: All of this presupposes that the powers of the EU’s supranational institutions, the European Parliament and the European Commission, will be significantly augmented.

zh: 欧盟委员会应该成为一个恰当的政府，并有民选总统。
en: The Commission should become a proper government, with a popularly elected president.

zh: 必须成立一个欧洲财政部，部长应该由欧元集团（由欧元区成员国财政部长组成）成员担任。
en: A European finance ministry should be created, and its head should preside over the Eurogroup (which convenes the finance ministers of eurozone member states).

zh: 应该建立一个由欧元区成员国组成的欧洲议会特别大会，仿照国家议会模式，赋予其立法和控制执法的权力。
en: A special Assembly of the European Parliament, comprising the eurozone members, should have powers – on the model of a national parliament – to legislate and control the executive.

zh: 这些方案将引起诸多批评 — — 不仅仅是欧元怀疑派。
en: These proposals will provoke plenty of criticism – and not just from Euroskeptics.

zh: 但迈向财政和政治一体化是欧洲 — — 从欧元区开始 — — 维持统一和全球重要性所必须付出的代价。
en: But a move toward fiscal and political integration is the price that Europe – beginning with the eurozone – must pay to maintain its unity and global relevance.

zh: 否则将是现有规则执行的前后矛盾（甚至独断专行 ） ， 导致成员国之间的分歧，最后导致分裂。
en: The alternative is inconsistent (if not arbitrary) enforcement of the current rules, inducing divisiveness among member states and eventual fragmentation.

zh: 欧洲的戏剧性回归
en: A Dramatic Comeback for Europe

zh: 伦敦—荷兰人以建造大坝闻名于世，这些大坝阻挡了横扫大西洋的大潮和大风。
en: LONDON – The Dutch are famous for building dykes that hold back the tides and storms sweeping across the Atlantic.

zh: 现在，荷兰人再次建成了一座大坝 — — 阻挡民粹主义浪潮政治的大坝吗？ 自去年英国脱欧公投和特朗普当选美国总统以来，这股民粹主义浪潮便威胁着欧洲。
en: Have the Dutch now done it again, holding back the wave of populist politics that seemed to be threatening Europe after last year’s Brexit referendum and Donald Trump’s victory in the United States?

zh: 吉尔特·维尔德斯（Geert Wilders）的自由党（PVV）在5月15日的荷兰选举中令人意外地表现低迷，这似乎印证了这一点。
en: The unexpectedly weak performance of Geert Wilders’ Freedom Party (PVV) in the Dutch election on March 15 seems to suggest this.

zh: 尽管预测结果显示维尔德斯的支持率高达25 % ， 但PVV最后只赢得13%的选票。
en: Despite predictions running as high as 25% of the popular vote for Wilders, the PVV gained only 13%.

zh: 如果在即将举行的法国总统选举中，选民再次表现出更加接近于荷兰而不是美国和英国的对仇外主义和保护主义的敏感性，他们的决定将影响到全球政治、经济和资本主义意识形态。
en: If voters in France’s upcoming presidential election prove closer to the Dutch than to Americans and Britons in their susceptibility to xenophobia and protectionism, their decision will have global implications for politics, economics, and the ideology of global capitalism.

zh: 欧洲大陆若能回归中间派，将强烈地表明，民粹主义和反全球化运动在美国和英国所取得的出人意料的胜利主要不是因为失业和金融危机以来令人失望的经济表现、大量移民，或伊斯兰恐怖主义威胁。
en: A swing back to the center in continental Europe would strongly suggest that the unexpected victories for populist and anti-globalization movements in the US and Britain were not primarily a response to unemployment and disappointing economic performance since the financial crisis, mass migration, or the threat of Islamist terrorism.

zh: 这一结论所依据的事实是，比起美国和英国，法国所承受的失业率要大得多，危机后衰退期要长得多，并且恐怖主义和伊斯兰斗争的问题也要严重得多。
en: This conclusion follows from the fact that France has suffered from much higher unemployment and a longer post-crisis recession than either the US or Britain, as well as experiencing more problems with terrorism and Islamic militancy.

zh: 如果德国选民在秋天也步法国和荷兰的后尘，回归政治中间派，那么移民也将从民粹主义的原因清单中除名。
en: If German voters in the autumn follow the French and Dutch in moving back toward the political center, immigration will also be discredited as the root cause of populism.

zh: 毕竟，德国所接受的外国人数量远远多于英国或美国。
en: After all, Germany has experienced a much larger influx of foreigners than Britain or the US.

zh: 相反，民粹主义将更像是一个盎格鲁-萨克逊现象，其动机与其说是渔民和经济政策，不如说是特朗普和英国选民的保守的文化态度，以及导致两国老少对立、城乡对立、大学毕业生和文化层次较低选民对立的反常的人口分层结盟。
en: Instead, populism will look more like an Anglo-Saxon phenomenon, motivated less by immigration and economic policy than by conservative cultural attitudes among Trump and Brexit voters and the unusual demographic alliances pitting old against young, rural against urban, and university graduates against less educated voters in the US and Britain.

zh: 如果中间派在欧洲稳住阵脚，对经济的影响也将十分深远。
en: The economic implications will also be far-reaching if the center holds in Europe.

zh: 对于大部分新兴经济体来说，欧盟是比美国更大的贸易伙伴。
en: The European Union is a bigger trading partner than the US for most emerging economies.

zh: 欧元也是唯一真正能够替代美元的国际货币。
en: And the euro is the only real alternative to the dollar as an international currency.

zh: 因此，欧盟继续坚守开放贸易、全球化和碳减排承诺或许足以阻止转向保护主义和否认气候变化的范式转变。 而随着特朗普的当选，这两个转变大有不可避免之势。
en: So the EU’s continuing commitment to a philosophy of open trade, globalization, and carbon reduction could be sufficient to prevent a paradigm shift toward protectionism and climate-change denial that seemed almost inevitable with Trump’s election.

zh: 全球领导层的如此变化需要欧洲经济表现发生很大起色。
en: Such a change in global leadership would require a dramatic improvement in Europe’s economic performance.

zh: 幸运的是，如果法国和德国的选民拒绝民粹主义政治，经济表现改善是可以期待的。
en: Fortunately, that outcome can be expected if voters reject populist politics in France and Germany.

zh: 自2008年金融危机以来，欧盟经历了长时间的经济萧条，这主要是因为德国政府否决了帮助美国2010年就走出衰退的货币和财政刺激。
en: The EU has suffered a prolonged economic slump since the 2008 financial crisis, largely because the German government vetoed the kind of monetary and fiscal stimulus that helped to pull the US out of recession in 2010.

zh: 德国否决美国式量化宽松也是2012年欧洲单一货币濒临崩溃的主要原因。
en: Germany’s veto on US-style quantitative easing was also the main reason for the near-collapse of the single currency in 2012.

zh: 但在2015年，欧洲政策和经济条件发生了戏剧性变化。 欧洲央行终于启动了类似于美国的债券购买计划，但规模更大。
en: But a dramatic change to European policy and economic conditions occurred in March 2015, when the European Central Bank belatedly launched a bond-buying program similar to America’s, but on a far larger scale.

zh: 欧洲央行购买了几乎三倍于欧元区净发行量的债券，有效地规避了欧元区规则，开始将欧洲政府赤字货币化，还在德国等坚挺经济体和意大利和西班牙等疲软经济体之间建立了一套互相支持系统。
en: By purchasing almost three times the total net issuance of eurozone bonds, the ECB effectively circumvented eurozone rules and began to monetize Europe’s government deficits, as well as creating a mutual support system between strong economies such as Germany and weaker ones like Italy and Spain.

zh: 欧洲央行的行动很快就扭转了欧洲银行体系四分五裂的局面，也消除了对欧元解体的担忧。
en: The ECB’s actions quickly reversed the fragmentation of the European banking system and eliminated fears of a euro breakup.

zh: 这立刻就提升了企业和消费者的信心。
en: The immediate result was an upsurge in confidence among both businesses and consumers.

zh: 到去年夏天，大部分欧洲国家复苏形势喜人，就在此时，新的分裂担忧接踵而至 — — 这一回的原因是政治，而不是金融 — — 一夜之间就压倒了经济条件的改善。
en: By last summer, most of Europe was already enjoying a decent recovery, when renewed fears of disintegration, this time caused by politics, not finance, suddenly overwhelmed the improvement in economic conditions.

zh: 英国脱欧和特朗普当选形成了一个预期：随着荷兰、法国和德国大选的巨型，欧洲可能将是下一块倒向民粹主义的多米诺骨牌。
en: Brexit and Trump created an expectation that Europe would be the next domino to fall to populism in the looming Dutch, French, and German elections.

zh: 当然，这一可能仍然不可忽视，因此，国际投资者仍然对欧洲保持谨慎。
en: Of course, this possibility still cannot be dismissed, which is why international investors remain cautious about Europe.

zh: 但如果投资者所担心的民粹主义胜利实际上没有发生，那么商业和消费者信心的大反弹将给欧元区带来巨大的投资流。
en: But if the populist victories that worry investors do not in fact happen, a surge of business and consumer confidence will send waves of investment flowing into the eurozone.

zh: 关键事件将是5月7日举行的法国大选第二轮。
en: The key event will be the final round of the French election on May 7.

zh: 如果领先的中间派安曼努尔·马克龙（Emmanuel Macron）胜出，法国将走上至少进行销量经济改革的道路。
en: If this results in a victory for Emmanuel Macron, the centrist front-runner, France will embark on a path leading to at least a modicum of economic reforms.

zh: 这反过来将在法国和德国之间营造出更加合作性的关系。
en: That, in turn, will create a much more cooperative relationship between France and Germany.

zh: 德国的两位主要总理候选人都渴望通过强化法德轴心重塑英国脱欧后的欧洲 — — 而法国启动改革过程将让德国选民放心地相信德国政府放松欧盟紧缩不会是徒劳地填补无底洞。
en: Both main candidates for German Chancellor are eager to rebuild post-Brexit Europe by strengthening the Franco-German axis – and the start of a French reform process would reassure German voters that their government, by easing EU austerity, would not merely be pouring money into a bottomless pit.

zh: 这就引出了，如果中间派胜出，并且今年欧洲经济复苏能够加速，会引起怎样的意识形态影响。
en: This brings us to the ideological implications if centrist forces win and economic recovery accelerates in Europe this year.

zh: 全球金融危机发生后，欧洲“社会市场”资本主义模式立刻成为撒切尔-里根市场原教旨主义在主宰了30年破产后的合乎逻辑的替代品。
en: In the immediate aftermath of the global financial crisis, the European “social market” model of capitalism seemed like a logical alternative to the Thatcher-Reagan market fundamentalism that had broken down after 30 years of global dominance.

zh: 事实上，美国总统奥巴马推动美国在宏观经济管理、金融监管、环境政策和医疗卫生等方面走向更大的政府积极主义。
en: Indeed, President Barack Obama moved the US toward greater government activism in macroeconomic management, financial regulation, environmental policy, and health care.

zh: 但荒谬的是，欧洲却走向了相反的方向。
en: Paradoxically, however, Europe moved in the opposite direction.

zh: 在德国的压力下，欧盟成为货币主义、财政紧缩和金融市场的“纪律约束者”角色的最后堡垒。
en: Under German pressure, the EU became the last bastion of monetarism, fiscal austerity, and the “disciplining” role of financial markets.

zh: 结果是2010—2012年爆发了几乎致命的欧元危机。
en: The result was the near-fatal euro crisis of 2010-2012.

zh: 如果今年的选举最后产生了一位中间派法国总统和法德合作的复兴，那么欧盟令人意外的对市场原教旨主义的沉迷很有可能寿终正寝。
en: If this year’s elections result in a centrist French president and a revival of Franco-German cooperation, the EU’s unexpected infatuation with market fundamentalism will probably end.

zh: 欧洲将出现比特朗普治下的美国更好、更加可持续的社会包容的经济复苏。
en: Europe will enjoy a better, more sustainable, and socially inclusive economic recovery than the US under Trump.

zh: 果真如此的话，世界其他国家将再次把欧盟视为灵感来源和榜样。
en: If this happens, the rest of the world may again start to see the EU as a source of inspiration and a model.

zh: 欧洲的债务冲突
en: Europe’s Brush with Debt

zh: 慕尼黑—法国总理瓦尔斯和他的意大利同侪伦齐宣布 — — 或者说，至少是暗示 — — 她们不会遵守2012年全部欧元区成员国一致同意的财政契约；相反，他们还想借点新债。
en: MUNICH – French Prime Minister Manuel Valls and his Italian counterpart, Matteo Renzi, have declared – or at least insinuated – that they will not comply with the fiscal compact to which all of the eurozone’s member countries agreed in 2012; instead, they intend to run up fresh debts.

zh: 他们的立场凸显出欧洲货币联盟结构的缺陷 — — 欧洲领导人必须在为时已晚之前认识并纠正这一漏洞。
en: Their stance highlights a fundamental flaw in the structure of the European Monetary Union – one that Europe’s leaders must recognize and address before it is too late.

zh: 这个财政契约 — — 正式名称是《欧洲货币联盟稳定、合作和治理条约 》 （ Treaty on Stability, Coordination, and Governance in the Economic and Monetary Union）是作为德国批准欧洲稳定机制（European Stability Mechanism，ESM，实质上是集体援助计划）的交换物签订的。
en: The fiscal compact – formally the Treaty on Stability, Coordination, and Governance in the Economic and Monetary Union – was the quid pro quo for Germany to approve the European Stability Mechanism (ESM), which was essentially a collective bailout package.

zh: 该契约设置了严格的国家结构性预算赤字上限，并规定对于占GDP的60%以上部分的公共债务，每年必须削减当前比率和目标比率差额的十二分之一。
en: The compact sets a strict ceiling for a country’s structural budget deficit and stipulates that public-debt ratios in excess of 60% of GDP must be reduced yearly by one-twentieth of the difference between the current ratio and the target.

zh: 但法国的债务/GDP之比将在今年年底上升到96 % ， 2012年为91 % 。 而意大利将达到135 % ， 2012年为127 % 。
en: Yet France’s debt/GDP ratio will rise to 96% by the end of this year, from 91% in 2012, while Italy’s will reach 135%, up from 127% in 2012.

zh: 瓦尔斯和伦齐对财政契约的事实违反表明，在未来几年中，这一比率还会继续上升。
en: The effective renunciation of the fiscal compact by Valls and Renzi suggests that these ratios will rise even further in the coming years.

zh: 在这样的背景下，欧元区领导人必须扪心自问一个严肃的问题，即目前欧洲货币联盟债务管理制度的可持续性。
en: In this context, eurozone leaders must ask themselves tough questions about the sustainability of the current system for managing debt in the EMU.

zh: 他们应该从考虑两种可能的在货币联盟中确保稳定和债务可持续性的模式开始：共同化模式和责任模式。
en: They should begin by considering the two possible models for ensuring stability and debt sustainability in a monetary union: the mutualization model and the liability model.

zh: 到目前为止，欧洲一直采取的是共同化模式，在该模式中，个体国家的债务由共同中央银行或财政援助体系兜底，确保投资者的安全，并基本抹平国家间的利差（不论它们的负债水平 ） 。
en: Europe has so far stuck to the mutualization model, in which individual states’ debts are underwritten by a common central bank or fiscal bailout system, ensuring security for investors and largely eliminating interest-rate spreads among countries, regardless of their level of indebtedness.

zh: 为了防止人为降低利率、鼓励国家过度借贷，实行了政治债务刹车。
en: In order to prevent the artificial reduction of interest rates from encouraging countries to borrow excessively, political debt brakes are instituted.

zh: 在欧元区，共同化通过慷慨的ESM援助和大约1万亿欧元的TARGET2信用（危机冲击国的货币供应）实现。
en: In the eurozone, mutualization was realized through generous ESM bailouts and some €1 trillion ($1.27 trillion) worth of TARGET2 credit from national printing presses for the crisis-stricken countries.

zh: 此外，欧洲央行承诺通过其“直接货币交易 ” （ OMT）机制免费保护这些国家不违约 — — 即承诺在二级市场买入它们的主权债务 — — 这和欧元债券的效果差不多。
en: Moreover, the European Central Bank pledged to protect these countries from default free of charge through its “outright monetary transactions” (OMT) scheme – that is, by promising to purchase their sovereign debt on secondary markets – which functions roughly as Eurobonds would.

zh: 2012年所设想的债务上限收紧就基于该模式。
en: The supposed hardening of the debt ceiling in 2012 adhered to this model.

zh: 替代方案 — — 责任模式 — — 要求各国为其自身债务负责，由其债权人承担违约成本。
en: The alternative – the liability model – requires that each state take responsibility for its own debts, with its creditors bearing the costs of a default.

zh: 面临这一风险的债权人将从一开始就要求更高的利率或者拒绝���供追加信用，以此作为约束债务人的纪律手段。
en: Faced with that risk, creditors demand higher interest rates from the outset or refuse to grant additional credit, thereby imposing a measure of discipline on debtors.

zh: 责任模式的最佳范例是美国。
en: The best example of the liability model is the United States.

zh: 当加利福尼亚、伊利诺伊或明尼苏达等州陷入财政困境时，没人会指望其他州或联邦政府会援助它们，更不用说美联储担保或购买它们的债券了。
en: When US states like California, Illinois, or Minnesota get into fiscal trouble, no one expects the other states or the federal government to bail them out, let alone that the Federal Reserve will guarantee or purchase their bonds.

zh: 事实上，与欧洲央行不同，美联储不购买任何来自个体州的债券；投资者必须承担任何一州无力偿债的成本。
en: Indeed, the Fed, unlike the ECB, does not buy any bonds from individual states; investors must bear the costs of any state insolvency.

zh: 1975年，纽约州不得不将未来税收收入抵押给债权人以维持偿债能力。
en: In 1975, New York had to pledge its future tax revenues to its creditors in order to remain solvent.

zh: 当然，美国也不是永远如此严格。
en: Of course, the US was not always so strict.

zh: 建国后不久美国曾尝试过债务共同化，首任财政部长汉密尔顿（Alexander Hamilton）在1791年将这一机制描述为新美利坚联邦的“混凝土 ” 。
en: Shortly after its founding, it tried debt mutualization, with Alexander Hamilton, America’s first Treasury secretary, describing the scheme in 1791 as the “cement” for a new American federation.

zh: 但是，事实是共同化模式 — — 在1813年第二次独立战争期间再次使用 — — 助长了信用泡沫，该泡沫在1837年破裂，导致美国29个州和领地中的九个陷入破产。
en: But, as it turned out, the mutualization model – used again in 1813 during the second war against the British – fueled a credit bubble, which collapsed in 1837 and thrust nine of the 29 US states and territories into bankruptcy.

zh: 未解决的债务问题恶化了导致1861年南北战争的奴隶冲突。
en: The unresolved debt problem exacerbated tensions over the slavery issue, which triggered the Civil War in 1861.

zh: 从这个角度讲，正如历史学家詹姆斯（Harold James）所指出的，共同化是新美国联邦的炸药而不是混凝土。
en: In this sense, as the historian Harold James has noted, mutualization turned out to be dynamite, not cement, for the new US federation.

zh: 直到南北战争后，美国才决定依照责任模式操作联邦 — — 此后，该方针巩固了稳定，也限制了个体州的债务水平。
en: Only after the Civil War did the US decide to operate the federation according to the liability model – an approach that has underpinned stability and limited individual states’ debt levels ever since.

zh: 对欧洲领导人来说，法国和意大利从财政契约中退出应该是一个明确的信号，共同化模式已不再适用于欧元区。
en: For Europe’s leaders, the withdrawal by France and Italy from the fiscal compact should serve as a clear sign that the mutualization model is not working for the eurozone, either.

zh: 欧洲央行应该效仿美联储，放弃其OMT计划 — — 根据德国宪法法院的裁决，OMT无论如何都不符合欧盟条约法。
en: Following the Fed’s example, the ECB should abolish its OMT program – which, according to Germany’s Constitutional Court, does not comply with EU treaty law anyway.

zh: 此外，欧洲央行应该重新引入TARGET2债务必须用黄金偿付的要求，美国在1975年前结算联邦储备体系各区之间余额时即如此操作。
en: Furthermore, the ECB should reintroduce the requirement that TARGET2 debts be repaid with gold, as occurred in the US before 1975 to settle balances among the districts of the Federal Reserve System.

zh: 也许财政契约本身也应该重新考虑。
en: Perhaps even the fiscal compact itself should be reconsidered.

zh: 这些措施将受到投资者关注 — — 他们无法再指望危机时有印钞机拯救他们，因此将迫使他们要求更高的利率，或在一开始就不提供信用。
en: Such measures would serve notice to investors that they cannot hope to be saved by the printing press in times of crisis, and would thus compel them to demand higher interest rates or deter them from granting credit in the first place.

zh: 这将给欧元区负债国带来更大的纪律约束，让欧洲免于债务雪崩 — — 债务雪崩可能最终导致目前仍有偿债能力的国家陷入破产并摧毁欧洲一体化工程。
en: This would lead to greater discipline among the eurozone’s indebted countries and save Europe from a debt avalanche that could ultimately drive currently solvent states into bankruptcy and destroy the European integration project.

zh: 新兴欧洲的去杠杆困境
en: Emerging Europe’s Deleveraging Dilemma

zh: 伦敦—私有化的塞尔维亚汽车轮胎和管道制造商Tigar公司曾经是转型经济体企业整顿的正面典型。
en: LONDON – Serbia’s Tigar Corporation, a privatized automobile tire and tube maker, was a poster child for corporate makeovers in transition economies.

zh: 然后，欧元区去杠杆化过程来了，如今，这个正面典型陷入了大麻烦。
en: Then eurozone deleveraging kicked in, and now the child in the poster is in serious trouble.

zh: Tigar将其轮胎部门出售给法国的米其林公司，将所获得的资金全部投入到了新业务中。
en: When Tigar sold its tire division to France’s Michelin, it invested the entire proceeds in new businesses.

zh: 或许资本支出过于雄心勃勃了，但这笔支出确实让出口有了快速增加，小城派洛特（Pirot）也增加了2 000多个为欧洲渔民和纽约市消防员制造靴子和其他高技术橡胶产品的工作岗位。
en: Perhaps capital expenditures were overly ambitious, but they triggered rapid export growth, and more than 2,000 jobs were created in the small town of Pirot to manufacture boots for European fishermen and New York City firemen, as well as technical rubber products.

zh: 由于缺乏其他选择，扩张大部分是通过短期贷款融资的。
en: Expansion was, for lack of other options, financed largely through short-term loans.

zh: 在塞尔维亚和其他欧洲转型国家，许多银行严重依赖来自欧元区母机购的资金。
en: Many banks in Serbia and other transition countries in Europe rely heavily on funding from their eurozone parent institutions.

zh: 但是，自全球金融危机爆发以来，欧元区银行的新兴欧洲分支一直在削减其对该地区的风险敞口。
en: But, since the onset of the global financial crisis, eurozone-based banks’ subsidiaries in emerging Europe have been reducing their exposure to the region.

zh: 2009—2010年，欧洲银行合作计划（European Bank Coordination Initiative ） ， 即俗称的“维也纳计划 ” （ Vienna Initiative）通过阻止国有母银行的恐慌性争相退出，避免了一场系统性危机。
en: In 2009-2010, the European Bank Coordination Initiative – known informally as the “Vienna Initiative” – helped to avert a systemic crisis in developing Europe by stopping foreign-owned parent banks from staging a catastrophic stampede to the exits.

zh: 但是，在2011年下半年，主宰新兴欧洲银行部门的欧元区母银行感到了去杠杆化的新压力。
en: But, in the second half of 2011, the eurozone-based parent banks that dominate emerging Europe’s banking sector came under renewed pressure to deleverage.

zh: 很多银行如今正在彻底改变业务模式以降低风险。
en: Many are now radically changing their business models to reduce risk.

zh: 去年，相当于该地区GDP的4%的资金被撤出，一些国家的撤资规模更是高达GDP的15 % 。
en: Over the last year, funding corresponding to 4% of the region’s GDP – and, in some countries, as much as 15% of GDP – has been withdrawn.

zh: 分行越来越依靠本地存款和其他本地资金来源为本地贷款融资。
en: Bank subsidiaries will increasingly have to finance local lending with local deposits and other local funding.

zh: 新的维也纳计划 — — 维也纳2.0避免了打扰去杠杆化需要的做法，而是寻求让去杠杆化过程更加有序。
en: Without disputing the need for some deleveraging, a new incarnation of the Vienna Initiative – Vienna 2.0 – seeks to make the process orderly.

zh: 毕竟，新兴欧洲贷款人的过度、混乱的去杠杆化 — — 及其所能造成的信贷动荡 — — 会动摇这一经济和制度颇为脆弱的地区。
en: After all, excessive and chaotic deleveraging by lenders to emerging Europe – and the ensuing credit crunch – would destabilize this economically and institutionally fragile region.

zh: 对Tigar公司来说，去杠杆化意味着支持其业务没几年的银行突然间砍掉了贷款，尽管该公司从未拖延过债务偿付。
en: For Tigar, deleveraging has meant that banks that had pursued its business only a couple of years ago have suddenly cut lending – even though the company never missed a debt payment.

zh: 此前的贷款逐渐到期，而现金流需求又在增加。
en: Previous loans came due, while cash-flow needs grew.

zh: 尽管营业利润相当出色，市场在增长，主要国际客户也在增加，但该公司仍经历了流动性的枯竭，需要进行严重的资产负债表重组。
en: Despite its good operating margins, growing markets, and prime international clients, the company experienced a drop in liquidity, requiring serious balance-sheet restructuring.

zh: Tigar公司还能应付过去，但许多前途无量但缺少牢固财务根基的公司却难以为继了。
en: Tigar will make it; but many promising companies that lack its solid financial footing will not.

zh: 当然，在经历了数年的自由信贷扩张后，出现一些紧缩是必要的，也是值得的，Tigar公司也可能扩张得太快了。
en: Of course, after several years of unfettered credit expansion, some retrenchment was necessary and desirable, and Tigar probably overextended itself.

zh: 但一些因素 — — 其中大多与该地区无关 — — 正在迫使银行追求比最优速度更快的去杠杆化。
en: But several factors – most of them unrelated to the region – are pressuring banks to pursue faster-than-optimal deleveraging.

zh: 首先，巴塞尔III全球银行改革方案和相应的欧盟资本要求指引第四版（Capital Requirements Directive IV）规则给跨境融资造成了反向激励。
en: For starters, the Basel III package of global banking reforms and the European Union’s corresponding Capital Requirements Directive IV rule create disincentives for cross-border financing.

zh: 诚然，它们有助于防止银行使用类似于抵押债务证券（银行使用该工具对个别贷款进行再包装，然后把它们推向二级市场）的工具降低风险敞口。
en: To be sure, they will help to prevent banks from using instruments resembling collateralized debt obligations (which banks use to repackage individual loans for placement on secondary markets) to reduce their exposure.

zh: 但新监管规则也对在新欧盟成员国和候选国从事融资活动的分行予以严厉惩罚。
en: But the new regulation also seriously penalizes subsidiary financing in new EU member and accession countries.

zh: 事实上，在很多国家，银行担保只能以地方分行股本为基础进行，得不到母行资产负债表的支持。
en: Indeed, in many countries, bank guarantees can be issued only on the basis of local subsidiary equity, without support from the parent’s balance sheet.

zh: 此外，抵押品 — — 特别是房地产资产 — — 将继续降级。
en: Furthermore, collateral – especially real-estate assets – will continue to be downgraded.

zh: 糟糕的2012年公司财务结果将进一步拖累信用评级。
en: Poor 2012 corporate financial results will further undermine credit ratings.

zh: 能满足基本风险标准的公司越来越少。
en: Fewer and fewer companies will meet basic risk criteria.

zh: 尽管政府可能会提供具有吸引力的流动性便利，但银行将无法贷出其所获得的资金。
en: While governments might offer attractive liquidity facilities, banks will be unable to on-lend the funds.

zh: 而希腊的溢出效应将继续影响巴尔干和其他新兴欧洲银行市场。
en: And spillover effects from Greece will continue to affect Balkan and other emerging European banking markets.

zh: 事实上，不少西方金融集团正在考虑部分或完全退出该地区，而且并没有提出明确的战略代替品。
en: Indeed, several Western financial groups are considering partial or complete exits from the region – without any clear strategic replacement in sight.

zh: 潜在系统性危机可能迫使去杠杆化进一步加速，给新兴欧洲带来严重后果。
en: The potential systemic crisis threatens to accelerate deleveraging further, with serious consequences for emerging Europe.

zh: 这就是为什么维也纳计划必须成为东道国在泛欧洲债务解决方案和银行联盟争论中更有力的“声音 ” 。
en: That is why the Vienna Initiative must become an effective “voice” for the host countries in the Europe-wide debate on debt resolution and banking union.

zh: 必须竭尽全力防止欧洲金融体系内部出现新壁垒。
en: Every effort must be made to prevent the creation of new barriers within Europe’s financial system.

zh: 在捍卫新兴欧洲银行系统方面，我们已经取得了一些进步。
en: Some progress has been made toward safeguarding emerging Europe’s banking system.

zh: 欧洲投资银行、世界银行和欧洲复兴开发银行已同意了新的联合行动计划，包括在未来两年中投资300亿欧元并提供政策建议以支持该地区的经济复苏和可持续发展。
en: The European Investment Bank, the World Bank, and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development have agreed on a new Joint Action Plan, including investment totaling €30 billion ($39 billion) over the next two years, as well as policy advice, to support economic recovery and sustained growth in the region.

zh: 这一计划必须现在就实施。
en: They must now deliver.

zh: 欧盟委员会和多边贷款人应该为正在进行的银行部门结构性变革提供便利，包括银行并购和健康的出口导向公司的资产负债表重组。
en: The European Commission and multilateral lenders should help to facilitate ongoing structural change in the banking sector, including bank acquisitions and balance-sheet restructuring for viable export-driven companies.

zh: 作为交换，私有银行必须承担起集体责任，平滑去杠杆化过程，限制其行为的系统性影响。
en: In exchange, private banks must live up to their collective responsibility to smooth the deleveraging process and limit the systemic impact of their actions.

zh: 在这样的条件下，去杠杆化能够把新兴欧洲带上更加可持续的增长模式。
en: Under these conditions, deleveraging could put emerging Europe on a more sustainable growth path.

zh: 让欧元区民主化
en: Democratizing the Eurozone

zh: 雅典—就像麦克白（Macbeth ） ， 决策者总是用新的重罪掩盖旧的轻罪。
en: ATHENS – Like Macbeth, policymakers tend to commit new sins to cover up their old misdemeanors.

zh: 而政治制度的价值就在于能很快地结束官员系列化的、互相强化的政策错误。
en: And political systems prove their worth by how quickly they put an end to their officials’ serial, mutually reinforcing, policy mistakes.

zh: 从这个标准判断，由19个老牌民主国家组成的欧元区比世界上最大的非民主经济体还要落后。
en: Judged by this standard, the eurozone, comprising 19 established democracies, lags behind the largest non-democratic economy in the world.

zh: 2008年全球金融危机导致发生衰退后，中国决策者花了七年时间用地方政府激进的卖地行为煽动国内投资泡沫取代不断下降的中国净出口需求。
en: Following the onset of the recession that followed the 2008 global financial crisis, China’s policymakers spent seven years replacing waning demand for their country’s net exports with a homegrown investment bubble, inflated by local governments’ aggressive land sales.

zh: 而当今年夏天清算时刻终于到来时，中国领导人拿出2,000亿美元辛苦积攒的外汇储备扮演了一回卡努特王（King Canute ） ， 试图力挽股市暴跌之狂澜。
en: And when the moment of reckoning came this summer, China’s leaders spent $200 billion of hard-earned foreign reserves to play King Canute trying to hold back the tide of a stock-market rout.

zh: 但是，与欧元区相比，中国政府纠正错误的努力 — — 最终让利率和股票价值下跌 — — 堪称速度和效率的典范。
en: Compared to the European Union, however, the Chinese government’s effort to correct its errors – by eventually allowing interest rates and stock values to slide – seems like a paragon of speed and efficiency.

zh: 事实上，失败的希腊“财政整合和改革计划 ” ， 以及欧盟领导人不顾五年来该计划根本无法成功的铁证顽固死守此法，是更广泛的欧洲治理失败的症候，而这一失败有其深刻的历史根源。
en: Indeed, the failed Greek “fiscal consolidation and reform program,” and the way the EU’s leaders have clung to it despite five years of evidence that the program cannot possibly succeed, is symptomatic of a broader European governance failure, one with deep historical roots.

zh: 20世纪90年代初，欧洲汇率机制的轰然崩溃加强了欧元区领导人支持它的决心。
en: In the early 1990s, the traumatic breakdown of the European Exchange Rate Mechanism only strengthened the resolve of EU leaders to prop it up.

zh: 这一机制越是表现出不可持续，欧盟官员就越顽固地要坚守它 — — 他们的辞令也越乐观。
en: The more the scheme was exposed as unsustainable, the more doggedly officials clung to it – and the more optimistic their narratives.

zh: 希腊“计划”只是欧洲的乐观政策惯性的又一个典型案例。
en: The Greek “program” is just another incarnation of Europe’s rose-tinted policy inertia.

zh: 过去五年，欧元区经济决策堪称一场壮观的错中错闹剧。
en: The last five years of economic policymaking in the eurozone have been a remarkable comedy of errors.

zh: 政策错误不胜枚举：欧洲央行在2008年7月和2011年4月两次升息；要求面临最糟糕衰退的经济体实施最严厉的紧缩；支持以邻为壑式的竞争性内部贬值的极权条约；以及缺少合理的存款保险机制的银行联盟。
en: The list of policy mistakes is almost endless: interest-rate hikes by the European Central Bank in July 2008 and again in April 2011; imposing the harshest austerity on the economies facing the worst slump; authoritative treatises advocating beggar-thy-neighbor competitive internal devaluations; and a banking union that lacks an appropriate deposit-insurance scheme.

zh: 为何欧洲决策者犯了如此大错而不受惩罚？
en: How can European policymakers get away with it?

zh: 毕竟，他们的政治豁免权不但与美国截然相悖（美国官员至少需要受国会问责 ） ， 与中国也格格不入（对中国你也许没那么不忿，因为中国官员被认为比欧洲官员还要难问责 ） 。
en: After all, their political impunity stands in sharp contrast not only to the United States, where officials are at least accountable to Congress, but also to China, where one might be excused for thinking that officials are less accountable than their European counterparts.

zh: 答案就在于欧洲货币联盟的碎片性和刻意为之的非正式性。
en: The answer lies in the fragmented and deliberately informal nature of Europe’s monetary union.

zh: 中国官员也许不必向民主选举的议会或国会负责，但政府官员仍然有一个机构 — — 七人组成的政治局常务委员会 — — 可以问责失败。
en: Chinese officials may not be answerable to a democratically elected parliament or congress; but government officials do have a unitary body – the seven-member standing committee of the Politburo – to which they must account for their failures.

zh: 另一方面，欧元区由官方地非官方（officially unofficial）的欧元集团治理。 欧元集团由成员国财政部长再加上欧洲央行的代表（在讨论“与其有关的经济计划”时还要再加上IMF的代表）组成。
en: The eurozone, on the other hand, is governed by the officially unofficial Eurogroup, which comprises the member states’ finance ministers plus representatives of the ECB and, when discussing “economic programs in which it is involved,” the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 直到最近，作为希腊政府与其债权人紧张谈判的结果之一，欧洲公民才认识到，身为世界最大经济体的欧元区是由一个没有成文程序规则 、 “ 秘密”讨论关键问题（而且不进行记录 ） 、 并且没有应答任何民选机构（甚至欧洲议会也不行）义务的集团运行的。
en: Only very recently, as a result of the Greek government’s intense negotiations with its creditors, did Europe’s citizens realize that the world’s largest economy, the eurozone, is run by a body that lacks written rules of procedure, debates crucial matters “confidentially” (and without minutes being taken), and is not obliged to answer to any elected body, not even the European Parliament.

zh: 认为希腊政府与欧元集团之间的僵局时希腊左翼与欧洲保守派主流的对峙是一个错误。
en: It would be a mistake to think of the standoff between the Greek government and the Eurogroup as a clash between Greece’s left and Europe’s conservative mainstream.

zh: 我们的“雅典之春”根源更加深刻：它事关一个欧洲小国挑战影响一代人（甚至两代人）前途的失败政策的权利 — — 不仅是希腊，也包括欧洲其他国家。
en: Our “Athens Spring” was about something more profound: the right of a small European country to challenge a failed policy that was wrecking the prospects of a generation (or two), not only in Greece, but elsewhere in Europe as well.

zh: 雅典之春因为与希腊政府的左翼政治无关的原因而被镇压。
en: The Athens Spring was crushed for reasons that had nothing to do with the Greek government’s left-wing politics.

zh: 一次又一次，欧盟拒绝并诋毁常识性政策。
en: Time after time, the EU rejected and denigrated common-sense policies.

zh: 首要证据是双方在税收政策上的立场。
en: Exhibit A is the two sides’ positions on tax policy.

zh: 作为希腊财政部长，我提出降低销售税、所得税和公司税税率，以扩大税基、增加收入、提振破产的希腊经济。
en: As Greece’s finance minister, I proposed a rate reduction for sales tax, income tax, and corporation tax, in order to broaden the tax base, increase revenues, and give Greece’s broken economy a boost.

zh: 罗纳德·里根的追随者绝不会反对我的计划啊。
en: No follower of Ronald Reagan would quarrel with my plan.

zh: 另一方面，欧盟要求增加所有这三项税的税率 — — 并且实施了。
en: The EU, on the other hand, demanded – and imposed – increases in all three tax rates.

zh: 那么，如果希腊与其欧洲债权人的角逐不是左右之争，又是什么？
en: So, if Greece’s tussle with its European creditors was not a left-right standoff, what was it?

zh: 美国经济学家克莱伦斯·亚里斯（Clarence Ayres）曾经写道 — — 仿佛是在描述欧盟官员 — — “他们用给予崇高礼遇恭维现实，但他们这么做的目的确立地位，而不是实现技术效率。
en: The American economist Clarence Ayres once wrote, as if describing EU officials: “They pay reality the compliment of imputing it to ceremonial status, but they do so for the purpose of validating status, not that of achieving technological efficiency.”

zh: ”而他们犯了错而不受惩罚，是因为欧元区决策者没有应答仍和主权机构的义务。
en: And they get away with it because the eurozone’s decision-makers are not obliged to answer to any sovereign body.

zh: 责任在于我们这些一厢情愿想要改善欧洲的效率、降低它的总体不公正性、致力于欧元区的再政治化并以此作为迈向民主化的第一步的人。
en: It is incumbent upon those of us who wish to improve Europe’s efficiency, and lessen its gross injustices, to work toward re-politicizing the eurozone as a first step toward democratizing it.

zh: 毕竟，欧洲难道不应该有一个至少比共产主义中国更加可问责的政府吗？
en: After all, doesn’t Europe deserve a government that is at least more accountable than that of communist China?

zh: 危险的欧元政治
en: The Perilous Politics of the Euro

zh: 圣地亚哥—对于希腊能否成功避免违约、继续留在欧元区中，并扭转经济颓势这桩公案，陪审团还没有就位。
en: SANTIAGO – The jury is still out on whether Greece will manage to avoid default, remain in the eurozone, and reverse the brutal contraction of its economy.

zh: 但只要法官持公平态度，就会裁定其给共同货币造成的政治后果：彻底失败。
en: But any fair panel already would have issued a verdict on the political consequences of the common currency: utter failure.

zh: 当然，欧元案永远是政治问题，并且有两个角度：俗和雅。
en: Of course, the case for the euro was always political and came in two varieties: earthy and lofty.

zh: 从俗案角度讲 — — 很少以礼貌的方式争论 — — 问题在于南欧国家支出太多、征税太少，因此借贷过度。
en: The earthy case, seldom made clearly in polite company, was that the countries in southern Europe spent too much, taxed too little, and thus borrowed in excess.

zh: 只要它们能够随时印制本币和贬值为债务融资，它们就会继续维持自由支出模式。
en: So long as they could finance deficits by printing a local currency and devaluing it from time to time, they would stick to their free-spending ways.

zh: 只有欧元和法兰克福货币政策当局能够在纪律上约束它们。
en: Only the straightjacket of the euro and a monetary policy governed from Frankfurt could discipline them.

zh: 理论上是如此。
en: That was the theory.

zh: 实际结果正好相反。
en: The practical result was precisely the opposite.

zh: 贬值风险不再让利差大幅缩小，借贷成本也随之下降。
en: With the risk of devaluation gone, interest-rate spreads dropped precipitously, and so did borrowing costs.

zh: 来自国外的廉价资金涌入了欧洲的较低收入国家。
en: Cheap money from abroad flooded into Europe's lower-income countries.

zh: 在一些地区 — — 希腊、意大利和葡萄牙 — — 这笔资金支撑了不可持续的公共支出狂欢。
en: In some places – Greece, Italy, and Portugal – the money financed an unsustainable public-spending binge.

zh: 在其他地区 — — 西班牙和爱尔兰 — — 这笔资金支撑了私人房地产开发商的错觉。
en: In others – Spain and Ireland – it financed the delusions of private real-estate developers.

zh: 债务到处泛滥。
en: Debts ballooned everywhere.

zh: 欧元的政治雅案在法国表现得最淋漓尽致。
en: The lofty political case for the euro was uttered most pleasingly in French.

zh: 它带来了和平、繁荣和日益增加的互相尊重，其最终目标是政治联盟。
en: It promised peace, prosperity, and growing mutual respect, with political union as the ultimate goal.

zh: 没人知道怎样实现这一最终目标，不过没有关系。
en: It did not matter that no one seemed to know how to get there.

zh: 多年来，我在各种会议上听说欧洲能实现这一目标，只要有决心就可以。
en: As I heard at countless conferences over the years, European will and determination would do the trick.

zh: 作为非欧洲人，有人告诉我（有时很礼貌，有时则不太礼貌）我无法理解这一点。
en: As a non-European, I was told (sometimes politely, sometimes less so) that I could not possible understand that.

zh: 好吧，如今结果已经昭然，即使是非欧洲人也能看清发生了什么。
en: Well, the results are now visible, and even non-Europeans can grasp what has happened.

zh: 欧洲机构合法性在节节下降，新法西斯运动风生水起。
en: European institutions' legitimacy is down, and neo-fascist movements are up.

zh: 反移民偏见和北欧吝啬、南欧懒惰的陈词滥调日渐兴旺。
en: Anti-immigrant prejudices and clichés about tight-fisted northerners and lazy southerners proliferate.

zh: 甚至严肃的报纸也免不了俗，把德国政客描绘成身穿德式皮裤、留希特勒小胡子的形象。
en: Even proper newspapers are not above depicting German politicians in lederhosen and Hitlerian moustaches.

zh: 对于构建团结而宽容的欧洲这一工程，也许还有更糟糕的结果，但我不敢想象。
en: There may well be a worse outcome for the project of building an integrated and tolerant Europe, but I have trouble imagining it.

zh: 并非必须如此。
en: It did not have to be this way.

zh: 货币联盟永远是高风险赌博，但并不一定会造成大量失业（希腊和西班牙一大半年轻人没有工作 ） 。
en: Monetary union was always a risky bet, but it did not necessarily have to produce mass unemployment (more than half of all young people in Greece and Spain do not have a job).

zh: 问题有很大一部分反映的是欧元的设计缺陷，而这也是政治失败。
en: A significant part of the problem reflects the eurozone's flawed design, and that failure, too, is political.

zh: 是的，希腊的许多麻烦纯属自作孽。
en: Yes, many of Greece's troubles were of its own making.

zh: 养老金滥发、征税工作一团糟、国家提供的商品和服务业不如世界其他地区法眼（美丽的海滨除外 ） 。
en: Pension benefits have been widely abused, tax collection is a mess, and (aside from beautiful beaches) the country offers few goods and services that the rest of the world wants to buy.

zh: 但萧条 — — 目前已经维持了五年多 — — 也有外部因素。
en: But the depression – now a half-decade old – also has external causes.

zh: 其他欧洲国家不仅很少买希腊的东西，其他国家的东西也一样。
en: Other European countries are not just buying too little from Greece; they are buying too little everywhere.

zh: 《金融时报》的马丁·沃尔夫（Martin Wolf）从未指出的是欧洲存在巨大的失衡，并且这个失衡与你想的也许并不一样。
en: As Martin Wolf of the Financial Times never tires of pointing out, there is a massive imbalance in Europe, and it is not the one you might think.

zh: 当前危机爆发以来，欧元区经常项目已从略有赤字变为近GDP的2.5%的盈余。
en: Since the current crisis erupted, the eurozone's current account has gone from a small deficit to a surplus of nearly 2.5% of GDP.

zh: 在希腊等国家削减支出的同时，其他国家（如德国）并没有扩张它们的支出。
en: As countries like Greece have cut their expenditures, others, like Germany, have not expanded theirs.

zh: 北欧人以量入为出为豪，至于这样做无异于帮助维持地区危机他们并不关心。
en: Northern Europeans are proud of living within their means – never mind that in doing so they are helping to sustain a regional crisis.

zh: 在二战后的布雷顿森林谈判期间，凯恩斯便已开始担忧这类问题。
en: This kind of problem already worried John Maynard Keynes at the time of the post-World War II Bretton Woods negotiations.

zh: 外部力量可能通过拒绝提供贷款强迫一国减少支出。
en: Outsiders can force a country to spend less by refusing to lend to it.

zh: 但你如何强迫一国或数国增加支出？
en: But how do you force a country or group of countries to spend more?

zh: 欧元区对于这一内在政治难题束手无策，而这就是根本缺陷之一。
en: The eurozone does not have an answer for this inherently political conundrum, and therein lies one of its fundamental flaws.

zh: 欧元区也没有自动财政冲击吸收器。 如今我们都知道，这一吸收器是稳定整个联盟的收入的关键。
en: Nor does the eurozone have the automatic fiscal shock absorbers that – as is widely understood by now – are essential to stabilize incomes across the union.

zh: 当石油价格下跌、德克萨斯州和俄克拉荷马州陷入衰退时，不消多久资金就会流向两州而不会有任何政治说三道四。
en: When the price of oil drops and Texas and Oklahoma fall into recession, money flows their way on a moment's notice and without any political vitriol.

zh: 但只要北欧反对，就无法形成这样的转移支付联盟。
en: But such a transfer union will not happen as long as a single northern European citizen is left standing.

zh: 因此，欧元区将永远承受经济失衡及其摆脱不了的政治紧张后果的影响。
en: So the eurozone will be forever plagued by economic imbalances and the political tensions that inevitably accompany them.

zh: 说道政治紧张，希腊与欧盟的谈判倒是赢得了新突破。
en: And, speaking of political tensions, Greece's negotiations with the EU broke new ground.

zh: 左翼联盟（Syriza）新政府仅仅坚持了两周就缴械投降，因为它们遇到了终极核威胁：行为不端，因此欧洲央行将停止给你的银行贷款。
en: The new Syriza government caved after barely two weeks, when confronted with the ultimate nuclear threat: misbehave and the European Central Bank will stop funding your banks.

zh: 甚至身穿皮夹克的财政部长也不愿阻止银行挤兑及随后的金融混乱。
en: Not even finance ministers in leather jackets are willing to countenance a bank run and the financial chaos that follows.

zh: 独立央行是一件了不起的事，欧洲央行行长德拉吉也是了不起的央行行长。
en: Independent central banks are a great thing, and ECB President Mario Draghi is a great central banker.

zh: 但这一独立性是为了适用于货币政策（在必要时提高利率，不管民众多么反对）而不是为了适用财政政策（强迫一国削减支出、提高税收以偿���存量债务 ） 。
en: But that independence is meant to apply to monetary policy (jacking up interest rates if necessary, however unpopular it may be) and not to fiscal policy (forcing a country to cut expenditures and raise taxes to pay outstanding debt).

zh: 有人说过民主赤字吗？
en: Did anyone say democratic deficit?

zh: 当然，所有这些都不意味着希腊退出欧元区是一个好结果。
en: Of course, none of this means that Greece's exit from the eurozone would be desirable.

zh: 老笑话说，你想去那里，我就不这里开始。
en: As the old joke goes, if you want to go there, I wouldn't start here.

zh: 但“这里 ” — —货币联盟 — — 是希腊自己走进来的，在没有B计划的情况下突然走出去将是一场灾难。
en: But here – in the monetary union – is where Greece finds itself, and leaving in a lurch without a plan B would be disastrous.

zh: 糟糕的经济算盘很容易变为糟糕的政治决定。
en: Bad economics easily turns into bad politics.

zh: 由于设计缺陷，欧元正在威胁到它应该起到推进作用的目标 — — 政治联盟。
en: Owing to its flawed design, the common currency now threatens to abort the very project of political union that it was meant to advance.

zh: 这将是一场希腊悲剧。
en: Now that would be a Greek tragedy.

zh: 兑现承诺或闭嘴
en: Put Up or Shut Up

zh: 纽约 — — 在公共政策、和平谈判、竞选活动或公司战略中，仅仅说明目标、约定和承诺还远远不够。
en: NEW YORK – In public policy, peace talks, election campaigns, or corporate strategy, laying out intentions, promises, and commitments is never enough.

zh: 这只是朝期望目标迈出的第一步 — — 除非采取第二步、第三步和所有必要的后续措施这一步是没有任何意义的。
en: It is merely a first step toward a desired end – and entirely meaningless unless the second, third, and all subsequent necessary steps are taken.

zh: 此外，第一步迈出后外界认为很快会采取后续步骤，否则就有可能造成误解，即特定目标未能实现是因为目标有误（或无关紧要 ） ， 而不是因为执行力度没有达到。
en: Moreover, taking the first step starts the clock on others' trust and confidence that the next steps will in fact be taken, or else risks creating the false impression that the failure to achieve a particular goal reflects mistaken (or irrelevant) intentions, not inadequate execution.

zh: 这样的例子几乎随处可见。
en: We can see examples of this virtually everywhere we look.

zh: 当时，很多领导人似乎认为欧洲央行此举已经足够：发公告、印货币、让经济重回轨道。
en: At the time, many leaders seemed to think that the ECB's move would be enough: Announcement made, money printed, economies back on track.

zh: 不幸的是，这并不符合货币政策的运行规律：人们千万不能天真地以为仅仅实行量化宽松就够了。
en: Unfortunately, that is not how monetary policy works: QE will not be enough, and no one should be naive about that.

zh: 为了让经济重回正轨，量化宽松是一个有益步骤，但其作用能否发挥有赖于落实涉及面更广的一揽子举措。
en: In order to get economies back on track, QE is a useful step, but only as part of a larger package of measures.

zh: 如果不进行其他经济改革，单纯依靠量化宽松并不能启动增长所需要的改革。
en: In the absence of other economic reforms, QE on its own cannot effect the changes needed to kick-start growth.

zh: 而且如果改革未能落实、增长未能实现，政治家们可能会责怪量化宽松，而不是他们自己未能采取必要的后续措施来实现经济复苏。
en: And if the reforms are not implemented and growth fails to materialize, politicians are likely to blame QE, not their own failure to take all the other steps that must follow it on the path of economic recovery.

zh: 现在来看看言论自由。
en: Now consider free speech.

zh: 对其中不少人而言，回国立即奉行这项原则本该是再自然不过的举措，但事实却恰恰相反，他们回国后却没有采取进一步动作。
en: The natural next step for many of them should have been to return home and immediately implement that principle. Instead, they returned home.

zh: 但埃及政权宣布与关押他们的权力机构脱钩的声明又在何处？
en: But where is the regime's renunciation of the authority to have imprisoned them in the first place?

zh: 在另一块战场，和平谈判和乌克兰最近的停火协议不过是结束乌克兰政府与俄分离主义武装战争的最新一次尝试。 过去大半年分离主义战火一直在顿巴斯东部地区熊熊燃烧。
en: In another arena, peace negotiations, the recent ceasefire agreement in Ukraine is but the latest attempt to end the war between the country's government and Russian-backed separatists that has been raging for much of the past year in the eastern Donbas region.

zh: 贯穿战争始终试图阻止杀戮的努力都未能取得持久的效果，战争的无辜受害者 — — 更不要说国际社会大部分国家 — — 都已经开始厌倦和愤世嫉俗。
en: Throughout the fighting, attempts to stop the killing have come and gone, and the war's innocent victims – not to mention much of the international community – have grown weary and cynical.

zh: 签订协议的第一步代表了各方采取必要后续措施的承诺。
en: The first step – signing the agreement – represents the parties' commitment to take the necessary subsequent steps.

zh: 每个人离开谈判桌时都明确知道自己该怎么做、别人该怎么做、以及不这么做可能带来的后果。
en: Everyone walks away knowing exactly what they are supposed to do, what to expect others to do, and what the consequences will be if they do not.

zh: 协议失败往往不是因为写进协议的内容，而是因为没有写入的部分，或者因为签字方明明签字同意却违反自己的承诺。
en: When agreements fail, it is usually not because of what they contain, but because of what is missing, or because of what the signatories do despite what they have agreed.

zh: 只有当每个人都严格遵守时和平路线图才能发挥作用。
en: A roadmap to peace is useful only if everyone follows it.

zh: 否则就不能实现目标。
en: Otherwise, the goal is lost.

zh: 今年欧盟成员国将举行至少七次大选（法国地区选举将于三月举行 ） 。
en: At least seven general elections will be held in European Union member countries this year (and France will hold regional elections in March).

zh: 希腊已经进行过投票（当选政府到目前为止除目标和承诺外还没有采取任何举措 ） ， 爱沙尼亚、芬兰、英国、丹麦、葡萄牙、波兰和西班牙则将在未���数月举行选举。
en: Greece has already voted (electing a government that so far seems unable to move beyond intentions and commitments), and the coming months will bring elections in Estonia, Finland, the United Kingdom, Denmark, Portugal, Poland, and Spain.

zh: 加之明年的美国总统大选 — — 相关竞选活动今年就已经开始 — — 我们无疑可以得到一大堆的承诺。
en: Add to this the US presidential election next year – preceded by a campaign that has already started – and we can expect a lot of promises floating around.

zh: 因为上述国家的选民被宏伟的目标、响亮的保证和郑重的承诺所环绕，他们当然期望当选的党派和候选人能够兑现自己的承诺。
en: As voters in these countries are inundated with good intentions, ringing assurances, and solemn commitments, they will expect parties and candidates to follow through if they are elected.

zh: 当然，政党和候选人兑现承诺的记录（和责难对手兑现承诺的记录）是说服选民的基础。
en: Certainly, parties and candidates attempt to persuade voters on the basis of their track records (and by impugning their opponents' track records).

zh: 如果实现不了承诺的目标和约定，资料查阅和即时沟通能够确保空头支票无法让多数民众信服。
en: If they do not follow through on their intentions, promises, and commitments, access to information and instant communication is such that empty promises simply will no longer persuade most people.

zh: 企业同样也在进行竞选活动。
en: Companies campaign, too.

zh: 他们派领导人前往立法机构忏悔严重渎职行为并承诺未来遵纪守法。
en: They send their leaders before law-making bodies to express contrition for grave malfeasance and promise future good behavior.

zh: 但报纸头条却一如既往充斥着不道德、甚至是犯罪的企业行动。
en: And yet the headlines are as filled as ever with stories of unethical, if not outright criminal, corporate behavior.

zh: 不幸的是，太多企业领导人坚持用“我们"与“他们"的视角来看待世界，而不是试图理解为什么如果不采取有力行动，没有人愿意相信他们的承诺。
en: Unfortunately, too many corporate leaders persist in viewing the world as “us" versus “them," rather than attempting to understand why, in the absence of vigorous action, no one trusts them.

zh: 开始至关重要；但它们也仅仅就是开始。
en: Beginnings are vital; but they are just that.

zh: 欧元区经济没有简单的解决方案，希腊、乌克兰或我们面临的其他重大挑战也是一样。
en: There is no easy solution for the eurozone economy, for Greece, for Ukraine, or for any of the other major challenges we face today.

zh: 但除非领导人能够肯定公告、竞选承诺及和平协议将带来明确、有目的的行动，他们应该先认真考虑再做出承诺。
en: But unless protagonists are sure that announcements, campaign promises, and peace agreements will give rise to clear, purposeful action, they should think twice before opening their mouths.

zh: 欧元区稳定之岛
en: The Eurozone Island of Stability

zh: 布鲁塞尔—最近，市场波动性飙升，显然，这与那些警告股票高企的人遥相呼应。
en: BRUSSELS – Market volatility has surged lately, apparently vindicating those who have warned of lofty equity valuations.

zh: 但是，尽管美国股市经历了金融危机以来最糟糕的一星期之一，欧元区公共债务市场仍保持相对稳定，风险差 — — 该指标通常会在市场波动中上扬 — — 几乎保持不变，即使是欧元区外围国也安然无恙。
en: But, even as the US stock market suffered one of its worst weeks since the financial crisis, the eurozone’s public-debt market has remained relatively stable, with risk spreads – which have usually increased amid market volatility – scarcely changing, even for the peripheral eurozone countries.

zh: 欧元区之所以看上去能够免疫于金融市场回旋，原因在于外围经济体基本面有了巨大改善：增长得到了提振，失业尽管仍然高企，但下降得很快。
en: The eurozone owes its ostensible immunity from financial-market gyrations to major improvements in the peripheral economies’ fundamentals: growth has picked up, and unemployment, though still high, is declining rapidly.

zh: 问题在于这些改善是否足以稳定到能够继续保持欧元区的韧性。
en: The question is whether these improvements are stable enough to ensure the eurozone’s continued resilience.

zh: 在这里，关键问题是目前的复苏过于依赖低利率：如果借贷成本上升，外围债务国就将蒙受损失。
en: Here, the key concern is that the current recovery is too dependent on low interest rates: if borrowing costs rise, the periphery’s debtor countries would suffer.

zh: 但认为外围经济体都是孱弱债务国已不再准确。
en: But it is no longer accurate to view the economies of the periphery as weak debtors.

zh: 事实上，除了希腊，所有外围国目前都存在经常项目盈余，这意味着它们并不需要依赖资本流入，反而在偿还外债。
en: Indeed, with the exception of Greece, they are all now running current-account surpluses, meaning that far from depending on capital inflows, they are repaying their foreign debt.

zh: 是的，这其中也包括意大利。 尽管意大利公共债务水平很高，从总体水平看它仍然存在经常项目盈余。
en: And, yes, this includes Italy, which, despite its high public debt, is running a current-account surplus at the aggregate level.

zh: 在过去，意大利外部赤字和盈余大体相当，这意味着它不是净债务国。
en: In the past, Italy’s external deficits and surpluses were of roughly similar size, meaning that the country is not a net debtor.

zh: 由于其净国际投资头寸能够保持平衡，因此一般化的升息对它未必是坏事。
en: Because its net international investment position is balanced, a generalized interest-rate hike would not necessarily be bad for the country.

zh: 意大利政府将面临更高的债务维持成本，但意大利公民能够获得更多的储蓄收益。
en: The government would face higher debt-service costs, but citizens would earn more on their savings.

zh: 相反，西班牙和葡萄牙可能会蒙受冲击，因为它们的外部债务水平仍然很高。
en: Spain and Portugal, by contrast, would probably suffer, owing to their still-considerable external debts.

zh: 尽管如此，如果升息可以与全球增长相协调，即便时西班牙和葡萄牙这样的国家情况也不会大幅恶化，因为增长有助于它们维持外债。
en: Nonetheless, if interest-rate hikes are aligned with accelerating global growth, even these countries might not be much worse off, because growth will help them to service their foreign debts.

zh: 但眼下经常项目平衡情况的影响远远不止于短期利率考虑。
en: But the implications of today’s constellation of current-account balances extend beyond shorter-term interest-rate considerations.

zh: 如果现状多维持几年，欧元区可能会出现全部成员国都是债权国的情况，其中一些拥有巨大的净外国资产头寸（德国和荷兰 ） ， 另一些（外围国）拥有较小的正外部头寸。
en: If the situation persists for a few more years, the eurozone might get to a point where it consists only of creditor countries, some with a large net foreign asset position (Germany and the Netherlands) and others (the peripheral countries) with a small positive external position.

zh: 这将造成巨大的政治影响。
en: This would have important political consequences.

zh: 首先，这样的欧元区，内部利益冲突要比十年前危机期间所爆发的利益冲突小得多。 十年前，债权国有义务援助债务国，而后者则被强迫的紧缩压得喘不过气来。
en: For starters, the conflicts of interests within such a eurozone might be much less acute than those that emerged during the crisis a decade ago, when creditor countries were obliged to bail out the debtors, which in turn felt squeezed by forced austerity.

zh: 更广泛地说，债权国（特别是德国）的相对权力将变小。
en: More broadly, the relative power of the creditor countries – particularly Germany – will be diminished.

zh: 乔治·索罗斯（George Soros）等一些观察者担忧欧元区仍将保持两级俱乐部的状态，债权国向债务国施加条件。 从现在的情况看，这样的看法有些夸张。
en: The concerns expressed by some observers, such as George Soros, that the eurozone will remain a two-tier club, in which the creditors impose their conditions on the debtors, thus seem exaggerated.

zh: 但这并不意味着这一新动态完全没有风险。
en: But that does not mean that this new dynamic is risk-free.

zh: 如果前债务国在来自主要债权国或风险溢价的压力见效的情况下，采取了有欠审慎的财政政策，它们的公共债务可能会继续累积。
en: If former debtors, facing diminished pressure from major creditors or risk premia, adopted less prudent fiscal policies, their public debt would continue to accumulate.

zh: 在这样的背景下，下一次危机可能会与上一次截然不同。
en: Against that background, the next crisis might be very different from the last one.

zh: 上一次欧元区危机爆发时，大规模流入外围国的资本流正在制造通胀压力；资源流出出口部门；政府收入看是强劲。
en: When the last eurozone crisis began, large capital flows into the periphery were generating inflationary pressures; resources were shifting away from exports; and government revenues appeared to be strong.

zh: 接着，资本流入突然逆转，这要求降低国内工资和价格（相对于欧元区水平 ） ， 以使资源重新流回出口。
en: Then the capital inflows abruptly reversed, which demanded a decline in domestic wages and prices, relative to the eurozone average, in order to shift resources back toward exports.

zh: 在大部分国家，政府收入减少，因为国内活动（如建筑活动）收缩速度远远快于出口扩张。
en: In most countries, government revenues fell, as domestic activities, such as construction, contracted much faster than exports increased.

zh: 结果，外围经济体陷入了深度衰退。
en: As a result, the peripheral economies fell into a deep recession.

zh: 更糟糕的是，由于出口拉动型复苏产生的收入变少 — — 出口可获得增值税退税，但进口需要交纳增值税 — — 貌似坚挺的政府财务状况很快便演变为巨额赤字。
en: Making matters worse, because an export-led recovery yields less revenue – value-added taxes are rebated on exports, but collected on imports – seemingly strong government finances quickly turned into large deficits.

zh: 在希腊的例子中，这一问题因为一个事实而加剧：在繁荣时期，巨额财政赤字完全通过资本流入来融资。
en: In Greece’s case, the problem was compounded by the fact that, during the boom years, the large fiscal deficits had been financed entirely by capital inflows.

zh: 当资本流入停止时，公共财政状况便现出了原形。
en: When these flows stopped, the bottom fell out of public finances.

zh: 如今，欧元区国家不再受制于巨额资本流入，因此危机不会导致它们面临外部失衡。
en: Today, eurozone countries are not subject to large capital inflows, so a crisis would not cause them to face external disequilibrium.

zh: 它们不需要大幅度工资和价格向下调整，政府收入也将保持相对稳定。
en: They would not need a large downward adjustment in wages and prices, and government revenues would remain relatively stable.

zh: 如果风险溢价上升，那么将是因为债权国质疑政府长期自我融资的能力，而这又是因为增长预期调低或国内纳税人反对债券持有人、进而产生政治僵局导致的。
en: If risk premia increase, it would be a result of creditors’ doubts about a government’s ability to finance itself in the long run, owing to a downward revision of growth expectations or a domestic political stalemate in which taxpayers oppose bondholders.

zh: 国内债券持有人可能首先认识到潜在风险，刺激资本逃离加剧。
en: Domestic bondholders might be the first to recognize potential risks, spurring escalating capital flight.

zh: 在这样的环境下，来自欧洲稳定性机制（ESM，欧元区的援助基金）的贷款只能进一步刺激外流。
en: In these circumstances, a loan from the European Stability Mechanism – the eurozone’s bailout fund – would merely provide fuel for even higher outflows.

zh: 但将ESM改造为“欧洲货币基金组织”是当前欧元区治理改革的主要争论话题。
en: Yet transforming the ESM into a “European Monetary Fund” is currently one of the main issues in the debate about eurozone governance reforms.

zh: 隐含的榜样模式是国际货币基金组织（IMF ） 。 IMF以收拾突发资本流逆转所造成的残局而闻名。
en: The implicit role model is the International Monetary Fund, which has made its reputation by addressing the fallout from sudden capital-flow reversals.

zh: 但这也不是如今对资本流入依赖程度较小的欧元区可能发生的危机类型。
en: Again, that is not the type of crisis that today’s less inflow-dependent eurozone is likely to experience.

zh: 欧洲领导人不应该试图复制IMF，而应该聚焦于加强金融体系的韧性，以使其能够为因为一些欧元区国家公共债务的不断积累而不可避免地产生的压力提供安全阀。
en: Instead of trying to copy the IMF, Europe’s leaders should be focused on strengthening the resilience of the financial system, so that it can provide a safety valve for whatever pressures inevitably arise from the build-up of excessive public debt in some eurozone countries.

zh: 如果真的爆发危机，ESM的资源可以用于防止欧元区金融体系内部的传染，而不是用于为国内问题深重的国家提供贷款。
en: If a crisis does occur, the ESM’s resources could perhaps be used to prevent contagion within the eurozone financial system, rather than to provide loans to countries with deep-seated domestic problems.

zh: 在经历了十年的挣扎后，欧元区已经成为一片波涛汹涌的海面上的一个相对稳定的岛屿。
en: After a decade of struggles, the eurozone is an island of relative stability in a turbulent sea.

zh: 要确保它一直稳定下去，其领导人必须铭记一个基本事实：显著的国内问题，绝不可能通过来自海外的贷款或资源转移解决。
en: To ensure that it stays that way, its leaders must remember a fundamental truth: no predominantly domestic problem will ever be resolved by a loan or transfer of resources from abroad.

zh: 维持无以为继的欧元区
en: Sustaining the Unsustainable Eurozone

zh: 发自雅典 — — 当欧元区建立之时，它的缔造者们希望它能逐渐朝着以财政统一，人员自由流动以及政治联盟为特点的“优化货币区 ” 。
en: ATHENS – When the eurozone was established, its creators envisioned gradual progress toward an “optimal currency area,” characterized by fiscal integration, the free movement of labor, and political union.

zh: 而这一进程却并未发生，与此同时，正如旷日持久的希腊危机所展现的那样，欧元区依然充斥着结构性缺陷并在内部冲击面前极端脆弱。
en: But this process has not occurred, and, as the interminable Greek crisis has shown, the eurozone remains rife with structural weaknesses and extremely vulnerable to internal shocks.

zh: 这个情况很显然是无法维持下去的。
en: This is clearly not sustainable.

zh: 尽管努力去推动财政政策协调一致，欧盟成员国的预算依然无法超越各国政府的狭隘眼界，而北欧各国也继续反对在欧盟区域基金规模本已很小的情况下像穷邻居们更多进行转移支付。
en: Despite efforts to promote fiscal-policy coordination, eurozone members’ budgets still fall under the purview of separate national authorities, and northern Europeans continue to oppose transfers from more to less prosperous countries beyond the very limited allowance of the European Union’s regional funds.

zh: 此外，劳动者的流动也受到了语言和文化壁垒以及行政瓶颈的严重限制。
en: Moreover, labor mobility is severely constrained by linguistic and cultural barriers, as well as administrative bottlenecks.

zh: 而“前所未有地紧密”的政治联盟也不再努力吸引公众支持 — — 如果曾经得到过的话 — — 因此也变得不再可行。
en: And “ever-closer” political union has ceased to attract public support – if it ever did – and is thus not feasible today.

zh: 越来越多的评论员 — — 而且不仅仅是说英语的那帮 — — 开始质疑这一货币联盟的生存能力。
en: A growing number of commentators – and no longer only in the Anglo-Saxon world – question the monetary union’s viability.

zh: 有些人鼓动希腊退出欧元区，这么一个覆盖面更小且各国国情类似的货币联盟可以更强大，也更容易联合。
en: Some encourage Greece to exit the eurozone, believing that a more restricted and homogeneous currency union would be stronger and easier to unite.

zh: 其他人则认为希腊的退出仅仅是一个开端，意味着一个与其初始设计意图背道而驰的进程正在不可避免地徐徐展开。
en: Others consider a Greek exit to be just the start of the inevitable unraveling of a scheme that does not serve the purpose for which it was created.

zh: 迄今为止，欧元区依然能证明这些预言家是错的。
en: The eurozone has so far managed to prove the doomsayers wrong.

zh: 人们在纯粹依靠政治意愿的力量下达成了一个又一个的妥协，并以此支撑着一个 — — 就其当前状态来说 — — 无法持续的历史规划。
en: By sheer force of political will, compromise after compromise has been reached, thereby sustaining a historic project that is not, in its current state, sustainable.

zh: 那个维持欧洲联合的承诺，以及克服经济困境的需要在新的地缘政治挑战之下得到了强化。
en: The need to maintain this commitment to European unity, and overcome the economic difficulties that arise, is reinforced by new geopolitical challenges.

zh: 其中最引人注目的，莫过于俄罗斯重夺苏联时代影响力的野心正在挑战二战之后建立的，以规则为基础的秩序，而宗教和政治极端主义的卷土重来则威胁着民主和自由价值观。
en: Most notably, Russia’s perceived ambition of recapturing its Soviet-era influence is challenging the rules-based order that was established after World War II, and a surge in religious and political extremism is threatening democratic and liberal values.

zh: 但经济困境将继续持续，引发对货币联盟未来前景的存疑 — — 而这些疑问也可以在削弱欧元合理运作能力的情况下不断自我强化。
en: But the economic difficulties are bound to continue, fostering doubts about the currency union’s future – doubts that could become self-fulfilling by undermining the euro’s ability to function properly.

zh: 经济压力本来就已经在不断撩动着西班牙，意大利甚至法国的反欧洲情绪；如果任由其发展，这种情绪将将最终导致独立行为，为欧元区以及欧洲整体带来灾难性的后果。
en: Already, economic pressures have fueled anti-European sentiment in Spain, Italy, and even France; if allowed to continue, such sentiment could culminate in secession, with devastating consequences for the eurozone and Europe as a whole.

zh: 这一进程的第一步很可能是欧元区分裂成为多个小区，各自由国情相近的国家构成。
en: The first step in such a process would probably be the eurozone’s division into sub-areas, comprising countries of relatively equal resilience.

zh: 随着越来越难以推动一致的财政和货币政策，欧元区完全解体的风险也逐渐增大。
en: As it becomes increasingly difficult to pursue coherent fiscal and monetary policies, the risk of the eurozone’s complete dissolution would grow.

zh: 而希腊的退出这将大大缩短这一进程。
en: Greece’s exit could shorten this timeline considerably.

zh: 虽然这一情景在五年前希腊危机首次爆发之时是无法想象的，但“希落(读là ) （ Grexit ） ” 这个词在危机达到了一个新高度之后迅速进入了欧洲的字典之中。
en: Though such a scenario was inconceivable five years ago, when the Greek crisis first erupted, the term “Grexit” entered the European lexicon soon after, when the crisis reached a new peak.

zh: 但欧洲领导人们似乎意识到了容许这样一个国家 — — 即便是危机深重的小国希腊 — — 退出意味着什么。
en: But European leaders seemed to recognize the implications of allowing a country – even small, crisis-stricken Greece – to exit the eurozone.

zh: 这也是为什么近一年时间召开了一连串欧洲集团会议，力阻这一后果的发生。
en: That is why, this year, a series of Eurogroup meetings were held with the avowed purpose of averting such an outcome.

zh: 但问题在于，欧洲人早已习惯在面对危机之时虚与委蛇，胡乱应付过去，使得任何长期解决方案都似乎无法实现。
en: The problem is that Europeans have become so accustomed to muddling through that long-term solutions seem all but impossible.

zh: 事实上近年以来，欧元区当局已经实施了多项政策来应对金融危机 — — 推动以政府为后盾的救助基金，一个局部的银行联盟，更严格的财政管制，以及将欧洲央行确定为最后���急借款者。
en: Indeed, in recent years, eurozone authorities have introduced several policies for fighting financial crises – including government-backed rescue funds, a partial banking union, tougher fiscal controls, and a role for the European Central Bank as lender of last resort.

zh: 但大多数这类政策 — — 可能银行联盟除外 — — 都旨在应对违约风险，而非铲除导致这一风险的根源。
en: But most of these policies – with the possible exception of the banking union – are aimed at managing default risk, not eliminating this risk’s root causes.

zh: 如今也是时候重拾当年欧盟缔造者们所展现出来的那种目光长远并梦想更美好未来的能力。
en: It is time to recover the capacity, displayed by the EU’s founders, to look ahead and pursue a dream of a better future.

zh: 特别是欧元区领导人们必须引入一个在强弱经济体之间进行转移支付的机制。
en: Specifically, eurozone leaders must introduce a mechanism for fiscal transfers from stronger to weaker economies.

zh: 在一个货币联盟中，单一经济体无法通过调整自身汇率来应对相对竞争力的改变。
en: In a currency union, individual economies cannot alter their exchange rates to account for changes in relative competitiveness.

zh: 因此产生的价格粘性也会拖延宏观经济稳定和结构性调整，使得弱小经济体负债和失业率双双提升。
en: The resulting price stickiness tends to delay macroeconomic stabilization and structural adjustment, leading to rising debt and unemployment in weaker economies.

zh: 如果如果劳动者无法自由流动的话，财政转移支付就是欧元区缓解债务偿付压力，以及通过刺激经济活动来促进就业的唯一选项。
en: Without free labor mobility, fiscal transfers are the eurozone’s only option to ease debt repayment and, by stimulating economic activity, boost employment.

zh: 建立这一机制绝不容易，因为它需要一种欧洲当前紧缺的资源：信任。
en: Establishing such a mechanism will not be easy, as it requires a resource that is in short supply in Europe today: trust.

zh: 事实上北欧和南欧一直都无法弥合双方的文化差异以及经济不平等状况，使得他们无法通过彼此的角度来判断形势。
en: Indeed, the north and south have struggled to overcome cultural differences and unequal economic conditions, preventing them from viewing the situation from each other’s perspective.

zh: 让联盟联接得更加紧密的努力对于构建这种来说至关重要。
en: Binding the union closer together could prove critical to building such trust.

zh: 一个既合理又与克服政治阻力所需的渐进主义相结合的策略就是稳步扩大欧盟的预算，使其最终得以扮演一个宏观经济的角色，提升欧元区内部的稳定和凝聚力。
en: One strategy that combines rationality with the gradualism needed to overcome political resistance would be to increase the EU budget steadily, so that it can ultimately play a macroeconomic role, promoting stability and reinforcing cohesion within the eurozone.

zh: 这是一个艰难的任务，但也是生死攸关的一步。
en: It is a tough sell, but also a vital one.

zh: 摆脱欧元，继续前进
en: Moving on From the Euro

zh: SAINT-PIERRE-D’ENTREMONT，法国—欧洲货币联盟从来不是个好主意。
en: SAINT-PIERRE-D’ENTREMONT, FRANCE – European Monetary Union was never a good idea.

zh: 我还记得，当时身为年轻助理教授的我意识到自己反对马斯特里赫特条约时是多么震惊。
en: I remember my surprise when, as a young assistant professor, I realized that I was opposed to the Maastricht Treaty.

zh: 当时的我相信欧洲一体化是一件非常美妙的事情 — — 现在仍然如此。
en: I believed then – and still do – that European integration is a very good thing.

zh: 但我所教授的教科书经济学表明，如果没有欧洲财政和政治联盟，欧洲货币联盟将带来巨大的危害。
en: But the textbook economics I was teaching showed how damaging EMU could be in the absence of European fiscal and political union.

zh: 此后发生的所有事情让我觉得，教科书绝没有过度悲观。
en: Nothing that has happened since has convinced me that the textbook was excessively pessimistic.

zh: 相反，教科书是过度乐观了。
en: On the contrary: it was far too optimistic.

zh: 生活的道路上到处是香蕉皮，如果踩到，你需要有调整能力。
en: Life is strewn with banana skins, and when you step on one you need to be able to adjust.

zh: 但货币联盟本身就是一块巨大的香蕉皮，它所带来的资本流动推高了欧洲外围的成本。
en: But the monetary union itself turned out to be a gigantic banana skin, inducing capital flows that pushed up costs around the European periphery.

zh: 而调整 — — 也就是货币贬值 — — 已不再是一个选项。
en: And adjustment – that is, currency devaluation – was not an option.

zh: 此外，大部分当代教科书都忽视金融部门；因此也就忽视了一个事实：流向外围的资本流将通过银行引导，而当资本停止流动时，银行危机将掣肘外围成员国的公共财政。
en: Furthermore, most textbooks of the time ignored the financial sector; thus, they ignored the fact that capital flows to the periphery would be channeled via banks, and that when the capital stopped flowing, bank crises would strain peripheral members’ public finances.

zh: 这反过来进一步削弱了银行资产负债表、制约了信用创造，形成了一个近几年来我们耳熟能详的主权-银行恶性循环。
en: This, in turn, would further erode banks’ balance sheets and constrain credit creation – the sovereign-bank doom loop that we have heard so much about in recent years.

zh: 而没有一本教科书预见到欧洲合作会向危机国施加亲周期紧缩，制造出一场在一定程度上堪与20世纪30年代相提并论的萧条。
en: And no textbooks predicted that European cooperation would impose pro-cyclical austerity on crisis-struck countries, creating depressions that in some cases have rivaled those of the 1930s.

zh: 多年来，很明显“实际存在的欧洲货币联盟”是一个代价昂贵的失败，不管在经济上还是在政治上都是如此。
en: It has been obvious for some years that the “actually existing EMU” has been a costly failure, both economically and politically.

zh: 对欧洲机构的信任崩溃了，质疑欧元乃至整个欧洲工程的政党开始兴起。
en: Trust in European institutions has collapsed, and political parties skeptical not just of the euro, but of the entire European project, are on the rise.

zh: 但是，大部分经济学家，哪怕是那些一开始对欧洲货币联盟并不热情的经济学家，都不愿意挑明是时候放弃这个失败实验了。
en: And yet most economists, even those who were never keen on EMU in the first place, have been reluctant to make the argument that the time has come to abandon a failed experiment.

zh: 巴里·艾肯格林（Barry Eichengreen）的一篇著名文章 指出，预期中的欧洲货币联盟解体将导致“所有金融危机之母 ” 。
en: A famous article by Barry Eichengreen pointed out that an anticipated EMU breakup would lead to the “mother of all financial crises.”

zh: 很难不同意他的论点。
en: It is hard to disagree with him.

zh: 因此，各派别经济学家，不管是否支持共同货币，在过去五年中纷纷设计和推出降低欧元区功能失调情况的机构改革和政治变革方案。
en: That is why economists of all stripes, whether or not they supported the introduction of the common currency, have spent the last five years developing and promoting a package of institutional reforms and policy changes that would make the eurozone less dysfunctional.

zh: 在短期，欧元区必须大幅放松货币和财政政策。
en: In the short run, the eurozone needs much looser monetary and fiscal policy.

zh: 它还需要提高通胀目标（以降低名义工资和物价下降的需要 ） 、 恰当的债务纾困、有充足的中央财政支持的合理银行联盟，以及一种各国银行可以持有的“安全”的欧元区资产，从而打破主权-银行恶性循环。
en: It also needs a higher inflation target (to reduce the need for nominal wage and price reductions); debt relief, where appropriate; a proper banking union with an adequate, centralized fiscal backstop; and a “safe” eurozone asset that national banks could hold, thereby breaking the sovereign-bank doom loop.

zh: 不幸的是，经济学家并未强烈要求合理的财政联盟。
en: Unfortunately, economists have not argued strongly for a proper fiscal union.

zh: 即使有些经济学家认为在经济上有必要也会仔细审视自己的观点，因为他们认为在政治上不可行。
en: Even those who consider it economically necessary censor themselves, because they believe it to be politically impossible.

zh: 问题在于沉默让政治可能性前沿变得更窄了，因此即使是较为温和的方案也无人问津。
en: The problem is that silence has narrowed the frontier of political possibility even further, so that more modest proposals have fallen by the wayside as well.

zh: 五年过去了，欧元区仍然没有合理的银行联盟，甚至如希腊所标明的，连合理的最后贷款人都没有。
en: Five years on, the eurozone still lacks a proper banking union, or even, as Greece demonstrated, a proper lender of last resort.

zh: 此外，提高通胀目标仍然无法想象，而德国政府指出，主权债务违约在欧元区是不合法的。
en: Moreover, a higher inflation target remains unthinkable, and the German government argues that defaults on sovereign debt are illegal within the eurozone.

zh: 亲周期财政调整至今仍主宰者政策界。
en: Pro-cyclical fiscal adjustment is still the order of the day.

zh: 欧洲央行姗姗来迟的量化宽松是一个值得欢迎的进步，但决策者关闭成员国银行系统 — — 并且是出于政治上的原因 — — 具��极大的破坏性，是退后的一大步。
en: The European Central Bank’s belated embrace of quantitative easing was a welcome step forward, but policymakers’ enormously destructive decision to shut down a member state’s banking system – for what appears to be political reasons – is a far larger step backward.

zh: 并且没人在谈论真正的财政和政治联盟，哪怕没人能够想象欧洲货币联盟可以在现状下生存下去。
en: And no one is talking about real fiscal and political union, even though no one can imagine European Monetary Union surviving under the status quo.

zh: 与此同时，政治伤害仍在继续发生：并非所有的反对党都像希腊执政党左翼联盟（Syriza）那样亲欧洲。
en: Meanwhile, the political damage is ongoing: not all protest parties are as pro-European as Greece’s ruling Syriza.

zh: 国内政治正在因为中间派政客无法解决选民担心欧元区经济政策以及民主赤字的问题而被扭曲。
en: And domestic politics is being distorted by the inability of centrist politicians to address voters’ concerns about the eurozone’s economic policies and its democratic deficit.

zh: 人们担心，这样做相当于间接支持怀疑派，而这是一个禁区。
en: To do so, it is feared, would give implicit support to the skeptics, which is taboo.

zh: 因此，在法国，社会党总统奥朗德援引萨伊（Jean-Baptiste Say）的话指出供给自会创造需求，而极右翼的国民阵线（National Front）的马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）则援引保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）和约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz）论证自己的观点。
en: Thus, in France, Socialist President François Hollande channels Jean-Baptiste Say, arguing that supply creates its own demand, while the far-right National Front’s Marine Le Pen gets to quote Paul Krugman and Joseph Stiglitz approvingly.

zh: 毫不奇怪工作阶级选民会倒向勒庞。
en: No wonder that working-class voters are turning to her party.

zh: 国民阵线在2017年或2022年的大选中获胜已不再是不可想象的事情，果真如此的话，将摧毁欧洲工程。
en: A victory for the National Front in 2017 or 2022, which is no longer unthinkable, would destroy the European project.

zh: 欧元区小国的公民将会注意到欧洲央行被赤裸裸地政治化服务于德国在希腊的目标，而欧元区也无可避免地将被认为是对小国十分“危险”的联盟。
en: Citizens of smaller eurozone member states will have noted the brutal way the ECB was politicized to achieve Germany’s goals in Greece, and the conclusion that the eurozone is a dangerous “union” for small countries will seem inescapable.

zh: 如果中间派政党继续袖手旁观而不是反对现状，那么政治极端分子将进一步攻陷更加重要的国家。
en: If centrist parties remain on the sidelines, rather than protesting what has happened, the political extremists will gain further valuable territory.

zh: 对于我这样的经济学家，一直在呼吁结束失败的欧元实验、支持改革，也许现在是时候承认失败、继续前行了。
en: As for economists like me, who have balked at advocating an end to the failed euro experiment and favored reform, perhaps it is time to admit defeat and move on.

zh: 只要反欧洲派反对欧洲货币联盟，欧盟就可能与欧元一道寿终正寝。
en: If only anti-Europeans oppose EMU, the EU baby could end up being thrown out with the euro bathwater.

zh: 欧元的末日确实会引来严重危机。
en: An end to the euro would indeed provoke an immense crisis.

zh: 但扪心自问：你真的认为欧元真的会以现在的形式存在一百年？
en: But ask yourself this: Do you really think the euro will be around in its present form a century from now?

zh: 如果不是，则它会有结束的一天，而这一天永远不会是“正确”的日子。
en: If not it will end, and the timing of that end will never be “right.”

zh: 因此，还不如趁着没有造成更大伤害让它结束。
en: Better, then, to get on with it before more damage is done.

zh: 欧元区的虚假复苏
en: The Eurozone’s False Recovery

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 乍眼看来，欧元区经济似乎终于走上了复苏的轨道。
en: LONDON – At first glance, the eurozone economy seems like it might finally be on the mend.

zh: 股市不断高涨，消费者重拾信心。
en: Stock markets are rallying. Consumer confidence has picked up.

zh: 更低的油价，更便宜的欧元汇率，加上欧洲央行所实施的量化宽松手段都有望刺激增长。
en: Lower oil prices, a cheaper euro, and quantitative easing by the European Central Bank are all expected to boost growth.

zh: 欧洲央行主席马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）宣称“一场持续的复苏已经确立。 ”而柏林和布鲁塞尔的政策制定者们纷纷拉来西班牙和爱尔兰的生命复苏迹象作样板，好证明自己那些严苛的财政巩固和结构改革方案都如早先宣称的那样奏效了。
en: ECB President Mario Draghi claims that “a sustained recovery is taking hold,” while policymakers in Berlin and Brussels latch onto signs of life in Spain and Ireland as proof that their bitter prescription of fiscal consolidation and structural reforms worked as advertised.

zh: 但如果抵近认真观察的话，就会明显发现这类改善的程度其实相当一般，甚至可能是临时性的，也非德国鼓吹的政策所产生的结果。
