en: On closer inspection, however, it becomes clear that the improvement is modest, probably temporary, and not the result of the policies promoted by Germany.

zh: 没错，按照某些估算数据，欧元区经济可能正以1.6%的年均增长率增长，高于2014年第四季度的0.9 % ， 但这一增长率依然远低于美国和英国。
en: True, according to some estimates, the eurozone economy may now be growing at an annual rate of 1.6%, up from 0.9% in the year to the fourth quarter of 2014. But that is far slower than in the United States and Britain.

zh: 再加上欧元区经济规模比七年前萎缩了2%的现状 ， “ 复苏”这个词似乎不太恰当 — — 尤其是在这一状况很可能无法持续的情况下。
en: With the eurozone economy 2% smaller than it was seven years ago, “recovery” does not feel like the right word – especially as the relief is unlikely to last.

zh: 首先，由低油价产生的一次性增长已经开始走向末路。
en: For starters, the one-off boost from lower oil prices is already being unwound.

zh: 在去年六月至今年一月期间下跌了超过50%之后，欧元计算的原油价格已经反弹了近1/3，这在某种程度上是由于欧元迅速贬值，以至于要花更多的钱来进口。
en: After dropping by more than half between mid-June and mid-January, oil prices in euros have since bounced back by a third, partly owing to the euro’s sharp depreciation, which is making imports generally more expensive.

zh: 而这对家庭支出和企业成本所造成的影响当然是不值得庆祝的。
en: The effect of that on households’ budgets and companies’ costs is hardly cause for celebration.

zh: 政策制定者们寄望于用一个更具竞争力的货币来刺激增长，但他们很可能会感到失望。
en: Policymakers are counting on a more competitive currency to stimulate growth. But they are likely to be disappointed.

zh: 随着欧元区的出口对国际供应链的依赖逐渐加深，廉价货币对经济的刺激要比以往更弱。
en: With eurozone exports increasingly reliant on global supply chains, a cheaper currency provides less of a boost than before.

zh: 出口商可能也会选择把利润放进口袋，而非试图扩大市场份额。
en: Exporters may also choose to pocket any gains, rather than seek to expand market share.

zh: 2014年，欧元区的出口总额达到了近2万亿欧元（当时相当于2.6万亿美元 ） — —这个数字比中国要高。
en: In 2014, exports from the eurozone amounted to nearly €2 trillion ($2.6 trillion at the time) – more than those from China.

zh: 但考虑到全球需求的不景气状况，很难实现出口的快速增长。
en: Given patchy global demand, rapid export growth will be difficult to achieve.

zh: 无论如何，出口只占到了整个欧盟区十万亿欧元总规模的1/5，因此也不大可能在国内需求依旧疲软的情况下带动强劲增长。
en: In any case, with exports accounting for only one-fifth of the eurozone’s €10 trillion economy, they are unlikely to spur a strong recovery while domestic demand remains weak.

zh: 根据欧洲央行的模型测算，欧元去年10%的贬值（以贸易加权的实际值计算）仅仅贡献了今年0.2%的增长。
en: According to the ECB’s model, the euro’s 10% depreciation over the past year (in real, trade-weighted terms) may lift growth this year by a mere 0.2%.

zh: 量化宽松所带来的好处也很可能会被证明是暂时的。
en: The benefits of quantitative easing are also likely to prove ephemeral.

zh: 政府借贷成本的降低也不太可能大幅刺激增长，因为欧盟的相关法规不允许财政扩张。
en: The decline in governments’ borrowing costs is unlikely to boost growth much, as European Union rules preclude fiscal expansion.

zh: 根据欧盟委员会的声明，虽然爱尔兰，法国和意大利进一步紧缩开支，但总体来说，欧元区今年的财政态势将在很大程度上维持中性。
en: Overall, the eurozone’s fiscal stance is set to be broadly neutral this year, according to the European Commission, albeit with further squeezes in Ireland, France, and Italy.

zh: 对于少数能触及资本市场的欧元区大企业来说，量化宽松确实改善了它们的融资状况。
en: Quantitative easing does improve funding conditions for the few eurozone companies large enough to tap capital markets.

zh: 但即便是资本市场在企业融资中扮演着更重要角色的英美两国，资产价格的膨胀也无力去鼓励消费者消费或企业投资。
en: But, even in the US and Britain, where capital markets play a much larger role in corporate finance, asset-price inflation did little to encourage consumers to spend or companies to invest.

zh: 要知道在开发金融产品上赚快钱的前景远比向一个弱势实体经济投资更具吸引力。
en: On the contrary, investment in a weak real economy has been far less attractive than the prospect of earning easy money from financial engineering.

zh: 大多数欧元区企业依赖银行融资，而虽然信贷状况得到了某种改善，贷款量依然波澜不惊（在南欧甚至持续下跌 ） 。
en: Most businesses in the eurozone rely on bank finance, and while credit conditions have improved somewhat, lending is flat (and continues to fall in southern Europe).

zh: 只要那些僵尸银行依然背负着重重坏账，这种状况就难以有大的改善。
en: As long as zombie banks are weighed down with bad loans, that is unlikely to change much.

zh: 而虽然德国开出了财政巩固药方以及旨在增强出口竞争力的相关措施，欧元区 — — 远低于西班牙和爱尔兰的相对快速扩张 — — 的小幅增长回升也没法证明其正确性。
en: Nor can the small uptick in the eurozone’s growth, much less the relatively rapid expansion in Spain and Ireland, be attributed to the German recipe of fiscal consolidation and measures to increase export competitiveness.

zh: 毕竟一切都必将回归真相。
en: Indeed, nothing could be further from the truth.

zh: 西班牙也算不上是成功财政调整的好榜样。
en: Spain is hardly an example of a successful fiscal adjustment.

zh: 相反，该国的复苏是与2011~2103年间极端紧缩政策的放宽相辅相成的，虽然是工资增长依旧停滞，但却鼓励家庭进行更多的消费来实现这一局面。
en: On the contrary, its recovery coincided with the easing of the extreme austerity imposed in 2011-13, which has encouraged households to spend more, despite stagnant wages. Even so, its economy remains 5.7% smaller than it was seven years ago.

zh: 高达23.7%的西班牙人 — — 包括50%的年轻人 — — 都处于失业状态，而更多的人干脆直接就退出了劳动力市场。
en: A whopping 23.7% of Spaniards – and one in two young people – are unemployed, while many more have dropped out of the labor force altogether.

zh: 与此同时，西班牙去年的预算赤字相当于GDP的5.7 % ， 也是欧盟第一高。
en: Meanwhile, Spain’s budget deficit was 5.7% of GDP last year, the highest in the EU.

zh: 该国快速增长的公共债务额今年也将超过GDP总量的100 % 。
en: Its rapidly rising public debt is set to top 100% of GDP this year.

zh: 为了应对该国的年末大选，欧盟委员会只得批准进一步扩大其结构性赤字。
en: As the country heads toward an election later this year, the European Commission has sanctioned the widening of its structural deficit.

zh: 因此与其说西班牙是因为执行紧缩而变得欣欣向荣，倒不如说是在很大程度上拿到了一张免费通行证而已。
en: Rather than flourishing as a result of austerity, Spain is in many ways getting a free pass.

zh: 爱尔兰这个欧盟去年增长最快的经济体也无法坐实德国政策方案的适当性。
en: Nor does Ireland – the fastest-growing EU economy last year – confirm the appropriateness of Germany’s policy prescriptions.

zh: 毕竟这个国家是一个规模较小且高度开放的经济体，其出口部门的蓬勃增长源自于其中一些已有的优点 — — 包括较低的商业税赋，拥有较强技能的劳动力大军，以及灵活的经济结构 — — 再加上有利的外部条件，尤其是英美等主要出口目的地的复苏。
en: Ireland, after all, is a tiny, highly open economy whose booming export sector is benefiting from existing strengths – including low business taxes, a skilled workforce, and a flexible economy – and favorable external conditions, especially the strong recovery in its main markets, the US and Britain.

zh: 即便如此，该国的经济总量依然小于危机之前，失业率维持在双位数，国内需求依然一蹶不振，而不公正地强加于220万爱尔兰纳税人身上的640亿欧元银行援助账单依然在不断膨胀。
en: Even so, the economy is smaller than it was before the crisis, the unemployment rate is in double digits, domestic demand remains depressed, and the €64 billion bank-bailout bill unjustly imposed on 2.2 million Irish taxpayers still looms large.

zh: 欧元区经济会在2015年表现的更好，但这并非出自于德国要求执行的政策。
en: The eurozone economy is set to do a bit better in 2015, but not because of the policies demanded by Germany.

zh: 这很可能是一个临时性的反弹，而非可持续复苏的开端。
en: And it is likely to be a temporary bounce, not the start of a sustained recovery.

zh: 为了克服自身资产负债表的衰退状况，欧元区需要清理自身的银行，减少大多数沉重的私人债务，纠正在投资方面的巨额差额，消除对企业设立的壁垒，并应对德国重商主义所带来的通缩阻力。
en: To overcome its balance-sheet recession, the eurozone needs to clean up its banks, reduce the crushing overhang of mostly private debt, redress the huge shortfall in investment, eliminate barriers to enterprise, and tackle the deflationary drag of German mercantilism.

zh: 而这也是为何欧元区无法在短时间内摆脱自身问题的原因。
en: And that is why the eurozone will not escape its problems anytime soon.

zh: 欧元区的生命迹象
en: Signs of Life in the Eurozone

zh: 纽约—欧元区最新经济数据表明复苏也许近在眼前。
en: NEW YORK – The latest economic data from the eurozone suggest that recovery may be at hand.

zh: 是什么推动了形势向好？
en: What is driving the upturn?

zh: 前方面临什么障碍？
en: What obstacles does it face?

zh: 应该如何维持有利形势？
en: And what can be done to sustain it?

zh: 复苏的近因不难识别。
en: The immediate causes of recovery are not difficult to discern.

zh: 去年，欧元区还在二次触底边缘徘徊。
en: Last year, the eurozone was on the verge of a double-dip recession.

zh: 当欧元区陷入技术性通缩时，欧洲央行终于扳动了激进宽松的扳机，采取了量化宽松（包括购买主权债券）和负政策利率双管齐下的措施。
en: When it recently fell into technical deflation, the European Central Bank finally pulled the trigger on aggressive easing and launched a combination of quantitative easing (including sovereign-bond purchases) and negative policy rates.

zh: 金融效果立竿见影：预期货币宽松的欧元立刻贬值，并且在宽松实施之后维持跌势，欧元区核心和外围的债券收益率下降到极低水平，股市也开始强劲反弹。
en: The financial impact was immediate: in anticipation of monetary easing, and after it began, the euro fell sharply, bond yields in the eurozone’s core and periphery fell to very low levels, and stock markets started to rally robustly.

zh: 再加上油价暴跌，共同刺激了经济增长。
en: This, together with the sharp fall in oil prices, boosted economic growth.

zh: 其他因素也起到了帮助作用。
en: Other factors are helping, too.

zh: 欧洲央行的信用宽松事实上不贴了银行贷款。
en: The ECB’s easing of credit is effectively subsidizing bank lending.

zh: 随着欧盟委员会标准的放宽，因紧缩而导致的财政拖累今年也有所减小。
en: The fiscal drag from austerity will be smaller this year, as the European Commission becomes more lenient.

zh: 银行联盟的启动也有所助益；在最近的压力测试和资产质量检查后，银行拥有了更大的流动性和更多的资本用于私人部门贷款。
en: And the start of a banking union also helps; following the latest stress tests and asset quality review, banks have greater liquidity and more capital to lend to the private sector.

zh: 拜这些因素所赐，欧元区增长有所恢复，欧元区股票表现也胜过了美国。
en: As a result of these factors, eurozone growth has resumed, and eurozone equities have recently outperformed US equities.

zh: 欧元贬值和欧洲央行的激进措施甚至有可能在今年玩那些时候结束通缩压力。
en: The weakening of the euro and the ECB’s aggressive measures may even stop the deflationary pressure later this year.

zh: 但要想获得更强劲、更持续的复苏，还面临着诸多挑战。
en: But a more robust and sustained recovery still faces many challenges.

zh: 首先，政治风险可能破坏进展。
en: For starters, political risks could derail progress.

zh: 我们希望希腊能够留在欧元区。
en: Greece, one hopes, will remain in the eurozone.

zh: 但左翼联盟（Syriza）政府与“三驾马车 ” （ 欧洲央行、欧盟委员会和国际货币基金组织）之间的艰苦谈判可能导致意料外的结果 — — 姑且称之为“希腊退出 ” — —如果未来几周内无法形成融资协议的话。
en: But the difficult negotiations between the Syriza-led government and the “troika” (the ECB, the European Commission, and the International Monetary Fund) could cause an unintended accident – call it a “Grexident” – if an agreement on funding the country is not reached in the next few weeks.

zh: 此外，西班牙的左翼联盟 — — 社会民主党（Podemos）可能赢得西班牙选举。
en: Moreover, Podemos, a leftist party in the Syriza mold, could come to power in Spain.

zh: 左翼和右翼民粹主义反欧元政党正在挑战意大利总理伦齐。
en: Populist anti-euro parties of the right and the left are challenging Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi.

zh: 极右翼的国民阵线（National Front）的马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）在2017年法国总统选举民调中领先。
en: And Marine Le Pen of the far-right National Front is polling well ahead of the 2017 French presidential election.

zh: 缓慢的就业创造和收入增长可能继续助长针对紧缩和改革的民粹主义反击。
en: Slow job creation and income growth may continue to fuel the populist backlash against austerity and reform.

zh: 就连欧洲央行也估计，2017年欧元区失业率仍将高达9.9 % — —远高于七年前全球金融危机爆发前的平均水平。
en: Even the ECB estimates that the eurozone unemployment rate will still be 9.9% in 2017 – well above the 7.2% average prior to the global financial crisis seven years ago.

zh: 欧元区外围过存在紧缩和改革疲劳，而核心国则存在援助疲劳，并让德国、荷兰和芬兰的反欧元政党大受欢迎。
en: And austerity and reform fatigue in the eurozone periphery has been matched by bailout fatigue in the core, boosting support for a range of anti-euro parties in Germany, the Netherlands, and Finland.

zh: 持续复苏的第二个障碍是欧元区不利的周边环境。
en: A second obstacle to sustained recovery is the eurozone’s bad neighborhood.

zh: 俄罗斯日益变得咄咄逼人，大举染指乌克兰、波罗的海乃至巴尔干（而对俄制裁也伤害了许多欧洲经济体 ） 。
en: Russia is becoming more assertive and aggressive in Ukraine, the Baltics, and even the Balkans (while sanctions against Russia have hurt many European economies).

zh: 中东则可谓家门口的大火：最近的巴黎和哥本哈根恐怖袭击，以及突尼斯针对外国游客的袭击提醒欧洲，数百土生土长的圣战者可能从叙利亚、伊拉克或其他地区的战场中回国发动更多袭击。
en: And the Middle East is burning just next door: the recent terrorist attacks in Paris and Copenhagen, and against foreign tourists in Tunisia, remind Europe that hundreds of homegrown jihadists could return from fighting in Syria, Iraq, or elsewhere and launch further attacks.

zh: 第三，尽管欧洲央行政策压低了借贷成本，外围国家的但私人和公共债务（占GDP之比）仍然很高并在继续升高，因为债务比率的分母 — — 名义GDP几无增长。
en: Third, while ECB policies keep borrowing costs lower, private and public debt in the periphery countries, as a share of GDP, is high and still rising, because the denominator of the debt ratio – nominal GDP – is barely increasing.

zh: 因此，债务可持续性在中期仍将是这些经济提的一大问题。
en: Thus, debt sustainability will remain an issue for these economies over the medium term.

zh: 第四，财政政策仍然矛盾，因为德国继续拒绝关于其应该采取短期刺激措施的日益异口同声的建议。
en: Fourth, fiscal policy remains contractionary, because Germany continues to reject a growing chorus of advice that it should undertake a short-term stimulus.

zh: 因此，不可能指望德国增加支出来抵消外围国增加紧缩的影响，也不可能指望德国增加支出填补欧盟委员会主席容克所提出的投资计划中的三年3,000亿预计欧元资金缺口。
en: Thus, higher German spending will not offset the impact of additional austerity in the periphery or the significant shortfall expected for the three-year, €300 billion ($325 billion) investment plan unveiled by European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker.

zh: 第五，结构改革进展依然缓慢，拖累了潜在增长。
en: Fifth, structural reforms are still occurring at a snail’s pace, holding back potential growth.

zh: 而尽管结构改革必不可少，但一些措施 — — 比如劳动力市场自由化和退休金改革 — — 可能增加欧元区储蓄率，从而进一步降低需求（十年前德国采取结构改革后就是如此 ） 。
en: And, while structural reforms are necessary, some measures – for example, labor-market liberalization and pension overhauls – may boost the eurozone’s savings rate and thus weaken aggregate demand further (as occurred in Germany following its structural reforms a decade ago).

zh: 最后，欧洲货币联盟依然不完整。
en: Finally, Europe’s monetary union remains incomplete.

zh: 其长期可行性需要逐渐发展出完整的银行联盟、财政联盟、经济联盟以及最终的政治联盟才能保证。
en: Its long-term viability requires the development over time of a full banking union, fiscal union, economic union, and eventually political union.

zh: 但欧洲进一步一体化的过程陷入了停滞。
en: But the process of further European integration has stalled.

zh: 如果欧元区失业率在2016年底仍处于过高水平，年通胀仍低于欧洲央行2%的目标，而财政政策和结构改革又造成短期的经济增长拖累，那么唯一的办法只能是继续量化宽松。
en: If the eurozone unemployment rate is still too high by the end of 2016, annual inflation remains well below the ECB’s 2% target, and fiscal policies and structural reforms exert a short-term drag on economic growth, the only game in town may be continued quantitative easing.

zh: 但欧元的持续贬值 — — 拜这些政策所赐 — — 刺激了欧元区经常项目盈余增长。
en: But the ongoing weakness of the euro – fed by such policies – is fueling growth in the eurozone’s current-account surplus.

zh: 事实上，随着欧元贬值，外围国的外部账户已经从赤字转为平衡并且日益向盈余迈进。
en: Indeed, as the euro weakens, the periphery countries’ external accounts have swung from deficit to balance and, increasingly, to surplus.

zh: 德国和欧元区核心国已经存在大量盈余；如果没有政策提振国内需求，这些盈余还将进一步增加。
en: Germany and the eurozone core were already running large surpluses; in the absence of policies to boost domestic demand, those surpluses have simply risen further.

zh: 因此，欧元区货币政策将日益呈现出以邻为壑效应，导致与美国和其他贸易伙伴之间的贸易和货币紧张局面。
en: Thus, the ECB’s monetary policy will take on an increasingly beggar-thy-neighbor cast, leading to trade and currency tensions with the United States and other trade partners.

zh: 要避免这一结果，德国需要采取能提振国内支出、降低其外部盈余的政策 — — 财政刺激、提高基础设施和公共投资支出，以及工资加快上涨。
en: To avoid this outcome, Germany needs to adopt policies – fiscal stimulus, higher spending on infrastructure and public investment, and more rapid wage growth – that would boost domestic spending and reduce the country’s external surplus.

zh: 除非德国向这一方向转变，否则欧元区复苏难以达到强劲而持续的程度。
en: Unless, and until, Germany moves in this direction, no one should bet the farm on a more robust and sustained eurozone recovery.

zh: 认真对待欧元区增长
en: Taking Eurozone Growth Seriously

zh: 伦敦—我已经有四年多没有关注国际金融和经济预测了，但在我在这一领域全职工作的30多年里所学到的经验仍在影响我看待世界的方式。
en: LONDON – I have been out of the world of international finance and economic forecasting for more than four years, but much of what I learned during my 30 years working full-time in the field still influences how I view the world.

zh: 一个经验是，衡量一个实体的经济和金融表现，可以通过将其与该实体的基本潜力和市场对它的表现的估值来进行。
en: One lesson was to measure an entity’s economic and financial performance by how it compares both to the entity’s underlying potential and the market’s valuation of its performance.

zh: 将这一方法应用到主要经济体中，就能发现一些令人惊奇的观察，以及可能。
en: Applying this approach to the major economies gives rise to some surprising observations – and possibilities.

zh: 首先，与流行的信念相反，世界增长在这个十年并不令人特别失望。
en: For starters, contrary to popular belief, world growth hasn’t been especially disappointing so far this decade.

zh: 据国际货币基金组织（IMF ） ， 从2010年到2016年，全球产出增长平均年率为3.4 % 。
en: From 2010 to 2016, global output rose at an average annual rate of 3.4%, according to the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 这或许要低于2000—2010年间的平均水平，但仍比20世纪80和90年代的增长率要高 — — 而这二十年通常并不认为属于经济令人失望的年代。
en: That may be lower than the 2000-2010 average, but it is higher than the growth rate in the 1980s and 1990s – decades that are not typically viewed as economically disappointing.

zh: 分解某些国家的表现能提供更进一步的洞见。
en: A breakdown of particular countries’ performance offers further insights.

zh: 尽管受到了巨大的政治冲击，但美国和英国表现仍达到了预期。
en: Despite significant political trauma, the United States and the United Kingdom have performed as expected.

zh: 中国、印度和日本的增长也接近潜在水平。
en: China, India, and Japan have also grown close to their potential.

zh: 比较罕见的是没有一个主要经济体表现大幅超过潜在水平。
en: In a rare occurrence, no major economy has dramatically outperformed its potential.

zh: 但三个经济体的表现真正令人失望：巴西、俄罗斯和欧元区。
en: Three economies have, however, genuinely disappointed: Brazil, Russia, and the eurozone.

zh: 这是否意味着包括我在内的许多观察者高估了这些经济体的潜力？
en: Could that mean that many observers, including me, overestimated these economies’ potential?

zh: 还是说，这情有可原？
en: Or does it reflect extenuating circumstances?

zh: 如果是后者，那么必须要问一问，这三个经济体中的一个乃至全部是否会与流行的预期相反，将在这个十年余下的时间里给我们一个惊喜？
en: If it is the latter, one must ask whether, contrary to prevailing expectations, new developments or shifts in any or all three of these economies might surprise us on the upside for the rest of the decade.

zh: 对于欧元区，认为其经济增长可能即将起飞或许已经足以 — — 至少到目前为止是如此 — — 让人觉得你应该去看看精神科医生。
en: When it comes to the eurozone, embracing the idea that economic growth may be about to take off might be enough, at least until recently, to earn one a referral to a mental-health specialist.

zh: 但从我的昔日经验出发，我会鼓励我的分析师用投入更多时间研究这一可能，因为，万一这个疯子一样的概念是真的，那么在如今估值慷慨的市场中，我们可以赚到许多钱。
en: But, in my old life, I would be encouraging my analysts to spend more time considering just that possibility, because, on the off-chance that this crackpot notion were true, there would be some serious money to be made in today’s generously valued markets.

zh: 而事实上，欧元区增长抬头的前景可能只算得上部分疯狂。
en: And, in fact, the prospect of a growth pickup in the eurozone might be only partly insane.

zh: 从周期角度看，欧元区目前横向和纵向比较都做得很好。
en: Cyclically, the eurozone is currently doing well both by its own standards and relative to others.

zh: 今年一季度，欧元区增长强于美国和英国，并且欧元区的大部分较大国家在一段时间里都表现出较强的相对增长。
en: In the first quarter of this year, the eurozone grew more strongly than the US or the UK, and most of the eurozone’s larger countries have been showing stronger relative growth for some time.

zh: 尽管如此，欧元区的长期结构性前景仍然不容乐观。
en: Nonetheless, the eurozone’s long-term structural outlook remains uninspiring.

zh: 欧元区最大国家的长期增长的两大关键动力 — — 工作年龄人口规模和生产率的增长 — — 形势严峻，即使大部分人都认为首屈一指的经济体德国从周期角度看目前表现良好。
en: The prospects for the two key drivers of long-term growth – the size and growth of the working-age population and productivity – look grim for the eurozone’s largest countries, even Germany, the one economy that most acknowledge is, from a cyclical perspective, doing just fine.

zh: 但是 — — 进一步大胆假设欧元区增长繁荣即将到来 — — 如果某些因素发生重大变化，从而强化这些增长动力呢？
en: But – to indulge further that outlandish notion of an impending eurozone growth surge – what if something changes significantly to strengthen those growth drivers?

zh: 从难民 — — 其中有大量年轻人 — — 不断从混乱的中东和非洲局部涌入欧洲看，这一假设也许并非天方夜谭。
en: With refugees – many of them young – continuing to pour into Europe from troubled parts of the Middle East and Africa, that may not be an altogether fanciful prospect.

zh: 当然，释放难民的潜力需要让他们融进欧洲社会和经济中 — — 许多欧洲人对这一挑战表示担忧，不无道理。
en: Of course, tapping the potential of refugees requires assimilating them to European societies and economies – a challenge that has many Europeans justifiably worried.

zh: 但如果这一要求得到满足，将肯定会减弱欧洲日益严重的人口挑战，特别是德国和意大利。
en: But, if that need were met, it would certainly mitigate Europe’s mounting demographic challenge, especially in Germany and Italy.

zh: 还有一种可能是新的发展将带来更有建设性的政策方针。
en: There is also the possibility that new developments will bring about a more constructive policy approach.

zh: 近几年中，大部分欧元区成员国的财政状况都经历了巨大但常常不为人所注意的改善 — — 欧元区整体财政赤字目前已低于GDP的3 % ， 远远好于美国和英国。
en: Most eurozone members’ fiscal positions have undergone considerable, though often unnoticed, improvement in recent years – so much so that the eurozone-wide fiscal deficit is now less than 3% of GDP, much better than the US or the UK.

zh: 此外，欧元区局部 — — 主要是德国 — — 税收收入大增，带来了令人咋舌的巨大的财政盈余。
en: Moreover, soaring tax receipts in some parts of the eurozone – notably Germany – are feeding almost embarrassingly large fiscal surpluses.

zh: 现在是否是推动法德领导的刺激计划的时机？
en: Could now be the moment to push for an ambitious Franco-German-led stimulus effort?

zh: 如果法国新总统马克龙成功地在6月的选举中获得足够的国民大会支持，也许他就能采取措施降低法国的结构性政府支出，同时实施减税和改善劳动力市场弹性。
en: If France’s new president, Emmanuel Macron, manages to obtain sufficient backing in the National Assembly in the June election, perhaps he could do something about reducing France’s structural government spending, while pursuing tax cuts and improved labor-market flexibility.

zh: 特别是劳动力市场改革将至关重要，不仅对于法国本身，对于说服德国总理默克尔支持加强财政一体化（包括马克龙所提出的建立欧元区财政部）也是如此，如果她在今年9月能继续掌权的话。
en: Labor-market reform, in particular, could be crucial, not just for France itself, but also to convince German Chancellor Angela Merkel, if she is returned to power this September, to move toward greater fiscal integration, including the creation of a eurozone finance minister, which Macron advocates.

zh: 也许这些内容的大部分都是长久之计，但几个月前人们还不敢做这样的想象。
en: Much of this is probably a long shot, but nowhere near as long as it was just a few months ago.

zh: 而从市场估值出发，探索这些可能要比专注于其他许多分析师沉迷其中的问题有趣得多。
en: And, given market valuations, it is much more interesting to explore such possibilities than it is to focus on many of the other issues that analysts obsess about.

zh: 更进一步，我们甚至可以梦想英国贸易平衡得到改善，因为极有竞争力的汇率大幅改善其主要市场 — — 欧元区的需求。
en: Carrying the scenario further, one could even dream up an optimistic outlook for the UK’s trade balance, with a highly competitive exchange rate significantly improving demand in its major market, the eurozone.

zh: 这可能足以抵消单一市场准入结束所带来的影响。
en: That could more than compensate for the challenges that arise from the end of single-market access.

zh: 这也许只是痴人说梦，但谁知道呢。
en: With this, the fantasy may have jumped the shark. But you never know.

zh: 被误导的欧洲投资狂热
en: Europe’s Misguided Investment Mania

zh: 布鲁塞尔—如今，在布鲁塞尔和整个欧洲广为流传的说法是经济复苏的关键在投资。
en: BRUSSELS – The mantra in Brussels and throughout Europe nowadays is that investment holds the key to economic recovery.

zh: 新欧盟委员会的经济战略核心是其正在开展的计划 — — 在未来三年增加3,150亿欧元投资。
en: The lynchpin of the new European Commission’s economic strategy is its recently unveiled plan to increase investment by €315 billion ($390 billion) over the next three years.

zh: 但欧盟委员会的方案是错误的，不管是其对投资的强调还是其所建议的融资结构。
en: But the Commission’s proposal is misguided, both in terms of its emphasis on investment and its proposed financing structure.

zh: 作为主席容克的新官上任三把火之一，欧盟委员会的计划在意料之中。
en: The Commission’s plan, the signature initiative of President Jean-Claude Juncker at the start of his term, comes as no surprise.

zh: 欧元区陷入了看不见尽头的衰退，强化增长的投资是可持续复苏的关键这一思想已经深深地植根于公共讨论。
en: With the eurozone stuck in a seemingly never-ending recession, the idea that growth-enhancing investment is crucial for a sustainable recovery has become deeply entrenched in public discourse.

zh: 基本假设是增加投资永远是件好事，因为它增加了资本存量，进而提振产出。
en: The underlying assumption is that more investment is always better, because it increases the capital stock and thus output.

zh: 此刻，在欧洲，未必如此。
en: This is not necessarily the case in Europe at the moment.

zh: 欧盟当局（和许多其他人）认为欧洲 — — 特别是欧元区 — — 受困于“投资缺口 ” 。
en: European Union authorities (and many others) argue that Europe – particularly the eurozone – suffers from an “investment gap.”

zh: 铁证就是相对于2007年，每年据信出现了4,000亿欧元投资。
en: The smoking gun is supposedly the €400 billion annual shortfall relative to 2007.

zh: 但这一比较具有误导作用，因为2007年时信用泡沫顶峰之年，这一信用泡沫导致了大量浪费投资。
en: But the comparison is misleading, because 2007 was the peak of a credit bubble that led to a lot of wasteful investment.

zh: 欧盟委员会在其支持容克的辅助文件中承认了这一点，并认为应该用信用繁荣前的年份作为当今合意投资水平的基准。
en: The Commission recognizes this in its supporting documentation for the Juncker package, in which it argues that the pre-credit-boom years should be used as the benchmark for desirable investment levels today.

zh: 根据这一标准，投资缺口只有原来的一半。
en: According to that measure, the investment gap is only half as large.

zh: 不幸的是，即使是繁荣前年份也不是今天欧洲经济的好指引，因为一个基本要素比通常认为的变化得更快：欧洲的人口趋势。
en: Unfortunately, even the pre-boom years are not a good guide for today’s European economy, because something fundamental has changed more quickly than is typically recognized: Europe’s demographic trends.

zh: 欧元区工作年龄人口一直保持增长至2005年，但从2015年将开始下降。
en: The eurozone’s working-age population had been growing until 2005, but it will fall from 2015 onward.

zh: 由于生产率一直没有上升，工人的减少意味着显著降低的潜在增长率。
en: Given that productivity has not been picking up, fewer workers mean significantly lower potential growth rates.

zh: 而更低的增长率意味着维持资本/产出比所需要的投资更少。
en: And a lower growth rate implies that less investment is needed to maintain the capital/output ratio.

zh: 如果欧元区保持繁荣前年份的投资率水平，其资本相对于经济的规模很快就会大大增加。
en: If the eurozone maintained its investment rate at the level of the pre-boom years, there would soon be much more capital relative to the size of the economy.

zh: 你也许会问，那又怎样？
en: One might be tempted to say: So what?

zh: 更多的资本永远是好事。
en: More capital is always good.

zh: 但是，资本存量相对于产出不断增加意味着不断降低的资本回报，假以时日，这将给银行部门带来更多的不良贷款。
en: An ever-increasing capital stock relative to output, however, means ever-lower returns to capital and thus ever more non-performing loans in the banking sector over time.

zh: 考虑到欧洲银行体系的脆弱性，积累过多资本可不是欧盟经受得起的奢侈品。
en: Given the weak state of Europe’s banking system, accumulating too much capital is not a luxury that the EU can afford.

zh: 姑且将更多是否永远更好的问题放在一边，容克的计划可以做些什么才能产生对总投资的短期积极影响？
en: Even setting aside the question of whether more is always better, what can the Juncker plan do to have a positive short-run impact on aggregate investment?

zh: 投资决定要素的学术研究的总体结论是，关键变量是增长（或增长的预期 ） ， 其次则是利率。
en: Academic research on the determinants of investment has generally concluded that the key variable is growth (or expectations of growth), and that interest rates play at most a secondary role.

zh: 当然，一个马上可以得到的推论是货币政策不可能对投资带来重大影响。
en: One immediate implication of this, of course, is that monetary policy is unlikely to have a strong impact on investment.

zh: 事实上，市场信号十分明确：眼下欧盟大部并不存在你融资短缺。
en: Indeed, the market signal is clear: At present, there is no shortage of funding available in most of the EU.

zh: 欧元区外围国也许仍处于信用稀缺状态，但它们只占欧洲经济的四分之一弱。
en: The countries on the eurozone periphery, where credit might still be scarce, account for less than one-quarter of Europe’s economy.

zh: 因此融资不足不是投资低迷的原因。
en: So a lack of funding is not the reason that investment remains weak.

zh: 据称容克的计划要用210亿欧元的欧盟资金撬动价值15倍于此（3,150亿欧元）的工程。
en: The Juncker plan is supposed to unlock, with €21 billion in EU funding, projects worth 15 times as much (€315 billion).

zh: 听起来很是飘渺。
en: That sounds far-fetched.

zh: 欧洲银行体系资本已经超过1万亿欧元。
en: Europe’s banking system already has more than €1 trillion in capital.

zh: 以欧盟预算担保的形式增加210亿欧元不可能大幅刺激银行为投资提供融资的意愿。
en: The addition of €21 billion, in the form of guarantees from the EU budget, is unlikely to have a significant impact on banks’ willingness to finance investment.

zh: 特别是，容克的计划目标是基础设施工程，这类投资通常比其他投资风险更高。
en: The Juncker plan targets, in particular, infrastructure projects, which are often riskier than other investments.

zh: 但这些��险往往不是金融上的；它们反映的是国家层面的潜在政治和监管壁垒。
en: But these risks usually are not financial; they reflect potential political and regulatory barriers at the national level.

zh: 这些问题不可能通过欧盟预算担保解决（欧盟预算担保无论如何不可超过工程价值的1/15 ） 。
en: These problems cannot be solved by a guarantee from the EU budget (which in any case could not be larger than 1/15th of the value of the project).

zh: 西班牙和法国电网之所以仍然不能很好地互通，原因不在缺少融资，而在于两边的垄断商不愿意开放市场。
en: The reason why there still is no good interconnection between the Spanish and French power grids is not a lack of financing, but the unwillingness of monopolies on both sides of the border to open their markets.

zh: 许多铁路和公路工程也是进展缓慢，原因在于地方反对而不是缺少融资。
en: Many rail and road projects are also proceeding slowly, owing to local opposition, not a lack of financing.

zh: 欧洲的基础设施投资面临实实在在的壁垒。
en: These are the real barriers to infrastructure investment in Europe.

zh: 欧洲大公司可以轻松地以近零利率获得融资。
en: Large European companies can easily obtain financing at near-zero interest rates.

zh: 号召增加投资永远具有吸引力。
en: Calling for more investment is superficially always attractive.

zh: 但有根本性理由认为欧元区的投资率将持久保持低水平。
en: But there are fundamental reasons to believe that the eurozone’s investment rate will remain permanently depressed.

zh: 时常被人提及的投资缺口主要来自想当然，依然存在的投资壁垒与缺少融资没有什么关系。
en: The often-invoked investment gap is mostly a result of wishful thinking, and the remaining barriers to investment have little to do with a lack of financing.

zh: 美国和英国的经济表现给欧元区提供了重要教训。
en: Economic performance in the United States and the United Kingdom holds an important lesson for the eurozone.

zh: 美国和英国的经济复苏主要都是由消费推动的，而消费又是依靠家庭负债表改善推动的。
en: Both economies’ recoveries have been driven largely by a pickup in consumption on the back of stronger household balance sheets, especially in the US.

zh: 美国尤其如此。 投资复苏随着消费增长恢复而到来。
en: The revival of investment has followed the resumption of consumption growth.

zh: 如果欧洲决策者真的想要经济复苏，就应该专注于消费而不是投资。
en: If European policymakers are serious about economic recovery, they should focus on consumption, not investment.

zh: 优化欧元区
en: Optimizing the Eurozone

zh: 东京—欧元区正面临暗淡的经济前景，增长依然停滞不前，通缩风险挥之不去。
en: TOKYO – The eurozone is facing a bleak economic outlook, with growth remaining stagnant and the threat of deflation looming large.

zh: 从一开始就对此保持怀疑的经济学家马丁·费尔德斯坦（Martin Feldstein）称之为“失败 ” 。
en: The economist Martin Feldstein, who was skeptical of the initiative from the start, now calls it a “failure.”

zh: 费尔德斯坦说对了吗？ 欧元能够成为创立者相信其能够成为的“最优货币区”吗？
en: Is Feldstein right, or could the eurozone become the “optimal currency area” that its creators believed it to be?

zh: 要回答这一问题，最重要的是理解不同汇率制度的利弊。
en: Answering this question requires, first and foremost, an understanding of the costs and benefits of various exchange-rate systems.

zh: 七十年前，国际货币基金组织（IMF）之所成立，是为了管理“可调整的盯住”制度。 这是一个混合制度，汇率通常情况下与美元保持固定汇率，但偶尔也可以调整以改善一国在出口市场中的竞争力。
en: The International Monetary Fund was established 70 years ago to manage an “adjustable peg” system – a hybrid system in which exchange rates were usually fixed to the US dollar, but could be adjusted occasionally to improve the country’s competitive position in export markets.

zh: 在最初几十年里，这一制度严重倾向于“盯住 ” ， 这是因为美元与黄金直接可兑换。
en: For the first few decades, this system leaned heavily toward “peg,” owing to the US dollar’s direct convertibility to gold.

zh: 这给全球货币秩序带来了巨大的稳定性，许多经济学家认为有害的20世纪30年代式的竞争性贬值一去不返。
en: This brought significant stability to the global monetary order, following the competitive devaluations of the 1930s that some economists considered damaging.

zh: 但固定汇率制度也不利于美国管理收支平衡。
en: But the fixed exchange-rate system also undermined the United States’ capacity to manage its balance of payments.

zh: 正因如此，1971年美国总统尼克松单方面放弃了美元与黄金的兑换性，主要货币汇率开始浮动。
en: That is why, in 1971, President Richard Nixon unilaterally abandoned the dollar’s convertibility to gold, leaving major currencies’ exchange rates to float against one another.

zh: 这套制度拥有重要优点 — — 最值得注意的是它使美联储能够向经济中注入货币以防止或停止衰退。
en: Such a system provides important advantages – most notably, it enables the US Federal Reserve to pump money into the economy to prevent or halt a recession.

zh: 但这也带来了巨大的风险，20世纪80年代所出现的贸易失衡就是明证。
en: But it also carries serious risks, exemplified in the trade imbalances that emerged in the 1980s.

zh: 1980至1985年，美元相对日本、西德、法国和英国货币升值了50 % ； 美国经常项目赤字接近GDP的3 % ； 而其最主要的四大竞争者出现了巨大的盈余和GDP负增长。
en: From 1980 to 1985, the US dollar appreciated by 50% against the currencies of Japan, West Germany, France, and the United Kingdom; America’s current-account deficit was approaching 3% of GDP; and its top four competitors had massive surpluses and negative GDP growth.

zh: 为了纠正这些失衡，五国签署了广场协定，同意干预货币市场以使美元贬值。
en: In order to correct these imbalances, the five countries signed the Plaza Accord, in which they agreed to intervene in currency markets to devalue the dollar.

zh: 欧元就是在这一背景下诞生的，其目标是通过扩大“本地”市场提振欧洲经济体、降低交易成本、促进信息流动。
en: It is against this background that the euro was born, with the goal of boosting European economies by expanding their “local” market, lowering transaction costs, and facilitating the flow of information.

zh: 1991年，对欧洲经济体来说，让出货币政策独立性似乎是划算的买卖，但如今看来这也许是一个错误。
en: In 1991, the loss of monetary-policy independence seemed like a worthwhile trade-off for Europe’s economies; today, it seems that it may have been a mistake.

zh: 事实上，美国在20世纪60年代的经验应该成为欧元区创立者的警告：束缚国家货币当局的双手也许并不是出色的主意。
en: In fact, America’s experience in the 1960s should have warned the eurozone’s creators that tying national monetary authorities’ hands might not be such a good idea.

zh: 若根据罗伯特·蒙代尔（Robert Mundell）的最优货币区概念操作（用劳动力和资本调整代替汇率调整，冲击将是同步的而非不对称的 ） ， 就不会如此。
en: That would not be the case if the eurozone operated according to Robert Mundell’s vision of an optimal currency area, with labor and capital adjustments replacing exchange-rate adjustment, and shocks being homogeneous (rather than asymmetric).

zh: 此外，德国重新统一的经验表明政治联盟才是货币联盟成功的关键。
en: Moreover, Germany’s experience with reunification suggests that political union is integral to such a union’s success.

zh: 欧元区的表现没有达到这些标准中的任何一个。
en: The eurozone’s performance has not met any of these criteria.

zh: 最令人注目的是，欧元区国家经受了巨大的不对称冲击，而缺乏独立货币政策机构意味着几乎无从应对。
en: Most notably, eurozone countries have faced powerful asymmetric shocks, to which their lack of independent monetary-policy instruments made it virtually impossible to respond.

zh: 结果，欧元区国家陷入了反复发作的经济危机。
en: As a result, they have struggled with recurring economic crisis.

zh: 要理解货币政策的正确力量，你只需要考察日本最近在摆脱几十年停滞方面所取得的进展。
en: To understand the corrective power of monetary policy, one need only consider Japan’s recent progress in escaping from decades of stagflation.

zh: 货币扩张是日本首相安倍晋三经济战略的三大关键部分之一 — — 该战略应该在多年前就采用以阻止日元急剧升值。
en: Monetary expansion was one of the three key features of Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s economic strategy – an approach that could have been implemented years ago to halt the yen’s sharp appreciation.

zh: 问题在于日本银行行长黑田东彦的前任似乎陷入了固定汇率制度的桎梏。
en: The problem was that Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda’s predecessors behaved as if they were bound by a fixed exchange-rate regime.

zh: 和日本不同，欧元区国家没有实施果断的货币政策措施并非它们的可选项。
en: Unlike in Japan, eurozone countries’ failure to implement bold monetary-policy measures is not a choice.

zh: 它们唯一可用的货币政策工具只有集体改变欧元相对外部国家的价值。
en: The only available monetary-policy tool is to change collectively the euro’s value relative to outside currencies.

zh: 但这一工具的使用有一个制约因素：个体国家对价格通胀或通缩水平的忍受力大相径庭。
en: But use of this tool is constrained by the wide discrepancies among individual countries’ appetite for inflationary or deflationary price levels.

zh: 平心而论，欧洲经济一体化 — — 有人会说，这一过程在欧元成立时达到了高峰 — — 也带来了显而易见的政治裨益。
en: To be sure, European economic integration – a process that, one might say, culminated with the eurozone’s establishment – also brought clear political benefits.

zh: 罗伯特·舒曼（Robert Schuman）在构思欧共体时承诺，一体化阻止了德国和法国之间再次爆发战争。
en: As Robert Schuman promised when he conceived the idea of a European Community, integration has prevented the recurrence of war between Germany and France.

zh: 但是否必要通过如此大规模的货币联盟实现这一目标仍可商榷。
en: But whether monetary union on such a large scale was necessary to achieve this goal is dubious.

zh: 无论如何，欧元区诞生了 — — 而时至今日，要想完全拆散它也是极其困难的。
en: In any case, the eurozone exists – and, at this point, it would be exceedingly difficult to dismantle it fully.

zh: 考虑到这一点，今天的目标应该是向最优货币区靠拢。
en: Given this, the goal today should be to move toward an optimal currency area.

zh: 首先，欧元区领导人必须认识到，欧元区目前的构成规模已经超过了欧洲最佳货币区。
en: For starters, Europe’s leaders must recognize that the eurozone, as it is currently constituted, is larger than Europe’s optimal currency area.

zh: 一些成员国 — — 希腊显然是，意大利和西班牙也许是 — — 需要独立的货币政策。
en: Some of its member countries – certainly Greece, and probably Italy and Spain – need an independent monetary policy.

zh: 否则它们将继续从一场危机走向领一场危机，而确实符合最优货币条件的国家 — — 比如德国和法国 — — 则需要收拾烂摊子。
en: Otherwise, they will continue to go from one crisis to the next, with countries that do fall within the optimal currency area – for example, Germany and France – facing the consequences.

zh: 在对欧元区成员资格做出优化后，下一阶段应该是确保朝向政治整合持续迈进。
en: Once membership in the eurozone is optimized, the next step will be to ensure continued progress toward political consolidation.

zh: 结果将是更强大、更有效的欧元区 — — 这个欧元区将利远大于弊。
en: The result will be a stronger, more efficient eurozone – one in which the benefits really do outweigh the costs.

zh: 欧洲的经济困境
en: Europe’s Economic Dilemma

zh: 坎布里奇—欧洲面临严重的问题。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Europe faces a serious problem.

zh: 尽管经济活动最近有所活跃，但欧元区已经丧失了应对下一次衰退的能力。 这是一个必然结果。
en: Although economic activity has recently increased, the eurozone has lost the ability to respond to the next downturn when it happens, as it inevitably will.

zh: 过去几年中所实现的经济改善应该归功于欧洲中央银行。
en: The European Central Bank deserves credit for the economic improvements that have occurred in the past few years.

zh: 在2014年怀俄明州的杰克森霍尔（Jackson Hole）央行行长年会的讲话中，欧洲央行行长德拉吉（Mario Draghi）说了三个能够改善欧洲经济表现的因素：
en: In a speech at the annual gathering of central bankers in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, in 2014, Mario Draghi, the ECB’s president, explained that three things could improve economic performance in Europe:

zh: 但德拉吉跟着预测，德国不会出现财政赤字，意大利和法国也不会实施必要的结构性改革。
en: But Draghi went on to predict that Germany would not create a fiscal deficit and that Italy and France would not undertake the needed structural reforms.

zh: 他下结论说，欧洲央行必须通过降息刺激增长。 降息能够让欧元更有竞争力，从而增加净出口。
en: He concluded that the ECB would have to stimulate growth by reducing interest rates, which would increase net exports by creating a more competitive euro.

zh: 此后，欧洲央行将短期利率下降到了负区间，即从2014年8月的0.2%下降到目前的-0.3 % 。
en: The ECB has since taken the short-term interest rate into negative territory, cutting it from 0.2% in August 2014 to -0.3% now.

zh: 欧洲央行还用自己的组合购买长期债券，将其持有量从2014年的2.2万亿欧元增加了一倍多。
en: The ECB also bought long-term bonds for its portfolio, increasing the volume of its holdings from €2.2 trillion ($2.6 trillion) in 2014 to more than double that amount now.

zh: 欧元-美元汇率从2014年的1.39美元下探至2016年1.04美元的低点，随后反弹到目前的1.18美元。
en: The euro-dollar exchange rate fell from $1.39 in 2014 to a low of $1.04 in 2016, before recovering to the current level of $1.18.

zh: 欧洲央行的负利率政策还刺激了商业投资和其他对借贷成本比较敏感的支出。
en: The ECB’s negative-interest-rate policy also stimulated business investment and other spending that is sensitive to borrowing costs.

zh: 但欧洲央行的政策也意味着它已经没有弹药可用来对付下一场衰退，这场衰退可能因为资产价格崩盘而引发，首当其冲的将是长期债券价格。
en: But the ECB’s policies also mean that it has no ammunition left to fight the next recession, which could be caused by a collapse of asset prices, starting with the price of long-term bonds.

zh: 德国十年期债券价格目前非常高，隐含收益率还不到0.5 % 。
en: German ten-year bond prices are extremely high, reflecting a current yield of less than 0.5%.

zh: 美国股票和债券价格的下跌 — — 目前也已经偏离了历史经验水平 — — 可能导致欧洲资产价格的同步下跌。
en: A fall in US stock and bond prices, which are also out of line with past experience, could cause European asset prices to decline in sympathy.

zh: 或者，欧洲出口可能因为亚洲或中东的地缘政治事件而下降，抑制欧洲的总体经济活跃度。
en: Alternatively, European exports could fall in response to geopolitical events in Asia or the Middle East, depressing overall economic activity in Europe.

zh: 美国扩张的结束 — — 目前这一扩张期已经持续到第九年 — — 可能拖累欧洲的需求。
en: An end to the US expansion, now in its ninth year, could pull down demand in Europe.

zh: 尽管美国经济目前表现出色，但资产价格水平过高 — — 这是十年来利率接近于零的结果 — — 严重威胁着稳定。
en: Although the US economy is now performing very well, the excessive level of asset prices – the result of a decade of near-zero interest rates – poses a threat to stability.

zh: 不管下一场衰退原因为何，在过去起到帮助作用的欧洲央行政策都不再可用。
en: Whatever the cause of the next downturn, ECB policies that helped in the past would no longer be available.

zh: 常规响应手段 — — 削减利率不再可能，因为当前欧元区国家短期利率已经接近于零或为负数。
en: The conventional response – reducing interest rates – is impossible, because current short-term interest rates in the eurozone countries are already near zero or negative.

zh: 诚然，欧洲央行可以扩大其长期债券购买量。
en: To be sure, the ECB could expand its purchases of long-term bonds.

zh: 但这样做无法产生和过去一样的效果。
en: But doing so would not have the same effect that it did in the past.

zh: 大规模购买债券，即所谓的量化宽松的目标之一是压低长期利率从而刺激商业投资和住房建设。
en: One of the goals of large-scale bond purchases – so-called quantitative easing – was to drive down long-term interest rates in order to stimulate business investment and housing construction.

zh: 目前，长期利率已经接近于零，购买债券无法进一步降低它们。
en: But with long-term interest rates now close to zero, bond purchases would not be able to lower them any further.

zh: 降低长期债券收益率的另一个目标是刺激股票需求。
en: Another goal of lowering the yield on long-term bonds was to stimulate demand for equities.

zh: 股价上涨降低了股权融资的商业投资的成本，也增加了家庭财富，从而刺激了消费。
en: Higher stock prices would lower the cost of equity-financed business investment and increase household wealth, thereby stimulating consumption.

zh: 在这一点上，欧洲一直不如美国成功，后者的股票所有权分布得更加广泛。
en: This was never as successful in Europe as it was in the United States, where share ownership is more widespread.

zh: 但如今，长期债券收益率已经接近于零，无法如法炮制。
en: But now, with long-term bond yields already close to zero, it could not even be tried.

zh: 简言之，欧洲央行无法再通过降低利率和购买长期债券来应对经济衰退了。
en: In short, the ECB would be unable to respond to an economic downturn by lowering interest rates and buying long-term bonds.

zh: 而如果失去了降低利率的能力，欧洲央行也将无法通过降低欧元价值来刺激净出口。
en: And without the ability to reduce interest rates, the ECB also would be unable to stimulate net exports by reducing the value of the euro.

zh: 美国可以用财政刺激应对新的衰退，但欧洲很难实现这一点。
en: Whereas the US could respond to a new downturn with fiscal stimulus, it is difficult to see how this could be achieved in Europe.

zh: 欧元区没有财政当局。
en: The eurozone has no fiscal authority.

zh: 当然，各成员国可以减税增支。
en: Each member country could of course reduce taxes and increase spending.

zh: 但这些刺激的大部分都将通过增加进口溢出到贸易伙伴国。
en: But much of the stimulus would spill over to the country’s trading partners through increased imports.

zh: 结果是国家国民债务增加，而国内需求相对来说几无变动。
en: The result would be an increase in the country’s national debt with relatively little increase in its domestic demand.

zh: 应对这一困境的一个合适的方案是协调性财政扩张政策。
en: An appropriate response to this dilemma may be a policy of coordinated fiscal expansion.

zh: 各国必须达成一致，根据经济衰退的规模采取联合减税和增加政府支出。
en: Each country would have to agree to a combination of tax cuts and increases in government spending scaled to the size of the economic downturn.

zh: 等到衰退发生再去规划这一协调响应措施将是一个错误。
en: Waiting until the downturn occurs to plan this coordinated response would be a mistake.

zh: 所有欧元区国家政府应该未雨绸缪地将与欧洲伙伴国的财政协调列为重点事项。
en: All eurozone governments should place fiscal coordination with their European partners high on their agenda, before it is too late.

zh: 逆转了的欧洲厄运循环
en: Europe’s Doom Loop in Reverse

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 在2011~2012年的欧元危机期间，欧元区曾经陷入过一场“厄运循环（doom loop ） ” — — 财政危机国的各个受灾银行都对信贷实施定量配给，导致经济衰退，进一步加剧了本已背负了救助银行损失责任的政府财政压力。
en: BRUSSELS – During the 2011-2012 euro crisis, the currency area became mired in a “doom loop,” in which weak banks in financially distressed countries rationed credit, causing a recession that intensified pressure on government finances, which were already burdened by the need to cover banks’ losses.

zh: 但这类自我强化型螺旋也可以朝着相反方向运动。
en: But such self-reinforcing spirals can also operate in the opposite direction.

zh: 而对这些动态的理解则可能是决定当今欧元区相对强弱势力的关键。
en: Understanding these dynamics may be the key to determining the eurozone’s relative strength today.

zh: 在厄运循环中，即使潜在的问题能够随时间得到应对，对违约的预期也会不断推高风险溢价直到经济濒临崩溃。
en: In a doom loop, the expectations of default drive up risk premia until the economy reaches the brink of collapse, even if the underlying problems could be managed over time.

zh: 而在某一特定时点上，当金融市场悲观情绪与经济现实之间差距过大时，市场就可能会出现逆转。
en: At a certain point, when the gulf between financial-market pessimism and economic reality becomes too large, the market becomes ready for a reversal.

zh: 2012年夏天的欧元区就是如此。
en: This was the case for the eurozone during the summer of 2012.

zh: 欧洲央行行长马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi ） “ 尽一切可能”来防止欧元瓦解的承诺之所以能如此有效地安抚市场，是因为投资者的恐惧主要基于 — — 用美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福的话说 — — “恐惧本身 ” 。
en: European Central Bank President Mario Draghi’s pledge to do “whatever it takes” to prevent the euro from disintegrating reassured markets so effectively because investors’ fear was largely based, to paraphrase US President Franklin D. Roosevelt, on “fear itself.”

zh: 德拉吉的干预标志着一个新周期的开始：厄运循环逆转并形成一个良性的信贷周期，低风险溢价令银行和政府可以以较低的利率实施再融资，为经济提供更多的信贷，从而推动经济复苏增加政府收入。
en: Draghi’s intervention marked the start of a new cycle: the doom loop reversed, and became a benign credit cycle in which lower risk premia allowed both banks and governments to refinance at lower rates, making more credit available to the economy and thereby fueling a recovery that increased government revenue.

zh: 以前陷入厄运循环的大多数欧元区国家政府都能够在无需进一步削减支出的情况下稳定公共财政。
en: Governments in most of the eurozone countries that had previously been stuck in the doom loop were able to stabilize public finances without further expenditure cuts.

zh: 但这一正面信贷周期并不像厄运循环那样明确可见，因为减少借贷者数量并推动经济陷入衰退的时间可比在信贷恢复供应时孕育经济复苏要短促得多。
en: But this positive credit cycle is less visible than the doom loop, because it takes a lot less time to cut the number of borrowers and push the economy into a recession than to foster a recovery when credit becomes available again.

zh: 即便原本周转困难的借贷者终于可以花钱和投资，他们也可能不会立马执行。
en: Even if over-stretched borrowers can spend and invest, they most likely won’t do so right away.

zh: 不过随着时间的推移，更宽松的信贷条件基本上都会产生一场复苏。
en: But, given time, easier credit conditions rarely fail to generate a recovery.

zh: 欧洲央行于2015年3月启动的大规模量化宽松计划也强化了这一良性循环。
en: The ECB’s vast program of quantitative easing (QE), initiated in March 2015, reinforced the virtuous cycle.

zh: 但事实上在宽松开始之前厄运循环就已逆转。
en: But the truth is that the doom loop had been reversed long before QE began.

zh: 无论如何，大家对该计划的定义 — — 由欧洲央行大规模购买各国政府债券 — — 是不准确的。
en: In any case, the common definition of that program – the large-scale purchase of government bonds by the ECB – is inaccurate.

zh: 这一关键决策会由欧洲央行总理事会作出，但其政策主要由各国中央银行去执行。
en: The ECB General Council makes the key decisions, but its policy is executed mostly by national central banks (NCBs).

zh: 通常情况下，欧元体系内所有国家的央行都采取同样的行动，并将行动结果汇聚在一起。
en: Normally, all NCBs in the euro system undertake the same operations, and the results are pooled.

zh: 但就量化宽松而言，每个国家央行都只是动用自身财力去购买本国政府债券。
en: But, when it comes to QE, each NCB buys only the bonds of its own government on its own account.

zh: 意大利银行只购买了意大利国债，而德意志银行也只购买了德国国债。
en: The Banca d’Italia has bought only Italian government bonds, and the Bundesbank only German Bunds.

zh: 这些央行只是各国更庞大公共部门的一部分，也会最终将这些交易产生的所有利润或损失转移回本国政府。
en: NCBs are part of their respective countries’ larger public sectors, and eventually transfer all of the profits or losses from these transactions back to their own government.

zh: 所以当它们购买长期政府债券时就类似一家大型企业的子公司去购买母公司债务一样（等于母公司向自身发行了短期债 ） 。
en: So when they purchase long-term government bonds, they are acting like a subsidiary of a large corporation buying the debt of its parent company (issuing short-term liabilities to itself).

zh: 简而言之，欧元区的量化宽松计划实质上是一项大规模资产负债管理工作，其中（国家）公共债务由公共部门的一部分（政府）重新配置到另一部分（国家央行 ） 。
en: In short, the eurozone’s QE program amounts essentially to a massive asset-liability management exercise, in which (national) public debt is reshuffled from one part of the public sector (governments) to another part (the national central bank).

zh: 虽然涉及金额极大 — — 迄今为止共计达2万亿欧元（折合2.44万亿美元 ） — —但实际影响却是微不足道的。
en: While the sums involved are very large – a total of about €2 trillion ($2.44 trillion) so far – the real impact is minor.

zh: 虽然欧洲央行声称自己的量化宽松计划对复苏作出了决定性的贡献。
en: Of course, the ECB claims that the QE program contributed decisively to the recovery.

zh: 但事实上，自债券购买启动以来利率或风险利差几乎都没有发生变化。
en: But the fact is that there has been little change in interest rates or risk spreads since the bond purchases started.

zh: 这表明量化宽松的停止 — — 可能在今年晚些时候 — — 并不意味着复苏的终结。
en: This indicates that the end of QE – which is likely to come later this year – will not mean the end of the recovery.

zh: 且由于金融市场已经知道量化宽松行将结束，它们也已经在对这一预期进行定价。
en: And, given that financial markets know that QE will end, they have already priced in that expectation.

zh: 但当前这一良性信贷周期能持续更久吗？
en: But can today’s benign credit cycle last much longer?

zh: 在此可能存在一些值得关注的理由；毕竟在2007~2008年全球金融危机之前欧元区也经历过一个类似的信贷宽松，增长，政府财政压力不大的自我强化周期。
en: There may be some reason for concern; after all, the eurozone experienced a similar self-reinforcing cycle of easy credit, growth, and little pressure on government finances before the global financial crisis of 2007-2008.

zh: 但当前周期似乎不可能导致类似的过度投机行为并以类似的爆破收场，因为欧元区外围国家的增长模式已经发生了很大变化。
en: But it seems unlikely that the current cycle will lead to similar excesses and end in a similar bust, because the growth pattern in the peripheral eurozone countries has changed considerably.

zh: 在危机前的信贷繁荣期，西班牙和葡萄牙等国的经济增长很大程度上依赖于国内需求，靠资本流入来支持。
en: During the pre-crisis credit boom, growth in countries like Spain and Portugal was based largely on domestic demand, financed by capital inflows.

zh: 意大利的国内需求不太旺盛，但依然需要低利率的外资来支撑庞大的公共债务。
en: In Italy, domestic demand was less exuberant, but foreign capital was still needed at the margin to finance a large public debt.

zh: 所以当资本流入突然停止，这些经济体立刻就陷入了危机。
en: So when capital inflows suddenly stopped, these economies were thrown into crisis.

zh: 而今这些国家的增长主要依靠出口，而国内需求依然疲软。
en: Today, however, growth in these countries is based mainly on exports, while domestic demand remains subdued.

zh: 此外，这些国家在经济增长率上升的同时保持了经常账户盈余；换句话说，它们远远不需要依靠反复无常的资本流入就可以偿还外债。
en: Moreover, these countries are maintaining current-account surpluses while their growth rates rise; in other words, far from relying on fickle capital inflows, they are repaying their external debt.

zh: 这个崭新也更强劲的增长模式可以持续到剩余的失业率被吸收掉。
en: This new, more robust growth model could be sustained until the remaining unemployment is absorbed.

zh: 没有一个金融周期能永远持续。
en: No financial cycle lasts forever.

zh: 但推动欧元区 — — 包括遭受危机冲击最严重的欧元区外围国家 — — 当前复苏的周期有可能会持续一段时间。
en: But the one driving today’s recovery in the eurozone, including the peripheral countries that were hardest hit by the crisis, may be set to persist for a while yet.

zh: 欧元区的隐藏优势
en: The Eurozone’s Hidden Strength

zh: 布鲁塞尔—多年来，欧元区一直被视为灾难地区，对于货币联盟未来的讨论往往以其可能解体为中心。
en: BRUSSELS – For years, the eurozone has been perceived as a disaster area, with discussions of the monetary union’s future often centered on a possible breakup.

zh: 去年，当英国投票脱离欧盟时，部分原因就在于英国人认为欧元区是一个无法正常运转 — — 并且可能已经无法挽回 — — 的工程。
en: When the British voted to leave the European Union last year, they were driven partly by the perception of the eurozone as a dysfunctional – and perhaps unsalvageable – project.

zh: 但最近，欧元区成了金融市场的“香饽饽 ” ， 其来有自。
en: Yet, lately, the eurozone has become the darling of financial markets – and for good reason.

zh: 欧元区的隐藏优势其实早就应该被发现。
en: The discovery of the eurozone’s latent strength was long overdue.

zh: 事实上，欧元区从2011—2012年危机中复苏已经持续了几年。
en: Indeed, the eurozone has been recovering from the crisis of 2011-2012 for several years.

zh: 用人均值衡量，其经济增长已经超过美国。
en: On a per capita basis, its economic growth now outpaces that of the United States.

zh: 失业率也在下降 — — 诚然比美国更慢，但这部分是因为劳动力参与率的不同导致的。
en: The unemployment rate is also declining – more slowly than in the US, to be sure, but that partly reflects a divergence in labor-force participation trends.

zh: 劳动力参与率在欧元区呈现上升之势，而在美国自从2000年左右以来一直在下降。
en: Whereas labor-force participation in the eurozone is on the rise, it has been declining in the US since around 2000.

zh: 美国人民远离就业市场反映了经济学家所谓的“沮丧的工人”现象。
en: The departure of Americans from the job market reflects what economists call the “discouraged worker” phenomenon.

zh: 事实上，这一趋势在2009年衰退以来有所加速。
en: And, indeed, the trend has accelerated since the recession of 2009.

zh: 理论上，劳动力参与率下降也应该成为欧元区的问题，因为许多欧洲工人长期以来都面临着非常高的失业率。
en: In principle, declining labor-force participation should be a problem in the eurozone, too, given the prolonged period of very high unemployment that many European workers have faced.

zh: 但是，在过去五年中，实际上有250万欧元区人加入了劳动力大军，而创造就业岗位数量达到了五百万，从而总体失业情况下降了一半。
en: But, in the last five years, 2.5 million people in the eurozone have actually joined the labor force, as five million jobs were created, reducing the overall decline in unemployment by half.

zh: 此外，有些出乎预料，即使在没有进行持续的财政刺激的情况下，欧元区的复苏也得到了维持。
en: Moreover, the eurozone recovery has been sustained, somewhat unexpectedly, even in the absence of continuous fiscal stimulus.

zh: 近几年来日益激烈的关于紧缩的讨论没有切中要害，批评者和官方支持者都高估了紧缩的实际规模。
en: The heated discussions about austerity of recent years have been misplaced, with both critics and official cheerleaders overestimating the amount of austerity applied.

zh: 自2014年以来，经周期调整的平均财政赤字基本一直保持在GDP的1%上下。
en: The average cyclically adjusted fiscal deficit has been roughly constant since 2014, at around 1% of GDP.

zh: 当然，个别成员国之间巨大的财政状况差异仍然存在。
en: Of course, large differences in the fiscal position of individual member states remain.

zh: 但在如此多样化的货币联盟中，这本是应有之义。
en: But this is to be expected in such a diverse monetary union.

zh: 真相是，即便是常常被认为是“劣等生”的法国，其赤字和债务水平也只是和美国等量齐观。
en: The truth is that even France, often considered a weak performer, has deficit and debt levels comparable to those of the US.

zh: 与美国还有日本的对比也可以反驳一个常见的感觉，即欧元区财政规则，包括大（臭）名鼎鼎的稳定与增长公约和2012年“财政契约 ” ， 是无关紧要的。
en: A comparison with the US, as well as with Japan, also undercuts the common perception that the eurozone’s fiscal rules, including the (in)famous Stability and Growth Pact and the 2012 “fiscal compact,” have been irrelevant.

zh: 诚然，没有国家因为赤字或债务过高而受到正是惩罚。
en: True, no country has been officially reprimanded for excessive deficits or debts.

zh: 但对略微越界的大呼小叫蒙蔽了人们对更大的基本趋势的关注：财政规则塑造了趋向可靠公共财政的趋势。
en: But the clamor over rule breaches at the margin has overshadowed the broad underlying trend toward sound public finances that the fiscal rules have fostered.

zh: 所有这些都表明，许多欧元区国家所采取的“软紧缩”是完全正确的选择。
en: All of this suggests that the “soft austerity” pursued in many eurozone countries may have been the right choice after all.

zh: 当然，我们不应该高估欧元区的长期经济优势。
en: To be sure, one should not overestimate the eurozone’s long-term economic strength.

zh: 未来几年，随着剩余失业人口得到吸收，以及年长劳动者重新加入劳动力市场的长期趋势维持下去，平均增长率有望继续维持在2%以上，但未利用劳动力最终会耗尽。
en: While the average growth rate might remain above 2% for the next few years, as the remaining unemployed are absorbed and the long-term trend of older workers rejoining the labor market continues, the pool of unused labor will eventually be exhausted.

zh: 一旦欧元区达到所谓的“刘易斯拐点 ” ， 即剩余劳动力耗尽，工资开始上升时，增长率将下降到能更好地反映人口动态的水平。
en: Once the eurozone has reached the so-called “Lewis turning point” – when surplus labor is depleted and wages start to rise – growth rates will fall to a level that better reflects demographic dynamics.

zh: 而这些动态并不十分动人：至少未来十年，欧元区工作年龄人口可能每年都会减少大约半个百分点。
en: And those dynamics aren’t particular desirable: the eurozone’s working-age population is set to decline by about half a percentage point per year over the next decade at least.

zh: 但即使到那时，欧元区人均增长率也不可能大大低于美国，因为它们之间的生产率增长率现在已经非常微小。
en: Yet, even then, the eurozone’s per capita growth rate is unlikely to be much lower than that of the US, because the difference in their productivity growth rates is now minor.

zh: 从这个角度讲，欧元区的未来更像是日本的现在，其特征是标题年增长率略高于1 % ， 通胀畸低，但人均收入增长与美国或欧洲相当。
en: In this sense, the eurozone’s future may look more like Japan’s present, characterized by headline annual growth of a little over 1% and stubbornly low inflation, but per capita income growth similar to that of the US or Europe.

zh: 对欧元区来说，幸运的是它进入这一高就业、慢增长的时期时步履很稳 — — 这部分要归功于充满争议的紧缩。
en: Fortunately for the eurozone, it will enter this period of high employment and slow growth on sound footing – thanks, in part, to that controversial austerity.

zh: 相反，美国和日本都面临着充分就业时财政赤字高于GDP的3%的情况 — — 大约比欧元区的水平高2—3个百分点。
en: By contrast, both the US and Japan are facing full employment with fiscal deficits higher than 3% of GDP – about 2-3 percentage points higher than those of the eurozone.

zh: 美国和日本的债务负担也更加沉重：美国债务-GDP之比为107 % ， 日本更是超过200 % ， 而欧元区为90 % 。
en: The US and Japan also have heavier debt burdens: the debt-to-GDP ratio stands at 107% in the US and more than 200% in Japan, compared to 90% in the eurozone.

zh: 有证据表明，在发生金融危机的情况下，如果政策无效 — — 比如因为名义利率已经位于零区间 — — 赤字支出可以起到不同寻常的稳定效果。
en: There is evidence that in the wake of a financial crisis, when monetary policy becomes ineffective – for example, because nominal interest rates are at the zero bound – deficit spending can have an unusually strong stabilizing impact.

zh: 但仍然有一个关键的未解决问题：一旦金融市场实现了正常化，长时间保持赤字是否能提供持续的刺激？
en: But there remains a key unresolved issue: once financial markets have normalized, will maintaining a deficit for a long time provide continuous stimulus?

zh: 欧元区复苏目前正在赶上美国，尽管没有进行任何持续的刺激，这一事实表明答案是否定的。
en: The fact that the eurozone’s recovery is now catching up with that of the US, despite its lack of any continuing stimulus, suggests that the answer is no.

zh: 事实上，欧元区的经验表明，尽管一致的财政刺激能在剧烈衰退时制造不同，当刺激不再不可或缺时退出刺激要比无限期地保持刺激更好。
en: Indeed, the experience of the eurozone suggests that while concerted fiscal stimulus can make a difference during an acute recession, withdrawing that stimulus when it is no longer vital is preferable to maintaining it indefinitely.

zh: 在紧缩情况下 — — 即等到衰退结束就降低赤字 — — 复苏可能需要更长时间来巩固；但一旦巩固了，经济表现就会更加稳定，因为政府账户此时处于可持续的状态。
en: With austerity – that is, reducing the deficit, once the recession has ended – recovery might take longer to become consolidated; but once it is, economic performance is even more stable, because the government’s accounts are in a sustainable position.

zh: 凯恩斯有一句名言 ： “ 长期看，我们都死了。
en: John Maynard Keynes famously said, “In the long run, we are all dead.”

zh: ”这也许是正确的，如果“长期”够长的话。
en: That may be true, on a long enough timeline.

zh: 但这绝不是放弃长期整合的借口。
en: But it is no excuse to dismiss longer-term considerations.

zh: 事实上，对欧元区来说，长期似乎已经到达 — — 而经济仍然生龙活虎。
en: In fact, for the eurozone, the long run seems to have arrived – and the economy is still alive and kicking.

zh: 不平等是如何推动欧元危机的
en: How Inequality Fueled the Euro Crisis

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 自2007~09年大衰退以来，大多数经济学家都开始将金融视为商业周期的关键驱动力，但对这一动力究竟如何运作方面还是缺乏全面的了解。
en: BRUSSELS – Since the Great Recession of 2007-2009, most economists have begun to regard finance as a key driver of the business cycle. But the precise dynamics are not yet fully understood.

zh: 例如芝加哥大学的阿米尔·苏菲（Amir Sufi）和普林斯顿大学的阿提夫·米安安（Atif Mian）认为信贷扩张会导致严重的经济衰退，因为一旦大量家庭不论出于何种原因而无法获得所需的融资来偿还债务，衰退就会席卷而来。
en: For example, the University of Chicago’s Amir Sufi and Princeton’s Atif Mian argue that credit expansion leads to nasty recessions, which emerge as soon as households, for whatever reason, lose access to the financing they need to roll over their debts.

zh: 但是这个论点忽略了一个关键因素，而欧元区危机则可以说明这一点。
en: But this argument misses a key factor, exemplified by the eurozone crisis.

zh: 欧元的创建伴随着大规模的金融自由化，包括取消资本管制并采用一个新的法律框架以允许任何欧洲银行在海外设立分支机构。
en: The creation of the euro was accompanied by large-scale financial liberalization, including the elimination of capital controls and the adaptation of the legal framework to allow any European bank to open branches abroad.

zh: 这一过程导致银行业竞争加剧，私营银行相对于公营银行的比例逐渐增加。
en: This process led to growing competition in the banking sector and a progressive increase in the ratio of private banks to public ones.

zh: 其结果是长期利率全面下降，信贷占GDP的比重上升。
en: The result was an across-the-board decline in long-term interest rates, and an increase in credit as a share of GDP.

zh: 几乎所有欧洲国家家庭负债率都有所上升，但这种信贷扩张对私人消费的影响在经常账户盈余增长的欧盟核心国家和赤字不断增大的外围地区之间则存在着根本性的差异。
en: European households almost everywhere became more indebted, but the impact of this credit expansion on private consumption was fundamentally different in the EU’s core countries, where current-account surpluses grew, and in the periphery, where countries accumulated deficits.

zh: 那么同样的信贷供给冲击为何会产生如此不同的反应？
en: Why did the same credit-supply shock produce such varied responses?

zh: 最近的一项研究表明，欧元区的金融自由化进程对外围国家转变要比核心国家更为深刻，前者的资本账户开放程度较低，公营银行相对私营银行数量较多，长期利率较高，同时信贷相对GDP的比例较低。
en: As a recent study shows, the eurozone’s financial-liberalization process amounted to a more profound shift for the periphery than for the core, with the former having had less open capital accounts, more public banks relative to private ones, higher long-term interest rates, and lower credit-to-GDP ratios.

zh: 同一项研究指出，在财政压力较大的外围国家，与自由化进程相关的主要期望在于那些过往无法获得信贷的人 — — 因收入较低或储蓄不足等原因 — — 如今可以借贷来支撑更多的消费。
en: The same study argues that in the more financially repressed peripheral countries, the main expectation associated with the liberalization process was that those who had previously lacked access to credit – say, because of low incomes or low savings – could now borrow, in order to finance more consumption.

zh: 换句话说，在改变各经济体的外部态势方面发挥了最大的作用的，其实是那些在不平等状况相对严重的外围国家中占据了大多数人口比例的低收入家庭。
en: In other words, it was low-income households – which represent a large share of the population in the relatively more unequal countries of the periphery – that played the largest role in changing their economies’ external positions.

zh: 相比之下，在欧元核心区，引入欧元的最初成果主要是更多更好的储蓄机会，其特点是风险/收益比率的改善。
en: In the eurozone core, by contrast, the initial upshot of the euro’s introduction was mainly more and better saving opportunities, characterized by improved risk-return trade-offs.

zh: 这方面的受益者大多是那些富有的家庭，比如这些家庭可以贷款进行长期投资，从而为未来 — — 而不是当下 — — 的消费进行融资。
en: This primarily benefited wealthy households, which could, for example, borrow to make long-term investments that would finance future, rather than current, consumption.

zh: 由于较高收入家庭在这些国家中所占比例较大（而这些国家的不平等程度也往往较低 ） ， 因此总消费额依然处于被抑制状态。
en: Because higher-income households comprise a larger share of the total in these countries (which also tend to have lower levels of inequality), aggregate consumption remained subdued.

zh: 随着1990年代不平等状况开始加剧 — — 尤其是德国 — — 这些家庭也变得更有动力去增加储蓄。
en: With inequality starting to rise in the 1990s – particularly in Germany – these households had all the more incentive to increase their savings.

zh: 在全球金融危机爆发后，外围和核心地区的上述对比趋势加剧，同时欧元区也陷入了衰退。
en: The contrasting trends in the periphery and the core were intensified after the global financial crisis erupted, and the eurozone entered recession.

zh: 在外围国家，首先被从劳动力市场驱逐出去的就是那些低收入群体。
en: In the periphery, low-skill groups were the first to be ejected from the labor market.

zh: 随着那些陷入困境的商业银行变得越发厌恶风险，这些挣扎求存的消费者再也无法靠借债来偿还债务以及为当前的消费融资，于是消费停滞，又加剧了衰退。
en: With troubled commercial banks more risk-averse, these struggling consumers could no longer borrow to roll over their debt and finance current consumption, which came to a halt, deepening the recession.

zh: 相比之下，核心国家的主要借款人都比较有钱，因此遭受的冲击也最少。
en: In the core countries, by contrast, the key borrowers were wealthy, and thus suffered the least.

zh: 就算确实遭到了负收入冲击，他们也可以利用储蓄作为缓冲。
en: If they did face negative income shocks, they could use their savings as a cushion.

zh: 因此，萧条的严重程度不单单是一列关于家庭债务水平的函数，更取决于债务在各收入层级上的分布。
en: So the severity of the bust was a function not simply of the level of household debt, but rather of the distribution of debt across income levels.

zh: 在某种程度上这是个好消息。
en: To some extent, this is good news.

zh: 由于外围已经经受过了最初的金融自由化冲击，未来的信贷供给事件也就不太可能对其造成过大的影响。
en: With the periphery having already endured the initial financial-liberalization shock, future credit-supply events are less likely to affect them disproportionately.

zh: 同时宏观审慎监管从国家层面转向欧盟的做法可能有助于进一步协调银行贷款行为，从而强化这一成果。
en: And the shifting of macroprudential regulation from the national level to the European Union may reinforce this outcome by further helping to harmonize bank-lending behavior.

zh: 但此处存在一个障碍：欧盟层面的金融监管仅限于大型系统重要性银行，因此那些小型本地银行向那些急不可耐的低收入消费者发放借款的业务不太会受影响。
en: But there is a snag: EU-level financial regulation is limited to the large systemic banks. As a result, it is unlikely to affect the operations of the small local banks lending small amounts to impatient low-income consumers.

zh: 加强欧元区财政危机抵御能力的最佳方式就是着眼于借贷激励措施。
en: The best way to strengthen eurozone financial resilience is to address borrowing incentives.

zh: 最好的办法是通过将欧洲的资源投资于教育和就业岗位质量的提升之上，从而改善低收入借款者的财务状况。
en: And the best way to do that is to improve the position of low-income borrowers by investing European resources in education and job quality.

zh: 即使在核心地区，机会均等状况的提升也可能会提高人们对未来的信心，从而降低预防性储蓄。
en: Even in the core, more equality of opportunity might improve morale, thereby reducing precautionary saving.

zh: 人力资本的升级以及机会均等的提升应该在欧盟下一个多年金融框架的谈判中发挥重要作用，而欧洲投资银行也可以对此提供支持。
en: Human-capital upgrading and more equality of opportunity should play a prominent role in negotiations over the EU’s next Multiannual Financial Framework, with the European Investment Bank possibly also providing support.

zh: 就目前而言，现有欧元区改革方案的公分母是构建一个银行联盟，许多人认为这个联盟的作用在于减少金融碎片化并打破银行与主权债务之间的恶性循环。
en: As it stands, the common denominator of existing eurozone-reform proposals is the completion of a banking union, which many believe is needed to reduce financial fragmentation and break the vicious circle between banks and sovereign debt.

zh: 这也是在6月份欧洲理事会会议召开前最有可能取得进展的领域。
en: This is the area where progress is most likely in the run-up to June’s European Council meeting.

zh: 而虽然建立银行联盟确实是积极的一步，但如果不去减少不平等状况的话，这就依然算不上是大功告成。
en: But, while a banking union would be a positive step, it will be incomplete without efforts to reduce inequality.

zh: 欧元区的改革生死关
en: The Eurozone Must Reform or Die

zh: 发自牛津 — — 随着法国的中间路线改革派新总统上台，同时德国总理默克尔的连任概率日渐增加，是否意味着陷入停滞的欧洲单一货币项目重燃希望？ 也许如此。
en: OXFORD – With the election of a reform-minded centrist president in France and the re-election of German Chancellor Angela Merkel seeming ever more likely, is there hope for the stalled single-currency project in Europe?

zh: 但在隔三差五的债务动荡的袭扰之下，我们更有可能面临又一个十年的低速增长。
en: Perhaps, but another decade of slow growth, punctuated by periodic debt-related convulsions, still looks more likely.

zh: 如果能财政和银行业联盟方面迈出坚实的一步，情况可能会有所改善；但在缺乏政策以强化稳定和可持续性的情况下，最终崩溃的可能性却要大得多。
en: With a determined move toward fiscal and banking union, things could be much better. But, in the absence of policies to strengthen stability and sustainability, the chances of an eventual collapse are much greater.

zh: 的确，在短期内有很多理由去保持乐观。
en: True, in the near term, there is much reason for optimism.

zh: 过去一年来，欧元区一直处于稳健的周期性复苏态势，且表现比其他主要发达经济体更超出预期。
en: Over the past year, the eurozone has been enjoying a solid cyclical recovery, outperforming expectations more than any other major advanced economy.

zh: 请记住：伊曼纽尔·马克龙的当选是一个具有里程碑意义的事件，令法国有机会充分重振其经济，以期能在欧元区治理中成为德国一个全面而对等的合作伙伴。
en: And make no mistake: the election of Emmanuel Macron is a landmark event, raising hopes that France will re-energize its economy sufficiently to become a full and equal partner to Germany in eurozone governance.

zh: 马克龙和他的经济团队都充满了有前景的想法，而他在国民议会中也拥有绝大多数席位来推行这些想法 — — 如果德国人能给予他一些预算赤字的空间来换取改革的话可能会有所帮助。
en: Macron and his economic team are full of promising ideas, and he will have a huge majority in the National Assembly to implement them (though it will help if the Germans give him leeway on budget deficits in exchange for reform).

zh: 而在西班牙，经济改革也正转化为更强势的长期增长。
en: In Spain, too, economic reform is translating into stronger long-term growth.

zh: 但整体来看就不甚乐观。
en: But all is not well.

zh: 在经历了史上最严重的衰退后，希腊经济的增长仍然停止，尽管那些指责在德国紧缩政策中的人显然没有看到下列数据：在左倾美国经济学家的鼓动下，希腊错过了或许是现代史上交换条件最轻柔的援助计划。
en: Greece is still barely growing, after experiencing one of the worst recessions in history, although those who blame this on German austerity clearly have not looked at the numbers: with encouragement from left-leaning US economists, Greece mismanaged perhaps the softest bailout package in modern history.

zh: 意大利比希腊好得多，但这只是一个言不由衷的赞美；实际收入事实上比10年前更低（但鉴于该国的地下经济规模极大，也很难确定 ） 。
en: Italy has done far better than Greece, but that is a backhanded compliment; real income is actually lower than a decade ago (albeit it is hard to know for sure, given the country’s vast underground economy).

zh: 对于南欧整体来，单一货币已被证明是一个金色的牢笼，一方面执行更为严苛的财政和货币政策，另一方面又剥夺了汇率这个抵受意外冲击的重要缓冲工具。
en: For southern Europe as a whole, the single currency has proved to be a golden cage, forcing greater fiscal and monetary rectitude but removing the exchange rate as a critical cushion against unexpected shocks.

zh: 事实上，自去年英国脱欧公投以来，英国经济（尚能）保持良好的一部分原因就是英镑大幅贬值提升了竞争力。
en: Indeed, part of the reason the United Kingdom’s economy has held up well (so far) since last year’s Brexit referendum is that the pound fell sharply, boosting competitiveness.

zh: 当然，英国当年也是大张旗鼓（且明智地）选择不去使用单一货币，即使现在正在（不太明智地）要从完全退出欧盟和单一市场。
en: The UK, of course, famously (and wisely) opted out of the single currency even as it is now moving (not so wisely) to withdraw from the European Union and the single market entirely.

zh: 现在我们可以相当明确地认识到，欧元不是实现欧盟伟业的必需品，也已被证明是一个巨大的障碍，正如许多身处大西洋这一侧的经济学家所预测的那样。
en: It is now fairly obvious that the euro was not necessary to the success of the EU, and instead has proved a massive impediment, as many economists on this side of the Atlantic had predicted.

zh: 欧盟官员长期以来都将欧洲一体化比作骑自行车：必须不断前进否则就要摔倒。
en: Eurocrats have long likened European integration to riding a bicycle: one must keep moving forward or fall down.

zh: 如果是这样的话，过早采用单一货币最好被视作是有大路不走，专门挑了条水泥未干的小道绕行。
en: If so, the premature adoption of the single currency is best thought of as a detour through thick, wet cement.

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，南欧各国原本欢迎欧元的主要原因在很大程度上是在1980~90年代，普通民众渴望能享有德国马克那样的的价格稳定。
en: Ironically, by far the main reason why euro adoption was originally so popular in Southern Europe was that back in the 1980s and 1990s, ordinary people longed for the price stability Germans enjoyed with their Deutsche Mark.

zh: 可尽管欧元推出后欧元区通胀率大幅下滑，但大多数区外国家也没有欧元的情况下成功压低了通胀。
en: But, while the euro has been accompanied by a dramatic eurozone wide fall in inflation, most other countries have managed to bring down inflation without it.

zh: 如果要实现价格稳定，更为重要的一点是现代独立央行的出现，正是这一机构帮助实现了全球通胀水平的大部降低。
en: Far more important to the achievement of price stability has been the advent of the modern independent central bank, a device that has helped dramatically reduce inflation levels worldwide.

zh: 虽然还有类似委内瑞拉等几个国家出现了三位数的通胀，但已经算是特例了。
en: Yes, a few places, such as Venezuela, still have triple-digit price growth, but they are now rarities.

zh: 如果不是加入欧元，只要意大利和西班牙简单地授予本国央行更多的自主权，那么今天的通货膨胀率也会很低。
en: It is very likely that if, instead of joining the euro, Italy and Spain had simply granted their central banks more autonomy, they, too, would have low inflation today.

zh: 虽然希腊的情况不太容易判断，但考虑到许多非洲穷国都能成功将通胀率保持在个位数以内，料想推测希腊也能如此。
en: Greece is admittedly a less obvious case; but, considering that many poor African countries have been able to keep inflation well within single digits, one can presume that Greece would have managed as well.

zh: 事实上，如果南欧国家保留自己的货币，他们可能永远不会沦为如此一个债务大坑，也可以选择利用通胀实现部分违约的选项。
en: Indeed, if Southern European countries had kept their own currencies, they might never have dug as big a debt hole, and would have had the option of partial default through inflation.

zh: 现在的问题是如何让欧盟摆脱这个泥沼。
en: The question now is how to maneuver the EU out of the wet cement.

zh: 虽然许多欧洲政客都不愿意承认，但现状可能是不可持续的；最终要么出现远大于当前规模的财政整合，要么在混乱中四分五裂。
en: Although many European politicians are loath to admit it, the status quo is probably not sustainable; eventually, there must be either significantly greater fiscal integration or a chaotic break-up.

zh: 如果有人觉得欧元不会在未来5~10年内面临进一步的实际压力测试（而不是更快爆发 ） ， 那就是太过幼稚了。
en: It is astonishingly naive to think the euro will not face further real-life stress tests over the next 5-10 years, if not sooner.

zh: 如果现状最终是不可持续的，那为什么市场竟如此极度淡定，以至于十年期意大利政府债券的利率只比德债高出不到两个百分点？
en: If the status quo is ultimately unsustainable, why are markets so supremely calm, with ten-year Italian government bonds yielding less than two percentage points more than Germany’s?

zh: 或许这点利差反映了投资者认定彻底救助方案最终会降临的信念，不管德国政客对此提出了多少反对声音。
en: Perhaps the small spread reflects investors’ belief that outright bailouts are eventually coming, however much German politicians protest to the contrary.

zh: 欧洲央行对周边国家债务的采购已经构成了一种隐性补贴，而发行欧洲债券的讨论也正随着马克龙的胜利而升温。
en: European Central Bank purchases of periphery countries’ debt already constitute an implicit subsidy, and discussion of Eurobonds is heating up with Macron’s victory.

zh: 或者也许投资者正在赌南欧各国已经泥足深陷无力回天。
en: Or perhaps investors are gambling that the South has walked too far into the cement to get out.

zh: 德国也将继续挤压这些国家的预算以确保德国银行的贷款能得到偿还。
en: Germany will just keep squeezing their budgets in order to ensure that its banks are repaid.

zh: 无论以哪种方式，欧元区领导人现在最好要行动起来，而不是坐等单一货币的下一个考验降临。
en: Either way, eurozone leaders would be better off taking action now, rather than waiting for the single currency’s next moment of truth.

zh: 而今天的乐观情绪究竟能持续时间，还是取决于马克龙和默克尔两人。
en: How long today’s optimism lasts is for Macron and Merkel to decide.

zh: 欧元可以修复吗？
en: Can the Euro Be Repaired?

zh: 巴黎—德国财政部长朔伊布勒最近将希腊退出欧元的选项摆上了台面，他希望释放一个信号，即，任何一个成员国都不能免于货币联盟严格纪律的约束。
en: PARIS – When Wolfgang Schäuble, Germany’s finance minister, recently tabled the option of a Greek exit from the euro, he wanted to signal that no member could abstain from the monetary union’s strict disciplines.

zh: 事实上，他的方案激发了关于作为欧元、欧元治理模式以及欧元存在理由基础的原则的大讨论。
en: In fact, his initiative triggered a much broader discussion of the principles underpinning the euro, its governance, and the very rationale for its existence.

zh: 在朔伊布勒方案提出前两周，欧洲领导人便已经注意到欧盟委员会主席容克及其来自其他欧盟机构的同事所撰写的关于欧元未来的报告。 但关于希腊的新争论让很多决策者认为有必要回归原始出发点。
en: Only a fortnight before Schäuble’s proposal, Europe’s leaders had barely paid attention to a report on the euro’s future prepared by European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker and his colleagues from the other European Union institutions.

zh: 与此同时，公民们则在质疑为什么他们要共用一种货币？
en: But the new dispute over Greece has convinced many policymakers of the necessity to return to the drawing board.

zh: 这样有意义吗？ 关于希腊的未来是否能形成一致？
en: Meanwhile, citizens wonder why they share this currency, whether it makes sense, and if agreement can be reached on its future.

zh: 货币就像是国家，建立它需要神话。
en: For currencies, as for countries, founding myths matter.

zh: 传统智慧认为，欧元时德国为了重新统一而向法国支付的政治代价。
en: The conventional wisdom is that the euro was the political price Germany paid for French acquiescence to its reunification.

zh: 事实上，德国重新统一只是20世纪80年代便已成型的、解决一个长期存在的难题的工程的最后一步。
en: In fact, German reunification only provided the final impetus for a project conceived in the 1980s to resolve a longstanding dilemma.

zh: 欧洲政府强烈反对浮动汇率，认为这与单一市场不相容；同时它们又不愿长期保留德国央行主导的货币机制。
en: European governments were both strongly averse to floating exchange rates, which they assumed would be incompatible with a single market, and unwilling to perpetuate a Bundesbank-dominated monetary regime.

zh: 一个建立在德国原则基础上的真正的欧洲货币似乎是最佳解决之道。
en: A truly European currency built on German principles appeared to be the best way forward.

zh: 事后看来，德国重新统一更多地是一个诅咒而非祝福。
en: In retrospect, German reunification was more a curse than a blessing.

zh: 当汇率在1999年被锁定时，德国处于高估状态，其经济十分困难；法国处于低估状态，其经济正在繁荣。
en: When exchange rates were locked in 1999, Germany’s was overvalued, and its economy was struggling; France’s was undervalued, and its economy was booming.

zh: 在此后的十年中，失衡逐渐在重新崛起的德国与因为低利率而导致信贷繁荣的国家之间形成。
en: During the ensuing decade, imbalances slowly grew between a resurgent Germany and countries where low interest rates had triggered credit booms.

zh: 而随着2008年全球金融危机的爆发，这些条件便成为完美风暴的温床。
en: And when the global financial crisis erupted in 2008, conditions were ripe for a perfect storm.

zh: 没人知道没有欧元欧洲会变成什么样。
en: No one can say how Europe would have evolved without the euro.

zh: 固定汇率制度会延续还是崩溃？
en: Would the fixed-exchange-rate system have endured or collapsed?

zh: 德国马克还会高估吗？
en: Would the Deutschemark have been overvalued?

zh: 各国会重新引入贸易壁垒、结束单一市场吗？
en: Would states have reintroduced trade barriers, ending the single market?

zh: 房地产泡沫会在西班牙兴起吗？
en: Would a real-estate bubble have developed in Spain?

zh: 政府改革会更多还是更少？
en: Would governments have reformed more or less?

zh: 建立反向分析基线评估欧元的影响是不可能的。
en: Establishing a counterfactual baseline against which the euro’s impact could be assessed is impossible.

zh: 但这绝不是自满的理由。
en: But that is no excuse for complacency.

zh: 在过去15年中，欧元区经济表现一直令人失望，其政治制度必须为此负责。
en: Over the last 15 years, the eurozone’s economic performance has been disappointing, and its policy system must answer for this.

zh: 真正重要的是共同欧洲货币对未来是否仍然重要。
en: What really matters is whether a common European currency still makes sense for the future.

zh: 这一问题常常被回避，因为退出欧元的成本高得无法想象（而如果欧元区解体发生在危机期间，并加剧参与国之间的互相倾轧，成本还会进一步提高 ） 。
en: This question is often evaded, because the cost of exiting is deemed too high to consider it (and could be higher still if the break-up takes place in a crisis and sharpens reciprocal acrimony among participating countries).

zh: 此外，废除欧元可能释放民族主义和保护主义的黑暗力量。
en: Moreover, pulling the plug on the euro could unleash the dark forces of nationalism and protectionism.

zh: 但是，牛津大学的凯文·奥洛克（Kevin O’Rourke）最近指出，这一观点并不充分。
en: But, as Oxford’s Kevin O’Rourke recently argued, this is hardly a sufficient argument.

zh: 在逻辑上，这等同于建议一对夫妇因为离婚成本太高昂而将婚姻保持下去。
en: It is the logical equivalent of advising a couple to remain married because divorce is too expensive.

zh: 那么，欧元仍然有意义吗？
en: So does the euro still make sense?

zh: 本来，人们期待欧元带来三大经济好处。
en: It was expected to deliver three economic benefits.

zh: 人们假设，货币联盟能促进经济一体化、巩固欧洲的长期增长。
en: Monetary union, it was assumed, would foster economic integration, bolstering Europe’s long-term growth.

zh: 相反，欧元区内部贸易和投资增长平庸，而增长潜力事实上还有所削弱。
en: Instead, intra-eurozone trade and investment have increased only modestly, and growth potential has actually weakened.

zh: 这部分是因为国家政府没有在货币统一的基础上更进一步，将欧元区建设成经济超级大国，而是试图保留它们剩下的权力。
en: This is partly because national governments, rather than building on currency unification to turn the eurozone into an economic powerhouse, tried to hang onto their remaining power.

zh: 这也许合乎��治逻辑，但在经济上一无是处：欧洲巨大的内部市场是其主要资产之一，因此决不能浪费加强内部市场的机会。
en: This was perhaps logical politically, but it made no economic sense: Europe’s huge domestic market is one of its main assets, and opportunities to strengthen it should not be squandered.

zh: 其次，人们希望欧元成为主要国际货币之一（特别是在考虑到极少有国家能满足必要的法律、市场和政策制度的情况下 ） 。
en: Second, it was hoped that the euro would become a major international currency (particularly given how few countries are equipped with the necessary legal, market, and policy institutions).

zh: 而根据最新的欧洲央行数据，这一希望已经基本实现。
en: And, according to recent ECB statistics, this hope has been largely fulfilled.

zh: 欧元的国际用途仅次于美元，这一成就有助于欧洲继续影响全球经济秩序而非沦为无关紧要的实体。
en: With international use of the euro behind only the US dollar, this achievement can help Europe to continue shaping the global economic order, rather than sliding into irrelevance.

zh: 第三，人们（不无天真地）认为作为欧元基础的机构能够改善经济政策的总体质量，好像欧洲整体政策水平天然就比国家政策水平高似的。
en: Third, it was (somewhat naively) believed that the institutions underpinning the euro would improve the overall quality of economic policy, as though Europe-wide policies would automatically be better than national ones.

zh: 2008年全球金融危机后，严峻的考验来临了：欧元区高估了危机的财政维度，低估了它的金融维度，因此其表现不如美国和英国。
en: The acid test came in the aftermath of the 2008 global financial crisis: because it overestimated the fiscal dimension of the crisis and underestimated its financial dimension, the eurozone performed worse than the United States and the United Kingdom.

zh: 如果欧元要带来繁荣，就必须进一步采取政策制度改革。
