en: If the euro is to create prosperity, further reforms of the policy system are therefore needed.

zh: 但制定和实施一套日程必须有对问题性质的广泛一致的认识。
en: But an agenda can be designed and implemented only if there is a broad consensus on the nature of the problem.

zh: 而希腊问题上的持续争论表明，欧洲距离达成一致尚远：参与国对于债务危机的根源的分析彼此矛盾，于是开出的药方也彼此矛盾。
en: And, as the ongoing dispute over Greece illustrates, agreement remains elusive: Participating countries have developed contradictory analyses of the causes of the debt crisis, from which they derive contradictory prescriptions.

zh: 哈佛大学的理查德·库珀（Richard Cooper）曾经观察到，在国际公共卫生合作的早期阶段，对全球疾病的治理因为各国存在不同的传染模式而大受掣肘。
en: Richard Cooper of Harvard University once observed that in the early days of international public health cooperation, the fight against global diseases was hampered by countries’ adherence to different models of contagion.

zh: 各国都青睐联合行动，但无法形成一致计划，因为它们对于传染病如何从一国传染到另一国意见不一。
en: They all favored joint action, but they could not agree on a plan, because they disagreed on how epidemics crossed borders.

zh: 这就是欧元区今天面临的问题。
en: That is the problem the eurozone faces today.

zh: 幸运的是，这个问题不是无法解决的，成立欧洲稳定性机制（European Stability Mechanism ） 、 启动银行联盟等重大改革已经证明了这一点。
en: Fortunately, it is not unsolvable, as significant reforms like the creation of the European Stability Mechanism and the launch of banking union show.

zh: 不一致也没有阻止欧洲央行采取果断行动，这表明机构治理确实很重要。
en: Disagreements also did not prevent the ECB from acting boldly, which illustrates that the governance of institutions does matter.

zh: 但改革和行动直到最近才开始，并且是在严重危机的压力下才实施，这一事实让问们清醒地认识到达成共识的困难性。
en: But the fact that reforms and actions were undertaken only lately, and under the pressure of acute crisis, is a sobering reminder of the difficulty of reaching consensus.

zh: 欧洲不能再拖延和装模作样了。
en: Europe cannot afford to procrastinate and pretend.

zh: 欧元区成员国必须形成一套关于治理和政治改革的一致日程，将货币联盟变成繁荣的引擎，否则就只能在反复的争论和危机中沉沦下去，直到公民失去耐心或市场失去信任。
en: Either the eurozone’s members find agreement on an agenda of governance and political reforms that will turn the currency union into an engine of prosperity, or they will stumble repeatedly from dispute to crisis, until citizens lose patience or markets lose trust.

zh: 明确性是严肃讨论和宏大改革的前提。
en: Clarity is a prerequisite of serious discussion and ambitious reform.

zh: 如今，所有主要参与方都有义务明确什么是它们看来不可缺少的，什么是它们不可接受的，什么是准备用来交换它们想要的东西的。
en: Each of the major participants now has an obligation to define what it regards as indispensable, what it considers unacceptable, and what it is ready to give in exchange for what it wants.

zh: 欧元区改革会有助于遏制特朗普吗？
en: Can Eurozone Reform Help Contain Trump?

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 美国总统特朗普正在利用经济战来实现其外交政策目标。
en: BRUSSELS – US President Donald Trump is using economic warfare to pursue his foreign-policy objectives.

zh: 8月，他的政府宣布将土耳其进口钢铁和铝的关税提高一倍以迫使土耳其当局释放一名因间谍罪被囚禁两年的美国牧师，此外在下个月初还将加大对伊朗的单方面制裁力度。
en: In August, his administration announced that it would double tariffs on steel and aluminum imports from Turkey, in order to pressure the Turkish authorities to release an American pastor detained for two years on espionage charges. At the beginning of next month, the United States will also ratchet up unilateral sanctions against Iran.

zh: 特朗普政府知道美国经济杠杆的一个主要来源是美元作为世界主要储备货币的角色。
en: The Trump administration knows that a key source of US economic leverage is the dollar’s role as the world’s dominant reserve currency.

zh: 因此如果要削弱美国破坏全球经济稳定的多大权力就要减少以美元进行的国际贸易份额。
en: Countering America’s disproportionate power to destabilize the global economy thus requires reducing the share of international trade conducted in dollars.

zh: 俺么欧元可以成为可靠的替代品吗？
en: Can the euro serve as a credible alternative?

zh: 欧元虽是世界第二大货币，但仍远远落后于美元。
en: The euro is the world’s second-leading currency, but it still lags far behind the US dollar.

zh: 全球各地银行以外币发行的所有贷款中有2/3以美元计价，而欧元仅为20 ％ ， 在全球外汇储备上大概也是如此。
en: Two-thirds of all loans issued by local banks in foreign currencies are denominated in dollars, compared to just 20% in euros. Similar proportions apply to global foreign-exchange reserves.

zh: 欧盟委员会主席让-克劳德·容克（Jean-Claude Juncker）渴望改变这种现状。
en: European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker is eager to change this.

zh: 上个月，他宣称“欧洲每年80％的能源进口费用 — — 相当于3000亿欧元 — — 都用美元支付”的做法是“荒谬的 ” （ 同时只有约2％的能源来自美国 ） 。
en: Last month, he declared it “absurd” that “Europe pays for 80% of its energy import bill – worth €300 billion a year – in US dollars,” even though only about 2% of the EU’s energy imports come from the US.

zh: 为此他呼吁将欧元打造为“一个新的、更具主权意义的欧洲的工具 ” ， 并承诺要“推出一些加强欧元国际作用的举措 ” 。
en: He then called for the euro to become “the instrument of a new, more sovereign Europe,” and promised to “present initiatives to strengthen the international role of the euro.”

zh: 而容克也不是唯一一个认识到单一货币在投射实力方面具备强大作用的欧洲领导人。
en: Juncker is not alone among European leaders in recognizing how powerful a tool the single currency can be when it comes to projecting power.

zh: 德国外交部长海科·马斯（Heiko Maas）就提议欧盟建立自己的国际支付体系。
en: German Foreign Minister Heiko Maas has proposed that the European Union establish its own international payments system.

zh: 但这些建议虽然极富雄心，却可能会忽略提升欧元地位所真正需要做到的事。
en: But these proposals, while ambitious, may overlook what is really needed to elevate the euro’s status.

zh: 如果欧元在国际贸易中的作用得以提升，外国企业持有的欧元计价资产以及欧元计价贷款总额也会增加。
en: If the euro’s role in international trade increased, so would foreign companies’ holdings of euro-denominated assets and the total volume of euro-denominated loans.

zh: 而更多的欧元全球贸易可能导致外国银行系统严重暴露于该货币的风险之下。
en: More global trade in euros could lead foreign banking systems to become heavily exposed to the currency.

zh: 这意味着在发生危机时欧洲央行将不得不美联储过去所做的那样采取行动。
en: That means that, in the event of a crisis, the European Central Bank would have to take action, much as the US Federal Reserve has done in the past.

zh: 在2008年全球金融危机期间，美联储成为事实上的全球最后贷款者，不但同意与欧洲央行和瑞士国家银行等储备货币中央银行建立无担保货币互换额度，还与墨西哥和巴西等新兴经济体达成了类似协议。
en: During the 2008 global financial crisis, the Fed served as de facto global lender of last resort, agreeing to unsecured swap lines not only with reserve-currency central banks like the ECB and the Swiss National Bank, but also with emerging economies like Mexico and Brazil.

zh: 这样做的目标是稳定全球经济，但这些流动性也有助于防止外国出售美元资产干扰国内经济，同时防止外国银行抢购美元。
en: The goal was to stabilize the global economy, but the liquidity also helped to prevent domestic disturbances from foreign sales of dollar assets and to stop foreign banks from scrambling to buy dollars.

zh: 而欧洲央行在这方面则更为保守。
en: The ECB adopted a much more restrictive approach.

zh: 2008年底，它开始向匈牙利，拉脱维亚和波兰央行提供欧元，但要求它们以欧元计价的证券作为抵押品。
en: In late 2008, it began to provide euros to the central banks of Hungary, Latvia, and Poland, but required them to put up euro-denominated securities as collateral.

zh: 欧洲央行希望保护其资产负债表免受匈牙利福林或波兰兹罗提的无担保风险。
en: The ECB wanted to guard its balance sheet against unsecured exposure to Hungarian forint or Polish złoty.

zh: 但这些国家持有的合要求证券太少，根本无法根据欧洲央行的初始条款获得足够的欧元。
en: But these countries held too few eligible securities to obtain enough euros under the ECB’s initial terms.

zh: 在奥地利和其他国家的压力下，欧洲央行又花了一年时间才与匈牙利和波兰央行最终建立适当的外汇抵押品货币互换额度。
en: It took another year for the ECB, under pressure from Austria and other countries, to establish proper swap lines against foreign-currency collateral with the Hungarian and Polish central banks.

zh: 即便到了现在，欧洲央行也只会向被认为与欧元区系统相关的国家提供欧元流动性。
en: Even now, the ECB will provide euro liquidity only to countries considered systemically relevant for the eurozone.

zh: 这种规避风险的做法与美联储的做法形成了鲜明对比，也与中国人民银行的做法大相径庭，后者近年来建立了广泛的货币互换网络以促进人民币在贸易中的应用 — — 以及其作为国际货币的地位。
en: This risk-averse approach contrasts with that of the Fed and, more tellingly, with that of the People’s Bank of China, which in recent years has established an extensive network of swap lines to promote the renminbi’s use in trade – and thus its standing as an international currency.

zh: 如果要实现容克的愿景，欧洲央行将不得不放弃这种狭隘的心态，并承担美联储式的国际最后贷款者角色。
en: If Juncker’s vision is to be realized, the ECB will have to abandon this parochial mindset and adopt a Fed-style role as international lender of last resort.

zh: 然而目前尚不清楚欧洲央行是否真心愿意将其部分资产负债表置于非欧元区国家经济走势的影响之下。
en: Yet it remains unclear whether the ECB actually would be willing to leave part of its balance sheet exposed to the fate of non-eurozone countries.

zh: 欧洲央行有充分的理由趋保持谨慎：它缺乏类似于美国财政部长这样的美联储政治对手。
en: The ECB has good reason to be cautious: it lacks a political counterpart akin to the Fed’s US Treasury Secretary.

zh: 由于缺乏欧元区财政部长在危机时期与之协调，当欧洲央行决定帮助第三国 — — 甚至欧盟国家 — — 的时候就可能遭遇强烈阻力。
en: With no eurozone finance minister with whom to coordinate in times of crisis, a decision by the ECB to help third countries – even EU countries – could be met with strong resistance.

zh: 对此欧洲央行不愿与匈牙利建立货币互换可能就是一个例子：匈牙利已经远离了欧盟。
en: The ECB’s reluctance to establish a swap line with Hungary may be a case in point: Hungary was already distancing itself from the EU.

zh: 最后欧洲央行确实已经决定要“不惜一切代价”拯救欧元。
en: Eventually, the ECB did resolve to do “whatever it takes” to save the euro.

zh: 但如果欧洲领导人希望通过提升欧元的国际地位来推进容克加强欧盟主权的愿景，那么他们就不能依赖欧洲央行在缺乏适当制度支持的情况下按照老一套行事。
en: But if European leaders want to advance Juncker’s vision of strengthening EU sovereignty by boosting the euro’s international role, they cannot rely on the ECB to repeat that approach, without proper institutional support.

zh: 相反，欧元区领导人应该完成货币联盟架构的改革，并为欧洲央行提供一个支持货币政策中央集权的政治对手。
en: Instead, eurozone leaders should complete the reforms of the currency union’s architecture and provide a political counterpart to the ECB that would support centralized monetary policy.

zh: 这是对特朗普经济攻击的最佳初步回应，而其他的做法都只是再一次的本末倒置而已。
en: This is the best initial response to Trump’s economic attacks. Anything else would be putting the cart before the horse – yet again.

zh: 欧元区主权债务的新方法
en: A New Approach to Eurozone Sovereign Debt

zh: 雅典—希腊公共债务又回到了欧洲日程上。
en: ATHENS – Greece’s public debt has been put back on Europe’s agenda.

zh: 事实上，这也许是希腊政府在与其债权人为期五个月的痛苦的僵局中所取得的主要成就。
en: Indeed, this was perhaps the Greek government’s main achievement during its agonizing five-month standoff with its creditors.

zh: 在多年的“延期和假装”后，今天，几乎所有人都同意债务重组必不可少。
en: After years of “extend and pretend,” today almost everyone agrees that debt restructuring is essential.

zh: 最重要的是，不仅仅希腊是如此。
en: Most important, this is true not just for Greece.

zh: 2月，我想欧元集团（Eurogroup，由欧元区成员国财政部长组成）提出了一份选择清单，包括查尔斯·古德哈特（Charles Goodhart）最近在《金融时报》撰文支持的 GDP指数债券、清算欧洲央行账上遗留债务的永续债券等。
en: In February, I presented to the Eurogroup (which convenes the finance ministers of eurozone member states) a menu of options, including GDP-indexed bonds, which Charles Goodhart recently endorsed in the Financial Times, perpetual bonds to settle the legacy debt on the European Central Bank’s books, and so forth.

zh: 我们希望，如今，在希腊进一步滑向破产深渊之前，让这些方案站稳脚跟的基础已有所加强。
en: One hopes that the ground is now better prepared for such proposals to take root, before Greece sinks further into the quicksand of insolvency.

zh: 但更有趣的问题是所有这些对作为整体的欧元区的意义。
en: But the more interesting question is what all of this means for the eurozone as a whole.

zh: 约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stigltiz ） 、 杰弗里·萨克斯（Jeffrey Sachs）和其他许多人颇有先见之明地呼吁改良一个不同的针对一般需要的主权债务的方针，以适应欧元区危机的特殊性质。
en: The prescient calls from Joseph Stiglitz, Jeffrey Sachs, and many others for a different approach to sovereign debt in general need to be modified to fit the particular characteristics of the eurozone’s crisis.

zh: 欧元区是一个独特的货币区：其央行缺少一个支持其决定的国家，而其成员国缺少一个在困难时期支持它们的央行。
en: The eurozone is unique among currency areas: Its central bank lacks a state to support its decisions, while its member states lack a central bank to support them in difficult times.

zh: 欧洲领导人试图用复杂而不可信的规则修补这一制度缺陷，这套规则常常无法形成约束力，而尽管存在这一缺陷，它最终仍对有需要的成员国形成了巨大的制约。
en: Europe’s leaders have tried to fill this institutional lacuna with complex, non-credible rules that often fail to bind, and that, despite this failure, end up suffocating member states in need.

zh: 规则之一是马斯特里赫特条约将成员国的公共债务水平限定在GDP的60%以下。
en: One such rule is the Maastricht Treaty’s cap on member states’ public debt at 60% of GDP.

zh: 另一个规则是马约的“无援助”条款。
en: Another is the treaty’s “no bailout” clause.

zh: 大部分成员国，包括德国，都违反过第一个规则（不管是暗中还是明里 ） ， 而第二个规则有好几次通过昂贵的融资方案得以维持。
en: Most member states, including Germany, have violated the first rule, surreptitiously or not, while for several the second rule has been overwhelmed by expensive financing packages.

zh: 欧元区债务重组存在的问题是它很重要，与此同时，它与作为货币联盟基础的隐含宪法不一致。
en: The problem with debt restructuring in the eurozone is that it is essential and, at the same time, inconsistent with the implicit constitution underpinning the monetary union.

zh: 当经济考量与一套制度的规则冲突时，决策者必须要么找出创新方法修改规则，要么眼睁睁看着他们创造出来的东西轰然倒塌。
en: When economics clashes with an institution’s rules, policymakers must either find creative ways to amend the rules or watch their creation collapse.

zh: 而关于重订规则、强化它们的精神以及解决其根本性经济问题，斯图尔特·荷兰（Stuart Holland）和詹姆斯·加尔布雷斯（James K. Galbraith）合著的《解决欧元危机的温和方案 》 （ A Modest Proposal for Resolving the Euro Crisis）中提出了一个观点。
en: Here, then, is an idea (part of A Modest Proposal for Resolving the Euro Crisis, co-authored by Stuart Holland, and James K. Galbraith) aimed at re-calibrating the rules, enhancing their spirit, and addressing the underlying economic problem.

zh: 简单说，欧洲央行可以在明天早上宣布，从今以后它将推出一个债务转换计划，任何成员国都可以参加。
en: In brief, the ECB could announce tomorrow morning that, henceforth, it will undertake a debt-conversion program for any member state that wishes to participate.

zh: 欧洲央行将为所有到期政府债券的一定比例（与马约规则所允许的成员国公共债务百分比一致）偿付利息（而不是购买 ） 。
en: The ECB will service (as opposed to purchase) a portion of every maturing government bond corresponding to the percentage of the member state’s public debt that is allowed by the Maastricht rules.

zh: 因此，对于（比如）债务-GDP比率为120%和90%的成员国，欧洲央行将分别为50%和66.7%的所有到期政府债务付息。
en: Thus, in the case of member states with debt-to-GDP ratios of, say, 120% and 90%, the ECB would service, respectively, 50% and 66.7% of every maturing government bond.

zh: 为了为一些成员国的赎回操作融资，欧洲央行将以自身名义发行债券，该债券完全由欧洲央行担保，但由该成员国负责足额偿付。
en: To fund these redemptions on behalf of some member states, the ECB would issue bonds in its own name, guaranteed solely by the ECB, but repaid, in full, by the member state.

zh: 在发行这一欧洲央行债券时，欧洲央行同时将为其代为发行债券的成员国开立借方账户。
en: Upon the issue of such an ECB bond, the ECB would simultaneously open a debit account for the member state on whose behalf it issued the bond.

zh: 该成员国将承担法律义务将存款存入该账户偿还欧洲央行债券的息票和本金。
en: The member state would then be legally obliged to make deposits into that account to cover the ECB bonds’ coupons and principal.

zh: 此外，该成员国对欧洲央行的负债将享受超国家待遇，由欧洲稳定性机制（European Stability Mechanism）提供硬违约风险保险。
en: Moreover, the member state’s liability to the ECB would enjoy super-seniority status and be insured by the European Stability Mechanism against the risk of a hard default.

zh: 这一债务转换计划能提供五个好处。
en: Such a debt-conversion program would offer five benefits.

zh: 首先，与欧洲央行目前的量化宽松不同，它没有将债务货币化。
en: For starters, unlike the ECB’s current quantitative easing, it would involve no debt monetization.

zh: 因此不存在导致资产价格泡沫的风险。
en: Thus, it would run no risk of inflating asset price bubbles.

zh: 其次，该计划将大大降低欧元区总利息偿付。
en: Second, the program would cause a large drop in the eurozone’s aggregate interest payments.

zh: 欧元区成员国主权债务中与马约相符的部分将以更长的期限（等于欧洲央行债券期限）和只有欧洲央行可以在国际资本市场上获得的极低利率得到重组。
en: The Maastricht-compliant part of its members’ sovereign debt would be restructured with longer maturities (equal to the maturity of the ECB bonds) and at the ultra-low interest rates that only the ECB can fetch in international capital markets.

zh: 第三，德国的长期利率不会受到影响，因为德国既不需要担保该债务转换机制，也不需要支持欧洲央行的债券发行。
en: Third, Germany’s long-term interest rates would be unaffected, because Germany would neither be guaranteeing the debt-conversion scheme nor backing the ECB’s bond issues.

zh: 第四，关于公共债务的马约规则精神得到了执行，道德风险也得到了降低。
en: Fourth, the spirit of the Maastricht rule on public debt would be reinforced, and moral hazard would be reduced.

zh: 毕竟，该计划将极大地增加与马约相容的债务和留在成员国手中的债务（此前这些债务是不允许积累的）之间的利率差。
en: After all, the program would boost significantly the interest-rate spread between Maastricht-compliant debt and the debt that remains in the member states’ hands (which they previously were not permitted to accumulate).

zh: 最后，GDP指数债券和其他应对不可持续的债务的明智工具将只适用于成员国不受该计划覆盖的债务，并符合主权债务管理的国际最佳实践。
en: Finally, GDP-indexed bonds and other tools for dealing sensibly with unsustainable debt could be applied exclusively to member states’ debt not covered by the program and in line with international best practices for sovereign-debt management.

zh: 解决欧元危机最显而易见的方案是联邦方案。
en: The obvious solution to the euro crisis would be a federal solution.

zh: 但一场地让一个骄傲的国家与另一个骄傲的国家对立起来的悲剧让联邦方案的可能性变得更小而不是更大。
en: But federation has been made less, not more, likely by a crisis that tragically set one proud nation against another.

zh: 事实上，欧元集团今天可能支持的任何政治联盟必然是雷厉风行而效果甚微的。
en: Indeed, any political union that the Eurogroup would endorse today would be disciplinarian and ineffective.

zh: 与此同时，欧元区 — — 而不仅仅是希腊 — — 所迫切需要的债务重组在当前的气候下在政治上必然行不通。
en: Meanwhile, the debt restructuring for which the eurozone – not just Greece – is crying out is unlikely to be politically acceptable in the current climate.

zh: 但有办法聪明地重组债务而不给纳税人造成任何负担，并且还能让欧洲更加团结。
en: But there are ways in which debt could be sensibly restructured without any cost to taxpayers and in a manner that brings Europeans closer together.

zh: 一个步骤便是本文所提出的债务转换方案。
en: One such step is the debt-conversion program proposed here.

zh: 实施这一方案有助于治疗欧洲的伤口，为欧盟所需要的关于欧洲人应该获得什么样的政治联盟的争论扫清道路。
en: Taking it would help to heal Europe’s wounds and clear the ground for the debate that the European Union needs about the kind of political union that Europeans deserve.

zh: 欧元区仍然脆弱
en: The Eurozone is Still Vulnerable

zh: 布鲁塞尔—尽管最近总体经济呈现好转之势，欧元区仍然十分脆弱，远远没有摆脱另一场危机的风险。
en: BRUSSELS – Despite recently experiencing an overall economic uptick, the eurozone remains fragile and uninsured against the risk of another crisis.

zh: 一个主要原因是它仍然极易发生不对称的枯荣循环。
en: And a major reason is that it is still vulnerable to asymmetric boom-and-bust cycles.

zh: 简言之，所有欧元区成员国都能从景气时期获益，但一些国家在萧条期所受到的伤害要远大于其他国家。
en: Simply put, while all eurozone members can benefit during good times, some suffer far more than others during busts.

zh: 这意味着，只要下一次危机爆发，注重安全的投资者将逃离财政疲软的国家，涌向财政坚挺、有着良好的经济增长纪录的国家。
en: This means that whenever the next crisis hits, safety-conscious investors will flee from fiscally weak countries toward fiscally strong ones that have a proven track record of generating economic growth.

zh: 当经济考虑逆转时，预计我们将体验到一种似曾相识的感觉。
en: When the economic calculus reverses, we can expect to experience a sense of déjà vu.

zh: 一国的收益意味着另一个国家的损失，这将危害到泛欧元区合作，助长政治紧张。
en: Each country’s gain will entail another country’s loss, which will undermine inter-eurozone cooperation and fuel political tensions.

zh: 其影响可能波及每个国家的国内政策，增强支持解体的力量。
en: The effects will likely reverberate through each country’s domestic politics, strengthening forces that favor disintegration.

zh: 平心而论，为了应对上一场危机而实施的改革在总体水平上改善了情况；但这些措施并未解决欧元区的根本性的不对称。
en: To be sure, reforms that were implemented in response to the last crisis have improved the situation at the aggregate level; but they have not resolved the eurozone’s fundamental asymmetry.

zh: 尽管欧元区采取了各种措施试图通过自上而下的规则实现财政趋同，各国基础财政处境仍然各不相同。
en: Underlying fiscal positions still vary from one country to another, despite all the efforts to achieve fiscal convergence through top-down rules.

zh: 类似地，最近几年的欧洲金融业改革尽管算得上大手笔，但并不足以解决问题。
en: Likewise, Europe’s financial-sector reforms in recent years, while significant, have not provided an adequate solution to the problem.

zh: 如今，欧洲银行联盟在一定程度上闭塞了上一场危机中的公共债务的堆积渠道 — — 本国银行。
en: The European banking union has now partly muted one of the primary channels – domestic banks – through which public debt piled up during the last crisis.

zh: 金融监管上升到了欧盟层次，而不再由国家当局代理。
en: Financial supervision has been placed at the EU level, rather than being delegated to national authorities.

zh: 政府援助（bailout）被债权人自救（bail-in）所取代，至少在后者不至于威胁到金融稳定时是如此。
en: And government bailouts have been replaced with creditor bail-ins, at least when the latter does not threaten financial stability.

zh: 但所有这些都无法改变一件事：出于担心金融传染会放大初始市场反应，因此当下一次危机来袭时，仍然需要公共援助。
en: But none of this will avert the need for public bailouts when the next crisis hits, out of fear that financial contagion will amplify the initial market reaction.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲的新危机管理工具具有显而易见的局限性。
en: At the same time, Europe’s new crisis-management tools have obvious limitations.

zh: 欧洲稳定性机制（ESM）只有5,000亿欧元的借贷能力，如果新危机爆发，这点钱无法造成显著的区别。
en: With a lending capacity of only €500 billion ($535 billion), the European Stability Mechanism (ESM) will likely not make much of a difference in the next crisis.

zh: 另一个选择是激活欧洲央行的“直接货币交易 ” （ OMT）计划，即欧洲央行在二级市场购买欧元区成员国的债券。
en: An alternative option would be to activate the European Central Bank’s “outright monetary transactions” program, in which the ECB would purchase eurozone member states’ bonds in secondary markets.

zh: 但OMT的实施存在整治难点，自2012年9月宣布以来，它从未成为现实。
en: But the OMT, announced in September 2012 but never applied, would be politically difficult to implement.

zh: 此外，它和ESM一样也是有条件的，因此无助于缓和债权人和债务人之间的紧张。
en: And because, like the ESM, it is conditional, it would do nothing to alleviate the tension between creditors and debtors.

zh: 事实上，第二轮欧洲央行公共部门购买计划（Public Sector Purchase Program，PSPP）无法解决欧洲的不对称问题。
en: In fact, even a second round of the ECB’s Public Sector Purchase Program would not solve Europe’s asymmetry problem.

zh: 欧洲央行，以及国家央行，系根据各国的欧洲央行资本占比购买政府债券，因此，PSPP无法优先对待承受压力的国家。
en: Because the ECB, together with national central banks, buys government bonds in proportion to each country’s share of ECB capital, the PSPP cannot privilege the countries that are under stress.

zh: 重债国采取积极的财政刺激政策的能力有限。
en: High-debt countries are limited in their ability to pursue proactive fiscal-stimulus policies.

zh: 在上一次危机的高峰期，一些国家不得不花费GDP的5%以上来支付未偿还债务的利息。
en: During the peak of the last crisis, some countries had to spend over 5% of their GDP just paying interest on their outstanding debt.

zh: 即使在市场动荡结束、PSPP将利率压低后，去年重债国仍然平均要花费GDP的3—4%左右支付利息。
en: And even after the market turmoil ended, and the PSPP brought interest rates down, high-debt countries last year still spent an average of around 3-4% of their GDP on interest payments.

zh: 这些国家大部分还远远没有到破产的地步。
en: Most of these countries are far from being insolvent.

zh: 但它们的债务就像是一件紧身衣，限制了它们在景气时期实现经济增长的能力，而在危机时期又会导致负债增加。
en: But their debt is like a straightjacket, limiting their capacity to deliver economic growth in good times, and posing a liability in times of crisis.

zh: 正式债务重组的进行常常是作为无效的超国家和国家财政框架的替代品。
en: A formal debt restructuring is often offered as an alternative to ineffective supranational and national fiscal frameworks.

zh: 在这一情形中，市场监督将取代政治监督。
en: In this scenario, market supervision would replace political supervision.

zh: 但是，由于一些国家仍然显著比其他国家更加脆弱，现在引入债务重组计划将把投资者吓出这些国家，因而弊大于利。
en: But, because some countries are still clearly more vulnerable than others, introducing a debt-restructuring program now would scare investors away from those countries, thereby doing more harm than good.

zh: 在短期，决策者应该探索其他解决公共债务积压的方法。
en: In the short term, policymakers should explore other avenues for solving the public-debt overhang.

zh: 就目前的结构而言，PSPP允许返还欧洲央行和国家央行购买的债券的利息。
en: The PSPP, as it is currently constructed, allows repatriation of interest on bonds purchased by the ECB and national central banks.

zh: 但利息的节约相当有限，因为欧洲央行在形式上只能购买一定数量的各国政府债券，不能超量购买。
en: But interest savings are modest, because the ECB is formally limited from buying more than a certain amount of each country’s government debt.

zh: 提高这一限制可以让当前框架用于未来减轻一些国家的财政负担。
en: Lifting this limit would permit the existing framework to be used in the future to alleviate some countries’ fiscal burdens.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲央行需要需要扮演与现在不同的角色，保持更远的距离。
en: Meanwhile, the ECB would need to play a different and more distant role than it has.

zh: 独立当局 — — 如欧盟委员会，甚至建立一个全新的机构 — — 需要确保节约下来的资金被用于各国的生产性用途。
en: And independent authorities – such as the European Commission or even an entirely new institution – would need to ensure that savings were put to productive use in each country.

zh: 一场欧洲经济奇迹即将来临?
en: A European Economic Miracle?

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 几年前，经济总量约占全球1/6的欧元区似乎陷入了严重困境。
en: LONDON – A couple of years ago, the eurozone – about one-sixth of the world economy – appeared to be in serious trouble.

zh: 从2010年开始，一场意想不到的主权债务危机触发并加剧了各大型银行的严重危机。
en: Beginning in 2010, an unexpected sovereign debt crisis contributed to and was compounded by serious weaknesses in major banks.

zh: 在希腊和其他国力相对薄弱的国家，财政紧缩政策导致整体经济下滑。
en: Fiscal austerity, in Greece and other relatively weak countries, helped fuel an overall economic downturn.

zh: 在缺乏大手笔互助资金的情况下，各方仿佛都走到了绝境，直到在2015年3月欧洲央行宣布实施一项雄心勃勃的政府债务采购计划后才得以告终。
en: In the absence of generous mutual support, there was an aura of last-ditch desperation when, in March 2015, the European Central Bank announced an ambitious program of purchasing government debt.

zh: 计划启动至今两年多，形势看似大为好转。
en: Just over two years later, the situation looks much more positive.

zh: 根据国际货币基金组织的最新预测，2017年欧元区整体将实现1.7％的增长，2018年则为1.6 ％ — —这相对几年前可谓极大改善，须知当时要实现1％的增长都极为勉强。
en: The latest International Monetary Fund forecast projects 1.7% growth for the eurozone as a whole in 2017, and 1.6% growth in 2018 – a remarkable improvement from a few years ago, when the region struggled to break 1%.

zh: 近期对几家意大利和西班牙小型银行偿付能力问题的处理并未遇到什么大的阻碍。
en: Recent solvency concerns for some smaller banks in Italy and Spain were handled without causing any significant disruption.

zh: 而在刚刚闭幕的欧洲央行会议上，甚至出现了一些针对欧洲央行何时可以开始收回干预措施或提高利率的讨论（会议的所有环节都进行了录音和网络直播 ） 。
en: And, at a just-concluded ECB conference that I attended, there was even some discussion of when the ECB could scale back its interventions and perhaps begin to raise interest rates. (All the sessions were on the record and live webcast.)

zh: 然而眼下的宏观经济图景仍然略显模糊。
en: The immediate macroeconomic picture remains somewhat murky.

zh: 6月27日上午，金融市场认为，欧洲央行行长马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）谈论增长的语气比过去更为积极，推动欧元兑美元大幅上涨。
en: On the morning of June 27, financial markets thought ECB President Mario Draghi spoke more positively on growth than in the recent past, and the value of the euro strengthened significantly.

zh: 第二天早上，又有消息引述几位央行高级官员说行长的言论被过度诠释，于是欧元应声下跌。
en: By the next morning, senior ECB officials were quoted as saying that Draghi’s remarks had been overinterpreted – and the euro fell.

zh: 真正的问题是下一步会出现什么情况，而这也是这次央行会议的主题：如何看待欧洲的中期增长潜力？
en: The real question is what comes next, and this was the theme of the conference: what should we expect in terms of Europe’s medium-term growth potential?

zh: 特别是在当前的低利率水平下，意大利等国的政府债务水平表现可控，可一但利率上升，又能否能有足够的增长来维护公共债务水平可持续的预期？
en: In particular, as long as interest rates remain low, the current level of government debt in countries such as Italy remains manageable. But as interest rates rise, will there be sufficient growth to sustain the expectation that public debt levels are sustainable?

zh: 过去几年的促增长政策确实取得了一些成就。
en: The pro-growth achievements of the past few years are real.

zh: 欧洲央行的低利率（实际上是负的）利率政策有助于维持整体信贷，尤其能确保政府赤字能够获得持续融资。
en: The ECB’s low (in fact, negative) interest-rate policies helped sustain credit in general and ensure continued financing of government deficits in particular.

zh: 这解除了财政政策所肩负的压力 — — 而紧缩政策也比原先预想的要少。
en: This took pressure off fiscal policy – and there has been less austerity than previously seemed likely.

zh: 各大银行的基础也得到进一步强化，拥有更多可以吸收亏损的资本。
en: Banks have been gradually placed on a stronger footing, with more loss-absorbing equity capital.

zh: 还有一些证据表明商品市场的竞争有所增加，这或许是监管更为宽松的结果。
en: There is also some evidence that competition in product markets has increased, perhaps owing to more relaxed regulation.

zh: 此外还有一些坏消息 — — 但其中一些也不是欧元区特有的。
en: There is also bad news, although not all of it is specific to the eurozone.

zh: 纵观全球发达工业国，生产力的增长放缓 — — 以及因此产生的整体经济增长放缓 — — 已经是自2000年延续至今的难题。
en: Across industrial countries, there has been a slowdown in productivity growth – and therefore in overall economic growth – which now appears to have started around the year 2000.

zh: 人们对此依然缺乏精确的解释，而通行的看法是虽然新信息技术的出现确实对1990年代的生产力水平产生了一定的积极影响，但无法证明这些好处是能足够长期或普遍存在的。
en: The precise explanation remains elusive, but the prevailing view is that while the advent of new information technology had some definite positive impact on productivity in the 1990s, the gains have not proved sufficiently long-lived or widespread.

zh: 另外，技术变革的特定模式也给世界各地的中产阶级带来了压力 — — 对中等教育程度工人的需求因此减少了。
en: In addition, the precise pattern of technological change has put pressure on the middle class everywhere – by reducing the demand for workers who have only a secondary-school education.

zh: 这意味着增长放缓和不平等状况的扩大，而两者合一则可能进一步损害劳动者的教育和技能水平。
en: This implies weak growth and widening inequality, a combination that could further undermine education and skill levels.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲的人口趋势也值得忧虑。
en: At the same time, European demographic trends are a source of concern.

zh: 人口老龄化意味着退休人员相对于经济活跃人口的比例增加 — — 为政府带来养老金压力。
en: An aging population means more retirees – expecting publicly provided pensions – relative to the number of economically active people.

zh: 虽然欧洲接收了来自叙利亚，利比亚和阿富汗等国的大量移民，但是很多新来者都基本没有受过教育，让这些人实现就业极为困难。
en: Europe has experienced significant immigration from countries such as Syria, Libya, and Afghanistan; but many of the newcomers have little education, and finding them employment has proved difficult.

zh: 更多的创新肯定是有帮助的。
en: More innovation could definitely help.

zh: 甚至悲观主义者都承认在全球各地已经掀起了生命科学，人工智能和机器人技术的热潮。
en: Even pessimists acknowledge the incipient wave of technology in life sciences, artificial intelligence, and robotics around the world.

zh: 但随着中国逐渐成长为研究型大国，欧洲压力也越来越大。
en: But as China continues to emerge as a research powerhouse, there is increasing pressure on Europe to keep up.

zh: 但也不应该把欧洲排除在外，因为欧洲的人力资本健全，医疗保健也比美国更好，而且在各国市场的一体化过程中也不断涌现出更强大的企业。
en: It would be a mistake to count Europe out yet. Its human capital is sound, good health care is available to more people than in the US, and stronger companies are emerging through the process of integrating national markets.

zh: 此外，英国脱离欧盟的决定似乎统一了欧陆各国领袖的思想，也没有人想再犯2010~14年间的政策失误。
en: Moreover, Britain’s decision to leave the European Union seems to have concentrated continental leaders’ minds.

zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙（Emmanuel Macron）提议建立一个更强大的中央权力机构，并可能在其中设立一个财政部。
en: No one wants to repeat the policy missteps of 2010-2014. French President Emmanuel Macron is proposing a stronger central authority, including a potential finance ministry.

zh: 虽然尚不清楚德国人会否同意此举，但要记得美国花了很长一段时间才建立了财政联盟（而且在某种意义上这个进程还未完成 ） 。
en: Whether the Germans will agree remains far from clear, but it is worth recalling that building a fiscal union in the US took a very long time (and in some senses may remain an unfinished project).

zh: 而令人担忧的可能是欧元区内的失衡。
en: The greatest cause for concern could turn out to be imbalances within the eurozone.

zh: 德国经济强劲：增长率达1.5~1.6 ％ ， 近乎完全就业，坐拥巨额经常账户盈余；西班牙经济虽然大幅改善，实现了2.6％的增长，但失业率居高不下，维持在18％左右。
en: The German economy is strong: 1.5-1.6% growth, near-full employment, and a large current-account surplus. Spain’s economy is greatly improved, experiencing 2.6% growth, but unemployment remains stubbornly – and disturbingly – high, at around 18%.

zh: 意大利仍然是一个大问题，国际货币基金组织预计该国今明两年的GDP增长率为0.8 ％ 。
en: Italy remains the big question, with the IMF forecasting GDP growth of 0.8% this year and next.

zh: 意大利北部的家族企业能否再次证明自己可以在竞争日渐激烈的国际市场上发展壮大？
en: Can northern Italy’s family firms again prove themselves capable of growth in increasingly tough international markets?

zh: 对这些企业来说下一波新技术浪潮是助力还是冲击？
en: Will the next wave of new technology help or hurt them?

zh: 法国则依然是个未知之数。
en: France, too, remains something of a wildcard.

zh: 马克龙对法国政治的大刀阔斧调整会否催生促进增长的改革？
en: Will Macron’s stunning makeover of French politics lead to growth-enhancing reforms?

zh: 如果改革难产，德国或许不会在欧元区整合方面与法国妥协。
en: If not, Germany may be less inclined to meet Macron halfway on eurozone integration.

zh: 最重要的是，欧元区 — — 或者也许是欧盟 — — 必须找到方法来确保每个国家都能实现增长并从增长中获益。
en: Above all, the eurozone – or perhaps the EU – must find ways to ensure that everyone grows and benefits from growth.

zh: 虽然我们不知道这一点能否实现，但可以肯定的是，在现在这样的环境下最差的情况已经过去，任务也会变得更加轻松。
en: Whether it will succeed or not cannot be known. What is certain is that in an environment like the current one, where the worst has passed, the task has become easier.

zh: 拯救欧洲的威胁
en: The Threat That Will Save Europe

zh: 布鲁塞尔—对欧盟来说，2015年又是一个根本变化之年。
en: BRUSSELS – For the European Union, 2015 was another year of fundamental challenges.

zh: 欧洲一体化的两大关键要素 — — 欧元和申根区无国界自由旅行 — — 承受了巨大压力。
en: Two key elements of European integration – the euro and border-free travel within the Schengen Area – were placed under severe strain.

zh: 并且压力都没有减轻。
en: And neither is in the clear.

zh: 尽管如此，2015年的一大发展趋势让我们有理由希望欧洲领导人能够超越“得过且过 ” ， 在2016年实施更加果断的方案。 这一趋势就是驱逐威胁日益可信。
en: Nonetheless, one development in 2015 offers reason to hope that EU leaders will move beyond “muddling through” to implement bolder solutions in 2016: The threat of expulsion gained credibility.

zh: 始于2008年的全球经济危机暴露出欧洲货币联盟的深刻缺陷，尽管2010—2012年欧元危机的濒死经验才迫使欧洲领导人有所反应，成立了一个巨型基金帮助受困国家，并建立了一个银行联盟。
en: The global economic crisis that began in 2008 exposed the deep flaws in Europe’s monetary union, though it took the near-death experience of the euro crisis of 2010-2012 to force Europe’s leaders to act, by creating a large fund to help struggling countries and establishing a banking union.

zh: 尽管如此，三年多后，这一联盟 — — 它包括欧洲央行的监督以及成立一个重组破产银行的激进，但缺少共同存款保险机制 — — 仍然漏洞百出。
en: Even so, more than three years later, that union – which entails supervision by the European Central Bank and the beginnings of a fund for restructuring failing banks, but lacks a common system for deposit insurance – is far from perfect.

zh: 尽管有各种缺陷，但银行联盟在2015年上半年帮助金融市场保持平稳，即使总理齐普拉斯领导的希腊新政府叫板欧洲处理国家金融危机的基本原则：接受支持的国家必须勒紧裤腰带。
en: Despite its flaws, the banking union helped to keep financial markets calm in the first half of 2015, even as Greece’s new government, led by Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras, challenged a basic feature of Europe’s approach to national financial crises: that recipients of support must engage in belt-tightening.

zh: 在7月份的全民公决中，希腊选民选择了齐普拉斯所想要的结果，决然地拒绝了希腊债权人所提出的新援助方案的交换条件 — — 包括严厉紧缩。
en: In a July referendum, Greek voters delivered the outcome for which Tsipras campaigned, soundly rejecting the conditions – including strict austerity – which Greece’s creditors had demanded in exchange for a new bailout.

zh: 几周后，一切都变了。
en: A few weeks later, everything changed.

zh: 齐普拉斯接受了援助计划，从某些角度看，该计划甚至比希腊选民所拒绝的更加严厉。
en: Tsipras accepted a bailout program that was, in some ways, even tougher than the one that voters had rejected.

zh: 而压倒性多数的选民和议会成员都支持这一措施。
en: An overwhelming majority of voters and members of parliament supported the move.

zh: 什么促成了这一突然转变显而易见：全民公决后，德国财政部长朔伊布勒（Wolfgang Schäuble）表示希腊应该从欧元区中“放假 ” — —这无异于警告开除出欧元区的前景近在眼前。
en: What triggered this about-face is obvious: After the referendum, German Finance Minister Wolfgang Schäuble suggested that Greece should be offered a “holiday” from the euro – a thinly veiled warning that exclusion from the eurozone was on the table.

zh: 显然，威胁起了作用。
en: Clearly, the threat worked.

zh: 这一威胁的潜在影响存在争议。
en: The potential implications of this threat are disputed.

zh: 一些人认为这意味着欧元区事实上已经变成了一个固定汇率体系，退出对于受困国及其竞争力更强的伙伴国来说也许是更值得做出的选择。
en: Some interpret it to mean that the eurozone has de facto become a fixed exchange-rate system, where exit might actually be preferable for a struggling country and its more competitive partners.

zh: 果真如此的话，欧元区的日子已经进入了倒计时。
en: If this is the case, the eurozone’s days are numbered.

zh: 但是，这出希腊闹剧更应该被视为欧元区恢复力的证明，其基础则是欧元区的诱惑力依然强大。
en: It might be more accurate, however, to view this Greek episode as proof of the eurozone’s resilience, underpinned by its still-powerful allure.

zh: 即使面临比20世纪30年代大萧条期间的美国更大的GDP收缩，希腊仍更愿意保留欧元区成员资格，而不是回归德拉克马。 回归德拉克马能够解放更多的工具用于重获竞争力，并对债权人实施大规模“剃头 ” （ haircut ） 。
en: Even in the face of a GDP contraction larger than that of the United States during the Great Depression of the 1930s, Greece preferred continued membership in the eurozone to a return to the drachma, which would have freed up some additional tools for regaining competitiveness and imposed asubstantial haircut on creditors.

zh: 如果后一种解读正确，那么欧洲货币联盟尽管漏洞百出，但比以前更有凝聚力了。
en: If the latter interpretation is correct, Europe’s monetary union, though still deeply flawed, has become more cohesive.

zh: 如果欧元区成员资格不再稳固，如果不遵守共同规则的国家可以踢出了事，那么各国就会更加努力地保留这一资格。
en: If eurozone membership cannot be taken for granted, if countries that do not abide by the common rules can simply be kicked out, countries will try harder to hold onto it.

zh: 申根区的问题也体现出同样的演化趋势。
en: The problems within the Schengen Area illustrate a similar evolution.

zh: 和欧元区一样，申根区是一个不完整的结构，因为它在放弃了内部边境的同时并没有建立维护外部边境的机制。
en: Like the eurozone, the Schengen Area is an incomplete structure, because it abolished internal borders without creating a common mechanism for policing the external border.

zh: 直到目前为止，这一缺陷并没有造成很尖锐的问题，因为中东和非洲极权政权能够控制战争和经济失败造成的移民压力。
en: Until recently, this failing did not pose an acute problem, because dictatorial regimes in the Middle East and Africa controlled the migratory pressure resulting from wars and failing economies.

zh: 但最近涌入欧洲的移民潮主要由叙利亚不断恶化的内战造成，它让申根区的缺陷尽显无疑。
en: But the recent surge in migration to Europe, driven largely by Syria’s intensifying civil war, has brought Schengen’s shortcomings to the fore.

zh: 到去年夏天，巴尔干路径周边国家 — — 首先是希腊，然后是匈牙利和斯洛文尼亚 — — 面对数十万寻找安全之地的难民不堪重负。
en: By last summer, countries along the Balkan route – first Greece, then Hungary and Slovenia – buckled under the pressure of hundreds of thousands of refugees attempting to make their way to safety.

zh: 欧洲一开始的反应毫无凝聚力可言，面对移民涌入，不同的欧盟成员国采取了完全不同的方针。
en: Europe’s initial response was incoherent, with different EU member states taking radically different approaches to the influx.

zh: 但是，越来越多的内部边境正在重启入境检查 — — 最新的例子是丹麦的德国边境。
en: Still, checks are being reinstituted at an increasing number of internal borders – most recently, on Denmark’s border with Germany.

zh: 对许多人来说，申根区已经支离破碎。
en: To many, Schengen appears to be in tatters.

zh: 但重启一些边境控制只是暂时措施。
en: But the reinstatement of some border controls is merely a temporary measure.

zh: 和希腊（以及直到最近的塞浦路斯）的资本管制一样，其目的是阻止危机，同时实施更好的机制。
en: Like the capital controls in Greece (and, until recently, in Cyprus), the purpose is to stem the crisis while better mechanisms are implemented.

zh: 此外，内部边境控制仍然只是例外而非规则。
en: Moreover, internal border controls remain the exception, not the rule.

zh: 申根国家直到，重启所有内部边境的完全控制��本极其高昂，将迫使它们挪用大量本可用于打击犯罪和恐怖主义这些主要目标的资源。
en: The Schengen countries know that reviving full controls across all internal borders would be extremely costly, forcing them to divert significant resources away from the primary objective of fighting crime and terrorism.

zh: 因此，这些国家的领导人依然承诺捍卫开放的内部边境，同时保持更强的外部边境控制 — — 即使如希腊所表明的，这意味着剥夺被认为没有做好本职工作的国家的申根区成员资格。
en: That is why their leaders remain committed to preserving open internal borders, while maintaining a stronger external border – even if that means, as has been made clear to Greece, revoking the Schengen membership of a country deemed incapable of doing its part.

zh: 欧元区和申根区之所以能战胜严峻考验，是因为一个原因：它们为成员国带来了有形的实际好处。
en: Both the eurozone and the Schengen Area have survived the tough tests they have faced for one reason: They bring practical, tangible benefits to their members.

zh: 经济学家称之为“显示偏好 ” 。
en: Economists call this “revealed preference.”

zh: 如今，来自欧洲一体化的新增价值不仅局限于欧盟成员资格，还包括参与欧元区或申根区等次一级国家集团，给日常生活和重要政策选择带来更加直接和看得见的影响。
en: The value added from European integration now extends beyond EU membership to include participation in sub-groups like the eurozone or the Schengen Area that have a more direct and tangible impact on daily life and key policy choices.

zh: 在现实世界中，高喊崇高原则的意义远远比不过脚踏实地的行动。
en: In the real world, declarations of lofty principles mean a lot less than concrete actions.

zh: 而去年的脚踏实地的行动 — — 最主要的便是警告不遵守规则的国家可能被开除 — — 表明2016年将带来通往更强大的欧元区和真正的政治联盟的更多进步，不管进步多么微小。
en: And the concrete actions of the last year – notably, the warning that countries that do not follow the rules will be left out – suggest that 2016 will bring more progress, however piecemeal, toward a stronger eurozone and a real political union.

zh: 不用偿还的借贷
en: Money for Nothing

zh: 布鲁塞尔—发达世界似乎正在迎来长期零利率环境。
en: BRUSSELS – The developed world seems to be moving toward a long-term zero-interest-rate environment.

zh: 尽管美国、英国、日本和欧元区维持央行政策利率为零已有多年，但仍有许多人感觉这只是暂时的反常现象，这意味着中期到长期利率仍然坚挺。
en: Though the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, and the eurozone have kept central-bank policy rates at zero for several years already, the perception that this was a temporary aberration meant that medium- to long-term rates remained substantial.

zh: 但这可能发生改变，特别是在欧元区。
en: But this may be changing, especially in the eurozone.

zh: 严格而言，零利率应该只存在于被认为无风险的中期债务的名义值。
en: Strictly speaking, zero rates are observed only for nominal, medium-term debt that is perceived to be riskless.

zh: 但是，纵观欧元区，利率无不接近于零 — — 并且有相当大部分的政府债务为负 — — 预计将在相当长时间里保持低水平。
en: But, throughout the eurozone, rates are close to zero – and negative for a substantial share of government debt – and are expected to remain low for quite some time.

zh: 比如，五年期德国公债利率将保持在负值，五年期以上公债也只是略高于零，加权平均则为零。
en: In Germany, for example, interest rates on public debt up to five years will be negative, and only slightly positive beyond that, producing a weighted average of zero.

zh: 显然，日本的近零利率环境已不再独特。
en: Clearly, Japan’s near-zero interest-rate environment is no longer unique.

zh: 诚然，欧洲央行的大规模债券购买计划也许正在暂时性抑制利率，而当明年购买操作中止时，利率会回升。
en: To be sure, the European Central Bank’s large-scale bond-buying program could be suppressing interest rates temporarily, and, once the purchases are halted next year, they will rise again.

zh: 但投资者似乎并不认为如此。
en: But investors do not seem to think so.

zh: 事实上，德国30年期国债收益率还不到0.7 % ， 表明投资者认为极低利率会维持极长时间。
en: Indeed, Germany’s 30-year bund yield is less than 0.7%, indicating that they expect ultra-low rates for a very long time.

zh: 许多发行国正在延长债务的期限结构以锁定不可能再大幅降低（但可能大幅上升）的当前利率。
en: And many issuers are extending the maturity structure of their obligations to lock in current rates, which cannot go much lower (but could potentially increase a lot).

zh: 无论如何，欧元区的零利率期限正在不断延长。
en: In any case, the eurozone seems stuck with near-zero rates at increasingly long maturities.

zh: 这对投资者和债务人实际意味着什么？
en: What does this actually mean for its investors and debtors?

zh: 在这个问题上，你不但要考虑名义利率，还要考虑真实（经通胀调整的）利率。
en: Here, one must consider not only the nominal interest rate, but also the real (inflation-adjusted) interest rate.

zh: 极低 — — 甚至为负 — — 的名义利率可以为储蓄者带来正的真实利率，如果价格降幅足够的话。
en: A very low – or even negative – nominal interest rate could produce a positive real return for a saver, if prices fall sufficiently.

zh: 事实上，日本储蓄者十多年来一直从这一现象中获益，获得比美国储蓄者更高的真实回报，尽管日本的近零名义利率远低于美国。
en: In fact, Japanese savers have been benefiting from this phenomenon for more than a decade, reaping higher real returns than their counterparts in the US, even though Japan’s near-zero nominal interest rates are much lower than America’s.

zh: 尽管如此，名义利率确实重要。
en: Nonetheless, nominal rates do matter.

zh: 当名义利率低到可以忽略时，就会影响利润表，而资产负债表问题则逐渐累积。
en: When they are negligible, they flatter profit statements, while balance-sheet problems slowly accumulate.

zh: 资产负债表簿记是根据奇特的名义和市场价值组合进行，因此可能恨不透明而容易操纵。
en: Given that balance-sheet accounting is conducted according to a curious mix of nominal and market values, it can be opaque and easy to manipulate.

zh: 如果价格 — — 因而平均债务维持能力 — — 下降，债务的真实负担就会增加。
en: If prices – and thus average debt-service capacity – fall, the real burden of the debt increases.

zh: 但只有当债务必须再融资或利率上升时，这些状况才会暴露。
en: But this becomes apparent only when the debt has to be refinanced or interest rates increase.

zh: 在零或近零利率环境中，债权人有动力“延期和假装 ” ， 即烟气到期债务以便在更长时间里隐瞒它们的问题。
en: In an environment of zero or near-zero interest rates, creditors have an incentive to “extend and pretend” – that is, roll over their maturing debt, so that they can keep their problems hidden for longer.

zh: 由于债务可以以极低利率再融资，延期风险很低，这让在正常环境中将被认定为资不抵债的债务人可以维持更长时间。
en: Because the debt can be refinanced at such low rates, rollover risk is very low, allowing debtors who would be considered insolvent under normal circumstances to carry on much longer than they otherwise could.

zh: 毕竟，如果债务以零利率不断延期直到永远，就不会出现真正的问题 — — 也不会有债务人被认为资不抵债。
en: After all, if debt can be rolled over forever at zero rates, it does not really matter – and nobody can be considered insolvent.

zh: 债务实际上将成为无限期。
en: The debt becomes de facto perpetual.

zh: 日本的经验完美地说明了这一现象。
en: Japan’s experience illustrates this phenomenon perfectly.

zh: 日本政府负债高达GDP的200%以上，看起来根本无力解决这一问题。
en: At more than 200% of GDP, the government’s mountain of debt seems unconquerable.

zh: 但其债务维持成本只有GDP的1—2 % ， 因此日本仍有偿债能力。
en: But that debt costs only 1-2% of GDP to service, allowing Japan to remain solvent.

zh: 类似地，希腊现在可以负担相当于GDP的175%左右的公债负担也是因为其欧洲伙伴国给予的极低利率和长期限（比日本债务期限更长 ） 。
en: Likewise, Greece can now manage its public-debt burden, which stands at about 175% of GDP, thanks to the ultra-low interest rates and long maturities (longer than those on Japan’s debt) granted by its European partners.

zh: 简言之，只要利率足够低，任何债务-GDP比率都是可管理的。
en: In short, with low enough interest rates, any debt-to-GDP ratio is manageable.

zh: 正因如此，在当前利率环境下，马斯特里赫特条约中公债不得高于GDP的60%的限制根本没有意义 — — 所谓的“财政契约”要求各国不断朝这一水平靠近的条款也必须重新考虑。
en: That is why, in the current interest-rate environment, the Maastricht Treaty’s requirement limiting public debt to 60% of GDP is meaningless – and why the so-called “fiscal compact” requiring countries to make continued progress toward that level should be reconsidered.

zh: 事实上，近零利率破坏了希腊、爱尔兰、葡萄牙和西班牙等国家的“债务积压”的概念。
en: In fact, near-zero interest rates undermine the very notion of a “debt overhang” in countries like Greece, Ireland, Portugal, and Spain.

zh: 这些经济提确实在结束于2008年的信用繁荣期中积累了巨量债务，但现在的债务维持成本非常低，根本无法产生正常情况下所应该产生的影响 — — 降低收入、阻碍增长回归、在投资者中间制造不确定性。
en: While these countries did accumulate a huge volume of debt during the credit boom that went bust in 2008, the cost of debt service is now too low to have the impact – reducing incomes, preventing a return to growth, and generating uncertainty among investors – that one would normally expect.

zh: 如今，这些国家只需要对其债务以更长期限进行再融资。
en: Today, these countries can simply refinance their obligations at longer maturities.

zh: 国家债务毫无疑问在全球金融体系中扮演关键角色。
en: Countries’ debts undoubtedly play a vital role in the global financial system.

zh: 但是，在零利率环境中，这一角色必须重新评估。
en: But, in a zero interest-rate environment, that role must be reevaluated.

zh: 欧洲的战略集结号
en: A Strategic Rallying Cry for Europe

zh: 马德里 — — 六月末，希腊疾速滑向内爆，而欧盟则被越来越汹涌的移民内部辩论所吞噬。
en: MADRID – At the end of June, Greece was hurtling toward implosion and the European Union was consumed by an increasingly vicious internal debate over migration.

zh: 这听上去或许不像欧洲理事会最终批准起草期待已久的欧盟新“全球外交及安全战略”的最佳时机。
en: That might not sound like the most auspicious time for the European Council to give final approval for the preparation of a long-awaited new “global foreign and security strategy” for the EU.

zh: 但事实却的确如此，理事会6月25-26日会议的决议当中就包含上述批准决定 — — 还有明确的提交日期。
en: But that is what happened, with the endorsement – complete with deliver-by date – buried in the conclusions of the Council’s June 25-26 meeting.

zh: 上述举措有可能彻底改变欧洲应对当前诸多挑战的解决办法，或许更重要的是，能为欧盟注入其迫切需要的目的性。
en: The initiative has the potential to revolutionize how Europe addresses the many challenges it now faces and, perhaps more important, to give the EU the sense of purpose that it so badly needs.

zh: 欧盟显然需要新的安全战略。
en: That the EU needs a new security strategy is clear.

zh: 2003年出台的现行战略已经严重过时，这一点集中体现在其开篇的序言之中 ： “ 欧洲从来没有像现在这样繁荣、安全和自由。
en: The current one, created in 2003, is deeply outmoded, as epitomized by its opening line: “Europe has never been so prosperous, so secure, nor so free.”

zh: ”今天显然已经不再如此。
en: This is clearly no longer the case today.

zh: 欧洲所处的长期混乱是其越来越复杂的内外部现实相互作用的结果 — — 其中最值得注意的是四大相互关联交错的生存威胁。
en: The constant state of turmoil in which Europe has found itself is a result of the increasing complexity and intertwining of its internal and external realities – shaped, most notably, by four overlapping existential threats.

zh: 首先，俄国已重新挑起欧洲本以为早已解决的传统安全威胁。
en: First, Russia has revived a traditional security challenge that Europe had, it was thought, solved long ago.

zh: 其次，跨国恐怖主义带来了多方面的本质性危险。
en: Second, transnational terrorism poses a multifaceted and fundamental danger.

zh: 第三，正在兴起的移民危机就欧洲的价值观和身份提出了质疑。
en: Third, a burgeoning migration crisis is raising questions about European values and identity.

zh: 最后，普遍缺乏对未来远见的欧洲计划已经导致了欧洲各国的不满，进而破坏凝聚力并反过来影响了欧盟对所面临考验的解决。
en: And finally, a general lack of vision for the future of the European project has led to disaffection throughout the continent, undermining cohesion and, in turn, the EU’s capacity to address the trials it faces.

zh: 这些问题彼此激化加剧。
en: These menaces exacerbate and intensify one another.

zh: 恐怖组织活动导致邻近地区暴力动荡，致使越来越多的人口选择向欧盟移民。
en: The activities of terrorist groups contribute to violence and instability in neighboring regions, driving an increasing number of migrants to the EU.

zh: 移民群体难以融入欧洲社会有时会导致激进运动，为民族主义政客提供口实并进一步分裂欧洲。
en: The difficulty of integrating immigrant communities into European societies has sometimes led to radicalization, providing ammunition to nationalist politicians and further fracturing Europe.

zh: 俄国领导人也在暗中努力破坏团结，失去了团结的欧盟无力应对所面临的威胁。
en: Russia’s leaders, too, have worked insidiously to break down solidarity, without which the EU is powerless to respond to the threats it faces.

zh: 所有这一切严重挑战了欧盟的全球作用，同时削弱了欧洲计划本身的可行性。
en: All of this raises serious questions about the EU’s global role, while diminishing the viability of the European project itself.

zh: 鉴于这样一种相互关系，事实证明欧盟条块化对策 — — 如欧洲移民议程、东部伙伴关系和能源安全战略 — — 虽然重要，但远远跟不上形势发展其实并不出人意料。
en: Given this interconnectedness, it is unsurprising that the EU’s compartmentalized responses – such as the European Agenda on Migration, the Eastern Partnership, and the Energy Security Strategy – while important, have proved inadequate.

zh: 我们需要的是不仅能够支撑在核心安全威胁面前拿出自我强化、协调对策的总体框架，还需要利用形形色色的联系和机会优势巩固欧洲的行动能力。
en: What is needed is an overarching framework that not only underpins a self-reinforcing and coordinated response to core security threats, but also takes advantage of linkages and opportunities to buttress Europe’s capacity to act.

zh: 欧洲安全战略的上述重构 — — 而不止是修补 — — 必须考虑到内部和外部正变得越来越难以区分的事实。
en: Such a reconceptualization – not just revision – of Europe’s security strategy must account for the fact that the internal and external are becoming increasingly difficult to separate.

zh: 实际上，数字统一市场等着重于内部的计划产生了显著的国际影响，而外部事件也影响了欧盟的生活。
en: Indeed, internally focused initiatives– the digital single market is one clear example – have significant international impacts, while external events shape life in the EU.

zh: 有鉴于此，新安全战略应当考虑到内部政策更广泛的影响，充分利用欧洲可以利用的一切工具。
en: Given this, the new security strategy should account for the wider implications of domestic policies, leveraging the full array of tools that Europe has at its disposal.

zh: 当然，除非欧洲领导人致力于长期推行具体计划，否则高谈阔论和宏伟的目标并没有太多实际意义。
en: Of course, lofty rhetoric and ambitious intentions will mean little unless Europe’s leaders commit to the sustained implementation of concrete initiatives.

zh: 这也解释了起草过程本身为什么非常重要；它提供了一次让欧盟机构和更广泛的欧洲政界展开严肃讨论的机会，他们已经花了不少时间思考这些问题。
en: This is why the drafting process itself is so important; it presents an opportunity for a serious discussion involving EU institutions and the wider European policy community, which has already spent considerable time reflecting on these issues.

zh: 欧盟高级代表外交事务与安全政策代表兼欧洲委员会副主席莫盖里尼明智地敦促各成员国积极参与讨论，以便他们对最后制定的战略拥有主人翁意识。
en: Federica Mogherini, the EU’s High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and Vice-President of the European Commission, is correct when she urges the close involvement of member states in the discussions, in order to give them a sense of ownership over whatever strategy emerges.

zh: 我们的目标是在不忘记盟友和伙伴的前提下首先在欧盟内部拿出可行的想法，凝聚共识并且找到联系。
en: The aim should be to produce viable ideas, build consensus, and find linkages – first and foremost within the EU, but without forgetting allies and partners.

zh: 事实上，这样的外部视角至关重要。
en: In fact, that external dimension is essential.

zh: 目前的欧元危机已经夺走了支撑一体化进程数十载的理由。
en: The ongoing euro crisis has stripped away the rationale that undergirded the integration process for decades.

zh: 因为共同繁荣不能再作为存在价值，欧盟正在苦苦挣扎着寻找一种新的说法 — — 以便说服民众和成员国欧洲一体化依然具有实际价值。
en: No longer able to point toward shared prosperity as its raison d'être, the EU is floundering in its search for a new narrative – one that convinces citizens and member states that European integration still has real value.

zh: 这项战略不仅关注世界如何影响欧盟，而且关注欧盟价值观和利益应当如何投射到海外，这将为欧盟吹响集结号，明确欧盟更广阔的使命以及明确的目标。
en: A strategy that focuses not only on how the world impacts the EU, but also on how European values and interests can and should be projected abroad would provide a rallying cry, a broader mission, and a clear purpose.

zh: 欧洲一体化进程就其核心而言始终坚持以价值为导向、以规则为基础 — — 这两种属性在当今世界正在逐步退潮。
en: The European integration process has, at its core, always been values-driven and rules-based – two qualities that are on retreat in today’s world.

zh: 通过扛起自由主义、善政和国际法治的旗帜，欧盟就可以克服危机期间在内部不断加强的离心力，从而能更从容地面对今天所面临的挑战并确保自身在未来世界的地位。
en: By carrying the banner of liberalism, good governance, and the rule of law internationally, the EU can reverse the centrifugal forces at home that have intensified during the crisis, thereby strengthening its capacity to respond to today’s challenges and securing its position in tomorrow’s world.

zh: 对我们而言这是一次不容错过的机会。
en: This is an opportunity that we cannot afford to miss.

zh: 重建欧盟-土耳其关系
en: An EU-Turkey Reset

zh: 罗马—今年晚些时候，土耳其将承办2015年G-20领导人峰会，这也是G-20政府首脑第十届年度会议。
en: ROME – Later this year, Turkey will host the 2015 G-20 Leaders' Summit, the tenth annual meeting of the G-20 heads of government.

zh: 土耳其在世界舞台上出任主角的时机可谓怪异，因为它正在被日益扩大的动荡周边所包围。
en: The country's prominence on the world stage comes at an odd time, when it finds itself surrounded by a widening arc of instability.

zh: 欧盟和土耳其从未如此需要对方，也很少想去如此遥远。
en: Never have the European Union and Turkey needed one another more, and yet rarely have they been so distant.

zh: 土耳其已不再是其总统埃尔多安12年执政时期前半段的地区新星了。
en: Turkey is no longer the rising regional star that it was during the first half of President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's 12 years in office.

zh: 土耳其经济繁荣、迈向真正民主国家、成为该地区许多人的希望源泉的日子早已不再。
en: Long gone are the days when the country was booming economically and advancing toward true democracy, a source of inspiration to many in the region.

zh: 如今，土耳其面临着多重挑战：日益加剧的极权主义、萎靡不振的经济增长，以及每况愈下的库尔德地区和平进程。
en: Today, Turkey faces myriad challenges: growing authoritarianism, unimpressive growth, and a faltering Kurdish peace process.

zh: 与伊朗和以色列交恶已是根深蒂固，并且土耳其变得日益依赖来自觊觎重塑昔日辉煌的俄罗斯的能源。
en: Tensions with both Iran and Israel have become deeply entrenched, and the country has become increasingly dependent on energy from a revanchist Russia.

zh: 土耳其无法独力应对这些挑战。
en: Turkey cannot confront these challenges alone.

zh: 与此同时，自2011年阿拉伯之春以来，土耳其与其南方邻国的经济关系每况愈下。
en: Meanwhile, the country's economic ties with its southern neighbors have spiraled downward since the Arab Spring in 2011.

zh: 简言之，土耳其正在意识到，除了欧盟以及与跨大西洋社会紧密合作，它别无选择。
en: Simply put, Turkey is waking up to the reality that it has no attractive alternative to the EU and close cooperation with the transatlantic community.

zh: 去年秋天土耳其欧洲事务部长沃尔干·博孜克尔（Volkan Bozkir）所宣布的“欧盟战略"可以解读为对这一事实的间接承认。
en: The country's “EU Strategy" announced by European Affairs Minister Volkan Bozkir last fall can be read as an implicit recognition of this fact.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲从未如此需要一个稳定、民主、西方导向的土耳其。
en: Meanwhile, Europe has never had a greater interest in a stable, democratic, and Western-oriented Turkey.

zh: 没有土耳其的合作，欧洲和国际社会就难以面临外国“斗士"的威胁、击败伊斯兰国、稳定伊拉克、制定叙利亚困局的政治解决方案。
en: Without Turkey's cooperation, Europe and the international community will struggle to confront the threat of foreign fighters, defeat the Islamic State, stabilize Iraq, and craft a political solution to the Syrian quagmire.

zh: 欧盟还需要与土耳其构建可靠的伙伴关系，从而通过多样化实现能源安全。
en: The EU also needs a sound partnership with Turkey to achieve energy security through diversification.

zh: 但是，欧盟和土耳其并没有走得更近，反而在渐行渐远。
en: And yet, rather than being drawn closer together, the EU and Turkey are drifting apart.

zh: 在埃尔多安治下，言论自由、权力分隔以及法治被逐渐蚕食。
en: Freedom of expression, the separation of powers, and the rule of law have been progressively eroded under Erdoğan.

zh: 土耳其有可能卷入地区宗派冲突 — — 并可能受到普��的俄罗斯的极权诱惑。
en: The country risks being sucked into the region's sectarian conflicts – and being tempted by the authoritarian sirens of Vladimir Putin's Russia.

zh: 去年年底，土耳其加大了对于自我流亡的伊斯兰领袖葛兰（Fethullah Gülen）关系密切的媒体的压力，导致欧盟-土耳其关系降至新低点。
en: The EU-Turkey relationship hit a new low at the close of last year, when Turkey increased its pressure on media close to the self-exiled Islamic leader Fethullah Gülen.

zh: 镇压行为引起了欧盟的强烈抨击，埃尔多安则愤怒地拒绝接受。
en: The clampdown triggered strong criticism by the EU, which Erdoğan, in turn, angrily rejected.

zh: 一些欧洲人认为土耳其权利和自由的恶化非常严重，因此已经陷入僵局的加入欧盟程序应该暂停。
en: Some in Europe argue that the deterioration of rights and freedoms in Turkey is so serious that the already-moribund EU accession process should be suspended.

zh: 事实上，土耳其很难满足哥本哈根政治标准。
en: Indeed, it would be difficult to make the case that Turkey fulfills the Copenhagen political criteria.

zh: 比如，土耳其在无国界记者（Reporters Without Borders）的世界言论自由指数上已滑落至第154位（总共180个国家 ） 。
en: For example, Turkey slid in Reporters Without Borders' World Press Freedom Index to 154th place (out of 180 countries).

zh: 但正式暂停入盟谈判的唯一效果只能是扼杀土耳其追求民主化和欧盟和谐的最后动力。
en: But it is unlikely that a formal suspension of accession negotiations would do anything other than remove the last incentive for Turkey to pursue democratization and EU harmonization.

zh: 相反，欧盟应该加倍努力，加强对土耳其民主倒退的批评，同时也加强入盟程序的可信度。
en: Instead, the EU should redouble its efforts, strengthening both its criticism of Turkey's democratic backsliding and the credibility of its accession process.

zh: 目前，塞浦路斯一直是土耳其加入欧盟的最大障碍。
en: Until now, Cyprus has posed the biggest obstacle to Turkish accession.

zh: 欧盟成员国应该积极劝说塞浦路斯政府，使其做出必要的改变。
en: EU member states should engage more actively with the Cypriot government to bring about the necessary change.

zh: 然后，欧盟将能够在恰当的法律框架内进行批评，而土耳其领导人也决不能继续无视欧盟的关注点了。
en: The EU would then be able to cast its criticism within the appropriate legal framework, while Turkish leaders would no longer be in a position to brush aside the EU's concerns.

zh: 移除谈判的障碍对塞浦路斯和对欧洲一样有利。
en: Lifting its blockade on negotiations would benefit Cyprus as much as Europe.

zh: 没有哪个国家能像塞浦路斯那样从土耳其实现稳定民主中获取那么大的好处，而在邻国分崩离析环境下的去民主化的土耳其将严重威胁塞浦路斯和欧洲的利益。
en: No country would gain more than Cyprus from stable democracy in Turkey, whereas a de-democratizing Turkey in an unraveling neighborhood seriously threatens Cypriot and European interests alike.

zh: 除了加入欧盟程序，还应该采取其他重要措施重塑信任和为双方制造切实利益，从而修复病态但日益具有战略意义的关系。
en: Beyond the EU accession process, other important measures should be taken to rebuild trust and deliver concrete benefits to both sides, thereby revitalizing an ailing and yet increasingly strategic relationship.

zh: 尽管这些措施并非修补入盟谈判的替代方案，但它们有助于振兴入盟谈判。
en: Though these measures are not alternatives to a revamped accession process, they would help to revive it.

zh: 最重要的是，这些措施有望将土耳其纳入欧洲大家庭，从而阻止它朝远离我们的共同欧洲价值的方向越滑越远。
en: Above all, by embedding Turkey within the European family, such measures would counter the country's dangerous drift away from our common European values.

zh: 本评论的联署者还包括慕尼黑安全会议主席Wolfgang Ischinger、荷兰外交部前部长、负责对外关系的前欧盟委员Hans van den Broek、西班牙外交部前部长Marcelino Oreja Aguirre、法国前总理Michel Rocard以及罗马国际关系学院副院长Nathalie Tocci。
en: This commentary was also signed by Wolfgang Ischinger, Chairman of the Munich Security Conference; Hans van den Broek, a former Dutch foreign minister and EU commissioner for external relations; Marcelino Oreja Aguirre, a former Spanish foreign minister; Michel Rocard, former French Prime Minister; and Nathalie Tocci, Deputy Director of the Istituto Affari Internazionali in Rome.

zh: 打击逃税现象
en: Evading Tax Evasion

zh: 意大利亚历山德里亚—逃税是一个全球性的问题。
en: ALESSANDRIA, ITALY – Tax evasion is a global scourge.

zh: 根据某些估算，这种“黑色”经济占到发达国家国民生产总值的10 % ， 而在发展中国家这一比例最高甚至达到70 % ， 并且情况还在继续恶化。
en: The “black” economy has, by some estimates, reached 10% of GDP in advanced countries and can top 70% in developing countries. And it is getting worse.

zh: 应对逃税通常有两种方式：审计和严厉的制裁。
en: Tax evasion is usually confronted in two ways: audits and harsh sanctions.

zh: 但是，越来越猖獗的逃税现象表明这些机制充其量只是一种猫捉老鼠的游戏，而且看上去更多的时候老鼠是这场游戏的获胜者。
en: But, as the rising tide of tax evasion suggests, these mechanisms amount only to a cat game of and mouse problem – and the mice, it seems, are winning.

zh: 随着逃税行为的蔓延，出现了帮助隐瞒收入的完整的网络，使得那些违反法律的人受到惩罚的可能性变得更小。
en: As tax evasion becomes more pervasive, whole networks to help hide incomes have appeared, making it far less likely that those who break the law are punished.

zh: 此外，因为越来越多的人在逃避纳税，税务机关面临着越来越大的压力对他们表现得很宽容，或者，接受贿赂。
en: Moreover, because more people are evading taxes, tax administrations are under increasing pressure to become more lenient or to accept bribes.

zh: 削弱潜在的逃税者之间的联系的一种策略是引进各种不同的利益冲突。
en: One strategy for weakening ties among potential evaders is to introduce various conflicts of interests.

zh: 比如，增值税就是被设计来鼓励公司为它们购买的东西索取发票，以便降低它们自己的税收支出。
en: For example, value-added tax is designed to encourage firms to procure invoices for their inputs in order to reduce their own tax outlays.

zh: 但是其结果通常低于潜在的利益，因为增值税帮助促使逃税者建立能够掩盖整个交易链的更强大的网络。
en: But the results often fall short of the potential benefits, because VAT has helped inspire tax evaders to create even stronger networks that can hide an entire chain of transactions.

zh: 中国人想出了一个新奇的解决方案。
en: The Chinese have devised a novel solution.

zh: 为了鼓励消费者索取正式发票作为付款的证明，一些地方的税务机关发行了一种同时也是彩票的收据。
en: To encourage customers to request official receipts as proof of payment, some local tax authorities issue a type of receipt that doubles as a lottery ticket.

zh: 这些收据可以被用作刮刮卡，赢得小额的现金；但是同时它们也可以用作彩票，赢得更大数额的奖金。
en: The receipts can be used as scratch cards to win small amounts of cash, but they also serve as lottery tickets for winning larger amounts.

zh: 为了防止造假，企业必须购买专门用于印制这些收据的专利机器。
en: To prevent forgery, businesses must purchase special, patented machines for printing these receipts.

zh: 印制收据的记录被自动传输到税务机关，用于计算税额。
en: Records of the printed receipts are automatically transmitted to the tax authorities and are used to calculate taxes.

zh: 台湾和拉丁美洲也在使用类似的制度。
en: Similar systems are in use in Taiwan and Latin America.

zh: 另一种奖励消费者与逃税现象作斗争的方式是提供补贴。
en: Another way to reward consumers for combating tax evasion is to offer subsidies.

zh: 一些发展中国家为索取正式发票的消费者提供了一种广泛应用的增值税退款制度。
en: Some developing countries have introduced a far-reaching VAT refund system for consumers who collect official receipts.

zh: 北塞浦路斯，像土耳其一样，对于增值税给予2.5个百分点的退款，而标准的增值税率是13 % 。
en: Northern Cyprus, like Turkey, offers a 2.5 percentage point refund on VAT, compared to the standard VAT rate of 13%.

zh: 但是这种制度受到庞大的管理成本和合规成本的重压。
en: But such systems are burdened by large administration and compliance costs.

zh: 收集和确认索取退款的要求需要耗费很长的时间，而纳税人能够获得的净利益非常低。
en: The process of collecting and verifying claims is time-consuming, and the net benefit for taxpayers is low.

zh: 此外，这种方法在防范非法行为方面显得非常脆弱，比如收集出具给那些外国人和学生的收据，因为他们无法收到应该退还给他们自己的钱。
en: Moreover, the method is vulnerable to illicit practices, such as collecting receipts issued to foreigners and students, who cannot claim their own refunds.

zh: 发达国家也经常出于各种目的对消费提供现金补贴，其中很重要的一个目的就是打击逃税。
en: Monetary subsidies to consumption are also often granted in developed countries for a variety of purposes, not least of which is fighting tax evasion.

zh: 一种这样的补贴是允许从所得税中扣除固定百分比的某些费用。
en: One such subsidy is permitting deduction of a fixed percentage of certain expenses from income tax.

zh: 在意大利，过去十年改善房屋的费用部分是可以扣除的，这主要是为了提高房产业的企业在税收上的合规。
en: In Italy, expenditures for home improvements have been partly deductible for the past ten years, mainly to improve tax compliance by firms in the housing sector.

zh: 最近又出台了旨在打击夜间活动的新规定。
en: New regulations have recently been introduced with the specific aim of cracking down on moonlighting.

zh: 根据2007年的金融法律，那些要求扣除改善房屋的费用的人必须出示由建筑承包商提供的发票，发票上应标明劳务费用的数额。
en: Under the 2007 financial law, those who claim the home improvement deduction must supply an invoice from the building contractor, which must specify the cost for labor.

zh: 在减少逃税现象方面，各地的成效不尽相同。
en: In terms of reducing tax evasion, the results have been mixed.

zh: 大部分要求获得补贴的人来自意大利北部，而那里通常被认为逃税现象并没有那么普遍。
en: The bulk of claims for the subsidy come from northern Italy, which is usually considered less prone to tax evasion to begin with.

zh: 尽管有某些非法要求获得补贴的案例正在受到调查，但是并没有出现非法买卖收据的现象；欺诈看上去主要来自伪造的收据。
en: While some cases of illegitimate claims are under investigation, there is no black market for receipts; fraud seems to arise mainly through falsified invoices.

zh: 尽管在这方面没有进行过经济研究，但是粗略的数据显示申报的收入和进行申报的企业和正式工的数量都出现了增长。
en: While econometric studies are not available, raw data show an increase in reported income and in the number of firms and official workers.

zh: 但是，该行业可税收入的增长率还是比国民总收入的增长率要低。
en: However, taxable income in the sector is still growing at a slower rate than gross income as measured by national accounts.

zh: 尽管逃税现象现在非常普遍，但是纳税人在要求税收审计员强制开具发票时可能会承受很高的交易和心理成本。
en: When tax evasion is extremely common, taxpayers are likely to experience high transaction and psychological costs in resorting to tax auditors to enforce the issuing of receipts.

zh: 如果消费者承担了向行政机关报告违反法规的成本的冲击，那么补贴可能会诱使他们去寻找愿意提供合法交易的卖主。
en: But if consumers bear the brunt of costs for reporting violations to the authorities, subsidies may induce them to seek out vendors willing to offer legal transactions.

zh: 然而这些努力的成本同样也是极高的。
en: Yet these efforts are also costly.

zh: 任何时候当一家企业选择逃税时，要找到一家愿意进行合法交易的卖主就会变得越来越困难。
en: Whenever a firm chooses to evade, it becomes increasingly difficult to find a vendor willing to engage in legal transactions.

zh: 当替代的卖主越来越难寻找到时，对要求接受非法交易的补偿就会下降。
en: When alternatives become difficult to find, the compensation requested for accepting an illegal transaction falls.

zh: 在这些案例中，通常当逃税的群体达到一个关键的数量时，它的价值就会变得更高。
en: As typically happens in these cases, once a critical mass of tax evasion is reached, it can jump to much larger values.

zh: 这一过程也许可以解释为什么许多在一开始被证明是奏效的奖励制度其成效会很快消失。
en: This process might also explain why, although many reward systems have proven successful at the beginning, their benefits quickly fade.

zh: 当然，补贴和彩票也许会有削弱公民遵守税收法律的道德动力的危险，因为合规变成是以某种形式的补偿为条件的。
en: Of course, there is a risk that subsidies and lotteries may diminish the moral motivation of citizens to obey tax laws, because compliance becomes conditional on some form of compensation.

zh: 不过如果彩票、补贴和其他方式都不能控制逃税现象，中国人还有另外一种方法：死刑。
en: But if lotteries, subsidies, and other devices fail to control tax evasion, the Chinese have another method: the death penalty.

zh: 实证经济
en: Evidence-Based Economics

zh: 医药界发起行动，要求申请上市的新药必须经过“实证 ” 。
en: There is a movement in medicine to require that applications for licenses to sell a new drug be “evidence-based.”

zh: 与此形成对比的是，受过正规训练的经济学家人们却认为他们的学科已经达到了这个科学水准。
en: By contrast, trained economists view their discipline as having already achieved this scientific standard.

zh: 毕竟，他们用数学数据阐述观点，根据实验数据对大量不明确关系做出估算。
en: After all, they express their ideas with mathematics and arrive at quantitative estimates of implied relationships from empirical data.

zh: 但是经济学家们在选择理论范式之时并没有抱着实证主义的态度。
en: But economics is not evidence-based in selecting its theoretical paradigms.

zh: 经济政策往往在应做的实验性预试没有完成时，就已经被制定好了。
en: Economic policy initiatives are often taken without all the empirical pre-testing that could have been done.

zh: 一个有名的例子就是战后激进的凯恩斯学派领导下的宏观经济政策。
en: A notorious example is postwar macroeconomic policymaking under the radical Keynesians.

zh: 激进派依赖于凯恩斯未经测试的理论，即失业率取决于“有效需求 ” ， 而非“货币工资 ” ， 但是他们的政策忽略了工资这个部分，并期望把需求稳定地保持在一个较高水平上以保证“充分”就业。
en: The radicals relied on Keynes’s untested theory that unemployment depended on “effective demand” in relation to the “money wage,” but their policy ignored the part about wages and sought to stabilize demand at a high enough level to ensure “full” employment.

zh: 塞希尔·皮古（Cecil Pigou）和弗兰科·莫迪利安尼（Franco Modigliani）对此表示反对，如果能够成功扩大需求，货币工资的水平将会随之上升，直达需求水平，然后就会将就业率重新推回到原来水平。
en: Cecil Pigou and Franco Modigliani objected that if demand were successfully increased, the money wage level would rise, catch up to demand, and thus push employment back down to its previous level.

zh: 就业率无法通过扩大有效需求而维持在均衡路径水平之上。
en: Employment cannot be sustained above its equilibrium path by inflating effective demand.

zh: 然而，激进派在那个被经济学家哈利·约翰森 （Harry Johnson ） “ 蔑视与嘲笑”的年代却盛极一时。
en: Nevertheless, the radicals prevailed through what the economist Harry Johnson called “scorn and derision.”

zh: 在没有任何数据证明货币工资不会带来障碍的情况下，战后的宏观经济政策全盘奉献给了“充分”就业。
en: Postwar macroeconomic policies were dedicated to “full” employment, without any evidence that money wages would not get in the way.

zh: 直到1950年后期，新凯恩斯学派才最终同意皮古和莫迪利安尼提出的观点。
en: In the late 1950’s, neo-Keynesians finally conceded the point raised by Pigou and Modigliani.

zh: 威尔·菲利普斯（Will Phillips）对工资的研究著作让他们无从选择。
en: Will Phillips’s work on wages gave them no choice.

zh: 但是他们仍然坚持，如果需求以一个足够快的速度保持稳健的增长势头，那将使需求水平始终领先于货币工资水平，因此就业率就能如希望的那样居高不下，尽管这得以持续的通货膨胀为代价。
en: But they still insisted that steady increases of demand at a fast enough rate would keep demand one step ahead of the money wage level, so that employment could be kept as high as desired, albeit at the cost of steady inflation.

zh: 米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）和我却提出了不同的反对意见，认为实行这样的政策必须得有一个持续上涨的通货膨胀率。
en: In different ways, Milton Friedman and I objected, arguing that such a policy would require an ever-rising inflation rate.

zh: 我认为，只有防止代表性公司不会因为误认为其他公司的工资已经低于他们时提高工资，货币工资才会滞后于需求水平，但是这种不平衡维持不了太久。
en: Money wages will lag behind demand, I argued, only as long as the representative firm is deterred from raising wages by the misperception that wages at other firms are already lower than its own – a disequilibrium that cannot last.

zh: 新凯恩斯学派像激进派一样并没有将他们面临的挑战与实验性测试联系起来。
en: Like the radicals, the neo-Keynesians did not engage their challengers with empirical testing.

zh: 高需求水平带来的效益与信心息息相关。
en: The efficacy of high demand was a matter of faith.

zh: 然而1970年代发生的事件却把这种信心带入一个严峻的考验之中。
en: Yet events in the 1970’s put that faith to a cruel test.

zh: 当供给冲击袭击美国经济时，新凯恩斯学派的反应是拉动更多的需求，他们相信这能恢复就业率。
en: When supply shocks hit the US economy, the neo-Keynesians’ response was to pour on more demand, believing it would revive employment.

zh: 但是没有出现任何复苏迹象 — — 只是加速了通货膨胀。
en: There was little recovery – only faster inflation.

zh: 当前时期也颇为相似。
en: The current era offers a parallel.

zh: 尽管政策自从转变后已经反映出供给方经济和真正的经济周期论，新统治模式的缔造者和推动者却也表现出对确认数据的憎恶，这是一个很严重的错误。
en: Although policy has since shifted to reflect supply-side economics and real business-cycle theory, the new reigning paradigm’s builders and promoters display the same antipathy to checking data for serious error.

zh: 前车之鉴，后人之师：今年暂时低于正常的劳动力税率，与明年将重回正常税率的前景结合在一起，将促使许多家庭把更多的工作挤在今年，而在今后几年减少工作量。
en: An earlier classroom lesson was well-founded: temporarily below-normal tax rates on labor this year, when merged with the prospect of reversion to normal rates next year, will encourage households to squeeze more work into this year and to work less in future years.

zh: 这一观点最近已得到来自冰岛的数据的重新验证。
en: This proposition was recently tested anew on Icelandic data and performed well.

zh: 但是供应学派却又突然抛出了一个惊人的结论，持续降低劳动力税率将会持久性增加工作岗位 — — 还不会降低效率。
en: But the supply-siders jumped to the daring conclusion that a permanent cut in tax rates on labor would encourage more work permanently – with no diminution of effectiveness.

zh: 拉里·萨莫斯（Larry Summers）和我都对它的真实性表示怀疑。
en: Larry Summers and I both doubted that this could be generally true.

zh: 如果每次税后工资率的上升都会增加现有劳动力数量，我们推理可得，自十九世纪中期后，税后工资率的急剧增长应该已使工作时间惊人延长，退休年龄大大推后。
en: If every increase in the after-tax wage rate gave a permanent boost to the amount of labor supplied, we reasoned, steeply rising after-tax wages since the mid-nineteenth century would have brought an extraordinary increase in the length of the workweek and in retirement ages.

zh: 但是相反，工作时间却减少了，退休年龄也被提前，欧洲大陆的失业率反而更高了。
en: But both have fallen, and in continental Europe unemployment is higher.

zh: 在我看来，供应学派的中心观点建立在一个单纯的错误之上。
en: In my view, this core tenet of supply-side economics rests on a simple blunder.

zh: 决定可供劳动力数量的，是与收入财富相关的税后工资率。
en: What matters for the amount of labor supplied is the after-tax wage rate relative to income from wealth.

zh: 当税后工资率已经猛涨了一个多世纪，它所带来的财富和收入也一起随之迅速增长。
en: While after-tax wage rates soared for more than a century, wealth and the income it brought grew just as fast.

zh: 固然，若今年税率持续下降的话，那么一开始它将会对可供劳动力产生尤为积极的影响。
en: To be sure, if tax rates were decreased permanently this year, there would initially be a strongly positive effect on labor supplied.

zh: 但是那也会对储蓄产生积极作用，到明年乃至今后，这种作用就会影响到财富积累。
en: But there would also be a positive effect on saving and thus on wealth next year and beyond.

zh: 从长期来看，财富与税后工资有以相同比例增长的趋势，其对工作的影响将消失。
en: In the long run, wealth could tend to increase in the same proportion as after-tax wages. The effect on work would vanish.

zh: 然而，我们必须步步为营。
en: We must proceed cautiously, however.

zh: 根据标准分析，减税会使政府削减财务和劳务购买，比如国防开支。
en: In standard analyses, the tax cut brings a reduction in government purchases of goods and services, like defense.

zh: 但是，减税也会减少福利承诺 — — 社会援助、社会保险，此两者是社会财富的组成部分。
en: But a tax cut could instead contract the welfare state – social assistance and social insurance, which constitute social wealth.

zh: 从那个方面来说，减税虽然逐渐增加了个人财富，却会降低社会财富的数量。
en: In that case, the tax cut, while gradually increasing private wealth, would decrease social wealth.

zh: 这是一个实验性的问题。
en: The issue is an empirical one.

zh: 十年前Gylfi Zoega与我一同做的调查，肯定了劳力税的降低在短期内会促进就业。
en: Research I did with Gylfi Zoega a decade ago confirmed that cuts in taxes on labor boost employment in the short run.

zh: 但是长期呢？
en: But what about the long run?

zh: 税率对就业的长期影响有何国际性差异吗？
en: Do large long-run effects of tax rates show up in international differences in employment?

zh: 1998年我们为研究1990年代中期国家失业率和当今劳动力税率之间的联系而检查了经济合作发展组织(OECD)的数据。
en: In 1998 we examined OECD data for a correlation between national unemployment rates in the mid-1990’s and current tax rates on labor.

zh: 结果一无所获。
en: We found none.

zh: 2004年，我们研究了劳动力参与率，并再一次关注失业率。
en: In 2004, we looked at labor-force participation rates and again at unemployment.

zh: 仍然没有发现什么联系。
en: Still no correlation.

zh: 失业率高的国家包括高税收的德国、法国和意大利，但也包括低税收的日本和西班牙。
en: High-unemployment countries include high-tax Germany, France, and Italy, but also low-tax Japan and Spain.

zh: 低失业率的国家包括低税收的英国和美国，但是也有税收很高的丹麦和瑞典。
en: Low-unemployment nations include low-tax Britain and the US, but also very high-tax Denmark and Sweden.

zh: 当前，新自由主义学派告诉欧洲大陆，降低劳动税能够解决高失业率问题。
en: Neoliberals are now telling continental Europe that tax cuts on labor can dissolve high unemployment.

zh: 但是这样的降税所带来的效果，即使不是完全地，那也是在很大程度上转瞬即逝的 — — 尤其是当福利承诺被节省了的时候。
en: But the effectiveness of such tax cuts would be largely, if not wholly, transitory – especially if the welfare state was spared.

zh: 不出二十年，高失业率将重新悄悄潜回欧洲大���。
en: In two decades’ time, high unemployment would creep back.

zh: 由于降税所引发的错误期待将使政策制定者把重心从基础改革移开，而那些改革正是欧洲大陆要再创繁荣所必不可少的，因为高革新率、充分的就业岗位以及国际级生产力都要借助于此项改革。
en: The false hopes raised by cutting taxes would have diverted policy makers away from fundamental reforms that are necessary if the Continent is to achieve the dynamism on which high rates of innovation, abundant job creation, and world-class productivity depend.

zh: 基于证据的政策的问题
en: The Problem With Evidence-Based Policies

zh: 坎布里奇—从政府机构到慈善组织和援助组织，如今许多组织要求计划和政策必须“基于证据 ” 。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Many organizations, from government agencies to philanthropic institutions and aid organizations, now require that programs and policies be “evidence-based.”

zh: 要求政策基于证据，并且证据要尽可能优良，还要符合合理的时间和预算条件，这是有意义的。
en: It makes sense to demand that policies be based on evidence and that such evidence be as good as possible, within reasonable time and budgetary limits.

zh: 但是，这一方针的实施方法可能造成很多伤害，影响我们学习和改善我们的做法的能力。
en: But the way this approach is being implemented may be doing a lot of harm, impairing our ability to learn and improve on what we do.

zh: 目前的优良证据“黄金标准”是随机控制实验，即RCT。 RCT的思想产生于两个世纪前的医学，然后应用到农业，过去二十年成为经济学的流行做法。
en: The current so-called “gold standard” of what constitutes good evidence is the randomized control trial, or RCT, an idea that started in medicine two centuries ago, moved to agriculture, and became the rage in economics during the past two decades.

zh: 其之所以如此普及，是基于一个事实：它解决了统计推断中的关键问题。
en: Its popularity is based on the fact that it addresses key problems in statistical inference.

zh: 比如，富人衣锦。
en: For example, rich people wear fancy clothes.

zh: 那么，让穷人也衣锦能让他们变富吗？
en: Would distributing fancy clothes to poor people make them rich?

zh: 在这个例子中，相关性（衣与富）并不构成因果关系。
en: This is a case where correlation (between clothes and wealth) does not imply causation.

zh: 哈佛毕业生得到好工作。
en: Harvard graduates get great jobs.

zh: 是哈佛擅长教学 — — 还是只是选出了无论如何都能赢得好生活的聪明人？
en: Is Harvard good at teaching – or just at selecting smart people who would have done well in life anyway?

zh: 这就是选择偏差的例子。
en: This is the problem of selection bias.

zh: RCT通过随机地向参与试验者分配“治疗”和“安慰剂 ” （ 从而制造“控制”组）解决这些问题。
en: RCTs address these problems by randomly assigning those participating in the trial to receive either a “treatment” or a “placebo” (thereby creating a “control” group).

zh: 通过观察两组参与者在干预后的不同，治疗的效果就能得到评估。
en: By observing how the two groups differ after the intervention, the effectiveness of the treatment can be assessed.

zh: RCT在药品、小微贷款、培训项目、教育工具和其他多种干预中都有实施。
en: RCTs have been conducted on drugs, micro-loans, training programs, educational tools, and myriad other interventions.

zh: 设想你正在考虑用平板电脑改善在校学习。
en: Suppose you are considering the introduction of tablets as a way to improve classroom learning.

zh: RCT要求你选取300家左右的学校作为参与者，其中150家被随机指派为控制组，不获得平板电脑。
en: An RCT would require that you choose some 300 schools to participate, 150 of which would be randomly assigned to the control group that receives no tablets.

zh: 在分配平板电脑前，你应该做一番所谓的基线调查，评估有孩子们在学校的学习情况。
en: Prior to distributing the tablets, you would perform a so-called baseline survey to assess how much children are learning in school.

zh: 然后，你向150家“治疗”学校分派平板电脑，静待效果。
en: Then you give the tablets to the 150 “treatment” schools and wait.

zh: 一段时间后，你需要做另一个调查，看看现在收到平板电脑的学校和没有收到平板电脑的学校之间是否存在学习差异。
en: After a period of time, you would carry out another survey to find out whether there is now a difference in learning between the schools that received tablets and those that did not.

zh: 假设没有发现显著差异，这一结果和四项发现分派书籍也根本没有效果的RCT一样。
en: Suppose there are no significant differences, as has been the case with four RCTs that found that distributing books also had no effect.

zh: 由此认为平板电脑（或书籍）没有改善学习是不正确的。
en: It would be wrong to assume that you learned that tablets (or books) do not improve learning.

zh: 你只证明了装了某种软件、使用了某种教法进行某种概念教学的某种平板电脑没有产生差异。
en: What you have shown is that that particular tablet, with that particular software, used in that particular pedagogical strategy, and teaching those particular concepts did not make a difference.

zh: 但我们想要回答的真正问题是如何使用平板电脑最大化学习效果。
en: But the real question we wanted to answer was how tablets should be used to maximize learning.

zh: 在这里，设计空间着实巨大，而RCT只能一次测试最多两三种设计 — — 并且只能在很小的空间中测试。
en: Here the design space is truly huge, and RCTs do not permit testing of more than two or three designs at a time – and test them at a snail’s pace.

zh: 这可以改进吗？
en: Can we do better?

zh: 设想以下思想实验：我们在平板电脑中嵌入某种机制，让教师实时了解他/她的学生在吸收教学材料方面做得如何。
en: Consider the following thought experiment: We include some mechanism in the tablet to inform the teacher in real time about how well his or her pupils are absorbing the material being taught.

zh: 我们允许所有教师用不同软件、不同教法、不同的使用新工具的方式做实验。
