en: We free all teachers to experiment with different software, different strategies, and different ways of using the new tool.

zh: 迅速的反馈环将让教师调整教法以实现表现最大化。
en: The rapid feedback loop will make teachers adjust their strategies to maximize performance.

zh: 一段时间后，我们将观察到一些教师发现了高效的教法。
en: Over time, we will observe some teachers who have stumbled onto highly effective strategies.

zh: 我们将他们的做法与其他教师分享。
en: We then share what they have done with other teachers.

zh: 注意这一方法的截然不同之处。
en: Notice how radically different this method is.

zh: 这一方法不是让300家学校中的150家实施相同的计划，以此测试一种设计的效果，而是让所有教师去寻找结果，以此实现设计空间的“蠕变 ” （ crawling ） 。
en: Instead of testing the validity of one design by having 150 out of 300 schools implement the identical program, this method is “crawling” the design space by having each teacher search for results.

zh: 该方法不做基线调查和最终调查，而是持续提供表现反馈。
en: Instead of having a baseline survey and then a final survey, it is constantly providing feedback about performance.

zh: 该方法不需要计量经济学家用集中化方法做研究然后向所有人公布实验结果，而是让教师以分散地方方式做研究，向中心报告他们的发现。
en: Instead of having an econometrician do the learning in a centralized manner and inform everybody about the results of the experiment, it is the teachers who are doing the learning in a decentralized manner and informing the center of what they found.

zh: 显然，在调整教法时，教师会混淆相关性和因果关系；但这些误差很快就会被发现，因为错误的假设不会带来更好的结果。
en: Clearly, teachers will be confusing correlation with causation when adjusting their strategies; but these errors will be revealed soon enough as their wrong assumptions do not yield better results.

zh: 类似地，选择偏差也会发生（某些地方因为其他方式不同而效果不如其他地方 ） ； 但如果不同的环境要求不同的教法，那么系统迟早会找到这样的教法。
en: Likewise, selection bias may occur (some places may be doing better than others because they differ in other ways); but if different contexts require different strategies, the system will find them sooner or later.

zh: 这一策略更加类似于机器学习算法的社会实施，而不是临床试验。
en: This strategy resembles more the social implementation of a machine-learning algorithm than a clinical trial.

zh: 在经济学中，RCT可谓无处不在，特别是在国际发展领域，尽管诺贝尔奖获得者安格斯·迪顿（Angus Deaton ） 、 兰特·普莱切特（Lant Pritchett）和丹尼·罗德里克（Dani Rodrik）等人批评RCT支持者夸大其词。
en: In economics, RCTs have been all the rage, especially in the field of international development, despite critiques by the Nobel laureate Angus Deaton, Lant Pritchett, and Dani Rodrik, who have attacked the inflated claims of RCT’s proponents.

zh: 一个严重的缺陷是外部有效性。
en: One serious shortcoming is external validity.

zh: 教训很难推广：如果一项RCT发现，向危地马拉儿童提供微量元素改善了他们的学习，你会因此向挪威儿童提供微量元素吗？
en: Lessons travel poorly: If an RCT finds out that giving micronutrients to children in Guatemala improves their learning, should you give micronutrients to Norwegian children?

zh: 我认为RCT的主要问题是它让我们以错误的方式思考干预、政策和组织。
en: My main problem with RCTs is that they make us think about interventions, policies, and organizations in the wrong way.

zh: 与拿两三项设计供RCT慢慢测试（就像在学校里使用平板电脑或挂图）不同，大部分社会干预存在数百万种设计可能性，其结果取决于这些可能性之间的复杂组合。
en: As opposed to the two or three designs that get tested slowly by RCTs (like putting tablets or flipcharts in schools), most social interventions have millions of design possibilities and outcomes depend on complex combinations between them.

zh: 这导致了复杂科学家斯图尔特·考夫曼（Stuart Kauffman）所谓的“崎岖的拟合景观 ” 。
en: This leads to what the complexity scientist Stuart Kauffman calls a “rugged fitness landscape.”

zh: 正确组合参数至关重要。
en: Getting the right combination of parameters is critical.

zh: 这需要组织实施哈佛大学国际发展中心（Center for International Development）的马特·安德鲁斯（Matt Andrews ） 、 兰特·普莱切特和迈克尔·伍尔考克（Michael Woolcock）所提出的革命性策略，做各种尝试，通过快速反馈环迅速研究表现。
en: This requires that organizations implement evolutionary strategies that are based on trying things out and learning quickly about performance through rapid feedback loops, as suggested by Matt Andrews, Lant Pritchett and Michael Woolcock at Harvard’s Center for International Development.

zh: RCT也许适用于临床药物实验。
en: RCTs may be appropriate for clinical drug trials.

zh: 但对于范围极为宽泛的政策领域，RCT运动的影响相当于让审计师主管研发部门。
en: But for a remarkably broad array of policy areas, the RCT movement has had an impact equivalent to putting auditors in charge of the R&D department.

zh: 这绝非设计有用物品的正确方法。
en: That is the wrong way to design things that work.

zh: 只有创造出学习如何学习的组织，如产业界所做的所谓的精益生产，我们才能加速进步。
en: Only by creating organizations that learn how to learn, as so-called lean manufacturing has done for industry, can we accelerate progress.

zh: 归咎于个人的罪恶
en: Evil Personified

zh: 德克萨斯州大学城 — — 将战争和个人罪恶混为一谈如果不是现代国际政治中人们的共同选择，也无疑已经成为一种普遍现象。
en: COLLEGE STATION, TEXAS – Equating war with individual evil has become ubiquitous – if not universal – in contemporary international politics.

zh: 战争被冠之以反对专制暴君及其治下非法政府的名号。
en: Wars are fights against evil tyrants and the illegitimate governments they control.

zh: 尤其对于那些必须直接对民意变化做出反应的当选领导人来讲，这样的花言巧语降低了发动和支持战争的难度，也让他们更容易为发动战争找到借口。 在当今这个被媒体所左右的时代，这样的说法在任何社会中都同样有效。
en: Such rhetoric makes wars easier to justify, easier to wage, and easier to support, especially for elected leaders who must respond directly to swings in public opinion.  Such language works equally well for any society in today’s media-obsessed age.

zh: 难怪政治领导人一直力图将国际冲突个人化。
en: Little wonder, then, that political leaders consistently personalize international conflicts.

zh: 这样的陈词滥调还加大了避免和结束战争的难度，有人认为还使战争更加具有破坏性。
en: Alas, such commonplace language also makes wars harder to avoid, harder to end, and arguably more deadly.

zh: 将罪恶归咎于个人的花言巧语在美国的例子中很容易观察到，但这却绝不是美国所独有的现象。
en: The rhetoric of personified evil is easily seen through American examples, but is hardly a uniquely American phenomenon.

zh: 中国领导人将台海关系的紧张状况归咎于台湾，将西藏问题归咎于达赖喇嘛。
en: Chinese leaders blame Taiwanese leaders for cross-straits tensions, and blame the Dalai Lama for all that ails Tibet.

zh: 同样，世界各地的抗议者将乔治·W·布什比作希特勒，而所有伊斯兰国家的毛拉则程式化地将美国总统称之为人间撒旦，并在同时重申对于美国人民的根本的喜爱。
en: So, too, have protestors around the world made George W. Bush resemble Hitler, and mullahs throughout the Islamic world ritualistically harangue US presidents as earthly Satans, simultaneously noting their basic affection for the American people.

zh: 近代美国领袖们发现如果没有这些粉饰之辞的颂扬和支持作为铺垫，部署军队几乎是不可能的。
en: Recent American leaders, for their part, find it nearly impossible to deploy military force without first employing such rhetoric as both mantra and crutch.

zh: 其中尤以1917年的例子最为著名。
en: The most famous example came in 1917.

zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊要求对德国宣战时说 ， “ 我们与德国人民无怨无仇。
en: Woodrow Wilson, asking for a declaration of war against Germany, said, “We have no quarrel with the German people.

zh: 我们对他们的感情只有同情和友谊。
en: We have no feeling toward them but one of sympathy and friendship.

zh: 德国政府卷入这场战争并不是他们的本意。
en: It was not upon their impulse that their Government acted in entering this war.”

zh: ”只有德皇及其罪恶的党羽需要为此负责。
en: Only the Kaiser and his evil henchmen were to blame.

zh: 1990年，乔治·H·W·布什又搬出了同样的理由 ： “ 我们与伊拉克人民无怨无仇。
en: In 1990, George H.W. Bush made the same plea: “We have no quarrel with the Iraqi people.”

zh: ”他的儿子在2003年也说过同样的话，并补充说“他们是萨达姆·侯赛因压迫的牺牲者。
en: His son said the same thing in 2003, adding, “they are the daily victims of Saddam Hussein’s oppression.”

zh: ”乔治·W·布什早先还曾说过美国人民“与阿富汗人民无怨无仇 ” ， 我们所针对的只有基地组织及其塔利班支持者。
en: George W. Bush had earlier noted that Americans “had no quarrel with the people of Afghanistan,” only with Al Queda and their Taliban supporters.

zh: 他甚至将这写进了2008年最后一次国情咨文讲话，称“我们对伊朗人民的态度非常明确：我们与你们无怨无仇…我们对伊朗领导人的态度也非常明确：在国际社会的监督下停止你们的铀浓缩活动，这样才能开始谈判。 ”
en: He even employed this phrase in his final State of the Union address in 2008, saying that “Our message to the people of Iran is clear: We have no quarrel with you….Our message to the leaders of Iran is also clear: Verifiably suspend your nuclear enrichment, so negotiations can begin.”

zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊之后的历任美国总统在任期间，都曾不止一次地借用过与国外敌人“无怨无仇”这句话。
en: Every American president since Wilson has, at least once while in office, uttered the phrase “have no quarrel with” a foreign enemy.

zh: 通常在这样的声明发表几天、有时甚至是几小时后，美国就会投下第一枚炸弹。
en: Such statements are typically made only days, sometimes hours, before the first American bombs fall.

zh: 比尔·克林顿在轰炸塞尔维亚之前就曾承诺“无论我怎样强调美国与塞尔维亚人民无怨无仇都不过分。
en: Bill Clinton promised on the eve of the bombing of Serbia that “I cannot emphasize too strongly that the United States has no quarrel with the Serbian people.”

zh: ”巴拉克·奥巴马在竞选时曾经承诺“我们与伊朗人民无怨无仇。
en: Barack Obama promised from the campaign trail that “We have no quarrel with the Iranian people.

zh: 伊朗人民清楚艾哈迈迪内贾德总统鲁莽、不负责任，不关心他们的日常需求。 ”
en: They know that President Ahmadinejad is reckless, irresponsible, and inattentive to their day-to-day needs.”

zh: 总统们这样说话自有其理由。
en: Presidents employ such language for good reason.

zh: 他们知道本国人民自视为全世界人民的熔炉，他们宁愿与独裁者交战而不愿侵犯国外的兄弟和同胞。
en: They know their public, a self-styled melting pot of peoples, would rather fight dictators than brothers and cousins abroad.

zh: 实际上，威尔逊最初的提法是人口和政治困境所造成的结果。
en: Indeed, Wilson’s initial formulation grew from a demographic and political quandary.

zh: 1917年超过三分之一的美国人都来自德国及其盟国。
en: More than one-third of Americans in 1917 could trace their heritage back to Germany and its allies.

zh: 威尔逊无法像英法领导人常作的那样要求他的人民去“杀死德国佬 ” ， 因为威尔逊的太多战士至少从种族渊源上划分本身就来自德国。
en: Wilson could not implore his people to “kill the Krauts,” as British or French leaders frequently did, because so many of Wilson’s soldiers were, by ethnicity at least, Krauts themselves.

zh: 相反，他巧妙地将美国士兵从手足相残的杀人魔鬼变成了他们古老祖国的解放者。
en: He instead rhetorically transformed American soldiers from fratricidal killers into liberators of their ancient fatherland.

zh: 只有当外国敌人与美国人想象有出入的情况下美国总统才能对该国全体民众发动战争。
en: Only when foreign enemies looked different from what Americans conceived themselves to be could presidents wage war against a people as a whole.

zh: 这样，富兰克林·罗斯福可以在敦促美国人不让世界“落入 希特勒 和 墨索里尼 主宰”的同时，告诉他们“我们正在对 日本 发动战争。
en: Thus, Franklin Roosevelt could simultaneously urge Americans to keep the world from being “dominated by Hitler and Mussolini ,” even as he told them that “we are now in the midst of a war against Japan .”

zh: ”欧洲的战争是要解放被专制暴君压迫的民众，而太平洋战争则是一场种族战争。
en: The war in Europe was a war to liberate oppressed peoples from tyrants. The war in the Pacific was a race war.

zh: 像这样适应政治需要的语言自有其战略问题。
en: Such politically expedient language has a strategic downside.

zh: 首先，一旦你将冲突的责任归咎于某一个人，比如萨达姆·侯赛因或金正日，那么就很难看到在专制暴君不垮台的情况下解决国际争端的希望。
en: First, once you pin blame for a conflict on a single individual, a Saddam Hussein or Kim Jong Il, it is difficult to see a solution to international conflict that does not result from the tyrant’s downfall.

zh: 想象一下如果从未爆发过第二次伊拉克战争，那么布什在称萨达姆·侯赛因为当代的希特勒之后，该怎样在2005或2006年与萨达姆赌博。
en: Imagine Bush parlaying with Saddam Hussein in 2005 or 2006, if war had never come again to Iraq, after having called him this generation’s Hitler.

zh: 更麻烦的是将冲突的原因与某个人划等号，这常常会掩盖国际冲突更潜在也更系统的性质。
en: More troubling is the identification of conflict with a single human source, which obscures the more systemic and insidious nature of international conflict.

zh: 我们再想象一下，如果不久前那段历史以不同的方式发展，萨达姆·侯赛因实际上接受了布什政府11小时的逃亡建议而不是选择接受战争。
en: Again, imagine if recent history had gone differently, and Saddam had in fact taken the Bush administration’s eleventh-hour offer of exile rather than war.

zh: 或者如果在战争爆发初期杀死萨达姆的最初努力取得了成功。
en: Or if the initial attempt made on Saddam’s life in the war’s first hours had been successful.

zh: 如果伊拉克真像布什所认为的那样拥有大规模杀伤性武器，那么侯赛因的逃离将会使这些武器落入谁的手中？
en: If Iraq indeed had weapons of mass destruction, as Bush believed, Hussein’s departure would have left such weapons in the hands of…whom exactly?

zh: 将战争与某一个独裁者等同起来的做法因此会给决策者带来战略方面的限制。
en: Equating war with a solitary tyrant thus imposes strategic limitations for policymakers.

zh: 而且矛盾的是，这样做还会增加平民的伤亡人数。
en: It also leads, paradoxically, to a greater number of civilian deaths.

zh: 对准外国独裁者或其安全设施的炸弹几乎肯定会杀死远离权力走廊的民众。
en: Bombs aimed at foreign dictators or their security apparatus almost invariably kill individuals far from the corridors of power.

zh: 他们的死亡更容易为外界所容忍，也更容易找到借口，只要飞行员和士兵，还有在家观看电视转播的公众认为这种暴力至少针对的是邪恶的化身。
en: Their deaths are easier to stomach, and to justify, so long as airmen and soldiers, and the public watching at home, believe the violence was at least directed against evil incarnate.

zh: 这样的巧言令色显然非常有效。
en: Such rhetoric clearly works.

zh: 它在世界各国都具有普遍性。
en: It is global in nature.

zh: 但它也掩盖了战争的真正理由，让世界各国民众找到不将暴力和冲突视作达到目的的一种手段，而将其视为神圣的解放、自由和消灭暴政目标的借口。
en: But it also helps make the world a more dangerous place by obscuring the real reasons for war, and by allowing peoples around the world to justify violence and conflict not as a means to an end, but rather as a holy mission of liberation, freedom, and the eradication of tyranny.

zh: 除非政治领袖拒绝以罪恶的花言巧语为由发动战争，否则战争本身不太可能消除。
en: Until political leaders reject the rhetoric of evil as a justification for war, war itself is unlikely to disappear.

zh: 进化的新前沿
en: Evolution’s New Frontiers

zh: 三岛 — — 近期我们对分子机制理解的突破彻底改变了包括细胞生物学和发育生物学在内的众多生物学领域。
en: MISHIMA – Recent breakthroughs in our understanding of molecular mechanisms have revolutionized many fields of biology, including cell biology and developmental biology.

zh: 上述新技术同时顺理成章地为进化生物学提供了有价值的见解，包括用证据支持了我在1973年提出的近乎于中性的分子进化理论。
en: So it is no surprise that these advances are providing valuable insights into the field of evolutionary biology as well, including evidence supporting the nearly neutral theory of molecular evolution that I developed in 1973.

zh: 就像典型的科学一样，进化生物学的每一项新发现提出的问题都和回答的一样多。
en: As is typical in science, each new discovery in evolutionary biology raises as many questions as it answers.

zh: 事实上，我所研究的领域正在进入150年历史上活力最旺盛的时期之一。
en: Indeed, my field is now going through one of the most dynamic periods in its 150-year history.

zh: 在查尔斯·达尔文的《物种起源》发表大约一个世纪后，科学家们认为类似自然选择之父所描述的程序管理着基因突变的整个过程。
en: For roughly a century after the publication of Charles Darwin’s On the Origin of Species, scientists believed that genetic mutations were governed by a process similar to that described by the father of natural selection.

zh: 上述思想认为相比不具备优秀遗传变异的个体，那些具备优秀遗传变异的个体将更有可能生存、繁衍和传递他们的基因。
en: The idea was that individuals with superior genetic variants would be more likely to survive, reproduce, and pass on their genes than those without them.

zh: 因此，有害的基因突变会迅速消亡。
en: As a result, harmful mutations would quickly die out.

zh: 而有益的则会扩散到整个种群。
en: Beneficial ones would spread until the entire species carried them.

zh: 进化改变，包括形态上的改变被视为日积月累和有益突变不断扩散的结果，种群的基因构成被认为接近同质化，只有极少数随机突变成为造成个体差异的主因。
en: Evolutionary changes, including morphological ones, were thought to be the result of the accumulation and distribution of beneficial mutations, and the genetic makeup of populations was believed to be close to homogeneous, with only a few rare, random mutations creating differences between one individual and another.

zh: 脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）的发现挑战了上述观点的可信性。
en: That view was challenged by the discovery of DNA.

zh: 因为现在可以对个人基因组成进行分析，人们逐渐了解到种群中存在的基因变异比主流进化论所做的预测要多得多。
en: As it became possible to analyze an individual’s genetic makeup, it become apparent that there was much more variation within populations than prevailing evolutionary theory predicted.

zh: 事实上，类似特征的人可以有完全不同的基因序列。
en: Indeed, individuals could have similar traits but very different gene sequences.

zh: 而这显然违背了所谓的自然选择法则。
en: This appeared to contradict the principles of natural selection.

zh: 我已故的同事木村本雄最先提出了支撑上述理论的证据，他假定存在对个体既非有利亦非有害的中性基因突变，因此也不受自然选择的管辖。
en: One of the first attempts to square the theory with the evidence was proposed by my late colleague Motoo Kimura, who posited the existence of neutral mutations – gene variants that are neither advantageous nor harmful to an individual, and therefore not influenced by natural selection.

zh: 木村研究了蛋白质进化率，并于1968年提出了分子进化的中性学说。
en: Kimura examined the rate of evolutionary change of proteins and proposed the neutral theory of molecular evolution in 1968.

zh: 他的理论认为导致分子水平进化改变的不是自然选择而是随机的遗传漂变，他的理论很好地解释了研究人员发现的遗传变异现象。
en: His theory – which held that evolutionary changes at the molecular level are caused not by natural selection, but by random genetic drift – provided a good explanation for the genetic variation that researchers had discovered.

zh: 木村的理论简单而优雅，但将突变分为有益、中性和有害的不同类别在我看来似乎太简单了。
en: Kimura’s theory was simple and elegant, but the classification of mutations into the distinct classes – beneficial, neutral, or harmful – seemed too simple to me.

zh: 我本人的研究表明具有微小正面或负面影响的边缘突变可能在推动进化改变时意义重大。
en: My own work showed that borderline mutations, those with very small positive or negative effects, could be very important in driving evolutionary changes.

zh: 近乎中性的分子进化论正是以这种假设为基础的。
en: This insight was the basis of the nearly neutral theory of molecular evolution.

zh: 二十一世纪基因组和群体遗传学的数据爆炸在开拓全新研究领域的同时支持了我在42年前提出的理论。
en: The explosion of data on genomes and population genetics in the twenty-first century has not only lent new support to my 42-year-old theory; it has also uncovered broad new areas of research.

zh: 比方说，动态折叠过程的发现大大拓宽了我们对蛋白质结构和功能的认识。
en: Our knowledge of the structure and function of proteins, for example, has been greatly expanded through the discovery of dynamic folding processes.

zh: 人们认为上述过程提供了或许与近中性突变有关的蛋白质功能的灵活性。
en: These are thought to provide flexibility in how proteins function, in a way that may be connected to nearly-neutral mutations.

zh: 确定驱动形态进化的基因表达的分子机制堪称进化生物学最有趣的挑战。
en: Among the most interesting challenges in evolutionary biology is the attempt to identify the molecular mechanisms of gene expression that drive morphological evolution.

zh: 上述研究领域试图更好地了解个体细胞内一系列复杂的系统过程。
en: The field is in the process of gaining a better understanding of a host of complex systems within individual cells.

zh: 上述分子系统处在试验胚胎学的核心位置 — — DNA序列差异无法解释的基因功能改变是试验胚胎学的研究内容。
en: These molecular-level systems are at the heart of epigenetics – the study of changes in genetic function that cannot be explained by differences in DNA sequences.

zh: 试验胚胎学的关键是要理解遗传组成、基因型和我们实际观察到的特征之间的联系。
en: Epigenetics is crucial for comprehending the link between the genetic composition, or genotype, and the traits we can actually observe.

zh: 具体到人类等高等生物，细胞内由脱氧核糖核酸 、蛋白质和核糖核酸等组成的复合物大分子链（也叫核染色质）控制着试验胚胎学的进程。
en: In higher organisms – such as humans – epigenetic processes are controlled by chromatin, a complex of macromolecules inside cells consisting of DNA, protein, and RNA.

zh: 遗传和环境因素反过来又塑造了核染色质的运行方式，让人们很难把握它们的功能。
en: The way chromatin works is, in turn, shaped by genetic and environmental factors, making their functioning difficult to grasp.

zh: 但因为能够造成某些人类疾病，这些快速进化、充满变数的大分子链非常值得研究。
en: These rapidly evolving, highly variable macromolecules are well worth studying, however, as they may be the cause of some human diseases.

zh: 遗传组成和可观测性状间关系的另一要素是蛋白质有时是可以修改的。
en: Another factor in the relationship between genetic composition and observable traits is the way that proteins can sometimes be modified.

zh: 比方说，蛋白酶可以开启或关闭，并借此改变蛋白质的行为和功能。
en: For example, protein enzymes can be turned on and off, thereby altering their function and activity.

zh: 像其他形式的基因表达一样，貌似由一系列先天及环境因素的组合来驱动这一过程。
en: This process, like other forms of genetic expression, seems to be driven by a combination of innate and environmental factors.

zh: 看起来不能孤立地研究某项单一结构；选择、漂变和试验胚胎学等因素在非常基础的水平上共同作用、密不可分。
en: No single mechanism, it seems, can be studied in isolation; at a very basic level, factors like selection, drift, and epigenetics work together and become inseparable.

zh: 我们对曾经认为的直接进化过程了解越深入，就越能发现它们的奇妙和复杂。
en: The deeper we dive into what we once thought were straight-forward evolutionary processes, the more wondrous and complex they are revealed to be.

zh: 值得欢迎的进化论危机
en: Evolutionary Theory’s Welcome Crisis

zh: 艾克赛特—那些相信宇宙由超自然生物所创的人从未对进化论构成过智识上的威胁。
en: EXETER – Those who believe that a supernatural being created the universe have never posed an intellectual challenge to evolutionary theory.

zh: 但是，神创论者，不论他是圣经原教旨主义者还是“智能设计”信徒，确实构成了对科学思维的威胁。
en: But creationists, whether biblical fundamentalists or believers in “intelligent design,” do pose a threat to scientific thinking.

zh: 事实上，神创论的阴鸷之处在于它可以重新阐释进化论，将它嵌入自身的教条主义信仰体系（因此也是科学的对立面）中。
en: Indeed, creationism’s insidious genius lies in its ability to reinvent evolution in its own image as a dogmatic belief system – and thus the antithesis of science.

zh: 神创论者有一点是正确的：与该问题的流行观点给人的印象相反，进化论正处于危机之中。
en: The creationists are right about one thing: contrary to the impression given by much popular writing on the subject, the theory of evolution is in crisis.

zh: 但这是积极的发展态势，因为这反映了科学知识的非线性进步，托马斯·库恩在其名著《科学革命的结构 》 （ The Structure of Scientific Revolutions）中将其称为“范式变迁 ” 。
en: But this is a positive development, because it reflects the non-linear progress of scientific knowledge, characterized by what Thomas Kuhn described in his influential book The Structure of Scientific Revolutions as “paradigm shifts.”

zh: 在过去70年中，进化论科学的主流范式是所谓的“新综合 ” （ new synthesis ） 。
en: For the last 70 years, the dominant paradigm in evolutionary science has been the so-called “new synthesis.”

zh: 牛津大学进化生物学家理查德·道金斯（Richard Dawkins）近年来做了大量推广新综合范式的工作。 新综合范式将他的自然选择理论与孟德尔遗传理论结合了起来。
en: Widely publicized in recent years by Oxford evolutionary biologist Richard Dawkins, the new synthesis unites Darwin’s theory of natural selection with Mendelian genetics, which explains heredity.

zh: 进化论科学的当前危机并不意味着这一范式是完全错误的。
en: The current crisis in evolutionary science does not imply complete rejection of this paradigm.

zh: 反之，这体现了对现有知识的大整合和进步性重组，并没有破坏进化论的基本原理：今天活在世上的生物体是由与之大相径庭的上古祖先发展而来；不同生物体可能具有共同祖先；而自然选择在这一过程中扮演关键角色。
en: Rather, it entails a major, progressive reorganization of existing knowledge, without undermining the fundamental tenets of evolutionary theory: organisms alive today developed from significantly different organisms in the distant past; dissimilar organisms may share common ancestors; and natural selection has played a crucial role in this process.

zh: 不过，其他假设则遇到了危机。
en: Other assumptions, however, are under threat.

zh: 比如，在代表进化的传统“生命树”上，枝干永远在分叉而不会汇合，这表明物种的血统发展遵循线性路径，所有沿着这条路径发生的进化变化都发生在世系追溯过程中。
en: For example, in the traditional “tree of life” representation of evolution, the branches always move apart, never merging, implying that species’ ancestry follows a linear path, and that all evolutionary changes along this path occur within the lineage being traced.

zh: 但对基因组的考察（特别是微生物基因组）表明，关系疏远的生物体之间的基因移动是进化的重要催化剂。
en: But examination of genomes – particularly microbes – has shown that genes moving between distantly related organisms are an important catalyst of evolutionary change.

zh: 此外，新综合范式假设进化的主要动力是物种内部随机产生的微小突变。
en: Moreover, the new synthesis assumes that the main drivers of evolution are small mutations generated by chance within a species.

zh: 但最新的证据表明，由吸收大量外来基因物质引发的重大变化也许同样是进化的主要动力。
en: But recent evidence suggests that large changes, caused by the absorption of a chunk of alien genetic material, may be just as significant.

zh: 事实上，吸收整个生命体 — — 比如组成第一个真核细胞（通常发现于多细胞动物体内的较复杂的细胞类型）的两个细菌 — — 可能造成重大且关键性的进化。
en: Indeed, the absorption of entire organisms – such as the two bacteria that formed the first eukaryotic cell (the more complex cell type found in multicellular animals) – can generate large and crucial evolutionary change.

zh: 进一步动摇进化论的是人们逐渐意识到，许多因素（而不仅仅是基因组）决定了个体生命的发展。
en: Further destabilizing evolutionary theory is the growing realization that many factors, not just the genome, determine an individual organism’s development.

zh: 讽刺的是，DNA结构的发现 — — 当初被称为新综合范式彻底胜利的最后一击 — — 使人们更好地理解了基因组的功能，最终却削弱了人们关于它们单独决定了生物发展方向的观念。
en: Ironically, as the discovery of DNA’s structure – initially lauded as the final act in the triumph of the new synthesis – led to a better understanding of genomes�� functioning, it ended up weakening belief in their unique role in directing biological development.

zh: 那些长期以来强烈抗议进化模型忽略发育过程的人 — — 几十年来，这一批评被冠以进化发育生物学的名号 — — 以及坚持生命体的发育需要利用各种资源的人被证明是正确的。
en: Those who long deplored the omission of development from evolutionary models – a decades-old critique made under the scientific banner of evolutionary developmental biology (“evo-devo”) – together with the insistence that organisms’ development draws on a wide variety of resources, have been vindicated.

zh: 分子生物学的新发展为传统基因决定论钉上了最后一颗棺材钉。
en: Recent developments in molecular biology have put the final nail in the coffin of traditional genetic determinism.

zh: 比如，实验胚胎学 — — 不改变基因编码的可遗传基因组修改 — — 正在崛起。
en: For example, epigenetics – the study of heritable modifications of the genome that do not involve alterations to the genetic code – is on the rise.

zh: 许多种类的小RNA分子被逐渐认为能够充当高于基因组的决定因素。
en: And the many kinds of small RNA molecules are increasingly recognized as forming a regulatory layer above the genome.

zh: 除了推翻主宰公共观点数十年之久的以基因为中心的进化论，这些发展还表明需要有心的理论框架。
en: Beyond undermining the gene-centered theories of evolution that have dominated public consciousness for several decades, these developments call for new philosophical frameworks.

zh: 传统科学还原论者专注于“自下而上”机制，不足以理解自上而下和循环的因果关系，也不能理解嵌套过程的世界。
en: Traditional reductionist views of science, with their focus on “bottom-up” mechanisms, do not suffice in the quest to understand top-down and circular causality and a world of nested processes.

zh: 这把我们带回了出发点。
en: This brings us back to where we started.

zh: 彻底反思进化论免不了要引起神创论者的注意，他们欢欣鼓舞地宣称，如果达尔文主义的专业支持者都不能形成一致，那么这个概念肯定在式微。
en: Radically rethinking evolutionary theory invariably attracts the attention of creationists, who gleefully announce that if professional advocates of Darwinism cannot agree, the concept must be in retreat.

zh: 而面对如此反应，进化论者总是如临大敌般地宣称绝无异议。
en: And, evolutionists, confronted with this response, tend to circle the wagons and insist that everyone is in agreement.

zh: 但是，没有比神创论者的“分歧等于失败”观点更能说明它与科学之间的极端对立的了。
en: But nothing more clearly demonstrates that science and creationism are polar opposites than the latter’s assumption that disagreement signals failure.

zh: 事实上，正是分歧 — — 以及由此产生的更深层次的洞见 — — 让我们找到了更好地理解科学的方法。
en: In fact, disagreement – and the deeper insights that result from it – enables new approaches to scientific understanding.

zh: 科学不是教条主义信仰体系，分歧在科学中是值得鼓励的。
en: For science, unlike for dogmatic belief systems, disagreement is to be encouraged.

zh: 进化论当前的意外危机 — — 以及我们的无力预测该领域50年后会怎样 — — 是值得庆幸的。
en: Evolutionary theory’s current contretemps – and our inability to predict where the field will be in 50 years – are a cause for celebration.

zh: 让神创论者沉浸在自己的空洞信念中去吧，我们不妨愉快地拥抱理解世界的真正实证方法所固有的不确定性。
en: We should leave the creationists to their hollow convictions and happily embrace the uncertainties inherent in a truly empirical approach to understanding the world.

zh: 菜单的演化
en: Evolution on the Menu

zh: 爱丁堡—不管某些食谱怎么说，大自然对于智人的饮食计划，是相当仁慈的。
en: EDINBURGH – While some diet books might suggest otherwise, nature has been very accommodating in its meal plan for Homo sapiens.

zh: 其他类人猿，比如大猩猩和红毛猩猩，都是素食者（尽管一些黑猩猩会吃猴子 ） ， 但演化让人类“杂食化 ” ， 并让我们自己决定大部分饮食决策。
en: Whereas other great apes, like gorillas and orangutans, are vegetarian (though some chimpanzees will eat monkey), evolution has made humans “omnivores” and left most culinary decisions up to us.

zh: 那么，演化是什么时候让人可以吃肉的呢？
en: So, when did evolution enable humans to eat meat?

zh: 两条线索 — — 物种家族树和化石记录 — — 可以让我们管中窥豹。
en: Two sources – our species’ family tree and the fossil record – offer clues.

zh: 人类家族树的分叉朝它的根部汇拢，指向这些分叉的共同祖先。
en: The branches of the human family tree converge as they descend toward the root, revealing common ancestors where branches join.

zh: 人类和猩猩的共同祖先生活在五百万年前，尽管我们不确定这个祖先是什么，但想必主要甚至只吃素食。
en: The shared ancestor of humans and chimps lived some five million years ago, and, while we do not know for certain what that ancestor ate, the best guess is that it was mainly, if not exclusively, vegetarian.

zh: 如果说五百万年前的人类元祖第一次有了选择包括肉类在内的食谱的机会，那么最后一次这样的机会发生在什么时候？
en: If five million years ago is the earliest date that human ancestors could have opted for a diet that included meat, what is the latest date by which this might have happened?

zh: 这个问题的一个答案可以从“露西”的骨架残骸上寻找线索。 露西是人类的类人猿祖先化石，发现于1974年。
en: One answer to that question can be gleaned from the skeletal remains of “Lucy,” a pre-human fossil ancestor of humans, discovered in 1974.

zh: 她属于南方古猿阿法种，这种古猿生活在300—400万年前的东非，被认为是我们所属的智人的直接祖先。
en: Lucy belonged to a species called Australopithecus afarensis, which lived in East Africa between 3-4 million years ago and is thought to have been the immediate ancestor of our genus, Homo.

zh: 2009年，人们首次找到了露西所在物种吃肉的证据。 研究者发掘了一座埃塞俄比亚遗址，出土了两件339万年历史的化石化的动物骨头，上面有石刀刻上去的标记。
en: The first evidence that Lucy’s species might have eaten meat came in 2009, when researchers excavating a site in Ethiopia unearthed two 3.39-million-year-old fossilized animal bones scored with markings made with a stone blade.

zh: 这些标记被解释为屠宰动物的记录，但有人质疑为何遗址中没有发现屠夫的“刀刃 ” 。
en: The marks were interpreted to mean that the animals had been slaughtered, but skeptics questioned why no butcher’s “blades” were found in the vicinity.

zh: 五年后，遗失的证据出现在了另一座东非遗址中。 330万年前，某种生物便在制作钝石器，用途 显然是屠宰。
en: Then, five years later, the missing evidence showed up at another site in East Africa where, 3.3 million years ago, some creature was making flaked stone tools for the apparent purpose of butchery.

zh: 这个日期要早于大部分属于智人种的生物，因此肯定是智人的祖先。
en: This date is too early for that creature to have belonged to a species of Homo, so it must have been an ancestor.

zh: 最有可能的是南方古猿阿法种，而如果露西不是素食者，那么她的后代 — — 我们 — — 很有可能一直是杂食动物。
en: The most likely candidate is Australopithecus afarensis, and if Lucy was no vegetarian, then her descendants – us – have very likely always been omnivores.

zh: 演化也许让人类具备了食肉的能力，但吃多少、吃不吃则完全由我们自己决定。
en: Evolution may have equipped humans with the ability to eat meat, but it left us with plenty of latitude to decide how much, if any at all.

zh: 一个更“顽固”的演化遗留是我们与奶的关系。
en: A more inflexible evolutionary legacy involves our relationship with milk.

zh: 母乳可能是生物学驱使我们必须吃的唯一食物。
en: Mother’s milk may be the only food that humans were biologically programmed to consume.

zh: 但全世界有三分之二成年人因为乳糖不耐而不能喝液态奶。 乳糖几乎只在存在于奶中。
en: And yet two-thirds of adults worldwide cannot drink liquid milk, because they are intolerant to lactose, a sugar that is found almost exclusively in milk.

zh: 对于这种不耐的解释是产生乳糖酶（让身体能够消化乳糖的酶）的基因一般会在儿童时代晚期消失。
en: The explanation for this intolerance is that the gene that codes for the production of an enzyme called lactase, which enables babies to digest the lactose, is normally switched off in late childhood.

zh: 对于这个问题，有两个办法解决。
en: There are two solutions to this problem.

zh: 首先，安纳托利亚（Anatolia）农民在大约10,000年前，让细菌去分解乳糖，将奶变为凝乳、奶酪和酸奶。
en: The first, invented by farmers in Anatolia about 10,000 years ago, is to allow bacteria to consume the lactose, turning milk into curd, cheese, and yoghurt.

zh: 如此，乳糖敏感人士也可以毫无阻碍的消化这些乳制品了。
en: That is why a lactose-sensitive person can comfortably digest these dairy products.

zh: 第二个办法来自演化。
en: The second solution was provided by evolution.

zh: 大约7,000年前，中欧农民出现了基因突变，乳糖酶基因不再会在儿童时代晚期消失。
en: About 7,000 years ago, a genetic mutation arose among farmers in Central Europe that prevented the lactase gene from being switched off in childhood.

zh: 携带这一突变的人类终身都能安全饮用液态奶，而不会产生乳糖不耐个体需要承受的不良反应。
en: People carrying this mutation are able to drink liquid milk safely throughout their lives, without the unpleasant side effects that lactose-intolerant individuals suffer.

zh: 这一突变对于继承者来说是一大优势，而随着携带者进入北欧，在农民中间迅速传播，形成了人类历史上扩张最迅速的演化事件之一。
en: This mutation was a great advantage to those who inherited it, and carriers multiplied among farmers as they swept into Northern Europe, creating one of the fastest-spreading evolutionary event humans have ever experienced.

zh: 如今，大约90%的北欧人，以及相近比例的欧洲裔北美人，为乳糖耐受型。
en: Today, some 90% of Northern Europeans, and a similar percentage of North Americans who trace their ancestry to Europe, are lactose-tolerant.

zh: 非洲、南亚和中东的部分地区也独立演化出了相同效果的突变。
en: Other mutations with the same effect have evolved independently in parts of Africa, South Asia, and the Middle East.

zh: 人类饮食习惯在动物中独树一帜，因为我们无处不在，无所不吃。
en: The human diet is unique among animals because we are ubiquitous and eat whatever is at hand.

zh: 事实上，人类食用数千种动物和大约7,000种植物。
en: In fact, humans consume thousands of animal varieties and some 7,000 plant species.

zh: 但尽管我们吃的每一样东西都有演化维度，其中却很少有禁食效果 — — 肉类和奶类从不同方式证明了这一点。
en: But while everything we eat has an evolutionary dimension, this rarely contains any prohibitions – as meat and milk illustrate in different ways.

zh: 简言之，选择也许是决定人类饮食的最大因素。
en: Simply put, choice may be the biggest factor shaping human diets.

zh: 生物学决定了我们能吃什么，而文化决定了我们要吃什么。
en: Biology provides the potential in our cuisine, but it is culture that writes the menu.

zh: 何以为人
en: What Makes a Human?

zh: 圣安德鲁斯，苏格兰—上个月，电影发烧友们纷纷涌入影院观看《猩球崛起3：终极之战 》 。 在这部影片中，一支经逆转录病毒“改造”过的灵长类大军，向人类发起了战争。
en: ST ANDREWS, SCOTLAND – Last month, moviegoers flocked to theaters to see War for the Planet of the Apes, in which an army of retrovirus-modified primates wage war against humanity.

zh: 猩猩们骑在马上，举着机枪，还能做学究，这毫无疑问构成了一部好看的影片。
en: Chimpanzees on horseback, machine-gun-wielding gorillas, and scholarly orangutans undoubtedly make for good theater.

zh: 但这些东西真的会在现实中发生吗？
en: But could anything like this ever happen in real life?

zh: 在皮埃尔·布尔（Pierre Boulle）1963年的影片原著小说《人猿星球 》 （ Planet of the Apes）中，星际旅行者尤利西斯·梅鲁（Ulysse Mérou）被困在了一个由大猩猩、红毛猩猩和黑猩猩统治的星球上，他们复制了从前人类主人的语言、文化和科技。
en: In Planet of the Apes, Pierre Boulle’s 1963 novel upon which the films are based, space traveler Ulysse Mérou is stranded on a terrifying planet ruled by gorillas, orangutans, and chimpanzees who have copied their former human masters’ language, culture, and technology.

zh: 与此同时，人类则退化为野蛮淳朴的野兽。
en: The humans, meanwhile, have degenerated into brutal and unsophisticated beasts.

zh: 《人猿星球》中的邪恶现实主义（sinister realism）大多来自布尔对当时的动物行为研究的科学细节和知识的细致关注。
en: Much of the sinister realism in Planet of the Apes stems from Boulle’s impressive attention to scientific detail and knowledge of research into animal behavior at that time.

zh: 他的小说利用了一个流行至今的概念：大猩猩和海豚等动物拥有复杂但隐蔽的、人类无法理解的通讯系统。
en: His book tapped into the still-popular notion that animals such as chimpanzees and dolphins have complex but covert communication systems that humans cannot even fathom.

zh: 许多人宁可相信，认为动物无法说话的“傲慢”科学家无非是无法解释动物的发出的信号而已。
en: Many people would prefer to think that all those “arrogant” scientists who have concluded that animals cannot talk have simply failed to decode animals’ calls.

zh: 但布尔的书终归是虚构的，因为地球上的猩猩永远无法通过单纯的模仿而获得人类文化。
en: But Boulle’s book is decidedly a work of fiction, because apes here on Earth could never actually acquire human culture solely through imitation.

zh: 在现实中，复杂的文化需要通过漫长演化过程所产生的基本生物能力。
en: In reality, complex culture requires underlying biological capabilities that are fashioned over long periods of evolution.

zh: 黑猩猩根本不具有必要的语言控制和心理能力来创造语言。
en: Chimpanzees simply do not have the vocal control or physiology to produce speech.

zh: 此外，现代猿类即使在脑力增强药物的作用下，也无法达到高度智能。
en: Moreover, modern apes could not be made highly intelligent even with brain-enhancing drugs.

zh: 尽管微生物可以改变行为 — — 比如狂犬病病毒能让宿主产生暴力和攻击性 — — 但永远无法授予一个物种语言。
en: And although microbes can change behavior – such as when rabies renders its host violent and aggressive – they could never bestow language upon a species.

zh: 我们之所以知道这一点，是因为我们全面研究动物的沟通已有一个多世纪，而科学证据表明，非人类物种基本上不具有真正的复杂沟通能力。
en: We know this because animal communication has been investigated extensively for more than a century, and the scientific evidence yields few hints of truly complex communication faculties in non-human species.

zh: 比如，20世纪40年代的研究者曾在家中饲养了一只名叫维基（Viki）的黑猩猩。
en: For example, in the 1940s, researchers raised a chimpanzee named Viki in their home.

zh: 但维基只学会了四个单词 — — “妈妈 ” 、 “爸爸 ” 、 “杯子”和“向上 ” — —而这已经比早前的一个将黑猩猩和人类孩子饲养在一起的实验有所进步了。
en: But Viki learned just four words – “mama,” “papa,” “cup,” and “up” – which was more than could be said for an earlier experiment in which a chimpanzee and a human child were reared together.

zh: 这个实验在黑猩猩一个单词都学不会，而人类孩子实际上已经在开始模仿黑猩猩的声音时不得不叫停。
en: That exercise had to be abandoned after the chimpanzee failed to learn a single word, and the child actually started imitating chimpanzee sounds.

zh: 在伺候的几十年中，研究者指导猿类符号语言，产生了一些令人振奋的结果。
en: In the following decades, studies teaching apes sign language generated much excitement.

zh: 但几乎所有语言学家都认为，这些实验中的猿类并没有产生语言。
en: And yet virtually all linguists would agree that the apes in these experiments had not produced language.

zh: 它们能够记住符号的意义，但无法习得语法规则。
en: They could memorize the meanings of signs, but they could not learn the rules of grammar.

zh: 很能说明问题的是 ， “ 说话的”猿类的语言表达极端以自我为中心。
en: Tellingly, utterances by “talking” apes proved to be exceedingly egocentric.

zh: 在具备了说话的手段后，猿类的沟通局限于诸如“给偶食物”等欲望的表达。
en: When equipped with the means to talk, apes’ communications are limited to expressions of desire such as “Gimme food.”

zh: “说话的”猿类有记录的最长句子是一只名叫尼姆·钦普斯基（Nim Chimpsky）的黑猩猩说的，内容是“给橙子我给吃橙子我吃橙子给我吃橙子给我你。
en: The longest recorded statement of any “talking” ape, by a chimpanzee named Nim Chimpsky, was, “Give orange me give eat orange me eat orange give me eat orange give me you.”

zh: ”看起来，黑猩猩、倭黑猩猩和大猩猩都只是非常拙劣的对话者。
en: It turns out that chimpanzees, bonobos, and gorillas make for poor conversationalists.

zh: 相反，在发出第一批单词之后不出几个月，两岁的人类儿童就能够造出复杂的、符合语法规则的、主体多样化的句子，这些句子包含动词、名词、介词和限定语。
en: By contrast, within months of uttering their first words, two-year-old children can produce complex, grammatically correct, and topically diverse sentences comprising verbs, nouns, prepositions, and determiners.

zh: 他们之所以能够如此，是因为人类思维已经进化到能够理解和产生语言。
en: They can do so because human minds have evolved to comprehend and produce language.

zh: 许多学者认为，语言产生自运用有意义的符号。
en: Many scholars believe that language emerged from the use of meaningful signs.

zh: 我们的祖先生活在一个充满了符号的世界里，这形成了有利于让我们能够有效操纵符号的神经结构的演化反馈。
en: Our ancestors were immersed in a symbol-rich world, and this generated evolutionary feedback favoring the neural structures that enable us to manipulate symbols efficiently.

zh: 今天的人类语言中的句法之所以形成，是因为我们的祖先曾经长期使用象征性原型语言。
en: The syntax in human language today was made possible by our ancestors’ long use of symbolic proto-languages.

zh: 基因和文化共同进化，重新组织了人类大脑。
en: Genes and culture coevolved to reorganize the human brain.

zh: 战争也是如此。 战争远远不只是扩大了规模的攻击。
en: The same is true of warfare, which is much more than just scaled-up aggression.

zh: 在战争中，复杂的机构规定了严格的行为模式和个体角色，从而促进合作。
en: In war, complex institutions dictate strict behavioral codes and individual roles that facilitate cooperation.

zh: 研究表明，如果物种不具备复杂的文化以及制度化惩罚和被社会认可的报复等特征，就无法演化出这种水平的合作。
en: Research suggests that this level of cooperation could not evolve in a species that lacked a complex culture and such features as institutionalized punishment and socially sanctioned retaliation.

zh: 这些范式大部分并不浅显，因此需要反复灌输，这通常发生在幼年阶段。
en: Most of these norms are not obvious, and thus have to be inculcated, usually during youth.

zh: 但即使是精通模仿的猿类，也没有令人信服的证据表明真的可以教会它们行为。
en: But even among apes that are proficient imitators, there is little compelling evidence that behaviors are actively taught.

zh: 当猿类确实出现了合作时，大多是为了帮助亲属。
en: When apes do cooperate, it is largely to help relatives.

zh: 人类合作的规模 — — 为数巨大的彼此无关的个体在一起工作 — — 此前从未出现过，因为这需要建立在习得和可以进行社会传播的范式的基础上。
en: The scale of human cooperation, which involves huge numbers of unrelated individuals working together, is unprecedented largely because it is built upon learned and socially transmitted norms.

zh: 如今，大量证据表明，我们的祖先的文化活动通过自然选择改变了人类的大脑，而这一改变又进一步强化了我们反复进行这一循环的文化能力。
en: There is now extensive evidence that our ancestors’ cultural activities changed the human brain through natural selection, which then further enhanced our cultural capabilities in recurring cycles.

zh: 比如，喝牛奶始于新石器时代早期人类，他们因此暴露于适合分解富含能量的乳糖的基因的强烈选择。
en: For instance, milk-drinking began with early Neolithic humans, who were consequently exposed to strong selection favoring genes that break down energy-rich lactose. This genetic-cultural coevolution explains why many of us with pastoralist ancestors are lactose tolerant.

zh: 毫无疑问，布尔过于强调模仿。
en: It is little wonder that Boulle put such an emphasis on imitation.

zh: 人类在长长的模仿者名单中的位次被大大降低，他们模仿彼此的恐惧反应来识别掠食者、规避危险。
en: Humans are descended from a long line of imitators, who mimicked each other’s fear responses to identify predators and avoid danger.

zh: 如今，这体现在同情和其他形式的情绪传染中，它们构成了直击人心的电影体验。
en: Today, this is reflected in empathy and other forms of emotional contagion that make movies a heartfelt experience.

zh: 如果不具有这些特征，看电影的我们就都是一群反社会分子，对谋杀和亲吻都无动于衷。
en: Without these traits, we would all watch movies like sociopaths, equally unmoved by a murder or a kiss.

zh: 我们的祖先也是通过模仿学会了屠宰尸体、点火以及制造挖掘工具、长矛和鱼钩。
en: It was also through imitation that our forebears learned how to butcher carcasses, build fires, and make digging tools, spears, and fishing hooks.

zh: 这些其他数不清的技能让我们能够随心所欲地破译其他物种的活动，用我们的肌肉、肌腱和关节来改造它们。
en: These and countless other skills left us supremely adapted to decipher others’ movements, and reproduce them with our own muscles, tendons, and joints.

zh: 千万年后，今天的电影明星在模仿其他灵长类的活动过程中也表现出同样的天赋，能够达到任何其他物种难以企及的精确度。
en: Eons later, today’s movie stars demonstrate the same aptitude when imitating the movements of other primates, with a precision that no other species can match.

zh: 人类文化历经了千年演化，绝不是其他物种能够轻易获得的。
en: Human culture, having evolved over millennia, is not something that another species can easily pick up.

zh: 我们可以高枕无忧地认定，地球上永不可能发生灵长类之间的战争。
en: We can rest assured that there will be no inter-primate war on Earth.

zh: 要想发生这样的事情，另一个物种就必须经历类似的漫长的进化之旅。
en: For that to happen, another species would have to undergo a similarly prolonged evolutionary journey.

zh: 而地球上唯一的真正好战的猿类将会不顾一切地阻止这一幕的发生。
en: And the only real warmongering ape on the planet seems hell-bent on preventing that.

zh: 埃沃·莫拉莱斯和民粹主义悖论
en: Evo Morales and the Populist Paradox

zh: 拉巴斯 — — 埃沃·莫拉莱斯成功修改了玻利维亚宪法，再次当选总统。
en: LA PAZ – Evo Morales succeeded in amending the Bolivia’s constitution and being re-elected President.

zh: 并且依靠在议会中的多数席位，日前又成功填补了司法职位的空缺，成为玻利维亚现代史上权力最大的总统。
en: And, backed by his parliamentary majority, he was recently able to fill vacant judicial posts, making him the most powerful president in Bolivia’s contemporary history.

zh: 反对势力认为莫拉莱斯正在恢复专制元首的传统，将大权独揽到自己一人手中，让政府机构仅仅剩下形式上的作用。
en: According to his opponents, Morales is reproducing the tradition of caudillismo, concentrating power in his hands and turning government institutions into mere formalities.

zh: 但五年来莫氏广受欢迎的事实表明多数玻利维亚人似乎并不为国家民主面临威胁而忧心忡忡。
en: But his immense popularity over the past five years suggests that most Bolivians do not seem very worried in putting their country’s democracy at risk.

zh: 民粹主义悖论在很大程度上造就了莫拉莱斯的成功。
en: Morales’s success rests largely on the paradox of populism.

zh: 尽管他对外宣称反对经济自由主义，但他本人却是市场经济推动和造就的政治自由的产物。
en: Although he claims to oppose economic liberalism, he is a product of the political liberties that it promotes and feeds on the benefits generated by the market economy.

zh: 莫拉莱斯出身于安第斯高原的一个农民家庭，其后在古柯繁荣的开始阶段在查帕雷站住了脚跟。
en: Morales was born into a peasant household on the Andean altiplano and later established himself in Chapare at the beginning of the coca boom.

zh: 工会领袖的身份让他得以脱离土地，进入政界，后又因对美国的尖锐批评而获得了广泛的关注，美国长期坚定不移的反毒斗争意味着要彻底根除古柯这种贫苦农民赖以维生的经济作物。
en: His career as a union leader took him away from agriculture and into politics, where he stood out for his criticism of the United States, whose anti-drug crusade meant the eradication of a cash crop for poor peasants.

zh: 通过为安第斯地区沿用长达几个世纪之久的可卡因原料古柯叶辩护，莫拉莱斯成功地将反对美国禁毒政策与捍卫本国文化传统和穷人的经济权利挂钩。
en: By defending the coca leaf, consumed for centuries in the Andean world and the raw material for cocaine, Morales was able to link his opposition to America’s anti-drug policy with the defense of native cultural tradition and the economic rights of the poor.

zh: 因此，莫拉莱斯的统治是三大标志性领域的成功融合：民族主义情绪、对穷人的关注和玻利维亚人越来越强烈的民族自豪感。
en: Thus, Morales’s leadership brought together three strongly symbolic dimensions: nationalist sentiment, concern for the poor, and emerging ethnic pride among Bolivia’s native peoples.

zh: 但莫拉莱斯之所以能够成为融合这三大标志领域的领袖确乎反映了这样一个事实：20世纪90年代的机构改革扩大了社会参与基础，为新兴领导人和政治运动带来了发展机遇。
en: But the making of Morales as a leader able to combine these three dimensions reflects two institutional reforms in the 1990’s that expanded social participation and opened up opportunities for new leaders and political movements.

zh: 玻利维亚国内的“自治市”区划致使税收资源和决策权力转移到民间团体手中，农业联合会也因此能够控制重要城镇的局势并承担相应的管理责任。
en: The division of the country into municipalities transferred tax resources and decision-making capabilities to communities, thereby enabling agricultural unions to control several towns and assume management responsibilities.

zh: 新的政党也由此出现，1997年成立的区域委员会使得像莫拉莱斯这样具有强大地方根基的政治领袖在没有任何主要政党支持的情况下成功跻身于玻利维亚议会。
en: This led to the formation of new political parties, and the creation of regional councils in 1997 made it possible for leaders with strong local roots – like Morales – to reach Bolivia’s congress without any major party’s backing.

zh: 登上核心政治舞台的莫拉莱斯议员随即利用手中的宪法豁免权进一步强化工会活动并反对禁毒政策。
en: Once situated at the center of the political scene, Congressman Morales took advantage of his constitutional immunity to intensify his union activities and his fight against anti-drug policies.

zh: 2002年大选期间，莫拉莱斯意外得到了美国大使的强力推动，这位大使宣布自己反对莫拉莱斯当选，并由此激起了玻利维亚民众强烈的民族主义情绪。
en: In the 2002 elections, Morales received an unexpected boost from the US ambassador, who, by declaring himself against Morales, stirred up nationalist sentiment.

zh: 莫拉莱斯随即以绝对优势在2005年的总统选举中获胜。
en: Morales went on to win the 2005 presidential election with an absolute majority.

zh: 其他政党相互揭短让莫拉莱斯从中渔利，这些政党甚至捍卫不了20年来自己所取得的成就。
en: The other parties made it easier for him by discrediting each other, failing even to defend their own achievements over the previous 20 years.

zh: 让莫拉莱斯崛起成为可能的另外两个因素是玻利维亚石油工业的复兴和建立起石油收入的分配机制。
en: Two other factors that made Morales’s rise possible were the revival of Bolivia’s oil industry and the creation of mechanisms for distributing the income that oil produces.

zh: 这两大因素直到现在仍然是莫氏执政的支柱。
en: Both now sustain his rule.

zh: 此外，20世纪90年代中期的私人投资提高了天然气的产量。
en: Private investment in the mid-1990’s, moreover, increased output of natural gas.

zh: 天然气很快就以利润丰厚的价格向巴西出口。
en: Soon gas was being exported – very profitably – to Brazil.

zh: 因此，在莫拉莱斯执政期间，玻利维亚经济能够从原材料价格的全球繁荣中分得一杯羹。
en: Thus, when Morales came to power, Bolivia’s economy was in a position to take advantage of the global price boom for raw materials.

zh: 也正因为如此，虽然莫氏政府的民族主义和中央集权政策赶走了投资并阻碍了对新市场的进入，但是财政收入却依然持续飙升。
en: As a result, revenues increased, despite his government’s nationalist and statist policies, which drove away investment and hindered access to new markets.

zh: 2005年来，玻利维亚的出口和财政收入已经是原来的6倍。
en: Since 2005, Bolivian exports have increased six-fold, along with fiscal revenue.

zh: 按照莫拉莱斯前任总统确立起来的模式，这笔财富被自动分配给地方政府，从而使国内最边远的地区都能享受到资源带来的好处。
en: This money is distributed automatically to local governments, according to the model established by Morales’s predecessors, carrying resources to the farthest reaches of the country.

zh: 但需要强调的是借助所谓“新自由主义”时代转移资金流获益的不仅是地方政府，普通的玻利维亚家庭也从中得到了好处，这种好处主要来自于无需缴费即自动向60岁以上公民发放的全民退休金，约有30%以上的家庭能够享受到全民退休金所带来的好处。
en: But it is not only local governments that have benefited; through cash transfers created during the so called neo-liberal years, families have gained as well, most importantly through a universal and non-contributive old-age pension benefit given to persons over 60, which reaches slightly more than 30% of households.

zh: 近年来政府又开始发放公立学校的学生补助和孕妇在医疗中心的分娩补助，但上述措施的政治意义远比其经济意义更为重要。
en: In recent years, aid for students at public schools and maternity assistance for pregnant women at health centers have been created, but these have a greater political than economic impact.

zh: 事实上，莫拉莱斯的经济计划常常事后被证实空洞无物，这方面的例子有与委内瑞拉签订的碳氢化合物供应协议和与印度签订的铁矿石供应合同。
en: Indeed, Morales’s economic initiatives usually turn out to be empty, such as his deals with Venezuela for hydrocarbon supplies and with India for iron.

zh: 莫氏工业化开发国内天然气田的计划到现在仍然停留在一句空洞的承诺。
en: His plan to exploit and industrialize the country’s gas fields remains just a promise.

zh: 玻利维亚经济在莫氏治下温和增长，这主要归功于国际需求和从国家到地方政府及个���的转移现金流。
en: The Bolivian economy has grown moderately under Morales’s management, owing to international demand and cash transfers from the state to local governments and individuals.

zh: 这不仅拉动了家庭消费，而且也为正规和非正规部门提供了难得的贸易机会，并因此成为战胜贫困最成功的政策。
en: These not only increase household spending, but also offer opportunities for trade, in both the formal and informal sectors, making it the most successful policy in the fight against poverty.

zh: 于是，尽管官方言论意在鼓吹国家干预，但莫拉莱斯政府却从市场机制中获得了大部分好处。
en: Thus, despite official speeches intended to support state intervention, Morales’s government benefits mainly from the workings of the market.

zh: 人们并不十分在意国家计划和项目的失败，因为国内市场虽然规模不大，但却生机勃勃，而这股生机实际来自于包括走私和贩毒增长在内的经济自由化。
en: The failure of state plans and projects is overlooked because of the small but expanding internal market, which is invigorated by de facto economic liberalism involving the growth of smuggling and drug traffic.

zh: 这些非法活动并非政府的本意，但却增加了农民、承运商、建筑工人和商人的收入。
en: These illicit activities are not intended, but they increase the income of peasants, transporters, builders, and businessmen.

zh: 这就是21世纪社会主义的悖论：经济自由化恰恰为想要取代它的政策提供了基础。
en: This is the paradox of twenty-first-century socialism: economic liberalism is the foundation for a policy that aspires to replace it.

zh: 作为政治方案这种局限性同样是致命的。
en: This might also be its greatest limitation as a political project.

zh: 对全球软经济的硬审视
en: A Hard Look at a Soft Global Economy

zh: 米兰—全球经济正在滑向低速增长轨道，这是拜决策者无能或不愿在全球水平上解决主要障碍所赐。
en: MILAN – The global economy is settling into a slow-growth rut, steered there by policymakers’ inability or unwillingness to address major impediments at a global level.

zh: 事实上，即使是当前低迷的增长速度，可能也是不可持续的。
en: Indeed, even the current anemic pace of growth is probably unsustainable.

zh: 问题在于对全球经济表现障碍的诚实评估是否能刺激决策者行动起来。
en: The question is whether an honest assessment of the impediments to economic performance worldwide will spur policymakers into action.

zh: 2008年以来，发达经济体真实（经通胀调整的）累计增长只有5—6 % 。
en: Since 2008, real (inflation-adjusted) cumulative growth in the developed economies has amounted to a mere 5-6%.

zh: 中国GDP增长了70%左右，是全球增长的最大贡献者，但在很大程度上受到债务助长的投资的推动。
en: While China’s GDP has risen by about 70%, making it the largest contributor to global growth, this was aided substantially by debt-fueled investment.

zh: 而事实上，随着这一刺激因素的消失，发达国家需求不足对中国增长的影响已经越来越明显。
en: And, indeed, as that stimulus wanes, the impact of inadequate advanced-country demand on Chinese growth is becoming increasingly apparent.

zh: 增长正在受到腹背夹击。
en: Growth is being undermined from all sides.

zh: 杠杆率正在上升，自全球金融危机爆发以来，全世界债务已高达57万亿美元。
en: Leverage is increasing, with some $57 trillion having piled up worldwide since the global financial crisis began.

zh: 这一杠杆 — — 大多是大部分发达经济体货币扩张的结果 — — 甚至连提振长期总需求这一目标都没有达到。
en: And that leverage – much of it the result of monetary expansion in most of the world’s advanced economies – is not even serving the goal of boosting long-term aggregate demand.

zh: 毕竟，有利的货币政策充其量只能为更加持久的需求源的出现赢得时间。
en: After all, accommodative monetary policies can, at best, merely buy time for more durable sources of demand to emerge.

zh: 此外，长期保持低利率推高了资产价格，使它们背离基础经济表现。
en: Moreover, a protracted period of low interest rates has pushed up asset prices, causing them to diverge from underlying economic performance.

zh: 但尽管利率可能继续保持低位，但它们对资产价格的影响可能已无法持久。
en: But while interest rates are likely to remain low, their impact on asset prices probably will not persist.

zh: 因此，资产回报相较于不久前可能出现下滑；资产价格已普遍认为存在泡沫，修正走势一触即发。
en: As a result, returns on assets are likely to decline compared to the recent past; with prices already widely believed to be in bubble territory, a downward correction seems likely.

zh: 财富效应对消费和去杠杆化的积极作用也不太可能维持。
en: Whatever positive impact wealth effects have had on consumption and deleveraging cannot be expected to continue.

zh: 世界还面临严重的投资问题，降低资本成本对于这个问题几乎毫无用处。
en: The world also faces a serious investment problem, which the low cost of capital has done virtually nothing to overcome.

zh: 目前，公共部门投资低于维持强劲增长所需要的水平，因为其规模不足以产生足够的总需求和生产率的提高。
en: Public-sector investment is now below the level needed to sustain robust growth, owing to its insufficient contribution to aggregate demand and productivity gains.

zh: 这一公共投资短缺的最可靠的解释是财政约束。
en: The most likely explanation for this public investment shortfall is fiscal constraints.

zh: 的确，债务和存在资金缺口的非债务负债日益压迫着公共资产负债表和退休基金，破坏强力可持续增长的基础。
en: And, indeed, debt and unfunded non-debt liabilities increasingly weigh down public-sector balance sheets and pension funds, eroding the foundations of resilient, sustainable growth.

zh: 但如果降低主权债务过重的最佳办法是实现更高的名义GDP增长（真实增长与通胀之和 ） ， 那么减少投资 — — 促增长战略的关键要素 — — 绝非可靠方法。
en: But if the best way to reduce sovereign over-indebtedness is to achieve higher nominal GDP growth (the combination of real growth and inflation), cutting investment – a key ingredient in a pro-growth-strategy – is not a sound approach.

zh: 相反，预算规则必须将公共投资排除在外，从而促进不同的财政整合应对措施。
en: Instead, budget rules should segregate public investment, thereby facilitating a differential response in fiscal consolidation.

zh: 增加公共部门投资有助于刺激私人部门投资，而私人部门投资也承受着巨大的压力。
en: Increased public-sector investment could help to spur private-sector investment, which is also severely depressed.

zh: 在美国，投资仍未超越危机前水平，尽管GDP增长了10 % 。
en: In the United States, investment barely exceeds pre-crisis levels, even though GDP has risen by 10%.

zh: 而美国绝非个例。
en: And the US is not alone.

zh: 显然，总需求不足通过降低扩大产能的激励起作用。
en: Clearly, deficient aggregate demand has played a role by reducing the incentive to expand capacity.

zh: 在一些国家，结构僵化造成了极大的消极投资激励，影响了投资回报。
en: In some economies, structural rigidities adversely affect investment incentives and returns.

zh: 类似地，监管不透明性 — — 或更广义的经济政策方向的不确定性 — — 也阻碍了投资。
en: Similarly, regulatory opacity – and, more broadly, uncertainty about the direction of economic policy – has discouraged investment.

zh: 而某些类型的股东积极主义造成了企业的短视。
en: And certain types of shareholder activism have bred short-termism on the part of firms.

zh: 还有一个中介问题。
en: There is also an intermediation problem.

zh: 主权财富基金、退休基金和保险公司集聚了巨量储蓄，这笔资金可用来（比如）满足新兴经济体巨大的举出设施和城市化融资需求。
en: Large pools of savings in sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, and insurance companies could be used, for example, to meet emerging economies’ huge financing needs for infrastructure and urbanization.

zh: 但这些投资 — — 能够极大地提振全球增长 — — 的渠道被堵死了。
en: But the channels for such investment – which could go a long way toward boosting global growth – are clogged.

zh: 与此同时，科技和市场力量使的就业呈现两极分化，中等收入群体每况愈下。
en: Meanwhile, technological and market forces have contributed to job polarization, with the middle-income bracket gradually deteriorating.

zh: 比如，自动化刺激了常规白领和蓝领岗位出人意料的迅速减少。
en: Automation, for example, seems to have spurred an unexpectedly rapid decline in routine white- and blue-collar jobs.

zh: 这导致了中位收入停滞不前和收入不平等性的加剧，而这两者都制约了总需求中的私人消费因素。
en: This has resulted in stagnating median incomes and rising income inequality, both of which constrain the private-consumption component of aggregate demand.

zh: 即使有效增加了可支配收入、支持了需求的因素 — — 大宗商品（特别是化石燃料）价格暴跌 — — 说到底也是大有问题。
en: Even the one factor that has effectively increased disposable incomes and augmented demand – sharply declining commodity prices, particularly for fossil fuels – is ultimately problematic.

zh: 事实上，对大宗商品出口国来说，价格下跌正在造成各种财政和经济困境。
en: Indeed, for commodity-exporting countries, the fall in prices is generating fiscal and economic headwinds of varying intensity.

zh: 通货膨胀 — — 或通货不膨胀 — — 带来了进一步挑战。
en: Inflation – or the lack of it – presents further challenges.

zh: 许多国家的物价增长远远低于目标水平，并且还在下降。
en: Price growth is well below targets and declining in many countries.

zh: 如果演变为全面通缩，加之以不受控制的真实利率升高，那么增长风险将非常严重。
en: If this turns to full-blown deflation, accompanied by uncontrolled rising real interest rates, the risk to growth would be serious.

zh: 即使是极低的通胀也不利于于各国解决过度负债问题。
en: Even very low inflation hampers countries’ ability to address over-indebtedness.

zh: 而几乎没有迹象表明会出现通胀压力，即使是在接近“充分”就业的美国。
en: And there is little sign of inflationary pressure, even in the US, which is near “full” employment.

zh: 在需求短缺和产出缺口如此巨大的情况下，毫不奇怪，即使是无与伦比地宽松的货币条件也不足以提振通胀。
en: Given such large demand shortfalls and output gaps, it should surprise no one that even exceptionally generous monetary conditions have proved insufficient to bolster inflation.

zh: 各国对于如何解决通缩问题几乎没有选择，只能求助于竞争性贬值。
en: With few options for fighting deflation, countries have resorted to competitive devaluations.

zh: 但如果每个人都这样做，那么争取可贸易全球需求的更大份额也没有什么意义。
en: But this is not an effective strategy for capturing a larger share of tradable global demand if everyone is doing it.

zh: 而以汇率竞争力为目标无法解决总需求问题。
en: And targeting exchange-rate competitiveness doesn’t address the aggregate demand problem.

zh: 如果全球经济继续沿着当前轨迹运行下去，那么一段时间的剧烈波动可能动摇许多新兴经济体，也破坏全球发展努力。
en: If the global economy remains on its current trajectory, a period of intense volatility could destabilize a number of emerging economies, while undermining development efforts worldwide.

zh: 因此，决策者必须立刻行动起来。
en: That’s why policymakers must act now.

zh: 首先，政府必须认识到，决不能让央行独力支持经济，不管它们在这方面做得多么出色。
en: For starters, governments must recognize that central banks, however well they have served their economies, cannot go it alone.

zh: 需要实施补充性改革以维持和改善货币政策的传递渠道并避免不利的副作用。
en: Complementary reforms are needed to maintain and improve the transmission channels of monetary policy and avoid adverse side effects.

zh: 在一些国家 — — 如法国、意大利和西班牙 — — 旨在增加结构灵活性的改革也至关重要。
en: In several countries – such as France, Italy, and Spain – reforms designed to increase structural flexibility are also crucial.

zh: 此外，阻碍增加和提高公共和私人部门投资的因素必须消除。
en: Furthermore, impediments to higher and more efficient public- and private-sector investment must be removed.

zh: 政府必须实施措施重新分配收入、改善基本服务的供给，并训练劳动力大军抓住经济结构变化的良机。
en: And governments must implement measures to redistribute income, improve the provision of basic services, and equip the labor force to take advantage of ongoing shifts in the economic structure.

zh: 争取政治意愿，让这些要点（哪怕是其中一些）得以实现绝非易事。
en: Generating the political will to get even some of this done will be no easy feat.

zh: 但诚实地看待全球经济的不利局面 — — 以及不乐观的轨迹 — — 兴许有助于让决策者做需要的事。
en: But an honest look at the sorry state – and unpromising trajectory – of the global economy will, one hopes, help policymakers do what’s needed.

zh: 疲惫不堪的意大利
en: Exhausted Italy

zh: 意大利面临着或许是自1948年以来最为重要的选举。 当时，人们通过选举在墨索里尼法西斯政权的废墟上成立了新的意大利共和国。
en: Italy is facing perhaps its most important elections since 1948, when voters confirmed the emergence of Italy’s new republic from the wreckage of Mussolini’s fascist regime.

zh: 4月9日到10日，意大利人必须在现任总理贝鲁斯卡尼领导的中间偏右政府和以普罗迪为首的中间偏左政党中做出选择。
en: On April 9-10, Italians must choose between Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi’s center-right government and the center-left bloc headed by Romano Prodi.

zh: 但是这两个人好像都不是那种能够带领意大利走出令人沮丧的经济困境的决定性人物。
en: But neither man seems the sort of decisive figure that overcoming Italy’s bleak economic predicament demands.

zh: 意大利的经济萎靡不振显而易见。
en: Italy’s economic malaise is obvious.

zh: 过去的五年中，经济累积增长速度是欧元区中最缓慢的，只有3.2 % ， 而欧元区平均增长速度达到了7.8 % ， 其中两年处于停滞状态。
en: Cumulative economic growth over the past five years was the slowest in the euro zone – 3.2%, compared to an average of 7.8% – with two years of stagnation.

zh: 人均国民生产总值也下降到欧元区平均水平之下。
en: Per capita GDP, too, has fallen below the euro-zone average.

zh: 虽然就业率有所提高，但劳动生产率仍然毫无起色，生产要素总生产率不升反降。
en: Employment has increased, but labor productivity has remained flat and total factor productivity has declined.

zh: 雪上加霜的是实际汇率提升，导致竞争力大幅下降，出口受到重创。
en: Combined with strong real exchange-rate appreciation, this has led to a dramatic loss of competitiveness and weakening exports.

zh: 实际上，唯一增长的部分好像只剩下有关意大利经济衰退的书籍了。
en: Indeed, the only growth sector seems to be books about Italy’s decline.

zh: 贝鲁斯科尼宣称这些数字并不可靠，因为它们掩盖了当今富裕的意大利人的实际情况。
en: Berlusconi claims that statistics are unreliable, for they conceal a much rosier reality for today’s well-off Italians.

zh: 现政府的其他成员则审慎地承认意大利确实面临严重的问题，但他们将之归结于那些超出他们控制范围的因素，也就使一系列的全球经济动荡、欧洲大陆经济不景气、中国加入世贸组织以及欧元的作用。
en: Other members of the government admit more soberly that Italy faces serious problems, but they lay the blame on factors beyond their control: a series of global economic shocks, a slow-down in continental Europe, the admission of China to the World Trade Organization, and the role of the euro.

zh: 但是这种解释难以令人信服。
en: But such explanations are unconvincing.

zh: 全球动荡对所有欧洲国家都有影响，中国（以及其它亚洲国家）加入世贸组织同样如此，但是例如法国的出口损失甚微，德国的出口竟然有所增长。
en: The global shocks affected all European countries alike, as did the entry of China (and other Asian countries) into the WTO, but French exports, for example, suffered much less, while German exports actually increased.

zh: 确切地说，德国经济增长乏力拖了欧洲经济增长的后腿，但是意大利的经济增长更是微乎其微，甚至不如德国。
en: True, European growth was dragged down by meager growth in Germany, but Italy grew marginally less than Germany.

zh: 最后，虽然欧元的出现终结了竞争性货币贬值，但也给意大利带来了相当大的好处，那就是将国民生产总值中自上世纪90年代累积的大量公债的利息支付减少了6 % 。
en: Finally, while the euro has put a stop to competitive devaluations, it also provided Italy with a sizeable benefit: a reduction by 6% of GDP in interest payments on the huge public debt accumulated in the 1990’s.

zh: 然而，将经济的低迷表现都归罪于贝鲁斯科尼政府并不公平。
en: It would be unfair, however, to blame the Berlusconi government alone for this dismal performance.

zh: 在过去十几年中，意大利经济增长低于欧洲平均水平，出口疲软，原因是该国对全球信息技术革命和世界贸易方式的变化准备不足，应对乏力。
en: Italy’s growth has been slower than Europe’s, with weakening exports, for the past decade, because the country was ill prepared to adjust to the global revolution in information technology and the changing pattern of world trade.

zh: 其基础设施，无论是物资还是智力，都更为匮乏，并且其经济结构不能适应新的挑战，主要原因是公司的规模、专注于传统行业以及教育和研发水平低下。
en: Its infrastructure, both material and intellectual, was poorer, and its economic structure was unfit for the new challenges, owing both to firm size and their specialization in traditional sectors, as well as low levels of education and R&D.

zh: 尽管贝鲁斯科尼政府是意大利历史上第一个渡过了完整五年任期的政府，但是在应对这些困境方面却基本上无所作为。
en: Yet the Berlusconi government did next to nothing to address these deficiencies, despite being the first government in Italy’s history to survive a full five-year electoral term.

zh: 本来凭借其在议会中无法撼动的绝对多数，它可以进行连贯的供应学派的改革，即使在开始阶段存在面临抵制的风险。
en: With an unassailable parliamentary majority, it could have undertaken coherent supply-side reforms, even at the risk of some initial unpopularity.

zh: 出台的一些改革措施则姗姗来迟。 例如，轻度干预退休金和进一步加大劳动市场的灵活性。
en: A couple of reforms were belatedly enacted: timid intervention on pensions and a further increase in labor-market flexibility.

zh: 但是在解除产品市场管制或适度刺激结构重组方面则没有采取任何措施，私有化进程也停滞不前。
en: But nothing was done to deregulate product markets or to give proper incentives to restructuring, while privatization came to a halt.

zh: 相反，现任政府选择的是老套的凯恩斯主义政策，也就是温和减税以增加可支配收入和经常性支出。
en: Instead, the government chose old-style Keynesian policy: moderate tax cuts to increase disposable income and an increase in current expenditure.

zh: 2001年到2005年间，国民生产总值中经常性无息支出增长了2 % ， 税收下降了0.5 % ， 政府赤字增加了1 % 。
en: Between 2001 and 2005, current non-interest expenditure rose by 2% of GDP, revenues fell by 0.5% of GDP, and the general government deficit rose by 1% of GDP.

zh: 更糟糕的是，盈余额从3.2%下降到0.5 % ， 即使考虑到商业周期的因素也是如此。
en: Worse, the surplus fell from 3.2% to 0.5% of GDP, and fell even allowing for the business cycle.

zh: 后果就是国民生产总值的负债率直至2004年才有所下降，但在2005年再次上升到超过106%
en: As a result, the debt-to-GDP ratio declined only modestly until 2004 and rose again – to more than 106% – in 2005.

zh: 无论哪一方上台，恶劣的财政状况都将严重束缚未来政府的手脚。
en: The weak fiscal position will severely constrain whatever government comes to power.

zh: 中间偏左政党在其冗长乏味的竞选计划中提议将收入税减少5个百分点，但没有说明从哪里支付执行这一政策所需的100亿欧元。
en: The center-left’s ponderous electoral program proposes a cut of five percentage points in payroll taxes, but it is not clear where the required €10 billion will come from to pay for this.

zh: 提高针对资本收入的低预扣赋税率（12.5 % ） 的提议则遭到指责，指责普罗迪打算劫富济贫。
en: The idea of increasing the low (12.5%) withholding tax on capital gains met with accusations that Prodi intends to expropriate wealth.

zh: 但是中间偏右政党在其空洞无物的宣言中做出的承诺，如削减财产税和提高低水平退休金，更是空中楼阁，镜花水月。
en: But the right’s slim manifesto includes its own unaffordable promises, such as cuts in property taxes and increases in low-level pensions.

zh: 意大利的选民也茫然不知所措。
en: Italian voters are perplexed.

zh: 2001年，贝鲁斯科尼签订《与意大利公民契约 》 ， 包括种种无法兑现的承诺。
en: In 2001, Berlusconi signed a “contract with the Italians” containing promises that have gone unfulfilled.

zh: 他一直以来都把自己想象成救世主，确信单凭其一己之力就可以解决国家的问题。
en: He has always fancied himself as a savior, convinced that he alone can fix the country.

zh: 因此如果任何人有其它想法，他都觉得不可思议，甚至法规都不应对他构成限制和阻挡。
en: So he finds it unconceivable that anybody can feel otherwise or even that rules should stand in his way.

zh: 因此他领导的政府尽力通过修改司法程序的法律，设法巩固公共电视台（政府控制）和他所有的电视台的双头垄断地位，费尽心思去制定一部对其政党有利的离奇的新选举法。
en: Hence his government’s efforts to pass laws changing judicial procedures, or to consolidate the duopoly of public (government-controlled) television stations and his own, or to concoct a bizarre new electoral law favorable to his coalition.

zh: 但是选民对贝鲁斯科尼丧气对普罗迪及左派政党来说不一定是好消息。
en: But voters’ frustration with Berlusconi is not necessarily good news for Prodi and the left.

zh: 民调显示民众对所有的政客和政党的信任度已经降到有史以来最低水平。
en: Opinion polls reveal that trust in all politicians and political parties has reached the lowest level ever.

zh: 意大利已经忍受了一场可悲可耻的选举，一场产生了大量的热量却没有产生多少光的选举。
en: Italy has endured a sad and degrading electoral campaign, one that has generated a lot of heat, but little light.

zh: 民众希望无论是谁获胜上台，都应顺应意大利的急需，全力以赴地开展工作。
en: One hopes that whoever wins buckles down to the serious work that Italy so desperately needs.

zh: 撤离民主？
en: Exiting from Democracy?

zh: 乔治·W·布什总统和托尼·布莱尔首相都需要从伊拉克撤军的看似可行的计划。
en: Both President George W. Bush and Prime Minister Tony Blair urgently need a plausible exit strategy from Iraq.

zh: 毫无疑问，他们都想撤离，因为他们发动战争的理由已经戏剧性地化为乌有，国内的支持也早已不复存在。
en: That they want to get out, now that their reasons for the war have so dramatically collapsed and domestic support is fading, is beyond doubt.

zh: 但他们又都不想带着耻辱离开，由直升飞机戏剧性地接走使馆屋顶上的最后一名官员。
en: But neither wants to leave in ignominy, with their last man dramatically lifted of an embassy rooftop by helicopter.

zh: 布什和布莱尔都想离开伊拉克，即使无法戴着胜利的花环，至少也让人感到"完成了使命 " 。
en: Both Bush and Blair want to leave Iraq, if not with a victory, then at least with some sense of "mission accomplished."

zh: 从两人最近的讲话看，他们着手导演的一幕再简单不过，一月份将在伊拉克举行大选。
en: Judging from their recent statements, the scenario that they are concocting is simple. In January, there will be elections in Iraq.

zh: 选举产生的政府跟着会要求占领军离开，比如以一年为限，然后第二年春天，撤军就会开始。
en: The resulting government will then ask the occupation troops to leave, say, within a year. Withdrawal will begin next spring.

zh: 尽管设想再简单不过，但现实却极为复杂。
en: While that scenario is simple, reality is not.

zh: 令人心烦意乱的问题首先是：大选能否在明年一月如期举行？
en: The first nagging question is this: will there actually be elections next January?

zh: 阿拉维总理信誓旦旦向全世界保证这不是问题，布什总统也一再附和。
en: Prime Minister Iyad Allawi assures the world that there will be, and President Bush echoes his words.

zh: 可立场更为中立的观察家－还有日复一日的爆炸、绑架以及"起义 " ， 都足以使人们对描绘中的前景提出置疑。
en: More neutral observers - and indeed, the daily news bulletins about bombings and hostage taking and "insurgents" - cast doubt on that prospect.

zh: 明年1月伊拉克大选的可能性肯定到不了50 % ， 而且我们可以认定，这绝不会是自由、公正的全国性大选。
en: The probability of Iraqi elections being held this coming January must be lower than 50%, and we can be certain that these will not be free and fair elections throughout the entire country.

zh: 实际上，伊拉克已经算不上是个统一的国家。
en: Indeed, Iraq no longer deserves to be described as a united country.

zh: 如今世界上失控的国家越来越多，现在又加上个伊拉克，即便人们拿出最乐观的估计，也只能是由三个州组成的潜在的联邦，再加上个谁都管不了的城市巴格达。
en: It has now joined the growing list of the world's failed states and can at best be described as a potential federation of three states plus the unruly city of Baghdad.

zh: 大选不能举行，盟军就少不了麻烦，还能有什么样的撤军战略？
en: Without elections, the Coalition is in trouble. What other exit strategy can it devise?

zh: 可最重要的是，伊拉克会有麻烦，这个曾几何时的不幸国家还能有什么出路？
en: Above all, however, Iraq is in trouble. What other way forward is there for that unhappy former country?

zh: 答案也不见得是死路一条，也许在新形势下重新思考真的会另辟蹊径。
en: The answer need not be all despair. It may be that rethinking strategy in the light of new facts will open a way forward.

zh: 归根结底，全国大选在一个摸索着走向民主的国家也许不是自由秩序的最好开端，尤其在库尔德人、什叶派和逊尼派几个民族为中央政权争得头破血流的情况下更是如此。
en: After all, it might be the case that national elections in a place groping for a democratic future are not the best first step on the road to a liberal order. This is notably the case where entrenched groups - Kurds, Shiites, Sunnis - compete for central power.

zh: 这种时候举行大选也许根本就不明智，甚至还有可能带来负面的效果。
en: Elections, in such a case, may not even be wise at all - indeed, they may prove to be counterproductive.

zh: 历史经验表明选举不一定能创造民主，而只能说明这里具备建设民主的条件。
en: History suggests that elections do not create democracies. They confirm that the conditions for a democratic order are present.

zh: 因此，选举不是民主进程中的第一步，而是在至少具备两个前提的条件下整个准备阶段的最后一步。
en: Thus, they are not the first step in the process of democratisation, but the last step in a preparatory phase in which at least two conditions have been created.

zh: 第一个条件是做好地区安排，这在"民族"社会中并非易事。
en: The first condition is a settled territorial arrangement. In "tribal" societies, this is not easy to bring about.

zh: 波斯尼亚发生的一切说明了个中原委。
en: Bosnia's experience reveals why this is so.

zh: 可不管人们多想建立多民族国家，一旦这种建设失败，就不得不服从大众情绪的指引。
en: However much one may favor multiethnic nation-states, once such a construction has failed, it is imperative to listen to popular sentiment.

zh: 能被多数人接受的组织会应运而生，虽然它们并不完美，却至少能产生合法的政府－这样的政府不仅有效，也能被大多数人所接受。
en: Viable units will emerge that are less than ideal but at least capable of creating legitimate government - meaning a government that is both effective and acceptable.

zh: 如果以有悖原则为由摧毁刚刚涌现的伊拉克－库尔德联盟，而执意重建不复存在的大伊拉克，其结果将是灾难性的。
en: It would be disastrous to destroy the emergent Iraqi-Kurdish entity in the name of an abstract and no-longer existent greater Iraq.

zh: 像我本人一样，二次大战后经历过德国占领的人都会记得，最初的战后选举仅仅局限在地区的内部。
en: Anyone who experienced occupied Germany after World War II, as I did, remembers that the first postwar elections held there were local and regional.

zh: 实际上，他们当时建立了如今德意志联邦共和国的雏形。
en: In fact, they established what are now the Länder of the Federal Republic of Germany.

zh: 选举之前必须满足的条件之二是安全。
en: The second condition that must be satisfied before elections can be credible is security.

zh: 起初，这可能要由军队负责，但建立在坦克和空袭威胁基础上的和平与安宁是远远不够的。
en: Initially, this may be an issue for the military. But peace and quiet based on tanks and the threat of air strikes cannot be enough.

zh: 安全不仅需要强大的军队，还要有法律和严格的执行过程。
en: Security requires not just troops, but laws and their enforcement.

zh: 人们口中的"自由秩序"至少有两个制度要素。
en: What one might call "the liberal order" requires at least two institutional ingredients.

zh: 其一是民主，包括对议会及人民负责的选举和政府，其二则是法治。
en: One is democracy, including elections and governments held to account by parliaments and ultimately the people. The other is the rule of law.

zh: 在建立法治方面，波斯尼亚－黑塞哥维纳国家联盟高级代表阿什顿勋爵为我们创立了很好的典范。
en: Lord Ashdown, the High Representative of a coalition of countries in Bosnia-Herzegovina, has set a good example of how the rule of law can be established.

zh: 这需要极有勇气的人担任法官，以及强劲有力的权威部门来执行判决。
en: It requires persons of great courage to become judges, and strong authorities to enforce their judgments.

zh: 但这一切都是可以实现的。
en: But it can be done.

zh: 在穆斯林国家里，这样的策略还能够防止宗教狂徒们劫持法律。 这可能会遵循所谓的"土耳其方案。
en: In a Muslim country, such a strategy would, moreover, provide protection against hijacking of the law by religious fanatics.

zh: "近100年前，土耳其的开国前辈凯莫尔．
en: It would establish what might be called the "Turkish solution."

zh: 阿塔土耳克首先提出了这个问题，继他之后，总理雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安成功地解决了这一挑战。
en: Turkey's Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan has taken up this very challenge, first set by his great predecessor Kemal Atatürk nearly a century ago.

zh: 也许伊拉克最需要的不是简单的投票箱，而是像阿塔土耳克这样有远见卓识的伟人。
en: Perhaps what Iraq needs most is not a ballot box, but an Atatürk.

zh: 这样的策略远不像强行大选这么简单，可能会使占领军的撤退情势更为复杂，时间也更漫长。
en: Such a strategy would be less simple than merely holding highly imperfect elections. It would make the exit of occupation forces more complex and perhaps more drawn-out.

zh: 但与少数人选出的疲弱无力的中央政府相比，它会对民主发展产生更为深远的影响。
en: It would, however, have a more lasting impact on democratic development than a dubious process by which a limited number of people go to the polls to elect an ineffectual central government.

zh: 这样的策略甚至可能引导伊拉克踏上自由之路，那时候人们就可以发自内心地说：任务完成了。
en: Such a strategy might even lead to an outcome about which those who want Iraq to join a free world can genuinely say: mission accomplished.

zh: 脱离国际公正
en: Exiting International Justice

zh: 不久前，我出席了贝尔格莱德举行的会议，题目是“面对前南斯拉夫的过去。
en: I recently took part in a conference in Belgrade entitled “Dealing with the Past in ex-Yugoslavia.”

zh: ”尽管欧洲其它后共产主义国家早在10年前就不得不面对这个问题，但20世纪90年代的巴尔干战争却让犯罪者和牺牲者都陷在正义迟迟得不到伸张的时空怪圈之中。
en: Although the rest of postcommunist Europe confronted such questions a decade ago, the Balkan wars of the 1990’s left both perpetrators and victims stuck in a time warp of justice delayed.

zh: 随着与会者走进贝尔格莱德的Hyatt酒店，一群抗议者高举写着“释放米洛舍维奇”的标语正等待着他们，抗议者中绝大多数都是中老年人。
en: As the conference’s participants made their way into Belgrade’s Hyatt Hotel, an angry band of mostly older protesters bearing posters that read, “Free Milosevic” greeted them.

zh: 在媒体记者和保安人员的一阵混乱中，他们拦住了海牙国际刑事法庭负责前南问题的首席检察官迪旁蒂（Carla Del Ponte ） 。
en: In a flurry of media and security, they confronted Carla Del Ponte, chief prosecutor at the International Criminal Tribunal for former Yugoslavia (ICTY) in The Hague.

zh: 迪旁蒂曾向塞尔维亚政府施加压力，迫使他们在拉多万•卡拉季奇和拉特科·姆拉迪奇的审判中合作，正是这两个人下令执行并监督了1995年发生在斯雷布雷尼察的屠杀7000名穆斯林成年男子和男孩的暴行。
en: Del Ponte is pressing Serbia’s government to cooperate in the still unresolved cases of Radovan Karadzic and Ratko Mladic, who ordered, implemented, and oversaw the massacre of 7,000 Muslim men and boys at Srebrenica in 1995.

zh: 抗议者还是代表了一些塞族人的观点。
en: The protesters are not unrepresentative of Serb opinion.

zh: 尽管前南国际刑庭成立已达10年之久，但有关战争罪行的争论还是非常激烈，就连波斯尼亚、克罗地亚和科索沃究竟发生了哪些基本事实都未能达成一致。
en: Almost a decade after the start of the ICTY’s work, debate still rages over responsibility for war crimes, with little agreement on even the most basic facts of the conflicts in Bosnia, Croatia, and Kosovo.

zh: 塞尔维亚总理（当时任总统）伊斯拉夫·科什图尼察2001年成立真相委员会的企图从一开始就被指控为缺乏公正，成立起来的真相委员会也不到一年就遭到解散的厄运。
en: Serbian Prime Minister (then President) Vojislav Kostunica’s attempt in 2001 to set up a truth commission was doomed from the outset by allegations of bias, and was disbanded within a year.

zh: 前南国际刑事法庭也同样困难重重。
en: The ICTY is also in trouble.

zh: 的确，米洛舍维奇以战争罪、反人道主义罪和种族灭绝罪在海牙接受审判。
en: To be sure, Milosevic is on trial in The Hague for war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide.

zh: 但海牙法庭和二次大战后纽伦堡法庭之间的对比正在日渐消失：由于审判迁延日久，观察家们怀疑为什么用了那么长时间来确立战争责任。
en: But comparisons to the post-WWII Nuremberg tribunal have worn thin: as the proceedings drag on, observers wonder why it has taken so long to establish criminal liability.

zh: 毕竟在纽伦堡，第三帝国最高统帅们的审判和定罪只用了短短几个月的时间。
en: After all, at Nuremberg, the top rung of the Third Reich was tried and convicted within months.

zh: 与此相反，米洛舍维奇抓住前南国际刑事法庭的程序漏洞来拖延对他的审判，同时对法庭的权限及合法性提出质疑。
en: By contrast, Milosevic has taken advantage of the ICTY’s procedures to delay his trial, while challenging its jurisdiction and legitimacy.

zh: 这一招在国内收到了很好的效果，那些受到指控的战争罪犯都像英雄似的被人崇拜。
en: This plays well back home, where indicted war criminals are still touted as war heroes.

zh: 实际上，塞尔维亚最近的总统大选几乎成了米氏问题的全民投票－同时参与表决的还有塞尔维亚与西方乃至世界的关系。
en: Indeed, Serbia’s last presidential election became something of a referendum on Milosevic – and hence on Serbia’s relations with the West and the wider world.

zh: 拥护米洛舍维奇的候选人托米斯拉夫·尼科利奇没能赢得选举，但却获得了高达46%的选票。
en: The pro-Milosevic candidate, Tomislav Nikolic, lost, but he received 46% of the vote.

zh: 尽管曾在竞选时做出承诺，塞尔维亚总统鲍里斯·塔迪奇还是没能把姆拉迪奇交给前南国际法庭（卡拉季奇也许根本不在塞尔维亚 ） ， 而姆拉迪奇的证言肯定对米洛舍维奇不利。
en: Despite his campaign promises, Serbia’s President Boris Tadic has so far failed to cooperate with the ICTY by assisting in turning over Mladic (Karadzic is probably not in Serbia), who would surely testify against Milosevic.

zh: 我们能对塔迪奇的恐惧表示理解：第一位后米洛舍维奇时代的总理佐兰·金吉奇与法庭进行了合作，但却为此付出了生命的代价。
en: One understands his trepidation: the first post-Milosevic prime minister, Zoran Djindjic, cooperated with the tribunal, and paid for it with his life.

zh: 如此掣肘恰恰暴露了前南国际法庭的根本弱点：与纽伦堡法庭不同，国际社会是在战争中，而不是在战后，召集了前南国际法庭。
en: Such foot-dragging exposes the ICTY’s fundamental weakness: unlike the Nuremberg tribunal, the international community convened it during, not after, a war.

zh: 没有对证据或被审判者的绝对控制，前南国际法庭从一开始就缺乏行使“胜利者的公正”所必须的权威与合法性。
en: Without full control of either the evidence or the accused, the ICTY lacked from the outset the legitimacy and authority of “victors’ justice.”

zh: 这继续阻碍着对米洛舍维奇的审判，使人们对是否有足够的证据证明他与种族灭绝政策有直接的关系产生了怀疑。
en: This continues to impede the case against Milosevic, raising questions about whether there is sufficient proof directly linking him to the policy of genocidal ethnic cleansing, although this is likely to be less problematic since the charges against him turn not on “command responsibility,” but instead on the ICTY’s charter principles of individual responsibility.

zh: 但由于对他的指控不是仰仗“指挥责任 ” ， 而是采用了前南国际法庭个人责任的宪章原则，其中隐含着对“联合犯罪企业”责任者的起诉授权，把驱逐、免职等犯罪行为所应承担的责任与今后其它的暴力行为结合起来。
en: These implicitly authorize prosecution of those responsible for a “joint criminal enterprise,” thus linking liability for criminal behavior such as deportations and removals to other foreseeable atrocities.

zh: 可时间却越来越紧迫。
en: But time is running out.

zh: 前南国际法庭必须在年内了结新的诉讼，并于2008年前彻底解散。
en: The ICTY must wrap up new indictments this year, and disband by 2008.

zh: 这场审判在进入尾声的时候，却面临着国际社会日益缩减的资源分配和日益削弱的政治意愿。
en: It enters this end game facing diminished resources and waning political will within the international community.

zh: 前南法庭会留下什么呢？
en: What will be the Tribunal’s legacy?

zh: 从一开始，由联合国安理会维和力量控制的前南国际法庭就抱着雄心壮志。
en: From the start, the ICTY’s aims were ambitious, having been launched under the UN Security Council’s peacemaking powers.

zh: 如果这意味着法庭想阻止进一步的暴力行动，那么它失败了，至少在短期内一败涂地。
en: If this meant that the Tribunal was intended to deter further violence, then it failed, at least in the short run.

zh: 毕竟，暴行－包括斯雷布雷尼察大屠杀－在前南国际法庭开始运行后仍在继续。
en: After all, atrocities – including the Srebrenica massacre – continued after the ICTY began operating.

zh: 种族和解又会怎样？
en: What about ethnic reconciliation?

zh: 前南国际法庭的第一位首席检察官理查德·戈德斯通（Richard Goldstone）呼吁谴责种族迫害，目的是使所有各方超越身份政治，建立起更为自由的政治秩序。
en: The ICTY’s first chief prosecutor, Richard Goldstone, called for condemnation of ethnic persecution in order to enable all sides to transcend identity politics and move towards a more liberal political order.

zh: 个人责任制会在一定程度上斩断种族身份和公共复仇的锁链。
en: Individual accountability would somehow break the chain of ethnic identity and communal vengeance.

zh: 但鼓励种族和解对任何法庭来讲都是脱离现实的要求，前南国际法庭也无法实现这样的目标。
en: But fostering ethnic reconciliation is a tall order for any court, and the ICTY hasn’t yet delivered.

zh: 自由的政治秩序包含着承认已有先例和进行类似推理的法律原则，但很多塞族人都不肯放弃自己的历史例外论，认为自己��着独特的遭遇。
en: A liberal political order implies a rule of law that recognizes precedents and analogical thinking. But many Serbs hold on to their sense of historical exceptionalism and unique suffering.

zh: 实际上，1999年的北约轰炸与对米洛舍维奇的指控都被看成是“对塞尔维亚人民发起的攻击。 ”
en: Indeed, the coincidence of the NATO bombing in 1999 with the indictment of Milosevic helped convert both events into “attacks on the Serbian people.”

zh: 否定历史在克罗地亚也同样明显，那里的指责与苦难颠倒了位置。
en: Historical denial is no less evident in Croatia, where the polarities of blame and suffering have simply been reversed.

zh: 前南国际法庭同样不会受到当地民众的怀念。
en: There, too, the ICTY will not be missed.

zh: 因此今天要讨论如何脱离国际公正的问题。
en: So the talk nowadays is of the right “exit strategy” from international justice.

zh: 当前南国际法庭的大门轰然关闭，那些尚未了结的诉讼该往何处去？
en: When the ICTY closes its doors, where should its unfinished cases go?

zh: 迪旁蒂呼吁建立“新型公正伙伴关系。
en: Del Ponte has called for “new partnerships for justice.”
