zh: ”这个主意听起来不错，但现实的选择又在哪里呢？
en: That sounds fine, but what, realistically, are the choices?

zh: 前南国际法庭的调查和诉讼是否真能移交给国家法庭？
en: Can the ICTY’s investigations and indictments really be turned over to national courts?

zh: 迄今为止，前景并不乐观：该地区有数的几起国内审判仍然反映着周围难以驾驭的政治环境和无处不在的民族偏见。
en: So far, the picture is not promising: the few domestic trials in the region continue to reflect the fractious politics and pervasive ethnic bias that surround them.

zh: 和世界许多地方一样，可能需要经过几代人的不懈努力，才能完成该地区的犯罪调查。
en: As in many parts of the world, it may be several generations before the region’s crimes can be worked through.

zh: 前南国际法庭的任务应当是完成并传播一份记录，从而使否定历史的可能性大大降低。
en: The ICTY’s responsibility should be to forge and disseminate a record that limits the possibility of historical denial.

zh: 走出中东迷宫
en: Exiting the Middle East Labyrinth

zh: 柏林 — — 巴拉克·奥巴马当选美国总统已经两年了。
en: BERLIN – Two years have passed since Barack Obama was elected President of the United States.

zh: 这两年里有一点值得赞扬，那就是与刚刚离职的前任相比，奥巴马从上任伊始就努力寻找以色列和巴勒斯坦冲突的解决办法。
en: Much to his credit – and in contrast to his immediate predecessor – Obama tried, from his first day in office, to work towards a resolution of the conflict between Israelis and Palestinians.

zh: 但两年过去了，奥巴马新政是否除了善意之外没有带来别的什么？
en: Two years on, are good intentions the best that Obama’s new policy has to offer?

zh: 毕竟，新政没有带来任何有价值的结果。
en: After all, nothing of value has in fact resulted from them.

zh: 不仅奥巴马永久冻结西岸定居点兴建的努力已经失败，冲突各方的直接谈判也已经走进了死胡同。
en: Even worse, given that Obama’s effort to enforce a permanent moratorium on new settlement construction in the West Bank has failed, is that direct negotiations between the conflicting parties have run aground.

zh: 善意在实际生活中没有多少价值 — — 在政治领域更是这样。
en: Good intentions count for little in life – and for less in politics.

zh: 生活中真正起作用的只有结果。
en: What matters, first and foremost, are results.

zh: 乔治·W·布什总统认为他所要做的只是顾及到美国在中东扮演双重角色之中的一个，说具体点就是以色列的盟友。
en: President George W. Bush believed that he needed to take account of only one half of America’s dual role in the Middle East, namely the alliance with Israel.

zh: 在长达八年的总统任期内，他始终没有时间顾及美国的另一个角色，那就是在以巴之间发挥关键的和平调解作用。
en: He had no time for the second US role, that of pivotal peace mediator between Israelis and Palestinians, during his entire eight-year presidency.

zh: 他提出的所有计划都是为了安抚国际公众。
en: All his initiatives were intended only to pacify the international public.

zh: 我们都知道他所取得的结果。
en: We all know where that led.

zh: 而奥巴马从上任伊始就力求改变，采取更为积极的中东政策。
en: From the start, Obama wanted to do things differently, pursuing an active Middle East policy.

zh: 可是从目前来看，结果并不比布什好多少。
en: But the results so far are not very different from those under Bush.

zh: 在布什和奥巴马任内，停滞都压倒进展成为中东问题的主旋律。
en: In both cases, standstill triumphed over progress.

zh: 有鉴于此，再加上双方的强硬立场，很多人都选择远离是非，彻底忘掉这场中东冲突。
en: Given this, and both sides’ intransigence, many would withdraw and try to forget the conflict altogether.

zh: 但事情却没有那么简单，因为冲突的持续（也是“视而不见”的必然结果）不仅会延长巴以双方的悲剧，也会给整个地区带来危险的结果。
en: But it isn’t as simple as that, because a continuation of the conflict (which is what “forgetting about it” would boil down to) would not only prolong what is a tragedy for both Palestinians and Israelis, but would also be too dangerous for the region.

zh: 最可怕的是实现两国方案的机遇之门会永远关闭，因为现实情况已经不再允许做出这种选择。
en: Most ominously, the window of opportunity for a two-state solution could close for good, because realities on the ground will no longer allow it.

zh: 对以色列而言这意味着永久性的占领西岸和东耶路撒冷，从而不得不面对在数量上远胜于己的阿拉伯人，而这将削弱他们建国的基础 — — 民主和法治 — — 进而影响其地位的合法性。
en: For Israelis, this would mean permanent occupation of East Jerusalem and the West Bank, and thus reckoning with an Arab majority, which would erode the foundations of their state – democracy and the rule of law – and thus its legitimacy.

zh: 这样的事态发展是以色列中期面临的最大威胁，而两国方案也因此对捍卫其自身利益至关重要。
en: Such a development is the greatest threat that Israel faces in the medium term, which makes a two-state solution vital to its own interests.

zh: 当然，从以色列领导人的角度看，除恐怖活动和导弹袭击以外的现实情况一点都不差。
en: Of course, from Israeli leaders’ perspective, the status quo, with its absence of terror and missile strikes, is anything but negative.

zh: 但情况不会永远这样。
en: But it won’t last.

zh: 此外，以色列所面临的战略环境正在逐年恶化，因为全球权力和影响力在东西方之间的重新分配只能削弱以色列的力量。
en: Moreover, the country’s strategic situation is deteriorating with each passing year, because the global redistribution of power and influence from the West to the East can only weaken Israel’s position.

zh: 而巴勒斯坦人所面对的现状令人窒息，说加沙面对一场彻头彻尾的人道主义灾难一点都不为过。
en: For the Palestinians, the situation is oppressive, and for Gaza it is an outright humanitarian disaster.

zh: 他们在以色列占领的东耶路撒冷和西岸地区分裂为法塔赫和哈马斯两派势力，加沙地区的居民完全与世隔绝，在难民营里过着绝望的生活，同时受到阿拉伯邻国的抵制和冷落。
en: They are internally divided between Fatah and Hamas, under Israeli occupation in East Jerusalem and the West Bank, isolated from the outside world in Gaza, hopeless in the region’s refugee camps, and rebuffed by their Arab neighbors.

zh: 在这样的情况下，分别建国的希望日益渺茫只能让巴勒斯坦民众进一步丧失尊严，并进一步加深他们的痛苦。
en: In these circumstances, the loss of a two-state perspective would be a recipe for further indignities and deepening misery.

zh: 虽说以色列和巴勒斯坦人在两国制方案中拥有共同的利益，但由于双方利益差别太大，因此在同一问题上常常提出截然相反的诉求。
en: But, if Israelis and Palestinians share a vital interest in a two-state solution, they have very different interests, and therefore mean very different things when referring to the same issues.

zh: 安全对以色列而言是头等大事，而结束以色列占领则是巴勒斯坦人梦寐以求的愿望。
en: For Israel, security is the top priority; for Palestinians, what matters most is an end to Israeli occupation.

zh: 把西岸和东耶路撒冷变成另一个加沙是以色列不能承受之重，而对巴勒斯坦人而言，如果允许以色列长期驻军，建国就是没有任何意义的空头支票。
en: Israel cannot afford a second Gaza in the West Bank and East Jerusalem; for the Palestinians, a state with an ongoing Israeli military presence would be worthless.

zh: 或许奥巴马的核心失误在于之前他给予停止新建定居点这一重要但不起决定作用的问题太过的关注。
en: Perhaps Obama’s central error was that an important but minor matter – stopping new settlements – was given central significance.

zh: 无限期冻结新建定居点会立即终结以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡��耶路撒冷的联合政府，而以色列或内塔尼亚胡却无法从中获得任何好处。
en: An indefinite building freeze would lead to the immediate end of Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu’s coalition government in Jerusalem, without giving Israel or Netanyahu anything tangible in return.

zh: 内塔尼亚胡不会延长冻结时间的事实应该再明显不过。
en: It should have been clear that Netanyahu would not extend the freeze.

zh: 美国必须询问内塔尼亚胡和巴勒斯坦总统马哈茂德·阿巴斯的关键问题是，他们是否愿意在此时此地就最终解决方案展开严肃的讨论。
en: The crucial question that the US must ask both Netanyahu and Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas is whether they would be willing – here and now – to negotiate in earnest about the final status.

zh: 如果美国能这么做，就会开启化解以色列安全和巴勒斯坦独立国家地位这对似乎无解矛盾的光明大道。
en: If so, a way out of the seemingly irresolvable conflict between Israeli security and Palestinian statehood would open.

zh: 具体解决方法如下： 立即达成有关最终解决方案的全面协议（要综合考虑所有悬而未决的问题，包括以东耶路撒冷作为巴勒斯坦国的首都 ） ； 在相当长的一段时期内按预定步骤落实全面协议内容；由以美国为首的第三方按预定机制对整个进程实行监督。 这既能确保巴勒斯坦的边界和首都不受侵犯，也能确保按预定计划结束以色列的占领活动。
en: The formula could run as follows: a comprehensive agreement about the final status now (taking into account all open questions, including East Jerusalem as the capital of Palestine); implementation of the agreement in pre-defined steps over a longer period of time; and monitoring of the process via a mechanism based on the presence on the ground of a third party (led by the US).This would give Palestinians a guarantee of their state’s borders, its capital, and the Israeli occupation’s pre-defined endpoint.

zh: 他们可以在国际社会的帮助下利用这段时间建立起行之有效的国家机构，解决经济发展问题，并消除西岸和加沙地带之间长期存在的不和。
en: They could use the time, with international help, to build up effective state institutions, address economic development, and heal the rift between West Bank and Gaza.

zh: 在这个永久性解决方案的基础上，他们可以找到巴勒斯坦难民问题的解决办法，为法塔赫和哈马斯之间的和解事业而奋斗。
en: On this new and permanent basis, they may find a solution for the Palestinian refugees and advance the cause of reconciliation between Fatah and Hamas.

zh: 以色列将会得到保证，最终地位协议和巴勒斯坦建国不会威胁到它的安全，而且它可以在几年内逐步从巴勒斯坦领土上撤军，同时接受第三方的实地监督。
en: Israel would have a guarantee that its security would not be endangered by a final-status agreement and the establishment of a Palestinian state, and that its withdrawal from the Palestinian territories would be gradual, over several years, and monitored on the ground by a third party.

zh: 以色列自此将拥有国际社会承认的明确边界，确保它能永远结束与阿拉伯邻国的冲突。
en: The country would then have clear, internationally recognized borders, enabling it to end permanently the conflict with its Arab neighbors.

zh: 尽管目前的中东局势似乎无望，但注重关键而非次要问题的新的努力理应得到国际社会的支持。
en: While the situation in the Middle East currently looks hopeless, a new attempt that focuses on the essential points, not on minor ones, deserves support.

zh: 否则我们就要面临失去两国方案的危险，这场可怕而极度危险的冲突将可能常态化。
en: The alternative is the loss of the two-state solution and the perpetuation of a terrible – and terribly perilous – conflict.

zh: 驱除穆沙拉夫的幽灵
en: Exorcising Musharraf's Ghost

zh: 剑桥－在最近的自由选举之后，巴基斯坦正处于政治上的恢复过程之中。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Following its recent free elections, Pakistan is rebounding politically.

zh: 但是穆沙拉夫时代结束带来的喜悦，因为新政府面对的严峻选择，正在消失。
en: But the euphoria that came with the end of the Musharraf era is wearing off, as the new government faces stark choices.

zh: 不像伊拉克和阿富汗，民主对这个有60年历史的国家来说并不新鲜，但是民族分裂，松散的公共机构和在北部的宗教极端主义正在不断的破坏国家的稳定。
en: Unlike Iraq and Afghanistan, democracy is not new to this 60-year-old state, but ethnic cleavages, weak institutions, and religious extremism in the North are perennially destabilizing.

zh: 并且，在新政府入主并确定其优先解决的问题的同时，西方世界，特别是美国，必须对其过去和巴基斯坦交往的效果进行重新评估。
en: And, while the new government settles in and establishes its priorities, the West, especially the United States, must reassess the impact of its past dealings with Pakistan.

zh: 巴基斯坦的新总理，优素福·吉拉尼是一位经验丰富的政治家，更重要的是，他具有苏非派背景，因为该派提倡宽容的传统，这是一个很好的预兆。
en: Pakistan’s new prime minister, Yousaf Gilani, is a seasoned politician and, more importantly, has Sufi family roots, which is a good omen because of the Sufi tradition of tolerance.

zh: 吉拉尼在他的就职演说中明白地宣布打击恐怖主义是国家的首要任务，他的第一个决定就是释放被穆沙拉夫软禁的法官。
en: Gilani unequivocally declared in his inaugural address that fighting terrorism is a top priority, and his first decision was to release from house arrest judges deposed by Musharraf.

zh: 新政府上任以来，大量恐怖的自杀炸弹袭击减少了，这同样令人振奋。
en: The respite from the horrendous spate of suicide bombings since the new government assumed power is similarly heartening.

zh: 但是蜜月期即将结束。
en: But the honeymoon period is coming to an end.

zh: 在吉拉尼的家乡木尔坦，已经有聚众闹事者袭击政府机关和银行以抗议电力中断。
en: Already, in Gilani’s hometown of Multan, rioters attacked government offices and banks to protest electricity disruptions.

zh: 一些出名的反对派政治家，在前一届支持穆沙拉夫政府里任职的一位重要部长和一个联邦内阁议员，被公开暴打，这引起人们对政府控制国家法律和秩序能力的怀疑。
en: A couple of well-known opposition politicians, a chief minister and a federal cabinet minister of the previous pro-Musharraf government, were publicly thrashed, raising doubts about government control over law and order in the country.

zh: 到目前为止，穆沙拉夫已经平静地接受了其影响力减弱的事实－虽然他几乎没有其它的选择。
en: So far, Musharraf has accepted his diminishing stature quietly – though he has few other options.

zh: 新政治领导层，不管是在议会里还是在议会外，都小心地避免和总统发生正面冲突。
en: The new political leadership, both inside and outside the parliament, has been carefully avoiding a head-on collision with the president.

zh: 有趣的是，在政治过渡的过程中，穆沙拉夫对中国进行了为期一周的访问，游说中国在中国和波斯湾之间建造一条通过巴基斯坦的石油和天然气管道。
en: Interestingly, in the midst of the political transition, Musharraf embarked on a week-long visit to China to lobby for construction of an oil and gas pipeline between China and the Persian Gulf that would be routed through Pakistan.

zh: 这个提议引发的深层次问题是，这是否显示穆沙拉夫有意向美国传达巴基斯坦的优先解决问题正在发生转变。
en: The deeper question raised by this proposal is whether Musharraf meant to convey a message to the US that Pakistan’s priorities were shifting.

zh: 巴基斯坦民主政治的复兴毫无疑问会影响它和美国的关系。
en: The revival of democratic politics in Pakistan will undoubtedly effect Pakistan-US relations.

zh: 巴基斯坦和美国的军事联系似乎仍然很牢固，所以它和美国的战略联盟可能依然会继续，虽然或许在怎样进行“反恐战争”上有细微的差别。
en: Pakistan’s military links with America appear to remain on a sound footing, so the strategic alliance with the US is likely to continue, perhaps with some nuanced differences over how to fight the “war on terror.”

zh: 但是巴基斯坦政治家一定会受到国内公众意见的影响，而这些意见基本上都对美国政策不满。
en: But Pakistani politicians are bound to be influenced by domestic public opinion, which is generally critical of US policies.

zh: 然而，如果巴基斯坦的民主力量能够成功确立其地位的话，美国在该地区的长期利益会得到更好地实现。
en: Nevertheless, long-term US interests in the region will be better served if Pakistan’s democratic forces successfully establish themselves.

zh: 美国参议院要求增加对巴基斯坦发展和教育援助的提议可以帮助美国在巴基斯坦赢得民心。
en: A proposal in the US Senate to increase development and education aid to Pakistan could help in winning the hearts and minds.

zh: 同时，乔治·沃克·布什总统说过“如果有人正在密谋另一个911式的袭击，它可能是在巴基斯坦而不是在阿富汗策划的。
en: Meanwhile, President George W. Bush has said that “if another September 11-style attack is being planned, it probably is being plotted in Pakistan and not Afghanistan.”

zh: ”美国的这个情报评估是否建立在可靠的消息上还不知道。
en: Whether this American intelligence assessment is based on credible information is unknown.

zh: 美国选举年的政治也可能在这个断言背后起着作用。
en: American election-year politics may also be behind this assertion.

zh: 但是布什决定在巴基斯坦政治过渡过程中说出这个观点意义重大。
en: But it is significant that Bush decided to voice this view during Pakistan’s political transition.

zh: 不管布什的动机是什么，巴基斯坦都必须认真对待这个观点。
en: Pakistan must take this view seriously, regardless of Bush’s motivations.

zh: 新政府应尽快设计出对付恐怖主义的政策。
en: The new government should quickly devise a policy to deal with terrorism.

zh: 最近几个月内发生了许多自杀炸弹袭击事件和其他恐怖活动－巴基斯坦自己和西方国家过去错误的代价。
en: Recent months have seen dozens of suicide bombings and other terrorist activities – the price of Pakistan’s own past blunders, as well as those of the West.

zh: 阿富汗是一个重要的例子，巴基斯坦没能和印度解决克什米尔纠纷也是一个，这两个失败都加强了国内恐怖团体的力量。
en: Afghanistan is a prime example, as is the failure to settle the Kashmir imbroglio with India. Both failures have strengthened domestic terrorist groups.

zh: 巴基斯坦政府似乎准备和部族地区的极端分子展开对话，引进政治改革以及加强在发展方面的努力。
en: Pakistan’s government appears to be preparing to talk to some of the extremists in the tribal areas, introduce political reforms, and redouble development efforts.

zh: 但是，提及“会谈”让西方国家感觉不舒服。
en: But reference to “talks” makes the West uncomfortable.

zh: 美国官员已经把这个策略比作和恐怖分子谈判，并且指出前一轮的谈判对停止部族地区的暴力活动没有起到任何作用。
en: American officials have likened this strategy to negotiating with terrorists, and point to a previous round of negotiations that did nothing to stop violence in the tribal areas.

zh: 但是新的领导层想将在巴基斯坦内的基地组织恐怖分子和宗教保守派以及醒悟的普什图青年区别开来。
en: But the new leadership wants to distinguish between al-Qaeda terrorists and religious conservatives and disillusioned Pashtun youth within Pakistan.

zh: 毕竟，世俗的人民民族党(ANP)在巴基斯坦西北边境省份选举的胜利有力地的说明那里的人民已经拒绝了宗教政治和暴力。
en: After all, the victory of the secular Awami National Party (ANP) in Pakistan’s North-West Frontier Province is a strong indication that people there have rejected religious political forces and violence.

zh: 巴基斯坦新政府可以通过与那些准备放弃极端主义和武力的人的对话和和解来扩大机会窗口，它也需要将这一点解释给西方国家以保持它们的支持。
en: This window of opportunity can be expanded through dialogue and reconciliation with those who are ready to disavow extremism and militancy. The new Pakistani government needs to explain this to the West in order to keep its support.

zh: 同时，美国应停止在该地区的直接军事打击，即使这些军事打击是在巴基斯坦军队知晓并配合的情况下进行的。
en: The US, meanwhile, should end direct military strikes in the area, even if these are conducted with the knowledge and cooperation of Pakistan’s military.

zh: 武力从来对普什图族不起作用，现在也没有证据证明这一点已经发生了改变。
en: Force has never worked with the Pashtun tribes, and there is no evidence that this has changed.

zh: 有确实的迹象表明在该部族地区，新政府被认为是一个可信的合作伙伴。
en: There are real signs that the new government is considered a credible partner in the tribal areas.

zh: 而且，找出解决无休止的暴力循环的方法需要时间。
en: It needs to be given time to find a way out of the endless cycle of violence.

zh: 驱走巴尔干半岛最后的恶魔
en: Exorcising the Last Balkan Ghosts

zh: 接下来几周将会最终解决巴尔干半岛留下的最后的领土问题，不管是以哪种方式。 二十世纪九十年代在那里发生的战争最终导致了北约1995年在波斯尼亚、1999年在科索沃的介入。
en: The next few weeks will see the resolution, one way or another, of the last territorial issues remaining in the Balkans, where the wars of the 1990’s ended with NATO interventions in Bosnia (1995) and Kosovo (1999).

zh: 即便维持了和平，但是一些关键的问题依然悬而未决。
en: Even with peace, major problems were left unresolved.

zh: 波斯尼亚被分裂成了一个穆斯林-克罗地亚联邦和一个塞族共和国，中央政府的权威小得可怜，只是依靠一支庞大的国际部队、最终是平民的存在才把这个国家联结在了一起。
en: Bosnia was divided between a Muslim-Croat federation and a Serb republic, with little authority vested in the central government and a large international military – and eventually civilian – presence needed to hold it together.

zh: 科索沃需要联合国的保护，它的“最终地位”还没有确定。
en: Kosovo was left as a United Nations protectorate whose “final status” was uncertain.

zh: 这些悬而未决的问题现在又开始浮现出来：在塞尔维亚政府的唆使下，波斯尼亚的塞族领导人正在考虑脱离波斯尼亚，即便它的穆斯林领导人试图加强中央政府的控制。
en: These unresolved issues are now returning: prompted by Serbia’s government, Bosnia’s Serb leadership is contemplating secession, even as its Muslim leadership tries to increase central control.

zh: 科索沃的阿尔巴尼亚族叫嚷着要独立，而塞尔维亚试图通过阻止安理会的行动来推迟作出决定。
en: And Kosovo’s Albanian population is clamoring for independence, while Serbia tries to postpone a decision by blocking action in the Security Council.

zh: 现在真的存在再次发生暴力的危险，尽管也许不会达到二十世纪九十年代那样的规模。
en: There is a real risk of renewed violence, though perhaps not on the scale of the 1990’s.

zh: 如果目前对科索沃地位的谈判失败的话，阿尔巴尼亚族的极端分子将会试图把生活在那儿的10万多塞族人驱逐出去。
en: If the current negotiations on Kosovo’s status fail, Albanian extremists will seek to expel the more than 100,000 Serbs who live there.

zh: 同样地，波斯尼亚的塞族共和国任何寻求脱离国家的行动都会引发那里的不稳定。
en: Similarly, any move by Bosnia’s Serb Republic to secede could incite instability there.

zh: 当米洛舍维奇八年前被推翻时将暴力民族主义变为非暴力的民族主义塞尔维亚依靠普京在背后的撑腰，一直在尽力阻止在这些问题上作出决议。
en: Serbia, which traded violent nationalism for nonviolent nationalism when Slobodan Milosevic was overthrown eight years ago, has done all it can to impede resolution of these issues, with strong support from Vladimir Putin’s Russia.

zh: 塞尔维亚希望塞族共和国能取得尽可能大的独立权，同时维持它自己对科索沃的主权。
en: Serbia wants as much independence as possible for the Serb Republic, while asserting its own sovereignty over Kosovo.

zh: 所有塞族人只在他们自己的领土上由塞族人来管治依然是塞尔维亚的目标。
en: Serbs governed only by Serbs on their own territory is still Serbia’s goal.

zh: 美国和欧盟却有着不同的想法，他们希望看到民主的转变和把巴尔干半岛的所有国家都融入北约以及最终融入欧盟。
en: The United States and the European Union are committed to a different vision: democratic transition and integration of all of the Balkans into NATO and eventually the EU.

zh: 但是他们却不太想强行让塞尔维亚接受条件，因为他们担心这样做会导致更多的激进民族主义分子走上权力的舞台。
en: But they have been reluctant to impose conditions on Serbia, for fear of bringing even more radical nationalists to power.

zh: 美国允许塞尔维亚加入北约的和平伙伴计划，尽管塞尔维亚拒绝将二十世纪九十年代波斯尼亚塞族的军事领导人姆拉迪奇将军引渡到海牙接受战争罪的指控。
en: The US allowed Serbia into NATO’s Partnership for Peace, despite Serbia’s refusal to extradite General Ratko Mladic, the Bosnian Serbs’ military leader in the 1990’s, to The Hague to face war crimes charges.

zh: 欧盟已经和塞尔维亚谈判并启动了稳定与联系协议（协议还没有签 ） ， 尽管后者在科索沃问题的谈判上拒不退让并且还干涉波斯尼亚的事务。
en: The EU has negotiated and initialed (but not yet signed) a Stabilization and Association Agreement with Serbia, despite its recalcitrance in the Kosovo negotiations and meddling in Bosnia.

zh: 但是这种安抚却遭到了失败。
en: But appeasement has failed.

zh: 美国和欧盟必须运用它们手上依然掌握的强大手段确保它们预想的局面占据上风，从而给这个一再把大国拖进冲突的地区带去最终的和平。
en: The US and the EU must use the strong hand that they still hold to ensure that their vision prevails, bringing lasting peace to a region that has repeatedly dragged great powers into conflict.

zh: 这首先要求严肃警告塞尔维亚不得再阻止波斯尼亚和科索沃向欧洲靠拢。
en: This requires, above all, a stiff warning to Serbia that it can no longer prevent Bosnia and Kosovo from moving towards Europe.

zh: 如果现在一个民主的塞尔维亚宁愿走上激进民族主义的道路，并且在成为欧盟和北约成员国的问题上听从俄罗斯的指使，那么就随它去。
en: If for now a democratic Serbia prefers radical nationalism and alignment with Russia to membership in the EU and NATO, so be it.

zh: 美国的任何重大利益都不会受到损害，并且塞尔维亚很快将认识到它的错误。
en: No vital US interests are at stake, and Serbia will soon recognize its mistake.

zh: 欧盟应该为没有接收这样的一个塞尔维亚而感到松了一口气。
en: The EU should be relieved not to admit such a Serbia.

zh: 与此同时，美国和欧盟应该携起手来严肃地对待波斯尼亚和科索沃的问题。
en: At the same time, the US and the EU, acting together, must get serious in Bosnia and Kosovo.

zh: 在波斯尼亚，任何进一步削弱1995年戴顿协议所达成的重要妥协的举动都应该被波斯尼亚“高级代表”全权制止，后者最近通过协商达成了一项协议以加强这个国家脆弱的管治结构。
en: In Bosnia, any further moves to undermine the essential compromise reached in the 1995 Dayton agreement should be met with the full powers of Bosnia’s “high representative,” who has recently negotiated an agreement that will strengthen the country’s fragile governing structure.

zh: 波斯尼亚的塞族和穆斯林政治家正在玩火，因为他们知道有消防队员站在他们身边。
en: Bosnia’s leading Serb and Muslim politicians are playing with fire because they know the fire department is standing by.

zh: 现在是把他们手上的火柴拿走的时候了。
en: It is time to take away their matches.

zh: 在科索沃，最后一轮孤注一掷的谈判后形成了一份呈交联合国秘书长的报告。 美国和欧盟应该同意承认科索沃的独立，只要科索沃人同意执行由芬兰调解人马尔蒂·阿赫蒂萨里提交的计划。
en: In Kosovo, now that a last-ditch round of negotiations has concluded with a report to the UN Secretary General, the US and the EU should agree to recognize Kosovo’s independence, provided the Kosovars agree to implement the plan submitted by Finnish mediator Marti Ahtisaari.

zh: 阿赫蒂萨里计划为塞族人提供了充分的保护，并且让国际社会派代表驻扎在科索沃。 在这一方面，即便安理会没有达成新的决议，美国和欧盟也需要派人驻扎在那儿以确保计划的实施。
en: The Ahtisaari plan provides ample protection for Serbs and an international presence in Kosovo – which the US and the EU will need to deploy even without a new Security Council resolution – to ensure implementation.

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，塞尔维亚对阿赫蒂萨里计划的拒绝削弱了对生活在科索沃的塞族人的保护，并且增加了他们遭到虐待的危险。
en: Ironically, Serbia’s resistance to the Ahtisaari plan undermines protection for Kosovo’s Serbs and increases the risk that they will be mistreated.

zh: 美国官员总喜欢说美国曾经一再出面干涉以保护穆斯林免受战争和独裁统治。
en: American officials are fond of pointing out that the US has repeatedly intervened to protect Muslims from war and dictatorship.

zh: 但是如果迄今为止在波斯尼亚或科索沃成功的国际干涉最终以悲剧告终的话，这样的说法就不会有那么大的说服力。
en: But this claim will be devalued if the so far successful international interventions in Bosnia or Kosovo end in tragedy.

zh: 我们已经接近于在两个地方都取得令人满意的结果。
en: A satisfactory outcome in both places is within reach.

zh: 为了实现这样的结果，美国和欧盟必须确保塞尔维亚不会再制造麻烦，科索沃获得独立，而波斯尼亚能够保持完整。
en: To achieve it, the US and the EU must ensure that Serbia is blocked from making trouble, Kosovo becomes independent, and Bosnia stays united.

zh: 西藏，不断膨胀的罪与罚
en: Expanding Crime and Punishment in Tibet

zh: 发自纽约 — — 中国一向对其西藏地区的任何政治异见分子都予以严厉镇压，并因此遭到了外界的广泛批评。
en: NEW YORK – China has been widely criticized for its harsh treatment of almost any form of political dissent in Tibet.

zh: 比如在2008年，一个名叫旺度，原本在拉萨进行艾滋病防治教育工作的西藏人就被判处了终身监禁，因为他向海外的西藏人传播西藏暴动的消息。
en: In 2008, for example, a Tibetan named Wangdu, an AIDS educator in Lhasa, received a life sentence for sending news about Tibetan protests to Tibetans abroad.

zh: 而政府这样做的逻辑也非常简单：维持领导人所说的“稳定”和“和谐 ” ， 从而维护手中的政权。
en: The logic was clear: preserve what China’s leaders call “stability” and “harmony” in order to maintain state power.

zh: 但最近在西藏地区发生的事件却与上述逻辑毫不相关，因为案件牵涉到的两个西藏当地著名人士根本就没有攻击或是批评过政府。
en: But two recent events in Tibet, involving the trials of two leading Tibetans who had not attacked or criticized the state at all, do not follow this logic.

zh: 在6月24日的第一起案件中，42岁的嘎玛桑珠（中国大陆地区最富有的西藏商人之一）被新疆地区一所法院以盗窃文物罪判刑15年。
en: In the first trial, on June 24, Karma Samdrup, 42, one of the wealthiest Tibetan businessmen in China, received a 15-year sentence from a court in Xinjiang for stealing antiques.

zh: 人权团体认为该罪名是捏造的，因为在该案件于12年前开审时警方就以缺乏证据为由放弃了调查，而最近这次审判则既未传召证人，也没有提出新的证据。
en: Human rights groups suggested the charge was invented, because the police had dropped the case for lack of evidence when it was first investigated 12 years ago, and neither witnesses nor new evidence were produced in court.

zh: 尽管有两位中国辩护律师对公诉人的指控进行了详细辩护，但判决依然如是，并且消息只是在政府官员中私下流传。
en: Despite a detailed critique of the prosecution’s case by two Chinese defense lawyers, the sentence, which had been known privately among officials for several days, was confirmed.

zh: 接着在7月3日，嘎玛的哥哥，46岁的仁青桑珠以“威胁国家安全”罪被起诉。
en: On July 3, Karma’s elder brother, Rinchen Samdrup, 46, was tried on charges of “endangering state security.”

zh: 原因是他与其弟其美朗加在两人的家乡，西藏东部的贡觉县建立了一个小型环保组织，却没有在有关部门注册备案。
en: His crime was failing to register a small environmental group run by him and his younger brother in their remote home village of Gonjo, in eastern Tibet.

zh: 在中国，审判定罪率大概在98%左右，在西藏地区则更高，因此裁决也是毫无疑问的 — — 他被判处5年有期徒刑。
en: Having been found guilty -- the conviction rate in China is around 98%, and is even higher in Tibet, so the verdict was never in doubt – he was sentenced to five years in prison.

zh: 而38岁的其美朗加则由于在拘留期间受重伤，自6月11日开始就在医院关押留医。
en: The younger brother, Chime Namgyal, 38, who is disabled, has been hospitalized since June 11 for serious injuries received whilst in custody.

zh: 甚至在未经审判的情况下，他就被当地官员判处21月的劳改，罪名跟仁青桑珠一样 — — “威胁国家安全 ” ， 未经批准组织垃圾收集和植树活动，组织巡逻队阻止对珍稀野生动物的偷猎行为。
en: He did not even receive a trial, but was given a 21-month sentence by local officials for the same offense as Rinchen – endangering state security by unofficially organizing litter-collection, tree-planting, and nature patrols to stop the hunting of endangered species.

zh: 而即便是在中国，这些行为一般也都算不上对国家的威胁。
en: Even in China, such activities are not usually considered threats to the state.

zh: 这三起案件都疑点重重，因为这三兄弟都从未被指控有批评国家，反对共产党甚至谈论政治的行为。
en: These three cases are doubly inexplicable, because none of the three brothers has been accused of actually criticizing China, opposing the Communist Party, or even talking about politics.

zh: 相反，他们被人们视为西藏人的楷模。
en: On the contrary, they have been hailed as ideal Tibetan citizens.

zh: 嘎玛于2001年创立并资助了西藏最大的一个环保组织，并被中央电视台选为2006年度中国慈善家（当选原因是“创造了人与自然之间的和谐 ” ） 。
en: Karma had founded and financed a leading Tibetan environmental organization in 2001, and was named China’s philanthropist of the year in 2006 by China Central Television (for “creating harmony between men and nature”).

zh: 而就在去年，由华人电影明星李连杰创立的人道组织“壹基金”还向嘎玛颁发了“2009壹基金典范工程”奖，奖金100万元人民币。
en: And, last year, the One Foundation, a humanitarian fund run by the film star Jet Li, awarded him one million renminbi by for his “model project.”

zh: 而仁青桑珠同样也是名声在外。
en: Rinchen was well regarded, too.

zh: 他的组织在2006年度获“福特汽车环保奖”自然环境保护类一等奖，在2008年中国政府还称赞他及其组织“对政府的环保项目工作给予了极为有力的支持 ” 。
en: His group was awarded a major environmental prize from Ford Motor Company in 2006, and in 2008 the Chinese government described him and his organization as “an extremely beneficial supplement to the government’s environmental protection work.”

zh: 今年2月，中国最重要的报纸《人民日报》登载了一张仁青桑珠领奖的大幅照片，并撰文描述他的贡献（该报似乎不知道他自此之后就开始了长达5个月的拘留 ） 。
en: This February, China’s most important paper, the People’s Daily, published a large photograph of him receiving the award, together with praise of his work. (The paper was apparently unaware that by then he had been in custody for five months.)

zh: 事实上，一本名为《天珠》的书在去年末出版，书中对这几兄弟的贡献予以盛赞，并得到了广泛好评。
en: Indeed, a book praising the brothers for their work, Tianzhu (“Heavenly Beads”), was published in China late last year, to wide acclaim.

zh: 谁知到了6月，虽然书中并未包含任何政治内容，但该书却莫名其妙地遭到全国范围的查禁。
en: In June, for no apparent reason, the book was banned throughout the country, despite its lack of political content.

zh: 那么，中国政府为什么要把目标指向这些与政治毫无关联，且被视为模范公民的西藏人呢？
en: So, why is China targeting Tibetans who have no connection with politics and are regarded as model citizens?

zh: 这其中一部分原因可能是跟腐败有关，因为仁青桑珠和其美朗加曾经批评一名当地公安部门领导猎杀珍稀动物。
en: Part of the answer may lie with corrupt local officials. Rinchen and Chime had criticized a local police chief for hunting endangered animals.

zh: 而有怀疑说正是该领导在昌都地区的上级决定惩罚他们及其两个兄弟，索朗曲培和仁青多杰，这两人目前也因为某些模糊的罪名而被关押在西藏。
en: One of his superiors at the nearby prefectural headquarters in Chamdo is suspected of having decided to punish them, as well as two of their cousins, Sonam Choephel and Rinchen Dorje, who are also in custody in Tibet for vague or unspecified offenses.

zh: 但当地官员显然是无法安排嘎玛桑珠到遥远的新疆受审的，更别说去说服中央政府查禁那本没有政治问题，描述几兄弟对自然之爱的书。
en: But local officials could not have arranged for Karma to be tried in far-away Xinjiang, let alone persuade the central government to ban the brothers’ innocuous book about their love of nature.

zh: 这意味着可能有更高级的官员在针对嘎玛桑珠 — — 这些官员要求他们在新疆的同僚把盗窃文物的旧案翻出来 — — 因为桑珠利用自己和北京的关系来反映兄弟们在西藏当地官员处所受到的不良待遇。
en: Higher-level leaders may have taken up the case against Karma – persuading their counterparts in Xinjiang to resurrect the old antiques case – because he had used his connections in Beijing to complain about the treatment of his brothers by officials in Tibet.

zh: 这个推理比较有说服力，因为西藏自治区当前的领导人曾经在新疆地区担任要职。
en: This theory has gained credence because the Communist Party’s current leader in the Tibet Autonomous Region formerly held a powerful position in Xinjiang Province.

zh: 如果这是真的话，这个针对嘎玛桑珠的事件就意味着西藏当地官员的权力正不断膨胀，甚至能超出自己的管辖范围去处理一些显然属于私人恩怨的问题。
en: If it is true, the case against Karma suggests that officials stationed in Tibetan areas may be gaining more power, able to reach out beyond their jurisdictions to pursue what appear to be little more than personal grievances.

zh: 而上述事件也不仅仅是孤立的个案。
en: Nor are these the only cases.

zh: 据说拉萨著名旅游酒店“牦牛（Yak）宾馆”的老板多杰扎西也因为某种政治指控而入狱。
en: Dorje Tashi, the wealthy owner of the Yak, a leading tourist hotel in Lhasa, is also said to be languishing in prison on vague political charges.

zh: 在过去30年间，这些西藏大商人都被视为政府的天然同盟，而如今，这些事态的变化也是始料未及的。
en: In Tibet, where for the last 30 years major Tibetan businessmen had been seen as natural allies of the state, such developments are unprecedented.

zh: 中国的中央政府拥有节制地方首脑的权力，而其对西藏当地官员的放纵也是令人费解的。
en: China’s central government has the power to rein in its local chieftains, so its failure to do so in Tibet is puzzling.

zh: 如果任由事态继续发展下去，中央政府就可能失去那些遵纪守法，避谈政治的西藏人 — — 正如上述三个环保主义者 — — 的信任。
en: If it continues to allow such cases to go forward, it risks losing even more credibility among those Tibetans who, like the three environmentalists, have tried to stay within the law and avoid politics.

zh: 其他西藏人可能会因此认为：中国政府已经把该地的管治权下放到了那些心术不正的地方首脑手里。
en: Other Tibetans may conclude that China’s government has relegated governance of their region to local satraps who have their own interests to pursue.

zh: 在这么一个对中央政府充满猜疑和敌意的地区，将政治指控的目标从政治抗议者扩展到环保主义者，从持不同政见的僧侣延伸到商人，势必威胁到中国希望在该地区所达成的目标。
en: In an area full of suspicion and antagonism towards the state, expanding the targets of its political prosecutions from Tibetan protestors to environmentalists and from dissident monks to businessmen risks further undermining China’s own objectives in its most troubled region.

zh: 扩大就是团结
en: Expansion is Solidarity

zh: 如今常听人说欧盟吸收中东欧国家加入的做法如果还没有彻底毁坏欧盟的团结，至少也产生了很大的威胁。
en: Nowadays it is often alleged that the European Union’s sense of solidarity was put in jeopardy, if not shattered outright, by its enlargement to take in the countries of central and eastern Europe.

zh: 随着保加利亚和罗马尼亚入盟日期的临近，与土耳其和克罗地亚的谈判也即将开始，挑战这种说法就显得尤为重要。
en: As Bulgaria and Romania come closer to membership, and with accession talks with Turkey and Croatia set to begin, it has become increasingly important to challenge that view.

zh: 多数领域里，欧盟最新成员国的价值观和利益与最早的15个成员国完全相同。
en: The values and interests of the EU’s newest member states coincide in most ways with those of the 15 earlier members.

zh: 当然，东扩的确给欧盟带来了质的变化，也产生了全新的问题和政策顾虑，但中东欧的新成员与这块大陆的经济、社会和文化发展有着割舍不断的联系。
en: It is, of course, true that enlargement has fundamentally changed the Union and given rise to new problems and policy concerns. But the new member states in central and eastern Europe are deeply embedded in the economic, social, and cultural development of our Continent.

zh: 40年的苏联统治损坏了我们赖以联系的纽带，但并没有彻底抹杀这些国家的欧洲个性。
en: The ties that bind us together were frayed by forty years of Soviet domination, but this did not fundamentally change these states’ European character.

zh: 我的祖国波兰自始至终就与欧洲国家，特别是法国，有着深厚的文化联系。
en: My country, Poland, has always had deep cultural ties to other European countries, especially France.

zh: 欧洲音乐、文学和电影的所有重大发展都离不开我们的参与（这一点只要想想安杰伊·瓦依达在统一时代与法国联合摄制的《丹东》等电影就知道了 ） 。
en: We participated in all the major developments in European music, literature, and film (think of Andrzej Wajda’s films from the Solidarity era, such as “Danton,” which were French co-productions).

zh: 即便在体育领域，东欧国家也与其它欧洲国家也有着密不可分的联系。
en: Even in sport, East Europeans have long been integrated with the rest of Europe.

zh: 实际在一次大战前，德国国家足球队就完全由波兰裔球员组成，但最重要的是，波兰人、匈牙利人、捷克人和其它东欧人一直坚定地认为自己是欧洲人。
en: Indeed, before World War I the German national football team consisted entirely of players with Polish names. But, above all, there is a deep sense among Poles, Hungarians, Czechs, and others, that they are Europeans.

zh: 这就是“团结”一词在牛津英语辞典中的全部含义 ： “ 以感情和认同为基础的一致性。 ”
en: This is the very meaning of the word “solidarity,” as defined in the Oxford English Dictionary: “unity resulting from feelings and sympathies.”

zh: 欧盟原15国与东扩后的新成员间显然存在着以共同利益为基础的团结。
en: Solidarity, in the sense of unity resulting from common interests, also clearly exists within both the original EU-15 and the enlarged Union.

zh: 这条法则在一些特例中得到了证实。
en: The exceptions prove the rule.

zh: 我们不该因为欧盟在对伊战争问题上的分歧而忽略各成员国在所有其它重要国际问题上的一致看法，而在经济领域，对单一欧盟规则的不同看法也不该掩盖这样一个事实：那就是无论新老成员，我们对欧盟内部市场的看法是完全一致的。
en: The EU’s disunity over the war in Iraq should not overshadow its member states’ agreement on almost all other great questions of international affairs. In economic matters, disagreements on, say, a single EU regulation should not be allowed to mask the fact that no member state, new or old, has ever contested the internal market.

zh: 最后，东扩进程本身就明明白白地显示了欧洲在社会、人文和文化领域的团结。
en: Finally, the enlargement process itself is also manifestly a symbol of European social, civic, and cultural unity.

zh: 由此引发的争论并不能动摇新老成员国共同的信仰，那就是它们有责任在长达40年的分裂后重新建设这块大陆。
en: The fact that it provoked debate and dispute does not detract from the conviction shared by old and new member states that they had an obligation to rebuild the Continent after 40 years of division.

zh: 但有些问题如果没有直接造成分裂，至少也很令人担忧。
en: But there are concerns that, if not fundamentally divisive, are worrying.

zh: 欧洲不再是只信奉犹太/基督教的纯粹的白人大陆，这样的事实是否令人恐惧？
en: Should we fear the fact that Europe is no longer a purely Jewish/Christian and white continent?

zh: 很多来自其它大陆、信奉印度教、伊斯兰教、锡克教或佛教的欧盟居民是否能够接受“欧洲”的价值观和文化？
en: Will EU citizens whose origins are in other continents and whose religion is Hindu or Islam, Sikh or Buddhist, be able to identify with “European” values and culture?

zh: 他们是否会像波兰和捷克人一直以来那样，认可自己的欧洲身份？
en: Will they be able to feel European, like the Poles or the Czechs have always felt?

zh: 这些问题不可避免地集中出现在土耳其可能的入盟问题上。
en: These questions apply most pointedly – indeed, they cannot be avoided – in the case of Turkey’s possible accession to the EU.

zh: 尊重其它信仰是否会为欧盟增添新的活力？
en: Is European integration animated by respect for another’s values?

zh: 我们是应该接受这些信仰还是应该对其加以改造？
en: Is it about sharing them or about contributing to them?

zh: 这些问题显然十分棘手，特别是把文化看作欧洲未来的黏合剂时就更是如此。
en: These are obviously knotty questions. They are particularly difficult if we see culture as the cement of Europe’s future.

zh: 开始时，所有欧洲国家可能都认为：那些非欧洲的外来者应该完全融入欧洲的文化，就像19世纪的波兰移民融入到德国鲁尔地区的文化当中一样。
en: All European countries probably believed at the outset that non-European newcomers could be assimilated in the same way that Polish immigrants were assimilated into Germany’s Ruhr region in the nineteenth century.

zh: 人们所期待的融合没有大规模发生，但这并不是说永远不会发生。
en: That this has not happened, at least on a large scale, is not to say that it cannot happen at all.

zh: 只要看看越来越多在德国取得骄人成绩的土耳其人后裔，再想想那些身着西服、手提笔记本电脑飞遍全球的英国第二代印度和巴基斯坦人后裔就明白了。
en: Look at the growing number of prominent citizens of Turkish origin in Germany. Consider the many second generation Indian and Pakistani Britons who are now seen in business suits carrying laptop computers and flying around the world.

zh: 但欧洲人也必须承认这些人只能代表移民中很少的一部分。
en: But Europeans must admit that these individuals represent a small minority.

zh: 由于在社会和经济领域根本无法融合，欧洲很多移民团体都只能回头附着于自己的社团。
en: Many immigrant groups in Europe find themselves flung back on their own communities by the impossibility of social and economic integration.

zh: 经常性的恐怖威胁使欧洲伊斯兰人的孤立更为严重。
en: The constant threat of terrorism has made this isolation even more dramatic for the Europe’s Islamic populations.

zh: 欧盟不能仅仅空谈“团结”作为核心价值观的重要，却不采取行动团结那些身处社会边缘的移民。
en: The EU cannot simply proclaim “solidarity” as a core value and then do nothing to foster it among those who feel marginalized.

zh: 他们也必须能够感受到“基于感情和认同的团结。
en: They, too, must be allowed to feel those ties of “unity resulting from feelings and sympathy.”

zh: ”欧洲的团结根本经受不起他们的忽略。
en: European solidarity cannot and will not survive their neglect.

zh: 中国改革的新实践
en: Experimental China

zh: 香港—五年前，极少有人会料到中国能占据全球互联网公司前十名中的四席（以访问数衡量 ） — —阿里巴巴、百度、腾讯和搜狐，并且能产生华为和小米这样的创新性跨国公司。
en: HONG KONG – Five years ago, few would have expected that China would produce four of the top ten global Internet companies (by number of visitors) – Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent, and Sohu – as well as innovative multinationals like Huawei and Xiaomi.

zh: 大多数人也不会预料到中国对全球公共品贡献的日益增加，包括其旨在提供将欧亚地区（Eurasia）打造成一个单一巨大市场所需要的基础设施的“一带一路”战略。
en: Nor would most have anticipated China’s increasing provision of global public goods, including its “one belt, one road” strategy, which aims to provide the infrastructure needed to knit Eurasia into a single vast market.

zh: 还有更加引人注目的最新消息：尽管经济增长率正在放缓，但今年中国与香港资本市场首次公开发行量已达290亿美元，是美国市场筹资规模的近两倍。
en: More remarkable news has just emerged: despite slowing economic-growth rates, China, together with Hong Kong, has recorded $29 billion in initial public offerings so far this year – almost twice the funds raised in US markets.

zh: 不论从什么指标看，中国创新的节奏和范围都开始增加。
en: By any measure, the pace and scope of innovation in China has begun to increase.

zh: 这是如何发生的？ 为何会在现在发生？
en: How has this happened, and why is it happening now?

zh: 答案在于中国所遇到的前所未有的挑战，包括腐败、污染、不可持续的地方债务 、 “ 鬼城 ” 、 影子银行、效率低下的国有企业、政府对经济的过度控制等。
en: The answer lies in the unprecedented challenges that China faces, including corruption, pollution, unsustainable local debts, ghost towns, shadow banks, inefficient state-owned enterprises (SOEs), and excessive government control over the economy.

zh: 显然，没有人认为这些因素对中国有利。 但是，它们实际上起到了意料外的刺激作用。
en: Certainly, no one would argue that these are positive developments for China; nonetheless, they have arguably been a blessing in disguise.

zh: 这使得改革任务变得紧迫，并形成深远的影响。 事实上，传统GDP数据无法反映中国目前所推动的转型的规模。
en: They have imbued reform efforts with a degree of urgency that has had a far-reaching impact; indeed, conventional GDP data do not reflect the scale of the transformation that they are driving.

zh: 当然，在国家和地方层面，中国长期致力于推动市场发展的结构改革。
en: Of course, China has long been committed to market-driven structural reforms, at the national and municipal levels.

zh: 否则中国也无法成为世界第二大经济体。
en: It could not have attained its position as the world’s second-largest economy otherwise.

zh: 但中国成功的关键是持续改革实验，并且这方面的执着似乎还在增强。
en: But the key to China’s success has been constant experimentation, and the pursuit of that credo appears to have intensified.

zh: 比如，通讯、公路、铁路、航空和航海的网络化让中国成为全球耐用消费品生产枢纽，也改善了这些产品的分销。
en: For example, the networking of telecommunications, roads, rail, air, and maritime transport enabled China to become a global hub for the production of consumer durables, and improve their distribution.

zh: 最近，中国开始以同样的改革实践模式来构建更加创新、更加强调知识基础的经济，即由服务业和国内消费驱动的增长。
en: More recently, China began to apply the same approach to building a more innovative, knowledge-based economy – one in which the services sectors, together with domestic consumption, drive growth.

zh: 结果，中国日益重视所谓的“经济发展杀手软件包 ” — —用历史学家尼尔·弗格森（Niall Ferguson）的话说，这类软件包推动了西方崛起成为经济主导力量 — — 他们包括竞争、科学、产权、现代医学、消费主义和努力工作的伦理。
en: As a result, the country has increasingly been focusing on the so-called “killer apps” that, according to the historian Niall Ferguson, drove the West’s rise to economic dominance: competition, science, property, modern medicine, consumerism, and an ethic of hard work.

zh: 特别是，中国致力于刺激市场竞争和推进科学与创新。 中国在这些领域获得进步的三个基础指标是：改善治理、强化问责机制、有效的公共品投资。
en: In particular, China has worked to boost market competition and foster science and innovation, with progress in these areas underpinned by efforts to improve governance, strengthen mechanisms of accountability, and boost investment in public goods.

zh: 至关重要的是，即使中国的具体目标发生了改变，其决策者也一直坚持了到目前为止让中国取得巨大成功的实验主义方针。
en: Crucially, even as China’s specific goals have shifted, its policymakers have adhered to the experimental approach that has served the country so well thus far.

zh: 事实上，宽基础教育、向科学和创新开放、投资先进通讯基础设施、以及智能手机制造技术所组成的合力，让中国在电子和互联网行业迅速崛起。
en: Indeed, it was the combination of broad-based education, openness to science and innovation, investment in advanced telecommunications infrastructure, and knowhow in manufacturing smart-phones that fueled China’s rapid advancement in the e-tail and Internet industries.

zh: 向创新的开放 — — 以及一些人所谓的宽松监管 — — 也让阿里巴巴等平台得以抢在西方竞争对手之前整合支付和物流服务。
en: This openness to innovation – along with what some say is lax regulation – also allowed platforms like Alibaba to integrate payments and logistics before many Western players did.

zh: 中国的“干中学（摸着石头过河 ） ” 的政策有望继续产生对新问题的创新性解决办法。
en: China’s “learning by doing” approach is likely to continue to yield innovative solutions to emerging problems.

zh: 比如，面临劳动力减少的局面，中国政府与企业加大了对机器人自动化和其它提高生产率的技术的投资。
en: For example, faced with a shrinking labor force, the government has ramped up investment in robotic automation and other productivity-enhancing technologies.

zh: 中国领导人期望，由于实际工资的迅速增长（2008年以来每年增加了15 % ） 对中国竞争力的影响，最终可以由生产率增长所带来的收益以及急需的国内消费增长来抵消。
en: The impact on China’s competitiveness of rising real wages – which have been increasing by more than 15% annually since 2008 – will, the country’s leaders expect, ultimately be offset by the benefits of productivity-led growth, not to mention the much-needed increase in domestic consumption.

zh: 当然，中国的“干中学”改革实践也带来了巨大的压力，包括一些领域的倒退及失败。
en: Of course, China’s approach has brought significant stresses, setbacks, and failures.

zh: 中国的房地产、信贷和股市泡沫 — — 它们造成了鬼城、地方坏账和股价波动 — — 就是明证。
en: China’s real-estate, credit, and stock-market bubbles – which produced ghost towns, bad local debts, and stock-price volatility – attest to that.

zh: 但导致这些问题产生的前期改革决定，如下放土地控制权、允许市场决定人才、贸易、投资和资本的流动方向 — — 却是中国进步的关键。
en: But the policy decisions that gave rise to these problems – decentralizing control over land and permitting markets to direct the flow of talents, trade, investment, and capital – have also been critical to progress.

zh: 中国领导人十分明白这一点。
en: China’s leaders understand this well.

zh: 他们没有回避风险，而是时刻准备扭转失败政策；必要时他们愿意为错误付出代价。
en: Rather than avoiding risk, they remain prepared to reverse failing policies; and, if necessary, they are willing to pay for mistakes.

zh: 中国拥有巨大的储蓄 — — 反映在其巨额外汇储备中 — — 中央政府有足够的财政空间应对改革实践中的一些不可避免的失败。
en: Given the savings the country has built up, reflected in bulging foreign-exchange reserves, the central government has the fiscal room to afford it.

zh: 今天的反腐运动应该被视为中国领导人试图纠正过往在国有企业过度下放行政权利政策的另一大举措。
en: Today’s anti-corruption campaign should be viewed as an effort by China’s leaders to correct another negative consequence of past policies.

zh: 中国的国有企业改革是一个双管齐下的过程：政府将一些国有企业私有化，从而让市场竞争来约束公司管理者的行为，同时将其他（通常规模更大的）国有企业管理者视为公务员，受日益严格的公共问责法规（包括党纪）约束。
en: The approach is two-pronged: the government is privatizing some SOEs, so that market competition can check the behavior of corporate managers, while treating the managers of other (typically larger) SOEs as public servants, subject to the increasingly severe rules of public accountability, including party discipline.

zh: 本月早些时候，习近平主席宣布了新一轮国企改革的措施，旨在加强对后一类国企管理者的问责。
en: Earlier this month, President Xi Jinping announced a new wave of measures.

zh: 中国政府正以前所未有的速度、规模和复杂性来推进结构改革。 在这个过程中会面临一些失败的风险。
en: China’s government is running real risks as it pushes through structural reforms that are unprecedented in speed, scale, and complexity.

zh: 幸运的是，中国拥有足够的经验和资金实施下一阶段结构转型所需要的改革新实验。
en: Fortunately, China has both the experience and the wherewithal to experiment with the next stage of structural transformation.

zh: 为何美国债券投资者不恐慌？
en: Why Aren’t US Bond Investors Panicking?

zh: 伦敦—美国总统特朗普加码对华贸易战，美联储也在提高美国利率，而几个月前还一片光明的全球经济前景也开始显得黯淡起来。
en: LONDON – As US President Donald Trump ratchets up his trade war with China and the Federal Reserve Board increases US interest rates, the prospects for the world economy and financial markets, so bright just a few months ago, appear to be darkening.

zh: 全球股市跌向2月份的低点，欧洲和亚洲大部企业信心低迷，全世界决策者纷纷发出紧张的声音。
en: Stock markets around the world have fallen back toward their February lows, business confidence has weakened in Europe and much of Asia, and policymakers worldwide are making nervous noises.

zh: 这些事件是全球经济扩张结束的开始，还是最近的市场动荡只是错误的警报？
en: Are these events the beginning of the end of the global economic expansion, or is the recent market turbulence just a false alarm?

zh: 上个月，我强调三个指标 — — 石油价格、长期美国利率以及美元汇率 — — 表明全球条件仍将保持有利。
en: Last month, I highlighted three indicators – the oil price, long-term US interest rates, and the dollar’s exchange rate – suggesting that global conditions would remain benign.

zh: 经济学家可能警告说，在美国经济已经接近充分就业的情况下，特朗普的保护主义、大幅减税以及不受控制的政府借贷将助长通胀压力。
en: Economists may warn that the combination of Trump’s protectionism, big tax cuts, and uncontrolled government borrowing, coming at a time when the US economy is already near full employment, will ultimately fuel inflationary pressure.

zh: 但金融市场根本不相信这一看法。
en: But financial markets simply do not believe this message.

zh: 2月初的金融动荡以来，最大和最重要的金融市场 — — 美国政府债券市场所传来的消息更是令人安心。
en: And since the financial turbulence of early February, the message from the biggest and most important financial market – for US government bonds – has become even more reassuring.

zh: 尽管美联储决定提高短期利率，并暗示2019年还会有更多升息，但美国十年期债券利率仍远低于2月峰值。
en: Despite the Fed’s decision to raise short-term interest rates, and to signal more rate hikes than expected for 2019, interest rates on US ten-year bonds have fallen to levels well below their February peak.

zh: 三十年期国债利率目前也低于2017年3.25%左右的峰值水平。
en: Thirty-year interest rates are now below their 2017 peak of around 3.25%.

zh: 这些利率走势表明，债券投资者目前担心通胀和经济过热并不比特朗普采取减税、保护主义措施并从预算整合向激进财政扩张转变之前更甚。
en: These interest-rate movements imply that bond investors are less worried today about inflation and economic overheating than they were before Trump’s tax cuts, protectionist measures, and the shift from budget consolidation to aggressive fiscal expansion.

zh: 债券投资者不担心通胀和过热，这一事实并不意味着特朗普的保护主义和财政放荡一点危害也没有。
en: The fact that bond investors seem unworried about inflation or overheating does not mean that Trump’s protectionism and fiscal profligacy are harmless.

zh: 金融市场有时候会错到离谱的程度，如2007—08年金融危机前。
en: Financial markets are sometimes catastrophically wrong, as they were before the 2007-08 financial crisis.

zh: 但美国债券市场不仅仅是金融观点的指标。
en: But the US bond market is more than just an indicator of financial opinion.

zh: 债券市场所表现的长期利率对营商条件影响甚大，投资者的观点对经济现实的影响不亚于经济现实对投资者观点的影响。
en: The long-term interest rates set in bond markets have so much impact on business conditions that changes in investors’ views can influence economic reality almost as much as vice versa.

zh: 目前，投资者的观点和经济现实并不完全冲突。
en: At present, investors’ views and economic reality are completely at odds.

zh: 3%左右的长期利率不足以体现美联储2%的通胀目标加上2—3%的真实经济增长（在特朗普政府的大规模财政刺激落实之前就有望实现 ） 。
en: Long-term interest rates of around 3% come nowhere near pricing in the Fed’s inflation target of 2% plus the real economic growth of 2-3% that was likely to be achieved even before the Trump administration’s big fiscal stimulus.

zh: 事实上，经济分析和过去几十年的经验都表明，长期利率总是围绕名义GDP增长率波动。
en: In fact, both economic analysis and decades of past experience suggest that long-term interest rates tend to fluctuate around the rate of nominal GDP growth.

zh: 这一经验法则表明，当前30年利率应在4—5%的水平。
en: This rule of thumb implies 30-year rates in the 4-5% range.

zh: 如果特朗普将经济增长提升到4%的努力被认真消化，那么长期利率应该上升到6%及以上才合理。
en: And if Trump’s efforts to boost economic growth toward 4% were taken seriously, long-term interest rates should logically rise to 6% or above.

zh: 迟早，债券收益率和名义GDP增长之间的差异会缩小。
en: Sooner or later, the gap between bond yields and nominal GDP growth will presumably close.

zh: 要么增长大幅放缓（债券市场预期表明会如此 ） ， 要么利率大幅上升（因为债券市场预期被证明大错特错 ） 。
en: Either growth will weaken dramatically, as implied by bond-market expectations, or interest rates will rise dramatically, because bond-market expectations turn out to be completely wrong.

zh: 但在未来两年中，这两件事都未必会发生。
en: And yet neither of these things will necessarily happen in the next year or two.

zh: GDP增长不可能放缓，因为政府将采取大规模财政刺激，企业信心水平高涨，并且个人收入也随着就业岗位的迅速增加而强劲增长。
en: GDP growth is unlikely to weaken, given the big fiscal stimulus, very high business confidence, and strong growth in personal incomes resulting from rapid job growth.

zh: 那么债券收益率呢？
en: But what about bond yields?

zh: 如果美国经济继续如预期那样增长，长期利率是否将不可避免地大幅上升，对高杠杆的美国形成冲击并最终影响到全世界，使其偏离当前强劲而稳定的增长路径？
en: If the US economy continues growing as expected, is it not inevitable that long-term interest rates will surge to much higher levels, knocking the highly leveraged US, and ultimately the entire world economy, off its current path of strong and stable growth?

zh: 这不太可能，至少在未来一年不太可能，有几个相互关联的原因。
en: This seems unlikely, at least in the year ahead, for several related reasons.

zh: 首先也最重要的是，对慢增长、低通胀的“新常态”的信念在投资者和央行官员中间根深蒂固。
en: First and foremost, the belief in a “new normal” of anemic growth and low inflation is deeply embedded among investors and central bankers.

zh: 金融危机以来，在经过了长达十年的长期停滞和物价下跌后，投资者和美联储官员需要好几个月甚至好几年的持续且无可争议的通胀和增长提高的证据来使他们相信通缩条件真的已被逆转。
en: After spending the decade since the financial crisis obsessing about secular stagnation and falling prices, investors and Federal Reserve officials will require many months or even years of consistent and incontrovertible evidence of inflation and higher growth to be convinced that deflationary conditions have genuinely reversed.

zh: 即使投资者接受了债券收益率大幅提高的逻辑，银行和退休基金的监管高压，以及日本和欧洲的量化宽松和其他形式的金融抑制，将确保政府债券在远高于基本面估值的合理预期的水平上仍能保证需求。
en: Even when investors accept the intellectual case for much higher bond yields, regulatory impositions on banks and pension funds, together with quantitative easing in Japan and Europe and other forms of financial repression, will ensure continuing demand for government bonds at prices far above any reasonable estimate of fundamental values.

zh: 监管压力所造成的定价扭曲被债券投资者中间的一种条件反射所放大。
en: The distorted pricing cause by regulatory pressures is amplified by a kind of conditioned response among bond investors.

zh: 在过去三十年中，通胀和利率稳步下降，债券投资者也因为利用每一次暂时性的利率提高作为买点而持续赚钱。
en: As inflation and interest rates have fallen steadily over the past 30 years, bond investors have been consistently rewarded for treating every temporary uptick in interest rates as a buying opportunity.

zh: 这一经验形成了一种“抄底”的巴甫洛夫反射，只有好几个月乃至好几年的反向经验才能打破。
en: This experience has created a Pavlovian reflex to “buy on dips” that can be broken only by many months or perhaps even years of negative experience.

zh: 这一反射在过去两个月中非常明显。
en: This reflex has been strongly apparent in the past two months.

zh: 只要股市大幅下跌 — — 如2月初以及特朗普宣布对华贸易制裁后 — — 债券买入本能就变得不可遏制，债券价格应声反弹，促使长期利率下降进而稳定股市。
en: Whenever stock markets have fallen sharply, as they did in early February and again after Trump announced his trade sanctions on China, the bond-buying instinct became irresistible, bond prices rallied, and the resulting reductions in long-term interest rates stabilized stock markets.

zh: 在某一点上，债券市场的巴甫洛夫行为将停止，长期利率将大幅走高。
en: At some point, the bond market’s Pavlovian behavior will stop, and long-term interest rates will move much higher.

zh: 但在此之前，投资者对低利率成为经济现实的永恒特征的不可动摇的信念将让美国政府能够继续采取日益具有通胀作用的政策。
en: But until this happens, investors’ unshakable belief that low inflation is a permanent feature of economic reality will allow the US government to pursue increasingly inflationary policies.

zh: 而债券市场的自满所造成的畸低的长期利率将为全球金融市场提供安全网 — — 至少在自满变得不可持续之前是如此。
en: And the bizarrely low long-term interest rates set by complacent bond markets will provide a safety net for global financial markets – at least until complacency proves to be unsustainable.

zh: 朝鲜的麻烦
en: The Trouble with North Korea

zh: 纽约—没人会很在意朝鲜 — — 这是一个孤立的小国，有2400万人口，被一个自称共产主义的怪异王朝所统治 — — 如果不是它有核武器的话。
en: NEW YORK – Nobody would care much about North Korea – a small and isolated country of 24 million people, ruled by a grotesque dynasty that calls itself communist – if it were not for its nuclear weapons.

zh: 朝鲜的现领导人 、 “ 伟大领袖”30岁的孙子金正恩正在威胁把韩国富裕繁荣的首都首尔变成“一片火海 ” 。
en: Its current ruler, Kim Jong-un, the 30-year-old grandson of North Korea’s founder and “Great Leader,” is now threatening to turn Seoul, the rich and bustling capital of South Korea, into “a sea of fire.”

zh: 美军亚洲和太平洋基地也在他的目标清单上。
en: American military bases in Asia and the Pacific are also on his list of targets.

zh: 金正恩十分明白，对美国的战争可能意味着亡掉自己的国家 — — 全世界最穷的国家。
en: Kim knows very well that a war against the United States would probably mean the destruction of his own country, which is one of the world’s poorest.

zh: 他的政府甚至养不活国民 — — 饥荒时不时就会袭击朝鲜。
en: His government cannot even feed its own people, who are regularly devastated by famine.

zh: 样板间式的首都平壤甚至提供不了充足的电力保证最大饭店的灯都亮着。
en: In the showcase capital, Pyongyang, there is not even enough electricity to keep the lights on in the largest hotels.

zh: 因此威胁袭击世界最强大国家的举动看起来与发疯无异。
en: So threatening to attack the world’s most powerful country would seem like an act of madness.

zh: 但认为金正恩及其军事幕僚发疯既无用处，也不合理。
en: But it is neither useful nor very plausible to assume that Kim Jong-un and his military advisers are mad.

zh: 平心而论，朝鲜政治制度确实不乏疯狂之处。
en: To be sure, there is something deranged about North Korea’s political system.

zh: 金氏家族暴政的基础是意识形态狂热、残酷现实政治和偏执狂的混合物。
en: The Kim family’s tyranny is based on a mixture of ideological fanaticism, vicious realpolitik, and paranoia.

zh: 但这颗致命的种子有其历史来源值得细究。
en: But this lethal brew has a history, which needs to be explained.

zh: 短暂的朝鲜史十分简单。
en: The short history of North Korea is fairly simple.

zh: 1945年日本帝国覆灭后 — — 1910年以来，日本帝国一直对整个朝鲜半岛实施着残暴统治 — — 苏联红军占领了北部，美国占领了南部。
en: After the collapse in 1945 of the Japanese empire, which had ruled quite brutally over the whole of Korea since 1910, the Soviet Red Army occupied the north, and the US occupied the south.

zh: 苏联人从符拉迪沃斯托克军营中物色了一个相对无名的朝鲜共产党金日成，在平壤立他为朝鲜领袖。
en: The Soviets plucked a relatively obscure Korean communist, Kim Il-sung, from an army camp in Vladivostok, and installed him in Pyongyang as the leader of North Korea.

zh: 随后，关于他在战争时期的英勇事迹和神化地位蜂拥而出，个人崇拜随之建立。
en: Myths about his wartime heroism and divine status soon followed, and a cult of personality was established.

zh: 将金日成、金日成之子和金日成之孙当作朝鲜之神崇拜成为国家宗教的一部分。
en: Worshipping Kim, and his son and grandson, as Korean gods became part of a state religion.

zh: 从本质上说，朝鲜是一个神权体制。
en: North Korea is essentially a theocracy.

zh: 其中一些元素借鉴了斯大林主义和毛泽东思想，但金氏崇拜的大部分源自朝鲜本土的萨满神教：承诺救世的人神（文鲜明及其统一教出自韩国，这并不是偶然 ） 。
en: Some elements are borrowed from Stalinism and Maoism, but much of the Kim cult owes more to indigenous forms of shamanism: human gods who promise salvation (it is no accident that the Reverend Sun Myung Moon and his Unification Church came from Korea, too).

zh: 但金氏崇拜的权力，以及弥漫于朝鲜政权中的偏执狂，其政治历史根源可以远远追溯到1945年之前。
en: But the power of the Kim cult, as well as the paranoia that pervades the North Korean regime, has a political history that goes back much further than 1945.

zh: 朝鲜半岛就像是钉在中国、俄国和日本之间的一枚楔子，长期以来一直是大国的流血战场。
en: Wedged awkwardly between China, Russia, and Japan, the Korean Peninsula has long been a bloody battleground for greater powers.

zh: 朝鲜统治者需要游走在各个外国势力之间小心生存，还需寻找宗祖国（主要是中国历朝）以寻求保护。
en: Korean rulers only managed to survive by playing one foreign power off against the other, and by offering subservience, mainly to Chinese emperors, in exchange for protection.

zh: 这一历史根源导致朝鲜狂热地害怕和厌恶依靠强国。
en: This legacy has nurtured a passionate fear and loathing of dependency on stronger countries.

zh: 金氏王朝的正统性主要来自其正式意识形态 — — 主题思想，主题思想的核心是国家的自力更生甚至自给自足。
en: The Kim dynasty’s main claim to legitimacy is Juche, the regime’s official ideology, which stresses national self-reliance to the point of autarky.

zh: 事实上，金日成及其子金正日都是典型的朝鲜统治者。
en: In fact, Kim Il-sung and his son, Kim Jong-il, were typical Korean rulers.

zh: 他们在中国和苏联的夹缝中游刃有余，从两国得到保护。
en: They played China against the Soviet Union, while securing the protection of both.

zh: 当然，这并不妨碍朝鲜宣传机构指责韩国沦为美帝国主义的无耻走狗。
en: Of course, this did not stop North Korean propagandists from accusing the South Koreans of being cowardly lackeys of US imperialism.

zh: 事实上，对美帝国主义的偏执态度正是独立崇拜的一部分。
en: Indeed, paranoia about US imperialism is part of the cult of independence.

zh: 对金氏王朝的生存来说，外敌的威胁是必不可少的。
en: For the Kim dynasty to survive, the threat of external enemies is essential.

zh: 和古巴一样，苏联解体对朝鲜来说是一场灾难；不但苏联的经济支持就此消失，金家甚至无法再游走于强国之间。
en: The fall of the Soviet Union was a disaster for North Korea, as it was for Cuba; not only did Soviet economic support evaporate, but the Kims could no longer play off one power against another.

zh: 对朝鲜来说，所剩只有北方邻国中国，而如今朝鲜中国的依赖可谓无以复加。
en: Only China was left, and North Korea’s dependence on its northern neighbor is now almost total.

zh: 只要中国切断食品和燃料供应，朝鲜指日之间就可能崩溃。
en: China could crush North Korea in a day just by cutting off food and fuel supplies.

zh: 只有一种方法让人们的视线从这一羞辱性的窘境中移开：宣传自力更生和美帝国主义及其韩国走狗迫在眉睫的威胁，必须这样做，而且要提高到歇斯底里的程度。
en: There is only one way to divert attention from this humiliating predicament: propaganda about self-reliance and the imminent threat from US imperialists and their South Korean lackeys must be turned up to a hysterical pitch.

zh: 没有这一精心炮制的偏执，金氏王朝就没有正统性。
en: Without this orchestrated paranoia, the Kims have no legitimacy.

zh: 没有哪个暴政单靠蛮力长期维持。
en: And no tyranny can survive for long by relying on brute force alone.

zh: 一些人指出，美国可以通过向朝鲜妥协增强其在东北亚的安全 — — 具体而言，就是能诺不袭击或颠覆金氏政权。
en: Some people argue that the US could enhance security in northeast Asia by compromising with the North Koreans – specifically, by promising not to attack or attempt to topple the Kim regime.

zh: 美国人不可能同意这一点，韩国也不希望看到这一幕。
en: The Americans are unlikely to agree to this, and South Korea would not want them to.

zh: 除去其他因素，美国的缄默还有重要的国内政治原因：民主党美国总统不能忍受被视为“软 ” 。
en: Apart from anything else, there is an important domestic political reason for US reticence: a Democratic US president cannot afford to look “soft.”

zh: 更重要的是，即使美国向朝鲜提供这一保证，朝鲜的偏执宣传也会继续，因为来自外部世界的恐惧乃是主题思想的核心。
en: More important, even if the US were to provide such guarantees to North Korea, the regime’s paranoid propaganda would probably continue, given the centrality to Juche of fear of the outside world.

zh: 朝鲜的悲剧在于，没人真的希望改变现状：中国希望朝鲜继续充当缓冲国，也担心朝鲜一旦崩溃会有数百万难民涌入；韩国绝不可能像西德吸收崩溃的民主德国那样吸收朝鲜，它负担不起；而日本和美国也不愿意掏钱收拾朝鲜崩溃留下的残局。
en: The tragedy of Korea is that no one really wishes to change the status quo: China wants to keep North Korea as a buffer state, and fears millions of refugees in the event of a North Korean collapse; the South Koreans could never afford to absorb North Korea in the way that West Germany absorbed the broken German Democratic Republic; and neither Japan nor the US would relish paying to clean up after a North Korean implosion, either.

zh: 因此，朝鲜崩溃的情形让人崩溃，朝鲜人民将继续承受饥荒和暴政，战争用词将继续在三八线上下飞来飞去。
en: And so an explosive situation will remain explosive, North Korea’s population will continue to suffer famines and tyranny, and words of war will continue to fly back and forth across the 38th parallel.

zh: 到目前为止，战争只停留在口头上。
en: So far, they are just words.

zh: 但一着不慎 — — 就像萨拉热窝的枪声 — — 就可能导致全盘崩塌。
en: But small things – a shot in Sarajevo, as it were – can trigger a catastrophe.

zh: 而朝鲜还掌握着核武器。
en: And North Korea still has those nuclear bombs.

zh: 俄罗斯的非营利间谍们
en: Russia’s Nonprofit Spies

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 没有什么比对俄罗斯针对外国代理人的法律更让西方恼火的了。
en: LONDON – Nothing so riles Western opinion about Russia today as its law on foreign agents.

zh: 这项2012年7月通过的法律要求所有从事（未定义 ） “ 政治活动”的非商业组织以“承担外国代理人职能”的名目在俄罗斯司法部注册。
en: Enacted in July 2012, the law requires all non-commercial organizations (NCOs) engaged in (undefined) “political activities” to register with the Ministry of Justice as “carrying functions of a foreign agent.”

zh: 而随后于2015年制定的《不良组织法》要求所有这些非政府组织公开将自身定义为为“外国代理人 ” 。
en: A follow-up measure in 2015, the Undesirable Organizations law, required any such NCO to identify itself publicly as a “foreign agent.”

zh: 这个定义既怪异又意味深长。
en: The wording is peculiar and significant.

zh: 毕竟在一般术语中，所谓“外国代理人的职能”除了服务于外国利益外还有其他含义吗？
en: What, after all, are the “functions of a foreign agent,” in common parlance, except to serve the interests of a foreign power?

zh: 事实上，俄罗斯法律有效地阻止了非国家控制的非政府组织在该国开展任何活动。
en: Indeed, Russia’s law effectively prevents NCOs not under state control from carrying out any activities in the country.

zh: 显然这种设计使它们无法获得俄罗斯政府的资助，从而迫使它们自行注销。
en: Certainly, the designation puts them beyond the reach of the Russian funding which might get them removed from the registry.

zh: 可见它们不仅被视为外国人：还是渗透者和叛徒！
en: They are not only foreign: they are infiltrators and traitors!

zh: 有些组织自愿解散；其他则因不符合规定而遭压制；还有一些则流亡海外。
en: Some groups have gone into voluntary liquidation; others have been suppressed for not complying with regulations; and still others are in exile.

zh: 其中比较出名的受迫害者是萨哈罗夫中心，人权纪念中心和莫斯科公民教育学院这三个组织。
en: Prominent victims have been the Sakharov Center, the Memorial Center for Human Rights, and the Moscow School of Civic Education.

zh: 圣彼得堡的欧洲大学如今也因琐碎的技术违规而面临关闭 — — 这是俄罗斯政府最喜欢的官僚策略了。
en: Having fended off an earlier attempt to stigmatize it as a “foreign agent,” the European University at St. Petersburg now faces closure for trivial technical violations – a favorite bureaucratic tactic.

zh: 对那些海外背景独立组织的无休止迫害对俄罗斯有害无益，还损害了其国际声誉。
en: The vendetta against independent groups with foreign ties brings Russia no benefits and damages its international reputation.

zh: 我们可以尝试分成在三个层面来理解这一点。
en: One can try to understand it at three levels.

zh: 首先，2012年的法律是对前一年在莫斯科，圣彼得堡和其他俄罗斯城市爆发的大规模公众示威的直接回应 — — 这些示威旨在抗议普京第三次参选总统，成功当选以及因此举办的就职典礼。
en: First, the 2012 law was a direct response to the large public demonstrations that began the previous year in Moscow, St. Petersburg, and other Russian cities to protest Vladimir Putin’s decision to stand for a third term as president, his election, and his inauguration.

zh: 普京在2012年2月23日的唯一一次竞选演讲中回顾了俄国在1812年抗击拿破仑侵略的胜利，以此警告外界不得干涉本国内政。
en: In his only election speech, on February 23, 2012, Putin, recalling Russia’s victory over Napoleon in 1812, warned against foreign interference in the country’s internal affairs.

zh: 这一讲话直指2004年的乌克兰橙色革命 — — 据称由中情局组织和资助，推翻了莫斯科心仪的总统候选人维克托·亚努科维奇。
en: This was a clear reference to Ukraine’s 2004 Orange Revolution, allegedly organized and bankrolled by the CIA, which overthrew Viktor Yanukovych, Moscow’s preferred presidential candidate.

zh: 2015年的法律则对应前一年在乌克兰基辅爆发的，再次成功罢免了亚努科维奇的独立广场起义。
en: The 2015 law followed the previous year’s Maidan uprising in Kyiv, which succeeded in deposing Yanukovych a second time.

zh: 一份帝国的遗产 — — 对俄罗斯国家分裂的恐惧 — — 从未远离统治者的脑海，也成为了民主政治发展的主要障碍。
en: Fear of the Russian state’s disintegration, a legacy of empire, is never far from its rulers’ thoughts. It is the principal barrier to the development of democratic politics.

zh: 这份遗产依旧在所谓“前线组织”认知的阴暗世界中盘恒：那些真正的“外国代理人”虽然表面上独立且致力于有价值的事业，但是受到外国的秘密控制。
en: It is a legacy still mired in the murky world of “front organizations”: real “foreign agents,” apparently independent and devoted to worthy causes, but secretly controlled from abroad.

zh: 俄罗斯人对此都耳熟能详，因为苏联常常将这些组织当成秘密的外交政策工具。
en: The Russians know all about them, because the Soviets routinely established them as a clandestine foreign-policy tool.

zh: “前线”是一大批受人尊敬的，往往不会引人怀疑的学者和文化体育界人物 ； “ 后方”则由克格勃控制，并藉由该组织输出同情（或至少不批评）苏联的观点。
en: The “front” would be a collection of respectable, often unsuspecting academics and cultural and sports figures; the “rear” would be controlled by the KGB. The organization’s output would be sympathetic to, or at least not critical of, the Soviet viewpoint.

zh: 美国中情局也依样画葫芦。
en: The CIA responded in kind.

zh: 成立于1950年的文化自由大会（Congress for Cultural Freedom）就是其众多“前线”之一，该组织一方面资助一系列知名文学和政治期刊，例如英国的《邂逅》杂志；一方面又为铁幕背后持不同政见的知识分子提供帮助。
en: The Congress for Cultural Freedom, founded in 1950, was one of its many “fronts,” which funded well-known literary and political journals such as Encounter in the United Kingdom, as well as helping dissident intellectuals behind the Iron Curtain.

zh: 这些“前线”对各类事件实际上有多大的影响我们不得而知，但对于沉迷于阴谋论的人来说，它们是冷战秘密历史的重要组成部分，而今天的平面和电子媒体则为“前线论”提供了新的空间。
en: How much influence these “fronts” actually had on events is hard to know. To those addicted to conspiracy theories, they are an essential part of the secret history of the Cold War.

zh: 在充沛而生动的想象力推动下，足以让人们相信英国保守派政客乔治·奥斯本出任俄罗斯寡头亚历山大·列别杰夫旗下伦敦《标准晚报》的编辑是来自于普京的指示。
en: And today’s print and electronic media provide new scope to “frontism.” With a sufficiently vivid imagination, one can see the long arm of Putin in the appointment of George Osborne as editor of London’s Evening Standard, owned by the Russian oligarch Alexander Lebedev.

zh: 但对外国的怀疑在俄罗斯更为根深蒂固。
en: But suspicion of the foreign has much deeper roots in Russia.

zh: 所有努力学习俄语的人都就会很快遭遇到这种异乎寻常的模糊性。
en: Anyone struggling to learn the Russian language soon runs up against its extraordinary opaqueness.

zh: 俄罗斯的文化基因由小农社会背景中演变而来，以共同持有财产和集体生活为特征。
en: Russians’ cultural genome (DNA) evolved in a peasant milieu, in which property was held, and life lived, in common.

zh: （苏联共产主义所引入的西方概念都植根于集体财产的传统观念之上 ） 。
en: (Soviet communism, for all its imported Western inputs, was rooted in the traditional idea of collective property.)

zh: 社会关系不受法律规范的约束，而是通过非正式的了解和是否拥有共同心态的明确区分来管理。
en: Relationships were governed not by legal norms, but by informal understandings and a clear distinction between those inside and outside the common mentality.

zh: 正如电影制作人安德烈·科恰罗夫斯基（Andrei Konchalovsky）在2015年所解释的那样，在这个传统上封闭的社会里，俄罗斯人要么热爱要么痛恨；却不懂尊重他人。
en: Traditionally a closed society, Russians love or hate, explained filmmaker Andrei Konchalovsky in 2015; they do not respect.

zh: 彼得大帝于18世纪发起的西方化是一种强迫性生长 — — 是嫁接而非移植。
en: The Westernization started by Peter the Great in the eighteenth century was a forced growth –a graft, not a transplant.

zh: 科恰罗夫斯基认为，没有彼得大帝，就没有普希金，柴可夫斯基或托尔斯泰，只会有皮门大主教（Pimen，曾为克格勃担任间谍 ） ， 还有希腊人菲奥凡（Feofan Grek）和安德烈·卢布廖夫（Andrei Rublev）这些宗教画家。
en: Without Peter, writes Konchalovsky, there would have been no Pushkin, Tchaikovsky, or Tolstoy, but only Pimen, Feofan Grek, and Andrei Rublev.

zh: 但彼得大帝并没有将俄罗斯文明的重心从集体和斯拉夫民族主义转移到个人主义和西方文明。
en: But it did not shift the center of gravity of Russian civilization, which remained collective and slavophile, not individualistic and Western.

zh: 西方为俄罗斯带来了持不同政见者和船坚炮利，却未能将其内核移植过来。
en: The West gave Russia its dissidents and its missiles, but not its meaning. Putin understands this very well.

zh: 普京非常清楚这一点，他的演讲总会无意冒出几句监狱里的黑话，正是封闭社会的缩影。
en: Occasionally, his speech lapses into the slang of the prison, or tyurma, the epitome of the closed society.

zh: 希望废除外国代理人法律的想法可能难以实现。
en: It is too much to expect a repeal of the foreign agent law.

zh: 但俄罗斯可以通过将“外国代理人”的登记限制在资金来源50％以上由境外提供的非商业组织中来作出无代价让步。
en: But Russia could make a cost-free concession, by limiting the registration of “foreign agents” to NCOs that receive more than 50% of their funding from non-Russian sources.

zh: 这也能为国内资金松绑，使这些团体能够在俄罗斯开展工作。
en: This would unlock domestic funding, enabling such groups to operate in Russia.

zh: 西方这边也可以拿出些无代价让步，例如将一些俄罗斯人从欧洲或美国的禁止入境名单中删除。
en: And the West could offer a cost-free concession of its own – such as the removal of some Russians from the list of those barred from traveling to Europe or the United States.

zh: 在全球和平与繁荣在某种程度上取决于西方-俄罗斯关系是否稳定的情况下，为何要吝啬这些小小的减少偏执让步呢？
en: With global peace and prosperity partly hinging on a stable Western-Russian relationship, is it too much to ask for such small, paranoia-reducing steps?

zh: 双理记
en: A Tale of Two Theories

zh: 巴黎—全球增长再一次令人失望。
en: PARIS – Global growth disappoints again.

zh: 一年前，国际货币基金组织（IMF）预计2015年世界产出增长率为4 % 。
en: A year ago, the International Monetary Fund expected world output to rise 4% in 2015.

zh: 如今，IMF对今年的预测为3.3 % — —与2013年和2014年大致相当，比2000—2007年平均水平低了整整一个百分点。
en: Now the Fund is forecasting 3.3% for the year – about the same as in 2013 and 2014, and more than a full percentage point below the 2000-2007 average.

zh: 在欧元区，最近一个季度的增长令人失望。
en: In the eurozone, growth in the latest quarter was underwhelming.

zh: 日本又回到了负增长。
en: Japan has returned to negative territory.

zh: 巴西和俄罗斯陷入衰退。
en: Brazil and Russia are in recession.

zh: 世界贸易停滞不前。
en: World trade has stalled.

zh: 而今年夏天中国经济的减速和股市动荡又进一步增加了不确定性。
en: And China’s economic slowdown and market turmoil this summer have created further uncertainty.

zh: 诚然，闪光点还是有的：印度、西班牙和英国都好于预期。
en: True, there are bright spots: India, Spain, and the United Kingdom are beating expectations.

zh: 美国的复苏也很扎实。
en: The United States’ recovery is solid.

zh: 非洲表现出色。
en: Africa is doing well.

zh: 但是，总体而言，无法否认全球经济增长乏力。
en: But, overall, it is hard to deny that the global economy lacks momentum.

zh: 这部分是因为树木不可能永远向上长：中国经济无法继续以每年10%的速度扩大。
en: This is partly because trees cannot grow forever: China’s economy could not continue to get 10% bigger every year.

zh: 另一部分原因是增长并不是无条件值得追求的东西：增长略低但空气更清新，公民的生活会变得更加美好。
en: And in part, it is because growth is not unconditionally desirable: Citizens may be better off with a little less of it, and more clean air.

zh: 但许多国家仍然很穷，没有强劲增长的潜力，其他许多国家尽管较富裕，但尚未从全球金融危机中恢复。
en: But many countries are still poor enough to be endowed with strong growth potential, and many others, though rich, have not yet recovered from the global financial crisis.

zh: 因此，必须做点其他什么让增长回归。
en: So there must be something else holding growth back.

zh: 从本质上说，有两个互相竞争的解释。
en: There are essentially two competing explanations.

zh: 第一个解释是拉里·萨默斯（Larry Summers）提出的长期停滞假说。
en: The first, the Secular Stagnation Hypothesis, has been proposed by Larry Summers.

zh: 该假说的关键前提是目前让供求平衡的均衡利率低于实际（actual）利率。
en: Its key premise is that the equilibrium interest rate at which demand would balance supply is currently below the actual interest rate.

zh: 这似乎存在矛盾，因为大部分发达经济体的利率接近于零。
en: This seems paradoxical, because interest rates are close to zero in most advanced economies.

zh: 但真正重要的是真实（real）利率，基市场利率与通货膨胀率之差。
en: But what matters is the real rate of interest, that is, the difference between the market rate and inflation.

zh: 总体经济平衡可能需要真实利率为负；但通胀正处于历史最低水平 — — IMF预计发达经济体今年和明年通胀率均为负，新兴经济体则接近于零 — — 因此真实利率不可能为负。
en: Aggregate economic balance may require a negative real interest rate; but with inflation at an all-time low – the IMF expects it to be negative this year and next in the advanced economies, and zero in the emerging economies – this is not feasible.

zh: 有多个原因能够解释为何均衡利率可能已经进入负区间。
en: There are several reasons why the equilibrium interest rate could have reached negative territory.

zh: 其中一些是机构性原因：全球而言，储蓄率非常高，亚洲尤其如此，欧洲也比较高（德国的个老龄化国家存钱以备退休 ） 。
en: Some are structural: saving is high globally, especially in Asia but also in Europe, where aging countries like Germany put money aside for retirement.

zh: 与此同时，新数字经济的资本密集程度不如旧的砖块水泥经济。
en: At the same time, the new digital economy is less capital-intensive than the old brick-and-mortar economy.

zh: 而所谓的分享经济的崛起可能让这一趋势在未来更加明确。
en: This may be accentuated in the future by the advent of the so-called sharing economy.

zh: 其他因素是暂时性的。
en: Other factors are temporary.

zh: 在一些国家，债务融资的住房繁荣让家庭和公司过度使用杠杆 ；政府则削减预算以遏制自身债务。
en: In several countries, debt-financed housing booms have left households and companies over-leveraged; and governments have reduced deficits to contain their own debt.

zh: 结果是投资者过少而储蓄者过多。
en: As a result, there are likely to be too few investors and too many savers.

zh: 长期停滞假说令人担忧，因为根据这一假说，没有理由认为事情会自己变好。
en: The Secular Stagnation Hypothesis is worrying, because it gives few reasons to believe that things will improve by themselves.

zh: 诚然，债务去杠杆不是没有限度的。
en: True, debt deleveraging is not without limits.

zh: 但这一过程受到增长低迷和持续低通胀（拜高失业和萎靡的全球需求所赐）的制约。
en: But it is impeded by slow growth and, thanks to high unemployment and weak global demand, persistently low inflation.

zh: 更糟糕的是，在长期，低投资会破坏生产率，而长期失业会破坏技能。
en: Worse, over the longer term, low investment undermines productivity, while protracted unemployment destroys skills.

zh: 两者都降低了未来潜在增长。
en: Both reduce future potential growth.

zh: 看起来似乎形成了一个恶性循环。
en: A vicious circle, it seems, is at work.

zh: 在萨默斯看来，打破这一恶性循环的办法是保持货币刺激和通过财政政策大幅提振需求。
en: The way to break it, according to Summers, is to sustain monetary stimulus and boost demand aggressively through fiscal policy.

zh: 关于全球增长持续萎靡的另一个解释的最佳阐述来自央行的央行 — — 国际清算银行（BIS ） 。
en: The alternative explanation for the persistence of weak global growth has been best formulated by the Bank for International Settlements, an organization of central banks.

zh: BIS认为，过低的利率是增长令人失望的重要原因。
en: The BIS maintains that excessively low interest rates are a big reason why growth is disappointing.

zh: 这一解释看上去比第一个解释还要矛盾，但逻辑很清楚：政府常常试图摆脱通过供给端改革改善经济效率的艰巨任务，而依靠供给端措施。
en: This explanation may seem even more paradoxical than the first, but the logic is straightforward: Governments often try to escape the hard task of improving economic efficiency through supply-side reforms and rely on demand-side fixes instead.

zh: 因此，当面临因结构性因素引起的增长减速时，许多国家的应对措施时降低利率和刺激信用。
en: So, when confronted with a growth slowdown caused by structural factors, many countries responded by lowering interest rates and stimulating credit.

zh: 但廉价信用刺激了坏投资和过度债务，借款人常常无法偿还。
en: But cheap credit promotes bad investment and excessive debt, which borrowers often are unable to repay.

zh: 更为根本的是，投资是一项赌博，如果增长被结构性抑制，就无法产生收益。
en: More fundamentally, investment is a bet that cannot pay off if growth is structurally depressed.

zh: 伪刺激增长必然以悲剧收场。
en: Artificial growth promotion only ends in tears.

zh: 此外，BIS还认为信用可能大大激化了结构性弱点。
en: Furthermore, the BIS claims that credit may well aggravate structural deficiencies.

zh: 住房泡沫和对可疑项目的投资导致资源浪费和资本错配，最终恶化潜在增长。
en: Housing bubbles and investments in dubious projects result in a waste of resources and a misallocation of capital that ultimately dampens potential growth.

zh: 最好的例子也许要数21世纪初的西班牙，大学生们纷纷辍学投身房地产疯狂。
en: The best example is perhaps Spain in the 2000s, where students left university before graduating to take part in the real-estate frenzy.

zh: 西班牙建造了大量无用的水泥建筑而失去了人力资本，结果是双重损失。
en: Amassing useless concrete and losing human capital, the country lost twice.

zh: 这一解释的逻辑也指向一个恶性循环：增长减速导致伪方案，从而进一步破坏长期增长潜力。
en: So here, too, the logic points to a vicious circle: Slower growth leads to artificial remedies and further erosion of long-term growth potential.

zh: BIS支持财政约束、必要的债务重组以及货币政策的迅速正常化 — — 相当直白地批评了美联储的谨慎和欧洲央行的激进立场。
en: The BIS argues in favor of fiscal restraint, debt restructuring if needed, and swift normalization of monetary policies – quite explicitly criticizing the US Federal Reserve’s caution and the European Central Bank’s aggressive stance.

zh: 这两个理论都具有自洽性。
en: Both theories are internally consistent.

zh: 但都只符合部分事实。
en: Both also fit only some of the facts.

zh: 长期停滞假说很好地考察了欧元区在全球衰退后所犯的错误 — — 主权实体试图去杠杆，公司和家庭不愿支出，欧洲央行则保持相对较紧的货币政策。
en: The Secular Stagnation Hypothesis accounts well for the mistakes made in the eurozone in the aftermath of the global recession, when sovereigns attempted to deleverage while companies and households were unwilling to spend, and the ECB was keeping monetary policy relatively tight.

zh: BIS的解释就像是对中国问题的总结 — — 中国增长从10%放缓到7 % ， 但当局仍保持投资占GDP的近半壁江山并推进各种低回报项目。
en: The BIS’s explanation reads like a summary of the woes of China, where growth has slowed from 10% to 7% or less, but the authorities still push investment amounting to almost half of GDP and promote all sorts of low-return projects.

zh: 那么，那套理论更符合全球事实？
en: So which theory fits the facts better globally?

zh: 到目前为止，很难宣称发达国家过度刺激了需求。
en: So far, it is odd to claim that advanced countries have stimulated demand excessively.

zh: 持续低就业和接近于零的总通胀并不意味着它们犯了不知节制的错误。
en: Persistently low employment and near-zero aggregate inflation do not suggest that they have erred on the side of profligacy.

zh: 诚然，金融鲁莽仍是一个风险，但正因如此，必须在政策工具箱中添加监管工具。
en: True, financial recklessness remains a risk, but this is why regulatory instruments have been added to the policy toolbox.

zh: 因此BIS号召全面货币正常化为时过早（尽管这并不意味着应该让改革等一等 ） 。
en: So the BIS’s call for across-the-board monetary normalization is premature (though this does not mean that reforms should wait).

zh: 但是，在新兴世界，增长预期和实际潜力之间的不匹配常常演变为一个严重问题，需求端刺激和无尽的债务累积无法解决这个问题。
en: In the emerging world, however, the mismatch between growth expectations and actual potential has often become a serious issue that demand-side stimulus and endless debt accumulation cannot cure.

zh: 反之，政府应该不要再将合法性建立在膨胀的增长前景上。
en: Rather, governments should stop basing their legitimacy on inflated growth prospects.

zh: 爆发式扩张的美国预算赤字
en: America’s Exploding Budget Deficit

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 美国拥有一个规模庞大且迅速扩大的预算赤字。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The United States has an enormous and rapidly widening budget deficit.

zh: 根据现行法律，联邦政府今年必须借款8000亿美元，而这个数字还会在2028年翻一番，达到1.6万亿美元。
en: Under existing law, the federal government must borrow $800 billion this year, and that amount will double, to $1.6 trillion, in 2028.

zh: 在此期间，赤字相对GDP的比例将从4％上升到5.1 ％ 。
en: During this period, the deficit as a share of GDP will increase from 4% to 5.1%.

zh: 在这些年度赤字之下，联邦政府的债务规模将从现今的16万亿美元增加到2028年的28万亿美元。
en: As a result of these annual deficits, the federal government’s debt will rise from $16 trillion now to $28 trillion in 2028.

zh: 而联邦政府债务总额相对GDP的比例则从十年前的不到40％上涨到了如今的78 ％ ， 而国会预算办公室预计该比例将在2028年上升到96 ％ 。
en: The federal government’s debt has risen from less than 40% of GDP a decade ago to 78% now, and the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) predicts that the ratio will rise to 96% in 2028.

zh: 由于美国政府的大部分债务都在外国投资者手里，这个预测意味着他们将在未来十年内吸收超过6万亿美元的美国债券。
en: Because foreign investors hold the majority of US government debt, this projection implies that they will absorb more than $6 trillion in US bonds during the next ten years.

zh: 美国债务的长期利率将不得不大幅上涨以诱使国内外投资者出手购买。
en: Long-term interest rates on US debt will have to rise substantially to induce domestic and foreign investors alike to hold this very large increase.

zh: 为什么会发生这一切？
en: Why is this happening?

zh: 根据国会预算办公室的测算，就算去年的税收立法未获通过，2028年的负债比率仍将达到GDP的93 ％ 。
en: Had last year’s tax legislation not been enacted, the 2028 debt ratio would still reach 93% of GDP, according to the CBO.

zh: 因此债务爆发肯定有其他方面的原因。
en: So the cause of the exploding debt lies elsewhere.

zh: 未来十年赤字增长的主要推动因素是不断提升的中产阶级老年人福利成本。
en: The primary drivers of the deficit increase over the next decade are the higher cost of benefits for middle-class older individuals.

zh: 更具体地说，社会保障退休福利支出将从GDP的4.9％上升到6 ％ 。
en: More specifically, spending on Social Security retirement benefits is predicted to rise from 4.9% of GDP to 6%.

zh: 政府在老年保健医疗制度（Medicare ） — —跟社会保障制度（Social Security）一样，根本没有进行受助者收入状况调查 — — 上为高龄民众提供的医疗保健支出将从GDP的3.5％上升到5.1 ％ 。
en: Government spending on health care for the aged in the Medicare program – which, like Social Security, is not means tested – will rise from 3.5% of GDP to 5.1%.

zh: 所以这两个项目合共会将使年度赤字增加2.7 ％ 。
en: So these two programs will raise the annual deficit by 2.7% of GDP.

zh: 其实官方预计的年度赤字增长本来会更加难看，但由于去年制定的个人所得税削减政策将在2025年后失效，所以还能2028年赤字相对GDP的比例降低1 ％ 。
en: This officially projected increase in the annual deficit would be even worse but for the fact that the cuts in personal income tax enacted last year will lapse after 2025, reducing the 2028 deficit by 1% of GDP.

zh: 官方赤字预测也认为，最近颁布的国防和非国防全权预算支出项目支出只能起到短期提振作用。
en: The official deficit projections also assume that the recently enacted increases in spending on defense and non-defense discretionary programs will be just a temporary boost.

zh: 国防支出预计将从当前相当于GDP的3.1％下降到2028年的2.6 ％ ， 而非国防全权预算支出的占比将从3.3％下降到2.8 ％ 。
en: Defense spending is expected to decline from 3.1% of GDP now to 2.6% in 2028, while the GDP share of non-defense discretionary spending will fall from 3.3% to 2.8%.

zh: 但这些减少赤字的变化其实不太可能发生，导致2028年的赤字规模相当于GDP的7.1 ％ — —比官方预测还要高出两个百分点。
