en: These deficit-shrinking changes are unlikely to happen, causing the 2028 deficit to be 7.1% of GDP – two percentage points higher than the official projection.

zh: 如果允许在2028年出现相当于GDP7.1％的赤字规模并一路延续下去，那么债务相对GDP的比率将达到150％以上，从而使美国的负债比率与意大利、希腊和葡萄牙相当。
en: If a deficit amounting to 7.1% of GDP were allowed to occur in 2028, and to continue thereafter, the debt-to-GDP ratio would reach more than 150%, putting the US debt burden in the same league as that of Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

zh: 在这种情况下美国债券将不再是一种安全资产，投资者会要求风险溢价。
en: In that case, US bonds would no longer look like a safe asset, and investors would demand a risk premium.

zh: 因此政府债务利率将大幅走高，进一步增加年度赤字。
en: The interest rate on government debt would therefore rise substantially, further increasing the annual deficits.

zh: 由于金融市场看的是未来，它们已经在着手提高美国长期债券的实际（排除通胀因素后）利率了。
en: Because financial markets look ahead, they are already raising the real (inflation-adjusted) interest rate on long-term US bonds.

zh: 十年期美国国债的实际利率（基于美国财政部的抗通胀债券）已经从2016年的零涨到了一年前的0.4 ％ ， 再到如今的0.8 ％ 。
en: The real rate on the ten-year US Treasury bond (based on the Treasury’s inflation-protected bonds) has gone from zero in 2016 to 0.4% a year ago to 0.8% now.

zh: 由于年通货膨胀率维持在2％左右，实际利率的上升将十年期国债的名义收益率推高至3 ％ 。
en: With annual inflation running at about 2%, the increase in the real interest rate has pushed the nominal yield on ten-year bonds to 3%.

zh: 展望未来，债务比率上升，短期利率上升以及通货膨胀的进一步上涨这三者的综合作用会将十年期债券的名义收益率推高到4％以上。
en: Looking ahead, the combination of the rising debt ratio, higher short-term interest rates, and further increases in inflation will push the nominal yield on ten-year bonds above 4%.

zh: 那么如何能减少联邦政府的赤字并阻止债务比率的攀升？
en: What can be done to reduce the federal government’s deficits and stem the growth of the debt ratio?

zh: 从推动赤字扩大的某些力量中可以看出，减缓社会保障和老年医疗保险支出的增长必须成为解决方案的一部分。
en: It is clear from the forces that are widening the deficit that slowing the growth of Social Security and Medicare must be part of the solution.

zh: 这两者预计未来十年年间合共会让年度赤字相对GDP的比例上升2.7 % ， 是官方预计的年度赤字/GDP比率的两倍多。
en: Their combined projected addition of 2.7% of GDP to the annual deficit over the next decade is more than twice the officially projected rise in the ratio of the annual deficit to GDP.

zh: 减缓社会保障成本的最佳方式是提高获取全额福利的年龄门槛。
en: The best way to slow the cost of Social Security is to raise the age threshold for receiving full benefits.

zh: 早在1983年国会两党就已经达成一致意见，认为这个门槛应该从65岁逐渐提高到67岁，使社会保障的长期成本降低约1.2 ％ 。
en: Back in 1983, Congress agreed on a bipartisan basis that this threshold should be raised gradually from 65 years to 67, cutting the long-run cost of Social Security by about 1.2% of GDP.

zh: 自1983年以来65岁左右人口的平均预期寿命增加了约三年。
en: Since 1983, average life expectancy of individuals in their mid-sixties has increased by about three years.

zh: 如果将未来全额福利年龄从67岁提高到70岁，则会使社会保障制度的长期成本相对GDP的比率降低约2 ％ 。
en: Raising the future age for full benefits from 67 to 70 would cut the long-run cost of Social Security by about 2% of GDP.

zh: 虽然在这个时候减缓社会保障制度和老年保健医疗制度的支出增长并不是一个政治上可行的选择。
en: At this time, slowing the growth of Social Security and Medicare is not a politically viable option.

zh: 但随着赤字增加和利率上升，公众和国会可能会重新采用这种久经考验的手段。
en: But as the deficit increases and interest rates rise, the public and the Congress might return to this well-tried approach.

zh: 容忍民粹主义
en: Living With Populism

zh: 马德里 — — 1867年在议会登记簿上增补一百万选民的第二次改革法案通过后，英国政治家罗伯特·劳恩告诉同事“我们必须教育我们的主人。
en: MADRID – “We must educate our masters,” Robert Lowe, a British statesman, told colleagues after the passage of the Second Reform Act of 1867, a law that added over a million voters to the Parliamentary Register.

zh: ”在劳恩看来，受过教育的民众是确保英国实现参与式执政的最佳方式。
en: For Lowe, an educated populace was the best means to secure participatory governance in Britain.

zh: 但150年过去了，那些受过自由民主教育的“主人”显然没有学到什么东西。
en: But 150 years later, the educated “masters” of liberal democracy have apparently learned little.

zh: 人们可以想见，劳恩可能会对现在瞒天过海的民粹主义趋势印象深刻。
en: Lowe, one may assume, would not be impressed with the populist trends pulling the wool over their eyes.

zh: 正如英国脱欧公投和唐纳德·特朗普当选美国总统所显示的那样，选民太容易被偏见和虚假的承诺所愚弄。
en: As the United Kingdom’s Brexit referendum and the election of Donald Trump as President of the United States demonstrated, voters are too easily fooled by prejudice and false promises.

zh: 批判性思想越来越被作为精英主义行为嗤之以鼻，而不负责任的社交媒体 ， “ 假新闻”和“另类事实”则主导着民众探讨。
en: Critical thought is increasingly dismissed as an elitist endeavor, while unaccountable social media, “fake news,” and “alternative facts” dominate public discussion.

zh: 在无知的环境中，民粹主义政治家有意识地将那些自我感觉遭到忽视的民众当做猎物。
en: In an environment of ignorance, populist politicians make willing prey of those who feel ignored.

zh: 但因为那些政治家对许多人具有如此之强的吸引力，他们必须和很容易摇摆不定的选民一道接受审查。
en: But because those politicians are so appealing to so many, they, no less than easily swayed voters, must be scrutinized.

zh: 问题在于我们是否可以通过改革一个威胁自由民主的政治品牌来拯救民主。
en: The question is whether a brand of politics that threatens liberal democracy can also be reformulated to save it.

zh: 今天盛行两种类型的民粹主义：剥削型和开明型。
en: There are two types of populists today: the exploitative and the enlightened.

zh: 特朗普是前者的代表。
en: Trump represents the former.

zh: 凭借一个充斥着高盛校友的内阁，以及一个在为超富阶层减税的同时私有化医保和教育的承诺，特朗普让那些选他进入白宫的白人工薪阶层失望是命中注定的。
en: With an administration full of Goldman Sachs alumni, and an agenda that promises tax cuts for the super-rich while privatizing Medicare and education, Trump is bound to disappoint the white working class that won him the White House.

zh: 造成制造业岗位衰落的是自动化而非贸易。
en: Automation, not trade, is responsible for the decline of manufacturing jobs.

zh: 天然气，而非环境监管，已经推动了美国煤炭工业的消亡。
en: Natural gas, not environmental regulation, has fueled the demise of the US coal industry.

zh: 但特朗普的崛起并不仅仅是经济现象。
en: But Trump’s rise was not just about the economy.

zh: 它还体现了将美国本土身份与少数族裔和移民对立起来的思潮。
en: It was also about turning a nativist American identity against minorities and immigrants.

zh: 就像乔治·奥威尔在他对希特勒所著《我的奋斗》中所评论的那样，对煽动者而言，玩弄民众的情绪永远比唤醒他们的“常识”更加有效。
en: For demagogues, playing on peoples’ emotions is always more effective than appealing to their “common sense,” as George Orwell explained in his review of Hitler’s Mein Kampf.

zh: 这对美国的特朗普、法国右翼民粹主义者马琳·勒庞、德国的弗劳克·彼得里以及荷兰的基尔特·威尔德斯来讲同样有效。
en: This is as true for Trump in the US as it is for right-wing populists like Marine Le Pen in France, Frauke Petry in Germany, and Geert Wilders in the Netherlands.

zh: 但民主政体也可以制造一种更加开明的民粹主义，就像美国参议员伯尼·桑德斯所做的那样。
en: Democracies, however, can also produce a more enlightened type of populism, such as that offered by US Senator Bernie Sanders.

zh: 如果当时是他而不是希拉里·克林顿成为民主党总统候选人，而且如果他当选美国总统，他所作出的推翻美国社会经济秩序并植入某种斯堪的纳维亚式社会民主的承诺可能会激怒大批选民。
en: Had he become the Democratic Party’s nominee for president (rather than Hilary Clinton), and had he assumed the US presidency, his promise to upend the American socioeconomic order and implant a Scandinavian-style social democracy might have enraged large swaths of the electorate.

zh: 国会可能会破坏支撑其平台的整个崇高目标列表 — — 包括单一付款人医疗保险、为所有人免费提供大学教育、改革竞选融资和分拆大银行 — — 将其斥之为代价无法承受，甚至“不符合美国精神 ” 。
en: Congress probably would have derailed the entire list of noble goals that comprised his platform – single-payer health care, free college for all, campaign-finance reform, and breaking up big banks – as unbearably costly, if not “un-American.”

zh: 尽管如此，桑德斯可能会让美国更加贴近林登·约翰逊消除贫困或种族歧视的伟大的社会愿景。
en: Nonetheless, Sanders could have led America closer toward Lyndon B. Johnson’s vision of a Great Society without poverty or racial discrimination.

zh: 他肯定会尊重三权分立，不会用每天的谎言和自恋来玷污总统职位。
en: He surely would have respected the separation of powers, and would not have tainted the presidency with daily bacchanals of lies and narcissism.

zh: 桑德斯的道德指南和公众精神决定他必然谦卑，这种特质对限制世界权力最大的公职人员的冲动本能至关重要。
en: Sanders’ moral compass and public spirit counsel humility, a trait vital to restraining the impulsive instincts of the world’s most powerful officeholder.

zh: 桑德斯良性形式的民粹主义不仅仅是获取权力的一种方式；还是道德和社会改善一种开明的驱动力量。
en: Sanders’ benign form of populism was not just a way to achieve power; it was an enlightened drive for moral and social improvement.

zh: 他被民主党体制否决使得美国避免了一场两种极度对立的民粹主义体系对决的独特选举，如果汉娜·阿伦特有关“鄙视道德标准”对公众心态具有“病态吸引力”的理论是对的，那么愤怒的“主人”可能仍然会给特朗普投票。
en: His rejection by the Democratic Party establishment spared America a unique election contest between too diametrically opposed brands of populism. If Hannah Arendt was right about the “morbid force of attraction” that “contempt for moral standards” has for the mass mentality, the angry “masters” might have still voted Trump.

zh: 然而，赢得民众竞赛 — — 无论是英国的脱欧公投、西方民主国家的选举，亦或是与哥伦比亚革命武装部队（FARC）和平协议的公民表决 — — 都需要首肯民粹主义政治。
en: Nonetheless, winning popular contests – whether the Brexit referendum in the UK, elections in Western democracies, or even the plebiscite on the peace agreement with the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) – requires a nod to populist politics.

zh: 放弃既有制度，即使候选者本人是既有制度的一部分，现在已经成为规则。
en: Lambasting the established system, even when the candidate is part of it, is now the norm.

zh: 选民们现在似乎是在剥削思想承包商或开明领袖之间作出选择。
en: The choice for voters seems to be whether to side with purveyors of exploitative ideas or enlightened leadership.

zh: 特郎普永久性的反建制运动表明，即使身为总统，他仍然打算树立一个局外人的形象。
en: Trump’s perpetual anti-establishment campaign shows that, even as president, he intends to cultivate an outsider image.

zh: 这其实是剥削型领导的经典形式。
en: It is the classic form of exploitative leadership.

zh: 在这方面，他和以色列总理内塔尼亚胡有诸多共同之处。
en: In this respect, he and Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu have much in common.

zh: 在其十一年任期中，内塔尼亚胡一直对所谓的工党建制霸权主义和主流媒体持攻击态度。
en: Throughout his 11-year tenure, Netanyahu has maintained his onslaught on the supposed hegemony of the Labor Party establishment and the mainstream media.

zh: 但即使是开明民粹主义者也无法摆脱表里不一；他们也常常被迫背叛自己的投票者。
en: But not even enlightened populists are free from the risks of duplicity; they, too, are frequently forced to betray their voters.

zh: 但最终获胜的选举前，另一位以色列总理伊扎克·拉宾曾说“即使以换取和平为目的，下令从戈兰高地撤军的领导人也肯定是疯了。
en: Prior to the election that brought him to power, another Israeli prime minister, Yitzhak Rabin, said that, “the leader who would give the order to withdraw from the Golan Heights, even in exchange for peace, must be out of his mind.”

zh: ”但一旦就职，拉宾就开始同叙利亚谈判旨在用以色列从这块具有战略意义的高地撤军来换取签署与叙利亚的和平协议。
en: Yet, once in office, Rabin initiated talks aimed at securing peace with Syria in exchange for Israel’s withdrawal from the strategic heights.

zh: 西方民主制度似乎陷入了一个难题。
en: Western democracy seems trapped in a conundrum.

zh: 选民无法基于候选人平台作出明智决定可能破坏民主制度。
en: The system falters when voters cannot make informed decisions based on candidates’ platforms.

zh: 从长远来看，解决方案是像劳恩曾在一个半世纪以前所倡导的那样教育“身为主人的民众”并以事实回应他们的关切。
en: In the long run, the solution is to educate the “masters” and respond to their concerns with facts – as Lowe advocated a century and a half ago.

zh: 与此同时，开明民粹主义或许将成为最佳选择。
en: In the meantime, enlightened populism may be the best option.

zh: 无论在哪里践行民主制度，都不能允许缺乏信息和专业知识的选民追捧最终削弱民主制度本身的领导人和政策。
en: Wherever democracy is practiced, voters’ lack of information and expertise cannot be allowed to give rise to leaders and policies that weaken democracy itself.

zh: 欧洲政治的新机会
en: A New Chance for European Politics

zh: 马德里—大部分欧洲政治领袖都希望欧盟能走出当前危机，变得更强壮、更统一。
en: MADRID – Most political leaders in Europe want the European Union to emerge from its current crisis stronger and more united.

zh: 但危机开始以来，大部分欧盟国家所实施的经济政策让深入一体化遇到了前所未有的挑战 — — 目前已经取得的成就也陷入了危机之中。
en: But the economic policies that have been implemented in most EU countries since the crisis began have given rise to an unprecedented threat to deeper integration – and, indeed, to what already has been achieved.

zh: 金融和经济危机爆发五年已经五年了，反欧洲政治在许多欧盟国家逐渐成为时尚 — — 法国、英国、意大利、奥地利、荷兰、芬兰、希腊、葡萄牙甚至德国都是如此。
en: After five years of financial and economic crisis, anti-European politics has come resoundingly to the fore in many EU countries – France, the United Kingdom, Italy, Austria, Holland, Finland, Greece, Portugal, and even Germany.

zh: 日渐增加的制度性不满成为欧洲随处可见的后果严重的现实。
en: Growing institutional disaffection has become a corrosive reality almost everywhere in Europe.

zh: 克服欧洲生存危机、响应人民的变革需求的唯一可行之道是直面欧洲的国内反对者：决不妥协的政治。
en: The only way to overcome Europe’s existential crisis, and to respond to citizens’ demands for change, is to confront Europe’s domestic opponents head-on: politics without palliatives.

zh: 欧洲首先需要打破目前所处的衰退、失业和紧缩的恶性循环。
en: Europe needs, first and foremost, to break the vicious circle of recession, unemployment, and austerity that now has it in its grip.

zh: 这首先意味着把经济政策的注意力重新集中到增长、就业和制度创新上来。
en: That means, first of all, refocusing economic policy on growth, employment, and institutional innovation.

zh: 通过一路抛弃欧洲人民推进政治统一是不可能的，而这正是一根筋的紧缩给人带来的印象。
en: It is impossible to advance toward political union while seeming to abandon Europe’s citizens along the way, which is the impression that unremitting austerity has created.

zh: 太多欧洲人相信，牺牲并不能给更好更繁荣的欧洲创造基础，只能把他们拖入致命的混乱。
en: Sacrifice, too many Europeans believe, is not laying the groundwork for a better, more prosperous Europe, but is dragging them into a fatal tailspin.

zh: 面对如今席卷整个大陆的危险的民粹主义海啸，欧洲领导人不能再消极以待了，他们也明白这一点。
en: European leaders cannot remain passive in the face of the dangerous populist tsunami now crossing the continent, and they know it.

zh: 他们还有时间做出反应 — — 通过向世人表明强大的领导力和把增长置于短视政策之前 — — 但时间已经不多，而倒计时的钟在滴答作响。
en: There is still time to react – by demonstrating strong leadership and prioritizing growth over short-sighted policies – but that time is limited and the clock is ticking.

zh: 明年是关键的一年，因为它标志着当前政治周期的结束和新政治周期的开始。
en: Next year will be crucial, for it will mark the end of the current political cycle and the beginning of a new one.

zh: 明年将迎来新的德国政府、欧洲议会选举，年底还会有新的欧盟委员会。
en: There will be a new German government, European Parliament elections, and, at the end of the year, a new European Commission.

zh: 政治领袖应该将努力花在此处。
en: It is here that political leaders should devote their efforts.

zh: 没人希望欧盟因为人民的不满而崩溃。
en: No one wants the EU to fail because of its citizens’ disaffection.

zh: 利用2014年提供的政治机会需要从现在开始展开开放、教育性的努力。
en: To take advantage of the political opportunity offered in 2014 requires launching an open, pedagogical effort now.

zh: 欧洲人民已经显示了责任心和牺牲精神，但他们应该知道为什么希望 — — 即更高的就业和生活水平 — — 没有满足。
en: European citizens have already shown a sense of responsibility and capacity for sacrifice, but they should know why hope – in the form of higher employment and living standards – is not futile.

zh: 若非如此，明年的欧洲选举可能会带来不幸的悖论。
en: If that does not happen, next year’s European elections may give rise to an unfortunate paradox.

zh: 由于里斯本条约的结果，随着彼时欧洲议会获得了前所未有的权力，它被细枝末节窒息的风险也达到了最大。
en: Just when, as a result of the Lisbon Treaty, the European Parliament gains more power than it has ever had, the risk of it being condemned to irrelevance is greatest.

zh: 如果反映成员国情绪的选举产生出一个分裂的议会 — — 可能因低投票率而产生较少的代表 — — 僵局、不满和效率低下将难以避免。
en: If, reflecting the mood in the member states, the elections result in a fragmented Parliament – possibly rendered less representative by low voter turnout – paralysis, disaffection, and ineffectiveness are guaranteed.

zh: 这就是欧洲领导人应该利用即将带来的政治周期纠正欧洲制度设计、强化其国内合法性的原因，从而让它们能够应对欧元怀疑派临时的双边深化一体化交易。
en: That is why Europe’s leaders should take advantage of the coming political cycle to correct Europe’s institutional design and strengthen its democratic legitimacy, thereby enabling them to respond to Euro-skepticism and ad hoc bilateral deals with more integration.

zh: 如果欧洲人想要克服对放弃主权以实现政治联盟的恐惧，一种归依欧洲和欧洲机构的公民意识必须重新树立并成长起来。
en: If Europeans are to overcome their fear of giving up sovereignty in order to achieve political union, a civic sense of attachment to Europe and its institutions must be regained and nurtured.

zh: 达到这一目标的要求之一是作为欧洲驱动力的法-德轴心的复苏。
en: Achieving this requires, among other things, the recovery of the Franco-German axis as Europe’s driving force.

zh: 另一个前提是欧洲预算足以满足预算，能够面对前方的挑战。
en: It also presupposes a European budget that is sufficient to meet expectations and equal to the challenges that await.

zh: 解决这些问题与解决个别国家的经济问题一样重要。
en: Resolving these issues is as important as resolving individual countries’ economic problems.

zh: 事实上，它们在很大程度上是同一个问题。
en: Indeed, they are in large part the same problem.

zh: 制度的合法性部分来自于其效率，欧盟必须恢复其捍卫共同利益的权力，并将之与国家利益相协调。
en: Institutions are legitimized in part by their effectiveness, and the EU must recover its authority to defend common interests and harmonize them with national concerns.

zh: 欧洲议会可以行使其权力，只要人民认为有代表在议会中。
en: The European Parliament can exercise its power only if citizens feel represented there.

zh: 正如布鲁金斯研究所副主席德尔维什（Kemal Derviş）最近所指出的 ： “ 如果独立技术官僚能够决定长期政策并设置不受民主多数派影响的目标，那么民主本身便已陷入了严重的问题之中。 ”
en: As Kemal Derviş, a vice president of the Brookings Institution, recently put it: “If independent technocrats are allowed to determine long-term policy and set objectives that cannot be influenced by democratic majorities, democracy itself is in serious jeopardy.”

zh: 明年还是第一次世界大战爆发100周年纪念。 从那时到现在，欧洲经历了历史上最坏的时代和最好的时代。
en: Next year will also mark the centenary of the outbreak of World War I. From that moment until the present, Europe has both endured the worst and enjoyed the best of its history.

zh: 我们应该时刻铭记这个日子的诸多象征意义，从而明白欧洲到底改变了多少 — — 与此同时也认识到捍卫这些改变的需要。
en: We should bear in mind the enormous symbolism of this date in order to understand how much Europe has changed – and, at the same time, to recognize the need to defend those changes.

zh: 欧盟是人类最重要的政治里程碑之一。
en: The EU is one of the great political milestones of mankind.

zh: 因此，也为了从欧洲人目前的困难局面中走出并变得更加强大，欧洲领导人必须自信地认定更加一体化、更加无所不能的欧盟是不可阻挡的未来趋势。
en: For this reason, and in order to emerge stronger from the difficult situation in which Europeans now find themselves, Europe’s leaders must work with the conviction that the future is inexorably linked to a more integrated and more capable Union.

zh: 民粹主义的腐败核心
en: Populism’s Corrupt Core

zh: 纽约 — — 近年来世界各国民粹主义分子胜选已经导致许多人认定自由民主制度受到攻击。
en: NEW YORK – Populist electoral victories around the world in recent years have led many to conclude that liberal democracy is under assault.

zh: 但本周马来西亚前总理因腐败指控而被捕是表明对全球自由民主灭亡的普遍预测为时尚早的迹象之一。
en: But the arrest this week of Malaysia’s former prime minister on corruption charges is one of several signs suggesting that widespread predictions of the global demise of liberal democracy are premature.

zh: 自由民主制度前景黯淡的涵意是除非自由民主制度的捍卫者重新审视自己的政治和经济假设，否则就无法重新占领道德高地。
en: The implication of the doom-and-gloom view is that liberal democracy’s defenders cannot reclaim the moral high ground until they have reexamined their own political and economic assumptions.

zh: 但认为独裁主义的崛起完全来源于意识形态、或其代表了对民主、自由主义或人权及公民权利的普遍否定同样是一种误读。
en: Yet it is a mistake to think that the rise of autocrats is all about ideology, or that it represents a widespread rejection of democracy, liberalism, or human and civil rights.

zh: 今天当选煽动者背后的推动力量是权利和贪婪而非原则 — — 他们是在为维护自己、家人及亲信的利益而努力工作。
en: Today’s elected demagogues are motivated not so much by principle as by power and greed – they are in it for themselves, their families, and their cronies.

zh: 我们需要揭露位居新非自由主义潮流核心的等级腐败才能使这个不平等世界的平衡得以恢复。
en: Restoring balance to our off-kilter world requires that we expose the rank corruption at the heart of the new illiberalism.

zh: 匈牙利总理维克托·奥尔班的朋友和家人已经借助政府贷款和公共合同变得富有。
en: In Hungary, Prime Minister Viktor Orbán’s friends and family members have grown rich on government loans and public contracts.

zh: 在奥尔班的故乡费尔丘特，他的一位亲信监督建造了一座可容纳4，000人的足球场，而当地的仅有不到1，600人的总人口。
en: In Orbán’s hometown of Felcsút, one crony has overseen the construction of a soccer stadium that seats 4,000 people, even though the total population of the town is just 1,600.

zh: 虽然“2010年前的腐败现象大都是系统功能失调的表现 ， ” 但监督组织透明国际表示 ， “ 今天的腐败主要来源于系统。 ”
en: Whereas “corruption before 2010 was rather a dysfunction of the system,” notes the watchdog group Transparency International, “Today, it’s a part of the system.”

zh: 2014年在土耳其，接近总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安的人员，包括几位执政的正义与发展党（AKP）高级成员，均涉嫌卷入了据称试图绕过以美国为首的伊朗制裁行动的洗钱计划。
en: In Turkey in 2014, people close to President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, including several senior members of his ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP), were implicated in a money-laundering scheme that purportedly sought to bypass US-led sanctions on Iran.

zh: 上述丑闻导致四名内阁部长辞职，并公开了一段录音，据称在这段录音中可以听到 埃尔多安告诉自己的儿子将高达数百万美元的不义之财处理掉。
en: The scandal led to the resignation of four cabinet ministers, and to the release of audio recordings in which Erdoğan allegedly can be heard telling his son to dispose of millions of dollars of ill-gotten funds.

zh: 但埃尔多安将上述指控说成是陷害，而土耳其检察人员最终宣布将此案撤销。
en: But Erdoğan dismissed the allegations as a set-up, and Turkish prosecutors eventually quashed the case.

zh: 马来西亚前首相纳吉布·拉扎克及其同事现在被指控从政府投资基金1MDB掠夺超过45亿美元的财富。
en: In Malaysia, former Prime Minister Najib Razak and his associates now stand accused of pillaging more than $4.5 billion from 1MDB, a government investment fund.

zh: 据美国司法部透露，这笔被盗资金被用于购买曼哈顿的高端房产、洛杉矶的豪宅、莫奈和凡高的画作、公务飞机、游艇和其他奢侈品。
en: According to the US Department of Justice, the pilfered money was used to purchase high-end real estate in Manhattan, mansions in Los Angeles, paintings by Monet and Van Gogh, a corporate jet, a yacht, and other luxury goods.

zh: 当然，在美国，围绕总统唐纳德·特朗普及其家人的私利及其对公务行为造成何种影响依然存在着诸多质疑。
en: And in the United States, of course, questions continue to swirl around the private interests of President Donald Trump and his family, and how they may bear on his behavior in office.

zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是， 对腐败的愤怒在推动当前民粹主义独裁潮流方面发挥了关键的作用。
en: The irony is that anger over corruption played a critical role in fueling the current wave of populist autocrats.

zh: 因此为了捍卫自由民主，我们必须重新控制反腐败斗争。
en: So, to defend liberal democracy, we must reclaim the anti-corruption mantle.

zh: 通过重新分配来自政界和企业窃贼及其法律和金融宗主的盗窃财产，反腐败运动不仅要让强权人物为自己的腐败行为负责。
en: By redistributing stolen assets from political and corporate thieves and their legal and financial enablers, anti-corruption campaigns do not just hold the powerful to account.

zh: 它们还可以解决不平等 — — 从而将被民粹分子利用的普遍的挫折感从根本上铲除。
en: They can also address inequality – and thus the widespread frustration that populists have exploited.

zh: 但打击腐败同时意味着揭露 — — 并起诉 — — 那些威胁、杀害或以其他方式阻挠记者曝光权力滥用的既得利益者。
en: But fighting corruption also means shining a spotlight on – and prosecuting – those who threaten, kill, or otherwise thwart journalists working to expose abuses of power.

zh: 言论自由和其他基本权利绝不是像当局所称的那样是一种奢侈品，而且是仅仅属于精英的。
en: Freedom of expression and other fundamental rights are not elitist luxuries, as authoritarians claim.

zh: 它们对保护自由社会起到了不可或缺的作用。
en: They are indispensable for safeguarding free societies.

zh: 此外，在政治分歧严重的国家，要想实现团结可以依靠协调一致的反腐行动。
en: Moreover, a concerted campaign against corruption could serve as a unifying force in countries with deep political divisions.

zh: 虽然多数政府可以粗暴对待少数民族利益，但腐败政权却会偷走所有人的财富。
en: While a majoritarian government can ride roughshod over the interests of minorities, corrupt regimes steal from everyone.

zh: 这也能够解释腐败行为为什么在过去一年中引发了从布加勒斯特到 巴西利亚的大规模抗议活动。
en: That is why corruption has provoked mass protests from Bucharest to Brasilia over the past year.

zh: 可以肯定，当权者可以将反腐败运动当作政治工具来使用。
en: To be sure, those in power can turn anti-corruption campaigns into a political tool.

zh: 在中国，习近平主席巧妙地利用了反腐运动来消灭政治对手并将近乎绝对的权力争取到手中。
en: In China, President Xi Jinping has made deft use of anti-corruption purges to eliminate political adversaries and secure near-absolute power.

zh: 但正因如此，自由民主倡导者就更有理由加倍努力打击辜负公众信任的行径。
en: But this is all the more reason for proponents of liberal democracy to redouble their own efforts to combat violations of the public trust.

zh: 幸运的是，上述努力已经留下了良好的记录。
en: Fortunately, those efforts already have a strong track record.

zh: 在美国，海外反腐败法40年来越来越强有力的诉讼已经对世界各地的腐败行为进行了惩戒，并追回了高达数十亿美元的被盗资产。
en: In the US, four decades of increasingly robust prosecutions under the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act have punished misconduct around the world and recovered billions of dollars in stolen assets.

zh: 尽管特朗普本人一直批评海外反腐败法，但其尚未削弱该法案的执法活动（尽管这种情况仍有可能发生 ） 。
en: And despite Trump’s own long-standing criticisms of the FCPA, he has yet to blunt its enforcement activities (though that may yet happen).

zh: 同样，在法国，检察人员最近刚对一名前总统和在非洲从事大规模腐败行为的知名商业大亨提出了指控。
en: Likewise, in France, prosecutors recently charged a former president and a leading business tycoon with large-scale corruption in Africa.

zh: 在英国，政府刚刚通过法律，要求英国所有海外领地 — — 同时也是黑金臭名昭著的避险天堂 — — 到2020年底公开其注册企业的真正所有者。
en: In the United Kingdom, the government has just adopted rules requiring that all British overseas territories – notorious havens for dark money – publicly list the real owners of registered companies by the end of 2020.

zh: 在西班牙，长期执政的西班牙人民党不久前在一次不信任投票中失利，究其原因是一次针对金融渎职行为的刑事调查将该党财务主管投入狱中。
en: And in Spain, the long-ruling Partido Popular recently lost a no-confidence vote following a criminal investigation of financial malfeasance that sent its treasurer to prison.

zh: 尽管有这些进步迹象，但还需要采取进一步行动。
en: But despite these signs of progress, more action is needed.

zh: 各司法辖区的反腐执法力度仍然不平衡。
en: Anti-corruption enforcement remains uneven across different jurisdictions.

zh: 为管理跨国金融交易，我们必须建立起更有力的检察和调查人员国际网络。
en: To address transnational financial transactions, we must build stronger international networks of prosecutors and investigators.

zh: 与此同时，各国政府应当效法英国终结秘密第三方“受益所有权”的习惯做法。
en: At the same time, more governments should follow the UK’s example, by ending the practice of “beneficial ownership” by secret third parties.

zh: 纽约某些最昂贵公寓的所有者通过信托、有限责任公司、或其他实体方式注册从而为掩盖身份付出了巨大的努力 — — 而这些努力多数均属合法。
en: Owners of some of the most expensive apartments in New York City have gone to great effort – much of it legal – to keep their identities hidden, by registering through trusts, limited liability companies, or other entities.

zh: 从更广义上讲，公共和私人捐助者应当加强对民间社会组织和独立媒体的支持力度。
en: More broadly, public and private donors should bolster their support for civil-society organizations and independent media.

zh: 上述机构可以追踪并揭露腐败，向外界揭露强权政治人物所扮演的角色，并推动国家主体制裁那些责任者。
en: These institutions can track and expose corruption, explain how it implicates powerful political figures, and push state actors to sanction those responsible.

zh: 控制腐败绝非易事，因为许多经济体均依赖与犯罪活动相关的资金流。
en: Reining in corruption will not be easy, given that many economies are dependent on investment flows linked to criminal activity.

zh: 但很明显无所作为会产生什么样的后果。
en: But the consequences of doing nothing are clear.

zh: 腐败是对自由价值观的背叛和推动民粹主义发展的主要力量。
en: Corruption is a primary driver of populism and the retreat from liberal values.

zh: 因此下次如果再有人问你自由民主都发生了什么，告诉他们要追踪资金流。
en: So the next time someone asks you what happened to liberal democracy, tell them to follow the money.

zh: 腐败如何助长气候变化
en: How Corruption Fuels Climate Change

zh: 伦敦、柏林—2016年，反腐运动取得了许多关键性胜利，比如通过保证了大石油公司最复杂的交易之一的问责：2011年荷兰皇家壳牌公司和意大利最大公司埃尼集团（Eni）收购尼日利亚离岸油块OPL245。
en: LONDON, BERLIN – Anti-corruption campaigners achieved a number of crucial victories in 2016, not least by ensuring accountability for one of Big Oil’s most crooked deals: the acquisition of Nigerian offshore oil block OPL 245 in 2011 by Royal Dutch Shell and Eni, Italy’s largest corporation.

zh: 去年12月，尼日利亚经济和金融犯罪委员会起诉了与此案有关的尼日利亚人，意大利检方随后也完成了调查，负责该并购交易的高管和公司即将受审。
en: Last December, Nigeria’s Economic and Financial Crimes Commission indicted some of the Nigerians involved, and Italian prosecutors then concluded their own investigation, bringing the executives and the companies responsible for the deal closer to standing trial.

zh: 几个月前，2016年6月，美国证券与交易委员会（SEC）发布了一项规则，根据2010年多德-弗兰克（Dodd-Frank）法第1504条，石油、天然气和矿业公司必须逐项披露它们在所有项目上向政府支付情况。
en: Several months earlier, in June 2016, the US Securities and Exchange Commission published a rule, under Section 1504 of the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act, requiring oil, gas, and mining companies to disclose all payments made to governments on a project-by-project basis.

zh: 如果SEC更早一些发布这一规则，壳牌和埃尼很有可能不会继续进行OPL245交易，因为它们必须披露它们的支付情况。
en: If the SEC had issued its rule earlier, Shell and Eni most likely would not have gone ahead with the OPL 245 deal, because they would have had to disclose their payment.

zh: 但来自石油业的反对推迟了这一规则，两家公司得以隐瞒它们的支付情况。
en: But opposition from the oil industry delayed the rule, so the companies were able to conceal their payment.

zh: 去年也是几百万年以来大气中二氧化碳第一次达到400ppm（百万分之一 ） 。
en: Last year also marked the first time in millions of years that the concentration of CO2 in the atmosphere reached 400 parts per million (ppm).

zh: 2015年12月，巴黎气候协定签署，被视为是一项重大成功。 但很多签署国显然缺乏信守减排承诺的决心。
en: While the Paris climate agreement was hailed as a major success when it was concluded in December 2015, many signatories have displayed a remarkable lack of ambition in upholding their carbon-reduction commitments.

zh: 要理解个中原因，只要看看我们的政府系统被既得利益的腐败影响力所侵蚀的触目惊心的情况。
en: To understand why is to see the sheer extent to which our systems of government have been captured by the corrupting influence of vested interests.

zh: OPL245交易始于1998年，当时的尼日利亚独裁者阿巴查（Sani Abacha）将这一油块赏给了马拉布石油和天然气公司（Malabu Oil and Gas ） ， 该公司由阿巴查的石油部长丹·埃提提（Dan Etete）秘密所有。
en: The story of OPL 245 began in 1998, when the Nigerian dictator Sani Abacha awarded the block to Malabu Oil and Gas, which was secretly owned by Dan Etete, Abacha’s own oil minister.

zh: 因此，埃提提实际上是把OPL245送给了自己。
en: Thus, Etete had essentially given OPL 245 to himself.

zh: 但随着阿巴查政权的倒台，该油块被从马拉布公司夺走，给了壳牌公司。
en: But after the Abacha regime fell, the block was taken from Malabu and awarded to Shell.

zh: 这引发了马拉布、壳牌和尼日利亚政府之间的一系列法律纠纷，最终的结果是2011年腐败的壳牌-埃尼交易。
en: This triggered a series of legal battles between Malabu, Shell, and the Nigerian government that ended only with the corrupt Shell-Eni deal in 2011.

zh: 公开档案显示，壳牌和埃尼就该交易向尼日利亚政府支付了11亿美元，实际上这笔钱给了马拉布。
en: Public documents show that the $1.1 billion that Shell and Eni paid to the Nigerian government for the deal was, in reality, being paid to Malabu.

zh: 两家公司都知道这一支付方法 — — 通过一个在伦敦JP摩根银行开设的账户 — — 违反了尼日利亚宪法，这笔钱最终将落入私人手中。
en: Both companies knew that this payment method, through an account created by J.P. Morgan in London, was in breach of the Nigerian constitution, and that the funds would end up in private hands.

zh: 埃尼集团宣称它调查了该交易，发现“没有证据表明存在于交易有关的腐败行为。
en: Eni claims that it investigated the deal and found “no evidence of corrupt conduct in relation to the transaction.”

zh: ”至于壳牌公司，它说它只向尼日利亚政府付了钱，并且“不同意全球见证（Global Witness）组织所发布的关于壳牌公司与OPL245的关系的各种公开陈述的背后的假定。
en: Shell, for its part, says that it only paid the Nigerian government, and that it does “not agree with the premise behind various public statements made by Global Witness about Shell companies in relation to OPL 245.”

zh: ”但意大利检方现在要求对多位埃尼集团高管 — — 包括现任首席执行官克劳迪奥·德斯卡尔奇（Claudio Descalzi）和他的前任 — — 以及埃提提和其他一些人进行庭审；并且正在寻求对四位壳牌公司高管提起各自的指控。
en: But Italian prosecutors have now requested a trial for several senior Eni executives – including the current CEO, Claudio Descalzi, and his predecessor – as well as Etete and several others; and they are pursuing separate charges against four senior Shell executives.

zh: 不论这些起诉成功与否，目前我们无法再为SEC的披露规则，或美国重新支持建立采掘业的全球透明度标准的态度欢呼雀跃。
en: Whether or not these prosecutions succeed, for now we can no longer celebrate the SEC’s disclosure rule, or the United States’ renewed support in creating a global standard of transparency for the extractive industries.

zh: 在特朗普当选总统、共和党控制国会的情况下，SEC规则立刻根据国会审查法被撤销，这部晦涩的法律此前只动用过一次。
en: With Donald Trump’s presidency and a Republican-controlled Congress, the SEC rule was immediately vacated under the Congressional Review Act, an obscure law that had been used only once before.

zh: 特朗普经常表现出种族主义和仇女倾向，承诺要“清理门户 ” ， 根除华盛顿政坛的腐败。
en: Trump’s frequently racist and misogynist campaign promised to “drain the swamp” of corruption in Washington politics.

zh: 但国会共和党决定撤销SEC规则，并且立刻经由特朗普签署为法律，这是一次赤裸裸的犬儒主义行动，只能让特朗普宣称要大力铲除的“腐败”制度持久化。
en: But congressional Republicans’ decision to scrap the SEC rule, which Trump quickly signed into law, was an act of pure cynicism that helps perpetuate the “corrupt” system that Trump claims he ran against.

zh: 石油和天然气行业通过法律行动阻挠第1504条失败后，转向了他们在国会中的朋友寻求帮助。
en: After the oil and gas industry failed to block Section 1504 through legal action, it appealed to its friends in Congress for help.

zh: 要不是结果如此悲剧的话，他们的国会代理人所提出的论点可谓荒谬可笑。
en: And the arguments used by its congressional proxies would be risible had the consequences not been so tragic.

zh: 参议员詹姆斯·因霍夫（James Inhofe）以拒绝承认气候变化而臭名昭著，他从化石燃料行业获得了300多万美元的政治献金，领衔提出异议：披露规则是一项奥巴马时代的强制性措施，它的实施成本太大，并且会增加毫无意义的官僚主义繁文缛节。
en: Senator James Inhofe, a notorious climate-change denier who has received more than $3 million in campaign contributions from the fossil-fuel industry, led the charge: the disclosure rule was an imposition from the Obama era that would be too costly to implement and add needless bureaucratic red tape.

zh: 至于公民因为他们的国民财富通过肮脏的交易被出卖而蒙受的损失，以及投资者因为腐败导致诉讼和巨额罚款而蒙受的损失，则只字未提。
en: No mention was made of the costs borne by citizens when their national wealth is sold off through dirty deals, or by investors when corruption leads to prosecutions and massive fines.

zh: 要实现巴黎协定，反复和反气候变化的措施必须双管齐下。
en: To fulfill the Paris agreement, efforts to combat corruption and climate change must go hand in hand.

zh: 从最广泛的字义上讲，腐败是将“制度”粘合在一起的胶水，它确保金钱和权力利益逃脱为了制约它们而制定的规则的约束。
en: Corruption, in the widest sense of the word, is the glue that holds the “system” together, that ensures that moneyed and powerful interests are free from rules that are meant to hold them in check.

zh: 正因如此，承诺大幅削减温室气体排放的政府根本无法兑现承诺。
en: It is why governments that pledged to make large reductions in greenhouse-gas emissions have been unable to meet their commitments.

zh: 壳牌、埃克森和其他大部分石油和天然气巨头几十年前就知道它们的产品加速了气候变化。
en: Shell, Exxon, and most other major oil and gas companies knew decades ago that their products were fueling climate change.

zh: 但它们并没有根据这一认识展开行动，改变业务模式，而是花大力气愚弄公众，利诱决策者就范。
en: But instead of acting on that knowledge, and changing their business model, they embarked on a massive campaign to deceive the public and lure policymakers into complacency.

zh: 毫不奇怪，菲律宾政府目前正在调查47家主要石化产品生产商导致气候变化进而侵犯人权的情况，壳牌赫然在列。
en: Not surprisingly, Shell is one of 47 major hydrocarbon producers now being investigated by the Filipino government for its role in contributing to human-rights violations stemming from climate change.

zh: 要想保持遏制气候变化和打击腐败方面的进展，环境和反腐运动需要携手共进，各取所长。
en: To sustain progress in the fight against climate change and corruption, environmental and anti-corruption movements will have to work together, and play to their respective strengths.

zh: 无论如何，特朗普的当选，以及今年民粹主义在欧洲取得更多胜利的可能性，为我们敲响了警钟。
en: If nothing else, Trump’s election, and the possibility of more populist victories in Europe this year, have given us a wake-up call.

zh: 更美好的世界就在这里
en: A Better World Is Here

zh: 斯坎讷堡，丹麦—你很容易落入现代世界正在解体的感觉。
en: SKANDERBORG, DENMARK – It’s very easy to form the view that the modern world is coming apart.

zh: 我们一直面临着消极的猛烈攻击：令人毛骨悚然的新闻标题、危言耸听的研究发现，以及惨不忍睹的统计数字。
en: We are constantly confronted with an onslaught of negativity: frightening headlines, alarming research findings, and miserable statistics.

zh: 诚然，地球上有很多东西值得我们严重关注。
en: There are indeed many things on the planet that we should be greatly concerned about.

zh: 但沉溺于恐怖故事难以自拔意味着你会失去大视野。
en: But fixating on horror stories means that we miss the bigger picture.

zh: 联合国关注三类发展：社会、经济和环境。
en: The United Nations focuses on three categories of development: social, economic, and environmental.

zh: 回顾过去四分之一个世纪，每一类发展都是应该是欢呼远大于忧虑。
en: In each category, looking back over the last quarter-century, we have far more reason for cheer than fear.

zh: 事实上，这段时间可谓无与伦比的进步时期。
en: Indeed, this period has been one of extraordinary progress.

zh: 在社会方面，最重要的指标是我们能活多长。
en: Socially, the most important indicator is how long each of us lives.

zh: 1990年，平均寿命预期是65年。
en: In 1990, average life expectancy was 65 years.

zh: 2016年，这一数字增加到72.5年。
en: By 2016, it had climbed to 72.5.

zh: 在短短26年间，我们的生命延长了7.5年。
en: In just 26 years, we gained 7.5 years of life.

zh: 悲观派可能会说，这意味着我们多了五年的病痛和悲惨时期，但事实并非如此。
en: A pessimist might suggest this means we have 7.5 more years to be sick and miserable, but this is not the case.

zh: 1990年，我们的生命有大约13%的时间生活在不舒服的状态，此后这一比例并未提高。
en: In 1990, we spent almost 13% of our life unwell, and that percentage has not increased.

zh: 而尽管有人多人认为不平等性比以往任何时候都更加严重，但在这个最为关键的指标上，不平等性是下降的：穷国和富国之间的寿命预期差距大幅缩小。
en: And while there is much talk of inequality being worse than ever, on this most vital measure, inequality is decreasing: the gap between life expectancy in poor and rich countries has narrowed dramatically.

zh: 在经济发展方面，最重要的指标之一是生活在贫困中的人口的比例。
en: In terms of economic development, one of the most important indicators is the share of people in poverty.

zh: 现在，吃嗟来之食的人少了很多。
en: Far fewer people now live in abject need.

zh: 1990年，有37%的总人口生活在极端贫困中；如今这一比例还不到十分之一。
en: In 1990, 37% of all people were living in extreme poverty; today it’s less than one in ten.

zh: 在短短28年中，超过12.5亿人摆脱了贫困 — — 而这一奇迹受到的关注远远不够。
en: In just 28 years, over 1.25 billion people have been lifted out of poverty – a miracle that receives far too little attention.

zh: 再来看环境，人类最大的杀手是穷人燃粪和柴烹饪和取暖所导致的室内空气污染。
en: Looking at the environment, one of the biggest killers is indoor air pollution caused by poor people using dung and wood to cook and keep warm.

zh: 1990年，这一因素“贡献”了8%以上的死亡人数；如今这一比例为4.7 % 。
en: In 1990, this caused more than 8% of deaths; now it’s 4.7%.

zh: 这意味着机关人口有所增加，但每年死于室内空气污染的人数减少120万以上。
en: That equates to more than 1.2 million fewer people dying from indoor air pollution each year, despite an increase in population.

zh: 其他许多环境发展统计指标也表现出同样的趋势。
en: There is a similar trend in many other environmental development statistics.

zh: 1990—2015年间，全球露天排便人口比例下降了一半至15 % 。
en: Between 1990 and 2015, the percentage of the world practicing open defecation halved to 15%.

zh: 与此同时，优质水资源的普及率增加了26亿人，达到了91 % 。
en: Access to improved water sources increased by 2.6 billion people in the same period, to 91%.

zh: 超过三分之一的世界总人口能够获得优质水。
en: More than one-third of the world’s entire population gained access to improved water.

zh: 进步不止于此：世界文化程度变得更高了，童工一直在减少，我们生活的时代是历史上最和平的时代，全世界大部分政府都采用了民主体制。
en: The improvements do not stop there: the world is more literate; child labor has been dropping; we are living in one of the most peaceful times in history; and the majority of the world’s governments are democratic regimes.

zh: 牛津大学的马克斯·罗瑟（Max Roser）建立了一个完整的网站探索类似这些的数据。
en: Max Roser of Oxford University has built a comprehensive website to explore data like these.

zh: 他引人注目地指出，我们可以透过过去24小时发生了什么来思考这些四分之一个世纪以来的变化：这样看，仅仅在过去的一天中，平均寿命预期增加了9.5小时；137,000人摆脱了极端贫困；205,000人能够获得安全饮用水。
en: He strikingly suggests that we could think about these quarter-century changes in terms of what happened over the past 24 hours: seen this way, just in the last day, average life expectancy increased by 9.5 hours; 137,000 people escaped extreme poverty; and 305,000 got access to safer drinking water.

zh: 自1990年以来，媒体可以每一天都发布这些报道。
en: The media could have told each of these stories every single day since 1990.

zh: 但好消息不像坏消息那么劲爆。
en: But good news is not as newsworthy as bad news.

zh: 这不仅仅是媒体的错。
en: That is not just the media’s fault.

zh: 讲述积极的故事要难得多。
en: It’s more challenging to tell a positive story.

zh: 在很多例子中，发生了什么不是“新闻 ” ， 坏事不再发生才是新闻。
en: In many cases, the “news” isn’t that something has happened, but that a bad thing is no longer happening.

zh: 它捕获我们的想象力的方式也有所不同。
en: It doesn’t capture our imagination in the same way.

zh: 一项有趣的2014年研究发现，即使参与者表示他们想看积极报道，但他们的行为揭示他们更喜欢消极内容（他们并没有意识到这一篇好 ） 。
en: An intriguing 2014 study found that even when participants stated that they wanted to read positive stories, their behavior revealed a preference for negative content (a preference they didn’t even realize).

zh: 我们都应该驱使自己更加关注积极的事实。
en: We should all challenge ourselves to pay more attention to the positive facts.

zh: 当人们被问及未来16年全球生活水平是否会升高时，有35%相信会，29%认为生活水平会变得更加糟糕 — — 不相上下。
en: When people are asked if living conditions around the world will be better in 15 years, 35% believe they will be, and 29% think they will get worse – essentially a toss-up.

zh: 但在明白许多事情已然比曾经更好的人中间，有62%相信世界在进步中。
en: But among people who understand that many things on the planet already are better than they were, 62% believe in progress.

zh: 这一比例在不了解事实的人中间只有17 % 。
en: That share drops to just 17% among those who don’t know the facts.

zh: 所有事物都在变遭的信念描绘了一幅扭曲的图画，让我们不知所措，变得更加恐慌。
en: The belief that everything is getting worse paints a distorted picture of what we can do, and makes us more fearful.

zh: 想象一下一个非常常见的情形，政客和媒体炮制犯罪恐慌，即使统计数字表明国民犯罪率很低或正在下降。
en: Consider the fairly common scenario in which politicians and the media whip up fear of crime, even when statistics show national crime rates are low or falling.

zh: 注意力的稀缺资源可能被用在了解决错误的挑战上，街上警察变多了，公民自由变少了，而提高福利的政策，比如改善学前教育或医疗，则并未发生。
en: Attention and scarce resources can end up being devoted to solving the wrong challenge, and we get more police on the streets or reduced civil liberties, rather than more welfare-enhancing – but less newsy – policies like improving pre-schools or health care.

zh: 错误地理解事实很容易导致被误导的、受恐慌驱使的政策，但更加平衡的、以事实为基础的对人类成就的认知能让我们聚焦于我们最能有所作为的领域（常常是我们已经做得非常出色的领域 ） 。
en: While getting the facts wrong can easily result in misguided, fear-based policies, a more balanced, fact-based recognition of what humanity has achieved enables us to focus our efforts on the areas where we can achieve the most good (often where we are already doing well).

zh: 这将会确保未来更加光明。
en: This will ensure that the future can be even brighter.

zh: 投票处的飓风
en: Hurricanes at the Ballot Box

zh: 新加坡 — — 飓风佛罗伦萨上周袭击了美国东南部，这一系列极端天气事件已经提升了人们对灾难准备的预期。
en: SINGAPORE – Hurricane Florence, which smashed into the southeastern United States last week, is the latest in a string of extreme weather events that has raised expectations for disaster preparedness.

zh: 因为大规模风暴频繁发生，全球政府的应对举措是升级早期预警系统、改良疏散计划以及出台更积极的避难措施。
en: With big storms occurring more frequently, authorities worldwide are responding with upgraded early-warning systems, better evacuation plans, and more aggressive sheltering strategies.

zh: 但因全球变暖影响而恶化的火灾、干旱和风暴压过我们反应能力的一天正在快速逼近。
en: But the day is fast approaching when fires, droughts, and storms exacerbated by global warming will dwarf our ability to respond.

zh: 降低二氧化碳排放 — — 以及减缓人为变暖速度的理由 — — 随着每一次爆发新灾难而变得更加迫切。
en: The case for reducing carbon dioxide emissions – and slowing the rate of anthropogenic warming – grows stronger with every new catastrophe.

zh: 解决之道十分明确：我们必须选出能够认真对待气候变化的领导人。
en: The solution is clear: we must elect leaders who will take climate change seriously.

zh: 在美国，下一次实现这一目标的机会将是国会中期选举。
en: In the US, the next opportunity to do that will be the midterm congressional elections in November.

zh: 自从美国宇航局前科学家詹姆斯·汉森首次“高度自信地”警告人类活动正在导致地球变暖以来，30年已经过去。
en: Three decades have passed since former NASA scientist James Hansen first warned “with a high degree of confidence” that human activity was making the planet hotter.

zh: 但当时由于很少人注意到他的警告，所有人现在都在付出代价。
en: And yet, because too few people heeded his warnings then, everyone is paying a price now.

zh: 在2018年的前九个月，世界已经经历了平生罕见的历史性天气事件 — — 从美国西部、希腊和瑞典因干旱导致的森林火灾到夏威夷、印度南部和南亚其他地方的洪水。
en: In the first nine months of 2018, the world has experienced a lifetime’s worth of “historic” weather events – from drought-fueled forest fires in the American West, Greece, and Sweden, to floods in Hawaii, southern India, and elsewhere in South Asia.

zh: 就在佛罗伦萨穿越卡罗莱纳州时，台风山竹正在淹没菲律宾和中国南部。
en: As Florence was tearing through the Carolinas, Typhoon Mangkhut was swamping the Philippines and southern China.

zh: 尽管汉森的警示始于气候科学的起步阶段，但今天的科学家已经在二氧化碳排放、气候变化和恶劣天气之间建立了联系。
en: While Hansen’s warnings came when climate science was in its infancy, scientists today have connected the dots among CO2 emissions, climate change, and severe weather.

zh: 例如，研究人员已经将全球变暖和极端热浪联系起来 — — 就比如加利福尼亚、中国、日本和韩国近期的经历。
en: For example, researchers have linked global warming to extreme heat waves – such as the ones recently experienced in California, China, Japan, and South Korea.

zh: 数据还在美国南部的严重飓风与墨西哥湾水域升温之间建立了联系。
en: Data have also tied the severity of hurricanes in the southern US to warmer waters in the Gulf of Mexico.

zh: 飓风哈维于2017年袭击了德克萨斯州和其他地方，并在其中某些地区带来了多达50英寸的降雨。
en: Hurricane Harvey, which hit Texas and other areas in 2017, brought 50 inches of rain in some places.

zh: 灾难规划仍然可以挽救生命，这一点毋庸置疑。
en: To be sure, disaster planning still saves lives.

zh: 在休斯敦，当局为飓风哈维做好了准备，这部分来源于从飓风卡特里娜中所吸取的教训，卡特里娜曾于2005年将新奥尔良变成了一片废墟。
en: In Houston, authorities were ready for Harvey in part because of lessons learned from Hurricane Katrina, which devastated New Orleans in 2005.

zh: 那场风暴导致1，833人死亡，而哈维登陆期间的死亡人数至少有88人。
en: That storm caused 1,833 deaths, while at least 88 were killed during Harvey.

zh: 印度所吸取教训的影响更难以忘记。
en: The impact of lessons learned in India is even more striking.

zh: 2013年10月，奥迪萨邦的居民在气旋菲林抵达之前提前得到了警示。
en: In October 2013, residents of Odisha state were alerted early to the arrival of Cyclone Phailin.

zh: 截止风暴登陆时， 许多人已经成功撤离。
en: By the time the storm made landfall, many people had already evacuated.

zh: 尽管菲林仍然夺走了45条生命，但14年前袭击同一地区的类似规模的风暴曾导致10，000人丧生。
en: Although Phailin did claim 45 lives, a storm of similar magnitude that hit the same region 14 years earlier killed 10,000 people.

zh: 尽管如此，由于知识和行动之间存在危险的脱节，哪怕科学证据堆积如山，但紧急情况管理工作仍然难以跟上气候变化所造成的破坏。
en: Still, emergency management efforts will struggle to keep pace with the havoc wrought by climate change, owing to a dangerous disconnect between knowledge and action, even as the scientific evidence piles up.

zh: 例如，许多经济顾问仍然认为气候变化方案阻碍而非促进增长 — — 尽管事实是低碳方案创造了新的投资和就业机会。
en: For example, many economic advisers still consider climate-change solutions to be anti-growth rather than pro-growth – despite the fact that low-carbon solutions create new investment opportunities and jobs.

zh: 决策者同样不愿推动有意义的变革 — — 例如收取碳税或取消化石燃料补贴。
en: Policymakers are equally reluctant to champion meaningful changes – like carbon taxes or the elimination of fossil-fuel subsidies.

zh: 多数国家领袖认为保持现状在政治上更加安全。
en: Leaders in most countries consider the status quo to be politically safer.

zh: 就连电视播放的天气预报也通常并未提及气候变化是导致严重气象事件的根本原因。
en: Even weather reports on television typically fail to mention climate change as an underlying cause of severe meteorological events.

zh: 尤其在美国，政策层面的差距表现得更为明显。
en: But the gap is most glaring at the policy level, particularly in the US.

zh: 随着对气候变化的国际对策来到关键的转折点，特朗普政府正在通过逆转燃煤电厂的排放限制、鼓励提高化石燃料生产和撤销对风能和太阳能的支持而引导美国经济走上一条提高二氧化碳排放的道路。
en: With the international response to climate change at a critical juncture, the Trump administration is putting the US economy on a path to higher CO2 emissions by reversing emissions limits for coal-fired power plants, encouraging higher fossil-fuel production, and rolling back support for wind and solar power.

zh: 所有这些在经济上都毫无道理。
en: None of this makes economic sense.

zh: 更糟的是，白宫提议削弱国家气象局和放松环境及分区法规将进一步阻碍提升灾害管理。
en: To make matters worse, the White House’s proposed cuts to the National Weather Service and its loosening of environmental and zoning regulations will further impede disaster management.

zh: 作为全世界二氧化碳人均排放量最高的国家，美国肩负着独一无二的责任协助解决气候变化难题。
en: As the world’s largest CO2 emitter per capita, the US has a unique responsibility to help solve the climate-change challenge.

zh: 美国的选民也是如此。
en: So do American voters.

zh: 11月投票时，美国选民必须考虑候选人的气候变化政策。
en: When they go to the polls in November, they must consider the candidates’ policies toward climate change.

zh: 尽管国内问题在选民心目中可能是最重要的，但哈维、佛罗伦萨和其他极端天气事件已经使全球变暖成为投票时不得不考虑的一个与当地息息相关的问题。
en: While domestic issues might be uppermost in voters’ minds, Harvey, Florence, and other extreme weather events have made global warming a local issue and placed it squarely on the ballot.

zh: 极端天气和全球增长
en: Extreme Weather and Global Growth

zh: 坎布里奇—直到最近，宏观经济学家的惯常思维一直是短期天气波动对经济活动影响不大。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Until recently, the usual thinking among macroeconomists has been that short-term weather fluctuations don’t matter much for economic activity.

zh: 如果3月份的天气反常地温和，那么建筑业也许会雇用更多工人，但到了4月和5月就会出现相反的情况。
en: Construction hiring may be stronger than usual in a March when the weather is unseasonably mild, but there will be payback in April and May.

zh: 如果8月份的大雨让人们打消了上街购物的冲动，那么他们会在9月份买更多东西。
en: If heavy rains discourage people from shopping in August, they will just spend more in September.

zh: 但最近，超强厄尔尼诺让最新经济学研究纷纷开始反思这一观点。 厄尔尼诺是一种复杂的全球气候事件，其标志是厄瓜多尔和秘鲁太平洋沿岸海水特别温暖。
en: But recent economic research, bolstered by an exceptionally strong El Niño – a complex global climactic event marked by exceptionally warm Pacific Ocean water off the coast of Ecuador and Peru – has prompted a rethink of this view.

zh: 极端天气显然会对重要的短期宏观经济数据造成影响。
en: Extreme weather certainly throws a ringer into key short-term macroeconomic statistics.

zh: 它可以让全世界最受关注、也被广泛认为是最准确的经济指标之一的美国月度就业增加或减少100,000人。
en: It can add or subtract 100,000 jobs to monthly US employment, the single most-watched economic statistic in the world, and generally thought to be one of the most accurate.

zh: 像今年这样的厄尔尼诺相关天气事件（更准确地说应该是“厄尔尼诺南部震荡 ” ） 的影响因为其全球效应而显得尤其巨大。
en: The impact of El Niño-related weather events like the one this year (known more precisely as “El Niño Southern Oscillation” events) can be especially large because of their global reach.

zh: 国际货币基金组织的最新研究表明，澳大利亚、印度、印度尼西亚、日本和南非等国家在厄尔尼诺年份中受害严重（常常是因为旱灾 ） ， 而美国、加拿大和欧洲等地区则从厄尔尼诺中获益。
en: Recent research from the International Monetary Fund suggests that countries such as Australia, India, Indonesia, Japan, and South Africa suffer adversely in El Niño years (often due to droughts), whereas some regions, including the United States, Canada, and Europe, can benefit.

zh: 比如，加利福尼亚州近多年来旱灾严重，现在终于喜逢甘霖。
en: California, for example, which has been experiencing years of severe drought, is finally getting rain.

zh: 总体而言（但非总是如此 ） ， 厄尔尼诺事件倾向于带来通胀效应，这部分是因为庄稼收成下降导致价格升高。
en: Generally, but not always, El Niño events tend to be inflationary, in part because low crop yields lead to higher prices.

zh: 我生活在波士顿，在经历了两个严冬之后，你很难再相信天气不重要的观点。
en: After two crazy winters in Boston, where I live, it would be hard to convince people that weather doesn’t matter.

zh: 去年，波士顿市积雪创出了历史记录。
en: Last year, the city experienced the largest snow accumulation on record.

zh: 最后你会感到无从下脚：四车道高速公路变成两车道，两车道道路变成一车道。
en: Eventually, there was no longer any place to put it: four-lane highways narrowed to two lanes, and two-lane roads to one.

zh: 屋顶被压塌，贫民窟“冰坝”带来严重内涝。
en: Roofs collapsed and “ice dams” building up from gutters caused severe flooding.

zh: 公共交通系统关闭，许多人没法上班。
en: Public transport closed, and many people couldn’t get to their jobs.

zh: 这是一场维持了几个月的慢动作自然灾害。
en: It was a slow-motion natural catastrophe that lasted for months.

zh: 总体而言，2015年初美国的冬天并不像新英格兰地区那样极端，天气对美国总体经济的影响也要小一些。
en: The US as a whole did not have a winter as extreme as New England’s in the first part of 2015, and the effects of the weather on the country’s overall economy were subdued.

zh: 诚然，纽约市遭遇了几场大雪；但如果市长在扫雪工作上做得更加“给力”一些，你对此不会做太多关注。
en: True, New York City had some significant snowfalls; but no one would have paid much attention had the mayor been more competent in getting the streets plowed.

zh: 东加拿大情况严重得多，严寒天气（以及大宗商品价格下跌）导致加拿大在去年上半年遭遇小型衰退。
en: Eastern Canada suffered much more, with severe winter weather playing a role (along with lower commodity prices) in the country’s mini-recession in the first half of the year.

zh: 今年的冬天和去年相比是另一个极端。
en: This year’s winter is the polar opposite of last year’s.

zh: 圣诞节前一天，波士顿洛根机场温度为20℃，第一场雪直到元旦前夕才姗姗来迟。
en: It was 68º Fahrenheit (20º Celsius) at Boston’s Logan Airport the day before Christmas, and the first speck of snow didn’t come until just before New Year’s Day.

zh: 树木也植被仿佛觉得现在是春天，开始开花；鸟类也对天气感到困惑不已。
en: Trees and plants, sensing spring, started to blossom; birds were just as confused.

zh: 去年冬天的波士顿属于反常情况。
en: Last winter Boston was something of an anomaly.

zh: 而在今年，部分拜厄尔尼诺所赐，怪异的天气已经成为新常态。
en: This year, thanks in part to El Niño, weird weather is the new normal.

zh: 从俄罗斯到瑞士，气温比往年高4—5℃，2016年的天气模式看上去也会高度反常。
en: From Russia to Switzerland, temperatures have been elevated by 4-5º Celsius, and the weather patterns look set to remain highly unusual in 2016.

zh: 这对于发展中国家的影响尤其令人关注，因为许多发展中国家已经承受着中国减速对大宗商品价格的消极影响和干旱条件所导致的庄稼收成大降。
en: The effect on developing countries is of particular concern, because many are already reeling from the negative impact of China’s slowdown on commodity prices, and because drought conditions could lead to severe crop shortfalls.

zh: 在上一次严重厄尔尼诺期间（1997—1998年，有人称之为“世纪厄尔尼诺 ” ） ，许多发展中国家遭遇重挫。
en: The last severe El Niño, in 1997-1998, which some called the “El Niño of the Century,” represented a huge setback for many developing countries.

zh: 厄尔尼诺事件的经济效应几乎与其背后的天气现象本身一样复杂，因此难以预测。
en: The economic effects of El Niño events are almost as complex as the underlying weather phenomenon itself and therefore are difficult to predict.

zh: 但是，当我们回首2016年时，很有可能会将厄尔尼诺视为许多重要国家经济表现背后的重要推动力，津巴布韦和南非面临旱灾和粮食危机，而印尼疲于扑灭森林火灾。
en: When we look back on 2016, however, it is quite possible that El Niño will be regarded as one of the major drivers of economic performance in many key countries, with Zimbabwe and South Africa facing drought and food crises, and Indonesia struggling with forest fires.

zh: 美国中西部最近则是大洪水泛滥。
en: In the American Midwest, there has lately been massive flooding.

zh: 天气深刻影响国内冲突的历史也很悠久。
en: There is a long history of weather having a profound impact on civil strife as well.

zh: 经济学家艾米丽·奥斯特（Emily Oster）指出，中世纪烧死巫师风潮最盛的时候正是经济剥削和显而易见与气候相关的粮食短缺时期，这段时间有数十万巫师（大部分是女巫）被杀死。
en: Economist Emily Oster has argued that the biggest spikes in witch burnings in the Middle Ages, in which hundreds of thousands (mostly women) were killed, came during periods of economic deprivation and apparently weather-related food shortages.

zh: 有人将叙利亚内战的根源追溯到导致严重庄稼欠收、迫使大量农民流入城市的旱灾。
en: Some have traced the roots of the civil war in Syria to droughts that led to severe crop failure and forced a mass inflow of farmers to the cities.

zh: 从更平淡（但经济后果巨大）的层面看，美国的温暖天气让美联储用来决定何时升息的就业数字变得十分微妙。
en: On a more mundane level (but highly consequential economically), the warm weather in the US may very well cloud the job numbers the Federal Reserve uses in deciding when to raise interest rates.

zh: 诚然，就业数据已经经过季节调整以考虑不同温度带的正常天气差异；但建筑业在春天总是比冬天兴旺。
en: It is true that employment data are already seasonally adjusted to allow for normal weather differences in temperate zones; construction is always higher during spring than winter.

zh: 但标准的季节调整不考虑重大天气偏差。
en: But standard seasonal adjustments do not account for major weather deviations.

zh: 总体而言，从前的厄尔尼诺证据表明，此次大规模厄尔尼诺可能给全球增长造成重大影响，有助于支持美国和欧洲的经济复苏，但也让已经十分疲软的新兴市场雪上加霜。
en: Overall, the evidence from past El Niños suggests that the current massive one is likely to leave a significant footprint on global growth, helping support economic recovery in the US and Europe, while putting even more pressure on already weak emerging markets.

zh: 这还不是全球变暖，但已经是一项重大经济事件 — — 并且可能只是一个开端。
en: It is not yet global warming, but it is already a very significant event economically – and perhaps just a taste of what is to come.

zh: 毁灭历史的政治
en: The Politics of Historicide

zh: 纽约 — — 在混乱的世界中，中东四分五裂。
en: NEW YORK – In a world of disarray, the Middle East stands apart.

zh: 后一战秩序在中东绝大部分地区都正在解体。
en: The post-World War I order is unraveling in much of the region.

zh: 叙利亚、伊拉克、也门和利比亚民众为此付出了巨大的代价。
en: The people of Syria, Iraq, Yemen, and Libya have paid an enormous price.

zh: 但受此影响的还不仅是地区的现在和未来。
en: But it is not just the present and future of the region that has been affected.

zh: 当今暴力活动另外一个受害者是过去。
en: An additional casualty of today’s violence is the past.

zh: 伊斯兰国已经公开声称要捣毁一切在它看来不够伊斯兰的东西。
en: The Islamic State (ISIS) has made a point of destroying things it deems insufficiently Islamic.

zh: 叙利亚巴尔米拉壮观的贝尔神庙就是最引人注目的例子。
en: The most dramatic example was the magnificent Temple of Bal in Palmyra, Syria.

zh: 在我写这篇文章时，伊拉克北部的摩苏尔市历经两年多的伊斯兰国控制后正在得到解放。
en: As I write this, the city of Mosul in northern Iraq is being liberated, after more than two years of ISIS control.

zh: 但那些已经被摧毁的雕像、焚烧的图书馆或掠夺的古墓却已经来不及得到抢救。
en: It will not come soon enough to save the many sculptures already destroyed, libraries burned, or tombs pillaged.

zh: 可以肯定，文物的破坏不仅在中东才有。
en: To be sure, destruction of cultural artifacts is not limited to the Middle East.

zh: 2001年，世界惊恐地亲眼目睹塔利班炸毁巴米扬大佛雕像。
en: In 2001, the world watched in horror as the Taliban blew up the large statues of Buddha in Bamiyan.

zh: 更近的例子是激进的伊斯兰教徒摧毁了廷巴克图的古墓和手稿。
en: More recently, radical Islamists destroyed tombs and manuscripts in Timbuktu.

zh: 但伊斯兰国却以前所未有的规模进行破坏。
en: But ISIS is carrying out destruction on an unprecedented scale.

zh: 以过去为打击目标并不是什么新鲜事。
en: Taking aim at the past is not new.

zh: 亚历山大大帝在两千多年前摧毁了今天所称波斯波利斯的绝大部分遗迹。
en: Alexander the Great destroyed much of what is now called Persepolis more than 2,000 years ago.

zh: 几个世纪以来，蹂躏欧洲的宗教战争对教堂、圣像和绘画造成了严重的破坏。
en: The religious wars that ravaged Europe over the centuries took their toll on churches, icons, and paintings.

zh: 斯大林、希特勒和毛泽东想方设法摧毁与被视为危险文化和思想相关的建筑物和艺术品。
en: Stalin, Hitler, and Mao did their best to destroy buildings and works of art associated with cultures and ideas viewed as dangerous.

zh: 五十年前，红色高棉捣毁了柬埔寨各处的神庙和纪念碑。
en: A half-century ago the Khmer Rouge destroyed temples and monuments across Cambodia.

zh: 事实上 ， “ 摧毁历史”的行为尽管令人厌恶，但却并非无法理解。
en: In fact, what might best be described as “historicide” is as understandable as it is perverse.

zh: 希望围绕截然不同的新思想、忠诚和行为模式塑造社会的领导人首先必须摧毁成年人的现有身份，并阻止将这些身份传递给儿童。
en: Leaders wishing to mold a society around a new and different set of ideas, loyalties, and forms of behavior first need to destroy adults’ existing identities and prevent the transmission of these identities to children.

zh: 革命者相信，摧毁这些身份的符号和表达形式是建设新社会、文化和/或政治的先决条件。
en: Destroying the symbols and expressions of these identities and the ideas they embody, the revolutionaries believe, is a prerequisite to building a new society, culture, and/or polity.

zh: 因此，保护和捍卫过去对想要确保今天危险狂热分子无法成功的人至关重要。
en: For this reason, preserving and protecting the past is essential for those who want to ensure that today’s dangerous zealots do not succeed.

zh: 博物馆和图书馆非常宝贵，这不仅因为它们陈列和展示精美的物品，而且因为它们保护诠释我们身份的遗产、价值观、思想和故事，协助我们将知识传递给后来人。
en: Museums and libraries are invaluable not only because they house and display objects of beauty, but also because they protect the heritage, values, ideas, and narratives that make us who we are and help us transmit that knowledge to those who come after us.

zh: 政府对毁灭历史的主要对策是禁止艺术品和工艺品的贩卖。
en: The principal response of governments to historicide has been to ban traffic in stolen art and artifacts.

zh: 这出于诸多理由而成为理想对策，包括摧毁文化遗址和奴役并杀戮无辜男人、女人和儿童的刽子手需要依靠出售掠夺来的财富才能获得所需的资源。
en: This is desirable for many reasons, including the fact that those who destroy cultural sites, and enslave and kill innocent men, women, and children, acquire the resources they need in part from the sale of looted treasures.

zh: 1954年海牙公约呼吁各国不要破坏文化遗址及切勿将其用于军事目的，如设立战斗阵地、驻军或储存武器。
en: The 1954 Hague Convention calls on states not to target cultural sites and to refrain from using them for military purposes, such as establishing combat positions, housing soldiers, or storing weapons.

zh: 这样做的目标非常明确：那就是保护和保存过去。
en: The goal is straightforward: to protect and preserve the past.

zh: 但人类不应夸大这些国际协定的意义。
en: Alas, one should not exaggerate the significance of such international agreements.

zh: 它们只适用于选择成为其缔约国的政府，对像伊拉克和叙利亚那样无视1954年公约的行为没有任何惩罚措施，也没有任何办法惩罚退出公约的缔约国，而且不包括像伊斯兰国那样的非国家行为主体。
en: They apply only to governments that have chosen to be a party to them. There is no penalty for ignoring the 1954 Convention, as both Iraq and Syria have done, or for withdrawing from it, and it does not cover non-state actors (such as ISIS).

zh: 此外，如果缔约国或任何其他人以公约力求防止的姿态行事，公约也不具备任何行动机制。
en: Moreover, there is no mechanism for action in the event that a party to the Convention or anyone else acts in ways that the Convention seeks to prevent.

zh: 一个严酷而悲伤的现实是，国际社会可以采取的对策少之又少，尽管这个名词常常被提及。
en: The hard and sad truth is that there is much less in the way of international community than the frequent invocation of the term suggests.

zh: 事实上，一个不愿履行保护民众责任的社会，就像最近叙利亚所表现出来的那样，不大可能因为雕像、手稿和绘画而团结在一起。
en: Indeed, a world that is unwilling to fulfill its responsibility to protect people, as has been shown most recently in Syria, is unlikely to come together on behalf of statues, manuscripts, and paintings.

zh: 没有什么能够取代在破坏文化遗产者行动之前就可以阻止他们的策略。
en: There is no substitute for stopping those who would destroy cultural property before they do it.

zh: 在如今过去面临迫切威胁的情况下，这意味着阻止年轻人选择激进道路、减缓新兵和资源流向极端组织、说服政府派驻警察和军队保护有价值的历史遗址，并在可能的情况下，对恐怖分子发动先发制人的袭击。
en: In the case of today’s principal threats to the past, this means discouraging young people from choosing radical paths, slowing the flow of recruits and resources to extremist groups, persuading governments to assign police and military units to protect valued sites, and, when possible, attacking terrorists before they strike.

zh: 如果对文化遗址的威胁主要源于政府，那么更恰当的工具可能是制裁。
en: If a government is the source of the threat to cultural sites, sanctions may be a more appropriate tool.

zh: 指控、起诉、判决和囚禁上述破坏活动的执行人可能被证明能对其他人起到威慑作用 — — 这非常类似于防止个人暴力的措施。
en: Indicting, prosecuting, convicting, and jailing those who carry out such destruction might prove to be a deterrent to others – similar to what is required to stop violence against persons.

zh: 在这一切实现之前，毁灭历史将既是威胁也是现实。
en: Until then, historicide will remain both a threat and, as we have seen, a reality.

zh: 过去将处于危险境地。
en: The past will be in jeopardy.

zh: 从这个意义上看，过去与现在和将来没有什么区别。
en: In that sense, it is no different from the present and the future.

zh: 活力四射的巴西
en: Exuberant Brazil

zh: 自从路易斯•伊纳西奥•卢拉•达席尔瓦（Luis Inácio Lula da Silva）总统2002年10月首度当选以来，巴西的圣保罗证交所指数（Bovespa index）在扣除通胀因素后的价值增长已经超过四倍，而且目前所处的点位是2000年高点的两倍。
en: Brazil’s stock market, as measured by the inflation-corrected Bovespa index, has more than quadrupled in value since President Luis Inácio Lula da Silva’s first election victory in October 2002, and is now at almost twice the peak achieved in 2000.

zh: 相比之下，扣除通胀因素后的上证综指仅仅上涨了两倍，而美国股市如果用扣除通胀因素的标准普尔500来衡量，增长率只有50 % 。
en: In comparison, the inflation-corrected Shanghai Composite only doubled during this period, while the American stock market, as measured by the inflation-corrected Standard and Poor’s 500, increased only 50%.

zh: 事实上，美国股价还从未在不到五年的时间内经历过四倍的增长，即便在20世纪90年代后期的股市泡沫中也不例外。
en: Indeed, the United States has never experienced a fourfold increase in stock prices in less than five years, even during the late 1990’s bubble.

zh: 考虑到卢拉是人所共知的左翼分子，坚定地把雨果·查维兹（Hugo Chávez）和菲德尔·卡斯特罗（Fidel Castro）列为自己的伙伴，巴西的经济发展就更令人感到震惊。
en: Given that Lula is an avowed leftist who counts Hugo Chávez and Fidel Castro among his friends, Brazil’s performance is all the more surprising.

zh: 他是怎样导演了这样一场蔚为壮观的股市大发展？
en: How could he manage to preside over such a spectacular stock-market boom?

zh: 巴西股市是不是太过繁荣了？
en: Are Brazilians too exuberant?

zh: 国外投资者是不是应该撤出资金？
en: Might it be time for foreign investors to pull their money out?

zh: 股市的运行肯定很难解释，但我们有理由认为巴西仍然属于 理性的 繁荣。
en: Stock-market movements are certainly hard to explain, but there are reasons to believe that Brazilians might be rationally exuberant.

zh: 巴西企业盈利的增速几乎可以同股价的增速相媲美。
en: Corporate earnings in Brazil have gone up roughly as fast as stock prices.

zh: 由于市盈率保持稳定并相对合理，目前的股市繁荣似乎不只是投资者心理的反映。
en: With the price/earnings ratio remaining stable and moderate, the stock-market boom does not appear to reflect merely investor psychology.

zh: 恰恰相反，真正的问题是股价的增长为什么没能超过企业收入的增幅。
en: On the contrary, the real question is why the increase in stock prices has not outpaced growth in corporate earnings.

zh: 归根结底，20世纪90年代，美国的股价飙升（与很多国家的情况类似）是由创纪录的市盈率所推动的。
en: After all, in the 1990’s, the US stock-market surge (as in many countries) was fueled by record-high price/earnings ratios.

zh: 1998年，美股市盈率为24倍，而该指标的历史平均值只有约15倍。
en: In 1998, the price-earnings ratio in the US was 24, compared to a historical average of around 15.

zh: 与此形成鲜明的对照，巴西股价的急剧飙升开始于完全不同的点位 ― ― 1998年的市盈率最低只有6倍。
en: By contrast, the run-up in stock prices in Brazil started from a very different point, with the price-earnings ration as low as six in 1998.

zh: 股市繁荣创下历史记录的时刻，总会有报道称这一切都是理所当然。
en: When a stock-market boom reaches historic proportions, a story always develops to rationalize it.

zh: 新闻媒体通常会搜罗原因，来证明经济发展已经步入了“新的阶段 ” 。
en: The news media typically present reasons to justify the view that the economy has entered a “new era.”

zh: 有时这种报道纯属为市场乐观情绪提供依据的胡编乱造，20世纪90年代的股市繁荣就是如此。
en: Sometimes the stories are mere fabrications to validate market optimism, as with the 1990’s boom.

zh: 但还有些时候，这样的报道似乎颇有根据。
en: But, at other times, the stories seem more solid.

zh: 卢拉称之为巴西经济的“魔幻”时刻。
en: Lula has called this a “magic moment” for the Brazilian economy.

zh: 尽管使用这样的字眼需慎之又慎，但经济基本面却证实了卢拉的预言。
en: While such words merit caution, economy fundamentals bear them out.

zh: 货币、不动产一直在稳步攀升，较之2002年10月卢拉首次当选总统时对美元的比价增长了将近两倍。
en: The currency, the real, has been strengthening steadily, to nearly twice its value against the US dollar in October 2002, when Lula was first elected.

zh: 而通货膨胀和利率却一直在下降，国家的对外贸易一直处于顺差，外资也在快速涌入，政府不仅全部还清了所欠外债，而且还以纯债权国的形象出现在世界各国面前。
en: Inflation and interest rates are falling, the country is running a trade surplus, foreign investment is flowing in at a high rate, and the government has more than paid off its debts to foreigners, becoming a net creditor to the rest of the world.

zh: 因此股票投资人似乎认可巴西的经济活力，关注企业盈利的增长，并且在股市中顺势而为。
en: So stock investors seem to be recognizing Brazil’s economic vitality, carefully watching corporate earnings rise, and running with them.

zh: 在经历了2002年的孤军奋战以后，巴西股市参与者们如今发现，来自世界各国的投资者都愿意加入到这场盛宴。
en: After being lone believers through 2002, Brazilian stock market participants are now finding that investors from all over the world want to join the party.

zh: 尽管如此，考虑到涉及政要人士的腐败丑闻在过去几年内被不断曝光，对股市仍然维持强势感到惊讶也就显得再自然不过。
en: Nevertheless, given corruption scandals involving prominent government figures that have come to light over the past few years, it is natural to wonder why the stock market has remained so strong.

zh: 为什么巴西没有像1997－1998年亚洲金融危机中的韩国和马来西亚那样，由于种种腐败报道而陷入重重危机？
en: Why haven’t the stories of corruption caused a crisis, as similar scandals did in Korea and Malaysia during the Asian financial crisis in 1997-98?

zh: 实际上，虽然丑闻的确影响到了政府的声誉，但卢拉仍然在去年以骄人的战绩重新当选，投资者也继续把大笔的资金投入股市。
en: Indeed, while the scandals have shaken the government, Lula was overwhelmingly reelected last year, and investors continue to pour money into the stock market.

zh: 理由之一是腐败丑闻为投资者认识巴西实行的言论和民主自由提供了机会。
en: One reason is that the corruption scandals have provided an opportunity for investors to see Brazilian freedom of speech and democracy in action.

zh: 报纸和电视媒体在丑闻报道中毫不留情，从而向巴西民众和国外投资者证明了巴西的政治体制足够稳定，能够经受得起公开责难的考验。
en: Newspapers and television commentators have been relentless in reporting the scandals, helping to prove to Brazilians and foreign investors alike that the political system is sufficiently stable to withstand open criticism.

zh: 卢拉在巴西国内民众中的热度依然不减，这是因为他的民粹主义言论显示出对欠富裕阶层的真正同情，而成功地控制激进主义势力，使之适应经济的现实发展使得他在外国投资者当中也颇受青睐。
en: Lula remains popular with Brazilians because his populist rhetoric shows real sympathy with the less affluent, and with foreign investors because he has always tempered his radicalism to accommodate economic reality.

zh: 他不久前对玻利维亚总统埃沃·莫拉莱斯（Evo Morale）剥夺国外财产的威胁大加批判，认为“激进主义与执政者所必不可少的常识格格不入。
en: He recently criticized Bolivian President Evo Morales’s threats to seize foreign assets for his failure in this regard: “Radicalism is incompatible with the common sense needed from someone who governs.”

zh: ”这种激进主义哲学和实用主义经济结合在一起，被证明是巴西发展的超完美方程。
en: That combination of philosophical radicalism and economic pragmatism has proven to be a perfect formula for Brazil’s progress.

zh: 的确，前途很难预料；我们没有预测圣保罗证交所指数可能走向的水晶球。
en: Granted, the future is unknown; we have no crystal ball to predict the Bovespa’s likely path.

zh: 但对我来讲，巴西的股市繁荣远比20世纪90年代股市暴涨所讲述的故事更有说服力。
en: But, for me, the story is far more convincing than the one told during the 1990’s stock-market boom.

zh: 埃克森美孚的危险商业战略
en: ExxonMobil’s Dangerous Business Strategy

zh: 纽约—埃克森美孚的最新商业战略对它的股东和世界来说是一个威胁。
en: NEW YORK – ExxonMobil’s current business strategy is a danger to its shareholders and the world.

zh: 埃克森美孚公司CEO雷克斯·蒂勒森（Rex Tillerson）担任主席的美国石油委员会（National Petroleum Council） 北极委员会（Arctic Committee）的一份报告确认了这一点。
en: We were reminded of this once again in a report of the National Petroleum Council’s Arctic Committee, chaired by ExxonMobil CEO Rex Tillerson.

zh: 该报告要求美国政府继续从事北极圈石油和天然气钻井活动，而没有提及这对气候变化的后果。
en: The report calls on the US government to proceed with Arctic drilling for oil and gas – without mentioning the consequences for climate change.

zh: 其他石油公司正在开始直面气候变化问题，而埃克森美孚的业务模式仍在否认现实。
en: While other oil companies are starting to speak straightforwardly about climate change, ExxonMobil’s business model continues to deny reality.

zh: 这一方针不但在道德上是错误的，在财务上也是灾难。
en: That approach is not only morally wrong; it is also doomed financially.

zh: 2014年是有仪器记录以来最热的一年，这残酷地提醒我们，将在12月的巴黎达到顶峰的今年的气候谈判将决定着地球的命运。
en: The year 2014 was the hottest on instrument record, a grim reminder of the planetary stakes of this year’s global climate negotiations, which will culminate in Paris in December.

zh: 世界政府已同意将人为导致气温升高幅度限制在2℃以下。
en: The world’s governments have agreed to keep human-induced warming to below 2º Celsius (3.6º Fahrenheit).

zh: 但从目前的情况看，升温幅度要远远超过这个阈值，到本世纪末可能升温4—6℃。
en: Yet the current trajectory implies warming far beyond this limit, possibly 4-6º Celsius by the end of this century.

zh: 当然，解决的办法是从化石燃料转向风能和太阳能灯能源，以及用低碳电力供能的电动汽车。
en: The answer, of course, is to shift from fossil fuels to low-carbon energy like wind and solar power, and to electric vehicles powered by low-carbon electricity.

zh: 世界诸多大石油企业已开始承认这一事实。
en: Many of the world’s biggest oil firms are beginning to acknowledge this truth.

zh: 道达尔、埃尼、挪威石油公司（Statoil）和壳牌公司支持用碳定价（如征税或许可制度）加快向低碳能源的转型，并正在开始从内部为此做好准备。
en: Companies like Total, ENI, Statoil, and Shell are advocating for a carbon price (such as a tax or permit system) to hasten the transition to low-carbon energy and are beginning to prepare internally for it.

zh: 壳牌公司增加了对碳捕捉和储存（CCS）技术的投资，以测试化石燃料的使用是否可以通过捕捉可能排放到大气中的二氧化碳而变得安全。
en: Shell has stepped up its investments in carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) technology, to test whether fossil-fuel use can be made safe by capturing the CO2 that would otherwise go into the atmosphere.

zh: 这并不是说所有这些都在这些公司形成了一致；它们承诺在今年的气候峰会前宣布它们的气候立场和政策。
en: This is not to say that all is agreed with these companies; they have promised to state their climate positions and policies in advance of this year’s climate summit.

zh: 但至少它们在谈论气候变化，并开始面对新的长期市场条件。
en: Yet at least they are talking about climate change and beginning to face up to the new long-term market conditions.

zh: 埃克森美孚，唉，它与众不同。
en: ExxonMobil, alas, is different.

zh: 该公司的管理层被自己强大的政治实力蒙蔽了双眼，一厢情愿地否认变化的全球现实。
en: The company’s management, blinded by its own vast political power, behaves with a willful disregard for changing global realities.

zh: 在华盛顿游说集团和政治顾问的簇拥下，该公司领导人相信，在美国参议院掌控在共和党手中的现状下，气候变化的商业风险或多或少已经消失，有没有气候变化，世界都不会变化。
en: It lives in a cocoon of Washington lobbyists and political advisers who have convinced the company’s leaders that because the US Senate is currently in Republican hands, the business risks of climate change have somehow been nullified, and that the world will not change without or despite them.

zh: 与此同时，埃克森美孚绝非无关紧要的地球行为人。
en: At the same time, ExxonMobil is not some marginal actor in the planetary drama.

zh: 它是舞台中央的主角之一。
en: It is one of the central protagonists.

zh: 根据2013年的一项研究，埃克森美孚是世界上二氧化碳总排放第二大的公司，仅次于雪弗龙。
en: According to a 2013 study, ExxonMobil ranks second among the world’s companies, just behind Chevron, in total contributions of CO2 emissions.

zh: 事实上，该研究部发现埃克森美孚一家公司就贡献了化石燃料时代开始以来全球总排放量的3%强！
en: Indeed, the study finds that this single company has contributed more than 3% of the world’s total emissions since the start of the fossil-fuel age!

zh: 那么，埃克森美孚对这些新的气候现实有何说法？
en: So what does ExxonMobil say about the new climate realities?

zh: 它如何协调它的公司政策和地球的需要？
en: How does it reconcile its corporate policies with planetary needs?

zh: 不幸的是，该公司基本上对这一问题采取了回避态度。
en: Unfortunately, the company basically ducks the issue.

zh: 碳跟踪系统（Carbon Tracker）等独立分析机构曾问埃克森美孚，其无止尽的钻井活动与守住2℃气候变化阈值所必须的化石燃料使用量限制之间如何协调。 埃克森美孚根本无视这一限制。
en: When asked by independent analysts such as Carbon Tracker how it plans to square its relentless oil drilling with the planetary limits on fossil-fuel use necessary to stay below the 2º climate-change threshold, it ignores the limits.

zh: 它认定世界各国政府根本无法兑现它们的承诺（或者它可以游说它们不去兑现它们的承诺 ） 。
en: It blithely believes that the world’s governments simply will not honor their commitments (or that it can lobby its way out of fulfilling them).

zh: 于是就有了最近的北极报告。
en: And so we come to the recent Arctic report.

zh: 能源部向行业组织美国石油协会征询关于北极圈钻井的意见。
en: The Department of Energy asked the National Petroleum Council, an industry group, for its advice on Arctic drilling.

zh: 蒂勒森的委员会的回答是赤裸裸的误导。
en: What it received from Tillerson’s committee is an exercise in misdirection.

zh: 北极圈油气资源的开发将让升温幅度远远超过2℃的限制。
en: The development of the Arctic’s oil and gas resources would contribute to warming far above the 2º limit.

zh: 北极本身的变暖速度远快于地球平均水平，可能造成全球范围的严重气候破坏 — — 美国中纬度地区最近所观察到的极端天气也许也是因此导致的。
en: The Arctic itself is warming far faster than the planetary average, potentially causing massive, global-scale climate disruptions – which may include the extreme weather patterns recently observed in the US mid-latitudes.

zh: 出于这些原因，最出色的最新科学，包括今年发表在《自然》杂志上的一项重要研究，提供了明确无误的信息：让北极圈石油留在地下和深海海底；气候体系中找不到安全的地方容纳它们。
en: For these reasons, the best recent science, including an important study published in Nature this year, provides a clear and unequivocal message: Keep the Arctic oil in the ground and beneath the deep seas; there is no safe place in the climate system for it.

zh: 世界现有油气储量早已足够；我们现在需要的是想低碳能源转变，保留大部分探明储量而不是开发它们并进一步破坏地球。
en: The world has more than enough oil and gas reserves already; we now need to shift to low-carbon energy, stranding much of the proven reserves, rather than developing them and further threatening the planet.

zh: 《自然》的研究指出 ： “ 北极圈资源的开发和任何非常规石油产量的增加不利于将全球平均升温水平限制在２℃以内的目标。 ”
en: As the Nature study puts it: “Development of resources in the Arctic and any increase in unconventional oil production are incommensurate with efforts to limit average global warming to 2º C.”

zh: 这本应成为美国石油委员会北极报告的合适主题。
en: This would have been a fitting topic for the National Petroleum Council’s Arctic study.

zh: 但石油委员会的北极报告从未提及北极圈石油和天然气资源是否与气候安全相容的问题。
en: But the report never takes up the issue of whether Arctic oil and gas resources are compatible with climate safety.

zh: 埃克森美孚的厚颜无耻可能成为股东的大麻烦。
en: ExxonMobil’s brazenness should be deeply troubling for its shareholders.

zh: 该公司管理层计划花巨资 — — 也许达到数百亿美元 — — 开发无法安全使用的北极圈油气储量。
en: The company’s management is planning to spend vast sums – perhaps tens of billions of dollars – to develop Arctic oil and gas reserves that cannot safely be used.

zh: 正如向可再生能源的全球转型大大拉低了石油价格，将在未来几年采取的气候政策将让新北极圈钻井沦为巨大的资源浪费。
en: Just as the global shift toward renewable energy has already contributed to a massive drop in oil prices, climate policies that will be adopted in future years will render new Arctic drilling a huge waste of resources.

zh: 全世界退休基金、大学、保险公司资金池和主权财富基金正在面临持有石油、天然气和煤炭公司股票的日益增加的道德和财务风险。
en: Pension funds, universities, insurance pools, and sovereign wealth funds worldwide are grappling with the increasing risks, both moral and financial, of owning shares in oil, gas, and coal companies.

zh: 丽莎·萨克斯（Lisa Sachs）和我最近指出，负责任的投资者必须尽快询问这些公司有什么计划应对2℃升温限制。
en: As Lisa Sachs and I recently explained, responsible investors must urgently query these companies about their business plans to comply with the 2º limit on warming.

zh: 包括在北极圈、极深海域和加拿大油砂上投资的商业计划与气候安全的世界格格不入。
en: Business plans that include investments in the Arctic, the ultra-deep sea, and the oil sands of Canada have no place in a climate-safe world.

zh: 埃克森美孚的投资者必须尽快就该公司管理层违反全球需要和政策一致的商业战略提出质疑。
en: ExxonMobil’s investors must urgently query the company’s management on a business strategy that contradicts global needs and policy agreements.

zh: 如果埃克森美孚坚持其危险的商业战略，该公司投资者应该迅速下决心抛售股份，转投其他公司。
en: If ExxonMobil persists in its dangerous business strategy, the company’s investors should quickly conclude that the time has come to pull up stakes and move on.

zh: 石油巨头、烟草巨头、谎言巨头
en: Big Oil, Big Tobacco, Big Lies

zh: 波士顿 — — 过去几年来，越来越多人已经开始认真审视我们这个星球正在发生的事情 — — 历史性干旱、海平面上升、大规模洪涝 — — 并最终认识到人类活动正在推动快速气候变化。
en: BOSTON – Over the last few years, a growing number of people have been taking a hard look at what is happening to our planet – historic droughts, rising sea levels, massive floods – and acknowledging, finally, that human activity is propelling rapid climate change.

zh: 但你猜怎么着？
en: But guess what?

zh: 埃克森（现在叫埃克森美孚）早在1978年就已经看出了端倪。
en: Exxon (now ExxonMobil) had an inkling of this as early as 1978.

zh: 到20世纪80年代初，埃克森科学家的理解更加深入。
en: By the early 1980s, Exxon scientists had much more than an inkling.

zh: 他们不仅了解气候变化背后的科学，而且也承认公司自身在这一现象背后所起的巨大作用。
en: They not only understood the science behind climate change, but also recognized the company’s own outsize role in driving the phenomenon.

zh: 科学家们认识到这可能会对很大部分人产生“灾难性”的影响，并因此敦促埃克森的高管采取行动。
en: Recognizing the potential effects as “catastrophic” for a significant portion of the population, they urged Exxon’s top executives to take action.

zh: 但高管们非但没有采取行动，反而掩盖了真相。
en: Instead, the executives buried the truth.

zh: 这个令人义愤的故事背后可能尚存一线希望：最近揭露埃克森骗局的调查可能最终对应对迫在眉睫的气候危机起到催化作用。
en: There may be a silver lining to this infuriating story: the recent investigation that exposed Exxon’s deceit could end up catalyzing the action needed to address the looming climate crisis.

zh: 毕竟，有关烟草行业的类似披露 — — 大型烟草企业知道些什么、什么时候知道的 — — 彻底改变了公共卫生状况。
en: After all, similar revelations about the tobacco industry – what the major cigarette companies knew and when they knew it – transformed the public-health landscape.

zh: 1996年，系列诉讼迫使烟草公司公开数以百万计的内部文件，证实了公共健康倡导者和决策者早就怀疑的内容：早在上世纪50年代，业内人士就知道尼古丁具有成瘾性和香烟会诱发癌症。
en: In 1996, a series of lawsuits forced tobacco companies to release millions of internal documents, which confirmed what public-health advocates and policymakers had long suspected: as early as the 1950s, the industry knew that nicotine was addictive and that cigarettes caused cancer.

zh: 但为保护自身利益，烟草巨头故意误导公众，千方百计质疑它明知准确无误的科学发现的准确性。
en: But, to protect its own interests, Big Tobacco deliberately misled the public, doing everything possible to cast doubt on scientific findings that it knew to be accurate.

zh: 此等伎俩使烟草行业成功延迟每年本可挽救成百上千万人生命的法规出台超过50年之久。
en: Such tactics enabled the industry to delay, for more than 50 years, regulation that could have saved millions of lives annually.

zh: 但此次披露证明烟草业是不应属于决策过程的邪恶力量。
en: After the revelations, however, it was clear that the tobacco industry was a malevolent force that did not belong in the policymaking process.

zh: 随着烟草巨头的出局，手握烟草消费的实证效果的健康倡导者终于成功地迫使政府采取行动。
en: With Big Tobacco out of the picture, and armed with evidence of the real effects of tobacco consumption, health advocates were finally able to compel their governments to act.

zh: 2003年，世界领导人在世卫组织的主持下签署了烟草控制框架公约（FCTC ） 。
en: In 2003, world leaders agreed to the Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (FCTC), negotiated under the auspices of the World Health Organization.

zh: 今天，上述公约涵盖 90%的世界人口，并导致全球烟草企业销售显著下降。
en: Today, the treaty covers 90% of the world’s population and has contributed to a significant decline in sales for global tobacco corporations.

zh: 随着时间的推移，这将挽救成百上千万的生命（并为政府节约巨额医疗预算 ） 。
en: Over time, it will save hundreds of millions of lives (and save governments’ health-care budgets huge sums).

zh: 显而易见，石油巨头一直在学习烟草巨头的榜样。
en: Big Oil, it is now clear, has been following Big Tobacco’s playbook.

zh: 1997年，石油巨头在开始气候变化研究近20年后隐瞒了自己的研究成果，声称气候科学“很不明朗 ” ， 因此并不支持出台“强制削减能源使用”的规定。
en: In 1997, almost two decades after it began studying climate change, it quashed its research, claiming that climate science was “far from clear” and thus that it did not “support mandated cuts in energy use.”

zh: 除隐瞒自己的研究结果，埃克森美孚（及其同行）还出资推动垃圾科学，攻击警告气候灾难即将到来的科学家。
