en: Beyond suppressing its own findings, ExxonMobil (and its peers) funded and promoted junk science and attacked scientists who warned of the impending climate disaster.

zh: 化石燃料公司的方法非常有效，以至媒体到现在才开始意识到石油业在凭空捏造的所谓“气候辩论”中所起的主导作用。
en: The fossil-fuel companies’ approach was so effective that the media are only now beginning to recognize the leading role the industry played in creating – almost out of whole cloth – the so-called “climate debate.”

zh: 不过或许打消推行相关法规的政治意愿才是石油巨头最大的成功。
en: But perhaps Big Oil’s biggest success was diminishing the political will to implement appropriate regulation.

zh: 即使在1992年国际社会通过联合国气候变化框架公约（UNFCCC）后，化石燃料行业仍成功阻止了有意义的进展 — — 乃至今天如果不迅速采取行动，整个过程都有遭到逆转的可能。
en: Even after the international community adopted the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) in 1992, the fossil-fuel industry managed to block meaningful progress – to the point that, if serious action is not taken soon, the entire process could unravel.

zh: 在欧洲，荷兰皇家壳牌石油的游说严重稀释了欧盟的努力，以至针对各国的限制性可再生或能源效益目标至今都没有出台。
en: In Europe, Royal Dutch Shell’s lobbying so diluted the European Union’s efforts that there are now no binding targets for renewables or energy efficiency for individual countries.

zh: 该公司甚至致函欧盟委员会主席称“天然气有益于欧洲发展 ” 。
en: The company even sent a letter to the European Commission’s president claiming that “gas is good for Europe.”

zh: 壳牌和其他石油公司现在承诺承担国家政府“应对气候变化目标”的顾问任务。
en: Shell and other oil companies are now promising to work as “advisers” to national governments on how to deal with climate change.

zh: 就像烟草文件将烟草业赶出决策过程一样，埃克森调查应促使世界领导人将化石燃料行业清除出解决气候危机的进程。
en: Just as the tobacco files drove the tobacco industry out of policymaking processes, the Exxon investigation should compel world leaders to eliminate the fossil-fuel industry from efforts to solve the climate crisis.

zh: 毕竟，如果政策制定者一心希望政策失败，那政策成功的可能性将微乎其微。
en: After all, no policy can succeed if those who shape it are betting on its failure.

zh: 当行业堕落成为不争事实的时候出现了烟草领域公共卫生政策的转折点。
en: The turning point for tobacco-related public-health policy came when the industry’s depravity became indisputable.

zh: 现在，气候运动的时机已经到来。
en: Now, that moment has come for the climate movement.

zh: 我们不能简单地希望化石燃料业改弦更张。
en: We cannot simply hope that the fossil-fuel industry will change its ways.

zh: 正如人权组织、环保人士和企业责任倡导者联盟已经要求的那样，我们必须将化石燃料业彻底踢出决策过程。
en: As an alliance of human-rights groups, environmental activists, and corporate-accountability advocates already is demanding, we must kick the industry out of the policymaking process altogether.

zh: 埃克森的科学家没有说错：气候变化对许多群体的影响的确可以用灾难性来形容。
en: Exxon’s scientists were right: the effects of climate change on many communities are catastrophic.

zh: 因为威胁到如此多的生命 — — 以及威胁的证据如此明确 — — 石油巨头就像之前的烟草巨头一样，应该被视为巨大的麻烦制造者。
en: With so many lives at stake – and such clear evidence of the threat – Big Oil, like Big Tobacco before it, should be treated for what it is: Big Trouble.

zh: 让盲目的以色列重获视野
en: Eyesight for Israel’s Blind

zh: 发自巴黎 — — 如今在以巴问题上即便想找到一丝微漠的希望都非常困难，甚至近乎绝望。
en: PARIS – To find a glimmer of hope on the Israel-Palestine question has become difficult, if not impossible.

zh: 大多数以色列人如今都不相信和平决议能在自己这代人实现。
en: Most Israelis now believe that a peaceful solution will not come in their generation.

zh: 而在巴勒斯坦人看来，正是目前的政治僵局以及持续的以色列占领导致了极端主义的产生：如果自己连“一点东西”都得不到，那就干脆豁出去了。
en: As for the Palestinians, the political stalemate, and ongoing Israeli occupation, has led to radicalization: if they cannot have “something,” they want it all.

zh: 此外如今许多巴勒斯坦人都相信不管自身有何不足之处，时间都在自己这边。
en: And many believe that whatever their weakness today, time is on the Palestinians’ side.

zh: 为了反抗以色列定居者或警察的所作所为，即便最温和的巴勒斯坦人都拒绝接受以色列左翼的人道主义援助。
en: Even the most moderate Palestinians now reject Israeli leftists’ offers of help in terms of human support against the actions of Israeli settlers or police.

zh: 双方阵营温和派之间的政治对话几乎为零，而私人联系也微乎其微。
en: The political dialogue between moderates of both camps is mostly dead, and personal contact has become minimal.

zh: 在耶路撒冷街头，犹太人和巴勒斯坦人看上去仿佛刻意都装着看不见对方。
en: In the streets of Jerusalem, Israelis and Palestinians give the impression of deliberately trying not to see each other.

zh: 此外，随着以色列日益发展成为一个成功的发达国家，它的犹太裔公民似乎都倾向于忽视其他阿拉伯裔公民，正如其他地方的富人无视身边的穷人那样。
en: Moreover, as Israel increasingly resembles a successful developed country, its Jewish citizens tend to ignore its Arab citizens, just as the rich elsewhere often do not see the poor in their midst.

zh: 但与那些还有阶级流动希望的新兴和发达国家穷人不同，以色列的阿拉伯裔公民就是二等公民 — — 虽然他们的生活水平比该地区的大多数阿拉伯人都要高。
en: But, unlike the poor in many emerging and developed countries, who can hope for social mobility, Israeli Arabs are second-class citizens, even if their living standards remain higher than those of most Arabs in the region.

zh: 但正如《圣经》申命记所说 ： “ 人可不是单靠面包活着的。 ”
en: As we know from Deuteronomy, “Man does not live by bread alone.”

zh: 这种互不信任的相互无视现象在以色列国内普遍存在。
en: This distrustful ignorance of the other can be found everywhere in Israel.

zh: 或者说除了医院之外其他地方都无法摆脱这一现实。
en: Or almost everywhere, for there is a place that escapes this reality: the hospital.

zh: 而笔者之所以有此判断是因为到达以色列后突患眼疾，只好在隐加林（Ein Kerem）的哈达萨医院眼科部呆了7个小时 — — 该院是耶路撒冷进行医学治疗，教学和研究的主要机构。
en: Because of an urgent eye problem upon my arrival in Israel in late June, I had to spend seven hours in the ophthalmology department of the Hadassah Hospital in Ein Kerem, which is the main center of treatment, teaching, and research in Jerusalem.

zh: 虽然眼部不适，但笔者在这几个小时中的见闻堪称数年来在该地区能看见的最令人欢欣鼓舞的景象。
en: What I saw during those hours were, despite my personal condition, the most comforting and hopeful signs that I have encountered in the entire region in many years.

zh: 以色列的阿拉伯裔公民 — — 也就是巴勒斯坦医护人员 — — 照顾着犹太和阿拉伯裔病人。
en: Arab citizens of Israel – that is, Palestinian doctors and nurses – were treating Jewish and Arab patients.

zh: 以色列医护人员也对阿拉伯人关怀备至。
en: Israeli doctors and nurses attended to Arabs’ needs.

zh: 我甚至看到一些病人之间的互动交流。
en: I even saw some interaction among patients themselves.

zh: 那些显然是二战前从东欧移民来的以色列长者与巴勒斯坦幼童玩耍。
en: Old Israelis who had clearly come from Eastern Europe before World War II were playing with very young Palestinian children.

zh: 四处都充满着人与人之间的互信和宽容。
en: There was an atmosphere of reassuring tolerance of the other.

zh: 在医院这个高度专业化，组织良好但又非常放松（但也让人略感不真实）的气氛当中，我们可以瞥见双方阵营在不同政治家的领导下会产生一个什么样的未来。
en: In the highly professional, well-organized, and yet very relaxed (if not slightly confused) atmosphere of the hospital, one could glimpse what the future might hold with different political leadership on both sides.

zh: 情况就像是这里的病人都有着正常人的行为举止，而医院之外的健康人却展现出种种病态。
en: It was as if the ill were behaving in a healthy way, whereas, outside of the hospital, the healthy were behaving pathologically.

zh: 在医院里，病人唯一的选择就是把自己托付给别人。
en: In the hospital, patients’ only choice was to place themselves in the hands of the other.

zh: 我在隐加林遇见的是以色列最美的一面 — — 也直接驳斥了那种认定以色列是个“种族隔离国家”的惯常指控。
en: What I encountered that day in Ein Kerem was the best of Israel – and a direct rebuttal to the frequent accusation that Israel is an “apartheid state.”

zh: 而在眼科部这个致力于恢复人们视力 — — 也是眼界 — — 的地方发现某种潜在未来的象征也是非常恰当的。
en: And it was fitting that this token of a possible future should be found in an ophthalmology department, an enterprise devoted to restoring vision.

zh: 在被放置在一个可以且必须的情境下之时，以色列的阿拉伯裔公民和犹太裔公民是可以进行平等互动的。
en: Arab citizens of Israel and Jewish citizens of Israel interact with each other as equals when they are placed in a situation in which they can and must.

zh: 而所有的以色列人和巴勒斯坦人是否有一天也能让自己处于这样的情境中？
en: Might all Israelis and Palestinians find themselves in such a position one day?

zh: 我并不幼稚。
en: I am not naïve.

zh: 我知道自己当天（用一只眼睛）在哈达萨医院所看到的一切不可能被轻易复制到其他地方。
en: I understand that what I saw that day (with one eye) in the Hadassah Hospital cannot easily be replicated elsewhere.

zh: 就在出院两天后，笔者到访了耶路撒冷的巴勒斯坦社区，这个被安全墙重重包围分割的地界不断提醒着人们该区域严酷冷峻的现实。
en: Two days after my hospital experience, a tour of the Palestinian neighborhoods of Jerusalem – surrounded or divided by the security wall – served as a reminder of the region’s harsh and sobering realities.

zh: 但在哈达萨医院的见闻不但留在我的记忆���，也活在了我的心里。
en: But the lessons from the Hadassah Hospital remain alive in my heart as much as my head.

zh: 当人们别无选择只能信任别人的时候，他们就能做到这一点而且因此感觉更好。
en: When people have no other choice but to trust each other, they will be able to do so and feel better for it.

zh: 这是一个与权衡，技能和尊重有关的问题。
en: It is a question of balance, competence, and respect.

zh: 那么医院里的现实是否能被移植到到外面的世界？
en: Can the reality of the hospital be transferred to the reality outside?

zh: 这可能无法实现。
en: Probably not.

zh: 但这不能阻止人们去表达出某天将出现一个不一样的世界 — — 或是从今天开始，努力去实现这个世界。
en: But that should not prevent people from reflecting on what a different world could look like one day – or from working to bring about that world now.

zh: 对全球气候变暖视而不见
en: Eyes Wide Shut on Global Warming

zh: 哈佛大学教授罗伯·斯塔文曾说，有关控制全球气候变化的京都议定书“太少又太快 ” 。
en: The Kyoto Treaty on controlling climate change was, as Harvard professor Rob Stavins puts it, “too little, too fast.”

zh: 一方面，由于议定书只涉及到本世纪中叶排放全世界温室气体大约一半的国家，因此它并不是针对全球气候变暖危险的长期有效的防备措施。
en: On one hand, because it covered only those countries projected to emit roughly half of the world’s greenhouse-gas emissions by mid-century, it was not an effective long-run safeguard against the dangers of global warming.

zh: 另一方面，由于它要求工业化国家短期内花费巨资大幅削减排放数量，因此对美国、欧洲以及日本的经济造成巨大损失。
en: On the other hand, because it required significant and expensive short-run cuts in emissions by industrial countries, it threatened to impose large immediate costs on the American, European, and Japanese economies.

zh: 简而言之，京都议定书意味着为了微小的长期效应而忍受巨大的短期痛苦。
en: In short, the Kyoto agreement meant lots of short-term pain for little long-run gain.

zh: 克林顿时期欧盟和美国的经济学家主张在为本不属于京都议定书的东西建立模式的条件下而通过该议定书。
en: The European Union and American economists in the Clinton administration argued for passage of the Kyoto Treaty only by creating models for something that wasn’t the Kyoto Treaty.

zh: 他们预计，发展中国家会在某一时候加入议定书框架，并且会同美国和欧盟交换二氧化碳和其他温室气体排放权利而换取发展援助。
en: They projected that developing countries would enter the Kyoto framework at some point, and would trade their rights to emit CO2 and other greenhouse gases to the United States and Europe in return for development aid.

zh: 但是，这么多年过去，把京都议定书辩解为实在的全球性公共政策、同时又言而有据的人，我还没有遇到一个。 关于气候变化，有人说 ： “ 这是开端 ” 。
en: But, all these years later, I have yet to meet anyone who knows what they are talking about who is prepared to defend Kyoto as a substantive global public policy. ”It was a way of getting the ball rolling,” on climate change, say some. ”It was a way of waking up the world to the seriousness of the problem,” say others.

zh: 那些谈判签署议定书的人用以上两种解释都不能说明他们造福了世界。
en: Under neither of these interpretations can those who negotiated and signed the Kyoto Treaty be said to have served the world well.

zh: 当然，议定书签署以来这个世界更为糟糕。
en: Of course, the world has been served a lot worse since.

zh: 布什总统同副总统切尼一同否认甚至存在全球气候变暖的问题（而其财政部长奥尼尔和环境保护署署长惠特曼则意见相左 ） 。
en: President George W. Bush sided with his vice president, Dick Cheney, in denying that a global-warming problem even exists (his treasury secretary, Paul O’Neill, and his administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, Christine Whitman, disagreed).

zh: 这恐怕让世界耽误了整整十年来制定处理问题的政策，特别是鉴于在布什任期结束前，国际上的无所作为还有可能持续。
en: This has probably cost the world a decade of wasted time in developing a policy to deal with the problem, particularly given that intentional inaction is likely to continue until Bush’s term is finished.

zh: 但是，政治牌将会重新洗过，而且当2008年11月美国选举一位新总统时，将会有一个有关全球气候变暖的新协议。
en: But the political cards will be reshuffled, and there will be a new deal on global warming, when America next elects a president in November 2008.

zh: 到2009年，美国新的国务院可能会重新直抒己见。
en: By 2009, the US may have a State Department willing to speak up again.

zh: 除非我们极为幸运，而且知道气候学家忽略了碳隔离的某些极为重要的渠道，在2009年的时候，预测全球气候变暖的模型还将会特别不精确。
en: Unless we are extraordinarily fortunate and learn that climatologists have overlooked some enormously important channels of carbon sequestration, the models predicting global warming will still be grimly accurate in 2009.

zh: 在重新审视有关全球气候变暖的国际政策时，应当做两件事情。
en: When the time comes to revisit international policies on global warming, two things should happen.

zh: 首先，世界主要工业化国家必须激励发展中国家沿着环境友好、二氧化碳和甲烷排放量轻微的道路实现工业化。
en: First, the world’s industrial core must create incentives for the developing world to industrialize along an environmentally-friendly, C02- and CH4-light, path.

zh: 中国、印度、墨西哥、巴西以及其他许多发展中国家面临工业化、教育以及城市化的艰巨任务。 这些经济国家高速发展而体温室气体排放增长缓慢，这必须辅之以切实保证提供大量援助。
en: Slow growth of greenhouse-gas emissions in rapidly-growing economies must be accompanied by credible promises to deliver massive amounts of assistance in the mighty tasks of industrialization, education, and urbanization that China, India, Mexico, Brazil, and many other developing countries face.

zh: 第二，全球主要工业化国家必须鼓励其能源产业向新技术投资。 这些新技术可以使我们在本世纪中叶的时候拥有一个碳气排放轻微而隔离显著的经济结构。
en: Second, the world’s industrial core must create incentives for its energy industries to undertake the investments in new technologies that will move us by mid-century to an economic structure that is light on carbon emissions and heavy on carbon sequestration.

zh: 为有效的研发提供适当的激励不是轻而易举的。
en: Providing the proper incentives for effective research and development will not be easy.

zh: 当实现目标的最佳途径并不明朗之时（对于这种情况而言是最为有前途的后碳能源技术 ） ， 公共规划项目并不切实可行。
en: Public programs work less well when the best route to the goal – in this case, the most promising post-carbon energy technologies – is uncertain.

zh: 当投资者怀疑成功可能导致他们的劳动成果被以某种征并在世界范围内几乎无偿使用时，就难以鼓励私营部门的研发。
en: Private R&D is difficult to encourage when investors suspect that success would lead the fruits of their work to be taken by some form of eminent domain and used throughout the world with little compensation.

zh: 世界可以对全球气候变暖视而不见并且指望出现最好的结果，那就是气候略微暖和，既产生受益者（西伯利亚、北欧以及加拿大中部省份 ） ， 也产生受害者（已经炎热的地区将更为炎热和干燥 ） ； 海湾暖流继续温暖欧洲，季风不受破坏，而且恒河三角洲不被更为猛烈的台风淹没。
en: The world could continue to close its eyes to global warming and hope for the best: a slightly warmer climate that produces as many winners (on the Siberian, Northern European, and Canadian prairies) as losers (in already-hot regions that become hotter and dryer), and that the Gulf Stream continues warming Europe, the monsoons are not disrupted, and that the Ganges delta is not drowned by stronger typhoons.

zh: 或者，我们可能希望，在制定重大决策时利益被考虑进去的“我们”不是那些受害大户的“我们 ” 。
en: Or perhaps we are hoping that the “we” whose interests are taken into account when important decisions are made will not be the “we” who are among the big losers.

zh: 我们也可能继续视而不见。
en: Perhaps we will continue to close our eyes.

zh: 但是，如果过去十年来我们未曾让我们自己被称之为京都议定书的公关噱头以及称之为布什行政当局的一贯愚蠢所蒙蔽，我们确保一个更为可持续发展的世界的机会会更大。
en: But our chances of ensuring a more sustainable world would be higher if we had not allowed ourselves to be blinded for the past decade by the combination of the public-relations stunt known as the Kyoto Treaty and the idiocy-as-usual known as the Bush administration.

zh: 脸书和在线私隐的未来
en: Facebook and the Future of Online Privacy

zh: 发自纽约 — — 脸书（Facebook）的联合创始人克里斯·休斯（Chris Hughes）最近指出，公众对脸书的监督“早就该实施了 ” ， 宣称“令人我感到震惊的是，他们之前竟然无需回答更多关于正方面的这些问题。
en: NEW YORK – Chris Hughes, a co-founder of Facebook, recently noted that the public scrutiny of Facebook is “very much overdue,” declaring that “it’s shocking to me that they didn’t have to answer more of these questions earlier on.”

zh: ”信息技术领域（尤其是在欧洲）的许多领导者多年来一直在警告脸书（和其他门户网站）的滥用行为。
en: Leaders in the information technology sector, especially in Europe, have been warning of the abuses by Facebook (and other portals) for years.

zh: 而如今我们也急需他们的见解和现实建议。
en: Their insights and practical recommendations are especially urgent now.

zh: 脸书首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在美国参议院所做的证词根本没能增强公众对那些买卖用户个人数据企业的信心。
en: Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s testimony before the US Senate did little to shore up public confidence in a company that traffics in its users’ personal data.

zh: 当伊利诺伊州参议员理查德·德宾（Richard Durbin）询问扎克伯格是否乐意分享他的酒店名称以及本周跟他在网聊过的用户名时 — — 这些正是脸书所追踪和使用的数据。
en: The most telling moment of testimony came when Illinois Senator Richard Durbin asked whether Zuckerberg would be comfortable sharing the name of his hotel and the people he had messaged that week, exactly the kind of data tracked and used by Facebook.

zh: 扎克伯格回答说他不愿意提供这些信息。
en: Zuckerberg replied that he would not be comfortable providing the information.

zh: “我想说的就是这一点 ， ” 德宾说 ， “ 就是你对你隐私的权利。
en: “I think that may be what this is all about,” Durbin said.
“Your right to privacy."

zh: 脸书的批评者们多年来都在强调这一点。
en: Critics of Facebook have been making this point for years.

zh: 欧洲顶级IT专家斯蒂芬努·昆塔莱利（Stefano Quintarelli）是网上隐私的主要倡导者之一（直到最近还是意大利议会的一名成员 ） ， 他长期以来都是脸书滥用其市场地位和在线个人数据的预言者和批评者。
en: Stefano Quintarelli, one of Europe’s top IT experts and a leading advocate for online privacy (and, until recently, a member of the Italian Parliament), has been a persistent and prophetic critic of Facebook’s abuse of its market position and misuse of online personal data.

zh: 他一直主张一个重大的理念：我们每个人都应该紧握对自身在线个人资料的控制权，而且这些资料可以在门户网站之间随时转移。
en: He has long championed a powerful idea: that each of us should retain control of our online profile, which should be readily transferable across portals.

zh: 如果我们决定弃用脸书，就应当能在转投其竞争对手的同时不至于丢失那些继续留在脸书者的联系。
en: If we decide we don’t like Facebook, we should be able to shift to a competitor without losing the links to contacts who remain on Facebook.

zh: 在昆塔莱利看来，剑桥分析公司（Cambridge Analytica）对脸书数据的滥用是脸书不负责任商业模式的必然后果。
en: For Quintarelli, Cambridge Analytica’s abuse of data acquired from Facebook was an inevitable consequence of Facebook’s irresponsible business model.

zh: 脸书现在也已经承认剑桥分析公司并不是唯一一个从脸书提取个人资料的机构。
en: Facebook has now acknowledged that Cambridge Analytica is not alone in having exploited personal profiles acquired from Facebook.

zh: 昆塔莱利在与我的私人交流中表示，在历经六年的准备和辩论后，欧盟的《通用数据保护条例》将于5月25日生效，并“可以在某些方面起到指导作用。
en: In personal communications with me, Quintarelli says that the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation, which takes effect on May 25, following six years of preparation and debate, “can serve as guidance in some aspects.”

zh: ”他指出在该条例下一些不合规的组织机构可能面临相当于其收入4％的巨额罚款。
en: Under the GDPR, he notes, “non-compliant organizations can face heavy fines, up to 4% of their revenues.

zh: 如果条例能早一点就位，为了避免这类罚款，脸书会在意识到数据泄露后立即通报当局，而且肯定是在上次美国总统大选之前。 ”
en: Had the GDPR already been in place, Facebook, in order to avoid such fines, would have had to notify the authorities of the data leak as soon as the company became aware of it, well in advance of the last US election.”

zh: 昆塔莱利强调“有效的竞争是增强和保护数字领域生物多样性的有力工具。
en: Quintarelli emphasizes that, “Effective competition is a powerful tool to increase and defend biodiversity in the digital space.”

zh: ”而条例在此也应该有所帮助，因为它“引入了个人资料可转移性的概念，用户可以自身个人信息从一个服务提供商转移到另一个，就像我们将电话信息 — — 手机号码 — — 从一个电信运营商转移到另一个那样。 “
en: And here, the GDPR should help, because it “introduces the concept of profile portability, whereby a user can move her profile from one service provider to another, like we do when porting our telephone profile – the mobile phone number – from one operator to another.”

zh: 他继续指出 ： “ 这种形式的个人资料数据所有权当然是不够的。
en: But “this form of ownership of one’s own profile data,” Quintarelli continues, “is certainly not enough.”

zh: ”而同样重要的是“互连：那些接收我们个人资料的运营商应该与上一个运营商互连，这样我们就不会与自己的在线好友失去联系。
en: Just as important is “interconnection: the operator to which we port our profile should be interconnected to the source operator so that we don’t lose contact with our online friends.

zh: 而得益于Web发明者蒂姆·伯纳斯-李（Tim Berners-Lee）所开发的IPFS和Solid等技术，今天我们有可能做到这一点。 ”
en: This is possible today thanks to technologies like IPFS and Solid, developed by the web inventor Tim Berners-Lee.”

zh: 维也纳经济大学教授兼该校管理信息系统研究所主任莎拉·斯皮尔克曼（Sarah Spiekermann）则是另一位宣扬网上隐私保护，号召大家警惕脸书滥用行为的先行者。
en: Sarah Spiekermann, a professor at the Vienna University of Economics and Business (WU), and Chair of its Institute for Management Information Systems, is another pioneer of online privacy who has long warned about the type of abuses seen with Facebook.

zh: 作为一名研究以精准广告营销，政治宣传，公共和私人监控或其他邪恶目的而贩卖人们在线身份行为的全球权威，斯皮尔克曼强调要对“个人数据市场”予以打击。
en: Spiekermann, a global authority on the trafficking of our online identities for purposes of targeted advertising, political propaganda, public and private surveillance, or other nefarious purposes, emphasizes the need to crack down on “personal data markets.”

zh: “自从2011年世界经济论坛开始将个人数据作为一种新资产类别进行讨论以来 ， ” 她告诉我说 ， “ 个人数据市场因个人数据可能成为数字经济 — — 以及政治 — — 的‘新金矿’这一理念而蓬勃发展 . ” 因此“如今有超过一千家公司参与了这一数字信息价值链，该链条可以从任何在线活动中收集数据，只要那些在线或移动用户一连上网，它们就可以在大约36秒内向这些人发送有针对性的内容。
en: “Ever since the World Economic Forum started to discuss personal data as a new asset class in 2011,” she told me, “personal data markets have thrived on the idea that personal data might be the ‘new oil’ of the digital economy as well as – so it seems – of politics.” As a result, “more than a thousand companies are now involved in a digital information value chain that harvests data from any online activity and delivers targeted content to online or mobile users within roughly 36 seconds of their entry into the digital realm.”

zh: ”而“收集和使用我们的数据用于任何可能想到的目的也不仅仅是脸书、谷歌，苹果或亚马逊 ， ” 斯皮尔克曼指出 ， “ 那些‘数据管理平台 ’ ， 例如由Acxiom或甲骨文BlueKai运营的平台，就拥有数亿用户的每人几千条个人属性和社会心理档案。
en: Nor is it “just Facebook and Google, Apple or Amazon that harvest and use our data for any purpose one might think of,” Spiekermann says. “‘Data management platforms’ such as those operated by Acxiom or Oracle BlueKai possess thousands of personal attributes and socio-psychological profiles about hundreds of millions of users.”

zh: 虽然斯皮尔克曼认为“当前这种个人数据市场及其数据使用形式应当被禁止 ” ， 但她认为《通用数据保护条例 》 “ 对于全球各地的企业来说是都是其反思自身个人数据共享实践的良好动力 ” 。
en: While Spiekermann thinks “personal data markets and the use of the data within them should be forbidden in their current form,” she thinks the GDPR “is a good motivator for companies around the world to question their personal data sharing practices.”

zh: 她还指出“一个致力于保护隐私的富饶在线服务生态系统正在启动和运行 ” 。
en: She also notes that “a rich ecosystem of privacy-friendly online services is starting to be up and running.”

zh: 一项由维也纳经济大学研究生进行的研究“对那些顶级在线服务商（如谷歌，脸书或苹果）的数据收集行为进行了评估，并将之与其他注重隐私的新竞争对手做了比较。
en: A study by a class of WU graduate students “benchmarked the data collection practices of our top online services (such as Google, Facebook or Apple) and compared them to their new privacy-friendly competitors.”

zh: ”她指出“这项研究让每个人都有机会在现场切换服务。 ”
en: The study, she says, “gives everyone a chance to switch services on the spot.”

zh: 脸书的巨大游说力量迄今为止将昆塔莱利，斯皮尔克曼及其同仁的大部分操作理念挡在了门外。
en: Facebook’s immense lobbying power has so far mostly fended off the practical ideas of Quintarelli, Spiekermann, and their fellow campaigners.

zh: 然而最近的丑闻也已经让公众看清了这种不作为对民主本身造成的威胁。
en: The recent scandal, however, has opened the public’s eyes to the threat that inaction poses to democracy itself.

zh: 欧盟已率先对此做出了回应，一方面推出了新的隐私标准，一方面建议对脸书和其他在线个人数据贩子征税。
en: The EU has taken the lead in responding, thanks to its new privacy standards and proposed greater taxation of Facebook and other peddlers of online personal data.

zh: 但还有很多必要和可行的事要做。
en: Yet more is needed and feasible.

zh: 而昆塔莱利，斯皮尔克曼和其他在线道德规范的倡导者们已经为我们提供了一个透明，公平，民主和尊重个人权利的实用路径。
en: Quintarelli, Spiekermann, and their fellow champions of online ethics offer us a practical path to an Internet that is transparent, fair, democratic, and respectful of personal rights.

zh: 陈-扎克伯格方案
en: The Chan-Zuckerberg Solution

zh: 伯克利—Facebook创始人扎克伯格和他的夫人普莉希拉·陈最近宣布计划将大约450亿美元Facebook股票用于改善世界。 一些批评者称他们的这一举动为公关花招。
en: BERKELEY – When Facebook’s founder, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, recently announced their plan to devote some $45 billion in Facebook shares toward making the world a better place, some critics wrote off the move as a public-relations ploy.

zh: 他们指出，陈和扎克伯格并没有将股票注入慈善基金会，而是放在一个投资公司中，这家公司可以任意配置这笔资金 — — 也可以选择用于营利投资。
en: They noted that Chan and Zuckerberg were not putting their shares in a charitable foundation, but rather into an investment company that can allocate funds however it chooses – and that it can choose for-profit investments.

zh: 质疑者还指出，扎克伯格夫妇并没有订立不可撤销的法律承诺，而只是说要向该基金捐出“大部分财富 ” 。
en: Skeptics also noted that instead of making an irrevocable legal commitment, the couple had only pledged to donate “most of their wealth” to the fund.

zh: 据一位卑劣的批评者说，扎克伯格只是把“他的钱从一个口袋转移到另一个口袋 ” ， 而其中极端的“公关投资回报足以令他的Facebook股票相形见绌 ” 。
en: According to one mean-spirited critic, Zuckerberg was simply moving his “money from one pocket to the other” with a substantial “PR return-on-investment [that] dwarfs that of his Facebook stock.”

zh: 真相与此截然不同。
en: The truth is quite different.

zh: 陈和扎克伯格所选择的策略是传统慈善与影响力投资的结合，正符合现代利他主义的潮流。
en: The strategy adopted by Chan and Zuckerberg, a combination of traditional philanthropy and impact investing, is exactly in sync with the most promising trends in modern altruism.

zh: 传统慈善的绝对优势是其承担风险的能力。
en: The defining strength of traditional philanthropy is its ability to take risks.

zh: 慈善机构不需要回应公共官员，也不必给私人股东创造回报。
en: Philanthropies don’t have to answer to public officials or generate returns for private shareholders.

zh: 这让它们能够为大胆的创新概念提供融资。
en: That allows them to finance bold, innovative ideas.

zh: 此外，与公共和营利部门不同，它们可以采取非常长的时界，针对需要几十年时间才有可能解决的问题。
en: And, in contrast to both the public and for-profit sectors, they can adopt a very long time horizon for problems that require decades to solve.

zh: 从很多方面看，传统慈善的运营类似于风险资本。
en: In many ways, traditional philanthropies operate like venture capitalists.

zh: 它们也许知道，许多项目不会形成回报，但它们下注于某些项目能够成为开创性突破，它们的成功能促使政策转变或吸引更大的公共和营利私人资金流。
en: They might know that many of their projects will not pay off, but they are betting that a few will turn out to be pioneering breakthroughs, and that their success will spark policy changes or attract larger flows of public and for-profit private funding.

zh: 但慈善只是解决社会和环境挑战的方法之一。 另一种方法是影响力投资。
en: But philanthropy is only one way to address social and environmental challenges.

zh: 影响力投资一词由世界上最古老的慈善机构之一 — — 洛克菲勒基金会赞助的一次2007年的会议上被提出。
en: Impact investing – a term coined in 2007 at a conference sponsored by the Rockefeller Foundation, one of the oldest traditional philanthropies – is another.

zh: 和慈善捐赠人不同，影响力投资者寻求获得社会和财务回报。
en: Unlike philanthropic donors, impact investors seek both social and financial returns on their investments.

zh: 影响力投资不但扩大了可用财富规模；也带来了能产生自我维持的回报的项目。
en: Impact investing not only broadens the pool of available wealth; it fosters projects that will produce self-sustaining returns.

zh: 近几年来，流入影响力投资的资金迅速扩张，影响力投资者的可投资产范围相应地拓宽了。
en: In recent years, the money flowing into impact investing has expanded rapidly, and the range of assets available to impact investors has grown to match.

zh: 社会风险资本企业寻求“双重利润 ” （ 健康的财务回报以及更广泛的社会或环境收益 ） ， 它们是风险资本业的一个增长迅猛的细分。
en: Social venture capital firms, which seek a “double bottom line” (healthy financial returns, as well as broader social or environmental benefits) are one of the fastest-growing segments of the venture-capital industry.

zh: 比如，在北加州，湾区权益基金（Bay Area Equity Fund）自2004年以来向Revolution Foods、Pandora、SolarCity和Tesla等公司投资了1亿美元。
en: In Northern California, for example, the Bay Area Equity Fund has invested $100 million since 2004 in companies such as Revolution Foods, Pandora, SolarCity, and Tesla.

zh: 该基金估计这些投资总共产生了15,000个工作岗位和24.4%的内部回报率。
en: All told, the fund estimates that those investments have created 15,000 jobs and generated an internal rate of return of 24.4%.

zh: 与此同时，大型机构也在日益变身为重要的影响力投资者，向环境、社会和治理（ESG）共同基金注入资金。
en: Big institutional players, meanwhile, are becoming significant impact investors by pouring money into Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) mutual funds.

zh: 一项估计表明，ESG基金投资呈现出爆炸式增长，从2007年的2,020亿美元增加到2014年的4.3万亿美元。
en: By one estimate, investment in ESG funds has exploded, from $202 billion in 2007 to $4.3 trillion in 2014.

zh: 越来越多的ESG基金目前散户投资者也可以直接投资。
en: A growing number of ESG funds are now directly available to retail investors.

zh: 就连体量巨大的退休基金也急切地要进入到该领域，美国劳工部最近为此提供了便利。
en: Even giant pension funds are eager to enter the arena, and the US Department of Labor recently made that easier.

zh: 10月，劳工部长佩雷兹（Tom Perez）修订了现有规则，允许退休基金经理考虑社会影响力投资，只要这种投资不与基金经理的信托义务相悖。
en: In October, Secretary of Labor Tom Perez revised existing rules to allow pension fund managers to consider the social impact of investments as long as doing so does not compromise the managers’ fiduciary obligations.

zh: 1978年的一项类似规则允许退休基金将一些投资配置给非传统资产，结果助推了风险资本业的增长。
en: A similar 1978 ruling, allowing pension funds to allocate some of their investments to non-traditional assets, helped fuel the growth of the venture capital industry.

zh: 纯慈善基金会面临着重大约束。
en: Purely philanthropic foundations face major constraints.

zh: 理论上，它们被允许作为影响力投资者，在于它们的规定职责相符的项目中做一些“项目相关投资 ” ； 但是，在实践中，它们面临着严格的信托规则，使它们根本不愿意去做这样的投资。
en: They are, in theory, allowed to act as impact investors to make “program-related investments” in projects consistent with their stated missions; in practice, however, they face strict fiduciary rules that make them reluctant to do so.

zh: 越来越多的基金会 — — 比如比尔和梅琳达·盖茨基金会、洛克菲勒基金会和克雷奇基金会（Kresge Foundation ） — —都在增加对有利于其慈善目标的活动的投资。
en: A growing number of foundations – such as the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, the Rockefeller Foundation, and the Kresge Foundation – are increasing their investment in activities that further their philanthropic goals.

zh: 不幸的是，项目相关投资仍只占基金会资本配置的1 % ， 而其中又只有0.05%投向了股权投资。
en: Unfortunately, program-related investments still represent only 1% of the capital deployed by foundations, with just 0.05% of that going toward equity investments.

zh: 陈-扎克伯格计划是一个显著的例子，说明了社会影响力融资的高速增长能够补充和支持传统慈善。
en: The Chan-Zuckerberg initiative is a high-profile example of the rapid growth of social-impact finance that complements and supports traditional philanthropy.

zh: 陈和扎克伯格不会因为将财富转移到有限责任公司而获得税收优惠。
en: Chan and Zuckerberg will receive no tax benefit from transferring their wealth to a limited liability corporation.

zh: 但如果他们将Facebook股票捐给慈善组织，那么该组织在套现股票将所获资金用于运营时不必支付资本利得税。
en: But when they donate Facebook shares to a charitable organization, the recipient won’t have to pay capital gains tax when it liquidates the shares and puts the money to work.

zh: 陈和扎克伯格也将在捐献股票时获得股票价值的慈善支出扣除。
en: And Chan and Zuckerberg will get a charitable deduction for the value of the shares at the time they are donated.

zh: 与此同时，他们也可以用部分财富作为影响力投资者投资营利性社会企业，获得财务和社会回报（他们必须为所获利润缴税 ） 。
en: Meanwhile, they will be free to use part of their fortune as impact investors in for-profit social enterprises that promise both financial and social returns (and they will have to pay taxes on the profits they reap).

zh: 他们也可以选择投资于宣传甚至政治活动以鼓励变革。
en: They can also choose to invest in advocacy and even political activity to encourage change.

zh: 从皮埃尔·奥米迪亚（Pierre Omidyar）到劳伦斯·鲍威尔·乔布斯（Laurene Powell Jobs ） ， 这一代靠高科技支付的慈善家都在使用这一方法。
en: This is exactly the approach that many of this generation’s major tech-based philanthropists, from Pierre Omidyar to Laurene Powell Jobs, are using.

zh: 所有这些都不是在说政府应该撇清其在应对重大公共挑战中的作用。
en: None of this is to say that the government should relinquish its own role in addressing major public challenges.

zh: 即使是扎克伯格和盖茨这样的亿万富翁慈善家，也没有财力实施地区、国家或全球规模的方案。
en: For all their money, not even billionaire philanthropists like Zuckerberg and Gates can implement solutions on a regional, national, or global scale.

zh: 但他们可以承担开发和测试应对长期社会和环境问题的新方法的前端风险。
en: But they can assume the upfront risks of developing and testing new approaches to tackling long-term social and environmental problems.

zh: 然后，他们可以鼓动政策变革和公共资金扩大有效方法的规模。
en: And then they can advocate for policy changes and public funding to scale those approaches that work.

zh: 简言之，公共精神的创新资本没有问题。
en: In short, there is nothing wrong with public-spirited innovation capital.

zh: 相反，其蓬勃发展表明它将是二十一世纪解决问题之道的关键组成部分。
en: On the contrary, its soaring popularity suggests that it will be a crucial component of twenty-first-century problem-solving.

zh: 跟Facebook面对面
en: Face-to-Face with Facebook

zh: 发自纽约 — — 很久很久以前，当Facebook的创立者马克·扎克伯格还在念小学的时候，我写了本名叫《版本2.1 : 数码时代的生活规划》的书，书中盛赞了一种叫“P3”的理念（如今叫p3p, the platform for privacy preferences，为私隐数据所设的平台 ） 。
en: NEW YORK – Long ago, when Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg was in grade school, I wrote a book (Release 2.1: A Design for Living in the Digital Age) in which I lauded something called “P3” (now p3p), the platform for privacy preferences.

zh: 当时我确信人们会开始用P3或者其他类似的东西来管理一些与自身有关的数据。
en: I was sure that people would start using P3 or something like it to control access to data about themselves.

zh: 谁知无人响应，因为我的理念超前了整整十年 … …
en: Of course, I was wrong...for about 10 years.

zh: 如今，这一切终于露出了苗头 — — 虽然不是以我所预料的方式，但也不是扎克伯格所预想的那样。
en: Now, at last, it’s starting to happen – though not exactly the way I envisioned it. Nor is it exactly the way Zuckerberg envisioned it...

zh: 在许多人竭力反对Facebook变更私隐政策之时，数百万人正在利用Facebook以及其他社交网站所提供的工具平静地经营着自己的声誉。
en: While many people are up in arms about Facebook’s shifting privacy policies, millions of others are calmly managing their reputations online, using the tools that Facebook and other social Web sites provide.

zh: 事实上，正是Facebook教会了他们如何去做。
en: In fact, Facebook has helped them learn how to do that.

zh: 据美国皮尤研究中心发布的“网络与美国人生活”项目统计资料(http : / /pewinternet.org/Reports/2010/Reputation-Management.aspx)显示，年轻人比年长者更加在意自己的网络名声。
en: Statistics recently published by the Pew Research Center’s Internet & American Life Project (http://pewinternet.org/Reports/2010/Reputation-Management.aspx) indicate that young people manage their reputations online more carefully than do older people.

zh: 但我不认为这就意味着年轻人更注重私隐；事实上，扎克伯格说得有道理 ： “ 人们不但非常乐于分享更多各类资讯，而且愿意更加开放地与更多的人分享。
en: I don’t think that means that the young care more about privacy; in fact, I think Zuckerberg is right when he says, “People have really gotten comfortable not only sharing more information and different kinds, but more openly and with more people.

zh: 这种社会规范已经贯穿了我们的整个生活。 ”
en: That social norm is just something that has evolved over time.”

zh: 而年轻一代之所以更加乐于分享，恰恰是因为他们知道如何去掌控自己的信息。
en: The younger generation is comfortable with sharing precisely because they know how to control it.

zh: 扎克伯格是对的，这一代人并不一定是要私隐或者是分析家戴安·博尔德所谓的“隔绝 ” ， 他们真正想要的是“控制 ” 。
en: Zuckerberg is right that they don’t necessarily want privacy or what analyst Danah Boyd calls “seclusion,” but they do want “control.”

zh: 他们不会盲目接受网站的默认设置。
en: They won’t blindly follow defaults.

zh: 一般来说，年轻人比年长者更多地在网上发布一些自己及其同伴所干的傻事，因此他们也迅速学会了对某些方面的信息加以控制。
en: Generally, young people post more information of an edgy nature about themselves and about their friends than do older adults, so they are quickly learning the need for specific controls.

zh: 反过来，年长的网络用户一方面较少胡作非为，另一方面也很少把这些蠢事暴露在别人的镜头之下（当然也有例外 ） 。
en: By contrast, older users (1) are less likely to do stupid things in the first place, and (2) are less likely to do so in range of a camera. (Of course, there are notable exceptions.)

zh: 但他们也不愿意使用那些可能泄露私隐的默认设置。
en: But they, too, don’t want default settings that leave them feeling exposed.

zh: 他们希望依靠自己的力量去“升级，而不是被Facebook推着走（或者是不情愿地被带领着 ） 。
en: They want to “evolve” on their own, rather than be pushed (or led unwittingly) by Facebook.

zh: 简而言之，市场正在缓慢成长，而消费者们同样也正逐步地进行自我教育。
en: In short, the market is working, slowly, and consumers are educating themselves, slowly.

zh: Facebook是整个过程的重要一部分：它提供了相关工具，还不断加以改进，而且（常常在无意中）通过修改公共默认设置的方式推广了这些工具。
en: Facebook has been a big part of that: it has provided the tools to do so, and is constantly tweaking them. It has also publicized those tools, often inadvertently, by setting overly public defaults.

zh: 但在忙于攫取利润的过程中，该公司在回应外界批评方面似乎有点吝啬 — — 以及闭目塞听。 那些批评可能不代表大多数用户的意见，但也应该得到礼貌且严肃的回应。
en: But in its rush to make money, the company seems to have been greedy – and pretty tone-deaf – in its response to critics.  The critics may not represent the majority of users, but they deserve a polite and considered response.

zh: 而当该公司在其广告系统Beacon方面遭遇挫折，最近又与Pandora这类专属供应商在用户数据分享方面闹翻之时， 企业就需要表现得更加人性化了。
en: And when the company does screw up – as with Beacon and more recently its plans for user data-sharing with favored vendors such as Pandora – it needs to show more humility.

zh: 这不是一个道德判断，而是一个商业分析。
en: That’s not a moral judgment, but a business one.

zh: 当我们正迈向一个用户有权管理自己名声的世界，而市场也正朝着同一方向发展的时候，所有逆流而动的公司都将受到惩罚。
en: If the market is working towards a world where users exercise the power to manage their own reputations, it will ultimately punish companies that become too arrogant.

zh: 上述事实仅仅是私隐讨论的其中一部分。
en: But that is only part of the privacy discussion.

zh: 令人欣慰的是，Facebook主要处理的都是一些公共数据，这意味着如果你的朋友看得到的话，你自己也能看到。
en: The comforting thing about the kind of data that Facebook primarily deals with is that it’s public. If your friends and other people can see it, so can you.

zh: 而更令人困扰的则是一些你没意识到的数据 — — 比如你的在线活动，网络广告公司将这类信息收集起来并传递给广告商和其他市场经营者，有时还会和其他供应商所提供的线下活动资料相结合。 总的来说，这就是你所无法看到的数据 — — 你点击了什么，搜索了什么，你在哪些网页之间浏览 — — 而你的朋友们基本上也无法得知这些。
en: More troubling is the data you don’t even know about – the kind of data about your online activities collected by ad networks and shared with advertisers and other marketers, and sometimes correlated with offline data from other vendors.  By and large, that’s information you can’t see – what you clicked on, what you searched for, which pages you came from and went to – and neither can your friends, for the most part.

zh: 但这些信息却被贩卖出去，通过统计整理来将你归入一个门类，最终决定你看到什么广告，收到什么邮件，得到什么优惠信息。
en: But that information is sold and traded, manipulated with algorithms to classify you and to determine what ads you see, what e-mails you receive, and often what offers are made to you.

zh: 毫无疑问，有些信息还可能被滥用 … …
en: Of course, some of that information could go astray...

zh: 我个人对此并不太在意，但对于许多突然意识到发生了什么的人来说，这可是件要紧的事情。
en: Personally, I don’t really mind, but there are many people who would, if they understood what was going on in the first place.

zh: 据我推测，在今年或者未来十年以内，这个议题将比人们向同伴公开分享何种信息更具争议性。
en: I predict that, whether it’s this year or in ten years, this will become a much greater issue than what information people share openly with friends.

zh: 而挑战则在于令这些被暗中分享的信息变得更加容易被理解，更加明确，也更加透明，而且要抢在公众通过某种方式发觉自己被蒙蔽之前。
en: The challenge is to make this hidden sharing of information less confusing, more explicit, and more transparent before the majority of people discover it for themselves in a way that leaves them feeling deceived.

zh: 我经常在与广告业有关的场合提出这一点，而经常得到的就是“人们不知情的事也不会伤害他们”或者“我们都是为了他们好，这样人们看到的都是自己感兴趣的广告”这样的答复。
en: I regularly attend advertising industry events and raise this issue, and the answers I get are something along the lines of “what people don’t know won't hurt them,” or “all we’re doing is giving them ads better targeted to their interests.”

zh: 但人们从来都不喜欢这样被操纵，他们喜欢被作为独立的个体来对待，而不是被分门别类放在一个篮子里。
en: But people have a way of objecting to being manipulated like that. They like to be treated as individuals, not to be put into buckets.

zh: 我不断告诫市场经营者这不是一个威胁，而是一个机会。
en: I keep telling marketers that this is not a threat, but an opportunity.

zh: 正如Facebook在磕磕碰碰中教会了人们私隐控制那样，市场经营者们也应该用一种更为优雅的方式教育人们何为数据跟踪控制。
en: Just as Facebook has educated people, clumsily, about privacy controls, so marketers must educate people, ideally more elegantly, about tracking controls.

zh: 我想实现这一点不需要10年，也不没必要用一大批广告商暴出丑闻的方式来实现。
en: I hope it won’t take ten years and a lot of bad publicity for advertisers to figure that out.

zh: 正如我一路看着人们收集并使用自身健康和行为数据的市场蓬勃兴起那样，目前市场的这种混乱是有益的。
en: From my own perspective, as I look at the emerging market for people generating and using their own health/behavior data, this commotion is useful.

zh: 那些分享健康数据的人会比几年前更加熟练地管理那些数据，也会对托管这类数据的公司怀有一份合理的戒心。
en: People who share health data are likely to be much more adept at managing it than they would have been just a few years ago. They will also be fairly skeptical about the companies they entrust it to.

zh: 而这将最终涉及到透明度和付费模式，令消费者们不再为自己的数据将被贩卖到何处而感到困惑。
en: That ultimately argues for transparency and paid models, so that consumers don’t wonder what other allegiances companies may have.

zh: “我给你钱来管理我的数据”是相当直截了当的做法。
en: “I pay you to manage my data,” is pretty straightforward.

zh: 而“我给你数据，你给我免费服务”则会让消费者们不禁存疑：究竟还有哪间公司在使用自己的数据呢？
en: “I give you my data and you give me a free service” leaves the customer wondering what else the company may do with the data.

zh: 第二核时代
en: The Second Nuclear Age

zh: 纽黑文—12月中旬，朝鲜发射了远程导弹，此举引起了全球的谴责，这些无关痛痒的谴责闭着眼睛都能想到，显得颇为滑稽。
en: NEW HAVEN – North Korea’s launch of a long-range missile in mid-December was followed by a flurry of global condemnation that was almost comical in its predictability and impotence.

zh: 但朝鲜的发射动作凸显了已不可再坐视不理的大现实：世界进入了第二个核时代。
en: But the launch underscored a larger reality that can no longer be ignored: the world has entered a second nuclear age.

zh: 原子弹在后冷战时代卷土重来了。
en: The atomic bomb has returned for a second act, a post-Cold War encore.

zh: 若要处理好这一局面，就必须更好地理解大图景。
en: This larger pattern needs to be understood if it is to be managed.

zh: 第二核时代的轮廓仍在形成之中。
en: The contours of the second nuclear age are still taking shape.

zh: 但未来几年将充满危险，因为随着规则和红线的定义，新情况本身就制造着危险。
en: But the next few years will be especially perilous, because newness itself creates dangers as rules and red lines are redefined.

zh: 在第一核时代中，整个过程历时十年之久，这一回也不会不同。
en: This took at least ten years in the first nuclear age, and this time may be no different.

zh: 在中东、南亚和东亚，旧对手们正在开展核竞赛。
en: In the Middle East, South Asia, and East Asia, old rivalries now unfold in a nuclear context.

zh: 这已经改变了中东的军事格局。
en: This has already changed military postures across the Middle East.

zh: 以色列的部分核武器正在向大海移动，常规动力潜艇装载着原子弹头，以防止它们成为突然袭击的目标。
en: Part of the Israeli nuclear arsenal is being shifted to sea, with atomic warheads on diesel submarines, to prevent their being targeted in a surprise attack.

zh: 以色列还部署了新一代卫星系统，以提供其他国家准备进行导弹打击的先期预警。
en: Israel also is launching a new generation of satellites to provide early warning of other countries’ preparations for missile strikes.

zh: 如果伊朗机动导弹出现动静，以色列希望马上能够知晓。
en: If Iran’s mobile missiles disperse, Israel wants to know about it immediately.

zh: 于是，阿拉伯-以色列和平的就问题有了新背景 — — 伊朗核威胁。
en: Thus, the old problem of Arab-Israeli peace is now seen in the new context of an Iranian nuclear threat.

zh: 这两个问题有着千丝万缕的联系。
en: The two problems are linked.

zh: 以色列如何在同时面对伊朗核打击威胁的情况下应对加沙、黎巴嫩或埃及的火箭袭击？
en: How would Israel respond to rocket attacks from Gaza, Lebanon, or Egypt if it simultaneously faced the threat of nuclear attack by Iran?

zh: 如果伊朗的威胁达到了疏散城市，或将导弹对准自己的城市以确保任何对它们的打击都能形成大规模附带伤害，美国和以色列会怎么做？
en: What would the United States and Israel do if Iran carried its threat to the point of evacuating its cities, or placing missiles in its own cities to ensure that any attack on them would cause massive collateral damage?

zh: 过去五年，巴基斯坦的核武库扩张了一倍。
en: Pakistan has doubled the size of its nuclear arsenal in the last five years.

zh: 其武装部队已开始装备战术核武器 — — 短程战场武器。
en: Its armed forces are set to field new tactical nuclear weapons – short-range battlefield weapons.

zh: 印度已经形成了核武器铁三角 — — 轰炸机、导弹和潜艇 — — 并于2012年测试了洲际弹道导弹，足以打击北京和上海。
en: India has deployed a nuclear triad – bombers, missiles, and submarines – and in 2012 tested an intercontinental ballistic missile, giving it the ability to hit Beijing and Shanghai.

zh: 印度几乎肯定已开始研发多弹头导弹（被称为MIRV ） ， 并且发射了卫星以协助其锁定巴基斯坦军队。
en: India almost certainly has a multiple warhead (known as a MIRV), in development, and has also launched satellites to aid its targeting of Pakistan’s forces.

zh: 在东亚，朝鲜已经成为有核国家，并马上将拥有新的铀炸弹。
en: In East Asia, North Korea has gone nuclear and is set to add a whole new class of uranium bombs to its arsenal.

zh: 它已经进行了导弹发射演习，证明了它能够在任何反导装备到达前打击韩国和日本。
en: It has rehearsed quick missile salvos, showing that it could launch attacks on South Korea and Japan before any counter-strike could be landed.

zh: 中国的和力量也在向机动导弹和潜艇转型。
en: China, too, is shifting its nuclear forces to mobile missiles and submarines.

zh: 这些武器可以在美国卫星和全球媒体的注目下进入戒备状态。
en: These weapons can be put on alert in a way that would be highly visible to US satellites and the global media.

zh: 因此，中国可以轻易地将与美国和其他国家的问题“核化 ” 。
en: Thus, the Chinese can easily “nuclearize” a crisis with the US or anyone else.

zh: 他们无需引爆核武器，只消警告对手就能大大增加政治赌注和摊牌威胁。
en: They do not have to detonate a nuclear weapon, but only alert adversaries to the dramatic increase in the political stakes and dangers of a showdown.

zh: 俄罗斯也不甘居于人后，最近进行了数十年来规模最大的核演习，以提醒世人它仍是核大国。
en: Russia, not wanting to be left out of the act, has recently staged the largest nuclear exercises in decades to remind everyone that it remains a serious nuclear player, too.

zh: 这些发展态势都很危险。
en: These individual developments are troubling.

zh: 但不能脱离它们所形成的更大的多极系统来看待它们。
en: But they cannot be understood in isolation from the larger multipolar system of major powers that is forming.

zh: 从很大程度上说，这是一个多极核系统：拥有核武器有助于一国赢得强国地位。
en: To a great extent, this is a nuclear multipolar system: possessing nuclear weapons contributes to a country’s global status as a major power.

zh: 为了理解这一点，可以考虑以下问���：美国或其他国家认真地建议伊朗签署核不扩散条约 — — 即让伊朗放弃核弹是在什么时候。
en: To see this, consider the following question: When was the last time that the US or anyone else seriously proposed that India sign the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) – that is, that India give up the Bomb.

zh: 美国经济问题重重，防务开支也将削减，而中国的实力正在崛起，在这样的环境下，这样的要求无论如何没有可行性。
en: Given America’s economic problems and looming defense cuts, as well as growing Chinese power, there is no longer even a remote possibility that this demand will be made.

zh: 印度已成为被广泛接受的合法核俱乐部成员，核不扩散条约已经成了笑柄。
en: India has become an accepted, legitimate member of the nuclear club, the fiction of the NPT notwithstanding.

zh: 要中国或俄罗斯为了无核世界销毁核武器更是不可能的任务。
en: It is even less likely that China or Russia would disarm for the sake of a nuclear-free world.

zh: 但最紧迫的问题是大国对和力量的垄断被打破，朝鲜、巴基斯坦、以色列（极有可能还有伊朗）等小国也拥有了核武器。
en: But the most urgent problem stems from the breakdown of major countries’ one-time nuclear monopoly and the empowerment of smaller countries like North Korea, Pakistan, Israel, and, quite possibly, Iran.

zh: 为了稳定新出现的核秩序，必须有新的外交、军事战略和武器控制规则。
en: A new set of rules for diplomacy, military strategy, and arms control is needed to stabilize this emerging nuclear order.

zh: 装作什么都没发生不是战略。
en: Pretending that it does not exist is not a strategy.

zh: 希腊的致命火灾背后
en: Behind Greece’s Deadly Fires

zh: 雅典 — — 上周一，阿提卡遭遇了圣经级别的灾难。
en: ATHENS – A biblical calamity befell Attica last Monday.

zh: 清晨我在雅典机场目睹了灾难的景象，当天我到那里为前往澳大利亚的女儿送行。
en: I saw its first sign in the late morning at Athens airport, where I was seeing off my daughter to Australia.

zh: 一股木材燃烧般的浓烈味道让我抬头望向天空，天空中悬挂着一轮暗淡的黄白色太阳，而我身边则环绕着如日蚀般黑暗的白昼，这样的景象只有直冲云霄的浓烟才有可能造成。
en: A strong whiff of burning wood caused me to look up to the sky, where a whitish-yellow sun beckoned, surrounded by the telltale eclipse-like daytime darkness that only thick, sky-high smoke can cause.

zh: 傍晚时分，相关消息开始大量涌入。
en: By the early evening, the news began cascading in.

zh: 我们在东阿提卡州的许多朋友和亲属的房屋被毁。
en: Many of our friends’ and some of our relatives’ houses in East Attica were destroyed.

zh: 肆虐的森林大火向人口稠密的海岸线蔓延，将马蒂和拉斐那的居民同雅典隔开，迫使那里的居民向海边逃命。
en: Forest fires had run amok, spreading toward the heavily built-up coastline, cutting the settlement of Mati and the town of Rafina off from Athens and forcing residents to flee toward the sea.

zh: 我起初了解伤亡状况时，别人在向我讲述我所在的政治运动DiEM25活动人士所处的困境。
en: I first learned of casualties when told of the plight of activists belonging to our political movement, DiEM25.

zh: 火焰吞噬了他们在马蒂的住宅，街道上的其他房屋均未能幸免；但至少他们逃脱了性命。
en: The flames destroyed their house in Mati, along with every other house on their street; but at least they escaped with their lives.

zh: 但也仅仅是将将逃生。
en: Barely.

zh: 他们隔壁的邻居丧生，当第二天早晨发现尸体时，他们蜷缩在一起，他们年仅三岁的女儿令人心碎地被拥抱在当中。
en: Their next-door neighbors perished; when their corpses were discovered the next morning, they were crouched together, their three-year-old girl in the middle of a heartbreaking huddle.

zh: 不幸的消息继续涌入。
en: And the ominous news continued to stream in.

zh: 一个朋友和她丈夫的房子被烧成了碎片，人也被报告失踪。
en: A friend and her husband, whose house is in smithereens, are missing.

zh: 我的一个堂兄弟家住在海边的悬崖上，在房子被大火夷为平地时不得不跳入悬崖下70米的礁石密布的水中；幸运的是，渔民救了他的性命。
en: A cousin, whose house sits on a cliff by the sea, had to jump 70 meters into the rocky waters below as his house burned down; fortunately, he was rescued by fishermen.

zh: 但另外26个人虽然也几乎到达了同一条海岸线，但却死于烟雾和火焰而未能跳入水中。
en: But 26 other people, who had come very close to the same coastline, succumbed to the smoke and flames before they could reach the water.

zh: 就在我写这篇文章时，官方统计已有81人死亡，而失踪人数尚无法确定。
en: As I write, the official death toll stands at 81, with an indeterminate number of people missing.

zh: 语言无法形容我现在的心情。
en: Words fail me.

zh: 这场灾难为什么会发生？
en: Why did it happen?

zh: 干燥的冬天制造了大量干燥的森林和灌木，而当有一天温度高达摄氏39度（华氏102度）而风速高达每小时130公里（80英里）时，大火开始熊熊燃烧。
en: A dry winter had produced large quantities of parched forest and bush, which, on a day when temperatures reached 39ºCelsius (102º Fahrenheit) and winds gusted at 130 kilometers (80 miles) per hour, fueled the conflagration.

zh: 但在我们这个黑色的星期一，天气再加上希腊政府和社会的长期失败将一场野火变成了致命的地狱。
en: But on this, our Black Monday, the weather conspired with the chronic failures of Greece’s state and society to turn a wildfire into a lethal inferno.

zh: 希腊战后的经济模式依赖于无所不在的无计划房地产开发（包括峡谷和松树林 ） 。
en: Greece’s post-war economic model relied on anarchic, unplanned real-estate development anywhere and everywhere (including ravines and pine forests).

zh: 这导致我们像所有发展中国家一样，在夏天很容易爆发致命的森林大火，而在冬季则很容易出现山洪暴发（就在去年冬天， 20人死于自己修建在古河道上的房屋中 ） 。
en: That has left us, like any developing country, vulnerable to deadly forest fires in the summer and flash floods in winter (just last winter,  20 people died in houses built on the bed of an ancient creek).

zh: 由于希腊政府永远缺少准备，这样的集体失败自然得到了帮助和怂恿：例如政府未能在冬季和春季清理田地和森林中逐渐积累的可燃物，也未能对居民的紧急逃生线路进行规划和维护。
en: That collective failure is, naturally, aided and abetted by the Greek state’s perpetual lack of preparedness: its failure to clear fields and forests of accumulated kindling during the winter and spring, for example, or to establish and maintain emergency escape routes for residents.

zh: 而后还有寡头政治的常见罪行，比如为了私有化海滩而将海边别墅周围的海岸线非法封闭住。
en: Then there are the usual crimes of oligarchy, such as the illegal enclosure of the coast around seaside villas for the purpose of privatizing the beach.

zh: 和我谈过话的目击者表示富人修建的海边铁丝网导致很多人伤亡惨重。
en: Eyewitnesses I spoke to said that many died or were badly injured struggling against the barbed wire that the rich had put between them and the sea.

zh: 最后，人类的集体罪行也同样重要。
en: And, last but not least, there is also humanity’s collective guilt.

zh: 这场灾难恰恰表现出快速的气候变化导致惩罚人类弱点的自然现象越来越难以应付。
en: This catastrophe demonstrates nothing if not the manner in which rapid climate change is turbocharging the natural phenomena that punish our human foibles.

zh: 就像每次森林大火肆虐希腊时一样，政府暗示存在纵火嫌疑。
en: As is often the case when forest fires ravage Greece, the government hinted at arson.

zh: 虽然我不能排除犯罪的可能性，但这样的理由并不令人信服。
en: While I cannot rule out the possibility of foul play, I am unconvinced.

zh: 希腊政府一直更愿意把责任推给奸商、纵火犯、恐怖分子甚至外国特工。
en: Greek governments have traditionally found it convenient to blame profiteers, arsonists, terrorists, and even foreign agents.

zh: 由于这种煽动性主张在新闻中占据主导地位，因此官员们不必承认他们缺乏准备，且未能采纳和执行恰当的法律和安全法规。
en: With such incendiary claims dominating the news, officials avoid having to admit their lack of preparedness and their failure to adopt and enforce appropriate laws and safety regulations.

zh: 紧缩和希腊正在经历的大萧条在应对措施的无效性方面发挥了什么作用？
en: What role did austerity and Greece’s ongoing Great Depression play in the ineffectiveness of the response?

zh: 消防部门、公民保护机构、救护服务和医院人手均严重不足。
en: Fire departments, citizens’ protection agencies, ambulance services, and hospitals are terribly understaffed.

zh: 尽管哪怕我们有三倍数量的消防人员及灭火飞机也无法阻止火灾的发生，但很难指望一个公共服务连续十年不断缩减的国家，它的社团和士气能为迎接因气候变化而进一步恶化的灾难做好准备。
en: While the fires would not have been stopped if we had three times the number of fire brigade workers and firefighting airplanes, a country suffering a decade-long diminution of its public services, its communities, and its morale can scarcely be expected to prepare itself well for a calamity made worse by climate change.

zh: 记者问我欧盟是否在提供帮助。
en: Journalists ask me whether the European Union is helping.

zh: 事实是我们在加入欧盟和将德拉克马换成欧元前后都曾发生过破坏性火灾。
en: The reality is that we had destructive fires before and after joining the EU and swapping the drachma for the euro.

zh: 欧盟在协助我们对抗火灾方面没有发挥任何作用。 这项任务不在欧盟的职权范围之内，我们也无法要求欧盟为火灾或希腊社会长达70年对自然环境的破坏承担责任。
en: The EU played no role in helping us fight the flames, a task not in its remit, and it cannot be held responsible for the fires or for 70 years of Greek society’s abuse of the natural environment.

zh: 但毫无疑问，过去十年来希腊官方债权的三驾马车 — — 欧盟委员会、欧洲央行和国际货币基金组织 — — 一直在积极剥夺希腊政府在这种情况下所必须具备的资源和能力。
en: But it is unquestionable that over the past decade the Troika of Greece’s official creditors – the European Commission, the European Central Bank, and the International Monetary Fund – has actively deprived the Greek state of the resources and capabilities it needs in such situations.

zh: 因此 ， （ 同一位记者）问我这难道不是雅典奋力反抗并要求结束威胁希腊生存的紧缩和削减开支的最佳时刻？
en: Might, therefore, this not be the moment (the same journalists ask) for Athens to rebel and demand the end of austerity and of spending cuts that are detrimental to Greece’s survival?

zh: 当然是！
en: Of course!

zh: 每时每刻都是对抗三驾马车的好机会，他们给希腊套上愚蠢紧缩及反人类社会政策的硬约束，正是这些政策在希腊造成了永久性的人道主义危机。
en: Every moment is a good moment to confront the Troika over the straitjacket of inane austerity and misanthropic social policies that have created a permanent humanitarian crisis in Greece.

zh: 过去十年来，欧盟体制所造成的悲剧比任何洪水或山火杀死的人都要多。
en: Over the course of a decade, we have lost many more people to the tragedy caused by the EU establishment than to any flood or forest fire.

zh: 2011年来已经有超过2万人自杀 ，而希腊工作年龄人口的1/10因为欧盟强加给希腊的经济萧条而移居海外。
en: More than 20,000 people have committed suicide since 2011, while one in ten working-age Greeks have emigrated because of the economic depression the EU has imposed on Greece.

zh: 我预测布鲁塞尔将为我们的火灾受害者流下鳄鱼眼泪，而希腊政府也会做出同样虚伪的姿态。
en: I expect crocodile tears to be shed in Brussels over our fire victims, and similarly hypocritical posturing by the Greek government.

zh: 但我并不认为仅仅因为近一百人在一天内丧生，就会逆转强加给希腊的有组织的反人类行为。
en: But I do not expect any reversal of the organized misanthropy afflicting Greece just because nearly 100 died in a single day.

zh: 除非并且直到欧洲各地进步人士组织起来承担起地方责任，并联合起来在欧盟层面施加压力，否则什么改变都不会发生。 但自以为是的反人类政治势力会进一步强化，比方说希腊的金色黎明、意大利的北方联盟党、德国的基督教社会联盟和另类选择党、塞巴斯蒂安·库尔兹的奥地利政府以及波兰-匈牙利的非自由联盟。
en: Unless and until progressives across Europe get organized, accept local responsibility, and band together to apply pressure at the EU level, nothing will change, except a further strengthening of proudly misanthropic political forces like Greece’s Golden Dawn, Italy’s Lega, Germany’s Christian Social Union and Alternative für Deutschland, Sebastian Kurz’s Austrian government, and the Polish-Hungarian illiberal nexus.

zh: 在这样的背景下，希腊的森林大火是对我们作为欧洲人集体责任的悲剧性提醒。
en: In this context, Greece’s forest fires are a tragic reminder of our collective responsibility as Europeans.

zh: 狂热，疯狂和金融
en: Fads, Frenzies, and Finance

zh: 巴塞罗纳－金融危机、信贷紧缩以及随之而来的经济下滑，已经严重损害了金融市场、金融机构以及交易商的信誉。
en: Barcelona – The financial crisis, credit crunch, and ensuing economic downturn have severely damaged the credibility of financial markets, institutions, and traders.

zh: 越来越多的人认为，金融市场是以非理性、泡沫、狂热和疯狂为特征的，其中的经济参与者都受到了偏差行为的驱使。
en: More and more people are claiming that markets are characterized by irrationality, bubbles, fads, and frenzies, and that economic actors are driven by behavioral biases.

zh: 乔治·索罗斯关于信贷危机的近作就是这种思维方式的一个极好的例子；他甚至提出，现在已经确立起来的金融理论都是很陈旧的。
en: George Soros’s recent book on the credit crisis is a good example of this line of thinking. He even suggests that established financial theory is obsolete.

zh: 实质上，索罗斯的观点意味着，当前的金融危机是金融市场没有有效处理信息的最终证据。
en: His view, in essence, means that the current financial crisis is the final proof that markets do not process information efficiently.

zh: 如果这是事实，那么，比起弗里德里希·冯·哈耶克（Friedrich von Hayek）的市场是一个处理分散信息的非凡机制的观点来，我们更接近梅纳德·凯恩斯（Maynard Keynes）的市场就是赌场的观点。
en: If this is true, we are closer to John Maynard Keynes’s view of the market as a casino than to Friedrich von Hayek’s view of it as a marvelous mechanism for processing dispersed information.

zh: 例如，最近油价的波动就是由期货市场的非理性狂热所驱动的。
en: For example, the recent spike in oil prices would have been driven by an irrational frenzy in futures markets.

zh: 金融市场的交易商可能有系统地误判，对他们的信息过于自信，并且对新闻反应过度。
en: Market operators would have miscalculated systematically, been overconfident about their information, and overreacted to news.

zh: 但是，我认为，对这些现象有另外一个解释，这一解释是建立在机构和交易商的合理考量和信息处理的基础上的。
en: I believe, however, that there is another explanation for these phenomena, which is based on rational calculation and information processing by institutions and traders.

zh: 我们在金融市场发现的问题和有益信息的缺乏、动机的不当以及事实上对环境的 理性 反应有很大关系。
en: The problems we see in the financial markets have very much to do with lack of good information, misaligned incentives, and, in fact, rational responses to the environment.

zh: 当信息缺乏并且分配不均的时候，价格可能就会和基本面的实际情况相差甚远。
en: When information is scarce and unevenly distributed, prices may well depart from the reality of fundamentals.

zh: 当新技术出现的时候，我们会看到这种现象。
en: We see this when new technologies arrive on the scene.

zh: 网络泡沫就是最近的一个例子，但是，在一个多世纪前的铁路建设中，也出现了同样现象。
en: The Internet bubble is the most recent example, but a similar phenomenon occurred with the construction of railways more than a century ago.

zh: 银行在最近几年里创造的复杂的贷款项目，可以认为被就像是一个新的不知名的产品，因而，人们对其的信息和支持定价的经验不足，并且很零散。
en: It can be argued that the sophisticated loan packages created by banks in recent years are, likewise, a new and unknown product, so information and experience to aid pricing has been scarce and dispersed.

zh: 在这样的情形下，价格可能和通过假设汇集所有市场信息的集体智慧所确定的基本面相去甚远。
en: In such circumstances, prices may well move far from the fundamentals as assessed by a hypothetical collective wisdom that would pool all information in the market.

zh: 当投资者决定在泡沫破灭之前“驾驭泡沫”的时候，按照价格变化趋势进行交易就变成了自我实现的理性行为。
en: Trading on the momentum of price movements may then become a rational activity that becomes self-fulfilling, as investors decide to “ride the bubble” while it lasts.

zh: 由于那些赌价格会上涨并且买入的人和那些预测价格会下跌但是因为卖空代价太大而仍然坚持的人之间的不对称，泡沫进一步被吹大。
en: The bubble is inflated further by the asymmetry between those who bet that prices will rise and buy, and those who forecast a fall, but stay out because to sell short is too costly.

zh: 这意味着，价格和基本价值重大而相对持久的偏离是可能的，并且，当信息分散时 — — 但是将价格和实际联系起来的修正总是会随之而来，更有可能。
en: This means that important and relatively persistent departures of prices from fundamental values are possible, and even likely, when information is dispersed – but that a correction to align them with reality will always follow.

zh: 最终，股票价格确实反映了经济的基本面。
en: Eventually, stock prices do reflect the fundamentals of the economy.

zh: 这解释了为什么市场可以在短期内看起来像凯恩斯所称的赌场，在长期内看起来像哈耶克所说的奇迹。
en: This explains why the market can look like Keynes’s casino in the short term and like Hayek’s marvel in the long term.

zh: 那么，这怎样解释许多机构在次级抵押风险中的过度风险暴露以及银行间市场的瓦解呢？
en: So how does this explain the overexposure of many institutions to sub-prime mortgage risk and the collapse of the interbank market?

zh: 那些选择将次级贷款证券化而不是将它们保留在其资产负债表上的银行，其行为是非理性的吗？
en: Were banks that chose to securitize sub-prime loans instead of keeping them on their balance sheets behaving irrationally?

zh: 再一次的，信息不对称和动机不当在当前的危机中处于中心地位。
en: Again, informational asymmetries and misaligned incentives are at the heart of what happened.

zh: 银行将这些贷款记在账上意味着，它将不得不满足巨额的资本充足要求，并且要自己花钱监控贷款的使用。
en: Keeping those loans on the books would have meant that a bank would have had to incur a large capital adequacy provision and monitor the loans’ performance, at a cost to itself.

zh: 银行将贷款证券化避免了这样的成本，并且在利用投资者的经验不足和信息缺乏获利的评级机构的帮助下，很容易处理这样的新产品。
en: Securitization avoided such costs and placed the new product advantageously – with the complicity of rating agencies, which stood to profit from investors’ inexperience and lack of information.

zh: 而各个机构的管理人员获得大量的奖金，股权持有人受到有限责任的保护。
en: Executives collected generous bonuses, and equity holders were protected by limited liability.

zh: 银行间市场瓦解的一个很大的可能原因正是信息失灵。
en: A probable cause of the collapse of the interbank market is precisely informational failure.

zh: 这是一个众所周知的现象；事实上，乔治·阿克罗夫（George Akerlof）因为对汽车“柠檬（在美国口语中意为次品 ） ” 市场的研究，获得了诺贝尔奖。
en: This is a well-known phenomenon; indeed the study of the market for automotive “lemons” won George Akerlof the Nobel Prize.

zh: 现在，各个银行互不信任，因为每家银行都在想对方还有多少问题没有暴露出来。
en: Banks still don’t trust each other, since each wonders how many skeletons the other has in its closet.

zh: 在这里，没有非理性。
en: There is no irrationality here.

zh: 对金融市场的非理性的争论，不仅仅是学术上的讨论。
en: The debate over the irrationality of financial markets is no mere academic argument.

zh: 如果我们认为经济参与者是非理性的，那么我们就会针对行为控制或对陷入困境的机构的援救制定家长式的政策，这是自我挫败甚至是危险的。
en: If we believe that economic actors are irrational, then we will enact paternalistic policies aimed at controlling behavior or bailing out failed agents and institutions, which could be self-defeating and even dangerous.

zh: 这样的政策可能包括对机构和个人投资的约束，以及限制或规定他们的市场行为的干预性规则。
en: This may include restrictions on investments by institutions and individuals and intrusive regulation that limits, or dictates, their conduct in the market.

zh: 呼吁遏制衍生品市场的投机以及限制卖空具有这样的意味。
en: The calls to curb speculation in derivatives markets or short sales have this flavor.

zh: 如果，在另一方面，我们认为金融市场参与者会对动机和信息作出理性的反应，那么，我们就能采取目标明确的措施 — — 包���对表外工具的限制，更严格的信息披露要求以及对评级机构利益冲突的控制，来有效地改革金融市场的监管体系。
en: If, on the other hand, we believe that economic actors will respond rationally to incentives and information, then we can usefully reform regulatory frameworks with well-targeted measures, including restrictions on off-balance sheet vehicles, tougher disclosure requirements, and controls on rating agencies’ conflicts of interests.

zh: 危机的爆发，解除和重蹈
en: Crisis, Rinse, Repeat

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 到了本世纪后期，当经济史学家将2007年开始的“大衰退”与1929年开始的大萧条相比较时，他们将得出两个基本结论。
en: BERKELEY – Later this century, when economic historians compare the “Great Recession” that started in 2007 with the Great Depression that started in 1929, they will arrive at two basic conclusions.

zh: 首先，他们会认定美联储和财政部对2007年危机的当即反应是一流的，而在1929年股市崩盘后作出的反应则是末流的。
en: First, they will say the immediate response of the US Federal Reserve and the Department of the Treasury to the crisis in 2007 was first-rate, whereas the response immediately after the stock-market crash of 1929 was fifth-rate, at best.

zh: 虽然2007~08年金融危机的后果无疑是痛苦的；但就产出和就业率的下降幅度而言它并未重蹈大萧条的覆辙。
en: The aftermath of the 2007-2008 financial crash was painful, to be sure; but it did not become a repeat of the Great Depression, in terms of falling output and employment.

zh: 另一方面经济史学家们也会指出，2007~08年后美国的长期应对手段是三流甚至更糟的，而富兰克林·罗斯福总统，国会和美联储在大萧条之后的回应至少是二流甚至是一流的。
en: On the other hand, future historians will also say that the longer-term US response after 2007-2008 was third-rate or worse, whereas the response from President Franklin Roosevelt, Congress, and the Fed in the years following the Depression was second- or even first-rate.

zh: 正是新政时期的有力政策为战后漫长繁荣期的快速和公平增长奠定了基础。
en: The forceful policies of the New Deal-era laid the foundations for the rapid and equitable growth of the long postwar boom.

zh: 现在让我们参考一些关键的经济数据。
en: Now, consider some key economic data points.

zh: 美国的人均国民收入在2006年（就在大衰退来临前）达到了一个顶峰，而2009年时的数据仍然比这一峰值要低5 ％ 。
en: US per capita national income peaked in 2006, just before the Great Recession, and was still 5% below that point in 2009.

zh: 但仅仅过了三年该数值就已经反弹到了2007年的点位。 而如果我们运气够好的话，今年的数据最终会比2007年的峰值高出8 ％ 。
en: Within three years, however, it had returned to its 2007 peak; and, if we are lucky, it will end up being 8% above its 2007 peak this year.

zh: 相比之下，美国人均国民收入在1929年到达顶峰的四年后仍然停留在下降28％的水平，并且花了整整十年也无法重回这一高峰。
en: By contrast, four years after US per capita national income peaked in 1929, it was still down 28%, and would not return to its 1929 peak for a full decade.

zh: 换句话说，至少在人均国民收入下降方面我们无法与大萧条相比较。
en: In other words, there can be no comparison to the Great Depression, at least in terms of decreased per capita national income.

zh: 而在生产率的微弱增长方面大衰退也不可能与大萧条相提并论。
en: But nor can there be any comparison to the Great Recession in terms of weak productivity growth.

zh: 在大萧条前的商业周期于1929年到达峰值后的11年中人均产出增长了11％且仍在迅速增长。
en: Within 11 years of the peak of the pre-Depression business cycle in 1929, output per worker was up 11% and still growing rapidly.

zh: 相比之下今年的人均产出仅比大衰退前的峰值高出了8 ％ ， 而且增长依旧缓慢。
en: By contrast, output per worker this year is only 8% higher than its pre-Great Recession peak, and that figure continues to rise slowly.

zh: 由此看来，在大萧条爆发后的11年中罗斯福和他的团队不但令美国的人均国民收入恢复到了之前的高点，还将每个工人的产出提高了11 ％ 。
en: So, within 11 years of the start of the Depression, Roosevelt and his team had gotten US per capita national income back to its previous peak while pushing output per worker 11% higher.

zh: 此外他们可是从1933年这个点位开始 — — 比2009年末美国政策制定者所面临的局面要差得多。
en: Moreover, they did that having started from a position in 1933 that was incomparably worse than what US policymakers faced in late 2009.

zh: 当历史学家回顾这两个时期时，他们将不得不得出结论：大衰退后的相对表现是极为糟糕的。
en: When historians look back at the two periods, they will have to conclude that the relative performance after the Great Recession was nothing short of appalling.

zh: 在为这一令人沮丧的记录追究责任时，民主党人会指出是共和党在2010年叫停了财政刺激计划并拒绝重启。
en: In assigning blame for this dismal track record, Democrats point to the fact that Republicans turned off the spigot of fiscal stimulus in 2010, and then refused to turn it back on.

zh: 而共和党人则拿出一系列令人费解且前言不搭后语的说法来解释金融危机以来的贫瘠增长。
en: Republicans, for their part, have offered a range of incomprehensible and incoherent explanations for the anemic growth recorded since the financial crisis.

zh: 一些共和党人自然而然地指责奥巴马和他那些包括2010年《平价医疗法案》和2010年《多德-弗兰克华尔街改革与消费者保护法案》等标志性的立法成就。
en: Some Republicans, naturally, blame Obama and his signature legislative accomplishments like the 2010 Affordable Care Act (Obamacare) and the 2010 Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act.

zh: 其他共和党人则会指责失业者，那些完全退出劳动力市场的人，或者那些想要工作但根本没法贡献什么价值的人 — — 所谓的“零边际产品劳动者 ” 。
en: Others blame the unemployed, those who have dropped out of the labor market altogether, or those who want to work but supposedly have nothing of value to contribute – the so-called “zero marginal product workers.”

zh: 奥巴马和他的团队当然难逃相应的责任，因为他们在复苏初期是也实施过不恰当的财政紧缩政策，但即便如此，民主党的说法还是包含更多的事实。
en: There is much more truth to the argument offered by the Democrats, even if Obama and his team also deserve a fair share of the blame for pursuing inappropriate fiscal austerity in the early stages of the recovery.

zh: 无论如何都紧缩政策不是事情的全部。
en: At any rate, austerity is not the whole story.

zh: 而当考察那些后续行动时，2007年后应对方案中最令人担忧的一面在于实施它的人及其继任者们仍然不认为该方案是失败的。
en: And when thinking about what comes next, the most worrisome aspect of the post-2007 response is that those who implemented it, and those who succeeded them, still do not recognize it as a failure.

zh: 例如，美联储的政策制定者们 — — 除了某些令人尊敬的例外者 — — 仍然坚持认为自己在当时的财政困境下已经尽力了。
en: For example, Fed policymakers, with a few honorable exceptions, still insist that they did the best they could, considering the fiscal headwinds at the time.

zh: 同样，奥巴马政府的政策制定者们仍然在为自己阻止了大萧条重演而相互道贺，并表示尽管2010年中期选举后共和党不断利用其议会大多数地位来捣乱，但自己也做出了最大的努力。
en: Likewise, Obama administration policymakers still pat themselves on the back for preventing a second Great Depression, and say they did the best they could, given recalcitrant Republican congressional majorities after the 2010 midterm elections.

zh: 与此同时，那些右派经济学家仍然忙于辩称奥巴马政府的财政政策和时任美联储主席本·伯南克的货币政策是危险的通胀伎俩。
en: At the same time, right-leaning economists still busy themselves arguing that the Obama administration’s fiscal policies and then-Fed Chair Ben Bernanke’s monetary policies were dangerously inflationary.

zh: 如果我们相信了他们的这套说辞，就会觉得自己有幸摆脱了希腊或津巴布韦的命运。
en: If we are to believe them, we should consider ourselves lucky to have escaped the fate of Greece or Zimbabwe.

zh: 但正如加州大学伯克利分校的克里斯蒂娜·D·罗玛（Christina D. Romer）和大卫·H·罗马（David H. Romer）的研究所表明的那样，二战后那些缺乏货币或财政空间去应对金融危机的国家往往会遭遇10％或以上的产出下降，甚至在危机发生10年以后依然如此。
en: But as Christina D. Romer and David H. Romer of the University of California, Berkeley, have shown, countries throughout the post-war period that lacked the monetary or fiscal space to deal with a financial crisis often suffered from output shortfalls of 10% or more even a decade after the fact.

zh: 从上次危机爆发距今已有11年了，而下一场危机的到来只不过是时间问题 — — 这个现代资本主义经济的规律至少从1825年以来就是如此了。
en: It has now been 11 years since the start of the last crisis, and it is only a matter of time before we experience another one – as has been the rule for modern capitalist economies since at least 1825.

zh: 一旦危机再度发生，我们能否有足够的货币和财政政策空间来应对以阻止长期性的产出下降？
en: When that happens, will we have the monetary- and fiscal-policy space to address it in such a way as to prevent long-term output shortfalls?

zh: 当前的政治环境可没有给人们带来多少希望。
en: The current political environment does not inspire much hope.

zh: 中美洲的失败国家
en: Failing states in Central America

zh: 当美国国防部在12月提交一份报告，指责墨西哥是存在迅速沦为失败国家风险的两个国家之一（另外一个是巴基斯坦）时，不难预料这样的结论将在许多地区受到谴责。
en: When the US Defence Department produced a report in December in which it named Mexico as one as one of two countries (along with Pakistan) at risk of rapidly becoming a failed state there was a predictable rejection of its findings in many quarters.

zh: 实际上，这份报告的作者可能分析正确，但只是搞错了国家。
en: In fact, the authors may have got their analysis right, just for the wrong country.

zh: 更靠近中美洲南部的国家 — — 特别是危地马拉 — — 可能更适合被称为失败国家。
en: Head further south to Central America – Guatemala in particular – and the failed state paradigm may be far more applicable.

zh: 如果考虑到20世纪90年代该地区民主的显著进步，失败国家的评估可能显得有些苛刻。
en: Considering the apparent progress made by democracy in the region since the 1990’s, this assessment may seem a little harsh.

zh: 但如果更深层次地审视民主的内在质量，特别是从司法和警察等国家机构的层面，情况似乎就变得不那么乐观。
en: But dig a little closer to look at the quality of democracy, above all in the condition of state institutions such as the judiciary and the police, and the picture becomes less rosy.

zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，造成局势恶化的正是墨西哥对待本国领土上贩毒卡特尔的强硬政策，贩毒团伙也因此试图把中美防御相对薄弱的国家建成自己的行动基地。
en: Ironically, it is Mexico’s hardline strategy against the drug cartels on its own territory which is making the situation worse; gangs are seeking the relative sanctuary of Central America as a base for their operations.

zh: 从危地马拉搜集的证据尤其令人忧心。
en: The evidence from Guatemala is particularly worrying.

zh: 拉美近80%运抵美国的可卡因全部途经该国。
en: Some 80% of Latin American cocaine reaching the US passes through the country at some point.

zh: 阿尔瓦罗·科洛姆总统2月声称2008年有案可查的6，200起谋杀中有40%与毒品暴力有关。
en: President Álvaro Colom in February claimed that 40% of the 6,200 murders recorded in 2008 were linked to drug-related violence.

zh: 美国和危地马拉的调查人员相信锡那罗亚和海湾集团这两个墨西哥最大的贩毒卡特尔正在把魔爪伸向各个部门，海湾卡特尔臭名昭著的武装派别 Los Zetas被指应对去年该国大量的屠杀事件负责。
en: Investigators from the US and Guatemala believe that the two biggest Mexican cartels, the Sinaloa and Gulf gangs, are spreading their tentacles across various departments; the Gulf cartel’s notorious armed wing, Los Zetas, is held responsible for a spate of massacres in the country in the past year.

zh: 许多经济学家认为近年来克沙尔对美元走强的主要原因是大量的贩毒黑钱通过危地马拉金融系统得以转移。
en: Many economists believe that a major reason for the quetzal’s strength against the dollar in recent years has been the amount of drug money laundered through the Guatemalan financial system.

zh: 较之墨西哥总统费利佩·卡尔德龙所采取的强硬策略，科洛姆似乎甘于接受失败。
en: Compared with the strong-arm tactics employed by his Mexican counterpart Felipe Calderón, Colom seems resigned to defeat.

zh: 1月有关危地马拉面对北方贩毒‘雪崩’束手无策的评论目的是争取国际支持，但对于激发对其领导能力的信心却鲜有作用。
en: Comments in January that the country was helpless against an ‘avalanche’ of drug-trafficking from the north were aimed at securing international support, but do little to inspire confidence in his leadership.

zh: 令人悲哀的现实是他说的或许没错：国家警察（PNC）的腐败臭名昭著，人员配备不足而且效率低下，就像贩毒集团一样是问题的组成部分。
en: The sad truth is that he may well be right: the national police (PNC) are notoriously corrupt, understaffed and inefficient, as much a part of the problem as the drug gangs themselves.

zh: 此外，武装部队已经退化到不成样子，到现在依然无法摆脱惨烈内战遗留下来的人权传统。
en: Moreover, the armed forces have become a shadow of their former self, and still have human rights legacies hanging over them from the country’s bitter civil war.

zh: 即便国家警察在一夜间转型为全世界最高效的打击犯罪机器，仍然不大可能立即产生重大影响。
en: Even if the PNC were to convert itself overnight into the world’s most effective crime-fighting machine, it would still be unlikely to have a significant immediate impact.

zh: 如果不对整个司法系统进行彻底的检查，任何政府措施或社会压力都不会取得明显的效果。
en: Without an overhaul of the entire judicial system, any government measures or societal pressure are not going to make much of a difference.

zh: 这在危地马拉和中美州其他国家都是现实情况 — — 唯一例外的是哥斯达黎加和巴拿马。
en: This is true as much as for the rest of Central America – with the general exception of Costa Rica and Panama – as it is for Guatemala alone.

zh: 从萨尔瓦多搜集的证据似乎能够证实这种说法：人们普遍认为萨尔瓦多警方更强大也更高效，但这个国家的犯罪率大致和危地马拉持平。
en: Evidence from El Salvador would appear to bear this point out: the Salvadoran police are widely regarded as stronger and more efficient, but crime rates remain roughly on a par with Guatemala.

zh: 在这两个国家，逃脱刑罚都是问题的关键：在危地马拉只有全部犯罪的大约4 % （ 至多）和谋杀罪的不超过2%最终获得刑事定罪。
en: In both countries, impunity is the key: in Guatemala only 4% (at most) of all crimes, and less than 2% of murders, result in a criminal conviction.

zh: 中美洲司法制度的现状是可能导致国家失败的核心问题。
en: The condition of the Central American judiciary is at the heart of the prospect of state failure.

zh: 因为脆弱、低效、腐败、政治化、不同部门间缺乏协调以及对官员的露骨恐吓，跨越地峡的司法制度一直是有组织犯罪的攻击目标。
en: Already weak and inefficient, prone to corruption, politicisation, lack of co-ordination between departments, and outright intimidation of its officials, judicial systems across the isthmus have been an easy target for organised crime.

zh: 危地马拉是到目前为止最明显的受害者，但洪都拉斯也存在同样的问题，是继危地马拉之后的下一个失败国家。
en: Guatemala has been the most obvious victim so far, but Honduras also suffers all the similar conditions to be the next in line.

zh: 迫使司法体系和其他关键国家机构屈服是毒品卡特尔的主要目标。
en: Bringing the judicial system and other key state institutions to their knees is the main aim of the drug cartels.

zh: 实际控制大片的中美洲领土和能够相对不受责罚地进行犯罪活动对贩毒业务很有好处。
en: Being in virtual control of large swathes of Central American territory and being able to act with relative impunity are ultimately very good for business.

zh: 美国可以认为在墨西哥和哥伦比亚的缉毒战争取得了部分胜利，但中美洲的危险之处在于并不具备上述国家的制度弹性，从而使开辟新战线成为可能。
en: The US may view its war on drugs in Mexico and Colombia as partially successful; the danger is that Central America does not have those countries’ institutional resilience, leaving the way open for new fronts to be opened.

zh: 除去恶劣的人文和制度影响，上述局面还破坏了中美国家政府的长期经济战略。
en: Quite aside from the terrible human and institutional impact, this situation also undermines the long-term economic strategies of Central American governments.

zh: 无论怎样，中美洲民主一直伴随着经济开放政策和吸引外资的努力，2005年《中美自由贸易协定》的签署使这种努力达到了高潮。
en: For better or for worse, democracy in the region has been accompanied by policies of economic liberalisation and efforts to attract foreign investment, culminating in the signing of the Central American Free Trade Agreement with the US in 2005.

zh: 尽管外国公司并没有成为刻意攻击的目标，但是对新发杀人案的定期新闻报导很难促成一种积极的国际形象。
en: While foreign companies have not been deliberately targeted, regular headlines of new killings hardly present a positive international image.

zh: 表面上政治稳定和有利的投资法律可能已经到位，但缺少了高效的司法或可靠的安全力量，把资金投入前景看好的项目变得困难得多。
en: On-the-surface political stability and favourable investment laws may be in place, but in the absence of an effective judiciary or reliable security forces, committing capital to promising projects becomes that much more difficult.

zh: 对局面的重大改变很难获得。
en: Significant improvements to this situation will be hard won.

zh: 中美洲政客针对暴力犯罪惯用的强硬态度实际上起不到什么作用，它对贩毒卡特尔几乎没有影响，贩毒集团掌握的资源常远远超过当地的军队和警察。
en: Central American politicians’ habitual tough talk on violent crime has paid few dividends in practice; it makes little impact on drug cartels, whose resources often far outweigh those of the local police or army.

zh: 人们毫无疑问会关注美国向安全部队提供更多的物资和技术支持 ， 《 梅里达倡议》条款规定的中美洲资金援助受到广泛的欢迎，但从全局来看可能仍然不够。
en: Attention will inevitably be focused on the US to provide more material and technical support to the security forces; drips of funding for Central America under the term of the Mérida Initiative agreed with Mexico are welcome, but likely to be insufficient in the grand scheme of things.

zh: 此外，经济低迷也为贩毒团伙的事业提供了帮助：就业机会将会枯竭，贫困将会增加，政府提供基本福利和社会服务的能力将受到考验，这使得犯罪生涯更有吸引力也能带来更多好处。
en: Meanwhile, the economic downturn is doing its bit to help the gangs’ cause: jobs will dry up, poverty will increase and the government’s ability to provide basic welfare and social services will be tested, making a life of crime all the more attractive and rewarding.

zh: 往好里说 ， 《 第二十二条军规》的涵义至少也是困难重重。
en: The possible implications of this Catch-22 are troubling to say the least.

zh: 叙利亚决议的失败
en: Failing the Syria Test

zh: 马德里 — — 10月2日，各路叙利亚反对运动在伊斯坦布尔朝着成立“叙利亚国家委员会”又迈进了一步。
en: MADRID – On October 2nd in Istanbul, Syria’s disparate opposition movements gave the go-ahead for the formation of a “Syrian National Council.”

zh: 这是这些各自为政的势力自5月份开始试图领导一场针对总统阿萨德政权的和平起义以来所迈出的最重要的一步。
en: This is the most important step yet taken by the fragmented forces that have been trying since May to lead a peaceful uprising against President Bashar al-Assad’s regime.

zh: 叙利亚国家委员会的成立鼓舞了那些一直在要求更强大、更团结的代表的人的士气。
en: The Council’s formation boosted the morale of those who have been demanding stronger and more unified representation.

zh: 但成立仅仅两天后，尚在雏形中的委员会就遭遇了第一次重大挫折。
en: But a mere two days after its creation, the embryonic Council suffered its first big setback.

zh: 法国、英国、德国和葡萄牙联合美国一起向联合国安理会递交了一份叙利亚决议草案，谴责叙利亚的镇压行为，要求叙利亚停止对平民动用武力。
en: France, the United Kingdom, Germany, and Portugal, in collaboration with the United States, presented a draft resolution before the United Nations Security Council seeking to condemn repression in Syria and put an end to the use of force against civilians.

zh: 该草案是去年6月提出的方案的糖衣版，使用了“特别措施 ” 、 “其他选择”等模棱两可的字眼。
en: The draft was a sugarcoated version of a previous text, proposed last June. This one contained nebulous terms such as “specific measures” or “other options.”

zh: 该草案强调叙利亚的主权、独立和领土完整，强调当前危机需要通过包容性政治议程和平解决，并呼吁进行叙利亚内部的国民对话。
en: It stressed the sovereignty, independence, and territorial integrity of Syria, and emphasized the need to resolve the current crisis peacefully, by means of an inclusive political process – and called for a national dialogue led from within the country.

zh: 该草案提出用30天时间来研究各种选择，而去年6月的方案只给了15天。
en: The draft called for a 30-day period to study the options, up from 15 days in the earlier draft.

zh: 目的很明确：争取俄罗斯的弃权，从而让中国也弃权。
en: The object was plain: to gain a Russian, and consequently, a Chinese abstention.

zh: 但俄罗斯和中国还是对该草案投了反对票，而整个安理会也只有9个成员国投了赞成票，巴西、印度、南非和黎巴嫩都投了弃权票。
en: But Russia and China vetoed the proposal anyway, and only nine members of the Security Council voted in favor, with Brazil, India, South Africa, and Lebanon abstaining.

zh: 安理会的投票结果具有三大影响。
en: There are three key implications of the Security Council’s vote.

zh: 首先，暴力会有所抬头。
en: First, violence will increase.

zh: 去年3月游行活动爆发以来，据估计已有2 700人丧生，超过10 000人流亡到了土耳其，另有数千人被捕。
en: Since the protests erupted last March, there have been an estimated 2,700 deaths, more than 10,000 people displaced to Turkey, and thousands more arrested.

zh: 阿萨德政府毫不犹豫地朝平民开火，包围城市，切断水电供应。
en: The Assad government does not hesitate to fire on civilians, lay siege to cities, or shut off their electricity and water.

zh: 几天前有报道称，约10 000名叙利亚士兵倒戈，其中数百人加入了自由叙利亚军（Free Syrian Army）和自由军官运动（Free Officers Movement）等运动。
en: And a few days ago, it was reported that some 10,000 Syrian soldiers had defected, with several hundred joining rival movements such as the Free Syrian Army and the Free Officers Movement.

zh: 除非国际保护介入，否则一场始于和平的运动很可能进入一个危险的新阶段。
en: Unless some international protection arrives, a movement that began peacefully risks entering a new and dangerous phase.

zh: 其次，地区安全形势也会有严重后果。
