en: Second, there will be grave consequences for regional security.

zh: 叙利亚是中东地区的战略枢纽。
en: Syria is a strategic hinge in the Middle East.

zh: 它一直以来都是反以色列最力的国家，主要通过支持哈马斯、伊朗和黎巴嫩真主党和以色列作对。
en: It has been one of the countries most hostile toward Israel, mainly through its support of Hamas, Iran, and Hezbollah.

zh: 叙利亚陷入混乱将威胁到黎巴嫩的稳定，也将改变伊朗在该地区的地缘政治影响力。
en: Chaos in Syria would threaten Lebanon’s stability and alter Iran’s geopolitical influence in the region.

zh: 由什叶派政治势力统治的伊朗也密切关注着叙利亚局势。 土耳其亦然，直到最近，叙利亚一直是该国地区政策的关键着眼点。
en: Iraq, governed by Shia political forces, also keeps close tabs on Syria’s evolution, as does Turkey, which, until fairly recently, considered Syria a keystone of its regional policy.

zh: 最后，安理会的投票结果暴露出国际社会存在明显的分歧。
en: Finally, the Security Council vote exposed a clear division within the international community.

zh: 金砖五国 — — 巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非，目前正好全部都是安理会理事国 — — 中有两国投了反对票，其他投了弃权票（黎巴嫩也投了弃权票，不过它这样做的原因是显而易见的 ） 。
en: Among the BRICS – Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, all of which happen to be on the Security Council currently – two vetoed and the rest abstained (along with Lebanon, for obvious reasons).

zh: 在此前关于军事干涉利比亚的决议中，金砖五国决定“让”卡扎菲被推翻。
en: In the case of the resolution on military intervention in Libya, the BRICS decided "to let" Col. Muammar el-Qaddafi be overthrown.

zh: 但对叙利亚就不同了，金砖五国无一与欧盟和美国站在同一个战壕里。
en: Not so with Syria, where none aligned itself with the positions supported by the European Union and the US.

zh: 要想让安理会席位达到“理想”的分配状况，其构成就不会发生重大变化。
en: The Security Council’s composition wouldn’t be substantially different if an “ideal” distribution of seats were to be achieved.

zh: 因此在叙利亚问题上无法达成一致这一事实迫使我们思考未来全球安全治理事务中会遇到哪些困难。
en: So the fact that no agreement has been reached on Syria forces us to reflect on the future difficulties that we will face in managing global security.

zh: 当然，不存在“普适”的干预模式，但决不能因此认为我们可以回避前联合国秘书长科菲·安南所大力宣扬并于2005年被所有联合国成员国所接受的“保护责任”概念。
en: Of course, there is no “one size fits all” model for intervention, but that does not justify evading our “responsibility to protect” – a fine concept promoted by former UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan and adopted by all UN member states in 2005.

zh: 支持干预叙利亚决议能够打击阿萨德的地位，让他知道他已经被其传统盟友俄罗斯和中国抛弃了。
en: Support for the resolution would have weakened Assad’s position, as it would have revealed him as isolated from his traditional allies, Russia and China.

zh: 这样做还能证明，国际社会在反对镇压和承诺保护叙利亚人民方面是完全一致的（尽管该草案并未提及任何军事干预 ） 。
en: It would also have shown the international community to be unanimous in its rejection of repression and committed to protecting the Syrian people (though the draft made no mention of military intervention).

zh: 欧盟和美国对阿萨德政府所采取的制裁措施还不够。
en: The sanctions adopted by the EU and the US against Assad’s regime are not enough.

zh: 但是，除非进一步措施在安理会���过从而获得合法性，否则要实行替代方案就会相当束手束脚。
en: But, unless further measures are channeled through – and thus legitimized by – the Security Council, other alternatives are limited.

zh: 近几年来，随着中国、印度和巴西等国家在国际事务中逐渐获得了应有的地位，G7已开始让位给G20。
en: In recent years, with countries such as China, India, and Brazil taking their rightful place on the international scene, the G-7 has given way to the G-20.

zh: 类似地，2010年通过的IMF大改革也反映了全球实力格局的变化。
en: Likewise, an ambitious reform of the International Monetary Fund was adopted in 2010 to reflect changes in the global distribution of power.

zh: 但全球治理的这一变化不能局限于经济决策。
en: But this change in global governance must not be limited to economic policymaking.

zh: 毕竟，全球化已经带来了不小的总体利益，但也不乏负面因素，比如全球安全问题。
en: After all, globalization has brought many overall benefits, but also less friendly aspects, such as the ones dealing with global security.

zh: 尽管世界各国的联系一日紧过一日，但联合国安理会并未能就叙利亚的紧急状况这样的问题达成充分一致。
en: Despite our growing interconnectedness, the UN Security Council has not yet been unable to achieve sufficient consensus to resolve pressing matters such as Syria.

zh: 加强全球治理的道路从来不是一片坦途。
en: Nobody ever said that the road to stronger global governance would be straight or simple to navigate.

zh: 但我们别无选择：除非有有效的实力结构和所有成员的真心承诺，否则全球稳定和繁荣的前景绝不是铁板一块。
en: But there are no detours: without effective structures of power and a genuine commitment from all players, the future does not look promising for global stability and prosperity.

zh: 自由移民的失败
en: The Failure of Free Migration

zh: 伦敦—法国国庆日，一位突尼斯裔法国人对尼斯庆祝人群发动了可怕的袭击，造成84人死亡，数百人受伤，该事件将极大地提振国民阵线领导人马琳·勒庞在明年春季总统大选中的支持度。
en: LONDON – The horrendous attack by a French-Tunisian man on a crowd in Nice celebrating Bastille Day, which killed 84 and injured hundreds more, will give National Front leader Marine Le Pen a massive boost in next spring’s presidential election.

zh: 凶手Mohamed Lahouaiej Bouhlel是否与极端伊斯兰教有关联并不重要。
en: It doesn’t matter whether the murderer, Mohamed Lahouaiej Bouhlel, had any links to radical Islamism.

zh: 放眼西方世界，人身、经济和文化不安定构成了一个危险的组合，并在助长反移民情绪和政治，而与此同时，伊斯兰新月地带后殖民地时代国家的分崩离析正在制造二战结束以来所未见的大规模难民问题。
en: Throughout the Western world, a toxic mix of physical, economic, and cultural insecurity has been fueling anti-immigration sentiment and politics precisely at the moment when the disintegration of post-colonial states across the Islamic crescent is producing a refugee problem on a scale not seen since World War II.

zh: 在过去30年中，自由民主社会的一个关键基本特征是对新来者的开放性。
en: In the last 30 years or so, a key benchmark for liberal-democratic societies has been their openness to newcomers.

zh: 只有顽固不化的人才看不见移民对东道国和移民本身的好处；因此，政治领导层的任务是将这样的观点排除在主流叙事之外，并为融合和吸收提供便利。
en: Only bigots could not see that immigration benefits both hosts and migrants; so the task of political leadership was to keep such views out of the dominant discourse, and to facilitate integration or assimilation.

zh: 不幸的是，大部分西方精英没有意识到成功的条件。
en: Unfortunately, most Western elites failed to appreciate the conditions of success.

zh: 民族的迁徙是人类历史的永恒特征，但只有当迁徙目的地为不太适合居住或尚需发展的领地时，才会相对和平。
en: Although the movement of peoples has been a constant feature of human history, it has been relatively bloodless only when it was into scantily settled or developing territories.

zh: 一个经典的例子是十九世纪欧洲向新世界移民。
en: A classic case was the nineteenth-century emigrations from Europe to the New World.

zh: 1840年至1914年期间，5,500万人离开欧洲来到美洲 — — 就人口比例而言，比二战以来移民规模庞大得多。
en: Between 1840 and 1914, 55 million people left Europe for the Americas – much larger, relative to population, than migration since WWII.

zh: 几乎所有这些移民都是经济移民，因为饥荒和农业萧条而背井离乡，受到免费的土地和更好的生活的感召来到新世界。
en: Nearly all the movers were economic migrants, pushed out of their countries by famine and agricultural depression and pulled to the New World by the promise of free land and a better life.

zh: 随着世界的工业化和人类足迹的遍布，移民从发达地区向发展中地区的流向发生了逆转。
en: As the world industrialized and filled up with people, the flow of people from developed to developing areas reversed.

zh: 贫困和饥荒仍然在驱使移民离开穷国；但是，如今，移民的动力不再是免费的土地，而是发达国家更好的工作岗位。
en: Poverty and starvation still pushed migrants off the land in poor countries; now, however, the pull factor was not free land, but better jobs in developed countries.

zh: 这造成了今天的紧张局面。
en: This set up today’s tension.

zh: 二战后，西方政府设计了旨在平衡移民的经济利益（廉价劳动力）和保护本国工作岗位和生活方式的政策。
en: After WWII, Western governments devised policies that aimed to balance the economic benefits of immigration (cheap labor) with protection of domestic jobs and ways of life.

zh: 比如，从1955年到1973年，西德允许1,400万“外籍劳工”入境，大多来自土耳其。
en: For example, between 1955 and 1973, West Germany admitted 14 million “guest workers,” largely from Turkey.

zh: 但是，尽管这些外国人应该在两年后回国，但在自由贸易和自由资本流动的大势面前，此类管制逐渐废弛。
en: But, though the guests were expected to return home after two years, these controls gradually weakened as part of the general movement toward free trade and free capital movements.

zh: 移民除了经济动机，一直也有其他动机：种族、宗教和政治迫害。
en: Alongside economic motives for migration there has always been another: ethnic, religious, and political persecution.

zh: 例子包括1492年犹太人被驱逐出西班牙；1685年胡格诺教派被驱逐出法国；二战后德国人和其他人被驱逐出东欧；1948年一些巴勒斯坦人被驱逐出以色列；20世纪70年代印度人被驱逐出乌干达等。
en: Examples include the expulsion of Jews from Spain in 1492, of Huguenots from France in 1685, of Germans and others from Eastern Europe following WWII, of some Palestinians from Israel in 1948, and of Indians from Uganda in the 1970s.

zh: 近几年来，难民主要因为迫害或因国家分裂导致的极端危险而逃离家园。
en: In recent years, refugees have mainly been fleeing either persecution or extreme insecurity following state disintegration.

zh: 20世纪90年代的巴尔干地区、21世纪初的阿富汗和非洲之角都是如此。
en: We saw this in the Balkans in the 1990s, and in Afghanistan and the Horn of Africa in the 2000s.

zh: 如今有五百万叙利亚人身处土耳其、黎巴嫩和约旦，这是这一模式最近也是最惹人关注的例子。
en: The five million Syrians now in Turkey, Lebanon, and Jordan are the latest and most dramatic example of this pattern.

zh: 对这类移民，到目前为止推动因素是最重要的。
en: For this class of migrant, push factors are by far the most important.

zh: 但难民和经济移民之间的界限逐渐模糊。
en: But the line between refugees and economic migrants blurs over time.

zh: 历史表明，大部分难民不会回到原来的国家。
en: History indicates that most refugees do not return to their country of origin.

zh: 极端不安全感需要极长的时间才能消除；而与此同时，更好的生活的诱惑一直存在。
en: It takes too long for the feeling of extreme insecurity to subside; and, meanwhile, the lure of a better life takes hold.

zh: 这解释了关于流行的观点的一个重要事实：大部分来到东道��的人不区分经济移民和难民。
en: This explains an important fact about popular perception: most people in the host countries do not distinguish between economic migrants and refugees.

zh: 他们大多都被认为是坐吃现有资源的人，而不是新资源的创造者。
en: Both are typically viewed as claimants on existing resources, not as creators of new resources.

zh: 东亚人在肯尼亚“非洲化”运动期间的大逃亡直接导致了1968年英国反移民立法。
en: The flight of East Asians from Kenya during that country’s “Africanization” campaign led directly to the UK’s anti-immigration legislation of 1968.

zh: 这一历史角度意味着三点。
en: This historical perspective suggests three conclusions.

zh: 首先，反移民情绪不是基于偏见、傲慢或政治投机主义。
en: First, anti-immigrant sentiment is not based only on prejudice, ignorance, or political opportunism.

zh: 反移民叙事不仅仅是社会构造（socially constructed）的。
en: Anti-immigrant language is not just socially constructed.

zh: 叙事不是“彼处 ” （ out there）事物的镜像，但与这些事物存在某些关联。
en: Words are not mirrors of things “out there,” but they have some relation to such things.

zh: 要先操纵某个东西，必须现有东西可供操纵。
en: You cannot manipulate something unless there is something to manipulate.

zh: 除非我们改变所提到的现实，否则很难改变叙事。
en: We have little chance of changing the words unless we alter the realities to which they refer.

zh: 其次，不受管制的大规模人口迁徙时代正在进入尾声。
en: Second, the era of unregulated mass population movement is drawing to a close.

zh: 英国退出投票表明，欧洲政治阶级极大地低估了跨境自由流动所造成的张力 — — 这是最大化市场资源配置这一失败的新自由主义计划的陈词滥调。
en: As the Brexit vote shows, Europe’s political class greatly underestimated the strains caused by free mobility across borders – a shibboleth of the failed neoliberal project of maximizing market-based resource allocation.

zh: 新自由主义的批评者无法一直让人口流动免于管制。
en: Critics of neoliberalism cannot consistently exempt population movements from regulation.

zh: 事实上，欧盟内自由迁徙的致命漏洞在于它永远预设了一个国家（state）去管理人口流动。
en: Indeed, the fatal flaw of free mobility in the EU is that it always presupposed a state to manage the movement.

zh: 这个国家是不存在的。
en: This state does not exist.

zh: 给予人们欧盟护照并没有让单一劳动力市场合法化，这就是欧盟内部移民“紧急刹车”无法避免的原因。
en: Giving people an EU passport doesn’t legitimize a single labor market, which is why “emergency brakes” on migration within the EU are inevitable.

zh: 第三，我们需要接受一个事实，即大部分到达欧盟的难民不会回去。
en: Third, we need to accept the fact that most of the refugees arriving in the EU will not return home.

zh: 前路艰辛。
en: The way forward is difficult.

zh: 最容易的步骤是增强选民最广义的安全，因为这类政策在政治领导人的可控范围内。
en: The easiest steps are those that increase voters’ security, in the widest sense, because such policies are within the control of political leaders.

zh: 这些措施不仅仅包括限制经济移民的数量，也包括形成充分就业和收入持续预期的政策。
en: These measures will include not just a cap on the number of economic migrants, but also policies leading to expectation of full employment and continuity of income.

zh: 只有选民的经济不安全性得到遏制，才有希望采取积极政策吸收或融合难民。 难民的数量不是西方领导人能够直接控制的。
en: Only if voters’ economic insecurity is diminished is there any hope for active policies to assimilate or integrate refugees, whose numbers Western leaders cannot directly control.

zh: 悬而未决的问题是如何遏制推动人们离开祖国的因素。
en: The unsolved problem is how to reduce those factors pushing people out of their own countries.

zh: 我们可以希望东欧 — — 或墨西哥 — — 的经济发展将让条件变得足够平等，结束从一个地区流向另一个地区的净流动；但结束来自中东和非洲的难民流的难度让人望而生畏。
en: We may hope that economic development in Eastern Europe – or Mexico – will equalize conditions sufficiently to end net flows from one region to another; but ending the flow of refugees from the Middle East and Africa is altogether more daunting.

zh: 重塑秩序和创造合法权力是经济发展的先决条件，我们不知道应该如何完成这个条件。
en: Restoration of order and creation of legitimate authority are preconditions of economic development, and we don’t know how this is to be done.

zh: 在一些例子中，这也许需要重画边境。
en: In some cases, it may require redrawing borders.

zh: 但不经历多年的战争，或知道西方如何能够减少流血，就很难实现这一点。
en: But it is hard to see that happening without years of fighting, or to know how the West can reduce the bloodshed.

zh: 对我来说，有一点似乎是肯定的：没有两端安全的增加，政治暴力将从伊斯兰世界溢出至最接近的欧洲邻国。
en: One thing seems certain to me: without increased security at both ends, political violence will spill over from the Islamic world to its nearest neighbors in Europe.

zh: 自由民主的双赢幻想
en: The Win-Win Fantasy of Liberal Democracy

zh: 华盛顿—很少有分析师预计到英国会投票退出欧盟，或者美国会选择特朗普做下任总统。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Few analysts expected Britons to vote to exit the European Union or Americans to choose Donald Trump as their next president.

zh: 但很快，人们就对这些误算的发生形成了一致解释。
en: Yet it did not take long for a consensus explanation of these miscalculations to emerge.

zh: 但是，面对如此复杂和重大的形势，我们必须小心翼翼，不能轻率推论。
en: When it comes to such complex and consequential developments, however, we should beware of facile reasoning.

zh: 目前的共识指责“精英 ” — —学术、媒体和商业精英 — — 过度沉浸在他们相对大同互通的世界中，而没有去聆听教育和互通程度较低的人民的声音。
en: The current consensus blames the “elites” – in academia, media, and business – for becoming so caught up in their relatively cosmopolitan and connected world that they failed to listen carefully to less educated and connected groups.

zh: 由于后者正是从全球化中获益最少的群体，他们也最有可能拒绝超国家制度（英国退欧的例子）和建制派候选人（特朗普的例子 ） 。
en: Because the latter groups are those that have benefited the least from globalization, they were the most likely to reject supranational institutions (in the case of Brexit) or establishment candidates (in the case of Trump).

zh: 从诸多方面讲，忽视他们是一个显而易见的错误。
en: Ignoring them was, in many ways, an obvious mistake.

zh: 这一观点有很大的价值。
en: There is considerable merit to this view.

zh: “集体思维”时不时折磨着当今金融和知识精英，包括民意调查专家，他们常常具有相近的教育背景，在一起工作，阅读同样的媒体，出席从达沃斯到阿斯彭的同样的会议和场合。
en: “Group think” regularly afflicts today’s financial and intellectual elite, including pollsters, who often have similar educational backgrounds, work together, read the same media, and congregate at the same conferences and events, from Davos to Aspen.

zh: 这群人倾向于认为他们已经汲取了历史的重大教训。
en: Members of this crowd tend to believe that they have absorbed the great lessons of history.

zh: 他们倾向于评判种族主义甚至比较温和的民族中心论，也不可能拒绝女权。
en: They tend to decry racism and even milder forms of ethnocentrism, and are unlikely to reject feminism.

zh: 尽管这些群体并非多元化的典范，但对于多元化的价值人们已经有了广泛认识，而男权主宰至少已经开始走下坡路。
en: Though these groups are not paragons of diversity, there is a widespread recognition of diversity’s value, and the dominance of men, at least, is beginning to decline.

zh: 这一群体的另一个“公分母”是财富。
en: The other common denominator of this group is wealth.

zh: 这一群体并非人人都是百万富翁，但他们确实大多具备收获经济全球化果实所需要的教育水平和技能。
en: While not all members of this group are multimillionaires, they do tend to have the education and skills needed to reap the benefits of economic globalization.

zh: 因此，总体而言他们知道最近才认识到不平等性加剧是一个大问题（尽管平心而论，许多最富有的精英对慈善前所未有地慷慨 ） ， 美国尤其如此。
en: As a result, they did not generally recognize rising inequality, particularly in the US, as a major problem until recently (though, to be sure, many of the wealthiest elites have engaged in an unprecedented amount of philanthropy).

zh: 显然，在关键领域 — — 从商业和金融到政治 — — 做出重大决策的大同论精英必须更加关注不太幸运、教育和互通程度较低的人群的怨恨。
en: It is clear that the cosmopolitan elites who are making consequential decisions in critical sectors, from business and finance to politics, must pay more attention to the grievances of the less fortunate, the less educated, and the less connected.

zh: 他们不能只和思维相近的人闭门聚会，而必须建立连接背景和条件更加多样化的人群的平台 — — 包括那些对全球化有着非常不同的体验的人。
en: Rather than congregating with like-minded people in silos, they must create platforms that connect people of more diverse backgrounds and circumstances – including those whose experiences with globalization are very different.

zh: 这些平台有助于解决公共争论的撕裂。
en: Such platforms would help to address the fragmentation of public debate.

zh: 但意识形态“泡沫”不是唯一的问题。
en: Yet ideological “bubbles” are not the only problem.

zh: 一方面，精英不但没能预见到最近的民粹主义胜利，他们也没有预见到坚定的反民粹主义者弗朗索瓦·菲永以绝对优势赢得法国中右翼共和党的总统初选。
en: For one thing, the elites have failed not only to predict recent populist victories, but also to anticipate that the decidedly non-populist François Fillon would win the French center-right Republicans’ presidential primary by a wide margin.

zh: 显然，忽视工作阶级的愤怒不是扰乱政治雷达的唯一因素。
en: Clearly, ignorance of working-class anger is not the only factor jamming their political radars.

zh: 当然，认为唯有事实被更好地了解，并且人们可以更冷静地讨论事实，选民才能更加团结，政治才能更加具有建设性，这样的信念令人欣慰。
en: Of course, it is comforting to believe that, if only the facts were better known and people could discuss them more dispassionately, voters would become more unified and politics more constructive.

zh: 但是，即使存在更好的、更加以事实为基础的讨论，人们的利益仍将趋于多元化。
en: But, even with better, more fact-based discourse, people’s interests will diverge.

zh: 支持英国退欧或特朗普的人并不只是因为无法理解全球化的真正好处；他们目前缺少技能或机会保证能够分得一杯羹。
en: Those who voted for Brexit or Trump did not simply fail to understand the true benefits of globalization; they currently lack the skills or opportunities to secure a piece of the pie.

zh: 因此，除了沟通，还有对再分配政策的真正需求，而再分配从根本上说无法双赢。
en: Beyond communication, therefore, lies a genuine need for redistributive policies, which are fundamentally not win-win.

zh: 自由贸易和技术变迁的主要受益者必须通过税收、补贴和就业支持补偿输家。
en: The main beneficiaries of free trade and technological change must actively compensate the losers through taxation, subsidies, and employment support.

zh: 类似地，认为自由民主的西方具有基本一致的经济和地缘政治利益的观点也存在根本性缺陷。
en: Similarly, the assumption that the liberal-democratic West is largely consistent in its economic and geopolitical interests is fundamentally flawed.

zh: 真相是传统西方列强尽管有诸多共同点，但在许多方面仍然是多样化的，从能源政策 — — 欧洲碳氢化合物依赖远大于美国 — — 到安全莫不如此。
en: The truth is that the traditional Western powers, despite having plenty in common, diverge in many areas, from energy policy – Europe is far more dependent on hydrocarbons than the US – to security.

zh: 在这样的背景下，仅仅加强沟通和在事实方面取得一致意见不足以促进合作协定。
en: In this context, simply communicating better and agreeing on the facts will not be enough to facilitate agreement on cooperation.

zh: 谈判仍然是必要的，双方都要做出一些牺牲。
en: Negotiations will be needed, with both sides sacrificing something.

zh: 这些问题都指向西方世界官中一个更加广泛的缺陷：信奉双赢方案。
en: Both of these issues point to a broader flaw in the Western worldview: the belief in win-win solutions.

zh: 事实上，自由民主 — — 不管以中右翼还是中左翼的面貌出现 — — 的基础是信奉双赢方案（最重要的一点是和平）从长期看有利于“社会 ” — —事实上是指全人类。
en: In fact, liberal democracy, in both its center-right and center-left incarnations, is underpinned by the belief that such solutions (the most important one being peace) can benefit a “society” – or, indeed, humanity as a whole – in the long run.

zh: 民主国家用谈判解决周折（twists and turns ） 、 管理短期牺牲。
en: Democracy negotiates the twists and turns and manages the short-run sacrifices.

zh: 但是，最终人人都能获益。
en: But, in the end, everyone benefits.

zh: 当然，不能确保双赢方案常常导致双输局面。
en: Of course, failure to secure win-win solutions often results in lose-lose situations.

zh: 在上个世纪前半叶，人们广泛认为不能征服农业领域将导致国家陷入饥饿。
en: In the first half of the last century, it was widely believed that failing to conquer agricultural space would condemn countries to starvation.

zh: 如今，类似的观点的目标变成了能源。
en: Today, similar arguments are made about energy.

zh: 现实要复杂得多。
en: The reality is more complicated.

zh: 对想要确保包容增长“赢”的经济来说，巨富人群必须遵从某种形式的监管和纳税，包括国际规则，从长期看，这将让他们付出沉重的财富代价。
en: For economies to secure the “win” of inclusive growth, the very rich may well have to submit to a form of regulation and taxation, including international rules, that cost them substantial wealth in the long run.

zh: 尽管这无法让富者沦为输家（他们仍将是富者 ） ， 但无法否认他们会蒙受损失。
en: While that would not turn the wealthy into losers (they would still be wealthy), one cannot deny that they would incur a loss.

zh: 自由民主方针确实正确的方面是几乎永远有妥协空间。
en: What the liberal-democratic approach does get right is that there is virtually always room for compromise.

zh: 尽管无法做到人人都能获得真正的赢家感，但个体和国家因为合作和形成协议而获益，比它们竭尽全力划定和捍卫有限的空间和资源时境况有所改善。
en: While not everyone will go home feeling like a true winner, individuals and countries are better off working together and striking deals than they would be if they appropriated and guarded limited space and resources by all available means.

zh: 现代冲突 — — 包括国内政治僵局 — — 的代价过于高昂，即使是最后的赢家也有可能得不偿失。
en: The costs of modern conflicts, including domestic political deadlock, are too large, to the point that even the winners end up losing.

zh: 在出现了最近的误算的情况下，我们必须校准我们的政治雷达 — — 而这意味着考虑一切潜在干扰源，而不只是符合条理的干扰源。
en: In the wake of recent miscalculations, we must recalibrate our political radars – and that means accounting for all potential sources of interference, not just those that fit a neat narrative.

zh: 在这方面，自由或社会民主与强硬空想家 — — 不管是民族主义者还是其他 — — 的世界观的根本性区别也许是最为重要的。
en: Here, the fundamental difference in the worldview of liberal or social democrats and hardline ideologues, whether nationalist or otherwise, may be the most consequential.

zh: 前者应该承认中期输赢局面，但保持对国内渐进式民主变革的长期信念，并致力于保持国际和平。
en: The former should acknowledge medium-term win-lose situations, but maintain their long-term faith in gradual democratic change at home, while working to uphold international peace.

zh: 与穷国签订公平合同
en: Fair Contracts for Poor Countries

zh: 拉丁美洲、非洲、东欧和其他地区的一些国家正在废除与跨国企业的合同或正与后者重新谈判，而其他的国家也可能步其后尘。
en: A number of countries in Latin America, Africa, Eastern Europe, and elsewhere are abrogating or renegotiating contracts with multinational enterprises (MNEs), and others are likely to follow suit.

zh: 但（这样做的）代价可能是高昂的。
en: The costs can be high.

zh: 政府虽然可能获得更有利的合同条款，但它们也可能被牵扯到国际投资争端中，从而打击投资者的信心。
en: Governments may get better terms, but they may also become embroiled in international investment disputes and discourage other investors.

zh: 对公司而言，重新谈判意味着不确定因素和对生产和收入可能被打断。
en: For companies, renegotiations mean uncertainty and possible interruptions of production and revenue.

zh: 实力（通常是商品价格变化的结果）和意识形态的转变，或项目经济效益的变化都可能导致重新谈判，特别在资源和基础设施的巨额投资方面更是如此。
en: Significant shifts in power (typically as a result of changes in commodity prices) and ideology, or changes in the economics of projects, can lead to renegotiations, especially when it comes to large investments in natural resources and infrastructure.

zh: 但通常的原因是东道国认为某项合同不公平。
en: But often the reason is that the host country considers a contract to be unfair.

zh: 虽然“公平”是个仁者见仁的概念，但在某些情况下，东道国可能没有足够的能力通过谈判获得最佳的交易—这是在跨国企业与最不发达国家（世界最穷的50个国家，大多位于撒哈拉沙漠以南的非洲）谈判时经常出现的情况。
en: While “fairness” may well be in the eyes of the beholder, in some cases, the host country may not have had the expertise required to negotiate the best possible deal – a frequent situation when MNEs negotiate with the least developed countries (the world’s 50 poorest countries, most of them in sub-Saharan Africa).

zh: Mittal’s与利比亚在2005年达成的交易（于去年重新谈判）以及与刚果的各种合同至少在一定程度上属于这一类型。 其在前苏联国家签订的合同也是如此。
en: Mittal’s 2005 deal with Liberia (renegotiated last year) and various contracts with Congo probably fall at least partly into this category, as do some deals in ex-Soviet countries.

zh: 假设需要谈判签订一项价值5亿美元的石油或铜的合同。
en: Suppose a $500 million petroleum or copper contract needs to be negotiated.

zh: 这很可能会牵涉一家领导性的跨国企业。 该企业能够组织一个由世界级的律师、地质学家和懂得诸如公司税和特许使用费之间的平衡并言之切切的分析师所参与的谈判团队。
en: This will most likely involve a leading MNE, which can field a negotiating team that includes world-class lawyers, geologists, and financial analysts who understand, for example, the trade-offs between taxes and royalties and can put them in appropriate language.

zh: 而东道国的谈判团队则不可能有这样的豪华阵容。
en: The host country, on the other hand, simply cannot match such a team.

zh: 很可能它甚至还不知道自己想从中获得什么样的利益。
en: Perhaps it does not even know what to ask for.

zh: 如此情况下签订的合同更是问题多多，因为它通常会涉及到东道国为数不多的几种重要资源之一，而该资源在相当时期里会产生比官方发展援助更多的收入。
en: The resulting contract is all the more problematic because it is likely to involve one of the host country’s few important resources, which can generate more predictable (and probably higher) revenues than official development assistance – and over a long period of time.

zh: 所以，即便在没有腐败的情况下，未来的某一届政府要求对该合同重新进行谈判也不足为奇了。
en: So, even without corruption, it is not surprising when a future government demands that the contract be renegotiated.

zh: 诚然，与跨国企业的博弈应该在同一水平上进行。
en: Clearly, the playing field with MNEs should be leveled.

zh: 从理论上讲，东道国也可以聘请自己的国际专家来协助谈判。
en: In theory, the host country could hire its own international experts to assist it in negotiations.

zh: 但穷国通常负担不起如此巨额的费用。
en: But poor countries typically lack the funds needed to pay such a team’s fees.

zh: 世界银行和区域性开发银行也没有自己的专家—或，相应的资金—来提供技术支援。
en: Nor do the World Bank and regional development banks have the in-house expertise – or, as a rule, the funds – to provide technical assistance.

zh: 但如果跨国企业为此买单呢？
en: But what if MNEs provided the funds?

zh: 显然，它们尽可能给自己争取最大的利益；但它们也想签订一份长期有效，不会让下一届政府拒绝履行的合同。
en: Obviously, MNEs want the best possible deal for themselves; but they also want durable contracts that won’t be repudiated by the next government.

zh: 因此，谈判订立一份（在外界看来也是）公平的合同是符合它们利益的。
en: So they have an interest in negotiating a fair deal, and one that is seen to be fair.

zh: 另外，在大型项目中，谈判团队的费用所占比例相对较小（或者可以由项目收入流以外的方式来报销 ） 。
en: Besides, in large deals, the negotiating team’s costs are relatively small (or they could be reimbursed out of the project’s revenue stream).

zh: 但即便是公司采取这样的方式，还是存在诸多问题。
en: But, even if a company embraces this approach, problems abound.

zh: 怎样实施而又不会有贿赂之嫌（在公司将资金直接支付给政府的情况下 ） ？
en: How can it be implemented without looking like bribery (in case the company gives the funds directly to the government)?

zh: 以及相关公司如何防止一部分资金被滥用（比如该国政府聘用了三流的团队 ） ？
en: And how can companies prevent some of the funds from being misused (say, if the government hires a third-rate team)?

zh: 这里有一个提议：在一个广受尊敬的组织监管下建立一种“投资合同援助机制 ” ( ICAF ) 。
en: Here is a proposal: an Investment Contract Aid Facility (ICAF) under the umbrella of a well-respected organization.

zh: ICAF的功能类似于一个第三方托管账户，公司将东道国雇用谈判团所需要的资金汇入其中。
en: The ICAF would function like an escrow account into which the firm pays the funds required for the host country to hire a negotiating team.

zh: 然后由账户管理人提出资质建议，甚至专家花名册让东道国定夺。
en: The escrow account manager then invites the country to select a team, suggesting what skills are required and perhaps even providing a roster of experts.

zh: 东道国可以自由选择自己的谈判团队，但必须要由账户管理人在一支由专家志愿者组成的国际顾问委员会的协助下来确认这支团队是世界级的。
en: The country would be free to choose its own team, but the escrow account manager, aided by an international advisory board of expert volunteers, would need to agree that it is, in fact, world-class.

zh: 东道国甚至还可以通过在团队中加入一两名当地的谈判专家来扩充实力。
en: One could even include a capacity-building element by adding to the team one or two local negotiators.

zh: 其结果应该是一份在同等条件下尽可能公平的合同—并且在外界看来也是如此。
en: The result should be a contract that is as fair as possible under the given circumstances – and perceived as such.

zh: 只要有一些CEO和总理们表示他们准备根据具体情况来考虑采用这一机制就足够了。
en: It would be enough for a handful of CEOs and prime ministers to say that they are prepared to consider using such a Facility on a case-by case basis.

zh: 它虽然不会终止对合同的废除和重新谈判，但却会消除一个这样做的理由，让东道国和跨国企业都受益。
en: While this would not end the abrogation or renegotiation of contracts, it would eliminate one important reason them, benefiting countries and companies alike.

zh: 气候正义之弧
en: The Arc of Climate Justice

zh: 伊斯兰堡—气候变化是一个令人痛苦的讽刺，对这个问题责任最小的人往往是受气候变化蹂躏最惨的人。
en: ISLAMABAD – It is a painful irony of climate change that those least responsible for the problem are often the most exposed to its ravages.

zh: 而最有资格声称是气候不公平受害者的国家莫过于巴基斯坦。
en: And if any country can claim to be the victim of this climate injustice, it is Pakistan.

zh: 在全球领导人准备齐聚巴黎联合国气候变化会议之际，巴基斯坦正在大洪灾过后的一地狼藉中挣扎。 洪水摧毁了房屋，毁灭了庄稼，冲垮了大桥，还夺走238人的生命。
en: As world leaders prepare to meet at the United Nations Climate Change Conference in Paris, the country is reeling from the aftereffects of devastating floods that damaged buildings, destroyed crops, swept away bridges, and killed 238 people.

zh: 这些与天气有关的悲剧对巴基斯坦来说绝不是什么新鲜事；不同之处在于它们的频繁度和猛烈度。
en: Such weather-related tragedies are not new to Pakistan; what’s different is their frequency and ferocity.

zh: 致命洪水已成为一年一遇的事件；2010年，创纪录的降雨杀死了近2,000人，令数百万人失去家园。
en: Deadly floods have become a yearly occurrence; in 2010, record-breaking rains killed nearly 2,000 people and drove millions from their homes.

zh: 巴基斯坦是全世界反恐斗争形势最严峻的国家之一，而日益“暴力”的天气正在推高粮食和清洁水的价格，威胁能源供给，破坏经济，造成严重的、代价高昂的安全威胁。
en: Even as Pakistan fights one of the world’s most pitched battles against terrorism, increasingly violent weather is pushing up the cost of food and clean water, threatening energy supplies, undermining the economy, and posing a potent and costly security threat.

zh: 毫无疑问，巴基斯坦气候混乱部分要归因于工业革命以来工业化国家向空气中排放的温室气体。
en: There is little doubt that the country’s climatic woes are caused, at least in part, by the greenhouse-gas emissions that industrialized countries have pumped into the air since the beginning of the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 即使在今天，巴基斯坦的排放量也不到世界总量的1 % 。
en: Even today, Pakistan produces less than 1% of the world’s emissions.

zh: 与此同时，巴基斯坦一直是最容易受到气候变化有害影响的国家之一，这是因为它的人口、地理和自然气候条件决定的。
en: Meanwhile, Pakistan is consistently ranked among the countries that are most vulnerable to the harmful effects of climate change, owing to its demographics, geography, and natural climatic conditions.

zh: 从1994年到2013年，气候变化平均每年给巴基斯坦带来的损失为40亿美元。
en: From 1994 to 2013, climate change cost Pakistan an average of $4 billion a year.

zh: 相比而言，2012年恐怖主义给巴基斯坦带来的损失为10亿美元左右。
en: By comparison, in 2012, terrorism in Pakistan resulted in losses of roughly $1 billion.

zh: 当巴基斯坦没有遭遇洪水时，又会受到水短缺的困扰。 据亚洲开发银行的数据，巴基斯坦是世界上水压力最大的国家之一。
en: When the country isn’t suffering from floods, it is subject to water shortages, ranking as one of the most water-stressed in the world, according to the Asian Development Bank.

zh: 气候变化让这两个问题都变得更加严重了，作为水流自然调节器的冰川和积雪日益消融，而洪水造成的日益严重的侵蚀导致主要水库淤积严重。
en: And climate change is compounding both problems, wearing away at the glaciers and snowpack that serve as natural regulators of water flow, even as increased erosion caused by flooding contributes to the siltation of major reservoirs.

zh: 与此同时，气温升高正在增加爆发庄稼病虫害的可能性，制约了农业生产率，也让巴基斯坦人民遭遇日益频繁的热浪袭击。
en: Meanwhile, rising temperatures are increasing the likelihood of pests and crop diseases, jeopardizing agricultural productivity and subjecting the population to increasingly frequent heatwaves.

zh: 海平面的上升增加了沿海地区的盐度，破坏了红树林，威胁鱼类的栖息地。
en: Rising sea levels are increasing the salinity of coastal areas, damaging mangroves, and threatening fish species’ breeding grounds.

zh: 而海洋温度的升高正在导致更加频繁和危险的气旋，威胁着巴基斯坦海岸线。
en: And higher ocean temperatures are leading to more frequent and dangerous cyclones, endangering the country’s coast.

zh: 未来前景也令人警觉：水压力恶化，暴雨山洪增加，水库枯竭。
en: The outlook for the future is no less alarming: worsening water stress, increased flash flooding, and the depletion of the country’s water reservoirs.

zh: 预测数据表明，到2040年，气温平均升高0.5℃将摧毁巴基斯坦8—10%的庄稼。
en: By 2040, projections indicate that an average rise in temperatures of 0.5º Celsius could destroy 8-10% of Pakistan’s crops.

zh: 这一负担不能完全由巴基斯坦独自承担。
en: This burden must not be left for Pakistan to carry alone.

zh: 目前，国际气候变化的进展十分缓慢。
en: Thus far, progress at international climate-change talks has been incremental at best.

zh: 化石燃料游说集团、工业化国家不肯作为的政府，以及漠不关心的选民导致减少全球温室气体排放的强大协议障碍重重，迟迟无法形成。
en: Fossil-fuel lobbies, reluctant governments in industrialized countries, and disengaged electorates have delayed and obstructed the emergence of a robust agreement to reduce global greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 但尽管人们乐观地预计巴黎能够带来遏制气候变化的突破，还必须为全球变暖成本制定平等的分配方案。
en: But while expectations of a breakthrough in the fight against climate change in Paris are optimistic, a push for equitable distribution of the costs of global warming must be made.

zh: 尽管发展中国家气候适应和减灾资金有所增加，但光从过去五年所遭受的灾难看，巴基斯坦所占比重仍然很小。
en: Despite an increase in funding for climate adaptation and mitigation in the developing world, Pakistan’s share has remained tiny, relative to the disasters it has suffered in the last five years alone.

zh: 到2050年，据联合国气候变化框架公约的数据，巴基斯坦气候变化适应年均成本将达到60—140亿美元。
en: By 2050, the average annual cost of climate-change adaptation in Pakistan will be $6-14 billion, according to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change.

zh: 减灾每年另需170亿美元。
en: Mitigation will run another $17 billion per year.

zh: 气候变化继续摧残着巴基斯坦，而巴基斯坦决不能允许它因为世界最大污染国蒙受数十亿美元的损失而得不到补偿。
en: As climate change continues to take its terrible toll, Pakistan cannot allow the billions of dollars in damages it suffers at the hands of the world’s largest polluters to go uncompensated.

zh: 不管巴黎达成怎样的最终协议，气候谈判员必须确保全球排放所孳生的损失得到公平分担，决不能只由蒙受最大伤害的国家承担。
en: Whatever the ultimate agreement in Paris, climate negotiators must ensure that the accrued losses resulting from global emissions are borne fairly and do not remain the sole burden of those suffering the greatest harm.

zh: 作为全球污染小国，巴基斯坦绝对有权利要求获得资源和资金应对并非由它所造成的问题带来的影响。
en: As one of the world’s smaller polluters, Pakistan is well within its rights in seeking resources and funds to cope with the impact of problems for which it is not responsible.

zh: 其他许多国家也是如此。
en: So are many other countries.

zh: 我们要求形成一个有约束力的国际机制，根据这个机制分配气候变化的负担，确保气候正义，这个要求巴黎决不能置之不理。
en: Our demand for a binding international mechanism to distribute the burden of climate change – a mechanism to ensure climate justice – must not go unheeded in Paris.

zh: 公平和气候变化
en: Fairness and Climate Change

zh: 普林斯顿—公平感是人类共有的，但对于具体情况而言，人们对需要怎样的公平见解不一。
en: PRINCETON – A sense of fairness is universal among humans, but people often differ about exactly what fairness requires in a specific situation.

zh: 最明显的便是关于减少温室气体排放量以避免危险的气候变化的需要的争论了。
en: Nowhere is this more apparent than in the debate over the need to reduce emissions of greenhouse gases (GHGs) in order to avoid dangerous climate change.

zh: 中国和美国是最大的两个温室气体排放国，没有这两个国家的参与，任何减排全球协议都不会有效果。
en: China and the United States are the two largest GHG emitters, and it seems unlikely that any global agreement to reduce emissions will be effective unless both participate.

zh: 但是，在国际气候谈判中，它们对各自应该做什么存在极大分歧。
en: Yet, in international climate negotiations, their views of what each should do seem to be far apart.

zh: 作为关心气候变化问题的教授，我们 — — 一位来自中国名牌大学，一位来自美国名牌大学 — — 认为看看我们是否可以就监管温室气体排放的公平原则方面达成一致是一个相当有趣的问题。
en: As professors interested in the issue of climate change – one from a leading university in China, and one from a leading university in the US – we thought that it would be interesting to see if we could agree on a fair principle for regulating GHG emissions.

zh: 我们决定使用常用的收入不平等指标 — — 基尼系数来衡量碳排放中的不平等性。
en: We decided to use the Gini coefficient, a common measure of income inequality, to measure inequality in carbon emissions.

zh: 基尼系数的下限是0，代表每个人的收入都相同；上限是1，代表一个人攫取了全部收入，其他人一无所有。
en: The lowest-possible Gini coefficient is 0, which indicates that everyone has exactly the same income; the highest-possible coefficient is 1, which indicates that a single person has all of the income and no one else has any.

zh: 显然，任何一个社会的基尼系数都落在两个极端之间，想对平等的国家如丹麦基尼系数在0.25左右，相对不平等的国家如美国和土耳其则接近0.4。
en: Naturally, all existing societies fall somewhere between these two extremes, with relatively egalitarian countries like Denmark at around 0.25, and less egalitarian countries like the US and Turkey closer to 0.4.

zh: 不同的公平原则会产��每个总体的不同的排放分布以及不同的“碳基尼系数 ” 。
en: Different principles of fairness will generate different emission distributions for each population and different “carbon Gini coefficients.”

zh: 但用1850—2050年的时间区间来计算碳基尼系数，我们可以分析历史责任原则，该原则受到中国、印度和巴西等国家的支持，考虑过去排放量对大气的影响。
en: By using the 1850-2050 timespan to calculate the carbon Gini coefficient, we can analyze the principle of historical accountability, advocated by countries like China, India, and Brazil, which takes into account past emissions that have had an impact on the atmosphere.

zh: 我们选择了三种被广泛讨论的温室气体排放量指标国家间分配方法。
en: We have selected three widely discussed methods of allocating GHG emission quotas to different countries:

zh: 等人均排放权法根据人口数量分配排放权利，但以现有全球“碳预算”为基数，即现在至2050年间不至于产生危险的、不可逆的气候变化的可排放的量。
en: The equal per capita emission rights approach allocates emission rights to countries in proportion to their population, but only for the remaining portion of the global “carbon budget” – that is, for the amount that can still be emitted, between now and 2050, without causing dangerous, irreversible climate change.

zh: （其极限通常是全球气温升高2℃。 ）
en: (This limit is usually stated as a 2oC rise in global temperature.)

zh: 等人均累计排放量法追求跨时间的公平。
en: The equal per capita cumulative emission approach seeks equality over time.

zh: 因此，它将过去的排放责任和等人均排放权相结合。
en: Thus, it combines responsibility for past emissions and equal per capita rights.

zh: 它以相等比例分配全球总碳预算，并计入已经消费的碳排放部分。
en: It allocates an equal share of the overall global carbon budget, taking into account the portion that has already been consumed.

zh: 循锚法以现有模式为排放权基础。
en: The grandfathering approach bases emission rights on existing patterns.

zh: 该机制已成为京东议定书中发达国家的实际使用方法，它要求发达国家将排放量减少相对于1990年水平的量。
en: This scheme has become the de facto approach applied to developed countries in the Kyoto Protocol, which requires them to reduce emissions relative to their levels in 1990.

zh: 因此，1990年排放量更高的国家在未来也能排放得更多（相对1990年排放量较低的国家 ） 。
en: Thus, countries that emitted more in 1990 are entitled to emit more in the future than countries that emitted less in 1990.

zh: 根据定义，第二种方法 — — 等人均累计排放量 — — 能根据各国以往所产生的气候变化效应进行完美公平分配的方法。
en: The second approach – equal per capita cumulative emissions – is, by definition, a way to produce perfect equality among all countries in the contribution that they will have made, over time, to climate change.

zh: 故它的碳基尼系数为0.
en: It thus leads to a carbon Gini coefficient of 0.

zh: 第一种方法 — — 从现在开始的等人均排放权法 — — 的碳基尼系数约为0.4。
en: The first approach – equal per capita emission rights from now on – results in a carbon Gini coefficient of about 0.4.

zh: 其中的差别表明，发达国家和发展中国家关于历史责任原则的争议大约占全球温室气体排放量的40 % （ 1850—2050年间的总发生量，且不超过碳预算 ） 。
en: The difference shows that the dispute between developed and developing countries over the principle of historical responsibility accounts for about 40% of the global GHG emissions that can occur from 1850 to 2050 without exceeding the carbon budget.

zh: 当前使用的方法 — — 循锚法 — — 的碳基尼系数最高，约为0.7。
en: The prevailing approach – the grandfathering principle – leads to the largest carbon Gini coefficient, roughly 0.7.

zh: 碳基尼系数的巨大差异表明，世界缺少关于什么才是解决全球气候变化问题的公平方法的共识。
en: These widely different carbon Gini coefficients indicate that the world lacks a common understanding of what would be a fair approach to addressing global climate change.

zh: 国际谈判的成功取决于各方 — — 以及他们所代表的人民 — — 如何看待关键的公平原则，特别是历史责任和等人均权利。
en: Success in international negotiations will hinge on how parties – and the citizens they represent – consider a few vital equity principles, especially historical responsibility and equal per capita rights.

zh: 在截至目前的谈判中，显而易见的是，长期公平问题并没有得到充分解决。
en: In the negotiations so far, it is already clear that long-term equity concerns are not being adequately addressed.

zh: 若将实际使用的循锚法包括进来，我们的碳基尼系数表明，多达70%的全球碳预算仍有待发达国家和贫穷国家争议解决。
en: When the de facto grandfathering principle is included, our carbon Gini coefficient indicates that as much as 70% of the global carbon budget is still in dispute between rich and poor countries.

zh: 如果达成名副其实的公平原则的一致太困难，那么一致认为某些碳基尼系数太过极端不可能属于“公平”可以形成最低限度的共识。
en: If it proves too difficult to reach agreement on a substantive equity principle, then an agreement that some carbon Gini coefficients are simply too extreme to be fair could form the basis of a minimum consensus.

zh: 比如，我们可以将循锚原则的碳基尼系数（0.7）与美国的基尼系数相比，大部分人认为美国的基尼系数（大约0.38）属于高度不公平范畴。
en: For example, we can compare the grandfathering principle’s carbon Gini coefficient of 0.7 with the Gini coefficient of the US, which most people regard as highly inegalitarian, and yet is much lower, at about 0.38.

zh: 另一方面，等人均年排放基于一个至少可被认为公平、碳基尼系数不到0.4的原则。
en: On the other hand, equal per capita annual emissions is based on a principle that at least has a claim to be considered fair, and has a Gini coefficient of less than 0.4.

zh: 因此，我们建议，公平解决方案的碳基尼系数应在0.0—0.4之间。
en: We therefore propose that any fair solution should have a carbon Gini coefficient of 0.0-0.4.

zh: 尽管具体数字的选择可以较为随意，但承诺气候变化问题的公平解决方案者应以这一“公平范围”为界。
en: Although the choice of a precise number is somewhat arbitrary, this “fair range” should establish the boundaries for those committed to an equitable solution to the problem of climate change.

zh: 保护移民的责任
en: The Responsibility to Protect Migrants

zh: 科克—移民面临着数不清的危险。
en: CORK – Migrants face countless perils.

zh: 各种黑道人士在边境附近肆无忌惮地抢掠，根本不顾移民的死活。
en: Vicious mafias smuggle them across borders with reckless disregard for their lives.

zh: 贪婪的蛇头将他们的所得席卷一空。
en: Rapacious recruiters fleece them of their earnings.

zh: 雇主不把他们的劳动力榨干不罢休。
en: Abusive employers exploit their labor.

zh: 此外，让他们雪上加霜的是，反移民情绪让政客不愿意直面这些挑战。
en: And, adding insult to injury, anti-immigrant sentiment erodes the political will to confront these challenges.

zh: 但是，在保护移民的福利和权利方面，我们有许多明智的实践，它们应该得到鼓励和更广泛、更频繁地实施。
en: Yet, when it comes to protecting migrants’ well-being and rights, smart practices abound – and should be promoted more widely and implemented more frequently.

zh: 近几十年来，能跟踪到的国际移民数量接近翻番，这些实践必须作为行动的参照点。
en: With the number of international migrants on track nearly to double in the coming decades, such practices must become reference points for action.

zh: 暴力冲突（比如叙利亚和利比亚）和自然或人为灾难产生的移民状况尤其悲惨。
en: The plight of migrants is particularly tragic when its source is violent conflict, like in Syria and Libya, or natural or manmade disasters.

zh: 在这些危机中，移民生命和人身安全受到了严重侵害，而这并不是因为他们自身的原因产生的。
en: In crises like these, migrants’ lives and physical safety are jeopardized through no fault of their own.

zh: 但世界仍没有明确的原则指导如何保护他们。
en: Yet the world has no clear guidelines for how to protect them.

zh: 利比亚内战使人们对移民的脆弱性一览无余，千百万人遭遇了战火。
en: Libya’s civil war placed the vulnerability of migrants in stark relief, with hundreds of thousands caught in the crossfire.

zh: 此外，与饱受战争摧残的利比亚人相比，外来工人甚至更加脆弱，因为他们被排除在以保护公民为目的的政策之外。
en: And, while Libyans were badly affected by the war, foreign workers were even more vulnerable, as they were largely left out of schemes aimed at protecting civilians.

zh: 由此带来的是移民命运的大相径庭。
en: What stood out were the very different fates migrants faced.

zh: 大部分移民必须靠自己躲避暴力，很多人在此过程中丧命。
en: Most were left to their own devices to escape the violence, and many died trying.

zh: 一些人因为被误认为雇佣兵而被杀（这主要是因为他们的肤色 ） 。
en: Some were killed after being falsely targeted as mercenaries (largely owing to the color of their skin).

zh: 不过，其他群体状况要好一些。
en: Other groups, however, fared better.

zh: 比如，受雇于西方石油公司的高技能移民被飞机转移到安全地带。
en: High-skilled migrants employed by Western oil companies, for example, were airlifted to safety.

zh: 来自有强大保护代理人和足够资金来源的国家的公民也得到了充分的撤离（菲律宾在这方面树立了榜样 ） 。
en: Nationals from countries with robust protection protocols, and sufficient financial resources, were efficiently evacuated (the Philippines was exemplary in this regard).

zh: 因此，利比亚为我们提供了生动的写照，让我们看到了在帮助移民面对威胁生命局面时各国表现的严重差异。
en: Libya was thus a vivid reminder of the serious gaps that exist in helping migrants in life-threatening situations.

zh: 移民的脆弱性因为法律地位和其他障碍而突出，比如对行使其基本权利的限制、语言障碍、移动限制和社交资本和网络限制等。
en: Their vulnerability is heightened due to their legal status and other obstacles – restrictions on exercising their fundamental rights, language barriers, constraints on their movement, and limited social capital and networks.

zh: 国际移民组织（IOM）和UNHCR（联合国难民署）以及其他许多非政府组织在保护利比亚受威胁移民方面上下奔走，成果显著。
en: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) and the UNHCR, the United Nations’ refugee agency, were heroic in going above and beyond their mandates to protect migrants at risk in Libya, as were many NGOs.

zh: 世界银行也迅速行动起来，为撤离孟加拉国公民提供资金。
en: The World Bank also acted quickly to provide funds to evacuate Bangladeshi nationals.

zh: 但光靠国际组织解决不了问题。
en: But international organizations alone cannot solve the problem.

zh: 在下一次危机爆发前，我们需要厘清各主要行动方所应扮演的关键角色，包括来源国和目的国、邻国、企业和公民社会。
en: Before the next crisis erupts, we need to clarify the critical roles that all key actors – including countries of origin and destination, neighboring states, businesses, and civil society – should play.

zh: 去年，我开始敦促国家和其他组织为针对陷入危机局面的移民的援助措施制定框架。
en: Last year, I began urging states and others to define a framework for action on helping migrants caught in crisis situations.

zh: 该框架包括一组原则，其中一项最根本的原则是：在危机期间，紧急援助应该棉线所有公民和移民，不能区别对待。
en: It would include a set of principles, such as this fundamental one: During a crisis, emergency assistance should be afforded to citizens and migrants alike, without discrimination.

zh: 我要感谢美国和菲律宾，在IOM、HNHCR和公民社会团体的紧密合作下，它们帮助发起了旨在改变陷入严重危机的移民的境况的项目。
en: I am grateful to the United States and the Philippines – working closely with the IOM, the UNHCR, and civil-society groups – for offering to help lead an initiative to address the situation of migrants caught in acute crises.

zh: 乔治敦大学和麦克阿瑟基金会也起到了不可或缺的作用。
en: Georgetown University and the MacArthur Foundation also are playing indispensable roles.

zh: 一些国家已经有了一些措施，相关方可以在危机之前、之中和之后采取这些措施使移民免受伤害。
en: Already, some countries have identified measures that stakeholders can take before, during, and after crises in order to keep migrants out of harm’s way.

zh: 在保护本国海外工人方面经验丰富的国家提供了行动蓝本。
en: Countries that are especially experienced in protecting their workers abroad offer a blueprint for action.

zh: 比如，菲律宾的早期警告系统动员政府机构快速响应危机，并成立了特别基金出资紧急撤离。
en: An early warning system in the Philippines, for instance, mobilizes government agencies to react quickly to crises, while a special fund pays for emergency evacuations.

zh: 政府还提供义务的撤离前和到达后指导，以便难民知道在紧急状况中应该怎样做。
en: The government also provides compulsory pre-departure and post-arrival orientation, so that migrants know what to do in an emergency.

zh: 注册系统，比如墨西哥的身份证系统（matricula consular ） ， 有助于确保各国了解危机发生时本国移民的为止，包括没有记录在案者。
en: Registration systems, such as Mexico’s matricula consular, help to ensure that countries know the location of their migrants – including those who are undocumented – in a crisis.

zh: 危机发生时，目的国也有同样重要的责任。
en: Destination countries have equally profound responsibilities in crises.

zh: 撤离危险区和人道援助应是人人都能获得的权利，不论其法律地位如何 — — 比如美国在去年遭受飓风桑迪袭击时做的那样。
en: Evacuation from danger zones and humanitarian aid should be provided regardless of legal status – as the United States did last year in the wake of Hurricane Sandy.

zh: 类似地，在2011年地震和海啸发生后，日本当局用17种语言广播信息，保证移民可以找到紧急服务。
en: Likewise, after the earthquake and tsunami in 2011, Japanese authorities broadcast information in 17 languages, assuring migrants that they could seek emergency services.

zh: 危机发生后，移民通常还需要紧急旅行文件和帮助他们找回遗失资产的法律援助。
en: Migrants also typically need emergency travel documents after a crisis, as well as legal assistance to help them recover lost assets.

zh: 邻国也扮演着关键作用 — — 比如保持边境开放以使移民免受困顿 — — 利比亚危机期间，埃及和突尼斯非常慷慨地这么做了。
en: Neighboring countries have a vital role to play, too – for example, by keeping borders open so that migrants do not become trapped, as Egypt and Tunisia so generously demonstrated during the Libya crisis.

zh: 与此同时，雇主也是危机期间的关键角色。
en: Employers, meanwhile, are linchpins during a crisis.

zh: 它们应该有义务遣返外国员工，菲律宾标准移民雇用合同就纳入了这项规定。
en: They should be obliged to repatriate foreign workers, as required in the standard migrant employment contract used by the Philippines.

zh: 它们也应该有不论层级的全体雇员撤离计划，而不仅限于高管。
en: They also should have evacuation plans for employees at all levels, not just executives.

zh: 我们需要帮助所有受困移民，这是不言自明的真理 — — 不仅包括受冲突和灾难影响的额移民，也包括被黑道打劫后遭到抛弃的移民，还有数不胜数的在出国后遭受多年如炼狱般生活的移民，以及数百万向奴隶一样工作的移民。
en: It should be self-evident that we need to help all migrants in distress – not only those affected by conflicts and disasters, but also those abandoned by smugglers, countless more left in limbo for years in transit countries, and the millions working in slave-like conditions.

zh: 我们在保护移民面临受威胁生命状况的原则和计划最终可以 — — 也应该 — — 予以扩大，以保护范围更广的脆弱移民。
en: The principles and plans that we put in place to protect migrants in life-threatening situations eventually could – and should – be expanded in order to protect a much broader array of vulnerable migrants.

zh: 我们不应该被移民所遭受的数不清的问题吓住。
en: We need not be overwhelmed by the dizzying array of problems plaguing migrants.

zh: 一小部分国家、专家、国际组织和公民社会精诚合作点燃的星星之火有望变成全球的燎原大火（这个模式可以应用于其他国际问题 ） ， 我们能够拿出决心一个一个战胜移民所面临的挑战。
en: With small groups of states, experts, international organizations, and civil society working together to trail-blaze solutions that might become global practices (a model that could be applied to other international problems), we can address the challenges facing migrants one by one and with the necessary resolve.

zh: 全球化时代的信仰
en: Faith in a Globalized Age

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 数十年以来，西方人都认定宗教这东西必将随着社会的不断发展而最终消亡，但事实却并非如此，因此在这个未来十年的起始之年，政策制定者们也应该认真考虑一下宗教问题了。
en: LONDON – For years, it was assumed, certainly in the West, that, as society developed, religion would wither away. But it hasn’t, and, at the start of a new decade, it is time for policymakers to take religion seriously.

zh: 世界上自认拥有宗教信仰的人正不断增多。
en: The number of people proclaiming their faith worldwide is growing.

zh: 在伊斯兰世界尤其如此。
en: This is clearly so in the Islamic world.

zh: 当欧洲国家的婴儿出生率停滞不前之时，阿拉伯世界的人口数量却将在未来十年内翻一番，还有许多穆斯林占大多数的亚洲国家的人口也在增加。
en: Whereas Europe’s birthrate is stagnant, the Arab population is set to double in the coming decades, and the population will rise in many Asian Muslim-majority countries.

zh: 而与此同时，基督教徒的数量也有所增长 — — 不过是以一种怪异的方式，以及在一些意料之外的地区。
en: Christianity is also growing – in odd ways and in surprising places.

zh: 宗教人口的最大增长其实发生在中国。
en: Religion’s largest growth is in China.

zh: 事实上，中国的宗教状况是值得仔细研究的。
en: Indeed, the religiosity of China is worth reflecting on.

zh: 中国穆斯林的数量超过欧洲，新教徒的数量大于英国，天主教徒人数比整个意大利的还要多。
en: There are more Muslims in China than in Europe, more practicing Protestants than in England, and more practicing Catholics than in Italy.

zh: 此外，最新的调查显示有1000万中国人是佛教徒。
en: In addition, according to the latest surveys, around 100 million Chinese identify themselves as Buddhist.

zh: 而儒教 — — 与其说是宗教不如说是一种哲学 — — 也深深地根植在中国人心中。
en: And, of course, Confucianism – a philosophy rather than a religion – is deeply revered.

zh: 在巴西和墨西哥都发生了大规模的福音主义运动。
en: There is a huge Evangelical movement in Brazil and Mexico.

zh: 信仰也依然是许多美国人生命中的一个重要组成部分。
en: Faith remains for many in the United States a vital part of their lives.

zh: 即便是在欧洲，信上帝的人数量依旧庞大。
en: Even in Europe, the numbers confessing to a belief in God remain high.

zh: 当然世界上还有数亿印度教徒以及依旧虔诚的锡克教和犹太社区。
en: And, of course there are hundreds of millions of Hindus and still solid numbers of Sikhs and Jews.

zh: 这些信众都在信仰的驱使下做出了伟大的贡献。
en: Those of faith do great work because of it.

zh: 非洲大概有40%的卫生服务都是由宗教团体来承担的。
en: Around 40% of health care in Africa is delivered by faith-based organizations.

zh: 大量的穆斯林，印度教和犹太教团体活跃在全球扶贫抗病阵线上。
en: Muslim, Hindu, and Jewish relief groups are active the world over in combating poverty and disease.

zh: 在许多发达国家，你会发现那些受宗教感召的人们为残疾人，垂死者，穷人和受压迫的人提供了无私的帮助。
en: In any developed nation, you will find selfless care being provided to the disabled, the dying, the destitute, and the disadvantaged, by people acting under the impulse of their faith.

zh: 基本上所有伟大的宗教都拥有同样的信条：爱你周围的人，在神面前人人平等。
en: Common to all great religions is love of neighbors and human equality before God.

zh: 不幸的是，宗教带给人们的不仅仅是怜悯和同情。
en: Unfortunately, compassion is not the only context in which religion motivates people.

zh: 它同时也会催生极端甚至是恐怖主义。
en: It can also promote extremism, even terrorism.

zh: 此时信仰摇身一变成为了某种身份定义的符号，借以反对那些没有这身符号的人，最终演变成一种精神上的民族主义，将那些拥有不同意见的人 — — 即便他们笃信同一宗教 — — 视为不信教者，视为异教徒，并因此与之为敌。
en: This is where faith becomes a badge of identity in opposition to those who do not share it, a kind of spiritual nationalism that regards those who do not agree – even those within a faith who live a different view of it – as unbelievers, infidels, and thus enemies.

zh: 这种情况自古有之。
en: To a degree, this has always been so.

zh: 唯一改变的则是全球化的压力，随着科技的不断发展，这个不断“缩小”的地球正将全世界的人们更紧密地糅合在一起。
en: What has changed is the pressure of globalization, which is pushing the world’s peoples ever closer together as technology advances and shrinks the world.

zh: 在50年前，一个孩子很少有机会接触来自其他文化信仰的孩子。
en: Growing up 50 years ago, children might rarely meet someone of a different cultural or faith background.

zh: 而如今当我置身于自己儿子的十岁生日聚会中，就会发现自己被无数不同的语言，宗教和肤色所拥簇着，
en: Today, when I stand in my ten-year-old son’s playground or look at his friends at his birthday party, I find myriad different languages, faiths, and colors.

zh: 我个人是很喜欢这一点的。
en: Personally, I rejoice in this.

zh: 但这样一个世界要求的是互相尊重而不是互相猜忌，彻底颠覆了所有的传统和旧思维，迫使我们要么自觉地去接受，或者反其道而行之。
en: But such a world requires that mutual respect replace mutual suspicion. Such a world upends traditions and challenges old thinking, forcing us to choose consciously to embrace it.

zh: 而这正是矛盾的地方：对于某些人来说，这股力量是一种威胁。
en: And there is the rub: for some, this force is a threat.

zh: 它对那些高度保守的社会造成了破坏。
en: It menaces deeply conservative societies.

zh: 而对许多笃信宗教的人来说，全球化总是伴随着令人不快的世俗主义和享乐主义。
en: And, for those for whom religion matters, globalization can sometimes be accompanied by an aggressive secularism or hedonism that makes many uneasy.

zh: 因此我们必须小心考虑宗教世界如何与全球化的强大进程实现互动的问题。
en: So we must make sense of how the world of faith interacts with the compulsive process of globalization.

zh: 但奇怪的是我们在这方面竟然只投入了非常少的政治时间和精力。
en: Yet it is extraordinary how little political time or energy we devote to doing so.

zh: 当今世界的许多冲突背后都有宗教的影子。
en: Most of the conflicts in today’s world have a religious dimension.

zh: 基于歪曲伊斯兰教义的极端主义仍在不断膨胀；事实上，只有靠宗教的方式（加上相应安全措施）才能遏制它的滋长。
en: Extremism based on a perversion of Islam shows no sign of abating; indeed, it will not abate until it is taken on religiously, as well as by security measures.

zh: 这种极端主义也正在缓慢但逐步地孕育着自己的反对力量，正如我们看到反伊斯兰政党在欧洲大选中逐渐得势，而欧洲领导人关于文化多元化的宣言都沦为废纸。
en: This extremism is, slowly but surely, producing its own reaction, as we see from Islamaphobic parties’ electoral gains in Europe, and statements by European leaders that multiculturalism has failed.

zh: 当然，从古到今，宗教从来就是政治冲突的其中一部分。
en: Of course, throughout time, religion has often been part of a political conflict.

zh: 但这不意味着宗教必须被抛弃。
en: But that doesn’t mean that religion should be discounted.

zh: 相反，需要对宗教给予特别关注。
en: On the contrary, it requires a special focus.

zh: 这一点在耶路撒冷体现得特别明显，在那里 — — 东边和西边 — — 教徒的群体都不断壮大。
en: I see this very plainly spending so much time in Jerusalem, where – East and West – there is an emphatic increase in religiosity.

zh: 而我创立信仰基金会的原因正是为了在不同信仰间促成更多的理解。
en: I started my Faith Foundation precisely to create greater understanding between the faiths.

zh: 我的想法很简单。
en: My reasoning is simple.

zh: 那些以宗教之名鼓吹极端主义的人非常活跃，有大量资源撑腰，而且无论其思想有多么保守反动，他们都很善于利用最现代化的通信和技术手段。
en: Those advocating extremism in the name of religion are active, well resourced, and – whatever the reactionary nature of their thinking – brilliant at using modern communication and technology.

zh: 据我们估计，全世界每年都有数十亿美元资金投入到宣传这类宗教观点的运动当中。
en: We estimate that literally billions of dollars every year are devoted to promoting this view of religion.

zh: 因此我的基金会拥有一个大学项目 — — 目前在九个国家的院校中推行 — — 目的就是将宗教从神学院的高墙背后解放出来，并开始研究其在当今世界上所扮演的角色。
en: So my Foundation has a university program – now underway in nine countries – that is designed to take religion out of the sole preserve of divinity schools and start analyzing its role in the world today.

zh: 我们还有另一个项目 — — 目前已经有15个国家参与其中 — — 通过互动技术将各国高校学生��联起来，让他们可以共同讨论自己的信仰以及这些信仰对自身的意义。
en: We have another program – in 15 countries, with others set to join – that links high school students across the world through interactive technology to discuss their faith and what it means to them.

zh: 我们还设立了一个行动项目，拥有不同信仰的年轻人可以通过该项目进行合作，共同提高对千年发展目标（联合国带头设立的全球扶贫项目）的认识。
en: And we have an action program through which young people work with those of another faith to raise awareness of the Millennium Development Goals, the United Nations-led program to combat world poverty.

zh: 这个基金会只是众多投身于此的组织之一。
en: We are just one organization. There are others starting.

zh: 但政府应该开始认真重视这个问题。
en: But governments should start to take this far more seriously.

zh: 由西班牙和土耳其政府共同启动的文明联盟（Alliance of Civilizations）项目就是其中一个范例。
en: The Alliance of Civilizations, begun by Spain and Turkey, is one example.

zh: 沙特国王在该领域也表现了强大的领导作用。
en: The King of Saudi Arabia has also shown great leadership in this sphere.

zh: 但这不应仅仅是把那些头面人物聚集在一起。
en: Yet this is not just about bringing high-level people together.

zh: 而必须投身到各国的草根阶层，尤其是年轻人的交流媒介中去。
en: It has to be taken down into the grassroots of nations, especially into the media of their young people.

zh: 最终，宗教领袖们都必须承担一个新的责任：全心全意地尊重那些与自己持有不同宗教信仰的人。
en: Finally, religious leaders must accept a new responsibility: to stand up firmly and resolutely for respecting those of faiths different from their own.

zh: 激进世俗主义者和宗教极端主义者是相伴而生的。
en: Aggressive secularists and extremists feed off each other.

zh: 他们确实对信仰宗教的人们构成了极大的挑战。
en: Together, they do constitute a real challenge to people of faith.

zh: 我们必须显示出真正信仰的爱心本质；否则的话，宗教将最终演变成一场斗争：极端主义者充斥着各个宗教社区，而世俗主义者则宣称这些态度就是宗教的本质。
en: We must demonstrate the loving nature of true faith; otherwise, religion will be defined by a battle in which extremists seize control of faith communities and secularists claim that such attitudes are intrinsic to religion.

zh: 这将是个悲剧。
en: This would be a tragedy.

zh: 毕竟在这个全球化时代，信仰也可以代表着理性和进步。
en: For, above all, it is in this era of globalization that faith can represent reason and progress.

zh: 宗教并不是在消亡，也不应该消亡。
en: Religion isn’t dying; nor should it.

zh: 因为这个世界其实是需要信仰的。
en: The world needs faith.

zh: 让新闻再次伟大
en: Making Journalism Great Again

zh: 牛津—在关于新闻的未来的争论中 ， “ 假新闻”是中心议题，其特色内容是一位慷慨激昂的美国总统，俄罗斯通讯“机器人 ” ， 以及为了争夺公共注意力的背叛和花招。
en: OXFORD – In the debate over the future of journalism, “fake news” has taken center stage, with storylines featuring a ranting American president, Russian communication “bots,” and betrayal and subterfuge competing for public attention.

zh: 但在这个利润节节下降、关注度日益降低的时代，假新闻真的是传统媒体所面临的最大威胁吗？
en: But in an era of diminishing profits and shrinking audiences, is fake news really the biggest threat that traditional media face?

zh: 在一个动辄需要倒吸一口凉气的新闻环境中，很难将事实和编造出来或故意留有破绽并通过社交媒体分享出来的内容区分开来。
en: In a news environment increasingly prone to hyperventilation, it can be difficult to separate fact from fabricated or deliberately skewed content shared via social media.

zh: “机器人 ” — —自动散播虚假信息的电脑程序 — — 大行其道，让边界变得更加模糊。
en: The proliferation of “bots” – computer programs that automatically spread disinformation – has blurred these lines further.

zh: 而随着操纵手段的多样化，问题还可能进一步恶化。
en: And as the methods of manipulation multiply, the problem is only likely to worsen.

zh: 但几乎一直关注着假新闻，这让许多业内人士不再主义专业新闻学所面临的严峻挑战。
en: And yet the near-constant focus on fake news has distracted many in the industry from more serious challenges confronting professional journalism.

zh: 业务模式的萧条和对第三方数字散播者 — — 如脸谱和谷歌 — — 的日益依赖，严重制约了新闻组织，也吞噬了它们的利润。
en: The erosion of business models and growing dependence on third-party digital distributors – like Facebook and Google – have handcuffed news organizations and cut deeply into their profits.

zh: 更糟糕的是，新闻受众不再信任呈现给他们的信息。
en: Worse, audiences no longer trust the information presented to them.

zh: 这表明问题不止于假新闻。
en: This suggests that the problem is bigger than fake news.

zh: 事实上，大型传统或老牌媒体组织仍然是比社交媒体更值得信任的消息源。
en: In fact, large, traditional, or legacy media organizations still trump social media as trusted sources.

zh: 路透新闻研究所（Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism）的《2017年数字新闻报告 》 （ Digital News Report 2017）揭示，40%的新闻消费者说老牌新闻组织 — — 比如《纽约时报 》 — —能准确地区分事实和虚构。
en: As the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism’s Digital News Report 2017 revealed, 40% of news consumers say that established media organizations – The New York Times, for example – accurately differentiate fact from fiction.

zh: 而社交媒体的这一比例只有24 % 。
en: For social media, this share is only 24%.

zh: 但这也意味着60%的新闻消费者认为老牌媒体对于事实并不上心。
en: But this also means that 60% of news consumers regard the legacy media as being careless with facts.

zh: 这一统计数字已足以让新闻业全体同仁感到深切的忧虑。
en: That statistic alone should be a cause for grave concern to everyone in the industry.

zh: 报告调查了36个国家的大约70,000名互联网用户，有29%的受访者说他们根本不看新闻。
en: According to the report – which surveyed some 70,000 Internet users in 36 countries – 29% of respondents said they were avoiding news altogether.

zh: 对很多人来说，这要么是因为新闻提供者偏好负能量故事，令他们心情不悦，要么是因为他们认为报道有政治倾向，因而不可信任。
en: For many, this was either because producers’ preference for negative stories put them in a bad mood, or because they viewed the reporting as politically slanted and therefore untrustworthy.

zh: 没有信任，就没有受众；没有受众，就没有生意。
en: Without trust, there is no audience; and without an audience, there is no business.

zh: 如果调查结果反映了广泛的趋势，那么全球民主最重要的支柱之一 — — 自由开放的媒体 — — 就岌岌可危。
en: If the survey’s results are representative of broader trends, one of the world’s most important pillars of democracy – a free and open press – is in jeopardy.

zh: 也许这本不足为奇。
en: Perhaps this should come as no surprise.

zh: 在数字时代，信任赤字影响着大部分重要机构，包括政党、大公司、宗教组织和大学。
en: In the digital era, trust deficits have affected most major institutions, from political parties and big companies to religious organizations and universities.

zh: 这可能表明公民变得更加知情，更加具有批判精神；也可能 — — 这种可能性更大 — — 是人们因为被选择压得喘不过气来，或因为身处复杂世界的无力感而产生的反应。
en: This could be a sign of a more informed and critical citizenry; or, more likely, it could be a response to feeling overwhelmed by choice and powerless in a complex world.

zh: 但新闻组织所面临的变化是，拜社交媒体所赐，它们不再垄断解释权。
en: But what has changed for news organizations is that, thanks to social media, they no longer have a monopoly on holding the powerful to account.

zh: 相反，它们被人们与权力等同起来 — — 成为与老百姓的关注点脱离的媒体-商业-政治精英的一部分。
en: On the contrary, they have come to be identified with the powerful – part of a media-business-political elite divorced from the concerns of ordinary people.

zh: 新闻成为汹涌民意的对象，需要自我“破坏”以重获信誉、重建受众的信任。
en: Having become a target of popular anger, journalism will need to “disrupt” itself to regain credibility and restore audiences’ trust.

zh: 在这方面，媒体组织应该至少采取六项措施。
en: To this end, media organizations should take at least six steps.

zh: 首先，新闻媒体必须制定自身的日程，而不是将资源浪费在追逐他人日程上。
en: For starters, news outlets must set their own agendas, rather than wasting resources on pursuing someone else’s.

zh: 产生了巴拿马文件（Panama Papers）和天堂文件（Paradise Papers）的国际调查便是重要且有趣的新闻的闪光的例子 — — 而重要和有趣乃是所有报道都应该达到的两个基本标准。
en: The international investigation that led to the Panama Papers and the Paradise Papers are brilliant examples of journalism that is relevant and interesting – two fundamental criteria that all reporting should meet.

zh: 其次，记者有责任替受众分析权势人物如何做，而不是他们在说什么。
en: Second, reporters have a responsibility to their audiences to analyze what powerful actors are doing, rather than what they are saying.

zh: 《华盛顿邮报》媒体专栏玛格丽特·苏利文（Margaret Sullivan）最近观察道，对美国总统特朗普的报道狭隘地聚焦于他的用词，却忽视了他的政策。
en: As the Washington Post’s media columnist Margaret Sullivan recently observed, coverage of US President Donald Trump has focused narrowly on his words, at the expense of his policy.

zh: 第三，媒体必须成为更好的聆听者。
en: Third, the media must become better listeners.

zh: 记者对“报道 ” （ reporting）和“接地气的报道 ” （ reporting on the ground）的区分突显出一个现实：相当一部分新闻工作者总是在闭门造车。
en: Journalists’ distinction between “reporting” and “reporting on the ground” highlights the reality that a sizable proportion of newsroom staff never leave their desks.

zh: 记者未必是刻意这样做；许多人离不开屏幕是因为公司缺乏资源，或强迫他们跟踪推特消息源上的报道。
en: Journalists don’t necessarily do this by choice; many are glued to their screens because their companies lack resources, or force them to follow and report on twitter feeds.

zh: 从某种程度上讲，记者的行为只是编辑方法的表征。
en: In a sense, reporters’ behavior is merely a symptom of an editorial pathology.

zh: 第四，新闻组织必须走到受众中去 — — 和他们交谈，而不是居高临下。
en: Fourth, news organizations must engage audiences – talking to them, not down to them.

zh: 通常发生的情况是，新闻圈根据先入为主地认定观众和读者喜欢什么，而不是根据他们实际喜欢什么来采取行动。
en: Very often, the news cycle is driven by assumptions about what viewers or readers might like, rather than what they actually want.

zh: 新闻室的多样化对于拓宽报道的关联性至关重要。
en: Diversity in a newsroom is vital to broadening the relevance of its coverage.

zh: 第五，一些新闻媒体急于实验新的叙事类型，忘记了自己的使命。
en: Fifth, in the rush to experiment with new forms of storytelling, some media companies are forgetting their mission.

zh: 如果花费糜巨、华而不实的项目无助于让受众更好地理解报道，就应该放弃。
en: News outlets should forego expensive, flashy projects if they do little to further audiences’ understanding of a story.

zh: 最后，重建信任需要重新定义新闻本身。
en: Finally, rebuilding trust will require a new definition of news itself.

zh: 当受众感到被信息和复杂性压得喘不过气时，他们的反应有可能是干脆不理不睬。
en: When audiences feel overwhelmed by information and complexity, the response can be to tune out.

zh: 媒体必须给人们一个重新关注的理由。
en: The media must give people a reason to tune back in.

zh: （举一个例子：正能量新闻在当今的媒体环境中被大大低估了。 ）
en: (One example: positive news is dramatically undervalued in today’s media environment.)

zh: 如果传统媒体组织任由假新闻争论来定义自己，那么它们也会被压得无法翻身。
en: If traditional media outlets allow themselves to be defined by the fake-news debate, they, too, will be overwhelmed.

zh: 只要社交媒体采用广告收入最优化的路线，它们的算法总会奖励极端，而新闻组织将把宝贵的资源浪费在打击虚假消息上。
en: So long as social media companies optimize for advertising revenue, their algorithms will tend to reward the extremes, and news organizations will waste valuable resources battling disinformation.

zh: 更好的方针是让新闻不再那么无聊。
en: A better approach would be to make news less boring.

zh: 信誉卓著的媒体公司永远在试图利用事实：独家新闻、独家采访、调查挖掘。
en: Reputable media companies have always sought to capitalize on facts: the scoop, the exclusive interview, the probing investigation.

zh: 和信任一样，真相也是商品。
en: Truth, like trust, is a commodity.

zh: 新闻业的未来取决于你能否变得更加擅长生产真相。
en: The future of the industry depends on getting better at producing it.

zh: 自由言论和假新闻
en: Free Speech and Fake News

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 去年11月美国总统大选一周前，有人在推特上发帖称，希拉里·克林顿是一个恋童癖团伙的核心成员。
en: PRINCETON – About a week before the United States presidential election last November, someone posted on Twitter that Hillary Clinton was at the center of a pedophilia ring.

zh: 有人通过社交媒体不断散播谣言，还有一位右翼脱口秀节目主持人亚历克斯·琼斯反复指控她参与虐待儿童，还指控她的竞选主席约翰·波德斯塔参与撒旦的邪恶仪式。
en: The rumor spread through social media, and a right-wing talk show host named Alex Jones repeatedly stated that she was involved in child abuse and that her campaign chairman, John Podesta, took part in satanic rituals.

zh: 在一段YouTube视频中（后来被删除 ） ， 琼斯提到“希拉里·克林顿亲手谋杀、切碎和强奸的所有儿童。
en: In a YouTube video (since removed), Jones referred to “all the children Hillary Clinton has personally murdered and chopped up and raped.”

zh: ”这段视频在大选前四天被上传至网络，并被观看超过400,000次。
en: The video, posted four days before the election, was watched more than 400,000 times.

zh: 维基解密发布的电子邮件显示波德斯塔有时会去华盛顿特区一家名叫彗星乒乓的比萨饼餐厅就餐。
en: Emails released by WikiLeaks showed that Podesta sometimes dined at a Washington, DC, pizza restaurant called Comet Ping Pong.

zh: 显然因为这个原因，儿童性团伙的指控就聚焦这座比萨饼餐厅，并采用了#比萨门的主题标签。
en: Apparently for that reason the child-sex-ring accusations focused on the pizza restaurant and used the hashtag #pizzagate.

zh: 旨在散播某类信息的机器人程序大肆转发上述指控 — — 给人留下的印象是很多民众都在严肃探讨“比萨门 ” 。
en: The allegations were frequently retweeted by bots – programs designed to spread certain types of messages – contributing to the impression that many people were taking “Pizzagate” seriously.

zh: 令人吃惊的是，迈克尔·弗林将军也转发了这则推特，而这位将军很快就将成为当选总统唐纳德·特朗普的国家安全顾问。
en: The story, amazingly, was also retweeted by General Michael Flynn, who is soon to be President-elect Donald Trump’s national security adviser.

zh: 即使在特朗普胜选后 — — 虽然谎言被《纽约时报》和《华盛顿邮报》所拆穿 — — 这则故事仍然继续传播。
en: Even after Trump’s election – and despite debunking by the New York Times and the Washington Post – the story continued to spread.

zh: 彗星乒乓餐厅经常接到辱骂、往往还带有威胁意味的骚扰电话。
en: Comet Ping Pong was harassed by constant, abusive, and often threatening phone calls.

zh: 当餐厅经理向华盛顿警方求助时，他被告知谣言是受到宪法保护的言论。
en: When the manager approached the DC police, he was told the rumors were constitutionally protected speech.

zh: 埃德加·韦尔奇是一位把圣经经文纹在背上的基督徒，也是琼斯的忠实听众之一。
en: Edgar Welch, a Christian who has Bible verses tattooed on his back, was one of Jones’s listeners.

zh: 12月4日，他从家乡北卡罗来纳驱车350英里抵达彗星乒乓餐厅，随身携带突击步枪、左轮手枪和刀具。
en: On December 4, he drove 350 miles from his home in North Carolina to Comet Ping Pong, armed with an assault rifle, a revolver, and a knife.

zh: 他让客人和工作人员离开后搜查被认为藏在隧道里的受到奴役的儿童。
en: He allowed guests and staff to leave while he searched for enslaved children supposedly hidden in tunnels.

zh: 他用突击步枪至少射击一次，目的是打开一扇被锁住的房门。
en: He fired his rifle at least once, to open a locked door.

zh: 在没有找到孩子后，他向警方投降。
en: After finding no children, he surrendered to police.

zh: 虚假消息 — — 即精心包装、看似来自严肃新闻网站的“主动误导 ” — —对民主制度构成了严重威胁。
en: Fake news – “active misinformation” that is packaged to look as if it comes from a serious news site – is a threat to democratic institutions.

zh: 还有一些不那么荒谬的例子，其中包括以色列国防部长核威胁的虚假报告 ，误导其巴基斯坦同行转发了这份报告，并警告以色列巴基斯坦同样是有核国。
en: There have been less absurd examples, including a fake report of a nuclear threat by Israel’s defense minister that misled his Pakistani counterpart into retweeting the report and warning Israel that Pakistan, too, is a nuclear power.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马总统在美国大选刚刚结束时接受德国媒体采访，承认了谣言对民主自由的威胁。
en: President Barack Obama acknowledged the danger to democratic freedoms when speaking to the press in Germany shortly after the US election.

zh: 无论假新闻是否导致克林顿在总统大选中落败，它显然可以导致候选人选举失利，并破坏国际关系。
en: Whether or not fake news cost Clinton the presidency, it plainly could cause a candidate to lose an election and upset international relations.

zh: 谣言也违背了民主体制赖以存在的一个基本前提：即选民可以在完全知情的情况下选择候选人。
en: It is also contrary to one of the fundamental premises on which democracy rests: that voters can make informed choices between contending candidates.

zh: 美国宪法第一修正案规定“国会不应制定任何法律 . . .
en: The First Amendment to the US Constitution states that.

zh: 限制言论或新闻自由 . . . ” 。 到1919年，最高法院对上述条款的解释已经树立了国会只有在构成“明确且现实威胁”的情况下才能对言论进行限制的原则。
en: “Congress shall make no law… abridging the freedom of speech, or of the press…” By 1919, the Supreme Court’s interpretation of those words had led to the doctrine that Congress could prohibit speech only if it posed “a clear and present danger” of serious harm.

zh: 这一立场在路易斯·布兰戴斯对1927年惠特尼诉加利福尼亚案表达部分赞同意见后进一步得以强化，这或许是美国法官对言论自由最有力的支持。
en: That position was further refined in what is perhaps the greatest defense of freedom of speech by an American judge: Louis Brandeis’s concurring opinion in the 1927 case of Whitney v. California.

zh: 布兰戴斯将言论和集会自由形容为“有效民主所必须的职能 ” 。
en: Brandeis described freedom of speech and assembly as “functions essential to effective democracy.”

zh: 他呼吁民众“勇敢、自力更生，对民选政府流程贯彻自由和无畏理性的能力抱有完全的信任。
en: He appealed to “courageous, self-reliant men, with confidence in the power of free and fearless reasoning applied through the processes of popular government.”

zh: ”在这样的基础上，如果某一言论构成明确而现实的威胁，并在此基础上满足启动限制规定需要满足的条件，那么上述言论必须造成直接的损害，以至于充分探讨言论内容的任何可能性都被预先排除。
en: On that basis, for speech to pose a clear and present danger that could justify prohibiting it, the harm the speech would cause must be so imminent that it could preclude any opportunity to discuss fully what had been said.

zh: 布兰戴斯坚持认为如果“有时间通过讨论来揭露谎言和谬误，通过教育来避免邪恶向前发展，那么就必须以更多言论来进行补救，而不是强制谣言散播者不许发声。 ”
en: If, Brandeis insisted, there is “time to expose through discussion the falsehood and fallacies, to avert the evil by the processes of education, the remedy to be applied is more speech, not enforced silence.”

zh: 今天，尤其在本应“由民主政府通过特定程序来贯彻执行的前提下 ” ， 很难对“自由和无畏推理”的力量抱有如此强烈的信心 — — 这个假设成立的前提条件是“自由和无畏的推理”能够影响选举进程。
en: Today, it is difficult to have so much confidence in the power of “free and fearless reasoning,” especially if it is supposed to be “applied through the processes of popular government” – which presumably requires that it influence elections.

zh: 同样，布兰戴斯认定“更多讨论、而非强制沉默”是“虚假和谬误”的补救办法看上去也非常天真，尤其如果适用于竞选活动中。
en: Similarly, Brandeis’s belief that “more speech, not enforced silence” is the remedy for “falsehood and fallacies” looks naïve, especially if applied in an election campaign.

zh: 那么，还有哪些可以采纳的替代方法？
en: What, though, is the alternative?

zh: 琼斯对克林顿的言论无疑涉及诽谤，她可以对他提出民事诉讼；但那种方法注定耗时、昂贵，法院审理很有可能要历时数年才能完成。
en: What Jones said about Clinton is surely defamation, and she could bring a civil suit against him; but that would be costly and time-consuming, most likely taking years to move through the courts.

zh: 无论如何，民事诽谤诉讼仅对那些有财力支付判决赔偿的人才有效。
en: In any case, civil defamation lawsuits are effective only against those who have the assets to pay whatever damages are awarded.

zh: 那么诽谤罪怎样？
en: What about criminal libel?

zh: 在英国 ， “ 诽谤”几百年来都属于刑事犯罪，但后来却逐渐停用并于2010年被彻底取消。
en: In the United Kingdom, “defamatory libel” was for many centuries a criminal offense, but it fell into disuse and was abolished in 2010.

zh: 在美国，刑事诽谤不属于联邦犯罪之列。
en: In the US, criminal libel is not a federal offense.

zh: 某些州仍将诽谤列为刑事犯罪，但实际审理诽谤案件的情况却少之又少。
en: It continues to be a crime in some states, but few cases are brought.

zh: 2015年杰伊·瓦格纳和安托尼·法格为国际新闻研究所提交的一份报告用“琐碎”来形容许多近期案例，并把民事诽谤法视为发泄“个人不满”的渠道。
en: A report in 2015 by A. Jay Wagner and Anthony L. Fargo for the International Press Institute describes many of the recent cases as “petty” and regards the civil libel law as a better recourse for “personal grievances.”

zh: 该报告认定刑事诽谤罪已经变得“多余和没有必要 ” 。
en: The report concludes that criminal libel has become “redundant and unnecessary.”

zh: 近期的假新闻事例表明瓦格纳和法戈的结论为时过早。
en: Recent examples of fake news suggest that Wagner and Fargo’s conclusion was premature.

zh: 在大选期间指责一位美国总统候选人亲手杀害儿童绝非小事，而民事诽谤法没有提供任何充分的补救。
en: To accuse, during an election campaign, a US presidential candidate of personally murdering children is not petty, and civil libel law provides no adequate remedy.

zh: 在互联网时代里，法律的钟摆再次回归刑事诽谤罪的时机是否已经成熟？
en: In the Internet age, is it time for the legal pendulum to swing back toward the offense of criminal libel?

zh: 假新闻和有偏见的新闻
en: Fake News and Biased News

zh: 东京—访谈就是防不胜防。
en: TOKYO – Interviews are always tricky.

zh: 如果一位“无良”访问者想要挖掘某个答案或观点，他完全有权力去编辑、操纵甚至改写访问对象的话。
en: If an unscrupulous interviewer is looking for a particular answer or claim, they have the power to edit, manipulate, or even rewrite their subject’s words to that end.

zh: 正因如此，我一直会仔细阅读我被媒体引用的言辞。
en: That is why I have long taken pains to check carefully quotations attributed to me by the media.

zh: 但对于电视或广播采访，我认为这样的扭曲会比较困难。
en: But, when it comes to television or radio interviews, it seemed to me that such distortions would be more difficult to pull off.

zh: 我错了。
en: I was wrong.

zh: 不久前，一位日本某电视节目的代表要求采访我。 这个节目与一家偏自由派立场的报纸有关，采访的内容是首相安倍晋三的经济改革战略，即“安倍经济学 ” 。
en: Not long ago, representatives from a Japanese television program associated with a liberal-leaning newspaper requested an interview with me to discuss Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s economic-reform strategy, known as “Abenomics.”

zh: 我被采访了大约一个小时，我的回答被做进了在工作室录制的一期专家讨论中。
en: I was interviewed for about an hour, with my answers to be included in an episode centered on a panel discussion held in the studio.

zh: 结果和我预想的不一样。
en: The result was not what I expected.

zh: 平心而论，对于讨论组成员否认安倍经济学的最新成果、持有货币政策无法提振经济，反而可能突然引起恶性通胀的奇怪观点，我并不是十分震惊。
en: To be sure, I wasn’t entirely shocked to find that the panelists denied the recent achievements of Abenomics and espoused the strange view that monetary policy cannot boost an economy, and yet can suddenly cause hyperinflation.

zh: 这样的论调由来已久，尽管货币政策驱动的低通胀复苏在美国、欧洲和日本进行的十分良好。
en: Such claims have persisted, despite the ongoing monetary-policy-driven, low-inflation recoveries in the United States, Europe, and Japan.

zh: 但节目严重扭曲了我的原话。
en: But the distortion of my own words was significant.

zh: 在我的采访中，我强调了安倍经济学的成功之处。
en: In my interview, I highlighted the successes of Abenomics.

zh: 我指出，劳动力市场的强势和企业利润的上升都是安倍经济学的未竟的遗产，尽管安倍政府面临了政治挑战。
en: And I argued that a strong labor market and rising business profits would be among Abenomics’ enduring legacies, even if Abe’s administration faced political challenges.

zh: 节目却只播出了我两分钟的采访，强调了潜在政治挑战的部分而不是安倍经济学的巨大成功。
en: The program included just two minutes of my interview, emphasizing the part about the potential political challenges, rather than Abenomics’ great successes.

zh: 近几年来，人们大量关注“假新闻 ” — —即传播广泛的完全错误的信息，它们通常通过社交媒体或其他在线平台传播。
en: In recent years, much attention has been devoted to “fake news” – outright disinformation that spreads widely, often through social media or other online platforms.

zh: 但我的最近经验突显出另一种危险：有偏见的新闻，即策略性地编辑新闻，从而支持记者、编辑或节目制作者的观点。
en: But my recent experience highlighted another danger: biased news, in which strategic edits surreptitiously advance the views of a journalist, editor, or broadcaster.

zh: 这类报道甚至可能由传统新闻组织制作，它们可能造成巨大的破坏性，至少对政治领导人是如此。
en: Such reporting, which may be delivered even by traditional news organizations, can be very damaging, not least for political leaders.

zh: 毫无疑问，安倍的政治立场很容易受到有偏见的新闻的影响。
en: Without a doubt, Abe’s political standing has been vulnerable to the effects of biased journalism.

zh: 比如，接个月前，安倍在东京秋叶原区的群众集会上发表演讲。
en: For example, several months ago, Abe was addressing a crowd gathered in Akihabara, a district of Tokyo.

zh: 一些听众显然是为了捣乱，不断地发出嘘声和刁难。
en: A number of attendees, in a clear attempt to sabotage his speech, booed and heckled relentlessly.

zh: 最后，安倍大喊道 ： “ 我不是为向你们这样瞎嚷嚷的群众演讲的！
en: Eventually, Abe shouted, “I am not addressing a crowd shouting like you!”

zh: ”第二天，他的这番话被广泛报道；但听众的行为只字未提，让读者产生了首相完全是主动向日本公民爆粗口的印象。
en: The next day, his words were reported widely; the behavior of the crowd, however, was not, leaving readers with the impression that their prime minister had, completely unprompted, yelled coarsely at Japanese citizens.

zh: 类似的扭曲也出现在对日本众议院调查指控听证会的报道中。 指控来自前文部科学事务次官前川喜平（Kihei Maekawa ） ， 说安倍操纵了一所由其密友主持的大学新设兽医系的决策过程。
en: Similar distortions characterized accounts of hearings in Japan’s Diet to investigate allegations, originally made by former Vice Minister of Education and Science Kihei Maekawa, that Abe rigged the decision-making process behind the opening of a new veterinary department at a university run by a close friend of his.

zh: 不但安倍本人否认了指控，前大阪大学教授八田达夫（<>Tatsuo Hatta）和前爱媛县知事加户守行（Moriyuki Kato）也作证整个决策过程是公平合法的。
en: Not only did Abe himself deny the accusations; Tatsuo Hatta, formerly of Osaka University, and Moriyuki Kato, former Governor of Ehime Prefecture, testified that the process had been conducted fairly and lawfully.

zh: 但许多媒体组织，包括两家大报《朝日新闻》和《每日新闻》持续报道着所谓的丑闻 — — 对八田和加户的证词只字不提，而对前川的指控长篇累牍地报道。
en: Yet many media organizations, including two leading newspapers, Asahi and Mainichi, continued to report on the supposed scandal – leaving out the testimony of Hatta and Kato, while providing an extensive account of Maekawa’s accusations.

zh: 这类有偏见的报道可以轻易地让选民反对领导人。
en: Such biased reporting can easily turn voters against a leader.

zh: 对日本来说，幸运的是选民没有被骗。
en: Fortunately for Japan, its voters have not been duped.

zh: 安倍刚刚在10月22日举行的大选中赢得压倒性胜利，轻松让其执政联盟重新掌权。
en: Abe just scored a landslide victory in the general election on October 22, easily returning his ruling coalition to power.

zh: 相反，在美国，有偏见的新闻报道，特别是社交媒体上的报道，对选民产生了强大的影响，也让政治极化达到了前所未有的程度。
