en: Now, climate change is set to add a fresh layer of risk to their lives.

zh: 未来几十年中的升温将导致农业大崩坏，特别是在热带地区。
en: Rising temperatures in the decades ahead will lead to major disruptions in agriculture, particularly in tropical zones.

zh: 庄稼将因为降雨过少或过多而无法生长。
en: Crops won’t grow because of too little rain or too much rain.

zh: 病虫害将因为更温暖的气候而大量繁殖，毁坏庄稼。
en: Pests will thrive in the warmer climate and destroy crops.

zh: 富裕国家的农民也将经历变化。
en: Farmers in wealthier countries will experience changes, too.

zh: 但他们有工具和支持管理这些风险。
en: But they have the tools and supports to manage these risks.

zh: 世界最穷农民日夜劳作，最后常常颗粒无收。
en: The world’s poorest farmers show up for work each day for the most part empty-handed.

zh: 因此，在全部将因为气候变化而遭罪的人中，他们所遭的罪最严重。
en: That’s why of all the people who will suffer from climate change, they are likely to suffer the most.

zh: 贫穷农民将感受到这些变化的痛处，而与此同时，世界需要他们养活日益增长的人口。
en: Poor farmers will feel the sting of these changes at the same time the world needs their help to feed a growing population.

zh: 到2050年，全球粮食需求预计将增加60 % 。
en: By 2050, global food demand is expected to increase by 60%.

zh: 收成的减少将制约全球粮食系统，增加饥饿，扼杀过去半个多世纪以来世界在减少贫困方面所取得的巨大进步。
en: Declining harvests would strain the global food system, increasing hunger and eroding the tremendous progress the world has made against poverty over the last half-century.

zh: 我很乐观地认为，我们能够避免气候变化最糟糕的影响并养活世界 — — 如果我们现在就行动起来。
en: I’m optimistic that we can avoid the worst impacts of climate change and feed the world – if we act now.

zh: 我们急切地需要政府投资于能大量减少温室气体排放、停止气温上升的新清洁能源创新。
en: There’s an urgent need for governments to invest in new clean-energy innovations that will dramatically reduce greenhouse-gas emissions and halt rising temperatures.

zh: 与此同时，我们需要认识到，阻止所有气温上升带来的影响已经太晚了。
en: At the same time, we need to recognize that it’s already too late to stop all of the impacts of hotter temperatures.

zh: 即使世界下周就发现一种廉价清洁的能���资源，也需要时间改变化石燃料供能习惯，走向无碳未来。
en: Even if the world discovered a cheap, clean energy source next week, it would take time for it to kick its fossil fuel-powered habits and shift to a carbon-free future.

zh: 因此，世界投资于帮助最贫穷人口适应这一新变化是至关重要的。
en: That’s why it’s critical for the world to invest in efforts to help the poorest adapt.

zh: 他们所需要的很多工具十分基本 — — 只要想种更多粮食、挣更多收入就必须用到这些工具：融资渠道、改良的种子、肥料、培训和出售庄稼的市场。
en: Many of the tools they’ll need are quite basic – things that they need anyway to grow more food and earn more income: access to financing, better seeds, fertilizer, training, and markets where they can sell what they grow.

zh: 其他工具则是新工具，专为满足气候变化的需要。
en: Other tools are new and tailored to the demands of a changing climate.

zh: 盖茨基金会及其合作伙伴合作培育了多种能在干旱或洪水条件下生长的种子。
en: The Gates Foundation and its partners have worked together to develop new varieties of seeds that grow even during times of drought or flooding.

zh: 比如，我在比哈尔所访问的米农现在种上了一种新的抗洪稻米 — — 我们称之为“水肺”米 — — 它可以在水下生活两周。
en: The rice farmers I met in Bihar, for instance, are now growing a new variety of flood-tolerant rice – nicknamed “scuba” rice – that can survive two weeks underwater.

zh: 气候模式的变化可能给带地区带来更多的洪水，而他们已经做好了准备。
en: They are already prepared if shifts in the weather pattern bring more flooding to their region.

zh: 其他米种也在培育中，它们具有抗旱、抗热、抗寒、抗盐碱化等特性。
en: Other rice varieties are being developed that can withstand drought, heat, cold, and soil problems like high salt contamination.

zh: 所有这些努力都有改变生活的力量。
en: All of these efforts have the power to transform lives.

zh: 如果能够拥有发达世界农民习以为常的进步，这些农民常常可以实现收成和收入翻一倍或两倍。
en: It’s quite common to see these farmers double or triple their harvests and their incomes when they have access to the advances farmers in the rich world take for granted.

zh: 这一新繁荣让他们能够改善饮食、投资农场、让孩子上学。
en: This new prosperity allows them to improve their diets, invest in their farms, and send their children to school.

zh: 他们不用再过剃刀边缘的日子，即使收成不好，也能获得安全感。
en: It also pulls their lives back from the razor’s edge, giving them a sense of security even if they have a bad harvest.

zh: 气候变化还会带来我们无法预见的威胁。
en: There will also be threats from climate change that we can’t foresee.

zh: 要想做好准备，世界需要加快种子研究和对小农的支持。
en: To be prepared, the world needs to accelerate research into seeds and supports for smallholder farmers.

zh: 一项最令人振奋帮助农民的创新是卫星技术。
en: One of the most exciting innovations to help farmers is satellite technology.

zh: 在非洲，研究者用卫星影像绘制详细土壤地图，指导农民应该在土地上种植哪种作物可以丰收。
en: In Africa, researchers are using satellite images to create detailed soil maps, which can inform farmers about what varieties will thrive on their land.

zh: 但是，更好的种子和新技术无法改变农民家庭的生活，除非农民能够获得它们。
en: Still, a better seed or a new technology can’t transform the lives of farming families until it’s in their hands.

zh: 许多组织，包括名为一英亩基金（One Acre Fund）的非盈利组织，正在寻找办法保证农民能够利用这些解决方案。
en: A number of organizations, including a non-profit group called One Acre Fund, are finding ways to ensure that farmers take advantage of these solutions.

zh: 一英亩基金与20多万非洲农民密切合作，提供融资渠道、工具和培训。
en: One Acre Fund works closely with more than 200,000 African farmers, providing access to financing, tools, and training.

zh: 他们的目标是到2020年与一百万农民建立关系。
en: By 2020, they aim to reach one million farmers.

zh: 在今年的年度公开信中，梅琳达和我打赌15年后非洲将能养活自己。
en: In this year’s Annual Letter, Melinda and I made a bet that Africa will be able to feed itself in the next 15 years.

zh: 即使存在气候变化风险，我对这个赌注相当有自信。
en: Even with the risks of climate change, that’s a bet I stand by.

zh: 是的，贫穷的农民生活艰辛。
en: Yes, poor farmers have it tough.

zh: 他们的生活就像许多谜题 — — 从种正确的种子、使用正确的肥料，到获得训练和找到能出售收成的市场。
en: Their lives are puzzles with so many pieces to get right – from planting the right seeds and using the correct fertilizer to getting training and having a place to sell their harvest.

zh: 一招出错便满盘皆输。
en: If just one piece falls out of place, their lives can fall apart.

zh: 我知道世界拥有帮助他们正确处理今天所面临的和明天将要面临的挑战的条件。
en: I know the world has what it takes to help put those pieces in place for both the challenges they face today and the ones they’ll face tomorrow.

zh: 最重要的是，我知道农民也是这样。
en: Most importantly, I know the farmers do, too.

zh: 当农业工作者陷入到饥饿之中
en: When Agricultural Workers Go Hungry

zh: 日内瓦 — — 粮食问题能有力地揭露真相。
en: GENEVA – Food is a powerful storyteller.

zh: 我们的日常饮食能表明我们是否在家做饭、在附近购物、偏好廉价菜肴，甚或对所吃的食物进行过认真的思考。
en: Our diet signals whether we cook at home, shop locally, prefer inexpensive dishes, or even think about what we eat.

zh: 但从消费者角度的餐饮故事仅仅是粮食诸多线索中的一种。
en: But the consumer side of mealtime is just one of food’s many plot lines.

zh: 粮食同样也有背后的故事，其中最令人作呕的莫过于农业从业者 — — 那些使晚餐成为可能的人 — — 也最有可能饿着肚子上床睡觉。
en: Food has backstories, too, none more unsavory than this one: agricultural workers – the people who make dinner possible – are also the most likely to go to bed hungry.

zh: 每天，约有11亿人 — — 占全球劳动力总量的1/3 — — 到遍布世界各地的农场工作。
en: Every day, some 1.1 billion people – one-third of the global workforce – go to work at the world’s farms.

zh: 而每天晚上，他们很多人在无数次忍受侵权行为之后回到家，但却挣不到足够的钱来养活自己或家人。
en: And, every night, many of them return home – having suffered countless violations of their human rights – without enough money to feed themselves or their families.

zh: 农场工作属于常常被国家法律保护所忽视的少数几种行业。
en: Farm work is one of the only professions in which national legal protections are regularly ignored.

zh: 国际劳工组织（ILO）认可并被世界各地许多行业所广泛采用的最低工资标准在农业部门或者得不到实施，或者对非正式农业从业者不适用。
en: Minimum wage standards endorsed by the International Labor Organization (ILO), and adopted by many industries around the world, remain either unenforced in the agriculture sector or do not extend to informal farm workers.

zh: 但因为移民劳动力占农业劳动力的绝大部分，这种覆盖范围上的缺口已经形成了一条深深的裂缝。
en: But, because migrant labor makes up the bulk of the agricultural workforce, this gap in coverage has become a canyon.

zh: 在发展中国家的农村地区，80%的农场劳动力每天收入低于1.25美元，导致他们陷入贫困之中。
en: In rural parts of developing countries, 80% of farm workers earn less than $1.25 per day, trapping them in poverty.

zh: 此外，计件工作制也迫使劳动者在极端天气状况下工作长达数小时，才能满足苛刻的额度要求。
en: Additionally, piece-rate pay schemes force workers to spend hours in extreme weather to meet demanding quotas.

zh: 最糟的是，那些在不道德农场工作的人承受的风险很高。
en: Worst of all, those working on unethical farms do so at high risk.

zh: 根据国际劳工组织的说法，危险机械、工作时间过长以及接触有毒农药使得农场工作成为全世界最致命的工作之一；每年有超过17万农业劳动者在不安全的农场丧命，这样的死亡率是任何其他行业的两倍之多。
en: According to the ILO, dangerous machinery, long working hours, and exposure to toxic pesticides makes farm work one of the world’s deadliest jobs; more than 170,000 agricultural workers are killed every year on unsafe farms, twice the mortality rate of any other industry.

zh: 尽管如此，多数国家都将农业劳动从职业健康和安全规则的覆盖范围当中排除。
en: And yet, agricultural work is typically excluded from occupational health and safety rules in most countries.

zh: 就连在美国，即使中暑仍然是美国与工作相关的农场死亡的最主要原因，但依然没有联邦法律强制雇主让农场工人饮水和乘凉。
en: Even in the United States, there is no federal law mandating that employers give farm workers breaks for water and shade, even though heatstroke remains a leading cause of work-related farm deaths in the US.

zh: 阿根廷农场工人、阿根廷国内农药工业的批评者法比安·托马西最近的死亡使工业化农业的危险性再次引发人们的关注。
en: The recent death of Fabián Tomasi, an Argentine farm worker and critic of the agrochemical industry in his country, was a reminder of the hazards of industrialized agriculture.

zh: 尽管孟山都等公司称农药在确保粮食安全方面必不可少，但化学接触给像托马西这样的工人所带来的后果揭示了使用农药所付出的人类代价 — — 托马西的身体在常年不戴任何保护处理化学药品后出现了严重的扭曲和损伤。
en: While companies like Monsanto argue that pesticides are necessary to ensure food security, the consequences of chemical exposure to workers like Tomasi – whose body was left twisted and mangled after years of handling chemicals without protection – reveal the human cost of their use.

zh: 就连在发达国家，急性农药中毒对农业从业者的影响率也高达1/5000，而且每天都有无数员工被迫接触毒素。
en: Even in developed countries, acute pesticide poisoning affects one in every 5,000 agricultural workers, and countless more employees are exposed to toxins on a daily basis.

zh: 不幸的是，鲜有农业从业者能够主张自己的权利。
en: Unfortunately, few agricultural workers are in a position to advocate for their rights.

zh: 季节性及农村劳动者无法进行集体谈判，而无证移民劳动力则因为担心雇主会致电移民局报复而避开工会。
en: Seasonal and rural workers lack access to collective bargaining, and undocumented migrant workers avoid unions for fear that employers will retaliate by calling the immigration authorities.

zh: 此外，通常并不存在基本福利，如社会保障、医疗保健和工人赔偿。
en: Moreover, basic benefits such as social security, health care, and workers’ compensation are typically nonexistent.

zh: 因为不受绝大多数工作法规的监管，农业行业能够将节约成本和牟取利润放在员工福利之上。
en: Exempt from much workplace regulation, this is an industry that can afford to put cost-savings and profits above the wellbeing of employees.

zh: 现在我们是时候停止被动地将叉子插入餐盘，并利用我们的购买权抵制为粮食支付最低的价格。
en: It is time for us to stop passively sticking a fork into what lands on our plates, and use our purchasing power to resist paying the cheapest price for food.

zh: 追究人们虐待农场工人的责任将是一种挑战，但却并非不可能。
en: Holding people accountable for mistreating farm workers will be challenging, but not impossible.

zh: 我们可以首先呼吁政府花更多时间来保护农场工人，而不是对其移民身份展开调查。
en: We can begin by calling on governments to spend more time protecting farm workers than investigating their immigration status.

zh: 当然，要想实现这一目标，我们需要更多信息来了解食物的来源状况。
en: Of course, for this to be possible, we need more information about where our food comes from.

zh: 今天，我们往往依靠信息标签和认证来了解这些状况。
en: Nowadays, we tend to rely on informational labels and certifications to tell us that.

zh: 但它们所透露的信息分散、不完整，有时甚至能对人产生误导。
en: But the story they tell is fragmented, incomplete, and at times even misleading.

zh: 我们需要采取额外措施来掌握整体状况。
en: We need to take the extra steps to learn the full story.

zh: 这意味着超越宣称粮食生产方式公平和人道的自愿标签，并要求执行强制标签来对违反这些规范的行为进行曝光。
en: This means moving beyond voluntary labels declaring that food is produced fairly and humanely to demand mandatory labels that expose non-compliance with these norms.

zh: 全世界约有8.21亿人营养不良 — — 这一数字还在不断增加中。
en: Worldwide, some 821 million people are undernourished – a figure that continues to increase.

zh: 这是一场悲剧；任何人都无权侵犯他人的权利 — — 其中包括食品权；但这恰恰是如此多农场劳动者和食物链工人每天都在忍受的状况。
en: This is a tragedy; no one anywhere should have their rights, including the right to food, violated; yet that is exactly what so many farm workers and food-chain workers endure every day.

zh: 为他们的权利而战一直难度很大，但如果我们继续战斗，全球粮食体系的故事可能会少一些苦涩。
en: Fighting for their rights has always been difficult, but if we continue the battle, the story of the global food system may lose some of its bitterness.

zh: 你可以进一步了解特别报告员的工作，并访问Hilalelver.org查看她关于农场劳动者和粮食权问题的正式报告。
en: You can learn more about the work of the Special Rapporteur, and access her official report on agricultural workers and the right to food at Hilalelver.org.

zh: 杀手农场
en: Killer Farms

zh: 剑桥—4月3日，英国宣布了“全世界最严格之一”的象牙销售禁令。
en: CAMBRIDGE – On April 3, the United Kingdom announced a ban on the sale of ivory that is “one of the toughest in the world.”

zh: 通过限制象牙贸易，英国加入了其他国家 — — 其中包括中国和美国 — — 的行列，用市场障碍来阻止盗猎、保护濒危物种免于灭绝。
en: By restricting the ivory trade, the UK joined other countries – including China and the United States – in using market deterrents to discourage poaching and shield an endangered species from extinction.

zh: 因果环境大臣迈克尔·戈夫（Michael Gove）在宣布这项决定时说，其目标是“为子孙后代保护大象 ” 。
en: As British Environment Secretary Michael Gove put it in the announcement, the goal is to “protect elephants for future generations.”

zh: 平心而论，这些都属于目标崇高的高姿态。
en: These are, to be sure, laudable gestures in the service of a noble goal.

zh: 但光靠终结象牙销售无法扭转大象数量下降之势。
en: But ending ivory sales alone will not reverse declines in elephant populations.

zh: 事实上，大象和其他物种所面临的最大威胁是更加普通的人类活动：务农。
en: In fact, the biggest threat facing these and many other species is a far more ordinary human pursuit: farming.

zh: 放眼发展中世界，农民不懈地追寻肥沃的耕地，在此过程中，他们拓荒的面积越来越大。
en: Throughout the developing world, farmers are expanding areas of cultivation in an endless quest for fertile soil.

zh: 重要野生动物栖息地以令人警惕的速度被毁坏。
en: In the process, critical wildlife habitats are being destroyed at an alarming rate.

zh: 据联合国粮农组织（FAO ） ， 如果当前趋势持续下去，到2050年全球适耕土地将增加7,000万公顷，很大一部分新开农地将来自目前的森林。
en: According to the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), if current trends hold, by 2050 the world’s arable land will increase by some 70 million hectares, and much of the new farmland will be on areas that are currently forested.

zh: 南美和撒哈拉以南非洲风险最大，人口增长和食物需求将对热带森林造成非常严重的冲击。
en: The risk is greatest in South America and Sub-Saharan Africa, where population growth and food demand will hit tropical woodlands particularly hard.

zh: 贫困是这场生态危机的根源，但拙劣的农业活动让人们迟迟无法摆脱饥饿和栖息地丧失的循环。
en: Poverty is at the root of this ecological crisis, but poor farming practices perpetuate the cycle of hunger and habitat loss.

zh: 比如，在非洲，庄稼产量的一直低迷 — — 常常仅等于全球平均水平的20 % — —与种子品质低劣、无法获得肥料，以及缺乏灌溉有关。
en: In Africa, for example, persistently low crop yields – often just 20% of global averages – are tied to low seed quality, the unavailability of fertilizers, and a lack of irrigation.

zh: 随着土壤质量的下降和产出萎缩，许多农民别无选择，只能寻找新的土地耕种。
en: As soil health declines and output drops, many farmers see no option but to look for new land to cultivate.

zh: 幸运的是，有办法结束这一恶性循环。
en: Fortunately, there is a way to end this vicious cycle.

zh: 研究表明，更好的农业活动和技术能够增加农业生产率，同时减少栖息地损失和保护野生动物。
en: Research shows that better farming practices and technology can increase agricultural productivity while reducing habitat loss and protecting wildlife.

zh: 这一方法称为“可持续集约化 ” ， 其目的是用整合作物管理和先进虫害控制等技术，提高现有耕地的产出。
en: This approach, known as “sustainable intensification,” aims to boost the output of existing farmland using techniques such as integrated crop management and advanced pest control.

zh: 如果得到广泛应用，可持续集约化甚至能够减少当前耕种的土地总量。
en: If applied widely, sustainable intensification could even reduce the total amount of land currently under cultivation.

zh: 这不是一个不可能的目标。
en: This is not an impossible goal.

zh: 在过去25年中，全世界20多个国家的农民既改善了粮食安全，又保持或增加了森林覆盖面。
en: Over the last 25 years, farmers in more than 20 countries around the world improved food security while maintaining or increasing forest cover.

zh: 据一项研究，1965至2004年间，种植高质量种子的发展中国家农民能够减少近3,000万公顷耕地 — — 相当于意大利大小的面积。
en: According to one study, between 1965 and 2004, farmers in developing countries who planted high-quality seeds were able to reduce farmland by almost 30 million hectares – an area roughly the size of Italy.

zh: 如果小农能够获得现代设备、更好的数据和分析以及更多的融资，这些收益可以进一步提高。
en: These gains could be extended further if smallholder farmers had access to modern equipment, better data collection and analysis, and more financing.

zh: 批评者指出，提高小农的生产率可能适得其反，特别是如果这鼓励贫农扩大种植面积以期提高收入的话。
en: Critics argue that increasing the productivity of smallholder farms could backfire, especially if it encouraged poor farmers to expand their acreage in the hope of increasing profits.

zh: 为了避免这一结果，集约化战略必须辅之以强大的保护规划 。
en: To avoid this outcome, intensification strategies must be accompanied by strong conservation planning.

zh: 但与此同时，不能要求发展中国家的农民完全停止使用其耕地附近的非农场资源。
en: At the same time, however, farmers in developing countries cannot simply be asked to stop using non-farm resources adjacent to their fields.

zh: 许多贫穷社区居民需要依靠森林获得燃料和建筑材料，禁止使用这些资源，又不提供足够的替代品的政府政策很容易失败。
en: Many people in poor communities rely on woodland products for fuel and construction materials, and government policies that prohibit use of these resources without offering adequate alternatives will likely fail.

zh: 相反，理想的发展中国家保护方针是农业和经济支持双管齐下，以限制农地扩张的限度。
en: Rather, the ideal conservation approach in developing countries would link agricultural and economic support to strict limits on farmland expansion.

zh: 今天还远远没有达成这一成就。
en: That is far from being the case today.

zh: 放眼全球，每年都有数十亿美元投资被用于解决环境破坏和贫困；17个联合国可持续发展目标中大部分以某种方式与这两个问题有关。
en: Around the world, billions of dollars are invested annually to address environmental degradation and poverty; many of the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals are linked in some way to these two concerns.

zh: 但是，大部分为解决这些问题而制定的计划，处于孤立执行的状态。
en: And yet, most programs designed to tackle these issues operate in isolation.

zh: 这是错误的：粮食不安全和栖息地损失问题的解决方案要想真正解决挑战，必须更好地整合起来。
en: This is a mistake: solutions to food insecurity and habitat loss must be better integrated if either challenge is ever to be solved.

zh: 没有人怀疑象牙禁令等初衷良好的政策能够减轻人类活动的生态硬性。
en: No one doubts that well-meaning policies like ivory bans can lessen the ecological impact of human activity.

zh: 但在目前，农业活动 — — 它们才是危及许多物种健康的罪魁 — — 并没有获得应该获得的决策关注。
en: But, at the moment, farming – the activity most responsible for damaging the health of many species – is failing to attract the policymaking attention that it deserves.

zh: 除非这一局面发生改变，否则旨在“为子孙后代”保护野生动物的战略都会功亏一篑。
en: Until that changes, government strategies to protect wildlife “for future generations” will very likely come up short.

zh: 实现货币政策正常化的勇气
en: The Courage to Normalize Monetary Policy

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 让我们为中央银行欢呼致意！
en: NEW HAVEN – Three cheers for central banks!

zh: 这句话出自我这么一个常年批评世界货币当局的人之口可能有点奇怪。
en: That may sound strange coming from someone who has long been critical of the world’s monetary authorities.

zh: 但我对美联储终于履行了其政策利率和资产负债表正常化的迟到承诺是表示赞赏的，对英国央行的类似行为以及欧洲央行朝着这个方向的不情愿转向也持同样态度。
en: But I applaud the US Federal Reserve’s long-overdue commitment to the normalization of its policy rate and balance sheet. I say the same for the Bank of England, and for the European Central Bank’s grudging nod in the same direction.

zh: 然而风险在于，这些举动可能太微小，也太迟了。
en: The risk, however, is that these moves may be too little too late.

zh: 中央银行的非常规货币政策 — — 具体来说就是零利率和大量资产购买 — — 在2008~09年金融危机的谷底时出台实施。
en: Central banks’ unconventional monetary policies – namely, zero interest rates and massive asset purchases – were put in place in the depths of the 2008-2009 financial crisis.

zh: 这本质上是个紧急行动，由于传统的政策工具已经全部耗尽，当局必须非常拿出极具创新的方案去应对金融市场的崩溃以及可能随之而来的实体经济垮塌。
en: It was an emergency operation, to say the least. With their traditional policy tools all but exhausted, the authorities had to be exceptionally creative in confronting the collapse in financial markets and a looming implosion of the real economy.

zh: 当时中央银行似乎别无选择，只能选择被称之为“量化宽松”的大量流动性注入方案。
en: Central banks, it seemed, had no choice but to opt for the massive liquidity injections known as “quantitative easing.”

zh: 这个策略确实阻止了市场的自由下跌。
en: This strategy did arrest the free-fall in markets.

zh: 但它在促进实质性经济复苏方面作用不大。
en: But it did little to spur meaningful economic recovery.

zh: 七国集团经济体（美国，日本，加拿大，德国，英国，法国和意大利，合称G7）在2010~17年后危机时期的集体年均增长率仅为1.8 ％ ， 远低于1980年代和1990年代两次复苏期间可供对比的八年间隙期平均3.2％的比率。
en: The G7 economies (the United States, Japan, Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, and Italy) have collectively grown at just a 1.8% average annual rate over the 2010-2017 post-crisis period. That is far short of the 3.2% average rebound recorded over comparable eight-year intervals during the two recoveries of the 1980s and the 1990s.

zh: 不幸的是，那些中央银行家误判了2008年后政策行动的效力。
en: Unfortunately, central bankers misread the efficacy of their post-2008 policy actions.

zh: 他们的所作所为仿佛是认定那些有助于结束危机的战略也可以在促进实体经济周期性反弹方面达到同样的效果，因此他们将零政策利率和资产负债表扩张的鸡尾酒疗法用药量增大了一倍。
en: They acted as if the strategy that helped end the crisis could achieve the same traction in fostering a cyclical rebound in the real economy. In fact, they doubled down on the cocktail of zero policy rates and balance-sheet expansion.

zh: 这个赌注是如此之大，根据国际清算银行的统计，过去九年来中央银行在各主要发达经济体（美国，欧元区和日本）的合共持有的资产增加了8.3万亿美元，从2008年的4.6万亿美元扩大到2017年初的12.9万亿美元。
en: And what a bet it was. According to the Bank for International Settlements, central banks’ combined asset holdings in the major advanced economies (the US, the eurozone, and Japan) expanded by $8.3 trillion over the past nine years, from $4.6 trillion in 2008 to $12.9 trillion in early 2017.

zh: 但这一庞大的资产负债表扩张却没有体现出来。
en: Yet this massive balance-sheet expansion has had little to show for it.

zh: 在同样的九年间这些经济体的名义GDP增长了2.1万亿美元。
en: Over the same nine-year period, nominal GDP in these economies increased by just $2.1 trillion.

zh: 这意味着6.2万亿美元的过剩流动性注入 — — 中央银行资产增长与名义GDP之间的差 — — 并未被实体经济所吸收，而是在全球金融市场中徘徊，扭曲了整个风险波段的资产价格。
en: That implies a $6.2 trillion injection of excess liquidity – the difference between the growth in central bank assets and nominal GDP – that was not absorbed by the real economy and has, instead been sloshing around in global financial markets, distorting asset prices across the risk spectrum.

zh: 这类扭曲早该得到纠正，而正常化就是药方。
en: Normalization is all about a long-overdue unwinding of those distortions.

zh: 在金融危机爆发十多年之后将货币政策杠杆从紧急状态下解除出来似乎再合适不过了。
en: Fully ten years after the onset of the Great Financial Crisis, it seems more than appropriate to move the levers of monetary policy off their emergency settings.

zh: 无论复苏有多疲软，一个复苏中的世界都已经不需要那种危机式的货币政策操作手法了。
en: A world in recovery – no matter how anemic that recovery may be – does not require a crisis-like approach to monetary policy.

zh: 但众多货币当局只是勉强接受了这一点。
en: Monetary authorities have only grudgingly accepted this.

zh: 当前这一代中央银行家对通货膨胀目标有着近乎宗教式的狂热 — — 即便在今天这个缺乏通货膨胀的世界上。
en: Today’s generation of central bankers is almost religious in its commitment to inflation targeting – even in today’s inflationless world.

zh: 虽然钟摆已经从摆脱过度通胀转向了避免通缩，但维持价格稳定性仍然是央行界的绝对必要条件。
en: While the pendulum has swung from squeezing out excess inflation to avoiding deflation, price stability remains the sine qua non in central banking circles.

zh: 这种通货膨胀思维定势可不容易打破，我可以以个人名义证实这一点。
en: Inflation fixations are not easy to break. I can personally attest to that.

zh: 作为1970年代受雇于美联储的经济学家，我亲眼目睹了大通胀（the Great Inflation，几乎贯穿整个1970年代的美国经济危机）的诞生 — — 以及笨拙无能的央行在这场危机的催生中所扮演的角色。
en: As a staff economist at the Fed in the 1970s, I witnessed first-hand the birth of the Great Inflation – and the role played by inept central banking in creating it.

zh: 在经历了那场事件的多年甚至几十年后，我总是会担心新一轮通胀随时会卷土重来。
en: For years, if not decades, after that experience, I was convinced that renewed inflation was just around the corner.

zh: 而当代的中央银行家却陷入了通胀光谱的另一端。
en: Today’s generation of central bankers has dug in its heels at the opposite end of the inflation spectrum.

zh: 他们拘泥于一种受限于经济萧条和通胀之间假设性权衡的“菲利普斯曲线”心态，坚持认为只要通货膨胀低于目标值，宽松的政策偏向就可以适用。
en: Wedded to a “Phillips curve” mentality conditioned by the presumed tradeoff between economic slack and inflation, central bankers remain steadfast in their view that an accommodative policy bias is appropriate as long as inflation falls short of their targets.

zh: 这也是当前最大的风险。
en: This is today’s biggest risk.

zh: 正常化不应被视为一个依附于通胀状况的行动。
en: Normalization should not be viewed as an inflation-dependent operation.

zh: 低于目标的通胀不是正常化策略一再延长的借口。
en: Below-target inflation is not an excuse for a long and drawn-out normalization.

zh: 为了应对必将到来的下一次危机或衰退，我们必须重建自己的政策武器库，而快速且有条理地回归到危机前的货币政策是极有必要的。
en: In order to rebuild the policy arsenal for the inevitable next crisis or recession, a prompt and methodical restoration of monetary policy to pre-crisis settings is far preferable.

zh: 事实上，2000年代初的上一个危机前时期所遭遇的问题正是没有做到这一点。
en: A failure to do this was, in fact, precisely the problem during the last pre-crisis period, in the early 2000s.

zh: 美联储犯下了最为严重的错误。
en: The Fed committed the most egregious error of all.

zh: 在2000年初网络泡沫破裂之后，他们害怕重蹈日本的覆辙并因此选择了一种渐增式的正常化策略 — — 从2004年年中至2006年年中的24个月间将其政策利率调高了17次，每次都小幅提升25个基点。
en: In the aftermath of the bursting of the dotcom bubble in early 2000, and with fears of a Japan scenario weighing heavily on the policy debate, it opted for an incremental normalization strategy – raising its policy rate 17 times in small moves of 25 basis points over a 24-month period from mid-2004 to mid-2006.

zh: 然而正是在这个时期，泡沫越吹越大的金融市场正在播下不久以后那场灾难的种子。
en: Yet it was precisely during that period when increasingly frothy financial markets were sowing the seeds of the disaster that was shortly to follow.

zh: 在此期间，美联储提出了一项到2022~2023年度前不去实现资产负债表正常化的策略，其运作时长比2000年代中期那个设计不佳的行动还要长2.5~3倍。
en: In the current period, the Fed has outlined a strategy that does not achieve balance-sheet normalization until 2022-2023 at the earliest – 2.5-3 times as long as the ill-designed campaign of the mid-2000s.

zh: 在今天这个光鲜脆弱的市场上这是在自找麻烦。
en: In today’s frothy markets, that’s asking for trouble.

zh: 为了实现金融稳定，有必要去实施更快的正常化 — — 比美联储当前建议的时间还得短一半。
en: In the interest of financial stability, there is a compelling argument for much speedier normalization – completing the task in as little as half the time the Fed is currently suggesting.

zh: 独立的中央银行本来不是为了四处讨好而生的。
en: Independent central banks were not designed to win popularity contests.

zh: 保罗·沃尔克（Paul Volcker）在1980年代早期带领美联储应对猛烈通胀压力时就知道这一点。
en: Paul Volcker knew that when he led the charge against raging inflation in the early 1980s.

zh: 但他的继任者格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）和本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）所采取的方法却截然不同，他们允许金融市场和日渐转向资产依赖型的经济体去掌控美联储。
en: But the approach taken by his successors, Alan Greenspan and Ben Bernanke, was very different – allowing financial markets and an increasingly asset-dependent economy to take charge of the Fed.

zh: 对于珍妮特·耶伦（Janet Yellen）或其继任者来说创造不同的道路则需要勇气。
en: For Janet Yellen – or her successor – it will take courage to forge a different path.

zh: 眼看超过6万亿美元的过剩流动性仍然在全球金融市场徘徊，这股勇气还是早点生出来为好。
en: With more than $6 trillion of excess liquidity still sloshing around in global financial markets, that courage cannot be found soon enough.

zh: 维持现状的法塔赫代表大会
en: Fatah’s Status Quo Congress

zh: 发自赫兹利亚（以色列港口城市 ） — —近日在伯利恒召开的法塔赫第六次代表大会是关乎阿以冲突及巴勒斯坦民族运动未来的重要事件。
en: HERZLIYA – The Sixth Fatah Congress, held recently in Bethlehem, was an important event for the future of the Arab-Israeli conflict and for the Palestinian movement.

zh: 但如果认真观察一下的话，人们就会发现本次大会选举法塔赫中央委员会成员的最终结果，相较于外界的许多判断来说，勾勒出的是一幅相当不同的图景。
en: But a careful look at the results of the Congress’s elections to Fatah’s Central Committee yields a picture that is quite different from what many will conclude about the meeting.

zh: 此次大会似乎是为了向人们证明三个重点：法塔赫正在向对以色列和平方面靠拢，并在自身运作方面引入了民主程序。 此外，新一代领导人，或者说是一个被称为“青年卫队”的特殊组织已经承担起法塔赫的领导责任。
en: The Congress seemed to demonstrate three main points: Fatah has moved toward peace with Israel; it has adopted democratic procedures; and a new generation, or even a specific group called the Young Guard, has assumed leadership.

zh: 但其实，人们的以上三点解读在很大程度上都是错误的。
en: But this interpretation is in large part wrong.

zh: 就推进和平进程的方式而言，新中央委员会同其前任相比几乎是如出一辙。
en: In terms of its approach to peace, the new Central Committee is roughly the same as the old one.

zh: 当选的18名成员中（巴勒斯坦自治机构领导人穆罕默德·阿巴斯随后将增加任命4名成员 ） ， 不超过两位，即只有纳比尔·沙阿斯和穆罕默德·施塔耶是真正的温和派。
en: Of the 18 elected members (Palestinian Authority leader Mahmoud Abbas will appoint four more later), no more than two (Nabil Shaath and Muhammad Shtayyeh) are really moderate.

zh: 至少有四名成员（穆罕默德·阿尔-古奈姆，萨利姆·阿尔-扎农，阿巴斯·扎吉和纳赛尔·齐德拉）坚持走强硬路线，而其他大多数成员将会在很大程度上将遵循法塔赫传统的政策方针。
en: At least four (Muhammad al-Ghuneim, Salim al-Zanoun, Abbas Zaki, and Nasser Kidra) are hardliners, and most of the rest follow pretty much the traditional Fatah line.

zh: 而在组织内部民主方面，本次大会与过去相比无疑是向前迈出了一步（在阿拉法特主政时期，法塔赫领导层均由其亲自挑选 ） ， 但其局限性也仍然存在。
en: As for democracy, while the Congress was certainly a step forward from the past (when Fatah leader Yasir Arafat could handpick Fatah’s leadership), real limits remain.

zh: 根据他自己的意思，阿巴斯挑选并任命了占大会代表总数1/2至1/3之间的代表。 因以毫不意外，中央委员会的大部分成员都是阿巴斯的亲密合作者和支持者。
en: Depending on one’s definition, Abbas chose between one-third and one-half of the delegates. The majority of the Central Committee, not surprisingly, are Abbas’s close associates and supporters.

zh: 而18名委员中只有一位来自哈马斯控制的加沙地带（须知法塔赫管辖的巴勒斯坦民众有一半都生活于此）的事实，也令本次选举的合法性大打折扣。
en: The fact that only one out of 18 members will be from the Hamas-ruled Gaza Strip, which contains about half of all the Palestinians that Fatah governs, also skews the results.

zh: 而此次选举中还存在一个极其危险的因素，其严重性甚至可能超过其他一切方面，那就是得票数独占鳌头、拿下2/3选票的候选人阿布德·阿尔-马希尔·古奈姆，而认定此人为阿巴斯继承人的言论正愈演愈烈。
en: But there is one aspect of this election so dangerous that it might outweigh everything else.

zh: 然而古奈姆是一个顽固的强硬派，他本人就是奥斯陆协议的公开反对者，让他去和以色列谈判签订和平协议更是不可能。
en: The candidate who came in first, with two-thirds of the vote, was Abd al-Mahir Ghuneim, who is increasingly being spoken of as Abbas’s successor.  Ghuneim is an unrepentant hardliner and an open opponent of the Oslo agreement, much less of a negotiated peace agreement with Israel.

zh: 如果古奈姆最终当选为法塔赫的领导人，并因此成为巴勒斯坦当局以及巴勒斯坦解放组织领导人的话，那么同以方达成任何形式的妥协方案都只能是无稽之谈了。
en: If he becomes Fatah’s leader (and hence leader of the PA and the PLO as well), any compromise with Israel would become unimaginable.

zh: 那么在另一方面，法塔赫内部向新一代领导集体移交权力的情况如何呢？
en: What about the transfer of power to a new generation?

zh: 纯粹就时间而论，大会的召开正合时宜 — — 毕竟老一届委员会成员都不可避免地日渐衰老，但在大部分上届委员会成员都没能继续留任的情况下，至少15到22名成员都将依然是那种“老派”领导人（预计阿巴斯将在四个额外席位中任命类似人选 ） 。
en: This is accurate in purely chronological terms – old leaders inevitably get older, after all. Yet, while almost all the old members of the committee were not reelected, at least 15 of the 22 members will be old-style leaders (presuming Abbas will appoint such people to the four seats that he controls).

zh: 此外，许多新当选的委员其实也都是些法塔赫老官僚。
en: Many of the newly elected members, moreover, are veteran Fatah bureaucrats.

zh: 而中央委员会中最引起兴趣的是三位较年轻的成员的加入，虽说是“较年轻 ” ， 但这三人也已分别在法塔赫内部担任领导位置超过20年之久了。
en: The most interesting additions to the Central Committee are three younger men, though they have played leading roles in the organization for 20 years or more.

zh: 其中之一是约旦河西岸法塔赫基层组织领导人马尔万·巴尔毫迪，此人现正在以色列监狱中服刑，罪名是领导了2000年爆发的流血叛乱，并直接参与策划多起谋杀以色列平民的事件。
en: Marwan Barghouti, the leader of Fatah’s grassroots group on the West Bank, is now in an Israeli prison for organizing the bloody uprising that began in 2000, and for direct involvement in planning the killings of many Israeli civilians.

zh: 虽然有人认为巴尔豪迪的当选意味着更年轻一代领导人的胜利，但此人身陷囹圄，他的追随者自然也接触不到他。
en: While some will point to Barghouti’s election as a victory for the younger generation, not one of his followers will join him.

zh: 而另外两位较年轻的领导人：穆罕默德·达赫兰和吉布勒·拉杰卜分别作为加沙地带和约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦安全部队的领导人，已经在当地奠定了自己的政治基础。
en: The other two younger men, Muhammad Dahlan and Jibril Rajoub, built political bases of their own as commanders of security forces in the Gaza Strip and on the West Bank, respectively.

zh: 但值得注意的是，拉杰卜树敌众多，而达赫兰本人则对法塔赫被哈马斯驱逐出加沙地带这一屈辱性的失败负有直接责任。
en: But Rajoub has many enemies, and Dahlan was responsible for Fatah���s humiliating defeat by Hamas in the fight that led to the expulsion of Fatah from Gaza.

zh: 此外这三位“较年轻”领导人也并非盟友，而是相互竞争的对手。
en: In addition, all three of the younger men are rivals, not allies.

zh: 换言之，团结统一的“青年卫队”并不存在。
en: In other words, there is no unified Young Guard.

zh: 实际上，如果要把法塔赫第六次代表大会称为一次选举革命的话还有点困难，因为当选委员中只有巴尔豪迪，以及穆罕默德·施塔耶这位领导巴勒斯坦经济发展和复兴理事会���该机构旨在推进政治透明化和经济发展）的官员能够从根本上被认为是法塔赫组织机构的关键人物。
en: Indeed, far from being an electoral revolution, only two of those elected – Barghouti and Muhammad Shtayyeh, who has headed PECDAR, the Palestinian agency that promotes transparency and economic development – can be considered at all critical of the Fatah establishment.

zh: 但尽管此次选举没能产生出一个有意寻求以巴和平并通过妥协方案建立巴勒斯坦国的领导集体， 法塔赫第六次代表大会也不会导致新一轮暴力冲突的爆发。
en: But, while the election did not usher in a leadership eager for peace with Israel and a Palestinian state achieved by compromise, nor was it a prelude to a renewal of violence.

zh: 新领导集体中仍有若干领导人同以色列有多方面接触，甚至随时能与以方直接取得联系。
en: There are several individuals in the new leadership who have many Israeli contacts, and who can pick up a phone and call or be called by their Israeli counterparts.

zh: 另外还有一点极为重要：大多数法塔赫的新领导人对哈马斯都怀有极大反感，这一点使得哈法两大阵营的关系重建希望渺茫。
en: It is also extremely important that most of Fatah’s new leaders have a strong distaste for Hamas, which makes rapprochement between the two groups unlikely.

zh: 但必须指出的是，假如来年古奈姆仍当选为巴勒斯坦当局及法塔赫的领导人，那么巴以和谈的终止和新一轮冲突自然也毫不奇怪。
en: Still, if Ghuneim takes over as the PA’s and Fatah’s leader, which could happen next year, a breakdown of negotiations with Israel and a new round of fighting would not be surprising.

zh: 法塔赫六大上另一个引起关注的新面孔则是施塔耶。
en: The other interesting new face, though he has no chance of becoming a major leader, is Shtayyeh.

zh: 尽管没有机会成为主要领导者，但作为一名成功的商人，施塔耶有能力担任组织内部监督者和揭发者这类的角色，而这将是一个革新性的举措。
en: A successful businessman, he could become an ombudsman and whistle-blower, which would be a real innovation.

zh: 然而，虽然施塔耶最终会变成大炮筒或者被封嘴的可能性是一个有趣的观察点，但是人们不应赋予他的当选过多含义：在所有当选人中他的得票最少，以一票之差输给了塔伊卜·阿布·拉赫曼，后者是阿拉法特最信任的副手之一，并且是一个老派强硬路线的执行者。
en: But, while it will be interesting to see whether he speaks out or is shut up, one shouldn’t read too much into his election: he finished last among those elected, beating by a single vote Tayib Abu Rahman, one of Arafat’s most trusted lieutenants and an old-school hardliner.

zh: 由此可见，新巴勒斯坦领导集体中政见不一，各立山头。
en: There is a wide range of views in the new Palestinian leadership.

zh: 因此这样的领导集体既不能在将来同以色列实现和平，也难以与哈马斯重回同一阵线。
en: This is neither a group that will make peace with Israel nor one that will ally itself with Hamas.

zh: 换句话来说，尽管这个领导集体能够与以色列一道，共同合作解决巴以一些眼前的现实问题，但双方将无法达成一个全面性的协议。
en: In other words, it is a group with which Israel can work on status quo issues, though not on a comprehensive agreement.

zh: 而如果古奈姆真的当选为巴勒斯坦当局的新一届领导人的话，那么一切巴以和平的前景，都将会黯淡无光。
en: But if Muhammad al-Ghuneim does indeed become the new leader, the prospects for any peace at all look grim.

zh: 43亿美元一耸肩
en: The $4.3 Billion Shrug

zh: 伦敦—11月，英国金融市场行为监管局（Financial Conduct Authority，FCA）宣布与六家银行和解。 这六家银行被FCA指控操纵外汇市场，将支付总共43亿美元的和解金。
en: LONDON – In November, the United Kingdom’s Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) announced a settlement in which six banks would be fined a total of $4.3 billion for manipulating the foreign-exchange market.

zh: 但股价并未因此起反应。
en: And yet share prices barely reacted.

zh: 原因何在？
en: Why?

zh: 为期一年、导致如此巨大罚金的调查所揭露的恶劣行为和管理失灵令人震惊。
en: The nefarious practices and management failings uncovered during the yearlong investigation that led to the fines were shocking.

zh: 贪婪的交易员之间半真半假的电子邮件和聊天室记录表明，他们无耻地操纵午后汇率的“固定 ” （ fix ） ， 以获得利润和个人好处。
en: Semi-literate email and chat-room exchanges among venal traders revealed brazen conspiracies to rig the afternoon exchange-rate “fix” for profit and personal gain.

zh: 高级管理人员形同虚设，放任手下如同手里钱太多的孩子一样做出任性下流的行为。
en: Senior managers were so disengaged that they allowed their employees to act like vulgar, overpaid children.

zh: 他们用“三个火枪手 ” 、 “A队”等绰号为所欲为，给所在机构造成沉重代价。
en: Using nicknames like “the three musketeers” and “the A-team,” they did whatever they liked, at an enormous cost to their institutions.

zh: 但是，尽管FCA对它们课以巨额罚款，但没有一位高管被迫为此负责，投资者对此也只是一耸肩。
en: But, despite the huge FCA fine, no top executive was forced to fall on his or her sword, and investors did little more than shrug.

zh: 当然，一个原因是和解是必然的；只有罪名的细节和罚金的规模有待确定。
en: One reason, of course, is that the settlement was known to be coming; only the details of the offenses and the scale of the fines were news.

zh: 但是，更重要的原因是，即使罚金高达43亿美元，与大银行在过去五年来所支付的总罚金和诉讼成本来说也只是九牛一毛。
en: The more important reason, though, is that even $4.3 billion is small change when compared to the total fines and litigation costs incurred by the major banks over the last five years.

zh: 摩根士丹利分析师估算，2009年以来美国和欧洲银行被迫支付了2,300亿美元 — — 是FCA和解金的50多倍。
en: Morgan Stanley analysts estimate that the top 22 banks in the United States and Europe have been forced to pay $230 billion since 2009 – more than 50 times the cost of the FCA settlement.

zh: 这个数字比银行因不良贷款和过度宏大的金融工程所蒙受的损失还要大。
en: This is over and above the heavy losses that banks incurred from bad lending and overambitious financial engineering.

zh: 美资银行占了这些巨额罚金的大头。
en: American banks have incurred more than half of these massive penalties.

zh: 欧洲的罚单只有1,000亿美元出头 — — 其中大约有一半是由七家英国大银行支付的。
en: The European bill amounts to just over $100 billion – roughly half of which was paid by the top seven British banks.

zh: 但数字只是故事的一部分。
en: But the numbers tell only part of the story.

zh: 在美国，罚金主要是因为销售误导性营销的按揭支持证券，销售对象通常是两家政府支持机构 — — 房利美（Fannie Mae）和房地美（Freddie Mac ） 。
en: In the US, the penalties have been dominated by fines for sales of misleadingly marketed mortgage-backed securities, often to the two government supported entities Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

zh: 平心而论，银行并不完全接受监管者的这一观点，但它们还是忍气吞声付了罚金。
en: The banks, it would be fair to say, do not wholly accept regulators’ arguments about that, but they have bitten their tongues and paid up.

zh: （美国监管机构还向外国银行美国分支开出了巨额罚单，理由是它们违反了美国与伊朗有关的制裁政策。 ）
en: (US regulators have also imposed high penalties on foreign banks for breaches of American sanctions policies in relation to Iran.)

zh: 相反，在英国，最大额罚金以补偿金的形式付给了买有支付保护保险（Payment Protection Insurance）的个人按揭借款人。
en: In the UK, by contrast, the biggest penalties have come in the form of compensation payments made to individual mortgage borrowers who were sold Payment Protection Insurance.

zh: 监管机构主张这一保险大多对借款人毫无价值，属于错误销售。
en: The regulators maintain that much of this insurance was worthless to borrowers and was mis-sold.

zh: 银行认为一些它们被迫偿付的索偿是没有价值的，但它们被迫出钱。
en: The banks believe that some of the claimants whom they are being forced to pay are unworthy, but they have nonetheless coughed up the money.

zh: 到目前为止，这出不愉快的闹剧让英国银行付出了370亿美元，未来还会有更多 — — 有可能还有50亿美元。
en: That unhappy episode has cost British banks $37 billion so far, with more to come – most likely another $5 billion or so.

zh: 摩根士丹利的分析表明，在未来两年中，已发现错误和遗漏还将造成700亿美元的罚金和诉讼成本。
en: The Morgan Stanley analysis suggests that we can expect another $70 billion in fines and litigation costs over the next two years from already identified errors and omissions.

zh: 此外，有可能还有新案件出现；两年前就没人预见到这一外汇市场操纵案的发生。
en: And new episodes could emerge; two years ago, no one anticipated the fallout from the manipulation of the foreign-exchange markets.

zh: 这里的讽刺之处 — — 并非只有大银行财务主管 — — 是银行在竭力通过发行股本和留存利润增加资本以满足审慎监管机构的要求，与此同时，这些资金又在以同样的速度被监管者罚没。
en: The irony here – not lost on the major banks’ finance directors – is that as fast as banks add capital from rights issues and retained earnings to meet the demands of prudential regulators, the funds are drained away by conduct regulators.

zh: 如今，罚金规模之大已足以对银行资产负债表造成重大影响，减缓它们的恢复速度，制约它们的贷款能力。
en: The scale of the penalties is now large enough to have a substantial impact on banks’ balance sheets, delay the restoration of their health, and constrain their lending capacity.

zh: 其中一些钱 — — 特别是在英国 — — 回到了个体客户手中。
en: Some of the money, especially in the UK, has gone back to individual customers.

zh: 但更多的钱进了监管机构本身的腰包，然后流入了国家政府。
en: But more has gone to the regulators themselves and onward to national governments.

zh: 在英国，罚金曾经帮助支付了监管机构的成本：坏行为人减少了好行为人所需支付的费用，创造了积极反馈环。
en: In the UK, fines once helped defray the regulator’s costs: bad actors reduced the fees charged to the good ones, creating a positive feedback loop.

zh: 如今，罚金规模是如此之大，以至于填补监管机构执法成本有余，剩下来的被政府用于老兵抚恤。
en: Today, the payments have become so large that the government has seized them and channeled revenues exceeding the regulator’s enforcement costs to veterans’ charities.

zh: 在美国，最终受益者比较不明确；事实上，到底是谁并未得到披露。
en: In the US, the end recipients are less clear; indeed, they are undisclosed.

zh: 查哥伦比亚大学的尔斯·卡罗米里斯（Charles Calomiris）提出了他所谓的“财政程序的真正破坏”质疑 — — 资金的来源和去向都不透明。
en: Charles Calomiris of Columbia University has challenged what he calls “a real subversion of the fiscal process” as funds are raised and spent in non-transparent ways.

zh: 但是，最重要的问题是如此大规模的罚金是否能起到有用的威慑作用。
en: The most important question, however, is whether fines on this scale serve as useful deterrents.

zh: 显然，后危机时代披露了许多机构存在不可接受的行为。
en: Clearly, the post-crisis period has revealed unacceptable behavior in many institutions.

zh: 在我们了解大额公司罚款 — — 主要由股东掏腰包 — — 是否有助于保持金融体系的诚信之前需要时间。
en: It will be some time before we know whether large fines on corporations, paid principally by their shareholders, contribute to keeping the system honest.

zh: 但在银行和投资者都是一笔糊涂账、对监管机构的出击无动于衷时，这似乎是不可能的。
en: But that seems unlikely when banks and investors seem punch-drunk, barely reacting to regulators’ blows.

zh: 每一起新和解对名誉的影响都十分有限，尽管罚金规模在逐步升级。
en: The reputational impact of each new settlement is modest, despite the escalation in the level of fines imposed.

zh: FCA刚刚宣布要检查它的定价政策。
en: The FCA has just announced a review of its pricing policies.

zh: “这不是罚金比赛 ， ” FCA执法战略主管乔治娜·费利佩（ Georgina Philippou）说。
en: “This is not a penalties race,” according to Georgina Philippou, the authority’s enforcement strategy director.

zh: 目前的办法是否有效威慑仍是一个值得广泛讨论的问题。
en: Whether the current approach serves as an effective deterrent is a question that should be widely debated.

zh: 发展更有效的体系 — — 一个惩罚罪行、为未来提供正确激励的体系 — — 符合银行高管和高层监管者的共同利益。
en: Senior bank managers and regulators have a common interest in developing a more effective system – one that punishes the guilty and creates the right incentives for the future.

zh: 因特网上的恐惧和自由
en: Fear and Freedom on the Internet

zh: 据报道本月月初，应中国统治者要求，微软关闭了一家建立在MSN分享空间上的中国博客网站。
en: Earlier this month it was reported that, at the request of China’s rulers, Microsoft shut down the Web site of a Chinese blogger that was maintained on a Microsoft service called MSN Spaces.

zh: 博客版主赵静（音译）此前报导了《新京报》记者的罢工事件，这次罢工的起因是该报思想独立的编辑遭到解雇。
en: The blogger, Zhao Jing, had been reporting on a strike by journalists at The Beijing News that followed the dismissal of the newspaper’s independent-minded editor.

zh: 微软的所作所为突显了一个关键问题：因特网真的能够成为高压政府无法像报纸、电台和电视台那样轻易操纵的自由力量吗？
en: Microsoft’s action raises a key question: can the Internet really be a force for freedom that repressive governments cannot control as easily as newspapers, radio, and television?

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，微软的创立者和主席比尔·盖茨一直是这种观点狂热的倡导者。
en: Ironically, Microsoft’s founder and chairman, Bill Gates, has been an enthusiastic advocate of this view.

zh: 就在去年10月，他说过 ： “ 今天从广义上来讲，确实无法再压制信息了，我认为这是值得所有人高兴的奇妙的进步…互联网是完全公开和彻底自由的载体，这也正是互联网的特别之处。 ”
en: Just last October, he said: “There’s really no way to, in a broad sense, repress information today, and I think that’s a wonderful advance we can all feel good about….[T]his is a medium of total openness and total freedom, and that’s what makes it so special.”

zh: 尽管如此慷慨陈词，微软还是竭尽所能地帮助中国当局压制信息。
en: Despite these sentiments, Microsoft is helping the Chinese authorities to repress information as best they can.

zh: 据报导微软的一位发言人说该公司已经封锁了中国的“很多站点 ” ， 而且几个月来外界传言微软在华的博客工具一直从标题中过滤“民主”和“人权”这样的字眼。
en: A Microsoft spokeswoman was reported as saying that the corporation has blocked “many sites” in China, and it has been known for several months that Microsoft’s blog tool in China filters words like “democracy” and “human rights” from blog titles.

zh: 微软的辩护是它必须“遵守当地和全球的法律 ” 。
en: Microsoft’s defense is that it must “comply with local and global laws.”

zh: 但MSN分享空间的站点却是设在美国境内的服务器上。
en: But the MSN Spaces sites are maintained on servers in the United States.

zh: 因此相关法律似乎应该是美国法律，而赵静有关北京记者罢工的讨论根本就没有任何违法之处。
en: The relevant local laws would therefore seem to be those of the US, and Zhao Jing’s discussion of the Beijing journalists’ strike does not violate any of them.

zh: 此外世界上也没有任何一条法律阻止中国人民探讨政府不希望他们探讨的问题。
en: Nor are there any global laws that prevent Chinese people from discussing events that their government would prefer them not to discuss.

zh: 比如《纽约时报》有权自由地刊登对罢工的报导，尽管它所经营的网站只要上网不受管制都可以阅读。
en: TheNew York Times, for example, is free to publish its report on the strike, even though it operates a Web site that anyone with unfettered Internet access can read.

zh: 如果中国政府不希望人民阅读外国报纸，那么应该由它自己想出封锁的办法，而报纸本身却没有义务替它这么做。
en: If the Chinese government does not want its citizens to read a foreign newspaper,then it is up to them to figure out how to block access to it. The newspaper is under no obligation to do it for them.

zh: 因此微软的辩护文不对题。
en: So Microsoft’s defense misfires.

zh: 我们只能对它封杀站点的真正原因进行猜测，但害怕其在中国的商业利益受到损害很可能是一个重要的因素。
en: We can only guess at the company’s real reason for taking down the Web site, but fear of repercussions against its commercial interests in China seems likely to have been an important factor.

zh: 可以肯定的是，企业有权也理应对服务使用者做出限制。
en: To be sure, a corporation can and should place limits on the use of its services.

zh: 绝对论路线¾推行彻底的言论自由¾在令人不快的例证面前失去了根基。
en: The absolutist line – let complete freedom of expression prevail – crumbles in the face of uncomfortable examples.

zh: 据盖茨讲，微软可能阻止使用它提供的服务来传播制造核炸弹的方法、将支持纳粹的言论传入视其为非法的德国、以及传播儿童色情文学等方面的言论。
en: According to Gates, Microsoft might prevent the use of its services to spread instructions about making nuclear bombs, to send pro-Nazi statements into Germany, where such material is illegal, and to propagate child pornography.

zh: 但这些例子的相关性又有多高呢？
en: But how relevant are such examples?

zh: 在言论自由的经典著作《论自由》中，约翰·斯图亚特·密尔（John Stuart Mill）提出确保言论自由最重要的原因是尽可能促进各种思想之间的竞争，而无拘无束的辩论是检验思想的最佳方法。
en: In his classic defense of freedom of expression, On Liberty, John Stuart Mill argued that the most important reason for freedom of expression is to promote competition between the widest possible range of ideas, and that unfettered debate is the best way to test them.

zh: 而对政府来讲，保护主张不受诘难的最好方法莫过于将其变成没有生命的僵硬教条，而不管这些思想是否正确。
en: For the government to protect ideas from criticism is to turn them into a lifeless and rigid dogma, regardless of whether they are true.

zh: 如果我们赞同密尔的论述，那么盖茨所举的例子只有一个属于言论保护的范畴。
en: If we agree with Mill, then only one of Gates’s examples falls into the category of expression that should be protected.

zh: 制造核炸弹的秘诀应该是技术，而不是思想。
en: Recipes for making nuclear bombs are techniques, not ideas.

zh: 儿童色情文学也不是思想的表达。
en: Nor is child pornography the expression of ideas.

zh: 因此我们可以对这上述两者进行限制，而不违反密尔的观点。
en: We may therefore restrict both of them without running afoul of Mill’s argument.

zh: （另一方面，有篇文章提出成人对儿童在性方面产生兴趣并无过错，这样的行为理应得到容忍，因为它们是人们思想的表达，因此无论它在我们看来是多么有害，都不应该受到审查。 ）
en: (On the other hand, an essay arguing that there is nothing wrong with adults taking a sexual interest in children, and that such conduct should be permitted, expresses ideas, and thus should not be censored, no matter how poisonous we may consider them.)

zh: 盖茨的三个例子中最难判断的一个就是在互联网上对德国传播纳粹主义言论。
en: The most difficult of Gates’s three examples is that of pro-Nazi statements on a Web site aimed at Germany.

zh: 德国为什么希望禁止这样的言论不言而喻。
en: It is easy to understand why Germany would wish to prohibit such statements.

zh: 有几个国家的法律禁止煽动种族仇恨，如果它们禁止的范围真的仅限于煽动仇恨而不是压制人们的思维和言论，无论这样的言论有多坏，那么按照密尔为自由所做的辩护，这样的法律也可以算作正义的化身。
en: Several countries’ laws proscribe incitement of racial hatred, which can be justified, consistently with Mill’s defense of liberty, if such laws really focus narrowly on incitement of hatred rather than on suppressing arguments, bad as they may be, that appeal to people’s intellectual capacities.

zh: 为压制纳粹思想辩护的人可能提出这种思想已经受到了审判，而且已经无法创造一个更加美好的社会，不仅如此，它还带来了人们想象之中最为可怕的后果。
en: A defender of suppression of Nazi ideas might argue that have already been tried, and have failed – in the most horrendous manner imaginable – to produce a better society.

zh: 即便如此，德国已经把纳粹历史抛在脑后的最佳标志就是特别制定反对煽动民族仇恨，而不是纳粹主义的法律。
en: Nevertheless, the best possible sign that Germany has overcome its Nazi past would be to focus its laws specifically on incitement to racial hatred, rather than on Nazism as such.

zh: 无论如何，中国压制对国内事件的直接报导和探讨并不是压制一种名誉扫地的政治理念，而是压制充分理解信息后的公开政治探讨。
en: In any case, China’s crackdown on straightforward reporting and discussion of events taking place in that country is not the suppression of a discredited political ideology, but of open and informed political debate.

zh: 如果比尔·盖茨真的相信因特网应该成为一种开放的力量，那么他应该确保微软不会成为中国政府的帮凶。
en: If Bill Gates really believes that the Internet should be a liberating force, he should ensure that Microsoft does not do the dirty work of China’s government.

zh: 欧洲的恐惧和仇视
en: Fear and Loathing in Europe

zh: 在最新的奥地利大选中，两个极右翼政党即奥地利自由党和奥地利未来运动赢得29%的选票，这是它们在2006年选举中获得总票数的两倍。
en: Two far-right parties, the Austrian Freedom Party and the Movement for Austria’s Future, won 29% of the vote in the latest Austrian general election, double their total in the 2006 election.

zh: 这两个党派对移民、特别是穆斯林移民以及欧盟抱有相同的态度，也就是恐惧和仇视。
en: Both parties share the same attitudes toward immigrants, especially Muslims, and the European Union: a mixture of fear and loathing.

zh: 由于两党领导人斯特拉赫和海德尔相互蔑视，因此，极右翼联合政府组阁的可能性不大。
en: Since the two parties’ leaders, Heinz-Christian Strache and Jörg Haider, despise each other, there is little chance of a far-right coalition taking power.

zh: 但是，奥地利是希特勒的故乡，犹太人曾经被迫用牙刷清洗维也纳的街道，随后遭到驱逐和杀戮。 因此，这一选举结果令人担忧。
en: Nonetheless, this is Adolf Hitler’s native land, where Jews were once forced to scrub Vienna’s streets with toothbrushes before being deported and killed, so the result is disturbing.

zh: 然而，担忧程度有多大呢？
en: But how disturbing?

zh: 这29%的得票率要超过欧洲其他国家民粹主义极右翼政党在其好年景中所获票数15 % 。
en: That 29% is about 15% more than populist right-wing parties get in very good years (for them) in other European countries.

zh: 自由党领导人斯特拉赫想要让政府建立一个新部门来管理遣返移民。
en: Strache, the leader of the Freedom Party, wants the government to create a new ministry to manage the deportation of immigrants.

zh: 穆斯林遭到公开的贬低。
en: Muslims are openly disparaged.

zh: 海德尔曾经称赞希特勒第三帝国的就业措施。
en: Haider once praised the employment practices of Hitler’s Third Reich.

zh: 新的右翼人物将会不可避免地带回纳粹突击队和种族法律的记忆。
en: Inevitably, the new rightists bring back memories of storm troopers and race laws.

zh: 但是，把奥地利右翼的崛起看成是纳粹主义的复苏是错误的。
en: Yet, to see the rise of the Austrian right as a revival of Nazism is a mistake.

zh: 两党没有一个主张暴力，即便它们的某些严辞或许会引发联想。
en: Neither party advocates violence, even if some of their rhetoric might inspire it.

zh: 极右翼的选民们也许是受到担忧和仇恨、而非意识形态的鼓动而投票。 许多欧洲国家都感受到了这些担忧和仇恨，包括荷兰以及丹麦等没有纳粹传统的国家。
en: Voters for the far right may be motivated less by ideology than by anxieties and resentments that are felt in many European countries, including ones with no Nazi tradition, such as The Netherlands and Denmark.

zh: 在丹麦，极右翼的丹麦人民党拥有25个议会席位，是丹麦的第三大政党。
en: In Denmark, the hard-right Danish People’s Party, with 25 parliamentary seats, is the country’s third largest party.

zh: 荷兰的民粹主义者如威尔德斯受到所谓“伊斯兰化”偏执恐惧的驱使，给传统政治精英、也就是自由党、社民党和基民党施加了巨大的压力。
en: Dutch populists, such as Rita Verdonk or Geert Wilders, who is driven by a paranoid fear of “Islamization,” are putting the traditional political elites – a combination of liberals, social democrats, and Christian democrats – under severe pressure.

zh: 这就是问题所在。
en: This is precisely the point.

zh: 欧洲国家极右翼选民最大的仇恨就是针对政治精英们。 在许多人眼里，这些政治精英在舒服的联合政府中执政时间过长，而这些政府看起来主要就是为了保护既得利益。
en: The biggest resentment among right-wing voters in European countries is reserved for political elites, who, in the opinion of many, have been governing for too long in cozy coalitions, which appear to exist chiefly to protect vested interests.

zh: 在奥地利，甚至连自由党都承认社民党和基民党政府无休止地轮流执政，已经堵塞了政治体系动脉。 小党派难以穿透政治特权的堡垒。
en: In Austria, even liberals admit that an endless succession of social democratic and Christian democratic governments has clogged the political system’s arteries, making it difficult for smaller parties to penetrate what is seen as a bastion of political privilege.

zh: 领导人都是好心好意而又家长式作风。 直到最近，人们很少质疑这些领导人有关“多元文化 ” 、 “宽容”以及“欧洲”的观点。
en: The same is true in The Netherlands, which has been governed for decades by the same middle-of-the-road parties, led by benevolent but rather paternalistic figures, whose views about “multiculturalism,” “tolerance,” and “Europe,” were, until recently, rarely challenged.

zh: 战后，欧洲民主国家只是在足球赛中容忍中表达民族主义，而非公共场合。
en: Expressions of nationalism in postwar European democracies were always tolerated in soccer stadiums, not in public life.

zh: 对于欧洲联合持怀疑态度被指责为顽固，甚至是种族主义。
en: Skepticism about European unity was routinely denounced as bigotry, or even a form of racism.

zh: 欧洲国家政府习惯于指责欧盟机构官僚要对不受欢迎的政策负责，从而进一步削弱了民族主义情感依附。 而人们越发把那些欧盟官僚们视为自我满足、享有特权以及不受问责的精英人物。
en: Attachment to national feeling was further undermined by governments’ habit of blaming unpopular policies on European Union bureaucrats, who are increasingly seen as yet another bunch of self-satisfied, privileged, and unaccountable elitists.

zh: 这与仇视移民有关。
en: This is linked to resentment of immigrants.

zh: 当六十年代来自土耳其和摩洛哥等国体力工人的后代们开始在欧洲城市中形成大量穆斯林少数族裔的时候，工薪阶层聚居区的紧张关系开始上升。
en: When the offspring of manual workers imported from countries such as Turkey and Morocco in the 1960’s began to form large Muslim minorities in European cities, tensions rose in working-class neighborhoods.

zh: 自由派精英人物经常把对犯罪和陌生习俗的抱怨指责为“种族主义 ” 。
en: Complaints about crime and unfamiliar customs were often dismissed by liberal elites as “racism.”

zh: 他们说人就是应该学会宽容。
en: People simply had to learn to be tolerant.

zh: 这些都没错。
en: None of this was necessarily wrong.

zh: 宽容、欧洲团结、不信任民族主义以及警惕种族主义值得赞许。
en: Tolerance, European unity, distrust of nationalism, and vigilance against racism are laudable goals.

zh: 但是在没有讨论、何况是批评的情况下推崇这些目标造成副作用。
en: But promoting these aims without discussion, let alone criticism, resulted in a backlash.

zh: 当荷兰、法国以及爱尔兰选民否决欧洲宪法的时候，他们是在表达对其政治精英的不信任。
en: When the Dutch, the French, and the Irish voted against the European constitution, they were expressing distrust of their political elites.

zh: 那些保证通过拒绝“欧洲 ” 、 反抗“伊斯兰化”以及驱逐移民来恢复国家主权的民粹主义者正好利用了这一不信任感。
en: And populists who promise to restore national sovereignty by rejecting “Europe,” fighting “Islamization,” and kicking out immigrants are exploiting this distrust.

zh: 排外主义以及沙文主义的论调是难受的，而且，在奥地利历史背景下，也是令人担忧的。
en: The rhetoric of xenophobia and chauvinism is unpleasant, and, in a country with Austria’s past, even alarming.

zh: 但是，新的民粹主义还不是非民主的，甚至也不是反对民主。
en: But the new populism is not yet undemocratic, or even anti-democratic.

zh: 在奥地利极右翼选民中最为经常听到的词语是“新鲜空气 ” 。
en: The phrase most often heard in Austria among voters of the right-wing parties is “fresh air.”

zh: 人们说他们投海德尔和斯特拉赫的票为的是打破统治党派的把持。
en: People say they voted for Haider and Strache to break the stranglehold of the ruling parties.

zh: 这一动机并非无理。
en: This is not an illegitimate motivation.

zh: 如果人们对其民族身份认同、政府的主权以及社会的人口和社会构成感到担忧，那么，这些恐惧最好在政治场合表达出来。
en: If people are anxious about their national identities, the sovereignty of their governments, the demographic and social complexion of their societies, such fears are best voiced in the political arena.

zh: 只要人们通过选票而非暴力表达关切，而无论这些关切在自由派听来有多么不顺耳，民主都不会受到严重伤害。
en: As long as people express their concerns, however distasteful to liberal ears, by votes, not violence, democracy will not be seriously harmed.

zh: 当然，全球各地民粹主义精髓就是反对政治精英。
en: Running against the political elite is, of course, the essence of populism everywhere.

zh: 美国总统候选人即使是前总统的儿子表面上也要对抗华盛顿的政治精英。
en: American presidential candidates pretend to run against “Washington” even when they are the sons of former presidents.

zh: 当人们不仅对精英、而且对制度本身丧失信心就会产生真正的破坏。
en: Real damage is done when people lose confidence, not only in the elites, but in the system itself.

zh: 这种事情在欧洲尚未发生，即使奥地利也是如此。
en: This has not yet happened in Europe, not even in Austria.

zh: 现在，传统自由党派没有必要惊慌失措，通过讨好相同的仇恨对抗右翼。
en: There is no need for liberal, traditional parties, in a fit of panic, to battle the right by pandering to the same resentments.

zh: 但是应该在政治辩论中严肃对待这些仇视。
en: But those resentments should be taken seriously in political debates.

zh: 这样就可以遏制民众反感。
en: That way, the dangers of popular antipathies will be contained.

zh: 右翼通过挑战既得利益的腐化崛起不仅不会破坏民主，或许还会到头来加强民主。
en: Instead of damaging democracy, the rise of the right, by challenging the corruption of vested interests, might actually turn out to strengthen it.

zh: 第一世界的惧与怨
en: Fear and Loathing in the First World

zh: 在过去的几年中，世界经济最发达的国家的人们开始对中国、印度和其它拥有廉价劳力大军的新兴国家的经济实力极度担心。
en: Within the last few years, people throughout the world's most advanced economies have become acutely worried about the economic prowess of China, India, and other emerging countries with large low-wage populations.

zh: 他们担心自己的饭碗和子女的未来。 他们必须同世界上最贫穷的国家展开竞争。
en: They fear for their own jobs and for their children's future in a world where they must compete alongside the world's poorest.

zh: 这些担心正考验着世界上最富有的国家的政治领袖们。
en: Those fears are testing political leaders in the world's richest countries.

zh: 新闻报道是这种日益强烈的担忧的一个指标。
en: Newspaper stories are an indicator of this rising concern.

zh: 我在Lexis-Nexis数据库里搜索了全世界英文报纸中关于"外包 " 、 "工作"和"印度"三个关键词的新闻报道。
en: I searched the Lexis-Nexis database of English-language newspaper stories around the world that contained all three of the words "outsourcing," "jobs," and "India."

zh: 在1999年，Lexis-Nexis只收录了39篇报道；到2003年则有749篇报道。
en: In 1999, Lexis-Nexis produced only 39 stories; by 2003, there were 749 stories.

zh: 而在2004年的前6个月就已经有1208篇相关报道。
en: In the first six months of 2004, there were already 1208 stories.

zh: 当我用"外包 " 、 "工作"和"中国"三个关键词搜索时，结果也是大同小异。
en: The results were much the same when I searched "outsourcing," "jobs", and "China."

zh: 在我用法、德、意和西班牙文搜索时发现这三个关键词连用的频率也有相似的增长：90%的报道出现在2003和2004年。
en: I found similar growth in the use of these three terms together when I searched in French, German, Italian, and Spanish: 90% of the stories were in 2003 and 2004.

zh: 为什么这种关注出现了爆炸性的增长呢？
en: Why this explosion of concern?

zh: 毕竟，制造性的工作从发达国家转移到欠发达国家已经持续了50多年了。
en: After all, advanced countries have been losing manufacturing jobs to less developed countries for more than fifty years.

zh: 一个原因是新的信息技术，特别是移动电话和因特网的快速发展和使用让世界变小，并使来自海外的竞争成为可能。
en: One reason is that the expanding development and use of new information technology, notably cell phones and the Internet, shrinks the world and makes competition from abroad more plausible.

zh: 实际上新技术很可能就是全球化急速行进的最重要原因。
en: In fact, new technologies are probably the most important reason why globalization is advancing at a rapid pace.

zh: 移动电话和因特网将不同国家的人们的思想便利而有效地连接起来，从而促进了知识产品的贸易。
en: Cell phones and the Internet link the minds of many people in different countries effortlessly and efficiently, encouraging trade in intellectual creations.

zh: 同时，新的信息技术让我们更清楚地意识到向印度和中国转移的工作都是高质量的，由受过良好教育和技术熟练的人从事的工作。
en: At the same time, the new information technology makes us more aware that the kinds of jobs that are migrating to India and China are high-quality jobs, the jobs for educated and skilled people.

zh: 在过去的50年里，发达国家的人们日益重视通过大学教育和特别训练来确保自己不被残酷的劳力市场淘汰。
en: Over the last fifty years, people in advanced countries have increasingly sought university education and specialized training to protect them from an unforgiving labor market.

zh: 而现在第一世界的人们甚至不能确定这样做能否保障他们的经济地位。
en: Now First-Worlders are uncertain whether even this will protect their economic status.

zh: 对来自新兴国家的竞争的恐惧也是2000年资产投机泡沫破裂的自然结果；一些国家的股市市值跌倒不及顶峰时期的一半。
en: Increased fear of competition from emerging countries is also a natural consequence of the collapse of the speculative bubble in equities in 2000; stock markets in some countries fell to less than half their peak value.

zh: 一旦我们发现对投资回报过高的期望不能实现时，就开始考虑其它收入和财富的来源。 但此时所要面对的却是始于2001年的世界性经济增速放缓。
en: Once we saw our exaggerated hopes for our investments failing, we began to consider our other sources of income and wealth, only to confront the worldwide economic slowdown that began in 2001.

zh: 高涨的经济焦虑自然引发了对外国竞争的日渐强烈的不安。
en: Increased economic anxiety has, unsurprisingly, fueled increasing unease about foreign competition.

zh: 今年早些时候，我在美国的四个城市对最近购房的人们进行了调查。
en: Earlier this year, I surveyed people who recently bought homes in four American cities.

zh: 我在问卷中问道 ： " 有鉴于经济变化（诸如中国的某人和你竞争同一份工作，电脑取代了你的工作等）可能带来的风险，你对你（或你的家庭）在未来赚取同样收入的能力感到担心吗？
en: My questionnaire asked: "Do you worry that your (or your household's) ability to earn as much income in future years as you expect might be in danger because of changes in the economy (someone in China competing for your job, a computer replacing your job, etc.)?"

zh: "在442名受访者中，11%的人回答 ： " 是，我非常担心 " ， 36%的人回答 ： " 是，我有点担心 " ， 而有55%的人回答 ： " 不，我毫不担心。
en: Of 442 respondents, 11% answered, "Yes, I worry a lot," 36% replied, "Yes, I worry a little," and 52% said, "No, I don't worry at all."

zh: "因此，虽然多数人表示不担心，但也有近半数的人表示了不同程度的担忧。
en: Thus, while most respondents said they were not worried, nearly half expressed some worry.

zh: 我还询问了新近的购房者们是否同意美国（和其它许多发达国家）的房地产价格大幅上扬是因为人们担心失去工作这一理论。
en: I asked this question of recent homebuyers on the theory that fear of job loss might help explain the remarkable boom in home prices in the US (as well as many other advanced countries).

zh: 毕竟，担心失去工作的人们可能会通过投资不动产寻求更大的经济保障从而带动房地产价格上涨。
en: After all, people who fear losing their jobs may seek greater economic security by investing in real property in their own wealthy country, bidding up prices in the process.

zh: 我的调查结果在某种程度上支持了这种理论。
en: My survey's results lend some support to this theory.

zh: 虽然81%的受访者表示失去工作的担忧并没有影响他们的购房决定，但在给予肯定回答的人中，认为这种担心鼓励人们购房的人数比持相反意见的人数多出一倍。
en: Although 81% of the respondents said fear of job loss had no effect on their decision to buy a house, of those who said it did, the number who said it encouraged home purchase outnumbered those who said it discouraged home purchase by a margin of two to one.

zh: 对外国竞争日益增长的恐惧在未来能够解释许多事情。
en: Growing fear of foreign competition ought to explain a lot of things in the future.

zh: 人们曾一度认为自己不会受到发生在外国的经济问题影响。
en: People used to feel insulated from economic problems that occurred beyond their country's borders.

zh: 而实际情况已不再如此。
en: No more.

zh: 对来自国外的竞争的恐惧现在具有根本性的影响，它还将会改变全世界发达国家和相对发达的新兴国家的政治进程。
en: Fear of competition from abroad is now fundamental, and will change the political process in advanced and relatively advanced emerging countries throughout the world.

zh: 它也能解释保护主义的抬头和世贸组织去年9月旨在改善新兴国家在发达国家的市场准入的Cancun谈判无果而终的原因。
en: It helps explain the rise of protectionism, and the failure of the WTO trade talks in Cancun last September to improve emerging countries' access to advanced-country markets.

zh: 作为一名教授，我发现我的学生时常以一种与以往不同的语气向我寻求个人事业方面的建议。
en: As a professor, I find that my students often ask me for career advice with a different tone than in the past.

zh: 我所听到的是他们对自己能在所选择的职业方面表现出色缺乏根本的信心。
en: What I hear is a fundamental lack of confidence that they will do well in any chosen career.

zh: 他们想要明白如何才能与和受过同等甚至更良好教育的中国人和印度人竞争。
en: They want to figure out how they can compete with Chinese or Indian workers who have the same, or better, education.

zh: 尽管有美国优越感的虚张声势，这些学生自身似乎并没有什么优越感，他们反倒在琢磨着自己是否会在未来的日子里过一种新兴国家似的生活。
en: Despite bravado about American superiority, the students themselves do not seem to feel superior, and wonder if they will be living emerging-country lives of their own in coming years.

zh: 这种对新兴国家的突然的恐惧代表着一种巨大的困境。
en: This sudden fear of emerging countries presents a major dilemma.

zh: 这种恐惧是真实而内在的。 忽视它的政治家们前途堪忧。
en: The fear is real and visceral, and politicians ignore it at their peril.

zh: 这种恐惧的继续增长可能会导致保护主义的反作用。
en: Its further increase could lead to counterproductive protectionist measures.

zh: 我们决不能让这种情况发生。
en: We must not let this happen.

zh: 新兴国家所做的仅仅是努力发展向发达国家看齐因而无可厚非。
en: The emerging countries are doing nothing more blameworthy than working towards their place as equals alongside advanced countries.

zh: 它们的成功在道德和实践上都是极为重要的。
en: It is morally and practically vital that they succeed.

zh: 全球市场中的恐慌因素
en: The Fear Factor in Global Markets

zh: 坎布里奇—去年波澜壮阔的市场波动在很大程度上要归因于中国增长、欧洲银行和石油过剩等因素的真风险和不确定性。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The phenomenal market volatility of the past year owes much to genuine risks and uncertainties about factors such as Chinese growth, European banks, and the oil glut.

zh: 对今年前两个月，许多投资者开始担心，就连全世界最令人放心的增长故事美国也即将陷入衰退。
en: For the first two months of this year, many investors were panicked that even the United States, the world’s most comforting growth story, was about to fall into recession.

zh: 事实上，在《华尔街日报》月度调查做出预测的专家中，有21%认为衰退就在眼前。
en: Indeed, among the experts who participate in the Wall Street Journal’s monthly poll, 21% believed a recession was around the corner.

zh: 我不否认存在风险。
en: I won’t deny that there are risks.

zh: 如果中国增长或欧洲金融体系受到足够大的打击，全球经济肯定将从慢增长转变为衰退。
en: A big enough hit to China’s growth or to Europe’s financial system could certainly tip the global economy from slow growth to recession.

zh: 而更加可怕的观点是，明年今日，美国总统可能沦为一场现实电视秀。
en: An even more frightening thought is that by this time next year, the US presidency may have turned into a reality television show.

zh: 但是，从宏观经济角度看，基本面根本没有那么糟。
en: Yet, from a macroeconomic perspective, the fundamentals are just not that bad.

zh: 就业数字一直强势，消费信心稳固，石油行业相对GDP的规模还没有大到油价暴跌导致美国经济要“跪”的地步。
en: Employment numbers have been strong, consumer confidence is solid, and the oil sector is just not large enough relative to GDP for the price collapse to bring the US economy to its knees.

zh: 事实上，目前最不受关注的市场情绪推动因素是另一场大危机。
en: In fact, the most under-appreciated driver of market sentiment right now is fear of another huge crisis.

zh: 今天的不安和二战后十年的市场情绪有一些相似之处。
en: There are some parallels between today’s unease and market sentiment in the decade after World War II.

zh: 这两个时期都存在巨大的安全资产需求。
en: In both cases, there was outsize demand for safe assets.

zh: （当然，金融抑制在战后也起着重要作用，政府以低于市场水平的利率用债务扼住私人投资者的咽喉。 ）
en: (Of course, financial repression also played a big role after the war, with governments stuffing debt down private investors’ throats at below-market interest rates.)

zh: 即使在二战结束整整十年后，著名经济学家加尔布雷斯（John Kenneth Galbraith）预测世界可能经历又一场萧条，市场应声慌乱。
en: Even a full decade after World War II, when the famous economist John Kenneth Galbraith opined that the world might experience another depression, markets went into a tizzy.

zh: 人们仍然记得美国股市如何在大萧条的开头几年跌去90 % 。
en: People still remembered how the US stock market had fallen 90% during the early years of the Great Depression.

zh: 20世纪50年代，不难想象局势可能再次变坏。
en: Back in the 1950s, it was not hard to imagine that things might go wrong again.

zh: 毕竟，世界刚刚从一系列灾难中走出，包括两次世界大战，一次全球流感大流行，以及大萧条本身。
en: After all, the world had just navigated through a series of catastrophes, including two world wars, a global influenza epidemic, and of course the Depression itself.

zh: 六十年后，原子战争的幽灵似乎随时都会成为现实。
en: Sixty years ago, the specter of atomic war also seemed all too real.

zh: 今天的人们不需要提醒就知道股市可以以多么快的速度下跌多么深。
en: People today need no reminding about how far and how fast equity markets can fall.

zh: 2008年金融危机后，美国股市跌去50%以上。
en: After the 2008 financial crisis, US stocks fell by more than 50%.

zh: 一些其他国家的股市跌幅更大：比如冰岛股市跌去90%以上。
en: Equity markets in some other countries fell significantly more: Iceland’s, for example, plummeted by over 90%.

zh: 毫不奇怪，当最近市场跌幅达到20%时，很多人不知道情况可能有多糟糕 — — 也不知道新衰退恐慌是否会成为自我实现的预言。
en: No wonder that once the recent market drop hit 20%, many people wondered how much worse it could get – and whether fears of a new recession could become a self-fulfilling prophecy.

zh: 这里的思想是投资者过于担心衰退，而股市跌幅过大，以致于看熊情绪通过大幅降低额支出反馈到实体经济，让担心的衰退成为现实。
en: The idea is that investors become so worried about a recession, and that stocks drop so far, that bearish sentiment feeds back into the real economy through much lower spending, bringing on the feared downturn.

zh: 这也许是对的，即使市场总是高估它对实体经济的影响。
en: They might be right, even if the markets overrate their own influence on the real economy.

zh: 另一方面，在全球增长乏��的情况下，美国仍在前进，这一事实表明内需强劲。
en: On the other hand, the fact that the US has managed to move forward despite global headwinds suggests that domestic demand is robust.

zh: 但市场似乎对此不买账。
en: But this doesn’t seem to impress markets.

zh: 即使仍对美国经济抱谨慎乐观的投资者也担心美联储将增长作为继续提高利率的理由，给新兴市场带来巨大的问题。
en: Even those investors who remain cautiously optimistic about the US economy worry that the US Federal Reserve will view growth as a reason to continue raising interest rates, creating huge problems for emerging economies.

zh: 当然，除了恐慌，还有其他因素解释波动。
en: There are other explanations for volatility besides fear, of course.

zh: 最简单的解释是事情真的有那么糟。
en: The simplest is that things really are that bad.

zh: 也许个别风险与20世纪50年代不是一个量级，但现在的个别风险数量更多，并且时常是在一个通胀程度远远更大的起点起步的。
en: Maybe the individual risks aren’t of the same order of magnitude as in the 1950s, but there are more of them, and markets are starting from a much more inflated position.

zh: 此外，金融全球化极大地深化了互联，放大了冲击的传播。
en: Moreover, financial globalization has profoundly deepened interlinkages, magnifying the transmission of shocks.

zh: 世界债务市场存在巨大的脆弱性和弱点，目前的货币宽松政策掩盖了深层次的问题。
en: There are large pockets of fragility and weakness in world debt markets, with current monetary easing covering up deep-rooted problems beneath the surface.

zh: 一些人指出，领先市场缺乏流动性是价格大部震荡的原因；在一个规模很小的市场中，有时需求或供给的微小变化就需要巨大的价格调整幅度才能重塑均衡。
en: Some have pointed to a lack of liquidity in leading markets as driving the massive price fluctuations; in a thin market, a small change in demand or supply can sometimes require a big shift in prices to restore equilibrium.

zh: 尽管如此，最令人信服的解释仍然是市场害怕当外部风险真的发生时，政客和决策者不能有效应对它们。
en: The most convincing explanation, though, is still that markets are afraid that when external risks do emerge, politicians and policymakers will be ineffective in confronting them.

zh: 金融危机所揭示的最大的弱点之一正是政策瘫痪是如此严重。
en: Of all the weaknesses revealed by the financial crisis, policy paralysis has been the most profound.

zh: 有人说政府在提振需求方面做得不够。
en: Some say that governments did not do enough to stoke demand.

zh: 诚然，但这不是问题的全部。
en: Although that is true, it is not the whole story.

zh: 困扰当今世界的最大的问题是大部分国家没有实施结构改革。
en: The biggest problem burdening the world today is most countries’ abject failure to implement structural reforms.

zh: 生产率增长至少暂时处于低速挡，全球人口呈现出长期下降趋势，在这样的背景下，供给端，而不是需求端，才是发达经济体的真正约束。
en: With productivity growth at least temporarily stuck in low gear, and global population in long-term decline, the supply side, not lack of demand, is the real constraint in advanced economies.

zh: 在长期，供给因素决定着一国的增长。
en: In the long run, it is supply factors that determine a country’s growth.

zh: 如果国家无法在危机后管理好深层次结构改革，就难以预料会发生什么。
en: And if countries cannot manage deep structural reform after a crisis, it is hard to see how it will happen.

zh: 治大国如演真实电视秀，一只眼紧盯收视率绝不是做好工作的“正确姿势 ” 。
en: Running the government like a reality TV show, with one eye always on the ratings, is not going to do the job.

zh: 金融恐惧症
en: Fear of Finance

zh: 对金融的恐惧正与日俱增。
en: Fear of finance is on the march.

zh: 对那些拿着高薪在电脑前不知所谓地忙活的人的不信任感十分普遍。
en: Distrust of highly paid people who work behind computer screens doing something that doesn’t look like productive work is everywhere.

zh: 纸上谈兵的比从事生产的赚得多；投机者比经理人赚得多；交易员比企业家赚得多；套利者比积累者赚得多；而在这些表象的背后原因是金融市场比国家更强大。
en: Paper shufflers are doing better than producers; speculators are doing better than managers; traders are doing better than entrepreneurs; arbitrageurs are doing better than accumulators; the clever are doing better than the solid; and behind all of it, the financial market is more powerful than the state.

zh: 一般民意认为这种情况是不公平的。
en: Common opinion suggests that this state of affairs is unjust.

zh: 正如弗兰克林•罗斯福所说，我们必须将这些“钱商”从他们“在我们文明圣殿里的宝座上”推下来。
en: As Franklin D. Roosevelt put it, we must cast down the “money changers” from their “high seats in the temple of our civilization.”

zh: 我们必须“重建古老的真理 ” ， 即培植、制造和发明事物的工作应该比金融家们所做的享有更高的地位、更大的荣誉和更好的报酬。
en: We must “restore the ancient truths” that growing, making, managing, and inventing things should have higher status, more honor, and greater rewards than whatever it is that financiers do.

zh: 当然，现代全球金融着实让人恐惧。
en: Of course, there is a lot to fear in modern global finance.

zh: 其规模令人震撼：今年的并购交易总额超过了4万亿美元。 可交易和（理论上的）流动性金融资产在今年年底可能达到160万亿美元，而全球的年度GDP却只有50万亿美元。
en: Its scale is staggering: more than $4 trillion of mergers and acquisitions this year, with tradable and (theoretically) liquid financial assets reaching perhaps $160 trillion by the end of this year, all in a world where annual global GDP is perhaps $50 trillion.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院最近测算认为当今全世界的金融资产比全世界GDP高三倍多—三倍于1980年的比率（二战后的全球金融资产总值只比全球GDP高三分之二 ） 。
en: The McKinsey Global Institute recently estimated that world financial assets today are more than three times world GDP – triple the ratio in 1980 (and up from only two-thirds of world GDP after World War II).

zh: 还有一些巨大而令人费解的数字：300万亿美元的“衍生”证券；其中3万亿美元由12000个“对冲基金”管理；每年有1.2万亿美元以“私募股权”的形式存在。
en: And then there are the numbers that sound very large and are hard to interpret: $300 trillion in “derivative” securities; $3 trillion managed by 12,000 global “hedge funds”; $1.2 trillion a year in “private equity.”

zh: 但在我们现代全球金融体系中有些重要的东西被创造出来，它们既有正面的，也有负面的。
en: But important things are created in our modern global financial system, both positive and negative.

zh: 想想今年总值4万亿美元的并购吧。 各个公司收购并剥离分支或部门希望获得协同效应、市场实力或是更好的管理。
en: Consider the $4 trillion of mergers and acquisitions this year, as companies acquire and spin off branches and divisions in the hope of gaining synergies or market power or better management.

zh: 相对于其资产在并购前的价值，资产的出售方会获得约8000亿美元的收益。
en: Owners who sell these assets will gain roughly $800 billion relative to the pre-merger value of their assets.

zh: 收购方公司的股东则会损失约3000亿美元的市值，那是因为市场将收购理解为这样的信号，即：经理人们都是好大喜功、我行我素的野心家而不是为投资者创造最大化收益的、目光严峻的托管人。
en: The shareholders of the companies that buy will lose roughly $300 billion in market value, as markets interpret the acquisition as a signal that managers are exuberant and uncontrolled empire-builders rather than flinty-eyed trustees maximizing payouts to investors.

zh: 这3000亿美元是成长性公司的股东甘愿为精力充沛的公司管理者所支付的税（或者也可能是他们不得不支付的税 ） 。
en: This $300 billion is a tax that shareholders of growing companies think is worth paying (or perhaps cannot find a way to avoid paying) for energetic corporate executives.

zh: 约5000亿美元的全球市值收益从何而来？
en: Where does the net gain of roughly $500 billion in global market value come from?

zh: 我们不得而知。
en: We don’t know.

zh: 有一部分可能是因为一些公司的垄断实力增长损害消费者而使股东得益；有一部分是来自于更佳的管理和更合理的规模经营所带来的效益提升；还有一部分是来自于那些借公司出名的好大喜功者的超额支付。
en: Some of it is a destructive transfer from consumers to shareholders as corporations gain more monopoly power, some of it is an improvement in efficiency from better management and more appropriately scaled operations, and some of it is overpayment by those who become irrationally exuberant when companies get their names in the news.

zh: 如果以上三个因素每个都代表了净收益的三分之一，那么我们就能有以下的几个结论。
en: If each of these factors accounts for one-third of the net gain, several conclusions follow.

zh: 首先，一旦我们不只把目光局限在金融部门的交易中，那么就会发现这一块交易对全球的影响是以增加的真实股东价值的形式出现的约3400亿美元的收益。 而这种增长来自于更高的预期未来收益。
en: First, once we look outside transfers within the financial sector, the total global effects of this chunk of finance is a gain of perhaps $340 billion in increased real shareholder value from higher expected future profits.

zh: 1700亿美元的损失是由未来的真实薪资造成的，因为普通消费者会发现他们将为拥有更大市场实力的公司支付更高的利润边际。
en: A loss of $170 billion can be attributed to future real wages, for households will find themselves paying higher margins to companies with more market power.

zh: 因此2007年的净收益就是1700亿美元的增加社会价值，占全球GDP的0.3 % ， 相当于700万个工人的平均总产值。
en: The net gain is thus $170 billion of added social value in 2007, which is 0.3% of world GDP, equal to the average product of seven million workers.

zh: 从某种意义上讲，我们应该对这些努力工作的并购技师们心存感激，虽然他们收入不菲：管理不善或经营低效的公司从更有实力并有能力获得融资的公司那里受到压力是非常重要的。
en: In one sense, we should be grateful for our hard-working M&A technicians, well-paid as they are: it is important that businesses with lousy managements or that operate inefficiently be under pressure from those who may do better, and can raise the money to attempt to do so.

zh: 我们不能将股东民主作为唯一的公司控制系统。
en: We cannot rely on shareholder democracy as our only system of corporate control.

zh: 第二个结论是毛收益—付给赢家的费用、交易盈利和资本收益（可能是今年并购总值中的8000亿美元 ） - -大大超过1700美元的可能净收益。
en: The second conclusion is that the gross gains – fees, trading profits, and capital gains to the winners (perhaps $800 billion from this year’s M&A’s) – greatly exceed the perhaps $170 billion in net gains.

zh: 各国政府要发挥非常重要的教育、劝告和监管的作用：人们应该了解风险和概率，因为他们可能成为为那6300亿美元买单的失败者。
en: Governments have a very important educational, admonitory, and regulatory role to play: people should know the risks and probabilities, for they may wind up among losers of the other $630 billion.

zh: 但到目前为止似乎还很少有人明白这个道理。
en: So far there is little sign that they do.

zh: 最后，金融素来就对稳定的、高利润边际的垄断和寡头垄断感兴趣，而公众则青睐低利润边际的竞争性市场。
en: Finally, finance has long had an interest in stable monopolies and oligopolies with high profit margins, while the public has an interest in competitive markets with low margins.

zh: 你对政府反垄断政策在抵销并购带来的垄断实力增加方面的作用越怀疑，就越应该寻求其它渠道的抵销力量—也就是累进所得税制—来���销收入不平等的急剧拉大。
en: The more skeptical you are of the ability of government-run antitrust policy to offset the monopoly power-increasing effects of M&A’s, the more you should seek other sources of countervailing power – which means progressive income taxation – to offset any upward leap in income inequality.

zh: 十八世纪的重农主义者认为只有农民是具有生产力的，而其它所有人都在不同程度地骗取农民应得的份额。
en: Eighteenth-century physiocrats believed that only the farmer was productive, and that everyone else was somehow cheating the farmers out of their fair share.

zh: 二十世纪的马克思主义者对于工厂工人也持同样的观点。
en: Twentieth-century Marxists thought the same thing about factory workers.

zh: 这两种观点都是错误的。
en: Both were wrong.

zh: 让我们对金融市场进行监管以使其不会损害外部投资人的利益。
en: Let us regulate our financial markets so that outsiders who invest are not sheared.

zh: 但我们也不应该错误地对金融怀有过度的恐惧。
en: But let us not make the mistake of fearing finance too much.

zh: 聚光灯下的欧元区预算
en: Eurozone Budgets Under the Spotlight

zh: 都柏林—债券市场向来变化无常，常常被情绪而不是靠谱的宏观经济分析推动，而正如2008年全球金融危机所表明的，债券市场也绝不是永远正确的。
en: DUBLIN – Bond markets are notoriously fickle, often driven by sentiment rather than rigorous macroeconomic analysis, and, as the 2008 global financial crisis demonstrated, they are far from infallible.

zh: 在评估经济的长期前景时，债券市场可能极不靠谱。
en: They can also be particularly unreliable when assessing an economy’s long-term prospects.

zh: 尽管欧元区上下利率位于历史低点，但如果债券市场重新评估主权借款人的风险，欧元区政府债务可能面临严重压力。
en: Though interest rates across the European Union are at historic lows, government debt in the eurozone could come under severe pressure should bond markets re-evaluate the riskiness of sovereign borrowers.

zh: 在负债国政府向欧盟委员会递交预算以供检查时，它们应该考虑这一点。
en: That is a consideration that should weigh heavily on indebted governments as they submit their budgets for scrutiny to the European Commission.

zh: 受非理性繁荣（或相反）左右的并不只是债券交易员。
en: It is not just bond traders who can be swayed by irrational exuberance (or its opposite).

zh: 评级机构对资产质量的判断同样可能存在缺陷。
en: The verdicts of rating agencies on asset quality can also be flawed.

zh: 评级者更喜欢追随而不是引导情绪，这种事情已经见怪不改了。
en: Too often, the raters seem content to follow rather than lead sentiment.

zh: 就像寓言中看后视镜而不是眼前的巴士司机一样，太多债券分析员关注历史经济数据，以此作为未来表现的关键决定因素。
en: Like the proverbial bus driver fixated on what is happening in his rear view mirror rather than watching what is in front of him, too many bond analysts focus on historical economic data as the key determinant of future performance.

zh: 在这样的背景下，10月15日递交的欧元区政府预算必须进行评估。
