en: It is against this background that the budget plans submitted by eurozone governments on October 15 will have to be assessed.

zh: 欧元区稳定和增长契约（Stability and Growth Pact）的这一要求 — — 具体内容见欧盟运作条约（Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union）第126条 — — 适用于不能履行将预算赤字压在GDP的3%以下的承诺的成员国政府。
en: This requirement of the eurozone’s Stability and Growth Pact, specified by Article 126 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, applies to member states that fail to meet their commitments to bring their budget deficits below 3% of GDP.

zh: 主要的担心是大部分欧元区政府目前所能得到的低借贷利率不太可能持续下去。
en: The main source of concern is that the low interest rates at which most European governments can currently borrow are not likely to last.

zh: 原因有二。
en: There are two reasons for this.

zh: 首先，根据欧盟银行偿债能力和资本充足度计算规则，银行所持有的主权债券被视为无风险资产。
en: First, sovereign bonds held by banks are treated as risk-free assets under EU rules for calculating banks’ solvency and capital-adequacy levels.

zh: 这是一个危险的结社，因为这意味着没有一个欧洲政府会出现无法按时足额连本付息偿还债券的情况。
en: This is a risky assumption, because it implies that no European government will ever fail to repay the bond in full, with all interest due, and on time.

zh: 但一些欧洲国家债务相对收入的水平之高让人颇为怀疑它们的债券是否真的无风险。
en: But the debt levels of some European countries relative to their income raise serious questions about whether their bonds really are risk-free.

zh: 而假设不会发生通胀剧增或经济增长，那么违约的危险就无法轻易排除。
en: And, assuming that there is no surge in inflation or economic growth, the danger of default cannot be so easily dismissed.

zh: 其次，低利率导致大量资金追逐极少数高收益机会，因此不难理解投资者转向了政府债券，从而进一步压低收益率。
en: Second, with low interest rates causing vast sums of money to chase so few opportunities for decent yields, it is understandable that investors have turned to government bonds, thereby driving down yields still further.

zh: 但这一局面不可能永远维持；如果资金流放缓，或者可以获得更高收益的资产，政府债券需求就有可能大幅下降。
en: But this situation cannot last forever; if the flow of funds slows, or alternative, higher-yielding assets become available, demand for government bonds could drop markedly.

zh: 此时，主权债务利率就不得不上升以维持政府的借贷规模。
en: At that point, interest rates on sovereign debt would have to rise to sustain governments’ borrowing levels.

zh: 这一情况离我们并不遥远，如果发生，将会给许多负债欧元区成员国预算带来灾难。
en: This is not a far-fetched scenario, and its realization would play havoc with the budgets of many indebted eurozone member states.

zh: 因此，在评估成员国预算草案时，政府和欧盟委员会假设政府债券将在可预见的未来维持低利率是愚蠢的。
en: Therefore, in assessing member states’ draft budgets, governments and the Commission would be foolish to assume that low interest rates on government bonds will be around for the foreseeable future.

zh: 如果投资者确实认定政府债券收益率已不再值得投资，主权借款人的选择将十分有限。
en: If investors do decide that government bond yields are no longer worth the investment, sovereign borrowers’ options may be limited.

zh: 它们可能可以挑战欧盟委员会，但顽抗债券市场观点将让它们付出沉重代价。
en: They might be able to defy the European Commission, but they would be hard-pressed to resist the views of the bond markets.

zh: 毕竟，世界金融中心不但容易爆发非理性行为；而且还不太会受可能在欧盟委员会和欧洲议会部长同僚那里获得些许同情的政治说辞的影响。
en: After all, the world’s financial centers are not only susceptible to bouts of irrationality; they are also less likely to be swayed by the sort of political rhetoric that might find some sympathy within the Commission or among ministerial colleagues in the EU Council.

zh: 此外，市场心理的转换可能发生得极为迅速，根本没有警示信号，政府根本没时间采取必要的财政调整。
en: Moreover, the market’s change of heart can occur very quickly and without warning, giving governments little if any time to make the necessary fiscal adjustments.

zh: 但如果欧盟协调18个欧元区成员国预算政策的制度（所谓的“两部法规”和“六部法规 ” （ Two Pack and Six Pack ） ） 可以获得尊重（特别是法国和意大利等大国的尊重 ） ， 则发生这一情况的可能性会小一点。
en: But that is less likely to happen if the EU system for coordinating the 18 eurozone members’ budget policies (the so-called Two Pack and Six Pack) is seen to be respected – especially by the larger countries, such as France and Italy.

zh: 另一方面，如果该制度受到违抗，或者以有违其初衷的方式解释，那么债券市场将再次紧张起来。
en: On the other hand, if the system is defied, or reinterpreted in a way that alters its intended meaning, bond markets could once again become nervous.

zh: 爱尔兰比大部分国家都更了解不得不借钱为维持和偿还到期债务所引起的困难。
en: Ireland knows better than most countries the difficulties that can arise from having to borrow to fund services or repay maturing debts.

zh: 美国的联邦主义和进步抵制
en: Federalism and Progressive Resistance in America

zh: 伯克利—2016年是民粹主义在美国、英国和其他许多发达国家崛起的一年。
en: BERKELEY – The year 2016 was one of ascendant populism in the United States, the United Kingdom, and many other developed countries.

zh: 在收入停滞、经济机会损失和丧失进步信念导致不满大幅扩散的情况下，选民选择支持承诺让权力回归“人民 ” 、 动摇主流政治领导人为了腐败“精英”的利益而“操纵”的制度的候选人。
en: With income stagnation, faltering economic opportunities, and a loss of faith in progress fueling widespread discontent, voters backed candidates who promised to return power to the “people” and to shake up systems that mainstream political leaders had “rigged” in favor of a corrupt “elite.”

zh: 在美国，日益增加的种族多样性、慢火焖炖般的种族紧张以及社会风俗的改变让选举之火火上浇油。
en: In the US, growing ethnic diversity, smoldering racial tensions, and changing social mores added fuel to the electoral fire.

zh: 在美国，对联邦政府的信任感的长期流失在11月唐纳德·特朗普赢得总统竞选中达到顶峰：尽管奥巴马总统得到了众多民众的认可，但只有19%的美国人相信联邦政府能做出正确的事。
en: In the US, long-term erosion of trust in the federal government culminated in Donald Trump’s victory in November’s presidential election: even though President Barack Obama enjoyed high public approval, only 19% of Americans trusted the federal government to do what is right.

zh: 考虑到共和党的政策重点传统 — — 从当选总统特朗普的内阁人选中可见一斑 — — 联邦政府项目可能遭到大量削减（军事是一个显著的例外 ） 。
en: Given traditional Republican priorities, reflected in President-elect Trump’s cabinet choices, federal government programs (with the notable exception of the military) are likely to be slashed.

zh: 讽刺的是，削减医疗、教育和培训以及环境支出，加上大规模累退性个人和企业减税，将进一步有利于“精英”而有损于惠及大部分家庭的项目。
en: Ironically, spending cuts for health, education and training, and the environment, along with large regressive personal and business tax reductions, will further enrich the “elite” while undermining programs that benefit the majority of households.

zh: 但联邦���目所解决的重大社会和经济挑战不会消失。
en: But the major social and economic challenges addressed by federal programs will not disappear.

zh: 处理它们的责任只是更多地落到了州和地方政府肩上，后者必须找到创新解决办法。
en: The responsibility to deal with them will merely fall more heavily on state and local governments, which will have to tackle them in innovative ways.

zh: 事实上，特朗普主义的答案是“进步联邦主义 ” ： 用授予美国联邦体系中的次国家级政府的重大权力追求进步政策。
en: Indeed, the answer to Trumpism is “progressive federalism”: the pursuit of progressive policy goals using the substantial authority delegated to subnational governments in the US federal system.

zh: 盖洛普年度调查仍然显示，大部分美国人信任州政府（62 % ） 和地方政府（71 % ） 能够解决问题。
en: Annual Gallup polls continue to show that a majority of Americans trust their state governments (62%) and their local governments (71%) to handle problems.

zh: 2014年的皮尤（Pew）研究发现，只有25%的受访者满意国家政策方向，但有60%满意本人所在社区的治理。
en: A 2014 Pew study found that while only 25% of respondents were satisfied with the direction of national policy, 60% were satisfied with governance in their own communities.

zh: 美国宪法允许各州充当布兰代斯（Brandeis）法官所谓的民主实验室，在不危及其他州的情况下实施创新政策。
en: And the US Constitution allows individual states to function as what Judge Brandeis called laboratories of democracy by experimenting with innovative policies without putting the rest of the country at risk.

zh: 成功实验历史既长，案例亦丰。
en: There is a long and rich history of successful experiments.

zh: 州和地方政府是建立公立中小学教育体系以及州立学院和大学的领导者。
en: State and local governments were leaders in establishing public primary and secondary education systems, as well as state colleges and universities.

zh: 加利福尼亚、怀俄明和其他州允许女性投票 — — 这一先例促使第十九修正案（授予全体成年女性选举权）获得通过。
en: California, Wyoming, and other states allowed women to vote – an example that encouraged passage of the Nineteenth Amendment (enfranchising all adult women).

zh: 密歇根和威斯康辛州的以工代赈项目成为比尔·克林顿总统的联邦福利改革的样板，而奥巴马医保则是基于马萨诸塞州共和党州长米特·罗姆尼（Mitt Romney）所引入的医疗制度。
en: Welfare-to-work programs in Michigan and Wisconsin served as the model for federal welfare reform under President Bill Clinton, and Obamacare is based on Massachusetts’ health-care system, introduced under Republican Governor Mitt Romney.

zh: 类似地，从2000年到2014年，33个州实行了各自的能源政策 — — 有的制定了广泛的气候行动计划，有的建立了可再生能源标准 — — 既减少了二氧化碳排放，也扩张了经济。
en: Likewise, from 2000 to 2014, by enacting a variety of energy policies – from broad climate action plans to mandated renewable-energy standards – 33 states cut carbon dioxide emissions while expanding their economies.

zh: 最近，一些州引入了限额和交易制度为碳定价，许多周已经开始实现奥巴马的清洁电力计划目标。
en: More recently, some states have introduced cap-and-trade systems to put a price on carbon, and many are already on track to meet Obama’s Clean Power Plan targets.

zh: 一半的美国州已经实现某种形式的大麻合法化，其中八个州完全合法。
en: Half of all US states have now legalized marijuana in some form, with eight embracing full legalization.

zh: 三个州实施了带薪产假立法，四分之一的州正在跟进。
en: Three states have implemented laws offering paid family leave, with a fourth on the way.

zh: 2017年将有十九个州提高最低工资。
en: Nineteen states rang in 2017 with increases in their minimum wage.

zh: 这个清单还可以继续列举。
en: The list goes on.

zh: 成功的进步联邦主义例子在各个领域都随处可见，包括医疗、监狱改革、高等教育和就业培训、企业家精神、工人保护和福利，以及成功后支付的政府合同。
en: Successful examples of progressive federalism can be seen in a wide variety of areas, including health care, prison reform, higher education and job training, entrepreneurship, worker protection and benefits in the “gig economy”, and pay-for-success government contracts.

zh: 合作、协同和妥协 — — 私人与公共部门之间、营利性和非营利性组织之间、共和党和民主党之间 — — 是所有这些例子的重要特征。
en: Cooperation, collaboration, and compromise – between private and public actors, for-profit and non-profit organizations, and Republicans and Democrats – are essential features in all of them.

zh: 它们也是詹姆斯·法洛斯（James Fallows）在最近的文章和即将出版的新书中所描述的大量地方层面政策创新和公民参与的例子的基础。
en: They also underpin the myriad examples of policy innovation and civic engagement at the local level described by James Fallows in a recent article and upcoming book.

zh: 为了促进州和地方政策创新，联邦政府常常扮演风险资本家的角色，提供可测的目标和激励，而不是规定解决方案。
en: To promote state and local policy innovation, the federal government often assumes the role of venture capitalist, providing measurable goals and incentives, rather than dictating solutions.

zh: 奥巴马是这一方针的坚定践行者，他用教育部的力争上游（Race to the Top）项目促进州内竞争，用联邦“社会创新拨款”支持州和地方政府，并扩大医疗补助（Medicaid）项目。
en: Obama championed this approach through statewide competitions like the Department of Education’s Race to the Top program, through federal “social innovation grants” to support state and local governments, and through the Medicaid expansion program.

zh: 当选副总统麦克·彭斯（Mike Pence）自豪于他在印第安纳州州长任上对医疗补助的推广 — — 尽管截至2016年10月，19个州（主要是南部和中西部州）选择不参与，从而让250万多低收入人群无法获得医保。
en: Vice President-elect Mike Pence is proud of the Medicaid expansion he led as Governor of Indiana – though, as of October 2016, 19 states, mainly in the South and Midwest, had opted not to participate, thereby denying health insurance to more than 2.5 million low-income people.

zh: 作为世界第六大经济体、拥有4,000万人口、堪称美国未来的化身、由团结负责的民主党政府执政的加利福尼亚州是进步联邦主义能够取得什么成就的榜样。
en: With the world’s sixth-largest economy, a population of nearly 40 million that looks like the future of America, and a united and responsible Democratic government, California is a model of what progressive federalism can accomplish.

zh: 加州是扩大女性、农民、移民、性少数群体和其他群体权利的先锋。
en: It has led the way in expanding rights for women, farmworkers, immigrants, and sexual minorities, among others.

zh: 类似地，加州也是环境保护和遏制气候变化的先行者 — — 从指定严格的能源消费和汽车排放标准（2016年被通过为联邦法律）到率先建立碳定价体系。
en: Similarly, it has been at the vanguard of environmental protection and efforts to combat climate change – from setting tough standards for energy consumption and auto emissions (adopted as federal law in 2016), to pioneering a carbon-pricing system.

zh: 州长杰瑞·布朗（Jerry Brown）最近承诺，如果特朗普政府削减收集其后数据所需要的卫星的联邦拨款，加州将“发射自己的该死的卫星 ” 。
en: Governor Jerry Brown recently promised that if the Trump administration cuts federal funding for satellites needed to collect climate data, California would “launch its own damn satellite.”

zh: 加州也可能成为进步抵制或“不合作联邦主义”的领导者，比如拒绝实施它所反对的联邦政策。
en: California can also be a leader of progressive resistance or “uncooperative federalism,” by refusing to carry out federal policies that it opposes.

zh: 许多加州城市和该州本身已经开始按照“庇护所司法辖区”采取行动，限制与联邦当局的合作以保护无证移民免遭遣返。
en: Many cities in California and the state itself already act as “sanctuary jurisdictions,” which protect undocumented immigrants from deportation by limiting cooperation with federal authorities.

zh: 根据法律，执行移民法是联邦政府的责任；在实践中，联邦政府没有足够的资源。
en: By law, immigration enforcement is the federal government’s responsibility; in practice, it lacks adequate resources.

zh: 特朗普所承诺的大规模支出和人手削减将加剧执法资源短缺的状况，迫使联邦政府更多地依靠州和地方当局完成这一工作。
en: The massive spending and personnel cuts promised by Trump will exacerbate the shortfall, forcing the federal government to rely even more on state and local authorities to do much of the work.

zh: 加州立法机关最近开始考虑新法案资助对抗遣返的移民的法律服务和禁止州和地方资源用于依据宪法立场的移民法执行。
en: Signaling its opposition, the California legislature recently introduced for consideration new bills to finance legal services for immigrants fighting deportation and to ban the use of state and local resources for immigration enforcement on constitutional grounds.

zh: 特朗普威胁要削减庇护所司法辖区的联邦拨款。
en: Trump has already threatened to cut federal funding to sanctuary jurisdictions.

zh: 但这样的压力策略因为最高法院的最新裁决而变得更加困难：最高法院限制联邦政府用有条件支出来“强迫”州官员实施联邦政策。
en: But such pressure tactics have been rendered more difficult by a recent Supreme Court decision limiting the use of conditional spending by the federal government to “coerce” state officials into implementing federal policies.

zh: 2016年也许将以民粹主义在美国重新夺权之年而被铭记。
en: We may remember 2016 as the year populism returned to power in the US.

zh: 但它也有可能以进步联邦主义和抵制新时代元年而被铭记，进步联邦主义和抵制的排头兵是受到公民信任、相信它们能改善自己的生活和社区的州和地方政府。
en: But it may also be remembered as the start of a new era of progressive federalism and resistance, championed by state and local governments trusted by their citizens to help improve their lives and communities.

zh: 美联储的不确定性
en: Uncertainty at the Fed

zh: 伯克利—美联储正面临越来越大的失去信誉的风险 — — 并且不无道理。
en: BERKELEY – The US Federal Reserve is increasingly at risk of losing credibility – and for good reason.

zh: 明尼阿波利斯联储银行前行长纳拉亚纳·科薛拉科塔（Narayana Kocherlakota）最近指出，美联储官员似乎正在他们的规定使命 — — 将长期通胀保持在2%附近和其他一些隐含的考虑因素之间寻找平衡。
en: As Narayana Kocherlakota, former President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis, recently argued, Fed officials seem be balancing their stated aim of keeping inflation near 2% over the long term with a host of other, inexplicit, considerations.

zh: 美联储官员在公开资料中给出了一些关于这些其他考虑因素是什么的线索。
en: In public statements, officials have given some hints as to what these other considerations may be.

zh: 它们似乎包括金融系统扭曲风险、对失业可能下降至不可持续的低位的担心，以及对过快提高利率破坏经济复苏的担心。
en: They seem to include the risk of distortion in the financial system, worries that unemployment may fall to unsustainable lows, and concerns that raising interest rates too quickly will disrupt economic recovery.

zh: 但事实仍然是美联储改变利率的标准在很大程度上从未公布也不清不楚，这让人难以预测它会如何行动。
en: But the fact remains that the Fed’s criteria for changing interest rates are for the most part unstated and unclear, making it difficult to predict how it will act.

zh: “这种不确定性 — — 关于哪些目标决定美联储的政策的不确定性 — — 是不健康的 ， ” 科薛拉科塔说 ， “ 如果消费者和企业无法获得关于央行在任何情况下如何行动的足够强的感觉，他们就无法做出好决策。
en: “This kind of uncertainty – about which goals will define the Fed’s policies – is not healthy,” says Kocherlakota. “Consumers and businesses can’t make good decisions if they don’t have a strong enough sense of how the central bank will act in any situation.”

zh: 科薛拉科塔的担心是正确的。
en: Kocherlakota is right to be concerned.

zh: 如果说有什么问题的话，那就是他低估了问题。
en: If anything, he understates the problem.

zh: 美联储的经济目标缺乏明确性只是妨碍对美联储决策的理解的一个因素。
en: A lack of clarity about the Fed’s economic objectives is just one factor obscuring understanding of its decision-making.

zh: 麻烦的核心在于一个事实：似乎不管是金融市场参与者还是美联储本身，都不知道经济的真正状态或如何最好地为此建模 — — 特别是在2008年金融危机爆发后。
en: The heart of the trouble consists in the fact that neither financial-market participants nor, it seems, the Fed itself know the true state of the economy or how best to model it – especially in the wake of the 2008 financial crisis.

zh: 而美联储如何使用新数据来更新它的分析仍不清楚。
en: And it remains unclear how the Fed is using new data to update its analysis.

zh: 不清楚哪些因素 — — 除物价稳定和可行就业最大化外 — — 是美联储在制定货币政策时所考虑的因素加剧了这一问题。
en: The confusion about which factors – besides price stability and maximum feasible employment – the Fed takes into consideration in setting monetary policy aggravates the problem.

zh: 预测美联储如何响应事件变得几乎不可能。
en: It has become nearly impossible to predict how the Fed will respond to events.

zh: 在当今经济波动的环境中，审慎的央行应该竭尽全力提高预期和实际通胀，从而获得在任意方向上稳定经济的能力。
en: In an environment of economic volatility like the one in which we find ourselves today, a prudent central bank should do everything it can to raise expected and actual inflation, in order to gain the ability to stabilize the economy in any direction.

zh: 如果利率远高于零，美联储可以在过热的时候进一步提高利率，而在面临不利需求冲击时降低利率。
en: If interest rates were well above zero, the Fed would have scope to raise them further in case of overheating or to lower them in response to adverse demand shocks.

zh: 但美联储并没有将通胀推向或推高到目标之上。
en: But the Fed is not pushing for inflation at or above its target.

zh: 相反，其收紧政策的举动压缩了施展空间 — — 并且还在迫不及待地进一步压缩这一空间。
en: Instead, by tightening policy, it is narrowing its room for maneuver – and is champing at the bit to narrow it even more.

zh: 美联储似乎也没有以可理解的方式更新对经济的看法。
en: Nor does the Fed seem to be updating its view of the economy in an understandable way.

zh: 2013年6月，美联储预测2013—2015年年GDP增长率平均为2.9 % ， 更长期实际潜在GDP增长率平均为2.4 % 。
en: In June 2013, the Fed was predicting that annual GDP growth during the 2013-2015 period would average 2.9%, with longer-run growth of real potential GDP averaging 2.4%.

zh: 而在现实中，年增长率平均为2.3 % （ 或2.2 % ， 如果2016年上半年的估算值被修正的话 ） 。
en: Instead, annual growth has averaged 2.3% (or 2.2%, if estimates for the first half of 2016 are correct).

zh: 以其他标准衡量，美联储的表现也不出色。
en: Nor did it perform better on other measures.

zh: 美联储预测基于个人消费支出指数的2015年年通货膨胀率为1.9 % 。
en: The Fed predicted an annual inflation rate, based on the personal consumption expenditures index, of 1.9% for 2015.

zh: 真正的数字是1.5 % 。
en: The true number was 1.5%.

zh: 类似地，2015年联邦基金利率平均预测值为1.5 % 。
en: Similarly, its average projection of the federal funds rate for 2015 was 1.5%.

zh: 目前这一数字为0.25 % 。
en: The figure is currently 0.25%.

zh: 在始于2013年的这三年（经济表现不如美联储预期）之前，是一个经济同样落后于美联储预测的三年。
en: This three-year period, starting in 2013, in which the economy undershot the Fed’s expectations, follows a three-year period in which the economy likewise fell short of the Fed’s forecast.

zh: 而在这三年之前，是一个美联储大规模低估下行通缩风险的三年（从2007年开始 ） 。
en: And that period followed a three-year period, starting in 2007, in which the Fed massively understated downside deflationary risks.

zh: 你也许会想，如此表现记录理应促使官员修正他们的经济模型。
en: One would think that such a track record would have prompted officials to revise their model of the economy.

zh: 但美联储仍然无视不对称性，将它视为第二阶甚至第三阶现象。
en: But the Fed continues to neglect asymmetry, considering it only a second- or third-order phenomenon.

zh: 它仍然将通胀预期定在基于过去通胀数字的不切实际的高水平上。
en: It continues to gear inflation expectations at unrealistically high levels based on past inflation.

zh: 它仍然依靠失业率作为劳动力市场状态的替身，而忽略其他指标。
en: And it continues to rely on the unemployment rate as a stand-in for the state of the labor market, at the expense of other indicators.

zh: 美联储对于升息余量的看法也一直比市场预期更乐观。
en: The Fed has also been consistently more optimistic than market expectations about the available headroom for raising interest rates.

zh: 这导致观察者认定美联储官员并非仅仅是不幸运；他们对经济的理解是错误的。
en: This had led observers to conclude that Fed officials have not just been unlucky; they have an incorrect understanding of the economy.

zh: 事实上，美联储官员没有证明在做出正确预测方面的无能已经促使他们更新了模型，这正在让很多人失去对美联储做出可靠决策的能力的信心。
en: Indeed, the failure of officials to convey how their inability to make accurate predictions has prompted them to update their model is leading many to lose confidence in the Fed’s capacity for sound decision-making.

zh: 如果美联储要维持市场信心，不但需要沟通其关键目标；还必须明确它优先考虑哪些因素以及如果满足不同目标所需要的政策药方彼此冲突官员将如何响应。
en: If the Fed is to maintain the confidence of markets, it will need not only to communicate its key objectives; it will also have to make clear which considerations have priority and how officials will respond if policy prescriptions required to meet various objectives conflict with one another.

zh: 最后 — — 也是最重要的 — — 美联储必须能够保证其内部经济模型与时俱进。
en: Finally – and most important – the Fed will have to provide reassurance that it is keeping its internal model of the economy up to date.

zh: 提高利率能提振美国增长吗？
en: Would Higher Interest Rates Boost US Growth?

zh: 伯克利—百仕通公司（Blackstone）首席执行官托尼·詹姆斯（Tony James）最近在《金融时报》发表了一篇专栏，名为《为复兴美国经济，提高利率 》 （ To revive America’s economy, raise interest rates ） 。
en: BERKELEY – Blackstone CEO Tony James recently published a column in the Financial Times titled “To revive America’s economy, raise interest rates.”

zh: 这真是一个坏主意。
en: This is a very bad idea.

zh: 想象我们被输送到平行世界，在那里，美联储并没有将利率保持在零或近零水平。
en: Let us imagine that we have been transported to a parallel universe, one where the US Federal Reserve has not held interest rates at or near zero.

zh: 相反，这个美联储在过去六年中逐步提高利率，联邦基金利率要比现在高400个基点。
en: Instead, this Fed has gradually raised interest rates for the past six years, and the federal funds rate is now 400 basis points higher than it currently is.

zh: 在探讨这个平行世界的经济将如何之前，我们先回顾一下真实世界发生了什么。
en: Before looking at what this alternate-universe economy would look like, let us review what has happened in the real world.

zh: 2015年四季度，家庭、企业和外国投资者在美国存了9,400亿美元。
en: In the fourth quarter of 2015, households, businesses, and foreign investors saved $940 billion in the United States.

zh: 当是时，1,850亿美元投资于新发行政府债券，7,550亿美元流入产生利息和红利的储蓄工具，如贷款、公司债券和新股发行，这反过来增加了美国私人部门生产性资本存量。
en: Of that amount, $185 billion was invested in newly issued government bonds, and the other $755 billion flowed into interest- and dividend-paying savings vehicles such as loans, corporate bonds, and new equity issues, which in turn added to the US private sector’s productive-capital stock.

zh: 在我们的假设情景中，流入新储蓄工具的7,550亿美元无法在2015年四季度创造出来用于投资的。
en: In our hypothetical scenario, $755 billion in new savings vehicles would not have been created in the fourth quarter of 2015 to fund investment.

zh: 尽管利率更高，但这7,550亿美元可能仍会有7,350亿美元，也有可能低至7,000亿美元。
en: With higher interest rates, that $755 billion could still have been as high as $735 billion, or it could have dropped to as low as $700 billion.

zh: 无论如何，我们知道它一定会降低一些，支出的流动性余额会减少200—550亿美元。
en: In any case, we know that it would have been lower, and that the liquidity balances that support spending would have been deprived of $20-55 billion.

zh: 也许詹姆斯只是在通知企业不要在利率提高时为投资计划找理由；但许多企业显然是这么做了。
en: Perhaps James only talks to firms that do not rationalize their investment plans when interest rates rise; but many firms certainly do.

zh: 比如，利率在建筑业中起着重要作用，特别是在房地产价值对融资成本和可用现金流特别敏感的沿海地区。
en: For example, interest rates play a major role in the construction business, especially on the coasts, where real-estate values are especially sensitive to financing costs and available cash flows.

zh: 融资成本增加和流动性的减少还可能抑制消费品购买，阻止小企业扩张。
en: Increased financing costs and reduced liquidity can also dampen consumer-goods purchases and prevent small businesses from expanding.

zh: 美联储的反应可能是增加经济的现金存量，但那样的话利率将下降，回到我们现在的状况。
en: The Fed could respond by adding to the economy’s cash stock, but then interest rates would fall, and we would be exactly where we are now.

zh: 另一方面，如果美联储维持较高的联邦基金利率，金融流将从生产性投资流出，成为闲置现金余额，支出将下降，经济将进入新衰退。
en: On the other hand, if the Fed maintained the higher federal funds rate, financial flows would be diverted away from productive investment and into idle cash balances, spending would decrease, and the economy would enter a new recession.

zh: 这时，詹姆斯会抗议说这完全不是他想要的。
en: At this point, James would object that this is not what he wanted at all.

zh: 他原本预期信心仙女现身刺激经济中各部门的产量和需求，从而2015年四季度企业仍能在政府债券之外创造7,550亿美元用于投资新储蓄工具。
en: He would have expected the confidence fairy to show up and spur production and demand across all economic sectors, so that businesses still would have created $755 billion in new savings vehicles, aside from government bonds, in the fourth quarter of 2015.

zh: 随着信心仙女的到来，一切都真的会变好：经济将稳定下来，接近充分就业；利率将会更高；詹姆斯所列出的反常地利率的消极效应将全部消失。
en: With the confidence fairy’s arrival, everything would indeed be fine: the economy would be stable and close to full employment, interest rates would be higher, and the negative effects of abnormally low interest rates that James lists would all disappear.

zh: 据詹姆斯的说法，这些效应包括“公司以不正常的程度用资本代替劳动力 ” 、 “年长者和其他依赖产生收益的投资的人”的经济困难、更高的退休储蓄要求、金融系统因为投资者购买“深奥资产”以“抓住更高回报”而产生的“系统性风险 ” ， 以及银行贷款利润的降低。
en: According to James, these effects include “companies substituting capital for labor to an unnatural degree”; economic hardship for “the elderly and others who depend on income-producing investments”; higher retirement-savings requirements; “systemic risks” in the financial system as investors buy “esoteric assets” to “grasp for higher returns”; and lower bank profitability from lending.

zh: 但这些问题无法通过美联储独立地提高利率解决。
en: But these problems would not be averted by the Fed independently raising interest rates.

zh: 相反，企业必须创造储蓄工具和做投资，接着美联储才能做出反应让利率提高，从而遏制过度需求和高通胀。
en: Rather, businesses must create savings vehicles and make investments, to which the Fed can then respond by allowing interest rates to rise, in order to head off excess demand and high inflation.

zh: 美联储公开市场委员会（FOMC）无法在华盛顿埃克尔斯大厦（Eccles Building）控制这一过程。
en: The Federal Open Market Committee cannot dictate this process from the Eccles Building in Washington, DC.

zh: 但美联储现在试图引导创造更多储蓄工具，部分是通过购买3万亿美元长期证券实现。
en: But the Fed has now tried to induce the creation of more savings vehicles, in part through $3 trillion in purchases of long-term securities.

zh: 美联储��年将300亿美元的久期风险从私人部门资产负债表上剔除 — — 此前债券发行人必须向储蓄者支付这笔钱以补偿他们承担这一风险 — — 而因此释放的风险承受力想必被用于支持高风险投资项目。
en: The Fed has removed an annual $30 billion in duration risk from private-sector balance sheets – which bond issuers previously had to pay savers to bear – and that freed-up risk-bearing capacity has presumably been used to fund risky investment projects.

zh: 但显然詹姆斯也将同意，评估和承担久期风险的金融组织未必能够很好地判断其他高风险投资。
en: But surely James would agree that financial organizations that assess and bear duration risk are not necessarily competent to judge other risky ventures.

zh: 如果我们想要更多储蓄工具推高可贷资金市场的利率，从而美联储可以提高联邦基金利率，那么有一个显而易见的解决方法：政府本身应该创造储蓄工具。
en: If we want more savings vehicles to push up interest rates in loanable-funds markets, so that the Fed can then increase the federal funds rate, there is an obvious solution: the government itself should create savings vehicles.

zh: 比如，政府出资的基础设施银行可以开始每季度借入1,000亿美元用于基础设施项目融资。
en: For example, a government-sponsored infrastructure bank could start borrowing $100 billion every quarter to finance infrastructure projects.

zh: 这样，关于反常低利率的担忧就将是明日黄花。
en: With that, concerns about abnormally low interest rates would be a thing of the past.

zh: 与此同时，美联储显然不应该在尚无证据证明储蓄工具供给过剩的情况下领衔提高利率。
en: In the meantime, the Fed should certainly not take the lead in raising interest rates when there is no evidence of excess supply in savings vehicles.

zh: 这样做好比是1944年在太平洋上铺设半英里长的跑道，然后指望载重巨大的B-17轰炸机可以猛然着陆。
en: To do so would be akin to building a half-mile landing strip in the Pacific Ocean in 1944, and thinking that cargo-bearing B-17s would suddenly start to land.

zh: 饱受抨击的美联储
en: The Fed Under Fire

zh: 剑桥—美联储正在遭到攻击。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The Federal Reserve is under attack.

zh: 让其接受“政府问责局（Government Accountability Office ） “ 审计”的法案有望在国会两院获得通过。
en: Bills subjecting the United States' central bank to “auditing" by the Government Accountability Office are likely to be passed by both houses of Congress.

zh: 要求美联储以事先预定的公式制定利率的立法也在考虑当中。
en: Legislation that would tie how the Fed sets interest rates to a predetermined formula is also being considered.

zh: 任何没有意识到即将到来的“大火”的人，只要听一听美联储主席耶伦最近在国会山所受到的诘难便可略知一二。
en: Anyone unaware of the incoming fire only had to listen to the grilling Fed Chair Janet Yellen received recently on Capitol Hill.

zh: 国会议员批评耶伦私下会晤总统和财政部长，谴责她考虑与货币政策风马牛不相及的问题。
en: Members of Congress criticized Yellen for meeting privately with the president and treasury secretary, and denounced her for weighing in on issues tangential to monetary policy.

zh: 还有一些人，如即将卸任的达拉斯联邦储备银行行长理查德·费舍尔（Richard Fisher）猛烈抨击了纽约联邦储备银行的特殊角色。
en: Still others, like Richard Fisher, the outgoing president of the Dallas Fed, have inveighed against the special role of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

zh: 纽约联储银行承担着沉重的监管责任 — — 因为它与金融中心近在咫尺 — — 因此其行长拥有美联储基准利率决定机构 — — 美联储公开市场委员会的永久委员席位。
en: Reflecting the New York Fed's heavy regulatory responsibilities, owing to its proximity to the seat of finance, its president has a permanent seat on the Federal Open Market Committee, the body that sets the Fed's benchmark interest rate.

zh: 它的批评者指出，这给了华尔街影响美联储操作的特权。
en: This, its detractors warn, privileges Wall Street in the operation of the Federal Reserve System.

zh: 最后，一些人反对银行家把持了地区联储银行董事会，这就好像是让狐狸看守鸡窝。
en: Finally, some object that bankers dominate the boards of directors of the regional Reserve Banks, making it seem that the foxes are guarding the henhouse.

zh: 这类批评反映了美联储刚刚经历了重大金融危机的事实，在此期间，美联储采取了一系列非常规措施。
en: This criticism reflects the fact that the United States has just been through a major financial crisis, in the course of which the Fed took a series of extraordinary steps.

zh: 它出手救助了贝尔斯登公司（Bear Stearns ） 、 政府支持的按揭贷款商房利美和房地美以及保险巨头AIG。
en: It helped bail out Bear Stearns, the government-backed mortgage lenders Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae, and the insurance giant AIG.

zh: 它扩大了美元互换规模，其对象不仅包括英格兰银行和欧洲央行，也包括墨西哥、巴西、韩国和新加坡央行。
en: It extended dollar swap lines not just to the Bank of England and the European Central Bank but also to the central banks of Mexico, Brazil, Korea, and Singapore.

zh: 它还以量化宽松的名义前所未有地扩大了其资产负债表。
en: And it embarked on an unprecedented expansion of its balance sheet under the guise of quantitative easing.

zh: 这些决定都带来了争议，其正当性饱受质疑 — — 在民主国家理应如此。
en: These decisions were controversial, and their advisability has been questioned – as it should be in a democracy.

zh: 反过来，美联储官员也在为他们的行动辩护，这也是民主的应有之义。
en: In turn, Fed officials have sought to justify their actions, which is also the way a democracy should function.

zh: 国会的反应有大量先例可循。
en: There is ample precedent for a Congressional response.

zh: 上一次经历如此规模危机时，即20世纪30年代，美联储也接受了类似的国会调查。
en: When the US last experienced a crisis of this magnitude, in the 1930s, the Federal Reserve System similarly came under Congressional scrutiny.

zh: 其结果是给予美联储更大贷款自由的1932和1933年格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案以及让美联储可以无视此前金本位规则的1934年黄金储备法案。
en: The result was the Glass-Steagall Act of 1932 and 1933, which gave the Fed more leeway in lending, and the Gold Reserve Act of 1934, which allowed it to disregard earlier gold-standard rules.

zh: 接着，1935年银行法（根据1942年修订内容）将权力从地方联储银行转移到华盛顿美联储理事会手中，并确定了纽约联储银行的特殊地位。
en: The Banking Act of 1935, as amended in 1942, then shifted power from the Reserve Banks to the Board in Washington, DC, and confirmed the special role of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

zh: 这些改革反映了一个压倒性共识，即美联储在履行职责方面令人十分不满。
en: These reforms reflected an overwhelming consensus that the Fed had been derelict in fulfilling its duties.

zh: 它没有在大萧条初期阻止货币供给减少。
en: It had failed to prevent the money supply from contracting in the early stages of the Great Depression.

zh: 它没有注重其紧急贷款人的责任，放任银行体系崩溃。
en: Heedless of its responsibilities as an emergency lender, it had allowed the banking system to collapse.

zh: 当1933年金融稳定摇摇欲坠时，各联储银行又没有进行合作，导致无法采取有效行动。
en: When financial stability hung in the balance in 1933, the Reserve Banks' failure to cooperate prevented effective action.

zh: 美联储如此失职，无怪乎此后的改革如此深远。
en: Given such incompetence, it is not surprising that subsequent reforms were far-reaching.

zh: 但这些改革与今天的计划变革恰好相反：减少对政策制定者自由裁量权的限制、增加美联储理事会的权力、给予纽约联储银行更大的角色，所有这些都是为了让美联储能在危机中更快更强地采取行动。
en: But these reforms went in precisely the opposite direction from today's proposed changes: fewer limits on policy makers' discretion, more power to the Board, and a larger role for the New York Fed, all to enable the Federal Reserve System to react more quickly and robustly in a crisis.

zh: 换句话说，对于最新危机的正确反应是否是猛然向后转还远未可知。
en: It is far from clear, in other words, that the right response to the latest crisis is an abrupt about-face.

zh: 说到底，重大变革能否成为现实应该取决于央行干预是否实际加剧了当前危机，就像它在20世纪30年代所做的那样。
en: Ultimately, whether significant changes are warranted should depend on whether the central bank's interventions in fact aggravated the recent crisis, as they aggravated the crisis of the 1930s.

zh: 但美联储批评者很有意思地从未具���描述他们认为美联储错在何处。
en: But the Fed's critics have been curiously nonspecific about what they regard as the Fed's mistakes.

zh: 而他们做了具体论述的东西 — — 比如美联储在助长通胀 — — 完全错误的。
en: And where they have been specific, as with the accusation that the Fed was fomenting inflation, they have been entirely wrong.

zh: 至于美联储官员，他们应该更好地论证他们的行动。
en: Fed officials, for their part, must better justify their actions.

zh: 他们当然不想没完没了地辩解2008年的事件，但不断的批评表明他们的决定并未得到充分理解，美联储官员应该更详细地予以解释。
en: While they would prefer not to re-litigate endlessly the events of 2008, continued criticism suggests that their decisions are still not well understood and that officials must do more to explain them.

zh: 此外，美联储官员应该避免介入与货币政策没什么关系的问题。
en: In addition, Fed officials should avoid weighing in on issues that are only obliquely related to monetary policy.

zh: 美联储的职责是保持物价和金融稳定以及就业最大化。
en: Their mandate is to maintain price and financial stability, as well as maximum employment.

zh: 美联储高层越是专注于核心责任，公平的政客就越支持其独立性。
en: The more intently Fed governors focus on their core responsibilities, the more inclined politicians will be to respect their independence.

zh: 最后，美联储官员应该承认至少部分批评建议是有道理的。
en: Finally, Fed officials should acknowledge that at least some of the critics' suggestions have merit.

zh: 比如，取消商业银行选择每家联储银行理事会多数的权利将是迈向更开放、更多元的正确方向的有益的一步。
en: For example, eliminating commercial banks' right to select a majority of each Reserve Bank's board would be a useful step in the direction of greater openness and diversity.

zh: 美联储永远在改进。
en: The Federal Reserve System has always been a work in progress.

zh: 如今美国需要的是朝正确方向的改进。
en: What the US needs now is progress in the right direction.

zh: 政策大分歧
en: The Great Policy Divergence

zh: 华盛顿—未来几周，美联储和欧洲央行可能会采取极其不同的政策。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Over the next few weeks, the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank are likely to put in place notably different policies.

zh: 美联储即将提高利率，这是近十年来的第一次。
en: The Fed is set to raise interest rates for the first time in almost ten years.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲央行预计将采取更多非常规手段让利率朝反方向运动，即使这意味着给某些已经处于负名义收益率的政府债券造成进一步下跌压力。
en: Meanwhile, the ECB is expected to introduce additional unconventional measures to drive rates in the opposite direction, even if that means putting further downward pressure on some government bonds that are already trading at negative nominal yields.

zh: 实施这些政策的两家央行都是在执政立法机关的授权下追求国内目标。
en: In implementing these policies, both central banks are pursuing domestic objectives mandated by their governing legislation.

zh: 问题在于几乎没有可以用来管理这一日益严重的分歧所造成的国际影响的有序机制。
en: The problem is that there may be few, if any, orderly mechanisms to manage the international repercussions of this growing divergence.

zh: 美联储是在响应美国坚挺的就业创造指标和其他经济正在复苏的信号（尽管复苏势头不强 ） 。
en: The Fed is responding to continued indications of robust job creation in the United States and other signs that the country’s economy is recovering, albeit moderately so.

zh: 美联储也认识到，如果利率保持在人为的低水平，将给金融稳定造成风险，因此预计它将在12月15—16日的美联储公开市场委员会政策制定会议上提高利率。
en: Also conscious of the risk to financial stability if interest rates remain at artificially low levels, the Fed is expected to increase them when its policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee meets on December 15-16. The move marks a turning point in the Fed’s approach to the economy.

zh: 决定提高利率不仅意味着美联储不再踩下金融刺激油门，也意味着它向着为期多年的总体政策立场正常化过程迈出了第一步。
en: In deciding to raise interest rates, it will be doing more than simply lifting its foot from the financial-stimulus accelerator; it will also be taking a notable step toward the multiyear normalization of its overall policy stance.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲央行面临着完全不同的经济环境，包括停滞的总体增长形势、通缩风险以及对巴黎恐怖袭击给企业和消费信心造成的影响的担忧。
en: In the meantime, the ECB is facing a very different set of economic conditions, including generally sluggish growth, the risk of deflation, and worries about the impact of the terrorist attacks in Paris on business and consumer confidence.

zh: 因此，欧洲央行决策者正在认真考虑让贴现率朝负区间更进一步，并延长其大规模资产购买计划（即量化宽松 ） 。
en: As a result, the bank’s decision-makers are giving serious consideration to pushing the discount rate further into negative territory and extending its large-scale asset-purchase program (otherwise known as quantitative easing).

zh: 换句话说，欧洲央行可能扩大和延长进一步加大金融刺激油门的实验性措施。
en: In other words, the ECB is likely to expand and extend experimental measures that will press even harder on the financial-stimulus accelerator.

zh: 在完美的世界中，决策者会评估不同方向的政策的潜在国际溢出效应（包括大西洋两岸可能发生的互相影响 ） ， 用各种工具确保国内和全球目标的协调性。
en: In a perfect world, policymakers would have assessed the potential for international spillovers from these divergent policies (including possible spillbacks on both sides of the Atlantic) and put in place a range of instruments to ensure a better alignment of domestic and global objectives.

zh: 不幸的是，美国和欧盟的政治两极分化和总体政策无能仍制约着这样的评估。
en: Unfortunately, political polarization and general policy dysfunction in both the US and the European Union continue to inhibit such an effort.

zh: 结果，由于缺乏更全面的政策响应，两家央行的分歧政策的协调需要由市场来完成 — — 特别是固定收益资产和货币市场。
en: As a result, lacking a more comprehensive policy response, the harmonization of their central banks’ divergent policies will be left to the markets – in particular, those for fixed-income assets and currencies.

zh: 目前，大西洋两岸的“无风险”债券 — — 如美国国债和德国国债 — — 的利差相当可观。
en: Already, the interest-rate differential between “risk-free” bonds on both sides of the Atlantic – say, US Treasuries and German Bunds – has widened notably.

zh: 与此同时，美元不仅对欧元升值，也多其他大部分货币升值。
en: And, at the same time, the dollar has strengthened not only against the euro, but also against most other currencies.

zh: 若放任不管，这些趋势可能会持续。
en: Left unchecked, these trends are likely to persist.

zh: 从历史上看，在未来几个月中必须严密监控三个问题。
en: If history is any guide, there are three major issues that warrant careful monitoring in the coming months.

zh: 首先，如果美元大幅升值、美国国际竞争力大幅下降，美国不可能长时间袖手旁观。
en: First, the US is unlikely to stand by for long if its currency appreciates significantly and its international competitiveness deteriorates substantially.

zh: 公司已在纷纷抱怨美元升值所造成的利润压力，一些公司甚至要求政府更加强硬地遏制“货币暗战 ” 。
en: Companies are already reporting earning pressures due to the rising dollar, and some are even asking their governments to play a more forceful role in countering a stealth “currency war.”

zh: 其次，美国被用作储备货币，因此其价值的迅速上升将给不审慎地使用美元的国家造成压力。
en: Second, because the dollar is used as a reserve currency, a rapid rise in its value could put pressure on those who have used it imprudently.

zh: 风险尤其大的是那些几乎完全用美元借贷但美元收入有限的新兴国家公司，它们的资产和负债或者收入和支出之间存在严重的货币错配。
en: At particular risk are emerging-country companies that, having borrowed overwhelmingly in dollars but generating only limited dollar earnings, might have large currency mismatches in their assets and liabilities or their incomes and expenditures.

zh: 最后，利率和汇率的大幅波动可能导致其他市场的动荡，最主要是股市。
en: And, finally, sharp movements in interest rates and exchange rates can cause volatility in other markets, most notably for equities.

zh: 监管管制和市场约束让经纪商比较难以通过自身资产负债表上的累积存货起到反周期作用，由此导致的价格波动可能非常巨大。
en: Because regulatory controls and market constraints have made brokers less able to play a countercyclical role by accumulating inventory on their balance sheets, the resulting price instability is likely to be large.

zh: 有可能一些投资组合将被迫��序甩卖。
en: There is a risk that some portfolios will be forced into disordered unwinding.

zh: 此外，央行遏制所谓的“波动性波动 ” （ volatile volatility）的政策也可能受到挑战。
en: Furthermore, the central banks’ policy of curtailing so-called “volatile volatility” is likely to be challenged.

zh: 当然，所有这些结果都不是必然的。
en: Of course, none of these outcomes is preordained.

zh: 大西洋两岸的政客有能力通过实施结构改革、确保更平衡的总需求、解决过度负债问题以及理顺多边和地区监管机制来降低动荡风险。
en: Politicians on both sides of the Atlantic have the ability to lower the risk of instability by implementing structural reforms, ensuring more balanced aggregate demand, removing pockets of excessive indebtedness, and smoothing out the mechanisms of multilateral and regional governance.

zh: 所有这些因素的三个可能结果包括相对稳定的多速世界、破坏美国经济复苏的大扰动，以及得益于美国增长的欧洲复兴。
en: The three possible outcomes of all this include a relatively stable multi-speed world, notable disruptions that undermine the US’s economic recovery, and a European revival that benefits from US growth.

zh: 好消息是政策分歧的影响将取决于决策者如何管理压力。
en: The good news is that the impact of the divergence will depend on how policymakers manage its pressures.

zh: 坏消息是决策者并没有政治意愿果断行动尽量降低这些风险。
en: The bad news is that they have yet to find the political will to act decisively to minimize the risks.

zh: 在美联储货币政策正常化和欧洲央行加码非常规措施之际，我们当然应该报以最大的希望。
en: As the Fed normalizes its monetary policy and the ECB doubles down on extraordinary measures, we certainly should hope for the best.

zh: 但我们也应该为金融和经济不确定性的激增做好准备。
en: But we should also be planning for a substantial rise in financial and economic uncertainty.

zh: 美联储为何抛弃货币主义
en: Why the Fed Buried Monetarism

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 美联储推迟提高利率的决定对于一直关注该机构主席珍娜·耶伦（Janet Yellen）言论的人来说不足为奇。
en: LONDON – The US Federal Reserve’s decision to delay an increase in interest rates should have come as no surprise to anyone who has been paying attention to Fed Chair Janet Yellen’s comments.

zh: 这一决定只不过是确认了美联储并非对国际金融压力无动于衷，而且其风险管理手段仍然坚定倾向于“更低、更长期”的方针。
en: The Fed’s decision merely confirmed that it is not indifferent to international financial stress, and that its risk-management approach remains strongly biased in favor of “lower for longer.”

zh: 那么，为什么市场和媒体表现的就像美联储的动作（或者更精确地说，不作为）是意料之外呢？
en: So why did the markets and media behave as if the Fed’s action (or, more precisely, inaction) was unexpected?

zh: 真正震惊市场的并不是美联储决定维持零利率数月，而是伴随这个决定的声明。
en: What really shocked the markets was not the Fed’s decision to maintain zero interest rates for a few more months, but the statement that accompanied it.

zh: 美联储透露这一决策完全没有考虑高通胀的风险，并急于将失业率推低至大多数经济学家认为的“自然”失业率（约5 % ） 以下。
en: The Fed revealed that it was entirely unconcerned about the risks of higher inflation and was eager to push unemployment below what most economists regard as its “natural” rate of around 5%.

zh: 而关于货币政策和央行行为的所有争论核心正是通货膨胀和失业率之间的关系。
en: It is this relationship – between inflation and unemployment – that lies at the heart of all controversies about monetary policy and central banking.

zh: 而几乎所有的现代经济模式，包括美联储所使用的都基于由米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）在其1967年的美国经济学会主席发言中首先提出的利率货币主义理论。
en: And almost all modern economic models, including those used by the Fed, are based on the monetarist theory of interest rates pioneered by Milton Friedman in his 1967 presidential address to the American Economic Association.

zh: 弗里德曼的理论断言，一旦失业率低于最低安全水平（即他形容的“自然”失业率 ） ， 通胀便会自动无上限加速攀升。
en: Friedman’s theory asserted that inflation would automatically accelerate without limit once unemployment fell below a minimum safe level, which he described as the “natural” unemployment rate.

zh: 在弗里德曼的原文中，自然失业率是一个纯理论推测，建基于称之为“理性预期”的假设，尽管它违背了任何理性行为的标准定义。
en: In Friedman’s original work, the natural unemployment rate was a purely theoretical conjecture, founded on an assumption described as “rational expectations,” even though it ran counter to any normal definition of rational behavior.

zh: 当时全球正面对两位数的通胀忧心不已，而该理论的出世恰恰为央行行长采用那些极为不受欢迎的行动提供了借口。
en: The theory’s publication at a time of worldwide alarm about double-digit inflation offered central bankers exactly the pretext they needed for desperately unpopular actions.

zh: 通过大幅提高利率以对抗通胀，政策制定者击破了工会组织的力量，同时避免了因货币紧缩必然导致的大规模失业而受指责。
en: By dramatically increasing interest rates to fight inflation, policymakers broke the power of organized labor, while avoiding blame for the mass unemployment that monetary austerity was bound to produce.

zh: 几年后，弗里德曼的“自然”率被换成了更少价值判断，但更冠冕堂皇的“非加速通胀型失业率 ” （ NAIRU ） 。
en: A few years later, Friedman’s “natural” rate was replaced with the less value-laden and more erudite-sounding “non-accelerating inflation rate of unemployment” (NAIRU).

zh: 但其基本思维是始终不变的，如果试图用货币政策将失业率降低至某个预定水平，通胀将无限加速并消灭就业职位。
en: But the basic idea was always the same. If monetary policy is used to try to push unemployment below some pre-determined level, inflation will accelerate without limit and destroy jobs.

zh: 因此，必须不惜一切代价避免实施将低于非加速通胀型失业率作为目标的货币政策。
en: A monetary policy aiming for sub-NAIRU unemployment must therefore be avoided at all costs.

zh: 该理论还有一个更极端的版本推断说通货膨胀和失业率之间不存在持久的权衡，所有以“快钱（easy money ） ” 刺激就业和经济增长的努力只会助推物价上涨，抵消在降低失业率上所做的努力。
en: A more extreme version of the theory asserts that there is no lasting tradeoff between inflation and unemployment. All efforts to stimulate job creation or economic growth with easy money will merely boost price growth, offsetting any effect on unemployment.

zh: 因此货币政策必须只关注如何达到通胀目标，而央行应免遭任何关于失业率的指责。
en: Monetary policy must therefore focus solely on hitting inflation targets, and central bankers should be exonerated of any blame for unemployment.

zh: 当费里德曼为将央行职责缩窄为实现通胀目标寻找理论依据时，这一货币主义理论还没有什么实践经验来支撑。
en: The monetarist theory that justified narrowing central banks’ responsibilities to inflation targeting had very little empirical backing when Friedman proposed it.

zh: 自那以后，它同时遭到政治经验和统计检验的驳斥。
en: Since then, it has been refuted both by political experience and statistical testing.

zh: 在货币政策方面也远未如理论预期的那样作用在物价提升之上，反而对失业造成了比通胀更大的影响，特别是在过去的20年内。
en: Monetary policy, far from being dissipated in rising prices, as the theory predicted, turned out to have a much greater impact on unemployment than on inflation, especially in the past 20 years.

zh: 但就算有实践经验的批驳，在“理性”预期的所谓权威撑腰下，货币主义的意识形态吸引力如日中天。
en: But, despite empirical refutation, the ideological attractiveness of monetarism, supported by the supposed authority of “rational” expectations, proved overwhelming.

zh: 于是这一单纯通胀导向的货币政策便统治了央行界和经济学学术圈。
en: As a result, the purely inflation-oriented approach to monetary policy gained total dominance in both central banking and academic economics.

zh: 让我们回顾一下到最近的金融事件。
en: That brings us back to recent financial events.

zh: 美联储（以及其他国家央行和官方机构，如国际货币基金组织）所使用的通胀目标模型都假设存在着某个对非通胀型失业率的预设限值。
en: The inflation-targeting models used by the Fed (and other central banks and official institutions like the International Monetary Fund) all assume the existence of some pre-determined limit to non-inflationary unemployment.

zh: 美联储的最新模型估计该比率为4.9-5.2 ％ 。
en: The Fed’s latest model estimates this NAIRU to be 4.9-5.2%.

zh: 这就是为何众多经济学家和市场参与者被耶伦的过度自信所震惊。
en: And that is why so many economists and market participants were shocked by Yellen’s apparent complacency.

zh: 由于美国目前5.1％的失业率，标准的货币理论规定利率必须紧急提高。
en: With US unemployment now at 5.1%, standard monetary theory dictates that interest rates must be raised urgently.

zh: 否则要么出现灾难性的通胀井喷，要么自弗里德曼对“理性”预期和“自然”失业率论文的论文发表后主宰了一代政策和学术思想的经济理论主体被证明为完全错误。
en: Otherwise, either a disastrous inflationary blowout will inevitably follow, or the body of economic theory that has dominated a generation of policy and academic thinking since Friedman’s paper on “rational” expectations and “natural” unemployment will turn out to be completely wrong.

zh: 那么，我们应该从美联储决定不加息的行为中得出什么结论？
en: What, then, should we conclude from the Fed’s decision not to raise interest rates?

zh: 一个可能的结论就是什么也不会发生。
en: One possible conclusion is banal.

zh: 由于自然失业率是一个纯粹的理论建构，美联储的经济学家们可以直接更改对这个神奇的数字的估算。
en: Because the NAIRU is a purely theoretical construct, the Fed’s economists can simply change their estimates of this magic number.

zh: 事实上在过去两年内美联储已经三次下调了对自然失业率的估算。
en: In fact, the Fed has already cut its NAIRU estimate three times in the past two years.

zh: 但美联储的克制也有可能出于一个更深层次的原因。
en: But there may be a deeper reason for the Fed’s forbearance.

zh: 由耶伦近期的讲话判断，美联储可能不再相信任何版本的“自然”失业率了。
en: To judge by Yellen’s recent speeches, the Fed may no longer believe in any version of the “natural” unemployment rate.

zh: 导致一心关注物价稳定的弗里德曼长期加速通胀假设和非理性的“理性”预期依然如圣经创世神话那样深植在官方的经济模型中。
en: Friedman’s assumptions of ever-accelerating inflation and irrationally “rational” expectations that lead to single-minded targeting of price stability remain embedded in official economic models like some Biblical creation myth.

zh: 但美联储，与几乎所有他家央行一道，显得已经对这个神话失去了信仰。
en: But the Fed, along with almost all other central banks, appears to have lost faith in that story.

zh: 相反，央行如今似乎暗中（甚至不自觉地）返回到前货币主义者的观点：通货膨胀与失业之间的权衡是真实的，而且可以持续多年。
en: Instead, central bankers now seem to be implicitly (and perhaps even unconsciously) returning to pre-monetarist views: tradeoffs between inflation and unemployment are real and can last for many years.

zh: 货币政策应逐步随着商业周期调整这两个经济指标之间的平衡。
en: Monetary policy should gradually recalibrate the balance between these two economic indicators as the business cycle proceeds.

zh: 当通货膨胀率较低，当务之急应该是降低失业率到尽可能低的水平；同时也并没有令人信服的理由让货币政策去抑制创造就业或GDP的增长，除非过度通胀变得迫在眉睫。
en: When inflation is low, the top priority should be to reduce unemployment to the lowest possible level; and there is no compelling reason for monetary policy to restrain job creation or GDP growth until excessive inflation becomes an imminent danger.

zh: 这并不意味着永远实施接近零的美元利率。
en: This does not imply permanent near-zero US interest rates.

zh: 美联储几乎肯定会在12月开始加息，但货币紧缩会比以往的经济周期要慢得多，主要动机也将是金融稳定而非通胀。
en: The Fed will almost certainly start raising rates in December, but monetary tightening will be much slower than in previous economic cycles, and it will be motivated by concerns about financial stability, not inflation.

zh: 这样一来，围绕在一些新兴市场对美联储政策收紧对全球经济形势影响的恐慌状况的担忧，可能会证明是站不住脚的。
en: As a result, fears – bordering on panic in some emerging markets – about the impact of Fed tightening on global economic conditions will probably prove unjustified.

zh: 坏消息是，绝大多数仍沿袭着旧有货币主义框架的分析师将指责美联储通过坐视美国失业率过度下降而“下跌到曲线之下”并未能预见到通货膨胀上升的威胁。
en: The bad news is that the vast majority of market analysts, still clinging to the old monetarist framework, will accuse the Fed of “falling behind the curve” by letting US unemployment decline too far and failing to anticipate the threat of rising inflation.

zh: 而美联储应该直接忽略这样的老古董的抗议，正如它上周的正确作为。
en: The Fed should simply ignore such atavistic protests, as it rightly did last week.

zh: 把持财政最高法院
en: Controlling the Supreme Court of Finance

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 近期很多人忧虑美国国会可能采取的行动推翻2008年危机后颁布的2010年多德-弗兰克金融改革。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – There has been a great deal of concern recently about potential action by the US Congress to roll back the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial reforms, enacted in the wake of the 2008 crisis.

zh: 最终虽然共和党控制的众议院希望将其大部废除，但很可能只能说服参议院对中小银行的限制规则进行相对小范围的放宽。
en: In the end, while the Republican-controlled House of Representatives wanted a broad repeal, the Senate could be persuaded only to support relatively minor relaxation of the rules for small and medium-size banks.

zh: 不幸的是，考虑到特朗普时代的金融政治态势，这并不意味着金融体系会因此保持相对安全。
en: Unfortunately, given the politics of finance in the Trump era, this does not mean that the financial system will remain relatively safe.

zh: 在参众两院共和党的支持之下，特朗普总统制定了广泛的放松管制议程。
en: President Donald Trump has a broad deregulation agenda, supported by House and Senate Republicans.

zh: 大多数规管金融的关键权力都被授予美联储 — — 讽刺的是，这正是多德-弗兰克法案本身要求的。
en: Most of the key powers to regulate finance have already been delegated to the Federal Reserve – ironically by the Dodd-Frank legislation itself.

zh: 而总统则可以任命全权掌管美联储监管工作的人选。
en: And the president appoints the people who have complete control over regulation at the Fed.

zh: 这堪称是一个危险的组合。
en: This is a dangerous combination.

zh: 特朗普不会遵从一些标准的保守派立场，比如赞成自由贸易。
en: Trump does not adhere to some standard conservative positions, like favoring free trade.

zh: 但他非常清楚自己在政府与企业之间关系方面想要的东西：政府不要对企业指手画脚。
en: But he knows very well what he wants with regard to the relationship between government and business: he wants the government to stop telling business what to do.

zh: 在这个问题上，总统与罗纳德·里根总统的意识形态遗产完全保持一致，而后者坚信政府就是问题所在。
en: On this issue, the president stands in a direct line of ideological descent from Ronald Reagan, who strongly believed that government was the problem.

zh: 历史上，国会制定财政规则，而美联储及其他监管机构决定如何实施。
en: Historically, Congress set financial rules and the Federal Reserve – along with other regulators – decided on implementation.

zh: 在2008年危机爆发前的那几十年中，两党之间达成了广泛的共识，允许大型金融企业按照自身认为合适的方式行事。
en: In the decades leading up to the crisis of 2008, there was a broad bipartisan consensus in favor of allowing large financial firms to do as they saw fit.

zh: 这包括借入更多债务并增大债务相对于其股东权益的比率。
en: That included borrowing more and running up their debt relative to the size of their shareholder equity.

zh: 其中的逻辑（也是得到美联储充分认可的）是这些坐拥数万亿美元资产的大企业能雇用最聪明的人才，而这些人也有能力去安全地管理高度杠杆化的资产负债表。
en: The reasoning, which was fully endorsed at the Fed, was that such large firms – with assets in the trillions of dollars – employed smart people who could figure out how to manage highly leveraged balance sheets safely.

zh: 但2008年9月全球各大银行（以及保险公司和共同基金）破产和濒临破产的浪潮则表明这种看法是大错特错的。
en: In September 2008, the wave of failures and near-failures at global banks (and insurance companies and mutual funds) demonstrated that this view was deeply mistaken.

zh: 但是政治体系的整体回应却是自相矛盾的。
en: But the political system’s overall response was paradoxical.

zh: 美联储 — — 以及英格兰银行和欧洲央行非但没有被剥夺权力，反而变得更加强大了。
en: Instead of stripping powers from central banks, the Federal Reserve – as well as the Bank of England and the European Central Bank – became much more powerful.

zh: 造成这一结果的原因有二：首先，中央银行拥有必要的工具 — — 廉价信贷和扩张性货币政策 — — 来避免危机加深。
en: There were two reasons for this outcome. First, central banks had the tools – cheap credit and expansionary monetary policy – necessary to avert a deeper crisis.

zh: 其次，现代金融太过复杂又演进得太快，以致任何立法都无法完全跟上步伐。
en: Second, modern finance is far too complex and evolves too fast for any piece of legislation to address fully.

zh: 因此必须有人以更详细的方式来负责监督。
en: Someone has to be in charge of oversight in a more detailed way.

zh: 危机无疑损害了美联储的声誉，但其他可靠的替代监管机构也好不到哪里去。
en: The crisis damaged the Fed’s reputation, but all plausible alternative regulators looked worse.

zh: 因此，多德-弗兰克法案最终赋予了美联储更多权力，使其事实上成为了财政方面的最高法院。
en: So the Dodd-Frank legislation ended up granting even more power to the Fed, making it in effect the Supreme Court of Finance.

zh: 英格兰银行前副行长保罗·塔克（Paul Tucker）在其重量级新书《非民选权力：对央行行为和监管国家合法性的探讨》中更深入地描述了这个故事及其含义。
en: In his important new book, Unelected Power: The Quest for Legitimacy in Central Banking and the Regulatory State, Paul Tucker, a former deputy governor of the Bank of England, traces this story and its implications more deeply.

zh: 正如塔克所解释的那样，央行掌握的权力集中现象不仅限于美国 — — 英国和欧元区也面临着同样问题。
en: As Tucker explains, the increased concentration of power in the hands of central banks is not limited to the United States – the United Kingdom and the eurozone confront a version of the same issue.

zh: （笔者是由塔克担任主席的系统性风险委员会的非授薪成员）
en: (I am an unpaid member of the Systemic Risk Council, which is chaired by Tucker.)

zh: 当一个政党试图推进一个宏大的意识形态议程而同时存在一个最高法院时，明智的政治策略显然是把自己人安插到该法院 — — 在这种情况下就是美国联邦储备委员会 — — 去执行该党的方略。
en: When a political party seeks to advance a broad ideological agenda and there exists a Supreme Court, the smart political strategy obviously is to appoint people to that court – the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, in this case – who will implement the party’s program.

zh: 在奥巴马执政期间，美联储在金融监管方面变得更清晰有效。
en: During the Obama administration, the Fed became clearer-thinking and more effective on financial regulation.

zh: 美联储理事丹·塔鲁罗(Dan Tarullo)明智地削弱了纽约联邦储备银行的管辖权，因为该行基本处于大银行的把持之下了。
en: Governor Dan Tarullo sensibly weakened the jurisdiction of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, which had become largely captured by big banks.

zh: 而主席珍妮特·耶伦则敏锐地意识到了不受监管的融资所带来的问题。
en: Chair Janet Yellen was acutely aware of the problems that result from unregulated finance.

zh: 理事蕾尔·布林纳德（Lael Brainard）也非常支持这一策略，莎拉·布鲁姆·拉斯金（Sarah Bloom Raskin）在就任财政部副部长之前也是如此。
en: Governor Lael Brainard was also very supportive, as was Sarah Bloom Raskin before she became Deputy Treasury Secretary.

zh: 但如今这一切都起了变化。
en: But now all of that is changing.

zh: 耶伦继任者杰罗姆·鲍威尔的金融监管方略似乎从未明晰。
en: It has never been completely clear how Yellen’s successor, Jerome Powell, thinks about financial regulation.

zh: 而美联储新任监察副主席兰达尔·K·夸尔斯（Randal K. Quarles）的早期动向表明他很可能会在特朗普和财政部的支持下持续腐蚀金融保护措施（虽然目前为止布林纳德仍然留任 ） 。
en: And early indications from the Fed’s new vice chair for supervision, Randal K. Quarles, suggest the potential for a steady erosion of safeguards, cheered on by Trump and the Treasury Department. (Brainard remains on the Board, at least for now.)

zh: 塔克认为，在理想状态下那些关键问题 — — 比如说管理所谓“大而不能倒”的银行 — — 应该交由国会一级决定，因为这在某种程度上需要更多的透明度以及真正的问责制。
en: Ideally, in Tucker’s view, vital issues – like how much to regulate so-called too-big-to-fail banks – should be decided at the congressional level, in part because this implies more transparency and real accountability.

zh: 当然国会也不是永远正确的，但这就是要用选举来决定人选的原因。
en: Of course, Congress is perfectly capable of making mistakes; but that is why there are elections.

zh: 然而我们当前所拥有却是一个排除了透明和问责制的终极授权。
en: What we have now, however, is an extreme delegation of authority that precludes transparency and accountability.

zh: 美联储可以在无须进一步国会行动的情况下大幅改变银行的抗风险能力。
en: The Fed can substantially change the details of how resilient the banks are without any further congressional action.

zh: 当然国会的意图也确实重要 — — 共和党人就明确表示要让那些大银行任意行事。
en: Congressional intent does matter – and the Republicans have clearly indicated that the needle should point toward letting the bigger banks do what they want.

zh: 这是一种短视的做法，而将追求这一做法的政治负担转移到未经选举的机构是极其危险的。
en: That is a shortsighted approach, and shifting the political burden of pursuing it to an unelected body is extremely dangerous.

zh: 下一次危机爆发时，美联储 — — 以及其他中央银行 — — 的合法性都将直接受到质疑。
en: The next time a crisis erupts, the legitimacy of the Fed – and other central banks – will be called directly into question.

zh: 美联储危险的新使命
en: The Fed’s Risky New Mandate

zh: 伦敦 — “ 这个世界只有两出悲剧 ， ” 奥斯卡·王尔德（Oscar Wilde）曾经写道 ， “ 一是得不到想要的，而是得到。
en: LONDON – “In this world, there are only two tragedies,” Oscar Wilde once wrote. “One is not getting what one wants, and the other is getting it.”

zh: ”随着美联储逐渐接近实现国内经济目标，它面临着日益增加的货币政策正常化的压力。
en: As the US Federal Reserve inches closer to achieving its targets for the domestic economy, it faces growing pressure to normalize monetary policy.

zh: 但国内经济已不再是美联储决策的唯一考虑因素。
en: But the domestic economy is no longer the Fed’s sole consideration in policymaking.

zh: 相反，美国的货币政策已经明白无误地有了新的使命：促进全球金融稳定。
en: On the contrary, America’s monetary authority has all but explicitly recognized a new mandate: promoting global financial stability.

zh: 1913年，美国国会建立了美联储，它是一个从党派政治中分离出来的独立机构，其任务是保证国内物价稳定和国内就业最大化。
en: The US Congress created the Fed in 1913 as an independent agency removed from partisan politics, tasked with ensuring domestic price stability and maximizing domestic employment.

zh: 其角色随时间而扩大，和许多发达国家的同道机构一样，自2008年全球金融危机以来，美联储也采取了日益非常规的货币政策 — — 量化宽松、信用宽松、前瞻指引，等等。
en: Its role has expanded over time, and the Fed, along with many of its developed-country counterparts, has engaged in increasingly unconventional monetary policy – quantitative easing, credit easing, forward guidance, and so on – since the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 如今，非常规已经成为常规。
en: Now, the unconventional has become conventional.

zh: 这一代全球市场参与者只识低（甚至负）利率和人为抬高的资产价格。
en: A generation of global market participants knows only a world of low (or even negative) interest rates and artificially inflated asset prices.

zh: 但美联储的双重使命仍然有效。
en: But the Fed’s dual mandate remains in force.

zh: 而尽管美联储最近的语调相当“鸽派 ” ， 但美国经济的基本面 — — 特别是应该对美联储最为重要的基本面 — — 显然表明未来将会升息。
en: And while the Fed’s recent rhetoric has been dovish, the fundamentals of the US economy – particularly those that supposedly matter most for the Fed – indicate a clear case for further rate hikes.

zh: 首先考虑美联储的就业使命。
en: Consider, first, the Fed’s employment mandate.

zh: 失业率已下降至略高于5 % ， 就业增长强劲而持续，失业登记多年来呈现出显而易见的下降趋势。
en: The unemployment rate is down to just 5%, job growth is strong and consistent, and jobless claims have been on a clear downward trajectory for several years.

zh: 至于物价稳定使命，石油价格崩盘必然地影响了去年的标题数字，但核心通胀（剔除能源）趋势表明美联储已经落后于形势。
en: As for the price-stability mandate, the oil-price collapse has naturally affected headline figures over the past year, but the trend in core inflation (excluding the energy component) suggests that the Fed is falling behind the curve.

zh: 核心CPI已处于危机后的高点，2月同比上涨2.3 % ， 3月同比上涨2.2 % 。
en: Core CPI is at a post-crisis high, having risen 2.3% year on year in February, and 2.2% in March.

zh: 此外，通胀压力可能随着今年的深入而增加。
en: Moreover, inflationary pressures will likely mount as the year progresses.

zh: 目前家庭债务-资产比正在接近20世纪90年代的低水平，消费者有充足的空间增加借贷。
en: With the household debt-to-asset ratio now approaching levels last seen in the 1990s, consumers have plenty of capacity to ramp up their borrowing.

zh: 与此同时，通胀低迷的成本因素必然会随着石油价格的稳定而减弱，而最近美元的弱势意味着进一步的通胀压力。
en: At the same time, the cost drag on inflation is set to diminish as the oil price stabilizes, and the dollar’s recent softness implies further inflationary pressure.

zh: 但这一国内进展让美联储处于困难的境地。
en: But this domestic progress puts the Fed in a difficult position.

zh: 结果，美联储实际上陷在了日益要求货币政策正常化的美国经济和脆弱的要求进一步采取鸽派立场的全球市场（其中大约60%的交易用美元计价）利益之间。
en: As a result, the Fed is effectively trapped between a US economy that increasingly justifies normalization of monetary policy and the interest of fragile global markets – in which about 60% of the world’s transactions are dollar-denominated – in further dovishness.

zh: 来自金融市场的信号日益影响着美联储的决策。
en: Messaging from financial markets increasingly influences the Fed’s decision-making.

zh: 任何美联储将比预期更快更早升息的暗示都将导致金融条件收紧的恐慌和暴力规避风险动作。
en: Any suggestion that the Fed will hike faster or sooner than anticipated leads to fears of tighter financial conditions, and violent risk-off moves.

zh: 受美联储货币政策影响，股票和固定收益证券市场经历了多年的牛市，如今美联储试图退出这些货币政策，而市场估值无力提供反弹支持。
en: After a multi-year bull market in equities and fixed-income securities, stimulated by the very monetary policies the Fed is trying to leave behind, there is no valuation support to dampen the reaction.

zh: 在全球增长无力、并且近期难见起色的情况下，金融市场需要依赖极端宽松的货币政策来支持价格。
en: In the absence of genuinely robust global growth, which is unlikely in the near term, financial markets are relying on extremely loose monetary policy to prop up prices.

zh: 美联储的3月利率决定，以及美联储主席耶伦的评论是一个很好的例证。
en: The Fed’s rate decision in March, and Fed Chair Janet Yellen’s commentary, was a case in point.

zh: 美联储显然无法消化1月和2月的全球金融市场抛售，而这一抛售潮主要是因为对美联储进一步紧缩的担忧导致的。
en: The Fed apparently could not stomach the sell-off in global financial markets in January and February, which was driven largely by concerns about further tightening.

zh: 这有些奇怪，因为金融财富（股票和债券）的变化对消费的影响很小。
en: This is odd, because effects on consumption from changes in financial wealth (stocks and bonds) are small.

zh: 更为重要的是房价变化，而房价形势并未恶化。
en: What matters far more are changes in house prices, which have not deteriorated.

zh: 类似地，资本成本，包括资本的权益成本的变化对商业投资的影响也很小。
en: Similarly, changes in the cost of capital, including the equity cost of capital, have a minor impact on business investment.

zh: 换句话说，从双重使命的角度看，美联储不应该严重关注市场波动性，即使出现了1月和2月这样的大波动。
en: In other words, from the standpoint of its dual mandate, the Fed should not be terribly concerned about market volatility, even of the magnitude seen in January and February.

zh: 但耶伦和美联储所释放的没一个信号都表明决策者非常关注市场波动。
en: But every signal sent from Yellen and the Fed was that policymakers were very concerned about exactly this.

zh: 而美联储延缓升息节奏后所出现的市场反弹更是强化了美国升息概率和全球市场波动之间的反馈环。
en: And the rally in markets that came after the Fed backpedaled on the pace of rate increases has only served to strengthen the feedback loop between the probability of US interest-rate hikes and global market volatility.

zh: 这一反馈环已经演变为美联储的一项新使命，其他全球决策者提及这一点时已经日益不加掩饰。
en: The loop has become calcified into a new mandate for the Fed, with other global policymakers becoming increasingly overt in referring to it.

zh: 中国财政部副部长最近赞扬了耶伦的沟通和谨慎方针“考虑了我们的情况。 ”
en: China’s deputy finance minister recently praised Yellen for her communication and cautious approach, which “takes us into consideration.”

zh: 其中的影响值得担忧。
en: The implications of this are worrying.

zh: 如果耶伦和美联储感到受制于金融市场，那么未来更加急剧地提升利率的风险也将随着美联储落后于通胀曲线而增加。
en: If Yellen and the Fed feel beholden to financial markets, the risk of sharper rate hikes further down the road, as the Fed increasingly falls behind the inflation curve, will rise.

zh: 除此之外，还有重要的长期考量。
en: Beyond this, there are important longer-term considerations.

zh: 考虑到较低的基数，以及美联储显而易见的谨慎态度，到美国下一次衰退前，名义利率不太可能有很大的提升。
en: Given the low base, and the Fed’s obvious caution, nominal interest rates are unlikely to climb too far by the next US recession.

zh: 在缺少传统降息手段的情况下，下一次衰退可能比往常更长，迫使美联储更加依靠非常规货币政策 — — 甚至不止于欧洲和日本目前正在实施的负名义利率。
en: With a lack of traditional rate-cutting firepower, the next downturn could be longer than usual, compelling further reliance on unconventional monetary policy – even beyond the negative nominal interest rates now being pursued in Europe and Japan.

zh: 事实上，耶伦的前任本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）最近提出了这样的可能，特别是可以持久提高货币供给（所谓的直升机撒钱 ） 。
en: Indeed, Yellen’s predecessor, Ben Bernanke, recently addressed such possibilities, notably the potential for a permanent increase in the money supply (so-called helicopter money).

zh: 这可以通过多种形式实现：量化宽松加财政扩张（如提高基础设施支出 ） 、 直接向政府转移支付现金，或最极端的，直接向家庭转移支付现金。
en: This could take a number of forms: quantitative easing combined with fiscal expansion (for example, higher infrastructure spending), direct cash transfers to the government, or, most radically, direct cash transfers to households.

zh: 这些极端政策仍只有理论可能，实施它们很有可能引发国会调查。
en: Such extreme policies are still only theoretical, and implementing them would most likely spur heightened congressional scrutiny.

zh: 尽管如此，支持全球金融市场和其他外部经济体的压力解释了这一问题为何会受到争论。
en: Nonetheless, the pressure to support global financial markets and other external economies suggests why the issue is being debated.

zh: 美联储在刚刚结束的4月会议上再次决定保持利率不变，其所面临的困境在今年将更加严峻：根据国内基本面正常化货币政策，还是屈从于全球金融市场的压力？
en: With the Fed deciding in their just-concluded April meeting, yet again, to hold rates, their dilemma is set only to intensify this year: normalize monetary policy in line with domestic fundamentals, or cede to the pressures of global financial markets.

zh: 前者必然会导致高波动的未来；后者将让美联储的新使命固化 — — 而这一使命将破坏央行独立性的表象。
en: The former is sure to usher in a highly volatile future; the latter would further entrench the Fed’s new mandate – one that undermines any semblance of central-bank independence.

zh: 不情不愿的世界央行
en: The World’s Reluctant Central Banker

zh: 纽约—这应该是强势央行时刻准备着向全世界提供弹药的时代。
en: NEW YORK – This is supposed to be the era of powerful central banks, ready to wield their firepower worldwide.

zh: 但最强势的央行 — — 美联储也是最不愿意承认其全球地位的央行。
en: Yet the most powerful of all central banks – the United States Federal Reserve – is also the most reluctant to acknowledge its global reach.

zh: 和所有央行一样，美联储也有本国使命，关注国内物价稳定和就业。
en: Like all central banks, the Fed has a local mandate, focused on domestic price stability and employment.

zh: 但是，和大部分央行不同，美联储还有全球责任。
en: But, unlike most central banks, the Fed has global responsibilities.

zh: 这一矛盾是当今世界经济所面临的一些最大的威胁的根源。
en: This tension is at the root of some of the most threatening problems facing the world economy today.

zh: 美联储有全球责任，是因为两个关系紧密的原因，这两个原因都和避免巴西前财政部长曼特加（Guido Mantega）深深忧虑的“货币战争”的需要没什么关系。
en: The Fed has global responsibilities for two closely related reasons, neither of which has much to do with the need to avoid the “currency wars” that so concerned former Brazilian Finance Minister Guido Mantega.

zh: 首先，尽管诞生了欧元并且人民币地位也在提升，但美元仍然是全世界借贷行为的货币选择。
en: First, despite the birth of the euro and talk of the Chinese renminbi’s ascendancy, the dollar remains the currency of choice for borrowing and lending around the world.

zh: 当吉隆坡、圣保罗或约翰内斯堡的银行或公司需要进行海外借贷时，计价货币更有可能是美元而不是其他货币。
en: When a bank or corporation in Kuala Lumpur, São Paulo, or Johannesburg borrows abroad, the loan is more likely to be denominated in dollars than in any other currency.

zh: 如果本地银行遭遇挤兑，或者公司难以延展债务，它们就必须能够从本地央行借到美元，而本地央行又只能从美联储获得美元。
en: If local banks suffer a run, or if corporations have trouble rolling over their debt, they need to be able to borrow dollars from the local central bank, which in turn may have no choice but to get those dollars from the Fed.

zh: 2007—2008年，美联储与14家央行签订互换协议，包括四个新兴经济体（巴西、墨西哥、新加坡和韩国 ） ， 它实际上是承认了它是全世界美元最后贷款人。
en: When the Fed in 2007-2008 entered into swap agreements with 14 central banks, including those of four emerging economies (Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, and South Korea), it de facto acknowledged that it is the world’s lender of last resort in dollars.

zh: 但是，美联储官员称，不能指望这称为美联储的常规业务。
en: Yet the Fed, its governors argue, cannot be expected to do that on a regular basis.

zh: 在2015年的讲话中，美联储最具国际思维的关于之一的斯坦利·费舍尔（Stanley Fischer）承认，世界金融稳定可以由一家全球央行支持，但又总结说 ： “ 我应该澄清，这家央行不是美联储。 ”
en: In a 2015 speech, Stanley Fischer, one of the most internationally-minded of the Fed’s governors, acknowledged that world financial stability could be supported by a global central bank, yet concluded: “I should be clear that the US Federal Reserve is not that bank.”

zh: 美联储有全球责任的第二个原因是其政策影响着全世界货币条件。
en: The second reason why the Fed has global responsibilities is that its policies affect monetary conditions worldwide.

zh: 大量证据表明，货币政策冲击影响风险溢价，这一渠道通过国际和国内两方面起作用，影响甚大。
en: There is mounting evidence that monetary-policy shocks affect risk premia, and that this channel operates internationally as well as domestically, with sizeable effects.

zh: 在2013年的所谓的“退出恐慌 ” （ taper tantrum）中，美联储仅仅是暗示可能减慢其债权购买计划的节奏，就引发了大部分新兴经济体大量资本外逃和资产价格暴跌。
en: In the 2013 episode known as the “taper tantrum,” the mere hint that the Fed might slow the pace of its bond-buying program triggered large capital outflows and asset-price drops in most emerging economies.

zh: 传统的美联储反应，美联储前主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）在2015年IMF研究会议上明确指出，十分简单：让你的货币浮动起来。
en: The traditional Fed response, expressed eloquently by former Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke at the 2015 IMF Research Conference, is simple: Float your currency.

zh: 国际货币政策的标准三元悖论认为，一国不可能同时满足固定汇率、货币独力和自由资本流动，但它们可以实现其中两者。
en: The standard trilemma of international monetary policy holds that countries cannot have fixed exchange rates, monetary independence, and free capital movement simultaneously, but they can have two of the three.

zh: 浮动货币的国家可以自由制定利率、决定国内金融条件，甚至赢得极大的国际资本流动性（mobility ） 。
en: Countries that float their currencies can be free to set interest rates and determine financial conditions at home, even with substantial international capital mobility.

zh: 如果货币不浮动 — — 由于存在出口目标或实际利率目标等原因 — — 那是各国自己的问题。
en: If they don’t float – because they have targets for exports or the real exchange rate �� that is their problem.

zh: 伯南克认为，不能指望美联储去帮助它们。
en: The Fed, Bernanke argued, cannot be expected to help them.

zh: 但伯南克的观点并不十分令人信服。
en: But Bernanke’s argument is not entirely convincing.

zh: 伦敦商学院的海伦·雷（Hélène Rey）指出，货币政策的“风险承担”渠道的国际影响力太大，美联储政策让许多国家的信用条件几乎与汇率机制独立。
en: As London Business School’s Hélène Rey has argued, the “risk-taking” channel of monetary policy is so powerful internationally that Fed policy helps determine credit conditions in many countries quite independently of their exchange-rate regimes.

zh: 当美联储政策放松时，全世界信用都会增长，反之则反是。
en: When the Fed loosens policy, credit grows all over the world, and vice versa.

zh: 因此，这不是三元悖论，而是二元悖论：资本账户管制 — — 而不只是弹性汇率 — — 可能是各国央行有效控制国内信用情况的必要条件。
en: So it is not a policy trilemma but a dilemma: capital-account restrictions –not just flexible exchange rates – may be necessary for central banks to exercise effective control over domestic credit conditions.

zh: 美联储不愿充当世界最后贷款人，或不愿承认汇率运动无法抵消其行动的海外效应，这似乎表明它是只顾自己的分内事的内省机构。
en: The Fed’s reluctance to serve as the world’s lender of last resort, or to acknowledge that exchange-rate movements cannot undo its actions abroad, would seem to condemn it to being a parochial and inward-looking institution.

zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）是不会因此拍手称快的。
en: But Donald Trump should not start applauding yet.

zh: 美联储的国内责任要求它承认 — — 用费舍尔的话说 — — “美国经济，以及世界其他国家的经济，彼此之间存在重要的反馈效应。
en: The Fed’s domestic mandate requires it to recognize, in Fischer’s words, that “the US economy and the economies of the rest of the world have important feedback effects on each other.”

zh: ”并且这些效应正在日益变大。
en: And those effects are getting larger.

zh: 在论证其利率决策时，传统上美联储不怎么关注美国经济的国际环境的影响。
en: When justifying its interest-rate decisions, the Fed has historically paid little attention to the effect of international conditions on the US economy.

zh: 但在2015年9月，它打破了这一传统。
en: But it broke with tradition in September 2015.

zh: 利率制定委员会官方备忘录和主席耶���在新闻发布会上都强调了外部不确定性（包括中国经济疲软）是美联储推迟提高利率的关键原因。
en: Both the official minutes of the rate-setting meeting and Chairman Janet Yellen in her press conference mentioned heightened uncertainties abroad, including weakness in the Chinese economy, as key reasons to delay the Fed’s increase in interest rates.

zh: 其他国际联系也在日益受到关注。
en: Other international linkages are also receiving greater attention.

zh: 在国际贸易和资本流动方面，美国经济变得更加开放了，美元价值随之变得更加重要，因为它影响着通货膨胀和国内金融环境。
en: As the US economy becomes more open to international trade and capital movements, the dollar’s value matters more because of its effect on inflation and on domestic financial conditions.

zh: 在关于美联储下一步应该怎么做的最新争论中，美联储官员布莱恩纳德（Lael Brainard）一直认为美元在2014年和2015年实际升值20 % ， 这降低了进一步收紧货币政策的必要性。
en: In the current debate about what the Fed should do next, Governor Lael Brainard has been arguing that real dollar appreciation of 20% in 2014 and 2015 reduces the need for further monetary-policy tightening.

zh: 当然，关心世界如何影响美国和担心世界其他国家的经济健康是不同的。
en: Of course, caring about how the world affects the US is not the same as concern about the economic health of the rest of the world.

zh: 但这些小措施意义重大。
en: And yet these small steps are significant.

zh: 加州大学伯克利分校的巴里·艾肯格林（Barry Eichengreen）指出，国际考虑因素长期以来一直是美联储货币政策的重要考虑因素，而在过去三十年中，美联储主要关注美国国内，这是反常。
en: Berkeley’s Barry Eichengreen has shown that international considerations have long played a key role in the conduct of Fed policy, and that the last three decades, in which the Fed turned mostly inward, were something of an aberration.

zh: 因此，102岁的美联储也许正在回归其最初的传统。
en: So perhaps the 102-year-old Fed is returning to its original tradition.

zh: 或者其展望已经相当国际主义 — — 其在金融危机中的行动就是明证 — — 只不过国内正是约束阻止了它公开承认这一点。
en: Or perhaps its outlook already is quite internationalist – as its actions during the financial crisis suggest – and it is only domestic political constraints that prevent this from being acknowledged openly.

zh: 无论如何，这一方向的举动即使只是渐进的，也是值得欢迎的，因为全世界最不需要的是只顾国内的美联储。
en: Either way, even incremental movement in this direction is welcome, for the last thing the world needs is a parochial Fed.

zh: 最近的金融史表明，下一次流动性危机近在眼前，这类危机可能造成极大的经济和社会成本。
en: Recent financial history suggests that the next liquidity crisis is just around the corner, and that such crises can impose enormous economic and social costs.

zh: 在一个极为美元化的世界经济中，避免这些危机的唯一的确定的工具是美元最后贷款人。
en: And in a largely dollarized world economy, the only certain tool for avoiding such crises is a lender of last resort in dollars.

zh: IMF应该成为这个贷款人，但它没有。
en: The IMF could have been that lender, but it is not.

zh: 美联储才是。
en: The Fed is.

zh: 美国和世界其他国家越早充分认识到这一点，世界经济就越安全。
en: The sooner the US and the rest of the world fully recognize this, the safer the world economy will be.

zh: 美联储的沟通危机
en: The Fed’s Communication Breakdown

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 如果要形容美国联储现行沟通政策的话，最适合的说法莫过于“骆驼是一匹由委员会设计的马”这一老话了（形容决策过程导致结果走样 ） 。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Nothing describes the United States Federal Reserve’s current communication policy better than the old saying that a camel is a horse designed by committee.

zh: 负责政策制定的联邦公开市场委员会中的多名成员都认为保持基准利率不变的决定“过于依赖数据 ” 。
en: Various members of the Fed’s policy-setting Federal Open Markets Committee (FOMC) have called the decision to keep the base rate unchanged “data-dependent.”

zh: 这听起来有点道理，直到你意识到他们每个人对“数据依赖”似乎都有着不同的解读，以至于这一词汇的含义似乎有点“凭直觉 ” 。
en: That sounds helpful until you realize that each of them seems to have a different interpretation of “data-dependent,” to the point that its meaning seems to be “gut personal instinct.”

zh: 换句话说，美联储的沟通策略是个烂摊子，而理顺它远比搞清楚联邦公开市场委员会决定退出近零利率的确切时间更重要。
en: In other words, the Fed’s communication strategy is a mess, and cleaning it up is far more important than the exact timing of the FOMC’s decision to exit near-zero interest rates.

zh: 毕竟，即使在美联储最终做出了将有效联邦基金利率从（目前的）0.13％调到（未来）0.25％的“重大“飞跃，市场仍想知道在此之后将是如何走向，而我担心的是大家还将继续蒙在鼓里。
en: After all, even after the Fed does finally make the “gigantic” leap from an effective federal funds rate of 0.13% (where it is now) to 0.25% (where is likely headed soon), the market will still want to know what the strategy is after that. And I fear that we will continue to have no idea.

zh: 平心而论，决定如何行动是一个非常艰难的选择，对此经济学家们也存在严重分歧。
en: To be fair, deciding what to do is a very tough call, and economists are deeply divided on the matter.

zh: 国际货币基金组织也强势介入，要求美联储在提升利率前等待更长的时间。
en: The International Monetary Fund has weighed in forcefully, calling on the Fed to wait longer before raising rates.

zh: 而国际货币基金组织正在保护的新兴市场国家央行行长们也在传达一个同样强烈的信息：赶紧决定吧；不确定性快要害死我们啦！
en: And yet central bankers in the very emerging markets that the IMF is supposedly protecting have been sending an equally forceful message: Get on with it; the uncertainty is killing us.

zh: 就个人而言，我可能会倾向于等待时间较长的一方，并接受如果通胀最终上升，它会迅速行动，以一个陡峭曲线大幅加息的极高风险。
en: Personally, I would probably err on the side of waiting longer and accept the very high risk that, when inflation does rise, it will do so briskly, requiring a steeper path of interest-rate hikes later.

zh: 但如果美联储最终走上了这条路线，就需要向外界表明这是有意识地冒着通胀飙升的风险来运作。
en: But if the Fed goes that route, it needs to say clearly that it is deliberately risking an inflation overshoot.

zh: 而等待所产生的问题是我们真的不知道均衡实际（去除通胀因素）政策利率现在究竟是多少，正因如此，在行动之前需要一个价格增长的明确信号。
en: The case for waiting is that we really have no idea of what the equilibrium real (inflation-adjusted) policy interest rate is right now, and as such, need a clear signal on price growth before moving.

zh: 但只要美联储不继续发送引人耳目的有关其理念和目标的混合信号，导致随机噪声涌入市场，就只有泡沫论者才会否认存在提早升息的问题。
en: But only a foaming polemicist would deny that there is also a case for hiking rates sooner, as long as the Fed doesn’t throw random noise into the market by continuing to send spectacularly mixed signals about its beliefs and objectives.

zh: 毕竟，美国经济正处于或接近充分就业，而国内需求也不断稳步增长。
en: After all, the US economy is at or near full employment, and domestic demand is growing solidly.

zh: 尽管美联储试图忽略过去商品价格的短暂波动，也将难以忽视一旦过去一年价格大幅下降态势 — — 尤其是能源价格 — — 出现停止甚至逆转所导致的消费通胀。
en: While the Fed tries to look past transitory fluctuations in commodity prices, it will be hard to ignore rising consumer inflation as the huge drop of the past year – particularly in energy prices – stabilizes or even reverses.

zh: 事实上，所有央行使用的现行标准决策规则都决定了加息将会姗姗来迟。
en: Indeed, any standard decision rule used by central banks by now dictates that a hike is long overdue.

zh: 但我们也不要犯下将“更高利率”视��于“高利率”的低级错误。
en: But let’s not make the basic mistake of equating “higher interest rate” with “high interest.”

zh: 在这种情况下认定0.25 ％ — —甚至1 ％ — —属于高利率完全是夸大。
en: To say that 0.25%, or even 1%, is high in this environment is pure hyperbole.

zh: 虽然我们不应该过分强调持续超低利率对金融稳定的风险，也不应完全否定这些风险的存在。
en: And while one shouldn’t overstate the risks of sustained ultra-low rates to financial stability, it is also wrong to dismiss them entirely.

zh: 随着加息的决定变得如此迫切，人们可能会认为美联储倾向于在今年实现这一点，因为主席和副主席都已经一连几个月对市场如此表态，然而不在年末加息的真正原因则是公共关系。
