en: Banks and other lenders are extending credit to lower-quality borrowers, to borrowers with large quantities of existing debt, and as loans with fewer conditions on borrowers (so-called “covenant-lite loans”).

zh: 此外，低利率还制造了新问题：流动性错配。
en: Moreover, low interest rates have created a new problem: liquidity mismatch.

zh: 有利的借贷成本促使公司债券发行量猛增，其中有许多持有于债券共同基金和交易所交易基金（ETF ） 。
en: Favorable borrowing costs have fueled an enormous increase in the issuance of corporate bonds, many of which are held in bond mutual funds or exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

zh: 这些基金的投资者 — — 正确地 — — 认为它们具有完美流动性。
en: These funds’ investors believe – correctly – that they have complete liquidity.

zh: 他们只需要提前一天通知就可以套现。
en: They can demand cash on a day’s notice.

zh: 但是，接到套现通知后，共同基金和ETF必须出售这些公司债券。
en: But, in that case, the mutual funds and ETFs have to sell those corporate bonds.

zh: 谁来当买家无法清楚地知道，特别是自2010年多德-弗兰克（Dodd- Frank）金融改革立法限制银行行为、增加资本要求从而提高了持有债券的成本之后。
en: It is not clear who the buyers will be, especially since the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial-reform legislation restricted what banks can do and increased their capital requirements, which has raised the cost of holding bonds.

zh: 尽管有人建议用宏观审慎政策抵消这些风险，但美国不存在宏观审慎政策 — — 除了已经实施的增加商业银行资本要求之外。
en: Although there is talk about offsetting these risks with macroprudential policies, no such policies exist in the US, except for the increased capital requirements that have been imposed on commercial banks.

zh: 没有政策降低影子银行、保险公司或共同基金的风险。
en: There are no policies to reduce risks in shadow banks, insurance companies, or mutual funds.

zh: 这就是现在美联储在考虑货币政策“正常化”时所面临的局面。
en: So that is the situation that the Fed now faces as it considers “normalizing” monetary policy.

zh: 联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC，美联储决策机构）的一些委员因此担心，提高短期联邦基金利率会导致长期利率大幅上升，造成投资者和贷款人损失，经济也受到拖累。
en: Some members of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC, the Fed’s policymaking body) therefore fear that raising the short-term federal funds rate will trigger a substantial rise in longer-term rates, creating losses for investors and lenders, with adverse effects on the economy.

zh: 也有委员担心，即使没有这些金融冲击，美国经济目前的强劲表现也会因为利率提高而终止。
en: Others fear that, even without such financial shocks, the economy’s current strong performance will not continue when interest rates are raised.

zh: 其他一些委员希望维持低利率以使失业率进一步下降，尽管这有可能加速通胀、继续增加金融部门风险。
en: And still other FOMC members want to hold down interest rates in order to drive the unemployment rate even lower, despite the prospects of accelerating inflation and further financial-sector risks.

zh: 但是，最终，FOMC委员们必须认识到，他们无法永远阻止利率升高，而一旦他们开始提高利率，就必须让实际（经通胀调整的）联邦基金利率相对迅速地提高到2 % 。
en: But, in the end, the FOMC members must recognize that they cannot postpone the increase in interest rates indefinitely, and that once they begin to raise the rates, they must get the real (inflation-adjusted) federal funds rate to 2% relatively quickly.

zh: 我自己的猜测是他们会在9月开始提高利率，联邦基金利率将在2017年的某个时候达到3%的水平。
en: My own best guess is that they will start to raise rates in September, and that the federal funds rate will reach 3% by some point in 2017.

zh: 美联储如何降低不平等性
en: How the Fed Just Reduced Inequality

zh: 纽约—美联储终于这么做了，近十年来第一次升息。
en: NEW YORK – The US Federal Reserve has finally done it, raising interest rates for the first time in almost a decade.

zh: 这对利差、新兴市场股市、住房需求和其他许多方面的影响是一个争论激烈的话题。
en: The ramifications for interest-rate spreads, emerging-market equities, and housing demand, among much else, are the subject of widespread debate.

zh: 但是，在市场不得不应对不太友好的货币政策的同时，也有一个重要的闪光点，这个闪光点大部分人都没有注意到。
en: But, as markets learn to cope with a less accommodative monetary policy, there could be an important silver lining, which most people have ignored.

zh: 自2008年全球金融危机爆发以来，美国收入和财富不平等稳步加剧，但货币政策正常化可能标志着这一趋势结束的开始。
en: Income and wealth inequality in the United States has grown steadily since the global financial crisis erupted in 2008, but monetary-policy normalization could mark the beginning of the end of this trend.

zh: 事实上，这有助于这一趋势的逆转。
en: Indeed, it should serve to accelerate its reversal.

zh: 看一看反映现状的令人触目惊心的统计数字。
en: Consider a few dismal statistics reflecting the current state of affairs.

zh: 美国实际（经通胀调整的）中位家庭收入和1979年的水平大致相当。
en: Real (inflation-adjusted) median household income in the US is about the same as in 1979.

zh: 皮尤研究中心的最新研究指出，2014年美国人的收入比2000年少4 % ， 并且40多年来第一次出现中产阶级不再占人口大部分的情况。
en: A recent study by the Pew Research Center noted that Americans earned 4% less income in 2014 than they did in 2000, and for the first time in more than 40 years, middle-class Americans no longer constitute a majority of the population.

zh: 如今，20位最富有美国人所拥有的财富比全部美国人口中较穷的一半的总和还要多。 美国高收入群体和其他群体之间的财富差距从未如此极端；富裕家庭占美国总人口的五分之一多。
en: America’s 20 wealthiest people now own more wealth than the bottom half of the entire population The wealth gap between America’s high-income group and everyone else has never been more extreme; rich households account for more than one in five of the entire US population.

zh: 令人震惊的是，在华尔街以北一小时路程的康涅狄格州布里奇波特（Bridgeport ） ， 基尼系数（衡量收入分配和不平等性的标准指标）比津巴布韦还要糟糕。
en: Strikingly, one hour north of Wall Street, in Bridgeport, Connecticut, the Gini coefficient – a standard measurement of income distribution and inequality – is worse than in Zimbabwe.

zh: 讽刺的是，这一趋势因为应对金融危机的政策而更加强烈了。
en: Ironically, this trend was exacerbated by the policy response to the financial crisis.

zh: 2007—2008年衰退导致高收入群体损失大于低收入群体（因为前者相对更多的收入来自波动性更大的资本收入而不是劳动收入 ） ， 但2009年以后，情况正好相反。
en: While the recession of 2007-2008 caused higher-income groups to suffer more than lower-income groups (because the former tend to derive relatively more of their income from more volatile sources of capital income, as opposed to labor income), the opposite has been true since 2009.

zh: 2009年以来，大约95%的全部收入增量流向了最顶层1%的腰包。
en: Since then, about 95% of all income gains have gone to the top 1%.

zh: 收入和财富不平等性加剧的原因是多样而微妙的；但最近一段时期的极端宽松货币政策所造成的意外后果必须受到指责。
en: The causes of rising income and wealth inequality are multiple and nuanced; but the unintended consequences of the recent unprecedented period of ultra-loose monetary policy deserves a chunk of the blame.

zh: 负实际利率和量化宽松加强了对现金持有者的金融抑制 ， “ 收割”了存款者，同时大面积刺激了高风险金融资产（一般主要由富人持有）的价格。
en: Negative real interest rates and quantitative easing have enforced financial repression on holders of cash, hurting savers, while broadly boosting prices of riskier financial assets, most commonly held by the rich.

zh: 当固定收入证券难以产生收益时，就连最保守的退休基金也纷纷转向风险资产，导致价格节节攀升。
en: When there is no yield in fixed income, even the most conservative pension funds pile into risk assets, driving prices higher and higher.

zh: 公司从这些刺激措施中收益颇丰，但这建立在劳动人口的损失之上。
en: Corporations have benefited massively from these stimulus measures, but at the expense of the working population.

zh: 公司旭也见了成本，推迟了基础设施投资，以极低利率借贷，并利用劳动力市场��软的状态拒不加薪，利润率随之提高到创纪录的水平。
en: Profit margins have expanded to record highs as companies have cut costs, delayed infrastructure investments, borrowed at ultra-low rates, and taken advantage of weak labor markets to avoid raising wages.

zh: 但现在趋势即将反转了吗？
en: But are we now on the verge of a trend reversal?

zh: 标准普尔500指数自2009年低点反弹了150 % ， 基于萎靡不振的增长动态，估值看上去已经相当高（希勒市盈率高达26倍，2009年只有15倍 ） 。
en: The S&P 500 has rallied 150% since its 2009 lows, and valuations look rich given weakening growth dynamics (the Shiller price/earnings ratio stands at 26, compared to 15 in 2009).

zh: 在这一背景下，短期内最富有的美国人已无法从金融投资中获得利润的进一步大幅提升。
en: Against this backdrop, the wealthiest Americans are unlikely to enjoy substantial further profits from their financial investments in the near term.

zh: 与此同时，我们应该看到，多年来第一次出现了有意义的工资上涨压力。
en: At the same time, we should see meaningful upward pressure on wages for the first time in many years.

zh: 失业率已经降到5 % ， 略高于美联储最新的不引起通胀加速的失业率（NAIRU）中位估计值。
en: The unemployment rate has dropped to 5%, just above the Fed’s current median estimate for the non-accelerating inflation rate of unemployment (NAIRU).

zh: 尽管真正的NAIRU水平可能还要更低一些，并且劳动参与率可能出现长期下降，但2016年美国劳动力市场仍应该趋紧。
en: While the true NAIRU level is probably lower, and we are likely witnessing a secular decline in the workforce participation rate, the US labor market should still tighten in 2016.

zh: 事实上，11月“不属于劳动力，目前想要找工作”的人数下降了416,000人，目前略高于560万；从历史上看，这类人的数量变化与工资上涨压力密切相关。
en: Indeed, the number of those “not in the labor force, currently want a job” category dropped 416,000, to just above 5.6 million, in November; historically, this kind of change has been closely associated with rising wage pressure.

zh: 而10月私营部门非农就业全体雇员平均时薪录得2.5%的年增长率，为2009年以来的最高值。
en: And the average hourly wages for all employees on private non-farm payrolls posted an annual increase of 2.5% in October, the biggest since 2009.

zh: 随着美联储缓慢提高利率，把辛苦赚的的储蓄存在银行的中产阶级家庭将开始从存款中获得一些回报。
en: As the Fed slowly raises interest rates, those middle-class families holding their hard-earned savings at the bank will finally start realizing some return on their deposits.

zh: 其长期效应不应该低估，因为复合存款（compound savings）能带来积极影响。
en: The long-term effects should not be underestimated, given the helpful impact of compound savings.

zh: 在2004—2006年的紧缩周期中，家庭利息收入增加了29 % 。
en: During the last tightening cycle between 2004 and 2006, households’ interest income rose 29%.

zh: 拜美联储紧缩的可能速度和规模所赐，这一次的这一收益应该规模更小、实现更晚，但储蓄所获得的利息将让家庭收入迈向正确的方向：增加。
en: Although this time, the gains presumably will be smaller and slower to arrive, owing to the likely pace and extent of Fed tightening, interest paid on savings will move household income in the right direction: up.

zh: 当然，大量政治改革 — — 每一项都有望带来积极的福利影响 — — 可能进一步降低不平等程度。
en: Of course, a multitude of political reforms, each with potential positive implications for welfare, could reduce the extent of inequality further.

zh: 但这些措施（比如增加税收制度的累进性）的障碍也是众所周知的，特别是考虑到总统选战的背景。
en: But the barriers to such measures – say, to make the tax system more progressive – are well known, especially against the backdrop of a presidential election campaign.

zh: 这意味着工人实际工资的增加形成影响最快，尽管这可能导致美国公司利润率下降。
en: This means that an increase in real wages for workers will have the most immediate impact, even if the downside is lower profit margins for corporate America.

zh: 美联储决定升息对于金融市场来说是一个历史性时刻，并且已经给全世界资产价格带来了波动增加的时期。
en: The Fed’s decision to raise rates is a historic moment for financial markets and is already ushering in a period of increased volatility for asset prices worldwide.

zh: 尽管这会对投资者构成挑战，但我们大可放心这对实体经济的影响。
en: Although this may be challenging for investors, we should take comfort in the implications for the real economy.

zh: 美国的社会契约已饱受摧残，并可能在即将到来的总统选举中造成重大影响，因为选民纷纷对日益难以企及的美国梦表示愤懑之情。
en: The social contract in the US has frayed badly, and this is likely to play an important role in the upcoming presidential election, as voters express anger that the American Dream is increasingly out of reach.

zh: 工资不增长、消费者购买力不提高的经济复苏无法自我维持。
en: No economic recovery can sustain itself without rising wages and higher consumer spending power.

zh: 美联储所释放的信号表明，这一必须的动态 — — 也许是不平等趋势的关键拐点 — — 终于要开始了。
en: The Fed may have just signaled that the beginning of this necessary dynamic, perhaps the key inflection point of the inequality trend, is finally here.

zh: 并且它也许已经尽了力让它更早到来。
en: And it may also have done its part to speed its arrival.

zh: 美国货币紧缩史的警示
en: A Cautionary History of US Monetary Tightening

zh: 伯克利—在过去四十年中，美联储四次着手收紧货币政策。
en: BERKELEY – The US Federal Reserve has embarked on an effort to tighten monetary policy four times in the past four decades.

zh: 在这四次中，每一次紧缩都引发了就业和产出降低的过程，并且下降幅度之大远超美联储工作人员的预测。
en: On every one of these occasions, the effort triggered processes that reduced employment and output far more than the Fed’s staff had anticipated.

zh: 美联储已准备好再次收紧货币政策，考察这段历史 — — 以及当前经济状况 — — 表明美国马上就要进入危险区域了。
en: As the Fed prepares to tighten monetary policy once again, an examination of this history – and of the current state of the economy – suggests that the United States is about to enter dangerous territory.

zh: 1979—1982年间，时任美联储主席保罗·沃克尔（Paul Volker）改变了当局的货币政策方针。
en: Between 1979 and 1982, then-Fed Chair Paul Volcker changed the authorities’ approach to monetary policy.

zh: 他的预期是，通过控制流通中货币量，美联储可以在更大幅度地降低利率的同时以比传统凯恩斯主义模型所预测的更小的幅度增加闲置产能和失业。
en: His expectation was that by controlling the amount of money in circulation, the Fed could bring about larger reductions in inflation with smaller increases in idle capacity and unemployment than what traditional Keynesian models predicted.

zh: 对美联储 — — 以及美国经济 — — 来说，不幸的是凯恩斯主义模型才是对的；它们关于不通胀（disinflation）的代价的预言完全正确。
en: Unfortunately for the Fed – and for the American economy – the Keynesian models turned out to be accurate; their forecasts of the costs of disinflation were dead on.

zh: 此外，这一货币紧缩期带来了预料外的后果；花旗集团等金融机构发现，救它们于破产的完全是监管宽容（regulatory forbearance ） ， 许多拉美国家陷入了长达五年以上的萧条。
en: Furthermore, this period of monetary tightening had unexpected consequences; financial institutions like Citicorp found that only regulatory forbearance saved them from having to declare bankruptcy, and much of Latin America was plunged into a depression that lasted more than five years.

zh: 接着，1988—1990年，艾伦·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）进行了新一轮货币紧缩，这轮紧缩摧毁了过度负债、资本不足、原本便已经岌岌可危的美国储贷协会的资产负债表。
en: Then, between 1988 and 1990, another round of monetary tightening under Alan Greenspan ravaged the balance sheets of the country’s savings and loan associations, which were overleveraged, undercapitalized, and already struggling to survive.

zh: 为了防止随之而来的衰退恶化，联邦政府被迫援助了资不抵债的机构。
en: To prevent the subsequent recession from worsening, the federal government was forced to bail out insolvent institutions.

zh: 州政府也被拖下了水：德克萨斯州将相当于全州三个月总收入的资金用于援助该州储贷银行及其储户。
en: State governments were on the hook, too: Texas spent the equivalent of three months of total state income to rescue its S&Ls and their depositors.

zh: 1993—1994年，格林斯潘再一次勒紧货币政策，结果人们惊讶地发现，小规模紧缩可以给长期资产价格和公司借贷成本带来如此大的影响。
en: Between 1993 and 1994, Greenspan once again reined in monetary policy, only to be surprised by the impact that small amounts of tightening could have on the prices of long-term assets and companies’ borrowing costs.

zh: 幸运的是，他愿意推翻自己的决定，立刻中止紧缩周期（在诸多负责制定政策的美联储公开市场委员会委员的抗议下 ） — —这一举动防止了美国重新滑入衰退。
en: Fortunately, he was willing to reverse his decision and cut the tightening cycle short (over the protests of many on the policy-setting Federal Open Markets Committee) – a move that prevented the US economy from slipping back into recession.

zh: 最近一次紧缩是2004—2007年，也是四次紧缩中最具破坏力的一次。
en: The most recent episode – between 2004 and 2007 – was the most devastating of the four.

zh: 格林斯潘和他的继任者本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）都不明白，在经历了长期去监管化后，房地产市场和金融体系已经变得多么脆弱。
en: Neither Greenspan nor his successor, Ben Bernanke, understood how fragile the housing market and the financial system had become after a long period of under-regulation.

zh: 这些双重错误 — — 去监管化，然后错误地收紧货币政策 — — 至今仍在折磨着美国经济。
en: These twin mistakes – deregulation, followed by misguided monetary-policy tightening – continue to gnaw at the US economy today.

zh: 如今，美联储似乎马上又要开启紧缩周期了。 这次紧缩正逢经济的微妙时刻。
en: The tightening cycle upon which the Fed now seems set to embark comes at a delicate time for the economy.

zh: 美国失业率也许暗示存在通胀抬头的风险，但就业-人口比仍表明经济举步维艰。
en: The US unemployment rate may seem to hint at the risk of rising inflation, but the employment-to-population ratio continues to signal an economy in deep distress.

zh: 事实上，工资形势表明，该比率，而非就业率，才是更好的经济松弛度指标 — — 而在十年前，没有人会将今天的就业-人口比作为货币紧缩的依据。
en: Indeed, wage patterns suggest that this ratio, not the unemployment rate, is the better indicator of slack in the economy – and nobody ten years ago would have interpreted today’s employment-to-population ratio as a justification for monetary tightening.

zh: 事实上，就连美联储也不相信经济面临着过热的紧迫威胁。
en: Indeed, not even the Fed seems convinced that the economy faces imminent danger of overheating.

zh: 美国通胀不但低于美联储的长期目标；并且至少三年内都将如此。
en: Inflation in the US is not just lower than the Fed’s long-term target; it is expected to stay that way for at least the next three years.

zh: 而美联储要在它自己的经济学家都认为美国财政政策过于严格的时候改变政策。
en: And the Fed’s change in policy comes at a time when its own economists believe that US fiscal policy is inappropriately restrictive.

zh: 与此同时，考虑到全球经济的脆弱性 — — 以及连通性，美国收紧货币政策可能产生负面海外效应（并给美国国内带来反作用力 ） ， 特别是考虑到中国的波动以及欧洲经济萎靡的情况下。
en: Meanwhile, given the fragility – and interconnectedness – of the global economy, tightening monetary policy in the US could have negative impacts abroad (with consequent blowback at home), especially given the instability in China and economic malaise in Europe.

zh: 你很有可能得出一个结论，即，美联储急于收紧货币政策 — — 尽管有不利的历史先例和经济不确定性存在 — — 背后的驱动力是对官方决策影响力过大的商业银行。
en: It is tempting to conclude that the Fed’s eagerness to tighten monetary policy – despite unfavorable historical precedents and ongoing economic uncertainty – is driven by commercial banks with excessive influence in official policymaking.

zh: 毕竟，商业银行的业务模式只有在银行每年（通过消极和相对较安全的长期投资）所赚的收益至少比它们向储户支付的利率高3%时才能运转下去。
en: After all, commercial banks’ business model works only when the banks can earn (via passive and relatively safe long-term investments) at least 3% a year more than they pay depositors.

zh: 而这只有在美国国债收益率比现在更高时才能实现。
en: And that is possible only if US Treasury rates are higher than they are now.

zh: 果真如此的话，这将反映出银行家没有理解银行业的实质利益（material interest ） 。
en: If this is true, it would reflect a failure by bankers to understand their industry’s material interests.

zh: 让商业银行获益最大的不是立即提高利率，而是有利于确保经济能够支持未来更高利率的货币政策。
en: What would most benefit commercial banks is not an immediate increase in interest rates, but a monetary policy that contributes to ensuring that the economy is capable of supporting higher interest rates in the future.

zh: 如果历史能够作为指引，那么在短期内收紧货币政策只能导致更多的经济动荡，然后是迅速回归低利率。
en: If history is any guide, tightening monetary policy in the near term will only lead to further economic turbulence, followed by a rapid retreat to low interest rates.

zh: 升息之路应该引起所有人的警觉。
en: Embarking on that path should be a cause of concern for everyone.

zh: 新兴经济体的美联储风险
en: The Fed’s Risk to Emerging Economies

zh: 米兰—美联储在坚守了近十年极低利率后终于提高了其联邦基金利率25个基点。 联邦基金利率是所有其他利率的参考利率。
en: MILAN – The US Federal Reserve has finally, after almost a decade of steadfast adherence to very low interest rates, hiked its federal funds rate – the rate from which all other interest rates in the economy take their cue – by 25 basis points.

zh: 这次升息将新利率提高到0.5 % ， 仍然很低，美联储主席耶伦聪明地承诺，未来升息都将是渐进的。
en: That brings the new rate up to a still-minimal 0.5%, and Fed Chair Janet Yellen has wisely promised that any future increases will be gradual.

zh: 从美国经济状态看 — — 实际增长率为2 % ， 劳动力市场吃紧，通胀也没有靠近美联储2%的目标 — — 我认为升息是迈向正常化的合理谨慎的第一步（正常化是指借款人和贷款人之间达成更好的平衡 ） 。
en: Given the state of the US economy – real growth of 2%, a tightening labor market, and little evidence of inflation rising toward the Fed’s 2% target – I view the rate rise as a reasonable and cautious first step toward normality (defined as a better balance between borrowers and lenders).

zh: 但是，其他央行，特别是产出缺口比美国更大的新兴经济体央行，不会急切地步美联储后尘。
en: However, other central banks, particularly in economies where the output gap is larger than in the United States, will not be keen to follow the Fed’s lead.

zh: 这意味着世界将迎来一段货币政策分歧时期，给全球经济带来不确定后果。
en: That implies a coming period of monetary-policy divergence, with uncertain consequences for the global economy.

zh: 在如此形势下，美国利率的微小变动应该不会导致全球资本流的剧烈变动。
en: On the face of it, a tiny change in the US rate should not trigger dramatic shifts in global capital flows.

zh: 但是，随着美国货币政策继续向利率正常化迈进，极有可能产生经济和金融连锁反应，特别是货币波动和破坏性流出新兴经济体。
en: But, as US monetary policy follows the path of interest-rate normalization, there could well be knock-on effects, both economic and financial, especially in the form of currency volatility and destabilizing outflows from emerging economies.

zh: 我们之所以应该担忧这一可能性，是因为世界经济均衡脆弱不稳 — — 如果没有果断而的协作政策干预，可能出现危险的波动。
en: The reason we should fear this possibility is that the world’s economic equilibrium is both fragile and unstable – and could wobble dangerously without determined and coordinated policy intervention.

zh: 美联储升息未必会导致如此波动，但其他一些看似安全的事件可能达到这一“效果 ” 。
en: A Fed rate hike might not tip it over, but some other seemingly innocuous event could.

zh: 不需要很久远的记忆就能理解相对温和的政策变化如何引发市场的剧烈反应。
en: One doesn’t need a long memory to understand how even relatively modest policy shifts can trigger outsize market reactions.

zh: 比如，2013年春金融市场出现了一次“锥形崩盘 ” ， 原因只是时任美联储主席伯南克（Ben Bernanke）说决策者正在考虑逐渐停止量化宽松。
en: Consider, for example, the “taper tantrum” that roiled financial markets in the spring of 2013, after then-Fed Chair Ben Bernanke said only that policymakers were thinking of gradually ending quantitative easing.

zh: 但伯南克的这番话出乎人们意料（今年夏天人民贬值也是如此 ） 。
en: But that announcement came as a surprise (as did the devaluation of China’s renminbi this past summer).

zh: 涌入新兴市场追寻在发达经济体无法实现的高收益率的资本猛然转向。
en: Capital that had flooded into emerging markets seeking yields no longer available in developed economies abruptly reversed course.

zh: 没人愿意成为最后一个离开的。
en: No investor wanted to be the last one out.

zh: 我们现在的全球金融体系犹如惊弓之鸟，一点都不欢迎意外冲击。
en: A jittery global financial system, like the one we have now, does not tolerate unwelcome surprises well.

zh: 和锥形崩盘以及人民币贬值不同，12月16日的美联储升息决定不属于意外。
en: Unlike the taper tantrum and the devaluation of the renminbi, the Fed’s rate-hike announcement on December 16 certainly was no surprise.

zh: 因此，人们也许会认为，如果美联储的动作却是导致了国际资本流波动，这一过程必然也已经开始了。
en: So one might argue that if the Fed’s move does lead to volatility in international capital flows, the process must have already started.

zh: 事实上，几乎被一致预期到的美联储升息没有造成资本流或资产价格的大起大落。
en: In fact, near-universal anticipation of a US rate rise did not produce a spike in capital flows or asset prices.

zh: 但普遍的担忧依然存在。
en: Yet widespread concerns persist.

zh: 比如，国际货币基金组织（IMF）认为美联储的任何升息举动都需要“有效的货币政策沟通策略 ” — —委婉的表示美国和其他发达经济体的任何货币紧缩政策都操之过急了。
en: The International Monetary Fund for example, has argued that any rate hike by the Fed would need an “effective monetary policy communication strategy” – a polite way of saying that any monetary tightening in the US and other advanced economies would be premature.

zh: 原因在于新兴经济体对低利率和高大宗商品价格产生了危险的依赖。
en: The reasoning is that emerging economies have become dangerously dependent on low interest rates and high commodity prices.

zh: 许多新兴市场公司十分虚弱，背负着沉重的外币债务。
en: Many emerging-market companies are in the highly vulnerable position of having borrowed heavily in foreign currencies.

zh: 如果发生资本逃离，后果将十分可怕：信用收紧，收支平衡出现困难，通货膨胀，利率上升，财政压力，以及被主要评级机构降级 — — 所有这些都意味着更多的资本逃离。
en: If capital flight occurs, the consequences will be dire: tightened credit, balance-of-payments difficulties, inflation, rising interest rates, fiscal stress, and downgrades by the major credit-rating agencies – all of which implies more capital flight.

zh: 欧洲人也变得依赖低利率，他们有欧洲央行充当重要的稳定器。
en: Europeans, too, have become dependent on low interest rates, with the European Central Bank as the key stabilizing force.

zh: 欧洲央行自2012年以来一直竭尽全力阻止主权债务收益率一飞冲天，若非如此，欧元区也将有持久的主权债务违约风险 — — 甚至整个欧盟都会受到动摇��
en: Without the ECB’s commitment, in place since 2012, to prevent sovereign-debt yields from soaring, there would be a persistent risk to the eurozone – and, indeed, to the entire edifice of the European Union – of sovereign-debt defaults.

zh: 但至少欧洲是大宗商品价格下跌的受益者。
en: But at least Europe has benefited from falling commodity prices.

zh: 相反，许多新兴经济体高度依赖大宗商品出口收益，它们因为大宗商品价格暴跌、发达经济体增长乏力和中国增长减速而饱受压力。
en: By contrast, many emerging economies, highly dependent on commodity export earnings, have been stressed by the commodity-price reset, sluggish growth in developed economies, and slower growth in China.

zh: 资本外逃则令它们雪上加霜 — — 一些国家因此一蹶不振。
en: Capital flight would materially add to their plight – in some cases disastrously so.

zh: 自2008年金融危机以来，世界已经习惯于这样的联系和溢出效应。
en: Since the 2008 financial crisis, the world has become accustomed to such linkages and spillovers.

zh: 而应对危机的政策反应仍然是各自为政。
en: And yet policy responses to crises remain decentralized.

zh: 新兴经济体没有自己的欧洲央行。
en: There is no ECB for the emerging economies.

zh: 它们无法信任它们的决策者能应对快速的资本外流，也无法信任政策工具、储备和资产负债表。
en: They cannot be confident of appropriate reactions by their policymakers to rapid capital outflows, or of their capacity in terms of policy tools, reserves, and balance sheets.

zh: 它们无法确定国际政策反应的“断路器”效果。
en: And they cannot be fully certain of the speed and effectiveness of the international policy responses that might otherwise act as “circuit breakers.”

zh: 现实是在2008年危机后受益于中国经济增长、大宗商品价格上涨和廉价外国资本的新兴市场现在必须适应所有这些因素的一齐逆转。
en: The reality is that emerging markets that benefited after the 2008 crisis from China’s economic growth, rising commodity prices, and cheap foreign capital must now adjust to reversals in all of these factors.

zh: 这些市场的必要转型是复杂而危险的，它们自身未必能够完全掌控。
en: The necessary transitions for these markets will be complex, risky, and not entirely within their control.

zh: 美联储在升息的同时强调了微小、渐进的节奏原则，因此这也许不会成为触发因素，但对连锁反应的担忧不无道理。
en: While the Fed’s rate hike, prudently accompanied by an emphasis on small and gradual steps, may not turn out to be a trigger, the concerns about the knock-on effects are legitimate.

zh: 认为第一步升息已经过去，因此系统性风险已经有所消散的观点是不明智的。
en: It would be unwise to assume that, with the initial hike now behind us, systemic risk has somehow disappeared.

zh: 当然，从长期看，新兴市场将从利率正常化中获益，因为它们不再需要面对导致不可持续增长路径的扭曲和失衡。
en: In the long run, of course, emerging markets will benefit from interest-rate normalization, because they will no longer suffer the distortions and imbalances that lead to unsustainable growth patterns.

zh: 但难点在于平安地从短期过渡到长期。
en: But the hard part will be getting from here to there without an accident.

zh: 费利佩·卡尔德龙的两副面孔
en: Felipe Calderón’s Two Faces

zh: 墨西哥城 — — 墨西哥总统费利佩·卡尔德隆终于达到了自己的目的：逼迫美国大使卡洛斯·帕斯夸尔辞职。
en: MEXICO CITY – Mexican President Felipe Calderón has finally gotten what he wanted: the resignation of United States Ambassador Carlos Pascual.

zh: 卡尔德隆惩罚了通过维基解密秘密电报透露坏消息的信使。
en: Calderón shot the messenger for delivering bad news through confidential cables released by WikiLeaks.

zh: 帕斯夸尔对四年前卡尔德隆“反毒战争”的严厉评价激怒了这位总统。
en: Pascual’s harsh assessments of the “war on drugs” that Calderón unleashed four years ago infuriated the president.

zh: 因为指出军队经常不对美国提供的情报采取行动并极端厌恶风险，此次泄密事件也惹恼了墨西哥军队。
en: The revelations also annoyed the Mexican army, for they pointed out that the military frequently doesn’t act on intelligence provided by the US, and displays a strong aversion to risk.

zh: 此外，帕斯夸尔坦率地批评了墨西哥安全机构内斗比打击有组织犯罪更积极的混乱状况。
en: Moreover, Pascual’s candid assessments described a dysfunctional situation in which Mexican security agencies fight each other more than they fight organized crime.

zh: 实际上，帕斯夸尔因为说出了卡尔德隆及其政府宁愿忽视也不愿面对的现实而被迫离职。
en: Essentially, Pascual was forced to leave for describing a reality that Calderón does not want to face, and that his government would prefer to ignore.

zh: 换句话讲，他因为恪尽职守而丢掉了工作。
en: In other words, he lost his job for doing it properly.

zh: 但这位美国外交官揭露的残酷现实每天都在发生，不管逮捕的贩毒头目，发现的武器或缴获的可卡因数量有什么影响。
en: But the stubborn truth revealed by the US diplomat emerges every day, despite the impact of drug kingpins who are arrested, the number of weapons discovered, or the amount of cocaine seized.

zh: 墨西哥没有打赢这场针对贩毒和有组织犯罪的“战争 ” ： 帕斯夸尔的辞职无法掩盖34，000人丧生，越来越多墨西哥人染上毒瘾，绑架和处决数量激增和大面积犯罪行为不受惩罚的残酷现实。
en: Mexico is not winning the “war” against drug trafficking and organized crime: Pascual’s forced resignation cannot hide the 34,000 dead, the growing number of Mexicans addicted to drugs, the surge in kidnappings and executions, and widespread impunity.

zh: 官方的说法是暴力是对抗贩毒集团的必然结果。
en: The official narrative is that violence is an inevitable consequence of taking on the drug cartels.

zh: 但其他国家的确防止了贩毒集团向无辜民众发泄怒火。
en: But other countries have managed to prevent drug gangs from unleashing their fury on innocent civilians.

zh: 尽管墨西哥人得到的说法是暴力活动只发生在帮派内部，但可以判处死刑的罪名却不仅仅限于贩毒。
en: And, while Mexicans are told that the violence is only between rival gangs, executions transcend the realm of drug trafficking.

zh: 政府告诫民众要声讨犯罪份子，但98.5%的刑事调查却永远没有结果。
en: Citizens are exhorted by their government to denounce criminals, though 98.5% of criminal investigations are never solved.

zh: 最近的民意调查显示59%的墨西哥人认为政府的反毒战争失败，只有23%的人支持政府目前的举措。
en: A recent poll showed that 59% of Mexicans believe that the government is losing the war that it declared, while only 23% support the government’s current course.

zh: 正如《孙子兵法》所云，欺骗是所有战争的必然结果。
en: As Sun Tzu wrote in The Art of War, all wars entail deception.

zh: 墨西哥就是最新的受害者。
en: Mexico has become its latest victim.

zh: 墨西哥政府不肯如实说出所面对的问题、采取的措施和要求美国给予的支持、参与和协作。
en: The Mexican government has not been sufficiently honest about the scale of the challenges that it faces, the measures that it has taken, and the level of US support, involvement, and collaboration that it has sought.

zh: 这也是卡尔德隆战争条件的矛盾、隐晦和不透明所在。
en: Therein lie the contradictions, evasiveness, and lack of transparency regarding the terms on which Calderón’s war is being conducted.

zh: 卡氏政府人人要求美国提供更多的关注和资源，但又公开拒绝美国加强驻墨力量。
en: Everyone on his team demands that the US devote more attention and resources to Calderón’s effort, but publicly denies doing so when evidence of heightened US presence in Mexico becomes public.

zh: 最近几周，卡尔德隆政府在解释授权美国无人机穿越墨领空搜集情报的方法和原因时前言不搭后语。
en: In recent weeks, the Calderón administration has twisted itself into knots trying to explain how and why it authorized US drone planes to fly over Mexican territory for intelligence-gathering purposes.

zh: 然而，就在卡尔德隆坚持美国负起双边责任的同时，他也要求美国大使为揭露其在执意发动的这场战争中的战略和战术失误而引咎辞职。
en: And yet, while Calderón insists that the US assume its bilateral responsibilities, he also demands the US Ambassador’s head for revealing his own tactical and strategic mistakes in the war he insists on prosecuting.

zh: 墨西哥政界习惯借谴责美国来给自己加分，卡尔德隆的立场因此自相矛盾。
en: Calderón’s contradictory stance is rooted in the reflexive habits of a Mexican political class trained to gain points by kicking the US.

zh: 卡尔德隆也经常借墨西哥国旗和抨击陷入重围的主权来当挡箭牌。
en: Calderón, too, has sought refuge behind the folds of the Mexican flag and in diatribes about sovereignty under siege.

zh: 换句话说，卡尔德隆一边谴责美国干涉其内政，一边又积极寻求美国的干涉。
en: In other words, Calderón accuses the US of intervention, even as he assiduously seeks it.

zh: 他的政府在推动美国干涉的同时严厉批评美国干涉。
en: He criticizes the US for meddling, after his government promoted that meddling.

zh: 无能或不负责任的墨西哥当局在迫使帕斯夸尔扮演总督角色的同时又借此对其横加指责。
en: Pascual is accused of behaving like a “Proconsul,” after Mexican authorities – due to incompetence or irresponsibility – assigned him that role.

zh: 最近一次会面中，卡尔德隆因帕斯夸尔发电报说明真实情况而痛斥这位美国大使“无知 ” 。
en: In a recent interview, Calderón lambasted Pascual for his “ignorance,” after the ambassador sent incontrovertible cables describing the real situation on the ground.

zh: 电报内容读起来令人痛苦，但却令人难以反驳。
en: They’re painful to read, but difficult to refute.

zh: 卡尔德隆的当务之急不是杀死信使，而是认真反思这场战争及其发动的条件。
en: Rather than shooting the messenger, Calderón should reflect on the message itself, and rethink not only the war but the terms on which he has decided to wage it.

zh: 电报应促使卡尔德隆纠正目前滋生暴力，但却没有遏制贩毒的无效策略。
en: The cables should lead Calderón to rectify a strategy that so far has increased the level of violence without decreasing drug trafficking.

zh: 这场战争“成功”与否要靠暴力伤亡的缓和程度来衡量。
en: The “success” of the war needs to be measured by the reduction in its toll of violence.

zh: 此外，帕斯夸尔的结论应该迫使卡尔德隆以更诚实的方式重新界定墨美关系。
en: Moreover, Pascual’s conclusions should force Calderón to redefine Mexico’s relationship with the US in a more honest fashion.

zh: 因为若非如此，卡尔德隆迫使美国大使出局及其凭借此举获得的任何短期政治利益都不会带来好的结果。
en: Because if all of this does not happen, Calderón’s ability to force out the US ambassador, and any short-term political gain he obtained in doing so, will be irrelevant.

zh: 实际上，在这个“丑陋的美国人”打包滚蛋之后，华雷斯仍将是世界上最危险的城市。
en: Indeed, after the “ugly American” has packed his bags, Ciudad Juárez will still be the most dangerous city in the world.

zh: 墨西哥的杀人案发率仍将居高不下，公安机关仍将对导致国家边缘化的绝大多数暴力案件的预防、侦破或惩罚束手无策。
en: The homicide rate in the country will continue to soar, and public security agencies will remain incapable of preventing, detecting, or punishing the vast majority of violent events that have placed the country on edge.

zh: 墨西哥政府仍将以诡异的方式要求美国的援助，而在公之于众时又忙着矢口否认。
en: The Mexican government will continue to request US aid in a surreptitious fashion, and deny doing so when it becomes public.

zh: 问题已经非常明确。
en: The message is clear.

zh: 如果我们墨西哥人不结束这场考虑不周、执行不力、解释不清的战争，我们就会为它陪葬。
en: If we Mexicans don’t end this war – so ill-conceived, so poorly executed, and so badly explained – it will end us.

zh: 这一点不用看卡洛斯·帕斯夸尔的泄密电报也能知道。
en: One does not have to read Carlos Pascual’s leaked cables to understand that.

zh: 男性大脑和女权主义
en: Feminism and the Male Brain

zh: 纽约 — — 我这一代北美人是听着20世纪70年代“自由自在…表现真我”的儿童唱片长大的，在这张唱片中，伟大的前足球巨星格里尔唱道“哭吧没关系 ” 。
en: NEW YORK – North Americans of my generation grew up with the 1970’s children’s record “Free to Be...You and Me,” on which Rosey Grier, an immense former football star, sang “It’s Alright to Cry.”

zh: 这就是说：女孩可以坚强，而男孩不坚强也没有关系。
en: The message: girls could be tough, and boys were allowed not to be.

zh: 近40年来，那个年代西方女权主义批评在性别角色领域的僵化成见一直占统治地位。
en: For almost 40 years, that era’s Western feminist critique of rigid sex-role stereotyping has prevailed.

zh: 在很多方面，它侵蚀甚至是消灭了那种把温和的男孩变成有侵略性的男人、并让有抱负的女孩深陷低薪工作而无法自拔的强迫性限制。
en: In many ways, it has eroded or even eliminated the kind of arbitrary constraints that turned peaceable boys into aggressive men and stuck ambitious girls in low-paying jobs.

zh: 女权主义者一直不愿承认挑战这类性别角色批评的科学依据，这一点是可以理解的。
en: Feminists understandably have often shied away from scientific evidence that challenges this critique of sex roles.

zh: 毕竟，由于有关性别差异的生物依据在过去一直被用来解释女性的从属地位，女性也因此不愿承认任何先天的差异，唯恐这会被当成对她们不利的证据。
en: After all, because biology-based arguments about gender difference have historically been used to justify women’s subjugation, women have been reluctant to concede any innate difference, lest it be used against them.

zh: 不过，鉴于最新得出的科学结论，女权主义者拒绝承认任何天生性别差异的存在是否只能创造出新的偏见？
en: But, in view of recent scientific discoveries, has feminist resistance to accepting any signs of innate gender difference only created new biases?

zh: 举例来讲，女权主义批评已经彻底重塑了基础教育，其中的统治地位由女性决策者占据：校园里男性等级制度的建立如今经常被重新引导，因为人们对“欺侮”一词充满了恐惧，无论男孩女孩都被希望“分享”和“处理”他们的情绪。
en: The feminist critique, for example, has totally remade elementary-level education, where female decision-makers prevail: the construction of male hierarchies in the schoolyard is often redirected nowadays for fear of “bullying,” with boys and girls alike expected to “share” and “process” their emotions.

zh: 但许多教育学家已经开始提出，对于硬性“男孩特点”诸如此类的干预可以导致男孩的学业成绩逊于女孩，被频繁诊断出行为疾患、注意力缺失，以及诸如此类的其他问题。
en: But many educators have begun to argue that such intervention in what may be a hardwired aspect of “boy-ness” can lead to boys’ academic underperformance relative to girls, and to more frequent diagnoses of behavioral problems, attention deficit disorder, and so on.

zh: 而教育问题不过是个开始。
en: And education is just the beginning.

zh: 对男性建立等级制度、保护领土权和参与冲突的趋向不分青红皂白的批判形成了完整的学术领域。
en: An entire academic discipline emerged out of the wholesale critique of the male tendency to create hierarchy, engage in territoriality, and be drawn to conflict.

zh: 我上大学时 ， “ 家长制”的女权主义解决方案是想象中没有等级制度的世界，人们在这里整天靠语言交流，建立起情感方面的联系。
en: When I was in college, the feminist solution to “patriarchy” was an imagined world without hierarchy, where people verbalized all day long and created emotional bonds.

zh: 这种对“男子气”的批评同样在很大程度上影响了亲密关系：女性受到鼓励，表达因男子拒绝“分享”他们内心生活所引起的不满情绪。
en: This critique of “masculinity” also dramatically affected intimate relationships: women were encouraged to express their dissatisfaction with men’s refusal to “share” their inner lives.

zh: 女性抱怨没有人听她讲话，抱怨男人下班后就钻进车库修修补补不见人影，或者坐在电视机前发呆。
en: Women complained of not being heard, of men disappearing after work to tinker in the garage or zone out in front of the TV.

zh: 不过不管如何真心实意，这样的抱怨都假定男人所有这些行为无不是 有意为之。
en: But, however heartfelt, such complaints assumed that men choose all of their behavior.

zh: 现在大量以脑显像以及全新人类和进化研究成果为基础的科学分析表明我们可能一直在逃避现实，我们必须愿意尽力解决两性间至少某些真实存在并可以度量的性别差异问题。
en: Now a spate of scientific analyses, based on brain imaging technology and new anthropological and evolutionary discoveries, suggests that we may have had our heads in the sand, and that we must be willing to grapple with what seem to be at least some genuine, measurable differences between the sexes.

zh: 人类学家海伦·费舍尔 《爱的解析》 是上述研究中最著名的一项，它解释了人类求爱、结婚、通奸、离婚和抚养子女倾向背后存在的进化动力。
en: The most famous of these studies, anthropologist Helen Fisher’s The Anatomy of Love , explains the evolutionary impetus for human tendencies in courtship, marriage, adultery, divorce, and childrearing.

zh: 她的某些发现引发了广泛争议：比如，我们可能会有多次一夫一妻的经历，必须非常努力才能很好地维护伴侣关系；再如情欲亢奋的女性拥有进化优势；以及灵长类动物的调情非常类似于今天酒吧里男女青年表达性喜好的方式。
en: Some of her findings are provocative: it seems, for example, that we are hard-wired for serial monogamy and must work very hard to maintain pair-bonds; that highly orgasmic women enjoy an evolutionary advantage; and that flirtation among primates closely resembles the way young men and women in a bar show their sexual interest today.

zh: 此外，在对人类进化的描述中，费舍尔强调能够忍受长时间沉默的男性（以捕猎状态等待猎物）能将他们的基因传递下去，因此从基因的角度讲他们会选择“空间”偏好。
en: Moreover, in her description of our evolution, Fisher notes that males who could tolerate long periods of silence (waiting for animals while in hunt mode) survived to pass on their genes, thus genetically selecting to prefer “space.”

zh: 恰恰相反，女性则只有通过与他人合作、形成团体才能更好地生存下去，因为她们需要团体来采集块根、坚果和浆果，并同时照顾孩子。
en: By contrast, females survived best by bonding with others and building community, since such groups were needed to gather roots, nuts, and berries, while caring for small children.

zh: 读过费舍尔的研究结果，人们就更倾向于让男孩们相互挑战并测试环境，同时像她所说的那样接受男女合作生存是大自然的设计。
en: Reading Fisher, one is more inclined to leave boys alone to challenge one another and test their environment, and to accept that, as she puts it, nature designed men and women to collaborate for survival.

zh: “合作”隐含着自由意愿和选择，就连灵长类动物中的雄性也无法通过占有或者控制雌性来取得成功。
en: “Collaboration” implies free will and choice; even primate males do not succeed by dominating or controlling females.

zh: 在她的分析中，男人和女人分享他们有时差异巨大但通常又互为补充的优势符合所有人的利益 — — 这样的结论似乎很令人放心，而不是给人压力。
en: In her analysis, it serves everyone for men and women to share their sometimes different but often complementary strengths – a conclusion that seems reassuring, not oppressive.

zh: 由神经生物学领域顾问麦克·古瑞创作的 《他到底在想什么？ 》 进一步发展了这样的看法。
en: What Could He Be Thinking? , by Michael Gurian, a consultant in the field of neurobiology, takes this set of insights further.

zh: 古瑞提出男人的大脑实际可以被太多关于情绪的语言加工侵入并且压倒，因此男人发呆或从事某些机械活动而不是表达感情的需求通常并不是拒绝伴侣的表现，而只是一种神经方面的需要。
en: Gurian argues that men’s brains can actually feel invaded and overwhelmed by too much verbal processing of emotion, so that men’s need to zone out or do something mechanical rather than emote is often not a rejection of their spouses, but a neural need.

zh: 古瑞甚至假设男性的大脑事实上不能像女性那样“看到”成堆的灰尘或待洗的衣物，这可以解释为什么男人和女人以不同的方式处理家务。
en: Gurian even posits that the male brain actually can’t “see” dust or laundry piling up as the female brain often can, which explains why men and women tend to perform household tasks in different ways.

zh: 男人通常听 不 到女人的低音，他们的大脑和女人不一样，存在一种“休眠”模式（他在有些时候实际上“什么也没想 ” ！ ）
en: Men often can’t hear women’s lower tones, and their brains, unlike women’s, have a “rest” state (he actually is sometimes thinking about “nothing”!).

zh: 此外，古瑞提出由于相似的神经病学原理，男人倾向于以一种不同于女性的方式来抚养孩子，鼓励孩子更多地冒险和独立，而对育儿方面的细节并不那么关注。
en: Moreover, Gurian argues that men tend to rear children differently from women for similarly neurological reasons, encouraging more risk-taking and independence and with less awareness of the details of their nurture.

zh: 人们可以看到两种教育方式并存给孩子带来的好处。
en: One can see the advantages to children of having both parenting styles.

zh: 他敦促女人尝试肩并肩的活动，而不是面对面的交流，通过这种方式来体验与伴侣的亲密关系。
en: He urges women to try side-by-side activities, not only face-to-face verbalization, to experience closeness with their mates.

zh: 从某种角度讲，所有这些事实都让人放松，而不是使人发怒。
en: Somehow, all this is liberating rather than infuriating.

zh: 那些激怒女性、或者让她们感到遭受拒绝或没有被倾听的因素可能并不反应男性的有意忽视甚至性别歧视，而只是因为大脑的连接方式不同！
en: So much that enrages women, or leads them to feel rejected or unheard, may not reflect men’s conscious neglect or even sexism, but simply their brains’ wiring!

zh: 按照古瑞的说法，如果女性接受上述生物差异并在两性关系中找到解决的办法，男人就会以更多的欣赏和忠诚作为回报（通常会以非语言的方式来表达 ） 。
en: According to Gurian, if women accept these biological differences and work around them in relationships, men respond with great appreciation and devotion (often expressed nonverbally).

zh: 接受上述结果的女性报告与生命中男性的关系变得更亲密，同时也更顺畅。
en: Women who have embraced these findings report that relations with the men in their lives become much smoother and, paradoxically, more intimate.

zh: 这些结论并不意味着男人和女人不应努力调整各自的愿望，要求分担家务劳动的责任，或期望“有人听自己说话 ” 。
en: None of this means that men and women should not try to adjust to each other's wishes, ask for shared responsibility with housework, or expect to be “heard.”

zh: 但它可能意味着我们可以更好地去了解对方，并且更耐心地进行沟通和交流。
en: But it may mean we can understand each other a bit better and be more patient as we seek communication.

zh: 最新的科学研究并未显示男人（或女人）应当高人一等，更不用说为令人作呕的歧视找到证据了。
en: Nor does recent scientific research imply that men (or women) are superior, much less justify invidious discrimination.

zh: 不过它们确实显示一个开放地对待所有差异的更加多元化的社会，可以更好地学习、工作和恋爱。
en: But it does suggest that a more pluralistic society, open to all kinds of difference, can learn, work, and love better.

zh: 虚构主权国家
en: Fictional Sovereignties

zh: 伦敦—一年前，小国格鲁吉亚试图重新控制被其合围的叛离之地南奥塞梯。
en: LONDON – A year ago, tiny Georgia tried to regain control over its breakaway enclave of South Ossetia.

zh: 俄国人很快出兵驱逐了格鲁吉亚军队。 此举遭到西方的一致谴责。
en: The Russians quickly expelled the Georgian army, to almost universal opprobrium from the West.

zh: 南奥塞梯和阿布哈兹（总人口30万）立即宣布“独立 ” ， 建立了两个虚构的主权国家，并在此期间努力发展所有官方的国家身份系统：民族英雄、光鲜的制服、国歌、国旗、边境哨所、军队、总统、议会以及最重要的走私和腐败的新机会。
en: South Ossetia, together with Abkhazia (combined population 300,000), promptly declared their “independence,” creating two new fictional sovereignties, and acquiring in the process all the official trappings of statehood: national heroes, colorful uniforms, anthems, flags, frontier posts, military forces, presidents, parliaments, and, most important, new opportunities for smuggling and corruption.

zh: 到目前为止，只有俄罗斯和尼加拉瓜承认阿布哈兹和南奥塞梯的独立。
en: So far, only Russia and Nicaragua recognize the independence of Abkhazia and South Ossetia.

zh: 俄罗斯的承认被广泛认为是其对西方在去年初承认科索沃的报复。 拥有200万人口的科索沃是塞尔维亚的一个分裂省份。
en: Russian recognition was widely seen as retaliation for Western recognition of Kosovo (population two million), the breakaway province of Serbia, earlier last year.

zh: 格鲁吉亚以西1000英里就是摩尔多瓦（人口350万 ） 。
en: A thousand miles to the west of Georgia is Moldova (population 3.5 million), which lies between Romania and Ukraine.

zh: 它位于罗马尼亚和乌克兰之间，1812年被沙俄吞并，1918年加入罗马尼亚，1940年重新被前苏联侵占，最终于1991年摆脱莫斯科的统治获得独立。
en: Annexed by Tsarist Russia in 1812, joined to Romania in 1918, and re-annexed by the Soviet Union in 1940, it seized its independence from Moscow in 1991.

zh: 它是联合国、欧洲理事会、世贸组织、欧洲安全与合作组织等多个重要国际机构的成员国。
en: It is a member of the United Nations, the Council of Europe, the World Trade Organization, the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe, and various other prestigious international bodies.

zh: 摩尔多瓦的名声主要来自于史蒂芬王在十五世纪的一次伟大战役中打败了奥斯曼人。
en: Moldova’s main claim to fame is King Stephen the Great, who defeated the Ottomans in a great fifteenth century battle.

zh: 它也出产葡萄佳酿。
en: It also produces rather good wine.

zh: 我最近走访该国首都基希纳乌所获得的一个持久印象是一张竞选海报。 海报上一位名为鲁普的政治人物将一副眼镜举到眼前，不清楚这究竟是暗示着远见还是智慧。
en: An enduring memory from my own recent visit to its capital Chisinau is the election poster of a local politician called Lupu, who holds a pair of spectacles to his eyes, whether to suggest visions or wisdom isn’t clear.

zh: 从敖德萨（现在乌克兰境内）驾车到摩尔多瓦必须经过所谓的Transdniestria“共和国 ” （ 人口70万 ） ， 德涅斯特河北岸的一条狭长地带。
en: To get to Moldova from Odessa (now in Ukraine) one must drive through the self-proclaimed “republic” of Transdniestria (population 700,000), a sliver of land on the north shore of the Dniester river.

zh: 一片斑驳的建筑、锈蚀的铁丝网和一个肮脏的厕所标志着Transdniestria主权的起始。
en: A clump of peeling buildings, rusting wire, and a filthy lavatory mark the start of Transdniestrian sovereignty.

zh: 穿行在这个污秽却重兵把守的边境哨所，需要敲大量的图章和进行无处不在的贿赂，这一过程在离开该“共和国”时又周而复始。
en: Progress through this squalid, but well manned, frontier post involved the stamping of lots of documents and a liberal scattering of bribes, a process repeated on leaving the “republic.”

zh: 一个影子般的、黑社会性质的公司，Sheriff，掌控着绝大部分经济命脉。
en: A shadowy mafia-style company, Sheriff, owns most of the economy.

zh: 据说该公司和总统及其家庭有着密切的关系。
en: It is said to have close links to the president and his family.

zh: 该公司在首都Tiraspol修建了一个巨大的足球场，似乎要借此来象征其国民的男子气概。
en: It has built a giant football stadium in the capital, Tiraspol, which seems to be some kind of symbol of Transdniestrian virility.

zh: 由于未受到世界其他国家的承认，该国的“独立”由俄罗斯驻军来保全。
en: Unrecognized by the rest of the world, Transdniestrian “independence” is secured by a Russian garrison.

zh: 世界人口约六十亿。
en: The world’s population is about six billion.

zh: 假设将其等分为200万人口的独立政治单位，那就将意味着3000个拒绝接受更高主权的微型国家。
en: Suppose it was divided into independent political units of two million people each. That would mean 3,000 micro-states, each refusing to accept any sovereignty superior to its own.

zh: 当然，这将会是全球无政府主义状态的温床。
en: Of course, this would be a recipe for global anarchy.

zh: 然而，过去一个世纪以来的趋势是小国家的数量不断增多，这主要是由于针对多民族帝国的民族主义反抗的发生：最近一次大规模的建国潮出现在前苏联解体之后。
en: Yet the trend over the past century has been towards a continuous increase in the number of small states, mainly owing to nationalist revolts against multi-national empires: the latest bout of state creation followed the disintegration of the USSR.

zh: 就连英国这样的老牌国家现在也出现了强势的分裂运动。
en: Even long-established states like the United Kingdom now have strong separatist movements.

zh: 即便在世界的经济生活日益全球化的情况下，我们的政治生活也正日益倒退到某种形式的部族主义。
en: In its political life, the world has been regressing to a form of tribalism, even as its economic life has become increasingly globalized.

zh: 将国家等同于民族是我们这个时代无出其右的异端邪说。
en: The equation of state with nation is the arch-heresy of our time.

zh: 一个“民族 ” ， 从根本上讲，是一个种族语言学—间或也是宗教—的实体。 因为文化是通过语言和礼拜仪式传播的，所以每一个民族都会有自身独特的文化历史，可以被使用和误用，被发明和发现。
en: A “nation” is, at root, an ethno-linguistic – occasionally religious – entity, and because it is through language and liturgy that culture is transmitted, each nation will have its own distinctive cultural history, available for use and misuse, invention and discovery.

zh: 然而���家却是一种政治构造，目的是在一片具有经济活力的领土上维持和平。
en: The state, however, is a political construction, designed to keep the peace in an economically viable territory.

zh: 有太多实际或潜在的“民族”可以形成世界国家体系的基础。 更重要的是，它们中的许多经过了数世纪以来的相互纠葛，早已是剪不断，理还乱。
en: There are simply too many “nations,” actual or potential, to form the basis of a world system of states, not least because so many of them, having been jumbled up for centuries, cannot now be disentangled.

zh: 微型国家再小也满足不了被其倡导者拔高的文化完整性标准。
en: Micro-states can never be made small enough to satisfy their advocates’ exalted standards of cultural integrity.

zh: 所以拆散多民族国家是一条歧途。
en: So the unraveling of multi-national states is a false path.

zh: 真正的出路在于某种形式的联邦主义，这既能够为国家统一保持足够的中央权力，又尊重了地方和地区的文化。
en: The way forward lies in democratic forms of federalism, which can preserve sufficient central authority for the purposes of statehood, while respecting local and regional cultures.

zh: 当今的微型国家主义高涨不仅是反抗帝国的结果：它也是对全球化的反叛。
en: Today’s upsurge of micro-nationalism is not just a consequence of the revolt against empires: it is also a revolt against globalization.

zh: 有一种理念认为现代国家的首要职能就是将其各民族分配到以效率和廉价为第一要旨的全球市场，而不顾对非经济活动的破坏。 而这一理念现在遭到了广泛的抵触。
en: There is widespread resistance to the idea that the chief function of modern states is to slot their peoples into a global market dominated by the imperatives of efficiency and cheapness, heedless of the damage to non-economic activities.

zh: 当全球经济最终成为全球赌场时，这种情绪又被强化了。
en: This feeling is strengthened when the global economy turns out to be a global casino.

zh: 民族主张成为对抗非人性力量和远距离权威的一种方式。
en: National assertion is a way of combating impersonal forces and remote authorities.

zh: 全球化在福利增长方面的过度承诺（特别是对发展中国家）使其被摒弃。
en: Globalization promises too much in terms of welfare gains, particularly to developing countries, to be abandoned.

zh: 但从当下的危机中我们学到的教训是必须发展出一种全球经济治理的方式来管理、监管并遏制全球市场所释放出的创造性，但通常也是破坏性的力量。
en: But the lesson from the current crisis is that we will have to develop styles of global economic governance to manage, regulate, and mitigate the creative, but often disruptive forces unleashed by the global market.

zh: 在一个实际的世界性政府缺位的情况下，这只能通过国家间的合作实现。
en: In the absence of an actual world government, this can be done only through cooperation among states.

zh: “主权国家”越少，实现必要的合作就越容易。
en: The fewer “sovereigns” there are, the easier it will be to secure the necessary cooperation.

zh: 为二战后的世界经济打下制度基础的1944年《布雷顿森林协议》之所以能成功是因为美国和英国掌握了话语权。
en: The Bretton Woods Agreement of 1944, which laid the institutional foundation for the post-war World War II economy, was made possible because the United States and Britain called the shots.

zh: 当古巴的反对意见被提交到起草委员会，美国代表哈里·德克斯特·怀特却说，古巴的职能就是提供雪茄。
en: When objections were raised to Cuba being put on the drafting committee, Harry Dexter White, the American representative, remarked that Cuba’s function was to provide cigars.

zh: 现今已不可能再出现这种针对较弱小国家的傲慢态度。
en: Such a cavalier attitude to the demands of lesser powers to be heard is no longer possible.

zh: 但这一切都意味着表面的功夫将不得不更微妙，而背后的摩擦也更复杂。
en: But all this means is that the facades will have to be more subtle and the fictions more elaborate.

zh: 倘若我们不在真正权力归属的问题上自欺欺人，那么就让总统们和议会们多如牛毛吧，如果那样能让人们觉得舒服的话。
en: Provided we do not deceive ourselves about where real power lies, let presidents and parliaments be three a penny if that is what makes people feel good about themselves.

zh: 玩火
en: Fiddling at the Fire

zh: 巴黎—7月份以来，金融市场因为寄希望于全球经济和地缘政治前景不会再恶化 — — 即使真的恶化了，各大央行也早已做好了准备通过更多轮的流动性供应和量化宽松力挺经济和市场 — — 而出现了反弹。
en: PARIS – Financial markets have rallied since July on the hope that the global economic and geopolitical outlook will not worsen, or, if it does, that central banks stand ready to backstop economies and markets with additional rounds of liquidity provision and quantitative easing.

zh: 因此，不但关于经济的好（或好于预期的）消息提振着市场，就连坏消息也被视为好消息，因为这增加了美联储主席伯南克和欧洲央行行长德拉吉等央行救火队员用现金扑灭市场之火的可能性。
en: So, not only has good – or better-than-expected – economic news boosted the markets, but even bad news has been good news, because it increases the probability that central-banking firefighters like US Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke and European Central Bank President Mario Draghi will douse the markets with buckets of cash.

zh: 但不论利好利空都上扬的市场绝不是稳定的市场。
en: But markets that rise on both good and bad news are not stable markets.

zh: “去风险”模式 — — 即投资者情绪全面转坏 — — 很可能随着经济消息的恶化以及对决策者效率的信心的下降而卷土重来。
en: “Risk-off” episodes, in which investor sentiment sours, are likely to return if economic news worsens and confidence in policymakers’ effectiveness drops.

zh: 在欧元区，乐观情绪随着欧洲央行实行事实上无限制的购买受困国债券的支持决策而泛滥。
en: In the eurozone, euphoria followed the ECB’s decision to provide support with potentially unlimited purchases of distressed countries’ bonds.

zh: 但这一动作并不能扭转局势；而只能为决策者赢得一些时间来实施解决危机所必须实施的痛苦措施。
en: But the move is not a game changer; it only buys time for policymakers to implement the tough measures needed to resolve the crisis.

zh: 政策挑战令人沮丧：随着前瞻性财政整合和严格的信用配给制的继续实施，欧元区的衰退正在深化。
en: And the policy challenges are daunting: the eurozone’s recession is deepening as front-loaded fiscal consolidation and severe credit rationing continues.

zh: 而随着欧元区银行和公共部门债务日益呈现出两极分化，在建立银行联盟、财政联盟和经济联盟的同时追求重塑增长、外部平衡和竞争力的宏观经济政策会变得特别困难。
en: And, as eurozone banks and public-debt markets become increasingly balkanized, establishing a banking union, a fiscal union, and an economic union while pursuing macroeconomic policies that restore growth, external balance, and competitiveness will be extremely difficult.

zh: 甚至欧洲央行的支持也不是板上钉钉。
en: Even the ECB’s support is not obvious.

zh: 担心欧洲央行采取无限制动作的货币鹰派 — — 德国央行和其他核心国央行 — — 成功地给从债券购买计划中受益的国家施加了严格而有效的条件。
en: Monetary hawks – the Bundesbank and several other core central banks – who were worried about a new open-ended ECB mandate pushed successfully for strict and effective conditionality for countries benefiting from the bond purchases.

zh: 如果这些严苛的条件得不到满足，它们可以叫停购买计划。
en: As a result, they can pull the plug on the program if its stringent criteria are not met.

zh: 此外，希���可能在2013年退出欧元区，此后，西班牙和意大利也将被隔离；西班牙像希腊一样，也在逐渐步入萧条，需要“三驾马车 ” （ 欧洲央行、欧洲委员会和IMF）的全面援助。
en: Moreover, Greece could exit the eurozone in 2013, before Spain and Italy are successfully ring-fenced; Spain – like Greece – is spiraling into depression, and may need a full-scale bailout by the “troika” (the ECB, the European Commission, and the International Monetary Fund).

zh: 与此同时，欧元区外围国的紧缩疲劳与核心国的援助疲劳的对立正日渐严重。
en: Meanwhile, austerity fatigue in the eurozone periphery is increasingly clashing with bailout fatigue in the core.

zh: 因此，不必奇怪在政治上不可能赞成更多援助措施的德国会把这一职责踢给唯一能够绕过民选议会决策的机构 — — 欧洲央行。
en: Small wonder, then, that Germany, politically unable to vote on more bailout resources, has outsourced that job to the ECB, the only institution that can bypass democratically elected parliaments.

zh: 但是，流动性供应 — — 如果不尽快辅之以重塑增长的政策的话 — — 仍然只能推迟而不能阻止货币联盟的解体，最终导致经济/贸易联盟的崩溃和单一市场的毁灭。
en: But, again, liquidity provision alone – without policies to restore growth soon – would merely delay, not prevent, the breakup of the monetary union, ultimately taking down the economic/trade union and leading to the destruction of the single market.

zh: 在美国，最新经济数据 — — 包括疲软的劳动力市场数据 — — 确认了增长不振的现状，2012年下半年产出不可能大大超过1—6月份的1.6%的年增长率。
en: In the United States, the latest economic data – including a weak labor market – confirm that growth is anemic, with output in the second half of 2012 unlikely to be significantly stronger than the 1.6% annual gain recorded in January-June.

zh: 此外，由于美国政坛的两极分化和政策僵局，不难预期，在预算和债务上限问题上还会有更多争论，信用评级降级还会再次发生，关于中期财政整合和可持续性问题的协议也将难以达成，不管奥巴马是否能在11月连任总统。
en: And, given America’s political polarization and policy gridlock, we can expect more fights on the budget and the debt ceiling, another rating downgrade, and no agreement on a path toward medium-term fiscal consolidation and sustainability – regardless of whether President Barack Obama is reelected in November.

zh: 相反，协议只可能在政治阻力最小的方向上达成：在债券卫士最终觉醒、长期利率大幅上升、政治制度不得不进行财政调整之前避免痛苦的财政选择。
en: On the contrary, we should expect agreement only on the path of least political resistance: avoidance of tough fiscal choices until the bond vigilantes eventually wake up, spike long rates, and force fiscal adjustment on the political system.

zh: 在中国，随着投资泡沫的消灭和净出口的下降，硬着陆的可能性正在与日俱增。
en: In China, a hard economic landing looks increasingly likely as the investment bubble deflates and net exports shrink.

zh: 与此同时，降低储蓄、增加私人消费所必需的改革被推迟了。
en: Meanwhile, the reforms necessary to reduce savings and increase private consumption are being delayed.

zh: 与欧洲和美国一样，中国只能通过更多的货币、财政和信用刺激避免问题在2012年爆发。
en: As in Europe and the US, the worst will be avoided in 2012 only by kicking the can down the road with more monetary, fiscal, and credit stimulus.

zh: 但2013年，由于刺激措施停止、不良贷款增加、投资泡沫破裂加速以及省政府及其地方融资平台债务展期问题无法再掩盖，发生硬着陆的可能性会更大。
en: But a hard landing becomes more likely in 2013, as the stimulus fades, non-performing loans rise, the investment bust accelerates, and the problem of rolling over the debts of provincial governments and their special investment vehicles can no longer be papered over.

zh: 此外，新领导层掌权阶段将会谨慎为上，因此改革进度将极为缓慢，导致社会和政治动荡可能性大增。
en: And, given a new leadership’s caution as it establishes its power, reforms will occur at a snail’s pace, making social and political unrest more likely.

zh: 与此同时，巴西、印度、俄罗斯和其他新兴国家情况也差不多。
en: Meanwhile, Brazil, India, Russia, and other emerging economies are playing the same game.

zh: 许多新兴国家并没有随发达国家疲软挤压了出口拉动型增长空间而采取调整措施；许多新兴国家推迟了提振私人部门发展和生产率提高所必须的结构性改革，而采取了很快就会到达极限的国家资本主义模式。
en: Many have not adjusted as advanced economies’ weakness reduces the room for export-led growth; and many delayed structural reforms needed to boost private-sector development and productivity growth, while embracing a model of state capitalism that will soon reveal its limits.

zh: 因此，最近新兴市场的减速并不完全是周期性的，不完全是因为发达国家增长疲软或发生全面衰退所致；其中也有结构性因素。
en: So the recent slowdown of growth in emerging markets is not just cyclical, owing to weak growth or outright recession in advanced economies; it is also structural.

zh: 类似的摇摆在地缘政治中也是显而易见。
en: Similar dithering is apparent at the geopolitical level as well.

zh: 主要全球性大国仍在就促使伊朗放弃开发和武器的谈判和制裁做着努力。
en: The major global powers are still trying negotiations and sanctions to induce Iran to abandon its efforts to develop nuclear weapons.

zh: 但伊朗却在争分夺秒争取进入豁免区。
en: But Iran is playing for time and hoping to reach a zone of immunity.

zh: 2013年，以色列（不管对错）都将把伊朗核计划视为外部威胁，而拒绝包容伊朗核计划的美国可能会发动袭击，导致战争和油价暴涨。
en: By 2013, an Israel that – rightly or wrongly – perceives Iran’s nuclear program to be an existential threat, and/or the US, which has rejected containment of a nuclear Iran, may decide to strike, leading to a war and a massive spike in oil prices.

zh: 低效的政府和孱弱的领导力是问题的根源。
en: Ineffective governments with weak leadership are at the root of the problem.

zh: 在民主国家，定期选举导致了政策的短视。
en: In democracies, repeated elections lead to short-term policy choices.

zh: 中国和俄罗斯等专制国家，领导人拒绝采取削弱根深蒂固的游说集团和既得利益集团权力的改革，从而导致因反腐败和寻租情绪激发的社会不安转变为示威。
en: In autocracies like China and Russia, leaders resist the radical reforms that would reduce the power of entrenched lobbies and interests, thereby fueling social unrest as resentment against corruption and rent-seeking boils over into protest.

zh: 但是，由于每个人都想把负担一扔了之，结果负担越变越重，不管是新兴市场还是发达国家，都已经快走到了南墙。
en: But, as everyone kicks the can down the road, the can is getting heavier and, in the major emerging markets and advanced economies alike, is approaching a brick wall.

zh: 决策者可以选择撞向南墙，也可以选择用领导力和远见卓识安全巧妙地拆掉南墙。
en: Policymakers can either crash into that wall, or they can show the leadership and vision needed to dismantle it safely.

zh: FIFA综合征
en: The FIFA Syndrome

zh: 伦敦—以多起欺诈和腐败指控拘捕FIFA（国际足联）高官成为近几天来媒体关注的焦点。
en: LONDON – The arrest of FIFA executives on a raft of fraud and corruption charges has been front-page news in recent days.

zh: 但瑞士和美国当局提起的指控集中在贿赂和侵吞公款上，并没有解决另一种臭名昭著的不公：在卡塔尔为2022年FIFA世界杯建设足球场的移民工人的待遇。
en: But the charges brought by the Swiss and American authorities focus on bribery and embezzlement, and do not address another egregious injustice: the treatment of the migrant workers in Qatar who are building the stadiums for the 2022 FIFA Football World Cup.

zh: 大赦国际（Amnesty International）最近公布了一份关于卡塔尔糟糕情况的报告。
en: Amnesty International recently released a report on the abysmal conditions in Qatar.

zh: 工人在不安全的工地工作，遭受招工头盘剥，无从寻求形式正义。
en: The workers are subject to unsafe construction sites, exploitative recruitment agencies, and little recourse to formal justice.

zh: 最近，尼泊尔劳工部长公开批评卡塔尔不许尼泊尔民工回国为2015年4月地震死难亲属奔丧。
en: Recently, Nepal’s labor minister publicly spoke out about the government of Qatar not allowing his country’s migrant workers to return home to mourn relatives who died in the April 2015 earthquake.

zh: 大赦国际指出，责任主要在卡塔尔当局。
en: As Amnesty International notes, the responsibility lies primarily with the Qatari authorities.

zh: 但FIFA也有行动责任 — — 过去有，现在也有。
en: But FIFA had – and still has – a responsibility to act.

zh: 已经有人要求赞助商，包括麦当劳、维萨、可口可乐、阿迪达斯、百威、俄天然气、起亚和现代，向FIFA和卡塔尔施压，要求它们改善工作条件。
en: There have also been calls for sponsors, including McDonalds, Visa, Coca-Cola, Adidas, Budweiser, Gazprom, KIA, and Hyundai, to place pressure on FIFA and Qatar to improve working conditions.

zh: 这些问题近几年来也出现在其他部门。
en: Such issues have arisen in recent years in other sectors as well.

zh: 4月，人权观察组织（Human Rights Watch）发布了一份关于孟加拉国纺织工人待遇的报告。
en: In April, Human Rights Watch issued a report on the treatment of garment workers in Bangladesh.

zh: 该报告因2013年拉纳广场（Rana Plaza）倒塌事件而启动。 倒塌事件造成1,100多人死亡，2,000多人受伤，凸显出孟加拉国工作条件恶劣、建筑检查工作不严、缺乏劳动法、需要更公平的工资和法律福利等问题。
en: The report, prompted by the 2013 Rana Plaza collapse, in which more than 1,100 people died and over 2,000 were injured, highlighted poor working conditions, inadequate building inspections, weak labor laws, and the need for fairer wage practices and legal benefits.

zh: 还有其他许多例子。
en: Beyond these examples, there have been many others.

zh: 在科技行业，苹果和富士康面临关于中国工厂工作环境的批评。
en: In technology, Apple and Foxconn have faced criticism for working conditions at their Chinese production sites.

zh: 甚至教育机构，如纽约大学阿布扎比新校区，也爆出了在工作场所压迫和虐待的丑闻。
en: Even educational institutions, such as New York University’s new campus in Abu Dhabi, have been tainted by episodes of workplace exploitation and abuse.

zh: 这些都不是孤例。
en: These are not isolated cases.

zh: 每一起媒体所关注的灾难和大案的背后都有许多我们不曾听说的案例。
en: For every disaster and high-profile case that hits the headlines, there are many more that we never hear about.

zh: 尽管如此，我们希望生产商品、提供服务、建造让我们幸福和富于生产力的东西的人 — — 不管他们生产的是服装、技术还是体育场和大学校园 — — 都能继续受到关注。
en: Nonetheless, one hopes that the treatment of those who make the goods, produce the services, and build the things that make us happy and productive – from clothing and technology to sports stadiums and college campuses – continues to come under scrutiny.

zh: 全球化应该迫使管理者 — — 以及我们所有人 — — 认真反思全世界的劳动行为。
en: Globalization should force managers – and all of us – to do some serious thinking about labor practices around the world.

zh: 症结就在这里。
en: Here is where it gets complicated.

zh: 什么构成了公司的劳动力（workforce ） ？
en: What counts as a company’s workforce?

zh: “它的”工人只是那些在公司花名册上注册的人吗？
en: Are “its” workers only those people on its own payroll?

zh: 公司是否需要为其产品的整个供应链负责？
en: Are companies responsible for their products’ entire supply chains?

zh: 在何种程度上可以 — — 也应该 — — 要求公司为好几环之外的公司的选择负责？
en: To what extent can – and should – a company be held to account for the choices of those who may be several links removed?

zh: 当一个严重的问题引起了某公司的关注，其管理人是否有责任解决它，哪怕其中包含着层层转包的关系？
en: When a serious issue has been brought to a company’s attention, are its managers obliged to address it, even if it involves the subcontractor of a subcontractor?

zh: 公司规模越大越复杂，跟踪所有与它有直接和间接业务往来的企业的难度也越大。
en: The larger and more complex the company, the harder it is to track all of the firms with which it does business, the firms that they then subcontract to, and so on.

zh: 毫不奇怪，公司声称它们的责任到此为止。
en: Companies, not surprisingly, say that their responsibility extends only so far.

zh: 但这并不是答案；这是一个选择。
en: But that is not an answer; it is a choice.

zh: 组织可以决定它的触及面范围。
en: Organizations can decide to extend their reach.

zh: 它们甚至可以决定要了解产品的所有材料和部件的全部来源，决定要问责扩大的一整条供应链。
en: They can even decide that they want to know the full provenance of all materials and components in their products, and that they will hold their extended suppliers to account.

zh: 从这个角度，公司规模越大，责任也越大。
en: In this sense, the larger the company, the greater its responsibility.

zh: 但越大的公司，成为正义力量（不管是在本地还是在全球）的能力也越强。
en: But larger companies also have a larger ability to become a force for good, both locally and globally.

zh: 大如美国零售商沃尔玛，如果它决定拒绝浪费性包装（wasteful packaging ） ， 其购买力足以导致整个零售业的包装变革。
en: If a company the size of US retailer Walmart decides that it will not allow wasteful packaging, its purchasing power will lead to changes in packaging for the entire retail sector.

zh: 工资和劳动行为也是如此。
en: The same is true of wages and labor practices.

zh: 当全世界最大的公司和最驰名的商标认真对待它们作为买家、卖家和制造商的责任，坚定致力于维护核心价值，那么其他公司也会跟进 — — 否则就会被淘汰。
en: When the world’s biggest companies and most well recognized brands take seriously their responsibility as buyers, sellers, and manufacturers and make a firm commitment to act on core values, others tend to follow – or risk being left behind.

zh: 那些以高道德标准精英、寻求改善所有与产品制造、营销和分销相关的人的生活的公司将会赢得信誉和更多的生意，而就算只是不再名列坏公司名单，也会让它们受益良多。
en: Those that operate in an ethical manner and seek to improve the lives of all who are associated with the manufacture, marketing, and distribution of their products will benefit from kudos, more business, or simply not being singled out as a bad actor.

zh: 相反，如果公司管理者认为竞争性市场不是一个讲道德的场所，那么消费者可以和其他公司打交道；政府监管和罚款会强迫它们采取行动；它们也将无法吸引受过教育、辨别力日益增强的劳动力，因此而蒙受损失。
en: By contrast, companies whose managers believe that a competitive marketplace is no place for ethical behavior will suffer if and when consumers take their business elsewhere; government regulation and fines force them to act; or they become unable to attract an educated and ever-more discerning workforce.

zh: 所有这些 — — 不断的监督、负面报道、名誉扫地 — — 将影响它们的长期股价。
en: All of it – the constant scrutiny, the bad press, the tarnished reputation – will hit their long-term stock prices.

zh: FIFA等组织也是如此。
en: Much the same is true for organizations like FIFA.

zh: 当可口可乐和阿迪达斯等赞助商认为它们的名誉因为与从事腐败的组织有染而受到影响，它们将把品牌管理预算投向别处。
en: When sponsors like Coca-Cola or Adidas believe that their reputations will be tarnished by association with an organization engaged in corrupt practices, they will take their brand-management dollars elsewhere.

zh: 公司是为人民而成立的。
en: Companies are made up of people.

zh: 支付公平的工资、采取合乎道德的采购、捍卫工人尊严应该成为公司衡量成功的一部分。
en: Paying fair wages, adopting ethical sourcing practices, and upholding the dignity of workers should be a part of the way they calculate their success.

zh: 漠不关心他人的命运、毫无道德观或是非观、践踏普通人体面尊严的组织将无立足之地，这样的公司将无从建设品牌。
en: Those who disconnect themselves from the fate of others, who act without conscience or a sense of right and wrong, and who spurn ordinary human decency have no place running organizations or sitting on company boards.

zh: 让我们幸福的东西决不能只有付出难以负担的高价才能获得。
en: The things that make us happy must not come at an unforgivably high price.

zh: 足球黑手党
en: The Soccer Mafia

zh: 纽约—5月27日清晨，七名国际足联官员在瑞士一家饭店被捕，此事的唯一令人震惊之处是它居然发生了。
en: NEW YORK – The only surprise about the arrest of seven FIFA officials in a Swiss hotel in the early morning of May 27 is that it happened at all.

zh: 大部分人认为这些管理着世界足球联盟的养尊处优、金履华服之士享受着“刑不上大夫”的待遇。
en: Most people assumed that these pampered men in expensive suits, governing the world’s soccer federation, were beyond the reach of the law.

zh: 不论关于贿赂、回扣、选举操纵和其他不法行为的流言和报道如何日嚣尘上，国际足联主席“赛普”约瑟夫·布拉特（Joseph “Sepp” Blatter）及其同僚和相关人士总是可以逍遥法外。
en: Whatever rumors flew or reports were made on bribes, kickbacks, vote-rigging, and other dodgy practices, FIFA President Joseph “Sepp” Blatter and his colleagues and associates always seemed to emerge without a scratch.

zh: 目前，包括九名现任或前任国际足联高官在内的14人（但不包括布拉特）在美国被控从事一系列欺诈和腐败行为，检方指控他们收受1.5亿美元贿赂和回扣。
en: So far, 14 men, including nine current or former FIFA executives (but not Blatter), have been charged with a range of fraud and corruption offenses in the United States, where prosecutors accuse them, among other things, of pocketing $150 million in bribes and kickbacks.

zh: 瑞士联邦检察官正在调查2018年和2022年世界杯主办权（分别授予了俄罗斯和卡塔尔）决定的幕后交易。
en: And Swiss federal prosecutors are looking into shady deals behind the decisions to award the World Cup competitions in 2018 and 2022 to Russia and Qatar, respectively.

zh: 当然，职业体育的勒索传统已是老生常谈了。
en: There is, of course, a long tradition of racketeering in professional sports.

zh: 比如，美国黑帮涉入拳击运动很深。
en: American mobsters have had a major interest in boxing, for example.

zh: 甚至曾经的绅士运动板球也被赌博网络和其他不法商人染指。
en: Even the once gentlemanly game of cricket has been tainted by the infiltration of gambling networks and other crooked dealers.

zh: 国际足联只不过是其中最富有、最强大、最全球化的奶牛罢了。
en: FIFA is just the richest, most powerful, most global milk cow of all.

zh: 有人将国际足联和黑手党相提并论，而出生于一个瑞士小村庄的布拉特被称为“唐布拉特龙 ” （ Don Blatterone ） 。
en: Some have likened FIFA to the Mafia, and Blatter, born in a small Swiss village, has been called “Don Blatterone.”

zh: 这并不完全公平。
en: This is not entirely fair.

zh: 就目前我们所知而言，苏黎世国际足联总部还从未找过职业杀手。
en: So far as we know, no murder contracts have ever been issued from FIFA’s head office in Zürich.

zh: 但该组织的秘密性、其对于反对其管理者的人的恐吓，以及其对惠赠、贿赂和债务的依赖确实与有组织犯罪没什么区别。
en: But the organization’s secrecy, its intimidation of the rivals to those who run it, and its reliance on favors, bribes, and called debts do show disturbing parallels to the world of organized crime.

zh: 当然，你也可以选择将国际足联视为一个功能失调的组织而非犯罪帝国。
en: One could, of course, choose to see FIFA as a dysfunctional organization, rather than a criminal enterprise.

zh: 但即使在这个比较善意的情形中，许多渎职行为也直接源自国际足联缺少透明度。
en: But even in this more charitable scenario, much of the malfeasance is a direct result of the federation’s total lack of transparency.

zh: 其全部运作都由一个紧密的男人帮（女性在其隐晦难辨的行为中不起任何作用）进行，所有人都对老板效忠。
en: The entire operation is run by a close-knit group of men (women play no part in this murky business), all of whom are beholden to the boss.

zh: 布拉特不是始作俑者。
en: This did not start under Blatter.

zh: 他的前任、阴险的阿维兰热才是。 阿维兰热把越来越多的发展中国家拉入国际足联，用各种丰厚的营销和媒体协议收买选票，将国际足联变成了腐败的财富帝国。
en: It was his predecessor, the sinister Brazilian João Havelange, who turned FIFA into a corrupt and vastly rich empire by incorporating more and more developing countries, whose votes for the bosses were bought with all manner of lucrative marketing and media deals.

zh: 来自可口可乐和阿迪达斯的巨额企业资金涌入这个系统，流入第三世界当权者以及（据说）阿维兰热本人贪得无厌的腰包中。
en: Huge amounts of corporate money from Coca-Cola and Adidas went sloshing through the system, all the way to the roomy pockets of Third World potentates and, allegedly, of Havelange himself.

zh: 可口可乐是1978年阿根廷世界杯主赞助商，当时的阿根廷由残酷的军人集团统治。
en: Coke was the main sponsor of the 1978 World Cup in Argentina, ruled in those days by a brutal military junta.

zh: 布拉特不像阿维兰热那样粗鄙。
en: Blatter is not quite as uncouth as Havelange.

zh: 和巴西人（阿维兰热）不同，他不会公开与黑帮扯上关系。
en: Unlike the Brazilian, he does not openly associate with mobsters.

zh: 但他的权力也依赖西欧之外的国家，而这些国家的忠诚需要电视转播权和商业特许经营权来保障。
en: But his power, too, relies on the votes of countries outside Western Europe, and their loyalty, too, is secured by the promise of TV rights and commercial franchises.

zh: 在卡塔尔的例子中，这意味着在极不适合的气候条件下举办世界杯的权利，工资低廉、毫无权利可言的外国工人在可怕的工作条件下急速建设着足球场。
en: In the case of Qatar, this meant the right to stage the World Cup in an utterly unsuitable climate, in stadiums hastily built under terrible conditions by underpaid foreign workers with few rights.

zh: 欧洲人提出稍显严苛的抱怨就会招致新殖民主义乃至种族主义的指责。
en: Complaints from slightly more fastidious Europeans are often met with accusations of neo-colonialist attitudes or even racism.

zh: 事实上，正是这一点让布拉特成为现时代的典型人物。
en: Indeed, this is what makes Blatter a typical man of our times.

zh: 他是一个无情的“作手 ” （ operator ） ， 把自己打造成发展中世界的旗手，保护非洲、亚洲、阿拉伯和南利益免受傲慢的西方的侵蚀。
en: He is a ruthless operator who presents himself as the champion of the developing world, protecting the interests of Africans, Asians, Arabs, and South Americans against the arrogant West.

zh: 来自穷国的贪婪之辈收钱推动西方政治或商业利益以来，这一情况已经开始改变。
en: Things have changed since the days when venal men from poor countries were paid off to further Western political or commercial interests.

zh: 当然，这一幕至今仍在发生。
en: This still occurs, of course.

zh: 但如今，真正的“大钱”更多地来自西方以外，来自中国、波斯湾乃至俄罗斯。
en: But the really big money now, more often than not, is made outside the West, in China, the Persian Gulf, and even Russia.

zh: 西方商人、建筑师、艺术家、大学校长和博物馆馆长 — — 或任何需要大量资金推进昂贵项目的人 — — 现在都需要和非西方独裁者打交道。
en: Western businessmen, architects, artists, university presidents, and museum directors – or anyone who needs large amounts of cash to fund their expensive projects – now have to deal with non-Western autocrats.

zh: 当然，民主选举的政客亦然。
en: So do democratically elected politicians, of course.

zh: 而一些人 — — 比如托尼·布莱尔（Tony Blair ） — —已经将它作为退出政府后的职业。
en: And some – think of Tony Blair – turn it into a post-government career.

zh: 为极权政权和密不透风的商业利益当掮客并不是高枕无忧的生意。
en: Pandering to authoritarian regimes and opaque business interests is not a wholesome enterprise.

zh: 西方利益 — — 艺术和高等教育在这方面不亚于体育 — — 与富有的非民主力量的当代同盟中不乏可以轻易摧毁卓著信誉的妥协。
en: The contemporary alliance of Western interests – in the arts and higher education no less than in sports – with rich, undemocratic powers involves compromises that might easily damage established reputations.

zh: 一种转移视线的办法是借用左翼的旧反帝国���义论调。
en: One way to deflect the attention is to borrow the old anti-imperialist rhetoric of the left.

zh: 与独裁者和幕后大佬做交易不再是唯利是图的，而是高尚的。
en: Dealing with despots and shady tycoons is no longer venal, but noble.

zh: 将大学或博物馆的特许经营权卖给海湾国家、在中国建造有一座巨型体育场，或从流向俄罗斯或卡塔尔的足球资金中中饱私囊是进步的、反种族主义的，因此是四海一家和普世价值的胜利。
en: Selling the franchise of a university or a museum to a Gulf state, building yet another enormous stadium in China, or making a fortune out of soccer favors to Russia or Qatar is progressive, anti-racist, and a triumph of global fraternity and universal values.

zh: 这是布拉特的国际足联最令人愤慨之处。
en: This is the most irritating aspect of Blatter’s FIFA.

zh: 腐败、收买选票、足球高官对国际特权的荒谬的渴望、昂首挺胸接受奖牌和花环 — — 所有这些都是意料中事。
en: The corruption, the vote-buying, the absurd thirst of soccer bosses for international prestige, the puffed-out chests festooned with medals and decorations – all of that is par for the course.

zh: 让人愤慨的是伪善。
en: It is the hypocrisy that rankles.

zh: 哀叹全球实力和影响力不再属于欧洲核心地带和美国无济于事。
en: To lament the shift in global power and influence away from the heartlands of Europe and the US is useless.

zh: 我们也无法准确预言这一转变的政治后果。
en: And we cannot accurately predict this shift’s political consequences.

zh: 但如果国际足联的丑闻有象征意义的话，我们可以肯定，不管政府以何种形式出现，钱仍是万能的。
en: But if the sorry story of FIFA is any indication, we can be sure that, whatever forms government might take, money still rules.

zh: 回到打击疾病的基本面
en: Back to Disease-Fighting Basics

zh: 伦敦—打击抗药性需要突破性技术解决方案。
en: LONDON – Combating antimicrobial resistance will require groundbreaking technological solutions.

zh: 为了防止超级病菌在2050年夺走预计一千万人的生命，我们需要发明新型抗生素，开发快速诊断测试以避免不必要的治疗和减少抗生素的大规模滥用。
en: To prevent superbugs from claiming an estimated ten million lives a year by 2050, we will need to invent new types of antimicrobial drugs and develop rapid diagnostic tests to avoid unnecessary treatment and cut our massive overuse of antibiotics.

zh: 但是，这些高科技的贡献固然重要，但它们只是解决办法的一部分。
en: And yet, as important as these high-tech contributions may be, they are only partial fixes.

zh: 要永久解决这个问题，唯一的选择是在源头上组织传染的发生 — — 这需要改善卫生、卫生设施和疾病监控。
en: To tackle the problem permanently, the only option is to prevent infections from occurring in the first place – with improved hygiene, sanitation, and disease surveillance.

zh: 事实上，只有专注于这些方面，我们才可以降低长期新药需求。
en: Indeed, only by focusing on these areas will we lower the demand for new drugs over the long term.

zh: 事实上，在十九世纪，现代药物还远远没有出现的时候，西方大城市就开始通过阻止传染对付疾病。
en: Indeed, in the nineteenth century, long before modern drugs were available, major Western cities tackled diseases by seeking to prevent infections.

zh: 而对于人口不断增加的大城市，这一方法仍然是最佳方案。
en: And this approach remains the best solution for large cities with growing populations.

zh: 以19世纪50年代的伦敦为例：穷人的生活条件非常凄惨。
en: Consider London in the 1850s: Living conditions for the poor were grim.

zh: 男性寿命预期为40岁。
en: Male life expectancy was 40 years.

zh: 霍乱和结核病横行，也没有治疗之方。
en: Diseases like cholera and tuberculosis were rife, and there was no way to treat them.

zh: 1854年9月，一场霍乱席卷伦敦贫民区中央苏豪（Soho）区，仅仅十天就导致500人丧命。
en: In September 1854, a cholera outbreak devastated the city’s impoverished, central Soho district, killing 500 people in just ten days.

zh: 这时，约翰·斯诺（John Snow）挺身而出。 他是一位有开创精神的医生，直觉地认为霍乱不是如同传统智慧认为的那样通过空气传播，而是通过水传播。
en: Enter John Snow, a pioneering physician who had intuited that cholera was spread not through the air, as conventional wisdom held, but through water.

zh: 斯诺以前所未有的详细程度监控苏豪区疫情的进展，画出每一例病例的地图。
en: Snow monitored the progress of the Soho outbreak in unprecedented detail, mapping each case.

zh: 他的研究让他确信，霍乱爆发的根源是该区中央地带一口公用水井。
en: His research convinced him that the source of the outbreak was a shared water pump in the heart of the district.

zh: 把水井泵的手柄换掉后，霍乱爆发速度大幅降低。
en: And once the pump’s handle was removed, the pace of the outbreak slowed dramatically.

zh: 斯诺的一些方法可以直接应用在抗生素耐药性这一现代问题上。
en: Several of Snow’s methods are directly applicable to the modern problem of antimicrobial resistance.

zh: 首先，他的努力表明，使用数据来理解公共卫生危机是有效的。
en: For starters, his effort demonstrated the efficacy of using data to understand a public health crisis.

zh: 他的疾病地图和统计分析有助于确认疾病爆发的中心点，进而确认爆发根源。
en: His mapping and statistical analysis helped identify the epicenter of the outbreak and thus its root cause.

zh: 斯诺所强调的使用数据指导干预也是比尔和梅琳达·盖茨基金会等机构今天所坚持的原则。
en: Snow’s emphasis on using data to guide his intervention is a principle that institutions like the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation insist upon today.

zh: 最近西非的埃博拉疫情通过一场悲剧证明了好数据的重要性。
en: The recent Ebola outbreak in West Africa demonstrated, in tragic fashion, the importance of good data.

zh: 这场传染病在基本基础设施和监测系统破败的地区蔓延最甚。
en: The epidemic spread most dramatically in areas where basic infrastructure and surveillance systems had broken down.

zh: 因此，即使在埃博拉被宣布为公共卫生紧急情况、资金也到位后，仍然花了好几周时间才将资源引入最需要的地区。
en: As a result, even after Ebola had been declared a public health emergency and funding had been made available, it remained difficult for many weeks to direct resources where they were most needed.

zh: 令人担忧的是，我的抗生素耐药性评估（Review on Antimicrobial Resistance）的最新文章警告，缺少全球协作的监控的系统检测超级病菌在全球范围的出现和传播。
en: Worryingly, as the latest paper from my Review on Antimicrobial Resistance warns, there is no globally coordinated system of surveillance to monitor the emergence and spread of superbugs around the world.

zh: 基本缺口仍在于如何收集和共享数据，即使在世界最富裕的国家也难以实现。
en: Fundamental gaps remain in how data are gathered and shared, even in the world’s richest countries.

zh: 结果形成了一系列巨大的盲点，让我们无法做出有效响应所需要的关键性洞察和早期警告。
en: The result is a series of enormous blind spots that deprive us of the key insights and early warnings that we need to mount an effective response.

zh: 斯诺德另一大贡献是认识到水在传播霍乱等疾病上的关键作用，让欧洲当局投资于污水和环境卫生系统的开发。
en: Snow’s other major contribution was to identify the central role that water plays in spreading diseases like cholera, leading authorities in Europe to invest in the development of sewage and sanitation systems.

zh: 在青霉素等药物被发现前几十年，战胜传染病、保护日益增长的城市人口别无他法，只能投资于预防工作。
en: Decades before the discovery of cures like penicillin, there was no alternative but to invest in prevention to beat infectious diseases and protect growing urban populations.

zh: 这一基础设施建设取得了巨大的成功：西欧最后一次城市霍乱爆发发生在1892年，到一战开始，传染病已不再是欧洲大部最主要的死亡原因。
en: This infrastructure-building was spectacularly successful: The last urban cholera outbreak in Western Europe occurred in 1892, and by the time World War I broke out, communicable diseases had ceased to be the leading cause of death across much of the continent.

zh: 但是，随着抗生素药物的普及，重点不再是预防措施。
en: As antimicrobial drugs became more widely available, however, the focus moved away from preventive measures.

zh: 这不但造成了迫使城市居民被迫生活在不卫生条件下的不良影响；也导致了抗药性的增强。
en: This has not only had dire implications for urban dwellers forced to live in unsanitary conditions; it has also contributed to rising drug resistance.

zh: 如今，安全水源和卫生设施不足是痢疾的主要发病原因，而痢疾每年要夺走大量生命，也是数亿人使用抗生素治疗的原因。
en: Today, inadequate access to safe water and sanitation is one of the leading causes of diarrheal illness – a major killer and the reason that hundreds of millions of people take antibiotic treatments each year.

zh: 但是，这些抗生素消费大部分是不必要的，因为痢疾的原因常常显而易见；对这种病使用抗生素只能促进抗药细菌的发展。
en: Most of this consumption is unnecessary, however, as the cause of diarrhea is usually viral; taking antibiotics in these cases only contributes to the development of resistant bacteria.

zh: 我的团队所获得的估计表明，仅仅在印度、尼日利亚、巴西和印度尼西亚，每年就有近五亿例痢疾用抗生素治疗。
en: Estimates provided to my team suggest that in India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Indonesia alone, nearly a half-billion cases of diarrhea are treated each year with antibiotics.

zh: 如果这四个国家能为全体公民提供清洁水和卫生设施，抗生素的消费量至少可以下降60 % 。
en: Were these four countries to provide their citizens with universal access to clean water and sanitation, this consumption could be reduced by at least 60%.

zh: 这些基础设施成本高昂，所有国家都面临艰难的预算选择。
en: Such infrastructure is costly, and all countries face tough budgetary choices.

zh: 但这是中等收入国家能够做出的最划算的投资之一。
en: But it is one of the best value-for-money investments a middle-income country can make.

zh: 如果控制收入变量，让卫生设施在人口中的普及率提高50%可以带来寿命预期增加九年。
