en: When one controls for income, increasing a population’s access to sanitation by 50% is correlated with more than nine years of additional life expectancy.

zh: 约翰·斯诺对此一定很欣慰。
en: John Snow would have been pleased.

zh: 他在卫生领域的最大贡献之一 — — 审慎地使用数据 — — 正在印证另一大贡献的重要性：投资于卫生和卫生设施。
en: One of his most significant contributions to the field of health care – the judicious use of data – is confirming the importance of another: investment in hygiene and sanitation.

zh: 有时候，以史为镜可以复制成功。
en: Sometimes those who study history are blessed to repeat it.

zh: 与生物剽窃作斗争
en: Fighting Biopiracy

zh: 渥太华 — — 1999年4月，美国公民兼种子公司所有人Larry Proctor从美国专利商标局（USPTO）获得一项专利，掌握对一种墨西哥黄豆的所有权。
en: OTTAWA– In April 1999 Larry Proctor, a United States citizen and owner of a seed company, won a patent at the US Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), claiming a Mexican yellow bean.

zh: 那项专利授予Proctor对一种名叫“Enola”的黄豆品种的独家所有权。
en: The patent conferred Proctor exclusive rights over a bean variety he called “Enola.”

zh: 这项决定是知识产权体系建立以来最令人气愤的生物剽窃事件。
en: That decision is one of the most outrageous examples of biopiracy in the history of intellectual property systems.

zh: Protor被授予专利的黄豆是一种源于墨西哥的作物种类，几百年来一直是人类的共有财产。
en: The bean for which Proctor was granted a patent is a farmers’ variety, originally from Mexico and in the public domain for centuries.

zh: 生活在墨西哥的墨西哥人和美国的美籍墨西哥人普遍食用这种名叫Mayocoba、Canario或Peruano的黄豆。
en: The bean is consumed throughout Mexico and by Mexicans and Mexican-Americans in the US who know it by the names Mayocoba, Canario, or Peruano.

zh: 虽然这种豆可以在公开种子展上买到，但在农民和民间团体的大规模抗议和国际机构的干涉下，却耗费了整整十年时间、数十万美元、历经连续五次司法判决才最终于2009年7月由美国专利商标局废除这项专利权。
en: Although the bean variety existed in publicly available seed collections, it took ten years, hundreds of thousands of dollars, massive protest by farmers and civil society, the intervention of international agencies, and five consecutive legal decisions before the USPTO finally annulled the patent in July 2009.

zh: 但彼时Proctor已经在专利寿命过半的时间内对这种黄豆的生产、销售和营销推广行使完全的垄断权。
en: By then, Proctor had exercised a complete monopoly over the production, distribution, and marketing of the bean for more than half of the patent’s lifespan.

zh: 1994年Proctor在墨西哥购买一袋“Enola”黄豆，这个故事便从此发端。
en: The story began in 1994, when Proctor purchased a bag of beans in Mexico.

zh: 他种植这种豆，从同一种植物上选种，而后再次种植，并重复这一过程两次以上。
en: He planted the beans, selected seeds from the same plants, and planted them again, repeating the procedure two more times.

zh: 在仅仅两年后的1996年末，他声称已经发明“独特”的品种，并为此申请专利。
en: In late 1996, after barely two years, he stated that he had invented a “unique” variety, and applied for a patent.

zh: 专利获批后，Proctor起诉两家黄豆进口商，要求他们支付专利使用费。
en: As soon as Proctor was awarded the patent, he sued two importers of the yellow beans, demanding that they pay royalties.

zh: 虽然进口商知道Proctor这项发明荒唐可笑（因为他们多年来一直从墨西哥进口黄豆 ） ， 但他们别无选择，只能承认专利的合法性，从而导致22，000名墨西哥农民和他们的家人仅第一年就损失90%的出口收入。
en: Although the importers knew that Proctor’s invention was ludicrous (because they had been importing the bean from Mexico for years), they had no choice but to accept the patent’s legality, causing 22,000 Mexican farmers and their families to lose 90% of their export incomes in just the first year.

zh: 2000年1月，侵蚀、技术和集聚行动小组（简称ETC小组，当时称为RAFI）首次发布公告，谴责Enola专利不仅在技术上无效而且在道德上不能接受。
en: In January 2000, the Action Group on Erosion, Technology and Concentration (ETC Group, then known as RAFI) published the first denunciation of the Enola patent as technically invalid and morally unacceptable.

zh: 为获取专利，申请人必须证明某一项发明符合新面世、非显见（其中涉及发明步骤）和具备实用价值（即发明能起到所称的作用）等项条件。
en: To obtain a patent, an applicant must demonstrate that an invention meets three criteria: newness, non-obviousness (that there is an inventive step), and utility (the invention does what it claims to do).

zh: 具体到Enola黄豆这一案例，根本不存在任何新发明：这种黄豆是墨西哥农民和土著数百年集体努力和创造的结果。
en: In the case of the Enola bean, there was nothing at all new: the yellow bean is the result of centuries of collective work and ingenuity on the part of Mexican farmers and indigenous peoples.

zh: 此外，这种黄豆还被收入由墨西哥国家农业研究院举办的公开展览。
en: Moreover, the bean was incorporated into public collections held by INIFAP, the Mexican national agricultural research institute.

zh: ETC小组将这一案件向哥伦比亚卡利的热带农业国际中心（CIAT）提交。
en: ETC Group took the case to the Center for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT) in Cali, Colombia.

zh: 热带农业国际中心是世界农业研究咨询小组（CGIAR）下属的国际中心之一。
en: CIAT is one of the international centers of the Consultative Group on International Agricultural Research (CGIAR).

zh: 世界农业研究咨询小组系统在基因库中保存着超过600，000种作物品种样本，其中多数均来自农田地头。
en: The CGIAR system maintains more than 600,000 samples of crop varieties in gene banks, mostly collected from peasant fields.

zh: 世界农业研究咨询小组为确认上述事实曾于1994年与联合国粮农组织（FAO）签订信托协议，承诺保持所搜集种子的无知识产权状态。
en: Acknowledging this, CGIAR signed a Trust Agreement with the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in 1994, pledging to keep the seeds in their collections free of any intellectual property claims.

zh: 热带农业国际中心负责人Joachim Voss出面确认这种黄豆已收入该中心的基因库，并确认这种黄豆原产于墨西哥。
en: Joachim Voss, then CIAT’s director, confirmed that the yellow beans were present in CIAT’s gene bank, and that they had originated in Mexico.

zh: 2000年底，热带农业国际中心在联合国粮农组织的支持下，要求美国专利商标局重新对这项专利进行审核。
en: At the end of 2000, CIAT, supported by the FAO, requested that the USPTO re-examine the patent.

zh: 遗传学家随后对黄豆进行基因指纹识别，结论是Proctor的Endola黄豆与信托协议中的墨西哥黄豆在基因上完全吻合。
en: Geneticists then performed genetic fingerprinting on the yellow beans, and concluded that Proctor’s Enola bean was identical to the Mexican beans covered by the Trust Agreement.

zh: 与此同时，2001年，利用美国专利商标局反应慢的弱点，Proctor对科罗拉多州16家小型种子公司提出侵犯专利权的诉讼。
en: Meanwhile, in 2001, taking advantage of the USPTO’s slow response, Proctor sued 16 small seed companies in Colorado for patent-infringement.

zh: 直到2003年12月，美国专利商标局才首次“非终审”宣布取消专利。
en: Only in December 2003 did the USPTO announce its first “non-final” rejection of the patent.

zh: Proctor就此提出上诉，而美国专利商标局于2005年4月发布终审取消公告。
en: Proctor appealed, and the USPTO issues its final rejection of the patent in April 2005.

zh: 但Enola黄豆纠纷并未就此结束。
en: But that was not the end of the Enola bean issue.

zh: Proctor要求继续对专利进行审核，提交其他几项专利申请甚至几次更换律师（目的就是争取将诉讼时间拖得更长 ） 。
en: Proctor requested that the patent examination be continued, submitting additional patent claims and even changing his lawyers several times (allowing more bureaucratic delay).

zh: 这项专利在10年时间里被起诉并否决四次，直至今年夏天美国上诉法院颁布第五次否决公告。
en: In total, the patent was rejected and appealed four times within a decade, until the US Court of Appeals rejected it for the fifth time this summer.

zh: 十多年来，一个专利所有者破坏了美国和墨西哥的大豆市场。
en: For more than a decade, a single patent owner disrupted the bean market in the US and Mexico.

zh: 因为害怕惹上官司，进口商停止黄豆和其他墨西哥豆类的进口。
en: Importers stopped importing not only the yellow bean, but also other Mexican beans, fearing lawsuits.

zh: 虽然这项专利最终被撤销，但Enola案件证明知识产权体系是如何催生对公共和集体资源的垄断，为有能力支付昂贵律���费用的人带来好处。
en: Although the patent was eventually rescinded, the Enola case shows how the intellectual property system facilitates the monopolization of public and collective resources, favoring those who can pay expensive lawyers’ fees.

zh: Enola专利从一开始就是个错误，但尽管国际机构、政府和民间组织付出积极的努力，但这项专利在其近半的寿命时间内却始终有效。
en: The Enola patent was wrong from the outset, yet it remained enforceable for half its life, despite the active efforts of international institutions, governments, and civil-society organizations.

zh: 也许人们更愿意将Enola专利事件作为一种错误，但同样的生物剽窃事例还有数百个。
en: It may be tempting to dismiss the Enola patent as an aberration, but there are hundreds of examples of such biopiracy.

zh: 墨西哥黄豆、南亚香米、玻利维亚昆诺阿藜、亚马逊卡皮木、印度鹰嘴豆、秘鲁努纳豆、安第斯玛卡 — — 都曾经经历过掠夺性的知识产权诉求。
en: Mexican beans, South Asian basmati rice, Bolivian quinoa, Amazonian ayahuasca, Indian chickpeas, Peruvian nuña beans, Andean maca – all have been subject to predatory intellectual property claims.

zh: Enola纠纷是专利制度危险性的明证，表现出专利阻碍农业进口、破坏或摧毁发展中国家出口市场、劫持数千年文化传承的粮食作物、掠夺人类集体智慧和威胁食品安全的巨大力量。
en: The Enola controversy is a stark illustration of the danger of patenting life, and the power of patents to block agricultural imports, disrupt or destroy developing countries’ export markets, hijack staple food crops that are the cultural heritage of millennia, plunder collective knowledge, and threaten food security.

zh: Enola案件表明最终结果正确是不够的：农民、土著和穷苦人经受不起长达十年的诉讼和垄断。
en: The Enola case demonstrates that being right is not enough: small farmers, indigenous people, and the poor can’t out-last a decade of lawsuits and monopoly.

zh: 无疑，南方国家和国际机构有比耗费资源起诉贪婪的企业更为急迫的目标。
en: Undoubtedly, international institutions and countries in the global South have far more urgent goals than to spend resources suing greedy companies.

zh: 是时候对将垄断所有权凌驾于人类共同利益之上的知识产权体系是否有必要存在提出质疑了。
en: It is high time to question the very existence of an intellectual property system that privileges monopoly ownership over the common good.

zh: 癌症的危险传说
en: Cancer’s Dangerous Mythology

zh: 日内瓦—今年，世界癌症日的焦点将是打消这一疾病的破坏性传说。
en: GENEVA – This year, World Cancer Day will focus on dispelling damaging myths about the disease.

zh: 这一主题 — — 以“癌症 — — 你了解过吗？ ” （ Cancer—Did you know）为标题 — — 给我们提供了一个机会，认真思考癌症的真正后果并加强全球预防和治疗。
en: The theme – illustrated in the tagline “Cancer – Did you know?” – offers an opportunity to reflect on cancer’s true consequences and enhance global prevention and treatment efforts.

zh: 一个流行的传说是癌症主要是发达国家的问题。
en: One prevailing myth is that cancer is primarily a developed-country problem.

zh: 但是，尽管癌症确实在富裕国家普遍存在，但世界最穷国家的人们因癌症损失的寿命更长。
en: But, while it is true that cancer is pervasive in wealthy countries, people in the world’s poorest countries lose more years of life to the disease.

zh: 医学进步和技术发展让高收入国家癌症患者能够活得更长 — — 从某种程度上说，某些癌症实际上无非是慢性病 — — 而低收入国家患者年纪轻轻就死了。
en: As medical advances and technological developments have helped cancer patients in high-income countries to live longer – to the extent that some forms of cancer have effectively become chronic conditions – those in low-income countries continue to die young.

zh: 除了不公平之外，这还是沉痛的悲剧。
en: Besides being unjust, this is deeply tragic.

zh: 在逃过了疟疾和艾滋病后，人们本不应该因癌症而过早撒手人寰 — — 特别是那些打一针负担得起的疫苗便可预防的癌症。
en: Having eluded killers like malaria and AIDS, one should not then be killed prematurely by cancer – especially a form of cancer that could have been prevented with something as simple and as affordable as a vaccine.

zh: 疫苗和癌症之间的联系常常被忽视，这是第二个普遍存在的误解：光是命运（或许还有吸烟）决定了谁得癌症。
en: The often-overlooked link between vaccines and cancer highlights a second common misconception: fate alone (and perhaps smoking) determines who gets cancer.

zh: 事实上，全世界六分之一的癌症是由已知致病因子造成的，在撒哈拉以南的一些非洲国家，这一比例高达三分之一。
en: In fact, one in six cancer cases worldwide is caused by a known infectious agent, with the proportion rising to one-third in some countries in Sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 四大主要致病因子是乙肝和丙肝、人类乳突病毒（HPV）以及幽门螺旋杆菌四者加起来每年造成190万例肝癌、子宫癌和胃癌病例。
en: The four main culprits are hepatitis B and C (hepB and hepC), human papillomavirus (HPV), and Helicobacter pylori, which are collectively responsible for 1.9 million cases of liver, cervical, and gastric cancer annually.

zh: 子宫癌每年造成的女性死亡数量比分娩还要高，平均没两分钟就有一人致死。
en: Cervical cancer now kills more women than childbirth, claiming a life every two minutes.

zh: 每年有275 000女性因子宫癌死亡，85%生活在最穷国家。
en: Of the 275,000 women who die of cervical cancer annually, 85% live in the world’s poorest countries.

zh: 毕竟，子宫癌患者通常是最虚弱的人群，如感染艾滋病毒的女性。
en: After all, cervical cancer tends to target the most vulnerable in particular, such as women infected with HIV.

zh: 若不加以控制，子宫癌年致死数量将在2030年增加到430 000。
en: If left unchecked, the number of cervical cancer deaths is set to rise to 430,000 annually by 2030.

zh: 其次是乙肝，其传染性比艾滋病毒高50倍，通常在分娩之前或之后不久通过母婴渠道传播。 乙肝会增加一生中患肝癌的可能性。
en: Then there is hepB, which is over 50 times more infectious than HIV and often passed from mother to child before or shortly after birth, increasing the likelihood of liver cancer later in life.

zh: 据估计，如今在世者中有20亿人感染了乙肝，3 500万人为慢性。
en: An estimated two billion people alive today have been infected with hepB, while 350 million people are chronically infected.

zh: 在这些人中，大约四分之一会死于与乙肝相关的癌症或肝硬化（慢性肝病的后果之一 ） 。
en: Of these, roughly one-quarter will die from hepB-related liver cancer or cirrhosis (a consequence of chronic liver disease).

zh: 好消息是，已经存在强大的工具防止大量此类死亡。
en: The good news is that powerful tools are available to avert many of these deaths.

zh: 现有HPV疫苗可以防止最多70%的子宫癌，研发中的新疫苗还能进一步提高这一纪录。
en: Existing HPV vaccines can prevent up to 70% of cervical cancer cases, and new vaccines are in the pipeline that will improve this record further.

zh: 类似地，乙肝疫苗在预防乙肝传染及其慢性后果方面的有效性高达95 % 。
en: Likewise, hepB vaccines are 95% effective at preventing infection and its chronic consequences.

zh: 针对幽门螺旋杆菌和丙肝的疫苗正在研发中（尽管后者的困难很大 ） 。
en: Vaccines protecting against Helicobacter pylori and hepC are in development (although the latter is proving particularly challenging).

zh: 就连人类孢疹病毒（Epstein-Barr virus）疫苗（可预防某些种类的淋巴癌）也获得了可喜的成果。
en: Even an Epstein-Barr virus vaccine, which would protect against some kinds of lymphoma, is achieving promising results.

zh: 但购买并将这些疫苗送到最脆弱的低收入国家公民手中仍是一项重大挑战。
en: But paying for and delivering these vaccines to the most vulnerable citizens of low-income countries poses a significant challenge.

zh: 尽管世界卫生组织在1992年便已建议将乙肝疫苗纳入常规免疫，但其高昂的价格仍限制了其在一些发展中国家的使用。
en: Although the World Health Organization (WHO) has recommended including the hepB vaccine in routine immunization since 1992, its high price initially hindered its uptake in some developing countries.

zh: 后来，同样的问题又出现在推广HPV疫苗上。
en: More recently, the same problem threatened to hinder the adoption of HPV vaccines.

zh: 但全球疫苗免疫联盟（GAVI Alliance）的出手干预保证了乙肝不再是个问题，HPV亦然。
en: But the GAVI Alliance intervened to ensure that this is no longer a concern with hepB, and it is unlikely to occur with HPV.

zh: 自2000年成立以来，GAVI联盟一直在寻求让更多的最穷儿童获得拯救生命的疫苗。
en: Since its launch in 2000, the GAVI Alliance has sought to increase access to life-saving vaccines for the world’s poorest children.

zh: 在与世界银行、世卫组织、联合国儿童基金会和比尔和梅琳达·盖茨基金会的合作中，GAVI联盟使用创新性融资工具筹集全球免疫项目资金，同时与产业界合作以降低疫苗价格。
en: In partnership with the World Bank, the WHO, UNICEF, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, it has used innovative financing tools to raise funds for global immunization programs, while working with industry to lower the prices of vaccines.

zh: 通过将乙肝疫苗纳入到五价（五合一）疫苗的一部分，GAVI联盟已让它走进了70个国家，成为常规免疫的一部分。
en: By including the hepB vaccine as part of a pentavalent (five in one) vaccine, the Alliance has already facilitated its delivery to children in 70 countries as part of routine immunizations.

zh: 目前，GAVI联盟正在致力于在2020年之前让3 000万世界去穷妇女和女孩获得HPV疫苗；作为这项努力的一部分，也正好赶上世界癌症日，GAVI联盟在八个国家开展了示范性项目。
en: The Alliance is now working to make the HPV vaccine available to more than 30 million of the world’s poorest women and girls by 2020; as part of this effort, and coinciding with World Cancer Day, it has launched demonstration programs in eight developing countries.

zh: 越来越多的证据表明，疫苗的好处不仅局限于预防疾病和死亡。
en: A growing body of evidence shows that vaccines’ benefits extend beyond preventing illness and death.

zh: 它们还被发现有助于婴儿的认知发展和儿童的教育程度，从而提振一国经济增长潜力。
en: They have also been found to aid infants’ cognitive development and children’s educational attainment, thus boosting countries’ economic-growth potential.

zh: 在与癌症的斗争中，医学进步需花费巨大的努力才能让死亡率有所下降，这表明改善疫苗的普及具有重大意义，只消花几美元打一针，就可以抑制发展中国家未来癌症患者数量。
en: In the fight against cancer, medical advances can shave precious percentage points off of mortality rates, which implies that improved access to vaccines can have a massive impact, slashing the number of future cases in developing countries for just a few dollars per dose.

zh: 毫无疑问，发达国家的人们已非常明白预防优于治疗的道理。
en: People in rich countries are undoubtedly familiar with the maxim that prevention is better than cure.

zh: 但是，由于发达国家疫苗已经获得了普及，对预防措施的关注已经移到了改变致癌生活方式上。
en: But, given the ready availability of vaccines in developed countries, the focus of prevention efforts has shifted to changing cancer-causing lifestyles.

zh: 与此同时，发展中国家的人们缺少预防集中最常见癌症的简单而有效的工具。
en: Meanwhile, people in developing countries lack access to simple and effective tools for preventing several of the most common cancers.

zh: 改善疫苗普及是纠正这一全球不平等并拉近越来越大的贫富差距的关键。
en: Improving access to vaccines is crucial to addressing this global inequity and reducing the widening gap between rich and poor.

zh: 而这首先要求打破人类无法“抓获”癌症的传说。
en: This requires, first and foremost, dispelling the myth that one cannot “catch” cancer.

zh: 菜单上的气候变化
en: Climate Change on the Menu

zh: 维泰博，意大利 — — 当我们思考应对气候变化的斗争时，大多数人都特别关注减少汽车、卡车和其他由化石燃料所驱动的机械的温室气体排放。
en: VITERBO, ITALY – When we think about winning the fight against climate change, most people concentrate on reducing greenhouse-gas emissions from cars, trucks, and other machines powered by fossil fuels.

zh: 但虽然这些排放来源无疑都值得我们关注，但另一个罪魁祸首却远未得到应有的重视：那就是我们的食物。
en: But while these emissions sources are certainly worthy of our attention, another culprit receives far less than it deserves: our food.

zh: 农业和粮食可持续性是气候变化难题的重要组成部分，但到目前为止，气候可持续饮食仍然不在我们的菜单上。
en: Farm and food sustainability are important pieces of the climate-change puzzle, but at the moment, climate-sustainable diets are not on the menu.

zh: 在发展中世界，目前仍有约8.21亿人在忍饥挨饿。
en: In the developing world, some 821 million people currently suffer from hunger.

zh: 但与此同时，富裕国家仅每年浪费掉的粮食就可以养活7.5亿人。
en: Meanwhile, rich countries waste enough food every year to feed 750 million people.

zh: 这就是粮食和气候变化之间的联系所在：随着许多民众逐步摆脱贫困 — — 他们需要更多的肉类和奶制品才能满足自身的需求。
en: Here is where the connection between food and climate change comes in: as people climb out of poverty – as many are – they demand more meat and dairy.

zh: 上述趋势对农业的生态足迹已经产生了严重的影响。
en: This trend has grave implications for agriculture’s ecological footprint.

zh: 动物所消耗的粮食多于他们所生产的肉类。
en: Animals consume more food than they produce.

zh: 奶牛释放出大量的甲烷来捕获热量。
en: Cows release large volumes of heat-trapping methane.

zh: 而清理土地用作牧场则以惊人的速度释放出二氧化碳。
en: And clearing land for pasture releases carbon dioxide at a staggering rate.

zh: 如果牛肉和乳品业是一个国家，那么它将是全世界第三大温室气体排放国，仅仅位列于美国和中国之后。
en: If the beef and dairy industries were a country, it would be the world’s third-largest emitter of greenhouse gases, behind only the United States and China.

zh: 幸运的是，这个问题有解决办法：那就是多吃水果和蔬菜，少吃肉。
en: Fortunately, there is a solution: eat less meat and more fruit and vegetables.

zh: 将红肉消费控制在每周两次将使全球耕地面积减少约3/4 — — 节约出来的面积相当于美国、中国、欧盟和澳大利亚的总和。
en: Reducing red meat consumption to twice per week would reduce global farmland by three-quarters – an area equivalent in size to the US, China, the European Union, and Australia combined.

zh: 这样做同样也具备营养学上的意义。
en: Doing so would also make nutritional sense.

zh: 目前，畜牧业占用了全球耕地的80%左右，但却仅出产了全球18%的卡路里。
en: At the moment, livestock farming uses about 80% of the planet’s farmland but produces just 18% of our calories.

zh: 最糟糕的是，动物养殖威胁到我们的供水；据斯德哥尔摩国际水资源研究所统计，截止2050年世界各国可能耗尽淡水，除非人们将动物产品的消费减少到日常卡路里需求的仅5%左右。
en: Worst of all, animal farming is a threat to our water supply; according to the Stockholm International Water Institute, the world could run out of fresh water by 2050 unless people reduce their consumption of animal products to just 5% of their daily calorie requirements.

zh: 有些习惯必须改变，而且越快越好；名人们无疑理解这一点。
en: Something must change, and fast; celebrities certainly understand this.

zh: 出生于养牛牧场主家庭的气候大师兼前美国副总统戈尔现在已经成为素食主义者，他曾经的老板美国总统比尔·克林顿也是这样。
en: Climate guru and former US Vice President Al Gore, who comes from a family of cattle ranchers, is now vegan, as is his former boss, US President Bill Clinton.

zh: 网球明星赛丽娜和维纳斯·威廉姆斯、流行歌手碧昂斯还有其他许多人也正在减少他们的肉类消费量。
en: Tennis stars Serena and Venus Williams, pop singer Beyoncé, and many others are also reducing their meat consumption.

zh: 与此同时，世界各地的学校正在采用“无肉星期一”来向学生传授可持续发展意识。
en: Meanwhile, schools all over the world are adopting “Meat Free Mondays” to teach students about sustainability.

zh: 就连麦当劳也开始在斯堪的纳维亚半岛提供麦当劳蔬菜汉堡，而且此举显然获得了好评。
en: Even McDonald’s has begun offering McVegan burgers in Scandinavia, apparently to rave reviews.

zh: 经济学人智库和巴里拉食品与营养基金会（BCFN）最近公布的一项研究发现，有关可持续食品和食品浪费领域的官方政策也正在发生变化。
en: A recent study published by the Economist Intelligence Unit and the Barilla Center for Food and Nutrition Foundation (BCFN) found that official policies toward sustainable food and food waste are also changing.

zh: 例如，在2016年，法国成为世界首个禁止杂货店浪费食物的国家。
en: In 2016, for example, France became the first country in the world to prohibit grocery stores from wasting food.

zh: 类似的法律也在意大利获得了通过。
en: Italy has adopted a similar law.

zh: 而丹麦的公寓居民所丢弃的食物比五年前减少了25 % ， 因为丹麦总理拉斯姆森已经把食品浪费列入了政治计划。
en: Apartment dwellers in Denmark, where Prime Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen has put food waste on the political agenda, throw out 25% less food than they did five years ago.

zh: 我与巴里拉食品及营养基金会所共同领导的一项为期三年的可持续饮食生活（SU-Eatable Life）欧盟委员会计划旨在证明饮食方面的改变能够产生重大的生态效果。
en: The SU-Eatable Life project, a three-year European Commission initiative that I am leading in partnership with BCFN – aims to demonstrate that dietary changes can have a significant ecological effect.

zh: 数据显示通过减少肉类食用量及减少粮食浪费，欧洲消费者每年可以减少200万立方米的用水量，同时减少约5，300吨的二氧化碳排放。
en: Data show that by eating less meat and wasting less food, European consumers could reduce water consumption by two million cubic meters and lower CO2 emissions by about 5,300 tons every year.

zh: 那么，我们每个人可以做些什么来支持这项工作？
en: So, what can each of us do to support these efforts?

zh: 首先，我们应当食用更多的蔬菜和谷物，这既有助于地球也有助于我们自身的健康。
en: For starters, we should consume more vegetables and grains, which would be good for the planet’s health and our own.

zh: 2017年，一项法国研究发现素食者往往比肉食者更加健康，因为他们所吃的食物更加丰富，同时减少了卡路里的摄取量。
en: A 2017 French study found that vegetarians are often healthier than meat eaters because they eat a more varied diet and consume fewer calories.

zh: 我们应当根据巴里拉食品及营养基金会的双重粮食及环境金字塔来消费食物，该标准推荐的食物不仅营养价值高、而且对环境的损害没那么严重；植物蛋白其实是最佳的选择。
en: We should eat according to the BCFN’s Double Food and Environmental Pyramid, which recommends foods that are high in nutritional value and less damaging to the environment; plant-based proteins are the best.

zh: 事实上，在素食者占据主导地位的世界里，农业温室气体排放将比今天降低70 % 。
en: In fact, in a world dominated by vegans, agricultural greenhouse-gas emissions would be 70% lower than they are today.

zh: 这的确是非常令人满意的。
en: That would be a welcome mouthful indeed.

zh: 打击腐败无法终结贫困
en: Fighting Corruption Won’t End Poverty

zh: 美国剑桥—国家之所以穷，是因为政府腐败。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Countries are poor because governments are corrupt.

zh: 除非它们保证公共资源不被窃取，公共权力不用于私利，否则它们就会一直穷下去，对吗？
en: And, unless they ensure that public resources are not stolen, and that public power is not used for private gain, they will remain poor, right?

zh: 显然，相信这种说法很有诱惑力。
en: It certainly is tempting to believe so.

zh: 毕竟，有一种叙事将繁荣承诺与反不公斗争漂亮地联系在一起。
en: Here, after all, is a narrative that neatly aligns the promise of prosperity with the struggle against injustice.

zh: 教皇方济各在其最近的拉美之行中说 ： “ 腐败是蠹虫，是人民中的坏疽。
en: As Pope Francis said on his recent trip to Latin America: “corruption is the moth, the gangrene of a people.”

zh: ”腐败理应“绑上岩石，沉入大海。 ”
en: The corrupt deserve to be “tied to a rock and cast into the sea.”

zh: 也许确实如此。
en: Perhaps they do.

zh: 但这并不一定能让他们的国家变得繁荣。
en: But that won’t necessarily make their countries more prosperous.

zh: 用数据说话。
en: Consider the data.

zh: 最好的腐败指标或许是世界银行的腐败控制指标（CCI ） 。 该指标1996年开始发布，涵盖了180多个国家。
en: Probably the best measure of corruption is the World Bank’s Control of Corruption Indicator, which has been published since 1996 for over 180 countries.

zh: CCI表明，富国的腐败情况比穷国少，但相对腐败更少的国家，比如加纳、哥斯达黎加和丹麦，并不比发展水平相当的国家增长更快。
en: The CCI shows that while rich countries tend to be less corrupt than poor ones, countries that are relatively less corrupt, for their level of development, such as Ghana, Costa Rica, or Denmark, do not grow any faster than others.

zh: CCI分数有所改善的国家，如赞比亚、马其顿、乌拉圭和新西兰，并没有增长得更快。
en: Nor do countries that improve in their CCI score, such as Zambia, Macedonia, Uruguay, or New Zealand, grow faster.

zh: 相反，世界银行政府效率指标表明，给定收入水平，政府效率相对较高或改善政府绩效的国家确实增长更快。
en: By contrast, the World Bank’s Government Effectiveness Indicator suggests that countries that, given their income level, have relatively effective governments or improve their performance, do tend to grow faster.

zh: 出于某些原因 — — 也许与纽约大学的乔纳森·海特（Jonathan Haidt）所谓的“正义思维”的性质有关 — — 我们的道德情绪与面对伤害和不公时的感同身受有很大关系。
en: For some reason – probably related to the nature of what NYU’s Jonathan Haidt calls our “righteous minds” – our moral sentiments are strongly related to feelings of empathy in the face of harm and unfairness.

zh: 动员反对不公远比动员支持公正容易。
en: It is easier to mobilize against injustice than for justice.

zh: 我们对“斗恶 ” — —比如饥饿和贫困 — — 有很大热情，而对为了保证粮食和可持续生计充裕的增长和发展而奋斗的热情要小得多。
en: We are more enthusiastic to fight the bad – say, hunger and poverty – than to fight for, say, the kind of growth and development that makes food and sustainable livelihoods plentiful.

zh: 有时，从“恶”转变为相应的“善”完全只是语义学问题：打击种族主义就是为无歧视而奋斗。
en: Sometimes switching from the “bad” to the corresponding “good” is simply a matter of semantics: to fight against racism is to fight for nondiscrimination.

zh: 但是，在腐败的例子中，腐败是一种恶，其根源是善的缺失，因此斗恶与造善完全不同。
en: But, in the case of corruption, which is a bad that is caused by the absence of a good, attacking the bad is very different from creating the good.

zh: 善是一种能力国家（capable state ） ： 能够保护国家及其人民、维持和平、执行规则和契约、提供基础设施和社会服务、监管经济活动、可信地进行跨期借贷、对社会征税并用之于全社会的官僚体系。
en: The good is a capable state: a bureaucracy that can protect the country and its people, keep the peace, enforce rules and contracts, provide infrastructure and social services, regulate economic activity, credibly enter into inter-temporal obligations, and tax society to pay for it all.

zh: 能力国家的缺失（无力阻止公职人员以公谋私以至于常常与社会其他成员的利益相悖）造成腐败，也造成了贫困和退步。
en: It is the absence of a capable state that causes corruption (the inability to prevent public officials, often in collusion with other members of society, from subverting decision-making for private gain), as well as poverty and backwardness.

zh: 一些人也许会说，减少腐败包括了建立能力国家；善是在斗恶的过程中创造出来的。
en: Some might argue that reducing corruption entails the creation of a capable state; the good is created out of the fight against the bad.

zh: 但果真如此吗？
en: But is it?

zh: 教师和护士常常不在工作中露面，但这并不意味着如果他们出工绩效就能得到改善。
en: Teachers and nurses often do not show up for work, but that does not mean that performance would improve much if they did.

zh: 警察也许会停止索贿，但这并不能让他们更好地抓捕罪犯、阻止犯罪。
en: Policemen may stop asking for bribes, but that will not make them any better at catching criminals and preventing crime.

zh: 减少补偿性支付（side-payments）并不意味着管理特许经营合同或征税的能力。
en: Curtailing side-payments does not imply the ability to manage concession contracts or collect taxes.

zh: 除了起诉害群之马，打击腐败的手段常常包括改革采购规则、公共财政管理体系和反腐立法。
en: Aside from prosecuting some bad apples, measures to fight corruption typically involve reforming procurement rules, public financial-management systems, and anti-corruption legislation.

zh: 基本假设是新规则将不同于此前的规则，它们将获得执行。
en: The underlying assumption is that the new rules, unlike the previous rules, will be enforced.

zh: 乌干达的经验表明并非如此。
en: That has not been Uganda’s experience.

zh: 2009年，在救援社会的压力下，政府实施了当时被誉为全世界最佳反腐立法的法律；但所有腐败指标依然继续恶化。
en: In 2009, under pressure from the aid community, the government enacted what was billed at the time as the best anti-corruption legislation in the world; and yet all corruption indicators have continued to worsen.

zh: 乌干达绝非例外。
en: Uganda is not an exception.

zh: 我的哈佛同事马特·安德鲁斯（Matt Andrews）记录了预防贪污的公共财政改革失败的情况。
en: My colleague at Harvard, Matt Andrews, has documented the failure of public financial management reforms designed to prevent graft.

zh: 失败的原因并不限定于财政管理。
en: And the reasons for these failures are not specific to financial management.

zh: 所有组���都需要被认为合法。
en: All organizations need to be perceived as legitimate.

zh: 它们可以通过实际行使它们的建立初衷功能创造出合法的形象。 但这样很困难。
en: They can create this perception by actually performing the function for which they were created, which is difficult.

zh: 或者，它们可以借助于一个自然界的战略，即所谓的同构拟态（isomorphic mimicry ） ： 就像无毒蛇进化出与毒蛇相近的外貌，组织可以让它们看起来像是其他地方被人合法的机构。
en: Alternatively, they can borrow from the natural world a strategy called isomorphic mimicry: just as non-poisonous snakes evolve to resemble a poisonous species, organizations can make themselves look like institutions in other places that are perceived as legitimate.

zh: 而反腐斗争常常会刺激这一行为：出现更沉迷于遵守繁复的新流程而不是实现既定目标的组织。
en: And this is what the anti-corruption agenda often ends up stimulating: the creation of organizations that are more obsessed with abiding by the new and burdensome processes than they are with achieving their stated goals.

zh: 哈佛大学的兰特·普莱切特（Lant Pritchett ） 、 迈克尔·乌尔科克（Michael Woolcock）和安德鲁斯指出，当无能的组织采取财政管理系统和采购规则等“最佳实践”时，它们就会彻底沉沦在扭曲决策的协议中，根本无法完成成立它们的初衷目的。
en: As Harvard’s Lant Pritchett, Michael Woolcock, and Andrews argue, when inept organizations adopt “best practices” such as financial management systems and procurement rules, they become too distracted by decision-distorting protocols to do what they were established to do.

zh: 弗朗西斯·福山（Francis Fukuyama）指出，可问责的、法治的能力国家的发展是人类文明成就的皇冠。
en: As Francis Fukuyama has pointed out, the development of a capable state that is accountable and ruled by law is one of the crowning achievements of human civilization.

zh: 它需要创造出“我们”的共同感，即一个国家代表其行动的“想象的共同体 ” 。
en: It involves the creation of a shared sense of “us,” an imagined community on whose behalf the state acts.

zh: 当社会因为种族、宗教或社会地位而处于深度分裂状态时，这绝不是个容易的任务。
en: This is not an easy task when societies are deeply divided by ethnicity, religion, or social status.

zh: 毕竟，谁才是国家？
en: After all, who is the state for?

zh: 是所有伊拉克人还是只是其中的什叶派？
en: All Iraqis or just the Shia among them?

zh: 是所有的肯尼亚人还是只是其中的基库尤人？
en: All Kenyans or just the Kikuyu?

zh: 怎样防止当前掌权的种族群体带着“风水轮流转”的心态霸占资源？
en: What is to prevent the ethnic group currently in power from diverting resources to itself on the argument that “it’s our turn to eat?”

zh: 为何目前掌握在国家手中的资源不会成为他们的传家之物？ 比如，在委内瑞拉，前总统查韦斯逝世已经两年多，但其女仍然占据着总统官邸。
en: Why shouldn’t those currently in control of the state transform it into their patrimony, as in Venezuela, where, more than two years after former President Hugo Chávez’s death, his daughters still occupy the presidential residence?

zh: 反腐斗争之所以能动员我们所有人，是因为我们希望赶走恶魔和不公。
en: The fight against corruption mobilizes all of us because we want to do away with evil and injustice.

zh: 但我们应该铭记，将恶投入大海并不能让我们需要的善立刻出现在眼前。
en: But we should remember that casting the bad into the sea does not imply the sudden appearance on our shores of the good that we need.

zh: 当打击假新闻护航审查制度
en: When Fighting Fake News Aids Censorship

zh: 华盛顿 — — 许多媒体分析人士已经正确认识到“假新闻”所带来的危害，但却往往会忽视这一现象对记者本身的意义。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Many media analysts have rightly identified the dangers posed by “fake news,” but often overlook what the phenomenon means for journalists themselves.

zh: 这个词不仅已经成为诋毁整个新闻行业的捷径，更有甚者，独裁势力正在利用其作为囚禁记者和审查新闻报道的借口，最常见的是毫无依据的指控被审查媒体支持恐怖主义。
en: Not only has the term become a shorthand way to malign an entire industry; autocrats are invoking it as an excuse to jail reporters and justify censorship, often on trumped-up charges of supporting terrorism.

zh: 纵观整个世界，因为发布虚假或虚构新闻而被监禁的诚实的记者人数已经达到至少21位的历史顶点。
en: Around the world, the number of honest journalists jailed for publishing fake or fictitious news is at an all-time high of at least 21.

zh: 随着非民主领袖越来越多的使用“假消息”的反击手段来镇压独立媒体，这一数字很有可能仍会呈攀升之势。
en: As non-democratic leaders increasingly use the “fake news” backlash to clamp down on independent media, that number is likely to climb.

zh: 曾经作为捍卫自由言论世界领袖的美国已经放弃了这项任务。
en: The United States, once a world leader in defending free speech, has retreated from this role.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统有关“假新闻”的推特长文已经为专制政权合理化其国内媒体镇压行动提供了实例。
en: President Donald Trump’s Twitter tirades about “fake news” have given autocratic regimes an example by which to justify their own media crackdowns.

zh: 12月，中国由国家经营的人民日报在推特 和脸书上发帖欢迎特朗普的假新闻口头禅，强调它“揭露了与西方媒体有关的更大真相。
en: In December, China’s state-run People’s Daily newspaper posted tweets and a Facebook post welcoming Trump’s fake news mantra, noting that it “speaks to a larger truth about Western media.”

zh: ”之后埃及政府又在2017年2月赞扬特朗普政府，该国的外交部长批评西方记者报道全球恐怖主义。
en: This followed the Egyptian government’s praise for the Trump administration in February 2017, when the country’s foreign ministry criticized Western journalists for their coverage of global terrorism.

zh: 2017年1月，土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安赞扬特朗普在一次现场直播的新闻发布会上指责一位CNN记者。
en: And in January 2017, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan praised Trump for berating a CNN reporter during a live news conference.

zh: 埃尔多安批评CNN电视网报道2013年土耳其的亲民主抗议活动，表示特朗普说出了记者问题的“真相 ” 。
en: Erdoğan, who criticized the network for its coverage of pro-democracy protests in Turkey in 2013, said that Trump had put the journalist “in his place.”

zh: 几个月后在会见埃尔多安时特朗普投桃报李。
en: Trump returned the compliment when he met Erdoğan a few months later.

zh: 赞扬这位土耳其总统是打击恐怖主义的盟友，而根本没有提到埃尔多安自身在新闻自由方面的惨淡记录。
en: Praising his counterpart for being an ally in the fight against terrorism, Trump made no mention of Erdoğan’s own dismal record on press freedom.

zh: 上述三个国家最快接受特朗普假新闻的比喻绝非偶然。
en: It is no accident that these three countries have been quickest to embrace Trump’s “fake news” trope.

zh: 中国、埃及和土耳其2017年囚禁了世界范围内超过半数的记者，延续了上一年的趋势性记录。
en: China, Egypt, and Turkey jailed more than half of the world’s journalists in 2017, continuing a trend from the previous year.

zh: 面对上述政府对独立媒体的攻击，国际社会的沉默似乎被解读为默许。
en: The international community’s silence in the face of these governments’ attacks on independent media seems to have been interpreted as consent.

zh: 在连续两年成为世界头号记者监禁国的土耳其，对自由言论的侵蚀一直尤其迅速。
en: In Turkey, the world’s top jailer of journalists two years in a row, the erosion of free speech has been particularly swift.

zh: 自2016年政变失败以来，土耳其法庭已经审理了约4，6000起涉及起诉民众侮辱总统、民族或国家机构的案子。
en: Since a failed coup attempt in 2016, Turkey’s courts have processed some 46,000 cases involving people accused of insulting the president, the nation, or its institutions.

zh: 目前身陷囹圄的73名记者无不因为反国家罪而遭受调查或指控。
en: Each of the 73 journalists currently behind bars is being investigated for, or charged with, anti-state crimes.

zh: 对记者最常见的指控是隶属、协助或宣扬所谓的恐怖组织。
en: The most common charge against reporters is belonging to, aiding, or propagandizing for an alleged terrorist organization.

zh: 措辞含糊的法律将报道与支持恐怖主义混为一谈，为旨在阻止不利新闻报道的政府提供了掩护。
en: Vaguely worded laws that conflate reporting about terrorism with supporting it provide cover for regimes intent on preventing unfavorable news coverage.

zh: 例如，试图在土耳其报道库尔德斯坦工人党（PKK ） 、 在埃及报道穆斯林兄弟会或在中国报道维吾尔人可能很快会导致记者因为同情恐怖分子而入狱。
en: For example, attempting to write about the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK) in Turkey, the Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt, or Uighurs in China can quickly land reporters in jail for harboring terrorist sympathies.

zh: 按照保护记者委员会的最新调查结果，世界范围内262名被监禁记者中近3/4被控犯有反国家罪。
en: Nearly three-quarters of the 262 journalists in prison around the world are being held on anti-state charges, according to the Committee to Protect Journalists’ most recent survey.

zh: 即便记者不被逮捕，独裁势力也正越来越多地借助“假新闻”指控来对合法报道进行诋毁。
en: Even when journalists aren’t arrested, autocrats are increasingly invoking the claim of “fake news” to discredit legitimate reporting.

zh: 在这方面，颇具讽刺意味的是，某些西方国家或者社交媒体审查假新闻或暴力材料的努力却恰恰契合了独裁者们的心意。
en: And here, ironically, efforts by some Western governments to sanitize social media of fake or violent material have played into the autocrats’ hands.

zh: 尽管上述清理工作的目标 — — 例如阻止俄罗斯已经完善的那类选举干预活动 — — 本身值得称赞，但由此所带来的意想不到的后果却是审查诚实记者在某些世界最危险地方报道的真实故事。
en: While the goals of these cleansing efforts – to prevent the type of electoral interference that Russia has perfected, for example – are laudable, an unintended consequence has been censorship of honest journalists reporting on real stories in some of the world’s most dangerous places.

zh: 以去年叙利亚内战的视频报道所发生的事件为例。
en: Consider what happened last year to video coverage of the civil war in Syria.

zh: 为控制极端主义内容，YouTube 删除了数百条与冲突相关的视频，许多由记录这场灾难的独立新闻渠道 — — Shaam新闻网、Qasioun通讯社和伊德利卜媒体中心所发布的视频也包括在内。
en: In an effort to rein in extremist content, YouTube removed hundreds of videos related to the conflict, including many posted by Shaam News Network, Qasioun News Agency, and Idlib Media Center – all independent news outlets documenting the disaster.

zh: 同样，Facebook关闭了利用该平台记录对缅甸穆斯林罗兴亚人暴力活动的个人和机构账户。 缅甸罗兴亚危机被联合国称为“种族清洗教科书般的范例 ” 。
en: Similarly, Facebook closed accounts of individuals and organizations that were using the platform to document violence against Muslim Rohingya in Myanmar, a crisis that the United Nations has called a “textbook example of ethnic cleansing.”

zh: Facebook表示破坏平台的“社区标准”是其采取行动的依据。
en: Facebook said it acted in response to violations of the platform’s “community standards.”

zh: 按照那些账号被关闭的记者的说法，在埃及和叙利亚，推特已经阻止公民记者报道侵犯人权事件。
en: And in Egypt and Syria, Twitter has blocked citizen journalists from reporting on human-rights abuses, according to journalists whose accounts have been closed.

zh: 推特的审查制度甚至已经触及了欧洲核心区；1月，在联邦议会执行拟对未能及时删除非法内容的社交媒体企业施以最高可达5000万欧元（合6100万美元）罚款的相关法案后，一家德国讽刺杂志被平台封禁。
en: Twitter’s censors have even hit the heart of Europe; in January, a German satire magazine was blocked from the platform after the Bundestag enacted legislation imposing fines of up to €50 million ($61 million) on social media firms that fail to remove illegal content in a timely manner.

zh: 其他欧洲国家也在考虑采取类似措施来迫使互联网企业应对错误信息和极端主义。
en: Other European countries are considering similar measures to compel Internet companies to battle misinformation and extremism.

zh: 旨在遏制仇恨言论、暴力或假新闻的法律可能用意不坏，但执行过程却草率不堪，缺乏确保问责制、透明度或可逆性的相关机制。
en: Laws meant to curb hate speech, violence, or “fake news” may be well intentioned, but their implementation has been sloppy, with few mechanisms to ensure accountability, transparency, or reversibility.

zh: 政府正在将审查权外包给私营部门，而对后者来讲，股东价值最大化，而非维护新闻自由才是推动其决策的依据。
en: Governments are outsourcing censorship to the private sector, where maximizing shareholder value, not upholding journalistic freedom, drives decision-making.

zh: 世界民主国家的领袖必须抵制对独立新闻机构的非自由攻击，而这意味着重新思考内容充满漏洞、容易被利用的法律。
en: Leaders of the world’s democracies must resist the illiberal assault on independent news organizations, and that means rethinking loosely crafted content laws that are vulnerable to abuse.

zh: 自由、充满活力的媒体对健康社会的运行至关重要，而错误信息将破坏媒体的根基。
en: A free, vibrant media is vital to the functioning of a healthy society, and misinformation can undermine it.

zh: 但比现存问题更加糟糕的是最终压制那些新闻报道的官方补救措施。
en: But official remedies that end up silencing those reporting the news are worse than the disease.

zh: 在美国扶贫
en: Fighting Poverty in America

zh: 伯克利—2005年到2014年间，25个发达经济体三分之二家庭的真实收入不增或下降。
en: BERKELEY – From 2005 to 2014, the real income of two-thirds of households in 25 developed economies was flat or fell.

zh: 一些国家在经过了政府的大量税收和转移支付干预后才实现家庭收入不降。
en: Only after very aggressive government intervention in taxes and transfers have some countries been able to hold families at least even.

zh: 这一经验给美国等国家带来了教训。 在即将到来的11月总统和国会选举中，不平等性和收入分配至关重要。
en: This experience holds lessons for countries like the United States, where inequality and income distribution loom large in the run-up to November’s presidential and congressional elections.

zh: 美国可以从有用的政策中学到什么？
en: What can the US learn from what works?

zh: 美国是全球异类，其社会安全网与就业紧密相关。
en: The US is a global outlier in tying much of its social safety net to employment.

zh: 在欧洲，社会福利支出平均占GDP的23 % ， 美国只有16 % 。
en: Social-welfare spending averages 23% of GDP in Europe, but only 16% in the US.

zh: 而对家庭来说，美国是异类中的异类：只有三个国家 — — 汤加、苏里南和巴布亚新几内亚 — — 没有带薪探亲假国家政策。
en: And the US is an especially distant outlier when it comes to families: only three other countries – Tonga, Suriname, and Papua New Guinea – lack a national policy on paid family leave.

zh: 但是，美国也有诸多成功的政策计划。
en: There are, however, many successful policy initiatives in the US.

zh: 比如，弗雷斯诺（Fresno）退休商业高管、加州共和党执行委员会成员皮特·韦伯（Pete Weber）领导着一场大胆思考如何让家庭摆脱贫困、实现自足的全国计划运动。
en: For example, Pete Weber, a retired business executive from Fresno and a member of the California Republican Party’s executive committee, is at the forefront of a nationwide movement of efforts to think boldly about how to move families out of poverty and into self-sufficiency.

zh: 2010年，韦伯创建了弗雷斯诺桥学院（Fresno Bridge Academy ） 。 该学院的成果赢得了全州和全国的赞誉 — — 不仅因为在个体需要方面的成功，也因为其高超的性价比。
en: The Fresno Bridge Academy, founded by Weber in 2010, has received statewide and national acclaim for its results – not only its success with individuals in need, but also its cost effectiveness.

zh: 该学院是一个18个月的就业培训计划，也为家庭提供支持性服务 — — 包括计算机扫盲班、简历助手、育儿班和儿童辅导 — — 通过旗下非盈利下属机构“阅读及其他 ” （ Reading and Beyond）进行。
en: The program is an 18-month employment-training program that also provides support services for families – including computer-literacy classes, résumé assistance, parenting classes, and tutoring for children – through its non-profit umbrella agency, Reading and Beyond.

zh: 该学院在加州最贫困邮政编码区帮助了1,200户自愿参与家庭，并以获得资金支持在未来两年在帮助2,300户家庭。
en: Located in the poorest postal code in California, the program has helped 1,200 families who enrolled voluntarily and is funded to serve an additional 2,300 families over the next two years.

zh: 目前，80%的参与家庭找到了工作或实现工资大幅增长，而在这些家庭中，80%在一年后能够保持收益。
en: To date, 80% of enrolled families have gained employment or significant wage growth, and 80% of those that do, retain these gains a year later.

zh: 三成家庭能够在区区18个月后就实现充分自立。
en: Thirty percent have achieved full self-reliance within just 18 months.

zh: 弗雷斯诺计划的资金来自SNAP（前食品券）计划的创新补助。 该计划严格基于结果，并采取两化评估。
en: The Fresno scheme, funded by an innovation grant from the SNAP (formerly food stamps) program, is rigorously outcome-based and quantitatively assessed.

zh: 其所投入的每一美元能够产生22美元收益，其中16美元归家庭，5美元归纳税人（主要以更高的税收收入和食品券发放量降低的形式实现 ） 。
en: It has generated $22 of benefit for every dollar invested, with $16 going to the families and $5 going to taxpayers (mainly in the form of higher revenues and reduced outlays for food stamps).

zh: 弗雷斯诺的环境比较特殊，那里是农业经济，但韦伯相信该计划可以扩展，并已经着手向其他两个加州郡 — — 圣华金（San Joaquin）和纳帕（Napa）推广。
en: While the circumstances in Fresno are particular to the agricultural economy there, Weber believes the program is scalable and is already extending it to two other California counties (San Joaquin and Napa).

zh: 通过与加州前进会经济峰会（California Forward’s Economic Summit）的更广泛的合作，韦伯正在将弗雷斯诺经验加入到2025年加州实现一百万家庭脱贫的计划中。
en: Through a broader effort with California Forward’s Economic Summit, Weber is embedding the lessons from Fresno in an effort to move a million families out of poverty in the state by 2025.

zh: 弗雷斯诺桥学院所采取的新方针出现得正是时候 — — 左派和右派都在质疑当前扶贫计划。
en: New approaches such as that taken by the Fresno Bridge Academy come at a time when both the left and the right are questioning current anti-poverty programs.

zh: 据一些统计数据，自1964年约翰逊总统发动“扶贫战争”以来，总支出已经超过了22万亿美元。
en: By some estimates, since President Lyndon B. Johnson launched his “War on Poverty” in 1964, total spending on the fight has exceeded $22 trillion.

zh: 但战线并未得到推进，美国官方贫困率依然高位徘徊在15%左右。
en: Yet the front isn’t moving. The official poverty rate in the US seems stuck at roughly 15%.

zh: 在右翼，美国众议院议长保罗·莱恩（Paul Ryan）的美国扩张机会（Expanding Opportunity in America）认定美国已经花了足够多的钱，只需要更好地花这些钱。
en: On the right, Speaker of the US House of Representatives Paul Ryan’s Expanding Opportunity in America anchors the view that America already spends enough and just needs to spend it better.

zh: 莱恩的计划着重于将各种计划整合为一个“机会津贴 ” 、 扩大低收入所得税优惠（EITC）以及刑事司法改革 — — 同时要鼓励经济增长，从而让就业创造来担当大任。
en: Ryan’s plan focuses on integrating programs into an “opportunity grant,” expanding the earned income tax credit (EITC), and criminal justice reform – all while encouraging economic growth, so that job creation does the heavy lifting.

zh: 在左翼，机会研究所（Opportunity Institute，充分披露：我们都是其董事会董事）等组织支持定向支出（特别是早教方面 ） 、 将大学和就业挂钩以及减少刑事累犯。
en: On the left, organizations like the Opportunity Institute (full disclosure: we both sit on its board of directors) argue for targeted spending, particularly in early education; linking college to careers; and reducing criminal recidivism.

zh: 民主党总统提名人希拉里·克林顿的政策平台提出了解决这些问题的新计划，并特别强调探亲假和早教和大学教育。
en: Democratic presidential nominee Hillary Clinton’s policy platform proposes new programs to address these issues, with a particular focus on family leave and early childhood and college education.

zh: 许多甚至大部分研究过这一主题的学者，如布鲁金斯研究所和美国企业研究所（American Enterprise Institute）的联合研究计划，兼顾了左翼和右翼要素 — — 特别是旨在强化家庭、改善现有工作质量和数量以及打破累犯循环的战略方面。
en: Many if not most scholars who have explored the topic, such as a joint effort by the Brookings Institution and the American Enterprise Institute, include elements from the left and the right – particularly strategies aimed at strengthening families, improving the quality and quantity of work available, and breaking the cycle of recidivism.

zh: EITC也获得了广泛的支持（在美国经济学会进行的调查中，四分之三的受访经济学家支持扩大EITC ） 。
en: The EITC also has broad backing (more than three-quarters of economists surveyed by the American Economic Association support expanding it).

zh: 另一个广泛共识是需要对哪些政策管用进行更好的定量评估。
en: There is also broad consensus on the need for better quantitative assessment of what works.

zh: 其他人，特别是许多硅谷科技界人士以及一些劳工运动人士，担心科技发展超过就业创造速度，造成大量人员失业。
en: Others, especially many in Silicon Valley’s technology world and some in the labor movement, are concerned that technology will outpace job creation and leave many out of work.

zh: 他们更喜欢切断就业和收入之间的联系的全民基本收入（UBI）计划。
en: They would prefer a universal basic income (UBI), which would sever the link between employment and income.

zh: 在最近的全民公投中，瑞士人民婉拒了UBI，但致力于更加激进的方针帮助需要人士值得欢迎，即使UBI的详情及其成本仍有待论证。
en: Swiss citizens roundly rejected that approach in a recent referendum, but the energy devoted to more radical approaches to help those who need it is welcome, even if the specifics of UBI and its cost have yet to proven.

zh: 桥学院以及联邦家庭访问计划（Federal Home Visiting Program）等例子表明，深度植根和面向服务社区、受有效结果证据推动的计划能起作用。
en: Examples like the Bridge Academy – and others, such as the Federal Home Visiting Program– show that initiatives that are deeply rooted in and tailored to the needs of the communities they serve, and that are driven by evidence of effective outcomes, can work.

zh: 不幸的是，我们常常采取相反的方针：不关注结果的粗放型全国计划。
en: Unfortunately, we too often embrace the opposite approach: broad-brush national programs with no focus on outcomes.

zh: 以美国农业部的食品和营养服务（Food and Nutrition Service）为例。
en: Consider the US Department of Agriculture’s Food and Nutrition Service.

zh: 其820亿美元的年度支出中有大约88%是直接补助（SNAP，或“食品券 ” ） ，只有0.33%用于为人们提供摆脱政府援助所需要的技能上。
en: Approximately 88% of its $82 billion in annual spending goes to direct aid (SNAP, or “food stamps”) while only 0.33% goes to providing people the skills they need to avoid government assistance.

zh: 更糟糕的是，注重技能的计划中没有一项具备评估计划的数据。
en: Even worse, none of the skills-focused programs have data to evaluate them.

zh: “进步的联邦主义”计划将大大增加这类支出并严格评估。
en: A “progressive federalist” program would substantially increase this type of spending and rigorously evaluate it.

zh: 这一计划将树立很高的联邦标准，但允许各市和州创新，然后为起作用的项目提供资金。
en: Such a program would set high federal standards but allow cities and states to innovate, then fund what works.

zh: 应该进行不同的思考并用真正起作用的结果来理顺我们的思路 — — 以及我们的支出。
en: It’s time to think differently and align our thinking – and our spending – with what actually works.

zh: 以民主对抗恐怖主义
en: Fighting Terrorism Democratically

zh: 伦敦和土耳其的爆炸事件再一次把这样一个陈腐观念推到了人们的面前：那就是独裁政权能比民主制度更好地应对恐怖，而这些袭击是我们为自由付出的惨重代价。
en: Bombings in London and Turkey have brought to the fore the old ideas that authoritarian regimes are better equipped than democracies to combat terrorism, and that such attacks are the price we pay for liberty.

zh: 对有些人来讲，付出这种代价还算值得，但对另外一些人来讲，这样的代价似乎就有些太高了。
en: For some, that is a price worth paying; for others, the costs seem too high.

zh: 但认真研究一下从前的记录，就会发现民主国家比独裁政权拥有对抗恐怖的更为有效的武器。
en: But a look at the record shows that democracies possess more effective weapons to fight terror than do authoritarian regimes.

zh: 实际上，民主国家放弃道德、未能抵御住独裁诱惑之时，他们的力量才会削弱。
en: Indeed, it is when democracies abandon their ethics and fail to resist the authoritarian temptation that they become weaker.

zh: 当然，片面地来看，呼吁限制自由背后的逻辑非常诱人：极端分子利用自由来从事犯罪，因此防止对自由权利的滥用需要缩减自由的范围。
en: Of course, the logic behind calls to restrict our freedoms has a simplistic appeal: extremists use our freedoms to commit their crimes, so preventing the abuse of freedom requires curtailing freedom’s scope.

zh: 但这种说法的错误在于假定与生活在独裁政权中的人们相比，开放社会的公民更纵容恐怖活动，也更容易遭受恐怖分子的袭击。
en: The mistake, however, is to assume that open societies are more permissive and vulnerable to terrorism than those who live under authoritarian regimes.

zh: 只需要看一看今天的俄国，或者回忆一下20世纪90年代的阿尔及利亚，就知道这样的想法有多么可笑。
en: One need only look at today’s Russia, or recall Algeria in the 1990’s.

zh: 的确，民主和法治提供不了绝对的安全保障。
en: True, democracy and the rule of law provide no foolproof security guarantee.

zh: 但无论如何，这样的保障也只能在海市蜃楼中才能找到，而在对抗恐怖主义时尊重基本自由和既定程序却是孤立极端分子和削弱他们在同道心目中合法性的有力的武器。
en: But such a guarantee is a mirage anyway, whereas respect for basic freedoms and due process when repressing terrorism is a powerful instrument to isolate extremists and diminish their legitimacy in the eyes of those that might identify with their cause.

zh: 正因为英国是个尊重法治的民主国家，它才能够把国内多数的穆斯林人口动员起来，共同对抗恐怖主义。
en: It is because Britain is a democracy that respects the rule of law that it has been able to mobilize vast sectors of its Muslim community.

zh: 与此形成鲜明对照的是，独裁政权对民众的压制以及他们把民众和凶手混为一谈的策略使得政府在很大一部分民众中毫无信誉可言，也为极端分子提供了肥沃的招募土壤。
en: By contrast, authoritarian regimes’ repression of civilians, and their non-differentiation between civilians and killers, provides extremists with fertile recruiting conditions by discrediting the government in the eyes of a significant part of its population.

zh: 不分青红皂白地将伊斯兰政治混为一谈，将抵制暴力和使用暴力者同等对待只会有利于极端分子开展工作，因为这样他们就可以把自己装扮成正义事业的支持者，尽管这根本不是他们的真实目标。
en: An undifferentiated approach towards political Islamism that fails to distinguish between those who reject violence and those who resort to terror only facilitates the extremists’ work, for they emerge as champions of causes that do not reflect their true goals.

zh: 俄国为独裁暴力和轻忽法治政策的不堪一击提供了决定性的证据。
en: Russia provides conclusive evidence of the impotence of authoritarian violence and disregard for the rule of law.

zh: 普京总统在车臣实行了焦土政策，将很多车臣民族主义者直接赶进了极端分子的怀抱。
en: President Vladimir Putin undertook a scorched-earth policy in Chechnya, driving many Chechen nationalists straight into the extremists’ arms.

zh: 针对俄国的恐怖主义袭击既没有停止、也没有减少。
en: Terrorist attacks on Russia did not cease or decline.

zh: 实际上，人们时常回忆起2004年9月发生在别斯兰的恐怖事件，在那次恶梦中，一次针对学校的恐怖袭击就夺去了330多人的生命。
en: Indeed, recall the terrorism in Beslan in September 2004, in which a single attack on a school killed over 330 people.

zh: 伊拉克的局势同样可以证明非法暴力在遏制恐怖活动中的作用非常有限。
en: Iraq also is demonstrating the limits of illegitimate violence when combating terrorism.

zh: 布什政府现在似乎开始明白这一点。
en: The Bush administration now seems to realize this.

zh: 如果认为成千上万平民百姓的死亡、再加上强制监禁和折磨没有为伊拉克境内大肆蔓延的恐怖活动推波助澜，无疑将犯下致命的错误。
en: It would be a mistake to believe that the deaths of thousands of civilians, along with arbitrary imprisonment and torture, do not contribute to the spread of terror in Iraq.

zh: 毕竟，曾经深受其害的人会为恐怖分子招兵买马提供最有力的宣传。
en: After all, torture victims are the best possible advertisement for terrorist recruitment.

zh: 不仅如此，单就对抗恐怖主义而言，民主制度无论从政治还是实际操作角度都更为有效，尤其在情报搜集领域更是如此。
en: When it comes to fighting terrorism, moreover, democracies are more effective both politically and operationally, particularly in terms of their intelligence services.

zh: 独裁国家的情报力量要么高度集权，要么就可能成为权力自治中心。
en: Intelligence forces in authoritarian states are either highly centralized or tend to become autonomous power centers.

zh: 而无论出现上述哪种情况，他们都拒绝接受来自公众的监督，也不对人民负责。
en: In either case, they are subject to no public scrutiny and accountability.

zh: 导致的结果是时间一长，他们就失去了用批判的眼光评估自身行动和错误的能力。
en: As a result, they lose their ability over time to evaluate critically their own actions and errors.

zh: 民主环境中的情报部门通常都设立了监督机制，防止权力被人滥用，并通过对未能完成任务的高官进行惩戒来确保行动的有效性。
en: Intelligence services in democratic contexts usually have oversight mechanisms that serve to limit abuses of power, and to guarantee effective action by punishing top officials that fail to do their jobs properly.

zh: 在美国，由强大的两党参议院委员会直接监督情报部门的工作。
en: In the United States, a powerful bi-partisan Senate committee directly monitors the intelligence services.

zh: 参议院在有关情报部门，特别是中央情报局和联邦调查局，未能阻止2001年9月11日恐怖袭击事件的报告之中还提出了一系列的重组建议，旨在提高情报部门的效率。
en: Its report on the inability of the intelligence services, notably the CIA and the FBI, to prevent the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks also contained a series of recommendations for restructuring these services to render them more effective.

zh: 欧洲对恐怖主义的回应所需的首要也是核心的因素是加强自身的情报力量，以便在尊重基本权利和既定程序的同时，能够发现和解除恐怖分子的武装。
en: Europe’s response to terror requires, first and foremost, strengthening its intelligence services so that they can detect and dismantle terrorist cells while respecting basic rights and due process.

zh: 这还需要所有欧盟成员国以及它们的盟友和伙伴进行更有效的合作。
en: It also requires greater coordination among all the European Union’s member states and their allies and partners.

zh: 与此同时，通过法治途径对抗恐怖主义必须成为欧洲与第三方，特别是地中海各国、或巴基斯坦合作的基石，以此来营造一种有利于民主的安全文化。
en: At the same time, the rule-of-law approach to fighting terrorism must be a pillar of European cooperation with third countries, namely with those of the Mediterranean, or with Pakistan, thereby contributing to a security culture that is conducive to democratization.

zh: 而深化民主又意味着允许全体公民，包括非暴力伊斯兰团体的充分参与。
en: Deepening democracy in turn means allowing full civic participation, including non-violent Islamic groups.

zh: 必须坚决捍��公众言论及和平集会的权利，这既是为了那些自觉被主流社会边缘化的团体，也是为了那些对巴勒斯坦、车臣和伊拉克民众所遭受的不公正待遇而义愤填膺的全体民众和大多数欧洲公民。
en: The right to public speech and peaceful assembly must be defended for those who feel marginalized and indignant at what they – and most Europeans – view as injustices committed against the Palestinians, the Chechens, and the Iraqis.

zh: 此外还有同等重要的最后一点，那就是对抗基于种族身份的极端主义要求把所有居住在欧洲大陆的人团结在一起。
en: Last, but not least, combating identity-based extremism calls for a greater capacity to integrate all those who live within the EU.

zh: 对恐怖主义的回应应当是再次强调法治而不是强力镇压，强调把多样化作为欧洲城市，特别是伦敦、巴黎和越来越多的其它城市的突出特色。
en: The response to terrorism should be to reaffirm the value of the rule of law over arbitrary repression, and of the diversity that is the hallmark of Europe’s cities, particularly London and Paris, but increasingly many others across the Union.

zh: 我们不能¾实际上也不该¾在我们社会的内部和周围竖起围墙，向恐怖主义低头。
en: We cannot – indeed, must not – cede to terror by building walls around and within our societies.

zh: 对于狭隘极端主义的最佳回应是创造一个开放、多元的社会，赋予所有在其境内生活的居民完整的公民待遇。
en: The best response to intolerant extremism is to cultivate an open and pluralistic society that treats all those who live within its borders as full citizens.

zh: 欧洲将多元化变成了其固有的特征载入宪法，这也是它在全世界产生了巨大影响的原因。
en: Europe turned diversity into one of its constitutional traits, and this is why it has had such an impact on the world.

zh: 保护上述精髓是纪念恐怖活动牺牲者的最佳途径，无论曾经的受害者来自伦敦、沙母沙伊赫、马德里、卡萨布兰卡还是纽约。
en: Protecting that essence is the best way to honor the memory of the victims of terror, be they from London, Sharm el-Sheik, Madrid, Casablanca, or New York.

zh: 与"新"恐怖主义斗争
en: Fighting the "New" Terrorism

zh: 随着美国大选日益升温，很多评论家认为美国总统乔治·W·布什的伊拉克战争使反恐形式日益严峻。
en: As the US presidential heats up, critics argue that President George W. Bush's war in Iraq has made the problem of combating terrorism worse.

zh: 上述指责非常严肃，因为世界各国需要更为广泛的反恐策略。
en: It is a serious charge, because the world needs a broader strategy against terrorism.

zh: 恐怖主义不是新话题，也不是什么单一对手，而是一种长期的冲突手段。
en: Terrorism is nothing new, nor is it a single enemy.

zh: 通常情况下，它被定义为故意袭击无辜百姓，目的是传播恐怖情绪。
en: It is a longstanding method of conflict frequently defined as deliberate attack on the innocent with the objective of spreading fear.

zh: 2001年对纽约和华盛顿的袭击就是这种古老现象的骤然升级。
en: The attacks on New York and Washington of 2001 were dramatic escalations of an age-old phenomenon.

zh: 然而今天，恐怖主义与过去已经有了很大区别。
en: Terrorism today, however, is different from what it was in the past.

zh: 现实社会里，大规模杀伤性武器更轻巧、廉价，也更容易得到。
en: Nowadays, instruments of mass destruction are smaller, cheaper, and more readily available.

zh: 手机在去年3月马德里恐怖袭击中被用作定时器，劫机的费用也并不昂贵。
en: Cellular phones were used as timers in the attacks in Madrid last March. Hijacking an airplane is relatively inexpensive.

zh: 最后，信息革命提供了价格低廉的沟通和组织方式，使以前限于本地和本国警力管辖的恐怖组织具备了全球性特征。
en: Finally, the information revolution provides inexpensive means of communication and organization that allow groups once restricted to local and national police jurisdictions to become global.

zh: 据称基地组织在50多个国家设立了恐怖网络。
en: Al Qaeda is said to have established a network in fifty or more countries.

zh: 变化还集中在恐怖组织的动机和组织形式。
en: Changes have also occurred in the motivation and organization of terrorist groups.

zh: 二十世纪中期的恐怖分子一般具有相对明确的政治目的，而大规模屠杀常常是服务于这种目的的卑劣手段。
en: Terrorists in the mid-20th century tended to have relatively well-defined political objectives, which were often ill-served by mass murder. Governments supported many covertly.

zh: 恐怖活动得到政府的暗中支持。
en: Toward the century's end, radical groups grew on the fringes of several religions.

zh: 临近世纪末，极端组织在宗教的边缘开始滋长，数量最大的是数以万计的青年穆斯林，他们曾反抗过苏联对阿富汗的占领，并在那里接受了多种技巧的培训。 很多人被持有极端观点的杰哈德宗教义务组织所吸纳。
en: Most numerous were the tens of thousands of young Muslims who fought against the Soviet occupation of Afghanistan, where they were trained in a wide range of techniques and many were recruited to organizations with an extreme view of the religious obligation of jihad .

zh: 上述技术和意识潮流助长了恐怖主义的毁灭性，也使人们的应对更为困难。
en: These technological and ideological trends increased both the lethality and the difficulty of managing terrorism.

zh: 由于基地组织袭击的规模史无前例，焦点自然集中在了伊斯兰极端主义者身上。
en: Because of the unprecedented scale of Al Qaeda's attacks, the focus is properly on Islamic extremists.

zh: 但仅限于关注伊斯兰恐怖分子是一个错误，因为这会忽略技术给叛乱组织和个人带来的破坏性力量，从前，这样的力量只有政府和军队才能掌握。
en: But it would be a mistake to limit our concern solely to Islamic terrorists, for that would ignore the way that technology is putting into the hands of deviant groups and individuals' destructive capabilities that were once limited primarily to governments and armies.

zh: 只要是人类社会就存在反叛组织和个人，如今他们具备前所未有的力量。
en: Deviant individuals and groups exist in all human societies, and they are now empowered in ways that were once unthinkable.

zh: 比如1995年炸毁俄克拉荷马城联邦大楼的蒂莫西·麦克维和同年在东京地铁站释放沙林毒气的奥姆真理教。
en: Think, for example of Timothy McVeigh, who bombed the federal building in Oklahoma City in 1995, or the Aum Shinrykio cult that released poison gas in the Tokyo subway system the same year.

zh: 20世纪70年代，恐怖活动的破坏性激增。
en: Lethality has been increasing.

zh: 巴勒斯坦恐怖分子在慕尼黑奥运会上袭击以色列运动员和红色旅实施恐怖进攻造成了数十人因此丧生，引起了世界范围的广泛关注。
en: In the 1970's, the Palestinian attack on Israeli athletes at the Munich Olympics and attacks by groups like the Red Brigades galvanized world attention at the cost of dozens of lives.

zh: 20世纪80年代，最可怕的恐怖事件夺去了300多条无辜的生命。
en: In the l980's, the worst terrorist incident killed 300 people.

zh: 2001年9月对美国的袭击中，几千名无辜群众因此丧生。
en: The attacks on America of September 2001 cost several thousand lives.

zh: 所有这些骤然升级的惨剧都没有使用大规模杀伤性武器。
en: This escalation occurred without using weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 如果像人们想象的那样，某些国家的叛乱组织已经拥有了生物或核材料，那么恐怖分子就可能摧毁数以百万计的无辜生命。
en: If one imagines a deviant group in some society gaining access to biological or nuclear materials, it is possible terrorists could destroy millions of lives.

zh: 要想在20世纪杀害这么多人，即便是希特勒或斯大林也需要借助集权政府的力量。
en: To kill so many people in the 20th century, a Hitler or Stalin required the apparatus of a totalitarian government.

zh: 而现在，很容易设想极端组织和个人杀害数以百万计的无辜群众，而无须得到政府的帮助。
en: It is now easy to envisage extremist groups and individuals killing millions without government help

zh: 为了在联合国达成界定恐怖主义的共识，人们付出了艰苦的政治努力。
en: Politics has plagued efforts to agree on a common definition of terrorism at the United Nations.

zh: 有些怀疑论者提出某人眼中的恐怖分子也许是别人眼中的自由战士，因此将镇压恐怖视作全球的公益事业不过是强者试图让弱者放下武器的虚伪借口。
en: Some skeptics argue that one man's terrorist is another man's freedom fighter, and that treating suppression of terrorism as a global public good is thus merely the hypocrisy of the powerful trying to disarm the weak.

zh: 但这绝不是必须的。
en: That need not be the case.

zh: 并非所有争取民族解放的斗争都会演变成对无辜平民的杀戮。
en: Not all struggles for national liberation turn to deliberate killing of innocents.

zh: 故意屠杀非战斗人员（无论是否在战争之中）受到多数主要宗教的谴责，伊斯兰教也不例外。
en: Deliberate killing of non-combatants (in war or not) is condemned by most major religions, including Islam.

zh: 这样的行为无论强弱都无法容忍。
en: Such behavior is unacceptable whether it is carried out by the powerful or the weak.

zh: 尽管任何恐怖主义的界定都在边缘领域渐趋模糊，但其核心界定都非常清晰明了，足以为清除措施提供依据。
en: While any definition of terrorism has problems at the margins, the core of terrorism is clear enough to permit efforts to de-legitimize it.

zh: 实际上，虽然联合国还未就唯一正式定义达成一致，但很多国家都缔结了联合国公约，有义务与恐怖行为进行斗争。
en: Indeed, many countries are parties to UN conventions that commit them to combating aspects of terrorist behavior, even though the UN has not agreed on a single formal definition.

zh: 今天，有些国家为攻击对手而庇护恐怖分子，也可能因为他们国力太弱，无法控制实力强大的组织。
en: Today, some states harbor terrorists in order to attack their enemies or because they are too weak to control powerful groups.

zh: 如果镇压恐怖的战斗以广泛的联盟为基础，专门制止对无辜非战斗人员的袭击，就很有可能获得成功。
en: If a campaign to suppress terrorism is based on broad coalitions that focus on de-legitimizing attacks on innocent non-combatants, it has some prospect of success.

zh: 实际上，2001年后反恐努力的重要经验就是无法避免广泛的国际合作。
en: Indeed, one lesson of the efforts since 2001 is that there is no way to avoid broad cooperation.

zh: 从这个意义上，战争的比喻偏重于强调军事力量，因此��产生误导的作用。
en: In that sense, the metaphor of war - with its emphasis on military force is - misleading.

zh: 战争的比喻出现在2001年恐怖事件后可以理解，但它造成的问题与解决的一样多。
en: The metaphor of war was understandable in the aftermath of the 2001 attacks, but creates as many problems as it solves.

zh: 战争要持续多长时间，与国内公民自由和国外联盟之间有什么联系？
en: How long will the war last and how does it relate to civil liberties and alliances?

zh: 在汉堡、新加坡或底特律，炸弹都不是应对恐怖主义的选择。
en: Bombing is not an option for fighting terrorist cells in Hamburg, Singapore, or Detroit.

zh: 只有进行民间情报的密切交流、加强跨越国境的警察合作、跟踪资金流动、力争掌握前期的货物及人员流向，才有可能面对这样的威胁。
en: Only close civilian cooperation in intelligence sharing, police work across borders, tracing financial flows, and working to pre-clear cargo manifests and passenger lists can cope with such a threat.

zh: 国家间出于自身利益进行合作，但一个国家的军事实力，还有它具备的软性或吸引力量，能对合作力度产生深远的影响。
en: Countries cooperate out of self-interest, but a country's soft or attractive power, not only its military might, affects the degree of cooperation.

zh: 这也是为什么评论家认为布什的伊拉克政策是个错误。
en: That is why critics argue that Bush's policy in Iraq was a mistake.

zh: 它挥霍了美国的软性力量，将注意力从阿富汗和基地组织转移开去，并增加了伊拉克成为恐怖避难所的危险。
en: It squandered American soft power, diverted attention from Afghanistan and Al Qaeda, and created a danger that Iraq may become a haven for terrorists.

zh: 但布什在国内外的批评者也必须意识到，尽管我们过去犯下了错误，如今也必须采取共同的策略，因为恐怖主义还会长久的存在下去。
en: But critics of Bush at home and abroad must also realize that, notwithstanding past mistakes, pursuing a common strategy is essential, because terrorism is here to stay.

zh: 向谣言和虚假誓言开战
en: Fighting Words and False Promises

zh: 几乎五年时间里 ， “ 反恐战争”已经成为了一个导致政策南辕北辙并且弄巧成拙的虚假比喻。
en: For almost five years, the â€œwar on terrorâ€ has proved to be a false metaphor that has led to counterproductive and self-defeating policies.

zh: 一个误导性的修辞得到了一字不差地执行，引发了多个战线的真实战争，包括伊拉克、加沙、黎巴嫩、阿富汗和索马里。
en: A misleading figure of speech has been applied literally to unleash a real war on several fronts, including Iraq, Gaza, Lebanon, Afghanistan, and Somalia.

zh: 数以千计的无辜平民惨遭杀害，令全世界数百万人愤怒不已。
en: Thousands of innocent civilians have been killed, enraging millions around the world.

zh: 然而最近炸毁从伦敦飞往美国的商业飞机的阴谋表明基地组织还没有屈服。
en: Yet al-Qaeda has not been subdued, as was shown by the recent plot to blow up United States-bound commercial flights from London.

zh: 这个阴谋原本可能导致比9/11事件更多的人员伤亡，在英国情报部门的警惕之下流产。
en: That plot, which could have claimed more victims than the 9/11 attacks, was foiled by the vigilance of the British intelligence authorities.

zh: 很明显，这不会是最后一次。
en: Clearly, it wonâ€™t be the last.

zh: 不幸的是，美国公众全盘接受了战争比喻是回应9/11事件的说法。
en: Unfortunately, the American public accepted uncritically the war metaphor as the obvious response to 9/11.

zh: 实际上，即使到现在入侵伊拉克已经被广泛承认是一个错误的时候 ， “ 反恐战争”仍然是美国政策不得不适应的既定框架。
en: Indeed, even now, when it is widely admitted that the invasion of Iraq was a blunder, the â€œwar on terrorâ€ remains the frame into which American policy has to fit.

zh: 大多数民主党政治人士因为担心被贴上防务不力的标签也对之赞成。
en: Most Democratic politicians, too, subscribe to it for fear of being branded as weak on defense.

zh: 但是继续支持反恐战争却无法减弱这场战争弄巧成拙的色彩。
en: But continuing support for the war on terror makes it no less self-defeating.

zh: 战争特有的性质就是伤害无辜平民，针对恐怖分子的战争这一特性表现的更加突出，因为恐怖分子常常行踪诡秘。
en: By its very nature, war creates innocent victims, and this even more likely when it is waged against terrorists, because terrorists tend to keep their whereabouts hidden.

zh: 平民死亡、受伤和蒙羞会引发他们的家庭和社区的愤怒和怨恨，这反过来又会促使他们支持恐怖分子。
en: The deaths, injuries, and humiliation of civilians generate rage and resentment among their families and communities, in turn fueling support for terrorists.

zh: 此外，恐怖主义是一个抽象的概念，包括所有使用恐怖战术的政治运动。
en: Moreover, terrorism is an abstraction that lumps together all political movements that use terrorist tactics.

zh: 基地组织、哈马斯、真主党和逊尼派起义以及伊拉克的马赫迪军队之间存在着巨大的差异，但是布什总统的全球反恐战争阻止我们对此进行区分并分别对待。
en: Al-Qaeda, Hamas, Hezbollah, and the Sunni insurrection and the Mahdi army in Iraq are very different forces, but President George W. Bushâ€™s global war on terror prevents us from differentiating between them and dealing with them accordingly.

zh: 它阻止了我们与伊朗和叙利亚进行急需的谈判，因为它们是支持恐怖集团国家。
en: It inhibits much-needed negotiations with Iran and Syria, because they are states that support terrorist groups.

zh: 同时，正如英国发生的事件所示，对付像基地组织这样的集团最好的方式是优质的情报。
en: At the same time, as the British have shown, groups like al-Qaeda are best dealt with by good intelligence.

zh: 反恐战争强调军事行动仅仅增加了恐怖威胁并使得情报部分的任务更加艰巨。
en: The war on terrorâ€™s emphasis on military action merely increases the terrorist threat and makes the task of the intelligence agencies more difficult.

zh: 本·拉登和扎瓦希里现在仍然逍遥法外，如果我们想要防止如同在英国流产的攻击事件再次发生，我们需要集中力量找到他们。
en: Osama bin Laden and Ayman al-Zawahiri are still at large, and we need to focus on finding them if we are to prevent attacks like the one foiled in England.

zh: 最后，反恐战争在“我们”和“他们”之间打进了一个楔子。 我们是无辜平民；他们是作恶罪犯。
en: Finally, the war on terror drives a wedge between â€œusâ€ and â€œthem.â€ We are innocent victims; they are perpetrators.

zh: 然而，尽管我们好像还没有注意到在此过程中我们也变成了作恶的罪犯，世界上其它大部分人却已经注意到了。 这是一个认知差异，它已经严重削弱了美国的国际信誉和声望。
en: While we seem not to notice that we also become perpetrators in the process, much of the rest of the world does notice â€“ a gap in perception that has severely weakened Americaâ€™s international credibility and standing.

zh: 综合这些因素，可以断定反恐战争不可能获胜。
en: Taken together, these factors ensure that the war on terror cannot be won.

zh: 相反，一场面对看不见的敌人的无休止的战争不仅仅严重损害我们在世界上的权威和声望，而且严重损害我们自己的社会。
en: On the contrary, an endless war waged against an unseen enemy is doing great damage not only to our authority and prestige in the world, but also to our own society.

zh: 它已经导致了危险的行政权力扩张、削弱了我们对普遍人权的坚持，阻止了一个开放社会核心所在的批判过程。
en: It has led to a dangerous extension of executive powers, tarnished our adherence to universal human rights, and inhibited the critical process that is at the heart of an open society.

zh: 它也耗费了大量的钱财。
en: It has also cost a lot of money.

zh: 最重要的是，反恐战争已经将我们的注意力从其它需要美国发挥领袖作用的紧急任务中转移开来，如完成我们在阿富汗正确开展的工作、应对迫在眉睫的全球能源危机、处理核扩散问题。
en: Most importantly, the war on terror has diverted attention from other urgent tasks that require American leadership, such as finishing the job that we correctly began in Afghanistan, addressing the looming global energy crisis, and dealing with nuclear proliferation.

zh: 随着美国影响力的衰退，世界正处于陷入暴力升级的恶性循环的危险境地。
en: With American influence at low ebb, the world is in danger of sliding into a vicious cycle of escalating violence.

zh: 只有我们美国人批判反恐战争是一个错误的说法，我们才能避开这种恶性循环。
en: We can escape it only if we Americans repudiate the war on terror as a false metaphor.

zh: 如果我们坚持现在的路线，局势将会继续恶化。
en: If we persevere on our current course, the situation will continue to deteriorate.

zh: 正在经受考验的不是我们的意志，而是我们对现实的理解。
en: It is not our will that is being tested, but our understanding of reality.

zh: 承认我们面临的困境是我们自己的误解所导致的让人痛苦。
en: It is painful to admit that our predicaments are brought about by our own misconceptions.

zh: 但是不承认这一点，长期来看它注定会让我们更加痛苦。
en: But not admitting it is bound to prove even more painful in the long run.

zh: 一个开放社会的力量在于它有能力承认并改正自己的错误。
en: The strength of an open society lies in its ability to recognize and correct its mistakes.

zh: 这正是我们面临的考验。
en: That is the test that now confronts us.

zh: 菲永能击败勒庞吗？
en: Can Fillon Beat Le Pen?

zh: 剑桥 — — 在星期天进行的法国共和党总统初选中，弗朗索瓦·菲永以赢得67%选票的成绩毫无争议地击败了领跑者阿兰·朱佩。
en: CAMBRIDGE – In the French Republican party’s presidential primary on Sunday, François Fillon soundly defeated frontrunner Alain Juppé, winning close to 67% of the votes.

zh: 仅仅两周前，明显处于劣势的候选人以绝对优势获胜似乎根本不可能。
en: Two weeks ago, a landslide victory for the apparent underdog seemed out of the question.

zh: 人们一直认为曾在雅克·希拉克总统内阁担任波尔多市长及前总理职务的朱佩将在第二轮决选中击败前总统尼古拉斯·萨科齐，也是另一位党内竞争领跑者。
en: It had long been expected that Juppé, the mayor of Bordeaux and a former prime minister under President Jacques Chirac, would beat the other frontrunner, former President Nicolas Sarkozy, in a second-round runoff.

zh: 菲永曾在前总统萨科齐手下担任总理，从首回合开始即以44%的选票处于绝对领先地位。
en: Instead, Fillon, a former prime minister under Sarkozy, emerged from the first round with a commanding lead, winning 44% of the vote.

zh: 结果对萨科齐而言是一种耻辱，萨科齐只赢得了20%多一点的选票，并实际导致自身政治生涯终结。
en: The outcome was a humiliating one for Sarkozy, who received just a little over 20% support, and effectively ended his political career.

zh: 对许多观察家而言，此次投票令人联想起6月的英国退欧公投和美国当选总统唐纳德·特朗普本月早些时候的胜利。
en: For many observers, the vote invoked the specter of June’s Brexit referendum and US President-elect Donald Trump’s victory earlier this month.

zh: 事实证明了显示菲永处于第三且与前两位差距巨大的民调结果错误，部分原因可能是许多投票者似乎是在投票前几天才做出决定的。
en: Opinion polls placing Fillon as a distant third were proven wrong, partly because many voters seem to have made up their minds just days before the vote.

zh: 社交媒体再次被认为发挥了关键的作用。
en: Social media were also credited, again, with playing a key role.

zh: 在投票前的最后一场辩论中，菲永向公众证明自己是朱佩和萨科齐可靠的替代者。
en: In the last debates before the vote, Fillon presented himself as a credible alternative to Juppé and Sarkozy.

zh: 因为现任总统弗朗索瓦·奥朗德的支持率低于5 % — —这创造了法国总统有史以来的最低支持率记录 — — 现在的一个重大问题是将在2017年5月举行的第二轮总统大选中，菲永能否击败极右翼国民阵线领导人马琳·勒庞。
en: With incumbent President François Hollande’s approval ratings below 5% – the lowest ever for a French president – the big question now is whether Fillon can beat far-right National Front leader Marine Le Pen in the second round of the presidential election in May 2017.

zh: 朱佩被外界认为是足够“温和”的候选人，从而在左翼选民内部提供了勒庞的替代者。
en: Juppé was seen as a sufficiently “soft” candidate, who would provide an alternative to Le Pen for left-wing voters.

zh: 而菲永却远比朱佩更偏向右翼，这意味着左翼选民可能很难意识到他和勒庞之间的区别，并可能要求一位中左翼立场候选人加入到选战当中。
en: Fillon, however, is much further to the right than Juppé, which means that left-wing voters might not see much difference between him and Le Pen, and could demand that a center-left third candidate enter the fray.

zh: 竞争者之一是中间派人士埃曼纽尔·马龙，马龙曾表示将会参选但拒绝参加今年1月社会党举办的初选活动。
en: One contender is the centrist Emmanuel Macron, who says he will run but refuses to stand in the Socialist Party primary this January.

zh: 在未能赢得除自身En Marche! 运动以外主要党派支持的情况下，马龙似乎不太可能集齐赢得总统竞选所需的票数（马龙目前仅赢得14%的选民投票 ） 。
en: Without major-party backing beyond his own En Marche! movement, however, Macron is unlikely to be able to muster the support needed to win the presidency (he currently has just 14% support).

zh: 而且，作为奥朗德手下出身银行家并力主改革的经济部长，马龙为勒庞的反精英、反欧洲论提供了理想的目标。
en: And, as a banker-turned-reformist economy minister under Hollande, Macron is an ideal target for Le Pen’s anti-elitist, anti-European rhetoric.

zh: 除马龙外，左翼正竭力推出一位可信的竞选者。
en: Beyond Macron, the left is struggling to put forward a credible candidate.

zh: 奥朗德竞选连任的机会非常小；其忠实总理曼努埃尔·瓦尔斯预计本周将公开宣布参与竞选，但其民调结果仅略高于奥朗德徘徊在9 % 。
en: Holland’s reelection chances are dismal; his loyal prime minister, Manuel Valls, is expected to announce his own candidacy this week, but is polling only marginally better than Hollande, at 9%.

zh: 此外只剩下极左翼候选人让·吕克·梅朗雄（支持率13 % ） 和表面光鲜但优柔寡断的蒙特布赫，后者曾担任马龙的前任经济部长。
en: That leaves only the far-left Jean-Luc Mélenchon (13%) and the photogenic but waffling Arnaud Montebourg, whom Macron succeeded as economy minister.

zh: 如果没有左翼候选人进入第二轮，左翼选民有可能像2002年曾经发生的那样将票投给“共和党统一联盟 ” ， 当时他们曾拱手送给希拉克一次对勒庞父亲让-马里·勒庞的大胜。
en: If no leftist candidate makes it to the second round, voters on the left could cast their votes for “Republican unity,” as they did in 2002, when they handed Chirac a landslide victory over Le Pen’s father, Jean-Marie Le Pen.

zh: 左翼选民或许更偏爱朱佩，也有可能容忍菲永，但他们仅占共和党初选首轮总票数的15 % ， 因此对2017年总统竞选的影响力可能远不及2002年那样大。
en: Leftist voters would have preferred Juppé, and will likely tolerate Fillon, but they comprised only 15% of total voters in the first round of the Republican primary, so they may not have the same impact in 2017 as they did in 2002.

zh: 菲永的政治基础主要是外省退休的天主教民众，他们在两轮初选中几乎倾巢而出。
en: Fillon’s political base is dominated by provincial, retired Catholic men, who turned out in force for both rounds of the primaries.

zh: 菲永的支持者似乎一致反对同性恋婚姻，而自称天主教徒的菲永是迄今为止本次大选中社会观念最保守的候选人。
en: Fillon’s supporters seem to be united in their opposition to gay marriage, and Fillon, as an avowed Catholic, was the most socially conservative candidate on offer.

zh: 虽然菲永并不打算剥夺同性恋夫妇结婚的法定权利，但却对授予他们收养子女的权利持反对态度。
en: While Fillon does not want to revoke same-sex couples’ legal right to marry, he opposes granting them the right to adopt children.

zh: 从地域上看，菲永几乎在除朱佩波尔多大本营以外的所有地区获胜，包括地中海南部的普罗旺斯-阿尔卑斯-蓝色海岸（PACA ） ， 该地区原本是萨科奇的坚定支持者。
en: Geographically, Fillon won almost everywhere outside of Juppé’s Bordeaux bastion, including the southern Mediterranean Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur (PACA) region, which was originally Sarkozy’s strongest base of support.

zh: 但普罗旺斯-阿尔卑斯-蓝色海岸同时也是国民阵线的据点，这意味着菲永必须将自己与同为右翼候选人的勒庞加以区分，以免选民认定他是勒庞的翻版而不愿给他投票。
en: But PACA is also the National Front’s stronghold, which means that Fillon will have to distinguish himself from Le Pen as a right-wing candidate, lest voters decide they would prefer the original to the copy.

zh: 菲永在若干领域和勒庞确有不同。
en: There are a few areas where Fillon and Le Pen differ.

zh: 首先，勒庞的副手之一菲利波是位公开的同性恋，而且勒庞一直对在社会问题上表达强硬立场持谨慎态度。
en: For starters, Florian Philippot, one of Le Pen’s deputies, is openly gay, and Le Pen has been careful not to take a strong position on social issues.

zh: 菲永也是一位经济自由主义者 — — 常常被称为法国的玛格丽特·撒切尔 — — 而勒庞则是位保护主义者。
en: Fillon is also an economic liberal – and is often characterized as a French Margaret Thatcher – whereas Le Pen is a protectionist.

zh: 而且菲永想要将法国公务员队伍减少500,000人，而勒庞则倾向于保留强大的政府。
en: And while Fillon wants to reduce the French civil service by 500,000, Le Pen favors a strong state.

zh: 最后，勒庞反对法国加入欧盟并希望法郎回归，而菲永则更愿意将权力下放给国民议会。
en: Finally, Le Pen opposes France’s membership in the European Union and wants to return to the franc, while Fillon would prefer to delegate power back to national assemblies.

zh: 菲永可能在亲欧平台上参与竞选，他在第二轮辩论期间赞成成立欧元区政府的核心观点就是证明。
en: Heading into the election campaign, Fillon may run on a pro-European platform, as evidenced by his pivot during the second-round debates, when he suggested that he favors forming a eurozone government.

zh: 不同于特朗普和英国的脱欧运动，国民阵线已经拥有了占选民总数约1/4的可以预见的核心选民。
en: Unlike Trump and the United Kingdom’s “Leave” campaign, the National Front already has a predictable core constituency, amounting to about one-quarter of the electorate.

zh: 由国民阵线古老的法国极右翼势力和愤愤不平的工薪阶层选民组成的联盟像美英两国那样出人意料地不期而至将不太可能。
en: Its coalition of the old French far right and disaffected working-class voters will not arrive unannounced or defy expectations, as happened in the US and the UK.

zh: 鉴于约8%的初选投票者自我描述为国民阵线的支持者，菲永或许可以得到与勒庞同等水平的支持，甚至可以从勒庞那里夺走选票。
en: Fillon, for his part, can probably muster the same level of support, and he may even be able to skim votes from Le Pen, given that around 8% of primary voters described themselves as National Front backers.

zh: 此外，政治天主教仍然吸引众多法国选民，而教会本身则希望诱使天主教民众远离国民阵线，回到更为传统的保守主义群体当中。
en: What’s more, political Catholicism still appeals to many French voters, and the Church itself wants to lure Catholics away from the National Front and back into its more traditionally conservative fold.

zh: 不仅如此，有几家极右翼组织支持菲永在初选期间的竞选资格，因为他对旨在禁止布基尼（即穆斯林女性穿着的全身泳衣）的立法持坚定的支持态度。
en: Meanwhile, a number of far-right organizations supported Fillon’s candidacy during the primaries, owing to his strong support for laws that would ban the burkini, a full-body bathing suit worn by Muslim women.

zh: 考虑到目前的政治形势，菲永在明年5月举行的第二轮总统选举中将极有可能遭遇勒庞。
en: Given the current political field, Fillon will most likely face Le Pen in the presidential election’s second round next May.

zh: 菲永获胜后的民调显示其支持率为26 % ， 而勒庞则拥有24%被调查者的支持。
en: Polling after Fillon’s victory put his support at 26%, with Le Pen backed by 24% of respondents.

zh: 但外界预测菲永将以67%的选票在第二轮中获胜。
en: Fillon, however, is projected to win the second round with 67% of the vote.

zh: 以前也曾出现过类似的情况，而第二轮预测的前提是“共和党统一 ” ， 而实际情况也许并不是那样。
en: We have been here before, and that second-round projection is based on “Republican unity,” which might not hold.

zh: 左翼选民囿于菲永的自由经济和保守社会主张可能放弃投票。
en: Left-wing voters, put off by Fillon’s liberal economics and social conservatism, might stay home.

zh: 鉴于今年其他地方民调专家的大规模预测失利，在计票完成之前人们不应过于相信这些民调专家的主张。
en: Given pollsters’ massive predictive failures elsewhere this year, no one should count on them to turn out until the votes themselves are counted.

zh: 关于长期停滞的最后一点想法
en: Final Thoughts on Secular Stagnation

zh: 坎布里奇—约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz ） 、 罗杰·法尔莫（Roger Farmer）和我现在是、并且早就已经在什么才是最重要的要点方面达成了一致。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Joseph Stiglitz, Roger Farmer, and I are now and have long been in agreement on what are probably the most important points.

zh: 认为商业周期来自工资和价格的暂时性僵化的“新凯恩斯”范式，并不足以解释大萧条和大衰退这样的事件。
en: The “New Keynesian” paradigm that sees business cycles as arising from temporary rigidities in wages and prices is insufficient to account for events like the Great Depression and the Great Recession.

zh: 十年前的金融危机后，我们在刺激总需求方面做得远远不够。
en: Too little was done in the aftermath of the financial crisis a decade ago to stimulate aggregate demand.

zh: 更加平等的收入分配有助于提高总需求。
en: A more equal income distribution operates to increase aggregate demand.

zh: 应该采取较2008年之前显著更强的金融监管以实现未来危机风险最小化。
en: Substantially stronger financial regulation than was in place before 2008 needs to be adopted to minimize the risks of future crises.

zh: 我一直就政策建议记录问题与斯蒂格利茨存在分歧，就长期停滞的相关理论的一些方面与斯蒂格利茨和法尔莫都存在分歧。
en: I continue to have disagreements with Stiglitz on the record of policy advice, and with both Stiglitz and Farmer on some points of theory regarding secular stagnation.

zh: 先说政策记录。 斯蒂格利茨正确地认为，不必指望经济学家就政治可行性问题达成一致。
en: Starting with the policy record, Stiglitz is right to assert that economists should not be expected to agree on issues of political feasibility.

zh: 但他们应该能够就白纸黑字说了什么达成一致。
en: They should, however, be able to agree on what texts say.

zh: 斯蒂格利茨自豪地引用《纽约时报》的评论，说他呼吁采取“两年内至少6,000到10,000亿美元”的刺激。
en: The New York Times commentary that Stiglitz proudly cites calls for a stimulus of “at least $600 billion to $1 trillion over two years.”

zh: 奥巴马政府要求并得到了总额大约8,000亿美元的刺激计划，正好在斯蒂格利茨的范围之内，尽管受到国会批准的政治阻挠。
en: The Obama administration called for and received stimulus totaling some $800 billion, a figure well within Stiglitz’s range, despite being politically constrained by the necessity of Congressional approval.

zh: 因此我不确定他到底想说什么。
en: So I’m not sure what he is claiming.

zh: 斯蒂格利茨说，房利美（Fannie Mae）请他在2002年写的研究只说了房里内当时的贷款操作是安全的。
en: Stiglitz asserts that the study Fannie Mae hired him to write in 2002 said only that its lending practices at that time were safe.
