en: The last thing that Europe needs is another sudden reversal, as we saw at the height of the Greek debt crisis.

zh: 就英国而言，今年经常账户赤字将超过国内生产总值的3 % ， 接近十年前的三倍左右。
en: The United Kingdom, for its part, will have a current-account deficit above 3% of GDP this year, which is nearly three times what it was ten years ago.

zh: 但这并不是说英国的贸易平衡严重恶化。
en: But that is not to say that the UK’s trade balance has significantly deteriorated.

zh: 相反，它反映出英国是一个重要金融中心，并且英国的投资回报比其他国家变化更多。
en: Rather, it reflects the fact that the UK is a major financial center, and that investment returns have shifted more in the UK than elsewhere.

zh: 总而言之，今天的全球经济比十年前健康得多。
en: All told, the global economy today is much healthier than it was ten years ago.

zh: 许多人对危机以来实际全球GDP增长与过去十年相比表现不佳颇感失望。
en: Many are disappointed that real global GDP growth since the crisis has undershot performance in the previous decade.

zh: 但2009年来 — — 那也是经济衰退最糟糕的年份 — — 全球经济平均增长率为3.3 % ， 与20世纪80年代和90年代大致相同。
en: But since 2009 – the worst year of the recession – the global economy has grown at an average rate of 3.3%, just as it did in the 1980s and 1990s.

zh: 当然，这在很大程度上归功于中国，中国是十年来满足我增长预期的唯一一个金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国 ） （ 尽管印度相差也不是太多 ） 。
en: Of course, this is largely owing to China, the only BRIC country (Brazil, Russia, India, and China) that has met my growth expectations for the decade (although India is not too far behind).

zh: 2007年来，中国经济体量增长超过三倍，其国内生产总值从3.5万亿美元增长到约12万亿美元左右。
en: The size of China’s economy has more than trebled in nominal terms since 2007, with GDP rising from $3.5 trillion to around $12 trillion.

zh: 结果是金砖经济体的经济总量现在约为18万亿美元，这一数字超过了欧盟，几乎和美国一样大。
en: As a result, the aggregate size of the BRIC economies is now around $18 trillion, which is larger than the European Union and almost as big as the US.

zh: 再一次出现金融泡沫不可避免，因此，我们应当思考下一次泡沫可能在哪里发生。
en: There will inevitably be another financial bubble, so it is worth asking where it might occur.

zh: 我认为不太可能直接从银行业出现，因为银行业现在的管制非常严格。
en: In my view, it is unlikely to emerge directly from the banking sector, which is now heavily regulated.

zh: 最大的问题是不同行业的许多领先企业继续过度关注季报利润，因为这直接决定了管理人员的薪酬。
en: The bigger concern is that many leading companies across different industries have continued to focus excessively on quarterly profits, because that determines how executives are remunerated.

zh: 决策者应当认真审视这一过程中股票回购的作用。
en: Policymakers should take a hard look at the role of share buybacks in this process.

zh: 据信，在保守党2017年选举宣言中，英国首相特雷莎·梅公开宣布她的政府将会这样做。
en: To her credit, in the Conservative Party’s 2017 election manifesto, British Prime Minister Theresa May announced that her government would do this.

zh: 我们希望梅政府能够兑现承诺。
en: One hopes that May’s government follows through.

zh: 这样做会象征性地打击后危机经济生活当中的潜在隐患。
en: Doing so could strike a symbolic blow against the underlying malaise of post-crisis economic life.

zh: 西方不需要更多经济上不合理的利润，而需要真正的投资和更高的生产率及工资增长。
en: The West needs real investments and higher productivity and wage growth – not more economically unjustifiable profits.

zh: 金融早期预警系统
en: A Financial Early-Warning System

zh: 纽约—最近的市场波动 — — 新兴市场和发达经济体都一样 — — 再一次证明，评级机构和投资者在评估各国经济和金融脆弱性时会犯下极其严重的错误。
en: NEW YORK – Recent market volatility – in emerging and developed economies alike – is showing once again how badly ratings agencies and investors can err in assessing countries’ economic and financial vulnerabilities.

zh: 评级机构需要太长的时间认识风险、调降国家评级，而投资者的行为就像是羊群，常常在太长的时间里忽视风险的累积，然后突然转变方向，导致市场波动放大。
en: Ratings agencies wait too long to spot risks and downgrade countries, while investors behave like herds, often ignoring the build-up of risk for too long, before shifting gears abruptly and causing exaggerated market swings.

zh: 从市场动荡的性质看，金融海啸早期预警系统也许很难构建；但如今世界比任何其他时候都更加需要这样一套系统。
en: Given the nature of market turmoil, an early-warning system for financial tsunamis may be difficult to create; but the world needs one today more than ever.

zh: 几乎没有人预见到2008年的次贷危机、欧元区违约风险和当前全球金融市场动荡。
en: Few people foresaw the subprime crisis of 2008, the risk of default in the eurozone, or the current turbulence in financial markets worldwide.

zh: 指责之声纷纷指向政客、银行和超国家机构。
en: Fingers have been pointed at politicians, banks, and supranational institutions.

zh: 但错判债务人（包括政府）偿还能力的评级机构和分析师的责任却被一笔带过。
en: But ratings agencies and analysts who misjudged the repayment ability of debtors – including governments – have gotten off too lightly.

zh: 理论上，评级机构基于过去违约的统计模型；但是，在实践中，国家违约的情况十分罕见，主权评级常常是基于主观做出的。
en: In principle, credit ratings are based on statistical models of past defaults; in practice, however, with few national defaults having actually occurred, sovereign ratings are often a subjective affair.

zh: 评级机构的分析师追踪他们所负责的国家的发展趋势，必要时到相应的国家去看看情况如何。
en: Analysts at ratings agencies follow developments in the country for which they are responsible and, when necessary, travel there to review the situation.

zh: 这一过程意味着评级往往是后瞻的，降级总是来得太晚，而国家获得评级通常取决于分析师何时到访，而不是基本面何时改变。
en: This process means that ratings are often backward-looking, downgrades occur too late, and countries are typically rerated based on when analysts visit, rather than when fundamentals change.

zh: 此外，评级机构缺少连贯追踪重要因素的工具，如社会凝聚力变化、国家创新能力、私人部门资产负债表风险等。
en: Moreover, ratings agencies lack the tools to track consistently vital factors such as changes in social inclusion, the country’s ability to innovate, and private-sector balance-sheet risk.

zh: 但主权评级影响甚大。
en: And yet sovereign ratings matter tremendously.

zh: 对许多投资者来说，信用评级决定了投资在哪里、投资多少。
en: For many investors, credit ratings dictate where and how much they can invest.

zh: 评级影响银行愿意贷款多少，以及发展中国家（及其公民）必须获得多大的代价才能借到钱。
en: Ratings affect how much banks are willing to lend, and how much developing countries – and their citizens – must pay to borrow.

zh: 它们决定着公司和谁做生意，开出什么条件。
en: They inform corporations’ decisions regarding whom to do business with, and on what terms.

zh: 由于评级机构的这些问题，投资者和监管者认识到需要采取不同的方法。
en: Given the problems with ratings agencies, investors and regulators recognize the need for a different approach.

zh: 投资者试图寻找好的替代品 — — 基本以失败告终。
en: Investors have tried to identify good alternatives – and have largely failed.

zh: 主权利差和信用违约互换等风险评估手段反应（常常过度反应）迅速；但是，由于它们仅仅反映了市场对风险的理解，因此并非揭示隐藏风险和避免危机的系统性机制。
en: Assessments of risk such as sovereign interest-rate spreads and credit default swaps react (and often over-react) fast; but, because they reflect only the market’s understanding of risk, they are not a systematic mechanism for uncovering hidden risks and avoiding crises.

zh: 事实上，最近市场波动性猛然上升表明它们在侦测早期麻烦预警信号方面和评级机构一样糟糕。
en: Indeed, the recent sudden rise in market volatility suggests that they are as bad as rating agencies at detecting the early warning signs of trouble.

zh: 与此同时，监管者现在开始要求银行开发自身的内部评级程序。
en: Regulators, meanwhile, are now starting to require banks to develop their own internal ratings processes.

zh: 问题在于只有极少数机构拥有独力完成这项任务的工具和知识。
en: The problem is that few institutions have the tools and expertise to do this alone.

zh: 全面评估一国的宏观投资风险需要系统性地研究国民账户的存量和流量，捕捉所有危险情况，包括金融系统和实体经济的风险以及更广泛的风险问题。
en: A comprehensive assessment of a country’s macro investment risk requires looking systematically at the stocks and flows of the national account to capture all dangers, including risk in the financial system and the real economy, as well as wider risk issues.

zh: 我们在最近的危机中看到，危机发生时，私人冒险行为和债务就会社会化。
en: As we have seen in recent crises, private risk taking and debt are socialized when a crisis occurs.

zh: 因此，即使危机前公共赤字和债务很低，也可能在危机爆发后急剧升高。
en: So, even when public deficits and debt are low before a crisis, they can rise sharply after one erupts.

zh: 财政状况看上去十分可靠的政府可能一夜之间变得资不抵债。
en: Governments that looked fiscally sound suddenly appear insolvent.

zh: 我们使用200个量化变量和因素，为174个国家进行季度评分，发现对于很多国家，投资者们正在错过风险和机会。
en: Using 200 quantitative variables and factors to score 174 countries on a quarterly basis, we have identified a number of countries where investors are missing risks – and opportunities.

zh: 中国是很好的例子。
en: China is a perfect example.

zh: 中国住房��发商、地方政府和国有企业都有严重的过度负债问题。
en: The country’s home developers, local governments, and state-owned enterprises are severely over-indebted.

zh: 中国有强大的资产负债表，足以救助它们，但当局因此面临一个选择：采取改革，或再次依靠杠杆刺激经济。
en: China has the balance-sheet strength to bail them out, but the authorities would then face a choice: embrace reform or rely once again on leverage to stimulate the economy.

zh: 即使中国继续选择后者，也无法实现增长目标，并且会随着时间的推移而日益脆弱弱。
en: Even if China continues on the latter course, it will fail to achieve its growth targets and will look more fragile over time.

zh: 巴西在去年就应该被降级到投资级以下，因为巴西经济存在不断扩大的财政赤字、日益增加的总体经济债务负担，以及疲软且不断恶化的商业环境。
en: Brazil should have been downgraded below investment grade last year, as the economy struggled with a widening fiscal deficit, a growing economy-wide debt burden, and a weak and worsening business environment.

zh: 能源巨头巴西石油公司（Petrobras）的腐败丑闻最终导致评级机构重新评估巴西，但这一动作来得太迟了，并且降级幅度也许也不足以反映真正的风险。
en: The corruption scandal at energy giant Petrobras is finally causing ratings agencies to reassess Brazil, but the move comes too late, and their downgrades probably will not be sufficient to reflect the true risk.

zh: 其他新兴市场看上去也十分脆弱，有可能遭遇降级。
en: Other emerging markets also look fragile and at risk of an eventual downgrade.

zh: 在欧元区，影子评级在2010年之前便给希腊和其他外围国亮起了红灯。
en: In the eurozone, shadow ratings already signaled red flags in the late 2000s in Greece and the other countries of the periphery.

zh: 后来，爱尔兰和西班牙进行了财政整合和改革，也许应该获得升级。
en: More recently, Ireland and Spain may deserve to be upgraded, following fiscal consolidation and reforms.

zh: 但是，希腊毫无改善迹象。
en: Greece, however, remains a basket case.

zh: 即使采取了重大改革刺激增长潜力，希腊仍无法偿还期主权债务，需要大规模债务纾困。
en: Even with substantial reform to improve its growth potential, Greece will never be able to repay its sovereign debt and needs substantial relief.

zh: 系统性、以数据为基础的主权风险评估有助于发现全球不利因素改变所隐含的风险。
en: An assessment of sovereign risk that is systematic and data-driven could help to spot the risks that changing global headwinds imply.

zh: 从这个角度讲，它提供了世界现在所需要的：让人们不再需要依靠临时性的、变化缓慢的评级机构方法以及充满噪声和波动的来自市场的信号的方法。
en: To that extent, it provides exactly what the world needs now: an approach that removes the need to rely on the ad hoc and slow-moving approach of ratings agencies and the noisy and volatile signals coming from markets.

zh: 金融伪善
en: Financial Hypocrisy

zh: 今年是亚洲金融危机十周年。 这场危机于1997年7月2日从泰国发端，分别于10月份和12月份蔓延到印尼和韩国。
en: This year marks the tenth anniversary of the East Asia crisis, which began in Thailand on July 2, 1997, and spread to Indonesia in October and to Korea in December.

zh: 最终成为全球金融危机，俄国和拉美国家，例如巴西卷入其中，并且释放出了在随后几年中显现出来的力量。 2001年的阿根廷可以被算做是受害者之一。
en: Eventually, it became a global financial crisis, embroiling Russia and Latin American countries, such as Brazil, and unleashing forces that played out over the ensuing years: Argentina in 2001 may be counted as among its victims.

zh: 还有许多无辜的受害者，包括那些没有参与是危机根源的国际资本流动的国家。
en: There were many other innocent victims, including countries that had not even engaged in the international capital flows that were at the root of the crisis.

zh: 实际上，老挝成为受到打击最为严重的国家。
en: Indeed, Laos was among the worst-affected countries.

zh: 尽管所有的危机最终都会结束，当时没有人知道随之而来的衰退和萧条的范围会有大，程度会有多深，历时会有多长。
en: Though every crisis eventually ends, no one knew at the time how broad, deep, and long the ensuing recessions and depressions would be.

zh: 这是从大萧条以来最严重的全球危机。
en: It was the worst global crisis since the Great Depression.

zh: 作为世界银行的首席经济学家和高级副总裁，我亲身经历了这一危机以及有关这一危机根源和适当的政策对策的辩论。
en: As the World Bank’s chief economist and senior vice president, I was in the middle of the conflagration and the debates about its causes and the appropriate policy responses.

zh: 今年夏天和秋天，我再度访问了许多受到危机影响的国家。
en: This summer and fall, I revisited many of the affected countries, including Malaysia, Laos, Thailand, and Indonesia.

zh: 这些国家现在的经济增长速度是5%和6 % ， 甚至更快。
en: It is heartwarming to see their recovery.

zh: 尽管不是在亚洲经济奇迹的年代那么快，但是也要比危机后人们认为可能的要快很多。
en: These countries are now growing at 5% or 6% or more – not quite as fast as in the days of the East Asia miracle, but far more rapidly than many thought possible in the aftermath of the crisis.

zh: 许多国家改变了政策，但是改变的方向与国际货币基金组织所敦促的大为不同。
en: Many countries changed their policies, but in directions markedly different from the reforms that the IMF had urged.

zh: 当工资锐减和失业率上升的时候，穷人承受了危机中最大的负担。
en: The poor were among those who bore the biggest burden of the crisis, as wages plummeted and unemployment soared.

zh: 在各国崛起得时候，许多都新近强调“和谐 ” ， 以便解决贫富之间和城乡之间不断拉大的差别。
en: As countries emerged, many placed a new emphasis on “harmony,” in an effort to redress the growing divide between rich and poor, urban and rural.

zh: 它们更为重视对人力的投资，实行了创新性的项目来为本国人们带来医疗和信贷，并且建立社会基金来帮助发展地方社区。
en: They gave greater weight to investments in people, launching innovative initiatives to bring health care and access to finance to more of their citizens, and creating social funds to help develop local communities.

zh: 十年之后回首这一危机，我们可以更为清晰地看到国际货币基金组织和美国财政部的判断、处方以及预测是多么错误。
en: Looking back at the crisis a decade later, we can see more clearly how wrong the diagnosis, prescription, and prognosis of the IMF and United States Treasury were.

zh: 根本问题是过早地开放资本市场。
en: The fundamental problem was premature capital market liberalization.

zh: 因此，我们具有讽刺意味地看到美国财政部长再次敦促印度开放资本市场。 印度和中国是从1997年金融危机中从容脱身的两大发展中国家。
en: It is therefore ironic to see the US Treasury Secretary once again pushing for capital market liberalization in India – one of the two major developing countries (along with China) to emerge unscathed from the 1997 crisis.

zh: 没有完全开放资本市场的国家表现优异并不足为奇。
en: It is no accident that these countries that had not fully liberalized their capital markets have done so well.

zh: 国际货币基金组织随后的研究已经确认了每个严肃认真的研究所表明的东西，那就是资本市场开放带来不稳定，而不一定是增长。
en: Subsequent research by the IMF has confirmed what every serious study had shown: capital market liberalization brings instability, but not necessarily growth.

zh: 由于同样的原因，中国和印度是增长最快的经济体。
en: (India and China have, by the same token, been the fastest-growing economies.)

zh: 当然，华尔街(美国财政部代表了华尔街的利益)从资本市场开放中获益。 当资本流入流出并且在随后混乱中的重组的时候，华尔街从中受益。
en: Of course, Wall Street (whose interests the US Treasury represents) profits from capital market liberalization: they make money as capital flows in, as it flows out, and in the restructuring that occurs in the resulting havoc.

zh: 韩国人自己在过去四十年中管理经济出色，具有更高的经济增长和更大的稳定，也没有美国金融市场如此频繁的丑闻。 尽管如此，国际货币基金组织还是敦促其将银行出售给美国的投资者。
en: In South Korea, the IMF urged the sale of the country’s banks to American investors, even though Koreans had managed their own economy impressively for four decades, with higher growth, more stability, and without the systemic scandals that have marked US financial markets with such frequency.

zh: 在某些情况中，美国公司购买银行，在韩国复苏之前一直持有这些银行，随后创新出售它们，从中赚取几十亿美元的利润。
en: In some cases, US firms bought the banks, held on to them until Korea recovered, and then resold them, reaping billions in capital gains.

zh: 国际货币基金组织仓促地让西方人购买银行，却忘记了一个细节，那就是确保韩国可以通过税收重新获取至少些许收益。
en: In its rush to have westerners buy the banks, the IMF forgot one detail: to ensure that South Korea could recapture at least a fraction of those gains through taxation.

zh: 美国投资者在新兴市场的银行业是否具有更大的专长或许值得讨论，但是他们在避税方面具有更大的专长则是无须讨论的。
en: Whether US investors had greater expertise in banking in emerging markets may be debatable; that they had greater expertise in tax avoidance is not.

zh: 国际货币基金组织和美国财政部给东亚国家的建议和当前次级房贷危机的形成鲜明的对照。
en: The contrast between the IMF/US Treasury advice to East Asia and what has happened in the current sub-prime debacle is glaring.

zh: 它们告诉东亚国家要提高利率，在某些情况下达到25 % 、 40%甚至更高，造成一大片拖欠。
en: East Asian countries were told to raise their interest rates, in some cases to 25%, 40%, or higher, causing a rash of defaults.

zh: 在当前的危机中，美联储和欧洲央行则在降息。
en: In the current crisis, the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank cut interest rates.

zh: 同样地，卷入金融危机的国家被教训说要更加透明和更好地管理。
en: Similarly, the countries caught up in the East Asia crisis were lectured on the need for greater transparency and better regulation.

zh: 但是透明度的缺乏在今年夏天的信贷紧缩中发挥了重要的作用；毒性的房屋贷款被重组，扩散到全球，和更好的产品一起包装起来，然后以抵押的形式隐藏起来，因此没人确切知道谁持有什么东西。
en: But lack of transparency played a central role in this past summer’s credit crunch; toxic mortgages were sliced and diced, spread around the world, packaged with better products, and hidden away as collateral, so no one could be sure who was holding what.

zh: 现在又有很多人异口同声地反对新的管理条例。 人们认为这些条例将会可能阻碍金融市场(包括盘剥信息不灵的借贷者，这是问题的根源 ) 。
en: And there is now a chorus of caution about new regulations, which supposedly might hamper financial markets (including their exploitation of uninformed borrowers, which lay at the root of the problem.)

zh: 最后，尽管对道德危险发出了警告，西方银行则部分地被从糟糕的投资中拯救出来。
en: Finally, despite all the warnings about moral hazard, Western banks have been partly bailed out of their bad investments.

zh: 1997年危机以后人们形成了共识，就是需要对全球金融建筑结构进行根本性的改革。
en: Following the 1997 crisis, there was a consensus that fundamental reform of the global financial architecture were needed.

zh: 但是，当前的体系或许会导致不必要的不稳定并给发展中国家造成巨大的代价，它还是很好地满足了某些利益。
en: But, while the current system may lead to unnecessary instability, and impose huge costs on developing countries, it serves some interests well.

zh: 因此，十年以后还是没有根本性的改革也就不足为奇了。
en: It is not surprising, then, that ten years later, there has been no fundamental reform.

zh: 全世界再一次面临全球金融不稳定，世界经济前景不明朗同样也不足为奇了。
en: Nor, therefore, is it surprising that the world is once again facing a period of global financial instability, with uncertain outcomes for the world’s economies.

zh: 银行家的革命
en: A Banker’s Revolution

zh: 吉隆坡—一般认为，金融监管者对于变化采取克制慎重的态度。
en: KUALA LUMPUR – Financial regulators are generally known for taking a measured and cautious approach to change.

zh: 但在发达世界，这一名声正在发生颠覆。
en: But in the developing world, that reputation is being turned upside down.

zh: 在一些世界上最贫困的国家，央行官员愿意采取果断措施 — — 为了加大在正式金融体系中的参与、增加金融稳定以及让国家走上包容的可持续经济增长之路，他们实施了创新方针。
en: In some of the world’s poorest countries, central bankers have proved willing to make bold decisions – embracing innovative approaches in their quest to broaden participation in the formal financial system, increase financial stability, and put their countries on the path to inclusive, sustainable economic growth.

zh: 增加金融包容性需要从根本上反思一国的金融体系是如何构造和运行的。
en: Increasing financial inclusion requires fundamentally rethinking how a country’s financial system is structured and operates.

zh: 此外，通常还必须用到传统央行工具箱之外的工具。
en: It also frequently necessitates the use of instruments outside of the central bankers’ traditional toolkit.

zh: 比如，在肯尼亚，官员改变监管框架以便利移动资金（mobile money）的增长。
en: In Kenya, for instance, officials altered the regulatory framework to allow for the growth of mobile money.

zh: 在马来西亚，央行在提高公共金融知识水平方面起着领导作用。
en: In Malaysia, the central bank took a lead role in raising the public’s level of financial literacy.

zh: 在菲律宾，菲律宾央行将消费者能够获得金融服务的接入点数量扩大了一倍，支持517家微银行开张，其中许多开在没有传统银行网点的行政区。
en: And in the Philippines, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas helped double the number of access points where consumers could obtain financial services, supporting the opening of 517 micro-banking offices, many of them in municipalities with no traditional bank branches.

zh: 类似地，2011年，坦桑尼亚银行根据金融包容联盟（Alliance for Financial Inclusion）的玛雅宣言，做出了增加金融包容性的具体承诺。 玛雅宣言是发展中国家决策者解放穷人社会和经济潜力的承诺。
en: Likewise, in 2011, the Bank of Tanzania made a specific commitment to increase financial inclusion under the Alliance for Financial Inclusion’s Maya Declaration, a commitment by policymakers in the developing world to unlock the social and economic potential of the poor.

zh: 结果是造成了巨大的、大大超过的预期。
en: The result was dramatic and vastly exceeded expectations.

zh: 坦桑尼亚提前一年实现了其为50%成年公民提供银行服务的目标，该国也成为数字金融服务的全球领先者。
en: Tanzania reached its goal of providing 50% of its adult citizens with access to banking a year ahead of schedule, making the country a global leader in digital financial services.

zh: 在其邻国肯尼亚，局面改变因素是移动资金的广泛使用。
en: As in neighboring Kenya, the game changer was the widespread adoption of mobile money.

zh: “听起来也许有点不可思议 ， ” 肯尼亚央行行长尼杜杜（Benno Ndulu）说 ， “ 但我们必须让创新走在监管之前。
en: “It may sound maverick,” said Benno Ndulu, the bank’s governor. “But we must let innovation run ahead of regulation.”

zh: 在电子货币方面，东非可谓开路先锋，而世界的另一端正在采取不同的创新方针。
en: While East Africa is blazing the trail when it comes to electronic money, other parts of the world are adopting different innovative approaches.

zh: 去年，哥伦比亚议会通过了一项法律，成立一种新类型的金融机构 — — 电子存款和支付专门局（Specialized Electronic Deposit and Payment Institution ） 。
en: Last year in Colombia, Congress passed a law creating a new type of financial institution called a Specialized Electronic Deposit and Payment Institution.

zh: 在技术上，它们不是银行，但这些机构能够通过移动电话或在邮局等特许场所接受客户的电子存款和支付。
en: While not technically banks, these institutions are able to accept customer deposits and payments electronically through mobile phones or at licensed locations like a post office.

zh: 这一政策是2014年所发布的更大的国家战略的一部分 — — 到2016年底为76%的成年人和56%的活跃储蓄账户提供金融服务。
en: The effort is part of a larger national strategy, launched in 2014, to provide 76% of adults with financial access and 56% with active savings accounts by the end of 2016.

zh: 在太平洋地区，斐济、巴布亚新几内亚、萨摩亚、所罗门群岛、东帝汶、汤加和瓦努阿图共同成立了太平洋岛国地区计划（Pacific Islands Regional Initiative，PIRI ） ， 该计划将让所有太平洋岛国 — — 即使它没有央行 — — 共享关于在不利的地理环境下改善金融服务的普及、质量和用途的知识。
en: And in the Pacific region, Fiji, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Timor-Leste, Tonga, and Vanuatu have banded together to create the Pacific Islands Regional Initiative (PIRI), which will enable every Pacific Island state, even those without a central bank, to share knowledge on improving access, quality, and usage of financial services in geographically challenging environments.

zh: 这些政策一开始都是国家领导的项目，诞生于特定的挑战面前，目的是为了满足当地人口的具体需求。
en: Each of these efforts started as a country-led initiative, born of particular challenges and designed to meet the specific needs of the local population.

zh: ���经验的累积正在起到极有价值的作用。
en: But the accumulation of experience is proving invaluable.

zh: 教训获得共享，成功则为其他国家提供启发，所形成的影响力可谓巨大，即使是最小的国家，也证明了它们能够做出巨大贡献。
en: As lessons are shared and successes provide inspiration for others, the impact is becoming exponential, with even the smallest countries demonstrating that they have a significant contribution to make.

zh: 与此同时，随着央行改变其经营方式，零售银行也开始响应新生意经。
en: Meanwhile, as central banks change how they operate, retail banks are responding with new ways of doing business.

zh: 肯尼亚公平银行（Equity Bank）明确地定位于金融受排斥群体，结果迅速成长；在六年时间里，该银行的客户数量从五十万增加到近六百万。
en: Kenya’s Equity Bank has grown enormously by explicitly targeting the financially excluded; in just six years, it has expanded from a half-million customers to almost six million.

zh: 通讯公司也在创新新服务。
en: Telecommunication companies are also pioneering new services.

zh: 比如，Tigo公司目前为14个拉丁美洲和非洲国家的5,600万客户提供跨境移动支付和经销商无现金服务等产品。
en: Tigo, for example, now serves more than 56 million customers in 14 countries in Latin America and Africa with products such as cross-border mobile payments and cashless services for sales agents.

zh: 和任何大变革时代一样，看清楚前方的路绝不容易。
en: As with any period of great change, it is not easy to see what lies ahead.

zh: 维萨公司全球金融包容性主管史蒂芬·吉欧（Stephen Kehoe）最近指出 ， “ 过去七年对于未来七年毫无指导意义。
en: As Stephen Kehoe, Head of Global Financial Inclusion at Visa, recently noted, “The last seven years provide absolutely no indication of what the next seven years will be.”

zh: ”但是，清楚的是，我们还有很多事需要做 — — 而机会可以说无穷无尽。
en: What is clear, however, is that there still remains much to be done – and that the opportunities are nearly limitless.

zh: 让全世界二十亿无法获得银行服务的人走出阴影，进入主流金融体系需要监管者、私人部门、非营利组织、地区机构和国际组织之间的新合作。
en: Bringing the world’s two billion unbanked people out of the shadows and into the mainstream financial system will require new partnerships among regulators, the private sector, non-profits, regional bodies, and international organizations.

zh: 看上去这是个艰巨的任务，但完成这个任务有助于为所有人带来更加光明的未来。
en: That may seem like a tall order, but filling it would help build a brighter future for everyone.

zh: 金融包容与超越
en: Financial Inclusion and Beyond

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 因为传统金融服务并非为小储户和借款人设计，若干非传统模式已经能在这片未开发的市场上迅速发展壮大。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Because traditional financial services are not designed for small depositors and borrowers, several non-traditional models have been able to scale up rapidly in this untapped market.

zh: 但如果没有战略性政策路线图来指导进一步的金融技术（fintech）研发，这些新的“连接”模式所能提供的服务依然是有限的。
en: But, without a strategic policy roadmap to guide further financial-technology (fintech) development, these new “connector” models will remain limited in terms of the services they can provide.

zh: 在肯尼亚，移动支付应用M-Pesa的成功可谓具有变革性意义。
en: In Kenya, the success of M-Pesa, a mobile payments app, has been nothing short of transformational.

zh: PayPal两次在纳斯达克上市、几乎在世界最大经济体经营了二十年，才积累了1.88亿活跃客户和2820亿美元的年支付额。
en: It took PayPal two NASDAQ listings and almost two decades operating in the world’s largest economy to reach 188 million active customers and $282 billion in annual payments.

zh: 而尽管M-Pesa在一个相比之下收入低得多的市场只经营了不到十年，但去年已经积累了近1700万活跃用户，实际操作了超过500亿美元的无现金交易。
en: Although M-Pesa has been operating for less than a decade in a much lower-income market, it had nearly 17 million active users conducting more than $50 billion in cashless transactions last year.

zh: 同样，bKash现在主宰着孟加拉国的支付系统，以至于“bKashing”就像英语中的“Xeroxing ” 、 “Hoovering”和“Googling”一样，已经成为孟加拉语中的常用词汇。
en: Similarly, bKash now dominates the payments system in Bangladesh to such a degree that “bKashing” has become common Bengali parlance, just as “Xeroxing,” “Hoovering,” and “Googling” are in English.

zh: Microensure和Bima等提供小额保险解决方案的其他模式也在新兴国家快速成长。
en: Other models, such as Microensure and Bima, have also gained ground, offering micro-insurance solutions in emerging countries.

zh: Jan Dhan Yojana是高优先级的印度联邦政府计划，为穷人提供银行服务，并在不到两年内促成开立了2.5亿个新银行账户。
en: Jan Dhan Yojana, a high-priority Indian federal-government program that provides access to the banking sector for the poor, has enabled 250 million new bank accounts to be opened in less than two years.

zh: 为超越仅仅是改善金融服务的范畴，新型金融科技产品必须跨越几大障碍。
en: New fintech products will have to clear several hurdles to move beyond just improving access to financial services.

zh: 促进金融包容的服务必须提供大量的低价值产出，这意味着它们通常必须依赖伙伴关系来满足某些消费者需求。
en: Services fostering financial-inclusion must deliver a high volume of low-value output, which means they often have to rely on partnerships to meet certain consumer demands.

zh: 当这些合作伙伴有各自不同的约束或优先级时，问题就会出现。
en: Problems arise when these partners have their own constraints or different priorities.

zh: 例如，Microensure和Bima已经为数百万人提供了保险解决方案；但它们的服务最终要靠独立保险企业来分配资本和承保保单。
en: For example, Microensure and Bima have made insurance solutions available to millions of people; but their services ultimately depend on independent insurers to allocate capital and underwrite insurance policies.

zh: 同样，尽管撒哈拉以南非洲等地区的保险业增长刚刚出现萌芽，但全球保险企业必须不断适应其主要市场或国内市场的监管变化，且目前尚不清楚它们是否有能力针对低收入国家进行有意义的扩展。
en: Likewise, while there are green shoots of insurance-industry growth in regions like Sub-Saharan Africa, global insurers must constantly adapt to regulatory changes in their primary or home markets, and it is unclear if they have the capacity to expand meaningfully into low-income countries.

zh: 或者来审视一下M-Pesa本身。
en: Or consider M-Pesa itself.

zh: 四年前，它与非洲商业银行建立了合作关系，将贷款工具M-Shwari添加到其产品组合。
en: Four years ago, it formed a partnership with the Commercial Bank of Africa to add a lending tool, M-Shwari, to its suite of products.

zh: 自那以后，它开设的贷款帐户比任何肯尼亚银行都要多。
en: It has since opened more loan accounts than any Kenyan bank.

zh: 但这些帐户仍不到活跃M-Pesa用户的四分之一，且M-Shwari仍然仅提供小额30天贷款服务。
en: But such accounts still number less than a quarter of active M-Pesa users, and M-Shwari still supports only small 30-day loans.

zh: M-Shwari尚未成为任何一个合作伙伴的核心业务。
en: M-Shwari is not a core part of either partner’s business.

zh: 它也不是市场上唯一的同类产品。
en: Nor is it the only product of its kind on the market.

zh: 最近挑战M-Pesa的竞争对手是mVisa，这是Visa Inc. 和其他两家肯尼亚银行联手创办的合伙企业。
en: The most recent competitor to challenge M-Pesa is mVisa, a partnership between Visa Inc. and two other Kenyan banks.

zh: 因为关系到2016年的4亿美元收入，M-Pesa的母公司Safaricom很可能重点保护其核心产品，然后���尝试推出新的赢利点。
en: With $400 million in 2016 revenues at stake, Safaricom – M-Pesa’s parent company – will likely focus on defending its core offering before it tries to introduce new products.

zh: 在Safaricom当前扩大金融包容性的新产品优先序列中，储蓄和贷款产品几乎排在最后。
en: In Safaricom’s current list of new product priorities to expand financial inclusion, saving-and-loan products are ranked almost last.

zh: 必须依靠无障碍创新创业将穷人接入到正规金融系统； 但从政策和发展的角度来看，我们需要过渡到改善大规模生态系统，以确保发挥新金融科技产品的全部潜能。
en: Unfettered innovation and entrepreneurship are necessary for connecting the poor to the formal financial system; but, from a policy and development perspective, we need to shift our efforts toward improving the larger ecosystem to realize new fintech products’ full potential.

zh: 比方说，M-Pesa的无现金交易由客户提供的现金支持，并在任何特定时点以信托的形式持有。
en: For example, M-Pesa’s cashless transactions are underpinned by cash contributed by its customers, which is held in trust at any given time.

zh: 这些基金的利息收入目前通过M-Pesa基金会支付。
en: Interest income from these funds is currently disbursed through the M-Pesa Foundation.

zh: 通过精心构建的系统，这笔钱可以被用于更有效率的生产用途。
en: With a carefully constructed system, this money could be put to even greater productive use.

zh: 印度的Jan Dhan Yojana计划已从新晋客户处筹集了大约60亿美元，这笔钱可以用于额外定制产品的提供。
en: India’s Jan Dhan Yojana program has mobilized an estimated $6 billion from newly acquired customers, which could be used to provide additional tailored products.

zh: 新兴金融技术服务可以吸取中国电子商务企业阿里巴巴的经验，该公司迅速对其支付平台 — — 支付宝加以利用。
en: Emerging fintech services can take a lesson from the Chinese e-commerce company Alibaba, which was quick in leveraging its payments platform, Alipay.

zh: 阿里巴巴推出货币市场基金后，2013年6月，余额宝开始对支付宝客户的非生产性小额存款进行再投资。
en: After Alibaba launched its money market fund, Yu’e Bao, in June 2013, it began reinvesting its Alipay customers’ unproductive micro-deposits.

zh: 截至2015年末，余额宝基金经理管理着1,650亿美元资产，并将支付宝数百万缺乏财务知识的小额储户转化为得到可观回报的投资者。
en: By the end of 2015, the Yu’e Bao fund manager was overseeing $165 billion in assets and had converted Alipay’s millions of small, financially unsophisticated savers into investors collecting respectable returns.

zh: 为开发其平台，阿里巴巴依靠大数据来管理基金独特的流动状态；同时受益于中国不稳定的监管框架，虽然未来这或许会成为可变因素。
en: To develop its platform, Alibaba relied on big data to manage the fund’s unique liquidity dynamics; and it benefited from China’s unsettled regulatory framework, though this could change in the future.

zh: 中国的情况可能非常独特； 事实上，外界对“余额宝模式”所隐含的固有风险越来越关注。
en: The Chinese context may be unique; and, indeed, there are growing concerns about risks inherent in the Yu’e Bao model.

zh: 但是监管机构和金融技术企业应当注意像支付宝这样的例子，为这个新兴行业制定合理的战略政策。
en: But regulators and fintech firms should take note of examples like Alipay to develop rational strategic possibilities for this emerging sector.

zh: 最重要的是，他们应当牢记获得融资本身不是目的，真正的目的是通过获得融资来获得自我提升的方法。
en: Most important, they should remember that access to finance is not an end in itself, but a means to improve one’s lot.

zh: 最近一期印度快讯报调查显示，在真空中提供金融服务会带来什么样的后果。
en: A recent Indian Express investigation revealed what can happen when access to financial services is provided in a vacuum.

zh: 这份调查发现几例印度公共银行官员在客户并不知情的情况下将一卢比存入客户账户。
en: The paper found several instances where officials at Indian public-sector banks were depositing one rupee into customer accounts without customers’ knowledge.

zh: 这些官员显然面临减少零余额账户数的压力，而所有零余额账户都被证明关系到Jan Dhan Yojana计划。
en: These officials were apparently under pressure to reduce the number of zero-balance accounts, all of which, it turns out, were related to the Jan Dhan Yojana program.

zh: 我们现在知道，同样的欺骗曾是美国富国银行的常规做法。
en: Similar chicanery, we now know, was a routine practice at the US bank Wells Fargo.

zh: 不同之处是金字塔底部的客户几乎鲜有银行选择。
en: The difference is that customers at the bottom of the pyramid have few banking alternatives.

zh: 获取金融服务是非常必要的开始，但它必须要达到某个目标。
en: Financial-services access is a much needed start, but it must lead somewhere.

zh: 寄希望于无银行户头者
en: Banking on the Unbanked

zh: 多伦多 — — 在一片悲观消息的海洋里，出现了一抹亮眼的颜色。
en: TORONTO – In a sea of gloomy news, one bright headline appears on the horizon.

zh: 世界银行计划于明年春天发布的个人银行账户最新统计数据预计将会表明越来越多的人开始持有银行或其他正式金融机构的账户。
en: The World Bank’s latest figures on individuals’ bank accounts, to be released next spring, are expected to show that the number of people holding accounts at banks or other formal financial institutions has grown.

zh: 2015年4月，世界银行最近一次发表全球金融发展水平指数报告时，估计有7亿成年人（主要来自发展中国家）已经在过去三年中获得了金融服务。
en: The last time the World Bank published its Global Findex report, in April 2015, an estimated 700 million adults, mainly in developing countries, had obtained access to financial services during the previous three years.

zh: 这相当于全球“拥有银行账户”的个人增长超过21 % 。
en: That amounted to an increase of more than 21% in the global number of “banked” individuals.

zh: 因为扩大金融服务范围有助于实现脱贫，因此，上述指标的提升可以被视为人类发展领域的积极信号。
en: Because broader access to financial services helps to create a path out of poverty, any increase in this metric is a positive sign for human development.

zh: 但我所在机构不会在新报告发表时庆祝胜利。
en: But my organization won’t be declaring victory when the new report comes out.

zh: 无论世行数据如何，为世界最贫困人口提供普遍金融服务仍然是一个遥远的目标。
en: No matter what the World Bank data show, universal financial inclusion for the world’s poorest remains a distant goal.

zh: 目前，仍有约20亿成年人无法享受到正式的金融服务。
en: At the moment, some two billion adults remain excluded from formal financial services.

zh: 文件要求繁琐、账户费用过高、银行分支机构有限以及金融机构“只为富人服务”的理念共同构成的障碍往往最难以克服。
en: Excessive documentation requirements, high account fees, limited access to bank branches, and the perception that financial institutions are “only for the rich” are among the most persistent obstacles to overcome.

zh: 在万事达基金会，我们正在为协助世界最贫困人口克服这些障碍而努力工作。
en: At the Mastercard Foundation, we are committed to helping to remove these barriers for the world’s poorest.

zh: 本月在加纳的阿克拉，我们召开了第五届金融包容性年度研讨会，汇集了数百位金融服务提供商、决策者、学者和发展专家共同研究如何扩大和深化贯彻金融包容。
en: This month in Accra, Ghana, we convened the fifth annual Symposium on Financial Inclusion, bringing together hundreds of financial services providers, policymakers, academics, and development experts to examine how to broaden and deepen financial inclusion.

zh: 我们举办上述全球会议始于2013年，而每年都会出现一个熟悉的问题：那就是金融机构可以将更多精力投入到关注最贫困客户的需求当中。
en: We have been hosting this global conference since 2013, and each year, a familiar concern emerges: financial institutions could do more to focus on the needs of their poorest clients.

zh: 因为银行往往不考虑贫困客户的行为和希望，因此他们并不总能提供穷人所需的产品和服务。
en: Because banks often do not consider the behaviors and aspirations of poor customers, they do not always offer the products and services the poor need.

zh: 如果行业优先目标发生变化，那么实现包容性的障碍自然而然就会有所下降。
en: If the industry’s priorities changed, barriers to inclusion would fall.

zh: 扭转这一趋势本来应当相对容易。
en: Reversing this trend should be easier than it is.

zh: 归根结底，如果民众兴旺发达，银行也会受益。
en: After all, when people prosper, so do banks.

zh: 穷人在开立银行账户后往往会存更多的钱或者进行手机支付。
en: Poor people tend to save more money when they can access bank accounts or make mobile payments.

zh: 储蓄增加将会带来整体繁荣。
en: With savings comes increased overall prosperity.

zh: 父母能轻易支付费用时孩子在学校的表现也会更好。
en: Children do better in school when parents can easily pay fees.

zh: 女性也会拥有更强的创业能力。
en: Women become more empowered to start businesses.

zh: 贫困家庭能够更好地面对农作物歉收、疾病或自然灾害等不利影响。
en: Poor households can better cope with adverse shocks like crop failure, illness, or natural disaster.

zh: 拥有银行账户对经济产生的正面连锁反应显而易见。
en: The positive economic knock-on effects are obvious.

zh: 有了银行账户，处在创业阶段的企业家可以建立自己的信用，并享受负责任的正规贷款商所提供的服务。
en: With bank accounts, budding entrepreneurs can establish their creditworthiness and tap responsible, formal lenders.

zh: 而小企业有了资金就可以成长为大企业，雇用包括年轻人在内的更多民众。
en: And with capital, small enterprises can grow into larger businesses, employing others, especially young people.

zh: 近年来在技术协助下已经缩小了目前存在的差距。
en: Technology has helped close the gap in recent years.

zh: 肯尼亚M-Pesa移动应用程序等数字支付平台的成功表明如果根据弱势客户的需求来设计产品，他们会以何等的速度对这些廉价产品和服务加以利用。
en: The success of digital payment platforms, such as the M-Pesa mobile app in Kenya, demonstrates how quickly vulnerable clients will take up and use inexpensive products and services if they are designed with users’ needs in mind.

zh: 此外，非洲和亚洲的金融技术公司正在寻找创新方式来分析贫困人口活动所产生的数据，并利用相关数据来设计和提供更高质量的银行服务。
en: Moreover, financial technology firms in Africa and Asia are finding innovative ways to analyze data generated by poor people’s activities, and using that data to design and deliver better banking services.

zh: 超越传统的方法也正在不断涌现，比如通过他们已经在使用并且信任的小型独立企业来联系那些尚未开立银行账户的贫困人口。
en: Non-traditional approaches are also emerging, such as reaching the unbanked poor via small, independent businesses that they already use and trust.

zh: 但金融机构仍将承担扩大金融服务的大部分职责。
en: But much of the onus for inclusion will remain on financial institutions.

zh: 我经常听到的一个说法是金融服务业的本质是风险厌恶。
en: One argument I often hear is that the financial services sector is risk-averse.

zh: 鉴于银行对客户负有信托责任，这种特征并不完全错误。
en: Given banks’ fiduciary obligations to their customers, this is not an entirely bad trait.

zh: 但银行和其他金融机构应当意识到风险防护能够与为贫困客户提供服务实现完美兼容。
en: Yet banks and other financial institutions should realize that risk protection is perfectly compatible with service to poor customers.

zh: 因为忽视贫困群体的需求，金融机构正在忽视规模巨大的潜在市场。
en: By ignoring poor people’s needs, financial institutions are overlooking a massive potential market.

zh: 要想接触到数以亿计的新客户，全球金融机构只需要站在穷人的角度进行某种象征性的思考，而后他们就会发现不应当因为过时、不准确或不公平的假设而剥夺任何人的金融服务。
en: To reach hundreds of millions of new clients, the world’s financial institutions need only walk a metaphorical mile in the shoes of a poor person. They would then see that no one should be excluded because of inaccurate, outdated, or unfair assumptions.

zh: 今天，从负责任的现代金融服务中获益的普通人正越来越多。
en: Today, more people than ever are benefiting from access to modern and responsible financial services.

zh: 毫无疑问，明年的世行数据将会展现出更丰硕的成果。
en: No doubt, next year’s World Bank data will indicate even greater gains.

zh: 但要想创造一个没有人被排斥在外的世界，金融业必须把业务核心转移到关注贫困客户的需求。
en: But to achieve a world where no one is excluded, the industry must place the needs of poor clients at the center of its business strategies.

zh: 只有到那时，关于金融包容性的好消息才会结出丰硕的成果。
en: Only then will the good news about financial inclusion become great.

zh: 为何金融市场低估风险
en: Why Financial Markets Underestimate Risk

zh: 坎布里奇—在2017年的大部分时间里，芝加哥期权交易所波动指数（VIX）一直位于过去十年来的最低水平。
en: CAMBRIDGE – During most of 2017, the Chicago Board Options Exchange Volatility Index (VIX) has been at the lowest levels of the last decade.

zh: 最近，VIX跌破了9，比2007年次贷危机几乎引爆全球金融体系前夕还要低。
en: Recently, the VIX dipped below nine, even lower than in March 2007, just before the subprime mortgage crisis nearly blew up the global financial system.

zh: 看起来，投资者再一次无视世界到底有多危险。
en: Investors, it seems, are once again failing to appreciate just how risky the world is.

zh: VIX又被称为“恐慌指数 ” ， 它测量通过股票指数期权价格表现的金融市场对不确定性的敏感程度，即人们认为股市价值发生重大波动的概率。
en: Known colloquially as the “fear index,” the VIX measures financial markets’ sensitivity to uncertainty – that is, the perceived probability of large fluctuations in the stock market’s value – as conveyed by stock index option prices.

zh: VIX水平较低表示“冒险”期，投资者“寻找收益率 ” ， 减仓美国国债和其他安全港证券，加仓股票、公司债券、不动产和套息交易货币等高风险资产。
en: A low VIX signals a “risk-on” period, when investors “reach for yield,” exchanging US Treasury bills and other safe-haven securities for riskier assets like stocks, corporate bonds, real estate, and carry-trade currencies.

zh: 我们现在就处于VIX极低的水平，尽管经济面临着众多切实的风险。
en: This is where we are today, despite the variety of actual risks facing the economy.

zh: 对于某个给定的月份，这些风险中的每一个都有可能继续保持低位，但保持低位的风险反常地多，这表明有很大的可能至少其中之一会在未来几年中变为现实。
en: While each of those risks will probably remain low in a given month, the unusually large number of them implies a reasonably strong chance that at least one will materialize over the next few years.

zh: 主要风险之一是股市泡沫破裂。
en: The first major risk is the bursting of a stock-market bubble.

zh: 在美国和其他地区，主要股市指数在9月纷纷创出新高，并且股价与收益和分红等基准的比值也非常高。
en: Major stock-market indices hit record highs in September, in the United States and elsewhere, and equity prices are high relative to benchmarks like earnings and dividends.

zh: 罗伯特·希勒（Robert Shiller）的经周期调整的市盈率目前已高于30 — — 此前这种情况只出现过两次，即1929年和2000年股市顶部，随后都发生了股市崩盘。
en: Robert Shiller’s cyclically adjusted price-earnings ratio is now above 30 – a level previously reached only twice, at the peaks of 1929 and 2000, both of which were followed by stock-market crashes.

zh: 我们还面临着债券市场泡沫破灭的风险。
en: We also face the risk of a bursting bond-market bubble.

zh: 美联储前主席艾伦·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）最近表示，债券市场要比股票市场还要高估（或“非理性繁荣 ” ） 。
en: Former US Federal Reserve Board Chair Alan Greenspan recently suggested that the bond market is even more overvalued (or “irrationally exuberant”) than the stock market.

zh: 市场已经习惯于债券收益率不断下降：1981年—2016年间，公司和政府债券都表现出下降趋势。
en: The market is accustomed to falling bond yields: both corporate and government bonds were on a downward trend from 1981 to 2016.

zh: 但利率不可能比今天的水平再低多少了；事实上，预计利率将出现上升，特别是在美国，而欧洲央行和其他主要央行也可能即将进入紧缩周期。
en: But interest rates can’t go much lower than they are today; in fact, they are expected to rise, particularly in the US, though the European Central Bank and other major central banks also appear to be entering a tightening cycle.

zh: 如果 ， （ 比如）通胀升高形成了对美联储更快加息的预期，股票或债券市场崩盘可能随之而来。
en: If, say, an increase in inflation generates expectations that the Fed will raise interest rates more aggressively, a stock- or bond-market crash might result.

zh: 地缘政治风险也很高 — — 事实上，历史上地缘政治风险很少有和现在那么高的时候，正如美国全球领导力的稳定作用很少有和现在那么低的时候。
en: Geopolitical risk is also high – indeed, it has rarely been higher than it is today, just as faith in the stabilizing influence of US global leadership has rarely been lower.

zh: 最尖锐的风险是朝鲜不断推进其核计划，但在中东和其他地区也存在很大风险。
en: The most acute risk relates to North Korea’s advancing nuclear program, but there are also substantial risks in the Middle East and elsewhere.

zh: 美国总统特朗普放大了这些风险，他在外交政策上犯了许多错误，既没能处理好朝鲜危机，还威胁要废除伊朗核协议。
en: These risks are being exacerbated by US President Donald Trump, who has made a number of foreign-policy missteps, from mishandling the North Korea crisis to threatening to abrogate the Iran nuclear agreement.

zh: 目前，特朗普对国内事务大放厥词的后果尚且颇为有限，因为大部分内容都还没有转化为立法。
en: So far, the consequences of Trump’s wild rhetoric on the domestic front have been limited, because most of it has not been translated into legislation.

zh: 但在国际事务上，后果可能十分严重。
en: But on the international front, it could have disastrous implications.

zh: 除了特朗普的变幻莫测之外，美国还面临更大的增值危机。
en: Beyond Trump’s capriciousness is a broader crisis in US politics.

zh: 尽管美国国会就债务上限问题的“决战”没有导致政府在这个月惨遭关门，但美国领导人只是把大限延后到今年年底，到那时，这个问题的后果可能会更加严重，僵局可能更加难以克服。
en: Though showdowns in the US Congress over the debt ceiling did not result in a government shutdown this month, US leaders have only kicked the can down the road to the end of the year, when the stakes could well be higher and the stalemate more intractable.

zh: 美国还有可能面临一场宪政危机，如果特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒（Robert Mueller）找到（比如）特朗普选举阵营与俄罗斯政府进行非法联系的证据的话。
en: The US may even face a constitutional crisis, if Special Counsel Robert Mueller were to find, for example, evidence of illegal contact between the Trump campaign and the Russian government.

zh: VIX上一次跌到今天这么低的水平实在2006年到2007年初期间，当时，你也可以找到一长串潜在风险。
en: The last time the VIX was as low as it is today, in 2006 and early 2007, one could also draw up a lengthy list of potential crises.

zh: 最显而易见的是英国和美国房价相对租金等基准的水平达到了历史新高，积累了崩盘风险。
en: Most obvious, housing prices in the United Kingdom and the US were at record highs relative to benchmarks like rent, raising the risk of a collapse.

zh: 但市场表现得好像风险很低一样，让VIX和美国国债利率节节下跌，而股票、垃圾债券和新兴市场证券节节走高。
en: Yet markets acted as if risk was low, driving down the VIX and US Treasury bill rates, and driving up prices of stocks, junk bonds, and emerging-market securities.

zh: 当住房市场真的崩盘时，人们认为这是一场意外。
en: When the housing market did crash, it was regarded as a surprise.

zh: 分析师说，这场危机位于可用过去的数据进行估算的一切正态概率分布之外，因此属于黑天鹅事件，或“奈特式不确定性 ” （ 即彻底的不确定性，亦即未知的未知 ） 。
en: The crash lay outside any standard probability distribution that could have been estimated from past data, analysts declared, and was therefore a black swan event, or a case of “Knightian uncertainty,” radical uncertainty, or unknown unknowns.

zh: 分析师说，毕竟，住房价格此前从未出现过名义下跌。
en: After all, the analysts argued, housing prices had never fallen in nominal terms before.

zh: 但是，尽管美国名义住房价格在此前70年里从未下跌，但20世纪90年代的日本和20世纪30年代的美国曾经出现过这种情况。
en: But, while nominal housing prices had not fallen in the US in the previous 70 years, they had fallen in Japan in the 1990s and in the US in the 1930s.

zh: 因此，这不是奈特式不确定性，而是古典不确定性，即产生概率分布的数据集毫无必要地被限定在近几十年中的国内情况。
en: This was, therefore, not a case of Knightian uncertainty, but of classical uncertainty, in which the data set generating the probability distribution was unnecessarily limited to a few decades of domestic observations.

zh: 从这个角度讲 ， “ 黑天鹅”这个描述最为恰当 — — 事实上，要比它的使用者所认识到的更加恰当。
en: In this sense, it is the “black swan” term that fits best – indeed, better than those who use it realize.

zh: 十九世纪英国哲学家用黑天鹅作为经典例子，来说明发生与否无法用观察到的数据进行推断的现象。
en: Nineteenth-century British philosophers cited black swans as the quintessential example of a phenomenon whose occurrence could not be inferred from observed data.

zh: 但这也体现出他们没有考虑足够多的国家或世纪。
en: But that, too, reflected a failure to consider data from enough countries or centuries.

zh: （黑天鹅是一个澳大利亚物种，在十八世纪被鸟类学家命名。 ）
en: (The black swan is an Australian species that had been identified by ornithologists in the eighteenth century.)

zh: 这类没能采用充分广泛的视野的谬误，成了投资者反复低估风险的关键原因。
en: This type of failure to take a sufficiently broad view turns out to be a key reason why investors periodically underestimate risk.

zh: 比如，期权定价公式需要对方差进行统计估计。
en: The formulas for pricing options, for example, require a statistical estimate of the variance.

zh: 类似地，按揭支持证券定价公式需要对违约的频率分布进行统计估计。
en: Likewise, the formula for pricing mortgage-backed securities requires a statistical estimate of the frequency distribution of defaults.

zh: 分析师在估计这些参数时，只使用了给定国家过去几年的数据。
en: Analysts estimate these parameters by plugging in just the last few years of data for the given country.

zh: 此外，在海曼·明斯基（Hyman Minsky）所描述的枯荣循环中，低波动时期诱使投资者产生错误地安全感，导致他们过度举债，最终引发崩盘。
en: Moreover, in the boom-bust cycle described by Hyman Minsky, a period of low volatility lulls investors into a false sense of security, leading them to become over-leveraged and ultimately producing a crash.

zh: 也许投资者会重新评估目前影响经济的风险，VIX也将做出调整。
en: Perhaps investors will re-evaluate the risks affecting the economy today, and the VIX will adjust.

zh: 但如果说历史有什么借鉴意义的话，那就是，这一幕要等到负面冲击（不论它是什么）真的发生时才会发生。
en: But, if history is any guide, this will not happen until the negative shock, whatever it is, actually hits.

zh: 地缘政治坟场上的哨声
en: Whistling Past the Geopolitical Graveyard

zh: 纽约—随着马克龙在法国总统竞选中击败右翼民粹主义者玛丽娜·勒庞（Marine Le Pen ） ， 欧盟和欧元躲过了一颗子弹。
en: NEW YORK – With Emmanuel Macron’s defeat of the right-wing populist Marine Le Pen in the French presidential election, the European Union and the euro have dodged a bullet.

zh: 但地缘政治风险仍在扩散。
en: But geopolitical risks are continuing to proliferate.

zh: 西方的反全球化民粹主义逆袭不会因为马克龙的胜利而戛然而止，仍然可能导致保护主义、贸易战和激烈的移民限制。
en: The populist backlash against globalization in the West will not be stilled by Macron’s victory, and could still lead to protectionism, trade wars, and sharp restrictions to migration.

zh: 如果分裂的力量保持势头，英国的脱欧可能最终导致欧盟解体 — — 不管有没有马克龙。
en: If the forces of disintegration take hold, the United Kingdom’s withdrawal from the EU could eventually lead to a breakup of the EU – Macron or no Macron.

zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯继续在波罗的海、巴尔干地区、乌克兰和叙利亚横行霸道。
en: At the same time, Russia has maintained its aggressive behavior in the Baltics, the Balkans, Ukraine, and Syria.

zh: 中东仍然充斥着几乎失败的国家，如伊拉克、利比亚和黎巴嫩。
en: The Middle East still contains multiple near-failed states, such as Iraq, Yemen, Libya, and Lebanon.

zh: 而沙特阿拉伯和伊朗之间的逊尼派-什叶派代理战争也没有结束迹象。
en: And the Sunni-Shia proxy wars between Saudi Arabia and Iran show no sign of ending.

zh: 在亚洲，美国或朝鲜的边缘政策可能演化为朝鲜半岛的军事冲突。
en: In Asia, US or North Korean brinkmanship could precipitate a military conflict on the Korean Peninsula.

zh: 中国则继续与其域内邻国存在领土纠纷 — — 其中一些有升级之势。
en: And China is continuing to engage in – and in some cases escalating – its territorial disputes with regional neighbors.

zh: 尽管存在这些地缘政治风险，全球金融市场却涨出了新高度。
en: Despite these geopolitical risks, global financial markets have reached new heights.

zh: 因此，值得一问投资者是否低估了这些冲突中的一个或多个引发严重危机的可能，以及如果真的发生严重危机的话，他们会遭到怎样的冲击。
en: So it is worth asking if investors are underestimating the potential for one or more of these conflicts to trigger a more serious crisis, and what it would take to shock them out of their complacency if they are.

zh: 对于为何市场忽视地缘政治风险，有很多解释。
en: There are many explanations for why markets may be ignoring geopolitical risks.

zh: 首先，虽然中东大部战火不断，但并未发生石油供给冲击或禁运，美国的页岩气革命也增加了低成本能源的供给。
en: For starters, even with much of the Middle East burning, there have been no oil-supply shocks or embargos, and the shale-gas revolution in the United States has increased the supply of low-cost energy.

zh: 在前几次中东冲突中 — — 比如1973年赎罪日战争、1979年伊朗伊斯兰革命、1990年伊拉克入侵科威特等 — — 石油供给冲击导致了全球滞涨和股市剧烈调整。
en: During previous Middle East conflicts – such as the 1973 Yom Kippur War, Iran’s Islamic Revolution in 1979, and Iraq’s invasion of Kuwait in 1990 – oil-supply shocks caused global stagflation and sharp stock-market corrections.

zh: 第二个解释是，投资者从此前的冲击中判断 — — 如2001年9月11日的恐怖袭击 — — 决策者会用强力货币和财政政策宽松来支撑经济和金融市场，从而拯救世界。
en: A second explanation is that investors are extrapolating from previous shocks, such as the attacks of September 11, 2001, when policymakers saved the day by backstopping the economy and financial markets with strong monetary and fiscal policy easing.

zh: 这些政策让冲击后的市场调整成为买入机会，因为资产价格的下跌在几天到几周之内就能收复。
en: These policies turned post-shock market corrections into buying opportunities, because the fall in asset prices was reversed in a matter of days or weeks.

zh: 第三，真正经历本地化急产石长冲即的国家 — — 如2014年俄罗斯吞并克里米亚、入侵东乌克兰后的俄罗斯和乌克兰 — — 没有大到在经济上能够影响美国和全球金融市场的程度。
en: Third, the countries that actually have experienced localized asset-market shocks – such as Russia and Ukraine after Russia’s annexation of Crimea and incursion into Eastern Ukraine in 2014 – are not large enough economically to affect US or global financial markets.

zh: 类似地，即使英国追求“硬脱欧 ” ， 它也只占全球GDP的区区2 % 。
en: Similarly, even as the UK pursues a “hard Brexit,” it still only accounts for around 2% of global GDP.

zh: 第四个解释是到目前为止，世界还没有受到与眼下的地缘政治战火有关的尾部风险的影响。
en: A fourth explanation is that the world has so far been spared from the tail risks associated with today’s geopolitical conflagrations.

zh: 大国之间没有发生任何直接军事冲突，欧盟和欧元区也没有解体。
en: There has not yet been a direct military conflict between any major powers, nor have the EU or eurozone collapsed.

zh: 美国总统特朗普更加激进和民粹主义的政策已经得到部分遏制。
en: US President Donald Trump’s more radical, populist policies have been partly contained.

zh: 中国经济也没有遭遇可能引起社会政治动荡的硬着陆。
en: And China’s economy has not yet suffered from a hard landing, which would create sociopolitical instability.

zh: 此外，市场难以定价这些“黑天鹅”事件，即不太可能出现、一旦出现便代价高昂的“未知的未知 ” 。
en: Moreover, markets have trouble pricing such “black swan” events: “unknown unknowns” that are unlikely, but extremely costly.

zh: 比如，市场不可能预见到会发生9/11。
en: For example, the market couldn’t have predicted 9/11.

zh: 而即使投资者认为会发生又一场重大恐怖袭击，也不可能知道是什么时候。
en: And even if investors think that another major terrorist attack will come, they cannot know when.

zh: 美国和朝鲜的冲突也可能演化为黑天鹅事件，但有一种可能，市场心安理得地忽视了它。
en: A confrontation between the US and North Korea could also turn into a black swan event, but this is a possibility that markets have happily ignored.

zh: 一个原因是，尽管特朗普气势汹汹，其实美国并没有多少现实的军事选项：如果美国发动打击，朝鲜可以用常规武器夷平首尔及其周边，而那里居住着将近一半的韩国人口。
en: One reason is that, notwithstanding Trump’s bluster, the US has very few realistic military options: North Korea could use conventional weapons to wipe out Seoul and its surroundings, where almost half of South Korea’s population lives, were the US to strike.

zh: 投资者可能认为，即使发生有限的军事交火，也不会升级成全面战争，而政策的放松可以减轻经济和金融市场受到的打击。
en: Investors may be assuming that even if a limited military exchange occurred, it would not escalate into a full-fledged war, and policy loosening could soften the blow on the economy and financial markets.

zh: 这一情形就像是9/11，最初的市场调整最终只是一个买入机会。
en: In this scenario, as with 9/11, the initial market correction would end up being a buying opportunity.

zh: 但也有其他可能情形，其中一些会变成黑天鹅。
en: But there are other possible scenarios, some of which could turn out to be black swans.

zh: 考虑到与直接军事行动相关的风险，据说美国现在正在使用网络武器消除朝鲜对美国本土的核威胁。
en: Given the risks associated with direct military action, the US is now alleged to be using cyber weapons to eliminate the North Korean nuclear threat against the US mainland.

zh: 这可以解释为何最近几个月来朝鲜导弹试射频频失败。
en: This may explain why so many of North Korea’s missile tests have failed in recent months.

zh: 但朝鲜面对军事斩首会作何反应？
en: But how will North Korea react to being militarily decapitated?

zh: 一个答案是它可能发动自己的网络打击。
en: One answer is that it could launch a cyber attack of its own.

zh: 朝鲜的网络战能力被认为仅仅略次于俄罗斯和中国，而在2014年的入侵索尼影业事件中，世界就领教过朝鲜网络战的实力。
en: North Korea’s cyber-warfare capabilities are considered to be just a notch below those of Russia and China, and the world got an early glimpse of them in 2014 when it hacked into Sony Pictures.

zh: 大型朝鲜网络攻击可能令美国重要基础设施部分瘫痪甚至毁灭，导致巨大的经济和金融损失。
en: A major North Korean cyber attack could disable or destroy parts of the US’s critical infrastructure, and cause massive economic and financial damage.

zh: 即使美国能够破坏朝鲜的整体工业体系和基础设施，这一风险仍然存在。
en: That remains a risk even if the US can sabotage North Korea’s entire industrial system and infrastructure.

zh: 或者，朝鲜面对导弹计划和政权的破产，可能会转向低科技手段，派遣舰只携带脏弹进入洛杉矶或纽约港口。
en: Or, faced with disruption of its missile program and regime, North Korea could go low-tech, by sending a ship with a dirty bomb into the ports of Los Angeles or New York.

zh: 这类攻击将非常难以监控或组织。
en: An attack of this kind would most likely be very hard to monitor or stop.

zh: 因此，尽管投资者看淡美国和朝鲜间爆发常规军事冲突的风险也许是正确的，他们仍有可能低估了真正的黑天鹅事件的威胁，比如两国间爆发破坏性网络战或针对美国的脏弹袭击。
en: So, while investors may be right to discount the risk of a conventional military conflict between the US and North Korea, they also may be underestimating the threat of a true black swan event, such as a disruptive cyberwar between the two countries or a dirty bomb attack against the US.

zh: 朝鲜半岛事态升级是“回调买入”的机会，还是标志着市场大崩盘的开始？
en: Would an escalation on the Korean Peninsula be an opportunity to “buy the dip,” or would it mark the beginning of a massive market meltdown?

zh: 众所周知，市场可以定价与可以进行统计估计和测度的正态分布事件有关的“风险 ” 。
en: It is well known that markets can price the “risks” associated with a normal distribution of events that can be statistically estimated and measured.

zh: 但市场难以处理“奈特式不确定性 ” ， 即无法用概率计算的风险。
en: But they have more trouble grappling with “Knightian uncertainty”: risk that cannot be calculated in probabilistic terms.

zh: 黑客的市场？
en: A Hacker’s Market?

zh: 纽约 — — 140个字符所能造成的影响已经在书面交流史上达到了顶峰。
en: NEW YORK – Never in the history of written communication could 140 characters have the impact that they can have now.

zh: 两周前，叙利亚电子军（SEA）在侵入美联社主推特账户 （ @ AP）后发布了报导白宫两起爆炸事件和奥巴马总统受伤的虚假推特。
en: Two weeks ago, after gaining access to the Associated Press’s main Twitter account (@AP), the Syrian Electronic Army (SEA) posted a fake tweet reporting two explosions in the White House and the injury of President Barack Obama.

zh: 短短几秒钟后，美国金融市场就出现了约1%的跌幅。
en: Within seconds, US financial markets dropped by about 1%.

zh: 过了几分钟，不少人发表推特进行反驳。
en: Minutes later, Twitter was abuzz with refutations.

zh: 白宫记者的推文说没有感觉到爆炸，美联社记者和美联社政治推特账户宣布@AP遭黑客劫持。
en: Reporters at the White House tweeted that they felt no explosion, and AP reporters and the AP Politics Twitter account announced that @AP had been hacked.

zh: 白宫新闻秘书杰伊·卡尼在下午举行的发布会上证实奥巴马其实安然无恙。
en: At his afternoon briefing, White House press secretary Jay Carney confirmed that Obama was indeed unharmed.

zh: 金融市场应声反弹至骗局前的水平。
en: Financial markets returned to their pre-hoax level.

zh: @AP推特骗局表现出无法消除的系统风险，上述风险来自高度一体化的金融市场和日益民主化的新闻发布。
en: The @AP Twitter hoax represents systemic risk that cannot be eliminated, for it arises from the interaction of highly integrated financial markets and increasingly democratized news delivery.

zh: 鉴于恶意方具备布下此类骗局的强烈动机，我们看到的类似事件一定会大幅增加。
en: Given strong incentives for malicious parties to perpetrate such hoaxes, we should expect to see an increase in incidents.

zh: 金融市场容易被操纵，因为他们不评价真相。
en: Financial markets are vulnerable to manipulation, because they are not in the business of evaluating the truth.

zh: 交易行为往往是先下手为强，因此抢先犯错或许仍然有利可图。
en: Trading often favors first movers, so being fast but wrong can still be profitable.

zh: 试想某家成熟的贸易公司投入大量资源开发快速评估新闻潜在市场影响的一种算法，之后再根据预测影响自动发出交易指令。
en: Imagine that a sophisticated trading firm has invested significant resources to develop an algorithm that quickly evaluates the potential market impact of news, and then automatically sends orders to trade based on that predicted impact.

zh: 该算法从美联社推特解析出重要关键词（爆炸、白宫和奥巴马）之后，将在其他参与者（速度较慢的算法、甚至是反应较慢的人）开始消化这条消息的同时，基于市场下跌预期而发送卖出指令。
en: When that algorithm parses a tweet from the AP containing important keywords (explosion, White House, and Obama), it will send orders to sell with the expectation that the market will drop as others – first, slower algorithms, then even slower humans – start to process the same news.

zh: 先行者无需核实消息真假即可交易。
en: The first mover is happy to make such trades without verifying that the news is true.

zh: 如果后来消息��明属实，市场将筑底或继续下探，而抢先卖出将使先行者有利可图。
en: If it is true, the market will stay down or continue dropping, and the first mover will profit from the sales that it has made.

zh: 如果故事最终被证明是个骗局，市场可能会恢复早先的合理估值，而先行者最终将打成平手，甚至可能借市场下跌时买入的对冲头寸获利。
en: If the story is a hoax, the market will probably return to its earlier, fairly valued level, and the first mover will break even on its sales, and possibly profit from any position purchased as a hedge when the market was down.

zh: 无论事件真实与否，先行者算法都能够奏效。
en: The first mover’s algorithm worked, regardless of the story’s veracity.

zh: 对消息反应不够迅速，却对市场运行做出反应的后觉者可能会沦为@AP推特骗局的失利方。
en: The likely losers in the @AP Twitter hoax were later movers who did not react quickly to the news, but reacted instead to the market’s movement.

zh: 这些后觉者同样可能是久经沙场的电子或机构交易员；有些人可能还在运用以期货市场公平价值为基础的套利策略。
en: These late movers were also likely to have been sophisticated electronic or institutional traders; some were probably using arbitrage-based strategies that relied on the futures market for a calculation of the fair price.

zh: 由于内在结构使然，市场在骗局面前的脆弱性断乎难以消除。
en: The market’s vulnerability to hoax stories is thus difficult to eliminate, for it is inherent in its structure.

zh: 监管自然难以奏效，技术或监控同样于事无补。
en: It cannot be regulated away or fixed by technology or surveillance.

zh: 即便市场反应稍缓，仍有人会在消息证实为骗局前率先采取行动。
en: Even if markets moved more slowly, there would still be a first mover who responded before such a news story was revealed as a hoax.

zh: 上述机制类似于资产泡沫，只不过反应更加迅速。
en: This dynamic is similar to that of an asset bubble, albeit faster.

zh: 泡沫估值基于共同评估证据，抢先入市者往往获利丰厚。
en: In a bubble, valuations are based on collectively evaluated evidence, and those who enter the market earliest often benefit.

zh: 无论是评估房价上涨假设还是消息真实与否，市场确定答案都不会在瞬间给出。
en: Whether evaluating an assumption about the rise of house prices or whether a news story is true, the market does not provide a definitive answer instantaneously.

zh: 如果防范恶作剧不属于市场的职责范畴，像推特这样的新闻或新媒介机构能否预防骗局的发生？
en: If protecting against hoaxes is not the market’s purview, can news agencies or new media entities like Twitter prevent such deception?

zh: 他们无疑因为此次惨败而声誉受损，也可能会试着亡羊补牢。
en: To be sure, they have suffered reputational damage from this fiasco and will likely try to improve.

zh: 但他们的努力远远不够。
en: But their efforts will not be enough.

zh: 推特服务的技术漏洞在此之前已经引发关注，目前正在向复杂的验证模型过渡（密码搭配经由短信或其他设备发送的一次性密钥 ） 。
en: Twitter’s vulnerabilities were technically understood before this event, and the service was already moving toward a more sophisticated authentication model (a password paired with a one-time key from a text message or other device).

zh: 推特可能会尽快落实这种方式。
en: Twitter will likely implement this soon.

zh: 推特还应该考虑增加选择性“双密钥”系统，即在相关推特发出前由其他账户进行独立签发。
en: It should also consider adding an optional “two-key” system, in which an independent signoff from a separate account is required before a proposed tweet is broadcast.

zh: 但尽管上述措施可以加大黑客攻击系统的难度，但任何技术措施都并非牢不可破。
en: But, while such measures would increase the difficulty of hacking the system, no technological fix can make it impenetrable.

zh: 美联社的漏洞是什么？
en: What about the AP’s vulnerabilities?

zh: 攻击者在发布欺骗性推特前曾对AP的电子邮件发起了“网络钓鱼”式的攻击。
en: Attackers launched a “phishing” attempt against the AP’s emails shortly before the hoax tweet was sent.

zh: 网络钓鱼诱使员工向第三方发送密码或点击不可信链接安装恶意软件，凸显出文化技术故障的组合。
en: Phishing attacks, in which an employee is duped into sending a password to a third party or clicking an untrusted link that installs malicious software, represent a hybrid of cultural and technological failures.

zh: 随着袭击者的技术越来越高超，他们制作的邮件质量越来越过硬，有时冒充可以信赖的信息源引诱粗心的用户上钩。
en: As attackers become more sophisticated, they send better-crafted emails, sometimes impersonating trusted sources that lure unwary users.

zh: 构建安全文化难度很大，因为这往往和编辑部快速反应的动态及分散工作环境背道而驰。
en: Crafting a culture of security is difficult and often at odds with the dynamic and decentralized work environment of a fast-moving newsroom.

zh: 对漏洞的认识必须随技术变化而变化，并借助除与日常实务脱节的公司备忘录以外的形式加以传播。
en: As technologies change, so must awareness of vulnerabilities, and this awareness must be disseminated through means other than corporate memos that are disconnected from day-to-day business realities.

zh: 凭经验判断，没有几个公司能完成好这个任务：美国全国公共广播电台和英国广播公司最近都曾受叙利亚电子军的攻击，而麦当劳和汉堡王最近都曾被侵入推特账户。
en: Empirically, few firms get this right: America’s National Public Radio and the BBC were both recently hacked by the SEA, while McDonald’s and Burger King recently had their Twitter accounts compromised.

zh: 安全漏洞的扩散意味着人们可能对被侵犯的企业耸耸肩表示遗憾，而不会投出第一块石头。
en: The proliferation of security lapses means that people are more likely to shrug their shoulders than to cast the first stone at a company that is breached.

zh: 最后，美联社不太可能因此而遭受经济处罚。
en: Finally, the AP is unlikely to face financial penalties for this mistake.

zh: 因欺骗性推特引发的索赔诉讼面临着几乎无法逾越的障碍。
en: A lawsuit for losses stemming from the hoaxed tweet would face nearly insurmountable obstacles.

zh: 因为鲜有制度可以防止欺诈推特蔓延，且鉴于成功的黑客可以期待高调回应，推特仍将成为恶意欺骗的载体，即使技术壁垒可以加大攻击的难度。
en: Because few mechanisms can prevent the proliferation of hoaxed tweets, and given the high-profile response that successful hackers can expect, Twitter will remain a vehicle of malicious hoaxes, even as technological barriers make attacks more challenging.

zh: 事实上，美国证券交易委员会最近批准将Facebook和推特等社交媒体用于上市公司面向投资者的信息披露。
en: Indeed, the SEC recently approved the use of social media like Facebook and Twitter for publicly traded companies’ disclosures to investors.

zh: 试想如果@BP_America发表推文 ： “ 海湾油井发生爆炸。 详情随后播出。
en: Imagine what might happen if @BP_America tweets: “#Explosion reported at Gulf well.

zh: ”将产生什么后果。
en: Details to follow.”

zh: 攻破上述账户的动机显而易见：不仅黑客能因此声名大噪，随后不可避免的股市波动还能带来丰厚的获利机会。
en: The incentives to try to hack such accounts are obvious: not only significant publicity for hackers, but highly lucrative profit opportunities from the almost inevitable stock-market movements that will result.

zh: 不管在推特还是其他地方，我们只能提倡买者自慎。
en: On Twitter, as elsewhere, caveat emptor.

zh: 私营领域和可持续发展目标
en: The Private Sector and the SDGs

zh: 华盛顿 — — 实现雄心勃勃的全球可持续发展目标(SDGs ) — —包括到2030年实现消除贫困、改善全球健康、确保普及教育及缓和气候变化 — — 需要耗费巨额资金。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Achieving the ambitious global Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) – which include ending poverty, improving global health, ensuring universal education, and mitigating climate change by 2030 – will cost a lot of money.

zh: 所需资金总额将远远超过政府的供应能力，而且官方发展援助也无法弥补现在每年高达1320亿美元的差额。
en: The total will be far more than governments can make available, and the gap cannot be closed by official development assistance, now at $132 billion per year.

zh: 私营领域以及完成升级的金融市场将发挥关键作用。
en: The private sector, as well as updated financial markets, will be essential.

zh: 直到不久前，政府和国际机构在全球发展和可持续议程中所起的作用相对明确，而私营领域对进程的参与却往往只涉及对经济增长、就业机会创造和税收收入的贡献情况。
en: Until recently, international organizations and governments had relatively well-defined roles in the global development and sustainability agenda, whereas the private sector’s participation in the process was often viewed through the lens of its contributions to economic growth, job creation, and tax revenue.

zh: 这样的情况现在必须改变。 私营部门必须在发展议程中承担更广泛的综合责任。
en: That must now change, with the private sector taking on a broader, more integrated role in the development agenda.

zh: 私营领域可以扮演金融家，将数万亿美元的资金转移到发展中经济体。
en: The private sector can become a financier, shifting trillions of dollars of capital toward developing economies.

zh: 同时它可以扮演执行者的重要角色，将利润转化为持续经济增长、社会包容和环境保护。
en: And it can play an important role as an implementer, translating profits into sustained economic growth, social inclusion, and environmental protection.

zh: 支撑上述措施的原则来源于12.6可持续发展目标，该目标鼓励“企业、尤其是大型和跨国企业采取可以持续的做法，并将可持续发展信息纳入它们的周期报告。 ”
en: The principles underpinning such measures are anchored in SDG target 12.6, which encourages “companies, especially large and transnational companies, to adopt sustainable practices and to integrate sustainability information into their reporting cycle.”

zh: 金融和资产管理机构可以积极鼓励这样的企业 — — 这些企业通过按相应的方法分配资产将可持续发展、长期思维及环境、社会、治理（ESG）绩效标准纳入到自身的核心业务模式之中。
en: Financial and asset-management institutions can provide positive incentives to such companies – those that incorporate sustainability, long-term thinking, and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance criteria in core business models – by allocating assets accordingly.

zh: 这样的举措将非常有助于促进可持续发展目标的长期进步。
en: Such a move would go a long way toward promoting long-term progress on the SDGs.

zh: 幸运的是，很多企业已经符合这样的描述。
en: Fortunately, many companies already fit this description.

zh: 由联合国全球契约组织和埃森哲公司进行的2016年首席执行官调查表明很多企业领导人已经将解决“社会挑战视为争取竞争优势的核心要素 ” 。
en: A 2016 survey of CEOs, conducted by the United Nations Global Compact and Accenture showed that many business leaders already view solving “societal challenges as a core element in the search for competitive advantage.”

zh: 而且近半数受访的首席执行官认为“企业将成为实现可持续发展目标唯一最重要的行动者。 ”
en: And almost half of all CEOs surveyed believe that “business will be the single most important actor in delivering the SDGs.”

zh: 穆迪最近发表的一份报告显示，机构投资者对气候变化及可持续发展相关投资的兴趣近年来迅速攀升。
en: According to a recent report published by Moody’s, interest in investments relating to climate change and sustainable development by institutional investors has grown rapidly in recent years.

zh: 现在，具备长期环境、社会和治理经验的机构投资者，如加利福尼亚公共雇员退休体系(CalPERS ) ， 正在吸引越来越多的同道者加入。
en: Now, institutional investors with long histories of ESG investments, such as the California Public Employees’ Retirement System (CalPERS), are being joined by a growing number of their peers.

zh: 其中有些甚至选择退出可能对可持续发展构成挑战的行业及商业投资机会。
en: Some are even opting to divest from any company with exposure to industries or business practices that present sustainability challenges.

zh: 这种可持续投资趋势无疑将不断加快。
en: This trend toward sustainable investment will undoubtedly accelerate.

zh: 但即使没有这项协议，上述投资的吸引力依然存在：证据显示如果能明智地执行、透明地衡量及报告环境、社会和治理因素，就有可能使得投资超越企业和投资者双方的预期。
en: But, even without the agreement, the appeal of such investments stands: evidence indicates that integration of ESG considerations – when implemented intelligently and measured and reported transparently – could help investments outperform expectations, for both companies and investors.

zh: 如果辅之以金融市场的激励机制，就有可能吸引大量资本流入环境、社会和治理投资。
en: Add to that financial-market incentives, and huge amounts of capital could be attracted to ESG investments.

zh: 尽管如此，依然存在着重大挑战，包括不确定的业绩预期以及不断变化的披露机制。
en: Nonetheless, significant challenges remain, including uncertain performance expectations and evolving disclosure regimes.

zh: 尽管金融产品创新不断引导环境、社会和治理投资，但绿色债券等环境、社会和治理金融工具的供应却依然不足。
en: Despite innovation in the financial products channeling ESG investment, the supply of ESG instruments, such as green bonds, remains insufficient.

zh: 还有一个难题关乎数据。
en: Another challenge relates to data.

zh: 准确的环境、社会和治理投资数据不可或缺，因为投资者和企业需要借此来确定他们在这一领域的支出是否将促进还是阻碍可持续发展目标的实现。
en: Good data on ESG investment are indispensable, as they enable investors and companies to determine whether their outlays in this area will promote or impede the achievement of the SDGs.

zh: 为达到这一目的，我们需要建立一套健全、透明的报告框架，让企业报告财务及非财务业绩。
en: To this end, we need to develop a robust, transparent reporting framework that allows companies to report on financial and non-financial performance.

zh: 这套框架还必须有益于私人部门及投资者将利润最大化与追求长期经济、社会和环境目标相结合。
en: That framework must also support the private sector and investors in their effort to combine profit maximization with the pursuit of long-term economic, social, and environmental objectives.

zh: 综合企业报告和披露重要环境、社会、治理信息可以有助于建立一套高效的金融系统，促进可持续经济增长，并同时辅助实现可持续发展目标。
en: Integrated corporate reporting and disclosure of material ESG information can facilitate the creation of an efficient financial system that advances sustainable economic growth, while supporting achievement of the SDGs.

zh: 目前正由全球报告倡议组织（GRI ） 、 可持续发展会计标准委员会（SASB）和 国际综合报告委员会（IIRC）等若干国家和国际机构领导上述综合报告框架的制定工作。
en: The development of such an integrated reporting framework currently is being led by a few national and international organizations, such as the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI), the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB), and the International Integrated Reporting Council (IIRC).

zh: 它们的主要目标是使企业和机构能够制定可持续发展目标和关键绩效指标；监测、编写和公布衡量经济和环境、社会、治理绩效的比较数据；并将可持续生产和消费惯例纳入到企业的商业战略和模式当中。
en: Their main objectives are to enable companies and organizations to set sustainability targets and key performance indicators; to monitor, prepare, and disclose comparative data measuring their economic and ESG performance; and to integrate sustainable production and consumption practices in company business strategies and models.

zh: 全球对这个问题的认识正越来越明确。
en: Global awareness of this topic is growing.

zh: 最近，英国央行行长兼G20金融稳定委员会主席马克·卡尼和前纽约市市长兼彭博社首席执行官迈克尔·布隆伯格发布了关于气候市场数据的声明。
en: Recently, Mark Carney, Governor of the Bank of England and Chairman of the G20’s Financial Stability Board, and Michael Bloomberg, a former New York City mayor and CEO of Bloomberg LP, issued an announcement regarding market data on climate.

zh: 但鉴于这项任务的艰巨性，必须确保与相关标准制定者、监管者和专业机构有效协调，一致推进这项工作。
en: Given the magnitude of the task, however, it is important also to ensure effective coordination and harmonization of these efforts with the relevant standard-setters, regulators, and professional organizations.

zh: 例如，美国证券交易委员会已经在探讨这些问题，并同时分析响应投资者和企业环境、社会、治理需求的备选政策。
en: The US Securities and Exchange Commission, for one, is already discussing these issues, as it analyzes options to respond to investor and business needs regarding ESG.

zh: 全新环境、社会和治理报告框架有助于吸引数十亿美元的机构投资，助力实现可持续发展目标的工作。
en: New ESG reporting frameworks can help to attract billions of dollars from institutional investors to support the effort to achieve the SDGs.

zh: 但这只是公共和私人部门共同努力、寻找推进可持续发展目标机会的一个实例。
en: But that is only one example of how the public and private sectors can work together to identify opportunities to advance the SDGs.

zh: 如果我们对上述可能性善加利用，公共及私营部门合作可以让数百万人摆脱贫困，并协助建设一个更加和平、繁荣和安全的世界。
en: If we take advantage of these possibilities, public-private cooperation can enable millions of people to lift themselves out of poverty and help to build a more peaceful, prosperous, and secure world.

zh: 金融的下一阶段
en: The Next Phase of Finance

zh: 华盛顿—全球金融危机以来的十年是喧嚣的十年。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The decade since the global financial crisis has been tumultuous, to say the least.

zh: 诚然，大战并未爆发，我们也或多或少避免了大萧条的错误 — — 这些错误曾在20世纪30年代导致保护主义抬头、银行倒闭、严厉紧缩和通缩环境。
en: True, no great war has erupted, and we have more or less avoided the mistakes of the Great Depression, which led in the 1930s to greater protectionism, bank failures, severe austerity, and a deflationary environment.

zh: 但新浮现的市场紧张表明，这些风险只是被掩盖，并未被消除。
en: But renewed market tensions indicate that these risks have not been eradicated so much as papered over.

zh: 从某种程度上说，2008年金融危机的故事始于从二战废墟上建立起来的世界秩序。
en: In a sense, the story of the 2008 financial crisis begins when the global order was created from the ashes of World War II.

zh: 布雷顿森林机构（世界银行和国际货币基金组织 ） 、 马歇尔计划、欧洲经济共同体等项目支持了世界经济重要部分的复兴。
en: Initiatives like the Bretton Woods institutions (the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund), the Marshall Plan, and the European Economic Community supported the reconstruction of significant portions of the world economy.

zh: 尽管发生了冷战（或者说，也许因为冷战 ） ， 它们仍然重新启动了因二战而陷入停顿的全球化。
en: Despite the Cold War (or perhaps because of it), they also re-started the globalization that WWII had brought to a halt.

zh: 20世纪六七十年代的越南战争、美元停止兑换黄金、1973年石油价格冲击以及大滞涨等事件对全球化进程形成了干扰。
en: This globalization process was interrupted during the late 1960s and early 1970s, owing to the Vietnam War, the suspension of the US dollar’s convertibility into gold, the 1973 oil price shock, and the great stagflation.

zh: 但随后美国和英国经历了某种保守主义革命，新自由主义经济政策得到复兴，包括全面去监管化、贸易自由化和前所未有的资本账户开放。
en: But the United States and the United Kingdom then underwent a kind of conservative revolution and a revival of neoliberal economic policies, including widespread deregulation, trade liberalization, and unprecedented capital-account openness.

zh: 这一重新设计的全球化进程助长了增长和发展，但其影响的分布并不均匀，其所带来的金融和经济变化超过了法律和伦理的适应速度。
en: While this redesigned globalization process helped to fuel growth and development, its effects were uneven, and the financial and economic changes it wrought outpaced legal and ethical adaptation.

zh: 后果尤其严重的是，创新性金融工具使用起来肆无忌惮，只受到非常宽松的监督和微弱的监管。
en: Particularly consequential, innovative financial instruments were used with abandon, subject to only loose supervision and weak regulation.

zh: 结果，金融最终成为世界经济的主人而不是佣人。
en: As a result, finance eventually became the master of the world economy, rather than its servant.

zh: 因为这一切，危机一爆发便造成了深刻而深远的影响，而眼下正在不断强化的经济复苏并没有克服危机之后可理解但灾难性的金融体系信任损失。
en: Given all of this, when the crisis struck, it was deep and far-reaching, and today’s strengthening economic recovery has not overcome the understandable but devastating loss of trust in the financial system that followed.

zh: 美国和欧洲的政治局势发展清楚地说明了这一点。
en: This has been made apparent by political developments in the US and Europe.

zh: 美国总统特朗普政府一直在鼓吹“美国优先”政策方针，最近更是对钢铁和铝进口实施高额关税。
en: US President Donald Trump’s administration continues to tout an “America First” policy approach, reflected, most recently, in the imposition of large tariffs on steel and aluminum imports.

zh: 英国退欧投票也反映了类似的对全球化的反动。
en: The United Kingdom’s vote for Brexit reflects a similar backlash.

zh: 与此同时，国家领导的资本主义为中国经济提供了自己的保护。
en: Meanwhile, state-led capitalism offers China’s economy its own protections.

zh: 但极化新竞争模式和抵制贸易并非恢复信心之道。
en: But polarizing new models of competition and resistance to trade are not the way to restore trust.

zh: 相反，我们需要重新控制金融业，以确保它服务于经济而不是相反，这可以通过推动一系列基于世界共识的目标实现 — — 首先就是2015年的三次重要会议所确定的目标。
en: Instead, we need to reassert control over the financial sector, to ensure that it is serving the economy, not vice versa, by advancing a set of goals upon which the world agrees – beginning with those established at three momentous conferences in 2015.

zh: 在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴举行的第三节发展融资国际会议（International Conference on Financing for Development）上，与会者为融资流和可持续发展政策制定了经济、社会和环境方面的协调重点。
en: At the Third International Conference on Financing for Development, held in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, participants set economic, social, and environmental priorities with which financing flows and policies for sustainable development should be aligned.

zh: 在纽约举行的联合国可持续发展峰会上，联合国成员国正式通过了一项雄心勃勃的新全球日程。
en: At the United Nations Sustainable Development Summit in New York, UN member countries formally adopted an ambitious new global agenda.

zh: 在巴黎联合国气候会议（COP 21）上各国同意将全球变暖幅度限制在前工业化水平以上2℃以内。
en: And at the UN Climate Change Conference (COP 21) in Paris, countries agreed to hold global warming well below 2° Celsius above pre-industrial levels.

zh: 制定这些目标是重要的第一步。
en: Articulating these goals was an important first step.

zh: 但如果世界真正想要实现这些共同目标，就必须建立有效的融资机制，以能够创造正确激励的合理的监管为支撑。
en: But if the world is serious about achieving these shared goals, an effective mechanism for financing them must be established, supported by well-designed regulations that create the right incentives.

zh: 目前，世界在这方面的进展仍然不足，资本配置的不合理就是明证。
en: And, so far, the world has not made nearly enough progress on this front, as the continued misallocation of capital shows.

zh: 相关利益者应该从长远考虑企业经营和投资策略。
en: Stakeholders must take a longer-term view of business operations and investment strategies.

zh: 金融必须派上真正的用场，实现（在已有全球目标的指引下）朝向共同目标的进展与形成足够财务回报以确保进展可持续的需要之间的平衡。
en: Finance must be made genuinely useful, balancing progress toward agreed goals – guided by existing global targets – with the need to generate sufficient financial returns to ensure that progress is sustainable.

zh: 我们必须不断强调、不断践行。
en: We must keep saying it, and keep doing it.

zh: 没有其他选择。
en: There is no other option.

zh: 在某些领域，对全球目标的承诺仍然不够。
en: In some quarters, commitment to global goals has so far been too weak.

zh: 以美国和巴黎气候协定为例，美国已经完全撤销了自己的承诺。
en: In the case of the US and the Paris climate agreement, that commitment has been rescinded outright.

zh: 但要想成功，所有人都必须坐上一条船。
en: But, to succeed, everyone must be on board.

zh: 这其中包括多边贷款人，它们需要改造就工具，迅速开发新工具，以动员私人部门资本。
en: This includes multilateral lenders, which need to revise old tools and rapidly develop new ones, in order to mobilize private-sector capital.

zh: 至于私人部门，必须保持开放态度，以全新方针对待公司合作。
en: The private sector, for its part, must be open to an updated approach to public-private partnerships.

zh: 嘴上言必称变革，实际上却死守过时的工作模式不可取。
en: Simply paying lip service to change, while clinging to outdated modes of working, is not an option.

zh: 更广泛而言，我们需要致力于确保技术的收益被所有人所共享。
en: More broadly, we need to work to ensure that the benefits of technology are shared by all.

zh: 在这方面，我们应该遵循IMF第一副总裁大卫·利普顿（David Lipton）的建议，超越流行的“OHIO ” （ 自扫门前雪）方针，转向要求更高的加州（CA）策略 — — “集体行动 ” 。
en: To that end, we should follow the advice of David Lipton, the IMF’s first deputy managing director, and move beyond the fashionable “OHIO” approach, focused on getting one’s “own house in order,” to the more demanding California – or “CA” – strategy of “collective action.”

zh: 前路坎坷。
en: The path ahead will not be easy.

zh: 但这不是消极的理由。
en: But this is no excuse for apathy.

zh: 作为投资者、消费者、选民和公民，我们必须让我们的声音被听见，以确保金融被用来增进共同价值观和共同利益。
en: As investors, consumers, voters, and citizens, we must make our voices heard, in order to ensure that finance is used to promote shared values and the common good.

zh: 惟其如此，我们才能够不仅避免另一场灾难性危机，还能构建更好的未来。
en: Only then can we go beyond merely avoiding another devastating crisis and build a better future.

zh: 关于美国金融改革，谁才是对的?
en: Who’s Right on US Financial Reform?

zh: 坎布里奇—八年前，美国引发了一场几乎让全球金融体系破产的危机，如今，美国仍然没有弄清楚需要怎样的改革防止危机再次发生。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Eight years after triggering a crisis that nearly brought down the global financial system, the United States remains plagued by confusion about what reforms are needed to prevent it from happening again.

zh: 美国人正在准备选举下一任总统，急需更好地认识能让未来危机风险最小化的政策变革 — — 以及最有可能实施这些变革的政客。
en: As Americans prepare to choose their next president, a better understanding of the policy changes that would minimize the risk of future crises – and which politicians are most likely to implement them – is urgently needed.

zh: 美国人可以确定的是他们对金融业愤怒不已。
en: What Americans are sure about is that they are angry with the financial sector.

zh: 《大空头 》 （ The Big Short）等好莱坞芯片的大热就是明证 （ 《 大空头》获得广泛赞誉，认为它让金融衍生品等复杂工具变得通俗易懂，这是正确的 ） 。
en: This is reflected in the success of recent Hollywood movies such as The Big Short (which has been rightly praised for making complex instruments like derivatives broadly understandable).

zh: 最近的总统选战 — — 其中最引人关注的是伯尔尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）参议员为竞选民主党提名而提出的左倾方案受到广泛支持 — — 也是明证。
en: And it is reflected in the current presidential campaign – most notably, in remarkable support for Senator Bernie Sanders’s leftist bid for the Democratic nomination.

zh: 桑德斯阵营提出的核心方案是将华尔街大银行分解成小机构，从而确保任何银行都不会过于庞大以至于其倒闭会危及金融体系的其他部分。
en: At the center of Sanders’s campaign is a proposal to break up the big Wall Street banks into little pieces, thereby ensuring that no bank is so big that its failure would endanger the rest of the financial system.

zh: 这一目标的号召力不难理解。
en: The appeal of that goal is understandable.

zh: 但实现这一点需要大刀阔斧的改革。
en: But achieving it would require a massive sledgehammer.
